templates.title: Epic Fantasy Monkey King Battle

The dynamic scene features flying sparks, shattered debris, and flowing fabric. The background is a {argument name="setting" default="heavenly realm with ornate pillars and clouds"}, showing distant warriors on grand staircases. Cinematic lighting, intense action, and dramatic particle effects.

templates.title: Photorealistic Reclining Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 照片级写实躺姿肖像

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, photorealistic portrait of a {argument name="subject description" default="beautiful young Asian woman"} reclining gracefully on a {argument name="furniture" default="white modern sofa"}. She is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="short white silk slip dress"} with thin straps, her {argument name="hair style" default="long wavy dark brown hair"} cascading softly over a white pillow. Her pose is relaxed and intimate, with one arm raised elegantly above her head and the other hand resting gently on her stomach, as she gazes directly at the camera with a soft, alluring expression. The scene is illuminated by {argument name="lighting style" default="soft natural sunlight streaming through a window"}, casting gentle, diffused shadows across her flawless skin and the pristine white upholstery. templates.prompt: An anime-style illustration of a {argument name="action type" default="high-impact martial arts battle"} between two young female fighters in a {argument name="setting" default="traditional wooden martial arts dojo"}. templates.title: Cross-Device Social Media Feed

titleLocalized.zh: 跨设备社交媒体信息流

templates.prompt: A realistic over-the-shoulder shot of a person with dark hair wearing a grey shirt, sitting at a desk and looking at a large computer monitor while holding a black smartphone. On the desk in the bottom left corner is a {argument name="drink on desk" default="white mug filled with black coffee"}. The monitor displays a split-screen social media interface. The left column has the header "{argument name="left column header" default="English Post"}" with blurred-out feed items below it. The right column is in sharp focus with the header "{argument name="right column header" default="中文文案"}". Below this right header are 2 distinct social media posts: the top post features an avatar, pseudo-Chinese text, {argument name="first post image" default="a landscape photo of a mountain lake"}, and a heart icon with "2.5K"; the bottom post features an avatar, pseudo-Chinese text, {argument name="second post image" default="a photo of dumplings on a plate"}, and a heart icon with "1.8K". The person is holding the smartphone in their left hand and tapping the screen with their right index finger. The phone screen displays the exact same mountain lake social media post seen on the monitor. The image has a shallow depth of field, blurring the left side of the screen to emphasize the right column and the phone.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的肩后视角照片，画面中是一位留着深色头发、身穿灰色衬衫的人，正坐在桌前看着一台大型电脑显示器，手中拿着一部黑色智能手机。桌子左下角放着一个 {argument name="drink on desk" default="装满黑咖啡的白色马克杯"}。显示器上呈现出分屏式的社交媒体界面。左侧栏标题为 "{argument name="left column header" default="英文帖"}"，下方是模糊的信息流内容。右侧栏处于清晰对焦状态，标题为 "{argument name="right column header" default="中文文案"}"。右侧标题下方有 2 条不同的社交媒体帖子：上方帖子包含头像、伪中文文本、{argument name="first post image" default="一张山间湖泊的风景照"} 以及显示 "2.5K" 的心形图标；下方帖子包含头像、伪中文文本、{argument name="second post image" default="一张盘中饺子的照片"} 以及显示 "1.8K" 的心形图标。此人左手拿着智能手机，右手食指正在点击屏幕。手机屏幕上显示的内容与显示器上看到的山间湖泊社交媒体帖子完全一致。图像具有浅景深效果，屏幕左侧经过模糊处理，以突出右侧栏和手机画面。

templates.prompt: A photorealistic fashion magazine cover featuring a portrait of a beautiful young Asian woman. She has {argument name="hair style" default="light brown hair with blonde highlights and a braided crown"}, soft elegant makeup, and a gentle expression. She is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="white ribbed off-the-shoulder top with spaghetti straps"} and delicate gold drop earrings. The background is a soft, textured neutral gray. templates.title: CCTV Security Camera Footage

templates.prompt: A genuinely low-quality, grainy, black-and-white CCTV security camera still showing a {argument name="subject" default="classic grey alien with a large head and skinny body"} standing next to a gas pump at a {argument name="setting" default="deserted gas station at night"}. The gas pump has the word "UNLEADED" printed on the top canopy and a large number "2" on the side. In the bottom left corner, there is a digital timestamp overlay reading "{argument name="camera label" default="CAM 2"}", "{argument name="date" default="OCT 27 2004"}", and "12:04:16 AM" in a retro pixelated font. The overall aesthetic is authentic early-2000s surveillance footage with heavy noise, poor contrast, and VHS-style artifacts.

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, generate a {argument name="number of panels" default="4"}-panel studio-style character sheet. The generated grid must show the exact same character, wearing the preserved white lace camisole and heart necklace, in {argument name="number of panels" default="4"} distinct poses: 1) straight-on front view, 2) right profile view, 3) left 3/4 view looking over the shoulder, and 4) right 3/4 view looking slightly down.

templates.title: Calligraphic City Impression Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 书法城市印象海报

templates.prompt: 【Background and Skeleton Lines】 Deep black background, a thick and powerful ink calligraphy S-shaped curve winding across the screen, vigorous strokes with varied ink density, forming the visual skeleton and narrative flow. 【Subject: {argument name="subject bird" default="thrush"}】 Above the curve, a {argument name="subject bird" default="thrush"} with wings spread occupies the visual core; the body is transparent like glass, reflecting traditional architectural layers inside with blue-green light streams; the outline is edged with fine gold lines. 【Mid-ground: Classical Architectural Sequence】 Below the bird, various scenic spots of {argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} are scattered along the ink line: Baiyun Mountain, Chen Clan Ancestral Hall, and the Canton Tower; the main tones are blue-green and pale gold with clear architectural details; Kapok flowers and ink-wash clouds add ethereal layers. 【Foreground: White Cranes and Water Surface】 Lakeside foreground: several white cranes in various elegant poses; the light blue water is mirror-like with sparkling light, creating a serene atmosphere. 【Background: Mountains】 Distant mountains rise and fall in indigo ink shading from thick to light, creating depth of field. 【Composition and Lighting】 Non-linear perspective with the ink curve as the axis; light radiates from the center creating strong contrast; cool tones dominate with warm accents; fusion of Eastern aesthetics and modern imagery. 【Technical Specs】 8K Ultra HD rendering, extreme detail precision, best quality, ratio {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

promptLocalized.zh: 【背景与骨架线条】 深黑色背景，一条厚重有力的水墨书法 S 型曲线蜿蜒贯穿画面，笔触雄浑且墨色浓淡相间，构成了视觉骨架与叙事流动。 【主体：{argument name="subject bird" default="画眉鸟"}】 曲线之上，一只 {argument name="subject bird" default="画眉鸟"} 展翅占据视觉核心；身体如玻璃般透明，内部映射出层叠的传统建筑与青绿色光流；轮廓边缘勾勒着精细的金线。 【中景：古典建筑序列】 鸟身下方，{argument name="city" default="广州"} 的多处景点沿墨线错落分布：白云山、陈家祠和广州塔；主色调为青绿色与淡金色，建筑细节清晰；木棉花与水墨云雾增添了空灵的层次感。 【前景：白鹤与水面】 湖畔前景：几只姿态优雅的白鹤；浅蓝色的水面如镜面般波光粼粼，营造出宁静的氛围。 【背景：山峦】 远山在靛青色的水墨晕染下起伏，由浓转淡，营造出景深感。 【构图与光影】 以墨色曲线为轴的非线性透视；光线从中心向外辐射，形成强烈的对比；冷色调为主，暖色点缀；融合了东方美学与现代意象。 【技术规格】 8K 超高清渲染，极致细节精度，最佳画质，比例 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

templates.title: Wireframe to Corporate Web Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 从线框图到企业网页横幅

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a wireframe layout, generate a polished, professional corporate web banner ad for an AI sales tool. Use a clean blue, white, and orange color palette. Transform the sketched character into a photorealistic image of 2 smiling Japanese business professionals (a man and a woman in suits) looking at a silver laptop in a bright office. In the top left, add a logo for {argument name="brand name" default="KAWAISALES"} with a small tagline 'AIを活用した新しい営業支援ツール'. Map the wireframe's text bubbles as follows: replace the top bubble with a white oval containing the blue text {argument name="main copy" default="その営業、AIで「飛躍」しませんか？"}; replace the middle bubble with {argument name="sub copy" default="リード獲得からクロージングまでAIがあなたの営業活動を強力サポート！"}. Replace the bottom CTA box with a bright orange pill-shaped button reading {argument name="cta text" default="今すぐ 無料デモを体験する >"}. In the lower-right center, add a blue 3D-style bar chart with an upward arrow, accompanied by a target icon showing 3 user silhouettes and a white UI card with 4 checkmarked bullet points. Finally, add a white panel in the bottom left containing exactly 3 blue line-art icons (a clock, a rising chart, and a laptop) with short captions below each.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为线框布局，为一款 AI 销售工具生成一个精致、专业的企业网页横幅广告。使用简洁的蓝色、白色和橙色调色板。将草图中的人物转换为 2 位面带微笑的日本商务专业人士（身穿西装的男女）的逼真图像，他们在明亮的办公室里看着一台银色笔记本电脑。在左上角，添加 {argument name="brand name" default="KAWAISALES"} 的标志，并附带小标语“AIを活用した新しい営業支援ツール”。将线框图中的文本气泡映射如下：将顶部气泡替换为包含蓝色文本 {argument name="main copy" default="その営業、AIで「飛躍」しませんか？"} 的白色椭圆形；将中间气泡替换为 {argument name="sub copy" default="リード獲得からクロージングまでAIがあなたの営業活動を強力サポート！"}。将底部的 CTA 框替换为亮橙色的药丸状按钮，文字为 {argument name="cta text" default="今すぐ 無料デモを体験する >"}。在右下中心处，添加一个带有向上箭头的蓝色 3D 风格柱状图，并配有一个显示 3 个用户剪影的目标图标，以及一张带有 4 个勾选要点的白色 UI 卡片。最后，在左下角添加一个白色面板，其中包含 3 个蓝色线条艺术图标（时钟、上升图表和笔记本电脑），并在每个图标下方配有简短说明。

templates.title: 3D Anime Visual Novel Game Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 动漫视觉小说游戏封面

templates.prompt: A 3D anime-style illustration of four high school girls in a Japanese classroom bathed in {argument name="lighting" default="warm afternoon sunlight"}. In the foreground on the right, a girl with {argument name="foreground right character hair" default="long coral-brown hair in a ponytail with a white bow"} and green eyes reaches her hand out towards the viewer with a warm smile. In the foreground on the left, a girl with {argument name="foreground left character hair" default="short pink hair with red hairclips"} and pink eyes stands with her arms crossed, looking slightly annoyed. In the midground, a girl with long dark purple hair stands calmly holding a book, while in the background, a girl with short coral-pink hair and a red bow waves cheerfully. All four girls wear matching school uniforms consisting of {argument name="uniform style" default="grey blazers, brown sweater vests, red ribbons, and blue pleated skirts"}. The classroom features wooden floors, desks, and a green chalkboard. In the top left corner, there is a circular logo with a pink border containing the stylized text "{argument name="logo text" default="DOKI DOKI Literature Club!"}" and a large pink "3D" below it, decorated with a green pencil and a pink heart. The image has a high-quality 3D render aesthetic, resembling video game promotional art with soft lighting and depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 3D 动漫风格的插画，展示了四名女高中生身处日本教室中，沐浴在 {argument name="lighting" default="温暖的午后阳光"} 下。在右侧前景中，一位留着 {argument name="foreground right character hair" default="系着白色蝴蝶结的珊瑚棕色长马尾"}、拥有绿色眼睛的女孩带着温暖的微笑向观众伸出手。在左侧前景中，一位留着 {argument name="foreground left character hair" default="粉色短发配红色发夹"}、拥有粉色眼睛的女孩双臂交叉站立，表情略显烦恼。在中景处，一位留着深紫色长发的女孩平静地拿着一本书站着；而在背景中，一位留着珊瑚粉色短发、系着红色蝴蝶结的女孩正愉快地挥手。四名女孩都穿着统一的校服，包括 {argument name="uniform style" default="灰色西装外套、棕色针织背心、红色丝带和蓝色百褶裙"}。教室里有木地板、课桌和一块绿色黑板。左上角有一个带有粉色边框的圆形 Logo，其中包含程式化的文字“{argument name="logo text" default="DOKI DOKI Literature Club!"}”，下方是一个巨大的粉色“3D”字样，并装饰着一支绿色铅笔和一个粉色爱心。整张图片具有高质量的 3D 渲染美感，类似于带有柔和光影和景深效果的电子游戏宣传艺术图。

templates.title: Anime VTuber Live Stream Overlay

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 VTuber 直播界面覆盖图

templates.prompt: An anime-style illustration of a cute {argument name="animal type" default="tanuki"}-girl VTuber streaming live. She has dark skin, short white bob hair, fluffy brown animal ears, large brown eyes, and a fluffy striped tail. She is smiling happily with her mouth open and waving at the camera with her left hand. She is wearing a black and white maid outfit with frilly white trim, a white apron with a light green waistband, and a green ribbon choker with a golden bell. The background is a cozy, softly lit room with bokeh effects, featuring a glowing pink neon heart on the wall. To her left is a professional black studio microphone on a stand, and behind it is a computer monitor displaying a pink chat interface. A small {argument name="plushie type" default="tanuki plushie"} sits on the desk next to the microphone. The image features a streaming UI overlay with 3 distinct components: a red badge in the top left reading "{argument name="top left badge" default="LIVE"}", a pink badge in the top right reading "{argument name="top right badge" default="ON AIR"}" with a heart icon, and a semi-transparent dark grey chat box in the bottom left containing exactly 3 messages. The first message has a green heart and the text "Cute!", the second has a green heart and the text "Warm~!", and the third says "{argument name="chat message" default="Love"}" with two green hearts.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫风格的可爱 {argument name="animal type" default="狸猫"}-娘 VTuber 直播插图。她有着深色皮肤、白色短波波头、毛茸茸的棕色动物耳朵、棕色大眼睛以及一条毛茸茸的条纹尾巴。她正开心地张嘴微笑，左手对着镜头挥手。她身穿黑白相间的女仆装，配有荷叶边装饰、带有浅绿色腰带的白色围裙，以及系着金色铃铛的绿色丝带项圈。背景是一个温馨、光线柔和且带有光斑效果的房间，墙上挂着一个发光的粉色霓虹爱心。她的左侧是一个放在支架上的专业黑色录音室麦克风，麦克风后方是一台显示着粉色聊天界面的电脑显示器。桌上麦克风旁边放着一个小的 {argument name="plushie type" default="狸猫玩偶"}。图像包含一个直播 UI 覆盖层，由 3 个独立组件组成：左上角是一个写着“{argument name="top left badge" default="LIVE"}”的红色徽章，右上角是一个带有爱心图标并写着“{argument name="top right badge" default="ON AIR"}”的粉色徽章，左下角是一个半透明的深灰色聊天框，其中包含 3 条消息。第一条消息带有绿色爱心和文字“Cute!”，第二条带有绿色爱心和文字“Warm~!”，第三条写着“{argument name="chat message" default="Love"}”并配有两个绿色爱心。

The man on the left has white hair and a full white beard, wearing a {argument name="man's clothing" default="green fleece jacket"} over a maroon shirt. The woman on the right has short grey hair and glasses, wearing a {argument name="woman's clothing" default="blue denim jacket and cream scarf"}. They are looking directly at the camera, each holding one of the 2 {argument name="beverage" default="glasses of beer"}. On the table in the foreground, there is 1 small lit brass lantern and 1 {argument name="table snacks" default="bowl of potato chips"}. The background features warm lighting, wooden paneled walls with framed pictures, windows on the left, and blurred patrons, creating a shallow depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的肖像，一对面带微笑的老年夫妇正坐在 {argument name="setting" default="温馨传统酒馆"} 内一张质朴的木桌旁。左侧的男士留着白发和浓密的白胡子，身穿一件 {argument name="man's clothing" default="橄榄绿抓绒夹克"}。右侧的女士留着灰色短发并戴着眼镜，身穿 {argument name="woman's clothing" default="蓝色牛仔夹克和白色围巾"}。他们都直视镜头，每人手中各拿着一杯 {argument name="beverage" default="品脱啤酒"}。桌子前方放着一 {argument name="table snack" default="碗薯片"} 和一盏点亮的小型复古灯笼。背景呈现出温暖诱人的灯光，采用浅景深效果，虚化了木镶板墙壁、挂框照片以及其他几位顾客。

templates.title: Anime Starry Night Sky with Custom Neon Text

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格星空与自定义文字

templates.prompt: A breathtaking anime-style landscape featuring a vibrant, starry night sky dominated by a brilliant, sweeping Milky Way in hues of deep purple, blue, and magenta. Two prominent shooting stars, one glowing bright blue and the other a softer pinkish-red, streak downwards across the sky, their tails intersecting. In the center of the sky, written in elegant, glowing cursive neon-like script, is the text "{argument name="custom text" default="Your Name"}", underlined by a delicate pink line that forms a small bow in the middle. Below, a serene landscape unfolds with dark, silhouetted clouds framing the edges. A distant town with glowing city lights sits nestled along the shores of a calm lake, reflecting the twilight colors of the horizon where the sun has just set, leaving a gradient of pink and orange. The foreground features dark silhouettes of grassy hills and subtle hints of purple flowers, adding depth to this magical, cinematic scene reminiscent of Makoto Shinkai's art style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅令人惊叹且细节丰富的风景插画，采用 {argument name="art style" default="新海诚动漫背景风格"}。场景展现了广阔壮丽的夜空，繁星点点，银河带呈现出 {argument name="sky color palette" default="深蓝、紫色和粉色"} 的绚丽光芒。两颗发光的彗星，一颗明亮的蓝色和一颗较小的粉色彗星，在天空中斜向划过。在天空中央，文字“{argument name="display text" default="Your Name"}”以优雅的发光白色草书字体书写，下方有一条精致的粉色发光线条，系成一个小蝴蝶结，宛如命运的红线。地平线上方，橙色与粉色的日落渐变光芒映照着剪影云朵。中景是一片宁静的深色湖泊，倒映着城市灯光与暮色天空，四周环绕着山峦剪影。近景则是草坡与紫色小花的深色剪影。

templates.prompt: A first-person POV screenshot inside a {argument name="game environment" default="VRChat lobby"} featuring a dark checkered floor, a "VR CHAT" welcome sign on the left, a "Mirror" doorway, and an "Avatar Showcase" on the right. templates.title: Handwritten Japanese Study Notes

titleLocalized.zh: 手写日语学习笔记

templates.prompt: A top-down photorealistic image of an open lined notebook resting on a smooth wooden desk. A dark green HB pencil with a silver ferrule and white eraser lies diagonally on the desk to the right of the notebook. The notebook pages are filled with neat, handwritten text in pencil, resembling a student's study notes. On the left page, the top left corner reads {argument name="date" default="2024年5月20日(月)"} above {argument name="subject" default="国語 「枕草子」"}. Below this is a rectangular boxed heading reading {argument name="left page heading" default="清少納言のものの見方"}, followed by exactly three bulleted sentences: one about valuing the changes in nature and seasons, one about finding beauty and amusement in small everyday things, and one about being honest with one's senses while having a sense of humor. Further down is a cloud-shaped border containing a heading translated as 'Words that left an impression', followed by a famous classical quote about spring mornings and a brief explanation below it marked with an arrow. On the right page, the top section has the heading {argument name="right page heading" default="〈現代とのちがい〉"} with exactly two bulleted points: one noting that the perception of seasons is much more delicate than today, and another stating that the perspective is sensory and poetic. This is followed by an arrow pointing to a concluding thought about wanting to cherish this sensibility. Below this is another cloud-shaped border containing a heading translated as 'Summary' and a short paragraph about how the 1000-year-old text still resonates today and the importance of carefully observing nature. templates.prompt: A photorealistic, highly detailed portrait of a muscular {argument name="warrior culture" default="Mesoamerican"} warrior standing proudly. He wears an elaborate headdress adorned with {argument name="headdress feathers" default="red, green, and black feathers"} and a carved stone mask. His face features dark painted lines across his cheeks and nose. He is outfitted in heavy, intricate ceremonial armor, including a large stone necklace with a face pendant, armbands, and a detailed belt with a loincloth featuring carved glyphs and faces. In his right hand, he grips a {argument name="weapon" default="tall wooden spear with a stone tip and red tassels"}, and in his left hand, he holds a round shield displaying a large carved face with red fringed edges. The background features a towering {argument name="background structure" default="ancient stepped stone pyramid"} with steep stairs, banners hanging near the top entrance, and small figures standing on the steps. Lush green jungle foliage surrounds the temple under a partly cloudy sky, with a tall carved stone stela standing in the right foreground, all captured with {argument name="lighting style" default="epic cinematic lighting"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真、高度精细的肖像，描绘了一位肌肉发达的 {argument name="warrior culture" default="中美洲"} 战士自豪地站立着。他戴着装饰有 {argument name="headdress feathers" default="红色、绿色和黑色羽毛"} 的精致头饰以及雕刻的石面具。他的脸颊和鼻梁上有深色的彩绘线条。他身着厚重且复杂的礼仪盔甲，包括一条带有面部吊坠的大型石项链、臂环，以及一条带有雕刻符号和人脸图案的缠腰布的精致腰带。他的右手紧握着一把 {argument name="weapon" default="带有石制尖端和红色流苏的高大木矛"}，左手拿着一面圆盾，盾牌上展示着一张巨大的雕刻人脸，边缘带有红色流苏。背景是一座高耸的 {argument name="background structure" default="古代阶梯式石金字塔"}，有着陡峭的台阶，顶部入口附近悬挂着旗帜，台阶上站着一些小人影。郁郁葱葱的丛林植被环绕着神庙，天空半多云，右侧前景中矗立着一块高大的雕刻石碑，所有画面均以 {argument name="lighting style" default="史诗般的电影级灯光"} 呈现。

templates.prompt: A cinematic anime illustration of a mature woman looking into a dark mirror, but her reflection shows her as a young child. templates.prompt: A cinematic anime-style movie poster featuring an {argument name="character description" default="anime girl with short blue hair, blue cat ears, and a fluffy blue cat tail, wearing an oversized white t-shirt"}. Cover the surrounding street and buildings with {argument name="environment details" default="white and pink blossoms and intricate silver architectural elements"}. templates.prompt: A cinematic, high-quality advertisement poster featuring two older Asian men sitting at a rustic wooden table in a warmly lit, moody environment. The man on the left has grey hair and a mustache, smiling enthusiastically, holding one glass of dark soda with a Pepsi logo. The man on the right has short hair and round glasses, looking forward with a subtle smile, holding one glass of dark soda with a Coca-Cola logo. Between them is one large, steaming dark ceramic pot filled with {argument name="dish description" default="braised green beans and pork belly"}. On the table in the front left is one blue Pepsi can, and on the front right is one red Coca-Cola can. The poster features elegant, bold Chinese typography. At the top, a collaboration logo of Pepsi and Coca-Cola sits above the main headline {argument name="main headline" default="炖豆角 可乐"}. Vertical text on the left reads {argument name="left character text" default="赵本山 饰 马大帅 倾情代言"}. Vertical text on the right reads {argument name="right character text" default="范伟 饰 彪哥 倾情代言"}. At the bottom center, an ornate badge contains the tagline {argument name="bottom tagline" default="东北硬菜 遇见经典"}, with smaller fine print below it. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the steam rising from the food and the condensation on the cold drinks.

templates.title: Graffiti Sketch Style AI Builder

titleLocalized.zh: 涂鸦草图风格 AI Builder

templates.prompt: Express {argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"} in a graffiti sketch style, presenting an overall visual effect of quick outlines, free deformation, improvised hand-drawing, and draft-like sketches. The lines are casual, exaggerated, varying in thickness, and slightly messy but rhythmic and expressive, emphasizing generalization, exaggeration, fun, and spontaneity rather than rigorous realism or fine detail. The colors are expressed in rough blocks with a distinct dry-brush feel, retaining uneven smears, brush marks, fly-white, and layering. Colors automatically adapt to the {argument name="theme" default="powerful AI builder"}, but the overall expression remains graffiti-like, sketch-like, and generalized. No transparent watercolor smudging effects, no delicate watercolor transitions, no paper textures, no soft atomization, and no dreamy textures. The background is mainly white space, maintaining a sense of simplicity, ease, unfinishedness, and design. Small amounts of auxiliary symbols, arrows, marks, circles, repeated lines, handwritten text, or other graffiti elements can be added to enhance the sketchbook or essay-like visual language, but they should not be too crowded or destroy the subject and the white space atmosphere. The content of the picture does not need to be written in advance; {argument name="character image" default="a powerful AI builder"} will automatically deduce and generate the most suitable main image, actions, related elements, symbols, or simplified scenes. The overall style remains a unified graffiti sketch style and an exaggerated, generalized expression, avoiding complex realistic backgrounds and excessive detail. A special signature 'BlanPlan' should be naturally added as part of the picture, in a low-key but clear position such as the bottom left, bottom right, or near the title. The style should be unified with the overall layout, like an artist's signature or a design mark; the signature font should be exquisite, restrained, and high-end, not too large, and should not destroy the main composition or appear abrupt or cheap.

promptLocalized.zh: 以涂鸦草图风格表现 {argument name="subject" default="一个强大的 AI builder"}，呈现出快速勾勒、自由变形、即兴手绘和草稿般的视觉效果。线条随意、夸张、粗细不一，略显杂乱却富有节奏感和表现力，强调概括性、夸张感、趣味性和自发性，而非严谨的写实或精细细节。色彩以粗犷的色块呈现，具有明显的干笔触感，保留不均匀的涂抹、笔触、飞白和层叠感。色彩会自动适配 {argument name="theme" default="强大的 AI builder"}，但整体表达仍保持涂鸦、草图和概括化的风格。不使用透明水彩晕染效果、细腻的水彩过渡、纸张纹理、柔和的雾化或梦幻质感。背景以留白为主，保持简洁、轻松、未完成感和设计感。可以添加少量辅助符号、箭头、标记、圆圈、重复线条、手写文字或其他涂鸦元素，以增强速写本或随笔般的视觉语言，但不能过于拥挤，以免破坏主体和留白氛围。画面内容无需预先设定；{argument name="character image" default="一个强大的 AI builder"} 将自动推演并生成最合适的主体形象、动作、相关元素、符号或简化场景。整体风格保持统一的涂鸦草图感以及夸张、概括的表达，避免复杂的写实背景和过多的细节。画面中应自然地加入一个特殊的签名“BlanPlan”，位置低调但清晰，例如左下角、右下角或标题附近。签名风格应与整体布局统一，如同艺术家的签名或设计标记；签名字体应精致、克制且高级，不宜过大，且不能破坏主体构图，或显得突兀、廉价。

Colors automatically adapt to the {argument name="subject" default="theme/subject"}, but the overall expression remains graffiti-like, sketch-like, and generalized. No transparent watercolor smudging effects, no delicate watercolor transitions, no paper textures, no soft atomization, and no dreamy textures. The background is mainly white space, maintaining a sense of simplicity, ease, unfinishedness, and design. Small amounts of auxiliary symbols, arrows, marks, circles, repeated lines, handwritten text, or other graffiti elements can be added to enhance the sketchbook or essay-like visual language, but they should not be too crowded or destroy the subject and the white space atmosphere. The content of the picture does not need to be written in advance; {argument name="subject" default="theme/subject"} will automatically deduce and generate the most suitable main image, actions, related elements, symbols, or simplified scenes. The overall style remains a unified graffiti sketch style and an exaggerated, generalized expression, avoiding complex realistic backgrounds and excessive detail. A special signature 'voxcat' should be naturally added as part of the picture, in a low-key but clear position such as the bottom left, bottom right, or near the title. The style should be unified with the overall layout, like an artist's signature or a design mark; the signature font should be exquisite, restrained, and high-end, not too large, and should not destroy the main composition or appear abrupt or cheap.

promptLocalized.zh: 以涂鸦素描风格表现 {argument name="subject" default="主题/主体"}，呈现出快速勾勒、自由变形、即兴手绘和草稿般的整体视觉效果。线条随意、夸张、粗细不一，略显杂乱但富有节奏感和表现力，强调概括性、夸张感、趣味性和自发性，而非严谨的写实或精细的细节。色彩以粗犷的色块表现，具有明显的干笔触感，保留不均匀的涂抹、笔触、飞白和层叠感。色彩会自动适应 {argument name="subject" default="主题/主体"}，但整体表达保持涂鸦感、素描感和概括性。无透明水彩晕染效果，无细腻的水彩过渡，无纸张纹理，无柔和的雾化效果，无梦幻质感。背景以留白为主，保持简约、轻松、未完成感和设计感。可添加少量辅助符号、箭头、标记、圆圈、重复线条、手写文字或其他涂鸦元素，以增强速写本或随笔般的视觉语言，但不可过于拥挤，以免破坏主体和留白氛围。画面内容无需预先设定；{argument name="subject" default="主题/主体"} 将自动推演并生成最合适的主体形象、动作、相关元素、符号或简化场景。整体风格保持统一的涂鸦素描风格和夸张、概括的表达，避免复杂的写实背景和过多的细节。画面中应自然地加入特殊签名“voxcat”，位置低调但清晰，例如左下角、右下角或标题附近。签名风格应与整体布局统一，如同艺术家的签名或设计标记；签名字体应精致、克制且高级，不宜过大，且不应破坏主体构图或显得突兀、廉价。

templates.title: 90s Sci-Fi Cliffhanger Movie Still

titleLocalized.zh: 90 年代科幻电影悬崖惊险剧照

templates.prompt: A cinematic still from a {argument name="movie era and genre" default="1990s American sci-fi action movie"}. A {argument name="male character description" default="rugged male protagonist with a dirty face and a distressed brown leather jacket"} is {argument name="action" default="desperately dangling from the edge of a rocky cliff"}, gripping the rough stone with both hands. Above him, a {argument name="female character description" default="female-presenting android with pale skin, a sharp black bob haircut, and visible robotic joints on her arms"} is calmly looking down at him, resting her hands on the cliff edge. The background features a {argument name="setting" default="vast, deep canyon with a river winding through it under an overcast, dramatic sky"}. Shot on 35mm film, realistic textures, dramatic cinematic lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张来自 {argument name="movie era and genre" default="1990 年代美国科幻动作电影"} 的电影剧照。一名 {argument name="male character description" default="面容脏兮兮、身穿破旧棕色皮夹克的硬汉男主角"} 正 {argument name="action" default="绝望地悬挂在岩石悬崖边缘"}，双手紧紧抓着粗糙的岩石。在他上方，一个 {argument name="female character description" default="皮肤苍白、留着利落黑色波波头、手臂上有明显机械关节的女性机器人"} 正冷静地俯视着他，双手搭在悬崖边缘。背景是 {argument name="setting" default="一个广阔深邃的峡谷，一条河流在阴沉、戏剧性的天空下蜿蜒流过"}。使用 35mm 胶片拍摄，纹理逼真，具有戏剧性的电影级光影效果。

templates.title: Classroom Chalkboard Lesson

titleLocalized.zh: 教室黑板课程

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A photorealistic, slightly angled snapshot of a green classroom chalkboard. On the left side of the board is a large, meticulously drawn chalk illustration of the {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"} logo, rendered in blended pastel colors like green, blue, and purple, with the word "{argument name="logo text" default="OpenAI"}" written in neat white chalk beneath it. The right side of the board features handwritten text organized into exactly 3 numbered sections. Section 1 is titled "{argument name="section one title" default="1. OpenAI란?"}" followed by a brief explanatory paragraph. Section 2 is titled "{argument name="section two title" default="2. 주요 제품"}" and lists 3 bullet points including ChatGPT, DALL-E, and Codex. Section 3 is titled "{argument name="section three title" default="3. 특징"}" and contains 3 bullet points describing features. The chalkboard has a silver metal frame and a chalk ledge holding 2 rectangular erasers and scattered pieces of chalk. Below the board is an off-white wall with a double electrical outlet. In the bottom left foreground, the top edge of a dark laptop screen is partially visible, and above the chalkboard, the bottom edge of a framed sign is cut off by the frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真、略带角度的教室绿板快照。黑板左侧是一幅精心绘制的粉笔画，展示了 {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"} 的标志，采用绿色、蓝色和紫色等混合柔和色彩渲染，下方用整洁的白色粉笔写着“{argument name="logo text" default="OpenAI"}”。黑板右侧是组织成 3 个编号部分的手写文本。第 1 部分标题为“{argument name="section one title" default="1. OpenAI란?"}”，后跟一段简短的说明性文字。第 2 部分标题为“{argument name="section two title" default="2. 주요 제품"}”，列出了 3 个要点，包括 ChatGPT、DALL-E 和 Codex。第 3 部分标题为“{argument name="section three title" default="3. 특징"}”，包含 3 个描述特征的要点。黑板配有银色金属边框，粉笔槽上放着 2 块长方形黑板擦和零散的粉笔。黑板下方是灰白色的墙壁，上面有一个双孔电源插座。在左下角前景中，可以看到深色笔记本电脑屏幕的顶部边缘，黑板上方，一个带框标志的底部边缘被画面截断。

templates.prompt: Using the reference image, completely remove the pelican's body. Replace the traffic cone with a {argument name="hat style" default="white fedora with a black band"} and place it directly on top of the human feet. Apply a strong glowing effect to the feet, making them {argument name="foot effect" default="radiate bright warm light"}. Keep the open doorway framing, the porch setting, and the dusk suburban background intact.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用参考图，彻底移除鹈鹕的身体。将交通锥替换为 {argument name="hat style" default="带有黑色饰带的白色软呢帽"}，并将其直接放置在人类脚部上方。为脚部添加强烈的发光效果，使其 {argument name="foot effect" default="散发出明亮的暖光"}。保持开放的门框、门廊环境以及黄昏郊区的背景不变。

templates.title: Post-Apocalyptic Tactical Anime Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 末日废土风战术动漫少女

templates.prompt: A high-quality anime illustration of a young girl with {argument name="character hair" default="short brown hair with cat ears"} and blue eyes standing in a {argument name="setting" default="post-apocalyptic wasteland"}. She is wearing a {argument name="character outfit" default="white short-sleeve shirt, blue plaid pleated skirt, black thigh-high socks with white stripes, and a heavy tactical chest rig"}, equipped with a backpack, a wrist-mounted retro-futuristic computer device, and a katana strapped to her waist. The background features a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. To her right is a heavily rusted brick building with a large, weathered red sign on the roof partially reading "{argument name="sign text" default="RED R"}" alongside a red rocket sculpture. In the foreground, there is a rusted bright blue metal container cart, and to the left, a dilapidated, rusted blue car sits among dry, overgrown weeds and debris. The scene combines vibrant anime character design with detailed, realistic textures of rust and decay.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高质量的动漫插画，描绘了一位有着 {argument name="character hair" default="短棕发和猫耳"} 以及蓝色眼睛的少女，站在 {argument name="setting" default="末日废土"} 中。她身穿 {argument name="character outfit" default="白色短袖衬衫、蓝色格子百褶裙、带有白色条纹的黑色过膝袜以及厚重的战术胸挂"}，背着背包，手腕上佩戴着复古未来主义风格的电脑设备，腰间系着一把武士刀。背景是湛蓝的天空和零星的白云。在她的右侧是一栋锈迹斑斑的砖房，屋顶上有一个巨大的、饱经风霜的红色招牌，上面隐约写着 "{argument name="sign text" default="RED R"}"，旁边还有一座红色火箭雕塑。前景中有一个生锈的亮蓝色金属集装箱推车，左侧是一辆破旧且生锈的蓝色汽车，周围杂草丛生，遍布残骸。整个画面将充满活力的动漫角色设计与锈迹和衰败的细腻写实纹理完美融合。

templates.title: Anime Scholars with Cosmic Holograms

titleLocalized.zh: 拥有宇宙全息图的动漫学者

templates.prompt: An anime illustration of two characters at a desk in a {argument name="setting" default="cozy study overlooking the ocean at sunset"}. In the foreground, a young man in a dark knit sweater sits with his back to the viewer. Facing him is a young woman with {argument name="female character hair" default="long blonde hair"} and {argument name="female character eyes" default="striking, glowing blue eyes"}, wearing an elegant navy and white Victorian dress with a sapphire brooch. Floating between them are exactly 4 glowing holographic spheres connected by faint lines, showing {argument name="hologram theme" default="cosmic and futuristic scenes"}: a swirling galaxy, a golden energy tree, a futuristic control room, and a planet with an energy burst. The desk holds open astronomical journals, a starry mug with steam, a glowing brass lamp, a pocket watch, and a pen. Warm sunset lighting contrasts with the magical blue and gold holograms.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫插画，描绘了两名角色坐在 {argument name="setting" default="俯瞰大海的温馨书房，时值日落"} 的书桌前。前景中，一名穿着深色针织毛衣的年轻男子背对观众坐着。面对他的是一名年轻女子，她有着 {argument name="female character hair" default="金色长发"} 和 {argument name="female character eyes" default="引人注目的发光蓝眼睛"}，身穿优雅的藏青色与白色维多利亚风格连衣裙，佩戴着蓝宝石胸针。在他们之间漂浮着 4 个发光的、由细线连接的全息球体，展示着 {argument name="hologram theme" default="宇宙与未来主义场景"}：旋转的星系、金色的能量树、未来的控制室以及一颗带有能量爆发的行星。书桌上放着打开的天文日志、一个冒着热气的星空马克杯、一盏发光的黄铜台灯、一块怀表和一支钢笔。温暖的日落光线与神奇的蓝色和金色全息图形成了鲜明对比。

templates.title: Anime Light Novel Cover with Typography

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫轻小说封面与排版

templates.prompt: An anime light novel cover. Top left features a stylized Japanese title {argument name="main title" default="黒焔の魔眼使いは、追放先の学園都市で三人の最強ヒロインに溺愛される"} and English subtitle {argument name="english subtitle" default="The Exiled Black-Flame Eye in Arcane Metropolis"}. A vertical Japanese blurb on the right reads {argument name="vertical blurb" default="追放されたはずの俺が、なぜか最強美少女たちの運命そのものになっていた。"}. The scene includes 4 characters and 1 creature. Centered is a male protagonist with {argument name="protagonist hair color" default="black"} hair, a glowing red eye, and a dark coat. He is surrounded by 3 heroines: a top-right girl with long {argument name="heroine hair color" default="silver"} hair and a white-blue crystal dress; a mid-left blonde girl with a side ponytail casting a pink magic circle; and a bottom-right girl with short magenta hair holding a grimoire. A black-and-white wolf familiar sits bottom-left. The background is a dark gothic academy at night, filled with floating pink petals, glowing magic particles, shattered glass, and a faint demonic figure top-right.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫轻小说封面。左上角展示了风格化的日文标题 {argument name="main title" default="黒焔の魔眼使いは、追放先の学園都市で三人の最強ヒロインに溺愛される"} 和英文副标题 {argument name="english subtitle" default="The Exiled Black-Flame Eye in Arcane Metropolis"}。右侧的竖排日文简介写着 {argument name="vertical blurb" default="追放されたはずの俺が、なぜか最強美少女たちの運命そのものになっていた。"}。场景包含 4 个角色和 1 只生物。画面中心是一位男性主角，拥有 {argument name="protagonist hair color" default="黑色"} 头发、一只发光的红眼和一件深色外套。他被 3 位女主角环绕：右上角是一位留着长 {argument name="heroine hair color" default="银色"} 头发、身穿白蓝色水晶礼服的少女；左中是一位扎着侧马尾、正在施展粉色魔法阵的金发少女；右下角是一位留着洋红色短发、手持魔导书的少女。左下角坐着一只黑白相间的狼型使魔。背景是夜晚黑暗的哥特式学院，空中飘浮着粉色花瓣、发光的魔法粒子、破碎的玻璃，右上角隐约可见一个恶魔身影。

templates.title: Backstage Cosplayer Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 后台 Cosplayer 肖像

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, realistic photograph of a young East Asian woman sitting in a cluttered backstage dressing room, getting ready for a cosplay event. She has {argument name="hair color" default="vibrant short red"} hair styled in a bob with bangs and is wearing an elaborate fantasy warrior costume featuring a {argument name="costume color" default="glossy red"} and gold tiered mini skirt, a white corset top with black lace and red lacing, matching glossy arm guards, and thigh-high boots. She is looking down with a focused expression, using her right hand to adjust the arm guard on her left arm. The vanity counter in front of her is messy, covered with makeup brushes, bottles, a hairbrush, and extra hairpieces. A large, ornate {argument name="prop" default="fantasy sword with a blue blade and gold hilt"} leans against the edge of the counter. The background shows a brightly lit vanity mirror with round bulbs reflecting a clothing rack, capturing a candid, slightly over-sharpened, and highly textured photographic style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富、写实风格的照片，展示了一位年轻的东亚女性坐在杂乱的后台更衣室里，为 Cosplay 活动做准备。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳的短红发"} 波波头刘海，身穿一套精致的奇幻战士服装，包括一条 {argument name="costume color" default="亮红色"} 金色分层迷你裙、一件带有黑色蕾丝和红色系带的白色紧身胸衣，以及配套的亮面护臂和过膝长靴。她神情专注地低头看着，右手正在调整左臂上的护臂。她面前的梳妆台非常杂乱，摆满了化妆刷、瓶瓶罐罐、发梳和额外的发饰。一把巨大的、装饰华丽的 {argument name="prop" default="带有蓝色刀刃和金色剑柄的奇幻长剑"} 斜靠在台面边缘。背景中，明亮的梳妆镜上圆形的灯泡反射出衣架的倒影，整体呈现出一种抓拍感、略微锐化且极具质感的摄影风格。

variables.defaultValue: fantasy sword with a blue blade and gold hilt

templates.title: Sci-Fi Chibi Robot Welding in Space

titleLocalized.zh: 科幻 Q 版机器人太空焊接场景

templates.prompt: A highly detailed sci-fi illustration of a {argument name="robot style" default="cute chibi robot"} floating in space, {argument name="action" default="welding a massive metallic megastructure"}. The robot has a large round head with {argument name="eye color" default="glowing blue"} eyes and a white and black mechanical body. It is holding a tool that emits bright orange sparks against the framework. The megastructure is enormous, curving through the scene, built as a {argument name="structure type" default="dark metal lattice covered in thousands of tiny glowing yellow lights"}. In the background, a {argument name="star color" default="brilliant glowing blue"} star shines brightly against a deep space backdrop filled with stars and cosmic dust. The image features hyper-detailed textures, cinematic lighting, high contrast, and a dense, intricate mechanical design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的科幻插图，画面中是一个 {argument name="robot style" default="可爱的 Q 版机器人"} 漂浮在太空中，正在 {argument name="action" default="焊接一个巨大的金属巨型结构"}。该机器人拥有一个圆圆的大脑袋，配有 {argument name="eye color" default="发光的蓝色"} 眼睛，身体为黑白相间的机械结构。它手中拿着的工具在框架上迸发出明亮的橙色火花。这个巨型结构极其宏大，在场景中蜿蜒延伸，呈现为 {argument name="structure type" default="覆盖着数千个微小黄色亮点的深色金属网格"}。背景中，一颗 {argument name="star color" default="璀璨发光的蓝色"} 恒星在布满繁星和宇宙尘埃的深空背景下熠熠生辉。该图像具有超精细的纹理、电影级的灯光效果、高对比度以及密集而复杂的机械设计。

templates.title: Idyllic Alpine Lake Village Landscape

templates.prompt: A breathtaking, hyper-realistic landscape of an {argument name="setting" default="alpine lake village"}. In the foreground, a {argument name="foreground element" default="wooden pier with 1 empty bench"} extends into the crystal-clear blue water from the bottom left, framed by vibrant {argument name="flower color" default="bright pink and red"} flowers on the left and tall green reeds on the right. The calm lake perfectly reflects the scenery and features exactly 1 small red rowboat floating on the left and 1 white sailboat on the right. On the right shoreline, a picturesque European village with 1 prominent pointed church spire and traditional houses is nestled at the base of lush green hills. Towering {argument name="mountain type" default="snow-capped jagged peaks"} dominate the background under a {argument name="weather" default="bright sunny day with fluffy white clouds"}. The lighting is vibrant, idyllic, and highly detailed.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅令人惊叹的超写实景观，描绘了 {argument name="setting" default="阿尔卑斯湖畔村庄"}。在前景中，一个 {argument name="foreground element" default="带有 1 张空长椅的木质码头"} 从左下角延伸至清澈湛蓝的湖水中，左侧点缀着鲜艳的 {argument name="flower color" default="亮粉色和红色"} 花朵，右侧则是高耸的绿色芦苇。平静的湖面完美地倒映着周围的景色，湖面上漂浮着 1 艘红色小划艇（位于左侧）和 1 艘白色帆船（位于右侧）。在右侧岸边，一个风景如画的欧洲村庄坐落在郁郁葱葱的青山脚下，拥有 1 座显眼的尖顶教堂和传统房屋。背景中，高耸的 {argument name="mountain type" default="白雪皑皑的锯齿状山峰"} 在 {argument name="weather" default="阳光明媚、白云朵朵的天气"} 下显得格外壮观。整体光影效果鲜明、充满田园气息且细节丰富。

Inside her silhouette is a rich, layered fantasy world. At the top is a {argument name="top scenery" default="grand white castle with multiple spires under a starry night sky with a crescent moon"}. Below the castle, two cloaked figures stand in a mystical forest. In the center, a {argument name="central character" default="young female mage with pink hair holding a glowing magical staff"} stands prominently. To the left of the mage, a white horse is visible. At the bottom of the silhouette is a {argument name="bottom scenery" default="fantasy village surrounded by blooming cherry blossom trees, with a large open spellbook and a sword resting in the foreground"}. The artwork features a {argument name="color palette" default="soft pastel purples, pinks, and blues"} color palette. templates.prompt: A photorealistic interior view of a bustling {argument name="store type" default="Japanese bookstore"}. The scene is illuminated by {argument name="lighting style" default="warm overhead lighting"} that reflects off the polished wooden floor. In the foreground, large wooden display tables are stacked high with books, many featuring anime-style illustrated covers facing outward. Above the shelves, prominent hanging signs display Japanese text, including a red sign on the left reading {argument name="left sign text" default="新刊コーナー"} and a blue sign on the right reading {argument name="right sign text" default="旅行ガイド"}. A central hanging directional sign points towards different sections. Tall wooden bookshelves packed tightly with colorful spines line the walls, creating deep aisles. In the mid-ground, a {argument name="customer description" default="woman in a green top browsing"} stands looking at the shelves. The atmosphere is cozy, inviting, and highly detailed.

templates.title: Romantic Voxel Dinner Date

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫体素晚餐约会

templates.prompt: A first-person POV shot of a romantic dinner date with a {argument name="character" default="Minecraft Creeper"}. The scene is set in a {argument name="setting" default="romantic dimly lit restaurant"} with warm ambient lighting and a blurred background showing other tables and a window looking out into the night. The character is sitting directly across the table. Around its head are 7 {argument name="atmosphere effect" default="floating 8-bit red hearts"}. On the wooden table between the viewer and the character, there is a red and white checkered placemat. On it sits a voxel-style plate containing a {argument name="food" default="blocky steak with red and green garnish"}. To the left is a blocky, transparent wine glass filled with red wine. To the right is a blocky red rose in a transparent blocky vase. There are 2 glowing blocky candles in wooden holders on the table. The foreground shows the blurred edge of the viewer's own matching plate of food. The entire image blends realistic cinematic lighting and depth of field with voxel-based, 3D pixel-art objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一段第一人称 POV 视角，与 {argument name="character" default="Minecraft 苦力怕"} 进行浪漫晚餐约会的画面。场景设定在一家 {argument name="setting" default="浪漫且灯光昏暗的餐厅"} 中，环境光温暖，背景虚化，可以看到其他餐桌和窗外的夜景。该角色正坐在桌子对面。它的头部周围环绕着 7 个 {argument name="atmosphere effect" default="漂浮的 8-bit 红色爱心"}。在观看者与角色之间的木桌上，铺着一张红白格纹的餐垫。餐垫上放着一个体素风格的盘子，里面装着 {argument name="food" default="方块状牛排，配有红绿装饰"}。左侧是一个透明的方块状红酒杯，里面盛着红酒。右侧是一个透明方块花瓶，插着一朵方块状红玫瑰。桌上还有 2 支放在木质烛台里的发光方块蜡烛。前景展示了观看者自己餐盘边缘的虚化效果。整张图像将逼真的电影级灯光和景深效果与基于体素的 3D 像素艺术物体完美融合。

templates.title: Retro 3D Claymation Desk Setup

titleLocalized.zh: 复古 3D 黏土动画风格桌面布置

templates.prompt: A vibrant, cute 3D claymation-style illustration of a retro yellow desktop computer setup on a desk. The central yellow CRT monitor displays a teal screen with the {argument name="OS logo text" default="Microsoft Windows 98"} logo and 7 desktop icons labeled 'My Computer', 'Online Services', 'My Documents', 'Outlook Express', 'Internet Explorer', 'Connect to the Internet', and 'Recycle Bin', plus a bottom taskbar with a 'Start' button and a clock reading '5:49 PM'. The monitor has a yellow sticky note reading '{argument name="monitor sticky note" default="Be Happy"}' and a small yellow bird perched on top. The computer base is labeled 'CREATIVE PC'. In front is a yellow mechanical keyboard labeled 'KBD-98' with orange and cream keys, and a yellow mouse labeled 'MS'. To the left is a green desk lamp, a smiling potted cactus, a blue floppy disk labeled '{argument name="floppy disk label" default="FUN STUFF"}', and a blue mug reading '{argument name="mug text" default="COFFEE TIME!"}' with a smiley face. To the right are 2 stacked books (green 'WINDOWS 98 MANUAL', blue 'INTERNET EXPLORER') and 2 smiling balloons (orange and yellow). The foreground features a green cutting mat, a yellow pencil, a green tape dispenser labeled 'TAPE IT!', 2 crayons, a pink sticky note reading 'Take a Break!', and a white notepad with a 5-item 'TO DO LIST': '1. Be curated', '2. Play More', '3. Call Mom', '4. Eat Snacks', '5. Smile :)'. The background wall has a green and cream clock, a white poster reading '{argument name="poster text" default="HAVE A NICE DAY!"}' with a smiling sun and 'Do Your Best!', and 3 additional sticky notes: a yellow one reading 'Dream Big Work Hard!', a pink one reading 'You've Got This!', and a green one reading 'Meeting 10:00 AM!'.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力、可爱的 3D 黏土动画风格插图，展示了复古黄色台式电脑的桌面布置。中央的黄色 CRT 显示器屏幕呈青色，显示着 {argument name="OS logo text" default="Microsoft Windows 98"} 标志，以及 7 个桌面图标，分别标注为“My Computer”、“Online Services”、“My Documents”、“Outlook Express”、“Internet Explorer”、“Connect to the Internet”和“Recycle Bin”，底部任务栏带有“Start”按钮和一个显示“5:49 PM”的时钟。显示器上贴着一张黄色便签，写着“{argument name="monitor sticky note" default="Be Happy"}”，顶部停着一只黄色小鸟。电脑底座上标有“CREATIVE PC”。前方是一个黄色机械键盘，标有“KBD-98”，配有橙色和奶油色键帽，以及一个标有“MS”的黄色鼠标。左侧有一盏绿色台灯、一盆微笑着的仙人掌、一张标有“{argument name="floppy disk label" default="FUN STUFF"}”的蓝色软盘，以及一个写着“{argument name="mug text" default="COFFEE TIME!"}”并带有笑脸的蓝色马克杯。右侧有 2 本堆叠的书（绿色“WINDOWS 98 MANUAL”、蓝色“INTERNET EXPLORER”）和 2 个微笑着的气球（橙色和黄色）。前景包括一张绿色切割垫、一支黄色铅笔、一个标有“TAPE IT!”的绿色胶带座、2 支蜡笔、一张写着“Take a Break!”的粉色便签，以及一个白色记事本，上面有 5 项“TO DO LIST”：“1. Be curated”、“2. Play More”、“3. Call Mom”、“4. Eat Snacks”、“5. Smile :)”。背景墙上挂着一个绿色和奶油色的时钟，一张写着“{argument name="poster text" default="HAVE A NICE DAY!"}”的白色海报，上面画着一个微笑着的太阳和“Do Your Best!”字样，还有 3 张额外的便签：一张写着“Dream Big Work Hard!”的黄色便签、一张写着“You've Got This!”的粉色便签，以及一张写着“Meeting 10:00 AM!”的绿色便签。

templates.prompt: A striking black and white close-up portrait of a {argument name="subject description" default="handsome young Asian man"} with {argument name="hair style" default="messy wet hair sticking to his forehead"}. templates.title: Xianxia Cityscape from God's-Eye View

titleLocalized.zh: 上帝视角下的仙侠城市景观

templates.prompt: An extreme top-down god's-eye perspective looking directly down at a vast, glowing {argument name="city style" default="ancient Chinese city"} extending to the horizon, where the curvature of the planet is visible. In the foreground, a lone {argument name="character type" default="swordsman"} in traditional robes stands on the edge of an ornate, dark-tiled ancient palace roof, looking down. Below lies an endless sea of ancient architecture illuminated by warm glowing lights, bustling streets, and dense crowds. Soft mist and fog layers drift through the sprawling metropolis. Photorealistic fantasy concept art, Chinese Xianxia aesthetics, extreme wide angle, massive depth of field. Grand, lonely, and poetic atmosphere with strong color contrast and a moody {argument name="color palette" default="dark blue and warm gold"} color palette.

promptLocalized.zh: 极致的上帝视角俯瞰，直接向下望向广阔且发光的 {argument name="city style" default="中国古代城市"}，城市一直延伸至地平线，甚至可以看到星球的弧度。在前景中，一位孤独的 {argument name="character type" default="剑客"} 身着传统长袍，站在装饰华丽的深色瓦片古宫殿屋檐边缘向下眺望。下方是无尽的古代建筑群，被温暖的灯光点亮，街道熙熙攘攘，人群密集。柔和的薄雾在广阔的都市中缭绕。照片级写实的奇幻概念艺术，中国仙侠美学，超广角，巨大的景深。宏大、孤独且富有诗意的氛围，具有强烈的色彩对比和深沉的 {argument name="color palette" default="深蓝与暖金"} 色调。

templates.prompt: A photorealistic studio portrait of a {argument name="subject ethnicity and gender" default="young Asian woman"}. She has {argument name="hair style" default="long, wavy dark hair"}, light freckles, and a subtle glisten of sweat on her skin for a fresh, athletic appearance. templates.title: Museum Style Infographic Breakdown

titleLocalized.zh: 博物馆风格信息图解拆解

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Please automatically generate a "Museum Guide-style Chinese Breakdown Infographic" based on the [Theme: {argument name="theme" default="Hanfu"}].

Requirements: The entire image must combine a realistic main visual, structural breakdown, Chinese annotations, material descriptions, pattern meanings, color symbolism, and a summary of core features. You need to automatically determine the most suitable subject, clothing system, artifact structure, era style, key components, material craftsmanship, color scheme, and layout based on the [Theme] without further user input.

The overall style should be: National Museum exhibition board, historical clothing guide, or cultural museum special infographic, rather than a common poster, ancient-style photo, e-commerce details page, or anime illustration. The background should use paper textures like off-white, silk white, or light tea color. The overall look should be high-end, restrained, professional, and collectible.

The layout is fixed as:
- Top: Chinese main title + sub-title + introduction
- Left: Structural breakdown area with Chinese leader lines marking key components and matching close-ups
- Top Right: Material/Craftsmanship/Texture area showing real texture samples with descriptions
- Middle Right: Pattern/Color/Meaning area showing the main color palette, pattern samples, and cultural explanations
- Bottom: Wearing order / Composition flowchart + summary of core features

If the theme is suitable for person display, use a full-body standing pose of a real person as the central subject; if it's more suitable for artifacts, use a central subject breakdown, but maintain the complete Chinese infographic format. All text must be in Simplified Chinese, clear, neat, and readable without garbled characters or typos.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 [Theme: {argument name="theme" default="汉服"}] 自动生成一张“博物馆导览风格的中文拆解信息图”。

要求：整张图片必须结合写实主视觉、结构拆解、中文注释、材质描述、纹样寓意、色彩象征以及核心特征总结。你需要根据 [Theme] 自动确定最合适的主题、服饰体系、文物结构、时代风格、关键部件、材质工艺、配色方案及排版，无需用户进一步输入。

整体风格应为：国家博物馆展板、历史服饰指南或文化博物馆专题信息图，而非普通海报、古风照片、电商详情页或动漫插画。背景应使用米白、丝绸白或浅茶色等纸张质感。整体视觉效果需高端、克制、专业且具有收藏价值。

排版固定如下：
- 顶部：中文主标题 + 副标题 + 简介
- 左侧：结构拆解区，使用中文引线标注关键部件并配以局部特写
- 右上：材质/工艺/纹理区，展示真实质感样本及说明
- 右中：纹样/色彩/寓意区，展示主色调色板、纹样样本及文化解读
- 底部：穿着顺序 / 构成流程图 + 核心特征总结

如果主题适合人物展示，请使用真人全身站姿作为中心主体；如果更适合文物，则使用中心主体拆解，但需保持完整的中文信息图格式。所有文字必须为简体中文，清晰、整洁、易读，不得出现乱码或错别字。

templates.prompt: A {argument name="subject" default="graceful lady"} with hair like a waterfall of smooth black silk stands contemplatively, her eyes reflecting a classical, reserved charm. The golden sunset glow pours across the sky, casting a soft amber halo around her figure. {argument name="background scene" default="Modern buildings with cold glass reflections and geometric structures"} fade into the depth of field, using a traditional ink-wash "negative space" technique to create an airy composition of dialogue between the past and present. In the foreground, a {argument name="pilot description" default="young male anime character with black hair in a sleek black pilot suit"} stands confidently, holding a helmet. Both the pilot and mecha have the number '08' on their shoulders. The background shows a dramatic sunset sky with dark clouds, smoke rising from the ruins, flying drones, and a wet, reflective ground. At the top, a tagline reads "{argument name="top tagline" default="守護の名で生まれ、破壊の命で目覚めた。"}". At the bottom, a large, elegant serif main title reads "{argument name="main title" default="鋼鉄の盾"}" with the English subtitle "S T E E L  S H I E L D" just below it. At the very bottom edge, a smaller text line reads "{argument name="bottom tagline" default="2096年、東京湾岸第八埋立層。最後の防衛機兵、反逆起動。"}". The overall mood is epic, dystopian, and highly detailed.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的科幻动画电影海报，画面中是一台高耸入云、历经战火的 {argument name="mecha color" default="白色"} 机甲，带有发光的红色装饰和复杂的机械细节，伫立在破败的工业城市废墟中。前景中，一位 {argument name="pilot description" default="留着黑发、身穿黑色流线型驾驶服的年轻男性动画角色"} 自信地站立着，手中拿着头盔。驾驶员和机甲的肩部都印有数字“08”。背景展示了戏剧性的日落天空，乌云密布，废墟中烟雾缭绕，无人机在空中盘旋，地面湿润且带有倒影。海报顶部是一句标语：“{argument name="top tagline" default="守護の名で生まれ、破壊の命で目覚めた。"}”。底部是一个醒目且优雅的衬线体主标题：“{argument name="main title" default="鋼鉄の盾"}”，下方配有英文副标题“S T E E L  S H I E L D”。在最底部的边缘，有一行较小的文字：“{argument name="bottom tagline" default="2096年、東京湾岸第八埋立層。最後の防衛機兵、反逆起動。"}”。整体氛围宏大、具有反乌托邦色彩且细节丰富。

templates.prompt: A cinematic anime-style fantasy movie poster featuring a female knight standing in the center of a cobblestone courtyard. At the very top center, small elegant Japanese text reads "{argument name="top catchphrase" default="願いは、星に選ばれた。"}". Just below the main title, smaller English text reads "{argument name="english subtitle" default="REGALIA OF THE STARBLADE"}". templates.prompt: A breathtaking, panoramic view of a {argument name="setting" default="fantasy coastal city"}. templates.title: Urban Energy Drink Advertisement Poster

templates.prompt: A photorealistic urban advertisement poster featuring a young Japanese woman in streetwear doing a deep squat in the middle of a busy crosswalk. She wears a black beanie, a dark grey oversized hoodie, a chunky silver chain necklace, olive green cargo pants, and chunky beige and black sneakers. She is holding out exactly two identical energy drink cans towards the camera; the cans are silver and black with a prominent yellow lightning bolt logo and the word {argument name="can logo text" default="ENERGY"}. The background is a blurred, bustling {argument name="city background" default="Tokyo street scene resembling Shibuya crossing"} with pedestrians and neon signs. The image features bold typography: large red vertical Japanese text on the left reading {argument name="left red text" default="新登場"}, white vertical Japanese text on the right reading {argument name="right white text" default="ストリートま上げてく エナジー。"}, and a solid yellow horizontal banner across the bottom edge containing bold black text {argument name="bottom banner text" default="ENERGY DRINK"} alongside smaller Japanese text and a small black hand logo on the far right. Dynamic wide-angle perspective with a shallow depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的城市广告海报，画面中一位身穿街头服饰的日本年轻女性正在繁忙的人行横道中央做深蹲。她戴着黑色针织帽，身穿深灰色超大款连帽衫，佩戴粗款银色项链，下身穿着橄榄绿工装裤，脚蹬米色与黑色拼接的厚底运动鞋。她正向镜头展示两罐一模一样的能量饮料；罐身为银黑配色，印有醒目的黄色闪电标志和文字 {argument name="can logo text" default="ENERGY"}。背景是模糊且熙熙攘攘的 {argument name="city background" default="类似涩谷十字路口的东京街景"}，伴有行人与霓虹灯。图像采用醒目的排版设计：左侧为巨大的红色竖排日语文字 {argument name="left red text" default="新登場"}，右侧为白色竖排日语文字 {argument name="right white text" default="ストリートま上げてく エナジー。"}，底部边缘有一条纯黄色横幅，上面印有粗体黑色文字 {argument name="bottom banner text" default="ENERGY DRINK"}，旁边配有较小的日语文字以及最右侧的一个小型黑色手部标志。采用动态广角视角，具有浅景深效果。

templates.prompt: A bright, summery commercial product photography shot featuring a refreshing beverage on a weathered wooden table. In the sharp foreground, there is 1 tall glass filled with a golden, bubbly iced drink garnished with 1 lemon slice and a sprig of rosemary, sitting next to 1 silver aluminum can covered in cold condensation. The can prominently displays the English text {argument name="product name" default="TOKYO HIGHBALL"} below a small gold star logo, featuring a graphic of the drink itself and the Japanese text "アルコール分 7%" near the bottom. To the right of the can, 2 cut lemon wedges rest on the table. In the softly blurred background, a sunny beach scene unfolds with sparkling turquoise water and a clear blue sky. Floating elegantly in the sky above the scene is the Japanese text {argument name="catchphrase" default="夏、これがいい。"}. templates.prompt: A highly realistic Blu-ray disc cover featuring a portrait of a young Japanese woman. She has short, messy black bob hair and wears large, round, thin wire-rimmed glasses. She is dressed in a thick, textured, dark red knit sweater. Her expression is soft and alluring, looking directly at the viewer. The background is a softly blurred, warm-toned indoor setting, possibly a cafe, with a glimpse of a white coffee cup and saucer on a table to the right. The lighting is warm and cinematic, highlighting her face and the texture of the sweater. The image is framed within a standard blue Blu-ray case border, complete with the Blu-ray Disc logo at the top center, top right, and bottom left corners. On the left side, there is large, elegant vertical Japanese text that reads '{argument name="main title" default="魔女乃家 林檎"}' with smaller furigana text beside it reading 'まじょのいえ りんご', accompanied by delicate, glowing pink decorative lines and star/pentagram motifs. In the bottom right corner, there is smaller Japanese text reading '{argument name="subtitle" default="魔女のように、あなたを魅了する。"}' above the English text 'R I N G O' and 'M A J Y O N O I E'.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的蓝光光盘封面，主体为一位年轻日本女性的肖像。她留着凌乱的黑色短波波头，戴着一副大而圆的细金属框眼镜。她身穿一件厚实、有质感的深红色针织毛衣。她的表情柔和而迷人，直视着镜头。背景是柔和模糊的暖色调室内环境，看起来像是在咖啡馆里，右侧桌上隐约可见一个白色咖啡杯和托盘。光线温暖且具有电影质感，突显了她的面部轮廓和毛衣的纹理。图像被框在标准的蓝色蓝光光盘盒边框内，顶部中央、右上角和左下角均配有蓝光光盘（Blu-ray Disc）标志。左侧有醒目且优雅的竖排日文文字“{argument name="main title" default="魔女乃家 林檎"}”，旁边配有注音假名“まじょのいえ りんご”，并装饰着精致的发光粉色线条和星星/五角星图案。右下角有较小的日文文字“{argument name="subtitle" default="魔女のように、あなたを魅了する。"}”，下方印有英文字母“R I N G O”和“M A J Y O N O I E”。

templates.prompt: An {argument name="overall theme" default="epic fantasy"} illustration utilizing a {argument name="art style" default="watercolor and ink wash double exposure"} technique on a vintage parchment background. The overall composition forms the {argument name="main silhouette subject" default="right-facing profile of a man's head"}. Inside this silhouette is a complex montage of scenes and characters. At the top, a white tree with red leaves stands near a cliffside castle, with a white winged creature flying on the left and a black dragon breathing fire on the right. Below this, a blonde woman sits on a throne made of swords, while a cloaked figure stands on a hill nearby. In the center right, a romantic couple consisting of a blonde woman and a dark-haired man in a fur collar gaze at each other. To their left stands a knight in full plate armor holding a sword. Below them is a group of 3 figures: a man, a young woman, and a child. At the bottom, a large white wolf head is on the left, and a stag stands near a castle on the right. templates.prompt: A realistic photograph taken from the audience in a dimly lit university lecture hall, looking over the backs of the heads of three students in the foreground towards a large projector screen. The left panel shows vertical {argument name="left game" default="Subway Surfers gameplay"}, featuring a character running on train tracks collecting gold coins with UI elements like a score of "001022". The wide center panel displays an academic presentation slide titled "{argument name="slide topic" default="9.3: Infinite Geometric Series"}". The slide contains math text: "Example 3: Find the sum of the infinite geometric series. 1/3 - 1/9 + 1/27 - 1/81 + ... Solution: The series is geometric with a = 1/3 and r = -1/3. Since |r| < 1, the infinite geometric series converges. S = a / (1 - r) = (1/3) / (1 - (-1/3)) = (1/3) / (4/3) = 1/4. The sum of the series is 1/4." The slide footer reads "{argument name="professor name" default="Dr. Larson"}", "{argument name="course name" default="Calculus II"}", "11/14/2024", and "7 / 35". The right panel shows vertical {argument name="right game" default="Minecraft parkour gameplay"}, featuring floating wooden blocks over a grassy landscape with a TikTok watermark at the bottom right. The room has a drop ceiling and blackboards visible behind the screen edges.

templates.prompt: A person wearing a highly detailed, weathered, and battle-damaged {argument name="armor type" default="T-60 power armor from Fallout"} taking a mirror selfie with a {argument name="phone type" default="black smartphone"}. The armor is bulky, metallic, and covered in grime, rust, and scratches, featuring a distinctive helmet with a respirator, headlamp, and thick shoulder pauldrons. The person is holding the phone in their right armored hand, positioned in front of their chest. The reflection is seen in a slightly dirty mirror with a dark wooden frame. In the background, there is a dimly lit, messy room with a {argument name="poster subject" default="Vault Boy poster"} partially visible on the wall behind the armor. The lighting is moody and realistic, emphasizing the textures of the metal and the gritty atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个身穿细节丰富、饱经风霜且带有战斗损伤的 {argument name="armor type" default="《辐射》中的 T-60 动力装甲"} 的人，正拿着一部 {argument name="phone type" default="黑色智能手机"} 进行镜中自拍。装甲厚重、充满金属质感，表面覆盖着污垢、锈迹和划痕，配有带有呼吸器、头灯和厚实肩甲的独特头盔。此人右手戴着装甲手套，将手机举在胸前。镜子略显脏污，带有深色木质边框，映照出拍摄者的身影。背景是一个光线昏暗、杂乱的房间，墙上隐约可见一张 {argument name="poster subject" default="避难所小子 (Vault Boy) 海报"}。光影效果写实且富有氛围感，突显了金属的质感与粗犷的氛围。

templates.title: Tech Keynote Presentation Slide

titleLocalized.zh: 科技主题演讲演示 Slides

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A photograph of a tech keynote presentation. A bald man with glasses, wearing a dark blue sweater and jeans, stands on a stage to the left, smiling and pointing with both index fingers at a large presentation screen behind him. The screen displays a slide with a light blue background. At the top left is a small teal pill-shaped badge reading "NEW DATA". Below it, the main headline reads "{argument name="headline" default="Microsoft Edge is the #1 browser to download Google Chrome"}", with "#1" highlighted in blue. A subheadline reads "% of Google Chrome downloads that started from another browser". Below this is a bar chart with three bars. The first bar is tall and blue, labeled "38.6%" above it, with the Microsoft Edge logo and text "Microsoft Edge" below it. The second bar is shorter and gray, labeled "17.2%" above it, with the Mozilla Firefox logo and text "Mozilla Firefox" below it. The third bar is the shortest and gray, labeled "13.0%" above it, with the Apple Safari logo and text "Apple Safari" below it. At the bottom left of the slide, small text reads "Source: Microsoft internal analysis of Google Chrome download referrals Cohort: Windows 10 and 11, Worldwide, Jan - March 2024". To the left of the screen, a wooden panel features the Microsoft logo (four colored squares). The backs of audience members' heads are visible in the foreground at the bottom.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张科技主题演讲的照片。一位戴眼镜的秃头男子，身穿深蓝色毛衣和牛仔裤，站在舞台左侧，微笑着并用双手食指指向身后的大型演示屏幕。屏幕上显示着一张浅蓝色背景的 Slides。左上角有一个写着“NEW DATA”的青色胶囊状小徽章。下方的主标题写着“{argument name="headline" default="Microsoft Edge is the #1 browser to download Google Chrome"}”，其中“#1”以蓝色高亮显示。副标题写着“% of Google Chrome downloads that started from another browser”。下方是一个包含三个柱状的条形图。第一根柱子较高且为蓝色，上方标注“38.6%”，下方带有 Microsoft Edge 标志和“Microsoft Edge”文字。第二根柱子较短且为灰色，上方标注“17.2%”，下方带有 Mozilla Firefox 标志和“Mozilla Firefox”文字。第三根柱子最短且为灰色，上方标注“13.0%”，下方带有 Apple Safari 标志和“Apple Safari”文字。在 Slides 左下角，小字写着“Source: Microsoft internal analysis of Google Chrome download referrals Cohort: Windows 10 and 11, Worldwide, Jan - March 2024”。屏幕左侧的木板上印有 Microsoft 标志（四个彩色方块）。前景底部可见观众的后脑勺。

The artwork is a {argument name="art style" default="modern digital illustration with high contrast lighting and subtle shin-hanga influences"}, featuring a red square seal in the bottom right corner with the text "新版画" and a blank white vertical signature box with a tiny red seal in the bottom left.

templates.title: Handwritten Korean Diary Entry

titleLocalized.zh: 手写韩语日记

templates.prompt: A photorealistic, casual top-down snapshot of an open lined notebook resting on a textured gray fabric surface. The notebook pages are filled with {argument name="handwriting style" default="neat, legible Korean handwriting"}. The right page is the main focus, starting with the date "{argument name="date" default="2024 10월 18일 금요일"}" at the top left and a printed "Date." at the top right. Below the date is a small hand-drawn sun icon next to the text "{argument name="weather" default="날씨: 맑음"}". templates.title: Isometric Pixel Art Evolution Museum

titleLocalized.zh: 等距像素艺术演变博物馆

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create an ultra-high detail isometric pixel art timeline illustration (3:4, 4K) that blends detail density, symbolism, and metaphor. The user-specified theme is "{argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"}".

First, perform reasoning around {argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"} to determine: the bilingual Chinese and English titles, the earliest and most recent historical periods covered, the starting and ending phase labels, and 3-5 key evolution stages with their respective symbolic elements and color schemes.

Then construct an isometric "Evolution Museum" themed around "{argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"}", where each gallery area represents an evolution stage, and spatial progression represents temporal evolution. Use a standard isometric perspective (2:1) with rich depth layers and smooth transitions. Assign 3-5 symbolic elements strongly associated with the theme to each stage, using differentiated colors to suggest the flow of time. Incorporate bilingual pixel font titles in the scene: Chinese "[Theme in Chinese] Evolution History" and English "EVOLUTION OF {argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"}", along with bilingual subtitles for the start and end phases and key time node markers. The overall style should be professional and visually striking, suitable for academic analysis and comparative visualization, directly generating the image.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一张超高细节的等距像素艺术时间轴插图（3:4，4K），融合细节密度、象征意义和隐喻。用户指定的主题为“{argument name="theme" default="西方艺术发展"}”。

首先，围绕“{argument name="theme" default="西方艺术发展"}”进行推理，确定：中英文双语标题、涵盖的最早和最近历史时期、起始和结束阶段标签，以及 3-5 个关键演变阶段及其各自的象征元素和配色方案。

然后，构建一个以“{argument name="theme" default="西方艺术发展"}”为主题的等距“演变博物馆”，其中每个画廊区域代表一个演变阶段，空间推进代表时间演变。使用标准的等距视角（2:1），具有丰富的深度层次和平滑的过渡。为每个阶段分配 3-5 个与主题紧密相关的象征元素，并使用差异化的颜色来暗示时间的流动。在场景中加入双语像素字体标题：中文“{argument name="theme" default="西方艺术发展"}演变史”和英文“EVOLUTION OF {argument name="theme" default="Western Art Development"}”，以及起始和结束阶段的双语副标题和关键时间节点标记。整体风格应专业且具有视觉冲击力，适合学术分析和比较可视化，直接生成图像。

templates.title: Oriental Fantasy City Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 东方奇幻城市海报

templates.prompt:
Flat illustration, high-end oriental fantasy style city poster design, vertical 9:16 composition. The layout uses a diagonal + S-shaped flow extending from the bottom left to top right. The background is deep black grading down to intense dark red, creating strong warm-cool contrast and spatial depth with faint stardust and grain texture. In the center, a flowing golden energy line winds through like a flame, extending upward from the base, featuring fluid texture, particle effects, and gradient highlights, with subtle energy debris and volumetric light.

Within the golden flow, the architectural landmarks of {argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} emerge layer by layer: the Canton Tower is the visual core with prominent proportions, surrounded by the Zhujiang New Town skyline, Liede Bridge, and modern Lingnan architectural elements. Buildings are rendered using "fine line drawing + golden luminous blocks," with clear outlines and rich details, appearing to float in a void against the golden halo, creating a surreal spatial hierarchy with slightly fogged backgrounds for added depth.

At the bottom of the frame is an oriental white-haired female figure with flowing hair like mist, naturally connecting and merging with the golden light. Her hair is translucent with gradient light effects; she has a graceful posture, eyes closed, and a serene expression, holding a bouquet of colorful flowers dotted with shimmering particles, symbolizing the spiritual connection between people and city energy. Character details are moderately simplified to emphasize the overall design.

Lighting is concentrated on the golden flow, buildings, and character outlines, creating intense chiaroscuro and visual focus. The overall atmosphere is grand, mysterious, imbued with oriental mythology, and slightly healing. Colors use black and dark red as a base with brilliant gold as the main visual emphasis. The gold has rich light-dark layers, complemented by small areas of high-saturation floral colors, maintaining a sophisticated and restrained aesthetic.

Integrated text and layout: Centered Songti font at the top reads "{argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} · China," followed by smaller text "{argument name="date" default="2026/04/20"}" and "{argument name="author" default="LIYUE"}" below. Text uses pale gold or soft warm white, unified with the overall lighting. High-quality details, cinematic lighting, rich volumetric and particle details, clean image without noise, ultra-high 8K resolution, commercial-grade poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
扁平化插画，高端东方奇幻风格城市海报设计，9:16 竖构图。布局采用从左下向右上延伸的对角线加 S 型流线。背景为深黑色渐变至浓郁的暗红色，营造出强烈的冷暖对比和空间深度，并带有淡淡的星尘与颗粒质感。画面中心，一条流动的金色能量线如火焰般蜿蜒穿过，从底部向上延伸，呈现出流体质感、粒子特效和渐变高光，伴有细腻的能量碎片和体积光。

在金色流线中，{argument name="city" default="广州"} 的地标建筑层层浮现：广州塔作为视觉核心，比例突出，周围环绕着珠江新城天际线、猎德大桥以及现代岭南建筑元素。建筑采用“细线勾勒 + 金色发光块面”的渲染方式，轮廓清晰且细节丰富，仿佛悬浮在金色光晕中的虚空之上，通过背景的轻微雾化营造出超现实的空间层次感。

画面底部是一位东方白发女性形象，发丝如雾般飘逸，与金色光芒自然衔接并融为一体。她的头发呈现半透明的渐变光效；姿态优雅，双目微闭，神情宁静，手中捧着一束点缀着闪烁粒子的彩色花束，象征着人与城市能量的精神联结。人物细节经过适度简化，以突出整体设计感。

光影集中在金色流线、建筑和人物轮廓上，营造出强烈的明暗对比和视觉焦点。整体氛围宏大、神秘，充满东方神话色彩，且带有淡淡的治愈感。配色以黑、暗红为基底，以璀璨的金色作为主要视觉重点。金色具有丰富的明暗层次，辅以小面积高饱和度的花卉色彩，保持了精致且克制的审美。

文字与排版整合：顶部居中采用宋体字，书写“{argument name="city" default="广州"} · 中国”，下方辅以较小的文字“{argument name="date" default="2026/04/20"}”和“{argument name="author" default="LIYUE"}”。文字采用淡金色或柔和的暖白色，与整体光影统一。高品质细节，电影级光效，丰富的体积感与粒子细节，画面干净无噪点，超高清 8K 分辨率，商业级海报品质。

templates.title: Oriental Aesthetics Ink Wash Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 东方美学水墨海报

templates.prompt:
New Chinese style ink wash landscape poster, vertical 9:16 composition, oriental minimalist aesthetic style. Large areas of white space, overall color palette of a spring morning (cyan-green, misty blue, light gray, pale ink), low saturation, clear and soft, high-end texture. The main subject consists of steep, majestic mountains rising from both sides of a calm lake, occupying the left and right sides of the frame. The mountains are rendered with ink wash techniques showing rich variations in wetness and density, with local pale green tints reflecting spring vitality. Peaks are enveloped in moist, soft morning mist that layers into the pale blue-gray sky, creating atmospheric perspective and spatial depth.

The lake surface is as calm as a mirror with a slight green tint, reflecting the mountains and sky with a soft focus and atomized diffusion effect, enhancing the moist and dreamy spring atmosphere. In the middle ground, a small wooden boat with a curved canopy floats slowly, oars lightly touching the water to create fine ripples that spread naturally, maintaining total stillness. On the boat is a fisherwoman in red, small in scale (distant perspective), simplified into an ink silhouette with light coloring. She wears a low-saturation cinnabar red traditional dress (not bright red), the color softened by the mist. No facial details, only the silhouette and posture (e.g., lightly touching the canopy or holding an oar). The red forms a faint reflection on the water, serving as the only warm visual focus.

The banks are dotted with sparse woods and new spring vegetation, using light ink and pale green dots, combining solid and void to enhance rhythm and life. A few birds soar in the distant sky, lightly and sparsely distributed to enhance spatial hierarchy and nimbleness. Centered at the top is vertical calligraphy: "{argument name="title" default="Oriental Aesthetics"}", in traditional hand-written running or cursive style (in the spirit of Wang Xizhi), with natural brushstrokes, clear transitions, and ink smudge effects to avoid a digital font feel. Calligraphy color is deep ink-blue or soft black, unified with the scene. Style: Fusion of ink wash and modern minimalist design, spring Zen, ethereal and moist, serene atmosphere, restrained warm-cool contrast, cinematic lighting, high-end artistic poster quality, 8K ultra-clear details.

promptLocalized.zh:
新中式水墨山水海报，9:16 竖构图，东方极简美学风格。大面积留白，整体色调为春日清晨（青绿色、雾霾蓝、浅灰色、淡墨色），低饱和度，清透柔和，高级质感。主体为湖泊两侧拔地而起的巍峨山峦，占据画面左右两侧。山体采用水墨技法，展现出浓淡干湿的丰富变化，局部点缀淡绿色以体现春意。山峰笼罩在湿润柔和的晨雾中，层层叠叠融入淡蓝灰色的天空，营造出大气透视感与空间深度。

湖面如镜，泛着淡淡的青色，倒映着山峦与天空，呈现出柔焦与雾化扩散效果，增强了湿润梦幻的春日氛围。中景处，一艘带曲形篷的小木船缓缓漂浮，船桨轻触水面，泛起自然扩散的细微涟漪，保持整体静谧感。船上有一位红衣渔女，比例较小（远景视角），简化为带有淡彩的水墨剪影。她身着低饱和度的朱砂红传统服饰（非大红），色彩被雾气晕染得柔和。无面部细节，仅保留剪影与姿态（如轻扶船篷或执桨）。红色在水面形成淡淡倒影，成为唯一的暖色视觉焦点。

岸边点缀着疏林与新春植被，运用淡墨与浅绿点染，虚实结合以增强节奏感与生命力。远方天际有几只飞鸟掠过，分布疏朗，提升空间层次与灵动感。顶部居中处为竖排书法：“{argument name="title" default="东方美学"}”，采用传统手写行书或草书风格（王羲之神韵），笔触自然，转折清晰，带有墨迹晕染效果，避免数码字体感。书法颜色为深墨蓝或柔黑色，与画面统一。风格：水墨与现代极简设计融合，春日禅意，空灵湿润，氛围宁静，克制的冷暖对比，电影级光影，高端艺术海报品质，8K 超清细节。

templates.title: Character Relationship Diagram Poster Generator

titleLocalized.zh: 角色关系图海报生成器

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Please generate a high-design character relationship map poster based on {argument name="theme" default="Demon Slayer"}. This image should not be a simple illustration, but a character relationship map that combines information visualization, narrative structure, poster design sense, and stylistic fidelity.

Please automatically complete the following:
- Identify the work and core settings corresponding to the theme
- Extract the most representative 6–12 key characters, not exceeding 15 if necessary
- Identify and display key character relationships, including blood ties, romance, friendship, alliances, hostility, master-disciple, etc.
- Automatically choose a composition method based on the work's characteristics, such as protagonist-centered, dual-core confrontation, faction-based, family tree, or chronological evolution
- Automatically refine the work's style DNA, including color, worldview symbols, textures, mood, typography, and representative elements
- Transform these stylistic elements into an overall visual design for the relationship map, rather than simply copying an official poster
- Use different colors, line types, and arrows to distinguish different relationships, ensuring clear lines and layers without clutter
- Make core characters most prominent, followed by important characters, and subordinate characters weakened to form a clear visual hierarchy
- Ensure every character name is legible, with identity or faction labels if necessary

The final product should satisfy:
- Immediate understanding of character hierarchy and key relationships
- Obvious alignment with the original work's temperament and setting
- Combines the clarity of an infographic with the premium design of a poster
- Unified, exquisite, complete, and suitable for social media sharing or poster display
- Avoids a cheap flowchart feel, messy piling, and information overload.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 {argument name="theme" default="鬼灭之刃"} 生成一张高设计感的角色关系图海报。这张图像不应只是简单的插画，而是一张结合了信息可视化、叙事结构、海报设计感以及风格还原度的角色关系图。

请自动完成以下内容：
- 识别与主题对应的作品及核心设定
- 提取最具代表性的 6–12 位关键角色，必要时不超过 15 位
- 识别并展示关键角色关系，包括血缘、爱情、友情、盟友、敌对、师徒等
- 根据作品特点自动选择构图方式，例如主角中心式、双核对立式、阵营式、家族树式或时间线演变式
- 自动提炼作品的风格 DNA，包括色彩、世界观符号、质感、氛围、排版及代表性元素
- 将这些风格元素转化为关系图的整体视觉设计，而非简单复制官方海报
- 使用不同的颜色、线条类型和箭头来区分不同关系，确保线条清晰、分层明确，避免杂乱
- 使核心角色最突出，次要角色次之，从属角色弱化，形成清晰的视觉层级
- 确保每个角色名称清晰易读，必要时标注身份或阵营标签

最终成品应满足：
- 能立即理解角色层级和关键关系
- 与原作的气质和设定高度契合
- 兼具信息图表的清晰度与海报的高级设计感
- 统一、精致、完整，适合社交媒体分享或海报展示
- 避免廉价的流程图感、杂乱的堆砌以及信息过载。

You need to automatically determine the most suitable subject, clothing system, artifact structure, period style, key components, material craftsmanship, color scheme, and layout structure based on the subject, without the user providing further information.

The overall style should be: National Museum exhibition board, historical costume illustration, or a cultural heritage thematic infographic, rather than a regular poster, ancient-style portraiture, e-commerce detail page, or anime illustration. templates.prompt: Express [{argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"}] in a graffiti sketch style, presenting an overall visual effect of rapid sketching, free transformation, improvised hand-drawing, and draft-like qualities. Lines are casual, exaggerated, varied in thickness, slightly messy but rhythmic and expressive, emphasizing generalization, exaggeration, fun, and spontaneity rather than rigorous realism or fine detail. Colors use rough, dry-brush block expressions, retaining uneven smears, brush marks, flying whites, and overlapping feelings. Colors automatically adapt to the [theme/subject], but the overall expression remains graffiti-like, sketch-like, and generalized. No transparent watercolor smudging, no delicate watercolor transitions, no paper textures, no soft atomization, and no dreamlike quality. The background is mainly white space, remaining simple, relaxed, unfinished, and design-oriented. A small amount of auxiliary symbols, arrows, marks, circles, repeated lines, handwritten text, or other graffiti elements can be added to enhance the sketchbook or essay-like visual language, but should not be too crowded or destroy the subject and atmosphere of the white space. The image content does not need to be written in advance; the [{argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"}] will automatically deduce and generate the most suitable main image, actions, related elements, symbols, or simplified scenes. The whole maintains a unified graffiti sketch style and exaggerated generalized expression, avoiding complex realistic backgrounds and over-elaboration. Naturally add a unique signature "{argument name="signature" default="BlanPlan"}" as part of the image, placed discreetly but clearly in the lower-left, lower-right, or near the title. The style should be unified with the overall layout, like an artist's signature or design inscription; the signature font should be refined, restrained, and high-end, not too large, not destructive to the main composition, and not appearing abrupt or cheap.
