templates.prompt: This scene is a medium-close shot using a eye-level lens, focusing on a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"}. She is shown in a three-quarter shot, sitting with a slight tilt, hips pushed back, legs naturally crossed with the left leg in front and right behind, knees slightly bent. She turns her upper body toward the back right, with her head facing the camera in a classic 'looking back' pose, eyes direct and clear with a hint of playfulness. Her hairstyle is {argument name="hairstyle" default="voluminous brown shoulder-length short hair"} with natural bangs and slightly curled ends. Her makeup is light and natural, with slight eyeliner and natural nude-pink lips. The overall image uses a natural daylight filter, with light hitting from the upper left to create a soft back-lit silhouette. The face and right side of the body are illuminated by warm golden light, while the left side has a natural shadow transition to enhance three-dimensionality. The lighting effect is bright natural light with slight lens flare, creating an afternoon sun atmosphere. From an eye-level angle, the composition places the subject in the middle-right of the frame, with crosswalks and road lines in the background serving as natural leading lines toward the figure. The background is a city street including roads, crosswalks, green belts, and distant vehicles; it is moderately blurred but elements like trees, guardrails, and parked scooters remain recognizable. The composition uses the rule of thirds, with the figure on the right third to balance the frame. The subject wears a {argument name="clothing" default="army green camo hooded sweatshirt"}, paired with black shorts and white high-top sneakers with white mid-calf socks. The backpack is black with orange-yellow decorative stripes and an orange plush pendant, made of canvas and leather. The overall style is street casual, with relaxed body language and a curious, playful expression, presenting an image of a spontaneous, youthful, and vibrant urban girl.

promptLocalized.zh: 此场景为中近景镜头，采用平视视角，聚焦于 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}。她呈现四分之三侧身，坐姿微倾，臀部后推，双腿自然交叉，左腿在前右腿在后，膝盖微屈。她上半身向右后方转动，头部面向镜头，呈现经典的“回眸”姿态，眼神直视且清澈，透着一丝俏皮。她的发型为 {argument name="hairstyle" default="蓬松的棕色齐肩短发"}，配有自然刘海和微卷的发梢。妆容清透自然，带有淡淡的眼线和自然的裸粉色唇妆。整体画面使用自然日光滤镜，光线从左上方射入，营造出柔和的逆光轮廓。面部和身体右侧被温暖的金色光线照亮，左侧则有自然的阴影过渡，增强了立体感。光效为明亮的自然光，带有轻微的镜头光晕，营造出午后阳光的氛围。从平视角度来看，构图将主体置于画面的中右侧，背景中的人行横道和道路标线作为自然的引导线指向人物。背景为城市街道，包括道路、人行横道、绿化带和远处的车辆；背景经过适度模糊处理，但树木、护栏和停放的踏板车等元素依然清晰可辨。构图采用三分法，将人物置于右侧三分之一处以平衡画面。主体身着 {argument name="clothing" default="军绿色迷彩连帽卫衣"}，搭配黑色短裤和白色高帮运动鞋及白色中筒袜。背包为黑色，带有橙黄色装饰条纹和一个橙色毛绒挂件，材质为帆布和皮革。整体风格为街头休闲风，肢体语言放松，表情好奇且俏皮，呈现出一位随性、年轻且充满活力的都市女孩形象。

Edge details: four corners adorned with fine microscopic illustrations themed on ancient observation notes, ritual implements, and runes. Color: low-saturation sage green, light gold, and off-white as main tones, generally light and soft without piercing high-saturation colors. Details: architectural lines, landscape brushwork techniques, lotus patterns, and cloud layers are clearly visible and rendered with extreme detail. Seamless fusion: Natural transitions between the three layers via clouds and flowing water, seamlessly connecting Buddhist light, Taoist Taiji clouds, and Confucian scholarly atmosphere. Style: {argument name="art style" default="classical ink line art + low-saturation digital watercolor"}, with a light Chinese style ancient book manuscript texture. Text annotations: Pure traditional Chinese characters in a mottled ancient Song font, each annotation containing a short title + a line of poetic description, connected to details by dark gold hairline leads with no repetitive pointing. Aspect ratio: 3:4 vertical independent complete unit. Title Area (top): `Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism: Fundamental Differences`. Central layered annotations: Top layer 'Buddhism': `Buddhism`, `Relationship between self and self`, `No-self, governing the heart, letting go`. Middle layer 'Taoism': `Taoism`, `Relationship between self and all things`, `Non-action, governing the body, keeping an open mind`. Bottom layer 'Confucianism': `Confucianism`, `Relationship between people`, `No-ego, governing the world, taking responsibility`. Side auxiliary annotations: Left: `Purity: clear heart and bright mind, severing afflictions`; `Stillness: following nature, returning to the original heart`; `Reverence: awe of responsibility, active engagement with the world`. Right: `60+ years refining the heart: looking past gains and losses, returning to the inner self`; `35-55 years being human: balance of tension and relaxation, following laws`; `7-35 years doing things: forging ahead with determination, building a career`. Bottom summary: `The balance between being in the world and being out of it is a high-level wisdom of life`.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊叹且极其复杂的概念性世界观信息图杰作，主题为“{argument name="theme" default="儒家、道家与佛家的根本差异"}”，整体设计为古代东方神话手稿风格。背景：纯白复古纹理画布，浅米色陈旧羊皮纸底色，带有轻微的磨损边缘和水渍效果。核心布局：中心视觉采用宏大的“垂直蛋形分层结构”，从上至下分别为佛家、道家和儒家层。边缘细节：四个角落装饰有以古代观察笔记、礼器和符文为主题的精细微型插画。配色：以低饱和度的鼠尾草绿、浅金和灰白色为主调，整体明亮柔和，无刺眼的超高饱和度色彩。细节：建筑线条、山水笔触、莲花纹样和云层清晰可见，渲染极其细腻。无缝融合：通过云朵和流水实现三层之间的自然过渡，将佛家之光、道家太极云纹与儒家书卷气息无缝连接。风格：{argument name="art style" default="古典水墨线条艺术 + 低饱和度数字水彩"}，带有轻盈的中国风古籍手稿质感。文字标注：纯繁体中文字符，采用斑驳的古宋体，每处标注包含一个短标题 + 一行诗意描述，通过深金色的细线连接至细节处，无重复指向。长宽比：3:4 垂直独立完整单元。标题区域（顶部）：`儒释道：根本差异`。中心分层标注：顶层“佛家”：`佛家`，`自我与自我的关系`，`无我、治心、放下`。中层“道家”：`道家`，`自我与万物的关系`，`无为、治身、虚怀`。底层“儒家”：`儒家`，`人与人的关系`，`无我、治世、担当`。侧边辅助标注：左侧：`清净：清心明目，断除烦恼`；`静谧：顺应自然，回归本心`；`敬畏：对责任的敬畏，积极入世`。右侧：`60+ 岁炼心：看淡得失，回归内心`；`35-55 岁做人：张弛有度，遵循法度`；`7-35 岁做事：砥砺前行，建功立业`。底部总结：`出世与入世之间的平衡，是人生的高级智慧`。

templates.title: Pose and Lighting Analysis Sheet Transformer

titleLocalized.zh: 姿态与光影分析图转换器

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
[CORE TASK]
Transform the provided input image into a pose-and-light analysis sheet.

This is NOT a finished character illustration.
This is NOT a clothing sheet.
This is NOT a beauty-preserving redraw.

This is a white-line rough mannequin conversion.

[PRIMARY GOAL]
Extract and visualize only:
- pose structure
- body balance
- camera angle
- body line flow
- inferred light source placement
- illuminated areas and light intensity

[INPUT ROLE]
Use the provided image as the strict anchor for:
- pose
- camera angle
- body tilt
- weight distribution
- approximate lighting situation

Do NOT preserve:
- face rendering
- hairstyle rendering
- clothing detail
- accessories
- weapon detail
- background architecture
- character identity
- emotional expression

[FIGURE CONVERSION]
single rough mannequin-like human figure
white body contour lines
white internal construction lines
simple mannequin head
no face
no eyes
no mouth
no eyelashes
no personality
no individual identity

human figure should look like:
- rough pose mannequin
- anatomy proxy
- line-based body guide
- structural sketch
- white-line rough dummy

keep:
- pose readability
- silhouette flow
- head tilt
- torso direction
- pelvis direction
- limb placement

[BACKGROUND]
pure black background
negative-style dark field
no scenery
no props
no architecture
no environmental storytelling

[LINE STYLE]
rough white line drawing
clean but sketch-like
construction-line feeling
anatomy guide lines visible
joint flow visible
body contour emphasized
no polished illustration finish

[LIGHT ESTIMATION]
predict the likely light source positions from the input image
visualize the light sources and illuminated areas using green glow only

use green light intensity with variation:
- strongest green where the light directly hits
- medium green for wrap light
- soft green for reflected or fading light

mark the estimated light sources with labels and arrows such as:
- Main Light
- Rim Light
- Fill Light
- Floor Bounce
- Back Light
only if appropriate

IMPORTANT:
do not invent random lights
infer lighting from the original input image
if the lighting is ambiguous, keep the annotations simple and plausible

[GREEN LIGHT VISUALIZATION]
show green glow on:
- head / skull plane
- neck
- shoulders
- chest plane
- ribcage direction
- pelvis edge
- thigh planes
- knee contact points
- floor contact bounce if applicable

use green light not as decoration,
but as lighting analysis information

[POSE PRIORITY]
1. preserve pose structure
2. preserve camera angle
3. preserve body balance
4. preserve head-torso relationship
5. visualize likely light direction
6. show illuminated areas with readable green intensity variation

[NEGATIVE]
finished person,
cute girl,
detailed face,
hair rendering,
clothing rendering,
weapon emphasis,
beautiful anatomy

promptLocalized.zh:
[核心任务]
将提供的输入图像转换为姿态与光影分析图。

这不是成品角色插画。
这不是服装设计图。
这不是保留美感的重绘。

这是一个白线草图人体模型转换。

[主要目标]
仅提取并可视化以下内容：
- 姿态结构
- 身体平衡
- 摄像机角度
- 身体线条流向
- 推断的光源位置
- 受光区域与光照强度

[输入角色]
将提供的图像作为以下内容的严格锚点：
- 姿态
- 摄像机角度
- 身体倾斜度
- 重心分布
- 大致的光照情况

请勿保留：
- 面部渲染
- 发型渲染
- 服装细节
- 配饰
- 武器细节
- 背景建筑
- 角色身份
- 情绪表达

[人物转换]
单一粗略的人体模型
白色身体轮廓线
白色内部构造线
简单的模型头部
无面部
无眼睛
无嘴巴
无睫毛
无个性
无个人身份

人体模型应呈现为：
- 粗略的姿态模型
- 解剖学代理模型
- 基于线条的身体指南
- 结构草图
- 白线粗糙模型

保留：
- 姿态的可读性
- 轮廓流向
- 头部倾斜
- 躯干方向
- 骨盆方向
- 四肢位置

[背景]
纯黑色背景
负片风格暗场
无场景
无道具
无建筑
无环境叙事

[线条风格]
粗略的白线绘图
简洁但具有草图感
构造线感
可见解剖引导线
可见关节流向
强调身体轮廓
非精细插画成品

[光影估算]
根据输入图像预测可能的光源位置
仅使用绿色光晕可视化光源和受光区域

使用具有变化的绿色光照强度：
- 最强绿色：光线直射处
- 中等绿色：包裹光
- 柔和绿色：反射光或减弱的光

使用标签和箭头标记估算的光源，例如：
- 主光 (Main Light)
- 轮廓光 (Rim Light)
- 补光 (Fill Light)
- 地面反光 (Floor Bounce)
- 背光 (Back Light)
仅在合适时使用

重要提示：
不要随意编造光源
根据原始输入图像推断光照
如果光照模糊，请保持标注简单且合理

[绿色光影可视化]
在以下部位显示绿色光晕：
- 头部 / 头骨平面
- 颈部
- 肩部
- 胸部平面
- 胸腔方向
- 骨盆边缘
- 大腿平面
- 膝盖接触点
- 地面接触反光（如适用）

使用绿色光影不是为了装饰，
而是作为光影分析信息

[姿态优先级]
1. 保留姿态结构
2. 保留摄像机角度
3. 保留身体平衡
4. 保留头身关系
5. 可视化可能的光照方向
6. 通过可读的绿色强度变化展示受光区域

[负面提示]
成品人物，
可爱女孩，
精细面部，
头发渲染，
服装渲染，
武器强调，
美化后的解剖结构

templates.prompt: A photorealistic amateur photograph of a custom building block set resting on a light wood grain table in a living room. A red circular badge on the box reads "CUSTOM SET FAN DESIGN", and the box art depicts the house and characters under a blue sky. In the foreground sits the fully assembled block model of a {argument name="house color" default="blue"} two-story suburban house with a brown roof, white porch, red steps, a white picket fence, and a blocky green tree. To the left of the house is a built block model of a {argument name="car color" default="pink"} station wagon. Standing in a row in front of the house are exactly 5 custom block minifigures: a blue cat in tan pants, an orange fish with legs, a tall pink rabbit in a white shirt and tie, a blue cat in a white shirt, and a small pink rabbit in an orange dress. The background is a slightly blurred living room with a grey sofa and white blinds.

The hotbar contains, from left to right: a selected blue tool with a green highlight box, a green tool, a knife, a wrench with the number '3', a piece of meat with '6', a lantern with '24', a dirt block with '10', a bucket, and a sponge block.

titleLocalized.zh: 复古石榴生长图谱

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create a highly detailed vintage scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, styled like a 19th-century natural history atlas plate with modern clean layout refinement. The main subject is a full pomegranate plant, labeled {argument name="plant name" default="石榴"} / {argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"}, shown centered from crown to roots in a full vertical cutaway-style presentation. Depict a slender woody trunk with many branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red blossoms, unopened buds, young fruits, mature fruits, one large split-open pomegranate exposing dense ruby seeds, and a fully visible sprawling root system underground. Use delicate watercolor and ink rendering, realistic botanical anatomy, precise linework, subtle sepia shadows, fine leader lines, arrows, and small numbered callout circles. Overall poster title at upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="植物生命路径剖面"} with English subtitle directly below: {argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"}. Add a short introductory bilingual-style text block beneath the title. The composition is a tall 9:16 educational poster with the plant occupying the center and explanatory diagrams surrounding it.

Include exactly 8 numbered educational sections around the plant, each with visible Chinese title and smaller English translation, arranged atlas-style:
1. Seed Architecture — a large cutaway seed diagram with labeled internal parts and a smaller cellular cross-section inset.
2. Germination Mechanism — a left-side sequence of exactly 5 stages showing seed swelling, cracking, sprouting, radicle emergence, and early seedling.
3. Root System + Substrate Intelligence — a large exposed root mass at lower left with exactly 2 circular magnified root-detail insets showing branching structures and root-hair/network texture.
4. Stem, Leaf & Vascular System — a right-middle section with exactly 2 anatomical circular cross-sections and exactly 1 separate leaf illustration, with labels for xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues.
5. Photosynthesis + Energy Conversion — a lower-right biology panel with exactly 3 green microstructure diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, plus a simple chemical flow line indicating CO2 + H2O to sugars and O2.
6. Bud Formation + Blooming — an upper-right flowering section with exactly 2 large flower anatomy diagrams, one side view and one longitudinal cutaway, with labeled stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures.
7. Pollination + Fruiting Pathway — a right-side development strip with exactly 5 fruit development stages from bud to mature pomegranate, accompanied by a pollination inset featuring a bee approaching a flower.
8. Fruit Maturation + Seed Cycle — a bottom-right lifecycle section with exactly 3 fruit illustrations showing whole fruit, cracked fruit, and opened fruit with scattered seeds, plus exactly 3 seedling progression drawings.

Along the very bottom edge, include a long chronological growth strip with exactly 19 small step illustrations, each numbered in sequence from 1 to 19, showing the plant life cycle from dormant seed through germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit set, ripening, seed release, and cycle renewal. Add a small environmental factors panel at lower left with icon-like indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Use bilingual labeling throughout, with Chinese headings more prominent and English translations in smaller serif text. Aesthetic should feel scholarly, elegant, museum-quality, and information-dense, with refined antique typography, muted beige background, realistic reds and greens, and a clean balanced atlas layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张细节极其丰富的复古科学植物信息图海报，采用暖象牙色纸张，风格仿照 19 世纪自然历史图谱，并结合现代简洁的排版优化。主体为一株完整的石榴植株，标注为 {argument name="plant name" default="石榴"} / {argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"}，以垂直剖面风格居中展示，从树冠到根部一览无余。描绘一根纤细的木质树干，带有繁茂的分枝、油亮的绿叶、几朵橙红色的花朵、未开的花蕾、幼果、成熟果实，以及一个裂开的硕大石榴，露出密集的红宝石般种子，地下则是完全可见的蔓延根系。采用精致的水彩和墨水渲染，具备写实的植物解剖结构、精准的线条、微妙的深褐色阴影、精细的引导线、箭头以及小型编号标注圆圈。海报左上方设有总标题：{argument name="headline text" default="植物生命路径剖面"}，下方紧跟英文副标题：{argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"}。在标题下方添加一段简短的双语风格介绍文本。构图为 9:16 的高长教育海报，植株位于中心，周围环绕说明性图表。

在植株周围包含 8 个编号的教育板块，每个板块均配有醒目的中文标题和较小的英文翻译，按图谱风格排列：
1. 种子结构 — 一个大型种子剖面图，标有内部零件，并附带一个较小的细胞横截面插图。
2. 发芽机制 — 左侧序列，包含 5 个阶段，展示种子膨胀、裂开、发芽、胚根出现及幼苗早期形态。
3. 根系与基质智能 — 左下方展示大型裸露根系，配有 2 个圆形放大根部细节插图，显示分支结构及根毛/网络纹理。
4. 茎、叶与维管系统 — 右中部区域，包含 2 个解剖学圆形横截面和 1 个独立的叶片插图，标注木质部、韧皮部、表皮及相关组织。
5. 光合作用与能量转换 — 右下方生物学面板，包含 3 个绿色微观结构图，包括叶片组织/类细胞切片，以及简单的化学流动线，指示 CO2 + H2O 转化为糖分和 O2。
6. 花蕾形成与开花 — 右上方开花部分，包含 2 个大型花朵解剖图（侧视图和纵剖面），标注雄蕊、花瓣、子房和花粉结构。
7. 授粉与结果路径 — 右侧发育条，包含 5 个从花蕾到成熟石榴的果实发育阶段，并附带一个展示蜜蜂接近花朵的授粉插图。
8. 果实成熟与种子循环 — 右下方生命周期部分，包含 3 个果实插图，展示完整果实、裂开果实及露出种子的开裂果实，外加 3 幅幼苗生长过程图。

在最底边缘，包含一条长长的生长纪实带，内含 19 个小型步骤插图，每个均按 1 到 19 编号，展示从休眠种子到发芽、根系生长、幼苗破土、树苗发育、开花、坐果、成熟、种子散播及循环更新的植物生命周期。左下方添加一个小型的环境因素面板，配有光照、温度、水分、养分和空气的图标式指示器。全程使用双语标注，中文标题更为突出，英文翻译采用较小的衬线字体。整体美学应呈现出学术、优雅、博物馆级品质及信息密集感，并辅以精致的古风排版、柔和的米色背景、写实的红绿色调以及平衡整洁的图谱布局。

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, cinematic wide shot of a grand, dark gothic hall with a {argument name="atmosphere" default="dark fantasy"} aesthetic. In the center, a single figure wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="long white robe"} kneels on a highly reflective stone floor, facing an ornate golden altar illuminated by a row of lit candles. To the right of the kneeling figure, a single {argument name="floor object" default="wooden violin"} rests on the ground. The cavernous room is framed by massive dark stone pillars detailed with {argument name="accent color" default="glowing blue"} ethereal cracks and veins. Suspended from the high ceiling are dozens of {argument name="floating objects" default="white porcelain theatrical masks"} hanging on thin strings, filling the upper half of the space and creating a haunting, surreal atmosphere. The lighting is dramatic and moody, featuring a rich color palette of deep blacks, tarnished golds, and cool blue accents. Format 16:9.

Additional text at the bottom includes author credits and a publisher logo. The overall mood is dramatic and romantic with dynamic lighting.

templates.prompt: A cinematic Japanese movie poster featuring a romantic, melancholic scene of a man and a woman standing face-to-face on a wet train station platform at night in the rain. The tall man on the left wears a dark coat and backpack, holding a black umbrella over them. The woman on the right wears a tan trench coat, looking up at him. A red and white commuter train with the word Tokyo written in Japanese and English on the front is on the tracks to the right. A station sign on the left indicates the Yamanote Line in Japanese. The lighting is moody with neon city lights reflecting on the wet platform. The poster features prominent text overlays. At the top, a horizontal tagline reads {argument name="top tagline" default="あの日、言えなかった言葉がある。"}. On the left, a vertical tagline reads {argument name="side tagline" default="あの日、置き去りにした想い 今、ふたりをつなぐ..."}. In the lower center, the large main title is {argument name="main title" default="最後の切符"} in a white serif font, with a red cursive subtitle {argument name="romaji subtitle" default="Saigo no Kippu"} below it. Below the title are two lines of Japanese cast names, followed by a dense block of small Japanese production credits. At the bottom center, a red website URL and the release text {argument name="release info" default="2025年秋 全国ロードショー"}. The bottom corners feature two golden award laurels with Japanese text.

templates.title: Gothic Mystery Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特悬疑电影海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic, dark gothic mystery movie poster. In the center, a lone man wearing a trench coat and fedora stands with his back to the viewer, looking up at a massive, imposing gothic clock tower. The clock face is illuminated, and the structure around it is shattering with dark fragments falling. The setting is a foggy, wet cobblestone square at night, illuminated by warm yellow streetlamps and glowing windows from surrounding European-style buildings. A full moon shines through cloudy skies. There are exactly 3 ravens: one perched on a stone monument on the left, and two flying in the sky. The monument on the left has engraved text "VERITAS IN UMBRA, TEMPUS NEMINI PARET". On the right, a wooden signpost has 3 directional arrows reading "Marktplatz", "Uhrenturm", and "Alte Gasse", with a small newspaper leaning against it reading "Die Uhr steht." and "Wer lügt?". The poster features elegant, slightly distressed serif Japanese typography. At the top, a horizontal tagline reads {argument name="top tagline" default="真夜中、時は止まり、嘘が動き出す。"}. On the upper left, a vertical tagline reads {argument name="side tagline" default="その鐘の音が、真実を葬った。"}. In the lower center, the large main title reads {argument name="main title" default="時計塔の殺人"}. Below the title is a smaller tagline "時を欺いたのは、誰だ。" followed by a dense block of realistic movie credits including director, cast, and crew names. At the very bottom, the release text {argument name="release date" default="2025年 秋 全国ロードショー"} is displayed alongside a website URL and rating logos. The entire poster is framed by a thin, ornate gold border.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的暗黑哥特悬疑电影海报。画面中心，一名身穿风衣、头戴软呢帽的男子背对观众，仰望着一座宏伟且压抑的哥特式钟楼。钟面发出亮光，周围的建筑结构正在崩塌，黑暗的碎片四散坠落。场景设定在雾气弥漫、潮湿的夜晚鹅卵石广场上，被温暖的黄色路灯和周围欧式建筑中透出的光亮所照亮。一轮满月穿过云层。画面中共有 3 只乌鸦：一只停在左侧的石碑上，两只在天空中飞翔。左侧的石碑上刻有文字“VERITAS IN UMBRA, TEMPUS NEMINI PARET”。右侧是一个木制路标，带有 3 个指向标，分别写着“Marktplatz”、“Uhrenturm”和“Alte Gasse”，旁边靠着一份报纸，上面写着“Die Uhr steht.”和“Wer lügt?”。海报采用了优雅且略带磨损感的衬线日文字体。顶部横向标语为 {argument name="top tagline" default="真夜中、時は止まり、嘘が動き出す。"}。左上方垂直标语为 {argument name="side tagline" default="その鐘の音が、真実を葬った。"}。下方中心位置的主标题为 {argument name="main title" default="時計塔の殺人"}。标题下方是一行较小的标语“時を欺いたのは、誰だ。”，随后是一段包含导演、演员和剧组成员名字的逼真电影演职员表。最底部显示发布信息 {argument name="release date" default="2025年 秋 全国ロードショー"}，旁边附有网站 URL 和评级标志。整张海报由细致的华丽金边框装饰。

templates.title: Sci-Fi Anime Detective Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 科幻动漫侦探海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic anime-style sci-fi movie poster. In the center, a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long silver"} hair and blue eyes sits confidently in a massive, futuristic grey armchair with glowing light blue neon accents. She wears a black trench coat over a white high-collared shirt, black pants, and black heeled boots. The chair rests on a glowing blue circular holographic platform floating in deep space filled with stars. Behind her, translucent blue holographic screens display data and planetary images. At the top center, the series title {argument name="series title" default="『電脳椅子探偵シャルロット』"} is written in small white text, above the large main title {argument name="main title" default="『天使の涙』"} in an elegant serif font. Below the main title is the tagline {argument name="subtitle" default="すべての記録は、この出会いから始まった。"}. At the bottom center of the poster, a block of text reads "This is the first record of Charlotte and W.A.T.S.O.N." followed by a large stylized title {argument name="bottom text" default="シャルロット & W.A.T.S.O.N."} and credits "Original Story / Screenplay / Director noriyang" at the very bottom. The overall atmosphere is mysterious, high-tech, and epic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感动漫风格的科幻电影海报。画面中央，一位有着 {argument name="hair color" default="银色长发"} 和蓝色眼睛的年轻女性自信地坐在一张巨大的、充满未来感的灰色扶手椅上，椅子带有发光的浅蓝色霓虹灯装饰。她身穿黑色风衣，内搭白色高领衬衫，下身穿着黑色长裤和黑色高跟靴。座椅位于一个漂浮在繁星点点的深空中的发光蓝色圆形全息平台上。在她身后，半透明的蓝色全息屏幕显示着数据和行星图像。在顶部中央，系列标题 {argument name="series title" default="『電脳椅子探偵シャルロット』"} 以白色小字呈现，位于优雅衬线字体书写的大型主标题 {argument name="main title" default="『天使の涙』"} 上方。主标题下方是标语 {argument name="subtitle" default="すべての記録は、この出会いから始まった。"}。海报底部中央有一段文字写着 "This is the first record of Charlotte and W.A.T.S.O.N."，随后是醒目的风格化标题 {argument name="bottom text" default="シャルロット & W.A.T.S.O.N."}，最底部标注着 "Original Story / Screenplay / Director noriyang"。整体氛围神秘、充满高科技感且史诗宏大。

templates.prompt: An anime-style key visual poster for a fictional slice-of-life anime. In the foreground left, an energetic blonde anime girl with star hairpins and blue eyes wears an {argument name="main character outfit" default="American flag t-shirt and denim shorts"}, holding tongs with a slice of smoked meat towards the viewer. In the foreground right, a gentle girl with long dark hair and a white sweater sits at a wooden table writing in a notebook. In the background, two more girls are present: one with a brown ponytail carrying firewood, and another with short silver hair holding a blue mug. The scene is a sunny outdoor BBQ area with a large black smoker grill featuring a sign that reads {argument name="background grill sign" default="LONE STAR BBQ"}. In the immediate foreground is a {argument name="food platter" default="massive wooden platter loaded with sliced brisket, ribs, sausages, burnt ends, and pickles"}, along with side dishes like coleslaw and bread. In the top left corner, a large, cute, bubbly anime logo reads {argument name="anime title" default="もくもく すもーく ガールズ"} with smoke and grill motifs. In the bottom left corner, there is a {argument name="credits text block" default="staff credits block with names and roles"}. In the bottom right corner, a small text box lists four character names. The overall atmosphere is cheerful, highly detailed, and vibrant.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张虚构日常系动漫的动漫风格主视觉海报。左前方，一位充满活力的金发动漫少女戴着星星发夹，有着蓝色双眼，身穿 {argument name="main character outfit" default="美国国旗 T 恤和牛仔短裤"}，正拿着烤肉夹向观众递出一片烟熏肉。右前方，一位留着长黑发、身穿白色毛衣的温柔女孩坐在木桌旁写着笔记。背景中还有另外两名女孩：一位扎着棕色马尾辫，正搬运着木柴；另一位留着银色短发，手里拿着一个蓝色马克杯。场景设定在阳光明媚的户外烧烤区，设有一个大型黑色烟熏烤炉，上面挂着写有 {argument name="background grill sign" default="LONE STAR BBQ"} 的招牌。最前方是一个 {argument name="food platter" default="盛满切片牛胸肉、排骨、香肠、焦边肉和酸黄瓜的大型木制拼盘"}，旁边还有凉拌卷心菜和面包等配菜。左上角是一个大型、可爱且充满活力的动漫 Logo，写着 {argument name="anime title" default="もくもく すもーく ガールズ"}，并配有烟雾和烧烤图案。左下角有一个 {argument name="credits text block" default="包含姓名和职位的制作人员名单块"}。右下角的小文本框列出了四个角色的名字。整体氛围欢快、细节丰富且充满活力。

The setting is a sunlit room equipped for music production, featuring two computer monitors displaying audio waveforms, a microphone, and a keyboard. The scene features bright, cinematic lighting with lens flares and sparkling effects. templates.title: Japanese Self-Help Book Cover Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 日式自助类书籍封面样机

templates.prompt: A realistic 3D mockup of a softcover book standing upright at a slight angle on a plain off-white background, revealing both the front cover and the spine. The cover features a minimalist, serene illustration of a white arched doorway opening to a bright pastel sunrise over a calm sea, with a woman in a flowing white dress standing in the archway looking toward the horizon. Large, elegant vertical Japanese text in a Mincho serif font dominates the right and left sides of the arch, reading {argument name="main title" default="我慢をやめたら、人生が動き出した。"}. In the top left corner, smaller horizontal text reads {argument name="subtitle" default="自分の人生を取り戻す 7つのステップ"}. The bottom third of the book is wrapped in a light pink belly band. The band features a prominent horizontal catchphrase reading {argument name="obi catchphrase" default="もう、他人軸で生きなくていい。"}, with smaller text above it separated by a dotted line mentioning work, relationships, love, and future anxiety. On the right side of the band is a white circular badge with a small crown icon and text reading {argument name="sales badge text" default="累計 20万部 突破!"}. At the very bottom of the band are exactly 4 small rectangular boxes containing keywords about self-esteem, time management, mental organization, and ideal future, followed by the text "Everything will change!". The spine is white and displays the main title, subtitle, a placeholder for the author's name, and a placeholder for the publisher.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个逼真的 3D 平装书样机，以微倾斜角度直立在纯净的米白色背景上，展示了封面和书脊。封面采用极简且宁静的插画，描绘了一扇白色的拱门，门外是平静海面上明亮的柔和日出，一位身穿飘逸白裙的女性站在拱门处望向地平线。拱门左右两侧是优雅的竖排日文大字，采用明朝体（Mincho），内容为 {argument name="main title" default="我慢をやめたら、人生が動き出した。"}。左上角有较小的横排文字 {argument name="subtitle" default="自分の人生を取り戻す 7つのステップ"}。书的底部三分之一处包裹着淡粉色的腰封。腰封上印有醒目的横排宣传语 {argument name="obi catchphrase" default="もう、他人軸で生きなくていい。"}，上方通过虚线分隔的小字提到了工作、人际关系、爱情和未来焦虑。腰封右侧是一个带有小皇冠图标的白色圆形徽章，文字为 {argument name="sales badge text" default="累計 20万部 突破!"}。腰封最底部有 4 个小矩形框，包含关于自尊、时间管理、心理整理和理想未来的关键词，随后是文字 "Everything will change!"。书脊为白色，展示了主标题、副标题、作者名占位符以及出版社占位符。

templates.prompt: A {argument name="art style" default="traditional Japanese Ukiyo-e woodblock print"} landscape featuring an {argument name="main character" default="anthropomorphic glass of beer with a frothy head, a happy smiling face, stick-like yellow arms and legs, and traditional sandals"} walking on a dirt path. The background includes a large pine tree and a wooden bridge on the right with 3 small figures crossing, plus 3 more figures walking on the path. To the left, tall reeds border a river leading to a distant {argument name="background mountain" default="snow-capped Mount Fuji"} under a gradient sky. A traditional text cartouche in the top left reads "{argument name="top left text" default="東海道 五十三次之内 由井"}" next to red artist seals, with a matching cartouche in the bottom left. The image has vintage, muted colors and authentic woodblock paper textures.

The center showcases a vibrant, illuminated modern metropolis with {argument name="modern landmark" default="a cluster of futuristic skyscrapers connected by a skybridge"}, a wide river with boats, a red suspension bridge, and a cable car suspended in the air. templates.title: Fitness SaaS Landing Page UI

titleLocalized.zh: 健身 SaaS 着陆页 UI

templates.prompt:
Design a modern, high-end {argument name="app type" default="fitness app"} landing page and product UI for a brand called {argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"}.

Create a clean web design mockup that looks like a real SaaS fitness platform and mobile companion app. The design should feel premium, motivating, and easy to use, with a polished UI/UX style similar to top-tier health and wellness apps.

Include:
- A hero section with bold headline, short subheadline, strong call-to-action button, and app preview
- Dashboard UI showing daily activity, calories burned, workout streak, heart rate, step count, and progress rings
- Workout program cards for strength, cardio, mobility, and recovery
- Nutrition tracking section with macro breakdown and water intake
- Progress charts and analytics widgets
- Trainer/community section with profile cards and testimonials
- Pricing section and download/app store callout
- Mobile app screens shown alongside the web design for a cohesive product ecosystem

Style direction:
- Sleek, minimal, modern interface
- Premium fitness brand aesthetic
- Smooth spacing, strong hierarchy, rounded cards, soft shadows
- Dark mode UI with energetic accent colors like electric blue, neon green, or vibrant orange
- Crisp typography, realistic charts, polished buttons, beautiful onboarding feel
- Highly detailed, dribbble-worthy, startup-quality product design
- Realistic UX case study presentation, not a cartoon or illustration

Composition:
- Full website homepage mockup
- Multiple UI sections visible in one polished presentation
- Slight perspective or straight-on product showcase
- Clean background with subtle gradients and professional lighting
- Ultra-detailed, sharp text rendering, visually balanced layout

Output:
A stunning, realistic UI/UX design concept for a fitness app website and dashboard that looks ready for development.

Make it look like a real Figma product design presentation for a premium startup.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一个现代、高端的 {argument name="app type" default="健身应用"} 着陆页及产品 UI，品牌名称为 {argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"}。

创建一个简洁的 Web 设计模型，使其看起来像一个真实的 SaaS 健身平台及配套移动端应用。设计风格应体现高端感、激励性且易于使用，UI/UX 风格需对标顶级健康与健身应用。

包含内容：
- 首屏板块：包含醒目的标题、简短的副标题、强有力的行动号召（CTA）按钮以及应用预览
- 仪表盘 UI：展示每日活动、消耗卡路里、锻炼连续天数、心率、步数及进度环
- 锻炼计划卡片：涵盖力量、有氧、灵活性及恢复训练
- 营养追踪板块：包含宏量营养素分析及饮水量记录
- 进度图表与分析组件
- 教练/社区板块：包含个人资料卡片及用户评价
- 定价板块及应用商店下载引导
- 移动端应用界面：与 Web 设计并列展示，呈现统一的产品生态系统

风格导向：
- 时髦、极简、现代的界面
- 高端健身品牌美学
- 舒适的间距、清晰的层级、圆角卡片、柔和阴影
- 深色模式 UI，搭配电光蓝、霓虹绿或活力橙等充满能量的强调色
- 清晰的排版、真实的图表、精致的按钮、美观的引导页体验
- 高度细节化、符合 Dribbble 标准、具备初创公司水准的产品设计
- 真实的 UX 案例研究展示，非卡通或插画风格

构图：
- 完整的网站首页模型
- 在一个精致的展示中呈现多个 UI 板块
- 采用微透视或正视的产品展示视角
- 简洁的背景，带有微妙的渐变与专业灯光效果
- 超高细节、清晰的文字渲染、视觉平衡的布局

输出：
一个令人惊艳、逼真的健身应用网站及仪表盘 UI/UX 设计概念，看起来已达到可开发标准。

使其看起来像是一个针对高端初创公司的真实 Figma 产品设计演示。

templates.title: 3D Papercut Pirate Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 纸雕海盗场景

templates.prompt: Eye-level view, looking straight at a high-saturation 3D multi-layered paper carving scene. The overall colors are grayish-blue, creamy white, and deep forest green, accented with amber warm light. All elements must be physical paper layered structures, with hard-cut edges and clearly visible thick paper cross-sections. Extremely rich composition, a high-energy {argument name="scene theme" default="pirate group scene"} set in a chaotic sea adventure. Multiple stylized pirate characters are presented in exaggerated actions, with a {argument name="core character" default="young captain wearing a straw hat"} in the middle layer charging forward, surrounded by crew members with distinct poses. Layered ships, surging waves, and swirling currents run through the foreground, middle, and background, with multiple ships colliding and tilting in different spatial layers, sails torn, and flags flying. Silhouettes of giant opposing characters appear in the background layer to enhance the sense of oppression and spatial hierarchy. The foreground is filled with narrative elements: treasure chests, gold coins, maps, barrels, ropes, lanterns, and a wanted poster with a smiling pirate. A mascot-like small character is placed in the corner as a visual anchor. All atmospheric elements are presented in paper carving form: waves, splashes, smoke, debris, and movement lines, strengthening the chaos and sense of motion. The main subject is in the middle layer, with elements interacting across layers to express movement through overlap and spatial relationships. Soft light from a single direction creates clear inter-layer shadows. Overall matte paper texture, no glowing, no soft edges, no volumetric light. Octane render, 8K, clear details --ar 3:4 --stylize 450

promptLocalized.zh: 平视视角，直面高饱和度 3D 多层纸雕场景。整体色调为灰蓝色、奶油白和深森林绿，并以琥珀色暖光点缀。所有元素必须为物理纸张分层结构，具有硬切边缘和清晰可见的厚纸横截面。构图极其丰富，以 {argument name="scene theme" default="海盗群像场景"} 为主题，置身于混乱的海上冒险中。多个风格化的海盗角色呈现出夸张的动作，中间层为 {argument name="core character" default="戴草帽的年轻船长"} 正在向前冲锋，周围环绕着姿态各异的船员。分层的船只、汹涌的波浪和漩涡贯穿前景、中景和背景，多艘船只在不同的空间层级中碰撞倾斜，船帆撕裂，旗帜飘扬。背景层中出现巨大的敌方角色剪影，以增强压迫感和空间层次感。前景充满了叙事元素：宝箱、金币、地图、木桶、绳索、灯笼以及一张印有微笑海盗的悬赏令。角落处放置了一个吉祥物般的小角色作为视觉锚点。所有大气元素均以纸雕形式呈现：波浪、水花、烟雾、碎片和运动线条，强化了混乱感和动感。主体位于中间层，元素跨层交互，通过重叠和空间关系表达运动感。来自单一方向的柔光营造出清晰的层间阴影。整体为哑光纸张质感，无发光，无柔边，无体积光。Octane 渲染，8K，细节清晰 --ar 3:4 --stylize 450

titleLocalized.zh: 带有角色参考的极简电影感竖版海报

templates.prompt:
Using the attached character, generate the following:

# Instructions
Create a minimalist theater-style vertical poster for {argument name="user input" default="[user input]"} using monochrome + {argument name="accent color" default="one accent color"}.

# Layout Requirements
- Place the title largely in the bottom 1/4 area, with the Japanese title at maximum size and the English subtitle small directly underneath.
- Place a catchphrase (1-2 lines) in the top center.
- Stack 3-4 awards/official certification badges vertically in the top-left corner.
- Place a vertical catchphrase (2-3 lines) along the right edge.
- Position the main character as a silhouette from behind, slightly left of the center.
- Represent fantastical elements (floating islands, giant creatures) in the background as silhouettes.
- Place staff credits, release date, and distribution info in a small horizontal line at the bottom.
- Highlight the release date in a large font at the bottom right.

# Design Requirements
- Keep the background monochrome (black to gray gradient).
- Use only one accent color (e.g., vivid cobalt blue or gold).
- Combine silhouette and thin line art styles.
- Emphasize the title text with white + the accent color.
- Create a cinematic and artistic atmosphere overall.
- Avoid colorful backgrounds, excessive decoration, or heavy use of gradients.
- Format: Vertical, aspect ratio 2:3, high resolution.

promptLocalized.zh:
使用附带的角色，生成以下内容：

# 指令
为 {argument name="user input" default="[用户输入]"} 创建一张极简主义剧院风格的竖版海报，使用单色 + {argument name="accent color" default="一种强调色"}。

# 布局要求
- 将标题大字置于底部 1/4 区域，日文标题最大化，英文副标题紧随其下，字号较小。
- 在顶部中心放置一句宣传语（1-2 行）。
- 在左上角垂直堆叠 3-4 个奖项/官方认证徽章。
- 沿右侧边缘放置一句竖排宣传语（2-3 行）。
- 将主角以背影剪影形式置于中心偏左位置。
- 在背景中以剪影形式呈现奇幻元素（浮岛、巨型生物）。
- 在底部以小字水平行排列演职员表、上映日期和发行信息。
- 在右下角用大字体突出显示上映日期。

# 设计要求
- 保持背景为单色（黑色至灰色渐变）。
- 仅使用一种强调色（例如：鲜艳的钴蓝色或金色）。
- 结合剪影和细线条艺术风格。
- 标题文字使用白色 + 强调色进行强调。
- 整体营造电影感和艺术氛围。
- 避免使用彩色背景、过多的装饰或大量的渐变效果。
- 格式：竖版，长宽比 2:3，高分辨率。

templates.title: Abstract Chaos Character Art

titleLocalized.zh: 抽象混乱风格角色艺术

templates.prompt:
# Art that reveals a character's face from a chaotic collection of notes and symbols

---

## Style
- Mass of handwritten notes, formulas, symbols, and random lines in black ink on white paper.
- Scribbled chaos scattered across the paper.
- Sporadic emphasis using {argument name="accent color" default="red ink"} (lines, fills, marker-like blobs).
- Texture of analog notebook doodles.

---

## Composition
- Random notes and symbols cover the entire area.
- The density of black ink lines and characters concentrates on the position of the "character's face."
- As a result, the silhouette and expression of the given character's face faintly emerge from the chaos.
- The face is not realistic but formed by a collection of chaotic fragments.

---

## Color Palette
- Mainly monochrome (black and white).
- {argument name="accent color" default="red ink"} placed sporadically as an accent.
- Low saturation, emphasizing the feel of analog paper and ink.

---

## Expressive Elements
- Mixed strings of semi-readable Japanese, English, and numbers.
- Mathematical symbols, arrows, dots, slashes, crosses, and ink drips.
- The outlines of the face, eyes, and hair emerge from the "negative space" and "shading" of the symbol placement.

---

## Prohibitions
- Direct, realistic portraits.
- Digitally processed, orderly geometric patterns.
- Colorful or oversaturated expressions.
- Logos, watermarks, or artificial CG aesthetics.

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- The whole piece works as a "chaotic collection of notes and symbols."
- The provided character's face naturally emerges from the density and arrangement of chaos.
- Colors are monochrome + {argument name="accent color" default="red accent"} only.
- Maintains the hand-drawn texture of paper and ink.

promptLocalized.zh:
# 通过混乱的笔记与符号集合呈现角色面部特征的艺术作品

---

## 风格
- 纸面上布满了黑墨水书写的笔记、公式、符号和随机线条。
- 纸张各处散布着涂鸦般的混乱感。
- 使用 {argument name="accent color" default="红色墨水"}（线条、填充、记号笔般的色块）进行零星点缀。
- 具有模拟笔记本涂鸦的质感。

---

## 构图
- 随机的笔记和符号覆盖整个画面。
- 黑墨水线条和字符的密度集中在“角色面部”的位置。
- 因此，给定角色的面部轮廓和表情会从混乱中隐约浮现。
- 面部并非写实风格，而是由混乱的碎片集合而成。

---

## 色调
- 以单色（黑白）为主。
- {argument name="accent color" default="红色墨水"} 零星点缀作为强调。
- 低饱和度，强调模拟纸张和墨水的质感。

---

## 表现元素
- 混合了半可读的日语、英语和数字字符串。
- 数学符号、箭头、点、斜线、十字和墨水滴。
- 面部、眼睛和头发的轮廓从符号排列的“负空间”和“阴影”中显现出来。

---

## 禁止事项
- 直接的写实肖像。
- 数字处理后的整齐几何图案。
- 多彩或过度饱和的表现形式。
- 徽标、水印或人工 CG 美学。

---

## 完成定义 (DoD)
- 整体作品呈现为“混乱的笔记与符号集合”。
- 所提供的角色面部能从混乱的密度和排列中自然浮现。
- 颜色仅限单色 + {argument name="accent color" default="红色点缀"}。
- 保持纸张和墨水的手绘质感。

templates.title: Retro RPG Item Grid Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 复古 RPG 物品网格提示词

templates.prompt: Create a {argument name="grid size" default="10x10"} grid containing {argument name="item count" default="100"} different fantasy role-playing game (RPG) items in a {argument name="art style" default="classic pixel art style"} (16-bit or 32-bit sprite style, similar to Japanese RPGs from the SNES/GBA era). Each item should occupy a square tile individually with a short, clear label below. The grid should be neatly arranged on a white background. Ensure each item is visually unique and every label is spelled correctly. Use clean pixel edges, a limited palette for each sprite, and subtle dithering for shadows. Use the following row themes: Row 1: Swords and blades; Row 2: Shields and armor; Row 3: Bows, crossbows, and ranged weapons; Row 4: Staves, wands, and magical implements; Row 5: Potions, elixirs, and bottles; Row 6: Scrolls, grimoires, and spellbooks; Row 7: Rings, amulets, and enchanted accessories; Row 8: Helmets, crowns, and headgear; Row 9: Keys, relics, and quest items; Row 10: Gems, runes, and crafting materials. Display each tile as a centered item sprite on a clean background square, presented in the form of classic inventory icons—similar to what you'd see in a fantasy RPG menu. Maintain consistency and coherence in the overall style, reminiscent of beloved retro fantasy RPGs—charming and refined, yet clear even at small sizes.

templates.prompt: A realistic editorial product photo of a glossy magazine lying diagonally on a warm medium-brown wooden table, viewed from above at a slight angle. The magazine dominates the frame and has a deep cobalt-blue cover with a large elegant serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="Convergence"} across the top. On the left side of the cover, a huge stacked white sans-serif headline reads {argument name="cover headline" default="CHATGPT IMAGES 2.0"}. The main cover image is a highly detailed green chameleon in close-up profile facing left, wearing a tan cowboy hat with a brown leather band and metal stud, creating a surreal but polished magazine-cover concept. Add small editorial cover lines in white text beneath and along the bottom, arranged in neat columns like a technology or design magazine, with tiny issue details in the upper right including a price and date. The magazine should look physically printed, with visible page thickness, subtle edge wear, and realistic reflections on the glossy cover. Surrounding environment: soft leafy shadows fall across the tabletop from the upper left, a clear faceted drinking glass is partially visible on the right edge, an orange-red plate peeks in from the top right corner, a pale yellow sticky note in the lower right reads {argument name="sticky note text" default="SOTA"} in handwritten uppercase letters, and a hint of a green houseplant appears in the upper left. Use warm natural afternoon sunlight, cinematic shadows, crisp focus, and photorealistic materials for a premium lifestyle desk scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的编辑生活方式场景，采用略微抬高的四分之三俯视角度拍摄，展示了一本光面杂志斜放在温暖的中棕色木质桌面上。杂志是清晰的视觉焦点，占据了画面的大部分空间。封面背景为深钴蓝色至海军蓝，主体是一只鲜绿色变色龙的大幅特写肖像，它面向左侧，微距细节清晰可见，鳞片纹理分明，眼睛明亮，戴着一顶带有棕色皮带和小银铆钉的棕褐色麂皮牛仔帽。杂志顶部的刊名以优雅的白色大号衬线字体显示为 {argument name="magazine title" default="Convergence"}。在封面左侧，醒目的堆叠式白色无衬线标题显示为 {argument name="headline text" default="CHATGPT IMAGES 2.0"}。包含 7 个较小的封面文本块：标题下方左侧一列有 3 个简短的专题简介，底部边缘有 4 个紧凑的预告简介。在右上角添加细小的真实期刊细节，包括价格、日期和简短的代码行，均采用极小的白色字体。场景应呈现出自然午后阳光下随意摆放的桌面快照感，柔和的叶片窗影投射在木头和杂志的部分区域。在杂志周围，包含 4 个桌面元素：左上角伸入的盆栽植物局部、右上角边缘的橙色盘子或碗局部、右侧边缘被截断的多面玻璃杯，以及右下角一张写有手写文字 {argument name="sticky note text" default="SOTA"} 的淡黄色便签。强调真实的印刷质感、微妙的封面反光、杂志书脊和底部的纸张厚度、温暖的阴影，以及精致的现代产品摄影风格。

templates.title: Vintage Malta Travel Poster

templates.prompt: A vintage travel poster illustration for {argument name="destination" default="Malta"}, designed like a mid-century Mediterranean tourism advertisement with elegant painterly realism and slightly textured printed-poster grain. At the top center, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="MALTA"} in oversized cream serif capitals, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} directly below in smaller dark navy sans-serif capitals. Show a sunlit coastal road curving along a stone waterfront in Valletta, viewed from slightly above and behind a classic white 1960s sedan driving away from the viewer in the lower left foreground; the rear license plate reads {argument name="license plate" default="MTA 1964"}. Across the harbor, depict warm honey-colored limestone buildings climbing the hillside, including 1 large domed church, 1 tall narrow church spire, rows of historic townhouses with several colorful enclosed wooden balconies, and distant city walls stretching across the opposite shoreline. In the bay, include exactly 3 traditional Maltese fishing boats in vivid blue, yellow, red, and green, plus 2 tiny white sailboats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls flying across a brilliant turquoise-blue sky with soft white clouds. Frame the whole composition with dark leafy trees and abundant bright magenta bougainvillea blossoms arching in from the top and right edges, with more flowers in the lower right corner, creating a lush border around the scene. Include a palm tree among the waterfront buildings and a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. Use warm golden sunlight, saturated coastal colors, romantic vacation-poster composition, clean readable typography, and a nostalgic, idealized Mediterranean atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古旅行海报插画，主题为 {argument name="destination" default="马耳他"}，设计风格参考 20 世纪中叶的地中海旅游广告，具有优雅的绘画写实感和轻微的印刷海报颗粒质感。在顶部中央，放置大号标题 {argument name="headline text" default="MALTA"}，使用超大号奶油色衬线大写字母；下方紧邻副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"}，使用较小的深海军蓝无衬线大写字母。画面展示瓦莱塔阳光明媚的沿海公路，沿着石质海滨蜿蜒，视角略高于并位于一辆经典的 1960 年代白色轿车后方，轿车正驶离画面，位于左下角前景；车牌显示为 {argument name="license plate" default="MTA 1964"}。在港口对面，描绘爬满山坡的暖蜂蜜色石灰岩建筑，包括 1 座大型圆顶教堂、1 座高耸狭窄的教堂尖塔、成排的历史联排别墅（带有多个色彩鲜艳的封闭式木制阳台），以及延伸至对岸的远方城墙。在海湾中，包含 3 艘色彩鲜艳（蓝、黄、红、绿）的传统马耳他渔船，以及远处 2 艘微小的白色帆船。在明亮的绿松石色天空中，加入 4 只飞翔的白色海鸥，并点缀柔软的白云。整个构图由深色枝叶茂密的树木和从顶部及右侧边缘拱起的繁茂亮洋红色三角梅框架，右下角也有更多花朵，在场景周围形成郁郁葱葱的边框。在海滨建筑群中加入一棵棕榈树，并在左下角前景处放置一株尖刺状的龙舌兰植物。运用温暖的金色阳光、饱和的海岸色彩、浪漫的度假海报构图、清晰易读的排版，营造出一种怀旧且理想化的地中海氛围。

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic open-world crime video game screenshot in the style of a modern Miami-inspired beach club mission scene, captured in bright midday sunlight with a clear blue sky. Show a third-person gameplay-like composition with {argument name="character description" default="a young adult man with short dark hair, light skin, wearing a plain black t-shirt and patterned swim shorts"} seated casually in the foreground on pale sand, turned slightly to the side as if the player camera stopped near him. Place him large in frame, off-center left, with natural relaxed body posture. Behind him, depict an upscale beachfront club with exactly 3 white cabanas with flowing curtains visible across the sand, multiple tall palm trees, turquoise ocean water on the left, and an art-deco hotel strip on the right with pastel facades and neon accents. Populate the beach with a lively crowd of exactly 12 background people in swimwear: some standing and chatting, some walking near the shoreline, and exactly 2 seated at a dining table on the right with food and drinks. Include white lounge furniture, umbrellas, and a polished social party atmosphere. Add a convincing video game HUD overlay: a square mini-map in the bottom-left labeled {argument name="map label" default="GPS Route"}, weapon and control icons in the bottom-right, and a money counter in the top-right reading {argument name="money amount" default="$45,670"}. The overall feel should resemble a next-gen Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay screenshot, cinematic but clearly in-game, with sharp environmental detail, realistic shadows, vibrant coastal color grading, and subtle satirical luxury-beach energy in {argument name="city setting" default="Vice City"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超逼真的开放世界犯罪类电子游戏截图，风格参考现代迈阿密风格的海滩俱乐部任务场景，画面呈现于明亮的午后阳光下，天空湛蓝。采用类似第三人称游戏视角的构图，前景中坐着 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深色短发、肤色白皙的年轻男子，身穿纯黑色 T 恤和印花泳裤"}，他随意地坐在浅色沙滩上，身体微微侧向一旁，仿佛玩家视角在他身旁停下。将他置于画面左侧偏中心位置，占据较大比例，姿态自然放松。在他身后，描绘一个高档海滩俱乐部，沙滩上清晰可见 3 个带有飘逸窗帘的白色凉亭，种植着多棵高大的棕榈树，左侧是绿松石色的海水，右侧是一排具有装饰艺术风格的酒店，外墙呈柔和色调并带有霓虹装饰。海滩上布满了 12 位身着泳装的背景人群：有人站着聊天，有人在岸边行走，另有 2 人坐在右侧的餐桌旁享用餐饮。画面包含白色休闲家具、遮阳伞，营造出精致的社交派对氛围。添加逼真的游戏 HUD 界面：左下角是一个标有 {argument name="map label" default="GPS 路线"} 的方形小地图，右下角显示武器和控制图标，右上角显示金额为 {argument name="money amount" default="$45,670"} 的金钱计数器。整体观感应类似于次世代《Grand Theft Auto VI》的游戏截图，具有电影感且呈现出明显的游戏内质感，细节丰富、阴影真实、色彩分级充满活力的海岸气息，并带有 {argument name="city setting" default="罪恶都市"} 中那种微妙的奢华海滩讽刺感。

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic open-world crime-game gameplay screenshot inspired by a modern Miami-style beach city, showing {argument name="character description" default="a stylish young man with short dark hair, trimmed beard, aviator sunglasses, and an open navy Hawaiian shirt with large pink-orange flowers"} standing at an outdoor beach club bar and holding a tropical cocktail garnished with fruit. The camera is in a third-person gameplay-cinematic angle from behind the bartender, framing the player character in the center-left foreground as he faces a bartender in a teal polo shirt across a white stone counter. Set the scene at a lively beachfront party during warm late-afternoon sunlight, with 1 bartender, 1 main playable character, and around 12 partygoers dancing and mingling on the sand and deck behind him. Include tall palm trees, the ocean horizon, beach umbrellas, bottles on the bar, and an art-deco club building with glowing neon signage reading {argument name="club name" default="VICE BEACH CLUB"} plus a circular neon palm-tree logo. Add a luxurious, sun-drenched Vice City vibe with long shadows, haze, reflections, and saturated tropical colors. Overlay authentic video game HUD elements: 1 circular mini-map in the bottom-left corner, and 1 circular weapon-selection wheel in the bottom-right corner showing 8 slots with visible icons for handgun, submachine gun, shotgun, rifle, melee, throwable, and empty/inactive slots. The image should look like a polished AAA console gameplay capture, ultra-detailed, realistic skin and fabric, dynamic crowd poses, shallow atmospheric depth, and subtle lens bloom.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的开放世界犯罪游戏截图，灵感源自现代迈阿密风格的海滩城市。画面展示了 {argument name="character description" default="一位时尚的年轻人，留着黑色短发和修剪整齐的胡须，戴着飞行员墨镜，身穿一件印有大朵粉橙色花卉的深蓝色夏威夷衬衫"} 站在户外海滩俱乐部的吧台前，手中拿着一杯装饰着水果的热带鸡尾酒。镜头采用第三人称游戏电影视角，从调酒师身后拍摄，将玩家角色置于左前方的中心位置，他正面对着一位身穿青色 Polo 衫的调酒师，两人之间隔着一个白色石材吧台。场景设定在温暖的午后阳光下，海滩派对热闹非凡，画面中包含 1 名调酒师、1 名主要可玩角色，以及约 12 名在身后沙滩和甲板上跳舞交流的派对参与者。背景包括高大的棕榈树、海平线、沙滩伞、吧台上的酒瓶，以及一栋装饰艺术风格的俱乐部建筑，上面带有发光的霓虹灯招牌，写着 {argument name="club name" default="VICE BEACH CLUB"} 以及一个圆形的霓虹棕榈树标志。营造出一种奢华、阳光明媚的“罪恶都市”氛围，带有长长的阴影、薄雾、反射效果和饱和的热带色彩。叠加真实的电子游戏 HUD 元素：左下角显示 1 个圆形小地图，右下角显示 1 个圆形武器选择轮，包含 8 个插槽，清晰可见手枪、冲锋枪、霰弹枪、步枪、近战武器、投掷物以及空置/未激活插槽的图标。图像应呈现出精致的 AAA 级主机游戏截图质感，细节极其丰富，皮肤和织物纹理真实，人群姿态动态自然，具有浅景深效果和细腻的镜头光晕。

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime action illustration of two young martial-arts women fighting inside a traditional Japanese-style wooden dojo. The left fighter is in the foreground, a black-haired girl with a neat bun tied by a yellow ribbon, wearing a sleeveless yellow Chinese kung fu tunic with black trim, loose black pants, and black cloth shoes. She is in a deep low stance on the wooden floor, one fist pulled back and the other punching forward, surrounded by bright red energy trails that arc around her body and sweep across the scene. Water splashes dramatically around her feet as if her movement skims through a shallow layer of water. The right fighter is airborne in the midground, a pale-skinned girl with light lavender hair in two round buns, wearing a short black-and-white cheongsam-inspired battle dress with gold trim, black sheer tights, and black shoes. She performs a flying side kick while a vivid blue energy spiral curls around her in a circular motion. The collision of force between them has cracked and exploded the wooden floor at center-right, with debris and wood fragments flying outward, while dust and smoke billow across the lower right corner. The dojo interior has exposed timber beams, tatami edging, shoji-style windows, and warm natural light entering from the left. Hang a wooden sign above them with the Chinese text {argument name="sign text" default="币安 vs OKX"}. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, strong foreshortening, cinematic motion blur, intense speed lines, high-detail anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, energetic combat choreography, and a polished poster-like finish. Add exactly 2 visible fighters, 1 overhead wooden sign, 1 cracked floor impact point, 1 red energy effect around the left fighter, and 1 blue energy effect around the right fighter. Optionally place a subtle watermark-like text at the lower right reading {argument name="watermark text" default="UM Image Prompt Gallery"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫动作插画，描绘了两名年轻武术少女在传统的日式木质道场内对战的场景。左侧的格斗者位于前景，是一位黑发少女，扎着整齐的发髻，系着黄色丝带，身穿无袖黄色中国功夫上衣，配黑色滚边、宽松黑裤和黑色布鞋。她正以低姿势蹲在木地板上，一手后拉，另一手向前出拳，身体周围环绕着明亮的红色能量轨迹，并横扫整个画面。水花在她脚下剧烈飞溅，仿佛她的动作掠过了浅浅的水面。右侧的格斗者位于中景的半空中，是一位皮肤白皙的少女，留着淡紫色双丸子头，身穿黑白相间的短款旗袍风格战斗服，配金色滚边、黑色透肉连裤袜和黑色鞋子。她正在施展飞踢，一道鲜艳的蓝色能量螺旋呈圆形环绕着她。两人力量的碰撞使得中右侧的木地板开裂并炸开，碎片和木屑向外飞溅，尘土和烟雾在右下角翻滚。道场内部有裸露的木梁、榻榻米边缘、障子风格的窗户，温暖的自然光从左侧射入。在她们上方悬挂一块木牌，上面写着中文文本 {argument name="sign text" default="币安 vs OKX"}。采用戏剧性的广角构图、强烈的透视缩短、电影级的动态模糊、强烈的速度线、高细节的动漫渲染、光泽高光、干净的线条艺术、充满活力的战斗编排以及精致的海报级质感。添加 2 名可见的格斗者、1 块头顶木牌、1 个开裂的地板撞击点、1 个环绕左侧格斗者的红色能量特效，以及 1 个环绕右侧格斗者的蓝色能量特效。可选择在右下角放置一段微妙的水印式文本，内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="UM Image Prompt Gallery"}。

titleLocalized.zh: 低角度奔跑女性街拍

templates.prompt: A photorealistic candid street photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a young Russian woman"} running toward the camera in a frantic late-for-school moment, holding one hand near her chest and with {argument name="prop" default="a slice of toast in her mouth"}. She wears {argument name="dress style" default="a light beige patterned flowing dress with long sleeves and a cinched waist"} and flat shoes, the skirt billowing with motion. Shot from an extreme low-angle worm's-eye perspective on a rough roadside in a modest urban neighborhood, making her appear tall against a huge uninterrupted {argument name="sky color" default="deep cobalt blue"} sky. Dense intersecting overhead power lines and utility poles crisscross the upper half of the frame, creating strong geometric tension. Use hard noon sunlight with crisp, dark shadows stretching across the dusty pavement. Include exactly 4 background pedestrians, slightly blurred and walking away or across the street, plus a few distant cars and low buildings lining both sides of the road. The composition should feel chaotic, youthful, cinematic, and frozen in motion, with a wide-angle lens, high-fidelity realism, subtle film grain, strong contrast, slightly nostalgic color rendering, and a {argument name="film look" default="Fujifilm Classic Negative"} aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的抓拍街头照片，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的俄罗斯女性"} 正匆忙赶往学校，向镜头方向奔跑，一只手放在胸前，嘴里 {argument name="prop" default="叼着一片吐司"}。她穿着 {argument name="dress style" default="一件浅米色印花长袖收腰飘逸连衣裙"} 和平底鞋，裙摆随动作飘动。采用极低角度的虫眼视角拍摄，背景是简朴城市社区的粗糙路边，使她在巨大的、无遮挡的 {argument name="sky color" default="深钴蓝色"} 天空映衬下显得格外高挑。密集的交叉架空电线和电线杆横跨画面上半部分，营造出强烈的几何张力。使用正午强烈的阳光，在尘土飞扬的地面上投下清晰、深邃的阴影。画面中包含 4 名背景行人，略显模糊，正走远或穿过街道，此外还有几辆远处的汽车和道路两侧的低矮建筑。构图应呈现出混乱、青春、电影感和定格瞬间的视觉效果，采用广角镜头、高保真写实风格、细腻的胶片颗粒感、强烈的对比度、略带怀旧的色彩渲染，以及 {argument name="film look" default="Fujifilm Classic Negative"} 的美学风格。

templates.title: Censored Point-Cloud Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 审查点云肖像

templates.prompt: A minimalist monochrome portrait made entirely from millions of tiny white point-cloud dots on a pitch-black background, showing 1 adult man from the chest up in a formal dark blazer and light collared dress shirt. The subject is centered slightly to the right, facing forward with a subtle three-quarter turn, with neatly combed short hair and one visible ear sharply defined by dense lidar-like particles. Render the figure as raw 3D scan data mixed with topological contour logic: ultra-dense stippling, precise geometric dot placement, faint isoline structure, and clean depth shaping across the hair, jacket lapels, collar, neck, and shoulders. Keep the face intentionally obscured by 1 large vertical rectangular censor block in dark gray to black, perfectly centered over the facial area from forehead to below the nose, creating a stark privacy-mask effect. Use matte texture, crisp edges, sharp focus, high contrast, no glow, no bloom, no neon, no fog, no motion blur, no chromatic aberration, no painterly strokes. Add 1 small four-point sparkle icon in light gray in the bottom-right corner. The overall image should feel mathematical, forensic, and futuristic, like a high-resolution lidar scan portrait in 8k.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义的单色肖像，完全由漆黑背景上数百万个微小的白色点云颗粒组成，展示了 1 位成年男性从胸部以上的半身像，身穿正式的深色西装外套和浅色翻领衬衫。主体略微偏右居中，正面朝向并带有微妙的三分之二侧转，梳理整齐的短发，一只可见的耳朵由致密的激光雷达式粒子清晰勾勒。将人物渲染为原始 3D 扫描数据与拓扑轮廓逻辑的结合：超致密的点画、精确的几何点位、微弱的等高线结构，以及在头发、西装翻领、衣领、颈部和肩部呈现清晰的深度塑形。面部由 1 个位于深灰色至黑色的大型垂直矩形审查块刻意遮挡，该遮挡块完美居中于从前额到鼻下方的面部区域，营造出鲜明的隐私遮罩效果。使用哑光质感、清晰的边缘、锐利对焦、高对比度，无光晕、无泛光、无霓虹、无雾气、无动态模糊、无色差，无绘画笔触。在右下角添加 1 个浅灰色的小型四角星形图标。整体图像应具有数学感、取证感和未来感，如同 8k 分辨率的激光雷达扫描肖像。

templates.prompt: A high-resolution top-down satellite map view of central {argument name="city" default="London"}, focused tightly on the area around {argument name="landmark" default="Big Ben"} and the Palace of Westminster beside the River Thames. Show a realistic aerial orthographic perspective like a modern digital map or satellite layer, with detailed rooftops, streets, trees, shadows, and brownish river water. Place the long Palace of Westminster complex vertically near the center-right, directly along the west bank of the river, with Big Ben at the northeast corner of the palace near the river edge. A bridge labeled {argument name="bridge name" default="Westminster Bridge"} crosses horizontally near the bottom of the frame from left to right over the river. Include 6 visible map labels total: {argument name="label 1" default="Westminster Abbey"}, {argument name="label 2" default="Parliament Square"}, Big Ben, Palace of Westminster, Westminster Bridge, and Horse Guards Parade. Also show Whitehall as a labeled road running vertically on the left side of the palace area. Surrounding details should include Westminster Abbey in the upper left quadrant, Parliament Square above the palace, Horse Guards Parade as a large sandy rectangular ground in the lower left quadrant, dense city blocks and roads on the left half, the River Thames occupying the full right side, embankments on both sides, a few boats on the river, and tree-lined streets and parks. Use natural satellite-image colors, crisp cartographic label overlays, and the look of a zoomed-in online maps screenshot.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张以 {argument name="city" default="伦敦"} 市中心为核心的高分辨率俯视卫星地图，紧密聚焦于 {argument name="landmark" default="大本钟"} 及泰晤士河畔威斯敏斯特宫周边区域。呈现出现代数字地图或卫星图层般的逼真航拍正射视角，包含详细的屋顶、街道、树木、阴影及棕褐色的河水。将长条形的威斯敏斯特宫建筑群垂直放置在画面中右侧，紧邻河流西岸，大本钟位于宫殿东北角靠近河岸的位置。一座标注为 {argument name="bridge name" default="威斯敏斯特桥"} 的桥梁在画面底部从左至右横跨河流。总共包含 6 个可见地图标签：{argument name="label 1" default="威斯敏斯特教堂"}、{argument name="label 2" default="议会广场"}、大本钟、威斯敏斯特宫、威斯敏斯特桥和骑兵卫队阅兵场。同时将白厅作为一条标注道路，垂直显示在宫殿区域左侧。周边细节应包括左上象限的威斯敏斯特教堂、宫殿上方的议会广场、左下象限作为大型沙色长方形场地的骑兵卫队阅兵场、左半部分密集的城市街区与道路、占据整个右侧的泰晤士河、两岸的堤岸、河上的少量船只以及绿树成荫的街道与公园。采用自然的卫星图像色彩、清晰的地图标注叠加层，呈现出放大后的在线地图截图效果。

templates.title: VINCO Editorial Moodboard Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: VINCO 编辑风格项目截图

templates.prompt: Create a 4:5 editorial fashion lookbook moodboard for a fictional brand called {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"}. The image is a dark-interface screenshot-style composition with a large rounded charcoal text panel across the upper half and a 2-by-3 grid of six fashion/editorial images in the lower left quadrant. The overall aesthetic blends Italian archival graphic design with late-1990s Southern California streetwear, mixing natural wine culture, skate utility, and sun-faded documentary fashion photography. Use gritty but precise art direction, midday outdoor light, slightly chaotic but disciplined typography, and real-person casting rather than polished fashion-model energy. In the top text panel, show a long white sans-serif creative-direction paragraph describing the shoot, with multiple lines of copy, like an AI prompt or design brief displayed inside a rounded dark gray bubble on a near-black background. In the image grid, include exactly 6 tiles: tile 1 shows a young man in an oversized faded olive T-shirt and dark pants standing in front of an off-white poster-like backdrop with bold {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} branding, barcode graphics, and small editorial text; tile 2 is a close-up still life of a dark wine bottle with a minimalist white label reading {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}, photographed in warm sunlight with tactile paper texture and shadow; tile 3 shows a person from the back in a washed olive long-sleeve shirt with large subtle chest or back branding, white shorts, and a yellow hanging tag or sticker element near the top right, posed against a pale wall with blue stripe detail and editorial layout text; tile 4 shows a skateboarder crouching or riding away, photographed from behind, wearing a white T-shirt with a large black graphic block on the back and dark shorts, in golden sun on pavement; tile 5 is a printed wine ephemera flat lay with cream paper and a pale chartreuse-green wine label or booklet reading {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}, featuring grape illustration, small black text, and layered paper pieces; tile 6 shows a person facing camera in a white T-shirt with a race-bib style chest print reading 97, wearing a fluorescent yellow-green cap with small brand text, standing outdoors with palm trees and bright sky behind them. Keep the six images slightly imperfect and collage-like, as if pulled from a campaign deck or saved references. Use earthy tones throughout: olive, cream, charcoal, sun-bleached white, asphalt gray, muted brown, and one fluorescent yellow-green accent repeated in small details. Include visible interface framing around the composition: a dark app-like background, the lower image grid aligned left, and a rounded gray “Edit” button near the bottom left, plus a small circular icon near the bottom right, reinforcing that this is a screenshot of a generated moodboard rather than a clean standalone poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 4:5 的编辑时尚画册项目，用于名为 {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"} 的虚构品牌。图像采用深色界面截图风格，上半部分是一个大型圆角炭灰色文本面板，左下象限是一个 2x3 的六图时尚/编辑图像网格。整体美学融合了意大利档案图形设计与 20 世纪 90 年代末南加州街头服饰，混合了自然酒文化、滑板实用主义和阳光褪色的纪实时尚摄影。采用粗犷但精准的艺术指导、正午户外光线、略显混乱但严谨的排版，并使用真实人物选角而非精致的时尚模特。在顶部文本面板中，显示一段长篇白色无衬线创意指导段落，描述拍摄内容，包含多行文案，就像显示在近乎黑色的背景上、圆角深灰色气泡内的 AI 提示词或设计简报。在图像网格中，包含 6 个图块：图块 1 展示了一名身穿超大号褪色橄榄绿 T 恤和深色长裤的年轻人，站在类似海报的灰白色背景前，带有醒目的 {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} 品牌标识、条形码图形和小字编辑文本；图块 2 是一个深色酒瓶的特写静物，带有极简主义白色标签，上面写着 {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}，在温暖的阳光下拍摄，具有真实的纸张质感和阴影；图块 3 展示了一个背对镜头的人，穿着水洗橄榄绿长袖衬衫，胸部或背部有醒目但低调的品牌标识，搭配白色短裤，右上角有黄色吊牌或贴纸元素，背景是带有蓝色条纹细节的浅色墙壁和编辑排版文本；图块 4 展示了一名滑板手蹲着或滑走，从背后拍摄，穿着背面有大块黑色图形的白色 T 恤和深色短裤，在金色阳光下的路面上；图块 5 是印刷的葡萄酒周边平铺图，使用奶油色纸张和浅黄绿色酒标或小册子，上面写着 {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}，带有葡萄插图、小字黑体文本和分层纸张碎片；图块 6 展示了一个面向镜头的人，穿着白色 T 恤，胸前印有类似比赛号码牌的“97”字样，戴着荧光黄绿色帽子，上面有小字品牌文本，背景是户外棕榈树和明亮的天空。保持这六张图像略显不完美且具有拼贴感，就像从活动方案或保存的参考资料中提取的一样。通篇使用大地色调：橄榄绿、奶油色、炭灰色、阳光漂白后的白色、沥青灰、柔和的棕色，并在细节处重复使用一种荧光黄绿色作为点缀。在构图周围包含可见的界面框架：深色应用背景、左对齐的下方图像网格，以及左下角的一个圆角灰色“编辑”按钮，右下角还有一个小圆形图标，以强调这是一张生成的项目截图，而非干净的独立海报。

templates.title: Historical Invention Timeline Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 历史发明时间轴网格

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create a square infographic-style illustration showing a {argument name="grid size" default="15×15"} invention timeline grid rendered as a collection of miniature isometric dioramas on aged parchment tiles. The image should look like a curated historical poster that spans from {argument name="starting year" default="1000 BC"} to {argument name="ending year" default="2026"}, with one invention per tile and no repeats. Show the visible portion as a 5 by 5 section of the larger grid, for a total of 25 labeled tiles, arranged in neat rows and columns with thin dark borders. Every tile contains a unique world-changing invention depicted as a small handcrafted diorama with era-appropriate materials, colors, and background details. Use a warm antiquarian palette for ancient and medieval inventions, sepia technical-document tones for early modern inventions, and cooler neon-blue futuristic lighting for modern digital and biotech inventions. Surround the grid with an old-map border and subtle historical cartography textures, blending into faint modern network graphics near the bottom right.

Label each visible tile with a small beige caption tag in bold black text. Include exactly these 25 visible inventions in reading order from top left to bottom right: 1) {argument name="first tile label" default="1000 BC"} tile showing an iron plow and simple hand tools in a farm field, captioned "Iron Plow & Tools"; 2) "Concept of Zero" shown as a parchment-like tile with a carved zero symbol and a blue hourglass; 3) "Water Clock" shown as a wooden water-timing device; 4) "Catapult" shown as a wooden siege engine; 5) "Antikythera Mechanism" shown as an intricate bronze gear device in a stone niche; 6) "Concrete" shown as a wheelbarrow filled with wet cement or mortar; 7) "Wheelbarrow" shown as a simple wooden one-wheel cart; 8) "Windmill" shown as a traditional mill on grassy ground; 9) "Gunpowder" shown as a barrel and a mound of black powder with smoke; 10) "Printing Press" shown as a wooden press framed by classical columns; 11) "Mechanical Clock" shown as an ornate standing clock; 12) "Telescope" shown as an early brass telescope on a tripod with sketch-like scientific notes; 13) "Steam Engine" shown on a blue blueprint-style tile with an early locomotive engine; 14) "Electric Battery" shown on a blueprint-like tile with two cylindrical battery cells and wiring; 15) "Telegraph" shown as a Morse telegraph key on technical paper; 16) "Light Bulb" shown glowing warmly on a neutral pedestal; 17) "Automobile" shown as an early red motorcar on a workshop-plan background; 18) "Airplane" shown as a commercial jet aircraft in miniature; 19) "Transistor" shown as a black microchip on a luminous circuit-board tile; 20) "Personal Computer" shown as a beige desktop computer with CRT monitor and keyboard; 21) "World Wide Web" shown as a glowing blue globe over digital circuitry; 22) "Smartphone" shown as a sleek modern phone on a neon-tech background; 23) "CRISPR-Cas9" shown as a DNA double helix in a biotech-blue display tile; 24) "Reusable Rocket" shown as several upright rockets launching with exhaust clouds; 25) "AI (LLMs)" shown as glowing large letters AI in a holographic tech cube; 26) "Brain-Computer Interface" shown as a glowing brain hologram on a blue platform; 27) "Advanced Neural Interface (Implant)" shown as a transparent human head profile with a glowing brain implant, with a small top label reading "2026".

Keep the composition highly organized, poster-like, and visually dense, with each tile readable at a glance. Use slight isometric perspective, crisp linework, painterly shading, and polished editorial illustration quality. The overall feeling should combine museum poster, educational timeline, and imaginative historical-tech diorama art.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个方形信息图风格的插图，展示一个 {argument name="grid size" default="15×15"} 的发明时间轴网格，渲染为陈旧羊皮纸砖块上的微型等轴测立体模型集合。图像应看起来像一张精心策划的历史海报，跨度从 {argument name="starting year" default="公元前 1000 年"} 到 {argument name="ending year" default="2026 年"}，每个砖块展示一项发明，且不重复。显示较大网格中 5 乘 5 的可见部分，总共 25 个带有标签的砖块，排列整齐，行与列之间有细深色边框。每个砖块都包含一项改变世界的独特发明，描绘成带有时代特征的材料、颜色和背景细节的小型手工立体模型。古代和中世纪发明使用温暖的古董色调，早期现代发明使用棕褐色技术文档色调，现代数字和生物技术发明使用冷色调的霓虹蓝灯光。网格周围环绕着旧地图边框和微妙的历史制图纹理，右下角逐渐融入淡淡的现代网络图形。

用醒目的黑色粗体文字为每个可见砖块贴上米色小标签。按从左上到右下的阅读顺序，包含以下 25 项可见发明：1) {argument name="first tile label" default="公元前 1000 年"} 砖块，展示农田里的铁犁和简易手工工具，标签为“铁犁与工具”；2) “零的概念”，展示为带有雕刻零符号和蓝色沙漏的羊皮纸风格砖块；3) “水钟”，展示为木制计时装置；4) “投石机”，展示为木制攻城器械；5) “安提基特拉机械”，展示为石龛中复杂的青铜齿轮装置；6) “混凝土”，展示为装满湿水泥或砂浆的手推车；7) “独轮车”，展示为简单的木制单轮车；8) “风车”，展示为草地上的传统磨坊；9) “火药”，展示为木桶和一堆带有烟雾的黑色粉末；10) “印刷机”，展示为古典圆柱框架下的木制印刷机；11) “机械钟”，展示为华丽的立式钟；12) “望远镜”，展示为三脚架上的早期黄铜望远镜，配有素描风格的科学笔记；13) “蒸汽机”，展示在蓝色蓝图风格的砖块上，带有早期火车头引擎；14) “电池”，展示在蓝图风格的砖块上，带有两个圆柱形电池单元和线路；15) “电报”，展示为技术纸张上的莫尔斯电报键；16) “灯泡”，展示在中性底座上发出温暖的光；17) “汽车”，展示为车间规划背景下的早期红色汽车；18) “飞机”，展示为微型商用喷气式飞机；19) “晶体管”，展示为发光项目砖块上的黑色微芯片；20) “个人电脑”，展示为带有 CRT 显示器和键盘的米色台式电脑；21) “万维网”，展示为数字电路之上发光的蓝色地球仪；22) “智能手机”，展示为霓虹科技背景下时尚的现代手机；23) “CRISPR-Cas9”，展示为生物科技蓝色显示砖块中的 DNA 双螺旋结构；24) “可重复使用火箭”，展示为几枚竖立发射并带有尾气的火箭；25) “AI (LLMs)”，展示为全息科技立方体中发光的巨大字母 AI；26) “脑机接口”，展示为蓝色平台上的发光大脑全息图；27) “高级神经接口 (植入物)”，展示为带有发光大脑植入物的透明人头侧影，顶部带有小标签“2026 年”。

保持构图高度组织化、海报感强且视觉密集，每个砖块一目了然。使用轻微的等轴测透视、清晰的线条、绘画般的阴影和精致的编辑插图质量。整体感觉应结合博物馆海报、教育时间轴和富有想象力的历史科技立体模型艺术。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫奇幻插画设定图，采用 2x2 网格布局，展示了同一位优雅女剑士的 4 个画面。角色为一位年轻女性，拥有一头极长的铂金白发，扎成高马尾并系有深海军蓝色的巨大蝴蝶结，发丝柔软卷曲且飘逸，皮肤白皙，五官精致细腻，双眸呈现明亮的红粉色。她身着华丽的白蓝配色哥特贵族裙装：带有蕾丝花边和金色刺绣的白色高领荷叶边衬衫，胸前饰有镶嵌红色宝石胸针的巨大海军蓝蝴蝶结，泡泡袖配有丝带袖口，深海军蓝色束腰紧身胸衣带有金色细节，蓬松的海军蓝色裙摆装饰着金色花纹、层叠的荷叶边，并带有缎面光泽。她携带一把带有深色剑柄和金色装饰的武士刀。第 1 格为胸部以上的特写肖像，身体微侧，在深色闪烁的夜空背景下，头发呈现出戏剧性的轮廓光。第 2 格为动态的上半身动作镜头，角色正横向拔剑或展示剑身，头发随风狂舞，背景为电影感的城市夜景虚化效果，周围环绕着发光的花瓣。第 3 格为全身时尚肖像，她优雅地站在高耸发光建筑环绕的明亮反光大厅中，展示了裙装的完整轮廓、带蝴蝶结的高跟鞋以及身侧的佩剑。第 4 格为日落或黎明时分在波光粼粼的海边拍摄的四分之三背影，角色回眸，背景是温暖的柔和色调天空和闪烁的水面，樱花花瓣随风飘落。采用超精细动漫渲染，轻小说封面级画质，细腻的织物纹理，光泽高光，金色装饰，柔和光晕，戏剧性背光，漂浮花瓣，闪烁粒子，优雅浪漫的氛围，以及海军蓝、白、金、淡粉色的和谐配色。

templates.title: Golden Hour Café Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻咖啡馆人像

templates.prompt: A warm, candid editorial-style street café portrait of a relaxed young woman sitting alone at a small round outdoor table on a narrow European cobblestone street in late afternoon sunlight. She wears an oversized cream knit V-neck sweater and loose light blue jeans, with dark brown hair loosely tied in a messy bun with soft flyaway strands. She is seated casually with one knee drawn up, holding a small white espresso cup in one hand while the other rests near a saucer on the table. On the table are exactly 6 visible items: 1 terracotta potted green plant at the left edge, 1 glass sugar dispenser with a metal lid in the foreground, 1 black smartphone, 1 open paperback book, 1 white saucer with a small spoon, and 1 white espresso cup with a subtle red emblem. The café is beside a storefront window on the left, with a row of outdoor chairs and tables receding into the background on the right, soft pedestrians and buildings out of focus in the distance. Golden-hour backlighting, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, cinematic bokeh, intimate lifestyle photography, realistic textures, soft shadows, vertical composition, medium shot framed from table level, highly photorealistic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温暖、抓拍风格的街头咖啡馆编辑人像，一位放松的年轻女性独自坐在欧洲狭窄鹅卵石街道旁的小圆桌前，沐浴在午后的阳光下。她穿着一件超大款奶油色针织 V 领毛衣和宽松的浅蓝色牛仔裤，深棕色头发随意扎成一个凌乱的丸子头，有几缕发丝垂落。她姿态随意地坐着，一只膝盖抬起，一只手拿着白色小浓缩咖啡杯，另一只手放在桌上的碟子旁。桌上清晰可见 6 件物品：左边缘有 1 盆赤陶盆栽绿植，前景有 1 个带金属盖的玻璃糖罐，1 部黑色智能手机，1 本翻开的平装书，1 个放有小勺的白色碟子，以及 1 个带有精致红色标志的白色浓缩咖啡杯。咖啡馆左侧是店面橱窗，右侧是一排向背景延伸的户外桌椅，远处的行人和建筑虚化处理。黄金时刻逆光，浅景深，自然的肤色，电影级焦外成像，亲密的生活方式摄影，逼真的质感，柔和的阴影，竖构图，从桌面高度拍摄的中景，高度写实。

templates.title: Vintage Confidential Case File

titleLocalized.zh: 复古机密案件档案

templates.prompt: A top-down cinematic still life of a vintage classified investigation dossier on a dark wooden desk, centered and filling most of the frame. Show a stack of 3 worn manila folders with aged beige paper, frayed corners, subtle stains, and realistic paper texture. The top folder is the main focus and is clipped at the upper left with 1 oversized silver paper clip. Across the top center, typewritten in bold black monospaced letters, the headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="CONFIDENTIAL – CASE FILES"}, with a thin horizontal rule beneath it. Add 2 red rubber-stamp marks: one near the top right that says "CONFIDENTIAL" at a slight angle, and one boxed stamp at the bottom right that says "HANDLING INSTRUCTIONS DO NOT COPY – DO NOT DISTRIBUTE". On the right edge of the folder stack, show 1 tabbed side label reading "CASE FILE NO." with a thick black redaction bar below it. The page is formatted like an old typewritten government document with crisp black ink, slightly uneven typewriter alignment, and many thick black redaction bars obscuring key details. Include 5 numbered sections exactly: "1. SUBJECT INFORMATION", "2. CASE SUMMARY", "3. DETAILS", "4. ASSOCIATES / CONTACTS", and "5. REMARKS". In the header area, include the fields "CASE FILE NO.:" with a black redaction bar, "DATE OPENED:" with {argument name="date opened" default="March 14, 20___"}, "PREPARED BY:" with a black redaction bar, "DEPARTMENT:" with {argument name="department" default="Internal Investigations Unit"}, and "CLASSIFICATION:" with {argument name="classification" default="CONFIDENTIAL"}. In section 1, include 6 fields: "NAME:", "ALIASES:", "DATE OF BIRTH:", "PLACE OF BIRTH:", "LAST KNOWN ADDRESS:", and "OCCUPATION:", each followed by black redaction bars of varying lengths. In section 2, add a short paragraph of typewritten case-summary text with 5 separate black redaction bars embedded in the sentence flow. In section 3, add a second paragraph of details text with 4 separate black redaction bars embedded in the paragraph. In section 4, include a 3-column table labeled "NAME", "RELATIONSHIP", and "NOTES", with 3 filled rows, each cell content covered by black redaction bars. In section 5, add a short warning sentence about sensitive information and unauthorized disclosure. Use warm sepia lighting, soft shadows around the folder edges, subtle vignetting, and a moody noir archival atmosphere. The image should feel realistic, tactile, secretive, and slightly dusty, like a confidential detective case file photographed for a crime thriller or worldbuilding prop.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张俯视视角的电影级静物照，展示了深色木桌上一份复古的机密调查档案，画面居中并占据大部分空间。展示一叠 3 个磨损的马尼拉文件夹，带有陈旧的米色纸张、磨损的边缘、细微的污渍和逼真的纸张纹理。最上方的文件夹是视觉焦点，左上角用 1 个超大号银色回形针固定。顶部中央用粗体黑色等宽字体打字显示标题 {argument name="headline text" default="CONFIDENTIAL – CASE FILES"}，下方有一条细水平线。添加 2 个红色橡胶印章标记：一个在右上角附近，略微倾斜地印着 "CONFIDENTIAL"；另一个在右下角的方框印章，印着 "HANDLING INSTRUCTIONS DO NOT COPY – DO NOT DISTRIBUTE"。在文件夹堆叠的右侧边缘，显示 1 个带标签的侧边栏，上面写着 "CASE FILE NO."，下方有一条粗黑色的涂改遮盖条。页面格式仿照旧式打字机打印的政府文件，带有清晰的黑色墨迹、略显不齐的打字机对齐方式，以及许多遮盖关键细节的粗黑色涂改条。准确包含 5 个编号部分："1. SUBJECT INFORMATION"、"2. CASE SUMMARY"、"3. DETAILS"、"4. ASSOCIATES / CONTACTS" 和 "5. REMARKS"。在页眉区域，包含以下字段："CASE FILE NO.:"（带黑色涂改条）、"DATE OPENED:"（后接 {argument name="date opened" default="March 14, 20___"}）、"PREPARED BY:"（带黑色涂改条）、"DEPARTMENT:"（后接 {argument name="department" default="Internal Investigations Unit"}）以及 "CLASSIFICATION:"（后接 {argument name="classification" default="CONFIDENTIAL"}）。在第 1 部分中，包含 6 个字段："NAME:"、"ALIASES:"、"DATE OF BIRTH:"、"PLACE OF BIRTH:"、"LAST KNOWN ADDRESS:" 和 "OCCUPATION:"，每个字段后均跟随长度不一的黑色涂改条。在第 2 部分中，添加一段简短的打字机风格案件摘要文本，并在句子流中嵌入 5 个独立的黑色涂改条。在第 3 部分中，添加第二段详细文本，并在段落中嵌入 4 个独立的黑色涂改条。在第 4 部分中，包含一个 3 列的表格，标签分别为 "NAME"、"RELATIONSHIP" 和 "NOTES"，共 3 行填充内容，每个单元格的内容均被黑色涂改条覆盖。在第 5 部分中，添加一句关于敏感信息和未经授权披露的简短警告。使用温暖的深褐色光线，文件夹边缘周围有柔和的阴影，带有细微的晕影，营造出一种忧郁的黑色电影档案氛围。图像应具有逼真、触感真实、神秘且略带灰尘的感觉，就像为犯罪惊悚片或世界观构建道具拍摄的机密侦探档案。

Above, render a bright blue sky with large creamy white clouds, halftone-dot shading throughout the sky and mountains, subtle vintage comic print texture, visible dithering, and crisp sharp pixel edges. The whole image should feel colorful, nostalgic, scenic, and richly layered, with heavy halftone comic shading, retro print grain, no text, no UI, no characters, and no buildings.

templates.title: Photoreal Alien in Dark Ravine

titleLocalized.zh: 深谷中的写实外星人

templates.prompt: A full-body cinematic portrait of a deeply unsettling humanoid alien standing alone in a dark rocky ravine, centered in the frame and facing forward in a neutral upright pose with both arms hanging low at its sides. The creature is extremely tall and emaciated, with elongated limbs, narrow shoulders, a sunken torso, visible rib-like structures, taut sinewy anatomy, long forearms, oversized hands with long thin fingers, and long digitigrade-looking feet planted on wet black ground. Its skin is hairless, slick, pale gray-beige with brownish fleshy undertones, semi-organic and biomechanical in appearance, with glossy damp highlights, leathery textures, stretched membranes, tendons, grooves, and subtle vein-like striations. The neck and upper chest are fused into a disturbing organic structure, with tendril-like folds and open channels running from the clavicle area upward into the head. The head is broad and mushroom- or hammer-shaped with a ridged crown and flared side lobes, giving a nonhuman silhouette; the face should feel unreadable and alien rather than cute or familiar. Place the figure in a narrow canyon of dark eroded stone, with 2 large foreground rock masses framing the subject on the left and right, and a misty cliff wall receding behind it. Use cold desaturated lighting, soft fog, damp surfaces, shallow atmospheric haze, and a grim monochrome palette of charcoal, slate, ash gray, and muted flesh tones. The mood should be uncanny, realistic, oppressive, and biologically plausible, like a high-end sci-fi horror still. Ultra-detailed photorealism, sharp texture on the creature, subtle depth of field, dramatic natural backlight from above, no clothing, no tools, no background creatures, no gore, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的全身肖像，描绘了一个令人极度不安的人形外星人，它独自站在黑暗的岩石峡谷中。主体居中，正面朝向镜头，姿态中立挺拔，双臂自然下垂。该生物身材极高且消瘦，四肢修长，肩膀窄小，躯干凹陷，肋骨结构清晰可见，肌肉线条紧绷，前臂长，手掌巨大且手指细长，长长的趾行式足部稳稳地踩在潮湿的黑色地面上。其皮肤无毛，光滑，呈灰米色并带有棕色肉质底色，外观呈现半有机与生物机械的质感，带有湿润的光泽、皮革般的纹理、拉伸的薄膜、肌腱、沟壑以及细微的血管状条纹。颈部和上胸部融合为一种令人不安的有机结构，带有触手状的褶皱和从锁骨区域向上延伸至头部的开放通道。头部宽大，呈蘑菇状或锤状，带有脊状冠和向外张开的侧叶，呈现出非人类的轮廓；面部应显得难以捉摸且充满异域感，而非可爱或熟悉。将主体置于黑暗侵蚀岩石构成的狭窄峡谷中，前景左右两侧各有一块巨大的岩石作为框架，背景是若隐若现的雾气悬崖。使用冷色调的去饱和光线、柔和的雾气、潮湿的表面、浅景深的大气霾，以及由炭色、板岩色、灰烬色和柔和肉色组成的阴郁单色调。整体氛围应营造出怪诞、写实、压抑且符合生物逻辑的感觉，如同高端科幻恐怖电影剧照。超精细写实风格，生物纹理清晰，微妙的景深效果，来自上方的戏剧性自然背光，无衣物，无工具，无背景生物，无血腥，无文字。

templates.title: Luxury Indoor Mirror Selfie Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华室内镜面自拍人像

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor mirror selfie of a slender glamorous young woman standing in a softly lit upscale living room or hotel suite, photographed vertically from head to below the knees. She wears a form-fitting cream or ivory bodycon midi dress with elegant draping and ruching, featuring an asymmetrical neckline with 1 shoulder strap crossing diagonally over the chest and leaving the other shoulder bare. Her hair is long, dark brown, softly wavy, and parted near the center, falling over both shoulders. She holds a smartphone in her right hand in front of her face, partially covering it, with the phone angled toward a wall mirror; the phone has a dark case with a red cloud pattern. Her left arm hangs naturally by her side. Add subtle jewelry: 1 thin necklace with a small pendant, 1 silver bracelet or bangle on the right wrist, and rings on the fingers of the hand holding the phone. Emphasize a realistic feminine silhouette, smooth skin, soft warm ambient lighting, and polished editorial social-media style photography. The background should include 1 beige sofa behind her, 1 brown leather handbag resting on the right side of the sofa, 1 textured stone or concrete accent wall behind the mirror area, and a warm hallway on the left with 2 framed wall artworks visible. Use natural indoor shadows, refined skin texture, realistic fabric folds and compression around the waist and hips, luxury apartment aesthetic, clean composition, and high detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的室内镜面自拍，拍摄对象为一位身材苗条、充满魅力的年轻女性。她站在光线柔和的高档客厅或酒店套房内，采用从头部到膝盖以下的竖构图拍摄。她身穿一件修身的奶油色或象牙白紧身中长裙，裙身带有优雅的褶皱和抽褶设计，不对称领口设有一条斜跨胸前的单肩带，露出另一侧肩膀。她留着一头深棕色长发，发丝微卷，中分偏分，自然垂落在双肩。她右手持智能手机置于脸部前方，部分遮挡面部，手机朝向墙上的镜子；手机配有带有红色云朵图案的深色手机壳。左臂自然垂在身侧。添加精致的首饰：1 条带有小吊坠的细项链，右手腕佩戴 1 只银色手镯或手环，持手机的手指上佩戴戒指。强调逼真的女性轮廓、细腻的皮肤、柔和的暖色环境光，以及精致的编辑级社交媒体摄影风格。背景应包括她身后 1 张米色沙发，沙发右侧放着 1 只棕色皮质手提包，镜子区域后方为 1 面质感石材或混凝土装饰墙，左侧为温暖的走廊，可见 2 幅挂墙艺术品。运用自然的室内阴影、细腻的皮肤纹理、逼真的面料褶皱以及腰部和臀部的紧致感，营造奢华公寓美学，构图简洁，细节丰富。
