templates.title: Uncanny Full-Body Alien Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 诡异的全身体外星人肖像

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic full-body studio portrait of a disturbing humanoid alien standing alone against a dark, smoky blue-black backdrop. The creature is extremely tall and emaciated, with elongated limbs, a narrow waist, long thin fingers, and oversized bare feet planted on a dim studio floor. Its skin is smooth but leathery and subtly wrinkled, colored deep charcoal blue with cold gray highlights, showing sharply defined ribs, sternum, collarbones, tendons, and stringy musculature across the chest, abdomen, shoulders, and neck. The torso is hairless and gaunt, with an eerie anatomical realism that feels biologically plausible but unsettling. The head is bald, enlarged, and slightly bulbous with a classic extraterrestrial silhouette, attached to an unnaturally long neck; keep the face obscure, unreadable, and deeply uncanny rather than expressive. Pose the alien front-facing with a slight three-quarter angle, arms hanging loosely at its sides, posture upright but subtly predatory, centered in frame from head to feet. Use low-key cinematic lighting with a faint cool rim light and soft overhead illumination that sculpts every crease and contour while keeping the overall scene dark, moody, and oppressive. Desaturated palette, ultra-detailed skin texture, photoreal creature design, sharp focus, high contrast, ominous atmosphere, no clothing, no props, no environment details beyond the shadowy studio background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的全身体外星人摄影棚肖像，画面中一个令人不安的人形外星人独自站在昏暗、烟雾缭绕的蓝黑色背景前。该生物身材极高且消瘦，四肢修长，腰部狭窄，手指细长，巨大的赤脚踩在昏暗的摄影棚地面上。其皮肤光滑但呈皮革质感，带有细微褶皱，呈现深炭蓝色并伴有冷灰色高光，清晰地勾勒出肋骨、胸骨、锁骨、肌腱以及胸部、腹部、肩部和颈部紧绷的肌肉线条。躯干无毛且干瘪，具有一种生物学上看似合理却令人不安的诡异解剖真实感。头部光秃、肥大，呈略微球状，具有经典的外星人轮廓，连接着异常修长的脖子；面部保持模糊、不可读且极度诡异，而非具有表情。外星人呈正面站立，略带四分之三侧角，双臂自然垂在身体两侧，姿态挺拔但带有微妙的掠食感，全身居中于画面。采用低调的电影级布光，辅以微弱的冷色轮廓光和柔和的顶部照明，雕刻出每一处褶皱和轮廓，同时保持整体场景的阴暗、压抑和沉重感。低饱和度色调，超精细皮肤纹理，写实生物设计，焦点清晰，高对比度，氛围阴森，无衣物，无道具，除阴影笼罩的摄影棚背景外无其他环境细节。

templates.title: Haunting Statue Woman at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分令人难忘的雕像女子

templates.prompt: A cinematic dark fantasy photograph of a weathered marble-like woman seen from behind in a ruined garden at sunset, framed from mid-back upward. Her face is turned partly over her shoulder but remains mostly hidden in shadow. She has an antique Greco-Roman appearance with pale stone-textured skin, hair pinned into a loose classical updo, and a draped one-shoulder gown in aged ivory fabric that looks cracked, dusty, and partially fused to her body like an eroded sculpture. Across her exposed back and arm are delicate botanical tattoo-like markings and a faded blue floral mosaic embedded into the shoulder blade area. The atmosphere is moody, haunting, and elegant. Place 2 tall stone columns in deep shadow on the left background, dense dark trees and foliage on both sides, and clusters of small pale flowers in the lower garden. Use a glowing amber-orange sunset sky behind her as a strong backlight, with soft rim light on her shoulders and hair, very deep shadows in the foreground, shallow depth of field, rich contrast, muted earth tones, and ultra-detailed textures of cracked plaster, aged fabric, and stone. Fine-art editorial photography, hyperreal, mysterious, melancholic, 85mm lens look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级黑暗奇幻摄影作品，描绘了日落时分废墟花园中一位背对镜头的风化大理石质感女性，构图为中背部以上。她的脸部微微转向肩后，但大部分隐藏在阴影中。她呈现出古希腊罗马风格，拥有苍白的石质皮肤、盘起的古典发髻，以及一件做旧象牙色单肩长袍，长袍看起来布满裂纹、灰尘，并像受侵蚀的雕塑一样部分与身体融合。她裸露的背部和手臂上有着精致的植物纹身状标记，肩胛骨区域嵌入了褪色的蓝色花卉马赛克。整体氛围忧郁、令人难忘且优雅。背景左侧放置两根深影中的高大石柱，两侧是茂密的深色树木和植被，花园下方点缀着成簇的小型淡色花朵。使用发光的琥珀橙色落日余晖作为强烈的背光，勾勒出她肩部和头发的柔和轮廓光，前景阴影深邃，浅景深，对比度丰富，大地色调柔和，并呈现出裂纹石膏、陈旧织物和石材的超精细纹理。艺术编辑摄影风格，超写实，神秘，忧郁，85mm 镜头质感。

templates.title: Golden Bay City Romantic Landscape

templates.prompt: A grand romantic landscape painting of {argument name="city skyline" default="San Francisco"} seen across a wide bay from an elevated hillside overlook. In the foreground, an old rocky path with 5 large stone ruins or broken masonry blocks sits among dark shrubs and windswept trees, painted in soft earthy browns and deep greens. The middle ground shows calm reflective water with 3 small sailboats scattered across the bay. On the left spans a long suspension bridge with 4 visible towers stretching toward the city. In the distance, a luminous modern skyline rises along the waterfront, including a tall tapered central skyscraper and a pointed pyramid-shaped tower. Above, dramatic swirling clouds open around a radiant low sun, casting warm golden light through the sky and across the water. Render it as a vast cinematic matte painting blended with 19th-century oil landscape aesthetics, atmospheric perspective, glowing haze, soft brushwork, monumental scale, serene mood, and detailed cloud drama.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅宏大且浪漫的风景画，描绘了从高处山坡俯瞰宽阔海湾的 {argument name="city skyline" default="旧金山"} 城市天际线。前景中，一条古老的岩石小径上散落着 5 块巨大的石制废墟或破碎的砖石块，周围点缀着深色的灌木和被风吹拂的树木，色调为柔和的土褐色与深绿色。中景呈现出平静且具有倒影的水面，海湾上散布着 3 艘小帆船。左侧是一座横跨海湾的长悬索桥，4 座桥塔清晰可见，向城市方向延伸。远处，明亮的现代天际线沿水岸升起，包括一座高耸的中央锥形摩天大楼和一座尖顶金字塔形塔楼。上方，戏剧性的漩涡云层在灿烂的低垂太阳周围散开，将温暖的金色光芒洒向天空和水面。画面呈现为宏大的电影级遮罩绘画，融合了 19 世纪油画风景美学、大气透视、发光的雾气、柔和的笔触、纪念碑式的规模、宁静的意境以及细腻的云层动态。

The overall composition is editorial, minimal, and premium, designed like a social media showcase of mobile web designs. The middle panel sits on a lavender-to-deep-violet gradient background and shows a second black-framed phone with a more typographic landing page. Above it, serif text reads {argument name="middle headline" default="Claude Code"}. The screen includes a cropped portrait image at top, a very large bold black stacked title reading “LIP PULSE.” with a pink italic script-style line “is here.” beneath it, a rounded dark button, a dark section with the phrase “Lips in their fullest expression.”, and a product grid near the bottom containing 6 shade cards arranged in 2 rows of 3. The right panel sits on a dark navy textured background and shows a third black-framed phone with a pink-forward e-commerce style page. Keep the layout symmetrical with exactly 3 phones, one per panel, each fully visible and vertically oriented. Use high-end cosmetic campaign aesthetics, clean spacing, fashion-web typography mixing serif and bold sans serif, soft pink and cream UI palettes, subtle shadows, and a sleek product-design presentation suitable for showcasing AI-generated mobile website concepts.

promptLocalized.zh: 一套精致的宣传样机，以垂直三联画布局并排展示了 3 个修长的智能手机屏幕，每个屏幕都呈现了一个现代美妆品牌的唇部产品落地页。整体构图具有编辑感、极简且高级，专为社交媒体上的移动端网页设计展示而设计。左侧面板位于柔和的淡紫色到腮红色的渐变背景上，展示了一款黑色边框手机，屏幕上是 {argument name="brand name" default="Kosas"} 的奶油色调腮红美妆网站。在该面板顶部，优雅的小号衬线字体写着 {argument name="left headline" default="Fresh Pout."}。手机屏幕顶部展示了一张裁剪过的美妆特写图片，醒目的大标题写着“Lips in their fullest expression.”（其中“fullest”采用斜体衬线样式），配有一个圆角深色行动号召按钮、一排 3 个唇部特写缩略图、3 个标注为“Plumps”（丰盈）、“Tingles”（清凉）、“Shines”（光泽）的功效标签，以及下方一排 5 个色号或效果图标。中间面板位于淡紫色到深紫色的渐变背景上，展示了第二款黑色边框手机，其落地页更具排版设计感。上方衬线字体写着 {argument name="middle headline" default="Claude Code"}。屏幕顶部包含一张裁剪过的人像图片，一个非常醒目的黑色堆叠大标题“LIP PULSE.”，下方配有一行粉色斜体手写风格文字“is here.”，一个圆角深色按钮，一个包含短语“Lips in their fullest expression.”的深色区域，以及底部附近包含 6 张色号卡片（排列为 2 行 3 列）的产品网格。右侧面板位于深海军蓝纹理背景上，展示了第三款黑色边框手机，其页面采用粉色调的电商风格。上方居中处，等宽白色字体写着 {argument name="right headline" default="GPT Images 2.0"}。该屏幕显著展示了产品首屏区域，包含品牌名称“Kosas”、大标题“The Lip Pulse”、一个向右倾斜的粉色唇彩管、小型功能图标、中间附近的一排 6 个唇部试色，以及下方包含更多粉色产品图像的促销板块。保持布局对称，恰好 3 部手机，每面板一部，均完全可见且垂直放置。采用高端化妆品广告美学、整洁的间距、混合衬线与粗体无衬线字体的时尚网页排版、柔和的粉色与奶油色 UI 配色、微妙的阴影，以及适合展示 AI 生成的移动端网站概念的时尚产品设计呈现。

The man on the left is much closer to the camera, partially cropped, wearing a black zip-up jacket with a large white OpenAI logo on the chest and a gray panel on the sleeve. The man on the right stands farther back, wearing a loose black T-shirt with a bold white "xAI" style logo on the chest, one hand raised near his mouth as if smoking or thinking. Include exactly 2 men, 1 cigarette visible in the foreground, 1 black jacket with the OpenAI emblem, and 1 black T-shirt with the xAI logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张低角度抓拍照片，两名成年男子站在一座传统的东亚木质建筑前，背景是温暖的棕色木框架和重复的绿色格子窗棂。拍摄于黄金时刻，强烈的暖色阳光投下深邃的阴影。左侧男子距离镜头较近，处于部分裁剪状态，身穿黑色拉链夹克，胸前印有醒目的白色 OpenAI 标志，袖口带有灰色拼接。他的手臂直接伸向镜头，手中夹着一支香烟，位于画面极近的前景，使手部和香烟占据左下角，并因浅景深效果呈现出轻微的虚化。右侧男子站位较靠后，身穿宽松的黑色 T 恤，胸前印有醒目的白色“xAI”风格标志，一只手抬起靠近嘴边，仿佛正在抽烟或思考。两名男子的面部均被平滑的矩形模糊块遮挡，以保持匿名。采用写实纪实街拍美学，呈现自然的肤色、广角镜头带来的细微畸变、电影级对比度、浓郁的日落光影，以及强调服装品牌和伸向观众的香烟的随意对抗式构图。画面需包含 2 名男子，前景可见 1 支香烟，1 件带有 OpenAI 标志的黑色夹克，以及 1 件带有 xAI 标志的黑色 T 恤。

templates.title: Anime Samurai Game Ad Poster

The main scene shows 2 young adult male fighters in modern black business suits crouching aggressively in the foreground, each drawing a katana toward the viewer. Both have styled blond hair, sharp handsome features, white dress shirts, blue neckties, and intense action poses, with foreshortened hands and swords dominating the lower foreground. One sword has a blue ribbon tied near the hilt. Behind them, centered and towering, place 1 massive armored mecha samurai with ornate gold horns, layered metallic blue-black armor, glowing blue eyes, and a sheathed sword across its back, framed like a guardian deity. Use a vivid neon city and energy-burst backdrop in electric blue, violet, magenta, and gold, with light streaks, sparks, petals, slash effects, and ink-brush explosion textures. Add 1 vertical black brushstroke banner on the upper right with bold white Japanese text reading 「この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。」. Across the middle-lower area, place 1 huge gold Japanese calligraphy headline with thick brush texture and black shadow reading 「切り捨て御免」, spanning nearly the full width. In the lower left, embed 1 framed gameplay screenshot panel with a gold border, showing a night battle in front of a red Japanese temple courtyard, 1 playable swordsman in combat, multiple enemies, floating damage numbers including 5324, 5329, and 6132, a left-side virtual joystick, 5 character portraits total arranged vertically and along the bottom, 3 circular skill buttons on the right, and a top HUD showing a timer around 01:28 and WAVE 3/3. In the lower right, place 1 large black-and-white QR code inside a white square frame. Beneath and beside it, add bold Japanese text in white with blue outline reading 「今すぐダウンロード」. At the very bottom, include 2 official-style store badges: App Store on the left and Google Play on the right. Overall look: ultra-detailed, polished key art, dynamic perspective, metallic highlights, sharp cel-shaded anime rendering, premium mobile game marketing poster, intense action energy, cinematic lighting, and layered UI-heavy promotional layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有高冲击力的竖版手游广告海报，采用光泽感动漫动作风格，呈现极具戏剧性的赛博武士幻想美学，以及紧凑、高级的抽卡 RPG 推广构图。主画面展示了 2 名年轻男性战士，他们身穿现代黑色商务西装，在前景中呈进攻姿态蹲伏，每人都在向观众拔出武士刀。两人均留着时尚的金发，五官轮廓分明、英俊帅气，身穿白色衬衫，系着蓝色领带，动作姿势充满张力，近大远小的手部和剑身占据了下方前景。其中一把剑的护手附近系着一条蓝色丝带。在他们身后居中位置，放置 1 个巨大的装甲机甲武士，它拥有华丽的金色犄角、层叠的金属蓝黑色盔甲、发光的蓝色眼睛，背部横跨着一把收鞘的剑，宛如守护神一般。背景采用生动的霓虹城市和能量爆发效果，主色调为电光蓝、紫罗兰、洋红色和金色，并辅以光束、火花、花瓣、斩击特效和水墨爆炸纹理。在右上角添加 1 个竖向黑色笔触横幅，上面用醒目的白色日文写着「この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。」。在中下部区域，放置 1 个巨大的金色日文书法标题，带有厚重的笔触质感和黑色阴影，写着「切り捨て御免」，几乎横跨整个画面宽度。在左下角，嵌入 1 个带有金色边框的游戏截图面板，展示了红色日本寺庙庭院前的夜战场景，1 名可操作的剑客正在战斗，周围有多个敌人，漂浮的伤害数字包括 5324、5329 和 6132，左侧设有虚拟摇杆，底部及侧边共排列 5 个角色头像，右侧有 3 个圆形技能按钮，顶部 HUD 显示计时器约为 01:28 和 WAVE 3/3。在右下角，放置 1 个巨大的黑白二维码，置于白色方框内。在其下方和侧面，添加带有蓝色描边的白色粗体日文「今すぐダウンロード」。在最底部，包含 2 个官方风格的应用商店徽标：左侧为 App Store，右侧为 Google Play。整体外观：超精细、精致的关键视觉图、动态视角、金属高光、锐利的赛璐珞动漫渲染、高级手游营销海报、强烈的动作能量、电影级光影以及层级丰富的重 UI 推广布局。

His face is fully obscured by a large solid rectangular blur block in the center, preserving privacy while leaving the hair, ears, jawline edges, and glasses arms visible. In the lower left foreground sits 1 white McDonald's paper drink cup with a lid and a white straw, cropped by the frame. The background shows the restaurant counter area with warm ambient lighting, 1 large red wall panel on the left featuring the yellow McDonald's arches and the white slogan “i’m lovin’ it” with Chinese text below, 4 illuminated digital menu boards across the top displaying burgers, fries, combo meals, prices, and Chinese text, plus 2 people in the background near the counter, one facing away with a backpack and another partially visible behind the register. Use natural color balance, slight indoor grain, realistic reflections, shallow to moderate depth of field, and the candid look of an unstaged social media snapshot.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在亚洲麦当劳餐厅室内拍摄的高度逼真的智能手机休闲自拍，构图为一名年轻男子坐在桌前的半身肖像。相机以手臂长度从略高于桌面的高度持握，营造出自然的正面自拍视角，一只前臂向镜头延伸。拍摄对象身穿黑色 T 恤，左胸处印有白色 Tesla 小标志，留着黑色直短发，隐约可见细黑框眼镜，一只手轻托下巴，姿态放松。他的面部中心被一个大型实心矩形模糊块完全遮挡，在保护隐私的同时，保留了头发、耳朵、下颌边缘和眼镜腿的可见度。左下角前景处放置着 1 个带有杯盖和白色吸管的白色麦当劳纸质饮料杯，被画面边缘裁切。背景展示了餐厅柜台区域，配有温暖的环境光；左侧是一块大型红色墙板，上面印有黄色麦当劳拱门标志和白色标语“i’m lovin’ it”及其下方的中文字样；顶部悬挂着 4 块发光的数字菜单项目，显示着汉堡、薯条、套餐、价格和中文字样；背景柜台附近还有 2 人，一人背对着镜头背着背包，另一人部分身影出现在收银台后。请使用自然的色彩平衡、轻微的室内颗粒感、逼真的反射效果、浅至中等的景深，以及未经摆拍的社交媒体快照的随性观感。

templates.title: Realistic Sam's Club Shopping Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: 写实的 Sam's Club 购物快照

templates.prompt: A candid, highly realistic smartphone photo inside a busy Sam’s Club warehouse store in China. Center the composition on a young East Asian man from mid-torso up, standing upright and facing the camera, with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block for privacy. He wears a plain black short-sleeve T-shirt with a small white Tesla logo on the left chest and holds a large clear plastic bag of red apples in his left hand, tied at the top with a blue band. The apple bag has a white label reading “envy” with small Chinese text beneath it. Behind him is a bright retail interior with tall industrial ceilings, warehouse shelving, shoppers, shopping carts, and stacked produce displays. Prominently show the blue diamond Sam’s Club wall sign at upper left with the text “Sam’s CLUB” and “山姆会员商店,” and a large blue wall banner behind him reading “更好的生活尽在山姆” and “Life is Better in the Club.” On the upper right, hang a tall white vertical banner that reads “优质优价” and “Great Products Great Prices,” with blue and green geometric accents. Include many background customers, slightly out of focus, to create an authentic crowded shopping atmosphere. Lighting should be bright, even retail overhead lighting; colors natural; perspective eye level; documentary snapshot aesthetic; sharp foreground subject with mildly softened background; portrait orientation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在中国繁忙的 Sam’s Club 仓储式商店内拍摄的、高度写实的手机抓拍照片。构图中心为一名年轻的东亚男性，半身像，直立面向镜头，为了隐私保护，他的脸部被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。他身穿一件纯黑色短袖 T 恤，左胸前有一个小的白色 Tesla 标志，左手提着一大袋透明塑料袋装的红苹果，袋口用蓝色扎带系住。苹果袋上贴有一张白色标签，上面写着“envy”，下方有小字中文。他身后是明亮的零售店内部，有高大的工业天花板、仓储货架、购物者、购物车和堆叠的农产品陈列。左上方显著展示蓝色的 Sam’s Club 墙面标志，文字为“Sam’s CLUB”和“山姆会员商店”；他身后有一条巨大的蓝色墙面横幅，上面写着“更好的生活尽在山姆”和“Life is Better in the Club”。右上方悬挂着一条高大的白色垂直横幅，上面写着“优质优价”和“Great Products Great Prices”，并带有蓝色和绿色的几何装饰。背景中包含许多略微失焦的顾客，以营造真实拥挤的购物氛围。光线应为明亮、均匀的零售顶灯；色彩自然；视角为平视；具有纪录片快照的美感；前景主体清晰，背景略微柔化；肖像构图。

templates.title: Chinese Livestream Rocket Gala Edit

titleLocalized.zh: 中文直播间火箭嘉年华效果图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference photo, transform the person into a flashy Chinese livestream screenshot while keeping the same head position, crop, hairstyle, and overall identity. Replace the outdoor umbrella-and-street background with a dramatic night city skyline scene filled with fireworks, and add a large rocket launch on the right side. Change the clothing to a dark business blazer over a light blue dress shirt to make the subject look like a high-value livestream VIP guest. Overlay a polished live-stream app interface in Chinese: top left profile area with the name "王树芝兰", a red "关注" button, and the line "12.8万本场浪费"; top left ranking tag "🔥小时榜第1名"; top center a glowing neon celebratory headline in 2 lines reading "感谢榜一大哥" and "的大火箭嘉年华" with heart and sparkle decorations; top right 4 small circular viewer avatars, the count "1.3万", a close "×" icon, and the label "更多直播". On the left side add 2 gift notification cards: "神秘大哥 送 大火箭 x1" and "可乐加冰 送 嘉年华 x1". Below that add 5 stacked chat bubbles with exact visible usernames and messages: 1) "榜1 神秘大哥：大火箭送给最棒的主播！" followed by 6 party popper emojis, 2) "小美：哇！嘉年华太震撼了！😍😍😍", 3) "阳光男孩：主播真棒，支持支持！👍👍👍", 4) "快乐星球：666666，太厉害了！", 5) "路人甲：大哥威武！主播加油！". Add a bottom translucent comment bar with "说点什么...". Add 5 bottom action icons: smiley, colorful swirl, heart, gift box, and three dots. Add a vertical stream of 4 floating heart reactions on the lower right. Make the composite look like a convincing, high-end social app livestream screenshot with smooth Chinese typography, vivid neon colors, realistic UI integration, and festive viral spectacle.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考照片，将人物转换为炫酷的中文直播间截图，同时保持头部位置、裁剪比例、发型和整体特征不变。将室外的遮阳伞和街道背景替换为充满烟花的夜间城市天际线，并在右侧添加大型火箭升空特效。将服装更换为深色商务西装外套搭配浅蓝色衬衫，使主体看起来像高价值的直播间 VIP 嘉宾。叠加一个精致的中文直播 App 界面：左上角个人资料区显示名称“王树芝兰”、红色“关注”按钮以及“12.8万本场浪费”字样；左上角显示排名标签“🔥小时榜第1名”；顶部中央显示两行霓虹灯风格的庆祝标题，内容为“感谢榜一大哥”和“的大火箭嘉年华”，并配有爱心和闪光装饰；右上角显示 4 个小型圆形观众头像、人数“1.3万”、关闭“×”图标以及“更多直播”标签。在左侧添加 2 张礼物通知卡片：“神秘大哥 送 大火箭 x1”和“可乐加冰 送 嘉年华 x1”。下方添加 5 条堆叠的聊天气泡，显示具体的用户名和消息：1) “榜1 神秘大哥：大火箭送给最棒的主播！”后跟 6 个礼花表情，2) “小美：哇！嘉年华太震撼了！😍😍😍”，3) “阳光男孩：主播真棒，支持支持！👍👍👍”，4) “快乐星球：666666，太厉害了！”，5) “路人甲：大哥威武！主播加油！”。底部添加半透明的评论栏，显示“说点什么...”。添加 5 个底部操作图标：笑脸、彩色漩涡、爱心、礼盒和三个点。在右下角添加一串 4 个垂直漂浮的爱心点赞特效。使合成图像看起来像一张逼真的高端社交 App 直播截图，具备流畅的中文排版、鲜艳的霓虹色彩、真实的 UI 集成以及节庆般的病毒式视觉效果。

templates.title: Nostalgic 80s 90s China Memory Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古中国童年记忆海报

templates.prompt: Create a richly detailed nostalgic Chinese retro poster collage in warm sepia, faded red, and aged paper tones, designed like a memory scrapbook spread on an old desk. The composition is vertical and packed with miniature diorama scenes embedded inside a large irregular paper cutout path, while a realistic adult hand at the upper right holds a black fountain pen with a gold nib, as if writing the memories into existence. At the top, large distressed Chinese headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="8090的记忆"}, with smaller handwritten-style subtitle text beneath it reading “那些简单、热闹、发亮的日子”. The paper surface should look cracked, yellowed, stained, and worn, with old magazine clippings, notebooks, marbles, ribbon, pencils, enamel mug, and children’s illustrated books scattered around the edges. Include exactly 8 numbered memory scenes arranged from top to bottom on the central paper path, each with a red circle number and Chinese handwritten annotations beside it: scene 1 is a boy crouching outdoors aiming a slingshot under a tree; scene 2 is two children running with a metal hoop and stick in an alley; scene 3 is two children crouching over small firecrackers on the ground with smoke and red paper debris; scene 4 is a tiny old-fashioned neighborhood shop counter labeled “供销社”, with one child buying snacks from the shopkeeper and shelves packed with goods; scene 5 is a bustling market fair with many adults, baskets, poultry, produce, and a bicycle vendor; scene 6 is an open-air village opera stage with red curtains, performers in colorful traditional costumes, and a seated audience; scene 7 is two children at a tree, one climbing or reaching into a nest while another watches below, with a green tin frog toy nearby; scene 8 is a man riding a motorcycle with a child passenger down an old street at sunset. Add surrounding retro printed items with visible vintage Chinese cover text, including a left-side old children’s book, a right-side magazine titled “儿童画报 1985 5”, a small blue booklet near the lower left, and a worn exercise notebook near the lower right. At the bottom, place a bold red banner with large cream-colored Chinese text reading {argument name="bottom quote" default="那时候日子不快，但快乐很满。"} and a second smaller line reading {argument name="sub quote" default="很多东西都旧了，可一想起来还是会发亮。"}. The entire image should feel tactile, cinematic, and emotionally warm, combining photorealistic objects with handcrafted poster design, dense storytelling details, tiny human figures, nostalgic 1980s–1990s Chinese childhood atmosphere, and soft golden lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张关于 {argument name="theme title" default="8090的记忆"} 的怀旧中国风复古拼贴海报，设计风格如同磨损的剪贴簿页面与手绘记忆地图的结合。采用竖构图，色调为温暖的深褐色、灰红色、褪色的橙色以及陈旧的纸张米色。背景为老旧的裂纹纸、泛黄的杂志剪报和磨损的复古印刷纹理。在右上角，展示一只写实的人手握着一支金尖黑色钢笔，仿佛正在页面上书写这些记忆。海报中心是一个巨大的不规则木质牌匾或剪贴项目，其中包含 8 个编号的记忆场景，每个场景都像微型立体模型一样嵌入其中，并配有手写的中文标题和简短的要点说明。场景 1 标注为“1 弹弓”，展示了一个小男孩蹲在户外石墙和树旁瞄准弹弓；场景 2 标注为“2 滚铁环”，展示了 2 个孩子在巷子里推着铁环奔跑；场景 3 标注为“3 鞭炮”，展示了 2 个孩子蹲在地面点燃的鞭炮旁，伴有烟雾和红色纸屑；场景 4 标注为“4 供销社”，展示了一个老式社区供销社柜台，有 1 名售货员和 1 名小顾客，身后货架上摆满了商品；场景 5 标注为“5 赶集”，展示了一个热闹的农村集市，有许多大人、鸡、农产品、篮子和一位骑自行车的商贩；场景 6 标注为“6 戏台”，展示了一个乡村戏台，4 名身着传统戏服的演员在红幕下表演，台下坐着观众；场景 7 标注为“7 掏鸟窝”，展示了 2 个男孩在树旁，其中 1 人正在爬树或伸手掏鸟窝，另 1 人在下方观看；场景 8 标注为“8 摩托车”，展示了 2 名骑手骑着复古摩托车在日落时分行驶在老街上。在主项目周围环绕 10 个怀旧物品：左上角有一本系着红丝带的旧儿童手册，旁边有 2 颗玻璃弹珠，中右侧有一本复古漫画或画报，左下角有一本蓝色小插画手册，左下方有一个绿色铁皮青蛙玩具，左下边缘有一把小木椅，右下角有一个印有红色中文的搪瓷杯，杯旁有 2 支彩色铅笔，右下角有一本标有“练习簿”的学校练习册。在顶部，放置醒目的粗体中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="8090的记忆"}，采用做旧的红蓝字体，下方配有较小的手写风格副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="那些简单、热闹、发亮的日子"}。在中心项目右侧，添加手写文字“这一页，刚刚写完。”在底部，添加一个红色大横幅，写有主引语 {argument name="bottom quote" default="那时候日子不快，但快乐很满。"}，下方附带一行较小的文字 {argument name="bottom subquote" default="很多东西都旧了，可一想起来还是会发亮。"} 整体画面应具有丰富的细节、电影感、触感、情感色彩，并深深植根于 1980 年代至 1990 年代的中国童年记忆，融合了插画、微型写实、海报设计、剪贴簿图层和编辑怀旧感。

templates.title: Dreamlike Shanshui Woman Silhouette

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻山水女子剪影

templates.prompt: A dreamlike vertical Chinese ink-and-wash fantasy illustration of a woman's side-profile silhouette merged with a vast shanshui landscape, with the facial area obscured by a plain soft-edged rectangular block in {argument name="overlay color" default="warm taupe beige"}. Her long flowing dark hair turns into swirling brushstroke ribbons, mountain ridges, mist, and clouds, filling the upper left with elegant motion. Inside the silhouette, create a layered classical Chinese landscape with towering blue-green mountains, drifting fog, cascading waterfalls, 4 traditional pagodas nestled among cliffs, 1 arched stone bridge crossing a narrow river, 1 tiny boat with a lone figure beneath the bridge, and stylized pine trees scattered across the peaks. Add 5 white cranes in flight across the upper half of the image and several small drifting petals. Place pink cherry blossom branches in 4 distinct clusters: one woven into the upper-left hair mass, one blooming near the bridge, one large cluster rising from the lower left, and one sparse flowering branch near the upper right. Use a warm sunrise glow from the upper right with a pale golden sun disk, luminous mist, parchment-textured negative space, and a refined palette of teal, indigo, ivory, blush pink, and soft gold. The composition should feel ethereal, poetic, elegant, and highly detailed, blending feminine portrait silhouette art with ancient Chinese landscape painting. Add vertical calligraphy on the lower right reading {argument name="calligraphy text" default="山水如梦"} with 2 red seal stamps beneath it. Ultra-detailed, painterly, airy atmosphere, delicate linework, watercolor and ink textures, cinematic depth, premium wall-art aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的东亚水墨风奇幻插画，将女性侧影与广阔的山水景观融为一体，采用竖版海报构图。她飘逸的深色长发如旋涡状的笔触与云雾般向外延展，幻化为山脊、云朵和装饰性的水墨卷草纹。在剪影与发丝内部，描绘一个精致的中国古典山水世界，包含层叠的青绿山峰、柔和的瀑布、漂浮的云雾，以及悬崖间错落有致的 4 座传统宝塔。在左上方及中心天空中加入 4 只飞翔的白鹤。在发丝、肩部和下半身分布 5 簇盛开的樱花枝，并有零星花瓣飘散在画面中。在画面中下部，放置一座横跨平静河流的拱形石桥，桥下有一艘载着 1 位独行者的小木船。右上角采用温暖的金色阳光天空，呈现淡桃色和奶油色羊皮纸色调，与冷色调的青色、板岩蓝及水墨黑山峦形成对比。女性侧影应朝向右侧，优雅而宁静，无需面部细节，仅保留额头、鼻子、嘴唇、颈部和肩部的清晰轮廓。整体风格应呈现为 {argument name="art style" default="空灵的中国水墨与水彩"}，高度精细、富有氛围感、诗意且超现实，具备细腻的线条、柔和的云雾、明亮的高光、纸张纹理，并平衡留白与密集的景物细节。在右下角添加竖排书法题字 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="山水如梦"}，并在其下方盖上 2 枚红色小印章。主色调：{argument name="main color palette" default="青蓝色、暖金色、奶油色、淡粉色和炭墨色"}。构图重点：{argument name="composition focus" default="由山水与飘逸长发构成的女性剪影"}。氛围：{argument name="mood" default="宁静、雄伟、浪漫、梦幻"}。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Web3 AI Profile Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克 Web3 AI 个人资料海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic vertical sci-fi personal brand poster in a dark blue cyberpunk style, designed like a futuristic profile infographic for {argument name="profile name" default="Meta_wu"}. The composition centers on a young Asian man shown from the back and in partial side profile, standing confidently in a glossy black futuristic jacket with luminous blue accents and the text “META_WU” and “WEB3 × AI” printed on the back. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block. Behind him is a dramatic outer-space scene with a large glowing Earth filling the upper background, dense stars, a futuristic megacity skyline at night, neon road light trails, and 1 small flying spaceship near the left-middle area. At the very top, place a huge metallic ice-textured title reading “{argument name="main title" default="Meta_wu"}” in bold beveled silver letters with blue rim light. Directly below it, add 2 centered lines of Chinese text: the first line is a role tagline reading “BTC矿工｜币安夏普比率No.1交易员｜程序员｜专注web3+AI交叉”, and the second line reads “投资观察-加密货币&美股&A股”. Surround the character with glowing holographic HUD panels in transparent dark glass with cyan neon borders. On the left side, create 4 stacked panels: panel 1 is an “关于我” card containing 4 lines of profile info, “科技｜Hongkong 🇭🇰”, “github.com/Ferwoo”, “出生于 1999年5月1日”, and “2016年10月 加入”; panel 2 is a social stats card with 3 large metrics, “1,950 正在关注”, “3,906 关注者”, and “1 置顶推文”; panel 3 is a “BTC MINER” card showing 1 large gold Bitcoin coin and a server-mining rack scene; panel 4 is a “交易哲学” card with 3 lines of text, “数据驱动 × 理性决策”, “长期主义 × 价值投资”, and a glowing upward candlestick chart. On the right side, create 6 stacked panels: panel 1 shows a globe icon and “被全球KOLs关注 1”; panel 2 shows a group icon and “被中文KOLs关注 93”; panel 3 shows a chart icon and “全球影响力排名 62,434 /200K”; panel 4 shows a trophy icon and “华语影响力 5,053 /10K”; panel 5 is a “TRADER” card with subtitle “币安夏普比率 No.1” and a golden rising line graph, plus the small text “SHARPE RATIO TOP 1”; panel 6 is a “DEVELOPER” card with code-like text lines “// Code is law”, “// Web3 is future”, “// AI x Crypto”, “function build() {”, “return change_the_world();”, “}” and a GitHub-style icon. In the lower center, add a bold Chinese slogan in large glowing white text: “{argument name="slogan text" default="探索未来的交叉点"}”. Beneath it, add a smaller subtitle line: “在web3与AI的浪潮中，构建价值与未来”. At the bottom, include 3 rectangular category cards aligned horizontally: card 1 labeled “加密货币” with a Bitcoin icon and tiny market chart; card 2 labeled “美股” with Tesla and Apple logos; card 3 labeled “A股” with a rising bar-and-line market graph. At the very bottom center, place 4 Chinese keywords separated by vertical bars, “科技｜投资｜自由｜影响力”, and below them the English words “TECHNOLOGY · INVESTMENT · FREEDOM · INFLUENCE”. Use a high-contrast blue-and-silver color scheme with subtle gold accents, ultra-detailed sci-fi UI, crisp and accurate typography, volumetric glow, reflective surfaces, dramatic rim lighting, premium poster design, clean layout symmetry, sharp focus, and a polished high-end GPT-image-2 futuristic promotional aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的竖版科幻个人品牌海报，采用深蓝色赛博朋克风格，设计为 {argument name="profile name" default="Meta_wu"} 的未来感个人资料信息图。构图中心是一位年轻亚裔男性的背影及部分侧脸，他自信地穿着一件带有发光蓝色装饰的亮面黑色未来感夹克，背部印有“META_WU”和“WEB3 × AI”字样。他的面部被一个矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。背景是壮丽的外太空场景，上方背景是一个巨大的发光地球，布满繁星，下方是未来感十足的夜间大都市天际线、霓虹灯路轨，左中位置有一艘小型飞行飞船。在最上方，放置一个巨大的金属冰晶质感标题，以粗体斜面银色字母书写“{argument name="main title" default="Meta_wu"}”，并带有蓝色边缘光。正下方添加两行居中的中文文本：第一行是角色标语“BTC矿工｜币安夏普比率No.1交易员｜程序员｜专注web3+AI交叉”，第二行是“投资观察-加密货币&美股&A股”。在人物周围环绕透明深色玻璃材质的发光全息 HUD 面板，并配有青色霓虹边框。左侧创建 4 个堆叠面板：面板 1 是“关于我”卡片，包含 4 行个人资料信息，“科技｜Hongkong 🇭🇰”、“github.com/Ferwoo”、“出生于 1999年5月1日”和“2016年10月 加入”；面板 2 是社交数据卡片，包含 3 个大指标，“1,950 正在关注”、“3,906 关注者”和“1 置顶推文”；面板 3 是“BTC MINER”卡片，展示一枚巨大的金色比特币和服务器挖矿机架场景；面板 4 是“交易哲学”卡片，包含 3 行文本，“数据驱动 × 理性决策”、“长期主义 × 价值投资”以及一个发光的向上 K 线图。右侧创建 6 个堆叠面板：面板 1 显示地球图标和“被全球KOLs关注 1”；面板 2 显示群组图标和“被中文KOLs关注 93”；面板 3 显示图表图标和“全球影响力排名 62,434 /200K”；面板 4 显示奖杯图标和“华语影响力 5,053 /10K”；面板 5 是“TRADER”卡片，副标题为“币安夏普比率 No.1”，配有金色上升折线图，以及小字“SHARPE RATIO TOP 1”；面板 6 是“DEVELOPER”卡片，包含类似代码的文本行“// Code is law”、“// Web3 is future”、“// AI x Crypto”、“function build() {”、“return change_the_world();”、“}”以及 GitHub 风格图标。在下方中心，添加一句醒目的中文口号，使用巨大的发光白色文字：“{argument name="slogan text" default="探索未来的交叉点"}”。在其下方添加一行较小的副标题：“在web3与AI的浪潮中，构建价值与未来”。底部包含 3 个水平对齐的矩形分类卡片：卡片 1 标记为“加密货币”，带有比特币图标和微型市场图表；卡片 2 标记为“美股”，带有特斯拉和苹果标志；卡片 3 标记为“A股”，带有上升的柱状和折线市场图。在最底部中心，放置 4 个由竖线分隔的中文关键词：“科技｜投资｜自由｜影响力”，下方是对应的英文单词“TECHNOLOGY · INVESTMENT · FREEDOM · INFLUENCE”。采用高对比度的蓝银配色方案，点缀微妙的金色，超精细的科幻 UI，清晰准确的排版，体积光效果，反射表面，戏剧性的边缘照明，高级海报设计，整洁的布局对称性，焦点清晰，呈现出精致的高端 GPT-image-2 未来感宣传美学。

templates.title: Futuristic Mumbai Sunset Skyline

titleLocalized.zh: 未来主义风格孟买日落天际线

templates.prompt: A cinematic ultra-detailed wide-angle cityscape of {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} reimagined as a futuristic megacity at sunset, viewed from an elevated overlook above the coastline. The skyline is packed with dozens of towering futuristic skyscrapers of varied silhouettes, including 6 especially prominent supertall towers with sleek glass facades, sharp angular forms, and neon accents, mixed with dense mid-rise urban buildings below. On the right side, a long sea bridge resembling the Bandra-Worli Sea Link curves dramatically from the foreground into the distance over calm coastal water, with flowing streams of headlights and taillights. The sun sits low near the horizon over the Arabian Sea, casting glowing golden reflections across the water and bathing the scene in intense orange, amber, pink, and magenta light under richly layered clouds. In the lower left foreground, include a grand historic domed building inspired by South Mumbai heritage architecture, warmly illuminated, juxtaposed against the futuristic skyline; above it, add a hovering circular UFO-like platform with blue light. Also place 2 visible illuminated billboards in the lower-left and center-right urban area: one large sign reading "MUMBAI", "मुंबई", and "THE CITY OF DREAMS", and one smaller sign reading "NAVI MUMBAI". Add 1 small flying vehicle or drone near the central towers. Place large clean white uppercase text near the top center reading {argument name="top text" default="CHATGPT"}. The overall mood is epic, aspirational, glossy, highly detailed, vibrant, cinematic sci-fi urban fantasy, with atmospheric haze, glowing windows, reflective glass, dramatic contrast, and a polished concept-art finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级、超精细的广角城市景观图，将 {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} 重新构想为日落时分的未来主义超级城市，视角位于海岸线上方的俯瞰点。天际线密布着数十座轮廓各异的未来主义摩天大楼，其中包括 6 座格外显眼的超高层塔楼，它们拥有光滑的玻璃幕墙、锐利的几何造型和霓虹灯点缀，与下方密集的城市中层建筑交织在一起。在右侧，一座类似于班德拉-沃里海湾大桥（Bandra-Worli Sea Link）的长跨海大桥从前景戏剧性地延伸至远方平静的海岸水域，桥上车流汇聚成流动的头灯和尾灯光带。太阳低悬在阿拉伯海上方的地平线附近，在水面上投射出金色的光辉，使整个场景沐浴在浓郁的橙色、琥珀色、粉色和洋红色的光影中，云层层次丰富。在左下角前景处，加入一座受南孟买历史建筑启发、灯光温暖的宏伟圆顶建筑，与未来主义天际线形成鲜明对比；在其上方，添加一个带有蓝色灯光的悬浮圆形 UFO 平台。此外，在左下角和中右侧的城市区域放置 2 个可见的照明广告牌：一个大型标志，上面写着 "MUMBAI"、"मुंबई" 和 "THE CITY OF DREAMS"，另一个较小的标志写着 "NAVI MUMBAI"。在中央塔楼附近添加 1 个小型飞行器或无人机。在顶部中央放置醒目、整洁的白色大写文字 {argument name="top text" default="CHATGPT"}。整体氛围宏大、充满抱负、光泽感强、细节丰富，呈现出充满大气霾感、窗户发光、玻璃反射、对比鲜明且精致的概念艺术风格，属于科幻城市幻想题材。

templates.title: Photorealistic Boeing 747 Cockpit

titleLocalized.zh: 超写实波音 747 驾驶舱

templates.prompt: Ultra-realistic interior photograph of a {argument name="aircraft model" default="Boeing 747"} cockpit viewed from slightly behind and between the two pilot seats, centered and perfectly symmetrical, showing the full main instrument panel, center pedestal, dual control yokes, and the overhead switch panel across the top edge of the frame. The cockpit is unoccupied, with 2 pilot seats visible in the foreground, each with light gray or off-white sheepskin seat covers, and 2 control yokes each holding a dark rectangular checklist or electronic note board clipped to the center. The main panel is densely packed with authentic-looking avionics, analog dials, autopilot controls, radio panels, and 6 illuminated display screens total: 2 large central navigation displays, 2 smaller blue-toned flight displays near the left and right sides, and 2 green text/data screens on the lower center pedestal. Include 4 throttle levers in the center, plus additional flap and systems levers, rotary knobs, guarded switches, and weathered brown-gray metal surfaces typical of a widebody airliner cockpit. The overhead panel should be crowded with rows of switches, toggles, and indicator lights, partially shadowed but sharply detailed. Through the front cockpit windows, show an airport gate scene in soft focus with pale concrete tarmac, painted ground markings, and a passenger jet bridge connected or positioned near the aircraft. Lighting is natural daylight from outside, subdued inside the cockpit, with realistic shadows, mild reflections on glass screens, and documentary-style photographic color grading. Emphasize extreme detail, realism, authentic aviation engineering complexity, and a near indistinguishable-from-real photo quality. Shot with a full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, wide lens around 24–28mm, deep focus across the instrument panel, high dynamic range, no people, no dramatic stylization, no illustration look.

promptLocalized.zh: 超写实内部摄影作品，展示了 {argument name="aircraft model" default="波音 747"} 驾驶舱。视角位于两个飞行员座椅后方中间，构图居中且完全对称，完整呈现了主仪表板、中央操纵台、双控制杆以及顶部边缘的头顶开关面板。驾驶舱内无人，前景可见两个飞行员座椅，座椅配有浅灰色或米白色的羊皮座套，每个控制杆上都夹着一块深色矩形检查清单或电子笔记项目。主面板上密布着外观逼真的航空电子设备、模拟表盘、自动驾驶控制器、无线电面板，总计 6 个发光显示屏：2 个大型中央导航显示屏、左右两侧各 1 个较小的蓝色调飞行显示屏，以及中央操纵台下方的 2 个绿色文字/数据屏幕。中央包含 4 个油门杆，以及额外的襟翼和系统操纵杆、旋转旋钮、带防护罩的开关，以及宽体客机驾驶舱典型的风化棕灰色金属表面。头顶面板应布满成排的开关、拨动开关和指示灯，部分处于阴影中但细节清晰。透过前挡风玻璃，显示虚化处理的机场登机口场景，包括浅色混凝土停机坪、地面标记，以及连接或靠近飞机的乘客登机桥。光线为来自外部的自然日光，驾驶舱内光线柔和，具有逼真的阴影、玻璃屏幕上的轻微反射以及纪录片风格的色彩分级。强调极致细节、写实感、真实的航空工程复杂性，以及与真实照片无异的画质。使用全画幅相机拍摄，平视视角，24–28mm 广角镜头，仪表板全景深，高动态范围，无人物，无夸张的风格化处理，非插画风格。

templates.title: Rain-Soaked Formula Race Car Action

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中方程式赛车疾驰

templates.prompt: A dramatic ultra-realistic motorsport action photograph of a modern Formula 1 race car in {argument name="team livery" default="dark navy with red and yellow accents"} charging through heavy rain on a soaked circuit, shot from a very low trackside angle near the front-left corner of the car. The car dominates the foreground, with slick aerodynamic bodywork, exposed wet tires throwing up massive sprays of water, glowing red reflections on the wet asphalt, and sharp sponsor-style markings across the nose, front wing, sidepod, and rear wing. Capture the sensation of high speed with subtle motion blur in the background and water streaks, while keeping the car body mostly crisp and detailed. The scene takes place in a packed stadium-like racetrack with 1 main grandstand full of blurred spectators along the left side, 2 bright red illuminated signage boards in the distance, 1 safety fence running parallel to the track, and 1 reflective rain-soaked racing surface stretching toward the camera. Overhead, dense storm clouds fill the sky, creating a moody cinematic atmosphere with cold blue-gray tones contrasted by the car’s vivid warm colors. Emphasize dramatic spray, reflections, realism, tension, and the feeling of a championship race in brutal weather, as if captured on a professional sports telephoto-lens camera with shallow depth of field, high contrast, and editorial motorsport photography styling.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具张力的超写实赛车动作摄影作品，展示了一辆现代 F1 赛车（{argument name="team livery" default="深蓝色配红黄点缀"}）在暴雨中冲过湿滑赛道的场景，采用极低视角从赛道旁靠近赛车左前角的位置拍摄。赛车占据前景，展现出光滑的空气动力学车身、飞溅起大量水雾的湿地轮胎、湿润沥青路面上红色的发光倒影，以及车鼻、前翼、侧箱和尾翼上清晰的赞助商标识。通过背景和水痕的细微动态模糊捕捉高速感，同时保持车身主体清晰且细节丰富。场景设定在一个类似体育场的拥挤赛道中，左侧是坐满模糊观众的 1 个主看台，远处有 2 个明亮的红色发光项目，1 道与赛道平行的安全护栏，以及 1 条向镜头延伸的、倒映着雨景的湿滑赛道表面。头顶上方，浓密的风暴云层布满天空，营造出冷蓝灰色调与赛车鲜艳暖色调形成对比的电影感氛围。强调戏剧性的水雾、倒影、真实感、紧张氛围以及在恶劣天气下进行冠军赛的临场感，如同使用专业体育长焦镜头、浅景深、高对比度及编辑类赛车摄影风格拍摄而成。

templates.title: Cafe Phone Camera Food Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆手机拍摄美食快照

templates.prompt: A photorealistic close-up of a hand holding a modern black smartphone vertically in a cozy sunlit cafe. The phone screen shows the live camera view in photo mode, with a young woman seated at a table and leaning forward, extending an orange plate toward the camera with both hands. On the plate is 1 seeded cream-filled pastry or bagel-like sandwich topped with mixed sesame and poppy seeds and a dusting of sugar. The woman has shoulder-length dark brown hair, small gold hoop earrings, a light-colored baseball cap with NYC lettering, and a faded mauve-pink ringer T-shirt with darker trim and partially visible vintage text. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block centered over it. The smartphone camera UI is clearly visible: 1 flash icon at top left, 1 target or focus icon at top right, and along the bottom 5 mode labels reading SLO-MO, VIDEO, PHOTO, PORTRAIT, and PANO, with PHOTO highlighted in yellow; include 1 large white shutter button, 1 small gallery thumbnail at bottom left, and 1 camera-switch icon at bottom right. Outside the phone, add playful floating food-themed stickers around the scene: 1 waffle at the upper left, 1 pink heart sticker reading YUMMY on the left, 1 yellow smiling face emoji on the left, 1 blue speech bubble at the upper right reading {argument name="sticker text" default="Yummy!"}, 1 small yellow smiley on the right, 2 white sparkle stars at the upper right, 1 silver fork at the lower right, and 1 cherry sticker at the lower right. The real cafe background outside the phone is softly blurred with warm wood tones, chairs, tables, large windows, and on the right side of the table 1 red apple and 1 plate of waffles with berries. Emphasize shallow depth of field, natural daylight, glossy phone reflections, realistic skin texture, and a trendy candid social-media food photo aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的特写，展示了一只手在阳光明媚的舒适咖啡馆内垂直握着一部现代黑色智能手机。手机屏幕显示着拍照模式下的实时取景，画面中一位年轻女性坐在桌前身体前倾，双手向镜头递出一个橙色盘子。盘子里放着 1 个撒有混合芝麻、罂粟籽并撒有糖粉的奶油夹心糕点或贝果三明治。该女性留着齐肩深棕色头发，戴着小巧的金质圆圈耳环，头戴印有 NYC 字样的浅色棒球帽，身穿一件褪色的淡紫粉色滚边圆领 T 恤，上面隐约可见复古文字。她的脸部被居中的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。智能手机相机界面清晰可见：左上角有 1 个闪光灯图标，右上角有 1 个目标或对焦图标，底部有 5 个模式标签，分别为 SLO-MO、VIDEO、PHOTO、PORTRAIT 和 PANO，其中 PHOTO 以黄色高亮显示；包含 1 个白色大快门按钮，左下角有 1 个小型相册缩略图，右下角有 1 个切换摄像头图标。在手机画面之外，添加俏皮的漂浮美食主题贴纸：左上角 1 个华夫饼，左侧 1 个写有 YUMMY 的粉色心形贴纸，左侧 1 个黄色笑脸表情，右上角 1 个写有 {argument name="sticker text" default="Yummy!"} 的蓝色对话气泡，右侧 1 个黄色小笑脸，右上角 2 个白色闪烁星星，右下角 1 把银色叉子，以及右下角 1 个樱桃贴纸。手机画面外的真实咖啡馆背景经过柔焦处理，呈现出温暖的木质色调、椅子、桌子和大窗户，桌子右侧放着 1 个红苹果和 1 盘配有浆果的华夫饼。强调浅景深、自然日光、手机表面的光泽反射、逼真的皮肤纹理以及时尚的社交媒体美食抓拍美学。

templates.title: Chengdu Hand-Drawn Food Map UI

titleLocalized.zh: 成都手绘美食地图 UI

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A screenshot-style composition of an AI image generation chat interface on a light gray app background, centered inside a rounded white panel with a soft drop shadow. Near the top is a large pale mint-green chat bubble containing a long Chinese prompt in black sans-serif text, describing a hand-drawn food map of Chengdu. Beneath it, aligned slightly left of center, is a square illustrated map image with rounded corners. The map is a whimsical hand-painted tourist food map titled in large Chinese calligraphy at the upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="成都! 吃货暴走地图"}. The subject is {argument name="city name" default="Chengdu"}, presented as a vintage hand-drawn local cuisine map with warm beige paper texture, watercolor ink outlines, and a playful artisanal travel-poster feel. The map shows simplified streets, landmarks, and district labels in Chinese, not geographically exact, but cute and decorative. Place exactly 12 featured food locations, each marked with a numbered red dot and a small Chinese label, each paired with a detailed illustrated dish. Include 12 dishes total: 1) a bowl of skewers in red chili broth, 2) a bowl of sweet water noodles, 3) rabbit head specialty, 4) guokui or stuffed baked flatbread, 5) hot pot, 6) maocai, 7) dan dan noodles, 8) hongyou chaoshou or chili oil wontons, 9) bobo chicken, 10) fuqi feipian, 11) a spicy stir-fried dish, 12) another classic Chengdu snack platter. Add a few Chengdu landmarks sketched in miniature around the roads, including a pagoda-like tower, traditional gate architecture, modern city buildings, and a central emblematic structure. Frame the entire map with a decorative border made of red chili peppers, green vines, and small leaves. Use a warm color palette dominated by chili red, mustard yellow, olive green, tea brown, and muted jade. In the lower right corner of the map, include a small legend box labeled {argument name="legend title" default="图例说明"} with 4 legend items, each with a tiny icon and Chinese text, plus a compass rose with N, E, S, W. Add many handwritten-style Chinese road names and annotations throughout. Outside the image, the interface includes small gray action icons beneath the green chat bubble on the right, a page indicator reading 2/2, an Edit pill button overlapping the lower left of the map image, a circular download/share button at the lower right of the image, and a sparse bottom toolbar with 4 small reaction/action icons. Overall look: clean modern chat UI presenting a generated square illustration, with the map as the visual focus.

promptLocalized.zh: 一种截图风格的 AI 图像生成聊天界面构图，背景为浅灰色应用界面，中心是一个带有柔和投影的圆角白色面板。顶部附近是一个巨大的淡薄荷绿聊天气泡，其中包含一段黑色的无衬线中文字符串，描述了一张成都手绘美食地图。在其下方，略微偏左对齐的是一张带有圆角的方形插画地图。该地图是一张充满童趣的手绘旅游美食地图，左上角有醒目的中文书法标题：{argument name="headline text" default="成都! 吃货暴走地图"}。主题为 {argument name="city name" default="成都"}，呈现为复古手绘风格的当地美食地图，具有温暖的米色纸张质感、水彩墨水轮廓以及俏皮的手工旅行海报感。地图展示了简化的街道、地标和中文区域标签，不追求地理精确，但显得可爱且具有装饰性。放置 12 个特色美食点，每个点都标有红色数字圆点和小型中文标签，并配有详细的菜品插画。共包含 12 道菜：1) 一碗红油串串，2) 一碗甜水面，3) 特色兔头，4) 锅盔或夹馅烤饼，5) 火锅，6) 冒菜，7) 担担面，8) 红油抄手，9) 钵钵鸡，10) 夫妻肺片，11) 一道香辣炒菜，12) 另一款经典成都小吃拼盘。在道路周围零星点缀一些成都地标的微缩素描，包括塔状建筑、传统门楼、现代城市建筑以及一个核心标志性结构。用由红辣椒、绿藤和嫩叶组成的装饰性边框环绕整张地图。使用以辣椒红、芥末黄、橄榄绿、茶褐色和柔和玉色为主的暖色调。在地图右下角，包含一个标有 {argument name="legend title" default="图例说明"} 的小型图例框，内含 4 个图例项，每一项都有微型图标和中文文字，外加一个带有 N、E、S、W 的指南针。在地图各处添加许多手写风格的中文路名和注释。在图像外部，界面包括绿色聊天气泡右下方的灰色操作小图标、显示为 2/2 的页面指示器、覆盖在地图图像左下方的“编辑”胶囊按钮、图像右下角的圆形下载/分享按钮，以及底部一个简洁的工具栏，包含 4 个反应/操作小图标。整体外观：简洁现代的聊天 UI，展示生成的方形插画，并以地图作为视觉焦点。

templates.title: Mechanical Keyboard Product Page Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 机械键盘产品页面模型

templates.prompt: Create a clean modern e-commerce product detail page for a premium mechanical keyboard brand called {argument name="brand name" default="KeyForge"}, presented as a high-fidelity desktop website mockup on a white background with subtle light-gray dividers and generous spacing. The layout is a single unified storefront scene with a top navigation bar, a left product thumbnail rail, a large center product hero image, and a right-side purchase information panel. In the header, place the bold wordmark on the far left, then 7 navigation items reading “Keyboards”, “Switches”, “Keycaps”, “Accessories”, “Sale”, “Blog”, and “Support”, and on the far right 3 icons for search, account, and cart, with a small black notification badge showing “1” on the cart. The main product shown in the center is a compact 75% mechanical keyboard photographed from a slightly elevated front angle on a pale gray stage, with an aluminum case in silver, white and gray keycaps, several accent keys in lavender purple, and a silver volume knob at the top right. The left vertical gallery contains exactly 5 thumbnails: 1 selected front product shot, 1 angled keyboard view, 1 mechanical switch close-up, 1 keycap texture close-up, and 1 dark video thumbnail with a circular play icon. The right product panel includes a small pill badge reading “NEW”, a large bold product name {argument name="product name" default="KeyForge K75 Pro"}, a subtitle “75% Mechanical Keyboard”, a 5-star rating row with 4.8 and “(126 reviews)”, a large bold price {argument name="price" default="$129.99"} followed by a green “In Stock” status, and a short two-sentence description about premium performance, gasket-mounted design, QMK/VIA support, and RGB. Under that, include a “Switch Type” selector with exactly 4 pill buttons labeled “Cherry MX Red”, “Gateron Brown”, “Gateron Blue”, and “TTC Gold Pink”, with the first selected; a “Color” selector with exactly 3 pill buttons labeled “White / Purple”, “Black / Gray”, and “Navy / Blue”, with the first selected; a “Quantity” dropdown set to “1”; one large black primary button labeled “Add to Cart” with a cart icon; and one outlined secondary button labeled “Add to Wishlist” with a heart icon. Beneath the buttons, show exactly 3 horizontal service highlights with small icons: “Free Shipping” with subtext “On orders over $99”, “30-Day Returns” with subtext “Hassle-free returns”, and “2-Year Warranty” with subtext “Peace of mind”. In the lower content area, create a two-column section separated by light lines. On the left is a vertical tab list with exactly 5 items: “Overview” selected, then “Specifications”, “What’s in the Box”, “Shipping & Returns”, and “Reviews (126)”. To the right of the tabs, place a rounded white feature card grid with exactly 6 feature blocks in 2 rows of 3, each with a simple line icon, bold title, and short explanatory text: “75% Layout”, “Gasket-Mounted”, “QMK/VIA Support”, “Hot-Swappable”, “RGB Backlighting”, and “Premium Build”. On the far right of this lower area, add a specifications bullet list with exactly 7 bullets: “Layout: 75% (82 Keys)”, “Switch Type: Cherry MX Red”, “Mounting: Gasket-Mounted”, “Connectivity: USB-C (Wired)”, “Backlight: RGB, South-facing”, “Material: Aluminum Case”, and “Dimensions: 322 x 135 x 42 mm”, plus an additional final bullet “Weight: 1.25 kg”. Use a refined minimalist product-design aesthetic, realistic UI spacing, clean sans-serif typography similar to Inter or SF Pro, soft shadows, subtle rounded corners, monochrome icons, and polished startup-style consumer electronics presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个简洁现代的电商产品详情页，用于展示名为 {argument name="brand name" default="KeyForge"} 的高端机械键盘品牌。页面呈现为高保真桌面端网站模型，背景为白色，配有浅灰色分割线和宽裕的留白。布局为一个统一的店面场景，包含顶部导航栏、左侧产品缩略图栏、中央大型产品主图以及右侧购买信息面板。在页眉处，最左侧放置加粗的品牌字标，随后是 7 个导航项，依次为“Keyboards”、“Switches”、“Keycaps”、“Accessories”、“Sale”、“Blog”和“Support”；最右侧放置搜索、账户和购物车 3 个图标，购物车图标上带有一个显示“1”的黑色小通知角标。中央展示的主产品是一款 75% 配列的紧凑型机械键盘，以略微俯视的前侧角度拍摄，置于浅灰色展台上，采用银色铝合金外壳，搭配白色和灰色键帽，点缀几颗淡紫色功能键，右上角配有银色音量旋钮。左侧垂直画廊包含 5 个缩略图：1 个选中的正面产品图、1 个键盘侧视图、1 个机械轴体特写、1 个键帽纹理特写以及 1 个带有圆形播放图标的深色视频缩略图。右侧产品面板包含一个写有“NEW”的小型胶囊标签、加粗的大字产品名称 {argument name="product name" default="KeyForge K75 Pro"}、副标题“75% Mechanical Keyboard”、一行 4.8 分的 5 星评分及“(126 reviews)”、加粗的大字价格 {argument name="price" default="$129.99"} 以及随后的绿色“In Stock”状态，下方是关于卓越性能、Gasket 结构设计、QMK/VIA 支持及 RGB 灯效的简短两句描述。在此之下，包含一个“Switch Type”选择器，设有 4 个胶囊按钮，分别标注为“Cherry MX Red”、“Gateron Brown”、“Gateron Blue”和“TTC Gold Pink”，默认选中第一个；一个“Color”选择器，设有 3 个胶囊按钮，分别标注为“White / Purple”、“Black / Gray”和“Navy / Blue”，默认选中第一个；一个设为“1”的“Quantity”下拉菜单；一个带有购物车图标的大号黑色主按钮，标注为“Add to Cart”；以及一个带有心形图标的轮廓风格次要按钮，标注为“Add to Wishlist”。在按钮下方，展示 3 个带有小图标的横向服务亮点：“Free Shipping”及其副标题“On orders over $99”、“30-Day Returns”及其副标题“Hassle-free returns”以及“2-Year Warranty”及其副标题“Peace of mind”。在下方内容区域，创建一个由细线分隔的两栏式板块。左侧为垂直标签列表，包含 5 个项目：选中状态的“Overview”，以及“Specifications”、“What’s in the Box”、“Shipping & Returns”和“Reviews (126)”。在标签右侧，放置一个圆角白色功能卡片网格，包含 2 行 3 列共 6 个功能块，每个功能块配有简单的线条图标、加粗标题和简短说明文字：“75% Layout”、“Gasket-Mounted”、“QMK/VIA Support”、“Hot-Swappable”、“RGB Backlighting”和“Premium Build”。在该区域的最右侧，添加一个包含 7 个要点的规格列表：“Layout: 75% (82 Keys)”、“Switch Type: Cherry MX Red”、“Mounting: Gasket-Mounted”、“Connectivity: USB-C (Wired)”、“Backlight: RGB, South-facing”、“Material: Aluminum Case”和“Dimensions: 322 x 135 x 42 mm”，并增加最后一条“Weight: 1.25 kg”。采用精致的极简主义产品设计美学，具备真实的 UI 间距、类似 Inter 或 SF Pro 的简洁无衬线字体、柔和阴影、细微圆角、单色图标以及精炼的初创公司风格消费电子产品展示效果。

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor portrait of {argument name="subject" default="Elon Musk"} standing at a traditional Chinese writing desk, practicing brush calligraphy on a large sheet of rice paper. He wears a black Tang-style Chinese jacket with frog-button closures and subtle embroidered texture, leaning slightly forward with one hand resting on the table and the other holding a calligraphy brush vertically over the paper. The scene is a warm, elegant scholar's studio with dark wooden furniture, a carved brush stand holding exactly 4 hanging calligraphy brushes on the left, an ink stone and small ink containers in the lower-left foreground, and a small ceramic vase on a side table in the back. Behind him are exactly 2 vertical hanging scrolls: the left scroll prominently displays the large characters {argument name="left scroll text" default="满江红"}, and the right scroll contains a longer column of Chinese calligraphy. A wooden lattice window appears on the right side, letting in soft ambient light. The paper on the desk is filled with many lines of black Chinese calligraphy in flowing semi-cursive script, suggesting he is writing {argument name="written poem" default="《满江红》"}. Use a documentary-style, photorealistic aesthetic with cinematic warm lighting, rich wood tones, authentic calligraphy tools, shallow depth of field, waist-up composition, and a serious, focused atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的室内肖像，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="Elon Musk"} 正站在一张传统中式书桌前，在大幅宣纸上练习毛笔书法。他身穿一件带有盘扣和精致刺绣纹理的黑色唐装，身体微微前倾，一只手撑在桌面上，另一只手垂直握着毛笔悬于纸上。场景是一间温暖优雅的学者书房，配有深色木质家具；左侧摆放着一个雕花笔架，上面悬挂着 4 支毛笔；左前方设有砚台和小型墨盒；后方的边桌上摆放着一个小瓷瓶。他身后悬挂着 2 幅垂直卷轴：左侧卷轴醒目地展示着大字 {argument name="left scroll text" default="满江红"}，右侧卷轴则写有一长列中国书法。右侧是一扇木质格栅窗，透进柔和的环境光。桌上的纸张写满了行云流水的半草书体黑色书法，暗示他正在书写 {argument name="written poem" default="《满江红》"}。采用纪录片风格、照片级真实感的美学，结合电影般的暖色调灯光、浓郁的木质色调、地道的书法工具、浅景深、半身构图，营造出严肃且专注的氛围。

templates.prompt: A cinematic fantasy scene inside a rocky cave during a blizzard, viewed from slightly above campfire level, with 8 characters seated in a circle around a small fire. Outside the cave mouth, a colossal dark mountain rises in the snowstorm, shaped like a sinister pyramid or volcanic fortress, split with glowing crimson-magenta fissures and crowned by a branching, ember-like red energy bloom at the summit; a ring of lava or fire glows at its base across the frozen landscape. The cave interior is warm, amber, and intimate, lit by the fire and a single ornate oil lamp on the right, contrasting with the cold blue-gray storm outside. The group should feel like a high-fantasy adventuring party resting together: 1 regal bird-like humanoid on the left with white feathers, a hooked beak, braided plumage, and layered tribal jewelry; 1 red-haired woman in the left foreground with long braided hair and ornate fantasy garments; 1 young elf-like traveler in blue sitting left of center; 1 small blond elf-like girl at center with pointed ears and clasped hands; 1 elderly king-like man on the right with long white hair, full beard, crown, and dark green robe with gold ornamentation; 1 elegant blond noblewoman beside him in embroidered formal dress; 1 white-haired figure in the foreground right seen mostly from behind in feathered or fur-trimmed clothing; and 1 blue-skinned aquatic-looking woman on the far right with a fin-like headdress, elaborate jewelry, and a cup in hand. Include cups, bowls, plates, bedrolls, sacks, and travel gear scattered around the cave edges. The composition should frame the terrifying glowing mountain through the cave opening behind the party, emphasizing the contrast between sheltered companionship and looming apocalyptic danger. Ultra-detailed textures, realistic fabric and skin, dramatic volumetric firelight, snow streaks driven by wind, moody dark fantasy color grading, painterly realism, epic film still atmosphere, high contrast, rich shadows, masterpiece quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一场电影级的奇幻场景，描绘了暴风雪中岩洞内的景象。视角略高于篝火，8 位角色围坐成一圈。洞口外，一座巨大的暗色山峰在风雪中耸立，形状如同险恶的金字塔或火山要塞，山体裂缝中透出绯红与洋红色的光芒，山顶绽放着如余烬般的分支状红色能量；冰封的景观底部环绕着一圈熔岩或火焰。洞穴内部温暖、呈现琥珀色且氛围亲密，由篝火和右侧一盏华丽的油灯照亮，与洞外寒冷的蓝灰色风暴形成鲜明对比。这群人看起来像是一个正在休憩的高阶奇幻冒险小队：左侧有一位高贵的鸟人族，长着白色羽毛、钩状喙、编织的羽饰和层叠的部落珠宝；左前方是一位留着长辫红发的女性，身穿华丽的奇幻服饰；左中坐着一位年轻的精灵族旅者；正中是一位有着尖耳朵、双手合十的娇小金发精灵女孩；右侧是一位年长的国王，留着长白发和浓密的胡须，头戴王冠，身穿带有金色装饰的深绿色长袍；他身旁是一位穿着刺绣礼服的优雅金发贵族女性；右前方是一个背影为主、身着羽毛或皮草镶边服饰的白发身影；最右侧是一位皮肤呈蓝色的水生族女性，戴着鳍状头饰，佩戴精致珠宝，手持杯子。洞穴边缘散落着杯子、碗、盘子、睡袋、袋子和旅行装备。构图通过小队身后的洞口框住那座恐怖的发光山峰，强调了庇护所内的同伴情谊与外界迫在眉睫的末日危机之间的对比。超精细纹理，逼真的布料与皮肤质感，戏剧性的体积火光，风中飞舞的雪痕，忧郁的暗黑奇幻调色，油画写实风格，史诗电影剧照氛围，高对比度，丰富的阴影，大师级品质。

templates.title: Cinematic Backlit Woman Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感背光女性肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic vertical portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} shown from the chest up in a close half-body composition, positioned slightly right of center, with her body turned to the right and her head turned back toward the camera in a restrained over-the-shoulder pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"}, loose and slightly messy, being blown strongly through the frame so many strands lift outward and sweep across the air around her face and shoulders. Her visible styling is elegant and minimal: a dark thin-strap slip dress or camisole exposing the shoulder line, collarbone, and upper back, with a sheer black off-shoulder wrap or translucent outer layer slipping down the arms to create a soft dark framing shape around the lower body. The mood is cold, quiet, mysterious, and wistful, with a high-fashion cinematic realism rather than glamour polish. Use dramatic backlighting from the upper left, creating a bright halo along the hair, shoulder, and edge of the body, while the front of the figure stays mostly in shadow with only extremely soft fill light. The face is largely obscured in darkness and soft haze, emphasizing silhouette, neck, ear, shoulder, and luminous hair edges more than facial detail. The background is a dark gray to near-black empty space with 2 clear environmental elements: floating dust-like particles and soft circular bokeh light spots scattered mostly on the left side and around the hair. Overall color grading is low saturation with cool blue-gray shadows and slightly warm skin tones for subtle warm-cool contrast. Add diffused bloom, misty atmosphere, faint film grain, soft vignette, and shallow depth of field. Keep the eyes and lips de-emphasized or hidden in shadow, avoid hard frontal light, avoid bright busy background details, avoid cartoon styling, avoid oversharpening, and avoid plastic skin texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感的竖构图肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，采用胸部以上的半身特写构图，位置略微偏右。身体朝向右侧，头部回转看向镜头，呈现出一种克制的侧身回眸姿态。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色长发"}，发丝蓬松且略显凌乱，在强风吹拂下向画面外飘散，发丝在脸庞和肩部周围飞舞。她的造型优雅简约：身穿深色细肩带吊带裙或背心，露出肩线、锁骨和上背部，外搭一件黑色透明露肩披肩或半透明外衣，从双臂滑落，在下半身形成柔和的深色轮廓。整体氛围冷峻、安静、神秘且忧郁，呈现出高级时装的电影质感，而非过度修饰的浮华感。采用左上方的戏剧性背光，在头发、肩膀和身体边缘勾勒出明亮的光晕，而人物正面大部分处于阴影中，仅有极柔和的补光。面部大部分隐藏在黑暗和柔和的雾气中，强调轮廓、颈部、耳朵、肩膀以及发光的发丝边缘，而非面部细节。背景为深灰色至近乎黑色的空旷空间，包含 2 个清晰的环境元素：漂浮的尘埃状颗粒，以及主要分布在左侧和头发周围的柔和圆形光斑（bokeh）。整体色调为低饱和度，阴影部分带有冷蓝色调，肤色略带暖意，形成微妙的冷暖对比。添加漫反射光晕、朦胧氛围、淡淡的胶片颗粒感、柔和的暗角以及浅景深效果。保持眼睛和嘴唇弱化处理或隐藏在阴影中，避免硬朗的正面光，避免背景过于明亮杂乱，避免卡通风格，避免过度锐化，并避免塑料感的皮肤纹理。

templates.prompt: A clean editorial fashion collage on a light gray-white background with a thin black rectangular border, styled like a minimalist magazine outfit board. Center the outfit as a flat lay style composition with 5 visible fashion items: a bright {argument name="jacket color" default="crimson red"} cropped zip-front jacket with a pointed collar and elastic hem placed slightly left and layered on top; underneath it, a fitted {argument name="top color" default="white"} long-sleeve crew-neck knit top visible at the shoulders and sleeves; below, a voluminous mid-calf A-line skirt in off-white with evenly spaced large black polka dots; at lower left, a structured small black handbag with short top handles and a subtle glossy crocodile texture; at lower right, one pair of black square-toe Mary Jane flats with wide straps and silver grommet-ring hardware. Add oversized very pale gray background typography reading {argument name="background brand text" default="MANGO"} stretched large across the middle behind the clothing. Place smaller black fashion-brand wordmarks around the layout: {argument name="top right logo" default="MANGO"} near the upper right of the outfit, "Stradivarius" near the handbag and again near the shoes, and "DOLCE & GABBANA" at the lower left near the skirt hem. The composition should feel balanced, chic, and contemporary, with soft studio lighting, no shadows or only faint soft shadows, crisp cutout edges, and a polished social-media fashion moodboard aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 在浅灰白色背景上呈现一张干净的编辑风时尚拼贴图，带有细黑色矩形边框，呈现出极简杂志穿搭项目风格。将穿搭以平铺构图置于中心，包含 5 件可见的时尚单品：左侧叠放一件亮色 {argument name="jacket color" default="深红色"} 短款拉链夹克，配有尖领和松紧下摆；下方叠穿一件合身的 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 长袖圆领针织衫，露出肩部和袖子；下方为一条米白色大廓形中长款 A 字裙，裙身带有间距均匀的黑色大波点；左下角放置一个结构感十足的小号黑色手提包，配有短手柄和细腻的亮面鳄鱼纹理；右下角放置一双黑色方头玛丽珍平底鞋，配有宽带和银色金属圆环扣。在衣物后方的中间位置添加超大号的极浅灰色背景文字 {argument name="background brand text" default="MANGO"}，并进行拉伸处理。在布局周围放置较小的黑色时尚品牌标识：在穿搭右上角附近放置 {argument name="top right logo" default="MANGO"}，在手提包和鞋子附近放置“Stradivarius”，在裙摆附近的左下角放置“DOLCE & GABBANA”。整体构图应平衡、时髦且具有现代感，采用柔和的摄影棚灯光，无阴影或仅有淡淡的柔和阴影，边缘剪裁清晰，呈现出精致的社交媒体时尚项目美学。

templates.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Landscape

titleLocalized.zh: 中国书法诗意山水

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll style painting on warm off-white rice paper, vertically composed with large black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right-central area and a poetic landscape illustration in the lower left and bottom. The calligraphy must be crisp, fully legible, and written in expressive semi-cursive brush script, arranged in 6 vertical columns read right to left. The exact text of the 6 columns is: “金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱”, “停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然”, “欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山”, “闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边”, “行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在”, “长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海”. Add a smaller vertical signature inscription to the left of the main poem reading “李白行路难”, plus 1 small red square seal beneath the inscription. In the painted scene, show 1 ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing pale robes with a dark topknot and trailing ribbons, standing on the edge of a rugged cliff at lower left, gazing upward and outward in contemplation. Below and across the lower half, depict a turbulent river or sea with whitecaps and foam, misty ink-wash mountains receding in the distance, sparse grasses and dark brush vegetation near the cliff edge, and soft atmospheric fog. Use monochrome black and gray ink with very restrained muted blue-gray washes in the water and robe shadows. The mood is heroic, melancholic, and literary, evoking classical Chinese shanshui painting and museum-quality calligraphy, with empty negative space preserved around the text and landscape.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅传统的中国水墨挂轴风格画作，绘制于暖米色宣纸上，采用竖构图，上方及右侧中部为大字黑墨书法，左下方及底部为诗意山水插画。书法必须清晰、易读，采用富有表现力的行书笔触，分为 6 列竖排，从右向左阅读。6 列的具体文字为：“金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱”、“停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然”、“欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山”、“闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边”、“行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在”、“长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海”。在主诗左侧添加较小的竖排落款“李白行路难”，并在落款下方加盖 1 枚红色方形印章。在山水场景中，描绘 1 位身着淡色长袍、束发髻并带有飘带的中国古代文人墨客，伫立在左下方的崎岖悬崖边缘，正抬头向远方凝望，神情沉思。在下方及整个下半部分，描绘波涛汹涌的河流或大海，伴有白浪与泡沫，远处是隐没在雾气中的水墨山峦，悬崖边缘点缀着稀疏的草木，整体笼罩在柔和的雾气中。使用黑灰水墨，并在水面和长袍阴影处加入极其克制的暗蓝灰色渲染。整体氛围豪迈、忧郁且富有文学气息，展现出古典中国山水画与博物馆级书法作品的质感，并在文字与景观周围保留了适度的留白。

templates.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Scroll

titleLocalized.zh: 中国书法诗词卷轴

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A traditional Chinese ink wash hanging-scroll painting on warm aged rice paper, vertical composition, with six large vertical columns of bold black brush-calligraphy occupying the upper and right half of the image. The calligraphy should be highly legible expressive Chinese cursive-regular script with varied ink density and natural brush taper, reading from right to left in 6 columns: "金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱", "停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然", "欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山", "闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边", "行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在", "长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海". Add one smaller vertical inscription on the left side reading "李白行路难" with a small red seal stamp beneath it. In the lower left foreground, depict an ancient Chinese scholar-poet in flowing white and pale gray robes with a blue sash, long black hair in a traditional topknot with loose strands and ribbon, standing on the edge of a dark rocky cliff, body angled right and head lifted upward in a contemplative, heroic pose. Below and across the lower half, paint a turbulent river or sea with white crashing waves in monochrome ink and soft gray washes; in the distance, faint misty mountains and fog dissolve into the paper. Classical literati painting style, dynamic calligraphy as the main focus, poetic and majestic mood, restrained palette of black ink, gray wash, off-white paper, and a small touch of muted blue on the robe, ample negative space, museum-quality Chinese shanshui and calligraphy fusion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅传统的中国水墨挂轴画，绘于泛黄的陈年宣纸上，采用竖构图。画面上方及右侧分布着六列醒目的黑色大字书法。书法应为清晰且富有表现力的行楷，墨色浓淡相间，笔触自然，从右至左共六列，内容为：“金樽清酒斗十千 玉盘珍羞直万钱”，“停杯投箸不能食 拔剑四顾心茫然”，“欲渡黄河冰塞川 将登太行雪满山”，“闲来垂钓碧溪上 忽复乘舟梦日边”，“行路难 行路难 多歧路 今安在”，“长风破浪会有时 直挂云帆济沧海”。在左侧添加一列较小的竖向题款，内容为“李白行路难”，下方盖有一枚红色小印章。画面左下方前景处，描绘一位古代中国文人诗人，身着飘逸的白灰长袍，系蓝色腰带，留着黑色长发并挽成传统发髻，发丝与发带随风飘动，伫立在深色崖边，身体向右倾斜，抬头仰望，姿态沉思而豪迈。画面下半部分绘有汹涌的河流或大海，以黑白水墨和柔和的灰色渲染出白色的浪花；远处，淡淡的烟云山峦隐没在纸面中。古典文人画风格，以动态书法为视觉焦点，意境诗意而雄浑，色调克制，以黑墨、灰渲染、米白色纸张为主，袍服处点缀少许柔和的蓝色，留白充裕，呈现博物馆级的中国山水与书法融合之作。

templates.title: Anime Wedding Poster at a Church

titleLocalized.zh: 教堂前的动漫风婚礼海报

templates.prompt: A vertical anime-inspired wedding key visual poster that blends live-action cosplay-style newlyweds in the foreground with illustrated anime girls surrounding them, set in front of a sunlit stone church under a brilliant deep blue sky. In the center foreground, a bride and groom pose for a dramatic selfie-like shot with their arms reaching toward the viewer. The groom is a youthful androgynous character with {argument name="hair color" default="light brown"} shaggy short hair, wearing a crisp white wedding suit, white shirt, and white tie, smiling and making a playful hand sign near his face. The bride has {argument name="hair color" default="dark purple-black"} hair in short twin tails and wears an ornate white wedding dress with layered lace, veil, pearl choker, long white gloves, and holds a bouquet of white roses. Behind them rises a beautiful European-style church with a tall steeple, floral garlands over the entrance, stained glass, and warm sunlight bursting from the left side, creating lens flare and sparkling highlights. The sky is filled with fluffy white clouds, flying white birds, a faint rainbow streak, and drifting pink flower petals. Around the edges are 6 anime schoolgirl portraits in dark school uniforms with red or yellow ribbon bows, each showing a different emotional expression: top left brown-haired girl reaching forward, upper left purple-haired girl with an eyepatch looking flustered, lower left pink-haired cheerful girl, top right brown-haired girl extending a gloved hand, mid-right dark-haired boy in school uniform, lower right brown-haired shy girl, and bottom right small blonde girl with an excited open-mouth expression. Add ornate decorative corner filigree framing the poster. Include vertical Japanese tagline text on the upper right reading {argument name="tagline text" default="さあ、契約の時間だ— 私たちの永遠を誓おう"}. Place a large colorful Japanese title across the bottom center reading {argument name="title text" default="中二病でも恋がしたい！"} in bold blue and pink outlined typography, with a small romanized subtitle beneath it reading "Chu-2 byo demo KOI ga shitai!" and small credits near the bottom reading {argument name="credit text" default="富樫勇太　小鳥遊六花"}. Overall look: dazzling, romantic, sentimental, nostalgic anime movie poster, ultra-detailed, glossy lighting, magical sparkle effects, vivid colors, polished promotional composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张垂直的动漫风格婚礼主视觉海报，将前景中真人 Cosplay 风格的新婚夫妇与环绕他们的动漫少女插画融为一体，背景是明媚阳光下的石砌教堂，天空呈现出绚丽的深蓝色。画面中心前景，新郎和新娘摆出类似戏剧性自拍的姿势，手臂向观众伸展。新郎是一位年轻的中性化角色，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色"} 的凌乱短发，身穿干练的白色婚礼西装、白衬衫和白色领带，面带微笑，在脸旁做出俏皮的手势。新娘留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫黑色"} 的短双马尾，身穿华丽的白色婚纱，配有层叠蕾丝、头纱、珍珠项圈和白色长手套，手中捧着一束白玫瑰。他们身后矗立着一座美丽的欧式教堂，高耸的尖塔、入口处挂着花环、彩色玻璃窗，温暖的阳光从左侧迸发，营造出镜头光晕和闪烁的亮光。天空中飘浮着蓬松的白云，飞翔的白鸽，隐约的彩虹条纹，以及飘落的粉色花瓣。边缘处环绕着 6 位身穿深色校服、系着红或黄色蝴蝶结的动漫女学生肖像，每位都展现出不同的表情：左上角棕发女孩向前伸手，左中紫色头发戴眼罩的女孩显得局促不安，左下角粉色头发的开朗女孩，右上角棕发女孩伸出一只戴手套的手，中右侧身穿校服的黑发男孩，右下角棕发害羞女孩，以及最右下角张嘴兴奋的小金发女孩。海报四周添加华丽的装饰性边角花纹。右上角包含垂直的日语标语，文字为 {argument name="tagline text" default="さあ、契約の時間だ— 私たちの永遠を誓おう"}。底部中心放置一个醒目且色彩丰富的日语标题 {argument name="title text" default="中二病でも恋がしたい！"}，采用粗体蓝色和粉色描边字体，下方附有小型罗马音副标题 "Chu-2 byo demo KOI ga shitai!" 以及底部的制作人员名单 {argument name="credit text" default="富樫勇太　小鳥遊六花"}。整体观感：耀眼、浪漫、感性、怀旧的动漫电影海报，超高细节，光泽感光效，魔法闪光特效，色彩鲜艳，精致的宣传构图。

templates.title: Anime Martial Arts Duel in Dojo

titleLocalized.zh: 道场动漫武术对决

templates.prompt: A dramatic anime action illustration inside an old wooden martial arts hall, showing two young women in mid-battle with explosive motion and elemental energy trails. In the foreground, a fierce female martial artist lunges low toward the viewer in a powerful punching stance, her right fist extended straight ahead and her body twisted dynamically. She has dark black hair tied into a messy high bun with loose strands and red ribbons, sharp intense eyes, and a focused combative expression. She wears a white traditional Chinese martial arts top with red trim, red tassel frog closures, and subtle embroidered patterns, paired with flowing deep red pants and black cloth shoes with red accents. Red ribbon-like energy and glowing scarlet brushstroke arcs coil around her arms, torso, and legs, sweeping across the frame like fiery calligraphy. In the upper right, a second young woman leaps through the air in a defensive or spellcasting pose, one hand stretched outward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light purple"} hair styled in two buns with trailing strands and ornate gold hair ornaments. She wears a dark green Chinese-style dress with gold embroidery, black stockings, and dark shoes. Bright blue water-like energy spirals around her in a large circular arc, splashing and glittering with luminous droplets. Set the scene in a weathered dojo or wuguan interior with tall wooden beams, hanging lanterns, broken floorboards, flying splinters, dust, sparks, and debris exploding from the impact of the fight. Include one large wooden signboard above them with the black calligraphy text 武术会, plus two vertical hanging banners, the left reading 以武会友 and the right reading 刚柔并济. Use a low-angle cinematic perspective, strong foreshortening, extreme motion, dense particles, and dramatic warm-vs-cool color contrast between the red and blue energy. Highly detailed anime painting, ultra-dynamic composition, sharp linework, rich textures, glowing effects, volumetric lighting, and epic battle key visual quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的动漫动作插画，场景设定在古老的木质武术馆内，展现了两名年轻女性在战斗中的激烈瞬间，画面充满爆发性的动作感和元素能量轨迹。前景中，一名凶猛的女性武术家正以低姿态向观众冲刺，摆出强有力的出拳姿势，右拳笔直向前延伸，身体呈现出动态的扭转。她留着黑色长发，扎成凌乱的高丸子头，几缕发丝垂落，系着红色丝带，眼神犀利而专注，神情充满战斗感。她身穿带有红色镶边的白色传统中式武术上衣，配有红色盘扣和精致的刺绣图案，下身穿着飘逸的深红色长裤，脚蹬带有红色装饰的黑色布鞋。红色的丝带状能量和发光的绯红色笔触弧线缠绕在她的手臂、躯干和腿部，如燃烧的书法般横扫整个画面。在右上角，另一名年轻女性正摆出防御或施法姿势跃向空中，一只手向外伸展。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅紫色"} 的头发，梳成两个丸子头，垂下几缕发丝，并佩戴着华丽的金色发饰。她身穿带有金色刺绣的深绿色中式长裙，穿着黑色长袜和深色鞋子。明亮的蓝色水状能量在她周围盘旋，形成一个巨大的圆形弧线，闪烁着发光的水滴。场景设定在一个饱经风霜的道场或武馆内部，背景可见高大的木梁、悬挂的灯笼、破碎的地板、飞溅的木屑、灰尘、火花以及战斗冲击产生的碎片。在她们上方悬挂着一块大型木质牌匾，上面写着黑色书法文字“武术会”，两侧各有一条垂直悬挂的横幅，左侧写着“以武会友”，右侧写着“刚柔并济”。采用低角度电影视角，运用强烈的透视缩短、极端的动作表现、密集的粒子效果，以及红蓝能量之间强烈的冷暖色调对比。高度精细的动漫绘画，超动态构图，线条锐利，纹理丰富，光效绚丽，体积光渲染，呈现史诗级的战斗视觉效果。

templates.title: Moonlit Anime Horror Cosplay Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的动漫恐怖 Cosplay 海报

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic anime-horror key visual in a vertical poster composition, set at night inside or beside a shattered window with a huge glowing full moon dominating the background. In the center foreground, a young couple stands in an intimate embrace. The male figure is tall and slim, wearing a dark brown or charcoal hoodie with the hood up, white drawstrings, subtle red blood-like stains on the sleeve and lower hem, and dark red pants. His skin is pale, his long black hair falls over one eye, and the lower half of his face is wrapped in dirty white bandages stained with blood, giving him a disturbing but protective antihero presence. One hand and wrist are also wrapped in bandages. He looks slightly upward and away with a solemn, haunted expression while holding the girl around her back. The female figure is petite with extremely long straight platinum-blonde hair reaching past her waist, wearing a loose white coat or cardigan over a black-and-white outfit and a black choker. She faces him closely with both hands clasped together against his chest, creating a tender contrast against the horror atmosphere. Add 2 ghostly supporting figures in the background: on the left, a pale blonde girl in shadow wearing striped clothing and holding an object close to her chest; on the right, a hooded male figure in profile with glasses or sharp facial lines, his hood marked by a dark blood stain. The environment is filled with floating shards of broken glass, blue moonlight, dust motes, and star-like particles, with deep navy, black, and icy blue tones throughout. Place a stylized red Japanese title at the top right, {argument name="headline text" default="殺戮の天使"}, with a smaller red serif English subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Memory Collection"}. Make the overall style a polished live-action cosplay poster blended with anime horror cover art, highly detailed, dramatic rim lighting, glossy fabric textures, supernatural atmosphere, tragic romance mood, and a premium game or visual novel promotional aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑暗、电影质感的动漫恐怖主视觉图，采用竖版海报构图。背景设定在夜晚，场景位于破碎的窗户内或窗边，一轮巨大的发光满月占据了背景。前景中央，一对年轻情侣紧紧相拥。男性角色身材高挑纤细，身穿深棕色或炭灰色连帽衫，兜帽戴在头上，带有白色抽绳，袖口和下摆有细微的血迹，穿着深红色裤子。他皮肤苍白，黑色长发遮住一只眼睛，下半张脸缠着沾有血迹的脏白色绷带，赋予他一种令人不安却又具有保护欲的反英雄气质。他的一只手和手腕也缠着绷带。他神情庄重而忧郁，目光微微向上看向别处，同时环抱着女孩。女性角色身材娇小，留着及腰的超长直发，发色为白金色，外罩宽松的白色外套或开衫，内搭黑白配色服装，佩戴黑色颈圈。她与他面对面，双手紧扣在他的胸前，在恐怖氛围中营造出一种温柔的对比。在背景中加入 2 个幽灵般的配角：左侧是一个穿着条纹衣服、怀抱物品的苍白金发女孩；右侧是一个戴着眼镜或面部线条锐利的侧面连帽男性，兜帽上有一块深色血迹。环境充斥着漂浮的碎玻璃片、蓝色月光、尘埃微粒和星光般的粒子，整体色调为深海军蓝、黑色和冰蓝色。在右上角放置一个风格化的红色日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="殺戮の天使"}，下方配以较小的红色衬线英文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Memory Collection"}。整体风格呈现为精致的真人 Cosplay 海报与动漫恐怖封面艺术的结合，细节丰富，具有戏剧性的轮廓光、光泽面料质感、超自然氛围、悲剧浪漫基调以及高级游戏或视觉小说的宣传美学。

templates.title: Chinese Co-Branded Summer Drink Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 中式联名夏季饮品海报

templates.prompt: Create a glossy Chinese co-branded beverage poster advertisement in a bold commercial style, vertical 4:5 composition, with a dramatic split-color background: bright saturated red on the left and vivid royal blue on the right, blended at the center with radiant streaks, motion lines, glow effects, and high-energy product-launch lighting. At the top, place 2 brand logo areas separated by a white multiplication sign: on the upper left, a snowman mascot logo with Chinese text {argument name="left brand name" default="蜜雪冰城"} and smaller subtitle text "始于1997冰淇淋与茶"; on the upper right, the deer logo and wordmark {argument name="right brand name" default="luckin coffee"} with smaller Chinese subtitle "专业咖啡新鲜式". Centered beneath the logos, add a huge Chinese headline in thick 3D extruded display typography with white faces, colored edging, heavy shadows, and a glossy embossed look, reading {argument name="headline text" default="蜜雪冰城 × 瑞幸咖啡"}, with the left half accented red and the right half accented blue. Below it, add a second slogan line in bold Chinese text, split by brand color, reading "冰爽甜蜜，咖啡加倍", flanked by short horizontal white dashes. Under that, place a rounded capsule banner in red-to-blue gradient containing the Chinese text "双品牌联名主打・人气招牌同框". In the center foreground, show 2 hero products: on the left, 1 vanilla soft-serve ice cream in a waffle cone, tall swirl, creamy white, slightly glossy, wrapped in a bright red cone sleeve printed with the snowman mascot and Chinese branding; on the right, 1 large clear plastic cup of iced latte or coffee with visible ice cubes, caramel-brown liquid marbling into milk, condensation droplets on the cup, a transparent lid, the blue deer logo, the wordmark "luckin coffee", and small Chinese subtitle text. Surround the cup with dynamic coffee splash arcs and exactly 3 flying coffee beans. Around the lower foreground, add scattered translucent ice cubes and white milk splashes to emphasize cold freshness. Include exactly 2 comic-style promotional burst badges: a red circular badge on the left reading "联名新品" and a blue circular badge on the right reading "限时热卖". In the bottom left corner, add 1 cute 3D snowman mascot character wearing a red cape and holding a tiny ice cream cone, smiling and winking. At the bottom center, place a large red-and-blue beveled ribbon banner with bold white Chinese text reading "今夏限定 立即尝鲜", ending with a yellow lightning bolt icon on the right. Along the very bottom edge, place 3 small selling-point items separated by vertical dividers: a snowflake icon with "冰爽甜蜜", a coffee bean icon with "咖啡加倍", and a heart icon with "双倍满足". Use premium e-commerce poster rendering, ultra-clean product retouching, glossy highlights, rich contrast, crisp Chinese typography, depth, reflections, splash effects, and an energetic summer limited-edition campaign aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张光泽感十足的中式联名饮品广告海报，采用大胆的商业风格，4:5 竖版构图，背景为戏剧性的双色拼接：左侧为明亮饱和的红色，右侧为鲜艳的宝蓝色，中心处融合了放射状光束、动态线条、发光特效以及高能的新品发布灯光。顶部放置 2 个品牌 Logo 区域，中间由一个白色乘号分隔：左上方为雪人吉祥物 Logo，配有中文字样 {argument name="left brand name" default="蜜雪冰城"} 及较小的副标题 "始于 1997 冰淇淋与茶"；右上方为鹿头 Logo 及品牌字样 {argument name="right brand name" default="luckin coffee"}，配有较小的中文副标题 "专业咖啡新鲜式"。在 Logo 下方居中处，添加醒目的 3D 立体加粗中文标题，字体表面为白色，带有彩色边缘、厚重阴影及光泽浮雕感，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="蜜雪冰城 × 瑞幸咖啡"}，左半部分以红色为基调，右半部分以蓝色为基调。下方添加第二行加粗中文标语，按品牌色拆分，内容为 "冰爽甜蜜，咖啡加倍"，两侧饰以短横线。下方放置一个红蓝渐变的圆角胶囊横幅，内含中文 "双品牌联名主打・人气招牌同框"。前景中心展示 2 款主打产品：左侧为 1 个华夫筒香草软冰淇淋，高耸的螺旋状，乳白色，带有微光，包裹在印有雪人吉祥物和中文品牌的亮红色蛋筒套中；右侧为 1 个透明塑料大杯冰拿铁或咖啡，可见冰块、焦糖色液体与牛奶交融的纹理、杯身冷凝水珠、透明杯盖，印有蓝色鹿头 Logo、"luckin coffee" 字样及小型中文副标题。杯子周围环绕动态咖啡溅射弧线及 3 颗飞溅的咖啡豆。前景底部周围添加散落的半透明冰块和白色牛奶溅射，以强调冰爽新鲜感。包含 2 个漫画风格的促销爆炸贴：左侧红色圆形贴纸写有 "联名新品"，右侧蓝色圆形贴纸写有 "限时热卖"。左下角添加 1 个可爱的 3D 雪人吉祥物角色，身披红色斗篷，手持迷你冰淇淋甜筒，面带微笑并眨眼。底部中心放置一个红蓝斜面丝带横幅，带有醒目的白色中文 "今夏限定 立即尝鲜"，右侧末端饰以黄色闪电图标。最底部边缘放置 3 个小型卖点项，由竖线分隔：雪花图标配 "冰爽甜蜜"，咖啡豆图标配 "咖啡加倍"，爱心图标配 "双倍满足"。采用高级电商海报渲染，超洁净产品精修，光泽高光，丰富的对比度，清晰的中文字体，深度感，反射效果，溅射特效，以及充满活力的夏季限定营销美学。

templates.title: Xuanwu Gate Incident Moments Post

titleLocalized.zh: 玄武门之变朋友圈动态

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A humorous, highly detailed composite image showing a modern smartphone displaying a Chinese social-media Moments post about the Xuanwu Gate Incident, placed on the left side of the frame, with the posted battle image expanded into a large cinematic historical scene filling the right side. The phone should look like a black iPhone with thin bezels and a top notch, shown front-facing. On the phone screen, the app header bar is dark gray-black and reads “朋友圈” in white, with a back arrow on the left and a camera icon on the right. Below it is a social post from {argument name="poster name" default="唐王世民"}, with a small square profile avatar of an ancient Chinese warrior in armor and helmet. Under the name is a location pin and the text “长安·玄武门”, and a timestamp line “唐武德九年六月初四 巳时”. The main post text in Chinese says: “吾为国家除逆贼，请社稷。今日玄武门，功在千秋！⚔️💪”. Beneath the text is a square battle image preview matching the large scene on the right. Below the image is a metadata row showing exactly three items: “3.8万次浏览”, “赞 (666)”, and “(128)” beside a comment icon. Under that is a comments box with exactly 5 visible commenters, each with a tiny avatar and Chinese text styled like supportive social-media replies from historical figures. The comments should include these names in Chinese: “尉迟恭”, “房玄龄”, “李渊”, “杜如晦”, and “长孙无忌”, with the tone praising the success of the action; one comment line should suggest the emperor is shocked and the state is secured. The right side is a dramatic Tang-dynasty battle painting at sunset outside {argument name="gate name" default="玄武门"}, with a massive gray stone gate tower and the gate plaque reading “玄武门”. In the center foreground, a mounted armored archer in red-plumed helmet draws a bow while riding a brown horse; around him are exactly 7 clearly visible mounted or standing soldiers in Tang armor, plus 1 fallen armored figure on the ground pointing upward. Multiple yellow battle flags with the large black character “唐” wave through the dust; show at least 4 visible flags. Arrows fly through the sky, horses rear and turn, and the air is filled with dust, warm sunset light, and battlefield motion. The visual style is realistic historical epic key art with painterly detail, but the overall concept is comedic and anachronistic because it presents an ancient coup as a social-media朋友圈 post. Keep all visible interface text in Chinese, maintain believable mobile UI spacing, and blend the phone mockup with the expanded battle artwork in one widescreen composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张幽默且细节丰富的合成图像，画面左侧是一部显示玄武门之变朋友圈动态的现代智能手机，右侧则是动态中发布的战场图像，延伸为宏大的电影级历史场景。手机应为黑色 iPhone，边框极窄，带有顶部刘海，正面朝向。手机屏幕上，应用标题栏为深灰黑色，显示白色文字“朋友圈”，左侧有返回箭头，右侧有相机图标。下方是来自 {argument name="poster name" default="唐王世民"} 的社交动态，配有一个身着盔甲、头戴战盔的中国古代武士方形头像。名字下方有定位图标和文字“长安·玄武门”，以及时间戳“唐武德九年六月初四 巳时”。朋友圈正文内容为：“吾为国家除逆贼，请社稷。今日玄武门，功在千秋！⚔️💪”。正文下方是与右侧大场景相呼应的方形战场图片预览。图片下方是元数据行，精确显示三项内容：“3.8万次浏览”、“赞 (666)”以及评论图标旁的“(128)”。下方评论区可见 5 条评论，每条评论配有微型头像，文字风格模仿历史人物的社交媒体回复。评论者应包含以下中文名称：“尉迟恭”、“房玄龄”、“李渊”、“杜如晦”和“长孙无忌”，语气需赞美行动的成功；其中一条评论应暗示皇帝震惊且国家局势已定。右侧是 {argument name="gate name" default="玄武门"} 外日落时分的唐代史诗战场画作，背景是一座巨大的灰色石质城楼，门匾上书“玄武门”。画面中央前景处，一名头戴红缨盔的骑马甲胄弓箭手正在拉弓，胯下骑着一匹棕马；周围有 7 名清晰可见的骑马或站立的唐军甲士，地上还有 1 名倒地并向上指点的甲士。多面印有黑色大字“唐”的黄色战旗在尘土中飘扬，至少可见 4 面旗帜。天空中箭矢飞掠，战马嘶鸣腾跃，空气中弥漫着尘土、温暖的夕阳余晖和战场动感。视觉风格为写实历史史诗艺术，带有绘画质感，但整体概念具有喜剧性和时代错位感，将古代政变呈现为社交媒体朋友圈动态。所有可见的界面文字均需使用中文，保持合理的移动端 UI 间距，并将手机模型与扩展的战场艺术作品融为一体，呈现为宽屏构图。
