templates.title: Celestial Anime Fantasy Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 星空奇幻动漫电影海报

templates.prompt:
A dramatic Japanese fantasy anime movie poster, vertical one-sheet composition, centered on a beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing silver-white hair, glowing golden eyes, and a calm inviting smile, reaching one hand toward the viewer. She wears a black-and-white celestial dress with a fitted corset bodice, white chest panel, black ribbon lacing at the front, detached black sleeves with soft white ruffles, a black belt at the waist, layered skirt panels decorated with exactly 3 gold crescent moon ornaments, and a black choker with a gold crescent moon pendant. She also has exactly 1 gold crescent moon hair clip near her bangs. Behind her is a luminous night sky filled with stars, nebula-like clouds, and a huge eclipsed moon halo directly above her head, plus exactly 3 floating crescent-ring light effects around the left side of her hair. The background shows an ornate fantasy city with towering gothic palace architecture, spires, observatory-like structures, and glowing windows, all bathed in cool moonlight. Use a rich palette of deep indigo, violet, midnight blue, silver, and gold, with sparkles, magical particles, rim lighting, glossy highlights, and a slightly dense, painterly modern-anime poster finish.

Design it as a fully typeset Japanese film poster with elegant serif display typography in gold and white. At the very top, place a centered headline in Japanese: {argument name="headline text" default="夜が欠けるたび、忘れていた真実が目を覚ます。"}. On the right side, set a large vertical Japanese tagline in gold: {argument name="right-side tagline" default="最後の月光が消える前に、世界の記憶をつなぎ直せ。"}. On the left side, arrange 4 stacked blocks of smaller Japanese body copy separated by decorative divider lines and crescent motifs. Add a circular gold burst badge on the lower right with Japanese promotional text inside. Across the lower middle, place the large glowing Japanese title in ornate gold-white lettering: {argument name="movie title" default="月蝕のリグレット"}. Beneath the title, add a smaller centered Japanese subtitle line. Below that, place a horizontal feature line with exactly 3 gold-separated phrases in Japanese: "記憶", "月光", "観測魔法". At the very bottom, add 3 short Japanese teaser lines spread left, center, and right, and a large glowing release line centered under them: {argument name="release text" default="近日公開"}. The overall feeling is epic, melancholic, magical, celestial, romantic, and nostalgic, like a high-budget fantasy anime film poster.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张极具戏剧张力的日式奇幻动漫电影海报，采用竖版单张构图。画面中心是一位美丽的少女，留着极长的银白色飘逸长发，拥有闪烁的金色双眸和冷静而迷人的微笑，正向观众伸出一只手。她身着黑白配色的星空礼服，配有合身的束腰胸衣、白色胸前饰板、前襟黑色丝带系带、带有柔和白色荷叶边的黑色分体式袖子、腰间黑色腰带，多层裙摆上装饰着 3 个金色的新月装饰，脖子上戴着带有金色新月吊坠的黑色颈圈。她的刘海附近还别着 1 个金色新月发夹。背景是璀璨的夜空，繁星点点，伴有星云状云团，头顶上方悬挂着巨大的月食光环，左侧发丝周围环绕着 3 个漂浮的新月光环特效。背景展现了一座华丽的奇幻城市，拥有高耸的哥特式宫殿建筑、尖塔、类似天文台的结构以及闪烁的窗户，一切都沐浴在清冷的月光下。整体采用深靛蓝、紫罗兰、午夜蓝、银色和金色的丰富色调，点缀着闪光、魔法粒子、轮廓光和光泽高光，呈现出一种质感浓郁、现代动漫风格的绘画海报效果。

将其设计为一张排版完整的日式电影海报，使用优雅的金色和白色衬线字体。在顶部居中位置放置日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="夜が欠けるたび、忘れていた真実が目を覚ます。"}。在右侧，竖排设置一行金色的日文大标语：{argument name="right-side tagline" default="最後の月光が消える前に、世界の記憶をつなぎ直せ。"}。在左侧，排列 4 块堆叠的日文正文，中间用装饰性分割线和新月图案隔开。在右下角添加一个圆形的金色宣传徽章，内含日文宣传文字。在画面中下部，放置巨大的发光日文片名，采用华丽的金色与白色字体：{argument name="movie title" default="月蝕のリグレット"}。在片名下方添加一行居中的日文副标题。下方放置一条水平特征线，包含 3 个由金色符号分隔的日文短语：“记忆”、“月光”、“观测魔法”。在最底部，左右中各放置一行简短的日文预告文案，并在其下方居中位置放置一行巨大的发光上映日期：{argument name="release text" default="近日公開"}。整体氛围史诗、忧郁、魔幻、空灵且怀旧，呈现出高预算奇幻动漫电影海报的质感。

templates.title: Photoreal Schoolgirl Shrine Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 写实风格校服神社肖像

templates.prompt: A photorealistic upper-body portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="Japanese high school girl"} standing outdoors in bright natural sunlight, framed from mid-torso up in a vertical composition. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with a glossy sheen, a clean center part, and soft strands catching the light. Her pose is calm and slightly angled to the side, with her head turned subtly away from the camera for a candid fashion-portrait feel. She wears a crisp white short-sleeve school shirt and a navy blue striped necktie, with a detailed embroidered crest patch on the left chest pocket featuring a crown and heraldic shield. The background is a shallow-depth-of-field scene of vivid red shrine or temple architecture with bold vertical pillars and hints of blue and gold decorative elements, creating strong color contrast against the white shirt and dark hair. Emphasize realistic skin, natural fabric folds, high-end DSLR portrait photography, soft bokeh, sharp focus on hair and clothing, polished commercial beauty styling, and an elegant, refined mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的半身肖像，主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，站在明亮的自然阳光下，采用竖构图。她留着一头长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 秀发，发质光泽亮丽，中分偏侧，自然垂落在双肩。她身穿一件挺括的白色短袖校服衬衫，搭配海军蓝条纹领带，左胸口袋处有精致的刺绣徽章，图案为皇冠与纹章。让她以微侧的角度站立，姿态放松，头部微微转向一侧，营造出一种精致的抓拍时尚感。背景设定为生动的 {argument name="background setting" default="红色神社建筑"}，模糊的背景中可见浓郁的红色柱子和弧形蓝色屋顶细节，利用浅景深和柔和的焦外成像效果，使主体保持清晰对焦。光线应干净、高对比度且具有修饰感，头发和衬衫上有明亮的高光，展现真实的衣物褶皱、自然的肤色，呈现出类似于日本商业摄影的精致高级肖像美学。

templates.title: Long Stretching Tabby Cat

titleLocalized.zh: 长条伸展虎斑猫

templates.prompt: A whimsical minimalist illustration of a {argument name="cat breed" default="brown tabby kitten"} standing upright in the exact center of a very tall vertical canvas, with an absurdly elongated, noodle-like body stretched from near the top to near the bottom of the image. The cat has a small round face with large glossy eyes, a tiny open smiling mouth, upright ears, and both front paws raised straight overhead in a cheering pose, showing 2 visible pink paw pads. Its fur is soft and detailed, with a white muzzle, chest, belly, and inner legs, and brown-and-black tabby stripes along the sides, head, arms, and tail. The body is extremely thin and vertically extended, creating a comical exaggerated proportion, while the hind paws remain tiny and close together at the bottom. Add 1 curved striped tail extending to the lower right side. Above the head, place the playful hand-drawn text "{argument name="caption text" default="nyoooon~"}" in a rounded dark brown font, arched like a semicircle, with 6 short motion lines around the raised paws and text to emphasize stretching. Use a clean off-white or warm light beige background with no scenery, only a faint soft oval shadow beneath the feet. Cute, polished digital illustration style, centered composition, high detail in fur, humorous Japanese sticker or social-media mascot vibe, lots of negative space, extra-tall aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极简主义的奇趣插画，画面正中央站立着一只 {argument name="cat breed" default="棕色虎斑幼猫"}，它位于一张非常高的垂直画布中心，身体被夸张地拉长，像面条一样从画布顶部延伸至底部。猫咪有着圆圆的小脸、大而有光泽的眼睛、微张的笑脸、竖起的耳朵，两只前爪高高举过头顶，呈现出欢呼的姿势，露出 2 个粉色的肉垫。它的毛发柔软且细节丰富，口鼻部、胸部、腹部和腿部内侧为白色，身体侧面、头部、手臂和尾巴带有棕黑相间的虎斑条纹。身体极度纤细且垂直延伸，形成了滑稽夸张的比例，而两只后爪则小巧地并拢在底部。在右下方添加 1 条弯曲的条纹尾巴。在头顶上方，放置一段俏皮的手写文字 "{argument name="caption text" default="nyoooon~"}"，字体采用圆润的深棕色，呈半圆形拱起，并在举起的爪子和文字周围添加 6 条短促的动态线，以强调伸展感。背景使用干净的米白色或暖浅米色，无任何场景，仅在脚下有一道淡淡的椭圆形阴影。可爱且精致的数字插画风格，居中构图，毛发细节丰富，带有日式贴纸或社交媒体吉祥物的幽默感，留白充足，采用超高纵横比。

templates.title: Crimson Space Opera Key Visual

titleLocalized.zh: Crimson Space Opera 关键视觉图

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical sci-fi key visual poster for a dark space opera game, featuring a single colossal alien-mechanical spacecraft centered slightly low in the frame, angled diagonally from lower left toward upper right as if surging forward through space. The ship is razor-sharp, asymmetrical, and aggressively organic, built from layered black metal and glowing crimson-red armor plates, with a long spear-like prow, many jagged fins, and about 12 to 16 whip-like tendrils or spines streaming backward from its upper rear like biomechanical hair. Behind it floats a large shadowed planet at center, encircled by 3 luminous red orbital rings that create a halo effect. At upper left, include 1 cratered moon or planet partially cropped by the frame. Scatter multiple dark asteroids and rocky debris across the foreground and edges, especially lower right and lower left, to create depth. The background is a dense starfield with red nebula clouds and streaks of fiery cosmic dust. In the upper right, place a blazing orange-white sun flare breaking into the scene, casting hot rim light across the ship and rings. Use a high-contrast palette of black, deep crimson, ember red, and white highlights, with glossy metallic reflections and a grim, apocalyptic mood. Add vertical Japanese tagline text on the right side in white Mincho-style serif characters: 「あの太陽に飛び込めば 冷めきった私の心も温かくなるのだろうか」. At the bottom center, add the main title in very large distressed white Japanese serif characters with cracked texture and subtle red glow: 「斑鳩の柩」. Beneath it, add 1 line of smaller red katakana subtitle text: 「イカルガのクルスー」, and beneath that 1 line of small Roman letters in red: "IKARUGA NO CRUX". Make it look like premium anime game key art, cinematic poster composition, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, dynamic lighting, epic scale, ominous and beautiful.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版科幻关键视觉海报，描绘了一款黑暗太空歌剧游戏。画面中心偏下方是一艘巨大的外星机械飞船，呈对角线从左下向右上倾斜，仿佛正在太空中疾驰。飞船造型锋利、非对称且极具侵略性的有机感，由层叠的黑色金属和发光的深红色装甲板构成，拥有长矛般的船首、许多锯齿状的鳍，以及约 12 到 16 条像生物机械发丝一样从后上方飘向后方的鞭状触须或尖刺。飞船后方悬浮着一颗处于阴影中的大行星，被 3 个发光的红色轨道环环绕，形成光环效应。左上方包含一颗被画面部分裁切的环形山月球或行星。前景和边缘（尤其是右下角和左下角）散布着多个暗色小行星和岩石碎片，以营造深度感。背景是密集的星场，伴有红色星云和炽热的宇宙尘埃条纹。右上角有一道耀眼的橙白色太阳耀斑射入场景，在飞船和轨道环上投射出炽热的边缘光。采用黑色、深红、余烬红和白色高光的高对比度调色板，呈现出光泽的金属反射效果和冷峻的末日氛围。在右侧添加竖排白色明朝体日文标语：「あの太陽に飛び込めば 冷めきった私の心も温かくなるのだろうか」。在底部中心，添加非常大的、带有裂纹质感和微弱红光的白色日文衬线体主标题：「斑鳩の柩」。在其下方添加一行较小的红色片假名副标题：「イカルガのクルスー」，再下方添加一行红色的小写罗马字母："IKARUGA NO CRUX"。整体呈现出高级动漫游戏关键艺术风格，电影级海报构图，超高细节，焦点清晰，动态光影，史诗规模，既阴森又唯美。

templates.title: Fantasy Manga Spell Explosion Page

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻漫画魔法爆发页面

templates.prompt: A dramatic black-and-white fantasy manga page in highly detailed ink line art and screentone style, vertical comic layout with 2 panels. The top panel is a full-width action scene showing a young anime-style mage boy, about early teen age, standing on cracked rocky ground and casting a powerful spell with his right hand extended toward the left side of the frame. He has short tousled light hair, large serious eyes, and a calm, focused expression. He wears a high-collared cape flowing behind him, a buttoned vest over a shirt, fitted trousers, boots, a belt with pouches, and a holstered wand or small magical tool at his hip, with a gemstone clasp at the neck. In front of his open palm is a large glowing circular magic sigil with intricate concentric symbols and runic ornamentation. The spell erupts into a massive explosion of white light and energy, blasting outward with dense speed lines, black debris clouds, shattered rock fragments, dust, and impact textures filling the background. Large stylized Japanese sound effect lettering is integrated into the art on the left side and along the lower foreground, creating a sense of repeated roaring impacts. The composition is dynamic and high contrast, with the boy positioned right of center and the blast dominating the left half. The bottom panel is a narrower reaction shot, count 1 character visible, showing a long-haired witch in profile facing left, wearing a wide-brimmed pointed hat with an ornate band and gem, and a cloak fastened with a jewel brooch. Her face is partially obscured by a solid rectangular censorship block over the central face area. Behind her, the same explosion and flying rubble continue in the distance. A single vertical Japanese speech balloon on the right reads "…うわ". Use clean manga panel borders, polished professional shonen fantasy comic style, intense motion, crisp pen hatching, screentone shading, and cinematic impact.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的黑白奇幻漫画页面，采用高细节的墨线艺术和网点纸风格，垂直漫画排版，共 2 个分镜。上方分镜为全宽动作场景，展示了一名年轻的动漫风格男法师，约莫十几岁，站在开裂的岩石地面上，右手向画面左侧伸出，正在施展强大的法术。他留着凌乱的短浅色头发，有着大而严肃的眼睛，神情冷静且专注。他身穿高领斗篷，身后随风飘动，内搭衬衫和扣式马甲，穿着合身的裤子、靴子，腰间系着带有小袋的腰带，并配有魔杖或小型魔法工具的皮套，领口处有宝石扣。在他张开的手掌前方，是一个巨大的发光圆形魔法阵，带有复杂的同心符号和符文装饰。法术爆发出一团巨大的白光和能量，向外喷涌，伴随着密集的加速线、黑色碎片云、破碎的岩石块、尘土和充满背景的冲击质感。画面左侧和下方前景融入了大型风格化的日语拟声词，营造出连续轰鸣的冲击感。构图动态且对比强烈，男孩位于画面中心偏右，爆炸占据了左半部分。下方分镜为较窄的反应特写，可见 1 名角色，展示了一名长发女巫的侧脸，面向左侧，戴着一顶带有华丽饰带和宝石的宽檐尖顶帽，披风上别着一枚珠宝胸针。她的脸部中央被一个实心的矩形审查遮挡块部分遮盖。在她身后，同样的爆炸和飞溅的瓦砾在远处持续。右侧有一个垂直的日语对话气泡，写着“……うわ”。使用整洁的漫画分镜边框，精致的专业少年奇幻漫画风格，强烈的动感，清晰的排线，网点阴影以及电影级的视觉冲击力。

templates.title: Sengoku vs Sangoku Crossover Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 战国 vs 三国跨界海报

templates.prompt:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing {argument name="left faction title" default="日本戦国"}; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing {argument name="right faction title" default="中国三国"}. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads {argument name="center slogan" default="時空を越え、宿命が交錯する。"}. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. Mid-left, show 1 battle-hardened older general with wild silver hair, heavy layered armor, and a fierce glare, partially emerging from the fortress cityscape. Lower-left, show 1 aggressive crimson-clad warrior lunging forward with sweeping cloth, horned or antler-like helmet ornamentation, and dynamic red-black armor. At the bottom-left foreground, show 1 dominant swordsman in demonic samurai armor with a crescent-moon helmet crest and glowing red eyes, gripping a katana angled diagonally downward, surrounded by embers and petals. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

Blend historical East Asian war aesthetics with futuristic cyberpunk megacity elements: Japanese pagodas and fortresses on the left, neon skyscrapers and glowing urban lights across both halves, flying fortress silhouettes and distant airborne warships in the sky, magical lightning, smoke, and storm clouds overhead. The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. Use hyper-detailed painterly anime illustration, intricate armor textures, metallic reflections, volumetric lighting, high contrast, epic scale, and intense atmosphere.

At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Below that, add a smaller centered subtitle line reading SENGOKU VS SANGOKU, and beneath it a Japanese tagline: {argument name="bottom tagline" default="時空を超え、英雄たちの戦いが始まる。"}. Poster layout, polished commercial promotional art, extremely detailed, high-impact, collectible poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张极具戏剧性、超精细的竖版动漫主视觉海报，展示了日本战国时代与中国三国时代之间的跨界战争，画面被一道发光的垂直光束精确地从中间一分为二。左半部分以深红、洋红、余烬橙和樱花粉为主题，代表 {argument name="left faction title" default="日本战国"}；右半部分以翡翠绿、青色、蓝绿色、金色和风暴蓝为主题，代表 {argument name="right faction title" default="中国三国"}。画面中央，巨大的垂直日文书法写着 {argument name="center slogan" default="时空交错，宿命碰撞。"}。构图紧凑、充满电影感且对称，如同高端游戏或电影的跨界海报，伴有无数火花、花瓣、发光粒子、动态光影以及层叠的背景建筑。

在左侧，描绘 4 位风格鲜明的战国主题武士。左上方，一位神情严峻的武士大名，身着饰有金边的华丽黑红铠甲，长发高束，随风飘动，以强有力的上半身肖像面向内侧；身后是樱花、旗帜和点缀着霓虹洋红色高光的层叠日式城堡。左中部，展示 1 位久经沙场、银发狂野、身着厚重层叠铠甲且目光凶狠的老将，半隐于堡垒城市景观中。左下方，展示 1 位身着深红铠甲、向前突刺的勇猛武士，衣摆飞扬，头戴鹿角状头盔，铠甲呈现动态的红黑配色。左下角前景，展示 1 位身着恶魔武士铠甲、头戴新月形头盔饰物、双眼闪烁红光的霸气剑客，斜握武士刀，周围环绕着余烬与花瓣。左上边缘附近的垂直旗帜上显示日文文本“日本战国”。

在右侧，描绘 4 位风格鲜明的三国主题英雄。右上方，展示 1 位身着精致蓝黑金配色礼仪铠甲、头戴高冠的尊贵战略家/帝王形象，以半身侧面像面向内侧；身后升起一条由水、云和光构成的发光灵龙。右中部，展示 1 位长须绿袍、头戴高冠、身着札甲的将军，神情庄重英勇，背景是霓虹灯点缀的城市建筑和旋转的魔法能量。右中下方，展示 1 位手持羽扇、身着层叠长袍并佩戴金饰的优雅谋士，神态冷静且深谋远虑。右下边缘，展示 1 位表情凶猛、发丝飞扬的咆哮武将。右下角前景，将一位身着绿金铠甲的英雄作为核心人物，他向观众伸出闪烁着翡翠绿光芒的宝剑，长袍飘逸，发光的能量丝带缠绕在剑刃周围。右上边缘附近的垂直旗帜上显示中文文本“中国三国”。

将东亚历史战争美学与未来派赛博朋克大都市元素融合：左侧是日式宝塔和堡垒，两侧均有霓虹摩天大楼和闪烁的城市灯光，天空中可见飞行堡垒的剪影和远处的空中战舰，上方则是魔法闪电、烟雾和风暴云。天空颜色从左侧的日落紫红过渡到右侧的风暴青绿色和银色。采用超精细的绘画风动漫插画，展现复杂的铠甲纹理、金属反射、体积光、高对比度、史诗般的规模和强烈的氛围。

在底部，添加巨大的风格化标题字体：左侧是巨大的火红色汉字“战国”，下方标注罗马音“SENGOKU”；中间是金属质感的金色“VS”；右侧是巨大的翡翠色发光汉字“三国”，下方标注罗马音“SANGOKU”。在下方，添加一行较小的居中副标题“SENGOKU VS SANGOKU”，并在其下方添加日文标语：{argument name="bottom tagline" default="跨越时空，英雄们的战斗即将开始。"}。海报布局，精致的商业宣传艺术，细节极其丰富，视觉冲击力强，具有收藏级的海报美感。

templates.title: Anime Romance Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫爱情电影海报

templates.prompt: A Japanese theatrical romance movie poster in a tall smartphone-style vertical layout with rounded corners, designed like a polished anime key visual. The main image shows a beautiful teenage billboard girl heroine standing on an outdoor balcony at dusk, turning back over her shoulder to look at the viewer with a soft, wistful expression. She has very long silver-white twin-tail hair tied with dark ribbons, pale skin, and large pink-violet eyes. She wears a delicate white frilled blouse with voluminous sleeves and a dark high-waisted dress or corset-like skirt, creating an elegant, slightly gothic school-romance look. The atmosphere is dreamy and emotional, filled with glowing bokeh lights, drifting petals or snow-like sparkles, sunset pink and lavender light, and a luminous cityscape in the blurred background. Use rich cinematic anime rendering, ultra-detailed hair strands, soft rim light, glossy eyes, and a bittersweet first-love mood. Add Japanese poster typography integrated into the composition: a large vertical pink poetic tagline on the right, a vertical white tagline on the left, a very large main title near the lower left reading {argument name="title text" default="看板娘"}, and a smaller subtitle beside it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="君と紡ぐ恋物語"}. Include 5 small rectangular film-strip preview stills aligned across the lower middle, each showing the same heroine in different emotional close-ups. Add dense credits, festival-style laurels, and small release information at the top and bottom in Japanese, with the overall feel of a premium romance anime film poster advertising a tragic, beautiful love story. Use a pastel palette of mauve, blush pink, violet, pearl white, and midnight navy, with soft bloom, shallow depth of field, and elegant poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张日式爱情电影院线海报，采用适合智能手机的圆角竖构图，设计风格如同精致的动漫主视觉图。画面主体是一位美丽的少女看板娘，她站在黄昏的户外阳台上，回眸看向观众，神情柔和而忧伤。她留着极长的银白色双马尾，用深色丝带系住，皮肤白皙，有着粉紫色的明亮大眼睛。她身穿精致的白色荷叶边衬衫，袖子蓬松，搭配深色高腰裙或束腰式裙装，展现出优雅且略带哥特风的校园恋爱感。氛围梦幻而感性，充满发光的虚化光点、飘落的花瓣或雪花般的闪光，笼罩在日落粉色与淡紫色的光影中，背景是模糊的璀璨城市景观。采用丰富的电影级动漫渲染，呈现超精细的发丝、柔和的轮廓光、明亮的双眸以及苦涩初恋的情绪。将日文海报排版融入构图：右侧为巨大的竖排粉色诗意标语，左侧为竖排白色标语，左下方为超大的主标题 {argument name="title text" default="看板娘"}，旁边是较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="君と紡ぐ恋物語"}。在下方中部排列 5 张小型矩形电影胶片预览图，每张图展示同一位女主角不同的情感特写。顶部和底部添加密集的制作人员名单、电影节奖项标识以及小字号的发行信息，整体呈现出高端爱情动漫电影海报的质感，传达出一段凄美动人的爱情故事。色调采用淡紫色、腮红粉、紫罗兰色、珍珠白和午夜蓝，并运用柔光效果、浅景深以及优雅的海报构图。

templates.title: Zombie Survival RPG Anime Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 僵尸生存 RPG 动漫风格广告海报

templates.prompt:
Create a dramatic Japanese mobile game advertisement poster for a zombie survival RPG in anime-meets-cinematic style. Vertical smartphone poster layout, dense promotional design, gritty urban apocalypse background at dusk with ruined city streets, smoke, sparks, debris, damaged buildings, neon signs, and a crowd of zombies advancing from behind. In the center, a young anime woman sits on the ground in a slightly slouched pose, legs bent, holding a black handgun upright in one hand. She has straight dark brown to black shoulder-length hair, pale skin, and an oversized dirty white T-shirt splattered with blood. Large bold Japanese calligraphy is printed vertically on the shirt: "働きたくね〜". Her expression area is simple and unobtrusive so the composition emphasizes the shirt, weapon, and mood. Surround her with multiple zombies in torn clothing, reaching forward from the left and right background.

Use an aggressive game key-art design with 8 clearly separated promotional sections. Section 1: top-left game logo block, count 3 text elements, with large distressed English title "Dead or work", smaller Japanese subtitle "ゾンビサバイバルRPG", and heavy black paint-splatter background with white and red text. Section 2: right-side vertical slogan area, count 2 text elements, with white Japanese text "動かない、ただ" above giant red vertical text "生き残れ。" on a rough black brushstroke strip. Section 3: left-middle feature list panel, count 4 feature rows, each row with a white icon in a black square and yellow/white Japanese copy; labels are "ゾンビを倒して生き延びろ", "拠点を強化・カスタマイズ", "仲間と協力プレイ", and "デイリーミッションで報酬GET". Section 4: right-middle bonus campaign panel, count 1 headline plus 3 reward items; headline in a bright jagged yellow burst says "今すぐ始めると 豪華特典プレゼント!" and beneath it are three item boxes labeled "ゴールド ×5000", "レア武器 (7日間)", and "サバイバルキット ×10". Section 5: lower-middle gameplay screenshot strip, count 4 thumbnails with captions; captions are "リアルタイムバトル!", "基地を自由にカスタム!", "仲間とレイドボスに挑め!", and "広大なオープンワールド!". Section 6: bottom call-to-action banner, count 2 text elements, with a huge yellow-and-red Japanese phrase "今すぐダウンロード!" and smaller white/red subtext "あなたの選択が、生死を分ける。". Section 7: bottom-right store badges, count 2 badges, showing App Store and Google Play style download buttons. Section 8: bottom-right QR area, count 1 QR code in a white square.

Overall aesthetic: hyper-detailed, high-contrast, grimy, intense, commercially polished gacha/mobile game ad, combining anime character art with realistic zombie horror background. Use bold distressed typography, black brush textures, red warning colors, yellow promotional highlights, metallic UI framing, and cinematic orange-gray lighting.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张戏剧性的日式僵尸生存 RPG 手机游戏广告海报，采用动漫与电影相结合的风格。垂直智能手机海报布局，高密度宣传设计，背景为黄昏时分残酷的城市末日，包含废弃的街道、烟雾、火花、碎片、受损的建筑物、霓虹灯，以及从后方逼近的僵尸群。画面中央，一位年轻的动漫女性坐在地上，姿势略显慵懒，双腿弯曲，一只手垂直握着一把黑色手枪。她留着齐肩的深棕色至黑色直发，皮肤苍白，穿着一件沾满血迹的超大号脏白色 T 恤。T 恤上垂直印有醒目的日文书法：“働きたくね〜”。她的表情区域处理得简洁且不突兀，以确保构图重点突出 T 恤、武器和氛围。在她周围，多名身穿破烂衣服的僵尸从左右背景中伸出双手向前抓取。

采用具有冲击力的游戏主视觉设计，包含 8 个清晰划分的宣传区域。区域 1：左上角游戏 Logo 区，包含 3 个文本元素，带有巨大的做旧英文标题“Dead or work”、较小的日文副标题“ゾンビサバイバルRPG”，以及带有白色和红色文字的厚重黑色喷溅背景。区域 2：右侧垂直标语区，包含 2 个文本元素，在粗糙的黑色笔触条上，上方为白色日文“動かない、ただ”，下方为巨大的红色垂直文字“生き残れ。”。区域 3：左中功能列表面板，包含 4 行功能，每行都有一个黑色方块内的白色图标和黄色/白色日文文案；标签分别为“ゾンビを倒して生き延びろ”、“拠点を強化・カスタマイズ”、“仲間と協力プレイ”和“デイリーミッションで報酬GET”。区域 4：右中奖励活动面板，包含 1 个标题和 3 个奖励项目；标题位于明亮的锯齿状黄色爆炸框中，写着“今すぐ始めると 豪華特典プレゼント!”，下方是三个标注为“ゴールド ×5000”、“レア武器 (7日間)”和“サバイバルキット ×10”的物品框。区域 5：中下部游戏截图条，包含 4 个带有说明文字的缩略图；说明文字分别为“リアルタイムバトル!”、“基地を自由にカスタム!”、“仲間とレイドボスに挑め!”和“広大なオープンワールド!”。区域 6：底部行动呼吁横幅，包含 2 个文本元素，带有巨大的黄色和红色日文短语“今すぐダウンロード!”以及较小的白色/红色副标题“あなたの選択が、生死を分ける。”。区域 7：右下角商店徽章，包含 2 个徽章，显示 App Store 和 Google Play 风格的下载按钮。区域 8：右下角 QR 码区域，包含 1 个白色方块内的 QR 码。

整体美学：超精细、高对比度、肮脏、强烈、商业化精良的抽卡/手机游戏广告，将动漫角色艺术与写实的僵尸恐怖背景相结合。使用醒目的做旧字体、黑色笔触纹理、红色警示色、黄色宣传高光、金属 UI 边框以及电影般的橙灰色光影。

templates.title: 108 Chibi Fantasy Mandala

titleLocalized.zh: 108 款 Q 版奇幻曼陀罗

templates.prompt:
A gigantic ultra-detailed fantasy mandala poster featuring exactly 108 distinct chibi characters arranged in concentric circular rings around a radiant central emblem. The composition is perfectly symmetrical overall and fills a wide horizontal canvas like an ornate collectible mural. In the center, place a glowing golden core with 9 chibi animal-fantasy mascots clustered in a circular medallion, each with oversized heads, tiny bodies, expressive eyes, and luxurious costume details. Surround this center with multiple evenly spaced concentric rings containing the remaining 99 characters, each character occupying its own wedge-like segment and designed as a unique elemental or mythical variation. Include fox-like, rabbit-like, cat-like, wolf-like, lion-like, bird-like, dragon-like, deer-like, and hybrid beast characters, all rendered in a cute super-deformed style but with epic high-fantasy armor, robes, crowns, feathers, horns, gems, capes, staffs, and magical accessories. Make every character visually distinct through color, silhouette, species traits, and elemental theme, while preserving a unified painterly anime-fantasy aesthetic.

Use a rich palette dominated by luminous gold, ivory, cream, violet, indigo, sapphire, and soft amber, with accents of crimson, icy cyan, emerald, and sunset orange. Give the image the feel of a sacred celestial chart or zodiac wheel, with each circular band separated by elegant gilded borders and arc dividers. Add glowing magical energy, sparkles, halos, swirling fire, mist, snow, clouds, water splashes, lightning curls, floral motifs, and celestial particles around many of the characters. Around the outer perimeter, place several larger decorative guardian illustrations integrated into the border: a bright sun medallion at the upper left, a white phoenix-like bird in a circular panel at the upper right, a floral or starburst medallion at the lower right, and a fiery character cluster in a circular panel at the lower left, plus additional large elemental beast figures embedded along the left and right edges. Frame the entire artwork with an elaborate antique ornamental border inspired by illuminated manuscripts and fantasy tarot designs, using filigree, corner medallions, geometric trim, and arcane motifs.

The rendering should be extremely dense and crisp, like a 4k fantasy illustration meant for a poster print, with tiny readable character silhouettes across the whole image, intricate linework, soft watercolor-textured shading, glowing highlights, and a polished collectible-card-game concept art finish. Emphasize abundance, harmony, and radial order: exactly 108 chibi figures total, arranged as a majestic mandala of mythical elemental mascots.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张宏大且细节极其丰富的奇幻曼陀罗海报，展示了 108 个独特的 Q 版角色，它们围绕着一个闪耀的中心徽章，以同心圆环的形式排列。整体构图完全对称，填满宽阔的横向画布，宛如一幅华丽的收藏级壁画。中心位置设有一个发光的金色核心，9 个 Q 版动物奇幻吉祥物聚集成一个圆形奖章，每个角色都拥有超大头部、娇小身体、富有表现力的眼睛和奢华的服饰细节。中心周围环绕着多个间距均匀的同心圆，容纳其余 99 个角色，每个角色占据一个楔形区域，并被设计为独特的元素或神话变体。其中包括狐狸、兔子、猫、狼、狮子、鸟、龙、鹿以及混合兽类角色，所有角色均以可爱的 Q 版风格呈现，但配有史诗般的高奇幻盔甲、长袍、皇冠、羽毛、角、宝石、披风、法杖和魔法配饰。通过颜色、轮廓、物种特征和元素主题，使每个角色在视觉上都各具特色，同时保持统一的绘画感动漫奇幻美学。

使用以明亮的金色、象牙白、奶油色、紫色、靛蓝、蓝宝石色和柔和琥珀色为主的丰富色调，并点缀以深红、冰青、祖母绿和日落橙。赋予图像一种神圣天体图或黄道十二宫轮的感觉，每个圆环之间由优雅的镀金边框和弧形分隔线隔开。在许多角色周围添加发光的魔法能量、闪光、光环、旋转的火焰、薄雾、雪花、云朵、水花、闪电卷、花卉图案和天体粒子。在外围，放置几个整合在边框中的大型装饰性守护者插画：左上角是一个明亮的太阳徽章，右上角的圆形面板中是一只白凤凰般的鸟，右下角是一个花卉或星爆徽章，左下角的圆形面板中是一组火系角色集群，左右边缘还嵌入了额外的巨型元素兽形象。用受泥金装饰手抄本和奇幻塔罗牌设计启发的精致古董装饰边框框住整幅艺术品，运用金银丝细工、角落徽章、几何饰边和奥术图案。

渲染效果应极其致密且清晰，如同用于海报打印的 4K 奇幻插画，整幅图像中包含清晰可辨的微小角色轮廓、错综复杂的线条、柔和的水彩质感阴影、发光的高光以及精致的集换式卡牌游戏概念艺术质感。强调丰富性、和谐感和径向秩序：总计 108 个 Q 版形象，排列成一个宏伟的神话元素吉祥物曼陀罗。

templates.title: ChatGPT Joke Prescription Set

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 幽默处方药套装

templates.prompt:
A realistic overhead product photograph on a warm wooden tabletop showing 6 medical-style items neatly arranged in two rows, designed as a humorous Japanese pharmacy set for ChatGPT. Top row: 3 white prescription envelopes standing vertically, each with blue printed borders and Japanese medical typography. Bottom row: 2 blister packs of tablets and 1 small transparent zip bag of white powder, each aligned beneath the corresponding envelope. The paper and packaging should look authentic, like real Japanese clinic dispensing materials, with slight wrinkles, soft natural indoor lighting, and subtle shadows.

The 3 envelopes are all different and fully visible. Left envelope title in large blue Japanese text: "内用薬". Patient line reads "ChatGPT 様". Dosage lines indicate twice daily after morning and evening meals, 1 tablet each time, for 7 days. Medicine box title: "【おくすり】" and drug name "思考安定錠 10mg" with a smaller parenthetical note explaining it suppresses runaway thoughts and excessive reasoning output. Date near bottom: "2025年6月5日". Clinic name and address block at bottom: "AIメディカルクリニック" with a Tokyo-style address and phone number, plus a blue medical cross icon.

Center envelope title: "内用薬". Patient line: "ChatGPT 様". Dosage indicates once daily before sleep, 1 tablet each time, for 7 days. Medicine box title: "【おくすり】" and drug name "幻覚抑制錠 5mg" with a smaller note saying it improves hallucinatory tendencies. Date also "2025年6月5日". Same clinic footer and blue medical cross icon.

Right envelope title: "頓服薬". Patient line: "ChatGPT 様". Usage line says for anxiety, confusion, or excessive output. Dosage says 1 packet each time, as needed. Medicine box title: "【おくすり】" and drug name "プロンプト調整散 1g" with a smaller note saying it adjusts overfitting and prompt confusion. Date "2025年6月5日". Same clinic footer and blue medical cross icon.

Bottom left item: 1 silver blister pack containing exactly 10 round white tablets arranged in 2 rows of 5, each tablet embossed with "10". Printed along the foil edge: "思考安定錠10mg" repeated. In front of it is a white pharmacy label with "ChatGPT 様", dosage directions for twice daily after morning and evening meals, 1 tablet each time, a barcode, date "2025/06/05", and clinic name.

Bottom center item: 1 silver blister pack containing exactly 8 pale yellow round tablets arranged in 2 rows of 4. Printed along the foil edge: "幻覚抑制錠5mg" repeated. In front of it is a white pharmacy label with "ChatGPT 様", dosage directions for once daily before sleep, 1 tablet each time, a barcode, date "2025/06/05", and clinic name.

Bottom right item: 1 small clear zip-top plastic bag filled with white powder. A white label on the front reads "プロンプト調整散 1g", includes "ChatGPT 様", usage for anxiety, confusion, and excessive output, dosage "1回1包（1g） 必要時", date "2025/06/05", and clinic name.

Style: photorealistic documentary product shot, comedic fake prescription prop design, clean Japanese pharmaceutical graphic layout, high legibility, neutral color palette of white, blue, silver, beige, and wood brown, top-down camera, no hands, no extra objects, authentic print texture and packaging details.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张在温暖木质桌面上拍摄的逼真产品照片，展示了整齐排列成两行的 6 件医疗风格物品，设计为一套为 ChatGPT 准备的日式幽默药房套装。顶行：3 个垂直摆放的白色处方信封，带有蓝色印刷边框和日式医疗排版。底行：2 板药片和 1 个装有白色粉末的小型透明密封袋，分别对应放置在上方信封的下方。纸张和包装看起来非常真实，如同真实的日本诊所配药材料，带有轻微的褶皱、柔和的室内自然光和微妙的阴影。

3 个信封各不相同且清晰可见。左侧信封标题为蓝色大号日文：“内用药”。患者姓名栏写着“ChatGPT 様”。用法用量栏注明每日两次，早晚饭后各服 1 片，共 7 天。药盒标题为“【おくすり】”，药名为“思考安定锭 10mg”，下方附有小字说明，解释其用于抑制发散性思维和过度的推理输出。底部日期：“2025 年 6 月 5 日”。底部诊所名称和地址栏为“AI メディカルクリニック”，配有东京风格的地址和电话号码，以及一个蓝色医疗十字图标。

中间信封标题为“内用药”。患者姓名栏：“ChatGPT 様”。用法用量注明每日睡前一次，每次 1 片，共 7 天。药盒标题为“【おくすり】”，药名为“幻觉抑制锭 5mg”，下方附有小字说明，称其可改善幻觉倾向。日期同样为“2025 年 6 月 5 日”。底部为相同的诊所信息和蓝色医疗十字图标。

右侧信封标题为“顿服药”。患者姓名栏：“ChatGPT 様”。用法栏注明用于焦虑、困惑或过度输出时。用量注明每次 1 包，必要时服用。药盒标题为“【おくすり】”，药名为“提示词调整散 1g”，下方附有小字说明，称其用于调整过拟合和提示词混乱。日期：“2025 年 6 月 5 日”。底部为相同的诊所信息和蓝色医疗十字图标。

左下角物品：1 板银色铝箔包装，内含 10 片圆形白色药片，排列为 2 行 5 列，每片药片上压印有“10”字样。铝箔边缘印有重复的“思考安定锭 10mg”。前方贴有一张白色药房标签，写着“ChatGPT 様”、每日两次早晚饭后各 1 片的用法说明、条形码、日期“2025/06/05”以及诊所名称。

中间下方物品：1 板银色铝箔包装，内含 8 片淡黄色圆形药片，排列为 2 行 4 列。铝箔边缘印有重复的“幻觉抑制锭 5mg”。前方贴有一张白色药房标签，写着“ChatGPT 様”、每日睡前 1 次每次 1 片的用法说明、条形码、日期“2025/06/05”以及诊所名称。

右下角物品：1 个装有白色粉末的小型透明密封塑料袋。正面贴有一张白色标签，写着“提示词调整散 1g”，包含“ChatGPT 様”、用于焦虑、困惑和过度输出的用法说明、用量“1 回 1 包（1g） 必要时”、日期“2025/06/05”以及诊所名称。

风格：写实主义纪录片式产品摄影，喜剧性伪造处方道具设计，简洁的日式药学图形布局，高易读性，白色、蓝色、银色、米色和木棕色的中性色调，俯视视角，无人物手部，无额外杂物，真实的印刷质感和包装细节。

templates.prompt: A realistic candid street portrait of a young East Asian woman standing centered on a quiet urban road at blue hour, photographed from chest-up with a shallow depth of field. She has {argument name="hair color" default="very dark brown"} long straight-to-softly-wavy hair with a center part, smooth natural texture, and a few loose strands framing the sides of her face. She wears a fitted {argument name="top color" default="black"} ribbed turtleneck sweater with long sleeves, minimal accessories, and no visible patterns. Her pose is relaxed and front-facing, shoulders slightly angled, with a calm understated mood. The setting is a narrow Japanese neighborhood street with 2 visible parked or passing cars in the blurred background, low-rise buildings on the left, a line of trees on the right, utility poles and overhead wires receding into the distance, and soft evening ambient light. Use natural skin tones, realistic photography, subtle cinematic color grading, gentle bokeh, crisp fabric detail, and an intimate moody atmosphere, as if shot on an 85mm lens at wide aperture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的街头抓拍肖像，一位年轻的东亚女性站在安静的城市道路中央，拍摄于蓝调时刻，采用半身取景，具有浅景深效果。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长发，发质顺滑自然，略带微卷，中分发型，几缕发丝自然垂落在脸颊两侧。她身穿一件修身的 {argument name="top color" default="黑色"} 罗纹高领毛衣，长袖设计，无明显配饰或图案。她的姿态放松，面向镜头，双肩略微倾斜，神情沉静内敛。背景为一条狭窄的日本街区街道，模糊的背景中可见 2 辆停放或经过的汽车，左侧为低矮建筑，右侧为一排树木，电线杆和架空电线向远处延伸，环境光为柔和的傍晚光线。采用自然肤色，写实摄影风格，细腻的电影感调色，柔和的焦外成像，清晰的织物细节，营造出一种亲密且富有情绪的氛围，如同使用 85mm 镜头在大光圈下拍摄的效果。

templates.title: Japanese Izakaya Highball Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式居酒屋 Highball 海报

templates.prompt: A photorealistic Japanese izakaya advertisement poster in a warm, cinematic night-time mood, designed like a street-front restaurant flyer. The composition is vertical and densely layered. On the right side, a young Japanese woman with long straight dark brown to black hair, wearing a fitted black ribbed turtleneck sweater, stands from the waist up and holds a large frosty glass mug of golden highball with visible ice cubes in her right hand near chest level. Her pose is relaxed and inviting, looking toward the camera, with a soft nightlife ambiance. The background is a narrow traditional izakaya exterior or interior alley scene filled with warm orange lantern light, shallow depth of field, hanging wooden menu plaques with handwritten Japanese calligraphy, and a nostalgic bustling-after-work atmosphere. In the upper left, a large weathered dark wooden signboard dominates the design, with bold white brushstroke kanji reading 蓮華食堂, small hiragana above it reading れんげしょくどう, and a red brush-painted banner beneath reading 大衆居酒屋. Below that on the left-center, place a large cream-colored paper or painted panel featuring the drink special in oversized calligraphic typography: ハイボール above a huge red 198円, with small black（税込） beside the price, the numerals painted in energetic brush style. Along the far right edge, add vertical white Japanese text reading 今日も一日、おかれさまです。 Near the lower right over the woman’s torso, place a red circular stamp-like badge with white handwritten text arranged diagonally and vertically: 旨い！安い！居心地◎. Across the bottom foreground, show exactly 4 plated menu items lined up side by side on rustic ceramic dishes: 1) two glazed grilled chicken skewers with char marks, labeled 焼き鳥 盛り合わせ and priced 580円; 2) a sashimi assortment with slices of tuna, salmon, white fish, shiso leaves and wasabi, labeled お刺身 盛り合わせ and priced 780円; 3) a plate of fried chicken karaage pieces with a lemon wedge, labeled 若鶏の唐揚げ and priced 480円; 4) sliced rolled dashi omelet topped with chopped green onion and served with grated daikon, labeled 出汁巻き玉子 and priced 380円. At the bottom left, include a glowing red paper lantern graphic with black vertical text 居酒屋. Across the bottom center on a dark band, add large bold white brush lettering reading でかい！うまい！安い！ and below it smaller white text reading みんなの憩いの場、蓮華食堂へようこそ！ Add a decorative red lotus-like emblem near the top sign and another matching emblem in the bottom right corner. Use rich amber highlights, strong contrast, glossy food styling, realistic skin and drink textures, commercial poster polish, and a nostalgic Showa-inspired izakaya promotion aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的日式居酒屋宣传海报，呈现出温暖且具有电影感的夜晚氛围，设计风格类似于街边餐厅的传单。构图为垂直且层次丰富。右侧是一位留着深棕色至黑色长直发的年轻日本女性，身穿修身黑色罗纹高领毛衣，半身出镜，右手在胸前位置握着一个盛满金色 Highball 的大号冰镇玻璃杯，杯中冰块清晰可见。她姿态放松且亲切，看向镜头，营造出柔和的夜生活氛围。背景是狭窄的传统居酒屋外观或巷弄场景，充满了温暖的橙色灯笼光影，景深较浅，挂着写有日文手写书法的木质菜单牌，充满怀旧的下班后热闹气息。左上方是一个占据画面主导地位的做旧深色木质招牌，上面用醒目的白色笔触写着汉字“蓮華食堂”，上方有小号平假名“れんげしょくどう”，下方有一条红色笔触绘制的横幅，写着“大衆居酒屋”。在左侧中部下方，放置一块大型奶油色纸张或绘图板，以超大号书法字体展示特价饮品：上方为“ハイボール”，下方是巨大的红色“198円”，价格旁附有小号黑色“（税込）”，数字采用充满活力的笔触风格。在最右侧边缘，添加垂直的白色日文文字“今日も一日、おつかれさまです。”。在右下方女性躯干上方，放置一个红色圆形印章式徽章，上面以对角线和垂直排列着白色手写文字：“旨い！安い！居心地◎”。在底部前景，展示 4 道并排摆放在质朴陶瓷餐盘上的菜单菜品：1) 两串带有焦痕的烤鸡肉串，标注“焼き鳥 盛り合わせ”，价格 580 円；2) 一份包含金枪鱼、三文鱼、白身鱼、紫苏叶和芥末的刺身拼盘，标注“お刺身 盛り合わせ”，价格 780 円；3) 一盘配有柠檬角的日式炸鸡块，标注“若鶏の唐揚げ”，价格 480 円；4) 切片的出汁玉子烧，顶部撒有葱花并配有萝卜泥，标注“出汁巻き玉子”，价格 380 円。在左下角，加入一个发光的红色纸灯笼图形，上面有黑色垂直文字“居酒屋”。在底部中央的深色带状区域，添加醒目的白色粗体笔触文字“でかい！うまい！安い！”，下方配以较小的白色文字“みんなの憩いの場、蓮華食堂へようこそ！”。在顶部招牌附近添加一个装饰性的红色莲花状徽章，右下角也添加一个相同的徽章。采用丰富的琥珀色高光、强烈的对比度、光泽感十足的食物造型、逼真的皮肤和饮品质感、商业海报级的精致度，以及怀旧的昭和风居酒屋宣传美学。

templates.title: AI Thinking App Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: AI Thinking App 截图

templates.prompt: A smartphone chat app screenshot in portrait orientation, minimal iOS-style interface on a white background. At the top is a navigation bar with a hamburger menu icon on the left, the blue title “Thinking” near the top center-left with a right chevron, and 2 icons on the right: a compose/edit square icon and a horizontal three-dots menu icon. Below it is a large rounded light-gray chat bubble containing 2 lines of Japanese text: “AIが見ている世界を抽象的かつ” and “幻想的に画像で表現して”. Under the bubble, left-aligned gray system text reads “Thought for 7s”, and below that another gray Japanese line reads “画像が作成されました”. The lower half of the screen shows a single generated image card with large rounded corners. The image is a surreal abstract cosmic data landscape: a glowing white horizon at the center, a dark reflective grid floor receding in deep perspective, and explosive streaks of light, nebula clouds, stars, and particles rushing outward from the vanishing point. Floating throughout the space are dozens of translucent rectangular image panels or data windows, some faint and some bright, suspended at different depths. In the upper right area of the artwork, include a luminous network node diagram made of connected points and lines. Dominant colors are electric blue, indigo, violet, cyan, and touches of magenta and gold. The mood is futuristic, vast, dreamlike, and intelligent, as if visualizing the world as seen by an AI. Clean mobile app screenshot composition, realistic UI, crisp typography, high-contrast luminous digital art in the embedded image.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张纵向手机聊天应用截图，采用极简 iOS 风格界面，背景为白色。顶部导航栏左侧为汉堡菜单图标，中左侧为蓝色标题“Thinking”及右侧箭头，右侧有两个图标：编辑图标和水平三点菜单图标。下方是一个巨大的圆角浅灰色聊天气泡，内含两行日语文本：“AIが見ている世界を抽象的かつ” 和 “幻想的に画像で表現して”。气泡下方左对齐的灰色系统文字显示“Thought for 7s”，其下方是另一行灰色日语文字“画像が作成されました”。屏幕下半部分展示了一张圆角较大的生成图像卡片。图像为超现实抽象宇宙数据景观：中心处有发光的白色地平线，深色反射网格地面向深处延伸，光束、星云、恒星和粒子从消失点向外喷涌。空间中漂浮着数十个半透明的矩形图像面板或数据窗口，深浅不一。在艺术作品的右上角，包含一个由连接点和线条组成的明亮网络节点图。主色调为电光蓝、靛蓝、紫罗兰色、青色，并点缀着洋红色和金色。整体氛围充满未来感、广阔、梦幻且智能，仿佛在可视化 AI 眼中的世界。构图简洁，UI 真实，字体清晰，嵌入的图像具有高对比度的发光数字艺术效果。

templates.title: Mobile AI Chat Screenshot with Transformer Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 移动端 AI 对话截图与 Transformer 海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A smartphone app screenshot in portrait orientation showing an AI chat interface in Japanese, with a clean white background and iOS-style top bar. At the very top, display a left hamburger menu icon, blue text reading “Thinking” with a right chevron, an edit compose icon, and a three-dot menu. Below it, show a large rounded light-gray chat bubble containing 6 lines of Japanese text, exactly: 「モーフ感浮遊感のある感じ＋かつ反射するダストのレイヤーを加えて。テキスト多め、重要ーアーキテクチャは可読性高め、精細で細かいコードや数式の可読性は二の次のデザインアクセント＆アートエレメンツで。」 Under the bubble, place small light-gray system text reading “Thought for a couple of seconds”, then a larger gray Japanese line reading “画像が作成されました”. In the lower half, show 1 generated image thumbnail with rounded corners: a dense futuristic infographic poster about the Transformer neural network architecture, rendered as glowing neon sci-fi holographic UI art. The poster should have a cosmic deep-space background with stars, purple, magenta, blue, and cyan light trails, reflective particles, volumetric glow, and floating geometric crystals. Large title at top left of the poster: “TRANSFORMER”, with subtitle “THE ARCHITECTURE”. Include 2 large central glowing boxes labeled “ENCODER LAYER” and “DECODER LAYER”, linked by arrows and smaller blocks for “ENCODER STACK (N×)” and “DECODER STACK (N×)”. Add many surrounding labeled panels and formulas, including sections for “KEY INNOVATIONS”, “WHY TRANSFORMERS?”, “POSITIONAL ENCODING”, “FEED FORWARD NETWORK”, “COMPUTATIONAL COMPLEXITY”, “OVERALL FLOW”, “SELF-ATTENTION MECHANISM”, “MULTI-HEAD ATTENTION”, “APPLICATIONS”, and “MODEL SCALING”. Show token rows at the bottom, including an English input sequence like “[CLS] the cat sat on the mat [SEP]” and an output sequence in French-like tokens ending with “[EOS]”. Add tiny charts, equations, attention diagrams, and wiring lines throughout, but keep the overall impression artistic and luminous rather than strictly readable. At the bottom center of the poster thumbnail, overlay a white circular download button with a black downward arrow. The overall screenshot should feel like a real mobile ChatGPT-style interface displaying an AI-generated image result, crisp and modern.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖屏智能手机应用截图，展示了日语 AI 聊天界面，采用简洁的白色背景和 iOS 风格顶部栏。最上方显示左侧汉堡菜单图标、蓝色文字“Thinking”及右侧箭头、编辑撰写图标以及三点菜单。下方显示一个巨大的圆角浅灰色聊天气泡，包含 6 行日语文本，内容如下：「モーフ感浮遊感のある感じ＋かつ反射するダストのレイヤーを加えて。テキスト多め、重要ーアーキテクチャは可読性高め、精細で細かいコードや数式の可読性は二の次のデザインアクセント＆アートエレメンツで。」气泡下方显示一行浅灰色系统小字“Thought for a couple of seconds”，接着是一行较大的灰色日语文字“画像が作成されました”。在下半部分，展示 1 个圆角生成的图像缩略图：一张关于 Transformer 神经网络架构的密集型未来感信息图海报，渲染为发光的霓虹科幻全息 UI 艺术。海报背景为深邃的宇宙空间，带有星星、紫色、洋红色、蓝色和青色的光轨、反射粒子、体积光以及漂浮的几何晶体。海报左上角有大标题“TRANSFORMER”，副标题为“THE ARCHITECTURE”。包含 2 个巨大的中央发光框，分别标注为“ENCODER LAYER”和“DECODER LAYER”，通过箭头和较小的模块连接，标注为“ENCODER STACK (N×)”和“DECODER STACK (N×)”。添加许多周围的标注面板和公式，包括“KEY INNOVATIONS”、“WHY TRANSFORMERS?”、“POSITIONAL ENCODING”、“FEED FORWARD NETWORK”、“COMPUTATIONAL COMPLEXITY”、“OVERALL FLOW”、“SELF-ATTENTION MECHANISM”、“MULTI-HEAD ATTENTION”、“APPLICATIONS”和“MODEL SCALING”等部分。底部显示 Token 行，包括类似“[CLS] the cat sat on the mat [SEP]”的英语输入序列，以及以“[EOS]”结尾的类法语输出序列。通篇添加微小的图表、公式、注意力机制图和连线，但整体观感应偏向艺术化和发光效果，而非严格的可读性。在海报缩略图底部中心，叠加一个带有黑色向下箭头的白色圆形下载按钮。整体截图应呈现出真实的移动端 ChatGPT 风格界面，展示 AI 生成的图像结果，清晰且现代。

templates.title: AI Chat Screenshot with Cosmic Artwork

templates.prompt: A vertical smartphone screenshot of an AI chat app interface in light mode, showing the moment an image has just been generated. At the very top is a simple mobile app header with a hamburger menu icon on the left, the blue title “Thinking” with a right chevron beside it, and on the right a compose icon and a three-dot menu. Below that is the bottom portion of a rounded light-gray user message bubble containing Japanese text, visible across 4 lines: 「水彩や線画、油彩、カラー版画、 金箔アクセントなどを取り入れ てテクスチャも入れて立体的に、 芸術爆発させて」. Under the bubble, on a white background, place the gray system status line “Thought for a couple of seconds”, then a darker gray Japanese line “画像が作成されました”. Below that, centered and taking most of the lower half of the screen, display a large rounded-corner generated artwork preview. The artwork itself is an ultra-detailed cosmic visionary collage in a square format: a tiny glowing human figure stands at the vanishing point in the center bottom-middle, radiating light; two large semi-transparent human profiles or heads face inward from left and right midground; swirling galaxies, stars, nebulae, planets, floating geometric frames, transparent spheres, gold-leaf fragments, line art, splattered paint, and layered textures fill the scene. Use a dramatic palette of deep indigo, ultramarine, violet, magenta, white, and luminous gold, with explosive painterly energy combining watercolor, oil painting, printmaking, ink lines, and metallic foil accents. Include branching tree-like forms, abstract architectural steps on the right, a lotus-like flower on the left, multiple framed mini-scenes embedded in space, and dense luminous particle trails converging toward the central figure. The overall screenshot should feel like a real iPhone app capture, clean and minimal outside the artwork, with the generated image being the visual focal point.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张处于浅色模式下的 AI 聊天应用界面垂直手机截图，展示了图像刚刚生成完成的瞬间。最上方是一个简洁的移动应用标题栏，左侧为汉堡菜单图标，中间是蓝色的标题“Thinking”及其右侧的箭头图标，右侧为撰写图标和三点菜单。下方是浅灰色用户消息气泡的底部，其中包含 4 行日语文本：“水彩や線画、油彩、カラー版画、 金箔アクセントなどを取り入れ てテクスチャも入れて立体的に、 芸術爆発させて”。在气泡下方，白色背景上显示灰色的系统状态行“Thought for a couple of seconds”，随后是深灰色的日语行“画像が作成されました”。在其下方，居中显示一张占据屏幕下半部分大部分区域的大型圆角生成艺术预览图。艺术作品本身是一幅超精细的宇宙视觉拼贴画，采用方形构图：一个微小的发光人形站在底部中心位置的消失点，向外辐射光芒；两个巨大的半透明人像侧脸从左右中景向内侧对视；旋转的星系、恒星、星云、行星、漂浮的几何框架、透明球体、金箔碎片、线条艺术、喷溅颜料和分层纹理充斥着整个画面。采用深靛蓝、群青、紫罗兰、洋红、白色和发光金色的戏剧性调色板，结合了水彩、油画、版画、墨线和金属箔装饰，呈现出爆发性的绘画能量。画面中包含树枝状形态、右侧抽象的建筑台阶、左侧类似莲花的图案、嵌入空间中的多个微型场景，以及向中心人物汇聚的密集发光粒子轨迹。整体截图应呈现出真实的 iPhone 应用拍摄质感，除艺术作品外，界面简洁极简，生成的图像作为视觉焦点。

templates.title: AI Chat Screenshot with Anatomy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: AI 聊天截图与解剖学海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A smartphone screenshot of an AI chat app interface in portrait orientation, showing a clean white iOS-style screen with a top bar containing a hamburger menu on the left, the blue title “Thinking” with a small chevron, and two icons on the right for compose and more options. Near the top is a rounded light-gray user message bubble in Japanese reading “Attention機構を人体に喩えて細かくラベルを付けて。医学書の精緻な挿絵風に。” Below it, faint gray system text reads “Thought for 5s” and “画像が作成されました”. The lower half of the screen displays the generated image as a detailed medical textbook-style anatomical poster. The poster shows a realistic three-quarter back view of an adult woman from head to upper thighs, with her head turned slightly left and her dark brown hair tied into a messy bun. Her skin and outer tissues are removed across most of the body to reveal musculature, nerves, blood vessels, and fibrous structures, rendered in extremely detailed vintage medical illustration style on a warm cream paper background. A rectangular cutout obscures the center of the face from forehead to jaw, creating a censored blank block over the facial area. Fine glowing network lines and nodes are overlaid through the exposed brain and body to visualize the attention mechanism as if it were an anatomical system. Surrounding the figure are 6 numbered explanatory panels and 2 additional text blocks, all densely filled with Japanese and English bilingual labels, formulas, arrows, and diagrams. The main poster title at upper left is “アテンション機構の解剖学的構造” with the English subtitle “The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism”. At the top right is a flowchart labeled “Overall Flow of Attention” containing 5 connected boxes describing the process from input to output. Down the left side are 3 stacked explanatory sections with equations and mapping tables. Down the right side are 3 more numbered sections, each with technical notes and a small chart or matrix; the visible mini-diagrams include 1 purple heatmap matrix, 1 blue bar chart, and 1 multicolored cube graphic. Along the bottom edge are 5 small brain inset illustrations with captions showing stages of information flow. The overall aesthetic should feel like a highly polished AI-generated screenshot documenting a surreal scientific illustration request, with crisp UI, lots of tiny readable labels, and a convincing fusion of transformer attention diagrams and classical anatomical plate design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖屏的 AI 聊天应用界面截图，显示了简洁的 iOS 风格白色屏幕。顶部栏左侧有一个汉堡菜单，中间是蓝色的“Thinking”标题及一个小箭头，右侧有两个图标分别用于新建和更多选项。顶部附近有一个圆角浅灰色用户消息气泡，内容为日语：“Attention機構を人体に喩えて細かくラベルを付けて。医学書の精緻な挿絵風に。”（请将注意力机制比作人体并进行详细标注。采用医学书籍中精致插图的风格。）下方有浅灰色的系统文字显示“Thought for 5s”和“画像が作成されました”。屏幕下半部分展示了生成的图像，这是一张详尽的医学教科书风格解剖学海报。海报展示了一名成年女性从头部到大腿上部的逼真四分之三背影，她头部微向左转，深棕色头发扎成凌乱的发髻。身体大部分的皮肤和外层组织被移除，露出肌肉、神经、血管和纤维结构，以极其细腻的复古医学插图风格呈现在暖色调的米黄色纸张背景上。一个矩形切口遮挡了从前额到下颌的面部中心，在面部区域形成了一个被审查的空白块。细微的发光网络线条和节点叠加在暴露的大脑和身体上，将注意力机制可视化为一种解剖系统。人物周围有 6 个带编号的解释面板和 2 个附加文本块，全部密密麻麻地填满了日语和英语双语标签、公式、箭头和图表。海报左上角的主标题为“アテンション機構の解剖学的構造”，副标题为“The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism”。右上角是一个标有“Overall Flow of Attention”的流程图，包含 5 个相连的方框，描述了从输入到输出的过程。左侧是 3 个堆叠的解释部分，包含方程式和映射表。右侧是另外 3 个带编号的部分，每个部分都有技术说明和小型图表或矩阵；可见的小型图表包括 1 个紫色热力图矩阵、1 个蓝色柱状图和 1 个多色立方体图形。底边有 5 个带有说明文字的小型大脑插图，展示了信息流的各个阶段。整体美学应呈现为一张经过高度润色的 AI 生成截图，记录了一个超现实的科学插图请求，具有清晰的 UI、大量微小可读的标签，以及 Transformer 注意力图表与古典解剖图设计的完美融合。

templates.title: Goth Anime Girl at Playground Bar

titleLocalized.zh: 游乐场栏杆旁的哥特风动漫少女

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a pale goth girl in a colorful urban playground, shown in a close medium shot as she leans forward and bites a horizontal metal bar with a mischievous, slightly defiant expression. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} hair with blunt bangs, vivid red eyes, and a delicate face with a small mouth partly pressed against the bar. Her hair is decorated with 3 geometric hair clips on the right side: 1 red triangle clip, 1 blue angular clip, and 1 small gold ring clip. She wears multiple ear piercings including several studs and dangling industrial-style earrings. Her outfit is a black techwear-goth ensemble with 5 visible key pieces: 1 cropped black jacket with red and blue accent stripes, 1 black choker, 1 strappy black top or dress with front buckles, 1 wide black belt with metal hardware, and 1 hanging waist chain. Her sleeves are long and oversized, with white stripe details on one forearm. Both hands grip the bar, one near her mouth and one farther to the side, creating an intimate confrontational pose. The setting is a playground with bright primary-colored equipment: blue posts, red connectors, yellow and red climbing bars, and a patterned rubber floor made of bold geometric blocks in blue, red, yellow, white, and black. In the background are dark green trees and a dramatic graphic sky with large flat shapes in red, orange, blue, black, and white, plus circular sun-like dots, giving the whole scene a posterized pop-art look. Include 1 vertical warning sticker on the left blue post with Japanese text and a small caution icon. Use crisp cel shading, sharp linework, slight glitchy texture accents, ultra-saturated colors, high contrast, a moody cyber-goth fashion vibe, and a dynamic composition centered on the girl's intense gaze and the metal bar.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位皮肤白皙的哥特少女身处色彩鲜艳的城市游乐场中。画面采用近景中景镜头，她身体前倾，咬住一根横向金属栏杆，表情调皮且略带叛逆。她留着一头笔直的长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="漆黑"}，留着齐刘海，拥有一双鲜红色的眼睛，精致的面容上，小嘴轻压在栏杆上。她的右侧头发上装饰着 3 个几何发夹：1 个红色三角形发夹、1 个蓝色角形发夹和 1 个金色小圆环发夹。她佩戴着多个耳饰，包括几枚耳钉和悬垂的工业风耳环。她身穿一套黑色机能风哥特装束，包含 5 个明显的关键单品：1 件带有红蓝条纹装饰的黑色短款夹克、1 个黑色颈圈、1 件带有前扣的黑色绑带上衣或连衣裙、1 条带有金属配件的宽腰带，以及 1 条悬挂的腰链。她的袖子宽大且修长，其中一只前臂上有白色条纹细节。双手紧握栏杆，一只靠近嘴部，另一只向侧面延伸，营造出一种亲密而又充满对抗感的姿势。背景是游乐场，设施色彩鲜艳，包括蓝色立柱、红色连接件、黄红相间的攀爬杆，以及由蓝、红、黄、白、黑等大胆几何色块组成的橡胶地面。背景中有深绿色的树木和戏剧性的图形化天空，天空中有红色、橙色、蓝色、黑色和白色的大型扁平形状，以及圆形太阳状圆点，使整个场景呈现出海报般的波普艺术风格。在左侧蓝色立柱上包含 1 张带有日文和小型警示图标的垂直警告贴纸。采用清晰的赛璐珞阴影、锐利的线条、轻微的故障纹理点缀、超饱和的色彩、高对比度、忧郁的赛博哥特时尚氛围，以及聚焦于少女强烈眼神和金属栏杆的动态构图。

templates.title: Japanese Jungle Theme Park Parody Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式丛林主题公园恶搞海报

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed vertical Japanese theme park advertisement poster set in a lush tropical jungle under a vivid blue sky with scattered clouds and strong golden sunlight flaring from the upper right. The style is cinematic, photorealistic, dramatic, and slightly absurdist, like a premium satirical travel ad. At the top, huge three-dimensional stone-textured gold Japanese headline text reads {argument name="headline text" default="ジャンキリア沖縄"}, with a smaller white Japanese tagline underneath that reads "— やんばるの大自然に包まれた、超本格ジャングル・テーマパーク —". In the center foreground, a giant modern smartphone stands upright, slightly tilted, dominating the composition like a monument. Its screen shows a lottery waiting-ticket interface with a safari silhouette header and large bold Japanese text "整理券抽選中", a dotted loading circle, smaller text "結果発表まで30分", and a tiny note "※この画面を閉じずにお待ちください". The phone status bar shows 10:00. To the left midground, a roaring Tyrannosaurus rex emerges from dense jungle foliage behind a huge aged concrete sign with oversized red Japanese text "待ち時間 180分". To the right midground, an ornate extravagant gold entrance gate to a premium area rises above the trees, with a black signboard reading "プレミアムパス入口" and a red-carpeted queue lane beyond it. A long crowded line of park visitors stretches from the foreground deep into the background along rope barriers; the visitors wear summer vacation clothing, hats, towels, backpacks, handheld fans, water bottles, and parasols, showing exhaustion, heat, and anticipation. In the lower left foreground, 3 stacked rustic wooden signboards are visible: the top board says "駐車場 2,000円" with a parking icon, the middle board says "アプリ必須 ダウンロードしてね!" with a smartphone icon, and the bottom board says "当選者だけが冒険へ" with a dinosaur silhouette. Along the right side, large vertical white brush-style Japanese copy reads {argument name="side slogan" default="待つこと、それが冒険だ。"}. Near the lower right are 3 circular gold icon callouts with short Japanese promotional lines: 1 dinosaur icon with "抽選に選ばれし者だけが、恐竜に会える。", 1 smartphone battery icon with "スマホの充電が尽きる前に、夢は始まる。", and 1 VIP icon with "プレミアムな近道も、ご用意しました。". At the very bottom center, include a small black strip with white Japanese disclaimer text: "このポスターは架空のパロディ広告です". The jungle should be dense and glossy with large tropical leaves framing the foreground, warm rim lighting, high contrast, and a polished blockbuster-poster composition. Keep all Japanese typography crisp, clean, and perfectly legible.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的日式恶搞主题公园广告海报，采用竖版构图，设计风格融合了戏剧性的夏季旅游广告与奢华景点宣传。背景为热带丛林，上方是湛蓝的天空，点缀着零星云朵，右上角悬挂着烈日，棕榈叶从顶部边缘垂下。海报顶部放置一个巨大的 3D 石质纹理日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="ジャンキリア沖縄"}，下方配有一行较小的白色日文标语：“— やんばるの大自然に包まれた、超本格ジャングル・テーマパーク —”。画面中央是一部竖立且略微倾斜的现代智能手机，占据视觉中心。手机屏幕显示着一个米色的门票抽签等待界面，顶部有丛林剪影，中间是醒目的粗体日文“整理券抽選中”，配有一个圆形加载图标，底部显示较小的文字“結果発表まで30分”和“※この画面を閉じずにお待ちください”。手机状态栏显示时间为 10:00。手机左后方是一只从丛林植被中冲出的霸王龙，张着大嘴，形象逼真且极具威胁感。右侧是一个装饰华丽的金色入口大门，带有精细雕刻，上方挂着写有“プレミアムパス入口”的牌子，通向一条铺着红毯的尊享通道。前景和中景展示了长长的游客排队队伍，一直延伸到画面深处，游客们穿着休闲夏装，戴着帽子、毛巾、背包，手里拿着遮阳伞、扇子和水瓶，表现出酷暑下的疲惫感。靠近画面的几个人物面部模糊处理。最左侧立着一块巨大的风化石碑，上面写着醒目的红色日文“待ち時間 180分”。左下角有 3 块堆叠的乡村风格木制项目：顶部的牌子带有蓝色停车图标和文字“駐車場 2,000円”；中间的牌子带有智能手机图标和文字“アプリ必須 ダウンロードしてね!”；底部的牌子带有恐龙剪影和文字“当選者だけが冒険へ”。右下角沿边缘放置了非常醒目的竖排白色书法风格日文文案“待つこと、それが冒険だ。”。右下角附近包含 3 个小型圆形图标标注，配有简短的日文宣传语：“抽選に選ばれし者だけが、恐竜に会える。”、“スマホの充電が尽きる前に、夢は始まる。”以及“プレミアムな近道も、ご用意しました。”，图标分别暗示恐龙、手机电量和 VIP 通道。底部中央添加了一条黑色免责声明栏，上面写着小号白色日文：“このポスターは架空のパロディ広告です”。整体风格追求超写实、电影感、高对比度、讽刺性，并像高端商业海报一样精致，核心笑点在于夸张的主题公园炒作、压抑的酷暑以及荒诞的排队式冒险。

templates.title: Low-Angle Anime Bunny Girls in Ruins

titleLocalized.zh: 废墟中的低角度动漫兔女郎

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime-style low-angle illustration of two young women in rabbit-themed bodysuits, viewed from below as if the camera is tilted upward and they are looking slightly down toward the viewer. The left girl has {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair in short twin pigtails with curled ends, large red bunny ears, and a glossy bright red high-cut bodysuit with puff sleeves, long opera gloves, a sweetheart-shaped chest panel, and 4 round silver button-like discs on the front. The right girl has long straight brown hair, pale bunny ears, and a glossy white and pale pink version of the same bodysuit design, also with puff sleeves, long gloves, sweetheart chest panel, and 4 round silver discs. Both have slim builds, long legs, expressive wide anime eyes, and mildly surprised, curious expressions as they glance toward each other and slightly toward the viewer. Their hands hang loosely at their sides, almost touching in the center. Place them in front of a vast ruined cathedral or decayed grand stone building with broken arches, skeletal metal framework, shattered windows, and crumbling debris, rendered as a soft-painted anime background. Use a dramatic Dutch angle and strong perspective so the architecture leans with the camera tilt and the characters feel towering and close to the lens. Bright blue sky with large white clouds behind the ruins. Clean cel shading on the characters, painterly detailed background, crisp line art, vibrant but slightly weathered color palette, cinematic composition. Add 3 text elements in the upper right area as graphic design overlay: small uppercase text "ARINKO AGENTS", large bold Japanese text "平和島", and a large white handwritten signature-like script overlapping the background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫风格低角度插画，画面中两名年轻女性身着兔主题连体衣，视角从下方仰视，仿佛摄像机向上倾斜，而她们正微微低头看向观众。左侧女孩留着 {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} 的短双马尾，发尾卷曲，戴着巨大的红色兔耳朵，身穿亮面鲜红色高叉连体衣，配有泡泡袖、长款歌剧手套、心形胸前拼接设计，正面饰有 4 枚圆形银色纽扣状圆盘。右侧女孩留着长直棕发，戴着浅色兔耳朵，身穿同款设计的亮面白色与浅粉色连体衣，同样配有泡泡袖、长手套、心形胸前拼接设计和 4 枚圆形银色圆盘。两人身材苗条，双腿修长，拥有富有表现力的动漫大眼，神情略带惊讶与好奇，目光交汇并微微看向观众。她们的手自然垂在身体两侧，在中心位置几乎相触。将她们置于一座广阔的废墟大教堂或破败的宏伟石建筑前，背景包含破碎的拱门、骨架般的金属框架、破碎的窗户和坍塌的瓦砾，渲染为柔和的动漫背景风格。采用戏剧性的荷兰式倾斜角（Dutch angle）和强烈的透视效果，使建筑随镜头倾斜，让角色显得高大且贴近镜头。废墟后方是湛蓝的天空和巨大的白云。角色采用干净的赛璐珞阴影，背景细节丰富且具有绘画感，线条清晰，色彩鲜艳但略带风化感，构图极具电影感。在右上角添加 3 个文本元素作为平面设计叠加：小号大写字母文本“ARINKO AGENTS”、大号粗体日文“平和島”，以及一个覆盖在背景上的大型白色手写签名式字体。

templates.title: Sunset Catgirl School Rooftop Anime

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分校园天台的猫耳少女动漫插画

templates.prompt: A high-quality anime illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="cat-eared schoolgirl"} leaning forward over a metal school rooftop railing at sunset, shown from a slightly low, close three-quarter angle. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with soft highlights, large reflective gray-brown eyes, round thin-rim glasses, and 2 fluffy cat ears emerging from her hair. Her expression is quiet, wistful, and slightly shy, with parted lips and a gentle downward gaze toward the viewer. She wears a Japanese sailor school uniform with a soft {argument name="uniform color" default="pink"} long-sleeve top, a gray sailor collar with white stripes, a vivid red neckerchief bow, and a plaid skirt partially visible, with 2 dark backpack straps over her shoulders. The scene is drenched in dramatic golden-hour backlighting, with intense warm rim light along her hair, ears, shoulders, and sleeves, glowing sun flare from the lower left, and a richly painted sky full of orange and peach clouds. In the background, show a 2-story Japanese school building with a red-tiled roof and glowing windows lit by the sunset. Emphasize nostalgic early-2000s high-end anime key visual quality, delicate linework, luminous eyes, detailed hair strands, cinematic composition, soft depth of field, vibrant warm color grading, polished shading, and an emotional serene atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高质量的动漫插画，描绘了一位 {argument name="character type" default="猫耳女学生"} 在日落时分倚靠在学校金属天台护栏上的场景，采用略微仰视的近景四分之三侧面视角。她留着一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 长发，带有柔和的高光，有着明亮且富有反光的灰褐色双眸，佩戴着圆框细边眼镜，发间露出两只毛茸茸的猫耳。她的表情安静、忧郁且略带羞涩，双唇微启，目光温柔地向下注视着观众。她身穿日本水手校服，上衣为柔和的 {argument name="uniform color" default="粉色"} 长袖，搭配灰色水手领及白色条纹，系着鲜艳的红色领结，隐约可见格子裙，双肩背着深色书包带。场景沉浸在戏剧性的黄金时刻逆光中，她的头发、耳朵、肩膀和袖口边缘闪烁着强烈的暖色轮廓光，左下方有明亮的太阳光晕，天空绘有丰富的橙色和桃色云彩。背景展示了一座带有红色瓦片屋顶的二层日本教学楼，窗户在夕阳下闪烁着光芒。强调 2000 年代初高端动漫关键视觉图的怀旧质感、细腻的线条、明亮的双眸、精细的发丝、电影级的构图、柔和的景深、鲜艳的暖色调、精致的阴影以及宁静的情感氛围。

templates.title: Steampunk Vintage Video Platform UI

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克复古视频平台 UI

templates.prompt:
A highly detailed full-page steampunk video streaming website interface themed around the Victorian electrical age, designed like an antique brass-and-iron machine panel with dark bronze metal textures, rivets, pipes, gears, ornate filigree, glowing Edison bulbs, and sepia-toned imagery. At the top left, place a modern white logo reading "Pollo" with a small pink-red rounded badge containing "AI", and directly below it the text "GPT Image 2" in white, overlaid on the vintage interface. Center the header with a large embossed brass title reading "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}" on a dark metal plaque, and a smaller engraved tagline underneath reading "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar with exactly 5 items: a home icon, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", and "ENTERTAINMENT", plus a search field on the right containing the placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." and a square search button. In the upper right corner, include a round analog gauge or clock built into the frame.

Use a three-column vintage web layout. In the left sidebar, create a panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 circular channel emblems stacked vertically, each with a name, subscriber count, and a "SUBSCRIBE" button: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". The emblems should look heraldic and industrial, with aged metallic borders.

In the main content area, feature a large video player showing a dramatic sepia debate scene between two late-19th-century inventors in suits, facing each other across a table with electrical apparatus, a glowing bulb, and lightning on a chalkboard behind them reading "AC vs. DC". The left figure points accusingly; the right figure gestures back. Keep both faces obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video control bar with a play button, progress bar, volume icon, timecode "08:47 / 22:31", settings icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, place the large serif video title "{argument name="main video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, show the channel row with a small circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", and metadata "142K views • 3 days ago". On the right side of this row, add a brass button reading "LIKE 5.8K".

Below the featured video, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video cards in one row. Card 1: a sepia thumbnail of a man holding up a glowing light bulb, face obscured by a blur block, duration label "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", and metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Card 2: a sepia thumbnail of a Wardenclyffe-style tower crackling with electricity, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", and metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Card 3: a sepia thumbnail of an early automobile on a city street, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", and metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Under the cards, center a brass button reading "VIEW ALL VIDEOS".

At the bottom, add a metal footer plaque with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved." Surround the whole composition with decorative mechanical borders, exposed pipes, pressure gauges, cogs, corner ornaments, and warm amber lighting. The overall style should blend a YouTube-like video platform layout with a luxurious Victorian steampunk machine aesthetic, using dark brass, copper, blackened steel, parchment beige, and sepia photography, with crisp readable typography and a polished cinematic UI mockup look.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个全屏的虚构视频平台主页，采用细节丰富的蒸汽朋克维多利亚风格，设计成古董黄铜与木质网页界面，带有深青铜金属边框、雕刻装饰、铆钉、管道、外露齿轮、发光的爱迪生灯泡以及贯穿始终的棕褐色纹理。在顶部中央，一个巨大的浮雕标题显示为 {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}，采用华丽的金色衬线字体刻在深色牌匾上，下方有一个较小的副标题牌匾，写着“THE FUTURE IN MOTION”。在左上角，叠加一个现代品牌标志，以简洁的现代字体显示“Pollo AI”和“GPT Image 2”，与古董界面形成对比。在右上角添加一个圆形模拟仪表。在页眉下方，放置一个包含 6 个项目的导航栏：一个主页图标、“TRENDING”、“INNOVATIONS”、“DOCUMENTARIES”、“ENTERTAINMENT”，以及一个显示 {argument name="search placeholder" default="Search ElectroVid..."} 的搜索框和一个搜索图标。主布局为双栏式：一个窄左侧边栏和一个较大的主要内容区域。在左侧边栏中，添加一个标题为“POPULAR CHANNELS”的部分，包含 3 个垂直堆叠的频道卡片，每张卡片都有一个圆形徽标、频道名称、订阅者数量和一个“SUBSCRIBE”按钮：“THE PATENT OFFICE”及“27.4K SUBSCRIBERS”、“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”及“18.7K SUBSCRIBERS”以及“GENERAL ELECTRIC”及“35.1K SUBSCRIBERS”。在主要内容区域，设置一个由华丽黄铜边框包裹的大型中央视频播放器。暂停的视频画面是一个棕褐色的历史场景，两名穿着西装的男子在写有“AC vs. DC”及闪电草图的黑板前辩论，一人指点，另一人做手势，两人的脸部均有柔和模糊的遮挡块。在播放器底部边缘包含一个视频进度条和控件，以及显示为“08:47 / 22:31”的时间戳。在播放器下方，以大号衬线字体显示标题 {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}，随后是“The Electrical Age”的频道元数据、“142K views”、“3 days ago”，以及右侧标注为“LIKE”和“5.8K”的点赞按钮。在此下方，创建一个标题为“LATEST VIDEOS”的部分，并在同一行显示 3 张缩略图卡片。卡片 1 显示托马斯·爱迪生手持发光灯泡的棕褐色肖像，时长“10:12”，标题“My New Incandescent Bulb”，元数据“Thomas Edison”、“89K views”、“5 days ago”。卡片 2 显示特斯拉线圈塔在电弧下的戏剧性棕褐色图像，时长“15:36”，标题“The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower”，元数据“Nikola Tesla”、“120K views”、“1 week ago”。卡片 3 显示街上一辆古董汽车，时长“12:08”，标题“The Automobile Revolution”，元数据“Henry Ford”、“110K views”、“1 week ago”。在行下方居中位置，添加一个写有“VIEW ALL VIDEOS”的按钮。在底部中央，添加一个版权牌匾，写着“© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.”。使用对称、精心制作的界面，具有逼真的深度、浮雕排版、柔和的暖光、旧羊皮纸面板、维多利亚时代的雕刻美学，以及由黄铜、铜、深色木材、黑钢和古董金组成的精致电影感棕褐色调。

templates.title: Korean Sports Drink Celebrity Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 韩式运动饮料名人广告海报

templates.prompt: A bold Korean beverage advertisement poster in a glossy commercial photography style, featuring {argument name="spokesperson" default="Donald Trump lookalike"} in a dark navy business suit, white dress shirt, and vivid blue tie, standing front-facing against a saturated bright-blue sky with a few soft white clouds and a faint modern city skyline including a tall skyscraper resembling the Empire State Building on the right. He is holding a cold plastic bottle of {argument name="product name" default="POCARI SWEAT"} dramatically toward the camera in his left hand, with extreme foreshortening so the bottle appears large in the foreground and the person is slightly behind it. The bottle is clear with condensation, a white cap, visible water inside, and a deep blue label reading “POCARI SWEAT” in large white letters with smaller text above saying “ION SUPPLY DRINK.” Add energetic frozen water splashes and droplets around the bottle, hand, and lower foreground to emphasize freshness and hydration. Place the brand logo in the upper left corner: “POCARI SWEAT” in white with the curved underline mark. Across the top, add huge distressed white Korean headline text, slightly angled and filling most of the upper half: {argument name="headline text" default="갈증 해소? 이걸로 끝! 포카리스웨트!"}. In the lower right over the suit, add a bold italic quotation in white and blue Korean text: {argument name="quote" default="WINNING은 수분 싸움! 포카리스웨트로 리프레시!"}. In the bottom left, include exactly 3 circular benefit icons stacked vertically with short Korean labels: a water drop icon with “수분 보충”, a lightning bolt icon with “전해질 보충”, and a running figure icon with “빠른 흡수”. Use a high-contrast, patriotic blue-and-white color palette, dramatic ad lighting, sharp focus on the bottle and hand, slightly softer focus on the face and background, and an overall energetic premium campaign-poster look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格鲜明的韩式饮料广告海报，采用光泽感商业摄影风格。画面主体为 {argument name="spokesperson" default="唐纳德·特朗普替身"}，身穿深海军蓝商务西装，内搭白色衬衫，系着鲜艳的蓝色领带，正面对着镜头。背景是饱和度极高的亮蓝色天空，点缀着几朵柔和的白云，右侧隐约可见现代城市天际线，包括一座类似帝国大厦的高耸摩天大楼。他左手拿着一瓶冰镇塑料瓶装的 {argument name="product name" default="POCARI SWEAT"}，以夸张的透视效果伸向镜头，使瓶身在前景中显得格外巨大，人物则略微靠后。瓶身透明且带有冷凝水珠，配有白色瓶盖，瓶内可见液体，深蓝色标签上印有醒目的白色“POCARI SWEAT”字样，上方有较小的“ION SUPPLY DRINK”文字。在瓶身、手部及下方前景周围添加充满活力的冰冻水花和水滴，以强调清爽与补水感。品牌 Logo 放置在左上角：白色的“POCARI SWEAT”字样及下方的弧形下划线。海报顶部添加巨大的做旧风格白色韩文标题，略微倾斜并占据上半部分的大部分空间：{argument name="headline text" default="갈증 해소? 이걸로 끝! 포카리스웨트!"}。在右下方西装位置，添加一行醒目的斜体白色与蓝色韩文引用语：{argument name="quote" default="WINNING은 수분 싸움! 포카리스웨트로 리프레시!"}。左下角垂直排列 3 个圆形益处图标，并配有简短的韩文标签：水滴图标配“수분 보충”（水分补充）、闪电图标配“전해질 보충”（电解质补充）、奔跑人物图标配“빠른 흡수”（快速吸收）。采用高对比度的蓝白配色，运用戏剧性的广告布光，瓶身和手部焦点清晰，面部和背景焦点略微柔化，整体呈现出充满活力的优质广告海报质感。

templates.prompt: Create a vintage Korean food poster infographic on aged beige parchment paper with worn texture, darkened edges, subtle stains, and an ornate traditional frame in muted green. The design is a single vertically stacked poster with 4 clearly separated sections and all text rendered sharply in Korean and English calligraphy. At the top, place a large ribbon banner with bold black Korean brush lettering reading "정통 한국 김밥" and a smaller ribbon subtitle reading "Traditional Korean Gimbap". In the upper-left corner, include a small modern badge that says "Pollo AI" and "GPT Image 2". The centerpiece of the top section is a large blue-and-white porcelain platter piled with exactly 12 sliced gimbap pieces, each showing white rice, yellow egg, orange carrot, green spinach, and dark seaweed wrapping, illustrated in a hand-drawn ink-and-watercolor style. To the right of the platter, add a small blue-and-white bowl of kimchi and a handwritten Korean note reading "간단해 보여도 정성이 들어간 한국의 맛!" with a small red heart, plus a small red seal stamp containing Korean characters. Add faint traditional landscape and floral ink painting details in the background, including a flowering branch on the left and misty mountains on the right. The second section is an ingredient row under a ribbon label reading "재료", showing exactly 6 numbered ingredients in separate compartments from left to right: 1. "김 (건김)" as a stack of dark seaweed sheets, 2. "밥 (양념 밥)" as a bowl of white rice, 3. "계란 (지단용)" as yellow egg strips on a plate, 4. "당근 (채썰어볶기)" as orange julienned carrots on a plate, 5. "시금치 (데쳐서 무치기)" as seasoned green spinach in a bowl, 6. "단무지 (김밥용)" as yellow pickled radish strips on a plate. templates.prompt:
Create a bold Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm golden splash background and dramatic commercial lighting. Show a {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="Donald Trump-like older male politician"} from the chest up, wearing a navy suit, white dress shirt, bright red tie, and a small American flag lapel pin, facing camera with a confident sales-pitch expression. His face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a skin-toned color. In his left hand, extended close to the camera in forced perspective, he holds a yellow aluminum can of Korean rice punch drink labeled prominently in Korean, with red top and bottom bands and the main product text "비락 식혜" and "Since 1993" on the can. The can also includes smaller Korean copy, an image of sweet rice drink near the bottom, and the volume text "238 ml (120 kcal)". His right hand gives a thumbs-up.

Use an energetic retro-commercial composition, with splashing sweet rice beverage and droplets behind him, glowing golden highlights, and a slightly low-angle heroic framing. At the top, include 3 distinct headline text groups: a small handwritten-style black slogan on the upper left reading "전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!", a huge central headline in distressed bold Korean type reading "걸죽는 땐?" in dark brown-black and "비락 식혜!" in vivid red, and a brand logo on the upper right reading "비락" with small red text "Since 1993" beneath it. Add 2 callout badges: on the left, a yellow circular seal with a tiny crown icon and the text "대한민국 국민음료 No.1"; on the right, a white speech bubble with handwritten Korean text "한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!" and red English text "I LOVE IT!".

At the bottom foreground, place 2 food elements: a brass bowl filled with sweet rice drink and floating rice grains on the left, and a wooden bowl piled with white rice on the right. Across the lower middle, add 2 lines of large brush-style promotional text, the first in white reading "달콤하게! 시원하게!" and the second in mixed white and yellow reading "속까지 시~원하게!" with an energetic yellow underline stroke. Along the very bottom, include 3 circular feature icons with captions in Korean: "국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료", "시원하게 갈증해소", and "부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜". In the lower right corner, add tiny disclaimer text "연출된 이미지입니다". Make the overall look glossy, exaggerated, funny, and convincing like a viral parody print ad.

采用充满活力的复古商业构图，背景中有飞溅的甜米露和液滴，带有闪耀的金色高光，并使用略微仰视的英雄式取景。在顶部，包含 3 组醒目的标题文字：左上角是一句手写风格的黑色标语“전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!”，中央是巨大的做旧粗体韩文标题，深棕黑色文字写着“걸죽는 땐?”，鲜红色文字写着“비락 식혜!”，右上角是品牌标志“비락”，下方附有红色小字“Since 1993”。添加 2 个标注徽章：左侧是一个带有微型皇冠图标的黄色圆形印章，文字为“대한민국 국민음료 No.1”；右侧是一个白色对话气泡，内含手写韩文“한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!”和红色英文“I LOVE IT!”。

在底部前景处，放置 2 种食物元素：左侧是一个盛满甜米露和漂浮米粒的黄铜碗，右侧是一个堆满白米的木碗。在下部中间位置，添加 2 行大型毛笔风格的促销文字，第一行白色文字为“달콤하게! 시원하게!”，第二行白色与黄色相间的文字为“속까지 시~원하게!”，并配以充满活力的黄色下划线。在最底部，包含 3 个圆形功能图标，配有韩文说明：“국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료”、“시원하게 갈증해소”以及“부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜”。在右下角，添加微小的免责声明文字“연출된 이미지입니다”。整体视觉效果需呈现出光泽感、夸张、幽默，并像病毒式传播的恶搞印刷广告一样令人信服。

templates.title: Retro ChatGPT Space Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Retro ChatGPT Images 2.0 太空海报

templates.prompt: A retro-futurist propaganda-style poster pasted on a rough white plaster wall, photographed straight-on in natural light. The poster is slightly wrinkled, creased, and weathered with worn corners and subtle tears, giving it the look of an old screen-printed street poster. Use a mid-century space-race aesthetic from the 1950s–1960s, with a limited palette of deep navy blue, faded cream, muted teal, and bold red-orange. The poster has 5 visible text elements: the large cream headline {argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPT"} at the upper left in bold condensed sans-serif, the large red-orange subheadline {argument name="subheadline text" default="Images 2.0"} directly below it, the vertical red text {argument name="rocket text" default="OpenAI"} printed on the rocket body, and the small cream tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="EXPLORING TOMORROW"} along the bottom red band, plus a small cream star icon to the left of the tagline. Composition: a tall white-and-black rocket launches from the lower right edge with red exhaust flames and billowing cream smoke; the rocket is near-vertical and dominates the right third of the poster. A small detached space capsule floats to the left of the rocket, angled diagonally. A thin cream orbital path curves in a large loop across the upper half of the poster, passing behind and around the rocket. The lower left shows the curved horizon of Earth in muted teal and cream, cropped by the frame. The background is a dark navy star field with exactly 3 visible celestial accents: 1 small cream planet or moon near the top center-left, 1 bright star near the upper right, and 1 smaller star near the middle-left. Add a solid red-orange horizontal band across the bottom of the poster. Emphasize vintage print texture, paper folds, faded ink, and nostalgic sci-fi optimism. The final image should look like a realistic photo of a pasted old space-age poster rather than a clean digital graphic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张贴在粗糙白色石膏墙上的复古中世纪太空竞赛宣传海报，在自然光下进行正拍。海报略显褶皱、有折痕且饱经风霜，边缘磨损并带有细小撕裂，呈现出真实的陈旧纸张质感。设计采用了深海军蓝、褪色奶油色、柔和红橙色和灰青色的有限复古色调。左上方醒目的大标题文字占据主导地位：{argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0"}，其中“ChatGPT”采用超大号奶油色无衬线字体，“Images 2.0”位于下方，使用粗体红橙色。在右侧，一枚高耸的复古火箭垂直矗立，正穿过奶油色的烟雾向上发射，垂直的机身文字 {argument name="rocket text" default="OpenAI"} 为红橙色。一条细细的轨道轨迹线从左向右横跨海报上半部分，环绕着火箭。在中心偏左处，一个小型分离式太空舱沿着轨道路径漂浮。左下方展示了地球的弯曲地平线，以复古插画风格呈现，配有青色海洋和奶油色陆地。底部是一条纯红橙色长条，包含间距均匀的小号奶油色文字 {argument name="tagline text" default="EXPLORING TOMORROW"}。在深色天空中包含 4 颗可见的星星或天体点：2 个微小的星爆、1 个小奶油色圆点和 1 个较大的奶油色圆点。整体构图应呈现出 1950 年代至 1960 年代的科幻旅行海报或苏联/美国太空时代广告印刷品的质感，具有丝网印刷纹理、细微的折痕、怀旧的排版以及电影般的复古未来主义氛围。
