templates.title: Realistic X Profile Page Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 逼真的 X 个人资料页面模型

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic dark-mode social media interface mockup that closely resembles the desktop X/Twitter layout in French, shown as a full-browser screenshot with three vertical columns on a black background and subtle dark gray separators. The left sidebar contains exactly 11 navigation items stacked vertically with white icons and labels: “Accueil”, “Explorer”, “Notifications” with a small blue badge showing 3, “Messages”, “Grok”, “Signets”, “Communautés”, “Premium”, “Organisations certifiées”, “Profil”, and “Plus”. At the top of this sidebar place the white X logo, near the lower-middle add a large rounded white button labeled “Poster”, and at the bottom show a compact logged-in account block for Martin Dubois with handle @martindubois and a small circular avatar. The center column is the main profile page for {argument name="profile name" default="Martin Dubois"}, with a top bar showing a back arrow, the name “Martin Dubois” and a blue verification badge, and underneath the text “1 248 posts”. Below that, include a wide panoramic cover photo of dramatic cloudy alpine mountains above a forest lake. Overlapping the bottom-left of the banner, place a circular profile picture of a young man in dark clothing, face slightly obscured or blurred, with a pale background and a thin border. On the right side of the profile header place three small circular action buttons and one prominent rounded light button labeled “Éditer le profil”. Under the avatar show the display name Martin Dubois with a blue verification badge, the handle @martindubois, and a one-line bio in French: “Créateur de contenu • Passionné de tech, de design et de productivité.” Then add a metadata row with exactly 4 items: location “Lyon, France”, website “martindubois.com”, and “A rejoint X en janvier 2021”, followed by a follower row reading “320 abonnements” and “12,4 k abonnés”. Add a horizontal tab bar with exactly 5 tabs: “Posts”, “Réponses”, “Tweets marquants”, “Médias”, and “J’aime”, with “Posts” active and underlined in blue. Beneath the tabs, show a feed containing exactly 3 visible posts by Martin Dubois. Post 1 is pinned, indicated by “Épinglé”, dated “12 mai”, with the French text “10 leçons que j’ai apprises en construisant mon projet pendant 2 ans” followed by an emoji, and an engagement row with 5 values: 24 replies, 142 reposts, 1 k likes, 85 k views, and a bookmark/share area. Post 2 is dated “2h” with the French text “Le meilleur moment pour commencer était hier. Le deuxième meilleur moment, c’est maintenant.” and engagement values 12 replies, 37 reposts, 256 likes, and 8 k views. Post 3 is dated “1j” with the French text “Un week-end à Chamonix, toujours ressourçant” followed by a mountain emoji, and includes a large embedded image of snowy mountain peaks under soft daylight. Use circular avatars at the left of each post and thin separators between posts. The right sidebar starts with a rounded search field containing the placeholder “Chercher”. Below it, include a card titled “Vous pourriez aimer” with exactly 3 suggested profiles, each with avatar, display name, handle, blue verification badge, and a white rounded “Suivre” button: “Théo Catarino” @theocatarino, “Aurélie Martinez” @aurel_martinez, and “Ulrich Rozier” @ulrichrozier. Add a “Voir plus” link at the bottom of that card. Under it, create a trends card titled “Tendances : France” listing exactly 4 trends in ranked order with category and post counts: 1. “#RolandGarros” with “32,1 k posts”, 2. “#FêteDesMères” with “18,4 k posts”, 3. “Mbappé” with “45,2 k posts”, 4. “#LundiMotivation” with “12,3 k posts”. Add a “Voir plus” link below the trend list. At the very bottom place a compact footer with multiple small gray legal links and “© 2024 X Corp.”. The entire image should look almost indistinguishable from a real desktop screenshot: crisp typography, authentic spacing, realistic UI proportions, subtle rounded cards, white and gray text on near-black surfaces, blue accent color, polished anti-aliased icons, and a clean modern product-design aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高度逼真的深色模式社交媒体界面模型，外观需高度还原桌面端 X/Twitter 的法语布局，以全浏览器截图形式呈现，背景为黑色，配有细微的深灰色分隔线。左侧边栏包含 11 个垂直排列的导航项，配有白色图标和标签：“Accueil”（首页）、“Explorer”（探索）、“Notifications”（通知，带有一个显示数字 3 的蓝色小徽章）、“Messages”（消息）、“Grok”、“Signets”（书签）、“Communautés”（社区）、“Premium”、“Organisations certifiées”（认证组织）、“Profil”（个人资料）以及“Plus”（更多）。在此侧边栏顶部放置白色 X Logo，在偏下方位置添加一个大的圆形白色按钮，标签为“Poster”（发布），底部显示 Martin Dubois 的紧凑型登录账户栏，包含账号 @martindubois 和一个小圆形头像。中间栏为 {argument name="profile name" default="Martin Dubois"} 的主个人资料页面，顶部栏显示返回箭头、“Martin Dubois”名称及蓝色认证徽章，下方显示“1 248 posts”（1248 条帖子）。下方包含一张宽幅全景封面照片，展示阿尔卑斯山脉云雾缭绕的壮丽景色及森林湖泊。在横幅左下方重叠放置一张年轻男性的圆形头像，身着深色服装，面部略微模糊或遮挡，背景浅淡，带有细边框。在个人资料标题栏右侧放置三个小型圆形操作按钮和一个显眼的浅色圆角按钮，标签为“Éditer le profil”（编辑个人资料）。在头像下方显示显示名称 Martin Dubois 及蓝色认证徽章、账号 @martindubois，以及一行法语简介：“Créateur de contenu • Passionné de tech, de design et de productivité.”（内容创作者 • 热衷于科技、设计与生产力）。随后添加一行包含 4 个项目的元数据：地点“Lyon, France”（法国里昂）、网站“martindubois.com”以及“A rejoint X en janvier 2021”（于 2021 年 1 月加入 X），紧接着是关注者行，显示“320 abonnements”（320 个关注）和“12,4 k abonnés”（1.24 万粉丝）。添加一个包含 5 个标签的水平选项卡栏：“Posts”（帖子）、“Réponses”（回复）、“Tweets marquants”（精选推文）、“Médias”（媒体）和“J’aime”（喜欢），其中“Posts”处于激活状态并带有蓝色下划线。在选项卡下方，展示一个包含 3 条 Martin Dubois 可见帖子的信息流。第 1 条帖子为置顶，标注“Épinglé”（置顶），日期为“12 mai”（5 月 12 日），法语文本为“10 leçons que j’ai apprises en construisant mon projet pendant 2 ans”（我在构建项目 2 年中学到的 10 课）并附带表情符号，互动行包含 5 个数值：24 条回复、142 次转发、1 k 次喜欢、85 k 次浏览，以及书签/分享区域。第 2 条帖子日期为“2h”（2 小时前），法语文本为“Le meilleur moment pour commencer était hier. Le deuxième meilleur moment, c’est maintenant.”（开始的最佳时间是昨天。第二个最佳时间是现在。），互动数值为 12 条回复、37 次转发、256 次喜欢和 8 k 次浏览。第 3 条帖子日期为“1j”（1 天前），法语文本为“Un week-end à Chamonix, toujours ressourçant”（在霞慕尼度过的周末，总是令人恢复活力）并附带山脉表情符号，包含一张柔和日光下雪山峰顶的大型嵌入式图片。每条帖子左侧使用圆形头像，帖子之间使用细分隔线。右侧边栏顶部为一个圆角搜索框，占位符为“Chercher”（搜索）。下方包含一张标题为“Vous pourriez aimer”（你可能感兴趣）的卡片，列出 3 个建议关注的个人资料，每个包含头像、显示名称、账号、蓝色认证徽章和一个白色圆角“Suivre”（关注）按钮：“Théo Catarino” @theocatarino、“Aurélie Martinez” @aurel_martinez 和“Ulrich Rozier” @ulrichrozier。在该卡片底部添加“Voir plus”（查看更多）链接。下方创建一个标题为“Tendances : France”（趋势：法国）的趋势卡片，按排名列出 4 个趋势，包含类别和帖子数量：1. “#RolandGarros” 附带 “32,1 k posts”，2. “#FêteDesMères” 附带 “18,4 k posts”，3. “Mbappé” 附带 “45,2 k posts”，4. “#LundiMotivation” 附带 “12,3 k posts”。在趋势列表下方添加“Voir plus”（查看更多）链接。最底部放置一个紧凑的页脚，包含多个小型灰色法律链接和“© 2024 X Corp.”。整张图像应看起来与真实的桌面端截图几乎无异：清晰的排版、地道的间距、逼真的 UI 比例、细腻的圆角卡片、深色背景上的黑白文字、蓝色强调色、精致的抗锯齿图标，以及简洁现代的产品设计美学。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的智能手机 App 截图模型，展示了几乎与 X/Twitter 一致的社交媒体界面，呈现于带有圆角的 iPhone 风格全屏显示器上，背景为深蓝黑色。顶部状态栏左侧显示时间 9:41，右侧显示蜂窝网络、Wi‑Fi 和电池图标。屏幕显示 {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"} 的法文个人资料页面，顶部为一张埃菲尔铁塔与塞纳河在日落时分、橙蓝色戏剧性天空下的巨幅封面图。圆形头像覆盖在页眉左下方，部分遮挡了面部。左上角有一个深色半透明圆形返回箭头按钮，右上角有一个匹配的圆形三点菜单按钮。页眉下方显示带有蓝色认证徽章的个人资料名称 {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"}，账号 {argument name="handle" default="@MarieDubois"}，以及法文简介：第一行显示“Journaliste | Paris”，第二行显示“✨ Curieuse & voyageuse”，下方显示“Rejoint en mai 2012”。以法文显示关注者统计数据：“1 245 Abonnements”和“32,8 k Abonnés”。添加一个包含 4 个标签的选项卡栏，标签分别为“Publications”、“Réponses”、“Médias”和“J'aime”，其中“Publications”处于选中状态并带有蓝色下划线。在信息流中，包含 3 条可见帖子。第 1 条帖子由 {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"} 发布，带有蓝色认证徽章和法文标题 {argument name="post caption" default="Balade matinale le long des quais de la Seine ☀️ #Paris #Promenade"}，后接一行 4 张图片的拼贴：1) 黄金时刻河畔的埃菲尔铁塔，2) 带有桥梁和秋叶的巴黎河畔步道，3) 可俯瞰埃菲尔铁塔的舒适露台咖啡馆，4) 水边打开的笔记本旁的一杯咖啡。下方显示互动图标及计数：回复 258，转发 642，点赞 3,1 k。第 2 条帖子来自认证新闻账号“Le Monde”，账号为“@LeMonde”，头像为白色字母的黑色圆形图标，法文内容为：“Dernières infos : Le nouveau gouvernement français a été annoncé 📰 Tous les details ici ↓”，后接蓝色链接“lemonde.fr/article123”；下方显示计数 187、512 和 2,7 k。第 3 条帖子来自“Thomas Lefevre”，账号为“@Thomas_Lf”，内容为“Juste incroyable ! 😍 Le Mont-Saint-Michel vu du ciel 📷”，后接一张圣米歇尔山的宽幅航拍照片。底部包含一个 iOS 风格的导航栏，共有 5 个元素：主页图标、搜索图标、带有红色数字 4 标记的通知铃铛、带有红色数字 4 标记的消息信封，以及一个带有白色羽毛笔图标的大型蓝色悬浮发布按钮。在最底部居中添加细长的黑色 iPhone 主屏幕指示条。使用清晰的现代 UI 排版、微妙的灰色分割线、逼真的间距、地道的 X 风格图标、精美的移动端 App 渲染效果，以及近乎摄影级的截图真实感。

templates.title: Night Forest Thriller Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗夜森林惊悚小说封面

templates.prompt: A moody graphic-novel style book cover illustration set in a snowy conifer forest at night, painted in deep blue tones with cinematic contrast. In the foreground, show exactly 4 human figures standing behind a low striped road barrier: 3 adults and 1 small child. The central adult is a tall broad-shouldered man in a dark winter jacket, holding the sleeping or limp child in his arms; the child wears a puffy {argument name="child coat color" default="purple"} snowsuit. To his left stands a teenage or young adult male with a backpack beside a dark parked SUV partially visible at the edge of the frame. To his right stands an adult woman in a dark hooded winter jacket, holding a flashlight that casts a warm cone of light onto the snow and the barrier. All faces should be mostly in shadow, unreadable, emphasizing mystery and danger. Place exactly 2 man-made warning elements in the foreground: 1 red-and-white striped gate blocking the path and 1 weathered warning sign on a wooden post showing a deer silhouette inside a red prohibition circle and slash. In the midground and background, fill the scene with tall black pine trees, a narrow snow-covered road or clearing, and a dead animal shape lying partly buried in the snow on the right side. In the far distance, show a rugged snow-streaked mountain under a star-filled sky. From behind the mountain, a single narrow vertical blue beam of light rises straight into the sky, acting as the focal point. Composition should be vertical, dramatic, and poster-like, suitable for a thriller or survival graphic novel cover for {argument name="book title" default="La Réserve"}. Style: detailed Franco-Belgian / realistic comic-book painting, inked outlines, textured brushwork, cold nocturnal atmosphere, subtle rim lighting, high contrast, ominous and suspenseful.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满情绪感的图像小说风格书籍封面插画，背景设定在夜晚的针叶雪林中，采用深蓝色调，具有电影般的对比度。在前景中，展示 4 个人物站在低矮的条纹路障后：3 名成年人和 1 名幼童。中间的成年人是一名身材高大、肩膀宽阔的男子，身穿深色冬装外套，怀里抱着一个正在睡觉或瘫软的孩子；孩子穿着一件 {argument name="child coat color" default="紫色"} 的雪服。在他左侧站着一名背着背包的少年或青年男性，旁边是一辆在画面边缘隐约可见的深色 SUV。在他右侧站着一名身穿深色连帽冬装外套的成年女性，手中拿着手电筒，将一束温暖的光锥投射在雪地和路障上。所有人的面部应大部分处于阴影中，无法辨认，以强调神秘感和危险感。在前景中放置 2 个明显的人造警示元素：1 个阻挡道路的红白条纹门，以及 1 个立在木柱上、带有红色禁止圆圈和斜杠的鹿形剪影警示牌。在中景和背景中，填充高大的黑松树、一条狭窄的积雪道路或空地，右侧雪地里半掩埋着一个动物尸体形状。在远方，展示一座在星空下布满积雪的崎岖山脉。从山后，一道狭窄的垂直蓝色光束直冲云霄，作为视觉焦点。构图应为垂直、具有戏剧性和海报感，适合作为 {argument name="book title" default="La Réserve"} 的惊悚或生存类图像小说封面。风格：细腻的法比漫画 / 写实漫画绘画风格，带有墨线轮廓，笔触质感丰富，寒冷的夜间氛围，微妙的轮廓光，高对比度，充满不祥与悬疑感。

templates.title: Mystery Forest Barrier Book Cover

titleLocalized.zh: “神秘森林禁区”书籍封面

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic graphic-novel style book cover illustration set in a snowy mountain forest at night, with a cold blue palette and dramatic vertical composition. In the foreground, 4 human figures stand behind a red-and-white striped barrier gate blocking a forest road. The first is an adult man in a heavy dark winter jacket, carrying 1 sleeping young girl in his arms; the girl wears a padded pink snowsuit and pale winter boots, her head resting on his shoulder. Beside him stands 1 adult woman in a fur-trimmed winter parka, holding a flashlight angled downward so its warm beam cuts across the snow. Next to her stands 1 teenage boy or young man in a dark hooded winter coat, looking into the forest. On the right foreground, place 1 weathered warning sign mounted on a wooden post, showing a black pedestrian silhouette inside a red prohibition circle and diagonal slash. In the left midground, partially hidden by trees, include 1 dark off-road SUV parked on the snowy roadside. In the right midground, on the ground among the trees, place 1 dead deer with visible antlers. In the distant background between the trunks, include 2 faint, eerie humanoid silhouettes standing still in the forest. Towering pine trees frame the scene on both sides, with steep snow-dusted mountain peaks rising in the background under a clear star-filled sky. From high in the sky near the center-right, a single brilliant vertical beam of pale blue-white light descends from above into the forest, illuminating mist and suggesting a mysterious anomaly. templates.prompt:
A highly detailed full-screen steampunk video-streaming website interface in a dark bronze, brass, and sepia color palette, designed like an antique Victorian industrial dashboard. The page is framed by ornate metal borders, rivets, pipes, gears, pressure gauges, and glowing Edison bulbs, with rich engraved textures and warm low-key lighting. At the top left, a modern white and red brand mark reads "Pollo AI" with smaller white text "GPT Image 2" beneath it, overlaid on the interface. Centered across the top is a large embossed brass title plaque reading "ElectroVid" with a smaller engraved tagline below, "THE FUTURE IN MOTION". A horizontal navigation bar sits under the title with exactly 6 items: a home icon button, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search field showing placeholder text "Search ElectroVid..." followed by a search icon. On the upper right, include 1 round vintage gauge dial built into the metal frame.

The main content area is split into 2 columns. The left sidebar is a framed panel titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 stacked channel cards, each with a circular emblem, a channel name, subscriber count, and a brass subscribe button labeled "SUBSCRIBE". Card 1: emblem with an eagle seal, channel name "THE PATENT OFFICE", subscriber text "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS". Card 2: emblem with a royal crest, channel name "THE ROYAL SOCIETY", subscriber text "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS". Card 3: blue circular GE-style logo, channel name "GENERAL ELECTRIC", subscriber text "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS".

The large central featured video panel has an ornate metal frame and shows a sepia historical scene of two famous inventors in suits debating in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning illustrations. Their faces are obscured by 2 soft rectangular blur blocks, one over each face. Add an old-film, archival-photo look. Along the bottom of the video frame, show a player control bar with exactly 7 visible UI elements: play icon, volume icon, red progress bar, timestamp "08:47 / 22:31", settings gear, small rectangle screen icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the video, show the title "The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate". templates.title: Cinematic Woman in Vintage Library

templates.prompt: A cinematic waist-up portrait of a refined woman in an old-fashioned library, turned slightly to the left and seated or standing close to the camera, with her face centered and partly in soft shadow. She has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair styled in an elegant Edwardian or early 20th-century updo with volume at the crown and loose curled strands framing the sides. She wears a high-necked {argument name="dress color" default="cream-gold"} lace dress with intricate floral texture and delicate trim, plus one visible dangling earring. The setting is a warm, intimate study with 2 tall wooden bookcases filled with aged books in brown, green, and muted blue tones, and on the far left a softly glowing window with a sheer curtain beside 1 framed wall picture. Use golden-hour indoor lighting, amber highlights, shallow depth of field, rich wood tones, soft filmic contrast, realistic skin and fabric detail, and a quiet historical-drama mood. Compose it in a 16:9 frame, medium close-up, photorealistic, luxurious, subtle, and painterly without looking illustrated.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感的半身肖像，描绘了一位优雅的女性身处老式图书馆中，身体略微向左转，坐着或站立在靠近镜头的位置，面部居中且部分处于柔和的阴影中。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 的头发，梳成优雅的爱德华时代或 20 世纪初风格的发髻，头顶蓬松，两侧有松散的卷发垂下。她身穿一件高领的 {argument name="dress color" default="奶油金色"} 蕾丝连衣裙，带有精致的花卉纹理和细腻的饰边，并佩戴着一只清晰可见的吊坠耳环。背景是一个温暖而私密的书房，有 2 个高大的木制书架，摆满了棕色、绿色和柔和蓝色调的旧书；最左侧是一扇透着柔和光线的窗户，窗边挂着薄纱窗帘，旁边还有 1 幅装裱好的墙面挂画。采用黄金时段的室内光线、琥珀色高光、浅景深、浓郁的木质色调、柔和的电影质感对比度、逼真的皮肤和织物细节，营造出安静的历史剧氛围。构图采用 16:9 画幅，中景特写，写实、奢华、细腻，且具有油画质感，而非插画风格。

templates.title: Found-Footage Office Horror Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: Found-Footage 办公室恐怖快照

templates.prompt: A gritty found-footage horror photo taken inside a dim, cramped security office at night, shot with a direct on-camera flash and slight film grain. In the foreground are exactly 2 young women, both partially cropped by the frame and both with their faces heavily blurred into rectangular smudges for privacy. The woman on the left has long dark hair and wears a black top, turned slightly away from camera. The woman on the right has long platinum blonde hair, a low-cut black top, and is holding a black flashlight angled upward in her right hand. Between them in the lower center foreground is 1 small black metal desk fan with visible circular grill. The background reveals a narrow open doorway centered in the image, leading into almost complete darkness. Standing deep inside that doorway is a terrifying rabbit animatronic silhouette with glowing eyes, long upright ears, a huge toothy grin, and faintly visible metallic body details, barely illuminated so it emerges from the shadows. The office walls are off-white and worn, with a black-and-white checker stripe and a thin red stripe running horizontally across the room. On the left wall is 1 colorful “CELEBRATE!” poster featuring animatronic characters, plus 1 smaller character drawing sheet pinned nearby, and 1 black walkie-talkie standing upright on a surface. Near the doorway is 1 silver desk lamp. On the right side are 2 sheets of paper clipped to the wall and a gray filing cabinet in shadow. The door is ajar with the handle visible. Composition should feel like a candid party snapshot turning into a horror scene, with harsh flash-lit foreground subjects, deep black shadows, analog noise, muted colors, unsettling realism, and the hidden monster in the center background as the main scare.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张粗粝的 Found-Footage 风格恐怖照片，拍摄于夜晚昏暗狭窄的安保办公室内，采用机顶闪光灯直闪，带有轻微的胶片颗粒感。前景中共有 2 名年轻女性，两人均被画面部分裁切，且面部因隐私保护被模糊处理成矩形色块。左侧女性留着深色长发，身穿黑色上衣，身体略微背向镜头。右侧女性留着白金长发，身穿低胸黑色上衣，右手向上握着一支黑色手电筒。两人之间的下方前景中央有一个小型黑色金属台式风扇，可见圆形格栅。背景中，画面中央的一扇窄门半掩，通向几乎完全黑暗的空间。在那扇门的深处，站着一个恐怖的兔子电子玩偶剪影，它有着发光的眼睛、长长的竖耳、巨大的露齿笑容以及隐约可见的金属身体细节，在阴影中若隐现。办公室墙壁呈灰白色且陈旧，墙面横贯着黑白格纹条纹和一条细红线。左侧墙上贴着一张色彩鲜艳的“CELEBRATE!”海报，上面印有电子玩偶角色，旁边还钉着一张较小的角色绘画纸，桌面上立着一个黑色对讲机。门附近有一盏银色台灯。右侧墙上夹着 2 张纸，阴影中有一个灰色文件柜。门半开着，可以看到门把手。构图应呈现出一种派对抓拍瞬间转变为恐怖场景的感觉，前景主体由强烈的闪光灯照亮，背景则是深邃的黑色阴影，整体带有模拟噪点、低饱和色彩、令人不安的写实感，并将背景中央隐藏的怪物作为核心惊悚点。

templates.title: Tiny Planet Aerial of Canakkale

titleLocalized.zh: 恰纳卡莱的“小星球”航拍视角

templates.prompt: A dramatic ultra-wide aerial tiny-planet photograph of {argument name="city name" default="Canakkale"}, Turkey, rendered as a full 360-degree stereographic projection so the city and waterfront form a compact spherical world surrounded by a swirling ring of blue sky and white clouds. The viewpoint is high above the shoreline in bright daytime with crisp summer light, realistic colors, and strong photographic detail. Place the large hillside sign reading {argument name="landmark sign text" default="Canakkale"} prominently across the center of the miniature planet. On the left-upper side of the sphere, show a tall pale stone clock tower with a small red Turkish flag at the top, surrounded by dense urban blocks with red-tiled roofs and mid-rise buildings. On the right side, include a vivid blue harbor with 2 white passenger ferries docked along the waterfront and a long curving coastline extending into the distance. In the lower-right quadrant, feature the monumental dark wooden Trojan horse statue on a circular plaza. In the lower-left quadrant, include the large rectangular concrete memorial structure set within green parkland. Cover the planet with winding pedestrian paths, lawns, trees, and landscaped gardens, with city streets and waterfront promenades visible around the edges. Use a highly realistic drone-photo look, deep depth of field, sharp textures, slightly exaggerated fisheye distortion from the tiny-planet projection, and a majestic travel-poster composition emphasizing the contrast between the green park, historic landmarks, and sparkling sea.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具视觉冲击力的超广角“小星球”航拍照片，拍摄地点为土耳其的 {argument name="city name" default="恰纳卡莱"}。画面采用 360 度全景立体投影，使城市与海滨融合成一个紧凑的球形世界，周围环绕着蓝天白云。拍摄视角位于海岸线上方的高空，呈现明亮的日间效果，光线清澈，色彩真实，摄影细节丰富。将写有 {argument name="landmark sign text" default="恰纳卡莱"} 的大型山坡标语醒目地置于微型星球的中心。在球体左上方，展示一座高耸的浅色石制钟楼，顶部悬挂着一面红色土耳其国旗，周围环绕着密集的红瓦屋顶城市街区和中层建筑。右侧呈现一片湛蓝的港口，两艘白色客轮停靠在岸边，长长的海岸线向远处延伸。在右下象限，展示圆形广场上那座宏伟的深色木制特洛伊木马雕像。在左下象限，包含坐落在绿地公园中的大型长方形混凝土纪念建筑。星球表面覆盖着蜿蜒的人行道、草坪、树木和景观花园，边缘处可见城市街道和海滨长廊。采用高度逼真的无人机摄影风格，具有深景深、锐利的纹理，以及由“小星球”投影带来的轻微夸张鱼眼畸变。整体构图呈现宏伟的旅游海报风格，强调了绿色公园、历史地标与波光粼粼的大海之间的鲜明对比。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Cliffside Outpost

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻悬崖前哨站

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy matte painting of a bleak hilltop encampment overlooking a vast cursed wasteland at dusk. In the left foreground, a ragged hanging banner reads "The Pale Lodge Outpost" in large black hand-painted letters, attached to wooden poles and weathered by wind. Beside it stands a tall carved totem post topped with a black raven and draped with bones, skulls, and tattered ornaments. The camp itself contains 4 visible canvas tents: 2 large central tents, 1 medium tent on the left, and 1 smaller tent on the right, all in dirty beige fabric with black occult sigils painted on them, held by ropes, spikes, and crooked poles. Around the tents are 5 hooded human figures in dark robes, standing still like sentries or cultists. Near the center-left is a small campfire casting a faint orange glow. In the right foreground sit 2 brass-and-iron astronomical or ritual instruments on stone pedestals, resembling armillary spheres or astrolabes. The ground is uneven black rock at the edge of a cliff, with scattered stakes, lanterns, banners, and ritual posts. Beyond the outpost stretches a desolate valley of ash-colored plains, winding pale waterways, jagged rock spires, and distant mountain silhouettes. On the horizon, slightly right of center, a sinister dark castle rises from a lone hill. The sky is filled with enormous turbulent storm clouds, with 3 flying creatures or birds silhouetted in the distance and a break in the clouds casting cold, sickly light across the landscape. Use a grim, painterly, highly detailed style with muted sepia, charcoal, umber, and gray tones, dramatic atmospheric perspective, cinematic composition, and the mood of a foreboding fantasy frontier outpost at the edge of a dead world.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅暗黑奇幻风格的哑光画作，描绘了黄昏时分俯瞰广袤被诅咒荒原的荒凉山顶营地。左侧前景中，一面破烂的悬挂横幅上用黑色大字手绘着“The Pale Lodge Outpost”，横幅固定在木杆上，经受着风吹雨打。旁边立着一根高大的雕刻图腾柱，顶部是一只黑色的乌鸦，上面挂满了骨头、头骨和破烂的装饰物。营地内可见 4 顶帆布帐篷：2 顶大型中央帐篷，左侧 1 顶中型帐篷，右侧 1 顶小型帐篷，均为脏兮兮的米色织物，上面绘有黑色神秘符号，由绳索、木桩和歪斜的杆子支撑。帐篷周围有 5 个身穿深色长袍、戴着兜帽的人形身影，像哨兵或邪教徒一样静静站立。左中位置附近有一堆小篝火，散发出微弱的橙色光芒。右侧前景放置着 2 个黄铜与铁制成的天文或仪式仪器，位于石基座上，类似于浑天仪或星盘。地面是悬崖边缘崎岖的黑色岩石，散落着木桩、灯笼、横幅和仪式柱。前哨站外延伸着一片荒凉的灰烬色平原山谷，蜿蜒着苍白的水道，矗立着锯齿状的岩石尖塔，远处是山脉的轮廓。在地平线上，中心偏右处，一座阴森的黑色城堡从孤山上拔地而起。天空中布满了巨大的湍流风暴云，远处有 3 只飞行的生物或鸟类剪影，云层裂开处投射出冰冷、病态的光芒，照亮了整个景观。采用阴沉、油画质感、高度细腻的风格，运用柔和的深褐色、炭色、赭色和灰色调，营造出强烈的空气透视感、电影般的构图，以及死寂世界边缘那令人不安的奇幻前哨站氛围。

templates.title: Vintage Kyoto Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古京都旅行海报

templates.prompt: A vintage travel poster for {argument name="destination name" default="KYOTO"}, Japan, designed in a nostalgic mid-century tourism style with a faded paper texture, softly worn edges, and warm sun-aged colors. Use a vertical poster layout with rounded corners and a cream border. At the top, place the large headline {argument name="headline text" default="KYOTO"} in oversized elegant red serif letters, with “JAPAN” centered below in dark blue serif type and thin decorative divider lines. Add an italic tagline beneath it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories."}. The main image should show a dramatic low-angle view of a traditional five-story Japanese pagoda in vivid vermilion red with dark wooden eaves and black railings, standing on a stone base with a wooden walkway in the foreground. Surround the pagoda with green wooded hills, a bright blue sky, and soft cream-colored clouds. On the left side, include a vertical red label with white Japanese characters reading “京都、日本”. Also add a blooming cherry blossom branch entering from the left, with clusters of pale pink flowers. In the upper right corner, include a postage stamp featuring a pagoda silhouette in muted red tones, partially overlapped by a circular postal cancellation mark reading “KYOTO JAPAN” with the kanji “京都” in the center and a few wavy postmark lines extending rightward. At the bottom, add a centered vintage footer slogan in serif capitals reading {argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."}. The overall look should feel romantic, collectible, slightly distressed, and like a classic Japanese tourism print from the 1950s or 1960s.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="destination name" default="KYOTO"}（日本），采用怀旧的 20 世纪中期旅游风格设计，带有褪色的纸张质感、轻微磨损的边缘以及温暖的岁月色调。使用带有圆角的竖版海报布局，并配以奶油色边框。顶部放置醒目的大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="KYOTO"}，采用超大号优雅红色衬线字体；下方居中放置深蓝色衬线字体的“JAPAN”，并配有细长的装饰分割线。下方添加斜体标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories."}。主体画面应展示一个极具张力的低角度视角，呈现一座鲜艳朱红色的传统日本五重塔，配有深色木质屋檐和黑色栏杆，矗立在石基上，前景为木质走道。塔周围环绕着绿色的树木繁茂的山丘、明亮的蓝天和柔和的奶油色云朵。左侧包含一个垂直的红色标签，上面印有白色日文字符“京都、日本”。同时，从左侧伸入一枝盛开的樱花，带有簇簇淡粉色的花朵。在右上角，加入一枚邮票，上面有暗红色的塔影，部分被一个圆形的邮戳覆盖，邮戳上写着“KYOTO JAPAN”，中心为汉字“京都”，并向右延伸出几条波浪形的邮戳线。底部添加居中的复古页脚标语，采用衬线大写字母，内容为 {argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."}。整体外观应呈现出浪漫、具有收藏价值、略带磨损感，如同 20 世纪 50 年代或 60 年代的经典日本旅游印刷品。

templates.title: Revenge Action Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复仇动作电影海报

templates.prompt: A gritty, high-contrast cinematic action movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout for a revenge thriller titled {argument name="movie title" default="DEADLINE VENGEANCE"}. The composition is dominated by a large foreground figure of a tough middle-aged man with short dark hair, rugged stubble, and a black leather or tactical jacket, aiming a semi-automatic handgun directly at the viewer from the left side of the frame with strong foreshortening so the gun appears oversized and close to camera. His face is partially obscured in shadow for a mysterious, menacing look. Behind him is a dark modern city skyline at night under stormy clouds, with 1 helicopter in the upper right sky and 1 massive fireball explosion on the right side near the buildings, sending smoke, sparks, and debris into the air. Across the very top, small red uppercase text reads {argument name="top tagline" default="REVENGE IS HIS MISSION"}. On the left-center area, add a stacked white uppercase tagline in 4 lines: {argument name="left tagline" default="THE PAST TOOK EVERYTHING. HE'LL TAKE EVERYTHING BACK."}, styled as 2 short blocks separated by thin red accent lines. Place the main title huge across the lower middle, with 2 words: the first word in enormous distressed metallic-white block letters, and the second word in slightly smaller bold red uppercase letters. In the bottom third, show 1 lone male figure from behind standing in the middle of a wet reflective street, holding a pistol, facing the burning city. Surround him with 4 police vehicles total, 2 on the left and 2 on the right, with flashing lights, plus 2 additional helicopters in the distant sky near the horizon, making 3 helicopters total in the full poster. Include flames along both lower corners, wreckage, smoke, embers, and silhouettes of several armed figures in the distance. At the bottom center, add red uppercase release text {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"} with smaller white text underneath reading {argument name="format line" default="EXPERIENCE IT IN IMAX"}. Add a dense strip of tiny fake production credits and a film rating box at the very bottom. Color palette: black, charcoal, steel gray, orange fire, and deep crimson. Style: polished Hollywood blockbuster key art, dramatic rim lighting, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, intense contrast, anamorphic action lighting, smoky atmosphere, explosive urban chaos, premium theatrical poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高对比度、电影质感的复仇惊悚片竖版海报，标题为 {argument name="movie title" default="DEADLINE VENGEANCE"}。构图主体是一位身处前景的硬汉，中年男性，短黑发，留着粗犷的胡茬，身穿黑色皮夹克或战术夹克。他从画面左侧直接向观众瞄准一把半自动手枪，通过强烈的透视效果使枪支看起来巨大且靠近镜头。他的面部部分隐藏在阴影中，营造出神秘而危险的氛围。背景是夜间黑暗的现代城市天际线，上方笼罩着风暴云，右上角天空有 1 架直升机，右侧建筑物附近有 1 团巨大的火球爆炸，烟雾、火花和碎片四散。海报最上方，有一行红色小号大写文字：{argument name="top tagline" default="REVENGE IS HIS MISSION"}。在左中区域，添加 4 行堆叠的白色大写标语：{argument name="left tagline" default="THE PAST TOOK EVERYTHING. HE'LL TAKE EVERYTHING BACK."}，样式为由细红线分隔的 2 个短块。主标题横跨中下部，分为 2 个单词：第一个单词采用巨大的做旧金属白色块状字体，第二个单词采用稍小一些的粗体红色大写字母。在海报下三分之一处，展示 1 个孤独的男性背影，他站在湿漉漉的反光街道中央，手持手枪，面对着燃烧的城市。他周围共有 4 辆警车，左右各 2 辆，闪烁着警灯；远方地平线附近还有 2 架直升机，使整张海报中共有 3 架直升机。下方的两个角落点缀着火焰、残骸、烟雾、余烬以及远处几个武装人员的剪影。底部中央添加红色的发行文字 {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}，下方配有较小的白色文字 {argument name="format line" default="EXPERIENCE IT IN IMAX"}。最底部添加一行密集的虚构制作人员名单和电影分级框。配色方案：黑色、炭灰色、钢灰色、橙色火焰和深红色。风格：精致的好莱坞大片主视觉，戏剧性的轮廓光，照片级真实感，超高细节，强烈的对比度，变形宽银幕动作照明，烟雾缭绕的氛围，爆炸性的城市混乱，高级院线海报设计。

templates.title: Solar System Ice Cream Cones

titleLocalized.zh: 太阳系冰淇淋甜筒

templates.prompt: A whimsical, photorealistic product-style food photograph of 8 ice cream cones lined up in a straight row on a matte black rectangular stand, each scoop designed to look like a different planet of the solar system. The scene is shot at eye level with a shallow depth of field and creamy urban bokeh in the background, suggesting an outdoor city street or café setting in soft daylight. From left to right, show exactly 8 cones: a gray speckled Mercury scoop, a yellow-brown swirling Venus scoop, a blue-and-green Earth scoop with white cloud patterns and a small blue drip, a deep red Mars scoop with darker marbling and red melted drips, a striped Jupiter scoop with its Great Red Spot visible, a pale tan Saturn scoop with a thin ring encircling it, a light icy blue Uranus scoop with a blue drip, and a vivid cobalt-blue Neptune scoop with glossy texture and blue dripping melt. Use crisp waffle cones, realistic melting details, glossy frozen surfaces, careful studio-quality lighting, and a centered symmetrical composition. Keep the planets highly recognizable but rendered as believable ice cream, with the black stand spanning the width of the frame and the background softly blurred.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满奇思妙想、产品风格的写实美食照片，8 个冰淇淋甜筒在哑光黑色长方形支架上排成一列，每个冰淇淋球都被设计成太阳系中不同行星的模样。场景采用平视角度拍摄，具有浅景深效果，背景为柔和的城市虚化光斑，营造出户外街道或咖啡馆的柔和日光氛围。从左到右依次展示 8 个甜筒：灰色斑点的水星球、黄褐色漩涡的金星球、带有白色云纹和蓝色小滴的蓝绿色地球球、带有深色大理石纹和红色融化液滴的深红色火星球、带有大红斑纹理的条纹木星球、环绕着细环的浅棕色土星球、带有蓝色液滴的浅冰蓝色天王星球，以及具有光泽质感和蓝色融化液滴的鲜艳钴蓝色海王星球。使用酥脆的华夫饼甜筒，呈现逼真的融化细节、光泽的冷冻表面、考究的摄影棚级布光以及居中的对称构图。确保行星高度可辨认，同时呈现出逼真的冰淇淋质感，黑色支架横跨画面宽度，背景经过柔和虚化处理。

templates.title: Surreal Octopus Burger Fine Dining Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实章鱼汉堡高级餐饮摄影

templates.prompt: A dark, moody fine-dining restaurant scene photographed with direct flash and a slightly unsettling surreal-horror tone. Center the composition on a plated gourmet sandwich that looks like a realistic octopus used as the filling: a glossy golden-brown sesame burger bun on top of a fleshy pink-purple octopus body with detailed veins, pores, suction cups, wrinkled skin, and several visible tentacles protruding from the sides and front. The creature should appear cooked yet disturbingly lifelike, with one bulbous eye-like form visible on the left side and clustered holes and texture on the right side, creating an uncanny bio-organic appearance. The sandwich sits on a large round white ceramic plate with a pool of yellow butter-like or oily sauce spreading beneath it and a few small reddish droplets mixed into the sauce. In the foreground-left background place a small white dish holding a pat of butter. On the dining table include exactly 6 visible drinking glasses: 2 large red wine glasses, 3 tall white-wine or champagne-style stem glasses, and 1 dark beer glass at the right edge. In the back center place 1 small lit candle in a gold-toned holder and 1 small clear vase with white flowers. Use a white tablecloth, very dim ambient lighting, warm candle glow, strong camera flash reflections on the glassware, shallow casual snapshot framing, and a bizarre upscale restaurant presentation that feels grotesque, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, and intentionally shocking.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张昏暗、情绪化的高级餐厅场景照片，采用直接闪光灯拍摄，带有略显不安的超现实恐怖基调。构图中心是一份摆盘精致的美味三明治，其内馅看起来像是一只逼真的章鱼：顶部是光泽诱人的金棕色芝麻汉堡胚，下方是肉质粉紫色的章鱼躯体，细节包括清晰的静脉、毛孔、吸盘、褶皱的皮肤，以及从两侧和前方伸出的几条触手。生物看起来既像是烹饪过的，又带有令人不安的生命感，左侧可见一个球状眼球状结构，右侧则有密集的孔洞和纹理，营造出一种诡异的生物有机外观。三明治放置在一个大型圆形白色陶瓷盘中，盘底有一滩黄色黄油状或油状酱汁，酱汁中混有几滴红色液滴。在左前景的背景处放置一个小碟子，里面盛着一块黄油。餐桌上必须准确摆放 6 个可见的饮用杯：2 个大型红酒杯，3 个高脚白葡萄酒或香槟杯，以及右边缘的 1 个深色啤酒杯。在后方中心放置 1 个金色烛台中的点燃小蜡烛和 1 个插有白色花朵的小型透明花瓶。使用白色桌布，环境光非常昏暗，带有温暖的烛光，玻璃器皿上有强烈的相机闪光反射，采用随意的快照式浅景深构图，呈现出一种怪诞、超细节、写实且极具视觉冲击力的高级餐厅氛围。

templates.prompt: A majestic deep-space scene of an owl-shaped nebula floating in a black starfield, centered composition, the cosmic gas and dust naturally forming the clear face of an owl. Two large glowing circular eyes with bright electric-blue star cores, a narrow pointed beak of amber light between them, and two long upward-sweeping ear tufts made of burnt-orange and golden-brown nebula pillars. The body is formed from layered translucent clouds of warm copper, sepia, ivory, and cool smoky blue, with soft luminous edges and intricate filament textures. Surround the figure with many sharp stars of varying sizes, including several bright blue-white stars with subtle diffraction spikes. Make the owl shape unmistakable but still fully made of astronomical nebula structures, realistic space photography aesthetic, dramatic contrast, ultra-detailed, ethereal glow, inspired by a {argument name="animal silhouette" default="owl"} formed from a {argument name="cosmic subject" default="nebula"}, with {argument name="primary glow color" default="amber and blue"} tones, portrait orientation, centered and symmetrical, cinematic and awe-inspiring.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅雄伟的深空场景，一只猫头鹰形状的星云漂浮在漆黑的星场中，采用中心构图，宇宙气体和尘埃自然形成了清晰的猫头鹰面部。两只巨大的发光圆形眼睛拥有明亮的电蓝色星核，中间是一个琥珀色光芒构成的尖细喙，以及由焦橙色和金棕色星云柱组成的向上延伸的长耳簇。身体由温暖的铜色、深褐色、象牙白和冷烟蓝色层叠的半透明云团构成，边缘散发柔和光芒，并带有复杂的丝状纹理。主体周围环绕着许多大小不一的锐利恒星，包括几颗带有细微衍射光芒的亮蓝白色恒星。猫头鹰的形状清晰可辨，但完全由天文星云结构组成，呈现逼真的太空摄影美感，对比强烈，细节极其丰富，散发空灵光芒，灵感源自于由 {argument name="cosmic subject" default="nebula"} 形成的 {argument name="animal silhouette" default="owl"}，色调为 {argument name="primary glow color" default="amber and blue"}，纵向构图，居中且对称，具有电影般的震撼效果。

templates.title: Surreal Archer With Birds and Animals

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实主义射手与飞禽走兽

templates.prompt: A surreal cinematic outdoor portrait of a masked archer standing in a dry field under a deep clear blue sky, framed from about the knees up in a wide horizontal composition. The central figure is a woman-like person in a vintage prairie-style dress and matching headscarf, aiming a simple wooden longbow toward the left side of the frame with an arrow drawn back to the cheek. Her face is fully obscured by a soft rectangular blur or blocky censorship patch, creating an uncanny anonymous effect. The dress is sage green with long puffed sleeves, a gathered waist tied with a sash, and a tiny repeating red-and-white floral dot pattern. A red cloth or scarf is wrapped around the lower face and neck beneath the green head covering. Surrounding her are 12 animals total: 8 white birds flying across the sky at different distances, 2 larger white birds standing on the ground at the right side, 1 deer head entering from the lower left foreground, and 1 sheep or goat head entering from the lower right foreground. Add 1 red-headed crane-like bird at the far right edge, visible in profile. The image should feel dreamlike, strange, and symbolic rather than realistic, with crisp midday sunlight, rich saturated colors, soft film grain, and a slightly vintage editorial-photography look. Use low-angle perspective, dynamic diagonal lines from the bow and arrow, and layered animal placement to create tension and motion. Dry grasses appear at the bottom edge, but the background is mostly open sky. Highly detailed fabric folds, natural bird wing positions, and a balanced surreal composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超现实主义电影风格的户外肖像，描绘了一位站在深邃晴空下干草地里的蒙面射手，采用宽幅横向构图，取景范围约为膝盖以上。中心人物是一位身着复古草原风连衣裙、佩戴同款头巾的女性形象，她正手持一把简易木制长弓瞄准画面左侧，箭已拉满至脸颊处。她的面部被一块柔和的矩形模糊或块状遮挡物完全遮盖，营造出一种离奇的匿名感。连衣裙为鼠尾草绿，配有长泡泡袖，腰部有系带收腰，并带有细小的红白相间碎花图案。绿色头巾下方，红色的布料或围巾包裹着她的下半张脸和颈部。她周围共有 12 只动物：8 只白色飞鸟在不同距离的天空中翱翔，2 只较大的白色鸟类站在右侧地面，1 个鹿头从左下角前景探入，1 个羊头从右下角前景探入。在最右侧边缘增加 1 只侧面可见的红头鹤类鸟。画面应呈现出梦幻、怪诞且具有象征意义的氛围，而非写实风格，并具备明亮的中午阳光、浓郁的色彩、细腻的胶片颗粒感以及略带复古的编辑摄影质感。使用低角度透视，通过弓箭形成的动态对角线以及分层的动物布局来营造张力和动感。底部边缘可见干草，但背景大部分为开阔的天空。画面需呈现高细节的织物褶皱、自然的鸟类翅膀姿态以及平衡的超现实构图。

templates.title: Apple macOS Redesign Promo Mockup

templates.prompt: A polished Apple-style macOS promotional desktop mockup shown as a full-screen screenshot, with a soft pastel dawn wallpaper of layered purple-blue rolling hills under a pale peach and lavender sky. Centered near the top is a large minimalist headline reading "macOS" with the subheadline "Redesigned." and a smaller line below that says "More clarity. More focus. More you." The top system menu bar is visible across the full width: Apple logo, Finder, File, Edit, View, Go, Window, Help on the left; Wi‑Fi, battery, search, colorful user icon, and the date/time "Mon Jun 10  9:41 AM" on the right. On the left side, stack 4 translucent rounded widgets vertically: a weather widget for "Sonoma, CA" showing "65°", "Sunny", high/low "H:72°  L:55°", and 6 hourly temperatures from 10 AM to 3 PM; an "Up Next" widget with 2 calendar items, "Design Review" and "Lunch with Sophie" with times; a "Focus" widget showing "Do Not Disturb" and "On Until 10:00 AM"; and a "Notes" widget with the note "Website redesign" and time "3:30 PM". In the middle-left foreground, place a Finder window with rounded corners and a light frosted interface, titled "iCloud Drive". Include a left sidebar with 10 items total: Favorites with 6 items "AirDrop", "Recents", "Applications", "Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads"; iCloud with 2 items "iCloud Drive" and "Shared"; and Locations with 1 item "Macintosh HD". In the main Finder area show 8 file items arranged in a grid: 4 folders on the top row labeled "Work", "Personal", "Projects", "Presentations", and 4 documents on the bottom row labeled "Brand Guidelines.pdf", "Project Brief.docx", "Research.png", "Moodboard.key". Add standard macOS traffic-light window buttons and small view/search controls in the title bar. On the right side, overlap a Mail app window with a three-column layout. The left mail list column is titled "Inbox" and shows "1237 messages" plus 5 visible senders/messages: "Antonio Manriquez" with subject "Design updates", "Jenny Court" with "Re: Team lunch", "Heather Lee" with "Q3 Planning", "Nisha Kumar" with "Re: Feedback", and "Simon Pickford" with "Offsite ideas". The reading pane shows the selected message from Antonio Manriquez to You with subject "Design updates" and body text about attached mockups for a new feature, plus a file attachment card labeled "Mockups.zip" and "12.4 MB". Use clean SF Pro-style typography, subtle shadows, translucent glassmorphism panels, soft ambient lighting, and a premium Apple keynote aesthetic. At the bottom center, include a glossy translucent macOS Dock with 15 icons: Finder, Launchpad, Safari, Messages, Mail, Calendar showing "JUN 10", Photos, Notes, Reminders, TV, Music, News, App Store, Settings, and Trash. Composition should feel balanced, airy, realistic, and highly refined, like an official Apple macOS redesign announcement image.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的 Apple 风格 macOS 宣传桌面样机，以全屏截图形式呈现。壁纸采用柔和的淡彩晨曦风格，描绘了淡桃色与薰衣草色天空下层叠的紫蓝色连绵山丘。顶部中央是一个巨大的极简主义标题“macOS”，下方副标题为“Redesigned.”，再下方是一行较小的文字：“More clarity. More focus. More you.”。顶部系统菜单栏横跨整个屏幕：左侧依次为 Apple 图标、Finder、文件、编辑、显示、前往、窗口、帮助；右侧为 Wi‑Fi、电池、搜索、彩色用户图标以及日期时间“6 月 10 日周一 上午 9:41”。左侧垂直堆叠 4 个半透明圆角小组件：一个显示“Sonoma, CA”、“65°”、“晴天”、最高/最低气温“H:72° L:55°”以及上午 10 点至下午 3 点每小时气温的天气小组件；一个显示“Design Review”和“Lunch with Sophie”及其时间的“接下来”日程小组件；一个显示“勿扰模式”及“开启至上午 10:00”的“专注”小组件；以及一个包含“Website redesign”笔记和时间“下午 3:30”的“备忘录”小组件。在左中前景处放置一个带有圆角和轻盈磨砂界面的 Finder 窗口，标题为“iCloud Drive”。左侧边栏包含 10 个项目：个人收藏包含“隔空投送”、“最近使用”、“应用程序”、“桌面”、“文稿”、“下载”6 个项目；iCloud 包含“iCloud Drive”和“共享”2 个项目；位置包含“Macintosh HD”1 个项目。Finder 主区域以网格形式显示 8 个文件：顶行是标记为“Work”、“Personal”、“Projects”、“Presentations”的 4 个文件夹，底行是标记为“Brand Guidelines.pdf”、“Project Brief.docx”、“Research.png”、“Moodboard.key”的 4 个文档。标题栏包含标准的 macOS 交通灯窗口按钮及小型视图/搜索控件。右侧重叠一个三栏布局的“邮件”应用窗口。左侧邮件列表栏标题为“收件箱”，显示“1237 封邮件”及 5 条可见的发件人/邮件摘要：“Antonio Manriquez”的“Design updates”、“Jenny Court”的“Re: Team lunch”、“Heather Lee”的“Q3 Planning”、“Nisha Kumar”的“Re: Feedback”以及“Simon Pickford”的“Offsite ideas”。阅读窗格显示选中的 Antonio Manriquez 发给你的邮件，主题为“Design updates”，正文内容关于新功能的附件样机，并附有一个标记为“Mockups.zip”和“12.4 MB”的文件附件卡片。采用简洁的 SF Pro 风格字体、微妙的阴影、半透明的玻璃拟态面板、柔和的环境光以及高端的 Apple Keynote 美学。底部中央包含一个光泽半透明的 macOS 程序坞，内含 15 个图标：Finder、启动台、Safari、信息、邮件、显示“6 月 10 日”的日历、照片、备忘录、提醒事项、TV、音乐、新闻、App Store、系统设置和废纸篓。整体构图平衡、通透、写实且高度精致，宛如 Apple 官方发布的 macOS 重新设计公告图。

templates.prompt: A vast ultra-wide cinematic fantasy xianxia world map painted as a highly detailed Chinese cultivation sect panorama, viewed from an elevated distance above a sea of clouds. The scene shows a majestic mountain realm made of many steep rocky islands, waterfalls, mist-filled valleys, floating stone shards, ornate bridges, and layered traditional Chinese palace architecture with glowing mystical blue energy. In the center, place the grand main sect complex labeled "玄天剑宗", built on the tallest luminous mountain with white-blue crystal light, ascending pagodas, terraces, and celestial aura; nearby add the smaller label "宗门大殿". Surrounding it, include exactly 9 additional labeled locations distributed across the panorama: on the far left a purple-toned cliff region labeled "问剑崖" with the smaller annotation "弟子历练之地"; left-center a blue misty cultivation platform island labeled "悟道峰" with the smaller annotation "弟子悟道之地"; upper left a solemn hall cluster labeled "藏经阁" with the smaller annotation "典藏无上功法"; upper right a jagged icy mountain sword formation labeled "剑冢" with the smaller annotation "历代剑修终寝之地"; right-center a bright ceremonial complex labeled "演武场" with the smaller annotation "磨砺弟子心性"; lower right-center an alchemy pavilion area labeled "炼丹房" with the smaller annotation "炼丹疗法"; far right a pink flowering valley sanctuary labeled "百花谷" with the smaller annotation "入神绮艳秘境"; bottom right an outer compound labeled "外门" with the smaller annotation "新弟子居所". Add one title inscription in the upper left corner reading "玄天剑宗" in large gold calligraphy, with a smaller poetic line beneath it and a small red seal stamp. Use an elegant painted concept-art style, monumental scale, pale gold and icy blue highlights, soft volumetric fog, dramatic storm-clearing sky, ethereal lighting, and finely rendered Chinese ink-and-digital matte painting aesthetics. No characters in the foreground, no modern elements, just an expansive legendary sect environment designed like a promotional world-building illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅宏大的超宽幅电影级仙侠世界地图，呈现为细节极其丰富的中国修真宗门全景，视角从云海之上的高空俯瞰。场景展现了一个由众多陡峭岩石岛屿组成的壮丽山界，包含瀑布、云雾缭绕的山谷、漂浮的碎石、华丽的桥梁，以及层叠的中国传统宫殿建筑，并伴有发光的神秘蓝色能量。在中心位置，放置宏伟的主宗门建筑群，标注为“玄天剑宗”，建在最高处发光的山峰上，配有白色与蓝色交织的晶莹光芒、高耸的宝塔、露台以及仙气；附近添加较小的标注“宗门大殿”。在全景中环绕分布另外 9 个标注地点：最左侧为紫色调的悬崖区域，标注为“问剑崖”，下方附带较小注释“弟子历练之地”；左中为蓝色云雾缭绕的修炼平台岛屿，标注为“悟道峰”，下方附带较小注释“弟子悟道之地”；左上方为庄严的殿宇群，标注为“藏经阁”，下方附带较小注释“典藏无上功法”；右上方为锯齿状的冰山剑阵，标注为“剑冢”，下方附带较小注释“历代剑修终寝之地”；右中为明亮的仪式建筑群，标注为“演武场”，下方附带较小注释“磨砺弟子心性”；右下方为炼丹阁区域，标注为“炼丹房”，下方附带较小注释“炼丹疗法”；最右侧为粉色花海山谷圣地，标注为“百花谷”，下方附带较小注释“入神绮艳秘境”；右下角为外围建筑群，标注为“外门”，下方附带较小注释“新弟子居所”。在左上角添加一处题字，以金色大字书写“玄天剑宗”，下方配有一行较小的诗句及一枚红色印章。采用优雅的绘画概念艺术风格，宏大的比例，淡金与冰蓝色的高光，柔和的体积雾，雨过天晴的戏剧性天空，空灵的灯光，以及精致的中国水墨与数字绘景美学。前景无人物，无现代元素，仅呈现一个广阔的传奇宗门环境，设计如同一幅世界观宣传插画。

templates.title: Moonlit Celestial Kimono Dancer

titleLocalized.zh: 月下星辰和服舞者

templates.prompt: A breathtaking fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a celestial shrine maiden"} in a snowy winter night landscape, shown in a graceful full-body dancing pose beside a reflective lake. She has extremely long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="rose pink"} hair, partially seen from the back and side, with an elaborate gold floral hair ornament and dangling chains. Her face is mostly obscured by the angle. She wears a richly layered, ornate Japanese court kimono inspired by a jūnihitoe, with voluminous sleeves and many overlapping panels in crimson, white, purple, green, gold, and soft pink, decorated with floral brocade, embroidered blossoms, metallic trim, and shimmering patterns. Both arms are raised elegantly as she appears to guide 2 huge arcs of translucent iridescent silk or magical ribbon that spiral around her body in a luminous loop, catching rainbow highlights like soap-film aurora light. The ribbons glow with prismatic reflections and tiny sparkles, framing her against the sky. The setting is a moonlit lakeshore covered in fresh snow, with bare winter trees on the right, a small traditional pavilion or shrine structure across the water on the left, and the bright full moon high in a deep indigo sky filled with dense stars and softly falling snow. The water mirrors the moonlight and glittering particles. Emphasize cinematic lighting, ethereal atmosphere, ultra-detailed fabric textures, dynamic flowing motion, magical sparkle effects, elegant composition, and a dreamlike celestial mood. Highly polished anime key visual, vertical composition, intricate detail, luminous highlights, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅令人惊叹的奇幻动漫插画，描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="一位天界巫女"} 在雪夜景观中的身影，她以优雅的全身舞姿伫立在波光粼粼的湖畔。她拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="玫瑰粉色"} 秀发，从背面和侧面部分可见，发间饰有精致的金色花卉发饰和垂坠链条。她的面部大部分被角度遮挡。她身着灵感源自十二单的华丽多层日本宫廷和服，袖口宽大，层叠的衣襟交织着深红、纯白、紫色、绿色、金色和柔粉色，装饰着花卉锦缎、刺绣花朵、金属饰边和闪烁的图案。她优雅地抬起双臂，仿佛在引导两条巨大的半透明虹彩丝带或魔法绸带，丝带在她身周盘旋成发光的圆环，捕捉着如同肥皂膜极光般的彩虹高光。丝带散发着棱镜般的反射光和细小的火花，将她衬托在天幕之下。背景是覆盖着新雪的月下湖岸，右侧是光秃秃的冬树，左侧水对面有一座传统的小亭子或神社，深靛蓝色的天空中悬挂着明亮的满月，繁星密布，雪花轻盈飘落。湖水倒映着月光和闪烁的微粒。强调电影级光影、空灵氛围、超精细的织物纹理、动态的流动感、魔法闪光效果、优雅的构图以及梦幻般的天界意境。高质感的动漫关键视觉图，竖构图，细节复杂，高光亮眼，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Futuristic Photonics Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感光子学杂志封面

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed French popular science magazine cover in the style of a bold mainstream newsstand publication, full-page vertical layout, dramatic glossy print design, black background with intense neon lighting and saturated red, blue, purple, green, and orange highlights. At the very top, a wide red masthead bar with the magazine title {argument name="magazine title" default="SCIENCE & VIE"} in huge white serif capital letters with subtle beveling and metallic shine; small issue details on the upper right in tiny white text. On the upper left, a bright yellow and black special tag reading {argument name="special tag" default="SPÉCIAL PHOTONIQUE"} with a red arrow motif. The main headline dominates most of the upper half in gigantic white block capitals with a red glow and slight 3D shadow: {argument name="main headline" default="LA PHOTONIQUE RÉVOLUTIONNE TOUT !"}. Beneath it, 3 short cover lines in smaller white text with selected words highlighted in yellow, discussing ultrafast light-speed chips, a French record computer called Lucy, and light trapped for millions of cycles for energy-efficient AI. Centerpiece image: a futuristic square photonic processor chip floating in space at a slight perspective tilt, extremely detailed circuitry, metallic screws at the corners, glowing traces, and a bright cyan-blue core display labeled {argument name="chip name" default="Lucy"}; the chip emits intersecting beams and flowing fiber-optic light trails in electric blue, magenta, orange, and violet that radiate outward across the page. Background behind the chip shows 2 luminous server-wall corridors, red on the left and green on the right, fading into darkness, suggesting a high-tech datacenter. At the bottom, the curved horizon of Earth from space with a soft blue atmospheric glow and scattered city lights. Add 4 side callout boxes total: 2 stacked on the left and 2 stacked on the right, each with yellow headers and white body text, using a magazine cover typography hierarchy. Left box 1 header: "EXCLUSIF", featuring Lucy as the most powerful French photonic quantum computer in the world, with several short bullet lines and a yellow emphasis on "12 qubits". Left box 2 header: "RECORD MONDIAL", about light trapped for millions of cycles in a chip, with yellow emphasis on "millions de cycles". Right box 1 header area in yellow, with a bold red percentage "+300 %" and text about the French gem Soitec rising thanks to photonic AI and saving datacenters during the energy crisis. Right box 2 header: "ENQUÊTE", about the end of power-hungry GPUs, with yellow-highlighted numeric claims such as 100 times cheaper and 1,000 times faster. Near the lower center, tiny white image-credit text. A thick black bottom banner spans the page with a red square containing a white plus symbol on the left, and a large dossier teaser in white and red text: {argument name="bottom feature text" default="DOSSIER COMPLET Photonique & IA : les 10 avancées qui vont transformer votre quotidien"}. Along the very bottom, add 3 small circular red icon blurbs with short white captions about seismic optical fibers, a new generation of LiDAR and AR, and European sovereignty in progress. Lower right corner includes a white barcode box and a short block of white text about the issue being on sale. Overall look: sensational, prestigious, futuristic, glossy, information-dense, sharp editorial typography, dramatic science-news cover, cinematic lighting, high contrast, photorealistic 3D chip illustration mixed with premium magazine graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的法国科普杂志封面，采用大胆的主流报刊亭出版物风格，全页垂直布局，戏剧性的光面印刷设计，黑色背景配以强烈的霓虹灯光，以及饱和的红、蓝、紫、绿和橙色高光。最上方是一条宽大的红色刊头栏，以巨大的白色衬线大写字母展示杂志标题 {argument name="magazine title" default="SCIENCE & VIE"}，带有微妙的斜角和金属光泽；右上角有微小的白色文字，标注期号详情。左上角是一个明亮的黄黑相间特殊标签，文字为 {argument name="special tag" default="SPÉCIAL PHOTONIQUE"}，带有红色箭头图案。主标题占据了上半部分的大部分空间，采用巨大的白色块状大写字母，带有红色光晕和轻微的 3D 阴影：{argument name="main headline" default="LA PHOTONIQUE RÉVOLUTIONNE TOUT !"}。下方有 3 行较小的白色文字作为封面导读，部分关键词以黄色高亮显示，讨论超快光速芯片、名为 Lucy 的法国记录级计算机，以及为节能 AI 而被捕获数百万周期的光。中心图像：一个未来感十足的方形光子处理器芯片，以轻微的角度倾斜悬浮在太空中，具有极其精细的电路、角落处的金属螺丝、发光的线路，以及一个标有 {argument name="chip name" default="Lucy"} 的明亮青蓝色核心显示屏；芯片向外辐射出交叉的光束和流动的光纤光迹，呈现电光蓝、洋红色、橙色和紫色，向页面四周扩散。芯片背后的背景展示了 2 条发光的服务器墙走廊，左侧为红色，右侧为绿色，逐渐隐入黑暗，暗示着高科技数据中心。底部是地球从太空中看到的弯曲地平线，带有柔和的蓝色大气光晕和零星的城市灯光。总共添加 4 个侧边标注框：左侧堆叠 2 个，右侧堆叠 2 个，每个框都有黄色标题和白色正文，采用杂志封面排版层级。左侧框 1 标题："EXCLUSIF"，介绍 Lucy 作为世界上最强大的法国光子量子计算机，包含几行简短的项目符号，并以黄色强调 "12 qubits"。左侧框 2 标题："RECORD MONDIAL"，关于光在芯片中被捕获数百万周期，并以黄色强调 "millions de cycles"。右侧框 1 标题区域为黄色，带有醒目的红色百分比 "+300 %"，以及关于法国宝石公司 Soitec 得益于光子 AI 而崛起，并在能源危机期间拯救数据中心的文字。右侧框 2 标题："ENQUÊTE"，关于高功耗 GPU 的终结，包含黄色高亮显示的数字声明，如成本降低 100 倍，速度提升 1,000 倍。靠近底部中心处有微小的白色图片来源文字。页面底部有一条厚实的黑色横幅，左侧有一个包含白色加号的红色方块，以及一段白色和红色的专题预告文字：{argument name="bottom feature text" default="DOSSIER COMPLET Photonique & IA : les 10 avancées qui vont transformer votre quotidien"}。在最底部，添加 3 个小的圆形红色图标说明，配有简短的白色标题，内容涉及地震光纤、新一代 LiDAR 和 AR，以及正在推进的欧洲主权。右下角包含一个白色条形码框和一小段关于本期发售的白色文字。整体外观：轰动、高端、未来感、光泽感、信息密集、锐利的编辑排版、戏剧性的科学新闻封面、电影级灯光、高对比度、照片级真实的 3D 芯片插图与高级杂志图形设计相结合。

templates.title: WWII D-Day Cinematic Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 二战诺曼底登陆电影海报

templates.prompt: A gritty cinematic World War II movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, designed like a modern prestige war film advertisement. At the top, two centered tagline lines in condensed uppercase text read {argument name="top tagline" default="COURAGE. BROTHERHOOD. SACRIFICE."} and {argument name="second tagline" default="VICTORY COMES AT A PRICE."}. The main composition features 4 American WWII soldiers in the foreground wearing dark olive uniforms and large netted M1 helmets: 1 dominant central soldier shown from the chest up, facing forward, flanked by 3 slightly smaller soldiers receding behind him, one on the left and 2 on the right. Their faces are shadowed, dirty, battle-worn, and dramatic, with intense low-key lighting and smoky backlight. Behind them, a stormy war-torn sky filled with heavy smoke columns, sparks, embers, and 2 aircraft groups: 1 group of 3 planes on the upper left and 1 group of 5 planes on the upper right. In the middle, a small centered line of text says {argument name="based on text" default="INSPIRED BY TRUE EVENTS"}. Below it, an enormous distressed title in bold block letters reads {argument name="movie title" default="D-DAY"}, with a star used as the separator between the two D letters. Under the title, a red condensed date line reads {argument name="date text" default="JUNE 6, 1944"}. The lower half shows the D-Day beach landing from the viewpoint inside an open landing craft, with 2 dark metal ramp walls framing the left and right edges. In the surf, exactly 8 soldiers are wading toward shore with rifles and packs, surrounded by Czech hedgehog beach obstacles, rough water, smoke, distant fires, and an embattled coastline under bombardment. At the very bottom is a dense strip of tiny production credits, and beneath that a bold red release line reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}, followed by a smaller white line, "HONOR THEIR SACRIFICE.". Color palette is charcoal gray, steel blue, muddy brown, and fire orange with red accent typography. Ultra-detailed, photoreal, high contrast, moody, epic, historical, dramatic theatrical poster design, realistic film grain, volumetric smoke, distressed textures, symmetrical composition, premium blockbuster key art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满质感的二战电影海报，采用垂直单页布局，设计风格如同现代高规格战争片广告。海报顶部居中显示两行压缩大写标语：{argument name="top tagline" default="勇气。兄弟情。牺牲。"} 和 {argument name="second tagline" default="胜利的代价。"}。主体构图为 4 名身着深橄榄色制服、佩戴大网眼 M1 头盔的美国二战士兵：1 名占据主导地位的中央士兵半身像面向前方，两侧各有 3 名略小的士兵，左侧 1 名，右侧 2 名。他们的面部笼罩在阴影中，布满污垢，饱经战火，光影效果强烈，伴有烟雾缭绕的背光。背景是战火纷飞的阴沉天空，充斥着浓烟、火花、余烬以及 2 组飞机：左上方 3 架，右上方 5 架。画面中部有一行居中的小字：{argument name="based on text" default="根据真实事件改编"}。下方是巨大的粗体块状做旧标题：{argument name="movie title" default="D-DAY"}，两个 D 字母之间用星号分隔。标题下方是一行红色的压缩日期：{argument name="date text" default="1944 年 6 月 6 日"}。下半部分展示了从敞开的登陆艇内部视角看到的诺曼底登陆场景，两侧由两扇深色金属斜坡墙框住。在浪花中，共有 8 名士兵背着步枪和背包向岸边涉水前进，周围布满了捷克刺猬型路障、汹涌的海水、烟雾、远处的火光以及遭受轰炸的海岸线。最底部是一条密集的微小制作人员名单，下方是醒目的红色上映日期行：{argument name="release text" default="即将上映"}，紧随其后是一行较小的白色文字：“致敬他们的牺牲。”。色调为炭灰色、钢蓝色、泥棕色，并配以红色强调字体。超精细、写实、高对比度、情绪化、史诗感、历史感、戏剧性的影院海报设计，具有真实的胶片颗粒感、体积烟雾、做旧纹理、对称构图，是顶级大片的主视觉艺术。

templates.title: Cosmic Ink Dragon Roar

titleLocalized.zh: 宇宙墨龙吟

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical close-up of a roaring cosmic dragon head in side profile, painted in a violent ink-splatter and brushstroke style on a stark white background. The creature has a long sharp horn, angular armored facial plates, a glowing white-green eye, and a huge open mouth lined with jagged teeth. Inside the mouth and throat, instead of flesh, there is a swirling galaxy-like void of luminous {argument name="energy color" default="violet"} and magenta nebula light, with sparkling stars and dust erupting outward like cosmic fire. The dragon’s body is mostly black and deep indigo with glossy highlights, accented by iridescent emerald reflections along the neck and scales. Use expressive high-contrast sumi-e-inspired strokes, splattered paint textures, torn abstract edges, and explosive particle effects concentrated around the eye, mouth, and upper head. Composition should fill the frame with the head tilted upward in a feral scream, cropped tightly for maximum intensity, with no environment and no extra subjects, just raw abstract energy, ink, and celestial debris.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的垂直特写，展示了侧面咆哮的宇宙龙首，采用强烈的墨迹飞溅与笔触风格，背景为纯白色。生物长有尖锐的长角、棱角分明的装甲面部，眼睛闪烁着白绿色的光芒，巨大的嘴巴张开，露出参差不齐的牙齿。在口腔和喉咙深处，没有血肉，取而代之的是如星系般旋转的虚空，充满发光的 {argument name="energy color" default="violet"} 和洋红色星云光芒，闪烁的恒星与尘埃如宇宙之火般喷涌而出。龙身主要为黑色和深靛色，带有光泽感，颈部和鳞片上点缀着虹彩般的翡翠色反光。运用富有表现力、受水墨画启发的高对比度笔触、飞溅的颜料质感、撕裂的抽象边缘，以及集中在眼睛、嘴部和头顶的爆炸性粒子特效。构图应使头部向上倾斜并发出狂野的咆哮，填满整个画面，紧凑裁剪以达到极致的视觉冲击力，无需环境或其他主体，仅呈现原始的抽象能量、墨迹与天体碎片。

templates.title: Gritty Evangelion Unit-01 Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 硬核风格 Evangelion Unit-01 海报

templates.prompt: A gritty vertical anime-mecha poster in distressed screen-print style, inspired by retro military dossiers and Evangelion key art. The main subject is a massive close-up side profile of {argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"}, dominating the right two-thirds of the composition, facing left with its jaws open in a feral scream. The head is angular and biomechanical, with deep purple armor, olive-green accent plates, black metal inner structures, a single long horn projecting diagonally upward to the left, sharp teeth, and a narrow glowing eye. The surface is scratched, chipped, weathered, and inked with heavy comic-style linework. Behind it is a dark navy blueprint background filled with 8 visible technical diagram clusters, white schematic lines, anatomical overlays, cross-sections, labels, measurement marks, and interface graphics. A violent red paint slash explodes diagonally across the upper center and left side, with additional red drips running downward from the mecha’s mouth area. In the lower left corner, 1 small human figure sits hunched on a gray equipment crate: a teenage boy in a short-sleeve white school shirt, dark pants, and white sneakers, elbows on knees, looking down at a glowing handheld device, conveying isolation and anxiety. Add layered poster typography and warning graphics throughout the border: a torn yellow caution sign in the upper right with Japanese warning text and “CAUTION NERV ONLY”; a tall left sidebar with “01”, barcode-like blocks, hazard icons, and red-black labels; large distressed white kanji vertically stacked over the mecha torso; the word {argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"} in spaced red capitals beneath the kanji; a small black label reading “PILOT: {argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"}”; a bottom-right NERV logo; and footer text such as classified file markings and top secret stamps. Include 6 clearly readable English technical labels in the blueprint area: “TEST TYPE”, “BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT”, “AT FIELD”, “MAGI SYSTEM”, “INTERNAL”, and “CLASSIFIED MATERIAL”. Add Japanese dossier text blocks as authentic graphic texture. The palette is limited to dark indigo, black, crimson red, purple, olive green, dirty beige, and off-white. High contrast, torn-paper collage details, halftone texture, ink splatter, cracked paint, and worn print edges. Cinematic, oppressive, chaotic, collectible poster design, ultra-detailed, sharp, textured, no clean modern polish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张硬核风格的竖版动漫机甲海报，采用做旧丝网印刷风格，灵感源自复古军事档案和 Evangelion 关键视觉艺术。主体是 {argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"} 的巨大侧面特写，占据了构图右侧三分之二的位置，面朝左侧，下颚大张，发出狂野的咆哮。头部呈棱角分明的生物机械结构，拥有深紫色装甲、橄榄绿装饰板、黑色金属内部结构、一根向左上方斜向延伸的长角、锋利的牙齿以及一只狭长的发光眼睛。表面布满划痕、缺口和风化痕迹，并配有厚重的漫画风格线条。背景为深海军蓝色的蓝图，布满了 8 组清晰可见的技术图表、白色示意线条、解剖叠层、横截面、标签、测量标记和界面图形。一道狂暴的红色油漆斜向划过画面上部中心和左侧，机甲嘴部区域还有额外的红色滴落效果。在左下角，1 个小小的少年人影蜷缩在灰色设备箱上：他穿着短袖白衬衫、深色长裤和白色运动鞋，手肘撑在膝盖上，低头看着手中的发光设备，传达出孤独与焦虑感。在边框处添加分层海报排版和警示图形：右上角有一张破损的黄色警示标志，印有日文警告文字和“CAUTION NERV ONLY”；左侧长条边栏印有“01”、条形码状方块、危险图标以及红黑标签；机甲躯干上方垂直堆叠着巨大的做旧白色汉字；汉字下方是间距拉开的红色大写单词 {argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"}；下方有一个黑色小标签，写着“PILOT: {argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"}”；右下角印有 NERV 标志；页脚处包含机密文件标记和绝密印章。在蓝图区域包含 6 个清晰可辨的英文技术标签：“TEST TYPE”、“BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT”、“AT FIELD”、“MAGI SYSTEM”、“INTERNAL”和“CLASSIFIED MATERIAL”。添加日文档案文本块作为真实的图形纹理。色调限制为深靛蓝、黑色、深红色、紫色、橄榄绿、脏米色和灰白色。高对比度，撕纸拼贴细节，半色调纹理，墨水飞溅，裂纹漆面，磨损的印刷边缘。电影感、压抑、混乱、收藏级海报设计，超精细，锐利，富有质感，拒绝干净的现代感。

templates.title: Dark Manga Monster Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑漫画风怪物海报

templates.prompt: A dark monochrome manga-style horror illustration on a pure black background, in a tall vertical poster composition. Centered at the bottom is a small lonely teenage boy with messy short dark hair, sitting on the ground with his knees pulled to his chest and his arms wrapped around them, head slightly bowed, conveying fear, isolation, and helplessness. Towering over him is a gigantic biomechanical demon or armored monster head descending from above, with a long angular skull-like face, sharp chin, narrow hollow eye sockets, layered helmet-like plates, and a jagged open mouth. Surrounding the boy are exactly 2 enormous skeletal clawed hands, one on the left and one on the right, framing him like a cage; each hand has long segmented metallic fingers ending in sharp pointed tips, bent inward menacingly. Render everything in rough scratchy white ink linework and heavy crosshatching against deep black, with intense high-contrast seinen manga energy. Add vivid neon purple paint-like liquid in splashes and long dripping streaks from the monster’s face, the hands, and the ground, pooling around the boy for the only strong color accent. On the upper right side, add vertical Japanese text reading 逃げちゃダメだ, and beneath it in small white English text: EGO BORDER: ACTIVE. The mood is oppressive, psychological, claustrophobic, and nightmarish, like a dark anime poster about inner fear and mental collapse.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张纯黑背景下的暗黑单色漫画风恐怖插画，采用竖版海报构图。画面底部中心是一个孤独的短发少年，他坐在地上，双膝蜷缩抱在胸前，头微微低垂，传达出恐惧、孤立和无助感。在他上方，一个巨大的生物机械恶魔或装甲怪物头颅正俯冲而下，有着长而有棱角的骷髅状面孔、尖锐的下巴、狭窄空洞的眼眶、层叠的头盔状甲片以及锯齿状的张开大嘴。男孩周围有 2 只巨大的骨骼利爪，左右各一，像牢笼一样将他围住；每只手都有长长的分段式金属手指，指尖尖锐，向内弯曲，极具威胁感。整体采用粗犷的白色划痕线条和厚重的交叉排线，在深黑色背景下呈现出强烈的对比，极具青年漫画（Seinen manga）的张力。在怪物的脸部、利爪和地面上添加鲜艳的霓虹紫色液体泼溅和长长的滴落痕迹，汇聚在男孩周围，成为画面中唯一的强色彩点缀。在右上角添加竖排日文文字“逃げちゃダメだ”，并在其下方添加白色小字英文：EGO BORDER: ACTIVE。整体氛围压抑、心理化、幽闭且充满梦魇感，宛如一张关于内心恐惧与精神崩溃的暗黑动漫海报。

She has {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} long loose wavy hair with a middle part, glossy shine, and soft volume falling over both shoulders. templates.prompt: A realistic outdoor sports portrait of two American football players standing side by side on a waterfront path with the Golden Gate Bridge filling the background on a bright clear day. The player on the left wears a muddy white jersey with the large black number 10, white football pants, black undersleeves, and holds a white helmet at his side. The player on the right wears a muddy dark navy jersey with the large white number 23, white football pants, a white long-sleeve undershirt, and holds a white helmet at his side. Their uniforms are visibly grass-stained and dirty from play. Behind them is blue water, a rocky shoreline, a heavy rust-colored chain barrier, distant hills, and the red-orange towers and suspension cables of the Golden Gate Bridge. Natural daylight, documentary-style sports photography, shallow depth of field, sharp fabric texture, realistic anatomy, candid team-bonding mood. promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的户外体育肖像，两名美式橄榄球运动员并肩站在水滨小径上，背景是晴朗天气下的金门大桥。左侧球员身穿沾满泥土的白色球衣，印有醒目的黑色数字 10，穿着白色橄榄球裤，内搭黑色长袖，身侧拿着一个白色头盔。右侧球员身穿沾满泥土的深海军蓝球衣，印有醒目的白色数字 23，穿着白色橄榄球裤，内搭白色长袖，身侧拿着一个白色头盔。两位运动员均为半身像（从躯干到大腿），面向镜头，内侧手臂搭在对方肩上，呈现出友好的赛后姿态。他们的制服上清晰可见比赛留下的草渍和污垢。背景是蓝色的水面、岩石海岸线、厚重的铁锈色铁链护栏、远处的山丘，以及金门大桥红橙色的桥塔和悬索。自然光，纪实风格体育摄影，浅景深，织物纹理清晰，人体结构逼真，展现团队凝聚力的抓拍氛围。为保护隐私，请用平滑的矩形模糊块遮挡两人的面部。

templates.prompt: A faithful oil-painting parody of the Mona Lisa in the style of a High Renaissance museum masterpiece, waist-up seated portrait with folded hands, dark brown dress, translucent veil, soft golden-brown sfumato lighting, and the classic hazy landscape with winding paths, water, and rocky hills in the background. Replace the entire face area with a single flat rectangular censor block in {argument name="censor color" default="medium brown"}, centered over the head and covering from forehead to chin, with clean hard edges that contrast against the painterly surface. Keep the hair visible around the block, including light brown hair parted at the top and falling over the shoulders. Preserve the aged varnish look, muted earthy palette, subtle craquelure-like texture, and solemn museum-quality composition. Vertical framing, centered subject, realistic proportions, old master brushwork, dramatic but soft shading.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅忠实于文艺复兴盛期博物馆杰作风格的蒙娜丽莎油画恶搞作品，半身坐姿肖像，双手交叠，身着深棕色长裙，佩戴半透明面纱，采用柔和的棕金色晕涂法（sfumato）光影，背景为经典的朦胧风景，包含蜿蜒小径、水域和岩石山丘。将整个面部区域替换为一个平整的矩形审查遮挡块，颜色为 {argument name="censor color" default="medium brown"}，位于头部中心，覆盖范围从前额至下巴，边缘清晰硬朗，与绘画质感形成鲜明对比。保留遮挡块周围可见的头发，包括顶部中分并垂在肩上的浅棕色秀发。保留陈旧的清漆感、柔和的大地色调、细微的裂纹质感以及庄重的博物馆级构图。竖构图，主体居中，比例写实，大师级笔触，光影戏剧性且柔和。

templates.title: Chaotic Road Trip Comedy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 混乱公路旅行喜剧海报

templates.prompt: A bright, chaotic theatrical comedy movie poster in a polished Hollywood one-sheet style, vertical composition, with a retro yellow Mini Cooper speeding straight toward the viewer down a sunny palm-lined city street. The car is packed with exactly 5 vacationing friends: 2 visible in the front seats, 2 partially visible squeezed in the back, and 1 man sprawled on the roof luggage, pointing dramatically forward with a wild grin. Everyone wears colorful casual vacation clothes, including tropical prints, relaxed shirts, and sun hats. The scene feels loud, reckless, and fun. On the roof are stacked suitcases and travel bags. A police car with flashing lights chases from the rear right background. On the left side, a crooked wooden signpost has exactly 3 signs reading "BEACH", "MOUNTAINS", and "WHAT COULD GO WRONG?". A squawking seagull perches on top of the signpost. On the right side, a giant roadside donut shop sign reads "DONUT" and a folded paper map flies through the air. The street is full of motion blur, dust, debris, and tire energy, with a saturated blue sky and fluffy clouds above. At the very top, place exactly 4 actor names in black condensed caps: "DAVE JOHNSON", "LILY WANG", "KEVIN HARTLEY", and "AMY CHEN". Beneath that, add a stacked tagline in bold caps: "THEY CAME. THEY SAW." in dark navy, and "THEY MESSED EVERYTHING UP." in red. The main title dominates the upper middle in huge playful 3D typography: "{argument name="movie title" default="VACATION MODE"}", with "VACATION" in bright yellow and "MODE" in white, heavy blue shadowing, and the O replaced by a simple smiling face wearing sunglasses. Add small doodle-like yellow accent marks around the title. Across the lower right of the title, place a tilted hot-pink banner reading "A COMEDY ABOUT BAD IDEAS & GOOD TIMES" with a hand-drawn curved arrow pointing down. The car license plate reads "NO PLAN ALL FUN". Near the bottom, add a glowing pull-quote in yellow: "LAUGH-OUT-LOUD FUNNY!" and below it "- MOVIE BUZZ". At the bottom center, add the release line "ONLY IN THEATERS" and then "{argument name="release date" default="JUNE 20"}" in large bold yellow caps. Add tiny legal credits along the very bottom edge and small production logos in the corners, including "GOOD TIME FILMS" on the lower left and "NO PLAN ALL FUN" on the lower right. Use high-contrast lighting, exaggerated perspective, glossy commercial poster finish, vibrant summer colors, and a goofy road-trip comedy tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、混乱的院线喜剧电影海报，采用精致的好莱坞单张海报风格，垂直构图。一辆复古黄色 Mini Cooper 正沿着阳光明媚、棕榈树成荫的城市街道向观众疾驰而来。车内挤满了 5 位度假的朋友：前排可见 2 人，后排挤着 2 人，另有 1 名男子趴在车顶行李架上，咧着嘴大笑，戏剧性地指向前方。每个人都穿着色彩鲜艳的休闲度假服装，包括热带印花、宽松衬衫和遮阳帽。场景显得喧闹、鲁莽且充满乐趣。车顶堆放着行李箱和旅行包。右后方有一辆闪烁着警灯的警车正在追赶。左侧有一个歪斜的木制路标，上面有 3 个牌子，分别写着“BEACH”（海滩）、“MOUNTAINS”（山脉）和“WHAT COULD GO WRONG?”（还能出什么差错？）。一只尖叫的海鸥停在路标顶端。右侧有一个巨大的路边甜甜圈店招牌，上面写着“DONUT”，一张折叠的纸质地图在空中飞舞。街道上充满了动态模糊、灰尘、碎片和轮胎留下的能量感，上方是饱和的蓝天和蓬松的云朵。在最顶部，放置 4 位演员的姓名，使用黑色压缩大写字母：“DAVE JOHNSON”、“LILY WANG”、“KEVIN HARTLEY”和“AMY CHEN”。下方添加一行堆叠的标语，使用粗体大写字母：深海军蓝色的“THEY CAME. THEY SAW.”，以及红色的“THEY MESSED EVERYTHING UP.”。主标题以巨大的趣味 3D 字体占据中上方：“{argument name="movie title" default="VACATION MODE"}”，其中“VACATION”为亮黄色，“MODE”为白色，带有厚重的蓝色阴影，字母 O 被一个戴着太阳镜的简单笑脸取代。在标题周围添加黄色的小涂鸦式强调符号。在标题右下方，放置一个倾斜的亮粉色横幅，上面写着“A COMEDY ABOUT BAD IDEAS & GOOD TIMES”（一部关于坏主意与好时光的喜剧），并配有一个指向下方的手绘弯曲箭头。汽车牌照上写着“NO PLAN ALL FUN”。在底部附近，添加一句黄色的发光引语：“LAUGH-OUT-LOUD FUNNY!”，下方写着“- MOVIE BUZZ”。在底部中心，添加上映信息“ONLY IN THEATERS”，然后是“{argument name="release date" default="JUNE 20"}”，使用醒目的黄色粗体大写字母。在最底边缘添加微小的法律声明，并在角落添加小型制作公司 Logo，包括左下角的“GOOD TIME FILMS”和右下角的“NO PLAN ALL FUN”。采用高对比度照明、夸张的透视效果、光泽感的商业海报质感、鲜艳的夏季色彩以及搞怪的公路旅行喜剧基调。

templates.title: Dark Space Emperor Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 《Dark Space Emperor》电影海报

templates.prompt: A dark epic sci-fi movie poster for {argument name="film title" default="EMPIRE OF THE VOID"}, in a highly cinematic photorealistic space-opera style. Centered composition with a tall alien emperor standing behind a massive circular command table, viewed from slightly below to make the figure feel imposing and godlike. The emperor wears ornate black and gunmetal biomechanical armor with sharp layered pauldrons, engraved metallic filigree, a long dark cloak, and a regal elongated helmet-crown. The face is mostly obscured in shadow, giving a mysterious, intimidating presence. One large clawed hand rests prominently on the glowing table in the foreground. The command table displays a luminous spiral galaxy hologram in blue-violet tones, with concentric interface rings and subtle cosmic light. The setting is the bridge of a colossal starship or throne room, with two curved panoramic windows framing outer space. Outside the windows are 8 visible spacecraft total: 4 on the left side and 4 on the right side, including several large battleships and smaller escort vessels. A huge planet fills much of the left background, while the right background shows a purple-blue nebula and starfield. Two secondary alien officers are seated in the mid-background, 1 on the left and 1 on the right, each at glowing futuristic control consoles. The color palette is deep black, steel gray, indigo, violet, and cold blue, with dramatic rim lighting, glossy metallic reflections, and dense atmospheric shadows. The layout should feel like a premium blockbuster poster: a centered top tagline in small uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline" default="INTELLIGENCE. DOMINION. DESTINY. THE GALAXY BOWS TO NONE."}, the giant title near the bottom in elegant spaced serif capitals with the words {argument name="main title" default="EMPIRE"} on the first line and {argument name="subtitle" default="OF THE VOID"} below it, with the letter O stylized as a glowing black-hole eclipse. Beneath that, add a glowing imperial trident-like emblem centered above the release line {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}. At the very bottom, include a dense strip of tiny production credits in authentic movie-poster typography. Ultra-detailed, symmetrical, ominous, imperial, galactic conquest mood, vertical one-sheet poster, premium VFX key art, sharp focus, high contrast, dramatic sci-fi lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑暗史诗科幻电影海报，适用于 {argument name="film title" default="EMPIRE OF THE VOID"}，采用极具电影感的写实太空歌剧风格。构图居中，一位高大的外星皇帝站在巨大的圆形指挥台后，采用低角度仰拍视角，使人物显得威严且如神明般不可侵犯。皇帝身着华丽的黑色与枪灰色生物机械盔甲，配有锋利的层叠肩甲、雕刻精美的金属丝饰、长长的深色斗篷以及高贵的长形头盔冠冕。面部大部分隐藏在阴影中，营造出神秘而令人生畏的气场。一只巨大的利爪手部显眼地放在前景中发光的桌面上。指挥台显示着蓝紫色调的发光螺旋星系全息图，带有同心圆界面环和微妙的宇宙光芒。场景设定在一艘巨型星舰的舰桥或王座室中，两扇弧形全景窗框住了外太空。窗外总共可见 8 艘宇宙飞船：左侧 4 艘，右侧 4 艘，包括几艘大型战舰和较小的护航舰。一颗巨大的行星占据了左侧背景的大部分，而右侧背景则展示了紫蓝色的星云和星场。两名次要的外星军官坐在中景背景中，左侧 1 名，右侧 1 名，每人都在发光的未来派控制台前。色调为深黑、钢灰、靛蓝、紫罗兰和冷蓝色，带有戏剧性的轮廓光、光泽的金属反射和浓郁的氛围阴影。布局应呈现出高端大片海报的质感：顶部居中处为小号大写字母组成的标语 {argument name="tagline" default="INTELLIGENCE. DOMINION. DESTINY. THE GALAXY BOWS TO NONE."}，底部附近为优雅且字间距宽阔的衬线大写字母标题，第一行是 {argument name="main title" default="EMPIRE"}，下方是 {argument name="subtitle" default="OF THE VOID"}，其中字母 O 设计为发光的黑洞日食样式。在此下方，添加一个发光的帝国三叉戟式徽章，居中放置在发行日期文本 {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"} 上方。最底部包含一条由微小电影海报排版风格组成的密集制作人员名单。超精细、对称、险恶、帝国风、银河征服氛围、垂直单张海报、高级 VFX 关键视觉图、清晰对焦、高对比度、戏剧性科幻灯光。

templates.title: Ancient Scroll Scholar Riding Dragon

titleLocalized.zh: 骑龙古卷学者

templates.prompt: An ancient Chinese ink-and-wash style portrait on aged tan parchment, composed like a classical hanging scroll. A scholarly East Asian man in flowing gray-blue robes sits side-saddle atop a long serpentine Chinese dragon emerging through swirling clouds. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in parchment-brown tones. He has short dark curly hair and wears layered traditional robes with ornate patterned trim, a dark sash belt, and two modern OpenAI knot emblems worked into the costume: one printed on the chest and one on a round hand fan he holds upright in his right hand. His left hand rests near the dragon's mane as if holding the creature steady. The dragon is large and detailed, with blue-green scales, a pale underbelly, reddish-brown mane and fin accents, antler-like horns, whiskers, bared teeth, and a fierce expressive face in the lower left foreground, while its body coils upward to the upper right. Surround the figures with mist, stylized clouds, and steep craggy mountain peaks fading into the background. Add a vertical column of black Chinese calligraphy at the upper left and 3 red seal stamps near the lower part of the inscription area. The palette is muted, dusty, and antique: parchment beige, faded teal, moss green, smoky gray, sepia, and rust. Overall feeling: mythical, scholarly, dignified, slightly surreal, blending classical Chinese scroll painting with subtle modern AI iconography. Highly detailed brushwork, weathered paper texture, elegant composition, no border, full-frame vertical artwork.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅中国水墨风格的古老肖像，绘于陈旧的棕褐色羊皮纸上，构图如同古典立轴。一位东亚学者身着飘逸的灰蓝色长袍，侧身骑在一条穿梭于云雾间的长身中国龙背上。他的面部被一块羊皮纸棕色的矩形模糊色块刻意遮挡。他留着深色短卷发，身穿带有华丽花边饰边的多层传统长袍，系着深色腰带；服装上巧妙融入了两个现代 OpenAI 结状徽章：一个印在胸前，另一个印在他右手竖持的圆形团扇上。他的左手靠近龙鬃，仿佛在稳住龙身。巨龙体型庞大且细节丰富，拥有蓝绿色的鳞片、苍白的腹部、红棕色的鬃毛与鳍状装饰、鹿角状的角、龙须、露出的牙齿，以及左下角前景中那张凶猛而生动的面孔，龙身则向右上角盘旋而上。人物周围环绕着薄雾、风格化的云朵以及逐渐淡入背景的陡峭山峰。在左上方添加一列黑色中国书法，并在题字区域下方添加 3 枚红色印章。色调柔和、陈旧且充满古韵：羊皮纸米色、褪色的青色、苔藓绿、烟灰色、深褐色和铁锈红。整体意境：神话感、书卷气、庄重且略带超现实感，将中国古典卷轴画与微妙的现代 AI 图标融为一体。笔触细腻，纸张纹理斑驳，构图优雅，无边框，全画幅垂直艺术作品。

templates.title: Surreal Skull and Tree of Consciousness

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实头骨与意识之树

templates.prompt: A surreal, ultra-detailed fantasy illustration of a large weathered human skull rising from dark water, centered in the frame, with the top of the skull opened like a pedestal supporting a giant transparent glass sphere. Inside the sphere stands an intricate luminous tree made of twisting golden branches and roots, with exactly 1 main trunk, dozens of tiny warm glowing orbs embedded among the branches, and many metallic bronze leaves. The roots spread across the base inside the globe and wrap around a small ladder built into the trunk. At the lower left inside the globe, depict exactly 1 translucent seated human figure in a contemplative pose, knees drawn up, head resting on one hand, holding a small glowing flower or crystalline bloom in the other hand. On the lower right inside the globe, include exactly 1 miniature architectural tower-like structure made of delicate gold framework. Surrounding the sphere and background are ornate branch networks with hanging crystal ornaments, faceted gemstones, suspended droplets, circular glass forms, and metallic leaves, all arranged symmetrically but organically. The skull is highly realistic with deep eye sockets, detailed teeth, cracked bone texture, and fine copper-like tubes and circuitry extending from both sides near the temples. In the skull’s right eye socket, show exactly 1 glowing mechanical orrery-like light structure. Place the whole composition in a dreamlike seascape at dusk with calm reflective water, distant rock spires, soft clouds, and a blue-to-gold sky. Use cinematic lighting, high contrast, sharp focus, mystical atmosphere, luxurious gold and bronze filigree, crystal transparency, and a color palette of deep teal, midnight blue, ivory bone, warm amber, and metallic gold. Make it feel like symbolic metacognition, consciousness contained within mortality, blending dark surrealism, baroque ornament, and ethereal sci-fi fantasy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超现实、极致细节的奇幻插画，画面中心是一个巨大的风化人类头骨，从深色水域中升起。头骨顶部像底座一样打开，支撑着一个巨大的透明玻璃球。球体内矗立着一棵错综复杂的发光树，由扭曲的金色枝干和根系组成，拥有 1 根主干，枝叶间嵌入了数十个微小的温暖发光球体，并点缀着许多青铜质感的金属叶片。根系在球体内部底部蔓延，并缠绕在树干上的一架小型梯子上。在球体内部左下方，描绘 1 个半透明的坐姿人形，姿态沉思，双膝蜷缩，头部靠在一只手上，另一只手拿着一朵发光的小花或水晶花。在球体内部右下方，包含 1 座由精致金框架构成的微型建筑塔状结构。球体周围和背景是华丽的树枝网络，挂着水晶装饰、多面宝石、悬浮的水滴、圆形玻璃形态和金属叶片，整体布局对称且有机。头骨高度写实，具有深邃的眼眶、细致的牙齿、开裂的骨骼纹理，以及从太阳穴附近两侧延伸出的精细铜管和电路。在头骨的右眼眶内，展示 1 个发光的机械式天体仪状光源结构。将整个构图置于黄昏时分的梦幻海景中，背景是平静的反射水面、远处的岩石尖塔、柔和的云层以及从蓝色过渡到金色的天空。采用电影级光效、高对比度、清晰对焦、神秘氛围，结合奢华的黄金与青铜花丝工艺、水晶透明度，色调采用深青色、午夜蓝、象牙骨色、暖琥珀色和金属金色。营造出一种象征性的元认知感，即禁锢在死亡之中的意识，融合了黑暗超现实主义、巴洛克装饰和空灵的科幻奇幻风格。

templates.title: Ancient Scroll Google DeepMind Vision

titleLocalized.zh: Ancient Scroll Google DeepMind Vision

templates.prompt: A sepia-toned ancient Chinese scroll painting reimagined as a visionary propaganda-style scene. In the center stands a scholarly robed figure styled like an imperial sage or philosopher, wearing flowing blue-gray hanfu with ornate trim, addressing a crowd of exactly 8 followers seen mostly from behind in the foreground. The sage’s face is intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur, and 3 members of the crowd also have blurred rectangular faces. The central figure raises one hand in a teaching gesture and holds a glowing geometric polyhedron crystal in the other hand. Behind him is a monumental hanging banner or framed plaque displaying the Google DeepMind logo and the words “Google DeepMind.” The background is a richly detailed traditional shanshui landscape with layered mountains, mist, trees, rocky formations, and a pagoda temple on the right. Along the upper right side, include vertical Chinese calligraphy text headed by “德米斯願景圖,” followed by several elegant columns of classical-style writing, plus a smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps. Use aged paper texture, muted brown ink, faded mineral pigments, fine linework, and the composition of a historic Chinese hanging scroll or literati painting, but with subtle anachronistic modern-AI symbolism. The overall mood is solemn, mythic, intellectual, and satirical, blending traditional East Asian art with corporate AI iconography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅深褐色调的中国古代卷轴画，被重新构想为具有愿景感的宣传风格场景。画面中央站着一位学者模样的长袍人物，造型如同帝国圣贤或哲学家，身着饰有华丽镶边的飘逸蓝灰色汉服，正对着前景中 8 位主要以背影示人的追随者讲学。圣贤的面部被刻意用一个纯色矩形模糊处理，人群中也有 3 位成员的面部呈现同样的矩形模糊。中央人物一手做出教导的手势，另一只手托着一颗发光的几何多面体水晶。在他身后是一面巨大的悬挂横幅或牌匾，上面展示着 Google DeepMind 的标志和“Google DeepMind”字样。背景是细节丰富的传统山水景观，包含层峦叠嶂、云雾、树木、岩石构造以及右侧的一座宝塔。在右上侧，加入以“德米斯願景圖”为标题的竖排中文书法，随后是几列优雅的古典风格文字，外加一行较小的竖排签名和 2 枚红色印章。采用陈旧的纸张纹理、柔和的棕色墨水、褪色的矿物颜料、细腻的线条，以及历史悠久的中国挂轴或文人画构图，但融入了微妙的时代错位现代 AI 象征意义。整体氛围庄重、神圣、知性且具有讽刺意味，将东亚传统艺术与企业 AI 图像学融为一体。
