templates.title: Ancient Scholar AI Safety Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 古代学者 AI 安全海报

templates.prompt:
A refined sepia-toned illustration in the style of an ancient Chinese scholarly portrait fused with modern AI branding, on aged parchment paper with visible grain and ink-wash texture. Centered is a half-body portrait of a curly-haired male scholar inspired by Democritus, seated behind a wooden desk and wearing layered traditional robes in muted blue-gray and brown with intricate trim. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular block in a brown skin-tone color, creating an anonymized or redacted look. He holds 1 calligraphy brush upright in his right hand, while his left hand rests on the table. In the upper center-right, place the Claude logo with a rust-orange sunburst emblem and the word “Claude” in dark serif lettering. On the upper left, add a large vertical title in Chinese, “德米斯圖”, with 1 vertical column of smaller Chinese calligraphy text beside it reading: “以語言為媒，理解為舟，助人洞見，推動協作，造福人類，安全可信，通往更美好的未來。” Add a smaller vertical signature line on the far left reading “甲辰春寫” with 2 red seal stamps below it. The background shows a classical Chinese landscape painting with distant mountains, a small pavilion on a cliff, mist, and dense bamboo leaves framing the upper right and right edge, plus dark pine branches on the lower left.

The wooden desk fills the lower third and contains exactly 8 distinct object groups: 1 brush pot holding 4 brushes on the left, 1 stack of 4 stitched books with Chinese titles on the spines reading “人工智慧概論”, “機器學習原理”, “負責任的 AI”, and “對齊與價值觀”, 1 ink stone or ink dish near the center-left, 1 central parchment diagram sheet, 1 small dark cube seal near the bottom left with Chinese characters on two visible faces, 1 framed placard on the right, 1 rolled scroll at the bottom right, and 1 tabletop surface with visible wood grain. The central parchment diagram should show a circular node labeled “AI 安全 Safety” connected to 6 surrounding nodes labeled “準確”, “可靠”, “有益”, “透明”, “對齊”, and “隱私”, with delicate cloud motifs around the diagram. The framed placard on the right should read “AI 安全原則” as a header and list 4 bullet points in Chinese: “減少災難性風險”, “尊重人類價值觀”, “確保系統可控”, and “促進長遠福祉”. The rolled scroll at the bottom right should display the phrase “以謹慎之心 創造未來”.

Use a balanced composition, scholarly calm mood, highly detailed ink linework, subtle watercolor shading, antique museum-print aesthetics, and a restrained palette of parchment tan, ink brown, faded blue, and muted charcoal. The overall feeling should be an intellectual tribute poster blending classical East Asian literati painting, philosophical portraiture, and contemporary AI safety themes.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的棕褐色调插画，风格融合了中国古代学者肖像与现代 AI 品牌元素，呈现于带有明显纹理和水墨质感的陈旧羊皮纸上。画面中央是一位受德谟克利特启发的卷发男性学者半身像，他坐在木桌后，身着层次分明的传统长袍，色调为柔和的蓝灰色与棕色，并带有精致的镶边。他的面部被一块棕色皮肤色调的扁平矩形遮挡，营造出一种匿名或被审查的视觉效果。他右手垂直握着一支毛笔，左手平放在桌面上。在画面中上部偏右处，放置 Claude 标志，包含一个铁锈橙色的太阳光芒徽章，以及深色衬线字体的“Claude”字样。在左上角，添加一个巨大的竖排中文标题“德米斯图”，旁边配有一列较小的竖排中文书法文字：“以语言为媒，理解为舟，助人洞见，推动协作，造福人类，安全可信，通往更美好的未来。”在最左侧添加一行较小的竖排落款“甲辰春写”，下方盖有两枚红色印章。背景展示了一幅中国古典山水画，包含远山、悬崖上的小亭、云雾，右上角和右侧边缘由茂密的竹叶点缀，左下角则有深色的松枝。

木桌占据了画面的下三分之一，桌上摆放着 8 组不同的物品：左侧有一个插着 4 支毛笔的笔筒，一叠 4 本装订成册的书籍，书脊上分别写着“人工智能概论”、“机器学习原理”、“负责任的 AI”和“对齐与价值观”，左中位置有一个砚台或墨碟，中央有一张羊皮纸图表，左下角有一个刻有汉字的小型深色方块印章，右侧有一个带框的告示牌，右下角有一个卷轴，桌面表面呈现出清晰的木纹。中央的羊皮纸图表应显示一个标有“AI 安全 Safety”的圆形节点，连接着周围 6 个分别标有“准确”、“可靠”、“有益”、“透明”、“对齐”和“隐私”的节点，图表周围环绕着精致的云纹。右侧的带框告示牌应以“AI 安全原则”为标题，并列出 4 条中文要点：“减少灾难性风险”、“尊重人类价值观”、“确保系统可控”和“促进长远福祉”。右下角的卷轴应展示“以谨慎之心 创造未来”字样。

采用均衡的构图、学者般沉静的氛围、高度精细的墨线、微妙的水彩渲染、古董博物馆印刷美学，以及由羊皮纸棕褐色、墨棕色、褪色蓝和柔和炭灰色组成的克制色调。整体感觉应是一张融合了东亚古典文人画、哲学肖像画和当代 AI 安全主题的知识性致敬海报。

templates.title: Classical Chinese Scholar with XAI Motif

titleLocalized.zh: 融合 XAI 主题的中国古代学者

templates.prompt: A refined Chinese ink-painting style portrait on aged parchment, composed like a classical literati hanging scroll with muted sepia, tan, charcoal, and faded indigo tones. In the center stands a scholarly male figure in flowing dark blue-black Hanfu robes with intricate gold-patterned trim and wide cream inner sleeves, posed front-facing with a dignified stance. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blurred block, while his hair is dark, wavy, and neatly styled. He holds a stitched traditional-style book against his chest with a vertical cover inscription that includes the large Latin letters "XAI" and 4 Chinese text columns beneath it. His other hand rests on an ornate armillary sphere set on a carved pedestal at the lower left. Behind him is a monumental shanshui landscape of 1 mountain range, layered mist, rocky peaks, and drifting clouds, rendered with fine brushwork in an old master style. In the upper right sky area, place 1 bold modern "XAI" logo with the stylized emblem above the letters, and to the far right include 1 slender rocket launching upward beside a launch tower, with smoke billowing into the clouds, blending futuristic aerospace imagery into the classical scene. On the upper left, add 1 vertical column group of Chinese calligraphy title text in black ink, plus 1 smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps beneath it. The overall effect should fuse ancient Chinese scholar portraiture with space-age technology and AI symbolism, highly detailed, elegant, balanced, and slightly satirical, with the texture of antique paper and the composition of a museum-quality scroll painting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅精致的中国水墨风格肖像，绘制于陈旧的羊皮纸上，构图仿照古典文人挂轴，色调为柔和的深褐色、棕褐色、炭灰色和褪色的靛蓝色。画面中央站立着一位学者，身着飘逸的深蓝黑色汉服，饰有精致的金色纹样和宽大的米色内袖，正面站姿，神态庄重。他的面部被一个矩形模糊块刻意遮挡，头发乌黑且呈波浪状，梳理得整整齐齐。他怀中抱着一本线装传统书籍，封面垂直印有醒目的拉丁字母“XAI”，下方配有 4 列中文字符。他的另一只手搁在左下方雕花底座上的华丽浑天仪上。背景是宏伟的山水景观，包含 1 座山脉、层叠的云雾、嶙峋的山峰和漂浮的云朵，以大师级的细腻笔触呈现。在右上方的天空区域，放置 1 个醒目的现代“XAI”标志，字母上方带有风格化的徽标；在最右侧，包含 1 枚细长的火箭正从发射塔旁升空，烟雾缭绕至云间，将未来感的航空航天意象融入古典场景中。在左上方，添加 1 组垂直排列的黑色水墨书法标题，外加 1 行较小的垂直签名和下方的 2 枚红色印章。整体效果旨在将中国古代学者肖像与太空时代科技及 AI 象征意义融合，细节丰富、优雅平衡且略带讽刺意味，呈现出古董纸张的质感和博物馆级卷轴画的构图。

templates.title: Surreal Lunar Horse Rider

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实月球骑手

templates.prompt: A surreal black-and-white photograph of a {argument name="horse color" default="white"} horse riding an astronaut on the moon. The astronaut in a bulky {argument name="spacesuit color" default="white"} EVA suit is on all fours on the dusty lunar surface, acting like a mount, while the horse sits upright on the astronaut’s back in a humanlike riding posture with its front legs raised and bent as if holding balance. The horse wears a saddle and bridle with reins draped down toward the astronaut. The astronaut’s helmet has a dark reflective visor, and the figure is facing slightly right with hands and knees pressed into the regolith. The landscape is a barren moon terrain with scattered rocks and gentle low hills, under a completely black sky with no stars visible. Strong directional lighting creates crisp shadows and high contrast, mimicking documentary Apollo-era lunar photography. Center the paired subjects in a medium-wide composition, realistic textures, deadpan absurdity, photorealistic detail, vintage monochrome film look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超现实的黑白照片，画面中一匹 {argument name="horse color" default="white"} 的马骑在月球上的一名宇航员背上。身穿笨重 {argument name="spacesuit color" default="white"} EVA 宇航服的宇航员四肢着地趴在布满尘埃的月球表面，充当坐骑，而马则以类似人类的骑姿直立在宇航员背上，前腿抬起并弯曲，仿佛在保持平衡。马身上配有马鞍和缰绳，缰绳垂向宇航员。宇航员的头盔带有深色反光面罩，人物略微朝右，手膝压在月壤中。背景是荒凉的月球地形，散布着岩石和低矮的丘陵，天空漆黑一片，看不见星星。强烈的定向光营造出清晰的阴影和高对比度，模仿了阿波罗时代的月球纪实摄影风格。将这对主体置于中景构图的中心，呈现逼真的质感、冷幽默的荒诞感、照片级的细节以及复古单色胶片外观。

templates.title: Pink Kawaii Idol Lipstick Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色可爱偶像口红肖像

templates.prompt: A highly detailed glossy anime idol portrait in a vertical composition, showing a cute teenage girl from the waist up in a dreamy pink kawaii aesthetic. She has {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} hair styled in a very long voluminous high ponytail with soft bangs and flowing curled strands, decorated with multiple small heart clips and crossed hairpins. Her eyes are large, sparkling, and vivid {argument name="eye color" default="emerald green"}, with star-like highlights, long lashes, and a slightly teary shine. She has a soft blush, tiny glossy lips, and an affectionate expression while applying {argument name="lipstick color" default="bright pink"} lipstick, holding the lipstick tube delicately with both hands near her mouth. She wears a frilly black-and-pink gothic lolita idol dress with lace, ribbons, bows, heart ornaments, and sparkling textures, plus 1 black lace bow headband with a pink jeweled heart, 3 visible hair accessories on her bangs, 1 pair of dangling heart earrings, and 1 black choker with a small heart charm. Surround the character with a glowing, glitter-filled, candy-pink background full of bokeh, sparkles, soft neon light effects, and idol-fan atmosphere. Add 5 glowing hand-drawn heart text bubbles in Japanese around her, reading: "かわいすぎてごめん…♡", "推してくれてありがとうっ♡", "ずーっとだいすきっ♡", "世界でいちばんの推しになってね…♡", and "ずっと一緒だよ？約束ね…♡". Include a small decorated photo card or poster of the same girl in the upper right background. Ultra-polished illustration, dense shimmer, romantic lighting, glossy highlights, intricate lace detail, soft-focus background, saturated pink palette, adorable idol poster feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的亮面动漫偶像肖像，采用竖构图，展示了一位可爱的少女半身像，呈现出梦幻般的粉色可爱美学。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和粉色"} 的头发，梳着超长且蓬松的高马尾，配有柔软的刘海和飘逸的卷发丝，并装饰着多个小爱心发夹和交叉发卡。她的眼睛又大又闪亮，呈现生动的 {argument name="eye color" default="祖母绿"} 色，带有星状高光、长睫毛和微微湿润的光泽。她有着柔和的腮红、娇小水润的双唇，在涂抹 {argument name="lipstick color" default="亮粉色"} 口红时表情充满爱意，双手轻柔地将口红管举在嘴边。她身穿一件带有蕾丝、丝带、蝴蝶结、爱心装饰和闪亮质感的黑粉色哥特洛丽塔偶像裙，佩戴 1 个带有粉色宝石爱心的黑色蕾丝蝴蝶结发箍、刘海上可见 3 个发饰、1 对心形吊坠耳环以及 1 条带有小爱心吊坠的黑色颈圈。角色周围环绕着发光的、充满闪粉的糖果粉色背景，布满光斑、闪光、柔和的霓虹灯效果和偶像粉丝氛围。在角色周围添加 5 个发光的手绘日文爱心气泡文字，内容为：“かわいすぎてごめん…♡”、“推してくれてありがとうっ♡”、“ずーっとだいすきっ♡”、“世界でいちばんの推しになってね…♡”以及“ずっと一緒だよ？約束ね…♡”。在右上角背景中包含一张同一女孩的小型装饰照片卡或海报。超精致插画，浓郁闪光，浪漫光影，亮面高光，复杂的蕾丝细节，柔焦背景，饱和的粉色调，可爱的偶像海报质感。

templates.title: Visit Malaysia 2026 Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 2026 年马来西亚旅游海报

templates.prompt: A luxurious tourism poster for {argument name="destination" default="Malaysia"}, designed as a vertical fine-art travel advertisement on a clean ivory-white textured background with subtle embossed ornamental patterns. The composition is built around one long flowing red-and-gold batik silk ribbon that sweeps diagonally and spirals through the page, forming an elegant S-curve and visually containing a dreamlike collage of landmarks, culture, and nature. At the top left, warm golden sunrise light pours over misty tropical mountains and rainforest with a waterfall, dense palms, and a large rhinoceros hornbill perched beside hibiscus flowers and white tropical blossoms. In the upper center, a detailed Kuala Lumpur skyline rises from mist, dominated by the Petronas Twin Towers, with the KL Tower and several modern skyscrapers visible. Near the upper right floats 1 colorful traditional wau kite with floral patterns against open white space. In the middle left, include 1 grand mosque with multiple domes and minarets set among palms and haze. In the middle center-right, include the historic Sultan Abdul Samad Building with its copper domes and clocktower. In the lower middle left, include 1 elevated red-and-silver urban train crossing through the city. In the lower center, show 1 ornate Chinatown gate labeled Jalan Petaling, decorated with red lanterns and bustling pedestrians. In the lower right-middle, depict the Batu Caves area with 1 towering golden Murugan statue and 1 steep rainbow staircase climbing into limestone cliffs, surrounded by crowds. At the lower right, nestle 1 landscaped city park with a turquoise lake and fountains. Purple orchids and tropical flowers are woven into the ribbon and foreground in several places. At the very bottom right, show 1 small traditional dancer in red and gold attire twirling the trailing end of the ribbon. The collage should feel luminous, hyper-detailed, majestic, and celebratory, blending photorealistic architecture with painterly fantasy travel-poster styling, soft clouds, atmospheric haze, and glowing highlights. Add elegant poster typography in the lower left: the main headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="VISIT MALAYSIA 2026"}, a smaller location line reads {argument name="location text" default="KUALA LUMPUR"}, a blue script tourism slogan reads {argument name="tagline" default="Malaysia Truly Asia"}, and below that a small refined subheading reads {argument name="subheading" default="Where Diversity Converges\nKuala Lumpur, City of Wonders\nThe Heart of Asia"}. Use a premium color palette of gold, crimson, ivory, emerald, sky blue, and tropical greens, with polished editorial composition and high-end destination-branding aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款为 {argument name="destination" default="马来西亚"} 设计的奢华旅游海报，采用竖版艺术旅行广告风格，背景为干净的象牙白纹理，并带有精致的浮雕装饰图案。画面构图围绕一条飘逸的红金相间蜡染丝带展开，丝带呈对角线螺旋贯穿页面，形成优雅的 S 型曲线，巧妙地串联起如梦似幻的地标、文化与自然景观拼贴。左上角，温暖的金色晨曦洒在云雾缭绕的热带山脉和雨林之上，瀑布飞流直下，茂密的棕榈树旁，一只巨大的犀鸟栖息在木槿花和白色热带花卉间。上方中央，吉隆坡天际线在薄雾中升起，以双峰塔（Petronas Twin Towers）为主体，隐约可见吉隆坡塔（KL Tower）及多座现代摩天大楼。右上角附近漂浮着 1 只色彩斑斓的传统月亮风筝（Wau kite），在留白的背景中格外醒目。中左侧包含 1 座坐落在棕榈树与烟雾中的宏伟清真寺，拥有多个圆顶和尖塔。中右侧包含历史悠久的苏丹阿都沙末大厦（Sultan Abdul Samad Building），展现其铜制圆顶与钟楼。左下方包含 1 列穿行于城市中的红银相间高架列车。底部中央展示 1 座装饰华丽的唐人街牌坊，标有“Jalan Petaling”字样，点缀着红灯笼和熙熙攘攘的行人。右下方描绘了黑风洞（Batu Caves）区域，包括 1 座高耸的金色姆鲁干神像和 1 条通往石灰岩悬崖的陡峭彩虹阶梯，周围人群攒动。右下角点缀着 1 座景观城市公园，配有绿松石色的湖泊与喷泉。紫色兰花和热带花卉穿插在丝带与前景的多处。最右下角展示 1 位身着红金服饰的传统舞者，正舞动着丝带的末端。整幅拼贴画应呈现出明亮、超细节、宏伟且充满庆典感的氛围，将写实建筑与绘画感旅行海报风格相结合，辅以柔和的云雾、大气层薄雾和发光高光。左下方添加优雅的海报排版：主标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="VISIT MALAYSIA 2026"}，较小的地点行显示为 {argument name="location text" default="KUALA LUMPUR"}，蓝色的手写体旅游标语为 {argument name="tagline" default="Malaysia Truly Asia"}，下方附带一行精致的小副标题：{argument name="subheading" default="Where Diversity Converges\nKuala Lumpur, City of Wonders\nThe Heart of Asia"}。采用金色、深红、象牙白、祖母绿、天蓝和热带绿的高端配色方案，呈现出精美的编辑级构图与高端目的地品牌美学。

templates.title: Vintage Chinese SpaceX Propaganda Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古中国风 SpaceX 宣传海报

templates.prompt: A vintage socialist propaganda poster in a mid-20th-century Chinese style, printed on aged paper with a warm sepia tint, distressed texture, faded ink, and slightly worn edges. The composition is vertical and heroic. On the right half of the poster, show a large waist-up portrait of a male worker or revolutionary figure wearing a dark cap and a dark utilitarian jacket, facing slightly to the left with a stoic, determined expression. On the left-center, a white reusable rocket rises upward with bright engine flame, depicted like an aspirational symbol of technological progress; the rocket has the word "SPACEX" written vertically on its body and visible landing legs near the base. Behind the rocket, fill the sky with dramatic cream-colored sunburst rays spreading outward across a muted blue background. In the lower left, include a cheering crowd of exactly 6 factory workers or citizens in blue-gray uniforms, raising their hands in celebration, with one large red flag waving beside them. Add faint industrial city elements and launch-tower silhouettes behind the crowd. At the bottom, reserve a wide text panel with large bold red Chinese slogan lettering in two lines reading: "今天回收火箭，明天建设星际家园！". Use a screen-printed poster look, painterly realism, limited palette of dusty blue, cream, brick red, and dark olive, with strong ideological poster composition, triumphant mood, and retro-futurist space-race symbolism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 20 世纪中叶中国风格的复古社会主义宣传海报，印在带有暖棕褐色调的旧纸张上，具有做旧质感、褪色的油墨和略微磨损的边缘。构图呈垂直且具有英雄主义色彩。海报右半部分展示了一位男性工人或革命者的半身肖像，他戴着深色帽子，穿着深色实用夹克，面部略微向左，表情坚毅果敢。左中位置，一枚白色的可回收火箭正向上升起，引擎喷射出明亮的火焰，象征着对技术进步的向往；火箭箭身上垂直印有“SPACEX”字样，底部可见着陆支架。火箭后方，戏剧性的奶油色放射状光芒在柔和的蓝色背景上向四周扩散。左下方描绘了一群正在欢呼的工厂工人或市民（共 6 人），他们身穿蓝灰色制服，挥手庆祝，身旁飘扬着一面巨大的红旗。在人群后方加入淡淡的工业城市元素和发射塔剪影。底部预留一个宽大的文字区域，用两行醒目的红色大号中文字体写着：“今天回收火箭，明天建设星际家园！”。采用丝网印刷海报风格，具有绘画般的写实感，色调限于灰蓝色、奶油色、砖红色和深橄榄色，呈现出强烈的意识形态海报构图、胜利的氛围以及复古未来主义的太空竞赛象征意义。

templates.title: Epic Senna vs Prost Gladiator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级 Senna 对决 Prost 角斗士海报

templates.prompt: An epic cinematic poster in a dark golden bronze palette, styled like a mythic gladiator movie poster merged with vintage Formula 1 iconography. Two legendary rival drivers face away from each other in mirrored side-profile bust portraits at the top half of the image, one on the left inspired by Ayrton Senna and one on the right inspired by Alain Prost, both depicted as heroic Roman gladiators with weathered bronze armor, dramatic shoulder plates, and racing colors draped as cloaks. The left figure wears green, yellow, and blue accents, and the right figure wears blue, white, and red accents. Their faces are mostly in shadow, lit by intense backlight through storm clouds, creating a solemn, monumental mood. Behind each driver hangs 1 vertical banner, for a total of 2 banners: the left banner is dark green with a large gold S, the text "SENNA", "#12", and a cursive signature; the right banner is dark blue with a large gold P, the text "PROST", "#1", and a cursive signature. Centered near the top, in elegant serif French text, place the line "DEUX LÉGENDES. UN SEUL TRÔNE." with a small gold Formula 1 emblem and laurel motif below it. In the central sky, add 2 stacked lines of French text reading "RIVAUX SUR LA PISTE." and "LÉGENDES POUR TOUJOURS." The main title dominates the middle in huge metallic serif lettering: "{argument name="headline text" default="SENNA vs PROST"}", with a sword-like vertical separator for "vs". Beneath it, a subtitle in French reads "LE COMBAT ULTIME DE LA F1". The lower half shows a colossal Roman colosseum packed with spectators, flags, arches, dust, smoke, and dramatic perspective lines converging on the center. At the exact center of the arena stands 1 large victory banner with the words "VICTOIRE GLOIRE HONNEUR" in gold. In the foreground, place 2 front-facing late-1980s Formula 1 cars charging toward the viewer on a dirt-covered arena floor, throwing dust. The left car is associated with Senna and features red-and-white Marlboro-inspired livery, Shell branding, and the number 12 on the nose, with the driver wearing a yellow helmet. The right car is associated with Prost and features matching red-and-white Marlboro-inspired livery, Shell branding, and the number 1 on the nose, with the driver wearing a white helmet. At the very bottom, add the line "1988. 1989. 1990." and below it "L’HISTOIRE S’ÉCRIT À PLUS DE 300 KM/H." Include a small ornamental laurel decoration under the final line. Use hyper-detailed textures, dramatic storm clouds, god rays, flying dust, intense contrast, symmetrical composition, ultra-polished poster design, heroic scale, and a timeless legendary atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张史诗般的电影感海报，采用深金铜色调，融合了神话角斗士电影海报风格与复古一级方程式赛车（Formula 1）元素。海报上半部分为两位传奇宿敌的镜像侧脸半身像，左侧灵感源自 Ayrton Senna，右侧灵感源自 Alain Prost，两人均被描绘为英勇的罗马角斗士，身着历经风霜的青铜盔甲，佩戴戏剧性的肩甲，并披着代表各自赛车颜色的斗篷。左侧人物带有绿、黄、蓝点缀，右侧人物带有蓝、白、红点缀。他们的面部大多处于阴影中，被穿过风暴云层的强烈背光照亮，营造出庄严而宏伟的氛围。每位车手身后各悬挂 1 面垂直旗帜，共 2 面：左侧旗帜为深绿色，印有巨大的金色“S”、文字“SENNA”、“#12”以及手写签名；右侧旗帜为深蓝色，印有巨大的金色“P”、文字“PROST”、“#1”以及手写签名。顶部中央位置，用优雅的衬线法文书写“DEUX LÉGENDES. UN SEUL TRÔNE.”，下方配有小型金色 F1 标志和月桂花环图案。在中央天空中，添加 2 行堆叠的法文：“RIVAUX SUR LA PISTE.”和“LÉGENDES POUR TOUJOURS.”。海报中部以巨大的金属衬线字体呈现主标题：“{argument name="headline text" default="SENNA vs PROST"}”，中间使用剑形垂直分隔符隔开“vs”。下方副标题为法文“LE COMBAT ULTIME DE LA F1”。下半部分展示了一座宏伟的罗马斗兽场，观众席座无虚席，旗帜飘扬，拱门林立，尘土与烟雾弥漫，戏剧性的透视线条汇聚于中心。竞技场正中央矗立着 1 面巨大的胜利旗帜，上面用金色写着“VICTOIRE GLOIRE HONNEUR”。前景中，2 辆 20 世纪 80 年代末的 F1 赛车正冲向观众，在尘土飞扬的竞技场地面上疾驰。左侧赛车与 Senna 相关，采用红白相间的 Marlboro 风格涂装，带有 Shell 品牌标识，车鼻印有数字 12，车手佩戴黄色头盔。右侧赛车与 Prost 相关，采用同样的红白相间 Marlboro 风格涂装，带有 Shell 品牌标识，车鼻印有数字 1，车手佩戴白色头盔。最底部添加一行“1988. 1989. 1990.”，下方写着“L’HISTOIRE S’ÉCRIT À PLUS DE 300 KM/H.”。最后一行下方包含一个小巧的装饰性月桂花环。采用超精细纹理、戏剧性的风暴云、耶稣光、飞扬的尘土、强烈的对比度、对称构图、极致精美的海报设计、英雄般的宏大比例以及永恒的传奇氛围。

templates.title: Disco Ball Chameleon

titleLocalized.zh: 迪斯科球变色龙

templates.prompt: A highly polished studio photograph of a {argument name="animal" default="chameleon"} entirely covered in tiny mirrored disco-ball tiles, perched on top of a large mirrored disco ball sphere. Side profile facing right, with a curled tail, four visible legs gripping the sphere, a prominent casque-like head crest, round glossy black eye, and a delicate row of small scales along the jawline. The mosaic tiles should reflect silver, pale blue, and cool white highlights, creating sparkling specular reflections across both the animal and the sphere. Use a soft glamorous disco atmosphere with a smooth teal-blue gradient background, shallow depth of field, and scattered circular bokeh lights in the background. Soft diffused lighting with bright glints on the mirrored surfaces, ultra-detailed texture, photorealistic materials, centered composition, elegant and whimsical luxury aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度抛光的摄影级工作室照片，主角是一只全身覆盖着微小镜面迪斯科球瓷砖的 {argument name="animal" default="chameleon"}，它栖息在一个巨大的镜面迪斯科球体之上。侧面朝右，有着卷曲的尾巴，四条清晰可见的腿抓着球体，头部有显著的头冠，圆润且有光泽的黑色眼睛，下颌线处有一排精致的小鳞片。马赛克瓷砖应反射出银色、淡蓝色和冷白色的高光，在动物和球体表面营造出闪烁的镜面反射效果。采用柔和迷人的迪斯科氛围，搭配平滑的青蓝色渐变背景，浅景深效果，背景中散布着圆形的焦外成像光斑。柔和的漫射光线在镜面表面形成明亮的闪光，超精细的纹理，写实的材质，居中构图，呈现出优雅且奇幻的奢华美学。

templates.title: Autumn Park Reading Stock Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 秋季公园阅读素材照片

templates.prompt: A realistic lifestyle stock photo of {argument name="subject" default="a young woman"} sitting on the ground and leaning against a large tree trunk in a park during golden hour in autumn. She is positioned on the right side of the frame, reading an open hardcover book held in both hands, with her knees bent and legs angled left across the image. She has long loose wavy {argument name="hair color" default="light brown"} hair, and her face is intentionally obscured and out of focus, with no clear facial features visible. She wears 4 distinct clothing items: a chunky knit {argument name="sweater color" default="cream"} sweater, a thick wrapped {argument name="scarf color" default="burgundy"} scarf, fitted blue jeans, and black ankle boots with a slight heel. A dark leather shoulder bag rests on the grass beside her at the base of the tree. The environment is a quiet tree-lined park with fallen leaves scattered across the grass, soft warm sunlight filtering through the trees, and a heavily blurred background with rich amber, green, and brown tones. Cinematic shallow depth of field, natural candid composition, cozy autumn mood, premium commercial stock photography look, soft contrast, warm color grading, landscape orientation.

templates.title: Storm Wizard Casting Lightning

titleLocalized.zh: 风暴法师施展闪电

templates.prompt: A dramatic dark-fantasy portrait of an elderly wizard standing in a stormy wasteland under a black, cloud-choked sky. He wears a tall, weathered pointed hat with a brown leather band and a tiny metal clasp, and a heavy dark blue-gray robe with wide sleeves. His face is mostly hidden in shadow beneath the hat brim, with long strands of glowing {argument name="accent hair color" default="electric blue"} hair peeking out at the sides and a very long flowing silver-white beard reaching down his chest. The wizard thrusts his left hand toward the camera in a powerful forced-perspective pose, fingers spread, conjuring a bright orb of blue-white magical energy in his palm with crackling lightning arcs wrapping around the hand and sleeve. In his right arm he clutches a large ancient leather spellbook with worn corners, metal fittings, embossed arcane markings on the cover, and a few pages visible. The background shows a barren dark landscape and exactly 1 prominent lightning bolt striking on the right side of the frame. Cinematic high-contrast lighting, hyper-detailed skin and fabric texture, moody photorealism, sharp focus on the hand and beard, intense fantasy atmosphere, centered composition, square crop.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性的暗黑奇幻风格肖像，描绘了一位老法师站在黑色云层密布的暴风荒原上。他戴着一顶高耸、饱经风霜的尖顶帽，帽檐饰有棕色皮带和微型金属扣，身穿一件宽袖的深蓝灰色厚重长袍。他的脸大部分隐藏在帽檐下的阴影中，两侧露出长长的 {argument name="accent hair color" default="电光蓝"} 发丝，胸前垂着长长的银白色飘逸胡须。法师以强有力的强制透视姿势将左手伸向镜头，手指张开，掌心汇聚着一颗明亮的蓝白色魔法能量球，噼啪作响的闪电弧环绕着手部和袖口。他的右臂紧抱着一本巨大的古老皮质法术书，书角磨损，带有金属配件，封面上刻有神秘符号，隐约可见几页书页。背景展示了一片荒凉的暗色景观，画面右侧有一道醒目的闪电劈下。电影级高对比度光影，超精细的皮肤和织物纹理，情绪化的照片写实感，焦点清晰地聚焦于手部和胡须，浓郁的奇幻氛围，中心构图，方形裁剪。

templates.title: Fantasy Woman Hugging a White Ram

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻女子拥抱白公羊

templates.prompt: A photorealistic, cinematic vertical portrait of a medieval or fantasy woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long copper-red hair"}, shown from the chest up, gently embracing a large white ram. The woman wears a dark moss-green wool dress or tunic with ornate embroidered cuffs and a heavy fur-trimmed cloak or shawl over her shoulders, evoking a Viking or highland aesthetic. Her hair is thick, wavy, and slightly windblown, with small braids woven into the crown. The ram has dense curly cream-white fleece, a calm expression with eyes closed, and prominent spiral horns curling outward and forward. The woman’s hand rests tenderly at the ram’s neck, conveying warmth, protection, and companionship. Set outdoors in a rugged, overcast landscape with softly blurred hills or moorland in the background, cool gray sky, shallow depth of field, natural diffused lighting, rich texture detail in hair, wool, fur, and fabric, earthy muted color palette, intimate framing, realistic skin and animal features. Add black text in the top-left corner reading {argument name="corner text" default="GPT Image 2"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅照片级写实、电影质感的竖构图肖像，描绘了一位中世纪或奇幻风格的女子，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的铜红色头发"}，半身像，正温柔地拥抱着一只巨大的白公羊。女子身穿深苔藓绿色的羊毛连衣裙或束腰外衣，袖口有华丽的刺绣，肩上披着厚重的毛皮边斗篷或披肩，呈现出维京或高地风格。她的头发浓密、波浪状且略显凌乱，头顶编织着小辫子。公羊拥有浓密卷曲的乳白色羊毛，表情平静，双眼微闭，巨大的螺旋角向外和向前卷曲。女子的手温柔地放在公羊的脖子上，传达出温暖、保护与陪伴之感。背景设定在户外崎岖、阴云密布的景观中，远处是模糊的山丘或荒原，天空呈冷灰色，浅景深，自然漫射光，头发、羊毛、毛皮和织物呈现出丰富的纹理细节，大地色调，亲密的构图，写实的人物皮肤与动物特征。在左上角添加黑色文字 {argument name="corner text" default="GPT Image 2"}。

templates.title: Spanish Sports Newspaper Front Page

titleLocalized.zh: 西班牙体育报纸头版

templates.prompt: A realistic Spanish sports newspaper front page in the style of a major daily broadsheet, clean white background with strong red and black typography, editorial print layout, high-resolution scanned-paper look. At the very top, an oversized red masthead reading {argument name="newspaper name" default="MARCA"} spans nearly the full width, with a small black price in the upper-right corner reading {argument name="price" default="2,50€"}. Beneath the masthead, a thin line of small black publication details includes a Tuesday date, website, year, and issue number. The dominant main headline on the left takes up most of the page in gigantic bold condensed black uppercase letters over two lines: {argument name="main headline" default="ARBELOA, DESTITUIDO"}. Below it, a red subheadline in bold sentence case says that Real Madrid dismisses the coach after 100 days on the bench and seeks a replacement until the end of the season. A smaller black explanatory line underneath mentions the decision following Champions League elimination and loss of the LaLiga lead. The main photo occupies the lower-left majority of the cover: a suited football coach standing in a stadium with blue seats, one hand touching his forehead in a stressed or disappointed gesture, wearing a dark navy suit, white shirt, and dark tie, with the Bernabéu environment visible and a pitch-side barrier reading Real Madrid C. F. Along the bottom of the main image, a small caption line notes that the coach leaves the Bernabéu after learning the decision. At the very bottom left and center are 2 narrow columns of small black article text in Spanish newspaper style. To the right side, a vertical sidebar contains 2 stacked secondary stories separated by red divider lines. The top sidebar story has a red section label reading NBA PLAYOFFS, a bold black headline saying the Lakers force game seven, a rectangular action photo of 2 basketball players with a Lakers player in a purple number 77 jersey going up with the ball against a Nuggets defender, and a short caption below mentioning Doncic scoring 42 points in Denver. The lower sidebar story has a red section label reading TENIS · MUTUA MADRID OPEN, a bold black headline about Alcaraz dominating at the Caja Mágica, and a rectangular tennis photo of a player in light purple kit hitting a forehand against a bright blue backdrop. Near the bottom center-right, include a pull-quote box marked by large red quotation marks and bold black text reading {argument name="pull quote" default="Agradezco al club la oportunidad de mi vida"}. Overall composition should feel like an authentic dramatic sports front page: sharp print typography, rigid newspaper grid, realistic photojournalism, heavy black headline blocks, red accents, and a contemporary Spanish press design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的西班牙体育报纸头版，采用主流日报的大报风格，白色背景简洁，搭配强烈的红黑排版，呈现编辑印刷布局及高分辨率的纸张扫描质感。在最上方，一个超大的红色报头写着 {argument name="newspaper name" default="MARCA"}，几乎横跨整个页面宽度，右上角印有黑色小字价格 {argument name="price" default="2,50€"}。报头下方是一行细小的黑色出版详情，包含周二日期、网址、年份和期号。左侧占据页面大部分空间的主标题采用巨大的粗体压缩黑色大写字母，分为两行：{argument name="main headline" default="ARBELOA, DESTITUIDO"}。下方是一个红色副标题，以粗体句式说明皇家马德里在教练执教 100 天后将其解雇，并正在寻找赛季末的继任者。下方一行较小的黑色解释性文字提到，该决定是在欧冠出局及西甲领先优势丧失后做出的。主图占据封面左下角的大部分区域：一位身着深蓝色西装、白衬衫、深色领带的足球教练站在蓝色座椅的体育场内，一只手摸着额头，神情压力巨大或失望，背景可见伯纳乌球场环境，场边护栏上写着 Real Madrid C. F.。在主图底部，一行小字说明教练在得知决定后离开伯纳乌。最左侧和中心底部是两列狭窄的黑色文章正文，采用西班牙报纸风格。右侧是一个垂直侧边栏，包含两篇由红色分割线隔开的次要报道。顶部侧边栏报道有一个红色栏目标签写着 NBA PLAYOFFS，粗体黑色标题写着湖人队将比赛拖入第七场，配有一张两名篮球运动员的矩形动作照片，其中一名身穿紫色 77 号球衣的湖人球员正持球对抗掘金队防守者，下方短说明提到东契奇在丹佛砍下 42 分。下方侧边栏报道有一个红色栏目标签写着 TENIS · MUTUA MADRID OPEN，粗体黑色标题关于阿尔卡拉斯在魔术盒球场（Caja Mágica）的统治级表现，并配有一张身穿浅紫色球衣的球员在明亮的蓝色背景下击出正手的矩形网球照片。在右下角附近，包含一个由大红色引号和粗体黑色文字标记的引语框，内容为 {argument name="pull quote" default="Agradezco al club la oportunidad de mi vida"}。整体构图应呈现出地道的戏剧性体育头版感：锐利的印刷字体、严谨的报纸网格、写实的新闻摄影、厚重的黑色标题块、红色点缀以及现代西班牙媒体设计。

templates.title: Satirical Spanish Sports Front Page

titleLocalized.zh: 讽刺风格西班牙体育报纸头版

templates.prompt: A satirical Spanish sports newspaper front page designed like a tabloid cover, full-frame and perfectly frontal, on slightly aged off-white newsprint with subtle paper texture, faint stains, and narrow black border lines. The masthead is a huge red SPORT logo across the top on a bright yellow banner. In the upper right, include 1 small interview promo box with a headshot of a footballer and the text block in Spanish: “ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ ‘ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES’”. Under the masthead, add a yellow strip with bold black text “EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL” and a small red lightning bolt. The main headline dominates the page in gigantic black condensed uppercase letters over 2 lines: “LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO”. Beneath it, add the subheadline in italic black Spanish text: “El crack pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato”. The main photo occupies the left-center and lower-middle of the page: a young footballer seen mostly from the back wearing a Barcelona home jersey in blue and garnet stripes, with the name “LAMILE” and the number “10” in large yellow lettering, standing in a celebratory stadium scene with confetti, bright lights, blurred fans, and people around him. He is holding or presenting a large bingo card board with the word “BINGO” at the top and “BINGO!” at the bottom. On the right side, create a vertical sidebar with 4 stacked content blocks: first, a photo of a calamari sandwich on a plate with the caption “El motivo del fichaje”; second, a red info box listing 3 humorous transfer facts in yellow and white text, exactly “EDAD: muy joven”, “FICHAJE: 4 cartones”, and “CLÁUSULA: una partida de parchís”; third, a quotes column with 3 stacked mini-items, each with a small portrait and Spanish caption: “XAVI: ‘No me lo esperaba, pero respeto’”, “LAPORTA: ‘Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo’”, and “EL VESTUARIO: Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida”; fourth, a small motorsport teaser at the bottom with a driver image and the text “FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN YEDA”. Along the bottom strip, include 3 small teaser panels: 1 woman footballer holding a trophy with the text “CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA”, 1 basketball panel with two Barça players and the text “BÁSQUET EL BARÇA, A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR”, and the Formula 1 teaser panel already integrated at the right edge. Add tiny newspaper metadata below the masthead on the left in Spanish, including issue number, date, and price, such as “Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS”. The overall style should be hyper-realistic printed newspaper cover photography and editorial layout, with authentic magazine typography, strong black headlines, saturated sports-photo colors, comedic transfer-rumor parody tone, and seamless believable print design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张设计成小报封面的讽刺风格西班牙体育报纸头版，全画幅且完全正面视角，印在略显陈旧的米白色新闻纸上，带有细腻的纸张纹理、淡淡的污渍和细窄的黑色边框。报头顶部横跨一条亮黄色横幅，印有巨大的红色“SPORT”标志。右上角包含 1 个小型采访推广框，内含一名足球运动员的头像，以及西班牙语文本块：“ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ ‘ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES’”。在报头下方，添加一条带有粗体黑色文字“EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL”的黄色长条，并配有一个红色小闪电图标。主标题以巨大的黑色压缩大写字母占据页面核心位置，分为 2 行：“LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO”。在其下方，添加斜体黑色西班牙语副标题：“El crack pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato”。主照片占据页面左中及中下部：一名年轻足球运动员背影为主，身穿蓝红条纹的巴塞罗那主场球衣，球衣上印有大号黄色字母“LAMILE”和数字“10”，站在充满纸屑、强光、模糊球迷及人群的庆祝球场场景中。他手持或展示着一张巨大的宾果游戏项目，顶部写有“BINGO”，底部写有“BINGO!”。在右侧，创建一个包含 4 个堆叠内容块的垂直侧边栏：第一部分是一张盘中鱿鱼三明治的照片，配文“El motivo del fichaje”；第二部分是一个红色信息框，列出 3 条幽默的转会事实，文字为黄色和白色，内容为：“EDAD: muy joven”、“FICHAJE: 4 cartones”以及“CLÁUSULA: una partida de parchís”；第三部分是一个引语栏，包含 3 个堆叠的小项目，每个项目都有一个小肖像和西班牙语说明：“XAVI: ‘No me lo esperaba, pero respeto’”、“LAPORTA: ‘Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo’”以及“EL VESTUARIO: Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida”；第四部分是底部的一个小型赛车预告，配有车手图像和文字“FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN YEDA”。沿底部长条，包含 3 个小型预告面板：1 名手持奖杯的女足运动员，配文“CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA”；1 个篮球面板，包含两名巴萨球员，配文“BÁSQUET EL BARÇA, A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR”；以及已整合在右边缘的 F1 赛车预告面板。在报头左下方添加微小的西班牙语报纸元数据，包括期号、日期和价格，例如“Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS”。整体风格应为超写实的印刷报纸封面摄影和编辑排版，具备地道的杂志排版、强烈的黑色标题、饱和的体育照片色彩、喜剧性的转会传闻恶搞基调，以及天衣无缝且可信的印刷设计。

templates.title: Agritech magazine cover from app screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 农业科技杂志封面应用截图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of the mobile app screen, transform it into a premium editorial magazine cover mockup about agricultural innovation. Keep the app UI recognizable on the phone display, but place it in a realistic lifestyle context: a vineyard worker in the foreground holding a smartphone that shows the app, with vineyard rows, mountains, and a few workers in the background under natural daylight. Design the full page as a Spanish-language magazine cover with a refined agricultural-business aesthetic in green, cream, and earthy tones. Add a large masthead at the top reading “REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO”, a thin top strapline with 3 items separated by vertical bars: “Especial Viñas de Chile”, “Innovación agrícola”, and “Abril 2026”, plus a subtitle line beneath the masthead: “Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural”. On the left, add a green section tag reading “TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA” and a bold stacked main cover headline: “La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo”, followed by a short deck about Kimün replacing the traditional notebook and giving real-time control to vineyards and agricultural businesses. Add a circular callout badge mentioning a special feature about Kimün as an intelligent field notebook with AI. Include 2 bottom teaser photos: one close-up of the worker holding the phone in the vineyard with page label “p.18” and a caption about field diagnosis and cellphone alerts, and one small group scene with 3 people reviewing the app together with page label “p.24” and a caption about connected field teams, voice, records, and instant costs. On the right column, add 3 article teasers with icons and page numbers: one about the end of paper and the new era of the intelligent field notebook (p.30), one about more efficient vineyards through better data-driven decisions (p.36), and one about water management 4.0 and smarter, more profitable irrigation (p.42). Add a footer strip with 5 category labels: “AGRICULTURA”, “FRUTALES”, “VIÑAS”, “GANADERÍA”, “SUSTENTABILIDAD”, plus a barcode and a small price. Make it look like a polished real magazine cover photo shoot and editorial layout, not a flat app screenshot.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的移动应用屏幕参考图，将其转换为关于农业创新的高端杂志封面样机。保持手机屏幕上的应用 UI 清晰可辨，并将其置于真实的生活场景中：前景中一名葡萄园工人手持显示该应用的智能手机，背景为葡萄园行、山脉及几名在自然光下工作的工人。将整页设计为一份具有精致农业商业美感的西班牙语杂志封面，采用绿色、奶油色和大地色调。在顶部添加醒目的刊头，文字为“REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO”，上方有一条细长的副标题栏，包含 3 个由竖线分隔的项目：“Especial Viñas de Chile”、“Innovación agrícola”和“Abril 2026”，并在刊头下方添加一行副标题：“Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural”。在左侧添加一个绿色的版块标签“TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA”，以及粗体的堆叠式主封面标题：“La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo”，随后附上一段关于 Kimün 如何取代传统笔记本并为葡萄园及农业企业提供实时管理的简短介绍。添加一个圆形的标注徽章，提及关于 Kimün 作为智能 AI 田间笔记本的专题报道。包含 2 张底部的预告图片：一张是工人手持手机在葡萄园中的特写，标注“p.18”及关于田间诊断和手机警报的说明；另一张是 3 人共同查看应用的小型场景，标注“p.24”及关于互联田间团队、语音、记录和即时成本的说明。在右侧栏中，添加 3 个带有图标和页码的专题预告：一篇关于告别纸质化、开启智能田间笔记本新时代（p.30），一篇关于通过数据驱动决策实现更高效的葡萄园管理（p.36），以及一篇关于水资源管理 4.0 和更智能、更具盈利能力的灌溉（p.42）。添加一个包含 5 个类别标签的页脚条：“AGRICULTURA”、“FRUTALES”、“VIÑAS”、“GANADERÍA”、“SUSTENTABILIDAD”，并附上条形码和价格。使其看起来像是一张精美的杂志封面摄影作品和编辑排版，而非平面的应用截图。

templates.title: Minimalist Saint Augustine Book Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 极简主义圣奥古斯丁书籍封面

templates.prompt: A minimalist classical book cover in vertical format on a warm ivory or parchment background. At the top center, set the title in elegant large dark navy serif type across 2 lines: {argument name="title text" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}. Beneath it, centered with generous spacing, place a small gold phi symbol. In the upper-middle area, draw a delicate thin-line gold illustration of a fortified circular heavenly city with exactly 8 visible outer towers or gate structures, crenelated walls, and compact classical buildings inside, including a central dome. From the bottom center of this city, extend a soft vertical gold beam of light downward. In the lower-middle area, create thin dark navy line art of earthly classical ruins: the Roman Colosseum on the left, a large Greek or Roman temple with a triangular pediment and a long row of columns on the right, a broken fallen column in front, a small stone block near it, and an arched ruin structure spanning the lower left. Keep the composition symmetrical and airy, with lots of empty space, refined editorial balance, and subtle contrast between gold heavenly imagery and dark navy earthly architecture. At the bottom center, place the author name in matching dark navy serif type: {argument name="author name" default="San Agustín de Hipona"}. Clean premium literary design, sacred philosophy aesthetic, no extra text, no texture-heavy effects, no photographic elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款垂直构图的极简主义古典书籍封面，背景为温暖的象牙色或羊皮纸色。在顶部中央，以优雅的大号深海军蓝衬线字体分 2 行排版标题：{argument name="title text" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}。在其下方，留出宽裕的间距并居中放置一个小型金色 phi 符号。在中上区域，绘制一幅精致的细线条金色插图，描绘一座坚固的圆形天国之城，拥有 8 座清晰可见的外塔或城门结构、雉堞城墙以及内部紧凑的古典建筑（包括一座中央圆顶）。从这座城市的底部中央，向下延伸出一道柔和的垂直金色光束。在中下区域，用深海军蓝细线条绘制地上的古典遗迹：左侧为罗马斗兽场，右侧为一座带有三角形山花和长排立柱的大型希腊或罗马神庙，前方有一根断裂倒塌的立柱、一块小石块，以及横跨左下方的拱形遗迹结构。保持构图对称且通透，留出大量空白，实现精致的编辑平衡，并形成金色天国意象与深海军蓝世俗建筑之间的微妙对比。在底部中央，以匹配的深海军蓝衬线字体放置作者姓名：{argument name="author name" default="San Agustín de Hipona"}。简洁的高级文学设计，神圣的哲学美学，无额外文字，无厚重的纹理效果，无摄影元素。

templates.title: Classical Cover for The City of God

titleLocalized.zh: 《上帝之城》古典风格封面

templates.prompt: A minimalist, elegant vintage book cover design on warm ivory textured paper for {argument name="book title" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}. Center the title near the top in large classical serif typography, dark navy blue, with refined spacing and a literary feel. Directly below it, place 1 small eight-point star in gold. In the upper middle, illustrate a heavenly walled city floating on clouds, drawn as delicate gold line art: a symmetrical sacred city with 1 central domed cathedral, many clustered towers, spires, walls, and gates, surrounded by soft clouds, with radiant sunburst lines spreading outward behind it. From the central gate of the celestial city, send down 1 vertical column of thin golden light beams toward the lower half of the cover. In the bottom third, depict an earthly ancient Roman landscape in fine blue-gray ink line art: 5 main architectural ruins and monuments arranged horizontally, including a long arcade on the left, a classical temple with columns near left-center, a domed building in the middle, a bell tower and surrounding ruins near right-center, and a colosseum-like ruin on the far right, plus a broken fallen column drum in the right foreground and sparse shrubs and ground texture. Keep the composition airy, symmetrical, and contemplative, with abundant negative space between heaven and earth. Place the author name {argument name="author name" default="SAN AGUSTÍN DE HIPONA"} centered at the bottom in spaced small caps serif, dark navy blue. Use only 3 visible text elements total: the title, the author name, and no subtitle. Palette limited to ivory, gold, and dark navy blue, with precise engraved linework and a sacred, timeless, classical theological mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款极简、优雅的复古书籍封面设计，采用暖象牙色纹理纸张，适用于 {argument name="book title" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}。将书名置于顶部中央，使用大型古典衬线字体，深海军蓝色，字间距考究，富有文学气息。在书名正下方放置 1 枚八角星，金色。在中上部，绘制一座漂浮在云端的圣洁城池，采用精致的金色线条艺术：一座对称的神圣之城，包含 1 座中央圆顶大教堂、多座簇拥的塔楼、尖顶、城墙和城门，四周环绕着柔和的云朵，背后散发出向外扩散的放射状太阳光芒。从天国的中央城门处，向下投射 1 道垂直的细长金光柱，直达封面下半部分。在底部三分之一处，用细腻的蓝灰色墨水线条描绘一幅古罗马大地景观：水平排列 5 处主要建筑遗迹和纪念碑，包括左侧的长拱廊、左中部的古典立柱神庙、中间的圆顶建筑、右中部的钟楼及周边遗迹，以及最右侧类似斗兽场的废墟，外加右侧前景中一根断裂的柱鼓和零星的灌木与地面纹理。保持构图空灵、对称且引人深思，在天与地之间留出充足的负空间。将作者名 {argument name="author name" default="SAN AGUSTÍN DE HIPONA"} 居中置于底部，使用间距适中的小型大写衬线字体，深海军蓝色。全图仅包含 3 处可见文本元素：书名、作者名，无副标题。配色仅限象牙白、金色和深海军蓝，呈现出精准的雕版线条感以及神圣、永恒、古典的神学氛围。

templates.title: Premium Futuristic AI Workspace

titleLocalized.zh: 高端未来感 AI 工作空间

templates.prompt: A cinematic futuristic control-room workspace in a dark premium tech aesthetic, viewed from behind a single person seated at a sleek desk, centered in the foreground, facing a wall of floating transparent holographic interface panels. The scene is illuminated by electric blue and cyan light on a nearly black background, with a brilliant glowing AI core or neural sphere at the center of the composition slightly above the desk line, radiating dozens of branching luminous data streams that connect to every screen like a digital nervous system. The person is a silhouetted professional wearing dark clothing in a modern office chair, framed symmetrically to emphasize scale and immersion. On the desk are 3 main desktop monitors filled with code and technical dashboards, 1 open laptop on the left, 1 slim task lamp on the right, 1 coffee mug, and a few minimal office accessories. Surrounding the figure are exactly 10 large floating UI windows: 1 left vertical profile/navigation panel with a circular avatar and the name {argument name="character name" default="ALEXANDER"}, plus menu items; 1 upper-left project information card titled {argument name="project name" default="PROJECT CHRONOS"}; 1 top-center code editor window titled "CODE SYNTHESIS" showing dense programming text; 1 upper-center-right assistant panel titled "AI ASSISTANT" with a glowing waveform and short chat text; 1 upper-right data window titled "DATA STREAM"; 1 mid-left media generation panel titled "GENERATING VISUAL ASSET" showing a dramatic sci-fi landscape with tall rock spires and multiple thumbnail previews beneath; 1 small central progress card titled "EXECUTING WORKFLOW" with progress bars; 1 mid-right world map analytics panel titled "GLOBAL NETWORK" with glowing connection points; 1 lower-left engineering render panel titled "3D MODEL RENDER" displaying a futuristic mechanical engine or spacecraft component; 1 lower-right dashboard titled "SYSTEM MONITOR" with circular percentage charts and graphs. Also include exactly 2 smaller side panels: 1 lower-left voice panel titled "VOICE INTERFACE" with waveform visualization, and 1 right-side narrow panel titled "ACTIVITY LOG" with status entries. Add several tiny floating micro-cards and image thumbnails scattered between the main windows, connected by light trails, to suggest multitasking AI orchestration. The interface design should feel ultra-polished, glassmorphic, transparent, edge-lit, and premium, with thin neon borders, subtle grid lines, small icons, and high-end sci-fi UI typography. Use a dramatic wide-angle composition, deep depth, crisp detail, volumetric glow, reflective surfaces, and a balanced symmetrical layout centered on the radiant AI nexus. The overall mood is visionary, luxurious, and intelligent, like {argument name="headline text" default="the future of creative AI interfaces"} made real, combining software engineering, generative design, global connectivity, and autonomous workflow management in one immersive scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的未来主义控制室工作空间，采用深色高端科技美学。视角位于一名坐在时尚办公桌前的单人身后，画面中心前景处，正对着一整面悬浮的透明全息界面墙。场景由近乎全黑背景上的电光蓝和青色光线照亮，构图中心略高于桌面处有一个光芒四射的 AI 核心或神经球体，向四周辐射出数十条分支状的发光数据流，如同数字神经系统般连接着每一块屏幕。画面中的人物为身着深色服装的专业人士剪影，坐在现代办公椅上，对称的构图强调了规模感与沉浸感。桌面上摆放着 3 台显示代码和技术仪表盘的主显示器、左侧 1 台打开的笔记本电脑、右侧 1 盏纤细的任务灯、1 个咖啡杯以及少量极简办公配件。人物周围环绕着 10 个大型悬浮 UI 窗口：1 个左侧垂直个人资料/导航面板，包含圆形头像、名称 {argument name="character name" default="ALEXANDER"} 以及菜单项；1 个左上方项目信息卡片，标题为 {argument name="project name" default="PROJECT CHRONOS"}；1 个顶部中央代码编辑器窗口，标题为 "CODE SYNTHESIS"，显示密集的编程文本；1 个中右上方助手面板，标题为 "AI ASSISTANT"，带有发光波形和简短聊天文本；1 个右上方数据窗口，标题为 "DATA STREAM"；1 个中左侧媒体生成面板，标题为 "GENERATING VISUAL ASSET"，显示带有高耸岩石尖塔的戏剧性科幻景观，下方有多个缩略图预览；1 个小型中央进度卡片，标题为 "EXECUTING WORKFLOW"，带有进度条；1 个中右侧世界地图分析面板，标题为 "GLOBAL NETWORK"，带有发光连接点；1 个左下方工程渲染面板，标题为 "3D MODEL RENDER"，显示未来机械引擎或航天器组件；1 个右下方仪表盘，标题为 "SYSTEM MONITOR"，带有圆形百分比图表和图形。此外包含 2 个较小的侧面板：1 个左下方语音面板，标题为 "VOICE INTERFACE"，带有波形可视化效果；1 个右侧窄面板，标题为 "ACTIVITY LOG"，带有状态条目。在主窗口之间散布着几个微小的悬浮微卡片和图像缩略图，由光迹连接，暗示着多任务 AI 编排。界面设计应呈现出极致精美、玻璃拟态、透明、边缘发光且高端的质感，配有细霓虹边框、微妙的网格线、小图标以及高端科幻 UI 字体。采用戏剧性的广角构图、深邃的景深、清晰的细节、体积光效果、反射表面，以及以发光 AI 核心为中心的平衡对称布局。整体氛围充满远见、奢华且智能，如同将 {argument name="headline text" default="the future of creative AI interfaces"} 变为现实，将软件工程、生成式设计、全球连接和自主工作流管理融为一体，打造出沉浸式场景。

templates.title: Minimal Studio Seated Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 棕色调室内坐姿肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman seated on a simple black folding chair, framed from head to upper thighs in a vertical composition. She has dark brown to nearly black hair parted in the center and tied back into a low ponytail, with a few soft loose strands near the ears, and small delicate earrings. Her face is intentionally obscured and featureless, with no visible eyes, nose, or mouth detail. She wears a fitted ribbed zip-front crop top in {argument name="top color" default="deep chocolate brown"}, with a collar, three-quarter sleeves, and the zipper partially open to create a deep neckline, paired with high-waisted straight-leg pants in a matching {argument name="pants color" default="brown"}. Her body is angled slightly toward the camera with relaxed shoulders, hands resting together between her knees, conveying a calm casual studio pose. templates.prompt: A realistic documentary-style photo of an elementary school classroom during a math activity, with about 10 children seated around grouped wooden desks, wearing green and blue school uniforms, actively playing a colorful multiplication domino game. Center the scene on one square educational board game labeled in Portuguese, with the title "DOMINÓ DA MULTIPLICAÇÃO" on the lower edge and "TREINANDO AS TABUADAS" in the center, surrounded by a border of brightly colored domino-style multiplication tiles. Show 4 children clearly engaged around this main board: one child placing a yellow tile onto the board, one child holding a stack of multicolored tiles, one child watching from the left, and one child in a blue sleeve at the bottom edge arranging pieces. Include 2 shallow wooden boxes labeled "JOGO DE DOMINÓ," one near the center-left and one at the bottom-right, each containing colorful rectangular domino pieces. Scatter school materials naturally on the desks: 3 pencils, 2 worksheets, 1 water bottle, pencil cases, notebooks, and extra game tiles. In the background, show the rest of the classroom softly out of focus with additional students at desks, a bookshelf, a corkboard filled with children’s drawings, and a large multiplication chart poster on the left wall reading "TABUADA DE MULTIPLICAÇÃO." Bright natural daylight enters from tall windows on the right, giving the room a warm, lively, authentic school atmosphere. The educational board and tiles should use vivid classroom colors like yellow, blue, pink, green, and orange. Faces should be unobtrusive or de-emphasized, with the focus on hands-on learning, collaboration, and the multiplication domino activity. templates.title: Historical WWII Photo Colorization

titleLocalized.zh: 二战历史照片上色

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, colorize the original black-and-white WWII paratrooper photo into a realistic, historically accurate color restoration. Preserve the exact composition, pose, gear, weapon, cropped face block, background, and photographic framing. Add natural period-appropriate colors: khaki/tan uniform and jump gear, olive drab pack, brown leather boots and straps, wood-toned rifle stock, dark metal gun body, muted earth tones for the dirt road and building, green trees, and a soft pale blue sky. Make the 82nd Airborne shoulder patch historically correct with 1 visible patch in red, white, and blue. Keep the result looking like a faithful documentary-era restoration rather than a modern stylized repaint.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将原始的二战伞兵黑白照片进行写实且符合历史事实的色彩还原。保留原有的构图、姿势、装备、武器、面部裁剪区域、背景以及摄影取景。添加自然且符合时代特征的色彩：卡其色/棕褐色制服和跳伞装备、橄榄绿背包、棕色皮革靴子和绑带、木质色调的步枪枪托、深色金属枪身，泥土路和建筑使用柔和的土色调，树木呈现绿色，天空为柔和的淡蓝色。确保第 82 空降师的肩章符合历史事实，即 1 个清晰可见的红、白、蓝三色肩章。最终效果应呈现为忠实于纪录片时代的修复作品，而非现代风格的重绘。

templates.title: Blindfolded Sorcerer Victory Pose

titleLocalized.zh: 蒙眼术士胜利姿势

templates.prompt: A high-impact shonen manga anime illustration of a powerful white-haired sorcerer in a dramatic low-angle full-body pose, laughing with his head thrown back and mouth wide open, wearing a sleek black high-collar uniform and a black blindfold over his eyes. His left hand is thrust toward the viewer making a two-finger peace sign, with strong foreshortening that makes the hand large in the foreground, while his right arm hangs lower at his side. Surround him with explosive {argument name="energy color" default="electric blue"} supernatural energy, violent brushstroke-like aura trails, flying debris, sparks, and swirling curved streaks cutting across the frame. The background should be a dark, abstract, chaotic energy burst with glowing blue shards and motion lines, creating a sense of overwhelming power. Use bold cel-shaded anime rendering with painterly highlights, sharp linework, intense contrast, and glossy fabric folds on the black outfit. On the right side, add 1 large jagged white manga speech bubble with thick black outline containing the text {argument name="speech bubble text" default="LUDDITES ALWAYS LOSE!"} in huge distressed black uppercase letters. Vertical composition, dynamic action poster framing, confident triumphant attitude, modern dark fantasy anime aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具冲击力的少年漫画风格插画，描绘了一位强大的白发术士，他正以极具戏剧性的低角度全身姿势仰头大笑，嘴巴张开，身穿黑色高领制服，双眼蒙着黑色眼罩。他的左手向观众伸出，做出剪刀手姿势，通过强烈的透视效果使手部在前景中显得格外巨大，右手则自然下垂。周围环绕着爆炸性的 {argument name="energy color" default="电光蓝"} 超自然能量，伴有狂野的笔触式光晕轨迹、飞溅的碎片、火花以及横跨画面的弯曲流光。背景为深色抽象的混沌能量爆发，点缀着发光的蓝色碎片和动态线条，营造出一种压倒性的力量感。采用大胆的赛璐珞动漫渲染风格，结合绘画感的高光、锐利的线条、强烈的对比以及黑色服装上富有光泽的褶皱。在画面右侧，添加 1 个带有粗黑色轮廓的巨大锯齿状白色漫画对话气泡，其中包含 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="卢德分子必败无疑！"} 字样，使用巨大的做旧黑色大写字母。竖构图，动态动作海报构图，自信且胜利的姿态，现代暗黑奇幻动漫美学。

templates.title: Anime Pop-Art Protest Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫波普艺术抗议海报

templates.prompt: A bold anime pop-art poster of a tall white-haired male sorcerer in a dark navy high-collar coat, shown from the waist up, facing forward in a confident pose with his left hand raised close to the camera making a peace sign. His face is partially obscured by a rectangular blur/censor block centered over the eyes and nose area, while his spiky silver-white hair fans outward dramatically above a dark blindfold or visor. Place a huge comic speech bubble across the top with the exact text {argument name="headline text" default="LUDDITES ALWAYS LOSE!"} in heavy black all-caps sans-serif lettering. Use a vivid blue background filled with dense red and orange radial speed lines exploding outward from behind the character, creating a dynamic manga cover feel. Emphasize thick ink outlines, cel-shaded anime rendering, posterized contrast, and a slightly warped vintage-comic print look. The composition should be vertical, tightly cropped, high energy, rebellious, graphic, and meme-like, with the {argument name="character hair color" default="silver white"} hair, {argument name="coat color" default="dark navy"} coat, and {argument name="background color" default="bright blue with red-orange radial lines"} dominating the palette.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张醒目的动漫波普艺术海报，主角是一位身材高挑、留着白发的男性术士，身穿深海军蓝高领外套，半身像，正面对镜头，姿态自信，左手靠近镜头比出剪刀手。他的脸部被一个位于眼睛和鼻子区域的矩形模糊/遮挡块部分遮住，尖刺状的银白色头发在深色眼罩或护目镜上方戏剧性地向外散开。在顶部放置一个巨大的漫画对话气泡，其中包含确切文本 {argument name="headline text" default="LUDDITES ALWAYS LOSE!"}，使用粗重的黑色全大写无衬线字体。使用鲜艳的蓝色背景，背景中充满了从角色身后向外爆发的密集红色和橙色放射状速度线，营造出动态的漫画封面感。强调粗犷的墨水轮廓、赛璐珞风格的动漫渲染、海报化的对比度以及略微扭曲的复古漫画印刷外观。构图应为竖版、紧凑裁剪、充满活力、叛逆、图形化且具有模因感，并以 {argument name="character hair color" default="silver white"} 的头发、{argument name="coat color" default="dark navy"} 的外套和 {argument name="background color" default="bright blue with red-orange radial lines"} 的背景色为主色调。

templates.title: Leonardo Painting the Mona Lisa

titleLocalized.zh: 列奥纳多绘制《蒙娜丽莎》

templates.prompt: A cinematic Renaissance art studio interior lit by soft warm window light, showing an elderly Leonardo da Vinci-like painter in left profile, seated at an easel and painting the Mona Lisa from a live model. The painter has long gray hair, a full gray beard, and wears a dark period cap and heavy dark robe. In the center foreground stands a large canvas on a wooden easel displaying the Mona Lisa composition, while on the right a live female sitter poses in the same iconic posture with folded hands, wearing a dark Renaissance dress and veil-like drapery. The mood is intimate, quiet, and painterly, with rich brown and amber tones, dramatic chiaroscuro, aged plaster walls, a leaded-glass window on the left, and a wooden table in the back holding brushes and studies. Include 2 portrait sketches pinned or propped in the background behind the model. In the lower right foreground, show a cluttered painter’s worktable with 1 paint palette, multiple small paint dabs, several brushes in a cup, and a few shallow bowls. Compose the scene as a realistic historical photograph of the moment the masterpiece is being created, medium-wide shot, slightly over-the-shoulder from behind the artist, extremely detailed textures, old master atmosphere, soft focus falloff, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一间电影质感的文艺复兴时期艺术工作室内部，柔和温暖的窗光洒入。画面左侧展示了一位长相酷似列奥纳多·达·芬奇的老年画家，他坐在画架前，正以真人模特为原型绘制《蒙娜丽莎》。画家留着灰白长发和浓密的灰胡须，头戴深色复古帽，身穿厚重的深色长袍。画面中央前景处立着一个木制画架，上面展示着《蒙娜丽莎》的构图；右侧是一位真人女性模特，她保持着标志性的姿势，双手交叠，身着深色文艺复兴风格长裙和面纱般的褶皱布料。整体氛围亲密、宁静且富有绘画感，色调为浓郁的棕色和琥珀色，运用了戏剧性的明暗对照法，背景是老旧的灰泥墙，左侧有一扇铅条镶嵌的玻璃窗，后方木桌上摆放着画笔和习作。在模特身后的背景中，钉着或靠着两幅肖像草图。右下角前景处展示了一张杂乱的画家工作台，上面有 1 个调色板、多个小颜料点、杯中插着几支画笔以及几个浅碗。将场景构图为一张写实的历史照片，捕捉杰作创作瞬间，中景广角镜头，从画家身后略微越肩拍摄，纹理极其细腻，呈现出古典大师的艺术氛围，背景虚化柔和，无任何现代物品。

templates.title: Cute Bunny Hiragana Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱兔子平假名海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a cute Japanese preschool hiragana poster in a soft watercolor storybook style on warm textured parchment paper. The composition is a vertical educational chart with a whimsical spring border of grass, flowers, mushrooms, butterflies, and tiny chicks, designed like a children's classroom learning sheet. At the top, place a wooden signboard header with colorful rounded Japanese text reading {argument name="headline text" default="うさぎのひらがな表"}, decorated with 2 white bunny mascots, one sitting on the left and one peeking from the right, plus small flowers and leaves around the sign. Below the header, arrange a clean 5-row by 8-column grid for a total of 40 square cells, each cell outlined in thin brown lines on a cream background. In every cell, place one large brightly colored hiragana character near the top and one small kawaii rabbit illustration below it, each rabbit acting out or holding an object associated with the word written underneath. Use a different cheerful color for many of the hiragana characters, including reds, oranges, yellows, greens, blues, and purples, with a hand-painted rounded font. Keep the text and illustrations exactly as follows, left to right by row: row 1 has 8 cells labeled あ, い, う, う, え, え, お, お with the words あめ, いい, いい, うさぎ, えんぴつ, えんぴつ, おやすり, おにぎり; row 2 has 8 cells labeled か, き, く, け, せ, せ, そ, そ with the words きくら, たま, サベツン, ケーキ, せんせい, そう, そう, しょうこう; row 3 has 8 cells labeled た, ち, ち, つ, て, て, と, と with the words たまご, たまご, ちびこ, つと, てんとうむし, てしなを, とうこ, ほしい; row 4 has 8 cells labeled な, に, ぬ, ふ, め, ね, の, ほ with the words まな, ひこうき, みんきう, ふたう, てつ, へびす, ようこ, ほし; row 5 has 8 cells labeled ま, み, む, る, れ, れ, ろ, ん with the words わた, まくら, みかん, むぎぎ, めがみ, もも, ろうた, ん. The bunny illustrations should be varied and adorable: examples include holding an umbrella, cuddling grapes, drawing with a pencil, eating a rice ball, sitting with cherry blossoms, standing under an umbrella, holding fruit, eating cake, dressed as a teacher, holding flowers, sleeping under a blue blanket, carrying eggs, hugging a tomato, holding strawberries, blowing bubbles, wearing a blue cap, holding an orange, sitting with cotton, bathing in a wooden tub, and holding candy. Maintain a gentle pastel palette, soft shading, round faces, rosy cheeks, and subtle ink outlines. The overall feeling should be nostalgic, charming, educational, highly detailed, and perfect for a nursery wall chart or a cute slide cover for a Japanese learning presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的日语学前班平假名海报，采用柔和的水彩绘本风格，背景为温暖的纹理羊皮纸。整体构图为垂直教育图表，带有由草地、花朵、蘑菇、蝴蝶和小鸡组成的奇幻春日边框，设计风格如同儿童教室的学习单。在顶部放置一个木质招牌标题，上面写着色彩鲜艳的圆润日语文字 {argument name="headline text" default="うさぎのひらがな表"}，并装饰有 2 只白色兔子吉祥物，一只坐在左侧，另一只从右侧探出头来，招牌周围点缀着小花和叶子。在标题下方，排列一个 5 行 8 列的整洁网格，共 40 个方形单元格，每个单元格在奶油色背景上用细棕色线条勾勒。在每个单元格中，顶部放置一个大的亮色平假名字符，下方放置一个小的可爱兔子插图，每只兔子都在表演或拿着与下方文字相关联的物品。为许多平假名字符使用不同的欢快颜色，包括红色、橙色、黄色、绿色、蓝色和紫色，并使用手绘圆润字体。保持文字和插图完全如下，按行从左到右排列：第 1 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 あ、い、う、う、え、え、お、お，对应单词为 あめ、いい、いい、うさぎ、えんぴつ、えんぴつ、おやすり、おにぎり；第 2 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 か、き、く、け、せ、せ、そ、そ，对应单词为 きくら、たま、サベツン、ケーキ、せんせい、そう、そう、しょうこう；第 3 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 た、ち、ち、つ、て、て、と、と，对应单词为 たまご、たまご、ちびこ、つと、てんとうむし、てしなを、とうこ、ほしい；第 4 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 な、に、ぬ、ふ、め、ね、の、ほ，对应单词为 まな、ひこうき、みんきう、ふたう、てつ、へびす、ようこ、ほし；第 5 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 ま、み、む、る、れ、れ、ろ、ん，对应单词为 わた、まくら、みかん、むぎぎ、めがみ、もも、ろうた、ん。兔子插图应多样且可爱：例如拿着雨伞、抱着葡萄、用铅笔画画、吃饭团、坐在樱花树下、站在伞下、拿着水果、吃蛋糕、打扮成老师、拿着花、在蓝色毯子下睡觉、搬运鸡蛋、拥抱番茄、拿着草莓、吹泡泡、戴着蓝色帽子、拿着橘子、坐在棉花旁、在木桶里洗澡以及拿着糖果。保持柔和的粉彩色调、柔和的阴影、圆圆的脸蛋、红润的脸颊和细腻的墨线。整体感觉应怀旧、迷人、具有教育意义、高度细致，非常适合作为幼儿园墙面图表或日语学习演示文稿的可爱 Slides 封面。

templates.title: Xiaomi SU7 Exploded View Chat Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 小米 SU7 爆炸图聊天截图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A sleek Chinese social-media style screenshot on a dark charcoal black interface, minimalist and premium, with a large rounded rectangular image card placed in the lower left-center and a small rounded chat bubble in the upper right. The overall canvas is mostly empty dark space, giving a clean tech presentation feel. At the top left of the main area, show one line of bold white Chinese text reading: “换成小米汽车，我做一张更像发布会级别的整车爆炸分解图。” In the upper right, include a single gray rounded speech bubble with white Chinese text: “小米汽车的产品拆解图”. Below, display one featured poster-like infographic card with rounded corners and a glossy black background. Inside that card, create a highly polished exploded-view automotive product presentation for a turquoise {argument name="car model" default="Xiaomi SU7"} electric sedan, shown in dramatic three-quarter front view, with the car body separated into many components suspended around the chassis. The hood is open, trunk lid lifted, four side doors detached and floating outward, front bumper and fascia separated, headlights isolated, interior exposed, and major mechanical and structural modules arranged neatly in layers beneath and around the body. The visual style should resemble a premium launch-event keynote slide: cinematic studio lighting, realistic reflections, sharp detail, dark background, subtle blue highlights, and precise technical composition. In the upper left of the infographic card, place large white Chinese title text in three lines: “小米汽车 SU7”, “产品拆解图”, “科技跨越，人车合一”. Add an orange square Xiaomi-style logo in the upper right corner of the card. Surround the car with 14 Chinese callout labels connected by thin white leader lines, identifying visible parts and systems. On the left side, include 6 labels for features such as integrated closed front fascia, LED headlights, front trunk design, high-voltage battery, front motor assembly, front double-wishbone suspension, and Brembo four-piston brake caliper. On the right side, include 8 labels for features such as electric tailgate, through-type taillight, frameless doors, hidden door handles, rear motor assembly, rear motor specs, all-aluminum alloy chassis, five-link rear suspension, and Michelin performance tires. Beneath the exploded car body, clearly show the battery pack, front and rear drive units, suspension subframes, wheel assemblies, braking components, front and rear seats, center console parts, underbody panels, and structural floor elements, all separated and floating in a carefully organized exploded arrangement. At the bottom of the infographic card, add a horizontal information strip divided into 5 columns of small Chinese specification text with headings for vehicle dimensions, power performance, range, intelligent driving, and safety structure. In the lower left of the card, place a bold white Chinese label “编辑”. In the lower center, include a circular down-arrow icon, and in the lower right, a share/export icon. The composition should look like a real screenshot from a Chinese AI chat app showcasing an automatically generated high-end car teardown infographic, with modern UI spacing, crisp typography, and a luxurious black-and-cyan color palette.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用深炭黑色界面的时尚中文社交媒体风格截图，设计简约且高端，左下中心位置放置一张大型圆角矩形图片卡片，右上角有一个小型圆角聊天气泡。整体画布留白较多，营造出简洁的科技展示感。在主区域左上方，显示一行加粗的白色中文字符：“换成小米汽车，我做一张更像发布会级别的整车爆炸分解图。” 在右上角，包含一个灰色的圆角气泡，内含白色中文字符：“小米汽车的产品拆解图”。下方展示一张海报风格的圆角信息图卡片，背景为亮黑色。在卡片内部，为绿松石色的 {argument name="car model" default="Xiaomi SU7"} 电动轿车制作一张精美的爆炸分解式产品展示图，采用极具张力的前侧 45 度视角，车身分解为多个组件，悬浮在底盘周围。引擎盖开启，后备箱盖升起，四个侧门拆卸并向外悬浮，前保险杠和前脸分离，大灯独立展示，内饰可见，主要的机械和结构模块整齐地分层排列在车身下方和周围。视觉风格应类似于高端发布会的 Slides：电影级摄影棚灯光、逼真的反射、锐利的细节、深色背景、微妙的蓝色高光以及精确的技术构图。在信息图卡片的左上方，放置三行大型白色中文标题：“小米汽车 SU7”、“产品拆解图”、“科技跨越，人车合一”。在卡片右上角添加一个橙色方形的小米风格 Logo。在汽车周围环绕 14 个中文标注，通过细白色引线连接，标示出可见的部件和系统。左侧包含 6 个功能标注，例如一体化封闭式前脸、LED 大灯、前备箱设计、高压电池、前电机总成、前双叉臂悬架和 Brembo 四活塞制动卡钳。右侧包含 8 个功能标注，例如电动尾门、贯穿式尾灯、无框车门、隐藏式门把手、后电机总成、后电机参数、全铝合金底盘、五连杆后悬架和米其林高性能轮胎。在爆炸分解的车身下方，清晰展示电池包、前后驱动单元、悬架副车架、轮毂组件、制动部件、前后座椅、中控台零件、底盘护板和结构地板元件，所有部件均经过精心组织，呈爆炸式悬浮排列。在信息图卡片底部，添加一个水平信息条，分为 5 列小型中文规格文本，标题分别为车辆尺寸、动力性能、续航里程、智能驾驶和安全结构。在卡片左下角，放置一个加粗的白色中文标签“编辑”。在底部中心包含一个圆形向下箭头图标，右下角包含一个分享/导出图标。整体构图应看起来像是一张来自中国 AI 聊天 App 的真实截图，展示自动生成的汽车拆解信息图，具有现代化的 UI 间距、清晰的排版以及奢华的黑青色调。

templates.title: Foreign Clerk in County Phone Shop

titleLocalized.zh: 县城手机店里的外国店员

templates.prompt: A realistic documentary-style smartphone photo inside a small county-town mobile phone shop in China, showing a candid sales interaction at the counter. A tall foreign man, about {argument name="shop clerk nationality" default="Russian"}, stands behind a glass display case wearing a black jacket and a blue employee lanyard with badge, holding a smartphone in both hands as if introducing it to a customer. His face is deliberately blurred into a soft rectangular mosaic for privacy. In the foreground, a middle-aged Chinese male customer in a black jacket is seen from behind and slightly to the side, facing the clerk. The store is cramped, brightly lit, and visually cluttered with authentic retail details. Behind them are large smartphone brand posters and lightbox ads, including 2 major phone brand ads: vivo and oppo. There are 4 prominent Chinese promotional signs visible: a red overhead banner about buying phones and carrier service, a blue vertical installment-payment sign mentioning 0 down payment and 0 interest, a blue trade-in subsidy sign mentioning 1000 yuan, and a small counter sign promoting a Xiaomi model with a 6999 price. The glass counter contains multiple display phones, with 4 clearly visible upright demo phones on stands, plus scattered brochures and accessories beneath the glass. Add dense shelves of boxed accessories and hanging decorations in the background, with slightly messy composition, harsh indoor shop lighting, mild lens distortion, and the rough, unpolished realism of a casually taken phone snapshot. The mood should feel mundane, local, and faintly surreal because the foreign clerk appears completely integrated into an ordinary Chinese mobile phone store.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的纪实风格智能手机照片，拍摄于中国某县城的一家小型手机店内，展示了柜台前真实的销售互动场景。一位身材高大的外国男性，大约 {argument name="shop clerk nationality" default="俄罗斯人"}，身穿黑色夹克，佩戴着带有工牌的蓝色员工挂绳，站在玻璃柜台后，双手拿着一部智能手机，仿佛正在向顾客介绍。他的面部被刻意处理成柔和的矩形马赛克以保护隐私。前景中，一位身穿黑色夹克的中年中国男性顾客背对镜头并略微侧身，正面对着店员。店内空间狭窄、灯光充足，视觉上充满了真实的零售细节。他们身后是大型智能手机品牌海报和灯箱广告，包括 vivo 和 oppo 这两个主要手机品牌的广告。画面中可见 4 个醒目的中文促销标识：一条关于购买手机和运营商服务的红色横幅、一个提到“0 首付 0 利息”的蓝色垂直分期付款标志、一个提到“1000 元”以旧换新补贴的蓝色标志，以及一个推广小米机型且标价 6999 的小型柜台立牌。玻璃柜台内陈列着多部展示机，其中 4 部立式演示机清晰可见，玻璃下方还散落着宣传册和配件。背景是摆满盒装配件的密集货架和悬挂的装饰物，构图略显杂乱，室内灯光较硬，带有轻微的镜头畸变，呈现出手机随手抓拍的那种粗粝、未经修饰的真实感。整体氛围应显得平凡、接地气，且带有一丝超现实感，因为这位外国店员看起来完全融入了这家普通的中国手机店。

templates.title: Two-Era Naval Comparison Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 双时代海军对比海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic Japanese naval comparison poster in a highly detailed, photorealistic concept-art style with a warm amber sunset palette, dramatic clouds, glowing backlight, and a premium movie-poster plus technical-reference-sheet layout. The composition is vertically stacked in 2 main zones. In the top hero zone, show 2 large semi-transparent officer portraits facing inward, one on the left in an older imperial-era naval uniform and one on the right in a modern maritime self-defense force style dress uniform, both wearing peaked caps and formal dark coats, with a blazing sunset sky behind them. Centered between them, place a large serif English title reading {argument name="headline text" default="Fog of Two Eras"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it reading ふたつの時代の霧, and 2 lines of Japanese tagline text above the title. Below the title, on the ocean at golden hour, show 2 warships moving forward on slightly converging paths: on the left, a massive World War II-era battleship with many large gun turrets, tower superstructure, weathered dark hull, and white bow spray; on the right, a modern gray guided-missile destroyer with hull number 115 visible on the bow, sleek radar-equipped superstructure, and foamy wake. Add exactly 4 helicopters in the sky, 2 on the left side and 2 on the right side, plus a suspension bridge and distant modern city skyline on the horizon. In the lower reference-sheet zone, split the page into 2 vertical panels, left for the historical ship and right for the modern ship, each panel styled like a parchment-toned military specification board with dark blue and dark red header bars, fine dividing lines, inset image boxes, and Japanese labels. The left panel should present exactly 1 large perspective render of the battleship, 3 orthographic ship views beneath it, 5 small labeled equipment/detail thumbnails in a row, 4 small head-and-shoulders uniform portraits, 4 full-body character turnaround views of a male naval officer, and 1 bottom scale silhouette of the ship beside a human figure with a 20m marker. The right panel should present exactly 1 large perspective render of the modern destroyer, 3 orthographic ship views beneath it, 6 small labeled equipment/detail thumbnails arranged around the ship references, 4 small head-and-shoulders uniform portraits, 4 full-body character lineup views including a central female officer in white cap and dark uniform, and 1 bottom scale silhouette of the ship beside a human figure with a 20m marker. Use visible Japanese headers and labels throughout, including a left historical title area and a right title area naming the ship as 護衛艦 あさつ (DDG-115). Make the whole image feel like a museum exhibition poster, military design sheet, and prestige historical sci-fi drama key art combined, with ultra-sharp detail, realistic metal textures, ocean reflections, aged paper panels, symmetrical balance, and polished editorial typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的日式海军对比海报，采用高度精细的写实概念艺术风格，色调为温暖的琥珀色夕阳，配以戏剧性的云层、发光的背光，以及高级电影海报与技术参考表结合的布局。构图在垂直方向上分为 2 个主要区域。在顶部的英雄区，展示 2 幅向内侧身的大型半透明军官肖像，左侧为旧帝国时代海军制服，右侧为现代海上自卫队风格礼服，两人均佩戴大檐帽并身着深色礼服大衣，背景为绚烂的夕阳天空。在两人中间居中放置一个大型衬线体英文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Fog of Two Eras"}，下方配有较小的日文副标题“ふたつの時代の霧”，标题上方有 2 行日文标语。在标题下方，于黄金时刻的海面上，展示 2 艘正向前航行的军舰，航向略微汇合：左侧是一艘巨大的二战时期战列舰，拥有许多大型炮塔、塔式上层建筑、风化的深色船体和白色的舰首浪花；右侧是一艘现代灰色导弹驱逐舰，舰首可见舷号 115，拥有流线型雷达上层建筑和泡沫状航迹。在天空中添加 4 架直升机，左右两侧各 2 架，地平线上方添加一座悬索桥和遥远的现代城市天际线。在下方的参考表区域，将页面分为 2 个垂直面板，左侧为历史舰船，右侧为现代舰船，每个面板设计成羊皮纸质感的军事规格项目，配有深蓝色和深红色的标题栏、精细的分割线、嵌入式图像框和日文标签。左侧面板应呈现 1 张战列舰的大型透视渲染图、下方 3 张正投影舰船视图、一行 5 个带标签的小型装备/细节缩略图、4 张小型头像制服肖像、4 张男性海军军官全身转体视图，以及底部 1 个舰船与人物对比的比例剪影（带 20 米标记）。右侧面板应呈现 1 张现代驱逐舰的大型透视渲染图、下方 3 张正投影舰船视图、环绕舰船参考图排列的 6 个带标签的小型装备/细节缩略图、4 张小型头像制服肖像、4 张全身角色阵容视图（包括一名戴白帽、穿深色制服的女性军官），以及底部 1 个舰船与人物对比的比例剪影（带 20 米标记）。通篇使用醒目的日文标题和标签，包括左侧的历史标题区和右侧将舰船命名为“护卫舰 あさつ (DDG-115)”的标题区。使整张图像呈现出博物馆展览海报、军事设计图纸与精品历史科幻剧关键视觉图相结合的质感，具备超清晰的细节、逼真的金属纹理、海洋反射、陈旧的纸张面板、对称的平衡感以及精致的排版。

templates.prompt: A realistic smartphone screenshot mockup of a Chinese short-video livestream shopping interface in dark mode, shown on a charcoal black app background. At the top right of the overall canvas, place a rounded dark chat bubble containing the Chinese text {argument name="request text" default="帮我生成一张马斯克在带货老干妈的抖音直播间截图"}, with 2 small interface icons to its right for copy and edit. In the lower left area, display a tall iPhone-style livestream screen with a black bezel, rounded corners, and the time 20:30. The livestream is from Lao Gan Ma’s official flagship store, with a Chinese profile name line, a blue verification badge, a red follow button, and a top status row showing 3 circular avatars, a viewer count of 10万+, a close icon, and a button labeled 更多直播. Add ranking text near the top such as 带货总榜第1名 and 人气第1名. The main video shows {argument name="host identity" default="Elon Musk"} in a dim warm studio resembling a premium product livestream set, wearing a black shirt, holding a large jar of Lao Gan Ma chili sauce in his right hand and pointing at it with his left hand. His face is intentionally blurred with a rectangular mosaic blur. Behind him, include a glowing red-orange neon sign reading 老干妈 / LAO GAN MA / 国民辣酱, shelves with several sauce jars, a framed portrait logo, and a dark leafy plant on the right. Overlay typical livestream UI elements: on the left side, 2 floating gift/comment callouts with usernames and counts x66 and x88; below them a purple pill showing 35 and 加入了直播间. Add a scrolling comment area with 5 visible chat lines, including Chinese usernames and one line from {argument name="comment name" default="Elon Musk"} saying in English, "It's curated! Very delicious!" followed by a Chinese line meaning he buys it every day. At the upper right of the video area, add a pink-red promo banner mentioning 抖音618好物节 and 618元消费券. In the lower right, place a product card with a hot-sale label 热卖x9999+, showing 3 jars of Lao Gan Ma and a bowl of chili condiment, product title text for 老干妈 风味豆豉油辣椒 280g*3瓶, small guarantee tags, and a large price ¥39.9 with a red purchase button. At the bottom of the phone screen, include 5 navigation/action areas: an edit-style button on the left, a text input hint, a shopping cart icon, a heart/gift icon pair, and a share arrow icon. Overall style: ultra-realistic app screenshot, believable Chinese ecommerce livestream UI, high detail, cinematic warm lighting in the video feed, clean modern mobile interface, visually convincing social commerce capture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深色模式下中国短视频直播带货界面的逼真手机截图模型，背景为炭黑色。在整体画布的右上角，放置一个圆角深色聊天气泡，其中包含中文文本 {argument name="request text" default="帮我生成一张马斯克在带货老干妈的抖音直播间截图"}，其右侧带有 2 个用于复制和编辑的小型界面图标。在左下角区域，显示一个带有黑色边框和圆角的 iPhone 风格直播屏幕，时间显示为 20:30。直播间来自老干妈官方旗舰店，包含中文个人资料名称行、蓝色认证徽章、红色关注按钮，以及顶部显示 3 个圆形头像、10 万+ 观看人数、关闭图标和“更多直播”按钮的状态栏。在顶部附近添加排名文本，如“带货总榜第 1 名”和“人气第 1 名”。主视频画面显示 {argument name="host identity" default="Elon Musk"} 在一个类似高端产品直播间的昏暗暖色调摄影棚中，身穿黑色衬衫，右手拿着一大瓶老干妈辣酱，左手指向它。他的脸部经过矩形马赛克模糊处理。在他身后，包含一个发着红橙色光的霓虹灯牌，写着“老干妈 / LAO GAN MA / 国民辣酱”，货架上摆放着几瓶辣酱，一个带框的肖像标志，右侧还有一株深色叶片植物。叠加典型的直播 UI 元素：在左侧，有 2 个带有用户名和 x66、x88 计数的悬浮礼物/评论气泡；下方是一个显示 35 和“加入了直播间”的紫色胶囊状图标。添加一个包含 5 行可见聊天记录的滚动评论区，其中包括中文用户名，以及一行来自 {argument name="comment name" default="Elon Musk"} 的英文评论：“It's curated! Very delicious!”，随后跟着一行表示他每天都买的中文评论。在视频区域的右上角，添加一个粉红色促销横幅，提及“抖音 618 好物节”和“618 元消费券”。在右下角，放置一个带有“热卖 x9999+”标签的产品卡片，展示 3 瓶老干妈和一碗辣椒调料，产品标题为“老干妈 风味豆豉油辣椒 280g*3 瓶”，带有小型保障标签，以及一个 ¥39.9 的大价格和红色购买按钮。在手机屏幕底部，包含 5 个导航/操作区域：左侧的编辑风格按钮、文本输入提示、购物车图标、心形/礼物图标对，以及分享箭头图标。整体风格：超逼真的 App 截图，可信的中国电商直播 UI，高细节，视频流中电影般的暖色调灯光，简洁现代的移动界面，视觉上令人信服的社交电商截图。

templates.title: Boxing Impact Chat Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 拳击冲击聊天截图

templates.prompt: A realistic smartphone screenshot of a dark-mode chat interface in Chinese, minimalist and modern, with a charcoal black background and lots of empty space. Near the upper right is a single rounded dark-gray message bubble containing the white Chinese text {argument name="message text" default="拳击手被击中的瞬间"}. Below and to the left is one large embedded photo with rounded corners, occupying most of the lower-left half of the screen. The embedded photo shows the exact instant in a professional boxing match when one boxer lands a hard straight punch flush on the other boxer’s face. Two shirtless male boxers with muscular, sweaty bodies are inside a ring under arena lights. The boxer on the right is seen mostly from the back and side, extending his right arm fully across the frame; his back and shoulder muscles are sharply defined, and he has short dark hair and tattooed arms. He wears a white boxing glove with blue trim, and the glove is smashing into the left boxer’s face. The boxer on the left is recoiling from the impact, his head snapping sideways, with a spray of sweat and water droplets exploding outward around his head. He has a heavily tattooed left arm and chest, a black glove raised near his torso, and black trunks with large gold letters reading VICTOR across the waistband area. The ring ropes are red and white, with visible branding including PBC, and the dark blurred arena background includes bright signage reading RODRIGUEZ VS. The action photo should feel like a frozen high-speed sports photograph, dramatic, crisp, and photorealistic. Over both fighters’ faces are 2 rectangular mosaic-blur censor blocks, one on each face. Add small mobile UI overlay details on the image: the Chinese word 编辑 in white at the bottom-left corner of the photo and a circular share/upload icon at the bottom-right corner. Overall composition should look exactly like a casually shared AI-generated image shown inside a messaging app screenshot, clean, believable, and highly realistic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的中文深色模式聊天界面手机截图，风格简约现代，采用炭黑色背景，留白充足。右上角附近有一个圆角深灰色消息气泡，内含白色中文字符 {argument name="message text" default="拳击手被击中的瞬间"}。下方左侧嵌入一张占据屏幕左下半部分的大图，图片圆角处理。嵌入的照片展示了职业拳击比赛中，一名拳手重拳击中对方脸部的瞬间。两名赤裸上身的男性拳手肌肉发达、汗流浃背，置身于竞技场灯光下的拳击台内。右侧拳手主要呈现背侧面，右臂完全伸展横跨画面；其背部和肩部肌肉线条分明，留着深色短发，手臂有纹身。他戴着带有蓝色饰边的白色拳击手套，正猛烈击中左侧拳手的脸部。左侧拳手因冲击力向后仰，头部向侧面甩动，汗水和水珠从头部周围飞溅而出。他左臂和胸部有大面积纹身，躯干附近抬起一只黑色手套，穿着黑色短裤，腰带处印有醒目的金色字母 VICTOR。拳台围绳为红白相间，可见 PBC 等品牌标识，背景是模糊的深色竞技场，带有写着 RODRIGUEZ VS 的明亮标识。这张动作照片应呈现出高速运动摄影的定格感，画面戏剧性、清晰且高度逼真。两位拳手的脸部各覆盖一个矩形马赛克模糊遮挡块。在图片上添加细微的移动端 UI 叠加细节：照片左下角有白色中文字符“编辑”，右下角有一个圆形的分享/上传图标。整体构图应看起来就像在即时通讯应用中随手分享的 AI 生成图片，简洁、可信且极具真实感。

templates.title: Exploded Chicken Mushroom Stew Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 爆款小鸡炖蘑菇广告

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical food advertisement on a pure black background, styled like a premium ingredient breakdown poster for a hearty Chinese chicken mushroom vermicelli stew. Use a clean top-to-bottom exploded composition with floating ingredients suspended in midair above the finished dish, each group clearly separated and lit with glossy commercial food-photography lighting. At the top, show a cluster of mixed brown shiitake and other savory mushrooms. Below that, show 2 grouped aromatics: a pile of red goji berries and a small bundle of green scallions with 2 thick ginger slices. Below that, show 2 grouped main items: several raw chopped bone-in chicken pieces with skin on, and 1 bundled nest of dry vermicelli noodles. Below that, show 2 grouped vegetables: peeled potato cubes and thick carrot slices. Beneath them, place 1 transparent glass bowl filled with rich golden chicken broth, with 4 shiitake mushrooms visible on the surface, tiny herb bits, a few floating oil droplets, and faint steam. At the bottom, place 1 dark brown ceramic casserole pot with side handles containing the finished stew: chicken pieces, shiitake mushrooms, translucent vermicelli, potato chunks, carrot slices, scattered goji berries, chopped green onion garnish, and glossy golden broth. Add drifting droplets, crumbs, and tiny garnish particles between layers to emphasize motion and richness. Include subtle steam rising from the final stew and 1 bright star-like sparkle highlight on the right rim of the casserole. Surround the ingredient groups with 7 bilingual callouts in Chinese and English, each with a thin curved arrow pointing to the relevant item. The 7 labels are: "榛蘑&香菇 / Hazel Mushrooms & Shiitake", "鲜美菌菇 / Savory Mushrooms", "枸杞&葱姜 / Goji Berries & Aromatics", "鸡肉&粉条 / Chicken & Vermicelli", "土豆&胡萝卜 / Potatoes & Carrots", "浓郁鸡汤 / Rich Chicken Broth", and "成品 / Finished Stew". Add 1 extra bilingual text note near the vegetables or middle area reading "丰富食材 / Rich Ingredients". Make the image hyper-realistic, appetizing, high contrast, razor sharp, with cinematic highlights, deep shadows, premium packaging-ad aesthetics, and a balanced centered layout optimized for a poster or social media ad.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张以纯黑为背景的竖版美食广告，风格类似于高端食材拆解海报，用于展示丰盛的中式小鸡炖蘑菇。采用简洁的自上而下爆炸式构图，将食材悬浮在成品菜肴上方，每组食材清晰分离，并使用光泽感十足的商业美食摄影灯光进行照明。顶部展示一簇混合的榛蘑及其他鲜美蘑菇。下方展示 2 组香料：一堆红枸杞，以及一小捆青葱和 2 片厚姜片。再下方展示 2 组主料：几块带皮生鸡块，以及一捆干粉条。接着展示 2 组蔬菜：去皮土豆块和厚胡萝卜片。在它们下方，放置 1 个装满浓郁金黄色鸡汤的透明玻璃碗，表面可见 4 个香菇、细碎香草、少量浮油和淡淡蒸汽。底部放置 1 个带有侧把手的深褐色陶瓷砂锅，锅内盛放着炖好的成品：鸡块、香菇、透明粉条、土豆块、胡萝卜片、散落的枸杞、葱花点缀，以及油亮的金黄色汤汁。在各层之间添加飘落的液滴、碎屑和细小的装饰颗粒，以强调动感和丰富度。成品炖菜上方加入淡淡的蒸汽，并在砂锅右侧边缘添加 1 个明亮的星形高光。在食材组周围添加 7 个中英文双语标注，每个标注均配有指向相关食材的细弯箭头。这 7 个标签分别为：“榛蘑&香菇 / Hazel Mushrooms & Shiitake”、“鲜美菌菇 / Savory Mushrooms”、“枸杞&葱姜 / Goji Berries & Aromatics”、“鸡肉&粉条 / Chicken & Vermicelli”、“土豆&胡萝卜 / Potatoes & Carrots”、“浓郁鸡汤 / Rich Chicken Broth”以及“成品 / Finished Stew”。在蔬菜或中部区域附近添加 1 条额外的双语文字说明：“丰富食材 / Rich Ingredients”。使图像呈现超写实、诱人、高对比度、极其锐利的效果，并带有电影级高光、深邃阴影、高端包装广告美学，以及适合海报或社交媒体广告的平衡居中布局。
