templates.title: Anime Martial Arts Energy Clash

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫武术能量对决

templates.prompt: A dramatic anime action illustration inside a traditional wooden martial arts hall, captured at a low angle with intense cinematic perspective. In the foreground, a fierce young female martial artist with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair in a messy high bun tied with red ribbons lunges forward in a deep fighting stance, one fist thrust toward the viewer. She wears a white Chinese-style kung fu top with red trim and tassel frog closures, wide red pants, and black martial arts shoes with red accents. Her expression is focused, aggressive, and determined, with sharp red-tinted eyes. Red energy ribbons and paint-like light trails spiral around her body and punch, scattering sparks and embers. In the upper right, a second young female fighter leaps through the air, partially turned sideways, wearing a dark green qipao-inspired combat dress with ornate gold embroidery, black stockings, and heeled shoes. Her {argument name="second character hair color" default="lavender"} hair is styled in two buns with loose curls and decorative hair ornaments. She casts a martial arts gesture with one hand extended, surrounded by a sweeping arc of luminous blue water-like energy that curves around her body in a near-complete ring. The two elemental forces, red and blue, contrast sharply and imply an imminent clash. The environment is a weathered dojo interior with broken wooden floorboards exploding upward, dust, splinters, and motion debris frozen midair. Warm shafts of light stream through the wooden structure and windows, mixing with glowing particles. Large hanging calligraphy signs are visible, including a central wooden plaque reading {argument name="main sign text" default="武術会"}, with additional vertical banners bearing black Chinese characters on aged paper. Highly detailed anime illustration, dynamic foreshortening, extreme motion, layered effects, rich textures, dramatic rim lighting, fiery warm highlights against cool blue energy, polished concept art quality, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的动漫动作插画，场景设定在传统的木质武术馆内，采用低角度拍摄，呈现出强烈的电影透视感。前景中，一位神情凶猛的年轻女武术家正摆出深蹲战斗姿态向前冲刺，一只拳头直击镜头，她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的头发，扎成凌乱的高丸子头，并系着红色丝带。她身穿带有红色镶边和盘扣的白色中式功夫上衣，搭配红色阔腿裤和带有红色装饰的黑色武术鞋。她的表情专注、充满攻击性且意志坚定，双眼闪烁着锐利的红光。红色的能量丝带和如油画般的流光环绕着她的身体和拳头，四散着火花与余烬。在右上角，第二位年轻女战士正跃向空中，身体呈半侧状，身穿深绿色旗袍风格的战斗服，配有华丽的金色刺绣、黑色长袜和高跟鞋。她的 {argument name="second character hair color" default="薰衣草色"} 头发梳成两个丸子头，带有卷曲的碎发和装饰性发饰。她单手伸出做出武术手势，周围环绕着一道弧形的蓝色发光水流能量，在身体周围形成一个近乎完整的圆环。红蓝两种元素力量形成鲜明对比，预示着一场迫在眉睫的冲突。环境为破旧的道场内部，破碎的木质地板向上炸裂，灰尘、木屑和运动碎片在半空中凝固。温暖的光束穿过木质结构和窗户，与发光的粒子交织在一起。背景可见大型悬挂书法牌匾，包括一块写有 {argument name="main sign text" default="武術会"} 的中央木质牌匾，以及带有黑色汉字的陈旧纸质竖幅。高细节动漫插画，动态透视，极致动感，层叠特效，质感丰富，戏剧性的轮廓光，冷色调蓝色能量与火热暖色高光的碰撞，精美的概念艺术品质，竖构图。

templates.title: Side-by-Side AI Portrait Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: AI 人像对比侧边展示

templates.prompt: A side-by-side desktop screenshot comparing two nearly identical AI-generated street portraits in separate macOS-style image viewer windows against a light cyan background. The layout has exactly 2 vertical image panels, left and right, each inside a rounded gray window with a toolbar at the top. The left window title begins with "NanoBanana2" and the right window title begins with "ChatGPTImage2". In both panels, show the same scene concept: a fashionable young woman standing on a city street corner during golden hour, framed from about mid-thigh to head, with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. She has long wavy brown hair, a slim figure, and wears an off-shoulder fitted cream long-sleeve top, high-waisted blue jeans, a delicate small pendant necklace, and a large black leather shoulder bag with a gold-tone chain strap over one shoulder. She holds a black smartphone in one hand near her waist. The background in both panels is an upscale tree-lined urban street with warm sunlight filtering through leaves, shallow depth of field, parked and passing cars, old stone buildings, and a visible green traffic light near the upper left area of each image. Keep the two portraits very similar but not identical: the left image is slightly cooler, softer, and more muted with a centered street perspective; the right image is slightly warmer, brighter, and crisper with stronger sunlight on the hair and more dramatic bokeh. Include exactly 2 viewer windows separated by a narrow vertical gap, with subtle drop shadows and a clean tech-comparison presentation, as if capturing a visual comparison between two image generation models.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张桌面侧边对比截图，在两个独立的 macOS 风格图像查看器窗口中展示两张几乎相同、由 AI 生成的街头人像，背景为浅青色。布局包含左右两个垂直图像面板，每个面板位于带有顶部工具栏的圆角灰色窗口内。左侧窗口标题以“NanoBanana2”开头，右侧窗口标题以“ChatGPTImage2”开头。两个面板均展示同一场景概念：一位时尚年轻女性站在黄金时段的城市街角，取景范围从大腿中部到头部，面部被柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡。她留着波浪形棕色长发，身材苗条，身穿露肩修身米色长袖上衣、高腰蓝色牛仔裤，佩戴精致的小吊坠项链，单肩背着一个带有金色链条的黑色大皮包。她的一只手拿着黑色智能手机，置于腰部附近。两个面板的背景均为高档绿树成荫的城市街道，温暖的阳光透过树叶洒下，具有浅景深效果，画面中有停放和行驶的车辆、古老的石砌建筑，每张图像左上角附近可见绿色的交通信号灯。保持两张人像非常相似但不完全相同：左侧图像色调稍冷、更柔和且更柔和，采用居中的街道视角；右侧图像色调稍暖、更明亮且更清晰，头发上的阳光感更强，虚化效果更具戏剧性。包含两个由窄垂直间隙隔开的查看器窗口，带有细腻的投影和简洁的科技对比展示效果，如同捕捉两个图像生成模型之间的视觉对比。

templates.title: Premium Blueberry Product Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高端蓝莓产品海报

templates.prompt: A premium e-commerce poster for fresh blueberries in a clean Chinese product-advertising style. Show a clear plastic clamshell box of blueberries as the main subject, placed diagonally from lower center to right side on folded blue fabric, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The package must remain realistic and consistent: a transparent square container with rounded corners, filled with dark blue blueberries, with a large irregular rounded label on top in white, pale blue, and deep blue, featuring one oversized blueberry illustration in the center and elegant Chinese branding. Make the fruit inside look larger, plumper, fresher, and covered with subtle moisture droplets, while keeping the overall blueberry arrangement believable. The background is an airy icy-blue tabletop with soft cloudy texture, cool daylight, and scattered loose blueberries around the package. Add a few blurred green leaves entering from the top right and bottom right edges for a fresh natural feeling. In the upper-right corner, include 1 small inset image showing the original product package from above on a warm brown surface, like a reference thumbnail. On the left side, create Chinese promotional typography with a large dark blue calligraphy headline {argument name="headline text" default="决茗新"}, followed by 2 smaller lines of copy: {argument name="subheadline text" default="新鲜蓝莓 自然之选"} and {argument name="tagline text" default="每一颗都是自然的礼物"}. Below that, place 3 vertically stacked feature icons with short Chinese captions: a leaf icon for natural ripeness, a fruit icon for juicy fullness, and a heart icon for rich nutrition. Near the bottom left, add large white brush-style Chinese text {argument name="product name" default="蓝莓"}, a secondary line {argument name="benefit text" default="膳食纤维+花青素"}, and a small net weight line reading 125克. Use cool blue color grading, crisp commercial lighting, sparkling highlights on the plastic lid, premium supermarket packaging aesthetics, high detail, realistic product photography blended with polished graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用简洁中式产品广告风格的高端蓝莓电商海报。主体展示一盒透明塑料盒装蓝莓，以略微俯视的角度斜向放置在折叠的蓝色布料上，从左下延伸至右侧。包装需保持写实且一致：一个带有圆角的透明方形容器，装满深蓝色蓝莓，顶部贴有大面积不规则圆形标签，配色为白色、浅蓝色和深蓝色，中心绘有一颗巨大的蓝莓插图，并配有优雅的中文字体品牌名称。盒内蓝莓需呈现得更大、更饱满、更新鲜，并覆盖细微的水珠，同时保持蓝莓整体排列的真实感。背景为带有柔和云雾纹理的通透冰蓝色桌面，光线为冷色调日光，包装周围散落着几颗蓝莓。在右上角和右下角边缘加入少量模糊的绿叶，营造清新自然的感觉。在右上角加入 1 张小型嵌入式图片，展示原始产品包装在暖棕色表面上的俯视图，作为参考缩略图。在左侧设计中式促销排版，包含一个深蓝色的大号书法标题 {argument name="headline text" default="决茗新"}，下方跟随两行较小的文案：{argument name="subheadline text" default="新鲜蓝莓 自然之选"} 和 {argument name="tagline text" default="每一颗都是自然的礼物"}。下方垂直排列 3 个功能图标及简短中文说明：叶子图标代表自然成熟，水果图标代表汁水饱满，爱心图标代表营养丰富。在左下角附近，添加醒目的白色毛笔风格中文文本 {argument name="product name" default="蓝莓"}，第二行文案 {argument name="benefit text" default="膳食纤维+花青素"}，以及一行小字“净含量 125 克”。采用冷蓝色调，呈现清脆的商业照明效果，塑料盖上有闪亮的高光，具备高端超市包装美学，细节丰富，将写实产品摄影与精致平面设计完美融合。

templates.title: Minimal Pelican Riding Bicycle

titleLocalized.zh: 极简鹈鹕骑自行车

templates.prompt: A minimalist vector-style illustration on a flat light gray background showing a pelican riding a bicycle, drawn from simple geometric shapes with thick dark charcoal outlines. The composition is wide and centered, with the bicycle occupying the lower two-thirds of the image and the bird’s head floating slightly above and forward of the handlebars in a deliberately abstract, diagram-like way. The bicycle is a simple black road-bike silhouette in side view with exactly 2 large wheels, each with a thick outer rim and exactly 4 visible spoke lines forming a cross, a straight horizontal ground line beneath both wheels, a triangular frame, a short black saddle, and simplified crank and pedal details near the rear of the frame. The pelican is constructed from clean abstract pieces: a white rounded head with a small black circular eye, a long open beak pointing left made of 2 parts with an upper orange triangular section and a lower pale pink pouch section, a short dark curve on top of the head, a small separate white oval neck/body connector, a larger white rounded body positioned over the bike, and a single white wing-like shape angled upward over the back. Add exactly 2 orange leg shapes, long narrow rectangles leaning downward from the body toward the bicycle frame, suggesting the bird is pedaling. Keep the forms intentionally sparse and slightly surreal, like a logo test or simple code-editor doodle, with no shading, no gradients, no textures, no text, and lots of negative space.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简矢量风格插图，背景为平整的浅灰色，展示了一只正在骑自行车的鹈鹕。插图由简单的几何形状构成，并带有粗犷的深炭灰色轮廓。构图宽阔且居中，自行车占据了图像下方的三分之二，鸟头位于车把上方稍靠前的位置，呈现出一种刻意抽象的示意图感。自行车为简单的黑色公路车侧影，拥有 2 个大轮子，每个轮子都有厚实的外圈和 4 条形成十字形的辐条，轮下有一条笔直的水平地面线，配有三角形车架、短小的黑色车座，以及车架后部简化的曲柄和踏板细节。鹈鹕由简洁的抽象部件构成：白色的圆形头部配有一只黑色小圆眼；向左张开的长喙由两部分组成，上部为橙色三角形，下部为淡粉色喉囊；头顶有一道短小的深色曲线；颈部与身体连接处有一个独立的小白色椭圆；身体为位于自行车上方的大型白色圆形；背部上方有一个向上倾斜的白色翅膀状形状。添加 2 个橙色腿部形状，即从身体向下延伸至车架的长窄矩形，暗示鸟儿正在踩踏板。保持形态的刻意稀疏和些许超现实感，类似于 Logo 测试或简单的代码编辑器涂鸦，无阴影、无渐变、无纹理、无文字，并留有大量负空间。

templates.title: Washington Crossing Style Winter Boat Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 华盛顿横渡风格冬季船景

templates.prompt: A cinematic historical scene at dusk on a freezing river crossing in winter, showing a crowded wooden rowboat packed with exactly 11 colonial-era soldiers and boatmen pushing through dark icy water filled with floating chunks of ice. In the center stands 1 commanding figure, upright and resolute, wearing a dark navy or black heavy cloak draped over a light tan military uniform and a black tricorne hat, evoking an 18th-century general. Around him are 10 other men seated or crouched low in the boat, dressed in weathered Revolutionary War-era clothing: dark coats, wool caps, cloaks, scarves, leather straps, and tricorne hats, with several gripping long wooden oars and one visible musket angled upward behind the central figure. The mood is grim, cold, and heroic, with wet clothing, snow dusting, pale breathy atmosphere, and a stormy blue-gray sky. The river is wide and partially frozen, with a dark tree-lined shoreline in the distance and a few tiny warm lights glowing on the far bank. Composition is frontal and tightly framed from just above the bow of the boat, making the viewer feel inside the freezing crossing. Use low-key lighting, muted desaturated colors, deep shadows, damp textures, realism, dramatic historical painting energy blended with cinematic photorealism, ultra-detailed fabric, wood grain, ice, and mist.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感历史场景图，描绘了黄昏时分在冰冷的河流上进行冬季横渡的画面。画面中一艘拥挤的木制划艇上载着整整 11 名殖民地时代的士兵和船夫，正穿行在布满浮冰的深色冰水中。画面中央站着一位指挥官，身姿挺拔且坚定，深蓝色或黑色的厚重斗篷披在浅棕色军装外，头戴黑色三角帽，展现出 18 世纪将军的风范。周围 10 名男子在船中坐着或蹲伏，身着饱经风霜的美国独立战争时期服装：深色外套、羊毛帽、斗篷、围巾、皮带和三角帽；几人紧握长木桨，中央人物身后可见一支斜向上方的火枪。氛围阴郁、寒冷且英勇，衣物湿润，带有积雪，空气中弥漫着苍白的哈气，天空呈现风暴般的蓝灰色。河流宽阔且部分结冰，远处是深色的树木繁茂的海岸线，对岸闪烁着几点微弱的暖光。构图采用正面视角，从船头上方紧凑取景，让观者仿佛置身于这冰冷的横渡之中。采用低调照明，色彩柔和且去饱和，深邃阴影，潮湿质感，追求写实主义，融合了戏剧性历史油画的张力与电影级写实感，展现超细节的织物、木纹、冰块和雾气。

templates.title: Japanese Builder Website Hero Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 日本建筑公司网站首屏设计模型

templates.prompt: A polished presentation-style mockup on a dark charcoal background showing a Japanese homebuilder website first view concept. In the upper right, place a large white rounded speech bubble with 4 Japanese bullet lines in clean sans-serif text: 「工務店のwebサイトのファーストビューを作成してください。」, 「- 緑ベース」, 「- お知らせを1件表示」, 「- FV画像は、机を囲んで業者とお客様が話しているところ」, 「- CTAボタン設置」. In the lower left, show a realistic desktop website hero section inside a large rounded browser-like frame with a muted forest-green theme and elegant lifestyle branding for a Japanese construction company. The top navigation bar includes a small house logo at far left, the company name in Japanese, 5 navigation links across the top, and 1 rounded white contact button on the right. The hero area is split visually into 2 major zones: on the left, a green textured panel with layered organic leaf patterns, small introductory copy, a large white Japanese headline in multiple lines, a short paragraph of smaller Japanese body text, and 1 white rounded CTA button; on the right, a warm natural-light photo of exactly 2 people seated across a wooden table in discussion, with papers and a small architectural house model visible, indoor plants and window light in the background. The entire website card has soft shadows, premium editorial spacing, and rounded bottom corners. Along the bottom of the website mockup, include a narrow light-gray notice bar showing exactly 1 announcement item with a small green tag, a date, Japanese notice text, and a subtle link on the right. Add a semi-transparent gray circular badge overlapping the bottom-left corner of the website card containing the Japanese text 「編集」. In the bottom-right corner of the website card, add a small circular share/upload icon. Overall style: high-end Japanese web design concept, realistic UI mockup, refined typography, green natural-material branding, minimal and elegant composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 在一个深炭灰色的背景上，展示一个精美的演示风格模型，呈现日本住宅建筑公司网站的首屏设计概念。在右上角，放置一个大的白色圆角气泡框，内含 4 行简洁的无衬线日文要点： 「工務店のwebサイトのファーストビューを作成してください。」, 「- 緑ベース」, 「- お知らせを1件表示」, 「- FV画像は、机を囲んで業者とお客様が話しているところ」, 「- CTAボタン設置」。在左下角，展示一个逼真的桌面端网站首屏区域，置于一个大的圆角浏览器框架内，采用柔和的森林绿主题，体现日本建筑公司优雅的生活方式品牌形象。顶部导航栏最左侧包含一个小房子 Logo，中间为日文公司名称，顶部横向排列 5 个导航链接，右侧设有一个圆角白色联系按钮。首屏区域在视觉上分为两个主要部分：左侧为带有分层有机叶片图案的绿色纹理面板，配有简短的介绍文案、多行白色大号日文标题、一段简短的日文正文，以及 1 个白色圆角 CTA 按钮；右侧为一张温暖自然光下的照片，展示 2 人围坐在木桌旁讨论，桌上有文件和一个小型建筑模型，背景可见室内植物和窗外光线。整个网站卡片具有柔和的阴影、高级的排版间距和圆角底部。在网站模型底部，包含一个窄窄的浅灰色公告栏，显示 1 条公告信息，带有小绿标、日期、日文公告文本以及右侧的一个细微链接。在网站卡片的左下角叠加一个半透明的灰色圆形徽章，内含日文文本「編集」。在网站卡片的右下角，添加一个小型的圆形分享/上传图标。整体风格：高端日本网页设计概念、逼真的 UI 模型、精致的排版、绿色自然材质品牌感、简约且优雅的构图。

templates.title: Giant Robot Meets Woman on Balcony

titleLocalized.zh: 巨型机器人与阳台上的女子

templates.prompt: A cinematic ultra-detailed dystopian sci-fi scene showing a colossal humanoid robot leaning in toward a lone woman standing on a small rusted balcony attached to a crumbling concrete high-rise. The composition is wide and dramatic: the woman is positioned on the far left, tiny in scale, while the robot dominates the entire right side of the frame. The giant machine has a weathered white-gray metal shell covered in scratches, grime, rust streaks, exposed joints, cables, pistons, and circular mechanical assemblies, with one glowing icy-blue eye. Its massive open hand is extended gently toward the woman, palm up, as if offering help or inviting trust. The woman appears to be a young adult with dark hair tied back, wearing a muted green hooded jacket and dark pants, standing upright and looking up at the robot without fear. Behind them is a dense, worn urban skyline of low rooftops and distant modern skyscrapers fading into haze, under a heavy overcast sky with thick gray storm clouds. The mood is melancholic, intimate, and awe-inspiring, blending post-apocalyptic realism with emotional scale contrast. Use photorealistic rendering, cinematic lighting, desaturated colors, sharp industrial textures, atmospheric perspective, dramatic cloud detail, and a sense of quiet connection between human and machine.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级反乌托邦科幻场景，采用宽画幅、写实风格：一个巨大的风化人形机器人占据了画面右侧，正向左侧远端一个狭小生锈公寓阳台上的孤独女子俯身。机器人高达数层楼，拥有圆形的头盔状头部，一只可见的蓝色发光眼睛，密集的裸露机械关节、分层装甲板、电缆、活塞，以及布满划痕的白灰色金属，覆盖着铁锈、污垢和战斗痕迹。它巨大的右臂向女子伸出，手掌张开并向上，呈现出温柔的馈赠姿态，其精巧的金属手指和巨大的前臂占据了画面下方中心位置。相比之下，女子显得非常渺小，侧身站立，抬头看着机器人，表情平静而沉思；她穿着深绿色连帽夹克和深色裤子，深色头发扎成低马尾。将她置于一个狭窄且腐蚀的阳台上，阳台带有生锈的栏杆，附着在一栋破败的混凝土高层建筑上，左侧边缘可见 2 层阳台及破损废弃的建筑细节。背景展示了一座密集、灰暗、被雨水浸透的超级城市，紧密排列的低层建筑逐渐隐入远处的现代摩天大楼和朦胧的山脉中。采用戏剧性的阴天光照，厚重的风暴云，柔和的钢灰色和炭黑色调，细腻的大气透视，淡淡的薄雾，营造出巨大的尺度感、孤独感以及人机之间意想不到的温柔。超精细纹理，逼真的金属磨损，电影级景深，情绪化的色彩分级，高对比度云层，以及严肃的未来主义基调。

templates.title: AI Chat Screenshot with Ad Design Grids

titleLocalized.zh: 带有广告设计网格的 AI 聊天截图

templates.prompt: A dark-mode mobile chat interface screenshot showing two separate Japanese prompt-and-result exchanges about AI-generated ad design. The background is nearly black. There are 2 large rounded light-gray chat bubbles aligned to the right, each containing Japanese text. The first bubble says: 「日本語の幼稚園の広告画像を、トンマナ違いで4種類並べて画像生成して。プロデザイナーが作ったトレンドのデザインで。アスペクト比は16:9」. Beneath it is 1 rounded rectangular generated image preview showing a 2x2 grid of kindergarten advertisement variations in soft pastel colors. In the top-left panel, show a bright, airy ad with a close-up photo of a young child in profile at right, soft sunlight, cream and pale green tones, handwritten-style Japanese headline text on the left, small circular badges near the bottom, and floral accents. In the top-right panel, show an energetic outdoor ad with 4 children running under a blue sky, bold Japanese headline text, teal and yellow graphic accents, and a yellow circular callout. In the bottom-left panel, show a modern kindergarten campus building with a grassy yard and children playing, with a large white speech-bubble-shaped text area on the left and muted green-beige abstract shapes. In the bottom-right panel, show an illustrated large green tree with children and parents underneath, sky-blue background, warm family-friendly Japanese copy, and soft rounded decorative shapes. Add 1 small gray circular overlay button labeled 「編集」 at the lower-left corner of this preview and 1 small semi-transparent circular upload/share icon at the lower-right corner. Under this first preview, include 4 small interface icons in a row: copy, thumbs up, thumbs down, and more options. Lower on the screen, show the second right-aligned light-gray chat bubble with this Japanese text: 「日本語の健康食品の広告画像を、トンマナ違いで4種類並べて画像生成して。プロデザイナーが作ったトレンドのデザインで。アスペクト比は16:9」. Beneath it is a second rounded rectangular generated image preview showing a 2x2 grid of health food advertisement variations. In the top-left panel, show a clean wellness ad in white and pale green with a woman touching her neck, Japanese headline text about inner balance, several circular benefit icons, and price text. In the top-right panel, show a dramatic black-and-gold supplement ad with a dark pouch package, glowing gold particles, luxury serif-style Japanese text, and a bold red-orange price tag reading 980円. In the bottom-left panel, show a soft pink beauty supplement ad with translucent floral or crystalline textures, pastel packaging, delicate Japanese copy, circular info badges, and feminine cosmetic styling. In the bottom-right panel, show a natural green juice ad with a tall glass of green smoothie, fresh vegetables in the background, a green-and-white product box, clean Japanese health copy, and a circular yellow callout. Add 1 small gray circular overlay button labeled 「編集」 at the lower-left of this second preview and 1 small semi-transparent circular upload/share icon at the lower-right. The overall image should feel like a realistic smartphone app screenshot of an AI image-generation chat, with generous spacing between the 2 conversations, rounded corners, crisp Japanese typography, and a premium contemporary UI.

templates.title: Digital Chessboard After 1.e4 e5

titleLocalized.zh: 1.e4 e5 后的数字棋盘

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A clean, flat digital top-down chessboard centered in the frame, shown as a square 8x8 board with algebraic coordinates visible on all four sides: letters a through h along the top and bottom, and numbers 8 through 1 along the left and right. Use a dark charcoal outer background and border, with alternating light beige and muted taupe-gray squares. Render simple high-contrast 2D chess icons, black pieces at the top and white pieces at the bottom, in a crisp vector-like style with no wood texture, no realistic lighting, and no extra interface elements. Show the exact position after the opening moves 1. e4 e5: black major pieces on a8 rook, b8 knight, c8 bishop, d8 queen, e8 king, f8 bishop, g8 knight, h8 rook; black pawns on a7, b7, c7, d7, f7, g7, h7, and e5; white pawns on a2, b2, c2, d2, f2, g2, h2, and e4; white major pieces on a1 rook, b1 knight, c1 bishop, d1 queen, e1 king, f1 bishop, g1 knight, h1 rook. Leave all other squares empty. Keep the composition perfectly symmetrical, instructional, and legible, like a digital chess diagram illustrating opening move order.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张清晰、扁平的数字俯视棋盘，居中于画面。棋盘为 8x8 方格，四周显示代数坐标：顶部和底部为 a 到 h 的字母，左侧和右侧为 8 到 1 的数字。使用深炭灰色作为外部背景和边框，棋盘格交替采用浅米色和柔和的灰褐色。渲染简洁的高对比度 2D 象棋图标，黑色棋子位于上方，白色棋子位于下方，呈现清晰的矢量风格，无木纹质感，无真实光影，无多余的界面元素。展示 1. e4 e5 开局后的准确位置：黑色大子位于 a8 车、b8 马、c8 象、d8 后、e8 王、f8 象、g8 马、h8 车；黑色兵位于 a7、b7、c7、d7、f7、g7、h7 和 e5；白色兵位于 a2、b2、c2、d2、f2、g2、h2 和 e4；白色大子位于 a1 车、b1 马、c1 象、d1 后、e1 王、f1 象、g1 马、h1 车。其余方格留空。保持构图绝对对称、具有教学意义且易于辨识，如同用于说明开局走法的数字象棋图。

templates.title: Realistic Chess Opening Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 逼真的国际象棋开局照片

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor photograph of a wooden chessboard on a dark wooden table, viewed from a slightly elevated front angle, with Staunton-style pieces in a mid-opening position. The board has light maple and dark walnut squares with a wooden border, and the pieces are glossy black and matte ivory. Show all 32 pieces with no captures: 16 black pieces and 16 white pieces. Black occupies the far side in standard back-rank order from left to right: rook, knight, bishop, queen, king, bishop, knight, rook, with 8 black pawns in front. White occupies the near side in standard back-rank order from left to right: rook, knight, bishop, queen, king, bishop, knight, rook, with 8 white pawns in front. The only moved pieces are 2 central pawns: a black pawn advanced two squares to e5 and a white pawn advanced two squares to e4, facing each other on adjacent central squares. Keep the rest of the pieces in their starting positions. Use natural window light from the right, soft shadows, a warm home interior background with cream curtains and a wooden cabinet, shallow depth of field, realistic proportions, clean digital-photography look, centered composition, and accurate chessboard geometry.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的室内照片，展示了放置在深色木桌上的木制国际象棋棋盘，视角为略微抬高的正面角度，棋子采用 Staunton 风格，处于开局中期位置。棋盘由浅色枫木和深色胡桃木方格组成，带有木质边框；棋子为亮面黑色和哑光象牙色。展示全部 32 枚棋子，无被吃掉的棋子：16 枚黑色棋子和 16 枚白色棋子。黑色棋子位于远端，按标准底线顺序从左至右排列：车、马、象、后、王、象、马、车，前方有 8 枚黑色兵。白色棋子位于近端，按标准底线顺序从左至右排列：车、马、象、后、王、象、马、车，前方有 8 枚白色兵。仅移动了 2 枚中心兵：一枚黑色兵向前推进两格至 e5，一枚白色兵向前推进两格至 e4，在相邻的中心格面对面。其余棋子保持初始位置。使用来自右侧的自然窗光，光影柔和，背景为温馨的家居室内环境，配有米色窗帘和木制柜子，浅景深，比例真实，呈现干净的数码摄影质感，构图居中，棋盘几何结构准确。

templates.title: Neon Lip Balm Launch Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Neon Lip Balm 新品发布广告

templates.prompt: Create a glossy, hyper-saturated social media ad poster for a futuristic beauty product launch, designed like a Canva marketing graphic. The composition is a single widescreen promotional banner centered on a cyan-to-purple gradient background, with rounded corners and a vivid neon pink color palette. Inside the banner, show a young woman from the chest up in a glowing sci-fi tunnel made of concentric pink and white light rings. Her face is obscured by a soft square blur block, but her hair is styled in two small buns, and she wears hoop earrings, layered chain necklaces, a metallic silver top, and an iridescent pink holographic jacket. She extends one hand toward the camera holding a clear lip balm tube close to the lens, creating strong foreground perspective. The tube label reads “GLOW MODE Lip Balm.” At the top center, large neon headline text reads “GLOW MODE” with a script subtitle “Lip Balm,” and below it a smaller line reads “JUICY SHINE. HYDRATING CARE. ZERO STICKINESS.” In the upper left corner, add a handwritten neon note reading “NEW!” In the upper right corner, place an orange rounded sticker with white text reading “gpt-image-2,” plus a small orange pointer tab beneath it. On the right side of the banner, include 2 circular callout badges: a pink starburst badge that says “ONLY $14.99” and a black glowing circular badge that says “VIRAL ON TikTok 2M+ views.” At the lower right, show 2 product display elements: one upright open lip balm tube with wand applicator beside it, and one whole sliced peach plus one cut mango half with green leaves, all sitting on a glossy reflective surface with pink light swirls. Along the lower center, add 3 feature icons with labels: a droplet icon labeled “HYALURONIC HYDRATION,” a fruit icon labeled “PEACH MANGO SCENT,” and a bunny icon labeled “100% VEGAN & CRUELTY-FREE.” In the lower left inside the banner, add a vertical stack of 3 social buttons with platform icons and handles: TikTok with “#GlowMode,” Instagram with “@LunaBeatty,” and Snapchat with “@LunaGlow.” Beneath them place 1 glowing QR code card, and next to it handwritten script text reading “Shop Now!” with an arrow pointing toward the QR code. Outside the banner at the bottom left, place a tilted teal rounded label reading “Canva AI,” with a small teal paper-plane style accent nearby. Add glossy reflections, lens flares, bloom, neon rim lighting, sparkles, and polished ad-design styling throughout, with crisp commercial product photography mixed with futuristic graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张光泽感强、色彩高度饱和的未来感美妆产品发布社交媒体广告海报，设计风格类似于 Canva 营销图。构图为一个居中的宽屏促销横幅，背景为青色到紫色的渐变，带有圆角和鲜艳的霓虹粉色调。横幅内展示一位年轻女性的半身像，背景是一个由同心粉色和白色光环组成的科幻发光隧道。她的脸部被一个柔和的方形模糊块遮挡，发型为两个小发髻，佩戴圆环耳环、多层链条项链，身穿金属银色上衣和虹彩粉色全息夹克。她向镜头伸出一只手，手中拿着一支透明润唇膏管靠近镜头，营造出强烈的近景透视感。管身标签写着“GLOW MODE Lip Balm”。顶部中央，醒目的霓虹大标题写着“GLOW MODE”，下方配有手写体副标题“Lip Balm”，再下方有一行小字写着“JUICY SHINE. HYDRATING CARE. ZERO STICKINESS.”。在左上角，添加一个手写风格的霓虹标签，写着“NEW!”。在右上角，放置一个橙色圆角贴纸，上面有白色文字“gpt-image-2”，下方配有一个小的橙色指针标签。在横幅右侧，包含 2 个圆形标注徽章：一个写着“ONLY $14.99”的粉色星爆徽章，以及一个写着“VIRAL ON TikTok 2M+ views”的黑色发光圆形徽章。在右下角，展示 2 个产品陈列元素：一支直立的开口润唇膏管及其涂抹棒，旁边放着一个完整的桃子和半个切开的芒果，配有绿叶，所有物品都放置在带有粉色光漩涡的光滑反射面上。在底部中央，添加 3 个带有标签的功能图标：一个标有“HYALURONIC HYDRATION”的水滴图标，一个标有“PEACH MANGO SCENT”的水果图标，以及一个标有“100% VEGAN & CRUELTY-FREE”的兔子图标。在横幅左下角，添加一列垂直堆叠的 3 个社交媒体按钮，包含平台图标和账号：TikTok 账号“#GlowMode”、Instagram 账号“@LunaBeatty”和 Snapchat 账号“@LunaGlow”。在它们下方放置一张发光的二维码卡片，旁边配有手写体文字“Shop Now!”以及指向二维码的箭头。在横幅外部左下角，放置一个倾斜的青色圆角标签，上面写着“Canva AI”，附近有一个小的青色纸飞机风格装饰。整体添加光泽反射、镜头光晕、辉光、霓虹轮廓光、闪光点和精致的广告设计风格，融合清晰的商业产品摄影与未来感图形设计。

templates.title: Three Floral Chickens Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 花卉小鸡三人组肖像

templates.prompt: A whimsical studio portrait of 3 full-body chickens standing side by side against a clean light gray seamless background, centered with soft diffused lighting and subtle shadows beneath their feet. Each chicken is sculpted entirely from layered flower petals and blossoms while keeping realistic chicken anatomy, skinny scaly legs, clawed feet, beaks, wattles, and combs. The left chicken is cream and ivory colored, fluffy and rounded, decorated with pale white blossoms and tiny sprigs of baby's breath, with oversized round googly eyes and a surprised, innocent expression. The center chicken is dusty pink and blush colored, built from dense overlapping petals and medium flower heads, with a long drooping pink comb falling over one eye, a stern intense expression, and floral detailing around the neck and body. The right chicken is vivid orange, amber, and golden yellow, made of marigold-like petals and warm autumn flowers, with narrowed sleepy eyes, a tall red-orange comb, and a grumpy unimpressed expression. Emphasize intricate botanical texture, handcrafted floral sculpture realism, playful character design, high detail, sharp focus, symmetrical lineup composition, and a cute surreal fine-art aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满奇趣的摄影棚肖像，展示了 3 只完全由层叠花瓣和花朵构成的风格化小鸡，它们并排站在浅灰色纯色背景前，光线柔和均匀，地面带有淡淡的阴影。左侧的小鸡呈奶油色和象牙色，由浅色花瓣和白色小野花构成，表情惊讶，有着非常大的圆形滑稽眼睛、小巧的浅色鸡冠、下垂的粉色肉垂和细长的黄色鸡腿。中间的小鸡圆润蓬松，由深浅不一的浓密粉色花瓣和花朵构成，表情严肃且略带不满，眯着眼睛，喙部较大且呈浅色，有着超大的粉色肉垂，以及垂在前额的类似粉色花朵的鸡冠。右侧的小鸡呈亮橙色和金色，由鲜艳的橙色花瓣和类似万寿菊的花朵构成，点缀着几片绿叶和黄色嫩枝，表情困倦且不屑，半眯着眼睛，有着高耸的红橙色鸡冠、红色肉垂和黄色鸡腿。让这 3 只小鸡都具备高度细节，可爱、古怪且具有手工质感，将逼真的花卉纹理排列成令人信服的鸡体结构，采用居中构图、全身视角、干净简约的背景，呈现出精致的奇幻编辑摄影美学。

templates.title: Censored Research Paper Office Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 经过审查的研究论文办公室肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic corporate office photo of a young man seated indoors, holding up a printed research paper toward the camera with both hands. His face is fully obscured by a solid rectangular censor block in a medium tan color. He has short dark brown hair and wears a plain dark charcoal crewneck sweater. The paper is a white letter-size document in portrait orientation, clearly visible and centered in front of his torso. The document title reads “DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems”. Below it are the author lines “DFlash Research Team” and “DFlash Inc.” The page shows 4 visible text sections: “Abstract”, “1. Introduction”, “2. DFlash Technology Overview”, and “2.1 Dual Charge-Trapping Architecture”, set in a formal academic paper layout with dense black serif text. In the background, place a softly blurred modern office lobby with warm ambient lighting, beige walls, glass partitions, a sofa, indoor plants, and the black OpenAI logo and wordmark mounted on the wall at upper left. The composition is a medium shot, straight-on, with the subject slightly right of center so the OpenAI logo remains visible. Shallow depth of field, soft natural office lighting, polished photorealistic style, subtle warm color grading, high detail in the hands, paper, sweater texture, and interior environment. Keep the overall image clean, believable, and like a candid press or announcement photo. Use {argument name="document title" default="DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems"} for the paper title, {argument name="company logo text" default="OpenAI"} for the wall branding, {argument name="sweater color" default="dark charcoal"} for the subject’s clothing, and {argument name="censor block color" default="medium tan"} for the face covering.

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, turn the cat into a realistic human portrait while keeping the same lounging pose, camera angle, framing, and the same plush turquoise chair background. Preserve the cat’s orange-and-white color pattern as inspiration for the human look: make the person a fair-skinned young woman with warm ginger hair and a soft, calm expression. Dress her in cozy off-white loungewear: 1 loose knit V-neck sweater and 1 pair of cream drawstring pants, seated naturally in the chair with relaxed body language. Make it photorealistic, soft natural indoor lighting, editorial lifestyle photo quality.

templates.title: Moody Coastal Road Trip Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁海岸公路旅行人像

templates.prompt: A cinematic candid photo of a {argument name="person" default="young woman"} standing in a wet coastal roadside turnout on an overcast day, viewed from behind and slightly to the side as she turns her head back toward the camera. She has dark messy hair tied in a loose bun with windblown strands, and her face is softly obscured and indistinct. She wears 2 visible clothing pieces: a worn tan-brown canvas jacket and medium-blue jeans. Her posture is relaxed with one hand near or in a pocket. The setting is a moody ocean cliff highway overlook with dark rocky mountains running along the left side, pale gray sea stretching into the distance on the right, and a cloudy washed-out sky. Include 1 parked light-colored late-1980s or early-1990s sedan on the right edge of the frame, rear end facing the viewer, and 1 large rock barrier near the overlook. The asphalt is dark and damp with faint parking lines, suggesting recent rain. Use natural light, muted cool tones, slight film grain, soft focus, shallow haze, and a nostalgic 35mm road-trip photography aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感十足的抓拍照片，画面中一位 {argument name="person" default="年轻女性"} 站在阴天湿漉漉的沿海路边停车区。视角从后方及侧后方拍摄，她正回头看向镜头。她留着深色凌乱的头发，扎成松散的发髻，发丝被风吹乱，面部轮廓柔和且模糊。她身穿两件可见的衣物：一件磨损的棕褐色帆布夹克和一条中蓝色牛仔裤。她姿态放松，一只手放在口袋附近或口袋里。背景是忧郁的悬崖公路观景台，左侧是深色的岩石山脉，右侧是延伸至远方的灰白色大海，天空阴沉且泛白。画面右侧边缘包含 1 辆停放的浅色 80 年代末或 90 年代初轿车，车尾朝向观众，观景台附近有 1 个大型岩石护栏。沥青路面深暗潮湿，带有模糊的停车线，暗示着刚下过雨。采用自然光，色调柔和偏冷，带有轻微的胶片颗粒感、柔焦效果、淡淡的薄雾，呈现出怀旧的 35mm 公路旅行摄影美学。

templates.title: Surreal Patio Portrait with Crow and Dog

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实露台肖像：乌鸦与小狗

templates.prompt: A slightly surreal but photorealistic portrait of a seated person in a quiet courtyard or patio, centered in frame, wearing a fitted white long-sleeve turtleneck top with delicate pink floral prints and a printed illustration of a girl on the chest, paired with loose cream floral pants. The person sits on a simple white metal chair and holds a small fluffy poodle-like dog in their lap; the dog has curly off-white fur and distinctly dyed orange ears. Perched on top of the person’s dark hair bun is a black crow or raven, facing left, calm and balanced as if it naturally belongs there. The subject’s pose is still, direct, and formal, creating an odd deadpan family-portrait feeling. Set the scene against a textured off-white stucco wall with exactly 4 notable decorative background elements: 1 brown sun-shaped wall ornament in the upper left, 1 small wall-mounted planter shelf with a small bird figurine and trailing flowers on the left, 1 tall arched window or mural on the right showing a bright blue sky with soft white clouds, and 1 white pedestal planter at lower right filled with long green leaves and exactly 2 pink flamingo ornaments. Include a bit of stone edging and dark greenery at lower left and a brown tiled floor. Lighting is soft natural daylight, slightly overcast, with muted colors, shallow depth of field, and a vintage editorial photography look. Composition should be vertical, full seated figure, straight-on, balanced, and quietly uncanny. Customize the main figure as {argument name="person" default="a middle-aged woman"}, the bird as {argument name="bird type" default="black crow"}, the dog breed as {argument name="dog type" default="small poodle mix"}, the dog ear color as {argument name="dog ear color" default="orange"}, and the outfit palette as {argument name="outfit colors" default="white and faded pink florals"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张略带超现实感但照片级逼真的肖像，画面中心为一名坐在安静庭院或露台上的角色，身穿修身白色长袖高领上衣，胸前印有精致的粉色花卉图案和女孩插画，搭配宽松的奶油色花卉长裤。该角色坐在简单的白色金属椅上，怀里抱着一只毛茸茸的小型贵宾犬；小狗有着卷曲的灰白色毛发，耳朵被染成了独特的橙色。角色深色的发髻上停着一只黑色的乌鸦或渡鸦，面朝左侧，姿态平衡且平静，仿佛它本就属于那里。主体姿势静止、直接且正式，营造出一种怪诞的冷幽默家庭肖像感。场景背景为质感十足的灰白色灰泥墙，包含 4 个显著的装饰性背景元素：左上方 1 个棕色太阳形墙饰，左侧 1 个小型壁挂式花架（带有小鸟摆件和垂吊花卉），右侧 1 个高大的拱形窗户或壁画（展示着明亮的蓝天和柔和的白云），右下方 1 个白色底座花盆（种有长长的绿叶，并装饰有 2 个粉色火烈鸟摆件）。左下方包含少许石边和深色绿植，地面为棕色瓷砖。光线为柔和的自然日光，略显阴天，色彩柔和，景深较浅，具有复古编辑摄影的质感。构图应为竖构图，展示完整的坐姿人物，正面直拍，平衡且带有一种安静的诡异感。可自定义主要人物 {argument name="person" default="一位中年女性"}、鸟类品种 {argument name="bird type" default="黑乌鸦"}、狗的品种 {argument name="dog type" default="小型贵宾混血犬"}、狗耳朵颜色 {argument name="dog ear color" default="橙色"} 以及服装色调 {argument name="outfit colors" default="白色和褪色的粉色花卉"}。

templates.title: Early 2000s Computer Lab With ChatGPT

titleLocalized.zh: 21 世纪初的计算机实验室与 ChatGPT

templates.prompt: A candid documentary-style photo of a {argument name="setting" default="high school computer lab classroom"} filled with exactly 10 students seated at rows of bulky off-white CRT desktop computers, viewed from the back-left corner of the room at a slight wide angle. The scene should feel like an early-2000s snapshot taken on a consumer digital camera with direct flash, soft grain, slightly warm indoor fluorescent lighting, and a timestamp in the bottom-right corner reading {argument name="timestamp" default="02 18 04"}. In the foreground left, a student in a navy track jacket with white sleeve stripes points at a CRT monitor; in the center foreground, another student with short spiky hair wears an oversized gray sweatshirt and sits facing away from the camera; on the right foreground, a blonde student with a ponytail wears a light blue long-sleeve top with dark horizontal arm stripes and types at a keyboard; far right, another student with curly dark hair sits at a workstation. Several other students occupy the middle and back rows, all facing their screens. The monitors prominently display the ChatGPT interface, with the visible heading reading {argument name="screen title" default="ChatGPT"} and simple prompt text beneath it. The room has beige walls, drop ceiling tiles, and multiple motivational classroom posters: exactly 4 readable posters on the back wall saying {argument name="poster one" default="YOU CAN DO HARD THINGS"}, "BE KIND ONLINE", "THINK BEFORE YOU CLICK", and a larger poster titled "KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS" with a list beneath it. Include bulletin boards, a classroom door at the back, rolling office chairs, white keyboards and mice, and a backpack on the floor near the right foreground desk. Faces should be partially obscured or softly anonymized, preserving the look of a real classroom photo while keeping the focus on the students using ChatGPT in an old computer lab.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张纪实风格的抓拍照片，场景为 {argument name="setting" default="高中计算机实验室教室"}，室内有 10 名学生正坐在成排笨重的米白色 CRT 台式机前，视角位于教室左后方，呈轻微广角。画面应呈现出 21 世纪初使用消费级数码相机拍摄的快照感，带有直接闪光灯效果、柔和的噪点、略显温暖的室内荧光灯光，右下角带有时间戳 {argument name="timestamp" default="02 18 04"}。左侧前景中，一名身穿海军蓝运动夹克、袖口带有白色条纹的学生正指向一台 CRT 显示器；中央前景中，一名留着短刺猬头的学生穿着超大号灰色卫衣，背对镜头坐着；右侧前景中，一名扎着马尾辫的金发学生穿着浅蓝色长袖上衣，袖子上有深色横条纹，正在键盘上打字；最右侧，另一名留着深色卷发的学生坐在工作站前。其他几名学生坐在中间和后排，全都面向屏幕。显示器上清晰地显示着 ChatGPT 界面，可见的标题为 {argument name="screen title" default="ChatGPT"}，下方是简单的提示词文本。房间墙壁为米色，配有吊顶天花板，墙上挂着多张励志海报：后墙上挂着 4 张清晰可见的海报，内容分别为 {argument name="poster one" default="YOU CAN DO HARD THINGS"}、“BE KIND ONLINE”、“THINK BEFORE YOU CLICK”，以及一张标题为“KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS”的大海报，下方列有清单。画面中还应包含项目、后方的教室门、转椅、白色键盘和鼠标，以及右侧前景桌旁地板上的背包。人物面部应部分遮挡或进行柔和的匿名处理，在保留真实课堂照片质感的同时，将焦点集中在学生在老式计算机实验室中使用 ChatGPT 的场景上。

templates.title: Luxury Fashion Book Spread

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华时尚书籍内页

templates.prompt: A high-end editorial fashion photograph shown as an open large-format hardcover magazine or art book lying flat on a clean off-white surface, viewed from directly above. The two-page spread contains 2 full-page portraits of the same elegant woman with her face obscured by a soft square blur, creating a privacy-censored look. On the left page, she stands against a pale stone or concrete architectural wall wearing a structured long-sleeve dress in {argument name="dress color" default="soft slate gray"}, with a fitted bodice, round neckline, sharply tailored seams, and an exaggerated sculptural bell-shaped skirt; the camera angle is slightly low, making her neck appear long and her posture statuesque. On the right page, she is photographed from the back in a dramatic {argument name="second dress color" default="black"} evening gown with a very deep open back, wide shoulder straps, and a voluminous full skirt, standing in front of a classic paneled wall or door in a dim, moody interior. Use luxury fashion magazine styling, minimal composition, muted tones, soft natural-looking light, refined shadows, realistic paper texture, visible book gutter, slightly curved pages, and crisp print detail. The overall mood is sophisticated, couture, cinematic, and understated, like a premium fashion editorial spread.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端时尚编辑摄影作品，展示了一本打开的大幅面精装杂志或艺术书籍，平放在干净的灰白色表面上，采用正上方俯视视角。双页内页包含 2 张同一位优雅女性的全页肖像，她的面部被柔和的方形模糊处理，营造出一种隐私遮蔽的视觉感。左页中，她站在浅色石材或混凝土建筑墙前，身穿一件 {argument name="dress color" default="柔和板岩灰"} 的结构感长袖连衣裙，配有合身紧身胸衣、圆领、剪裁利落的接缝以及夸张的雕塑感钟形裙摆；拍摄角度略低，使她的颈部显得修长，姿态如雕塑般优雅。右页中，她身穿一件戏剧性的 {argument name="second dress color" default="黑色"} 露背晚礼服，背部大面积镂空，配有宽肩带和蓬松的宽大裙摆，站在昏暗、情绪化的室内，背景是一面经典的镶板墙或门。采用奢华时尚杂志风格、极简构图、柔和色调、自然光感、精致阴影、逼真的纸张纹理、清晰可见的书脊装订线、略微弯曲的页面以及清晰的印刷细节。整体氛围高级、具有高定感、电影质感且低调，宛如顶级时尚杂志的内页。

templates.title: Soft Cafe Portrait of Young Woman

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆柔光年轻女性肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor portrait photo of a slim young East Asian woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long black"} softly wavy hair, seated on a smooth concrete bench in a minimalist cafe interior. She is facing the camera with a shy, gentle posture, shoulders slightly angled, hands loosely clasped together on her lap, and legs crossed at the ankles. She wears a fitted white cropped T-shirt with small centered Japanese text reading "{argument name="shirt text" default="午後"}" and a dark high-waisted denim mini skirt. Natural window light from the left side creates soft, diffused shadows and a calm, muted atmosphere. titleLocalized.zh: Countryball 霍尔木兹海峡对峙

templates.prompt: A detailed satirical countryball meme illustration of the {argument name="waterway name" default="Strait of Hormuz"} as a very narrow sea passage between two steep rocky cliffs, painted in a polished digital cartoon style with dramatic shading and textured stone. In the center foreground, exactly 2 countryballs block each other in the tight channel so that only one can pass. On the left is a USA countryball with angry narrowed eyes, painted with the American flag, wearing a dark navy baseball cap labeled "USA" in large white letters. On the right is an Iran countryball with angry narrowed eyes, painted with the Iranian flag and emblem, wearing a green-and-white headband tied on the side; the headband contains Korean text that reads "저항은 우리의 권리". Above each ball is exactly 1 white speech bubble with thick black outline, for a total of 2 speech bubbles, and both say {argument name="speech text" default="길!"} in large bold Korean lettering, as if neither side will yield. Show the two balls facing each other nose-to-nose in a standoff in the bottleneck. On the left cliff, include exactly 1 wooden sign reading in Korean and English: "호르무즈 해협" and "Strait of Hormuz". On the right cliff, include exactly 1 warning sign with Persian text at the top and a red warning triangle below, indicating that only one person can pass. In the left bottom corner, place exactly 1 black oil barrel labeled "OIL" with dark spilled oil pooling around it. In the right bottom corner, place exactly 1 black naval mine with Persian writing on it, attached to a chain. In the background beyond the narrow passage, show open sea with exactly 3 distant ships, including at least 1 larger tanker and faint dark smoke rising into the sky. Use a tense but humorous geopolitical meme tone, centered composition, eye-level view, soft daylight, slightly muted realistic colors, crisp outlines, and high readability for all text.

templates.title: Countryball Hormuz Strait Standoff

titleLocalized.zh: 国家球霍尔木兹海峡对峙

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A humorous political meme illustration in a simple countryball cartoon style, showing the current situation at the {argument name="location label" default="호르무즈 해협"} as a narrow chokepoint. Use a wide landscape composition with bright flat colors, thick black outlines, and a clean hand-drawn infographic-like look. In the foreground, place 2 countryballs standing shoulder to shoulder on an extremely narrow sandy land bridge with rocks along both sides, making it obvious that only one can pass at a time. On the left is a {argument name="left country" default="United States"} countryball painted with the American flag, wearing black sunglasses and a brown cowboy hat, facing the other ball with a stubborn attitude. On the right is an {argument name="right country" default="Iran"} countryball painted with the Iranian flag, wearing a dark turban-like hat, with angry slanted eyes, also refusing to move. Add 2 large white speech bubbles, one beside each countryball, and put the same bold Korean word in both bubbles: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"}. In the midground and background, show a busy blue sea crowded with 9 ships total: 2 gray US warships on the far left, 1 Chinese submarine with a red Chinese flag, 4 oil tankers lined up in the center-left and center carrying different national flags, and 2 gray military ships near the narrow passage with small American flags. At the top right, include a large Iranian flag overlay along the coastline. Draw beige landmasses around the waterway to resemble a simplified map view of the Strait of Hormuz. At the bottom center, add a bold caption in Korean and English on the sand: {argument name="bottom caption" default="호르무즈 해협 (Hormuz Strait)"}. The mood should be satirical, tense, and meme-like, but visually cute and readable.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格简洁的国家球卡通政治幽默插图，展示了 {argument name="location label" default="霍尔木兹海峡"} 作为狭窄咽喉要道的现状。采用宽幅横向构图，使用明亮的平涂色彩、粗黑轮廓线以及干净的手绘信息图风格。在前景中，放置 2 个国家球，它们肩并肩站在一条极窄的沙质陆桥上，两侧布满岩石，凸显出一次只能通过一人的窘境。左侧是涂有美国国旗的 {argument name="left country" default="美国"} 国家球，戴着黑色墨镜和棕色牛仔帽，以固执的态度面对另一个球。右侧是涂有伊朗国旗的 {argument name="right country" default="伊朗"} 国家球，戴着深色头巾状帽子，眼睛愤怒地斜视，同样拒绝移动。在每个国家球旁边各添加一个巨大的白色对话气泡，并在两个气泡中填入相同的韩语粗体字：{argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"}。在中景和背景中，展示一片繁忙的蓝色海域，总共挤满了 9 艘船只：最左侧有 2 艘灰色美国军舰，1 艘挂着中国国旗的中国潜艇，中左侧和中心排成一列的 4 艘载有不同国旗的油轮，以及狭窄通道附近 2 艘挂着小型美国国旗的灰色军舰。在右上角，沿海岸线叠加一面巨大的伊朗国旗。在水道周围绘制米色陆地，以呈现霍尔木兹海峡的简化地图视图。在底部中心，于沙地上添加一行韩语和英语的粗体标题：{argument name="bottom caption" default="호르무즈 해협 (Hormuz Strait)"}。整体氛围应具有讽刺性、紧张感和模因感，同时在视觉上保持可爱且易于阅读。

templates.title: Moody Censored Indoor Selfie Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁风格遮挡室内自拍肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor selfie-style portrait of a young East Asian man from the chest up, seated near a large modern window in a high-rise apartment or hotel room during soft daylight. He has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair, thick and slightly tousled with a center part and soft volume over the forehead and sides. His build appears slim, with a long neck and smooth light skin. He wears a {argument name="shirt color" default="black"} button-up shirt made of matte cotton or poplin, slightly oversized, with the top several buttons undone to create a deep open collar and relaxed, casual styling. The camera is held close in a natural selfie angle, portrait orientation, framing the shoulders, chest, neck, and head. His face is fully obscured by a large centered rectangular blur or mosaic censor block, while the ears, jawline edges, neck, and hair remain visible. The mood is understated, moody, and elegant, with muted neutral colors, soft window light from the right side, gentle shadows, and a candid social-media selfie feeling. Background details include 1 beige wall section on the left, 1 small dark wall control panel, 1 vertical metallic trim or lamp edge, and 2 tall dark-framed window panels on the right with a faint out-of-focus city skyline outside. Photorealistic smartphone photo, clean modern interior, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, subtle contrast, no smile visible because of the censor block, minimal editing, stylish and believable personal selfie.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的室内自拍风格肖像，拍摄对象为一名年轻东亚男性，半身像。他坐在高层公寓或酒店房间的一扇大型现代窗户旁，沐浴在柔和的日光中。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 的头发，发质浓密且略显凌乱，中分，额头和两侧有自然的蓬松感。体型偏瘦，颈部修长，肤色白皙细腻。他穿着一件 {argument name="shirt color" default="black"} 的哑光棉质或府绸衬衫，版型略微宽松，领口上方几颗纽扣解开，呈现出深 V 开领和随性的休闲风格。相机以自然的自拍角度近距离拍摄，竖构图，画面包含肩膀、胸部、颈部和头部。他的面部被一个位于中心的大型矩形模糊或马赛克遮挡块完全遮住，但耳朵、下颌边缘、颈部和头发清晰可见。整体氛围低调、忧郁且优雅，色调柔和中性，右侧透入柔和的窗光，阴影细腻，具有真实的社交媒体自拍感。背景细节包括左侧的一面米色墙壁、一个小型的深色墙面控制面板、一条垂直的金属饰条或灯具边缘，以及右侧两扇高大的深色边框窗户，窗外是模糊的城市天际线。写实风格智能手机摄影，整洁的现代室内环境，浅景深，自然的皮肤纹理，微妙的对比度，因遮挡块而看不到笑容，极简后期处理，时尚且真实的个人自拍。

templates.title: Turn Food Photo Into Japanese Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 将美食照片转化为日式海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of the udon meal, turn it into a clean, print-ready Japanese restaurant promotional poster while keeping the food photo itself as the main hero image. Expand the composition vertically into a portrait flyer layout, add a light icy-blue seasonal background with subtle watercolor texture and faint wave motifs, and overlay decorative green maple leaves for an early-summer feel. Add 5 text elements in Japanese: a blue circular badge at the upper left reading "初夏のおすすめ", a large bold brush-calligraphy headline across the top in 2 lines reading "とり天" and "ざるうどん", a small red vertical seal near the headline reading "自慢のとり天", a tall translucent blue vertical copy block at the upper right reading "ひんやり、つるり。さっぱり、満たされる。", and a price block at the lower right reading "980円 税込" with a blue brushstroke banner below that says "大盛り無料！". Add a short 4-line Japanese body copy paragraph at the lower left describing the dish in a menu-poster style. Preserve the original meal arrangement and realistic photography, but enhance it slightly for advertising: brighter, more appetizing, crisp, and high contrast. Make the overall design look like a polished restaurant poster created from a casual food photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的乌冬面参考图片，将其转化为一张简洁、可印刷的日式餐厅宣传海报，并保留美食照片本身作为核心主体。将构图垂直扩展为纵向传单布局，添加带有微妙水彩质感和淡雅波浪纹样的浅冰蓝色季节性背景，并叠加装饰性的绿色枫叶，营造出初夏的氛围。添加 5 处日文文本元素：左上角一个写有“初夏のおすすめ”的蓝色圆形徽章；顶部两行醒目的大号毛笔书法标题，分别为“とり天”和“ざるうどん”；标题附近一个写有“自慢のとり天”的小型红色垂直印章；右上角一个半透明的蓝色垂直文案块，写有“ひんやり、つるり。さっぱり、満たされる。”；右下角一个写有“980円 税込”的价格块，下方配有写着“大盛り無料！”的蓝色笔触横幅。在左下角添加一段简短的 4 行日文正文，以菜单海报风格描述这道菜品。保留原始的餐点摆盘和写实摄影效果，但针对广告需求进行适当优化：使其更明亮、更诱人、更清晰且具有高对比度。使整体设计看起来像是由一张随手拍摄的美食照片制作而成的精美餐厅海报。

templates.title: Pastel Anime Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调动漫宣传海报

templates.prompt: Create a bright pastel anime promotional poster for a fictional slice-of-life comedy series. The composition is a single-page Japanese key visual with one central heroine surrounded by 5 inset moments and blocks of Japanese promotional text, like an anime announcement poster. The main character is {argument name="character name" default="もち子さん"}, a cute anime girl with short white hair fading slightly to silver, large vivid blue eyes, soft blush, and twin low ponytails tied near the shoulders. She wears an oversized black hood shaped like floppy dog ears, round silver goggles resting on top of her head, a black choker with a metallic round ornament, a futuristic white-and-black cropped sleeveless top with dark trim and a small emblem on the chest, detached black arm sleeves, very short white shorts with black edging, a thigh strap on one leg, and a small side pouch on her hip. Her body proportions are youthful anime stylization with a slim, petite build and slightly exaggerated chest, rendered in polished modern moe character design. In the center she stands full body, smiling gently and holding a pen in one hand as if she is about to make a mistake while writing, facing the viewer in a confident but sweet pose. Around her place 5 supporting vignette images of the same character: 1) upper left, a chibi-style scene of her outside with both hands thrown forward, crying dramatically with a huge open mouth; 2) lower left, a comic scene of her collapsed face-down on a desk or floor with scattered papers, exhausted and flustered; 3) upper right, a bust shot where she holds up a paper sign with Japanese writing, looking apologetic; 4) lower right, a cheerful half-body portrait with closed smiling eyes and one fist raised in encouragement; 5) a small background portrait in the top-right area behind text, used like a character callout. Include exactly 2 small white mascot creatures near the bottom center, both round and mochi-like with tiny dot eyes and tiny mouths, one larger and one smaller, floating or standing beside the heroine. Use a soft spring palette with pink, sky blue, mint green, peach, cream, and white, with scattered cherry blossom petals and rounded graphic shapes in the background. The background should feel airy and celebratory, with subtle outdoor scenery blur and decorative swooshes, stars, and bubbles. Fill the poster with Japanese typography in a playful commercial-anime style: a large multicolored title at top left, small header text above it, a red seasonal broadcast announcement, a pink "あらすじ" synopsis box on the left with several lines of body text, a blue explanatory box at bottom left, vertical and angled exclamatory phrases around the character, and a pink production-credit block at bottom right. Add a prominent character name banner in the upper right. Keep all text looking like authentic printed Japanese promotional copy, using rounded colorful fonts for the title and clean magazine-style fonts for the smaller text. Overall mood: adorable, comedic, slightly chaotic, professionally designed anime key art for a new TV series announcement in 16:9 landscape format.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张明亮柔和色调的动漫宣传海报，用于一部虚构的日常喜剧系列。构图为单页日本动画主视觉图，中心为一位女主角，周围环绕 5 个插图瞬间和日文宣传文字块，呈现出动漫宣传海报的风格。主角是 {argument name="character name" default="もち子さん"}，一位可爱的动漫少女，留着发梢渐变为银色的短白发，拥有明亮的大蓝眼睛、柔和的腮红，以及系在肩部附近的低双马尾。她戴着一个形状像垂耳狗的超大黑色兜帽，头顶架着一副圆形银色护目镜，脖子上戴着带有金属圆饰的黑色项圈，身穿一件未来感十足的黑白配色露肩短上衣，胸前饰有小徽章，配有分离式黑色袖套、带黑色镶边的超短白短裤、单腿腿带，以及腰间的一个小侧包。她的身体比例采用年轻化的动漫风格，身材纤细娇小，胸部略微夸张，呈现出精致的现代萌系角色设计。她全身立于画面中央，面带温柔微笑，一只手拿着笔，仿佛正准备在书写时犯错，以自信而甜美的姿态面向观众。在她周围放置 5 个相同角色的辅助小插图：1) 左上角，Q 版风格场景，她身处户外，双手向前伸出，张大嘴巴戏剧性地大哭；2) 左下角，喜剧场景，她因疲惫和慌乱而脸朝下趴在桌子或地板上，周围散落着纸张；3) 右上角，半身像，她举着一张写有日文的纸牌，表情歉意；4) 右下角，欢快的半身肖像，闭眼微笑，一只拳头举起以示鼓励；5) 右上角文字后方的一个小型背景肖像，用作角色标注。在底部中心附近包含 2 个白色小吉祥物生物，它们圆润如麻薯，有着小圆点眼睛和小嘴巴，一大一小，漂浮或站在女主角身边。使用柔和的春季色调，包括粉色、天蓝色、薄荷绿、桃色、奶油色和白色，背景中散落着樱花花瓣和圆润的图形形状。背景应营造出轻盈和庆典的氛围，带有微妙的户外风景模糊以及装饰性的弧线、星星和气泡。海报中填满俏皮商业动漫风格的日文排版：左上角有一个巨大的多色标题，上方有小标题文字，一个红色的季节性播出公告，左侧有一个粉色的“あらすじ”（剧情简介）方框，内含多行正文，左下角有一个蓝色说明框，角色周围环绕着垂直和倾斜的感叹短语，右下角有一个粉色的制作人员名单块。在右上角添加一个醒目的角色名称横幅。所有文字应看起来像地道的印刷版日本宣传文案，标题使用圆润多彩的字体，较小的文字使用简洁的杂志风格字体。整体氛围：可爱、喜剧、略带混乱，专业设计的动漫主视觉图，适用于 16:9 横屏格式的新番动画宣传。

templates.title: Studio Product Render From Blueprint

titleLocalized.zh: 从蓝图生成摄影级产品渲染图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, turn the technical engineering spec sheet into a clean studio product hero render of the same jellyfish-shaped kitchen utensil holder. Keep the overall product design, translucent blue dome cap, silver base, and the same 4 hanging utensils: 1 slotted spatula, 1 pasta server, and 2 spoons. Remove all blueprint elements, including the exploded view, dimension lines, labels, tables, notes, and title block. Show only the assembled product centered in frame, front-facing, isolated against a minimal light gray background with a white surface, soft diffused lighting, subtle realistic shadows, and glossy premium materials. Make it look like a contemporary industrial design catalog or e-commerce product photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将技术工程规格表转换为同一个水母形状厨房用具架的干净摄影级产品主图。保留整体产品设计、半透明蓝色圆顶盖、银色底座以及 4 件悬挂用具：1 个漏勺、1 个意面捞勺和 2 个汤勺。移除所有蓝图元素，包括爆炸图、尺寸线、标签、表格、注释和标题栏。仅展示居中对齐、正面朝向的组装成品，背景为极简浅灰色，置于白色平面上，采用柔和的漫射光，带有细腻逼真的阴影，并呈现出高级的光泽质感。使其看起来像是一张现代工业设计目录或电商产品摄影图。

templates.title: Cinematic Wednesday Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感“周三”动漫海报

templates.prompt: A Japanese movie-poster style anime illustration, vertical theatrical one-sheet composition, showing a teenage schoolgirl seated alone in a classroom at golden hour. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, long and slightly wavy, gathered into a loose side braid draped over her right shoulder, with soft bangs and warm rim light along the top of her head and hair edges. She wears a cream or light beige sailor-style school uniform with navy trim and a dark blue ribbon bow at the chest. Her pose is quiet and introspective: sitting at a school desk, leaning her cheek into one hand, shoulders slightly curved, looking off to the side with a tired but calm midweek expression. The scene is lit by strong late-afternoon sunlight pouring in from a tall classroom window on the right, creating glowing highlights, dust motes in the air, soft haze, and a nostalgic cinematic mood. In the dimmer left background, include a green classroom chalkboard and 2 small chalkboard erasers or chalk accessories resting on the tray. Use painterly anime realism with rich filmic contrast, delicate facial rendering, textured brushwork, subtle grain, and dramatic poster lighting. Add Japanese poster typography integrated into the artwork: on the left side, large vertical white brush lettering reading "真ん中" with smaller handwritten-style vertical text above reading "やっと、"; across the lower middle, large pink calligraphic title text reading "水曜日" diagonally; on the upper right, a vertical tagline reading "週のまんなかで、わっと深呼吸ができる。" Near the lower right, include 3 stacked gold laurel award emblems with small Japanese text inside each. Along the bottom center, add 2 lines of small Japanese tagline text, then a credits block in small Japanese film-poster typography. In the bottom right corner, place a large release date reading {argument name="release date" default="5.29"} with "ROADSHOW" beneath it. Overall feeling: soft, melancholic, reassuring, like an understated coming-of-age film poster about an ordinary Wednesday becoming quietly special.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张日本电影海报风格的动漫插画，采用垂直剧场版海报构图，描绘了一名少女在黄金时刻独自坐在教室里的场景。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长发，微微卷曲，扎成松散的侧边麻花辫垂在右肩，带有柔和的刘海，头顶和发丝边缘有温暖的轮廓光。她穿着一件米色或浅褐色的水手服校服，带有海军蓝镶边，胸前系着深蓝色蝴蝶结。她的姿势安静而内省：坐在课桌前，单手托腮，双肩微弯，眼神看向一侧，流露出一种疲惫但平静的周中表情。场景由右侧高大教室窗户射入的强烈午后阳光照亮，营造出耀眼的高光、空气中的尘埃微粒、柔和的薄雾以及怀旧的电影氛围。在较暗的左侧背景中，包含一块绿色教室黑板，黑板槽上放着 2 个小黑板擦或粉笔配件。采用写实动漫绘画风格，具有丰富的电影质感、细腻的面部渲染、纹理笔触、细微的颗粒感以及戏剧性的海报灯光。在画面中融入日式海报排版：左侧为巨大的竖排白色毛笔字“真ん中”，上方配有较小的手写体竖排文字“やっと、”；中部下方为巨大的粉色斜向书法标题文字“水曜日”；右上角为竖排标语“週のまんなかで、わっと深呼吸ができる。”；右下角附近包含 3 个堆叠的金色月桂奖章，内部带有细小的日文；底部中心添加 2 行小型日文标语，下方为小型日文电影海报排版风格的演职员表。右下角放置一个醒目的上映日期 {argument name="release date" default="5.29"}，下方标注“ROADSHOW”。整体氛围：柔和、忧郁、治愈，如同讲述普通周三变得悄然特别的低调青春成长电影海报。

templates.title: Mars Selfie With Alien and Rocket

titleLocalized.zh: 与外星人和火箭的火星自拍

templates.prompt: A photorealistic selfie on the surface of Mars, framed at arm’s length in a casual slightly wide-angle smartphone perspective. In the foreground are 2 subjects standing close together from chest-up: a human man on the left wearing a black crewneck shirt with a clear white OpenAI logo on the chest, and a tall elegant female alien on the right with shimmering blue-green metallic skin, elongated ears, subtle facial ridges, and a sleek biomechanical-looking outfit with bronze and silver tones, a deep neckline, fine ornamental seams, and layered necklaces with a prominent blue gemstone pendant. The man has short dark messy hair and his left arm extends toward the camera as if taking the selfie. The alien leans in close beside him, both posed like a friendly commemorative snapshot. The background is a red rocky Martian desert with scattered stones, low hills, and a dusty orange sunset sky. On the far left stands a roadside-style sign with 2 lines of text reading {argument name="sign headline" default="MARS"} and {argument name="sign subtext" default="WELCOME HOME"}. On the far right in the distance is 1 large retro-futuristic white rocket standing upright on landing legs, with visible vertical text reading {argument name="rocket text" default="SPACEX"}. Warm orange lighting, cinematic realism, detailed textures, subtle atmospheric haze, social-media-announcement vibe, high detail, natural depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在火星表面拍摄的写实风格自拍，以智能手机拍摄的休闲广角视角呈现，仿佛手臂伸出拍摄。前景中是两个半身像：左侧是一名人类男性，身穿黑色圆领衫，胸前印有清晰的白色 OpenAI 标志；右侧是一名身材高挑、优雅的女性外星人，拥有闪烁着蓝绿色金属光泽的皮肤、细长的耳朵、精致的面部纹理，身着带有青铜和银色调的流线型生物机械风格服装，领口深邃，饰有精细的装饰性接缝，并佩戴着层叠项链，中间坠有一颗显眼的蓝色宝石吊坠。男子留着凌乱的深色短发，左臂向镜头伸出，做出自拍姿势。外星人紧靠在他身边，两人如同拍摄一张友好的纪念照。背景是红色的火星岩石沙漠，散布着碎石、低矮的山丘，天空呈现出尘土飞扬的橙色日落景象。最左侧立着一块路标式指示牌，上面有两行文字，分别为 {argument name="sign headline" default="MARS"} 和 {argument name="sign subtext" default="WELCOME HOME"}。最右侧的远处矗立着一枚巨大的复古未来主义白色火箭，火箭通过着陆支架垂直站立，上面有清晰的垂直文字 {argument name="rocket text" default="SPACEX"}。温暖的橙色光影，电影级写实感，细节纹理丰富，带有微妙的大气雾霾感，具备社交媒体公告的氛围，高细节，自然的景深效果。

templates.title: Wet Summer Anime Schoolgirl Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 湿润夏日动漫女学生肖像

templates.prompt: A luminous anime-style summer portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="Japanese high school girl"} shown from the chest up in side profile, standing outdoors under an intense blue sky with bright white clouds. She has a short wet bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="dark navy black"}, large sparkling blue-violet eyes, soft blush on her cheeks, and a calm, slightly distant expression. Her white sailor school uniform shirt is soaked and semi-translucent, clinging realistically to the fabric folds, with a deep navy sailor collar and a large navy ribbon at the chest. She raises one arm and presses a clear ridged plastic water bottle against her forehead, with cold water droplets running down her face, neck, arm, and clothing. In the background, include a softly blurred outdoor school pool area with metal railings, a pool ladder, and shimmering water. Emphasize crystalline transparency in the bottle, wet skin sheen, delicate eyelashes, detailed anime rendering, dramatic backlighting, refreshing heat-of-summer atmosphere, and a polished high-end illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅光彩夺目的动漫风格夏季肖像，主角为一名 {argument name="character type" default="日本女高中生"}，画面呈现胸部以上的侧面特写。她站在户外，背景是湛蓝的天空和明亮的白云。她留着一头湿漉漉的 {argument name="hair color" default="深藏青黑色"} 短波波头，有着一双硕大且闪烁着蓝紫色光芒的眼睛，脸颊泛着淡淡的红晕，表情平静而略显疏离。她身穿的白色水手服校服衬衫已被浸湿，呈现出半透明质感，真实地贴合在衣褶上，领口为深藏青色水手领，胸前系着一条深藏青色的大丝带。她抬起一只手臂，将一个透明的棱纹塑料水瓶抵在额头上，冰凉的水珠顺着她的脸庞、脖颈、手臂和衣物滑落。画面中充满了强烈的夏日阳光、亮丽的高光、穿透湿润发丝的轮廓光、彩虹色的镜头光晕、细小的漂浮气泡以及闪烁的倒影。背景中包含一个经过柔焦处理的户外学校泳池区域，可以看到金属栏杆、泳池扶梯和波光粼粼的水面。着重表现水瓶的晶莹剔透感、湿润皮肤的光泽、精致的睫毛、细腻的动漫渲染、戏剧性的逆光效果、清爽的夏日热浪氛围，以及精致的高端插画风格。

templates.prompt: A clean modern YouTube thumbnail on a bright white background, split visually between bold text on the left and a cropped presenter on the right. On the left, place a massive stacked headline in heavy black sans-serif uppercase reading {argument name="headline text" default="CLAUDE DESIGN"}, aligned top-left across two lines. Below it, add a large rounded rectangular orange banner with a subtle drop shadow containing bold white uppercase text with an orange outline that reads {argument name="subheadline text" default="IN 6 MINS"}. Near the headline, include 2 orange starburst spark shapes, one small beside the text and one much larger in the far right background. In the lower-left quadrant, show a floating app interface mockup for a design tool dashboard with a soft off-white panel, thin borders, rounded corners, and a faint shadow. The interface should have a left sidebar with 4 menu items labeled exactly: "Recent", "Your designs", "Examples", and "Design systems". The main panel header should say "Recent" and contain 3 project cards arranged in a grid, labeled exactly: "Thumio Design System", "Thumio Startup", and "Design System". On the right half, show a cropped photorealistic young adult man from chest up wearing a white turtleneck sweater, with messy light brown hair and light facial hair, positioned close to camera. His face is intentionally obscured by a solid tan rectangle placeholder covering most of the face area. He points with one hand toward the interface panel on the left, finger extended. Use a warm orange and white brand palette, high contrast, minimal clutter, polished creator-economy thumbnail styling, subtle shadows, and a composition designed for tech tutorial content.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁现代的 YouTube 缩略图，采用明亮的白色背景，视觉上分为左侧的粗体文字和右侧的半身演示者。在左侧，放置一个巨大的堆叠式标题，使用加粗的黑色无衬线大写字母，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="CLAUDE DESIGN"}，左对齐并分两行显示。在其下方，添加一个带有细微投影的大型圆角橙色横幅，内含加粗的白色大写文字，并带有橙色轮廓，内容为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="IN 6 MINS"}。在标题附近，加入 2 个橙色星爆形状，一个较小，位于文字旁，另一个较大，位于远处的背景右侧。在左下象限，展示一个设计工具仪表盘的悬浮应用界面模型，面板呈柔和的灰白色，带有细边框、圆角和淡淡的阴影。界面左侧边栏应包含 4 个菜单项，标签分别为：“Recent”、“Your designs”、“Examples” 和 “Design systems”。主面板标题应显示为 “Recent”，并包含 3 个网格排列的“项目”卡片，标签分别为：“Thumio Design System”、“Thumio Startup” 和 “Design System”。在右半部分，展示一位胸部以上的写实风格年轻男性，身穿白色高领毛衣，留着凌乱的浅棕色头发和浅浅的胡茬，位置靠近镜头。他的脸部被一个覆盖大部分区域的纯棕色矩形占位符刻意遮挡。他的一只手指向左侧的界面面板，手指伸出。采用温暖的橙白品牌配色，高对比度，极简布局，精致的创作者经济缩略图风格，带有细微阴影，构图专为科技教程内容设计。

templates.prompt: A photorealistic humorous academic presentation in a conference room: an anthropomorphic otter scientist stands at the left side of the frame wearing a crisp white lab coat and holding a thin pointing stick toward a large presentation board on an easel. The otter is upright like a human, with realistic brown fur, dark paws, and a professional posture. The lab coat has a stitched name tag reading "Dr. Otter" and a smaller line reading "Aquatic Systems Lab," plus two pens in the chest pocket. The otter’s face is partially censored by a square blur block. Behind the otter is a whiteboard with faint handwritten notes and doodles, including "WiFi > Fish," "H2O," "Hydration," a fish sketch, and a wifi symbol. The main focus is a large clean presentation slide with sharp readable text and polished corporate-academic layout. At the top, a bold title reads "{argument name="headline text" default="Ethan Mollick’s Otter Test"}" and beneath it a subtitle reads "Prompt: \"{argument name="prompt text" default="An otter sitting on an airplane seat using in-flight wifi on a laptop"}\"". Below that is a boxed section titled "Sample AI-Generated Images" containing exactly 4 side-by-side sample images of a realistic otter seated in an airplane seat using a laptop or tablet, each framed like model outputs, with one showing a large wifi symbol above the seat. Beneath the images is a section labeled "Performance Results (Pass = otter, airplane seat, in-flight wifi, laptop/tablet)" with exactly 5 score boxes: "DALL·E 3" with no visible numeric score, "GPT-4o" with "4/4" and "100%", "Midjourney v6" with "3/4" and "75%", "Stable Diffusion XL" with "2/4" and "50%", and "SD 1.5" with "0/4" and "0%". On the right side is a large highlighted box reading "Average Score" and "{argument name="average score" default="70%"}" in large blue type. At the bottom of the slide is a "Key Findings" box with exactly 3 bullet points: "Modern models understand complex, specific prompts surprisingly well.", "Otters + airplanes + wifi = a reliable benchmark.", and "Further research is otter-ly necessary." A small simple cartoon otter doodle appears in the lower-right corner of the slide. The room is warmly lit with wood-paneled walls, shallow depth of field, and a few blurred audience members in the foreground, including a laptop at the bottom edge showing an otter image on its screen and a glass pitcher on a table. Style: ultra-realistic editorial photography, deadpan scientific satire, believable conference presentation, high detail, natural indoor lighting, professional lens compression, readable slide typography, polished yet absurd.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的幽默学术演示场景，位于会议室内：一只拟人化的水獭科学家站在画面左侧，身穿干练的白色实验服，手持一根细长的指示棒，指向画架上的大型演示项目。这只水獭像人类一样直立，拥有逼真的棕色皮毛、深色的爪子和专业的姿态。实验服上缝着一个写有“Dr. Otter”的姓名牌，下方写着较小的一行字“Aquatic Systems Lab”，胸前口袋里插着两支笔。水獭的脸部被一个方形模糊块部分遮挡。水獭身后是一个白板，上面有模糊的手写笔记和涂鸦，包括“WiFi > Fish”、“H2O”、“Hydration”、一条鱼的草图以及一个 WiFi 符号。画面的焦点是一张大型且清晰的演示 Slides，具有锐利易读的文字和精致的企业学术布局。顶部是一个粗体标题，写着“{argument name="headline text" default="Ethan Mollick 的水獭测试"}”，下方副标题写着“提示词：\"{argument name="prompt text" default="一只水獭坐在飞机座位上，用笔记本电脑使用机上 WiFi"}\"”。下方是一个名为“AI 生成图像样本”的方框区域，包含 4 张并排的样本图像，展示了逼真的水獭坐在飞机座位上使用笔记本电脑或平板电脑，每张图像都像模型输出一样被框起，其中一张在座位上方显示了一个巨大的 WiFi 符号。图像下方是一个标有“性能结果（通过 = 水獭、飞机座位、机上 WiFi、笔记本电脑/平板电脑）”的部分，包含 5 个分数框：“DALL·E 3”无可见数字分数，“GPT-4o”为“4/4”和“100%”，“Midjourney v6”为“3/4”和“75%”，“Stable Diffusion XL”为“2/4”和“50%”，以及“SD 1.5”为“0/4”和“0%”。右侧是一个醒目的高亮方框，写着“平均分”和“{argument name="average score" default="70%"}”，字体为蓝色大号字。Slides 底部是一个“关键发现”框，包含 3 个要点：“现代模型对复杂、具体提示词的理解能力令人惊讶。”、“水獭 + 飞机 + WiFi = 一个可靠的基准测试。”以及“进一步的研究非常有必要（otter-ly necessary）。”Slides 右下角有一个简单的卡通水獭涂鸦。房间光线温暖，墙壁为木质镶板，景深较浅，前景中有几位模糊的听众，包括边缘处的一台笔记本电脑，屏幕上显示着一张水獭图像，桌上放着一个玻璃水壶。风格：超写实编辑摄影，冷面科学讽刺，可信的会议演示，高细节，自然室内光线，专业镜头压缩，易读的 Slides 排版，精致而荒诞。

promptLocalized.zh: 一页色彩鲜艳的日式漫画，场景设定在月球上一个异想天开的公共澡堂。画面采用精致的复古未来主义动漫风格，光影温暖，分镜边框厚实清晰，配有生动的音效文字，环境叙事细节丰富。场景是一个名为“月面銭湯 つきのゆ”的月球温泉，配有巨大的发光招牌、印有白色“ゆ”字的蓝色暖帘、外露的管道、仪表盘、圆润的建筑结构，以及一扇可以看到月球表面和太空中地球的巨大圆形窗户。请包含 8 个排列在动态页面布局中的漫画分镜。分镜 1：月球澡堂的外景建立镜头，招牌写着“月面銭湯 つきのゆ”，旁边有一个写着“重力 1/6”的小招牌、一台红色的“牛乳”自动贩卖机、一尊狸猫雕像、月球地形以及一张宣传澡堂的竖幅海报。分镜 2：一位年轻的女性澡堂机械师（{argument name="character design" default="棕色马尾辫系着红底波点头巾，身穿绿色工装连体裤，佩戴工具腰带，表情充满活力"}）正在调整机器或锅炉控制装置，侧后方视角，配有关于准备今日浴水和锅炉状况的对话气泡。分镜 3：一位可爱的外星顾客（{argument name="alien appearance" default="圆滚滚的薄荷绿身体，紫色斑点，睡眼惺忪，粉色脸颊，小嘴，头上顶着印有紫色星星的白色毛巾"}）在冒着热气的浴池中放松，半浸在水中，旁边漂浮着一只橡皮鸭，木牌上写着“ぬるめ じっくり リラックス”（温水，慢慢泡，放松）。分镜 4：一个小巧的清洁机器人（{argument name="robot design" default="银色机身，蓝色装饰，黑色电子脸配发光的蓝色眼睛，红色天线灯，细长的机械手臂和腿"}）正开心地拿着扫帚和水桶在挂着“清掃中”牌子的旁边擦地。分镜 5：机器人突然滑倒或戏剧性地溅入浴池，溅起巨大的水花和许多气泡，配有巨大的音效文字“ぽわぁ〜ん!!”，工作人员在一旁惊讶地反应。分镜 6：工作人员坐在浴池边微笑，手里拿着一瓶贴有“月面牛乳”标签的牛奶。分镜 7：浴池里的外星人竖起大拇指，手里拿着一瓶贴有“月面フルーツオーレ”标签的饮料，看起来非常满足，橡皮鸭依然在旁边。分镜 8：开心的机器人在浴池旁摆出姿势，身边放着清洁工具和水桶，背景是印有“ゆ”字的浴帘和贴有“つきのゆ”标签的粉色洗脸盆，说着澡堂是最棒的。保持温馨、喜剧的基调，将复古昭和风格的澡堂细节与太空科技相结合，展现光亮的瓷砖表面、蒸汽、气泡以及可爱的角色互动。整部漫画应呈现出一种关于在月球澡堂工作的迷人生活片段式搞笑漫画的感觉。

templates.title: Split-Screen Time Travel Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 分屏时空穿越场景

templates.prompt: A horizontal split-screen cinematic shot of {argument name="scene" default="Times Square, New York"}, seamlessly blending two different eras: {argument name="first era" default="1920s"} on the left and {argument name="second era" default="present day"} on the right (default: about 100 years ago vs. present day). On the left side: show era-appropriate architecture, interior or environment design, materials, vehicles, and props that clearly belong to that historical period. People wear authentic clothing from the era, including hairstyles, accessories, and typical items in their hands. The overall mood feels nostalgic and historically accurate. On the right side: show the same scene in the modern era, with updated architecture or renovated structures, contemporary materials (glass, steel, LED screens, modern furniture), modern vehicles or equipment, and current technology. People wear contemporary fashion that matches today’s style in this setting. In the center: the two eras merge and overlap organically, without a hard dividing line. Elements from both eras visually interact: people from different times look at each other, walk through each other’s space, or seem surprised by the other era’s technology and objects. Architecture and environment smoothly morph from old to new. Make sure the scene is not just a simple left/right comparison but a dynamic time-travel interaction. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, wide angle, highly detailed textures, rich sense of time-travel storytelling. Aspect Ratio: 4:3

promptLocalized.zh: 一张水平分屏的电影感镜头，展示 {argument name="scene" default="纽约时代广场"}，将两个不同的时代无缝融合：左侧为 {argument name="first era" default="1920 年代"}，右侧为 {argument name="second era" default="现代"}（默认：约 100 年前对比现代）。左侧：展示符合该时代特征的建筑、室内或环境设计、材料、车辆以及明确属于该历史时期的道具。人物穿着该时代的真实服饰，包括发型、配饰以及手中典型的物品。整体氛围充满怀旧感且符合历史真实性。右侧：展示同一场景的现代面貌，包含更新后的建筑或翻新结构、现代材料（玻璃、钢材、LED 屏幕、现代家具）、现代车辆或设备以及当前科技。人物穿着符合当代风格的时尚服饰。中心区域：两个时代有机地融合与重叠，没有生硬的分割线。两个时代的元素在视觉上产生互动：不同时代的人们互相注视、穿过对方的空间，或对彼此时代的科技和物品感到惊讶。建筑和环境从旧到新平滑过渡。确保场景不仅仅是简单的左右对比，而是一种动态的时空穿越互动。照片级真实感，8k 分辨率，电影级灯光，广角，高度精细的纹理，丰富的时空穿越叙事感。宽高比：4:3

templates.prompt: 9:16 vertical — creative forced perspective portrait, {argument name="style" default="Korean idol style"}, single subject. analog 35mm film aesthetic, soft natural grain, slightly faded colors, gentle overexposure, pastel tones, low contrast, soft highlight bloom, airy and dreamy atmosphere. minimal indoor setting near a window, clean light-toned background, simple everyday environment. young {argument name="subject" default="Korean female idol"}, very attractive, natural minimal makeup, dewy realistic skin texture, subtle imperfections. outfit: {argument name="outfit" default="oversized white shirt loosely draped + short bottoms"}, soft fabric, relaxed fit, modest but subtly body-shaping, no revealing elements. hair: long dark hair, slightly messy, natural volume. composition (key): forced perspective illusion — the subject appears unusually small relative to nearby objects (such as being inside a cup, standing on a table edge, or interacting with a hand in the foreground), but still realistic; scale ambiguity created by camera distance and alignment. camera: slightly low or eye-level angle, intentional perspective distortion, foreground object close to lens, subject placed farther away to create size illusion. pose: natural relaxed posture, slight body curve, casual stance or light sitting pose. expression: soft calm gaze, slight smile or slightly parted lips, natural and unposed. lighting: diffused natural window light, soft shadows, gentle light wrapping around subject. mood: playful, slightly surreal but grounded in reality, intimate everyday moment with a visual twist. quality: ultra-realistic, fine film grain, slight softness, imperfect framing, natural imperfections.

templates.title: Detailed multilingual Chinese manga prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 详细的多语言中文漫画提示词

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Generate a full color Chinese-text manga about this {argument name="character" default="OpenAI researcher, Chen Boyuan"} (first picture), who works on improving the text rendering capability of ChatGPT Image 2 model for the upcoming release. (in the background there is boba tea and a banana taped to the wall with a single slice of duct tape). The model can render insanely small Chinese text when he tried generating some detailed and beautiful multilingual infographics handdrawn-style poster about his hometown, {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} on his computer screen. His hard work pays off and the team was impressed by the absurdly good quality of multilingual text performance of his model, seeing all the languages it can write. When he takes a break with one hand holding his phone, he received a translated text message from Sam Altman on his phone (avatar attached as second picture), asking him to take a look at the rendered multilingual text in an image he just generated to congrat the team, since Sam only knows English. However, make it funny by let Boyuan outrage (typical manga style) at the end by seeing Sam's generated image contains a "稳稳地接住你" phrase at the central location in an otherwise perfectly rendered image that's used to congrat the team, because this sentence has been memed as an unnatural but funny Chinese sentence GPT likes to use on Chinese internet. Boyuan should rage "God! It learned to 'catch' again!" (with teammates as tiny heads on the side, sweating and saying in Chinese "we are working hard to fix it!"). At the very bottom of the manga, add a tiny line of footnote (very tiny)in Chinese that "note: the entire manga, including this footnote and picture in picture, are all generated with gpt image 2 at once without editing or multiple steps."

Additional Instructions: Use vertical 1440x2560 image layout, with first row about this researcher working hard, second row about his result on {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} with multiple languages, third row shows the team excitement, fourth row split into left and right where left shows he takes a break and the phone received a message, right panel shows Sam's text message, and fifth row shows Sam's picture and Chen Boyuan's reaction. No narration except for the first row. Avoid Chinese map. All characters should be in manga style. The banana background should only appear in the first panel and the tape should be a single slice of tape, not a cross tape. The banana and tape decoration should be small as a insignificant easter egg for people to find. OpenAI logo shall only appear on Chen Boyuan's cloth, not elsewhere. No mugs in the scene since we already have the boba. Sam should only appear in the text message panel. The entire manga should be appear as a professional photo of a physical page in a manga book. In the lower right most corner of the poster there is a small "Ultra-small Chinese is also clearly readable:" with a paragraph of much smaller Chinese that begins with "(This is an ultra-small font size test) Wuxi is the author's hometown, so I made this poster, and the Chinese is finally fixed. Haven't been home for many years, really want to eat hairy crabs!" (ultra small).

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一张全彩中文漫画，主角是这位 {argument name="character" default="OpenAI 研究员，陈博远"}（第一张图），他正致力于提升 ChatGPT Image 2 模型在即将发布版本中的文本渲染能力。（背景里有波霸奶茶，墙上贴着一根用单条胶带粘住的香蕉）。当他在电脑屏幕上尝试生成关于他家乡 {argument name="location" default="无锡"} 的手绘风格多语言信息图海报时，模型展现出了渲染极小中文字符的能力。他的努力得到了回报，团队对模型出色的多语言文本表现感到惊叹，看到了它所能书写的各种语言。当他单手拿着手机休息时，收到了 Sam Altman 发来的翻译后的短信（头像见第二张图），Sam 请他查看一张刚生成的祝贺团队的图片中渲染的多语言文本，因为 Sam 只懂英文。然而，请加入幽默元素：在漫画结尾，让博远（以典型的漫画风格）感到抓狂，因为他看到 Sam 生成的图片中央位置赫然写着“稳稳地接住你”这句话，而图片的其他部分渲染得非常完美。因为这句话在中文互联网上已被玩梗，被视为 GPT 喜欢使用的不自然但有趣的中文短语。博远应该愤怒地大喊：“天哪！它又学会‘接住’了！”（旁边是队友们缩小的头像，流着汗说：“我们正在努力修复它！”）。在漫画的最底部，添加一行极小的中文脚注：“注：整幅漫画，包括此脚注和画中画，均由 GPT Image 2 一次性生成，未经编辑或多步处理。”

额外说明：使用 1440x2560 的垂直图像布局。第一行展示研究员努力工作的场景；第二行展示他在 {argument name="location" default="无锡"} 课题上取得的多语言成果；第三行展示团队的兴奋之情；第四行分为左右两部分，左侧展示他休息时手机收到消息，右侧展示 Sam 的短信内容；第五行展示 Sam 的照片和陈博远的反应。除第一行外，不要使用旁白。避免出现中国地图。所有角色应采用漫画风格。香蕉背景仅出现在第一格，胶带应为单条，而非十字交叉。香蕉和胶带装饰应作为彩蛋，小巧且不显眼。OpenAI 标志仅出现在陈博远的衣服上，其他地方不得出现。场景中不要出现马克杯，因为已经有波霸奶茶了。Sam 仅应出现在短信面板中。整幅漫画应呈现为漫画书实物页面的专业照片。在海报的右下角，添加一行小字“超小号中文也能清晰可读：”，并附上一段更小的中文段落，以“（这是超小字体测试）无锡是作者的家乡，所以我制作了这张海报，中文终于修复了。多年未回家，真想吃大闸蟹！”开头（超小号字体）。

templates.title: Dual Exposure Sports Graphic

templates.prompt:
{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. 
Act as a high-end sports graphic designer creating a conceptual tribute poster. The style is a complex "dual exposure photo-grid composite" with mixed-media textures.
CENTRAL STRUCTURE (THE VESSEL):
The central focus is a large-scale, high-contrast black and white portrait silhouette of {argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}. This main portrait acts as the container.
THE GRID FILL & TEXTURES (MIXED MEDIA):
The interior of the silhouette is populated by a dense "photo mosaic grid" of action shots from the person's career.
CRITICAL TEXTURE INSTRUCTION: Do not just paste flat photos. Apply artistic textures to various grid cells to create a tactile, collage feel. Use effects like:
Halftone Dots: Comic-book style raster patterns on some cells.
Fabric/Embroidery: Subtle thread or canvas textures suggesting a jersey or patch.
Film Grain: Heavy noise on specific high-contrast action shots.
COLOR STRATEGY:
The base is Monochrome B&W. Use selective color overlays (relevant to the team/flag) ONLY on specific grid cells to create a rhythm.
TYPOGRAPHY & BRANDING (STRICT MICRO-SCALING):
Top Left (The Name): Write "{argument name="subject name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}" strictly using the font {argument name="font family" default="Inter Semibold"}.
Kerning: Tight negative kerning (-4%).
Size: SMALL and discreet. It must occupy MAXIMUM 20% of the canvas width. Do NOT make it large or loud.
Top Right (The Symbol): Place the primary logo (Team/Brand/Flag).
Size: VERY SMALL. It must occupy MAXIMUM 10% of the canvas width.
COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND:
Background: Off-white or light grey with a visible high-quality paper or concrete texture. It should not be flat digital white.
Alignment: Center the figure perfectly. Maintain wide negative space around the object.

promptLocalized.zh:
{argument name="subject name" default="[人物姓名]"}。
请扮演一位高端运动图形设计师，创作一张概念性的致敬海报。风格为复杂的“双重曝光照片网格合成”，并结合混合媒体纹理。
