templates.title: Sunset Motocross Action Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分摩托车越野动作肖像

templates.prompt:
A cinematic high resolution action portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man riding a modern motocross dirt bike"} across {argument name="setting" default="rough rocky terrain during golden hour sunset"}. He is leaning aggressively forward while turning, showing focus and intensity on his face. He has messy windswept dark hair, light stubble, sharp jawline, athletic build, wearing a fitted black compression t shirt, dark cargo pants, black motocross gloves with orange details, and black racing boots with orange accents.
The bike is a sleek matte black and gray off road dirt bike with detailed suspension, rugged knobby tires, visible engine parts, realistic mud splashes, spinning wheels, and dust flying from the rear tire. The rider is captured mid motion with dynamic energy and speed.
Background features a warm desert landscape with distant mountains softly blurred in the horizon. Huge clouds of dust rise behind the bike, illuminated by the sunlight. Sky has a smooth gradient from deep teal blue at the top to glowing orange near the horizon. Strong sunlight creates dramatic rim lighting around the rider and bike, with rich shadows and warm highlights.
Foreground has textured gravel, dirt, scattered stones, motion debris, sharp ground detail. Shot from a low angle for a heroic powerful perspective. Shallow depth of field keeps the rider sharp while background remains creamy and cinematic.
Color grading is {argument name="color grade" default="teal and orange"}, high contrast, realistic skin tones, crisp details, ultra sharp focus, premium editorial sports photography style, cinematic storytelling, adventure aesthetic, volumetric dust lighting, HDR quality, 8k, realistic textures, natural reflections, professional lens compression, intense atmosphere.
Camera settings: low angle tracking shot, 85mm lens, f/2.8, fast shutter speed, ISO 100, high clarity, subject centered composition.
Negative prompt: blurry face, extra limbs, bad anatomy, text, watermark, logo, low quality, oversaturated colors, distorted bike, duplicate wheels, unrealistic hands, noise, cartoon style, flat lighting.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张电影级高分辨率动作肖像，主角是 {argument name="subject" default="一位骑着现代越野摩托车的年轻人"}，场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="黄金时段日落下的崎岖岩石地形"}。他转弯时身体激进地向前倾斜，脸上流露出专注与强烈的神情。他留着凌乱的深色短发，有着淡淡的胡茬、轮廓分明的下颌线和健壮的体格，身穿修身黑色紧身 T 恤、深色工装裤、带有橙色细节的黑色摩托车越野手套，以及带有橙色点缀的黑色赛车靴。
这辆摩托车是一辆外观时尚的哑光黑灰色越野摩托车，拥有精细的悬挂系统、粗犷的越野轮胎、清晰可见的引擎部件、逼真的泥点飞溅、旋转的车轮，以及从后轮飞扬而起的尘土。骑手被捕捉在运动瞬间，充满动态能量与速度感。
背景是温暖的沙漠景观，远处的山脉在地平线上呈现出柔和的虚化效果。摩托车后方扬起巨大的尘土云，被阳光照亮。天空呈现出从顶部的深青色到地平线附近发光的橙色的平滑渐变。强烈的阳光在骑手和摩托车周围营造出戏剧性的轮廓光，伴随着丰富的阴影和温暖的高光。
前景包含质感丰富的砾石、泥土、散落的石块、运动碎屑和清晰的地面细节。采用低角度拍摄，以呈现英雄般强有力的视角。浅景深使骑手保持清晰，同时背景保持奶油般的虚化效果，极具电影感。
调色风格为 {argument name="color grade" default="青橙色调"}，高对比度，逼真的肤色，清晰的细节，超锐利对焦，高级体育编辑摄影风格，电影叙事感，冒险美学，体积感尘土光效，HDR 画质，8k 分辨率，逼真的纹理，自然的反射，专业镜头压缩，强烈的氛围。
相机设置：低角度追踪拍摄，85mm 镜头，f/2.8，高速快门，ISO 100，高清晰度，主体居中构图。
负面提示词：模糊的脸，多余的肢体，糟糕的解剖结构，文字，水印，标志，低质量，色彩过饱和，扭曲的摩托车，重复的车轮，不切实际的手部，噪点，卡通风格，平淡的光照。

templates.prompt: I am creating a magazine page with the theme of "visual polyglot". The title in the center of the image should be "{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}". Create a piece of art celebrating visual creations, not limited to beautiful photographs but also across the full breadth of human visual culture and natural visual elements. There should be curated collage representing the diverse distribution: scientific diagrams, the periodic table, the solar system, medieval manuscript pages, botanical illustrations, anatomical drawings, old maps, climate charts, engineering schematics, transit signage, multilingual text, comic panels, UI screenshots, a camera photo, a butterfly specimen, pie charts, architectural blueprints, and façade drawings. The text frames the model as fluent across languages, notation systems, interfaces, cultural forms, and visual conventions—able to move from utility to beauty, from document understanding to artistic generation. Also feature artistic elements like pixel art, styles, history, sculpture, nature, photography, paintings, and all art forms. These are just examples, I need you to actively think about other elements / styles that may fit in a good design that's not limited to these concepts. The overall effect is that of a premium research announcement or museum-style manifesto: elegant, ambitious, and designed to argue that image intelligence should be trained on the whole visual world, not just polished aesthetics. Use an unstructured, creative and artistic layout, such as but not limited to fan out, avoid grid-like layouts. Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. Don't add any content text beside the "Create Everything at Once" title. Text as part of the art is okay. Avoid a beige tint of the overall style, since we want vibrant elements to be vibrant.

promptLocalized.zh: 我正在创作一个主题为“视觉多语种”的杂志页面。图像中心的标题应为“{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}”。请创作一件赞美视觉创作的艺术作品，不仅限于精美的摄影作品，还要涵盖人类视觉文化和自然视觉元素的全部广度。画面应包含精心策划的拼贴画，以呈现多样化的分布：科学图表、元素周期表、太阳系、中世纪手稿页面、植物插图、解剖图、古地图、气候图表、工程示意图、交通标志、多语言文本、漫画分镜、UI 截图、相机照片、蝴蝶标本、饼图、建筑蓝图和立面图。文本将模型定位为精通各种语言、符号系统、界面、文化形式和视觉惯例——能够从实用性转向美感，从文档理解转向艺术生成。同时加入像素艺术、风格、历史、雕塑、自然、摄影、绘画等所有艺术形式的元素。以上仅为示例，我需要你积极思考其他可能适合优秀设计的元素或风格，而不局限于这些概念。整体效果应呈现出高端研究公告或博物馆风格宣言的质感：优雅、宏大，旨在论证图像智能应该基于整个视觉世界进行训练，而不仅仅是基于精致的美学。请使用非结构化、富有创意和艺术感的布局，例如但不限于扇形展开，避免网格状布局。纵向 4:5 比例。除了“Create Everything at Once”标题外，不要添加任何其他内容文本。作为艺术一部分的文本是可以的。避免整体风格带有米色调，因为我们希望鲜艳的元素保持鲜艳。

{argument name="style" default="Chinese style CG illustration"}, Tang Dynasty aesthetics, {argument name="character description" default="exquisite ancient woman"}, half-body close-up shot, focus on face and upper body, high-end portrait composition, cinematic camera language and spatial perspective.

Character Setting:
East Asian classical beauty, cold white transparent skin, fine and real skin texture, soft shimmer; exquisite and three-dimensional facial features but natural and not exaggerated, narrow phoenix eyes, slightly tilted eye corners, affectionate and shy eyes, slightly tipsy and hazy, long eyelashes casting subtle shadows; lip color like rouge, slightly parted lips, soft and emotional tension, presenting 'subtle Oriental beauty'.

Styling Design:
Pink-toned gorgeous Tang-style clothing, softly fitting the body curves, rich layers but not over-stacked; moderate low-neck design emphasizing collarbone and neck-shoulder lines, natural visual guidance; exquisite phoenix crown (metal, pearls, gems, tassels), realistic material reflection, moving slightly with action.

Dynamics and Pose:
Slightly side-turned or lightly rotating posture, neck extension, shoulder lines stretched, hands forming soft guide lines, enhancing picture rhythm and feminine soft tension.

Lighting System:
Cinematic lighting. Key light: warm gold front-side light focusing on face and skin highlights. Fill light: cold ambient light shaping volume and space. Rim light outlining hair and neck silhouette. Highlights controlled without overexposure, shadows retaining details, soft transition of facial light and shadow.

Art Style:
Ultra-realistic CG portrait merged with Oriental freehand charm, slight hazy aesthetics.

Atmosphere and Texture:
Dreamy, subtle, high-end atmosphere of Oriental aesthetics; blurred background to weaken environment and strengthen character; slight film grain + soft focus glow to enhance emotion and texture.

Color System:
Main colors: rouge pink, gold. Auxiliary colors: cold blue-gray. Overall low saturation and high quality, avoiding gaudiness.

Lens parameters:
85mm portrait lens, f1.4–f2, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing.

Quality:
ultra detailed, 8K–16K, extreme detail, high resolution, cinematic lighting.

Aspect Ratio:
{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

templates.title: Packaging Design Proposal Board Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 包装设计方案项目提示词

templates.prompt:
Please generate a "hand-drawn packaging proposal board style" product introduction poster for {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}.

If I provide a product image, please use it as the main reference, retaining the core visual characteristics, packaging form, colors, materials, brand identity, and overall temperament of the product. Prioritize the main color tone and color relationships from the product image for the design.
If I do not provide a product image, please automatically generate a product appearance and packaging design that fits the positioning of {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}, and automatically match natural and reasonable main, auxiliary, and background colors based on the product attributes, category characteristics, and temperament.

Overall poster style requirements:
This is not a standard e-commerce detail page or a simple studio-shot poster, but a creative proposal board that integrates "product finished image + packaging design sketches + brand concept development process." The overall presentation is a high-aesthetic, high-completion brand design display image, as if a designer is presenting a packaging concept proposal.

Visual requirements:
- Vertical composition
- Use a unified background with a brand feel; the background color should be naturally determined by the product itself and not fixed to any one color.
- Color schemes should coordinate with product attributes: if there is a reference image, prioritize inheriting its main and brand colors; if not, automatically generate a reasonable color scheme based on the product name.
- Place the most complete and eye-catching product main visual in the center, with realistic textures, 3D lighting, and commercial finish effects.
- Surround the product with multiple auxiliary visual elements: packaging sketches from different angles, structural sketches, local form explorations, hand-held display drafts, packaging unfolding ideas, and brand lettering layout experiments.
- Add natural and casual black or dark hand-drawn line art, arrows, circles, symbols, and handwritten Chinese annotations to give the image a strong sense of "design process" and "creative proposal."
- The finished product image should be relatively refined and realistic, while the sketch parts should be relatively casual and dynamic, creating a contrast between the "finished product + design sketches."
- The layout should look relaxed and free, but overall it must have order, rhythm, and a visual center, reflecting a high-end graphic design feel.
- Small graphics, symbols, or interesting elements related to the product can be added appropriately to enhance brand memory points.
- The final effect should have a sense of branding, creativity, process, and visual impact.

Color principles:
- Do not fix a yellow background.
- Automatically select the main color tone based on product type, material, use, consumer experience, and brand temperament.
- The background color, product color, text color, and sketch line art color should coordinate with each other.
- High-saturation monochromatic backgrounds or soft, unified color schemes can be used, as long as the overall image has a brand feel and visual impact.
- Colors should naturally serve the product rather than overshadow it.

Style keywords:
Packaging design proposal board, brand concept development, hand-drawn sketches, design process feel, moodboard, creative review draft, product finished rendering, visual experimentation, commercial design poster.

Special notes:
- If there is a reference product image, prioritize following it and do not deviate from the product itself.
- If there is no reference image, automatically generate reasonable product appearance, packaging, and color schemes based on the product name, maintaining overall style consistency.
- The focus of the image is "product introduction + creative design process display."
- Do not make it look like a common e-commerce detail page, a promotional poster, or overly neat and stiff; do not lack sketches and handwritten annotations; avoid a cheap feel or an immature cartoon style.

promptLocalized.zh:
请为 {argument name="product name" default="奶粉"} 生成一张“手绘包装方案项目风格”的产品介绍海报。

如果我提供了产品图片，请将其作为主要参考，保留产品的核心视觉特征、包装形式、颜色、材质、品牌标识和整体气质。设计时优先考虑产品图片中的主色调和色彩关系。
如果我没有提供产品图片，请根据 {argument name="product name" default="奶粉"} 的定位自动生成产品外观和包装设计，并根据产品属性、品类特征和气质自动匹配自然且合理的背景色、主色和辅助色。

海报整体风格要求：
这不是标准的电商详情页或简单的摄影棚拍摄海报，而是一个融合了“产品成品图 + 包装设计草图 + 品牌概念开发过程”的创意项目。整体呈现为一张高审美、高完成度的品牌设计展示图，如同设计师正在展示一份包装概念方案。

视觉要求：
- 竖构图。
- 使用具有品牌感的统一背景；背景色应由产品本身自然决定，不固定为任何单一颜色。
- 配色方案应与产品属性协调：如有参考图，优先继承其主色和品牌色；如无，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的配色方案。
- 将最完整、最引人注目的产品主视觉放置在中心，具备真实的质感、3D 灯光和商业级成品效果。
- 在产品周围环绕多个辅助视觉元素：不同角度的包装草图、结构草图、局部形态探索、手持展示草图、包装展开构思以及品牌字体排版实验。
- 添加自然随意的黑色或深色手绘线条、箭头、圆圈、符号和手写中文注释，使画面具有强烈的“设计过程感”和“创意方案感”。
- 成品图部分应相对精致写实，而草图部分应相对随意灵动，形成“成品 + 设计草图”的对比。
- 布局看起来应轻松自由，但整体必须有秩序、有节奏感并具备视觉中心，体现出高端平面设计感。
- 可适当添加与产品相关的小图形、符号或趣味元素，以增强品牌记忆点。
- 最终效果应具备品牌感、创意感、过程感和视觉冲击力。

色彩原则：
- 不要固定使用黄色背景。
- 根据产品类型、材质、用途、消费体验和品牌气质自动选择主色调。
- 背景色、产品色、文字色和草图线条色应相互协调。
- 可以使用高饱和度的单色背景或柔和统一的配色方案，只要整体画面具有品牌感和视觉冲击力即可。
- 颜色应自然地服务于产品，而不是喧宾夺主。

风格关键词：
包装设计方案项目，品牌概念开发，手绘草图，设计过程感，情绪板，创意评审草稿，产品成品渲染，视觉实验，商业设计海报。

特别说明：
- 如有参考产品图，优先遵循参考图，不得偏离产品本身。
- 如无参考图，根据产品名称自动生成合理的产品外观、包装和配色方案，保持整体风格一致性。
- 图像的重点是“产品介绍 + 创意设计过程展示”。
- 不要将其制作成普通的电商详情页、促销海报，或显得过于整齐僵硬；不可缺少草图和手写注释；避免廉价感或不成熟的卡通风格。

templates.title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 手绘风格信息图卡片提示词

templates.prompt:
Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. The card has a clear theme and the background is beige or off-white with a paper texture. The overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic.

The top of the card features a large brush cursive font in alternating red and black with sharp contrast to highlight the title and attract visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each using short, concise Chinese phrases to express core points. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive, being both legible and artistic.

The card is dotted with simple, fun hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, to enhance visual appeal and trigger thought and resonance in the reader. The overall layout pays attention to visual balance, reserving enough white space to ensure the image is concise, clear, and easy to read and understand.

The theme is: "{argument name="theme content" default="Building an IP is long-term compound interest. Keep setting up your stall every day, keep doing it, and there will definitely be results, because 99% of people can't stick to it."}"

templates.title: Food Lifecycle Infographic Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 食物生命周期信息图提示词

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
An educational infographic themed "Life of {argument name="food name" default="Garlic"}."

The image must feature "a single complete food item" (such as a potato / a bunch of bananas / a head of garlic), using horizontal slicing to show the changes of the same food at different time stages, rather than a collage of multiple different items.

The main food body maintains structural continuity and consistent shape, presenting different levels of maturity in different slice areas (like time being sliced open).

The image is in vertical 3:4 ratio, with the main subject centered and horizontally expanded, evenly divided into 4-6 segments:

From left to right: Immature → Mature → Overripe → Spoiled

Each segment reflects real changes:

Color changes (green → yellow → black, etc.)
Texture changes (plump → softened → shriveled → decayed)
Feature changes (sprouting, weeping, mold, etc.)

Each stage is accompanied by text descriptions:

Stage name
Appearance characteristics
Internal changes (sugar/starch/moisture changes)
Consumption suggestions (recommended/suitable for cooking/inedible)

Design style:

Minimalist light background (beige)
Highly realistic photography style
Clear dividing lines (sense of time slicing)
Chinese educational layout, Little Red Book style
Appropriate use of icons like ⚠️✔️

Title at the top: "Life of {argument name="food name" default="Garlic"}"

Key requirement: It must be presented as "slices of the same food item changing over time," not a collage of independent individuals.

promptLocalized.zh:
以“{argument name="food name" default="大蒜"} 的一生”为主题的科普信息图。

画面必须呈现“单个完整的食物主体”（例如：一个土豆 / 一串香蕉 / 一个大蒜），通过横向切片展示同一食物在不同时间阶段的变化，而非多个不同个体的拼贴。

食物主体保持结构连续性和形状一致，在不同切片区域呈现出不同成熟度（如同将时间切开）。

图片采用 3:4 竖屏比例，主体居中并横向延展，均匀分为 4-6 个片段：

从左至右：未成熟 → 成熟 → 过熟 → 变质

每个片段反映真实变化：

颜色变化（如：绿 → 黄 → 黑等）
质地变化（如：饱满 → 变软 → 萎缩 → 腐烂）
特征变化（如：发芽、出水、发霉等）

每个阶段配有文字说明：

阶段名称
外观特征
内部变化（糖分/淀粉/水分变化）
食用建议（推荐/适合烹饪/不可食用）

设计风格：

极简浅色背景（米色）
高度写实的摄影风格
清晰的分隔线（时间切片感）
中文科普排版，小红书风格
适当使用 ⚠️✔️ 等图标

顶部标题：“{argument name="food name" default="大蒜"} 的一生”

核心要求：必须呈现为“同一食物随时间变化的切片”，而非独立个体的拼贴。

templates.title: Hand-drawn Travel Journal Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 手绘风格旅行日记插画

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Please draw a brightly colored, vertical (9:16) hand-drawn style "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Travel Journal Illustration." The style should look as if it were created with crayons by a curious child. Use a soft and warm light-colored background (such as light yellow), paired with bright tones like red, blue, and green, to create a cozy, child-like, and travel-inspired atmosphere.

I. Main Image: Journal-style Travel Route

Draw a "winding travel route" in the center of the illustration, connecting multiple locations with arrows and dashed lines. Recommended attractions will be automatically generated based on a {argument name="number of days" default="1"}-day itinerary:

Example format (automatically replaced with {argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} related content):

- "Stop 1: {Attraction 1 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 2: {Attraction 2 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 3: {Attraction 3 recommendation + short fun description}"
- ...
- "Final Stop: {Local signature food/souvenir + warm closing statement}"

> The number of travel stops is automatically generated based on the number of days. If no days are input, a 1-day/highlights route will be generated by default.

II. Fun Surrounding Elements (Automatically replaced based on the city)

Add plenty of child-like elements around the route, such as:

- Cute travel characters: "A child holding local snacks," "An adventurous kid wearing a backpack," etc.
- Child-like Q-version hand-drawings of local landmarks: such as "{landmark 1}," "{landmark 2}," "{landmark 3}."
- Fun signboards: "Watch out for getting lost!", "Mind the crowds!", "Good food ahead!" (Adjusted according to city context).
- Sticker-style slogans: "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Travel Memories Unlocked!", "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Food Adventure!", "Where to next?"
- Cute small icons of local delicacies: such as "{food 1}," "{food 2}," "{food 3}."
- Exclamations (maintaining a child-like tone): "{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} is so much fun!", "I want to go again!"

III. Overall Style Requirements

- Hand-drawn crayon style / children's travel log style
- Bright colors, full but warm composition
- Emphasis on the joy and exploration of travel
- All text uses cute handwritten fonts
- Make the entire image look like a travel journal page full of child-like wonder.

promptLocalized.zh:
请绘制一张色彩鲜艳、竖版（9:16）的手绘风格“{argument name="city name" default="北京"} 旅行日记插画”。画面风格应如同好奇的孩子用蜡笔绘制而成。使用柔和温暖的浅色背景（如浅黄色），搭配红色、蓝色和绿色等明亮色调，营造出舒适、童趣且充满旅行气息的氛围。

I. 主图：日记风格旅行路线

在插画中心绘制一条“蜿蜒的旅行路线”，用箭头和虚线连接多个地点。推荐景点将根据 {argument name="number of days" default="1"} 天的行程自动生成：

示例格式（自动替换为与 {argument name="city name" default="北京"} 相关的内容）：

- “第一站：{景点 1 推荐 + 简短有趣的描述}”
- “第二站：{景点 2 推荐 + 简短有趣的描述}”
- “第三站：{景点 3 推荐 + 简短有趣的描述}”
- ...
- “终点站：{当地特色美食/纪念品 + 温馨的结语}”

> 旅行停靠点的数量会根据天数自动生成。如果未输入天数，默认生成 1 天/精华游路线。

II. 有趣的周边元素（根据城市自动替换）

在路线周围添加大量童趣元素，例如：

- 可爱的旅行角色：“拿着当地小吃的孩子”、“背着背包的探险小童”等。
- 当地地标的 Q 版手绘图：如“{地标 1}”、“{地标 2}”、“{地标 3}”。
- 有趣的指示牌：“小心迷路！”，“注意人群！”，“前方有美食！”（根据城市背景调整）。
- 贴纸风格的标语：“{argument name="city name" default="北京"} 旅行记忆解锁！”，“{argument name="city name" default="北京"} 美食大冒险！”，“下一站去哪儿？”
- 当地美食的可爱小图标：如“{食物 1}”、“{食物 2}”、“{食物 3}”。
- 感叹语（保持童趣语气）：“{argument name="city name" default="北京"} 太好玩了！”，“我还想再去一次！”

III. 整体风格要求

- 手绘蜡笔风格 / 儿童旅行日志风格
- 色彩明亮，构图饱满而温暖
- 强调旅行的快乐与探索感
- 所有文字均使用可爱的圆体手写字体
- 让整张图片看起来就像一页充满童真奇想的旅行日记。

promptLocalized.zh: 请创作一张东方奇幻角色概念插画，主角为 {argument name="character role" default="一位东方奇幻角色"}，并使用 {argument name="weapon" default="乐器或武器"}。整体风格融合了中国传统仙侠、神话意象及电影级 CG 概念艺术质感。画面需具备强烈的东方奇幻美学、高级感与史诗氛围。角色为核心视觉焦点，气质需呈现空灵、神圣、优雅、清冷或威严感。根据 {argument name="character role" default="角色"} 自动匹配最合适的表情、服饰、发型、配饰及身份设定。若 {argument name="weapon" default="物品"} 为乐器，角色应处于仪式感强且流畅的姿态，如弹奏、拨弄、吹奏或持琴而立，强调音乐能量、灵气流动，以及化作光纹、云雾、星光或法阵的音波效果。若 {argument name="weapon" default="物品"} 为武器，角色应处于持械、蓄势、对峙、施法或战前瞬间的姿态，强调力量感、压迫感、气场及能量汇聚。构图以居中或偏心构图为主，平衡且庄重，具备海报级主视觉效果；角色背后可带有月轮、光环、神光、古阵或图标式圆形结构。服饰采用东方奇幻风格，材质轻盈华美，包含薄纱、飘带、层叠裙摆、金属饰品、玉饰或冠冕。发丝与衣物随风飘动，营造强烈的动态美感。背景根据角色气质自动匹配东方奇幻场景，如星空神域、云海天宫、月下圣地、竹林仙山、冰雪秘境、静夜祭坛、古老遗迹等，环境需带有烟雾、流光、粒子、神秘能量及空间深度。色彩采用统一且高级的主色调以把控画面。可根据角色与道具自动选择冰蓝、月白、青色、紫色、赤金、墨黑、银灰等配色方案，并辅以少量亮金或冷光进行神性点缀。整体要求：唯美、梦幻、空灵、神秘、超脱、神圣、精致，具备电影级光影、体积光、空气感及超精细 CG 插画质感；避免庸俗，避免廉价古风摄影感，避免网红脸，避免背景杂乱，避免塑料质感。

templates.title: Cinematic Anime Movie Poster Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级动漫海报提示词

templates.prompt:
16:9 theatrical anime movie poster. Boundary area of a night forest. In the center-left foreground, a Japanese girl in her late teens. Black hair ponytail, slender, wearing a dark-colored practical winter outdoor jacket and a research backpack. 3/4 rear view showing her back, looking back over her shoulder. Calm tension and strong will.
Above the forest in the upper right, a giant spherical paranormal phenomenon emitting white-blue light. An energy sphere intertwined with countless luminous filaments and electrical outlines. Foggy white light inside, surrounded by fine pale blue particle light. Mt. Fuji emitting plumes of smoke in the far left background. In the middle ground, forbidden entry tape with Japanese warnings, realistic disaster response staff, and emergency vehicles on both sides. No military feel required.
Ground is muddy mountain forest, with shallow water streams and wet ground reflecting the light. Tall trees on the left and right frame the scene. Sky is full of stars, with subtle city lights at the foot of Mt. Fuji. An atmosphere where mystery and disaster coexist.
Triangular composition of the girl, the giant light sphere, and Mt. Fuji. Slightly low cinematic viewpoint. The girl and the light sphere are clearly shown as the two main protagonists. Based on cold night blue, the main light source is the white-blue emission from the giant light sphere. Strong rim light on the trees, ground, water surface, and the girl. Secondary light sources are starlight and the faint orange glow of the distant eruption. The girl's face is not too dark and her expression is readable. High contrast.
High-end key visual for the latest Japanese theatrical anime. Movie poster grade completion. High-density, delicate background, precise light expression, atmospheric perspective, beautifully organized anime drawing leaning towards realism. Overall tone is dark navy, white-blue emission, and faint volcanic orange. Solemn, unsettling, mysterious, and high drama.
Small Japanese copy in the top center: "{argument name="poster slogan" default="It was not a miracle. It was a disaster that connected to the beyond."}"
Large elegant English serif title in bottom center with pale light close to white: "{argument name="movie title" default="Re:Connect Worlds"}"
Directly below it, a small Japanese subtitle: "{argument name="subtitle" default="Forest of Boundaries"}"
Characters are accurate and highly readable. Do not include characters, logos, or watermarks other than specified. Do not include unnecessary people, monsters, mechs, or unnecessary flashy particles or noise.

promptLocalized.zh:
16:9 院线动漫电影海报。夜间森林的边界区域。左前方中心位置，一位 10 多岁后期的日本少女。黑色马尾辫，身材苗条，身穿深色实用型冬季户外夹克，背着研究用背包。3/4 背面视角，展示她的后背，正回头望向后方。冷静的张力与坚定的意志。
森林上方右侧，一个巨大的球形超自然现象正散发着白蓝色光芒。能量球体与无数发光丝线和电光轮廓交织在一起。内部为雾状白光，周围环绕着细微的淡蓝色粒子光。远景左侧是正在喷发烟雾的富士山。中景处有带有日文警告的禁入带，两侧是写实的灾害应对人员和应急车辆。不需要军事感。
地面是泥泞的山林，有浅水溪流和反射光线的湿地。左右两侧的高大树木构成了场景框架。天空繁星点点，富士山脚下有隐约的城市灯光。营造出神秘与灾难并存的氛围。
少女、巨型光球和富士山呈三角形构图。略微低沉的电影化视角。少女和光球被清晰地呈现为两个主要主角。以冷夜蓝色为基调，主要光源是来自巨型光球的白蓝色发射光。树木、地面、水面和少女身上有强烈的轮廓光。次要光源是星光和远处火山喷发的微弱橙光。少女的面部不会太暗，表情清晰可见。高对比度。
最新日本院线动漫的高端主视觉图。电影海报级的完成度。高密度、细腻的背景，精准的光影表现，大气透视，偏向写实风格的精美动漫绘图。整体色调为深海军蓝、白蓝色发射光和微弱的火山橙色。庄重、不安、神秘且充满戏剧性。
顶部中心的小号日文文案：“{argument name="poster slogan" default="那并非奇迹。那是连接彼岸的灾难。"}”
底部中心的大号优雅英文衬线标题，颜色为接近白色的淡光：“{argument name="movie title" default="Re:Connect Worlds"}”
标题正下方是小号日文副标题：“{argument name="subtitle" default="边界之森"}”
文字准确且高度可读。除指定内容外，请勿包含其他文字、标志或水印。请勿包含不必要的人物、怪物、机甲，或不必要的炫目粒子和噪点。

templates.title: Cheesy Chips Snack Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 芝士薯片零食广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic studio food advertisement poster on a dark black textured background with moody, high-contrast lighting and rich warm orange tones. The composition is vertical and split visually: bold stacked ad copy on the left, hero food action on the right. Show a deep rustic bowl overflowing with triangular cheddar corn chips in the lower center-right, with thick glossy cheese sauce being poured in a continuous stream from a tilted dark metal saucepan entering from the upper right. The cheese lands heavily on top of the chips and drapes over them in thick molten folds. Behind the bowl on the left, place 1 upright red snack bag with a large yellow-orange starburst graphic and the brand text {argument name="brand name" default="CRUNCHY CHIPZ"} in big white outlined letters, plus smaller flavor text {argument name="flavor text" default="ZESTY CHEDDAR"} and tiny subtitle "FLAVORED CORN SNACKS". Print tiny text near the lower left of the bag: "SAVORY TRIANGLES". Add 2 small condiment bowls on the dark tabletop: 1 shallow bowl of shredded cheddar in the bottom left corner and 1 tiny bowl of reddish seasoning near the bottom center-right. Scatter a few crumbs and cheese shreds across the table, with a dark napkin tucked under the main bowl. Include bold distressed condensed uppercase typography in a vintage poster style. On the upper left, stack the headline in 5 lines reading: {argument name="headline text" default="THE ULTIMATE MUNCH."} with "THE" on line 1, "ULTIMATE" on line 2, and "MUNCH." on line 3 in large type, followed by line 4 "EXPERIENCE" and line 5 "TRUE UMAMI." in smaller white text. Beneath that, add 2 promotional lines in orange: {argument name="review text" default="OVER 300 REVIEWS."}. In the bottom right, place a 3-line orange callout reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DIP, POUR, MUNCH."}. Use cinematic food photography styling, sharp focus on chips and cheese stream, appetizing glossy textures, commercial packaging realism, premium snack-brand ad aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的摄影棚美食广告海报，背景为黑色质感底色，采用情绪化的高对比度灯光，色调呈现浓郁的暖橙色。构图为垂直布局，视觉上分为左右两部分：左侧为醒目的堆叠式广告文案，右侧为核心美食动态展示。在右下方展示一个深色的乡村风格碗，里面堆满了三角形的切达玉米片，右上角倾斜的深色金属平底锅正源源不断地淋下浓稠亮泽的芝士酱。芝士厚重地覆盖在薯片上，形成浓郁的熔岩状褶皱。在左侧碗后方放置 1 袋直立的红色零食包装袋，袋上印有醒目的黄橙色星爆图形，并以巨大的白色描边字体显示品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="CRUNCHY CHIPZ"}，下方配有较小的口味说明 {argument name="flavor text" default="ZESTY CHEDDAR"} 以及微小的副标题“FLAVORED CORN SNACKS”。在包装袋左下方印上微小文字：“SAVORY TRIANGLES”。在深色桌面上放置 2 个小型调料碗：左下角为 1 个盛有切达干酪碎的浅碗，右下角附近为 1 个盛有红色调味料的小碗。桌面上散落着些许碎屑和芝士丝，主碗下方垫着一张深色餐巾。使用复古海报风格的粗体做旧压缩大写字体。在左上方分 5 行堆叠标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="THE ULTIMATE MUNCH."}，其中第 1 行“THE”、第 2 行“ULTIMATE”、第 3 行“MUNCH.”使用大号字体，随后第 4 行“EXPERIENCE”和第 5 行“TRUE UMAMI.”使用较小的白色字体。在其下方添加 2 行橙色的促销文案：{argument name="review text" default="OVER 300 REVIEWS."}。在右下方放置 3 行橙色的宣传标语：{argument name="tagline text" default="DIP, POUR, MUNCH."}。采用电影级美食摄影风格，薯片和芝士流细节清晰，呈现诱人的光泽质感，具备商业包装的真实感及高端零食品牌的广告美学。

templates.prompt: A cinematic commercial product photo of a glossy red snack bag standing upright on a wet city street at night, centered in frame, shot straight-on at eye level with shallow depth of field and dramatic orange neon lighting. The package is covered in realistic water droplets and reflects warm streetlights. The brand name on the bag reads {argument name="brand name" default="CRUNCHY CHIPZ"} in very large bold white bubble letters with a thick dark outline, stacked across two lines in the center. Behind the logo is a jagged yellow-orange comic-style starburst graphic. In the lower right area of the bag, smaller printed flavor text reads {argument name="flavor text" default="ZESTY CHEDDAR"}, with tiny subtext below reading "FLAVORED CORN SNACKS." Near the bottom left edge of the bag, tiny text reads "SAVORY TRIANGLES." Show exactly 3 triangular corn chips total: 2 printed on the front of the bag and 1 real chip placed on the wet pavement in front of the package, leaning slightly back. The chips are orange, heavily seasoned, and textured. The background is a moody urban alley with blurred neon signs and round bokeh lights, all in deep amber, orange, and red tones, with glossy reflections on the rain-soaked ground. Ultra-detailed advertising photography, high contrast, sharp focus on the bag and front chip, premium snack packaging mockup, realistic condensation, rich saturated colors, studio-quality product retouching blended with a rainy street lifestyle setting.

templates.prompt: A minimalist luxury skincare product photograph of a frosted glass serum bottle standing upright at the center of a large shallow beige ceramic tray with a slightly raised rim. The bottle has a matte silver pump dispenser with a short side nozzle and a clean cylindrical form. On the bottle, elegant black serif typography reads {argument name="brand name" default="AURA"} on the top line and {argument name="product name" default="Hydrating Serum"} below. Around the bottle on the tray are exactly 4 small off-white paper cards placed loosely in the foreground and right side, each printed with a short phrase in a different language: one English card reading "Quiet skin, every morning", one French card reading "Peau calme, chaque matin", one vertical East Asian text card, and one Arabic text card. Warm natural morning sunlight streams in from the upper left, casting long soft-edged shadows of the bottle and cards across the sandy textured tray surface. templates.title: Summer McCafé Mountain Road Ad

templates.prompt: Create a premium vertical fast-food lifestyle advertisement in a polished commercial photography style, designed like a summer campaign poster for McDonald's and McCafé. Show a glamorous young woman with softly blurred, unidentifiable facial features sitting confidently on the hood of a sleek red sports car parked on a winding mountain road at golden hour. She has long wavy auburn hair glowing in warm sunset backlight, wears a dark green satin bomber jacket with gold detailing, a white camisole, high-waisted burgundy pants, and black ankle boots with heels. Her pose is relaxed and stylish, one leg bent and one extended forward, while she holds out a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw and visible McDonald's golden arches branding toward the camera. Scatter red roses across the car hood around her, and place 1 McDonald's paper takeout bag on the right side of the hood. Use a dramatic canyon or hillside background with warm sunlight, soft haze, cinematic depth of field, and a luxurious aspirational road-trip mood. Include floating red flower petals in the air. Compose the layout as a high-end ad with the model centered slightly right and large promotional typography on the left. Add exactly 3 large headline lines in the upper left: "SIP.", "SAVOR.", and "{argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER."}" with the first 2 in bold white and the third in bold golden yellow. Below that, add the subheadline: "Refresh your drive with McCafé." with "McCafé" highlighted in yellow. Add exactly 3 circular feature icons stacked vertically on the left with short captions: "PREMIUM McCAFÉ ICED COFFEE", "WORLD FAMOUS FRIES", and "QUALITY YOU CAN TASTE". Place the McDonald's golden arches logo with the text "i'm lovin' it" in the top right. Add a small lower-left tagline reading "Good days start here." with "start here." in yellow. Create a bold yellow bottom banner spanning the width, divided into 3 content areas: left area reads "SUMMER SAVINGS" and "ENJOY EXCLUSIVE OFFERS"; center area includes a McDonald's app icon and the text "DOWNLOAD THE APP FOR DEALS NEAR YOU"; right area reads "FOLLOW US @MCDONALDS" with social icons. Use brand-accurate red and yellow accents, glossy product styling, realistic lighting, sharp editorial retouching, shallow depth of field, luxury commercial ad composition, and mobile-first poster proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍的夜间街头人像，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"} 随意地坐在城市小餐馆外编织材质的法式餐椅上。她留着一头 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的长发，发丝略显蓬松，肤色呈小麦色，妆容自然简约，在柔和的闪光灯下透出光泽。她身穿修身白色背心，内搭黑色蕾丝抹胸，下身穿着高腰宽松蓝色牛仔裤，佩戴着精致的金色首饰：一只手腕上戴着 2 条细手链，颈间是一条带有微型心形吊坠的精致项链，另一只手腕上戴着 1 条纤细手链。她身体斜向镜头，一只手臂搭在弯曲的椅背上，另一只手放在大腿附近，表情平静且看向镜头外。采用竖构图，拍摄范围约为大腿以上的半身像，视角略近，充满亲密感。机顶直闪光灯营造出明亮的高光、深邃的阴影，以及带有轻微颗粒感的原始胶片抓拍效果。背景是黑暗的城市人行道，可见店面橱窗、黑色外墙、温暖的室内倒影，左上方有一个发着黄光的招牌，上面写着 {argument name="restaurant sign" default="KOZY KORNER RESTAURANT"}，下方有一个较小的发光招牌写着 LIQUORS。背景中加入一道狭长的红色垂直霓虹光影，左侧是远处的路灯和模糊的城市光斑，右侧玻璃门上有隐约的金色字样。画面最右侧的桌边放着一个透明玻璃瓶。营造真实的夜生活氛围，时尚且不加修饰，浅景深，比例真实，具备闪光灯摄影美学，呈现出电影级的城市抓拍质感。

templates.title: Vintage Moda Pier in Istanbul

templates.prompt: A dreamy vintage travel photograph of the historic Moda pier terminal in Istanbul, centered at the end of a stone waterfront jetty, shot in a vertical composition from across calm dark water. The two-story waterfront building has pale beige stone walls, a warm terracotta tiled hip roof, tall arched windows on the ground floor, an open upper veranda with many slim columns, and a visible sign reading "{argument name="pier sign text" default="MODA İSKELESİ"}" on the upper facade. A white ferry is partially visible on the far left behind the pier, and small scattered pedestrians stand along the dock and around the building, giving scale without becoming portrait subjects. The foreground is reflective harbor water with soft ripples and a muted reflection of the building; the pier edge is lined with white railings and rough dark rocks at the base. Above, a wide overcast sky with heavy layered clouds fills nearly half the image. Use a nostalgic Instagram-filter aesthetic with faded colors, warm sepia-beige tones, slight green cast in the shadows, gentle film grain, low contrast, soft haze, subtle vignette, and a lightly weathered analog-photo feel. Architecture-focused, serene, cinematic, realistic, slightly melancholy, like a viral travel postcard of {argument name="city" default="Istanbul"} on a cloudy day.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的复古旅行摄影作品，展现了伊斯坦布尔历史悠久的 Moda 码头候船厅。画面以石质水岸栈道的尽头为中心，采用竖构图，从平静深邃的水面彼岸拍摄。这座两层高的临水建筑拥有浅米色的石墙、温暖的赤陶瓦坡屋顶、底层的拱形高窗，以及带有许多纤细立柱的开放式上层走廊。建筑上层立面可见清晰的标牌，文字为 "{argument name="pier sign text" default="MODA İSKELESİ"}"。码头左后方隐约可见一艘白色渡轮，零星的行人站在码头和建筑周围，在不喧宾夺主的情况下衬托出建筑的宏伟比例。前景是波光粼粼的港口水面，倒映着建筑柔和的轮廓；码头边缘设有白色栏杆，底部点缀着粗糙的深色岩石。上方，厚重的层云覆盖了近半个画面。采用怀旧的 Instagram 滤镜美学，色调褪色，呈现温暖的棕褐色与米色，阴影中带有淡淡的绿色，伴有细腻的胶片颗粒感、低对比度、柔和的雾气、微妙的暗角，以及轻微的风化胶片质感。聚焦建筑，宁静、电影感、写实且略带忧郁，宛如一张在阴天拍摄的 {argument name="city" default="Istanbul"} 爆款旅行明信片。

templates.title: Vintage Bosphorus Bridge Ferry Scene

templates.prompt: A dreamy vintage-style photograph of the Bosphorus in {argument name="city" default="Istanbul"} at dusk, shot from water level in a vertical composition. The enormous suspension bridge spans the frame from upper left to upper right, with a tall bridge tower on the far left and delicate strings of warm lights hanging down from the cables, plus a line of tiny orange lights tracing the roadway. Below the bridge, calm dark water fills the foreground. Place 3 visible boats total: 1 medium white passenger ferry centered in the middle distance facing the viewer, 1 long low white ferry farther back near the right side under the bridge, and 1 small boat at the far right edge. On the left shoreline, show an illuminated waterfront with warm yellow lights, a few palm trees, and part of an old building at the extreme left edge. Near the center-left background beneath the bridge, include a pale waterside mosque with 1 dome and 2 slender minarets. Behind everything, add a hazy hillside dense with buildings fading into the distance. Use a nostalgic viral Instagram-filter look: heavy warm sepia and muted olive tones, faded contrast, soft focus, visible film grain, subtle vignette, slight light leaks, low clarity, and an aged analog print texture. The atmosphere should feel moody, romantic, cinematic, and softly blurred, like an old travel memory.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的复古风格照片，展示了黄昏时分的 {argument name="city" default="伊斯坦布尔"} 博斯普鲁斯海峡，采用水面视角的竖构图。巨大的悬索桥从左上角横跨至右上角，最左侧矗立着高大的桥塔，缆绳上悬挂着精致的暖色灯串，路面上有一排细小的橙色灯光。桥下是平静深邃的水面，占据了前景。画面中共有 3 艘可见的船只：中间远景处有一艘面向观众的中型白色客运渡轮，右侧桥下远方有一艘长而低矮的白色渡轮，最右侧边缘有一艘小船。左侧岸边展示了灯火通明的滨水区，点缀着暖黄色灯光、几棵棕榈树以及最左侧边缘的一座古老建筑局部。在桥下中左侧的背景中，包含一座带有 1 个圆顶和 2 座细长宣礼塔的浅色水滨清真寺。在所有景物后方，添加一片朦胧的山坡，上面密集的建筑向远处渐隐。采用流行的怀旧 Instagram 滤镜风格：浓郁的暖棕褐色和柔和的橄榄色调、褪色的对比度、柔焦效果、可见的胶片颗粒感、微妙的暗角、轻微的漏光、低清晰度以及陈旧的模拟照片质感。整体氛围应充满情绪感、浪漫气息、电影质感，并带有柔和的模糊感，宛如一段古老的旅行记忆。

The bow has a bold stylized lips graphic painted in red and black, creating a playful viral Instagram-filter feel. Behind and around the ship is a dense waterfront cityscape with low buildings, docks, and exactly 2 slender mosque minarets rising on the right side of the skyline. The composition is symmetrical and cinematic, with the ship dominating the vertical center, dark water in the foreground, and a huge dramatic sky above. The sky is filled with heavy storm clouds across the upper third, but the lower sky glows in pale yellow-green haze, giving the image a vintage, dreamy, slightly eerie atmosphere. Include exactly 4 small birds scattered in the sky. Apply a nostalgic analog film look with faded colors, grain, dust specks, soft blur, light vignette, muted contrast, and a slightly weathered 1990s tourist snapshot aesthetic. Add an orange camcorder-style date stamp in the lower left corner reading {argument name="date stamp" default="02 25 '94"}. Vertical 3:4 framing, centered composition, realistic photography, moody travel postcard tone, city and ship details slightly softened by haze.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张正面拍摄的照片，画面中心是一艘巨大的白色游轮，正航行在伊斯坦布尔的水面上。从狭窄港口航道的低处远距离望去，游轮正缓慢向镜头驶来。船头绘有醒目的红色和黑色风格化嘴唇图案，营造出一种俏皮且具有病毒式传播潜力的 Instagram 滤镜感。游轮后方及周围是密集的水岸城市景观，包括低矮的建筑、码头，以及天际线右侧耸立的 2 座细长清真寺宣礼塔。构图对称且具有电影感，游轮占据垂直中心位置，前景为深色水域，上方是巨大的戏剧性天空。天空上三分之一处布满厚重的风暴云，但下方的天空泛着淡黄绿色的雾气，为画面增添了一种复古、梦幻且略带诡异的氛围。画面中需包含 4 只散落在天空中的小鸟。应用怀旧模拟胶片外观，呈现褪色的色彩、颗粒感、灰尘斑点、柔焦、轻微暗角、柔和的对比度，以及 1990 年代旅游快照那种略显陈旧的质感。在左下角添加一个橙色的摄像机风格日期戳，显示为 {argument name="date stamp" default="02 25 '94"}。垂直 3:4 画幅，中心构图，写实摄影，忧郁的旅行明信片色调，城市和游轮细节因雾气而略显柔和。

templates.title: Dreamy Nemophila Date Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻粉蝶花约会人像

templates.prompt: A dreamy vertical spring portrait photo of a young woman standing in profile in a vast field of tiny blue nemophila flowers under a bright blue sky with soft white clouds. She wears a fitted ribbed knit dress in {argument name="dress color" default="pale sky blue"} with elbow-length sleeves, and her long straight brown hair is blowing dramatically to the right in the wind. Frame her from about mid-thigh upward, slightly off-center to the right, with the flower field filling the background and a small rope fence with wooden posts visible along the lower right edge beside a gravel path. Use soft natural morning sunlight, airy high-key exposure, gentle pastel tones, shallow depth of field, subtle lens bloom, and a romantic social-media snapshot aesthetic. Add a few large out-of-focus white flower petals drifting across the foreground. Overlay handwritten white Japanese text directly on the image: at the upper left, "{argument name="greeting text" default="おはよう"}" with a small doodled cloud beside it; below that, the date "{argument name="date text" default="2026.04.22"}"; across the lower middle-right, "{argument name="main note text" default="嫁と ネモフィラデート✌︎"}"; and beneath it, "{argument name="sub note text" default="に使っていいよっ♡"}". Keep the handwriting casual, playful, and slightly uneven like a marker pen on a photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的竖版春日人像摄影，一位年轻女性侧身站在广阔的蓝色粉蝶花田中，背景是明亮的蓝天和柔和的白云。她身穿一件 {argument name="dress color" default="淡天蓝色"} 的修身罗纹针织连衣裙，袖长及肘，一头棕色长直发在风中向右飘动。构图从大腿中部向上取景，人物略微偏向右侧，背景铺满花海，右下角可见碎石路旁带有木桩的小绳围栏。采用柔和的自然晨光、通透的高调曝光、淡雅的色调、浅景深、细腻的镜头光晕，以及浪漫的社交媒体快照美学。在前景中加入几片虚化的大型白色花瓣。在图像上直接叠加手写风格的白色日文：左上角为“{argument name="greeting text" default="おはよう"}”并配有一个涂鸦小云朵；下方为日期“{argument name="date text" default="2026.04.22"}”；中右下方为“{argument name="main note text" default="嫁と ネモフィラデート✌︎"}”；其下方为“{argument name="sub note text" default="に使っていいよっ♡"}”。保持手写字体随性、俏皮且略带不规则感，如同用马克笔在照片上书写的效果。

templates.title: Elegant Wuxia Swordsman Design Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅武侠剑客设计图

templates.prompt: Create an elegant high-fantasy character design sheet in a refined wuxia/xianxia style on a clean ivory background with a thin ornate vintage border. The layout is a split showcase with 5 visible panels: 1 large full-body panel on the left, 1 tall upper-right portrait close-up, and 3 stacked/lower detail panels on the right showing armor and weapon craftsmanship. The main subject is a handsome adult male swordsman, {argument name="character name" default="original character"}, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied in a half-up topknot, the rest loose and wind-swept, wearing a small gold earring. His expression is calm, noble, and slightly aloof. He wears luxurious layered robes in {argument name="robe colors" default="white, deep navy blue, and black"}, with wide sleeves, flowing sashes, and highly detailed gold embroidery. Over the shoulders and torso are ornate dark blue and black armor elements with elaborate gold filigree and dragon-like decorative metalwork, plus a jade-green gemstone set into the waist ornament and weapon fittings. In the full-body panel he stands in a poised three-quarter stance holding a long straight jian sword diagonally downward, with the robe hems and ribbons flowing gracefully to suggest motion. The costume should include exactly 6 standout outfit elements: white inner robe, dark blue outer robe panels, black underlayer trousers, wide black-and-gold waist belt, sculpted gold shoulder armor, and black bracers with gold detailing. The right-side close-up portrait emphasizes the layered collar, glossy hair texture, shoulder ornament, and elegant fabric rendering. The 3 detail panels show exactly these focus areas: a gold dragon-like waist armor emblem, a jade-set sword guard or accessory ornament, and a close-up of the ornate gold sword hilt and guard with part of the blade. Overall aesthetic: ultra-detailed concept art, stylish and polished, crisp linework blended with painterly rendering, premium character-sheet presentation, soft neutral studio lighting, subtle shadows, luxurious textures, and a restrained palette of ivory, midnight blue, black, gold, and jade green.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张优雅的高奇幻角色设计图，采用精致的武侠/仙侠风格，背景为干净的象牙色，并带有纤细华丽的复古边框。布局为 5 个面板的分屏展示：左侧为 1 个大型全身面板，右上角为 1 个高挑的肖像特写，右侧下方为 3 个堆叠的细节面板，展示盔甲和武器工艺。主角是一位英俊的成年男性剑客，{argument name="character name" default="原创角色"}，留着飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 长发，半扎发髻，其余发丝随风飘动，佩戴一枚小金耳环。他神情沉稳、高贵且略带清冷。身着奢华的层叠长袍，配色为 {argument name="robe colors" default="白色、深海军蓝和黑色"}，袖口宽大，腰带飘逸，并饰有极其精细的金色刺绣。肩部和躯干覆盖着华丽的深蓝色与黑色盔甲组件，配有精致的金色花丝和龙形装饰金属工艺，腰部饰品和武器配件上镶嵌着翠绿色的宝石。在全身面板中，他以优雅的三分之二侧身站立，斜持一把长直剑，长袍下摆和丝带优雅地飘动，营造出动感。服装应包含 6 个突出的元素：白色内袍、深蓝色外袍、黑色内衬长裤、宽大的黑金腰带、雕刻精美的金色肩甲以及带有金色细节的黑色护腕。右侧的肖像特写强调了层叠的领口、光泽的发质、肩部装饰以及优雅的织物渲染。3 个细节面板分别展示以下重点区域：龙形金质腰部徽章、镶玉剑格或配饰，以及精美的金质剑柄和剑格特写（包含部分剑身）。整体美学：超精细概念艺术，时尚且精致，清晰的线条与绘画渲染相结合，高级角色设计图展示，柔和的中性摄影棚灯光，微妙的阴影，奢华的质感，以及象牙白、午夜蓝、黑色、金色和翠绿色的克制配色。

templates.title: Luxury Trench Fashion Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华风衣时尚广告

templates.prompt: A high-end luxury fashion advertising poster in vertical 9:16 format, featuring a tall elegant female model with her face intentionally obscured, standing in a dramatic three-quarter pose against a stormy cinematic sky at golden sunset. She has windswept auburn hair pulled back loosely with flying strands, and wears a two-tone belted trench coat split in rich burnt orange and deep black, layered over a cream ribbed turtleneck sweater, with one hand in the coat pocket. The trench has a structured collar, double-breasted buttons, and a slim black leather belt with a polished gold circular buckle. Surround the model with 6 large torn fabric panels framing the composition from the left and right edges, in orange, tan, and charcoal textile textures with visible stitching and frayed edges, as if fabric is ripping open around her. Use a warm amber, copper, and ember color palette, with glowing sparks and smoky haze near the bottom. Place dramatic volumetric clouds in the background, lit with fiery sunset highlights for an epic editorial mood. Add a centered white luxury logo and brand text over the model’s chest area: the horse-and-carriage emblem above the word {argument name="brand text" default="HERMES"} in large elegant serif capitals. Make it look like a premium couture campaign, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, glossy magazine ad, strong contrast, refined fabric texture, fashion photography lighting, heroic composition, sharp focus on the outfit, cinematic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 9:16 竖版高端奢华时尚广告海报，画面中一位身材高挑、气质优雅的女性模特面部被刻意遮挡，以戏剧性的四分之三侧身姿态站在金色的日落时分，背景是充满电影感的风暴天空。她那被风吹乱的赤褐色长发松散地向后梳起，几缕发丝随风飘动；身穿一件双色系腰带风衣，风衣由浓郁的焦橙色和深黑色拼接而成，内搭奶油色罗纹高领毛衣，一只手插在风衣口袋里。风衣配有结构感衣领、双排扣设计，以及一条带有抛光金色圆形扣环的黑色细皮带。模特周围环绕着 6 块巨大的撕裂织物面板，从左右两侧边缘框住构图，呈现出橙色、棕褐色和炭灰色的纺织纹理，带有明显的缝线和磨损边缘，仿佛织物正围绕着她撕裂开来。使用温暖的琥珀色、铜色和余烬色调，底部带有发光的火花和烟雾缭绕的朦胧感。背景中布置戏剧性的体积云，被火红的日落余晖照亮，营造出史诗般的编辑风格氛围。在模特胸部区域居中添加一个白色的奢华标志和品牌文字：马车徽标位于 {argument name="brand text" default="HERMES"} 字样上方，采用醒目优雅的衬线大写字母。使其看起来像是一场高端时装宣传活动，超精细、照片级真实感、光面杂志广告、强对比度、精致的织物纹理、时尚摄影布光、英雄式构图、服装焦点清晰、电影级氛围。

templates.title: Spicy Nacho Tornado Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Spicy Nacho Tornado 广告

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic square commercial poster for a spicy snack brand, with a fiery red storm atmosphere and high-energy food advertising style. The background is a dark crimson sky filled with glowing clouds, scattered sparks, and visible lightning bolts. In the center, a giant tornado made of swirling transparent wind rings, glossy whole red chili peppers, square corn chips, crumbs, and seasoning particles rises upward from an opened snack bag, forming a powerful vortex. The tornado should feel dynamic and explosive, with chips and chili peppers flying outward in different sizes and depths for a cinematic 3D look. At the bottom center, place a glossy red snack packet standing upright, labeled with the brand logo and product name {argument name="product name" default="Crispy Nachos Chips"}, with a spicy flavor badge reading {argument name="flavor text" default="Spicy Masala"}, a small chili illustration, a corn note near the bottom, and a printed image of square nacho chips on the front. Put a stylized playful logo at the top left reading {argument name="brand name" default="SnaX"} in bold yellow and white script with a red outline, and a clean white platform watermark at the top right reading {argument name="platform text" default="Pollo.ai"}. On the left side, add a huge stacked distressed headline in bold condensed uppercase, with the first word in golden yellow and the remaining three lines in white, reading exactly: {argument name="headline text" default="WARNING! CRUNCH STORM INCOMING"}. Use intense rim lighting, glossy highlights, deep shadows, rich red-orange color grading, and a premium snack advertisement composition that feels spicy, crunchy, chaotic, and irresistible.

Use warm orange sunlight, realistic skin and fabric textures, soft highlights on the hair and shoulders, a luxurious urban atmosphere, and a polished lifestyle photography look as if shot for a premium fashion campaign in {argument name="city setting" default="a modern downtown skyline"} during {argument name="time of day" default="sunset"}.

The bag is the visual hero and should look premium, elegant, and sharply detailed. Use cinematic warm lighting, soft rim light on the hair, subtle luxury color grading, shallow depth of field, and blurred skyscrapers in the background. Compose the layout like a premium brand campaign with large text and icons on the left side. At top left, place a refined serif monogram logo: {argument name="brand monogram" default="L"}. At the bottom left, place the brand name in large elegant serif capitals: {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"}, with smaller uppercase tagline below: {argument name="tagline" default="BAGS THAT DEFINE YOU."}. templates.title: Minimal SaaS Ad With Invoice Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 极简 SaaS 广告与发票样机

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist static SaaS ad on a warm off-white background with elegant editorial typography and clean, high-fidelity text rendering. At the top, place a large black serif headline in two lines reading: "{argument name="headline text" default="Your dev team shouldn’t be your analytics team."}" The words “dev team” should appear in italic serif while the rest remains bold high-contrast serif, with generous spacing and a luxury magazine-style layout. Centered below, show a slightly tilted white paper invoice sheet with a soft drop shadow and a subtle vertical fold crease down the middle, as if photographed from above. The invoice uses black monospaced typewriter-style text and reads exactly: “INVOICE — DEV HOURS, OCTOBER” as the header, then 5 line items with hours and prices aligned in columns: “A/B test setup on pricing page   8 hrs   $1,200”, “GTM tag install (3 events)   4 hrs   $600”, “Funnel tracking debug   6 hrs   $900”, “Meta pixel mapping   3 hrs   $450”, and “Attribution reporting build   12 hrs   $1,800”. Under the 5 items, add a dashed divider line, then a bold monospaced “TOTAL” on the lower left and the total price “$4,950” on the lower right. Draw a hand-drawn yellow line striking through the total price. Add 4 doodle-style annotation elements around the invoice: on the left, handwritten yellow text saying “every month??” with a yellow arrow pointing right toward the paper; on the upper right of the paper, a yellow starburst scribble; below the total, a green curved arrow pointing up toward the crossed-out price; and on the lower right, a green hand-drawn circle containing the handwritten words “zero devs,” connected to the green arrow. At the bottom center of the ad, add a smaller black sans-serif body copy in 2 lines reading: “{argument name="body text" default="Marketers ship tests and track revenue themselves.\nNo tickets. No tag manager. One script."}" Keep the composition airy, premium, and conversion-focused, blending modern startup ad design with tactile paper realism and playful marker annotations.

Add 3 handwritten magenta annotation elements: on the left side, the words "{argument name="left annotation" default="one tool"}" in brush script with an underline and a curved arrow pointing to the receipt; near the bottom center, a curved magenta arrow pointing upward toward the circled price; and at the bottom right, the handwritten tagline "{argument name="tagline text" default="One script. One price."}" with an underline. In the bottom-right corner, add a small block of white sans-serif body copy, right-aligned, reading "{argument name="body copy" default="Analytics, heatmaps, A/B testing, and revenue attribution."}". Use an editorial ad-photography style with crisp text placement, clean hierarchy, high contrast, subtle paper realism, and a limited palette of black, white, and hot pink.

promptLocalized.zh: 在哑光黑色背景上创作一则醒目的静态 SaaS 广告，呈现高级编辑风格和极其精准的排版。在顶部放置一个巨大的堆叠式衬线标题，颜色为灰白色：第一行显示 "Your analytics stack"，第二行使用亮洋红色斜体衬线字体显示 "shouldn’t cost more"，第三行使用灰白色衬线字体显示 "than your rent."。构图中心是一张巨大的、卷曲且揉皱的白色热敏纸收据，从左上角向右下角略微倾斜，具有明显的纸张质感、柔和的阴影，以及右上角和左下角的卷边。在收据上，显示 5 行黑色等宽或收据风格的文本，分为两列对齐："GA4" 对应 "$0"，"Hotjar" 对应 "$99"，"Optimizely" 对应 "$2,450"，"GTM setup (dev hours)" 对应 "$1,800"，以及 "Tag manager debug" 对应 "$400"。在 "Optimizely" 一词后方添加一个锯齿状的洋红色星形贴纸以示强调。在项目下方添加一条虚线分割线，然后在收据左下方标注加粗的 "TOTAL"。在收据右下方，放置一个巨大的价格，内容为 "{argument name="monthly price" default="$19/mo"}"，使用粗体黑色字，并用 2 个手绘的洋红色记号笔圆圈圈起。添加 3 个手写洋红色标注元素：在左侧，用笔刷字体书写 "{argument name="left annotation" default="one tool"}"，下方带有下划线，并配有一个指向收据的弯曲箭头；在底部中心附近，有一个指向圈起价格的洋红色弯曲箭头；在右下角，书写手写标语 "{argument name="tagline text" default="One script. One price."}" 并带有下划线。在右下角，添加一小段右对齐的白色无衬线正文，内容为 "{argument name="body copy" default="Analytics, heatmaps, A/B testing, and revenue attribution."}"。采用编辑广告摄影风格，要求文本排版清晰、层级分明、对比度高、纸张质感逼真，并使用黑、白、亮粉色的有限配色方案。

templates.title: Minimal Slot Machine Attribution Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 极简老虎机归因广告

templates.prompt: Create a clean minimalist static ad on an off-white light gray studio background with a centered editorial layout. At the top, place a large luxury-fashion-style serif headline in black reading {argument name="headline text" default="Stop gambling with your ad spend."}, with the word "gambling" set in italic serif for emphasis. In the middle, show a vintage metal slot-machine window viewed straight on, slightly weathered and realistic, with 3 vertical reels inside a rectangular steel housing and a lever with a black knob on the right side. The 3 reels must display, from left to right, "$", "$", and "?". Make the rightmost reel background pale pink while the first 2 reels are aged white. Add a hand-drawn neon-pink annotation style over the image: 1 arrow-and-note on the left pointing to the first reel reading {argument name="left annotation" default="your attribution"}, 1 starburst scribble above the pink question-mark reel, 1 arrow from the question-mark reel to a circled note on the right reading {argument name="right annotation" default="actual revenue"}, and 1 large curved arrow in the lower left pointing toward the body copy area. Below the slot machine, center a short sans-serif paragraph in black reading {argument name="body text" default="See which campaigns drive revenue, not just clicks. Connect Meta, Google, and Stripe in 60 seconds."}. At the bottom center, place a simple black analytics-style bar logo icon followed by the bold sans-serif brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Humblytics"}. Use strong text fidelity, polished product-ad composition, soft studio shadows, restrained palette of black, steel gray, off-white, and hot pink, and a modern direct-response ad aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 在灰白色调的摄影棚背景下，创建一个简洁的极简主义静态广告，采用居中的编辑排版。顶部放置一个黑色的大号奢侈时尚风格衬线体标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="Stop gambling with your ad spend."}，其中“gambling”一词使用斜体衬线字以示强调。中间展示一个正视视角的复古金属老虎机窗口，略带风化感且真实，矩形钢制外壳内有 3 个垂直转轮，右侧配有一个带黑色旋钮的拉杆。3 个转轮从左到右依次显示“$”、“$”和“?”。最右侧转轮的背景设为淡粉色，前 2 个转轮为陈旧的白色。在图像上添加手绘霓虹粉色标注风格：左侧添加一个指向第一个转轮的箭头及注释，内容为 {argument name="left annotation" default="your attribution"}；在粉色问号转轮上方添加一个星形涂鸦；从问号转轮引出一个箭头指向右侧圈出的注释，内容为 {argument name="right annotation" default="actual revenue"}；左下角添加一个指向正文区域的大型弧形箭头。在老虎机下方，居中放置一段简短的黑色无衬线段落，内容为 {argument name="body text" default="See which campaigns drive revenue, not just clicks. Connect Meta, Google, and Stripe in 60 seconds."}。底部居中放置一个简单的黑色分析风格条形图 Logo 图标，后跟加粗的无衬线品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Humblytics"}。要求文字清晰度高，产品广告构图精致，具有柔和的摄影棚阴影，配色方案限制在黑色、钢灰色、灰白色和亮粉色，并呈现现代直接响应式广告的美感。

templates.title: Luxury Leather Fashion Collage Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华皮革时尚拼贴广告

templates.prompt: A high-fashion luxury editorial advertisement in a vertical format, featuring a mysterious female model from mid-torso up, centered and slightly turned to the side, wearing an oversized dark olive leather jacket with a high collar and prominent buckle strap detail near the neck. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur, while her dark wavy shoulder-length hair remains visible and voluminous. She carries a slouchy black leather shoulder bag with a gold chain strap and a small gold logo near the bottom corner. Place the large serif brand name {argument name="brand text" default="LOEWE"} across the center in elegant white uppercase letters, overlaying the figure. Build the entire composition as a tactile collage made of torn and layered fabric and leather swatches: exactly 8 visible material fragments surrounding and partially overlapping the subject, including beige linen at the top left, olive stitched leather panels on the left, soft beige fabric at the lower left edge, dark brown embossed leather with a monogram motif at the upper right, rocky coastline photography at the right and lower right, a textured taupe stitched textile across the lower center, a dark denim-like fragment at the lower left, and a deep brown leather panel at the bottom right. In the background, reveal a dramatic coastal landscape with rocks, ocean waves, and a moody cloudy sky lit like late afternoon or sunset. Use rich earthy tones, muted olive, dark brown, taupe, black, and warm highlights. The overall look should feel premium, cinematic, moody, artisanal, and minimalist, like a luxury fashion campaign combining leather craftsmanship, collage art direction, and editorial photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张垂直构图的高级时尚奢华广告，画面中心是一位半身女性模特，身体略微侧转，身穿一件深橄榄色超大款皮夹克，领口较高，颈部附近有醒目的搭扣细节。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，但深色波浪状的及肩长发依然清晰且蓬松。她背着一个松垮的黑色皮革单肩包，配有金色链条肩带，底部角落处有一个小巧的金色标志。将大号衬线字体品牌名称 {argument name="brand text" default="LOEWE"} 以优雅的白色大写字母置于画面中央，覆盖在人物上方。整个构图采用撕裂并分层的织物与皮革样本拼贴而成：主体周围及部分重叠处共有 8 个可见的材质碎片，包括左上角的米色亚麻布、左侧的橄榄色缝合皮革板、左下边缘的柔软米色织物、右上角带有字母组合图案的深棕色压花皮革、右侧及右下角的岩石海岸摄影、下部中央纹理感十足的灰褐色缝合织物、左下角的深色牛仔布碎片，以及右下角的深棕色皮革板。背景呈现出戏剧性的海岸景观，包含岩石、海浪以及如傍晚或日落时分般阴郁多云的天空。运用浓郁的大地色调、柔和的橄榄色、深棕色、灰褐色、黑色以及温暖的高光。整体视觉效果应呈现出高端、电影感、氛围感、手工艺术感与极简主义风格，如同结合了皮革工艺、拼贴艺术指导与编辑摄影的奢华时尚大片。

Use a muted earthy palette of black, charcoal, bronze, cream, brown, and stormy blue-gray, with cinematic lighting, rich texture detail, premium product-photography finish, and a refined surreal luxury campaign aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张为 {argument name="brand name" default="LOEWE"} 设计的奢华时尚编辑广告拼贴画，采用情绪化的高端杂志风格拍摄。画面中心是一位坐着的年轻女性，身穿超大款黑色皮衣，戴着黑色皮手套，身体微微前倾，双臂交叉，凌乱的深色头发在风中飘动。她的面部大部分被遮挡并弱化，营造出一种匿名编辑的氛围。她手持或倚靠着一个带有金链和悬挂式金色字母组合吊饰的黑色皮包。将巨大的白色衬线字体品牌名 {argument name="brand name" default="LOEWE"} 醒目地置于图像中央，与模特重叠。背景构建为黄昏时分的戏剧性户外场景，天空多云，地面布满岩石，左侧设有一个雕塑般的堆叠石基座，顶部饰有大型金色抽象字母组合装饰。将整幅图像构图为撕纸混合媒介拼贴画，在主体周围包含 5 个清晰可见的材质碎片：左下角 1 块黑色压纹皮革样本，左下前景 1 块带有压印标志的暖棕色皮革样本，右下角 1 块奶油色编织面料样本，右侧 1 块深橄榄色纹理撕纸面板，以及右侧面板上叠加的 1 块米色小皮革样本。采用黑色、炭灰色、青铜色、奶油色、棕色和风暴蓝灰色的柔和大地色调，结合电影级光影、丰富的纹理细节、高级产品摄影质感，以及精致超现实的奢华广告美学。

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="LOEWE"} 设计的奢华时尚编辑拼贴海报，竖构图，采用深沉的秋季大地色调，设计风格如同由层叠撕纸碎片构成的顶级杂志广告。画面中心是一位腰部以上的女性时尚模特，留着狂野且被风吹乱的深色波浪卷发，身穿一件深干邑棕色束腰皮大衣，衣领高耸，呈现出柔软自然的褶皱，侧身站立，姿态极具戏剧张力。她的面部部分被遮挡并弱化，焦点集中在造型与服装上。周围环绕着 8 个清晰可见的拼贴碎片：1 个中心模特肖像，1 个左上角深色纹理织物样本，1 个左上方岩石沙漠景观碎片，1 个上部中心云层背景下的黑色圆形月亮或行星，1 个右上角无叶树剪影，1 个右侧灰色纺织品样本（包含部分棕色皮带和金属环），1 个左下方压印有字母组合标志的棕色皮革样本，1 个右下方绣有相同标志的奶油色流苏织物补丁。在左下角增加一层柔和的米色纸张以增强深度感。到处使用撕裂的毛边效果，采用重叠的剪纸组合、触感强烈的材质对比，并在图层之间添加细微阴影。背景为多云的暴风雨天空与荒凉景观的融合，唤起原始自然与手工匠心的共鸣。在下部中间的大衣上方放置醒目优雅的白色衬线文字 {argument name="headline text" default="LOEWE"}，居中并横跨大部分宽度。在皮革样本上包含精致的压印字母组合标志，并在织物补丁上包含刺绣字母组合。光线柔和、具有电影质感且均匀扩散，皮革、布料、纸张纤维和景观细节纹理丰富。整体氛围：精致、触感、艺术感、顶级奢华广告、手工拼贴、时装屋广告、高端印刷编辑风格。

Her dark wet-look hair is slicked back and slightly messy, her head tilted upward with an elegant elongated neck, and her face mostly obscured by framing and shadow to create a mysterious high-fashion mood. Across the center, place the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="LOEWE"} in very large white high-contrast serif capital letters, spanning nearly the full width of the image. Build the composition as a collage framed by 5 torn material swatches: 1 embossed olive suede piece in the top left with a luxury monogram pressed into it, 1 coarse taupe-beige canvas fabric piece in the top right attached to a warm tan leather strip with visible white stitching, 1 pale textured fabric scrap with frayed edges in the bottom left, 1 dark brown glossy leather piece in the bottom right with a subtle embossed monogram, and 1 narrow vertical weathered beige panel along the left edge. Inside that left panel, include thin dark desert plant stems with small seed heads. In the background behind the model, use a dramatic golden-brown sunset sky with soft clouds and a faint rocky desert landscape near the lower right, creating a warm earthy palette. Lighting should be cinematic, moody, and directional, with rich shadows, tactile material detail, premium fashion-magazine styling, and an elegant artisan-luxury aesthetic. Use a color palette of olive green, camel, tan, beige, chocolate brown, and sunset gold. The overall feeling is sophisticated, handcrafted, minimal, and expensive, like a heritage luxury leather-goods campaign.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版手机格式的奢华时尚编辑广告海报，画面中心为一位女性模特半身像，身穿结构感橄榄绿皮衣，配有尖领，颈部可见一颗圆形的棕色纽扣。她深色的湿发造型向后梳理，略显凌乱，头部向上倾斜，颈部线条优雅修长，面部大部分被边框和阴影遮挡，营造出神秘的高级时尚氛围。在画面中心，放置品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="LOEWE"}，使用超大号白色高对比度衬线大写字母，几乎横跨整个图像宽度。构图采用由 5 片撕裂材质拼贴而成的边框：左上角为一片压印有奢华字母组合的橄榄色麂皮，右上角为一片粗糙的灰褐色帆布，连接着一条带有明显白色缝线的暖棕色皮带，左下角为一片边缘磨损的浅色纹理织物碎片，右下角为一片带有细微压印字母组合的深棕色亮面皮革，左侧边缘为一条狭窄的垂直风化米色面板。在该左侧面板内，包含细长的深色沙漠植物茎秆及小型种子头。模特背景为戏剧性的金棕色日落天空，伴有柔和的云层，右下角隐约可见岩石沙漠景观，营造出温暖的大地色调。灯光应具有电影感、情绪化且具备方向性，呈现丰富的阴影、细腻的材质细节、高级时尚杂志风格以及优雅的工匠奢华美学。色彩搭配采用橄榄绿、驼色、棕褐色、米色、巧克力棕和日落金。整体感觉精致、手工感强、极简且昂贵，如同传承深厚的奢华皮革制品广告活动。

templates.title: Convex Mirror Night Street Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 凸面镜街头夜景自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic nighttime street photo shot as a mirror selfie through a large roadside convex traffic mirror, vertical 3:4 composition, with the entire circular mirror filling the frame and no black empty border outside the reflected scene. Use a strong fisheye lens and a slightly exaggerated dome-mirror effect so the road, scaffolding, poles, buildings, and lane markings bend heavily toward the edges. At the bottom center of the reflection, show a young person from about waist up taking the photo, wearing a {argument name="jacket style" default="black leather jacket"}, with short dark hair, small silver hoop earrings, and 2 visible silver rings, holding a {argument name="phone model" default="white iPhone 15 Pro Max"} up to cover most of the face. The subject stands casually with one hand in a pocket, centered in the mirror. The street is wet and glossy, reflecting intense red light. Include 1 moving dark car crossing the curved road from left to right with subtle motion blur and bright red taillight streaks. Surround the road with dense construction scaffolding and striped barriers; show exactly 2 red-and-yellow diagonal road barriers along the right and upper-right curve and additional striped safety panels around the left side. Include 3 clearly visible red traffic lights glowing in the background. Across the top arc, place a scaffold-wrapped building with large bright red Chinese neon signage. Lighting is dominated by red neon signs and street lamps, casting saturated red highlights across the asphalt and metal structures. The mood is cinematic, urban, candid, and realistic, with a gritty night-street atmosphere in an East Asian city.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的夜间街头照片，通过路边的大型凸面交通镜拍摄的镜像自拍，采用 3:4 竖构图，整个圆形镜面填满画面，反射场景外无黑色空边。使用强力鱼眼镜头和略微夸张的圆顶镜面效果，使道路、脚手架、电线杆、建筑物和车道线向边缘大幅弯曲。在反射画面的底部中心，展示一位腰部以上的年轻人正在拍照，身穿 {argument name="jacket style" default="黑色皮夹克"}，留着深色短发，戴着小巧的银色圆环耳环和 2 枚显眼的银色戒指，手持 {argument name="phone model" default="白色 iPhone 15 Pro Max"} 遮住大半张脸。主体单手插兜，随意地站在镜子中央。街道湿润且富有光泽，反射着强烈的红光。画面中包含 1 辆正在从左向右穿过弯道的深色汽车，带有细微的动态模糊和明亮的红色尾灯拖影。道路四周环绕着密集的建筑脚手架和条纹护栏；在右侧和右上方的弯道处准确展示 2 个红黄相间的斜纹道路护栏，左侧配有额外的条纹安全板。背景中包含 3 个清晰可见的红色交通信号灯。在顶部弧线处，放置一栋被脚手架包裹的建筑，上面有巨大的亮红色中文霓虹灯招牌。光影以红色霓虹灯和路灯为主，在沥青路面和金属结构上投射出饱和的红色高光。整体氛围具有电影感、都市感、抓拍感和写实感，呈现出东亚城市粗粝的街头夜色。

templates.title: Translate Japanese manual into Chinese leaflet

titleLocalized.zh: 将日语说明书翻译为中文

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, recreate the same product instruction leaflet as a clean, professionally typeset Traditional Chinese version. Keep the overall brochure layout, orange header bars, section structure, product photos, knob diagram, USB accessories, and handheld product shot in the same approximate positions, but replace all Japanese text with natural Traditional Chinese copy and make it look like a polished localized manual. Preserve the 4 main content sections plus the top title banner. Use these Chinese headings: 1) top title: 「攪拌塗料瓶夾具－使用說明」, 2) section header: 「只需旋轉瓶蓋，即可完美攪拌！」, 3) section header: 「適用於各種廣口模型塗料與壓克力顏料」, 4) section header: 「可依塗料調整旋轉速度」, 5) section header: 「操作簡單，支援 USB 供電，安全裝置搭載」. In the speed section, keep the knob illustration and relabel the 3 color-coded ranges in Traditional Chinese with exactly 3 categories: 「藍色區域（低速）」, 「黃色區域（中速）」, 「紅色區域（高速）」, and keep the knob labels as exactly 3 labels: 「低速」, 「關閉」, 「高速」. Add 1 orange callout box on the right side of the speed section reading: 「小巧設計，不佔空間，適合任何工作環境！」. In the bottom-left text block, include the product name in English as 「BOLTEX STIRRER Turbo」 within the Chinese paragraph. Make the page cleaner, brighter, and easier to read than the reference, with crisp print graphics, corrected perspective, and high-resolution catalog/manual styling.

promptLocalized.zh: 参考提供的参考图像，重制一份整洁的繁体中文本地化产品说明书。保持原始页面布局、产品照片、章节结构、橙色圆角标题以及整体手册构图不变，将所有日语正文替换为含义准确且格式一致的流利繁体中文。将主标题更新为页面顶部的加粗繁体中文标题。保留 4 个橙色章节栏及其位置，并保持相同的图片布局：顶部区域放置 2 张产品使用照片，第二部分放置 1 排油漆瓶照片，第三部分放置 1 张调速旋钮特写，左下角放置 2 张配件照片，右下角放置 1 张手持产品照片。在速度章节中，将 3 个颜色编码的速度标签翻译为繁体中文，并保持其蓝色、黄色和红色的视觉区分。将右侧的小型橙色标注替换为更精致的繁体中文促销徽章。使整个页面看起来更整洁、清晰且排版专业，呈现出精修后的产品手册效果，而非原始扫描件。

templates.title: Convex Mirror Neon Street Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 凸面镜霓虹街头自拍

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic nighttime street photo seen entirely through a large circular roadside convex traffic mirror, shot in a vertical 3:4 composition with a strong fisheye lens look and pronounced dome-mirror distortion. The black rim of the mirror is fully visible and the whole circular reflection is filled with the surrounding city street, with roads, buildings, utility poles, wires, scaffolding, and signs bending dramatically toward the edges. At the lower center of the mirror reflection, a young woman is taking a mirror selfie from about the waist up, standing directly in front of the mirror and holding a {argument name="phone model" default="white iPhone 15 Pro Max"} in front of her face so the phone hides most facial features. She has straight dark hair around shoulder length, wears a {argument name="jacket style" default="black leather jacket"}, and has {argument name="accessory detail" default="silver rings"} on her fingers. The city scene is a quiet intersection at night with wet asphalt reflecting vivid red light. There are exactly 3 clearly visible red traffic lights in the reflection, and exactly 1 moving gray sedan crossing from right to left with slight motion blur and red neon reflections along its body. On the left side of the mirror reflection, dense metal construction scaffolding wraps the building facade, lit by a tall vertical red neon sign with white Japanese characters. Along the bottom edge and lower left, there are exactly 2 red-and-yellow striped road barriers curving with the mirror distortion. Street lamps and storefront lights recede into the background on the right side, while overhead cables and poles arc across the upper half of the image. Lighting is dominated by {argument name="lighting color" default="intense red neon and traffic lights"}, creating cinematic red highlights on the street, the car, the barriers, and the subject's jacket. Realistic urban Tokyo-like night atmosphere, candid yet stylish, crisp detail with slight grime and reflections on the mirror surface, high contrast, immersive convex mirror perspective.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的夜间街头照片，完全呈现于路边大型圆形交通凸面镜的反射中。采用 3:4 竖构图，具有强烈的鱼眼镜头感和明显的球形镜面畸变。镜子的黑色边框清晰可见，整个圆形反射区域充满了周围的城市街道，道路、建筑物、电线杆、电线、脚手架和标志向边缘剧烈弯曲。在镜面反射的下方中心，一位年轻女性正在进行镜中自拍，画面取景约从腰部以上，她站在镜子正前方，手持 {argument name="phone model" default="白色 iPhone 15 Pro Max"} 挡在脸前，遮住了大部分面部特征。她留着齐肩直发，身穿 {argument name="jacket style" default="黑色皮夹克"}，手指上戴着 {argument name="accessory detail" default="银色戒指"}。城市场景是一个安静的夜间十字路口，湿润的沥青路面反射着鲜艳的红光。反射画面中清晰可见 3 个红灯，以及 1 辆正从右向左行驶的灰色轿车，车身带有轻微的动态模糊和红色霓虹灯反射。在镜面反射的左侧，密集的金属建筑脚手架包裹着建筑立面，被一个带有白色日文字符的高大垂直红色霓虹灯牌照亮。在底部边缘和左下角，有 2 个红黄相间的道路护栏随着镜面畸变而弯曲。路灯和店面灯光在右侧背景中延伸，头顶的电缆和电线杆在图像上半部分形成弧线。光线以 {argument name="lighting color" default="强烈的红色霓虹灯和交通灯"} 为主，在街道、汽车、护栏和人物夹克上营造出电影般的红色高光。逼真的东京风格夜间氛围，随性而时尚，细节清晰，镜面带有轻微的污垢和反射，对比度高，具有沉浸式的凸面镜视角。

templates.title: Monochrome Tennis Streetwear Moodboard

titleLocalized.zh: 单色网球街头风潮项目

templates.prompt: A clean editorial fashion concept board on a pale powder-blue background with a minimalist green monochrome palette, combining 4 full-body lifestyle photos of the same youth streetwear tennis-inspired character arranged in a horizontal layout. On the far left, a tall vertical photo panel partially overlaps the background, showing a standing model in an oversized light gray-blue Nike windbreaker, mint green shorts, white crew socks, and white sneakers, holding a white tennis racket at their side and a small mint towel or accessory in the other hand. The character’s head is replaced by a large white doodle coffee-cup face icon with a smiling expression and ruler-like tick marks across the top rim. To the right are 3 rounded-rectangle photo panels, evenly spaced. In panel 1, the model sits in a folding chair reading a magazine and holding a green mug, with a dark Nike duffel bag on the floor and a few scattered cups nearby; the white doodle cup head has 2 steam squiggles rising above it. In panel 2, the model stands beside a pyramid made of approximately 28 stacked green and white paper cups, one arm resting on the top; they wear a soft green Nike T-shirt and shorts set, white socks, and white sneakers; a small white typographic logo in the upper left reads like a cafe or service-court brand mark. The doodle cup head here is a simple smiling cup with a wide rim. In panel 3, the model leans casually with crossed legs, holding a green cup, next to a small wire cart containing green tennis balls and topped with a retro CRT television; they wear a white polo shirt, mint shorts, white socks, and white sneakers. The doodle cup head in this panel has horizontal stripe bands across the top. Keep all faces fully replaced by the graphic cup icons, with no real facial features visible. Use a soft studio setup, flat even lighting, subtle shadows, matte textures, and a highly consistent mint, sage, olive, and white color story. Add thin white horizontal guide lines across the blue background near the top and bottom. Place small gray editorial footer text at the bottom: on the left, “{argument name="left footer text" default="MJ REFERENCE"}”; on the right, “{argument name="right footer text" default="KREA // GPT 2"}”. Overall style: premium streetwear campaign moodboard, playful surreal branding, minimalist graphic design, polished commercial photography, high consistency across all 4 looks.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个干净的时尚编辑概念项目，背景为淡粉蓝色，采用极简的绿色单色调，横向排列 4 张同一位青年街头网球风角色的全身生活照。最左侧是一个高大的垂直照片面板，部分覆盖在背景上，展示了一位模特站立的姿态，身穿超大号浅灰蓝色 Nike 风衣、薄荷绿短裤、白色中筒袜和白色运动鞋，一手拿着白色网球拍，另一只手拿着一条薄荷绿小毛巾或配饰。角色的头部被一个巨大的白色涂鸦咖啡杯图标取代，杯上有微笑表情，顶部边缘带有类似尺子的刻度。右侧是 3 个间距均匀的圆角矩形照片面板。面板 1 中，模特坐在折叠椅上阅读杂志并拿着一个绿色马克杯，地板上放着一个深色 Nike 运动包，附近散落着几个杯子；白色涂鸦杯头上方升起 2 缕蒸汽。面板 2 中，模特站在由大约 28 个堆叠的绿白纸杯组成的金字塔旁，一只手臂靠在顶部；他们穿着柔软的绿色 Nike T 恤和短裤套装，搭配白色袜子和白色运动鞋；左上角有一个小的白色排版标志，看起来像咖啡馆或服务球场的品牌标志。此处的涂鸦杯头是一个带有宽边的简单微笑杯子。面板 3 中，模特交叉双腿随意倚靠，拿着一个绿色杯子，旁边是一个装有绿色网球的小金属推车，上面放着一台复古 CRT 电视；他们穿着白色 Polo 衫、薄荷绿短裤、白色袜子和白色运动鞋。此面板中的涂鸦杯头顶部有横条纹。确保所有面部完全被图形杯子图标取代，不显示任何真实面部特征。采用柔和的摄影棚布景、平坦均匀的灯光、细微的阴影、哑光质感，以及高度统一的薄荷绿、鼠尾草绿、橄榄绿和白色配色方案。在蓝色背景的顶部和底部添加细长的白色水平引导线。在底部添加灰色的小型编辑页脚文字：左侧为“{argument name="left footer text" default="MJ REFERENCE"}”；右侧为“{argument name="right footer text" default="KREA // GPT 2"}”。整体风格：高端街头服饰宣传项目、俏皮的超现实品牌设计、极简图形设计、精致的商业摄影，4 种造型保持高度一致。

templates.title: Juventus Cinematic Player Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 尤文图斯电影感球员海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic luxury sports poster for {argument name="player name" default="Bernardo Silva"} as a Juventus football star, in a dark cinematic black-and-gold editorial style. Vertical composition, high contrast, moody stadium atmosphere, premium poster design with layered photomontage. The background is a massive waving Juventus flag filling the upper half of the image, black fabric with broad white stripes and a large metallic gold Juventus "J" crest on the right side, topped by exactly 3 gold stars. In front of the flag, place an oversized close-up half-body portrait of the player wearing a classic Juventus home kit, facing slightly left, with wet textured hair, visible neck tattoos, dramatic rim lighting, and the face partially obscured by shadow for a mysterious heroic look. In the foreground, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with a soccer ball at his feet on a floodlit pitch, centered near the bottom, wearing the black-and-white striped Juventus jersey with white shorts, white socks, black boots, gold number 20 on the shorts, gold Adidas details, and the Jeep sponsor logo clearly visible. The stadium should wrap across the lower half with bright white floodlights, dark packed stands, light fog, and subtle smoke near the ground. Use elegant magazine-poster typography integrated into the composition: top left small gold text "JUVENTUS" and "FOUNDED 1897", with exactly 3 gold stars beneath; along the upper left a vertical list of 4 words in white caps: "CLASS", "VISION", "INTELLIGENCE", "WORK RATE"; beneath that a gold handwritten signature and the year split across two lines as "20" and "26"; center-left large serif player name text with the first name smaller and the last name huge, reading "BERNARDO" and "SILVA" in white; below that smaller gold text "JUVENTUS"; lower right exactly 3 gold stars above 3 stacked white words: "TRADITION", "PASSION", "GLORY"; bottom center exactly 3 gold stars above the phrase "THE OLD LADY" and smaller text "SINCE 1897". Color palette limited to black, white, charcoal, and metallic gold. Add subtle rain haze, fabric texture, vignette, glowing highlights on the crest and text, and a polished Champions League poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="player name" default="Bernardo Silva"} 创作一张极具戏剧性的奢华体育海报，将其塑造为尤文图斯足球明星，采用暗黑电影感黑金编辑风格。垂直构图，高对比度，营造忧郁的球场氛围，呈现具有分层照片蒙太奇效果的高级海报设计。背景为一面巨大的挥舞着的尤文图斯旗帜，占据图像上半部分，黑色布料配以宽大的白色条纹，右侧印有巨大的金属质感金色尤文图斯“J”字队徽，上方饰有 3 颗金色星星。在旗帜前方，放置一张球员的大尺寸半身特写肖像，身着经典尤文图斯主场球衣，面朝左侧，湿发质感，颈部纹身清晰可见，边缘光影效果强烈，面部部分被阴影遮盖，呈现出神秘的英雄感。前景处放置该球员的全身动态姿势，在灯火通明的球场上带球奔跑，位于底部中央，身着黑白条纹尤文图斯球衣、白色短裤、白色球袜、黑色球鞋，短裤上有金色数字 20，Adidas 细节为金色，Jeep 赞助商标志清晰可见。球场应覆盖下半部分，配以明亮的白色泛光灯、黑暗中坐满观众的看台、轻微的雾气以及地面上淡淡的烟雾。构图中融入优雅的杂志海报排版：左上角为小型金色文字“JUVENTUS”和“FOUNDED 1897”，下方饰有 3 颗金色星星；左上方垂直排列 4 个白色大写单词：“CLASS”、“VISION”、“INTELLIGENCE”、“WORK RATE”；其下方为金色手写签名，年份分为两行显示为“20”和“26”；中左侧为巨大的衬线字体球员姓名，名字较小，姓氏巨大，显示为白色的“BERNARDO”和“SILVA”；下方为较小的金色文字“JUVENTUS”；右下角为 3 颗金色星星，下方堆叠 3 个白色单词：“TRADITION”、“PASSION”、“GLORY”；底部中央为 3 颗金色星星，下方为短语“THE OLD LADY”及较小的文字“SINCE 1897”。配色方案仅限黑色、白色、炭灰色和金属金色。添加细微的雨雾、织物纹理、暗角、队徽和文字上的发光高光，打造精致的欧冠海报美学。

templates.title: Minimalist AI Fashion Comparison Board

titleLocalized.zh: 极简 AI 时尚对比项目

templates.prompt: A minimalist fashion moodboard on a pale sage green background, laid out as a wide horizontal comparison sheet with four portrait panels of young male models wearing oversized white sports T-shirts. Use a soft editorial studio look with cool periwinkle-blue backdrops inside the portrait frames, subtle film grain, muted contrast, and a highly consistent color palette of sage green, cyan trim, off-white, deep shadow, and blue-lavender. On the far left, include 1 large cropped reference portrait that is partially cut off by the canvas edge, showing the left side of a dark-skinned male model’s shaved or closely buzzed head, ear, jawline, neck, and shoulder in profile, wearing a white shirt with a bright aqua ribbed collar; place 2 overlapping semi-opaque rectangular blocks over the face area, creating a graphic censorship/collage effect. To the right, place 3 rounded-corner portrait cards in a row, evenly spaced, each featuring a different young male model from the chest up against the same blue studio background: card 1 shows a light- to medium-skinned man with short slicked-back dark hair, facing slightly left, wearing a white athletic shirt with aqua collar trim and a small Nike swoosh on the lower right chest; card 2 shows a light-skinned man with medium dark hair swept back, turned three-quarters left, wearing a white Nike shirt with a black swoosh centered on the chest; card 3 shows a dark-skinned man with a short fade haircut, turned three-quarters right, wearing a white Adidas shirt with a cyan Adidas logo centered on the chest and a small hoop or cross earring. Add 3 face-obscuring gradient rectangles, one over each smaller portrait face, in dark green fading to gray-green, aligned vertically like graphic overlays. Include 2 thin horizontal divider lines across the full composition, one near the top and one near the lower third, in a slightly lighter sage tone. At the bottom, add small uppercase monospaced editorial text: near the lower center-left write "MJ REFERENCE" and near the lower right write "KREA  //  GPT 2". The overall image should feel like a premium AI-fashion comparison board, graphic design presentation, or concept consistency sheet, with clean spacing, flat background, and polished art-direction.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个以浅鼠尾草绿为背景的极简时尚项目，采用宽幅水平对比排版，包含四个身穿超大款白色运动 T 恤的年轻男性模特肖像面板。采用柔和的编辑式摄影棚风格，肖像框内为冷长春花蓝背景，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感、柔和的对比度，以及鼠尾草绿、青色饰边、灰白色、深阴影和蓝薰衣草色组成的极具一致性的调色板。最左侧包含 1 张被画布边缘部分裁切的大幅参考肖像，展示了一位深肤色男性模特剃光或修剪极短的头部、耳朵、下颌线、颈部和肩部的侧影，身穿带有亮水蓝色罗纹领口的白色衬衫；在脸部区域放置 2 个半透明的重叠矩形块，营造出图形化的审查/拼贴效果。右侧并排放置 3 张圆角肖像卡片，间距均匀，每张卡片展示了不同的年轻男性模特，胸部以上出镜，背景均为相同的蓝色摄影棚背景：卡片 1 展示了一位浅至中等肤色的男性，留着短背头，微向左侧，身穿带有水蓝色领口饰边和右下胸部带有小 Nike Swoosh 标志的白色运动衫；卡片 2 展示了一位浅肤色男性，留着中长深色背头，向左侧转四分之三角度，身穿胸前带有黑色 Swoosh 标志的白色 Nike 衬衫；卡片 3 展示了一位深肤色男性，留着短渐变发型，向右侧转四分之三角度，身穿胸前带有青色 Adidas 标志的白色 Adidas 衬衫，佩戴小圆环或十字耳环。在每张较小的肖像脸部上方各添加 1 个遮挡脸部的渐变矩形，颜色由深绿色渐变为灰绿色，垂直对齐，如同图形叠加层。在整个构图中添加 2 条细水平分割线，一条靠近顶部，一条靠近下三分之一处，颜色为略浅的鼠尾草色。在底部添加小型大写等宽编辑文本：在左下方附近书写“MJ REFERENCE”，在右下方附近书写“KREA // GPT 2”。整体图像应呈现出高端 AI 时尚对比项目、平面设计演示或概念一致性表的感觉，具备整洁的间距、平整的背景和精致的艺术指导。
