On the far left, a partially cropped reference image of a vintage reel-to-reel tape deck and silver stereo receiver on a wooden shelf against a warm off-white wall; two large white reels with dark green centers, brushed metal knobs, a blue-lit display, and pale mint and silver hardware. To the right, 3 tall rounded-corner poster cards evenly spaced, all using the same cream paper tone, dark forest-green typography, mint-green product styling, and soft studio shadows. First poster: a spherical retro speaker/radio on a pedestal base, pale mint body with a circular front face, small display, and two side knobs, centered under a large bold uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text 1" default="SOUND, REIMAGINED."}. Second poster: a mint-green vintage oscilloscope-like device with a CRT screen displaying a waveform, silver knobs and switches, and a metal tilt stand, centered under a bold uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text 2" default="WAVEFORM"}. Third poster: a compact mint-green portable cassette recorder/boombox with handle, front cassette window, buttons, speaker grille, and silver knobs, centered under a bold uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text 3" default="ANALOG STILL HITS."}. Each poster includes tiny microtype, fake brand marks, and footer icons in a refined Swiss-modern advertising style. Use a restrained palette of dusty blue, cream, sage mint, forest green, silver, black, and warm wood. Add thin horizontal guide lines across the background and small footer text at the bottom reading {argument name="left footer text" default="MJ REFERENCE"} on the left and {argument name="right footer text" default="KREA  //  GPT 2"} on the right. Overall look: premium concept design board, consistent aesthetic translation from analog hi-fi inspiration into three polished product posters, soft lighting, high-end graphic design, minimal clutter, crisp typography, and subtle nostalgic realism.

templates.title: Night Car Portrait With Popcorn

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间车内吃爆米花人像

templates.prompt: A cinematic vertical smartphone photo of a glamorous young woman sitting in the front passenger seat of a car at night, shot from slightly above chest level in a tight mid-shot. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair pulled back loosely with soft strands near the ears, and is wearing a fitted ribbed brown zip-front top or dress with a deep neckline, partially unzipped, creating a sleek nightlife look. Her face is mostly out of frame or obscured, keeping the focus on pose, outfit, and mood rather than identity. She holds 1 large black tub of caramel popcorn in her lap with one hand, while her other hand is raised lightly near her chin in a casual, candid pose. The setting is the interior of a car with 1 visible beige passenger seat, 1 visible door panel with window controls, and a side window showing blurred colorful city lights outside, suggesting nighttime urban traffic. Use warm low-key lighting from the front-left, realistic skin texture, glossy highlights on the collarbone and fabric, shallow depth of field, bokeh streetlights, photorealistic detail, intimate composition, luxury nightlife atmosphere, and a moody editorial aesthetic. Outfit and palette should stay in coordinated brown and neutral tones, with the popcorn sharply detailed and slightly glossy from caramel coating. Render as realistic photography, high contrast, soft shadows, vertical 9:16 framing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感竖版手机摄影作品，画面为一位迷人的年轻女性在夜间坐在汽车副驾驶座位上，采用略高于胸部水平的紧凑中景拍摄。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} 的头发，松散地向后扎起，耳边留有几缕柔和的发丝；身穿一件修身的棕色罗纹拉链上衣或连衣裙，深领口设计，拉链半开，营造出时尚的夜生活造型。她的面部大部分处于画面之外或被遮挡，将焦点集中在姿势、服装和氛围上，而非个人身份。她的一只手放在膝盖上，拿着一个黑色的大桶焦糖爆米花，另一只手轻轻抬起靠近下巴，姿态随意自然。场景为汽车内部，可见 1 个米色副驾驶座椅、1 个带有车窗控制按钮的车门内饰板，侧窗外是模糊的彩色城市灯光，暗示着夜间的城市交通。使用来自左前方的暖色调低调照明，呈现真实的皮肤质感，锁骨和织物上有光泽感的高光，浅景深，街道灯光呈现虚化效果，细节写实，构图亲密，充满奢华的夜生活氛围和忧郁的编辑风格。服装和色调应保持协调的棕色和中性色，爆米花细节清晰，焦糖涂层略带光泽。渲染为写实摄影风格，高对比度，柔和阴影，9:16 竖版构图。

She wears 4 visible clothing items: a fitted floral corset top in {argument name="corset color" default="cream with dusty mauve embroidery"}, white shorts, white ribbed crew socks scrunched at the ankles, and thin corset shoulder straps. The car interior includes 5 clearly visible elements: the white passenger seat, the white driver seat edge in the foreground right, the side window, the panoramic glass roof, and the dark door panel trim. Outside the rain-speckled windows is a quiet suburban neighborhood with 4 visible environmental cues: wet street pavement, green lawns, leafy trees, and blurred houses under overcast daylight. Lighting is soft diffuse gray daylight coming through the side window and glass roof, with gentle ambient shadows, subtle HDR smartphone clarity, mild exterior highlight overexposure, realistic skin tones, crisp white leather reflections, and distinct raindrops on the roof glass. Keep the scene tasteful, fashion-editorial, and highly realistic, as if captured on an iPhone 14 Pro or Sony Alpha wide-angle photo inside a parked car on a rainy day.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张锁定 4:5 纵向构图的超写实车内抓拍照片，从右前方平视角度拍摄，使用 24mm 广角智能手机镜头。画面中，一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 中长发的年轻女性正慵懒地坐在现代豪华轿车的副驾驶座上。她的身体以紧凑舒适的姿势斜靠在座椅中，双膝紧贴胸前，在广角镜头下呈现出强烈的透视感；躯干略微向左倾斜，面部转向镜头。一只手臂弯曲在脑后，另一只手轻轻触碰紧身胸衣的上缘。她穿着 4 件可见的服饰：一件合身的碎花紧身胸衣，颜色为 {argument name="corset color" default="带有灰紫色刺绣的奶油色"}，搭配白色短裤、脚踝处堆叠的白色罗纹中筒袜，以及细肩带。她的表情放松且亲密，妆容自然，皮肤质感细腻。车内包含 5 个清晰可见的元素：白色副驾驶座椅、前景右侧的白色驾驶座边缘、侧窗、全景天窗以及深色的车门饰板。窗外雨点斑驳，是一个宁静的郊区社区，有 4 个可见的环境线索：潮湿的街道、绿色的草坪、茂密的树木以及阴天下的模糊房屋。光线为透过侧窗和玻璃车顶射入的柔和漫射灰光，带有温和的环境阴影、微妙的 HDR 智能手机清晰度、轻微的外部高光过曝、真实的肤色、清脆的白色皮革反光以及车顶玻璃上清晰的雨滴。保持画面高雅、具有时尚编辑感且高度写实，如同在雨天停放的汽车内使用 iPhone 14 Pro 或 Sony Alpha 广角镜头拍摄的效果。

The composition is a sunlit Mediterranean coastal cityscape viewed from a curving seaside road in the foreground, painted in a richly textured retro poster style with warm cream stone architecture, saturated turquoise-blue sea, and a bright azure sky with soft white clouds. On the left, a hillside of tightly packed historic limestone buildings rises above the waterfront, including colorful enclosed wooden balconies, a large domed church with a reddish terracotta roof, and a slender church spire. In the foreground on the road, place a classic mid-century white sedan seen from the rear three-quarter angle, driving along the curve, with a dark license plate reading {argument name="license plate text" default="MTA 1964"}. A low stone seawall runs along the right edge of the road beside the harbor. In the bay, include exactly 4 boats: 2 colorful Maltese luzzu fishing boats in the near and mid water, plus 2 smaller distant boats farther back. Add exactly 4 white seagulls gliding across the sky above the water. Frame the scene with lush flowering bougainvillea branches in vivid magenta-pink arching across the upper right and lower right corners, and leafy tree branches along the upper left edge; include a spiky agave plant in the lower left foreground. The distant shoreline across the bay should show a pale sunlit city stretching along the horizon. Use a nostalgic 1950s–1960s tourism poster aesthetic, painterly brushwork, crisp composition, romantic travel mood, and elegant typography with the main title in large cream serif capitals and the subtitle in smaller dark sans-serif capitals.

templates.title: Futuristic Tech Beauty Product Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 未来科技美妆产品海报

templates.prompt: Luxury futuristic cosmetic product advertisement poster on a deep midnight-blue background, centered composition, featuring a glowing white spray bottle standing upright on a three-tier transparent crystal pedestal with water droplets and glossy reflections. The bottle is tall, cylindrical, minimalist, and softly backlit with a radiant halo, with visible condensation beads across the surface and an exposed pump top. Behind it, a symmetrical luminous lotus made of exactly 10 translucent petals fans out like a digital aura, each petal shimmering with iridescent blue-violet highlights, delicate circuit-like filaments, and tiny sparkling light nodes, blending botanical elegance with data-network aesthetics. The pedestal looks like stacked glass or ice blocks, wet and reflective, sitting on a slick sparkling surface with scattered blue light particles. At the top, elegant serif typography in large glowing white letters reads {argument name="headline text" default="THE PURITY PROTOCOL"}, with a thin horizontal divider line and a small star-like flare at the center beneath it. Below that, smaller spaced sans-serif text reads {argument name="subheadline text" default="DATA STREAM PURIFIER // 75ML"}. On the bottle, the main brand name reads {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}, and the product name reads {argument name="product label" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, followed by smaller copy: "for risk-free connections" and "pour des connexions sans risque", and at the bottom "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier". Make the overall style ultra-polished, premium, surreal, tech-luxury beauty campaign, with cinematic glow, crisp legible text, high detail, cool blue-white palette, ethereal sparkles, and a sleek balance between skincare advertising and cyber-security metaphor.

promptLocalized.zh: 深邃午夜蓝背景下的奢华未来感化妆品广告海报，采用居中构图，展示了一款发光的白色喷雾瓶，直立在三层透明水晶底座上，伴有水滴和光泽反射。瓶身修长、圆柱形、极简主义，带有柔和的背光光晕，表面可见凝结的水珠，泵头清晰可见。瓶身背后，一朵由 10 片半透明花瓣组成的对称发光莲花像数字光环般展开，每片花瓣闪烁着虹彩蓝紫色的高光，带有精致的电路状细丝和微小的闪烁光点，将植物的优雅与数据网络美学融为一体。底座看起来像堆叠的玻璃或冰块，湿润且具有反射感，放置在散落着蓝色光粒的光滑闪烁表面上。顶部采用优雅的衬线字体，以醒目的白色发光大字显示 {argument name="headline text" default="THE PURITY PROTOCOL"}，下方有一条细水平分割线，中心处有一个类似星形的光斑。下方较小的无衬线间距文本显示 {argument name="subheadline text" default="DATA STREAM PURIFIER // 75ML"}。瓶身上，主品牌名称为 {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}，产品名称为 {argument name="product label" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}，随后是较小的文案：“for risk-free connections” 和 “pour des connexions sans risque”，底部标注 “75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier”。整体风格追求极致精致、高端、超现实、科技奢华美妆大片质感，具备电影级光效、清晰易读的文字、高细节度、冷蓝白色调、空灵的闪光，并在护肤品广告与网络安全隐喻之间达到完美的平衡。

templates.title: Futuristic Ice Skincare Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感冰感护肤海报

templates.prompt: Create a high-end futuristic skincare advertisement poster in icy blue and white tones, vertical 2:3 composition. The scene features a translucent glass female bust in left profile with a low bun hairstyle, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame. Inside the transparent head, neck, and torso is a surreal miniature landscape of blue cliffs, glowing water, and multiple waterfalls, like a frozen digital sanctuary contained within the body. Add tiny suspended bubbles, glossy reflections, misty atmosphere, and soft aurora-like light streaks drifting diagonally across the image. On the right side, place a clean white cylindrical skincare bottle standing upright on a jagged translucent ice pedestal. The bottle label should read {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"} and below it {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, with smaller technical cosmetic copy beneath in a minimal editorial layout. Set giant vertical glowing text along the far right edge reading {argument name="side headline" default="DEEP CORE PURITY"}. Add 4 small infographic-style callouts in a sleek tech-beauty design: a top-right droplet icon with the heading “MOISTURE LOCK” and two short lines of tiny supporting text, a mid-right shield icon with the heading “IP PROTECTION” and three short lines of tiny supporting text, a lower-left headline block reading “PURE CONNECTION PURE CONFIDENCE” with 2 short lines of body copy, and a far-left small label reading “DATA STREAM PURIFIER” with a bracket line pointing toward the glass figure. Include a centered solid pale blue rectangular overlay covering part of the face and upper torso, as a flat opaque block. Lighting is ethereal, glossy, and premium, with strong bloom, frosted highlights, soft backlight, and luxury sci-fi cosmetic campaign styling. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic 3D render, clean commercial poster design, minimal yet surreal, polished surfaces, cold luminous atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高端未来感护肤广告海报，采用冰蓝色与白色调，构图比例为 2:3 竖版。画面左侧三分之二处为一位半透明玻璃质感的女性半身像，侧面朝左，梳着低发髻。在透明的头部、颈部和躯干内部，是一个超现实的微缩景观，包含蓝色悬崖、发光的水流和多条瀑布，宛如一个封存在体内的冰冻数字圣域。添加细小的悬浮气泡、光亮的反射、朦胧的氛围，以及斜向穿过画面的柔和极光状光束。在右侧，放置一个干净的白色圆柱形护肤瓶，直立在锯齿状的半透明冰座上。瓶身标签应显示 {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}，下方为 {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}，并在下方以极简的杂志排版风格添加较小的技术性化妆品文案。在最右侧边缘设置巨大的垂直发光文字，内容为 {argument name="side headline" default="DEEP CORE PURITY"}。添加 4 个小型信息图表风格的标注，采用流畅的科技美妆设计：右上角为水滴图标，标题为“MOISTURE LOCK”，下方配有两行简短的辅助文字；中右侧为盾牌图标，标题为“IP PROTECTION”，下方配有三行简短的辅助文字；左下角为标题块，内容为“PURE CONNECTION PURE CONFIDENCE”，配有 2 行简短正文；最左侧有一个小标签，内容为“DATA STREAM PURIFIER”，并带有指向玻璃人像的括号线。在面部和上半身覆盖一个居中的浅蓝色实心矩形遮罩，作为平面的不透明色块。光影效果空灵、光亮且高级，具有强烈的辉光、磨砂高光、柔和的背光以及奢华的科幻美妆大片风格。超精细、照片级 3D 渲染，干净的商业海报设计，极简而超现实，表面光洁，营造出寒冷而明亮的氛围。

templates.title: Futuristic Data-Driven Skincare Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感数据驱动护肤品广告

templates.prompt: Create a futuristic luxury skincare advertisement poster in a clean editorial layout on a pale icy silver-blue background with subtle metallic texture. Place a single white cylindrical spray bottle in the lower right quadrant, standing upright and casting a long soft blue-gray shadow toward the bottom right. The bottle has a matte premium finish, a rounded shoulder, a white pump top, and minimal dark navy typography. On the bottle label, show the brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}" near the top, the product name "{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}" in larger text below, a small line reading "for risk-free connections" with a smaller French line beneath it, and tiny bottom text reading "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier". Emerging from behind and above the bottle, create one dramatic translucent water-like abstract form shaped like a flowing spirit, cresting wave, or liquid ghost, made of glassy blue fluid with iridescent highlights, delicate ribbons, and splashing tendrils sweeping upward and to the right. The liquid sculpture should feel elegant, intelligent, and ethereal, suggesting data streams and hydration. On the left half of the poster, place minimalist navy editorial text with generous spacing: a small brand line reading "{argument name="headline brand" default="SECURE-IP"}" above a large stacked headline reading "{argument name="headline text" default="THE FUTURE OF DATA-DRIVEN SKINCARE"}". Below that, add one circular outlined arrow icon followed by the words "READ MORE". Near the lower left, include a small caption reading "SAFE CONNECTION" above one thin horizontal progress line ending with "100%". Use a high-end cosmetic campaign aesthetic, ultra-clean composition, lots of negative space, cool monochrome palette, soft diffused lighting, crisp reflections, refined typography, and a polished sci-fi beauty branding mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张未来感奢华护肤品广告海报，采用简洁的编辑排版，背景为带有细腻金属质感的淡冰银蓝色。在右下象限放置一个直立的白色圆柱形喷雾瓶，向右下方投射出长而柔和的蓝灰色阴影。瓶身采用哑光高级质感，圆肩设计，配有白色泵头，并印有极简的深海军蓝字体。在瓶身标签上，顶部显示品牌名称 "{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}"，下方用较大字体显示产品名称 "{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}"，紧接着是一行小字 "for risk-free connections"，下方附有一行更小的法语，底部印有微小的文字 "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier"。在瓶身背后及上方，创作一个极具戏剧性的半透明水状抽象形态，形状如流动的精灵、涌动的波浪或液态幽灵，由带有虹彩高光、精致丝带和向上及向右扫过的飞溅卷须的玻璃质感蓝色流体构成。该液体雕塑应呈现出优雅、智能且空灵的感觉，暗示数据流与补水效果。在海报左半部分，放置极简的海军蓝编辑文本，并留有充裕的间距：顶部是一行小字品牌名 "{argument name="headline brand" default="SECURE-IP"}"，下方是醒目的大号堆叠标题 "{argument name="headline text" default="THE FUTURE OF DATA-DRIVEN SKINCARE"}"。在标题下方，添加一个圆形轮廓箭头图标，后接 "READ MORE" 字样。在左下角附近，包含一行小标题 "SAFE CONNECTION"，上方是一条细长的水平进度线，末端显示 "100%"。采用高端化妆品广告美学，构图极其简洁，保留大量留白，使用冷色调单色配色，柔和的漫射光，清晰的反射效果，精致的排版，以及考究的科幻美妆品牌氛围。

templates.title: Futuristic Secure-IP Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感 SECURE-IP 广告海报

templates.prompt: A futuristic luxury skincare-style advertising poster in a pale icy blue monochrome palette, designed like a high-end tech-beauty campaign. The composition is vertical and airy with soft glowing light, misty gradients, translucent particle effects, and a clean editorial layout. On the left side, a young woman in a flowing white sleeveless dress is shown from the shoulders up in side profile, head tilted back as if inhaling fresh air, with dark windswept hair streaming outward. Her face is obscured by a plain square censor block. Fine luminous network lines and sparkling dots flow from her neck and chest toward the right, suggesting digital cleansing and connectivity. On the right side, a tall matte-white spray bottle floats upright, labeled "SECURE-IP" and "IP ADDRESS CLEANSER," with smaller product copy beneath and a subtle premium cosmetic finish. Behind and around the bottle, branching translucent stems rise like biotech coral or neural fibers, each ending in clear glowing bubbles; several bubbles contain faint tech text such as "DATA PACKET," while nearby micro labels identify features including "OXYGEN FLOW," "DATA PACKETS," "SECURE ROUTING," "RISK FILTER," "PRIVATE CLEAN," and "CONNECTION PURE." In the upper left, small brand text reads "IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY." A large bold uppercase headline dominates the left-center: "{argument name="headline text" default="BREATHE SECURE. GLOW FREE."}" with a smaller subheading below reading "for risk-free connections." Along the bottom is a row of 4 minimalist icon-and-text feature blocks, evenly spaced: 1) shield icon with the heading "CLEANSE YOUR IP" and short supporting copy, 2) wifi icon with the heading "SECURE CONNECTIONS" and short supporting copy, 3) leaf icon with the heading "BREATHE FREELY" and short supporting copy, 4) share/network icon with the heading "GLOW CONFIDENTLY" and short supporting copy. At the lower right, add a paragraph of marketing copy about constant connection and digital cleansing, ending with the tagline "BREATHE. CONNECT. GLOW." At the lower left, include a circular IP logo and the brand line "SECURE-IP" with a small subtitle like "OXYGEN FOR YOUR DIGITAL LIFE." Overall style: surreal product advertising, premium editorial poster, clean sans-serif typography, soft bloom, translucent glass spheres, elegant sci-fi wellness branding, ultra-detailed, polished, magazine-quality layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款采用冰蓝色单色调的未来感奢华护肤风格广告海报，设计灵感源自高端科技美妆营销。构图垂直且通透，配以柔和的微光、朦胧的渐变、半透明的粒子效果以及简洁的编辑排版。左侧展示了一位身着白色无袖连衣裙的年轻女性，侧面半身像，她头部后仰，仿佛在呼吸新鲜空气，深色的长发随风飘动。她的面部被一个简洁的方形遮挡块覆盖。精细的发光网格线条和闪烁的光点从她的颈部和胸部向右侧流动，暗示着数字净化与连接。右侧是一个直立悬浮的高挑哑光白色喷雾瓶，瓶身标注有“SECURE-IP”和“IP ADDRESS CLEANSER”，下方配有较小的产品文案，呈现出高级化妆品的质感。瓶身周围环绕着分叉的半透明茎秆，如同生物科技珊瑚或神经纤维，末端连接着清晰的发光气泡；部分气泡中隐约可见“DATA PACKET”等科技文字，附近的微型标签标注了包括“OXYGEN FLOW”、“DATA PACKETS”、“SECURE ROUTING”、“RISK FILTER”、“PRIVATE CLEAN”和“CONNECTION PURE”在内的功能特性。左上方印有小型品牌文字“IP 9OXYGEN TECHNOLOGY”。左中部是一个醒目的大号加粗大写标题：“{argument name="headline text" default="BREATHE SECURE. GLOW FREE."}”，下方配有较小的副标题“for risk-free connections”。底部排列着 4 个间距均匀的极简图标加文字功能块：1) 盾牌图标，标题为“CLEANSE YOUR IP”及简短说明；2) Wi-Fi 图标，标题为“SECURE CONNECTIONS”及简短说明；3) 叶片图标，标题为“BREATHE FREELY”及简短说明；4) 分享/网络图标，标题为“GLOW CONFIDENTLY”及简短说明。右下角添加一段关于持续连接与数字净化的营销文案，结尾处使用口号“BREATHE. CONNECT. GLOW.”。左下角包含一个圆形 IP 标志以及品牌行“SECURE-IP”，并配有小标题“OXYGEN FOR YOUR DIGITAL LIFE”。整体风格：超现实产品广告、高端编辑海报、简洁无衬线字体、柔和光晕、半透明玻璃球体、优雅科幻健康品牌感、超高细节、精致、杂志级排版。

templates.title: Magical Chibi Cafe Mascot at Sunrise

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻咖啡馆中的彩虹发色 Q 版少女

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, whimsical anime cafe illustration in a vertical composition, featuring a chibi girl mascot standing at the center of a cozy fantasy coffee shop during golden sunrise. She has extremely long, voluminous hair with a vivid rainbow gradient that begins as {argument name="hair color" default="deep blue at the crown"} and flows through cyan, green, yellow, orange, pink, and purple at the tips, with glossy highlights and thick bangs framing large sparkling blue eyes. She wears oversized silver headphones with green four-leaf clover emblems on both earcups, a red leather jacket, a white T-shirt with a yellow smiley face, fitted blue jeans, and white high-top sneakers with red accents. She smiles warmly and holds a white coffee mug decorated with a green clover symbol. Add a speech bubble near her head containing Japanese text: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="おはよう。今日も、ひとくち目の幸せから。"}. The cafe interior is richly decorated with dark polished wood, hanging banners, shelves filled with glass bottles and jars, trailing green plants, glowing crystal ornaments, and warm amber lighting. On the left upper area, hang a blackboard menu sign labeled {argument name="cafe name" default="AriteAL Cafe Menu"} with Japanese handwritten menu items and small coffee doodles. In the right background, place tall arched windows showing a dreamy pastel sunrise sky and storybook castle-like towers outside. Include exactly 2 mascot creatures: 1 small blue penguin barista on the left beside stacked clover mugs, and 1 small black cat-like creature with tiny bat wings and a red bow tie near a chalkboard sign on the lower right. In the foreground on a round table, show exactly 4 featured food and drink items: 1 thick slice of toast topped with a green clover garnish, 1 cup of latte art coffee in a clover cup, 1 glass jar of honey, and 1 tall rainbow parfait layered with colorful jelly, whipped cream, berries, strawberry slices, and crystal-like candy shards. Also place a teapot and additional clover-pattern cups on side tables in the midground. Add a small standing chalkboard sign on the lower right with Japanese welcome text and the cafe name. The whole image should feel magical, cheerful, polished, and richly rendered, with soft sparkles, warm morning light, saturated colors, intricate decorative details, and premium gpt-image-2 anime illustration quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节极其丰富、充满奇幻色彩的竖构图动漫咖啡馆插画，描绘了一位 Q 版少女站在清晨温馨的奇幻咖啡馆中央。她拥有极长且蓬松的头发，呈现出鲜艳的彩虹渐变色，从顶部的深蓝色过渡到发梢的青色、绿色、黄色、橙色、粉色和紫色；她有着闪烁的大眼睛，嘴角带着开心的笑容。她佩戴着超大号银色耳机，耳罩上有绿色四叶草标志，身穿红色皮夹克、印有黄色笑脸的白色 T 恤、修身蓝色牛仔裤，以及带有红色鞋带的厚底白色高帮运动鞋。她一手拿着印有绿色四叶草的白色马克杯，姿态轻松友好。她周围是温暖、充满魔法的咖啡馆内部，由抛光的深色木材打造，摆满了悬挂植物、装满瓶瓶罐罐的架子、发光的晶体、茶壶、马克杯，金色的晨光透过高大的拱形窗户洒入室内。窗外是梦幻般的欧式奇幻小镇，在柔和的晨曦天空下矗立着塔楼和屋顶。画面中包含 2 个小型吉祥物：左侧是一个穿着小马甲和领结、正在端着四叶草马克杯的圆滚滚蓝色企鹅咖啡师；右下方是一个有着红眼睛、小翅膀和红色领结的黑色蝙蝠猫生物。画面中包含 3 个清晰可见的菜单或项目：左上方悬挂着一块写有“AriteAL Cafe Menu”及下方日语条目的大型黑板；少女右上方有一个写着日语“おはよう。今日も、ひとくち目の幸せから。”的对话气泡；右下方有一块写有日语 AriteAL Cafe 字样的小型黑色欢迎项目。前景的圆桌上摆放着 4 样特色餐饮：一个盘子里放着一片点缀着绿色四叶草的厚吐司、一杯带有拉花的四叶草马克杯拿铁、一杯分层装有彩色果冻或水果、鲜奶油、草莓、浆果和水晶装饰的高脚彩虹芭菲，以及一个小玻璃蜂蜜或糖浆罐。场景中随处可见四叶草图案，装饰在杯子、项目和陈设上。采用高饱和度色彩、光泽高光、复杂的线条、柔和的魔法闪光、黄金时刻的轮廓光，营造出迷人的奇幻咖啡馆氛围，呈现出精致的高端动漫插画品质。

templates.title: Constructivist GPT Image 2.0 Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Constructivist GPT Image 2.0 海报

templates.prompt: A vintage political-propaganda-style poster collage on aged beige paper with a worn, slightly stained texture and torn-paper edges throughout. The composition is a bold vertical poster with a strong constructivist and Soviet-inspired graphic design, using only black, red, blue, yellow, and off-white. At the very top, centered in bold black sans-serif text, place the headline {argument name="headline text" default="Image generation with a point of view"}. In the center, reserve a large vertical rectangular area as the dominant focal block, slightly taller than wide, filled with a plain muted beige-to-taupe gradient like a blank poster insert. Around it, build a torn-paper photomontage from 4 visible collage zones: on the left, a red paper field with a black-and-white cutout of a person in a dark coat seen from behind or in profile, next to fragments of French poster text; at the top behind the central rectangle, a partial black-and-white face or head fragment peeking out; on the right, a blue paper field with a black-and-white Paris-like street scene including 1 tall ornate lamppost, old buildings, 1 car, and 1 walking man; at the bottom center, a yellow torn-paper field with a cropped black-and-white figure holding a newspaper, wearing a striped shirt. Add a vertical strip of black rectangular blocks near the upper right edge of the central rectangle, like cut graphic bars. At the bottom, place the main title in huge heavy condensed typography: {argument name="brand text" default="GPT Image"}, with "GPT" in black and "Image" in bright red. Beneath and to the right, add an enormous {argument name="version text" default="2.0"} in vivid blue. Below the left title area, add a rough horizontal black brushstroke underline. Centered near the bottom, in smaller black text, write {argument name="footer text" default="Coming soon"}. The overall look should feel like mid-20th-century avant-garde poster art, rough torn collage, distressed print, high contrast halftone photography, imperfect paper registration, and bold editorial typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古政治宣传风格的海报拼贴画，背景为陈旧的米色纸张，带有磨损、轻微污渍的质感，边缘呈现撕纸效果。整体构图为一张强烈的垂直海报，具有鲜明的构成主义和苏联风格设计，仅使用黑色、红色、蓝色、黄色和灰白色。在最上方，居中放置粗体黑色无衬线文本标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Image generation with a point of view"}。在中心位置，预留一个大的垂直矩形区域作为主要视觉焦点，长宽比略高，填充平淡的柔和米色至灰褐色渐变，如同空白的海报插页。围绕该区域，构建一个由 4 个可见拼贴区域组成的撕纸照片蒙太奇：左侧为红色纸面，配有身穿深色外套的人物背影或侧影的黑白剪纸，旁边是法语海报文本碎片；中央矩形后方顶部，露出部分黑白人脸或头部碎片；右侧为蓝色纸面，配有黑白巴黎街景，包括 1 根高大的装饰性路灯、古老建筑、1 辆汽车和 1 名行人；底部中央为黄色撕纸区域，配有手持报纸、身穿条纹衬衫的人物黑白剪影。在中央矩形右上边缘附近添加一条垂直的黑色矩形块条，如同剪切的图形条。在底部，放置巨大的粗体压缩字体主标题 {argument name="brand text" default="GPT Image"}，其中“GPT”为黑色，“Image”为亮红色。在下方右侧，添加一个巨大的蓝色 {argument name="version text" default="2.0"}。在左侧标题区域下方，添加一道粗糙的水平黑色笔触下划线。在底部附近居中位置，用较小的黑色文本书写 {argument name="footer text" default="Coming soon"}。整体外观应呈现 20 世纪中叶前卫海报艺术的质感，包括粗糙的撕纸拼贴、磨损的印刷效果、高对比度半色调摄影、不完美的纸张套印以及大胆的编辑排版。

templates.title: Dragon Knight and Crimson Dragon

titleLocalized.zh: 龙骑士与赤龙

templates.prompt: A cinematic high-fantasy illustration of a gigantic crimson dragon and a regal female dragon knight standing together on a rocky mountain ridge under a bright pale-blue daytime sky. The dragon dominates the frame, coiled behind and around the warrior, with 2 long sweeping golden-brown horns, a dense windswept mane of fiery red and copper hair, layered red scales with metallic sheen, a long snarling snout, sharp exposed teeth, 2 thin whiskers curling outward from the muzzle, and a fierce intelligent eye staring toward the viewer. Its back is lined with a row of sharp dorsal spines, and its massive body curves across the entire background, emphasizing scale and power. In front of the dragon stands {argument name="character name" default="a dragon knight queen"}, a tall armored woman in ornate red, black, and gold battle attire, facing forward in a heroic stance. She has {argument name="hair color" default="red"} hair styled long and flowing, partially tied up, and wears elaborate engraved plate armor with decorated pauldrons, gauntlets, a fitted breastplate, and a long layered gown-like armored skirt with intricate gold filigree. A rich crimson cape drapes behind her and catches the wind. She holds 1 unsheathed sword lowered at her side, while a second blade or dagger is visible at her waist, giving the composition exactly 2 visible weapons. The palette is dominated by scarlet, burgundy, copper, and antique gold, with dramatic sunlight, detailed textures, ultra-fine scales, polished metal, and flowing fabric. Composition is epic and centered, low-angle, full-body warrior in the foreground with the dragon’s head filling the left side and its coiled body arcing across the upper and right background. Style: ultra-detailed fantasy concept art, majestic, heroic, painterly realism, sharp focus, high contrast, volumetric light, premium game key art quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影级的高奇幻插画，描绘了一头巨大的赤龙与一位威严的女性龙骑士，站在明亮淡蓝色的白昼天空下，位于岩石嶙峋的山脊之上。巨龙占据了画面主体，盘绕在战士身后，长着 2 只修长且向后延伸的棕金色龙角，一头被风吹拂的火红与铜色鬃毛，层叠的红色鳞片闪烁着金属光泽，长长的吻部露出锋利的牙齿，吻部两侧伸出 2 根向外卷曲的细长龙须，一双凶猛而智慧的眼睛凝视着观众。它的背部排列着一排锋利的背棘，巨大的身躯横跨整个背景，突显出其庞大的体型与力量。在巨龙前方站着 {argument name="character name" default="一位龙骑士女王"}，她是一位高挑的装甲女性，身着华丽的红、黑、金三色战甲，以英勇的姿态面向前方。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="红色"} 的长发，发型飘逸且部分束起，身穿精美的雕花板甲，配有装饰性的肩甲、护手、贴合的胸甲以及带有复杂金丝镶边的长款层叠式铠甲裙。一件深红色的斗篷在她身后随风飘动。她手持 1 把出鞘的剑垂在身侧，腰间可见第 2 把刀或匕首，使构图中恰好有 2 件可见武器。色调以猩红、酒红、铜色和古金色为主，伴有戏剧性的阳光、细腻的纹理、超精细的鳞片、抛光的金属以及飘逸的织物。构图宏大且居中，采用低角度拍摄，战士全身位于前景，巨龙头部占据左侧，盘绕的身躯在上方和右侧背景中形成弧线。风格：超细节奇幻概念艺术、宏伟、英勇、写实绘画风、焦点清晰、高对比度、体积光、顶级游戏主视觉质量。

templates.title: OpenAI Merch Poster Grid

titleLocalized.zh: OpenAI 周边海报网格

templates.prompt: A clean, minimalist promotional poster on an off-white background in a modern tech-brand style. At the top left, a very large bold sans-serif headline in deep cobalt blue reads {argument name="headline text" default="Thinking Mode Searches"} split across two lines. Beneath it, a smaller gray explanatory sentence says that with thinking mode, the model can automatically browse the internet and find relevant contents for reference. At the top right, place a small blue OpenAI knot logo. Below the intro text, add a thin horizontal blue divider line ending with a tiny sparkle icon on the right. Under that, include a prompt line in small text with the word “Prompt:” in blue followed by the sentence {argument name="prompt text" default="Make a poster about OpenAI merch available on the official website right now."}. The main body is a centered 3-by-2 product grid with 8 total merchandise items shown as clean catalog cutouts with soft shadows inside rounded pale cards. Top row has 3 larger products: 1) a white long-sleeve striped rugby-style jersey with black collar and cuffs, small blue patches, and blue chest text “Research & Deployment Co.”, labeled “10 Year Jersey”; 2) a dark brown pullover hoodie with front pocket, small centered chest text “Research Deployment Co.” and sleeve print, labeled “Diagram Hoodie”; 3) a black T-shirt viewed from the back with a metallic knot graphic and pale pink text “Research & Deployment Co.”, labeled “Chrome Blossom Tee”. Bottom row has 5 smaller products: 4) a blue folding chair keychain shaped like a chair, labeled “Blue Chair Keychain”; 5) a black baseball cap with white flame graphics and “GPT-5” on the front, labeled “GPT-5 Flame Cap”; 6) a white notebook with a bold blue lower band and minimal OpenAI branding, labeled “OpenAI Notebook”; 7) a glossy black mug with “OpenAI” in white, labeled “OpenAI Office Mug”; 8) a dark green baseball cap with small white text “Thinking deeply”, labeled “Thinking Deeply Cap”. Keep all item labels centered below each product in small blue sans-serif text. Along the bottom footer, place “Research & Deployment Co.” on the left, the OpenAI knot logo plus wordmark centered, and “Designed with care.” on the right. Use a balanced editorial layout, lots of whitespace, premium product-ad poster aesthetics, subtle shadows, crisp studio lighting, and a restrained palette of off-white, blue, black, brown, and green.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁、极简主义的宣传海报，采用灰白色背景，呈现现代科技品牌风格。左上角是一个非常大的粗体无衬线标题，颜色为深钴蓝色，文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="Thinking Mode Searches"}，分为两行显示。下方是一句较小的灰色解释性文字，说明通过思考模式，模型可以自动浏览互联网并查找相关内容以供参考。右上角放置一个蓝色的小型 OpenAI 结状徽标。在介绍文字下方，添加一条细长的蓝色水平分隔线，右端带有一个微小的闪光图标。在此下方，包含一行小字体的提示词，蓝色文字“Prompt:”后跟句子 {argument name="prompt text" default="Make a poster about OpenAI merch available on the official website right now."}。主体部分是一个居中的 3x2 产品网格，共展示 8 件商品，以简洁的目录剪裁图形式呈现，带有柔和阴影，置于圆角的浅色卡片内。顶行有 3 件较大的产品：1) 一件白色长袖条纹橄榄球风格运动衫，配有黑色领口和袖口，带有蓝色小补丁和蓝色胸前文字“Research & Deployment Co.”，标注为“10 Year Jersey”；2) 一件深棕色套头连帽衫，带有前袋，胸前有小型居中文字“Research Deployment Co.”及袖口印花，标注为“Diagram Hoodie”；3) 一件黑色 T 恤（背部视角），带有金属质感结状图形和淡粉色文字“Research & Deployment Co.”，标注为“Chrome Blossom Tee”。底行有 5 件较小的产品：4) 一个蓝色折叠椅形状的钥匙扣，标注为“Blue Chair Keychain”；5) 一顶黑色棒球帽，正面带有白色火焰图形和“GPT-5”字样，标注为“GPT-5 Flame Cap”；6) 一个白色笔记本，带有醒目的蓝色底带和极简的 OpenAI 品牌标识，标注为“OpenAI Notebook”；7) 一个亮黑色马克杯，印有白色“OpenAI”字样，标注为“OpenAI Office Mug”；8) 一顶深绿色棒球帽，带有小型白色文字“Thinking deeply”，标注为“Thinking Deeply Cap”。所有商品标签均需居中置于产品下方，使用蓝色小号无衬线字体。在底部页脚，左侧放置“Research & Deployment Co.”，中间放置 OpenAI 结状徽标及文字标识，右侧放置“Designed with care.”。采用平衡的编辑布局，保留大量留白，呈现高级产品广告海报美学，运用微妙的阴影、清晰的摄影棚灯光，以及灰白、蓝、黑、棕和绿色的克制配色方案。

templates.title: Vintage Miami Art Date Comic Page

titleLocalized.zh: 复古迈阿密艺术约会漫画页

templates.prompt: A vintage American comic-book page in a faded 1950s romance-adventure style, printed on slightly yellowed paper with visible halftone texture, inked panel borders, and soft weathered colors. The page contains exactly 5 panels arranged in a classic comic layout: 1 wide top panel, 2 middle panels side by side, and 2 bottom panels side by side. In the top panel, show a sunny coastal boulevard in {argument name="city" default="Miami"}, with turquoise water on the left, a sailboat offshore, pastel Art Deco buildings in the distance, tall palm trees, and a pink classic convertible driving along the waterfront. A stylish couple sits in the car, and large dramatic comic title lettering reads “ART IN MIAMI!” with a small caption box at the top saying “MIAMI, SATURDAY AFTERNOON…”. Add two speech balloons: “READY TO SEE SOME ART?” and “ALWAYS!”. In the second panel, an interior car view from behind the couple as they drive down Ocean Drive, showing colorful pastel buildings and palms ahead; the man has dark hair and a blue shirt, the woman wears sunglasses, a pink dress, and a lavender headscarf. Include a caption box reading “WE DROVE DOWN OCEAN DRIVE…” and speech balloons saying “LOOK AT THOSE COLORS…” and “MIAMI FEELS LIKE A PAINTING!”. In the third panel, show the couple approaching the entrance of a modern museum with the visible wall text “MIAMI ART MUSEUM”, glass doors, and people inside; add a caption box reading “THE EXHIBIT WAS AT A MODERN MUSEUM…” and a speech balloon saying “LET’S GO!”. In the fourth panel, place the couple inside a gallery viewing large abstract paintings in bright pastel blocks and shapes, with a small sculpture on a pedestal nearby; add a caption box reading “INSIDE, THE ART SURROUNDED US.” and speech balloons saying “I LOVE HOW BRIGHT AND BOLD IT IS.” and “IT FEELS LIKE MIAMI… VIBRANT AND FREE!”. In the fifth panel, show the couple outside again by the water with the skyline, palm trees, and a sailboat in the background, standing close together in the sun; add a caption box reading “WE STEPPED OUT INTO THE SUN…” and a small closing narration box at the bottom right saying “A BEAUTIFUL DAY.” Include speech balloons saying “THAT WAS PERFECT.” and “ART, SUN, AND MIAMI… CAN’T BEAT IT!”. Use hand-lettered uppercase comic text, black outlines, slightly imperfect vintage printing registration, muted pinks, aquas, sandy beige, and seafoam green, with a nostalgic warm romantic mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅 1950 年代褪色浪漫冒险风格的复古美式漫画页，印在略微泛黄的纸张上，具有明显的网点纹理、墨水勾勒的边框以及柔和的陈旧色彩。页面包含 5 个格子，采用经典的漫画布局：顶部 1 个宽格，中间 2 个并排格子，底部 2 个并排格子。在顶部格子中，展示 {argument name="city" default="迈阿密"} 阳光明媚的沿海大道，左侧是绿松石色的海水，近海处有帆船，远处是柔和的装饰艺术风格建筑，高大的棕榈树，以及一辆沿着海滨行驶的粉色经典敞篷车。一对时尚的情侣坐在车里，上方有醒目的大号漫画标题文字“ART IN MIAMI!”，顶部有一个小标题框写着“MIAMI, SATURDAY AFTERNOON…”。添加两个对话气泡：“READY TO SEE SOME ART?”和“ALWAYS!”。在第二个格子中，展示从车后拍摄的视角，情侣正沿着海洋大道行驶，前方可见色彩鲜艳的建筑和棕榈树；男人留着深色头发，穿着蓝色衬衫，女人戴着太阳镜，穿着粉色连衣裙，系着淡紫色头巾。包含一个标题框写着“WE DROVE DOWN OCEAN DRIVE…”，以及对话气泡“LOOK AT THOSE COLORS…”和“MIAMI FEELS LIKE A PAINTING!”。在第三个格子中，展示情侣走向一家现代博物馆的入口，墙上可见“MIAMI ART MUSEUM”字样，有玻璃门和室内的人群；添加一个标题框写着“THE EXHIBIT WAS AT A MODERN MUSEUM…”和一个对话气泡“LET’S GO!”。在第四个格子中，展示情侣在画廊内欣赏大型抽象画，画作由明亮的柔和色块和形状组成，附近有一个底座上的小雕塑；添加一个标题框写着“INSIDE, THE ART SURROUNDED US.”以及对话气泡“I LOVE HOW BRIGHT AND BOLD IT IS.”和“IT FEELS LIKE MIAMI… VIBRANT AND FREE!”。在第五个格子中，展示情侣再次来到水边，背景是天际线、棕榈树和帆船，他们在阳光下紧紧依偎；添加一个标题框写着“WE STEPPED OUT INTO THE SUN…”以及右下角一个小型的结尾叙述框写着“A BEAUTIFUL DAY.”。包含对话气泡“THAT WAS PERFECT.”和“ART, SUN, AND MIAMI… CAN’T BEAT IT!”。使用手写大写漫画字体、黑色轮廓、略有偏差的复古印刷套色，色调采用柔和的粉色、水蓝色、沙米色和海泡绿，营造出怀旧而浪漫的氛围。

templates.title: 2026 Nine Palaces Flying Star Chart

titleLocalized.zh: 2026 年九宫飞星图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a clean, symmetrical Chinese feng shui infographic poster in a traditional almanac style on a warm light beige background. The main title at the top is large dark red Chinese calligraphy text reading {argument name="headline text" default="2026年九宫飞星图"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath in black reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="（丙午年）"}. Add a decorative compass rose in the upper left corner labeled with the four cardinal directions in Chinese: 南 at top, 北 at bottom, 东 at left, 西 at right. Center the composition around a 3x3 grid of 9 bordered square panels with thin ornamental Chinese-style corners, evenly spaced and perfectly aligned. Each square contains a large colored number, a Chinese star name, one line beginning with 吉星 or 凶星, and an illustrative symbolic object. Top row has 3 panels: top-left labeled 东南 with a purple-framed panel for number 9 and text 九紫右弼星, plus 吉星: 喜庆、姻缘、贵人, illustrated with purple balloons, a gift box, and a small firework burst; top-center labeled 正南 with an orange-framed panel for number 5 and text 五黄廉贞星, plus 凶星: 灾祸、意外、疾病, illustrated with a gold gourd and ancient Chinese coins tied with a red tassel; top-right labeled 西南 with a gold-framed panel for number 7 and text 七赤破军星, plus 凶星: 破财、口舌、盗贼, illustrated with a brass bell and a silver sword. Middle row has 3 panels: middle-left aligned with 正东 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 8 and text 八白左辅星, plus 吉星: 财运、置业、积蓄, illustrated with a bonsai-like money tree and gold ingots; middle-center labeled 中宫 in a blue capsule tag overlapping the top edge of the center square, a blue-framed panel for number 1 and text 一白贪狼星, plus 吉星: 人缘、感情、智慧, illustrated with a crystal ball on a wooden stand; middle-right aligned with 正西 in large vertical side text, a green-framed panel for number 3 and text 三碧禄存星, plus 凶星: 是非、口舌、争执, illustrated with bamboo and a small stacked rock fountain. Bottom row has 3 panels: bottom-left labeled 东北 with a green-framed panel for number 4 and text 四绿文曲星, plus 吉星: 学业、文昌、考试, illustrated with an open book, brush pen, and ink stone with bamboo leaves behind; bottom-center labeled 正北 with a gold-framed panel for number 6 and text 六白武曲星, plus 吉星: 权力、贵人、偏财, illustrated with a golden guardian lion statue on a pedestal holding a ball; bottom-right labeled 西北 with a gray-framed panel for number 2 and text 二黑巨门星, plus 凶星: 病痛、伤害、阻滞, illustrated with a stone pagoda and a small incense burner. Use exactly 6 outer direction labels around the grid: 东南, 正南, 西南 above the top row, and 东北, 正北, 西北 below the bottom row, each inside rounded capsules matching the panel colors. Add exactly 2 large vertical side direction labels outside the grid: 正东 on the left side and 正西 on the right side. At the bottom center, add a pill-shaped legend with 2 segments: a red segment reading 吉星: 1、4、6、8、9 and a dark gray segment reading 凶星: 2、3、5、7. Include faint pale cloud motifs behind some objects for traditional atmosphere. Style is crisp vector-infographic with soft watercolor-like object rendering, high readability, balanced spacing, and an elegant Chinese metaphysical chart aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张风格简洁、对称的中文风水信息图海报，采用传统历法风格，背景为暖浅米色。顶部主标题为醒目的深红色中文书法字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="2026 年九宫飞星图"}，下方配有较小的黑色副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="（丙午年）"}。在左上角添加一个装饰性的罗盘，标有四个中文方位：上南、下北、左东、右西。构图中心为一个 3x3 的九宫格，包含 9 个带细致中式边角的方形面板，间距均匀且对齐完美。每个方格内包含一个大号彩色数字、一个中文星名、一行以“吉星”或“凶星”开头的文字，以及一个象征性的插图。顶行 3 个面板：左上角标注“东南”，紫色边框面板内为数字 9 和文字“九紫右弼星”，以及“吉星：喜庆、姻缘、贵人”，配以紫色气球、礼盒和小型烟花爆竹插图；顶部中央标注“正南”，橙色边框面板内为数字 5 和文字“五黄廉贞星”，以及“凶星：灾祸、意外、疾病”，配以金葫芦和系有红绳的古钱币插图；右上角标注“西南”，金色边框面板内为数字 7 和文字“七赤破军星”，以及“凶星：破财、口舌、盗贼”，配以铜铃和银剑插图。中行 3 个面板：左侧对齐“正东”大号垂直侧边文字，绿色边框面板内为数字 8 和文字“八白左辅星”，以及“吉星：财运、置业、积蓄”，配以盆景式摇钱树和金元宝插图；中间中央上方覆盖一个蓝色胶囊标签，标注“中宫”，蓝色边框面板内为数字 1 和文字“一白贪狼星”，以及“吉星：人缘、感情、智慧”，配以木架水晶球插图；右侧对齐“正西”大号垂直侧边文字，绿色边框面板内为数字 3 和文字“三碧禄存星”，以及“凶星：是非、口舌、争执”，配以竹子和小型叠石喷泉插图。底行 3 个面板：左下角标注“东北”，绿色边框面板内为数字 4 和文字“四绿文曲星”，以及“吉星：学业、文昌、考试”，配以打开的书本、毛笔和砚台，背景衬有竹叶；底部中央标注“正北”，金色边框面板内为数字 6 和文字“六白武曲星”，以及“吉星：权力、贵人、偏财”，配以底座上持球的金色石狮子雕像插图；右下角标注“西北”，灰色边框面板内为数字 2 和文字“二黑巨门星”，以及“凶星：病痛、伤害、阻滞”，配以石塔和小香炉插图。在网格周围使用 6 个外部方位标签：顶行上方为“东南”、“正南”、“西南”，底行下方为“东北”、“正北”、“西北”，每个标签均位于与面板颜色匹配的圆角胶囊内。在网格两侧添加 2 个大号垂直侧边方位标签：左侧为“正东”，右侧为“正西”。在底部中心添加一个药丸形状的图例，分为两段：红色段显示“吉星：1、4、6、8、9”，深灰色段显示“凶星：2、3、5、7”。在部分物体后方加入淡淡的云纹，营造传统氛围。整体风格为清晰的矢量信息图，物体渲染带有柔和的水彩质感，具备高可读性、平衡的间距以及优雅的中国玄学图表美感。

templates.title: Vintage Diner Menu Board Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 将火车场景转换为复古餐馆

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, replace the train interior scene with a straight-on, documentary-style photograph of a classic American diner counter wall. Remove the person, window reflection, thermos, and book entirely. Keep the image photorealistic and naturally lit, with warm tungsten bulbs across the top and wood-paneled walls. Add a large black letter-board menu with white block letters as the main subject, framed in metal above an open kitchen pass. Include 6 menu sections with these exact headings and items: BREAKFAST with 5 items (TWO EGGS TOAST 4.95, BACON & EGGS 6.50, HAM & EGGS 6.75, OMELET 7.25, BISCUITS & GRAVY 5.50); GRIDDLE with 4 items (SHORT STACK 4.25, PANCAKES 5.25, FRENCH TOAST 5.75, WAFFLE 5.95); SANDWICHES with 5 items (BLT 5.50, TUNA MELT 6.25, GRILLED CHEESE 4.50, CLUB SANDWICH 7.50, HAMBURGER 6.00); SIDES with 5 items (HASH BROWNS 2.50, BACON 2.95, SAUSAGE 2.95, TOAST 1.50, PIE 3.25); DRINKS with 5 items (COFFEE 1.25, TEA 1.25, MILK 1.50, ORANGE JUICE 1.75, SODA 1.50); and a DAILY SPECIAL line reading CHICKEN FRIED STEAK 8.25. Below the menu, show a stainless service opening and countertop with diner details including 2 condiment bottles, 1 napkin dispenser, and 1 shaker in the foreground. Wide horizontal composition, centered, realistic textures, slightly nostalgic roadside-diner mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将火车内部场景完全替换为舒适的复古美式餐馆吧台内部。移除人物、窗户倒影、保温杯、书籍以及所有火车元素。创建一个餐馆服务吧台的正面广角镜头，采用温暖的钨丝灯照明，配有木镶板墙壁、不锈钢开放式厨房、吧台上的调味瓶和金属餐巾纸盒，并在上方安装一个大型黑色字母菜单项目。菜单应包含 6 个部分，分别标记为 BREAKFAST、GRIDDLE、SANDWICHES、SIDES、DRINKS 和 DAILY SPECIAL。请包含以下确切的项目和价格：BREAKFAST 包含 5 个项目：TWO EGGS TOAST 4.95、BACON & EGGS 6.50、HAM & EGGS 6.75、OMELET 7.25、BISCUITS & GRAVY 5.50。GRIDDLE 包含 4 个项目：SHORT STACK 4.25、PANCAKES 5.25、FRENCH TOAST 5.75、WAFFLE 5.95。SANDWICHES 包含 5 个项目：BLT 5.50、TUNA MELT 6.25、GRILLED CHEESE 4.50、CLUB SANDWICH 7.50、HAMBURGER 6.00。SIDES 包含 5 个项目：HASH BROWNS 2.50、BACON 2.95、SAUSAGE 2.95、TOAST 1.50、PIE 3.25。DRINKS 包含 5 个项目：COFFEE 1.25、TEA 1.25、MILK 1.50、ORANGE JUICE 1.75、SODA 1.50。DAILY SPECIAL 包含 1 个项目：CHICKEN FRIED STEAK 8.25。使其看起来像一张逼真的照片，带有一丝怀旧感，构图简洁，画面中无人物。

templates.title: Candid Train Photo to Studio Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 将火车抓拍照片转换为影棚肖像

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, turn this candid train photo into a clean professional studio head-and-shoulders portrait of the same person. Keep the same hairstyle, shirt-and-sweater outfit, and overall identity cues, but remove the headphones, train window reflection, table, thermos, book, and all travel context. Reframe the subject so he is centered and facing the camera in a neutral upright pose, cropped from mid-chest upward. Replace the background with a plain muted blue-gray studio backdrop and use soft even portrait lighting for a polished corporate profile photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将这张随意的火车抓拍照片转换为同一人物干净、专业的影棚半身肖像。移除耳机、窗户反光、桌子、保温杯、书本以及所有火车内部或背景元素。将构图从随意的偏心坐姿调整为居中、正面的裁剪，使主体直视镜头，背景为简洁的柔和蓝灰色影棚背景。保留相同的发型、衬衫加毛衣的穿搭以及整体逼真的摄影质感，但使用柔和均匀的影棚灯光进行重新布光，并进行精致的肖像修图。

templates.title: Surreal Floating Head Sky Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝天背景下的悬浮 3D 头像

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the person into a surreal floating head portrait. Remove the train interior, table, bottle, book, headphones, and all surrounding context. Reframe to a centered, front-facing close-up of only the head, cropped just below the chin, with a glossy hyperreal 3D/plastic look. Replace the background with a bright saturated blue sky containing {argument name="cloud count" default="6"} soft fluffy white clouds. Add ornate gold eyeglass temples visible on both sides of the head, and keep the small goatee. Use vivid colors, smooth studio-like lighting, sharp focus on the head, and a whimsical toy-like aesthetic.

templates.title: Sunlit Streetwear Jacket Portrait

templates.prompt: A realistic lifestyle fashion photo of a woman standing indoors in a warm, sunlit modern loft living room, framed from mid-thigh up, facing the camera with her hands tucked into the pockets of an oversized black satin varsity-style bomber jacket. The jacket is the clear focus: glossy black fabric, ribbed collar and hem, snap-button front, slightly puffed sleeves, and large collegiate lettering across the chest that reads {argument name="front text" default="NEW YORK"} in bold orange letters with white outlines. Add a smaller orange-and-white sports patch on the upper sleeve and white block text on the opposite sleeve for an authentic team-jacket feel. Style the model with long, loose, softly wavy balayage hair in {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with caramel highlights"}, minimal jewelry including layered gold necklaces, and light gray sweatpants visible at the bottom of frame. Keep the face intentionally obscured with a centered rectangular blur block for privacy. The setting is a minimalist beige interior with tall industrial windows on the left casting strong morning sunlight and geometric shadows, a cream sofa with a pillow, a low coffee table with 3 stacked books and a dark bowl, pale walls, and a simple wooden side table in the background. Shoot in a high-end editorial e-commerce style with natural golden light, soft shadows, sharp jacket detail, shallow depth of field, neutral warm tones, and a clean premium streetwear aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的生活方式时尚照片，拍摄一位女性站在室内温暖、阳光明媚的现代阁楼客厅中，取景范围从大腿中部向上，她面向镜头，双手插在超大号黑色缎面棒球夹克的口袋里。夹克是画面的绝对焦点：光泽感的黑色面料、罗纹领口和下摆、按扣前襟、微蓬袖子，胸前印有醒目的橙色字母，外加白色描边，内容为 {argument name="front text" default="NEW YORK"}。在袖子上部添加一个较小的橙白配色运动补丁，并在另一侧袖子上印有白色块状文字，营造出地道的队服夹克质感。模特留着长而蓬松、带有柔和波浪感的挑染发型，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色配焦糖色挑染"}，佩戴极简首饰（包括叠戴金项链），画面底部可见浅灰色运动裤。出于隐私考虑，面部刻意使用居中的矩形模糊块遮挡。背景为极简主义的米色室内空间，左侧高大的工业风窗户投射出强烈的晨光和几何阴影，配有带靠垫的奶油色沙发、放有 3 本堆叠书籍和深色碗的矮咖啡桌、浅色墙壁以及背景中的简约木质边桌。采用高端电商时尚风格拍摄，呈现自然金色的光影、柔和的阴影、清晰的夹克细节、浅景深、中性暖色调以及干净高级的街头服饰美学。

templates.title: Apple-Style CEO Announcement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 苹果风格 CEO 任命海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic, ultra-polished Chinese corporate announcement poster in a premium Apple-style keynote aesthetic, vertical 4:5 composition, featuring a confident middle-aged East Asian man from the waist up standing outdoors in front of a futuristic glass-ring campus building at dusk, with a huge glowing white Apple logo behind him on the right side. He wears a minimalist black button-up shirt over a dark undershirt, with a calm, authoritative posture and luxury-brand presentation lighting. The sky is a deep blue-to-gray gradient, and the overall color palette is dark navy, charcoal, silver, and warm soft white. At the very top center, place a small white Apple logo, with a thin horizontal divider line on each side and the Chinese text “Apple 新篇章 由此开启” beneath it in elegant sans-serif. In the top right corner, add large bold red Chinese text: “AI生成”. Across the upper-middle area, add a huge bold white Chinese headline: “{argument name="headline text" default="罗永浩 接任 Apple CEO"}”. Directly below it, add smaller spaced-out white Chinese subheadline text: “用 工 匠 精 神 ， 让 世 界 再 次 惊 叹”. On the left side of the subject’s chest area, place a quotation block with a large opening quotation mark and 2 lines of Chinese body text in dark navy: “{argument name="quote" default="我不是来改变 Apple，而是让 Apple 重拾改变世界的勇气。"}”, followed by a handwritten-style signature line and the name “罗永浩”. In the lower-middle area, overlay a dark translucent horizontal feature bar containing exactly 4 icon-and-text items, evenly spaced from left to right: 1) a hammer icon with the title “工匠精神” and subtitle “极致产品主义”, 2) a speech bubble icon with the title “用户至上” and subtitle “体验超越期待”, 3) a light bulb icon with the title “创新驱动” and subtitle “重新定义未来”, 4) a heart outline icon with the title “真诚沟通” and subtitle “打造人心的科技”. At the bottom center, add large white English text: “Think Different. Think Again.”, then below it smaller white Chinese text: “现在，交给罗永浩。” and a handwritten signature beneath. The subject should resemble {argument name="character name" default="罗永浩"}, with {argument name="hair style" default="short black hair, neatly combed"} and {argument name="outfit" default="minimalist black button-up shirt"}. Make the image photorealistic but slightly idealized like a premium launch campaign, with cinematic contrast, soft edge glow around the Apple logo, subtle reflections on the glass architecture, elegant typography hierarchy, and a highly believable luxury-tech advertisement finish.

Add large bold red Chinese text in the top left corner reading {argument name="headline text" default="AI生成"}. Compose it as an unposed, believable family moment with authentic domestic clutter, nostalgic realism, natural room lighting, and the unmistakable look of an old personal photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 21 世纪初中国大陆风格的家庭室内抓拍照片，采用消费级数码相机拍摄，焦点略显柔和，色彩柔和，带有轻微噪点，右下角带有相机自带的日期戳，显示为 {argument name="date stamp" default="2003.12.28"}。场景展示了一个朴素的客厅，三个人物的面部被刻意模糊处理：左前方，一位身穿淡粉紫色针织衫的成年女性坐在床边或沙发边缘，身体略微转向镜头；背景中央，一位身穿深色衣服的成年男性蹲在木质电视柜前，正在调试一台银色的 DVD 或 VCD 播放机；右前方，一个小女孩身穿浅粉色毛衣和深色裤子，跪在花纹繁复的红色地毯上，手里拿着一辆彩色玩具车。他们身后是一台笨重的银色 CRT 电视机，屏幕显示着灰色的雪花点，顶部覆盖着一块蕾丝布。电视机后的墙壁充满了生活气息：挂历上方贴着一张写有“福”字的红色大字海报，还有几张装裱的家庭照片和零星张贴的图片。最右侧是一个高大的黑色置物架，上面整齐地堆放着 VHS 录像带或媒体盒、书籍，顶部摆放着一盆垂下绿叶的盆栽。左侧边缘可见部分床铺或沙发，配有浅色床品和红色靠垫。在左上角添加醒目的红色粗体中文字样 {argument name="headline text" default="AI生成"}。整体构图呈现为一个未经摆拍、真实可信的家庭瞬间，包含地道的居家杂物、怀旧写实感、自然的室内光线，以及旧时个人照片特有的质感。

templates.title: Apple-Style Minimal Presentation Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Apple 风格极简演示文稿封面

templates.prompt: Create a premium minimalist keynote-style presentation cover slide in an Apple-inspired industrial design aesthetic. Use a wide 16:9 layout with a deep matte black upper background and a pale concrete-gray lower platform occupying the bottom quarter of the frame. Place a large photorealistic floating rectangular slab in the right-center foreground, resembling a thin black glass device or polished obsidian platform with mirror-like reflections, chamfered chrome-metal edges, and precise industrial finishing. The slab should hover above the light surface and cast a soft elongated shadow directly beneath it. Add a tall vertical gray metallic wall or pillar on the far right edge to frame the composition. Use extremely sparse, high-end art direction, lots of negative space, cinematic studio lighting, subtle gradients, and crisp contrast between black and silver materials. On the left side, set clean white sans-serif typography with a clear hierarchy: a tiny top caption reading "{argument name="system label" default="Apple-inspired presentation system"}", a very large bold headline reading "{argument name="headline text" default="Clarity At Scale"}", and a medium subtitle reading "{argument name="subtitle text" default="The strongest slides behave like products."}". Below that, include exactly 3 numbered principles in a vertical list with thin separators and refined spacing: "01 | {argument name="principle 1" default="One focal object"}", "02 | Binary light / dark rhythm", and "03 | Blue only for signal". Add a short thin horizontal rule above the list and a tiny blue accent line below the list. Draw a very fine horizontal guide line near the top spanning most of the slide, with the small page number "01" at the upper right. Repeat the small caption "Apple-inspired presentation system" once again at the bottom left on the light surface. Overall look: luxury tech presentation, editorial product-launch slide, ultra-clean Swiss grid, restrained monochrome palette with only one subtle blue accent, photorealistic rendering blended with presentation design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个具有 Apple 工业设计美学的高级极简 Keynote 风格演示文稿封面 Slides。使用 16:9 宽屏布局，背景上半部分为深哑光黑色，下半部分为占据画面底部四分之一的浅混凝土灰色平台。在右侧中心前景处放置一个大型逼真的悬浮矩形板，外观类似于薄型黑色玻璃设备或带有镜面反射、倒角铬金属边缘及精密工业饰面的抛光黑曜石平台。该板应悬浮在浅色表面上方，并在其正下方投下柔和的拉长阴影。在最右侧边缘添加一堵高大的垂直灰色金属墙或立柱以构图。采用极其简洁的高端艺术指导，留出大量负空间，运用电影级摄影棚灯光、微妙的渐变，以及黑色与银色材质之间清晰的对比。在左侧，设置干净的白色无衬线字体，并保持清晰的层级：顶部为一行微小的标题“{argument name="system label" default="Apple-inspired presentation system"}”，中间为一行非常大的粗体标题“{argument name="headline text" default="Clarity At Scale"}”，下方为一行中等字号的副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="The strongest slides behave like products."}”。在其下方，以垂直列表形式包含 3 条带细分隔线和精致间距的编号原则：“01 | {argument name="principle 1" default="One focal object"}”、“02 | Binary light / dark rhythm”以及“03 | Blue only for signal”。在列表上方添加一条短细水平线，在列表下方添加一条微小的蓝色强调线。在顶部附近绘制一条贯穿大部分 Slides 的极细水平引导线，并在右上角标注页码“01”。在底部左侧的浅色表面上再次重复微小的标题“Apple-inspired presentation system”。整体外观：奢华科技演示、编辑级产品发布 Slides、超干净的瑞士网格布局、克制的单色调配色方案（仅含一处微妙的蓝色点缀），以及融合了演示文稿设计的逼真渲染效果。

templates.title: Thoughtful Systems Presentation Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Thoughtful Systems 演示封面

templates.prompt: Create a refined editorial presentation cover slide in a warm, Claude-inspired design system. Use a landscape 16:9 composition with a parchment-paper background, subtle paper grain, soft shadows, and layered torn-paper collage elements. The overall palette should be warm ivory, cream, sand, charcoal, muted black, and terracotta accent. On the left half, place a small top label reading "{argument name="system label" default="Claude-inspired presentation system"}" with a small terracotta dot and a thin horizontal divider line. Below it, set an oversized elegant high-contrast serif headline in black that reads "{argument name="main headline" default="Thoughtful Systems"}", split across two lines and dominating the left side. Under the headline, add a smaller serif subheadline in terracotta reading "{argument name="subheadline" default="Warmth can still feel precise."}". Beneath that, create a vertical list of exactly 4 design principles, each on its own row with thin divider lines and a small icon at left: 1) a rectangular parchment-sheet icon with the text "Parchment canvas", 2) a serif capital T icon with the text "Serif-led hierarchy", 3) a filled terracotta circle icon with the text "Terracotta for signal", 4) a chain-link icon with the text "Organic diagrams over cold chrome". Add a tiny footer caption at bottom left reading "CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM" in spaced small caps. On the right half, build a layered collage of exactly 3 paper cards: first, a tall off-white art card with a fine border containing the heading "A more considered approach", a short body paragraph about complex problems yielding to clarity, a minimal landscape line drawing with a terracotta sun, and a vertical terracotta botanical branch overlapping the card; second, a dark charcoal rectangular card partially behind it with the lowercase title "thinking process" and an exact 5-step numbered list: "01 Observe", "02 Interpret", "03 Connect", "04 Synthesize", "05 Act with care", plus a delicate circular orbital diagram in dotted lines and terracotta highlight; third, a torn off-white note card in front near the bottom with a hand-drawn overlapping-circles diagram where one crescent-shaped intersection area is shaded in terracotta, alongside a handwritten quote reading "{argument name="quote" default="Clarity emerges when systems are designed with intention."}". Include one extra light beige paper strip tucked beneath the lower cards. Emphasize tactile realism, elegant negative space, print-editorial sophistication, soft natural lighting, and a calm, thoughtful luxury-tech mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个精致的编辑风格演示封面幻灯片，采用温暖的 Claude 风格设计系统。使用 16:9 横向构图，背景为羊皮纸，带有细腻的纸张纹理、柔和的阴影以及分层的撕纸拼贴元素。整体色调应为暖象牙色、奶油色、沙色、炭灰色、柔和黑色以及赤陶色点缀。在左半部分，放置一个小标签，显示“{argument name="system label" default="Claude 风格演示系统"}”，配有一个赤陶色小圆点和一条细水平分割线。在其下方，设置一个超大且优雅的高对比度衬线标题，颜色为黑色，内容为“{argument name="main headline" default="Thoughtful Systems"}”，分为两行，占据左侧主要位置。在标题下方，添加一个较小的赤陶色衬线副标题，内容为“{argument name="subheadline" default="温暖亦可精准。"}”。在此之下，创建一个包含 4 个设计原则的垂直列表，每一项占一行，带有细分割线和左侧小图标：1) 一个矩形羊皮纸图标，文字为“羊皮纸画布”；2) 一个衬线大写字母 T 图标，文字为“衬线主导的层级”；3) 一个填充的赤陶色圆形图标，文字为“赤陶色用于信号提示”；4) 一个链条图标，文字为“有机图表胜过冷峻金属感”。在左下角添加一行微小的页脚说明，以间距较大的小写字母显示“CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM”。在右半部分，构建一个由 3 张纸质卡片组成的分层拼贴：第一张是带有细边框的米白色高长艺术卡片，包含标题“更深思熟虑的方法”、一段关于复杂问题如何趋于清晰的简短正文、一幅带有赤陶色太阳的极简风景线条画，以及一张覆盖在卡片上的垂直赤陶色植物枝条；第二张是位于其后方的深炭灰色矩形卡片，带有小写标题“thinking process”和一个精确的 5 步编号列表：“01 Observe”、“02 Interpret”、“03 Connect”、“04 Synthesize”、“05 Act with care”，以及一个带有虚线和赤陶色高光的精致圆形轨道图；第三张是靠近底部前方的一张撕边米白色便签卡，上面有一个手绘的重叠圆圈图，其中一个新月形的交叉区域用赤陶色填充，旁边是一句手写引语：“{argument name="quote" default="当系统被有意设计时，清晰度便会显现。"}”。在底部卡片下方塞入一条额外的浅米色纸条。强调触感真实性、优雅的留白、印刷编辑的精致感、柔和的自然光影以及冷静、深思熟虑的奢华科技氛围。

templates.title: Chinese VPS Comparison Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 中文 VPS 测评封面

templates.prompt: Create a clean modern Chinese tech blog cover in a wide 16:9 layout with a soft light-gray background, rounded-corner canvas, and minimalist dashboard aesthetic. On the left, place a small rounded category pill near the top with a yellow dot icon and the text “VPS 实测 · 购买参考”. Below it, set a very large bold dark navy Chinese headline in two stacked lines: “DMIT涨价之后” and “我把搬瓦工”. Under the headline, add a short yellow underline accent and then a medium-gray subheading reading “先看重点再下单”. The typography should feel premium, editorial, and highly legible, with strong contrast and generous spacing. On the right, show a floating desktop-app style server monitoring panel with a white card body, subtle shadow, rounded corners, and a pale beige browser top bar with three small circular window buttons. The panel header should read “BandwagonHost – CN2 GIA”, with a smaller line underneath “洛杉矶 · CN2 GIA” and a green status label “运行中”, plus on the top-right a small clock icon and the text “运行时长 27 天”. Inside the panel, include exactly 5 metric cards across the top row labeled “CPU” showing “12%”, “内存” showing “28%”, “硬盘” showing “18%”, “带宽” showing “1.2 Mbps”, and “延迟（本地）” showing “156 ms”, each with a small teal icon and a thin teal progress bar. Below, place a large line chart card on the left titled “稳定性（近 7 天）” with a top-right annotation “可用性 99.92%”, a teal fluctuating line, a vertical scale from 97% to 100%, and date labels from “05-13” through “05-19”. To the right of the chart, add a specs card titled “配置摘要” listing exactly 5 rows: “CPU 2 vCPU”, “内存 2 GB”, “硬盘 40 GB SSD”, “流量 1 TB/月”, and “系统 CentOS 7.9 64bit”. In the lower-left area overlapping between the text block and the dashboard, add a smaller white recommendation card with rounded corners and shadow. Its title line should include a yellow bookmark icon and read “购买参考 · 重点看这几项”. Inside, list exactly 4 rows: “线路质量  CN2 GIA”, “稳定性  ★★★★☆”, “性价比  中上”, and “适用场景  建站 / 中转 / 轻应用”. Add soft decorative elements in the background: a pale mint abstract rounded shape in the bottom-left corner, a faint dotted mint pattern above it, and a light dotted curved connector line arcing from the left text area toward the top of the dashboard, with a small yellow dot on the curve. Place a small rounded yellow name tag in the bottom-right corner of the canvas with the text “小墨同学”. Use a restrained palette of dark navy, teal, yellow, white, and light gray, with crisp vector-style rendering, subtle shadows, spacious composition, and a polished AI-generated editorial cover look for a VPS comparison article.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个简洁现代的中文科技博客封面，采用 16:9 宽屏布局，背景为柔和的浅灰色，画布采用圆角设计，并呈现极简的仪表盘美学。在左侧顶部放置一个带有黄色圆点图标的小型圆角分类标签，文字为“VPS 实测 · 购买参考”。下方设置两行堆叠的超大号深海军蓝中文标题：“DMIT 涨价之后”和“我把搬瓦工”。在标题下方添加一条短黄色下划线装饰，随后是中灰色的副标题“先看重点再下单”。排版应具有高级感、编辑感且易于阅读，对比度强烈，间距充裕。在右侧，展示一个悬浮的桌面应用风格服务器监控面板，主体为白色卡片，带有细腻阴影和圆角，顶部为浅米色浏览器栏，配有三个圆形窗口按钮。面板标题应为“BandwagonHost – CN2 GIA”，下方有一行较小的文字“洛杉矶 · CN2 GIA”以及绿色的“运行中”状态标签，右上角配有一个小型时钟图标和文字“运行时长 27 天”。面板内顶部一行包含 5 个指标卡片，标签分别为“CPU”显示“12%”、“内存”显示“28%”、“硬盘”显示“18%”、“带宽”显示“1.2 Mbps”以及“延迟（本地）”显示“156 ms”，每个指标配有一个青色小图标和一条细青色进度条。下方左侧放置一个大型折线图卡片，标题为“稳定性（近 7 天）”，右上角标注“可用性 99.92%”，图表内有一条青色波动曲线，纵轴刻度从 97% 到 100%，日期标签从“05-13”到“05-19”。图表右侧添加一个标题为“配置摘要”的规格卡片，列出 5 行内容：“CPU 2 vCPU”、“内存 2 GB”、“硬盘 40 GB SSD”、“流量 1 TB/月”以及“系统 CentOS 7.9 64bit”。在左下角文字块与仪表盘重叠区域，添加一张较小的白色圆角阴影推荐卡片。标题行包含一个黄色书签图标，文字为“购买参考 · 重点看这几项”。内部列出 4 行内容：“线路质量  CN2 GIA”、“稳定性  ★★★★☆”、“性价比  中上”以及“适用场景  建站 / 中转 / 轻应用”。在背景中添加柔和的装饰元素：左下角一个浅薄荷绿的抽象圆角形状，其上方为淡淡的薄荷绿点阵图案，并有一条浅色点状弧线从左侧文字区域延伸至仪表盘顶部，曲线上带有一个黄色小圆点。在画布右下角放置一个黄色圆角名牌，文字为“小墨同学”。整体使用深海军蓝、青色、黄色、白色和浅灰色的克制配色方案，呈现清晰的矢量风格渲染、细腻的阴影、宽敞的构图，打造出专业且精致的 AI 生成式 VPS 测评文章封面。

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a layout and style guide, recreate it as a vintage Chinese mythological illustrated story page instead of the Monkey King page. Keep the aged textbook/comic print look, yellowed paper texture, retro ink-and-watercolor rendering, and boxed multi-panel composition. Replace the original content with a 山海经-themed page. Preserve the vertical title block on the left, but change the main title to {argument name="title text" default="山海经"}. Build a total of 8 content panels: 1 large title/hero panel at the top left featuring a mythic figure and a red sun, 5 medium boxed narrative panels in the middle rows with different ancient myth scenes, and 2 wide horizontal panels across the bottom row. Add dense Chinese explanatory captions under each panel in the same old-print style, with small numbered labels for panels 2 through 8 and a small red seal-like tag near the title. The overall result should feel like an antique Chinese serialized picture-book page from a retro children’s mythology encyclopedia.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像为布局和风格指南，将其重构为一页复古中国神话插画故事页，而非原有的孙悟空页面。保持陈旧的教科书/漫画印刷外观、泛黄的纸张纹理、复古水墨渲染以及多格漫画排版。将原始内容替换为以《山海经》为主题的页面。保留左侧的竖排标题栏，但将主标题更改为 {argument name="title text" default="山海经"}。共构建 8 个内容面板：左上方设 1 个大型标题/主图面板，展示神话人物和红日；中间行设 5 个中型叙事面板，展示不同的古代神话场景；底部行设 2 个宽幅横向面板。在每个面板下方添加密集的中文说明文字，保持旧式印刷风格，并为第 2 至第 8 个面板添加小型编号标签，在标题附近添加一个小型的红色印章式标签。最终效果应呈现出一种复古儿童神话百科全书中连环画页面的质感。

templates.title: Minimal Anti-Itch Cream Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 极简风止痒膏海报

templates.prompt: A clean minimalist vertical product poster on a soft pale gray background with a subtle green tint, designed like a modern Chinese skincare or medicine advertisement. Show a {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin lookalike"} from the chest up on the left side, wearing a black bowler hat, black suit jacket, white shirt, dark tie, and gray vest, posed formally and holding a bright green plastic jar of {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"} with a white lid in both hands at center-left. One hand supports the jar from below while the other points toward it, creating a clear product presentation pose. The face should have a gentle pleasant expression, but keep the composition focused more on wardrobe, hands, and product than facial detail. On the upper right, place a green brand logo and Chinese brand text. Below it, add large elegant green Chinese headline text reading “舒缓 止痒膏” and smaller English subtitle text “ANTI-ITCH CREAM”. To the right of the jar, include a circular botanical graphic with {argument name="herb" default="mint leaves"}, plus exactly 2 green checklist claims in Chinese beneath it. At the bottom, add a curved white panel spanning the width of the poster containing exactly 3 evenly spaced green line icons with Chinese captions: a leaf icon for cooling itch relief, a water droplet icon for moisturizing dry itch, and a shield icon for gentle protection. The product jar label should be yellow-green with Chinese text and small herb illustrations, matching the green branding. Overall style: sparse, neat, commercial poster, lots of negative space, premium pharmacy-ad aesthetic, soft studio lighting, realistic photography mixed with clean graphic layout, green-and-white color palette.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的极简主义竖版产品海报，背景为带有淡淡绿色的柔和浅灰色，设计风格参考现代中式护肤品或药品广告。在左侧展示一位 {argument name="character type" default="酷似查理·卓别林"} 的人物半身像，身穿黑色圆顶礼帽、黑色西装外套、白色衬衫、深色领带和灰色马甲，姿态正式，双手在左中位置捧着一个带有白色盖子的亮绿色 {argument name="product name" default="止痒膏"} 塑料罐。一只手托住罐底，另一只手指向罐身，呈现清晰的产品展示姿态。面部表情应柔和愉悦，但构图重点应更多放在服饰、手部和产品上，而非面部细节。在右上角放置绿色品牌 Logo 和中文品牌名称。下方添加醒目优雅的绿色中文大标题“舒缓 止痒膏”以及较小的英文副标题“ANTI-ITCH CREAM”。在罐身右侧，加入一个带有 {argument name="herb" default="薄荷叶"} 的圆形植物图形，并在其下方列出 2 条中文功效说明。在海报底部，添加一个横跨海报宽度的弧形白色面板，内含 3 个间距均匀的绿色线条图标及中文说明：叶片图标代表清凉止痒，水滴图标代表滋润干痒，盾牌图标代表温和防护。产品罐身标签应为黄绿色，配有中文文字和小型草本插图，与整体绿色品牌色调相呼应。整体风格：稀疏、整洁、商业海报感，留白充裕，高级药房广告美学，柔和的摄影棚灯光，写实摄影与简洁图形排版相结合，采用绿白配色。

templates.title: Minimal Anti-Itch Cream Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 极简风止痒膏海报

templates.prompt: A minimalist clean poster on a warm light beige studio background with a subtle wall-to-table horizon line, lots of negative space, and soft diffused lighting. Center-right stands a full-body vintage silent-film comedian resembling {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin"}, wearing a black bowler hat, dark worn suit, vest, white shirt, tie, oversized trousers, and old leather shoes, holding a thin curved cane in one hand and smiling gently. His other arm is extended in a presentation gesture toward a large green jar of {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"} placed in the foreground at center. The jar has a white screw cap, translucent green body, and a bright yellow-green label with Chinese medicine-style packaging details, including small Chinese characters and the English text {argument name="label text" default="ANTI-ITCH CREAM"}. A realistic human hand rises from below to support the jar from underneath, making the product the visual focal point. Add fresh green mint leaves around the base of the jar and near the character’s feet for a natural herbal cue. Composition should feel like a modern advertising poster: product large and centered, character slightly behind and to the right, clean cutout look, soft shadows, crisp edges, muted neutral palette with the green jar as the main color accent. No headline, no extra layout elements, no clutter, no border. Include a tiny four-point sparkle icon in the lower right corner. Aspect ratio vertical poster, polished commercial photomontage style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简风格的干净海报，背景为暖浅米色摄影棚背景，带有微妙的墙面与桌面水平线，留白充足，光线柔和漫射。画面中右侧站着一位全身复古默片喜剧演员，外形酷似 {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin"}，头戴黑色圆顶硬礼帽，身穿深色磨损西装、马甲、白衬衫、领带，穿着超大号长裤和旧皮鞋，一手拿着细长的弯曲手杖，面带温和微笑。他的另一只手臂伸出，做出展示姿势，指向位于画面中央前景处的一大罐 {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"}。该罐子配有白色旋盖，半透明绿色罐身，贴有亮黄绿色标签，标签上印有中药风格的包装细节，包括小号中文字符和英文字符 {argument name="label text" default="ANTI-ITCH CREAM"}。一只写实的人手从下方伸出托住罐子底部，使产品成为视觉焦点。在罐子底部和角色脚边添加新鲜的薄荷叶，以体现天然草本元素。构图应呈现现代广告海报感：产品居中且放大，角色位于其后方稍靠右侧，呈现干净的抠图效果，阴影柔和，边缘清晰，整体采用柔和的中性色调，以绿色罐子作为主要色彩点缀。无标题，无额外排版元素，无杂乱内容，无边框。在右下角添加一个微小的四角星图标。纵向海报比例，精致的商业照片合成风格。

templates.title: Luxury Bag Meets Discount Chaos Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢侈品包袋与折扣乱象碰撞海报

templates.prompt: A vertical 9:16 luxury-fashion parody advertising poster with a single centered handbag as the hero product, designed as a brutal collision between ultra-premium maison branding and chaotic Chinese e-commerce discount graphics. The top half should feel like an elegant Hermes-style campaign: a warm beige and taupe atelier interior with soft morning window light, shallow depth of field, refined wall paneling, a wooden worktable, and visible artisan tools including exactly 6 workshop elements around the bag: a brush cup with several brushes on the left, a small ceramic vase on the far left, a leather awl or burnishing tool on the table front left, a knife-like leather tool on the table front left edge, an adjustable desk lamp on the right, and a spool of thread on the right. At the top center place a gold luxury logo with a horse-and-carriage icon above the word HERMÈS and PARIS beneath it, followed by one giant serif headline reading BIRKIN in gold. In the center, show one large structured crocodile-embossed Birkin-style handbag in {argument name="bag color" default="warm greige taupe"}, front-facing, highly detailed leather texture, polished gold hardware, upright handles, sitting on the tabletop, photographed like a premium product shot. Across the right-middle of the bag, add one torn-paper rip effect revealing aggressive discount advertising underneath; around the tear add exactly 5 digital glitch accents in neon magenta, green, cyan, black, and white. On the torn area place exactly 3 visible Chinese promo stickers layered diagonally: a small red sticker reading 福利价, a large red sticker reading 百亿补贴, and a black sticker with bright outline reading 亿补贴. The bottom third of the poster should erupt into a loud comic-book and livestream-sale visual explosion with torn-paper separation from the luxury upper half. Use saturated red, yellow, white, black, and cyan with sharp starburst shapes, speed lines, heavy outlines, and flying gold coins. Include exactly 7 bottom promotional text blocks: 1 large central red banner reading 百亿补贴, 1 red rounded rectangle below it with the Pinduoduo logo and the text 拼多多, 2 side banners partially cropped with 拼多多, 2 additional yellow-red 百亿补贴 bursts at the lower left and lower center, and 1 handwritten black calligraphy slogan at the lower right reading 砍一刀. Add one extra handwritten black phrase at the lower left reading 只需9.9元!. The overall composition must feel like an elite fashion campaign violently invaded by cheap viral bargain marketing, with cinematic lighting, strong visual hierarchy, realistic product rendering, premium typography above, explosive discount chaos below, and intentional aesthetic contrast between sophistication and low-cost internet commerce. Make it look like a high-end brand collaboration key visual poster for {argument name="collaboration brand text" default="拼多多 × 爱马仕"} promoting {argument name="promo text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 9:16 竖版奢侈时尚恶搞广告海报，以居中的单只手提包为核心产品，旨在展现超高端品牌形象与混乱的中国电商折扣图形之间的激烈碰撞。上半部分应呈现优雅的爱马仕风格广告质感：温暖的米色与灰褐色工作室背景，柔和的晨光从窗外洒入，浅景深效果，精致的墙面装饰，木质工作台，以及包袋周围清晰可见的 6 个工匠工具元素：左侧放有几支画笔的笔筒，最左侧的一个小陶瓷花瓶，桌面前左侧的皮革锥子或打磨工具，桌面前边缘的一把皮革刀具，右侧的可调节台灯，以及右侧的一卷线轴。在顶部中央放置一个金色奢侈品 Logo，上方为马车图标，下方为 HERMÈS 和 PARIS 字样，随后是一个巨大的衬线字体标题：BIRKIN（金色）。中心位置展示一只大型结构感鳄鱼纹铂金包，颜色为 {argument name="bag color" default="暖灰褐色"}，正面朝向，皮革纹理细节丰富，抛光金色五金件，手柄竖立，置于桌面上，采用高端产品摄影手法拍摄。在包袋中右侧横跨处，添加一个撕纸效果，露出下方极具侵略性的折扣广告；在撕裂处周围添加 5 个霓虹洋红色、绿色、青色、黑色和白色的数字故障特效。在撕裂区域斜向叠放 3 个清晰可见的中文促销贴纸：一个小红色贴纸写着“福利价”，一个大红色贴纸写着“百亿补贴”，以及一个带有亮色轮廓的黑色贴纸写着“亿补贴”。海报下三分之一处应呈现出喧闹的漫画与直播带货式的视觉爆炸，并与上方的奢侈品区域通过撕纸效果隔开。使用高饱和度的红、黄、白、黑和青色，搭配锐利的星爆形状、速度线、粗轮廓线和飞舞的金币。包含 7 个底部的促销文字块：1 个中央的大型红色横幅写着“百亿补贴”，下方 1 个带有拼多多 Logo 和“拼多多”文字的红色圆角矩形，2 个部分被裁切的“拼多多”侧边横幅，左下角和下中部各 1 个额外的黄红相间“百亿补贴”爆炸贴，以及右下角 1 个手写黑色书法标语“砍一刀”。在左下角额外添加一个手写黑色短语“只需 9.9 元！”。整体构图应呈现出一种精英时尚广告被廉价病毒式营销暴力入侵的感觉，具备电影级光影、强烈的视觉层级、写实的产品渲染、上方的高级排版、下方的爆炸性折扣乱象，以及精致与低成本互联网商业之间的刻意美学对比。使其看起来像是一张 {argument name="collaboration brand text" default="拼多多 × 爱马仕"} 的高端品牌联名主视觉海报，用于推广 {argument name="promo text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}。

templates.title: Luxury x E-commerce Split Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华 x 电商风格对撞海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 luxury-campaign poster for a fictional crossover product, a disruptive co-branded handbag advertisement between {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} and {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"}. The composition is a violently split, collage-style fashion key visual with a torn-paper seam running vertically down the center, dividing two clashing aesthetics: on the left, refined premium luxury branding in warm Hermes orange, cream paper, and elegant editorial minimalism; on the right, aggressive Chinese e-commerce promotion energy in black and metallic red foil, with loud sale graphics, confetti, ripped stickers, and explosive discount typography. At the top center, place both brands prominently with a large collaboration headline in Chinese, the left logo area styled like a classic luxury house with serif typography and horse-and-carriage emblem, the right logo area in bold red Chinese branding. Below that, add the main headline text in huge Chinese characters: {argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}, and a boxed subheadline: {argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}. The centerpiece is one Birkin-style luxury handbag shown front-facing and large, perfectly centered but visually split in half along the torn seam: the left half is orange pebbled leather with gold hardware, the right half is crinkled metallic silver leather with silver hardware, both halves seamlessly merged into one surreal bag. The bag should include 5 clearly visible accessory/product elements around or on it: 1 orange clochette hanging on the left, 1 metallic silver hanging strap with lock on the right, 1 central turn-lock closure with padlock, 1 orange Hermes-style gift box with dark ribbon at lower left, and 1 beige dust bag with small logo near the bottom left. Behind the bag on the left is a painterly orange brushstroke on textured cream paper; behind the bag on the right is a crushed reflective red metallic wrapper surface with spark-like highlights and falling confetti. On the right half, add 8 aggressive promotional text bursts and stickers layered diagonally like an online shopping festival poster: 1 giant white Chinese slogan "百亿补贴 全网最低", 2 "限时秒杀!!", 3 a torn price sticker reading "补贴价 ¥999?!", 4 "万件疯抢", 5 "百亿补贴 官方直补", 6 "直降到底", 7 a large bottom torn banner repeating "补贴价 ¥999?!", and 8 small text "建议零售价 ¥1000000+". On the left margin, add a slim vertical editorial text column with 4 grouped text blocks in a luxury layout: 1 "限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION", 2 "HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE", 3 "CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE", and 4 "DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY". At the bottom, create a black app-like information bar with 3 feature blocks from left to right: 1 a red brand icon with "拼多多" and a search-bar style pill containing "百亿补贴铂金包", 2 a lightning icon with the text "百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价", and 3 a shield icon with the text "正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息". Add a thin final slogan line across the very bottom in small Chinese text. Use hyper-detailed commercial product photography, premium graphic design, sharp lighting, embossed textures, foil reflections, paper tears, and strong depth. The overall mood must feel like a world-class art director forced a heritage luxury campaign and a chaotic discount-shopping poster to collide in one image, producing extreme visual tension, irony, and high-impact contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 9:16 的竖版奢华营销海报，用于展示一款虚构的跨界产品，即 {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} 与 {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"} 之间极具颠覆性的联名手袋广告。构图采用强烈的对撞拼贴风格，画面中央有一道垂直贯穿的撕纸裂缝，将两种冲突的美学一分为二：左侧为精致的高端奢华品牌风格，采用爱马仕橙、奶油色纸张及优雅的编辑式极简主义；右侧为充满侵略性的中国电商促销风格，以黑色和金属红箔为基调，配以醒目的促销图形、五彩纸屑、撕裂的贴纸以及极具爆发力的折扣字体。在顶部中央，显著放置两个品牌，并配以醒目的中文联名大标题；左侧标志区呈现经典奢侈品牌风格，使用衬线字体和马车徽标，右侧标志区则采用醒目的红色中式品牌风格。下方添加巨大的中文主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}，以及一个带边框的副标题：{argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}。画面中心是一只 Birkin 风格的奢华手袋，正面朝向且尺寸巨大，完美居中但被画面中央的撕裂缝一分为二：左半部分为橙色荔枝纹皮革配金色五金，右半部分为褶皱金属银色皮革配银色五金，两半无缝融合为一只超现实主义手袋。手袋周围或上方应包含 5 个清晰可见的配饰/产品元素：左侧悬挂 1 个橙色钥匙扣，右侧悬挂 1 个带锁的金属银色挂带，1 个中央旋转锁扣及挂锁，左下角放置 1 个带深色丝带的橙色爱马仕风格礼盒，以及左下角附近 1 个带有小徽标的米色防尘袋。手袋左后方是纹理奶油纸上的油画感橙色笔触；手袋右后方是带有火花般高光和飘落纸屑的压碎感红色金属包装纸表面。在右半部分，添加 8 个充满侵略性的促销文字爆点和贴纸，像购物节海报一样呈对角线层叠排列：1 个巨大的白色中文标语“百亿补贴 全网最低”，2 个“限时秒杀!!”，3 个写着“补贴价 ¥999?!”的撕裂价格贴纸，4 个“万件疯抢”，5 个“百亿补贴 官方直补”，6 个“直降到底”，7 个底部重复“补贴价 ¥999?!”的大型撕裂横幅，以及 8 个小字“建议零售价 ¥1000000+”。在左侧边缘，添加一列纤细的垂直编辑式文字，包含 4 个分组文本块，采用奢华布局：1 “限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION”，2 “HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE”，3 “CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE”，4 “DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY”。底部创建一个黑色的 App 风格信息栏，从左至右包含 3 个功能块：1 个带有“拼多多”字样的红色品牌图标，以及一个包含“百亿补贴铂金包”的搜索栏式胶囊按钮，2 个带有闪电图标及“百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价”文字的区域，3 个带有盾牌图标及“正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息”文字的区域。在最底部添加一行细小的中文最终标语。使用超精细的商业产品摄影、高级平面设计、锐利的灯光、压印纹理、箔片反光、纸张撕裂效果和强烈的景深。整体氛围必须如同顶级艺术总监强行将传统奢华广告与混乱的折扣促销海报融合在一起，产生极端的视觉张力、讽刺感和高冲击力的对比。
