templates.title: Vintage Beijing Travel Scrapbook Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古北京旅行剪贴簿海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create a charming hand-drawn vintage travel scrapbook poster about {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, designed as a Chinese-language illustrated tourist guide page on warm aged paper lying on a wooden tabletop. The composition is a single vertical poster with a slightly worn notebook-page look, soft stains, folded corners, tape marks, stamp-like ink smudges, and a casual collage aesthetic. At the top center, place large bold black Chinese calligraphy for {argument name="city name" default="北京"}, with the English word {argument name="english city name" default="Beijing"} underneath in loose blue brush script. Near the title, add a small red seal stamp and a short Chinese text block on the upper right describing the geographic location of the city in dark blue handwritten-style Chinese characters.

Below the title, include 4 taped polaroid-style travel photos arranged in a slightly uneven row, each with a handwritten English caption on the white border. Photo 1: the Forbidden City at sunset with golden reflections and warm orange light, captioned about warm golden tones. Photo 2: the Great Wall winding across green mountains under a bright sky, captioned about Great Wall of China landscape and green mountains. Photo 3: Beihai Park lake with willow branches, boats, and a white stupa in the background, captioned about a serene lake view. Photo 4: a traditional hutong alley with gray brick walls and hanging red lanterns, captioned about red lanterns and a charming narrow street. Use different decorative tape patterns above the photos.

Arrange the lower two-thirds like an illustrated infographic with colorful doodles and handwritten Chinese headings in red and blue. Include 5 main content sections: a geographic description block at the top right; a “best travel season” section on the left with Chinese text recommending spring and autumn, decorated with a leaf doodle and a small sun icon; a “main attractions and features” section on the left-middle listing exactly 3 items in Chinese with bullet points: Forbidden City, Badaling Great Wall, and Shichahai & hutongs, accompanied by line-art sketches of a palace pavilion, the Great Wall, hutong houses, and a small tricycle; a “must-eat foods” section on the lower left listing exactly 3 foods in Chinese with bullet points: Peking duck, zhajiangmian, and douzhi, alongside cute food illustrations of a roast duck platter, a bowl of noodles with chopsticks, and a surprised face doodle; and a “tips” section near the lower middle with exactly 2 advice lines in Chinese, each with a small icon, one about wearing comfortable shoes because attractions are large, and one about booking tickets in advance because holidays are crowded.

Add a small outline map of China near the center-right with Beijing marked by a red star and a curved arrow pointing to it. Place a traditional stone guardian lion illustration on the right side with a comic-style handwritten Chinese callout bubble saying it is super imposing. Add a highlighted recommendation box with a scalloped red outline containing exactly 2 recommended places in Chinese: Temple of Heaven Park with a note about praying for good harvests, and Nanluoguxiang; decorate this box with 2 architectural illustrations, one of the Temple of Heaven and one of a traditional gate building. At the very bottom, include a bold handwritten Chinese quote line in dark blue with red emphasis marks, plus 3 doodles beside it: a retro camera, the Bird’s Nest stadium with a small red heart, and the CCTV Headquarters building.

Overall style: cozy travel journal infographic, hand-drawn pen-and-watercolor look, slightly naive sketch style, scrapbook collage, cream paper texture, muted red and navy blue palette with soft greens and warm browns, playful but informative layout, highly legible mixed typography, clean composition, nostalgic tourism poster feel.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张迷人的手绘复古旅行剪贴簿海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="北京"}，设计成一张放在木质桌面上的暖色调陈旧纸张，呈现出中文插画旅游指南页面的效果。构图为单张竖版海报，具有略显磨损的笔记本页面外观、柔和的污渍、折角、胶带痕迹、邮戳般的墨迹以及随性的拼贴美学。在顶部中心位置，放置醒目的黑色大号中文书法标题 {argument name="city name" default="北京"}，下方用随性的蓝色笔触书写英文单词 {argument name="english city name" default="Beijing"}。在标题附近，添加一枚红色小印章，并在右上角添加一段简短的中文文本块，用深蓝色手写体中文描述该城市的地理位置。

在标题下方，包含 4 张以略微不规则的行排列的宝丽来风格旅行照片，每张照片的白色边框上都有手写英文说明。照片 1：夕阳下的故宫，带有金色倒影和温暖的橙色光线，说明文字关于温暖的金色调。照片 2：蜿蜒在绿色山峦间的长城，背景是明亮的天空，说明文字关于中国长城景观和青山。照片 3：北海公园湖泊，有柳枝、游船和背景中的白塔，说明文字关于宁静的湖景。照片 4：传统的胡同小巷，有灰砖墙和悬挂的红灯笼，说明文字关于红灯笼和迷人的窄巷。在照片上方使用不同的装饰胶带图案。

将下三分之二区域安排成带有彩色涂鸦和红色及蓝色手写中文标题的插画信息图。包含 5 个主要内容板块：右上角的地理描述块；左侧的“最佳旅游季节”板块，用中文推荐春季和秋季，并装饰有叶子涂鸦和小太阳图标；左中部的“主要景点与特色”板块，用中文列出 3 个项目并带有项目符号：故宫、八达岭长城、什刹海与胡同，并配有宫殿亭台、长城、胡同建筑和小三轮车的线条画；左下部的“必吃美食”板块，用中文列出 3 种食物并带有项目符号：北京烤鸭、炸酱面、豆汁，旁边配有可爱的烤鸭拼盘、一碗面条配筷子以及惊讶表情涂鸦的插画；以及中下部的“小贴士”板块，包含 2 条中文建议，每条建议配有一个小图标，一条关于景点很大建议穿舒适的鞋子，另一条关于假期拥挤建议提前预订门票。

在右中附近添加一张中国轮廓地图，北京处标有红星并有指向它的弯曲箭头。在右侧放置一个传统石狮子插画，配有一个漫画风格的手写中文气泡，写着它非常威严。添加一个带有红色扇形轮廓的突出推荐框，内含 2 个中文推荐地点：天坛公园（附带关于祈求丰收的注释）和南锣鼓巷；用 2 个建筑插画装饰此框，一个是天坛，一个是传统大门建筑。在最底部，包含一行深蓝色的粗体手写中文引语，带有红色强调标记，旁边有 3 个涂鸦：一台复古相机、带有红色小爱心的鸟巢体育场以及中央电视台总部大楼。

整体风格：温馨的旅行日志信息图，手绘钢笔淡彩外观，略带稚气的素描风格，剪贴簿拼贴，奶油色纸张质感，柔和的红色和海军蓝调色板，辅以柔和的绿色和暖棕色，布局生动且信息丰富，混合排版清晰易读，构图整洁，具有怀旧的旅游海报感。

templates.title: Pastel Beach Selfie Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调海滩自拍肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic high-angle beach selfie of a young woman standing on bright white sand under harsh midday sunlight, framed from just above the head to the upper thighs in a vertical smartphone composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair parted in the center and styled into 2 long braided pigtails, one on each side. Her face is mostly obscured by her raised hand shading her eyes from the sun, creating a candid, slightly anonymous look. She is wearing a fitted ribbed deep V-neck cap-sleeve crop top in {argument name="top color" default="pale baby blue"} and low-rise {argument name="bottom color" default="white"} bottoms visible at the waist. Her body is slim with a soft, glamorous fashion-photo look. One arm is extended toward the camera holding the phone for the selfie, while the other hand rests across her forehead to block the sunlight. The lighting is extremely bright and washed with soft pale tones, producing delicate skin highlights, gentle shadows, and a clean airy summer aesthetic. Background is a minimal sandy beach with a faint strip of shoreline and water near the top edge, no other people, no props, no buildings. Style should feel like a polished social-media beach selfie, realistic skin texture, subtle retouching, soft pastel color grading, high detail, natural pose, feminine and youthful summer mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的俯拍海滩自拍，画面中一位年轻女性站在明亮的白沙滩上，正午阳光强烈，采用竖屏手机构图，取景范围从头顶上方至大腿上部。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的中分发型，扎成两条长辫子，垂在两侧。她的脸部大部分被抬起遮挡阳光的手遮住，营造出一种不经意且略带神秘感的氛围。她穿着一件 {argument name="top color" default="淡婴儿蓝"} 的修身罗纹深 V 领短袖露脐上衣，腰间露出 {argument name="bottom color" default="白色"} 的低腰下装。她身材苗条，呈现出柔和迷人的时尚摄影质感。一只手臂伸向镜头进行自拍，另一只手横在额前遮挡阳光。光线极其明亮，带有柔和的淡色调，呈现出细腻的皮肤高光、柔和的阴影以及干净通透的夏日美学。背景为极简的海滩，顶部边缘可见淡淡的海岸线和海水，画面中没有其他人、道具或建筑物。风格应呈现出精致的社交媒体海滩自拍感，具备写实的皮肤纹理、细腻的修图效果、柔和的粉彩色调、高细节、自然的姿态，以及充满女性魅力和青春活力的夏日氛围。

templates.title: Classical Chinese Poem Scroll Landscape

titleLocalized.zh: 中国古典诗词山水画卷

templates.prompt: A classical Chinese ink-wash painting on warm aged rice paper, combining landscape art and calligraphy in a clean two-part composition. On the left half, leave broad negative space filled with bold black brush-calligraphy showing the poem title {argument name="poem title" default="早发白帝城"}, the poet name {argument name="poet name" default="李白"}, and four large vertical lines of poem text in expressive handwritten script: {argument name="poem text" default="朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山。"}. On the right half, paint a serene river gorge at sunrise in the style of a traditional shan shui scroll: a soft orange sun low above misty layered mountains, tall steep cliffs on both sides, faint haze in the distance, and calm reflective water glowing with pale gold light. In the foreground at lower right, place a small wooden river boat with a simple covered cabin and a vertical mast. A solitary ancient Chinese scholar in flowing white hanfu stands on the deck facing the landscape from behind, hair tied in a traditional topknot, long robe and sash slightly trailing in the breeze, creating a contemplative mood. Add a tiny temple pavilion perched high on the top of the right cliff. Use delicate ink outlines, subtle sepia and gray washes, textured paper grain, elegant empty space, and refined literati-painting aesthetics. The overall image should feel poetic, quiet, balanced, and museum-quality, with especially beautiful legible calligraphy integrated into the artwork.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅绘制在暖色调陈年宣纸上的中国古典水墨画，将山水艺术与书法完美融合，构图简洁明快。左侧留出大面积空白，以苍劲有力的黑色毛笔书法书写诗歌标题 {argument name="poem title" default="早发白帝城"}、诗人姓名 {argument name="poet name" default="李白"}，以及四行竖排的诗文，笔触洒脱：{argument name="poem text" default="朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山。"}。右侧描绘一幅传统山水画卷风格的晨曦江峡：一轮柔和的橙色红日低悬于云雾缭绕的层峦叠嶂之上，两侧是高耸陡峭的悬崖，远处薄雾弥漫，平静的水面泛着淡淡的金光。右下角前景处，停泊着一艘带有简易船篷和竖桅的小木船。一位身着飘逸白色汉服的古代文人背对画面伫立在甲板上，发髻高束，长袍与腰带在微风中轻拂，营造出一种沉思的意境。右侧悬崖顶端点缀着一座小巧的寺庙亭台。运用细腻的墨线勾勒、淡雅的赭石与水墨渲染，呈现出纸张纹理、优雅的留白以及精致的文人画美学。整体画面富有诗意、静谧、平衡且具有博物馆级品质，尤其是书法部分清晰易读，与艺术作品融为一体。

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝发兔耳帽动漫少女

templates.prompt: A close-up anime fantasy illustration of a cute young girl in a luminous cathedral-like hall, reaching one hand toward the viewer in strong foreshortened perspective as if inviting them forward. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="light blue"} hair spilling from under an oversized glossy green bunny-eared hood, with one ear flopping across the top left and the other hanging down on the right. Her face is mostly obscured by her hair and the hood, creating a mysterious, shy composition. She wears an elaborate frilly outfit in white, green, and pastel pink, with lace trim, ribbons, and a pink bow at the collar. In her other arm she holds 1 plush toy: a white rabbit doll with pink inner ears, a wide open smile, one button X eye, and a small jester-like collar with tiny bells. The background is a grand blue crystal palace interior with tall glowing arches, soft bloom lighting, reflective floors, sparkling particles, and dreamy ethereal atmosphere. Highly polished anime game key art style, vibrant cool tones, soft highlights, delicate linework, glossy fabric textures, cinematic depth, centered composition, portrait cropped at the chest, whimsical and magical mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫奇幻风格的特写插画，描绘了一位可爱的少女身处类似发光教堂的大厅中，一只手向观众伸出，运用强烈的透视缩短效果，仿佛在邀请观众向前。她留着长长的波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="浅蓝色"} 的发丝从超大号的亮面绿色兔耳帽下倾泻而出，一只耳朵垂在左上方，另一只垂在右侧。她的脸部大部分被头发和兜帽遮住，营造出一种神秘而羞涩的构图。她身穿精致的荷叶边服装，配色为白色、绿色和柔粉色，饰有蕾丝边、丝带和领口的粉色蝴蝶结。她的另一只手臂抱着 1 个毛绒玩具：一只白色兔子玩偶，有着粉色的内耳、咧开的大嘴、一只纽扣 X 型眼睛，以及带有小铃铛的小丑式领圈。背景是一个宏伟的蓝色水晶宫殿内部，拥有高耸的发光拱门、柔和的辉光照明、反光的地面、闪烁的粒子以及梦幻空灵的氛围。高精度的动漫游戏关键视觉图风格，鲜艳的冷色调，柔和的高光，细腻的线条，光泽的织物纹理，电影级的景深，居中构图，胸部以上肖像剪裁，充满奇幻与魔法的氛围。

templates.title: Chinese Prompt Sheet for GPT IMAGE 2

titleLocalized.zh: GPT IMAGE 2 中文提示词文档

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A clean screenshot-like image showing a dark charcoal rounded-rectangle panel filled with dense simplified Chinese prompt text in white sans-serif font, presented as a text document or note on a flat dark background. The composition is a single full-frame panel with generous padding and subtle shadow, like a modern UI card. At the top is a sentence describing the creation of a high-end technology magazine double-page spread poster, with the English title in quotation marks: “GPT IMAGE 2: From Ideas to Images”. Below it are multiple left-aligned paragraphs of Chinese text with consistent line spacing, describing layout ratio, modern editorial design style, and a detailed two-page composition. In the middle section, there is a numbered list with exactly 6 items labeled 1 through 6, each item naming a module in English inside quotation marks followed by Chinese explanations. The 6 module names are exactly: “Photorealism”, “Readable Text”, “Product Mockup”, “Character Consistency”, “Storyboard”, and “World Knowledge”. Under item 2, include 5 separate quoted multilingual text lines as subitems, exactly these: “IDEAS → IMAGES”, “想法 → 图像”, “アイデア → 画像”, “아이디어 → 이미지”, and “فكرة → صورة”. Later in the text, add a section specifying the main title and subtitle as clearly readable quoted English lines: “GPT IMAGE 2” and “From Ideas to Images”. Near the lower portion, add another Chinese line introducing a small caption at the bottom right, followed by the exact quoted English caption: “Typography • Photorealism • Layout • Consistency • Multilingual Text”. At the bottom, include a final Chinese paragraph about visual style requirements such as premium ad feel, Apple-style product photography, Swiss graphic design, soft natural light, refined materials, clear layout, ample whitespace, and avoiding low-quality textures, blurry text, gibberish, or deformed fingers. The text should appear crisp and fully legible, with realistic screen-capture fidelity, high contrast, subtle anti-aliased edges, no illustrations, no icons, no photos, no extra interface chrome beyond the single dark card, and an overall polished editorial-tech presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的截图风格图像，展示了一个深炭灰色圆角矩形面板，上面布满了密集的白色无衬线字体简体中文提示词，呈现为平坦深色背景上的文本文档或笔记。构图为一个带有充足留白和细微阴影的单幅全屏面板，如同现代 UI 卡片。顶部是一句描述创作高端科技杂志双页跨页海报的句子，并附有英文标题：“GPT IMAGE 2: From Ideas to Images”。下方是多段左对齐的中文文本，行间距统一，描述了布局比例、现代编辑设计风格以及详细的双页构图。中间部分是一个包含 6 个项目的编号列表，标注为 1 到 6，每个项目均以引号括起的英文模块名称开头，后接中文解释。这 6 个模块名称分别为：“Photorealism”、“Readable Text”、“Product Mockup”、“Character Consistency”、“Storyboard” 和 “World Knowledge”。在第 2 项下方，包含 5 行独立的引号多语言文本作为子项，内容如下：“IDEAS → IMAGES”、“想法 → 图像”、“アイデア → 画像”、“아이디어 → 이미지” 以及 “فكرة → صورة”。在文本后段，添加一个明确指定主标题和副标题的部分，使用清晰易读的英文引号行：“GPT IMAGE 2” 和 “From Ideas to Images”。在下部区域，添加一行中文介绍右下角的小标题，后接精确的英文引号标题：“Typography • Photorealism • Layout • Consistency • Multilingual Text”。底部包含一段关于视觉风格要求的中文段落，例如高端广告质感、Apple 风格的产品摄影、瑞士平面设计、柔和自然光、精致材质、清晰布局、充足留白，并避免低质量纹理、模糊文字、乱码或手指变形。文本应清晰易读，具有逼真的屏幕截图保真度、高对比度、细微的抗锯齿边缘，不含插图、图标、照片，除单张深色卡片外不含多余的界面元素，整体呈现出精致的编辑科技风格。

templates.prompt: Create a clean premium Japanese tech infographic poster for {argument name="product name" default="Meta Quest 3"}, centered on a vertically stacked exploded view of a white mixed-reality headset floating in space against a soft lavender-to-blue gradient background. At the top, place the Meta logo in blue followed by a large bold black sans-serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="Meta Quest 3"}, with a smaller Japanese tagline beneath: 「まったく新しい現実を、まったく新しい構造から。」. The central subject is a highly polished 3D product render shown as an engineering breakdown with exactly 9 numbered layers, each layer separated evenly from top to bottom and labeled with blue circular number markers on the left side from 1 to 9. The 9 visible layers are: 1) the white outer faceplate shell with three front sensor/camera openings, 2) a row of exactly 3 black tracking camera modules, 3) the main logic board with chips and a clearly visible Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 processor graphic at the center, 4) a pair of large pancake lens assemblies with vivid purple-blue glass reflections, 5) the black internal frame chassis with openings for optics, 6) the battery/electronics bar with glowing blue accents, 7) two white articulated side strap arms, 8) a white fabric head strap loop, 9) a black soft facial interface cushion at the bottom. Add rounded rectangular annotation boxes with thin white borders and subtle transparency on both sides, each connected by fine white leader lines to the corresponding layer. There are exactly 7 feature callout boxes total: 3 on the left and 4 on the right. Left side boxes, from top to bottom, read: 「Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2」 with a chip icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「調整可能なIPD機構」 with an optics adjustment icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「精密設計されたヘッドストラップ」 with a headset strap icon and smaller Japanese body text. Right side boxes, from top to bottom, read: 「フェイスプレート」 with a simple faceplate icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「トラッキングカメラ」 with a camera icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「パンケーキレンズ」 with a dual-lens icon and smaller Japanese body text, 「高性能バッテリー」 with a battery icon and smaller Japanese body text, plus a lower-right box reading 「柔らかなフェイスインターフェース」 with a soft cushion icon and smaller Japanese body text; keep the overall visual balance elegant and symmetric. At the bottom, add a wide white rounded banner spanning most of the width. On its left side place a large bold Japanese statement in blue: 「体験は、構造から進化する。」 and below it smaller Japanese explanatory copy in black. On the right side of the banner place the blue Meta logo and the wordmark “Meta”. Use a sleek Apple-like product marketing style, ultra-sharp 3D rendering, soft studio lighting, subtle glow, precise shadows, glossy plastics, realistic materials, minimal clutter, and a high-end corporate presentation aesthetic.

templates.prompt: A realistic vertical smartphone screenshot of a Chinese livestream interface showing a young woman streamer seated in a cozy dorm room bedroom, front-facing medium close-up selfie composition from chest to head. Her face is intentionally obscured by a large soft rectangular blur centered over the face. She has dark messy black-brown hair in a loose high bun with wispy strands falling around the cheeks, and a small light-colored butterfly hair clip on the left side. She wears a fitted white scoop-neck long-sleeve top layered over delicate lace trim and a thin necklace with a small pendant. Her right hand supports her chin in a casual cute pose, and the mood is soft, intimate, and everyday. The room behind her is a feminine student dorm interior with a loft bed at upper right, white curtains printed with simple blue cartoon characters and stars, a desk with bottles and small items, a wooden chair draped with a pink towel, shelving on the left with plush toys, cosmetics, and bags, and warm indoor ambient lighting. Add full livestream app UI overlays in Chinese across the image, designed like a real mobile live-broadcast app screenshot. Top status bar: time 21:15 at top left, mobile signal, 5G, and battery 68 at top right. Top creator area: a circular avatar, the streamer name {argument name="streamer name" default="叮当猫"}, a red follow button labeled 关注, and a popularity line reading 10万+本场点赞. Add a small ranking badge reading 小时榜第3名. Near the top center-right, include exactly 3 small circular user avatars. At the upper right, add a dark rounded popularity pill reading 10万+, a close X icon, a purple button labeled 更多直播, and a gift progress card reading 礼物展馆 0/24 with a blue tag 经典. Left lower-mid floating gift banner: sender avatar and text 星辰大海 送小心心 with a pink heart icon and x1. Comment area on lower left: exactly 6 stacked translucent chat bubbles with these lines in order: 1. 萌萌小熊：主播今天好美呀～ 2. 小太阳：声音好好听，姐姐是哪里人呀？ 3. 芝士奶盖：主播在干嘛呢～ 4. 糖炒栗子：可以唱首歌吗～ 5. 嘴当的猫猫头：主播好可爱！ 6. 好运连连：关注了主播. Add small blue diamond level badges before the last three comments with the numbers 6, 10, and 21. Bottom input bar: a rounded translucent text field with placeholder 说点什么..., then 4 controls to the right: a smiley icon, a glowing pink heart gift icon, a pink present icon, and a gray three-dots icon. Photorealistic phone capture style, natural skin and fabric texture, mild beauty-camera softness, realistic app overlay transparency, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的竖屏智能手机截图，展示了中文直播界面。画面中，一位年轻女主播坐在温馨的宿舍卧室里，采用胸部以上的中景自拍构图。她的脸部被一个居中的大尺寸柔和矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。她留着深棕黑色的凌乱长发，扎成松散的高丸子头，脸颊两侧有几缕碎发垂下，左侧别着一个浅色的小蝴蝶发夹。她穿着一件修身的白色圆领长袖上衣，内搭精致的蕾丝边，颈间戴着一条带有小吊坠的细项链。她右手托腮，姿势随性可爱，氛围柔和、亲密且充满生活气息。背景是充满少女心的学生宿舍内景：右上角是高架床，白色窗帘上印有简单的蓝色卡通人物和星星，书桌上摆放着瓶瓶罐罐和杂物，木椅上搭着一条粉色毛巾，左侧架子上放着毛绒玩具、化妆品和包包，室内灯光温暖。在图像上方添加完整的中文直播 App UI 覆盖层，设计风格如同真实的手机直播 App 截图。顶部状态栏：左上角显示时间 21:15，右上角显示移动信号、5G 图标及 68% 电量。顶部创作者区域：一个圆形头像，主播名称为 {argument name="streamer name" default="叮当猫"}，一个标有“关注”的红色按钮，以及一行显示“10万+本场点赞”的人气数值。添加一个显示“小时榜第3名”的小型排名徽章。在右上侧附近，包含 3 个小型圆形用户头像。右上角添加一个深色圆角人气胶囊，显示“10万+”，一个关闭 X 图标，一个标有“更多直播”的紫色按钮，以及一个显示“礼物展馆 0/24”并带有“经典”蓝色标签的礼物进度卡。左下侧悬浮礼物横幅：发送者头像及文字“星辰大海 送小心心”，配有一个粉色爱心图标和 x1。左下角评论区：依次排列 6 条半透明聊天气泡，内容如下：1. 萌萌小熊：主播今天好美呀～ 2. 小太阳：声音好好听，姐姐是哪里人呀？ 3. 芝士奶盖：主播在干嘛呢～ 4. 糖炒栗子：可以唱首歌吗～ 5. 嘴当的猫猫头：主播好可爱！ 6. 好运连连：关注了主播。在最后三条评论前添加带有数字 6、10 和 21 的蓝色小钻石等级徽章。底部输入栏：一个圆角半透明文本框，占位符为“说点什么...”，右侧有 4 个控件：一个笑脸图标、一个发光的粉色爱心礼物图标、一个粉色礼盒图标和一个灰色三点图标。照片级逼真的手机拍摄风格，自然的皮肤和织物纹理，带有轻微的美颜相机柔光效果，逼真的 App 覆盖层透明度，9:16 竖屏比例。

In the upper left, show a circular cartoon avatar and a livestream info badge with the streamer name "叮当猫", age "18岁", and the line "直播中 | 10.2万人在看". Add small app icons in the upper right for chat/menu and close. The main scene is a young female college student sitting at a desk, facing the phone camera and waving with one hand. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. She has shoulder-length dark hair and wears large black-and-pink over-ear gaming headphones and a white hoodie with a small cute cat illustration on the chest. She is livestreaming from a tidy, warmly lit dorm bedroom. Behind her is a light-colored loft bed with a safety rail and cream bedding printed with bears and stars, plus a ladder with colorful rungs in orange, green, and blue. Under and beside the loft bed are shelves and a wardrobe area with hanging clothes in pale tones and one bright yellow hoodie. The shelves contain upright books, small plush toys, bottles, and personal items. A ring light is visible on the right edge of the frame. On the desk in front of her, place a smartphone in a clamp stand, a black desktop microphone with a subtle red accent on a mini tripod, open notebooks and papers, stacked textbooks, cosmetics including lipstick and brushes, a clear water bottle, a small black rectangular box, and warm fairy lights scattered across the tabletop. The lighting should feel soft, domestic, and inviting, with realistic indoor shadows and a slight phone-camera look. Overlay exactly 7 floating live chat comments stacked on the lower left in dark translucent rounded boxes with cyan name tags. The comments read, from top to bottom: "弹幕： 主播好可爱！", "弹幕： 叮当猫加油！", "弹幕： 10万+人了！🎉", "弹幕猫： 我也在这个大学", "弹幕： 求同款耳机", "弹幕： 支持主播，爱你💕", "弹幕： 欢迎新人！". At the bottom, include a dark comment input bar with placeholder text "说点什么..." and a row of livestream action icons. On the lower right, add a vertical like area with the label "点赞", a red count bubble showing "9.8万", and a large pink heart button. Overall style: photorealistic Chinese social media livestream screenshot, believable app UI, detailed dorm environment, cute youthful campus streamer aesthetic, natural composition, crisp text rendering, no extra panels.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的竖屏智能手机截图，展示了中国直播 App 中温馨的大学宿舍直播场景。界面应呈现为真实的 iPhone 屏幕截图效果，顶部包含状态栏，显示中国运营商文字、时间 9:16 以及约 67% 的电量。左上角显示一个圆形卡通头像和一个直播信息徽章，包含主播名“叮当猫”、年龄“18岁”以及“直播中 | 10.2万人在看”的字样。右上角添加用于聊天、菜单和关闭的小图标。主体场景为一位年轻的女大学生坐在书桌前，面向手机摄像头挥手。她的面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。她留着齐肩深色短发，戴着大号黑粉色头戴式游戏耳机，身穿一件胸前印有可爱小猫插画的白色连帽衫。她正在整洁、灯光温暖的宿舍卧室中直播。她身后是一张浅色的高架床，配有安全护栏和印有小熊与星星图案的奶油色床上用品，以及带有橙色、绿色和蓝色横档的梯子。高架床下方和侧面是架子和衣柜区，挂着浅色调的衣服和一件亮黄色连帽衫。架子上摆放着竖放的书籍、小型毛绒玩具、瓶子和个人物品。画面右边缘可见一个环形补光灯。她面前的书桌上放置着：夹在支架上的智能手机、一个带有微弱红色点缀并安装在迷你三脚架上的黑色桌面麦克风、打开的笔记本和纸张、堆叠的教科书、包括口红和化妆刷在内的化妆品、一个透明水瓶、一个小黑色长方形盒子，以及散落在桌面上的暖色调串灯。光线应感觉柔和、居家且具有吸引力，带有真实的室内阴影和轻微的手机拍摄质感。在左下角叠加 7 条浮动实时聊天评论，采用深色半透明圆角框，并带有青色名称标签。评论从上到下依次为：“弹幕： 主播好可爱！”，“弹幕： 叮当猫加油！”，“弹幕： 10万+人了！🎉”，“弹幕猫： 我也在这个大学”，“弹幕： 求同款耳机”，“弹幕： 支持主播，爱你💕”，“弹幕： 欢迎新人！”。底部包含一个深色评论输入栏，占位符文字为“说点什么...”，以及一行直播操作图标。右下角添加一个垂直点赞区域，带有“点赞”标签、显示“9.8万”的红色计数气泡以及一个巨大的粉色爱心按钮。整体风格：照片级逼真的中国社交媒体直播截图，可信的 App UI，细节丰富的宿舍环境，可爱的年轻校园主播美学，自然构图，清晰的文字渲染，无多余面板。

templates.title: Chinese Calligraphy Poem Scroll

titleLocalized.zh: 中国书法诗词卷轴

templates.prompt: A traditional Chinese calligraphy painting on aged tan xuan paper, landscape orientation, styled like an antique literati hanging scroll reproduction. The main composition is a large block of bold black semi-cursive to cursive brush calligraphy arranged in 10 vertical columns, read right to left, featuring the poem title at the top of the rightmost main column as {argument name="poem title" default="雨霖铃"}. The calligraphy should feel elegant, fluid, and expressive, with varied ink density, dry-brush texture, thick and thin stroke transitions, and natural hand-written spacing rather than perfect typesetting. Use the visible poem text as written in the image, including its inaccuracies, with the right-side main columns beginning: “寒蝉凄切，对长亭晚，骤雨初歇。都门帐饮无绪，留恋处，兰舟催发，执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎。念去去，千里烟波，暮霭沉沉楚天阔。多情自古，雷情自古伤离别，更那堪冷冷宵，酒醒倦兼芊？杨柳岸，晓风残月。此去经年良宰，经年，应是良辰好景。便纵有千种风情，更与何人说？” Place a narrower signature column on the far left with 1 vertical inscription reading {argument name="signature text" default="柳永《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》"}. Add 4 red seals total: 1 oval collector-style seal near the upper right margin and 3 square seals stacked vertically near the lower left inscription area. Include a faint monochrome ink-wash landscape in the lower right corner with 1 drooping willow tree and 1 small pavilion by the water, partially faded into the paper. The paper should have warm brown aging, subtle stains, mottling, foxing, worn edges, and a museum-photograph feel. Overall mood is refined, poetic, historical, and scholarly, like a Song-dynasty-inspired calligraphy artwork photographed flat in soft even light.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅绘制在陈旧棕色宣纸上的传统中国书法作品，横向构图，呈现出仿古文人挂轴复制品的风格。主体构图为大块粗犷的黑色行草书书法，按从右至左的顺序排列为 10 列纵行，最右侧主列顶部为诗词标题 {argument name="poem title" default="雨霖铃"}。书法应显得优雅、流畅且富有表现力，具有墨色浓淡变化、枯笔质感、笔画粗细过渡，以及自然的手写间距，而非完美的排版。请使用图像中书写的诗词文本，包括其中的笔误，右侧主列开头为：“寒蝉凄切，对长亭晚，骤雨初歇。都门帐饮无绪，留恋处，兰舟催发，执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎。念去去，千里烟波，暮霭沉沉楚天阔。多情自古，雷情自古伤离别，更那堪冷冷宵，酒醒倦兼芊？杨柳岸，晓风残月。此去经年良宰，经年，应是良辰好景。便纵有千种风情，更与何人说？” 在最左侧放置一列较窄的落款，包含 1 行纵向题字 {argument name="signature text" default="柳永《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》"}。总共添加 4 枚红色印章：右上角边缘附近放置 1 枚椭圆形收藏印，左下角落款区域附近垂直堆叠 3 枚方形印章。在右下角加入一处淡淡的单色水墨山水，包含 1 棵垂柳和 1 座水边小亭，部分融入纸张背景中。纸张应呈现出温暖的棕色陈旧感，带有细微的污渍、斑点、霉斑、磨损边缘，并具有博物馆摄影作品的质感。整体氛围雅致、诗意、充满历史感与书卷气，如同在柔和均匀的光线下拍摄的宋代风格书法艺术品。

templates.title: Surreal Woman at a Weathered Window

titleLocalized.zh: 窗前的超现实女性

templates.prompt: A moody surreal painting of a woman leaning forward through an old window frame, shown from behind and cropped tightly so the composition centers on her wildly windblown {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown with copper highlights"} hair streaming left across the image in long tangled strands. Her bare shoulders and upper back are mostly hidden by her hair, and both hands rest on a worn wooden windowsill at the bottom center, with 2 visible fingers on each side gripping the ledge. The face is completely obscured by hair and angle. Behind her is a weathered multi-pane window with 6 rectangular panes in a 3-by-2 grid, painted in cold gray-blue tones with grime, scratches, drips, and distressed edges. Use an expressive mixed-media style combining charcoal, ink, dry brush, scratched lines, and textured oil paint on rough canvas, with sketchy white and black linework layered over muted industrial colors. The mood is introspective, stormy, and haunting, as if wind or emotion is pulling the figure apart. Soft diffused light, subtle contrast, painterly realism fused with abstract expressionism, square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅忧郁的超现实主义画作，描绘了一位女性从旧窗框中探出身子，画面采用背影视角并进行紧凑裁剪，构图聚焦于她被风吹得凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色带铜色挑染"} 头发，发丝向左飘散，缠绕成缕。她裸露的肩膀和上背部大半被头发遮住，双手搭在底部的旧木窗台上，每侧各有 2 根手指抓着窗沿。面部完全被头发和角度遮挡。背景是一扇饱经风霜的多格窗户，采用 3x2 的网格布局，呈现出带有污垢、划痕、水渍和磨损边缘的冷灰蓝色调。采用表现主义的混合媒介风格，结合木炭、墨水、干画笔、划痕线条以及粗糙画布上的纹理油画效果，并在柔和的工业色调上叠加写意的黑白线条。整体氛围内省、狂暴且令人难忘，仿佛风或情绪正在将人物撕裂。柔和的漫射光，微妙的对比度，融合了抽象表现主义的绘画写实风格，方形构图。

templates.title: Girl on Window Seat in Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中窗边的女孩

templates.prompt: A moody storybook-style digital painting of a {argument name="character age" default="young girl"} sitting sideways on a cushioned window seat inside an old European attic room, hugging her knees and gazing out through a large rain-streaked window. She has {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown"} slightly messy shoulder-length hair, a cozy oversized cable-knit sweater, and soft striped socks, with bare legs tucked close to her body. The composition is intimate and contemplative, viewed from inside the room at a slight angle, with the child placed in the lower left foreground and the rainy city filling the right side and background. Outside the window is a dense cluster of steep-roofed old town houses, chimneys, crooked rooftops, and 2 tall vintage street lamps visible near the window, all under a dramatic overcast sky with heavy layered storm clouds and visible falling rain. The glass is covered with raindrops, rivulets, and wet reflections, and the rooftops outside are mostly muted gray, while the interior glows with warm amber light from the left, creating a strong contrast between the cozy room and the cold storm outside. Include a patterned cushion behind her, a worn upholstered bench with subtle floral fabric, dark curtains framing the left edge, and soft painterly textures with detailed brushwork on wood, fabric, hair, and rain. Color palette: warm browns, beige, muted gold, slate gray, charcoal, and soft silver. Atmosphere: melancholic, quiet, nostalgic, cinematic, whimsical, and emotionally tender. Highly detailed, painterly illustration, children’s book fantasy realism, dramatic lighting, depth through layered rooftops, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满情绪的绘本风格数字绘画，画面中一位 {argument name="character age" default="小女孩"} 侧身坐在老式欧洲阁楼房间的软垫窗台上，双膝相拥，凝视着窗外雨水冲刷的景象。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色"} 略显凌乱的齐肩短发，穿着一件舒适的超大号麻花针织毛衣和柔软的条纹袜，赤裸的双腿蜷缩在身体旁。构图亲密且富有沉思感，从室内侧向视角观察，女孩位于左下角前景，雨中的城市占据了右侧和背景。窗外是密集的尖顶老式联排房屋、烟囱、歪斜的屋顶，窗边可见 2 盏高大的复古路灯，天空阴沉，层叠的暴雨云层密布，雨水清晰可见。玻璃上布满了雨滴、水痕和湿润的倒影，窗外的屋顶多为柔和的灰色，而室内左侧则散发着温暖的琥珀色光芒，营造出温馨室内与寒冷风暴之间的强烈对比。画面包含她身后的花纹靠垫、带有精致花卉面料的磨损软垫长凳、勾勒左侧边缘的深色窗帘，以及在木材、织物、头发和雨水上呈现出细腻笔触的柔和绘画质感。调色板：暖棕色、米色、柔和金、板岩灰、炭黑色和柔和银色。氛围：忧郁、宁静、怀旧、电影感、奇幻且情感细腻。高度细节化，绘画风格插画，童书奇幻写实主义，戏剧性光影，通过层叠屋顶展现深度，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Sad Child by Rainy Window

titleLocalized.zh: 雨窗边的忧郁孩童

templates.prompt: A moody storybook-style digital painting of a small sad child sitting curled up on a wooden stool beside a large rain-streaked window, indoors in a dim gray room. The child has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} wild tangled messy hair, huge expressive eyes, pale skin with a few freckles, and a worried, lonely expression, hugging their knees tightly to their chest. They wear oversized {argument name="pajama pattern" default="muted blue-gray pajamas with small orange patches or floral shapes"} and soft worn slippers. Outside the window is a bleak rainy city street with 4 leaning old buildings visible, 4 wind-bent trees, a slick winding road, and dramatic swirling storm clouds, all painted in an exaggerated crooked perspective. The composition places the child on the left and the window view dominating the right, creating a feeling of isolation and melancholy. Use a painterly, hand-brushed, textured illustration style with visible rough brushstrokes, desaturated blue-gray tones, soft charcoal shadows, subtle highlights on the wet glass, and only faint warm accents in the child’s clothing. Evoke emotional children’s book art in the vein of dark whimsical gothic illustration, intimate, cinematic, rainy-day sadness, high detail, square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满情绪感的绘本风格数字绘画，描绘了一个瘦小的忧郁孩童，蜷缩在阴暗灰色房间里的一张木凳上，身旁是一扇布满雨痕的大窗户。孩童有着 {argument name="hair color" default="深褐色"} 凌乱蓬松的头发、一双巨大且富有表现力的眼睛、苍白的皮肤和几点雀斑，表情忧虑而孤独，双手紧紧抱着膝盖。他们穿着超大号的 {argument name="pajama pattern" default="带有橙色小补丁或花朵图案的柔和蓝灰色睡衣"} 和柔软破旧的拖鞋。窗外是凄凉的雨中城市街道，可见 4 栋倾斜的老建筑、4 棵被风吹弯的树、一条湿滑蜿蜒的道路，以及戏剧性翻滚的乌云，整体采用夸张的扭曲透视手法绘制。构图将孩童置于左侧，窗外景色占据右侧，营造出一种孤立与忧郁的氛围。采用具有手绘质感的绘画风格，保留明显的粗糙笔触，色调为低饱和度的蓝灰色，配以柔和的炭笔阴影，湿润玻璃上有细微的高光，孩童的衣物上仅有淡淡的暖色点缀。呈现出类似于暗黑奇幻风格的儿童绘本艺术感，私密、电影感、雨天的忧伤，高细节，方形构图。

templates.title: Gothic Girl at Rainy Window

titleLocalized.zh: 雨窗边的哥特女孩

templates.prompt: A moody gothic storybook illustration in thick impasto oil-paint style, showing a solitary little girl sitting curled up on a cushioned window seat inside a dim old room during a rainy evening. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} wild tangled hair, a large oversized knit sweater in {argument name="sweater color" default="rust red"}, black-and-cream striped stockings, and dark lace-up boots. Her pose is introspective and withdrawn, knees pulled to her chest, arms wrapped around her legs, gazing out through a tall multi-pane window. Outside the glass is a crooked, haunted-looking European village street with steep rooftops, spires, glowing windows, slick cobblestones, and a prominent clock tower, all under a gray stormy sky. Include exactly 1 small umbrella-carrying figure walking alone in the rain on the street. Inside the room, include exactly 1 hanging industrial lamp with warm yellow light in the upper left, exactly 1 red ceramic mug on the windowsill, exactly 1 open sketchbook on the bench with a dark cat drawing visible on one page, exactly 2 red pillows, and a few tiny framed wall pictures on the left. The palette is charcoal gray, sepia, black, and muted amber, with warm interior highlights contrasting against the cold wet exterior. The composition is slightly tilted and cinematic, with the girl placed left of center and the rain-soaked town filling the right side of the frame. Emphasize melancholy, loneliness, gothic whimsy, textured brushstrokes, scratched paint, dramatic window reflections, and a dark fairy-tale atmosphere in a square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满情绪感的哥特绘本插画，采用厚涂油画风格，描绘了一个孤独的小女孩在雨夜里蜷缩在昏暗老屋的软垫窗台上。她有着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的凌乱卷发，穿着一件 {argument name="sweater color" default="铁锈红"} 的大号针织毛衣，搭配黑米条纹长袜和深色系带靴子。她姿态内敛，双膝抱胸，正凝视着高大的多格窗外。玻璃外是一条歪斜、带有闹鬼气息的欧洲村庄街道，有着陡峭的屋顶、尖塔、闪烁的窗户、湿滑的鹅卵石路以及一座显眼的钟楼，背景是灰暗的暴风雨天空。画面中需包含 1 个在雨中独自撑伞行走的人物。室内需包含左上方 1 盏散发暖黄色光芒的工业吊灯、窗台上 1 个红色陶瓷马克杯、长凳上 1 本打开的素描本（页面可见一幅黑猫画作）、2 个红色枕头，以及左侧墙上几幅小巧的装裱画。色调以炭灰、深褐、黑和柔和的琥珀色为主，温暖的室内光影与寒冷潮湿的室外形成对比。构图略微倾斜且具有电影感，女孩位于中心偏左，雨水浸润的小镇占据画面右侧。强调忧郁、孤独、哥特式奇幻、纹理笔触、刮擦痕迹、戏剧性的窗户倒影以及正方形构图下的暗黑童话氛围。

templates.title: Anime Summer Street Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫夏日街头海报

templates.prompt: A high-energy vertical anime street poster inspired by a pirate adventure crew, designed like a stylish summer campaign key visual in a modern Japanese shopping street under a vivid blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Show exactly 8 characters grouped closely in the foreground and midground, all happily eating colorful ice cream cones while walking through the city. Center front: a young man in a wide straw hat, oversized red graphic T-shirt, blue shorts, and a black crossbody waist bag, holding a mint-blue ice cream cone. Front left: a green-haired young man in a black oversized graphic shirt with green lettering and layered necklaces, eating ice cream. Front right: a small chibi-like reindeer mascot character wearing a large pink hat with a white X, black and pink streetwear jacket, and holding a blue-and-pink ice cream cone. Right midground: a long-nosed smiling young man in a cap and casual streetwear, loudly laughing with an ice cream cone; behind him a tall skeleton man with a large black afro, crown-like hat, purple hoodie, sunglasses, and an ice cream cone. Left midground: an orange-haired young woman in a cropped white tank top and jeans holding ice cream; behind center-left a blond young man in a blue shirt with a relaxed pose and ice cream; center-right a dark-haired young woman in a purple outfit with sunglasses on her head holding ice cream. The mood is cheerful, summery, fashionable, and adventurous. Make the composition feel like a premium anime tourism or retail poster with dramatic perspective from street level, dense urban signage, shop windows, hanging signs, and branded poster panels. Add large brush-script title text across the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="ONE PIECE"} in huge white paint strokes, with a yellow handwritten subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Straw Hat Crew"}. On the upper left, stack poster text blocks reading exactly: "STRAW HAT CREW", "2024", "WE GO! TOGETHER! NEW WORLD!". On the right side, add a vertical street sign reading "New World". Include a pink hanging sign reading "ICE CREAM" with a skull emblem. Add pirate-skull hat emblems in the corners and on storefront signage. At the lower left, place white handwritten script reading "Enjoy! Ice Cream" with a small smiley, and beneath it smaller bold text reading "一起去吃冰淇淋吧！". At the lower left edge add small text: "I'M GONNA BE KING OF THE PIRATES!". At the lower right add "ONE PIECE 2024", a barcode, and tiny caption text "STRAW HAT CREW SUMMER ICE CREAM". Use glossy anime illustration rendering, bold cel shading, crisp line art, rich fabric folds, detailed accessories, vibrant summer lighting, cinematic contrast, poster-grade typography, and a polished commercial key art finish. Aspect ratio 2:3 portrait.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的竖版动漫街头海报，灵感源自海盗冒险团队，设计风格如同现代日本商业街的时尚夏季宣传主视觉图，背景为湛蓝天空与蓬松白云。画面前景和中景需精确展示 8 个角色，他们正开心地吃着色彩缤纷的冰淇淋球，漫步在城市中。正前方中心：一名戴着宽檐草帽的年轻男子，身穿超大号红色印花 T 恤、蓝色短裤，斜挎黑色腰包，手持薄荷蓝色冰淇淋。左前方：一名绿发年轻男子，身穿带有绿色字母的黑色超大号印花衬衫，佩戴叠层项链，正在吃冰淇淋。右前方：一个类似 Q 版驯鹿的吉祥物角色，戴着带有白色 X 标志的大粉色帽子，身穿黑粉色街头风夹克，手持蓝粉色冰淇淋。右中景：一名戴着帽子、穿着休闲街头服饰的长鼻子年轻男子，正拿着冰淇淋开怀大笑；他身后是一个高大的骷髅男，留着黑色大爆炸头，戴着皇冠状帽子、紫色连帽衫和太阳镜，手里拿着冰淇淋。左中景：一名橙发年轻女子，身穿白色短款背心和牛仔裤，手持冰淇淋；中左后方是一名身穿蓝色衬衫的年轻金发男子，姿态放松，手持冰淇淋；中右方是一名深色头发的年轻女子，身穿紫色套装，头上架着太阳镜，手持冰淇淋。整体氛围欢快、夏日感十足、时尚且充满冒险气息。构图需呈现出高级动漫旅游或零售海报的质感，采用街头视角的戏剧性透视，包含密集的城市招牌、商店橱窗、悬挂式标牌和品牌海报板。在顶部添加巨大的白色笔触书法标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="ONE PIECE"}，并配以黄色的手写副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Straw Hat Crew"}。在左上方，堆叠排列海报文本块，内容需完全一致："STRAW HAT CREW"、"2024"、"WE GO! TOGETHER! NEW WORLD!"。在右侧，添加一个写有 "New World" 的竖向路牌。包含一个写有 "ICE CREAM" 并带有骷髅标志的粉色悬挂标牌。在角落和店面招牌上添加海盗骷髅帽标志。在左下角，放置白色手写体 "Enjoy! Ice Cream" 并配以小笑脸，下方添加较小的加粗文本 "一起去吃冰淇淋吧！"。在左下边缘添加小字："I'M GONNA BE KING OF THE PIRATES!"。在右下角添加 "ONE PIECE 2024"、条形码以及微小的说明文字 "STRAW HAT CREW SUMMER ICE CREAM"。采用光泽感动漫插画渲染、大胆的赛璐珞阴影、清晰的线条艺术、丰富的布料褶皱、精细的配饰、鲜艳的夏日光影、电影级对比度、海报级排版以及精致的商业主视觉成品效果。长宽比为 2:3 竖版。

templates.title: Little Prince Shanghai Rain Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 小王子上海雨中海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic vertical poster inspired by The Little Prince, set on a rainy city street at blue hour in modern Shanghai. In the center foreground, a small child in Little Prince styling stands in side profile facing right, with messy curly golden-blond hair, a long flowing mustard-gold scarf blowing dramatically to the left, and a muted sage-green ankle-length coat tied at the waist. The child holds 1 single red rose upright in both hands. The face is simplified and softly obscured, with no detailed facial features. The wet pavement reflects neon lights, traffic, and the evening sky. In the background, the Oriental Pearl Tower rises softly out of the dusk with glowing pinkish lights, surrounded by blurred city buildings, storefronts, pedestrians, and car headlights, creating a dreamy bokeh urban atmosphere. On the upper right, include 1 street sign mounted on a traffic pole reading {argument name="street sign text" default="星球大道\nPLANET AVE."}. Also on the pole, include 1 red pedestrian traffic light showing a standing human figure. On the left side, place large handwritten brush-style Chinese quote text in warm pale yellow: {argument name="main quote" default="重要的东西，\n用眼睛是看不见的。"}, with a smaller signature line beneath reading {argument name="author text" default="—— 小王子"}. Scatter a few tiny hand-drawn star doodles and 1 small planet doodle around the text. Near the lower left, add 3 lines of small warm-yellow Chinese dedication text above a stylized script title reading {argument name="title text" default="Le Petit Prince"}. On the right side near the pole, tape 1 small paper note with handwritten Chinese text about not seeing truly important things with the eyes, plus a simple doodle. Add 1 vertical storefront sign on the left reading "咖啡". The composition should feel poetic, nostalgic, gentle, and premium, like an art-house movie poster or literary inspirational street poster. Color palette: twilight blue sky, amber street glow, soft gold typography, muted green clothing, vivid red rose. Shallow depth of field, glossy rain reflections, soft cinematic lighting, highly detailed illustration with realistic urban atmosphere and storybook character design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张灵感源自《小王子》的电影感竖版海报，背景设定在现代上海蓝调时刻的雨中街道。画面前景中央，一位身着小王子风格服饰的孩童侧身向右站立，留着凌乱的金色卷发，一条长长的芥末金围巾向左戏剧性地飘动，身穿一件腰间系带的柔和鼠尾草绿长款大衣。孩童双手垂直捧着 1 朵红玫瑰。面部处理简约且柔和模糊，没有具体的五官细节。湿漉漉的地面映照出霓虹灯、车流和夜空。背景中，东方明珠塔在暮色中柔和地耸立，闪烁着粉红色的光芒，周围环绕着模糊的城市建筑、店面、行人和车灯，营造出梦幻般的城市虚化氛围。在右上角，包含 1 个安装在交通杆上的路牌，文字为 {argument name="street sign text" default="星球大道\nPLANET AVE."}。同样在杆子上，包含 1 个显示站立人形的红色行人交通灯。在左侧，放置用温暖淡黄色书写的巨大手写毛笔风格中文引语：{argument name="main quote" default="重要的东西，\n用眼睛是看不见的。"}，下方附有一行较小的署名：{argument name="author text" default="—— 小王子"}。在文字周围散落着几个微小的手绘星星涂鸦和 1 个小行星涂鸦。在左下角附近，在 1 个风格化的手写体标题 {argument name="title text" default="Le Petit Prince"} 上方添加 3 行温暖的黄色中文寄语。在右侧靠近杆子的地方，贴着 1 张写有关于“用眼睛看不见真正重要之物”的中文手写便签，并配有简单的涂鸦。在左侧添加 1 个写有“咖啡”的竖式店招。构图应充满诗意、怀旧、温柔且高级，如同艺术电影海报或文学励志街头海报。配色方案：暮色蓝天空、琥珀色街灯光、柔和金色字体、鼠尾草绿服饰、鲜艳红玫瑰。浅景深，光泽感的雨水反射，柔和的电影光效，高度精细的插画，融合了写实的城市氛围与绘本角色设计。

templates.title: Sunlit Suit Portrait With Red Rose

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光下的西装肖像与红玫瑰

templates.prompt: A moody minimalist portrait of a young man in a formal black suit, white dress shirt, and black tie, standing against a plain light beige wall in warm late-afternoon sunlight. He is shown from the chest up, slightly angled, with his face mostly obscured by shadow and framing, emphasizing the jawline, neck, ear, and tousled short black hair. In one hand he delicately holds exactly 1 long-stemmed red rose with 1 bloom and a few small green leaves, positioned beside his chest. Strong directional golden light from the left casts a crisp shadow of both the man and the rose onto the wall, creating a cinematic romantic atmosphere. Clean editorial photography, soft natural skin tones, high contrast between the dark suit and sunlit wall, shallow luxury fashion aesthetic, centered composition, realistic photo style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义风格的忧郁肖像，一位年轻男子身着黑色正装、白色衬衫并系着黑色领带，站在浅米色的素色墙前，沐浴在午后温暖的阳光中。画面为半身像，略微侧身，面部大部分被阴影和构图遮挡，突显出下颌线、颈部、耳朵和凌乱的黑色短发。他的一只手轻柔地拿着一朵长茎红玫瑰，花朵盛开，带有几片绿叶，置于胸前。来自左侧强烈的定向金色光线将男子和玫瑰的清晰阴影投射在墙上，营造出电影般的浪漫氛围。干净的编辑摄影风格，柔和自然的肤色，深色西装与阳光墙面形成高对比度，浅景深奢华时尚美学，居中构图，写实摄影风格。

templates.title: Dark Wuxia Game Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑武侠游戏海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical cinematic poster for the dark wuxia action game {argument name="game title" default="Phantom Blade Zero"}, painted in an ultra-detailed gritty concept-art style with realistic textures, moody volumetric fog, and high contrast lighting. The scene shows 1 lone swordsman standing in the lower center foreground, viewed mostly from behind in a three-quarter pose, wearing a wide straw hat and layered black robes shredded into long wind-whipped strips, with pale loose hair streaming out beneath the hat. He holds 1 drawn sword low in his right hand, the blade catching cold silver light. The environment is a ruined ancient Chinese city of towering wooden pagodas and fortress-like buildings rising into steep cliffs, with collapsing architecture, hanging chains, smoke, drifting ash, and rubble. A bright full moon glows near the top center behind dense storm clouds, backlighting the skyline and the warrior. The color palette is almost monochrome charcoal, black, steel gray, and moonlit white, punctuated by sharp crimson slashes and blood-like streaks cutting diagonally across the composition. At the very top, place 4 huge Chinese calligraphy characters in explosive white brushstroke ink reading {argument name="main Chinese title" default="影之刃零"}, spanning nearly the full width. Directly beneath, centered, add the small elegant serif English subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="PHANTOM BLADE ZERO"}. At the bottom center, add 1 line of Chinese tagline text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="刀光即命运 影尽方归零"}, with the final character in red, plus 1 smaller line of Chinese promotional text beneath it. Add subtle ornamental divider lines and a tiny red seal-like emblem at the bottom. Composition should feel like an official AAA key art poster: epic, ominous, martial, supernatural, and intensely atmospheric, with dynamic wind, debris, embers, torn fabric, and ink-splatter energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的暗黑武侠动作游戏 {argument name="game title" default="Phantom Blade Zero"} 电影感竖版海报，采用超精细的硬核概念艺术风格绘制，具备逼真的纹理、阴郁的体积雾和高对比度光影。画面下方中心处站着 1 名孤独的剑客，以背影为主的三分之二侧身姿态呈现，头戴宽大斗笠，身穿层叠的黑色长袍，长袍被风吹得破碎成条状，苍白的散发从斗笠下飘逸而出。他右手低垂握着 1 把出鞘的剑，剑身闪烁着冷冽的银光。背景是一座荒废的中国古城，高耸的木质塔楼和堡垒般的建筑矗立在陡峭的悬崖上，伴随着坍塌的建筑、悬挂的铁链、烟雾、飘落的灰烬和瓦砾。一轮明亮的满月在顶端中心浓密的风暴云后发出光芒，为天际线和战士勾勒出轮廓。色调几乎是单色的炭黑、钢灰和月光白，并点缀着横跨构图的锐利深红色斩痕和血迹般的条纹。在最上方，放置 4 个巨大的白色爆炸式笔触书法汉字 {argument name="main Chinese title" default="影之刃零"}，几乎横跨整个宽度。正下方居中处，添加一行优雅的小型衬线英文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="PHANTOM BLADE ZERO"}。在底部中心，添加 1 行中文标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="刀光即命运 影尽方归零"}，最后一个字设为红色，并在其下方添加 1 行较小的中文宣传文字。底部加入精致的装饰性分割线和一个微小的红色印章式徽标。整体构图应呈现出官方 AAA 级主视觉海报的质感：史诗、不祥、武侠、超自然且极具氛围感，并融入动态的风、碎片、余烬、撕裂的布料和水墨飞溅的能量感。

templates.title: Anime Pop Sphynx Cat Outing Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫波普风斯芬克斯猫出行海报

templates.prompt: A vibrant anime-pop poster style selfie illustration of a young person carrying a Sphynx cat in a black front pet sling while holding a tan leash high in one hand. The person has short messy black hair, round glasses, and wears a black hoodie or dark oversized jacket; the face is intentionally obscured by a centered square blur block. The cat is the clear focal point in the lower center, a hairless pale pink Sphynx with very large ears, bright blue eyes, detailed skin folds, and a cozy brown knitted sweater with a collar. Use a dynamic upward selfie angle, with the raised fist and looping leash occupying the upper right. The background is a dense, celebratory amusement-park or festival scene rendered in explosive saturated colors, with electric blue dominating, plus confetti, paint splashes, stars, comic-style stickers, and playful signage. Include exactly 1 large Chinese headline at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="带皮子出去玩"} in oversized chunky bubble lettering with thick white outline and multicolor fill, exactly 1 pink paw-print icon near the headline, exactly 2 yellow exclamation marks near the raised hand, exactly 1 speech-bubble sticker on the left reading {argument name="left sticker text" default="GO!"}, exactly 1 speech-bubble sticker on the right reading {argument name="right sticker text" default="YEAH"}, exactly 1 paw-print speech bubble near the lower left, and exactly 2 pink heart icons near the cat. Make the composition feel energetic, cute, and chaotic, with bold cel-shaded outlines, glossy highlights, textured brush strokes, posterized lighting, high contrast, and a richly detailed neon comic aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的动漫波普风格自拍插画，画面中一名年轻人背着黑色宠物前置包，包里装着一只斯芬克斯猫，另一只手高举着棕褐色的牵引绳。人物留着凌乱的黑色短发，戴着圆框眼镜，身穿黑色连帽衫或深色大码夹克；面部被居中的方形模糊块刻意遮挡。猫咪是画面下方的视觉焦点，这是一只皮肤呈浅粉色的无毛斯芬克斯猫，有着大大的耳朵、明亮的蓝色眼睛、细腻的皮肤褶皱，并穿着一件舒适的棕色针织领口毛衣。采用动态的仰拍自拍视角，高举的拳头和环绕的牵引绳占据右上角。背景是热闹的游乐园或节日场景，采用爆炸性的饱和色彩渲染，以电光蓝为主色调，辅以五彩纸屑、颜料溅射、星星、漫画风格贴纸和趣味标牌。在顶部添加 1 个巨大的中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="带皮子出去玩"}，使用超大号的粗体气泡字体，带有厚实的白色描边和多色填充；在标题附近添加 1 个粉色爪印图标；在举起的手部附近添加 2 个黄色感叹号；在左侧添加 1 个对话气泡贴纸，文字为 {argument name="left sticker text" default="GO!"}；在右侧添加 1 个对话气泡贴纸，文字为 {argument name="right sticker text" default="YEAH"}；在左下方添加 1 个爪印对话气泡；并在猫咪附近添加 2 个粉色爱心图标。整体构图充满活力、可爱且略显混乱，运用大胆的赛璐珞风格轮廓线、光泽高光、纹理笔触、海报化光影、高对比度以及细节丰富的霓虹漫画美学。

templates.title: Anime Last Supper Ensemble

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫版《最后的晚餐》群像

templates.prompt:
A dark, cinematic anime group portrait inspired by The Last Supper, set in a long stone banquet hall at night. Show exactly 11 seated or leaning female characters arranged shoulder to shoulder behind a long table covered with a white tablecloth, viewed straight on in a wide symmetrical composition. In the exact center is a blonde knightly woman in ornate blue-and-silver armor and a royal-blue dress, posed as the visual focal point with both armored arms extended along the table. In front of her sits a glowing golden chalice radiating warm light upward onto the faces and hands of the group. Behind them, three tall arched windows reveal a twilight landscape with a huge tree silhouetted against a dusky sky. The ceiling has dark wooden beams, and the side walls are lined with large shadowy framed paintings.

The 11 characters should feel like a crossover ensemble of iconic anime-style women with varied silhouettes, hairstyles, and fashion. From left to right: 1) a woman in a glossy red skintight futuristic suit, leaning forward with one hand on the table; 2) a dark-haired woman in muted military-style clothing close beside her; 3) a pale gothic girl in a black dress with long sleeves, hands lifted with delicate fingers; 4) a short blonde woman in a loose white T-shirt, casual and modern; 5) a tall red-haired woman in a white shirt standing slightly behind the others; 6) the central blonde armored knight in blue; 7) a black-haired woman in a black dress with gold accessories and a headpiece, raising one finger; 8) a glamorous woman in a red embroidered dress with long black hair; 9) a dark-haired woman in a low-cut black outfit leaning inward; 10) a teal twin-tailed virtual-idol-like girl in a sleeveless outfit; 11) a green-haired girl in a pale patterned dress seated with crossed legs at the far right, holding a wine glass. Keep all faces attractive anime faces, mature young-adult women, elegant rather than caricatured.

On the table, include exactly 11 place settings, 8 visible wine glasses with red wine, several loaves of bread and scattered rolls, plates, silverware, crumbs, and a few metallic goblets or cups. The warm chalice light should illuminate the center while the rest of the room falls into moody shadow. Use painterly realism, high-detail anime illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro, subdued brown and blue ambience with red accents, solemn yet slightly decadent atmosphere, ultra-wide panoramic framing, masterpiece quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
一幅黑暗、电影质感的动漫群像肖像，灵感源自《最后的晚餐》，场景设定在夜晚长长的石砌宴会厅内。画面采用正面对称的宽幅构图，展示 11 位女性角色肩并肩坐在长桌后或倚靠在桌边。正中央是一位金发女骑士，身穿华丽的蓝银色盔甲与宝蓝色礼服，作为视觉焦点，双臂戴着盔甲平放在桌面上。她面前放着一只发光的金色圣杯，散发出温暖的光芒，映照在众人的脸庞与手上。她们身后是三扇高大的拱形窗，窗外可见暮色景观，一棵巨大的树木剪影映衬在昏暗的天空中。天花板上有深色的木梁，侧墙上挂着几幅巨大的阴影画框。

这 11 位角色应呈现出一种标志性动漫女性的跨界组合感，拥有各异的轮廓、发型与服饰。从左至右依次为：1) 一位身穿亮面红色紧身未来感战衣的女性，身体前倾，单手撑在桌上；2) 一位紧挨着她的深色头发女性，身穿低调的军装风格服饰；3) 一位身穿黑色长袖礼服的苍白哥特风少女，双手抬起，手指纤细；4) 一位身穿宽松白色 T 恤的短发金发女性，休闲且现代；5) 一位身穿白衬衫、站在其他人身后稍远处的红发高挑女性；6) 中央身穿蓝色盔甲的金发女骑士；7) 一位身穿黑色礼服、佩戴金色配饰与头饰的黑发女性，正竖起一根手指；8) 一位身穿红色刺绣礼服、留着黑色长发的迷人女性；9) 一位身穿黑色低胸装、向内侧倾斜身体的黑发女性；10) 一位留着青色双马尾、身穿无袖服饰的虚拟偶像风格少女；11) 一位身穿浅色花纹礼服的绿发少女，坐在最右侧，双腿交叠，手持酒杯。所有角色需保持精致的动漫面孔，呈现成熟年轻女性的优雅气质，而非夸张的漫画风格。

桌上需摆放 11 套餐具，包括 8 只可见的红酒杯、几块面包与散落的面包卷、餐盘、银器、面包屑以及几只金属高脚杯或酒杯。温暖的圣杯光芒应照亮中心区域，而房间其余部分则沉浸在阴郁的阴影中。采用绘画般的写实风格、高细节动漫插画、戏剧性的明暗对照法，以棕色和蓝色为主调，点缀红色，营造出庄重而略带颓废的氛围，超宽全景构图，大师级品质。

templates.title: Anime Selfie With Sphynx Cat

titleLocalized.zh: 与斯芬克斯猫的动漫自拍

templates.prompt: A cute anime-style vertical selfie illustration of a smiling young man with short {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair and large round glasses holding a hairless Sphynx cat in a black sling bag outdoors. The man is shown close-up from the left side of the frame, wearing a black hoodie or jacket, with a cheerful open-mouth smile and bright sparkling eyes, as if taking a selfie. His right hand is raised at the top right, lifting a yellow leash strap. The Sphynx cat is centered and tucked inside the front sling bag, with very large ears, pale pink wrinkled skin, big glossy blue-gray eyes, and a calm slightly curious expression. The cat wears a warm brown sweater with tiny colorful confetti-like shapes and a yellow collar or harness. In the background, show the exterior of a modern transit station or large public building with curved steel beams and glass, under a soft blue sky. Add a decorative sign floating near the upper center with the Chinese text “带皮子出去玩” in a cute ornamental frame. Include soft pastel sparkles, tiny hearts, paw-print accents, star shapes, and a subtle lens flare near the lower left to create a warm playful mood. Clean polished line art, soft shading, pastel lighting, glossy highlights on the glasses and eyes, wholesome slice-of-life anime aesthetic, highly appealing social-media illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的动漫风格竖版自拍插画，画面中一位面带微笑的年轻人留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的短发，戴着圆圆的大眼镜，在户外背着一个黑色斜挎包，包里装着一只无毛斯芬克斯猫。画面左侧为人物特写，他穿着黑色连帽衫或夹克，张嘴开心地笑着，眼睛明亮闪烁，仿佛正在自拍。他的右手举在右上角，拉着一根黄色的牵引绳。斯芬克斯猫位于画面中心，蜷缩在前面的斜挎包里，有着非常大的耳朵、淡粉色的褶皱皮肤、大而有光泽的蓝灰色眼睛，表情平静且略带好奇。猫咪穿着一件温暖的棕色毛衣，上面有细小的彩色五彩纸屑图案，并戴着黄色的项圈或背带。背景展示了现代交通枢纽或大型公共建筑的外部，有着弯曲的钢梁和玻璃，天空呈现柔和的蓝色。在上方中心附近添加一个装饰性浮动标志，框内带有可爱的中文文字“带皮子出去玩”。加入柔和的粉彩闪光、小爱心、爪印装饰、星星形状，并在左下角添加微妙的镜头光晕，营造出温暖俏皮的氛围。线条干净利落，阴影柔和，灯光呈粉彩色，眼镜和眼睛带有光泽感，呈现出治愈系的日常动漫美学，是一幅极具吸引力的社交媒体插画。

templates.title: Influencer Holding Floating Profile Card

titleLocalized.zh: 网红手持悬浮个人资料卡

templates.prompt: A clean lifestyle portrait for a social-media cover image: a stylish young East Asian woman with long wavy black hair sits on a light beige sofa in a bright pastel living room, wearing a light blue and white tweed jacket and matching skirt with pearl buttons over a white top. She holds both hands up in a presentation pose, palms flat and facing upward, as if supporting a floating rectangular profile card. The card is a large white creator-profile panel positioned above her hands on the left side of the frame, with 1 circular black-and-white avatar portrait, 1 bold display name reading {argument name="profile name" default="Dan Koe"}, 1 handle line reading {argument name="profile handle" default="@DanKoeTalks"}, 1 stats line in Chinese showing subscriber and video counts, 1 short bio sentence reading {argument name="bio text" default="If you want harsh truths, read my letters... 更多"}, 1 website link line reading {argument name="website text" default="letters.thedankoe.com"} followed by Chinese text indicating one more link, and 1 dark rounded subscribe button labeled {argument name="button text" default="订阅"}. The woman faces the camera with a polished influencer aesthetic, her expression neutral and friendly. The composition is vertical, centered on her seated pose, with the profile card clearly legible and visually balanced over her hands. The background is softly blurred and elegant, with pale blue walls, geometric wall decor, a shelf with small plants, and soft natural daylight. High-end photography style, bright airy tones, Xiaohongshu cover design, minimal, premium, realistic skin and fabric texture, shallow depth of field.

templates.title: Japanese AI Design Webinar Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 日语 AI 设计网络研讨会缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a clean, modern Japanese webinar thumbnail in a wide 16:9 layout with a corporate tech-design aesthetic. Use a very light gray background with subtle diagonal translucent panels and bold electric-blue geometric accents, including 3 angular blue-and-white ribbon shapes on the right side behind the speaker. The composition is split into 2 main horizontal sections: a large hero area on top and an information bar across the bottom. In the top-left hero area, place a large bold sans-serif Japanese headline in vivid blue on 2 lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="AI×デザインで\n新事業を創出"}. Beneath it, add a dark-blue rectangular banner with centered white bold text reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="〜社員AI活用率90%超・デザイン費削減達成する方法〜"}. On the right half, show a sharply lit half-body portrait of {argument name="speaker name" default="川合 卓也"}, an East Asian man in his 30s with short black hair, wearing a navy blazer over a white crew-neck shirt, arms folded, facing slightly left toward the headline. His face is intentionally obscured by a square skin-tone blur block centered over the face. Next to his torso, place a white rectangular name card with 2 lines of small black Japanese text above a larger bold black name: {argument name="speaker title" default="株式会社SHIFT AI\nデザイン部長/講師"} and {argument name="speaker name" default="川合 卓也"}. Across the bottom, create a white info bar with thin blue vertical dividers and 4 visual components from left to right: 1) a blue gradient angular K logo with the brand text KAWAI DESIGN in black uppercase sans-serif, 2) the date in large blue text reading 2026/2/9, 3) a blue filled circle containing the white Japanese weekday 月 followed by the time 21:30〜22:30 in large blue text, 4) a blue outlined laptop-and-chat icon followed by the blue text オンライン. Keep typography bold and highly legible, with strong hierarchy, generous spacing, precise alignment, minimal clutter, and a polished webinar promotional design suitable for a business landing page or social media thumbnail.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个简洁、现代的 16:9 宽屏日语网络研讨会缩略图，采用企业科技设计风格。使用极浅的灰色背景，搭配微妙的对角半透明面板和醒目的电光蓝几何装饰，包括演讲者身后右侧的 3 个角状蓝白丝带形状。构图分为 2 个主要水平部分：顶部的巨大主视觉区和底部的横向信息栏。在左上角的主视觉区，放置一行醒目的粗体无衬线日语标题，颜色为亮蓝色，分为 2 行，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="AI×设计\n创造新业务"}。在其下方，添加一个深蓝色矩形横幅，中间带有白色粗体文字，内容为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="〜员工 AI 使用率超 90%・实现削减设计成本的方法〜"}。在右半部分，展示一张光线明亮的半身肖像，人物为 {argument name="speaker name" default="川合 卓也"}，一位 30 多岁的东亚男性，留着黑色短发，身穿海军蓝西装外套内搭白色圆领衫，双臂交叉，身体略微向左侧向标题方向。他的面部被一个居中的肤色模糊方块有意遮挡。在他的躯干旁边，放置一张白色矩形名片，上面有 2 行较小的黑色日语文字，下方是较大的粗体黑色姓名：{argument name="speaker title" default="株式会社 SHIFT AI\n设计部长/讲师"} 和 {argument name="speaker name" default="川合 卓也"}。在底部，创建一个白色信息栏，带有细蓝色垂直分隔线，从左到右包含 4 个视觉组件：1) 一个蓝色渐变角状 K 标志，旁边是黑色的 KAWAI DESIGN 大写无衬线品牌文字，2) 以蓝色大字显示的日期 2026/2/9，3) 一个蓝色填充圆圈，内含白色日语星期几“月”，后跟蓝色大字显示的 21:30〜22:30 时间，4) 一个蓝色轮廓的笔记本电脑与聊天图标，后跟蓝色文字“在线”。保持排版粗体且高度易读，具有强烈的层级感、充裕的留白、精确的对齐和极简的布局，打造出适合商业落地页或社交媒体缩略图的精致网络研讨会宣传设计。

templates.title: Shoujo Manga Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 少女漫画杂志封面

templates.prompt: A glossy Japanese shoujo manga magazine cover illustration, packed edge to edge like a real weekly romance comic issue, in a dreamy spring sunset city scene with glowing bokeh lights and falling cherry blossom petals. The cover is dominated by 4 high-school-age characters in fashionable modern anime style. In the foreground, 1 main girl stands large and centered-right, shown from mid-thigh up, with long wavy blonde hair with pink streaks, multiple ear piercings, soft glamorous makeup, and a shy romantic pose with one hand near her lips. She wears a white blouse, a large pink plaid ribbon bow, a pink plaid skirt, a loose pink cardigan slipping off her shoulders, layered necklaces, and a navy school backpack over one shoulder. Behind her stand 3 supporting students: 1 tall handsome boy in a dark school blazer and loosened tie, 1 elegant girl with blonde hair in a braided bun wearing a beige cardigan and school uniform, and 1 shorter dark-haired girl in a school uniform with a ribbon tie. The background shows a glowing pedestrian bridge or riverside walkway at dusk, lined with lights and cherry trees in full bloom, with a pink-orange-purple sky and sparkling romantic atmosphere. The composition should feel like a premium manga cover: highly rendered anime illustration, luminous highlights, delicate linework, glossy print finish, dense overlapping Japanese cover text, issue badges, callouts, hearts, sparkles, and a barcode at the bottom right. Include exactly 7 main text clusters: 1 giant magazine masthead across the top in large bubbly pink Japanese lettering with white outline, 1 vertical romance headline on the right in large pink characters with a huge numeral 3, 2 circular promotional badges on the left, 1 angled banner on the lower left, 1 stacked list of 5 serialized story titles with author names at lower left, and 1 stacked list of 5 serialized story titles with author names near the lower center-right. Add exactly 3 small publication info elements on the upper right: a date/price block, a circular issue number badge, and a narrow vertical tag. Add exactly 1 inset bonus poster preview near the lower right above the barcode. Use a hyper-detailed shoujo manga cover aesthetic, romantic, fashionable, youthful, sparkling, soft glow, sunset rim light, cherry blossom storm, print-magazine realism, intricate typography layering, vibrant pinks and warm golds.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光泽感十足的日本少女漫画杂志封面插图，像真实的周刊浪漫漫画一样排版紧凑，背景为梦幻般的春日夕阳城市，伴有闪烁的焦外成像光斑和飘落的樱花花瓣。封面主体为 4 位时尚现代动漫风格的高中生角色。前景中，1 位主要女生居于右侧偏中位置，以大半身构图呈现，留着带有粉色挑染的长波浪金发，佩戴多个耳环，妆容精致柔美，姿态羞涩浪漫，一只手轻触唇边。她身穿白色衬衫，系着巨大的粉色格纹蝴蝶结，穿着粉色格纹短裙，肩上披着一件滑落的宽松粉色开衫，叠戴项链，单肩背着海军蓝色的书包。她身后站着 3 位配角学生：1 位身材高挑帅气的男生，穿着深色校服西装，领带松散；1 位优雅的女生，金发梳成编织发髻，穿着米色开衫和校服；以及 1 位个子较矮、留着深色短发的女生，穿着系有领结的校服。背景展示了黄昏时分发光的步行桥或河畔步道，两旁灯火通明，樱花盛开，天空呈现粉橙紫渐变色，充满浪漫气息。构图应呈现出高级漫画封面的质感：高渲染动漫插画、明亮的高光、细腻的线条、光面印刷质感、密集的日文封面文字重叠、期号徽章、宣传语、心形图案、闪光效果以及右下角的条形码。包含 7 组主要的文字排版：顶部横跨整个页面的巨大杂志刊名（采用大号粉色气泡感日文字体，带有白色描边），右侧垂直排列的粉色大号浪漫标题（带有巨大的数字“3”），左侧 2 个圆形宣传徽章，左下角 1 个倾斜的横幅，左下角 1 组包含 5 个连载故事标题及作者名的列表，以及右下角附近 1 组包含 5 个连载故事标题及作者名的列表。右上角添加 3 个小型出版信息元素：日期/价格块、圆形期号徽章和 1 个狭长的垂直标签。右下角条形码上方添加 1 个插页式赠品海报预览。采用超精细的少女漫画封面美学，浪漫、时尚、青春、闪耀、柔光、夕阳轮廓光、樱花雨、印刷杂志真实感、复杂的排版层次、鲜艳的粉色和温暖的金色。

templates.title: Explosive Shonen Manga Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 爆炸性少年漫画封面

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-detailed Japanese weekly shonen manga magazine cover, full-bleed, explosive and crowded, with no empty space. The format is a single vertically oriented magazine cover illustration packed with layered typography, character art, motion effects, and urban sci-fi chaos. At the top, a gigantic stylized Japanese masthead in fiery orange-red with heavy black outline and gold edging dominates the width of the page, reading 週刊少年ブレイズ, with a small celebratory badge integrated into the title showing 40年. Add a small slogan line across the very top edge in Japanese. In the top right corner, place a black issue-information box with bright yellow and white text showing the date 2026年4月22日号 and the price 特別価格 380円. The main image features exactly 3 anime characters in a dynamic triangular composition. In the center foreground, the star heroine lunges toward the viewer with strong foreshortening, one hand thrust out almost touching the camera. She is a teenage gyaru-style action heroine with {argument name="hair color" default="light brown with pink streaks"} long wavy hair flying wildly, sharp golden-brown eyes, a confident mischievous grin, sun-kissed skin, multiple ear piercings, and a flashy rebellious street-fighter vibe. Her outfit is black and gold with exactly 6 key visible pieces: a cropped top, a short jacket with metallic trim, short shorts, a belt with dangling chains, a thigh strap on one leg, and fingerless gloves. Add gold lightning motifs and glossy highlights across her clothing. Around her hand and body, draw arcs of yellow energy and speed streaks to emphasize impact. Behind her on the left midground, place a white-haired teenage boy in a black-and-white futuristic combat outfit, crouched aggressively and aiming a large mechanical gauntlet or weapon toward the viewer, surrounded by icy blue shards and angular motion lines. Behind her on the right midground, place a pink-haired teenage girl with twin tails or tied-up hair, wielding a circular bladed ring weapon, posed in motion with vivid magenta energy trails. In the upper right background, add a fourth visual focal area but not a separate main character count: a dark-haired teenage boy in a green-black combat suit aiming a glowing sci-fi rifle diagonally across the page, partially obscured by text and effects, embedded into the background action. The background is a dense neon-lit futuristic Japanese city street at night with tilted perspective, towering signs, debris, sparks, shattered fragments, electric streaks, and saturated blues, purples, pinks, and oranges. Use extreme contrast, glossy print texture, ink splatter accents, halftone-like manga magazine energy, and premium anime key visual rendering. Add large dramatic Japanese cover copy on the left in stacked blocks with thick white, yellow, red, and black lettering, including the prominent headline 新時代をブチ抜く 超熱量ヒロイン ここに爆誕!!. Add exactly 5 left-side feature callouts in colored rectangular boxes with bold names and smaller subtitle lines beneath: 雷閃ブレイカー / 天城ノア, 空駆けエンジン / 南雲ハヤト, 魔境デリバリー / 倉科ミツル, 白狼ストライカー / 久世リョウ, 超深海クラッシュ / 早瀬シン. Add exactly 5 right-side feature callouts in matching bold boxes: 極光パレット / 鳴海ユウト, 機巧グラフィティ / 胡野レイ, 龍骨ランナー / 火野アツシ, 王冠のラグナ / 深町カイ, 風神リベリオン / 東雲ガク. Also add exactly 3 promotional bursts on the right side in starburst or explosive label shapes with large yellow and white lettering: 巻頭カラー, 特大ポスター付き, 新連載スタート. Make the entire cover feel like a blockbuster debut issue for a hot new battle manga era, energetic, rebellious, flashy, polished, and unmistakably like a high-impact Japanese manga magazine cover illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节极其丰富的日本周刊少年漫画杂志封面，全出血设计，画面爆炸且拥挤，不留空白。采用单幅垂直构图的杂志封面插画形式，堆叠了排版文字、角色艺术、动态效果和都市科幻的混乱感。顶部是一个巨大的风格化日文刊名，采用火橙红色，配有厚重的黑色轮廓和金色边缘，横跨页面宽度，文字为“週刊少年ブレイズ”，标题中集成了一个小型的 40 周年庆祝徽章。在最顶端边缘添加一行简短的日文标语。在右上角放置一个黑色期刊信息框，配以亮黄色和白色的文字，显示日期“2026年4月22日号”和价格“特別価格 380円”。主图以动态三角形构图呈现 3 位动漫角色。画面中心前景，主角女英雄向观众猛冲而来，采用强烈的透视缩短效果，一只手伸向镜头前方，几乎触碰到屏幕。她是一位十几岁的辣妹风动作女英雄，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色带粉色挑染"} 的长波浪发，发丝狂乱飞舞，金棕色双眸锐利，带着自信而顽皮的笑容，拥有阳光亲吻般的肤色、多个耳环，散发着炫酷叛逆的街头战士气质。她的服装为黑金配色，包含 6 个关键可见部件：短款上衣、带金属饰边的短夹克、短裤、带垂坠链条的腰带、单腿腿带以及露指手套。在衣服上添加金色闪电图案和光泽高光。在她的手部和身体周围，绘制黄色能量弧线和速度线以强调冲击力。在她左侧中景处，放置一名白发少年，身穿黑白相间的未来主义战斗服，呈攻击姿态蹲伏，正将巨大的机械护手或武器瞄准观众，周围环绕着冰蓝色碎片和棱角分明的动态线条。在她右侧中景处，放置一名粉发少女，扎着双马尾或束发，挥舞着圆形刀刃武器，动作姿态中带有鲜艳的洋红色能量轨迹。在右上角背景中，添加第四个视觉焦点（非主要角色）：一名黑发少年身穿绿黑色战斗服，正斜向瞄准一把发光的科幻步枪，部分被文字和特效遮挡，融入背景动作中。背景是一个霓虹闪烁的未来主义日本夜间城市街道，采用倾斜视角，高耸的招牌、碎片、火花、破碎的残骸、电流条纹，以及饱和的蓝色、紫色、粉色和橙色。运用极端的对比度、光泽印刷质感、墨迹飞溅点缀、半色调漫画杂志风格以及高级动漫主视觉渲染。在左侧堆叠块中添加醒目的大型日文封面文案，使用厚实的白、黄、红、黑字体，包括突出的标题“新時代をブチ抜く 超熱量ヒロイン ここに爆誕!!”。在左侧添加 5 个特征标注框，采用彩色矩形框，配以粗体名称和下方的副标题：雷閃ブレイカー / 天城ノア, 空駆けエンジン / 南雲ハヤト, 魔境デリバリー / 倉科ミツル, 白狼ストライカー / 久世リョウ, 超深海クラッシュ / 早瀬シン。在右侧添加 5 个匹配的粗体特征标注框：極光パレット / 鳴海ユウト, 機巧グラフィティ / 胡野レイ, 龍骨ランナー / 火野アツシ, 王冠のラグナ / 深町カイ, 風神リベリオン / 東雲ガク。此外，在右侧添加 3 个促销标签，采用星形或爆炸形标签，配以大型黄色和白色文字：巻頭カラー, 特大ポスター付き, 新連載スタート。让整张封面呈现出热门战斗漫画新纪元大作首刊的感觉，充满活力、叛逆、炫目、精致，且具有极高冲击力的日本漫画杂志封面特征。

templates.title: Chaotic Shonen Manga Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 混乱风格少年漫画封面

templates.prompt: A hyper-energetic Japanese shonen manga magazine cover illustration, packed edge to edge with explosive pop-art chaos and bright candy colors, in the style of a weekly comic anthology cover. The main focus is a trendy gyaru teenage girl at the center, leaning toward the viewer in a dynamic foreshortened pose, grinning widely with her mouth open and pointing directly at the camera with one hand while holding a pink toy hammer over her shoulder with the other. She has layered medium-length wavy hair in {argument name="hair color" default="light brown with blonde and pink streaks"}, warm amber eyes, multiple colorful hair clips including stars and lightning bolts, earrings, rings, bracelets, necklaces, flashy nail art, and a bold street-fashion outfit: vivid pink satin bomber jacket, white cropped top, black belt with gold buckle, and mixed glam accessories. The cover logo dominates the top center in huge red Japanese lettering with thick black outline and yellow border reading {argument name="masthead text" default="バクアラ!?"}, with smaller text above it reading 週刊少年. At the upper left, add a loud burst caption reading 超豪華付録(ゴミ)付き!!! with a shocked cartoon trash can mascot. Along the left side place two giant sound-effect style callouts, ドーン! near the top left and バンバーン! in blue near the lower left. On the right side, create an oversized main headline in chunky black, yellow, white, and pink Japanese display type reading 笑って暴れて今日もカオス全開!!, surrounded by smaller promotional blurbs such as 全ページ抱腹絶倒!, 笑いすぎ注意報発令中ーっ!!, and 笑撃の新連載!. In the top right corner include a magazine issue box with the date 2026年4月22日号 and price 390円. Scatter exactly 3 supporting manga-style characters around the central girl: 1 silver-haired boy with goggles on the left aiming a spiral blaster toward the viewer, 1 cheerful purple-haired girl below him holding a dessert drink, and 1 orange-haired idol-like girl in headphones at the upper right making a peace sign. Fill the background and foreground with a dense collage of floating sweets, snacks, toys, doodles, and mascot faces, including donuts, cookies, chocolate bars, candy, pudding, ice cream, popcorn, planets, stars, speech bursts, and goofy creatures, all layered with thick outlines and halftone texture. Along the bottom, include exactly 7 small serialized feature boxes in a row, each with manga-style character art and Japanese titles, creating the look of a crowded anthology teaser strip. Use an ultra-saturated palette of hot pink, yellow, orange, red, cyan, and black, with maximal visual density, overlapping typography, comic speed lines, sticker-like elements, and a glossy printed magazine cover finish. Make it feel hilarious, rebellious, loud, youthful, and irresistibly cluttered, like a parody-yet-premium next-generation Weekly Shonen Jump cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的日式少年漫画杂志封面插画，画面边缘布满了爆炸性的波普艺术元素和明亮的糖果色，呈现出周刊漫画合集封面的风格。画面中心是一位潮流辣妹高中生，她以动态的透视姿势向观众倾斜，咧嘴大笑，一只手直指镜头，另一只手扛着一把粉色玩具锤。她留着中长波浪卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色，带有金色和粉色挑染"}，有着温暖的琥珀色眼睛，佩戴着星星和闪电形状的彩色发夹、耳环、戒指、手链、项链，涂着夸张的美甲，身着大胆的街头风服饰：亮粉色缎面飞行员夹克、白色露脐上衣、带有金色扣环的黑色腰带以及各种华丽的配饰。封面顶部中央是巨大的红色日文标题，带有粗黑边框和黄色描边，文字为 {argument name="masthead text" default="バクアラ!?"}，上方有较小的文字“週刊少年”。左上角添加一个醒目的爆炸式标题“超豪華付録(ゴミ)付き!!!”，并配有一个震惊的卡通垃圾桶吉祥物。左侧放置两个巨大的拟声词风格标语，左上方为“ドーン!”，左下方为蓝色的“バンバーン!”。右侧设计一个超大的主标题，采用粗体的黑、黄、白、粉色日文显示字体，内容为“笑って暴れて今日もカオス全開!!”，周围环绕着较小的宣传语，如“全ページ抱腹絶倒!”、“笑いすぎ注意報発令中ーっ!!”以及“笑撃の新連載!”。右上角包含一个杂志期号框，标有“2026年 4 月 22 日号”和价格“390 円”。在中心少女周围散布 3 个漫画风格的配角：左侧是一名戴着护目镜、正向观众瞄准螺旋冲击波的银发男孩；下方是一名拿着甜点饮料、神情愉悦的紫发女孩；右上角是一名戴着耳机、比着剪刀手的橙发偶像风女孩。背景和前景填满了漂浮的甜点、零食、玩具、涂鸦和吉祥物头像，包括甜甜圈、饼干、巧克力棒、糖果、布丁、冰淇淋、爆米花、行星、星星、对话气泡和搞怪生物，所有元素都带有粗轮廓线和网点纹理。底部整齐排列 7 个小型连载专题框，每个框内都有漫画角色插图和日文标题，营造出拥挤的合集预告条效果。使用高饱和度的亮粉色、黄色、橙色、红色、青色和黑色，视觉密度极高，文字重叠，配有漫画速度线、贴纸元素和光面印刷杂志封面的质感。整体感觉搞笑、叛逆、喧闹、年轻且极具吸引力的杂乱感，仿佛一张既是恶搞又具备高品质的次世代《周刊少年 Jump》封面。

templates.title: Blockbuster Anime Sky Fantasy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 大片级动漫天空幻想海报

templates.prompt: A breathtaking Japanese anime movie poster in the style of a blockbuster theatrical key visual, ultra-detailed and emotionally grand, with a delicate luminous sky reminiscent of prestige modern anime cinema. The scene shows 2 characters from behind on a flower-covered cliff overlooking a glowing coastal fantasy city at sunset and twilight: a teenage boy in a dark school uniform with a loosened tie and windblown short dark hair stands on the left, and a teenage girl in a long flowing pale dress with very long silver-white hair stands on the right. Both face the horizon in awe. Above them, an enormous celestial sky fills most of the composition, painted with vivid deep blue, indigo, violet, magenta, and gold clouds, a brilliant comet-like meteor streak slashing diagonally from upper center toward the horizon, scattered stars, sparkling particles, and a glowing circular magic-like ring constellation in the upper right sky. The sea and city below shimmer with reflected light, with slender fantasy skyscrapers and towers rising from the coastline and a radiant sunlit gap at the center horizon. Foreground flowers are saturated blue and purple with glowing highlights, and white-pink petals drift through the air. Use dramatic rim light, cinematic backlighting, lens-glow sparkle effects, highly polished anime rendering, crisp linework, atmospheric depth, and a vertical poster composition. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the design: giant embossed gold headline text across the top reading {argument name="top headline text" default="興行収入100億円突破"}, a gold subheadline block at upper left reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="大ヒット上映中"}, a vertical white tagline on the upper right reading {argument name="tagline text" default="あの日、君と見上げた空が、世界を変える。"}, and a very large glowing white-lavender Japanese film title at the bottom center reading {argument name="movie title" default="星屑の約束"}. Beneath the title, add small elegant romanized subtitle text reading {argument name="romanized subtitle" default="Hoshikuzu no Yakusoku"}, plus dense small production credits, cast lines, website text, release-copy lines, and cinema format logos along the bottom edge in authentic Japanese movie-poster layout. Add 2 gold laurel emblems flanking the top headline, one on the left and one on the right. Make it feel like a fictional anime film that earned 10 billion yen at the box office, sweeping, romantic, bittersweet, magical, and destined to make audiences cry.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人叹为观止的日本动漫电影海报，采用大片级电影主视觉风格，细节丰富，情感宏大，拥有现代精品动漫电影中那种精致而明亮的天空。画面展示了 2 名角色背对着镜头，站在开满鲜花的山崖上，俯瞰着日落与黄昏时分发光的沿海幻想城市：左侧是一位穿着深色校服、领带松开、短发随风飘动的少年，右侧是一位穿着长款飘逸浅色连衣裙、留着超长银白色长发的少女。两人都敬畏地望着地平线。在他们上方，巨大的天穹占据了构图的大部分，绘有生动的深蓝、靛青、紫罗兰、洋红和金色云彩，一道灿烂的彗星状流星从上方中心向地平线斜向划过，繁星点点，微光闪烁，右上方的天空中还有一个发光的圆形魔法环状星座。下方的海洋和城市闪烁着反射光，纤细的幻想摩天大楼和塔楼从海岸线升起，地平线中心有一道灿烂的阳光缝隙。前景的花朵呈现出饱和的蓝色和紫色，带有发光的高光，白粉色的花瓣在空中飘落。运用戏剧性的轮廓光、电影级背光、镜头光晕闪烁效果、高度精细的动漫渲染、清晰的线条、大气深度以及垂直海报构图。设计中融入日文海报排版：顶部横跨巨大的浮雕金色标题文本 {argument name="top headline text" default="興行収入100億円突破"}，左上方有一个金色副标题块 {argument name="subheadline text" default="大ヒット上映中"}，右上角有一行垂直的白色标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="あの日、君と見上げた空が、世界を変える。"}，底部中心有一个非常巨大的发光白薰衣草色日文电影片名 {argument name="movie title" default="星屑の約束"}。在片名下方，添加一行优雅的小型罗马字副标题 {argument name="romanized subtitle" default="Hoshikuzu no Yakusoku"}，并在底边添加密集的制作人员名单、演员表、网站文本、发行文案以及电影格式标志，呈现地道的日本电影海报布局。在顶部标题两侧各添加一个金色月桂花环标志。营造出一种虚构动漫电影的氛围，仿佛该片票房突破了 100 亿日元，宏大、浪漫、苦涩、充满魔力，注定会让观众落泪。

templates.title: Fake Japanese Newspaper in ChatGPT UI

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 界面中的伪造日本报纸

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A realistic smartphone screenshot of the ChatGPT web interface in Japanese, shown on a clean white background. Centered in the chat is a single generated image: a top-down photo of 1 Japanese newspaper placed neatly on a medium-dark wooden tabletop with rounded table corners visible. The newspaper dominates the image and looks highly believable, like a fake but convincing breaking-news front page. The masthead area is dense and traditional, with a huge bold black Japanese headline across the top reading 「高市総理辞任」. Beneath it is a large main photo of 1 politician at a press conference podium with multiple microphones, face intentionally blurred or obscured, in front of a dark blue curtain. Along the right side is 1 vertical blue newspaper nameplate area with white Japanese text resembling a major national daily. A tall vertical subheadline column in Japanese runs beside the main image, suggesting discussion of a successor candidate. The front page includes exactly 4 visible advertisement blocks near the bottom and lower side areas, 1 small portrait photo of a suited man in a left-side article, 1 sports photo block in the lower middle, 1 weather or data box on the right, and many tightly packed columns of Japanese body text throughout. The newspaper should feel authentic, serious, and editorial, with realistic print texture, slight page curl, subtle shadows, and credible Japanese typography. Around the image, include the visible ChatGPT UI chrome: top-left “ChatGPT”, top-right Japanese sharing controls, a small circular overlay button labeled 「編集」 at the lower-left corner of the image, a small share-style overlay icon at the lower-right corner of the image, reaction/action icons beneath the image, and a bottom input bar with Japanese placeholder text 「質問してみましょう」 plus microphone and voice buttons. Overall style: photorealistic screenshot, modern web app interface, fake-news newspaper front page, crisp legible layout, natural lighting, minimal perspective distortion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的 ChatGPT 日语网页版智能手机截图，背景为简洁的白色。聊天界面中央是一张生成的图片：一张从正上方拍摄的照片，展示了 1 份整齐放置在深色木质桌面上的日本报纸，可见圆润的桌面边缘。报纸占据了画面的主体，看起来非常真实，像是一份虚构但令人信服的突发新闻头版。报头区域布局紧凑且传统，顶部印有醒目的黑色粗体日语标题「高市総理辞任」。下方是一张大型主图，展示了 1 位在新闻发布会讲台上的政治人物，面前有多个麦克风，面部被刻意模糊或遮挡，背景为深蓝色幕布。右侧是 1 个垂直的蓝色报纸名称栏，带有类似日本主流全国性日报的白色日语文字。主图旁有一列垂直的日语副标题栏，暗示了对继任候选人的讨论。报纸头版底部及侧下方包含 4 个清晰可见的广告块，左侧文章中配有 1 张身着西装男士的小型肖像照，下方中间有 1 个体育新闻图片块，右侧有 1 个天气或数据框，整版充斥着密集的日语正文列。报纸应呈现出真实、严肃的编辑风格，具有逼真的印刷质感、轻微的纸张卷曲、细腻的阴影以及可信的日语排版。图片周围应包含可见的 ChatGPT UI 元素：左上角的“ChatGPT”、右上角的日语分享控件、图片左下角标有「編集」的小型圆形浮层按钮、图片右下角的小型分享图标、图片下方的反应/操作图标，以及底部的输入栏，其中包含日语占位符文字「質問してみましょう」以及麦克风和语音按钮。整体风格：照片级真实截图、现代 Web 应用界面、虚假新闻报纸头版、清晰易读的布局、自然光影、极小的透视畸变。

templates.title: Cute Winter Anime Channel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱冬季动漫频道海报

templates.prompt:
A cute pastel anime promotional poster in a dreamy idol-fanclub style, landscape orientation, featuring a single horse-girl character from the waist up on the right side of the composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark chestnut brown"} long fluffy hair with side-swept bangs covering one eye, one large visible sparkling purple-pink eye, fair skin, soft blush, and upright horse ears with a large cream bow tied between them. Her expression is gentle, shy, and welcoming, with a small smile and a slight head tilt toward the viewer. She wears a thick red scarf with white horizontal stripes, a cream cable-knit sweater, and a navy sailor-style inner collar with a small red ribbon at the chest. The overall color palette is warm pink, cream, beige, and cocoa brown with soft winter lighting.

Design the image as a Japanese fan-content announcement graphic with layered sticker-like typography, fluffy outlines, hearts, sparkles, and snowflake motifs. The background should be a softly blurred cozy winter café or warmly lit indoor scene with glowing bokeh and pale decorative textures. Add exactly 5 major text areas: a pink ribbon banner at the top with the Japanese text "ライスと一緒に"; a very large central-left headline in rounded pop lettering reading "ほのぼの 育成" with "ほのぼの" in pink and white and "育成" in bold brown with white stitched edging; a small dark ribbon under it reading "しよっ♪"; a circular brown badge on the right reading "初見さん歓迎"; and a logo-like label at bottom right reading "ライスシャワーちゃんねる" with a small horseshoe icon. Add exactly 1 memo pad in the bottom-left corner with 3 checklist lines, each with a pink checkmark: "ストーリー", "チャンミ", and "まったり雑談". Include small decorative pink hearts around the character, tiny accent lines near her head, white snowflakes, lace-like trim, paper-cut corner decorations, and a soft scrapbook aesthetic. Make the whole piece look like an adorable fictional stream or channel thumbnail welcoming new viewers, highly polished, clean anime line art, soft shading, glossy eyes, and charming commercial poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张可爱的柔和系动漫宣传海报，采用梦幻偶像粉丝俱乐部风格，横向构图，右侧为一名马娘角色的半身像。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深栗棕色"} 的长蓬松秀发，侧分刘海遮住一只眼睛，另一只眼睛又大又亮，呈紫粉色，皮肤白皙，面带柔和红晕，头顶竖立着马耳，两耳之间系着一个巨大的奶油色蝴蝶结。她的表情温柔、羞涩且亲切，带着浅浅的微笑，头部微微向观众倾斜。她戴着一条带有白色横条纹的厚实红色围巾，身穿奶油色麻花针织毛衣，内搭藏青色水手风领口，胸前系着一个小红丝带。整体色调为暖粉色、奶油色、米色和可可棕色，配以柔和的冬季光影。

将图像设计为日系粉丝内容公告图，采用分层贴纸式排版、蓬松的轮廓线、爱心、闪光和雪花图案。背景应为柔焦的温馨冬季咖啡馆或光线温暖的室内场景，带有发光的散景和浅色装饰纹理。添加 5 个主要的文字区域：顶部是一个粉色丝带横幅，写有日文“ライスと一緒に”；左侧中央是一个巨大的圆润流行字体标题，写着“ほのぼの 育成”，其中“ほのぼの”为粉白色，“育成”为加粗棕色并带有白色缝线边缘；下方是一个写着“しよっ♪”的小型深色丝带；右侧是一个写着“初见さん歓迎”的圆形棕色徽章；右下角是一个类似标志的标签，写着“ライスシャワーちゃんねる”并配有一个小马蹄图标。在左下角添加 1 个备忘录，包含 3 行清单，每行都有一个粉色勾选标记：“ストーリー”、“チャンミ”和“まったり雑談”。在角色周围添加装饰性的小粉心、头部附近的细小装饰线、白色雪花、蕾丝边、剪纸风格的边角装饰，营造出柔和的剪贴簿美感。使整张作品看起来像是一张可爱且虚构的直播或频道缩略图，旨在欢迎新观众，画面精美，线条清晰，阴影柔和，眼睛光泽感强，具有迷人的商业海报构图。
