templates.title: Cosmic Broken Compact Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 宇宙破碎感粉饼盒专辑封面

templates.prompt: A luxurious square streaming-cover illustration for the song {argument name="title text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"}, styled like a dreamy cosmic beauty advertisement. The scene is a dark, glittering tabletop in deep midnight indigo and black velvet, filled with sparkling dust and tiny stars. At the center is 1 ornate round compact mirror made of rose-gold metal, opened flat toward the viewer, with the upright mirror framed by delicate decorative filigree at the top. The mirror glass is visibly cracked with multiple branching fracture lines and a few missing shards, yet inside the reflection appears an impossible fantasy universe: 1 glowing purple-pink planet or moon in the upper left, 1 luminous crystalline city skyline rising from the lower left, and exactly 5 ethereal butterflies floating in the mirror space, including 1 large radiant pink butterfly on the right and 4 smaller butterflies in violet and blue tones. The lower compact tray also reflects the same starry purple cosmos and contains several broken mirror fragments. To the left of the compact are exactly 2 cosmetics objects: 1 faceted crystal perfume bottle and 1 open lipstick in a metallic case, the lipstick bullet colored {argument name="lipstick color" default="deep rose plum"}. In the lower right foreground lies exactly 1 soft pink cosmos flower with a stem and a few scattered petals. The whole image glows with magical particles, thin hanging star ornaments, misty nebula swirls, and a rich palette of violet, magenta, blush pink, and rose-gold highlights. Add vertical Japanese typography on the right reading {argument name="right vertical text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"} in a large luminous pale-pink font, and a second smaller vertical Japanese text block on the left reading {argument name="left vertical text" default="その輝きは、きっと本物じゃない。\nそれでも、蝶は誘惑されていく。"} in a delicate light font. The composition should feel romantic, melancholic, glamorous, mystical, and premium, like high-end album art for a dark feminine synth-pop or dream-pop release, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, shimmering reflections, elegant fantasy realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的方形流媒体封面插画，用于歌曲 {argument name="title text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"}，风格如同梦幻般的宇宙美妆广告。场景设定在深午夜靛蓝色和黑色天鹅绒质感的闪亮桌面上，布满了闪烁的尘埃和微小的星辰。画面中心是一个精致的玫瑰金金属圆形粉饼盒，平铺在观众面前，竖起的镜面顶部装饰着精致的镂空花纹。镜面明显破裂，布满分叉的裂纹并缺失了几块碎片，但镜中映照出的却是一个不可思议的奇幻宇宙：左上方有一颗发光的紫粉色行星或月球，左下方升起一座发光的水晶城市天际线，镜中空间漂浮着 5 只空灵的蝴蝶，包括右侧 1 只巨大的璀璨粉色蝴蝶和 4 只紫蓝色调的小蝴蝶。下方的粉饼托盘同样反射出星光熠熠的紫色宇宙，并散落着几块破碎的镜片。粉饼盒左侧放置着 2 件化妆品：1 个多面切割水晶香水瓶和 1 支金属外壳的开口口红，口红膏体颜色为 {argument name="lipstick color" default="深玫瑰李子色"}。右下角前景处躺着 1 朵带茎的柔粉色波斯菊，周围散落着几片花瓣。整张图片闪烁着魔法粒子、悬挂的星形装饰、朦胧的星云漩涡，以及紫罗兰色、洋红色、腮红粉色和玫瑰金高光的丰富色调。在右侧添加竖排日文文字 {argument name="right vertical text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"}，使用醒目且发光的淡粉色字体；在左侧添加第二段较小的竖排日文文本 {argument name="left vertical text" default="その輝きは、きっと本物じゃない。\nそれでも、蝶は誘惑されていく。"}，使用精致纤细的字体。构图需营造出浪漫、忧郁、迷人、神秘且高级的氛围，如同暗黑女性向合成器流行乐或梦幻流行乐的高端专辑封面，超细节呈现，电影级光影，闪烁的倒影，优雅的奇幻写实风格。

templates.title: Chibi Catgirl at Yokohama Stadium

titleLocalized.zh: 横滨体育场前的 Q 版猫娘

templates.prompt: A cute anime chibi girl walking toward the camera on the tree-lined pedestrian approach outside {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"}, shown in a realistic modern Japanese city photo background under bright midday sunlight with a blue sky peeking through the trees. The stadium fills the upper background with its large white structural beams and a dark blue sign reading {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"}. On the right side, there are 2 tall blue vertical banners on lampposts with a stylized B logo and welcome text for Yokohama Stadium, plus 2 smaller matching blue banners farther down the walkway. The paved plaza is wide and open, with 2 short black bollards visible in the foreground-left area, green hedges and mature trees along both sides, and small pedestrians scattered in the distance for scale. In the center foreground, place 1 super-deformed catgirl character composited naturally into the scene: petite chibi proportions, oversized head, soft anime shading, pale skin, long slightly tousled dark hair with bangs, fluffy cat ears, and a small black cat tail. She wears an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="forest green"} hoodie that falls like a short dress, black low-cut shoes, and 1 small black crossbody bag with a flap and tiny charm hanging from it. She is holding 1 wrapped burger or sandwich with both hands near her mouth as if eating while walking. Her pose is slightly pigeon-toed and casual, one leg crossing in front of the other, giving a shy adorable feeling. Use a whimsical contrast between highly realistic street photography and a polished anime sticker-like character with clean outlines and subtle shadowing on the pavement. Keep the face centered but obscured by a large square mosaic blur censor block.

promptLocalized.zh: 一位可爱的动漫 Q 版女孩正朝着镜头走来，背景是 {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"} 外绿树成荫的人行步道。画面呈现出逼真的现代日本城市摄影背景，正午阳光明媚，蓝天透过树叶缝隙隐约可见。体育场占据了背景上方，展示着巨大的白色结构梁，以及写有 {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"} 的深蓝色标牌。右侧的灯柱上悬挂着 2 面蓝色的垂直长旗，上面印有风格化的 B 标志和横滨体育场的欢迎文字，步道远处还有 2 面较小的配套蓝色旗帜。铺设的广场宽阔开阔，左前方可见 2 根矮小的黑色系缆桩，两侧是绿篱和成熟的树木，远处散布着零星的行人以衬托比例。在画面中心前景处，自然地合成 1 个超变形（super-deformed）猫娘角色：娇小的 Q 版比例，大头，柔和的动漫阴影，白皙的皮肤，长而略显凌乱的深色头发配有刘海，毛茸茸的猫耳，以及一条黑色小猫尾巴。她穿着一件超大号的 {argument name="hoodie color" default="forest green"} 连帽衫，衣摆像短裙一样垂下，脚穿黑色低帮鞋，背着 1 个带有翻盖和挂有小吊饰的黑色斜挎包。她双手拿着 1 个包装好的汉堡或三明治放在嘴边，仿佛边走边吃。她的姿势略带内八字，显得随意自然，双腿交叠，流露出害羞可爱的感觉。利用高度逼真的街头摄影与精致的动漫贴纸风格角色之间的奇妙对比，角色轮廓清晰，地面上有微妙的阴影。保持面部居中，但用一个大的方形马赛克模糊块遮挡。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Elf Girl Full-Body Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克精灵少女全身肖像

templates.prompt: A full-body anime character illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="cyberpunk elf girl"} standing alone against a clean plain white background, centered and facing slightly left in a relaxed neutral pose with both arms hanging naturally. She has a short bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="icy light blue"}, straight blunt bangs, pale skin, large pointed elf ears, and vivid {argument name="eye color" default="glowing red-orange"} eyes with a calm, slightly serious expression. Her design blends fantasy and futuristic biomechanics: she wears 1 oversized white techwear hooded jacket with black lining, black straps, zipper details, and red warning-style markings on the sleeve; underneath is 1 glossy black biomechanical bodysuit with exposed cutout sections, cables, segmented armor plates, and intricate hard-surface cybernetic detailing around the torso and hips. She has 1 strapped black thigh pouch on her right thigh, 2 mechanical knee braces with visible circular joints, 2 external cables running from the knees downward, and 1 pair of chunky black combat boots with thick soles, buckles, and subtle red accents. Add small black earrings and tiny industrial accessories around the ears. Render in highly detailed polished manga-style line art with crisp edges, delicate cel shading, glossy highlights on the skin and latex-like surfaces, subtle red accent lights, and an overall premium sci-fi character concept art look. Keep the figure fully visible from head to boots with generous negative space and no props, scenery, text, or shadows beyond minimal grounding.

templates.title: Cyberpunk Girl with Giant Claw Arm

titleLocalized.zh: 拥有巨型机械爪的赛博朋克少女

templates.prompt: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration of a lone young woman with a massive mechanical claw arm standing in a rainy neon-drenched alley at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle that makes her look imposing and dangerous. She has a pale face, long straight black hair partly hiding her eyes, and faintly glowing red eyes with a cold, emotionless expression. She wears an oversized hooded winter-tech coat with a large fur-trimmed hood and fur cuffs, layered black tactical streetwear, straps, belts, and baggy dark pants tucked into heavy boots. Her left arm is replaced by an enormous industrial mech prosthetic that dominates the foreground, packed with dense gears, pistons, tubing, cables, exposed mechanisms, and glowing red indicator lights, ending in 3 long curved talons with razor-sharp tips lit from within by crimson energy. Add small decals, warning labels, and vertical East Asian signage on the coat and machinery. Set her in a narrow futuristic city street filled with towering buildings, hanging cables, mist, and many vertical neon signs with Chinese characters in red and cyan-green. The pavement is wet and mirror-like, reflecting the red lights from the claw and the surrounding signage. Use a gritty, ultra-detailed, high-contrast palette of charcoal black, gunmetal, deep crimson, and sickly teal. The mood is cold, moody, intimidating, intelligent, and slightly melancholic. Highly detailed linework, complex mechanical rendering, cinematic lighting, rain haze, urban density, anime-meets-hard-surface concept art, masterpiece quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅暗黑赛博朋克动漫插画，描绘了一位拥有巨大机械爪臂的孤独少女，她站在雨夜中霓虹闪烁的巷子里，采用极具戏剧性的低角度视角，使她看起来威严且危险。她面色苍白，长直黑发遮住部分双眼，微弱的红色双眸流露出冷漠无情的表情。她身穿一件超大号连帽科技风冬装外套，带有巨大的毛领兜帽和毛绒袖口，内搭黑色战术街头服饰，配有绑带、皮带，宽松的深色长裤塞进厚重的靴子里。她的左臂被巨大的工业机械义肢取代，占据了画面前景，上面布满了密集的齿轮、活塞、管道、电缆和外露的机械结构，末端是 3 只弯曲的长爪，尖端锋利，内部闪烁着深红色的能量光芒。在外套和机械上添加小型贴纸、警告标签和垂直的东亚风格标牌。背景设定在狭窄的未来城市街道，周围是高耸的建筑、悬挂的电缆、薄雾以及许多带有红色和青绿色汉字的垂直霓虹灯牌。路面湿润如镜，倒映着机械爪和周围标牌发出的红光。采用颗粒感强、细节丰富、高对比度的色调，包括炭黑、枪铁灰、深绯红和病态青色。整体氛围冷峻、忧郁、令人畏惧、充满智慧且略带伤感。高度精细的线条、复杂的机械渲染、电影级光影、雨雾效果、城市密集感，动漫与硬表面结合的概念艺术，杰作级品质。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Girl with Giant Mech Claw

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克机甲利爪少女

templates.prompt: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration of a small eerie girl standing in a narrow rain-soaked alley at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle that makes her oversized mechanical arm dominate the foreground. She wears a large white hooded coat covered with printed patch-like symbols, diagrams, and industrial markings, the hood casting deep shadow over her face. Her face is minimal and doll-like with short straight black hair, pale skin, and two glowing white eyes with no visible pupils, giving a quiet emotionless expression. One of her arms is replaced by an enormous heavy mech limb that is far larger than her body, extending toward the viewer. The arm is built from layered white armored plates, exposed joints, cables, bolts, pistons, and segmented machinery, with scratches and grime for a worn combat-industrial look. The hand has exactly 4 massive clawed fingers touching the wet ground, each ending in long black-red talons, with red internal lights glowing through vents and gaps across the knuckles, wrist, and forearm. Add dangling black cables beneath the upper arm and subtle red light leaks around the elbow and shoulder mechanisms. Her other sleeve hangs normally at her side. She wears dark shorts or a skirt beneath the coat and oversized fluffy white leg warmers around her lower legs, with bare feet visible on the reflective pavement. The alley is dense with pipes, conduits, cables, vents, and old signage, including teal-green vertical neon signs in the background, creating a moody cyan backlight. Rain falls through the scene, puddles reflect teal and red light, and tiny orange-red sparks scatter near the claw tips on the ground. Use a muted palette of dirty white, charcoal, teal, and crimson, with cinematic contrast, highly detailed linework, gritty textures, atmospheric fog, and a haunting futuristic dystopian mood. Make the character {argument name="character name" default="a hooded mech-arm girl"}, with {argument name="coat color" default="dirty white"} outerwear, {argument name="glow color" default="crimson red"} mechanical lights, and {argument name="neon color" default="teal green"} alley signage.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑赛博朋克动漫插画，描绘了一位瘦小而诡异的少女站在狭窄且被雨水浸透的夜间小巷中。采用戏剧性的低角度构图，使她巨大的机械手臂在前景中占据主导地位。她穿着一件宽大的白色连帽外套，上面布满了印花补丁、图表和工业标记，兜帽在脸上投下深邃的阴影。她的面部特征简约且如玩偶般精致，留着黑色短直发，皮肤苍白，双眼散发着无瞳孔的白光，表情安静且冷漠。她的一只手臂被巨大的重型机甲肢体取代，其体积远超身体，向观众方向延伸。手臂由层叠的白色装甲板、外露关节、线缆、螺栓、活塞和分段式机械结构组成，带有划痕和污垢，呈现出一种饱经战火的工业质感。手部有 4 根巨大的爪状手指触碰着潮湿的地面，每根手指末端都有长长的黑红色利爪，指关节、手腕和前臂的缝隙处透出红色的内部光芒。上臂下方悬挂着黑色的线缆，肘部和肩部机械装置周围有细微的红色漏光。她的另一只袖子自然垂在身侧。外套下穿着深色短裤或短裙，小腿处套着超大号的蓬松白色腿套，赤脚踩在反光的地面上。小巷中布满了管道、导管、线缆、通风口和旧招牌，背景中竖立着青绿色的垂直霓虹灯牌，营造出一种忧郁的青色背光。雨水穿过场景，水洼反射着青色和红色的光芒，爪尖附近的地面上散落着细小的橙红色火花。采用脏白色、炭灰色、青色和深红色的柔和色调，结合电影级的对比度、高精度的线条、粗糙的质感、大气雾气以及令人难忘的未来反乌托邦氛围。将角色设定为 {argument name="character name" default="一位戴兜帽的机甲手臂少女"}，外衣颜色为 {argument name="coat color" default="脏白色"}，机械灯光为 {argument name="glow color" default="深红色"}，小巷霓虹灯颜色为 {argument name="neon color" default="青绿色"}。

templates.title: Steampunk Ship Cabin Interior

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克风格船舱内景

templates.prompt: A highly detailed cinematic interior of a cramped Victorian steampunk ship cabin engine room, viewed from standing eye level in a narrow corridor. The scene is packed wall-to-wall with aged polished brass pipes, copper tubes, riveted metal tanks, valves, gauges, and dark varnished wooden cabinets. On the left foreground, a steep wooden staircase with curved banister enters the frame diagonally. Along both sides of the corridor are heavy antique drawers and machinery consoles covered with small metal instruments, teapots, kettles, and mechanical fittings. At the back center is a small square-paned porthole window with 6 visible panes, showing a pale overcast exterior and a faint distant industrial skyline. Beneath the window is a narrow shelf unit with 3 open levels and a small drawer. On the right wall near the window hangs 1 round analog clock. The walls are painted teal-green metal with peeling paint and weathered patina. The floor is dark wood with a narrow worn patterned rug runner. Lighting is warm and moody, primarily from 1 glowing amber industrial wall lamp near the upper left of center, mixed with soft cold daylight from the porthole. Emphasize rich material texture, tarnished brass, oxidized copper, chipped paint, dust, age, and a lived-in mechanical atmosphere. Symmetrical depth, dense environmental storytelling, ultra-detailed, realistic, cinematic composition, shallow contrast but sharp focus throughout, no people.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节极其丰富的电影级蒸汽朋克风格船舱机房内景，视角位于狭窄走廊的站立视平线。场景中挤满了陈旧的抛光黄铜管道、铜管、铆接金属罐、阀门、仪表以及深色清漆木柜。左侧前景处，一段带有弧形扶手的陡峭木楼梯呈对角线进入画面。走廊两侧摆放着沉重的古董抽屉和机械控制台，上面布满了小型金属仪器、茶壶、水壶和机械配件。后方中心处是一个带有 6 块可见玻璃的小型方形舷窗，透出苍白阴沉的室外光线和隐约可见的远方工业天际线。窗下是一个带有 3 层开放式隔板和 1 个小抽屉的窄架子。窗户附近的右侧墙上挂着 1 个圆形模拟时钟。墙壁为青绿色金属材质，漆面剥落，带有风化的铜绿。地面为深色木地板，铺着一条磨损的窄条纹地毯。光影温暖且富有情绪感，主要光源来自左上方中心附近 1 盏发着琥珀色光芒的工业壁灯，并混合了舷窗透入的柔和冷色日光。强调丰富的材质纹理、失去光泽的黄铜、氧化的铜、剥落的油漆、灰尘、年代感以及充满生活气息的机械氛围。对称的景深，浓厚的环境叙事，超高细节，写实风格，电影级构图，对比度柔和但整体清晰对焦，画面中无人。

titleLocalized.zh: 高端日式清酒海报

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious Japanese poster advertisement for a fictional premium sake brand named {argument name="brand name" default="月白"}, with the romanized subtitle {argument name="romanized brand name" default="TSUKISHIRO"}. The composition is a single refined studio scene with a deep midnight-to-navy blue background and shimmering water-ripple caustics across the top, as if moonlight is reflecting on a still pool. Place one tall frosted glass sake bottle slightly left of center on a glossy black lacquer platform, with a soft cool-white halo behind it. The bottle should be elegant and slender with silver-blue condensation texture, a pale textured paper label, bold black Japanese calligraphy reading {argument name="label text" default="月白"}, small vertical text near the label edge reading "純米大吟醸", and tiny roman letters "TSUKISHIRO" near the bottom of the label. To the right of the bottle, place one small celadon-green ceramic sake cup on the same platform. Add a realistic plum blossom branch entering from the lower right, carrying approximately 9 open white blossoms and 8 visible buds on dark brown twigs, with a few scattered white petals on the platform and water surface. The surface below should be glossy dark water, showing subtle reflections of the bottle, cup, blossoms, and platform. On the right side, create very large glowing brushstroke Japanese calligraphy reading {argument name="display title" default="月白"}, stacked vertically, with the spaced serif romanization "TSUKISHIRO" beneath it. On the far left, add one vertical poetic line in Japanese reading {argument name="tagline text" default="月に酔い、白に還る。"}. At the bottom center, add the text "純米大吟醸" in pale gray. Include a small white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner. Lighting should feel cinematic, cool, moonlit, and premium, with minimalism, elegant negative space, high-end beverage advertising aesthetics, Japanese traditional refinement, ultra-detailed textures, crisp product photography realism, and a serene, poetic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张奢华的日式海报广告，品牌名为 {argument name="brand name" default="月白"}，并配有罗马拼音副标题 {argument name="romanized brand name" default="TSUKISHIRO"}。构图采用精致的单体摄影棚场景，背景为深邃的午夜蓝至海军蓝，顶部带有闪烁的水波纹焦散效果，宛如月光映照在静谧的水面上。在光亮的黑色漆面平台上，将一个高挑的磨砂玻璃清酒瓶置于偏左位置，瓶后带有柔和的冷白色光晕。酒瓶造型优雅修长，表面带有银蓝色冷凝水珠质感，贴有浅色纹理纸质标签，标签上印有醒目的黑色日文书法 {argument name="label text" default="月白"}，标签边缘处有细小的竖排文字“純米大吟醸”，标签底部印有微小的罗马字母“TSUKISHIRO”。在酒瓶右侧的同一平台上，放置一个小型青瓷清酒杯。从右下方加入一枝写实的梅花枝，枝干为深褐色，带有约 9 朵盛开的白梅和 8 个可见的花苞，平台上和水面上散落着几片白色花瓣。下方的表面为光亮的深色水面，隐约映照出酒瓶、酒杯、梅花和平台的倒影。在右侧，创作非常醒目的巨大发光笔触日文书法 {argument name="display title" default="月白"}，采用竖排布局，下方配有间距适中的衬线体罗马拼音“TSUKISHIRO”。在最左侧，添加一行竖排的日文诗意标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="月に酔い、白に還る。"}。底部居中处添加浅灰色文字“純米大吟醸”。在右上角添加一个微小的白色“Pollo.ai”水印。灯光需呈现电影质感，营造冷调、月光感与高级感，强调极简主义、优雅的留白、高端饮料广告美学、日式传统精致感、超精细纹理、清晰的产品摄影写实度，以及宁静、诗意的氛围。

templates.title: Japanese Law & Tax Services LP Hero

titleLocalized.zh: 日本法律与税务服务 LP 首屏设计

templates.prompt: Create a polished Japanese landing-page hero banner for a fictional combined law firm and tax accountant office, with a clean corporate style, high trust, soft daylight, and a white background with faint modern city buildings on the far right. Use a wide horizontal web header layout. At the very top, place a large navy Japanese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="あなたの『不安』に、確かな専門力で寄り添います。"}, and beneath it a smaller gold-accented Japanese subheadline reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="法律 × 税務のワンストップサポートで、最善の解決へ"}. Below the headline, arrange 4 equal vertical service cards side by side across the center. Card 1 is for criminal defense, with a circular icon showing handcuffs at the top, a cool blue color scheme, the large title "刑事事件", supporting copy "迅速な対応で、あなたの未来を守ります", a photo of a suited male professional seated with hands clasped across a desk, and a dark blue bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines with checkmarks: "逮捕・勾留対応" and "示談交渉・不起訴の獲得". Card 2 is for traffic accidents, with a circular icon showing a car crash at the top, a green color scheme, the title "交通事故", supporting copy "適正な補償を受けられるよう、全力でサポートします", a bright desk scene with 2 miniature cars colliding on documents, and a dark green bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "後遺障害・慰謝料の増額" and "保険会社との交渉代行". Card 3 is for inheritance tax, with a circular icon showing a house at the top, a warm gold color scheme, the title "相続税", supporting copy "円満な相続と、最適な税務対策をサポート", a tabletop scene with a model house, papers, and a calculator, and a mustard-gold bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "相続税の申告・節税対策" and "生前対策・事業承継支援". Card 4 is for divorce, with a circular icon showing a broken heart at the top, a rose-pink color scheme, the title "離婚", supporting copy "あなたの未来のために、納得できる解決を目指します", a soft professional consultation scene with a woman in a white blouse resting her hand near her chin while speaking across a desk, and a dusty-rose bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "親権・養育費・財産分与" and "離婚協議・調停・裁判対応". In the bottom area, add the firm identity on the left in Japanese: a small line "法律事務所・税理士事務所", a large firm name {argument name="firm name" default="架空総合法律税務事務所"}, and a smaller line "弁護士・税理士が連携するワンストップサービス". In the lower center, place 3 compact white feature boxes with navy line icons and short Japanese text: box 1 shows a group-of-people icon and says "各分野の専門家が対応", box 2 shows a handshake icon and says "相談者様に寄り添う親身なサポート", box 3 shows a document icon and says "初回相談60分無料". Add a small disclaimer beneath them: "※ご相談の内容によっては有料となる場合がございます。" On the lower right, create a prominent navy call-to-action panel with rounded corners. Include a small Japanese line "まずはお気軽にご相談ください", a large white phone number with phone icon {argument name="phone number" default="03-1234-5678"}, and a gold pill-shaped strip at the bottom reading {argument name="business hours" default="平日 9:00〜18:00（土日祝は事前予約で対応可）"}. Use refined Japanese Mincho-style typography for major headings, crisp spacing, balanced margins, subtle shadows, and premium legal-professional branding.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个精致的日本落地页首屏横幅，适用于一家虚构的综合律师事务所与税务师事务所，风格简洁专业，具有高度信任感，采用柔和的日光照明，背景为白色，右侧带有淡淡的现代城市建筑轮廓。采用宽幅横向网页页眉布局。在最上方，放置一个醒目的海军蓝日文大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="你的“不安”，由我们以确凿的专业能力守护。"}，下方放置一个带有金色点缀的较小日文副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="法律 × 税务一站式支持，助您达成最佳解决方案"}。在标题下方，横向排列 4 张等宽的垂直服务卡片。卡片 1 为刑事辩护，顶部带有手铐圆形图标，采用冷蓝色调，大标题为“刑事事件”，辅助文案为“以迅速的应对，守护您的未来”，配图为一名身着西装的专业男性坐在桌前双手交叠，底部深蓝色区域列出 2 条带勾选标记的要点：“逮捕・拘留应对”和“示谈交涉・争取不起诉”。卡片 2 为交通事故，顶部带有车祸圆形图标，采用绿色调，标题为“交通事故”，辅助文案为“全力支持您获得合理的赔偿”，配图为明亮的桌面场景，文件上有 2 辆微型车碰撞，底部深绿色区域列出 2 条要点：“后遗症障碍・慰问金增额”和“代办与保险公司的交涉”。卡片 3 为遗产税，顶部带有房屋圆形图标，采用暖金色调，标题为“遗产税”，辅助文案为“支持圆满的遗产继承与最优的税务对策”，配图为桌面场景，摆放着房屋模型、文件和计算器，底部芥末金色区域列出 2 条要点：“遗产税申报・节税对策”和“生前对策・事业继承支援”。卡片 4 为离婚，顶部带有破碎的心形图标，采用玫瑰粉色调，标题为“离婚”，辅助文案为“为了您的未来，旨在达成令您满意的解决方案”，配图为柔和的专业咨询场景，一名身穿白色衬衫的女性在桌对面说话时手托下巴，底部灰粉色区域列出 2 条要点：“亲权・抚养费・财产分割”和“离婚协议・调停・裁判应对”。在底部区域，左侧添加事务所标识，包括一行小字“法律事务所・税务师事务所”，一个大字事务所名称 {argument name="firm name" default="架空综合法律税务事务所"}，以及一行较小的字“律师与税务师协作的一站式服务”。在下方中央，放置 3 个紧凑的白色功能框，带有海军蓝线条图标和简短的日文说明：框 1 显示人群图标，文字为“各领域专家应对”；框 2 显示握手图标，文字为“贴近咨询者的亲切支持”；框 3 显示文档图标，文字为“首次咨询 60 分钟免费”。在下方添加一行小字免责声明：“※根据咨询内容，可能收取费用。”在右下方，创建一个醒目的海军蓝圆角行动号召（CTA）面板。包含一行小字“请随时咨询”，一个带有电话图标的白色大字电话号码 {argument name="phone number" default="03-1234-5678"}，以及底部一个金色的胶囊状条带，文字为 {argument name="business hours" default="平日 9:00〜18:00（周末及节假日可提前预约）"}。主要标题使用精致的日文明朝体排版，间距清晰，边距平衡，带有微妙的阴影，体现高端法律专业品牌形象。

templates.title: Elegant Japanese Divorce Law LP Hero

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅的日本离婚法律服务 LP 首屏设计

templates.prompt: Create a polished Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional divorce-law firm, designed like a high-conversion listing ad LP. Use a soft, elegant, feminine legal-brand aesthetic with a white background, blush pink accents, light gray dividers, and subtle botanical line art. The layout is a single wide desktop web hero split into two main columns: text-heavy content on the left and a lifestyle photo on the right. In the upper left, place the law firm logo and name: a delicate scripted monogram “D” with leaf ornament, followed by the Japanese office name and small English subtitle, shown as {argument name="firm name" default="法律事務所D"} and “LAW OFFICE D”. At the top right, include 2 rounded contact boxes: the first is a white phone box with a small phone icon and “24h”, short Japanese support text above, and the large phone number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}; the second is a pink email consultation button with an envelope icon and Japanese text indicating 24-hour reception. The main headline on the left is a large Japanese serif/mincho-style statement in 3 lines: “もう一人で悩まないで。” then “新しい一歩を、” in pink, then “一緒に考えます。” mixing black and pink emphasis. Below it, add a short supporting paragraph in Japanese about supporting clients with divorce-related worries and helping find the best solution, with one phrase highlighted in pink. On the right side, show a bright, airy photo of a Japanese woman in her 30s with short dark brown hair, wearing a loose white top, seated indoors on a sofa by a window, resting her face lightly on one hand and looking thoughtful; her face is obscured by a large rectangular blur block for privacy. Near her shoulder, place a pale pink circular badge with Japanese text saying that many female lawyers are on staff and consultations can be made with peace of mind. Across the lower middle, place 4 evenly spaced rounded white feature cards with thin borders and pink line icons. Card 1 shows a speech-bubble icon and text for “初回相談 60分無料” with a smaller line saying online consultation is also available. Card 2 shows a heart-in-hands icon and text about handling children’s issues carefully, with a smaller line mentioning custody and visitation. Card 3 shows stacked coins with a yen symbol and text about relieving anxiety over fees with a clear pricing structure, plus a smaller line about installment consultation. Card 4 shows a padlock icon and text about privacy protection and strict confidentiality, with a smaller line encouraging safe consultation. At the bottom, add a large curved pink-and-white call-to-action band spanning the width. On the left side of this band, include a circular phone icon, small Japanese text encouraging casual consultation and 24/365 reception, then the large repeated phone number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}, and beneath it smaller reception hours text. On the right side of the band, place a large pink rounded email button with envelope icon and Japanese text saying email consultation is available 24 hours. Along the very bottom, place 3 slim footer-style trust points separated horizontally: one about focusing on divorce consultation for women, one about consultations from family and friends also welcome, and one about nationwide and online consultations. Use refined Japanese typography, spacious layout, soft shadows, premium legal-advertising design, and realistic web-LP composition. Keep all visible text in Japanese except the small English subtitle “LAW OFFICE D”.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一家虚构的离婚律师事务所创建一个精致的日本落地页首屏图像，设计风格参考高转化率的列表广告 LP。采用柔和、优雅、女性化的法律品牌美学，以白色为背景，搭配淡粉色点缀、浅灰色分割线和精致的植物线条艺术。布局为单栏宽屏桌面网页首屏，分为左右两部分：左侧为文字密集的内容，右侧为生活方式照片。在左上方放置律师事务所的 Logo 和名称：一个带有叶片装饰的精致手写体字母“D”，后跟日文事务所名称及小型英文副标题，显示为 {argument name="firm name" default="法律事務所D"} 和“LAW OFFICE D”。在右上角，包含 2 个圆角联系框：第一个是带有小型电话图标和“24h”的白色电话框，上方有简短的日文支持文字，并显示大号电话号码 {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}；第二个是带有信封图标和表示 24 小时接待的日文文字的粉色邮件咨询按钮。左侧的主标题为 3 行大号日文衬线/明朝体声明：“もう一人で悩まないで。”（不要再一个人烦恼了。），接着是粉色的“新しい一歩を、”（迈出新的一步，），然后是混合黑色与粉色强调的“一緒に考えます。”（我们与您共同思考。）。下方添加一段简短的日文支持段落，介绍如何支持有离婚相关困扰的客户并帮助找到最佳解决方案，其中一个短语用粉色高亮显示。在右侧，展示一张明亮、通透的照片，照片中是一位 30 多岁的日本女性，留着深棕色短发，身穿宽松的白色上衣，坐在窗边的沙发上，单手托腮，神情若有所思；为了保护隐私，她的面部被一个大的矩形模糊块遮挡。在她的肩膀附近，放置一个淡粉色圆形徽章，上面写着有许多女性律师在职，可以安心咨询。在下方中部，放置 4 个间距均匀的圆角白色功能卡片，带有细边框和粉色线条图标。卡片 1 显示对话气泡图标和“初回相談 60分無料”（首次咨询 60 分钟免费）的文字，并附有一行较小的文字说明也提供在线咨询。卡片 2 显示心形托手图标和关于谨慎处理儿童问题的文字，并附有一行较小的文字提及监护权和探视权。卡片 3 显示带有日元符号的堆叠硬币图标，以及关于通过清晰的定价结构缓解费用焦虑的文字，并附有一行关于分期咨询的较小文字。卡片 4 显示挂锁图标和关于隐私保护与严格保密的文字，并附有一行鼓励安全咨询的较小文字。在底部，添加一个横跨页面宽度的巨大弧形粉白相间行动号召（CTA）带。在该带的左侧，包含一个圆形电话图标、鼓励轻松咨询和 24/365 接待的小型日文文字，然后是重复的大号电话号码 {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}，下方是较小的接待时间文字。在该带的右侧，放置一个带有信封图标的大号粉色圆角邮件按钮，以及表示 24 小时提供邮件咨询的日文文字。在最底部，横向排列 3 个细长的页脚式信任点：一个关于专注于女性离婚咨询，一个关于欢迎家人和朋友代为咨询，以及一个关于全国及在线咨询。采用精致的日文排版、宽敞的布局、柔和的阴影、高端法律广告设计和写实的网页 LP 构图。除小型英文副标题“LAW OFFICE D”外，所有可见文字均保持为日文。

templates.title: Japanese Inheritance Tax LP Hero

titleLocalized.zh: 日本遗产税 LP 首屏设计

templates.prompt: Create a clean, premium Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional tax accountant office specializing in inheritance tax consultation. The design should look like a modern listing-ad LP first view, wide desktop format, with a soft ivory and warm white background, muted sage green and gold accent colors, elegant serif Japanese typography for the headline, and a calm trustworthy atmosphere. On the left upper area, place a refined circular logo with a thin gold ring, a large serif letter C, and a small botanical line illustration, followed by the office name 税理士事務所 {argument name="office name" default="C"} and the English subtitle TAX ACCOUNTANT OFFICE {argument name="office name" default="C"}. In the top right, add a rounded white contact bar split into 2 blocks: a phone block with a green circular phone icon, the small text 初回相談無料・土日祝も対応, and the large number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"}; and a mail block with a gold circular mail icon and the text メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中. The main headline on the left should be large Japanese text reading 相続の不安に、安心という答えを。, with the key phrase 安心という答えを。 in sage green. Beneath it, add a supporting sentence in smaller Japanese text: 相続税の申告・節税対策を、経験豊富な税理士がご家族の想いに寄り添い、丁寧にサポートします。 Below that, place 3 rounded rectangular feature cards in a row with pale backgrounds and green line icons: card 1 shows a document icon and the text 相続税申告実績 1,000件以上 with a tiny note ※累計実績; card 2 shows a bar chart icon and the text 節税対策のご提案で 税負担を軽減 with a tiny note ※状況により効果は異なります; card 3 shows a group icon and the text 初回相談 無料 with a tiny note 安心の明朗会計. On the right half, show a bright consultation scene photo-style image: 3 Japanese adults around a desk in a sunlit office with greenery in the background, consisting of 1 male advisor in a navy suit seen from behind on the right, and 2 clients facing him, a middle-aged man in a light beige jacket and a woman in a white blouse. Place an open laptop on the table. Their expressions should feel calm and attentive. Overlay a pale circular badge near the lower right of the photo with delicate leaf decoration and the text 安心の 相続専門サポート わかりやすいご説明ではじめての方も安心. Across the lower middle, add a slim consultation invitation line reading 相続に関するお悩み、まずはお気軽にご相談ください, framed by diagonal slash marks. Under it, place 4 rounded category tabs in a row: 相続税の申告, 生前対策・節税, 遺産分割サポート, 二次相続対策. At the bottom right, add a large green rounded contact CTA area split into 2 main columns: the left column with a white phone icon, the small text お電話でのお問い合わせ（フリーダイヤル）, the large number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"}, and the small line 受付時間 9:00〜18:00（土日祝対応可）; the right column with a white mail icon, the text メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中, and a rounded white button reading ご相談はこちらから. Along the very bottom, create a white reassurance strip with 3 horizontally arranged items separated by thin vertical dividers: 1) shield icon and 秘密厳守・プライバシー保護を徹底, 2) clipboard icon and 明朗会計・事前お見積りで安心, 3) handshake icon and 相続の専門家がワンストップで対応. Use subtle shadows, rounded corners, soft natural light, polished commercial web design, and a highly believable Japanese legal-tax service advertisement aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一家专注于遗产税咨询的虚构会计师事务所，设计一张简洁、高端的日本落地页首屏图像。设计应呈现出现代化列表广告 LP 首屏的视觉效果，采用宽屏桌面格式，背景为柔和的象牙白与暖白色，搭配柔和的鼠尾草绿和金色作为点缀，标题使用优雅的衬线体日文字体，营造出冷静且值得信赖的氛围。在左上方放置一个精致的圆形 Logo，包含细金环、大号衬线字母 C 以及小型植物线条插图，随后是事务所名称“税理士事务所 {argument name="office name" default="C"}”以及英文副标题“TAX ACCOUNTANT OFFICE {argument name="office name" default="C"}”。在右上角，添加一个分为两部分的圆角白色联系栏：左侧为电话栏，包含绿色圆形电话图标、小字“初回相談無料・土日祝も対応”（首次咨询免费，周末节假日均可）以及大号数字 {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"}；右侧为邮件栏，包含金色圆形邮件图标和文字“メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中”（邮件咨询 24 小时受理中）。左侧的主标题应为醒目的日文：“相続の不安に、安心という答えを。”（为您的遗产继承焦虑，提供安心的答案。），其中关键短语“安心という答えを。”使用鼠尾草绿色。下方添加一行较小的日文辅助说明：“相続税の申告・節税対策を、経験豊富な税理士がご家族の想いに寄り添い、丁寧にサポートします。”（经验丰富的税务师将贴近家人的心意，为您提供遗产税申报及节税对策的细致支持。）下方横向放置 3 个圆角矩形功能卡片，背景色浅淡，配有绿色线条图标：卡片 1 显示文档图标及文字“相続税申告実績 1,000件以上”（遗产税申报业绩 1,000 件以上），附带小字“※累計実績”（累计业绩）；卡片 2 显示柱状图图标及文字“節税対策のご提案で 税負担を軽減”（通过节税对策建议减轻税务负担），附带小字“※状況により効果は異なります”（效果因情况而异）；卡片 3 显示群体图标及文字“初回相談 無料”（首次咨询免费），附带小字“安心の明朗会計”（明码标价，安心无忧）。在右半部分，展示一张明亮的咨询场景照片：在阳光充足、背景有绿植的办公室里，3 位日本成年人围坐在桌旁，包括右侧背对镜头、身着深蓝色西装的男性顾问，以及面对他的 2 位客户（一位身穿浅米色夹克的男性和一位身穿白色衬衫的女性）。桌上放着一台打开的笔记本电脑。他们的表情显得冷静且专注。在照片右下方叠加一个带有精致叶片装饰的浅色圆形徽章，文字为“安心の 相続専門サポート わかりやすいご説明ではじめての方も安心”（安心的遗产继承专业支持，通俗易懂的说明，初次咨询也能放心）。在下部中间，添加一行细长的咨询邀请线，文字为“相続に関するお悩み、まずはお気軽にご相談ください”（关于遗产继承的烦恼，请随时咨询），两侧以斜线装饰。下方横向放置 4 个圆角分类标签：“相続税の申告”、“生前対策・節税”、“遺産分割サポート”、“二次相続対策”。在右下角，添加一个大的绿色圆角联系 CTA 区域，分为两列：左列包含白色电话图标、小字“お電話でのお問い合わせ（フリーダイヤル）”（电话咨询（免费热线））、大号数字 {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"} 以及小字“受付時間 9:00〜18:00（土日祝対応可）”（受理时间 9:00-18:00，周末节假日可受理）；右列包含白色邮件图标、文字“メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中”（邮件咨询 24 小时受理中）以及一个圆角白色按钮“ご相談はこちらから”（点击此处咨询）。最底部创建一个白色保障条，横向排列 3 个由细竖线分隔的项目：1) 盾牌图标及“秘密厳守・プライバシー保護を徹底”（严格遵守保密与隐私保护），2) 剪贴板图标及“明朗会計・事前お見積りで安心”（明码标价，事前报价安心），3) 握手图标及“相続の専門家がワンストップで対応”（遗产继承专家一站式服务）。运用微妙的阴影、圆角、柔和的自然光，打造出专业、可信度极高的日本法律税务服务广告视觉效果。

templates.title: Japanese Legal Services LP Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 日本法律服务 LP 横幅

templates.prompt: A Japanese listing-ad style landing page hero banner for a fictional law office and tax accountant office, designed like a bold web advertisement with four equal vertical panels across the top and a strong call-to-action area across the bottom. The top row contains exactly 4 service panels, each with a colored header bar, a photo-realistic stock-photo image, and a colored caption bar at the bottom. Panel 1 is red and labeled 「刑事事件」 at the top, showing a close-up of two hands gripping dark prison bars against a black background; the bottom red caption reads 「逮捕・訴訟に即対応！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 2 is blue and labeled 「交通事故」 at the top, showing a realistic rear-end car crash with two damaged dark-colored sedans on a city street in daylight; the bottom blue caption reads 「慰謝料・示談もお任せ！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 3 is green and labeled 「相続税」 at the top, showing an elderly couple seated at a table consulting with a suited professional, with papers and a small house model visible; the bottom green caption reads 「税相続対策をしっかりサポート！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 4 is orange and labeled 「離婚問題」 at the top, showing a distressed woman sitting indoors with her head resting on one hand; the bottom orange caption reads 「慰謝料・親権の悩みを解決！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Make the four panels touch edge-to-edge with clean white dividers, each panel occupying the same width, and use highly saturated primary colors with glossy ad-design styling. Beneath the four panels, create a cream or light beige background footer area. On the left side, place a smaller black subheadline in Japanese: 「法律相談・税務相談なら」. Centered below it, place the large main office name in metallic gold gradient bold Japanese lettering with a slight bevel effect: 「{argument name="office name" default="〇〇法律事務所・税理士事務所"}」. Add thin black horizontal divider lines above and below the main office name. On the lower right, place a large glossy red rounded rectangular button with a bright gradient and white bold Japanese text reading 「{argument name="button text" default="無料相談受付中！"}」. The overall style should feel like a Japanese legal and tax services LP main visual from a listing ad: corporate, urgent, trustworthy, commercial, photo-based, clean grid layout, bold typography, high contrast, and realistic brochure-quality compositing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用日本列表广告风格的落地页首屏横幅，专为虚构的律师事务所和税务师事务所设计，呈现出醒目的网页广告效果，顶部设有四个等宽的垂直面板，底部设有强力的行动号召区域。顶行包含 4 个服务面板，每个面板均配有彩色标题栏、写实风格的素材图片以及底部的彩色说明栏。面板 1 为红色，顶部标注「刑事事件」，展示了一双紧握黑色背景下深色监狱铁栏的手部特写；底部红色说明栏以醒目的白色粗体日文写着「逮捕・訴訟に即対応！」。面板 2 为蓝色，顶部标注「交通事故」，展示了日光下城市街道上两辆受损深色轿车的真实追尾场景；底部蓝色说明栏以醒目的白色粗体日文写着「慰謝料・示談もお任せ！」。面板 3 为绿色，顶部标注「相続税」，展示了一对老年夫妇坐在桌前咨询身着西装的专业人士，桌上可见文件和一个小型房屋模型；底部绿色说明栏以醒目的白色粗体日文写着「税相続対策をしっかりサポート！」。面板 4 为橙色，顶部标注「離婚問題」，展示了一位神情忧郁的女性坐在室内，单手托腮；底部橙色说明栏以醒目的白色粗体日文写着「慰謝料・親権の悩みを解決！」。四个面板需边缘紧贴，并以干净的白色线条分隔，每个面板宽度一致，采用高饱和度原色及光泽感的广告设计风格。在四个面板下方，创建一个奶油色或浅米色的背景页脚区域。左侧放置一行较小的黑色日文副标题：「法律相談・税務相談なら」。正下方居中放置金属金渐变色、带有轻微斜面效果的粗体日文主事务所名称：「{argument name="office name" default="〇〇法律事務所・税理士事務所"}」。在事务所名称上下方添加细黑色水平分割线。右下角放置一个大型光泽红色圆角矩形按钮，带有明亮的渐变效果，并配有白色粗体日文：「{argument name="button text" default="無料相談受付中！"}」。整体风格应呈现出日本法律与税务服务 LP 列表广告主视觉的效果：企业化、紧迫感、值得信赖、商业化、基于照片、干净的网格布局、醒目的排版、高对比度以及写实的宣传册级合成效果。

templates.title: Fantasy Library Poster for Epix & Ria

titleLocalized.zh: Epix & Ria 奇幻图书馆海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic fantasy anime poster in a tall vertical composition, showing two childlike adventurer characters standing in a vast magical library-cathedral with impossibly high gothic arches, towering bookshelves on both sides, floating pages, glowing dust, and a grand staircase rising in the center toward a radiant portal-like window filled with intricate celestial magic-circle patterns. The viewpoint is low and dramatic, looking slightly upward, with both characters reaching one hand toward the viewer in an inviting gesture. On the left is a slightly taller child with short silver-white hair, soft bangs, and large green leaf-like ear ornaments or animal-like ears, wearing a navy hooded jacket over a warm orange top, dark pants, sturdy boots, and a black crossbody satchel; keep the face partially obscured by framing or angle. On the right is a shorter child with a matching design language, short silver-white bob hair with green-tinted ends, large teal-green eyes, and the same green leaf-like ear features, wearing a navy hooded jacket, orange inner layer, short dark bottoms, boots, and a mauve-purple shoulder bag decorated with small charms including a star. Between their outstretched hands, create a bright burst of magical light where two energies meet: luminous cyan-blue streams curling around the left character and warm pink-gold streams curling around the right character, with spark particles and ribbon-like trails. Split the lighting mood into cool blue on the left side and warm golden-magenta on the right side, blending at the center into a brilliant white flare. Add dense atmospheric detail: glowing motes, magical filaments, floating sheets of paper, layered architecture, and a sense of wonder and discovery. At the top, include centered Japanese tagline text in elegant white serif style: "わかることと、感じること。2つの力で世界をひらく。" At the bottom, place a very large luminous gold serif title reading "{argument name="title text" default="Epix&Ria"}" with ornate cinematic poster typography. High-detail, polished key visual, fantasy adventure film poster, richly textured, radiant, emotional, awe-inspiring, premium illustrated promotional art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的奇幻动漫海报，采用竖构图。画面展示了两位孩童模样的冒险者，站在一座宏伟的魔法图书馆大教堂中，背景是高耸入云的哥特式拱门和两侧参天的书架，空中飘浮着书页，闪烁着微光尘埃。中央有一座宏伟的楼梯，通向一扇如传送门般、布满复杂天体魔法阵图案的窗户。视角低沉而富有戏剧性，略微仰视，两位角色均向观众伸出一只手，做出邀请的姿态。左侧角色稍高，留着银白色短发，刘海柔顺，佩戴大型叶片状耳饰或动物耳，身穿海军蓝连帽外套，内搭暖橙色上衣，深色长裤，结实的靴子，背着黑色斜挎包；脸部通过构图或角度进行部分遮挡。右侧角色稍矮，设计风格相呼应，留着银白色波波头，发梢带有绿色调，拥有一双青绿色大眼睛，同样佩戴叶片状耳饰，身穿海军蓝连帽外套，内搭橙色衣物，深色短裤，靴子，背着装饰有星星等小挂件的淡紫色单肩包。在他们伸出的双手之间，创造出一团明亮的魔法光芒，两种能量在此交汇：青蓝色光流环绕左侧角色，暖粉金色光流环绕右侧角色，伴随着火花粒子和丝带状轨迹。光影氛围左侧为冷蓝色，右侧为暖金洋红色，在中心交融成耀眼的白光。添加丰富的氛围细节：发光的微尘、魔法丝线、飘浮的纸张、层次分明的建筑，营造出奇迹与探索感。海报顶部居中处加入优雅的白色衬线体日文标语：“わかることと、感じること。2つの力で世界をひらく。”（理解与感受，以双重力量开启世界。）海报底部放置巨大的发光金色衬线体标题 “{argument name="title text" default="Epix&Ria"}”，并采用华丽的电影海报排版。高细节、精致的主视觉图，奇幻冒险电影海报，质感丰富，光芒四射，情感充沛，令人惊叹，顶级插画宣传艺术。

templates.prompt: A clean anime-style full-body character illustration of a young woman squatting low on a plain light gray background, centered in frame, with a soft studio shadow beneath her. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} short bob hair with blunt straight bangs, slightly tousled ends, and a few loose strands around the face. Her expression is {argument name="expression" default="spiral half-lidded annoyed eyes"}, giving a tired, gloomy, slightly irritated look. She is wearing 4 visible clothing items: an oversized light gray hoodie with drawstrings and ribbed cuffs, dark blue denim short shorts with frayed hems, white scrunched ankle socks, and black low-top skate sneakers with white side stripes, white laces, and white soles. Her pose is a compact crouch with both knees up, one elbow resting on a knee, one hand partly covering the lower face or cheek, and the other hand hanging down near the front shoe. The art style is polished modern manga/anime key visual art with thin clean linework, smooth cel-shaded rendering, subtle fabric folds, natural skin highlights on the legs, and slightly oversized hoodie proportions. Emphasize a casual, moody, introverted vibe, minimalist composition, and a high-quality character-focused illustration.

templates.title: Cinematic Shiba Squat Hero Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感柴犬深蹲英雄海报

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-detailed cinematic parody movie poster featuring an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu as an extreme bodybuilding powerlifting hero, centered in a full frontal deep squat while holding a massively overloaded barbell across his shoulders. The dog has a realistic Shiba Inu head with a calm, confident expression, warm orange-and-cream fur, upright ears, and direct eye contact. The body is exaggeratedly muscular and humanlike, with huge deltoids, chest, arms, abs, quads, and calves, rendered with glossy dramatic highlights and dense texture in the fur and skin. He wears only tight black lifting shorts and a dark lifting belt. The squat stance is low and powerful, knees bent wide, feet planted on a wet reflective rooftop or industrial platform at night. Put a modern city skyline in the background with illuminated skyscrapers, bluish haze, smoke, and two bright stadium floodlights in the upper left and upper right creating strong rim light and a heroic sports-arena mood. The composition should be perfectly centered and symmetrical, with the barbell extending horizontally across the frame and stacked with many large black weight plates on both sides. Use a high-contrast teal, amber, black, and gold color palette with intense cinematic grading, sharp focus on the character, and atmospheric glow around the lights. Add stylized poster typography: at the very top, a gold all-caps tagline reading {argument name="top tagline" default="NO PAIN. MUCH GAIN. SUCH LEGEND."}. Add 2 blocks of small white Japanese copy, 1 on the left of the character and 1 on the right, each set in 2 lines. At the bottom, place a gigantic cracked stone-textured gold title in all caps reading {argument name="movie title" default="SQUAT HERO"}. Beneath it, add a red all-caps subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle" default="LEG DAY IS DESTINY."}. Add a small red stamp-like Japanese label near the lower right of the title. Include dense tiny mock film-poster credits in white across the lower center, a ratings box in the lower left, 3 tiny studio or audio logos in the lower right, and a centered release line near the bottom reading {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON TO A GYM NEAR YOU"}. Make it look like a polished blockbuster action-comedy sports film poster with absurdly epic intensity, photoreal rendering, dramatic shadows, volumetric smoke, reflective ground, and premium theatrical poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超高细节的电影感恶搞海报，主角是一只拟人化的柴犬，化身为极限健美力量举英雄。画面中心，他正处于全正面深蹲姿势，肩扛沉重的超负荷杠铃。这只狗拥有逼真的柴犬头部，表情冷静自信，毛色为温暖的橙奶油色，耳朵竖立，目光直视前方。身体呈现出夸张的肌肉感和人类特征，拥有巨大的三角肌、胸肌、手臂、腹肌、股四头肌和小腿，毛发和皮肤呈现出光泽的戏剧性高光和致密质感。他仅穿着紧身黑色举重短裤和深色举重腰带。深蹲姿势低沉有力，双膝宽展，双脚稳稳地踏在夜晚湿润反光的屋顶或工业平台上。背景为现代城市天际线，点缀着发光的摩天大楼、蓝色薄雾、烟雾，左上角和右上角各有一盏明亮的体育场泛光灯，营造出强烈的轮廓光和英雄般的体育竞技场氛围。构图应保持完美的居中对称，杠铃水平贯穿画面，两侧堆叠着许多大型黑色杠铃片。采用高对比度的青色、琥珀色、黑色和金色调，配合强烈的电影级调色，角色焦点清晰，灯光周围带有大气光晕。添加风格化的海报排版：在最顶部，使用金色大写字母添加标语 {argument name="top tagline" default="NO PAIN. MUCH GAIN. SUCH LEGEND."}。在角色左右两侧各添加 2 段小型白色日文文案，每段分 2 行排列。在底部，放置一个巨大的裂纹石质感金色大写标题 {argument name="movie title" default="SQUAT HERO"}。在其下方，添加一行红色大写副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="LEG DAY IS DESTINY."}。在标题右下方添加一个红色印章风格的日文标签。在底部中心添加密集的微型仿电影海报演职员表，左下角放置评级框，右下角放置 3 个微型工作室或音频标志，并在底部中心添加上映信息 {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON TO A GYM NEAR YOU"}。使其看起来像一张精致的动作喜剧体育大片海报，具有荒诞的史诗感、照片级渲染、戏剧性阴影、体积烟雾、反光地面以及高级院线海报设计。

She has black hair tied in a messy high ponytail, pale skin, and wears a glossy black tactical flight suit covered in patches, straps, cables, and sponsor markings. A massive hard-shell backpack radio rig with long antennas and decals is mounted on her back, and an ID badge hangs from her waist. templates.title: Cockatiel Owner Seed Spill Comic

templates.prompt: A single-panel Japanese comic-style illustration on a light wooden floor, drawn in a soft, detailed, slightly vintage manga-anime style with clean ink outlines and muted warm colors. In the center, a young woman kneels on the floor in a gray cockatiel kigurumi pajama suit with a white belly panel and small gray wings, while wearing an oversized yellow cockatiel hood shaped like a bird’s head with crest, round black eyes, orange cheek patches, and a beak above her forehead. She holds both sides of the hood in shock, her posture frozen and guilty, with a large rectangular censor block covering the center of her face. Across the floor in front of her is a huge mess of spilled birdseed: mixed grains, pellets, shells, and seeds scattered widely in a dense irregular pile. On the left lies 1 overturned white seed cup spilling its contents, and in the lower left corner 1 vacuum cleaner floor head points toward the mess, with part of the hose visible at the lower right edge. On the right stands 1 real cockatiel, small and curious, with a yellow face, orange cheeks, pale body, gray wings, and a raised crest, looking toward the kneeling woman; next to the bird is 1 small speech bubble containing a question mark. The background is simple indoor flooring with dramatic dark vertical stress lines filling the upper half to heighten panic. Add 4 Japanese text elements integrated like manga lettering: a huge sound effect 「ガーン」 at the upper left, 1 vertical thought bubble on the left reading 「やっちゃった…」, 1 large vertical spiky speech bubble on the upper right reading 「これ…掃除機かけるの…？無理ゲーすぎる…！」, and 1 beige caption box at the bottom right reading 「オカメ飼い、あるある。」. templates.title: Minimal Analog Wall Clock at 05:29

titleLocalized.zh: 05:29 的极简模拟挂钟

templates.prompt: A minimalist studio photograph of a round analog wall clock mounted on a smooth light gray wall, centered in frame and viewed straight on. The clock has a matte black circular frame, a clean white face, black Arabic numerals 1 through 12, and thin black minute tick marks around the entire dial with thicker hour marks at each numeral. Show exactly 12 numerals and 60 minute divisions. The time displayed is {argument name="clock time" default="05:29"}: the short hour hand is slightly past 5, the longer minute hand points to the 29-minute mark just before the 6, and a very thin black second hand is near the lower part of the dial around the 31-second position. Soft even lighting, subtle realistic shadow on the wall, high-detail product-photography realism, neutral modern interior aesthetic, no branding, no extra objects, square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义风格的摄影作品，展示了一个安装在平滑浅灰色墙面上的圆形模拟挂钟，画面居中且为正视视角。挂钟配有哑光黑色圆形边框、简洁的白色表盘、1 到 12 的黑色阿拉伯数字，表盘周围有细长的黑色分钟刻度，每个数字处有较粗的小时刻度。显示完整的 12 个数字和 60 个分钟刻度。显示时间为 {argument name="clock time" default="05:29"}：短时针略微超过 5 点，长分针指向 6 点前方的 29 分钟刻度，极细的黑色秒针位于表盘下半部分约 31 秒的位置。柔和均匀的灯光，墙上带有细腻逼真的阴影，高细节产品摄影质感，中性现代室内美学，无品牌标识，无额外物体，方形构图。

templates.title: Anime Girl Under Umbrella in Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中撑伞的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A luminous anime-style close-up portrait of a teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors in the rain, framed from the chest up, holding a transparent vinyl umbrella. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark navy black"} hair tied in a low side ponytail with soft loose strands and straight bangs, delicate round glasses, large glossy violet-blue eyes, and a calm, slightly awed expression as she looks upward toward leaves and raindrops. She wears a wet white short-sleeved school blouse and a dark blue plaid ribbon bow at the collar. The scene is filled with convincing water and light: rain falling in fine streaks, droplets clinging to the umbrella ribs, beads of water on her hair and shirt, and large crystal-clear drops hanging from broad green leaves in the upper right foreground. In the lower right and foreground, include blooming white garden flowers with dark glossy foliage covered in rain. Use a cool blue and silver palette with soft lavender highlights, backlit by diffused daylight after or during a shower, creating intense transparency, reflections, refraction, sparkling bokeh, and shimmering wet surfaces. The background should be an out-of-focus urban garden or residential walkway with fences and buildings blurred by rain, while the girl remains sharply rendered. Emphasize cinematic composition, layered foreground leaves, hyper-detailed raindrops, realistic translucent umbrella material, subtle rim light on wet hair, and an overall mood of quiet wonder and serene summer rain.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅明亮的动漫风格特写肖像，描绘了一位站在户外雨中的少女，半身构图，手持一把透明的塑料雨伞。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深藏青黑色"} 的头发，扎成低侧马尾，带有柔和的碎发和直刘海，戴着精致的圆框眼镜，有着明亮的大眼睛，呈紫蓝色，神情平静，带着一丝惊叹，仰望着叶片和雨滴。她穿着湿透的白色短袖校服衬衫，领口系着深蓝色格子蝴蝶结。场景中充满了逼真的水感与光影：细密的雨丝落下，雨滴附着在伞骨上，发丝和衬衫上挂着水珠，右上角前景的大片绿叶上悬挂着晶莹剔透的水滴。右下角及前景处，点缀着盛开的白色花园花卉，深色的光泽叶片上覆盖着雨水。采用冷蓝色和银色调，辅以柔和的淡紫色高光，背景为雨后或雨中漫射的日光逆光，营造出强烈的透明感、反射、折射、闪烁的焦外成像以及湿润表面的光泽。背景应为失焦的城市花园或住宅步道，围栏和建筑在雨中变得模糊，而少女主体保持清晰。强调电影感的构图、层叠的前景叶片、超精细的雨滴、逼真的半透明雨伞材质、湿润发丝上的细微轮廓光，以及整体宁静惊叹与夏日雨景的氛围。

templates.title: Photographed MIDI Piano Score Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: MIDI 钢琴乐谱实拍图

templates.prompt: A top-down realistic photograph of a single white sheet of printer paper placed on a light wood desk, showing a computer-generated music score. The page is centered horizontally with slight perspective and soft natural indoor lighting, minimal shadows, and a clean document-print look. At the top center, print the title "{argument name="file name" default="kura.mid"} - {argument name="track name" default="CH05 Piano"}" in a plain sans-serif font. Below it is a piano staff system rendered in standard black music notation with a treble clef and 4/4 time signature, designed to look like an automatically converted MIDI excerpt rather than carefully engraved sheet music. On the far left of the first system, include the instrument label "CH05 Piano". Show exactly 5 horizontal systems of notation on the page, beginning with measure numbers 18, 21, 25, 29, and 33 at the left edges of the systems. Near the first system, include a tempo marking with a quarter-note symbol equals 120. Fill the staves with dense, slightly awkward but plausible black notes, accidentals, stems, slurs, and rests, with many sharp signs and repeated short-note figures in the upper register, visually resembling piano transcription from MIDI. The first 3 systems should be long and nearly full width; the 4th system should also be long; the 5th system should be short, occupying only the left portion of the page. Keep the notation legible but somewhat mechanically spaced. Use a clean white page with wide margins and no handwritten marks, no colored elements, no extra graphics, just the printed score sheet photographed on a desk.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张放置在浅色木质书桌上的白色打印纸俯拍写实照片，展示了一份计算机生成的乐谱。页面水平居中，带有轻微的透视感，光线为柔和的室内自然光，阴影极少，呈现出干净的文档打印质感。在页面顶部中央，用简洁的无衬线字体打印标题“{argument name="file name" default="kura.mid"} - {argument name="track name" default="CH05 Piano"}”。下方是标准的黑色五线谱系统，带有高音谱号和 4/4 拍号，设计风格呈现出 MIDI 自动转换后的效果，而非精细排版的乐谱。在第一行五线谱的最左侧，标注乐器名称“CH05 Piano”。页面上需精确显示 5 行水平五线谱，各行左侧起始小节编号分别为 18、21、25、29 和 33。在第一行五线谱附近，包含一个四分音符等于 120 的速度标记。五线谱中填满密集、略显生硬但合理的黑色音符、变音记号、符干、连音线和休止符，高音区包含大量升号和重复的短音符组合，视觉上类似于 MIDI 转换出的钢琴谱。前 3 行五线谱应较长且几乎占满全宽；第 4 行也应较长；第 5 行应较短，仅占据页面左侧部分。乐谱需保持清晰可读，但间距呈现出机械生成的特征。使用干净的白纸，留有宽边距，无手写痕迹，无彩色元素，无额外图形，仅呈现放置在书桌上拍摄的打印乐谱。

templates.title: Anime Office Lady Beer Toast at Night

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫职场女性夜晚举杯庆祝

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style night illustration in a tall 1:2 vertical composition. A young Japanese office lady stands on a riverside promenade at night, facing the viewer, offering a large glass beer mug forward in a cheerful toast. She wears a fitted dark navy business suit with a pencil skirt, white dress shirt, red necktie, and a company ID badge on a lanyard. She has long straight dark brown to black hair with soft bangs, a slim figure, and a friendly after-work mood. Her right arm is extended toward the camera holding the frosty beer mug filled with golden lager and a foamy head, making the mug appear large in the foreground because of perspective. Her left arm hangs naturally by her side. Add a single white manga-style speech balloon to her upper right with vertical Japanese text reading 「今日もお疲れさまでした！」. Set the scene on a paved waterfront walkway with metal railings, 3 visible warm lantern lights along the path, a river or canal behind her, and a modern city skyline with many illuminated windows in the background. Above, a clear deep blue star-filled night sky dominates most of the image, with the Milky Way forming a bright diagonal band from lower center behind the character toward the upper right. Use cinematic lighting with cool moonlit blues contrasted by warm lantern glows, crisp linework, subtle glossy shading on the suit, detailed star field, and a calm, celebratory end-of-work atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格夜景插画，采用 1:2 竖构图。一位年轻的日本职场女性站在夜晚的河畔步道上，面向观众，欢快地举起一个大玻璃啤酒杯进行干杯。她身穿修身的深海军蓝职业套装，搭配包臀裙、白色衬衫、红色领带，脖子上挂着公司工牌。她留着深棕色至黑色的长直发，带有柔和的刘海，身材苗条，展现出下班后轻松友好的氛围。由于透视关系，她伸向镜头的右手中握着装满金色拉格啤酒和泡沫的冰镇啤酒杯，在前景中显得格外醒目。她的左臂自然垂在身侧。在她的右上角添加一个白色的漫画风格对话气泡，其中包含竖排日语文字「今日もお疲れさまでした！」。场景设定在铺设好的滨水步道上，配有金属栏杆，步道旁有 3 盏可见的暖色灯笼，身后是河流或运河，背景为拥有许多明亮窗户的现代城市天际线。画面上方，清澈深邃的蓝色星空占据了大部分空间，银河从角色身后的中心下方斜向延伸至右上角，形成一条明亮的光带。采用电影级光影效果，冷色调的月光与暖色调的灯笼光形成对比，线条清晰，套装上有细腻的光泽阴影，星空细节丰富，营造出一种宁静且充满庆祝感的下班氛围。

templates.title: Anime Girl by the Sea with Letter

titleLocalized.zh: 海边的动漫少女与信件

templates.prompt: A luminous anime-style illustration of a young woman standing on a sunlit stone stairway in a Mediterranean seaside town, with the viewpoint at half-body to three-quarter-body height. She has very long, flowing dark brown hair with soft highlights, slightly windswept, styled with small white flower hairpins near one side of her head. Her face is mostly obscured by her hair and angle, creating a gentle, dreamy, anonymous mood. She wears a delicate sleeveless {argument name="dress color" default="pale lavender-white"} summer dress with thin straps, lace trim, a soft fitted waist, and a large ribbon bow tied at the back. The background shows 1 narrow stone stair street lined with old buildings and greenery, 1 bright blue sea bay, 1 distant coastline with mountains, 1 lighthouse-like tower, and several tiny white boats on the water under a clear sky with soft clouds. Warm midday sunlight, sparkling atmosphere, romantic vacation postcard feeling, highly detailed anime painting, soft painterly textures, vivid blue ocean, lush green foliage, elegant feminine character design. On the right side, place 1 large white paper letter card floating as a clean overlay, with neat handwritten-style Japanese text in dark ink, including friendly emojis and flowers, as if it is a heartfelt fan message or thank-you note. The note should read: 「いつも見守ってくださって ありがとうございます😊✨ 皆さんの優しい言葉や応援が、紬の心の支えになっています🌷 日々の小さな幸せを大切にしながら、これからも心を込めて歌や言葉を届けていきますね♪♪🌸 どうか、皆さんの心が 穏やかであたたかい毎日で ありますように…🍀💖 結葉紬より🌸」. Make the letter large, legible, and balanced against the character, with a clean white background and slight paper texture. Add small subtle credit text in the bottom-left corner reading {argument name="credit text" default="Co-Creation with Motohiko Sato & AI"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在地中海海滨小镇阳光明媚的石阶上，视角为半身至四分之三身位。她留着一头非常长且飘逸的深棕色秀发，发丝随风轻拂，一侧别着精致的小白花发夹。她的面部大部分被头发和角度遮挡，营造出一种温柔、梦幻且神秘的氛围。她身穿一件精致的无袖 {argument name="dress color" default="淡薰衣草白"} 连衣裙，带有细肩带、蕾丝边、修身腰线，背后系着一个大蝴蝶结。背景展示了 1 条狭窄的石阶街道，两旁是古老的建筑和绿植，1 个湛蓝的海湾，1 条远处的山脉海岸线，1 座灯塔状的塔楼，以及在清澈天空和柔和云朵下海面上几艘小巧的白色船只。温暖的正午阳光，闪烁的氛围，浪漫的度假明信片感，高细节动漫绘画，柔和的绘画质感，生动的蓝色海洋，郁郁葱葱的绿色植被，优雅的女性角色设计。在右侧，放置 1 张巨大的白色纸质信笺作为清晰的叠加层，上面用深色墨水书写着整洁的手写体日语，包含友好的表情符号和花朵，仿佛是一封真挚的粉丝留言或感谢信。信件内容应为：「いつも見守ってくださって ありがとうございます😊✨ 皆さんの優しい言葉や応援が、紬の心の支えになっています🌷 日々の小さな幸せを大切にしながら、これからも心を込めて歌や言葉を届けていきますね♪♪🌸 どうか、皆さんの心が 穏やかであたたかい毎日で ありますように…🍀💖 結葉紬より🌸」。信件应清晰易读，与人物保持平衡，背景为干净的白色并带有轻微的纸张纹理。在左下角添加一行细微的署名文字：{argument name="credit text" default="Co-Creation with Motohiko Sato & AI"}。

templates.title: Luxury Lipstick Ad Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华口红广告视觉转换

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the portrait into a luxury lipstick advertisement while keeping the same girl, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, and elegant anime illustration style. Change the framing to a polished beauty-campaign composition with a dark crimson-to-black glamorous background, glossy lighting, and premium cosmetic brand aesthetics. Add a lipstick product in her raised hand on the right side, and add a large foreground product shot at the bottom left showing 1 opened lipstick tube and 1 separate cap on a reflective surface with a splash of deep red gloss. Add Japanese ad typography and layout elements: top left a small boxed label reading "新発売", a very large headline "ROUGE", a vertical text block reading "視線を奪う、ひと塗り。", followed by 3 smaller lines "鮮やかな発色。", "上品なツヤ。", "忘れられない印象へ。", then "2026 SPRING NEW COLOR" and a badge reading "全6色" with 6 lipstick swatches beside it. Add a top-right luxury logo with the letters "GB" and the brand name "GUFU BEAUTY". Add a bottom-right campaign block with a large "NEW" and the line "うるおい続く、密着ルージュ". Use rich ruby reds, gold accents, glossy highlights, soft sparkles, and a high-end magazine cosmetic poster finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将肖像转换为奢华口红广告，同时保留原有的女孩形象、发型、服装、配饰及优雅的动漫插画风格。将构图调整为精致的美妆广告风格，背景采用深绯红至黑色的华丽色调，搭配光泽感灯光及高端化妆品品牌美学。在右侧抬起的手中添加一支口红产品，并在左下角添加一张大型前景产品特写，展示一支打开的口红管和一只单独的盖子，放置在带有深红色光泽飞溅效果的反射面上。添加日文广告排版及布局元素：左上角添加一个写有“新発売”的小方框标签，一个超大的标题“ROUGE”，一个竖排文本块写着“視線を奪う、ひと塗り。”，随后是 3 行较小的文字：“鮮やかな発色。”、“上品なツヤ。”、“忘れられない印象へ。”，接着是“2026 SPRING NEW COLOR”以及一个写有“全6色”的徽章，旁边附带 6 个口红试色块。右上角添加一个带有字母“GB”及品牌名称“GUFU BEAUTY”的奢华标志。右下角添加一个广告宣传块，包含一个大号的“NEW”字样及文案“うるおい続く、密着ルージュ”。整体采用浓郁的红宝石色、金色点缀、光泽高光、柔和闪光，呈现高端杂志美妆海报的质感。

templates.prompt: A simple anime-style upper-body character illustration on a plain light gray background, centered and facing slightly left in a calm three-quarter pose. The character is a young futuristic female android or virtual idol with {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair, styled with one thick braided bun over the left side of the head, long loose side strands, and smooth straight hair flowing past the shoulders. She wears a geometric sci-fi headset over the left ear with a glowing cyan rectangular panel and angular metallic frame. Her outfit is a sleek white bodysuit with black structural straps and trim, a tall black high-neck collar, and thin glowing cyan accent lines running vertically and diagonally across the chest and torso. She has detached white arm sleeves with black bands, including one small dark diamond-shaped ornament on the upper arm. Render the image as a clean, minimal sketchy illustration with delicate pencil-like linework, light cel shading, soft pastel colors, subtle cyan highlights, and a polished concept-art feel. Keep the composition cropped from the top of the head to below the chest, with lots of negative space and no props, no text, and no detailed background.

templates.title: Coastal Reinforced Concrete Salt Damage

titleLocalized.zh: 沿海钢筋混凝土盐害

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic close-up documentary photograph of severe chloride-induced corrosion damage on a reinforced concrete coastal structure, viewed from slightly below at the corner of a cantilevered beam or pier. The image shows a large spalled area at the outer corner where the concrete cover has broken away, exposing exactly 5 rusted horizontal reinforcing steel bars embedded inside the concrete. The surrounding concrete is rough, cracked, and chipped, with irregular broken edges and visible aggregate. Brown-orange rust staining runs downward from the exposed reinforcement and along the underside of the beam, indicating long-term salt damage. The concrete surface is light gray, weathered, and matte, with subtle pores and construction imperfections. In the background, place a calm blue sea and a pale blue sky with a faint distant shoreline near the horizon, softly out of focus, reinforcing the marine environment. Bright natural daylight, clear weather, realistic smartphone photo composition, no people, no tools, no safety barriers, no text, no labels, no illustration style, only a believable engineering-inspection photo of salt-damaged reinforced concrete at the seaside.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的纪录片风格特写照片，展示了沿海钢筋混凝土结构上严重的氯化物腐蚀损坏，视角从悬臂梁或桥墩拐角处略微仰视。图像显示外角处有一大块剥落区域，混凝土保护层已脱落，精确露出内部嵌入的 5 根锈蚀水平钢筋。周围的混凝土粗糙、开裂且有缺口，边缘不规则，可见骨料。棕橙色的锈迹从裸露的钢筋处向下延伸，并沿着梁的底部蔓延，显示出长期的盐害影响。混凝土表面呈浅灰色，风化且呈哑光质感，带有细微的孔隙和施工瑕疵。背景处是平静的蓝色大海和淡蓝色的天空，地平线附近有模糊的远岸，柔和的虚化效果进一步强化了海洋环境。明亮的自然光，天气晴朗，真实的智能手机摄影构图，无人物、无工具、无安全护栏、无文字、无标签、非插画风格，仅呈现一张可信的沿海盐害钢筋混凝土工程检查照片。

templates.title: Winter Concrete Salt Damage Close-Up

titleLocalized.zh: 冬季混凝土盐害特写

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A hyperrealistic close-up documentary photograph of severe salt damage on a weathered concrete parapet wall in winter, shot from a low oblique angle so the wall recedes into the distance along the right side of the frame. The top coping is capped with a thin layer of snow and frost, and the lower ground surface beside the wall is dark, wet, and partially covered with slushy snow. The concrete face shows widespread scaling and spalling concentrated across the upper half, with irregular peeling patches exposing coarse aggregate stones of various sizes embedded in the mix. The damaged areas form rough, jagged, map-like shapes with crumbling edges, pitted texture, gray cement paste loss, and black and tan exposed pebbles. Vertical moisture streaks and dirty runoff stains descend toward the base of the wall. The overall palette is cold gray, charcoal, and muted winter white, with soft overcast daylight, shallow atmospheric haze in the distant background, and extremely detailed surface texture. Composition should feel like a civil engineering inspection photo, realistic smartphone or field-camera capture, no people, no text, no labels, no dramatic stylization.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的纪录片风格特写照片，展示了冬季风化的混凝土护栏墙上严重的盐害。拍摄角度为低位斜角，墙体向画面右侧纵深延伸。顶部压顶覆盖着一层薄薄的积雪和霜，墙侧的地面呈深色且潮湿，部分覆盖着泥泞的积雪。混凝土表面显示出大面积的剥落和脱落，主要集中在上半部分，不规则的剥落区域露出了混合料中嵌入的各种尺寸的粗骨料。受损区域呈现出粗糙、锯齿状的地图形轮廓，边缘碎裂，表面有麻点纹理，水泥浆流失，并露出黑色和棕褐色的砾石。垂直的湿气条纹和污浊的径流痕迹向下延伸至墙基。整体色调为冷灰色、炭灰色和柔和的冬季白色，光线为柔和的阴天日光，远景带有轻微的空气霾，表面纹理极其细腻。构图应呈现出土木工程检查照片的质感，如同真实的智能手机或现场相机拍摄，画面中无人、无文字、无标签，无夸张的艺术化处理。

templates.title: Concrete Wall with ASR Map Cracking

titleLocalized.zh: 带有 ASR 地图状裂缝的混凝土墙

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A highly realistic documentary-style close-up photo of a weathered reinforced concrete bridge pier or retaining wall outdoors, showing severe alkali-silica reaction damage. The wall fills most of the frame and is viewed from a slight angle so that both the front face and the left edge are visible. The concrete surface is gray, rough, aged, and stained, covered with a dense network of large irregular polygonal map cracks with approximately 18 clearly visible major crack cells across the surface. Many cracks have pale white gel-like seepage and chalky deposits along the edges, with vertical whitish and brownish water streaks running downward from several crack intersections. Include a horizontal construction joint or base line near the bottom of the wall, darker moisture staining along the lower section, and subtle moss or algae discoloration near the edges. The setting is an overcast riverside or drainage channel environment with sparse winter vegetation, rocks at the bottom right, and a narrow strip of still water on the right edge of the image. Natural muted lighting, neutral color palette, engineering inspection photo aesthetic, sharp surface texture, no people, no tools, no text, no annotations.

templates.prompt: A highly realistic documentary-style close-up photo of a reinforced concrete structural beam with severe {argument name="damage type" default="shear cracking"}. The scene shows the underside of a concrete building structure, with 1 large diagonal crack running from the lower left area upward toward the upper middle-right of the beam face, 1 secondary branching diagonal crack nearby on the left-center, and 3 thinner vertical to slightly irregular hairline cracks on the right half of the beam. The concrete surface is rough, weathered, pale gray, and speckled with small pores and aggregate marks, with darker grime and age staining near the ceiling slab and beam joints. Include a supporting concrete column at the far left, the underside of the beam visible along the bottom edge, and a dim industrial background below with shadowy pipes and structural elements out of focus. Lighting is natural and subdued, like an inspection photograph taken on site under a bridge or inside a parking structure. Composition is a straight-on medium close-up centered on the damaged beam face, emphasizing authentic structural deterioration, realistic texture, engineering-inspection accuracy, and no people, no safety signs, no overlay text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的纪录片风格特写照片，展示了一根带有严重 {argument name="damage type" default="剪切裂缝"} 的钢筋混凝土结构梁。场景显示了混凝土建筑结构的底部，梁面上有一条从左下区域向上延伸至中右上方的大型对角裂缝，左侧中心附近有一条次要的分支对角裂缝，右半部分还有 3 条较细的垂直或略显不规则的细微裂缝。混凝土表面粗糙、风化、呈灰白色，布满了小孔和骨料痕迹，天花板楼板和梁接缝处有较暗的污垢和老化污渍。画面最左侧包含一根支撑混凝土柱，底部边缘可见梁的底面，下方是昏暗的工业背景，带有失焦的管道和结构元件。光线自然且柔和，如同在桥下或停车场内拍摄的现场检测照片。构图为以受损梁面为中心的正面中景特写，强调真实的结构劣化、逼真的纹理和工程检测的准确性，画面中无人、无安全标志、无覆盖文字。

templates.title: Japanese Aqua Fashion Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日系水色时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: A polished Japanese fashion magazine cover illustration in elegant contemporary editorial style, vertical full-page composition. The cover title is a huge teal serif masthead reading "AURA" across the top. In the upper right, include 4 stacked issue details: "6", "June 2025", "No.126", and a small boxed label "アウラ", followed by the price line "特別定価 ¥980". The background is a bright pale blue sky with soft white clouds. Center the portrait of an androgynous, ethereal young model, shown from chest up, wearing a crisp white tailored jacket with subtle gold piping, a white shirt, a vivid aqua-teal vest or tie layer, and a gemstone-like star brooch at the collar. The character has very long, layered, windswept hair in {argument name="hair color" default="icy white with pale aqua tint"}, with glossy strands flowing across the shoulders, and fair luminous skin. The face is largely obscured by a centered rectangular censor block in muted gray-blue to pale pink gradient, covering the eyes, nose, and upper cheeks; the visible lower face shows a soft mouth and refined chin. One hand is raised near the lips in a thoughtful fashion-portrait pose. Use delicate anime-inspired linework, airy lighting, translucent highlights, and luxury beauty-editorial rendering. Add 3 left-column cover blurbs in Japanese with teal headlines and smaller black body text: first, "透明感をまとう 初夏のスキンケア" with 2 smaller lines beneath; second, "好印象をつくる 爽やかカラー術" with 2 smaller lines beneath; third, "プロが教える 美しい髪の条件" with 2 smaller lines beneath. Add a teal circular badge on the right with 4 lines of white text: "Special Interview", "風と光と、", "自分らしさと。", and "ソラが語る 日常と美学". Near the lower center, place a small italic English line "Cover & Special Feature" above the large Japanese main headline "ソラ、という名の透明感。" with the first word in teal and the rest in black. Under that, add 2 lines of smaller Japanese subheadline text. Along the bottom edge, create 3 feature teasers with pale italic English category labels and Japanese copy beneath: left label "Fashion", center label "Beauty", right label "Trend", each with 2 short Japanese lines. Overall mood: serene, luxurious, airy, refreshing early-summer beauty fashion cover with cohesive aqua-and-white color design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日系时尚杂志封面插图，采用优雅的现代编辑风格，垂直全页构图。封面标题为巨大的青色衬线字体“AURA”，横跨顶部。在右上角，包含 4 行堆叠的期刊详情：“6”、“June 2025”、“No.126”，以及一个带有小方框的标签“アウラ”，随后是价格行“特別定価 ¥980”。背景为明亮的淡蓝色天空，点缀着柔和的白云。画面中心为一位中性、空灵的年轻模特半身像，身穿剪裁利落的白色西装外套，配有精致的金色滚边、白色衬衫、鲜艳的水青色马甲或领带层，领口处佩戴一枚如宝石般的星形胸针。角色拥有非常长的层次感秀发，随风飘动，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="冰白色带淡水青色调"}，光泽发丝垂落在肩头，皮肤白皙透亮。面部大部分被居中的矩形遮挡块遮住，遮挡块呈柔和的灰蓝色至淡粉色渐变，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和上脸颊；可见的下半脸呈现出柔和的嘴唇和精致的下巴。一只手抬起靠近嘴唇，呈现出深思熟虑的时尚肖像姿势。使用细腻的动漫风格线条、轻盈的布光、半透明高光以及奢华的美妆编辑渲染效果。在左侧栏添加 3 条日文封面简介，配以青色标题和较小的黑色正文：第一条为“透明感をまとう 初夏のスキンケア”，下方附带 2 行小字；第二条为“好印象をつくる 爽やかカラー術”，下方附带 2 行小字；第三条为“プロが教える 美しい髪の条件”，下方附带 2 行小字。在右侧添加一个青色圆形徽章，内含 4 行白色文字：“Special Interview”、“風と光と、”、“自分らしさと。”以及“ソラが語る 日常と美学”。在下方居中位置，放置一行小的斜体英文“Cover & Special Feature”，上方为巨大的日文主标题“ソラ、という名の透明感。”，其中第一个词为青色，其余为黑色。下方添加 2 行较小的日文副标题。沿底部边缘，创建 3 个专题预告，配以淡色斜体英文分类标签和下方的日文文案：左侧标签“Fashion”，中间标签“Beauty”，右侧标签“Trend”，每项各配 2 行简短的日文。整体氛围：宁静、奢华、轻盈、清爽的初夏美妆时尚封面，采用统一的水青色与白色配色设计。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Stage Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑幻想风舞台剧海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical Japanese stage-play poster in luxurious dark fantasy anime style, featuring a single androgynous young actor in a half-body portrait against a nighttime city skyline with glowing high-rise windows and soft bokeh lights. The character has long straight hair in deep black with vivid teal-turquoise inner glow and streaks, glossy highlights, and strands flowing across the shoulders. They wear an elegant black high-collared costume with subtle brocade texture, a fitted dark coat, black leather gloves, and a jewel-like diamond-shaped turquoise pendant at the throat set in ornate gold. One gloved hand is raised near the collar in a poised theatrical gesture. The mood is mysterious, romantic, and slightly gothic, with cinematic rim lighting from behind, strong contrast, gold sparkles, and luminous accents in the hair and costume. Use a refined magazine-quality key visual composition with decorative gold filigree corners and a premium theatrical poster layout. Leave space for Japanese typography integrated into the design: at upper right, small text "夜空に輝く、唯一の星。", then "主演俳優" and the actor name "{argument name="character name" default="夜乃 宙"}" with small romanization "SORA YORUNO" beneath; along the left side, a vertical quote reading "この役に、すべてを捧げる。闇さえ、愛に変えてみせよう。"; near center-lower, small text "幻想ロマン・ステージ" above the large glowing gold title "{argument name="title text" default="夜の檻に囚われた光"}" with a small subtitle beneath "—それでも、君を愛した。"; include a dark teal rose motif and thorny circular ornament near the title. At the bottom left, add the date block "2025 6.20 FRI - 6.29 SUN" and venue "天穹シアター". At the bottom right, add a bordered ticket box with "チケット一般発売 5.10 SAT 10:00~". Center bottom credits in Japanese: "原作・脚本 霧月 澪", "演出 七海 翼", "音楽 深月 奏". Along the very bottom, add the tagline "—光か、闇か——。愛が、運命を選ぶ。—". Color palette: midnight blue, black, teal, cyan glow, and antique gold. Emphasize polished poster typography, layered depth, elegant fantasy drama branding, and a consistent face and atmosphere suitable for a theatrical promotional campaign.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧张力的日式舞台剧竖版海报，采用奢华的暗黑幻想动漫风格。画面中心为一位中性风年轻演员的半身肖像，背景是带有发光高层建筑与柔和散景灯光的夜间城市天际线。角色留着一头顺滑的长发，发色深黑，内层带有鲜艳的青绿光泽与挑染，发丝光泽感强，垂落在肩头。身着优雅的黑色高领服装，带有细腻的锦缎纹理，搭配修身深色外套、黑色皮手套，喉间佩戴着一颗镶嵌在华丽金饰中的菱形青绿色宝石吊坠。一只戴着手套的手抬至领口附近，呈现出优雅的舞台剧姿态。整体氛围神秘、浪漫且略带哥特感，背光处带有电影质感的轮廓光，对比强烈，点缀着金色火花，发丝与服装上的光效熠熠生辉。采用精致的杂志级主视觉构图，配以装饰性的金色花丝边角，呈现高端舞台剧海报布局。预留空间以融入日文排版：右上角小字“夜空に輝く、唯一の星。”，下方为“主演俳優”及演员姓名“{argument name="character name" default="夜乃 宙"}”，下方附带小字罗马音“SORA YORUNO”；左侧垂直排版引语“この役に、すべてを捧げる。闇さえ、愛に変えてみせよう。”；中下部为小字“幻想ロマン・ステージ”，上方为巨大的金色发光标题“{argument name="title text" default="夜の檻に囚われた光"}”，下方附带小标题“—それでも、君を愛した。”；标题附近加入深青色玫瑰图案与荆棘环形装饰。左下角添加日期栏“2025 6.20 FRI - 6.29 SUN”及演出地点“天穹シアター”。右下角添加带边框的票务信息栏“チケット一般発売 5.10 SAT 10:00~”。底部居中处标注制作人员名单：“原作・脚本 霧月 澪”、“演出 七海 翼”、“音楽 深月 奏”。最底部添加宣传语“—光か、闇か——。愛が、運命を選ぶ。—”。配色方案：午夜蓝、黑色、青色、青色荧光及古董金。强调精致的海报排版、层次深度、优雅的幻想戏剧品牌感，以及适合舞台剧宣传活动的统一面部特征与氛围。

templates.title: Sunny Japanese Cafe Street Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光明媚的日本咖啡馆街景

templates.prompt: A bright, ultra-realistic summer streetscape in Japan, photographed at pedestrian eye level on a wide, clean urban sidewalk lined with mature green trees casting dappled shadows. The scene shows a modern mixed-use city block on a clear sunny day, with a contemporary cafe or restaurant on the right featuring tall glass windows, dark frames, a stone facade, and a warm wood soffit extending over the terrace. Place 3 large beige patio umbrellas outside the cafe, with wooden tables and chairs beneath them. Show a lively but orderly sidewalk with around 14 pedestrians spread into the distance, most dressed in light summer office-casual clothing in white, beige, navy, and gray. In the center foreground, include 1 person riding a bicycle away from the camera, wearing a short-sleeve white shirt and dark pants with a shoulder bag. On the right foreground, include 2 women walking away, one in a white blouse and long dark floral skirt holding a round hand fan, and one in a white top and light patterned skirt carrying a bag. Add 2 visible standing signs outside the cafe: one vertical banner with large Japanese text "氷" and icy blue graphics, and one sandwich board with Japanese text reading "夏季限定 冷たいドリンク" plus images of 2 cold drinks, one dark iced beverage and one pale lemonade-like drink. On the left side, show a quiet street with a few vehicles in the distance, benches, low concrete planters, and neatly trimmed shrubs. Composition should emphasize depth with a long vanishing point down the tree-lined boulevard, crisp midday sunlight, realistic reflections in the windows, and an upscale, calm urban atmosphere. Photorealistic architectural photography, natural colors, high detail, wide-angle lens, deep focus.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、超写实的日本夏季街景，以行人视角的水平高度拍摄，展现了一条宽阔整洁的城市人行道，两侧绿树成荫，投下斑驳的树影。场景呈现了一个晴朗夏日里的现代综合用途街区，右侧是一家现代风格的咖啡馆或餐厅，配有高大的落地玻璃窗、深色边框、石材外立面，以及延伸至露台上方的暖色木质吊顶。在咖啡馆外放置 3 把大型米色遮阳伞，下方摆放着木质桌椅。人行道上行人往来有序，约有 14 名行人分布在远处，大多数人穿着浅色夏季商务休闲装，色调以白色、米色、海军蓝和灰色为主。在画面中心前景处，加入 1 名骑自行车的行人背对镜头，身穿短袖白衬衫和深色长裤，背着单肩包。在右侧前景处，加入 2 名背对镜头的女性，一人身穿白色衬衫和深色长碎花裙，手持圆扇；另一人身穿白色上衣和浅色花纹裙，提着包。在咖啡馆外添加 2 个显眼的立式招牌：一个是带有醒目日文“氷”字和冰蓝色图形的竖幅旗帜，另一个是写有日文“夏季限定 冷たいドリンク”的立式折叠招牌，并配有 2 款冷饮的图片，分别为一杯深色冰饮和一杯浅色柠檬水状饮料。在左侧，展示一条安静的街道，远处有少量车辆、长椅、低矮的混凝土花坛和修剪整齐的灌木。构图应强调纵深感，通过林荫大道形成长远的消失点，呈现正午明媚的阳光、窗户上真实的倒影，以及高端、宁静的城市氛围。照片级建筑摄影，自然色彩，高细节，广角镜头，深焦。

templates.title: Aerial View of Modern Transit Hub

titleLocalized.zh: 现代交通枢纽鸟瞰图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A high-angle aerial drone photograph of a modern urban transit hub in a dense mixed-use city district, captured in crisp late-afternoon sunlight with realistic architectural detail. The scene centers on a large multi-track rail station running diagonally through the frame, with 6 visible railway tracks, 2 long passenger trains at platforms, and a glass-covered station canopy near the upper middle. A broad pedestrian bridge crosses above the tracks from left to right, connecting plazas on both sides. In the lower middle is a bus interchange with 7 visible buses parked or moving through curved lanes and marked bays. Surround the station with tall contemporary residential towers, mid-rise office buildings, retail frontages, tree-lined streets, bike lanes, sidewalks, parked cars, and small groups of pedestrians. Include one prominent glass office building on the left with rooftop greenery and a visible corporate sign reading {argument name="building sign text" default="innovation"}. Add multiple green roofs and rooftop solar panels, especially on the lower-right building. Composition should feel like a clean, realistic North American transit-oriented development, viewed from an oblique bird's-eye perspective, ultra-detailed, natural colors, sharp focus, professional city-planning photography, no stylization.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张从高空俯瞰的无人机航拍照片，展示了密集混合用途城市区域中的现代交通枢纽，在清澈的傍晚阳光下拍摄，呈现出逼真的建筑细节。场景中心是一座斜穿画面的大型多轨道火车站，可见 6 条铁轨、2 列停靠在站台的长途客运列车，以及中上方带有玻璃顶棚的车站大厅。一座宽阔的人行天桥从左至右横跨铁轨，连接两侧的广场。中下方是一个公交枢纽，可见 7 辆公交车停靠或穿行于弯曲的车道和标线泊位中。车站周围环绕着高大的现代住宅楼、中高层办公楼、零售店面、绿树成荫的街道、自行车道、人行道、停放的车辆以及三三两两的行人。左侧包含一栋醒目的玻璃办公大楼，楼顶设有绿化，并带有清晰的企业标志，文字为 {argument name="building sign text" default="innovation"}。增加多个绿色屋顶和屋顶太阳能电池板，特别是在右下方的建筑上。构图应呈现出整洁、写实的北美以公共交通为导向的开发项目风格，采用斜向鸟瞰视角，超高细节，色彩自然，对焦清晰，具备专业城市规划摄影水准，无艺术化处理。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Pink Mecha Angel Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克粉色机甲天使少女

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime cyberpunk action illustration of a young female cyborg with {argument name="hair color" default="bright pink"} twin-tail hair, suspended in a vast futuristic neon city shaft filled with glowing circuitry, holographic reflections, and dense sci-fi architecture. She is viewed in an extreme foreshortened perspective, lunging directly toward the camera with one oversized mechanical hand thrust forward, fingers spread and tipped with long glossy claws, while the other cybernetic arm is bent back in attack posture. She has a fierce focused expression, luminous green eyes, small glossy black-and-magenta horn-like head implants, and long flowing hair whipping outward in all directions. Her body is encased in a high-detail reflective chrome-and-magenta cybernetic exosuit with translucent chest plating, segmented armored shoulders, mechanical gauntlets, exposed joint details, armored thighs, and blade-like lower leg armor. Behind her are 2 large radiant energy wings made of pink crystalline electricity and particle streaks, exploding outward symmetrically. The environment is a vertical futuristic corridor or megacity canyon with layered glass panels, glowing signage, metallic frameworks, blue and cyan lights mixed with dominant hot pink illumination, countless spark-like particles, lens glow, and high-density detail. Use a dramatic low-angle composition, centered character, aggressive attack pose, glossy surfaces, intense specular highlights, saturated magenta and cyan palette, cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, ultra-detailed anime rendering, sharp linework, and a sense of speed, power, and overwhelming visual density.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动态的动漫赛博朋克动作插画，主角是一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色"} 双马尾的年轻女性半机械人，悬浮在广阔的未来主义霓虹城市竖井中，周围充满了发光的电路、全息反射和密集的科幻建筑。她以极端的透视角度呈现，一只巨大的机械手向前伸出，直冲镜头，手指张开，指尖带有修长的光泽利爪，另一只机械手臂则向后弯曲呈攻击姿态。她表情凶狠专注，拥有发光的绿色双眼，头部植入了小型光泽黑洋红色角状物，长发向四面八方飘散。她的身体包裹在高度精细的反射式铬合金与洋红色机械外骨骼中，配有半透明胸甲、分段式装甲肩部、机械护手、裸露的关节细节、大腿装甲以及刀刃状的小腿装甲。在她身后，两对巨大的辐射能量翅膀由粉色结晶电流和粒子流组成，呈对称状向外爆发。环境是一个垂直的未来主义走廊或超级城市峡谷，布满了分层玻璃面板、发光标牌、金属框架，蓝色和青色灯光与主导的亮粉色照明交织，伴随无数火花般的粒子、镜头光晕和高密度的细节。采用戏剧性的低角度构图、居中角色、激进的攻击姿态、光泽表面、强烈的镜面高光、饱和的洋红色与青色调色板、电影级科幻氛围、超精细动漫渲染、锐利的线条，以及强烈的速度感、力量感和令人震撼的视觉密度。
