templates.title: Luxury Publishing Branding Editorial Spread

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华出版与品牌推广编辑排版

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious Japanese magazine-style PR editorial spread for a publishing and branding service, designed as a two-page brochure layout. The left half is a dark, cinematic portrait scene in a sophisticated office lounge: a seated Japanese businessman in a navy bespoke suit, white shirt, dark tie, white pocket square, and wristwatch sits in a leather chair with one hand near his chin, posed thoughtfully beside a glossy wooden table. His face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. The lighting is moody and warm, with reflections from tall windows and a premium executive atmosphere. On this dark left page, place large elegant serif headline text in English reading {argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}, stacked in two lines near the upper left in muted gold. Below it, add multiple lines of Japanese copy in white, including a larger subheadline and several short body paragraphs arranged vertically. Near the lower left, include a bordered dark box containing exactly 4 checklist items, each preceded by a check mark, with Japanese text. Put a small page number "02" in the bottom-left corner. The right half is a clean white editorial information page with refined minimalist typography and generous spacing. At the top, place a large Japanese headline in black, aligned upper center-right, with two short Japanese body text blocks beneath it; on the upper far right include a small photo of exactly 4 stacked hardcover books and a glass vase near a bright window with greenery. Across the middle, add a centered section title in Japanese for five benefits, followed by exactly 5 numbered columns labeled 1 through 5, each with a short Japanese heading and several lines of smaller explanatory Japanese text. Beneath that, add another centered Japanese section title for workflow, followed by exactly 4 step blocks laid out horizontally: STEP 01 with a speech bubble icon, STEP 02 with a pencil icon, STEP 03 with an open book icon, STEP 04 with a megaphone icon. Each step includes the English word STEP plus a two-digit number, a short Japanese subtitle, and a few lines of smaller Japanese description, with small chevrons between steps. Along the bottom of the right page, place exactly 3 rectangular photos side by side: a city-view office meeting table scene, a close-up of a hand writing with a pen, and a stack of books near an open book. Under these images, add a prominent Japanese closing statement in a serif style on the lower left, and a smaller Japanese paragraph on the lower right. Put page number "03" in the bottom-right corner. Use a premium palette of deep navy, black, warm brown, ivory, and muted gold, with a balance of editorial luxury, corporate trust, and high-end publishing aesthetics. The overall composition should feel like a real magazine advertisement or consulting brochure, polished, photorealistic, elegant, and credible.

promptLocalized.zh: 为出版与品牌服务创作一份奢华的日式杂志风格公关编辑排版，设计为双页宣传册布局。左半部分为深色电影质感的肖像场景，背景设在精致的办公休息室：一位身着海军蓝定制西装、白衬衫、深色领带、白色口袋巾并佩戴腕表的日本商务人士，坐在皮椅上，单手托腮，姿态沉思，身旁是一张光亮的木质桌子。他的面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理。灯光氛围感强且温暖，伴有落地窗的倒影，营造出高级行政氛围。在此深色左页上，放置醒目优雅的衬线英文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}，以哑光金色分两行堆叠在左上方。下方添加多行白色日文文案，包括一个较大的副标题和几段垂直排列的简短正文。左下角附近包含一个带边框的深色方框，内含 4 个带勾选标记的清单项，并配有日文文本。左下角放置页码“02”。右半部分为简洁的白色编辑信息页，采用精致的极简主义排版和宽裕的留白。顶部中央偏右处放置一个醒目的黑色日文大标题，下方配有两个简短的日文正文块；右上角包含一张小图，展示 4 本堆叠的精装书和一个靠近明亮窗户及绿植的玻璃花瓶。页面中部添加一个居中的日文五大优势标题，下方排列 5 个编号列（1 至 5），每列包含简短的日文标题及几行较小的日文说明文字。下方添加另一个居中的日文工作流程标题，随后横向排列 4 个步骤块：STEP 01 配有对话气泡图标，STEP 02 配有铅笔图标，STEP 03 配有打开的书本图标，STEP 04 配有扩音器图标。每个步骤包含英文单词 STEP 及两位数编号、简短的日文副标题和几行较小的日文描述，步骤之间以小箭头连接。右页底部并排放置 3 张矩形照片：城市景观办公会议桌场景、手持钢笔书写的特写，以及靠近打开书本的一叠书籍。在这些图片下方，左侧添加一段醒目的衬线风格日文结语，右侧添加一段较小的日文段落。右下角放置页码“03”。采用深海军蓝、黑、暖棕、象牙白和哑光金的高级配色，平衡编辑奢华感、企业信任度与高端出版美学。整体构图应呈现出真实杂志广告或咨询手册的质感，精致、写实、优雅且具有公信力。

templates.title: Low-Angle Redhead Cargo Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 低角度红发工装时尚人像

templates.prompt: A realistic fashion-photo style full-body cropped portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="young woman"} shot from a dramatic low angle against a bright blue sky with 2 soft white cloud patches. She is turned mostly away from the camera in a three-quarter back view, looking over her shoulder, with long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="auburn red"} hair falling to mid-back and moving naturally in the breeze. She wears a fitted black ribbed long-sleeve crop top that exposes the waist, olive green cargo pants with a low-rise fit, 5 visible belt-mounted utility pouches around the waistband, 2 visible back flap pockets, and 1 visible side cargo pocket on the left thigh. She also wears a pair of glossy black leather gloves, with one gloved hand raised near her neck and jaw and the other lowered near her thigh. Emphasize a cinematic, confident pose, natural daylight, realistic skin texture, detailed fabric stitching and seams, slightly sensual editorial styling, clean outdoor background, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the body and clothing, high-resolution photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实时尚摄影风格的全身裁剪人像，主角为 {argument name="character type" default="年轻女性"}，采用极具张力的低角度拍摄，背景为明亮的蓝天及两片柔和的白云。她背对镜头呈四分之三侧身，回头望向镜头，长长的波浪形 {argument name="hair color" default="红褐色"} 秀发垂至后背中部，在微风中自然飘动。她身穿修身黑色罗纹长袖短款上衣，露出腰部；下身搭配橄榄绿低腰工装裤，腰带处配有 5 个清晰可见的实用小包，后侧有 2 个翻盖口袋，左大腿侧有 1 个可见的工装口袋。她还戴着一副亮面黑色皮手套，一只手抬起靠近颈部和下颌，另一只手自然垂在腿侧。强调电影质感与自信姿态，自然日光，真实的皮肤纹理，细致的织物缝线与接缝，略带感性的编辑风格，干净的户外背景，浅景深，主体与服装焦点清晰，高分辨率写实效果。

templates.title: Censored Studio Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 带遮挡的摄影棚肖像

templates.prompt: A centered studio portrait photo of a single adult man from upper chest to top of head, facing straight toward the camera against a smooth deep navy-blue backdrop. He has a very closely shaved buzz cut, visible ears on both sides, medium tan skin, and short dark facial hair concentrated along the chin and jawline with a faint mustache. Dress him in a plain off-white or cream crewneck sweatshirt with no logo. Use soft professional studio lighting with gentle highlights on the scalp, ears, neck, and sweatshirt, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, and a clean photographic look. Compose it symmetrically with the head near the top of frame and broad shoulders filling the lower half, in a vertical portrait orientation. Overlay 1 large opaque rectangular censor block centered over the face, covering from forehead to below the nose area and spanning most of the facial width; make the block a flat muted brown tone with slightly soft edges so the facial features are completely hidden.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的摄影棚肖像照，拍摄对象为一名成年男性，取景范围从胸部上方至头顶，正对镜头，背景为平滑的深海军蓝色。他留着极短的寸头，双耳清晰可见，肤色为中等棕褐色，下巴和下颌线处有短促的深色胡茬，并带有淡淡的八字胡。让他穿着一件纯色米白色或奶油色圆领卫衣，无任何标志。采用柔和的专业摄影棚灯光，在头皮、耳朵、颈部和卫衣上形成柔和的高光，呈现逼真的皮肤纹理、浅景深以及干净的摄影质感。采用对称构图，头部靠近画面顶部，宽阔的肩膀填充下半部分，呈垂直肖像方向。在面部中心覆盖一个巨大的不透明矩形遮挡块，覆盖范围从前额到鼻部下方，横跨大部分面部宽度；将遮挡块设为平坦的柔和棕色调，边缘略微柔化，使面部特征完全被隐藏。

templates.title: Surreal Floating Head With Censor Block

titleLocalized.zh: 带有审查遮挡块的超现实漂浮头部

templates.prompt: A surreal studio portrait of a floating human head seen straight-on, centered in the frame against a vivid saturated blue sky with soft fluffy white clouds. The face is entirely obscured by a large smooth rectangular censor block in the center, covering from forehead to chin and most of the cheeks, with a subtle gradient of warm tan to muted blue-gray. Only the outer features remain visible: a close-cropped buzz cut with tight dark speckled hair texture on top, 2 visible ears, and the lower rounded chin and jaw. The head wears colorful eyeglass temples wrapping around the sides only, with no visible front lenses because the center is blocked; the left temple is pale cream with a tiny red-and-gold decorative mark, and the right temple is bright red-orange. Add 2 small rounded nubs peeking above the censor block near the top edge, one yellow on the left and one off-white on the right, creating a quirky toy-like feel. Render it as a hyperreal yet slightly uncanny 3D illustration, smooth skin, soft daylight, minimal composition, shallow depth of field, clean whimsical pop-surreal aesthetic.

In the lower background, include 2 red sports cars partially visible, one on each side, blending into a red desert-like horizon. templates.title: Dark Gothic Ritual in Cathedral

titleLocalized.zh: 大教堂中的黑暗哥特仪式

templates.prompt: A cinematic dark fantasy scene inside a vast gothic cathedral at night, centered on a mysterious woman in a floor-length black ceremonial gown standing in the middle of a glowing occult circle. The composition is perfectly symmetrical and frontal, with the woman placed dead center beneath a huge rose window and a bright full moon visible through the stained glass. She wears an ornate, form-fitting {argument name="dress color" default="black"} gown with lace, embroidered filigree, semi-sheer sleeves, a corseted bodice, and a long flowing train spreading across the stone floor. Her pose is regal and ritualistic, arms slightly extended at her sides with open hands, as if summoning smoke or dark magic. Her face is obscured and indistinct, with dark updo hair and a high gothic collar or headpiece. Around her feet is a large circular sigil inscribed in glowing {argument name="sigil glow color" default="amber-gold"} lines, with intricate symbols and concentric rings. Place exactly 30 black candles of varying heights around the circle and foreground, all lit, with warm flames casting low orange highlights. Fill the air with drifting smoke and mist, especially around her hands, the lower floor, and the side aisles. The cathedral interior is towering, shadowy, and highly detailed, with ribbed vaults, pointed arches, weathered stone, elaborate carvings, and deep blue-black darkness. On the left and right sides, include exactly 2 massive gargoyle or demon statues perched on ornate pedestals, one per side, leaning inward protectively or menacingly. Behind the woman, a raised altar and clusters of additional candles recede into darkness. Lighting is moody and high-contrast, dominated by cold moonlight from above and warm candlelight from below, creating metallic highlights on the dress and architecture. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, dramatic volumetric fog, gothic horror atmosphere, occult elegance, epic scale, sharp textures, realistic shadows, and a haunting, majestic mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个充满电影感的暗黑奇幻场景，背景设定在夜晚宏伟的哥特式大教堂内。画面中心是一位神秘女性，她身着及地黑色礼仪长袍，站在一个发光的神秘圆阵中央。构图采用完美的对称正面视角，女性位于巨大的玫瑰花窗正下方，透过彩色玻璃可以看到明亮的满月。她穿着一件华丽且修身的 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"} 长袍，带有蕾丝、刺绣花丝、半透明袖子、紧身胸衣以及铺散在石地板上的长拖尾。她的姿态庄严而富有仪式感，双臂向两侧微微伸展，手掌张开，仿佛正在召唤烟雾或暗黑魔法。她的面部模糊不清，梳着深色的盘发，戴着高耸的哥特式领饰或头饰。在她脚下是一个巨大的圆形符文，由发光的 {argument name="sigil glow color" default="琥珀金"} 线条刻画而成，包含复杂的符号和同心圆。在圆阵周围和前景处放置 30 支高度不一的黑色蜡烛，全部点燃，温暖的烛光投射出低沉的橙色高光。空气中弥漫着漂浮的烟雾和薄雾，尤其是在她的双手、地面及侧廊周围。大教堂内部高耸、阴暗且细节丰富，拥有肋架拱顶、尖拱、风化的石材、精致的雕刻以及深邃的蓝黑色阴影。在左右两侧，各放置 2 座巨大的石像鬼或恶魔雕像，它们栖息在华丽的基座上，向内倾斜，呈现出保护或威胁的姿态。在女性身后，一座高耸的祭坛和成簇的蜡烛隐入黑暗之中。光影氛围阴郁且对比强烈，上方是冷冽的月光，下方是温暖的烛光，在长袍和建筑表面营造出金属质感的高光。超高细节、照片级真实感、戏剧性的体积雾、哥特式恐怖氛围、神秘优雅、史诗级规模、清晰的纹理、逼真的阴影，以及令人难忘的庄严氛围。

In the exact center stands a mysterious sorceress in an elegant Victorian-inspired black gown with a fitted corset bodice, intricate silver embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, long draping lace panels from the arms, black gloves, and a long trailing skirt. Her hair is styled in a neat dark updo with a subtle ornamental hairpiece, and she wears delicate jewelry. She holds an open spellbook in one hand and raises the other hand in a poised spellcasting gesture. Surround her with low-lying mist and curling smoke. The cathedral interior is immense and decayed, with towering pointed arches, ribbed vaulted ceilings, cracked stone floors, broken tombs or altars on both sides, and thick twisted roots spreading across the ground and wrapping around the stone structures. Place exactly 2 large gargoyle statues perched symmetrically on elevated side structures, one on the left and one on the right, looming over the scene. Add many black candles with warm orange flames scattered across the foreground and midground, creating ritual ambience. In the background, show tall stained-glass windows with cold bluish daylight streaming through them in dramatic god rays, contrasting with the candlelight. Mood is haunting, arcane, cinematic, solemn, and highly detailed, with realistic textures, deep shadows, volumetric lighting, atmospheric haze, dark blue-gray color palette, and ultra-detailed gothic architecture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个位于巨大废弃大教堂内的暗黑哥特奇幻场景，采用垂直全身构图。画面正中央站着一位神秘的女巫，身着优雅的维多利亚风格黑色礼服，配有合身的束腰胸衣、精致的银色刺绣、透明蕾丝袖、从手臂垂下的长蕾丝饰片、黑色手套以及长拖尾裙摆。她的头发梳成整洁的深色盘发，戴着精致的发饰，并佩戴着考究的珠宝。她一手拿着一本打开的法术书，另一只手以优雅的姿态抬起进行施法。周围环绕着低垂的薄雾和缭绕的烟雾。大教堂内部宏大且破败，拥有高耸的尖拱、肋架拱顶、开裂的石质地面、两侧破碎的墓穴或祭坛，粗壮扭曲的树根在地面蔓延并缠绕着石质结构。在两侧的高处对称放置 2 座大型石像鬼雕像，左右各一，俯瞰着整个场景。在前景和中景散布许多带有温暖橙色火焰的黑色蜡烛，营造出仪式感。背景中，高大的彩色玻璃窗透出冷蓝色的日光，形成戏剧性的耶稣光，与烛光形成鲜明对比。整体氛围阴森、神秘、具有电影感、庄严且细节丰富，呈现出逼真的质感、深邃的阴影、体积光、大气雾霾、深蓝灰色调以及极致细节的哥特式建筑。

Inside notebooks, show exactly 2 visible files: 01_data_exploration.ipynb and 02_model_training.ipynb. Inside src, show a realistic ML code structure with dataset.py, transforms.py, models, resnet.py, train, engine.py, trainer.py, utils.py. The editor area has exactly 4 tabs open: trainer.py, engine.py, resnet.py, config.yaml. The active tab is trainer.py. Display clean, believable Python training code for a ResNet image classification pipeline, including a class Trainer, methods train(self) and train_epoch(self, epoch: int) -> Dict[str, float], references to self.cfg.training.epochs, train_metrics, val_metrics, scheduler.step, save_checkpoint, self.model.train(), batch["image"], batch["label"], optimizer.zero_grad, criterion, loss.backward, optimizer.step, accuracy(outputs, targets, topk=(1,))[0]. Keep the numbers plausible for a successful training run, with top-1 accuracy around 0.88 to 0.91 and top-5 around 0.97 to 0.98. Include the usual VS Code status bar along the bottom with Python environment details. On the right, place exactly 1 dark-themed web browser window showing a local dashboard at localhost:8000 with the page title "VisionClassifier | Dashboard" and the app header "VisionClassifier" plus subtitle "Image Classification Model". The dashboard contains exactly 3 stacked sections. The first section is "Model Overview" with exactly 4 metric cards: Top-1 Accuracy 91.23%, Top-5 Accuracy 98.30%, Total Parameters 23.51M, Model ResNet-50. The second section is "Recent Training" with a dark line chart of accuracy over 50 epochs, showing exactly 2 colored curves labeled Train (Top-1) and Val (Top-1), both rising quickly and stabilizing around the low 90s. The third section is "Confusion Matrix" showing a 10x10 heatmap with a bright diagonal and axes labeled True Label and Predicted Label. Use subtle reflections, crisp typography, realistic UI spacing, and believable screen glow. The macOS top menu bar should show common menus like Code, File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Window, Help on the left and system icons with the time reading Tue May 13 9:41 AM on the right. templates.prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy studio poster of two wizard-like figures posed like a parody heavy-metal album cover. In the foreground, a stocky older wizard sits or leans toward the camera, wearing a glossy black hooded robe, large over-ear studio headphones, and a long thick white beard spilling over his chest. He grips a tall black staff in his left hand; the staff has an elongated spearhead-shaped ornate top with open lattice details. A large black podcast microphone on a boom or stand is positioned directly in front of him at mouth level, with a visible sticker that reads "CARAJO" on the microphone body. Behind him stands a second older wizard in a luminous white robe with gold trim and a rope belt, also with long white hair and a long white beard. He holds a tall white staff with a matching ornate spearhead top in his right hand and extends his left hand toward the viewer in a commanding spell-casting gesture, fingers spread. Behind the standing wizard’s head is a bright electric-blue glowing circular halo made of runes, creating a magical summoning-ring effect. The background is pure black, with high-contrast cinematic lighting: cool blue rim light from behind and warm highlights on the hands, robes, and staffs. The composition is vertical, tightly framed, with the black-robed wizard occupying the lower center and the white-robed wizard towering behind him. At the bottom center, add the title {argument name="title text" default="GORDALF"} in huge metallic stone-textured gothic block letters, like a fantasy metal logo, and place 1 small occult-style emblem centered underneath the word. Photorealistic cosplay portrait, ultra-detailed fabrics, theatrical fantasy realism, poster design, sharp focus, moody epic atmosphere.

templates.title: LEGO Plaza de España at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 乐高版西班牙广场日落

templates.prompt: A highly detailed photorealistic LEGO interpretation of {argument name="landmark" default="Plaza de España, Seville"}, shown as a grand golden-hour architectural scene from canal level. The image is vertical and cinematic, with the viewer looking straight down a narrow curved canal toward an ornate Spanish Renaissance Revival palace facade built entirely from LEGO bricks. The warm terracotta building fills the upper half of the frame, with multiple towers, arched colonnades, balconies, decorative cornices, and intricate brick-built ornamentation. A small Spanish flag flies from the central tower. In the foreground, a LEGO rowboat with 2 minifigures is seen from behind, drifting along the canal; one has reddish-brown hair and the other light brown hair, both rowing with long brown oars. In the mid-distance, there is a second small rowboat with 2 minifigures under or near an elegant arched bridge. Count 2 boats total and 4 rowing passengers total. Along the right-side promenade, count 4 visible standing minifigures placed at intervals beside the tiled railing. The canal is lined with detailed blue, white, and yellow ceramic-style LEGO mosaic balustrades and brick parapets, with black vintage street lamps; count 7 visible lamp posts total. On the left edge, include 2 rounded pink flowering shrubs in planters. The bridge crossing the canal has ornate blue-and-white LEGO tile patterns and a graceful single arch. The water should look realistic yet made from small glossy LEGO-like tiles, with dark teal reflections of the building and sky. Lighting is soft sunset light with a glowing amber sky, scattered clouds, long highlights, and rich warm shadows. Emphasize realism, fine texture, playful scale illusion, and the convincing blend of real architectural grandeur with unmistakable LEGO construction.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅高度精细、写实风格的乐高版 {argument name="landmark" default="塞维利亚西班牙广场"}，呈现为黄金时刻的宏伟建筑场景，视角位于运河水平面。画面为竖构图，具有电影质感，观众视线沿着狭窄的弧形运河望向远方，尽头是完全由乐高积木搭建的华丽西班牙文艺复兴复兴风格宫殿外立面。温暖的赤陶色建筑占据了画面的上半部分，拥有多座塔楼、拱形柱廊、阳台、装饰性檐口以及复杂的积木拼搭细节。中央塔楼上飘扬着一面西班牙国旗。前景中，一艘载有 2 个小人的乐高划艇背对着镜头，正沿着运河漂流；其中一人留着红棕色头发，另一人留着浅棕色头发，两人正用长长的棕色船桨划船。中景处，在优雅的拱桥下方或附近，有第二艘载有 2 个小人的小划艇。总计 2 艘船，共 4 名划船乘客。在右侧长廊沿线，可以看到 4 个小人间隔站立在瓷砖栏杆旁。运河两岸排列着细节丰富的蓝、白、黄三色陶瓷风格乐高马赛克栏杆和积木护墙，配有黑色复古路灯；总计可见 7 盏路灯。左侧边缘包含 2 株种植在花盆里的圆形粉色开花灌木。横跨运河的桥梁拥有华丽的蓝白相间乐高瓷砖图案，以及优美的单拱结构。水面应看起来既真实又由细小的光面乐高积木块组成，倒映着深青色的建筑与天空。光线为柔和的日落光，天空呈现琥珀色光芒，伴有零星云朵、长长的亮部高光和浓郁温暖的阴影。强调真实感、细腻的纹理、趣味十足的比例错觉，以及真实建筑宏伟感与标志性乐高拼搭风格的完美融合。

templates.title: LEGO Alhambra Courtyard at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 乐高版阿尔罕布拉宫庭院日落

templates.prompt: A highly detailed photorealistic LEGO diorama of {argument name="landmark" default="the Alhambra in Granada"}, shown as an ornate Moorish courtyard at golden-hour sunset. The scene is built entirely from LEGO bricks and minifigure parts, with warm amber light, cinematic depth, and rich texture. Center the composition on a long narrow reflective water channel leading toward 1 small round fountain in the middle distance and a grand horseshoe arch beyond it. Surround the courtyard with intricate tan stone-like LEGO walls, carved-looking geometric relief patterns, slender columns, tiled archways, and terracotta rooflines made from densely layered reddish-brown pieces. In the background, include 2 main towers and several additional palace structures rising behind the courtyard, plus 6 tall dark green cypress trees silhouetted against a glowing orange sky. Add blue, green, and white mosaic-style tile details around the central arch and lower walls. Populate the courtyard with exactly 9 LEGO tourists and visitors: 1 traveler in a tan hat and light outfit, 1 visitor in a blue jacket beside them, 1 person with a green backpack at the left foreground, 1 photographer holding a camera in the left foreground, 1 kneeling visitor examining the garden at the right edge of the water channel, 2 standing visitors chatting in the right midground, and 2 seated visitors on a tiled bench in the right foreground. Frame the water channel with low manicured hedges and small pink flowers. Use a low eye-level perspective from the start of the reflecting pool, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the central courtyard, glossy water reflections, realistic LEGO stud texture, and a mood that feels majestic, playful, and museum-quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细、照片级的 {argument name="landmark" default="格拉纳达阿尔罕布拉宫"} 乐高立体模型，展现了黄金时刻日落下的华丽摩尔式庭院。整个场景完全由乐高积木和人仔零件拼搭而成，带有温暖的琥珀色光影、电影般的景深和丰富的质感。构图中心为一个狭长的反射水渠，通向中景处的一座小型圆形喷泉以及后方宏伟的马蹄形拱门。庭院四周环绕着错综复杂的棕褐色石质乐高墙壁，饰有雕刻感的几何浮雕图案、纤细的柱子、瓷砖拱门，以及由致密层叠的红褐色零件制成的赤陶屋顶线条。背景中包含 2 座主塔和几座耸立在庭院后的宫殿建筑，以及 6 棵高大的深绿色柏树，在橙色发光的天空映衬下呈现出剪影。在中央拱门和下层墙壁周围加入蓝色、绿色和白色的马赛克风格瓷砖细节。庭院内精确布置 9 名乐高游客：1 名戴着棕褐色帽子、身穿浅色服装的旅行者，其身旁 1 名穿着蓝色夹克的游客，左侧前景 1 名背着绿色背包的人，左侧前景 1 名拿着相机的摄影师，水渠右侧边缘 1 名跪着观察花园的游客，右侧中景 2 名站立交谈的游客，以及右侧前景 1 张瓷砖长椅上坐着的 2 名游客。水渠两侧饰有低矮的修剪整齐的树篱和粉色小花。采用从反射池起点出发的低视角，浅景深，中央庭院焦点清晰，水面光泽倒影，呈现真实的乐高颗粒质感，营造出一种宏伟、俏皮且具有博物馆品质的氛围。

templates.title: JoJo-Style OpenAI Stand Poster

titleLocalized.zh: JoJo 风格 OpenAI Stand 海报

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime illustration in the style of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, presented as a dramatic vintage manga character sheet poster for {argument name="character name" default="OpenAI"} personified as a glamorous female stand master. The layout is a single page with 6 distinct sections framed by ornate art nouveau borders and manga panel lines. Main section on the left: a full-body fashion portrait of the character in a confident contrapposto pose, wearing a tailored white suit with emerald green and black accents, gold trim, a long cape lined in teal, fitted vest, corset-like torso panel, high-waisted pants, heeled shoes, gloves, chain accessories, circular hair ornaments, earrings, and multiple OpenAI logo emblems integrated into the outfit. The belt buckle reads GPT, the pant leg has vertical text reading “SAFETY ★ ALIGNMENT ★ BENEFIT,” and the jacket sleeve shows the OpenAI name and logo. Her hair is silver-white, styled in elaborate curled twin buns and long ringlets, with glossy emerald accessories and JoJo-inspired luxury fashion detailing. Top left section: a cream parchment title panel with the OpenAI logo and the large text “OpenAI”, plus 3 text blocks reading “STAND NAME: GPT-∞”, “[dʒi: pi: ti: mu: geni ti]”, and “STAND MASTER: OPENAI”, followed by an italic Spanish quote: “La curiosidad es el prompt, el conocimiento es la respuesta, y la humanidad… es el contexto.” Top right section: a close-up portrait panel of the same woman from the shoulders up, turned partly away with one hand raised elegantly, against a dark purple manga background with 4 large stylized purple sound effect glyphs. Add a Spanish speech bubble with smaller English translation beneath it: “Mi propósito es extender el potencial de la humanidad.” and “(My purpose is to extend humanity’s potential.)” Center-right section: a stand ability information box titled “STAND ABILITY: [INFINITE CONTEXT]” with Spanish descriptive text beneath: “Permite analizar, conectar y generar conocimiento ilimitado a partir de cualquier información existente.” Lower center-right section: a humanoid robotic stand in a dynamic reaching pose, feminine and sleek, with a glossy black faceplate displaying the OpenAI knot logo, white biomechanical armor, emerald glowing seams, gold accents, and several floating holographic rings and data panels orbiting around it. The rings contain readable words including “DATA”, “CREATIVITY”, “REASONING”, and a distorted futuristic label similar to “RETRIEVAL/AGENT”. The background is cosmic and starry with dramatic energy effects. Bottom right section: a smaller rear three-quarter portrait panel of the woman looking over her shoulder with a confident smile and one finger near her chin, again over a purple manga background with 3 large stylized sound effect glyphs. Add a Spanish speech bubble with two lines: “¿ME PREGUNTAS SI TENGO LÍMITES?” and “MI ÚNICO LÍMITE ES TU IMAGINACIÓN.” Bottom left section: a circular JoJo-style stat chart with 6 labeled attributes in Spanish, showing “POTENCIAL ∞”, “VELOCIDAD A”, “ALCANCE ∞”, “DURABILIDAD B”, “PRECISIÓN A”, and “POTENCIA A”. Under it, include a small cream biography box titled “OPENAI” with Spanish text: “Fundada: 2015 (San Francisco, EE. UU.)” and “Misión: Asegurar que la inteligencia artificial general beneficie a toda la humanidad.” Use a richly inked manga print aesthetic, detailed crosshatching, cel shading, aged paper texture, elegant cream margins, deep emerald, ivory, black, and gold palette, exaggerated JoJo fashion anatomy, sharp linework, dramatic comic-book composition, and luxurious supernatural sci-fi energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫插画，采用《JoJo 的奇妙冒险》风格，呈现为一张戏剧性的复古漫画角色设定海报，将 {argument name="character name" default="OpenAI"} 拟人化为一位迷人的女性 Stand 使者。布局为单页，由华丽的新艺术风格边框和漫画分镜线划分为 6 个不同的区域。左侧主区域：角色全身时尚肖像，呈现自信的对位姿势，身穿剪裁考究的白色西装，点缀着祖母绿和黑色，配有金色饰边、青色内衬的长斗篷、合身马甲、紧身胸衣式躯干面板、高腰裤、高跟鞋、手套、链条配饰、圆形发饰、耳环，以及融入服装的多个 OpenAI 标志。皮带扣上写着 GPT，裤腿上有垂直文字“SAFETY ★ ALIGNMENT ★ BENEFIT”，夹克袖子上展示着 OpenAI 的名称和标志。她的头发是银白色的，梳成精致的卷曲双丸子头和长卷发，配有光泽的祖母绿饰品和 JoJo 风格的奢华时尚细节。左上区域：一个奶油色羊皮纸标题面板，带有 OpenAI 标志和醒目的“OpenAI”文字，外加 3 个文本块，分别写着“STAND NAME: GPT-∞”、“[dʒi: pi: ti: mu: geni ti]”和“STAND MASTER: OPENAI”，随后是一句斜体的西班牙语引言：“La curiosidad es el prompt, el conocimiento es la respuesta, y la humanidad… es el contexto。”右上区域：同一位女性从肩膀以上的特写肖像面板，身体微微转开，一只手优雅地举起，背景是深紫色的漫画背景，带有 4 个巨大的风格化紫色音效符号。添加一个西班牙语对话气泡，下方附有较小的英语翻译：“Mi propósito es extender el potencial de la humanidad.” 以及 “(My purpose is to extend humanity’s potential.)”。中右区域：一个 Stand 能力信息框，标题为“STAND ABILITY: [INFINITE CONTEXT]”，下方是西班牙语描述文字：“Permite analizar, conectar y generar conocimiento ilimitado a partir de cualquier información existente。”中下右区域：一个处于动态伸展姿势的人形机器人 Stand，女性化且线条流畅，带有显示 OpenAI 结标志的光泽黑色面罩、白色生物机械装甲、祖母绿发光接缝、金色装饰，以及围绕其旋转的多个悬浮全息环和数据面板。圆环包含可读单词，包括“DATA”、“CREATIVITY”、“REASONING”以及类似于“RETRIEVAL/AGENT”的扭曲未来感标签。背景是带有戏剧性能量效果的宇宙星空。右下区域：一个较小的后侧四分之三肖像面板，女性回头看，带着自信的微笑，一根手指靠近下巴，背景再次是带有 3 个巨大风格化音效符号的紫色漫画背景。添加一个带有两行文字的西班牙语对话气泡：“¿ME PREGUNTAS SI TENGO LÍMITES?” 和 “MI ÚNICO LÍMITE ES TU IMAGINACIÓN。”左下区域：一个圆形的 JoJo 风格属性图表，包含 6 个西班牙语标注的属性，显示“POTENCIAL ∞”、“VELOCIDAD A”、“ALCANCE ∞”、“DURABILIDAD B”、“PRECISIÓN A”和“POTENCIA A”。在其下方，包含一个名为“OPENAI”的小型奶油色传记框，内含西班牙语文字：“Fundada: 2015 (San Francisco, EE. UU.)” 和 “Misión: Asegurar que la inteligencia artificial general beneficie a toda la humanidad。” 采用浓墨重彩的漫画印刷美学、细致的交叉排线、赛璐珞阴影、陈旧纸张纹理、优雅的奶油色页边距、深祖母绿、象牙白、黑色和金色调色板、夸张的 JoJo 时尚人体结构、锐利的线条、戏剧性的漫画构图以及奢华的超自然科幻能量。

templates.title: 360 AI Art Gallery Panorama

titleLocalized.zh: 360 度 AI 艺术画廊全景图

templates.prompt: An ultra-wide 360-degree equirectangular panoramic view of a futuristic contemporary art gallery exhibition about artificial intelligence, designed for immersive VR viewing. The scene is inside a vast dark-ceilinged museum hall with exposed rigging, many small spotlights, polished reflective concrete floors, and curved white exhibition walls wrapping continuously across the panorama. The environment is filled with {argument name="visitor count" default="about 25"} adult visitors in smart casual and business attire, standing in small conversational groups and scattered around the room, with subtle face blur or indistinct facial detail. At the exact center of the panorama is a circular installation platform containing a tall translucent holographic human figure made of white glowing particles and vertical strands of light, suspended beneath a large circular ceiling ring. On the left side, show a white robotic arm sculpture on a round pedestal in front of a giant wall artwork depicting a luminous side-profile human head composed of particles and constellation-like dots. Across the walls, include 6 visible AI-themed artworks total: 1 giant particle head mural, 3 framed cosmic nebula or galaxy images, 1 large monochrome abstract painting, and 1 tall colorful starfield-like digital piece in the far right background. On the right foreground, place a large transparent cube installation containing a swirling spiral galaxy projection in blue, violet, and white. Also include 2 small white service robots near the center-right area of the floor. Lighting is cinematic and cool-toned, with blue, purple, and white glows from the installations contrasting against the dark ceiling and neutral gallery architecture. The mood is sleek, high-end, intellectual, and techno-cultural, like an AI biennale or premium digital art fair. Render photorealistically with crisp architectural detail, realistic reflections, natural human scale, and full seamless 360 panorama distortion appropriate for an equirectangular image.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超宽 360 度等距柱状全景图，展示了关于人工智能的未来主义当代艺术画廊展览，专为沉浸式 VR 观看而设计。场景位于一个巨大的深色天花板博物馆大厅内，配有外露的索具、许多小型聚光灯、抛光的反光混凝土地板，以及在全景中连续环绕的弧形白色展览墙。环境中充满了 {argument name="visitor count" default="约 25 位"} 身着商务休闲装的成年访客，他们三五成群地站在房间各处，面部细节模糊或不清晰。全景图的正中央是一个圆形装置平台，上面有一个由白色发光粒子和垂直光束组成的高大半透明全息人形，悬挂在一个巨大的圆形天花板环下方。在左侧，展示一个位于圆形底座上的白色机械臂雕塑，背景是一幅巨大的墙面艺术品，描绘了一个由粒子和星座般的点组成的侧面人头。在墙面上，总共包含 6 幅可见的 AI 主题艺术品：1 幅巨大的粒子人头壁画、3 幅装裱的宇宙星云或星系图像、1 幅大型单色抽象画，以及远景右侧 1 幅高大的彩色星空感数字作品。在右侧前景中，放置一个大型透明立方体装置，内部包含蓝色、紫色和白色的螺旋星系投影。此外，在地面中右侧区域放置 2 个小型白色服务机器人。灯光具有电影质感且色调偏冷，装置发出的蓝色、紫色和白色光芒与深色天花板及中性的画廊建筑形成对比。氛围时尚、高端、知性且具有科技文化感，如同 AI 双年展或高端数字艺术博览会。以照片级真实感渲染，具有清晰的建筑细节、逼真的反射、自然的比例，以及适用于等距柱状投影图像的完整无缝 360 度全景畸变。

templates.title: Elf Sniper Team in Forest Ambush

titleLocalized.zh: 森林伏击中的精灵狙击小队

templates.prompt: A cinematic ultra-realistic fantasy military scene in a dense woodland forest at ground level, showing 2 elf snipers concealed in camouflage while scouting a target. In the foreground, one elf with long pale-blond hair and clearly pointed ears lies prone behind a modern precision sniper rifle, aiming through a mounted scope. The rifle is long and tactical, fitted with a large suppressor, scope, and a deployed bipod planted in the mossy forest floor. The elf wears full modern woodland camouflage, tactical gloves, and a leaf-covered ghillie hood and shoulder covering that blends into the undergrowth. Behind and slightly to the right, a second elf crouches low, also with pointed ears and long light hair, wearing matching camouflage and a leafy ghillie cloak, holding binoculars to their eyes while observing. Add tactical chest gear and pouches on the rear scout. Set the scene in a shadowy temperate forest with tall thin trees, tangled branches, moss, roots, and scattered leaves, lit by soft early-morning natural sunlight filtering through the trees from the right side. Use muted green, brown, and gray tones, realistic textures, shallow depth of field, dramatic focus on the rifle and the two camouflaged elves, immersive war-photography composition, tense stealth atmosphere, and high-detail photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级超写实的奇幻军事场景，位于茂密的林地森林地面视角，展示了 2 名伪装的精灵狙击手在侦察目标时的情景。前景中，一名留着浅金色长发、耳朵尖尖的精灵正俯卧在现代精密狙击步枪后，通过瞄准镜进行瞄准。步枪修长且具有战术感，配备了大型消音器、瞄准镜，以及支撑在长满苔藓的林地地面上的两脚架。该精灵身穿全套现代林地迷彩服、战术手套，并戴着覆盖叶片的吉利服头套和肩罩，与灌木丛融为一体。在后方稍靠右侧，第二名精灵低姿蹲伏，同样有着尖耳朵和浅色长发，穿着配套的迷彩服和多叶吉利斗篷，正举着望远镜观察。为后方的侦察兵添加战术胸挂和弹药包。场景设定在阴影笼罩的温带森林中，周围有高而细的树木、纠缠的树枝、苔藓、树根和散落的叶子，由从右侧穿过树木的柔和清晨自然光照亮。采用柔和的绿色、棕色和灰色调，具有逼真的纹理、浅景深，重点突出步枪和两名伪装的精灵，呈现沉浸式战争摄影构图、紧张的潜行氛围以及高细节的照片级真实感。

templates.title: Hidden-Object Madrid Plaza Puzzle

titleLocalized.zh: 在马德里寻找“雪茄男”

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, colorful illustrated hidden-object poster set in Madrid’s Puerta del Sol on a bright sunny day, rendered like a lively hand-drawn travel puzzle with crisp ink outlines, textured watercolor-gouache shading, and a slightly whimsical caricature style. The composition is packed edge to edge with a huge crowd in the plaza, viewed from a slightly elevated eye level, with the Real Casa de Correos clock building dominating the right background, the Tío Pepe rooftop sign in the left background, the red diamond Sol metro sign on the left, the bear and strawberry tree statue near the center, historic facades, blue sky, and soft clouds. At the top left, include a torn notebook-paper sign pinned over the scene with large Spanish text: {argument name="headline text" default="¿Dónde está \"El Hombre del Puro\"?"} and a second line {argument name="subheadline text" default="Encuéntralo en Madrid"}. Next to it, add a pinned small portrait photo of the target man: a middle-aged man in a dark fedora and dark coat holding a cigar near his mouth, styled like a reference snapshot. Fill the square with exactly 1 metro entrance sign, 1 lottery kiosk labeled “Loterías y Apuestas del Estado,” 1 domed souvenir kiosk with postcard display and a sign reading “¡HOLA! DESDE MADRID,” 1 churros stand with a chalkboard reading “CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE,” 1 hat display stall on the lower right, 1 guitarist, 2 flamenco dancers in red dresses, 1 street cleaner in a bright orange-and-green uniform with text on the back reading “MADRID LIMPIO ENTRE TODOS,” 1 bicyclist, 2 dogs, 1 child holding a red teddy-bear balloon, many pigeons scattered across the foreground, children playing with soap bubbles, tourists with backpacks and maps, families, street onlookers, and performers. The crowd should feel dense and bustling, with dozens of distinct figures in varied summer clothing and natural poses, creating a challenging search scene. Emphasize Spanish local color, playful observational details, warm oranges and sunlit stone grays, and the feeling of a classic “Where’s Waldo?” style city-search illustration centered on finding {argument name="target character" default="El Hombre del Puro"} somewhere among the crowd in {argument name="city" default="Madrid"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细、色彩丰富的“威利在哪里”风格插画，描绘了 {argument name="city" default="马德里"} 一个拥挤的公共广场。视角处于街道水平面，背景是蓝天白云的明亮白昼。画面中挤满了数十名行人、游客、小贩、儿童、音乐家和市井生活场景，采用精细的手绘墨线与数字绘画相结合的社论漫画风格，线条清晰，石板路纹理细腻，人物表情生动，视觉叙事极其丰富。地点为太阳门广场，通过 4 个关键地标清晰可辨：左侧红色的菱形 Sol 地铁标志、中左侧背景中的 Tío Pepe 屋顶广告牌、中景处没有骑手的“熊与树”雕像，以及右侧背景中占据主导地位、阳台上挂着西班牙国旗的皇家邮政大楼（Real Casa de Correos）。在左上角，添加一张钉住的撕边纸海报，上面写有西班牙语文本 {argument name="headline text" default="¿Dónde está \"El Hombre del Puro\"?"}，第二行写着 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Encuéntralo en Madrid"}；旁边钉上一张目标人物的小肖像照片，他戴着深色软呢帽，穿着深色外套，抽着雪茄，就像一张线索卡。用热闹繁忙的群众场景填满广场，包括右侧 2 名穿红裙的弗拉门戈舞者、中右侧 1 名弹吉他的乐手、中右侧前景骑自行车的 1 名骑行者、中前景处 1 名穿着橙绿相间市政制服的清洁工、左下角 1 个写着“CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE”黑板招牌的吉事果摊位、左侧 1 个写有“Loterías y Apuestas del Estado”的彩票亭、右侧 1 个写着“¡HOLA! DESDE MADRID”招牌的明信片/报刊亭、最右侧 1 个堆满帽子的帽子展示摊、中左侧 1 名全身涂金的活体雕像表演者、1 名吹出半透明泡泡的泡泡表演者，前景散布着许多鸽子，中下部有 2 只小狗。画面中还包括背着背包的家庭、蹲在鸽子旁的孩子、拍照的游客、拿着地图的人、购物者以及穿着各式夏装的街头观众。隐藏的目标人物 {argument name="target character" default="El Hombre del Puro"} 应巧妙地嵌入人群中的某个位置，而不是放在中心，视觉上要与线索肖像中的深色帽子、深色衣服和雪茄相符，使他难以被发现但并非不可能找到。整体采用紧凑的构图、充满趣味的寻物能量、温暖的地中海色调以及丰富的城市细节。

templates.title: Indie Mind City Isometric Tech District

titleLocalized.zh: Indie Mind City 等轴测科技街区

templates.prompt: A dense isometric steampunk-cyberpunk city illustration at dusk, designed like a whimsical indie tech district called {argument name="city name" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}. The scene is a single sprawling urban plaza packed with narrow brick buildings, rooftop antennas, cables, pipes, neon signs, market stalls, tiny pedestrians, and playful programmer humor. In the center background, a plaza labeled “PLAZA DEL PROMPT” surrounds a sculptural fountain with pale blue water, with benches and people gathered around it. To the left background, a tall building with a giant sign reading “BARRIO CÓDIGO ABIERTO” is covered in balconies, windows, hanging laundry, air conditioners, plants, and street activity. To the right background, another block bears a large sign “CALLEJÓN DE LOS AGENTES,” with stacked storefront signs including “Codex Barbería cortes exactos,” “Gemini Lavandería,” “Claude’s Coffee,” and “Dr. Llama.” Further right, a heavy industrial factory zone with smokestacks, cranes, ducts, crates, and catwalks displays 3 large signs: “ZONA INDUSTRIAL,” “FÁBRICA DE TOKENS,” and “LLM.” A cloud of floating letters and symbols rises above the chimneys like generated text smoke. In the foreground center, a tall clocktower-like corner building has a vertical neon sign reading “INDIE MIND,” a large round clock on the facade, warm lit windows, and a small stone animal sculpture at its base. To the right foreground, a lively market district glows with string lights and a bright neon sign “MERCADO NOCTURNO,” with 3 visible stall signs: “Memoria usada barata,” “Embeddings frescos del día,” and “Se cambian vectores.” Nearby are 3 more joke signs: “HARD HAT: prompt injection zone,” “HACKATHON: entra y sal con un bug,” and a food stand labeled “STACK OVERFLOW NOODLES.” To the left foreground, an older mixed-use building is filled with signs and visual jokes, including a huge rooftop billboard with 2 cats on top and the title {argument name="main billboard text" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}, plus a small version label “v1.0.0.” On that same block, include these visible signs: “FORGE & CAFE,” “git push cafe +$2,” “Tienda de MERGE CONFLICTS abierto 24/7,” “Se reparan linters,” “NO rm -rf aquí,” “Ralph was here,” “npm install vv,” “sudo make me sandwich,” “WORKTREE,” “SE VENDE GPU USADA,” “MUSEO DEL MERGE CONFLICT,” “NOTARÍA DE COMMITS FIRMADOS,” “PSICÓLOGO PARA SENIOR DEVS 50m 80,” “GATO PERDIDO responde a localhost,” and a poster board reading “HOY: charla sobre agentic coding entrada libre” and “REUNIÓN DE AA^AI REUNIDOS DE LOS AGI.” Near the center-left plaza, add a sandwich-board style sign labeled “PROMPTS USADOS” with 3 lines beneath it, and small plaza signs that read “HELLO WORLD,” “Tailscale,” “OpenRouter,” and “Deepseek.” The streets are cobblestone and crowded with exact small story details: 1 yellow tram labeled “LÍNEA MAIN,” 1 small blue car, 1 bicycle cart, 1 delivery scooter, outdoor café tables, chess players, pedestrians, crates, potted plants, striped awnings, laundry lines, glowing windows, rooftop cats, and a white llama standing near the agent alley. Use a warm muted palette of dusty teal, rust, amber, tan, and faded neon pink and cyan. Render it as an ultra-detailed editorial illustration with clean isometric perspective, intricate linework, soft atmospheric lighting, tiny readable signage, cozy urban clutter, and humorous handcrafted worldbuilding.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅黄昏时分的等轴测蒸汽朋克-赛博朋克城市插画，设计为一个名为 {argument name="city name" default="INDIE MIND CITY"} 的异想天开的独立科技街区。场景是一个巨大的城市广场，挤满了狭窄的砖砌建筑、屋顶天线、电缆、管道、霓虹灯招牌、市场摊位、微小的行人和充满程序员趣味的幽默元素。背景中央是一个标有“PLAZA DEL PROMPT”的广场，环绕着一座带有淡蓝色喷泉的雕塑，周围聚集着长椅和人群。左后方是一栋高大的建筑，上面挂着巨大的“BARRIO CÓDIGO ABIERTO”招牌，布满了阳台、窗户、晾晒的衣物、空调、植物和街头活动。右后方是另一栋街区，挂着巨大的“CALLEJÓN DE LOS AGENTES”招牌，以及堆叠的店面招牌，包括“Codex Barbería cortes exactos”、“Gemini Lavandería”、“Claude’s Coffee”和“Dr. Llama”。再往右是一个重工业工厂区，有烟囱、起重机、管道、板条箱和走道，展示着 3 个大招牌：“ZONA INDUSTRIAL”、“FÁBRICA DE TOKENS”和“LLM”。一团漂浮的字母和符号像生成的文本烟雾一样从烟囱上升起。前景中央是一栋高大的钟楼式转角建筑，挂着垂直的“INDIE MIND”霓虹灯招牌，外墙上有一个巨大的圆形时钟，窗户透出温暖的灯光，底部有一个小石兽雕塑。右前景是一个热闹的市场区，闪烁着串灯和明亮的“MERCADO NOCTURNO”霓虹灯招牌，有 3 个可见的摊位招牌：“Memoria usada barata”、“Embeddings frescos del día”和“Se cambian vectores”。附近还有 3 个幽默招牌：“HARD HAT: prompt injection zone”、“HACKATHON: entra y sal con un bug”以及一个标有“STACK OVERFLOW NOODLES”的食品摊。左前景是一栋老式混合用途建筑，布满了招牌和视觉笑话，包括一个巨大的屋顶广告牌，上面有 2 只猫，标题为 {argument name="main billboard text" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}，还有一个小的版本标签“v1.0.0”。在同一街区，包含以下可见招牌：“FORGE & CAFE”、“git push cafe +$2”、“Tienda de MERGE CONFLICTS abierto 24/7”、“Se reparan linters”、“NO rm -rf aquí”、“Ralph was here”、“npm install vv”、“sudo make me sandwich”、“WORKTREE”、“SE VENDE GPU USADA”、“MUSEO DEL MERGE CONFLICT”、“NOTARÍA DE COMMITS FIRMADOS”、“PSICÓLOGO PARA SENIOR DEVS 50m 80”、“GATO PERDIDO responde a localhost”，以及一个写着“HOY: charla sobre agentic coding entrada libre”和“REUNIÓN DE AA^AI REUNIDOS DE LOS AGI”的公告项目。在广场中左侧附近，添加一个标有“PROMPTS USADOS”的三明治式立牌，下方有 3 行文字，以及写着“HELLO WORLD”、“Tailscale”、“OpenRouter”和“Deepseek”的小型广场标牌。街道是鹅卵石铺成的，挤满了精确的小故事细节：1 辆标有“LÍNEA MAIN”的黄色电车、1 辆蓝色小汽车、1 辆自行车推车、1 辆送货踏板车、户外咖啡桌、下棋的人、行人、板条箱、盆栽植物、条纹遮阳篷、晾衣绳、发光的窗户、屋顶上的猫，以及一只站在 Agent 小巷附近的白色羊驼。使用尘土青色、铁锈色、琥珀色、棕褐色以及褪色的霓虹粉和青色组成的温暖柔和色调。将其渲染为超详细的编辑插画，具有清晰的等轴测视角、复杂的线条、柔和的大气照明、微小可读的标牌、舒适的城市杂乱感以及充满幽默感的手工世界构建。

templates.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Homepage

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克风格 ElectroVid 主页

templates.prompt: Create a full-page steampunk video platform homepage mockup in a dark antique bronze, brass, and sepia palette, styled like a Victorian industrial version of YouTube. The interface should be vertically oriented like a poster or website screenshot, richly decorated with gears, pipes, engraved metal borders, filigree, gauges, screws, and glowing Edison bulbs. At the top left, place a modern overlay logo reading "Pollo AI" with smaller text "GPT Image 2" beneath it. Center the main site title in large ornate serif lettering: "{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}", with a smaller engraved tagline below: "{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}". Add a horizontal navigation bar under the title with exactly 6 items: a home icon button, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a search box on the right showing the placeholder "Search ElectroVid..." and a search icon. On the left sidebar, add a section titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" containing exactly 3 vertically stacked channel cards with circular emblems and subscribe buttons: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS". Each card should have an ornate vintage badge logo and a rectangular button labeled "SUBSCRIBE". In the main content area, place one large featured video player with a sepia still image of two late-19th-century inventors in suits arguing in front of a chalkboard marked "AC vs. DC" with lightning motifs; one man points while the other gestures back, and a light bulb plus early electrical apparatus sit on the table between them. Intentionally obscure both faces with soft rectangular blur blocks. Add a video progress bar, playback controls, and timestamp "08:47 / 22:31". Beneath the player, show the video title "{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}". Below that, include a channel row with a circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age", metadata "142K views • 3 days ago", and on the right a like button reading "LIKE" with count "5.8K". Under this, add a section header "LATEST VIDEOS" and exactly 3 video thumbnails in one row. Thumbnail 1: a sepia portrait of Thomas Edison holding a glowing bulb, face obscured with a blur block, duration "10:12", title "My New Incandescent Bulb", creator "Thomas Edison", metadata "89K views • 5 days ago". Thumbnail 2: a dramatic sepia image of the Wardenclyffe Tower under lightning, duration "15:36", title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower", creator "Nikola Tesla", metadata "120K views • 1 week ago". Thumbnail 3: a sepia photo of an early automobile with Henry Ford seated in it, duration "12:08", title "The Automobile Revolution", creator "Henry Ford", metadata "110K views • 1 week ago". Below the thumbnails, add a centered metal button labeled "VIEW ALL VIDEOS". At the bottom footer, include the text "© 1893 {argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."}" on one line and "All rights reserved." on the next. Add decorative pressure gauges in the upper right and lower right corners, plus exposed pipes and a large gear in the lower left. Make the whole design highly detailed, symmetrical, tactile, and cinematic, with engraved textures, aged paper panels, brass highlights, soft warm bulb glow, and crisp, legible typography integrated into the antique UI.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个全页面的蒸汽朋克风格视频平台主页模型，采用深古铜色、黄铜色和棕褐色调，设计风格如同维多利亚工业版的 YouTube。界面应呈纵向布局，类似于海报或网站截图，并以齿轮、管道、雕刻金属边框、花丝、仪表、螺丝和发光的爱迪生灯泡进行装饰。在左上角放置一个现代风格的叠加 Logo，文字为“Pollo AI”，下方附有较小的“GPT Image 2”字样。在页面中心放置主标题，使用大型华丽的衬线字体：“{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}”，下方配有一行较小的雕刻风格标语：“{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}”。在标题下方添加一个水平导航栏，包含 6 个项目：一个主页图标按钮、“TRENDING”（热门）、“INNOVATIONS”（创新）、“DOCUMENTARIES”（纪录片）、“ENTERTAINMENT”（娱乐），以及右侧的搜索框，显示占位符“Search ElectroVid...”和一个搜索图标。在左侧边栏，添加一个名为“POPULAR CHANNELS”（热门频道）的部分，包含 3 个垂直堆叠的频道卡片，配有圆形徽章和订阅按钮：1) “THE PATENT OFFICE”（专利局），显示“27.4K SUBSCRIBERS”；2) “THE ROYAL SOCIETY”（皇家学会），显示“18.7K SUBSCRIBERS”；3) “GENERAL ELECTRIC”（通用电气），显示“35.1K SUBSCRIBERS”。每张卡片应配有一个华丽的复古徽章 Logo 和一个标有“SUBSCRIBE”（订阅）的矩形按钮。在主要内容区域，放置一个大型精选视频播放器，画面为棕褐色调，展示两名 19 世纪末的发明家穿着西装，在写有“AC vs. DC”字样和闪电图案的黑板前争论；一人指向黑板，另一人做出回应，桌上放着一个灯泡和早期电气设备。刻意用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡两人的面部。添加视频进度条、播放控件和时间戳“08:47 / 22:31”。在播放器下方，显示视频标题“{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}”。下方包含一行频道信息，配有圆形头像、频道名称“The Electrical Age”、元数据“142K views • 3 days ago”，右侧是一个标有“LIKE”（点赞）的按钮，计数为“5.8K”。在此下方，添加一个部分标题“LATEST VIDEOS”（最新视频），并在一行中放置 3 个视频缩略图。缩略图 1：托马斯·爱迪生手持发光灯泡的棕褐色肖像，面部被模糊块遮挡，时长“10:12”，标题“My New Incandescent Bulb”，创作者“Thomas Edison”，元数据“89K views • 5 days ago”。缩略图 2：沃登克里弗塔在闪电下的戏剧性棕褐色图像，时长“15:36”，标题“The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower”，创作者“Nikola Tesla”，元数据“120K views • 1 week ago”。缩略图 3：亨利·福特坐在早期汽车里的棕褐色照片，时长“12:08”，标题“The Automobile Revolution”，创作者“Henry Ford”，元数据“110K views • 1 week ago”。在缩略图下方，添加一个居中的金属按钮，标注为“VIEW ALL VIDEOS”（查看所有视频）。在底部页脚，第一行包含文字“© 1893 {argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."}”，下一行包含“All rights reserved.”。在右上角和右下角添加装饰性压力表，并在左下角添加外露管道和一个大齿轮。使整个设计高度精细、对称、具有触感且富有电影感，融合雕刻纹理、陈旧的纸张面板、黄铜高光、柔和温暖的灯泡光芒，以及融入复古 UI 的清晰易读的排版。

templates.title: Boca Juniors Welcome Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 博卡青年队欢迎海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical football transfer announcement poster in Boca Juniors colors, designed like a polished social media graphic. Show a half-body portrait of {argument name="player name" default="Paulo Dybala"} wearing the modern Boca Juniors home jersey, dark royal blue with a wide gold chest band, gold shoulder stripes, Adidas logo on the right chest, CABJ crest on the left chest, and “betsson” sponsor across the yellow band. The player is centered slightly to the right, cropped from upper torso to top of head, with short dark hair and athletic build, turning his head slightly to his left while pointing with his right index finger directly at the club crest on his chest. Do not show facial details clearly; keep the face obscured or out of focus. Use a deep blue textured stadium-themed background with glowing highlights and subtle grunge overlays. In the lower left background, include La Bombonera stadium facade with visible signage reading “LA BOMBONERA” and “CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS.” Add small floating gold confetti particles throughout the scene for celebratory energy. Place a large CABJ shield logo in the upper right. Typography must be bold and poster-like: at the top left in small gold uppercase text, “BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA”; below it a small gold star; then a huge stacked headline on the left with “BIENVENIDO” in tall white condensed uppercase and “DYBALA” in oversized gold condensed uppercase. Below the name, add smaller white uppercase text reading “PAULO DYBALA,” flanked by thin gold lines and a small gold star. At the bottom, place a thin gold horizontal line across the width and centered gold uppercase text reading “| JUGADOR DE BOCA |” with a gold star beneath it. Use high contrast, glossy sports-poster lighting, rich navy and gold color grading, sharp fabric detail, and an elite club announcement aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用博卡青年队标志性配色的竖版足球转会官宣海报，设计风格如同精致的社交媒体海报。展示 {argument name="player name" default="Paulo Dybala"} 的半身肖像，他身穿现代博卡青年队主场球衣，球衣为深宝蓝色，胸前有宽大的金色横条，肩部带有金色条纹，右胸印有 Adidas 标志，左胸印有 CABJ 队徽，黄色横条上印有“betsson”赞助商标志。球员位于画面偏右侧，取景范围从上半身到头部，留着深色短发，体格健壮，头部微微向左转，右手食指指向胸前的队徽。无需清晰展示面部细节；保持面部模糊或虚化。使用带有发光高光和细微磨损纹理的深蓝色体育场主题背景。在左下角背景中，加入博卡青年队主场糖果盒球场 (La Bombonera) 的外观，并清晰可见写有“LA BOMBONERA”和“CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS”的标牌。在整个场景中添加少量漂浮的金色纸屑，营造庆祝氛围。在右上角放置一个巨大的 CABJ 盾形队徽。排版需采用醒目的海报风格：左上方使用小号金色大写文字书写“BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA”；下方配有一颗小金星；左侧为主标题，采用堆叠式排版，其中“BIENVENIDO”为高大的白色压缩大写字体，“DYBALA”为超大号金色压缩大写字体。在名字下方，添加较小的白色大写文字“PAULO DYBALA”，两侧配以细金线和一颗小金星。底部放置一条横跨画面宽度的细金线，居中书写金色大写文字“| JUGADOR DE BOCA |”，下方配有一颗金星。采用高对比度、光泽感十足的体育海报灯光，浓郁的深蓝与金色调，锐利的织物细节，呈现顶级俱乐部官宣的视觉美感。

templates.title: Satirical Expensive Supplements Cartoon

titleLocalized.zh: 讽刺昂贵补剂的漫画

templates.prompt: A clean, square editorial cartoon in flat vector style with soft shading and bold outlines, on a light gray background. The scene is a satirical medical office consultation about overpriced supplements that do not work. At the top left, a huge three-line Spanish headline in bold sans-serif reads: “Suplementos” in dark teal, “costosos” in orange, and “que no funcionan” in dark teal, with a small orange sparkle accent and an orange underline swoosh beneath the headline. At the top right, add a social handle and website in dark teal: “@elnutridice” and “elnutridice.com”. Along the far left edge, place a vertical orange credit line that reads “Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”. In the foreground, show a wooden desk covered with large stacks of green cash, with many loose bills flying through the air around the characters. titleLocalized.zh: Mirassol FC 球员签约官宣海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic Brazilian football club signing announcement poster in a vertical 2:3 layout, with a gritty high-contrast sports-marketing aesthetic in yellow, dark green, black, and gold. The main subject is a muscular tattooed male footballer wearing a bright yellow Mirassol FC home jersey, shown as a large centered half-body portrait from chest up, facing forward with a serious intimidating expression. He has a shaved head, visible neck and arm tattoos, and a broad athletic build. The jersey has dark green trim on the collar and sleeves, the Mirassol crest with two stars on the chest, the ATHLETA logo on the opposite chest, a large green sponsor wordmark reading “Poty” across the torso, shoulder brand marks, and a circular sleeve sponsor patch. Behind him, place a dramatic waving Mirassol flag in dark green and yellow on the upper right with a large club crest and two stars, glowing stadium lights, smoky golden particles, and a night stadium crowd background. On the left side, stack large bold condensed text in Portuguese: “BEM-VINDO AO” above an oversized yellow “MIRASOL”, then the player name split across 2 lines as “ALEX” and “POATAN” in huge white letters, with a handwritten yellow signature-style “Poatan” beneath. Below that, add a 4-line motivational block in uppercase white text with the final line highlighted in yellow: “DE CAMPEÃO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO. / A LUTA CONTINUA.” On the right side, add a vertical info panel with 3 icon-and-word traits, each in yellow with matching symbols: target icon with “FOCO”, fist icon with “DISCIPLINA”, and helmet icon with “GARRA”, then below them a bold yellow callout: “AGORA É PELO LEÃO!”. Include 2 smaller secondary player images at the bottom: 1 on the lower left, a cropped front three-quarter pose kissing the club badge on the jersey; and 1 on the lower center-right, a back view with both arms raised and index fingers pointing upward. On the back-view jersey, show the sponsor text “DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA” across the upper back, the name “POATAN”, and the number “10” in large green numerals. Add a black-and-gold bottom strip containing 4 values separated evenly with icons: lion head and “MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEÃO”, shield and “FORÇA E HONRA”, star and “HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”, soccer ball and “PAIXÃO PELO JOGO”. Beneath that, place a yellow banner with the slogan “NOVO DESAFIO. MESMA MISSÃO.” and at the very bottom a handwritten white phrase “FÉ, FOCO E FAMÍLIA!” followed by the hashtag “#POATANÉLEÃO”. Use cinematic rim lighting, intense contrast, metallic golden glow, textured smoke, and premium club-announcement poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 垂直构图的巴西足球俱乐部签约官宣海报，采用黄、深绿、黑、金配色，呈现出粗犷且高对比度的体育营销美学。主体是一位肌肉发达、有纹身的男性足球运动员，身穿明黄色的 Mirassol FC 主场球衣，以胸部以上的半身肖像居中展示，正面朝向镜头，表情严肃且具有威慑力。他留着寸头，颈部和手臂纹身清晰可见，体格健壮。球衣领口和袖口有深绿色镶边，胸前印有带有两颗星的 Mirassol 队徽，另一侧是 ATHLETA 标志，躯干处印有巨大的绿色赞助商文字“Poty”，肩部有品牌标识，袖口处有圆形赞助商补丁。在他身后，右上角放置一面飘扬的深绿色与黄色相间的 Mirassol 旗帜，旗帜上有巨大的俱乐部徽章和两颗星，背景为闪耀的球场灯光、烟雾缭绕的金色颗粒以及夜晚的球场观众席。在左侧，堆叠醒目的粗体压缩字体，葡语内容为：上方是“BEM-VINDO AO”，下方是超大的黄色“MIRASOL”，接着是分两行显示的球员姓名，巨大的白色字母“ALEX”和“POATAN”，下方配有手写风格的黄色签名“Poatan”。在此下方，添加一个 4 行大写白色文字的励志板块，最后一行用黄色高亮显示：“DE CAMPEÃO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO. / A LUTA CONTINUA.”。在右侧，添加一个垂直信息面板，包含 3 个图标加文字的特性，均为黄色并配有相应符号：目标图标配“FOCO”，拳头图标配“DISCIPLINA”，头盔图标配“GARRA”，下方是一个醒目的黄色标语：“AGORA É PELO LEÃO!”。在底部包含 2 张较小的辅助球员图像：左下角一张为亲吻球衣队徽的侧身姿势；中右下方一张为双臂高举、食指指天的背影。背影球衣上显示背部上方的赞助商文字“DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA”、姓名“POATAN”以及巨大的绿色数字“10”。底部添加一条黑金配色的横条，包含 4 个由图标分隔的价值观：狮子头图标配“MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEÃO”，盾牌图标配“FORÇA E HONRA”，星星图标配“HUMILDADE E TRABALHO”，足球图标配“PAIXÃO PELO JOGO”。下方放置一条黄色横幅，写有口号“NOVO DESAFIO. MESMA MISSÃO.”，最底部是一句手写的白色短语“FÉ, FOCO E FAMÍLIA!”，随后是标签“#POATANÉLEÃO”。运用电影级的轮廓光、强烈的对比度、金属质感的金色光芒、纹理烟雾以及高级的俱乐部官宣海报设计风格。

templates.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Homepage

titleLocalized.zh: Steampunk ElectroVid 主页

templates.prompt: A richly detailed steampunk-inspired vintage video platform homepage shown as a full-screen web interface mockup in dark brass, aged bronze, black iron, and sepia tones, designed like a Victorian industrial machine with ornate filigree, pipes, rivets, gears, gauges, and glowing Edison bulbs built into the frame. The top left shows a modern overlay logo reading Pollo AI and GPT Image 2. Centered across the top is a large engraved metal site title, {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}, with a smaller plaque subtitle reading {argument name="tagline text" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}. A navigation bar directly beneath contains 6 visible items: a home icon button, TRENDING, INNOVATIONS, DOCUMENTARIES, ENTERTAINMENT, and a search box on the right with placeholder text similar to Search ElectroVid.... On the upper right corner of the frame there is 1 round analog clock gauge. On the left sidebar, a framed section titled Popular Channels contains exactly 3 channel cards stacked vertically, each with a circular emblem, subscriber count, and a SUBSCRIBE button: The Patent Office with 27.4K subscribers, The Royal Society with 18.7K subscribers, and General Electric with 35.1K subscribers. The main content area features 1 large central video player with a sepia historical scene of two men in suits debating in front of a chalkboard marked AC vs. DC with lightning-like chalk effects; one man points while the other gestures with open hands, and a glowing light bulb plus early electrical apparatus sit on the table between them. Add a realistic video player UI with a play button, timeline with partial red progress, volume icon, elapsed and total time reading 08:47 / 22:31, settings icon, theater icon, and fullscreen icon. Beneath the player, show the featured video title as {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}, with channel metadata below: The Electrical Age, 142K views, 3 days ago, plus a small circular profile portrait and a brass LIKE button showing 5.8K. Below that, a section header reading LATEST VIDEOS contains exactly 3 thumbnail cards in one row: 1) My New Incandescent Bulb, showing a man holding a lit bulb, duration 10:12, channel Thomas Edison, 89K views, 5 days ago; 2) The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower, showing a Tesla tower under electrical arcs, duration 15:36, channel Nikola Tesla, 120K views, 1 week ago; 3) The Automobile Revolution, showing an early vintage car with a driver on a city street, duration 12:08, channel Henry Ford, 110K views, 1 week ago. Centered below the thumbnails is a brass button reading VIEW ALL VIDEOS. At the bottom center, add a footer plaque reading © 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved. Decorate the outer border with additional pipes, cogs, mechanical joints, embossed corners, and 1 more circular pressure gauge near the bottom right. Use symmetrical, highly polished antique UI design, cinematic warm lighting, realistic texture, impeccable serif typography, dense ornamental craftsmanship, and a believable fusion of modern streaming layout with 19th-century industrial aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的蒸汽朋克风格复古视频平台主页，呈现为全屏网页界面模型，采用暗黄铜、陈旧青铜、黑铁和棕褐色调，设计灵感源自维多利亚时代的工业机器，框架中融入了华丽的镂空花纹、管道、铆钉、齿轮、仪表盘和发光的爱迪生灯泡。左上角显示一个现代叠加标志，文字为 Pollo AI 和 GPT Image 2。顶部中央是一个巨大的金属雕刻网站标题 {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}，下方配有一块较小的副标题铭牌，文字为 {argument name="tagline text" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}。正下方的导航栏包含 6 个可见项目：一个主页图标按钮、TRENDING（热门）、INNOVATIONS（创新）、DOCUMENTARIES（纪录片）、ENTERTAINMENT（娱乐），以及右侧带有占位符文本（类似于 Search ElectroVid...）的搜索框。框架右上角有一个圆形模拟时钟仪表。左侧边栏中，一个标题为 Popular Channels（热门频道）的框架区域垂直堆叠了 3 张频道卡片，每张卡片均带有圆形徽标、订阅者数量和一个 SUBSCRIBE（订阅）按钮：The Patent Office（27.4K 订阅者）、The Royal Society（18.7K 订阅者）以及 General Electric（35.1K 订阅者）。主要内容区域设有一个大型中央视频播放器，画面为棕褐色的历史场景，两名身着西装的男子在写有“AC vs. DC”的黑板前辩论，黑板上有类似闪电的粉笔特效；一人在指点，另一人摊开双手示意，桌上放着一个发光的灯泡和早期的电气设备。添加一个逼真的视频播放器 UI，包含播放按钮、带有部分红色进度条的时间轴、音量图标、显示为 08:47 / 22:31 的已播放和总时长读数、设置图标、剧场模式图标和全屏图标。播放器下方显示精选视频标题 {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}，下方是频道元数据：The Electrical Age，142K 次观看，3 天前，以及一个圆形个人资料头像和一个显示 5.8K 的黄铜色 LIKE（点赞）按钮。下方是一个标题为 LATEST VIDEOS（最新视频）的区域，包含一行 3 张缩略图卡片：1) My New Incandescent Bulb，展示一名男子手持发光灯泡，时长 10:12，频道 Thomas Edison，89K 次观看，5 天前；2) The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower，展示处于电弧下的特斯拉塔，时长 15:36，频道 Nikola Tesla，120K 次观看，1 周前；3) The Automobile Revolution，展示一辆行驶在城市街道上的早期复古汽车，驾驶员在车内，时长 12:08，频道 Henry Ford，110K 次观看，1 周前。缩略图下方居中处是一个写有 VIEW ALL VIDEOS（查看所有视频）的黄铜按钮。底部中央添加一块铭牌，写着 © 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.。外边框装饰有额外的管道、齿轮、机械连接件、浮雕边角，右下角附近还有一个圆形压力表。采用对称、高度抛光的复古 UI 设计，电影级暖光，逼真的纹理，无可挑剔的衬线字体，密集的装饰工艺，以及现代流媒体布局与 19 世纪工业美学的完美融合。

templates.title: Helicopter Selfie Over Moscow

titleLocalized.zh: 莫斯科直升机自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic smartphone-style travel photo taken inside a helicopter cabin, showing a seated passenger on the left side of the frame and a sweeping aerial view of Moscow through a large window on the right. The person is wearing a black zip-up athletic jacket with a small white swoosh logo, a seatbelt across the chest, a metallic wristwatch, and large black aviation headphones with a microphone boom. Their face is obscured by a rectangular blur block, and they are giving a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera. The helicopter interior is dark, with black leather seating and beige cabin trim framing the window. Outside the window, capture an overcast daytime panorama of central Moscow from above, with the Kremlin walls and towers clearly visible, the colorful onion domes of Saint Basil's Cathedral in the lower right, a broad cityscape stretching into the distance, and a cluster of modern skyscrapers on the far right horizon. Use natural diffused light, realistic urban detail, mild atmospheric haze, and the candid composition of a tourist selfie shot from a helicopter ride, wide-angle but not distorted.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的智能手机风格旅行照片，拍摄于直升机机舱内。画面左侧为一名坐着的乘客，右侧大窗外呈现莫斯科的全景航拍视角。乘客身穿黑色拉链运动夹克，胸前有白色小勾标志，系着安全带，佩戴金属腕表和带有麦克风支架的大型黑色航空耳机。其面部被矩形模糊遮挡，正对着镜头竖起大拇指。直升机内部光线较暗，配有黑色真皮座椅，窗户边缘为米色舱内装饰。窗外捕捉到莫斯科市中心阴天白日的全景，克里姆林宫的围墙和塔楼清晰可见，右下角为圣瓦西里主教座堂色彩斑斓的洋葱头圆顶，广阔的城市景观向远处延伸，远处的地平线右侧可见一群现代摩天大楼。采用自然漫射光，呈现逼真的城市细节和轻微的大气雾感，构图模拟游客乘坐直升机时的随手自拍，广角但无畸变。

templates.title: Dog in Leather Cangaceiro Hat at a Bar

titleLocalized.zh: 戴着皮革 Cangaceiro 帽子的酒吧狗狗

templates.prompt: A cinematic low-angle photo of a medium-sized tan dog sitting proudly on a patterned tile floor inside a rustic old bar, wearing an oversized brown leather cangaceiro-style hat decorated with multiple metal star emblems and stitched details. The dog is centered in the frame, looking slightly upward with a calm, noble, almost heroic expression. Behind the dog is a long dark wooden bar counter on the right and a wall densely lined with many glass liquor bottles and hanging glasses, creating a cluttered authentic tavern atmosphere. On the left side, show a small wooden table, 2 wooden chairs, a dark doorway, worn walls, exposed beams, and 2 visible bare hanging light bulbs. Use warm amber indoor lighting, rich brown and golden tones, realistic textures, shallow depth of field, documentary-style realism, sharp focus on the dog, softly blurred background, wide cinematic composition, and a humorous but dignified mood. The image should feel like a Brazilian countryside bar portrait of a dog dressed like a regional folk hero.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感的低角度照片，一只中等体型的棕褐色狗狗骄傲地坐在质朴老酒吧的图案瓷砖地板上，头上戴着一顶超大的棕色皮革 Cangaceiro 风格帽子，帽子上装饰着多个金属星形徽章和缝合细节。狗狗位于画面中心，微微抬头，表情冷静、高贵，甚至带有一丝英雄气概。狗狗身后右侧是一个长长的深色木制吧台，墙上密密麻麻地摆满了许多玻璃酒瓶和悬挂的酒杯，营造出一种杂乱而真实的酒馆氛围。左侧展示了一张小木桌、2 把木椅、一个深色门洞、破旧的墙壁、裸露的横梁以及 2 个清晰可见的裸露悬挂灯泡。采用温暖的琥珀色室内灯光，丰富的棕色和金色调，逼真的纹理，浅景深，纪录片风格的写实感，焦点清晰地对准狗狗，背景柔和模糊，宽幅电影构图，氛围幽默而庄重。这张图片应呈现出一种巴西乡村酒吧肖像的感觉，仿佛狗狗装扮成了当地的民间英雄。

templates.title: Luxury Sunset Equestrian Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华日落马术肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-realistic golden-hour equestrian portrait of a {argument name="horse color" default="dark bay"} horse and a {argument name="rider gender" default="young man"} standing closely together in a quiet outdoor paddock at sunset. The horse is tall and elegant, shown from the chest up in three-quarter view, with a glossy coat, long dark mane, alert upright ears, and a black leather bridle and reins; part of an English saddle is visible on the left side of the frame. The rider wears a fitted {argument name="rider outfit" default="black long-sleeve riding shirt and black riding pants"}, standing on the right side of the horse, leaning in with one hand gently cupping the horse’s cheek and muzzle in a tender, intimate pose. Compose the image as a close portrait with the horse dominating the left half and the rider on the right, their faces nearly touching, emphasizing emotional connection and trust. Set the scene in a fenced field with softly blurred wooden rails, distant rolling hills, and a glowing orange sky with the sun low on the horizon. Use warm backlighting, rich amber highlights, realistic skin and fur texture, shallow depth of field, premium advertisement-style photography, natural shadows, high contrast, and a polished luxury editorial look. The overall mood should be affectionate, serene, and sophisticated, like a high-end lifestyle ad for equestrian fashion or horse care.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感十足、超写实的黄金时刻马术肖像，画面中是一匹 {argument name="horse color" default="深骝色"} 马和一位 {argument name="rider gender" default="年轻男性"} 在日落时分安静的户外围场中紧紧站在一起。马匹高大优雅，以四分之三侧面呈现胸部以上特写，毛发光亮，长长的深色鬃毛，耳朵警觉竖起，佩戴黑色皮革缰绳和挽具；画面左侧可见部分英式马鞍。骑手身穿合身的 {argument name="rider outfit" default="黑色长袖骑马衫和黑色马裤"}，站在马匹右侧，身体前倾，一只手温柔地托住马的脸颊和口鼻，姿态亲昵。构图采用近景肖像，马匹占据画面左半部分，骑手位于右侧，两人面部几乎相贴，强调情感连接与信任。场景设置在带有围栏的草场，背景是虚化的木质围栏、远处的连绵起伏的山丘，以及地平线上低垂的太阳所映照出的橙色天空。运用温暖的逆光、浓郁的琥珀色高光、逼真的皮肤和皮毛质感、浅景深、高级广告摄影风格、自然阴影、高对比度以及精致的奢华编辑感。整体氛围应充满温情、宁静且精致，如同马术时尚或马匹护理的高端生活方式广告。

templates.title: Cinematic Running Shoe Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感运动鞋广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic sports advertising poster featuring a giant close-up running shoe in motion splashing through shallow water on a wet city street at sunset. The composition is a low-angle, ultra-dynamic action shot with 1 primary shoe dominating the right half of the frame and 1 secondary blurred shoe visible behind it, implying a runner mid-stride. The hero sneaker is a white and gray knit performance shoe with a black side swoosh-style logo, gray laces, small red lace-loop accents, a thick translucent cushioned sole, and a bright orange-red outsole glow along the bottom edge. Show the shoe covered in realistic water droplets and sharp texture detail, with explosive splash particles frozen around the sole. The runner wears dark athletic leggings, visible only from the lower legs down. Place a dramatic urban skyline in the distant background on the right, softly blurred, under stormy dark clouds breaking into warm golden sunlight near the horizon. Use intense contrast between cool blue-gray shadows and fiery orange highlights, with glossy reflections on the rain-soaked pavement. On the left side, add 3 text elements arranged vertically: a huge bold distressed white uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="JUST DO IT."}, beneath it 1 white swoosh-style brand mark, and below that a smaller uppercase orange motivational line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="YOU CAN'T STOP WHAT'S ALREADY INSIDE YOU."}. Include visible branding on the tongue label with {argument name="brand name" default="NIKE"}. Make it look like a premium high-impact commercial poster for {argument name="product type" default="running shoes"}, with hyperreal detail, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, motion energy, crisp typography, ad-photography polish, and a widescreen 16:9 layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感运动鞋广告海报，画面主体为一只巨大的跑步鞋特写，正处于运动状态，在日落时分的潮湿城市街道上溅起浅水。构图采用低角度、超动态的动作捕捉视角，一只主鞋占据画面右侧，另一只模糊的鞋在后方，暗示跑者正处于跨步中。这款主打运动鞋为白灰针织材质，侧面带有黑色勾形标志，配有灰色鞋带、红色小鞋带扣点缀、厚实的半透明缓冲鞋底，以及鞋底边缘发出的亮橙红色光芒。展示鞋面上逼真的水珠和清晰的纹理细节，鞋底周围冻结着爆炸般的溅水颗粒。跑者穿着深色运动紧身裤，仅露出小腿以下部分。背景右侧远方是柔焦处理的城市天际线，在乌云密布的天空中，地平线附近透出温暖的金色阳光。运用冷蓝灰色阴影与火热橙色高光之间的强烈对比，路面呈现出雨后湿润的质感。在左侧垂直排列 3 个文本元素：一个巨大的粗体做旧白色大写标题 {argument name="headline text" default="JUST DO IT."}，下方是一个白色勾形品牌标志，再下方是一行较小的橙色大写励志标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="YOU CAN'T STOP WHAT'S ALREADY INSIDE YOU."}。在鞋舌标签上加入可见的品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="NIKE"}。使其看起来像是一张针对 {argument name="product type" default="running shoes"} 的高端高冲击力商业海报，具备超写实细节、戏剧性光影、浅景深、运动能量感、清晰的排版、广告摄影级的质感，以及 16:9 宽屏布局。

The burger should be an extreme close-up, shot at table level on a glossy dark reflective surface with sauce drips and scattered droplets. Show exactly 8 visible burger components from top to bottom: 1 sesame seed top bun, 1 layer of curly green leaf lettuce, 2 thick red tomato slices, 2 white onion rings, 3 pickle slices, 1 slice of melted yellow American cheese, 1 thick charred flame-grilled beef patty, and 1 glossy bottom bun with barbecue sauce dripping over the edge. Make the patty heavily textured with blackened grill-char detail and juicy highlights. Add sparks and steam rising around the burger. On the left side, place a circular fast-food logo near the upper-left corner, then huge distressed bold white block text in three stacked lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="FLAME GRILLED PERFECTION"}. Beneath it, add a short tagline in smaller uppercase text with an orange accent slash or underline, reading {argument name="tagline text" default="BOLD FLAVOR. PERFECTLY GRILLED."}. In the bottom-left corner, add the brand name again in white plus a handwritten script slogan in orange reading {argument name="slogan text" default="Have It Your Way"}. High contrast, rich warm tones, glossy food photography, ultra-detailed textures, realistic commercial lighting, shallow depth of field, premium restaurant poster aesthetic, print-ready ad composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="BURGER KING"} 创作一张电影级摄影风格的快餐广告海报。采用宽幅横向构图，主角汉堡占据画面右侧，醒目的促销排版堆叠在左侧。背景应接近黑色，辅以橙色火焰、发光的余烬、烟雾及飞溅的油脂，以强调热度和火烤感。汉堡应采用极致特写，以桌面视角拍摄，置于光亮的深色反射平面上，带有酱汁滴落和零星水滴。从上到下需清晰展示 8 个汉堡组件：1 个芝麻顶层面包、1 层卷曲绿叶生菜、2 片厚红番茄、2 个白洋葱圈、3 片酸黄瓜、1 片融化的黄色美式芝士、1 片厚实焦香的火烤牛肉饼，以及 1 个边缘滴落烧烤酱的光亮底层面包。肉饼需呈现厚重的质感，带有焦黑的烤痕细节和多汁的高光。在汉堡周围加入火星和升腾的热气。在左侧，左上角放置一个圆形快餐 Logo，下方是三行堆叠的巨大做旧粗体白色大字，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="FLAME GRILLED PERFECTION"}。在其下方，添加一行较小的橙色斜杠或下划线装饰的大写标语，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="BOLD FLAVOR. The composition is bold and graphic, with the character diagonally crossing the frame over 1 large inverted triangle backdrop filled with pale aqua and turquoise geometric fan-like patterns, outlined with a thin warm beige border, set against a clean light gray background. High-detail digital painting, glossy anime illustration, elegant action character art, crisp linework, rich fabric folds, dramatic perspective distortion, fashion-magazine polish, cool blue palette, white negative space, centered vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动态的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位穿着考究的年轻男子，呈现出极具戏剧性的透视动作姿势。从上方俯瞰，他仿佛正向镜头冲刺，并将细剑直指观众。他拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 的头发，发型整齐，中分且带有柔和的后梳蓬松感，肤色白皙。他的面部大部分被拍摄角度和阴影遮挡，营造出一种神秘而时尚的氛围。他身穿一套剪裁合身的深海军蓝商务西装，带有细腻的光泽，内搭浅蓝色衬衫，系着鲜艳的蓝色领带，脚穿抛光的黑色皮鞋。一只手在极端的透视下占据了前景，紧握着华丽的细剑剑柄；另一只手将剑身拔出，强调了动作与张力。这把剑拥有 1 把纤细的银色剑身、1 个带有交错环状结构的精致金属护手以及 1 个雕刻过的剑首。构图大胆且具有图形感，角色以对角线跨越画面，背景是 1 个巨大的倒三角形，内部填充着淡青色和绿松石色的几何扇形图案，并勾勒着细细的暖米色边框，整体置于干净的浅灰色背景之上。高细节数字绘画，光泽感动漫插画，优雅的动作角色艺术，清晰的线条，丰富的布料褶皱，戏剧性的透视变形，时尚杂志般的质感，冷蓝色调，白色留白，居中垂直构图。

templates.title: Latin American Tech Festival Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 拉丁美洲科技节海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, colorful isometric festival poster illustration of a bustling Latin American technology fair in an open urban plaza, packed with dozens of people networking, coding, presenting, eating, recording media, and attending talks. The overall style should feel like a premium editorial cityscape poster: vibrant, dense, optimistic, playful, and full of readable signage, with crisp linework, painterly textures, warm sunlight, and a celebratory startup-community atmosphere. The main headline on the large stage at upper left reads {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"}, with a subheading in Spanish reading "Aprender para transformar". On the stage, show a live conference with blue lighting, a presenter, and a seated audience; include 4 vertical icon panels on the stage area labeled "Educación", "Tecnología", "Innovación", and "Futuro", plus 3 glowing topic icons on the back wall labeled "Código", "Comunidad", and "Impacto". Build the plaza as a dense multi-zone event map with exactly 24 clearly labeled signs or booths distributed across the scene: "Keep Coding Keep Growing", "YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA", "Remote Work Zone", "ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE", "STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE", "DESIGN THINKING", "HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS", "Café con código", "AREPAS CON TODO", "Hechas con código y ♥", "Inspiración", "Networking", "Aprendizaje", "Café", "Baños", "SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA", "AI LAB", "DATA PEOPLE", "DEVS QUE IMPACTAN", "MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY", "PRODUCT BUILD WHAT MATTERS", "FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO", "FOUNDER MODE", and "DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE". In the center of the plaza, place a circular fountain with a large green geometric logo sculpture as the visual anchor. Surround it with tables, laptops, whiteboards, crowds, planters, and benches. Include a colorful hillside neighborhood in the background with mountains, palm trees, power lines, and exactly 2 red cable cars crossing the sky; also add exactly 1 small drone flying overhead. On the upper right building, place a large brand sign reading {argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"} and a green billboard that says "NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER". Populate the lower and middle foreground with many micro-scenes: a podcast booth labeled "PODCAST ON AIR", a neon "LIVE STREAM" corner, a startup workspace with people using laptops, a hackathon judging table, a founder pitch area, a fintech board with charts, and a coffee stand with espresso equipment and menu boards. Add 6 animal or mascot details across the scene: 1 orange cat lounging near the left worktables, 1 capybara at the lower left, 1 multicolor llama piñata in the lower center-left, 1 yellow rubber duck near the center-bottom, 1 small green robot near the bottom center-right, and 1 tiny turtle near the bottom beside a coin. Also place exactly 4 vehicle elements: 2 green scooters at the lower left, 1 decorated taco truck at the lower right with the sign "TACOS AL PASTOR", and 1 wheelchair user moving through the crowd. Include extra props that reinforce tech culture: whiteboards with sticky notes, a board titled "Traction" with an upward graph and bullet points "Users", "Revenue", "Retention", "Love", a board titled "CAP TABLE" with percentage rows, a Bitcoin-style coin on the ground, microphones, cameras, cables, monitors, smartphones, and branded green merchandise. Clothing should be modern casual startup attire with hoodies, jackets, backpacks, jeans, sneakers, and conference badges, featuring a diverse mix of ages and Latin American identities. Use rich greens, teals, oranges, purples, and warm neutrals, with lush plants and vines integrated into architecture. Make every corner busy and discoverable, like a Where's-Waldo-style tech ecosystem celebration, but keep the composition readable and inviting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细、色彩丰富的等距视角节日海报插画，描绘一个位于开放式城市广场中熙熙攘攘的拉丁美洲科技博览会，画面中挤满了数十人，他们正在进行社交、编程、演讲、用餐、录制媒体和参加讲座。整体风格应呈现出高端编辑类城市景观海报的质感：充满活力、内容密集、乐观、俏皮且带有清晰易读的标牌，线条利落，具有绘画质感，阳光温暖，充满创业社区的庆典氛围。左上角大型舞台上的主标题文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"}，副标题为西班牙语 "Aprender para transformar"。舞台上展示一场带有蓝色灯光的现场会议，包括一名演讲者和就座的观众；在舞台区域包含 4 个垂直图标面板，分别标注为 "Educación"、"Tecnología"、"Innovación" 和 "Futuro"，并在后墙上添加 3 个发光的主题图标，分别标注为 "Código"、"Comunidad" 和 "Impacto"。将广场构建为一个密集的多区域活动地图，在场景中分布 24 个标注清晰的标牌或展位："Keep Coding Keep Growing"、"YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA"、"Remote Work Zone"、"ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE"、"STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE"、"DESIGN THINKING"、"HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS"、"Café con código"、"AREPAS CON TODO"、"Hechas con código y ♥"、"Inspiración"、"Networking"、"Aprendizaje"、"Café"、"Baños"、"SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA"、"AI LAB"、"DATA PEOPLE"、"DEVS QUE IMPACTAN"、"MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY"、"PRODUCT BUILD WHAT MATTERS"、"FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO"、"FOUNDER MODE" 和 "DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE"。在广场中心放置一个圆形喷泉，以一个大型绿色几何 Logo 雕塑作为视觉锚点。周围环绕着桌子、笔记本电脑、项目、人群、花坛和长椅。背景包含一个色彩缤纷的山坡社区，有山脉、棕榈树、电线和正好 2 辆横跨天空的红色缆车；此外，在头顶上方添加正好 1 架小型无人机。在右上角的建筑物上，放置一个大型品牌标志 {argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"} 以及一个写着 "NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER" 的绿色广告牌。在前景的下部和中部填充许多微型场景：一个标有 "PODCAST ON AIR" 的播客展位、一个霓虹灯风格的 "LIVE STREAM" 角落、一个人们使用笔记本电脑的创业工作区、一张黑客松评审桌、一个创始人路演区、一个带有图表的金融科技项目，以及一个配备浓缩咖啡机和菜单板的咖啡摊。在整个场景中添加 6 个动物或吉祥物细节：左侧工作台附近有一只橙色猫，左下方有一只水豚，左下方偏中心处有一个多色羊驼皮纳塔，底部中心附近有一只黄色橡皮鸭，底部中右侧附近有一个绿色小机器人，底部靠近硬币处有一只小海龟。此外，放置正好 4 个车辆元素：左下方有 2 辆绿色滑板车，右下方有一辆装饰精美的塔可餐车，上面写着 "TACOS AL PASTOR"，以及一名穿过人群的轮椅使用者。包含强化科技文化的额外道具：带有便签的白板、一个标题为 "Traction" 的项目（带有向上趋势图和 "Users"、"Revenue"、"Retention"、"Love" 等要点）、一个标题为 "CAP TABLE" 的项目（带有百分比行）、地上的比特币风格硬币、麦克风、摄像机、线缆、显示器、智能手机和品牌绿色周边商品。服装应为现代休闲创业风格，包括连帽衫、夹克、背包、牛仔裤、运动鞋和会议胸牌，展现出不同年龄段和拉丁美洲身份的多样性。使用丰富的绿色、青色、橙色、紫色和温暖的中性色，并将茂盛的植物和藤蔓融入建筑中。让每一个角落都繁忙且充满发现感，如同“威利在哪里”风格的科技生态系统庆典，但要保持构图清晰且引人入胜。
