templates.title: Tim Cook MMO Raid Boss Screen

titleLocalized.zh: Tim Cook MMO 团本 Boss 屏幕

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic fantasy MMO raid boss loading-screen-style illustration with a full custom game UI overlay. The scene is set at dusk in front of the glass cube Apple Store, with the glowing white Apple logo centered on the building facade. In the middle of the plaza stands a giant raid boss version of {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, labeled as "The Architect," wearing a fitted black turtleneck, dark pants, and sneakers, holding a glowing smartphone in one hand and posing calmly with the other hand open. His face is intentionally blurred or anonymized. The overall tone is epic, satirical, and high-production, like a World of Warcraft raid encounter screen mixed with corporate tech parody. Around him, exactly 20 fantasy raiders in a semicircle battle formation face inward toward the boss, with varied races and silhouettes including armored warriors, rogues, mages, shamans, hunters, and orc-like and human-like characters. Several are casting bright spells in orange fire, blue lightning, green energy, and purple void magic. Include exactly 3 small robotic adds near the boss, each labeled "Supplier Add," with squat industrial bodies and Apple logos on their fronts. Also include 2 active encounter mechanic bubbles: one blue spherical shield labeled "Margin Shield" on the right side of the boss, and one purple circular dome labeled "Closed System" farther right with a humanoid enemy trapped inside. Build the image as a complete raid UI composition. Top left: a large expansion-style title reading "SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP" with subtitle "20-MAN HORDE RAID." Far left: a vertical "RAID FRAMES" panel listing exactly 20 player names in numbered rows from 1 to 20 with colored health bars. Top center: a boss portrait frame with the boss name {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}, subtitle "The Architect," and a red health bar at 100%. Top right: a large encounter guide panel titled "ENCOUNTER: {argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"THE ARCHITECT\"" containing exactly 3 phases. Phase 1 title: "SUPPLY CHAIN DOMINANCE (100% – 70%)" with 3 abilities: "Logistics Surge – Summons waves of Supplier Adds.", "Margin Shield – Reduces incoming damage by 40% for 10 sec.", and "Quarterly Pressure – Stacking debuff, explodes if not dispelled." Phase 2 title: "ECOSYSTEM LOCK-IN (70% – 30%)" with 3 abilities: "Closed System – Isolates 3 players, puzzle to return.", "Subscription Drain – Raid-wide damage over time.", and "Device Sync – Stack in correct formations to avoid spikes." Phase 3 title: "ONE MORE THING (30% – 0%)" with 3 abilities: "Surprise Launch – Massive AoE burst every 20 sec.", "Reality Distortion Field – Reverses controls briefly.", and "Enrage: Market Collapse – Boss enrages at 3:00." Bottom right: a "POTENTIAL LOOT" panel listing exactly 4 items with rarity-colored text: "Executive Cloak of Efficiency (Epic)", "Keynote Blade (Epic)", "Ecosystem Ring (Epic)", and "Investor's Favor (Bonus – Hard Mode)." Below that, add a small red-black badge reading "HARD MODE" and the line "Activate \"Investor Call\" during the fight to" with the remaining text cut off or obscured. Bottom left: a "CHAT" box with 4 lines, including taunting boss dialogue and a player response, such as "{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook yells: Innovation. Discipline. Excellence. That is how we win."}", "Tim Cook yells: Our ecosystem is unbreakable.", "Tim Cook yells: One more thing...", and "Lok'tarbrok: Lok'tar ogar!" Along the bottom center: a fantasy action bar with exactly 12 ability icons in ornate slots, some numbered, some showing cooldown text including "2m" and "1m". Use dramatic volumetric lighting, glossy reflections on the wet plaza, realistic environment rendering, highly detailed fantasy characters, exaggerated spell effects, dark vignette, sharp UI typography, and polished AAA game key art composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级奇幻 MMO 团本 Boss 加载界面风格的插图，并带有完整的自定义游戏 UI 叠加层。场景设定在黄昏时分，背景是玻璃立方体 Apple Store，建筑正面中央有发光的白色 Apple Logo。广场中央站着一个巨大的团本 Boss 版本的 {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}，标记为“建筑师 (The Architect)”，身穿合身的黑色高领毛衣、深色长裤和运动鞋，一只手拿着发光的智能手机，另一只手自然张开，姿态从容。他的面部经过模糊或匿名化处理。整体基调史诗、讽刺且具有高制作水准，如同《魔兽世界》团本遭遇战界面与企业科技恶搞的结合。在他周围，20 名奇幻团本玩家组成半圆战斗阵型面向 Boss，包括身穿盔甲的战士、潜行者、法师、萨满、猎人以及兽人族和人类等多种种族和剪影。其中几位正在施放明亮的法术，包括橙色火焰、蓝色闪电、绿色能量和紫色虚空魔法。在 Boss 附近加入 3 个小型机器人小怪，每个都标记为“供应商小怪 (Supplier Add)”，拥有矮胖的工业风躯干，正面印有 Apple Logo。此外，加入 2 个活跃的战斗机制气泡：Boss 右侧有一个标记为“利润护盾 (Margin Shield)”的蓝色球形护盾，更右侧有一个标记为“封闭系统 (Closed System)”的紫色圆形穹顶，内部困着一名人形敌人。将图像构建为完整的团本 UI 构图。左上角：一个大型扩展包风格的标题，写着“SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP”，副标题为“20-MAN HORDE RAID”。最左侧：一个垂直的“团队框架 (RAID FRAMES)”面板，列出 1 到 20 号共 20 个玩家姓名，并带有彩色生命值条。顶部中央：一个 Boss 头像框，显示 Boss 名称 {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}、副标题“建筑师”以及 100% 的红色生命值条。右上角：一个大型遭遇战指南面板，标题为“遭遇战：{argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"建筑师\"”，包含 3 个阶段。第一阶段标题：“供应链主导 (100% – 70%)”，包含 3 个技能：“物流激增 (Logistics Surge) – 召唤一波供应商小怪。”、“利润护盾 (Margin Shield) – 10 秒内减少 40% 所受伤害。”以及“季度压力 (Quarterly Pressure) – 可叠加的减益效果，若未驱散则会爆炸。”第二阶段标题：“生态系统锁定 (70% – 30%)”，包含 3 个技能：“封闭系统 (Closed System) – 隔离 3 名玩家，需解谜才能返回。”、“订阅流失 (Subscription Drain) – 全团持续伤害。”以及“设备同步 (Device Sync) – 在正确阵型中集合以避免尖刺伤害。”第三阶段标题：“还有一件事 (ONE MORE THING) (30% – 0%)”，包含 3 个技能：“惊喜发布 (Surprise Launch) – 每 20 秒造成大规模范围爆发伤害。”、“现实扭曲力场 (Reality Distortion Field) – 短暂反转控制。”以及“狂暴：市场崩溃 (Enrage: Market Collapse) – Boss 在 3 分钟时狂暴。”右下角：一个“潜在掉落 (POTENTIAL LOOT)”面板，列出 4 件带有稀有度颜色文本的物品：“高效执行官斗篷 (史诗)”、“发布会之刃 (史诗)”、“生态系统之戒 (史诗)”和“投资者青睐 (奖励 – 困难模式)”。下方添加一个红黑相间的小徽章，写着“困难模式 (HARD MODE)”，以及一行文字“在战斗中激活 \"投资者电话会议\" 以”，其余文本被截断或遮挡。左下角：一个“聊天 (CHAT)”框，包含 4 行文字，包括 Boss 的嘲讽台词和玩家回复，例如“{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook 大喊：创新。纪律。卓越。这就是我们获胜的方式。"}”、“Tim Cook 大喊：我们的生态系统坚不可摧。”、“Tim Cook 大喊：还有一件事……”、“Lok'tarbrok：Lok'tar ogar！”底部中央：一个奇幻动作条，包含 12 个装饰性槽位中的技能图标，部分带有数字，部分显示冷却时间文本，包括“2m”和“1m”。使用戏剧性的体积光、湿润广场上的光泽反射、逼真的环境渲染、高度精细的奇幻角色、夸张的法术效果、暗角效果、清晰的 UI 排版以及精致的 AAA 级游戏主视觉构图。

templates.title: Futuristic City With Sparkling Artifacts

titleLocalized.zh: 带有闪烁伪影的未来城市

templates.prompt: A bright daytime futuristic city street viewed from pedestrian level, looking upward through a canyon of tall sleek skyscrapers with blue-tinted glass facades, rounded balconies, layered terraces, and elegant sci-fi architecture. The scene shows a bustling urban promenade with about 12 visible pedestrians in the foreground and midground, casually dressed and walking away from the viewer, including one central figure in a gray jacket. At the upper left, include 1 small hovering flying vehicle or drone-like air taxi. The buildings are highly reflective and polished, with integrated greenery: trees along the walkway and planted terrace edges. The sky is clear blue with soft sunlight, giving the image a clean optimistic utopian mood. Across the entire image, add a conspicuous artifact layer of dense multicolored sparkling dots and specks, like a noisy pixel grid or glittering digital contamination scattered uniformly over the architecture, people, sky, and street. Use a painterly semi-realistic style with soft focus, luminous highlights, vertical composition, and cinematic depth.

promptLocalized.zh: 从行人视角仰望明亮的日间未来城市街道，视线穿过由高耸光滑的摩天大楼组成的峡谷，建筑拥有蓝调玻璃幕墙、圆形阳台、层叠露台以及优雅的科幻建筑风格。场景展示了一条熙熙攘攘的城市步行街，前景和中景可见约 12 名行人，他们衣着休闲并背对观众行走，其中包括一名身穿灰色夹克的中心人物。在左上方，加入 1 架小型悬浮飞行载具或类似无人机的空中出租车。建筑具有极高的反射感和光泽度，并融入了绿植：步道旁种植着树木，露台边缘也点缀着植被。天空湛蓝，阳光柔和，赋予画面一种纯净、乐观的乌托邦氛围。在整张图像上，添加一层显眼的伪影，即密集的彩色闪烁点和斑点，如同均匀散布在建筑、人物、天空和街道上的噪点像素网格或闪烁的数字污染。采用具有柔焦、明亮高光、垂直构图和电影般景深的半写实绘画风格。

templates.title: Rainforest Clearing with Speckle Artifacts

titleLocalized.zh: 带有斑点伪影的雨林空地

templates.prompt: An ultra-detailed wide-angle rainforest clearing photographed from a very low ground-level perspective, with the camera almost at the edge of a shallow muddy puddle. Dense tropical jungle vegetation forms a circular wall around the clearing, with tangled vines, broad wet leaves, shrubs, and tree trunks heavily covered in greenery. The foreground is slick with brown water, leaf litter, and reflective puddles, including a fallen branch stretching diagonally across the lower right area and a rounded mossy rock on the lower left. The center opens into a patch of low green plants, while the background rises into thick jungle canopy. Bright midday sunlight breaks through the treetops in the upper right, creating strong rays, haze, glowing highlights, and high contrast against a partly cloudy blue-and-white sky visible through the canopy. Use a dramatic fisheye or ultra-wide lens effect with subtle barrel distortion, immersive environmental scale, rich saturated greens, wet textures, realistic natural lighting, crisp foliage detail, and a photorealistic documentary nature-photography look. Include a faint, unnatural grid-like speckle noise artifact pattern across the image, especially visible in darker foliage and muddy ground, as if from an image-generation quality bug.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超细节的广角雨林空地照片，采用极低的地面视角拍摄，相机几乎贴近浅泥坑的边缘。茂密的热带丛林植被在空地周围形成了一圈环形墙，交织的藤蔓、宽大的湿叶、灌木和树干上覆盖着厚厚的绿植。前景是湿滑的棕色泥水、落叶和反光水坑，包括一根斜穿右下区域的倒木和左下角一块圆润的苔藓岩石。中心处是一片低矮的绿色植物，背景则是高耸的茂密丛林树冠。明亮的正午阳光从右上方的树梢间穿透而下，形成强烈的射线、薄雾、发光高光，并与透过树冠可见的局部多云蓝白天空形成高对比度。使用具有微妙桶形畸变的戏剧性鱼眼或超广角镜头效果，营造沉浸式的环境尺度、浓郁饱和的绿色、湿润的质感、逼真的自然光影、清晰的叶片细节以及写实的纪录片式自然摄影风格。在图像中加入微弱且不自然的网格状斑点噪点伪影图案，在阴暗的叶片和泥泞地面上尤为明显，模拟图像生成过程中的质量缺陷。

templates.title: Dystopian Woman by Frozen Waterfront

titleLocalized.zh: 冰封水岸边的反乌托邦女性

templates.prompt: A moody cinematic dystopian winter scene at dusk, viewed from a sheltered riverside foreground toward a dark modern city skyline glowing with hundreds of tiny warm window lights. In the left foreground, a stylish woman with dark curly hair sits in three-quarter view, her face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, holding a lit cigarette near her lips. She wears a sheer black lace high-neck dress with intricate floral embroidery, dangling earrings, and a glamorous noir aesthetic. The ground around her is wet, icy, and littered with trash, with glossy black garbage bags piled on the right foreground and scattered debris across the frozen shoreline. Across the icy water in the midground sits a huge weathered metal bowl or basin filled with snow, prominently marked with the text {argument name="headline text" default="USA"}. Three tiny human figures stand near it for scale. Bare tree branches frame the upper left. The overall palette is cold blue-gray with amber pinpricks of city light, and the whole image should have a gritty, painterly-photoreal look with a distinct artificial image artifact pattern: a visible grid of tiny glowing specks and dot noise scattered across the entire scene, especially in dark areas, as if from a flawed generative model output.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅充满电影感的反乌托邦冬季黄昏场景，视角从受遮蔽的河岸前景望向黑暗的现代城市天际线，远处闪烁着数百盏温暖的微小窗灯。左侧前景中，一位留着深色卷发的时尚女性以四分之三侧面示人，她的脸部被一个柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，唇边拿着一支点燃的香烟。她身着一件黑色蕾丝高领透视连衣裙，饰有精致的花卉刺绣，佩戴着垂坠耳环，展现出迷人的黑色电影美学。她周围的地面湿冷且结冰，散落着垃圾，右侧前景堆放着光亮的黑色垃圾袋，冰冻的岸边散布着残骸。冰冷水域的中景处坐落着一个巨大的风化金属碗或盆，里面积满了雪，上面显著标有文字 {argument name="headline text" default="USA"}。三个微小的人影站在旁边以作比例参考。光秃的树枝构成了左上方的框架。整体色调为冷蓝灰色，点缀着琥珀色的城市灯光，整张图像呈现出一种粗粝的、绘画般的写实感，并带有明显的 AI 图像伪影特征：整个场景（尤其是在暗部）散布着可见的微小发光斑点和噪点网格，仿佛出自一个有缺陷的生成式模型。

templates.title: Epic FC Barcelona Heritage Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级 FC Barcelona 传承海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical football tribute poster in a dark cinematic mixed-media style, combining fine-art portraiture, sports branding, textured grunge painting, and premium editorial typography. The central subject is a waist-up portrait of {argument name="historical figure" default="Rabindranath Tagore"} reimagined as an FC Barcelona icon, facing slightly to the right, with long wavy silver-gray hair, a long flowing beard, aged features, and a calm legendary presence. Dress him in a classic FC Barcelona home jersey with deep red and navy vertical stripes, visible Nike swoosh on the left side, and the FCB crest on the chest. Use moody rim lighting and painterly highlights around the hair and shoulders so the figure feels monumental and almost divine. Set the background as an abstract brush-texture composition in Barcelona colors, dark indigo, crimson, burgundy, and muted gold, with 3 major graphic elements behind the portrait: a large faded FC Barcelona crest near the top center, a vertical block of handwritten Bengali manuscript text on the left side, and a large gold handwritten signature-style script running vertically on the right. At the top left, place 5 lines of elegant serif text: the first line reads "RABINDRANATH", the second much larger line reads "TAGORE", the third line reads "1861-1941", the fourth line is the quote "Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high...", and the fifth line is a cursive signature reading "Rabindranath Tagore". In the middle-lower area, add 5 centered text lines in a refined poster layout: "MORE THAN A POET.", then a large gold handwritten line reading "A timeless spirit.", then "A {argument name="club nickname" default="CULER"} FOREVER.", then a thin horizontal red-and-blue accent line, and then a small centered FCB crest beneath it. At the bottom, show a wide view of Camp Nou at dusk with glowing stadium lights and a dramatic sunset horizon, packed stands, and a giant crowd mosaic reading exactly {argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}. In the foreground place 1 football centered on the wet reflective pitch with the Barcelona crest visible on the ball. The entire image should feel like a luxury fan-made heritage poster, ultra-detailed, painterly, emotional, reverential, high contrast, textured, epic, and suitable for a premium social media football graphic or wall poster. Use a tall 2:3 poster composition with layered depth, subtle sparks, paint streaks, and gold accents. Optionally replace the visible club identity with {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} while preserving the same elite tribute-poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具电影质感的竖版足球致敬海报，采用混合媒介风格，融合美术肖像、体育品牌元素、纹理质感绘画以及高端编辑排版。画面主体为 {argument name="historical figure" default="Rabindranath Tagore"} 的半身肖像，将其重塑为 FC Barcelona 的标志性人物，身体微向右转，留着飘逸的银灰色长发和长胡须，面容沧桑，神态沉稳且充满传奇色彩。让他身穿经典的 FC Barcelona 主场球衣，球衣带有深红色和海军蓝的竖条纹，左侧可见 Nike 标志，胸前印有 FCB 队徽。运用深沉的轮廓光和围绕头发与肩部的绘画式高光，使人物看起来宏伟且近乎神圣。背景采用 Barcelona 配色的抽象笔触构图，包含深靛蓝、深红、酒红和柔和的金色，肖像后方有 3 个主要的图形元素：顶部中央是一个巨大的褪色 FC Barcelona 队徽，左侧是一块竖排的手写孟加拉语手稿文字，右侧是一行巨大的金色手写体签名风格文字。在左上角放置 5 行优雅的衬线字体：第一行写着 "RABINDRANATH"，第二行（字号更大）写着 "TAGORE"，第三行写着 "1861-1941"，第四行是引言 "Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high..."，第五行是草书签名 "Rabindranath Tagore"。在中下部区域，以精致的海报布局添加 5 行居中文字："MORE THAN A POET."，接着是一行巨大的金色手写体 "A timeless spirit."，然后是 "A {argument name="club nickname" default="CULER"} FOREVER."，随后是一条纤细的红蓝水平装饰线，下方是一个居中的小型 FCB 队徽。底部展示黄昏时分 Camp Nou 的广角视野，球场灯光闪烁，夕阳地平线壮丽，看台座无虚席，巨大的观众拼图文字清晰显示为 {argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}。前景中放置 1 个足球，居中于湿润且具有反射感的球场草坪上，球上可见 Barcelona 队徽。整张图片应呈现出奢华的粉丝自制传承海报质感，细节丰富、具有绘画感、情感充沛、庄重、高对比度、纹理感强、史诗感十足，非常适合作为高端足球社交媒体图形或墙面海报。采用 2:3 的竖版海报构图，具有层次深度、细微火花、油漆笔触和金色点缀。可选择将可见的俱乐部标识替换为 {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"}，同时保持相同的精英级致敬海报美学。

templates.title: Summer Coffee Ice Cream Collab Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季咖啡冰淇淋联名海报

templates.prompt: A bright, cheerful summer co-branded beverage poster in a clean Chinese commercial advertising style, showing a collaboration between {argument name="brand one" default="蜜雪冰城"} and {argument name="brand two" default="STARBUCKS"}. Vertical poster layout with a soft blue sky background, sunlit greenery, and an outdoor cafe atmosphere. At the top, place both brand logos side by side with a large bold Chinese headline in playful hand-drawn display lettering: {argument name="headline text" default="雪王遇见星朋友"}. Beneath it, add a green ribbon banner with Chinese subheadline text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="米雪冰城 × 星巴克 联名开启"}, and a smaller line reading "甜蜜加倍·快乐翻倍". Include 2 circular stamp-style graphics: one on the left reading "联名限定", and one on the upper right like a postmark with Chinese text around a small drink icon. In the center foreground on a wooden outdoor table, display 2 iced drinks: on the left, a tall clear cup of vivid green matcha slush topped with a tall swirl of vanilla soft serve and green matcha drizzle, with visible ice texture and a cute snowman mascot logo on the cup; on the right, a tall clear Starbucks-style iced latte with milk and green matcha swirls at the bottom, topped with whipped cream and dark cookie crumbs, with the green siren logo on the cup. In front of the drinks, place 1 cute white snowman mascot figurine with a tiny crown, round body, rosy cheeks, red cape, and a happy wink, sitting and holding a small takeaway coffee cup. Add 2 vertical product name tags beside the drinks: left tag "雪顶抹茶星冰乐", right tag "抹茶雪王奥利奥". On the right midground, place 1 small black chalkboard sign on a wooden easel reading "ICE CREAM & COFFEE" with chalk drawings of an ice cream cone and a takeaway cup. In the lower left, create a torn-paper price block showing a combo offer with large red numbers "¥19.9", green supporting text, and a small green badge reading "立省 ¥6". In the lower center-right, add a "联名周边" area displaying exactly 4 merchandise items: 1 cup sleeve, 1 character keychain or acrylic charm, 1 round badge, and 1 small sticker or token, all using the snowman mascot and coffee collaboration theme. Use warm sunlight, glossy drink photography, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh trees, high contrast product retouching, crisp packaging details, and an upbeat youthful retail-promo aesthetic. Include scattered doodle hearts and playful decorative accents around the typography. Keep all visible text in Chinese except the Starbucks wordmark and the chalkboard text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮欢快的夏季联名饮品海报，采用简洁的中国商业广告风格，展示 {argument name="brand one" default="蜜雪冰城"} 与 {argument name="brand two" default="STARBUCKS"} 的联名合作。竖版海报布局，背景为柔和的蓝天、阳光下的绿植和户外咖啡馆氛围。海报顶部并排放置两个品牌 Logo，下方配有醒目的大号中文标题，采用俏皮的手绘艺术字体：{argument name="headline text" default="雪王遇见星朋友"}。标题下方添加一条绿色丝带横幅，内含中文副标题：{argument name="subheadline text" default="蜜雪冰城 × 星巴克 联名开启"}，以及一行小字“甜蜜加倍·快乐翻倍”。包含 2 个圆形印章式图形：左侧印有“联名限定”，右上角类似邮戳，周围环绕中文并带有小型饮品图标。画面中心前景的户外木桌上放置 2 杯冰饮：左侧是一杯高透明杯装的鲜绿色抹茶冰沙，顶部有高耸的香草软冰淇淋和绿色抹茶淋酱，冰块质感清晰，杯身印有可爱的雪王吉祥物 Logo；右侧是一杯高透明的星巴克风冰拿铁，底部有牛奶和绿色抹茶旋涡，顶部覆盖鲜奶油和深色饼干碎，杯身印有绿色美人鱼 Logo。饮品前方放置 1 个可爱的白色雪王吉祥物玩偶，戴着小皇冠，圆滚滚的身体，红润的脸颊，披着红斗篷，俏皮地眨着眼，坐着并手持一个小咖啡外带杯。在饮品旁添加 2 个竖排产品标签：左侧标签为“雪顶抹茶星冰乐”，右侧标签为“抹茶雪王奥利奥”。右侧中景处放置 1 个木质画架上的黑色小黑板，上面写着“ICE CREAM & COFFEE”，并用粉笔画有冰淇淋甜筒和外带杯。左下角设计一个撕纸风格的价格板块，显示组合优惠，配有醒目的红色数字“¥19.9”、绿色辅助文字以及一个写着“立省 ¥6”的小型绿色徽章。右下方添加一个“联名周边”展示区，精确陈列 4 件周边商品：1 个杯套、1 个角色钥匙扣或亚克力挂件、1 个圆形徽章和 1 个小贴纸或代币，均采用雪王吉祥物与咖啡联名主题。画面运用温暖阳光、光泽感饮品摄影、浅景深效果、柔和的树影虚化、高对比度产品修图、清晰的包装细节，呈现出积极向上的年轻化零售促销美学。在文字周围点缀零星的涂鸦爱心和俏皮的装饰元素。除 Starbucks 字标和黑板文字外，其余可见文字均保持为中文。

templates.title: UFC-Style Women's Fight Poster

titleLocalized.zh: UFC 风格女子格斗海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic UFC fight-poster style sports promotion for {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"}, designed as a high-contrast vertical matchup graphic with two female MMA fighters facing inward in orthodox guard poses. The left fighter is a fit blonde woman with shoulder-length messy beach-wave hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly right. The right fighter is a fit dark-haired woman with long straight black hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly left, with a large detailed black-and-gray tattoo sleeve on her right arm and script tattoo text on the inner upper arm. Both fighters are sweaty, intensely lit, and centered close together with fists raised near chest height. Use a split background: fiery orange sparks and smoke on the left, icy blue-white sparks and haze on the right, with a dark black center seam. At the top center, place a black rectangular logo box with gold trim containing the gold text {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}. Beneath it, in stacked condensed white uppercase type, add the tagline: "TWO ICONS. ONE OCTAGON." Along the far left edge, place the surname "SWEENEY" vertically in large distressed gold letters; along the far right edge, place the surname "FOXX" vertically in large distressed silver-gray letters. In the center, overlay huge distressed white condensed sans-serif typography with the matchup names stacked exactly as {argument name="left fighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} above a small gold "VS" and {argument name="right fighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"}. Below that, add a small gold subtitle reading "BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT". At the bottom center, show a small realistic UFC octagon cage seen from a slightly elevated front angle, embedded into the poster. In front of the cage, place a black date card with gold trim containing stacked gold text: "JUNE 14", "SATURDAY", "10PM ET / 7PM PT". Below the card, add white text "LIVE ON" and the ESPN+ logo. Bottom left, add small gold and white ticket text reading "TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25" with the Ticketmaster logo beneath. Bottom right, add the Rogers Arena logo and white text "ROGERS ARENA" with gold text "VANCOUVER, BC" below. Use a glossy premium combat-sports poster finish, cinematic rim lighting, gritty texture overlays, metallic typography, and intense face-off composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性的 UFC 风格格斗体育宣传海报，主题为 {argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"}，设计为高对比度的垂直对阵图，两位女性 MMA 格斗选手以正架姿势相对而立。左侧选手为一位健美的金发女性，留着齐肩凌乱的海浪卷发，肤色古铜，身穿黑色运动内衣、黑色 UFC 手套和黑色格斗短裤，画面从大腿上部到头部，身体略微向右转。右侧选手为一位健美的深色头发女性，留着长直黑发，肤色古铜，身穿黑色运动内衣、黑色 UFC 手套和黑色格斗短裤，画面从大腿上部到头部，身体略微向左转，右臂有大面积精致的黑灰色纹身袖，上臂内侧有文字纹身。两位选手都满头大汗，灯光强烈，身体居中靠拢，拳头抬至胸前高度。背景采用分割设计：左侧为火红色的火花与烟雾，右侧为冰蓝白色的火花与薄雾，中间有一道深黑色的接缝。在顶部中央，放置一个带有金色边框的黑色矩形标志框，内含金色文字 {argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"}。在其下方，以堆叠的压缩白色大写字体添加标语：“TWO ICONS. ONE OCTAGON.”。沿最左侧边缘，垂直放置巨大的做旧金色字母姓氏“SWEENEY”；沿最右侧边缘，垂直放置巨大的做旧银灰色字母姓氏“FOXX”。在中心位置，叠加巨大的做旧白色压缩无衬线字体，对阵名称堆叠方式为 {argument name="left fighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} 位于小号金色“VS”上方，下方为 {argument name="right fighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"}。在其下方，添加一行小号金色副标题“BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT”。在底部中央，展示一个嵌入海报中的小型写实 UFC 八角笼，视角略微抬高。在八角笼前方，放置一张带有金色边框的黑色日期卡，内含堆叠的金色文字：“JUNE 14”、“SATURDAY”、“10PM ET / 7PM PT”。在卡片下方，添加白色文字“LIVE ON”以及 ESPN+ 标志。左下角添加小号金色和白色票务文字“TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25”，下方附带 Ticketmaster 标志。右下角添加 Rogers Arena 标志，下方为白色文字“ROGERS ARENA”及金色文字“VANCOUVER, BC”。采用光泽感的高级格斗运动海报质感，运用电影级轮廓光、粗粝的纹理叠加、金属质感字体以及强烈的对峙构图。

templates.title: Flash Mirror Selfie in Retro Bathroom

titleLocalized.zh: 复古浴室闪光灯镜面自拍

templates.prompt: A candid flash mirror selfie in a small retro bathroom, shot vertically with a realistic early-2000s disposable-camera aesthetic. A young woman with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur stands in front of a slightly dirty mirror, holding a smartphone with a bright direct flash that creates a strong starburst flare at the center-right of the image. She has dark brown hair with lighter blonde highlights, styled in a messy claw-clip updo with loose strands around the face, and wears small hoop earrings plus 2 layered silver necklaces. Her outfit is a fitted white baby tee with faded pink collegiate-style text reading "NANTUCKET" in reverse from the mirror, and loose heather gray sweatpants with white socks; one knee is raised casually on the sink counter, giving the pose a relaxed, intimate snapshot feel. The phone case is covered with cute stickers and a round grip featuring a pink cartoon bear or bunny motif. The bathroom has pale pink wall tiles on the lower half, off-white upper walls, a sink counter cluttered with 7 visible toiletry and beauty items total: 4 bottles on the left side of the sink, 1 black hairbrush on the sink edge, and 2 perfume or cosmetic bottles along the bottom ledge of the mirror. A beige towel hangs in the background, and the mirror frame is metal with visible smudges and dust specks catching the flash. Include the subject’s shadow cast dramatically on the left wall and mirror, soft ambient greenish indoor light mixed with harsh flash, subtle film grain, natural skin texture, slight lens distortion, and an authentic unpolished lifestyle-photo mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在小型复古浴室中拍摄的随性闪光灯镜面自拍，采用 2000 年代初期写实的一次性相机美学进行竖构图。一位年轻女性站在略显脏乱的镜子前，面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理遮挡，她手持智能手机，明亮的直射闪光灯在画面中右侧产生了强烈的星芒光晕。她留着深棕色头发，带有浅金色挑染，梳着凌乱的鲨鱼夹盘发，脸颊两侧留有碎发，佩戴着小圆圈耳环和两条叠戴的银色项链。她身穿一件修身的白色短款 T 恤，上面印有褪色的粉色学院风文字“NANTUCKET”（在镜子中呈镜像显示），下身穿着宽松的灰麻色运动裤和白色袜子；她的一只膝盖随意地抬在洗手台上，使姿势呈现出一种放松、亲密的抓拍感。手机壳上贴满了可爱的贴纸，并配有一个带有粉色卡通熊或兔子图案的圆形气囊支架。浴室下半部分铺着淡粉色墙砖，上半部分为灰白色墙面，洗手台上杂乱地摆放着总共 7 件洗漱和美容用品：左侧有 4 个瓶子，洗手台边缘有一把黑色发梳，镜子底部边缘摆放着 2 个香水或化妆品瓶。背景中挂着一条米色毛巾，金属镜框上可见明显的污渍和灰尘颗粒，捕捉到了闪光灯的效果。画面包含投射在左侧墙壁和镜子上的戏剧性阴影，柔和的室内环境绿光与强烈的闪光灯交织，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感、自然的皮肤纹理、轻微的镜头畸变，营造出一种真实且未经修饰的生活照氛围。

templates.title: Anime Heroine Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫女主角宣传海报

templates.prompt:
A polished anime-style vertical key visual poster for a futuristic fantasy action series. Center the composition on a full-body young heroine in a confident three-quarter back pose, looking over her shoulder, with her face partially obscured by angle and hair. She has long flowing silver-white hair blowing dramatically in the wind, pale skin, and cool violet accents. Her outfit is a sleek black, white, and purple combat uniform: black cropped jacket with white hood and cape-like layered back panels, fitted bodice, short pleated skirt, utility belt and straps, black gloves, thigh strap on one leg, and subtle star-emblem details. In her right hand she holds a large angular sci-fi sword with glowing purple energy lines. The background is a bright blue daytime sky with soft clouds, several white birds, and an elegant white city of tall cathedral-like spires and bridges, creating a grand utopian futuristic kingdom atmosphere. Use strong wind effects in the hair, ribbons, coat tails, and fabric. Add smooth linework and smooth coloring, clean anime rendering, high-detail cel shading, crisp lighting, glossy highlights, and a premium game-promo illustration finish.

Design it as a complete Japanese promotional poster layout. On the upper left, place a large bold vertical headline in Japanese reading "未来を、自分の手で。" with the middle phrase in purple and the rest in black, over a pale decorative emblem. Beneath it, add a short Japanese blurb in smaller text. On the right side, place a tall dark vertical sidebar with white Japanese text reading "信じてる。だから、私が道を切り開く。". On the lower left, include 3 tilted rectangular inset images stacked diagonally: 1 close-up portrait of the heroine's face, 1 action shot of her fighting with the glowing sword, and 1 wide cityscape view. Below those in a dark character info panel, show the character name "ルシア" with the romanized name "Lucia" and a small emblem, followed by 7 profile lines in Japanese: "CV：悠木 碧", "年齢：17歳", "所属：黎明騎士団（不屈の翼）", "武器：双刃剣（レプリカント）", "誕生日：4月12日", "身長：165cm", "好きなもの：静かな場所、星空", and a final dislike line. At the bottom center, place the large series logo text "黎明のリベリオン" with the English subtitle "REIMEI NO REBELLION" beneath it, and below that the release line "2025年、始動。". Color palette: white, black, deep indigo, electric violet, and sky blue. Overall mood: heroic, elegant, aspirational, premium anime game or light novel promotional poster.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的动漫风格竖版主视觉海报，展现未来奇幻动作系列。构图中心为一位全身年轻女主角，她以自信的三分之四背影姿态回眸，面部因角度和发丝略微遮挡。她拥有随风飘逸的长银白发，肤色白皙，带有冷色调的紫色点缀。身着黑、白、紫三色相间的干练战斗服：黑色短款夹克搭配白色兜帽及披风式层叠后摆，修身胸衣，短百褶裙，配有战术腰带和绑带，黑色手套，单腿大腿绑带，并有精致的星形徽章细节。右手持一把巨大的多边形科幻长剑，剑身带有发光的紫色能量线。背景为明亮的蓝色白昼天空，点缀着柔和的云朵和几只白鸟，远景是一座由高耸大教堂式尖塔和桥梁构成的优雅白色城市，营造出宏伟的乌托邦式未来王国氛围。头发、丝带、衣摆和布料需体现强烈的风感。采用流畅的线条和色彩，干净的动漫渲染，高细节赛璐珞阴影，清脆的灯光，光泽感高光，呈现出高级游戏宣传插画的质感。

设计为完整的日式宣传海报布局。左上角放置醒目的竖排日文大标题“未来を、自分の手で。”，中间短语为紫色，其余为黑色，背景衬托淡色装饰徽章。下方添加较小的日文简介。右侧放置一个深色竖向侧边栏，内含白色日文文字“信じてる。だから、私が道を切り開く。”。左下角堆叠 3 张倾斜的矩形插图：1 张女主角面部特写，1 张她挥舞发光长剑的动作镜头，以及 1 张城市全景图。在下方的深色角色信息面板中，显示角色名“ルシア”及其罗马音“Lucia”和一个小徽章，随后是 7 行日文个人资料：“CV：悠木 碧”、“年齢：17歳”、“所属：黎明騎士団（不屈の翼）”、“武器：双刃剣（レプリカント）”、“誕生日：4月12日”、“身長：165cm”、“好きなもの：静かな場所、星空”，以及最后一行不喜欢的物品。底部中央放置大型系列 Logo 文字“黎明のリベリオン”，下方附带英文副标题“REIMEI NO REBELLION”，再下方为发布日期“2025年、始動。”。配色方案：白色、黑色、深靛色、电紫色和天蓝色。整体氛围：英雄气概、优雅、充满抱负，呈现出高级动漫游戏或轻小说的宣传海报感。

templates.title: Pastel Anime Fantasy Poster with Heroine

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和动漫奇幻风格女主角海报

templates.prompt: A vertical Japanese anime fantasy game or light-novel promotional poster in a soft pastel lavender, white, and gold palette, featuring a single heroic teenage girl as the main subject in a grand celestial city. She stands in a dynamic three-quarter full-body pose, slightly turned left, holding an ornate staff in her left hand, with her right arm extended behind her as if caught in wind. Her face is obscured by a flat pale square censor block centered over the head, but the visible design suggests a delicate anime heroine with very long flowing silver-lilac hair, side bangs, loose strands, and star-shaped hair ornaments with dark indigo ribbon bows. She wears an elaborate magical-girl style dress: off-shoulder white bodice with navy and violet trim, gold star motifs, layered asymmetrical skirt in white, periwinkle, violet, and deep indigo, a very large dark blue waist bow with a gold star jewel, detached flowing sleeves, gold chains with tiny star charms draped at the hip, white thigh-high stockings, and a blue star-shaped garter ornament on one thigh. Her staff is tall and elegant, dark shaft with gold frame elements and a suspended faceted blue crystal near the top, decorated with bows and star accents. The background is an airy fantasy skyline of white towers, cathedral-like spires, clouds, feathers, and drifting pink petals, with bright ethereal backlighting and a dreamy heroic atmosphere. Compose it like a polished key visual poster with abundant Japanese typography integrated into the artwork. At the upper left, place the Japanese tagline text "願いが、未来を照らす。" with two smaller lines below it. At the upper right, place a star-like emblem, the large character name "ルミナ", the subtitle "— Lumina —", and a smaller CV credit line. On the right side, add 3 vertically stacked feature callouts, each with a small icon and a bold Japanese heading followed by 2 short lines of smaller text. On the left side, add 1 vertical Japanese copy block running downward beside the character. At the lower right, include 3 small portrait inset panels of the same girl, stacked diagonally: 1 calm front-facing expression, 1 side-profile serious expression, and 1 smiling eyes-closed expression. At the lower left, place the large Japanese title "星紡ぐレガシア" with the English subtitle "— LEGACIA: Weave the Stars —" beneath it. At the bottom right, add the date text "2025. 夏" and one short Japanese tagline line below. At the very bottom edge, include 2 small social or website info blocks on the left and a tiny copyright line on the right. Render in high-end modern anime promotional illustration style, luminous pastel fantasy atmosphere, elegant composition, smooth linework and coloring, soft cel shading, delicate fabric movement, glossy highlights, intricate costume details, clean typography layout, and refined commercial poster finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版日本动漫奇幻游戏或轻小说宣传海报，采用柔和的淡紫色、白色和金色调，以一位英姿飒爽的少女为主角，背景为宏伟的空中之城。她呈动态的三分之四全身姿势，身体微向左转，左手持一柄华丽的法杖，右手向后伸展，仿佛正处于风中。她的面部被一个位于头部的平坦淡色方形遮挡块覆盖，但可见的设计暗示着这是一位精致的动漫女主角，拥有极长的飘逸银丁香色长发、侧刘海、散落的发丝以及带有深靛蓝色丝带蝴蝶结的星形发饰。她身着精致的魔法少女风格连衣裙：露肩白色紧身胸衣，配有海军蓝和紫罗兰色饰边及金色星星图案；不对称的层叠裙摆，色彩融合了白色、长春花蓝、紫罗兰色和深靛蓝色；腰间饰有巨大的深蓝色蝴蝶结和金色星形宝石；配有分离式的飘逸袖子，臀部垂挂着带有微型星星挂饰的金色链条，穿着白色过膝袜，大腿上饰有蓝色星形吊带。她的法杖高挑优雅，深色杖身配有金色框架元素，顶部附近悬挂着一颗多面蓝色水晶，并饰有蝴蝶结和星星装饰。背景是轻盈的奇幻天际线，包含白色塔楼、大教堂般的尖顶、云朵、羽毛和飘落的粉色花瓣，伴有明亮空灵的背光和梦幻般的英雄氛围。构图仿照精致的主视觉海报，并将丰富的日语排版融入画面中。左上方放置日语标语“願いが、未来を照らす。”，下方附带两行较小的文字。右上方放置一个星形徽章、大号角色名“ルミナ”、副标题“— Lumina —”以及一行较小的声优信息。右侧添加 3 个垂直排列的功能标注，每个标注包含一个小图标、一个粗体日语标题以及下方两行较小的短文。左侧添加一个沿角色身侧垂直排列的日语文案块。右下方包含 3 个该角色的斜向堆叠小肖像插图：1 个平静的正面表情、1 个严肃的侧面表情和 1 个闭眼微笑的表情。左下方放置大号日语标题“星紡ぐレガシア”，下方附带英文副标题“— LEGACIA: Weave the Stars —”。右下角添加日期文本“2025. 夏”及下方一行简短的日语标语。最底端边缘左侧包含 2 个小型社交或网站信息块，右侧包含一行微小的版权声明。采用高端现代动漫宣传插画风格，呈现明亮的柔和奇幻氛围、优雅的构图、流畅的线条和色彩、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、细腻的织物动感、光泽高光、复杂的服装细节、整洁的排版布局以及精致的商业海报质感。

templates.title: Modern Luxury Mansion Exterior

titleLocalized.zh: 现代豪华别墅外观

templates.prompt: A photorealistic architectural exterior rendering of a large modern luxury family house viewed straight on from the front gate, perfectly centered and symmetrical. The house is a two-story contemporary mansion with smooth off-white stone or stucco walls, dark charcoal roof trim, large black-framed windows, and a grand recessed entrance with tall dark double doors under a flat canopy. On the left side, an open garage clearly reveals 1 white luxury SUV parked inside. On the right side, a floor-to-ceiling glass living room window shows 1 black grand piano inside, with elegant interior lighting faintly visible. In the foreground, 2 tall gray stone gate pillars frame the entrance, each topped with 1 classic black lantern for a total of 2 lanterns, and the right pillar has a gold nameplate engraved with Japanese text {argument name="nameplate text" default="藤 咲"}. A wide light-gray tiled walkway leads from the gate to the front door, bordered by neatly manicured green lawn and abundant white rose flowerbeds on both sides. Add trimmed shrubs, slender cypress-like trees near the doorway, low hedges, and rooftop terrace greenery. Surround the property with lush leafy trees at the edges of the frame. Use bright midday summer sunlight, crisp shadows, a vivid deep blue sky with a few small white clouds, ultra-clean materials, high-end residential design, realistic reflections in the glass, and a polished aspirational real-estate advertisement look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的建筑外观渲染图，展示了一座大型现代豪华独栋别墅，从前门正前方视角拍摄，构图完美居中且对称。这是一座两层高的现代豪宅，墙面采用光滑的灰白色石材或灰泥，搭配深炭色屋顶装饰，配有大型黑色边框窗户，以及位于平顶雨棚下、高大深色双开门的宏伟内嵌式入口。左侧是一个开放式车库，清晰可见里面停放着 1 辆白色豪华 SUV。右侧是落地玻璃客厅窗户，可以看到里面摆放着 1 架黑色三角钢琴，隐约可见优雅的室内灯光。前景中，2 根高大的灰色石柱构成了入口框架，每根柱顶各装有 1 盏经典黑色灯笼（共 2 盏），右侧石柱上镶嵌着一块刻有日文的金色铭牌 {argument name="nameplate text" default="藤 咲"}。一条宽阔的浅灰色瓷砖步道从大门延伸至前门，两侧是修剪整齐的草坪和繁茂的白色玫瑰花坛。增加修剪过的灌木、门口附近的细长柏树、低矮树篱以及屋顶露台绿植。在画面边缘环绕着郁郁葱葱的树木。采用明亮的夏季正午阳光、清晰的阴影、湛蓝的天空和几朵小白云，呈现超洁净的材质、高端住宅设计、玻璃上的逼真反射，以及精致且令人向往的房地产广告视觉效果。

templates.title: Japanese Character Relationship Chart Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日文角色关系图海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the cast reference, transform the simple lineup into an ornate Japanese light-novel character relationship chart poster. Keep the same 10 named characters and reuse their existing portrait art as the base visuals, but redesign the layout into a polished infographic on a soft cream and pale-blue fantasy background with decorative borders, sparkles, roses, and a small European-style hotel building vignette in the upper left. Add a large Japanese title at the top, 「支配人はかりそめの顔」, with the subtitle 「キャラクター紹介＆相関図」, and place a dark badge in the upper right that says 「ネタバレ配慮版」. Put the heroine 一条 紬希 in the center as the main focus in a framed character card labeled 「主人公」, and place 秦野 啓司 in a large framed card on the right as the key counterpart. Arrange the remaining 8 characters around them in individual profile cards: 加賀坂 その葉, 川原 澪, 樫村, 紬希の母, ハルカ, 杏子, 美果, 桜子. Connect the characters with multiple colored arrows and relationship labels to visualize the network; include exactly 14 visible relationship labels: 「親友」, 「理解者」, 「本音を見抜く」, 「憧れ」, 「相談」, 「画策」, 「仲直り中」, 「直感的理解」, 「メンター」, 「実務支援」, 「保護者的存在」, 「後輩　ムードメーカー」, 「後輩　グループを支える」, 「後輩　明るさ・希望」. Also add the 8 central horizontal relationship callouts between 一条 紬希 and 秦野 啓司: 「偽溶み→公認」, 「ライバル」, 「秘密を共有」, 「対等な相棒」, 「気になる存在」, plus a pink central badge reading 「反発から信頼へ」, and 3 lower callouts: 「信頼」, 「協力を後押し」, 「二人の空気に気づく」. Include a gold-ribbon group label above the three lower girls that says 「ASTRALの仲間たち」. Add a bottom section with exactly 10 smaller summary cards, one for each character again, lined up across the width. On the far right, add 2 boxed sidebar sections titled 「作品のキーワード」 and 「関係の見どころ」; the first should contain 4 bullet items with icons, and the second should contain 4 bullet items with icons. Fill every card with dense Japanese profile text and role tags in a clean editorial style, as if for a promotional relationship guide included with a novel. Make the overall design elegant, readable, romantic-mystery themed, and magazine-quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为角色参考，将简单的阵容转化为精美的日式轻小说风格角色关系图海报。保留原有的 10 位角色，并沿用其现有的肖像画作为基础视觉，但将布局重新设计为精致的信息图表，背景采用柔和的奶油色和淡蓝色幻想风格，配以装饰边框、闪光、玫瑰以及左上角的小型欧式酒店建筑插图。在顶部添加醒目的日文标题「支配人はかりそめの顔」，副标题为「キャラクター紹介＆相関図」，并在右上角放置一个深色徽章，标注「ネタバレ配慮版」。将女主角一条 紬希置于中心作为焦点，放入标有「主人公」的框架角色卡中；将秦野 啓司放入右侧的大型框架卡中，作为关键对应角色。将其余 8 位角色排列在周围的独立个人资料卡中：加賀坂 その葉、川原 澪、樫村、紬希の母、ハルカ、杏子、美果、桜子。用多色箭头和关系标签连接角色以可视化关系网；包含 14 个可见的关系标签：「親友」、「理解者」、「本音を見抜く」、「憧れ」、「相談」、「画策」、「仲直り中」、「直感的理解」、「メンター」、「実務支援」、「保護者的存在」、「後輩　ムードメーカー」、「後輩　グループを支える」、「後輩　明るさ・希望」。同时在一条 紬希和秦野 啓司之间添加 8 个中央水平关系标注：「偽溶み→公認」、「ライバル」、「秘密を共有」、「対等な相棒」、「気になる存在」，并在中心放置一个粉色徽章，写着「反発から信頼へ」，以及 3 个下方的标注：「信頼」、「協力を後押し」、「二人の空気に気づく」。在下方三位女孩上方添加一个金色丝带组标签，写着「ASTRALの仲間たち」。在底部添加一个包含 10 个较小摘要卡的部分，每位角色对应一张，横向排列。在最右侧添加两个带边框的侧边栏，标题分别为「作品のキーワード」和「関係の見どころ」；前者包含 4 个带图标的要点，后者包含 4 个带图标的要点。用密集的日文个人资料文本和角色标签填充每一张卡片，风格简洁且具有编辑感，如同小说附赠的宣传关系指南。整体设计需优雅、易读，呈现浪漫悬疑主题，并达到杂志级品质。

templates.title: Blue Neon Denial ASMR Anime Portrait

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style close-up illustration of a young virtual streamer girl leaning toward the viewer in a dim blue neon studio, themed around harshly dismissive ASMR. She has short fluffy white hair with faint icy blue highlights, soft layered bangs partly covering one eye, bright blue half-lidded eyes, pale skin, and a slightly smug, cold, teasing expression with a small open mouth as if whispering criticism directly into the listener’s ear. One hand is raised beside her mouth in a whispering pose. She wears large futuristic over-ear headphones with glowing cyan rings and a small liquid-droplet motif on top, a white short-sleeved dress uniform with navy trim, gold buttons, a large dark blue ribbon at the collar, and a large blue bow at the back, plus a visible side tag reading “shizuku.” Add 2 blurred black binaural ASMR microphones in the foreground at the lower left, creating strong depth of field. Place 1 glowing holographic vertical panel on the left side with Japanese text and waveform graphics, including the headline {argument name="headline text" default="全否定 ASMR"} and small branding text {argument name="brand name" default="SHIZUKU"}. Include 4 short Japanese negative whisper lines beneath the headline, styled like a translucent cyan UI display. The room behind her is dark, atmospheric, and softly blurred with cool blue shelves and scattered glowing droplets or bokeh lights. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, cool monochrome blue and white tones, glossy highlights, delicate blush, highly detailed eyes and hair strands, soft bloom, crisp cel-shaded anime rendering, intimate composition, slight Dutch angle, and a feeling that the character is invading the listener’s personal space for an ASMR recording. The character should read as {argument name="character name" default="Shizuku"}, with {argument name="hair color" default="white with light blue highlights"} and {argument name="eye color" default="icy blue"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格近景插图，描绘了一位年轻的虚拟主播少女在昏暗的蓝色霓虹灯工作室中向观众倾身，主题为严厉的“全否定” ASMR。她留着蓬松的白色短发，带有淡淡的冰蓝色挑染，柔软的层次感刘海遮住了一只眼睛，明亮的冰蓝色半睁眼，皮肤白皙，表情带着一丝傲慢、冷漠和戏谑，微张的嘴唇仿佛正在对着听众的耳朵低语批评。一只手举在嘴边，做出低语的姿势。她戴着巨大的未来感头戴式耳机，耳机上有发光的青色圆环和顶部的液滴图案，身穿带有深蓝色镶边、金色纽扣的白色短袖制服，领口系着大大的深蓝色丝带，背后有一个巨大的蓝色蝴蝶结，侧面标签上清晰可见“shizuku”字样。在左下角前景中添加 2 个模糊的黑色双耳 ASMR 麦克风，营造出强烈的景深感。在左侧放置 1 个发光的全息垂直面板，包含日语文字和波形图形，其中包括标题 {argument name="headline text" default="全否定 ASMR"} 和小型品牌文字 {argument name="brand name" default="SHIZUKU"}。在标题下方包含 4 行简短的日语负面低语，采用半透明青色 UI 显示风格。她身后的房间昏暗且充满氛围感，背景中模糊的冷蓝色架子和散落的发光液滴或光斑若隐若现。采用戏剧性的电影级灯光，冷色调的蓝白配色，光泽高光，精致的腮红，高度精细的眼睛和发丝，柔和的辉光，清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染，亲密的构图，轻微的荷兰式倾斜角度，营造出角色为了 ASMR 录音而侵入听众个人空间的临场感。角色应呈现为 {argument name="character name" default="Shizuku"}，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="白色带浅蓝色挑染"} 的头发和 {argument name="eye color" default="冰蓝色"} 的眼睛。

templates.prompt: A cozy sunlit home office scene photographed in a realistic lifestyle style. A white short-haired cat with pale green eyes sits upright on a warm wooden desk near the center-left, facing the camera with a calm attentive expression, its tail curled around its front paws. To the left of the cat is 1 leafy potted houseplant in a textured beige pot and 1 ceramic mug filled with dark coffee. In front of the cat lies 1 open spiral notebook with handwritten notes and 1 silver pen resting diagonally across the pages. On the right side of the desk is 1 open laptop angled slightly toward the viewer, showing a vivid wallpaper of a turquoise lake and dramatic snow-capped mountain peaks under a blue sky. Behind the desk is a large window with soft cream curtains, bright golden morning sunlight streaming in from the right and casting natural shadows across the desk. Include 2 framed wall pictures partially visible on the left wall. The atmosphere should feel peaceful, productive, and warmly domestic, with soft cinematic lighting, crisp details, shallow depth of field, and high-end editorial photography realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨且阳光明媚的家庭办公场景，采用写实的生活摄影风格。一只拥有浅绿色眼睛的白色短毛猫端坐在温暖的木质书桌左侧中央，正对着镜头，神情平静而专注，尾巴环绕在两只前爪周围。猫的左侧摆放着 1 盆叶片茂盛的室内盆栽（置于米色纹理花盆中）和 1 个装有黑咖啡的陶瓷马克杯。猫的前方放着 1 本打开的螺旋笔记本，上面写有手写笔记，一支银色钢笔斜放在页面上。书桌右侧是 1 台稍微朝向观众倾斜的笔记本电脑，屏幕上显示着绿松石色湖泊与蓝天下壮丽雪山的生动壁纸。书桌后方是一扇大窗户，挂着柔软的米色窗帘，明亮的金色晨光从右侧射入，在书桌上投下自然的阴影。左侧墙壁上隐约可见 2 幅装裱好的挂画。整体氛围应显得宁静、高效且充满居家温暖感，并具备柔和的电影级光影、清晰的细节、浅景深效果以及高端的编辑摄影质感。

templates.title: Warm Penguin Fantasy Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨企鹅奇幻电影海报

templates.prompt: A heartwarming fictional movie poster in a soft cinematic Japanese drama style, photographed at golden hour with dreamy backlight and gentle lens glow. A person seen from behind and slightly below, wearing a cozy cream knit sweater, lifts a plush penguin toy high toward a bright sunset sky. The plush is centered and fills much of the frame: black fuzzy body, white belly, small yellow beak, yellow feet, outstretched stubby wings, and a humanlike anime-girl face framed by short dark brown bobbed hair with hairpins, creating a cute surreal mascot character. The background is an outdoor field with warm bokeh trees and a glowing sun low on the horizon, all in creamy beige, honey, peach, and gold tones. Several white feathers float through the air; show exactly 5 visible feathers scattered around the composition. Make the mood tender, nostalgic, hopeful, and slightly fantastical, like a family fantasy film poster. Add Japanese poster typography integrated into the design: at the top center, the tagline "この出会いが、世界をやさしく変えていく。"; along the left side vertically, "ずっと、いっしょだよ。"; near the bottom center, a large handwritten glowing title "{argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"}" in warm white neon-like script with a small pink heart above it; directly below in elegant serif capitals, "{argument name="subtitle" default="THE MOVIE"}". Beneath that, place a pink ribbon banner with the Japanese line "ずっと、いっしょだよ。". At the very bottom, add small centered Japanese credit text in a realistic film-poster layout, including cast and staff lines and production/distribution credits; include "gugugagaTokyo" and "AI Studio Tokyo" on the final line. Use a vertical one-sheet poster composition, polished commercial key art, shallow depth of field, soft filmic contrast, premium cinematic lighting, sentimental fantasy-drama aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨的虚构电影海报，采用柔和的日系电影剧照风格，拍摄于黄金时刻，带有梦幻般的逆光和柔和的镜头光晕。画面中，一名穿着舒适米色针织毛衣的人从后方及略低的角度被拍摄，正将一只毛绒企鹅玩具高高举向明亮的夕阳天空。毛绒玩具位于画面中心并占据大部分空间：黑色毛茸茸的身体、白色肚皮、黄色小嘴、黄色脚掌、向外伸展的短小翅膀，以及一张类似动漫少女的人脸，配有短棕色波波头和发卡，营造出一种可爱且超现实的吉祥物形象。背景是户外田野，带有温暖的树木虚化效果和地平线上低垂的耀眼太阳，整体色调为奶油米色、蜂蜜色、桃色和金色。几根白色羽毛在空中飘浮；画面中需清晰可见 5 根羽毛。氛围营造出温柔、怀旧、充满希望且略带奇幻的感觉，如同家庭奇幻电影海报。在设计中融入日文海报排版：顶部中央为宣传语“この出会いが、世界をやさしく変えていく。”；左侧垂直排列“ずっと、いっしょだよ。”；底部中央附近为巨大的手写发光标题“{argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"}”，采用温暖的白色霓虹灯风格字体，上方带有一个粉色小爱心；下方紧接着优雅的衬线大写字母“{argument name="subtitle" default="THE MOVIE"}”。在此下方，放置一条粉色丝带横幅，上面写有日文“ずっと、いっしょだよ。”。最底部添加居中的小型日文演职员表，采用真实的电影海报布局，包含演员和工作人员名单以及制作/发行信息；最后一行包含“gugugagaTokyo”和“AI Studio Tokyo”。采用垂直单张海报构图，精致的商业主视觉，浅景深，柔和的电影质感对比度，高级电影灯光，感性的奇幻剧情美学。

templates.title: Anime Schoolgirl on the Moon

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime illustration of a beautiful teenage schoolgirl sitting on a rocky lunar surface under a deep star-filled space sky, with a large glowing blue Earth dominating the upper right background. She has {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"} hair, extremely long and flowing in the low-gravity breeze, styled with two rounded twin buns high on the sides of her head and long loose strands cascading around her body. Her face is obscured by a flat square censor block centered over the head, with no facial features visible. She wears a Japanese-style school uniform: a crisp white long-sleeve blouse, a dark navy sleeveless sweater vest, a teal-green ribbon bow at the collar, a short dark pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown leather loafers. She is posed seated sideways on a rock with both legs extended toward the viewer, one hand resting behind her on the stone for support, creating a slightly low-angle composition that emphasizes her legs and hair. The scene is lit with dramatic cool moonlight and rim lighting from space, producing glossy highlights on her hair, clothing folds, and the dusty lunar rocks. In the distant mid-right background, include exactly 3 visible lunar base structures: a tall antenna tower, 1 dish-like communication unit, and 1 cylindrical installation. In the lower left foreground, include a curved metallic spacecraft or habitat rim partially entering the frame. Make the environment feel cinematic, serene, futuristic, and slightly melancholic, with ultra-detailed textures, sparkling dust particles, sharp linework, soft atmospheric glow, and premium polished anime key visual quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的动漫插画，描绘了一位美丽的少女坐在布满岩石的月球表面，背景是深邃且繁星点点的太空，右上角悬浮着一颗巨大的发光蓝色地球。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的头发，在低重力微风中极长且飘逸，发型为头顶两侧各有一个圆润的双丸子头，长发丝垂落在身体周围。她的脸部被一个位于头部的平整方形遮挡块覆盖，无法看到任何五官。她身穿日式校服：一件挺括的白色长袖衬衫、一件深海军蓝无袖针织背心、领口系着青绿色蝴蝶结、一条深色短百褶裙、白色及膝袜以及棕色皮质乐福鞋。她侧身坐在岩石上，双腿向观众方向伸展，一只手撑在身后的石头上支撑身体，构图采用略微仰视的角度，突出了她的双腿和头发。场景由戏剧性的冷色调月光和来自太空的轮廓光照亮，在她的头发、衣褶和布满尘埃的月球岩石上形成了光泽感的高光。在远处中右侧背景中，包含 3 个清晰可见的月球基地建筑：一座高耸的天线塔、1 个碟状通信单元和 1 个圆柱形装置。在左下角前景中，包含一个部分进入画面的弧形金属航天器或栖息地边缘。整体环境营造出电影般、宁静、未来感且略带忧郁的氛围，具备超精细的纹理、闪烁的尘埃粒子、锐利的线条、柔和的大气光晕以及顶级精美的动漫视觉质量。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性的虚构电影海报，用于 {argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"}，采用史诗级大片海报设计，具有深金棕色的电影质感光影和严肃的获奖电影基调。构图呈垂直对称。画面中心，一只圆滚滚、有着大而有光泽的眼睛、黄色喙和小黄脚的黑白毛绒企鹅吉祥物，被周围的非洲部落战士以仪式般的方式高高举起。画面中共有 6 名战士围绕在企鹅周围，肌肉发达的手臂向内向上伸出以托举吉祥物，形成一个由手部和身体组成的放射状光环。他们的皮肤在温暖的高光下显得质感丰富，佩戴着色彩鲜艳的串珠项链、手镯、头带和传统饰品。背景是一个光线昏暗的仪式场景，伴有温暖的火光、大地色的阴影、织物横幅和充满质感的琥珀色光晕，赋予场景一种古老而神圣的氛围。在顶部中心，居中书写日语文案：「知られざるググガガの誕生秘話。」左侧垂直书写日语标语：「モフモフが、世界を変えた。」右侧放置 5 个堆叠的金色月桂叶奖项方块，每个方块均带有日语文字并由月桂花环装饰。这 5 个奖项文字分别为：「第38回 モフモフ オブザイヤー 受賞」、「アフリカン タッチ映画祭 グランプリ」、「世界ぬいぐるみ 協会賞 最優秀賞」、「国際もふもふ アカデミー賞 主演賞」以及「ぬいぐるみが 選ぶ映画賞 観客賞」。在画面中下部，放置巨大的金属金色衬线标题 {argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"}，下方配有较小的金色衬线副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="THE MOVIE"}。在其下方，添加一行居中的小字：STARRING (声の出演)。在下部区域，包含 5 个圆形演员奖章，带有细小的月桂叶状边框和下方的标签。这 5 个演员角色分别是：一只毛茸茸的白色博美犬状小狗，标签为「モフリン」；一只长颈鹿，标签为「カワウーソン」；一只橙色虎斑猫，标签为「ニャンバラ」；一个蓝色圆形玩具状角色，标签为「トゥクトゥク星人」；以及一个学者模样的狒狒或猴子形象，标签为「バオバブ先生」。在演员行下方，添加精细的海报演职员表风格的日语制作信息，包括导演、编剧和音乐。在底部中心，显示一行醒目的金色上映日期 {argument name="release date" default="7.7 FRI ROADSHOW"}。沿底部边缘，包含小型制作和发行信息，文字为「制作：gugugagaTokyo」和「配给：AI Studio Tokyo」。在右下角放置一个黑白二维码。采用超精细照片级海报渲染、戏剧性对比、镀金排版、奢华质感、精品电影营销设计，以及对奥斯卡热门冒险剧情片的戏谑恶搞。

The lunar ground below is pale gray, dusty, and cratered, with scattered rocks, soft shadows, and a few small futuristic moon-base domes and antenna-like structures along the distant horizon. promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫插画，描绘了一名身材苗条的少女，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的长发，在月球表面以平静的坐姿处于失重漂浮状态。她拥有极长的飘逸秀发，向右侧戏剧性地延展，头顶扎着两个圆圆的双丸子头，长发丝顺滑地垂落至腿部下方。她身穿日式校服：白色衬衫、深海军蓝针织背心、领口系着绿色蝴蝶结、炭灰色百褶裙、白色及膝袜和棕色乐福鞋。将她放置在画面中心偏左位置，身体微向左侧，双腿前屈，一只手自然下垂，仿佛在低重力环境下轻轻漂浮。背景是深邃的黑色外太空，右上角可见一颗明亮且写实的地球，散发着蓝白色的光芒。下方的月球表面呈灰白色，布满尘埃和陨石坑，散落着岩石，带有柔和的阴影，远处的地平线上点缀着几个小型未来感月球基地圆顶和类似天线的结构。采用冷色调月光，在头发和身体边缘勾勒出细腻的轮廓光，发丝和衣褶细节丰富，运用柔和的动漫光影、清晰的线条，营造出一种将可爱女学生角色艺术与写实太空场景相结合的梦幻科幻氛围。

templates.title: Photorealistic Fast Food Storefront

The building has a beige stucco facade with a bold red trim band along the roofline, a large round brand logo near the upper left of the front wall, and oversized red channel letters spelling {argument name="main sign text" default="BURGER KING"} across the top. Add neatly maintained landscaping with 5 shrubs in dark mulch beds along the building edge, a concrete sidewalk in the foreground, a grassy strip, utility poles, traffic lights, and a suburban roadside intersection extending into the left background. Natural midday lighting, crisp shadows, commercial real-estate photography look, ultra-clean signage, highly legible text, realistic reflections on glass, sharp architectural details, and a subtle white {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} watermark in the top-right corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级写实的现代 {argument name="restaurant brand" default="BURGER KING"} 快餐店街角外观，从左前方视角拍摄，背景为蓝天白云。建筑采用米色灰泥外墙，屋顶边缘饰有醒目的红色装饰带，前墙左上方设有一个大型圆形品牌 Logo，顶部横跨着巨大的红色立体发光字，拼写为 {argument name="main sign text" default="BURGER KING"}。在立面右侧，展示一个高大的垂直菜单广告牌，包含 6 个清晰可见的产品面板和价格：皇堡 6.99 美元、植物基皇堡 7.49 美元、鸡薯条 3.49 美元、洋葱圈 2.49 美元、2 个 6 美元的混合搭配面板，以及包含薯条和饮料的 3 美元随心套餐面板。左侧设有一个黑色得来速（Drive-thru）顶棚，文字显示为 {argument name="drive thru sign" default="DRIVE THRU"}，车道上有 2 辆车，一辆深色 SUV 靠近镜头，另一辆银色轿车在前方。前角应有落地玻璃窗，透出明亮的室内环境，隐约可见几位顾客和菜单项目。前窗放置 1 张招聘海报，文字为 {argument name="window poster text" default="Now Hiring"}。建筑边缘配有精心打理的景观，深色覆盖物花坛中种有 5 丛灌木，前景为混凝土人行道、草地带、电线杆、交通信号灯，以及向左后方延伸的郊区路口。自然的中午光线，清晰的阴影，商业房地产摄影风格，超干净的标识，高度可读的文字，玻璃上的真实反射，锐利的建筑细节，以及右上角带有细微的白色 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} 水印。

templates.title: Cinematic Sci-Fi Action Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级科幻动作海报

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic action movie poster at golden-hour sunset, showing a rugged adult male action hero standing on the shattered glass edge of a skyscraper rooftop high above a futuristic megacity. He is positioned on the left side of the frame in a powerful full-body pose, wearing a dark fitted T-shirt, black jeans, and a dark open jacket, with windswept short brown hair. His face is intentionally obscured with a smooth rectangular blur block, as if censored. In one hand he holds a glowing blue holographic device projecting a transparent sci-fi interface with maps, targeting graphics, and a digital countdown timer reading 00:18:43. The background features a dramatic skyline of tall modern towers stretching to the horizon, with the sun low in the center-right casting warm orange light across the city. Fill the sky with explosive blockbuster action: 1 large helicopter in the upper right exploding midair with fire, smoke, debris, and spinning rotor fragments; 1 damaged passenger aircraft on the lower right banking downward trailing flames and black smoke; and 2 fast military jets streaking across the upper left sky leaving bright missile trails. Add flying embers, sparks, drifting debris, and intense volumetric smoke clouds for a high-stakes disaster atmosphere. Place a huge metallic 3D movie title across the upper-middle right reading {argument name="title text" default="TIMEFALL"}, angled slightly with bold steel texture and cinematic shadowing. Beneath it, add the tagline in clean bold capitals: {argument name="tagline" default="ONE MAN. ONE CHANCE. NO LIMITS."}. Add a small white brand mark in the top-right corner reading {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}. Use ultra-detailed photorealism, dramatic contrast, blockbuster poster composition, anamorphic flare, sharp character detail, epic scale, and polished Hollywood key art styling.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黄金时刻日落背景下的超写实电影级动作海报，画面展示了一位硬汉形象的成年男性动作英雄，站在未来超级城市高空摩天大楼破碎的玻璃边缘。他位于画面左侧，呈现强有力的全身姿态，身穿深色修身 T 恤、黑色牛仔裤和深色开衫夹克，留着被风吹乱的棕色短发。他的面部被一个平滑的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡，仿佛经过了审查。他的一只手拿着一个发光的蓝色全息设备，投射出一个透明的科幻界面，上面显示着地图、目标图形以及显示为 00:18:43 的数字倒计时。背景是延伸至地平线的现代高塔组成的壮观天际线，太阳位于中右侧低空，将温暖的橙色光芒洒满整座城市。天空中充满了爆炸性的动作大片元素：右上角有一架大型直升机在半空中爆炸，伴随着火焰、烟雾、碎片和旋转的旋翼残骸；右下角有一架受损的客机向下倾斜，拖着火焰和黑烟；左上角有两架快速飞行的军用喷气式飞机划过天空，留下明亮的导弹轨迹。加入飞舞的余烬、火花、漂浮的碎片和强烈的体积烟云，营造出高风险的灾难氛围。在右上方的中上部放置一个巨大的金属质感 3D 电影标题，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="TIMEFALL"}，带有轻微的角度倾斜，呈现粗犷的钢材纹理和电影级阴影效果。在标题下方，添加简洁醒目的大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="ONE MAN. ONE CHANCE. NO LIMITS."}。在右上角添加一个小的白色品牌标志，内容为 {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}。采用超精细的写实风格、强烈的对比度、大片海报构图、变形镜头光晕、清晰的人物细节、史诗般的规模以及精致的好莱坞主视觉艺术风格。

templates.title: Dragon Queen at Burning Sunset

Set in a ruined medieval city with burned stone towers and crumbling structures on both sides, active fires on the ground, drifting embers, smoke, and a blazing orange sunset sky with stormy clouds. Low-angle heroic composition, epic scale contrast between human and beast, ultra-detailed textures, photorealistic fantasy realism, dramatic rim lighting, fiery orange and black color palette, moody atmosphere, sharp focus on the queen and dragon, blockbuster poster aesthetic. Add the text {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} in clean white sans-serif near the upper right.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的暗黑奇幻肖像，{argument name="character name" default="一位银发龙之女王"} 站在前景中黑色的火山碎石上，身后是一条巨大的黑龙在守护着她。这位女性身穿一件精致的拖地黑色礼服，胸部和肩部带有盔甲细节，长袖修身，高领设计，厚重的深色斗篷向右拖曳。她的头发是 {argument name="hair color" default="铂银色"}，极长且呈波浪状散落，在火光中微微发亮。她的面部故意模糊处理，没有清晰的五官。巨龙占据了大部分背景，两只巨大的翅膀向外伸展，构成了画面的框架；它拥有浓密的炭黑色鳞片、许多锋利的角和面部尖刺、发光的琥珀色眼睛，巨大的弯曲脖颈在女性上方拱起。背景设定在一座破败的中世纪城市，两侧是烧焦的石塔和坍塌的建筑，地面上有活跃的火焰、漂浮的余烬、烟雾，以及带有风暴云层的炽热橙色落日天空。低角度英雄式构图，人类与野兽之间的史诗级比例对比，超精细纹理，超写实奇幻风格，戏剧性的轮廓光，火橙色与黑色的配色方案，忧郁的氛围，女王与巨龙聚焦清晰，大片海报美学。在右上角附近添加简洁的白色无衬线字体 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"}。

The sandwich is centered slightly left and stacked tall with a glossy brioche bun, spicy orange sauce on the top bun, 2 purple-red onion rings, 3 pickle slices, 2 tomato slices, melted cheddar cheese dripping over an extra-crunchy fried chicken fillet, curly green leaf lettuce, and more creamy orange sauce dripping from the bottom bun. templates.title: Epic Shonen Crossover Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级少年漫联动海报

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed cinematic anime crossover poster featuring 4 legendary shonen-inspired heroes charging forward in a single epic battle composition under a dramatic apocalyptic sky. The scene is wide, symmetrical, and explosively energetic, with a glowing break in the storm clouds at the top center sending intense golden sun rays downward across the characters. From left to right: a blond ninja-inspired teenage hero in an orange-and-black outfit with a forehead protector, crouched in an attack stance and forming a glowing spinning energy orb in one hand, surrounded by orange chakra flames and several floating black spheres behind him; a muscular black-haired martial artist in an orange gi at left-center, twisting mid-strike while charging a bright blue energy sphere in his hand, wrapped in crackling blue aura and electric arcs; a lean pirate-inspired young man at right-center wearing a straw hat, sleeveless red vest, blue shorts, and sandals, lunging forward with a fierce grin, one arm extended, with white steam-like energy curling around his body; a dark-haired swordsman at far right in a flowing black-and-red checkered haori, drawing or swinging a katana with a sweeping arc of fiery red-orange energy around him. The background is a chaotic fantasy battlefield of shattered rock, sparks, lightning, embers, molten light, and swirling elemental effects, with orange fire dominating the left and right edges, cool blue energy concentrated around the martial artist, and white vapor around the pirate hero. Use extreme contrast, ultra-saturated colors, sharp inked anime linework, painterly textures, dynamic foreshortening, intense motion blur in the effects, and premium poster-quality rendering. Add a massive title across the bottom foreground reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHONEN LEGENDS"} in oversized distressed brush lettering, bright yellow-gold with thick black shadows and rough torn edges, partially overlapping the characters and debris. Make it feel like a blockbuster key art poster for {argument name="franchise theme" default="legendary shonen anime crossover"}, with thunderous energy, heroic rivalry, and unstoppable momentum.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的电影级动漫联动海报，画面中 4 位传奇少年漫风格英雄在末日般戏剧性的天空下，于一场史诗级战役中并肩冲锋。场景宏大、构图对称且充满爆发力，云层顶部中央的裂隙中洒下强烈的金色阳光，笼罩着角色。从左至右：左侧是一位身穿橙黑相间服装、佩戴护额的金发忍者风格少年英雄，他呈攻击姿态蹲伏，手中凝聚着发光的旋转能量球，周身环绕着橙色查克拉火焰，身后漂浮着几颗黑色球体；左中是一位身穿橙色道服、肌肉发达的黑发武术家，他在半空中扭身出击，手中蓄积着明亮的蓝色能量球，周身缠绕着噼啪作响的蓝色光环与电弧；右中是一位戴着草帽、身穿无袖红背心、蓝色短裤和凉鞋的瘦削海盗风格青年，他咧嘴大笑向前猛冲，单臂伸展，白色的蒸汽状能量环绕周身；最右侧是一位身穿黑红格纹羽织的黑发剑士，他正在拔刀或挥剑，周围环绕着一道炽热的红橙色能量弧。背景是混乱的奇幻战场，碎石、火花、闪电、余烬、熔岩光芒与旋转的元素特效交织，左侧和右侧边缘以橙色火焰为主导，武术家周围集中着冷色调的蓝色能量，海盗英雄周围则环绕着白色蒸汽。采用极高的对比度、超饱和的色彩、锐利的动漫线条、油画质感、动态透视、强烈的特效运动模糊，以及顶级的海报级渲染效果。在底部前景添加一个巨大的标题 {argument name="headline text" default="SHONEN LEGENDS"}，使用超大号的做旧笔刷字体，亮黄金色配以厚重的黑色阴影和粗糙的撕裂边缘，部分遮挡角色与碎片。整体氛围如同 {argument name="franchise theme" default="legendary shonen anime crossover"} 的大片级主视觉海报，充满雷霆万钧的能量、英雄间的较量以及势不可挡的气势。

templates.title: Dark Anime Villains Crossover Poster

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic anime villain poster in an ultra-detailed gothic horror style, arranged as a single dramatic collage against a ruined infernal city. In the center foreground, a massive obese pirate emperor with a huge grin, wild black beard, open red captain coat, bare scarred chest and belly, layered necklaces, belt, and multiple pistols tucked at his waist, holding 2 flintlock pistols outward in a triumphant pose. On the left foreground, a pale long-haired Japanese swordsman in loose light robes, head bowed slightly, surrounded by a giant coiled serpent rising behind him with open mouth; add the vertical Japanese text "大蛇丸" near this figure and the vertical text "魔人ブウ" near the upper-center figure. On the right, a tall elegant demon lord in layered dark kimono-like robes, long flowing hair, calm sinister posture, framed by 8 smaller dark red moons plus 1 large full red moon above the head, for a total of 9 moons; add the vertical Japanese text "黒ひげ" near the pirate and "鬼舞辻無惨" near the right figure. The background should be a hellish apocalypse of shattered towers, burning ruins, and shadowy architecture fading into smoke. At the bottom, place huge aggressive brush-painted title text reading {argument name="headline text" default="RISE OF VILLAINS"} in blood red with magenta highlights, rough torn edges, and glowing texture. Make the whole image feel like an epic crossover key art poster, extremely high contrast, ominous, supernatural, and menacing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑电影质感的动漫反派海报，采用超精细的哥特恐怖风格，将四位标志性反派以戏剧性的拼贴形式呈现于废墟般的炼狱城市背景中。采用宽幅横向构图，配色以黑色、深红和电光紫为主，融入浓烟、灰烬、余烬、魔法闪电以及混乱的绘画感笔触。画面包含 4 位主要反派角色。中心前景是一位体型庞大的海贼皇帝，咧嘴大笑，留着狂野的黑色胡须，敞开红色船长外套，露出布满伤疤的胸膛和腹部，佩戴多层项链和腰带，腰间别着多把手枪，以胜利者的姿态向外举着两把燧发枪。其后方正上方是一位高大的粉色肌肉恶魔类人生物，头部光滑，长有一根卷曲的头触，双臂微张，周身环绕着紫色光环与闪电。左侧前景是一位长发飘飘、面色苍白的日本剑客，身着宽松的浅色长袍，微微低头，身后盘踞着一条张开大口的巨蛇；在该角色附近添加竖排日文文本“大蛇丸”，并在上方中心角色附近添加竖排文本“魔人ブウ”。右侧是一位高大优雅的魔王，身着层叠的深色和服，长发飘逸，姿态冷静而邪恶，头部上方环绕着 8 轮较小的暗红色月亮和 1 轮巨大的满月，共计 9 轮月亮；在海贼附近添加竖排日文文本“黒ひげ”，并在右侧角色附近添加竖排文本“鬼舞辻無惨”。背景应呈现出地狱般的末日景象，破碎的塔楼、燃烧的废墟以及隐没在烟雾中的阴影建筑。底部放置巨大的、极具侵略性的笔触风格标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="RISE OF VILLAINS"}，采用血红色搭配洋红色高光，边缘粗糙撕裂，并带有发光质感。整张图像应呈现出史诗级联动关键视觉海报的质感，对比度极高，充满不祥、超自然与威胁感。

templates.title: Dark Anime Legends Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑动漫传奇海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic dark-anime crossover poster titled {argument name="title text" default="DARK LEGENDS"}, showing 4 iconic male antihero figures standing in a ruined gothic nightmare city at night beneath an enormous blood-red full moon. The composition is a wide dramatic group shot with the characters lined up across the foreground, each facing a slightly different direction with confident, ominous body language. On the far left, 1 soldier-like young man with short dark hair wears a dark green hooded military cloak billowing in the wind, visible tactical harness straps and gear around his waist, and holds 2 steel blades pointed downward; a winged insignia is visible on the back of his cloak. In the center-left, 1 tall white-haired man with spiky hair wears a sleek high-collar black outfit and stands casually with one hand in his pocket, looking dominant and calm. In the center-right, 1 slim brown-haired young man in a wrinkled white button-up shirt holds 1 black notebook close to his chest with the visible cover text “Death Note,” posing with quiet intelligence. On the far right, 1 pale white-haired ghoul-like young man wears torn dark clothing; one glowing red eye is visible and monstrous red-black fleshy tendrils coil outward behind and beside him in 2 large swirling masses. The background is filled with towering ruined cathedral spires and shattered gothic skyscrapers, with many windows glowing crimson from within. The sky is stormy, cloud-choked, and nearly black, lit by the giant red moon centered high behind the group, creating a backlit halo effect and strong rim lighting. Use a dark palette of black, charcoal, deep crimson, and muted steel gray, with high contrast, gritty textures, subtle bloodlike embers, and a hyper-detailed illustrated anime style. Add distressed epic serif typography across the bottom spelling {argument name="headline text" default="DARK LEGENDS"} in huge cracked stone-like letters with red glow and weathered texture. The overall feeling is apocalyptic, stylish, menacing, and mythic, like a premium movie or game crossover key art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的暗黑动漫跨界海报，标题为 {argument name="title text" default="DARK LEGENDS"}，展示了 4 位标志性的男性反英雄角色，他们站在夜晚一座哥特式噩梦般的废墟城市中，头顶是一轮巨大的血红色满月。构图为宽幅的戏剧性群像，角色们在前景一字排开，每个人朝向略有不同，展现出自信且不祥的肢体语言。最左侧是一位留着深色短发的年轻士兵，身穿随风飘动的深绿色连帽军用斗篷，腰间可见战术背带和装备，手持两把向下指的钢刃；斗篷背面可见带翅膀的徽章。中左侧是一位身材高大的白发男子，留着尖刺状发型，身穿干练的高领黑色服装，单手插兜，神情从容且充满统治力。中右侧是一位身材苗条、棕色头发的年轻人，身穿褶皱的白色衬衫，将一本封面印有“Death Note”字样的黑色笔记本紧贴胸前，姿态展现出沉静的智慧。最右侧是一位脸色苍白的白发食尸鬼般的年轻人，身穿破损的深色服装；露出一只发光的红眼，身后和身侧盘绕着两团巨大的、怪异的红黑色肉质触须。背景中矗立着高耸的废墟大教堂尖顶和破碎的哥特式摩天大楼，许多窗户透出深红色的光芒。天空阴云密布，几乎全黑，被高悬在群体后方中央的巨大红月照亮，营造出背光光环效果和强烈的轮廓光。采用黑色、炭灰色、深绯红和柔和钢灰色的暗色调，具有高对比度、粗粝的质感、细微的血色余烬，以及超精细的插画动漫风格。在底部添加磨损的史诗衬线字体，拼写出 {argument name="headline text" default="DARK LEGENDS"}，字体呈现巨大的裂纹石质感，带有红色光晕和风化纹理。整体氛围呈现出末日感、时尚感、威胁感和神话感，如同高端电影或游戏跨界的主视觉图。

templates.title: Surreal Desert with Twin Celestial Spheres

titleLocalized.zh: 双星映照下的超现实沙漠

templates.prompt: A surreal sci-fi desert landscape at twilight or night, with a vast sandy plain covered in low drifting haze and surrounded by dark jagged rock formations. In the foreground, a rugged rocky ledge frames the lower left corner, with a steep cliff wall on the left and a smaller craggy outcrop on the right, while a distant mountain range sits low on the horizon. Above the horizon, centered in the sky, place 2 enormous overlapping celestial spheres: the rear sphere is a luminous blue-to-cyan gradient circle, and the front sphere is a slightly lower, partially eclipsing teal-green glowing sphere with a soft atmospheric fade on its lower half. The sky is deep black with very faint stars, creating a minimalist cosmic atmosphere. Use cinematic lighting with warm amber-brown tones across the desert and cool neon blues in the planets, soft mist, high contrast, ultra-clean digital rendering, sharp terrain detail, and a calm, otherworldly mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅黄昏或夜晚的超现实科幻沙漠景观，广阔的沙原上覆盖着低矮的漂浮薄雾，四周环绕着深色的锯齿状岩层。前景中，左下角由崎岖的岩石边缘构成框架，左侧为陡峭的悬崖壁，右侧为较小的嶙峋岩石，远处的山脉低垂在地平线上。在地平线上方的天空中央，放置 2 颗巨大的重叠天体：后方的球体是一个明亮的蓝至青色渐变圆环，前方的球体位置略低，是一个部分遮挡的青绿色发光球体，其下半部分带有柔和的大气晕染效果。天空为深黑色，点缀着微弱的星光，营造出极简主义的宇宙氛围。采用电影级光效，沙漠呈现温暖的琥珀棕色调，行星呈现冷峻的霓虹蓝色，配合柔和的薄雾、高对比度、超清数字渲染、锐利的地形细节，营造出一种宁静而超凡脱俗的意境。

templates.title: Hidden Engraved Rice Grain

titleLocalized.zh: 隐藏的刻字米粒

templates.prompt: A photorealistic close-up tabletop scene showing a large mound of uncooked long-grain white rice poured onto a warm brown wooden surface, filling almost the entire frame. The camera is slightly elevated and angled toward the pile so the rice forms a broad dome centered in the image, with thousands of individual grains sharply visible and softly lit by warm indoor lighting. Hide a tiny easter egg in the rice: exactly 1 unusual rice grain near the lower-left area is rotated horizontally and has the text "{argument name="engraved text" default="GPT Image 2"}" neatly engraved on its surface in small legible letters. Add a circular magnified callout in the bottom-left corner with a bright red outline, zooming in on that single engraved grain among surrounding rice grains so the text becomes readable. Also add exactly 1 small picture-in-picture inset in the bottom-right corner showing a casual indoor livestream or interview setting with 4 seated people around a round wooden table and an open laptop, warm ambient lighting, and faces slightly indistinct; the inset should feel like a secondary contextual thumbnail, much smaller than the main rice image. Prioritize realistic texture, convincing macro detail, natural shadows, subtle ivory color variation in the rice, and clear but believable engraved text on the highlighted grain.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的桌面特写场景，展示了一大堆倒在温暖棕色木质表面上的生白长粒米，几乎填满了整个画面。相机位置略高并朝向米堆倾斜，使米堆在画面中心形成一个宽阔的圆顶，数千粒米清晰可见，并被温暖的室内光线柔和地照亮。在米堆中隐藏一个小彩蛋：左下角区域附近有 1 粒特殊的米粒，它水平旋转，表面整齐地刻有“{argument name="engraved text" default="GPT Image 2"}”字样，字体清晰易读。在左下角添加一个带有亮红色轮廓的圆形放大标注，聚焦于那粒刻字米粒，使其文字清晰可见。此外，在右下角添加 1 个画中画小窗口，展示一个休闲的室内直播或访谈场景，4 个人围坐在圆木桌旁，桌上放着一台打开的笔记本电脑，环境光温暖，人物面部略显模糊；该小窗口应呈现为次要的背景缩略图，尺寸远小于主图。优先考虑逼真的纹理、令人信服的微距细节、自然的阴影、米粒细微的象牙色变化，以及高亮米粒上清晰且真实可信的刻字。

templates.title: Blurred Deer in Green Forest

titleLocalized.zh: 绿林中模糊的鹿

templates.prompt: A painterly wildlife photograph with strong intentional motion blur, showing 1 deer-like animal in a lush green forest clearing. The animal stands slightly left of center in side profile facing left, with a pale tan to cream body, slender legs, and a soft indistinct head and ears, partially emerging from a dark shadowy opening in dense foliage. The entire image is heavily smeared with diagonal and vertical camera motion, creating an impressionistic, dreamlike effect rather than sharp detail. Surround the subject with saturated summer greenery: deep emerald bushes in the background, darker forest shadows near the upper left, and bright vivid grass across the foreground. Use natural outdoor daylight, rich green tones, soft contrast, and an abstract photographic style that feels like a fleeting glimpse of wildlife captured while moving. No people, no text, no buildings, no extra animals.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有强烈主观动态模糊效果的写意野生动物摄影作品，展示了茂密绿色森林空地中的 1 只鹿类动物。动物呈侧面站立，位于中心偏左位置，面向左侧，身体呈浅棕色至奶油色，四肢纤细，头部和耳朵轮廓柔和模糊，从茂密枝叶的阴影空隙中隐约显现。整张图像呈现出强烈的对角线和垂直方向的相机动态模糊，营造出一种印象派的梦幻效果，而非锐利的细节。主体周围环绕着饱和的夏季绿植：背景是深翠绿色的灌木丛，左上方是深邃的森林阴影，前景则是明亮鲜艳的草地。采用自然户外日光，色调以浓郁的绿色为主，对比度柔和，呈现出一种抽象的摄影风格，仿佛在移动中捕捉到野生动物转瞬即逝的身影。画面中不包含人物、文字、建筑物或其他动物。

templates.title: Chinese Cursive Calligraphy Scroll

titleLocalized.zh: 中国草书书法卷轴

templates.prompt: A traditional Chinese ink calligraphy artwork on aged beige xuan paper, presented as a clean flat scan or photograph of a single hanging scroll page with no frame. The composition is entirely vertical Chinese cursive script, bold expressive grass-script brushwork in deep black ink with dynamic stroke variation, flying-white texture, dry-brush breaks, and elegant rhythm. Write the full poem {argument name="poem text" default="怒发冲冠，凭栏处、潇潇雨歇。抬望眼，仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切。\n靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子恨，何时灭！驾长车，踏破贺兰山缺。壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。待从头，收拾旧山河，朝天阙。"} in large vertical columns arranged right to left, about 8 main poem columns across the page, each column flowing freely with slight variations in spacing and tilt. Leave a wide left margin containing a smaller vertical inscription with 3 narrow columns: the title and attribution reading {argument name="inscription text" default="岳飞 满江红 甲辰書月 某元"}, written in a more restrained but still cursive hand. Add exactly 3 small red seal stamps: 2 stacked square seals in the lower-left margin beneath the inscription, and 1 small oval seal near the upper-right edge beside the first main column. The paper should have subtle warm tan mottling, soft fibers, faint age marks, and natural uneven tone. Overall mood is heroic, scholarly, and museum-quality, with authentic Song-inspired Chinese calligraphy aesthetics, minimal background, high detail, and faithful brush texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅传统的中国水墨书法艺术作品，呈现于陈年米色宣纸上，以干净的平扫图或单幅挂轴照片形式展示，无边框。构图为全竖版中国草书，深黑色墨迹展现出大胆且富有表现力的草书笔触，具有动态的笔画变化、飞白质感、枯笔断笔及优雅的韵律。请书写完整诗词 {argument name="poem text" default="怒发冲冠，凭栏处、潇潇雨歇。抬望眼，仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切。\n靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子恨，何时灭！驾长车，踏破贺兰山缺。壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。待从头，收拾旧山河，朝天阙。"}，采用从右向左排列的大字竖行，页面横跨约 8 列主要诗句，每行书写自由，间距与倾斜度略有变化。左侧留出宽阔的空白，包含 3 列较窄的竖排题跋：标题及落款为 {argument name="inscription text" default="岳飞 满江红 甲辰書月 某元"}，书写风格较收敛但仍保持草书笔意。添加 3 枚红色印章：左下角题跋下方叠放 2 枚方形印章，右上角首行诗句旁加盖 1 枚小型椭圆印章。纸张应带有细腻的暖棕色斑点、柔和的纤维纹理、淡淡的岁月痕迹及自然的色调不均。整体氛围庄重、文雅且具博物馆级品质，呈现出宋代风格的中国书法美学，背景简洁，细节丰富，笔触质感真实。

templates.title: Japanese Eel Derby Logo

titleLocalized.zh: 日本鳗鱼大赛 Logo

templates.prompt: Create a bold Japanese logo on a clean light gray background for a fictional racing-themed eel character brand. The main text should be large stylized katakana/kanji reading {argument name="main logo text" default="ウナ娘"}, with a smaller subtitle banner below reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="ヌルヌルダービー"}. Integrate exactly 2 eel illustrations into the lettering: one dark navy eel curling over the top left of the first character with a cute smiling face and pale belly markings, and one second eel forming a sweeping curl around the right side of the final character. Use a vivid aquatic palette with deep cobalt blue, electric blue, cyan, teal, white highlights, and metallic gold edging. The lettering should have thick white inner borders, gold outer trim, subtle drop shadows, and a glossy high-energy arcade mascot style. Add dynamic water splash effects around the bottom left and lower right, flowing wave ribbons beneath the text, exactly 6 gold star-shaped sparkles scattered around the logo, and exactly 4 small blue diamond-like sparkle accents near the center and top. Behind the subtitle, include a blue-and-white checkered racing flag pattern stretching horizontally. The overall composition should feel playful, premium, and fast-paced, combining marine motifs with horse-racing or derby energy, rendered as crisp vector-like logo art with polished gradients and strong sticker-style outlines.

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的浅灰色背景上创作一个大胆的日本风格 Logo，用于一个虚构的赛车主题鳗鱼角色品牌。主文字应为醒目的日文片假名/汉字，内容为 {argument name="main logo text" default="ウナ娘"}，下方配有一个较小的副标题横幅，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="ヌルヌルダービー"}。将 2 条鳗鱼插画精确融入文字中：第一条深海军蓝色的鳗鱼盘绕在第一个字符的左上方，带有可爱的笑脸和浅色腹部斑纹；第二条鳗鱼在最后一个字符的右侧形成一个大弧度的卷曲。使用鲜艳的水系配色，包括深钴蓝色、电光蓝、青色、蓝绿色、白色高光以及金属金色边缘。文字应带有厚实的白色内边框、金色外饰边、细腻的投影，并呈现出光泽感强、充满活力的街机吉祥物风格。在左下角和右下角添加动态水花特效，文字下方加入流动的波浪丝带，Logo 周围散布 6 个金色的星形闪光，并在中心和顶部附近添加 4 个小型蓝色钻石状闪光装饰。在副标题后方，加入水平延伸的蓝白方格赛车旗图案。整体构图应兼具趣味性、高级感与快节奏，将海洋元素与赛马或大赛的活力相结合，呈现出清晰的矢量风格 Logo 艺术效果，并带有精致的渐变和强烈的贴纸风格轮廓。

templates.title: Minimal SaaS Poster with Pink Mascot

titleLocalized.zh: 极简 SaaS 海报与粉色吉祥物

templates.prompt: A bold minimalist brand poster on a matte black background with a soft grainy print texture, designed like a startup landing-page hero graphic. In the top left, place a simple cream-colored logo icon followed by the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="Biscuit"} in a refined serif wordmark. Below it, create a large left-aligned typographic block occupying roughly the left half of the composition. The main headline reads: {argument name="headline text" default="Built for solopreneurs."} in oversized elegant cream serif type with strong contrast and generous line spacing. Directly beneath it, add a second headline line in vivid hot pink italic serif reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Backed by simplicity."}. Below that, add a smaller white sans-serif body copy block, left aligned, reading {argument name="body text" default="Everything you need to launch, run, and grow—all in one place."}. Near the bottom left, place the URL {argument name="website text" default="biscuit.so"} in bold hot pink sans-serif. On the right half, feature a cute abstract mascot: a rounded irregular cloud-like pink blob character with scalloped edges, 2 large cream-and-black circular eyes, 1 small curved smiling mouth, and 2 tiny rounded hands resting on top of a large curved pink foreground shape that rises from the bottom edge like a hill or product surface. Style: Black and white or slightly faded monochrome paper Fine paper texture, grain, and ink defects Small shadows and creases that mimic real printed paper The aesthetics of a clean but slightly worn vintage newspaper Mood: Give the design personality, expressiveness and plot, as if the plot is part of the main article. templates.prompt:
Create a cinematic commercial storyboard sheet.

LAYOUT:
- Fixed 6-panel grid (2x3), evenly spaced
- Clean white or neutral background
- Each panel clearly separated, no UI, no clutter

GLOBAL STYLE:
- Cinematic realism, high-end commercial look
- Soft controlled lighting, consistent across all panels
- No character or environment drift

STORY ARC (strict order):
1. Setup
2. Tension
3. Product reveal
4. Product interaction
5. Transformation (impact)
6. Clean closing shot

SCENE CONCEPT:
{argument name="story concept" default="A woman lives in a quiet apartment with a tense, unpredictable tiger. The tiger behaves like a domestic cat but carries constant danger. When she serves the product (cat food), the tiger visibly relaxes and transforms into a calm domestic house cat."}

PANEL REQUIREMENTS (for EACH panel include):
- Cinematic frame (clear composition, subject readable)
- Shot / Action (focused on character + product when applicable)
- Camera (shot type, angle, movement)

PRODUCT RULES:
- Product must be sharp, readable, and well-lit in panels 3, 4, 6
- No distortion, no redesign
- Packaging must remain consistent

VISUAL PRIORITIES:
- Strong contrast between tension (tiger) and relief (cat)
- Clear readability in every frame
- No abstract or surreal distortion, grounded realism

TEXT:
- Minimal, small, professional labels only (panel number + short shot note)
- No extra graphics

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个电影级商业分镜表。

布局：
- 固定 6 格网格 (2x3)，间距均匀
- 干净的白色或中性背景
- 每个面板清晰分隔，无 UI，无杂乱元素

全局风格：
- 电影级写实感，高端商业视觉效果
- 柔和且受控的灯光，在所有面板中保持一致
- 角色或环境无偏移

故事弧线（严格顺序）：
1. 铺垫
2. 紧张感
3. 产品展示
4. 产品互动
5. 转变（影响）
6. 简洁的收尾镜头

场景概念：
{argument name="story concept" default="一位女性住在一个安静的公寓里，身边有一只紧张且难以预测的老虎。老虎表现得像家猫，但时刻带有危险气息。当她奉上产品（猫粮）时，老虎明显放松下来，并转变为一只平静的家猫。"}

面板要求（每个面板需包含）：
- 电影级画面（构图清晰，主体易读）
- 镜头 / 动作（聚焦于角色 + 产品，如适用）
- 摄影（镜头类型、角度、运动）

产品规则：
- 产品在第 3、4、6 面板中必须清晰、易读且光照充足
- 无畸变，无重新设计
- 包装必须保持一致

视觉优先级：
- 紧张感（老虎）与放松感（猫）之间的强烈对比
- 每一帧都具备清晰的易读性
- 无抽象或超现实的扭曲，基于现实主义

文字：
- 极简，仅使用小型专业标签（面板编号 + 简短镜头备注）
- 无额外图形

templates.title: Minimalist Film Noir Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 极简主义黑色电影海报

templates.prompt:
Subject & Composition:

Central Figure: A {argument name="subject profile" default="sharp profile view of a man wearing a classic 1940s fedora and a formal suit"}.

Melting Effect: The lower half of the man's torso should dissolve or "drip" into long, vertical black ink streaks and splatters, creating a surreal, liquid-bleed effect against the background.

Graphic Element: A large, {argument name="background shape" default="solid vibrant red circle"} is positioned directly behind the man's head and shoulders, creating a "halo" or "rising sun" motif that anchors the composition.

Style & Color Palette:

Color Scheme: A strict {argument name="color scheme" default="minimalist palette of True Red, Deep Black, and Off-White/Cream"}.

Photography Style: High-contrast, black and white film noir photography for the subject. The texture should look like a high-resolution fashion editorial with a shallow depth of field.

Background: A clean, slightly textured off-white paper or canvas background to give it a premium, physical poster feel.

Technical Details:

Lighting: Strong "Rembrandt" lighting to define the facial contours, emphasizing the bridge of the nose and the jawline with deep shadows.

Atmosphere: Somber, intellectual, and high-stakes. The design should feel modern yet period-accurate to the mid-20th century.

Framing: Vertical poster orientation (A-frame), with significant negative space on the left and right to emphasize the central vertical axis.

Aspect ratio is 9:16

promptLocalized.zh:
主体与构图：

中心人物：{argument name="subject profile" default="一名戴着 1940 年代经典软呢帽、身穿正装的男子的侧脸轮廓"}。

融化效果：男子躯干的下半部分应溶解或“滴落”成细长的垂直黑色墨迹与飞溅效果，在背景上形成超现实的液体渗漏感。

图形元素：一个巨大的 {argument name="background shape" default="纯色鲜红圆圈"} 位于男子头部和肩部正后方，形成类似“光环”或“旭日”的图案，作为构图的视觉锚点。

风格与配色：

配色方案：严格遵循 {argument name="color scheme" default="由正红色、深黑色和米白色/奶油色组成的极简配色"}。

摄影风格：主体采用高对比度的黑白黑色电影摄影风格。质感应呈现出高分辨率时尚大片的观感，并带有浅景深效果。

背景：干净且带有轻微纹理的米白色纸张或画布背景，赋予其高级的实体海报质感。

技术细节：

光影：强烈的“伦勃朗”布光以勾勒面部轮廓，通过深邃的阴影强调鼻梁和下颌线。

氛围：忧郁、知性且充满悬疑感。设计既要现代，又要符合 20 世纪中叶的时代特征。

构图：垂直海报方向（A 型），左右两侧留有大量的负空间，以突出中心垂直轴线。

纵横比为 9:16

templates.title: Pizza Food Photography and Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 披萨美食摄影与信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
A high-end food product photograph of a loaded pizza slice centered against a warm rustic wooden-toned background. The slice features a thick golden crust with a crispy edge, stretchy melted mozzarella cheese with visible pull strands, rich tomato sauce underneath, and toppings including pepperoni slices, black olives, capsicum, and herbs. The textures are highly detailed with glossy melted cheese, slightly oily toppings, and realistic baked crust texture. Soft cinematic lighting creates depth and subtle shadows. Ultra-sharp focus, premium food advertisement style, hyper realistic, 8K.

Create a hyper-realistic exploded vertical infographic composition of a gourmet pizza slice.
Top → Bottom structure:
Melted Cheese Layer (stretchy, glossy mozzarella with pull texture)
→ Toppings Layer (pepperoni, olives, capsicum with natural detail)
→ Herb Seasoning (oregano flakes and spice particles lightly scattered)
→ Tomato Sauce Layer (rich red smooth sauce with slight gloss)
→ Dough Crust Base (thick baked crust with crispy edge texture)
All layers must be perfectly centered, evenly spaced, and aligned vertically. Use a warm rustic background with soft studio lighting and realistic shadows beneath each floating layer. The composition should feel like a premium food campaign combined with a clean infographic layout.
Add clean infographic labels with thin pointer lines using these exact labels:
“Cheese”
“Toppings”
“Seasoning”
“Sauce”
“Crust”

Ultra-detailed food texture, DSLR macro quality, hyper realistic, premium advertisement aesthetic, 8K.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张高端食品摄影作品，主角是一块披萨切片，置于温暖的乡村风木质背景中央。披萨边缘金黄酥脆，马苏里拉芝士融化并带有明显的拉丝效果，底部铺满浓郁的番茄酱，配料包括意大利辣香肠、黑橄榄、青椒和香草。画面细节丰富，呈现出芝士的光泽感、配料的油润感以及逼真的烘焙饼底质感。柔和的电影级光效营造出深度与细腻的阴影。超高清对焦，高级食品广告风格，超写实，8K 分辨率。

创作一张超写实的垂直拆解式美食披萨切片信息图。
从上至下的结构：
融化芝士层（带有拉丝质感的亮面马苏里拉芝士）
→ 配料层（带有自然细节的意大利辣香肠、橄榄、青椒）
→ 香草调味层（轻微散落的牛至叶碎和香料颗粒）
→ 番茄酱层（色泽浓郁且带有微光的顺滑酱料）
→ 饼底层（边缘酥脆的厚实烘焙饼底）
所有图层必须完美居中、间距均匀且垂直对齐。使用温暖的乡村风背景，配合柔和的摄影棚灯光，并在每个悬浮层下方添加逼真的阴影。整体构图应兼具高级食品广告的质感与简洁的信息图布局。
使用细指示线添加简洁的信息图标签，标签内容如下：
“Cheese”（芝士）
“Toppings”（配料）
“Seasoning”（调味）
“Sauce”（酱料）
“Crust”（饼底）

超精细食品纹理，DSLR 微距画质，超写实，高级广告美学，8K 分辨率。

templates.title: Tropical Product Photography
