templates.prompt: A professional product photography shot of a {argument name="product" default="cold sparkling water can"} placed upright in {argument name="setting" default="golden beach sand"}. The can is {argument name="branding colors" default="silver and teal"}, covered in realistic water droplets condensation, with a pineapple illustration and tropical branding. The can is slightly tilted, planted in a small mound of fine golden sand with tiny white pebbles and small green tropical leaves/grass scattered around the base. Background features a bold split composition - bright sky-blue on the left and vivid yellow on the right, with a large blurred real pineapple placed behind the can on the right side. Lighting is bright, vibrant, commercial studio lighting with clean shadows. Shallow depth of field - can in sharp focus, background softly blurred. Mood: summer, tropical, fresh, refreshing. Commercial product photography, ultra-detailed, 8K.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张专业的商业产品摄影照片，主体为 {argument name="product" default="冰镇气泡水罐"}，垂直放置在 {argument name="setting" default="金色沙滩"} 上。罐身为 {argument name="branding colors" default="银色与青色"}，表面覆盖着逼真的冷凝水珠，印有菠萝插画和热带风格的品牌标识。罐身略微倾斜，插在细软的金色沙堆中，底座周围散落着细小的白色鹅卵石和绿色热带叶片/草丛。背景采用大胆的分割构图——左侧为明亮的天蓝色，右侧为鲜艳的黄色，右后方放置着一个模糊处理的真实菠萝。左上角垂下一片模糊的热带棕榈叶，增加了画面的深度与框架感。罐体表面可见微距级别的冷凝水珠。光线采用明亮、鲜艳的商业摄影棚布光，阴影干净利落。浅景深效果——罐身焦点清晰，背景柔和虚化。氛围：夏季、热带、清新、提神。商业产品摄影，超高细节，8K 分辨率。

templates.prompt:
{argument name="grid layout" default="12-panel grid (4x3)"}, each panel is an independent FULL equirectangular 360° panorama of the SAME continuous {argument name="environment" default="forest world"}

each panel = complete spherical environment (360° horizontal, 180° vertical)
true equirectangular projection with natural distortion:
stretched edges, curved horizon, vertical compression toward zenith and nadir

STRICT global consistency across panels:
same forest biome, same architectural language, same materials, same lighting logic, same scale, same color palette, no visual drift

cinematic photorealism, live-action quality, physically accurate rendering
natural light behavior, realistic exposure, subtle lens response, filmic dynamic range

ultra-detailed environment, grounded material response (wood, moss, fabric, stone), believable imperfections, micro-detail variation

massive forest environment with large-scale vertical structures integrated into trees
multi-layered platforms, bridges, embedded interiors, organic construction logic

lighting:
motivated light sources only (lanterns, windows, bioluminescence)
soft volumetric fog interacting with light beams
physically correct falloff, no overglow, no artificial bloom
balanced contrast, filmic highlights, deep but readable shadows

atmosphere:
dense air perspective, layered depth, subtle particle presence
natural haze, humidity, soft diffusion

CAMERA (IMPORTANT):
each panel = fixed central capture point of a spherical camera
true 360° capture, no framing, no composition bias, no cropped view
but with subtle real-world camera characteristics:
slight lens softness toward edges, mild exposure adaptation, natural highlight rolloff

each panel represents a different location within the SAME world:
canopy height, mid-bridge level, interior spaces, vertical clearings, forest floor transitions
continuous spatial logic between panels

viewer always positioned at the center of the environment

environment fully resolved in ALL directions:
above (canopy, sky gaps, light sources) and below (structures, roots, depth layers)

COLOR:
{argument name="color scheme" default="deep indigo night base, warm amber practical lights, restrained violet accents"}
cinematic color grading, natural color separation, no oversaturation

STYLE:
cinematic spherical realism, VR-ready environment, physically coherent world
high-end film production quality, not stylized, not game-like

no labels, no text, no numbers

{argument name="grid layout" default="12 面网格 (4x3)"}，每个面板都是同一个连续 {argument name="environment" default="森林世界"} 的独立完整等距柱状 360° 全景图

超精细环境，扎实的材质响应（木材、苔藓、织物、石材），真实的瑕疵，微观细节变化

大型森林环境，将大规模垂直结构融入树木中
多层平台、桥梁、嵌入式室内空间、有机建筑逻辑

光照：
仅限自然光源（灯笼、窗户、生物发光）
柔和的体积雾与光束相互作用
物理正确的衰减，无过度光晕，无人工泛光
平衡的对比度，电影级高光，深邃但清晰的阴影

氛围：
浓厚的空气透视，分层深度，微妙的粒子感
自然雾霾、湿度、柔和漫射

相机（重要）：
每个面板 = 球形相机的固定中心捕捉点
真实的 360° 捕捉，无构图，无视角偏差，无裁剪视图
但具有微妙的现实世界相机特性：
边缘轻微的镜头柔化，温和的曝光适应，自然的高光衰减

每个面板代表同一个世界内的不同位置：
树冠高度、桥梁中层、室内空间、垂直林间空地、森林地面过渡
面板之间具有连续的空间逻辑

观察者始终位于环境中心

环境在所有方向上完全呈现：
上方（树冠、天空缝隙、光源）和下方（结构、根系、深度层）

色彩：
{argument name="color scheme" default="深靛蓝夜色基调，温暖的琥珀色实用灯光，克制的紫罗兰色点缀"}
电影级调色，自然的色彩分离，无过度饱和

高端电影制作质量，非风格化，非游戏感

无标签，无文字，无数字

templates.prompt: Create a 4:5 high-contrast, black-and-white studio portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="handsome man"} in the uploaded image. He is seated in a slumped, pensive posture on a {argument name="furniture" default="minimalist dark wooden chair"}. His right elbow rests on his knee, with his head leaning heavily into his palm, while his left hand loosely grips a white disposable coffee cup with a black plastic lid. He is wearing classic black Wayfarer-style sunglasses, hiding his eyes and adding to the stoic, moody atmosphere.Suit: An oversized, structured black blazer and matching wide-leg trousers. The fabric is a heavy, matte wool. Four small black buttons are visible on the sleeve cuff. Footwear: Crisp, bright white ribbed cotton socks creating a sharp visual break between the dark trousers and shoes. Shoes: Highly polished black leather Oxford shoes with thin laces and a slight sheen on the toe box. Background: A minimalist, sterile studio setting with a {argument name="background" default="light grey or off-white textured plaster wall"}. A soft, vertical shadow or curtain edge is visible on the far left. Lighting: Soft, diffused side-lighting that creates gentle gradients on the man's face and deep, dramatic folds in the oversized suit. The lighting emphasizes the high-contrast "black on white" aesthetic. Floor: A light, seamless studio floor that catches the soft shadows cast by the chair legs and the man's shoes. Color Grade: Pure monochrome (black and white) with a wide dynamic range—deep blacks and bright, clean whites. Film Quality: Sharp focus on the subject with a very subtle film grain, mimicking professional editorial fashion photography (reminiscent of 1990s minimalist campaigns).

promptLocalized.zh: 为上传图片中的 {argument name="subject" default="帅气的男士"} 创建一张 4:5 的高对比度黑白影棚肖像。他以一种颓废、沉思的姿态坐在 {argument name="furniture" default="极简主义深色木椅"} 上。他的右肘靠在膝盖上，头部沉重地倚在手掌中，左手松松地握着一个带有黑色塑料盖的白色一次性咖啡杯。他戴着经典的 Wayfarer 风格黑色太阳镜，遮住了双眼，增添了冷峻、忧郁的氛围。西装：一件超大廓形的黑色结构感西装外套，搭配同款阔腿裤。面料为厚实的哑光羊毛。袖口可见四颗小黑扣。袜饰：清爽、亮白色的罗纹棉袜，在深色裤子和鞋子之间形成鲜明的视觉分割。鞋履：高度抛光的黑色牛津皮鞋，配有细鞋带，鞋头带有轻微光泽。背景：极简主义、干净的影棚环境，背景为 {argument name="background" default="浅灰色或灰白色纹理灰泥墙"}。最左侧可见柔和的垂直阴影或窗帘边缘。光影：柔和的侧向漫射光，在男士面部形成细腻的渐变，并在超大西装上投下深邃、戏剧性的褶皱。光影强调了“黑白分明”的高对比度美学。地面：浅色无缝影棚地面，映衬出椅子腿和男士鞋子投下的柔和阴影。色调：纯单色（黑白），具有宽广的动态范围——深邃的黑色和明亮、纯净的白色。胶片质感：主体对焦清晰，带有非常细腻的胶片颗粒感，模仿专业的时尚编辑摄影（让人联想到 20 世纪 90 年代的极简主义广告大片）。

templates.title: Luxury Skincare Brand Key Visual (KV)

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华护肤品牌主视觉 (KV)

templates.prompt: Minimalist Eastern luxury advertising style, high-end skincare brand KV poster, brand name "BRAND", overall vibe is pure, restrained, combining technology with Eastern aesthetics. The center of the screen is a high-end essence product, glass bottle, transparent gradient texture (transparent top → cold cyan-green bottom), with liquid light at the bottom, paired with a champagne gold metal cap. The product is placed on a circular high-light base made of polished stone and metal. Details are exquisite and clear, serving as the absolute visual center. The product is surrounded by delicate golden energy halos and flowing light ribbons, forming a slight S-shaped movement, symbolizing repair and regeneration energy, with light diffusing outwards to strengthen "efficacy visualization". An Eastern woman is positioned in the background slightly to the right, looking back with a side profile, calm and elegant temperament, delicate natural features, cold white skin with a transparent glow (emphasizing skincare effects), low-saturation orange-pink makeup with faint golden highlights. Black long hair flows with the wind, hair strands integrated with golden light particles and weak light ribbons, overall clean and restrained without over-decoration, echoing the product's light effect. Wearing translucent silk clothing and a shawl, light and flowing, the material is transparent with fine gold-gilded textures and soft reflections, presenting a high-end texture. The lighting system is a clean warm-gold main light source (side-rear), the product is the focus, the person is auxiliary light, edge light is soft, volume light exists slightly, fine golden light particles float in the air, overall light is clear and not overexposed. Background is a minimalist light gradient (off-white + warm gold transition), large areas of negative space, the screen is clean without impurities, providing space for advertising layout. Cold-tone cyan-green water or mineral texture elements are added below (symbolizing pure technology and component sources), enhancing the brand's "pure technology feel". Strictly controlled color system: main colors are gold + off-white, accented with cold cyan-green and champagne gold, overall low-saturation high-end tones. Composition is stable center composition + slight S-curve, clear visual focus and hierarchy (Product > Light > Character). Overall style: high-end, pure, repair and regeneration, anti-aging technology, international big-brand skincare advertising quality (similar to La Mer / SK-II level). Ultra-fine, 8K texture, commercial photography-grade lighting, realistic material expression. Negative: product deformation, text errors, too much decoration, crowded screen, cheap gold, chaotic lighting, overexposure, low resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 极简东方奢华广告风格，高端护肤品牌 KV 海报，品牌名称为 "BRAND"，整体氛围纯净、克制，将科技感与东方美学相结合。画面中心为一款高端精华产品，玻璃瓶身，呈现透明渐变质感（顶部透明 → 底部冷青绿色），底部带有液体光泽，搭配香槟金金属瓶盖。产品放置在由抛光石材和金属制成的圆形高光底座上。细节精致清晰，作为绝对的视觉中心。产品周围环绕着细腻的金色能量光环和流动的光带，形成轻微的 S 型动势，象征修复与再生能量，光线向外扩散以强化“功效可视化”。背景右侧略微靠后处有一位东方女性，侧身回眸，气质沉稳优雅，五官精致自然，冷白皮透出通透光泽（强调护肤效果），低饱和度橘粉色妆容点缀淡淡金色高光。黑色长发随风飘动，发丝间融入金色光点与微弱光带，整体干净克制，不过度装饰，与产品光效呼应。身着半透明丝绸服饰与披肩，轻盈飘逸，材质通透且带有精细的金箔纹理与柔和反光，呈现出高级质感。灯光系统采用干净的暖金色主光源（侧后方），产品为焦点，人物为辅助光，边缘光柔和，存在微弱的体积光，空气中漂浮着细小的金色光粒，整体光感清晰且不过曝。背景为极简光影渐变（米白色 + 暖金色过渡），大面积留白，画面干净无杂质，为广告排版留出空间。底部加入冷色调青绿色水纹或矿物质感元素（象征纯净科技与成分来源），增强品牌的“纯净科技感”。严格控制色彩体系：主色为金色 + 米白色，点缀冷青绿色与香槟金，整体为低饱和度高级色调。构图采用稳定的中心构图 + 轻微 S 型曲线，视觉焦点与层级清晰（产品 > 光影 > 人物）。整体风格：高端、纯净、修复再生、抗衰老科技，国际大牌护肤品广告质感（类似 La Mer / SK-II 级别）。超精细，8K 纹理，商业摄影级布光，写实材质表现。负面提示词：产品变形、文字错误、装饰过多、画面拥挤、廉价金、灯光混乱、过曝、低分辨率。

templates.title: Japanese Realist Romance Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式现实主义爱情电影海报

templates.prompt: Japanese realistic romance movie poster style, inspired by 'We Made a Beautiful Bouquet', a pair of young Japanese couple in their twenties standing in a daily urban scene (street or intersection), maintaining a subtle and realistic distance from each other, no physical contact, like a moment of gradual estrangement in a relationship. The mood is quiet and restrained, with unuttered emotions and a sense of time passing. The composition is the main visual of a movie, characters located at the bottom or to one side, retaining a large area of white space to emphasize space and atmosphere. Light is natural (overcast or dusk), low-saturation gray-blue, beige, and warm gray tones, realistic photography texture. The image has fine film grain and a slight sense of daily life, not intentionally aesthetic, not over-decorated, like a frame from a real movie. A small amount of natural floral materials can be added at the edges or foreground as a metaphor (restrained, not excessive, not decorative). Add the title '花束みたいな恋をした' in the white space area, thin Mincho font, simple and sparse layout; add 'We Made a Beautiful Bouquet' in a smaller font size below. Overall requirements: Real Japanese movie poster texture, artistic, restrained, everyday life, emphasizing relationships over romantic symbols, avoiding sugary romance, avoiding flower piles, avoiding internet celebrity aesthetics, avoiding crowded compositions, avoiding the 'exquisite but hollow' AI feel. Negative prompt: AI feel, over-aesthetic, sea of flowers, romantic filters, excessive lighting effects, high saturation, neon lights, intimate couple embrace, posed feel, photobooth composition, internet celebrity style, illustration feel, 3D rendering, cluttered elements. Japanese minimalist artistic movie poster style, inspired by 'Love Letter', winter snow scene, a close-up of a young woman's face, face close to or semi-buried in the snow, tiny snowflakes falling naturally. The composition is a restrained close-up side profile or slightly tilted face, with the person occupying a large proportion of the screen but not overly sharp, edges slightly softened or slightly out of focus. Expression is calmness after sadness, with tears or tear marks in the eyes, emotions introverted and restrained, like having just cried and slowly returning to silence, eyes not looking at the camera, with a sense of memory and void. Light is winter natural scattered light or overcast soft light, cool white, light gray, pale blue tones, low saturation, low contrast, no strong shadows, no dramatic lighting effects. The snow and air form a clean background. The image texture is between real photography and film, with fine grain, slight mist, slightly white or slightly overexposed, like an old photo faded by time or a movie still. Skin not overly detailed, no skin smoothing, no sharpening, no retouching. Asymmetric composition, face can be partially cropped, minimalist background, retaining appropriate white space. Add the minimalist title 'Love Letter' or 'ラヴレター' in the white space area, thin Mincho or thin serif font, wide character spacing, sparse layout, color light gray; add 'Love Letter' in a tiny font size below. Overall requirements: Real Japanese artistic movie poster texture, quiet, subtle, restrained, like a memory covered by snow, avoiding photo studio feel, avoiding internet celebrity aesthetics, avoiding refined filters, avoiding lighting effects, avoiding high contrast and high saturation, avoiding sharp digital feel, avoiding theatrical emotions, avoiding 'pretty but hollow'. Negative prompt: AI feel, skin smoothing, sharpening, HDR, high contrast, high saturation, dreamy light effects, lens flare, filter feel, photo studio style, internet celebrity face, posing, looking directly at the camera, exaggerated emotions, 3D rendering, illustration style, complex background.

promptLocalized.zh: 日式现实主义爱情电影海报风格，灵感源自《花束般的恋爱》，一对二十多岁的日本年轻情侣站在日常城市场景（街道或十字路口）中，保持着微妙且真实的距离感，没有肢体接触，仿佛关系中逐渐疏离的瞬间。氛围安静而克制，蕴含着未说出口的情绪与时光流逝之感。构图为电影主视觉，人物位于底部或一侧，保留大面积留白以强调空间与氛围。光线为自然光（阴天或黄昏），低饱和度的灰蓝色、米色和暖灰色调，具有真实的摄影质感。画面带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和轻微的生活气息，不刻意追求美感，不过度装饰，如同真实电影中的一帧。边缘或前景可添加少量自然花材作为隐喻（克制，不过分，非装饰性）。在留白区域添加标题“花束みたいな恋をした”，使用细明体，排版简洁稀疏；下方以较小字号添加“We Made a Beautiful Bouquet”。整体要求：真实的日式电影海报质感，艺术化，克制，日常感，强调人物关系而非浪漫符号，避免甜腻的浪漫，避免花海堆砌，避免网红审美，避免拥挤的构图，避免“精致但空洞”的 AI 感。负面提示词：AI 感，过度美化，花海，浪漫滤镜，过度的灯光效果，高饱和度，霓虹灯，亲密拥抱，摆拍感，大头贴构图，网红风格，插画感，3D 渲染，杂乱元素。日式极简艺术电影海报风格，灵感源自《情书》，冬季雪景，年轻女性面部的特写，脸部靠近或半埋在雪中，细小的雪花自然飘落。构图为克制的侧脸特写或微倾斜的脸部，人物占据画面较大比例但不过分锐利，边缘略微柔化或轻微失焦。表情是悲伤过后的平静，眼中含泪或有泪痕，情绪内敛克制，仿佛刚哭过并慢慢回归寂静，眼睛不看镜头，带有记忆与虚无感。光线为冬季自然散射光或阴天柔光，冷白色、浅灰色、淡蓝色调，低饱和度，低对比度，无强阴影，无戏剧性灯光效果。雪与空气构成干净的背景。图像质感介于真实摄影与胶片之间，带有细颗粒、轻微雾感，略微发白或轻微过曝，如同被时间褪色的旧照片或电影剧照。皮肤不过分细节化，无磨皮，无锐化，无修图。非对称构图，脸部可部分裁切，极简背景，保留适当留白。在留白区域添加极简标题“Love Letter”或“ラヴレター”，使用细明体或细衬线体，宽字间距，稀疏排版，颜色为浅灰色；下方以极小字号添加“Love Letter”。整体要求：真实的日式艺术电影海报质感，安静，微妙，克制，如同被雪覆盖的记忆，避免影楼感，避免网红审美，避免精致滤镜，避免灯光特效，避免高对比度和高饱和度，避免锐利的数码感，避免戏剧化的情绪，避免“漂亮但空洞”。负面提示词：AI 感，磨皮，锐化，HDR，高对比度，高饱和度，梦幻光效，镜头光晕，滤镜感，影楼风格，网红脸，摆拍，直视镜头，夸张情绪，3D 渲染，插画风格，复杂背景。

templates.title: Epic Narrative Silhouette Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗叙事剪影电影海报

templates.prompt: Automatically generate a collector's edition epic narrative poster based on {argument name="theme" default="Dream of the Red Chamber"}. Use a giant, elegant silhouette of {argument name="character" default="Lin Daiyu"}'s profile as the outer outline. Inside the silhouette, let the complete world-building, iconic scenes, character relationships, symbolic icons, key architecture, creatures, props, and atmosphere most relevant to the theme grow naturally. This is not a simple collage but a high-end silhouette-filling narrative synthesis with double-exposure associations, enhanced for cinematic narrative expression and spatial choreography. A fusion of movie poster style and Eastern realist aesthetics, emphasizing realistic physical light and shadow, camera language, spatial depth, and narrative hierarchy. Lighting uses cinematic rim lighting with local warm accents, with restrained and realistic cool-warm contrast, adding volumetric light and light mist to enhance the sense of space. Textures should be realistic (architecture, silk, skin, stone), avoiding pure painterly strokes, retaining soft atmospheric perspective but optimized for cinematic depth of field and focus control. Fine film grain, with edge brushstrokes modified into soft cinematic transitions, large areas of negative space, and a refined, high-end layout. Quiet, grand, restrained, and infused with a strong sense of fatalism typical of Eastern cinematic storytelling. All elements must be strongly bound to the theme for instant recognition, avoiding clutter, hard collages, templated backgrounds, or cheap fantasy assets.

promptLocalized.zh: 自动生成一张基于 {argument name="theme" default="红楼梦"} 的典藏版史诗叙事海报。使用 {argument name="character" default="林黛玉"} 优雅的侧面剪影作为外轮廓。在剪影内部，自然地融入与主题最相关的完整世界观、标志性场景、人物关系、象征符号、关键建筑、生物、道具及氛围。这并非简单的拼贴，而是一种结合双重曝光联想的高端剪影填充叙事合成，旨在强化电影叙事表达与空间编排。融合电影海报风格与东方写实美学，强调真实的物理光影、镜头语言、空间深度及叙事层级。灯光采用电影级轮廓光并辅以局部暖色调，保持克制且真实的冷暖对比，增加体积光与轻雾以增强空间感。纹理需具备真实感（建筑、丝绸、皮肤、石材），避免纯绘画笔触，保留柔和的大气透视，并针对电影级景深与焦点控制进行优化。画面带有细腻的胶片颗粒感，边缘笔触处理为柔和的电影化过渡，留有大面积负空间，布局精致高端。整体风格静谧、宏大、克制，蕴含东方电影叙事中典型的宿命感。所有元素必须与主题紧密结合以实现即时识别，避免杂乱、生硬拼贴、模板化背景或廉价的奇幻素材。

The visual style should use bold and experimental brand language, including: high-saturation bright colors, simple geometric shapes, modern typography, dynamic visual rhythm, and slightly surreal image expression. The overall atmosphere should convey: creativity, youthfulness, rhythm, tactile experience, and conceptual avant-garde. The expression needs to integrate the fun of consumer products, the presentation of fashion brands, and the language of contemporary digital design. The brand manual should reflect: extreme focus on product details, diverse visual experimentation, packaging design exploration, editorial style photography, immersive retail experience, and cross-platform brand application. The final presentation should construct a confident, contemporary, unified, and complete brand worldview—both easy to understand and approachable, yet possessing a strong sense of art direction, maintaining high visual consistency while showcasing aesthetic standards at a high-end creative studio level.

promptLocalized.zh: 为名为“{argument name="brand name" default="Any Brand Name"}”的公司创建一份精致的多页品牌视觉手册。整体品牌形象应具有趣味性、未来感、活力且经过精心设计，在“玩具般的活力”与“高端创意科技品牌的精致感”之间取得平衡。视觉风格应采用大胆且实验性的品牌语言，包括：高饱和度的明亮色彩、简洁的几何形状、现代排版、动态视觉节奏以及略带超现实的图像表达。整体氛围应传达出：创造力、年轻化、节奏感、触感体验以及概念前卫感。表达方式需要融合消费品的趣味性、时尚品牌的呈现方式以及当代数字设计的语言。品牌手册应体现：对产品细节的极致关注、多元化的视觉实验、包装设计探索、编辑风格摄影、沉浸式零售体验以及跨平台品牌应用。最终呈现应构建出一个自信、当代、统一且完整的品牌世界观——既易于理解且平易近人，又具备强烈的艺术指导感，在保持高度视觉一致性的同时，展现出高端创意工作室级别的审美标准。

templates.title: Professional Brand Packaging System

titleLocalized.zh: 专业品牌包装系统

templates.prompt:
Please create a high-aesthetic, high-completion "Brand Packaging System Display Image" for the brand {argument name="brand name" default="Brand Name"} in the category {argument name="category" default="Product Category"}. This is not a common e-commerce white background shot, nor a single product photo, but a brand proposal-style display showing a 'packaging family' with visual identity system logic and commercial photography texture. The image should reflect the 'unified implementation of a single brand across multiple packaging carriers,' presenting a complete packaging system for a mature consumer brand.

[Aspect Ratio Requirements] The overall composition must be a fixed 4:5 vertical poster. Horizontal compositions or scattered arrangements are prohibited. The layout should follow poster reading logic: breathing space at the top, the main visual focus of the packaging system in the center, and auxiliary packaging, labels, and products at the bottom. The weight should be concentrated and suitable for immediate release as a brand display poster.

[Core Requirements] Automatically match the most reasonable packaging combination based on the [Category] and build a unified visual system around the [Brand Name]. Choose a small but representative number of packaging forms to form a refined system. Prioritize hierarchy, brand unity, and display beauty over quantity. You can include: shopping bags, gift boxes, shipping boxes, long boxes, single item boxes, pouches, sleeves, sample bags, bottles, jars, tubes, spray bottles, pump bottles, labels, stickers, tags, cards, and the actual product itself.

[Category Adaptation] Adapt packaging forms to the [Category]: e.g., paper bags and food containers for Bakery; cups and sleeves for Coffee/Tea; jars and tubes for Beauty/Skincare; candles and cards for Fragrance/Lifestyle; drawer boxes and tags for Fashion/Collectibles. The result must feel category-appropriate and systematic.

[Quantity Control] Control the number of items; do not overcrowd. The scene should be "less is more." Suggest: 1-2 large items, 2-3 medium items, 2-4 small items/labels, and 1-3 actual products. Total visible elements should be between 6-10. Ensure enough white space and clear hierarchy.

[Visual System] All packaging must belong to the same brand system, using the [Brand Name] as the core element. Maintain consistent logo placement, font style, graphics, illustration/pattern systems, and material texture. The style can be minimalist, organic, modern, luxury, or youthful, but must be mature and high-quality.

[Color Mechanism] Avoid fixed combinations. Generate different schemes like Cream White/Caramel Brown, Mist Blue/Warm White, Olive Green/Linen Beige, Chocolate Brown/Ivory, etc. Avoid neon or cheap high-saturation colors. Maintain a sense of high-end restraint.

[Composition] Use a commercial studio setting with a 3/4 top-down or slight perspective view. Arrange in layers: large items in the background, core packaging in the mid-ground, and small items/products in the foreground. At least one product should interact with its packaging (e.g., half-out of a box). Create a balanced triangular or staggered composition.

[Visual Style] High-end commercial photography feel. Clean studio background (white, warm white, light grey). Emphasize material textures (paper folds, box structures, bottle silhouettes, print quality, embossing, matte/cotton/kraft textures). Modern and clean visual language.

[Lighting] Commercial grade lighting. Soft studio light or slight directional natural side light. Use clear but restrained shadows for depth. The light should be transparent and bright, never dark or messy.

[Final Effect] The final image should look like a mature brand's packaging proposal poster or visual landing page, emphasizing vertical poster feel, brand unity, systematic completeness, and commercial photography quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
请为类别为 {argument name="category" default="产品类别"} 的品牌 {argument name="brand name" default="品牌名称"} 创建一张高审美、高完成度的“品牌包装系统展示图”。这不仅仅是一张普通的电商白底图或单品照，而是一张具有品牌提案风格的展示图，需体现“单一品牌在多种包装载体上的统一呈现”，展示成熟消费品牌的完整包装系统。

[比例要求] 整体构图必须为固定的 4:5 竖版海报。禁止横向构图或散乱排列。布局应遵循海报阅读逻辑：顶部留白，中心为包装系统的主视觉焦点，底部为辅助包装、标签和产品。重心应集中，适合作为品牌展示海报直接发布。

[核心要求] 根据 [产品类别] 自动匹配最合理的包装组合，并围绕 [品牌名称] 构建统一的视觉系统。选择少量但具有代表性的包装形式，组成一个精致的系统。优先考虑层级、品牌统一性和展示美感，而非数量。你可以包含：购物袋、礼盒、快递盒、长盒、单品盒、袋装、封套、样品袋、瓶子、罐子、管状物、喷雾瓶、泵头瓶、标签、贴纸、吊牌、卡片以及产品本身。

[类别适配] 根据 [产品类别] 适配包装形式：例如，烘焙类使用纸袋和食品容器；咖啡/茶饮类使用杯子和杯套；美妆/护肤类使用罐子和管状物；香氛/生活方式类使用蜡烛和卡片；时尚/收藏品类使用抽屉盒和吊牌。结果必须符合类别特征且具有系统性。

[数量控制] 控制物品数量，避免拥挤。场景应遵循“少即是多”的原则。建议：1-2 个大件，2-3 个中件，2-4 个小件/标签，以及 1-3 个实际产品。总可见元素应在 6-10 个之间。确保足够的留白和清晰的层级。

[视觉系统] 所有包装必须属于同一个品牌系统，以 [品牌名称] 为核心元素。保持一致的 Logo 位置、字体风格、图形、插画/图案系统以及材质纹理。风格可以是极简、有机、现代、奢华或年轻化，但必须成熟且高质量。

[色彩机制] 避免固定组合。生成不同的配色方案，如奶油白/焦糖棕、雾霾蓝/暖白、橄榄绿/亚麻米、巧克力棕/象牙白等。避免使用霓虹色或廉价的高饱和度色彩。保持一种高级的克制感。

[构图] 使用商业摄影棚场景，采用 3/4 俯视或轻微透视视角。分层排列：大件在背景，核心包装在中景，小件/产品在前景。至少有一个产品应与包装产生互动（例如，半露出盒子）。创造平衡的三角形或错落构图。

[视觉风格] 高端商业摄影质感。干净的摄影棚背景（白色、暖白、浅灰）。强调材质纹理（纸张折痕、盒子结构、瓶身轮廓、印刷质量、压印、哑光/棉质/牛皮纸纹理）。现代且简洁的视觉语言。

[光影] 商业级布光。柔和的摄影棚光或轻微的定向自然侧光。使用清晰但克制的光影来增加深度。光线应通透且明亮，绝不能昏暗或杂乱。

[最终效果] 最终图像应看起来像一张成熟品牌的包装提案海报或视觉落地页，强调竖版海报感、品牌统一性、系统完整性和商业摄影品质。

templates.title: Hyper-realistic Surreal Poster Design Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 超写实超现实海报设计提示词

templates.prompt:
Genre: {argument name="genre" default="Hamburger"}
Brand Name: {argument name="brand name" default="Kashiko"}

Based on this image, generate a photorealistic poster image with a concept that completely deviates from common sense and does not exist anywhere else in the world.

Don't just make it an extension; leap with the idea to a level where it 'makes sense but the interpretation is insane.'

[Absolute Conditions]
- Photorealistic expression (reproduce textures, atmosphere, and even light particles like a real-life photo)
- All language must be in Japanese

[Exaggerated/Boosted Elements]
■ Font Design
- The characters themselves are objectified or phenomenological
- The font physically interacts with the theme

■ Text Placement
- Ignore normal layouts and place text within the space itself
- Layouts with abnormally strong gaze direction

■ Composition
- Unrealistic perspective, extreme wide angles, distortion, scale destruction
- Clear foreground, middle ground, and background layers with abnormally high information density
- A central element that catches the eye instantly + countless subtle oddities in the details

■ Lighting
- Movie-level cinematic lighting
- Intense backlighting, rim lights, neon, particle light, volume light
- Light itself has meaning (functioning as a guide or emphasis)

■ Catchphrase
- Short, intense Japanese text that makes sense but is hard to fully grasp
- Copy that is slightly off-situation but fits strangely well

[Additional Effects]
- A sense of discomfort where reality and unreality coexist simultaneously
- Parts of the image ignore the laws of physics
- Quality that functions as a professional-level advertisement

Ultimately, make it a poster that is 'understandable yet beyond comprehension' and warrants a second look. If the reference image is a character, apply actions such as wearing, using, or trying to eat the brand. Do not use any real brand logos, company names, or personal names; make it completely original. Verify that no real-world elements are included in the final finish. Suppress noise or balance disruptions caused by excessive detail, maintaining overall visual unity and a sophisticated impression.

promptLocalized.zh:
类型：{argument name="genre" default="汉堡"}
品牌名称：{argument name="brand name" default="Kashiko"}

基于此图像，生成一张具有照片级真实感的海报，其概念需完全脱离常识，且在现实世界中绝无仅有。

不要仅仅进行简单的延伸；要让创意实现飞跃，达到一种“逻辑上说得通，但解读起来极其疯狂”的境界。

[绝对条件]
- 照片级真实感表现（还原纹理、氛围，甚至像真实照片一样的光粒子）
- 所有文字必须使用日语

[夸张/强化元素]
■ 字体设计
- 字符本身被物化或现象化
- 字体与主题产生物理交互

■ 文字排版
- 忽略常规布局，将文字置于空间本身之中
- 具有极强视觉引导力的布局

■ 构图
- 不现实的透视、极广角、畸变、比例破坏
- 清晰的前景、中景和背景层次，且信息密度极高
- 一个瞬间抓人眼球的核心元素 + 细节中无数微妙的怪异之处

■ 灯光
- 电影级的灯光效果
- 强烈的逆光、轮廓光、霓虹灯、粒子光、体积光
- 光本身具有意义（作为引导或强调功能）

■ 标语
- 短促、强烈的日语短句，逻辑通顺但难以完全参透
- 文案与情境略有偏差，却又出奇地契合

[附加效果]
- 现实与非现实同时并存的违和感
- 图像部分区域无视物理定律
- 具备专业级广告水准的品质

最终，将其打造为一张“可被理解但又超乎想象”、让人忍不住回看的海报。如果参考图像是角色，请应用穿戴、使用或尝试食用该品牌等动作。请勿使用任何真实品牌 Logo、公司名称或个人姓名；使其完全原创。确保最终成品中不包含任何现实世界的元素。抑制因过度细节导致的噪点或平衡破坏，保持整体视觉统一与高级感。

templates.title: Emotional Hawaii Solo Travel Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 夏威夷情感向单人旅行拼贴画

templates.prompt:
A 12-frame collage of candid, emotional snapshots of a {argument name="subject" default="young Japanese woman"} traveling alone in {argument name="location" default="Hawaii"}, casually captured on a smartphone.
Each frame feels like a fleeting personal memory — imperfect, sun-drenched, intimate, and unposed.

The woman has a naturally curvy figure with a soft, feminine silhouette, subtly emphasizing her bust without exaggeration. Her presence feels real and unstyled, like a private photo album.

Scenes include: walking barefoot on the beach, seaside in strong sunlight, palm trees swaying, overexposed ocean reflections, small local cafés, a modest motel room, sunset coast, night markets, views from inside a moving car.

Shot with a smartphone aesthetic: slight motion blur, soft focus, blown-out highlights from tropical sunlight, lens flare, sun glare, high ISO noise at night, uneven framing, accidental cropping.

Composition feels random and spontaneous — subject sometimes off-center, partially cut off, mid-motion, or obscured by light leaks.

Lighting varies: harsh midday sun, warm golden hour glow, deep sunset tones, humid night street lighting.

Color grading: faded cinematic tones, slightly desaturated with warm highlights, nostalgic film-like look, subtle grain, lifted blacks.

Emotion: solitude, fleeting youth, bittersweet nostalgia, quiet introspection, like memories from a trip taken alone.

Layout: 12 images arranged in a loose, imperfect collage grid, slightly tilted and misaligned like a scrapbook.

No text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
一组 12 帧的抓拍照片，记录了 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻日本女性"} 在 {argument name="location" default="夏威夷"} 独自旅行时的情感瞬间，均由智能手机随手拍摄。
每一帧都如同转瞬即逝的个人记忆——不完美、阳光明媚、私密且自然。

画面中的女性拥有自然的曲线美和柔和的女性轮廓，在不夸张的前提下微妙地突显了胸部线条。她的状态真实且未经修饰，仿佛私人相册中的影像。

场景包括：在海滩赤脚行走、强光下的海边、摇曳的棕榈树、过曝的海面反光、小型当地咖啡馆、朴素的汽车旅馆房间、日落海岸、夜市、从行驶中的车内向外看的视角。

采用智能手机摄影美学：轻微的动态模糊、柔焦、热带阳光造成的过曝高光、镜头光晕、眩光、夜间的高 ISO 噪点、不均匀的构图、随意的裁剪。

构图随机且自发——主体有时偏离中心、被部分遮挡、处于运动中，或被漏光效果遮盖。

光影多变：强烈的正午阳光、温暖的黄金时刻余晖、深沉的日落色调、潮湿的夜间街灯。

调色风格：褪色的电影感色调、略微降低饱和度并带有暖调高光、怀旧的胶片质感、细腻的颗粒感、提升的暗部细节。

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vintage-inspired illustrated travel poster and infographic for {argument name="country name" default="Switzerland"}, shown as a sculpted 3D relief map centered on a clean light gray background. At the top, place a huge bold black sans-serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SWITZERLAND"}, with smaller uppercase text below reading TRAVEL GUIDE, flanked by thin horizontal divider lines and a tiny red shield emblem with a white cross. The centerpiece is a raised topographic map of Switzerland rendered like a miniature diorama, with rocky borders, green valleys, snowy alpine peaks, blue lakes, winding white roads, and a few rail lines. Mark exactly 12 destinations on the map with black dot markers and bold black capsule labels with white uppercase text: BASEL, ZÜRICH, ST. GALLEN, LUCERNE, BERN, INTERLAKEN, CHUR, ST. MORITZ, LUGANO, ZERMATT, GENEVA, and LAUSANNE. Integrate miniature landmark buildings and scenery directly onto the map, including churches, old town towers, waterfront structures, castles, and mountain villages, plus two small red trains moving through the landscape. Add surrounding travel ephemera arranged around the map: 1 worn brown vintage suitcase with travel stickers and a red Swiss-cross badge in the upper left, 1 antique brass compass rose on the left, 1 postage stamp in the upper right reading TRAVEL TO SWITZERLAND with mountain art and postal cancellation marks, 1 realistic Swiss flag on a pole in the top right corner, 1 tilted polaroid photo in the lower left with snowy mountains and the caption {argument name="photo caption" default="Swiss Alps"}, and 4 faceted heart-shaped crystal charms total, with 2 clear/silver hearts and 2 red hearts placed around the composition. On the right side, add a vertical sightseeing list with icon illustrations and thin separators, containing exactly 12 city entries with headings and short attraction lines: ZÜRICH — Bahnhofstrasse; Old Town (Altstadt); Lake Zurich. LUCERNE — Chapel Bridge; Lion Monument; Lake Lucerne. INTERLAKEN — Jungfraujoch; Harder Kulm; Lake Brienz & Thun. ZERMATT — Matterhorn; Gornergrat Railway; Skiing & Hiking. GENEVA — Jet d'Eau; United Nations; Lake Geneva. LAUSANNE — Olympic Museum; Lausanne Cathedral; Lake Geneva. BERN — Federal Palace; Zytglogge Clock Tower; Bear Park. ST. MORITZ — St. Moritz Lake; Skiing; Luxury Shopping. LUGANO — Lake Lugano; Monte Brè; Swiss-Italian Culture. ST. GALLEN — Abbey Library; St. Gallen Cathedral; Textile Museum. CHUR — Old Town; Bishop's Palace; Rhine Valley. BASEL — Kunstmuseum; Basel Minster; Rhine River. Use a premium editorial travel-brand aesthetic, combining realistic miniature map rendering, crisp typography, soft studio shadows, subtle drop shadows under objects, and a polished tourism campaign look.

templates.title: Tennis Hydration Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 网球补水广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic sports advertising poster shot from an extreme wide-angle, low courtside perspective on a bright sunny day at an outdoor tennis court. In the extreme foreground, a male tennis player lunges dramatically toward the camera while thrusting a large matte cobalt-blue insulated water bottle toward the viewer, making the bottle the dominant object in the frame. The bottle is covered with visible condensation droplets and has a brushed metallic gold cap, with the white logo text {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} printed near the bottom. The athlete wears a clean white athletic t-shirt, bright blue tennis shorts, white wristbands, white socks, and white tennis shoes. His other arm stretches back holding a black tennis racket, with 1 bright yellow-green tennis ball visible near the racket on the right side of the image. The pose should feel dynamic and athletic, with one leg bent deeply and the other extended in a wide lunge across the blue hard court. Use strong midday sunlight, crisp shadows, vivid saturated blues, and a clear cloudless sky, with green trees and a dark fence line in the distant background. Compose it like a premium hydration brand campaign, with sharp focus on the bottle and athlete, dramatic foreshortening, commercial polish, and energetic motion. Add clean white ad typography integrated onto the court surface in the lower half: a smaller line reading {argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}, a very large bold line reading {argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}, and a smaller subheading reading {argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keeps up with every move."}. Place the {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} logo again in white at the top right, and a small website URL in white at the bottom right reading {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的体育广告海报，采用极广角、低机位的场边视角，背景为阳光明媚的户外网球场。在极近的前景中，一名男性网球运动员向镜头做出戏剧性的跨步动作，同时将一个大型哑光钴蓝色保温水瓶推向观众，使水瓶成为画面中的主体。瓶身布满清晰的冷凝水珠，配有拉丝金属金色瓶盖，底部印有白色品牌标识文字 {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"}。运动员身穿干净的白色运动 T 恤、亮蓝色网球短裤，佩戴白色护腕，穿着白色运动袜和网球鞋。他的另一只手臂向后伸展，握着一把黑色网球拍，画面右侧球拍附近可见 1 个明亮的黄绿色网球。姿势应充满动感与力量感，一条腿深蹲，另一条腿在蓝色硬地球场上大跨度伸展。利用强烈的正午阳光、清晰的阴影、鲜艳饱和的蓝色以及万里无云的晴空，远处背景为绿树和深色围栏。构图应呈现出高端补水品牌广告的质感，聚焦于水瓶与运动员，运用戏剧性的透视缩短效果，展现商业级的精致感与活力。在画面下半部分的球场表面融入简洁的白色广告排版：较小的一行文字为 {argument name="headline intro" default="Play Hard"}，非常醒目的大号粗体文字为 {argument name="headline main" default="Hydrate Smart"}，以及较小的副标题 {argument name="tagline" default="Hydration that keeps up with every move."}。在右上角再次放置 {argument name="brand name" default="Aqua"} 的白色品牌 Logo，并在右下角放置一个小型白色网站 URL {argument name="website" default="www.aqua.com"}。

The lower half of her face is covered by a translucent neon-lime skull-shaped respirator mask with visible teeth structure, glossy acrylic material, and internal glowing green highlights. Her head and neck are partially exposed mechanical anatomy: black metal plates, pistons, cables, micro-circuitry, screws, and robotic joints integrated into the jawline, temple, ear area, and throat. Background is a soft-focus, saturated {argument name="background color" default="orange"} neon panel glow with blurred interface-like light blocks, creating strong color contrast against the teal hair and acid-green mask. Lighting is cinematic and glossy with sharp reflections on the mask and metal parts, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic skin texture, high contrast, moody sci-fi atmosphere, premium concept art, photoreal, extremely detailed, 85mm portrait lens look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的赛博朋克风格特写肖像，描绘了一位未来感女性机械改造人。构图为肩部以上，呈 3/4 侧面，一只明亮的翡翠绿眼睛直视镜头。她留着凌乱且轻盈的 {argument name="hair color" default="亮青色"} 头发，随意地束在脑后，几缕发丝散落在脸庞。她的下半张脸被一个半透明的霓虹青柠色骷髅形状呼吸面具遮盖，面具呈现出清晰的牙齿结构、光泽的亚克力材质以及内部发光的绿色高光。她的头部和颈部部分显露出机械构造：黑色金属板、活塞、线缆、微型电路、螺丝以及集成在下颌线、太阳穴、耳部和喉咙处的机械关节。包含 5 个清晰可见的耳环，耳部周围有工业风的控制论细节。在前额和靠近眼睛的脸颊处添加微妙的印刷科技标记和微小的黑色纹身式贴花。她穿着一件带有高领的黑色未来风夹克，肩部附近有一个小型的警示风格标签。背景是柔焦且饱和的 {argument name="background color" default="橙色"} 霓虹灯板光效，伴有模糊的界面式光块，与青色头发和酸绿色面具形成强烈的色彩对比。光影具有电影质感和光泽感，面具和金属部件上有锐利的反光，浅景深，超写实皮肤纹理，高对比度，营造出情绪化的科幻氛围，顶级概念艺术，照片级真实，极致细节，85mm 肖像镜头效果。

templates.title: Monkey Patrol in Cardboard Police Car

templates.prompt: A humorous photorealistic street scene in a busy Chinese market district in daylight, showing a tiny handmade police car driving down the road as if on patrol. The vehicle looks like a rough life-size toy or parade prop built from corrugated cardboard and tape, boxy and slightly crooked, painted white with dark blue police graphics, a red-and-blue light bar on the roof, the Chinese characters for police on the hood and side doors, the English word POLICE on the hood, a police badge emblem on the front doors, and a front license plate reading 京A8888. Inside and hanging out of the windows are 4 macaque monkeys total: 1 monkey in the driver’s seat wearing a white police cap with one hand on the steering wheel, 1 monkey in the front passenger seat leaning out the window and pointing forward, and 2 monkeys leaning out from the left side rear windows, each extending an arm and pointing outward. The monkeys have expressive alert faces and tan-brown fur, making the scene look like a monkey patrol. Surrounding environment is a real urban street with scooters, pedestrians, market stalls, green canopy tents, and dense red Chinese storefront signage in the background, all slightly out of focus. Shoot from a front-left three-quarter angle at street level, with the cardboard car centered and moving toward the viewer. Bright natural midday light, candid documentary photography style, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, comedic absurdity, high detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在繁忙的中国市场街区拍摄的写实风格幽默街头照片，展现了一辆微型手工警车像在巡逻一样行驶在路上。这辆车看起来像是一个由瓦楞纸板和胶带制成的粗糙等比例玩具或游行道具，外形方正且略显歪斜，车身漆成白色并带有深蓝色警用涂装，车顶配有红蓝警灯，引擎盖和侧门上印有中文“警察”字样，引擎盖上印有英文“POLICE”，前门贴有警徽标志，前车牌写着“京 A8888”。车内及窗外总共探出 4 只猕猴：1 只猴子坐在驾驶座上，戴着白色警帽，一只手扶着方向盘；1 只猴子坐在副驾驶座上，探出窗外并向前指引；另有 2 只猴子从左侧后窗探出，每只都伸出一只手臂指向外侧。猴子们表情机警，毛发呈棕褐色，使整个场景看起来像是一支猴子巡逻队。周围环境是真实的城市街道，背景中有滑板车、行人、市场摊位、绿色遮阳棚和密集的红色中文店招，均略微失焦。从街道水平面的左前方四分之三角度拍摄，纸板车位于画面中心并向观众驶来。明亮的自然正午光线，纪实摄影风格，浅景深，纹理逼真，充满喜剧荒诞感，细节丰富。

templates.title: Barcelona Transfer Poster for Saka

Center a large chest-up portrait of the player wearing the {argument name="jersey description" default="2024/25 FC Barcelona home shirt with Spotify sponsor"}, facing forward with a serious confident expression. Behind him, place a much larger low-opacity side portrait of the same player on the right side as a background layer, tinted dark blue. Add a huge faint FC Barcelona crest spanning the middle background, blended into the red-blue gradient. At the very top center, place 2 club identifiers: the FC Barcelona crest and above it a small vertical red-and-blue striped motif. On the upper left, include the text “MÉS QUE UN CLUB” in small gold uppercase letters. On the left lower-middle, create a bold typographic name stack with 2 lines: small gold uppercase first name “BUKAYO” above very large white condensed sans-serif “SAKA”. Below that, add 2 welcome lines in uppercase: “BENVINGUT” in white and “AL BARÇA” in red. Add a gold handwritten-style signature reading “B. Saka” with the number “7” beneath it. In the foreground near the lower center, place a full-body action pose of the same player running forward with arms stretched wide in celebration, wearing the same Barcelona kit, navy socks, light boots, and a white wrist wrap. At the bottom, show a stylized illuminated view of Spotify Camp Nou curving across the width of the poster in dark blue with red highlights, with small visible stadium text “SPOTIFY CAMP NOU”. In the bottom left corner, include 2 small lines of text: “FC BARCELONA” in gold and “2024/25” in red. Add a small gold sleeve detail on the right shoulder area. Use sharp photo-illustration compositing, realistic fabric texture, glossy highlights, and polished poster finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的足球转会官宣海报，主题为 {argument name="player name" default="Bukayo Saka"} 加入 {argument name="club name" default="FC Barcelona"}。采用 4:5 比例的竖版体育海报构图，运用深电光蓝与深红色的色调，强调高对比度光影、电影级阴影、微弱光晕以及高级社交媒体平面设计风格。画面中心放置一张球员胸部以上的正面肖像，身穿 {argument name="jersey description" default="2024/25 赛季 FC Barcelona 主场球衣（含 Spotify 赞助商标志）"}，表情严肃自信。在其身后右侧，放置一张该球员更大尺寸、低透明度的侧面肖像作为背景层，并叠加深蓝色调。在背景中部添加一个巨大的、若隐若现的 FC Barcelona 队徽，并与红蓝渐变背景融合。在顶部正中央放置 2 个俱乐部标识：FC Barcelona 队徽，其上方为一个小的垂直红蓝条纹图案。在左上方，以金色小号大写字母添加文字“MÉS QUE UN CLUB”。在左侧中下方，创建两行醒目的排版文字：上方为金色小号大写字母“BUKAYO”，下方为超大号白色紧凑型无衬线字体“SAKA”。在其下方，添加两行大写欢迎词：白色“BENVINGUT”和红色“AL BARÇA”。添加一个金色手写风格签名“B. Saka”，下方标注数字“7”。在前景靠近底部中央的位置，放置该球员全身奔跑庆祝的动作姿态，双臂张开，身穿同样的 Barcelona 球衣、深蓝色球袜、浅色球鞋及白色护腕。在底部，展示一张风格化的 Spotify Camp Nou 体育场发光全景图，横跨海报底部，呈现深蓝色调并带有红色高光，可见微小的“SPOTIFY CAMP NOU”体育场文字。在左下角，包含两行小字：“FC BARCELONA”（金色）和“2024/25”（红色）。在右肩区域添加一个金色袖口细节。保持布局整洁、层次分明、现代且富有感染力，呈现出顶级俱乐部转会官宣图的质感。运用锐利的照片合成技术、逼真的织物纹理、光泽高光以及精致的海报后期处理。

Medium close-up framing from the chest up, subject facing forward, with the face partially obscured by a large centered rectangular censor block in muted teal-green. The character has messy glowing {argument name="hair color" default="bright cyan"} hair, a visible cybernetic right eye area with metallic facial implants, cables and mechanical details around the neck and jaw, and a rugged high-tech armored jacket with straps, buckles, tubes, segmented plating, and luminous cyan and orange light accents. Use a dramatic teal-and-orange color palette, glossy wet pavement reflections, soft rain in the air, dense atmospheric haze, and heavy bokeh from neon signage in the background. The alley should contain 8 visible glowing sign clusters, mostly vertical and horizontal signs with Chinese characters, plus futuristic storefront lights and industrial wall details. Make the mood gritty, stylish, dystopian, and ultra-detailed, with sharp focus on the subject and a blurred background, as if from a high-end sci-fi film still.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具电影质感的赛博朋克肖像，描绘了一位未来主义街头战士，站在雨水浸润的亚洲大都市夜晚，一条狭窄且霓虹闪烁的巷道中央。采用胸部以上的半身特写构图，主体面向前方，面部被一个位于中心的大型矩形遮挡块部分遮盖，呈现柔和的青绿色。角色拥有凌乱且发光的 {argument name="hair color" default="明亮青色"} 头发，右眼区域可见明显的赛博格特征及金属面部植入物，颈部和下颌周围布满线缆与机械细节，身穿粗犷的高科技装甲夹克，配有绑带、扣环、管道、分段式护板以及青色和橙色的发光装饰。采用戏剧性的青橙色调，地面呈现湿润的倒影，空气中飘着细雨，背景中弥漫着浓厚的雾气，霓虹招牌产生强烈的背景虚化效果。巷道中应包含 8 组清晰可见的发光招牌，多为带有中文字符的竖向和横向标识，辅以未来感十足的店面灯光和工业风墙面细节。整体氛围粗粝、时尚、反乌托邦且极具细节感，主体焦点清晰，背景虚化，呈现出高端科幻电影剧照的质感。

templates.prompt: A photorealistic top-down product-style photograph of a single luxury tasting menu printed on bright white textured paper and placed on a dark walnut wooden tabletop, with soft warm ambient lighting and gentle natural shadows. The sheet is portrait orientation, slightly rotated clockwise, occupying most of the frame with clean margins around it. The design is an ultra-minimal fine-dining menu with elegant editorial typography, lots of negative space, precise alignment, and a refined black-and-dark-gray ink palette. At the upper left, the restaurant identity appears in 3 stacked lines: a large serif word {argument name="restaurant name" default="Silence"}, below it 2 Chinese characters "沈默", and below that a large serif French line "Le Silence". Under the title is a small location line reading "Ginza, Tokyo B3F". At the upper right is a small date line in French followed by Japanese date text: {argument name="date text" default="22 Avril 2026 • 令和八年四月二十二日"}. The main body is organized into 3 vertical content zones: a left numbered course list, a middle translated course list, and a far-right icon column. The left list contains exactly 9 numbered courses labeled 1 through 9, each with French title and Japanese subtitle and an English ingredient line beneath; the 9 visible course titles are: "Huître de Bretagne, eau de mer", "Daurade de Kyoto, pétale de sakura", "Oursin d’Hokkaidō, consommé d’algue", "Asperge de Nemuro, sauce mousseline", "Homard de Miyako, bisque légère", "Canard de Challans, figue et balsamique", "Boeuf de Kagoshima, truffe noire", "Fromage de chèvre, miel du Japon", and "Agrume, thé vert et gin". The middle list repeats the 9 dishes in a second compact column with French titles and Japanese descriptions. The far-right column contains exactly 9 horizontal icon rows aligned to the courses, each row showing small monochrome hand-drawn ingredient or allergen pictograms; some rows have 2 icons and some 3, for a total of 19 icons overall. Near the lower left is a section titled "Le mot du chef" followed by a short French paragraph in small serif text. Below that is a section titled "Origine des ingrédients / 食材の産地" with a dense 2-row ingredient-origin grid listing exactly 15 numbered origin entries in tiny text. In the lower right quadrant, include a small label "Chef" above a large sweeping handwritten signature reading {argument name="chef name" default="Keiichiro Aoyama"}. Along the very bottom edge is a thin horizontal rule and a centered allergen legend line with exactly 7 small outline icons and labels: shellfish, crustaceans, egg, fish, milk, gluten, sulfites, each labeled in French with Japanese beneath. The overall impression should be high-end Michelin-style menu design, editorial restraint, immaculate spacing, subtle paper grain, sharply legible text hierarchy, and realistic photography rather than a flat scan.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的产品风格俯拍照片，展示了一份印在亮白色纹理纸上的奢华品鉴菜单，放置在深色胡桃木桌面上，配有柔和的暖色环境光和自然的阴影。菜单呈纵向，顺时针略微旋转，占据了画面的大部分空间，四周留有整洁的边距。设计采用极简主义的高级餐饮风格，具有优雅的编辑排版、大量的留白、精准的对齐以及精致的黑灰墨色调。左上角是餐厅标识，分为 3 行堆叠：一行大号衬线字体 {argument name="restaurant name" default="Silence"}，下方是 2 个中文字符“沈默”，再下方是一行大号衬线法文“Le Silence”。标题下方是一行小字地址“Ginza, Tokyo B3F”。右上角是一行法文日期，后接日文日期文本：{argument name="date text" default="22 Avril 2026 • 令和八年四月二十二日"}。主体内容分为 3 个垂直区域：左侧编号菜品列表、中间翻译后的菜品列表以及最右侧的图标列。左侧列表包含 1 到 9 共 9 道编号菜品，每道菜均有法文标题、日文副标题以及下方的英文食材说明；9 道可见的菜品标题为：“Huître de Bretagne, eau de mer”、“Daurade de Kyoto, pétale de sakura”、“Oursin d’Hokkaidō, consommé d’algue”、“Asperge de Nemuro, sauce mousseline”、“Homard de Miyako, bisque légère”、“Canard de Challans, figue et balsamique”、“Boeuf de Kagoshima, truffe noire”、“Fromage de chèvre, miel du Japon”以及“Agrume, thé vert et gin”。中间列表以第二个紧凑的列重复了这 9 道菜，包含法文标题和日文描述。最右侧一列包含 9 行与菜品对齐的水平图标，每行显示小型单色手绘食材或过敏原象形图；部分行有 2 个图标，部分行有 3 个，总计 19 个图标。左下角附近是一个标题为“Le mot du chef”的区域，后接一段小号衬线字体的法文短文。下方是一个标题为“Origine des ingrédients / 食材の産地”的区域，包含一个 2 行的食材产地网格，以极小的文字列出了 15 个编号产地条目。在右下象限，包含一个“Chef”小标签，上方是大幅流畅的手写签名 {argument name="chef name" default="Keiichiro Aoyama"}。最底端边缘是一条细水平线，以及居中的过敏原说明行，包含 7 个小型轮廓图标和标签：贝类、甲壳类、蛋类、鱼类、乳制品、麸质、亚硫酸盐，每个标签均以法文标注，下方附带日文。整体观感应呈现高端米其林风格的菜单设计，体现编辑排版的克制感、完美的间距、细腻的纸张纹理、清晰易读的文字层级，并呈现真实的摄影质感，而非平面的扫描件。

The wall behind her is decorated with exactly 8 taped paper items: 4 instant photos, 2 concert flyers, 1 handwritten note, and 1 small dark photo print. promptLocalized.zh: 一张室内近景抓拍人像，{argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 背靠柔和的米色墙壁，采用 1990 年代一次性相机快照风格拍摄。她皮肤白皙，带着淡淡的、内敛的微笑，留着蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 卷发，发丝自然凌乱，几缕发丝垂落在肩头。她穿着一件 {argument name="top color" default="褪色紫红色"} 的宽松卫衣，版型休闲，袖口微微收拢。构图为胸部以上，视线平齐且略微偏离中心，身体姿态随性，一只手臂微微向前伸展，仿佛是她自己在自拍。使用直射机顶闪光灯营造平坦的阴影，环境光线昏暗，带有可见但细腻的胶片颗粒感，边缘柔和，充满怀旧随性的氛围。她身后的墙上贴着 8 件纸质物品：4 张拍立得照片、2 张演唱会传单、1 张手写便条和 1 张小型深色照片打印件。其中一张传单提到 {argument name="band name" default="SONIC YOUTH"}，另一张提到 {argument name="second band name" default="NIRVANA"}。整体画面应呈现出亲密、不完美、略带颗粒感且真实的模拟胶片质感。

templates.title: Inventor Portrait Memory Map

titleLocalized.zh: 发明家肖像记忆图谱

templates.prompt: A stylized half-body portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a brilliant young woman inventor"} in a dark, moody studio, rendered as a warm amber-and-copper digital painting with semi-realistic detail and subtle sketch-like linework. She faces forward in a relaxed upright pose, cropped from about mid-torso upward, with long dark brown hair swept loosely over one shoulder, a few flyaway strands rim-lit by orange backlight, and thin clear-framed eyeglasses partly visible. Dress her in a glossy mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a deep burgundy turtleneck sweater. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic: a glowing spherical lattice lamp sits behind her on the left, casting a golden halo and warm edge light around her hair and jacket, while the rest of the background fades into charcoal brown shadow. Behind her, integrate the feeling of a visual memory map or inventor's mind palace: faint technical sketches, geometric construction lines, and handwritten scientific notes drawn directly onto the background like illuminated chalk. Include exactly 2 large wireframe forms on the right side: 1 tilted basket-like lattice ellipsoid near the upper right and 1 faint rectangular diagram with axis-like guide lines near the lower right. Include exactly 1 glowing lattice sphere lamp on the lower left. Add small handwritten text in the upper right that reads “TPMS” with three bullet-like lines underneath: “gyroid”, “diamond”, and “primitive”, and a small formula note reading “E = hv” near the right-center. The overall mood should feel intelligent, elegant, flattering, and slightly futuristic, like a portrait merged with a conceptual memory interface. Use a rich palette of burnt orange, gold, auburn, brown-black, and wine red, with high contrast, luminous highlights, and a polished editorial-art finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格化的半身肖像，主角是 {argument name="subject" default="一位才华横溢的年轻女性发明家"}，背景为昏暗且充满氛围感的工作室。画面呈现为暖琥珀色与铜色调的数字绘画，具有半写实细节和微妙的素描线条感。她以放松的直立姿势面向前方，取景从躯干中部向上，深棕色长发松散地垂在一侧肩头，几缕发丝被橙色背光勾勒出轮廓，隐约可见佩戴着细框透明眼镜。她身穿一件亮面芥末黄飞行员夹克，内搭深酒红色高领毛衣。灯光效果具有戏剧性和电影感：左后方放置着一盏发光的球形晶格灯，为她的头发和夹克投射出金色光环与温暖的边缘光，其余背景则渐变为炭棕色的阴影。在背景中融入视觉记忆图谱或发明家“思维宫殿”的意境：淡淡的技术草图、几何构造线以及如同发光粉笔般直接绘制在背景上的手写科学笔记。在右侧精确包含 2 个大型线框形态：右上角附近有一个倾斜的篮状晶格椭球体，右下角附近有一个带有轴线引导线的模糊矩形图表。左下角包含 1 盏发光的晶格球形灯。在右上角添加小型手写文字“TPMS”，下方列出三个类似项目符号的短语：“gyroid”、“diamond”和“primitive”，并在右侧中心附近添加一个小型公式笔记“E = hv”。整体氛围应体现出智慧、优雅、美感，并带有轻微的未来感，如同肖像与概念化记忆界面的融合。采用焦橙色、金色、赤褐色、棕黑色和酒红色的丰富色调，具有高对比度、明亮的高光以及精致的编辑艺术质感。

templates.title: Edible History Pop-Up Chocolate Book

titleLocalized.zh: “可食用的历史”巧克力立体书

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a square 1:1 macro photography image of an open antique history book on a clean white background, styled like an edible history pop-up book. The book is thick, vintage, leather-bound, and lying open flat at 180 degrees. Its pages are aged parchment with yellowed paper, worn edges, and visible paper texture. On the left page, show an abundant, slightly messy cocoa harvest spread partially covering the printed text: exactly 5 whole or split cacao pods in deep red-orange and brown tones, 1 wooden bowl filled with cacao nibs, a large scatter of loose cacao beans, broken cacao shells, small piles of nibs, and several glossy green leaves tucked among the ingredients. Everything should feel organic, overflowing, and tactile. On the right page, create a large 3D pop-up sculpture of assorted Swiss chocolate built entirely from chocolate and confectionery materials: exactly 8 visible chocolate bars or bar segments in mixed dark, milk, and white chocolate, arranged in a bouquet-like upright structure with 5 large leaf-shaped cacao or chocolate leaves behind them, curled pale chocolate shavings at the base, scattered cacao crumbs, and a wrapped paper base with a vintage label reading “CHOCOLAT SUISSE” and smaller text “Maison de Qualité”. Beside it, place a tiny 1:35 scale Victorian-era chocolatier gentleman in an apron, actively presenting and adjusting the chocolate display with both hands. Print on the right page in bold black serif text: “Vevey, 1875”. Below that, include a short faded cursive lore paragraph about cacao and Swiss chocolate culture. The paragraph should read: “From the cacao pod’s humble shell emerges a confection of elegance. In Swiss chocolate houses, cacao is refined into a treasured delicacy, shared in salons and homes alike, prized for comfort, celebration, and the craft of sweet invention.” Lighting is soft, warm museum lighting focused at the center of the open book. Mood is educational, whimsical, and richly textural. Emphasize photorealism, shallow depth of field, miniature world aesthetic, premium editorial styling, and extremely high material texture fidelity.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 正方形的微距摄影图片，背景为干净的白色，主体是一本翻开的古董历史书，风格如同“可食用的历史”立体书。书本厚重、复古，采用皮革装订，平铺呈 180 度打开。书页为陈旧的羊皮纸，纸张泛黄，边缘磨损，纸张纹理清晰可见。在左页，展示丰富且略显凌乱的可可收获场景，部分覆盖了印刷文字：精确放置 5 个深红橙色和棕色调的完整或裂开的可可豆荚、1 个装满可可碎粒的木碗、大量散落的可可豆、破碎的可可壳、几小堆可可碎粒，以及几片夹在食材间的亮绿色叶子。整体感觉应自然、充盈且具有触感。在右页，创作一个大型 3D 立体雕塑，由各种瑞士巧克力组成，完全由巧克力和糖果材料构建：精确展示 8 块可见的巧克力排块或片段，混合了黑巧克力、牛奶巧克力和白巧克力，排列成花束般的直立结构，后方衬有 5 片大型叶状可可或巧克力叶，底部有卷曲的浅色巧克力屑、散落的可可碎末，以及一个带有复古标签的包装纸底座，上面印有“CHOCOLAT SUISSE”字样和较小的“Maison de Qualité”文字。在旁边放置一个 1:35 比例的维多利亚时代巧克力工匠小人，身穿围裙，双手正在展示和调整巧克力陈列。右页印有粗体黑色衬线文字：“Vevey, 1875”。下方包含一段简短、褪色的草书文字，讲述关于可可和瑞士巧克力文化的传说。段落内容应为：“From the cacao pod’s humble shell emerges a confection of elegance. In Swiss chocolate houses, cacao is refined into a treasured delicacy, shared in salons and homes alike, prized for comfort, celebration, and the craft of sweet invention.” 灯光采用柔和、温暖的博物馆式灯光，聚焦于翻开书本的中心。氛围具有教育意义、奇幻感且纹理丰富。强调超写实主义、浅景深、微缩世界美学、高端编辑风格以及极高的材质纹理保真度。

templates.title: Cinematic Cyberpunk Woman Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感赛博朋克女性肖像

templates.prompt: Cinematic Hollywood film still of a {argument name="subject" default="dark-skinned woman"} in a rainy neon cyberpunk city at night, framed as a medium full-body portrait with the subject crouching low in the street, one knee raised and one arm resting casually on it, facing camera with a confident, calm presence. Shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with Panavision anamorphic lenses, subtle organic Kodak Vision3 film grain, shallow depth of field, creamy oval bokeh, dramatic volumetric cinematic lighting, high contrast, glossy reflections, premium blockbuster color grading. The subject has dark curly hair pulled up in a messy high tied style with loose wet strands, 1 visible dangling metallic earring, and minimal visible cybernetic facial circuitry with 2 glowing eye implants implied by the cybernetic design. Outfit has 3 key pieces: a metallic {argument name="jacket color" default="purple"} bomber jacket with bright {argument name="led trim color" default="neon blue"} LED piping tracing the collar, zipper line, chest seam, and both sleeves; a dark inner top; and black designer tactical pants with fitted panels and 2 visible buckle straps around the knee and thigh area. Add 1 illuminated tech module on the upper sleeve of the jacket. Background is a dense futuristic alley or street canyon with tall blurred buildings, wet atmosphere, vertical neon signage in cyan, magenta, blue, and warm amber, soft fog, and distant practical lights. Emphasize glossy fabric texture, rain-slick urban mood, moody blue-purple palette, realistic skin detail, luxe sci-fi fashion editorial energy, and a photoreal cinematic portrait aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 好莱坞电影剧照风格，画面主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="深色皮肤女性"}，置身于雨夜中霓虹闪烁的赛博朋克城市。构图为中景全身肖像，主体蹲伏在街道上，单膝抬起，一只手臂随意地搭在膝盖上，正对镜头，神情自信而从容。使用 ARRI Alexa 65 搭配 Panavision 变形镜头拍摄，带有细腻的 Kodak Vision3 胶片颗粒感，浅景深，奶油般柔和的椭圆形焦外成像，戏剧性的体积光照明，高对比度，光泽感反射，顶级大片级调色。主体留着深色卷发，扎成凌乱的高马尾，湿润的发丝散落在脸颊旁，佩戴 1 只显眼的金属吊坠耳环，面部带有极简的赛博格电路设计，通过赛博格设计暗示其拥有 2 只发光的眼部植入物。服装包含 3 个关键部分：一件金属质感的 {argument name="jacket color" default="紫色"} 飞行员夹克，领口、拉链线、胸部接缝及双袖处饰有明亮的 {argument name="led trim color" default="霓虹蓝"} LED 灯带；内搭深色上衣；以及黑色设计师战术长裤，带有贴合的拼接设计，膝盖和大腿处可见 2 条扣带。夹克上袖处增加 1 个发光的科技模块。背景为密集的未来主义小巷或街道峡谷，高耸的建筑呈现虚化效果，雨雾弥漫，青色、洋红色、蓝色和暖琥珀色的垂直霓虹招牌，轻柔的雾气，以及远处的实用灯光。强调光泽感的面料质感、雨后湿润的城市氛围、忧郁的蓝紫色调、真实的皮肤细节、奢华的科幻时尚大片质感以及照片级的电影肖像美学。

templates.title: Scientific Neuron Anatomy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 科学神经元解剖海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed scientific anatomical poster of a {argument name="subject" default="neuron"} on a clean warm off-white paper background, presented as a museum-quality hybrid of 3D pencil drawing and ultra-realistic biological illustration. The composition centers on one large neuron in three-quarter view, with an oversized spherical purple nucleus inside a textured cell body, many branching dendrites spreading outward like winter tree branches, and a long axon extending diagonally down to the right. The axon is partially cut away to reveal its internal structure and is wrapped in segmented blue-gray myelin sheaths with visible gaps at the nodes of Ranvier. At the far end, the axon branches into exactly 15 thin terminal fibers, each ending in a rounded synaptic bulb with pale peach and pink tips. The main central figure should look sculptural, organic, and slightly glossy, with intricate membrane textures, subtle beige, ivory, silver, brown, and violet coloration, and extremely fine linework for the distal branches. Surround the centerpiece with 6 labeled educational inset sections arranged like a textbook infographic: top left a title block reading {argument name="title text" default="NEURON (NERVE CELL)"} with a short explanatory paragraph and a numbered structure list containing exactly 10 items; upper right a smaller monochrome full-neuron sketch labeled {argument name="style note" default="3D PENCIL DRAWING"}; lower left a cell body soma detail diagram with labels pointing to internal organelles; bottom left a myelin sheath cross-section cylinder diagram; lower center a square grayscale microscopic view panel with 4 labels; right center an electrical signal section with a small action potential graph showing membrane potential versus time; lower right a synapse close-up drawing with receptor and neurotransmitter labeling. Include fine serif typography, delicate leader lines, small circled numbers on the main neuron, and the feel of an elegant old scientific plate mixed with modern biomedical visualization. Keep the layout airy and balanced, with the central neuron dominating most of the canvas, landscape orientation, extremely high resolution, crisp educational poster design, and a refined neutral aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度详尽的科学解剖海报，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="神经元"}，背景为干净的暖米白色纸张，呈现出博物馆级的 3D 铅笔素描与超写实生物插图的混合风格。构图中心为一个四分之三侧视的大型神经元，细胞体内有一个超大的球形紫色细胞核，许多分支状树突像冬天的树枝一样向外延伸，一条长长的轴突向右下方斜向伸展。轴突部分切开以展示其内部结构，并包裹在分段的蓝灰色髓鞘中，在朗飞氏结处有明显的间隙。在末端，轴突分支为 15 条细长的终端纤维，每条纤维末端都有一个圆形的突触球，尖端呈浅桃色和粉色。中心主体应看起来具有雕塑感、有机感且略带光泽，具有复杂的膜纹理，色调为微妙的米色、象牙色、银色、棕色和紫色，远端分支线条极其精细。在中心主体周围布置 6 个带标签的教育性插图板块，排列方式如同教科书信息图：左上角为标题块，文字为 {argument name="title text" default="神经元（神经细胞）"}，附带一段简短的解释性文字和一个包含 10 个项目的编号结构列表；右上角为一个较小的单色全神经元草图，标注为 {argument name="style note" default="3D 铅笔素描"}；左下角为细胞体细节图，带有指向内部细胞器的标签；底部左侧为髓鞘横截面圆柱体图；下方中心为一个方形灰度显微镜视野面板，带有 4 个标签；右侧中心为一个电信号部分，配有一个显示膜电位随时间变化的小型动作电位图；右下角为一个突触特写图，带有受体和神经递质标签。包含精细的衬线字体、精致的引导线、主神经元上的小圆圈数字，营造出优雅的古老科学图版与现代生物医学可视化相结合的感觉。保持布局通透平衡，中心神经元占据画布大部分空间，横向构图，极高分辨率，清晰的教育海报设计，以及精致的中性美学。

templates.title: VTuber Debut Poster from Character Sheet

Change the composition from a full-body reference sheet to a dramatic upper-body key visual of the character seated at a streaming desk, one hand near the face, in a cozy nighttime bedroom-studio. Add a starry city-night window background, curtains, hanging star ornaments, glowing monitors, desk microphone, keyboard/controller, and a drink mug, with soft cinematic lighting and sparkly atmospheric effects. Preserve the branding of Yume Asta and make the layout feel like an X/Twitter thumbnail or promotional key visual. Add dense decorative typography and framed info panels in elegant Japanese idol/VTuber promo style: a large title with the Japanese name and romanized 'Yume Asta', a short poetic tagline, 4 boxed profile sections labeled 'Profile', 'Like', 'Keyword', and '配信スタイル', plus 1 smaller boxed hashtag/community section at the bottom left. Add a large glowing headline at the bottom center reading 'VTuber Debut' and 'Coming Soon', plus a ribbon-style banner beneath it with Japanese debut-stream text. Make it richly detailed, dreamy, luminous, and premium, like an official VTuber debut teaser poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为角色和设计基础，将简洁的 Live2D 模型设定图转化为精致的 VTuber 出道官宣海报，同时保留原有的角色设计、连帽衫、耳机、项圈、星星与星座元素，以及整体的紫蓝色夜色调。将构图从全身设定图改为更具戏剧性的半身主视觉图，展现角色坐在直播桌前，单手托腮，置身于温馨的夜间卧室直播间。添加星光熠熠的城市夜景窗背景、窗帘、悬挂的星星装饰、发光的显示器、桌面麦克风、键盘/手柄以及饮料杯，并辅以柔和的电影级光效和闪烁的氛围特效。保留 Yume Asta 的品牌标识，使布局呈现出 X/Twitter 缩略图或宣传主视觉图的质感。加入密集的装饰性排版和带框信息面板，采用优雅的日系偶像/VTuber 宣传风格：包含日语名称和罗马音“Yume Asta”的大标题、简短的诗意标语、4 个分别标注为“Profile”、“Like”、“Keyword”和“配信スタイル”的方框简介，以及左下角一个较小的标签/社区方框。在底部中央添加醒目的发光大标题“VTuber Debut”和“Coming Soon”，并在其下方添加带有日语出道直播文字的丝带状横幅。整体效果需细节丰富、梦幻、明亮且高级，如同官方 VTuber 出道预告海报。

templates.title: Urban Graffiti Hoodie Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 城市涂鸦连帽衫时尚人像

templates.prompt: A moody full-body fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} standing in a narrow urban alley or tunnel covered in dense colorful graffiti, photographed at night with dramatic low-key lighting and flash-lit realism. She is leaning casually against the wall with 1 hand touching a large pair of over-ear black headphones and 1 hand tucked into the front pocket of an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="mustard yellow"} hoodie. The hoodie is long enough to read almost like a hoodie dress and has a simple black smiley-face graphic centered on the chest with white drawstrings. She wears a black backpack with 2 visible shoulder straps, white crew socks, and chunky black-and-white low-top sneakers. Her legs are bare, and her pose is relaxed with one knee slightly bent and one foot set forward. Her hair is shoulder-length, slightly messy, and {argument name="hair color" default="dark blonde"}. Compose the shot vertically from head to shoes, with the subject centered slightly left of frame. The background is a gritty painted wall dominated by turquoise blue, yellow, pink, and black spray paint, with drips, tags, and abstract cartoon-like graffiti shapes creating a raw street-art atmosphere. The floor is dark, worn, and reflective with paint splatters. Use high contrast, deep shadows, realistic skin and fabric texture, editorial streetwear photography style, underground urban vibe, sharp focus on clothing and body, subdued facial detail, and a cinematic dark nightlife mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满情绪感的全身时尚人像，主角是一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，站在一条布满浓密彩色涂鸦的狭窄城市小巷或隧道中，在夜间拍摄，采用戏剧性的低调照明和闪光灯摄影的写实风格。她随意地靠在墙上，一只手触碰着一副大型黑色头戴式耳机，另一只手插在超大号 {argument name="hoodie color" default="芥末黄"} 连帽衫的前兜里。连帽衫长度足以当作连帽裙穿着，胸前印有一个简单的黑色笑脸图案，配有白色抽绳。她背着一个黑色双肩包，露出 2 条肩带，穿着白色中筒袜和厚底黑白低帮运动鞋。她双腿裸露，姿势放松，一膝微屈，一只脚向前迈出。她的头发齐肩，略显凌乱，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深金色"}。采用竖构图，从头到脚拍摄，主体位于画面略偏左的位置。背景是一面粗犷的喷漆墙，以蓝绿色、黄色、粉色和黑色喷漆为主，伴有滴漆、涂鸦签名和抽象的卡通涂鸦形状，营造出原始的街头艺术氛围。地面昏暗、磨损且带有反光的油漆溅痕。使用高对比度、深邃阴影、逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，呈现编辑级街头摄影风格、地下城市氛围，服装和身体细节清晰对焦，面部细节柔和，营造出电影般的暗夜生活氛围。

templates.title: Fake Apple CEO Announcement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 伪造 Apple CEO 任命海报

templates.prompt: A sleek, photorealistic Chinese tech-announcement poster in Apple advertising style, vertical 4:5 composition, with a dramatic dusk-to-night gradient sky in deep navy blue fading lighter near the horizon. Center the upper body of a middle-aged East Asian man in the foreground, wearing a minimalist black button-up shirt over a black undershirt, standing confidently with a calm executive posture in front of Apple Park’s curved glass architecture. His face is mostly front-facing and slightly turned, with short black hair and thin dark eyeglasses, styled like a serious corporate portrait. Behind him on the right side, place a large glowing white Apple logo floating against the sky. At the very top center, include a small white Apple logo with the Chinese line “Apple 新篇章 由此开启” in a refined thin sans-serif layout. In the top right corner, add large bold red Chinese text: “AI生成”. Across the upper-middle area, place a huge bold white Chinese headline: “罗永浩 接任 Apple CEO”. Directly below it, add a smaller spaced-out white Chinese slogan: “用 工 匠 精 神 ， 让 世 界 再 次 惊 叹”. On the left middle area, add a quoted statement block in dark text with an oversized opening quotation mark, reading: “我不是来改变 Apple， 而是让 Apple 重拾改变世界的勇气。” and beneath it a handwritten-style signature “罗永浩”. Across the lower middle, overlay a translucent dark horizontal feature bar containing exactly 4 icon-and-text columns with thin white line icons: 1) a hammer icon with the title “工匠精神” and subtitle “极致产品主义”, 2) a speech bubble icon with the title “用户至上” and subtitle “体验细节控”, 3) a light bulb icon with the title “创新驱动” and subtitle “重新定义未来”, 4) a heart outline icon with the title “真诚沟通” and subtitle “打造人的科技”. At the very bottom center, add large white English text: “Think Different. Think Again.”, and below it smaller Chinese text: “现在，交给罗永浩。” with another handwritten signature underneath. Use luxury tech keynote poster aesthetics, cinematic soft lighting, glossy reflections on the building, high contrast, clean typography, premium Apple-inspired branding, polished commercial realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简、照片级真实的 Apple 广告风格科技公告海报，采用 4:5 竖构图，背景为深海军蓝向地平线渐变的黄昏至夜晚天空。前景居中放置一位中年东亚男性的上半身，身穿黑色极简衬衫内搭黑色打底衫，以冷静的行政姿态自信地站在 Apple Park 的弧形玻璃建筑前。他面部主要朝向前方并略微偏转，留着黑色短发，佩戴细框深色眼镜，呈现出严肃的企业肖像风格。在他右后方，放置一个巨大的白色发光 Apple Logo 悬浮在空中。在顶部正中央，包含一个小巧的白色 Apple Logo，下方配有精致纤细的无衬线字体中文标语：“Apple 新篇章 由此开启”。在右上角，添加醒目的红色大号中文文本：“AI 生成”。在中上部区域，放置巨大的白色粗体中文标题：“罗永浩 接任 Apple CEO”。在其正下方，添加一行字间距拉开的白色中文口号：“用 工 匠 精 神 ， 让 世 界 再 次 惊 叹”。在中左侧区域，添加一个深色文本引语块，配有超大号的左引号，内容为：“我不是来改变 Apple， 而是让 Apple 重拾改变世界的勇气。”下方附带手写风格签名“罗永浩”。在中下部横向覆盖一个半透明的深色功能栏，包含 4 列带有细白线图标的图文内容：1) 锤子图标，标题“工匠精神”，副标题“极致产品主义”；2) 气泡图标，标题“用户至上”，副标题“体验细节控”；3) 灯泡图标，标题“创新驱动”，副标题“重新定义未来”；4) 爱心轮廓图标，标题“真诚沟通”，副标题“打造人的科技”。在底部正中央，添加白色大号英文文本：“Think Different. Think Again.”，下方配有较小的中文文本：“现在，交给罗永浩。”并在下方再次附上手写签名。采用高端科技发布会海报美学，电影级柔光，建筑上的光泽反射，高对比度，简洁的排版，优质的 Apple 风格品牌视觉，精致的商业写实感。

templates.title: Anime Graffiti Girl Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 身穿黄色连帽衫的动漫涂鸦少女

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the photo into a stylized anime street-art illustration while keeping the same subject, pose, outfit, headphones, backpack, and graffiti-wall setting. Replace the obscured real face with a clean original anime girl face, with a short blonde bob and side-swept bangs, and make the expression calm and slightly aloof. Keep the oversized yellow hoodie and black-and-white sneakers, but simplify the clothing into bold cel-shaded shapes with thick black ink outlines. Change the object in the raised hand from touching the headphones to holding a small blue spray-paint can near the face. Intensify the wall colors into vivid cyan, hot pink, and yellow graffiti splashes, and render the whole image in a dynamic manga/pop-art style with high contrast, sketchy linework, and a slightly low-angle full-body composition.

The sky is dusky twilight with a lavender and muted purple gradient, a few tiny white stars, and several distant birds as dark pixel silhouettes. Use classic 16-bit inspired sprite art, limited color palette, visible pixel grid, clean silhouette design, dramatic fantasy mood, side view landscape framing, and subtle old-game atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅 256x256 正方形构图的复古奇幻像素艺术场景，展示了一条巨大的红龙守护在古老石制城堡的最高中央塔楼上。巨龙有着长而卷曲的尾巴缠绕在塔楼周围，巨大的蝙蝠状翅膀展开，长角的头部低垂并面向左侧，身体呈现出明亮的红橙色，带有深栗色的阴影和清晰的黑色像素轮廓。城堡是一座饱经风霜的中世纪要塞，拥有多座塔楼、雉堞墙和狭小的暗色窗户，坐落在陡峭的岩石山丘之上。山丘周围是连绵起伏的绿色和棕色山脉，部分被淡雾和低云覆盖，营造出层叠的大气深度。天空是黄昏时分，呈现出淡紫色和柔和的紫罗兰色渐变，点缀着几颗微小的白星，远处还有几只作为黑色像素剪影的飞鸟。采用经典的 16 位游戏风格精灵图、有限的调色板、可见的像素网格、简洁的剪影设计、戏剧性的奇幻氛围、侧视图景观构图以及微妙的复古游戏质感。

templates.title: Pixel Art Dragon Castle

titleLocalized.zh: 像素风巨龙城堡

templates.prompt: A detailed retro fantasy pixel art scene of a massive medieval stone castle perched on a steep rocky hill, viewed from a slight low angle, with a winding dirt path leading up to the gate. The castle has many cylindrical towers and connecting walls, exactly 9 visible towers with red-orange conical roofs, several small red flags fluttering from the tallest spires, and weathered gray stone masonry. A huge red dragon is coiled around the tallest central tower, with its long body wrapped around the stone, claws gripping the battlements, horned head leaning forward near the top, and one large batlike wing spread open on the right side. Surround the hill with dense dark-green pine trees and rocky outcrops, with distant blue mountains on the horizon. Place the castle against a bright daytime sky in saturated blue with large fluffy white cumulus clouds. Render in classic 16-bit inspired pixel art with crisp sprite-like shapes, visible pixel texture, rich contrast, adventurous fantasy game cover composition, centered subject, and a square frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节丰富的复古奇幻像素艺术场景，描绘了一座巨大的中世纪石砌城堡坐落在陡峭的岩石山上，采用微仰视角，一条蜿蜒的土路通向大门。城堡拥有许多圆柱形塔楼和连接墙，清晰可见 9 座带有红橙色圆锥形屋顶的塔楼，最高的尖塔上飘扬着几面红色小旗，墙体呈现出风化的灰色石材纹理。一条巨大的红龙盘绕在最高的中央塔楼上，长长的身体缠绕着石墙，利爪紧扣城垛，长角的头部向前方探出，右侧展开一只巨大的蝙蝠状翅膀。山丘周围环绕着茂密的深绿色松树和岩石露头，地平线上可见远处的蓝色山脉。城堡背景为明亮的日间天空，呈现饱和的蓝色，点缀着大朵蓬松的白色积云。采用经典的 16 位像素艺术风格渲染，具有清晰的精灵图形状、可见的像素纹理、丰富的对比度、冒险类奇幻游戏封面构图、居中主体以及方形画幅。

templates.title: Overdecorated Sophie Magic Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Sophie 华丽魔法海报

templates.prompt: A highly embellished full-body anime fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="SOPHIE"}, a young elegant female alchemist-mage standing in the center of a vast celestial library laboratory. She has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair in a soft short bob with a side ponytail and a large crystalline flower hair ornament, though her face is obscured by a flat pale square censor block. She wears an ornate white and icy-blue dress with silver filigree, corset lacing, layered ruffles, translucent trailing panels, detached flowing sleeves, gemstone pendants, thigh garter ornaments, and white high-heeled ankle boots with metallic trims. Two glowing blue potion bottles hang at her hip. Her pose is graceful and confident: one hand raised with a floating faceted blue crystal hovering above her palm, the other holding an open magic book that projects transparent holographic pages and arcane interface diagrams in neon blue. The environment is a grand circular observatory-like library with towering bookshelves, alchemical instruments, astrolabes, hanging ornaments, glassware, candles, and luminous magical symbols. A huge backlit arched window behind her casts cool heavenly light. The floor beneath her is covered in glowing concentric magic circles and reflections, surrounded by crystalline blue flowers and sparkling particles. The composition is vertical, centered, and extremely polished, with dense decorative detail, ethereal lighting, layered translucency, shimmering highlights, and a palette dominated by white, silver, sapphire, and pale violet. Include large decorative title text on the left reading {argument name="title text" default="SOPHIE"}, smaller Japanese text beneath reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="ソフィー"}, a small "CV:" line below, a short block of tiny English flavor text on the lower left, and a luminous blue hologram panel on the right with the word {argument name="panel text" default="SOPHIC"}. Make it feel like a luxurious character key visual or promotional poster for a magical science heroine, ultra-detailed, glossy, radiant, and intentionally over-the-top.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度装饰性的全身动漫奇幻插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="SOPHIE"}，一位年轻优雅的女性炼金术士兼法师，站在巨大的天体图书馆实验室中央。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} 的短发波波头，侧边扎着马尾，戴着巨大的水晶花发饰，但她的面部被一个平面的浅色方形遮挡块遮住。她身穿华丽的白蓝配色礼服，带有银色花丝、紧身胸衣系带、层叠荷叶边、半透明拖尾、分离式飘逸袖子、宝石吊坠、大腿袜带装饰，以及带有金属饰边的白色高跟短靴。腰间挂着两个发光的蓝色药水瓶。她的姿势优雅而自信：一只手抬起，掌心上方悬浮着一颗多面蓝色水晶，另一只手拿着一本打开的魔法书，投射出透明的全息书页和霓虹蓝色的奥术界面图。环境是一个宏伟的圆形天文台式图书馆，配有高耸的书架、炼金仪器、星盘、悬挂装饰品、玻璃器皿、蜡烛和发光的魔法符号。她身后巨大的背光拱形窗投射出清冷的天界光芒。脚下的地面覆盖着发光的同心魔法阵和倒影，周围环绕着晶莹的蓝色花朵和闪烁的微粒。构图为垂直居中，极其精致，具有密集的装饰细节、空灵的灯光、层叠的半透明感、闪烁的高光，色调以白色、银色、蓝宝石色和淡紫色为主。在左侧包含醒目的装饰性标题文本 {argument name="title text" default="SOPHIE"}，下方是较小的日文文本 {argument name="subtitle text" default="ソフィー"}，下方有一行小的“CV:”字样，左下角有一小段微小的英文风味文本，右侧有一个发光的蓝色全息面板，上面写着 {argument name="panel text" default="SOPHIC"}。使其呈现出奢华的角色主视觉图或魔法科学女主角宣传海报的感觉，超精细、光泽感强、光芒四射，且刻意追求极致华丽的效果。

templates.title: Cross-Strait Dialogue Editorial Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 海峡两岸对话社论插画

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A minimalist editorial illustration about cross-strait relations and dialogue, in a muted flat-paper collage style with soft grain texture and rounded shapes. Show 2 human figures seated across a table in profile, facing each other: on the left a man in dark desaturated blue, resting his chin on one hand in a thoughtful pose; on the right a woman in warm brown, gesturing with one hand as if explaining. Both faces are intentionally anonymized with soft blurred rectangular blocks over the facial area. Centered between them is a dark blue balance scale, upright and symmetrical, symbolizing justice, negotiation, and equilibrium. Above the figures are 2 overlapping speech bubbles, one blue-gray on the left and one pale beige on the right, indicating conversation and contested viewpoints. At the bottom center, place 1 white silhouette of a human head in side profile containing a simple growing plant with stem and leaves, symbolizing peace, understanding, or constructive thinking. Use a cream background with 4 large translucent abstract circular forms around the composition, including a pale gray shape on the far left, a beige shape behind the upper center-right, a warm tan shape on the far right, and a darker blue-gray semicircular shape along the bottom foreground. Keep the composition balanced, calm, symbolic, and poster-like, with no text, no sharp outlines, no photorealism, and a subdued palette of dusty blue, slate, beige, cream, and brown.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅关于海峡两岸关系与对话的极简主义社论插画，采用柔和的扁平纸艺拼贴风格，带有细腻的颗粒质感和圆润的形状。画面展示了 2 个侧面相对而坐的人物：左侧是一名身着深低饱和度蓝色衣服的男性，单手托腮，姿态沉思；右侧是一名身着暖棕色衣服的女性，单手比划，仿佛正在解释。两人的面部均经过处理，用柔和模糊的矩形色块遮盖，以保持匿名。两人中间放置着一个深蓝色的平衡天平，垂直且对称，象征着公正、谈判与平衡。人物上方有 2 个重叠的对话气泡，左侧为蓝灰色，右侧为浅米色，象征着交流与不同观点。底部中心放置 1 个白色的人头侧影剪影，内部包含一株简单的生长植物（带有茎和叶），象征和平、理解或建设性思维。背景为奶油色，构图周围分布着 4 个大型半透明抽象圆形，包括最左侧的浅灰色形状、右上方的米色形状、最右侧的暖棕褐色形状，以及底部前景中深蓝灰色的半圆形。保持构图平衡、冷静、具有象征意义且如同海报一般，无文字，无锐利轮廓，非写实风格，色调采用灰蓝色、板岩色、米色、奶油色和棕色的柔和配色。

templates.title: Anime AI Studio Girls at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 AI 工作室少女与日落

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a cozy creative studio at golden hour, showing 5 young women gathered around a cluttered wooden worktable, lit by warm sunset light through large windows, hanging pendant lamps, and string lights. The mood is stylish, intelligent, playful, and slightly chaotic, like a startup loft mixed with an artist workspace. In the left foreground, a tall woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy auburn"} hair wears a white daisy flower crown and a sleeveless rust-red dress with a belt; she stands closest to camera and holds up a handwritten paper sign that reads exactly: {argument name="sign text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}, with a small heart doodle. Behind and to the right of her stands a second woman with platinum-blonde twin ponytails, a black gothic mini dress, black thigh-high stockings, and large headphones around her neck; she poses confidently with one hand on her hip near an open laptop covered in stickers, prominently featuring a large X logo. In the center background stands a petite girl with very long straight black hair and a dark navy dress, reserved and quiet, positioned in front of a wide monitor displaying a glowing Gemini star logo on a dark screen. To the right of center, a glamorous woman with a short black bob and earrings leans over the desk in a fitted red floral cheongsam-style dress, looking toward the papers and laptops. On the far right, a fifth woman with messy light-brown hair in a loose bun wears an oversized open shirt over a cropped white T-shirt with the OpenAI knot logo and casual pants, leaning over the table with one hand braced on the surface and the other near a drawing tablet. The room should contain 2 laptops visible on the desk, 1 central monitor, 3 mugs, 2 sticky notes, 1 paper sign, 1 notebook page titled "Plans", and many scattered creative objects like pens, cables, books, papers, and cans. The first laptop is covered with stickers including a large X logo; the second laptop has an OpenAI logo. The desk includes a black mug with a moon-and-text design, a white mug that says "Good answer takes time.", a white cup with an orange sunburst logo, an energy-drink can, a clear plastic drink cup, a closed notebook, loose handwritten notes, and a tablet on the far right. One sticky note says "You got this" with a heart, and another says "One step at a time" with a tiny flower. The notebook page on the desk reads "Plans" and lists 3 items: "1. World peace", "2. More coffee", "3. Nap", with a small cat doodle. The environment should include bookshelves, framed prints, potted plants, warm wood textures, and wall decor with visible posters and signs, including "Anthropic", "Kindness intelligence", "DO GOOD BUILD COOL SHIT", and a neon-style sign that says "focus fuel". Use cinematic composition, rich amber and sepia tones, intricate linework, soft painterly shading, detailed fabrics and hair, subtle glow on screens, and a polished modern anime illustration aesthetic. No blur, no distortion, no extra people, and no duplicated objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫风格插画，展现了黄金时段温馨的创意工作室。5 位年轻女性围聚在一张杂乱的木制工作台旁，温暖的夕阳透过大窗户、吊灯和串灯洒入室内。氛围时尚、知性、俏皮且略显杂乱，宛如创业阁楼与艺术家工作室的结合体。左侧前景中，一位高挑女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长波浪红褐色"} 头发，戴着白色雏菊头冠，身穿系腰带的无袖铁锈红连衣裙；她离镜头最近，举着一张手写纸牌，上面准确写着：{argument name="sign text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}，并画有一个小爱心。在她后方右侧站着第二位女性，扎着白金双马尾，身穿黑色哥特式迷你裙，穿着黑色过膝袜，脖子上挂着大耳机；她自信地摆着姿势，一只手叉腰，身旁是一台贴满贴纸的笔记本电脑，上面显眼地印着一个巨大的 X 标志。背景中央站着一位娇小的女孩，留着极长的直黑发，身穿深海军蓝连衣裙，显得内敛安静，站在一台显示着深色背景下闪烁 Gemini 星形标志的宽屏显示器前。中心右侧，一位留着黑色短波波头、戴着耳环的迷人女性身穿修身红色花卉旗袍，正俯身看向桌上的文件和笔记本电脑。最右侧，第五位女性留着凌乱的浅棕色丸子头，穿着超大号开衫衬衫，内搭印有 OpenAI 结标志的白色短款 T 恤和休闲裤，一只手撑在桌面上，另一只手靠近绘图板。房间内应包含桌上的 2 台笔记本电脑、1 台中央显示器、3 个杯子、2 张便签、1 张纸牌、1 页标题为“Plans”的笔记本页面，以及许多散落的创意物品，如笔、电缆、书籍、纸张和罐装饮料。第一台笔记本电脑贴满了贴纸，包括一个巨大的 X 标志；第二台笔记本电脑上有 OpenAI 标志。桌上包括一个印有月亮和文字图案的黑色马克杯、一个写着“Good answer takes time.”的白色马克杯、一个印有橙色太阳光芒标志的白色杯子、一罐能量饮料、一个透明塑料饮料杯、一本合上的笔记本、零散的手写笔记以及最右侧的一块平板电脑。一张便签上写着“You got this”并画有一个爱心，另一张写着“One step at a time”并画有一朵小花。桌上的笔记本页面写着“Plans”，列出了 3 项内容：“1. World peace”、“2. More coffee”、“3. Nap”，并画有一只小猫涂鸦。环境应包括书架、装裱好的印刷品、盆栽植物、温暖的木质纹理以及墙面装饰，墙上可见海报和标语，包括“Anthropic”、“Kindness intelligence”、“DO GOOD BUILD COOL SHIT”以及一个写着“focus fuel”的霓虹灯风格招牌。采用电影级构图，运用浓郁的琥珀色和深褐色调，精细的线条，柔和的绘画式阴影，细腻的织物和头发质感，屏幕带有微妙的微光，呈现出精致的现代动漫插画美学。无模糊，无失真，无额外人物，无重复物体。
