templates.title: Cinematic City Explosion Chase

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级城市爆炸追逐

templates.prompt: A cinematic photorealistic action scene in a rainy downtown city street canyon, showing {argument name="main subject" default="a dark-haired man in his 30s"} sprinting directly toward the camera in the center foreground with a tense survival expression, wearing a soaked dark jacket, dark shirt, and dark pants, mid-stride with one arm pumping forward. Behind him, a massive urban explosion tears through the street and lower facade of a high-rise building, sending a huge cloud of smoke, fire, dust, shattered concrete, glass, and metal debris outward in all directions. The scene includes exactly 3 visible damaged vehicles: 1 dark sedan in the left foreground with headlights on and a crumpled hood splashing through rainwater, 1 wrecked dark car in the right midground with severe front-end damage, and 1 overturned or airborne black SUV tilted upward behind it on the right side. Wet asphalt reflects headlights, firelight, and gray skyscrapers. Dense debris fills the air, with chunks of rubble frozen in motion. Overcast stormy daylight, desaturated blue-gray color palette with orange fire accents, dramatic motion blur in flying debris but sharp focus on the running figure, low-angle wide-lens composition, blockbuster disaster-movie realism, ultra-detailed textures, high contrast, dynamic depth, volumetric smoke, rain spray, cinematic lighting. Add a white {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} logo in the top-right corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级写实动作场景，背景位于雨中的市中心街道峡谷，展示了 {argument name="main subject" default="一名 30 多岁的深色头发男子"} 在前景中央正对着镜头奔跑，表情紧张，表现出求生欲，身穿湿透的深色夹克、深色衬衫和深色长裤，正处于迈步奔跑的姿态，一只手臂向前摆动。在他身后，一场巨大的城市爆炸撕裂了街道和高层建筑的下层外墙，向四面八方喷射出巨大的烟雾、火焰、灰尘、破碎的混凝土、玻璃和金属碎片。场景中包含 3 辆清晰可见的受损车辆：左前景中有一辆开着前大灯、引擎盖凹陷并溅起雨水的深色轿车；右中景中有一辆车头严重受损的深色汽车；右侧后方有一辆倾斜向上、翻倒或腾空的黑色 SUV。潮湿的沥青路面反射着前大灯、火光和灰色的摩天大楼。浓密的碎片充斥着空气，碎石块在运动中定格。阴沉的暴雨天气，去饱和的蓝灰色调搭配橙色火光，飞溅的碎片带有戏剧性的动态模糊，但奔跑的人物保持清晰对焦，低角度广角镜头构图，灾难大片般的真实感，超精细纹理，高对比度，动态景深，体积烟雾，雨水喷溅，电影级布光。在右上角添加一个白色的 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} 标志。

templates.title: Cinematic City Crash Explosion

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级城市撞击爆炸场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic ultra-realistic action scene on a rain-soaked urban street at dusk, showing a sudden multi-car crash and explosion in the middle of a modern city. In the foreground, one adult man with a blurred, indistinct face is running toward the camera between lanes, wearing a dark jacket and dark pants, his posture urgent and off-balance as if escaping danger. To his left is a dark gray sedan with headlights on, splashing through wet pavement. In the midground on the right, 2 wrecked cars are colliding: 1 silver sedan with its driver-side door open and 1 dark vehicle flipping upside down in midair, surrounded by shattered glass, torn metal, and flying debris. Count 2 visible fireballs in the background, one on the far left street and one large explosion on the right side, both sending sparks and black smoke into the sky. Show heavy smoke plumes rising above a dense downtown skyline of tall, slightly out-of-focus buildings. Include wet reflective asphalt, scattered car parts across the road, glowing streetlights, utility poles, overhead power lines, and a moody blue-gray storm atmosphere with orange firelight reflecting in puddles. Framing should be wide-angle and low to the street, with strong motion, dramatic perspective, cinematic depth of field, realistic physics, volumetric smoke, flying embers, and high-detail disaster-movie lighting. Add a white {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} watermark in the top-right corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 黄昏时分，雨后的城市街道上呈现出一幕电影级超写实动作场景，展示了现代城市中心突发的多车相撞与爆炸。前景中，一名面部模糊不清的成年男子正穿着深色夹克和长裤，在车道间向镜头方向奔跑，姿态急促且失去平衡，仿佛正在逃离危险。他的左侧是一辆开着前大灯的深灰色轿车，正溅起路面积水。中景右侧有 2 辆损毁的汽车正在碰撞：1 辆银色轿车驾驶座车门敞开，另 1 辆深色车辆在半空中翻转，周围散落着破碎的玻璃、撕裂的金属和飞溅的碎片。背景中可见 2 团火球，一团位于远处的左侧街道，另一团大型爆炸位于右侧，两者都向天空喷射着火星和黑烟。画面展示了浓重的烟雾升腾在密集且略显失焦的高层市中心建筑群上方。包含湿润的反光沥青路面、散落在路上的汽车零件、发光的街灯、电线杆、架空电线，以及带有橙色火光倒映在水洼中的忧郁蓝灰色风暴氛围。构图应采用广角低机位，强调强烈的动感、戏剧性的透视、电影级的景深、真实的物理效果、体积烟雾、飞舞的余烬以及高细节的灾难电影光影。在右上角添加一个白色的 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} 水印。

templates.title: Seaside Cafe Event Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 海边咖啡馆活动海报

templates.prompt:
Create a lively Chinese event poster with a warm, trendy coffee-shop aesthetic, photographed from inside a seaside cafe looking out through large floor-to-ceiling windows at palm trees, a bright blue sky, outdoor seating, and a Ferris wheel in the distance. The composition should feel like a candid lifestyle scene combined with energetic graphic design. In the foreground, place a dark wooden table with 1 open laptop centered near the bottom, 1 takeaway coffee cup with a black lid on the right side of the table, 1 black bag on the left, and 1 short stack of books near the left edge. Use a sunlit, slightly golden afternoon atmosphere with reflections on the glass and a relaxed vacation vibe.

Overlay bold poster graphics in a collage style using torn paper, brushstroke paint, stickers, and taped note-paper elements. The main headline on the upper left should be huge, hand-painted Chinese calligraphy in dark brown and orange, reading “疯狂星期四”, with a small yellow tag near it that reads “第11期”, and an even smaller top-left badge reading “活动预告” with a tiny megaphone icon. Beneath the main headline, add a green brushstroke banner with the text “下周四，不见不散！”, and below that a smaller line in parentheses: “（五一长假前最后一期）”.

Add 2 torn notebook-paper cards: 1 in the upper right and 1 in the lower left. The upper-right note should contain a short invitation paragraph in Chinese, neatly typeset in black and orange text, reading: “让我们海边小聚，远眺摩天轮，吹吹海风，和 App & AI Builder 们一起聊聊产品、远程生活与创作。” and include a small orange heart doodle in the bottom-right corner of that note. The lower-left note should list 3 info blocks with icons and orange section headers: “时间”, “地点”, and “说明”. Under “时间”, write “2026年04月23日 (星期四)” and “12:00 ~ 18:00”. Under “地点”, write “南山区·前海石公园·福叁咖啡”. Under “说明”, write “无需报名，随时来吧！”.

Across the middle-right area, place a large playful white script-style slogan with a dark outline, angled slightly upward, reading “喝咖啡、随意交流 海边散步，主打一个 Chill~”. Add 1 illustrated coffee cup sticker next to this slogan on the right. Use energetic orange paint splashes and sketch doodles around the headline and notes to make the poster feel youthful and spontaneous.

At the bottom, place a wide off-white torn-paper footer strip containing 3 feature blocks laid out horizontally. Block 1: a snowflake-like icon with the text “舒适环境” and smaller text “空调 + 宽敞桌椅”. Block 2: a Wi‑Fi icon with the text “电网无忧” and smaller text “WiFi + 插座”. Block 3: larger orange handwritten text “期待与你 海边相遇！” with a blue underline flourish and a tiny heart doodle. The overall design should mix real photography and graphic poster elements, with strong contrast, brush lettering, scrapbook textures, cafe lifestyle realism, and a fashionable AI-generated social-media event-poster look.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张充满活力、具有温暖时尚咖啡馆美学的中文活动海报。画面视角从海边咖啡馆内部向外拍摄，透过巨大的落地窗可以看到棕榈树、明亮的蓝天、户外座位以及远处的摩天轮。构图应兼具真实的生活场景感与充满能量的平面设计感。在前景中，放置一张深色木桌，桌子底部中央放置 1 台打开的笔记本电脑，右侧放置 1 个带黑色杯盖的外带咖啡杯，左侧放置 1 个黑色包，左边缘附近放着一小叠书。使用阳光明媚、略带金色午后的氛围，玻璃上有反光，营造出轻松的度假感。

以拼贴风格叠加醒目的海报图形，使用撕纸、笔触涂鸦、贴纸和胶带纸条等元素。左上角的主标题应为巨大的深棕色和橙色手写书法字体，写着“疯狂星期四”，旁边有一个写着“第 11 期”的小黄标签，左上角还有一个更小的徽章，上面写着“活动预告”并配有一个微型扩音器图标。在主标题下方，添加一个绿色笔触横幅，文字为“下周四，不见不散！”，下方括号内附上一行较小的文字：“（五一长假前最后一期）”。

添加 2 张撕裂的笔记本纸卡：一张在右上角，一张在左下角。右上角的纸条应包含一段简洁的中文邀请文案，采用黑色和橙色字体排版，写着：“让我们海边小聚，远眺摩天轮，吹吹海风，和 App & AI Builder 们一起聊聊产品、远程生活与创作。”并在纸条右下角加上一个橙色的小心形涂鸦。左下角的纸条应列出 3 个带有图标和橙色标题的信息块：“时间”、“地点”和“说明”。在“时间”下写上“2026 年 04 月 23 日 (星期四)”和“12:00 ~ 18:00”。在“地点”下写上“南山区·前海石公园·福叁咖啡”。在“说明”下写上“无需报名，随时来吧！”。

在右中区域，放置一个巨大的、带有深色描边的白色手写风格俏皮标语，略微向上倾斜，写着“喝咖啡、随意交流 海边散步，主打一个 Chill~”。在此标语右侧添加 1 个插画风格的咖啡杯贴纸。在标题和纸条周围使用充满活力的橙色油漆溅射和素描涂鸦，使海报看起来年轻且随性。

在底部，放置一条宽大的米白色撕纸风格页脚，横向排列 3 个功能块。第 1 块：一个雪花状图标，配文“舒适环境”及小字“空调 + 宽敞桌椅”。第 2 块：一个 Wi‑Fi 图标，配文“电网无忧”及小字“WiFi + 插座”。第 3 块：较大的橙色手写文字“期待与你 海边相遇！”，下方带有蓝色下划线装饰和一个微型心形涂鸦。整体设计应融合真实摄影与平面海报元素，具有强烈的对比度、书法笔触、剪贴簿质感、咖啡馆生活气息以及时尚的 AI 生成社交媒体活动海报风格。

templates.title: Teddy Bear Mona Lisa Hybrid

titleLocalized.zh: 泰迪熊版蒙娜丽莎混合体

templates.prompt: A surreal oil painting in the style of Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, reimagined as a teddy-bear hybrid portrait. The subject sits in the same half-length frontal pose with folded hands, wearing the dark Renaissance dress and soft draped shawl of the original painting, against the classic hazy landscape with winding water, distant mountains, and muted atmospheric perspective. The figure has 2 round fluffy teddy bear ears on top of the head and 2 plush furry paws folded at the bottom, with a warm beige teddy-bear fur chest replacing the visible skin of the neckline and hands. Long dark brown hair falls smoothly over both shoulders. The face area is intentionally left as a flat featureless brown rectangular block, creating an uncanny censored or unfinished effect. Use cracked varnish texture, aged museum-painting patina, smoky sfumato transitions, low-saturation brown and olive tones, soft golden lighting, centered composition, highly detailed fur texture blended into classical portrait brushwork, whimsical yet eerie fine-art parody.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅模仿列奥纳多·达·芬奇《蒙娜丽莎》风格的超现实主义油画，将其重新构想为泰迪熊混合肖像。主体保持了原作中半身正面、双手交叠的姿势，身着文艺复兴时期的深色长裙和柔软的披肩，背景是经典的朦胧风景，包含蜿蜒的水流、远山以及柔和的空气透视感。人物头顶长有 2 只圆润蓬松的泰迪熊耳朵，底部交叠着 2 只毛茸茸的爪子，领口和手部原本的皮肤由温暖的米色泰迪熊毛皮取代。深棕色的长发顺滑地垂在双肩。面部区域特意留白为一个平坦且无特征的棕色矩形块，营造出一种诡异的被审查或未完成的效果。采用龟裂的清漆质感、陈旧的博物馆画作光泽、烟雾般的晕涂法（sfumato）过渡、低饱和度的棕色和橄榄色调、柔和的金色光线、居中构图，将高度细腻的毛皮质感与古典肖像笔触完美融合，呈现出一种既怪诞又奇妙的艺术戏仿效果。

templates.title: Teddy Bear with a Pearl Earring

titleLocalized.zh: 戴珍珠耳环的泰迪熊

templates.prompt: A classical oil painting in the style of a 17th-century Dutch master, closely inspired by Vermeer’s composition, showing a teddy bear posed as the subject of a formal portrait. The bear is shown in three-quarter view from the shoulders up against a deep black background, turning its head slightly toward the viewer. It has soft golden-brown plush fur, one rounded fuzzy ear clearly visible and the other partially visible beneath a large blue-and-gold turban wrapped around its head, with a long fabric tail draping down the right side. The bear wears a single oversized pearl earring hanging from the visible ear area, echoing the iconic “girl with a pearl earring” look. The clothing includes 2 visible garments: a warm golden-brown robe or coat and a small white collar at the neckline. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the left, rich painterly texture, subtle canvas grain, realistic fabric folds, gentle highlights on the pearl, and a museum-quality old master atmosphere. Keep the composition simple, centered, and elegant, with the teddy bear’s face rendered as a plush toy version of a noble portrait subject, blending cute toy texture with fine-art realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅 17 世纪荷兰大师风格的古典油画，灵感紧扣维米尔的构图，展示了一只泰迪熊作为正式肖像画的主角。泰迪熊以四分之三侧面示人，从肩膀以上入画，背景为深黑色，头部微微转向观众。它拥有柔软的金棕色毛绒皮毛，一只圆润的毛绒耳朵清晰可见，另一只则部分隐藏在头顶缠绕的蓝金相间大头巾下，长长的布料尾部垂在右侧。泰迪熊在可见的耳部佩戴着一只超大珍珠耳环，呼应了标志性的“戴珍珠耳环的少女”造型。服装包括两件可见的服饰：一件温暖的金棕色长袍或外套，以及领口处的一小圈白色衣领。采用从左侧射入的戏剧性明暗对照法，呈现丰富的绘画质感、细腻的画布纹理、逼真的布料褶皱、珍珠上的柔和高光，以及博物馆级的古典大师氛围。构图保持简洁、居中且优雅，将泰迪熊的面部呈现为毛绒玩具版的贵族肖像主体，完美融合了可爱的玩具质感与美术写实风格。

templates.title: Teddy Bear Creation Fresco

titleLocalized.zh: 泰迪熊版《创世纪》壁画

templates.prompt: A whimsical high-detail oil-painting parody of Michelangelo’s Creation of Adam, but all human figures are replaced by teddy bears. On the left, a single plush teddy bear sits reclined on a rocky slope, posed like Adam, with soft golden-brown curly fur, round ears, shiny black eyes, a small dark nose, and a slightly open mouth. Its left arm supports its body while its right arm stretches outward, index paw extended toward the other bear. On the right, a larger central teddy bear posed like God emerges from a deep reddish-burgundy swirling mantle, wearing a flowing white draped robe, leaning forward with one outstretched arm and pointed paw reaching toward the left bear, almost touching fingertips. Surrounding the robed bear inside the mantle are 8 additional smaller teddy bears clustered tightly together, peeking from different angles like attendant figures. The composition exactly echoes the iconic near-touching hands scene, with the gap between fingertips centered. Use a cracked fresco wall background in warm beige tones, muted Renaissance palette, soft directional light, realistic fabric folds, detailed plush texture, subtle shadows, and a museum-quality painted surface. Blend classical Renaissance fresco aesthetics with charming surreal humor, keeping the scene elegant rather than cartoonish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满奇趣且细节丰富的油画风格《创世纪》戏仿作品，米开朗基罗原作中的人类形象全部被泰迪熊取代。画面左侧，一只毛绒泰迪熊斜倚在岩石坡上，姿态模仿亚当，拥有柔软的金棕色卷毛、圆耳朵、闪亮的黑眼睛、小巧的深色鼻子和微张的嘴。它的左臂支撑着身体，右臂向外伸展，食指爪尖伸向另一只熊。画面右侧，一只体型较大的泰迪熊模仿上帝的姿态，从深红酒色的漩涡状斗篷中显现，身披飘逸的白色垂褶长袍，身体前倾，伸出一只手臂，指尖爪尖向左侧的熊探去，几乎触碰到对方。在斗篷内，围绕着身穿长袍的泰迪熊，还有 8 只体型较小的泰迪熊紧密簇拥，从不同角度探出头来，宛如随从。构图精准还原了标志性的“指尖触碰”场景，两指间的空隙位于画面中心。背景采用暖米色的裂纹壁画质感，运用柔和的文艺复兴色调、柔和的定向光、逼真的织物褶皱、细腻的毛绒质感、微妙的阴影以及博物馆级的绘画表面。将古典文艺复兴壁画美学与迷人的超现实幽默感融为一体，保持画面优雅而不失童趣。

templates.title: Teddy Bear Last Supper

titleLocalized.zh: 泰迪熊版《最后的晚餐》

templates.prompt: A whimsical yet reverent Renaissance-style parody of The Last Supper, with exactly 13 anthropomorphic teddy bears seated along one side of a long banquet table in a grand classical dining hall. The central bear is the clear focal point, posed like Jesus, facing forward with a calm, solemn expression, wearing a muted red robe with a deep blue drape. The other 12 teddy bears cluster in animated conversational groups to the left and right, each with slightly different fur tones from honey brown to cream, all with soft plush texture, rounded ears, black bead-like eyes, and expressive paws raised in discussion. Dress the surrounding bears in painterly biblical robes in earthy reds, dusty blues, ochres, and greens. Recreate the composition closely to Leonardo da Vinci’s Last Supper: symmetrical perspective, coffered wooden ceiling, three rear windows with soft blue mountain landscape visible outside, dark wall tapestries on both side walls, and a long white tablecloth hanging over trestle supports. On the table, include scattered small bread rolls, plates, bowls, and multiple small glasses of dark red wine spaced across the full length. Use warm museum-like lighting, aged fresco tones, soft shadows, detailed oil-paint texture, and a highly polished old-master look, balancing humor with genuine artistic beauty. No modern objects, no text, no extra characters, straight-on wide composition, full table visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅既奇幻又庄重的文艺复兴风格《最后的晚餐》戏仿画作，画面中 13 只拟人化的泰迪熊并排坐在一张长宴会桌的一侧，背景位于宏伟的古典餐厅内。中央的泰迪熊是视觉焦点，姿态模仿耶稣，面朝前方，表情沉稳庄重，身穿柔和的红色长袍，披着深蓝色披肩。其余 12 只泰迪熊在左右两侧聚集成生动的交谈小组，每只熊的毛色略有不同，从蜜棕色到奶油色不等，均呈现出柔软的毛绒质感、圆润的耳朵、黑豆般的眼睛，以及在讨论中抬起的富有表现力的爪子。周围的泰迪熊穿着绘有大地红、灰蓝、赭石和绿色等圣经风格长袍。构图紧密还原列奥纳多·达·芬奇的《最后的晚餐》：对称的透视感、方格木制天花板、三个可以看到柔和蓝色山景的后窗、两侧墙壁上的深色挂毯，以及铺在支架桌上的长条白桌布。桌上散落着小面包卷、盘子、碗以及沿桌摆放的多只盛有深红葡萄酒的小杯子。采用温暖的博物馆式灯光、陈旧的壁画色调、柔和的阴影、细腻的油画质感，呈现出高度精致的大师级画作风格，在幽默感与纯粹的艺术美感之间取得平衡。无现代物品，无文字，无额外角色，采用正面广角构图，完整展示整张餐桌。

templates.title: Cute Chinese Tokenization Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的中文分词科普信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A cute hand-drawn scrapbook-style horizontal educational infographic in Chinese on a warm beige paper background with rounded borders, pastel doodles, tape stickers, tiny stars, and a classroom-notebook aesthetic. The top center has a large headline in playful handwritten Chinese: "什么是分词？" with the second half in coral pink and the rest in dark brown. On the upper left, a chibi Shiba Inu teacher character stands facing forward, wearing a pale yellow shirt and blue necktie, holding a pointer stick upward, with a speech bubble that says "今天来学习分词(Tokenization)!". On the upper right, a cute blue square token mascot labeled "TOKEN" sits smiling, with blush cheeks, tiny legs and arms, and a magnifying glass; next to it is a speech bubble saying "我是 Token！被切得越合理，模型越聪明！". Near the right edge, add a small hanging notepad card reading "知识点 收藏夹" with a heart icon. Beneath the headline, place a rounded dashed text box containing the definition: "分词是将人类可读的文本切分成 Token 的过程。" with the word "Token" highlighted in blue. Below that, add a line of explanatory text: "下面以 “程序员Left” 和 “人工智能” 为例，看看不同的分词方式：" with "程序员Left" highlighted in light blue and "人工智能" highlighted in pink. The lower half contains exactly 4 rounded pastel panels arranged left to right, each with a numbered badge and title. Panel 1 is mint green and titled "1 词级分词". It includes the subtitle "按完整语义划分文本" and exactly 3 token bubbles: "程序员", "Left", "人工智能". At the bottom of this panel, show the Shiba Inu teacher giving a thumbs up with a speech bubble saying "语义完整，容易理解！". Panel 2 is pale yellow and titled "2 字符级分词". It includes the subtitle "逐字切分文本" and exactly 9 circular token bubbles arranged in rows: "程", "序", "员", "L", "e", "f", "t", "人", "工", "智", "能"—visually presented as individual characters from the example text, in a compact grid. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot holding a pencil, with a speech bubble saying "粒度最细，但序列会很长~". Panel 3 is pale pink and titled "3 子词分词". It includes the subtitle "按词根以及前后缀划分" and exactly 5 token bubbles: "程序", "员", "Left", "人工", "智能". At the bottom, show the Shiba Inu teacher thinking with one paw at its mouth and a question mark above the head, with a speech bubble saying "折中方案，效果 often 很好！". Panel 4 is pale blue and titled "4 字节级分词". It includes the subtitle "将字词转为字节编码，根据转换后的内容进行组合和划分" and displays exactly 14 small circular code bubbles: "E7", "A8", "8B", "...", "66", "74", "E4", "BA", "BA", "E8", "83", "BD", "..." arranged in multiple rows like encoded bytes. At the bottom, show the blue token mascot again, smiling, with a speech bubble saying "适合处理任意文本！" and a tiny light bulb doodle nearby. Across the very bottom, place a rounded banner note that reads: "不同分词方式各有优势，实际应用中会根据任务和数据选择合适的方案哦！". Use soft pastel green, yellow, pink, and blue for the four panels, dark brown handwritten text, subtle shadows, rounded shapes, and adorable kawaii expressions throughout. Keep the composition balanced, clean, and friendly, like a polished social-media science explainer poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的横版手绘剪贴簿风格中文科普信息图，背景为暖米色纸张，带有圆角边框、马卡龙色涂鸦、胶带贴纸、小星星，充满课堂笔记本的氛围。顶部中央有醒目的手写体中文标题：“什么是分词？”，其中后半部分为珊瑚粉色，其余部分为深棕色。左上方有一只 Q 版柴犬老师角色，身穿淡黄色衬衫，系着蓝色领带，正面向前方，手持教鞭向上，旁边的对话气泡写着：“今天来学习分词 (Tokenization)！”。右上方有一个可爱的蓝色方形 Token 吉祥物，上面标有“TOKEN”，正微笑着，脸颊红润，长着细小的四肢，手里拿着放大镜；旁边有一个对话气泡写着：“我是 Token！被切得越合理，模型越聪明！”。在右边缘附近，添加一张悬挂的小记事卡，上面写着“知识点 收藏夹”，并配有一个爱心图标。在标题下方，放置一个圆角虚线文本框，包含定义：“分词是将人类可读的文本切分成 Token 的过程。”，其中“Token”一词用蓝色高亮显示。下方添加一行说明文字：“下面以 “程序员Left” 和 “人工智能” 为例，看看不同的分词方式：”，其中“程序员Left”用浅蓝色高亮，“人工智能”用粉色高亮。下半部分包含 4 个从左到右排列的圆角马卡龙色面板，每个面板都有编号徽章和标题。面板 1 为薄荷绿，标题为“1 词级分词”，副标题为“按完整语义划分文本”，包含 3 个 Token 气泡：“程序员”、“Left”、“人工智能”。在此面板底部，展示柴犬老师竖起大拇指，对话气泡写着：“语义完整，容易理解！”。面板 2 为淡黄色，标题为“2 字符级分词”，副标题为“逐字切分文本”，包含 9 个排列成行的圆形 Token 气泡：“程”、“序”、“员”、“L”、“e”、“f”、“t”、“人”、“工”、“智”、“能”——以紧凑的网格形式呈现示例中的单个字符。底部展示蓝色 Token 吉祥物手持铅笔，对话气泡写着：“粒度最细，但序列会很长~”。面板 3 为淡粉色，标题为“3 子词分词”，副标题为“按词根以及前后缀划分”，包含 5 个 Token 气泡：“程序”、“员”、“Left”、“人工”、“智能”。底部展示柴犬老师正在思考，一只爪子放在嘴边，头顶上方有一个问号，对话气泡写着：“折中方案，效果 often 很好！”。面板 4 为淡蓝色，标题为“4 字节级分词”，副标题为“将字词转为字节编码，根据转换后的内容进行组合和划分”，展示 14 个圆形小代码气泡：“E7”、“A8”、“8B”、“...”、“66”、“74”、“E4”、“BA”、“BA”、“E8”、“83”、“BD”、“...”像编码字节一样排列成多行。底部再次展示微笑的蓝色 Token 吉祥物，对话气泡写着：“适合处理任意文本！”，旁边有一个微小的灯泡涂鸦。在最底部，放置一个圆角横幅备注，写着：“不同分词方式各有优势，实际应用中会根据任务和数据选择合适的方案哦！”。四个面板使用柔和的马卡龙绿、黄、粉、蓝色，搭配深棕色手写字体、细腻的阴影、圆润的形状和可爱的表情。整体构图平衡、简洁且友好，如同精美的社交媒体科普海报。

templates.title: Scrapbook Byte-level BPE Explainer

titleLocalized.zh: Scrapbook Byte-level BPE 原理解析

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A cute horizontal educational infographic in a hand-drawn scrapbook style on a pastel desk-and-paper collage background, explaining Chinese word segmentation with byte-level BPE. The scene is divided into 3 clearly separated instructional sections arranged from left to right across a wide banner. On the far left stands a chibi Shiba Inu mascot, {argument name="character name" default="柴小七"}, with warm tan and cream fur, round face, small triangular ears, rosy cheeks, and a curious expression, holding a cup and standing beside a small desk with drawers, pencils, and a chair. Above the dog is a bold rounded white title box with black Chinese text: {argument name="headline text" default="中文分词：Byte-level BPE（BBPE）流程科普"}. In the first teaching section near the upper middle, show 4 small translucent blue token-shaped tiles lined up on a wooden shelf, each labeled “Token”, with a curved arrow and small handwritten Chinese note “词频语料统计” pointing toward the next step. In the second section, place a large magnifying glass highlighting 3 small frequency tiles labeled exactly “E7”, “94”, and “B5”, with the section label in a yellow note reading “2. 频率统计与合并”; beneath and inside the magnified area include a large black Chinese character “电”, and nearby a handwritten note “频繁字节对”. In the third section at lower middle-left, add a wooden sign and a larger merged translucent blue token tile labeled “Token”, with a small yellow note reading “3. 跨字合并”, large black Chinese text “我们→”, and a caption strip below that says “高频词组合并为 Token”. On the far right, show the final explanatory result with 3 small byte boxes labeled “E7”, “94”, and “B5” above a large black Chinese character “电”, then a note card reading “1. 字节级编码（UTF-8）”, and below that the large black Chinese word “我们”. Connect the sections with curved arrows in pink, blue, and green to show process flow. Include 1 animated blue token mascot with tiny arms and legs near the center-bottom, smiling and waving. Use soft cream, pink, beige, and light blue colors, thick clean outlines, sticker-like cutout shapes, taped paper corners, notebook textures, pencils around the edges, and a friendly hand-account illustration style suitable for a science explainer graphic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的横向教育信息图，采用手绘剪贴簿风格，背景为柔和的桌面和纸张拼贴，旨在解释基于 byte-level BPE 的中文分词原理。画面被分为 3 个清晰的教学区域，从左至右横跨整个宽幅横幅。最左侧站着一只可爱的柴犬吉祥物，{argument name="character name" default="柴小七"}，拥有温暖的棕褐色和奶油色毛发、圆脸、小三角耳、红润的脸颊和好奇的表情，手里拿着一个杯子，站在一张带有抽屉、铅笔和椅子的书桌旁。在柴犬上方是一个粗体圆角的白色标题框，内含黑色中文字符：{argument name="headline text" default="中文分词：Byte-level BPE（BBPE）流程科普"}。在靠近上方的第一个教学区域，展示 4 个排列在木架上的半透明蓝色 Token 形状方块，每个方块上标注“Token”，并配有一个弯曲的箭头和手写中文注释“词频语料统计”，指向下一步。在第二个区域，放置一个巨大的放大镜，突出显示 3 个标有“E7”、“94”和“B5”的频率方块，区域标签写在黄色便签上，内容为“2. 频率统计与合并”；在放大区域下方和内部包含一个巨大的黑色汉字“电”，旁边附有手写注释“频繁字节对”。在第三个区域的中下方，添加一个木制标牌和一个更大的合并后的半透明蓝色 Token 方块，上面标注“Token”，并附有一张黄色便签，写着“3. 跨字合并”，大号黑色中文字符“我们→”，下方配有说明条“高频词组合并为 Token”。在最右侧，展示最终的解释结果，3 个标有“E7”、“94”和“B5”的小字节方块位于一个巨大的黑色汉字“电”上方，旁边是一张写有“1. 字节级编码（UTF-8）”的便签卡，下方是巨大的黑色中文词汇“我们”。用粉色、蓝色和绿色的弯曲箭头连接各个区域，以展示流程走向。在底部中央附近包含一个带有细小四肢、面带微笑并挥手的蓝色 Token 吉祥物。使用柔和的奶油色、粉色、米色和浅蓝色，线条厚实清晰，采用贴纸般的剪裁形状、胶带纸角、笔记本纹理、边缘散落的铅笔，以及适合科普图表的友好手账插画风格。

templates.title: Celestial Dynasty World Bible Board

titleLocalized.zh: Celestial Dynasty 世界观设定项目

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the visual foundation, expand the single sky-palace scene into a complete cinematic world-building presentation for a fantasy civilization. Preserve the same East Asian celestial imperial design language, floating architecture above clouds, gilded ornamentation, warm sunset lighting, and ultra-detailed realistic concept-art look, then turn it into a polished multi-panel lore board on a dark background with elegant editorial typography. Include 8 labeled sections: 1 large hero overview panel for the civilization, 1 architecture section with 9 images, 1 characters section with 7 full-body character designs, 1 clothing and armor section with 6 outfit variations, 1 vehicles and transport section with 4 vehicle designs, 1 world map section with 1 illustrated map, 1 environments section with 6 environment images, and 1 culture and details section with 6 close-up detail images. Add a refined fantasy title and short lore paragraph for the civilization, using the name {argument name="civilization name" default="Celestial Dynasty"}. The architecture section should show 9 distinct items: palace, temple, gate, pillar, bridge, throne hall, garden, library, and observatory. The characters section should show 7 archetypes: emperor, empress, high priest, general, royal guard, scholar, and artisan. The clothing and armor section should show 6 designs: ceremonial robe, battle armor, noble attire, priest robes, artisan garments, and dancer costume. The vehicles and transport section should show 4 designs: an airship, a flying beast mount, a sky chariot, and a ceremonial palanquin. The environments section should show 6 scenes: one wide banner panorama plus 5 smaller locations, including forest, mountain peaks, lotus valley, golden fields, and a celestial port. The culture and details section should show 6 images: dragon motif, lantern or artifact, palace interior, scholarly scene, mechanical instruments, and decorative symbols. Keep all panels visually unified as if from one official franchise world bible, with extremely rich detail, believable material design, and cinematic realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为视觉基础，将单一的天宫场景扩展为完整的电影级奇幻文明世界观演示。保持相同的东亚天朝设计语言、云端悬浮建筑、镀金装饰、温暖的夕阳照明以及超精细的写实概念艺术风格，并将其制作成深色背景下带有优雅排版的多面板 lore 项目。包含 8 个标注版块：1 个文明大型主视觉概览面板，1 个包含 9 张图片的建筑版块，1 个包含 7 个全身角色设计的角色版块，1 个包含 6 种服装变体的服饰与盔甲版块，1 个包含 4 种载具设计的载具与交通版块，1 个包含 1 张插画地图的世界地图版块，1 个包含 6 张环境图片的环境版块，以及 1 个包含 6 张特写细节图片的文化与细节版块。添加一个精致的奇幻标题和一段简短的文明背景介绍，使用名称 {argument name="civilization name" default="Celestial Dynasty"}。建筑版块应展示 9 个不同的项目：宫殿、寺庙、大门、柱子、桥梁、大殿、花园、图书馆和天文台。角色版块应展示 7 种原型：皇帝、皇后、大祭司、将军、皇家卫兵、学者和工匠。服饰与盔甲版块应展示 6 种设计：礼服、战甲、贵族服饰、祭司长袍、工匠服饰和舞者服装。载具与交通版块应展示 4 种设计：飞艇、飞行坐骑、天车和礼仪轿子。环境版块应展示 6 个场景：一个宽幅横向全景图加上 5 个较小的地点，包括森林、山峰、莲花谷、金色田野和天港。文化与细节版块应展示 6 张图片：龙纹图案、灯笼或文物、宫殿内部、学术场景、机械仪器和装饰符号。保持所有面板在视觉上的统一性，如同出自同一官方系列作品的世界观设定集，具备极其丰富的细节、可信的材质设计和电影级的写实感。

templates.title: Reference-Based Cinematic World Expansion

titleLocalized.zh: 基于参考图的电影级世界观扩展

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the visual civilization seed, expand it into a new cinematic world scene that keeps the same grand East Asian fantasy design language, monumental scale, intricate architecture-first worldbuilding, and ultra-detailed realism, but shift the setting from a luminous cloud palace into an ancient mechanical ruin on the ground. Replace the gilded celestial temple environment with colossal circular ring structures, giant embedded gears, heavy industrial stone-and-metal architecture, broken conduits, and overgrown ruins with pale flowering trees. Change the mood to cold, misty, desaturated blue-gray lighting with soft atmospheric fog, while preserving the epic, awe-inspiring worldbuilding feel from the reference. Add 1 lone wandering swordsman seen from behind in the foreground, wearing flowing white robes and carrying a sheathed sword, centered beneath the largest ring to emphasize scale. Make it feel like a frame from a high-budget fantasy film, with extremely rich environmental detail and a cohesive visual language derived from the reference image.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像作为视觉文明的种子，将其扩展为一个全新的电影级世界场景。在保持宏大的东亚奇幻设计语言、纪念碑式的尺度、以建筑为核心的复杂世界观构建以及超细节写实感的同时，将场景从明亮的云端宫殿转变为地面上的古代机械遗迹。将镀金的仙境神庙环境替换为巨大的环形结构、嵌入的巨型齿轮、厚重的工业风石材与金属建筑、破损的管道，以及长满淡色花树的杂草丛生的废墟。将氛围调整为冷冽、朦胧、低饱和度的蓝灰色调，并辅以柔和的大气雾感，同时保留参考图中史诗般、令人惊叹的世界观质感。在前景中加入 1 位背对镜头的孤独流浪剑客，身着飘逸的白袍，佩戴着剑鞘，置于最大环形结构的正下方，以凸显尺度感。使其呈现出高预算奇幻电影画面的质感，具备极其丰富的环境细节，并展现出源自参考图像的连贯视觉语言。

templates.title: Isometric Coastal Base Under Naval Attack

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴视角下的海军突袭海岸基地

templates.prompt: An isometric real-time-strategy game battle scene viewed from a high oblique angle, showing a fortified coastal military outpost under naval attack in a desert oasis environment. The base sits in the lower left and center foreground, enclosed by pale concrete walls with defensive corner towers and several cylindrical turret emplacements. Inside the compound are 5 major structures: a large central metallic command or factory building with a curved roof and landing-pad markings, 1 long segmented industrial generator on the left, 1 smaller smokestack power structure near the bottom center, and 2 green cylindrical reactor or storage buildings on the right. Show dirt tracks, scattered crates, utility details, and a paved gray yard inside the walls. A large orange fireball explosion is erupting inside the base near the right-center interior, with smoke and debris. Another smaller explosion is happening outside the walls at the upper left on a dirt road near 2 red ground vehicles or launchers, with black smoke rising. The shoreline curves around shallow blue-green water with sandy banks, rocky cliffs, and many palm trees, creating a tropical desert cove. In the water on the right side, depict 5 gray modern warships in formation, angled diagonally, each leaving white wakes as they move. Count 8 missiles total with bright flaming trails arcing from the ships toward the land and base defenses; one missile is striking the nearest ship-side target area with a bright blue-white impact flash over the waterline, while others arc toward the compound and shore. Include tiny infantry figures near the beach and walls, some fallen, to suggest an active assault. The style should look like a polished high-detail strategy game screenshot, with realistic military sci-fi architecture, cinematic lighting, sharp textures, dynamic explosions, and readable spatial depth.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张从高斜角俯瞰的等轴视角即时战略游戏战斗场景，展示了沙漠绿洲环境中一个遭受海军攻击的加固型海岸军事前哨。基地位于左下方和中心前景，被带有防御角塔和数个圆柱形炮塔阵地的浅色混凝土墙包围。基地内部有 5 座主要建筑：一座位于中央的带有弧形屋顶和停机坪标记的大型金属指挥或工厂建筑，左侧有一座长条形分段式工业发电机，底部中心附近有一座较小的烟囱动力结构，右侧有两座绿色的圆柱形反应堆或仓储建筑。展示墙内的土路、散落的板条箱、公用设施细节以及铺设好的灰色场地。基地右中内部正爆发出一团巨大的橙色火球，伴随着烟雾和碎片。墙外左上方的一条土路上，靠近 2 辆红色地面载具或发射器的地方发生了另一次较小的爆炸，并升起黑烟。海岸线环绕着浅蓝绿色的水域，配有沙岸、岩石悬崖和许多棕榈树，营造出一个热带沙漠海湾。在右侧水域中，描绘 5 艘呈对角线编队航行的灰色现代战舰，每艘战舰移动时都留下了白色的尾迹。总共 8 枚导弹带着明亮的火焰轨迹从战舰射向陆地和基地防御设施；其中一枚导弹正击中靠近战舰一侧的目标区域，在水面上方产生明亮的蓝白色冲击闪光，其他导弹则呈弧线射向基地和海岸。在海滩和围墙附近加入微小的步兵模型，其中一些已经倒下，以体现激烈的突袭感。整体风格应呈现为精致的高细节战略游戏截图，具备写实的军事科幻建筑、电影级光影、锐利的纹理、动态爆炸效果以及清晰的空间深度。

templates.prompt: A cinematic first-person modern military battle on a tropical island coastline, viewed from the perspective of a soldier holding a black assault rifle in both hands at the lower right foreground, with dark tactical gloves visible. The scene shows a fortified coastal base under attack in bright midday sunlight beneath a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground and midground, depict a rugged dirt path with dry grass, scattered debris, crates, and metal barrels leading into a compact military installation made of futuristic-industrial bunkers and machinery painted olive green and gray. Include 5 prominent base structures: a rounded bunker with a small dome on the far left, a cylindrical tower just right of it, a large central arched hangar-like bunker with a dark entrance, 1 squat turreted structure on the right midground, and 1 stone-and-metal defensive wall section at the far right front. In the center midground, show 1 major ground explosion with orange fire and black smoke, plus 1 tall vertical smoke plume rising behind the base near the cliffs. The background features rocky cliffs lined with many palm trees and a small waterfall descending near the center-left, with the ocean and horizon visible to the right. Over the water, show 4 large gray battleships grouped near the coast on the right side. In the sky, include 3 helicopters, 4 smaller aircraft or drones in the distance, and 5 visible missile or rocket trails streaking diagonally across the sky from right to left, emphasizing an active large-scale assault. Ultra-detailed photorealistic AAA video game key art, realistic lighting, sharp textures, cinematic action composition, wide-angle first-person shooter viewpoint, high contrast, dynamic war atmosphere, epic scale.

templates.title: Chinese Tomato Nutrition Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 中式番茄营养海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
A clean premium food advertisement poster on a light gray-white studio background, featuring {argument name="fruit name" default="tomatoes"} as the hero subject. In the center, show exactly 7 tomato pieces arranged on a shallow round wooden plate: 5 whole ripe red tomatoes stacked in a natural pyramid, 1 halved tomato standing upright at the front center with glossy flesh and visible seeds, and 1 wedge slice placed at the lower right foreground. The tomatoes are fresh, vivid red, covered with realistic water droplets, with green stems attached to most whole fruits. Add a few green leaves and two small yellow tomato blossoms near the lower right edge for freshness accents. Use soft commercial lighting, gentle shadows, sharp focus, and highly realistic texture, in a polished supermarket-poster style.

Design the layout as a Chinese nutrition and freshness infographic poster. In the upper left, place a large two-line Chinese headline with strong typographic hierarchy: the first line in black reads {argument name="headline line 1" default="自然成熟"}, the second line in large warm red reads {argument name="headline line 2" default="营养美味"}. Below it, add a smaller gray Chinese slogan: {argument name="slogan text" default="每一口都是大自然的馈赠"}. Under the slogan, place exactly 3 simple red line icons in a horizontal row with short Chinese labels and gray sublabels beneath each: 1) a sun icon with text "充足日照" and subtext "自然成熟", 2) a sprout or leaf icon with text "科学种植" and subtext "健康美味", 3) a heart outline icon with text "新鲜采摘" and subtext "产地直供".

On the right side, create a thin curved red guide line framing the tomatoes, with exactly 4 circular nutrient callouts stacked vertically from top to bottom. Each callout is a red or red-orange gradient circle with a white symbol or letter inside, connected to the curve. Use these Chinese labels and explanatory text: 1) top callout with "C" and title "富含维生素C", description "有助于增强免疫力 促进胶原蛋白合成"; 2) second callout with a molecular icon and title "番茄红素", description "强效抗氧化剂 有助于抵御自由基"; 3) third callout with a leaf icon and title "膳食纤维", description "促进肠道蠕动 帮助消化"; 4) bottom callout with "K" and title "钾元素", description "有助于维持 心脏健康".

On the left lower side of the tomatoes, add exactly 2 red text feature callouts with fine red leader lines: the upper one titled "美味多汁" with smaller gray text "果肉饱满，汁水丰富 酸甜可口，回味无穷"; the lower one titled "新鲜采摘" with smaller gray text "人工精选，严格挑选 确保每一颗都新鲜优质".

Across the bottom, place a rounded rectangular nutrition table bar in white with light gray dividers. On the left end, add a solid red rounded label block containing the Chinese title {argument name="table title" default="营养成分表（每100g含量）"}. To its right, show exactly 6 nutrient columns with gray headings and darker values beneath: "能量" "20kcal"; "蛋白质" "0.9g"; "脂肪" "0.2g"; "碳水化合物" "4.2g"; "维生素C" "14mg"; "钾" "179mg". Center a tiny gray footnote below the table: "* 数据来源于《中国食物成分表》". Overall style: elegant Chinese fresh-produce marketing poster, balanced whitespace, red-accented infographic design, realistic product photography blended with clean vector UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张简洁的高端食品广告海报，背景为浅灰白色摄影棚背景，以 {argument name="fruit name" default="番茄"} 作为主体。在画面中心，展示 7 个摆放在浅圆形木盘上的番茄：5 个成熟的红番茄自然堆叠成金字塔状，1 个对半切开的番茄直立在前方中心，果肉光泽且种子清晰可见，另有 1 个番茄楔形切片放置在右下角前景。番茄新鲜、色泽鲜红，表面覆盖着逼真的水珠，大多数完整果实带有绿色果蒂。在右下角边缘添加几片绿叶和两朵黄色番茄小花，增添新鲜感。采用柔和的商业照明、柔和的阴影、清晰的对焦和高度逼真的质感，呈现出精致的超市海报风格。

将布局设计为中式营养与新鲜度信息图海报。在左上角，放置一个醒目的两行中文标题，具有强烈的排版层级：第一行黑色文字为 {argument name="headline line 1" default="自然成熟"}，第二行大号暖红色文字为 {argument name="headline line 2" default="营养美味"}。在其下方，添加一行较小的灰色中文标语：{argument name="slogan text" default="每一口都是大自然的馈赠"}。在标语下方，水平排列 3 个简单的红色线条图标，每个图标下方配有简短的中文标签和灰色副标题：1) 太阳图标，文字为“充足日照”，副标题为“自然成熟”；2) 嫩芽或叶片图标，文字为“科学种植”，副标题为“健康美味”；3) 心形轮廓图标，文字为“新鲜采摘”，副标题为“产地直供”。

在右侧，绘制一条细长的红色弧形引导线环绕番茄，并垂直堆叠 4 个圆形营养标注。每个标注均为红色或红橙色渐变圆圈，内部带有白色符号或字母，并与引导线相连。使用以下中文标签和说明文字：1) 顶部标注为“C”，标题“富含维生素C”，说明“有助于增强免疫力 促进胶原蛋白合成”；2) 第二个标注为分子图标，标题“番茄红素”，说明“强效抗氧化剂 有助于抵御自由基”；3) 第三个标注为叶片图标，标题“膳食纤维”，说明“促进肠道蠕动 帮助消化”；4) 底部标注为“K”，标题“钾元素”，说明“有助于维持 心脏健康”。

在番茄左下方，添加 2 个带有红色细引导线的红色文字功能标注：上方标题为“美味多汁”，配有较小的灰色文字“果肉饱满，汁水丰富 酸甜可口，回味无穷”；下方标题为“新鲜采摘”，配有较小的灰色文字“人工精选，严格挑选 确保每一颗都新鲜优质”。

在底部，放置一个带有浅灰色分隔线的白色圆角矩形营养成分表栏。左端添加一个实心红色圆角标签块，包含中文标题 {argument name="table title" default="营养成分表（每100g含量）"}。右侧展示 6 列营养成分，上方为灰色标题，下方为深色数值：“能量” “20kcal”；“蛋白质” “0.9g”；“脂肪” “0.2g”；“碳水化合物” “4.2g”；“维生素C” “14mg”；“钾” “179mg”。在表格下方居中放置一行微小的灰色脚注：“* 数据来源于《中国食物成分表》”。整体风格：优雅的中式生鲜营销海报，留白平衡，红色点缀的信息图设计，逼真的产品摄影与简洁的矢量 UI 元素完美融合。

templates.title: Chinese Cooking Cognition Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 中式烹饪认知信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A vintage hand-drawn Chinese infographic on textured off-white paper with torn deckled edges, printed in a limited two-ink palette of deep purple and bright cyan accents, with halftone shading and poster-like comic line art. The composition compares intuitive manual cooking versus tool-assisted cooking and externalized cognition. On the left, a large adult cook in an apron is dramatically stir-frying in a wok with flames, flying ingredients, smoke swirls, and energetic motion lines; the cook’s face is obscured by a rectangular blur block. Above the head is a glowing brain-like thought bubble containing 3 small icons: a seasoning bottle, a flame, and a timer/clock, with rays radiating outward. At the lower left, a broken chain hangs beside large bold Chinese text reading “全凭手感”. Below the cook, a smaller confused person mixing in a bowl looks worried, surrounded by exactly 4 question marks. In the center, multiple thick arrows point from the cook’s intuition toward a structured cooking workflow. At upper center is large Chinese text “照着做”. Beneath it, a hand holds a smartphone recipe screen showing visible Chinese text including “5克盐” and “中火3分钟”, with a finger tapping the screen. Around the phone are measured cooking tools and ingredients: 2 measuring spoons, 1 measuring cup, 1 digital scale, and 6 small bowls arranged neatly, plus a pot on a stove with steam rising and a finished plated dish nearby. Near the plated dish is Chinese text “七八分” and a 5-star rating row with exactly 4 filled stars and 1 empty star. On the right, show a concept map of externalized cognition around a simple smiling stick-figure cook standing behind a table of food. The node network is connected with cyan lines and includes exactly 6 tool/info nodes: a smart oven at the top, 2 seasoning packets labeled “调料包” and “榨酱包”, 1 clipboard labeled “精准配方”, 1 blender, 1 rice cooker, and 1 recipe note sheet. Centered in this network is large Chinese text “认知外化”. The table in front of the figure holds exactly 5 dishes/bowls/plates of prepared food. Along the bottom is a simplified cognition equation: a large brain icon, then an arrow to a smaller brain icon, then a cluster of external tools/documents including a phone screen, a microwave-like appliance, and 3 paper/manual items, then an equals sign, then a muscular human silhouette with gears inside the torso and an upward arrow near the shoulder. Beneath or beside this equation is bold Chinese text “脑 + 外部工具 = 更强能力”, with the first “脑” also shown separately under the left brain icon. Use expressive sketched arrows, doodle lightning bolts, comic emphasis marks, and a balanced left-to-right flow that visually communicates the transition from pure instinct to repeatable systems and augmented ability.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古手绘风格的中式信息图，印在带有撕边效果的米白色纹理纸上，采用深紫色和亮青色双色调印刷，结合了半色调阴影和海报般的漫画线条。画面对比了直觉式手工烹饪与工具辅助烹饪及认知外化。左侧，一位穿着围裙的成年厨师正在锅中进行夸张的翻炒，伴有火焰、飞溅的食材、烟雾旋涡和充满活力的运动线条；厨师的面部被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。头顶上方是一个发光的脑状思维气泡，内含 3 个小图标：调料瓶、火焰和计时器/时钟，并向外放射光芒。左下角，一条断裂的锁链悬挂在醒目的中文大字“全凭手感”旁。厨师下方，一个小人正困惑地搅拌着碗，神情焦虑，周围环绕着正好 4 个问号。画面中央，多支粗箭头从厨师的直觉指向结构化的烹饪工作流。上方中央是醒目的中文大字“照着做”。下方，一只手拿着智能手机，屏幕上显示着清晰的中文文本，包括“5 克盐”和“中火 3 分钟”，手指正在点击屏幕。手机周围摆放着量具和食材：2 把量勺、1 个量杯、1 台电子秤和 6 个整齐排列的小碗，旁边是一个冒着蒸汽的锅和一道成品菜肴。成品菜肴旁有中文文本“七八分”以及一行 5 星评分，其中 4 颗星为实心，1 颗星为空心。右侧展示了一个认知外化的概念图，一位微笑的火柴人厨师站在餐桌后。节点网络由青色线条连接，包含正好 6 个工具/信息节点：顶部的智能烤箱、2 包分别标注为“调料包”和“榨酱包”的调料、1 个标注为“精准配方”的剪贴板、1 台搅拌机、1 台电饭煲和 1 张食谱笔记。网络中心是醒目的中文大字“认知外化”。火柴人面前的桌子上摆放着正好 5 盘/碗准备好的食物。底部是一个简化的认知公式：一个大脑图标，指向一个较小的大脑图标，接着是一组外部工具/文档（包括手机屏幕、类似微波炉的设备和 3 件纸质/手册类物品），然后是一个等号，最后是一个躯干内带有齿轮的肌肉发达的人类剪影，肩部附近有一个向上箭头。在此公式下方或旁边是粗体中文文本“脑 + 外部工具 = 更强能力”，第一个“脑”字也单独显示在左侧大脑图标下方。使用富有表现力的草图箭头、涂鸦闪电、漫画强调符号，以及平衡的从左到右的流程，直观地传达从纯粹直觉到可重复系统及增强能力的转变。

templates.title: Dark Chinese Fantasy Desire Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑风中国神话“欲”主题海报

templates.prompt: A dark epic Chinese fantasy poster centered on the single gold calligraphy character {argument name="main Chinese character" default="欲"} dominating the upper left, rendered in huge textured brushed gold ink with rough edges and metallic leaf-like highlights. The scene is a cavernous infernal passage in deep black, bronze, and molten amber tones, lit by a blinding sacred glow at the top of a long stone staircase. At the top center-right stands an ornate golden lotus lamp or ritual chalice radiating holy light like a sun halo. In the lower center, show 1 lone ragged human figure from behind, slim and exhausted, wearing tattered dark robes shredded by the wind, reaching one arm upward toward the light while standing on a cracked stone path that becomes stairs. Flowing through the composition are 6 visible crimson silk ribbons or smoke-like fabric strands curling dramatically from left, right, and foreground, adding motion. Carve or inscribe 5 clearly visible Chinese characters onto broken stone slabs along the path and lower foreground: 情, 贪, 嗔, 痴, 慢, each glowing faintly in warm gold. Build the cave walls from writhing organic rock and shadow, with 3 large ghostly human faces emerging from the stone on the left and right sides, as if embodiments of temptation and suffering. Include 2 monstrous clawed hands reaching inward from the lower right toward the traveler. On the left side beneath the large title character, place 1 vertical block of elegant Chinese poem text in small gold calligraphy, plus 1 red seal stamp beside it. Along the bottom margin, add 1 horizontal line of small gold Chinese text with decorative dividers and the central highlighted character 心, plus 1 additional small red seal at the lower right. The overall style is cinematic, ultra-detailed, mythic, spiritual, and ominous, mixing Buddhist allegory, dark fantasy, and premium poster design; volumetric lighting, glowing dust, dramatic contrast, intricate brush typography, high detail, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张史诗级的暗黑风中国奇幻海报，画面左上方以巨大的金色纹理书法字 {argument name="main Chinese character" default="欲"} 为核心，笔触粗犷，带有金属箔般的质感与高光。场景设定在深邃的洞窟地狱中，色调为深黑、青铜与熔岩琥珀色，长长的石阶尽头闪烁着耀眼的圣光。在右上方的顶端，矗立着一盏华丽的金色莲花灯或祭祀圣杯，散发着如日晕般的圣光。画面下方中央，呈现 1 个孤独且衣衫褴褛的背影，身形消瘦疲惫，穿着被风吹得破烂的深色长袍，正向着光亮处伸出一只手臂，脚下是逐渐演变为台阶的碎裂石径。画面中飘动着 6 条醒目的绯红色丝带或如烟雾般的织物，从左、右及前景处戏剧性地缠绕，增添了动态感。在沿途及下方前景的断裂石板上刻有 5 个清晰可见的汉字：情、贪、嗔、痴、慢，每个字都散发着微弱的暖金色光芒。洞穴墙壁由扭曲的有机岩石与阴影构成，左右两侧的石壁中浮现出 3 张巨大的幽灵人脸，仿佛是诱惑与苦难的化身。在右下方加入 2 只向旅人伸出的狰狞利爪。在左侧大字下方，放置 1 竖排优雅的金色小楷诗词，并在旁边盖上 1 枚红色印章。在底部边缘，添加 1 横排带有装饰性分隔符的金色小字，中心突出“心”字，并在右下角额外添加 1 枚红色小印章。整体风格为电影级、超细节、神话感、灵性且带有不祥之兆，融合了佛教寓言、暗黑奇幻与高端海报设计；包含体积光、发光尘埃、强烈的明暗对比、精致的笔触排版、高细节度及竖构图。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑暗、电影质感的中式奇幻插画，灵感源自单个汉字 {argument name="Chinese character" default="痴"}，呈现为一幅富有诗意的仙侠场景。采用竖构图。左侧前景中，一位留着黑色长发的年轻男子侧身站立，身着层叠的黑色长袍，衣襟处有精致的刺绣图案，内衬隐约透出深红色。他的头发部分束成传统的发髻，戴着华丽的发饰，系着飘逸的红丝带。他神情忧郁而执着，望向远方。右上角背景处，在一轮明亮的满月或圆形光圈内，一位身着飘逸白袍的女子背影优雅，长袖与红丝带在风中飞舞，显得空灵而遥不可及。环境是夜晚一条布满岩石的阴影小径，在月光与薄雾的映照下，伴随着戏剧性的云层、飘落的粉色花瓣以及头顶上方弯曲的樱花枝。细长的红绳或命运之线在画面中呈对角线交错，连接着空间与情感。画面中漂浮着 3 片反光镜碎片，每一片都隐约映照出破碎的面孔或身影，增强了渴望与记忆破碎的氛围。左上角放置一个巨大的金色书法汉字 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="痴"}，笔触苍劲有力，下方盖有一枚红色印章，背景中隐约可见纵向排列的书法纹理向黑暗深处延伸。采用绘画风格的细节处理，高对比度，柔和的大气光感，丰富的黑、红、金配色，营造出浪漫悲剧、执念、渴望以及梦幻般的古风美学。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的中国水墨风奇幻肖像，以单个汉字 {argument name="character" default="嗔"} 为核心。画面展示了一位仙侠或武侠男性角色的背影，呈四分之三侧面，正微微回首。他留着随风飘逸的长发，束成高半马尾，戴着精致的深色金属发冠，几条细长的红丝带穿插在发间，随风飘动。身着黑色刺绣长袍，肩部和领口饰有精致的金色纹样，衣着层叠厚重，流动的布料与周围的笔触融为一体。由于角度和发丝的遮挡，面部大部分隐没在阴影中，营造出神秘而强烈的氛围。整体构图为竖版海报，背景为浅色羊皮纸质感，带有灰色和黑色的墨迹飞溅，人物头部后方有一个巨大的淡化圆形笔触光环，下半部分和右侧有狂野的红色笔触横扫而过，如同动态的血色书法。配色方案限定为黑色、炭灰色、羊皮纸米色和深绯红色。添加 2 处书法文本区域：左上角为黑色汉字书法竖排诗句，下方配有一个红色小印章；左下角绘制一个巨大的粗体红色汉字 {argument name="large title character" default="嗔"}。在大号红色汉字旁，放置一个竖排的罗马拼音标签 {argument name="romanization" default="CHEN"}。整体风格融合了表现力十足的水墨画与超精细的电影级角色插画，呈现出飞扬的发丝、飞溅的笔触纹理、强烈的情绪张力以及黑暗、愤怒且优雅的氛围。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑风格的电影感中式水墨奇幻插画，画面中心为一个巨大的黑色书法汉字“安”，以粗犷有力的笔触书写在背景中如发光满月般的白色圆盘之上。在画面右下方前景处，展示 1 位侧身向左的东亚武士学者形象，留着凌乱的发髻，发丝在风中飘散，身穿的长袍破碎成烟雾与墨迹。人物神情庄重、如幽灵般充满戏剧性，伫立在风暴迷雾与翻滚的黑色水墨云层中。色调以炭黑、灰烬灰和冷白色为主，仅点缀极少量的深红色。画面包含 4 座可见的宝塔：右侧远处有 2 座小宝塔，左下方一块巨大的破碎镜片中倒映出 1 座宝塔，右上方雾气中隐现 1 座更高的宝塔。构图周围环绕着 5 块醒目的破碎玻璃或镜面碎片：左下方 1 块巨大的三角形碎片，上方中心附近 1 块高耸的碎片，右上方 1 块巨大的垂直碎片，其下方 1 块悬挂的小碎片，以及右下方 1 块巨大的弧形碎片，另有少量细小残片。在左侧的一块碎片中，包含一张人脸的局部倒影。在巨大书法字下方的左侧，添加 1 枚带有汉字的红色印章。运用泼墨纹理、撕裂的纸张边缘、滴落的红色痕迹以及层叠的烟雾，营造出诡异的武侠恐怖氛围。高对比度光影，绘画混合媒介风格，质感笔触，海报式构图，超高细节，氛围感强，神秘且优雅。

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满梦幻与浪漫色彩的东亚庭院插画，呈现于暮色蓝调时分。采用高度细腻的动漫风格奇幻画法，带有柔和的光晕，营造出略显抽象且扣人心弦的氛围。在右侧前景中，一位优雅的年轻女子身着精致的传统和服，端庄地坐在锦鲤池旁的旧石阶上，肩上撑着一把巨大的和伞。她的面部轮廓柔和模糊，并未进行锐利刻画，以保持诗意而非写实肖像的意境。她的发型为正式的发髻，装饰着许多粉色樱花、垂坠饰品和精致的发簪。和服呈淡冰蓝色，层叠飘逸，饰有橙色锦鲤、卷云纹和花卉图案；她穿着白色足袋和传统木屐，背部系着花纹腰带。和伞呈奶油色，可见竹制伞骨，并装饰着悬挂的彩色半透明水滴状挂饰。池塘占据了画面的大部分，池中盛开着 10 朵粉色、桃色和淡黄色的莲花，点缀着宽大的绿色睡莲叶，9 条橙色、白色、黑色和金色的锦鲤在波光粼粼的水中游动。微小的萤火虫和魔法光点在空气中漂浮，并倒映在池面上。中景处有一座横跨水面的木拱桥。背景中，宁静的日式庭院向远处延伸，绿意盎然，覆盖着苔藓和灌木，左侧有一座石灯笼，右侧有一座温暖的庭院灯，还有一座带有深色瓦顶的小型传统凉亭，树木呈现出红橙色的秋叶与深绿色交织的景象。在坐着的女子附近添加几枝樱花。采用电影级构图，宽画幅，冷色调水面与暖色调灯光形成丰富的色彩对比，线条细腻，具有绘画质感，带有反光高光、柔和的景深雾气，营造出迷人、优雅且略带超现实的意境。

promptLocalized.zh: 一场大雨中的电影感夜间街景，从车外拍摄，呈现后侧车窗的三分之四近景视角。一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 及肩湿发的年轻女子，将双臂叠放在打开的车窗框上，头枕在手臂上，神情安静且忧郁地向外凝视。她穿着一件 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 长袖衬衫。车身占据了画面的右半部分，覆盖着密集的闪烁雨滴，车窗饰条和车门表面细节清晰。女子的面部部分被阴影和构图遮挡，营造出一种匿名感与神秘感。画面左半部分展示了失焦的城市街道，顶部和中远景处可见 2 盏温暖的琥珀色路灯，如同发光的球体，此外还有红、蓝、白、橙色的交通灯和招牌产生的多色光斑。湿润的柏油路面映照出长条状的光影。可见的雨丝穿过整个场景。采用浅景深、强烈的橙青色调对比、光泽反射、忧郁的黑色电影氛围、写实摄影风格、高对比度、柔和的胶片光晕，以及带有轻微过度处理的 AI 照片质感，并伴有偶尔出现的高频闪烁和雨水噪点。正方形构图。

Add a delicate cursive caption centered near the bottom edge of the image that reads {argument name="caption text" default="In me the tiger sniff the rose."}. templates.title: Surreal Wind, Sand and Stars Book World

templates.prompt: A poetic, cinematic macro illustration of the cover of {argument name="book title" default="Wind, Sand and Stars"} by {argument name="author name" default="Antoine de Saint-Exupéry"}, rendered as a surreal desert world emerging directly from the textured paper page. A large human hand holds a glossy black and gold fountain pen near the top right, the engraved gold nib touching the paper and releasing a dark stream of ink that becomes a winding path across a miniature Sahara landscape. The composition is vertical, warmly lit in amber and sepia tones, with dramatic side lighting, deep shadows, and ultra-detailed paper grain, skin texture, dust, and metallic reflections. On the upper left, the printed title text appears in elegant serif typography, with the author name below it and a short italic quote in smaller script beneath. The page transforms into a detailed map-like desert tableau with exactly 16 tiny human figures scattered across the scene: 1 lone standing figure balanced beside the pen nib, 3 figures near a small campfire, 2 central robed men in conversation, 3 figures gathered beside the biplane, 1 solitary figure walking near the lower middle, 2 riders on camels at the lower left, 3 standing figures near the truck at the lower right, and 1 tiny seated figure near the wreckage at the lower left. Include exactly 1 vintage biplane parked on the right with visible markings, exactly 1 old expedition truck at the bottom right, exactly 1 windsock near the center-right, exactly 1 desert oasis town with palm trees on the right, exactly 1 ruined sandcastle-like mound on the left, exactly 1 dark tent encampment on the left-center, exactly 1 wrecked engine or fuselage fragment in the lower left corner, and exactly 1 compass rose printed at the bottom left. The ink trail should branch through dunes and cracked earth like a route on an old map, connecting landmarks labeled with place names including {argument name="map label one" default="Tamanrasset"}, {argument name="map label two" default="Agadir"}, and {argument name="map label three" default="Dakar"}. Blend antique cartography, literary symbolism, and miniature diorama realism, evoking exploration, memory, loneliness, and the romance of early aviation.

The top half is labeled {argument name="top label" default="GPT-image-2"} in large bold white sans-serif text centered near the top, and the bottom half is labeled {argument name="bottom label" default="Nano Banana 2"} in the same style. Create a gritty, nostalgic, cinematic scene in a long, narrow shared hallway of a worn residential building from the late 20th century, with peeling paint, stained walls, faded propaganda posters and old newspapers on the walls, dark wooden doorways, hanging towels and laundry, a damp concrete floor, and daylight coming from a window at the far end. In the upper scene, show exactly 4 people: 1 adult standing at the left cooking over a small stove on a wooden table with visible steam, 1 adult man sitting deeper in the corridor beside an electric fan, 1 child crouching in the center playing near a basin on the wet floor, and 1 adult woman seated at a small table on the right writing or reading; include enamel mugs, metal pots, stools, buckets, thermos containers, and cluttered household items. In the lower scene, show exactly 4 people again: 1 adult woman at the left cooking at a stove with smoke rising, 1 adult man seated on the right in a bamboo chair leaning over a tabletop fan, 1 child crouching in front writing on paper on a low stool, and 1 distant adult figure near the back window; add more visible corridor clutter including a bicycle front wheel at lower left, wash basins, baskets, thermoses, shelves, shoes, and hanging clothes. Keep the camera straight-on and centered to emphasize the corridor depth, with realistic human proportions, candid slice-of-life behavior, muted aged colors, soft natural light, high detail, photojournalistic realism, and a subtle difference in arrangement between the top and bottom scenes while preserving the same overall environment and mood.

Medium close-up portrait composition, the bag prominently centered in the foreground and held near chest level by one hand gripping the handle, the model turned slightly sideways with bare shoulder and arm visible, wearing a dark brown pleated or textured dress. Long windblown wavy hair in {argument name="hair color" default="light brown with sun-kissed highlights"}, warm tanned skin, high-end campaign styling, confident elegant posture. Natural outdoor sunlight, warm earthy palette, beige and sandstone rock formations softly blurred in the background, shallow depth of field, realistic luxury advertising photography, rich texture on the leather, subtle highlights on the metal hardware, premium fashion magazine look. Add a small white rectangular picture-in-picture inset in the bottom-left corner showing the same handbag alone from the front on a clean white background, with the text {argument name="caption text" default="GPT Image2"} below it in simple black sans-serif lettering.

Use cinematic rim lighting, intense golden glow, ultra-detailed fabric, delicate hair strands, sparkling particles, elegant Japanese fantasy atmosphere, premium illustration quality, masterpiece anime key visual, refined composition, dramatic contrast, and a polished painterly finish.

templates.title: Golden Wuxia Palace Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 金碧辉煌武侠宫廷海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vintage Chinese martial-arts movie poster in a luxurious dark-gold and amber palette, styled like a classic historical epic. Center the composition on a young imperial man seated in front, wearing an ornate black-and-gold dragon robe and a Qing dynasty red-tasseled official hat, posed with one hand near his mouth in a sly, playful, confident manner. Surround him with exactly 8 beautiful court women in layered silk hanfu and gauzy robes, arranged tightly around him in a glamorous harem-like group portrait, with 4 women in the upper row and 4 women in the lower row. Each woman has an elegant updo with elaborate gold hairpins, floral ornaments, dangling earrings, and soft warm makeup; their expressions are alluring, gentle, or curious. Render the women in champagne, blush, peach, rose, and pale jade fabrics with translucent sleeves, embroidered bodices, and richly textured jewelry. Behind the group, place a large aged wooden plaque with carved golden Chinese calligraphy reading “鹿鼎记”, with a smaller line above it reading “金庸武侠经典”. Add vertical cast-name text in Chinese placed beside different figures: on the far left “苏荃”, below left “陈圆圆”, upper middle-left “阿珂”, upper middle-right “建宁公主”, far right upper “沐剑屏”, right middle “方怡”, lower right-middle “双儿”, and far lower right “曾柔”. Also add a vertical poetic slogan along the upper left margin in Chinese: “小人物，大智慧，游走江湖庙堂，玩转天下，抱得美人归”. At the bottom, blend in a secondary cinematic scene: an ancient palace gate and courtyard with soldiers and banners forming a grand processional crowd, with one lone figure centered in the foreground walking toward the viewer. Finish with a narrow line of Chinese tagline text across the bottom edge: “一部颠覆传统的英雄传奇 一段令人捧腹的江湖神话”. The whole image should feel opulent, theatrical, romantic, and slightly mischievous, with smoky sepia shadows, glowing rim light, rich texture, symmetrical poster composition, and polished high-end period-drama key art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧感的复古中国武侠电影海报，采用奢华的暗金与琥珀色调，呈现经典历史史诗风格。构图中心为一名坐在前方的年轻皇室男子，身穿华丽的黑金龙袍，头戴清朝红缨官帽，单手掩口，神情狡黠、自信且顽皮。周围环绕着 8 位身着层叠丝绸汉服与轻纱长袍的美丽宫廷女子，她们以迷人的后宫群像风格紧密排列，上排 4 人，下排 4 人。每位女子都梳着优雅的发髻，佩戴精致的金钗、花饰和垂坠耳环，妆容柔和温暖；神情或妩媚、或温柔、或好奇。女子们的服饰采用香槟色、腮红粉、桃色、玫瑰色和淡玉色面料，配以半透明袖口、刺绣胸衣和质感丰富的珠宝。在人物后方放置一块刻有金色中文字样“鹿鼎记”的陈旧木匾，上方配有一行较小的文字“金庸武侠经典”。在不同人物旁添加竖排中文演员名：最左侧为“苏荃”，左下为“陈圆圆”，中左上为“阿珂”，中右上为“建宁公主”，右侧上方为“沐剑屏”，右侧中部为“方怡”，右侧中下为“双儿”，最右下方为“曾柔”。在左上边缘添加竖排中文诗意标语：“小人物，大智慧，游走江湖庙堂，玩转天下，抱得美人归”。底部融入一个次要的电影场景：古老的宫门与庭院，士兵和旗帜组成宏大的游行队伍，前景中心有一位孤独的身影正走向观众。底部边缘以一行窄小的中文标语收尾：“一部颠覆传统的英雄传奇 一段令人捧腹的江湖神话”。整张图像应呈现出华丽、戏剧化、浪漫且略带俏皮的氛围，伴有烟熏感的深褐色阴影、发光的轮廓光、丰富的纹理、对称的海报构图以及精致的高端古装剧主视觉效果。

templates.title: Anime Boxing Title Match Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫拳击冠军赛海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese boxing match poster in a polished anime illustration style, vertical composition, split straight down the center into warm gold on the left and electric blue on the right. At the very top, huge metallic gold embossed lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="JUNGLE PREMIUM Vol.7"}, with a bright glow and beveled 3D effect. Directly beneath it, centered white Japanese text reads "世界4団体フェザー級タイトルマッチ". Show 2 male featherweight boxers facing each other in fighting stance inside a boxing ring, both full body, highly muscular, lean, and sharply defined with glossy skin highlights. The left boxer is a blond anime-style young man with short tousled hair, wearing gold boxing gloves, black-and-gold trunks with a white-red accent on one leg, black boxing boots with gold laces, and a thick championship-style waistband patch reading "SEIJI". He stands on the gold side with explosive golden sparks and streaks surrounding him. The right boxer is a black-haired anime-style young man with short spiky hair, wearing bright blue boxing gloves, dark navy-blue trunks, blue boxing boots, white socks, and a waistband patch reading "JUNICHI". He stands on the blue side with swirling blue energy, light trails, and glowing particles. Place a circular championship belt emblem in the center background between them, with ring ropes visible behind, and the words "WORLD CHAMPION" legible on the belt medallion. Add 2 large faded portrait overlays in the background, one behind each boxer: the left background portrait tinted gold and the right background portrait tinted blue. Along the far left side, place bold vertical Japanese calligraphy reading "黄金の閃光" in glowing white-gold. Along the far right side, place bold vertical Japanese calligraphy reading "蒼き鉄拳" in glowing white-blue. At the bottom, feature 2 very large Japanese name blocks: left in gold reading "松浦聖司", right in icy blue-white reading "藤原潤一", with a blazing gold "VS" between them. Beneath that, centered large white date text reads {argument name="event date" default="7月19日(日)"}. At the very bottom, centered gold serif text reads {argument name="venue name" default="SUN BIRTH STADIUM"}. Use extreme contrast, cinematic arena lighting, energetic particle effects, premium sports-event poster design, glossy typography, and a heroic high-stakes championship atmosphere.

templates.title: Antique Celestial Goddess Mural

titleLocalized.zh: 古代天女壁画

templates.prompt: A richly detailed vertical mural in the style of an aged East Asian religious wall painting on weathered silk or plaster, with visible cracks, abrasions, faded pigment, and distressed gold leaf. At the center, a celestial bodhisattva-like goddess floats gracefully above a large pink lotus pedestal, framed by a huge circular golden halo filling the upper middle of the composition. She wears an elaborate jeweled headdress, layered necklaces, armlets, and flowing robes in muted cinnabar red, cream, teal, and soft green, with long ribbon-like scarves swirling around her body in elegant arcs. Her right arm is raised, delicately holding a pink lotus flower, while her left hand extends outward in a gentle offering gesture. Surrounding her are exactly 3 smaller attendant maidens: one at lower left standing on clouds and playing a pipa, one at lower center kneeling or floating while presenting a tray of lotus blossoms, and one at lower right standing lightly on clouds with both hands raised in reverence. The background is a deep lapis-blue celestial sky filled with stylized cream and jade clouds, faint flying birds, lotus blooms, and 2 ornate temple pavilions in the upper left and upper right corners. Add hanging ornamental motifs near the mid-left and mid-right edges, and enclose the whole image in a decorative floral border. The overall mood is sacred, elegant, and antique, with intricate linework, delicate textile patterns, muted earthy tones, and a dominant blue-and-gold palette, resembling a treasured museum fresco or devotional hanging scroll.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节丰富的竖构图壁画，呈现出陈旧的东亚宗教壁画风格，绘于风化的丝绸或灰泥之上，带有明显的裂纹、磨损、褪色的颜料和斑驳的金箔质感。画面中心，一位宛如菩萨的天女优雅地悬浮于巨大的粉色莲花宝座之上，身后巨大的圆形金色光环占据了构图的中上部。她头戴精致的珠宝头饰，佩戴层叠的项链与臂钏，身着朱砂红、奶油色、青色和柔和绿色的飘逸长袍，长长的丝带如云雾般环绕周身，线条优美。她的右臂抬起，纤手轻持一朵粉莲，左手向外伸展，做出温柔的供奉姿态。周围环绕着 3 位较小的侍女：左下方一位站在云端弹奏琵琶，下方中央一位跪姿或悬浮着呈上莲花托盘，右下方一位轻立于云端，双手合十以示虔诚。背景是深青金石色的天穹，点缀着奶油色和玉色的写意云纹、隐约的飞鸟、盛开的莲花，以及左上角和右上角的 2 座华丽寺庙阁楼。在画面中左侧和中右侧边缘添加悬挂的装饰图案，并用花卉边框包裹整个图像。整体氛围神圣、优雅且古朴，线条错综复杂，织物纹理细腻，色调柔和且带有大地气息，以蓝金配色为主导，宛如珍贵的博物馆壁画或宗教挂轴。

templates.title: Surreal Neon Japanese Megacity Overlook

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实霓虹日本大都市俯瞰图

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed ultra-high-resolution vertical illustration of a surreal Japanese futuristic megacity at night, viewed from a very high, steep downward angle through a cramped canyon of buildings, as if standing on a dark hillside alley or rooftop overlook. Keep the composition 9:16 and dramatic, with a deep plunging perspective into an immense glowing urban basin packed with tightly layered low rooftops, narrow streets, elevated walkways, and towering skyscrapers fading into the distance. Frame the scene with dense foreground architecture on both sides: on the upper left, a large glowing red paper lantern sign with bold black Japanese characters hanging from an old wooden eave; on the right, a tall building facade with many lit windows and several vertical neon signs; across the image, tangled overhead utility wires and poles cut through the view. The city below should feel overcrowded yet mesmerizing, blending retro Showa-era alleyway aesthetics with cyberpunk futurism. Use a rich, graphic painterly style with strong black inky linework, bold cel-shaded shapes, and luminous neon accents, preserving a Midjourney-like cinematic beauty while adding much finer environmental detail. Dominant colors are blazing orange and amber window light, saturated crimson and scarlet signage, deep violet night sky, hot magenta highlights, and electric cyan accents. Populate the lower city with countless tiny readable micro-scenes implied through silhouettes and lit windows: festival processions in the streets, nightlife crowds, exhausted salary workers, hidden gang figures in side alleys, dancers in entertainment lanes, students studying in apartment windows, arguing couples, gamers at glowing screens, and many other small human stories embedded throughout the architecture. Emphasize the contrast between urban splendor and emotional isolation, overcrowded boredom and decadent beauty, with a satirical undertone about meaningless modern life. The image must remain aesthetically harmonious despite the density, with crisp small details visible everywhere, glowing signage in Japanese, layered depth, atmospheric haze, and a surreal, slightly oppressive but beautiful mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超高分辨率的竖版插画，描绘了夜晚超现实的日本未来主义大都市。视角从极高、极陡峭的角度向下俯瞰，仿佛站在黑暗的山坡小巷或屋顶观景台，穿过狭窄的建筑峡谷。构图保持 9:16 的比例，极具戏剧性，深邃的视角直入巨大的发光城市盆地，其中密布着层层叠叠的低矮屋顶、狭窄街道、高架人行道以及向远处延伸的摩天大楼。画面两侧由密集的建筑前景构成：左上方悬挂着一个巨大的发光红色纸灯笼招牌，上面印有醒目的黑色日本汉字，挂在古老的木制屋檐下；右侧是一栋高耸的建筑立面，布满明亮的窗户和数个垂直霓虹灯招牌；画面中交织的架空电线和电线杆穿插其中。下方的城市既拥挤又迷人，融合了昭和时代的复古小巷美学与赛博朋克未来主义。采用浓郁的图形绘画风格，具有强烈的黑色墨线、大胆的赛璐珞阴影和发光的霓虹灯点缀，在保留类似 Midjourney 的电影质感的同时，增加了更细腻的环境细节。主色调为耀眼的橙色和琥珀色窗光、饱和的深红与绯红色招牌、深紫色的夜空、热烈的洋红色高光以及电光青色点缀。在下方的城市中填充无数微小的可读场景，通过剪影和明亮的窗户暗示：街上的节日游行、夜生活人群、疲惫的上班族、小巷中隐藏的帮派成员、娱乐区的舞者、公寓窗前学习的学生、争吵的情侣、屏幕前发光的玩家，以及嵌入建筑中的许多其他微小的人类故事。强调城市辉煌与情感孤立、拥挤的无聊与颓废之美之间的对比，并带有一种关于无意义现代生活的讽刺意味。尽管细节密集，图像仍需保持美学上的和谐，处处可见清晰的微小细节、日文发光招牌、层次分明的深度、大气雾霾，以及一种超现实、略带压抑却又美丽动人的氛围。

templates.title: Neon Blue AI Video Editing Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹蓝 AI 视频剪辑缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a bold Japanese YouTube thumbnail for the theme {argument name="headline text" default="初心者でもできる AI×動画編集"}, in a futuristic neon-blue cyberpunk style. Use a wide 16:9 composition with a dark electric-blue background filled with glowing circuit lines, digital streaks, lens flares, and high-energy motion. Place a slanted glowing banner in the upper left containing the Japanese text {argument name="top banner text" default="初心者でもできる"}, with the first part in bright yellow and the rest in white. Make the main headline dominate the left and center: gigantic white glowing text “AI×” above even larger white glowing text “動画編集”, with thick blue neon outer glow, slight italic forward motion, beveled 3D shading, and dramatic perspective. In the upper right, add a circular holographic interface with the letters {argument name="ai badge text" default="AI"} in the center, surrounded by concentric rings and tiny HUD marks. Near it, include exactly 3 floating app-style icons: a play button icon, a square “Pr” icon, and an audio waveform icon, all glowing blue. Across the lower right, show a sleek angled video editing monitor displaying a neon city night road scene with a play symbol overlay; beneath the preview, include a timeline with exactly 4 visible tracks: 2 rows of video thumbnails and 2 colored audio bars, one magenta and one cyan-green. Along the bottom, add exactly 3 glowing rounded feature badges with icons and Japanese text: a book icon with “知識ゼロOK”, a clock icon with “時短でカンタン”, and a sparkle icon with “プロ級の仕上がり”. Add a tall solid blue vertical rectangle near the top center-right as a placeholder block. Overall design should feel dynamic, high-contrast, polished, techy, and optimized for maximum click-through as a modern AI and video-editing tutorial thumbnail.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张大胆的日式 YouTube 缩略图，主题为 {argument name="headline text" default="初心者でもできる AI×動画編集"}，采用未来感霓虹蓝赛博朋克风格。使用 16:9 宽屏构图，背景为深电蓝色，布满发光的电路线条、数字条纹、镜头光晕和高能量的动态效果。在左上角放置一个倾斜的发光横幅，包含日文文本 {argument name="top banner text" default="初心者でもできる"}，其中第一部分为亮黄色，其余部分为白色。主标题应占据左侧和中心位置：巨大的白色发光文字“AI×”位于更大的白色发光文字“動画編集”上方，带有厚实的蓝色霓虹外发光、轻微的前倾斜动态感、斜面 3D 阴影和强烈的透视效果。在右上角，添加一个圆形全息界面，中心带有字母 {argument name="ai badge text" default="AI"}，周围环绕着同心圆和微小的 HUD 标记。在其附近，包含 3 个浮动的应用风格图标：一个播放按钮图标、一个方形“Pr”图标和一个音频波形图标，全部呈现蓝色发光效果。在右下角，展示一个时尚的倾斜视频剪辑监视器，显示霓虹城市夜景道路场景，并覆盖有播放符号；在预览下方，包含一个时间轴，显示 4 个可见轨道：2 行视频缩略图和 2 条彩色音频条，分别为洋红色和青绿色。在底部，添加 3 个发光的圆形功能徽章，带有图标和日文文本：带有“知識ゼロOK”的书本图标、带有“時短でカンタン”的时钟图标以及带有“プロ級の仕上がり”的闪光图标。在顶部中心偏右处添加一个高大的纯蓝色垂直矩形作为占位块。整体设计应具有动态感、高对比度、精致感和科技感，并针对现代 AI 和视频剪辑教程缩略图的最高点击率进行了优化。

templates.title: Anime Roses and Books End Card

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格玫瑰与书籍片尾插画

templates.prompt: A dreamy anime end-card illustration of a relaxed young woman sitting sideways in a whimsical library of roses and books, surrounded by floating petals and open books. She has {argument name="hair color" default="vivid purple"} hair in a high ponytail tied with a black scrunchie, loose bangs, small gold earrings, and a tiny gold hair clip reading "AI" near her bangs. Her face is mostly obscured by a soft rectangular blur, but the composition still treats her as the central heroine. She wears a turquoise T-shirt with large white text {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"}, an oversized pastel windbreaker in icy blue with pink paint-splatter accents, and pale denim shorts. She holds 1 red rose in her right hand and 1 dark blue hardcover book in her left hand titled {argument name="book title" default="Roses & Books"}. Pose her lounging casually with one leg extended and one bent, like a stylish anime ending-card key visual. The setting is an ornate fantasy reading nook with 2 towering stacks of books framing her on the left and right, entwined with blooming rose vines in red and pink. Include exactly 6 clearly readable book spines or covers with decorative serif titles: "Poems & Books", "Roses & Books", "Dreams", "Memories", "Letters", and "Language of Flowers". Add 1 takeaway coffee cup at the lower left with the printed phrase {argument name="cup text" default="Read. Write. Bloom."}. Place 1 open notebook with a pen in the foreground near her legs, showing a rose sketch and notes, plus 1 additional open illustrated botanical book at the lower right. In the upper area, include exactly 4 floating open books and several loose pages drifting in the air. Behind her, create a bright arched window revealing a pastel fairytale city with a cathedral-like spire against a clear sky-blue background. Fill the whole image with scattered red and pink rose petals, sparkles, soft painterly light, decorative floral details, and richly colored book covers in navy, pink, and cream. Use polished anime illustration styling, highly detailed linework, luminous pastel highlights, romantic fantasy atmosphere, balanced symmetrical framing, and the feel of a commemorative spring book-and-rose themed visual for {argument name="occasion" default="Sant Jordi Day"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的动漫片尾插画，描绘了一位年轻女性侧坐在充满奇幻色彩的玫瑰与书籍图书馆中，周围环绕着飘落的花瓣和翻开的书籍。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳紫色"} 的高马尾，用黑色发圈束起，留有随意的刘海，戴着小巧的金耳环，刘海旁别着一个写有“AI”字样的微型金色发夹。她的面部大部分被柔和的矩形模糊处理，但构图上她依然是核心主角。她身穿一件印有醒目白色文字 {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"} 的青绿色 T 恤，外搭一件冰蓝色超大款粉色泼墨风衣，下身穿着浅色牛仔短裤。她右手拿着 1 朵红玫瑰，左手拿着一本深蓝色精装书，书名显示为 {argument name="book title" default="Roses & Books"}。让她以一种时尚动漫片尾主视觉图的姿态随意地斜倚着，一条腿伸直，另一条腿弯曲。场景是一个华丽的奇幻阅读角，左右两侧各堆叠着 2 摞高耸的书籍，并缠绕着盛开的红粉色玫瑰藤蔓。画面中需包含 6 个清晰可见、带有装饰性衬线字体的书脊或封面，标题分别为：“Poems & Books”、“Roses & Books”、“Dreams”、“Memories”、“Letters” 和 “Language of Flowers”。在左下角放置 1 个外带咖啡杯，杯上印有 {argument name="cup text" default="Read. Write. Bloom."} 字样。在前景的双腿附近放置 1 本打开的笔记本和一支笔，展示着玫瑰素描和笔记，右下角另有 1 本打开的植物学插画书。在上方区域，加入 4 本悬浮的打开书籍和几页在空中飘散的纸张。在她身后，设计一扇明亮的拱形窗户，透出窗外粉彩色的童话城市，背景是带有大教堂式尖顶的晴朗天蓝色天空。整幅画面充满散落的红粉色玫瑰花瓣、闪光点、柔和的绘画光影、装饰性花卉细节，以及海军蓝、粉色和奶油色等色彩丰富的书封。采用精致的动漫插画风格，线条细腻，高光呈现出明亮的粉彩质感，营造出浪漫的奇幻氛围，构图平衡对称，呈现出适合 {argument name="occasion" default="圣乔治节"} 的春日书籍与玫瑰主题纪念视觉效果。

templates.title: Cozy Anime ASMR Ear Massage Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨动漫风 ASMR 耳部按摩少女

templates.prompt: A soft, dreamy anime illustration of a cute young woman doing ASMR in a cozy bedroom at night, seated close to the viewer with her knees pulled up and a black 3Dio-style binaural microphone centered in front of her. She has {argument name="hair color" default="deep violet"} hair in a loose messy updo with wispy bangs framing her face, large sparkling {argument name="eye color" default="blue"} eyes, a gentle blush, and a sweet open-mouth smile. Her head is tilted slightly toward the viewer in a warm, affectionate pose. She wears a delicate white lace camisole with thin straps and an oversized fluffy knit cardigan in {argument name="cardigan color" default="soft pink-lavender"} draped off her shoulders, creating a tender, intimate late-night healing atmosphere. Both hands lightly touch the white silicone ears of the microphone as if about to give an ear massage. The room is softly lit with pink and amber ambient lighting, heavy curtains in the background, a bed or sofa with plush cushions, warm fairy-light bokeh, and a small plant on the right side. Add glowing handwritten Japanese neon text integrated into the composition: on the left, 4 text elements reading "とろける", "耳", "マッサージ", and "ASMR" with 2 small heart symbols; on the right, vertical text reading "いっぱい癒してあげるね…♡". Use a polished modern anime style, highly detailed face and hair, glossy eyes, smooth luminous skin, soft shading, pastel highlights, shallow depth of field, romantic cozy streamer-thumbnail composition, and a soothing feminine color palette dominated by pink, lavender, cream, and warm gold.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和梦幻的动漫插画，描绘了一位可爱的年轻女性在夜晚温馨的卧室里进行 ASMR 直播。她靠近镜头坐着，双膝蜷起，画面中央放置着一个黑色 3Dio 风格的双耳麦克风。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫色"} 的头发，扎成凌乱随意的发髻，细碎的刘海修饰着脸庞，拥有一双闪烁着光芒的 {argument name="eye color" default="蓝色"} 大眼睛，面带温柔的红晕和甜美的微笑。她的头部微微向镜头倾斜，姿态亲昵温暖。她身穿一件精致的白色蕾丝吊带背心，肩上披着一件 {argument name="cardigan color" default="柔粉紫色"} 的超大号蓬松针织开衫，营造出一种温柔、私密的深夜治愈氛围。她的双手轻轻触碰着麦克风的白色硅胶耳廓，仿佛正准备进行耳部按摩。房间里点缀着柔和的粉色和琥珀色环境光，背景是厚重的窗帘，配有带毛绒靠垫的床或沙发、温暖的仙女灯光斑，右侧摆放着一株小植物。画面中融入了发光的日文手写霓虹文字：左侧有 4 个文字元素，分别为“とろける”、“耳”、“マッサージ”和“ASMR”，并带有 2 个小爱心符号；右侧有竖排文字“いっぱい癒してあげるね…♡”。采用精致的现代动漫风格，面部和发丝细节丰富，眼睛明亮有神，皮肤光滑细腻，阴影柔和，带有柔和的粉彩色高光，浅景深效果，浪漫温馨的直播缩略图构图，以及以粉色、薰衣草色、奶油色和暖金色为主的治愈系女性化色调。

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fantasy warrior girl standing alone on a plain light gray background, clean character illustration with soft painterly rendering and crisp line art. She is a slender young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair, center-parted with long face-framing strands and a small tied section at the back, light {argument name="eye color" default="amber-brown"} eyes, fair skin, and a calm slightly serious expression. Her pose is dynamic and confident: legs apart in a stable stance, one arm raised over her head gripping a long spear shaft behind her shoulders, the other hand holding the spear lower near her side so the ornate spear extends diagonally across the composition. The weapon is 1 elaborate dark metallic spear with a long narrow blade, cross-shaped barbs, engraved gothic details, and a sharp butt spike. Her outfit is a refined dark fantasy battle costume with exactly 6 visible main pieces: 1 black steel armored right arm gauntlet with engraved plating, 1 fitted black-and-bronze corset breastplate, 1 white high-neck blouse with sheer long sleeves, 1 short asymmetrical white skirt with flowing split overskirt panels, 1 pair of black thigh-high armored boots with silver filigree knee and ankle accents, and 1 brown belt set with straps including a right-thigh garter strap. Add subtle silver ornamentation at the collar and armor edges, elegant leather textures, polished metal highlights, and gently wind-swept fabric. Keep the palette muted and sophisticated in ivory, charcoal, bronze, and silver. The style should feel like premium Japanese RPG character concept art, highly detailed, graceful, slightly gothic, isolated full figure, no extra props, no scenery, only a faint soft ground shadow beneath her feet.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅动漫奇幻女战士的全身插画，人物独自站立在纯浅灰色背景前，画面干净，采用柔和的绘画渲染风格与清晰的线条勾勒。她是一位身材苗条的年轻女性，留着一头长直发，{argument name="hair color" default="白金色"}，中分刘海修饰脸型，后方扎有一小束头发；拥有明亮的 {argument name="eye color" default="琥珀棕色"} 双眸，肤色白皙，神情沉稳且略带严肃。她的姿势充满动感与自信：双腿分开呈稳固站姿，一只手臂举过头顶，握住肩后的一柄长枪，另一只手在身侧下方握住枪身，使华丽的长枪在构图中呈对角线延伸。武器为 1 把精致的深色金属长枪，配有细长的枪刃、十字形倒钩、哥特风格雕刻细节以及锋利的枪尾。她的服装为精致的暗黑奇幻战斗装，包含 6 个清晰可见的主要部件：1 只带有雕刻甲片的黑色钢制右臂护手，1 件合身的黑铜色紧身胸甲，1 件白色高领衬衫配透明长袖，1 条不对称的白色短裙配飘逸的开叉裙摆，1 双带有银色花丝膝部和踝部装饰的黑色过膝战靴，以及 1 条包含大腿绑带的棕色腰带组合。领口和盔甲边缘饰有精致的银色纹饰，皮革质感细腻，金属高光处理考究，布料呈现出微风吹拂的动感。色调采用象牙白、炭黑、青铜色和银色，整体风格低调而高级。画面应呈现出高端日本 RPG 角色概念艺术的质感，细节丰富，姿态优雅，略带哥特风，全身人物独立呈现，无额外道具，无背景，仅在脚下有淡淡的柔和地面阴影。

templates.title: Full-Body Fantasy Adventurer Male

titleLocalized.zh: 全身奇幻冒险家男性角色

templates.prompt: A full-body fantasy character illustration on a plain light gray background, painted in polished anime-inspired RPG concept art style with crisp linework, soft rendering, and realistic leather, fur, and skin textures. Show a tall, athletic young man with a muscular build and fair skin, standing in a relaxed contrapposto pose. His right arm is raised across his forehead as if shielding his eyes from light, with his gloved hand touching the brim of a dark cap; his left arm hangs down with a clenched fist. His face is mostly obscured by the raised forearm and cap shadow, making the expression unreadable. He has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blond"} medium-length hair, slightly tousled, visible beneath a {argument name="headwear" default="black flat cap"}, with a small earring on one ear. Dress him in layered adventurer clothing dominated by dark brown, black, and muted reddish-brown. The upper body has a fitted black short-sleeve shirt under a brown leather vest with wide straps and buckles, topped with a thick pale fur collar draped around the neck and shoulders. Add a necklace with small metallic ornaments at the collarbone. Both hands wear dark fingerless gloves or fitted leather gloves, with multiple stacked wristbands and bracers. Around the waist, include several crossing leather belts, metal clasps, and hanging accessories, plus a reddish-brown sash tied at the hips with long hanging strips. On the left hip, attach 1 small leather pouch. The pants are slim dark trousers with a strapped harness around 1 thigh, including metal rings and buckles. The boots are 1 matching pair of tall, dark leather lace-up boots with reinforced knee guards or ornate metal-plated shin-and-knee armor, slightly weathered but stylish. From the right side of the waist, let a long torn cloth panel hang down, patterned near the end with subtle decorative motifs and finished with 1 dangling metal charm or spearhead-shaped ornament. Emphasize a rugged handsome adventurer aesthetic, detailed costume design, and a refined game character sheet feel, centered composition, full figure fully visible from head to boots, with a faint soft cast shadow on the floor.

promptLocalized.zh: 在一张纯浅灰色背景上绘制全身奇幻角色插画，采用精致的日系 RPG 概念艺术风格，线条清晰，渲染柔和，并呈现出逼真的皮革、毛皮和皮肤质感。描绘一位身材高大、体格健壮且皮肤白皙的年轻男性，以放松的重心转移姿势站立。他的右臂抬起横在额前，仿佛在遮挡光线，戴着手套的手触碰着深色帽檐；左臂自然下垂，拳头紧握。他的面部大部分被抬起的前臂和帽檐阴影遮挡，表情难以辨认。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="白金色"} 的中长发，略显凌乱，在 {argument name="headwear" default="黑色平顶帽"} 下隐约可见，一侧耳朵戴着小耳环。为他穿上以深棕色、黑色和柔和红棕色为主的叠穿冒险家服装。上身穿着修身黑色短袖衬衫，外搭棕色皮质马甲，配有宽带和搭扣，颈部和肩部披着厚实的浅色毛领。锁骨处佩戴一条带有小型金属装饰的项链。双手戴着深色露指手套或修身皮手套，并佩戴多个层叠的腕带和护腕。腰间配有多条交叉的皮带、金属扣和悬挂饰品，臀部系着一条红棕色腰带，带有长长的垂坠布条。左侧腰间挂着 1 个小型皮袋。下身穿着修身深色长裤，大腿处系有带金属环和搭扣的绑带。脚蹬一双配套的深色高帮系带皮靴，配有加固的护膝或精致的金属护胫，略显风霜感但时尚感十足。从右侧腰间垂下一块长长的破损布片，末端带有微妙的装饰图案，并挂有 1 个金属吊坠或矛头状饰物。强调粗犷帅气的冒险家美学、精细的服装设计以及精致的游戏角色设定图质感，构图居中，全身从头到靴子完整可见，地面带有淡淡的柔和投影。

templates.title: Cute Japanese Romcom Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的日系浪漫喜剧电影海报

templates.prompt: A flashy Japanese romantic comedy movie poster in a cute-but-dramatic pop anime mascot style, designed like a theatrical film teaser. Center the composition on a full-body cartoon bunny girl mascot named {argument name="character name" default="パン子"}, with a large white face, black body and one black ear, one bright red ear, thick black outline, half-lidded glamorous eyes with long lashes, pink blush circles on her cheeks, a tiny red nose, a small tongue peeking out, and a pink bow with white polka dots on top of her head. She wears a sleeveless pink dress with white polka dots and a black scarf-like neck detail, posing with one hand near her cheek in a confident, slightly flirty stance. The background is a dreamy sunset waterfront city skyline with golden reflections on the water, pastel pink-orange-blue sky, sparkles, soft bokeh, and a ferris wheel on the left. Place 2 male silhouette figures in the midground, one on the left standing casually and one on the right in a suit-like pose, suggesting potential love interests. Add lush tropical flowers and leaves around the borders, especially pink hibiscus blossoms in the corners, plus floating hearts and glitter effects throughout. Use a bold, layered Japanese poster layout packed with decorative typography and stickers. At the top, handwritten-style Japanese text reads: 「笑って、泣いて、恋をして。アラサーの私、まだまだ諦めない！」 with pink emphasis and doodled heart lines. On the upper left, include a bright pink scalloped badge that says 「2026年 夏公開」. Along the right side, place vertical Japanese text: 「私の幸せ、探しにいきます。」. Near the lower left, add a pink ribbon label reading 「劇場版！」. Across the bottom center, create the large main title in bold decorative Japanese lettering: 「アラサー パン子の 婚活奮闘記」 with pink and dark navy text, white outlines, and a cute heart accent. Beneath it, add a pink slogan banner with yellow-highlighted text: 「恋に迷って、人生はもっとキラキラする♥」. Include small faux credits at the bottom in Japanese film-poster style. Around the lower area, place 4 small polaroid-style inset snapshots of the bunny character: 2 on the lower left and 2 on the lower right, each showing different cute situations such as a close-up pose, sitting at a cafe table, wearing sunglasses, or posing outdoors. Add a small notebook page labeled "Today's Mission" with checklist hearts in the lower left, and a plastic iced drink cup with straw plus sunglasses in the lower right. Overall feeling: feminine, comedic, inspirational, sparkly, over-the-top, and nostalgic, like a parody of a live-action romance film poster starring a mascot heroine. Use vivid pinks, peach sunset tones, sky blue, white, and navy, with glossy highlights and a polished promotional-poster finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张华丽的日系浪漫喜剧电影海报，采用可爱又充满戏剧性的流行动漫吉祥物风格，设计如同电影预告海报。构图中心为一只全身卡通兔女郎吉祥物，名字为 {argument name="character name" default="パン子"}，她有着大大的白脸、黑色的身体、一只黑耳朵和一只亮红色的耳朵，轮廓线条粗犷，半闭的迷人双眼配有长睫毛，脸颊上有粉色腮红圆圈，小小的红鼻子，舌头微微探出，头顶戴着一个带有白色波点的粉色蝴蝶结。她穿着一件带有白色波点的无袖粉色连衣裙，颈部有黑色围巾状装饰，单手靠近脸颊，姿态自信且略带俏皮。背景是梦幻般的日落滨海城市天际线，水面有金色倒影，天空呈现粉、橙、蓝的柔和色调，伴有闪光、柔和的虚化效果，左侧有一座摩天轮。在中景处放置 2 个男性剪影，左侧一人站姿随意，右侧一人呈西装革履姿态，暗示潜在的恋爱对象。在边框周围添加茂盛的热带花卉和叶子，尤其是角落里的粉色木槿花，以及遍布画面的漂浮爱心和闪光效果。采用大胆、分层的日式海报布局，布满装饰性字体和贴纸。顶部用手写风格的日文写着：「笑って、泣いて、恋をして。アラサーの私、まだまだ諦めない！」并带有粉色强调和涂鸦心形线条。左上方包含一个明亮的粉色扇形徽章，写着「2026年 夏公開」。右侧放置垂直的日文文本：「私の幸せ、探しにいきます。」。左下方添加一个粉色丝带标签，写着「劇場版！」。底部中央创建醒目的主标题，采用粗体装饰性日文字体：「アラサー パン子の 婚活奮闘記」，配以粉色和深海军蓝文字、白色轮廓以及可爱的爱心装饰。下方添加一个粉色标语横幅，带有黄色高亮文字：「恋に迷って、人生はもっとキラキラする♥」。底部包含日式电影海报风格的小型伪造演职员表。在下方区域放置 4 张兔女郎角色的宝丽来风格小照片：左下 2 张，右下 2 张，每张展示不同的可爱场景，如特写姿势、坐在咖啡桌旁、戴着太阳镜或在户外摆拍。左下方添加一个标有“Today's Mission”并带有心形清单的笔记本页面，右下方放置一个带吸管的塑料冰饮杯和太阳镜。整体感觉：女性化、喜剧感、励志、闪耀、夸张且怀旧，就像一部由吉祥物女主主演的真人浪漫电影的恶搞海报。使用鲜艳的粉色、桃色日落色调、天蓝色、白色和海军蓝，并带有光泽高光和精致的宣传海报质感。
