templates.title: Dark Fantasy Isekai Novel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻异世界轻小说封面

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy anime light-novel cover in a vertical composition, painted with detailed dramatic brushwork and moody cinematic lighting. Show three young women posed in a triangular arrangement against a ruined medieval city engulfed in flames at night, with smoke, embers, collapsed timber buildings, and a large stone castle on a rocky hill in the upper background. In the foreground center, place a beautiful young woman with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="powder blue"} hair, wearing an off-shoulder blue corset dress with white frilled sleeves and lace-up bodice, one hand lightly gripping her chest, her expression serious and vulnerable. Behind her on the left, place a tall woman with silver-white hair tied in a high ponytail and a white headscarf, wearing a modest black dress with a high collar and front fastenings, standing in profile with a stern, unreadable presence. Behind her on the right, place a blonde girl with twin braids under a brown hooded cloak, pale blue-green eyes, holding a black book with a star-like emblem on the cover close to her chest, looking sideways with a guarded expression. Use layered character overlap, strong contrast, and slightly desaturated colors except for warm firelight and deep reds. Add large vertical Japanese title typography along the left side in distressed calligraphic style: 「異世界辺境伯領」 in black and dark red, plus two smaller vertical text blocks near the lower left reading 「現代の倫理観を捨て」 and 「権力と暴力で泥臭く生き延びます」. Add a decorative compass-like emblem near the lower left and a large bold vertical subtitle 「転生」 at the bottom left. Ornate corner filigree, gritty light-novel cover design, intense isekai war atmosphere, high detail, premium illustrated novel cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖构图的暗黑奇幻动漫轻小说封面，采用细腻且富有戏剧性的笔触绘制，营造出忧郁的电影感光影。画面展示了三位年轻女性呈三角形排列，背景是夜晚被火焰吞噬的中世纪废墟城市，伴有烟雾、余烬、倒塌的木质建筑，远景上方是一座矗立在岩石山丘上的巨大石堡。画面前景中央是一位美丽的年轻女性，留着一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="粉蓝色"} 长发，身穿露肩蓝色束腰连衣裙，配有白色荷叶边袖子和系带胸衣，一只手轻抚胸口，表情严肃而脆弱。她左后方是一位高挑女性，留着扎成高马尾的银白色长发，戴着白色头巾，身穿领口较高且有前襟系扣的朴素黑裙，侧身站立，神情严峻，令人捉摸不透。她右后方是一位金发少女，戴着棕色连帽斗篷，扎着双麻花辫，有着淡蓝绿色的双眸，怀抱一本封面上印有星形徽章的黑色书籍，侧目而视，神情警惕。画面采用层叠的人物布局，对比强烈，色彩略显低饱和，仅保留温暖的火光和深红色。在左侧添加醒目的竖排日文标题，采用做旧的书法风格：黑红色的「異世界辺境伯領」；左下方另有两个较小的竖排文本块，分别为「現代の倫理観を捨て」和「権力と暴力で泥臭く生き延びます」。左下方添加一个装饰性的罗盘状徽章，底部左侧添加一个醒目的大字竖排副标题「転生」。装饰性边角花纹，粗砺的轻小说封面设计，浓厚的异世界战争氛围，高细节，优质插画小说封面。

templates.title: Japanese Manufacturing Challenges Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 日本制造业挑战信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A clean corporate editorial infographic illustration for a Japanese business article about manufacturing industry challenges, set inside a realistic modern factory with metalworking machines and a cool gray-blue color palette. The composition is split into two thematic halves over a blurred industrial workshop background. At the top center, place a large bold Japanese headline in dark navy text: {argument name="headline text" default="製造業が直面する根深い課題: 「人手不足」と「技術伝承」"}. In the left foreground, show 1 factory worker in a light gray uniform and cap standing with arms crossed, looking concerned; nearby add a circular white icon showing exactly 6 human silhouettes, with 3 filled dark figures and 3 dotted outline figures to symbolize labor shortage. In the right foreground, show exactly 2 factory workers beside a large lathe machine: 1 veteran worker in a navy work jacket and navy cap pointing and demonstrating machine operation, and 1 younger worker in a light gray uniform and cap observing closely. Near them, add a white thought bubble icon containing a navy head silhouette with 2 gear symbols and exactly 3 small Japanese word bubbles reading "経験", "勘", and "コツ". In the center background, include exactly 2 additional workers in light gray uniforms operating machinery, slightly out of focus, for a total of 5 workers visible in the factory scene. Overlay two rounded white information panels with dark navy title tabs. The left panel title is "人手不足" and contains exactly 3 bullet points with blue circular check icons: "若手人材の確保が困難", "現場の負担増大", and "将来の生産性低下への懸念". The right panel title is "技術伝承" and contains exactly 3 bullet points with blue circular check icons: "熟練技術が属人化", "暗黙知が言語化・標準化されていない", and "ベテランの退職による技術の断絶リスク". At the bottom center, place a dark navy rounded rectangular callout box with white Japanese text: {argument name="callout text" default="製造業の持続的な成長のために、これらの課題解決が急務"}. Add exactly 2 large white arrows pointing inward toward this bottom callout, one from the left and one from the right. Style the whole image like a polished consulting-firm presentation visual or business magazine insert: photorealistic workers and machinery, subtle depth of field, high clarity, balanced layout, soft lighting, crisp typography, and a professional Japanese manufacturing-industry infographic aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的企业编辑类信息图插画，用于关于制造业挑战的日本商业文章，背景设定在拥有金属加工机械的写实现代化工厂中，采用冷灰蓝色调。构图在模糊的工业车间背景上分为两个主题部分。在顶部中心，放置一个深海军蓝色的醒目日文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="製造業が直面する根深い課題: 「人手不足」と「技術伝承」"}。在左侧前景中，展示 1 名身穿浅灰色制服和帽子、双臂交叉且神情担忧的工厂工人；附近添加一个圆形的白色图标，显示 6 个人的剪影，其中 3 个为深色实心，3 个为虚线轮廓，象征劳动力短缺。在右侧前景中，展示 2 名工厂工人在大型车床旁：1 名身穿海军蓝工作夹克和帽子、正在指点并演示机器操作的资深员工，以及 1 名身穿浅灰色制服和帽子、正在仔细观察的年轻员工。在他们附近，添加一个白色的气泡图标，内含一个海军蓝头部剪影，配有 2 个齿轮符号和 3 个写有“経験”、“勘”和“コツ”的小型日文气泡。在中心背景中，包含 2 名正在操作机器、略微失焦的额外工人，使工厂场景中总共可见 5 名工人。叠加两个带有深海军蓝色标题标签的圆角白色信息面板。左侧面板标题为“人手不足”，包含 3 个带有蓝色圆形勾选图标的要点：“若手人材の確保が困難”、“現場の負担増大”和“将来の生産性低下への懸念”。右侧面板标题为“技術伝承”，包含 3 个带有蓝色圆形勾选图标的要点：“熟練技術が属人化”、“暗黙知が言語化・標準化されていない”和“ベテランの退職による技術の断絶リスク”。在底部中心，放置一个深海军蓝色的圆角矩形标注框，内含白色日文文本：{argument name="callout text" default="製造業の持続的な成長のために、これらの課題解決が急務"}。添加 2 个指向底部标注框的大型白色箭头，分别来自左右两侧。整体风格仿照专业的咨询公司演示文稿或商业杂志插页：照片级的工人和机械、微妙的景深、高清晰度、平衡的布局、柔和的灯光、清晰的排版，以及专业的日本制造业信息图美学。

templates.title: Anime Clerk in PS5 Game Store

titleLocalized.zh: PS5 游戏店里的动漫店员

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style illustration of a young Japanese woman standing in a modern video game store aisle, posed like a store clerk or promotional staff member. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with soft shine and gentle layered ends, and she wears a fitted navy business suit with exactly 4 visible clothing/accessory pieces: a navy blazer, a matching pencil skirt, a white dress shirt, and a bright red necktie, plus a staff ID badge hanging from her waist. Her face is intentionally obscured by a smooth blank blur with no facial features. She stands in a relaxed three-quarter pose, slightly turned toward the viewer, holding up a PS5 game case with both hands at chest height to present it. The game cover title should read {argument name="game title" default="TRACE: TOKYO"}, showing an anime schoolgirl over a Tokyo city background. Set the scene inside a PlayStation-branded retail section with 2 dominant PS5 signs visible on the right side, multiple blue PlayStation displays, and shelves densely stocked with PS5 game boxes. Include 1 large floor display box for the same featured game near the lower left, and many repeated PS5 cases on the right shelf, with a few red-spined game cases on the lower shelves for color contrast. In the back left, add a large blue wall sign reading {argument name="store slogan" default="PLAY HAS NO LIMITS"}. In the mid-background, add 1 vertical red banner with Japanese text reading {argument name="banner text" default="未来は上にある。"}. Use warm overhead spotlights, a realistic game shop interior with exposed industrial ceiling fixtures, glossy tile floor reflections, and cinematic depth. Composition is vertical smartphone aspect ratio, full-body framing, slightly low eye-level perspective, with the woman centered-left and the PS5 shelf dominating the right side. Render in high-detail contemporary anime key art style, clean linework, soft shading, realistic store lighting, rich blue tones, and a premium promotional illustration feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格插图，描绘了一位年轻的日本女性站在现代电子游戏店的过道中，姿态如同店员或宣传人员。她留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发，发丝带有柔和的光泽和轻盈的层次感。她身穿合身的深蓝色职业套装，包含 4 件清晰可见的服饰/配饰：一件深蓝色西装外套、一条配套的包臀裙、一件白色衬衫和一条鲜红色的领带，腰间还挂着员工证。她的面部特意处理为平滑的空白模糊效果，没有任何五官。她以放松的三分之四侧身姿势站立，身体微向观众转动，双手在胸前托举着一个 PS5 游戏盒进行展示。游戏封面的标题应显示为 {argument name="game title" default="TRACE: TOKYO"}，画面展示了一名动漫女学生，背景为东京城市景观。场景设定在 PlayStation 品牌零售区内，右侧可见 2 个醒目的 PS5 标志，设有多个蓝色 PlayStation 展示柜，货架上密密麻麻地摆放着 PS5 游戏盒。在左下角附近加入 1 个大型的同款游戏落地展示盒，右侧货架上陈列着大量重复的 PS5 游戏盒，底层货架上点缀着少量红色书脊的游戏盒以形成色彩对比。在左后方，添加一个大型蓝色墙面标语，写着 {argument name="store slogan" default="PLAY HAS NO LIMITS"}。在中景背景处，添加 1 条垂直的红色横幅，上面印有日语文字 {argument name="banner text" default="未来は上にある。"}。采用温暖的头顶射灯，呈现出带有工业风裸露天花板、光亮瓷砖地面反射以及电影级景深的真实游戏店内部环境。构图采用竖版智能手机比例，全身取景，略微仰视的视角，女性位于画面中左侧，右侧由 PS5 货架占据。以高细节的当代动漫主视觉艺术风格渲染，线条清晰，阴影柔和，灯光真实，色调以浓郁的蓝色为主，营造出高级的宣传插图质感。

templates.title: Colorful Kimono Kemonomimi Festival

titleLocalized.zh: 色彩斑斓的和服兽耳娘祭典

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed, ultra-colorful anime festival illustration of 2 kemonomimi girls jumping midair in a joyful pose, filling the center of a tall vertical composition. The girl on the right is a cheerful catgirl with white-blonde hair, large fluffy cat ears, bright blue eyes, one eye winking, and a big open smile, wearing a vivid blue floral kimono-inspired short dress with oversized sleeves, layered frilly white petticoat trim, a large multicolored obi bow, floral hair ornaments, white ankle socks, and geta sandals, with a fluffy pale tail visible behind her; her right arm is raised making a peace sign and her left hand is near her chest. The girl on the left is a doggirl with medium brown hair, fluffy brown-and-white dog ears, and a curled fluffy tail, wearing a vivid pink and magenta floral kimono-inspired short dress with layered frills, a large decorative obi bow, floral hair ornaments, white socks, and sandals; she is also leaping with one arm raised in a peace sign. Render the left girl's face as intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. Surround them with an explosive fantasy-Japanese backdrop packed with decorative detail: Mount Fuji centered in the upper background with radiant sunrise rays, a large rainbow arc swirling on the right, stylized Great Wave-like curling waves on both sides, dense pink cherry blossoms overhead, 2 glowing paper lanterns near the upper left and upper right edges, and 2 more paper lanterns near the lower left and lower right corners, plus a red arched bridge at the bottom left. Use a saturated candy-bright palette of pink, cyan, blue, gold, orange, violet, and white, with confetti-like petals, sparkling particles, paint splashes, and intricate floral patterns covering nearly every surface. The mood is festive, cute, ecstatic, and celebratory, with dynamic foreshortening, crisp linework, glossy highlights, layered textures, and a highly polished gacha-card style illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超精细、色彩极其丰富的动漫祭典插画，画面中心是两位正在半空中欢快跳跃的兽耳娘（kemonomimi），构图呈高垂直状。右侧的少女是一位开朗的猫娘，有着白金色的头发、大而蓬松的猫耳、明亮的蓝色眼睛，一只眼睛眨着，笑容灿烂。她身穿一件鲜艳的蓝色花卉和服风格短裙，配有超大袖子、层叠的白色荷叶边衬裙、巨大的彩色腰带蝴蝶结、花朵发饰、白色短袜和木屐，身后隐约可见一条蓬松的浅色尾巴；她的右手举起比着剪刀手，左手靠近胸前。左侧的少女是一位狗娘，有着中棕色的头发、蓬松的棕白相间狗耳和卷曲的蓬松尾巴，身穿一件鲜艳的粉色和洋红色花卉和服风格短裙，配有层叠的荷叶边、巨大的装饰性腰带蝴蝶结、花朵发饰、白色短袜和凉鞋；她也在跳跃，一只手举起比着剪刀手。左侧少女的面部特意用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡。背景是充满爆炸性幻想色彩的日式场景，细节装饰丰富：背景上方中央是富士山，伴随着灿烂的日出光芒，右侧环绕着巨大的彩虹弧线，两侧是风格化的“神奈川冲浪里”式卷浪，头顶是茂密的粉色樱花，左上角和右上角各有两个发光的纸灯笼，左下角和右下角也各有两个纸灯笼，左下角还有一座红色拱桥。采用粉色、青色、蓝色、金色、橙色、紫色和白色的饱和糖果色调，几乎每一处表面都覆盖着五彩纸屑般的花瓣、闪烁的微粒、油漆飞溅和复杂的碎花图案。整体氛围欢庆、可爱、狂喜且充满节庆感，具有动态的透视效果、清晰的线条、光泽感的高光、层叠的纹理，呈现出高度精致的抽卡游戏卡面风格。

templates.title: Anime Fashion Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: A stylized Japanese fashion magazine cover titled MODE TOKYO, designed like a glossy contemporary women's style publication. The composition is a high-angle, dynamic street-fashion anime illustration of 2 girls looking up toward the viewer from beside a brick wall with colorful graffiti and dramatic sunlight. The girl on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair in a lively messy ponytail with loose bangs, bright green eyes, a wide cheerful grin, and a sporty-feminine outfit: a light blue lace-trim camisole or slip-style top, short bottoms, chunky white sneakers, and a black choker. She is posed energetically, leaning forward with one knee bent, giving a confident summer-fashion editorial feel. The girl on the left has long vivid teal-green hair with straight heavy bangs, large blue eyes, and a calm, cool expression. She wears a casual layered street outfit in dark tones with a sleeveless top and sits lower in the frame, angled toward the right girl while gazing upward. Use bold cel-shaded anime rendering with crisp linework, glossy highlights in the hair and eyes, soft skin shading, and a polished commercial illustration finish. The background should combine sunlit urban texture, blurred mural colors in pink, purple, orange, and black, and deep shadows to create contrast. The overall palette mixes hot pink typography, summer sunlight, teal, blonde, and saturated street-art hues. Include dense magazine-cover typography in a premium editorial layout: a giant pink serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"} across the top with TOKYO vertically on the left; on the upper right a dark circular or rounded block containing {argument name="issue number" default="06"}, JUNE 2024, vol.218, and cover lines in Japanese; on the left side several smaller Japanese and English fashion blurbs including NEO BASIC STYLE and SPORTY × FEMININE; a pink circular badge on the right with Japanese text and Trend 7; a large hot-pink Japanese headline across the lower left and center reading 私らしく、もっと輝く季節。; elegant white handwritten script diagonally across the lower right reading Shine in my Style; small footer cover lines and hashtags in Japanese; and a small BEAUTY label at bottom right. Make it look exactly like a real high-end Japanese fashion magazine cover, vertical format, full bleed, vibrant, youthful, feminine, sporty, and trendy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光泽感十足的现代动漫风格时尚杂志封面插画，设计参考了日本女性街头时尚杂志的编辑封面。顶部巨大的刊头采用优雅的衬线字体，写着 {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"}，颜色为亮粉色；“TOKYO”一词垂直排列在左上角边缘。右上角是杂志期号板块，显示大号数字“06”，下方有“JUNE 2024”和“vol.218”字样，再下方是写着“COVER GIRLS”的封面标题，随后是日语名字。主体画面展示了 2 位动漫女孩，采用戏剧性的俯视角度拍摄，仿佛观众正从城市小巷或楼梯间向下俯瞰，背景带有砖块和涂鸦纹理，阳光强烈，阴影深邃，充满活力的夏日氛围。右侧的女孩是主导人物：一位开朗、运动风的金发女孩，有着鲜艳的绿色眼睛、小麦色皮肤、灿烂的露齿笑容，凌乱的双马尾或高侧马尾发型，发丝飘逸，摆出俏皮且充满活力的姿势，向镜头上方倾斜。她穿着浅蓝色蕾丝或透明荷叶边吊带上衣、牛仔短裤、黑色颈圈和厚底白色运动鞋。左侧的女孩留着长直的 {argument name="second girl hair color" default="翡翠绿"} 头发，留着厚重的齐刘海，明亮的蓝色眼睛，皮肤白皙，表情冷静沉稳，坐在画面较低的位置向上看。她穿着休闲的夏日装束，色调为柔和的蓝灰色，露肩设计，搭配厚底运动鞋。在整个构图中添加层叠的日语杂志封面文字：左侧是多行堆叠的黑色和粉色专题标题，包括“NEO BASIC STYLE”和“SPORTY × FEMININE”；右侧是一个带有白色日文和英文短语“Trend 7”的粉色圆形徽章；下半部分是一个非常醒目的粉色大号日文主标题；右下角附近覆盖着白色手写体“shine in my style”；底部边缘还有额外的白色和粉色小字封面摘要。采用精致的编辑排版、重叠的字体、饱和的色彩、锐利的赛璐璐高光、时尚的夏日造型，呈现出 {argument name="issue month" default="2024 年 6 月"} 高端动漫杂志封面的质感。

templates.title: Post-Apocalyptic Ruins at Dusk

titleLocalized.zh: 黄昏下的末日废墟

templates.prompt: A moody post-apocalyptic cinematic landscape at dusk, painted in a dark sepia and amber palette, showing the ruins of an industrial or urban structure beneath a turbulent sky filled with dense, glowing clouds. In the left foreground, a large diagonal collapsed metal beam or crane arm rises from the bottom left toward the upper left, draped with torn fabric or shredded sheeting and tangled cables. A single long cable stretches diagonally downward across the frame toward the center. In the hazy midground, slightly right of center, stands a damaged domed tower or observatory-like building, partially obscured by dust, smoke, and drifting debris. The ground is filled with jagged rubble, broken structures, and silhouetted wreckage. Use dramatic backlighting from the cloud breaks near the horizon, soft volumetric haze, atmospheric perspective, painterly textures, and a ruined-world epic tone. The composition should feel vertical, solemn, desolate, and cinematic, with no people visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满忧郁气息的末日电影感景观，采用深褐色与琥珀色调，描绘了在布满浓厚发光云层的动荡天空下，工业或城市建筑的废墟。左侧前景中，一根巨大的倾斜坍塌金属梁或起重机臂从左下角向左上方延伸，上面覆盖着破损的织物或撕裂的板材以及缠绕的电缆。一根长电缆斜向穿过画面中心。在朦胧的中景偏右处，矗立着一座受损的圆顶塔楼或类似天文台的建筑，部分被灰尘、烟雾和漂浮的碎片遮挡。地面布满了锯齿状的瓦砾、破碎的结构和残骸剪影。利用地平线云层缝隙中的戏剧性逆光、柔和的体积雾、大气透视、绘画质感以及废墟世界的史诗基调。构图应呈现垂直感，庄重、荒凉且具有电影感，画面中无人出现。

templates.title: Cute Winking Schoolgirl Peace Sign

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的眨眼女学生比耶手势

templates.prompt: A simple cute flat vector illustration of a cheerful Japanese schoolgirl centered on a plain light gray background, shown from about mid-thigh up in a front-facing pose. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair with side-swept bangs, fair skin, a rounded face, pink blush on both cheeks, one eye open and the other eye winking, a small nose, and an open smiling mouth. She is wearing a classic Japanese high school uniform with a dark navy blazer, white shirt collar, large red ribbon bow at the neck, and a gray pleated skirt, with 2 visible gold blazer buttons. Both arms are stretched straight out horizontally to the sides toward the viewer, and both hands are making peace signs with the fingers angled downward. Use bold clean black outlines, soft pastel-like flat colors, minimal shading, kawaii sticker-style proportions, symmetrical composition, and a friendly playful expression.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁可爱的扁平矢量插画，主角是一位开朗的日本女学生，置于浅灰色纯色背景中心，画面展示从大腿中部以上的正面姿势。她留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 头发，配有侧分刘海，皮肤白皙，圆脸，双颊带有粉色腮红，一只眼睛睁开，另一只眼睛眨眼，小巧的鼻子，嘴巴微张露出笑容。她穿着经典的日本高中校服，包括深海军蓝西装外套、白色衬衫领、领口处系着大红色蝴蝶结，以及灰色百褶裙，外套上可见 2 枚金色纽扣。双臂向两侧水平伸出，面向观众，双手做出比耶手势，手指朝下。采用粗犷简洁的黑色轮廓线、柔和的淡色系扁平色彩、极简阴影、卡哇伊贴纸风格比例、对称构图以及友好俏皮的表情。

templates.title: Apocalyptic Ruined City Street

titleLocalized.zh: 末日废墟城市街道

templates.prompt: A dark, apocalyptic city street at night, viewed from ground level looking upward through a narrow canyon of ruined tall buildings on both sides. The architecture is heavily damaged and partially collapsed, with jagged silhouettes, broken facades, and blackened gothic-industrial details fading into shadow. A dense column of smoke and stormy cloud fills the center of the sky, backlit by a cold pale glow near the horizon, creating a dramatic high-contrast focal point. The overall palette is nearly monochrome deep navy, charcoal, black, and muted steel blue, with scattered tiny orange ember-like specks drifting through the air across the whole scene. The mood is bleak, ominous, and cinematic, like a post-disaster wasteland or bombed urban ruin. Painterly digital concept art, soft atmospheric haze, heavy texture, subtle film-grain feel, no people, no vehicles, no readable signs, wide composition, high detail in the ruined structures, strong vertical framing from the buildings, and a foreboding smoky sky dominating the upper half.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一条夜晚黑暗的末日城市街道，从地面视角向上仰望，两侧是如峡谷般狭窄的破败高楼。建筑受损严重且部分坍塌，呈现出参差不齐的轮廓、破碎的立面以及融入阴影中的黑色哥特工业风细节。浓重的烟柱和风暴云层充斥着天空中央，地平线附近透出的冷冽苍白光芒为其提供了背光，营造出极具戏剧性的高对比度视觉焦点。整体色调接近单色，以深海军蓝、炭灰、黑和柔和的钢蓝色为主，空气中散布着细小的橙色余烬，在整个场景中飘浮。氛围凄凉、阴森且具有电影感，宛如灾后废土或被轰炸后的城市废墟。绘画风格的数字概念艺术，柔和的大气雾霾，厚重的质感，带有微妙的胶片颗粒感，画面中无人、无车辆、无清晰可见的标志，采用广角构图，废墟结构细节丰富，建筑形成的强烈垂直构图以及占据上半部分的压抑烟雾天空，营造出不祥的预感。

templates.title: Flat-Color Elf Girl on Frilly Bed

titleLocalized.zh: 平涂风格精灵女孩与荷叶边床

templates.prompt: A soft flat-color anime illustration of a cute elf girl lounging sideways on a frilly bed in a pastel bedroom, with the composition weighted to the left and a large area of empty cream-colored negative space on the right. She has long slightly tousled {argument name="hair color" default="bright orange"} hair, large vivid {argument name="eye color" default="blue"} eyes, pale skin, and one clearly visible pointed elf ear decorated with a red flower hair clip. Her expression is gentle, shy, and relaxed, with a faint blush, as she rests her cheek against her hands and curls her body slightly on the bed. She wears a romantic off-shoulder {argument name="dress color" default="sage green"} dress with abundant white lace trim, floral embroidery, and 4 small red ribbon bows visible on the dress, paired with black bloomers with 1 red bow visible and white ankle socks with a tiny pink bow detail. The bed has a white ruffled pillow, pink cushions including a round frilled cushion, and a beige bunny plush toy with a pink ribbon sitting near her legs. In the background, show a small bedside table with 1 potted plant, 1 framed photo, and 1 lamp with a fabric shade, plus wall decor consisting of 1 hanging floral ornament and 2 small framed pictures. Scatter a few tiny pastel hearts and flower motifs across the empty right side. Use a delicate clean lineart style, muted pastel palette, very light beige background, flat coloring with minimal shading, airy and sweet shoujo mood, cozy bedroom aesthetic, high detail in frills and fabric, landscape format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和的平涂风格动漫插画，描绘了一位可爱的精灵女孩侧卧在粉彩卧室的荷叶边床上，构图重心偏左，右侧留有大面积的奶油色空白。她留着长而微乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="亮橙色"} 头发，有着明亮生动的 {argument name="eye color" default="蓝色"} 大眼睛，皮肤白皙，一只尖尖的精灵耳朵清晰可见，上面装饰着红花发夹。她表情温柔、羞涩且放松，脸颊微红，双手托腮，身体在床上微微蜷缩。她穿着一件浪漫的露肩 {argument name="dress color" default="鼠尾草绿"} 连衣裙，带有丰富的白色蕾丝饰边、花卉刺绣和 4 个可见的红色小蝴蝶结，搭配黑色灯笼裤（可见 1 个红色蝴蝶结）和带有粉色小蝴蝶结装饰的白色短袜。床上放着一个白色荷叶边枕头、粉色靠垫（包括一个圆形荷叶边靠垫），以及一只坐在她腿边、系着粉色丝带的米色兔子毛绒玩具。背景中展示了一个小床头柜，上面有 1 盆植物、1 张相框照片和 1 盏带布艺灯罩的台灯，墙面装饰包括 1 个悬挂式花卉饰品和 2 幅小相框画。在右侧的空白处散落着一些微小的粉彩心形和花朵图案。采用精致干净的线稿风格，柔和的粉彩调色板，极浅的米色背景，极简阴影的平涂上色，轻盈甜美的少女漫氛围，舒适的卧室美学，荷叶边和布料细节丰富，横向构图。

templates.title: Doodle-Style Cozy Restaurant Table Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 涂鸦风格温馨餐厅餐桌照片

templates.prompt: A moody, dark restaurant table photo styled like a trendy handwritten doodle edit, shot from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. The scene shows a wooden table with 4 main food-and-drink items: in the center-left, a large white pasta bowl with black rim text reading "OLIO E PIU," filled with creamy spaghetti or truffle pasta and topped with a glossy raw egg yolk, with a spoon resting inside the bowl and soft steam rising; at the lower right, a large white dinner plate cropped by the frame, holding roasted vegetables and a piece of browned meat with light green seasoning dust; at the lower left, a stemmed glass of white wine, partly cropped; at the upper right, a goblet-style glass of dark sparkling drink. The background is very dim and warm, almost black, making the food and glassware stand out under low ambient light. Add white hand-drawn overlay doodles and Japanese handwritten notes directly on top of the photo: one large curved headline at the upper left that says "おいしい時間、しあわせだな〜♡" with a sweeping underline and 2 small hearts; one note above the pasta that says "しっとり、たまごとろり" with a dotted arrow pointing to the egg yolk; one note near the upper-right drink that says "さっぱり、リフレッシュ！" with a dotted arrow pointing to the glass; one note at the lower left near the wine glass that says "sparkling. ちょっとした ごほうび。♡" with a curved dotted arrow; and one note near the lower center-right that says "あまくて、やわらかい :) ♡" with a dotted arrow pointing to the plated food. Include exactly 10 doodle embellishments besides the text: 2 steam squiggles above the pasta, 2 small sparkle stars near the wine glass, 2 small sparkle marks near the lower plate, 2 tiny droplet marks beside the upper-right drink, and 2 hearts near the headline. Use thin white chalk-like lines, casual imperfect handwriting, and a cozy editorial social-media aesthetic, keeping the composition realistic and photographic while the doodles look playful and hand-sketched.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张氛围感十足的深色餐厅餐桌照片，采用时尚的手绘涂鸦编辑风格，从略微俯视的四分之三角度拍摄。画面展示了一张木桌，上面摆放着 4 种主要的餐饮单品：左中位置是一个带有黑色边缘文字“OLIO E PIU”的大号白色意面碗，盛着奶油意面或松露意面，顶部放着一颗光亮的生蛋黄，碗内放着一把勺子，并冒着柔和的热气；右下角是一个被画面裁切的大号白色餐盘，盛放着烤蔬菜和一块带有浅绿色调料粉的褐色肉类；左下角是一只被部分裁切的白葡萄酒高脚杯；右上角是一只深色气泡饮料的高脚杯。背景非常昏暗且温暖，近乎黑色，使食物和玻璃器皿在低环境光下格外突出。在照片上方添加白色手绘涂鸦和日语手写注释：左上角有一行大的弧形标题，写着“おいしい時間、しあわせだな〜♡”，下方带有扫尾的下划线和 2 颗小爱心；意面上方有一条注释写着“しっとり、たまごとろり”，并有一条虚线箭头指向蛋黄；右上角饮料附近有一条注释写着“さっぱり、リフレッシュ！”，并有一条虚线箭头指向杯子；左下角葡萄酒杯附近有一条注释写着“sparkling. ちょっとした ごほうび。♡”，并有一条弯曲的虚线箭头；右下中心附近有一条注释写着“あまくて、やわらかい :) ♡”，并有一条虚线箭头指向盘中的食物。除了文字外，还需包含 10 个涂鸦装饰：意面上方 2 个热气波浪线，葡萄酒杯附近 2 颗小闪烁星，下层餐盘附近 2 个小闪烁标记，右上角饮料旁边 2 个微小水滴标记，以及标题附近 2 颗爱心。使用纤细的白色粉笔线条，呈现随意且不完美的笔触，营造出温馨的编辑类社交媒体美学，在保持构图真实摄影感的同时，让涂鸦看起来俏皮且具有手绘感。

templates.title: Moonlit Woman and Tiger Reflection

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的女子与虎影

templates.prompt: A dreamy cinematic fantasy night scene on a calm reflective sea under a deep indigo star-filled sky, with 1 large full moon in the upper left and the Milky Way stretching diagonally across the background. In the center, a slender woman with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} long straight hair walks barefoot across the shallow mirror-like water from left to right, shown in elegant full body profile. She wears a shimmering translucent silver evening gown with a fitted sparkling bodice, thin straps, a flowing gauzy skirt, and a high slit revealing one leg, the fabric trailing in the breeze. Around her right side, a curved arc of glowing magical particles forms 1 crescent-shaped trail made of luminous white roses, petals, and tiny lights, rising from the water near her reflection and curling upward beside her. Beneath her on the reflective surface appears a fantastical mirrored image: 1 glowing transparent white tiger lying on its side, rendered like liquid light and stardust, detailed with bright stripes and a softly radiant face. The water is glassy with subtle ripples and crisp reflections of the woman, moon, stars, and magical light. Low dark islands sit on the distant horizon. At the bottom center, add elegant luminous cursive text reading {argument name="quote" default="In me the tiger sniffs the rose"}. Ultra-detailed, ethereal, poetic, photoreal fantasy art, soft moonlight, cool blue palette, high contrast, gentle bloom, mystical atmosphere, widescreen composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的电影质感奇幻夜景，背景是深靛蓝色的星空，平静的海面如镜面般倒映着一切。左上方悬挂着 1 轮巨大的满月，银河斜向横跨整个背景。画面中央，一位身材修长的女子留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的长直发，赤脚走在浅浅的镜面水域上，从左向右行进，呈现出优雅的全身侧影。她身穿一件闪烁的半透明银色晚礼服，紧身胸衣闪闪发光，细肩带设计，裙摆轻盈飘逸，高开叉露出一条腿，裙摆在微风中摇曳。在她右侧，一道弯曲的魔法粒子弧线形成 1 条新月形轨迹，由发光的白玫瑰、花瓣和微小的光点组成，从她倒影附近的水面升起，并在她身旁向上盘旋。在她下方的水面上倒映着一个奇幻的镜像：1 只发光的透明白虎侧卧着，呈现出如液态光芒和星尘般的质感，带有明亮的条纹和柔和光亮的脸庞。水面如玻璃般平滑，带有细微的涟漪，清晰地倒映出女子、月亮、星星和魔法光芒。远处的地平线上坐落着低矮的深色岛屿。在底部中央，添加优雅的发光草书文字 {argument name="quote" default="心有猛虎，细嗅蔷薇"}。超精细、空灵、诗意、写实奇幻艺术，柔和月光，冷色调，高对比度，柔光效果，神秘氛围，宽银幕构图。

templates.title: Anime Concert Interview Magazine Spread

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫演唱会访谈杂志内页

templates.prompt: A high-impact anime promotional interview poster designed as a glossy two-page magazine spread for a futuristic live music event. The scene shows a packed nighttime concert arena filled with a crowd holding glowing light sticks in neon yellow, blue, and purple, with a huge illuminated stage in the background, laser beams, bokeh lights, haze, and a giant triangular play-icon screen reading "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026". In the center foreground are 2 anime-style female presenters seen from a dramatic side and back angle, both looking toward the stage. The left character is {argument name="left character name" default="ソラ"}, wearing a dark oversized hooded jacket with black and acid-lime accents, large lime-green headphones marked "06", and raising a bright yellow glow stick overhead; her face is partially obscured by a rectangular privacy block. The right character is {argument name="right character name" default="ナギ"}, with a short silver-white bob haircut and fair skin, wearing a pale oversized hooded coat, softly lit by stage lights, holding a white-blue glowing baton near her chest, with an emotional profile expression as she watches the show. Use cinematic rim lighting, richly saturated purple-blue concert colors, reflective fabric highlights, and detailed anime rendering with a polished editorial-advertising finish. Compose the layout like a Japanese special interview feature with dense text overlays, translucent dark panels, thin neon-yellow borders, and bold sans-serif typography. Include 8 distinct text blocks: 1 small header tag at top left reading "/ SPECIAL INTERVIEW /"; 1 large Japanese headline at upper left reading "この夏、AIと音楽の未来がステージで輝く！"; 1 event logo block at upper right reading "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026" and "2026.7.18 SAT @ FUTURE ARENA ODAIBA"; 3 question-and-answer panels stacked on the left with yellow-framed headers beginning with "Q."; 3 question-and-answer panels stacked on the right with yellow-framed headers beginning with "Q."; plus 2 character intro name boxes near the figures labeled "ソラ" and "ナギ". Add a bold closing Japanese tagline across the bottom left and center reading "AIと音楽が響き合う、新しい夏がはじまる。 一緒に、未来を体験しよう！". At the bottom right, include a footer block repeating the event name and date, plus a visible QR code and a small caption indicating the official website. The overall style should feel like a premium Japanese event flyer, interview article, and key visual combined, energetic, futuristic, emotional, and festival-like.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款极具视觉冲击力的动漫宣传访谈海报，设计为未来感现场音乐活动的精美杂志双页跨页。场景展示了一个座无虚席的夜间演唱会现场，观众挥舞着霓虹黄、蓝、紫色的荧光棒，背景是巨大的发光舞台、激光束、光斑、烟雾，以及一个巨大的三角形播放图标屏幕，上面写着“AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026”。前景中央是两位动漫风格的女主持人，以戏剧性的侧后方视角呈现，两人都望向舞台。左侧角色为 {argument name="left character name" default="ソラ"}，身穿带有黑色和酸橙绿点缀的深色超大款连帽夹克，佩戴标有“06”的大型酸橙绿耳机，头顶举着一支亮黄色的荧光棒；她的脸部被一个矩形隐私遮挡块部分遮盖。右侧角色为 {argument name="right character name" default="ナギ"}，留着银白色短波波头，皮肤白皙，身穿浅色超大款连帽外套，在舞台灯光的柔和映照下，胸前握着一支蓝白色的发光指挥棒，侧脸表情动人，注视着演出。运用电影级的轮廓光、饱和度丰富的紫蓝色演唱会色调、反光织物高光，以及精致的动漫渲染，呈现出高级的编辑广告质感。排版仿照日本专题访谈风格，包含密集的文字覆盖、半透明深色面板、细霓虹黄边框以及醒目的无衬线字体。包含 8 个独特的文本块：左上角 1 个小型标题标签，写着“/ SPECIAL INTERVIEW /”；左上方 1 个大型日文标题，写着“この夏、AIと音楽の未来がステージで輝く！”；右上角 1 个活动 Logo 块，写着“AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026”和“2026.7.18 SAT @ FUTURE ARENA ODAIBA”；左侧堆叠 3 个以“Q.”开头的黄色边框问答面板；右侧堆叠 3 个以“Q.”开头的黄色边框问答面板；以及人物附近标有“ソラ”和“ナギ”的 2 个角色介绍名称框。在底部左侧和中央添加一行醒目的日文结束语：“AIと音楽が響き合う、新しい夏がはじまる。 一緒に、未来を体験しよう！”。右下角包含一个重复活动名称和日期的页脚块，以及一个可见的二维码和标注官方网站的小字说明。整体风格融合了高端日本活动传单、访谈文章和主视觉图的特色，充满活力、未来感、情感张力与节日氛围。

templates.title: Kawaii Pink Kitten Escape Game Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱粉色小猫逃脱游戏广告

templates.prompt: A dreamy pastel pink Japanese mobile game advertisement poster in a vertical smartphone format, kawaii fantasy style, ultra-cute and glossy. The main subject is a fluffy white baby kitten with huge sparkling violet-blue eyes, soft blush on its cheeks, tiny pink nose, and a mischievous smile, lying on a pink cushion or blanket in the foreground while holding a baby bottle in its paws. The kitten is extremely fluffy and round, with soft glowing fur and a plush-toy feel, lit with warm magical highlights. The entire scene is filled with pink hearts, sparkles, lace details, soft bokeh, and candy-colored decorations, creating a soothing but playful atmosphere. In the background is a pastel pink bedroom or nursery interior with shelves holding exactly 3 stuffed animals: a pink rabbit, a mint-blue cat, and a lavender bear. Add translucent floating soap-bubble circles with white bone-shaped icons inside, small decorative charms, ribbons, and floral ornaments. On the left side, large bold vertical Japanese headline text in glossy bubble lettering reads 「脱出できない」 with smaller vertical text beside it reading 「かわいくて、」, all in bright pink with white glow and thick outline. Near the top inside a white lace-edged circular badge, include Japanese text reading 「もふもふ にゃんこと おへやから脱出？」 with a pink paw print icon beneath it. At the bottom, place a decorative game logo with large rounded Japanese text reading 「もふふミルクと にゃんこ」 and a ribbon banner below reading 「脱出ゲーム」, using pastel teal, cream, and pink colors with a shiny outlined style. Add a small rounded text plaque in the lower left that reads 「癒されるのに、意外とむずかしい…!?」 decorated with tiny flowers and a dangling baby bottle charm. Use a polished promotional key visual look for a cute indie app, highly detailed, soft airbrushed illustration, glossy typography, enchanting, comforting, and irresistibly adorable.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻粉彩风格的日式手机游戏宣传海报，采用竖版智能手机尺寸，卡哇伊幻想风格，超萌且具有光泽感。主体是一只毛茸茸的白色幼猫，有着巨大的闪烁紫蓝色眼睛、脸颊上带着淡淡的红晕、粉色的小鼻子和顽皮的微笑，它躺在前景的粉色坐垫或毯子上，爪子里抱着一个奶瓶。小猫极其蓬松圆润，毛发柔软发光，有着毛绒玩具般的质感，在温暖的魔法光影下显得格外可爱。整个场景充满了粉色爱心、闪光、蕾丝细节、柔和的虚化效果和糖果色装饰，营造出一种治愈又俏皮的氛围。背景是一个粉彩色的卧室或育婴室，架子上整齐地摆放着 3 个毛绒玩具：一只粉色兔子、一只薄荷蓝猫和一只薰衣草紫熊。添加半透明的漂浮肥皂泡，泡泡内有白色骨头形状的图标，以及小巧的装饰挂件、丝带和花卉装饰。左侧有醒目的垂直日文标题，采用光泽感的泡泡字体，写着「脱出できない」，旁边配有较小的垂直文字「かわいくて、」，均为亮粉色，带有白色光晕和粗轮廓。顶部是一个白色蕾丝边缘的圆形徽章，内含日文「もふもふ にゃんこと おへやから脱出？」，下方有一个粉色的猫爪印图标。底部放置一个装饰性的游戏 Logo，采用圆润的日文大字「もふふミルクと にゃんこ」，下方配有丝带横幅写着「脱出ゲーム」，配色采用粉蓝、奶油色和粉色，带有闪亮的轮廓风格。左下角添加一个圆润的小文本框，写着「癒されるのに、意外とむずかしい…!?」，并装饰有小花和悬挂的奶瓶挂件。采用精致的独立游戏宣传主视觉风格，细节丰富，柔和的喷绘插画，光泽感的排版，迷人、舒适且令人无法抗拒的可爱。

templates.title: Sunlit Anime Girl Outside Cafe

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光下的咖啡馆动漫少女

templates.prompt: A dreamy painterly anime-style full-body illustration of a young woman standing just outside a sunlit cafe entrance, with strong attention to the direction of her face and gaze. She is turned slightly to the right side of the image, her head angled sideways as if looking off-camera toward the street. Her face is softly simplified and partially obscured by bright light, with delicate features and no harsh outlines. She has long wavy brown hair with warm golden highlights, loose strands catching the sunlight, and a small hair clip near one side. She wears a loose cream-beige long-sleeved romper or short dress with a gathered waist and soft flowing sleeves, white scrunched socks, chunky white sneakers, and a small white shoulder bag with a thin gold chain strap. She holds 1 clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a black straw in both hands at chest height. The setting is the exterior of a cozy cafe with tall glass doors and windows on the right, and 2 visible cafe signs that read “MOUNT TOKYO” with smaller text “COFFEE, SANDWICH and more...” — 1 wall-mounted rectangular sign and 1 black A-frame sidewalk sign near the lower left; the A-frame also includes small opening hours text near the bottom. Include 1 simple wooden bench along the left edge. The whole scene is filled with dappled sunlight and dense leaf shadows cast across the walls, glass, ground, bench, and the woman’s clothing, creating a shimmering summer atmosphere. Use a soft watercolor and gouache-like rendering style with luminous overexposed highlights, warm cream, gold, and peach tones mixed with cool blue shadow accents, textured brushwork, reflective glass, and a nostalgic airy mood. Vertical composition, full body visible from head to shoes, elegant fashion illustration framing, highly detailed environment, sun-washed cafe street scene in Japan.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的绘画风格动漫全身插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在阳光明媚的咖啡馆入口外，画面着重表现了她面部朝向和视线的细节。她身体略微转向画面右侧，头部侧倾，仿佛正看向镜头外的街道。她的面部线条柔和简约，部分被明亮的光线遮蔽，五官精致，没有生硬的轮廓线。她留着一头带有温暖金色挑染的棕色长卷发，零散的发丝捕捉着阳光，一侧别着一个小发夹。她穿着一件宽松的米色长袖连体裤或短裙，腰部收紧，袖口轻盈飘逸，搭配白色堆堆袜、厚底小白鞋，以及一个带有细金链条的小白肩包。她双手捧着一杯插着黑色吸管的透明塑料冰咖啡，置于胸前。场景位于一家舒适的咖啡馆外，右侧是高大的玻璃门窗，可以看到两个写有“MOUNT TOKYO”字样的咖啡馆招牌，下方附有较小的文字“COFFEE, SANDWICH and more...”——其中一个是墙面安装的长方形招牌，另一个是左下方的黑色 A 型人行道立牌；A 型立牌底部还包含小字营业时间。左侧边缘放置着 1 张简单的木制长椅。整个场景充满了斑驳的阳光和浓密的树影，投射在墙壁、玻璃、地面、长椅和女性的衣物上，营造出闪烁的夏日氛围。采用柔和的水彩和水粉渲染风格，带有明亮过曝的高光，温暖的奶油色、金色和桃色调与冷蓝色的阴影相得益彰，笔触充满质感，玻璃反射出光泽，呈现出怀旧而轻盈的氛围。竖构图，全身可见，优雅的时尚插画构图，环境细节丰富，日本阳光洗礼下的咖啡馆街景。

templates.title: Urban Menswear Portrait on Overpass

titleLocalized.zh: 天桥上的都市男装肖像

templates.prompt: A natural-looking street fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young Japanese man"} standing on an urban pedestrian overpass in daylight, framed vertically from mid-thigh to head. He is leaning casually against a worn green metal railing with one hand in his coat pocket, body slightly angled, giving a relaxed but stylish candid pose rather than standing straight. He has medium-length wavy tousled hair in {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"}, soft volume around the ears and forehead, and a slim build. Dress him in layered neutral-toned winter fashion: an oversized wool coat in {argument name="coat color" default="taupe beige"}, a chunky knit crewneck sweater in {argument name="sweater color" default="cream"}, and a long striped button-up shirt peeking out at the collar and hem. The mood is calm, refined, and contemporary, like a Japanese men's fashion editorial. Use soft natural sunlight with realistic skin tones, subtle shadows, muted colors, and shallow depth of field. In the background, show out-of-focus mid- and high-rise city buildings, bare winter trees, and a pale bright sky, creating a realistic Tokyo-like urban atmosphere. Photorealistic, understated color grading, detailed fabric texture, editorial composition, no dramatic effects, no text overlays, no extra people.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张自然风格的街头时尚肖像，主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻日本男性"}，在日光下站在城市人行天桥上，构图为从大腿中部到头部的竖版肖像。他随意地倚靠在磨损的绿色金属栏杆上，一只手插在外套口袋里，身体微微倾斜，呈现出一种放松且时髦的抓拍姿态，而非笔直站立。他留着中等长度的微卷凌乱发型，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，耳部和额头处有自然的蓬松感，身材修长。为他穿上叠穿风格的中性色调冬季时装：一件 {argument name="coat color" default="灰褐色"} 的超大款羊毛大衣，内搭一件 {argument name="sweater color" default="米白色"} 的粗棒针圆领毛衣，领口和下摆露出长款条纹衬衫。整体氛围冷静、精致且充满现代感，如同日本男士时尚杂志的内页。使用柔和的自然光，呈现真实的肤色、细腻的阴影、柔和的色彩以及浅景深效果。背景中展示失焦的中高层城市建筑、冬季的枯树以及明亮的浅色天空，营造出真实的东京式都市氛围。写实风格，低调的色彩分级，细腻的织物纹理，杂志编辑级构图，无戏剧性特效，无文字叠加，无其他路人。

templates.title: Pastel Blueberry Cake Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 淡紫色蓝莓蛋糕动漫海报

templates.prompt: A dreamy pastel-purple Japanese movie poster illustration in a glossy shoujo anime style, packed with blueberry dessert chaos and soft sparkles. The scene shows 1 seated teenage girl with a short silver-lavender bob haircut, side bangs, a small lavender bow hair clip, and alternative cute fashion, sitting on the floor in a messy kitchen or baking workspace. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered square censor block in muted lavender-gray. She wears an oversized translucent lavender jacket with black ribbon details on the sleeves, a light purple graphic top, layered silver necklaces, a purple plaid skirt, slouchy white leg warmers decorated with lavender heart patches and black bows, and chunky lavender platform sneakers with ribbon accents. She holds 1 blueberry near her mouth with one hand and 1 metal mixing bowl smeared with vivid purple blueberry batter in the other. In front of her is 1 large golden pound cake split open dramatically, overflowing with dark glossy blueberries and purple filling, spilling across 1 cooling rack and the tabletop. Counted blueberries are scattered throughout the composition as floating and resting props, creating a whimsical suspended effect. The environment is cluttered with baking tools and notes: 1 spiral notebook page in the upper right labeled in English with a handwritten recipe for blueberry pound cake, 1 whisk in the lower right, 1 small pinned photo print in the lower left showing 2 anime girls, and 1 handwritten note card in the lower right with Japanese writing and a small bunny doodle. Use a monochrome palette of lilac, violet, periwinkle, cream, and deep blueberry purple, with luminous highlights, soft haze, translucent overlays, and romantic glitter. Add large expressive Japanese calligraphy text dominating the left half of the poster, reading vertically and diagonally like a dramatic light-novel or film advertisement, plus a ribbon banner near the cake with the date text “2026年7月メロードショー”, vertical copy on the right side, small production-credit text across the bottom, and a final tagline line at the very bottom. Make the composition feel like a cute disaster: beautiful but failed baking, sweet melancholy, fashionable messiness, and cinematic promotional poster energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的淡紫色日本电影海报插画，采用光泽感的少女动漫风格，充满了蓝莓甜点带来的混乱感与柔和的闪光。画面中，1 位少女坐在杂乱的厨房或烘焙工作台的地板上，留着银紫色短波波头，侧分刘海，戴着一个淡紫色小蝴蝶结发夹，身穿另类可爱的时尚服饰。她的脸部被一个居中的方形淡紫色灰色遮挡块刻意遮住。她穿着一件超大号半透明淡紫色夹克，袖口有黑色丝带装饰，内搭浅紫色印花上衣，叠戴银色项链，穿着紫色格纹裙、装饰着淡紫色心形补丁和黑色蝴蝶结的宽松白色堆堆袜，以及带有丝带装饰的厚底淡紫色运动鞋。她一只手拿着 1 颗蓝莓靠近嘴边，另一只手拿着 1 个沾满鲜艳紫色蓝莓面糊的金属搅拌碗。在她面前，1 个巨大的金色磅蛋糕戏剧性地裂开，溢出深色光亮的蓝莓和紫色馅料，洒落在 1 个冷却架和桌面上。蓝莓散落在整个画面中，作为悬浮和静置的道具，营造出一种奇妙的悬浮感。环境里杂乱地摆放着烘焙工具和笔记：右上角有 1 页螺旋笔记本，上面用英文手写着蓝莓磅蛋糕的食谱；右下角有 1 个打蛋器；左下角有 1 张别着的小照片，上面画着 2 位动漫少女；右下角还有 1 张写着日文和简笔画小兔子的手写便签。整体采用丁香紫、紫罗兰、长春花蓝、奶油色和深蓝莓紫的单色调，辅以明亮的高光、柔和的雾气、半透明的叠层和浪漫的闪粉。在海报左半部分加入醒目的大号日文书法文字，像戏剧性的轻小说或电影广告一样垂直和对角线排布；蛋糕旁配有 1 条丝带横幅，上面写着日期“2026年7月メロードショー”；右侧配有垂直文案；底部有小字制作人员名单；最底部有一行最终标语。整体构图营造出一种“可爱的灾难”感：美丽却失败的烘焙、甜蜜的忧郁、时尚的凌乱感以及电影宣传海报的张力。

templates.title: Pastel Anime Blueberry Cake Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和动漫风蓝莓蛋糕电影海报

templates.prompt: A dreamy pastel anime movie-poster illustration set in a narrow outdoor alley completely covered in dense floral mosaic wall art, rendered with glittering sparkles, soft haze, and romantic shoujo color grading in lavender, pink, periwinkle, and cream. In the foreground, show a cute teenage girl from a rear three-quarter view, her face mostly hidden, with short silvery-lavender bob hair and a large mauve bow hair accessory decorated with tiny flowers. She wears an oversized translucent lavender hoodie with embroidered floral appliqués on the sleeves, a layered pastel skirt, and carries a shiny lilac backpack covered with charms, ribbons, plush pom-poms, pins, and star details. She is holding a plate with a blueberry pound cake loaf that has been sliced open, and the center is dramatically overflowing with glossy dark-purple blueberry filling that pours out in thick syrupy streams down the cake and plate. Scatter whole blueberries around the cake and lower foreground. Make the scene whimsical, delicate, and slightly comedic despite the beautiful presentation. Design the image as a Japanese film poster with many decorative text overlays and laurels. Across the top, include 3 small award lines with laurel wreaths. Add a huge hand-lettered Japanese title in layered pink, white, and purple lettering with glow and sticker-like outlines reading: 「冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件。」 Below it, add a smaller subtitle line: 「〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜」. On the right side, place 1 vertical white quote box with Japanese text: 「うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。」 In the lower left, add 1 pinned pink note card that says “Sweet but clumsy.” and 1 torn recipe memo sheet with handwritten Japanese checklist items. Add a small speech bubble near the cake that says “Oops!”. Include a circular stamp-style seal near the lower right that reads “Blueberry disaster”. At the bottom, add film-credit style text in white, including “A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL”, and a large release line in pink and white: “{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} ROADSHOW”. Under that, add the Japanese tagline: 「失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。」 Frame the whole poster with lace, stickers, scraps of paper, and scrapbook-style decorations. Make it ultra-detailed, glossy, sentimental, kawaii, cinematic, and intentionally over-the-top like a fake coming-of-age movie poster about a baking failure.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的柔和动漫电影海报插画，背景设定在一条布满繁密花卉马赛克墙绘的狭窄户外小巷中，画面呈现出闪烁的星光、柔和的雾气，以及薰衣草色、粉色、长春花色和奶油色的浪漫少女漫色彩分级。前景展示了一位可爱的少女，背影呈四分之三侧面，面部大部分被遮挡，留着银薰衣草色的短波波头，戴着装饰有小花的大号淡紫色蝴蝶结发饰。她穿着一件超大号的半透明淡紫色连帽衫，袖子上绣有花卉贴花，搭配层叠的柔和色调短裙，背着一个闪亮的淡紫色双肩包，包上挂满了挂件、丝带、毛绒球、徽章和星星装饰。她手里端着一个切开的蓝莓磅蛋糕，中心戏剧性地溢出了光泽感十足的深紫色蓝莓馅料，浓稠的糖浆流淌在蛋糕和盘子上。在蛋糕周围和前景下方散落着整颗蓝莓。尽管画面精美，但整体氛围要显得奇幻、精致且带有一丝喜剧色彩。将图像设计为日式电影海报，带有许多装饰性文字叠加和月桂叶装饰。在顶部，包含 3 行带有月桂花环的小型奖项说明。添加一个巨大的手写日文标题，采用粉色、白色和紫色的层叠字体，带有发光和贴纸般的轮廓，文字为：「冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件。」（译：用冷冻蓝莓烤磅蛋糕结果内馅溢出失败了这件事。）在下方添加一行较小的副标题：「〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜」（译：～甜蜜又略带苦涩的青春食谱～）。在右侧放置一个垂直的白色引语框，内含日文：「うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。」（译：即使是不顺利的日子，也是人生的调味品。）在左下角，添加一张别着的粉色便签，上面写着“Sweet but clumsy.”，以及一张手写的日文清单撕页。在蛋糕附近添加一个小小的对话气泡，写着“Oops!”。在右下角附近添加一个圆形的印章式封条，上面写着“Blueberry disaster”。在底部，添加白色的电影演职员表风格文字，包括“A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL”，以及一行粉白相间的巨大上映日期：「{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} ROADSHOW」。在下方添加日文标语：「失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。」（译：失败，会成为最棒的回忆。所以，让我们再次挑战吧。）用蕾丝、贴纸、纸屑和剪贴簿风格的装饰框住整张海报。画面要超精细、有光泽、感性、可爱、具有电影感，并刻意营造出一种关于烘焙失败的青春成长电影海报的夸张效果。

templates.title: Vintage Japanese Crime Film Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古日本犯罪电影海报

templates.prompt: A vintage late-1970s Japanese crime film poster in the style of a Nikkatsu theatrical one-sheet, vertically composed on aged beige paper with visible grain, faint stains, and slightly faded ink. The main image is a large, moody half-body portrait of {argument name="lead actor name" default="原田芳雄"} occupying the upper right and center, turned partly away from camera, with thick curly dark hair, a serious expression, and a wrinkled light gray suit jacket over an open-collar white shirt; his face is mostly in shadow. Behind him is a bleak industrial waterfront with cranes, low factory structures, and heavy gray smoke rising into a washed-out sky. Across the lower middle, place a huge hand-brushed red Japanese title reading {argument name="title text" default="影の街"}, painted diagonally and aggressively, partially overlapping the portrait and the lower scene. In the lower half, add a second scene: a rainy urban street at dusk or night with wet reflective pavement, a dark police car at left with a glowing red roof light, and 6 men in suits and trench coats walking forward, with 1 central detective figure in a beige trench coat and loosened tie leading the group. On the far right, include a vertical strip of 5 stacked inset cast portraits framed in thin borders, each a dark cinematic still with different characters. Add vertical Japanese typography: on the upper right, the actor credit “原田芳雄 主演”; on the upper left, a 2-line tagline column reading “その男、刑事。 正義より、真実を追う。”; and near the lower right of the main image, another vertical blurb reading “誰が敵で、誰が味方か。闇に消えた事件の中で、ただひとつの真実を掴むまで—”. At the bottom, include dense small Japanese credits spanning the width, plus a large release date on the lower right reading {argument name="release date" default="11.23"} with “日活ロードショー” beneath it and a small studio mark. Use muted charcoal, sepia, smoky blue-gray, and off-white tones, with the red title as the only vivid color. The overall feeling is hard-boiled, melancholic, gritty, and cinematic, like a lost 1970s Japanese detective movie poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 20 世纪 70 年代末的复古日本犯罪电影海报，采用日活（Nikkatsu）院线单张海报风格，纵向构图，背景为带有明显颗粒感、微弱污渍和墨迹褪色的米色旧纸张。主体图像是位于右上角和中心位置的 {argument name="lead actor name" default="原田芳雄"} 的大型忧郁半身肖像，他侧身背对镜头，留着浓密的深色卷发，表情严肃，身穿皱巴巴的浅灰色西装外套，内搭敞领白衬衫；面部大部分处于阴影中。背景是荒凉的工业码头，有起重机、低矮的工厂建筑和升入灰暗天空的浓重烟雾。在画面中下部，放置一个巨大的手写红色日文标题 {argument name="title text" default="影の街"}，以倾斜且强烈的笔触书写，部分覆盖了肖像和下方场景。在下半部分，添加第二个场景：黄昏或夜晚雨中的城市街道，路面湿润且带有倒影，左侧是一辆车顶红灯闪烁的深色警车，6 名身穿西装和风衣的男子正向前走，其中 1 名身穿米色风衣、领带松散的侦探形象走在队伍最前方。在最右侧，包含一列垂直排列的 5 张嵌入式演员肖像，每张都带有细边框，呈现出不同角色的深沉电影剧照。添加垂直日文排版：右上角为演员表“原田芳雄 主演”；左上角为两行标语“その男、刑事。 正義より、真実を追う。”；在主体图像右下角附近，添加另一段垂直宣传语“誰が敵で、誰が味方か。闇に消えた事件の中で、ただひとつの真実を掴むまで—”。底部包含横跨整个宽度的密集小字日文演职员表，右下角标注醒目的上映日期 {argument name="release date" default="11.23"}，下方印有“日活ロードショー”字样及小型制片厂标志。色调采用柔和的炭灰色、深褐色、烟雾蓝灰色和灰白色，红色标题是唯一的鲜艳色彩。整体氛围硬派、忧郁、粗粝且充满电影感，宛如一张失传的 1970 年代日本侦探电影海报。

templates.title: Far Future City with Transparent Humanoid

titleLocalized.zh: 拥有透明人形生物的遥远未来城市

templates.prompt: A photorealistic ultra-futuristic cityscape in the year {argument name="year" default="100000 AD"}, viewed from a high terrace with glossy reflective flooring and lush vegetation climbing the architecture at the left edge. In the foreground, exactly 3 figures stand with their backs turned, looking out over the city: 1 human in a long elegant cream-colored robe or cloak, 1 sleek silver humanoid android with exposed mechanical details, and 1 mysterious translucent glowing humanoid made of shimmering light, almost like an invisible person outlined by refracted energy. The scene shows an immense advanced metropolis with countless slender megastructures and needle-like towers rising from green parklands and waterways, circular and elevated platforms supporting gardens and buildings, and several floating craft and hovering structures scattered across the skyline. Above the city, a gigantic transparent ring or shell-like orbital structure arcs across the sky, with a huge pale planetary body or moon dominating the background. Warm golden-hour sunlight, atmospheric haze, cinematic scale, highly detailed sci-fi architecture, utopian yet uncanny mood, realistic materials, long-distance depth, wide-angle composition, epic sense of civilization far beyond the present, with special visual emphasis on the enigmatic transparent humanoid figure.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超写实的未来城市景观，时间设定在 {argument name="year" default="公元 100000 年"}，视角从高处露台俯瞰，地面光洁如镜，左侧建筑上攀附着茂密的植被。前景中，3 个背对镜头的人物正眺望着这座城市：1 位身穿优雅米色长袍或斗篷的人类，1 位拥有外露机械细节的银色流线型安卓机器人，以及 1 位由闪烁光芒构成的神秘透明人形生物，宛如被折射能量勾勒出的隐形人。画面展现了一座宏伟的先进大都市，无数纤细的巨型建筑和针状塔楼从绿色的公园和水道中拔地而起，圆形高架平台支撑着花园与建筑，天际线上散布着多艘飞行器和悬浮结构。城市上方，一个巨大的透明环状或壳状轨道结构横跨天空，背景中悬挂着一颗巨大的苍白行星或卫星。温暖的黄金时刻阳光，大气薄雾，电影级尺度，高度精细的科幻建筑，乌托邦式又带有一丝诡谲的氛围，真实的材质，深远的景深，广角构图，展现出超越当今文明的史诗感，并特别强调了那个神秘的透明人形生物。

templates.title: Japanese Idol TV Show Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 日本偶像电视节目截图

templates.prompt: A brightly lit Japanese TV variety show studio screenshot in a cheerful pastel idol-program style, framed as a medium-wide group shot of {argument name="group size" default="5"} young women standing close together, with the center performer slightly forward and the others partially visible around her. Their faces are intentionally obscured by soft rectangular blur mosaics, as if anonymized for a social media post, but their hairstyles, outfits, body positions, and the set remain clear. They wear coordinated feminine stage uniforms in dusty pink and beige with white ribbon bows at the collar, floral lace trim on the shoulders and chest, puff sleeves, gold buttons, and small black lavalier microphones clipped near the neckline. The center woman has a shoulder-length light brown bob with side-swept bangs; two taller women in the back and right have long dark brown wavy hair; only the tops of two more members are visible at the lower left and lower right corners. The studio background is colorful and busy: a cream-and-pastel brick wall, stylized tree cutouts near the top left, a decorative pink ornate frame around a glowing purple LED panel with white flower icons on the left, and geometric pastel wall panels on the right. Add bold Japanese TV captions with crisp, readable text. In the top left, place a yellow-and-black construction-sign style box with diagonal hazard stripes reading "乃木坂工事中" and smaller roman text "nogizaka under construction". In the top right, place a black rectangle with yellow hazard-stripe border containing two lines of Japanese text: "イントロ中のアドリブ曲紹介" and "ピッタリ歌い出しまで埋めろ!". Across the lower center, add a huge playful headline in thick rounded Japanese lettering reading {argument name="main caption" default="1つ この曲を"}, colored bright yellow with orange shading, a white inner border, thick pink outline, and sparkly star accents integrated into the phrase. The composition should feel like a genuine paused television broadcast, colorful, polished, and highly legible, with a 16:9 aspect ratio and the visual emphasis on the large bottom caption and the center performer.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮的日本电视综艺节目演播室截图，采用欢快的柔和色调偶像节目风格，构图为中景广角群像，展示了 {argument name="group size" default="5"} 位年轻女性紧密站在一起，中心表演者略微靠前，其他人围绕在她周围部分可见。她们的面部被柔和的矩形马赛克故意遮挡，如同社交媒体帖子的匿名处理，但她们的发型、服装、身体姿态和场景保持清晰。她们穿着协调的女性化舞台制服，色调为灰粉色和米色，领口带有白色蝴蝶结，肩部和胸部饰有花朵蕾丝，泡泡袖，金色纽扣，领口附近别着小型黑色领夹麦克风。中心女性留着齐肩浅棕色波波头，带有侧分刘海；后方和右侧两位较高的女性留着深棕色长卷发；左下角和右下角仅可见另外两名成员的头部。演播室背景色彩丰富且繁杂：米色和柔和色调的砖墙，左上角有风格化的树木剪裁，左侧是一个发光的紫色 LED 面板，周围环绕着装饰性的粉色华丽边框，并带有白色花朵图标，右侧是几何形状的柔和色调墙板。添加醒目的日语电视字幕，文字清晰易读。在左上角，放置一个黄黑相间的施工标志风格方框，带有斜向危险条纹，文字为“乃木坂工事中”，下方有较小的罗马字“nogizaka under construction”。在右上角，放置一个带有黄色危险条纹边框的黑色矩形，包含两行日语文本：“イントロ中のアドリブ曲紹介”和“ピッタリ歌い出しまで埋めろ!”。在下方中央，添加一个巨大的趣味标题，采用粗圆体日语字形，内容为 {argument name="main caption" default="1つ この曲を"}，颜色为亮黄色，带有橙色阴影、白色内边框、粗粉色轮廓，短语中融入了闪亮的星星装饰。整体构图应呈现出真实的电视广播暂停画面感，色彩丰富、精致且高度清晰，采用 16:9 宽高比，视觉重点在于底部的大号标题和中心表演者。

templates.title: Japanese TV Idol Show Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 日本电视偶像节目截图

templates.prompt: A brightly lit Japanese television variety show set with two young female idols standing side by side behind a small white podium, framed in a medium shot from about waist-up. Both wear matching light gray school-uniform-style blazers with silver buttons, white dress shirts, gray striped ribbon ties, and coordinated name tags pinned to their left chest, with subtle lace detail visible at the waistline. The woman on the left has dark brown to black hair styled in a side braid draped over her right shoulder, hands clasped together in front of her chest, and a slightly angled body posture facing right. The woman on the right has long dark wavy hair falling over both shoulders and rests both hands lightly on the top of the podium. Their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. The background is a colorful, dense TV studio design: on the left, a tall pink glitter panel filled with repeating white icons including hearts, triangles, snowflake-like flowers, and tree silhouettes, bordered by ornate gold trim; in the center, a vivid red-orange vertical panel with partial white lettering behind the presenters; on the right, a yellow wall with metallic geometric decorations and a large curved brown mosaic arch studded with small reflective squares. Include 3 visible on-screen text areas: a top-left show logo in Japanese reading {argument name="show logo text" default="日向坂で会いましょう"} in a playful blue-and-white badge, a top-right headline banner in Japanese with two lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="ガッツリ褒められ隊を攻略せよ！『褒め褒めストラックアウト』"} in bold white and blue outlined text, and a lower-left black placard with red border containing Japanese text and a large score reading {argument name="score value" default="9 pt"}. The left name tag reads 1 member name in Japanese, {argument name="left name tag" default="高瀬 愛奈"}, and the right name tag reads 1 member name in Japanese, {argument name="right name tag" default="小坂 菜緒"}. Render it as a crisp broadcast screenshot with vivid studio lighting, saturated colors, realistic fabric texture, authentic Japanese TV graphics, and a polished entertainment-program look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个灯光璀璨的日本电视综艺节目现场，两位年轻女性偶像并排站在一个小白色讲台后，采用腰部以上的半身中景构图。两人均身穿配套的浅灰色校服风格西装外套，配有银色纽扣、白色衬衫、灰色条纹丝带领结，左胸前别着协调的名牌，腰部可见精致的蕾丝细节。左侧女性留着深棕色至黑色的侧编发，垂在右肩上，双手在胸前交叠，身体略微向右倾斜。右侧女性留着长长的深色波浪卷发，垂在双肩，双手轻轻搭在讲台顶部。她们的面部被柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡。背景是色彩丰富且密集的电视演播室设计：左侧是一个高大的粉色闪光面板，上面布满了重复的白色图标，包括心形、三角形、雪花状花朵和树木剪影，并镶有华丽的金色饰边；中央是一个鲜艳的红橙色垂直面板，在主持人身后带有部分白色字母；右侧是一面黄色墙壁，装饰着金属几何图形，以及一个镶嵌着小型反光方块的大型弧形棕色马赛克拱门。包含 3 个可见的屏幕文字区域：左上角为日语节目 Logo，显示为 {argument name="show logo text" default="日向坂で会いましょう"}，采用俏皮的蓝白徽章样式；右上角为日语标题横幅，分两行显示 {argument name="headline text" default="ガッツリ褒められ隊を攻略せよ！『褒め褒めストラックアウト』"}，采用粗体白色文字配蓝色描边；左下角为一个带有红色边框的黑色告示牌，包含日语文本和一个大号分数 {argument name="score value" default="9 pt"}。左侧名牌显示 1 个日语成员姓名 {argument name="left name tag" default="高瀬 愛奈"}，右侧名牌显示 1 个日语成员姓名 {argument name="right name tag" default="小坂 菜緒"}。将其渲染为清晰的广播截图，呈现生动的演播室灯光、饱和的色彩、逼真的织物纹理、地道的日本电视图形以及精致的娱乐节目质感。

templates.title: Japanese Waterproof Rainwear Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 日式防水雨衣广告

templates.prompt: A clean Japanese e-commerce promotional poster for a waterproof rainwear set, square format, bright high-key product ad style. Show 2 adult models walking outdoors on a wet pavement in light rain with a soft blurred background: 1 taller male model wearing a taupe-brown hooded waterproof jacket and black rain pants, and 1 shorter female model wearing a dusty pink hooded waterproof jacket and black rain pants. Both outfits are lightweight rain suits with zip-front jackets, subtle fabric sheen, visible water droplets on the surface, and casual sneakers. Faces are de-emphasized and not the focus. Use a white and pale gray background layout with the models placed center-right and full body visible. On the left side, large bold Japanese headline text in a mix of black and vivid blue reads exactly: "雨でも快適。しっかり防水" with small blue raindrop accents and a small umbrella icon near the text, plus a yellow brushstroke underline accent beneath the second line. Beneath the headline, add a blue ribbon-style banner with white Japanese text: "上下セット / 男女兼用". Below that, place exactly 3 circular blue feature icons in a horizontal row with Japanese labels: 1) water drops icon with text "耐水圧 20,000mm", 2) upward stretch arrows icon with text "ムレにくい", 3) feather icon with text "軽量設計". At the bottom left, display exactly 6 small product color variants as miniature jacket-and-pants set thumbnails arranged in 2 rows of 3. The 6 colorways are: black set, navy set, olive green set, pink set, beige set, and light gray set. In the top right corner, add a gold laurel award badge with red ribbons and Japanese text reading "Yahoo! ショッピング 第1位 RANKING" with smaller text beneath indicating a daily ranking note. Overall style: polished Japanese marketplace listing hero image, realistic apparel photography composited with clean graphic design, commercial catalog quality, waterproof outdoor lifestyle feel, soft overcast lighting, crisp typography, premium but accessible consumer product presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的日式电商促销海报，展示防水雨衣套装，方形构图，明亮的高调产品广告风格。画面展示 2 位成年模特在小雨中的湿润路面上行走，背景柔焦虚化：一位较高的男性模特穿着灰褐色连帽防水夹克和黑色雨裤，一位较矮的女性模特穿着灰粉色连帽防水夹克和黑色雨裤。两套服装均为轻便雨衣，配有拉链前襟夹克，面料带有细腻光泽，表面可见水珠，搭配休闲运动鞋。人物面部非焦点，弱化处理。采用白色和浅灰色背景布局，模特位于画面中右侧，全身可见。左侧为醒目的粗体日文标题，黑色与鲜蓝色混合，文字内容为：“雨でも快適。しっかり防水”，文字旁配有蓝色小雨滴装饰和一把小雨伞图标，第二行文字下方有黄色笔触下划线装饰。标题下方添加一个蓝色丝带状横幅，内含白色日文文字：“上下セット / 男女兼用”。下方水平排列 3 个圆形蓝色功能图标，并附带日文标签：1) 水滴图标，文字为“耐水圧 20,000mm”；2) 向上拉伸箭头图标，文字为“ムレにくい”；3) 羽毛图标，文字为“軽量設計”。左下角展示 6 款小型产品颜色变体，以 2 行 3 列的缩略图形式排列。6 种配色分别为：黑色套装、藏青色套装、橄榄绿套装、粉色套装、米色套装和浅灰色套装。右上角添加一个金色月桂奖章，配有红色丝带，文字为“Yahoo! ショッピング 第1位 RANKING”，下方附带较小的每日排名说明文字。整体风格：精致的日式电商列表主图，写实服装摄影与简洁平面设计合成，商业目录级品质，户外防水生活方式感，柔和阴天光线，清晰的排版，呈现出高端且亲民的消费品形象。

templates.title: Japanese Yoga Mat E-commerce Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 日式瑜伽垫电商广告

templates.prompt: Create a clean Japanese e-commerce advertisement image for a premium yoga mat in a bright minimalist home interior. The main scene shows 1 woman with her face softly blurred, doing an upward-facing dog yoga pose on a thick pastel pink yoga mat placed diagonally across a pale wood floor. She wears a white sports bra and light gray leggings, with her hair in a neat bun. In the left foreground, show 1 rolled purple yoga mat secured with 2 black straps. Along the bottom edge, display exactly 7 small rolled mat color variations in a row: pink, lavender, sky blue, mint green, beige, light gray, and black. Add large Japanese promotional typography on the left in a stylish modern layout: the headline reads "やさしく支える。" with "やさしく" in handwritten pink script and "支える。" in black, followed by a bold large line "極厚 10mm" with "10" oversized in pink and "mm" smaller in pink italic style. Under that, add a pink rectangular banner with white text reading "滑りにくい / TPE素材". Beneath the banner, place exactly 3 circular feature icons with labels in Japanese: 1) a non-slip texture icon labeled "滑り止め", 2) a cushioning icon with downward arrows labeled "クッション性", 3) a feather icon labeled "軽量". In the upper right corner, add a gold laurel award badge with a crown and layered red ribbons, containing the Japanese text "Yahoo! JAPAN ショッピング RANKING 第1位 ヨガマット部門". In the lower right corner, add a pink angled label reading "選べる 7色" with the number 7 large and white. The background should be soft, airy, and high-key with a white wall, natural daylight, and a slightly out-of-focus potted green plant and woven basket on the right side. Use a polished commercial product-photography style, soft shadows, pastel color palette, luxury wellness branding, sharp layout, and realistic materials, suitable for an online marketplace hero image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简洁的日式电商广告图，展示一款放置在明亮极简家居环境中的高级瑜伽垫。主场景中，1 位女性面部轻微虚化，正在浅色木地板上斜向铺设的加厚粉色瑜伽垫上做上犬式瑜伽动作。她身穿白色运动内衣和浅灰色紧身裤，头发梳成整齐的发髻。左侧前景展示 1 个用 2 条黑色绑带固定的紫色卷装瑜伽垫。底部边缘整齐排列 7 个小卷装瑜伽垫颜色变体：粉色、淡紫色、天蓝色、薄荷绿、米色、浅灰色和黑色。在左侧以时尚现代的排版添加醒目的日文促销文字：标题为“やさしく支える。”，其中“やさしく”采用粉色手写体，“支える。”采用黑色字体，下方紧跟一行加粗大字“极厚 10mm”，其中“10”字号放大且呈粉色，“mm”字号较小且呈粉色斜体。下方添加一个白色文字的粉色矩形横幅，写着“滑りにくい / TPE素材”。横幅下方放置 3 个带有日文标签的圆形功能图标：1) 防滑纹理图标，标签为“滑り止め”；2) 带有向下箭头的缓冲图标，标签为“クッション性”；3) 羽毛图标，标签为“軽量”。在右上角添加一个带有皇冠和层叠红丝带的金色月桂奖章，内含日文“Yahoo! JAPAN ショッピング RANKING 第1位 ヨガマット部門”。在右下角添加一个粉色斜角标签，写着“选べる 7色”，其中数字 7 放大并显示为白色。背景应柔和、通透且高调，包含白墙、自然光，右侧摆放一盆略微虚化的盆栽和编织篮。采用精致的商业产品摄影风格，柔和的阴影、柔和的色调、奢华的健康品牌感、清晰的布局以及逼真的材质，非常适合作为电商平台的主图。

templates.title: Japanese Cloud Insole Ad Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 日式云感鞋垫广告横幅

templates.prompt: Create a high-converting Japanese e-commerce product advertisement square image for a pair of ultra-cushioned insoles, styled like a Rakuten marketplace hero banner. Bright sky-blue gradient background with soft white clouds, clean glossy commercial design, energetic and premium. Large central Japanese headline in bold white calligraphic serif text with blue glow: "雲インソール". Above it, a rounded white capsule banner with blue text: "履いた瞬間ふわっ！". Below the main headline, smaller white handwritten-style Japanese subheading: "まるで雲の上を歩くような心地よさ". Show 4 insole product views total: 1 large white foam sole held vertically in a realistic human hand at lower left foreground, featuring a pebble-like bubble texture with small ventilation holes; 1 gray fabric-covered insole standing upright in the center; 2 stacked angled white insoles at lower right, emphasizing thick soft cushioning and textured underside. Add a large gold award badge at top left with crown and laurel, containing the Japanese text "第1位" and a red ribbon reading "楽天ランキング". Add a vertical gold ribbon badge at top right with the Japanese text "累計販売数 10万足 突破!". On the left side, place 4 vertically stacked rounded white icon boxes under a small blue handwritten caption "こんなお悩みに!", with simple blue line icons and labels: 1 "足の疲れ", 2 "衝撃吸収", 3 "長時間の立ち仕事", 4 "ウォーキング スポーツに". On the right side, place 2 rounded white feature boxes with blue outlines and blue-gray icon illustrations: top box text "衝撃吸収 疲れにくい" with a walking person icon; bottom box text "通気性◎ ムレにくい" with airflow lines icon. At the bottom right, add a large white cloud-shaped callout with bold blue Japanese text "極上の クッション感" and a tiny blue cloud icon. At the bottom center, place a small blue rounded label "選べるサイズ" with large blue size text underneath: "23.0cm〜29.0cm". Use crisp product-photography lighting, soft shadows, glossy highlights, vivid contrast, and a polished online shopping ad composition optimized for instant conversion.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张高转化率的日式电商鞋垫方形广告图，风格参考 Rakuten 乐天市场的首页横幅。背景采用明亮的天蓝色渐变，点缀柔和的白云，设计风格简洁、高级且充满活力。中央为醒目的白色粗体书法衬线字大标题，带有蓝色光晕：“雲インソール”。上方配有一个蓝色文字的白色圆角胶囊标签：“履いた瞬間ふわっ！”。主标题下方为较小的白色手写风格副标题：“まるで雲の上を歩くような心地よさ”。展示共 4 个鞋垫产品视图：左下角前景处由真人手持一只竖立的白色泡沫鞋垫，展示其鹅卵石般的泡棉纹理及细小透气孔；中央立着一只灰色织物面鞋垫；右下角堆叠放置两只倾斜的白色鞋垫，强调其厚实的缓冲感与底部纹理。左上角添加一个带有皇冠和月桂叶的大型金色奖章，内含日文“第1位”，并配有写着“楽天ランキング”的红色丝带。右上角添加一个垂直的金色丝带徽章，写有日文“累計販売数 10万足 突破!”。左侧放置 4 个垂直堆叠的白色圆角图标框，上方配有蓝色手写小标题“こんなお悩みに!”，内含简单的蓝色线条图标及标签：1“足の疲れ”、2“衝撃吸収”、3“長時間の立ち仕事”、4“ウォーキング スポーツに”。右侧放置 2 个带有蓝色边框的白色功能框，配有蓝灰色图标：上方框文字为“衝撃吸収 疲れにくい”（配步行者图标），下方框文字为“通気性◎ ムレにくい”（配气流线条图标）。右下角添加一个大型白色云朵状标注，内含醒目的蓝色日文“極上の クッション感”及一个小巧的蓝色云朵图标。底部中央放置一个蓝色小圆角标签“選べるサイズ”，下方标注大号蓝色尺码文字：“23.0cm〜29.0cm”。采用清晰的产品摄影布光，呈现柔和阴影、光泽高光与生动的对比度，打造专为即时转化而优化的精美电商广告构图。

templates.title: Anime VTuber Minecraft Stream Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 VTuber Minecraft 直播封面图

templates.prompt: A vibrant anime-style YouTube thumbnail for a livestream gaming broadcast, in a wide 16:9 composition, with a neon purple and pink streamer room. Center the scene on a cute catgirl VTuber sitting at a desk, shown from the waist up, leaning forward energetically with one hand on a computer mouse and the other hand reaching toward the viewer. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light orange-blonde"} bob-cut hair with soft bangs, fluffy brown-and-cream cat ears, and a visible cat tail. Her face is intentionally obscured by a solid rectangular censor block in the center. She wears a black-and-white maid-inspired outfit with a frilly white blouse, black dress bodice, puff sleeves, white ruffles, black ribbon bow, and a gold bell choker. Place a mechanical keyboard with bright RGB lighting on the desk, a glowing gaming mouse, and a streamer microphone on the far left with pink-purple LED lighting. Put 2 cat-themed desk items in the foreground: a plush cat face on the bottom left and a black cat-shaped mug on the bottom right. Behind her is a gaming chair with paw-print details. On the left side, add large bold Korean headline text in thick white block letters with black fill shadows and a glowing purple outline, stacked in 2 lines: {argument name="headline text" default="방송중 대참사"}. Below it, add a smaller yellow comic-style burst caption with black outline reading {argument name="sub text" default="> 크리퍼 실화냐"}. On the right side, show 1 large computer monitor angled inward, displaying a Minecraft-like scene with bright blue sky, green trees, water, and a large green Creeper popping out toward the viewer, outlined dramatically like a sticker cutout. Add starburst effects and neon accents around the monitor to heighten the chaos. Use exaggerated thumbnail aesthetics: ultra-saturated colors, sharp cel shading, thick outlines, glossy highlights, high contrast, dynamic perspective, and a clickworthy streamer-disaster mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的动漫风格 YouTube 直播游戏封面图，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，背景为霓虹紫粉色调的主播房间。画面中心是一位可爱的猫娘 VTuber，她坐在书桌前，半身出镜，身体前倾，充满活力，一只手握着鼠标，另一只手向观众伸出。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅橘金色"} 的波波头，配有柔和的刘海、毛茸茸的棕奶油色猫耳，身后可见猫尾。她的面部被画面中央的一个实心矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她穿着黑白配色的女仆装，包括荷叶边白衬衫、黑色连衣裙身、泡泡袖、白色褶边、黑色丝带蝴蝶结以及金色铃铛颈圈。书桌上放置着带有明亮 RGB 灯效的机械键盘、发光的电竞鼠标，最左侧放置着带有粉紫色 LED 灯光的直播麦克风。前景放置 2 个猫咪主题的桌面摆件：左下角是一个猫脸毛绒玩具，右下角是一个黑猫造型的马克杯。她身后是一把带有爪印细节的电竞椅。在左侧，添加醒目的粗体韩文标题，采用厚实的白色块状字体，配有黑色填充阴影和发光的紫色轮廓，分 2 行排列：{argument name="headline text" default="방송중 대참사"}。下方添加一个较小的黄色漫画风格爆炸气泡字幕，黑色轮廓，文字为 {argument name="sub text" default="> 크리퍼 실화냐"}。在右侧，展示 1 台向内倾斜的大型电脑显示器，屏幕显示着类似 Minecraft 的场景，包括明亮的蓝天、绿树、水面，以及一个巨大的绿色苦力怕向观众扑来，边缘经过戏剧性的贴纸式剪裁处理。在显示器周围添加星爆效果和霓虹装饰，以增强混乱感。采用夸张的封面美学：超饱和色彩、锐利的赛璐珞阴影、粗轮廓、光泽高光、高对比度、动态视角，营造出令人忍不住点击的直播事故氛围。

templates.title: Candy Lunar New Year Shrine

titleLocalized.zh: 糖果风农历新年神龛

templates.prompt: An ultra-dense maximalist fantasy illustration in a perfectly symmetrical front-facing composition, depicting a candy-themed Lunar New Year shrine scene exploding with color and detail. At the exact center, a kawaii doll-like girl deity sits cross-legged in a meditative lotus pose on a mound of sweets, framed by a huge radiant mandala halo shaped like layered lotus petals and ornamental festival patterns in gold, pink, orange, teal, and neon rainbow hues. She has a glossy bob haircut with blunt bangs in dark brown with purple sheen, a porcelain face with red lips, and her eyes are covered by a dramatic striped visor or blindfold made of yellow-and-black caution-tape-like ribbons. Her hair is decorated with oversized candy beads and lollipops, and her outfit is an extravagant sculptural dress made of frosting, sprinkles, bows, hearts, candy charms, pastel mascot faces, and dripping confection textures. Her hands rest open on her knees, palms up, in a serene ceremonial pose. Surrounding her is a packed altar-city of miniature pagodas, lantern towers, dragons, dolls, sweets, toys, and lucky symbols, all arranged in mirrored abundance. Include 4 large circular framed dessert mascots in the corners: top left a smiling pink frosted cupcake, top right a smiling pink macaron with a bow, bottom left a smiling gingerbread cookie, bottom right a smiling pink sprinkled donut. Include 6 prominent red-and-gold round festival signs across the upper half with Chinese characters such as fortune, prosperity, joy, and luck. Add 2 ornate dragon figures flanking the center, 2 decorated elephants in the mid-lower left and right, and 2 gold ingot bowls near them. Scatter many small doll girls in traditional festive dress throughout the background like collectible figurines. The entire foreground should be buried under countless colorful gumballs, candies, tiny teddy bears, smiley-face sweets, lollipops, beads, and toy-like creatures, with no empty space anywhere. Style: hyper-detailed, glossy 3D digital art, candycore, pop surrealism, toy diorama, festival altar, Chinese New Year iconography, saturated reds, pinks, oranges, and golds, sparkling highlights, crisp focus, intricate textures, celebratory and divine atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超高密度的极繁主义奇幻插画，采用完美对称的正面构图，描绘了一个糖果主题的农历新年神龛场景，色彩与细节极其丰富。正中央，一位卡哇伊风格的玩偶状女神盘腿坐在糖果堆上，姿态如莲花般静谧。她的身后是一个巨大的放射状曼陀罗光环，由层叠的莲花瓣和装饰性的节日图案组成，呈现出金色、粉色、橙色、青色和霓虹彩虹色。她留着深棕色带紫色光泽的亮面波波头，配有齐刘海，面容如瓷器般精致，双唇红润，双眼被一条黄黑相间的警示带状条纹遮阳板或眼罩遮住。她的头发上装饰着超大号糖果珠和棒棒糖，身穿一件极尽奢华的雕塑感礼服，由糖霜、糖针、蝴蝶结、爱心、糖果挂件、粉彩吉祥物头像和滴落的糖果纹理构成。她的双手平放在膝盖上，掌心向上，姿态庄重而宁静。环绕她的是一个由微型宝塔、灯笼塔、龙、玩偶、糖果、玩具和吉祥符号组成的祭坛城市，所有元素均以镜像对称的方式密集排列。四个角落分别包含 4 个大型圆形边框的甜点吉祥物：左上角是一个微笑的粉色糖霜纸杯蛋糕，右上角是一个带蝴蝶结的微笑粉色马卡龙，左下角是一个微笑的姜饼人，右下角是一个微笑的粉色糖针甜甜圈。上半部分包含 6 个醒目的红金配色圆形节日招牌，上面写有“福”、“旺”、“喜”、“吉”等中文字符。中心两侧各有一条华丽的龙，中下左右两侧各有一头装饰精美的大象，附近摆放着两个金元宝碗。背景中散布着许多身着传统节日服装的小玩偶女孩，宛如收藏级手办。整个前景被无数五颜六色的口香糖球、糖果、小泰迪熊、笑脸糖果、棒棒糖、珠子和玩具般的生物所覆盖，没有任何留白。风格：超高细节、光泽感 3D 数字艺术、糖果风、波普超现实主义、玩具立体模型、节日祭坛、农历新年意象、饱和的红色、粉色、橙色和金色，闪烁的高光，清晰的对焦，复杂的纹理，充满庆典与神圣的氛围。

templates.title: Japanese Visual Novel Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式视觉小说宣传海报

templates.prompt:
Create a Japanese bishoujo game promotional poster in the style of a premium visual novel box cover and store page composite. The image is split into three vertical areas. The left two-thirds is a dramatic illustrated key visual at sunset: a dreamy spring sky filled with pink and violet clouds, glowing rim light, drifting petals, and a reflective wet road or riverside path. Show 4 anime girls in school uniforms, all with soft emotional expressions and highly detailed hair moving in the wind. The largest girl is centered upper-left, shown from the chest up in profile or three-quarter view, with long dark hair and a small flower hair ornament, looking wistful. A second girl stands at lower-left with very light silver hair and a ribbon accessory, turned slightly away. A third girl is at lower center, smaller, with mauve or reddish-brown hair and a bowed, melancholy pose. A fourth girl is at mid-right, blonde or light brown-haired, facing upward with a hopeful expression. At the very bottom center of the key art, show 2 tiny full-body silhouettes of a boy and girl holding hands in the glowing distance, reflected in the wet ground. Add a white feather near the upper-left and scattered cherry blossom petals throughout. Overlay elegant Japanese title typography in large white brush-like serif lettering near the bottom-left to center: 「{argument name="title text" default="さよならの向こう側で"}」, with a smaller subtitle line beneath it. Along the far left edge, place 3 vertical lines of small Japanese catchphrase text in white. In the bottom-left corner, add 2 stacked black product labels with white text like a PC game package badge, one reading Windows compatible and one reading all ages.

The center is a narrow dark indigo vertical band separating the art from the info panel. On this band, place the game title again vertically in large white Japanese characters, with a smaller vertical tagline beneath it. Keep this band clean and elegant, like the spine of a game box.

The right third is a soft cream-colored information panel with a gentle paper texture. At top-left of this panel, add a bold Japanese heading in brackets: 「【あらすじ】」 followed by several lines of Japanese synopsis text laid out like a visual novel description page. Below that, add a dotted or dashed divider line. Then add a second bracketed heading: 「【特徴】」 with 4 feature bullets, each preceded by a simple icon. The 4 features are: branching choices, full voice support, tearjerking emotional story, and many beautiful CGs. Use small dark blue-gray icons and text. Add another divider line, then a third bracketed heading: 「【プレイヤーへ】」 followed by 2 short lines of Japanese message text.

On the far right side of the cream panel, stack 4 rounded-rectangle screenshot thumbnails vertically, each with thin white borders. Thumbnail 1: the dark-haired heroine by a seaside railing at sunset. Thumbnail 2: a pale-haired heroine with windblown hair against a bright blue ocean. Thumbnail 3: a girl indoors by a sunlit classroom or café window, warm and contemplative. Thumbnail 4: a girl surrounded by cherry blossoms in soft pink light. At the bottom of the cream panel, place a wide rounded lavender feature bar containing 4 large icons with short Japanese labels beneath or beside them: an open book, a microphone, an image/photo symbol, and a branching path/share-like icon. The overall mood should be nostalgic, romantic, cinematic, and emotionally overwhelming, like a high-budget Japanese gal game advertisement from the 2000s to 2010s. Use polished anime illustration, luminous backlighting, rich pastel sunset colors, glossy reflections, detailed typography, and authentic visual novel promo design.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张日式美少女游戏宣传海报，风格参考高端视觉小说包装封面与商店页面合成图。画面分为三个垂直区域。左侧三分之二为日落时分的戏剧性插画主视觉：梦幻般的春日天空，布满粉色与紫色的云彩，带有发光的边缘光，飘落的花瓣，以及倒映着光影的湿润路面或河畔小径。画面中展示 4 位身穿校服的动漫少女，她们都带有柔和的情感表达，发丝在风中飘动，细节极其丰富。最显眼的主角位于左上方，以胸部以上侧面或四分之三侧面呈现，留着长长的深色头发，佩戴小型花朵发饰，神情忧郁。第二位少女位于左下方，留着浅银色长发，佩戴丝带配饰，身体略微背向。第三位少女位于画面下方中央，体型较小，留着紫红色或红棕色头发，姿态低垂，略显忧伤。第四位少女位于右中部，金色或浅棕色头发，仰望天空，表情充满希望。在主视觉图的最底部中央，展示 2 个微小的全身剪影，男孩和女孩在发光的远方牵手，倒映在湿润的地面上。在左上方添加一片白色的羽毛，并在画面中散布樱花花瓣。在左下方至中央位置叠加优雅的日文标题排版，使用白色大号毛笔风格衬线字体：「{argument name="title text" default="さよならの向こう側で"}」，下方配有一行较小的副标题。在最左侧边缘，垂直排列 3 行白色的小号日文宣传标语。在左下角，添加 2 个堆叠的黑色产品标签，配以白色文字，类似于 PC 游戏包装徽章，一个写着 Windows 兼容，另一个写着全年龄适用。

中间是一个狭窄的深靛蓝色垂直带，将艺术图与信息面板隔开。在此带上，再次垂直放置大号白色日文游戏标题，下方配有较小的垂直标语。保持此区域简洁优雅，如同游戏盒的侧脊。

右侧三分之一是一个柔和的奶油色信息面板，带有细腻的纸张质感。在此面板的左上方，添加一个括号内的加粗日文标题：「【あらすじ】」，随后是几行日文剧情简介，排版如同视觉小说描述页面。下方添加一条虚线分割线。接着添加第二个括号标题：「【特徴】」，包含 4 个功能要点，每个要点前配有一个简单的图标。这 4 个功能分别是：分支选择、全程语音支持、催人泪下的情感故事以及大量精美 CG。使用深蓝灰色的小图标和文字。添加另一条分割线，然后是第三个括号标题：「【プレイヤーへ】」，后接 2 行简短的日文寄语。

在奶油色面板的最右侧，垂直堆叠 4 个圆角矩形截图缩略图，每个缩略图带有细白边框。缩略图 1：深发女主角在日落时分的海边栏杆旁。缩略图 2：浅发女主角在蔚蓝大海背景下，发丝随风飘动。缩略图 3：少女在室内，身处阳光明媚的教室或咖啡馆窗边，神情温暖而沉思。缩略图 4：少女被樱花环绕，沐浴在柔和的粉色光芒中。在奶油色面板底部，放置一个宽大的圆角薰衣草色功能栏，包含 4 个大图标，下方或侧面配有简短的日文标签：一本打开的书、一个麦克风、一个图像/照片符号以及一个分支路径/分享类图标。整体氛围应充满怀旧、浪漫、电影感，且情感充沛，如同 2000 年代至 2010 年代高预算日式美少女游戏广告。使用精致的动漫插画、发光的背光效果、浓郁的粉彩日落色调、光泽反射、精美的排版以及地道的视觉小说宣传设计。

templates.title: Anime Mecha Pilot Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫机甲驾驶员海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic anime sci-fi poster of {argument name="character name" default="Puru Two"}, inspired by a cyber-newtype pilot from a mecha war setting. The composition is a vertically oriented character key visual with one central full-body female figure in a sleek red and black pilot bodysuit, shown standing confidently in a slightly low-angle pose. She has short layered orange hair with long side bangs, pale skin, and a serious, emotionally distant expression. Her suit is glossy crimson with black side panels, a high collar, fitted seams, a front zipper line, dark gloves, a utility belt, and military insignia on the shoulders and chest. The background is a dark, space-like abstract field with black, crimson, magenta, and scattered star-like textures, splattered energy effects, and a gritty futuristic propaganda-poster mood. Surround the central figure with 3 inset panels: a top-right close-up of her eyes and upper face reflected through a transparent cockpit or HUD glass with red interface lights and small technical readouts, a mid-right soft pale portrait of a ghostly young girl in a loose white gown against a luminous misty white-gray background, and a bottom-right close-up of 1 gloved hand gripping a mechanical control lever with illuminated cockpit instrumentation. Add dense graphic design elements and typography throughout the left and right edges, combining elegant serif English text, Japanese vertical title text, compact technical labels, and mecha specification blocks. Include visible text such as the large title "PURU TWO", "NEO ZEON", "CYBER-NEWTYPE", "MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM ZZ", "PSYCHO GUNDAM MK-II", percentage/status readouts like "99.8%", and other small control-panel annotations. Use a high-detail painted anime illustration style, cinematic red lighting, glossy fabric highlights, sharp linework, subtle screen reflections, layered UI overlays, and a premium poster layout reminiscent of a luxury sci-fi character dossier.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧张力的动漫科幻海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Puru Two"}，灵感源自机甲战争背景下的“强化人”驾驶员。构图采用竖版角色主视觉设计，中心为一名身穿红黑相间流线型驾驶服的女性全身像，以略微仰视的视角自信站立。她留着短碎橘发，两侧留有长刘海，肤色苍白，表情严肃且带有疏离感。她的制服为亮面深红色，配有黑色侧边拼接、高领设计、贴合缝线、前拉链、深色手套、战术腰带，肩部和胸前饰有军事徽章。背景为深邃的太空感抽象空间，融合了黑色、深红、洋红色以及散落的星光质感、能量喷溅效果，营造出一种粗粝的未来主义宣传海报氛围。在中心人物周围添加 3 个嵌入式画格：右上角为透过透明驾驶舱或 HUD 玻璃看到的眼部及上半脸特写，伴有红色界面灯光和小型技术读数；中右侧为一名身穿宽松白裙的少女在明亮朦胧的灰白色背景下的柔和肖像，带有幽灵感；右下角为一只戴着手套的手紧握机械控制杆的特写，背景是发光的驾驶舱仪表盘。在左右边缘添加密集的图形设计元素和排版，结合优雅的衬线英文字体、日文竖排标题、紧凑的技术标签以及机甲规格说明块。包含可见文字，如大标题“PURU TWO”、“NEO ZEON”、“CYBER-NEWTYPE”、“MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM ZZ”、“PSYCHO GUNDAM MK-II”，以及“99.8%”等百分比/状态读数和其他小型控制面板注释。采用高细节的动漫插画风格，运用电影级红色光效、亮面织物高光、锐利的线条、细腻的屏幕反射、分层 UI 叠加，打造出如同奢华科幻角色档案般的高端海报布局。

templates.title: Cyberpunk City Highway HDRI

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克城市高速公路 HDRI

templates.prompt: Create a seamless-looking 360-degree equirectangular HDRI environment map of a futuristic urban expressway at night, viewed from the middle of a wide wet roadway beneath elevated highways in a dense modern city. Use a panoramic full-surround composition with strong fisheye-like equirectangular distortion at the top and bottom edges, designed for use as a Blender world background. The scene should feature 2 large curving elevated highway ramps, one on the left and one on the right, arching inward toward the center, with multiple supporting pillars and additional overpass layers receding into the distance. Surround the roadway with a skyline of illuminated high-rise office towers and apartment buildings, with cool blue and cyan windows and a few magenta and purple accent lights. Make the road surface glossy and rain-soaked, reflecting the city lights in long horizontal streaks of neon blue, violet, and pink. Add subtle light trails and luminous reflections across the pavement, creating a cyberpunk mood. The sky should be dark, cloudy, and atmospheric with a faint bright glow at the zenith and soft haze around distant buildings. Keep the overall palette dominated by deep indigo, electric blue, cyan, and purple. The image should feel cinematic, moody, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high dynamic range, with realistic urban lighting and mirrored wet-surface reflections, suitable as an HDRI backdrop. Include slight panorama seam artifacts and stretched distortion near the poles so it feels like an AI-generated but usable environment map.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张无缝的 360 度等距柱状投影 HDRI 环境贴图，展现未来主义城市夜间高速公路的景象，视角位于密集现代城市高架桥下宽阔湿润的道路中央。采用全景环绕构图，顶部和底部边缘带有强烈的鱼眼式等距柱状畸变，专为 Blender 世界背景设计。场景应包含 2 条大型弯曲高架匝道，左右各一，向中心拱起，并有多个支撑柱和向远处延伸的多层立交桥。道路四周环绕着灯火通明的写字楼和公寓楼天际线，窗户呈现冷蓝色和青色，并点缀少量洋红色和紫色装饰灯。路面应具有光泽且被雨水浸湿，反射出长条状的霓虹蓝、紫和粉色城市灯光。在路面上添加微妙的光轨和发光反射，营造出赛博朋克氛围。天空应为深沉、多云且富有质感的夜空，天顶处有微弱亮光，远处的建筑物周围环绕着柔和的雾气。整体色调以深靛蓝、电光蓝、青色和紫色为主。画面应具有电影感、情绪化、超高细节、照片级真实感，并具备逼真的城市照明和湿润表面的镜像反射，适合作为 HDRI 背景使用。包含轻微的全景接缝伪影和极点附近的拉伸畸变，使其呈现出 AI 生成但可用的环境贴图质感。
