templates.title: Epic Shiva Tandava Fire Dance

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级湿婆坦达瓦火之舞

templates.prompt: A monumental mythological fantasy painting of Lord Shiva performing the Tandava in the center of a fiery sacred arena, full-body, dynamic dancing pose with one leg raised and the other foot pressing down on a fallen figure beneath him. Shiva has ash-blue skin, a powerfully muscular physique, long wild flowing dark hair exploding outward in all directions, a high matted topknot, and a white crescent moon tucked into the hair. His expression is intense and divine. A cobra is coiled around his neck, and he wears multiple rudraksha bead necklaces, bracelets, and armlets, large circular earrings, and sacred ornaments. His clothing is a tiger-skin loincloth with dramatic red-orange cloth sashes whipping through the air. One raised hand holds a small damaru drum, one front hand is lifted in a blessing gesture with the Om symbol visible on the palm, and another hand conjures a bright flame above the open palm. Behind his head is a large glowing circular halo inscribed repeatedly with Sanskrit mantra text, creating a radiant mandala effect. The setting is an apocalyptic Himalayan temple landscape with dark storm clouds, smoke, embers, rocky mountains, waterfalls, and ancient stone shrines and temple towers on both the left and right sides. A trident wrapped with red cloth stands upright on the left side of the scene. Around Shiva is a circle of exactly 10 worshippers and ascetics, split across both sides, shown chanting, kneeling, raising arms, carrying torches, and playing drums in devotion. Beneath Shiva is exactly 1 fallen dark-skinned male figure lying on the stone ground. The ground is cracked and molten, with a blazing ring of lava and fire encircling the dance platform. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, glowing orange firelight against deep charcoal shadows, highly detailed anatomy, intricate jewelry and textures, swirling hair and fabric motion, devotional epic fantasy realism, painterly brushwork, symmetrical central composition, ultra-detailed, high contrast, vertical poster format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅宏大的神话奇幻画作，描绘了湿婆神在神圣火场中心表演坦达瓦之舞。全身动态舞姿，一腿抬起，另一只脚踩在身下倒地的身影上。湿婆拥有灰蓝色的皮肤、强健的肌肉线条，长而狂野的深色头发向四周炸开，头顶扎着高高的发髻，发间别着一弯白色新月。他的表情庄严而神圣。一条眼镜蛇盘绕在他的颈部，他佩戴着多串鲁德拉沙珠项链、手镯、臂环、巨大的圆形耳环以及神圣的饰品。他身着虎皮缠腰布，红橙色的布带在空中剧烈飘动。一只抬起的手拿着一个小达玛鲁鼓，前侧的一只手做出祝福姿势，手掌上可见“唵”字符号，另一只手在张开的掌心上方幻化出一团明亮的火焰。他脑后是一个巨大的发光圆形光环，上面刻满了梵文咒语，营造出光芒四射的曼陀罗效果。背景是末日般的喜马拉雅寺庙景观，伴有乌云、烟雾、余烬、岩石山脉、瀑布，以及左右两侧古老的石制神龛和寺庙塔楼。场景左侧矗立着一把缠绕着红布的三叉戟。湿婆周围环绕着整整 10 位信徒和苦行僧，分布在两侧，他们正在虔诚地吟唱、跪拜、举起双臂、手持火炬并敲击鼓点。湿婆身下是 1 位倒在石地上的深色皮肤男性身影。地面开裂且熔岩翻滚，一圈炽热的熔岩和火焰环绕着舞蹈平台。采用戏剧性的电影级布光，深邃的炭黑色阴影与明亮的橙色火光形成对比，展现高度精细的解剖结构、复杂的珠宝与纹理、飞扬的头发与织物动态、虔诚的史诗奇幻写实风格、油画般的笔触、对称的中心构图，超高细节，高对比度，竖版海报格式。

templates.title: Cinematic Beyblade Rooftop Launch

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感 Beyblade 屋顶发射场景

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic cinematic action photo of a young man mid-jump above a rooftop at golden-hour sunset, captured from a dramatic low angle against a glowing orange sky filled with scattered clouds. He is centered in the frame, airborne with both knees bent, wearing a woven straw hat, an open {argument name="jacket color" default="bright red"} overshirt flaring in the wind, a white tank top, dark loose cargo-style pants, rugged dark boots, layered necklaces, fingerless gloves, and a belt with a launcher holster clipped at his waist. His right arm is thrust toward the camera, launching a spinning top toy on a visible ripcord, with the toy in the extreme foreground on the right side rendered large and motion-blurred for depth and speed. Place a transparent plastic Beyblade battle stadium at the bottom foreground, catching warm reflections from the sunset, with the clearly visible printed logo text {argument name="brand text" default="BEYBLADE X"}. The city skyline stretches across the lower background with several high-rise buildings silhouetted by the setting sun near the horizon. Lighting is intensely warm and backlit, with strong rim light, cinematic contrast, subtle lens flare, and dynamic fabric movement. The composition should feel like a live-action promotional poster for {argument name="toy franchise" default="Beyblade X"}, emphasizing energy, youth, speed, and urban rooftop competition, in vertical poster format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的电影级动作照片，展示了一名年轻人在黄金时刻的日落背景下，在屋顶上腾空而起的瞬间。镜头采用极具戏剧性的低角度拍摄，背景是布满稀疏云层的橙色发光天空。他位于画面中心，双膝弯曲处于空中，头戴编织草帽，身穿一件在风中飘动的 {argument name="jacket color" default="亮红色"} 开衫外套，内搭白色背心，下身穿着深色宽松工装裤，脚蹬粗犷的深色靴子，佩戴叠层项链和露指手套，腰间系着带有发射器皮套的腰带。他的右臂向镜头方向伸出，正在拉动拉条发射一个陀螺玩具，玩具位于画面右侧极近的前景处，呈现出巨大的尺寸和动态模糊效果，以增强深度感和速度感。在底部前景放置一个透明塑料 Beyblade 对战盘，捕捉着日落的温暖反光，盘上清晰可见印制的标志性文字 {argument name="brand text" default="BEYBLADE X"}。城市天际线延伸至下方的背景中，几座高层建筑在靠近地平线的落日余晖中呈现出剪影。光线呈现出强烈的暖色调背光效果，具有明显的轮廓光、电影级对比度、细腻的镜头光晕以及充满动感的织物飘动效果。构图应呈现出 {argument name="toy franchise" default="Beyblade X"} 真人宣传海报的质感，强调活力、青春、速度与城市屋顶竞技感，采用竖版海报格式。

templates.title: Cinematic Spinning Top Street Duel

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感陀螺街头对决

templates.prompt: A cinematic live-action action scene in a narrow old European stone street at golden-hour sunset, shot from an extremely low, close-up perspective with a dramatic wide-angle lens. In the center-left foreground, a dynamic male fighter inspired by {argument name="character name" default="Luffy"} lunges forward in mid-motion, wearing a straw hat, an open {argument name="jacket color" default="red"} shirt, a light tank top, and dark pants. His body is twisted aggressively as he launches a spinning-top battle attack with a handheld launcher. In the right foreground, a sharply dressed gangster-like man in a dark suit and white shirt leans in, also firing a launcher, with two more suited men behind him and a crowd of onlookers filling the street. In the immediate foreground, exactly 2 spinning tops collide on a glossy dark surface, producing showers of bright orange sparks and multiple circular light trails that arc around them, emphasizing speed and impact. The environment is dense and atmospheric: weathered stone buildings rise on both sides, the street is packed with spectators, and a grand baroque cathedral dome and towers stand in the sunlit background. Use intense warm amber and copper lighting, deep shadows, high contrast, dust and spark particles, gritty texture, dramatic motion blur, shallow depth of field, and an epic blockbuster tone. The composition should feel like a hybrid of underground battle, street duel, and anime-inspired live-action adaptation, with kinetic energy, tension, and hyper-detailed realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一场电影级的真人动作场景，背景设定在黄昏时分狭窄的欧洲古老石板街上，采用极低角度的特写镜头和戏剧性的广角镜头拍摄。在左前方中心位置，一位灵感来自 {argument name="character name" default="路飞"} 的动态男性战士正向前俯冲，他头戴草帽，身穿敞开的 {argument name="jacket color" default="红色"} 外套、浅色背心和深色长裤。他的身体剧烈扭转，正使用手持发射器发动陀螺战攻击。在右前方，一名身着深色西装、白色衬衫的黑帮风格男子正倾身向前，同样发射着陀螺；他身后还有两名西装男，街道上挤满了围观群众。在画面最前方，两个陀螺在光亮的深色表面上发生碰撞，迸发出耀眼的橙色火花，多道圆形光轨环绕周围，突显出速度感与冲击力。环境氛围浓厚：两侧是风化的石质建筑，街道挤满了观众，阳光照耀下的背景中矗立着宏伟的巴洛克式大教堂圆顶和塔楼。运用强烈的暖琥珀色和铜色灯光、深邃的阴影、高对比度、尘埃与火花颗粒、粗粝的质感、戏剧性的动态模糊、浅景深，营造出史诗级大片的基调。构图应融合地下对决、街头决斗和动漫改编真人版的风格，充满动能、张力与超写实的细节。

templates.title: Surreal Futurist Japanese Collage Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实未来主义日式拼贴海报

templates.prompt: A dense surreal collage poster blending retro Japanese street culture, dystopian futurism, environmental collapse, and cosmic dream imagery in one vertically stacked composition. The image should feel like layered mixed-media street art made from torn posters, ink illustration, manga textures, watercolor washes, newspaper print, spray paint, and graphic design fragments. The overall palette combines deep midnight blues, black, cream paper tones, neon magenta, crimson red, cherry blossom pink, and industrial gray. In the upper left, show a large red sun behind Mount Fuji with cherry blossom branches crossing the corner, and a small airplane in the sky. Along the left side and lower left, depict a crowded Tokyo-like city street packed with pedestrians, glowing signs, dense buildings, and a tall cylindrical building with a smiley face near the top and a vertical sign reading AI IS WATCHING YOU. Include stylized Japanese-style signage on nearby buildings. Add a giant wave motif and a pagoda integrated into the urban scene. In the upper center, place a dark industrial skyline with multiple smokestacks releasing massive black clouds, transitioning into a giant astronaut floating forward with one hand reaching out. In the upper right, transform the sky into outer space with stars, a swirling purple-and-blue nebula, and a black hole. Beneath that, create a futuristic eco-city of sleek skyscrapers mixed with lush trees, cliffs, and cascading waterfalls. Add a glowing neon sign on the far right that reads DREAMING IS FREE. Near the astronaut, place a torn poster with the text THE FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN in large type and below it But we are the authors in smaller type. Across the center, layer floral elements including cherry blossoms and large roses around a partially obscured central human portrait to give the sense of fragmented identity. In the lower center, show a person from behind wearing a dark hooded jacket with graffiti-style text reading QUESTION EVERYTHING. Around them, include additional cutout portrait fragments, a Mondrian-inspired geometric block of red, blue, yellow, white, and black rectangles, a classical marble bust fragment, a white dove in flight, a small protest sign that reads EQUALITY ≠ EQUITY, and a seated figure looking toward the futuristic landscape. In the lower left corner, include part of a noir-style person in a dark hat and coat, and in the lower right, part of a manga-style female face in profile. Scatter graffiti, torn edges, ink splatters, layered paper textures, and poster remnants throughout. The composition should be extremely busy, cinematic, and thought-provoking, balancing hope and anxiety, tradition and technology, nature and urban overload, in the style of a high-detail contemporary collage mural.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张密集的超现实拼贴海报，将复古日本街头文化、反乌托邦未来主义、环境崩溃和宇宙梦境意象融合在垂直堆叠的构图中。画面应呈现出层叠的混合媒介街头艺术感，由撕裂的海报、水墨插画、漫画纹理、水彩晕染、报纸印刷、喷漆和平面设计碎片构成。整体色调结合了深午夜蓝、黑色、奶油纸色、霓虹洋红色、深红色、樱花粉和工业灰。左上角展示一轮巨大的红日映衬着富士山，樱花枝横跨角落，天空中有一架小型飞机。左侧及左下方描绘一条拥挤的东京风格街道，挤满了行人、发光的招牌、密集的建筑，以及一座顶部带有笑脸、垂直招牌写着“AI IS WATCHING YOU”的高耸圆柱形建筑。在附近的建筑上加入风格化的日式招牌。在城市场景中融入巨大的波浪图案和一座宝塔。上部中心放置一个黑暗的工业天际线，多个烟囱释放出巨大的黑烟，并过渡到一个向前漂浮、单手伸出的巨大宇航员。右上角将天空转化为外太空，点缀着星星、旋转的紫蓝色星云和一个黑洞。下方创造一个未来派的生态城市，由光滑的摩天大楼与茂密的树木、悬崖和层叠的瀑布混合而成。在最右侧添加一个发光的霓虹灯牌，上面写着“DREAMING IS FREE”。在宇航员附近，放置一张撕裂的海报，上面用大号字体写着“THE FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN”，下方用较小字体写着“But we are the authors”。在中心区域，层叠樱花和大型玫瑰等花卉元素，环绕着一个部分被遮挡的中央人像，营造出碎片化身份的感觉。下部中心展示一个身穿深色连帽夹克、背对观众的人，衣服上有涂鸦风格的文字“QUESTION EVERYTHING”。在他们周围，加入额外的剪纸肖像碎片、一个受蒙德里安启发的红、蓝、黄、白、黑矩形几何块、一个古典大理石半身像碎片、一只飞翔的白鸽、一个写着“EQUALITY ≠ EQUITY”的小型抗议标语，以及一个看向未来景观的坐姿人物。左下角包含一个戴着深色帽子和外套的黑色电影风格人物，右下角则是一个漫画风格的女性侧脸。画面中散布着涂鸦、撕裂的边缘、墨水溅痕、层叠的纸张纹理和海报残片。整个构图极其繁复、具有电影感且引人深思，在细节丰富的高级当代拼贴壁画风格中，平衡了希望与焦虑、传统与科技、自然与城市过载。

templates.title: Short-Form Attention Tax Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 短视频注意力税海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
A bold editorial poster in a brutalist Swiss-modern infographic style on a light warm-gray background, portrait orientation, with a split composition: oversized typography dominating the left half and a blurred monochrome human face dominating the right half. The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. The overall look should feel like a high-end social critique poster, mixing typographic activism, data editorial design, and dystopian tech-noise portraiture, with crisp layout, strong negative space, and print-poster realism.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张采用粗野主义瑞士现代信息图风格的醒目编辑类海报，背景为浅暖灰色，纵向构图，采用分割式布局：左侧由超大字体主导，右侧由模糊的单色人脸主导。主标题以巨大的压缩无衬线大写字母堆叠排版，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX"}，其中“SHORT-FORM”为黑色，“ATTENTION TAX”为鲜艳的红橙色。在最左侧边缘放置一个小的垂直年份标记“-2024”。左上角添加微小的全大写文字“YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.”，右上角添加微小的全大写文字“TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.”，角落附近带有小的加号对齐标记。在左侧标题下方，添加副标题“A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

在左下侧垂直排列 3 个带编号的信息块，每个信息块均以垂直红橙色条和巨大的黑色数字标记：第 01 部分标题为“WHAT IS IT?”，第 02 部分标题为“WHY DOES IT EXIST?”，第 03 部分标题为“HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”。在第 01 部分下，包含正文解释“短视频注意力税”是消费无尽短视频内容所支付的隐形代价，它以平台为让你持续滑动而提取的秒数、分钟数和精神能量来衡量。在第 02 部分下，包含正文解释平台竞相争夺注意力是因为注意力、数据和利润息息相关，且短视频内容经过优化，具有即时奖励性、无限滑动性和难以停止的特性。在第 03 部分下，包含 6 个红橙色短横线样式的要点：“Shortens attention span”（缩短注意力跨度）、“Reduces deep focus”（降低深度专注力）、“Increases impulsive behavior”（增加冲动行为）、“Disrupts memory & learning”（干扰记忆与学习）、“Drives comparison & anxiety”（驱动攀比与焦虑）以及“Creates compulsive usage loops”（产生强迫性使用循环），随后是一句关于重塑思维、感受和行为方式的简短总结。

在左中和中下区域，添加混合字号的辅助编辑排版：“Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.”，其中“currency”一词为红橙色；一个小型统计数据块写着“THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.”，其中“90+ MINUTES”为红橙色；一个巨大的堆叠数字声明，黑色字体写着“16 DAYS”，上方文字为“THAT’S OVER”，下方为“A YEAR.”；以及一行简短的结束语“TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

在右半部分，展示一张黑白人脸特写，部分裁剪，目视前方，表情严肃中性。应用强烈的水平动态模糊、数字涂抹、类似扫描线的条纹以及穿过脸部的故障条，特别是额头、鼻子和嘴部。在脸部中右侧叠加 5 个垂直的社交媒体风格界面图标：一个白色圆圈/个人资料点、一个红橙色心形、一个白色对话气泡、一个白色书签丝带和一个白色分享箭头。在脸部右下角添加一个巨大的半透明红橙色圆圈。包含微妙的类似 HUD 的图形元素：右上角附近有一个带有小红橙色三角形楔形的微弱圆形十字准线，最右侧边缘附近有一个细长的垂直测量标尺，几个白色方形标记，小的黑白水平条，以及散布的微小加号以增加布局质感。

在底部，左侧放置一个条形码，上方带有微小的坐标式文字，然后沿宽度方向间隔排列 3 个页脚标语：“PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”、“BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”以及“RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.”仅使用黑色、灰白色和红橙色的克制色调。整体外观应呈现出高端社会评论海报的感觉，融合排版激进主义、数据编辑设计和反乌托邦科技噪声肖像，具备清晰的布局、强烈的留白和印刷海报的真实感。

templates.title: Gothic Anime Witch Library Ensemble

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特动漫风魔法图书馆群像

templates.prompt: A lavish dark fantasy anime illustration of 11 elegant young women gathered in a grand gothic library at night, composed like an elite magical academy coven portrait. The room is filled wall-to-wall with towering wooden bookshelves, rolling ladders, crimson velvet banners with occult gold sigils, carved paneling, candlelight, a warm table lamp on the far left, red upholstered armchairs and sofas, stacked antique books, potion bottles, crystal orbs, brass instruments, and a tall arched window showing a deep violet night sky. The overall palette is black, crimson, gold, and purple, with dramatic low-key lighting, rich shadows, glossy highlights, and a luxurious, sinister atmosphere. All 11 characters wear coordinated occult-school uniforms: black tailored jackets with gold embroidery and crest details, white shirts, red ties or ribbons, layered belts and chains, short skirts or fitted bottoms, black thigh-high stockings, and black capes lined in dark red. Place 3 seated prominently in the middle on ornate red chairs and sofa, 3 in the back row standing among the shelves, 3 in the front row on the floor or leaning close to the table, and 2 reclining at the far left and far right edges. Vary their hair colors and styles across the group, including {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"}, silver, black, red, blue, brown, and purple; use long wavy hair, twin tails, straight long hair, side ponytail, and loose layered cuts. Give each woman a calm, confident, slightly dangerous expression, as if they are genius witches or aristocratic students. Count and include 6 clearly visible magical effects or props being actively handled: 1 red flame floating above a raised hand in the back center, 1 glowing purple orb held by a standing girl near the upper right center, 1 swirling purple magic circle over an open book at the lower left, 1 faint purple arcane flame near the lap of the seated silver-haired girl on the right-center, 1 dark violet smoky aura around the far-right reclined girl, and 1 glowing purple crystal lamp or alchemical vessel on the central coffee table. Also include 4 additional glass vessels in the foreground and side tables: 1 crystal ball at the bottom left, 1 tall red potion bottle at the bottom right, and 2 smaller laboratory bottles beside it. Add multiple open and closed grimoires across laps, tables, and the floor, with at least 8 visible books in total. The central focal character is a poised blonde girl seated in the largest armchair, legs crossed, hand near her face, framed as the leader. Render in highly detailed polished anime style, ultra-detailed fabrics, intricate gold trim, subtle facial shading, luminous eyes, cinematic composition, wide group shot, fantasy key art quality, moody gothic academia, magical sisterhood, sharp focus, ornate environment, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的暗黑奇幻动漫插画，描绘了 11 位优雅的年轻女性在深夜的宏伟哥特式图书馆中聚集，构图如同精英魔法学院的集会肖像。房间内堆满了高耸的木制书架、移动梯子、带有神秘金色符号的深红色天鹅绒横幅、雕花护墙板、烛光，最左侧有一盏温暖的台灯，配有红色软垫扶手椅和沙发、成堆的古籍、药水瓶、水晶球、黄铜仪器，以及一扇可以看到深紫色夜空的高大拱窗。整体色调为黑色、深红色、金色和紫色，采用戏剧性的低调照明，阴影浓郁，高光亮丽，营造出一种奢华而阴森的氛围。所有 11 位角色均身穿统一的神秘学院制服：带有金色刺绣和徽章细节的黑色修身夹克、白衬衫、红领带或丝带、多层腰带和链条、短裙或修身下装、黑色过膝袜以及内衬为深红色的黑色斗篷。安排 3 人坐在中间华丽的红色椅子和沙发上，3 人站在后排书架间，3 人在前排坐在地板上或靠近桌子，2 人分别斜靠在最左侧和最右侧边缘。角色的发色和发型各异，包括 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"}、银色、黑色、红色、蓝色、棕色和紫色；发型涵盖长卷发、双马尾、直长发、侧马尾和层次感碎发。赋予每位女性冷静、自信且略带危险的神情，仿佛她们是天才女巫或贵族学生。画面中需包含 6 个清晰可见的魔法效果或正在使用的道具：后方中心处悬浮在举起手上的 1 团红色火焰，右上中心附近站立少女手中持有的 1 个发光的紫色球体，左下方打开的书本上方 1 个旋转的紫色魔法阵，右中位置银发少女膝盖附近 1 团微弱的紫色奥术火焰，最右侧斜靠少女周围 1 圈深紫色烟雾光环，以及中央咖啡桌上 1 个发光的紫色水晶灯或炼金容器。此外，在前景和侧桌上增加 4 个额外的玻璃容器：左下角 1 个水晶球，右下角 1 个高大的红色药水瓶，以及旁边的 2 个小型实验瓶。在膝盖、桌子和地板上放置多个打开和合上的魔法书，总计至少 8 本。中心焦点角色是一位姿态从容的金色头发少女，她坐在最大的扶手椅上，双腿交叠，手靠近脸部，呈现出领袖的姿态。采用高度精细的抛光动漫风格渲染，展现超细腻的织物纹理、复杂的金色饰边、微妙的面部阴影、明亮的眼睛、电影级构图、宽幅群像镜头、奇幻主视觉图品质、忧郁的哥特学院风、魔法姐妹会、清晰对焦、华丽环境，无现代物品。

templates.title: Doomscrolling Editorial Poster

titleLocalized.zh: “Doomscrolling” 编辑风格海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A stark black-and-white editorial anti-tech poster on an off-white background, designed like a modern brutalist magazine cover about digital addiction. The composition is vertical and highly typographic, with one central surreal image and multiple blocks of small text. At the top center, huge bold condensed sans-serif text reads DOOM on one line and SCROLLING below it, with the word SCROLLING stretched across the page and partially motion-blurred or smeared horizontally. In the upper left corner, a tiny text block reads “SCROLL. SWIPE. NOTHING CHANGES.” with a short horizontal line above it. In the upper right corner, small text reads “24 / 7 / 365” above “THE FEED NEVER ENDS” with a horizontal divider line below. On the left side under the title, add a definition paragraph in small editorial text: “the act of spending an excessive amount of time scrolling through negative or distressing content online, often leading to feelings of anxiety, helplessness, and fatigue.” Beneath that, include 2 short horizontal divider lines, then a large statistic reading “67%” followed by smaller text: “OF PEOPLE AGED 18–24 SAY THEY SCROLL MORE THAN THEY INTEND TO. — PEW RESEARCH, 2023”. Below that, another statement reads “MORE SCROLLING. LESS LIVING.” with a divider line beneath. The center of the poster features a glossy black smartphone standing vertically at the bottom center, seen front-on, with the bottom speaker holes and charging port visible. Emerging from the phone screen is a long impossible staircase receding upward into a narrow tunnel made of repeated translucent vertical panels, creating a claustrophobic corridor. Within the tunnel, a giant grayscale human eye appears in the upper half, partially obscured by haze, vertical slicing, and ghosted repetitions, as if trapped inside the feed. The central image should feel eerie, dreamlike, oppressive, and cinematic, with soft fog, high contrast, photocopy grain, subtle motion smear, and layered transparency. Along the right side of the central image, add a narrow vertical numbered index with exactly 24 visible entries: 001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, 015, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021, 022, 024, 025, 026, and an ellipsis, plus a thin downward arrow underneath. In the right column, add a text block titled “DESIGNED TO KEEP YOU HOOKED.” followed by 4 short lines: “Infinite feeds. Unpredicted rewards. Endless comparison. It’s not a glitch— it’s the business model.” Below that place a simple eye/globe icon, then a black rectangular box containing the message: “AWARENESS IS THE FIRST STEP: PUT THE PHONE DOWN. LOOK UP. RECLAIM YOUR TIME.” On the lower left, place a massive cropped black word fragment reading END near the bottom edge, with another stacked statement beside it: “THE MORE YOU SCROLL, THE LESS YOU LIVE.” Add tiny vertical microtext near the left margin for editorial flavor. Across the bottom footer, place 4 icon/text groups: a globe icon, an eye icon, a small warning text block reading “WARNING: EXCESSIVE SCREEN TIME CAN IMPACT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, SLEEP, AND PRODUCTIVITY.”, an expand-corners icon, a barcode, and a final statement on the far right reading “STAY PRESENT. LIVE IN REAL LIFE.” Use minimalist Swiss-grid alignment, generous negative space, sharp black typography, subtle distressed print texture, and a high-fashion poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在灰白色背景上的醒目黑白编辑风格反科技海报，设计灵感源自关于数字成瘾的现代野兽派杂志封面。构图采用垂直布局，强调排版，包含一个核心超现实图像和多个小段落文本。顶部中央，巨大的粗体压缩无衬线字体显示为“DOOM”，下方为“SCROLLING”，其中“SCROLLING”一词横跨页面，带有部分动态模糊或水平拖影效果。左上角有一段微型文本：“SCROLL. SWIPE. NOTHING CHANGES.”，上方有一条短横线。右上角的小字写着“24 / 7 / 365”，下方是“THE FEED NEVER ENDS”，底部配有一条水平分割线。在标题下方的左侧，添加一段小字编辑文本定义：“指在网上花费大量时间浏览负面或令人痛苦的内容，通常会导致焦虑、无助和疲劳感。”下方加入 2 条短水平分割线，然后是一个巨大的统计数字“67%”，后接较小的文字：“OF PEOPLE AGED 18–24 SAY THEY SCROLL MORE THAN THEY INTEND TO. — PEW RESEARCH, 2023”。再下方是一句声明：“MORE SCROLLING. LESS LIVING.”，底部配有分割线。海报中央底部竖立着一部光亮的黑色智能手机，正面朝向观众，可见底部的扬声器孔和充电接口。从手机屏幕中延伸出一个长长的、不可能存在的楼梯，向上退缩进入一个由重复的半透明垂直面板构成的狭窄隧道，营造出一种幽闭恐惧的走廊感。在隧道内，上半部分出现了一只巨大的灰度人眼，被雾气、垂直切片和重影遮蔽，仿佛被困在信息流中。中心图像应具有诡异、梦幻、压抑和电影感，并带有柔和的雾气、高对比度、复印颗粒感、微妙的动态模糊和分层透明效果。在中心图像的右侧，添加一个狭窄的垂直编号索引，包含 24 个可见条目：001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 007, 008, 009, 010, 011, 012, 013, 014, 015, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021, 022, 024, 025, 026 以及一个省略号，下方配有一个细长的向下箭头。在右侧栏，添加一个标题为“DESIGNED TO KEEP YOU HOOKED.”的文本块，后接 4 行短句：“Infinite feeds. Unpredicted rewards. Endless comparison. It’s not a glitch— it’s the business model.”。下方放置一个简单的眼睛/地球图标，然后是一个黑色矩形框，内含信息：“AWARENESS IS THE FIRST STEP: PUT THE PHONE DOWN. LOOK UP. RECLAIM YOUR TIME.”。在左下角，放置一个巨大的被裁剪的黑色单词片段“END”，旁边是另一句堆叠的声明：“THE MORE YOU SCROLL, THE LESS YOU LIVE.”。在左侧边缘附近添加微小的垂直微型文本以增加编辑质感。在底部页脚处，放置 4 组图标/文本：一个地球图标、一个眼睛图标、一个小型警告文本块“WARNING: EXCESSIVE SCREEN TIME CAN IMPACT YOUR MENTAL HEALTH, SLEEP, AND PRODUCTIVITY.”、一个展开图标、一个条形码，以及最右侧的一句声明“STAY PRESENT. LIVE IN REAL LIFE.”。采用极简主义的瑞士网格对齐、充裕的负空间、锐利的黑色排版、微妙的做旧印刷纹理和高级时装海报美学。

templates.title: Anime Airline Student Discount Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风航空学生优惠海报

templates.prompt: A vibrant Japanese airline advertisement poster in glossy anime style, vertical composition, featuring a stylish young female idol-inspired traveler standing in the foreground at an airport apron with a pink-and-white passenger airplane behind her. The plane is branded {argument name="brand name" default="peach"} in large lowercase letters on the fuselage and tail. Bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds, airport terminal buildings in the distance, and scattered confetti-like geometric shapes in pink and yellow create an energetic promotional mood. The character has long split-color hair, black on one side and vivid pink on the other, with cat-ear-like hair accessories or headphones, side clips, and a single ahoge strand. Her face is partially obscured by a centered rectangular blur block. She wears large metallic headphones, a silver choker, a black mesh crop top layered over a black bralette, a short black-and-white asymmetrical skirt with two front buckles, a glossy oversized pink bomber jacket slipping off the shoulders, and a teal thigh strap. She poses with one hand reaching toward the viewer and the other holding a pink boarding pass or ticket card branded with the airline name. Add a second floating ticket on the right side reading “Everywhere!” in English. Use a bold commercial layout with exactly 8 distinct text areas: 1 large top-left logo reading {argument name="brand name" default="peach"}, 1 handwritten Japanese slogan across the upper left, 1 central promotional headline block in Japanese reading {argument name="main headline" default="学生割引"}, 1 blue circular badge reading {argument name="badge text" default="U25限定!"}, 1 large discount callout reading {argument name="discount text" default="20%OFF!"}, 3 rounded white icon boxes along the bottom each with small pink travel-related icons and Japanese captions, and 1 cursive English tagline at bottom left reading {argument name="tagline" default="Fly Peach. Love Life."}. Include a small search-bar style UI element at the bottom right, extra diagonal pink graphic borders at the top and bottom, and polished ad-design typography. High-saturation pink palette, youthful urban fashion, dynamic perspective, crisp cel-shaded rendering with soft airbrushed lighting, premium anime promotional poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的日式航空广告海报，采用光泽感动漫风格，竖构图。画面前景是一位时尚的年轻女性偶像风旅行者，站在机场停机坪上，身后是一架粉白相间的客机。机身和尾翼上印有大号小写字母 {argument name="brand name" default="peach"} 的品牌标识。明亮的蓝天配以蓬松的白云，远处可见机场航站楼，粉色和黄色的几何图形如纸屑般散落，营造出充满活力的促销氛围。角色留着长长的双色发，一侧为黑色，另一侧为鲜艳的粉色，戴着猫耳状发饰或耳机，配有侧边发夹和一根呆毛。她的脸部被中间的矩形模糊块部分遮挡。她佩戴着大型金属耳机、银色颈圈，身穿黑色网眼短款上衣，内搭黑色抹胸，下着黑白不对称短裙（带有两个前扣），肩上滑落着一件亮面超大款粉色飞行员夹克，腿部配有青色腿带。她摆出姿势，一只手伸向观众，另一只手拿着一张印有航空公司名称的粉色登机牌或票卡。在右侧添加第二张悬浮票据，上面用英文写着“Everywhere!”。采用醒目的商业布局，包含 8 个明确的文本区域：左上角 1 个印有 {argument name="brand name" default="peach"} 的大型 Logo，左上方 1 条手写日文标语，中央 1 个写有 {argument name="main headline" default="学生割引"} 的日文促销标题块，1 个写有 {argument name="badge text" default="U25限定!"} 的蓝色圆形徽章，1 个写有 {argument name="discount text" default="20%OFF!"} 的大型折扣提示，底部 3 个圆角白色图标框（每个框内配有小型粉色旅行相关图标和日文说明），以及左下角 1 条写有 {argument name="tagline" default="Fly Peach. Love Life."} 的英文草书标语。右下角包含一个小型搜索栏样式的 UI 元素，顶部和底部添加额外的对角粉色图形边框，并采用精致的广告设计排版。高饱和度粉色调，青春都市时尚感，动态视角，清晰的赛璐珞渲染配以柔和的喷枪光影，呈现出高级的动漫宣传海报美学。

A large white commercial passenger jet with the airline logo on the tail and the words JAPAN AIRLINES on the fuselage flies diagonally upward from left to right across the upper half of the image. In the foreground, place 1 anime high school girl standing slightly right of center on an airport observation deck with glass railings and distant terminal structures behind her. She has a short silver-blonde bob haircut with side-swept bangs, a youthful stylish look, and a confident relaxed pose. She wears a school uniform consisting of exactly 6 visible fashion pieces: a dark gray blazer with neon green piping, a white button-up shirt, a red striped necktie, a black pleated skirt with green trim, a black shoulder bag with a small red airline-tag style patch, and black wrist accessories. She holds exactly 2 travel documents in one hand, a passport booklet and a boarding pass or ticket booklet in matching red-and-white airline branding. Use crisp commercial illustration rendering, clean linework, soft cel shading, and glossy poster-design composition. Add Japanese advertising typography and branding laid out like a real campaign: top left airline logo and “JAPAN AIRLINES”; large white handwritten-style headline text in the upper left reading {argument name="main headline" default="飛び出そう、ミライへ。"}; smaller white subheadline below it reading “いましかできない旅がある。”; a bold red promotional block on the left-center with “JALで行こう!” above a large boxed “学生割引”, a smaller red strip “国内線がおトク!”, and oversized discount text “最大20% OFF!” with small disclaimer lines beneath. On the right side, include exactly 3 white circular callout badges stacked vertically with red line icons and Japanese copy: 1 suitcase icon with “気軽に旅に出て、新しい自分に出会おう。”, 1 camera icon with “思い出をたくさんつくろう。”, and 1 group-of-people icon with “仲間との時間を、一生の宝物に。” At the bottom, add a full-width deep red footer banner with large handwritten-style white text reading {argument name="footer slogan" default="学生の今こそ、世界はもっと広がる。"}, plus a small airplane doodle and cloud doodles on the right. Below or within the footer area, add small white text “詳しくはJALホームページへ” and a simple search bar graphic containing {argument name="search text" default="JAL 学生割引"}. High contrast red, white, and sky blue color palette, premium youth-marketing campaign aesthetic, clean modern Japanese poster layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精美的竖版动漫风格日本航空公司广告海报，用于 {argument name="airline name" default="JAPAN AIRLINES"}，营造出明亮且令人向往的旅行氛围。画面展现了湛蓝的天空，点缀着柔软的白色积云，右上角有强烈的阳光和镜头光晕。一架大型白色商用客机斜向从左下向右上飞行，机尾印有航空公司标志，机身上印有 JAPAN AIRLINES 字样。前景中，在机场观景台的玻璃栏杆前，站着一位动漫风格的女高中生，位置略偏右，背景可见远处的航站楼结构。她留着银金色短波波头，刘海侧分，造型青春时尚，姿态自信从容。她身穿校服，包含 6 件清晰可见的时尚单品：带有荧光绿滚边的深灰色西装外套、白色衬衫、红色条纹领带、带有绿色饰边的黑色百褶裙、带有红色小巧航空标签贴片的黑色单肩包，以及黑色腕饰。她的一只手拿着 2 份旅行证件，分别为一本护照和一张红白配色、与航空公司品牌一致的登机牌或票据册。采用清晰的商业插画渲染、干净的线条、柔和的赛璐珞阴影以及光泽感的海报设计构图。添加日式广告排版和品牌元素，布局如同真实的宣传活动：左上角放置航空公司标志和“JAPAN AIRLINES”；左上角有醒目的大号白色手写体标题，内容为 {argument name="main headline" default="飛び出そう、ミライへ。"}；下方配有较小的白色副标题“いましかできない旅がある。”；左侧中部有一个醒目的红色促销板块，上方写有“JALで行こう!”，下方是一个大的“学生割引”方框，以及一条较小的红色横条“国内線がおトク!”，并配有超大的折扣文字“最大20% OFF!”及下方的免责声明小字。右侧垂直排列 3 个白色圆形标注徽章，配有红色线条图标和日语文案：1 个行李箱图标配文“気軽に旅に出て、新しい自分に出会おう。”，1 个相机图标配文“思い出をたくさんつくろう。”，以及 1 个群体图标配文“仲間との時間を、一生の宝物に。”底部添加一个全宽的深红色页脚横幅，上面印有醒目的大号手写体白色文字 {argument name="footer slogan" default="学生の今こそ、世界はもっと広がる。"}，右侧配有小飞机和云朵涂鸦。在页脚区域内或下方，添加白色小字“詳しくはJALホームページへ”，以及一个包含 {argument name="search text" default="JAL 学生割引"} 的简单搜索栏图形。采用红、白、天蓝的高对比度配色方案，呈现高级的青年营销活动美学，布局简洁现代，充满日式海报风格。

templates.title: Anime JAL Student Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格 JAL 学生旅行海报

templates.prompt: A bright, polished Japanese airline promotional poster in anime illustration style, formatted as a full advertising key visual with a wide 4:3 composition. The scene shows an airport tarmac under a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds, sun flare, and a large Japan Airlines passenger aircraft parked behind the character, with the fuselage and tail logo clearly visible. In the foreground stands a cheerful high school girl traveler in a dynamic welcoming pose, one arm stretched toward the viewer as if inviting them to come along. She has long blonde twin-tail hair with soft waves and pink-dyed tips, windblown dramatically, and her face is simplified and unobstructed for a clean commercial illustration. She wears a black school blazer with gold trim, a white dress shirt, a red-and-black ribbon bow, a pleated black skirt with gold hem, thigh-high black socks, and carries a black shoulder bag with a cute round animal charm. Beside her is 1 silver rolling suitcase covered with multiple colorful travel stickers, including a prominent airline-themed sticker. The overall mood is youthful, aspirational, energetic, and travel-forward, blending school life and air travel. Include exactly 2 handwritten-style English phrases in the sky area: "Let's go!" near a doodled white airplane trail at upper right, and no other English handwritten phrase besides the brand text. Recreate the poster layout with exactly 1 airline brand block at top left reading "JAPAN AIRLINES" with a red crane logo, 1 large Japanese headline in brush-style lettering across the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="羽ばたけ、未来の私へ！"}, and 1 smaller Japanese subheadline beneath it reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="旅は、きみをもっと強く、もっと自由にする。"}. In the mid-left area, place a large white promotional panel with pink accents for a student discount campaign. This panel contains exactly 1 campaign title block with Japanese text reading {argument name="campaign name" default="JALの学生割引 スカイメイト"}, exactly 1 pink circular badge reading {argument name="discount text" default="最大12% OFF!"}, and exactly 3 bordered icon boxes aligned horizontally underneath. The 3 icon boxes should show: 1 graduation cap icon with Japanese text indicating students can use it, 1 suitcase icon with Japanese text indicating all domestic routes are eligible, and 1 calendar icon with Japanese text indicating same-day reservation changes are allowed. Add additional handwritten-style Japanese copy in smaller sizes around the lower half of the image for an emotional travel-ad feel, plus 1 pink call-to-action banner at the bottom left with a search-bar-like box containing Japanese reservation text. Place 1 circular red JAL logo at the bottom right corner. Use glossy anime poster rendering, crisp linework, vivid lighting, subtle lens glow, saturated sky blues, pink accent graphics, and premium commercial ad composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、精致的日式航空公司宣传海报，采用动漫插画风格，呈现为 4:3 宽画幅的完整广告主视觉图。场景设定在蓝天白云、阳光明媚的机场停机坪，背景是一架机身和尾翼标志清晰可见的日本航空（Japan Airlines）客机。前景中站着一位开朗的高中生旅行者，她摆出充满活力的欢迎姿势，一只手臂向观众伸出，仿佛在邀请大家一同出发。她留着长长的金色双马尾，发梢带有柔和的波浪卷和粉色挑染，在风中飘动，面部特征简洁清晰，符合商业插画的审美。她身穿带有金色镶边的黑色校服西装、白色衬衫、红黑相间的领结，搭配金色裙边的百褶裙和黑色过膝袜，肩上背着一个挂有可爱圆形动物挂件的黑色单肩包。她身旁有一个银色的行李箱，上面贴满了色彩缤纷的旅行贴纸，其中包含一张醒目的航空公司主题贴纸。整体氛围青春、励志、充满活力且富有旅行感，将校园生活与航空旅行完美融合。在天空区域包含 2 处手写风格的英文短语：右上角飞机涂鸦轨迹附近写着“Let's go!”，除品牌文字外，不包含其他英文手写短语。海报布局需包含：左上角 1 个带有红色鹤丸标志的“JAPAN AIRLINES”品牌板块；左上方 1 处醒目的毛笔字风格日文大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="羽ばたけ、未来の私へ！"}；其下方 1 处较小的日文副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="旅は、きみをもっと強く、もっと自由にする。"}。在画面中左侧，放置一个带有粉色装饰的大型白色学生折扣活动宣传面板。该面板包含 1 个日文活动标题 {argument name="campaign name" default="JALの学生割引 スカイメイト"}，1 个写有 {argument name="discount text" default="最大12% OFF!"} 的粉色圆形徽章，以及下方水平排列的 3 个带边框图标框。这 3 个图标框应分别展示：1 个学士帽图标（标注学生可用）、1 个行李箱图标（标注所有国内航线适用）以及 1 个日历图标（标注允许当日预订变更）。在图像下半部分周围添加额外的较小尺寸手写风格日文文案，以营造感性的旅行广告氛围；左下角放置 1 个粉色行动号召（CTA）横幅，内含一个类似搜索框的日文预订文本。右下角放置 1 个红色的圆形 JAL 标志。采用光泽感动漫海报渲染、清晰的线条、生动的光影、细腻的镜头光晕、饱和的天空蓝、粉色点缀图形以及高级的商业广告构图。

templates.title: Futuristic Boardroom Analytics Meeting

templates.prompt: A wide cinematic corporate boardroom scene in a bright modern glass-walled office with floor-to-ceiling windows and a panoramic city skyline faintly visible outside. Around {argument name="number of attendees" default="22"} business professionals of mixed genders and ethnicities sit in a large U-shaped arrangement of light wood conference tables, each person dressed in formal business attire and many working on open laptops. At the front of the room, a huge wall-mounted digital dashboard dominates the composition, showing a futuristic financial analytics interface in dark blue and cyan with exactly 12 visible data panels: 1 large top-left panel with the headline text {argument name="dashboard headline" default="SELECTING THE TRACKING TOOL"} and line and bar charts, 1 small top-center panel with abstract circular data textures, 1 top-center-right panel with a large numeric metric reading 92.231 and chart bars, 1 top-right panel with line graphs and gear-like interface icons, 1 mid-left strip of circular gauges and technical controls, 1 center-left tall panel with vertical data bars and circular overlays, 1 center panel with three round instrument-style readouts, 1 center-right panel with compact technical diagrams and tiny UI elements, 1 mid-right horizontal panel with circular dials and a central numeric indicator, 1 lower-center panel with glowing ring charts and waveform-style graphics, 1 lower-right wide panel with dense tabular dashboard data, and 1 small bottom-center auxiliary panel. The room is viewed from a centered rear perspective, emphasizing symmetry and the semicircle of seated attendees facing the screen, with one standing presenter silhouetted near the display. Warm sunlight enters from the left, creating soft lens flare and long shadows across the wooden floor, while the overall image style is a polished high-end editorial illustration leaning toward photorealistic corporate concept art, in a cool blue and warm amber color palette, ultra-detailed, clean, futuristic, professional, and ambitious.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅宽银幕企业董事会场景，位于明亮的现代玻璃幕墙办公室中，配有落地窗，窗外隐约可见城市全景。约 {argument name="number of attendees" default="22"} 名不同性别和族裔的商务专业人士坐在呈 U 型排列的浅色木质会议桌旁，每人都穿着正式商务装，许多人正在使用打开的笔记本电脑。在房间前方，一面巨大的壁挂式数字看板占据了构图中心，展示着深蓝色和青色的未来感金融分析界面，共有 12 个清晰可见的数据面板：1 个左上角的大面板，带有标题文本 {argument name="dashboard headline" default="SELECTING THE TRACKING TOOL"} 以及折线图和柱状图；1 个顶部中央的小面板，带有抽象的圆形数据纹理；1 个右上方的面板，带有 92.231 的大数字指标和柱状图；1 个右上角面板，带有折线图和齿轮状界面图标；1 个中左侧条形面板，带有圆形仪表和技术控件；1 个中左侧高面板，带有垂直数据条和圆形叠加层；1 个中央面板，带有三个圆形仪表式读数；1 个中右侧面板，带有紧凑的技术图表和微小的 UI 元素；1 个中右侧水平面板，带有圆形刻度盘和中央数字指示器；1 个下中央面板，带有发光的环形图和波形图；1 个右下角宽面板，带有密集的数据表格；以及 1 个底部中央的小型辅助面板。从房间后方居中视角拍摄，强调对称性和面向屏幕的半圆形就座人员，一名演讲者在显示屏附近呈现剪影。温暖的阳光从左侧射入，在木地板上形成柔和的镜头光晕和长长的阴影。整体图像风格为精致的高端编辑插画，偏向写实的企业概念艺术，采用冷蓝色和暖琥珀色的色调，超精细、整洁、具有未来感、专业且充满雄心。

The group includes men and women of varied ethnicities, all focused toward a huge wall-mounted digital presentation screen on a warm wood-paneled wall. Include sleek black leather office chairs with chrome frames, a polished wood floor, recessed linear ceiling lights, and a tall green potted plant near the display wall. Natural daylight fills the room, balanced with clean architectural interior lighting. Emphasize realism, professional atmosphere, sharp detail, subtle reflections, believable skin tones, and premium corporate interior design. Shot in a cinematic architectural photography style, ultra-detailed, high resolution, wide composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张广角照片级真实的企业董事会场景，展示了一场高层商务会议，视角位于房间后角。约 {argument name="number of attendees" default="18"} 位身着商务正装的专业人士围坐在大型 U 型浅色木质会议桌旁，大多数人面前放着打开的笔记本电脑、笔记本、咖啡杯、水杯和智能手机。团队成员包括不同族裔的男女，他们都专注于墙上巨大的数字演示屏幕，屏幕安装在温暖的木镶板墙面上。屏幕显示着一个深蓝色的分析仪表盘，包含多个图表和数据面板，如柱状图、折线图、KPI 平铺图、世界地图、百分比圆环和趋势图，暗示着财务、运营或高管汇报场景。一位演讲者坐在中右侧面向屏幕，其余团队成员在正式的战略会议中专注地观看。这间办公室是现代化的行政会议室，左侧整面墙均为落地窗，展现出白昼下朦胧的城市高层建筑天际线。配备带有铬合金框架的时尚黑色真皮办公椅、抛光木地板、嵌入式线性天花板灯，以及展示墙旁的一盆高大绿植。自然光充满整个房间，并与整洁的建筑室内照明相平衡。强调真实感、专业氛围、清晰细节、微妙的反射、可信的肤色以及高端的企业室内设计。采用电影级建筑摄影风格拍摄，超精细，高分辨率，广角构图。

templates.title: Futuristic AI Sports Poster

templates.prompt: A cinematic vertical poster of {argument name="subject name" default="Sam Altman"} styled like a futuristic football superstar campaign image, waist-up portrait, centered, arms crossed, wearing a plain dark navy or black crewneck sweater, confident and calm posture, looking slightly off-camera. Place him inside a dramatic high-tech stadium or arena at night with bright floodlights glowing from the upper left, dark steel architecture overhead, and a cool blue sci-fi atmosphere. Add floating particles and light debris in the air for energy and motion. Surround the subject with futuristic AI interface graphics: 1 glowing wireframe cube icon on the left side, 1 luminous digital brain or neural-network globe on the right side, and multiple transparent holographic dashboard screens with charts and data panels behind him. Use a deep blue, black, and white color palette with sharp contrast, glossy highlights, subtle lens glow, and premium blockbuster poster lighting. Make the composition sleek, aspirational, and tech-forward, like a sports ad merged with artificial intelligence branding. At the bottom, add the title text {argument name="main title" default="THE FUTURE"} in very large metallic white uppercase letters, with the word "THE" smaller above the main word, and add the tagline {argument name="tagline" default="Built with Intelligence"} below in smaller spaced-out sans-serif text. Include faint hexagonal HUD linework near the lower corners and a glowing horizontal light streak cutting through the title area. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, poster design, polished commercial key art, 9:16 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感竖版海报，主角为 {argument name="subject name" default="Sam Altman"}，风格呈现为未来感足球巨星宣传照，半身肖像，居中，双臂交叉，身穿深海军蓝或黑色纯色圆领毛衣，姿态自信从容，视线略微偏离镜头。将他置于夜晚极具戏剧性的高科技体育场或竞技场中，左上方有明亮的泛光灯照射，头顶为深色钢结构建筑，营造出冷色调的科幻氛围。空中加入漂浮的粒子和微小碎片，以增强能量感和动感。在主角周围环绕未来感 AI 界面图形：左侧放置 1 个发光的线框立方体图标，右侧放置 1 个发光的数字大脑或神经网络球体，身后悬浮多个带有图表和数据面板的透明全息仪表盘。采用深蓝、黑、白配色方案，对比强烈，具有光泽感的高光、微妙的镜头光晕以及高级大片海报的布光效果。构图时尚、富有抱负且具有前瞻性，如同体育广告与人工智能品牌的融合。在底部，添加标题文本 {argument name="main title" default="THE FUTURE"}，使用非常大的金属质感白色大写字母，其中“THE”字样较小，位于主标题上方；并在下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Built with Intelligence"}，使用较小的、字间距拉开的无衬线字体。在下角附近加入淡淡的六边形 HUD 线条，并有一道发光的水平光束穿过标题区域。超精细，照片级真实感，海报设计，精致的商业主视觉图，9:16 纵横比。

templates.title: Epic French Dystopian Book Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级法文反乌托邦书籍封面

templates.prompt: A cinematic French dystopian science-fantasy book cover in vertical poster format, dark and epic, with a cold desaturated palette of charcoal blue, steel gray, ash white, and muted silver. In the foreground, show 1 solitary young traveler seen from behind, standing on a snow-dusted rocky cliff at lower left, small against the environment, wearing a weathered winter jacket, rugged pants, boots, and a large worn backpack, with messy light brown hair visible, posture still and contemplative as he looks out over a vast ruined city. In the middle distance, depict 1 immense circular or sprawling fortified city in a frozen valley, dense with countless dark gothic-industrial buildings and spires, surrounded by icy water channels and connected by several narrow bridges. Rising from the exact center of the city, place 1 colossal needle-like black tower that dominates the skyline, dramatically taller than everything else. Surround the city with jagged snow-covered mountain ranges on both sides and in the far distance. Above, create a stormy sky filled with heavy textured clouds, faint snowfall or drifting ice particles, and a pale backlit glow breaking through behind the central tower, giving a mythic apocalyptic atmosphere. Composition should emphasize scale, isolation, and awe, with the traveler occupying only a small portion of the image and the city and tower centered. Add distressed serif typography integrated as a cover design: at the very top in small uppercase French text, "DANS L’UNIVERS DE APRÈS L’EFFONDREMENT"; below it, a huge title in cracked weathered off-white serif capitals, "{argument name="title text" default="ELON"}", spanning nearly the full width; beneath the title place 1 small compass-star ornament centered with thin horizontal lines. At the bottom center, add the author name in refined serif capitals, "{argument name="author name" default="MARTINOLLI"}". Make the overall image look like premium dark fantasy / post-apocalyptic cover art, ultra-detailed, atmospheric perspective, realistic textures, dramatic lighting, moody, monumental, polished publishing design.

At the top center, add the Spanish tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"} in elegant serif capitals. On the upper left, create an awards column in gold typography with laurel wreaths and exactly 4 award blocks: one text block reading "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS" with 5 gold stars beneath it, then three laurel award sections reading "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA / FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE ANIMACIÓN / 2024", "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO / FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE CINE / 2024", and "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL / ACADEMIA DE CINE ANIMADO / 2024". At the bottom, add the release line {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"} in large gold serif capitals, plus tiny production logos and credits along the footer, including a small studio emblem on the left. Rich blue, violet, and warm sunset orange palette, glossy poster lighting, romantic adventure mood, balanced composition, highly polished theatrical key art, vertical one-sheet film poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级动漫风格海报，用于虚构的奇幻剧情片，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="EL VIAJE DE LA LUNA DE PLATA"}，采用高级院线海报的垂直构图。画面中央是一位年轻动漫女性的半身肖像，她正面向前，神情平静而内敛。她留着短款银色波波头，发丝层次柔和且带有侧刘海，皮肤白皙，佩戴黑色颈圈和几何形状耳环，身穿宽松的海军蓝运动外套，袖口饰有双条金线，内搭白色吊带背心，单肩背着深色背包。她的表情细腻自然，去除了夸张的细节，呈现出更具写实感的绘画质感。在她身后，将多处旅行目的地风景融合成一幅无缝的魔法构图：左侧是黄昏时分灯火通明的火车站台，列车进站，远处是闪烁的城市天际线；下方是远山与蜿蜒的河谷；右侧是海岸落日，夕阳低垂于海面之上，伴有悬崖、新月和天空中飞翔的 2 只海鸟；右下角是一条蜿蜒的道路，穿过灯火通明的山丘，通向一座闪烁着灯光的城镇。在右侧添加一个木制路标，上面有 3 个指示牌，分别写着 "NUEVOS CAMINOS"、"VIEJOS RECUERDOS" 和 "SIN LÍMITES"。在顶部中央，添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"}，使用优雅的衬线大写字体。在左上方，放置 4 个带有月桂花环的金色奖项区域：1 行五星标志，文字为 "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS"，1 个奖项写着 "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA" 及下方较小的电影节文字，1 个奖项写着 "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO" 及下方较小的电影节文字，以及 1 个奖项写着 "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL" 及下方较小的学院奖文字。在底部中央，放置巨大的发光衬线电影标题，采用华丽的夜光排版，叠加在角色的躯干上。在标题下方，添加简短的引语 {argument name="quote" default="A veces, para encontrarte... tienes que perderte en el mundo."}。在最底部，包含一行制片厂演职员表和上映信息 {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"}（使用大号衬线大写字体），并在底部边缘添加微小的制作公司 Logo。使用浓郁的暮色蓝、金色夕阳余晖、柔和的洋红色云彩、大气雾气、反射高光、细腻的电影级布光，打造出一种情感丰富、充满冒险感且自然而不杂乱的精致插画海报风格。

templates.title: Tradition and Modernity Toothpaste Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 传统与现代牙膏广告

templates.prompt: Luxury advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Colgate Sensation White"}, split vertically into two mirrored halves by a narrow ornate mirror with a bright blue glow at the center. On the left side, an elderly African woman in three-quarter profile stands with arms folded, wearing a richly patterned indigo-and-gold traditional wax-print dress, a matching wrapped headscarf, layered gold bead necklaces, drop earrings, stacked bracelets, and holding 1 traditional chewing stick upright in one hand. On the right side, a younger African woman in matching indigo-and-gold dress and gold jewelry mirrors the pose and holds 1 modern white-and-blue toothbrush upright in one hand. Both figures are elegant, dignified, and photographed from the waist up against a warm textured brown studio backdrop with cinematic golden lighting, high contrast, polished skin tones, and premium beauty-ad aesthetics. Add 1 red circular Colgate logo in the top left corner. Overlay large refined serif typography in cream across the middle-lower area: left text {argument name="left slogan" default="Depuis toujours."} and right text {argument name="right slogan" default="Pour toujours."}, with a glowing blue tooth icon centered between the two phrases on the mirror divide. Add a smaller centered serif tagline near the bottom in cream: {argument name="tagline text" default="Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science"}. Place 1 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste box in the bottom right corner, angled slightly toward camera, glossy and realistic. The overall composition should communicate the fusion of ancestral tradition and modern dental science, premium African fashion portraiture, symmetrical balance, editorial campaign design, and a sophisticated international cosmetics advertisement.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="Colgate Sensation White"} 设计的奢侈品广告海报，画面被中间一个带有明亮蓝光的精致窄镜垂直分为左右两半。左侧，一位非洲老妇人侧身四分之三面朝镜头，双臂交叉，身穿图案华丽的靛蓝配金色传统蜡染印花裙，佩戴配套的头巾、多层金珠项链、垂坠耳环和叠戴手镯，手中垂直握着 1 根传统咀嚼棒。右侧，一位身穿同款靛蓝配金色裙装并佩戴金饰的年轻非洲女性，以同样的姿势镜像站立，手中垂直握着 1 支现代蓝白配色牙刷。两位人物均优雅端庄，半身像拍摄，背景为温暖的棕色纹理影棚背景，配以电影质感的金色灯光、高对比度、细腻的肤色处理及高端美妆广告美学。在左上角添加 1 个红色圆形 Colgate 标志。在画面中下部叠加大型精致的奶油色衬线字体：左侧文字为 {argument name="left slogan" default="Depuis toujours."}，右侧文字为 {argument name="right slogan" default="Pour toujours."}，镜面分割线中间放置一个发光的蓝色牙齿图标。在底部中央添加一行较小的奶油色衬线标语：{argument name="tagline text" default="Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science"}。在右下角放置 1 盒 Colgate Sensation White 牙膏，略微朝向镜头，质感光亮且真实。整体构图旨在传达祖传传统与现代牙科科学的融合，展现高端非洲时尚人像、对称平衡感、编辑级广告设计以及国际化的高级化妆品广告风格。

templates.title: Censored Anime Girl Selfie Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女自拍肖像（已打码）

templates.prompt: A soft, muted anime-style illustration of a young woman seated indoors at a table, shown from a slightly elevated close-up angle as if taken in a casual selfie. Her face is fully obscured by a centered square censor block in a warm taupe tone. She has long, slightly tousled {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair with delicate strands falling over her shoulders and chest, natural shine, and a gentle layered cut. She wears an oversized {argument name="top color" default="off-white"} sweatshirt over a visible gray inner collar, plus a thin silver necklace with a small drop pendant. Her pose is relaxed and intimate, with one arm extending toward the viewer, shoulders slightly angled, and her body turned diagonally across the frame. The background is minimal and calm: a beige wall, a dark bench or chair back, and the corner of a wooden tabletop visible at the lower right. Include a tan skirt or folded beige fabric near her lap at the bottom right. Use subdued earth tones, soft shading, painterly linework, a cozy everyday mood, and a clean contemporary Japanese illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、低饱和度的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性坐在室内桌前，采用略微俯视的特写视角，如同随意的自拍。她的面部被一个居中的方形遮挡块完全掩盖，遮挡块呈温暖的灰褐色。她留着长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"}，头发略显蓬松，细碎的发丝垂落在肩头和胸前，带有自然光泽，呈现出柔和的层次感。她穿着一件超大款 {argument name="top color" default="米白色"} 卫衣，内搭可见灰色衣领，并佩戴一条带有小吊坠的细银项链。姿态放松而亲密，一只手臂向镜头方向伸出，双肩微斜，身体在画面中呈对角线转向。背景简洁宁静：一面米色墙壁、一张深色长凳或椅背，右下角可见木质桌面的一角。在右下角膝盖附近加入一条棕褐色裙子或折叠的米色布料。采用柔和的大地色调、细腻的阴影、绘画感的线条，营造出舒适的日常氛围，并呈现出干净的现代日本插画美学。

templates.title: Tradition and Science Colgate Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Colgate 传统与科学广告

templates.prompt: Create a polished square advertising image for Colgate Sensation White, split vertically into two equal halves with a glowing divider line in the center, showing a side-by-side contrast between tradition and modern science. On the left half, place an elderly African woman seated behind a pale marble tabletop in a warm, earthy interior with carved wooden wall panels and a clay pot in the background. She wears a richly patterned traditional rust-orange and gold wrap dress with layered bead necklaces and bracelets, and has short gray natural hair. She holds a natural chewing stick near her mouth in a calm, dignified pose. Curve the French headline text above her head in large warm golden-yellow letters: "Depuis toujours." On the right half, place a young African child seated behind the same tabletop in a sleek modern blue interior with soft glowing lights and vertical gold accents. The child wears a vivid traditional-modern outfit: a copper-brown tunic with bright blue patterned front panel and gold trim, with neat braided hair, and holds a Colgate toothbrush near the mouth. Curve the French headline text above the child in large bright blue letters: "Pour toujours." At the bottom center, spanning both halves and placed prominently on the marble table, show exactly 2 Colgate Sensation White toothpaste boxes stacked slightly offset, with one matching toothbrush resting on top. The packaging must be highly legible and realistic, featuring the red Colgate logo and blue-white Sensation White branding. Add a bold white French tagline centered along the bottom edge: "Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science". Use cinematic commercial lighting, premium product-photography realism, rich skin tones, balanced symmetry, and a visual story of heritage meeting innovation.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 Colgate Sensation White 创建一张精致的正方形广告图像。画面垂直平分为左右两半，中间有一条发光的分割线，展现传统与现代科学的对比。左侧画面中，一位非洲老妇人坐在浅色大理石桌面后，背景是温暖的土色调室内空间，配有雕花木墙板和一个陶罐。她身穿图案丰富的传统铁锈橙色配金色裹身裙，佩戴多层珠串项链和手镯，留着短灰发。她姿态从容庄重，手中拿着一根天然咀嚼棒靠近嘴边。在她头顶上方，用醒目的暖金黄色大号字体呈弧形排列法文标题：“Depuis toujours.” 右侧画面中，一位非洲儿童坐在同一张桌面后，背景是时尚的现代蓝色室内空间，配有柔和的灯光和垂直的金色装饰。孩子身穿鲜艳的传统与现代结合的服饰：铜棕色束腰外衣，正面带有亮蓝色图案和金色镶边，梳着整齐的辫子，手中拿着一支 Colgate 牙刷靠近嘴边。在孩子头顶上方，用醒目的亮蓝色大号字体呈弧形排列法文标题：“Pour toujours.” 在底部中央，横跨左右两半并显眼地放置在大理石桌面上，展示 2 盒略微错位堆叠的 Colgate Sensation White 牙膏，上面放着一支配套的牙刷。包装必须清晰且逼真，突出红色的 Colgate 标志和蓝白相间的 Sensation White 品牌标识。在底部边缘居中添加一句醒目的白色法文标语：“Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science”。采用电影级的商业照明，呈现高端产品摄影的真实感，展现丰富的肤色、平衡的对称美，以及传承与创新碰撞的视觉故事。

templates.title: Editorial Woman in Wildflower Hills

titleLocalized.zh: 野花山丘上的时尚大片

templates.prompt: A soft, editorial-style outdoor fashion photograph of a woman standing in a wildflower meadow in the mountains during daylight, shown from behind with her body turned slightly three-quarters to the side and her head angled back toward the camera. She has shoulder-length to mid-back tousled {argument name="hair color" default="dark blonde"} hair, windblown and slightly messy. Her face is fully obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in a warm beige-brown tone. She wears a delicate, sheer white lace outfit consisting of 2 visible pieces: a long-sleeved semi-transparent floral lace top with ruffled cuffs and high-waisted white lace bottoms. The pose is relaxed and sensual, one arm hanging down and the other resting near her hip. Surround her with dense natural grasses and blooming wildflowers, including visible white daisies and small yellow flowers in the foreground and midground. Place her in front of rolling green and golden hills with dramatic chalky white cliff faces and erosion lines across the background. Use a wide open landscape, partly cloudy blue sky, warm natural sunlight, earthy tones, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition, realistic photography, high detail, soft contrast, and a dreamy bohemian countryside mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和的户外时尚风格摄影作品，展现了一位女性在白天的山间野花草甸中伫立，画面呈现其背影，身体微微侧转四分之三，头部向镜头方向回眸。她留着齐肩至中背部的凌乱 {argument name="hair color" default="深金色"} 秀发，发丝随风飘动，略显蓬松。她的面部被一个暖米棕色的平整矩形模糊块完全遮挡。她身着精致的白色透明蕾丝套装，由两件可见单品组成：一件长袖半透明碎花蕾丝上衣（带有荷叶边袖口）和一件高腰白色蕾丝下装。姿态放松而感性，一只手臂自然下垂，另一只手轻搭在髋部。周围环绕着茂密的天然草丛和盛开的野花，前景和中景可见白色雏菊和黄色小花。背景是连绵起伏的绿色与金色山丘，以及带有戏剧性白垩质感悬崖面和侵蚀纹理的山体。采用广阔的景观视野、局部多云的蓝天、温暖的自然光、大地色调、浅景深、电影级构图、写实摄影风格、高细节、柔和对比度，营造出梦幻的波西米亚乡村氛围。

templates.title: Japanese Roman Typeface Specimen Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式罗马字体样本海报

templates.prompt:
Create a refined vintage-modern type specimen poster for a fictional typeface named {argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}, designed as an elegant fusion of Roman and Japanese typography. Use a tall portrait layout on warm ivory textured paper with thin gray divider lines, black letterforms, and muted vermilion accent text and seals. Center the composition around a large serif Latin wordmark "{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}" above 2 oversized Japanese kanji, "華世", set in a matching high-contrast classical style. Above the title, place the small heading "INTRODUCING" with a tiny ornamental diamond. To the right of the title area, add a vertical Japanese tagline reading "古典の美、未来の書体。". Under the main kanji, add the subtitle "A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE" and below it a Japanese line in vermilion: "ローマの精神、日本の美。". On the far left, create a narrow sidebar with the stacked English text "A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN", a small circular crest, the Japanese text "製作 — MMXXIV", and "CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN".

Build the lower two-thirds as a meticulous type specimen sheet with exact labeled sections. In a left column, include 2 sections: "WEIGHTS" with 5 items — Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold — and "POINT SIZES" with 9 items — 8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt. In the main area, include a section titled "ROMAN CHARACTERS" showing 4 specimen lines: uppercase alphabet A through Z, lowercase alphabet a through z, numerals 0 through 9, and a punctuation/symbol line with slashes, commas, semicolons, exclamation mark, question marks, apostrophes, quotation marks, em dash, parentheses, brackets, braces, ampersand, at sign, dollar sign, asterisk, dagger, and double dagger. Below that, include a section titled "JAPANESE CHARACTERS" with 4 lines: 19 kanji "日 月 山 川 花 鳥 風 林 火 水 土 金 木 道 心 時 空 光 夢 永", 23 hiragana "あ い う え お か き く け こ さ し す せ そ た ち つ て と な に ぬ ね の", 21 katakana "ア イ ウ エ オ カ キ ク ケ コ サ シ ス セ ソ ン タ チ ツ テ ト ナ ニ ヌ ネ ノ", and a symbols line including Japanese punctuation, corner brackets, wave dash, middle dot, parentheses, angle brackets, double angle brackets, black lenticular brackets, postal mark, reference marks, and iteration mark.

Along the next row, add 4 compact specimen panels: "LIGATURES" with 10 items — Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU, and "st ct fi fl ft fb"; "STYLISTIC ALTERNATES" with 12 items — A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t — arranged as a neat sampling grid; "SPACING STUDY" showing the word "KASEI" with wide tracking above the kanji string "華世永美"; and "NUMERAL STYLES" with 4 lines — lining figures 0123456789, oldstyle figures 0123456789, and small caps combinations "H 0123" and "H 0123". Add tiny red Japanese captions beneath some of these sample boxes.

At the bottom, create 3 feature panels. Left panel titled "WORDS" with 3 entries: "HARMONIA" with the red Japanese and English gloss "調和  HARMONY", "VERITAS" with "真実  TRUTH", and "FORTITUDO" with "勇気  COURAGE". Center panel with a large Japanese quote "時を越え、美は残る。" above the English statement "BEAUTY ENDURES\nBEYOND TIME." and a small signature line "— KASEI" in red. Right panel titled "DETAILS" with a large kanji "永" over faint construction circles and guide lines, plus 4 right-aligned Japanese annotation callouts connected by fine dotted leader lines.

Finish with a footer containing 4 blocks: a small crest and "KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY" with "WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP"; a centered language support note "SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES" and "LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS"; a right-side statement "DESIGNED WITH RESPECT\nCRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE"; and a square vermilion seal bearing "華世". Overall style should feel like a premium Japanese foundry specimen sheet, balancing editorial Swiss-grid precision, classical book typography, subtle Japanese branding, generous margins, restrained luxury, and museum-poster elegance.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张精致的复古现代风格字体样本海报，展示一款名为 {argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"} 的虚构字体，旨在实现罗马字体与日式排版的优雅融合。采用竖向构图，使用暖象牙色纹理纸张，配以细灰色分割线、黑色字形以及柔和的朱红色强调文本和印章。构图中心为一个巨大的衬线拉丁文词标 “{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}”，其下方为两个超大的日文汉字 “华世”，采用与之匹配的高对比度古典风格。在标题上方，放置小型标题 “INTRODUCING” 并配以一个微小的装饰性菱形。在标题区域右侧，添加一行垂直的日文标语：“古典の美、未来の书体。”（古典之美，未来之字体）。在主汉字下方，添加副标题 “A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE”，并在其下方添加一行朱红色的日文：“罗马の精神、日本の美。”（罗马的精神，日本的美）。在最左侧，创建一个狭窄的侧边栏，包含堆叠的英文文本 “A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN”、一个小圆形徽章、日文文本 “制作 — MMXXIV” 以及 “CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN”。

将下部三分之二区域构建为一份严谨的字体样本表，并设有明确的标注区域。在左侧栏中，包含 2 个部分：“WEIGHTS”（字重）包含 5 个项目 — Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold；以及 “POINT SIZES”（字号）包含 9 个项目 — 8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt。在主区域中，包含一个标题为 “ROMAN CHARACTERS”（罗马字符）的部分，展示 4 行样本：大写字母 A 到 Z、小写字母 a 到 z、数字 0 到 9，以及一行标点/符号，包括斜杠、逗号、分号、感叹号、问号、撇号、引号、长破折号、圆括号、方括号、花括号、和号、at 符号、美元符号、星号、剑号和双剑号。在其下方，包含一个标题为 “JAPANESE CHARACTERS”（日文字符）的部分，包含 4 行：19 个汉字 “日 月 山 川 花 鸟 风 林 火 水 土 金 木 道 心 时 空 光 梦 永”，23 个平假名 “あ い う え お か き く け こ さ し す せ そ た ち つ て と な に ぬ ね の”，21 个片假名 “ア イ ウ エ オ カ キ ク ケ コ サ シ ス セ ソ ン タ チ ツ テ ト ナ ニ ヌ ネ ノ”，以及一行包含日文标点、角括号、波浪号、间隔号、圆括号、尖括号、双尖括号、黑隅付括号、邮政符号、参考符号和叠字符号的符号行。

在下一行，添加 4 个紧凑的样本面板：“LIGATURES”（连字）包含 10 个项目 — Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU 以及 “st ct fi fl ft fb”；“STYLISTIC ALTERNATES”（风格替换字）包含 12 个项目 — A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t — 排列成整齐的采样网格；“SPACING STUDY”（字距研究）展示单词 “KASEI” 并配以宽字间距，位于汉字 “华世永美” 上方；以及 “NUMERAL STYLES”（数字样式）包含 4 行 — 等高数字 0123456789、老式数字 0123456789 以及小型大写字母组合 “H 0123” 和 “H 0123”。在部分样本框下方添加微小的红色日文说明。

在底部，创建 3 个功能面板。左侧面板标题为 “WORDS”（词汇），包含 3 个条目：“HARMONIA” 附带红色日文和英文注释 “调和 HARMONY”、“VERITAS” 附带 “真実 TRUTH” 以及 “FORTITUDO” 附带 “勇気 COURAGE”。中心面板包含一句大型日文引言 “时を越え、美は残る。”（超越时光，美永存），上方为英文陈述 “BEAUTY ENDURES\nBEYOND TIME.” 以及一行红色的小型签名 “— KASEI”。右侧面板标题为 “DETAILS”（细节），展示一个大型汉字 “永”，背景为淡淡的构造圆和辅助线，外加 4 个通过细虚线连接的右对齐日文注释说明。

最后，在页脚包含 4 个区块：一个小徽章和 “KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY” 以及 “WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP”；一个居中的语言支持说明 “SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES” 和 “LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS”；右侧陈述 “DESIGNED WITH RESPECT\nCRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE”；以及一个印有 “华世” 的方形朱红印章。整体风格应呈现出高端日式字体铸造厂样本表的质感，平衡编辑风格的瑞士网格精度、古典书籍排版、微妙的日式品牌感、宽裕的页边距、克制的奢华感以及博物馆海报般的优雅。

templates.title: Futuristic STEM Classroom with Holograms

titleLocalized.zh: 充满全息影像的未来感 STEM 教室

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A bright futuristic classroom or science museum learning lab filled with school-age children interacting with large mixed-reality holograms, cinematic ultra-detailed photorealism. The scene is a wide-angle interior during warm late-afternoon sunlight, with floor-to-ceiling glass windows, modern tables, bookshelves, digital displays, and a clean high-tech educational atmosphere. About 9 children and 1 adult teacher are spread across the room, actively exploring science exhibits with gestures and touch interactions. In the center, a glowing semi-transparent holographic human heart floats at chest height while 3 children gather around it, reaching toward it in curiosity. Suspended overhead is a large holographic solar system mobile with exactly 9 planets orbiting a bright sun, with luminous orbit trails and a magical scientific visualization style. On the left side, one child interacts with a tall vertical holographic DNA double helix. On the front-left table, there is a circular tabletop hologram of a miniature mountain-and-river ecosystem containing exactly 4 visible animals: an elephant, a deer, a llama or alpaca, and a bear. On the back-left table, there is a circular holographic architectural city model featuring a grand classical domed building and surrounding structures. On the right-front table, there is a large ball-and-stick molecular model made of glowing spheres and rods. In the mid-right and upper-right space, include additional floating science holograms: exactly 2 geometric polyhedra, exactly 2 molecule diagrams, exactly 2 spherical energy or data globes, and 1 hourglass-like abstract hologram. The children should be ethnically diverse, dressed casually, engaged, amazed, collaborative, and looking at different holographic subjects. Use soft volumetric sunlight, realistic reflections on glass and tabletops, subtle blue and gold glow from the holograms, shallow atmospheric haze, and a premium inspirational STEM-education advertisement aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一间明亮且充满未来感的教室或科学博物馆实验室，学龄儿童们正在与大型混合现实全息影像进行互动，呈现出电影级的超精细照片写实效果。场景为午后温暖阳光下的广角室内视角，配有落地玻璃窗、现代桌椅、书架、数字显示屏，营造出简洁的高科技教育氛围。约 9 名儿童和 1 名教师分布在房间各处，通过手势和触控积极探索科学展品。房间中央，一颗发光的半透明全息人体心脏悬浮在胸部高度，3 名儿童围在周围，好奇地伸手触碰。头顶上方悬挂着一个巨大的全息太阳系模型，9 颗行星围绕着明亮的太阳旋转，带有发光的轨道轨迹和梦幻般的科学可视化风格。左侧，一名儿童正在与一个高大的垂直全息 DNA 双螺旋结构互动。左前方桌上有一个圆形的桌面全息图，展示了一个微型山川河流生态系统，其中包含 4 种可见动物：大象、鹿、羊驼（或驼马）和熊。左后方桌上有一个圆形的建筑全息模型，展示了一座宏伟的古典圆顶建筑及周边结构。右前方桌上有一个由发光球体和连杆组成的巨大球棍分子模型。在右中和右上方空间，包含额外的悬浮科学全息图：2 个几何多面体、2 个分子结构图、2 个球形能量或数据球，以及 1 个类似沙漏的抽象全息图。孩子们应具有多元的种族背景，穿着休闲，神情投入、惊叹且充满协作精神，正注视着不同的全息主题。运用柔和的体积光，呈现玻璃和桌面上的真实反射，全息图散发出细腻的蓝金色光芒，伴有轻微的大气雾感，展现出高端且富有启发性的 STEM 教育广告美学。

templates.title: Watercolor Elf Girl on Sunlit Bed

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光卧室里的水彩精灵少女

templates.prompt: A soft pastel watercolor anime illustration of a young elf girl sitting on a bed in a quiet sunlit bedroom, viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. She has {argument name="hair color" default="warm orange"} shoulder-length hair with soft layered strands, large blue eyes, pale skin, and long pointed elf ears. A red flower hair clip decorates the left side of her hair. Her expression is calm and dreamy as she gazes upward toward the bright light on the right side of the image. She wears a loose sage-green chiffon dress with ruffled trim, sheer puffed long sleeves, gathered ribbon details at the chest, and a black lace camisole visible underneath, plus a thin red choker with a small pendant and dark thigh-high stockings. She is posed seated near the edge of a lavender bedspread, leaning back with both hands resting on the mattress behind her, legs extended diagonally toward the lower right. The room is delicate and minimal: 1 bed with 2 white pillows, 1 wooden headboard or bedside surface behind her, 1 window on the left, 1 small potted plant on the windowsill, and flowing lavender curtains. Strong warm sunlight floods the scene from the right, creating a large glowing white area and gentle washed-out highlights. Use an airy handmade watercolor look with visible paper grain, soft bleeding edges, pastel lilac and cream shadows, subtle sparkled pigment texture, and a serene fantasy slice-of-life mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅柔和的粉彩水彩动漫插画，描绘了一位年轻的精灵少女坐在安静且阳光明媚的卧室床上，视角为略微俯视的三分之四侧面。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="暖橙色"} 的齐肩发，发丝层次柔和，有着大大的蓝色眼睛、白皙的皮肤和长长的尖耳朵。左侧头发上别着一个红色花朵发夹。她神情宁静而梦幻，凝视着画面右侧的明亮光线。她穿着一件宽松的鼠尾草绿雪纺连衣裙，带有荷叶边装饰、透明的泡泡长袖、胸前有褶皱丝带细节，内搭黑色蕾丝吊带背心，并佩戴着一条带有小吊坠的红色细颈圈，穿着深色过膝袜。她坐在薰衣草色床罩的边缘附近，双手向后撑在床垫上，双腿向右下方斜伸。房间精致简约：1 张床配 2 个白色枕头，她身后有 1 个木制床头板或床头平面，左侧有 1 扇窗户，窗台上放着 1 盆小植物，并挂着飘逸的薰衣草色窗帘。强烈的暖阳从右侧倾泻而入，营造出一大片明亮的光晕和柔和的褪色高光。采用轻盈的手绘水彩风格，呈现可见的纸张纹理、柔和的晕染边缘、淡紫色和奶油色的阴影、细腻的闪光颜料质感，以及宁静的奇幻生活氛围。

templates.title: Futuristic Audi Tron Concept Coupe

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感 Audi Tron 概念轿跑

templates.prompt: A futuristic concept coupe based on an {argument name="car brand" default="Audi"}, shown in a low rear three-quarter side view facing right, isolated in a vast black studio with a dark matte floor and almost no background detail. The car has a sleek white body with a long fastback roofline, blacked-out windows, an ultra-low stance, wide body proportions, and smooth minimalist surfacing. The side features 1 large pale gray swoosh graphic across the door and rear quarter panel, resembling a sporty decal. The rear is partially transparent or cut away to expose the performance drivetrain: 1 visible battery pack mounted low behind the cabin, 1 exposed metallic motor or transmission assembly, and 3 thick silver exhaust or intake pipes curving through the rear mechanical bay. The tail includes a continuous thin LED light bar spanning the width, the Audi rings glowing at center, and the word “tron” illuminated beneath. The wheels are deep black multi-spoke performance rims with low-profile tires; both visible tires have glowing white sidewall lettering, with stylized Japanese characters and racing text. Add subtle illuminated branding near the side skirt and front wheel arch. Lighting is cinematic and moody with cool blue rim light, glossy reflections, soft bloom, and a faint cyberpunk halo around the illuminated elements. Hyper-detailed automotive render, premium concept-car design visualization, photorealistic materials, dramatic contrast, clean composition, no people.

promptLocalized.zh: 一辆基于 {argument name="car brand" default="Audi"} 的未来感概念轿跑，采用低位后侧 45 度视角向右，置于广阔的黑色摄影棚中，地面为深色哑光材质，背景几乎无细节。车身呈流线型白色，拥有修长的溜背车顶线条、全黑车窗、超低底盘、宽体比例以及平滑极简的曲面。车侧饰有 1 个巨大的浅灰色弧形图案，横跨车门及后翼子板，酷似运动贴花。车尾部分透明或镂空，露出高性能动力总成：驾驶舱后方低位安装有 1 个可见的电池组，1 个外露的金属电机或变速箱总成，以及 3 根粗壮的银色排气管或进气管穿过车尾机械舱。车尾配有一条贯穿式的纤细 LED 灯带，Audi 四环标志在中央发光，下方点亮着“tron”字样。轮毂为深黑色多辐高性能轮圈，搭配低扁平比轮胎；两个可见轮胎的侧壁均有发光的白色文字，包含风格化的日文字符和赛车文字。在侧裙和前轮拱附近添加微妙的发光品牌标识。灯光呈现电影般的冷峻氛围，带有冷蓝色轮廓光、光泽反射、柔和的光晕以及发光元件周围隐约的赛博朋克光环。超精细汽车渲染，高端概念车设计视觉化，照片级真实材质，强烈的明暗对比，构图简洁，无人物。

templates.title: Night Drift Futuristic Sports Sedan

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间漂移未来感运动轿车

templates.prompt: A cinematic night automotive action photo of a futuristic white electric sports sedan inspired by an Audi e-tron GT, captured in a fast side-tracking shot while it drifts hard across a wet city street. The car is shown in clean left-side profile with the front pointing to the right, low and aggressive stance, black roof, dark tinted windows, black wheels, and a continuous thin LED rear light bar glowing red. The rear bodywork is radically modified and partially removed, exposing metallic turbo-like piping and mechanical components behind the rear wheel area. Thick white tire smoke billows from the back of the car and fills the entire left side of the frame. The pavement is glossy from rain and reflects blue, white, and amber city lights. The background is very dark with soft bokeh from distant buildings and streetlights, plus faint vertical poles and barriers, all heavily motion-blurred to emphasize speed. Use a moody urban color palette of black, steel blue, cool white, and warm orange highlights, realistic photography, high detail, low-angle tracking perspective, long-lens panning shot, dramatic reflections, shallow depth of field, and intense motorsport energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的夜间汽车动作照片，主角是一辆灵感源自 Audi e-tron GT 的未来感白色电动运动轿车，采用快速侧向跟拍视角，展现其在湿滑的城市街道上激烈漂移的瞬间。车辆呈现清晰的左侧轮廓，车头朝向右侧，姿态低趴且极具侵略性，配备黑色车顶、深色车窗、黑色轮毂，以及一条发着红光的连续细长 LED 尾灯带。后部车身经过深度改装并部分拆除，露出了后轮区域后方的金属涡轮状管道和机械组件。浓厚的白色轮胎烟雾从车尾喷涌而出，充盈了画面的整个左侧。路面因雨水而光亮，反射着蓝色、白色和琥珀色的城市灯光。背景极其深邃，远处建筑和路灯呈现出柔和的虚化效果，辅以模糊的垂直立柱和护栏，通过强烈的动态模糊强调速度感。采用黑色、钢蓝色、冷白色和暖橙色高光组成的忧郁城市色调，写实摄影风格，高细节，低角度跟拍视角，长焦平移拍摄，戏剧性的反射效果，浅景深，充满强烈的赛车运动能量。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Audi Rear Chase Shot

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克风格奥迪后方追拍镜头

templates.prompt: A cinematic rear three-quarter tracking shot of a futuristic white Audi supercar racing through a dense neon-lit city at night on a wet street, viewed from a very low angle close to the rear wheel. The car has a sleek widebody coupe silhouette, glossy pearl white body panels, a black rear fascia, and a continuous thin LED taillight strip with segmented red and white light elements stretching across the tail. The glowing Audi four-ring logo is illuminated in white at the center rear, with a stylized glowing model badge beneath it that reads "tron" in a futuristic font. The rear bodywork is partially removed or transparently open to reveal exposed high-performance mechanical components: 1 large rectangular metallic battery or power unit mounted low at the back, 3 visible thick exhaust or cooling pipes spanning across the rear, 1 visible gearbox or motor assembly near the center-right, and a deep black rear diffuser with 2 large fins. The car rides on oversized deep-dish black wheels with ultra-wide rear tires, and the tire sidewalls feature bright white Japanese-style lettering around the circumference. Use strong motion blur in the background and along the road surface to imply high speed, with sharp focus on the car body and exposed machinery. Surround the scene with abstract urban bokeh, streaking neon signage, reflections of red, blue, and white city lights across the wet pavement and glossy bodywork. High contrast, cyberpunk atmosphere, realistic automotive photography, dramatic nighttime lighting, ultra-detailed metal textures, cinematic lens, dynamic composition, speed, power, futuristic engineering.

promptLocalized.zh: 电影级后侧方跟拍镜头，一辆未来感十足的白色奥迪超级跑车在夜晚湿滑的街道上疾驰，穿梭于密集的霓虹城市中，视角极低，靠近后轮。车辆拥有流畅的宽体轿跑轮廓，采用光泽感珍珠白车身面板，配备黑色后包围，以及一条横贯车尾的细长 LED 贯穿式尾灯，灯带包含分段式红白光效。奥迪四环标志在车尾中央发出白光，下方带有风格化的发光车型徽标，以未来感字体书写着“tron”。后部车身部分移除或呈现透明开启状态，露出内部的高性能机械组件：后部低位安装有 1 个大型矩形金属电池或动力单元，横跨车尾可见 3 根粗壮的排气管或冷却管，右侧中央可见 1 个变速箱或电机总成，以及带有 2 个大尺寸鳍片的深黑色后扩散器。车辆配备超大尺寸深凹黑色轮毂和超宽后胎，轮胎侧壁环绕着亮白色的日式风格文字。背景和路面采用强烈的动态模糊以体现高速感，车身和裸露的机械结构保持清晰对焦。场景周围环绕着抽象的城市光斑（bokeh），霓虹招牌光影流转，红、蓝、白色的城市灯光在湿润的路面和光亮的漆面上交相辉映。高对比度，赛博朋克氛围，写实汽车摄影，戏剧性夜间照明，超精细金属质感，电影级镜头，动态构图，速度感，力量感，未来工程设计。

templates.title: Futuristic EV Racing Through City Night

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感电动汽车穿梭城市之夜

templates.prompt: A cinematic nighttime automotive action shot of a futuristic electric sports coupe racing through a modern downtown city, viewed from a low rear three-quarter tracking angle. The car is a sleek {argument name="car brand" default="Audi"} concept vehicle with a glossy {argument name="body color" default="white"} body, black roofline, dark tinted windows, extremely wide rear tires, illuminated rear light bar, and glowing {argument name="rear badge text" default="tron"} branding centered on the back. The rear lower section is partially transparent or open, revealing advanced electric drivetrain and battery hardware with metallic detail and cool blue illumination. Add flowing pale gray and blue side graphics on the doors and rear quarter panels for a concept-car look. The vehicle is driving fast on a wet multi-lane urban expressway, with strong motion blur in the asphalt, lane markings, and surrounding buildings. The background is filled with tall glass office towers at night, hundreds of bright window lights, scattered red aircraft warning lights on rooftops, and streaking traffic lights in the distance. Include reflections along a barrier or wall on the far left edge to emphasize speed and camera motion. templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical poster-style mixed-media portrait with a gritty urban editorial aesthetic, designed like a concert or personal brand poster. Center a middle-aged man from the waist up, wearing a black T-shirt, standing slightly turned and raising one arm upward with his index finger pointing toward the top of the frame. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur block. Use a dark black and sepia color palette with distressed cream and gold accents, heavy grunge textures, ink splatters, scratched overlays, torn-paper brush marks, dust, and weathered print effects. Place a large muted gold circular halo behind his head and upper torso. In the background, create a collage of Córdoba city landmarks: a cathedral facade on the right side, a river with bridge and low skyline on the left side, all blended into the textured poster composition. Add oversized bold condensed serif typography at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="EDU PEREYRA"}, with “EDU” in large distressed off-white letters and “PEREYRA” below in gold. Add 5 smaller text groups around the composition in uppercase handwritten or condensed styles: top left “MÚSICA PASIÓN VERDAD”, top right “DESDE ADENTRO HACIA AFUERA”, mid-right “LO QUE SE SIENTE NO NECESITA EXPLICARSE”, mid-left “AGRADECER SEGUIR CREAR”, and bottom center “TIERRA DE HISTORIA, CORAZÓN DE GENTE.” Across the lower foreground, add a huge expressive brush-script word {argument name="city name" default="cordoba"} in off-white, slightly diagonal, with a gold underline swoosh. Include 3 small symbolic graphic accents: a tiny crown icon near the upper right, a small starburst ornament near the bottom center, and a handwritten signature mark at the lower right. The shirt should include vintage printed lettering and emblem graphics. Lighting is moody and contrasty, with the subject cut out sharply against the layered collage. Overall feel: raw, passionate, musical, spiritual, local-pride poster, premium distressed print design, high visual impact, cinematic and artisanal.

templates.prompt: A gritty retro propaganda-style poster illustration with a limited palette of black, deep red, and aged beige paper texture, designed like a bold vintage screen-printed action poster. Show 2 stylized women in a dramatic diagonal composition, frozen mid-fight. On the left, a woman dressed like a nurse in a short white uniform and angular nurse cap lunges forward with one knee raised and one arm bent, her body sharply foreshortened. On the right, a woman in a fitted black dress and wide-brim black hat leans backward in a defensive pose, one arm raised above her head and the other near her torso, long dark hair flowing behind her. Render both figures with hard-edged geometric shapes, exaggerated limbs, sharp shadows, and high-contrast noir facial planes. Use aggressive red diagonal rays sweeping across the background, with black architectural bars and abstract constructivist shapes framing the scene. Add distressed paper grain, ink wear, and slight misregistration for a worn print effect. Place a small blurred monkey head emblem in the upper-right corner. Include large blocky poster text in the lower left across 3 lines reading “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” then “MINCE AND” then “TATTIES”, with the first 2 lines in beige and the final 2 lines in strong red, using a heavy squared sans-serif display font. Add a red cross-like graphic element in the lower-right corner. The overall mood is violent, satirical, cinematic, and strikingly graphic, like a Soviet constructivist pulp film poster advertising {argument name="dish name" default="Scottish Recipe: Mince and Tatties"}.
