templates.prompt: A realistic dark-mode social media screenshot of a tweet viewed on a desktop interface. At the top left is a circular profile photo and the display name Riley Goodside with a blue verification badge, followed by the handle @goodside and the timestamp 10h. The tweet text reads: "ChatGPT Images 2.0 generates a game die but instead of numbers it has working QR codes for each of their Wikipedia articles". Beneath the tweet is a large embedded image with 2 side-by-side panels inside a rounded rectangle. The left panel shows a glossy white six-sided die resting on a warm brown wooden tabletop, photographed at a slight angle, with 3 visible faces, and each visible face contains a different black QR code instead of pips; the lighting is soft and realistic with subtle reflections on the die’s rounded edges. Above the die image is a dark UI header area with a small line of text reading "Thought for 1m 43s" and a cropped speech-bubble-like overlay near the top that says "for the corresponding Wikipedia article for its number." The right panel is a mobile-style Wikipedia page screenshot for the number 1, with a white background and thin gray borders, showing the tabs "Article" and "Talk" at the top, small interface icons, and article text beginning with "This article is about the number. For the year AD 1, and other uses, see One (disambiguation) and Number One (disambiguation)" followed by a boxed notice about special characters and the bold opening line "1 (one, unit, unity) is a number, numeral, and grapheme." The social media interface around the embedded image uses a nearly black background with standard reply, repost, like, analytics, bookmark, and share icons along the bottom, with visible counts of 45 replies, 157 reposts, 3.5K likes, and 191K views. Crisp UI typography, authentic desktop X/Twitter layout, realistic screenshot style, high legibility, subtle compression and screen-capture appearance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在桌面界面上查看的逼真深色模式社交媒体推文截图。左上角是一个圆形头像，显示名称为 Riley Goodside，带有蓝色认证徽章，后跟账号 @goodside 和时间戳 10h。推文内容为：“ChatGPT Images 2.0 生成了一个游戏骰子，但它上面没有数字，而是为每个数字对应的维基百科文章提供了可用的 QR 码”。推文下方是一张巨大的嵌入式图片，圆角矩形内包含两个并排的面板。左侧面板显示一个光泽的白色六面骰子，放置在温暖的棕色木制桌面上，以微小角度拍摄，可见 3 个面，每个可见面上都有一个不同的黑色 QR 码代替点数；光线柔和逼真，骰子圆角处有细微的反射。骰子图像上方是一个深色 UI 标题区域，有一行小字写着“思考了 1 分 43 秒”，顶部附近有一个裁剪过的类似对话气泡的覆盖层，写着“用于其数字对应的维基百科文章”。右侧面板是数字 1 的移动端风格维基百科页面截图，背景为白色，带有细灰色边框，顶部显示“条目”和“讨论”标签、小型界面图标，以及以“本条目介绍的是数字。关于公元 1 年及其他用途，请见 One (消歧义) 和 Number One (消歧义)”开头的文章正文，随后是一个关于特殊字符的方框通知，以及加粗的开篇行“1（一，单位，统一）是一个数字、数值和字素。”嵌入式图片周围的社交媒体界面使用近乎黑色的背景，底部带有标准的回复、转发、点赞、分析、书签和分享图标，并显示 45 条回复、157 次转发、3.5K 次点赞和 191K 次浏览。清晰的 UI 排版，真实的桌面版 X/Twitter 布局，逼真的截图风格，高可读性，带有细微的压缩感和屏幕截图外观。

templates.title: Tweet Screenshot With Handwriting Match

titleLocalized.zh: 推文截图：手写笔迹匹配效果

templates.prompt:
A realistic dark-mode social media post screenshot styled like X/Twitter on a black interface. At the top left is a small blurred circular profile photo beside the display name {argument name="profile name" default="Pratham"} with a blue verification badge, and the handle {argument name="handle" default="@Prathkum"} underneath. At the top right is a rounded white Subscribe button plus two small interface icons. The tweet text in large white sans-serif type reads: {argument name="tweet text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0 can match your handwriting."} Below it is a side-by-side comparison image made of 2 notebook photos separated by a narrow black vertical gap. Both photos show an open lined notebook page shot from above under dim indoor lighting with soft shadows near the bottom edge. The left notebook page is mostly blank except for 2 handwritten lines in neat blue cursive at the top that say: {argument name="handwriting prompt text" default="match my hanawriting ana write a poem for me.."} Keep the misspellings and punctuation exactly as written. The right notebook page shows the same first 2 handwritten lines at the top, followed by a handwritten poem in matching blue cursive handwriting filling the page in 4 stanzas. The poem text reads exactly: {argument name="poem text" default="between the pages, quiet dreams, where ink becomes the stars, i write what my heart means, and let it heal the scars.

the world may move so fast, but here, time slows its pace. in every line i’ve made to last, i find a softer space.

some days are clouds, some days are sun, but i keep showing up. with every word, i’m not alone— my pen is my cup.

so here’s to thoughts, both big and small, to hopes, to fears, to me. i’ll keep on writing through it all, and set my spirit free."} The handwriting should look natural, slightly uneven, and convincingly human, with blue ballpoint pen texture. At the bottom left of the post, include a small sparkle icon and the words “Made with AI”. Preserve the look of a genuine mobile app screenshot with realistic spacing, rounded image corners, crisp UI typography, and subtle screen-capture softness.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张逼真的深色模式社交媒体帖子截图，采用黑色界面，风格类似于 X/Twitter。左上角是一个模糊的小圆形头像，旁边是显示名称 {argument name="profile name" default="Pratham"} 以及蓝色认证徽章，下方是账号 ID {argument name="handle" default="@Prathkum"}。右上角是一个圆角白色“订阅”按钮和两个小界面图标。推文内容采用大号白色无衬线字体，文字为：{argument name="tweet text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0 can match your handwriting."} 下方是一张并排对比图，由两张笔记本照片组成，中间由一条窄窄的黑色垂直间隙隔开。两张照片均展示了从上方拍摄的打开的横线笔记本页面，光线为昏暗的室内光，底部边缘有柔和的阴影。左侧笔记本页面大部分为空白，仅顶部有两行整齐的蓝色草书手写字：{argument name="handwriting prompt text" default="match my hanawriting ana write a poem for me.."} 请保留拼写错误和标点符号，确保与原文完全一致。右侧笔记本页面顶部显示相同的前两行手写字，随后是一首用匹配的蓝色草书手写体写成的诗，分 4 个诗节填满页面。诗歌内容如下：{argument name="poem text" default="between the pages, quiet dreams, where ink becomes the stars, i write what my heart means, and let it heal the scars.

the world may move so fast, but here, time slows its pace. in every line i’ve made to last, i find a softer space.

some days are clouds, some days are sun, but i keep showing up. with every word, i’m not alone— my pen is my cup.

so here’s to thoughts, both big and small, to hopes, to fears, to me. i’ll keep on writing through it all, and set my spirit free."} 手写笔迹应看起来自然、略有不均匀，具有令人信服的人类书写感，并呈现蓝色圆珠笔的质感。在帖子左下角，加入一个小闪烁图标和“Made with AI”字样。保留真实移动应用截图的外观，包括逼真的间距、圆角图片边缘、清晰的 UI 字体以及细微的屏幕截图柔和感。

templates.title: Historic Galleon and Chinese Junk

titleLocalized.zh: 历史大帆船与中国帆船

templates.prompt: A highly detailed historical maritime scene at water level, showing two large wooden sailing ships anchored close together on calm reflective water under a bright blue sky with soft scattered clouds. On the left, a massive ornate European galleon dominates the composition, viewed from the rear-left stern quarter, with richly carved baroque stern decorations in gold, red, blue, and cream, heraldic emblems, multiple stern windows, and a dark hull with warm reddish-brown planking. It has 4 visible masts including a bowsprit, dense black rigging, crow's nests, and many cream-white square sails partially unfurled and hanging loosely. On the right, a traditional Chinese junk faces slightly left, with 1 very large rust-brown battened sail raised, a curved wooden hull in brown, black, and white, carved stern details, and smaller masts and rigging. In the foreground center, include 1 small wooden rowboat with 1 standing boatman wearing light clothing and a brimmed hat, adding scale between the two ships. In the distant background, show faint silhouettes of additional sailing vessels near the horizon on the far left. Lighting is crisp daylight with warm highlights on the wood, subtle reflections in the rippling water, and a painterly yet photorealistic finish, ultra-detailed textures, cinematic composition, wide aspect ratio, no modern elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具细节的历史海洋场景，视角位于水面高度。画面展示了两艘大型木制帆船在平静且具有倒影的水面上近距离停泊，背景是明亮的蓝天和零星的柔和云朵。左侧是一艘宏伟华丽的欧洲大帆船，从左后方船尾视角呈现，船尾装饰着金、红、蓝、奶油色的巴洛克风格雕刻、纹章标志、多扇船尾窗，以及带有温暖红棕色木板的深色船体。船上有 4 根可见的桅杆（包括斜桅）、密集的黑色索具、瞭望台，以及许多半展开并自然下垂的奶油白色方帆。右侧是一艘略微朝左的传统中国帆船，挂着 1 面巨大的铁锈棕色板条帆，船体呈棕、黑、白色，带有雕刻的船尾细节，以及较小的桅杆和索具。画面前景中央包含 1 艘小型木制划艇，船上站着 1 位身穿浅色衣服、戴着宽檐帽的船夫，为两艘大船之间提供了比例参照。远景背景中，左侧地平线附近隐约可见其他帆船的轮廓。光线为清澈的日光，木材上带有温暖的高光，水面波纹中映出微妙的倒影，整体呈现出兼具绘画感与写实感的风格，纹理极其细腻，构图具有电影感，采用宽画幅比例，不包含任何现代元素。

templates.title: Futuristic Cyber Skincare Product Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感网络护肤品广告

templates.prompt: A futuristic luxury skincare product advertisement in a cool icy blue palette, shot as a high-end studio beauty campaign. Center a frosted white pump bottle labeled {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"} with minimalist navy text reading {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}, plus smaller lines "for risk-free connections", "pour des connexions sans risque", and "75 ml / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier" near the bottom. Place the bottle upright on a glossy wet reflective surface covered with realistic water droplets, with the translucent round cap lying off to the right behind the bottle. Surround the product with floating sharp-edged transparent glass shards and crystal fragments, suspended in midair like shattered ice. Several larger shards act as labeled callout panels: exactly 6 text shards reading "TEXTURE" on the left over a close-up of dewy skin, "SHIELD" in the upper right, "HYDRATION" on the right over a close-up of a blue eye and wet skin, "SECURITY SHIELD" in the lower left over a subtle hexagonal honeycomb pattern, "PROTECT" at bottom left, and "CLEANSE" at lower right. Integrate beauty-image fragments inside some of the shards: one shard shows cheek and lips with luminous skin texture, one shows a female eye with long lashes and water droplets on the skin, and one shows a scientific honeycomb barrier pattern. Add a tall soft rectangular frosted panel hovering behind the pump head in the upper center to create layered depth. Include two iridescent glass spheres on the wet surface, one at the lower left corner and one at the lower right corner. Use bright sparkling highlights, prismatic rainbow refractions, glowing rim light, floating mist, micro-particles, and a crisp 4K cosmetic advertising finish. The composition should feel premium, clean, protective, and cyber-skincare themed, blending hydration science with digital security metaphors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一则采用冷冰蓝色调的未来感奢华护肤品广告，以高端摄影棚美妆大片风格呈现。画面中心放置一个磨砂白泵头瓶，标签为 {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}，并印有极简主义海军蓝文字 {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}，底部附近有较小的文字行：“for risk-free connections”、“pour des connexions sans risque”以及“75 ml / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier”。将瓶子垂直放置在带有真实水珠的亮面湿润反射表面上，半透明圆形瓶盖位于瓶子右后方。产品周围环绕着悬浮在半空中、如碎冰般锋利的透明玻璃碎片和水晶碎块。几块较大的碎片作为标注面板：左侧 6 块文字碎片分别写着“TEXTURE”（覆盖在水润肌肤特写上）、右上角“SHIELD”、右侧“HYDRATION”（覆盖在蓝色眼睛和湿润肌肤特写上）、左下角“SECURITY SHIELD”（覆盖在微妙的六边形蜂窝图案上）、左下角“PROTECT”以及右下角“CLEANSE”。在部分碎片中融入美妆图像片段：一块碎片展示了具有光泽感的脸颊和嘴唇，一块展示了带有长睫毛和皮肤水珠的女性眼睛，另一块展示了科学的蜂窝屏障图案。在泵头后方上方中心处添加一个高大的磨砂长方形悬浮面板，以营造层次深度。在湿润表面上放置两个虹彩玻璃球，分别位于左下角和右下角。使用明亮的闪烁高光、棱镜彩虹折射、发光的轮廓光、漂浮的薄雾、微粒，以及清晰的 4K 化妆品广告质感。整体构图应体现高端、洁净、防护和网络护肤主题，将水合科学与数字安全隐喻完美融合。

templates.prompt: A luxury futuristic skincare advertisement in a vertical 4K poster format, centered on a sleek matte-white spray bottle floating diagonally in the middle of the frame, slightly tilted to the right, with a soft cylindrical cap and fine condensation droplets across the upper body. The bottle label reads "{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}" in clean navy sans-serif text, and below it: "{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}" with smaller subtext "for risk-free connections" and "pour des connexions sans risque," plus tiny footer text "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier." Behind the bottle, enormous translucent serif typography fills most of the background, reading "{argument name="headline text" default="ULTRA-SECURE"}", split across two lines and partially obscured by the product. The environment is deep midnight blue with glowing translucent fabric-like liquid ribbons curling around the bottle from top left to bottom right and from the lower foreground upward, mixed with 2 prominent glassy tubular arcs and multiple floating crystal-like droplets or bubbles. Lighting is cold, cinematic, glossy, and high-end, with luminous icy blue highlights, soft bloom, refractive reflections, and a pristine premium beauty-campaign look. At the bottom center, elegant spaced-out small caps text reads "{argument name="tagline" default="ENCRYPTED BARRIER FORMULA"}". Beneath that is a row of 4 ingredient callouts separated evenly across the width: 1) "CERAMIDE IP-07" with two lines "Strengthens" and "Lipid Defence"; 2) "SQUALANE ENCAPSULES" with "Reinforces" and "Moisture Lock"; 3) "NIACINAMIDE 5%" with "Calms Visible" and "Stress Signals"; 4) "HYALURONIC STACK" with "Multi-Layer" and "Hydration Matrix". At the very bottom center, add a small shield icon and the words "DEFEND. PURIFY. PROTECT." The overall style should blend luxury skincare product photography with cyber-security branding, ultra-polished commercial lighting, shallow depth of field, premium editorial composition, and production-ready ad design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的未来感护肤品广告，采用竖版 4K 海报格式。画面中央是一个悬浮的哑光白喷雾瓶，呈对角线放置并向右微倾，瓶盖为柔和的圆柱形，瓶身上部附有细腻的冷凝水珠。瓶身标签以简洁的深蓝色无衬线字体印有“{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}”，下方印有“{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}”，并配有较小的副标题“for risk-free connections”和“pour des connexions sans risque”，以及底部的微小文字“75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier”。瓶身背景中，巨大的半透明衬线字体占据了大部分空间，显示为“{argument name="headline text" default="ULTRA-SECURE"}”，分为两行，部分被产品遮挡。环境为深午夜蓝色，发光的半透明织物状液体丝带从左上角向右下角以及从前景下方向上缠绕瓶身，并混合了 2 个显眼的玻璃质感管状弧线，以及多个悬浮的晶体状水滴或气泡。光影冷峻、具有电影质感、光泽感强且高端，带有明亮的冰蓝色高光、柔和的辉光效果、折射反射，呈现出纯净的高级美妆广告质感。底部中央，优雅且间距适中的小型大写字母文字写着“{argument name="tagline" default="ENCRYPTED BARRIER FORMULA"}”。下方是一排 4 个成分说明，均匀分布在画面宽度上：1) “CERAMIDE IP-07”，配有两行文字“Strengthens”和“Lipid Defence”；2) “SQUALANE ENCAPSULES”，配有“Reinforces”和“Moisture Lock”；3) “NIACINAMIDE 5%”，配有“Calms Visible”和“Stress Signals”；4) “HYALURONIC STACK”，配有“Multi-Layer”和“Hydration Matrix”。在最底部中央，添加一个小盾牌图标和文字“DEFEND. PURIFY. PROTECT.”。整体风格应将奢华护肤品摄影与网络安全品牌形象相结合，具备极致精美的商业布光、浅景深、高级编辑排版以及可直接用于生产的广告设计感。

templates.title: Sunset Futuristic Megacity Panorama

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的未来感超级城市全景

templates.prompt: A vast cinematic sci-fi megacity at sunset, viewed from a high observation platform between dark futuristic superstructures, with an immense glowing orange-and-gold sky filled with dramatic clouds and haze. The scene shows a sprawling vertical city extending far into the distance, packed with countless ultra-tall needle-like skyscrapers and luminous architectural spires rising through layers of clouds. A colossal hovering platform-city dominates the upper right-middle area, dark metallic and heavily detailed, suspended above the skyline with smaller towers and structures attached beneath it. In the lower left foreground, a sleek futuristic spacecraft is launching away from a terrace, angled diagonally outward toward the center, with bright blue engine exhaust trails and reflective metallic panels. Tiny human silhouettes stand along the terrace edge for scale. Multiple small flying vehicles and hovercraft are scattered across the sky at different distances, creating dense air traffic. Far below, the city grid glitters with warm lights through atmospheric mist. Use a grand panoramic composition, high contrast between dark architectural framing and radiant sunset light, intricate techno-industrial detail, atmospheric perspective, volumetric clouds, reflective surfaces, and a richly colored palette of amber, peach, violet, deep navy, and electric blue accents. Ultra-detailed, epic futuristic concept art, photoreal matte-painting feel, sharp focus, dramatic scale, vertical 4:3 composition, no text or logos.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个广阔的电影级科幻超级城市日落景观，从黑暗的未来主义超大建筑群之间的高处观景台俯瞰，巨大的橙金色发光天空中充满了戏剧性的云层和薄雾。场景展示了一座向远方延伸的庞大垂直城市，密布着无数高耸入云的针状摩天大楼和穿透云层的发光建筑尖塔。右上中方是一座巨大的悬浮平台城市，呈深色金属质感且细节丰富，悬浮在天际线上方，下方附带着较小的塔楼和结构。左下角前景中，一艘流线型未来派航天器正从露台起飞，呈对角线向中心倾斜，带有明亮的蓝色引擎尾迹和反光的金属面板。露台边缘站着几个微小的人影以体现比例。天空中散布着许多不同距离的小型飞行载具和气垫船，形成了密集的空中交通。远处的下方，城市网格透过大气薄雾闪烁着温暖的灯光。采用宏大的全景构图，深色建筑框架与灿烂的日落光线形成高对比，展现复杂的科技工业细节、大气透视、体积云、反光表面，以及琥珀色、桃色、紫色、深海军蓝和电光蓝的丰富色彩组合。超精细、史诗般的未来主义概念艺术，照片级写实哑光绘画质感，焦点清晰，规模宏大，4:3 垂直构图，无文字或徽标。

templates.title: Floating Futuristic City at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的浮空未来城市

templates.prompt: A vast cinematic sci-fi megacity floating above dense glowing clouds at sunset, viewed from a high aerial perspective. The scene shows an expansive futuristic skyline with dozens of ultra-tall elegant skyscrapers and needle-like towers rising from hovering platforms, connected by distant structures and suspended districts. In the center-right, a large floating urban hub features multiple illuminated glass domes and layered circular bases, surrounded by several monumental towers, including one especially tall central spire with a wide ring-like observation structure near the top. Warm golden sunlight pours in from the left horizon, creating a dramatic orange, peach, and lavender sky with thick clouds and atmospheric haze, while the lower half of the image is filled with soft pink and blue cloud banks reflecting the sunset. Several flying vehicles are visible: 1 large dark metallic spacecraft in the lower left foreground with bright blue engine trails, 1 circular landing-pad-like platform craft in the lower right foreground, 2 medium ships crossing the midground with blue light trails, and multiple tiny distant air vehicles scattered across the skyline. Add intricate city lighting, reflective metallic surfaces, immense scale, serene futuristic grandeur, and highly detailed concept art styling. Include the white brand text {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"} in the top-right corner as a clean overlay.

promptLocalized.zh: 日落时分，一座宏伟的电影级科幻巨型城市漂浮在浓厚且发光的云层之上，采用高空俯瞰视角。画面展现了广阔的未来城市天际线，数十座优雅的超高层摩天大楼和针状塔楼从悬浮平台上拔地而起，由远处的结构和悬浮区域相互连接。在画面中右侧，一个巨大的浮空城市枢纽拥有多个发光的玻璃穹顶和分层圆形基座，周围环绕着数座纪念碑式的塔楼，其中包括一座特别高耸的中央尖塔，顶部附近设有一个宽大的环形观景结构。温暖的金色阳光从左侧地平线倾泻而下，营造出橙色、桃色和淡紫色的戏剧性天空，伴有浓厚的云层和大气雾霾，画面下半部分充满了反射着夕阳余晖的柔和粉色和蓝色云团。可见多架飞行载具：左下角前景处有一架大型深色金属航天器，带有明亮的蓝色引擎尾迹；右下角前景处有一架圆形着陆平台式飞行器；中景处有 2 架中型飞船穿过，留下了蓝色光迹；天际线各处还散布着多个微小的远距离飞行器。增加精致的城市灯光、反光的金属表面、宏大的比例、宁静的未来主义宏伟感以及高度精细的概念艺术风格。在右上角添加白色品牌文本 {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"} 作为清晰的覆盖层。

templates.title: Cinematic Heist Mastermind at Whiteboard

titleLocalized.zh: 白板前的电影级劫案策划大师

templates.prompt: A cinematic, moody heist-planning scene in a dimly lit office at night, shot in a realistic thriller style. A single adult man stands with his back mostly to the camera, slightly turned in profile, writing on a huge whiteboard filled edge to edge with tactical notes, building sketches, floor plans, arrows, routes, and hand-drawn diagrams. He has wavy dark hair and wears a dark olive or charcoal casual jacket over dark trousers, giving the impression of a mastermind strategist. The whiteboard is the focal point and contains multiple readable planning areas: the top left title says "OPERATION NIGHTHAWK"; the left column has 3 sections labeled "OBJECTIVE," "TARGET," and "TIMELINE"; the upper right has 2 labeled diagram areas, "ENTRY PLAN" and "CAMERA NETWORK"; the lower middle-right has 4 labeled planning blocks, "TRANSIT," "EQUIPMENT," "HOTEL ROUTE," and "CONTINGENCIES." Include sketched building elevations, a rooftop access drawing, loading bay notes, room labels, arrows in black and red marker, and a small van sketch near the lower center. The room is warm and shadowy with amber practical lighting. On the left side of the frame, show a desk lamp glowing over a dark wooden desk with scattered papers, and a wall with 3 framed black-and-white photographs arranged vertically. Composition is a medium-wide over-the-shoulder shot, the man centered slightly left, the whiteboard dominating the background. High contrast, soft filmic grain, tense atmosphere, realistic textures, prestige TV crime-drama aesthetic similar to a brilliant planner preparing a robbery, but not depicting any specific copyrighted character. Add a white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the top-right corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影感十足、氛围阴郁的劫案策划场景，背景为深夜昏暗的办公室，采用写实的惊悚片风格拍摄。一名成年男子背对镜头，侧身站立，正在一块巨大的白板上书写，白板写满了战术笔记、建筑草图、平面图、箭头、路线和手绘图表。他留着深色卷发，身穿深橄榄色或炭灰色休闲夹克，搭配深色长裤，展现出策划大师的形象。白板是视觉焦点，包含多个可读的规划区域：左上角标题写着“OPERATION NIGHTHAWK”；左侧栏分为 3 个部分，分别标注为“OBJECTIVE”（目标）、“TARGET”（目标对象）和“TIMELINE”（时间线）；右上角有 2 个标注的图表区域，分别为“ENTRY PLAN”（进入计划）和“CAMERA NETWORK”（监控网络）；中右下方有 4 个标注的规划区块，分别为“TRANSIT”（交通）、“EQUIPMENT”（装备）、“HOTEL ROUTE”（酒店路线）和“CONTINGENCIES”（应急预案）。包含建筑立面草图、屋顶通道图、装卸区笔记、房间标签、黑色和红色记号笔绘制的箭头，以及下方中心附近的一辆小型货车草图。房间光线温暖且阴影重重，带有琥珀色的实用照明。画面左侧展示了一盏台灯，照亮了摆满散乱文件的深色木质书桌，墙上垂直悬挂着 3 张黑白照片。构图为中远景过肩镜头，男子位于画面偏左中心，白板占据背景主导地位。高对比度，柔和的电影颗粒感，紧张的氛围，写实的质感，呈现出类似于天才策划者准备劫案的精品犯罪剧美学，但不描绘任何特定的受版权保护的角色。在右上角添加白色的“Pollo.ai”水印。

templates.title: Summer Menswear Lookbook Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季男装 Lookbook 网格图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Using the provided reference image as the same person and body base, transform it into a clean men's summer fashion lookbook on a plain warm beige studio background. Keep the subject recognizable, with the face intentionally blurred in every look, and generate 8 full-body outfit variations arranged in a 4-by-2 editorial grid. Add handwritten stylist notes with arrows labeling the key clothing items for each outfit.

Top row look 1: cream knit polo, navy tailored shorts, white leather sneakers. 
Top row look 2: sage green linen shirt, white linen shorts, brown leather sandals, sunglasses hanging from the shirt. 
Top row look 3: off-white ribbed tank, brown pleated trousers, white canvas sneakers, cream canvas tote bag over one shoulder. 
Top row look 4: light camp-collar floral shirt, light blue denim shorts, tan suede loafers. 
Bottom row look 5: white graphic tee with green "WELLNESS CLUB" text, dark green athletic shorts, white running sneakers, white crew socks, light baseball cap, canvas tote bag. 
Bottom row look 6: navy short-sleeve overshirt worn open over a white tank, beige relaxed chinos, dark brown boat shoes. 
Bottom row look 7: cream textured knit short-sleeve shirt, light wash jeans, tan wallabees, light cap. 
Bottom row look 8: black fitted tee, white linen drawstring trousers, black slide sandals, black crossbody bag.

Make it look like a polished fashion styling guide with realistic proportions, soft even lighting, minimal shadows, and elegant handwritten annotations beside each person.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图像作为人物和身体基础，将其转化为简洁的男士夏季时尚 Lookbook，背景为纯净的暖米色摄影棚背景。保持主体可辨识，每套造型中的面部均进行模糊处理，并生成 8 套全身穿搭变体，以 4x2 的编辑级网格形式排列。添加带有箭头的“手写风格”造型师笔记，标注每套穿搭的关键服饰单品。

第一行造型 1：米色针织 Polo 衫、海军蓝定制短裤、白色皮革运动鞋。
第一行造型 2：鼠尾草绿亚麻衬衫、白色亚麻短裤、棕色皮革凉鞋，衬衫上挂着太阳镜。
第一行造型 3：米白色罗纹背心、棕色百褶长裤、白色帆布运动鞋，单肩背着米色帆布托特包。
第一行造型 4：浅色古巴领印花衬衫、浅蓝色牛仔短裤、棕褐色麂皮乐福鞋。
第二行造型 5：带有绿色“WELLNESS CLUB”字样的白色印花 T 恤、深绿色运动短裤、白色跑步鞋、白色中筒袜、浅色棒球帽、帆布托特包。
第二行造型 6：海军蓝短袖外搭衬衫（敞开穿着，内搭白色背心）、米色休闲斜纹棉布裤、深棕色船鞋。
第二行造型 7：米色纹理针织短袖衬衫、浅水洗牛仔裤、棕褐色 Wallabees 鞋、浅色棒球帽。
第二行造型 8：黑色修身 T 恤、白色亚麻抽绳长裤、黑色拖鞋、黑色斜挎包。

使其呈现出精致的时尚造型指南效果，具备逼真的比例、柔和均匀的灯光、极简的阴影，并在每个人物旁添加优雅的手写注释。

templates.title: Cinematic Red Heist Team in Bank

titleLocalized.zh: 银行内电影质感的红色劫匪团队

templates.prompt: A cinematic, gritty heist-team group portrait inspired by a Spanish crime thriller, showing exactly 5 robbers standing shoulder to shoulder in a grand historic bank interior. The scene is framed symmetrically in a low-angle medium full-body shot, with the tallest figure centered in front as the leader and 2 teammates on each side. All 5 wear identical deep red hooded jumpsuits zipped up the front, black straps and backpack harnesses, and their hoods up, creating a menacing anonymous look. The far-left and far-right robbers stand with arms crossed; the second-left and second-right robbers stand with arms relaxed at their sides; the center robber stands squarely facing camera with hands down and a dominant posture. Their faces are intentionally obscured and featureless, hidden in shadow and blur beneath the hoods. The setting is an opulent old bank hall with dark polished wood, brass safety deposit boxes lining both side walls, ornate columns, balcony railings, classical architectural details, and warm globe lamps. A bright golden overhead light pours down from the ceiling behind the group, creating dramatic backlighting, rim light on the red suits, long shadows, and a tense high-contrast atmosphere. Color palette: crimson red, black, dark brown, brass, and warm gold. Style: ultra-realistic cinematic photography, suspenseful crime-drama poster aesthetic, highly detailed fabric texture, moody lighting, symmetrical composition, shallow haze in the background, sharp focus on the team. Add a white {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} logo in the top-right corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张受西班牙犯罪惊悚片启发、具有电影质感且粗粝的劫匪团队群像，画面中准确展示了 5 名劫匪并肩站在宏伟的历史银行内部。场景采用对称构图，通过低角度中景全身镜头拍摄，最高大的人物作为首领居中，两侧各站 2 名队友。5 人均穿着统一的深红色连体连帽衫，前襟拉链拉上，佩戴黑色绑带和背包背带，兜帽戴起，营造出一种充满威胁感的匿名形象。最左侧和最右侧的劫匪双臂交叉；左二和右二的劫匪双臂自然下垂；中间的劫匪正对镜头，双手下垂，姿态强势。他们的面部被刻意遮挡，隐藏在兜帽下的阴影和模糊中，无法辨认。背景是富丽堂皇的旧银行大厅，配有深色抛光木材、沿两侧墙壁排列的黄铜保险箱、华丽的圆柱、阳台栏杆、古典建筑细节以及温暖的球形灯。明亮的金色顶光从团队后方的天花板倾泻而下，营造出戏剧性的逆光效果、红色套装上的轮廓光、长长的阴影以及紧张的高对比度氛围。调色板：深红色、黑色、深棕色、黄铜色和暖金色。风格：超写实电影摄影、悬疑犯罪剧海报美学、高度精细的织物纹理、情绪化布光、对称构图、背景中带有浅薄的雾气，团队焦点清晰。在右上角添加一个白色的 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} 标志。

templates.title: Faux Pixel Raven in Wheat Field

titleLocalized.zh: 麦田里的伪像素乌鸦

templates.prompt: A stylized faux-pixel-art landscape illustration of a single {argument name="bird species" default="black raven"} standing in profile in a golden wheat field, facing right. The image should look like retro pixel art at first glance when viewed zoomed out, but not be perfectly grid-aligned or true sprite-based pixel art; instead it should feel like painterly image-generation imitating pixel art, with soft inconsistencies in the block shapes and edges. Place the bird large in the foreground, slightly left of center, with glossy near-black feathers shaded in deep navy and indigo, a dark beak, and one small amber-brown eye visible. Surround it with tall yellow-gold grasses and exactly 9 visible small purple wildflower blossoms scattered in the foreground. In the midground, show a broad rural plain with patchy fields and a dark green tree line including a few tall narrow conifers on the right. In the distance, add a low mountain range in muted blue-violet tones. Above, create a bright {argument name="sky color" default="soft blue"} sky filled with large chunky cumulus clouds and a few smaller cloud bands, all rendered in limited-color dithered blocks. Use a warm late-afternoon palette with gold, blue, lavender, and dark charcoal, strong atmospheric depth, and a calm pastoral mood. Full-frame composition, landscape orientation, thin black border around the entire image, crisp blocky edges, retro game background aesthetic, highly detailed but simple, no text, no UI, no extra animals.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅风格化的伪像素艺术风景插画，描绘了一只 {argument name="bird species" default="黑乌鸦"} 侧身站在金色的麦田中，面向右侧。当缩小查看时，图像应乍看像复古像素艺术，但并非完全网格对齐或基于精灵图的纯正像素艺术；相反，它应呈现出一种模仿像素艺术的绘画感，块状形状和边缘带有柔和的不规则感。将鸟置于前景偏左的大位置，其光泽的近黑色羽毛带有深海军蓝和靛蓝色的阴影，喙部呈深色，露出一只琥珀棕色的小眼睛。周围环绕着高大的金黄色草丛，前景中散布着 9 朵清晰可见的紫色小野花。在中景处，展示一片广阔的乡村平原，有零星的田地和深绿色的树林，右侧包括几棵高而窄的针叶树。在远处，添加一道柔和蓝紫色调的低矮山脉。上方，创作一片明亮的 {argument name="sky color" default="柔和蓝色"} 天空，布满大块的积云和几条较小的云带，全部以有限色彩的抖动块呈现。使用温暖的傍晚色调，包括金色、蓝色、薰衣草色和深炭色，具有强烈的空间深度感和宁静的田园氛围。全画幅构图，横向布局，整个图像周围有细黑边框，边缘清晰且呈块状，复古游戏背景美学，高度细节化但简洁，无文字，无 UI，无其他动物。

templates.title: Zoomed Fake Pixel Art Grid Analysis

titleLocalized.zh: 伪像素艺术网格放大分析

templates.prompt: A tightly zoomed-in comparison image demonstrating fake pixel-art rendering, showing a low-resolution-looking scene enlarged on screen with a thin bright blue square grid overlay across the entire frame. The composition is an abstract close crop of a pixel-art-style environment: sandy tan and ochre blocky forms on the left and center, a dark navy and black stepped diagonal mass on the right, muted olive-green and slate-blue shapes along the upper background, and a few lighter golden highlights. Every edge looks staircase-like and blocky at first glance, but the colors softly blur and blend within the apparent squares instead of aligning perfectly to the grid, creating the impression of pixel art that breaks down under inspection. Include a small white crosshair cursor near the upper left quadrant to suggest image analysis in an editor. The overall look should feel like a screenshot from a graphics program or social media demonstration about how AI can imitate retro game art aesthetics without producing true grid-perfect pixel art, with no text labels visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张经过紧密放大的对比图像，展示了伪像素艺术的渲染效果。画面呈现了一个低分辨率场景的放大视图，并在整个帧上叠加了细细的亮蓝色方形网格。构图是像素艺术风格环境的抽象局部特写：左侧和中心为沙褐色和赭色的块状形态，右侧为深海军蓝和黑色的阶梯状对角线块，背景上方为柔和的橄榄绿和板岩蓝形状，并点缀着少量较亮的金色高光。乍看之下，每个边缘都呈阶梯状且具有块状感，但颜色在明显的方格内呈现出柔和的模糊与融合，而非与网格完美对齐，从而营造出一种经不起仔细推敲的像素艺术假象。在左上象限附近包含一个小型的白色十字准星光标，以暗示编辑器中的图像分析过程。整体观感应类似于图形程序或社交媒体演示的截图，旨在说明 AI 如何在无法生成真正网格完美的像素艺术的情况下，模仿复古游戏艺术的美学，画面中不应包含任何可见的文字标签。

templates.title: Empty Fort Strategy at the City Gate

titleLocalized.zh: 空城计

templates.prompt: A cinematic historical Chinese scene depicting the Empty Fort Strategy at dawn, viewed from outside a massive ancient city gate. In the foreground, a dark armored general on horseback, seen from behind in a flowing black cape, pauses with several spear-bearing soldiers and banners, facing the open gate in suspicion. The huge wooden gate doors stand fully open, revealing a long stone-paved street inside the city. Exactly 6 townspeople are visible inside, calmly sweeping the street with brooms, spaced along the road, creating an eerie sense of normalcy. Above the gate, on a timber balcony of a traditional tiled gatehouse, a calm strategist in white robes and a tall scholar’s headdress sits behind a guqin table, with a small incense burner sending up thin smoke. Exactly 3 attendants stand around him on the balcony. The city walls are built of aged gray stone, and ranks of soldiers with upright spears line the battlements in the background. Use authentic Three Kingdoms era architecture, weathered wood, layered roof tiles, muted earth tones, soft golden morning light, distant misty mountains, long shadows, atmospheric haze, ultra-detailed textures, dramatic vertical composition, epic historical realism, cinematic framing, and a tense, quiet mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具电影感的中国历史场景，描绘了黎明时分的“空城计”，视角从巨大的古代城门外望去。前景中，一位身披黑色斗篷的暗甲将军骑在马上，背影示人，他与几名持矛士兵及旗手停下脚步，疑虑地注视着敞开的城门。巨大的木质城门大开，露出城内长长的石板街道。城内清晰可见 6 名平民，他们正从容地扫着地，沿街道分布，营造出一种诡异的平静感。城门上方，在传统瓦顶城楼的木质露台上，一位身着白袍、头戴高冠的谋士正从容地坐在古琴桌后，桌上香炉升起缕缕青烟。露台上还有 3 名侍从环绕在他身边。城墙由古老的灰石砌成，背景中的城垛上排列着手持长矛的士兵。采用真实的三国时代建筑风格、风化的木材、层叠的瓦片、柔和的大地色调、清晨的金色暖光、远处的朦胧山峦、长长的阴影、大气层雾气、超精细纹理、极具戏剧性的纵向构图、史诗般的历史写实感、电影级取景，以及紧张而静谧的氛围。

templates.title: Peach Garden Oath Cinematic Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 桃园结义电影感场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic historical scene from Romance of the Three Kingdoms showing the {argument name="scene name" default="Peach Garden Oath"}. Three ancient Chinese men stand side by side behind a ceremonial altar table in a blooming orchard of pink peach blossoms, each holding a respectful fist-and-palm salute at chest height. The man on the left is broad and heavily built, wearing dark lamellar armor with a deep red robe panel and rugged warrior styling; the man in the center is shorter and slimmer, wearing layered brown scholar-official robes and a simple topknot; the man on the right is tall and imposing, wearing flowing dark green robes with armor details, a long black beard, and a noble commanding presence. In front of them is one large carved wooden altar table arranged with exactly 10 ritual elements: 1 bronze incense burner in the center with three lit incense sticks and visible curling smoke, 4 bronze candlesticks with small flames placed near the corners, 1 fruit plate with peaches, 1 ewer or wine vessel on the left, 2 bronze pouring vessels on the right, and 1 open scroll laid across the tabletop. Pink petals drift through the air and scatter on the ground. The orchard forms a tunnel of flowering branches overhead, with rustic wooden fencing and traditional buildings softly visible in the background through light spring haze. Include exactly 2 horses flanking the group: a dark horse on the far left and a white horse on the far right, both saddled and calm. Composition is symmetrical, eye-level, centered on the oath ritual, with rich period textures, realistic faces and fabrics, soft natural morning light, shallow atmospheric depth, and an epic, reverent, painterly-cinematic realism in the style of a prestige historical drama.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅来自《三国演义》的电影感历史场景，展示了 {argument name="scene name" default="桃园结义"}。三位中国古代男子并肩站在盛开的粉色桃花林中的祭坛桌后，每人都在胸前行抱拳礼。左侧男子身材魁梧，身穿深色札甲，内衬深红色长袍，造型粗犷威武；中间男子身材较矮瘦，身穿多层棕色文官长袍，梳着简单的发髻；右侧男子身材高大威严，身穿飘逸的深绿色长袍，带有盔甲细节，留着长长的黑胡须，气宇轩昂。他们面前是一张大型雕花木祭坛桌，上面摆放着 10 件仪式用品：中间 1 个青铜香炉，插着三支点燃的香，烟雾缭绕；角落处放置 4 支点燃的小蜡烛；1 个放着桃子的果盘；左侧 1 个酒壶；右侧 2 个青铜斟酒器；以及桌面上摊开的 1 卷书简。粉色的花瓣在空中飘落，散落在地面上。头顶的桃花枝形成了一条花海隧道，背景在春日的薄雾中隐约可见质朴的木栅栏和传统建筑。画面两侧各配有 1 匹马：最左侧为黑马，最右侧为白马，两匹马均已备鞍，神态安详。构图对称，平视视角，以结义仪式为中心，呈现出丰富的时代质感、写实的人物面部与织物纹理、柔和的自然晨光、浅景深效果，以及如同史诗级历史剧般庄重、具有绘画感的电影级写实风格。

templates.title: Burning Red Cliffs Night Battle

titleLocalized.zh: 赤壁之战夜战

templates.prompt: A monumental cinematic historical painting of the Battle of Red Cliffs at night, showing an entire ancient Chinese river fleet consumed by fire. The composition is a tall vertical frame viewed from a slightly elevated dockside angle, with the river running deep into the center distance and packed with burning warships. Count exactly 3 dominant foreground raft-like platforms or deck structures on the lower left and center foreground, each made of rough timber and engulfed in flames, with soldiers standing shoulder to shoulder among drums, poles, and red battle flags. Count exactly 2 mounted commanders in the lower right foreground galloping toward the viewer along a wooden pier or bridge: the front rider is sharply visible, wearing dark lamellar armor and a wind-whipped deep red cloak, shouting with urgency; the second rider beside him is darker and partially obscured. Across the middle ground, count dozens of ancient Chinese sail warships and smaller boats, many already burning, with traditional battened sails, wooden hulls, siege-like superstructures, and collapsing masts. The far shoreline and fleet form a continuous inferno, with towering sheets of orange flame, black-red smoke clouds filling the sky, and countless sparks and embers blowing through the air. The water reflects molten orange firelight with streaks of black shadow between ships. Fill the image with dense soldiers, rigging, banners, drums, weapons, and chaotic battlefield detail, but keep the overall readability centered on the river of fire. Use a dark, dramatic palette of black, ember red, burnt orange, and bronze, with intense high-contrast firelight, volumetric smoke, epic scale, ultra-detailed textures, dynamic motion, and the grandeur of a legendary Three Kingdoms scene. Historical Chinese warfare aesthetic, grim, heroic, catastrophic, painterly realism, no modern elements, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅宏大的电影感历史画作，描绘了赤壁之战的夜晚，展现了整支中国古代江上舰队被烈火吞噬的场景。构图采用高耸的竖构图，视角从略微升高的码头侧面俯瞰，河流向中心远方延伸，江面上挤满了燃烧的战舰。画面左下角和中心前景处需精确包含 3 个显眼的前景木筏状平台或甲板结构，均由粗糙木材制成并被火焰包围，士兵们肩并肩站立，周围环绕着战鼓、旗杆和红色战旗。画面右下角前景处需精确包含 2 名骑马的指挥官，正沿着木质码头或桥梁向观众疾驰而来：前方的骑手清晰可见，身穿深色札甲，披着被风吹起的深红色披风，正急切地呼喊；身旁的第二名骑手身形较暗，部分被遮挡。在中景处，包含数十艘中国古代帆船战舰和小型船只，许多已经起火，展现出传统的硬帆、木质船体、攻城塔楼般的上层建筑以及倒塌的桅杆。远处的岸线与舰队连成一片火海，冲天的橙色火焰和黑红色的烟云填满了天空，无数火星和灰烬在空中飘散。水面反射着熔岩般的橙色火光，船只之间交织着黑色的阴影。画面中应充满密集的士兵、索具、旗帜、战鼓、武器和混乱的战场细节，但整体视觉重点应保持在火光冲天的河流上。采用黑色、余烬红、焦橙色和青铜色的深沉戏剧性色调，呈现强烈的高对比度火光、体积感烟雾、史诗般的尺度、超精细的纹理、动态感以及三国传奇场景的宏大感。中国古代战争美学，冷峻、英勇、灾难性、写实绘画风格，无现代元素，无文字。

templates.title: Borrowing Arrows with Straw Boats

titleLocalized.zh: 草船借箭

templates.prompt: A cinematic historical war scene from Romance of the Three Kingdoms depicting the straw boat borrowing arrows on a wide gray river during a violent rainstorm, viewed from a slightly elevated front angle. In the foreground, a convoy of 6 narrow wooden boats is lashed together in a line, each boat wrapped thickly with dense bundles of straw along the sides and bow, creating rough protective walls. Hundreds of black-feathered arrows are embedded all over the straw armor, sticking out in every direction, with more arrows flying diagonally through the air in heavy wind and rain. The lead boat dominates the frame; its cabin is covered with dark blue fabric curtains and blue roof panels. Standing calmly inside the front cabin are 2 robed ancient Chinese strategists, one in a pale white robe holding a feather fan and one darker-robed companion beside him, both composed and unhurried amid the chaos. Along the left side of the boats are clustered oarsmen and soldiers in dark period clothing, with several large war drums visible on the decks. In the background across the river, a massive enemy river fleet fills the misty distance: dozens of tall wooden warships, watchtowers, and platforms crowded with troops and archers. Multiple military banners bearing the single large Chinese character "曹" rise above the fleet, indicating Cao Cao's forces. The atmosphere is cold, desaturated, and epic, with fog, smoke, rain streaks, rough water, low contrast blue-gray lighting, and highly detailed realistic textures in wet wood, straw, fabric, and river spray. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic ancient Chinese battlefield tableau, dramatic scale, moody historical realism, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅来自《三国演义》的电影级历史战争场景，描绘了在狂风暴雨中，宽阔灰暗的江面上进行“草船借箭”的画面，视角为略微俯视的前方视角。前景中，6 艘狭长的木船首尾相连，每艘船的侧面和船头都紧密包裹着厚厚的草束，形成了粗糙的防御墙。数百支黑羽箭密密麻麻地插在草束护甲上，向四面八方伸出，更多的箭矢在狂风暴雨中斜向飞过。领头的船只占据了画面中心；其船舱覆盖着深蓝色的布帘和蓝色顶棚。前舱内，两位身着长袍的中国古代谋士神态自若地站立着，其中一人身着浅白色长袍，手持羽扇，身旁伴着一位身着深色长袍的同伴，两人在混乱中显得从容不迫。船只左侧聚集着身穿深色古装的桨手和士兵，甲板上可见几面巨大的战鼓。背景中，江对岸是密布在雾气中的庞大敌军舰队：数十艘高大的木制战舰、望楼和平台上挤满了军队和弓箭手。多面印有巨大“曹”字的军旗在舰队上方飘扬，象征着曹操的军队。整体氛围冷峻、低饱和且宏大，伴有浓雾、烟尘、雨丝、汹涌的江水、低对比度的蓝灰色调，以及湿木、稻草、织物和江面水雾的高细节写实质感。超精细、写实的中国古代战场画面，宏大的规模，沉郁的历史真实感，竖构图。

templates.prompt:
Create a premium Japanese plastic model kit product-poster layout on a clean white studio background with subtle gray gradients and a glossy floor reflection. The main subject is a highly detailed anime mecha schoolgirl figure posed dynamically in the center-left, in a wide combat stance, holding a katana horizontally across the frame with one robotic hand gripping the hilt and the other making a peace sign near her face. The character has a blurred face area, short dark navy-blue hair in a tousled bob with small side strands, and gold horn-like mechanical hair ornaments. Her outfit is a fusion of a Japanese high school sailor uniform and hard-surface sci-fi armor: white armored torso with mechanical panel lines, a red sailor neckerchief, a pleated navy skirt, bulky white armored thighs and shins, red and blue accent parts, gold circular joint details, a dark blue waist ribbon or back cloth, and red mechanical backpack-like attachments at the hips and lower back. The katana has a dark blade and a blue-and-gold wrapped handle. Render the figure like a professionally photographed collectible model or action plastic kit, with sharp material definition, realistic molded plastic surfaces, slight satin sheen, and commercial product-shot lighting.

Design the page as a figure advertisement/spec sheet with exactly 1 large hero image and 5 smaller detail panels stacked vertically on the right. The 5 right-side panels must show: 1) close-up of the head and hair ornaments, 2) upper-body torso detail with sailor scarf and chest armor, 3) weapon and articulated hand close-up with the sword near the face, 4) waist attachment and skirt/hip armor detail, 5) leg detail close-up showing joints and armor construction. Include thin blue divider accents around the right-side panel area.

At the top left, place a large Japanese title in bold serif-like characters reading "女子甲生", with the middle character in dark red and the others in dark navy. Beneath it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle line: "— メカ × 少女 × 青春 —". On the upper right, place a sleek logo and brand name reading "{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}" with small Japanese text beneath it. Add a vertical Japanese slogan block on the left side of the hero figure reading "鋼に咲く、乙女の意志。" with the middle phrase in red. Add Japanese captions beneath each of the 5 right-side detail panels: "表情造形", "上半身ディテール", "武装・可動手", "腰部アタッチメント", "脚部ディテール". In the lower left, include a boxed scale label reading "{argument name="scale label" default="1/12 SCALE"}" and nearby English product text reading "FULL ACTION PLASTIC MODEL KIT". Add two small bullet lines in Japanese beneath that: "◆ 塗装済み髪パーツ付属" and "◆ マーキングデカール付属". Across the bottom, add a dark navy footer band with the brand logo and "{argument name="footer brand" default="TENNEN"}" centered, plus small Japanese text below.

Use a polished modern hobby-brand aesthetic, Japanese mecha-girl collectible packaging design, minimal white negative space, crisp typography, balanced editorial layout, and realistic studio-photo rendering of a non-existent original figure. Color palette: white, navy blue, dark blue, red, gray, black, and metallic gold. Aspect ratio 3:4.

promptLocalized.zh:
在干净的白色摄影棚背景下，创作一张高级日系塑料模型套件产品海报，背景带有微妙的灰色渐变和光亮的地面反射。主体是一个高度精细的动漫机甲女高中生手办，位于画面中左侧，呈动态姿势，双腿大开呈战斗站姿，一只机械手握住武士刀横跨画面，另一只手在脸部附近比出剪刀手。角色面部区域模糊，留着凌乱的深海军蓝短波波头，带有小撮侧发，并佩戴金色的角状机械发饰。她的服装融合了日式水手服与硬表面科幻装甲：白色装甲躯干带有机械刻线，红色水手领巾，百褶海军蓝短裙，厚重的白色大腿和小腿装甲，红蓝配色点缀，金色圆形关节细节，深蓝色腰带或后摆布料，以及臀部和后腰处红色的机械背包式附件。武士刀配有深色刀刃和蓝金相间的刀柄。将该手办渲染成专业拍摄的收藏级模型或塑料拼装套件，具有清晰的材质定义、逼真的注塑塑料表面、轻微的丝缎光泽以及商业产品摄影灯光。

将页面设计为手办广告/规格说明书，右侧垂直堆叠 1 个大型主视觉图和 5 个较小的细节面板。右侧的 5 个面板必须展示：1) 头部和发饰特写，2) 带有水手领巾和胸部装甲的上半身细节，3) 武器和带有可动关节的手部特写（剑靠近脸部），4) 腰部附件和裙子/臀部装甲细节，5) 展示关节和装甲结构的腿部细节。在右侧面板区域周围加入细蓝色的分隔装饰。

在左上角放置一个醒目的粗体衬线风格日文标题“女子甲生”，其中中间的字符为深红色，其余为深海军蓝色。在其下方添加一行较小的日文副标题：“— メカ × 少女 × 青春 —”。在右上角放置一个简洁的标志和品牌名称“{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}”，下方配以小型日文文本。在主视觉形象的左侧添加一个垂直的日文标语块，内容为“鋼に咲く、乙女の意志。”，中间短语为红色。在右侧 5 个细节面板下方分别添加日文说明：“表情造形”、“上半身ディテール”、“武装・可動手”、“腰部アタッチメント”、“脚部ディテール”。在左下角包含一个带框的比例标签“{argument name="scale label" default="1/12 SCALE"}”，并在附近添加英文产品文本“FULL ACTION PLASTIC MODEL KIT”。在下方添加两行日文要点：“◆ 塗装済み髪パーツ付属”和“◆ マーキングデカール付属”。在底部添加一个深海军蓝色的页脚栏，居中放置品牌标志和“{argument name="footer brand" default="TENNEN"}”，下方配以小型日文文本。

采用精致的现代模型品牌美学、日系机甲少女收藏品包装设计、极简的白色留白、清晰的排版、平衡的编辑布局，以及对不存在的原创手办进行逼真的摄影棚渲染。配色方案：白色、海军蓝、深蓝、红色、灰色、黑色和金属金。长宽比 3:4。

The layout should look like a luxury hobby product introduction page for an original anime/mecha statue. The main centerpiece is a highly detailed 1/7 scale-style figure of {argument name="character name" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, a slim teenage anime girl in a dramatic crouching attack pose, turned three-quarters to the viewer, with one knee bent under her body and the other mechanical leg planted forward. She raises a katana overhead with both hands as if about to strike. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur block. She has long brown hair with loose strands flying outward, a white headband with a small mechanical side ornament, and a navy Japanese sailor school uniform with a cropped long-sleeve top, red neckerchief, short pleated skirt, and exposed midriff. Her arms and legs are mostly robotic: metallic silver-gray mechanical arms with articulated fingers and visible joints, bulky armored mech thighs and calves with realistic pistons, seams, weathering, and small orange caution markings. The sword is a polished katana with a white-and-black wrapped handle and a metallic guard. Render the statue as a realistic painted collectible figure with studio lighting, glossy and matte material contrast, precise shadows, and showroom-grade product photography.

Design the page like a commercial figure brochure with exactly 5 numbered detail callout sections. On the left side, stack 4 rectangular close-up panels vertically, each with a number and Japanese label plus short descriptive body text in Japanese: panel 1 shows a close-up of the face and hair, labeled "01 表情"; panel 2 shows the upper torso and uniform, labeled "02 上半身"; panel 3 shows the raised mechanical arms and sword grip, labeled "03 メカアーム&ソード"; panel 4 shows the mechanical legs, labeled "04 メカレッグ". At the bottom right, add a wider rectangular panel labeled "05 武装・ディテール" showing exactly 2 katana close-up views arranged horizontally, one above the other. Keep all panel images bordered lightly and integrated into the poster layout.

At the upper left, place a large expressive brush-calligraphy title reading {argument name="main title" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}, with an ink-brush circle motif behind the first word. At the upper right, add a gold minimalist logo and the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}, with small Japanese tagline text beneath it. Along the right side, place a vertical Japanese promotional slogan in elegant dark text. In the lower left area, include small product specification text in Japanese with exactly these lines of product info styling: scale, product name, sculptor credit, paint credit, brand, and a release date line. Use {argument name="release date" default="2025年12月"} in the schedule area. Along the bottom, add a dark horizontal footer bar with the gold brand logo on the left, the brand name repeated, a short Japanese brand statement in small text across the center, and tiny legal/disclaimer text at the far right. Overall style: high-end Japanese figure marketing sheet, refined editorial composition, realistic collectible statue photography, elegant white-and-gold packaging aesthetic, anime girl fused with hard-surface mecha design, polished and premium.

在干净的米白色背景上创作一张高端日式手办广告海报，背景带有微妙的浅灰色笔触纹理和零星的细小金箔点缀。排版应呈现出原创动漫/机甲雕像的高端兴趣产品介绍页风格。画面中心是一个高度精细的 1/7 比例风格手办 {argument name="character name" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}，一位身材苗条的动漫少女正处于戏剧性的蹲姿攻击状态，身体侧向观众，一膝弯曲在身下，另一条机械腿向前跨出。她双手将武士刀高举过头顶，仿佛即将发动攻击。她的面部被一个柔和的方形模糊块刻意遮挡。她留着棕色长发，发丝凌乱飞舞，佩戴着带有小型机械侧饰的白色发带，身穿海军风日本水手校服，包括短款长袖上衣、红色领巾、短百褶裙，并露出腰部。她的四肢大部分为机械结构：金属银灰色机械手臂，手指关节清晰可见；厚重的装甲机甲大腿和小腿，带有逼真的活塞、接缝、风化效果和细小的橙色警示标志。手中的武士刀经过抛光处理，配有黑白缠绕的刀柄和金属刀镡。将雕像渲染为具有摄影棚灯光、亮面与哑光材质对比、精确阴影以及展厅级产品摄影效果的逼真涂装收藏品。

将页面设计成商业手办宣传册，包含 5 个带编号的细节标注区域。在左侧垂直堆叠 4 个长方形特写面板，每个面板配有编号、日文标签以及简短的日文描述文本：面板 1 展示面部和头发特写，标注为“01 表情”；面板 2 展示上半身和制服，标注为“02 上半身”；面板 3 展示抬起的机械手臂和握剑姿态，标注为“03 メカアーム&ソード”；面板 4 展示机械腿部，标注为“04 メカレッグ”。在右下角，添加一个更宽的长方形面板，标注为“05 武装・ディテール”，水平排列展示 2 个武士刀特写视图，上下叠放。所有面板图像均需带有轻微边框，并融入海报整体布局中。

在左上角放置一个富有表现力的书法大标题 {argument name="main title" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}，第一个词后方带有水墨圆圈图案。在右上角添加一个金色极简 Logo 和品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}，下方配有简短的日文标语。在右侧放置一条优雅的深色日文宣传口号。在左下角区域，包含简短的日文产品规格文本，严格按照以下产品信息样式：比例、产品名称、原型师、涂装师、品牌以及发布日期行。在排期区域使用 {argument name="release date" default="2025年12月"}。在底部添加一个深色水平页脚栏，左侧放置金色品牌 Logo，重复品牌名称，中间放置简短的日文品牌声明，最右侧放置极小的法律/免责声明文本。整体风格：高端日式手办营销页，精致的编辑排版，逼真的收藏级雕像摄影，优雅的白金包装美学，动漫少女与硬核机甲设计的融合，精致且高端。

templates.title: Juventus Yamal Transfer Poster

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical football poster for {argument name="player name" default="Yamal"} in a Juventus transfer-announcement style, ultra-detailed, high-contrast, black-and-white with metallic gold accents, gritty premium sports graphic design. The composition has 2 visible portraits of the same young male footballer with dark brown skin and short tight curly hair: one large upper-body rear three-quarter portrait dominating the top half, wearing a glossy white Juventus jersey with the name {argument name="jersey name" default="YAMAL"} printed large across the back, head turned slightly left so one ear and partial cheek are visible; and one full-body action pose in the lower center, arms spread wide while running or celebrating, wearing the modern Juventus home kit with black-and-white vertical stripes, white shorts with the number {argument name="squad number" default="19"}, white socks, and light-colored boots with a subtle pink accent on the sole. Keep the face areas softly obscured and non-detailed. Use a dark moody background with layered architectural imagery of Turin, including 3 landmark elements: a faint domed historic building on the left mid-background, a tall tower resembling Mole Antonelliana on the lower right, and a shadowy stadium structure across the lower middle. Add 3 Juventus logos: one small white logo at the top left, one large translucent logo integrated into the upper right background, and one medium white logo at the bottom right. Add bold typography and editorial layout elements: the word {argument name="main vertical text" default="YAMAL"} set vertically in huge white condensed sans-serif letters along the left side, small vertical gold text reading "JUVENTUS FOOTBALL CLUB" beside it, gold text on the right reading {argument name="side name text" default="YAMAL"} above the large gold number "19", a gold signature scribble below, the slogan "FINO ALLA FINE" stacked in gold on the lower left, "JUVENTUS" in small white text beneath it, and small coordinate text at the bottom left reading "45.0703° N, 7.6869° E" and "TORINO, ITALIA". The jersey on the action figure should include visible sponsor and badge details: Juventus crest with 3 stars, Adidas logo, Jeep sponsor, a circular tricolor badge on the chest, and a black sleeve patch reading "azimut". Add energetic white paint streaks and brush slashes in 3 main areas: upper right, lower center near the kicking leg, and subtle scratches on the left edge. Include marble-like black texture panels, gold star accents, faint chevrons, and smoky atmosphere. Lighting should be cinematic with rim light on the player, glossy fabric highlights, sharp contrast, and a premium transfer-poster aesthetic suitable for a social media football announcement.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具张力的竖版足球海报，主角为 {argument name="player name" default="Yamal"}，采用尤文图斯转会官宣风格，超高细节，高对比度，黑白配色搭配金属金色点缀，呈现粗犷的高级体育图形设计感。构图包含 2 个同一位深褐色皮肤、短卷发年轻男足球员的肖像：上方为半身侧后方大肖像，占据上半部分，身穿印有 {argument name="jersey name" default="YAMAL"} 字样的亮面白色尤文图斯球衣，头部微向左转，露出部分耳朵和脸颊；下方中央为全身动作姿态，双臂张开奔跑或庆祝，身穿现代尤文图斯主场黑白竖条纹球衣，白色短裤印有号码 {argument name="squad number" default="19"}，白色球袜，浅色球鞋鞋底带有微妙的粉色点缀。面部区域保持柔和模糊，不作细节处理。背景采用深色调，叠加都灵的建筑影像，包含 3 个地标元素：左侧中景处隐约可见的圆顶历史建筑，右下方类似安托内利尖塔（Mole Antonelliana）的高塔，以及横跨中下方的阴影体育场结构。添加 3 个尤文图斯标志：左上角一个小白色标志，右上角背景中一个巨大的半透明标志，右下角一个中等大小的白色标志。加入醒目的排版和编辑布局元素：单词 {argument name="main vertical text" default="YAMAL"} 以巨大的白色压缩无衬线字体垂直排列在左侧，旁边是小号垂直金色文字“JUVENTUS FOOTBALL CLUB”，右侧金色文字 {argument name="side name text" default="YAMAL"} 位于大号金色数字“19”上方，下方带有金色签名涂鸦，左下角堆叠金色口号“FINO ALLA FINE”，下方有小号白色文字“JUVENTUS”，左下角坐标文字为“45.0703° N, 7.6869° E”和“TORINO, ITALIA”。动作人物的球衣应包含清晰的赞助商和徽章细节：带有 3 颗星的尤文图斯队徽、Adidas 标志、Jeep 赞助商、胸前的圆形三色徽章，以及袖口印有“azimut”的黑色臂章。在 3 个主要区域添加充满活力的白色油漆条纹和笔触：右上角、下部靠近踢球腿的位置，以及左侧边缘的细微划痕。包含大理石质感的黑色面板、金色星星装饰、淡淡的 V 字纹和烟雾氛围。灯光应呈现电影质感，球员带有轮廓光，球衣面料具有光泽感，对比强烈，打造出适合社交媒体足球官宣的高级转会海报美学。

He wears a modern AC Milan home kit: black and red vertical striped shirt, black shorts with the number 10, black socks, dark football boots, visible Puma logos, the AC Milan crest, and the chest sponsor text "Emirates Fly Better." In the background place 3 major graphic elements: the red-tinted gothic Duomo di Milano cathedral silhouette on the left, a large glowing AC Milan circular crest on the right, and oversized semi-transparent numerals "10" behind the running figure. promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版足球转会官宣海报，主角为 {argument name="player name" default="Kylian Mbappé"}，采用高端体育社交媒体图形设计风格。构图包含同一球员的两个视角：背景右上角是一个巨大的背影半身像，展示了黑红条纹 AC Milan 球衣的背面，肩部印有名字及醒目的 10 号数字；前景是一个全身动作姿态，球员正向观众奔跑，单手举起并食指向上。球员为一名年轻的黑人男性运动员，留着短发，体格强壮。他身穿现代 AC Milan 主场球衣：黑红竖条纹上衣、印有 10 号的黑色短裤、黑色球袜、深色足球鞋，清晰可见 Puma 标志、AC Milan 队徽以及胸前赞助商文字“Emirates Fly Better”。色调采用黑色、深红色和暗红色，对比强烈，营造出烟雾缭绕的氛围，地面附近有发光的红色雾气、散落的火星、淡淡的划痕以及电影级的轮廓光。背景中放置 3 个主要的图形元素：左侧是呈现红色的哥特式米兰大教堂（Duomo di Milano）剪影，右侧是一个巨大的发光 AC Milan 圆形队徽，奔跑的人物身后是超大的半透明数字“10”。添加融入海报的编辑排版：左上角放置“AC MILAN”，下方标注“1899”及一个小队徽；左侧中心位置，上方小字书写名字，下方是大号的高衬线字体姓氏“MBAPPÉ”，其下添加红色的手写签名式涂鸦；右上角边缘放置竖排标语“SEMPRE SEMPRE MILAN”。整体风格应体现精英足球海报设计感，呈现转会揭幕活动的艺术效果，光泽感强、风格激进、现代，具备照片级真实感与平面设计合成效果，布料纹理细节丰富，阴影处理富有戏剧性，并具有高端欧冠宣传的美学质感。 --ar 9:16

templates.title: Vintage Fantasy Postcard of Beacon Hollow

titleLocalized.zh: Beacon Hollow 复古奇幻明信片

templates.prompt: Create a vintage fantasy travel postcard poster for {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"}, designed like a large-letter souvenir postcard from the 1950s–1960s. The composition is a single richly detailed horizontal scene with heavily weathered paper texture, rounded postcard corners, faded inks, creases, scratches, foxing, and worn edges. Across the top and center, huge dimensional block letters spell “BEACON HOLLOW” in classic retro postcard style, with warm cream outlines and red-brown extruded shadows; each letter contains miniature painted scenic vignettes of the destination, including alpine peaks, waterfalls, pine forests, a magical manor, glowing towers, and valley landscapes. In the upper left, hand-painted script text reads “GREETINGS FROM” in dark red. In the upper right, include a circular black postal cancellation stamp reading “BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT,” overlapping a vintage postage stamp labeled “BEACON HOLLOW” and “CREATIVE RETREAT” with “7c,” depicting a moonlit mountain and a lighthouse-like beacon tower. Beneath the title, place a small curved ribbon banner reading {argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh destination"} with tiny compass-star ornaments. The main background should show a majestic golden-hour mountain valley with a winding river, distant snowy peaks, dense evergreen forests, and on the right a large timber-and-stone fantasy lodge perched on a cliff, warmly lit from within, with stairs descending the slope. Scatter subtle magical blue lights and faint arcane circular glyphs around the lodge and foreground for a worldbuilding-meets-magic atmosphere. In the lower left, place exactly 3 foreground desk objects: a dark ceramic mug with a compass emblem, an open sketchbook spread, and a fountain pen resting diagonally across the pages. The left page of the sketchbook is titled “Campaign Ideas” and lists 3 bullets: “The Forgotten Vale,” “Clockwork Pilgrims,” and “Echoes of the First Light,” with a small castle drawing below; the right page shows a tree illustration and the handwritten text “Beery world Hollow.” Across the lower center, add an old illustrated map spread out on the table, showing mountain icons and hand-drawn cartographic details. In the lower right, place exactly 5 more foreground elements: a closed leather journal embossed with a star compass and the phrase “Ideas Become Legends,” a cluster of 4 polyhedral dice, a rustic wooden signpost with 4 directional slats reading “STORY,” “GAME DESIGN,” “WORLD BUILDING,” and “AI FOR CREATORS,” a glowing glass lamp or tube device, and a nearby floating arcane target-like sigil. Add a pinned handwritten note left of center on aged paper reading, “Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures. — {argument name="signature name" default="magejosh"}” in blue cursive. Use painterly illustration with high detail, nostalgic Americana postcard design, fantasy concept art sensibility, warm sunset lighting, muted teal sky, sepia aging, and an inviting creative-retreat mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张关于 {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"} 的复古奇幻旅行明信片海报，设计风格参考 20 世纪 50 年代至 60 年代的大字纪念明信片。构图为单幅细节丰富的横向场景，带有严重的纸张风化纹理、圆角明信片边缘、褪色的油墨、折痕、划痕、霉斑和磨损边缘。在顶部和中心，巨大的立体块状字母拼写出“BEACON HOLLOW”，采用经典的复古明信片风格，带有温暖的奶油色轮廓和红棕色浮雕阴影；每个字母内都包含目的地的小型风景插画，包括高山峰峦、瀑布、松林、魔法庄园、发光的塔楼和山谷景观。左上角有深红色的手绘草书文字“GREETINGS FROM”。右上角包含一个圆形的黑色邮戳，上面写着“BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT”，并覆盖在一张标有“BEACON HOLLOW”和“CREATIVE RETREAT”以及“7c”的复古邮票上，邮票描绘了月光下的山脉和灯塔般的信标塔。在标题下方，放置一条弯曲的小丝带横幅，上面写着 {argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh destination"}，并带有微小的罗盘星装饰。主体背景应展示一个壮丽的黄金时刻山谷，有蜿蜒的河流、远处的雪峰、茂密的常绿森林，右侧悬崖上坐落着一座巨大的木石结构奇幻小屋，内部灯火通明，楼梯沿坡而下。在小屋和前景周围散布微妙的魔法蓝光和淡淡的奥术圆形符号，营造出世界观构建与魔法交织的氛围。左下角放置 3 个前景桌面物品：一个带有罗盘标志的深色陶瓷马克杯、一本打开的素描本，以及一支斜放在页面上的钢笔。素描本左页标题为“Campaign Ideas”，列出 3 个要点：“The Forgotten Vale”、“Clockwork Pilgrims”和“Echoes of the First Light”，下方有一幅小城堡画；右页展示了一幅树木插图和手写文字“Beery world Hollow”。在底部中心，添加一张铺在桌上的旧地图，显示山脉图标和手绘地图细节。右下角放置 5 个前景元素：一本压印有星形罗盘和短语“Ideas Become Legends”的封闭式皮革日志、一堆 4 颗多面骰子、一个质朴的木制路标，上面有 4 个方向条，分别写着“STORY”、“GAME DESIGN”、“WORLD BUILDING”和“AI FOR CREATORS”、一个发光的玻璃灯或管状装置，以及附近一个漂浮的奥术靶心符号。在中心偏左处钉上一张写在陈旧纸张上的手写便条，用蓝色草书写着：“Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures. — {argument name="signature name" default="magejosh"}”。采用绘画风格，细节丰富，具有怀旧的美国明信片设计感、奇幻概念艺术感、温暖的日落光影、柔和的青色天空、深褐色陈旧感以及引人入胜的创意静修氛围。

templates.title: Inter Milan Transfer Poster

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical football transfer announcement poster for {argument name="player name" default="Erling Haaland"} joining {argument name="club name" default="Inter Milan"}, designed in a dark, high-contrast black and electric-blue palette with a gritty cinematic sports-graphic style. The composition features 2 layered portraits of the same player: one oversized close-up bust in the upper center-left, turned in profile and looking upward, showing slick blond hair tied into a short bun with shaved sides; and 1 mid-body action portrait in the lower center, wearing the club’s blue-and-black striped home jersey and raising one index finger upward in a victory gesture. Use a muscular athletic build, intense heroic presence, rim lighting, deep shadows, textured skin detail, and glossy hair highlights. The jersey should include a white sponsor wordmark across the chest, a small white swoosh-style logo, the round club crest, and a tricolor shield patch. Behind the player, place a huge glowing circular Inter-style emblem graphic as a backdrop. Add 3 visible club logos total: 1 small logo at the top right, 1 large fabric flag logo at the bottom left, and 1 crest on the shirt. At the bottom center, include a night view of a modern football stadium with bright floodlights, blending into painterly blue smoke and brush-stroke effects. Across the center, place the player surname in huge rough hand-painted lettering, partially obscured by the figure, plus a large handwritten-style number 9 on the right. Add 8 text elements around the design: top center small text “INTER MILAN”; upper left stacked name text with the player name and a blue “9”; left-middle slogan “NATO PER SEGNARE”; right side vertical text “I M INTER”; right-middle slogan “FORZA INTER PER SEMPRE”; lower right city text “SAN SIRO”; lower right small text “MILANO ITALIA”; bottom center small text “1908” and “LA BENEAMATA”. Also add 1 white signature scribble near the upper-left portrait. The background should be a layered collage of black grunge textures, blue ink splashes, scratches, smoke, and radial light, with a premium social-media sports poster finish, hyper-detailed, sharp, energetic, and poster-ready for a football meme or fan transfer reveal.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版足球转会官宣海报，主题为 {argument name="player name" default="Erling Haaland"} 加入 {argument name="club name" default="Inter Milan"}。设计采用深色、高对比度的黑色与电光蓝配色，呈现出粗犷的电影级体育海报风格。构图包含同一球员的 2 层肖像：上方左侧为一个超大的半身特写，侧脸向上仰望，留着利落的金色短发丸子头，两侧剃短；下方中心为一个半身动作肖像，身穿俱乐部标志性的蓝黑条纹主场球衣，单手食指向上做出胜利手势。人物需具备强壮的运动员体格、强烈的英雄气场，运用轮廓光、深邃阴影、细腻的皮肤纹理和亮泽的发丝高光。球衣胸前应包含白色赞助商文字标识、一个小型的白色钩状 Logo、圆形俱乐部徽章以及三色盾牌补丁。在球员身后，放置一个巨大的发光圆形国际米兰风格徽章图形作为背景。总共添加 3 个可见的俱乐部 Logo：右上角 1 个小 Logo，左下角 1 个大型旗帜 Logo，以及球衣上的 1 个徽章。底部中心融入现代足球场的夜景，明亮的泛光灯与蓝色的绘画烟雾及笔触效果交织在一起。画面中心横跨球员姓氏，采用巨大的粗犷手绘字体，部分被人物遮挡，右侧配有一个巨大的手写风格数字“9”。在设计周围添加 8 处文字元素：顶部中心小字“INTER MILAN”；左上方堆叠的球员姓名及蓝色“9”；左侧中部口号“NATO PER SEGNARE”；右侧垂直文字“I M INTER”；右侧中部口号“FORZA INTER PER SEMPRE”；右下方城市名“SAN SIRO”；右下方小字“MILANO ITALIA”；底部中心小字“1908”和“LA BENEAMATA”。此外，在左上方肖像附近添加 1 个白色的签名涂鸦。背景应为黑色颓废纹理、蓝色墨水溅射、划痕、烟雾和放射状光线的层叠拼贴，呈现出高级社交媒体体育海报的质感，超高细节、锐利、充满活力，随时可用于足球模因或球迷转会官宣。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Manga Page of a Giant Robot Cat

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克漫画风：巨型机械猫

templates.prompt: A highly detailed black-and-white manga page showing a gigantic mechanical cat walking through a dense nighttime Japanese city street. The page has 4 panels total: 1 wide top panel spanning the full width, 2 smaller stacked panels on the bottom left, and 1 tall large panel on the bottom right. In the top panel, a colossal robotic cat dominates a narrow neon-lit alley lined with tall buildings, tangled power lines, vertical shop signs, and tiny pedestrians staring upward in shock. The cat has realistic feline proportions but is built from exposed armor plates, rivets, pistons, cables, gears, segmented metal limbs, and intricate machine internals, with a tag hanging from its neck that reads "猫神". The wet street reflects city lights. Add multiple Japanese signs in the environment including "古書 2F", "万事屋 B1", and "酒処". Include a large manga speech bubble in Japanese in the upper right of the top panel reading "うわっ？でっけえ!!". In the upper bottom-left panel, show a close-up of a long-haired woman seen from behind and slightly to the side, looking toward the creature, with a vertical Japanese speech bubble reading "…何でこんな街にこんなものが…". In the lower bottom-left panel, show a group of startled onlookers from the front, including a young man in the foreground and other shocked pedestrians behind him, with a vertical Japanese speech bubble reading "神様の使いか!?". In the tall bottom-right panel, show a dramatic low-angle close-up of the mechanical cat towering between buildings under a bright moon, emphasizing its chest machinery, massive forelegs, whiskers, and regal face, with the neck tag "猫神" clearly visible. Add a large stylized Japanese sound effect near the cat reading "カシ…". Use classic seinen manga aesthetics, cinematic panel composition, fine ink crosshatching, heavy contrast, detailed urban textures, realistic crowd scale, and a sense of awe, mystery, and divine cyberpunk presence.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的黑白漫画页，展示了一只巨大的机械猫走在拥挤的日本夜间城市街道上。整页共 4 个分镜：顶部是一个横跨全宽的大分镜，左下角是 2 个较小的堆叠分镜，右下角是一个纵向的大分镜。在顶部大分镜中，一只巨大的机械猫占据了狭窄的霓虹灯巷道，周围是高耸的建筑、错综复杂的电线、垂直的店铺招牌，以及抬头惊愕注视的小行人。猫咪拥有写实的猫科动物比例，但身体由外露的装甲板、铆钉、活塞、线缆、齿轮、分段式金属肢体和复杂的内部机械结构组成，脖子上挂着一个写有“猫神”字样的吊牌。潮湿的街道反射着城市灯光。环境中添加多个日文招牌，包括“古書 2F”、“万事屋 B1”和“酒処”。在顶部大分镜的右上角添加一个巨大的日文漫画对话气泡，写着“うわっ？でっけえ!!”。在左上方的分镜中，展示一名长发女性的背影及侧面特写，她正看向这只生物，旁边有一个垂直的日文对话气泡，写着“…何でこんな街にこんなものが…”。在左下方的分镜中，从正面展示一群受惊的围观群众，前景是一名年轻男子，身后是其他震惊的行人，配有一个垂直的日文对话气泡，写着“神様の使いか!?”。在右下方的纵向大分镜中，展示机械猫在明月下耸立于建筑之间的戏剧性低角度特写，强调其胸部的机械结构、巨大的前肢、胡须和威严的面孔，脖子上的“猫神”吊牌清晰可见。在猫咪附近添加一个巨大的日文风格拟声词“カシ…”。采用经典的青年漫画美学，电影般的分镜构图，细腻的墨水排线，强烈的对比度，细致的城市纹理，写实的比例感，营造出一种敬畏、神秘和神圣的赛博朋克氛围。

templates.title: Cozy AI Agents Studio Group Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: Cozy AI Agents Studio 合影

templates.prompt: A warm, highly detailed anime-style illustration set in a cozy, cluttered indie workspace that feels like a book café mixed with a startup studio, lit by golden afternoon sunlight streaming through tall windows on the right and by 4 black industrial pendant lamps hanging from the ceiling, with string lights, overflowing bookshelves, plants, and handwritten motivational signs covering the background. Show 5 young women standing around a large wooden worktable, framed as a wide group portrait. The mood is whimsical, slightly satirical, and aspirational-but-chaotic. On the far left, place a tall woman with very long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="auburn"} hair wearing a crown of white daisies and a sleeveless rust-brown dress with a white sunburst emblem on the chest and a dark belt at the waist; she holds a small handwritten note toward the viewer that reads exactly {argument name="note text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}. In front of her on a side table is a glass cup of tea, a book stack, and a tiny potted plant. Next to her, place a punky blonde woman with twin ponytails tied with black bows, large black headphones resting around her neck, and an off-shoulder black dress marked with a bold white X on the torso; she stands confidently beside an open sticker-covered laptop with another large X logo. In the center rear, place a mysterious slim girl with extremely long dark navy-black hair, pale skin, and a gothic dark dress, standing quietly in front of a desktop monitor showing a blue glowing star or sparkle on a dark screen. To the right of center, place an elegant woman in a fitted red cheongsam-inspired dress with floral embroidery and a side slit, leaning one hand on the wooden table near an open notebook filled with sketches or writing. On the far right, place a casually dressed brunette with messy hair in a bun, wearing a white T-shirt with a black knot-like AI logo under an open beige overshirt, standing behind an open silver laptop with the same logo. Scatter many cozy desk objects across the main table: 2 mugs, 1 open notebook, 1 pen, 1 small black figurine, 1 closed book stack, and laptops. Add readable handwritten wall notes and signs throughout the room: “FOCUS SHIPS DREAMS” on the upper left, “SHIPPING IS MY CARDIO” on the left wall, “turn caffeine into code” near the top center, “be kind to your future self” near the window, “The Art of Asking Nicely” on a book spine at lower left, “WORLD’S OKAYEST MODEL” on a black mug near center-left, “MOONSHOT DIARIES” on a book stack near lower right, “Good Prompts Only” on a mug at lower right, and a sticky note at the bottom right reading “AGI is already for ready us” with a small doodle. Use painterly linework, intricate textures, expressive fashion styling, warm brown and amber color grading, soft cinematic depth, and a polished social-media-viral illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温馨且细节丰富的动漫风格插画，背景设定在一个舒适而略显杂乱的独立工作室，融合了书店咖啡馆与初创公司工作室的氛围。午后的金色阳光从右侧的高窗洒入，天花板上悬挂着 4 盏黑色工业风吊灯，背景中点缀着串灯、堆满书籍的书架、绿植以及手写的励志标语。画面呈现 5 位年轻女性围站在一张大型木质工作台前，构图为广角集体照。整体氛围既异想天开又带有一丝讽刺意味，既充满抱负又略显混乱。最左侧是一位身材高挑、留着长波浪 {argument name="hair color" default="赤褐色"} 头发的女性，她头戴雏菊编织的花环，身穿带有白色太阳纹徽章的锈棕色无袖连衣裙，腰间系着深色腰带；她向观众展示一张手写便条，上面写着 {argument name="note text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"}。她身旁的边桌上放着一杯茶、一叠书和一盆小绿植。在她旁边，是一位朋克风格的金发女性，扎着系有黑色蝴蝶结的双马尾，脖子上挂着大号黑色耳机，身穿露肩黑色连衣裙，胸前印有醒目的白色 X 标志；她自信地站在一台贴满贴纸、印有同样 X 标志的笔记本电脑旁。画面中央后方，是一位神秘的瘦削女孩，留着极长的深海军蓝黑色长发，皮肤白皙，身穿哥特风深色连衣裙，安静地站在一台显示器前，屏幕上闪烁着蓝色的星光。右侧中央，是一位优雅的女性，身穿修身的红色旗袍式连衣裙，带有花卉刺绣和侧开叉，单手撑在木桌上，身旁放着一本打开的笔记本，上面画满了草图或文字。最右侧是一位穿着随意的棕发女性，头发凌乱地盘成发髻，身穿印有黑色结状 AI 标志的白色 T 恤，外搭一件米色衬衫，站在一台印有相同标志的银色笔记本电脑后。主桌上散落着许多温馨的办公用品：2 个马克杯、1 本打开的笔记本、1 支笔、1 个黑色小手办、1 叠合上的书和几台笔记本电脑。房间各处点缀着清晰可见的手写墙面笔记和标语：左上方写着“FOCUS SHIPS DREAMS”，左墙上写着“SHIPPING IS MY CARDIO”，顶部中央附近写着“turn caffeine into code”，窗户附近写着“be kind to your future self”，左下方书脊上写着“The Art of Asking Nicely”，左中位置的黑色马克杯上写着“WORLD’S OKAYEST MODEL”，右下方书堆上写着“MOONSHOT DIARIES”，右下方马克杯上写着“Good Prompts Only”，右下角的便利贴上写着“AGI is already for ready us”并配有一个小涂鸦。采用绘画感线条、复杂的纹理、极具表现力的时尚造型、温暖的棕色与琥珀色调、柔和的电影级景深，以及精致的社交媒体病毒式传播插画美学。

templates.title: Pixar-Style AI Web Design Sprint Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 皮克斯风格 AI Web 设计冲刺活动海报

templates.prompt: A stylized cinematic poster for a creative coding event, designed like a Disney-Pixar-inspired animated movie one-sheet. Vertical composition, warm cozy interior at night with a large loft window on the left showing a city skyline at sunset, exposed brick walls, and a neon-lit creative studio atmosphere. At the top center, big glossy dimensional typography reads "Disney•PIXAR" above the main title "The AI Web Design Sprint" in huge bold white 3D letters. Directly underneath, smaller bright text reads "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." In the center foreground, 2 adult men sit side by side at a wooden table with a laptop between them, casual startup-founder vibe, one in a dark hoodie and one in a light sweatshirt and baseball cap, both facing camera in a friendly promotional pose. Their faces should be generic and unobtrusive, with the emphasis on the event-poster composition rather than portrait realism. The laptop lid has 3 visible stickers: a purple code-brackets sticker, a black sticker with a white burst symbol, and a rectangular slogan sticker reading "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." Around the scene, include 4 whimsical animated mascot elements: a small hovering robot drone lamp in the upper left with glowing blue eyes and a cone of warm light shining downward; a smiling cartoon sun icon in the upper right; a tiny red pixel character floating nearby; and a glowing blue cat-like digital mascot standing on the table in front of the laptop. On the right side, a vertical monitor displays a dark coding interface with readable text including "// Welcome back, Julian!", "Opus 4.6", "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", "Surfers (late set)", and a checklist titled "Sprint Plan" with 4 items: "DISCOVER", "IDEATE", "BUILD", "SHIP". On the left side, a hand-lettered paper signboard contains 4 notices pinned together: "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", and "$10 ADV / $12 DOS". In the lower left foreground, a white coffee mug reads "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL" with a small skull icon. In the lower right foreground, a terracotta plant pot with green leaves reads "CREATIVE COLLISION". At the bottom center, large bold text reads "APRIL 27–30" and below it "LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB." Add a tiny line of faux credits along the bottom edge in classic movie-poster style, referencing names like Julian Lopez and Harvey Specter, projects such as Minimal Playground, Agency 976, Cyberpunk Cafe, and Surfers, and a playful production credit. Use dramatic warm-orange and cool-blue lighting, polished animated-film rendering, soft depth of field, glossy surfaces, rich contrast, highly detailed poster design, charming tech startup energy, and a premium event-advertisement finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满电影感的创意编程活动海报，采用迪士尼-皮克斯（Disney-Pixar）动画电影海报风格设计。采用竖构图，展现了一个温馨的夜晚室内场景，左侧巨大的阁楼窗户映出日落时的城市天际线，背景为裸露的砖墙，营造出霓虹灯点缀的创意工作室氛围。顶部中央，醒目的光泽感立体排版显示“Disney•PIXAR”，下方是巨大的白色 3D 粗体主标题“The AI Web Design Sprint”。正下方是较小的明亮文字：“BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.”。画面中央前景处，两名成年男子并排坐在木桌旁，中间放着一台笔记本电脑，呈现出休闲的初创公司创始人氛围；一人穿着深色连帽衫，另一人穿着浅色卫衣并戴着棒球帽，两人都面向镜头，姿态友好且具有宣传感。他们的面部应处理得通用且不突兀，重点在于活动海报的构图而非肖像写实感。笔记本电脑盖上有 3 个可见贴纸：一个紫色代码括号贴纸，一个带有白色爆炸符号的黑色贴纸，以及一个写有“BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.”的长方形标语贴纸。场景周围包含 4 个奇幻的动画吉祥物元素：左上方是一个悬浮的机器人无人机灯，带有发光的蓝色眼睛，向下投射出一束暖光；右上角是一个微笑的卡通太阳图标；附近漂浮着一个小小的红色像素角色；桌上笔记本电脑前站着一个发光的蓝色猫形数字吉祥物。右侧的竖屏显示器上呈现出深色代码界面，文字清晰可见，包括“// Welcome back, Julian!”、“Opus 4.6”、“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyberpunk Cafe”、“Surfers (late set)”，以及一个标题为“Sprint Plan”的清单，包含 4 个项目：“DISCOVER”、“IDEATE”、“BUILD”、“SHIP”。左侧，一个手写纸质告示牌上钉着 4 条通知：“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”以及“$10 ADV / $12 DOS”。左下角前景处，一个白色咖啡杯上写着“THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL”并配有一个小骷髅图标。右下角前景处，一个陶土花盆里种着绿叶植物，上面写着“CREATIVE COLLISION”。底部中央，醒目的粗体文字写着“APRIL 27–30”，下方是“LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB.”。底部边缘添加一行仿电影海报风格的微小制作人员名单，引用 Julian Lopez 和 Harvey Specter 等名字，以及 Minimal Playground、Agency 976、Cyberpunk Cafe 和 Surfers 等项目，并附带俏皮的制作职衔。运用戏剧性的暖橙色与冷蓝色灯光、精致的动画电影渲染、柔和的景深、光泽表面、丰富的对比度、高度精细的海报设计，展现出迷人的科技初创公司活力，并呈现出高端活动广告的质感。

templates.title: Swiss Poster for AI Web Design Sprint

titleLocalized.zh: AI 网页设计冲刺活动瑞士风格海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold Swiss-modernist event poster for a live AI and web design sprint, portrait orientation, with a warm off-white paper background, stark black typography, and vivid red accent blocks. The composition is asymmetrical and editorial, with a strong grid and generous negative space. In the top left, place a small red uppercase line of text reading {argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}, followed by a thin horizontal black rule stretching toward the right. Below it, set an oversized stacked headline in ultra-bold black sans serif, left aligned, reading {argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}, broken across 4 lines with dramatic scale so the words dominate the left half of the poster. In the upper right quadrant, add 1 large solid red rectangle as a graphic block. Beneath that red block, place a compact black uppercase subhead in 3 lines: {argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}. In the lower middle, include 2 cropped grayscale portrait photos of men from the chest up, side by side, documentary style, slightly overlapping the typography area; the left man has dark slicked-back hair and a short beard, the right man wears a dark baseball cap with embroidered lettering and has facial hair. Obscure both faces with 2 vertical soft-edged gray censor rectangles centered over each face. Along the right side, create a vertical feature column with 4 black square icons, each separated by thin horizontal divider lines and paired with uppercase labels. The 4 items are: a starburst icon with the label "CREATIVE COLLISION", a connected-nodes icon with the label "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS", a code brackets icon with the label "CODE IN MOTION", and a terminal prompt icon with the label "REAL-TIME DESIGN". Near the bottom, add a full-width footer separated by a thin horizontal black rule. Inside the footer, create 4 text blocks divided by slim vertical lines: block 1 says "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.", block 2 lists "MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976" with a small red line beneath reading "LIVE ON THE WEB", block 3 lists "CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)" and below it "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE" and then "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY", block 4 lists ticket info as "TICKETS $10 ADV $12 DOS". On the far lower right edge, add vertical red text reading {argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}. Use a clean neo-grotesk typeface similar to Helvetica or Akzidenz-Grotesk, heavy weight for the headline, condensed uppercase for supporting text, crisp alignment, subtle paper texture, and a high-contrast black-red-cream palette. The overall look should feel like a contemporary design-conference poster mixed with punk tech culture and brutalist editorial branding.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张大胆的瑞士现代主义风格活动海报，用于 AI 与网页设计冲刺活动，采用纵向构图，背景为温暖的米白色纸张质感，搭配醒目的黑色排版和鲜艳的红色色块。构图采用不对称的编辑风格，具有强烈的网格感和充裕的留白。在左上角，放置一行红色小号大写文字 {argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}，随后是一条向右延伸的细黑色横线。下方设置超大号堆叠式标题，使用超粗体黑色无衬线字体，左对齐，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}，分为 4 行排列，通过夸张的比例使文字占据海报左侧。在右上象限，添加 1 个大型实心红色矩形作为图形块。在该红色块下方，放置 3 行紧凑的黑色大写副标题：{argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}。在底部中间，包含 2 张半身男士黑白肖像照，并排摆放，纪实风格，略微覆盖排版区域；左侧男子留着深色背头和短胡须，右侧男子戴着带有刺绣字母的深色棒球帽，留有胡须。用 2 个垂直的柔边灰色遮挡矩形遮住两人的面部，矩形居中于面部。沿右侧创建一列垂直功能栏，包含 4 个黑色方形图标，每个图标由细横线分隔，并配有大写标签。这 4 项内容为：星爆图标配标签 "CREATIVE COLLISION"，连接节点图标配标签 "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS"，代码括号图标配标签 "CODE IN MOTION"，以及终端提示符图标配标签 "REAL-TIME DESIGN"。在底部附近，添加一个由细黑色横线分隔的全宽页脚。在页脚内，创建 4 个由细竖线分隔的文本块：第 1 块写着 "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD."，第 2 块列出 "MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976" 并在下方配有一条红色短线，写着 "LIVE ON THE WEB"，第 3 块列出 "CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)" 以及下方的 "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE" 和 "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"，第 4 块列出票务信息 "TICKETS $10 ADV $12 DOS"。在最右下边缘，添加垂直的红色文字 {argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}。使用类似于 Helvetica 或 Akzidenz-Grotesk 的简洁新怪诞体（Neo-grotesk），标题使用粗体，辅助文本使用压缩大写，对齐清晰，具有微妙的纸张纹理和高对比度的黑-红-米色调。整体视觉效果应融合当代设计会议海报、朋克科技文化与粗野主义编辑品牌风格。

templates.title: Punk AI Sprint Flyer

titleLocalized.zh: 朋克 AI 冲刺活动传单

templates.prompt: Create a raw, high-contrast punk rock gig poster collage for an event called {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"}. The design should feel like a xeroxed underground flyer pasted on a city wall: rough torn paper edges, photocopy grain, ink smudges, distressed black-and-white textures, hot magenta paint splashes, DIY zine aesthetics, and chaotic layered paper scraps taped and pinned together. Use a vertical poster composition with a black background and a central oversized torn white rectangle set at a slight angle, filled with huge condensed black distressed lettering for the main title. At the very top, add a smaller black torn strip with handwritten brush lettering in neon magenta reading {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}. On the left side, place a hot pink torn paper block with hand-drawn black text listing the date {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}, then smaller stacked lines reading "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", "$10 ADV", and "$12 DOS". On the right side, add an off-white torn note with magenta "WITH:" at the top and four supporting acts listed in black handwritten text: "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", and "Surfers (Late Set)". In the center-lower area, show exactly 2 black-and-white photocopied punk band members from the chest up, standing shoulder to shoulder, both wearing leather jackets with patches and pins; the left one has round glasses, the right one wears a baseball cap. Their faces should be generic and partially obscured by the collage styling so the poster focus remains typographic and graphic rather than portrait-specific. Add a hot pink spiky starburst on the mid-right containing a black circle with a simple white radial symbol. Near the bottom right, place a beige masking-tape-like paper scrap with bold handwritten black text reading "Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.". Near the bottom left, add a black rectangular venue block with magenta hand lettering for {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} and smaller white address text "218 W. 31st Street" and "Chicago, IL", plus a small white skull icon nearby. Include exactly 2 silver safety pins, one near the upper left corner and one near the lower left area, and exactly 1 strip of dark duct tape on the left edge of the main title paper. Finish the bottom edge with a black-and-white checkerboard strip spanning the full width. Overall mood: rebellious, loud, youthful, anarchic, street-pasted punk flyer meets tech event promo, with intense contrast, gritty halftone noise, screen-print imperfections, and hand-made collage energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张原始、高对比度的朋克摇滚演出拼贴海报，用于名为 {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"} 的活动。设计应呈现出贴在城市墙壁上的复印地下传单质感：粗糙的撕纸边缘、复印颗粒感、墨迹污点、做旧的黑白纹理、亮洋红色油漆溅射、DIY 杂志美学，以及用胶带和图钉固定的混乱分层纸屑。采用竖版海报构图，黑色背景，中央放置一个略微倾斜的超大撕裂白色矩形，内填巨大的压缩式黑色做旧字体作为主标题。在最上方，添加一条较小的黑色撕裂纸条，上面用霓虹洋红色手写笔触写着 {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}。在左侧，放置一块亮粉色撕裂纸块，上面用手绘黑色文字列出日期 {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}，下方堆叠较小的文字行，内容为“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”、“$10 ADV”和“$12 DOS”。在右侧，添加一张米白色撕裂便签，顶部用洋红色写着“WITH:”，下方用黑色手写体列出四个助演嘉宾：“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyberpunk Cafe”和“Surfers (Late Set)”。在中心偏下区域，展示 2 名黑白复印风格的朋克乐队成员，半身像，肩并肩站立，两人都穿着带有补丁和徽章的皮夹克；左侧的人戴着圆框眼镜，右侧的人戴着棒球帽。他们的面部应模糊处理，部分被拼贴风格遮挡，使海报焦点保持在排版和图形上，而非肖像本身。在右中部添加一个亮粉色尖刺星爆图案，其中包含一个带有简单白色放射状符号的黑色圆圈。在右下角附近，放置一张米色美纹纸胶带状的纸屑，上面用粗体手写黑色文字写着“Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.”。在左下角附近，添加一个黑色矩形场地信息块，用洋红色手写体标注 {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"}，以及较小的白色地址文字“218 W. 31st Street”和“Chicago, IL”，旁边附带一个小巧的白色骷髅图标。包含 2 枚银色别针，一枚靠近左上角，一枚靠近左下区域，并在主标题纸张的左边缘添加 1 条深色胶带。底部边缘以横跨全宽的黑白棋盘格条纹收尾。整体氛围：叛逆、喧闹、年轻、无政府主义，将街头张贴的朋克传单与技术活动宣传相结合，具有强烈的对比度、粗糙的半色调噪点、丝网印刷瑕疵以及手工拼贴的能量。
