templates.title: Cute Subscription Celebration Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的订阅庆祝插画

templates.prompt: A warm, cute digital illustration in a cozy desk setting celebrating a new subscription. On the left is a friendly humanoid robot mascot with a glossy black face screen showing pixelated purple LED eyes and a smiling mouth, wearing a tall black top hat with a purple band and a dark hoodie with a small American flag patch on one sleeve and the text "USN VET MSSP" on the chest. The robot gives a thumbs-up with one hand and holds a small rectangular sign in the other that reads "Subscribed!" with a purple heart underneath. On the right is a delighted young woman with long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair, seated at the desk with hands clasped near her chin in an excited grateful pose, wearing a white long-sleeve top with red and blue striped trim and a small chest logo. Her face is obscured by a simple square censor block. Above them, large playful handwritten text says "{argument name="headline text" default="Nick subscribed Sharon!"}". Beneath the headline is a rounded notification card showing a circular avatar of the same robot mascot, the name "{argument name="subscriber name" default="Nick"}", and the text "Subscribed to {argument name="creator name" default="Sharon Riley"}" followed by a purple heart. A speech bubble next to the woman says "{argument name="speech bubble text" default="Thank you!"}". Scatter exactly 7 pink heart doodles around the composition and add 1 small white sparkle near the center. Place everything on a wooden tabletop. On the left side of the desk, include 1 black mug with the text "CRYPTO CAN'T BE EVIL" and 1 gold coin featuring a Shiba Inu dog face. In the center-right foreground, include 1 white mug reading "AI FOR GOOD" with a blue heart. On the far right, stack exactly 3 books with visible spine titles: "AI & CREATIVITY", "ENTERTAINMENT", and "DREAM BIG" with a heart, beside 1 small potted plant. Use a softly blurred home-office background with shelves, pastel decor, and a framed letter X on the wall. Soft peach and beige lighting, painterly shading, rounded shapes, wholesome streamer fan-art aesthetic, polished storybook-style digital painting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温暖可爱的数字插画，背景为温馨的桌面环境，正在庆祝新的订阅。左侧是一个友好的类人机器人吉祥物，它有着光亮的黑色面屏，屏幕上显示着像素化的紫色 LED 眼睛和微笑的嘴巴，头戴饰有紫色带子的黑色高礼帽，身穿深色连帽衫，袖子上有一个小小的美国国旗补丁，胸前印有“USN VET MSSP”字样。机器人一只手竖起大拇指，另一只手拿着一块写着“Subscribed!”的小长方形标牌，下方画着一颗紫色爱心。右侧是一位欣喜若狂的年轻女性，留着长长的波浪形 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 头发，坐在桌边，双手合十放在下巴附近，做出兴奋而感激的姿势，身穿带有红蓝条纹装饰和胸前小标志的白色长袖上衣。她的脸被一个简单的方形遮挡块遮住。在他们上方，巨大的俏皮手写文字写着“{argument name="headline text" default="Nick 订阅了 Sharon!"}”。标题下方是一张圆角的通知卡片，显示着同一个机器人吉祥物的圆形头像、名称“{argument name="subscriber name" default="Nick"}”，以及“Subscribed to {argument name="creator name" default="Sharon Riley"}”的文字，后面跟着一颗紫色爱心。女子旁边的对话气泡写着“{argument name="speech bubble text" default="谢谢你！"}”。在构图中散布 7 个粉色爱心涂鸦，并在中心附近添加 1 个白色小闪光。将所有元素放置在木质桌面上。在桌子左侧，放置 1 个印有“CRYPTO CAN'T BE EVIL”文字的黑色马克杯和 1 枚印有柴犬头像的金币。在右前方中心，放置 1 个印有“AI FOR GOOD”字样和蓝色爱心的白色马克杯。在最右侧，堆叠 3 本书，书脊标题清晰可见：“AI & CREATIVITY”、“ENTERTAINMENT”和带有爱心的“DREAM BIG”，旁边放 1 盆小盆栽。使用柔和模糊的家庭办公室背景，包括书架、柔和色调的装饰以及墙上带字母 X 的相框。柔和的桃色和米色灯光，绘画般的阴影，圆润的形状，治愈系主播同人画美学，精致的绘本风格数字绘画。

templates.prompt: A photorealistic close-up portrait of a small tabby kitten styled like an early-2000s pop-punk rocker, sitting on a dark floor and facing the camera with a calm, slightly soulful expression. The kitten has large round eyes, soft striped fur, and long straight scene-kid hair in {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} with a bold {argument name="streak color" default="pink"} streak draped over one side of the face, partially covering one eye. It wears 4 visible fashion elements: a black band-style shirt with a distressed white graphic, a black-and-pink diagonal striped necktie, a black studded bracelet on one front paw, and the dramatic long wig-like hairstyle. The background is a gritty bedroom or rehearsal-space wall covered with punk posters and distressed textures; on the left is a black poster with large white text reading {argument name="poster text" default="AVRIL LAVIGNE"} above a pink heart-and-crossbones symbol, and on the right is a blurred poster of a person in dark clothing with a striped tie. Moody warm indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, highly detailed fur, realistic whiskers, subtle grunge atmosphere, centered composition, nostalgic emo aesthetic, studio-quality realism.

templates.title: Japanese Video Production Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式视频制作海报

templates.prompt: Create a clean, premium Japanese corporate poster for a {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} video production company, in a minimalist editorial layout on an off-white background with lots of negative space. Portrait orientation, A4-like poster proportions. At the very top left, place an oversized bold black sans-serif logotype reading {argument name="company name" default="Arks"}, spanning nearly the full width of the page. In the upper right, add a small stacked brand mark in thin uppercase letters: "VIDEO" on one line, "PRODUCTION" on the next, "COMPANY" on the third, with a small burnt-orange geometric accent nearby. Below the logo, add a vertical burnt-orange bar on the left and a large elegant Japanese headline in black Mincho-style serif: {argument name="headline text" default="4つの領域で、映像を磨く。"}. Directly underneath, add a smaller service line in Japanese with slash separators: "SNS運用 / ショートドラマ / MV制作 / AI映像". The main body is a 2 by 2 grid of exactly 4 service panels with thin light-gray divider lines. Each panel has a large black editorial number and a Japanese label. Panel 1 label: "SNS運用" with the number "01"; image shows a close-up hand holding a smartphone displaying social media analytics, on a desk with charts, a calendar sheet, a pen, and a coffee mug, in warm natural office lighting; caption below in Japanese: "企画・分析・運用を一つの流れで。" Panel 2 label: "ショートドラマ" with the number "02"; image shows exactly 2 Japanese high-school-age students in white shirts standing outdoors on a rooftop or balcony, one female and one male, side-profile composition, muted overcast daylight, cinematic shallow depth of field; caption below: "共感が残る、短編の物語設計。" Panel 3 label: "MV制作" with the number "03"; image shows a moody musician playing electric guitar in a dim studio, backlit by soft haze, with a camera monitor in the foreground showing the same performer; caption below: "アーティストの世界観を、映像で可視化。" Panel 4 label: "AI映像" with the number "04"; image shows a dark professional AI video-generation or image-editing software interface on a monitor, with a cinematic scene of a lone figure standing on rocks under dramatic clouds, plus thumbnail timeline images and side control panels; caption below: "技術を表現へ変える、次世代の映像制作。" At the bottom left, place a small three-line English slogan in uppercase: {argument name="tagline text" default="CREATE.\nCONNECT.\nLEAVE A MARK."} with a small burnt-orange line accent above it. At the bottom right, place the website {argument name="website" default="arks-vp.com"} in small serif text with a short black horizontal line beside it. Use a refined mix of bold modern sans-serif for the large logo and numbers, and elegant Japanese serif for headlines and labels. Color palette: black, charcoal, warm off-white, light gray rules, and restrained burnt-orange accents. The overall feel should be realistic, polished, contemporary, Japanese editorial advertising design, with accurate Japanese typography and natural image tones.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一家名为 {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} 的视频制作公司创作一张简洁、高端的日式企业海报。采用极简主义的编辑排版，以米白色为背景，留出大量负空间。海报为纵向构图，比例接近 A4 纸。在左上角放置一个超大的粗体黑色无衬线字体 Logo，内容为 {argument name="company name" default="Arks"}，宽度几乎横跨页面。在右上角，添加一个小型堆叠式品牌标识，使用纤细的大写字母：第一行写“VIDEO”，第二行写“PRODUCTION”，第三行写“COMPANY”，旁边配有一个小的焦橙色几何装饰。在 Logo 下方，左侧添加一条垂直的焦橙色线条，并配以黑色明朝体（Mincho）的大号优雅日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="4つの領域で、映像を磨く。"}。紧随其后，添加一行较小的日文服务说明，使用斜杠分隔：“SNS 运营 / 短剧制作 / MV 制作 / AI 视频”。主体部分为一个 2x2 的网格，包含 4 个服务板块，板块间由细浅灰色线条分隔。每个板块均配有一个大号黑色编辑风格数字和一个日文标签。板块 1 标签：“SNS 运营”，数字“01”；图片展示一只手拿着智能手机查看社交媒体分析数据，背景是办公桌，桌上有图表、日历页、钢笔和咖啡杯，光线为温暖的自然办公光；下方日文说明：“企画・分析・運用を一つの流れで。” 板块 2 标签：“短剧制作”，数字“02”；图片展示 2 名穿着白衬衫的日本高中生站在户外屋顶或阳台上，一男一女，侧面构图，柔和的阴天日光，电影感的浅景深；下方日文说明：“共感が残る、短編の物語設計。” 板块 3 标签：“MV 制作”，数字“03”；图片展示一名音乐人在昏暗的录音室中弹奏电吉他，背光带有柔和的雾气，前景中有一个显示同一表演者的摄像机监视器；下方日文说明：“アーティストの世界観を、映像で可視化。” 板块 4 标签：“AI 视频”，数字“04”；图片展示显示器上专业的 AI 视频生成或图像编辑软件界面，屏幕中是电影感场景：一个孤独的身影站在岩石上，背景是戏剧性的云层，此外还有缩略图时间轴和侧边控制面板；下方日文说明：“技術を表現へ変える、次世代の映像制作。” 在左下角，放置一个三行大写英文标语：{argument name="tagline text" default="CREATE.\nCONNECT.\nLEAVE A MARK."}，上方配有一条小的焦橙色线条装饰。在右下角，放置网址 {argument name="website" default="arks-vp.com"}，使用小型衬线字体，旁边配有一条短黑色水平线。整体采用粗体现代无衬线字体（用于大号 Logo 和数字）与优雅日文衬线体（用于标题和标签）的精致组合。配色方案：黑色、炭灰色、温暖的米白色、浅灰色线条以及克制的焦橙色点缀。整体风格应呈现出真实、精致、现代的日式编辑广告设计感，并具备准确的日文排版和自然的图像色调。

templates.title: Brand Guide to Ad Concepts UI

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the brand style guide, generate a dark creative-generation app interface showing 4 billboard ad concepts in a 2x2 grid for {argument name="brand name" default="Netflix"}. Apply the exact brand palette and overall visual identity from the reference: deep black background, red accent, white typography, charcoal overlays, and clean modern sans-serif styling. Turn the reference from a static brand settings page into an image-generation results screen with a left sidebar model picker containing 2 model cards, and a main canvas displaying 4 generated concept thumbnails. Each thumbnail should be a cinematic nighttime outdoor billboard mockup with dramatic lighting, glossy reflections, and a person wearing a VR headset. Use bold billboard copy reading {argument name="headline text" default="NETFLIX VR"}, {argument name="subheadline text" default="COMING SOON"}, and {argument name="date text" default="28TH MAY"}. Add small UI chips and labels on the right summarizing the prompt, plus generation-time badges above each of the 4 images. Keep the result looking like a premium creative tool screenshot for branded ad ideation.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为品牌风格指南，生成一个深色调的创意生成应用界面，以 2x2 网格形式展示 {argument name="brand name" default="Netflix"} 的 4 个广告牌概念。应用参考图中的精确品牌调色板和整体视觉识别系统：深黑色背景、红色点缀、白色排版、炭灰色叠加层以及简洁现代的无衬线字体风格。将参考图从静态的品牌设置页面转变为图像生成结果屏幕，左侧边栏包含 2 个模型卡片的模型选择器，主画布显示 4 个生成的概念缩略图。每个缩略图应为电影质感的夜间户外广告牌模型，具有戏剧性的光影、光泽反射以及佩戴 VR 头显的人物。使用醒目的广告牌文案，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="NETFLIX VR"}、{argument name="subheadline text" default="COMING SOON"} 以及 {argument name="date text" default="28TH MAY"}。在右侧添加小型 UI 标签和说明以概括提示词，并在 4 张图像上方添加生成时间徽章。确保最终效果呈现出用于品牌广告构思的高级创意工具截图质感。

Replace the infographic/chart layout with a clean 2x2 magazine spread on an off-white background. Add a large serif brand header reading {argument name="headline text" default="J.CREW"} and an italic subhead reading {argument name="subhead text" default="Gritty’s Off Hours: Cool & Casual"}. Show exactly 4 styled outfit photos of the same character, keeping the fuzzy orange fur, big eyes, and black helmet, but placing the mascot in modern menswear inspired by the “best” colors from the reference: 1) “CLASSIC CREW” — seated on a stool in a navy sweater over a crisp white oxford with dark denim; 2) “EASY LAYERS” — standing casually in a teal overshirt, white tee, and charcoal trousers; 3) “POP OF PLUM” — relaxed pose in a plum cardigan with dark pants; 4) “MODERN SPORT” — seated in a black sporty layer with black pants, white socks, and white sneakers. Give each panel a short catalog-style caption under it matching those 4 titles and concise fashion copy. Use soft natural indoor lighting, minimal home-interior editorial settings, premium catalog photography, and a tasteful upscale preppy aesthetic. Add a small closing line centered at the bottom: {argument name="footer text" default="TIMELESS STYLE. PLAYFUL SPIRIT."}

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为角色和配色指南，将其转化为一套由该吉祥物担任主角的精致 J.Crew 风格时尚画册。将信息图/图表布局替换为米白色背景下的简洁 2x2 杂志排版。添加一个大型衬线字体品牌标题 {argument name="headline text" default="J.CREW"} 以及一个斜体副标题 {argument name="subhead text" default="Gritty’s Off Hours: Cool & Casual"}。展示 4 张该角色的造型照片，保留其毛茸茸的橙色皮毛、大眼睛和黑色头盔，但让吉祥物穿上灵感源自参考图中“最佳”配色的现代男装：1) “CLASSIC CREW” — 坐在凳子上，身穿海军蓝毛衣，内搭清爽的白色牛津衬衫，下穿深色牛仔裤；2) “EASY LAYERS” — 随意站立，身穿青色外搭衬衫，内搭白色 T 恤，下穿炭灰色长裤；3) “POP OF PLUM” — 姿态放松，身穿李子色开衫，搭配深色长裤；4) “MODERN SPORT” — 坐着，身穿黑色运动外套，搭配黑色长裤、白色袜子和白色运动鞋。为每个板块下方添加一段简短的目录风格说明，与上述 4 个标题相匹配，并配以简洁的时尚文案。使用柔和的室内自然光，采用极简的家居室内专题布景、高级目录摄影风格以及高雅的学院风美学。在底部居中添加一行简短的结束语：{argument name="footer text" default="TIMELESS STYLE. templates.title: Premium Beverage Commercial Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高端饮品商业海报

templates.prompt:
Create a bold, high-end commercial poster for a premium {argument name="product" default="orange juice"} brand, shot in a hyper-realistic studio environment with a strong emphasis on freshness, precision, and striking visual appeal.
Hero Composition:
A sleek transparent bottle filled with rich, vibrant {argument name="liquid" default="orange juice"} stands at the center. The label is minimal, modern, and premium, featuring a clean orange graphic with refined typography. The bottle is topped with a matte black cap, enhanced by subtle highlights and realistic reflections.
Action & Story:
Two hands wearing matte black gloves interact with the product:
One hand firmly grips the bottle from the top
The other slices through a thick, juicy orange using a sharp stainless steel knife
The cut is captured mid-action, showcasing the juicy pulp and fresh citrus texture. A few orange slices are placed at the base, slightly scattered to create a natural yet styled composition.
Lighting & Mood:
Background: deep, rich green gradient with cinematic falloff
Surface: dark matte table with soft, controlled reflections
Lighting: dramatic studio setup
Strong key light from one side for depth
Soft fill light for balance
Crisp highlights on the bottle and knife
Deep, clean shadows for contrast
Typography Layout:

Top corner:
Clean, modern brand name (e.g., “VITRA”, “FRESCO”, or “NATURO”) in white
Bottom section:
Small line: “Not your average juice”

Large bold headline: “{argument name="headline" default="PURE ORANGE. NO COMPROMISE."}”
Typography should feel modern, bold, and premium with a strong visual hierarchy. Use a rich orange tone for the headline to complement the juice.

Visual Style:

High-end food advertising aesthetic

Cinematic, bold, and contrast-driven

Ultra-sharp details and textures

Premium editorial look (like a global campaign)

Clean yet powerful composition

Output Requirements:

4K resolution

Photorealistic, advertisement-grade quality

Sharp focus, rich contrast, high dynamic range

promptLocalized.zh:
为高端 {argument name="product" default="橙汁"} 品牌创作一张醒目、高端的商业海报，在超写实的影棚环境中拍摄，重点突出新鲜感、精准度与强烈的视觉吸引力。

主体构图：
一瓶装满浓郁、鲜活 {argument name="liquid" default="橙汁"} 的透明流线型瓶子位于画面中心。标签设计极简、现代且高端，采用简洁的橙子图案与精致的字体。瓶盖为哑光黑色，带有微妙的高光与逼真的倒影。

动作与叙事：
两只戴着哑光黑色手套的手正在与产品互动：
一只手从上方稳稳握住瓶子
另一只手正用锋利的不锈钢刀切开一颗多汁的橙子
捕捉切开瞬间的动作，展现出多汁的果肉与新鲜的柑橘纹理。底座处放置了几片橙子，略微散落，营造出自然又不失设计感的构图。

灯光与氛围：
背景：深邃、浓郁的绿色渐变，带有电影感的衰减效果
表面：深色哑光桌面，带有柔和、可控的倒影
灯光：戏剧性的影棚布光
一侧强主光以增加深度
柔和补光以保持平衡
瓶身与刀刃上有清晰的高光
深邃、干净的阴影以增强对比度

排版布局：

顶部角落：
白色简洁、现代的品牌名称（例如 “VITRA”、“FRESCO” 或 “NATURO”）
底部区域：
小字行：“Not your average juice”（非凡果汁）

大号粗体标题：“{argument name="headline" default="纯粹橙汁，绝不妥协。"}”
字体应呈现出现代、醒目且高端的质感，并具有强烈的视觉层级。标题使用浓郁的橙色调，与果汁相呼应。

视觉风格：

高端食品广告美学

电影感、醒目且对比强烈

超清晰的细节与纹理

高端杂志大片质感（类似全球性广告活动）

简洁而有力的构图

输出要求：

4K 分辨率

照片级真实感，广告级品质

焦点清晰，对比度丰富，高动态范围

The central focus is an oversized, giant white Croc clog positioned on its heel at a diagonal angle, serving as a backrest. A fashion model with long dark hair, dressed in a {argument name="clothing" default="clean, all-white coordinated sweatshirt and wide-leg trousers"}, leans her entire back against the giant shoe in a relaxed, leaning posture. She is facing right in profile, looking ahead with a serene expression, and wearing standard-sized white Crocs.
In the background, the word "CROCS" is written in massive, bold, white condensed sans-serif typography, partially occluded by the giant shoe and the model to create a sense of depth. At the  top right, "Designed with ChatGPT" 
At the bottom center, a white sans-serif tagline reads: "Made for comfort, worn for confidence. Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining." The lighting is soft, cool, and even, casting gentle shadows and a soft reflection of the subjects on the glossy blue floor. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and high-concept.

templates.title: Black-and-White Fine Art Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黑白艺术肖像

templates.prompt:
A cinematic, black-and-white portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man"} sitting on a {argument name="furniture" default="wooden chair"} in a vintage indoor setting. He is positioned sideways, leaning forward slightly, resting his head gently on his folded arms placed over the backrest of the chair. His posture is relaxed but heavy, conveying emotional depth and quiet introspection. He gazes downward, lost in thought, with a soft, melancholic expression.

He has slightly messy dark hair, subtle texture, and light stubble or a short beard, adding realism and character. A few strands of hair fall naturally across his forehead. He wears a {argument name="clothing" default="simple, slightly oversized white shirt"} with soft fabric folds, enhancing the candid, natural aesthetic.

Lighting is soft and natural, coming from a large window behind or to the side of him. The light wraps gently around his face and arms, creating delicate highlights while casting deep, dramatic shadows across the room. The lighting is diffused yet high-contrast, evoking classic analog film photography.

The environment is a vintage interior—aged wooden furniture, textured walls, and a large window with visible panes. The background is softly blurred but still readable, adding depth and context without distracting from the subject.

Mood is emotional, quiet, and introspective—capturing loneliness, contemplation, and stillness.

Color grading: monochrome (black and white) with rich contrast, deep blacks, soft highlights, and a film-like tonal range.

Depth of field is shallow, focusing sharply on the subject’s face and arms while smoothly blurring the background.

Style: fine art photography, cinematic film still, analog aesthetic, high dynamic range, subtle grain, timeless mood.

Camera details: 50mm or 85mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.2 aperture, natural light photography, strong subject isolation, gentle vignette.

Composition: vertical frame (4:5 or 9:16), subject slightly off-center, using the chair as a framing element for a layered, storytelling composition.
Generate image using uploaded image as reference

promptLocalized.zh:
一张电影感的黑白肖像，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男子"} 坐在 {argument name="furniture" default="木椅"} 上，置身于复古的室内环境。他侧身而坐，身体微微前倾，头部轻轻靠在叠放于椅背上的双臂上。他的姿态放松而沉重，传达出情感的深度与静谧的内省。他低头凝视，陷入沉思，表情柔和而忧郁。

他留着微乱的深色头发，发质细腻，带有淡淡的胡茬或短须，增添了真实感与个性。几缕发丝自然地垂在额前。他穿着一件 {argument name="clothing" default="简约且略显宽松的白衬衫"}，布料褶皱自然，增强了抓拍般的真实美感。

光线柔和自然，来自他身后或侧面的一扇大窗户。光线轻柔地包裹着他的脸庞和手臂，勾勒出精致的高光，同时在房间内投下深邃而戏剧性的阴影。光影弥漫且对比鲜明，令人联想到经典的胶片摄影。

环境为复古室内——陈旧的木质家具、富有质感的墙壁以及带有明显窗格的大窗户。背景经过柔化处理，但仍清晰可见，在不干扰主体的情况下增加了深度与语境。

氛围：感性、安静、内省——捕捉孤独、沉思与宁静。

调色：单色（黑白），具有丰富的对比度、深邃的黑色、柔和的高光以及胶片般的色调范围。

景深：浅景深，焦点清晰地聚焦在主体的脸部和手臂上，背景平滑虚化。

风格：艺术摄影、电影剧照、胶片美学、高动态范围、细腻颗粒感、永恒的氛围。

相机参数：50mm 或 85mm 镜头，f/1.8–f/2.2 光圈，自然光摄影，强主体隔离，柔和暗角。

构图：竖构图（4:5 或 9:16），主体略微偏离中心，利用椅子作为构图元素，营造出具有层次感的叙事构图。

templates.title: Artistic Portrait with Mural Background

titleLocalized.zh: 带有壁画背景的艺术肖像

templates.prompt: A striking artistic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="charismatic woman"} (image attached) that precisely captures her face, seated in a serene yet powerful pose. She sits cross-legged on a minimalist floor with decorative tiles, wearing a modern {argument name="top" default="blue sweatshirt"} with a minimalist print, {argument name="bottom" default="loose-fitting jeans"}, and black Converse sneakers. Her expression is serene and subtly confident, with a gentle smile and relaxed eyes as she gazes slightly toward a diffused light source. Behind her rises a monumental abstract mural of her own face, painted with bold and expressive brushstrokes in charcoal gray, white, gold, and muted red. The mural is not a literal copy, but a stylized and emotive interpretation of her: intense eyes, fragmented textures, broad brushstrokes that suggest movement, ambition, and inner complexity. Its scale dominates the background without overshadowing the main figure, creating a harmonious balance between reality and artistic representation. The lighting is cinematic and evocative, with soft reflections at the edges and a subtle overhead glow that defines her silhouette. Fine particles, like dust, float subtly in the air, catching flashes of light and enhancing the atmosphere. The setting evokes the fusion of a modern art studio with a dreamlike exhibition space: clean, spacious, minimalist, yet charged with emotion. Photographed with ultra-realistic quality, using a 50mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, sharp details, and elegant color gradation, the scene conveys creativity, introspection, and personal transformation. Negative: blurry, overexposed, cartoonish, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, poorly drawn hands, merged faces, unrealistic colors, watermark, text. ar. 9 :16

promptLocalized.zh: 一张引人注目的艺术肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="充满魅力的女性"}（见附图），精准捕捉其面部特征，她以一种宁静而有力的姿态端坐。她盘腿坐在铺有装饰性瓷砖的极简主义地面上，身穿一件带有极简印花的现代 {argument name="top" default="蓝色卫衣"}，搭配 {argument name="bottom" default="宽松牛仔裤"} 和黑色 Converse 运动鞋。她的表情宁静且透着微妙的自信，嘴角带着温柔的微笑，眼神放松，微微凝视着漫射光源。在她身后，矗立着一幅巨大的抽象壁画，画的是她自己的脸，笔触大胆而富有表现力，运用了炭灰色、白色、金色和柔和的红色。这幅壁画并非写实临摹，而是对她的一种风格化且充满情感的诠释：深邃的眼睛、破碎的纹理、暗示着运动、野心和内心复杂性的宽大笔触。壁画的尺度占据了背景的主导地位，却并未掩盖主体人物，在现实与艺术表现之间创造了和谐的平衡。灯光具有电影感和感染力，边缘有柔和的反射，头顶的微光勾勒出她的轮廓。细小的微尘在空气中轻盈漂浮，捕捉着闪烁的光线，增强了氛围感。场景融合了现代艺术工作室与梦幻般的展览空间：干净、宽敞、极简，却充满了情感张力。采用超写实画质拍摄，使用 50mm 肖像镜头，浅景深，细节锐利，色彩过渡优雅，传达出创造力、内省和个人蜕变的主题。负面提示词：模糊、曝光过度、卡通化、解剖结构扭曲、多余肢体、手部绘制拙劣、面部融合、色彩不真实、水印、文字。长宽比 9 :16

templates.title: Commercial Product Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 商业产品信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A high-end infographic-style visual featuring an oversized {argument name="product" default="Puma sneaker"} placed beside a {argument name="subject description" default="young woman"}. The shoe is scaled to be nearly the same size as her entire seated body, emphasizing dramatic proportion. The woman sits casually leaning against the shoe, one arm resting on it, creating a natural interaction. Her face must closely match the provided reference image — accurate facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and expression — clean, polished, and visually appealing. Composition is modern and minimal, with a soft gradient or clean studio background. Include subtle infographic elements such as thin annotation lines, labels, or callouts highlighting features of the shoe (material, cushioning, sole design), but keep them elegant and not cluttered. Lighting is soft studio lighting with gentle shadows, giving a premium commercial look. The sneaker texture should be ultra-detailed (fabric, stitching, logo clarity). The model is styled in minimal, contemporary clothing that complements the shoe color palette. Color grading is crisp and slightly vibrant, with a professional advertising aesthetic. Balanced composition, sharp focus, depth of field subtly applied. Style: premium product infographic, fashion editorial meets product showcase, clean UI-inspired annotations. Resolution: ultra high resolution, 4K, highly detailed, realistic. 85mm lens, f/2.8 for soft depth. photorealistic, commercial ad quality. no distortion, accurate proportions. clean typography annotations

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端信息图风格的视觉图，展示了一个超大的 {argument name="product" default="Puma 运动鞋"} 放置在一位 {argument name="subject description" default="年轻女性"} 旁边。鞋子的比例被放大到几乎与她坐着的身躯一样大，强调戏剧性的比例感。女性随意地靠在鞋子上，一只手臂搭在上面，营造出自然的互动感。她的面部必须与提供的参考图像高度一致——准确的面部结构、肤色、发型和表情——画面整洁、精致且具有视觉吸引力。构图现代且极简，采用柔和的渐变或干净的摄影棚背景。包含微妙的信息图元素，如细注释线、标签或突出鞋子特征（材质、缓冲、鞋底设计）的标注，但要保持优雅，避免杂乱。光线为柔和的摄影棚光，带有轻微阴影，呈现出高端商业质感。运动鞋纹理应极其细腻（面料、缝线、Logo 清晰度）。模特身着简约的现代服装，与鞋子的配色方案相得益彰。色彩分级清晰且略显鲜艳，具有专业的广告美学。构图平衡，对焦锐利，带有微妙的景深效果。风格：高端产品信息图，时尚编辑与产品展示的结合，简洁的 UI 风格注释。分辨率：超高分辨率，4K，高度细节化，写实。85mm 镜头，f/2.8 光圈以获得柔和景深。照片级真实感，商业广告品质。无畸变，比例准确。整洁的排版注释

templates.prompt:

Hyper-realistic {argument name="foliage" default="orange autumn maple leaves"} float gently around her hair and neck, adding motion and contrast. templates.prompt: Comic book page layout, {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} ratio. Panel 1: Character drinking coffee by a window, golden morning light. Caption: "Friday mornings are for breathing. The rest can wait." Panel 2: Character sending a message to a friend, sincere smiles. Caption: "One kind word can carry someone through the whole weekend." Panel 3: Character drawing or creating, absorbed in the moment. Caption: "You don't need to finish it. You just need to start." Panel 4: Character walking outside, hands in pockets, looking up at trees and sky. Caption: "The world is still beautiful. You just have to look up." Panel 5: Character peaceful, soft lighting, quiet smile. Caption: "You made it through another week. That's enough. That's everything."

Anime style medium shot of a chef placing sliced chashu pork onto a ramen bowl with chopsticks. Bowl filled with golden broth and noodles. Soft-boiled egg and nori being arranged. templates.title: Pixel Game Asset Atlas Template

titleLocalized.zh: 像素游戏资产图集模板

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Please create a high-completion, high-information-density "Pixel World Asset Atlas" suitable for serialized release based on [Game Theme: {argument name="game theme" default="Demon Slayer/Tanjiro"}].

This is not a regular pixel illustration or a single game scene, but a "2D pixel game asset overview map" for game development, art setting, level design, and visual proposals. The visual should look like a complete game material board, systematically organizing core characters, enemies, items, terrain, scenes, mechanisms, Bosses, and decorative elements required for a [Game Type: {argument name="game type" default="Side-scrolling action"}] into a single clear, professional, and reusable game asset atlas.

[Basic Settings]
Theme Worldview: [Game Theme]
Game Type: [Game Type]
Era Background: [Era Background]
Protagonist Identity: [Protagonist Identity]
Enemy Types: [Enemy Types]
Main Scenes: [Main Scene Environment]
Overall Style: [Style Direction, e.g., {argument name="style" default="16-bit retro arcade pixel style"}]
Main Color: [Main Color]
Secondary Color: [Secondary Color]
Accent Color: [Accent Color]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, Landscape 4:3]
If not filled, automatically match according to the optimal plan for the game theme.

[Overall Visual Requirements]
The visual uses a large landscape canvas with a light or low-interference background, looking like a game development asset sheet or an instruction-style resource catalog. All elements should be 2D pixel art sprites with uniform pixel density, clear black/dark outlines, limited color scales, and retro game textures. Do not generate realistic photography, 3D rendering, painterly illustration, or movie poster styles. Focus on being "systematically complete, clearly categorized, resource-rich, and high in developability."

[Layout Structure]
The map uses a modular grid layout with fine lines dividing different resource areas. Each area needs a numbered title and short category labels, with a reading path from left to right, top to bottom. The layout should have the orderliness of an instruction manual or game dev document. Information density must be high but not chaotic; elements within each module should be equidistantly arranged.

[Modules to Include]
1. Player Character Module: Show complete action frames including standing, walking/running, jumping, etc. frames arranged horizontally like a sprite sheet.
2. Enemy Unit Module: Design multiple enemies including common, ranged, heavy, and elite units.
3. Weapons & Items Module: Show melee, ranged, projectiles, effects, and pickups.
4. Basic Terrain Tile Module: Show ground, walls, platforms, corners, and different material blocks.
5. Natural/External Scene Resource Module: Show trees, grass, rocks, and obstacles.
6. Building/Base/Camp Resource Module: Show doors, windows, walls, ladders, and camp facilities.
7. Special Terrain Module: Show bridges, water bodies, cliffs, and cave openings.
8. Indoor/Underground/Facility Resource Module: Show pipes, consoles, metal doors, and equipment.
9. Boss / Encounter Resource Module: Show large Bosses, special vehicles, and giant mechanisms.
10. General Decoration & Interaction Elements Module: Show ladders, ropes, signs, switches, and mechanisms.

[Visual Detail Requirements]
All resources must maintain consistent pixel size logic and worldview consistency. Clear scale relationships. Action frames must show continuity; terrain tiles must be tileable; items and mechanisms must have functional recognizability; Boss elements should feel oppressive.

promptLocalized.zh:
请基于 [游戏主题: {argument name="game theme" default="鬼灭之刃/炭治郎"}]，创建一个适合系列化发布、高完成度且高信息密度的“像素世界资产图集”。

这并非普通的像素插画或单一游戏场景，而是一份用于游戏开发、美术设定、关卡设计及视觉提案的“2D 像素游戏资产概览图”。视觉效果应呈现为一张完整的游戏素材项目，将 [游戏类型: {argument name="game type" default="横版动作"}] 所需的核心角色、敌人、道具、地形、场景、机关、Boss 及装饰元素，系统性地整理成一张清晰、专业且可复用的游戏资产图集。

[基本设置]
主题世界观：[游戏主题]
游戏类型：[游戏类型]
时代背景：[时代背景]
主角身份：[主角身份]
敌人类型：[敌人类型]
主要场景：[主要场景环境]
整体风格：[风格方向，例如：{argument name="style" default="16-bit 复古街机像素风格"}]
主色调：[主色调]
辅助色：[辅助色]
强调色：[强调色]
长宽比：[长宽比，横向 4:3]
若未填写，将根据游戏主题自动匹配最优方案。

[整体视觉要求]
视觉上采用大尺寸横向画布，背景简洁或干扰度低，呈现出游戏开发资产表或说明书式资源目录的观感。所有元素应为 2D 像素艺术精灵图，具备统一的像素密度、清晰的黑色/深色轮廓、有限的色阶以及复古游戏质感。请勿生成写实摄影、3D 渲染、绘画插图或电影海报风格。重点在于“系统完整、分类清晰、资源丰富且具备高开发性”。

[布局结构]
图集采用模块化网格布局，使用细线划分不同的资源区域。每个区域需包含带编号的标题和简短的类别标签，阅读路径从左至右、从上至下。布局应具备说明书或游戏开发文档的秩序感。信息密度需高但不混乱；各模块内的元素应等距排列。

[包含模块]
1. 玩家角色模块：展示完整的动作帧，包括站立、行走/奔跑、跳跃等，像精灵图表一样横向排列。
2. 敌方单位模块：设计多种敌人，包括普通、远程、重型及精英单位。
3. 武器与道具模块：展示近战、远程、投射物、特效及拾取物。
4. 基础地形瓦片模块：展示地面、墙壁、平台、转角及不同材质的方块。
5. 自然/外部场景资源模块：展示树木、草丛、岩石及障碍物。
6. 建筑/基地/营地资源模块：展示门、窗、墙壁、梯子及营地设施。
7. 特殊地形模块：展示桥梁、水体、悬崖及洞穴入口。
8. 室内/地下/设施资源模块：展示管道、控制台、金属门及设备。
9. Boss / 遭遇战资源模块：展示大型 Boss、特殊载具及巨型机关。
10. 通用装饰与交互元素模块：展示梯子、绳索、标志、开关及机关。

[视觉细节要求]
所有资源必须保持一致的像素尺寸逻辑和世界观连贯性。比例关系明确。动作帧需体现连续性；地形瓦片需支持平铺；道具和机关需具备功能识别度；Boss 元素应体现出压迫感。

templates.title: Isometric Micro-World Cross-Section Archive

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴测微观世界剖面档案

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Please create a high-completion, high-information-density visual map of an 'Isometric Micro-World Archive' suitable for serialized publishing based on the [Theme].

This is not a regular room illustration or a simple architectural drawing, but a thematic space overview combining 'isometric perspective + architectural cross-section structure + multi-layer functional space + high-density thematic props + miniature model feel + game scene concept art feel.' The image should look like an opened miniature world, a business simulation game scene, a dollhouse model, or a world-building concept map, allowing viewers to understand the overall structure at a glance while repeatedly observing the small details within.

[Basic Settings]
Theme: [Theme, e.g., Insect Research Institute / Future Survival Base / Magic Potion Workshop / AI Automation Company / Plant Factory / Children's Learning Center / Space Supply Station]
Space Name / Brand Name: [Brand name or space name, can be empty]
Worldview Direction: [Reality / Sci-Fi / Fairy Tale / Magic / Post-Apocalyptic / Museum / Laboratory / Business Simulation / Campus / Natural Ecology]
Building Type: [Cottage / Base / Factory / Lab / Shop / Museum / Underground Space / Spaceship / Multi-layer Studio]
Core Function: [What this space is mainly used for, e.g., research, production, display, life, training, trading, learning, maintenance, planting]
Main Color: [Main color, e.g., light blue, mint green, cream yellow, pink, orange-green, purple-blue, white-blue tech color]
Auxiliary Color: [Auxiliary color, can be empty]
Accent Color: [Accent color, can be empty]
Aspect Ratio: [1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16]
Information Density: [Medium-high / High / Ultra-high]
Overall Vibe: [Healing, cute, precise, childlike, popular science, futuristic, retro, refreshing, sense of exploration]

If some fields are not filled, please automatically derive them reasonably based on the [Theme]; do not leave the screen blank. All content must be generated uniformly around the theme, avoiding irrelevant elements.

[Visual Structure]
Adopt a clear isometric perspective / axonometric view, where the main subject is an opened multi-layer thematic building or functional base. Viewers can simultaneously see the front, side, top, and internal space of the building. The entire building is located at the center of the screen, occupying most of the area, with the background environment moderately faded to highlight the subject.

The interior of the building needs to be divided into multiple functional areas, each with a clear purpose, rather than randomly piled decorations. It can include:
1. Main work area / Core operation area
2. Display area / Collection area / Specimen area
3. Research area / Lab area / Control area
4. Storage area / Shelving area / Supply area
5. Living area / Rest area / Small residential area
6. Energy area / Machine area / Piping area
7. Planting area / Cultivation area / Ecological area
8. Entrance area / Transport area / Maintenance area
9. Spatial connection structures like stairs, platforms, corridors, railings, ladders, etc.

Clear spatial relationships must be formed between various areas through stairs, corridors, platforms, pipes, bridges, or cables, making the image look like a real, functioning miniature system.

[Props and Details]
Generate a large number of relevant props based on the [Theme] and distribute them in different functional areas. Props need to be specific, identifiable, and thematically related, not just vague decorations. Each small object should be as clear and readable as a game asset, with a feel of being clickable, interactive, and collectable.

Types of props can include:
- Thematic equipment: machines, instruments, tools, consoles, containers, screens, workbenches
- Lifestyle objects: tables/chairs, bookshelves, beds, cups, boxes, cabinets, lamps
- Display objects: specimens, models, posters, signboards, glass cabinets, display racks
- Connection structures: pipes, wires, ladders, stairs, conveyor belts, slide rails, platforms
- Ecological elements: plants, water tanks, incubators, soil, branches, rocks, specimens
- Character elements: small number of characters, animals, robots, or thematic creatures to provide a sense of scale and story

The number of props should be rich but orderly. All props should serve the space's function and the thematic worldview.

[Style Requirements]
The overall style is clear, cute, precise hand-drawn cartoon isometric illustration. Lines are clean, edges are slightly rounded, colors are bright and soft, with an overall relaxed, healing, and exploratory feel. The image should have the feel of a business simulation game, a children's science picture book, a miniature model, or a concept art page.

Avoid over-realism, strong dark lighting/shadows, heavy oil painting feel, and complex noise. The focus is on being clear, exquisite, layered, and highly readable.

[Color and Lighting]
Use high brightness, low-to-medium saturation soft color schemes. The main color is unified, auxiliary colors are used to distinguish different spaces, and accent colors are used to highlight key equipment and small props. Line art colors should not use dead black; instead, use soft outlines like dark gray, blue-gray, or brown-gray.

Keep lighting and shadows lightweight; strong realistic projections are not needed. Build layers through color blocks, structures, lines, and local highlights. The background should use light colors and low-contrast processing to make the main building stand out more.

[Composition and Reading Path]
The main subject is centered or slightly upper-centered, with the building in a multi-layer cross-section structure. The visual reading path should start from the overall building outline, enter the functional areas of each floor, and finally observe the detailed props. The gaze can be guided by elements such as stairs, platforms, corridors, pipelines, and tracks.

The overall image should be full but not crowded, rich but not messy. Every room, platform, and corner should have content, yet still maintain clear spatial boundaries.

[Background Environment]
The background can include a weakened external environment according to the theme, such as a forest, city, street, underground rock layer, experimental park, seabed, space, campus, factory exterior, etc. The background should not compete with the subject; light colors, low opacity, and low contrast are recommended to achieve a 'subject clear, background receding' effect.

[Final Effect]
The final image should look like a complete thematic space concept map, with both the structural feel of an architectural cross-section and the detail of a game scene asset map, combined with the cute exploration feel of a miniature dollhouse. It should be suitable for serialized visual creation, IP worldview display, game scene settings, brand space concept maps, science content covers, or Little Red Book/Pinterest style visual posts.

Ensure the image has:
1. Clear isometric perspective
2. Clear architectural cross-section structure
3. Complete multi-layer functional areas
4. Rich props and thematic unity
5. Soft and bright colors
6. Clean and clear line art
7. Weakened background, prominent subject
8. High information density but not messy
9. A sense of an explorable, operable, and observable miniature world.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 [主题] 创建一张适合系列化发布、高完成度且高信息密度的“等轴测微观世界档案”视觉地图。

这不仅仅是一张普通的房间插画或简单的建筑图纸，而是一个结合了“等轴测视角 + 建筑剖面结构 + 多层功能空间 + 高密度主题道具 + 微缩模型感 + 游戏场景概念艺术感”的主题空间概览。图像应看起来像一个打开的微缩世界、商业模拟游戏场景、娃娃屋模型或世界观构建概念图，让观众一眼就能看清整体结构，同时又能反复观察其中的细微之处。

[基本设置]
主题：[主题，例如：昆虫研究所 / 未来生存基地 / 魔法药水工坊 / AI 自动化公司 / 植物工厂 / 儿童学习中心 / 太空补给站]
空间名称 / 品牌名称：[品牌名称或空间名称，可留空]
世界观方向：[现实 / 科幻 / 童话 / 魔法 / 后启示录 / 博物馆 / 实验室 / 商业模拟 / 校园 / 自然生态]
建筑类型：[小屋 / 基地 / 工厂 / 实验室 / 店铺 / 博物馆 / 地下空间 / 宇宙飞船 / 多层工作室]
核心功能：[该空间的主要用途，例如：研究、生产、展示、生活、培训、交易、学习、维护、种植]
主色调：[主色调，例如：浅蓝、薄荷绿、奶油黄、粉色、橙绿色、紫蓝色、白蓝色科技感]
辅助色：[辅助色，可留空]
强调色：[强调色，可留空]
长宽比：[1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16]
信息密度：[中高 / 高 / 超高]
整体氛围：[治愈、可爱、精准、童趣、科普、未来感、复古、清爽、探索感]

如果某些字段未填写，请根据 [主题] 自动合理推导；请勿留白。所有内容必须围绕主题统一生成，避免无关元素。

[视觉结构]
采用清晰的等轴测视角 / 轴测视图，主体为一个打开的多层主题建筑或功能基地。观众可以同时看到建筑的正面、侧面、顶部和内部空间。整个建筑位于屏幕中心，占据大部分区域，背景环境适度淡化以突出主体。

建筑内部需要划分为多个功能区，每个区域都有明确的用途，而不是随机堆砌装饰。可以包括：
1. 主工作区 / 核心操作区
2. 展示区 / 收藏区 / 标本区
3. 研究区 / 实验室区 / 控制区
4. 存储区 / 货架区 / 补给区
5. 生活区 / 休息区 / 小型居住区
6. 能源区 / 机器区 / 管道区
7. 种植区 / 培育区 / 生态区
8. 入口区 / 交通区 / 维护区
9. 楼梯、平台、走廊、栏杆、梯子等空间连接结构

通过楼梯、走廊、平台、管道、桥梁或电缆，在各个区域之间形成清晰的空间关系，使图像看起来像一个真实运作的微型系统。

[道具与细节]
根据 [主题] 生成大量相关道具，并将它们分布在不同的功能区。道具需要具体、可识别且与主题相关，而不是模糊的装饰。每个小物件都应像游戏资产一样清晰易读，具有可点击、可交互和可收集的感觉。

道具类型可包括：
- 主题设备：机器、仪器、工具、控制台、容器、屏幕、工作台
- 生活用品：桌椅、书架、床、杯子、盒子、柜子、灯具
- 展示物品：标本、模型、海报、招牌、玻璃柜、展示架
- 连接结构：管道、电线、梯子、楼梯、传送带、滑轨、平台
- 生态元素：植物、水箱、培养箱、土壤、树枝、岩石、标本
- 角色元素：少量角色、动物、机器人或主题生物，以提供比例感和故事感

道具数量应丰富但有序。所有道具都应服务于空间的功能和主题世界观。

[风格要求]
整体风格为清晰、可爱、精准的手绘卡通等轴测插画。线条干净，边缘略圆润，色彩明亮柔和，整体具有放松、治愈和探索的感觉。图像应具有商业模拟游戏、儿童科普绘本、微缩模型或概念艺术页面的感觉。

避免过度写实、强烈的暗部光影、厚重的油画感和复杂的噪点。重点在于清晰、精致、有层次且高度易读。

[色彩与光影]
使用高亮度、中低饱和度的柔和配色方案。主色调统一，辅助色用于区分不同空间，强调色用于突出关键设备和小道具。线稿颜色不使用纯黑色，应使用深灰、蓝灰或棕灰等柔和的轮廓线。

保持光影轻盈；不需要强烈的写实投影。通过色块、结构、线条和局部高光来构建层次。背景应使用浅色和低对比度处理，使主体建筑更加突出。

[构图与阅读路径]
主体居中或略微偏上，建筑采用多层剖面结构。视觉阅读路径应从整体建筑轮廓开始，进入各楼层的功能区，最后观察细节道具。视线可以通过楼梯、平台、走廊、管道和轨道等元素进行引导。

整体图像应饱满但不拥挤，丰富但不杂乱。每个房间、平台和角落都应有内容，同时保持清晰的空间边界。

[背景环境]
背景可以根据主题包含减弱的外部环境，例如森林、城市、街道、地下岩层、实验园区、海底、太空、校园、工厂外景等。背景不应与主体竞争；建议使用浅色、低透明度和低对比度，以达到“主体清晰，背景后退”的效果。

[最终效果]
最终图像应看起来像一张完整的主题空间概念图，既有建筑剖面的结构感，又有游戏场景资产图的细节，并结合了微型娃娃屋的可爱探索感。它应适用于系列化视觉创作、IP 世界观展示、游戏场景设定、品牌空间概念图、科普内容封面或小红书 / Pinterest 风格的视觉帖。

确保图像具有：
1. 清晰的等轴测视角
2. 清晰的建筑剖面结构
3. 完整的多层功能区
4. 丰富的道具和主题统一性
5. 柔和明亮的色彩
6. 干净清晰的线稿
7. 减弱的背景，突出的主体
8. 高信息密度但不杂乱
9. 可探索、可操作、可观察的微型世界感。

templates.title: Shadow Ensemble Movie Poster Template

titleLocalized.zh: Shadow Ensemble 电影海报模板

templates.prompt: Please create a high-completion, high-narrative tension 「Shadow Ensemble Cover」 suitable for serialized release based on the [Subject: {argument name="character name" default="Write character names"}]. This is not an ordinary character illustration, nor a simple combat poster, but an "ensemble action cover" with the feel of a novel cover, manga visual, game promotion, and dark fantasy illustration. The image needs to be composed of a huge spiritual core figure, multiple mid-ground action characters, background threat elements, local energy light effects, and a blank title area to form a complete character faction and worldview cover. [Basic Settings] Theme: {argument name="scene theme" default="Jujutsu battle / Dark Journey to the West / Cyber Hunter / Monster Hunting Team / Doomsday Survivor / Magic Academy Battle Group"} Work Name: [Work Name] Series Name / Brand Name: [Brand Name or Series Name] Subtitle: [Subtitle] Style Direction: {argument name="style" default="Dark fantasy, retro manga cover, hand-painted impasto, fantasy novel cover, game visual"} Main Tone: Dark green-black-gray / Deep blue neon / Dark brown-gold-red / Sand yellow-iron rust / Deep purple-gold Accent Color: Blood red energy, turquoise spell light, golden divine light, blue lightning Frame Ratio: 2:3 vertical / 3:4 vertical / 4:5 vertical / 9:16 vertical [Screen Structure] Use a vertical cover composition. There must be a huge visual figure as the spiritual core and atmosphere-dominating element. This person can be a profile, half-body, back, front stare, or huge silhouette, occupying the right, top, or main background area, with a calm, mysterious, and oppressive expression, not necessarily participating in the battle, but must govern the temperament of the whole picture. Arrange 3 to 6 action characters in the middle ground to form a combat faction ensemble. There should be clear division of labor and posture differences between characters, such as charging, holding a knife, casting spells, defense, summoning, jumping, alerting, long-range attack, etc. Avoid characters standing still; a strong rhythmic action and visual movement must be formed. Add enemy threats or worldview elements in the background, such as monsters, giants, villain shadows, mechanical legions, demons, ruins, forests, alien spaces, battlefield smoke, or city disasters. Background threats should not overshadow the main subject but wrap around characters like shadows to enhance the sense of crisis and narrative depth. Set 1 to 2 high-saturation energy hotspots, such as red flame fists, blue lightning, green cursed aura, purple magic, golden divine light, or white sword light. The energy effect should be concentrated on key characters or weapons, forming a visual focus, not uniformly lit across the screen. [Composition] The overall structure is "large spiritual core character + mid-ground action ensemble + background threat shadow + bottom or side blank title area". The image can use diagonal lines to organize characters, letting the ensemble rush from top-left to bottom-right or from bottom to center, forming a strong forward push. Retain a clear blank title area, suggested at the bottom-left, bottom, or side. Use off-white, gray-white, light paper color, or low-saturation background colors for the blank area to place the [Brand Name / Work Name / Subtitle]. The title typography should have a publication cover feel, using elegant serif fonts, retro title letters, manga cover titles, or high-end magazine-style layout. The text area must be clear and not completely blocked by characters and background. Do not make the edges a complete rectangle; use irregular brush edges, ink diffusion, torn paper style, or natural dissipation to let characters and background grow out of the paper, enhancing the hand-drawn cover feel and artistic quality. [Visual Style] The overall style should be a combination of hand-painted impasto and manga cover, with paper texture, brushstrokes, dark layers, and a retro publication temperament. Lighting is mainly low-key dark light with a darkened background, clear character silhouettes, and high-contrast focal points provided by local energy light. The image should not be excessively clean; it should retain hand-painted textures, paper grain, edge strokes, and dark mist. Use low-saturation dark tones mainly, supplemented by a small amount of high-saturation energy colors. The overall atmosphere should have a sense of pressure, mystery, combat, and worldview thickness. [Visual Goal] The final image should look like a mature fantasy novel cover, manga special cover, game character faction visual, or IP promo poster. It needs to possess: 1. A clear main visual character; 2. An ensemble with rhythmic movement; 3. Clear enemy threats or worldview background; 4. Strong but restrained energy effects; 5. A readable title text area; 6. An overall texture of a retro hand-drawn cover. Ensure the image is informative but not cluttered, with clear character levels and visual gravity, suitable for continuing to generate the same series with different themes.

promptLocalized.zh:
请基于 [Subject: {argument name="character name" default="填写角色名称"}] 创建一个高完成度、高叙事张力的「Shadow Ensemble 封面」，适用于系列化发布。这不仅仅是一张普通的人物插画或简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面、漫画视觉、游戏宣传及暗黑奇幻插画质感的“群像动作封面”。画面需要由一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效以及留白的标题区域组成，从而形成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。

[基础设置]
主题：{argument name="scene theme" default="咒术对决 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 怪兽狩猎小队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗群"}
作品名称：[作品名称]
系列名称 / 品牌名称：[品牌名称或系列名称]
副标题：[副标题]
风格导向：{argument name="style" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏视觉"}
主色调：深绿-黑-灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕-金-红 / 沙黄-铁锈 / 深紫-金
强调色：血红能量、青色咒光、金色神光、蓝色闪电
画面比例：2:3 竖版 / 3:4 竖版 / 4:5 竖版 / 9:16 竖版

[画面结构]
采用竖版封面构图。必须有一个巨大的视觉人物作为精神核心和氛围主导元素。此人可以是侧影、半身、背影、正面凝视或巨大剪影，占据右侧、顶部或主要背景区域，表情冷静、神秘且具有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张画面的气质。

在中景安排 3 到 6 个动作角色，形成战斗阵营群像。角色之间应有明确的分工和姿态差异，如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免角色静止站立；必须形成强烈的节奏感动作和视觉动势。

在背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，如怪物、巨人、反派阴影、机械军团、恶魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，以增强危机感和叙事深度。

设置 1 到 2 个高饱和度能量热点，如红色的火焰拳、蓝色闪电、绿色咒力、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色剑气。能量效果应集中在关键角色或武器上，形成视觉焦点，而非全屏均匀发光。

[构图]
整体结构为“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”。画面可利用对角线组织角色，让群像从左上向右下或从底部向中心冲锋，形成强烈的向前推进感。

保留清晰的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或侧边。留白区域使用灰白色、浅纸色或低饱和度背景色，以便放置 [品牌名称 / 作品名称 / 副标题]。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，使用优雅的衬线字体、复古标题字母、漫画封面标题或高端杂志风格布局。文字区域必须清晰，且不被角色和背景完全遮挡。

不要让边缘呈完全的矩形；使用不规则的笔触边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸风格或自然消散，让角色和背景从纸张中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术品质。

[视觉风格]
整体风格应结合手绘厚涂与漫画封面，具有纸张纹理、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，角色轮廓清晰，并由局部能量光提供高对比度焦点。画面不应过于洁净；应保留手绘质感、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。主要使用低饱和度暗色调，辅以少量高饱和度能量色。整体氛围应具备压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。

[视觉目标]
最终图像应看起来像成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特刊封面、游戏角色阵营视觉或 IP 宣传海报。它需要具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 具有节奏动势的群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但克制的能量效果；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。确保画面信息丰富但不杂乱，角色层次分明，视觉重心明确，适合持续生成不同主题的同一系列作品。

templates.title: Ethereal Buddhist Pure Land scene

titleLocalized.zh: 空灵的佛教净土场景

templates.prompt:
The Western Paradise (also known as the Western Pure Land, Sukhavati) is the Buddha-land of Amitabha (Infinite Life Buddha). Its core characteristic is the absence of all suffering and the experience of only joy, in stark contrast to our 'enduring' (Saha) world. Located in the west of our world, ten trillion Buddha-lands away (Amitabha Sutra).

Main Buddha: Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Light, Infinite Life), who constantly preaches the Dharma; flanked by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, collectively known as the 'Three Sages of the West'.

Land Environment: Adorned with Seven Treasures, flawless.
Ground: Gold as the ground, flat, soft, bright, and clean, without mountains, rivers, ravines, thorns, or stones.
Seven Treasure Ponds and Eight Merit Waters: Seven treasure ponds everywhere (gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, tridacna, red pearl, agate). The water possesses eight merits: sweet, cold, soft, light, clear, fragrant, thirst-quenching, and heart-nourishing. Golden sand at the bottom, seven-treasure pathways, and lotuses in the pond as large as wheels, emitting blue, yellow, red, and white light.
Architecture: Seven-treasure pavilions, palaces, and lecture halls, floating in the air, changing size at will, transparent and bright, countless times better than the heavenly realms.
Precious Trees and Heavenly Music: Seven rows of trees, seven rows of railings, seven rows of nets, all made of four treasures. The wind blows through the trees and nets, producing subtle Dharma sounds like hundreds of thousands of instruments playing together, naturally leading listeners to mindfulness of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.
Climate and Heavenly Rain: No heat or cold, no wind or rain, always mild and comfortable; Mandarava flowers rain down from the sky six times a day and night, fragrant and colorful.
Marvelous Birds: White cranes, peacocks, parrots, Kalavinkas, etc., all manifested by the Buddha to produce harmonious sounds proclaiming the Dharma.

Sentient Beings: No suffering, only joy, infinite lifespan.
Rebirth: Beings are born from lotus flowers in the seven treasure ponds, not from parents, free from the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death.
Appearance: Purple-gold bodies, majestic and solemn, similar to Amitabha Buddha; possessing five supernatural powers: heavenly eye, heavenly ear, telepathy, past-life recall, and spiritual travel, free and unobstructed.
Lifespan: Immeasurable kalpas, nearly eternal, without early death or aging.
Nature: All are superior good people, free from greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, or conflict; compassionate, equal, wise, and pure, constantly hearing the Dharma.
Life: Clothing and food manifest naturally without labor; in the morning, one can visit ten trillion Buddha-lands to offer to Buddhas and return by mealtime.

Time and Space: Infinite and Eternal.
Time: No day or night, no months or years, eternal happiness; the world does not undergo the changes of formation, existence, decay, and void.
Space: Vast and boundless, never crowded even with beings from all ten directions; a single grain of dust can contain three thousand great worlds.

promptLocalized.zh:
西方极乐世界（又称西方净土、Sukhavati）是阿弥陀佛（无量寿佛）的佛国。其核心特征是远离一切苦难，唯有纯粹的快乐，这与我们所处的“堪忍”（娑婆）世界形成鲜明对比。它位于我们世界西方，距离十万亿佛土之遥（详见《阿弥陀经》）。

主佛：阿弥陀佛（无量光、无量寿），常宣讲佛法；左右侍奉观世音菩萨和大势至菩萨，合称“西方三圣”。

国土环境：以七宝庄严，纯净无瑕。
大地：以黄金为地，平坦、柔软、明亮且洁净，没有高山、河流、沟壑、荆棘或岩石。
七宝池与八功德水：遍布七宝池（金、银、琉璃、水晶、砗磲、赤珠、玛瑙）。池水具备八种功德：甘甜、清凉、柔软、轻盈、清澈、芬芳、解渴、滋养心神。池底铺满金沙，池边有七宝阶道，池中莲花大如车轮，散发出青、黄、赤、白四色光芒。
建筑：七宝亭台、宫殿和讲堂，悬浮于空中，大小随心变化，通透晶莹，远胜于天界。
宝树与天乐：七重行树、七重栏楯、七重罗网，皆由四宝所成。微风吹拂树木与罗网，发出微妙的法音，如同百千种乐器同时演奏，自然引导听者生起对佛、法、僧三宝的念想。
气候与天雨：无寒暑之分，无风雨之灾，气候始终温和舒适；天空中昼夜六时飘落曼陀罗花，芬芳且色彩斑斓。
奇妙之鸟：白鹤、孔雀、鹦鹉、迦陵频伽等，皆为阿弥陀佛所化现，发出和谐的鸣叫声，宣扬佛法。

众生：无苦，唯有乐，寿命无量。
往生：众生皆从七宝池中的莲花化生，非父母所生，免受生、老、病、死之苦。
外貌：皆为紫磨真金色身，庄严殊胜，与阿弥陀佛相似；具备五种神通：天眼通、天耳通、他心通、宿命通、神足通，自在无碍。
寿命：历经无量劫，近乎永恒，无夭折或衰老之忧。
本性：皆为诸上善人，远离贪、嗔、痴、嫉妒或冲突；慈悲、平等、智慧且清净，常闻佛法。
生活：衣食自然化现，无需劳作；清晨可前往十万亿佛土供养诸佛，并在用餐时间返回。

时空：无限且永恒。
时间：无昼夜、无年月，永恒幸福；该世界不经历成、住、坏、空的演变。
空间：广袤无垠，即使容纳十方众生也永不拥挤；一粒微尘中即可容纳三千大千世界。

templates.title: Landscape Archive Model Map

titleLocalized.zh: 景观档案模型模板

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Based on the {argument name="subject" default="subject"}, create a high-quality visual of a "Landscape Archive Model" suitable for serial publication.

This is not a regular map, landscape illustration, or urban rendering, but a high-end archival visual combining "2D map drawings + 3D regional models + professional explanation systems + museum exhibition feel." The image should resemble a realistically crafted geographical research model, urban planning sandbox, architectural proposal model, or world-building exhibit, possessing a professional, restrained, precise, and tactile premium quality.

[Basic Settings]
Subject: {argument name="subject details" default="subject, e.g., Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing Mountain City / Island City / Ancient Ruins / Post-apocalyptic Ruins / Fantasy Continent / Game Capital"}
Subject Type: [Natural Landscape / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape]
Core Subject: {argument name="core subject" default="core subject, e.g., crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old town, landmark group, island city, ruin group, main city area"}
Content Focus: [Terrain Elevation / Urban Landmarks / Road Network / Hydrology / Relationship between Nature and City / Setting Collection Display]
Style Direction: [Geographic Surveying Style, Paper-cut Model Style, Architectural Proposal Style, Museum Archive Style, Urban Planning Style, Game Setting Collection Style]
Primary Color: [Off-white, Light Gray, Parchment White, Sand, Snow White]
Secondary Color: [Earthy Brown, Rock Gray, Cold Gray, Light Blue, Moss Green]
Accent Color: [Black thin lines, Red routes, Blue hydrological lines, Yellow numbering marks]
Aspect Ratio: [16:9 Landscape / 3:4 Portrait / 4:5 Portrait / 1:1 Square]

[Visual Structure]
The main subject is a rectangular map model board placed on a clean tabletop or white cloth surface. The base plate has realistic thickness with a visible section structure, like a refined map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with a clear but restrained layer of information, including contour lines, road networks, hydrological lines, zoning boundaries, geographical textures, a sense of coordinates, slight annotations, and drawing borders.

In the center or off-center area of the map, a 3D main model "grows" out of the 2D map, serving as the visual core of the entire image.

If the [Subject Type] is Natural Landscape:
The subject may consist of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, and coastlines, emphasizing terrain elevation, layered contour structures, rock wall textures, and natural terrain fluctuations.

If the [Subject Type] is Urban Space:
The subject may consist of core urban areas, CBDs, old city blocks, landmark clusters, waterfronts, road network nodes, bridges, water systems, and parks, emphasizing building volumes, urban recognizability, spatial hierarchy, and planning structures.

If the [Subject Type] is Mixed Landscape:
It should integrate both natural terrain and man-made environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient ruins, post-apocalyptic ruins, fantasy capitals, or sci-fi bases, allowing natural geography and urban structure to jointly form the core visual.

[Detail Requirements]
- Retain the feel of map drawings and professional information on the model surface.
- Terrain areas should have contour lines, slope layers, and relationships of depression and elevation.
- Building areas should have a sense of volume, block relationships, and clear hierarchy.
- Water bodies use low-saturation light blue.
- Green spaces, forests, parks, and mountains use moss green or low-saturation green.
- Road networks, paths, traffic axes, or exploration lines can be represented by fine lines but should not overwhelm the main subject.
- Landmark buildings or key structures should have clear recognizability.
- For fantasy, sci-fi, or game settings, maintain the archive model and drawing display feel rather than a pure scene illustration.

[Explanation System]
The edges of the map board need a complete and restrained explanation module, including:
- Outer and inner frames
- Scale bar
- Legend area
- Title area
- Archive number
- Index markers
- Annotation labels
- Simple symbolic explanations
Text doesn't need to be fully readable, but the overall structure must present a realistic, clear, precise, and orderly archival layout.

[Composition and Camera]
Use an oblique isometric or sandbox-style composition. The camera observes the entire model board from about 30 to 45 degrees above, allowing the audience to see the map plane, 3D subject height, edge thickness, and explanation areas. The visual focus is on the central main model, with the reading path being: first the core subject, then the surrounding terrain/road/water/block information, and finally the legend, scale, and explanation area.

[Material and Lighting]
The overall look needs realistic model photography texture:
- Paper texture
- Map printing texture
- Paper-cut or sandbox model feel
- Architectural model or terrain slice texture
- Soft natural light
- Delicate realistic shadows
- Clean background
- Low saturation, high-end, and restrained
Avoid cartoonishness, cheap game UI feel, excessive clutter, or excessive showboating. Highlight the unified visual of "map base board + 3D subject + professional explanation system."

The final effect should resemble a landscape archive model image that can be used for geographical education, urban research, architectural proposals, cultural tourism visual themes, world-building setting collections, or high-end series covers.

promptLocalized.zh:
请基于 {argument name="subject" default="长城 / 珠穆朗玛峰 / 外滩 / 珠江"} 创建一个高质量、专业的“景观档案模型”视觉图，适用于系列展示。

这不仅仅是一张普通的地图或简单的景观插画，而是一种结合了“2D 地图制图 + 3D 区域模型 + 专业注释系统 + 博物馆展览感”的高端档案视觉呈现。图像应看起来像真实的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑方案模型或世界构建展品，具有专业、克制、精确且富有触感的优质质感。

[基本设置]
主题：{argument name="subject content" default="火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆"}
主题类型：[自然地形 / 城市空间 / 混合景观]
核心主体：[核心主体，例如：火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗迹、主城区]
内容重点：[内容重点，例如：地形高程 / 城市地标 / 路网 / 水系 / 自然与城市关系 / 场景集合展示]
风格：{argument name="style" default="地理测绘风格、纸艺模型风格、建筑方案风格、博物馆档案风格、城市规划风格"}
主色调：[主色调，例如：米白色、浅灰色、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白色]
辅色调：[辅色调，例如：大地棕、岩石灰、冷灰色、浅蓝色、苔藓绿]
点缀色：[点缀色，例如：细黑线、红色路线、蓝色水系线、黄色编号标记]
长宽比：[长宽比，例如：16:9 横屏 / 3:4 竖屏 / 4:5 竖屏 / 1:1 正方形]

[构图]
主体是一个放置在干净桌面或白布上的长方形地图项目。底板具有真实的厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，如同精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖着清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、路网、水系、区域边界、地理纹理、坐标感、细微注释和绘图边框。

在中心或偏中心区域，一个 3D 模型从 2D 地图中“生长”出来，成为整个图像的视觉核心。

若 [主题类型] 为自然地形：主体由山脉、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层或海岸线组成，强调高程、分层等高线结构、岩壁纹理及自然地形起伏。

若 [主题类型] 为城市空间：主体由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标群、滨水区、道路节点、桥梁、水系或公园组成，强调建筑体量、城市特征、空间层次及规划结构。

若 [主题类型] 为混合景观：融合自然地形与人造环境，例如山城、岛屿城市、古代遗迹、末日废土、奇幻都城或科幻基地。

[细节要求]
- 表面保留地图纸张质感和专业信息感。
- 地形区域应具备等高线、坡度分层和凹陷感。
- 建筑区域应具备体量感、街区关系和清晰的层级。
- 水体使用低饱和度的浅蓝色。
- 绿地/森林使用苔藓绿或低饱和度绿色。
- 路网使用细线条，避免喧宾夺主。
- 地标应清晰可辨。
- 科幻/奇幻元素应保持档案模型感，而非纯粹的场景插画。

[注释系统]
地图项目边缘需要完整且克制的注释模块，包括边框线、比例尺、图例区、标题区、档案编号、索引标记、注释标签和简单的符号说明。文字无需完全可读，但必须呈现出真实、清晰、精确且有序的档案排版。

[相机与光影]
使用斜向俯视的等轴测或沙盘构图，相机角度约为 30 到 45 度，展示地图平面、模型高度、边缘厚度及注释区域。光影应柔和自然，在干净的背景上投射出细腻的真实阴影，避免卡通化或廉价的游戏 UI 感。

templates.title: 1980s Japanese Film Style Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 1980 年代日本电影风格分镜脚本

templates.prompt: Using the technique of abstractly expressing characters' emotions through dance, as seen in recently developed Indian cinema dance scenes, create a video portraying the anti-foreigner (Jo-i) enthusiasm of attackers like Shinsaku Takasugi just before the burning of the British Legation on January 31, 1863, set in an Edo town with a Western film atmosphere. Characters should be based on internet research of actual historical figures, with their features emphasized to look like characters in a period drama. To avoid rejection by video generation services, do not include sexual expressions, violence, or elements similar to existing works. The image quality should be a realistic photo from a 1980s live-action Japanese film. Conceive a storyboard and generate 8 landscape images (16:9 aspect ratio) for each shot from Start frame to End frame for Seedance 2.0. n=8. Be bold and comedic, using close-ups effectively. 1980s Japanese cinema look, shot on 35mm motion picture film. Photochemical texture, organic grain, subtle halation, soft highlight roll-off, slightly lifted blacks, realistic contrast, no digital sharpness, no HDR. Use a 35mm cinema camera with vintage spherical prime lenses. Lens style: 28mm, 35mm, 50mm, 85mm; mostly 35mm and 50mm for dialogue and observational framing. 24 fps, 180-degree shutter, restrained handheld and tripod shots, slow deliberate movement. Lighting is naturalistic and practical: mixed fluorescent and tungsten interior lighting, slightly underexposed, soft shadows, realistic skin tones. Color palette is subdued and earthy: brown, beige, olive, cream, muted red, with a slight yellow-green fluorescent cast. Film stock look inspired by Kodak Eastman 5247 / 5294. The overall feeling is intimate, understated, dryly comic, realistic, and melancholic, like a Japanese feature film from the 1980s. A video expressing the Jo-i spirit of the attackers like Takasugi Shinsaku just before the burning of the British Legation on January 31, 1863, in an Edo town with a Western atmosphere, using techniques from Indian cinema dance scenes. A musical film with no dialogue. A flashy, up-tempo song like an Indian movie dance scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 借鉴近期印度电影舞蹈场景中通过舞蹈抽象表达角色情感的技巧，创作一段视频，描绘 1863 年 1 月 31 日英国公使馆纵火案前夕，以高杉晋作（Shinsaku Takasugi）为首的袭击者们所展现出的“攘夷”热情。场景设定在具有西方电影氛围的江户城镇。角色应基于对真实历史人物的网络研究，并强调其特征，使其看起来像时代剧中的人物。为避免被视频生成服务拒绝，请勿包含性暗示、暴力或与现有作品相似的元素。图像质量应呈现 1980 年代日本真人电影的写实照片质感。构思分镜脚本，并为 Seedance 2.0 的每个镜头从起始帧到结束帧生成 8 张横向图像（16:9 宽高比）。n=8。风格要大胆且具有喜剧色彩，有效利用特写镜头。1980 年代日本电影外观，使用 35mm 电影胶片拍摄。具有光化学质感、有机颗粒感、细微的光晕、柔和的高光过渡、略微提升的暗部、写实的对比度，无数字锐化，无 HDR。使用配备复古球面定焦镜头的 35mm 电影摄影机。镜头规格：28mm、35mm、50mm、85mm；对话和观察性构图主要使用 35mm 和 50mm 镜头。24 fps，180 度快门，克制的肩扛和三脚架拍摄，缓慢而从容的运镜。灯光自然且实用：混合荧光灯和钨丝灯室内照明，略微欠曝，柔和的阴影，真实的肤色。色调柔和且偏大地色：棕色、米色、橄榄色、奶油色、柔和的红色，并带有轻微的黄绿色荧光感。胶片质感灵感源自 Kodak Eastman 5247 / 5294。整体感觉亲切、内敛、冷幽默、写实且忧郁，如同 1980 年代的日本剧情片。这是一部音乐电影，没有对话，通过印度电影舞蹈场景的技巧，展现 1863 年 1 月 31 日英国公使馆纵火案前夕，以高杉晋作为首的袭击者们的“攘夷”精神。配乐为类似印度电影舞蹈场景的华丽快节奏歌曲。

templates.title: Pastel Luxury Skincare Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调奢华护肤广告

templates.prompt: Create a vertical luxury skincare advertisement in a soft feminine pastel aesthetic, styled like a viral Instagram or TikTok beauty promo with no app UI. Show a single glass dropper serum bottle centered on a fluffy lavender-purple surface, photographed in ultra-realistic studio lighting with warm golden sunlight streaming from the upper left, soft shadows, glossy reflections, dreamy haze, and creamy bokeh in the background. The bottle label should read {argument name="brand name" default="ELEGANT SKINCARE"} and {argument name="product name" default="SERUM"}, with a pale pink-lilac translucent bottle and shiny rose-gold dropper cap. Surround the product with an elegant feminine vanity setup: 1 gold-framed round tabletop mirror on the left, 1 lit white candle in a glass jar on the right, 1 pearl necklace draped across the lower left foreground, and 4 clusters of white baby's breath flowers placed in the left foreground, left midground near the mirror, right foreground, and far right edge. Add cute hand-drawn doodle decorations in white and purple: curved arrows pointing toward the serum, sparkles, tiny hearts, short accent strokes, and small loops scattered around the composition. Include 2 paper note cards: one left of the bottle saying {argument name="left note text" default="My daily glow secret!"}, and one lower right saying {argument name="right note text" default="Feels amazing!"}; add 1 small round lavender sticker attached to the right note that says "MUST HAVE". Use large handwritten dark-purple headline text at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"}, with a torn white tape-style strip underneath containing {argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"}. Add smaller dark-purple copy to the upper right of the bottle reading "For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin", and at the bottom center repeat "For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin" with "Self care Everyday" beneath it in a lighter soft white tone. Keep the composition clean, premium, cozy, glossy, and highly aesthetic, with the serum as the clear focal point.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版奢华护肤广告，采用柔和女性化的粉彩色调，风格类似于 Instagram 或 TikTok 上的热门美妆宣传，且不含任何应用 UI。画面中心展示一瓶玻璃滴管精华液，放置在蓬松的薰衣草紫色表面上，采用超写实摄影棚灯光拍摄，左上方有温暖的金色阳光射入，伴随柔和阴影、光泽反射、梦幻雾感以及背景中奶油般的虚化效果。瓶身标签应显示 {argument name="brand name" default="ELEGANT SKINCARE"} 和 {argument name="product name" default="SERUM"}，瓶身为淡粉紫色的半透明材质，配有闪亮的玫瑰金滴管盖。产品周围布置优雅的女性化梳妆台：左侧放置 1 面金色边框圆形桌面镜，右侧放置 1 个玻璃罐装的白色点燃蜡烛，左下方前景处垂挂 1 条珍珠项链，并在左前景、镜子附近的左中景、右前景以及最右侧边缘放置 4 簇白色满天星花束。添加可爱的白色和紫色手绘涂鸦装饰：指向精华液的弯曲箭头、闪光点、小爱心、短装饰笔触以及散布在构图周围的小圆圈。包含 2 张纸质便签：瓶子左侧的一张写着 {argument name="left note text" default="My daily glow secret!"}，右下方的一张写着 {argument name="right note text" default="Feels amazing!"}；在右侧便签上贴 1 个写有“MUST HAVE”的小圆形薰衣草色贴纸。顶部使用醒目的深紫色手写标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"}，下方配有一条撕裂的白色胶带风格条，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"}。在瓶子右上方添加较小的深紫色文案“For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin”，并在底部中心重复“For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin”，下方以更浅的柔白色调写上“Self care Everyday”。保持构图简洁、高端、舒适、有光泽且极具美感，确保精华液成为视觉焦点。

templates.title: Indian Auto Rickshaw Street Photo

templates.prompt: A realistic street photography image in India, vertical composition, showing the exact rear view of a black-and-yellow auto rickshaw centered in frame on a narrow busy market street. The camera is positioned low and directly behind the vehicle, creating a strong symmetrical composition with the rickshaw filling most of the image. The top yellow canopy has bold uppercase red text reading {argument name="top text" default="AB TO PEECHHAA CHHOD DO MERA"}. The back panel below the window is black with large bold uppercase white text in 3 stacked lines reading {argument name="bottom text" default="ITNI BHI SUNDAR NAHI HU MAIN"}. Show 2 rectangular rear tail lights, one on each side, a worn metal bumper, mud flaps, scuffed paint, dirt, scratches, and realistic age on the vehicle. The street background contains market shops, signboards, pedestrians on both sides, and a few distant figures, but kept softly blurred with shallow depth of field so the rickshaw remains sharp. Warm daylight, realistic Indian urban atmosphere, natural colors, subtle cinematic bokeh, high detail textures, documentary street-photo realism, 4K ultra-realistic.

The lower half of the figure dissolves into elongated dripping black ink trails, with many uneven vertical streaks extending downward like wet paint pulled by gravity, creating a dramatic melting silhouette. Place 1 large, perfectly round vivid red disc directly behind her head and upper shoulders, centered like a halo or rising sun. Use a strictly limited palette of black, red, and warm off-white. Set the background to a soft cream paper or canvas texture with subtle grain. Light the subject like a high-end noir editorial portrait with strong contrast, sculpted highlights on the ear, jaw, neck, and cheek contour, and deep shadow across the clothing. Keep the composition tall and centered with generous negative space, elegant poster-like balance, moody contemplative atmosphere, and crisp, refined photographic detail blended with painterly graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义艺术海报肖像，画面为一位女性的干净侧面，面向右侧，展示范围约为上半身。她的面部被头部前方柔和的矩形模糊效果部分遮挡。她留着深黑色头发，梳成低垂的松散发髻，带有自然的蓬松感和细碎发丝，可见的耳朵上戴着 1 只银色吊坠耳环。为她穿上一件结构感十足的黑色西装外套或剪裁考究的大衣，领口深邃。人物下半部分溶解为拉长的黑色滴墨痕迹，许多不均匀的垂直条纹向下延伸，如同受重力牵引的湿颜料，营造出戏剧性的融化剪影。在她的头部和上肩部正后方放置 1 个巨大的、完美的鲜红色圆盘，如同光环或初升的太阳般居中。使用严格限制的黑色、红色和暖米白色调色板。背景设置为柔和的奶油色纸张或带有细微纹理的画布。以高端黑色电影编辑肖像的方式为拍摄对象布光，强调强烈的对比度，在耳朵、下颌、颈部和脸颊轮廓处雕琢出高光，并在服装上投下深邃的阴影。构图保持竖向居中，留有充足的负空间，呈现优雅的海报式平衡感，营造出忧郁沉思的氛围，并将清晰精致的摄影细节与绘画般的平面设计融为一体。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极简主义竖版艺术海报，主体为一名身着干练西装的男子侧影，面向左侧，画面呈现从大腿中部向上的视角。他穿着剪裁得体的深色西装外套、挺括的白衬衫，并戴着一顶带有丝带装饰的 1940 年代复古黑色软呢帽。他的姿态挺拔、沉稳且自信，散发出经典的黑色电影主角气质。以精致的单色摄影风格渲染人物，细节清晰，色调对比强烈，并运用受伦勃朗启发的戏剧性光影，勾勒出脸颊、耳朵、下颌线、帽檐和肩部的深邃阴影。在头部和上半身的正后方放置一个醒目的正圆形红色圆盘，如同光环或初升的太阳般居中，形成强烈的视觉焦点。背景应为干净的灰白色或米色纸质纹理，带有细腻的颗粒感，并在主体周围保留充足的留白。人物下半身应溶解为细长的黑色墨滴：从西装下摆和身体下部垂下 12 条粗细不一的明显滴痕，有的长而直，有的逐渐变细，并伴有少量细小溅点，仿佛身体正在融入画布。配色方案严格限制在黑色、红色和温暖的灰白色。整体氛围应沉郁、深思、优雅、略带不祥且具有现代感，宛如一张将黑色电影肖像与超现实水墨抽象艺术相结合的高端画廊海报。

templates.prompt: A highly realistic studio portrait of a woman in her mid-20s with a naturally fit build, framed from mid-torso up at eye level, standing in a relaxed yet confident pose with squared shoulders and a calm, neutral, self-assured expression. She has thick, long, dark brown to nearly black curly hair with natural volume, loose defined curls, and a slightly off-center part, falling over both shoulders. She wears 2 visible clothing pieces: an olive green fitted crew-neck t-shirt and a light beige casual jacket worn open and slipping off both shoulders for an effortless editorial look. Use a muted neutral palette with earthy tones. Shoot with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, tack-sharp focus on the subject, shallow depth of field, and soft natural background blur. Place her against a clean smooth studio backdrop in a soft warm beige-gray neutral gradient with no distractions. Keep skin tones accurate and realistic, color grading natural and balanced, post-processing minimal, and overall styling like a modern editorial fashion portrait in casual streetwear, ultra-detailed, clean, and photorealistic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的影棚肖像，主角是一位 20 多岁、身材匀称的女性。构图采用平视视角，截取至上半身，她站姿放松而自信，双肩平直，表情平静、中性且充满自信。她拥有一头浓密的长发，发色为深棕色至近乎黑色，卷发自然蓬松且纹理清晰，发缝略微偏分，自然垂落在双肩。她身着两件可见的服饰：一件橄榄绿修身圆领 T 恤，外搭一件浅米色休闲外套，外套敞开并从双肩滑落，营造出一种随性的编辑风格。色彩采用柔和的中性色调，以大地色系为主。使用 85mm 人像镜头，光圈 f/2.8，焦点精准对准主体，景深较浅，背景呈现柔和的自然虚化效果。布光采用专业影棚设置：柔和的正面主光，细腻的补光以保留柔和的阴影细节，以及微弱的轮廓光以增强主体与背景的层次感。背景为干净平滑的影棚幕布，呈现柔和的暖米灰色中性渐变，无任何杂物干扰。肤色真实自然，调色平衡，后期处理极简，整体风格如同现代编辑风格的休闲街头时尚肖像，超高细节，干净且逼真。

templates.title: Filmmaking Eras Typographic Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 电影时代排版网格

templates.prompt:
Create a clean 2x2 grid on a pure white studio background featuring 4 large 3D typographic sculptures, each a single character built entirely from filmmaking equipment from a different era. The four glyphs are exactly 4 characters: top-left letter A, top-right number 5, bottom-left letter X, bottom-right number 9. Each character should be front-facing, centered in its quadrant, legible but formed from a dense pile of realistic cinema tools and on-set props, with believable occlusion, weight, and construction logic. Use high-end Cinema 4D product visualization, subtle ambient occlusion, soft three-point studio lighting with a softbox overhead, crisp shadows, realistic materials, and isolated composition.

Top-left: the letter A made from early cinema and silent-era equipment, assembled from vintage wooden tripods, hand-cranked film cameras, brass lenses, reels, megaphones, bell-shaped horns, matte black metal parts, leather straps, and aged wood. Surface qualities should include worn varnished wood, black crackle paint, brass tarnish, scuffed metal, and dusty antique patina. The silhouette should feel chaotic but readable, with tripod legs and old camera bodies defining the A shape.

Top-right: the number 5 made from mid-century analog filmmaking gear, assembled from classic film cameras, magazine reels, metal canisters, brown leather cases, audio accessories, silver fabric packs, director chairs, cylindrical lenses, grips, and vintage production bags. Materials should emphasize brushed aluminum, leather, canvas, rubber, and weathered industrial finishes. The 5 should be chunky and balanced, with stacked props tightly packed into the glyph.

Bottom-left: the letter X made from late 20th century video and broadcast equipment, assembled from shoulder-mount camcorders, portable recorders, battery packs, coiled cables, cassette-like modules, control panels, worn blue and gray plastic housings, and rugged field electronics. Include visible wiring and taped components. Materials should feel utilitarian and slightly battered, with dark plastic, anodized metal, stickers, rubber grips, and yellow accent details. The crossing diagonals of the X must be clear and substantial.

Bottom-right: the number 9 made from contemporary digital cinema and virtual production gear, assembled from modern cinema cameras, compact monitors, LED light panels, drones, gimbals, matte boxes, black modular accessories, and a vivid green chroma screen wrap forming part of the numeral. Include sleek vents, carbon fiber textures, matte black metal, polished glass, and bright green screen fabric as the dominant accent color. The 9 should feel the most modern and refined, with modular precision and clean industrial design.

Keep the background plain and uncluttered, no extra text, no floating objects, no flat typography, no 2D rendering. The sculptures should look like physical objects at realistic scale, highly detailed, photorealistic, and suitable as a graphic design asset.

promptLocalized.zh:
在纯白色的工作室背景上创建一个整洁的 2x2 网格，展示 4 个大型 3D 排版雕塑，每个字符均完全由不同时代的电影制作设备构建而成。这四个字形精确为 4 个字符：左上角字母 A，右上角数字 5，左下角字母 X，右下角数字 9。每个字符应正对前方，位于各自象限的中心，清晰可辨，但由密集的逼真电影工具和片场道具堆叠而成，具有可信的遮挡关系、重量感和结构逻辑。使用高端 Cinema 4D 产品可视化技术，采用微妙的环境光遮蔽、柔和的三点式工作室布光（顶部配有柔光箱）、清晰的阴影、逼真的材质以及独立的构图。

左上角：由早期电影和默片时代设备构成的字母 A，由复古木制三脚架、手摇电影摄影机、黄铜镜头、胶片盘、扩音器、喇叭形号角、哑光黑色金属部件、皮带和陈旧木材组装而成。表面质感应包括磨损的清漆木材、黑色裂纹漆、黄铜锈迹、磨损的金属和布满灰尘的古董包浆。轮廓应显得杂乱但可辨认，三脚架腿和旧摄影机机身勾勒出 A 的形状。

右上角：由 20 世纪中期模拟电影制作器材构成的数字 5，由经典电影摄影机、胶片盒、金属罐、棕色皮箱、音频配件、银色织物包、导演椅、圆柱形镜头、场务器材和复古制作包组装而成。材质应强调拉丝铝、皮革、帆布、橡胶和风化的工业饰面。数字 5 应显得厚实且平衡，道具堆叠紧密，构成字形。

左下角：由 20 世纪末视频和广播设备构成的字母 X，由肩扛式摄像机、便携式录音机、电池组、盘绕电缆、盒式模块、控制面板、磨损的蓝灰色塑料外壳和坚固的现场电子设备组装而成。包含可见的布线和胶带固定的组件。材质应具有实用感且略显破旧，带有深色塑料、阳极氧化金属、贴纸、橡胶手柄和黄色点缀细节。X 的交叉对角线必须清晰且厚实。

右下角：由当代数字电影和虚拟制作器材构成的数字 9，由现代电影摄影机、紧凑型监视器、LED 灯板、无人机、稳定器、遮光斗、黑色模块化配件以及构成数字一部分的鲜艳绿色绿幕布组装而成。包含光滑的通风口、碳纤维纹理、哑光黑色金属、抛光玻璃，并以明亮的绿幕织物作为主导点缀色。数字 9 应显得最为现代和精致，具有模块化的精确性和简洁的工业设计感。

保持背景简洁明了，无额外文字，无漂浮物体，无平面排版，无 2D 渲染。雕塑应看起来像具有真实比例的实体物体，细节丰富，具有照片级真实感，适合作为平面设计素材使用。

Use high-end Cinema 4D product-render aesthetics, ambient occlusion, realistic scale relationships, intricate kit-bashing, subtle wear, metallic reflections, and three-point studio lighting with a soft overhead source. Top-left: the letter S, representing early silent-era or proto-cinema filmmaking, constructed from antique brass-and-wood cameras, exposed gears, film reels, projector parts, bellows, tripod wood legs, and vintage optical housings; warm bronze and copper tones; include 3 extra props at the base: a black megaphone labeled "DIRECTOR", a clapboard, and a short stack of film canisters; one projector-like lens at the upper right glows brightly. Top-right: the letter C, representing classical Hollywood film production, built from black metal film cameras, studio lenses, magazines, matte boxes, dolly components, control boxes, and analog set hardware; mostly black, steel, and gunmetal with subtle brass accents; include 4 extra props integrated around the base and inner right side: a clapperboard, a boxy side module, a film magazine marked "35", and a small cylindrical canister; a large forward-facing lamp or lens glows at the upper right. Bottom-left: the letter N, representing modern analog or late-20th-century cinema, assembled from Arriflex-style cameras, long cine zoom lenses, support rigs, rails, cables, a slate, and a field recorder; predominantly matte black with silver hardware and a few red accent rings; include 3 clearly visible base elements: a clapperboard section, a labeled director strip, and a rectangular audio recorder/control unit at the bottom. Bottom-right: the letter D, representing digital and virtual production, built from RED-style digital cinema cameras, monitors, battery packs, wireless transmitters, drones, LED panels, green-screen fabric inserts, and modular rig components; black technical bodies with vivid green accents and screen graphics; include 4 notable integrated device types: drone arms/propellers at the top, a rectangular LED light panel, multiple monitors, and a large camera lens at the lower left. Ultra-detailed, sharp, 8k, polished graphic design asset for a poster or visual comparison of filmmaking eras.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个干净的 2x2 网格，展示四个面向前方的 3D 排版雕塑，背景为浅灰色无缝工作室背景，由细白线分隔。每个象限包含一个巨大的字母，完全由来自不同电影时代的密集、逼真的电影设备和片场道具构建而成，字母形状虽然混乱但清晰可辨。采用高端 Cinema 4D 产品渲染美学、环境光遮蔽、逼真的比例关系、复杂的拼装细节、细微的磨损、金属反射以及带有柔和顶光源的三点式工作室照明。左上角：字母 S，代表早期默片或原始电影时代，由古董黄铜和木制相机、外露齿轮、胶片卷轴、放映机零件、皮腔、木制三脚架腿和复古光学外壳构成；暖青铜和铜色调；底部包含 3 个额外道具：一个标有“DIRECTOR”的黑色扩音器、一个场记板和一叠短胶片盒；右上角有一个类似放映机的镜头发出明亮的光。右上角：字母 C，代表古典好莱坞电影制作，由黑色金属电影摄影机、工作室镜头、胶片盒、遮光斗、轨道车组件、控制箱和模拟片场硬件构成；主要是黑色、钢色和枪灰色，带有细微的黄铜装饰；底部和右侧内部集成了 4 个额外道具：一个场记板、一个方形侧模块、一个标有“35”的胶片盒和一个小型圆柱形罐；右上角有一个大型正向灯或镜头发出光芒。左下角：字母 N，代表现代模拟或 20 世纪末电影，由 Arriflex 风格摄影机、长电影变焦镜头、支撑架、轨道、电缆、场记板和现场录音机组装而成；以哑光黑色为主，配有银色硬件和少量红色装饰环；底部包含 3 个清晰可见的基础元素：一个场记板部分、一个带标签的导演条和一个底部的矩形音频录音机/控制单元。右下角：字母 D，代表数字和虚拟制作，由 RED 风格数字电影摄影机、监视器、电池组、无线发射器、无人机、LED 面板、绿幕织物插件和模块化支架组件构成；黑色技术机身，带有鲜艳的绿色装饰和屏幕图形；包含 4 种显著的集成设备类型：顶部的无人机臂/螺旋桨、一个矩形 LED 灯板、多个监视器和一个左下角的大型相机镜头。保持所有物体接地并物理连接，没有悬浮部件，没有平面排版，没有手写风格，没有纸张质感，没有杂乱的背景。超精细、锐利、8k，适用于海报或电影时代视觉对比的精致图形设计素材。

The background is a clear vivid blue sky with exactly 4 small soft white clouds, warm sun rays entering from the upper left corner, cinematic lens flare, sparkling highlights on the glass, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh on distant trees at the far left and far right, highly polished photorealistic 3D render, whimsical eco-futurist mood, clean composition, centered symmetry, glossy reflections, gentle summer atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个梦幻般的超现实户外静物场景，呈现于明亮的午后阳光下：一个透明玻璃球体置于郁郁葱葱的苔藓土丘中央，球体内包含一个极简主义的白色发光计算机面部图标，圆角矩形内有两只垂直的眼睛，下方有一条短横线，看起来像一个友好的终端或聊天机器人符号。球体正前方放置着一个紧凑的白色机械键盘，呈完美的正面视角。球体底部周围环绕着 5 簇花朵：2 簇蓝色绣球花、2 簇白色绣球花和 1 簇浅金棕色花朵，它们掩映在茂密的绿苔和精致的蕨类植物叶片中。背景是清澈湛蓝的天空，点缀着 4 朵柔软的小白云，温暖的阳光从左上角射入，带有电影级的镜头光晕，玻璃上闪烁着高光，浅景深效果，远处的树木呈现柔和的虚化效果，高度精致的写实 3D 渲染，充满奇幻的生态未来主义氛围，构图简洁，对称居中，光泽反射，营造出温和的夏日气息。

templates.title: Back-to-Back Sirens in Sakura Dusk

templates.prompt: Two powerful fantasy women standing back-to-back in the center of a vast cherry blossom field at dusk, full-body heroic composition, seen from a slightly low angle, ultra-detailed cinematic anime-realism. The woman on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="vivid crimson red"} short layered hair, a curvy athletic build, and a fierce dominant presence; she wears a black and dark red strappy battle outfit with a cropped leather top, high-cut bottoms, garter-like thigh straps, flowing translucent red ribbons, and long glossy black armguards. The woman on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="golden blonde with soft pink ends"} wavy shoulder-length hair, an athletic curvy build, and extensive floral tattoo sleeves and body tattoos across her arm, shoulder, ribs, and thigh; she wears a black and purple strappy fantasy outfit with sheer purple fabric panels, chain accents, and black gloves. Their bare upper backs press together as they face opposite directions with calm, intimidating confidence. There are exactly 2 massive glowing energy swords planted upright in the ground behind and beside them: 1 on the left radiating molten red-orange fire and ember-like cracks, and 1 on the right radiating electric violet and cyan energy with lightning coursing through the blade. The scene is set in a breathtaking sakura landscape with dense pink cherry trees, countless petals swirling violently through the air, a dramatic sunset sky filled with magenta, purple, and orange clouds, distant lightning, and a glowing horizon over a Japanese-inspired cityscape with a pagoda visible on the right. Emphasize raw power, sensual elegance, high contrast rim lighting, wind-blown fabric and hair, luminous particle effects, rich red-versus-purple color contrast, epic fantasy atmosphere, hyper-detailed rendering, sharp focus on the two women, and painterly cinematic depth.

promptLocalized.zh: 两位强大的奇幻女性在黄昏时分广阔的樱花林中央背靠背站立，全身英雄构图，采用略微仰视的视角，呈现超精细的电影级动漫写实风格。左侧女性拥有 {argument name="left character hair color" default="鲜艳的深红色"} 短层叠发型，身材曲线健美，气场强悍霸气；她身穿黑色与深红色绑带战斗服，搭配短款皮质上衣、高叉下装、类似吊带袜的大腿绑带、飘逸的半透明红色丝带以及长款亮面黑色护臂。右侧女性拥有 {argument name="right character hair color" default="金发配柔和粉色发梢"} 的波浪形齐肩发，身材曲线健美，手臂、肩膀、肋骨和大腿上布满了大面积的花卉纹身；她身穿黑色与紫色绑带奇幻服装，带有透明的紫色布料拼接、链条装饰和黑色手套。她们赤裸的后背紧紧相贴，面朝相反方向，展现出冷静而令人敬畏的自信。她们身后和身侧的地面上插着 2 把巨大的发光能量剑：左侧的一把散发着熔岩般的红橙色火焰和类似余烬的裂纹，右侧的一把散发着电光紫和青色的能量，剑身上闪烁着雷电。场景设定在令人惊叹的樱花景观中，茂密的粉色樱花树，无数花瓣在空中剧烈旋舞，戏剧性的日落天空布满了洋红色、紫色和橙色的云彩，远处有闪电，地平线上隐约可见带有宝塔的日式城市景观。强调原始力量、感性优雅、高对比度的轮廓光、随风飘动的布料和头发、发光的粒子特效、浓郁的红紫色彩对比、史诗般的奇幻氛围、超精细渲染、对两位女性的清晰对焦以及绘画般的电影深度。
