templates.title: Surreal Planetary Sculpture Still Life

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实行星雕塑静物

templates.prompt: A surreal still-life in a dark black void, staged like a moody luxury sculpture display under a single soft spotlight. At the center, a large floating sphere dominates the composition, about one-third of the frame height, with a glossy translucent surface textured like swirling clouds and planetary gas bands in muted teal, cream, gray, and pale gold. Beneath and around the sphere sits an organic mound of dense mossy foliage and coral-like plant forms in olive green and bronze, mixed with a cluster of tiny luminous white-violet flowers on the left and a brighter white floral cluster on the right. Behind the sphere are 2 horizontal rectangular slabs suspended in space: 1 dark smoky slab on the left, partially hidden, and 1 larger warm brown-and-gold marbled slab on the right with vein-like lightning patterns. In the lower right foreground is 1 polished rectangular stone block resting on the ground, colored black, gray, and white with dramatic marble veining. The ground is a smooth matte surface with a pale green elliptical pool of light fading into darkness. Cinematic fine-art product photography style, surreal contemporary installation, minimal composition, strong negative space, soft bloom, subtle film grain, low-key lighting, glossy and mineral textures, slightly vintage color grading, high contrast but gentle focus, elegant and mysterious atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 在暗黑虚空中呈现的超现实静物，如同在单一柔光下布置的忧郁奢华雕塑展。画面中央是一个巨大的悬浮球体，占据了约三分之一的画幅高度，其半透明的表面呈现出如云雾缭绕的行星气带质感，色调为柔和的青色、奶油色、灰色和淡金色。球体下方及周围环绕着一团浓密的苔藓状叶片和橄榄绿与青铜色的珊瑚状植物，左侧点缀着一簇微小的发光白紫色花朵，右侧则是一簇更明亮的白色花朵。球体后方悬浮着 2 块水平长方形石板：左侧是一块部分遮挡的暗烟色石板，右侧是一块更大的暖棕金大理石纹石板，带有闪电般的脉络。右下方前景处放置着 1 块抛光长方形石块，呈现黑、灰、白三色，带有极具张力的大理石纹路。地面为平滑的哑光表面，有一处淡绿色的椭圆形光斑逐渐隐入黑暗。电影级艺术产品摄影风格，超现实当代装置艺术，极简构图，强烈的留白，柔和的光晕，细腻的胶片颗粒感，低调照明，光泽与矿物纹理，略带复古的调色，高对比度但对焦柔和，营造出优雅而神秘的氛围。

templates.title: Vintage Chinese Food Map Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古中国美食地图海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A hand-painted vintage Chinese tourist food map poster in watercolor and ink wash style, shown from a bird’s-eye view over a misty mountainous county landscape. The composition is a stylized illustrated map of {argument name="place name" default="缙云"}, with pale rice-paper texture, soft beige background, green-gray mountains, winding rivers, country roads, old towns, scenic rocks, bamboo leaves, and pink flowers framing the corners. Large artistic Chinese calligraphy title at the upper left reads {argument name="headline text" default="缙云 山野美食暴走地图"}, with a small subtitle ribbon below reading “黄帝缙云·人间仙都”. Add a poetic text block on the left in Chinese: “山水缙云，仙都奇境 百味乡野，烟火人间 跟着美食，遇见缙云 一城山水，一口乡愁”. In the center is the main county town labeled “缙云县城”, surrounded by illustrated routes connecting scenic destinations and local dishes. Include exactly 12 numbered food stops, each with a realistic painted bowl or plate of food placed on the map near its location, with orange circular numbers and Chinese labels plus a short one-line description. The 12 stops are: 1 “河阳土爽面” with description “山野本味，宾客烟火”; 2 “笕川笋干菜” with description “时令山珍，晒干留香”; 3 “缙云烧饼” with description “炭炉焦香，卷云招牌”; 4 “敲肉羹” with description “鲜香软糯，地道乡味”; 5 “岩下炖汤” with description “石材慢炖，暖身养胃”; 6 “溪鱼鲜” with description “山水河鲜，鲜掉眉毛”; 7 “壶镇扁食/落菜” with description “古法胶味，越吃越香”; 8 “葛根豆腐” with description “山野清润，解腻爽口”; 9 “山粉饺” with description “皮薄馅足，山野风味”; 10 “苦槠豆腐” with description “山林珍味，自然本鲜”; 11 “农家焐年糕” with description “糯香浓郁，儿时味道”; 12 “老街米糕” with description “清甜米香，古法手工”. Mark exactly 8 place labels on the map: “新建镇”, “壶镇镇”, “大洋镇”, “仙都景区”, “河阳古民居”, “岩宕书房”, “蛟龙大峡谷”, and “缙云县城”. Paint recognizable scenic clusters with white-walled black-roofed traditional houses, steep karst peaks, bridges, and terraced terrain. Add a small legend box at the lower right with exactly 5 items labeled “山脉”, “河流”, “主要道路”, “乡镇”, and “景点地标”, plus a sixth food icon label “美食推荐”. Include a decorative compass rose nearby. Overall mood is elegant, artisanal, nostalgic, and premium, like a cultural tourism poster combining local cuisine guide and scenic map illustration, with highly polished composition and refined Chinese branding.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张手绘复古中国旅游美食地图海报，采用水彩与水墨画风格，以俯瞰视角呈现云雾缭绕的山区县城景观。构图为一张风格化的 {argument name="place name" default="缙云"} 插画地图，带有淡雅的宣纸纹理，背景为柔和的米色，点缀着青灰色山脉、蜿蜒河流、乡村公路、古镇、奇石、竹叶，四角以粉色花卉装裱。左上角为醒目的艺术书法标题 {argument name="headline text" default="缙云 山野美食暴走地图"}，下方配有小型副标题丝带，写着“黄帝缙云·人间仙都”。左侧添加一段诗意中文文本：“山水缙云，仙都奇境 百味乡野，烟火人间 跟着美食，遇见缙云 一城山水，一口乡愁”。中心位置为标注“缙云县城”的县城主城区，周围环绕着连接各个景点与当地美食的插画路线。包含 12 个带编号的美食站点，每个站点在地图对应位置旁配有一份写实风格的食物手绘图，并带有橙色圆形数字、中文标签及一行简短描述。12 个站点分别为：1 “河阳土爽面”，描述为“山野本味，宾客烟火”；2 “笕川笋干菜”，描述为“时令山珍，晒干留香”；3 “缙云烧饼”，描述为“炭炉焦香，卷云招牌”；4 “敲肉羹”，描述为“鲜香软糯，地道乡味”；5 “岩下炖汤”，描述为“石材慢炖，暖身养胃”；6 “溪鱼鲜”，描述为“山水河鲜，鲜掉眉毛”；7 “壶镇扁食/落菜”，描述为“古法胶味，越吃越香”；8 “葛根豆腐”，描述为“山野清润，解腻爽口”；9 “山粉饺”，描述为“皮薄馅足，山野风味”；10 “苦槠豆腐”，描述为“山林珍味，自然本鲜”；11 “农家焐年糕”，描述为“糯香浓郁，儿时味道”；12 “老街米糕”，描述为“清甜米香，古法手工”。地图上标注 8 个地名标签：“新建镇”、“壶镇镇”、“大洋镇”、“仙都景区”、“河阳古民居”、“岩宕书房”、“蛟龙大峡谷”以及“缙云县城”。绘制具有辨识度的风景群落，包括白墙黑瓦的传统民居、陡峭的喀斯特峰林、桥梁及梯田地貌。右下角添加一个小型图例框，包含 5 个项目：“山脉”、“河流”、“主要道路”、“乡镇”和“景点地标”，以及第六个美食图标标签“美食推荐”。附近包含一个装饰性的罗盘玫瑰。整体氛围优雅、匠心独运、怀旧且高级，宛如一张结合了地方美食指南与风景地图插画的文化旅游海报，构图精良，品牌感十足。

templates.title: Bursting Soap Bubble Macro Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 肥皂泡破裂微距摄影

templates.prompt: A high-speed macro photograph of a soap bubble bursting in a sunlit garden, framed horizontally. On the far left edge, show the side profile of a young child with visible cheek, nose, lips, and part of one closed or half-closed eye, gently blowing toward the bubble. Place 1 large soap bubble near the center-left of the frame. The left half of the bubble remains intact as a smooth, glossy, iridescent sphere with vivid rainbow colors and strong reflective highlights, including a bright sun glint near the upper area and reflections of trees and garden scenery on the surface. The right half of the bubble is exploding outward into countless tiny droplets, mist, and thin web-like liquid filaments, frozen sharply in mid-air and spreading to the right side of the image. Emphasize the dramatic transition line between the intact sphere and the shattered spray. Use bright direct sunlight, very high shutter speed, crisp macro detail, high contrast, saturated color, dark green leafy background rendered as soft bokeh, and a Kodak Ektar 100 film look. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, dynamic motion frozen in time, shallow depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在阳光明媚的花园中拍摄的肥皂泡破裂高速微距照片，采用横向构图。在画面最左侧，展示一名幼童的侧脸，可见其脸颊、鼻子、嘴唇以及部分闭合或半闭的眼睛，正对着肥皂泡轻轻吹气。在画面中左侧放置 1 个大肥皂泡。肥皂泡的左半部分保持完整，呈现为一个光滑、有光泽且带有虹彩的球体，色彩鲜艳，并有强烈的反光高光，包括上方的明亮太阳光斑以及表面反射出的树木和花园景色。肥皂泡的右半部分向外爆裂，形成无数细小的水滴、薄雾和纤细的网状液体丝，在半空中被清晰地定格，并向画面右侧扩散。强调完整球体与破碎喷溅之间的戏剧性过渡线。使用明亮的直射阳光、极高的快门速度、清晰的微距细节、高对比度、饱和的色彩，背景为虚化处理的深绿色叶片，并呈现出 Kodak Ektar 100 胶片质感。超写实、超细节、定格动态瞬间、浅景深。

templates.title: Cinematic Last Supper Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 电影质感“最后的晚餐”场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic, historically grounded depiction of {argument name="scene subject" default="Jesus with his disciples during the Last Supper"} inside a modest ancient Middle Eastern dining room at night, shown from a close, immersive viewpoint at table height as if the viewer is seated among them. Include exactly 13 men gathered tightly around a long narrow supper table, with the central figure reading clearly as Jesus through calm presence, shoulder-length dark brown hair, a beard, and a soft off-white robe with a light beige shawl. The 12 disciples should vary in age and appearance, with curly or wavy dark hair, beards, and earth-toned robes in cream, brown, tan, muted blue, and dusty gray, leaning inward in conversation and attention. The room should have rough plaster walls, dark exposed wooden ceiling beams, a heavy wooden door at the back, simple wall niches, and small oil lamps or candle sconces casting warm amber light. On the table, show rustic period-appropriate food and vessels: round flatbread, grapes, olives, shallow bowls, clay plates, ceramic cups, and copper or earthenware goblets, with one small candle near the center creating a focal glow. Composition should be wide and intimate, slightly crowded at the foreground edges, with several figures partially cropped to enhance realism and immersion. Lighting should be low, golden, and dramatic, with soft shadows, a reverent mood, realistic skin tones, natural fabric folds, and rich cinematic contrast. Render in a photorealistic style with ultra-detailed textures, subtle depth of field, and the emotional tone of a historical biblical film still.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有电影质感且基于历史背景的描绘，场景为 {argument name="scene subject" default="耶稣与门徒共进最后的晚餐"}，地点位于夜晚一间朴素的古代中东餐厅内。视角采用沉浸式的近景，高度与餐桌齐平，仿佛观众正坐在他们中间。画面中需包含 13 位男子紧凑地围坐在一张狭长的餐桌旁，中心人物通过其沉稳的气质、齐肩深棕色长发、胡须以及身穿的米白色长袍配浅米色披肩，清晰地呈现为耶稣形象。12 位门徒在年龄和外貌上应有所差异，留着卷曲或波浪状的深色头发和胡须，身穿奶油色、棕色、棕褐色、柔和蓝色和灰尘色等大地色系长袍，身体向内倾斜，正在交谈或专注聆听。房间应具有粗糙的灰泥墙壁、裸露的深色木质天花板横梁、后方的一扇厚重木门、简单的墙壁壁龛，以及投射出温暖琥珀色光芒的小油灯或烛台。餐桌上应摆放符合时代特征的质朴食物和器皿：圆形扁面包、葡萄、橄榄、浅碗、陶盘、陶瓷杯以及铜制或陶制高脚杯，中心附近的一支小蜡烛营造出视觉焦点。构图应宽广而亲密，前景边缘略显拥挤，部分人物被适度裁剪以增强真实感和沉浸感。灯光应低沉、金黄且富有戏剧性，伴有柔和的阴影、庄重的氛围、真实的肤色、自然的织物褶皱以及丰富的电影对比度。以写实风格渲染，呈现超精细的纹理、微妙的景深，并传达出历史圣经电影剧照的情感基调。

templates.title: Last Supper Selfie Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 最后的晚餐自拍场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic reimagining of the Last Supper as a modern anachronistic selfie scene inside a dim ancient stone room. Show {argument name="central figure" default="Jesus"} seated at the center front of a long rustic wooden table, wearing dark earth-toned biblical robes, extending one arm toward the camera and holding a modern black smartphone to take a group selfie. Surround him with exactly 12 disciples crowded closely around the table, making 13 people total, all dressed in simple first-century robes in beige, brown, taupe, muted blue, and cream. The composition should feel intimate and slightly humorous but still believable, with everyone leaning inward toward the phone as if posing for the photo. Use warm candlelight and soft firelit illumination, with several visible candles on the table and wall niches, creating amber highlights, deep shadows, and a sacred old-world atmosphere. Include rustic pottery, clay cups, wooden bowls, torn flatbread, and simple food on the table. The background should feature rough plastered stone walls, hanging cloth drapes, wooden pegs, and sparse historical decor. Frame it as a medium-wide group portrait from the phone camera’s point of view, with shallow depth of field, cinematic realism, detailed fabric textures, natural skin tones, and a rich warm brown color palette.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅电影质感、照片级写实的“最后的晚餐”重构作品，呈现了一个充满现代时代错位感的自拍场景，地点位于昏暗的古老石室内。展示 {argument name="central figure" default="耶稣"} 坐在长条质朴木桌的正前方中央，身穿深色大地色系的圣经长袍，一只手臂伸向镜头，手持一部现代黑色智能手机进行集体自拍。在他周围，12 位门徒紧密地簇拥在桌子旁，总共 13 人，他们都穿着米色、棕色、灰褐色、柔和蓝色和奶油色的简约一世纪长袍。构图应营造出亲密且略带幽默但又不失真实感的氛围，每个人都向手机倾斜，仿佛正在摆姿势拍照。使用温暖的烛光和柔和的火光照明，桌上和墙壁壁龛中可见几支蜡烛，营造出琥珀色的高光、深邃的阴影和神圣的旧世界氛围。桌上摆放着质朴的陶器、粘土杯、木碗、撕开的扁面包和简单的食物。背景应呈现粗糙的抹灰石墙、悬挂的布帘、木钉和稀疏的历史装饰。以手机摄像头的视角进行中景广角群像构图，具有浅景深、电影级写实感、细腻的织物纹理、自然的肤色以及浓郁的暖棕色调。

templates.title: Nostalgic Youth Memory Photo Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧青春记忆照片墙

templates.prompt: A nostalgic collage of 16 candid youth snapshots arranged in a clean 4x4 photo grid, square format, styled like nonexistent memories from a Japanese coming-of-age film. Show a pair or small group of college-age friends spending time together through day and night, with a dreamy sentimental mood, soft blue and pink color cast, slight film grain, low-light bloom, motion blur, shallow focus, and the imperfect texture of casual phone photos. The main recurring subjects are a young woman with {argument name="hair style" default="short wavy bob"} wearing a {argument name="top color" default="white or light gray knit top"}, and a young man with dark hair in casual dark outerwear or a pale hoodie, appearing as close friends or a shy couple. Faces are intentionally obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks over every visible face, but body language remains warm, intimate, and natural. Include exactly 16 tiles: 1) night street portrait of the woman alone, 2) nighttime two-shot outdoors with the man and woman side by side, city lights behind them, 3) close indoor selfie of two friends shoulder to shoulder, 4) indoor two-shot near curtains, 5) blurred moving street selfie of the pair, 6) cozy cafe table scene with drinks, the woman touching her face while the man sits across, 7) spring park scene under blooming cherry blossoms, 8) playful outdoor shot with a hand partially covering the lens, 9) indoor couch or booth snapshot with one person holding a compact camera, 10) blue-hour overlook or rooftop shot with city lights and the pair standing together, 11) nighttime waterfront or city-light background portrait of two friends, 12) close side-by-side night snapshot of the pair, 13) heavily blurred close selfie with one figure in motion, 14) indoor mirror-area or restaurant snapshot with one person raising a camera, 15) indoor casual peace-sign pose beside a brick or tiled wall, 16) picnic-in-the-park scene with snacks and one friend holding a camera toward the viewer. Overall feeling: wistful, cinematic, intimate, youthful, spontaneous, and bittersweet, like a scrapbook of memories that never really happened.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张怀旧的拼贴画，包含 16 张青春抓拍照片，以整洁的 4x4 网格排列，方形构图，风格如同日本青春电影中虚构的记忆。展示一对或一小群大学生在日夜相处的时光，带有梦幻般的感性氛围，呈现柔和的蓝粉色调、轻微的胶片颗粒感、弱光下的光晕、动态模糊、浅景深，以及随意手机摄影的不完美质感。主要反复出现的主角是一位留着 {argument name="hair style" default="短波波头"} 的年轻女性，穿着 {argument name="top color" default="白色或浅灰色针织上衣"}，以及一位留着深色头发、穿着休闲深色外套或浅色连帽衫的年轻男性，他们看起来像是亲密的朋友或羞涩的情侣。所有可见的面部均被柔和的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡，但肢体语言依然温暖、亲密且自然。包含 16 个方格：1) 女性独自一人的夜间街头肖像，2) 夜间男女并肩的户外合影，背景是城市灯光，3) 两位朋友肩并肩的室内近距离自拍，4) 窗帘附近的室内合影，5) 两人移动中的模糊街头自拍，6) 舒适的咖啡馆餐桌场景，桌上有饮料，女性在摸脸，男性坐在对面，7) 樱花盛开下的春季公园场景，8) 手部部分遮挡镜头的俏皮户外拍摄，9) 室内沙发或卡座快照，其中一人拿着小型相机，10) 蓝色时刻的观景台或屋顶镜头，背景是城市灯光，两人站在一起，11) 夜间水边或城市灯光背景下的两位朋友肖像，12) 两人并肩的夜间近距离快照，13) 严重模糊的近距离自拍，其中一人处于动态中，14) 室内镜子区域或餐厅快照，其中一人举着相机，15) 砖墙或瓷砖墙旁的室内休闲比耶姿势，16) 公园野餐场景，有零食，其中一位朋友拿着相机对着镜头。整体感觉：怀旧、电影感、亲密、青春、自发且苦乐参半，就像一本从未真正发生过的记忆剪贴簿。

templates.title: Editorial Studio Portrait in Neutral Streetwear

titleLocalized.zh: 中性街头风时尚杂志肖像

templates.prompt: A high-end studio fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject gender" default="woman"} in her mid-30s to early 40s with a naturally fit build, shown in a half-body to upper-thigh framing, standing in a relaxed, confident pose with both hands tucked into her pants pockets. She has long, dark chestnut-brown wavy hair parted near the center, softly cascading over her shoulders, and wears 2 small gold hoop earrings on one visible ear, a delicate gold necklace, and a thin bracelet. Her outfit is modern minimal casual streetwear in soft neutral tones: a light beige zip-front jacket worn open, a fitted white cropped tank top, and matching light beige drawstring jogger pants. Shoot at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, keeping the subject tack sharp with shallow depth of field. Use professional studio lighting with 1 softbox key light from the front-left, subtle fill to soften shadows, and 1 gentle warm rim light along the hair and shoulder for separation. The background is a clean studio backdrop with a smooth taupe-to-warm-gray neutral gradient and no distractions. The image should feel highly realistic and editorial, with natural skin tones, balanced color grading, ultra-high detail, crisp fabric texture, soft natural shadows, no noise, no motion blur, no cartoon styling, and no anatomical distortions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端时尚摄影肖像，主体为一位 {argument name="subject gender" default="女性"}，年龄在 30 岁中期至 40 岁出头，体态自然匀称。构图为半身至大腿上部，她以放松且自信的姿态站立，双手插在裤兜里。她留着深栗棕色的长波浪卷发，中分发型自然垂落在肩头；佩戴一对小巧的金色圆环耳饰，颈间戴着精致的金色项链，手腕处有一条细手链。服装为现代极简休闲街头风，色调柔和中性：外搭一件敞开的浅米色拉链夹克，内穿修身白色短款背心，下身搭配同色系浅米色抽绳慢跑裤。采用平视角度拍摄，使用 85mm 人像镜头，光圈 f/2.8，确保主体清晰锐利，并呈现浅景深效果。使用专业影棚布光，左前方设置 1 个柔光箱作为主光，辅以微妙的补光以柔化阴影，并在发丝和肩部边缘增加 1 道柔和的暖色轮廓光以增强立体感。背景为干净的影棚幕布，呈现平滑的灰褐色至暖灰色渐变，无杂乱元素。画面应极具写实感与杂志质感，肤色自然，色彩分级平衡，细节超高，织物纹理清晰，阴影柔和自然，无噪点，无运动模糊，无卡通风格，且无任何解剖结构畸变。

templates.title: Luxury Magazine Cover With Featured Book

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华杂志封面与精选书籍展示

templates.prompt: A photorealistic premium magazine cover in the style of an international design and business publication, shot as a sophisticated editorial still life. The cover features a dark, moody interior with shallow depth of field and warm ambient lighting. Center-right, standing upright on a glossy black marble table, is a cream-colored paperback book titled {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"} by {argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}. The book is angled slightly to the left so both the front cover and spine are visible. The cover illustration is minimalist navy-blue line art showing an office interior with an open door leading into a winding outdoor path, framed pictures on the wall, a water cooler, a desk with stacked papers, and a person slumped in an office chair. The author’s name appears near the lower left of the front cover, and the title also runs vertically on the spine. To the left of the book on the marble surface is a small stack of 4 books, softly out of focus, and in the lower-left foreground sits 1 dark coffee cup on a saucer. Behind them is a dim, elegant room with blurred shelving and a soft green plant shape in the background. The magazine masthead dominates the top: {argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"} in very large white serif letters across the width, with small white issue text at top left reading {argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"} and small white tagline text at top right reading “THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”. Beneath the masthead is a thin rule and a category line in small gold serif text with 6 categories separated by dots: “AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION”. On the left side, large white serif cover headline text reads “Rethinking Success”. Below it is a white serif subheadline about leaving the default path behind and building a life and work that matters, followed by a small gold page number. Further down the left column are 4 editorial teaser blocks, each with a gold circular icon and gold uppercase heading, white descriptive text, and a gold page number. The 4 headings are “ESCAPE THE DEFAULT”, “WORK WITH PURPOSE”, “A NEW STORY”, and a boxed teaser “DESIGN SPECIAL”. At the bottom right is a realistic barcode block with small pricing text above it and a small issue number beside it. The overall layout should feel like a real luxury magazine cover mockup: crisp typography, elegant serif fonts, black, white, cream, and gold palette, glossy reflections on the marble, cinematic shadows, subtle product reflection beneath the book, and high-end editorial photography styling.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的高端杂志封面，采用国际设计与商业出版物风格，呈现出精致的编辑静物摄影效果。封面背景为光线昏暗、氛围感十足的室内空间，具有浅景深和温暖的环境光。在右侧中央，一张光亮的黑色大理石桌上竖立着一本奶油色的平装书，书名为 {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"}，作者为 {argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}。书籍略微向左倾斜，以便同时展示封面和书脊。封面插图为极简主义的深蓝色线条画，描绘了一个办公室内部场景：一扇通往蜿蜒户外小径的敞开大门、墙上的相框、饮水机、堆满文件的办公桌，以及一个瘫坐在办公椅上的人。作者姓名出现在封面左下角附近，书名也垂直印在书脊上。在大理石桌面的书籍左侧，有一小叠 4 本虚化处理的书籍，左下角前景处放着 1 个带托盘的深色咖啡杯。背景是一个昏暗而优雅的房间，带有模糊的货架和柔和的绿色植物轮廓。杂志刊头占据了顶部：{argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"}，以巨大的白色衬线字体横跨整个宽度，左上角有小号白色期号文字 {argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"}，右上角有小号白色标语文字“THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”。刊头下方是一条细线和一行小号金色衬线字体的分类栏，包含 6 个以圆点分隔的类别：“AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION”。在左侧，醒目的白色衬线大标题写着“Rethinking Success”。下方是关于告别默认路径、构建有意义的生活与工作的白色衬线副标题，随后是一个小的金色页码。左侧栏下方有 4 个编辑预告块，每个块都配有一个金色圆形图标、金色大写标题、白色描述性文字和一个金色页码。这 4 个标题分别是“ESCAPE THE DEFAULT”、“WORK WITH PURPOSE”、“A NEW STORY”以及一个带框的预告“DESIGN SPECIAL”。右下角是一个逼真的条形码块，上方有小号价格文字，旁边有小号期号。整体布局应呈现出真实奢华杂志封面样机的质感：清晰的排版、优雅的衬线字体、黑白奶油金配色、大理石上的光泽反射、电影般的阴影、书籍下方细腻的产品倒影，以及高端的编辑摄影风格。

templates.prompt: A minimalist flat vector illustration on a light gray background showing a stylized pelican riding a bicycle, composed from simple geometric SVG-like shapes with thick dark charcoal outlines and sparse details. The bicycle is shown in side view with 2 large wheels, each with a circular rim and a simple cross of 4 spokes, a black frame, seat, crank, and handlebars, resting on a single thin horizontal ground line near the bottom. The pelican is abstract and slightly awkward, built from clean outlined shapes: a white circular-oval body positioned over the bike, 2 narrow orange-yellow leg shapes hanging down toward the pedals, a white neck and head extending forward, 1 small black eye, a long triangular orange-yellow upper beak, and 1 large pale pink lower pouch. Add a separate white wing shape angled upward above the body. Keep the composition intentionally simple and a little imperfect, as if it were an SVG demo drawing generated from code in a code editor screenshot, but render only the artwork itself with no interface, no text, no shadows, and no extra scenery.

promptLocalized.zh: 在浅灰色背景上呈现一幅极简主义的扁平矢量插画，描绘了一只风格化的鹈鹕骑着自行车。图像由简单的几何 SVG 形状组成，带有深炭色的粗轮廓和简洁的细节。自行车以侧视图呈现，拥有 2 个大轮子，每个轮子配有圆形轮辋和简单的 4 辐条十字架，以及黑色的车架、车座、曲柄和车把，底部有一条细长的水平地面线。鹈鹕造型抽象且略显笨拙，由干净的轮廓形状构建而成：身体呈白色圆椭圆形，位于自行车上方；2 条窄窄的橙黄色腿部形状向下延伸至踏板；白色的颈部和头部向前伸展，配有 1 只黑色小眼睛、1 个长三角形的橙黄色上喙和 1 个巨大的淡粉色下喉囊。在身体上方添加一个向上倾斜的独立白色翅膀形状。保持构图刻意简洁且略带不完美感，如同代码编辑器截图中通过代码生成的 SVG 演示绘图，但仅渲染艺术作品本身，不包含任何界面、文字、阴影或额外背景。

templates.title: Neuron on a San Francisco Cable Car

titleLocalized.zh: 旧金山叮当车上的神经元

templates.prompt: A whimsical cinematic portrait of an anthropomorphic neuron riding on the outside step of a classic San Francisco cable car at golden hour. The character has a large neuron head with a rounded central body and dozens of long branching dendrites radiating outward like a crown, textured in pale lavender, mauve, and fleshy gray with subtle organic sheen. Its face area is obscured and featureless. The figure is dressed like a Victorian or Edwardian gentleman commuter: dark tweed jacket, patterned waistcoat, collared shirt, necktie, pinstriped trousers, polished brown leather shoes, and a pocket watch chain. One hand grips a brass pole on the cable car, and the other hand holds up a vintage transit ticket reading "MUNICIPAL RAILWAY SAN FRANCISCO ADMIT ONE." Add a small round lapel pin that says "MUNI." A slender purple tail-like axon curls behind the body. The cable car is richly detailed varnished wood and brass, with a route sign on the side reading "POWELL AND MARKET / HYDE AND BEACH / FISHERMANS WHARF." In the background, show a steep San Francisco street with cable tracks descending into the distance, a second cable car far down the hill, dense urban buildings on both sides, and Coit Tower visible on a hazy hilltop. Warm nostalgic lighting, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed textures, surreal realism, humorous but elegant mood, centered full-body composition, vertical framing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满奇幻色彩的电影感肖像，描绘了一个拟人化的神经元在黄金时刻乘坐旧金山经典叮当车的外侧踏板。该角色拥有一个巨大的神经元头部，中心呈圆形，数十条长长的树突像皇冠一样向外辐射，呈现出淡紫色、紫红色和肉灰色的纹理，带有微妙的有机光泽。其面部区域模糊且没有五官。人物穿着维多利亚或爱德华时代的绅士通勤装：深色粗花呢夹克、花纹背心、衬衫、领带、细条纹长裤、抛光的棕色皮鞋以及怀表链。一只手抓着叮当车上的黄铜杆，另一只手举着一张复古交通票，上面写着 "MUNICIPAL RAILWAY SAN FRANCISCO ADMIT ONE"。加上一枚写有 "MUNI" 的小圆形翻领徽章。一条细长的紫色轴突状尾巴在身体后方卷曲。叮当车细节丰富，由清漆木材和黄铜制成，侧面的路线牌写着 "POWELL AND MARKET / HYDE AND BEACH / FISHERMANS WHARF"。背景展示了一条陡峭的旧金山街道，缆车轨道向远处延伸，远处山坡下有第二辆叮当车，两侧是密集的城市建筑，朦胧的山顶上可见科伊特塔。温暖的怀旧光影，浅景深，超精细纹理，超现实主义，幽默而优雅的氛围，居中全身构图，竖构图。

templates.title: 9/11 Twin Towers Street Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 9/11 双子塔街头摄影

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A dramatic photojournalistic street-level scene in lower Manhattan showing the World Trade Center during the September 11 attacks, viewed from several blocks away on a bright clear blue morning. The composition centers on the Twin Towers, with the left tower engulfed near the upper floors by a massive orange-and-black fireball, thick dark gray smoke billowing horizontally across the sky, and debris falling downward. The right tower stands adjacent with its antenna visible, partially obscured by smoke. In the foreground, exactly 6 visible bystanders stand in the street and on the sidewalk with their backs to the camera, watching in shock; the closest is a man in a light blue dress shirt at lower left. Surrounding the avenue are mid-rise city buildings, including a beige building with black construction scaffolding on the left, older brick and stone facades at street level, a tall curved streetlamp near center, traffic signs, and a dense urban canyon leading the eye toward the towers. Realistic documentary photography, high detail, natural daylight, long-lens compression, urgent historical-news atmosphere, sharp focus, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具冲击力的纪实风格街头照片，拍摄于曼哈顿下城，展示了 9/11 袭击期间的世界贸易中心，视角位于几个街区外，背景是明亮晴朗的蓝天。构图以双子塔为中心，左侧塔楼高层被巨大的橙黑色火球吞没，浓厚的深灰色烟雾在天空中水平翻滚，碎片向下坠落。右侧塔楼紧邻其旁，天线清晰可见，部分被烟雾遮挡。前景中，有 6 位清晰可见的旁观者背对镜头站在街道和人行道上，神情震惊地注视着前方；最靠近镜头的是左下方一名身穿浅蓝色衬衫的男子。大道两侧是中层城市建筑，包括左侧带有黑色建筑脚手架的米色大楼、街面古老的砖石外墙、中心附近高大的弧形路灯、交通标志，以及将视线引向塔楼的密集城市峡谷。写实纪录片摄影，高细节，自然日光，长焦镜头压缩感，紧迫的历史新闻氛围，焦点清晰，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Crowd Camera POV Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫人群镜头视角对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A two-panel comparison graphic on a black background demonstrating a dramatic camera-angle change in an anime-style crowded street scene. Place a large white sentence centered across the top: "{argument name="headline text" default="Move the camera POV to be at ground level in the crowd."}". On the left side, add two large white labels aligned with the panels: "Source" beside the upper panel and "Output" beside the lower panel. Create exactly 2 stacked rectangular image panels centered on the canvas. In the top panel, show a high-angle overhead view of a densely packed historical street crowd in a hand-painted anime film style, with dozens of people pressed together around horse-drawn carts and wagon wheels; include bundled luggage, hats, muted earth-tone clothing, blue and tan garments, and a busy composition where figures overlap in every direction. In the bottom panel, recreate the same type of scene but shift the camera to a low, ground-level point of view inside the crowd, looking between bodies and beside a large wagon wheel on the right edge. The foreground should feel immersive and cramped, with several bent or crouched figures close to the camera, a person in a muted purple robe on the left foreground, a kneeling or hunched figure in tan near the center bottom, and a woman in a light blue dress or coat toward the right-middle turning through the crowd while holding a small child. Keep the environment as a chaotic old-world market or transit street with horses, carts, people in brimmed hats and simple period clothing, dusty ground, and warm subdued colors. Use soft cinematic anime lighting, painterly shading, and the visual feel of a classic Studio Ghibli crowd sequence. The overall image should read as a before-and-after camera experiment, with the upper panel as the original overhead composition and the lower panel as the transformed low-angle perspective.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑色背景的双图对比图，展示动漫风格拥挤街道场景中戏剧性的镜头角度变化。在顶部居中放置一行醒目的白色文字：“{argument name="headline text" default="将镜头视角移至人群中的地面水平。"}”。在左侧添加两个与面板对齐的大号白色标签：上方面板旁标注“源图像”，下方面板旁标注“输出结果”。在画布中央创建 2 个垂直堆叠的矩形图像面板。上方面板展示手绘动漫电影风格中，历史街道上人群密集的俯视视角，数十人挤在一起，周围有马车和车轮；包含捆绑的行李、帽子、柔和的大地色系服装、蓝色和棕褐色服饰，构图繁忙，人物在各个方向重叠。下方面板重现相同类型的场景，但将镜头切换至人群内部的低位地面视角，穿过人群身体之间，右侧边缘可见一个大车轮。前景应具有沉浸感和拥挤感，几个人物弯腰或蹲伏在镜头附近，左前景有一位身穿柔和紫色长袍的人物，底部中央有一位身穿棕褐色衣服的跪姿或佝偻人物，右中方有一位身穿浅蓝色连衣裙或外套的女性抱着一个小孩子穿过人群。保持环境为混乱的旧世界市场或交通街道，有马匹、马车、戴宽檐帽和穿着简单时代服装的人、尘土飞扬的地面以及温暖柔和的色调。使用柔和的电影级动漫光影、绘画质感的阴影，并呈现出经典吉卜力工作室人群序列的视觉感受。整体图像应呈现为一次“前后对比”的镜头实验，上方面板为原始的俯视构图，下方面板为转换后的低角度视角。

templates.prompt: A luminous impressionistic watercolor-style illustration of a young woman standing by a lakeside in bright summer light, shown in side profile with her face turned slightly upward toward the breeze. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair gathered into a loose, messy low ponytail with wispy strands blowing around her head. She wears a long flowing {argument name="dress color" default="white"} dress with soft translucent fabric and loose three-quarter sleeves, the skirt drifting gently in the wind. Her left hand rests on a large sunlit rock beside the trunk of a leafy tree, and her body is surrounded by exactly 2 flower colors in the foreground: vivid orange and golden yellow cosmos blossoms with thin green stems and airy leaves. The setting is a serene turquoise lake with sparkling reflections, a soft distant shoreline and hazy blue hills across the water, and an arching canopy of fresh green leaves overhead filtering warm sunlight. Compose the scene vertically, with the tree trunk on the left, the woman near center-left, the water opening to the right, and dense flowers filling the lower foreground. Use a painterly, high-key, airy style with visible brush textures, dappled sunlight, fresh greens, aqua blues, and glowing whites, evoking a peaceful early summer morning and a gentle, refreshing breeze.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅明亮的印象派水彩风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在夏日明媚阳光下、绿树成荫的湖畔。她呈侧面轮廓，面向右侧的水面，面部大部分被角度和光线遮挡。她深棕色的头发松散地扎成一个凌乱的低马尾，几缕发丝在微风中轻轻飘动。她身着一件飘逸的及踝白色长裙，面料轻盈透气，袖口宽松，在暖风中轻轻起伏。她的一只手向后撑在左侧边缘的一块深色岩石或树根上，身体微微后倾，姿态放松而沉思。前景中布满了茂密的野生波斯菊，主要由鲜艳的橙色和金黄色两种颜色组成，点缀着纤细的绿色茎秆和少量白色小花。左侧是一棵粗壮的树干，头顶上方茂密的绿叶过滤着闪烁的阳光，在画面上营造出斑驳的光影、明亮的亮部以及柔和的虚化光斑。右侧，平静的绿松石色湖水向远方延伸，泛起淡淡的涟漪，远处可见朦胧的岸线或低矮的山峦。采用高调配色，以清新的绿色、水蓝色、白色、黄色和橙色为主；运用柔和的绘画笔触；营造轻盈的氛围、浪漫的季节感和优雅的构图；采用竖构图；前景花卉细节丰富；呈现明亮的自然逆光效果；整体氛围宁静且如梦似幻。

templates.title: Restaurant POV Change Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 餐厅视角转换对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A side-by-side social media comparison graphic on a dark black background, showing a camera-angle transformation test for a busy restaurant interior. At the very top, large white sans-serif text reads: {argument name="headline text" default="Show me the POV from someone standing behind the bar looking out over this crowded restaurant. Change NOTHING in the scene other than the pov"}. Below that, centered on the page, are 2 vertically stacked rectangular photos with rounded corners. To the left of the top image, large white text reads "Source"; to the left of the bottom image, large white text reads "Output". The top image shows the original restaurant scene from the customer side facing the back bar: a warm, upscale, crowded restaurant at night with a massive illuminated wall of liquor bottles on shelves, wood ceiling beams, hanging globe pendant lights, bartenders and servers working, and many seated guests in the foreground and midground. The lower image shows the same restaurant with the same lighting, décor, crowd density, bottle wall, pendant lights, and overall atmosphere, but from a new viewpoint: the camera is now standing behind the bar looking outward across the crowded dining room. In the foreground of the lower image, include the bar counter surface with glassware, bottles, metal bar tools, and a glowing POS touchscreen at front left, reinforcing the behind-the-bar POV. Keep both photos photorealistic, warm amber lighting, lively evening ambiance, and maintain the sense that the lower image is the same scene with only the camera angle changed. Add subtle social-post styling with generous margins and clean layout, suitable for a tweet screenshot or AI image comparison post.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深黑色背景下的并排社交媒体对比图，展示了繁忙餐厅内部的摄像机角度转换测试。最上方是大号白色无衬线文字，内容为：{argument name="headline text" default="向我展示从吧台后方看向这间拥挤餐厅的视角。除视角外，场景中的任何内容都不要改变"}。页面中央垂直堆叠着两张圆角矩形照片。上方图片左侧有大号白色文字“原始视角 (Source)”；下方图片左侧有大号白色文字“输出结果 (Output)”。上方图片展示了从顾客侧看向后方吧台的原始餐厅场景：夜晚温馨、高档且拥挤的餐厅，背景是巨大的发光酒瓶陈列墙、木质天花板横梁、悬挂的球形吊灯，吧台调酒师和服务员正在工作，前景和中景坐满了客人。下方图片展示了同一间餐厅，保持了相同的灯光、装饰、人群密度、酒瓶墙、吊灯和整体氛围，但视角发生了变化：摄像机现在位于吧台后方，向外俯瞰拥挤的餐厅。在下方图片的前景中，包含吧台台面、玻璃器皿、酒瓶、金属吧台工具以及左前方发光的 POS 触摸屏，以强化“吧台后方”的视角。两张照片均需保持照片级真实感、温暖的琥珀色灯光和生动的夜晚氛围，并确保下方图片看起来与上方是同一场景，仅改变了摄像机角度。采用简洁的社交媒体发布风格，留有充足的边距和整洁的布局，适合作为推文截图或 AI 图像对比贴使用。

templates.title: Royal Blue Couture Group Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 宝蓝色高定系列集体肖像

templates.prompt: A luxurious editorial fashion portrait of 4 elegant young women posed together in a dark royal-blue baroque interior, styled like a haute couture group photoshoot. The scene is monochromatic in deep sapphire, midnight blue, and silver tones, with heavy velvet drapery, floral arrangements, a classical column, and ornate metallic vessels in the background. All 4 women wear distinct navy and cobalt evening gowns with elaborate embellishment: crystal beading, sequins, embroidered floral appliqué, layered tulle, satin, and sheer lace. The top-left woman has very long black hair and wears a dramatic long-sleeved sheer lace gown with floral embroidery and a fitted corset-like bodice, raising one arm above her head in a regal pose. The top-right woman has long wavy light brown or blonde hair and wears a sleeveless spaghetti-strap satin gown with blue flower appliqués at the bust and waist, seated upright with a poised expression. The bottom-left woman has long straight black hair and wears a structured satin dress with thin straps, jeweled floral ornaments across the bodice and skirt, and a voluminous gathered skirt. The bottom-right woman has long dark hair and wears an off-shoulder sheer glittering gown with translucent embroidered sleeves, leaning forward slightly with one hand near her chin in a soft, contemplative pose. All 4 wear coordinated sapphire gemstone jewelry including earrings, necklaces, and decorative hair accessories. Composition is a tightly framed vertical portrait with layered seated poses, rich fabric pooling across the foreground, soft diffused studio lighting, high detail, glamorous luxury campaign styling, moody shadows, polished skin, and a refined opulent atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的时尚编辑风格肖像，展示了 4 位优雅的年轻女性在深宝蓝色巴洛克风格室内共同摆拍，呈现出高级定制集体摄影的质感。场景采用深蓝宝石色、午夜蓝和银色的单色调，背景装饰有厚重的丝绒帷幔、花艺布置、古典立柱和华丽的金属器皿。4 位女性均身着独特的深蓝色和钴蓝色晚礼服，细节精致：饰有水晶珠饰、亮片、刺绣花卉贴花、多层薄纱、缎面和透明蕾丝。左上方的女性留着极长的黑发，身着一件戏剧性的长袖透明蕾丝礼服，带有花卉刺绣和紧身胸衣式上身，单臂高举过头，姿态高贵。右上方的女性留着长波浪浅棕色或金色头发，身着无袖细肩带缎面礼服，胸部和腰部饰有蓝色花朵贴花，坐姿端正，神情从容。左下方的女性留着长直黑发，身着结构感缎面连衣裙，配有细肩带，胸部和裙摆饰有珠宝花卉装饰，裙摆蓬松且带有褶皱。右下方的女性留着长深色头发，身着露肩透明闪光礼服，袖子带有半透明刺绣，身体微微前倾，一只手轻抚下巴，姿态柔和且沉思。4 人均佩戴协调的蓝宝石珠宝，包括耳环、项链和装饰性发饰。构图为紧凑的竖版肖像，采用层叠的坐姿，丰富的面料铺满前景，柔和的漫射影棚光，细节丰富，呈现出迷人的奢华广告大片风格，带有深邃的阴影、精致的肤质和高雅奢华的氛围。

templates.title: Nostalgic Watercolor Anime Adventure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧水彩动漫冒险海报

templates.prompt: A nostalgic watercolor anime poster on textured off-white paper, composed as a vertical double-exposure illustration inspired by late-1990s adventure anime. The main silhouette is the left-side profile of a young boy wearing large swim goggles pushed up on his head, his face turned to the right, with the silhouette filled by a dreamlike montage of memories and fantasy scenes. Inside the upper center of the silhouette, show 8 children from behind standing together on a ridge and looking toward a glowing, distant crystalline tower beneath a circular celestial portal in a cloudy blue-violet sky; include 7 small creature companions among them. On the upper right inside the silhouette, place a large dragon-like monster emerging from the clouds. Near the center, add a glowing round handheld digital device with a small screen, radiating light. In the middle-lower area, depict 2 iconic small dinosaur-like creatures sitting above an old shrine approach, one purple horned creature and one small yellow reptilian creature. In the lower area, show a mossy torii gate, overgrown stone steps, utility poles, and a small rural train on the right, all wrapped in mist and foliage. At the very bottom, include the 8 children again as tiny silhouettes walking away together along a path, reinforcing the theme of friendship and remembrance. Use soft ink-and-watercolor washes, muted blues, indigo, lavender, sepia, and warm golden highlights, with splattered pigment edges and painterly cloud textures. Keep the composition airy and elegant, with a refined modern poster-design sensibility and almost no generic AI gloss. Add vertical Japanese text on the right side reading あの日、僕たちは選ばれた。あの日、デジモンと出会った。 and place a Japanese title logo at the lower left reading デジモンアドベンチャー, with a small English subtitle “DIGIMON ADVENTURE” and the date line “1999 - 永遠の冒険”.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张印在纹理米白色纸张上的怀旧水彩动漫海报，采用受 20 世纪 90 年代末冒险动漫启发的竖版双重曝光插画构图。主体轮廓为一名年轻男孩的左侧侧脸，头上戴着一副向上推起的护目镜，面部朝向右侧，轮廓内填充着如梦似幻的记忆与奇幻场景蒙太奇。在轮廓上方的中心位置，展示 8 名儿童背对镜头站立在山脊上，望向云雾缭绕的蓝紫色天空中一个圆形天体传送门下方发光的远方水晶塔；他们身旁伴有 7 只小型生物伙伴。在轮廓内部的右上角，放置一只从云层中显现的巨型龙状怪物。在中心附近，添加一个发光的圆形手持数字设备，屏幕微亮，向外辐射光芒。在中下部区域，描绘 2 只标志性的小型恐龙状生物坐在古老的神社参道上方，其中一只是紫色长角生物，另一只是小型黄色爬行类生物。在底部区域，展示一座长满青苔的鸟居、杂草丛生的石阶、电线杆以及右侧的一列小型乡村火车，所有景物都笼罩在薄雾与植被之中。在最底部，再次呈现 8 名儿童作为微小剪影沿着小路并肩远去的画面，强化友谊与回忆的主题。使用柔和的水墨与水彩渲染，色调为柔和的蓝色、靛蓝、薰衣草紫、深褐色以及温暖的金色高光，并带有飞溅的颜料边缘和绘画感的云层纹理。保持构图的通透与优雅，具备精致的现代海报设计感，几乎没有常见的 AI 塑料感。在右侧添加竖排日文文字“あの日、僕たちは選ばれた。あの日、デジモンと出会った。”，并在左下角放置日文标题 Logo“デジモンアドベンチャー”，配以小型英文副标题“DIGIMON ADVENTURE”以及日期行“1999 - 永遠の冒険”。

templates.title: Journey to the West Ink Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 《西游记》水墨海报

templates.prompt: A majestic Chinese ink-wash fantasy poster inspired by Journey to the West, composed as a double-exposure silhouette of {argument name="character name" default="Sun Wukong"} in left-facing profile occupying most of the page. The portrait is formed from soft sepia, ash gray, parchment white, and smoky black watercolor textures on an off-white paper background with splattered brush edges and negative space. The figure has a strong simian facial profile, a short beard, and a golden circlet across the brow. Inside and around the silhouette, build a layered mythic landscape in traditional shan shui style with luminous mist, cliffs, clouds, and ancient temples. At the top center inside the head, place a glowing full moon behind a celestial Buddha-like figure seated above a grand heavenly palace complex with multiple tiered roofs. In the upper-middle right, show 4 traveling figures on a cliff path: a monkey warrior with a staff, a monk riding a white horse, a pig-faced companion, and a dark-robed companion. In the middle, depict 1 dramatic battle scene of the monkey warrior confronting a coiling dragon or serpent in swirling clouds. In the lower-right, place 1 illuminated temple shrine nestled in the mountains with a golden sacred statue visible inside. In the lower area, add 3 tiny pilgrims walking through the misty valley. Use atmospheric depth, elegant calligraphic brushwork, drifting fog, and a refined cinematic composition that feels painterly rather than digital. Add vertical Chinese calligraphy on the left reading {argument name="title text" default="西游记"}, with smaller vertical side text and several seal-style stamps for an authentic poster design. Include another subtle vertical location inscription on the right cliff face. The mood is sacred, epic, ancient, mystical, and poetic, with premium concept-art polish and almost no generic AI look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张受《西游记》启发的宏伟中国水墨奇幻海报，主体为 {argument name="character name" default="孙悟空"} 的左侧面双重曝光剪影，占据页面大部分空间。肖像由柔和的棕褐色、灰烬色、羊皮纸白和烟黑色水彩纹理构成，背景为灰白色纸张，带有飞溅的笔触边缘和留白。人物具有明显的猿猴面部轮廓、短须，额头上戴着金箍。在剪影内部及周围，构建一个层次分明的传统山水风格神话景观，包含发光的云雾、悬崖、云朵和古老的寺庙。在头部上方的中心位置，绘制一轮明月，月亮后方有一尊神圣的佛像，坐落于宏伟的天宫建筑群之上，建筑拥有多层屋檐。在右上部，展示 4 位取经人走在悬崖小径上：一位手持金箍棒的猴王、一位骑着白马的僧人、一位猪脸同伴以及一位身着黑袍的同伴。在中间位置，描绘 1 场猴王在云雾缭绕中与盘旋的龙或蛇进行激烈战斗的场景。在右下角，放置 1 座隐匿于山间的发光寺庙神龛，内部可见一尊金色的神像。在底部区域，添加 3 位在雾气弥漫的山谷中行走的微小朝圣者。运用大气深度、优雅的书法笔触、飘渺的云雾，以及精致的电影级构图，使其呈现出绘画质感而非数字感。在左侧添加垂直的中文书法，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="西游记"}，并配以较小的侧边垂直文字和几枚印章风格的印记，以呈现地道的海报设计。在右侧悬崖面上加入另一处隐约的垂直位置铭文。整体氛围神圣、史诗、古老、神秘且富有诗意，具备顶级概念艺术的质感，几乎没有常见的 AI 生成痕迹。

templates.title: Gritty Evangelion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 硬核风格《新世纪福音战士》海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vintage anime poster in the style of a gritty sci-fi mecha key visual, featuring three teenage pilots standing back-to-back in the foreground and a towering purple biomechanical robot looming directly behind them. The center pilot is a slim teenage boy in a dark navy and black plug suit with white shoulder panels and a glowing red circular core on the chest, standing front-facing with a serious expression. On the left is a pale teenage girl with short icy blue bob-cut hair and a white futuristic bodysuit, turned slightly away in profile. On the right is a teenage girl with long auburn hair flowing to the side, wearing a vivid red plug suit, looking outward with determination. Behind all three, the giant mecha head dominates the composition, centered and symmetrical, with a single horn, glowing orange eyes, angular armor, and massive shoulder structures rising like black wings. The background is outer space with 2 visible celestial bodies: 1 huge cratered moon directly behind the mecha’s head and 1 smaller planet at the right side. The bottom of the poster shows a ruined futuristic cityscape with broken buildings, rubble, sparks, and debris. At the very bottom center, include 2 tiny human silhouettes running forward through destruction, framed by pink energy streaks arcing left and right. Use a dark indigo, black, purple, rust red, and ash gray palette with heavy film grain, distressed ink texture, weathered paper wear, paint splatter, scratched print damage, and a rough screen-printed poster finish. Compose it as a full theatrical one-sheet with dense typography integrated into the edges: large vertical English title text on the left reading "NEON GENESIS EVANGELION", smaller vertical red text beside it reading "HIRANO OF EVANGELION", a red NERV insignia and the word "NERV" near the lower left, a boxed label at bottom left reading "TOKYO-3" and "JAPAN", a red warning box at the upper right reading "ANGEL ATTACK" with Japanese characters beneath, and multiple vertical Japanese taglines along the left and right borders. Cinematic, moody, apocalyptic, highly detailed, iconic 1990s anime poster design with premium modern illustration quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧张力的复古动漫海报，采用硬核科幻机甲主视觉风格。前景中，三名少年驾驶员背靠背站立，身后矗立着一台巨大的紫色生物机械机器人。中间的驾驶员是一位身材瘦削的少年，身穿深海军蓝配黑色的驾驶服，肩部带有白色镶板，胸口有一个发光的红色圆形核心，正面朝向前方，表情严肃。左侧是一位面色苍白的少女，留着冰蓝色短波波头，身穿白色未来感紧身衣，侧身微转。右侧是一位留着赤褐色长发的少女，发丝飘向一侧，身穿鲜艳的红色驾驶服，神情坚定地看向前方。在三人身后，巨大的机甲头部占据了构图中心，对称分布，长有一只角，双眼散发着橙色光芒，装甲棱角分明，巨大的肩部结构如同黑色羽翼般向上延伸。背景为外太空，可见 2 个天体：机甲头部正后方有一颗巨大的环形山月球，右侧有一颗较小的行星。海报底部展示了一座破败的未来城市，建筑残破，瓦砾、火花和碎片四散。在底部正中央，包含 2 个正在废墟中向前奔跑的微小人类剪影，周围环绕着向左右两侧弧形延伸的粉色能量流。色调采用深靛蓝、黑、紫、铁锈红和灰烬灰，带有浓重的胶片颗粒感、做旧墨迹纹理、风化的纸张磨损、油漆飞溅、划痕印刷损伤以及粗糙的丝网印刷海报质感。整体构图为完整的电影单张海报，边缘融合了密集的排版：左侧为巨大的垂直英文标题“NEON GENESIS EVANGELION”，旁边是较小的红色垂直文字“HIRANO OF EVANGELION”，左下角附近有红色的 NERV 标志和单词“NERV”，左下角有一个方框标签，写着“TOKYO-3”和“JAPAN”，右上角有一个红色的警告框，写着“ANGEL ATTACK”及其下方的日文字符，左右边缘还有多行垂直的日文标语。电影感、情绪化、末日氛围、高度细节，呈现出 1990 年代标志性动漫海报设计与现代高端插画品质的完美结合。

templates.title: Dark Chinese Crime Drama Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑风格中国犯罪剧海报

templates.prompt: A dark, gritty Chinese crime-thriller movie poster in a vertical one-sheet layout, with a moody neo-noir aesthetic and heavy cinematic contrast. The composition centers on a half-length portrait of a menacing middle-aged East Asian man with wavy black hair, wearing a dark textured overcoat over a black shirt, his face mostly swallowed by shadow, shown from chest up and slightly off-center to the right. His hands are visible in the lower-right area, calmly holding a string of dark wooden prayer beads, suggesting power, danger, and ritual. The background is a dim urban alley or old city street at night, layered with grunge textures, wet pavement reflections, decayed walls, and faint architectural silhouettes. In the lower center, place 1 small back-facing seated figure in a chair under a harsh spotlight, surrounded by 9 standing human silhouettes in the darkness, creating a tense interrogation or underworld confrontation scene. Use an almost monochrome palette of black, charcoal, and dirty gray, with deep blood-red accents and distressed white typography. On the left side, add 1 huge vertical column of expressive red Chinese brush-calligraphy title text, painted with rough splashes and dry-brush texture, dominating nearly the full height of the poster. Along the far left edge, add 2 vertical lines of smaller Chinese text in white and red: "我叫高启强，" and "风浪越大，鱼越贵". On the right side, add 1 vertical cast credit line in white Chinese text with a red circular separator: "张颂文 饰 高启强". In the lower-right quadrant, add 1 bold white brushstroke Chinese subtitle/title mark reading "狂飙", with the small English subtitle "THE KNOCKOUT" in red serif capitals beneath it. The overall feeling should be oppressive, violent, prestigious, and highly designed, like a premium streaming-platform crime drama key art poster, with layered depth, dramatic shadows, textured smoke and grime, and realistic photographic detail.

templates.prompt: A dreamy pastel anime illustration of a serene young woman in a moonlit spring garden beside a pond, rendered in delicate Japanese fantasy style with flat anime coloring, no shadows, ultra-clean linework, and no grainy texture. She is seated in three-quarter back view at the water’s edge, turning her face slightly toward the viewer with a calm, melancholic expression. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with soft bangs and floral ornaments woven into a blossom crown. She wears an elegant flowing kimono in pale blue and cream, richly patterned with stylized waves and white foxes, with layered fabric pooling around her. A large traditional paper parasol rests behind her on the right side, partly open, with dangling crystal-like ornaments. Surround her with dense blooming cherry blossom branches overhead and scattered petals in the foreground. The pond is filled with exactly 10 glowing lotus flowers floating on reflective water and exactly 4 visible koi fish swimming near the surface. In the distant left background, include a small multi-tier pagoda silhouette across the water. From the upper left, a soft rainbow beam of light descends diagonally onto the pond, creating iridescent reflections. Hang several faceted crystal ornaments from the branches so they sparkle in the light. Use a palette dominated by lavender, blush pink, pale blue, ivory, and soft gold. The atmosphere should feel ethereal, romantic, tranquil, and magical, with intricate decorative detail, luminous water reflections, and a polished vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的粉彩动漫插画，描绘了一位宁静的少女在月光下的春日花园池畔。画面采用精致的日式奇幻风格，平涂动漫色彩，无阴影，线条极其干净，无颗粒感。她以四分之三背影坐在水边，脸庞微微转向观众，表情平静而忧郁。她留着极长的直发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，配有柔和的刘海，发间编织着花朵装饰，形成花冠。她身穿优雅飘逸的淡蓝色与奶油色和服，上面饰有风格化的波浪和白狐图案，层叠的布料在周围铺开。右后方斜靠着一把半开的传统纸伞，伞上悬挂着水晶般的装饰物。头顶上方环绕着茂密的樱花枝，前景中散落着花瓣。池塘中漂浮着 10 朵发光的莲花，水面附近有 4 条清晰可见的锦鲤在游动。远处的左侧背景中，水面上隐约可见一座小型多层宝塔的剪影。从左上方，一道柔和的彩虹光束斜射入池塘，营造出虹彩般的倒影。树枝上悬挂着几串刻面水晶装饰，在光线下闪烁。色调以薰衣草紫、淡粉色、淡蓝色、象牙白和柔和的金色为主。整体氛围空灵、浪漫、宁静且充满魔力，细节装饰繁复，水面反光熠熠生辉，构图精致且呈竖向布局。

templates.title: Modern Queen on Iron Throne Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 现代女王铁王座海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic fantasy poster in the style of an epic medieval throne-room drama, showing a modern woman seated confidently on a dark iron sword throne. She is centered in a full-body portrait, sitting with one leg crossed over the other and both arms resting casually on the throne arms, projecting relaxed queenly confidence. She has long, wavy {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair falling over her shoulders, and wears contemporary casual clothing instead of period costume: a fitted long-sleeve {argument name="top color" default="deep burgundy"} shirt, dark blue skinny jeans, and black ankle boots. The throne is massive, jagged, and forged from overlapping weathered swords, filling most of the background. The setting is a dim, moody royal hall with warm firelight, soft glowing candles, faint sparks or embers in the air, and two vertical banners in the distant background bearing a red three-headed dragon-style sigil. Use dramatic, high-contrast lighting, rich dark metallic textures, warm orange highlights, and a polished premium fantasy-poster look. Add faint handwritten-style text near the upper left arc of the throne reading {argument name="name text" default="LAREENA STARKER"}. At the bottom, add large ornate metallic-gold title typography in a fantasy serif style reading {argument name="main title" default="BABE"} on the first line, smaller centered "OF" below it, and {argument name="subtitle" default="THRONES"} in very large letters across the bottom, with the O stylized as a circular emblem with vertical bars. Vertical poster composition, symmetrical framing, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, regal but playful modern parody of an iconic fantasy throne poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张史诗级中世纪王座厅剧风格的电影感奇幻海报，展示了一位现代女性自信地坐在黑暗的铁剑王座上。她位于全身肖像的中心，双腿交叠，双臂随意地搭在王座扶手上，展现出一种轻松而女王范儿的自信。她留着长长的波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 发丝垂在肩头，身穿现代休闲装而非古装：一件修身长袖 {argument name="top color" default="深酒红色"} 上衣、深蓝色紧身牛仔裤和黑色短靴。王座巨大且参差不齐，由重叠的风化剑刃锻造而成，占据了大部分背景。场景设定在一个昏暗、忧郁的皇家大厅中，伴有温暖的烛光、柔和的烛火、空气中漂浮的微弱火星或余烬，背景远处悬挂着两面带有红色三头龙纹章的垂直旗帜。采用戏剧性的高对比度照明、丰富的深色金属质感、温暖的橙色高光，呈现出精致的高级奇幻海报质感。在王座左上方的弧形区域附近添加模糊的手写风格文字，内容为 {argument name="name text" default="LAREENA STARKER"}。在底部，添加醒目且华丽的金属金色奇幻衬线字体标题，第一行显示 {argument name="main title" default="BABE"}，下方居中显示较小的“OF”，最底部以超大字体显示 {argument name="subtitle" default="THRONES"}，其中“O”字母被设计为带有垂直条纹的圆形徽章。竖版海报构图，对称式框架，超精细，照片级真实感，是对标志性奇幻王座海报的华丽而俏皮的现代恶搞。

templates.title: Netflix-Style Vibe Coder Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Netflix 风格“氛围编码员”海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic parody streaming-poster in vertical 2:3 format, styled like a dark Netflix original teaser poster for a humorous AI programming drama. At the very top, small white text reads {argument name="top banner text" default="A NETFLIX ORIGINAL"}. Centered and dominating the composition, huge glowing sci-fi sans serif title text in icy white with a faint lavender-blue neon bloom reads {argument name="title text" default="VIBE CODER"}, stacked on two lines. Below it, smaller white text says "STARRING" and beneath that a pink cast name in bold all caps reads {argument name="cast name" default="HUNKINS"}. The scene shows a dim moody programmer bedroom or office at night lit by monitors and purple-blue neon. In the center foreground, a plush teddy-bear-like mascot with white fuzzy paws sits slouched in a black desk chair wearing a black hoodie, face mostly hidden in shadow for a mysterious comedic look. On the hoodie chest, 4 lines of small off-white text read exactly: "// SHIP IT", "// VIBE CHECK", "// NO BUGS", "// JUST VIBES". In front of the character is an open laptop covered with 4 visible stickers: "vibe > spec", "DON'T THINK JUST PROMPT", a smiley face sticker, and "Claude 3.5", plus an abstract AI-style logo sticker. Behind the laptop are 2 widescreen monitors displaying dense code on dark themes. The background includes 2 wall notes/signs on the left: a sticky note reading "IDEAS > PLANS" and, on the right, a whiteboard with 3 stacked handwritten lines reading "BUILD FAST", "BREAK THINGS", "ASK AI", and a fourth line "REPEAT" beneath, plus a hand-drawn smiley. Next to the whiteboard is a pink-purple neon </> code icon sign. On the desk at lower right sits a matte black drink can with pink text reading "FOCUS (optional)" and a cardboard pizza box edge labeled "ITERATE LATER". Use rich shadows, soft practical light, purple and cyan rim light, subtle monitor glow, shallow depth of field, high contrast, glossy premium poster finish, and a slightly absurd, self-aware startup-comedy tone. At the bottom, centered white tagline text reads {argument name="tagline text" default="HE’S NOT A PROGRAMMER. HE’S A VIBE CODER."}, with the word "VIBE" highlighted in pink. Below that, a release line in white and red reads {argument name="release line" default="ONLY ON NETFLIX | COMING SOON"}, with "NETFLIX" in bold red. Make it look like a polished official teaser one-sheet for a fictional streaming series.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 2:3 纵向比例的电影感戏仿流媒体海报，采用类似 Netflix 原创黑色幽默 AI 编程剧集的预告海报风格。最上方，小号白色文字显示 {argument name="top banner text" default="A NETFLIX ORIGINAL"}。画面中央占据主导地位的是巨大的发光科幻无衬线标题文字，呈冰白色，带有淡淡的淡紫色霓虹光晕，显示为 {argument name="title text" default="VIBE CODER"}，分两行排列。下方是较小的白色文字“STARRING”，再下方是粉色的加粗全大写演员姓名 {argument name="cast name" default="HUNKINS"}。场景展示了一个昏暗、情绪化的程序员卧室或办公室，夜晚由显示器和紫蓝色霓虹灯照亮。前景中央，一个毛绒泰迪熊般的吉祥物懒散地坐在黑色办公椅上，穿着黑色连帽衫，脸部大部分隐藏在阴影中，营造出一种神秘的喜剧感。连帽衫胸前有 4 行米白色小字，内容为：“// SHIP IT”、“// VIBE CHECK”、“// NO BUGS”、“// JUST VIBES”。角色前方是一台打开的笔记本电脑，上面贴着 4 张可见的贴纸：“vibe > spec”、“DON'T THINK JUST PROMPT”、一个笑脸贴纸、“Claude 3.5”，以及一个抽象的 AI 风格标志贴纸。笔记本电脑后方是 2 台宽屏显示器，显示着深色主题的密集代码。背景包括左侧的 2 张墙面便签/标语：一张写着“IDEAS > PLANS”的便签；右侧是一个项目，上面有 3 行手写文字“BUILD FAST”、“BREAK THINGS”、“ASK AI”，下方还有第四行“REPEAT”，以及一个手绘笑脸。项目旁边是一个粉紫色霓虹灯 </> 代码图标标志。右下角的桌子上放着一个哑光黑色饮料罐，上面用粉色文字写着“FOCUS (optional)”，还有一个写着“ITERATE LATER”的披萨盒边缘。运用丰富的阴影、柔和的实用光线、紫色和青色的轮廓光、微妙的显示器光晕、浅景深、高对比度、光面高级海报质感，以及一种略显荒诞、具有自我意识的初创公司喜剧基调。底部居中的白色标语文字显示 {argument name="tagline text" default="HE’S NOT A PROGRAMMER. HE’S A VIBE CODER."}，其中“VIBE”一词以粉色高亮显示。下方是白色和红色的发布日期行 {argument name="release line" default="ONLY ON NETFLIX | COMING SOON"}，其中“NETFLIX”为加粗红色。使其看起来像是一部虚构流媒体剧集的精致官方预告海报。

templates.title: 2x2 Beauty Portrait Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 2x2 美妆人像拼图

templates.prompt: A clean 2x2 portrait collage of {argument name="subject" default="a young East Asian woman"} in a minimal studio setting with a soft white background, photographed in a high-end beauty editorial style. All four panels are tightly framed close-up or cropped bust portraits with soft diffused lighting, realistic skin texture, crisp pores, subtle natural freckles, glossy eyes, and sharp details around the eyelashes, lips, and hair strands. The overall color palette is pale, airy, and neutral with gentle pink accents, while the subject has straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and wispy bangs in most panels. In the top-left panel, she faces forward with both hands pressed to her cheeks, elbows out of frame, creating a cute symmetrical pose; her face is largely covered by her hands, only the hair, ears, and sides of the face visible. In the top-right panel, show the clearest beauty portrait: direct eye contact, calm slightly melancholic expression, crossed fingers held in front of the lips, long translucent pale pink manicure, and exactly 4 chunky pink plastic flower rings across the fingers, with delicate makeup and softly parted lips. In the bottom-left panel, she leans on a white tabletop with one arm folded forward, wearing exactly 2 pink hair clips on the left side of her hair, casual and youthful styling, relaxed posture. In the bottom-right panel, show a cropped portrait with the hair tied back, one hand supporting the chin, wearing a fluffy off-white sherpa zip jacket over a light pink top, minimal makeup, and a quiet natural expression. Keep the composition editorial and balanced, with each panel separated by thin white gutters, ultra-realistic beauty photography, enhanced image clarity, deblurred details, natural skin, soft shadows, and premium cosmetics campaign quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的 2x2 人像拼图，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的东亚女性"}，背景为极简影棚风格的柔和白色，采用高端美妆编辑风格拍摄。四格画面均为紧凑的特写或半身像，光线柔和漫射，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、清晰的毛孔、细腻的自然雀斑、水润的眼眸，以及睫毛、嘴唇和发丝的锐利细节。整体色调淡雅、通透且中性，带有柔和的粉色点缀；主体在多数画面中留着直的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 发型，并带有轻薄的刘海。左上角画面中，她正对镜头，双手按在脸颊上，手肘位于画框外，形成可爱的对称姿势；面部大部分被双手遮挡，仅露出头发、耳朵和脸部侧面。右上角画面展示最清晰的美妆人像：直视镜头，表情平静略带忧郁，手指交叉置于唇前，留着长款半透明淡粉色美甲，手指上佩戴着 4 枚厚实的粉色塑料花朵戒指，妆容精致，双唇微启。左下角画面中，她单手叠放支撑在白色桌面上，左侧头发上别着 2 个粉色发夹，造型休闲年轻，姿态放松。右下角画面展示一张扎起头发的半身特写，单手托腮，身穿浅粉色内搭和毛茸茸的米白色羊羔绒拉链外套，妆容极简，表情安静自然。构图保持编辑风格且平衡，各画面间由细白边分隔，呈现超写实美妆摄影效果，画质清晰，细节锐利，皮肤质感自然，阴影柔和，具备高端化妆品广告大片的品质。

templates.title: Neumorphic Glass UI Kit Board

titleLocalized.zh: Neumorphic Glass UI Kit 项目

templates.prompt: A clean neumorphic UI component showcase on a soft light gray background, arranged as a balanced design board of 18 separate interface elements with subtle shadows, frosted translucent white plastic surfaces, rounded corners, and glossy glass-like depth. Use a premium minimal product-design aesthetic with white-on-white layering, soft ambient occlusion, delicate inner shadows, and a restrained accent palette of deep teal green and vivid orange. Include 18 distinct components: 1 large circular rotary knob in the upper left with a dark teal glossy center, fine radial tick marks, and a small orange position indicator; 1 small circular directional control pad with a teal center button and four tiny arrow icons around it; 1 circular play button with a teal triangle icon and a short orange progress arc on the rim; 1 horizontal pill toggle switch at the top right with a teal knob positioned to the right; 1 rounded square heart button with a simple teal outline heart; 1 small circular indicator button with a single orange dot in the center; 1 pill-shaped plus-minus control with a teal minus on the left and teal plus on the right separated by a vertical divider; 1 long horizontal volume slider with a teal speaker icon on the left, fine slider ticks, a teal track, a teal knob near the right side, and a faint waveform icon on the far right; 1 circular percentage dial showing 60% with radial ticks and a few orange highlight marks near the upper right; 1 rounded square bell notification button with a teal outline bell icon; 1 compact music player card with a small square album image of misty evergreen trees on the left, the title {argument name="track title" default="Forest Drive"}, the subtitle {argument name="track subtitle" default="Ambient Journey"}, a thin progress bar, and a circular play button on the right; 4 small circular utility icon buttons in one row showing sliders/settings, search, share, and ellipsis; 1 large circular compass with cardinal letters N, E, S, W plus diagonal labels, a teal-and-orange needle, and metallic center; 1 tall vertical slider on the right with a teal track, teal knob around the middle, small side dots, an orange accent near the bottom, and a tiny speaker icon below; 1 bottom navigation bar in a long rounded pill containing 4 icons separated by subtle dividers: home, bar chart, compass, and user profile, with the home tab active in teal; 1 large rounded pill call-to-action button in glossy dark teal labeled {argument name="button text" default="Explore"} with a circular orange arrow button attached on the right; and 1 rounded square fingerprint button with a teal fingerprint icon. Keep spacing generous, alignment grid-based, and the overall render highly polished, tactile, and futuristic, like a luxury smart-device UI kit mockup.

promptLocalized.zh: 在柔和的浅灰色背景上展示简洁的拟态 UI 组件，布局为一个平衡的 18 个独立界面元素设计项目，具有微妙的阴影、磨砂半透明白色塑料表面、圆角以及光洁的玻璃质感。采用高级极简产品设计美学，结合白底白色的分层效果、柔和的环境光遮蔽、精致的内部阴影，以及深青绿色和鲜橙色的克制点缀色调。包含 18 个独特的组件：左上角 1 个大型圆形旋转旋钮，带有深青色光泽中心、精细的径向刻度及一个小橙色位置指示器；1 个小型圆形方向控制盘，带有青色中心按钮及周围的四个微小箭头图标；1 个圆形播放按钮，带有青色三角形图标及边缘的一段短橙色进度弧线；右上角 1 个水平药丸状切换开关，青色旋钮位于右侧；1 个圆角方形心形按钮，带有简单的青色轮廓心形；1 个小型圆形指示器按钮，中心有一个橙色圆点；1 个药丸状加减控制键，左侧为青色减号，右侧为青色加号，中间由垂直分隔线隔开；1 个长水平音量滑块，左侧带有青色扬声器图标、精细滑块刻度、青色轨道、右侧附近的青色旋钮，以及最右侧淡淡的波形图标；1 个圆形百分比表盘，显示 60%，带有径向刻度及右上角附近的几个橙色高亮标记；1 个圆角方形铃铛通知按钮，带有青色轮廓铃铛图标；1 个紧凑型音乐播放器卡片，左侧为一张雾气缭绕的常青树小方形专辑图片，标题为 {argument name="track title" default="Forest Drive"}，副标题为 {argument name="track subtitle" default="Ambient Journey"}，带有细进度条及右侧的圆形播放按钮；一行 4 个小型圆形实用图标按钮，分别显示滑块/设置、搜索、分享及省略号；1 个大型圆形指南针，带有方位字母 N、E、S、W 及对角线标签，配有青橙双色指针及金属中心；右侧 1 个高垂直滑块，带有青色轨道、位于中间的青色旋钮、侧边小圆点、底部附近的橙色点缀及下方的一个微小扬声器图标；1 个底部导航栏，呈长圆角药丸状，包含 4 个由微妙分隔线隔开的图标：主页、柱状图、指南针及用户个人资料，其中主页标签为青色激活状态；1 个大型圆角药丸状行动号召按钮，采用光泽深青色，标签为 {argument name="button text" default="Explore"}，右侧附带一个圆形橙色箭头按钮；以及 1 个圆角方形指纹按钮，带有青色指纹图标。保持间距充裕、对齐基于网格，整体渲染效果高度精细、具有触感且充满未来感，宛如奢华智能设备 UI 套件样机。

templates.prompt: A clean neumorphic mobile dashboard UI mockup shown straight-on, centered on a soft light gray background, inside a white rounded smartphone frame with subtle embossed shadows and glossy soft highlights. The interface uses a minimalist white-on-white design with teal green and warm orange accent colors. At the very top of the phone, include a small circular menu button on the left, a centered speaker slit and front camera dot, and status icons on the right showing Wi‑Fi, signal, 100%, and battery. The main layout contains 12 distinct UI modules: 1 large time card at upper left showing “AM”, “10:24”, and “Friday, May 24” with three tiny pagination dots beneath; 1 weather card at upper right showing a soft 3D partly cloudy sun icon, “24°”, “Partly Cloudy”, and “New York”; 4 small circular action buttons in one row under the time card, showing a grid icon, heart, bell, and gear, with the grid button filled in dark teal; 1 slim horizontal slider card to the right of those buttons with a droplet icon, “40%”, and a teal progress bar; 1 large circular volume control occupying the left middle area, with a thick beveled silver knob, a surrounding tick-mark ring split into teal on the left and orange on the right, a short orange indicator line near the upper right, tiny speaker icons on both sides, and a pill label reading “VOLUME”; 1 music player card on the right middle with square album art in dark teal waves, the title “Ocean Drive”, subtitle “Miami Nights”, a thin orange playback progress line with times “1:45” and “3:48”, and three circular transport controls for previous, play, and next, with the play button filled teal; 3 small rounded buttons in a row beneath the music player, showing an equalizer icon filled teal, a broadcast icon, and sliders icon; 1 compass card at lower left with small circular buttons in the top corners, heading text “320° NW” above, and a detailed analog compass with N, E, S, W letters and a teal-and-orange needle pointing northwest; 1 equalizer card at lower right with four vertical sliders, scale markings “+12”, “0”, “-12”, and bottom frequency labels “60”, “250”, “1K”, “4K”, “16K”, using orange slider stems and white knobs; and 5 bottom dock controls: an orange circular power button, a small Bluetooth button, a central pill waveform panel, a crescent moon button, and a sun brightness button. Use soft ambient shadows, gentle inner embossing, rounded corners, precise spacing, and a premium futuristic smart-home or control-center aesthetic inspired by high-end dribbble neumorphism, ultra-detailed, crisp vector UI, realistic depth, polished product presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个简洁的拟态风格移动端仪表盘 UI 模型，采用正视视角，居中置于柔和的浅灰色背景之上，嵌入在一个带有细腻浮雕阴影和光泽柔和高光的白色圆角智能手机边框内。界面采用极简的白底白设计，辅以青绿色和暖橙色的点缀。手机顶部左侧设有一个小型圆形菜单按钮，中间为扬声器缝隙和前置摄像头圆点，右侧为显示 Wi-Fi、信号、100% 电量及电池状态的图标。主布局包含 12 个独特的 UI 模块：左上角为一个大型时间卡片，显示“AM”、“10:24”及“5 月 24 日，星期五”，下方带有三个微型分页圆点；右上角为一个天气卡片，显示柔和的 3D 多云转晴图标、“24°”、“局部多云”及“纽约”；时间卡片下方一行排列着 4 个小型圆形操作按钮，分别为网格图标、心形、铃铛和齿轮，其中网格按钮填充为深青色；按钮右侧为一个细长的水平滑块卡片，带有水滴图标、“40%”及青色进度条；左侧中部为一个大型圆形音量控制器，配有厚实的斜面银色旋钮、周围环绕的刻度环（左侧为青色，右侧为橙色）、右上角附近的短橙色指示线、两侧的小型扬声器图标，以及一个写有“VOLUME”的胶囊状标签；右侧中部为一个音乐播放器卡片，带有深青色波浪纹的方形专辑封面，标题为“Ocean Drive”，副标题为“Miami Nights”，一条橙色的细播放进度条显示时间“1:45”和“3:48”，以及三个用于上一曲、播放、下一曲的圆形传输控制按钮，其中播放按钮填充为青色；音乐播放器下方一行排列着 3 个小型圆角按钮，分别为填充青色的均衡器图标、广播图标和滑块图标；左下角为一个指南针卡片，顶部角落设有小型圆形按钮，上方显示航向文本“320° NW”，以及一个带有 N、E、S、W 字母和指向西北方向的青橙双色指针的精细模拟指南针；右下角为一个均衡器卡片，带有四个垂直滑块、刻度标记“+12”、“0”、“-12”以及底部的频率标签“60”、“250”、“1K”、“4K”、“16K”，使用橙色滑块杆和白色旋钮；底部停靠栏包含 5 个控制按钮：一个橙色圆形电源按钮、一个小型蓝牙按钮、一个中央胶囊状波形面板、一个新月按钮和一个太阳亮度按钮。运用柔和的环境阴影、细腻的内部浮雕、圆角设计、精确的间距，打造出受高端 Dribbble 拟态风格启发、超精细、清晰的矢量 UI、具有真实深度感和精致产品质感的未来主义智能家居或控制中心美学。

templates.title: Neumorphic Smart UI Kit

titleLocalized.zh: 拟态智能 UI 套件

templates.prompt: Create a premium neumorphic smart-home and media control UI kit on a clean light gray background, arranged as a balanced dashboard-style composition of floating rounded cards and circular controls with soft extruded shadows, subtle inner highlights, frosted white surfaces, and elegant teal-and-orange accents. The overall style is minimalist, futuristic, tactile, and highly polished, like a high-end mobile interface concept. Include exactly 18 discrete UI modules and icons: 1 large circular volume knob card in the upper left with a glossy deep teal center, dotted perimeter, plus and minus symbols, and the text “VOLUME 67%”; 1 vertical volume slider card with the label “VOLUME”, a white knob, orange level bars, small speaker icons, and “67%”; 1 large circular balance dial at the top center-right with numeric markings 25, 50, 75, 100, the central value “72%”, the label “BALANCE”, and a small orange indicator dot; 1 circular compass widget in the upper right with N, E, S, W labels, a metallic teal compass needle, and a small orange accent dot on the rim; 1 smaller circular min-max knob on the left middle with a teal center, textured white dial edge, orange indicator dot, and “MIN” and “MAX” labels; 3 small circular utility buttons beneath it in one row, showing a power symbol, a connectivity or wireless symbol, and a heart outline; 1 horizontal toggle switch below those buttons with a teal knob and the text “ON”; 1 large media player card in the center with a square album cover showing abstract layered teal dunes or waves, the track title “Beyond The Horizon”, the artist name “Aurora Nights”, a heart icon in the top right, a waveform progress display, timestamps “1:45” and “3:58”, and 4 playback controls along the bottom row: shuffle, previous, central orange play button, next, and repeat; 6 rounded-square app icons in two columns on the right side, arranged in 3 rows, showing exactly these symbols: paper plane arrow, stacked layers, shield with check mark, cloud, bell with a small orange notification dot, and gear; 1 rectangular clock card at the bottom left with a circular analog clock face, large digital time “10:58 AM”, the date line “Thursday, May 23”, and sunrise/sunset times “06:15 AM” and “08:24 PM”; 1 weather card at the bottom center with the location “San Francisco”, current temperature “18°”, condition “Partly Cloudy”, high/low “H: 21°  L: 13°”, a large sun-behind-cloud illustration, and a 5-column hourly forecast labeled “11 AM”, “12 PM”, “1 PM”, “2 PM”, “3 PM”; 1 pill-shaped tab selector at the lower right with 3 tabs, where the left tab is active in teal with an audio waveform icon, and the other 2 tabs show a user icon and a folder icon; 1 search bar directly beneath it with a magnifying glass and placeholder text “Search...” ; 1 horizontal slider below the search bar with a teal progress line and a white knob; 1 large rounded CTA button at the bottom right reading “{argument name="button text" default="EXPLORE"}” with a right-facing orange arrow; and 5 circular bottom navigation icons centered along the bottom edge, showing home, bar chart, calendar with “23”, chat bubble, and user profile, plus 2 floating action buttons beside them: a camera icon and an orange plus sign. Use a restrained palette with white and very light gray surfaces, deep teal-green gradients for active states, and warm orange for highlights and notifications. Emphasize depth through soft ambient shadows, subtle bevels, glossy reflections, and realistic material rendering. Keep the layout spacious, symmetric but not rigid, and suitable for a luxury mobile app concept presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的浅灰色背景上创建一个高端的拟态智能家居与媒体控制 UI 套件，以平衡的仪表盘风格布局排列，包含悬浮圆角卡片和带有柔和挤压阴影、细腻内部高光、磨砂白色表面以及优雅青色与橙色点缀的圆形控件。整体风格极简、具有未来感、触感真实且高度精致，如同高端移动端界面概念。包含 18 个独立的 UI 模块和图标：左上角 1 个大型圆形音量旋钮卡片，中心为深青色光泽，带有圆点边缘、加减符号以及文字“VOLUME 67%”；1 个垂直音量滑块卡片，带有“VOLUME”标签、白色旋钮、橙色电平条、小型扬声器图标和“67%”；顶部中右侧 1 个大型圆形平衡拨盘，带有 25、50、75、100 的数字刻度，中心数值为“72%”，标签为“BALANCE”，以及一个小型橙色指示点；右上角 1 个圆形指南针小部件，带有 N、E、S、W 标签、金属青色指针以及边缘的一个小型橙色强调点；左侧中部 1 个较小的圆形最小-最大旋钮，带有青色中心、纹理白色拨盘边缘、橙色指示点以及“MIN”和“MAX”标签；下方一行 3 个小型圆形功能按钮，分别显示电源符号、连接或无线符号以及心形轮廓；这些按钮下方 1 个水平切换开关，带有青色旋钮和文字“ON”；中心 1 个大型媒体播放器卡片，带有显示抽象层叠青色沙丘或波浪的方形专辑封面，曲目名称“Beyond The Horizon”，艺术家名称“Aurora Nights”，右上角心形图标，波形进度显示，时间戳“1:45”和“3:58”，以及底部一行的 4 个播放控件：随机播放、上一首、中央橙色播放按钮、下一首和循环播放；右侧两列 3 行共 6 个圆角方形应用图标，精确显示以下符号：纸飞机箭头、堆叠图层、带勾选标记的盾牌、云朵、带有小型橙色通知点的铃铛以及齿轮；左下角 1 个矩形时钟卡片，带有圆形模拟时钟表盘、大型数字时间“10:58 AM”、日期行“Thursday, May 23”以及日出/日落时间“06:15 AM”和“08:24 PM”；底部中心 1 个天气卡片，显示位置“San Francisco”、当前温度“18°”、天气状况“Partly Cloudy”、最高/最低温“H: 21° L: 13°”、大型云后太阳插图，以及标注为“11 AM”、“12 PM”、“1 PM”、“2 PM”、“3 PM”的 5 列小时预报；右下角 1 个药丸状标签选择器，包含 3 个标签，左侧标签为激活状态（青色，带音频波形图标），另外 2 个标签显示用户图标和文件夹图标；其正下方 1 个搜索栏，带有放大镜和占位符文字“Search...”；搜索栏下方 1 个水平滑块，带有青色进度线和白色旋钮；右下角 1 个大型圆角 CTA 按钮，文字为“{argument name="button text" default="EXPLORE"}”，并带有一个向右的橙色箭头；底部边缘居中 5 个圆形底部导航图标，分别显示主页、柱状图、带有“23”的日历、聊天气泡和用户个人资料，旁边还有 2 个悬浮操作按钮：相机图标和橙色加号。使用以白色和极浅灰色表面为主的克制色调，激活状态使用深青绿色渐变，高亮和通知使用暖橙色。通过柔和的环境阴影、细腻的斜面、光泽反射和逼真的材质渲染来强调深度。保持布局宽敞、对称但不僵硬，适合高端移动应用概念演示。

templates.title: Wuxia MMORPG Ancient Town Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 武侠 MMORPG 古镇游戏截图

templates.prompt: A highly detailed cinematic third-person wuxia MMORPG gameplay screenshot set in a bustling ancient Chinese water-town market street at dusk, viewed from behind the player character standing in the center foreground. The player character is a wandering swordsman in layered dark gray and blue hanfu-style robes with embroidered fabric, long black hair tied in a low ponytail, and a sheathed sword on his back, facing forward into a crowded street. The environment is a richly rendered Ming- or Song-inspired town with traditional wooden shopfronts, tiled roofs, hanging red lanterns, pink cherry blossom trees, damp reflective stone pavement, soft golden evening light, and a lived-in crowd of townsfolk in historical clothing. On the right foreground, exactly 3 elegant female courtesans in translucent pastel hanfu sit and stand outside a richly decorated teahouse or brothel draped with red silk curtains; one is playing a pipa, one is seated in pale green and cream robes, and one stands in flowing rose-pink robes. The largest shop sign above them features large gold Chinese calligraphy on a black plaque, and additional vertical shop banners with Chinese characters hang along the street. The composition should feel like a premium AAA fantasy Chinese RPG, with realistic character proportions, dense environmental storytelling, dramatic but natural lighting, atmospheric depth, and intricate costume materials. Include a complete game HUD overlay in Chinese: top left circular character portrait with level 36 and 2 horizontal bars for health and mana; a left-side quest tracker panel with exactly 4 quest entries under tabbed headings; a bottom left semi-transparent chat box with multiple lines of Chinese world chat; a top right circular minimap with location text; a right-side vertical menu with exactly 6 icon buttons; a bottom center skill bar with exactly 10 slots including 8 square skill icons plus 2 circular end slots labeled with keyboard keys; and a bottom menu row with exactly 6 navigation icons. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic fantasy game interface mockup, polished UI, immersive crowded street scene, 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的电影级第三人称武侠 MMORPG 游戏截图，场景设定在黄昏时分熙熙攘攘的中国古代水乡集市街道，视角位于前景中央玩家角色的后方。玩家角色是一位流浪剑客，身着深灰色与蓝色交叠的汉服风格长袍，衣物带有刺绣纹理，黑色长发扎成低马尾，背负一把剑鞘，正面向前方拥挤的街道。环境是渲染精美的明代或宋代风格城镇，拥有传统木质店面、瓦片屋顶、悬挂的红灯笼、粉色樱花树、潮湿且带有倒影的石板路、柔和的金色夕阳，以及身着古装的城镇居民。右侧前景处，恰好有 3 位优雅的女性艺伎身着半透明的淡色汉服，站在装饰华丽的茶馆或青楼外，此处挂有红色丝绸帘幕；其中一人正在弹奏琵琶，一人身着淡绿色与米色长袍坐着，另一人身着飘逸的玫瑰粉色长袍站立。上方最大的店招牌上写有黑色牌匾上的金色中文字体，街道两旁还悬挂着带有汉字的垂直店铺旗帜。整体构图应呈现出顶级 AAA 级中国奇幻 RPG 的质感，具备写实的角色比例、密集的场景叙事、戏剧性但自然的灯光、大气深度以及复杂的服装材质。包含完整的中文游戏 HUD 叠加层：左上角圆形角色头像，显示 36 级及 2 条水平的生命值与法力值进度条；左侧任务追踪面板，在标签标题下包含 4 条任务条目；左下角半透明聊天框，显示多行中文世界频道聊天内容；右上角圆形小地图，带有位置文本；右侧垂直菜单，包含 6 个图标按钮；底部中央的技能栏，包含 10 个槽位，其中 8 个方形技能图标及 2 个带有键盘按键标签的圆形末端槽位；底部菜单行包含 6 个导航图标。超细节、照片级真实的奇幻游戏界面模拟图，精致的 UI，沉浸式拥挤街道场景，16:9 纵横比。

templates.title: Japanese Graduation Photo Under Sakura

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花树下的日本毕业照

templates.prompt: A soft, realistic Japanese graduation-day photo in the style of vintage film photography, showing 6 teenage schoolgirls standing together outdoors in front of a school gate under full-bloom cherry blossoms. They wear matching Japanese high school uniforms: navy blazers, white shirts, burgundy ribbon bows, gray-blue plaid pleated skirts, navy knee-high socks, and black loafers, each carrying a large navy school bag. The group stands close together on the road at the entrance, with relaxed celebratory body language and a candid class-photo feel. At least 5 of the girls are making peace signs near their faces, and one girl on the far right raises her hand in a playful salute-like pose. Emphasize natural, flattering leg shapes, neat straight dark hair with soft bangs, youthful styling, and believable proportions. The composition is front-facing and full-body, with the students centered slightly left and the school gate on the right. Include a tall black gate pillar with vertical gold Japanese text reading "桜花女子高等学校" and a white ceremonial signboard beside it with large Japanese text reading "卒業証書授与式" and smaller school-name text below. Background filled with pale pink sakura trees in bloom, shallow depth of field, soft pastel tones, gentle spring haze, overcast bright daylight, subtle film grain, muted contrast, and an understated nostalgic atmosphere like an old-fashioned commemorative photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、写实的日本毕业日照片，采用复古胶片摄影风格，展示了 6 名十几岁的女学生站在户外，背景是盛开的樱花和学校大门。她们穿着统一的日本高中校服：海军蓝西装外套、白衬衫、酒红色蝴蝶结、灰蓝色格子百褶裙、海军蓝及膝袜和黑色乐福鞋，每人背着一个大号海军蓝书包。这群学生紧挨着站在校门口的路上，肢体语言轻松欢快，呈现出随意的班级合影感。其中至少 5 名女生在脸旁比着剪刀手，最右侧的一名女生举起手做着俏皮的敬礼姿势。强调自然、修长的腿部线条，整齐的深色直发配上柔和的刘海，青春的造型以及真实的比例。构图为正面全身照，学生们略微偏左，学校大门位于右侧。画面中包含一根高大的黑色门柱，上面有垂直的金色日文“桜花女子高等学校”，旁边立着一块白色仪式告示牌，上面写着醒目的日文“卒業証書授与式”以及下方较小的校名。背景是盛开的淡粉色樱花树，浅景深，柔和的粉彩色调，淡淡的春日薄雾，阴天明亮的日光，细腻的胶片颗粒感，柔和的对比度，营造出一种老式纪念照片般低调而怀旧的氛围。

templates.prompt: A cinematic third-person fantasy RPG gameplay screenshot set in an ancient Chinese market city at golden hour, viewed from slightly behind a small group of foreground characters and looking down a busy stone-paved street toward a grand multi-tier pagoda in the distance. The scene is dense with exactly 1 central male hero in ornate dark red and black robes with gold armor accents, holding a drawn sword pointed downward, and exactly 1 female companion beside him in elegant flowing white Hanfu with red trim and gold accessories. Around them are exactly 4 blurred foreground onlookers or guards framing the shot, 2 on the left and 2 on the right, plus a large crowd of townspeople in period clothing filling the street. Traditional wooden buildings with curved tiled roofs line both sides, with hanging lanterns, red banners, fabric awnings, market stalls, and warm window lights. Add drifting flower petals or glowing particles in the air, soft atmospheric haze, strong depth, and rich warm sunlight with long shadows. The image should feel like a polished AAA open-world wuxia action game, highly detailed, dramatic, immersive, and realistic with stylized fantasy beauty. Include a full in-game HUD overlay: a top-right square minimap with icons, a right-side quest list with exactly 3 visible entries where 1 reads {argument name="quest objective" default="Explore Ximen Mansion"} and 2 are repeated combat-related quests, a bottom-left circular player status area with health and stamina bars and the location text {argument name="location name" default="Dinghe County"}, a bottom-center action bar with exactly 6 circular skill icons, and a bottom-right row of exactly 8 small menu or system icons. Use a wide 16:9 composition, ultra-detailed environment art, cinematic lighting, shallow foreground blur, and a majestic historical Chinese fantasy atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级第三人称奇幻 RPG 游戏截图，背景设定在黄金时刻的中国古代市集，视角位于前景小队角色后方，俯瞰着繁忙的石板街道，远方矗立着一座宏伟的多层宝塔。场景细节丰富，画面中心为 1 名身着华丽深红黑配色长袍、点缀金色铠甲的男性英雄，手持向下指的拔出长剑；身旁有 1 名身着优雅飘逸白底红边汉服、佩戴金饰的女性同伴。周围有 4 名模糊的前景旁观者或守卫作为构图框架，左右各 2 名，街道上挤满了身着古装的城镇居民。街道两侧是带有弧形瓦顶的传统木质建筑，挂着灯笼、红旗、布质遮阳棚，设有摊位，窗户透出温暖的灯光。空中飘散着花瓣或发光粒子，带有柔和的大气雾感、强烈的景深效果，以及浓郁温暖的阳光和长长的阴影。画面应呈现出精致的 AAA 级开放世界武侠动作游戏质感，高度细腻、充满戏剧性、沉浸感强，并兼具风格化的奇幻美感。包含完整的游戏内 HUD 界面：右上角带有图标的方形小地图；右侧任务列表，其中可见 3 条任务，第 1 条显示为 {argument name="quest objective" default="探索西门府邸"}，其余 2 条为重复的战斗类任务；左下角圆形玩家状态区，包含生命值和体力条，以及位置文本 {argument name="location name" default="定河县"}；底部中央动作栏，包含 6 个圆形技能图标；右下角一排 8 个小型菜单或系统图标。采用 16:9 宽屏构图，超精细环境艺术，电影级光影，浅景深前景模糊，营造出宏伟的中国历史奇幻氛围。

templates.prompt: A luxurious studio fashion portrait of {argument name="group size" default="four"} elegant young women posed closely together in a dramatic royal-blue fantasy setting, all wearing coordinated deep sapphire and midnight-navy couture evening gowns with glittering beadwork, floral appliqué, sequins, lace sleeves, sheer mesh details, and voluminous layered skirts. The scene is monochromatic blue with a cool, moody, high-end editorial color grade. Arrange the women in a tight triangular composition: two standing or elevated in the back and two seated in front on draped fabric, with varied graceful poses, one woman raising an arm above her head, one leaning slightly, one seated upright, and one resting her chin on her hand. Their dresses should each be distinct but harmonized, featuring ornate crystal embellishments, embroidered flowers, and fitted bodices. Add matching sapphire jewelry including dangling earrings, gemstone necklaces, and floral hair accessories. Use long flowing hair in mixed dark black and soft light brown tones, styled smooth and glamorous. Surround them with opulent set dressing: 2 classical urn vases filled with blue roses, 1 fluted stone column in the background, heavy shimmering velvet curtains, and abundant draped satin fabric pooling around them. Lighting should be soft and diffused with subtle highlights on satin and jewels, creating a regal, mysterious, romantic atmosphere. Shoot as a vertical fashion editorial portrait, waist-up to full seated composition, highly detailed fabric textures, polished luxury beauty campaign aesthetic, no visible text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的摄影棚时尚肖像，画面中 {argument name="group size" default="四位"} 优雅的年轻女性在充满戏剧性的皇家蓝梦幻场景中紧密靠在一起。她们身着协调一致的深蓝宝石色和午夜海军蓝高定晚礼服，礼服上点缀着闪亮的珠饰、花卉贴花、亮片、蕾丝袖、透明网纱细节以及蓬松的层叠裙摆。场景呈现单色调的蓝色，带有冷峻、忧郁且高端的编辑风格调色。将女性安排在紧凑的三角形构图中：两位站立或位于后方高处，两位坐在前方铺有织物的地面上，姿态优雅各异：一人手臂举过头顶，一人微微倾斜，一人端坐，一人手托下巴。她们的礼服各具特色但风格统一，饰有华丽的水晶装饰、刺绣花朵和修身胸衣。搭配配套的蓝宝石首饰，包括吊坠耳环、宝石项链和花卉发饰。她们留着飘逸的长发，发色混合了深黑色和柔和的浅棕色，造型顺滑且充满魅力。周围环绕着华丽的布景：背景中有 2 个插满蓝玫瑰的古典瓮形花瓶、1 根凹槽石柱、厚重的闪光天鹅绒窗帘，以及周围堆叠的大量缎面织物。灯光柔和且漫射，在缎面和珠宝上形成微妙的高光，营造出一种高贵、神秘且浪漫的氛围。采用竖构图时尚编辑肖像拍摄，从腰部以上到全身坐姿构图，展现高度细腻的织物纹理，呈现精致的奢华美妆广告美学，画面中无可见文字。

templates.title: Vintage Shibuya Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古涩谷街头肖像

templates.prompt: A candid street-fashion portrait of a young woman standing at a busy Tokyo crosswalk in daylight, framed from the upper torso up and turned slightly away from the camera so her bare shoulder is prominent. She has a short messy bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"}, soft wispy texture, and a delicate build. She wears an airy off-shoulder blouse in {argument name="clothing color" default="white"}, made of thin semi-sheer fabric with loose drape and a romantic, lightweight feel. Place her in the foreground left-of-center, with a shallow depth of field and a crowded urban background full of pedestrians crossing the street. Behind her, include a large curved glass building with the visible sign {argument name="background sign" default="TSUTAYA"}, evoking Shibuya. Use a warm vintage film aesthetic with faded colors, noticeable grain, slight blur, soft sunlight, muted contrast, and a nostalgic analog snapshot mood. The overall tone should feel stylish, spontaneous, and cinematic, like a fashion photo captured in the middle of a bustling city.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张年轻女性站在繁忙的东京十字路口白天的街拍时尚肖像，取景范围为上半身，她微微背对镜头，突显出裸露的肩部。她留着一头凌乱的短波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"}，质感轻盈柔和，身形娇小。她穿着一件 {argument name="clothing color" default="白色"} 的露肩上衣，面料轻薄半透明，垂坠感十足，营造出浪漫轻盈的氛围。将她置于画面左侧前景，采用浅景深效果，背景是熙熙攘攘的过街行人。在她身后，加入一栋带有弧形玻璃的建筑，并可见 {argument name="background sign" default="TSUTAYA"} 的标志，以此呈现涩谷风情。采用温暖的复古胶片美学，色调略显褪色，带有明显的颗粒感、轻微模糊、柔和的阳光、柔和的对比度，以及怀旧的模拟快照氛围。整体基调应显得时尚、自然且具有电影感，如同在繁华都市中抓拍的时尚大片。
