templates.title: Elegant Chinese Calendar App UI

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅的中国万年历 App UI

templates.prompt: A clean, elegant iPhone app UI mockup for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, shown as a full-screen mobile screenshot on a soft warm white background with subtle paper-like texture and refined East Asian editorial aesthetics. The interface uses a minimalist serif-and-sans mix, muted brown, gray, black, pale blue, green, and gold accents, with spacious layout and delicate dividers. Show the iOS status bar at the top with the time 8:45, cellular signal, Wi‑Fi icon, and a battery indicator reading 96. Below it, a header for {argument name="month" default="4月"} with secondary text “24日 | 每日万年历” and, on the right, a rounded rectangular date-picker button labeled “择日” with a calendar icon plus a separate plus symbol. The main section is a monthly calendar grid for {argument name="year" default="2026"}, with 7 weekday columns labeled Sunday through Saturday in Chinese: 周日, 周一, 周二, 周三, 周四, 周五, 周六. Render a 6-row month view with exactly 42 date cells including adjacent-month dates. The visible dates should be: first row 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; second row 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; third row 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; fourth row 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; fifth row 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; sixth row 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each day cell includes a large Gregorian date and a smaller Chinese lunar date or note underneath. Include colored holiday and solar-term tags across specific cells, with exactly 10 highlighted labels visible: “休十七” on the 4th, “清明节” on the 5th, “休十九” on the 6th, “谷雨” on the 20th in green, “劳动节” on the next-month 1st, “休十六” on the next-month 2nd, “休十七” on the last-row 3rd, “青年节” on the last-row 4th, “休立夏” on the last-row 5th, and “天后诞” on the last-row 9th in orange. Add small lunar phase markers on a few days, including yellow crescent or dot icons around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and next-month 2nd. Make the {argument name="selected date" default="24"} cell in the Friday column stand out with a rounded blue gradient tile and soft shadow, with smaller text “初八” inside. Beneath the calendar, show a detailed daily information panel separated by whitespace. The left side features a very large date title “4月24日”; the right side stacks “星期五 2026” and “农历三月初八”. Below that, include smaller gray metadata lines such as “第114天 · 第17周 金尊月” and a traditional sexagenary/date string like “丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”. At the far right of this metadata area, place a rounded outline pill button labeled “今日”. Underneath, present a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two major sections with exactly 2 headings: a green “宜” section and a red “忌” section, separated by fine dotted dividers. In the “宜” section, include the directional fortune line “喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北” and three activity items: “祭祀”, “修饰垣墙”, “余事勿取”. In the “忌” section, include the conflict line “冲煞 冲狗 煞南”. At the bottom, show a 5-item iOS-style tab bar with labels exactly “今日”, “MONTH”, “YEAR”, “EVENTS”, “MORE”; the first tab is active and includes the small sublabel “4月24日”. Overall style: premium app design concept, calm scholarly Chinese calendar aesthetic, high-fidelity mobile product shot, realistic yet idealized interface, perfectly aligned typography, subtle shadows, soft contrast, and polished startup-quality UI.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款简洁、优雅的 iPhone App UI 原型，展示了一款中国万年历及黄历应用。画面为全屏移动端截图，背景采用柔和的暖白色，带有细腻的纸张质感，呈现出精致的东亚编辑美学。界面采用极简的衬线体与无衬线体混排，配色包括柔和的棕色、灰色、黑色、淡蓝色、绿色及金色点缀，布局宽敞，分割线细腻。顶部显示 iOS 状态栏，时间为 8:45，包含蜂窝信号、Wi‑Fi 图标及 96% 的电量显示。下方为 {argument name="month" default="4月"} 的标题，辅以“24日 | 每日万年历”的副标题，右侧设有一个圆角矩形日期选择按钮，标注为“择日”，并配有日历图标及一个加号图标。主体部分为 {argument name="year" default="2026"} 年的月历网格，包含 7 列星期，中文标注为：周日、周一、周二、周三、周四、周五、周六。渲染 6 行月视图，共 42 个日期单元格，包含相邻月份的日期。可见日期应为：第一行 29、30、31、1、2、3、4；第二行 5、6、7、8、9、10、11；第三行 12、13、14、15、16、17、18；第四行 19、20、21、22、23、24、25；第五行 26、27、28、29、30、1、2；第六行 3、4、5、6、7、8、9。每个日期单元格包含一个较大的公历日期，下方附有较小的农历日期或备注。在特定单元格中加入彩色的节假日和节气标签，共显示 10 个高亮标签：4 日的“休十七”、5 日的“清明节”、6 日的“休十九”、20 日绿色的“谷雨”、下月 1 日的“劳动节”、下月 2 日的“休十六”、最后一行 3 日的“休十七”、最后一行 4 日的“青年节”、最后一行 5 日的“休立夏”，以及最后一行 9 日橙色的“天后诞”。在部分日期上添加微小的月相标记，包括 2 日、10 日、17 日、24 日及下月 2 日周围的黄色月牙或圆点图标。将周五列中 {argument name="selected date" default="24"} 的单元格突出显示，采用圆角蓝色渐变磁贴和柔和阴影，内部标注较小的“初八”字样。日历下方通过留白分隔出一个详细的每日信息面板。左侧为醒目的日期标题“4月24日”；右侧堆叠显示“星期五 2026”和“农历三月初八”。下方包含较小的灰色元数据行，如“第114天 · 第17周 金尊月”以及传统的干支纪年/日期字符串，如“丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”。在此元数据区域的最右侧，放置一个标注为“今日”的圆角轮廓胶囊按钮。下方展示一张带有黄历指引的白色圆角大卡片。卡片包含两个主要部分，共 2 个标题：绿色的“宜”部分和红色的“忌”部分，由细虚线分隔。在“宜”部分，包含方位运势行“喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北”以及三项活动：“祭祀”、“修饰垣墙”、“余事勿取”。在“忌”部分，包含冲突行“冲煞 冲狗 煞南”。底部展示一个 5 项的 iOS 风格标签栏，标签依次为“今日”、“MONTH”、“YEAR”、“EVENTS”、“MORE”；第一个标签处于激活状态，并包含“4月24日”的小型子标签。整体风格：高端 App 设计概念，沉稳的中国传统日历美学，高保真移动产品截图，既写实又理想化的界面，排版完美对齐，阴影细腻，对比度柔和，具备初创公司级产品的精致感。

templates.title: Minimalist Anime Girl Side Profile

titleLocalized.zh: 极简动漫少女侧颜

templates.prompt: A minimalist anime-style portrait of a young woman shown from the chest up in side profile, facing left, with her head slightly turned so only part of one eye and ear are visible. She has a short straight bob haircut with soft inward-curving ends, light tousled strands, and {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair. Her skin is pale and smooth, and she wears an off-shoulder loose white top or sweater slipping down one shoulder, exposing the collarbone and upper back. The composition is clean and graphic, with thin dark navy linework, flat muted colors, almost no shading, and a calm editorial illustration feel. Use a solid {argument name="background color" default="bright cyan blue"} background with no objects, no scenery, no text. Center the bust portrait slightly left of frame, leaving negative space around the figure. Keep the mood quiet, stylish, modern, and elegant, like a Japanese social-media anime girl illustration. Do not add accessories, jewelry, or extra background elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简动漫风格的年轻女性肖像，展示胸部以上部位，侧脸朝左，头部略微转动，仅露出部分眼睛和耳朵。她留着利落的短波波头，发梢微微内扣，带有轻微凌乱的发丝，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"}。皮肤白皙光滑，身穿一件露肩的宽松白色上衣或毛衣，滑落至一侧肩头，露出锁骨和上背部。构图简洁且具有图形感，采用深海军蓝色的细线条，平涂柔和色彩，几乎没有阴影，呈现出一种冷静的编辑插画质感。使用纯色 {argument name="background color" default="亮青蓝色"} 背景，不含任何物体、场景或文字。将半身肖像置于画面偏左位置，人物周围留有负空间。整体氛围安静、时尚、现代且优雅，类似于日本社交媒体上的动漫少女插画。请勿添加任何配饰、珠宝或额外的背景元素。

templates.title: Moonlit Tiger and Rose Fantasy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的虎与玫瑰奇幻海报

templates.prompt: A dreamy, cinematic fantasy illustration in vertical poster format, showing {argument name="celebrity model" default="Liu Yifei"} in side profile walking barefoot across a perfectly still midnight-blue lake under a luminous full moon and a richly detailed star-filled sky with the Milky Way stretching diagonally behind her. She is a graceful East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a shimmering silver sleeveless evening gown with a flowing skirt and a thigh slit, the fabric sparkling like stardust. Her expression is calm and introspective, and she faces to the right as one foot touches the water, creating delicate glowing ripples. Two small dark islands sit low on the horizon, one on each side, emphasizing the vast open water and sky. A glowing vine of soft white roses and petals wraps around her body in an elegant S-curve, beginning behind her upper back, spiraling around her waist and legs, and continuing downward into the reflection. Beneath the water, instead of a normal reflection, create a large luminous line-art tiger formed from fine white neon-like contours, upside down relative to the woman above, with its body curled dynamically and its head near a large glowing white rose at the lower right; the tiger should feel majestic, lean, and ethereal rather than aggressive. The overall palette is cool blue, silver, and white, with gentle moonlight, soft bloom, mirror-like reflections, magical realism, ultra-clean composition, high detail, romantic fantasy mood. Add elegant cursive text centered near the bottom that reads {argument name="quote" default="In me the tiger sniffs the rose."}, plus one small four-point star icon near the lower right corner. Make it refined, poetic, and visually symbolic of inner strength and tenderness.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的电影级奇幻插画，采用竖版海报格式。画面展示了 {argument name="celebrity model" default="刘亦菲"} 的侧影，她赤脚走在平静如镜的午夜蓝色湖面上，头顶是明亮的满月和细节丰富的星空，银河在身后斜向延伸。她是一位优雅的东亚女性，留着齐肩黑发，身穿闪烁着星尘般光芒的银色无袖晚礼服，裙摆飘逸且带有高开叉。她神情平静而内省，面向右侧，一只脚触碰水面，激起细腻的发光涟漪。地平线两侧各有一座低矮的小岛，突显出广阔的水域与天空。一株发光的柔美白玫瑰藤蔓以优雅的 S 型曲线缠绕在她的身上，从她后背上方开始，盘旋过腰部和腿部，并向下延伸至水中的倒影里。在水面之下，倒影并非普通的镜像，而是一只由纤细白色霓虹轮廓构成的巨大发光线条虎，与上方女子呈倒置关系，虎身动态蜷曲，虎头靠近右下角一朵巨大的发光白玫瑰；这只虎应显得威严、精瘦且空灵，而非具有攻击性。整体色调为冷蓝色、银色与白色，伴有柔和月光、光晕效果、镜面反射、魔幻现实主义、极简构图、高细节，营造出浪漫的奇幻氛围。在底部中心添加优雅的草书文字 {argument name="quote" default="心有猛虎，细嗅蔷薇。"}，并在右下角添加一个小巧的四角星图标。整体风格精致、富有诗意，视觉上象征着内在的力量与温柔。

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A comparison graphic on a black background with a faint gray square grid, designed like a social media test result poster. At the top are 2 large side-by-side titles in bold sans serif text: “GPT image 2” above the left image and “Nano Banana” above the right image. Below them are 2 vertically oriented illustrated posters placed next to each other with a small gap. Both posters depict the same concept: a hand-drawn foodie walking map of Guangzhou in Chinese, but rendered in 2 different visual styles. The left poster is more detailed, textured, dense, and richly illustrated, while the right poster is cleaner, flatter, and simpler. The left poster has a warm cream paper background and an intricate vintage hand-painted travel-map style with fine linework, watercolor texture, decorative flowers and lychee fruits, miniature buildings, roads, river areas, and many food illustrations. The large Chinese title at the top of the left poster reads “广州 吃货暴走地图”. The map includes roughly 12 featured food spots distributed across the city, each shown as a small food illustration with Chinese labels and short handwritten-style annotations. Visible foods include skewers, roast poultry, noodle dishes, clay pot dishes, rice rolls, dumplings, soups, and dessert bowls, with landmarks such as the Canton Tower and riverfront scenery integrated into the map. The right poster also has the Chinese title “广州 吃货暴走地图” and shows the same general idea but in a cleaner infographic-like map style with simplified roads, icons, floral and lychee border decorations, food callouts, a river, the Canton Tower, and approximately 12 labeled food illustrations around the map. At the bottom of the overall comparison graphic is 1 rounded black text panel with a white outline. Attached to its upper left edge is 1 bright yellow rounded tab label reading “提示词” in bold black Chinese characters. Inside the black panel is a block of white Chinese text describing the image-generation prompt; it appears as a multi-line paragraph. The composition is centered, high contrast, and presented as a polished AI image comparison post for Chinese social media, with crisp typography, poster-like symmetry, and a clean test-benchmark aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一张黑色背景、带有淡灰色方格网的对比图，设计风格类似于社交媒体的测试结果海报。顶部是两个并排的粗体无衬线大标题：左侧图像上方为“GPT image 2”，右侧图像上方为“Nano Banana”。下方是两张垂直排列的插画海报，中间留有细小间隙。两张海报表现了同一个概念：一张手绘风格的广州美食暴走地图，但呈现出两种不同的视觉风格。左侧海报细节更丰富、纹理感强、内容密集且插画细腻；右侧海报则更简洁、扁平且直观。左侧海报采用暖色调的奶油纸背景，呈现出精致的复古手绘旅行地图风格，线条细腻，带有水彩质感，装饰有花卉和荔枝，并绘有微缩建筑、道路、河流区域以及大量美食插画。左侧海报顶部的大号中文标题为“广州 吃货暴走地图”。地图涵盖了约 12 个分布在城市各处的美食点，每个点都配有小型美食插画、中文标签和简短的手写风格注释。可见的美食包括烤串、烧腊、面食、煲仔饭、肠粉、点心、汤品和甜品碗，广州塔和江景等地标也融入其中。右侧海报同样带有“广州 吃货暴走地图”的中文标题，展示了相同的构思，但采用了更简洁的信息图式地图风格，简化了道路、图标、花卉和荔枝边框装饰、美食标注，并绘有河流、广州塔以及约 12 个带有标签的美食插画。在整个对比图的底部，有一个带有白色轮廓的圆形黑色文本框。其左上角附有一个亮黄色的圆形标签，上面印有加粗的黑色中文字符“提示词”。黑色面板内是一段描述图像生成提示词的白色中文文本，呈现为多行段落。整体构图居中，对比度高，呈现为一张精致的 AI 图像对比帖，适用于中国社交媒体，具有清晰的排版、海报般的对称感以及简洁的测试基准美学。

templates.title: AI Poster Comparison Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: AI 海报对比缩略图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A vertical social-media comparison poster on a black background with a subtle gray grid, designed like a clean tech review graphic. At the top are two large side-by-side headings: on the left, bright yellow text reading “GPT image 2”; on the right, white text reading “Nano Banana”. Below the headings are 2 tall poster mockups placed side by side with narrow spacing, each in an off-white paper style. The left mockup shows a traditional Chinese ink-wash fantasy poster inspired by Journey to the West, with large vertical Chinese calligraphy “西游记” near the upper left, muted sepia and gray watercolor mountains, cliffs, mist, temple architecture, and 4 tiny human figures visible in the composition: 2 heroic figures near the upper middle on a rocky ledge, plus 2 travelers lower in the scene; a swirling luminous mist vortex appears near the lower area. The right mockup shows a more graphic surreal poster built inside the side-profile silhouette of a human head facing left, filled with a Chinese fantasy landscape including pagodas, water, paths, figures, and the vertical title “西游记” inside the silhouette; the silhouette is painted in dark navy and black watercolor with cream paper around it. Each of the 2 posters has a large centered vertical rectangular blur censor block over the middle area, with soft edges and gray-beige color. Along the bottom is a rounded black caption panel with a thin white outline. Attached to its upper left corner is a bright yellow pill-shaped label containing the Chinese text “提示词” in bold black. Inside the bottom panel is a block of bold white Chinese text in multiple lines. The text should read: “西游记主题收藏版史诗海报，人物侧脸剪影中生长出完整世界观与经典场景。整体偏电影海报和梦幻水彩插画风，安静、宏大、神圣、怀旧，带纸张颗粒、轻雾感、飞白刷痕与高级留白。” The overall style is a polished Chinese tech comparison thumbnail, high contrast, editorial layout, centered composition, 4:5 portrait aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张垂直的社交媒体对比海报，背景为黑色并带有细微的灰色网格，设计风格如同简洁的科技测评图。顶部有两个并排的大标题：左侧为亮黄色文字“GPT image 2”；右侧为白色文字“Nano Banana”。标题下方是两个间距较窄、并排摆放的高大海报样机，均采用米白色纸张风格。左侧样机展示了一张受《西游记》启发的传统中国水墨奇幻海报，左上方有巨大的竖排中文书法“西游记”，画面包含柔和的深褐色和灰色水墨山峦、悬崖、云雾、寺庙建筑，以及 4 个微小的人物剪影：2 个英雄人物位于中上部的岩架上，另有 2 个旅人位于场景下方；画面下部出现了一个旋转的发光云雾漩涡。右侧样机展示了一张更具图形感的超现实海报，画面构建在一个向左侧的人头剪影内，内部填充了包含宝塔、水流、小径、人物的中国奇幻景观，剪影内有竖排标题“西游记”；剪影以深海军蓝和黑色水墨绘制，周围环绕着奶油色纸张。两张海报的中间区域均覆盖有一个居中的垂直长方形模糊遮挡块，边缘柔和，呈灰米色。底部是一个带有细白边框的圆角黑色说明面板。其左上角附有一个亮黄色胶囊状标签，内含加粗黑色中文文字“提示词”。底部面板内是一段多行的加粗白色中文文字。文字内容应为：“西游记主题收藏版史诗海报，人物侧脸剪影中生长出完整世界观与经典场景。整体偏电影海报和梦幻水彩插画风，安静、宏大、神圣、怀旧，带纸张颗粒、轻雾感、飞白刷痕与高级留白。” 整体风格为精致的中文科技对比缩略图，高对比度，编辑排版，居中构图，4:5 竖屏比例。

templates.title: AI Hanfu Poster Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: AI 汉服海报对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A dark tech-comparison poster on a black background with a subtle gray square grid, showing two vertically oriented infographic images side by side for an AI image generation comparison. At the top, place two large bold yellow headings: “GPT image 2” above the left panel and “Nano Banana” above the right panel. The left panel is an elegant antique-style Hanfu reference poster on warm aged paper, with a large Chinese calligraphy title at the top reading “汉服·解构图鉴”, smaller subtitle text beneath, and a full-body woman in pale traditional Hanfu standing in the center, her face intentionally blurred. Surround her with many small labeled diagram blocks, fabric swatches, embroidery closeups, accessory notes, silhouette studies, and fine Chinese annotations in a scholarly museum-poster layout. Use beige, cream, light gray-blue, and faded ink tones, giving the panel a refined archival aesthetic. The right panel is a cleaner modern infographic poster on light beige paper with a bold Chinese title across the top reading “中国传统汉服：大明朝服解构图谱”. In the center, show a bright red Ming-style robe drawn as a technical exploded garment diagram with multiple callout arrows and labeled parts. Around it, include material samples, decorative pattern examples, a horizontal row of 6 circular color swatches, construction details, and a bottom strip with 4 small human figure diagrams showing wearing sequence or silhouette comparison. Make the right poster feel more graphic-design driven, with sharper contrast and more vivid red accents. At the bottom of the overall image, add a large rounded black text box with a thin white outline spanning most of the width. Attach a yellow rounded label tab on its upper-left corner containing the Chinese word “提示词” in bold black text. Inside the black box, place a dense paragraph of white Chinese text describing the test prompt for generating a Hanfu-themed decomposition chart, resembling a screenshot quote block. The whole composition should look like a social media comparison graphic, centered, cleanly aligned, high resolution, with strong contrast between the dark background and the two poster panels.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深色科技感对比海报，背景为黑色并带有细微的灰色方格，左右并排展示两张垂直方向的信息图，用于 AI 图像生成对比。在顶部放置两个醒目的黄色粗体标题：左侧面板上方为“GPT image 2”，右侧面板上方为“Nano Banana”。左侧面板是一张优雅的古风汉服参考海报，背景为温暖的旧纸质感，顶部有醒目的中式书法标题“汉服·解构图鉴”，下方配有较小的副标题，中心是一位身着淡雅传统汉服的全身女性，面部经过模糊处理。周围环绕着许多带有标签的小型图示块、布料样本、刺绣特写、配饰说明、轮廓研究以及学术博物馆海报风格的精细中文注释。使用米色、奶油色、浅灰蓝色和褪色的水墨色调，使面板呈现出精致的档案美学。右侧面板是一张更简洁的现代信息图海报，背景为浅米色纸张，顶部有醒目的中文标题“中国传统汉服：大明朝服解构图谱”。中心展示了一件鲜红色的明制长袍，以技术性爆炸图的形式呈现，配有多个标注箭头和部件说明。周围包含材质样本、装饰图案示例、一行 6 个圆形色卡、结构细节，底部条带展示了 4 个小型人体图示，说明穿着顺序或轮廓对比。右侧海报更具平面设计感，对比度更强，红色点缀更鲜艳。在整体图像底部，添加一个宽大的圆角黑色文本框，带有细白边，横跨大部分宽度。在左上角贴一个黄色圆角标签，内含加粗黑体中文“提示词”。在黑色框内，放置一段密集的白色中文文本，描述用于生成汉服主题解构图的测试提示词，类似于截图引用块。整体构图应呈现为社交媒体对比图，居中对齐，清晰整洁，高分辨率，深色背景与两个海报面板之间形成强烈对比。

templates.title: Luxury Germany Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 德国奢华旅行海报

templates.prompt:
Create a luxurious vintage-style travel poster for {argument name="country name" default="Germany"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign advertisement. Use a grand, symmetrical composition with elegant editorial typography and a refined gold border frame with tiny ornamental corner details. At the top center, place a small gold national emblem above the word “DISCOVER”, then a very large serif title reading {argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"} in deep navy blue. Under it, add the slogan “LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.” in gold uppercase, followed by a smaller classic serif tagline reading “Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.” with a tiny horizontal accent in the colors black, red, and gold.

Show a majestic panoramic montage of iconic German scenery at golden hour under a softly glowing blue sky with scattered clouds. On the left, feature a fairy-tale white hilltop castle resembling Neuschwanstein, perched above autumn trees. In the center distance, place dramatic alpine mountains. On the right, show a historic European riverside city with dense red-roofed houses, an arched stone bridge crossing the water, a domed cathedral, and a towering Gothic cathedral with twin spires. Add calm river reflections and a small white sightseeing boat at the lower right. The image should feel nostalgic, romantic, and aspirational, with warm sunlight, crisp architectural detail, and rich cinematic color grading.

Along the lower middle, include exactly 5 gold line-art cultural icons with labels beneath them, evenly spaced in a horizontal row: “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, “RICH HERITAGE”, “VIBRANT CULTURE”, “AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”, and “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”.

At the bottom, create a dark horizontal food showcase strip with the centered heading “SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY” in gold. Inside the strip, include exactly 5 framed food panels, each labeled in white uppercase beneath the image: “BREZEL”, “BRATWURST”, “KARTOFFELSALAT”, “SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”, and “GERMAN BEER”. Show each item as an appetizing close-up: a glossy pretzel on a plate, grilled sausages with sauerkraut, creamy potato salad, a slice of Black Forest cake topped with cream and cherry, and a frothy beer mug. Keep the overall design polished, high-end, poster-like, and suitable for a luxury destination campaign.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张复古风格的 {argument name="country name" default="德国"} 奢华旅行海报，设计感如同高端旅游宣传广告。采用宏大、对称的构图，搭配优雅的编辑排版，以及带有精致角落装饰细节的金色边框。在顶部中心，放置一枚小型金色国徽，下方为“DISCOVER”字样，随后是一个非常醒目的深海军蓝衬线标题 {argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"}。在其下方，添加金色大写标语“LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.”，随后是一行较小的经典衬线副标题“Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.”，并配以黑、红、金三色的小型水平装饰线。

展示一幅壮丽的德国标志性风景全景蒙太奇，背景是黄金时刻下云朵稀疏、柔和发光的蓝天。左侧呈现一座如同新天鹅堡般的童话白色山顶城堡，坐落在秋色树木之上。远景中心放置雄伟的阿尔卑斯山脉。右侧展示一座历史悠久的欧洲河畔城市，密集的红顶房屋、横跨水面的拱形石桥、圆顶大教堂以及带有双尖塔的哥特式大教堂。添加平静的河面反射，右下角有一艘白色观光船。画面应充满怀旧、浪漫和令人向往的氛围，具备温暖的阳光、清晰的建筑细节和丰富的电影级色彩分级。

在下方中部，均匀水平排列 5 个金色线条艺术风格的文化图标，下方附带标签：“ICONIC LANDMARKS”（标志性地标）、“RICH HERITAGE”（深厚底蕴）、“VIBRANT CULTURE”（活力文化）、“AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”（地道传统）和“BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”（绝美风景）。

底部创建一个深色水平美食展示条，居中标题为金色的“SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY”。在展示条内，包含 5 个带边框的美食面板，每张图片下方均标注白色大写文字：“BREZEL”（德国碱水面包）、“BRATWURST”（德国烤肠）、“KARTOFFELSALAT”（德国土豆沙拉）、“SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”（黑森林蛋糕）和“GERMAN BEER”（德国啤酒）。每种食物均以诱人的特写形式呈现：盘中光泽诱人的碱水面包、配有酸菜的烤肠、奶油土豆沙拉、点缀着奶油和樱桃的黑森林蛋糕切片，以及泡沫丰富的啤酒杯。整体设计需保持精致、高端、海报感，适合用于奢华目的地宣传活动。

templates.title: Romantic Paris Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫巴黎旅行海报

templates.prompt:
A luxurious vintage-travel-poster style illustration of {argument name="country name" default="FRANCE"} with {argument name="city name" default="PARIS"} as the destination, designed like an elegant tourism advertisement. Use a grand, romantic Paris cityscape at golden-hour sunset with a glowing pastel sky in peach, pink, lavender, and soft gold. Make the Eiffel Tower the dominant central landmark, tall and detailed, rising above the city. Include 4 additional iconic Paris landmarks: the Louvre Pyramid on the left, the Arc de Triomphe near the center background, Notre-Dame Cathedral to the right of the Eiffel Tower, and Sacré-Cœur Basilica on the far upper-right hillside. In the foreground, fill the scene with dense blooming {argument name="flower field" default="lavender"} in vivid purple, creating a dreamy, painterly foreground leading into the city. Add a river and elegant stone bridges beneath the Eiffel Tower with warm reflected sunset light. The composition should feel idealized, cinematic, and slightly fantastical, combining multiple landmarks into one harmonious panoramic view.

Overlay refined editorial typography in the upper-left to upper-center area: a very large serif title reading {argument name="headline text" default="FRANCE"}, with a smaller spaced serif subtitle reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="PARIS"}. Above the subtitle, place a small gold fleur-de-lis ornament; below it, add a tiny horizontal French tricolor accent. Under the main heading, include the two lines of promotional copy exactly: "TIMELESS BEAUTY. ENDLESS INSPIRATION." and "Where Every Moment Becomes a Memory" in elegant small caps and italic script. Add a thin decorative gold border around the whole poster with delicate ornamental corner details.

At the bottom, create a soft cream misted panel blending into the image, with the phrase "THE FRENCH ART OF LIVING" centered above a row of 3 food-and-drink items: 1 buttery croissant on a plate, 1 glass of red wine with 1 wine bottle, and 1 crème brûlée in a ramekin topped with berries. Label them "CROISSANT", "FINE WINE", and "CRÈME BRÛLÉE". To the right, add 4 small gold line icons with labels beneath them: "ICONIC LANDMARKS", "RICH HERITAGE", "AUTHENTIC CUISINE", and "UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES". Overall style: ultra-detailed, polished travel poster, romantic European tourism ad, painterly realism, warm luminous atmosphere, premium print design, balanced composition, high-end magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张奢华的复古旅行海报风格插画，以 {argument name="country name" default="法国"} 为国家，{argument name="city name" default="巴黎"} 为目的地，设计如同一则优雅的旅游广告。展现宏伟、浪漫的巴黎城市景观，背景为黄金时刻的日落，天空呈现桃色、粉色、淡紫色和柔和金色的梦幻渐变。以埃菲尔铁塔为中心地标，高耸且细节丰富，矗立在城市上方。包含 4 个额外的巴黎标志性地标：左侧的卢浮宫金字塔、背景中央附近的凯旋门、埃菲尔铁塔右侧的巴黎圣母院，以及远方右上角山坡上的圣心大教堂。前景处填满繁茂盛开的 {argument name="flower field" default="薰衣草花田"}，呈现鲜艳的紫色，营造出通往城市的梦幻绘画感前景。埃菲尔铁塔下方绘有河流和优雅的石桥，倒映着温暖的夕阳余晖。构图应具有理想化、电影感和些许奇幻色彩，将多个地标融合成一幅和谐的全景图。

在左上至中上方区域叠加精致的编辑排版：一个非常大的衬线字体标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="法国"}，下方配以较小的间距衬线副标题，内容为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="巴黎"}。在副标题上方放置一个金色鸢尾花装饰；下方添加一个微小的水平法国三色旗点缀。在主标题下方，包含两行促销文案，内容必须完全一致：“TIMELESS BEAUTY. ENDLESS INSPIRATION.” 以及 “Where Every Moment Becomes a Memory”，采用优雅的小写大写字母和斜体字。在整张海报周围添加一圈纤细的金色装饰边框，并配以精致的边角装饰细节。

在底部，创建一个与图像融合的柔和奶油色雾面面板，面板上方居中显示短语 “THE FRENCH ART OF LIVING”，下方排列 3 种餐饮元素：1 个盘子里的黄油可颂、1 杯红酒配 1 瓶红酒，以及 1 个顶部点缀浆果的焦糖布丁。分别标注为 “CROISSANT”、“FINE WINE” 和 “CRÈME BRÛLÉE”。在右侧添加 4 个金色小图标，下方分别标注：“ICONIC LANDMARKS”、“RICH HERITAGE”、“AUTHENTIC CUISINE” 和 “UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES”。整体风格：超精细、精致的旅行海报，浪漫的欧洲旅游广告，绘画写实主义，温暖明亮的氛围，高端印刷设计，构图平衡，高端杂志美学。

templates.title: Luxury Northern Europe Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 北欧奢华旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create an elegant luxury travel poster for {argument name="region name" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"}, designed like a premium tourism campaign brochure cover. Use a wide symmetrical layout with a thin gold decorative border and refined editorial typography. At the top center, place a small compass-star icon above the word DISCOVER, then a very large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"} in deep navy blue. Below it, add a gold uppercase tagline: {argument name="tagline" default="BREATHTAKING NATURE. RICH CULTURE. TIMELESS EXPERIENCES."} and beneath that a smaller elegant italic line: {argument name="subheading" default="Four Countries. Countless Memories."}. The main image area is divided into 4 equal vertical scenic panels showing iconic destinations at golden hour with soft glowing skies and cinematic realism. Panel 1: Denmark, Copenhagen, a colorful harbor waterfront with historic buildings, boats, calm reflective water, and a domed landmark in the background; include a small Danish flag above the labels DENMARK and COPENHAGEN. Panel 2: Sweden, Stockholm, a waterfront old-town skyline with church spires and warm sunset light reflected in the water; include a small Swedish flag above the labels SWEDEN and STOCKHOLM. Panel 3: Finland, Helsinki, a small stone castle-like island fortress in blue water under a bright sky; include a small Finnish flag above the labels FINLAND and HELSINKI. Panel 4: Norway, dramatic fjords with steep jagged mountains, a waterfall, and a tiny red-roof coastal village at the water’s edge; include a small Norwegian flag above the labels NORWAY and FJORDS OF NORWAY. Beneath the 4 country panels, add a row of 4 gold line icons with captions, evenly spaced: mountain icon with ICONIC LANDSCAPES, Viking ship icon with RICH HERITAGE, moose icon with WILD NATURE, camera icon with UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEYS. Near the bottom center, place a gold divider and the title A TASTE OF THE NORTH. Under it, show exactly 5 food thumbnail panels in a horizontal strip, each on a plate or bowl with warm appetizing lighting and dark blue framing: 1) Smørrebrød — Denmark, open-faced sandwich topped with shrimp; 2) Köttbullar — Sweden, Swedish meatballs with cream sauce and lingonberries; 3) Gravad lax — Finland, sliced cured salmon in a bowl; 4) Fish soup — Norway, creamy fish soup with herbs and seafood; 5) Kanelbulle — Sweden, a glossy cinnamon bun on a plate. Use a polished high-end travel-ad aesthetic, photorealistic scenery, soft sunset color grading, navy and gold graphic design, balanced composition, crisp text placement, and a nostalgic upscale European tourism mood.

Countless Memories."}。主体图像区域被平均分为 4 个垂直风景板块，展示黄金时段的标志性目的地，呈现柔和的霞光和电影级的写实感。板块 1：丹麦哥本哈根，色彩斑斓的海港码头，背景为历史建筑、船只、平静的倒影水面及圆顶地标；在标签 DENMARK 和 COPENHAGEN 上方添加一面小丹麦国旗。板块 2：瑞典斯德哥尔摩，水滨老城天际线，教堂尖顶在温暖的日落光线下映照在水中；在标签 SWEDEN 和 STOCKHOLM 上方添加一面小瑞典国旗。板块 3：芬兰赫尔辛基，蓝天碧水下的一座小型石砌城堡式岛屿要塞；在标签 FINLAND 和 HELSINKI 上方添加一面小芬兰国旗。板块 4：挪威，壮丽的峡湾，陡峭崎岖的山脉，瀑布，以及水边的小型红顶沿海村庄；在标签 NORWAY 和 FJORDS OF NORWAY 上方添加一面小挪威国旗。在 4 个国家板块下方，添加一行 4 个均匀分布的金色线条图标及说明：山脉图标配 ICONIC LANDSCAPES，维京船图标配 RICH HERITAGE，驼鹿图标配 WILD NATURE，相机图标配 UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEYS。在底部中心附近，放置一个金色分隔符和标题 A TASTE OF THE NORTH。在其下方，横向排列 5 个美食缩略图板块，每个板块展示在盘子或碗中，配以温暖诱人的灯光和深蓝色边框：1) Smørrebrød — 丹麦，铺满虾仁的开放式三明治；2) Köttbullar — 瑞典，配奶油酱和越橘的瑞典肉丸；3) Gravad lax — 芬兰，碗中的腌制三文鱼片；4) Fish soup — 挪威，配香草和海鲜的奶油鱼汤；5) Kanelbulle — 瑞典，盘中光泽诱人的肉桂卷。整体采用精致的高端旅游广告美学，照片级写实风景，柔和的日落色彩分级，海军蓝与金色的平面设计，平衡的构图，清晰的文字排版，营造出怀旧而高端的欧洲旅游氛围。

templates.title: Chibi Tetsuzankou Impact Attack

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版铁山靠冲击攻击

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime action illustration in a comedic chibi style, showing a tiny but fierce girl performing a powerful Chinese martial arts shoulder strike, tetsuzankou, into the side of a startled boy. The girl is the main focus: {argument name="character name" default="red-haired martial artist girl"}, with long vivid {argument name="hair color" default="crimson red"} hair streaming violently backward, sharp red eyes, and a determined angry expression. She is lunging from right to left at extreme speed, body low and compact, one shoulder and upper back driving into the boy’s torso, one fist pulled back and the other arm tucked for balance, with one knee bent forward and one leg trailing behind. She wears a short red Chinese-style qipao dress with gold floral embroidery, gold trim, side slit, and black flat shoes. The boy is a chibi black-haired teenager in a dark navy Chinese kung fu outfit with gold piping and black shoes, recoiling from the impact with a shocked open mouth, blank white eyes, sweat drops, and his body thrown backward to the left. Emphasize the exact moment of collision with a bright explosive impact burst at his side, flying debris, sparks, and strong speed-line distortion across the entire background. Add dust clouds and ground streaks near the girl’s trailing foot to show explosive forward momentum. Use a manga-inspired composition with exaggerated motion, foreshortening, and a diagonal rush from lower right to upper left. Include 3 large Japanese sound-effect text elements integrated into the art: one vertical right-side callout reading "鉄山靠!!", one smaller vertical annotation beside it reading "てつざんこう", and one large lower-left impact sound effect reading "ドガッ!!". The overall mood is fast, funny, aggressive, and high-impact, with polished modern anime rendering, glossy hair highlights, crisp line art, and dramatic red-white-black contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满喜剧 Q 版风格的动态动漫动作插画，展示了一个娇小但凶猛的女孩对一个受惊男孩的侧面施展强力的中国武术肩部撞击——铁山靠。女孩是画面焦点：{argument name="character name" default="红发武术少女"}，长长的鲜艳 {argument name="hair color" default="绯红色"} 头发向后剧烈飘动，有着锐利的红眼和坚定愤怒的表情。她正以极快的速度从右向左冲刺，身体低伏紧凑，一侧肩膀和上背部撞向男孩的躯干，一只拳头后拉，另一只手臂收拢以保持平衡，一只膝盖向前弯曲，另一条腿向后拖曳。她穿着一件短款红色中式旗袍，带有金色花卉刺绣、金色滚边、侧开叉和黑色平底鞋。男孩是一个黑发 Q 版少年，穿着深蓝色中式功夫装，配有金色滚边和黑色鞋子，因冲击而向后退缩，张着嘴露出震惊的表情，双眼翻白，带有汗滴，身体向左后方飞出。强调碰撞的瞬间，在他身侧产生明亮的爆炸冲击效果、飞溅的碎片、火花以及横跨整个背景的强烈速度线扭曲。在女孩拖曳的脚部附近添加尘云和地面划痕，以展现爆炸性的前进动能。采用漫画风格的构图，运用夸张的动作、透视缩短以及从右下到左上的对角线冲刺。画面中集成了 3 个大型日语拟声词文字元素：右侧一个垂直的标注文字“鉄山靠!!”，旁边一个较小的垂直注释“てつざんこう”，以及左下方一个巨大的撞击拟声词“ドガッ!!”。整体氛围快速、滑稽、具有攻击性和强烈的冲击感，采用精致的现代动漫渲染，具有光泽的头发高光、清晰的线条艺术以及戏剧性的红、白、黑对比。

templates.title: Pastel Idol Portrait with Neon Heart

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹心形装饰的马卡龙色系偶像肖像

templates.prompt: A close-up upper-body portrait of a cute Japanese idol-style girl in an ultra-kawaii pastel bedroom, centered in frame, with her face hidden by a large solid rectangular censor block in a muted mauve-brown color. She has dark brown medium-length wavy hair in twin tails, decorated with 2 oversized translucent pink bows, pearl strands, ribbon streamers, and 2 dangling star charms. Her outfit is an extravagant yume-kawaii idol dress in shimmering {argument name="main colors" default="pink and lavender"}, with glossy satin fabric, lace trim, frilly off-shoulder sleeves, sheer ruffles, beadwork, tiny gem details, and a large jeweled heart brooch at the center of the chest. Include a lace camisole neckline underneath, a sparkly collar with tiny pastel charms, a ribbon bow near one curl that she gently holds with one hand, and matching frilled wrist cuffs. The background is a dreamy, heavily decorated kawaii room filled with soft fairy lights, pastel curtains, ribbons, bows, plush textures, and glowing decor. On the left side, add a pink neon heart sign with a bow outline containing the Japanese text {argument name="neon sign text" default="夢は叶えるもの"}. Use a soft-focus lens, glittery highlights, pearlescent textures, warm pink-purple ambient lighting, bokeh sparkles, and a vertical social-media photo composition. The overall mood is sweet, magical, idol-core, feminine, and hyper-detailed, like a pastel fashion photo taken in a decorated kawaii studio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的日系偶像风格女孩半身特写肖像，背景为超卡哇伊的马卡龙色卧室，构图居中。她的脸部被一个哑光灰褐色的大型实心矩形遮挡块遮住。她留着深棕色中长波浪双马尾，装饰着 2 个超大透明粉色蝴蝶结、珍珠串、丝带飘带和 2 个垂坠的星星挂饰。她身穿华丽的梦幻卡哇伊（yume-kawaii）偶像礼服，主色调为 {argument name="main colors" default="粉色和薰衣草色"}，采用光泽缎面、蕾丝花边、荷叶边露肩袖、透明褶边、串珠工艺、细小宝石细节，胸前饰有一个巨大的珠宝心形胸针。内搭蕾丝吊带领口，佩戴带有细小马卡龙色挂饰的闪亮项圈，其中一缕卷发旁系着丝带蝴蝶结，她用一只手轻轻托住，并配有相称的荷叶边腕带。背景是一个梦幻且装饰繁复的卡哇伊房间，充满柔和的仙女灯、马卡龙色窗帘、丝带、蝴蝶结、毛绒质感和发光装饰。在左侧，添加一个带有蝴蝶结轮廓的粉色霓虹心形标志，其中包含日文文本 {argument name="neon sign text" default="夢は叶えるもの"}。使用柔焦镜头、闪光高光、珠光质感、暖粉紫色环境光、焦外成像光斑，以及垂直社交媒体照片构图。整体氛围甜美、梦幻、偶像核心、女性化且细节丰富，宛如在装饰精美的卡哇伊摄影棚中拍摄的马卡龙色时尚大片。

templates.title: Gothic Idol Concert Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风偶像演唱会自拍

templates.prompt: A dramatic close-up selfie-style stage photo of a Japanese idol performer leaning toward the camera from a low angle, filling most of the frame with her upper body and outstretched arm. She has long straight-to-wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark auburn brown"} hair with glossy highlights and heavy side-swept bangs partly covering one eye. Her expression is cute and intimate, with one hand near her mouth in a shy idol pose, as if interacting directly with fans during a live concert. She wears a dark gothic idol costume in black and deep {argument name="accent color" default="purple"}, featuring 5 clearly visible outfit elements: a shiny corset-style cropped top with metallic trim, a black belt at the waist with silver grommets, sheer black mesh opera-length gloves, multiple strapped arm bands on the upper arm, and draped silver chains across the bodice and skirt. Add glossy patent-leather textures, studs, buckles, lace, and layered frilled fabric for a high-detail J-pop or anisong concert look. The background is a large indoor live stage with bright blue-white spotlights, haze, truss rigging, and an LED screen glowing with soft abstract shapes, creating strong backlight and bokeh. Use cinematic concert photography, high contrast, cool-toned lighting with purple-blue highlights, shallow depth of field, slight lens distortion from the close arm’s-length perspective, dynamic foreshortening, and a vertical smartphone composition. Make the image feel energetic, glamorous, and fan-service oriented, like {argument name="idol group concept" default="a dark fantasy idol live performance"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的自拍视角舞台特写照片，一位日本偶像表演者从低角度向镜头倾身，上半身和伸出的手臂占据了画面的大部分。她留着长长的直发至微卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深红褐色"}，带有光泽感，厚重的斜刘海遮住了一只眼睛。她的表情可爱且亲密，一只手放在嘴边，摆出害羞的偶像姿势，仿佛正在演唱会现场与粉丝直接互动。她穿着一套黑色与深 {argument name="accent color" default="紫色"} 的哥特风偶像演出服，包含 5 个清晰可见的服装元素：带有金属饰边的亮面紧身胸衣式短上衣、腰间带有银色金属扣眼的黑色腰带、黑色透明网纱歌剧手套、上臂的多条绑带，以及横跨胸前和裙摆的垂坠银链。添加亮面漆皮质感、铆钉、搭扣、蕾丝和层叠的荷叶边面料，打造高细节的 J-pop 或动画歌曲演唱会造型。背景是大型室内现场舞台，配有明亮的蓝白色聚光灯、烟雾、桁架装置以及闪烁着柔和抽象形状的 LED 屏幕，营造出强烈的逆光和虚化效果。采用电影级演唱会摄影风格，高对比度，冷色调灯光配以紫蓝色高光，浅景深，近距离手臂视角带来的轻微镜头畸变，动态的前缩透视，以及竖屏手机构图。让画面充满活力、魅力十足且具有粉丝向服务感，如同 {argument name="idol group concept" default="一场暗黑奇幻风格的偶像现场演出"}。

templates.prompt: A dynamic close-up concert photo of a {argument name="idol performer" default="young female J-pop idol"} on stage, shot from the audience perspective with a shallow depth of field. She is leaning toward the camera and reaching one hand forward in the foreground, creating dramatic foreshortening, while holding a black handheld microphone with a red accent ring in her other hand near her mouth. She wears a highly detailed red-and-white frilly idol costume: twin-tail dark brown hair with straight bangs, 2 fluffy red pom-pom hair accessories tied with ribbon bows, dangling red earrings, a red choker with lace and a small heart jewel, a cropped lace-trimmed top with 1 oversized satin bow at the chest, off-shoulder frilled sleeves, a corset-style midriff section with red ribbon lacing and small metallic charms, and a layered satin skirt with sparkling bead chains and 1 heart-shaped jeweled ornament at the waist. Her manicure is glossy red with cute white decorative nail art. The lighting is vivid pink and crimson stage lighting, with a glamorous live-idol atmosphere. The background is filled with soft bokeh, LED screens, rigging, and numerous glowing heart shapes and floating heart confetti, creating a dreamy romantic concert scene. Use a photorealistic style with crisp fabric texture, shiny satin highlights, lace detail, concert ambience, slight motion energy, and an overall {argument name="color theme" default="red and pink"} palette. Include a subtle sense of excitement and fan-service stage charisma, like a promotional live-performance shot for a {argument name="theme" default="cute romantic idol concert"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的演唱会特写照片，主角为舞台上的 {argument name="idol performer" default="年轻的 J-pop 女偶像"}，以观众视角拍摄，具有浅景深效果。她向镜头倾斜，一只手伸向前景，形成强烈的透视缩短效果；另一只手拿着一支带有红色装饰环的黑色手持麦克风靠近嘴边。她身穿细节丰富的红白相间荷叶边偶像演出服：深棕色双马尾发型搭配齐刘海，两个蓬松的红色毛绒球发饰系着丝带蝴蝶结，佩戴红色吊坠耳环，颈部系着带有蕾丝和心形宝石的红色颈圈，身穿带有蕾丝边的露脐上衣，胸前有一个巨大的缎面蝴蝶结，露肩荷叶边袖子，束腰风格的中段设计带有红色丝带系带和小金属挂饰，层叠的缎面短裙上装饰着闪亮的珠链，腰间配有一枚心形宝石装饰。她的美甲是亮面红色，并配有可爱的白色装饰美甲艺术。灯光为生动的粉色和深红色舞台灯光，营造出华丽的现场偶像氛围。背景中充满了柔和的虚化效果、LED 屏幕、舞台装置以及无数发光的心形和漂浮的心形纸屑，营造出梦幻浪漫的演唱会场景。采用照片级逼真的风格，展现清晰的布料质感、闪亮的缎面高光、蕾丝细节、演唱会氛围、轻微的动态能量，以及整体的 {argument name="color theme" default="红色和粉色"} 色调。融入微妙的兴奋感和粉丝向的舞台魅力，如同 {argument name="theme" default="可爱浪漫偶像演唱会"} 的宣传现场表演照。

titleLocalized.zh: 病娇可爱风偶像自拍

templates.prompt: A close-up vertical selfie portrait of a {argument name="idol theme" default="dark yami-kawaii idol"} girl in a cramped neon-pink room, shot with her arm extended toward the camera so one glittery sleeve and hand blur large in the foreground. She wears a highly detailed black-and-hot-pink plaid stage outfit with glossy vinyl straps, lace trim, ribbons, buckles, and layered accessories: a sleeveless bodice, black fishnet detached sleeves, multiple black armbands on one upper arm, pink bows, and a heart-shaped chest badge that reads "病みかわいい". Her hair is dark brown, styled in a high bun with long straight sections framing the sides, decorated with a large ribbon. Her visible hand is posed near her lips in a coy idol gesture, wearing a frilly pink lace fingerless glove, long decorated nails, and chunky rings. Add a pink armband on the upper arm with handwritten Japanese text, and subtle earrings. The face is intentionally hidden by a large centered rectangular censor blur covering most of the face from forehead to chin. The background is dense and grungy, filled with black-and-pink graffiti, plastic curtains, plush toys, and distressed decor. Include exactly 4 visible Japanese text elements in the scene: graffiti on the left reading "闇ー?", graffiti below it reading "嫌いにならないで", graffiti further down reading "私だけ見ててね", and a glowing heart-shaped neon sign on the upper right reading "病みしか勝たん". Place 2 plush figures in the background: one pale pink stuffed animal on the left and one black plush with X eyes on the right. Lighting is moody club-style magenta and violet with glossy highlights, giving a chaotic underground idol dressing-room vibe. Ultra-detailed, flashy textures, glitter, lace, vinyl, messy cute-goth atmosphere, high contrast, smartphone selfie composition, portrait orientation.

templates.prompt: Luxury fashion magazine cover, vertical portrait, featuring a poised young professional woman seated in a black leather office chair in a modern high-rise office. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair styled in a sleek high ponytail with soft side bangs, and wears a fitted ribbed short-sleeve knit top in {argument name="top color" default="deep burgundy"}, a high-waisted pleated midi skirt in taupe-brown, and a delicate silver necklace with small key-like layered pendants. She sits with legs crossed, holding a slim tablet across her lap, looking calm, composed, and quietly powerful. The setting is a polished executive office with a wooden wall panel on the right, floor-to-ceiling glass behind her, a blurred meeting scene with 2 indistinct businesspeople visible through the glass on the left, and a desk edge in the lower left corner with an open laptop and stacked documents. Soft natural daylight, refined editorial styling, realistic fashion photography, warm neutral tones, subtle background blur, premium magazine aesthetic. Overlay elegant magazine typography: giant serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICIELLE"} across the top in ivory white, small subtitle below the left side reading "STYLE. CONFIDENCE. CAREER.", date at top right reading {argument name="cover date" default="MAY 2024"}. Add 5 cover lines total: left upper "DESK to DESTINY" with smaller subtext "Elevating everyday workwear with intent and ease.", left middle "POWER IN POISE" with smaller subtext "Refined staples and modern silhouettes for the woman who leads.", right middle "FOCUS & FLOW" with smaller subtext "Thoughtful style that keeps you confident from morning to night.", large bottom-left headline "MODERN ELEGANCE" with italic subheading "Polished looks. Purposeful days." and small text "Timeless style for the new generation of professionals.", and a circular badge at lower right containing "WORKWEAR EDIT" and smaller text "Burgundy tones, warm neutrals, effortless confidence." Clean balanced layout, upscale women’s fashion magazine cover, confident office-as-runway mood, highly realistic, sophisticated, cinematic softness.

templates.prompt: A high-fashion editorial magazine cover set inside a modern open-plan office, photographed in a polished realistic style with soft commercial lighting and a luxury fashion mood. Center the full-body figure of a tall slim East Asian businesswoman walking confidently down the aisle between desks as if on a runway, shoulders back, arms relaxed, gaze forward. She wears a fitted ribbed knit short-sleeve top in {argument name="top color" default="powder blue"}, tucked into a long high-waisted ribbed mermaid skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="white"}, with clean white pointed heels. Her hair is dark brown to black, styled in a high ponytail. The office around her is bright, elegant, and contemporary, with rows of desks on both sides, flat computer monitors, ergonomic white-and-gray office chairs, glass meeting room walls, warm wood panels, ceiling strip lights, and several blurred office workers seated and working, plus one suited figure standing in the background. Compose it like a premium fashion magazine cover with the woman dominating the center frame and the office receding in perspective behind her. Add large masthead text across the very top in oversized pale blue serif letters reading {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICESTYLE"}. Add small white cover line text near the upper left: {argument name="issue text" default="SUMMER 2024"}, and near the upper right: "FASHION & INSPIRATION". On the left side, place a large white serif headline broken over three lines: "Grace in Motion", with 2 smaller Japanese teaser blocks beneath it. On the lower left, add a blue serif subheadline: "Blue & White" with 2 lines of smaller Japanese text below. On the right side, add a white serif headline: "Modern Elegance" with 2 lines of smaller Japanese text below. In the lower right corner, place a large pale blue circle containing the white serif text "More inside" with 3 short lines of smaller Japanese teaser text beneath. Keep the overall palette airy and refined, dominated by blue, white, gray, and soft beige, with a clean magazine-cover layout, luxurious typography, subtle depth of field, and an aspirational office couture aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张置于现代开放式办公室内的时尚杂志封面，采用精致写实的摄影风格，配以柔和的商业灯光和奢华的时尚氛围。画面中心是一位身材高挑纤细的东亚女商务人士，她正自信地走在办公桌间的过道上，宛如走在 T 台上，双肩后展，双臂自然放松，目光直视前方。她身着一件 {argument name="top color" default="粉蓝色"} 的修身罗纹针织短袖上衣，下搭一条 {argument name="skirt color" default="白色"} 的高腰长款罗纹鱼尾裙，脚踩干净利落的白色尖头高跟鞋。她留着深棕色至黑色的高马尾发型。周围的办公室明亮、优雅且充满现代感，两侧排列着办公桌、纯平电脑显示器、符合人体工程学的黑白办公椅、玻璃会议室隔断、暖色调木质镶板和天花板条形灯；背景中有几位模糊的办公人员正在座位上工作，还有一位身着西装的人物站立。构图采用高级时尚杂志封面风格，女性占据画面中心，办公室在背景中呈现出纵深感。在顶部添加超大号的淡蓝色衬线字体作为刊头，内容为 {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICESTYLE"}。在左上角添加小号白色封面标题：{argument name="issue text" default="2024 年夏季"}，右上角添加 "FASHION & INSPIRATION"。在左侧放置一个分三行排列的大号白色衬线标题："Grace in Motion"，下方配有两个较小的日语预告块。在左下角添加一个蓝色衬线副标题："Blue & White"，下方配有两行较小的日语文本。在右侧添加一个白色衬线标题："Modern Elegance"，下方配有两行较小的日语文本。在右下角放置一个淡蓝色大圆圈，内含白色衬线文字 "More inside"，下方配有三行简短的日语预告文本。整体色调保持轻盈精致，以蓝色、白色、灰色和柔和的米色为主，呈现出干净的杂志封面排版、奢华的字体设计、微妙的景深效果以及令人向往的职场高定美学。

templates.title: China May Day Rail Travel Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 中国五一铁路旅行信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a polished Xiaohongshu-style Chinese travel infographic poster in a soft watercolor map aesthetic, square format, showing a five-day high-speed-rail travel route through China. Large brush-calligraphy headline at the top left: {argument name="headline text" default="五一出行计划"}. Directly below it, a green ribbon subtitle with white Chinese text: {argument name="route text" default="广州→湖南→武汉→北京"}. Add a smaller line of Chinese text under the subtitle: “一路向北·发现中国之美”. The background is a pale illustrated map of central and northern China in beige and light sage green, with faint mountain textures, soft rivers, and subtle floral decoration in the corners. A vertical curved railway line runs from the bottom center upward to the top center, connecting 4 cities with orange-red location pins and bold red Chinese city names. The 4 cities are, from bottom to top: 广州, 湖南, 武汉, 北京. Along the route, place small white high-speed train icons on the track and 3 green travel-time labels: “广州→湖南 高铁约2.5小时”, “湖南→武汉 高铁约1.5小时”, and “武汉→北京 高铁约4.5小时”. Near each city, include a scenic collage or illustrated landmark cluster: Guangzhou with a modern skyline and Canton Tower; Hunan with green mountains and cultural scenery; Wuhan with Yellow Crane Tower and historic architecture; Beijing with the Forbidden City / imperial palace architecture. Add small scenic tag labels near the city illustrations reading “花城广州·美食之都”, “山水湖南·人文荟萃”, “江城武汉·英雄之城”, and “中国首都·历史与现代交融”. Under the main title, show exactly 4 minimalist icon badges with short Chinese labels, evenly spaced in one row: a camera icon labeled “精选景点”, a train icon labeled “高铁直达”, a suitcase icon labeled “轻松出行”, and a star icon labeled “美食推荐”. Around the map, place 4 rounded rectangular itinerary cards with green headers, cream backgrounds, and photo thumbnails. Each card must contain day-by-day plans, a starred section for recommended attractions, and a starred section for recommended food. The 4 cards are: 1) top right card titled “北京｜2天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 2) right middle card titled “武汉｜1.5天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 3) left middle card titled “湖南｜2天”, with exactly 2 day rows, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo; 4) bottom left card titled “广州｜1天”, with exactly 1 day row, exactly 4 attraction thumbnails, and 1 food photo. Fill the itinerary text with compact Chinese travel-plan copy in a practical social-media infographic style. At the lower right, add a rounded notes panel containing exactly 2 sections with green titles: “行程亮点” and “出行小贴士”. Under “行程亮点”, list exactly 4 bullet points with small icon markers. Under “出行小贴士”, list exactly 4 bullet points with small icon markers. Decorate the notes area with a small luggage illustration and a handwritten-style diagonal Chinese phrase in green, such as “出发吧！去感受春天的风景”. At the bottom center, place a small rounded summary bar titled “行程总览”, including exactly 4 summary items with icons: total duration “总时长：约6.5天”, total distance “总里程：约2100公里”, recommended transportation “推荐交通：高铁”, and best travel period “最佳出行时间：4.29 - 5.5”. In the bottom left foreground, place a large sleek white high-speed train angled diagonally upward, partially overlapping the border as a hero element. Add a calligraphic closing slogan near the train in Chinese: “最美的风景在路上 最好的时光在五一”. Use an elegant olive-green, sage, beige, and warm red palette, combining traditional Chinese travel-poster charm with modern infographic clarity, crisp typography, soft shadows, rounded cards, realistic photo inserts, and clean editorial layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的小红书风格中国旅行信息图海报，采用柔和的水彩地图美学，方形格式，展示一条穿越中国的五天高铁旅行路线。左上角为醒目的毛笔书法标题：{argument name="headline text" default="五一出行计划"}。在其正下方，添加一条带有白色中文字符的绿色丝带副标题：{argument name="route text" default="广州→湖南→武汉→北京"}。在副标题下方添加一行较小的中文文字：“一路向北·发现中国之美”。背景为米色和浅鼠尾草绿色的中国中北部淡彩插画地图，带有淡淡的山脉纹理、柔和的河流以及角落处微妙的花卉装饰。一条垂直弯曲的铁路线从底部中心向上延伸至顶部中心，连接 4 个城市，并配有橙红色定位针和醒目的红色中文城市名称。从下到上依次为：广州、湖南、武汉、北京。沿途在轨道上放置白色小型高铁图标，并标注 3 个绿色旅行时间标签：“广州→湖南 高铁约 2.5 小时”、“湖南→武汉 高铁约 1.5 小时”以及“武汉→北京 高铁约 4.5 小时”。在每个城市附近，包含一个风景拼贴画或地标插画群：广州配以现代天际线和广州塔；湖南配以青山和人文景观；武汉配以黄鹤楼和历史建筑；北京配以紫禁城/皇家宫殿建筑。在城市插画附近添加小型风景标签，文字分别为“花城广州·美食之都”、“山水湖南·人文荟萃”、“江城武汉·英雄之城”和“中国首都·历史与现代交融”。在主标题下方，均匀排列 4 个极简图标徽章，并配有简短的中文标签：相机图标标注“精选景点”，火车图标标注“高铁直达”，行李箱图标标注“轻松出行”，星形图标标注“美食推荐”。在地图周围，放置 4 张圆角矩形行程卡片，配有绿色标题、奶油色背景和照片缩略图。每张卡片必须包含每日计划、一个推荐景点的星标部分，以及一个推荐美食的星标部分。4 张卡片分别为：1) 右上角卡片标题“北京｜2 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；2) 右侧中间卡片标题“武汉｜1.5 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；3) 左侧中间卡片标题“湖南｜2 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；4) 左下角卡片标题“广州｜1 天”，包含 1 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片。行程文字填充采用实用的小红书风格中文旅行计划文案。在右下角，添加一个圆角备注面板，包含 2 个绿色标题的板块：“行程亮点”和“出行小贴士”。在“行程亮点”下，列出 4 个带有小图标标记的要点。在“出行小贴士”下，列出 4 个带有小图标标记的要点。在备注区域装饰一个小型行李插画，并以绿色手写风格斜体书写中文短语，例如“出发吧！去感受春天的风景”。在底部中心，放置一个小型圆角总结栏，标题为“行程总览”，包含 4 个带图标的总结项：总时长“总时长：约 6.5 天”、总里程“总里程：约 2100 公里”、推荐交通“推荐交通：高铁”以及最佳出行时间“最佳出行时间：4.29 - 5.5”。在左下角前景处，放置一列大型流线型白色高铁，呈对角线向上倾斜，作为视觉焦点部分重叠边框。在火车附近添加书法风格的结束语：“最美的风景在路上 最好的时光在五一”。使用优雅的橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿、米色和暖红色调，将中国传统旅行海报的魅力与现代信息图的清晰度相结合，确保排版清晰、阴影柔和、卡片圆润、照片插入自然，并保持整洁的编辑布局。

templates.title: Office Style Fashion Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 职场风尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: A luxury fashion magazine cover photographed in a modern executive office, featuring a stylish young East Asian businesswoman standing beside a wooden desk in a confident editorial pose. She has long, smooth, dark brown to black hair parted slightly off center, falling over both shoulders, and wears a fitted ribbed knit short-sleeve top in {argument name="top color" default="deep navy"}, tucked into a high-waisted ribbed pencil skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="black"}. Add a delicate silver necklace with a small key pendant. Her body is angled slightly toward camera, with one hand lifted loosely near shoulder height and the other hand pointing down toward papers on the desk, conveying poised authority and effortless elegance. The setting is a refined corner office with warm wood bookshelves filled with books, a tufted brown leather executive chair, a polished wooden desk with neatly arranged documents and dark desk pads, and a tall window on the right revealing a soft blurred city skyline. Use soft natural daylight from the window mixed with warm interior tones, shallow depth of field, premium magazine photography, polished skin, realistic fabric texture, tasteful retouching, and a sophisticated editorial mood. Overlay elegant serif magazine typography: a very large masthead at the top left reading {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICE STYLE"}, small issue text at the top right reading {argument name="issue text" default="MAY/JUN 2024 VOL.28"}, and 5 cover lines total: on the upper right, "Modern Professional Wardrobe" with the smaller subtext "Refined pieces for confident everyday elegance."; on the upper left, "THE POWER OF PRESENCE" with the smaller subtext "Style is not just what you wear—it's how you carry yourself."; on the left middle, "DESIGNED FOR IMPACT" with the smaller subtext "Clean silhouettes. Timeless colors. Endless possibilities."; across the lower left in very large serif type, {argument name="main cover line" default="CONFIDENT & CAPABLE"}; and on the lower right, "FOCUS ELEVATE ACHIEVE" with the smaller subtext "Professional style that moves with you.". Vertical portrait layout, high-end fashion magazine cover composition, clean spacing, muted luxury palette, realistic office styling, chic corporate femininity, confidence in motion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在现代行政办公室拍摄的奢华时尚杂志封面，画面中一位时尚的年轻东亚女商人站在木质办公桌旁，摆出自信的编辑摄影姿势。她留着顺滑的深棕色至黑色长发，中分偏侧，垂落在双肩，身穿一件 {argument name="top color" default="深海军蓝"} 的修身罗纹针织短袖上衣，下搭一条 {argument name="skirt color" default="黑色"} 的高腰罗纹铅笔裙。佩戴一条精致的银色项链，挂坠为一把小钥匙。她的身体略微朝向镜头，一只手随意抬起至肩部高度，另一只手指向桌上的文件，展现出从容的权威感与毫不费力的优雅。背景是一间精致的转角办公室，配有摆满书籍的暖色木质书架、簇绒棕色皮革行政椅、摆放整齐的文件和深色桌垫的抛光木质办公桌，右侧的高大窗户透出柔和模糊的城市天际线。运用来自窗户的柔和自然光与室内暖色调混合，浅景深，高端杂志摄影质感，细腻的皮肤纹理，逼真的面料质感，高雅的修图风格，以及精致的编辑氛围。叠加优雅的衬线杂志排版：左上角为超大刊头 {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICE STYLE"}，右上角为小型期刊文字 {argument name="issue text" default="2024 年 5 月/6 月刊 第 28 卷"}，以及总共 5 条封面导语：右上角为“现代职业衣橱”，副标题为“为自信的日常优雅打造精致单品。”；左上角为“存在感的力量”，副标题为“风格不仅是你穿什么，更是你如何展现自我。”；左中部为“为影响力而设计”，副标题为“利落的剪裁。永恒的色彩。无限的可能。”；左下角为超大衬线字体 {argument name="main cover line" default="自信与干练"}；右下角为“专注 提升 成就”，副标题为“随你而动的职业风格。”。竖向肖像构图，高端时尚杂志封面排版，简洁的间距，低调奢华的色调，写实的办公室造型，时髦的职场女性气质，动感中的自信。

templates.title: Japanese Fashion Cover with Koinobori Dresses

titleLocalized.zh: 日式时尚杂志封面：鲤鱼旗主题礼服

templates.prompt: A fashion magazine cover styled like a luxurious Japanese women's magazine, photographed in soft natural daylight against a pale blue sky with a faint city skyline blurred in the background. The masthead is huge and elegant across the top, reading {argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"} in oversized soft pink serif lettering, with small Japanese cover text above and around it, plus a small issue marker on the upper right reading "5", "May 2026", and "No.218". Center the cover on exactly 2 young adult Japanese women standing close together from about thigh-up, facing camera in a poised editorial pose, with their faces intentionally obscured by smooth soft rectangular blur blocks. The woman on the left wears a flowing pale blue dress inspired by koinobori carp streamers: high Mandarin-style collar, sleeveless inner dress, long sheer cape panels draping from the shoulders, elaborate layered metallic and satin fish-scale appliqué across the bodice, a large stylized fish eye motif on the chest, more scale detailing and fin-shaped ornamentation at the hip, and a cinched waist with decorative jeweled clasp. Her dark hair is in an elegant updo with loose wisps, and she wears dangling earrings. The woman on the right wears the same design concept in pale pink and white, also with a high collar, translucent cape-like side panels, layered fish-scale bodice, a visible fish eye motif near the waist sash, soft pleated skirt, tassel ornament at the belt, and matching dangling earrings; her dark hair is also swept into a refined updo with a few loose strands. The overall styling is airy, graceful, feminine, and sophisticated, mixing traditional Japanese elegance with modern couture. Use a pastel palette dominated by baby blue, blush pink, white, and subtle gold trim, with bright but diffused lighting and a premium glossy magazine editorial finish. Include visible Japanese cover lines arranged like a real magazine layout: one left-side block introducing the cover girls, one large main headline block across the lower half, one right-side vertical cluster of smaller teaser text, and exactly 2 pale blue circular callout badges on the right side containing Japanese text; the upper badge advertises a special appendix gift set and includes exactly 2 small product images of pouch-like accessories, and the lower badge contains a shopping-plan checklist with exactly 3 checkbox lines. Add a small pink ribbon-like label above the main headline. The composition should feel clean, aspirational, and seasonally themed around Golden Week and koinobori fashion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格奢华的日式女性时尚杂志封面，在柔和的自然光下拍摄，背景为淡蓝色天空，远处有模糊的城市天际线。顶部印有巨大且优雅的刊名，以超大号柔粉色衬线字体显示 {argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"}，上方及周围环绕着小号日文封面文字，右上角标有小型期号标记，显示“5”、“2026 年 5 月”和“No.218”。封面中心为两名年轻的日本女性，两人站在一起，取景范围约为大腿以上，面向镜头摆出从容的编辑姿势，她们的面部被平滑的柔焦矩形色块刻意遮挡。左侧女性身着受鲤鱼旗启发的淡蓝色飘逸礼服：高立领中式设计，无袖内衬，肩部垂下长款透明斗篷，胸前饰有精致的层叠金属与缎面鱼鳞贴花，胸口有大型程式化鱼眼图案，腰部有更多鳞片细节和鳍状装饰，腰部收紧并配有装饰性珠宝扣。她留着优雅的盘发，带有几缕碎发，佩戴着垂坠耳环。右侧女性穿着同样设计理念的礼服，配色为淡粉色与白色，同样采用高领、半透明斗篷式侧片、层叠鱼鳞胸衣，腰带附近有明显的鱼眼图案，配有柔软的百褶裙、腰带上的流苏装饰以及配套的垂坠耳环；她的深色头发也盘成了精致的发髻，留有几缕发丝。整体造型轻盈、优雅、柔美且高级，融合了传统日式优雅与现代高定感。采用以婴儿蓝、腮红粉、白色和精致金边为主的柔和色调，光线明亮而柔和，呈现出高级杂志的质感。包含布局真实的日文封面标题：左侧一个介绍封面人物的文字块，下半部分有一个大型主标题块，右侧有一组垂直排列的小型预告文字，右侧还有 2 个淡蓝色圆形标注，内含日文文本；上方标注宣传特别附赠礼品套装，并包含 2 张小型袋状配饰的产品图，下方标注包含一个带有 3 行复选框的购物清单。在主标题上方添加一个粉色丝带状标签。整体构图应简洁、令人向往，并以黄金周和鲤鱼旗时尚为季节性主题。

templates.title: Japanese Koinobori Fashion Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日式鲤鱼旗时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt:
A polished Japanese fashion magazine cover photographed in a bright, airy outdoor setting with a pale blue sky and softly blurred modern railing in the background, portrait orientation. The masthead is enormous across the top in elegant soft pink serif letters reading "L’Allure", with small Japanese text above it and a bracketed Japanese subtitle at the top right. The issue information appears on the upper left as a large black "5" with smaller stacked text beside and below it indicating May 2026, No.156, and a May 2026 issue line. The cover features two adult East Asian women standing side by side from about mid-thigh upward, posed like a luxury editorial cover. Their faces are intentionally obscured by smooth soft rectangular blur blocks. Lighting is soft, natural, and flattering, with a refined premium magazine aesthetic.

The woman on the left wears a navy blouse with dramatic koi-scale sleeves in navy, white, and silver, styled with a bow or scarf-like neckline, tucked into a long flowing off-white skirt with a wide waistband. She carries 1 fish-shaped handbag: a navy and cream koi-inspired purse with a round eye detail, scale pattern, tail fin silhouette, gold hardware, and a thin chain strap hanging from her hand. Her hair is dark brown to black, loosely tied in a low messy bun with soft strands framing her face. Her pose is elegant and slightly angled, one hand near her chin.

The woman on the right wears a crisp white blouse with a soft bow-tie or vertical ruffle/placket detail at the front, paired with a striking koi-inspired skirt or dress panel featuring 2 main colors, coral pink and deep blue, with layered fish-scale motifs and a circular eye-like ornament at the waist. She holds 1 structured handbag: a rectangular white bag with coral pink koi face paneling, blue accents, gold hardware, top handles, and a shoulder strap. Her dark hair is tied back in a low ponytail. She stands facing slightly left with relaxed hands and a calm editorial expression implied by pose.

The fashion concept is themed around koi streamers and carp motifs, transforming traditional Japanese koinobori imagery into sophisticated contemporary womenswear. The palette is soft sky blue, blush pink, navy, white, cream, and coral red. Fabrics appear smooth, elegant, and lightly flowing, with printed or embroidered scale patterns. The overall mood is graceful, feminine, seasonal, and upscale, balancing tradition with modern fashion.

Add multiple Japanese cover lines in a realistic editorial layout. On the left side, include 4 grouped text blocks: 1 feature header in red and black about moody carp streamer fashion, 1 smaller blue subhead about inheriting traditional beauty with a fresh elegance balance, 1 black text block about basics and updates for women in their twenties, and 1 blue makeup feature line about translucent early-summer makeup. On the right side, include 3 grouped text blocks: 1 red "Cover Story" heading with larger black Japanese headline text beneath, 1 blue text block about conservative style that shines in fresh greenery, and 1 pink boxed reader gift notice with black Japanese text below about luxury brand new bags and accessories. Near the lower left, place 1 circular pink badge with white and cream Japanese text about a special walking guide supplement. Across the lower center, place a large dramatic Japanese main headline in pink and black serif and brush-style type, spanning most of the width.

Design this as a realistic premium women’s fashion magazine cover for {argument name="magazine name" default="L’Allure"}, themed around {argument name="fashion theme" default="koinobori-inspired spring fashion"}, featuring {argument name="issue month" default="May 2026"}. Keep the text predominantly in Japanese, the masthead in large pink serif type, and the composition clean, aspirational, and luxurious.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的日本时尚杂志封面，拍摄于明亮通透的户外环境，背景为淡蓝色天空和柔焦的现代栏杆，纵向构图。顶部刊头为巨大的优雅柔粉色衬线字体“L’Allure”，上方配有小型日文，右上角有带括号的日文副标题。左上角显示期刊信息，为一个巨大的黑色“5”，旁边和下方堆叠着较小的文字，标明 2026 年 5 月、第 156 期以及 2026 年 5 月刊的字样。封面展示了两位成年东亚女性，从大腿中部以上并肩站立，呈现出奢华编辑封面的姿态。她们的面部被平滑的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。光线柔和、自然且修饰感强，具有精致的高级杂志美感。

左侧女性身着海军蓝衬衫，袖子采用海军蓝、白色和银色的戏剧性鱼鳞设计，搭配蝴蝶结或围巾式领口，束进一条长款飘逸的米白色半身裙中，裙腰宽大。她手提 1 只鱼形手袋：一款海军蓝与奶油色相间的鲤鱼灵感包，带有圆形眼睛细节、鱼鳞图案、鱼尾轮廓、金色五金件和垂下的细链条。她的头发呈深棕色至黑色，松散地扎成低发髻，几缕发丝柔和地修饰着脸庞。她的姿态优雅，身体略微倾斜，一只手靠近下巴。

右侧女性身着干练的白色衬衫，前襟带有柔和的领结或垂直荷叶边/门襟细节，搭配一条引人注目的鲤鱼灵感半身裙或裙装，主色调为珊瑚粉和深蓝色，带有层叠的鱼鳞纹样，腰间饰有圆形眼状装饰。她手提 1 只结构感手袋：一款长方形白色包袋，带有珊瑚粉色鲤鱼面部拼接、蓝色点缀、金色五金件、顶部手柄和肩带。她的深色头发扎成低马尾。她身体略微向左侧站立，双手放松，姿态流露出从容的编辑感。

时尚概念围绕鲤鱼旗和鲤鱼纹样展开，将传统的日本鲤鱼旗意象转化为精致的当代女装。色调为柔和的天空蓝、腮红粉、海军蓝、白色、奶油色和珊瑚红。面料显得平滑、优雅且轻盈飘逸，带有印花或刺绣的鱼鳞图案。整体氛围优雅、女性化、充满季节感且高端，平衡了传统与现代时尚。

添加多行日文封面标题，采用写实的编辑排版。左侧包含 4 组文本块：1 个关于忧郁鲤鱼旗时尚的红黑配色专题标题，1 个关于以清新优雅平衡传承传统美感的蓝色小副标题，1 个关于二十岁女性基础款与更新的黑色文本块，以及 1 个关于初夏透明感妆容的蓝色美妆专题行。右侧包含 3 组文本块：1 个红色的“封面故事”标题，下方配有较大的黑色日文主标题，1 个关于在清新绿意中闪耀的保守风格的蓝色文本块，以及 1 个粉色框选的读者赠品通知，下方配有关于奢侈品牌新款包袋和配饰的黑色日文文本。左下角附近放置 1 个圆形粉色徽章，带有白色和奶油色日文，内容为特别步行指南增刊。下部中心横跨大部分宽度，放置一个巨大的、由粉色和黑色衬线及毛笔字风格组成的戏剧性日文主标题。

将其设计为一本写实的女性高端时尚杂志封面，杂志名称为 {argument name="magazine name" default="L’Allure"}，主题为 {argument name="fashion theme" default="鲤鱼旗灵感春季时尚"}，刊期为 {argument name="issue month" default="2026 年 5 月"}。保持文本以日文为主，刊头采用大号粉色衬线字体，构图简洁、令人向往且奢华。

templates.title: Otaku-Friendly Gyaru in Sunset Classroom

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻的辣妹（Gyaru）在教室

templates.prompt: A warm, golden-hour anime illustration of a fashionable high school gyaru girl standing in an empty classroom, leaning slightly forward between wooden desks with one hand resting on a desk and the other tucked into her cardigan pocket. She has long, voluminous wavy {argument name="hair color" default="bleached blonde"} hair with soft shine and layered strands, a trendy, approachable gal aesthetic, and multiple ear piercings with delicate jewelry. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat square censor block in the center of the image. She wears a Japanese school uniform consisting of 4 visible outfit pieces: a loose cream-beige cardigan with buttons, a white shirt with the collar open, a large navy plaid ribbon bow, and a short dark plaid pleated skirt. Add subtle accessories including 2 necklaces and manicured nails. The classroom is lit by strong sunset light streaming from tall windows on the left, casting long warm shadows across the desks, floor, and her clothes. In the background, show a green chalkboard with handwritten Japanese farewell-style messages including "ありがとう♡" and "ございました!", plus a few small doodles, and several neatly arranged desks and chairs. The mood should be soft, nostalgic, flirtatious, and kindhearted, capturing the feeling of an otaku-friendly gal after school. Highly detailed anime painting, soft rim light, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, polished linework, luminous hair highlights, realistic fabric folds, and a vertical portrait framing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温暖的黄金时刻动漫插画，描绘了一位时尚的辣妹（gyaru）高中女生，她随意地靠在空荡荡的日本教室课桌旁。她位于中景全身肖像的中心，面向观众，身体微微前倾，一只手放在桌子上，另一只手插在开衫口袋里，散发出一种友善、平易近人且符合御宅族审美的辣妹气质。她留着长长的波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="漂染金发"}，发丝蓬松且在肩部呈现出自然的卷度，带着一种略显凌乱的迷人感，佩戴着多个耳环、精致的项链，留着长长的美甲，妆容清透年轻。她的装扮是时尚化的日本校服：一件宽松的米色开衫敞开穿在白色衬衫外，衬衫领口解开，领口系着一个大的深蓝色格子蝴蝶结，下身是短款深色格子百褶裙。教室被左侧大窗户射入的午后低角度阳光照亮，形成了长长的阴影，她的发丝边缘泛着柔和的轮廓光，营造出一种怀旧的琥珀色氛围。背景中有几张木制课桌椅、一块写有日语感谢语和粉笔涂鸦的绿色黑板，以及放学后安静场景的柔和氛围。高细节动漫渲染，精致的轻小说/视觉小说关键视觉图质量，柔和的电影级光影，优雅的阴影处理，浪漫的怀旧情绪，竖构图。

templates.title: Sparkling Anime Idol Concert Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 闪耀动漫偶像演唱会肖像

templates.prompt: A dazzling anime idol concert illustration of a single female virtual singer performing center stage, shown in a dynamic medium full-body shot from slightly below, with one hand holding a microphone near her chest and the other arm reaching outward toward the viewer. She has extremely long, voluminous twin tails that flow dramatically across the entire composition, in a soft peach-blonde to pink gradient with glossy highlights and curled ends, plus a teal futuristic headband and matching ear-cover accessories. Her face is intentionally obscured by a simple square censor block in a muted beige-pink tone. She wears a vivid turquoise-blue idol dress with a glossy, jewel-like finish, a fitted bodice, white frilled cap sleeves, a white sailor-style collar, a large red bow at the chest set with a blue gem, gold chain ornaments and gold buttons at the waist, and a layered flared skirt with white ruffles underneath and thin pink stripe accents near the hem. Add long flowing red ribbon tails streaming from the waist and costume, black thigh-high stockings, and a gold-and-teal handheld microphone. The stage is a spectacular futuristic arena packed with a glowing audience of blue and purple penlights, surrounded by intense sparkling bokeh, glitter, confetti pieces, lens flares, and star-like light bursts. Fill the background with curved luminous stage structures, neon arcs, and multiple pink, purple, and blue spotlights crisscrossing overhead, creating a magical high-energy live-show atmosphere. The art style is polished modern anime key visual, ultra-detailed, glossy painterly rendering, radiant lighting, shimmering highlights on fabric and hair, saturated cyan-magenta palette, celebratory and emotional idol performance energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊艳的动漫偶像演唱会插画，画面中央是一位正在表演的女性虚拟歌手，采用略微仰视的动态中景全身构图，一只手将麦克风握在胸前，另一只手臂向观众方向伸展。她拥有极长且蓬松的双马尾，戏剧性地铺满整个画面，发色呈现从柔和桃金色到粉色的渐变，带有光泽感高光和卷曲的发梢，佩戴青色未来感发带及配套耳罩饰品。她的面部被一个简单的米粉色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身穿一件鲜艳的青蓝色偶像礼服，具有光泽的宝石质感，修身胸衣，白色荷叶边盖袖，白色水手领，胸前饰有镶嵌蓝色宝石的大红蝴蝶结，腰间配有金色链条装饰和金色纽扣，裙摆为分层喇叭裙，内衬白色褶边，下摆处有细粉色条纹点缀。腰间和服装上飘动着长长的红色丝带，穿着黑色过膝袜，手持金青色麦克风。舞台是一个壮观的未来感竞技场，观众席中闪烁着蓝色和紫色的荧光棒，周围环绕着强烈的闪光虚化效果、亮片、纸屑、镜头光晕和星状光芒。背景填充着弯曲的发光舞台结构、霓虹弧线，以及头顶交错的粉色、紫色和蓝色聚光灯，营造出充满魔力的高能量现场演出氛围。艺术风格为精致的现代动漫主视觉图，超高细节，光泽感绘画渲染，光芒四射的照明，织物和头发上的闪烁高光，饱和的青色-洋红色调，充满庆典感和情感张力的偶像表演氛围。

templates.title: Kawaii Street Fashion Duo Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱街头风双人肖像

templates.prompt: A candid street-fashion portrait of two cute anime-inspired girls standing close together in front of a colorful urban graffiti wall on a city sidewalk in Japan, photographed at eye level with a shallow depth of field and soft overcast daylight. Both have smooth pale skin and short blunt bob haircuts with straight ends, their bangs covering part of the forehead, and their faces intentionally simplified or blurred for an anonymous doll-like look. The girl on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="silver gray"} hair, wears a black knit beanie with a rectangular patch logo reading "Nightfall", a black leather jacket over a white graphic T-shirt with a dark distressed illustration and purple accent graphic, layered silver chain necklaces including a heart pendant, a black choker, and a black backpack strap over one shoulder. The girl on the right has icy light blue hair, wears a black knit beanie with a white scribble-style logo, an oversized black hoodie with bold hot-pink Japanese graffiti lettering across the chest, a silver chain necklace, and black backpack straps on both shoulders. They lean in slightly toward each other in a relaxed, stylish pose, with one hand lightly touching the hoodie shoulder area. The background is a vivid mural wall in pink, blue, and purple tones, plus a sticker-covered utility pole on the right edge with visible layered street stickers including "SMILE", "AQUARIUS", and a red "HELLO my name is" sticker covered in tags. Emphasize Japanese street style, alternative fashion, kawaii cool mood, realistic fabric textures, crisp clothing detail, subtle cinematic color grading, and a trendy Harajuku snapshot aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍风格的街头时尚肖像，两位可爱的动漫风女孩并肩站立在日本城市人行道的彩色涂鸦墙前，采用平视视角拍摄，具有浅景深效果和柔和的阴天自然光。两人均拥有白皙细腻的皮肤和短直发波波头，刘海遮住部分额头，面部经过刻意简化或模糊处理，呈现出匿名的人偶感。左侧女孩留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银灰色"} 的头发，头戴饰有矩形 "Nightfall" 标志贴片的黑色针织帽，身穿黑色皮夹克，内搭白色印花 T 恤（带有深色磨损插画和紫色点缀图案），叠戴银色链条项链（含心形吊坠），佩戴黑色颈圈，单肩背着黑色双肩包。右侧女孩留着冰蓝色头发，头戴饰有白色涂鸦风格标志的黑色针织帽，身穿超大款黑色连帽衫，胸前印有醒目的亮粉色日文涂鸦字样，佩戴银色链条项链，双肩背着黑色双肩包。她们姿态放松且时尚，微微向对方倾斜，其中一只手轻触连帽衫肩部。背景是一面色彩鲜艳的粉、蓝、紫色调涂鸦墙，右侧边缘有一根贴满贴纸的电线杆，上面可见层叠的街头贴纸，包括 "SMILE"、"AQUARIUS" 以及一张写有 "HELLO my name is" 的红色贴纸，上面布满涂鸦。强调日系街头风格、另类时尚、可爱酷炫氛围、逼真的布料质感、清晰的服装细节、微妙的电影感调色以及潮流原宿快照美学。

templates.title: Chibi Rabbit OpenPose Diagram

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版兔子 OpenPose 图示

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A simple centered full-body illustration of a cute chibi {argument name="animal type" default="rabbit"} character on a plain {argument name="background color" default="light gray"} background, drawn in a flat cartoon style with thick clean black outlines and minimal shading. The character has a white body, a large rounded head, 2 tall upright ears with bright cyan inner ear shapes, 2 large oval eyes with cyan irises, black pupils, and small highlights, tiny curved eyebrows, a small red-pink nose area, and a slight smiling mouth. The pose is front-facing with both arms stretched straight out horizontally to the sides, legs apart in a simple standing pose, and a short fluffy tail visible on the right side of the body as a curved semicircle made of short black dash marks. Overlay a clear OpenPose-style skeleton marker system on top of the character: 2 purple eye keypoints, 1 red nose keypoint, 1 blue neck keypoint, 2 shoulder keypoints, 2 elbow keypoints, 2 wrist keypoints, 1 yellow spine or pelvis center point, 2 hip keypoints, 2 knee keypoints, and 2 ankle keypoints, for a total of 17 colored points connected by thin colored lines across the face, shoulders, torso, arms, and legs. Use vivid point colors including purple, magenta, red, blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange, and teal so the pose overlay is clearly visible. Keep the composition vertically centered, symmetrical, clean, and diagram-like, with the cute mascot character and pose-estimation overlay as the sole subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简单的全身居中插图，展示了一个可爱的 Q 版 {argument name="animal type" default="兔子"} 角色，背景为纯色 {argument name="background color" default="浅灰色"}，采用扁平卡通风格绘制，具有清晰的黑色粗轮廓和极简阴影。角色拥有白色的身体、一个硕大的圆头、两只竖起的长耳朵（内耳为亮青色）、两只带有青色虹膜、黑色瞳孔和微小高光的大椭圆形眼睛、细小的弯眉、小巧的红粉色鼻区以及微微上扬的嘴巴。角色正面朝向，双臂水平向两侧伸直，双腿分开呈简单的站立姿势，身体右侧可见一个由短黑虚线构成的半圆形短绒尾巴。在角色上方叠加一套清晰的 OpenPose 风格骨架标记系统：包含 2 个紫色眼部关键点、1 个红色鼻部关键点、1 个蓝色颈部关键点、2 个肩部关键点、2 个肘部关键点、2 个腕部关键点、1 个黄色脊椎或骨盆中心点、2 个髋部关键点、2 个膝盖关键点和 2 个踝部关键点，总计 17 个彩色点，并通过细彩色线条连接面部、肩部、躯干、手臂和腿部。使用紫色、洋红色、红色、蓝色、青色、绿色、黄色、橙色和蓝绿色等鲜艳的颜色，使姿态叠加层清晰可见。构图保持垂直居中、对称、整洁且具有图示感，以可爱的吉祥物角色和姿态估计叠加层作为唯一主体。

templates.title: Shiba Inu Space Dream Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 柴犬太空梦海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese motivational movie-poster style illustration set at dusk, mixing corporate burnout and hopeful space-dream fantasy. In the center foreground, an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu with warm tan fur smiles confidently at the viewer, wearing a sharp navy business suit, white dress shirt, and blue striped tie. The dog holds a black e-reader in the left paw with the screen text “kindle” and a black-and-gold fountain pen in the right paw. Behind the character, the background is split into two thematic halves that blend together: on the left, a dense Tokyo-like city skyline at sunset with Tokyo Tower glowing orange, dark office buildings, and exhausted salary workers at desks under a stressful atmosphere; on the right, a deep starry cosmos with blue nebulae, a rocket launching upward, 3 airplanes, a winding glowing golden trajectory line, 1 small planet, 2 floating paw prints, 2 packaged breads labeled “カンパン,” and 1 round biscuit labeled “南部せんべい.” Near the right lower background, show a family of 4 from behind walking toward the bright horizon with a dog, symbolizing hope and future dreams. Add 3 black signboards floating in the left midground with the Japanese words “残業,” “プレッシャー,” and “会議 満員電車.” In the foreground on a wooden desk, place exactly 3 prominently displayed books standing upright: book 1 on the left is white and blue with the title “忙しい社会人のやり直し英語勉強法” and a small illustrated author portrait; book 2 in the center is dark blue and gold with the large title “『あたりまえ』を続けることは 最強の生存戦略である”; book 3 on the right is white and blue with the title “『すぐやる』は最速の仕事術” and a large “5” plus a circular “5 MIN” icon. Also on the desk, include 1 black coffee mug with the text “未来は 5分で変わる,” 1 spiral notebook opened flat with a handwritten to-do list in Japanese reading “今日やること ① ブログを書く（5分） ② 家族と過ごす（大切） ③ 未来を信じる（ワクワク）” plus a paw-print doodle, 1 black fountain pen lying beside it, 1 globe on a stand at the far right, 1 plate of crackers, 1 extra packaged “カンパン,” and small framed photos at the lower left edge. At the top, large luxurious gold Japanese headline text reads “{argument name="headline text" default="5分で宇宙へ！"}” with a smaller gold subtitle beneath: “〜たかお柴犬のサイドFIRE物語〜”. Below that, centered white copy reads “忙しい毎日に、たった5分。 犬だけど、夢は本気で掴んだ。” At the bottom center, add a cinematic English tagline: “Based on a true story of たかお柴犬” and beneath it “A heartwarming comedy-drama about taking small steps to big dreams”. Use ultra-detailed glossy poster rendering, warm orange sunset versus cool blue space contrast, inspirational commercial key art, sharp typography, rich cinematic lighting, whimsical but sincere tone, highly polished social-media poster composition, vertical format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性的日式励志电影海报风格插画，背景设定在黄昏，融合了职场倦怠与充满希望的太空梦想幻想。画面中心前景处，一只拟人化的柴犬拥有温暖的棕褐色皮毛，正自信地微笑着看向观众，它穿着剪裁利落的深蓝色商务西装、白色衬衫和蓝色条纹领带。这只狗左爪拿着一个黑色的电子阅读器，屏幕上显示着“kindle”字样，右爪握着一支黑金配色的钢笔。角色后方的背景分为两个相互融合的主题部分：左侧是日落时分密集的东京风格城市天际线，东京塔闪烁着橙色的光芒，深色的办公大楼里，疲惫的上班族在压力沉重的氛围下伏案工作；右侧是深邃的星空，点缀着蓝色星云、一枚向上发射的火箭、3 架飞机、一条蜿蜒发光的金色轨迹线、1 颗小行星、2 个漂浮的爪印、2 包标有“カンパン”的压缩饼干，以及 1 块标有“南部せんべい”的圆形仙贝。在右下方的背景附近，展示一家四口从背面走向明亮地平线的身影，身边跟着一只狗，象征着希望与未来梦想。在左侧中景处添加 3 块漂浮的黑色“项目”，上面分别写着日语词汇“残业”、“プレッシャー”和“会议 满员电车”。在前景的木质书桌上，放置 3 本醒目竖立的书籍：左侧第 1 本书为白蓝色，标题为“忙しい社会人のやり直し英语勉强法”，并配有小幅作者肖像插图；中间第 2 本书为深蓝色配金色，大标题为“『あたりまえ』を続けることは 最强の生存戦略である”；右侧第 3 本书为白蓝色，标题为“『すぐやる』は最速の仕事术”，并带有巨大的“5”和圆形的“5 MIN”图标。桌上还包括 1 个黑色咖啡杯，印有文字“未来は 5分で変わる”、1 本摊开的螺旋笔记本，上面用日语手写着待办事项清单：“今日やること ① ブログを書く（5分） ② 家族と過ごす（大切） ③ 未来を信じる（ワクワク）”，旁边还有一个爪印涂鸦、1 支平放的黑色钢笔、最右侧放置 1 个地球仪摆件、1 盘饼干、1 包额外的“カンパン”，以及左下角边缘处的小相框。顶部是奢华的金色大号日语标题文字“{argument name="headline text" default="5分で宇宙へ！"}”，下方配有较小的金色副标题：“〜たかお柴犬のサイドFIRE物语〜”。下方居中处是白色的文案：“忙しい毎日に、たった5分。 犬だけど、梦は本気で掴んだ。”底部中心处添加一句电影感十足的英文标语：“Based on a true story of たかお柴犬”，下方写着“A heartwarming comedy-drama about taking small steps to big dreams”。采用超精细光面海报渲染，温暖的橙色日落与冷色调太空形成鲜明对比，励志商业主视觉艺术，锐利的排版，丰富的电影级光影，风格既异想天开又真诚，高度精致的社交媒体海报构图，竖版格式。

templates.title: Romantic Tokyo Couple Photo Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 东京浪漫情侣照片拼贴

templates.prompt: A moody 4-by-3 photo collage made of 12 candid smartphone-style snapshots of a young couple during summer nights in Tokyo, shot with a nostalgic film look, soft grain, muted colors, slight blur, low contrast, dim ambient street lighting, and intimate casual framing. The overall tone is romantic, youthful, private, and documentary-like, with a warm gray-brown palette and a slightly desaturated teal-orange night city atmosphere. The man has messy dark hair, a slim build, and wears a dark overshirt or lightweight jacket over a white T-shirt; the woman has long dark brown hair, a slim build, and wears a white sleeveless top with thin black shoulder straps from a bag. In every panel, both faces are intentionally obscured by large soft-edged blur blocks for anonymity. Include exactly 12 images arranged in a tight seamless grid: top row panel 1, an extreme close-up side profile of the man at night; panel 2, the woman taking a mirror or phone selfie while standing beside the man outdoors at night; panel 3, the couple pressed close together near a street sign with Japanese text; panel 4, the couple kissing at a busy crosswalk in the city. Middle row panel 5, a pavement shadow photo of two people, one making a peace sign; panel 6, the couple standing close on a sidewalk in an urban shopping street; panel 7, a sunset skyline over water with Tokyo Tower visible, no people; panel 8, a high-angle shot looking down on the woman and the man close together on stairs or a walkway. Bottom row panel 9, a tight intimate close-up of the couple touching faces or kissing; panel 10, the man adjusting or touching the woman's hair on a city street; panel 11, the couple riding together on a scooter or motorcycle, both wearing helmets, captured in motion blur; panel 12, the couple embracing against a pale blue sky, framed from the shoulders up. Backgrounds should include Japanese city streets, storefronts, crosswalks, signage, buildings, night traffic, and urban evening ambience. Keep the composition casual and imperfect like real memories, with varied crops, soft focus, motion blur, and authentic handheld phone photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一组充满情绪感的 4x3 照片拼贴，由 12 张年轻情侣在东京夏夜的手机抓拍照片组成，采用怀旧胶片质感、柔和颗粒、低饱和色彩、轻微模糊、低对比度、昏暗的环境街灯以及亲密的随意构图。整体基调浪漫、年轻、私密且具有纪录片风格，色调为暖灰棕色，并带有轻微去饱和的青橙色城市夜景氛围。男子留着凌乱的深色短发，身材苗条，身穿深色外搭或轻便夹克，内搭白色 T 恤；女子留着深棕色长发，身材苗条，身穿白色无袖上衣，肩上背着黑色细肩带包。在每一格画面中，两人的面部均被刻意添加了大面积的柔边模糊遮挡以保护隐私。包含 12 张紧凑排列的无缝网格图像：第一行第 1 格，夜间男子侧脸的极致特写；第 2 格，女子在夜间户外与男子并肩站立时拍摄的镜面或手机自拍；第 3 格，两人在带有日文标识的街道旁紧紧依偎；第 4 格，两人在繁忙的城市人行横道上接吻。中间一行第 5 格，地面上两人的影子，其中一人比着剪刀手；第 6 格，两人在城市商业街的人行道上亲密站立；第 7 格，带有东京塔的日落水岸天际线，无人物；第 8 格，从高处俯拍楼梯或通道上紧挨着的男女。最后一行第 9 格，两人脸部触碰或接吻的亲密特写；第 10 格，男子在城市街道上为女子整理头发；第 11 格，两人骑着踏板车或摩托车，均佩戴头盔，呈现动态模糊感；第 12 格，两人在淡蓝色天空下拥抱，取景为肩部以上。背景应包含日本城市街道、店面、人行横道、标识、建筑、夜间交通和城市夜晚氛围。保持构图随意且不完美，如同真实的记忆，呈现多样的裁剪、柔焦、动态模糊以及真实的手机手持摄影感。

templates.title: Gothic Anime Girl with Black Roses

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风动漫少女与黑玫瑰

templates.prompt: A dark anime gothic portrait of a {argument name="character type" default="young woman"} shown from the chest up, centered in the frame, with long layered {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair in messy twin tails and loose strands falling over the shoulders. She wears two large black ribbon-and-lace hair ornaments, a black gothic dress with voluminous sleeves and delicate lace trim, black lace fingerless gloves, and a black leather choker with a buckle. Around her neck are 2 layered silver chain necklaces, one ending in a prominent cross pendant. Both hands are raised near her face making peace signs, one on each side, with black painted nails and a slightly playful, edgy pose. The background is a rich blood-red gradient with a dark, moody atmosphere, decorated with 5 visible black roses on thorny stems around the figure and dripping black shapes along the top edge, creating a dramatic gothic horror aesthetic. Use high-detail anime illustration, sharp linework, soft dramatic shading, glossy black fabrics, pale skin, strong red-and-black contrast, symmetrical composition, close-up framing, and an elegant but ominous mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑动漫风格的哥特肖像，主角为 {argument name="character type" default="年轻女性"}，半身构图，居中展示。她留着长长的多层次 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 凌乱双马尾，发丝自然垂落在肩头。她佩戴着两个巨大的黑色丝带蕾丝发饰，身穿带有蓬松袖口和精致蕾丝花边的黑色哥特裙，戴着黑色蕾丝露指手套，以及带有金属扣的黑色皮质颈圈。颈部叠戴两条银色链条项链，其中一条挂着醒目的十字架吊坠。双手举在脸颊两侧比出剪刀手，指甲涂成黑色，姿态俏皮又不失酷感。背景为浓郁的血红色渐变，营造出阴郁的氛围，人物周围装饰着 5 朵带刺的黑玫瑰，顶部边缘有黑色滴落状图形，呈现出极具戏剧性的哥特恐怖美学。采用高细节动漫插画风格，线条锐利，阴影柔和且富有戏剧性，强调黑色织物的光泽感、苍白的肤色以及强烈的红黑对比，构图对称，近景取景，整体氛围优雅而诡谲。
