templates.title: Tokyo DisneySea Front-Row Battle UI

titleLocalized.zh: 东京迪士尼海洋前排争夺战 UI

templates.prompt:
Create a hyper-detailed comedic Japanese arcade fighting game screenshot styled like a versus battle scene, using a real-world photo aesthetic with game UI overlaid on top. The scene shows an intense mock battle between two groups of theme-park fans competing for the front row at an outdoor show plaza in Tokyo DisneySea. Use a wide 16:9 composition. In the background, clearly show Mediterranean Harbor and Mount Prometheus under bright daytime skies, with the waterfront and DisneySea architecture visible. In the foreground, show exactly 10 young adult people in winter casual clothing, split into 2 opposing teams of 5, physically leaning, grabbing, reaching, and shoving in a tug-of-war-like scrum over position, with exaggerated competitive body language and frozen action as if in a fighting game. Faces should be anonymized with soft blurred blocks. Add floating character labels above each person with levels and names in Japanese. The overall tone is absurdly realistic, like a real candid photo transformed into a polished arcade game battle screen.

Add a full Japanese fighting-game HUD with glossy blue-versus-red interface styling. At the very top, place a center stage title bar reading "東京ディズニーシー　ミッキー広場　ショー最前列バトル" and a large timer in the middle reading "TIME 89". In the top left, add a blue team header "PLAYER1" and team name "最前列ガチ勢A". In the top right, add a red team header "RIVAL" and team name "ライバルグループB". On the left side, stack exactly 5 blue player status panels with portraits, level, Japanese class-like nicknames, HP, SP, and BURST meters. The 5 left-side labels are: "Lv.25 ガチ勢リーダー ユウキ", "Lv.24 筋肉マン タケシ", "Lv.23 眼鏡オタク シンジ", "Lv.23 開角心MAX ケント", "Lv.22 サポート要員 リョウ". On the right side, stack exactly 5 red rival status panels with the labels: "Lv.27 ライバルリーダー ダイキ", "Lv.26 パワフル代表 マサル", "Lv.24 戦略家 コウジ", "Lv.23 熱血漢 リク", "Lv.22 サポート女子 サキ". Each panel should include numeric HP and SP values and segmented BURST gauges, styled like a Japanese arcade RPG-fighter interface.

Place exactly 10 in-battle nameplates above the fighters in the center scene, color-coded blue for the left team and red for the right team. The 10 labels are: "Lv.24 タケシ", "Lv.25 ユウキ", "Lv.23 シンジ", "Lv.23 ケント", "Lv.22 リョウ", "Lv.27 ダイキ", "Lv.26 マサル", "Lv.23 リク", "Lv.22 サキ", "Lv.22 ミサキ".

At the lower left, add a skill menu titled "スキル" listing exactly 5 skills with SP costs: "ダッシュ突撃 SP 20", "肩押し強奪 SP 25", "荷物で場所確保 SP 15", "ロープくぐり SP 10", "本気の根性 SP 50". Beneath that, add a dark description box explaining the highlighted skill "本気の根性" with the Japanese text: "気合で相手を威圧し、どかす！ 一定時間、相手が怯みやすくなる！ （バーストゲージを大きく消費する） 効果時間：10秒".

At the bottom center, add an item menu titled "アイテム" with exactly 5 item slots showing icons and counts: a water bottle "x3", a folded purple towel "x2", a blue drawstring bag "x1", a gray backpack "x1", and a boxed meal "x2". At the lower right, add a quest panel titled "クエスト" with the mission text "ショー開始までに最前列を死守しろ！" and condition text "条件：ライバルグループを全員後ろに押し戻せ！" and countdown text "ショー開始まで：02:30". Beside it, add a mini-map titled "ミッキー広場MAP" showing red and blue dots for both teams in the plaza. Along the very bottom edge, include small controller prompts in Japanese for actions such as skill use, item use, grab/push, and dash.

Use dramatic, saturated lighting, crisp detail, realistic clothing folds, authentic plaza stone pavement, and a high-end Japanese game screenshot look. The image should feel like a ridiculous but believable crossover between a real Tokyo DisneySea crowd photo and a competitive arcade battle game interface.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张超精细的喜剧风格日本街机格斗游戏截图，采用对战场景样式，将真实照片的美学与游戏 UI 叠加在一起。场景展示了东京迪士尼海洋户外演出广场上，两组主题乐园粉丝为争夺前排位置而进行的激烈模拟对战。使用 16:9 宽屏构图。背景清晰可见地中海港湾和普罗米修斯山，天空明亮，水岸和迪士尼海洋的建筑清晰可见。前景展示 10 名身穿冬季休闲装的年轻人，分为 5 对 5 的两个对立阵营，像拔河一样身体前倾、抓扯、伸手、推搡，争夺位置，动作夸张，如同格斗游戏中的定格画面。面部使用柔和的模糊块进行匿名处理。在每个人上方添加悬浮角色标签，标注等级和日文名称。整体基调荒诞而写实，就像一张真实的抓拍照片被转化为精美的街机游戏对战画面。

添加一套完整的日式格斗游戏 HUD，采用亮面蓝红对比界面风格。最上方放置一个中央舞台标题栏，文字为“东京迪士尼海洋 米奇广场 演出最前排对战”，中间显示大计时器“TIME 89”。左上角添加蓝色队伍标题“PLAYER1”及队名“最前排硬核粉丝 A”。右上角添加红色队伍标题“RIVAL”及队名“竞争对手组 B”。左侧堆叠 5 个蓝色玩家状态面板，包含头像、等级、日式职业昵称、HP、SP 和 BURST 槽。左侧 5 个标签分别为：“Lv.25 硬核队长 勇树”、“Lv.24 肌肉男 武”、“Lv.23 眼镜宅 真司”、“Lv.23 开角心 MAX 健人”、“Lv.22 支援人员 亮”。右侧堆叠 5 个红色对手状态面板，标签为：“Lv.27 对手队长 大辉”、“Lv.26 力量代表 胜”、“Lv.24 战略家 浩二”、“Lv.23 热血汉 陆”、“Lv.22 支援女生 咲”。每个面板应包含数值化的 HP 和 SP 以及分段式 BURST 槽，风格类似于日式街机 RPG 格斗界面。

在中心场景的格斗者上方放置 10 个战斗名牌，左侧队伍为蓝色，右侧队伍为红色。10 个标签分别为：“Lv.24 武”、“Lv.25 勇树”、“Lv.23 真司”、“Lv.23 健人”、“Lv.22 亮”、“Lv.27 大辉”、“Lv.26 胜”、“Lv.23 陆”、“Lv.22 咲”、“Lv.22 美咲”。

左下角添加一个标题为“技能”的技能菜单，列出 5 个带有 SP 消耗的技能：“冲刺突击 SP 20”、“肩推强夺 SP 25”、“用行李占位 SP 15”、“钻绳索 SP 10”、“本气的毅力 SP 50”。下方添加一个深色说明框，解释高亮技能“本气的毅力”，文字为：“用气势威压对手，将其推开！一定时间内，对手更容易产生硬直！（大幅消耗 BURST 槽）效果时间：10 秒”。

底部中央添加一个标题为“道具”的道具菜单，包含 5 个显示图标和数量的槽位：水瓶“x3”、折叠紫色毛巾“x2”、蓝色抽绳包“x1”、灰色双肩包“x1”和盒饭“x2”。右下角添加一个标题为“任务”的任务面板，任务文字为“在演出开始前死守最前排！”，条件文字为“条件：将竞争对手组全员推回后方！”，倒计时文字为“距离演出开始：02:30”。旁边添加一个标题为“米奇广场 MAP”的小地图，显示广场上两队的红蓝点。在最底部边缘，包含用于技能使用、道具使用、抓取/推搡和冲刺等操作的小型日文控制器提示。

使用戏剧性的高饱和度光影、清晰的细节、写实的衣物褶皱、真实的广场石板路，呈现高端日本游戏截图的质感。画面应给人一种荒谬但可信的跨界感，仿佛是一张真实的东京迪士尼海洋人群照片与竞技街机对战游戏界面的结合。

templates.title: Japanese AI App Promo Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 日文 AI 应用推广横幅

templates.prompt: Create a polished Japanese tech advertising banner for a mobile app, widescreen 16:9, with a futuristic blue-to-purple gradient background filled with glowing network lines, connection nodes, soft lens flares, and subtle digital particles. At the top center, place a modern app logo: a cyan hexagon icon with large white letters “SC” and a small circuit symbol inside the C, followed by the brand text “SKILL Cert by AI” in a clean sans-serif font, with “SKILL” large and black, “Cert” below it in black, and “by AI” smaller in cyan. Center the composition around a bold Japanese headline in very large white text with a dark navy outline and soft drop shadow: {argument name="headline text" default="AIが出題する資格バトルアプリ"}. Directly below, add a second line of medium-large white Japanese text with the same outline and shadow: {argument name="subheadline text" default="200以上の資格でオンライン対戦"}. In the middle foreground, place one large glossy rounded rectangular call-to-action button in bright cyan with subtle gradient, bevel, and shadow, containing bold white Japanese text: {argument name="button text" default="今すぐ無料で対戦"}. Show exactly 3 smartphone mockups arranged around the center: 1 on the lower left, tilted slightly right, showing a leaderboard app screen with a line graph at the top, small profile avatars, ranking rows, and Japanese UI labels; 1 large phone on the lower right, tilted slightly left, showing a multiple-choice quiz screen with Japanese question text and radio-button answers plus a cyan bottom button; 1 smaller phone on the far right edge, angled inward, showing a darker dashboard-style screen with charts and Japanese text. Add exactly 4 floating UI graphic clusters in the background: 1 analytics line-chart panel near the upper left, 1 holographic cube/dashboard cluster near the upper right, 1 glowing wireframe brain or neural sphere near the lower left-center behind the button, and 1 hexagon chart/card element near the right-center. Use a sleek AI, SaaS, and edtech marketing aesthetic, high contrast, crisp typography, layered depth, neon glow accents, and premium app-promo lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张精美的日文科技广告横幅，用于移动应用，比例为 16:9 宽屏。背景采用充满未来感的蓝紫色渐变，布满发光的网络线条、连接节点、柔和的镜头光晕以及细腻的数字粒子。在顶部中心放置一个现代感应用 Logo：一个青色六边形图标，内部包含大号白色字母“SC”及一个小巧的电路符号，随后是品牌文字“SKILL Cert by AI”，采用简洁的无衬线字体，“SKILL”字号较大且为黑色，“Cert”位于其下方且为黑色，“by AI”字号较小且为青色。构图中心放置一行醒目的日文大标题，采用超大白色字体，带有深蓝色描边和柔和的投影：{argument name="headline text" default="AI 出题的资格认证对战应用"}。紧接着在下方添加第二行中等大小的白色日文副标题，同样带有描边和投影：{argument name="subheadline text" default="200 多种资格认证在线对战"}。在前景中间放置一个大型光泽圆角矩形行动号召（CTA）按钮，采用亮青色，带有细腻的渐变、斜面和阴影效果，内含醒目的白色日文文字：{argument name="button text" default="立即免费对战"}。展示 3 台智能手机样机，环绕中心排列：1 台位于左下方，略微向右倾斜，显示排行榜应用界面，顶部有折线图、小型个人资料头像、排名列表及日文 UI 标签；1 台较大的手机位于右下方，略微向左倾斜，显示多项选择题界面，包含日文题目文本、单选按钮以及底部的青色按钮；1 台较小的手机位于最右侧边缘，向内倾斜，显示深色仪表盘风格界面，包含图表和日文文本。在背景中添加 4 组悬浮的 UI 图形元素：左上方放置一个分析折线图面板，右上方放置一个全息立方体/仪表盘集群，左下方按钮后方放置一个发光的线框大脑或神经球体，右侧中心放置一个六边形图表/卡片元素。采用时尚的 AI、SaaS 和教育科技营销美学，强调高对比度、清晰的排版、层次感、霓虹光效以及高级的应用推广照明效果。

templates.title: Weathered Custom Cub Concept Bike

titleLocalized.zh: 风化定制版 Cub 概念摩托车

templates.prompt: A highly detailed concept illustration of a customized vintage step-through motorcycle inspired by a Honda Super Cub, shown in a clean studio-like three-quarter left side view on a plain light gray background. The bike has a rugged post-apocalyptic street-build aesthetic with a black, white, and muted gray color scheme accented by small pink stickers and decals. Emphasize heavy weathering: chipped paint, scratches, oil stains, grime, rust flecks, ink splatter, worn edges, and layered sticker residue across the entire body. The front has 1 square headlight with an X-shaped light pattern and 2 smaller stacked auxiliary lights beneath it. Use spoked wheels, thick all-terrain tires, visible front suspension, exposed mechanical detail, chain drive, and a sturdy center stand touching the ground. The leg shield and side panels are covered in graphic decals, Japanese-style warning labels, numbers, symbols, and distressed typography, including a bold large kanji mark on the front fairing. Add 2 hard side cargo boxes on the rear, one larger box on the far side and 1 nearer black box with extra stickers, plus 1 hanging vertical tag charm attached near the rear case. Include 1 long black ribbed seat, rear rack framing, exposed wiring, metal brackets, bolts, and compact utility accessories that make it feel hand-modified and functional. Render it like an industrial design sketch mixed with polished anime mech concept art: precise linework, watercolor wash shadows, soft gray ground shadow, high-detail mechanical realism, slightly messy inked edges, and a collectible custom-bike illustration feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的概念插图，展示了一辆受 Honda Super Cub 启发、经过深度改装的复古弯梁摩托车，采用干净的摄影棚风格，呈现左侧 4/3 视角，背景为纯浅灰色。这辆摩托车具有粗犷的后启示录街头改装美学，采用黑、白、灰的低饱和度配色，并点缀有少量粉色贴纸和涂装。重点强调强烈的风化效果：车身各处布满掉漆、划痕、油渍、污垢、锈斑、墨迹飞溅、边缘磨损以及层叠的贴纸残胶。车头配有 1 个方形大灯（带 X 型灯光图案）以及下方 2 个较小的堆叠式辅助灯。使用辐条轮毂、厚实的越野轮胎、可见的前悬挂、裸露的机械细节、链条传动，以及一个触地的坚固中心支架。腿部护板和侧板上覆盖着图形贴纸、日式警告标签、数字、符号和做旧的字体，前整流罩上有一个醒目的大号汉字标记。后部加装 2 个硬质侧边货箱，远侧为一个较大的货箱，近侧为一个贴有额外贴纸的黑色货箱，后箱附近还挂着 1 个垂直的吊牌挂饰。配备 1 个长条黑色条纹坐垫、后货架框架、裸露的线路、金属支架、螺栓以及紧凑的实用配件，使其看起来既有手工改装感又具备实用功能。渲染风格融合了工业设计草图与精致的动漫机甲概念艺术：精准的线条、水彩渲染的阴影、柔和的灰色地面投影、高细节的机械写实感、略显凌乱的墨线边缘，以及一种收藏级定制摩托车插画的质感。

templates.title: Medieval Shot Reverse Shot

titleLocalized.zh: 中世纪正反打镜头

templates.prompt: A cinematic medieval shot-reverse-shot pair presented as a gritty historical film still in an ultrawide 21:9 aspect ratio, overcast natural light, muted earth tones, damp autumn atmosphere, realistic muddy textures, shallow depth of field, and strong foreground shoulder framing. Set the scene on a rutted muddy country road running through a rural valley with rough wooden wattle fences on both sides, low rolling hills covered with sparse trees in the distance, open fields, and a small pale stone farmhouse or chapel on the far right hillside. The two characters face each other on the road. One is a weary medieval peasant man in a dirty brown tunic and cap, average build, carrying a wood-handled axe resting on his shoulder with a leather strap across his chest. The other is a knight or armed traveler in dark weathered chainmail and a worn hooded surcoat, standing still with a guarded posture. Create this as a grammar-of-cinema countershot demonstration: first frame shows the {argument name="foreground character" default="peasant man with axe"} from behind in the right foreground, his shoulder and back occupying the near right side of the frame, while the {argument name="background character" default="knight in chainmail"} stands full figure in the left midground facing camera on the muddy road; second frame reverses the angle and shows the knight’s shoulder and hooded back blurred in the left foreground while the peasant stands in the right midground holding the axe on his shoulder. Keep both shots consistent in location, weather, costume continuity, lens feel, and character spacing, with subdued dramatic realism and a tense conversational standoff.

promptLocalized.zh: 一组电影级的中世纪正反打镜头，呈现为具有颗粒感的历史电影剧照，采用 21:9 超宽画幅，阴天自然光，柔和的大地色调，潮湿的秋季氛围，逼真的泥泞质感，浅景深，以及强烈的过肩构图。场景设定在一条穿越乡村山谷的泥泞乡间小路上，两侧有粗糙的木制篱笆，远处是覆盖着稀疏树木的低矮连绵丘陵、开阔的田野，以及右侧远方山坡上的一座浅色石制农舍或教堂。两个角色在路上相对而立。其中一人是疲惫的中世纪农民，身穿脏兮兮的棕色束腰外衣和帽子，身材中等，肩上扛着一把木柄斧头，胸前斜跨着皮带。另一人是身穿深色风化锁子甲和破旧连帽罩衫的骑士或武装旅人，姿态戒备地站着。请将其制作成电影语法中的反打镜头演示：第一帧展示 {argument name="foreground character" default="扛斧头的农民"} 从右侧前景的背面视角，他的肩膀和背部占据了画面右侧近景，而 {argument name="background character" default="穿锁子甲的骑士"} 则在左侧中景全身出镜，面向镜头站在泥泞的道路上；第二帧反转角度，展示骑士的肩膀和连帽背影在左侧前景虚化，而农民站在右侧中景，肩扛斧头。保持两个镜头在地点、天气、服装连贯性、镜头质感和角色间距上的一致性，呈现出克制的戏剧写实感和紧张的对峙氛围。

templates.title: Anime Sakura Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花动漫电影海报

templates.prompt: A polished Japanese animated film poster in a soft, luminous springtime anime style. The main scene shows 2 teenage schoolgirls walking hand in hand down a quiet residential street lined with blooming cherry blossom trees. They wear matching Japanese sailor school uniforms: white long-sleeve blouses with navy sailor collars, pale blue neckerchiefs, and dark navy pleated skirts, each carrying a navy school bag. The girl on the left has dark hair tied in a low side bun with loose strands and a small pink cherry blossom hairpin; she turns toward the other girl with a tender, slightly wistful expression. The girl on the right has long straight dark hair and looks back at her softly. Pink sakura petals drift through warm late-afternoon backlight, creating a romantic, emotional atmosphere with glowing rim light, gentle lens bloom, and painterly detail. Along the left edge, add a vertical collage of 7 inset memory scenes from the story: 1) two children together in a nostalgic childhood moment, 2) a close portrait of the long-haired girl, 3) the two characters standing apart in a tense or reflective moment, 4) an indoor conversation scene with 3 people, 5) a close profile of the bun-haired girl, 6) an intimate almost-kiss close-up of the two leads, 7) a rear view of the two girls walking together beneath cherry blossoms. At the top, include the Japanese tagline: 「変わってしまった朝、変わらなかった想い。」 Across the lower center, place the large glowing handwritten title {argument name="title text" default="Story of U"} in elegant pink neon script. Beneath it, add small Japanese subtitle text and a release line reading {argument name="release text" default="2027年春公開"}. At the very bottom, add dense small white Japanese credits in authentic movie-poster layout. Overall mood: bittersweet yuri coming-of-age drama, cinematic key visual, emotionally resonant, highly detailed, pastel pink and navy palette, vertical poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日本动画电影海报，采用柔和、明亮的春日动漫风格。主画面展示了 2 名十几岁的女高中生手牵手走在种满樱花树的宁静住宅街道上。她们穿着配套的日本水手校服：白色长袖衬衫搭配海军蓝水手领、浅蓝色领巾和深蓝色百褶裙，每人背着一个海军蓝书包。左侧的女孩留着深色头发，扎成低侧发髻，留有几缕碎发，别着一枚小巧的粉色樱花发夹；她转头看向另一个女孩，表情温柔而略带忧伤。右侧的女孩留着黑色长直发，温柔地回望着她。粉色的樱花花瓣在温暖的午后逆光中飘落，营造出浪漫、感性的氛围，并带有发光的边缘光、柔和的镜头光晕和绘画般的细节。在左侧边缘，添加一个垂直拼贴画，包含 7 个来自故事的插图记忆场景：1) 两个孩子在一起的怀旧童年瞬间，2) 长发女孩的近景肖像，3) 两个角色在紧张或沉思时刻分开站立，4) 3 个人的室内谈话场景，5) 扎发髻女孩的侧脸近景，6) 两位主角近乎接吻的亲密特写，7) 两个女孩在樱花树下并肩行走的背影。在顶部，加入日语标语：「変わってしまった朝、変わらなかった想い。」在下方中心位置，放置优雅的粉色霓虹手写体大标题 {argument name="title text" default="Story of U"}。在其下方，添加小号日语副标题和一行上映信息 {argument name="release text" default="2027年春公开"}。在最底部，以正宗的电影海报排版添加密集的白色小号日语演职员表。整体基调：苦乐参半的百合成长剧，电影级主视觉，情感共鸣，高度细节化，粉彩与海军蓝配色，垂直海报构图。

templates.title: Dramatic Cricket Signing Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 震撼板球签约海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic sports poster featuring a waist-up portrait of a male cricket player in a royal blue Delhi Capitals jersey, facing slightly left in a strong three-quarter pose. His face is obscured by a large soft-edged vertical rectangular blur centered over the face, creating an anonymized reveal effect. Behind his head is a bright glowing white circular halo, centered like a spotlight or moon. The background is dark navy and black with electric blue flame-like textures rising on both sides, overlaid with rough chalk-style scribbles, arrows, circles, and large hand-drawn letters for a gritty urban sports aesthetic. The jersey has red-orange collar and placket accents, a white Puma logo on the right chest and sleeve, a Delhi Capitals crest on the left chest, a red circular Jio patch on the sleeve, a rectangular ALL SEASONS sponsor patch on the chest, and large Hero branding across the torso. Add realistic fabric texture, sweat sheen, grain, dust, scratches, and distressed poster wear. At the bottom, place elegant white handwritten script reading Welcome to Dilli above very large bold cracked white block letters reading {argument name="player name" default="REHAN AHMED"}. Use high contrast lighting, moody shadows, centered composition, and a premium IPL team announcement poster style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在米白色摄影棚背景下的简洁编辑类杂志封面，设计风格如同高端汽车插画杂志。顶部的主标题为巨大的蓝色压缩无衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="magazine title" default="AUTO ICON"}，下方配有小型副标题“THE ILLUSTRATED AUTOMOBILE MAGAZINE”。在右上角，放置小型蓝色期号文本 {argument name="issue date" default="May 2026"}，其下方是一行带有细下划线的蓝色大号数字“No.128”。画面中心是一辆精美的经典 {argument name="car model" default="红色蓝旗亚 Stratos"} 插画，采用左侧前 45 度视角，车身低矮呈楔形，亮红色漆面，黑色车顶扰流板，弹出式大灯开启，引擎盖上有精细的通风口，黑色格栅，金色轮毂，逼真的轮胎，地面上有细腻的倒影和阴影。在汽车右侧站着一位身材苗条的动漫风格 {argument name="companion character" default="蓝发少女"}，全身像，面向左侧的汽车，留着柔和的蓝色短波波头，后脑勺扎着一小束头发，面部细节简约，身穿白色长袖上衣、浅蓝色短裙、白色短袜、蓝色运动鞋，背着蓝色单肩包，姿态随性，一只手臂弯曲靠近胸前。采用柔和的赛璐璐动漫插画与写实汽车渲染相结合的精致风格，保留大量留白，并保持优雅的印刷排版平衡。在左侧添加两行巨大的红色日文封面文字 {argument name="main cover line" default="赤いランチア・ストラトス"}，下方配有一行较小的蓝色日文副标题“伝説のラリーカーを、イラストで楽しむ。”。添加另一行蓝色小字“特集 / CLASSIC SPORTS”，以及一行手写风格的浅红色备注“with blue-haired girl”。在左下角，包含两块小型日文封面文案和一个带有微小期号数字的逼真条形码。整体美学保持极简、精致、通透且具有海报感，带有柔和的日光阴影和高端日系杂志封面的构图。

templates.title: Mobster Cats Playing Poker

titleLocalized.zh: 黑帮猫咪打扑克

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-detailed noir-style scene of 7 anthropomorphic domestic cats gathered around a round green felt poker table in a dim, smoky backroom bar. The central cat is the boss: a serious tabby wearing a dark pinstripe suit, white shirt, tie, black fedora, and black sunglasses, calmly smoking a thick cigar with dramatic smoke curling upward into the overhead lamp. Around him sit 6 other cats, each holding playing cards and dressed like underworld gamblers: on the far left a gray tabby in a textured flat cap and round dark sunglasses; next a ginger cat in a dark fedora, chunky gold chain, and dark glasses; to the right of center a fluffy gray cat in a brown fedora; further right a white-and-tabby cat in a dark New York Yankees baseball cap and pendant necklace; in the near right foreground a striped cat in a fedora and sunglasses seen in profile; all styled as mobsters. The table is crowded with exact poker details: 7 cats total, each with cards in paw, multiple stacks of red, blue, white, and black poker chips, scattered US dollar bills, a short whiskey glass in the front right, and 5 community cards face up in the middle. Use warm amber overhead lighting from a single large hanging lamp, deep shadows, richly textured fur, realistic whiskers, reflective sunglasses, and dense atmospheric cigar smoke. Background should be a dark wood-paneled gambling den with framed vintage posters and signs including a large poker poster on the left and an "ALL IN OR FOLD" sign on the right, plus bottles on shelves. Composition is eye-level and slightly wide-angle, centered on the smoking cat, with a gritty, luxurious gangster mood, photorealistic, dramatic depth, high contrast, and filmic color grading.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级、超细节的黑色电影风格场景，7 只拟人化的家猫围坐在圆形的绿色毛毡扑克桌旁，身处昏暗且烟雾缭绕的地下酒吧。中间的猫是老大：一只表情严肃的虎斑猫，身穿深色细条纹西装、白衬衫、系着领带，戴着黑色软呢帽和黑色墨镜，正从容地抽着一支粗雪茄，戏剧性的烟雾向上缭绕至头顶的灯具。周围坐着另外 6 只猫，它们都手持扑克牌，打扮得像黑社会赌徒：最左边是一只戴着质感鸭舌帽和圆形墨镜的灰虎斑猫；旁边是一只戴着深色软呢帽、粗金链和墨镜的姜黄色猫；中心右侧是一只戴着棕色软呢帽的毛茸茸灰猫；再往右是一只戴着深色纽约洋基队棒球帽和吊坠项链的白虎斑猫；右前方近处是一只戴着软呢帽和墨镜的侧身条纹猫；所有猫都呈现出黑帮造型。桌上堆满了精确的扑克细节：总共 7 只猫，每只猫爪中都拿着牌，桌上有成堆的红、蓝、白、黑筹码，散落的美元钞票，右前方放着一个威士忌酒杯，中间面朝上摆放着 5 张公共牌。使用来自上方单盏大吊灯的温暖琥珀色灯光，营造出深邃的阴影、质感丰富的毛发、逼真的胡须、反光的墨镜以及浓郁的雪茄烟雾氛围。背景应为一个深色木镶板的赌博窝点，墙上挂着复古海报和标志，包括左侧的一张大型扑克海报和右侧写有“ALL IN OR FOLD”的标牌，架子上还摆放着酒瓶。构图为平视视角且略带广角，以抽雪茄的猫为中心，营造出粗粝而奢华的黑帮氛围，具有照片级真实感、戏剧性的景深、高对比度以及电影级的色彩分级。

templates.title: Retro Super Famicom RPG Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 复古 Super Famicom RPG 广告

templates.prompt: Create a full-page vintage Japanese Super Famicom game box advertisement designed like a worn 1990s magazine spread or game package front, on aged yellowed paper with creases, stains, frayed corners, fold marks, and slight print fading. The layout should feel authentically retro and densely composed, with bold Japanese promotional copy, a fake fantasy RPG logo, a character lineup on the right, a gameplay screenshot on the left, and pricing and feature callouts near the bottom. At the top left, place a large black “SUPER FAMICOM” header with smaller Japanese subtitle text beneath it, and nearby a red Japanese slogan line. At the top right, include a small Super Famicom style logo badge in a black rectangle with the English text “SUPER FAMICOM LICENSED BY NINTENDO” underneath. In the upper center, feature the game title logo “Epic 7 Seven” in ornate fantasy typography, dark teal and black, layered over a circular magical crest or sigil in pale blue. Under the logo, add small Japanese katakana subtitle text. On the right half, show 4 anime fantasy party members in a polished JRPG promotional illustration style: 1 white-haired young male hero in a white cloak and blue-black outfit holding a sword, 1 pink-haired female knight or mage in dark armor with gold trim, 1 tall long-black-haired swordsman in dark layered robes, and 1 blonde twin-tailed maid girl in a black-and-white frilled dress reaching one hand forward. Their faces should be generic and soft-featured, front-facing or three-quarter view, grouped in a heroic composition. Add 4 dark blue nameplates with Japanese character names and short class descriptions near each character. Place a tall vertical yellow Japanese slogan with black outline between the screenshot and the character group. On the left lower-middle, include 1 in-game battle screenshot framed in a dark blue rounded rectangle: a pixel-art dungeon battle scene showing 1 purple dragon monster facing a 4-character party in a stone corridor. At the bottom of the battle screen, show a classic RPG interface with 4 command options in Japanese and a party status list with character names, HP, and MP values. In the lower left, add a red Japanese headline followed by 4 black square bullet points of Japanese feature text. Near the bottom center, place a red circular burst sticker with white Japanese text indicating strong sales, beside a large printed price reading “9,800円” with smaller surrounding Japanese retail text. At the bottom right, include 1 yellow information box labeled “RPG” with additional Japanese text and a separate dark box below for player count reading “1人”. Use a muted retro print palette of cream, dark blue, teal, red, gold, black, and faded pastel character colors. The whole image should resemble a highly convincing fictional Super Famicom advertisement for a classic fantasy RPG titled {argument name="game title" default="Epic 7 Seven"}, with visible Japanese text, nostalgic print imperfections, and authentic 1990s console game marketing design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全页复古日本 Super Famicom 游戏盒广告，设计风格如同 1990 年代磨损的杂志内页或游戏包装正面，呈现于带有折痕、污渍、磨损边角、折叠痕迹及轻微印刷褪色的泛黄纸张上。排版应具有真实的复古感且布局紧凑，包含醒目的日文宣传文案、虚构的奇幻 RPG 标志、右侧的角色阵容、左侧的游戏截图，以及底部的价格和功能标注。左上角放置一个巨大的黑色“SUPER FAMICOM”标题，下方配有较小的日文副标题，附近有一行红色的日文标语。右上角包含一个黑色矩形内的 Super Famicom 风格标志徽章，下方附有英文文本“SUPER FAMICOM LICENSED BY NINTENDO”。顶部中央展示游戏标题标志“Epic 7 Seven”，采用华丽的奇幻字体，深青色与黑色，叠加在浅蓝色的圆形魔法纹章或印记之上。标志下方添加小号日文片假名副标题。右半部分展示 4 位动漫奇幻风格的队伍成员，采用精致的 JRPG 宣传插画风格：1 位身穿白色斗篷和蓝黑色服装、手持长剑的白发年轻男性英雄；1 位身穿带有金色饰边的深色盔甲的粉发女性骑士或法师；1 位身穿深色多层长袍的高个子黑长直剑士；以及 1 位身穿黑白荷叶边裙、单手向前伸出的金发双马尾女仆。他们的面部应为大众化且柔和的特征，正面或四分之三侧面视角，以英雄姿态构图。在每位角色附近添加 4 个深蓝色铭牌，标注日文角色名和简短的职业描述。在截图和角色组之间放置一条带有黑色轮廓的竖向黄色日文标语。左侧中下部包含 1 张深蓝色圆角矩形框内的游戏内战斗截图：一个像素风地下城战斗场景，展示 1 只紫色巨龙怪物面对 4 人小队，背景为石质走廊。在战斗画面底部，显示经典的 RPG 界面，包含 4 个日文指令选项以及带有角色名、HP 和 MP 值的队伍状态列表。左下角添加一个红色日文标题，后跟 4 个黑色方块项目符号的日文功能文本。底部中央放置一个带有白色日文文本的红色圆形促销贴纸，表示销量火爆，旁边印有醒目的“9,800円”价格，周围环绕较小的日文零售文本。右下角包含 1 个标有“RPG”的黄色信息框，内含额外的日文文本，下方是一个标有玩家人数“1人”的独立深色框。使用奶油色、深蓝色、青色、红色、金色、黑色以及褪色的柔和角色色彩等复古印刷色调。整张图像应看起来像是一张极具说服力的虚构 Super Famicom 广告，宣传名为 {argument name="game title" default="Epic 7 Seven"} 的经典奇幻 RPG，包含可见的日文文本、怀旧的印刷瑕疵以及地道的 1990 年代主机游戏营销设计。

templates.title: Vintage Roaring Tiger Japanese Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古咆哮猛虎日式海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold vintage Japanese-inspired poster on a square canvas with a fierce front-facing tiger head as the single central subject, perfectly symmetrical and filling most of the frame. The tiger is roaring with its mouth wide open, showing long curved ivory fangs, smaller lower teeth, a vivid pink tongue, a dark throat, a pink nose, intense yellow eyes, and dramatic black stripes over saturated orange fur with white cheek and neck fur. Add ornamental swirling stripe patterns on the forehead to give the face a stylized mythic look. Use a gritty retro screenprint or risograph texture with visible grain, worn ink, slightly distressed edges, and a limited palette of burnt orange, black, cream, white, muted pink, and small accents of yellow. The background should be a flat textured orange-red field. In the top right, include 1 small technical diagram panel showing a side-view tiger skeleton in thin cream line art with compact vertical Japanese annotation text beneath and beside it, like a pseudo-scientific label block. In the bottom left, include 3 vertically stacked icon boxes with thin cream borders: the first contains a heart icon with the label 心, the second contains crossed bones with the label 力, and the third contains three claw marks with the label 本能. Across the bottom center, place 2 very large cream-colored Japanese kanji characters with heavy black drop shadows and a rough hand-cut block print feel: 猛獣. Keep the overall composition aggressive, iconic, poster-like, centered, and highly graphic, blending traditional Japanese poster aesthetics, tattoo flash energy, and vintage animal anatomy chart styling.

promptLocalized.zh: 在方形画布上创作一张大胆的复古日式风格海报，以凶猛的正面虎头作为唯一的中心主体，构图完全对称并占据大部分画面。老虎张大嘴巴咆哮，露出长而弯曲的象牙獠牙、较小的下齿、鲜艳的粉色舌头、深色的喉咙、粉色的鼻子、锐利的黄色眼睛，以及饱和的橙色皮毛上覆盖着戏剧性的黑色条纹，脸颊和颈部带有白色绒毛。在额头上添加装饰性的漩涡条纹图案，使虎脸呈现出风格化的神话感。使用带有明显颗粒感、磨损墨迹、边缘轻微破损的粗糙复古丝网印刷或孔版印刷纹理，并采用由焦橙色、黑色、奶油色、白色、柔和粉色及少量黄色点缀组成的有限色调。背景应为平整的橙红色纹理底色。在右上角，包含 1 个小型技术图解面板，展示侧视图的老虎骨骼，采用纤细的奶油色线条绘制，下方和侧面配有紧凑的垂直日文注释文本，如同伪科学标签块。在左下角，包含 3 个垂直堆叠的图标框，带有纤细的奶油色边框：第一个包含心形图标及标签“心”，第二个包含交叉骨头图标及标签“力”，第三个包含三道爪痕图标及标签“本能”。在底部中心，放置 2 个非常大的奶油色日文汉字，带有厚重的黑色投影和粗犷的手工木刻版画质感：猛獣。保持整体构图具有侵略性、标志性、海报感、居中且高度图形化，融合了传统的日式海报美学、纹身闪图能量以及复古动物解剖图风格。

templates.title: Open Notebook with French Handwritten Plans

titleLocalized.zh: 打开的笔记本，内含法文手写计划

templates.prompt: A realistic overhead lifestyle photo of an open lined notebook lying on a dark wooden desk, shot in soft natural indoor light with warm neutral tones. The notebook fills most of the frame and is centered vertically, opened to two pages with neat black handwritten French notes, casual rounded handwriting, slight imperfections, a few doodles, and some crossed-out lines. Show a black ribbon bookmark hanging from the bottom center of the notebook. Include a partial stack of pale books or paper at the top left edge and a partial white mug entering from the top right corner. The pages should look cream-colored with faint horizontal ruling and a subtle center crease. On the left page, write the underlined heading "Plan articles blog" near the top, followed by exactly 6 bullet items: "Écris intro + pourquoi j’ai lancé le blog", "10 idées reçues sur le minimalisme" with the number 10 circled, "Ma routine du matin (version réaliste)", "Témoignages / retours lecteurs", "Outils que j’utilise au quotidien", and one crossed-out line reading "bons plans (liens affiliés)". Lower on the left page, add the underlined subheading "Idées à creuser :" followed by exactly 3 bullet items: "article sur les achats impulsifs", "parler d’argent sans tabou" with a small star doodle nearby, and "digital declutter : par où commencer ?", plus one additional fully crossed-out handwritten line beneath them. At the bottom left, draw a large cloud-shaped outline containing the text "Objectif : publier 2x/mois et rester authentique !" and add a small heart doodle near the lower right corner of the left page. On the right page, write the underlined heading "Routine matin idéale" at the top, then exactly 6 schedule lines: "6h30 : réveil (sans tel !!)", "6h40 : eau citron + respiration", "6h50 : 10 min de lecture", "7h05 : écriture / gratitude", "7h20 : sport / yoga / marche", "7h45 : douche + préparation", and then "8h15 : focus boulot" lower down with a hand-drawn star doodle to its right. Beneath that, add the underlined subheading "Pensées du jour :" and the quote across 3 lines: "La discipline, c’est choisir entre", "ce que tu veux maintenant et", "ce que tu veux vraiment.", with a small heart doodle below. At the bottom right, add the underlined subheading "À ne pas oublier :" followed by exactly 3 bullet items: "appeler la banque", "prendre rdv médecin", and a crossed-out "annuler abo salle (trop cher)". Keep the composition clean, minimal, and believable, like an authentic productivity journal or blog planning notebook photographed casually from above.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的俯视生活方式照片，展示了一本打开的横线笔记本平放在深色木质桌面上，在柔和的室内自然光下拍摄，色调温暖中性。笔记本占据了画面的大部分空间并垂直居中，翻开的两页上写着整齐的黑色法文手写笔记，字迹圆润随性，带有轻微的瑕疵、少量涂鸦和几行划掉的文字。笔记本底部中央垂下一条黑色丝带书签。左上角边缘可见一叠书或纸张的局部，右上角可见一个白色马克杯的局部。页面应呈现奶油色，带有淡淡的横线和微妙的中缝折痕。在左页顶部附近写下带下划线的标题“Plan articles blog”，随后列出 6 个项目符号： “Écris intro + pourquoi j’ai lancé le blog”、“10 idées reçues sur le minimalisme”（数字 10 需圈出）、“Ma routine du matin (version réaliste)”、“Témoignages / retours lecteurs”、“Outils que j’utilise au quotidien”以及一行划掉的文字“bons plans (liens affiliés)”。在左页下方，添加带下划线的副标题“Idées à creuser :”，随后列出 3 个项目符号：“article sur les achats impulsifs”、“parler d’argent sans tabou”（旁边画一个小星星涂鸦）以及“digital declutter : par où commencer ?”，并在下方额外添加一行完全划掉的手写文字。在左下角，画一个大的云朵状轮廓，内含文字“Objectif : publier 2x/mois et rester authentique !”，并在左页右下角附近画一个小爱心涂鸦。在右页顶部写下带下划线的标题“Routine matin idéale”，然后列出 6 行时间表：“6h30 : réveil (sans tel !!)”、“6h40 : eau citron + respiration”、“6h50 : 10 min de lecture”、“7h05 : écriture / gratitude”、“7h20 : sport / yoga / marche”、“7h45 : douche + préparation”，并在下方写上“8h15 : focus boulot”，右侧配有一个手绘星星涂鸦。在此下方，添加带下划线的副标题“Pensées du jour :”，并分 3 行写下引语：“La discipline, c’est choisir entre”、“ce que tu veux maintenant et”、“ce que tu veux vraiment.”，下方画一个小爱心涂鸦。在右下角，添加带下划线的副标题“À ne pas oublier :”，随后列出 3 个项目符号：“appeler la banque”、“prendre rdv médecin”以及一行划掉的“annuler abo salle (trop cher)”。保持构图简洁、极简且真实，如同从上方随意拍摄的真实生产力日记或博客规划笔记本。

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant tropical commercial poster for a citrus soda bottle, in a bright summer advertising style. Show a single large plastic bottle of {argument name="product name" default="Soda"} centered slightly to the right, tilted a little left, with a yellow cap and transparent bottle covered in cold condensation droplets, filled with glowing golden-orange soda. The label should feature sliced oranges and citrus artwork with the brand text "{argument name="product name" default="Soda"}", the phrase "aux agrumes d'été", and a small green "500 ml" mark. Use a sunny beach background with vivid blue sky, turquoise ocean, soft clouds, and blurred tropical palm leaves entering from the upper right corner. Add dramatic water splashes around the base of the bottle, scattered clear ice cubes, and 5 visible citrus pieces in the foreground: 2 orange wedges, 1 lime half, 1 grapefruit half, and 1 partial orange slice at the far right edge. Place large French promotional text on the left: a huge white headline "{argument name="headline text" default="Soda"}" with a small splash accent above it, then yellow script text "aux agrumes d'été" underneath. Add a yellow paint-stroke badge at mid-left with the text "LA FRAÎCHEUR QUI PÉTILLE !". Add a vertical feature list on the lower left with 3 round icons and French captions: "SAVEURS NATURELLES", "SANS COLORANTS ARTIFICIELS", and "EXTRA RAFRAÎCHISSANT". Add a green brushstroke banner at the bottom left reading "FORMAT PRATIQUE 500 ml". Add a round beige eco-style seal at the bottom right with green outline and leaf motif, containing the text "{argument name="seal text" default="PLAISIR FRUITÉ À CHAQUE GORGÉE"}". Lighting should be glossy and high-energy with strong sun flare from the upper left, saturated citrus colors, crisp packaging detail, realistic droplets, and polished supermarket-ad realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的热带商业海报，展示一瓶柑橘汽水，采用明亮的夏季广告风格。将一瓶 {argument name="product name" default="Soda"} 塑料瓶置于画面中心偏右位置，略微向左倾斜；瓶盖为黄色，透明瓶身上覆盖着冰冷的凝结水珠，瓶内装满闪耀的金橙色汽水。标签上应印有橙子切片和柑橘图案，并带有品牌文字 "{argument name="product name" default="Soda"}"、短语 "aux agrumes d'été" 以及一个绿色的小型 "500 ml" 标志。背景使用阳光明媚的海滩，配以湛蓝的天空、绿松石色的海洋、柔和的云朵以及从右上角伸入的模糊热带棕榈叶。在瓶底周围添加富有动感的水花、散落的透明冰块，并在前景放置 5 个清晰可见的柑橘类水果：2 片橙子瓣、1 个青柠半块、1 个葡萄柚半块，以及最右侧边缘的 1 片橙子切片。在左侧放置醒目的法语促销文字：巨大的白色标题 "{argument name="headline text" default="Soda"}"，上方配有一个小水花装饰，下方为黄色的手写体文字 "aux agrumes d'été"。在左中部添加一个黄色笔触徽章，文字为 "LA FRAÎCHEUR QUI PÉTILLE !"。在左下方添加一个垂直的功能列表，包含 3 个圆形图标和法语说明："SAVEURS NATURELLES"、"SANS COLORANTS ARTIFICIELS" 和 "EXTRA RAFRAÎCHISSANT"。在左下角添加一个绿色笔触横幅，文字为 "FORMAT PRATIQUE 500 ml"。在右下角添加一个圆形的米色生态风格印章，带有绿色轮廓和叶子图案，内含文字 "{argument name="seal text" default="PLAISIR FRUITÉ À CHAQUE GORGÉE"}"。光效应呈现出光泽感和高能量，左上方有强烈的太阳光晕，色彩饱和，包装细节清晰，水珠真实，具有精致的超市广告质感。

templates.title: Moonlit Barn Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 月光谷仓时尚人像

templates.prompt: A cinematic photorealistic portrait of a young woman sitting barefoot on a rectangular hay bale inside a rustic wooden barn at night, wearing a flowing mustard-yellow satin maxi dress with thin spaghetti straps, a deep neckline, a small bow-tie knot at the center of the bust, a fitted waist, and a long draped skirt pooling onto the straw-covered floor. She has long wavy auburn-brown hair styled half-up in a loose top knot, with soft strands falling over her shoulders. Her pose is elegant and demure: legs crossed at the ankles and extended forward, one hand resting near her lap, the other hand raised to partially cover her face. Warm golden light from the right side illuminates her skin and dress, creating soft highlights and deep shadows, while cool blue moonlight enters from a small open window on the left. Outside the window, show a bright full moon in a dark blue sky with silhouettes of pine trees. The barn interior is made of dark stained vertical wooden planks with built-in bench ledges along the walls, scattered loose straw on the floor, and 2 visible hay bales, including the one she sits on. Shot full body in a vertical composition, centered slightly right of frame, shallow depth of field, intimate moody atmosphere, high-detail skin and fabric texture, editorial fashion photography, soft cinematic contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感写实人像，描绘了一位年轻女性在夜晚坐在乡村木制谷仓内长方形干草捆上的赤脚形象。她身穿一件飘逸的芥末黄缎面长裙，配有细吊带、深领口，胸前中央饰有小蝴蝶结，修身腰部设计，长长的垂坠裙摆铺散在铺满稻草的地面上。她留着一头波浪状的赤褐色长发，半扎成松散的发髻，几缕发丝柔和地垂在肩头。她的姿势优雅而端庄：双腿在脚踝处交叉并向前伸展，一只手放在膝盖附近，另一只手抬起轻轻遮住脸庞。右侧的温暖金光照亮了她的肌肤与裙装，营造出柔和的高光与深邃的阴影，而左侧一扇小窗透入清冷的蓝色月光。窗外可见深蓝色夜空中的明亮满月，以及松树的剪影。谷仓内部由深色染色垂直木板构成，墙边设有内置长凳，地面散落着零星稻草，可见 2 个干草捆，包括她所坐的那一个。采用全身垂直构图，人物略微偏向画面右侧，浅景深，营造出私密且忧郁的氛围，皮肤与织物纹理细节丰富，编辑级时尚摄影，柔和的电影感对比度。

templates.title: Healthy Nutrition App Logo Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 健康营养类 App 图标矩阵

templates.prompt: A clean presentation grid of 20 modern mobile app logo concepts for nutrition, calorie tracking, healthy eating, food recognition, and AI wellness tools, shown on a vivid electric-blue background with soft studio lighting and subtle shadows. Arrange the icons in 4 rows by 5 columns, evenly spaced, each as a glossy rounded-square app tile with premium iOS-style depth, smooth gradients, glassy highlights, and crisp 3D-rendered detail. The color palette should center on saturated blues, cyan, teal, white, lime green, and small accents of orange and yellow. Include exactly 20 distinct icon designs: 1) a meal bowl with avocado, grains, broccoli, and cherry tomatoes framed by a camera scan bracket, 2) a white fork beside four horizontal nutrition bars in green, yellow, red, and blue on a dark navy tile, 3) a camera lens with a small bowl of vegetables in front, 4) a circular blue badge with the text {argument name="headline text" default="kcal"} and a green leaf overlapping the lower edge, 5) a teal-blue icon with the text {argument name="brand text" default="Ai"} above a white bowl and two sparkles, 6) a glossy green apple with circuit traces and nodes suggesting food-tech AI, 7) a halved avocado centered inside a glowing scan frame, 8) a metallic spoon with a blue lightning bolt symbol and curved tracking lines, 9) a circular segmented nutrition meter in green, orange, and red around salmon and broccoli, 10) a divided plate containing grilled chicken, broccoli, rice, blueberries, and a small ascending analytics bar chart, 11) a camera lens on a white tile with a green leaf attached, 12) a glowing green apple inside a scan bracket with a sparkle, 13) a luminous circular activity ring in blue, green, yellow, and orange on a dark tile, 14) a blue shield with a white fork in the center, 15) a yogurt or oatmeal bowl topped with strawberries, blueberries, and granola inside a scan bracket, 16) a dark navy calorie icon with the text {argument name="calorie text" default="kcal"}, a curved glow, one sparkle, and a tiny bar chart, 17) a mint-green square with a white circuit-tree or branching chip motif, 18) a plated healthy meal with grilled chicken, avocado, tomatoes, and greens inside a scan bracket, 19) a dark bowl of blueberries and white yogurt or cream with a bright electric lightning bolt overlay, 20) a pastel aqua 3D cube icon featuring a fork-and-plate symbol on one face and a green leaf on another. Make the overall style highly polished, slightly futuristic, commercially viable for App Store branding, with consistent visual language across all 20 icons, no extra text beyond the visible short labels, and a premium AI-generated product-design aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个整洁的 20 个现代移动 App 图标概念展示矩阵，涵盖营养、卡路里追踪、健康饮食、食物识别及 AI 健康工具，背景为鲜艳的电光蓝，配有柔和的摄影棚灯光和细腻的阴影。将图标排列为 4 行 5 列，间距均匀，每个图标均为带有高级 iOS 风格深度、平滑渐变、玻璃质感高光及清晰 3D 渲染细节的圆角方形 App 图标。配色方案应以饱和的蓝色、青色、蓝绿色、白色、青柠绿为主，并辅以少量的橙色和黄色。包含 20 个各不相同的图标设计：1) 一个由相机扫描框环绕的餐碗，内含牛油果、谷物、西兰花和圣女果；2) 在深海军蓝底色上，一把白色叉子旁放置四条水平排列的营养条，颜色分别为绿、黄、红、蓝；3) 一个前方带有蔬菜小碗的相机镜头；4) 一个圆形蓝色徽章，带有文本 {argument name="headline text" default="kcal"} 以及一个重叠在底部的绿叶；5) 一个青蓝色图标，在白色餐碗和两个闪光符号上方带有文本 {argument name="brand text" default="Ai"}；6) 一个带有电路轨迹和节点的光泽感青苹果，暗示食物科技 AI；7) 一个位于发光扫描框中心的半个牛油果；8) 一把带有蓝色闪电符号和曲线追踪线的金属勺；9) 一个围绕着三文鱼和西兰花的绿色、橙色、红色圆形分段营养仪表；10) 一个分隔餐盘，内含烤鸡、西兰花、米饭、蓝莓以及一个小型的上升分析柱状图；11) 一个带有绿叶的白色底色相机镜头；12) 一个位于扫描框内并带有闪光符号的发光青苹果；13) 一个深色底色上发光的蓝色、绿色、黄色和橙色圆形活动环；14) 一个中心带有白色叉子的蓝色盾牌；15) 一个位于扫描框内，顶部铺有草莓、蓝莓和格兰诺拉麦片的酸奶或燕麦碗；16) 一个深海军蓝卡路里图标，带有文本 {argument name="calorie text" default="kcal"}、曲线光晕、一个闪光符号和一个微型柱状图；17) 一个带有白色电路树或分支芯片图案的薄荷绿正方形；18) 一个位于扫描框内，包含烤鸡、牛油果、番茄和蔬菜的健康餐盘；19) 一个装有蓝莓和白色酸奶或奶油的深色碗，上方叠加明亮的电光闪电符号；20) 一个淡水蓝色 3D 立方体图标，其中一面带有叉子和盘子符号，另一面带有绿叶。整体风格需高度精致、略带未来感，具备 App Store 品牌推广的商业可行性，确保 20 个图标视觉语言统一，除可见的简短标签外不包含额外文字，并呈现出高级的 AI 生成产品设计美感。

templates.title: Ancient Egyptian Queen with Black Panther

titleLocalized.zh: 古埃及女王与黑豹

templates.prompt: A cinematic ancient Egypt portrait of a glamorous queen-like woman kneeling on warm desert sand beside a large black panther in the courtyard of a sandstone temple. The woman has {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} long wavy hair, medium-brown skin, and wears an ornate Egyptian gold headband with a central turquoise jewel and sun-disc detail, long rectangular gold earrings, a wide layered Egyptian collar in gold and blue, multiple gold armbands and bracelets, and a revealing ivory-and-gold draped outfit with gemstone ornaments, delicate gold chain adornments across the torso, a jeweled belt, and strappy sandals. Her pose is elegant and grounded, one hand resting on the sand, knees folded to one side, body angled slightly toward the viewer. Beside her is 1 sleek black panther with subtle rosette patterning and bright amber eyes, lying sphinx-like in the foreground, calm, regal, and protective. The setting includes 3 massive carved temple columns in the background with hieroglyphic and animal relief details, softly out of focus. Golden-hour sunlight, warm sandstone tones, realistic skin and fabric textures, dramatic yet natural shadows, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, luxurious, mythic atmosphere, centered vertical composition, full-body seated figure with animal companion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影质感的古埃及肖像，描绘了一位魅力十足、女王般的女性，跪在温暖的沙漠沙地上，身旁是一只巨大的黑豹，背景是砂岩神庙的庭院。这位女性拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="乌黑"} 的长波浪卷发，中棕色皮肤，佩戴着华丽的埃及金质头带，头带中央镶嵌着绿松石和太阳圆盘细节，戴着长方形金耳环、宽大的金蓝色叠层埃及领饰、多条金质臂环和手镯，身着露肤的象牙白与金色垂坠服饰，躯干上有精致的金链装饰、镶嵌宝石的腰带以及系带凉鞋。她的姿态优雅而沉稳，一只手撑在沙地上，双膝侧向一旁，身体略微朝向观众。她身旁是一只毛色油亮、带有隐约玫瑰花纹、双眼呈琥珀色的黑豹，它像狮身人面像一样卧在前景中，神态平静、高贵且具有保护性。背景中包括 3 根巨大的雕刻神庙石柱，上面饰有象形文字和动物浮雕，呈现出柔和的虚化效果。黄金时段的阳光，温暖的砂岩色调，逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，戏剧性而自然的阴影，浅景深，超高细节，写实风格，奢华且充满神话氛围，居中垂直构图，全身坐姿人物与动物伙伴。

templates.title: Colossal Labyrinth Woman Monument

titleLocalized.zh: 巨型迷宫女性雕像纪念碑

templates.prompt: A surreal dark-fantasy photorealistic scene of a colossal humanoid statue shaped like a woman standing in a rugged mountain landscape, viewed from a dramatic low angle so the figure towers into the sky. The statue’s body forms a massive bell-shaped dress covered entirely in deep carved labyrinth patterns, like an ancient maze sculpted into weathered stone and concrete, with moss, grime, erosion, and age stains across the surface. At the bottom center of the dress, place 1 arched doorway opening into darkness, with a narrow dirt path leading directly into it, making the statue feel like an inhabitable monument. The figure has 2 visible arms hanging straight down at the sides and a slender neck rising above the structure, with a human head turned slightly to the side; use short dark wavy hair and partially obscured facial detail. Surround the monument with scattered rocks, sparse alpine shrubs, and uneven ground. Add 1 steep rocky mountain peak on the right side in the background. Fill the sky with heavy overcast storm clouds in muted gray tones, creating a moody, ominous atmosphere. Color palette: cold gray, charcoal, stone beige, moss green, subdued earth tones. Lighting should be natural, diffuse, cloudy daylight with soft shadows. Style: ultra-realistic cinematic photography, monumental scale, eerie surreal architecture, ancient labyrinth temple fused with a female statue, highly detailed textures, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个超现实暗黑奇幻风格的写实场景，展现了一座巨大的女性人形雕像，矗立在崎岖的山地景观中。采用极具张力的低角度仰拍，使雕像显得高耸入云。雕像的身体呈现出巨大的钟形裙摆，表面完全覆盖着深雕的迷宫图案，如同在风化的石材和混凝土上雕刻出的古老迷宫，表面布满青苔、污垢、侵蚀痕迹和岁月留下的斑点。在裙摆底部的中心位置，设置 1 个通向黑暗的拱形入口，一条狭窄的泥土小径直通其中，使这座雕像看起来像是一座可居住的纪念碑。雕像双臂自然下垂，细长的颈部从结构上方升起，头部微微侧转；采用短波浪黑发，面部细节部分遮挡。纪念碑周围散布着岩石、稀疏的高山灌木和不平坦的地面。背景右侧添加 1 座陡峭的岩石山峰。天空布满厚重的阴沉风暴云，色调为柔和的灰色，营造出一种忧郁、不祥的氛围。调色板：冷灰色、炭灰色、石米色、苔藓绿、柔和的大地色系。光照应为自然的漫射阴天光线，带有柔和的阴影。风格：超写实电影摄影、宏伟尺度、诡异的超现实建筑、与女性雕像融合的古老迷宫神庙、高度精细的纹理、垂直构图。

templates.title: Dancing Couple on Cliffside House

titleLocalized.zh: 悬崖屋上的舞者夫妇

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical cinematic photograph of a weathered wooden house jutting out from the edge of a steep cliff, with a small balcony suspended over empty space. The house is old and dilapidated, made of gray, sun-bleached planks with warped boards, broken or dark window openings, and fragile angled wooden supports underneath the balcony. Dense green vines and foliage climb the cliff and partially frame the upper left side of the image, while the rock face drops sharply downward through most of the composition. On the balcony stand exactly 2 people: a formally dressed couple posed as if ballroom dancing. The man wears a dark suit or tuxedo and faces the woman with one arm raised in dance position; the woman wears a flowing {argument name="dress color" default="deep red"} evening gown, her hair styled up, and she mirrors his pose. The balcony railing is thin and rustic, emphasizing the dangerous height and precarious setting. The sky is pale blue-gray and overcast, with faint hazy mountains visible in the far lower right background. Use a realistic photographic style, moody natural light, high detail in the aged wood and cliff textures, a sense of vertigo and surreal elegance, and a composition that places the house in the upper left and the couple near the upper right edge of the structure.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖构图电影感照片，展示了一座从陡峭悬崖边缘突出的风化木屋，阳台悬空于虚无之上。房屋古老而破败，由灰色、被阳光晒褪色的木板构成，木板弯曲变形，窗户昏暗或破损，阳台下方支撑着脆弱的倾斜木架。茂密的绿色藤蔓和植被攀附在悬崖上，部分框住了图像的左上角，而岩壁在构图的大部分区域急剧向下延伸。阳台上站着 2 个人：一对身着正装的夫妇，摆出交谊舞的姿势。男子身穿深色西装或燕尾服，面向女子，一只手臂抬起呈舞蹈姿势；女子身穿飘逸的 {argument name="dress color" default="深红色"} 晚礼服，发型盘起，与男子的姿势相呼应。阳台栏杆纤细而粗犷，突显了高度的危险感和不稳定的环境。天空呈灰蓝色，阴云密布，远处的右下方背景中隐约可见朦胧的山脉。采用写实的摄影风格，忧郁的自然光，展现出陈旧木材和悬崖纹理的高细节，营造出一种眩晕感与超现实的优雅，构图将房屋置于左上角，夫妇位于结构右上方边缘附近。

titleLocalized.zh: 神秘赛博哥特拼贴海报

templates.prompt: A dark occult cyber-gothic collage poster in vertical format, dense and layered like a ritualistic noir album cover, with a distressed black, sepia, bronze, and deep crimson palette. Combine analog decay, glitch textures, scanned paper, technical schematics, surveillance graphics, sacred geometry, and fragmented photomontage into one unified composition. On the right side, feature a large aged human skull in profile, highly detailed, weathered, and partially overlaid with circles, target marks, sigils, thin grid lines, and red diagram annotations. Near the upper center, place a mysterious woman with long dark hair and pale skin, wearing a low-cut black garment, posed sensually with one hand raised near her face; behind her head, add a large dim red halo ring. On the left upper quadrant, include the draped back or shoulder of a pale classical-statue-like figure, ghostly and fragmentary. In the lower middle-right, place a dark-skinned ritual figure or priestess wearing layered beads, necklaces, and ceremonial adornment, partially obscured by texture and collage interference. In the lower right, show one worn cloth doll or voodoo-style rag figure hanging or suspended, with visible seams and outstretched limbs. In the bottom center, depict a rainy night street scene with 1 lone trench-coated figure walking away under dim lights and 1 car parked or idling on the wet road, reflections glowing red on the pavement. In the lower left, add a faceted black pyramid or crystal-like geometric form emerging from darkness. Scatter exactly 7 visible Latin text blocks throughout the design, styled as aged serif typography and cryptic inscriptions: "IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.", "ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.", "PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA", "EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.", "III FRAGMENTUM INFINITUM.", "COR AMAT; MENS DUBITAT; ANIMA LACERATUR.", and "IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO". Add small UI-like microtext, barcode fragments, tiny charts, occult emblems, crosshair symbols, and illegible data panels across the entire image. The composition should feel oppressive, esoteric, cinematic, and surreal, with heavy texture, layered transparency, subtle red accents, chiaroscuro lighting, and a premium dark-art poster finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深色神秘赛博哥特风格的竖版拼贴海报，如同仪式感十足的黑色电影专辑封面般密集且富有层次感，采用做旧的黑色、棕褐色、青铜色和深红色调。将模拟衰变、故障纹理、扫描纸张、技术示意图、监控图形、神圣几何和碎片化照片蒙太奇融为一体。在右侧，展示一个大型且高度精细的侧面陈旧人类头骨，经过风化处理，并部分覆盖着圆圈、目标标记、符文、细网格线和红色图表注释。在上方中央附近，放置一位留着深色长发、皮肤苍白的神秘女性，身穿低胸黑色服装，姿态性感，一只手抬起靠近脸部；在她脑后添加一个巨大的暗红色光环。在左上象限，包含一个苍白的古典雕像般人物的背部或肩部，呈现出幽灵般的碎片感。在右下中部，放置一个深色皮肤的仪式人物或女祭司，佩戴着层叠的珠子、项链和仪式装饰，部分被纹理和拼贴干扰所遮盖。在右下角，展示一个破旧的布娃娃或巫毒风格的破布人偶，呈现悬挂状态，可见明显的接缝和伸展的肢体。在底部中央，描绘一个雨夜街道场景，有 1 个孤独的穿风衣人物在昏暗的灯光下走远，另有 1 辆汽车停在或停滞在湿漉漉的道路上，路面反射着红色的光芒。在左下角，添加一个从黑暗中浮现的多面黑色金字塔或水晶状几何体。在整个设计中散布 7 个清晰的拉丁文文本块，样式为做旧的衬线字体和神秘铭文：“IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.”、“ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.”、“PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA”、“EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.”、“III FRAGMENTUM INFINITUM.”、“COR AMAT; MENS DUBITAT; ANIMA LACERATUR.” 以及 “IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO”。在整张图像中添加微小的 UI 风格微型文字、条形码碎片、微型图表、神秘徽章、十字准线符号和难以辨认的数据面板。整体构图应营造出压抑、深奥、电影感和超现实的氛围，并具备厚重的纹理、层叠的透明度、微妙的红色点缀、明暗对比照明以及高级暗黑艺术海报的质感。

templates.title: Black-and-White Wartime Ink Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 黑白战争水墨场景

templates.prompt: A dramatic black-and-white ink-wash wartime illustration in a vertical composition, combining realistic World War II imagery with abstract splattered brushwork on a mostly white background. Show 4 soldiers total advancing from the left toward the center and distance: 1 large foreground soldier seen from behind on a rocky ledge, wearing a steel helmet, heavy pack, and carrying a rifle with bayonet, plus 3 smaller soldiers in a staggered line behind him moving toward the right. In the sky, show 5 warplanes flying overhead through thick smoke. On the right side, place a steep rocky island or coastal cliff with a ruined fortress or castle on top, with smoke rising around it. Below, depict a rough sea crashing against dark rocks and a narrow shoreline with tiny landing figures near the water. Use explosive black ink splashes, soot clouds, scratches, drips, and painterly debris to merge the soldiers, cliffs, and surf into one expressive composition. High contrast monochrome, misty atmosphere, desaturated grayscale only, cinematic and haunting, with lots of negative space and a fine-art concept-art feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满戏剧性的黑白水墨战争插画，采用竖构图，将写实的二战意象与大面积留白背景上的抽象泼墨笔触相结合。画面左侧共展示 4 名士兵向中心及远方推进：前景中 1 名巨大的士兵背影站在岩石峭壁上，头戴钢盔，背负重装，手持带刺刀的步枪；身后另有 3 名较小的士兵呈错落队形向右移动。天空中，5 架战机穿过浓烟呼啸而过。画面右侧是一座陡峭的岩岛或海岸悬崖，顶部矗立着一座废弃的堡垒或城堡，周围烟雾缭绕。下方描绘了汹涌的海浪拍打着暗礁，狭窄的海岸线上隐约可见靠近水面的微小登陆身影。运用爆发式的黑色墨迹、烟尘、划痕、滴溅和绘画般的碎片效果，将士兵、悬崖和浪花融为一体，构成一幅极具表现力的作品。高对比度单色调，雾气氤氲，仅使用去饱和的灰阶，呈现出电影般令人难忘的质感，并留有大量负空间，兼具纯艺术与概念艺术的风格。

templates.title: Victorian Animal Chess Match

titleLocalized.zh: 维多利亚风格动物象棋对弈

templates.prompt: A highly detailed cinematic portrait of an anthropomorphic {argument name="dog breed" default="pug"} and a chimpanzee sitting across from each other playing chess in a dim, old-world Victorian study. The dog is on the left, shown from the waist up, wearing a brown tweed suit jacket, white shirt, and bow tie, with a single round monocle and chain over one eye, resting one paw near the chessboard and gazing thoughtfully at the pieces. The chimpanzee is on the right, also dressed in a heavy brown tweed jacket over a shirt, leaning forward with one hand against its chin in a classic thinking pose, intensely focused on the board. Between them is an ornate carved wooden chess table with a full chess set mid-game, with exactly 32 pieces visible: 16 light wooden pieces on the left side and 16 dark wooden pieces on the right side, arranged in a believable strategic position rather than a starting layout. The room is rich with dark polished wood, leather armchairs, a warm amber table lamp on the far left, bookshelves in the background, a framed classical portrait painting centered behind them, and a small mantel clock beneath the painting. Use warm tungsten lighting, shallow depth of field, moody shadows, ultra-realistic fur and skin textures, fine wrinkles, reflective glass on the monocle, and a serious intellectual atmosphere with subtle humor. Symmetrical composition, eye-level camera, photorealistic, sharp focus on both faces and the chessboard, luxurious period details, dark brown and sepia color palette.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅高度细腻的电影级肖像画，描绘了一只拟人化的 {argument name="dog breed" default="pug"} 和一只黑猩猩坐在昏暗的旧世界维多利亚式书房中对弈象棋。狗在左侧，半身像，身穿棕色粗花呢西装外套、白衬衫和领结，单眼戴着一副圆形的单片眼镜及链条，一只爪子放在棋盘旁，若有所思地注视着棋子。黑猩猩在右侧，同样穿着厚实的棕色粗花呢外套内搭衬衫，身体前倾，一只手托着下巴，呈现出经典的思考姿势，全神贯注地盯着项目。它们之间是一张雕刻精美的木制棋桌，上面摆放着一盘正在进行中的完整象棋，清晰可见 32 枚棋子：左侧 16 枚浅色木制棋子，右侧 16 枚深色木制棋子，呈现出真实的战略布局而非初始摆放。房间里充满了深色抛光木材、皮革扶手椅，最左侧有一盏温暖的琥珀色台灯，背景是书架，它们身后正中央挂着一幅古典肖像画，画下方有一个小型壁炉钟。采用温暖的钨丝灯光、浅景深、深沉的阴影、超逼真的毛发和皮肤纹理、细微的皱纹、单片眼镜上的反光，营造出一种严肃的知识分子氛围，并带有一丝微妙的幽默感。对称构图，平视视角，照片级逼真，面部和项目焦点清晰，奢华的时代细节，深棕色和棕褐色调。

templates.title: Office Transfer Announcement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 办公室调任公告海报

templates.prompt: Design a dramatic square promotional poster in the style of a TV sitcom cast transfer announcement, with a dark navy and black office-themed background, gritty sports-poster energy, bold blue paint strokes, white distressed typography, and layered collage composition. At the center, place a confident woman named {argument name="character name" default="Penny"} standing from the waist up with arms crossed, wearing a light cream floral V-neck dress, messy blonde hair in a high bun, softly rim-lit with a subtle glow around her silhouette. Behind her, show exactly 8 office coworkers arranged as a blurred ensemble cast in staggered rows inside a corporate office interior with blinds, desks, and framed company signage; keep them secondary and slightly shadowed so the central woman dominates the composition. At the top left, include a tilted blue company logo block reading "DUNDER MIFFLIN INC. PAPER COMPANY" with a small office icon. Across the top center, add a huge distressed white headline "TRANSFER" and beneath it an even larger blue brush-script word "CONFIRMED". At the top right, add the small stacked slogan "NEW CHAPTER. NEW SCRANTON." On the left side, place a torn-paper transfer slip with a stamped, photocopied look; it should contain exactly 2 labeled sections, "FROM:" with "DUNDER MIFFLIN PAPER COMPANY, SCRANTON, PA, EST. 1949" and "TO:" with "THE OFFICE, SCRANTON, PA", plus a small office icon at the bottom. Add a hand-drawn blue arrow from this slip pointing toward the central woman. Across the woman's torso, place a blue paint-stroke nameplate with "{argument name="character name" default="Penny"}" in white script, followed by a small black strip with "IS", then a large stacked headline in distressed white and blue block text reading "JOINING THE OFFICE". On the right side, add a glowing dark info panel with exactly 3 labeled lines: "NEW ROLE" with "{argument name="job title" default="SALES REPRESENTATIVE"}", "NEW TEAM" with "{argument name="team tagline" default="SAME PAPER"}", and "NEW MEMORIES" with "LOADING...", plus a horizontal progress bar beneath. Along the bottom center, include a narrow blue banner reading "DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="Penny"}". At the very bottom, create a footer strip with exactly 4 elements: a briefcase icon and "NEW JOB", a team icon and "NEW TEAM", a document icon and "NEW MEMORIES", and on the far right a handwritten blue script phrase "{argument name="footer text" default="LET'S GO!"}". Use a high-contrast blue-white-black palette, cinematic compositing, subtle dust and texture overlays, energetic paint smears, and a premium fan-edit social media announcement aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 设计一张戏剧性的方形宣传海报，采用电视剧演员调任公告的风格，背景为深海军蓝与黑色办公室主题，具有粗犷的体育海报质感，配以醒目的蓝色笔触、做旧的白色排版和分层拼贴构图。在画面中心，放置一位自信的女性 {argument name="character name" default="Penny"}，半身像，双臂交叉，身穿浅米色花卉 V 领连衣裙，凌乱的金色高丸子头，轮廓边缘带有柔和的微光。在她身后，展示 8 位办公室同事，作为模糊的群像演员，错落有致地排列在带有百叶窗、办公桌和公司标识牌的办公室内；保持他们处于次要位置并略带阴影，以突出中心女性的主导地位。在左上角，加入一个倾斜的蓝色公司标志块，上面写着 "DUNDER MIFFLIN INC. PAPER COMPANY" 以及一个小办公室图标。在顶部中央，添加巨大的做旧白色标题 "TRANSFER"，下方是更大的蓝色手写体单词 "CONFIRMED"。在右上角，添加小的堆叠标语 "NEW CHAPTER. NEW SCRANTON."。在左侧，放置一张带有盖章复印外观的撕纸风格调任单；它应包含 2 个明确的标签部分，"FROM:" 对应 "DUNDER MIFFLIN PAPER COMPANY, SCRANTON, PA, EST. 1949"，"TO:" 对应 "THE OFFICE, SCRANTON, PA"，底部附带一个小办公室图标。从这张单据画一个手绘蓝色箭头指向中心女性。在女性躯干位置，放置一个蓝色笔触的名牌，上面用白色手写体写着 "{argument name="character name" default="Penny"}"，后面跟着一个写有 "IS" 的黑色小条，再下方是巨大的堆叠标题，采用做旧的白蓝块状字体，写着 "JOINING THE OFFICE"。在右侧，添加一个发光的深色信息面板，包含 3 行明确的标签："NEW ROLE" 对应 "{argument name="job title" default="SALES REPRESENTATIVE"}"，"NEW TEAM" 对应 "{argument name="team tagline" default="SAME PAPER"}"，以及 "NEW MEMORIES" 对应 "LOADING..."，下方配有一个水平进度条。在底部中央，包含一个狭窄的蓝色横幅，写着 "DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="Penny"}"。在最底部，创建一个页脚条，包含 4 个元素：一个公文包图标和 "NEW JOB"，一个团队图标和 "NEW TEAM"，一个文档图标和 "NEW MEMORIES"，以及最右侧的一句手写蓝色短语 "{argument name="footer text" default="LET'S GO!"}"。使用高对比度的蓝、白、黑配色，电影级的合成效果，细腻的灰尘与纹理叠加，充满活力的油漆涂抹效果，以及高级的粉丝剪辑社交媒体公告美学。

templates.title: Pink Fashion Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: A glossy high-fashion magazine cover portrait in a vertical format, styled like a premium beauty and fashion publication. Show a young woman from the chest up in a soft glamorous studio setup, turning slightly sideways with one hand raised near her lips in a coy elegant pose. Her face is intentionally obscured by a solid rectangular block in a muted warm beige tone, centered over the face area. She has long, softly wavy light brown hair with pink rim lighting catching the strands, large thin silver hoop earrings, and long manicured pale pink nails. She wears a fluffy fuzzy knit sweater in blush pink with oversized sleeves and a cozy luxurious texture. Use a monochromatic pink palette with warm rosy lighting, soft glow, shallow depth of field, beauty-retouch polish, and editorial fashion photography aesthetics. The background should be a smooth pink gradient with subtle studio haze and light bloom. Design it as a magazine cover with layered typography: a very large pale pink masthead reading "{argument name="magazine title" default="GPT"}" across the top, with elegant serif text "{argument name="cover line" default="image 2.0"}" in the upper right. Add small upper-left text reading "MAY 2024" and "FASHION & BEAUTY MAGAZINE". Add three side feature blocks: left upper "Special Interview" with Japanese text beneath and "8P"; left lower "Trend Report" with Japanese text beneath; right middle "Beauty Update" with Japanese text beneath; right lower "Style Guide" with Japanese text beneath. At the bottom, place a large dramatic serif headline reading "{argument name="main headline" default="The Power of Confidence."}" with "The Power of" in black italic serif and "Confidence." in oversized deep pink italic serif. Beneath it, add the Japanese subheadline "自分を信じて、もっと輝く私に。" Keep the cover luxurious, feminine, trendy, and polished, like a contemporary Japanese fashion magazine.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光泽感十足的高级时尚杂志封面肖像，采用竖构图，呈现出高端美妆与时尚刊物的风格。画面展示了一位年轻女性的胸部以上特写，置于柔和迷人的摄影棚环境中，她身体微微侧转，一只手举在唇边，姿态优雅含蓄。她的面部被一个位于中心位置、哑光暖米色的实心矩形色块刻意遮挡。她留着长长的浅棕色微卷发，发丝间闪烁着粉色的轮廓光，佩戴着大号细银圈耳环，指甲修剪整齐并涂有淡粉色甲油。她身穿一件淡粉色毛绒针织毛衣，袖口宽大，质感舒适奢华。整体采用单色粉色调，配以温暖的玫瑰色灯光、柔光效果、浅景深、精细的美容修图质感以及编辑类时尚摄影美学。背景为平滑的粉色渐变，带有细腻的摄影棚雾感和光晕。设计为杂志封面，包含分层排版：顶部横跨一个非常大的淡粉色刊头，文字为“{argument name="magazine title" default="GPT"}”，右上角配有优雅的衬线字体“{argument name="cover line" default="image 2.0"}”。左上角添加小字“MAY 2024”和“FASHION & BEAUTY MAGAZINE”。添加三个侧边专题栏：左上为“Special Interview”及其下方的日文文本和“8P”；左下为“Trend Report”及其下方的日文文本；右中为“Beauty Update”及其下方的日文文本；右下为“Style Guide”及其下方的日文文本。底部放置一个醒目的大号衬线标题，文字为“{argument name="main headline" default="The Power of Confidence."}”，其中“The Power of”采用黑色斜体衬线字，“Confidence.”采用超大号深粉色斜体衬线字。在其下方，添加日文副标题“自分を信じて、もっと輝く私に。”保持封面奢华、柔美、潮流且精致的质感，如同当代日本时尚杂志。

templates.title: Pink Office Transfer Announcement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色办公室调动公告海报

templates.prompt: A glossy, feminine scrapbook-style office announcement poster inspired by a sitcom workplace promo, in a vertical 2:3 composition. The scene shows 1 central woman standing in front of a group of 7 office coworkers inside a warm beige office with venetian blinds, desks, and a visible Dunder Mifflin-style wall sign in the background. The central woman has blonde hair in a messy high bun, a light pink floral V-neck dress, folded arms, and a confident, celebratory pose. Behind her, the 7 coworkers are arranged in a loose semicircle, wearing office attire in muted blues, browns, black, and lavender. Build the image as a mixed-media collage with torn paper, taped notes, brush-lettered headlines, glitter textures, flowers, and pink-and-gold accents. At the top left, place a pink rectangular company card with a white office icon and the text “DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC” and “PAPER COMPANY”. Across the upper center, place a large torn-paper headline reading “TRANSFER CONFIRMED” in expressive brush lettering, with “TRANSFER” in hot pink and “CONFIRMED” in black, plus pink underline strokes and a hand-drawn heart. At the top right, pin a small off-white note card with a pink pushpin and pink tape reading “NEW CHAPTER. NEW SCRANTON.” Near the lower center, layer a bold title made of 4 stacked text strips: “{argument name="character name" default="PENNY"}” on a pink paint-stroke banner, “IS” on a small white strip with 2 tiny hearts, “JOINING” on a gold brush-stroke banner, and “THE OFFICE” on a pale pink strip. On the lower left, hang a tall pink transfer tag clipped with a gold paperclip, reading “FROM DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC PAPER COMPANY / SCRANTON, PA / EST. 1949” and below that “TO THE OFFICE / SCRANTON, PA”, with a pink women-and-desk restroom-style icon at the bottom. On the lower right, place a pink note card with 3 labeled sections: “NEW ROLE” with “{argument name="job title" default="Sales Representative"}”, “NEW TEAM” with “{argument name="team text" default="Same Paper"}”, and “NEW MEMORIES” with “{argument name="memories text" default="Let’s make some!"}”, each accented with small pink hearts. Along the bottom center, add a pink ribbon strip reading “DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES {argument name="character name" default="PENNY"}♡”. Beneath that, include 3 small icon-and-text items in one row: sparkle icon with “NEW JOB”, group icon with “NEW TEAM”, and heart icon with “NEW MEMORIES”. At the bottom right, add large handwritten pink script saying “LET’S GO!”. Decorate the corners with pink peonies, tiny white filler flowers, torn paper edges, soft glitter dust, and subtle gold foil flecks. promptLocalized.zh: 一张光泽感、女性化、剪贴簿风格的办公室公告海报，灵感源自情景喜剧职场宣传，采用 2:3 竖构图。画面展示了 1 位核心女性站在 7 位办公室同事前方，背景是温暖的米色办公室，配有百叶窗、办公桌以及清晰可见的 Dunder Mifflin 风格墙面标志。核心女性留着金色凌乱高丸子头，身穿浅粉色碎花 V 领连衣裙，双臂交叉，姿态自信且充满庆典氛围。她身后，7 位同事呈松散的半圆形排列，身着柔和的蓝色、棕色、黑色和淡紫色职场装束。将图像构建为混合媒体拼贴画，包含撕纸、胶带笔记、毛笔字体标题、闪光纹理、花朵以及粉色和金色装饰。左上角放置一张粉色长方形公司卡片，带有白色办公室图标和文字“DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC”及“PAPER COMPANY”。上方中央放置一个巨大的撕纸标题，以富有表现力的毛笔字书写“TRANSFER CONFIRMED”，其中“TRANSFER”为亮粉色，“CONFIRMED”为黑色，并配有粉色下划线和手绘心形。右上角用粉色图钉和粉色胶带固定一张米白色小卡片，上面写着“NEW CHAPTER. templates.title: Redacted Rooftop Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 天台遮挡肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic photorealistic rooftop portrait at golden hour of an older man standing centered and facing the camera, with his face fully obscured by a large vertical rectangular censor block in a muted brown tone. Show only the visible parts of him clearly: short dense tightly curled gray hair with silver highlights, both ears visible, a slender aged neck, and the upper torso in a charcoal gray blazer over an open-collar off-white dress shirt with no tie. Compose the image in a vertical portrait crop from mid-chest upward. Place him on a realistic New York City rooftop with exact visible details including 1 weathered HVAC unit on the left foreground, 1 cylindrical rooftop water tower on the right midground, 2 prominent Art Deco skyscrapers in the background resembling the Empire State Building on the left and the Chrysler Building on the right, plus low brick buildings, rooftop pipes, vents, railings, and soft atmospheric haze. Use warm sunset lighting with orange-pink sky tones, subtle rim light on the ears and hair, shallow depth of field on the skyline, and highly detailed textures in the suit fabric, rooftop concrete, metal machinery, and curly hair. The overall mood should feel mysterious, editorial, and slightly surreal, like an identity-redacted magazine cover photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的写实天台肖像，拍摄于黄金时刻。一位年长男性居中面向镜头，面部被一块巨大的垂直长方形棕色遮挡块完全遮住。清晰呈现可见部分：浓密且紧致的灰色卷发，带有银色高光；双耳清晰可见；颈部细长且显露岁月痕迹；上半身穿着炭灰色西装外套，内搭无领带的米白色翻领衬衫。构图采用从胸部中段向上的垂直肖像裁剪。场景设定在真实的纽约天台，细节包括：左前方 1 台风化的暖通空调机组，右中景 1 座圆柱形天台水塔，背景中 2 座醒目的装饰艺术风格摩天大楼（左侧类似帝国大厦，右侧类似克莱斯勒大厦），以及低矮的砖房、天台管道、通风口、护栏和柔和的大气薄雾。采用温暖的日落光影，天空呈现橙粉色调，耳朵和头发边缘带有微妙的轮廓光，天际线处景深较浅，西装面料、天台混凝土、金属机械和卷发的纹理细节丰富。整体氛围神秘、具有编辑感且略带超现实色彩，如同身份被遮挡的杂志封面照片。

templates.title: Corporate Cash Private Jet Satire

titleLocalized.zh: 讽刺科技圈金钱喷气机照片

templates.prompt: A photorealistic satirical airport tarmac scene in daylight, shot vertically, showing a sleek white private jet parked with its door open and stairs visible on the left. On the side of the jet, large clean corporate lettering reads “Google | ANTHROPIC”. In the foreground, 2 adult male executives in dark navy business suits embrace in a celebratory hug, centered slightly left. The man facing camera-left has curly dark hair and wears a charcoal suit; the other man, with short dark hair and a white dress shirt under a navy suit, holds a thick fan of U.S. $100 bills in one hand while hugging. Their expressions should feel triumphant and conspiratorial. In the midground and right side, 2 additional adult men in dark suits push 2 metal airport luggage carts overflowing with tightly bundled stacks of cash. The left cart has a black front panel labeled “Google” in multicolor corporate-style lettering, and the right cart has a black front panel labeled “Deep Pockets Division” in white sans-serif text. Count exactly 2 carts and show both piled high with money bricks wrapped in bank bands. The private jet extends across most of the background, with oval windows, a visible rear engine on the right, and a partly cloudy blue sky above. The ground is wet and reflective, adding glossy reflections under the people and carts. Editorial photojournalism style, ultra-realistic lighting, sharp focus, subtle depth of field, luxury wealth satire, corporate power imagery, high-detail textures on suits, aircraft metal, and cash bundles.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在明亮多云天空下、机场停机坪上的写实讽刺社论照片。画面中，一架白色私人飞机斜向停放，舱门开启，舷梯放下。机身上印有醒目整洁的企业字样“Google | ANTHROPIC”。前景中，两名身着深色商务西装的成年男性科技高管紧紧拥抱，面向镜头，其中一人手中拿着一叠厚厚的美元钞票。他们的面部被刻意用平滑的矩形模糊块遮挡。中景和右侧，另外两名同样面部模糊、身着深色西装的成年男性，正推着两辆堆满紧密捆扎的美元砖块的机场行李推车。左侧推车上有一个带有 Google 标志的黑色面板，右侧推车上的黑色面板写着“Deep Pockets Division”。潮湿的地面反射出人物、推车和飞机的倒影，增添了雨后光泽感。构图居中且略带低角度，拥抱的两人占据画面主体，身后的两辆现金推车清晰可见。整体基调犀利、写实、细节丰富，具有企业政治讽刺意味，呈现新闻摄影风格，自然日光，焦点清晰，景深微妙，展现高端私人航空美学。

templates.title: Funny DIY Disaster Cat Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 趣味 DIY 灾难猫咪漫画

templates.prompt: Create a colorful humorous comic-style poster in Spanish, vertical format, with a retro cartoon look, thick black outlines, warm orange and yellow palette, halftone texture, and exaggerated expressive characters. The layout has 4 distinct panels: 1 large title panel across the top and 3 equal vertical panels along the bottom row. In the top panel, show a smug orange tabby cat handyman standing upright like a person in a cozy living room workshop, holding a screwdriver in one paw and the other paw on the hip, wearing a utility belt with visible tools. The cat has narrowed confident eyes and a sly grin. On the left side of this top panel, place a large jagged comic burst with the Spanish headline in bold distressed lettering: "3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL", with "ARRUINAR" in red and the rest in black. Below it, add a taped paper strip that says "edición casera". In the background of the top panel, include a framed sign on the wall that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" with a small paw print, a small potted plant, shelves, and dynamic radial lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create 3 labeled step panels, each with a yellow header box and bold black text. Panel 1 header: "PASO 1". Show the same orange cat sitting calmly on the floor beside a standing lamp, eyes closed with overconfidence, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that says "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Include a small open toolbox and a few screws on the floor. Panel 2 header: "PASO 2". Show the cat mid-repair, now alarmed with wide eyes, awkwardly unscrewing the wrong part of the lamp while pieces and screws fly through the air. Add a speech bubble that says "Ups..." and a sticky note near the bottom that says "tocar lo que no era". Include visual motion lines, scattered debris, and a toppled plant pot. Panel 3 header: "PASO 3". Show the aftermath: the lamp is broken and smoking with exposed wires and sparks, the room is messy with shattered parts everywhere, and the cat sits stunned holding the screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a taped label at the bottom that says "resultado final". Make the entire image playful, chaotic, and meme-like, with polished digital illustration, expressive faces, comic lettering, and a DIY disaster tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张色彩鲜艳、风格幽默的西班牙语漫画海报，采用竖版格式，具有复古卡通外观、粗黑轮廓、暖橙色和黄色调、半色调纹理以及夸张生动的角色。布局分为 4 个独立的画格：顶部是一个大标题画格，底部一行是 3 个等大的竖向画格。在顶部画格中，展示一只自鸣得意的橘色虎斑猫修理工，像人一样直立在舒适的客厅工作室里，一只爪子拿着螺丝刀，另一只爪子叉在腰间，戴着装有明显工具的工具带。猫咪眯着自信的眼睛，带着狡黠的笑容。在此画格左侧，放置一个巨大的锯齿状漫画爆炸框，内含粗体做旧字体的西班牙语标题：“3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL”，其中“ARRUINAR”为红色，其余为黑色。下方添加一条写有“edición casera”的胶带纸条。在顶部画格背景中，墙上挂着一个写有“YO PUEDO SOLO”的牌子，旁边有一个小爪印，还有一盆小植物、架子以及猫咪身后动态的放射线。在底部一行，创建 3 个带标签的步骤画格，每个画格都有一个黄色标题框和粗体黑色文字。画格 1 标题：“PASO 1”。展示同一只橘猫平静地坐在落地灯旁，闭着眼睛，一脸过度自信，随意地拿着螺丝刀。添加一个对话气泡，写着“Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos.”。包含一个打开的小工具箱和地板上的几颗螺丝。画格 2 标题：“PASO 2”。展示猫咪正在修理中，现在惊慌失措，眼睛瞪大，笨拙地拆卸着灯具错误的部分，碎片和螺丝在空中飞舞。添加一个写着“Ups...”的对话气泡，并在底部附近贴一张写着“tocar lo que no era”的便签。包含视觉运动线、散落的碎片和倒下的花盆。画格 3 标题：“PASO 3”。展示后果：灯具损坏并冒着烟，电线裸露且伴有火花，房间一片狼藉，到处都是破碎的零件，猫咪惊呆地坐着，手里拿着螺丝刀。右侧站着一只棕色狗，看起来很失望，在对话气泡中问道：“¿Qué hiciste?”。猫咪在另一个对话气泡中回答：“No sé... se complicó solo.”。在底部添加一个写有“resultado final”的胶带标签。使整张图片充满趣味、混乱和表情包感，采用精美的数字插画、生动的表情、漫画字体和 DIY 灾难的基调。

templates.title: Anime Spring Travel Film Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫春季旅行电影海报

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style international film poster with a cinematic, slightly painterly look and soft natural lighting. Center the composition on a young woman shown from mid-thigh up, standing in a relaxed pose with one hand in the pocket of an oversized navy zip hoodie. The hoodie has two yellow athletic stripes running down each sleeve, a loose hood, and a partially open zipper over a fitted white tank top with thin black straps visible underneath. She wears a black choker and a single dark dangling earring. Her hair is a short platinum-silver bob with long side-swept bangs and a smooth, airy texture. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a muted beige tone. Keep the overall styling elegant and restrained rather than overly detailed, with a more natural, believable finish than flashy hyper-rendered anime art. Build the background as a travel-movie collage made of diagonal panel slices: one panel shows a coastal Mediterranean-style town on cliffs beside calm blue water with distant birds; one panel shows a rural railway line with a train on the left and utility poles along the tracks; one panel shows snow-covered mountains and a winding road in a quiet valley; one panel shows a dusky city skyline with glowing lights; and one panel shows a seaside road curving along the coast at sunset. Use a soft cream, blue, and slate palette with a nostalgic spring-travel mood. Add elegant festival-award laurels on the upper left, exactly 3 stacked laurels with Spanish text indicating major animation festival awards. Add large centered title typography near the bottom reading {argument name="headline text" default="VIAJES DE PRIMAVERA"}, with a refined serif font in pale ivory. Beneath it, add a smaller italic tagline in Spanish reading {argument name="tagline" default="Cada destino cambia su corazón."}. Add a release line below that reading {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"}. Include tiny production-credit text and a small studio logo at the very bottom. The image should feel like an arthouse animated movie poster advertising a spring journey drama, with balanced negative space, premium layout design, and realistic printed-poster typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格国际电影海报，具有电影质感、略带油画风格以及柔和的自然光效。构图中心为一位年轻女性，取景至大腿中部，姿态放松，一只手插在海军蓝拉链连帽衫的口袋里。连帽衫袖子上各有两条黄色运动条纹，兜帽宽松，拉链半开，内搭一件紧身白色吊带背心，隐约可见黑色细肩带。她佩戴着黑色颈圈和一只深色吊坠耳环。她的发型是铂银色短波波头，带有长长的斜刘海，质感顺滑轻盈。她的面部被一个柔和米色的扁平矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。整体风格保持优雅克制，而非过度细节化，呈现出比华丽超写实动漫艺术更自然、更真实的效果。背景采用斜向分割的旅行电影拼贴画：一个板块展示了悬崖上地中海风格的沿海小镇，旁边是平静的蓝色水域和远处的飞鸟；一个板块展示了乡村铁路线，左侧有一列火车，轨道旁立着电线杆；一个板块展示了白雪皑皑的山脉和静谧山谷中蜿蜒的道路；一个板块展示了暮色下的城市天际线和点点灯光；最后一个板块展示了日落时分沿海岸弯曲的海滨公路。采用柔和的奶油色、蓝色和板岩色调，营造出怀旧的春季旅行氛围。在左上方添加优雅的电影节奖项月桂叶，精确堆叠 3 个月桂叶，并配以西班牙语文字，标明主要动画电影节奖项。在底部附近添加居中的大号标题排版，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="VIAJES DE PRIMAVERA"}，使用精致的淡象牙色衬线字体。在其下方，添加一行较小的西班牙语斜体标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Cada destino cambia su corazón."}。在下方添加发行信息行 {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"}。在最底部包含微小的制作人员名单文字和一个小型工作室标志。整张图片应呈现出艺术电影海报的质感，宣传春季旅行题材的剧情片，具备平衡的留白、高级的布局设计以及逼真的印刷海报排版。

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the photo into a vintage naturalist encyclopedia plate in the style of a 19th-century scientific animal-and-botany illustration. Keep the same beagle and the same potted houseplant from the reference as the main subjects, but redraw them as finely inked and lightly hand-colored specimen illustrations on an aged off-white page. Preserve the dog's seated pose, collar and tag, and the plant's pot and overall structure. Add a formal infographic layout with 8 labeled figure areas total: 1 large central full-body beagle study, 1 large right-side plant study, 4 left-column inset studies labeled “Fig. 1. Head (Frontal View)”, “Fig. 2. Head (Profile View)”, “Fig. 3. Collar & Tag”, and “Fig. 4. Forepaw (Anterior View)”, 3 bottom comparative detail studies labeled “Eye”, “Nose”, and “Leaf (Detail)”, plus 1 bottom-right notes panel. Add delicate dotted annotation callouts around the main dog and plant identifying features such as eyes, ears, nose, chest, legs, paws, coat, leaves, stem, and roots. Include the page title “THE BEAGLE & THE HOUSEPLANT” at the top, the subtitle “Observations on a Domestic Companion and Its Environment”, corner plate markings “PL. I.” and “Tab. 1.”, a central caption “Fig. 5. The Beagle (Canis lupus familiaris) Adult. Seated Position.”, a plant caption “Fig. 6. Houseplant in Pot (Dracaena sp.)”, a bottom section title “Fig. 7. Comparative Study: Details”, and a notes box containing 5 lines: “Location: Indoor”, “Observations: Peaceful coexistence between companion animal and potted plant.”, “Date: May 17, 2024”, “Observer: Naturalist’s Journal”, and “Plate I.” Use clean engraved linework, restrained watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, decorative border corners, and a symmetrical museum-plate composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图片，将其转化为 19 世纪科学动植物插画风格的复古博物学百科全书图版。保留参考图中的比格犬和盆栽植物作为主体，但将其重绘为绘制在做旧米白色页面上的精细墨线与淡彩标本插图。保留狗的坐姿、项圈和吊牌，以及植物的花盆和整体结构。添加正式的信息图布局，总共包含 8 个标注区域：1 个中央大型比格犬全身研究图，1 个右侧大型植物研究图，4 个左侧栏插图，分别标注为“图 1. 头部（正面）”、“图 2. 头部（侧面）”、“图 3. 项圈与吊牌”和“图 4. 前爪（前视图）”，3 个底部对比细节研究图，分别标注为“眼睛”、“鼻子”和“叶片（细节）”，以及 1 个右下角的注释面板。在主要犬只和植物周围添加精致的虚线标注，标明眼睛、耳朵、鼻子、胸部、腿、爪、毛发、叶片、茎和根等特征。在顶部包含页面标题“THE BEAGLE & THE HOUSEPLANT”，副标题“Observations on a Domestic Companion and Its Environment”，角落图版标记“PL. I.”和“Tab. 1.”，中央说明文字“图 5. 比格犬（Canis lupus familiaris）成年。坐姿。”，植物说明文字“图 6. 盆栽植物（Dracaena sp.）”，底部章节标题“图 7. 对比研究：细节”，以及一个包含 5 行内容的注释框：“地点：室内”、“观察结果：伴侣动物与盆栽植物的和平共处。”、“日期：2024 年 5 月 17 日”、“观察者：博物学家日志”和“图版 I.”。采用干净的雕版线条、克制的淡水彩渲染、细腻的纸张纹理、装饰性边框角以及对称的博物馆图版构图。

The composition features a dynamic anime-inspired action scene in the center: a martial artist in a white gi with a black belt carries a long-haired woman over one shoulder in a fireman's carry or wrestling throw pose. The fighter is shown from the knees up in a powerful wide stance, facing left, with the woman draped horizontally across the shoulders, her bare legs lifted and bent, her long dark hair flowing downward, and a black wide-brim cowboy hat still on her head. Render both figures in high-contrast inked line art with thick black shadows and sharp graphic contours, mixing manga character design with vintage screen-printed poster energy. Behind them, fill the background with aggressive geometric rays and wedges: 6 major red and black angular shapes radiating outward across the cream backdrop, creating a sense of impact and motion. In the top right corner, add 1 circular emblem containing a fierce gorilla or ape head icon with red accents. Across the lower third, place large bold condensed block typography integrated into the composition: the smaller line reads “SCOTTISH RECIPE:” and the huge main title reads “MINCE AND TATTIES”. Make the text red on cream and cream on black in layered diagonal banner panels, with the words occupying 3 text groupings total: “SCOTTISH RECIPE:”, “MINCE AND”, and “TATTIES”. Emphasize dramatic diagonal layout, posterized shadows, distressed print texture, and the feeling of a vintage Soviet constructivist or pulp exploitation food poster fused with martial arts manga aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张醒目的复古宣传风格海报插画，采用红、黑与暖奶油色的有限配色方案，呈现于轻微老化的纸张纹理之上。构图中心为一个充满动感的动漫风格动作场景：一名身穿白色道服、系着黑带的武术家以消防员背负式或摔跤投掷姿势扛着一名长发女子。格斗者从膝盖以上入画，呈强有力的宽站姿，面向左侧；女子横卧在其肩上，双腿弯曲抬起，黑色长发向下垂落，头上仍戴着一顶黑色宽檐牛仔帽。两位人物均采用高对比度的墨线勾勒，带有厚重的黑色阴影和锐利的图形轮廓，将漫画角色设计与复古丝网印刷海报的张力融为一体。背景处填充着强烈的几何射线与楔形图案：6 个主要的红黑角形形状从奶油色背景向外辐射，营造出强烈的冲击感与动感。在右上角添加 1 个圆形徽章，内含一个带有红色点缀的凶猛大猩猩或猿猴头像图标。在下三分之一处，放置与构图融为一体的大号粗体压缩排版：较小的一行文字为“SCOTTISH RECIPE:”，巨大的主标题为“MINCE AND TATTIES”。文字采用奶油色底上的红色字与黑色底上的奶油色字，分布在分层的对角横幅面板中，共分为 3 组文本：“SCOTTISH RECIPE:”、“MINCE AND”以及“TATTIES”。强调戏剧性的对角线布局、海报化阴影、做旧印刷纹理，以及融合了苏联构成主义或低俗剥削电影美食海报与武术漫画美学的独特质感。

templates.title: 1990s Spanish Family Kitchen Lunch

titleLocalized.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代西班牙家庭午餐

templates.prompt: A candid documentary-style photograph of a {argument name="country" default="Spain"} family having lunch in a modest 1990s home kitchen, shot vertically with warm natural light and realistic lived-in detail. Four people sit around a small square table: an adult man in the left foreground seen mostly from the back and side, a middle-aged woman centered on the far side of the table serving food with a spoon, a teenage boy on the right side of the table, and a young girl in the right foreground with a ponytail, seen from behind in three-quarter view. The mood is intimate, ordinary, nostalgic, and unmistakably real, like a family snapshot rather than a staged commercial image. The table is covered with a blue-and-white plaid tablecloth and set with a rustic home-cooked meal: 1 black pan of stew or braised meat in the center, 1 wooden bowl filled with several pieces of bread, 2 small glass carafes containing dark red wine, multiple plates with food, cutlery, drinking glasses, and torn pieces of bread. The kitchen background should feel authentic and slightly worn: cream walls, a band of small patterned ceramic tiles across the middle of the wall, an open window on the left letting in soft daylight, 1 small potted plant on the windowsill, 1 wooden wall shelf holding jars and kitchen containers, 1 vintage wall calendar reading {argument name="month on calendar" default="AGOSTO"}, and dark wooden furniture on the right. Use soft film-like grain, muted colors, slight haze, gentle contrast, and natural imperfections typical of a 1990s analog photo. Composition should feel casually observed from a standing height near the table, with partial occlusion by the father and daughter in the foreground, no polished styling, no stock-photo cleanliness, just everyday family life in {argument name="decade" default="the 1990s"}.
