templates.title: Anime KFC Princess Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风 KFC 公主宣传海报

templates.prompt: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional poster in glossy anime advertising style, themed around KFC and a magical princess mascot. The composition is vertical and packed but still a single unified ad scene. At center-right, a cheerful young anime woman inspired by Princess Kaguya poses energetically toward the viewer with one hand reaching forward and the other arm lifted. She has long flowing golden-blonde hair, large sparkling amber-red eyes, a bright open smile, and ornate hair accessories including red floral ornaments, dangling beads, green ribbons, and a small gold crescent-moon crown. She wears a festive kimono-inspired outfit in coral red, soft pink, cream, and olive green with layered sleeves, floral patterns, decorative cords, bows, tassels, and a wide obi with a flower knot. Her hair and sleeves sweep dramatically as if caught in a lively breeze. In the lower left foreground, show 1 large KFC bucket overflowing with 4 pieces of crispy fried chicken, rendered extra crunchy, golden, juicy, and appetizing. Along the bottom foreground, include 3 side items: 1 chicken burger with sesame bun and lettuce, 1 small carton of fries, and 1 biscuit or pie-like pastry topped with glossy syrup. Use the KFC logo in the top right and on the bucket and fries carton, with the Colonel face partially censored by a rectangular blur on the bucket. Surround the scene with celebratory red-and-gold graphics, sparkles, brushstroke flourishes, and festive Japanese New Year-like motifs. Add large bold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading ケンタッキーの魅力 in thick red characters with white and gold outline. Add 2 white brushstroke callout bubbles on the left with red text: サクッと香ばしい！ and ジューシーで大満足！. Add a red flower-shaped badge on the right reading 今日のごほうびに. Add a red bottom banner with white text listing オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット. Extremely polished commercial illustration, high saturation, warm lighting, clean line art, glossy food rendering, energetic composition, premium poster finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的日本快餐宣传海报，采用光泽感动漫广告风格，以 KFC 和魔法公主吉祥物为主题。构图为竖版，内容丰富但仍保持统一的广告场景。画面中右侧，一位灵感来自辉夜姬的开朗动漫少女正充满活力地向观众摆出姿势，一只手向前伸展，另一只手臂抬起。她拥有飘逸的长金发、明亮闪烁的琥珀红双眸、灿烂的笑容，并佩戴着华丽的发饰，包括红色花朵装饰、垂坠珠饰、绿色丝带以及一个小巧的金色新月皇冠。她身着珊瑚红、柔粉色、奶油色和橄榄绿相间的节日和服风格服饰，搭配层叠的袖子、花卉图案、装饰绳结、蝴蝶结、流苏以及带有花朵结的宽腰带。她的头发和袖子随风飘动，仿佛置身于轻快的微风中。在左下方前景处，展示 1 个装满 4 块酥脆炸鸡的 KFC 炸鸡桶，炸鸡呈现出格外酥脆、金黄、多汁且诱人的质感。在底部前景处，包含 3 份配餐：1 个芝麻面包生菜鸡肉汉堡、1 小盒薯条，以及 1 个淋有光泽糖浆的饼干或派类点心。右上角以及炸鸡桶和薯条盒上印有 KFC 标志，炸鸡桶上的山德士上校头像部分被矩形模糊处理。场景周围环绕着喜庆的红金配色图形、闪光、笔触装饰以及类似日本新年的节日元素。左上方添加醒目的粗体日文标题“ケンタッキーの魅力”，采用红色字体，并带有白色和金色描边。左侧添加 2 个白色笔触气泡框，内含红色文字：“サクッと香ばしい！”和“ジューシーで大満足！”。右侧添加一个红色花形徽章，写有“今日のごほうびに”。底部添加红色横幅，用白色文字列出“オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット”。极致精致的商业插画，高饱和度，暖色调灯光，干净的线条，光泽感食物渲染，充满活力的构图，高级海报质感。

templates.title: Anime MOS Burger Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格 MOS Burger 宣传海报

templates.prompt:
A polished Japanese fast-food promotional poster in a bright anime-advertisement style, combining a fantasy princess character with clean product photography and cheerful branding. The composition is landscape and split visually: on the left, a full-body anime girl inspired by a moon-princess or bamboo-princess aesthetic stands in a welcoming pose with one hand extended toward the viewer and the other hand near her face. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white with pastel pink and lavender gradients"} hair, large expressive eyes, and an elegant floral-and-ribbon hair ornament in dark blue, gold, pink, and turquoise. Her outfit is a luxurious modernized kimono dress in white, teal, navy, and pink with translucent sleeves, floral patterns, layered obi bows, tassels, and gold ornaments, with a magical sparkling atmosphere around her. Behind her is a dreamy teal-and-cream background with soft circles, starry sparkles, faint floral motifs, sweeping decorative lines, and a subtle silhouette of a Japanese pagoda.

On the right is a neat food-ad layout for {argument name="brand name" default="MOS BURGER"}, with the red MOS BURGER logo at the top left corner and again at the bottom right. At the top center-right, place a green ribbon banner with the Japanese text "モスバーガー特集". Below it, add a large elegant handwritten-style Japanese headline: "行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ。" with the middle phrase "できたて" emphasized in vivid pink-red while the rest is black. Under that, add a smaller subheadline in Japanese: "ヤチヨ風の幻想感 × モスのごほうびバーガー". 

Feature exactly 4 food items arranged horizontally across the middle-right, each rendered as appetizing semi-photorealistic product shots with soft shadows and crisp detail. Item 1: a classic burger with bun, thick meat patty, sauce, mayonnaise, and a large tomato slice, with a red circular badge reading "定番人気" and the label "モスバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 2: a teriyaki burger with lettuce and glossy sauce, with a green circular badge reading "和風人気" and the label "テリヤキバーガー" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 3: a white paper carton of onion rings with a yellow circular badge reading "サイドも最高" and the label "オニポテ" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. Item 4: a pink milkshake in a clear cup with straw, with a blue circular badge reading "ひんやり甘い" and the label "モスシェイク" plus small Japanese descriptive text beneath. 

Below the products, add a rounded rectangular recommendation box with a teal border and a teal ribbon title reading "おすすめポイント". Inside, include exactly 4 bullet points in Japanese with pink flower-like bullets, describing made-to-order freshness, the appeal of the classic meat sauce and tomato burger, the Japanese-style popularity of teriyaki burger, and that onion rings and shake are also must-try items. To the right inside the same lower area, include a smaller rounded box with line-art icons of cutlery, a drink, and a burger, plus Japanese copy that reads "モスのこだわり" and "おいしさは、まごころから。" followed by smaller explanatory Japanese text.

Across the bottom, place a large curved banner with a teal gradient and white center glow containing the Japanese slogan "今日はモスに寄り道しよう。" with "モス" highlighted in bold red. Near the lower right, add a small orange-red circular callout with Japanese text similar to "あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!". Use a crisp commercial poster layout, vivid teal, aqua, white, pink, and gold accents, glossy food rendering, decorative sparkles, and a premium collaboration feel between anime fantasy illustration and modern restaurant advertising.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的日式快餐宣传海报，采用明亮的动漫广告风格，将奇幻公主角色与清晰的产品摄影及欢快的品牌元素相结合。构图为横向并进行视觉分割：左侧是一位灵感源自月亮公主或竹取公主的动漫少女，她摆出欢迎的姿势，一只手向观众伸出，另一只手靠近脸庞。她拥有非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色，带有淡粉色和淡紫色渐变"} 长发，大而富有表现力的眼睛，以及深蓝色、金色、粉色和绿松石色的花朵与丝带发饰。她的服装是一件奢华的现代化和服裙，采用白色、青色、海军蓝和粉色，配有半透明袖子、花卉图案、多层腰带蝴蝶结、流苏和金色装饰，周围环绕着梦幻般的闪光氛围。她身后是梦幻般的青色与奶油色背景，带有柔和的圆圈、星光闪烁、淡淡的花卉图案、优美的装饰线条以及日本宝塔的隐约剪影。

右侧是 {argument name="brand name" default="MOS BURGER"} 的整洁食品广告排版，左上角和右下角均有红色 MOS BURGER 标志。在右上方的中心位置，放置一条绿色丝带横幅，上面写有日文“モスバーガー特集”。在下方添加一个优雅的大号手写风格日文标题：“行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ。”，其中中间的短语“できたて”用鲜艳的粉红色强调，其余部分为黑色。在其下方，添加一个较小的日文副标题：“ヤチヨ風の幻想感 × モスのごほうびバーガー”。

在右侧中部横向排列 4 款食品，每款均呈现为令人垂涎的半写实产品照，带有柔和的阴影和清晰的细节。第 1 款：经典汉堡，配有面包、厚肉饼、酱汁、蛋黄酱和一大片番茄，带有写着“定番人気”的红色圆形徽章，下方标注“モスバーガー”及简短的日文描述。第 2 款：照烧汉堡，配有生菜和光亮的酱汁，带有写着“和風人気”的绿色圆形徽章，下方标注“テリヤキバーガー”及简短的日文描述。第 3 款：白色纸盒装洋葱圈，带有写着“サイドも最高”的黄色圆形徽章，下方标注“オニポテ”及简短的日文描述。第 4 款：透明杯装粉色奶昔，配有吸管，带有写着“ひんやり甘い”的蓝色圆形徽章，下方标注“モスシェイク”及简短的日文描述。

在产品下方，添加一个带有青色边框和青色丝带标题的圆角矩形推荐框，标题写着“おすすめポイント”。框内包含 4 个带粉色花朵符号的日文要点，描述现点现做的鲜美、经典肉酱番茄汉堡的魅力、日式照烧汉堡的受欢迎程度，以及洋葱圈和奶昔也是必点单品。在同一下方区域的右侧，包含一个较小的圆角框，内有餐具、饮料和汉堡的线条图标，以及写着“モスのこだわり”和“おいしさは、まごころから。”的日文文案，随后是较小的日文解释性文字。

在底部，放置一条带有青色渐变和白色中心光晕的大型弧形横幅，包含日文口号“今日はモスに寄り道しよう。”，其中“モス”以粗体红色突出显示。在右下角附近，添加一个橙红色的小圆形标注，文字类似于“あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!”。采用清晰的商业海报布局，运用鲜艳的青色、水蓝色、白色、粉色和金色点缀，呈现光泽感的食品渲染、装饰性闪光，营造出动漫奇幻插画与现代餐厅广告之间的高级联名感。

templates.title: Anthro Idol Group Concert Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 兽人偶像团体演唱会海报

templates.prompt:
A polished anime idol concert key visual on a glowing stage staircase, featuring exactly 5 anthropomorphic performers posed in a dynamic diagonal formation under dramatic purple-blue concert lighting and sparkling spotlights. The scene is viewed from a slightly low, wide-angle perspective to emphasize depth and stage presence, with neon-lit steps leading upward and metal truss structures framing the background. At center back is a large illuminated crest with a pawprint inside a geometric star emblem, flanked by laurel motifs, suggesting an idol group logo. The floor and stair edges glow with violet and blue rim light, and tiny glitter particles plus a few gold confetti pieces float through the air. The mood is energetic, triumphant, and glamorous, like a promotional poster for a live performance.

The 5 performers are all kemonomimi or furry idol characters in coordinated fantasy-stage costumes with belts, chains, layered fabrics, fingerless gloves, and tailored accessories, each color-themed individually while sharing a unified group design language. From left to right: a gray wolf boy in a deep blue outfit, closest to camera, smiling confidently and reaching one paw forward toward the viewer; an orange fox boy in black, white, and orange, stepping forward with a playful grin and one hand extended; a gray-and-white wolf boy in black, white, and green, standing slightly behind center and pointing upward/outward; a white rabbit girl in black, white, and pink, with tall bunny ears, fluffy tail, short skirt layers, and one arm raised high in an idol pose; and a brown bear boy in navy and gold, turned mostly away in a cool over-the-shoulder stance with one arm extended sideways. All characters should have expressive anime faces, fluffy fur rendering, detailed tails and paws, and high-end polished illustration quality.

Give each outfit a distinct accent color: blue for the left wolf, orange for the fox, green for the center wolf, pink for the rabbit, and gold for the bear. Costumes should mix idol fashion with fantasy military stagewear: fitted jackets or vests, asymmetrical panels, short trousers or layered skirts, harness straps, metallic trims, hanging chains, decorative cords, and patterned fabric inserts. The characters should look like a cohesive idol unit named {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"}. Use {argument name="stage lighting color" default="purple and blue"} as the dominant lighting palette, with bright white spotlights from above and subtle lens glow. Place {argument name="emblem design" default="a pawprint inside a star crest with laurel branches"} on the back screen. The overall style should be {argument name="art style" default="high-detail anime idol promotional illustration"}, and the atmosphere should feel like {argument name="performance mood" default="a climactic live show finale"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的动漫偶像演唱会主视觉图，场景设定在发光的舞台阶梯上，5 位兽人表演者以动态的对角线队形排列，置身于戏剧性的紫蓝色演唱会灯光和闪烁的聚光灯下。画面采用略微仰视的广角视角，以强调深度和舞台表现力，霓虹灯装饰的台阶向上延伸，背景由金属桁架结构勾勒。后方中央是一个巨大的发光徽章，几何星形标志内嵌爪印，两侧饰有月桂叶图案，暗示着偶像团体的标志。地板和台阶边缘闪烁着紫蓝色的轮廓光，空气中漂浮着细小的闪光颗粒和少量金色纸屑。整体氛围充满活力、胜利感和魅力，如同现场演出的宣传海报。

这 5 位表演者均为兽耳或兽人偶像角色，身着协调的奇幻舞台服装，配有腰带、链条、层叠面料、露指手套和定制配饰，每位成员拥有各自的主题色，同时共享统一的团体设计语言。从左至右依次为：一位身着深蓝色服装的灰狼少年，离镜头最近，自信地微笑并向观众伸出一只爪子；一位身着黑白橙色服装的橘色狐狸少年，带着俏皮的笑容向前迈步，一只手向前伸展；一位身着黑白绿色服装的灰白色狼少年，站在中心后方，指向斜上方；一位身着黑白粉色服装的白兔少女，拥有长长的兔耳、毛茸茸的尾巴、短裙层叠设计，一只手臂高举，摆出偶像姿势；以及一位身着海军蓝配金色服装的棕熊少年，以酷炫的回眸姿势站立，一只手臂向侧面伸展。所有角色均应具备生动的动漫面部表情、毛茸茸的皮毛渲染、细致的尾巴和爪子，以及高端精致的插画质量。

为每套服装赋予独特的强调色：左侧狼为蓝色，狐狸为橙色，中间狼为绿色，兔子为粉色，熊为金色。服装应融合偶像时尚与奇幻军事舞台风格：修身夹克或背心、不对称拼接、短裤或层叠短裙、束带、金属饰边、悬挂链条、装饰绳索及图案面料拼接。角色应看起来像一个名为 {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"} 的统一偶像团体。使用 {argument name="stage lighting color" default="紫色和蓝色"} 作为主导灯光色调，辅以来自上方的明亮白色聚光灯和柔和的镜头光晕。在后方屏幕上放置 {argument name="emblem design" default="星形徽章内嵌爪印及月桂枝"}。整体风格应为 {argument name="art style" default="高细节动漫偶像宣传插画"}，氛围应呈现出 {argument name="performance mood" default="现场演出高潮时刻"} 的感觉。

templates.title: Clean Photo of The Last Supper Fresco

titleLocalized.zh: 《最后的晚餐》壁画高清修复照片

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of The Last Supper, recreate the same mural as a clean, straightforward full-frame photograph of the artwork itself. Keep the original composition, the 13 seated figures, the long table, the architectural room, and the aged fresco texture unchanged, but remove the museum-like presentation cues from the reference: eliminate the face blurring on all 13 figures, remove the large foreground barrier/plinth blocking the bottom center, and crop/compose it as a more natural documentary photo of the painting with the lower table and floor visible. Maintain the worn, faded Renaissance colors, frontal viewpoint, and realistic art-photography look.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的《最后的晚餐》参考图像，将该壁画重构为一张清晰、直观的艺术品全画幅照片。保持原始构图、13 位人物、长桌、建筑空间以及古老壁画的纹理不变，但去除参考图中博物馆式的展示干扰：消除 13 位人物面部的模糊效果，移除遮挡底部中央的大型前景障碍物/基座，并将其裁剪/构图为一张更自然的艺术纪录片照片，使下方的桌子和地面可见。保持文艺复兴时期褪色的色彩、正面视角以及写实的艺术摄影质感。

templates.title: Japanese Horror Game Street Reflection

titleLocalized.zh: 日式恐怖游戏街道倒影

templates.prompt: A cinematic Japanese psychological horror game screenshot at night, shown from a third-person over-the-shoulder perspective behind a young man wearing a dark hooded jacket, standing under a convenience store awning and staring into a large front window. In the glass, instead of a normal reflection, there is a terrifying humanoid figure with an unnaturally elongated oval head, long straight black hair hanging down both sides, a pale expressionless face, and a dark coat, standing directly opposite him. Beyond the reflection is a wet urban street in Japan with glossy rain-soaked asphalt, sparse pedestrians holding umbrellas, dim storefronts, vending machines, parking signs, and tall buildings bending inward in a surreal warped perspective toward a dark swirling vortex in the sky at the end of the street. The convenience store window ledge displays exactly 5 visible magazine covers lined up side by side and exactly 8 instant food items or cup noodles stacked on the lower right. Add subtle in-game UI text in Japanese: exactly 2 objective lines in the upper left, and exactly 2 small action prompts in the lower left. Include readable Japanese street posters and shop signs, such as a large red staff recruitment sign on the upper right and a yellow points campaign sign on the lower right. Lighting is extremely dark, moody, and realistic, with reflections, deep shadows, damp textures, and a faint cold glow from interior lights and street lamps. Style: ultra-realistic survival horror video game, unsettling, grounded, detailed, cinematic, high contrast, eerie silence, no exaggerated action, no bright colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感十足的日式心理恐怖游戏夜间截图，采用第三人称越肩视角，镜头位于一名身穿深色连帽夹克的年轻男子身后，他正站在便利店遮阳棚下，凝视着巨大的前窗。玻璃中映出的并非正常的倒影，而是一个恐怖的人形生物，它有着不自然拉长的椭圆形头部、垂在两侧的长直黑发、苍白且面无表情的脸庞以及一件深色外套，正与他面对面站立。倒影之外是日本潮湿的城市街道，路面沥青在雨水浸润下闪闪发光，行人稀疏地撑着伞，街道两旁是昏暗的店面、自动贩卖机、停车标志，高楼大厦以超现实的扭曲视角向街道尽头天空中一个黑暗的漩涡弯曲。便利店窗台上整齐排列着 5 本清晰可见的杂志封面，右下角堆放着 8 件速食食品或杯面。添加细微的日文游戏内 UI 文字：左上角 2 行任务目标，左下角 2 个小型动作提示。包含可辨认的日文街道海报和商店招牌，例如右上角醒目的红色员工招聘广告和右下角的黄色积分活动标志。光影极其昏暗、压抑且写实，伴有倒影、深邃的阴影、潮湿的质感，以及来自室内灯光和路灯微弱的冷光。风格：超写实生存恐怖电子游戏，令人不安、写实、细节丰富、电影感、高对比度、诡异的寂静，无夸张动作，无鲜艳色彩。

templates.title: Japanese Apartment Horror Game Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 日式公寓恐怖游戏截图

templates.prompt: A realistic first-person horror game screenshot set in a narrow, dimly lit Japanese apartment corridor at night, viewed from slightly behind a lone human figure standing in the hallway. The figure is a young woman with straight dark shoulder-length hair, seen mostly in silhouette from the back, wearing a dark hoodie and a backpack, facing forward toward the end of the corridor. The setting is an older concrete apartment building interior with glossy reflective floor tiles, stained off-white walls, multiple apartment doors on both sides, and a cold fluorescent ceiling light receding into the distance. One apartment door on the right side is slightly open, emitting a vivid supernatural purple glow that spills into the hallway and creates rippling light patterns across the wall and floor. On the left foreground, include 2 beverage vending machines with illuminated rows of drinks. Also on the left wall, place a black sign with large Japanese text reading "事故物件", smaller text beneath, and a visible QR code. On the right wall, include a bulletin board and 4 posted notices: a warning-style poster with large red Japanese text, a dense text notice, a moving-service flyer with bold red text and phone numbers, and a vertical anti-crime sign. At the lower right, place a small magazine rack or stand holding several pamphlets, with the front magazine showing Japanese text including "月刊オカルト". Through the far end of the corridor, show a balcony railing and distant city lights. Add an in-game HUD overlay to make it look like a captured indie horror game screen: top left mission text in Japanese with 2 lines, including a green progress counter "2/5"; top right a digital time display "23:47" and date "2024/04/11"; bottom left a camcorder interface with Japanese text, a red recording dot, "4K", and "60FPS"; bottom right green Japanese collection text and a row of 4 inventory slots with only 2 occupied icons. Cinematic composition, moody shadows, photorealistic textures, subtle film grain, surveillance-camera and found-footage atmosphere, ominous supernatural tension, purple and blue-black color palette, realistic Japanese typography, ultra-detailed indie survival horror aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的恐怖游戏第一人称视角截图，场景设定在夜晚狭窄且光线昏暗的日式公寓走廊中，视角位于走廊内一名孤独身影的后方。该身影为一名留着黑色齐肩直发的年轻女性，背影多为剪影，身穿深色连帽衫并背着背包，面向走廊尽头。场景为一栋老旧的混凝土公寓内部，铺设着光亮的反射地砖，墙壁呈污渍斑斑的灰白色，两侧有多扇公寓门，冷色的荧光吸顶灯向远处延伸。右侧的一扇公寓门微微敞开，散发出强烈的超自然紫色光芒，光线溢出到走廊中，在墙壁和地面上形成波纹状的光影。左侧前景处包含 2 台带有发光饮料陈列的自动售货机。左侧墙上放置一块黑色标牌，上面印有醒目的日文“事故物件”、下方的较小文字以及一个清晰的二维码。右侧墙上设有一个项目，并张贴了 4 张告示：一张带有醒目红色日文的警告类海报、一张密集的文字通知、一张印有粗体红色文字和电话号码的搬家服务传单，以及一块垂直的防范犯罪告示牌。右下角放置一个小型杂志架，上面摆放着几本小册子，最前面的杂志封面上印有包含“月刊オカルト”在内的日文。通过走廊尽头，可以看到阳台栏杆和远处的城市灯光。添加游戏内 HUD 覆盖层，使其看起来像是一张截取的独立恐怖游戏画面：左上角为 2 行日文任务文本，包含一个绿色的进度计数器“2/5”；右上角显示数字时间“23:47”和日期“2024/04/11”；左下角为带有日文的摄像机界面，包含一个红色录制点、“4K”和“60FPS”字样；右下角为绿色的日文收集文本，以及一行 4 个物品栏槽位，其中仅有 2 个槽位显示图标。电影级构图，阴郁的阴影，写实的纹理，细腻的胶片颗粒感，监控摄像头与伪纪录片氛围，不祥的超自然张力，紫色与蓝黑色的色调，真实的日式排版，超细节的独立生存恐怖美学。

templates.title: Japanese Office Horror Game Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 日式办公室恐怖游戏截图

templates.prompt: A first-person survival horror game screenshot set in a dark abandoned Japanese office at night, viewed from the player’s eye level as if standing beside a cubicle desk. In the lower left foreground, show 1 outstretched human hand reaching cautiously into frame. The central foreground is a small white office desk lit by a harsh focused overhead light, creating deep shadows and a tense cinematic atmosphere. On the desk place exactly 7 visible desktop elements: 1 red stapler floating slightly above or oddly hovering over the desk, 1 messy stack of papers and newspapers, 1 loose folded sheet, 1 black smartphone, 2 pens lying separately, and 1 black mesh pen cup holding several pens. Behind the desk is a gray cubicle wall with exactly 3 posted items: 1 yellow sticky note with handwritten Japanese scribbles, 1 white Japanese office notice about saving electricity with a simple lightbulb illustration, and 1 blue corporate cityscape poster with Japanese text. On the right side of the desk area place exactly 4 upright office storage items: 3 thick binders or file books, one with a prominent label reading 15 and another with Japanese vertical text, plus 1 small plastic drawer unit. In the front-right foreground place 1 freestanding desk sign with Japanese text and a prohibition symbol. In the left background show 1 brightly lit vending machine glowing cold white-blue, with a few cardboard boxes and trash bags on the floor nearby. The office extends into a long aisle of cubicles and shelves, cluttered with scattered papers on the floor, fading into darkness. In the far center background, place 1 lone human silhouette standing motionless at the end of the corridor, backlit by dim bluish window light from the distant city. Add subtle game HUD elements at the bottom center with 2 interaction prompts in Japanese, each with a controller button icon, to make it unmistakably a modern horror video game screenshot. Use realistic 3D rendering, ultra-detailed environmental storytelling, moody blue-black color grading, soft volumetric darkness, strong contrast, eerie empty office ambience, and a sense of meaningless but unsettling supernatural presence.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张第一人称生存恐怖游戏截图，背景设定在深夜昏暗且废弃的日式办公室中，视角为玩家平视高度，仿佛正站在办公隔间旁。左下角前景展示 1 只伸出的人手，正小心翼翼地探入画面。画面中央前景是一张白色办公桌，上方强烈的聚光灯投下深邃的阴影，营造出紧张的电影感氛围。桌面上需精确放置 7 个可见的桌面元素：1 个悬浮在桌面上方或诡异漂浮的红色订书机、1 叠杂乱的纸张和报纸、1 张折叠的散纸、1 部黑色智能手机、2 支分开摆放的笔，以及 1 个装有几支笔的黑色网格笔筒。桌后是灰色的隔间墙，墙上贴有 3 件物品：1 张写有日文乱涂乱画的黄色便签、1 张带有简单灯泡插图的日式节电通知，以及 1 张带有日文的蓝色企业城市景观海报。办公桌右侧放置 4 件直立的办公收纳用品：3 本厚文件夹或档案书，其中一本贴有醒目的“15”标签，另一本带有日文竖排文字，此外还有 1 个小型塑料抽屉柜。右前方前景放置 1 个带有日文和禁止符号的独立桌面立牌。左侧背景展示 1 台发出冷白蓝色光芒的自动售货机，附近地板上散落着几个纸箱和垃圾袋。办公室延伸出一条长长的隔间与书架通道，地板上散落着纸张，逐渐隐入黑暗。在远处的中央背景中，放置 1 个孤独的人影，静止地站在走廊尽头，被远处城市透出的微弱蓝色窗光勾勒出轮廓。在底部中央添加细微的游戏 HUD 元素，包含 2 个日文交互提示，每个提示旁配有手柄按键图标，使其看起来像是一张现代恐怖游戏截图。采用逼真的 3D 渲染，超精细的环境叙事，冷蓝黑色的调色风格，柔和的体积光黑暗效果，强烈的对比度，诡异的空旷办公室氛围，以及一种无意义但令人不安的超自然存在感。

templates.title: Japanese Horror Game Inventory Screen

titleLocalized.zh: 日式恐怖游戏物品栏界面

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic survival-horror game inventory screen in Japanese, styled like a realistic modern console UI over a moody nighttime city background. The scene shows a rain-soaked urban intersection with 1 leaning high-rise building in the center background, 1 full moon in a cloudy sky, 1 glowing red traffic light, 1 red neon sign, 1 parked car, 1 vending machine on the far right, and 4 distant human silhouettes including 1 person holding an umbrella. The entire image has a gritty, low-key, bluish-black palette with subtle scanlines, soft bloom, wet reflections, and a tense occult atmosphere. The interface has a top navigation bar with 4 Japanese tabs labeled "所持品", "記録", "資料", "設定", plus 2 shoulder button hints labeled "L1" and "R1". On the left is an inventory grid under the label "重要アイテム" containing 6 visible slots arranged as 3 columns by 2 rows; the top row contains exactly 3 items, each with a small quantity number "1": an old key labeled "古びた鍵", a dented flashlight labeled "歪んだ懐中電灯", and an hourglass labeled "無音の砂時計". The selected slot is the old key, highlighted with a thin neon-magenta border. The bottom row shows 3 empty dark placeholder slots with faint X marks. Beneath the grid is 1 green ECG-like status indicator labeled "正常". In the lower left is an objectives panel labeled "目標" with 1 objective line: "駅前の異変の原因を調査する". In the center-bottom foreground, partially under the UI, place 1 spiral notebook opened to a page with the handwritten Japanese title "鍵の儀式" and 3 short ritual note lines, plus a hand-drawn occult circle symbol. Next to it place 1 beverage can labeled "ゼリ" and 1 small price tag card reading "おすすめ品 ¥298". On the right side, create a large item detail panel for the selected object, with the item name in magenta "古びた鍵" and a category line "分類：重要アイテム". Show a large detailed render of the rusty antique key, iron-like, worn, reddish-brown corrosion, ornate round bow with clover-like openings, and a jagged bit. Below it include 3 short Japanese description lines about it being a ritual-shaped key of unknown purpose, and at the bottom add a quoted note in magenta: "扉は開くべきものではない。閉じるべきものでもない。" followed by "― 書き殴られたメモより". In the lower right corner add 2 control prompts: "✕ 調べる" and "◯ 戻る". Make the composition feel like a polished AAA horror game screenshot, realistic UI, eerie lore-heavy item design, high contrast, subtle neon magenta accents, and a mysterious meaningless-but-plausible occult game logic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑暗、电影质感的日式生存恐怖游戏物品栏界面，采用逼真的现代主机 UI 风格，背景为阴郁的夜间城市。场景展示了一个雨水浸润的城市十字路口，背景中央有一栋倾斜的高层建筑，多云的天空中挂着一轮满月，还有 1 个发光的红色交通信号灯、1 个红色霓虹灯招牌、1 辆停放的汽车、最右侧有 1 台自动售货机，以及 4 个远处的行人剪影，其中 1 人撑着雨伞。整张图像呈现出粗砺、低调的蓝黑色调，带有细微的扫描线、柔和的泛光效果、湿润的反射以及紧张的神秘学氛围。界面顶部导航栏设有 4 个日文标签：“所持品”、“记录”、“资料”、“设定”，以及标有“L1”和“R1”的 2 个肩键提示。左侧为标签为“重要アイテム”的物品栏网格，包含 3 列 2 行共 6 个可见槽位；顶行包含 3 个物品，每个物品均带有数量“1”：标有“古びた鍵”的旧钥匙、标有“歪んだ懐中電灯”的破损手电筒，以及标有“無音の砂時計”的沙漏。当前选中的槽位为旧钥匙，并带有细细的霓虹洋红色边框。底行显示 3 个带有淡淡 X 标记的深色空槽位。网格下方有 1 个标为“正常”的绿色心电图式状态指示器。左下角是标为“目標”的任务面板，包含 1 行任务：“駅前の異変の原因を調査する”。在画面中下部前景、UI 下方，放置 1 本翻开的螺旋笔记本，页面上有手写的日文标题“鍵の儀式”和 3 行简短的仪式笔记，以及一个手绘的神秘学圆圈符号。旁边放置 1 罐标有“ゼリ”的饮料和 1 张写着“おすすめ品 ¥298”的小价签。右侧创建一个大型物品详情面板，用于显示选中的物品，物品名称“古びた鍵”以洋红色显示，分类行显示“分類：重要アイテム”。展示一个锈迹斑斑的古董钥匙的大型精细渲染图，铁质、磨损、带有红褐色锈迹，圆形的钥匙柄上有类似三叶草的镂空设计，钥匙齿部参差不齐。下方包含 3 行简短的日文描述，说明这是一把用途不明的仪式用钥匙，底部添加一行洋红色的引用笔记：“扉は開くべきものではない。閉じるべきものでもない。”，随后标注“― 書き殴られたメモより”。右下角添加 2 个操作提示：“✕ 調べる”和“◯ 戻る”。整体构图需呈现出精致的 AAA 级恐怖游戏截图质感，UI 逼真，物品设计充满诡异的背景故事，高对比度，带有微妙的霓虹洋红色点缀，以及神秘且看似合理但实则无意义的神秘学游戏逻辑。

templates.title: Anime X Battle Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 X 平台对战海报

templates.prompt:
Create a dramatic anime-style social media battle poster inspired by X/Twitter, split vertically down the center into two opposing halves with a glowing lightning-like divide and a huge luminous VS at the bottom center. The composition is a tall smartphone-optimized promotional key visual with dense layered UI cards, speech bubbles, tweet screenshots, reaction counters, and explosive energy effects. At the top center, place a large X logo with the title text "BATTLE" and the Japanese subtitle "Xでレスバ中". The left side is a cool purple and black theme, the right side is a hot red and white theme, with sparks, streaks, embers, and motion lines flying across both sides.

Show 2 anime schoolgirl characters facing off. On the left, a calm, composed girl representing logical rebuttal: long dark black-to-purple gradient hair, straight bangs, pale skin, slim build, black sailor-style school uniform with purple neck ribbon, pleated skirt, black knee socks, loafers, holding a smartphone in one hand and touching her glasses or temple with the other. Her face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur mosaic over the central face area. Her stance is reserved and still. Surround her with purple glowing tweet cards and speech bubbles. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "雲居モヤ @kumoi_moya". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "それ、前提が雑だよね。", "感情だけでは通らないよ。", and "論点、そこじゃない。". Also include exactly 5 smaller purple UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a small comment bubble reading "それな 千代先輩、強すぎ…", 2) a small comment bubble reading "論理的で草 完全に正論パンチ", 3) a like card reading "いいね! 12.8K", 4) a repost card reading "リポスト 9,341", and 5) a dark trend card reading "おすすめトレンド #モヤVSエナ 42,857件のポスト". Add a central dark smartphone tweet panel tilted slightly, showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "それ、前提が雑だよね。", and counters "312", "1,204", and "8,745".

On the right, show an aggressive, fiery girl representing emotional counterattack and confidence: vivid red hair in a high messy side bun with long loose hair, bright teal eyes, fair skin, energetic expression, open shouting mouth, pointing directly toward the opponent with one hand while the other hand rests on her hip. She wears a white blouse, black jumper-style dress or vest dress, oversized red bow tie, white loose socks scrunched around the ankles, and black loafers. Surround her with red glowing tweet cards and notification-style UI. Her display name and handle should appear repeatedly as "緋空エナ @hisora_ena". Include exactly 3 large quoted statement boxes on her side with these Japanese texts: "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", and "逃げてないで答えて!". Also include exactly 6 smaller red UI/comment elements on her side: 1) a top notification badge card reading "通知 99+", 2) a small comment bubble reading "エナちゃん つよすぎるww", 3) a small comment bubble reading "言いたいこと全部言ってくれる!", 4) a like card reading "いいね! 18.7K", 5) a like card reading "いいね! 23.6K", and 6) a repost card reading "リポスト 11.2K". Add a red tweet panel near the center showing her tweet with profile icon, name, handle, the text "ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?", and counters "278", "1,652", and "10.9K".

In the lower middle area, place exactly 3 central dark interface cards bridging both sides: 1) a quote-post card labeled "引用ポスト" showing both users and the exchange "論点、そこじゃない。" and "正論ぶってるだけでしょ!", 2) a reply count card reading "返信 1,876件", and 3) a bottom navigation bar styled like the X mobile app with home, search, notifications, messages icons and a blue button labeled "ポスト". The overall aesthetic should be glossy, high-contrast, highly rendered anime illustration with neon edge lighting, intense backlighting, dynamic perspective, layered translucency, and a chaotic viral-internet argument atmosphere. Use crisp Japanese UI typography, dramatic red-vs-purple color contrast, and polished promotional-poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张受 X/Twitter 启发、极具戏剧性的动漫风格社交媒体对战海报，画面从中心垂直分割为两个对立面，中间由一道发光的闪电状裂痕隔开，底部中心有一个巨大的发光“VS”字样。构图为适合智能手机展示的竖版宣传主视觉图，包含密集的层叠 UI 卡片、对话气泡、推文截图、反应计数器和爆炸性能量特效。在顶部中心放置一个巨大的 X Logo，并配上标题文本“BATTLE”以及日文副标题“Xでレスバ中”。左侧为冷色调的紫黑主题，右侧为暖色调的红白主题，火花、光束、余烬和动态线条在两侧穿梭。

展示 2 名动漫女高中生角色对峙的场景。左侧是冷静沉着的女生，代表逻辑反驳：留着黑色渐变至紫色的长发，平刘海，皮肤白皙，身材苗条，身穿黑色水手服风格校服，配紫色领结、百褶裙、黑色过膝袜和乐福鞋，一只手拿着智能手机，另一只手触碰眼镜或太阳穴。她的面部被矩形模糊马赛克遮挡。她的姿态矜持且静止。周围环绕着紫色发光的推文卡片和对话气泡。她的显示名称和账号应反复出现为“雲居モヤ @kumoi_moya”。在她的侧面放置 3 个大型引用语句框，内容分别为日文：“それ、前提が雑だよね。”、“感情だけでは通らないよ。”以及“論点、そこじゃない。”。此外，在她的侧面包含 5 个较小的紫色 UI/评论元素：1) 一个写着“それな 千代先輩、強すぎ…”的小评论气泡，2) 一个写着“論理的で草 完全に正論パンチ”的小评论气泡，3) 一张写着“いいね! 12.8K”的点赞卡，4) 一张写着“リポスト 9,341”的转发卡，以及 5) 一张写着“おすすめトレンド #モヤVSエナ 42,857件のポスト”的深色趋势卡。添加一个位于中心、略微倾斜的深色智能手机推文面板，显示她的推文（包含头像、姓名、账号）、文本“それ、前提が雑だよね。”以及计数器“312”、“1,204”和“8,745”。

右侧展示一名充满攻击性、火热的女生，代表情感反击和自信：鲜艳的红色头发扎成高高的凌乱侧丸子头，留着长碎发，明亮的青色眼睛，皮肤白皙，表情充满活力，张嘴大喊，一只手直指对手，另一只手叉腰。她身穿白色衬衫、黑色背心裙，配超大红色领结、堆堆袜和黑色乐福鞋。周围环绕着红色发光的推文卡片和通知风格的 UI。她的显示名称和账号应反复出现为“緋空エナ @hisora_ena”。在她的侧面放置 3 个大型引用语句框，内容分别为日文：“ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?”、“正論ぶってるだけでしょ!”以及“逃げてないで答えて!”。此外，在她的侧面包含 6 个较小的红色 UI/评论元素：1) 一张写着“通知 99+”的顶部通知徽章卡，2) 一个写着“エナちゃん つよすぎるww”的小评论气泡，3) 一个写着“言いたいこと全部言ってくれる!”的小评论气泡，4) 一张写着“いいね! 18.7K”的点赞卡，5) 一张写着“いいね! 23.6K”的点赞卡，以及 6) 一张写着“リポスト 11.2K”的转发卡。在中心附近添加一个红色推文面板，显示她的推文（包含头像、姓名、账号）、文本“ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?”以及计数器“278”、“1,652”和“10.9K”。

在下方中间区域，放置 3 个连接两侧的深色中央界面卡片：1) 一张标记为“引用ポスト”的引用推文卡，展示两位用户及交流内容“論点、そこじゃない。”和“正論ぶってるだけでしょ!”，2) 一张写着“返信 1,876件”的回复计数卡，以及 3) 一个仿照 X 移动端 App 样式的底部导航栏，包含主页、搜索、通知、消息图标和一个标记为“ポスト”的蓝色按钮。整体美学应呈现出光泽感、高对比度、高渲染度的动漫插画风格，带有霓虹边缘光、强烈的背光、动态透视、层叠的半透明效果以及混乱的病毒式互联网争论氛围。使用清晰的日文 UI 字体，强烈的红紫对比色，以及精美的宣传海报级画质。

templates.title: Anime Girl and Man Date Photo Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女与男子的约会照片拼贴

templates.prompt: A 4x4 photo collage of 16 warm, cinematic lifestyle snapshots featuring a real adult man and an anime-style young woman companion posed together as if in casual date photos. The man has short dark hair, light skin, an average build, and wears a plain dark navy or black long-sleeve shirt; his face is intentionally obscured and softly blurred in every frame. The anime girl has long blonde twin ponytails, large blue eyes, light skin, and a slim petite build, wearing a black sleeveless top, layered silver necklaces including a cross pendant, black wrist accessories, a red plaid pleated mini skirt, and black-and-white striped thigh-high socks. Blend realistic photography with a convincingly integrated 2D anime character, keeping her clean cel-shaded look while matching the scene lighting, perspective, focus, and color grading so she appears naturally present beside him. Use moody evening tones, soft bokeh, shallow depth of field, and intimate candid couple energy. The 16 panels are: 1) close indoor portrait with both seated close together, the girl resting beside him; 2) nighttime city street side profile conversation under blurred streetlights; 3) indoors, both reading a book together, the girl leaning on his shoulder; 4) outdoor cafe table, both holding takeaway coffee cups; 5) restaurant table with multiple dishes visible, dining together; 6) mirror selfie in an elevator, the man holding a smartphone while the girl makes a peace sign; 7) car interior road-trip shot, the man driving and the anime girl in the passenger seat; 8) seaside sunset from behind, both sitting side by side watching the ocean; 9) neon-lit city night portrait, the girl pointing toward the camera; 10) intimate elevator close-up, the girl with eyes closed leaning affectionately against him; 11) full mirror selfie in an elevator showing more of both outfits; 12) night city skyline portrait with a lit tower in the background; 13) camera selfie close-up, the man holding a compact camera toward a mirror or reflective surface; 14) cozy indoor lounge moment, the man holding a glass of red wine while the girl smiles and makes a peace sign; 15) rear full-body rainy night street shot, the pair walking away hand in hand under glowing streetlights; 16) extreme close-up night portrait with the girl flashing a peace sign. Keep the collage tightly gridded with thin white dividers, square overall format, consistent amber-brown color grading, romantic urban realism, and subtle social-media photo-dump aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 4x4 的照片拼贴，包含 16 张温馨的电影质感生活照，主角为一名真实成年男子和一名动漫风格的少女伴侣，两人如同在拍摄随意的约会照片。男子留着深色短发，肤色白皙，身材匀称，身穿深蓝色或黑色纯色长袖衬衫；他的面部在每一帧中都被刻意遮挡并进行了柔焦模糊处理。动漫少女留着金色长双马尾，拥有蓝色大眼睛，肤色白皙，身材娇小，身穿黑色无袖上衣，佩戴多层银色项链（含十字架吊坠）和黑色腕饰，下身穿着红色格纹百褶短裙，搭配黑白条纹过膝袜。将写实摄影与自然融合的 2D 动漫角色相结合，保留她清晰的赛璐珞风格，同时匹配场景光影、透视、焦距和色彩分级，使她看起来自然地出现在他身边。采用忧郁的夜色调、柔和的焦外成像、浅景深以及亲密的抓拍情侣氛围。16 个画面分别为：1) 室内近景肖像，两人紧挨着坐在一起，女孩靠在他身边；2) 夜间城市街道侧面交谈，背景是模糊的街灯；3) 室内，两人一起看书，女孩靠在他的肩膀上；4) 户外咖啡桌，两人手持外带咖啡杯；5) 餐厅餐桌，桌上摆满菜肴，两人正在用餐；6) 电梯镜面自拍，男子拿着手机，女孩比着剪刀手；7) 车内公路旅行视角，男子驾驶，动漫少女坐在副驾驶座；8) 海边日落背影，两人并肩坐着看海；9) 霓虹闪烁的城市夜景肖像，女孩指向镜头；10) 电梯内亲密特写，女孩闭着眼睛深情地靠在他身上；11) 电梯内全身镜面自拍，展示两人完整的穿搭；12) 以发光塔为背景的城市夜景天际线肖像；13) 相机自拍特写，男子对着镜子或反射面举着小型相机；14) 舒适的室内休息时刻，男子手持红酒杯，女孩微笑着比出剪刀手；15) 雨夜街道背影全身照，两人在发光的街灯下牵手离去；16) 夜间近距离肖像，女孩比出剪刀手。保持拼贴画紧凑的网格布局，带有细白色分割线，整体为正方形格式，统一采用琥珀棕色调，营造浪漫的城市写实感和微妙的社交媒体“照片堆”美学。

templates.title: Brutal Red-Kimono Manga Fight Page

titleLocalized.zh: 残酷的红衣和服漫画战斗页面

templates.prompt: A gritty black-and-white manga action page with selective red color on the heroine’s clothing, arranged as 6 comic panels with dynamic diagonal borders on a white page. The central and largest panel shows a fierce young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair and blunt bangs, wearing a short red kimono-style robe with a wide golden obi sash, barefoot, delivering a high vertical kick into a burly man’s face; her face is obscured by a soft square blur, and the impact explodes with ink splatter and debris. In the top-left panel, the same woman crouches low in a feral fighting stance on cracked ground, one hand touching the earth, hair streaming outward, robe open enough to show powerful legs. A narrow close-up panel shows only her intense eyes under straight bangs, cold and focused. In the bottom-left panel, she drives a straight punch into an attacker with a dramatic burst effect at the point of contact. In the bottom-center panel, she performs a rising kick or sweeping upward strike against another large male opponent, with speed lines and hair flowing. In the bottom-right panel, shown from behind, she stands calmly amid defeated men lying on the ground with smoke or dust rising around them, her long hair cascading down her back and the red robe hanging loosely. Use rough ink brushwork, heavy speed lines, splattered impact effects, high-contrast manga shading, violent kinetic composition, and bold Japanese sound effect lettering in black. The mood is brutal, cinematic, and relentless, like a seinen revenge manga. Keep the page mostly monochrome except for the woman’s red robe and subtle warm sash accents.

promptLocalized.zh: 一页粗犷的黑白漫画动作页面，女主角的服装带有局部红色点缀，采用 6 格漫画布局，页面上分布着动态的对角线边框。中央最大的分镜展示了一位留着长直发、齐刘海的凶猛年轻女性，她身穿短款红色和服式长袍，系着宽大的金色腰带，赤着双脚，正向一名魁梧男子的脸部踢出高难度的垂直踢；她的面部被柔和的方块模糊处理，冲击瞬间伴随着墨迹飞溅和碎片四散。左上方的分镜中，同一位女性在开裂的地面上以野性的战斗姿态低蹲，一只手触碰地面，长发向外飘散，长袍敞开，露出强有力的双腿。一个狭窄的特写分镜仅展示了她齐刘海下冷峻且专注的双眼。左下方的分镜中，她向一名攻击者挥出直拳，接触点伴随着强烈的爆发效果。底部中央的分镜中，她对另一名高大的男性对手施展上踢或横扫攻击，画面中充满速度线和飘动的长发。右下方的分镜中，从背后视角展示她平静地站在倒地的敌人中间，周围烟尘升起，长发垂在背部，红色长袍松散地挂在身上。采用粗犷的墨水笔触、厚重的速度线、飞溅的冲击效果、高对比度的漫画阴影、极具动感的构图，以及黑色的粗体日文拟声词。整体氛围残酷、具有电影感且毫不留情，如同青年复仇漫画。除女性的红色长袍和腰带的细微暖色点缀外，页面其余部分保持单色。

templates.title: Dark Moonlit Noir Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑月光黑色电影风格专辑封面

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic album-cover-style scene inside a high-rise room at night, viewed from a moody interior looking out over a vast modern city filled with dense skyscraper lights. On the left side, a solitary man sits slouched beside a tall rain-speckled window, his face obscured in deep shadow and cigarette smoke drifting upward, wearing a dark suit or open-collar dress shirt with a disheveled, brooding presence. In the lower left foreground, place exactly 2 liquor bottles, 1 short tumbler glass with amber whiskey, and a cluttered tabletop reflecting low warm light. Outside the giant window on the right, a winged human figure with large black feathered wings hovers or descends over the city, silhouetted dramatically against a huge luminous full moon surrounded by torn clouds and faint sparkling particles in the sky. The palette is nearly monochrome with cold blue-black shadows and small warm amber highlights from the drink and room lights. Add layered atmospheric haze, smoke, wet glass texture, dramatic contrast, realistic photography blended with dark fantasy, luxury noir, melancholic and dangerous mood. Across the lower middle, overlay large ornate serif title typography reading {argument name="title text" default="Soul King D'Ryoichi"}, with a decorative crown and flourishes integrated into the lettering. Beneath it, add a smaller elegant Japanese subtitle line reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="見上げた月は存外に綺麗で"}. Make it look like a premium music single cover or visual for lyrics, highly detailed, polished, cinematic, centered composition, square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑、电影质感的专辑封面风格场景，视角位于夜晚的高层房间内，从充满情绪感的室内向外望去，俯瞰着灯火通明的广阔现代城市。在左侧，一名孤独的男子瘫坐在布满雨点的落地窗旁，他的脸庞隐没在深沉的阴影中，烟雾向上缭绕，他身着深色西装或敞开领口的衬衫，显得凌乱而忧郁。在左下角的前景中，放置 2 个酒瓶、1 个装有琥珀色威士忌的矮玻璃杯，以及一张反射着微弱暖光的杂乱桌面。窗外右侧，一个拥有巨大黑色羽翼的人形生物悬浮或降落在城市上方，在巨大明亮的满月映衬下形成戏剧性的剪影，周围是破碎的云层和天空中闪烁的微光。色调接近单色，以冷蓝黑色的阴影为主，辅以酒水和室内灯光带来的少量琥珀色高光。添加层次感的大气雾气、烟雾、湿润的玻璃质感、强烈的对比度，将写实摄影与暗黑奇幻、奢华黑色电影风格融合，营造出忧郁且危险的氛围。在画面中下部，叠加大型华丽的衬线体标题，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="Soul King D'Ryoichi"}，并在字体中融入装饰性的皇冠和花纹。在其下方，添加一行较小的优雅日语副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="見上げた月は存外に綺麗で"}。使其看起来像是一张高级音乐单曲封面或歌词视觉图，高度细节化、精致、电影感强、构图居中，正方形格式。

templates.title: Japanese AI Product Landing Page Hero

titleLocalized.zh: 日文 AI 产品落地页首屏设计

templates.prompt:
Create a polished Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional premium consumer tech product brand called {argument name="brand name" default="DOKUMI"}. The page should look like a modern beauty-tech and food-safety product website, in a soft warm beige and ivory palette with elegant editorial styling, lots of whitespace, and subtle luxury cosmetics branding. Use a wide desktop web layout screenshot with a top navigation bar, a large left-aligned headline block, and a right-side lifestyle product photo composition.

The top header contains 8 visible navigation elements in a single row: the brand logo text "DOKUMI" at far left, then "ABOUT", "PRODUCT", "FEATURE", "INGREDIENT", "VOICE", "Q&A", then a small user account icon, and a rounded red call-to-action button labeled "今すぐ購入する" at the far right. Beneath the button area on the upper right, add a vertical red ribbon badge with white Japanese text reading exactly 4 stacked text groups: "発売記念", "限定", "20%", "OFF", plus small "CAMPAIGN" text below.

The hero section is split into two main columns. On the left, place a very large Japanese headline in elegant Mincho-style serif typography over three lines: "一口目は、", then "AIが先に。" with dramatic scale and generous spacing. Below it, add a smaller two-line Japanese subheading describing AI-based detection of food toxins, foreign substances, and allergens before eating, in a refined gray tone. Under that, place 2 horizontal CTA buttons: a filled red rounded button labeled "今すぐ始める" with a right arrow, and a white outlined rounded button labeled "詳しく見る" with a right arrow.

Below the buttons, add a row of 3 rounded white feature cards with thin borders and simple black line icons. The 3 cards are: 1) shield icon with title "AI画像解析" and a smaller subtitle about detecting toxins with high precision, 2) clock icon with title "3秒判定" and a smaller subtitle about instant results just by holding it up, 3) smartphone icon with title "スマホ連携" and a smaller subtitle about automatic history saving in the app.

At the bottom of the hero, add a row of 3 statistic cards with rounded corners and thin borders. The 3 cards read: 1) "累計販売台数※1" with large number "23,500" and smaller "台突破", 2) "満足度※2" with large number "94.3%", 3) "リピート率※2" with large number "81.2%". To the right of these cards, place 2 small footnote lines in Japanese: "※1 2026年4月時点 自社調べ" and "※2 2026年3月調査 N=180".

On the right side, create a soft, glamorous lifestyle photo scene. Show a stylish young woman with shoulder-length softly curled brown hair, fair skin, and a large red polka-dot bow headband. She wears an off-shoulder white ruffled blouse and rests her face lightly on one hand at a glossy tabletop. Her face is obscured by a centered rectangular skin-tone privacy block. In front of her on the table sits a sleek white handheld scanner device with a rounded vertical body and a small dark lens opening near the top rim accented in red. Next to the device is a realistic glossy red apple. Near the device, overlay a dark blue circular callout badge with white Japanese text reading "毒性チェック" and "わずか3秒", with a small plus sign beneath.

Use soft natural window light from the left, faint diagonal light streaks on the background wall, gentle shadows, realistic product rendering, and a premium e-commerce LP aesthetic. The composition should feel clean, aspirational, and slightly playful, like a startup landing page for an unusual AI gadget. Include all visible Japanese text exactly where specified.

promptLocalized.zh:
为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="DOKUMI"} 的虚构高端消费科技品牌，创作一张精致的日文落地页首屏图像。页面应呈现出现代美妆科技与食品安全产品的网站风格，采用柔和的暖米色与象牙白配色，具备优雅的编辑排版、充足的留白以及细腻的奢华美妆品牌感。使用宽屏桌面网页布局截图，包含顶部导航栏、左对齐的大标题块以及右侧的生活方式产品摄影构图。

顶部标题栏包含 8 个可见的导航元素，单行排列：最左侧为品牌 Logo 文字“DOKUMI”，随后依次为“ABOUT”、“PRODUCT”、“FEATURE”、“INGREDIENT”、“VOICE”、“Q&A”，接着是一个小型用户账户图标，最右侧是一个圆角红色行动号召按钮，标签为“今すぐ購入する”。在右上角按钮区域下方，添加一个垂直的红色丝带徽章，内含 4 组堆叠的白色日文文字：“発売記念”、“限定”、“20%”、“OFF”，下方附带较小的“CAMPAIGN”文字。

首屏区域分为两个主要列。左侧放置一个非常大的日文标题，采用优雅的明朝体衬线字体，分三行排列：“一口目は、”、“AIが先に。”，字号宏大且间距宽裕。下方添加一个较小的两行日文副标题，以精致的灰色调描述在进食前通过 AI 检测食物毒素、异物及过敏原的功能。在副标题下方，放置 2 个水平排列的 CTA 按钮：一个填充红色的圆角按钮，标签为“今すぐ始める”，带有一个向右的箭头；另一个为白色轮廓的圆角按钮，标签为“詳しく見る”，带有一个向右的箭头。

在按钮下方，添加一行 3 个带细边框的白色圆角功能卡片，配以简单的黑色线条图标。这 3 个卡片分别是：1) 盾牌图标，标题为“AI画像解析”，副标题为关于高精度检测毒素的描述；2) 时钟图标，标题为“3秒判定”，副标题为关于手持即可瞬间获取结果的描述；3) 智能手机图标，标题为“スマホ連携”，副标题为关于 App 自动保存历史记录的描述。

在首屏底部，添加一行 3 个带圆角和细边框的统计数据卡片。这 3 个卡片内容为：1) “累計販売台数※1”，大数字“23,500”，后接较小的“台突破”；2) “満足度※2”，大数字“94.3%”；3) “リピート率※2”，大数字“81.2%”。在这些卡片右侧，放置 2 行小型日文脚注：“※1 2026年4月時点 自社調べ”以及“※2 2026年3月調査 N=180”。

在右侧，营造一个柔和且充满魅力的生活方式摄影场景。展示一位时尚的年轻女性，留着齐肩微卷棕发，皮肤白皙，佩戴一个红色波点大蝴蝶结发带。她身着露肩白色荷叶边衬衫，单手轻托面部，倚靠在光亮的桌面上。她的面部被一个居中的矩形肤色遮挡块遮住。桌面上放置着一个时尚的白色手持扫描设备，机身呈圆柱状，顶部边缘附近有一个带红色装饰的小型深色镜头开口。设备旁放着一个逼真的亮红色苹果。在设备附近，叠加一个深蓝色圆形标注徽章，内含白色日文文字“毒性チェック”和“わずか3秒”，下方带有一个小加号。

使用来自左侧的柔和自然窗光，背景墙上有淡淡的斜向光影，阴影柔和，产品渲染真实，呈现出高端电商落地页的美感。整体构图应显得简洁、令人向往且略带俏皮，如同一个独特 AI 小工具的初创公司落地页。请包含所有指定位置的可见日文文本。

templates.title: Anime Girl in Straw Hat Under Blue Sky

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝天之下戴草帽的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A serene anime-style summer portrait of a young woman standing outdoors under a vivid blue sky with 4 soft white cloud clusters visible near the frame edges and a few tiny sparkling light specks in the air. She is shown from a low angle, framed from about the waist up, slightly turned to the side while looking calmly toward the viewer with a gentle, quiet expression. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="very dark indigo-black"} hair with full blunt bangs covering the forehead and many loose strands flowing dramatically to the right in the wind, large soft brown-gray eyes, pale skin, and a faint blush on her cheeks. She wears a wide-brimmed natural straw sunhat with a dark band and a simple sleeveless white summer dress with thin straps and minimal detail. Lighting is bright midday sunlight with soft cel-shaded anime rendering, subtle rim light, clean linework, delicate gradients, and a dreamy polished illustration style. The mood is airy, nostalgic, elegant, and peaceful, with the sky filling the background and no buildings or other objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宁静的动漫风格夏季肖像，描绘了一位年轻女性站在户外，背景是湛蓝的天空，画面边缘可见 4 朵柔和的白云，空气中漂浮着些许微小的闪烁光点。画面采用低角度拍摄，取景范围约为腰部以上，她微微侧身，神情平静温柔地注视着观众。她留着一头长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="深靛黑色"} 头发，厚重的齐刘海遮住额头，许多发丝在风中向右飘动，有着大而柔和的棕灰色眼睛、白皙的皮肤，脸颊带着淡淡的红晕。她戴着一顶带有深色饰带的宽檐天然草帽，身穿一件简单的白色无袖夏日连衣裙，细肩带设计，细节简约。光线为明亮的午后阳光，采用柔和的赛璐珞动漫渲染，带有微妙的轮廓光、干净的线条、细腻的渐变以及梦幻般的精致插画风格。整体氛围轻盈、怀旧、优雅且平和，背景由天空填满，没有建筑物或其他杂物。

templates.title: Low-Angle Anime Summer Hand Reach

titleLocalized.zh: 低角度动漫夏季伸手画面

templates.prompt: A dramatic anime-style summer scene viewed from an extreme low angle with strong foreshortening: a young woman in a flowing white sundress and a wide-brim straw hat stands on a sunlit country path and reaches one hand directly toward the camera, her open palm dominating the foreground in exaggerated perspective as if inviting the viewer to take her hand. She has very long {argument name="hair color" default="deep black"} hair streaming powerfully sideways in the wind, and a white ribbon tied to the hat also whips through the air. Her dress is sleeveless, softly pleated, light and breezy, cinched at the waist with a fabric bow on one side, with glossy sunlight highlights on her skin and fabric. The composition emphasizes motion, scale, and cinematic depth, with the character towering against a vivid cobalt summer sky filled with a few wispy cloud streaks and puffy white clouds near the horizon. Place her on a paved rural walkway bordered by rustic wooden fences on both sides, with green fields and distant low mountains in the background. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering with painterly detail, saturated colors, bright midday lighting, high contrast, ultra-clean linework, and a sense of awe and freedom. No text, no additional characters, single-subject illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的动漫风格夏季场景，采用极低角度拍摄，具有强烈的透视缩短效果：一位年轻女性身穿飘逸的白色夏日连衣裙，头戴宽檐草帽，站在阳光明媚的乡村小路上，将一只手直接伸向镜头。她张开的手掌以夸张的透视感占据了前景，仿佛在邀请观众牵住她的手。她有着非常长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑色"} 头发，在风中强劲地向侧面飘动，帽子上系着的白色丝带也在空中飞舞。她的连衣裙为无袖设计，带有柔和的褶皱，轻盈透气，腰间一侧系有布艺蝴蝶结，皮肤和布料上闪烁着明亮的阳光高光。构图强调了动态、尺度感和电影般的深度，角色在充满几缕纤细云丝和地平线附近蓬松白云的钴蓝色夏季天空映衬下显得高大。将她置于一条铺设好的乡村小路上，道路两侧是质朴的木栅栏，背景是绿色的田野和远处的低矮山脉。采用清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染，辅以绘画般的细节、饱和的色彩、明亮的正午光线、高对比度、超干净的线条，营造出一种敬畏与自由的感觉。无文字，无其他角色，单人主题插画。

templates.title: Rural Station Schoolgirl Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 乡村车站女学生场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic anime-style illustration of a quiet rural Japanese train station in early summer, filled with travel nostalgia and bright midday light. In the foreground, one high school girl stands alone on the platform near the left side of the frame, facing slightly toward the viewer with a shy, gentle posture, her legs together and one foot angled inward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short bobbed hair with soft bangs, and wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: a white long-sleeved sailor blouse with navy trim, a vivid red neckerchief, a dark navy pleated skirt, white socks, and dark brown loafers. She holds a dark school bag in one hand at her side. Her expression should feel calm, a little wistful, as if she was just about to speak before the train arrived. Place her beside an old weathered wooden station building with large windowpanes and a simple wooden bench. Above her is 1 hanging station sign reading {argument name="station name" default="山ノ下駅"}, with smaller romanized text “YAMANOSHITA” and small local line information beneath it. The right half of the image opens to 1 set of railway tracks receding into the distance, bordered by lush green grass and wildflowers, with 1 small local train approaching from far down the line. Add a few utility poles running alongside the tracks. In the deep background, show a dramatic mountain range with lingering snow on the peaks under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Composition should balance the girl on the left and the railway perspective on the right, with detailed background scenery, crisp sunlight, soft anime rendering, realistic textures in the station wood and rails, and a heartfelt slice-of-life travel mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影质感的动漫风格插画，描绘了初夏时节宁静的日本乡村火车站，充满旅行的怀旧气息和明亮的正午阳光。画面前景左侧，一位高中女生独自站在站台上，身体微微朝向观众，姿态羞涩而温柔，双腿并拢，一只脚向内侧倾斜。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的短波波头，刘海柔顺，身穿经典的日本水手服校服：白色长袖水手衫搭配海军蓝饰边、鲜红色的领巾、深海军蓝百褶裙、白袜和深棕色乐福鞋。她的一只手垂在身侧，提着一个深色的书包。她的表情应当显得平静而略带一丝惆怅，仿佛在火车进站前正欲开口说话。将她置于一座陈旧的木质车站建筑旁，建筑带有大块窗格和一张简单的木长椅。她上方悬挂着 1 块车站站牌，上面写着 {argument name="station name" default="山ノ下駅"}，下方配有较小的罗马拼音“YAMANOSHITA”以及简短的当地线路信息。画面右半部分延伸出 1 组铁轨，向远方延伸，铁轨旁是郁郁葱葱的草地和野花，远处有 1 列小型地方列车正缓缓驶来。在铁轨旁添加几根电线杆。远景处展现出壮丽的山脉，山顶覆盖着残雪，天空湛蓝，点缀着几朵白云。构图需平衡左侧的人物与右侧的铁轨透视，背景细节丰富，阳光清澈，采用柔和的动漫渲染风格，车站木材与铁轨的质感真实，整体营造出一种真挚的生活片段式旅行氛围。

templates.title: Japanese Skincare Lotion Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 日系护肤水广告

templates.prompt: A high-end Japanese skincare advertisement for a moisturizing lotion, shot in a luminous soft-white studio with a clean airy beauty aesthetic. On the right half of the image, a close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman with flawless dewy skin, natural glossy lips, subtle peach-toned makeup, dark brown eyes, and dark hair loosely tied back with a few wispy strands across her forehead. She smiles gently at the camera and rests one hand against her cheek, wearing a simple white sleeveless top. On the left half, place 1 tall transparent frosted bottle of lotion standing upright on a reflective water surface, with tiny water droplets on the bottle and a shiny silver cap. The bottle label reads "SUIREN" and "MOISTURIZING LOTION". Surround the bottle with 3 pale pink cherry blossoms: 2 clustered at the lower left corner and 1 floating near the bottom center-right. Add faint sparkles and soft reflections in the water. Use a pastel palette of white, pearl, blush pink, and very light blue-gray, with diffused daylight, silky skin retouching, shallow depth of field, and a premium cosmetic campaign look. Include Japanese ad copy on the left in elegant black Mincho-style typography: a large 2-line headline reading "触れたくなる、" and "透明感。"; beneath it, 2 smaller lines reading "うるおい満ちて、" and "澄みわたる素肌へ。"; a thin outlined circle containing 2 stacked phrases with an × between them, "高保湿" and "透明感". In the lower right, add small Japanese text "うるおいが、私を輝かせる。" above the brand name "SUIREN" and the subtitle "MOISTURIZING LOTION". Composition should feel balanced and luxurious, like a magazine-ready spring skincare poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端日系护肤水广告，在明亮柔和的白色影棚中拍摄，呈现出干净、通透的美容美学。画面右侧为一位年轻东亚女性的特写肖像，她拥有无瑕水润的肌肤、自然的亮泽双唇、精致的桃色系妆容、深棕色眼眸，深色长发松散地扎在脑后，额前散落着几缕发丝。她对着镜头温柔微笑，单手托腮，身穿简约的白色无袖上衣。画面左侧放置 1 个高挑的透明磨砂化妆水瓶，直立在反光的水面上，瓶身带有细小的水珠，配有闪亮的银色瓶盖。瓶身标签印有“SUIREN”和“MOISTURIZING LOTION”。在瓶子周围点缀 3 朵淡粉色樱花：2 朵簇拥在左下角，1 朵漂浮在底部中右侧。添加淡淡的闪光和水面柔和的倒影。采用白色、珍珠色、腮红粉和极浅的蓝灰色调，配合漫射日光、丝滑的皮肤修饰、浅景深效果，营造出高级化妆品广告的质感。在左侧添加优雅的黑色明朝体日文文案：大号双行标题为“触れたくなる、”和“透明感。”；下方为两行较小的文字“うるおい満ちて、”和“澄みわたる素肌へ。”；添加一个细线条圆圈，内部包含两行短语，中间用 × 分隔，分别为“高保湿”和“透明感”。在右下角添加小号日文“うるおいが、私を輝かせる。”，下方标注品牌名“SUIREN”及副标题“MOISTURIZING LOTION”。整体构图平衡且奢华，呈现出杂志级春季护肤海报的视觉效果。

templates.title: Pastel Japanese Mobile Game Store Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和日系手游商店截图

templates.prompt: A polished Japanese mobile game promotional graphic in a soft pastel kawaii style, formatted as a square split-screen advertisement with 2 vertical panels side by side. The left half has a pale blush pink watercolor background, and the right half has a warm cream-to-pink gradient background. At the top of the left panel, place a large bold rounded Japanese headline in dark rose pink reading {argument name="left headline text" default="ミルクと、ふわふわ脱出。"}, with a smaller gray subtitle below reading {argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしい謎解きの世界へ"}. Centered below is a black-framed modern smartphone mockup showing the title screen of a cute pastel escape game: a fluffy cream-colored kitten with big watery eyes on a sparkly pink background, decorative bubbles and hearts, a logo in Japanese reading もふもふミルク にゃんこ with a smaller ribbon-like subtitle 脱出ゲーム, and a large rounded start button near the bottom reading はじめる. Around the phone on the pink background, scatter translucent soap bubbles, tiny bows, hearts, and star-shaped sparkles near the lower area. In the right panel, place a large bold rounded Japanese headline in dark rose pink reading {argument name="right headline text" default="謎を解いて、おへやを抜けだそう。"}, with a smaller gray subtitle below reading {argument name="right subtitle text" default="全10ステージの脱出パズル"}. Centered below is a second black-framed smartphone mockup showing in-game play: a dreamy pastel pink room with striped wallpaper, a wooden shelf unit or vanity table, 3 small plush animals lined up on the top shelf, 3 empty square frames or slots on the middle shelf, and 2 small objects on the lower shelf including a pink rectangular item and an angled card-like object. Add a tiny top-left room title inside the phone UI reading ミルクのおへや, a small circular icon at top right, a vertical lock icon on the right edge, and a pale bottom text bar reading アイテムがまだないよ. The entire composition should feel like an App Store screenshot for a gentle puzzle game, with soft lighting, pastel pinks and creams, rounded typography, clean spacing, and a cute feminine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日系手游宣传图，采用柔和的粉彩可爱风格，格式为左右双栏分割的方形广告。左半部分为淡腮红粉色水彩背景，右半部分为暖奶油色至粉色的渐变背景。左侧面板顶部放置一个醒目的深玫瑰粉色圆体日文大标题 {argument name="left headline text" default="ミルクと、ふわふわ脱出。"}，下方配有较小的灰色副标题 {argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしい謎解きの世界へ"}。下方居中放置一个黑色边框的现代智能手机模型，展示可爱粉彩逃脱游戏的标题画面：背景为闪烁的粉色，画面中有一只长着水汪汪大眼睛的毛茸茸奶油色小猫，装饰着气泡和爱心，日文 Logo 显示为“もふもふミルク にゃんこ”，下方带有较小的丝带状副标题“脱出ゲーム”，底部附近有一个圆形的“はじめる”开始按钮。在粉色背景的手机周围，散布着半透明的肥皂泡、小蝴蝶结、爱心和星形闪光。在右侧面板顶部放置一个醒目的深玫瑰粉色圆体日文大标题 {argument name="right headline text" default="謎を解いて、おへやを抜けだそう。"}，下方配有较小的灰色副标题 {argument name="right subtitle text" default="全10ステージの脱出パズル"}。下方居中放置第二个黑色边框的智能手机模型，展示游戏内画面：一个梦幻般的粉彩粉色房间，带有条纹壁纸，配有一个木制架子或梳妆台，顶层架子上排着 3 只小毛绒动物，中间架子上有 3 个空的方形框或槽位，底层架子上有 2 个小物件，包括一个粉色长方形物品和一个倾斜的卡片状物体。手机 UI 左上角添加一个微小的房间标题“ミルクのおへや”，右上角有一个小圆形图标，右侧边缘有一个垂直的锁图标，底部有一个淡色的文字栏，显示“アイテムがまだないよ”。整体构图应呈现出温和解谜游戏的 App Store 截图质感，光线柔和，采用粉彩粉色与奶油色调，搭配圆润的字体、整洁的间距以及可爱且女性化的美学风格。

templates.prompt: Create a cute Japanese mobile game advertisement poster split vertically into 2 equal halves, with a soft pastel watercolor background and glossy translucent bubbles scattered around the canvas. The left half has a mint green to pale yellow wash, and the right half has a cream to blush pink wash. At the top left, place a large rounded Japanese headline in bold teal green: {argument name="left headline text" default="見つけて、ひらめいて、にゃ。"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath it in muted brown-gray: {argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしいヒントで誰でも遊べる"}. At the top right, place a large rounded Japanese headline in bold raspberry pink: {argument name="right headline text" default="ミニゲームも、たっぷり。"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath it in muted mauve-gray: {argument name="right subtitle text" default="記憶・パズル・スライドで遊びほうだい"}. Centered in each half is a black-bezel smartphone mockup shown straight-on. The left phone displays a hidden-object style game screen inside a bright greenhouse sunroom with lush tropical plants, a cream hammock stretched diagonally across the middle, pink tiled floor, warm sunlight through glass panels, hanging pastel glass orbs, lemons in the lower left foreground, and tiny cute character accents hidden in the scene; a Japanese room title appears at the top inside the phone UI: {argument name="left game screen title" default="おひるねサンルーム"}. The right phone displays a memory minigame screen on a pale pink interface with a back arrow, a centered Japanese title at the top reading "マカロン記憶ゲーム", a 3-step indicator showing 1 highlighted and 2 and 3 faded, small instruction text "よく見てにゃ…", and exactly 4 macarons arranged in a 2 by 2 grid: pink top left, blue top right, yellow bottom left, white bottom right, each on a soft circular shadow. Add small sparkling star icons and two decorative macarons at the bottom right outside the phone, plus tiny heart doodles nearby. The overall style is polished app-promo key art, kawaii, airy, elegant, soft-focus, with rounded typography, gentle gradients, subtle floral details, and a premium casual game advertisement look.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的日系手游宣传海报，垂直平分为左右两半，背景采用柔和的水彩画风，画布周围散布着光泽感十足的半透明气泡。左半部分为薄荷绿到浅黄色的渐变，右半部分为奶油色到淡粉色的渐变。左上角放置一个粗体青绿色的圆润日文大标题：{argument name="left headline text" default="見つけて、ひらめいて、にゃ。"}，下方配有较小的柔和棕灰色副标题：{argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしいヒントで誰でも遊べる"}。右上角放置一个粗体树莓粉色的圆润日文大标题：{argument name="right headline text" default="ミニゲームも、たっぷり。"}，下方配有较小的柔和紫灰色副标题：{argument name="right subtitle text" default="記憶・パズル・スライドで遊びほうだい"}。左右两半的中心各放置一台正面朝向的黑色边框智能手机样机。左侧手机屏幕显示一个隐藏物品类游戏画面，场景位于明亮的温室阳光房中，布满茂盛的热带植物，奶油色吊床斜跨在画面中间，地面铺设粉色瓷砖，温暖的阳光透过玻璃窗洒下，挂着柔和的玻璃球，左下角前景处有柠檬，场景中隐藏着可爱的小角色；手机 UI 顶部显示日文房间标题：{argument name="left game screen title" default="おひるねサンルーム"}。右侧手机屏幕显示一个记忆类小游戏界面，背景为淡粉色，带有返回箭头，顶部居中显示日文标题“マカロン記憶ゲーム”，一个 3 步进度指示器（第 1 步高亮，第 2、3 步变灰），下方有小字说明“よく見てにゃ…”，界面中排列着 4 个马卡龙（2x2 网格）：左上粉色、右上蓝色、左下黄色、右下白色，每个马卡龙下方都有柔和的圆形阴影。在手机外右下角添加小星星闪烁图标和两个装饰性马卡龙，并在附近点缀细小的心形涂鸦。整体风格为精致的应用宣传主视觉图，可爱、通透、优雅、柔焦，搭配圆润的字体、细腻的渐变、微妙的花卉细节，呈现出高级休闲游戏的广告质感。

templates.title: Candid Bedroom Lounge Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 卧室休闲抓拍照片

templates.prompt: A candid, softly lit lifestyle photograph of a young woman lounging on a white bed in a minimal bedroom, shot vertically with a slightly wide lens from near her knees so her legs and oversized top dominate the foreground. She is lying on her back diagonally across the bed, wearing an oversized dark navy or black sweatshirt and very short light blue denim cutoff shorts with frayed hems, with bare legs visible in the foreground. Her arms are raised above and around her head in a relaxed, sleepy pose, one wrist bent loosely, and her face is mostly obscured by her arms and angle, giving an unposed, intimate feeling. Place the bed against a pale gray wall, with rumpled white bedding and large white pillows. On the left side near a window with sheer curtains, include a freestanding clothing rack holding exactly 8 visible hangers with neutral-toned clothes in black, white, beige, and gray, plus one blue garment draped over the top bar. On the right side behind the bed, include exactly 7 upright books lined on a narrow surface against the wall. Use natural daylight coming from the left window, soft shadows, muted cool tones, slight film-like grain, shallow depth of field, and a calm Japanese apartment aesthetic. Emphasize a relaxed weekend mood, understated realism, and the subtle sense of a presence caught in a private moment rather than direct eye contact.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍的、光线柔和的生活方式照片，展示了一位年轻女性在极简卧室的白色床上休憩。采用竖构图拍摄，镜头从靠近她膝盖的位置以略微广角拍摄，使她的双腿和超大号上衣在前景中占据主导地位。她斜躺在床上，身穿一件超大号深海军蓝或黑色卫衣，搭配非常短的浅蓝色毛边牛仔短裤，前景中露出双腿。她的双臂举过头顶，姿态放松而慵懒，一只手腕松弛地弯曲，脸部大部分被手臂和拍摄角度遮挡，营造出一种未经摆拍的私密感。床靠在浅灰色墙壁前，铺着褶皱的白色床品和巨大的白色枕头。在左侧靠近带有透明窗帘的窗户旁，放置一个独立的衣架，上面挂着 8 个衣架，展示着黑色、白色、米色和灰色的中性色调服装，上方横杆还披着一件蓝色衣物。在床的右后方，墙边的窄架上整齐排列着 7 本竖放的书籍。利用从左侧窗户射入的自然日光，营造柔和的阴影、柔和的冷色调、轻微的胶片颗粒感、浅景深以及宁静的日式公寓美学。强调放松的周末氛围、低调的写实主义，以及捕捉私密瞬间的微妙存在感，而非直接的眼神交流。

templates.title: Goth Streetwear Anime Icon Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特街头风动漫头像

templates.prompt: A centered anime-style bust portrait of an androgynous young person facing forward against a clean pale gray-white background. The composition is square and designed like a social media icon. The character has medium-length layered straight hair with a center part, mostly black with glossy deep violet highlights and vivid purple-dyed lower sections and tips. Loose strands frame the face and the hair falls to the shoulders. The face is intentionally obscured by a large soft-edged square blur block in the center, tinted muted mauve-gray, covering the eyes, nose, and most facial features while leaving the jawline and neck partly visible. Show only a small hint of pale skin around the edges of the blur. The visible ear on the right side is decorated with multiple silver piercings, including small hoops, studs, and a dangling cross earring with chain details. The outfit is dark monochrome streetwear with a subtle goth aesthetic: a black high-neck zip-up inner layer fully zipped to the throat, a black oversized semi-gloss jacket layered over it, a black strap with a rectangular metal buckle over one shoulder, and a thin chain accessory over the other shoulder. Add a long silver necklace with a cross pendant hanging at the center of the chest. Lighting is soft and diffuse, with polished digital painting detail and semi-realistic anime rendering. The mood is cool, stylish, slightly mysterious, and alternative. In the background, add sparse minimalist cyber-glitch accents: several thin vertical bars and tiny rectangular pixels in pastel cyan, lavender, magenta, and dark blue scattered around the figure, plus one faint four-point sparkle near the upper right side. Keep the background uncluttered and airy, with the character occupying most of the frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的动漫风格半身肖像，描绘了一位中性化的年轻人，正面对着干净的浅灰白色背景。构图为方形，专为社交媒体图标设计。角色留着中长款层次感直发，中分，发色以黑色为主，带有光泽的深紫色高光，发梢和下半部分染有鲜艳的紫色。零散的发丝修饰着脸庞，头发垂至肩部。面部中央被一个大面积的柔边方形模糊块刻意遮挡，色调为柔和的淡紫灰色，遮住了眼睛、鼻子和大部分五官，仅露出部分下颌线和颈部。模糊区域边缘仅隐约透出一点苍白的肤色。右侧可见的耳朵上装饰着多个银色穿孔，包括小圆环、耳钉以及带有链条细节的十字架吊坠耳环。服装为暗黑单色街头风格，带有微妙的哥特美学：内层为拉链拉至喉咙的高领黑色上衣，外搭一件黑色超大款半哑光夹克，一侧肩部配有带矩形金属扣的黑色绑带，另一侧肩部则配有细链条装饰。胸前垂挂着一条带有十字架吊坠的长款银色项链。光线柔和且均匀，呈现出精致的数字绘画细节和半写实动漫渲染效果。整体氛围酷炫、时尚、略带神秘感且风格另类。背景中添加稀疏的极简赛博故障艺术元素：人物周围散布着几条细长的垂直条纹和微小的矩形像素点，颜色为淡青色、薰衣草色、洋红色和深蓝色，右上角附近还有一个淡淡的四角星光点。保持背景简洁通透，人物占据画面主体。

templates.title: Anime BL Promo Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 BL 宣传缩略图

templates.prompt: A bright, polished anime-style promotional thumbnail with a summer romance atmosphere. The composition is split visually, with large typography on the left and two handsome young men on the right. On the left side, place layered translucent white panels with soft glow and sparkles over a sky-blue background, featuring large elegant serif text "GPT" in a blue gradient at the top and "BL" in a lavender-to-violet gradient below. Add three lines of Japanese text arranged between and under them: "最新の画像生成で", "作って", and "遊んでみた", in deep blue calligraphic Japanese type. Include subtle decorative accents such as small star glints, diagonal light streaks, dotted texture, and a cyan underline swoosh beneath the middle text. On the right side, show 2 anime boys from the waist up, leaning casually together beside a chain-link fence under leafy trees. The taller boy has tousled dark brown hair, a navy overshirt worn open over a white T-shirt, layered silver necklaces, and holds 1 plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw. The shorter boy has messy silver-white hair, a white T-shirt with a small crest emblem on the chest, black backpack straps over both shoulders, layered silver necklaces, and one small earring. Their poses are relaxed and intimate, with the dark-haired boy’s arm resting around the other. Use a luminous blue-and-white palette with soft sunlight, lens flare, bokeh, and a faint cityscape in the background, creating a clean social-media header or article thumbnail aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮且精致的动漫风格宣传缩略图，带有夏日浪漫氛围。构图采用视觉分割，左侧为大号排版文字，右侧为两位帅气的年轻男子。在左侧，于天蓝色背景上放置带有柔光和闪烁效果的半透明白色层叠面板，顶部显示蓝色渐变的大号优雅衬线体文字“GPT”，下方为薰衣草色至紫色的渐变文字“BL”。在文字之间及下方排列三行日文：“最新の画像生成で”、“作って”和“遊んでみた”，采用深蓝色书法字体。添加微妙的装饰元素，如小星星闪光、对角线光束、点状纹理，以及中间文字下方的一道青色下划线弧线。在右侧，展示 2 位动漫少年半身像，他们靠在绿树下的铁丝网旁，姿态随意。个子较高的少年留着凌乱的深棕色短发，身穿白色 T 恤外搭海军蓝开衫，佩戴叠层银项链，手持一杯插着吸管的冰咖啡。个子较矮的少年留着凌乱的银白色短发，身穿胸前带有小徽章的白色 T 恤，双肩背着黑色双肩包，佩戴叠层银项链和一只小耳环。他们的姿势轻松亲密，深发少年将手臂搭在另一位少年身上。采用明亮的蓝白配色，辅以柔和的阳光、镜头光晕、虚化效果以及背景中淡淡的城市景观，营造出简洁的社交媒体页眉或文章缩略图美感。

templates.title: Anime Knight King on Burning Battlefield

titleLocalized.zh: 燃烧战场上的动漫骑士王

templates.prompt: A dramatic anime-style fantasy battle illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Artoria Pendragon"}, a young female knight with emerald green eyes and blonde hair styled in a braided bun with loose bangs and a single ahoge, shown in a powerful low-angle medium full-body shot. She stands in the center of the frame gripping a large glowing golden sword with both hands, the blade angled upward along the left side of the image, with ornate blue inlays and faint runic engraving. She wears blue and silver royal armor: a dark cobalt blue dress with gold trim, polished steel breastplate and faulds, heavy armored gauntlets, and layered plate armor over the torso and hips, with parts of the white underskirt torn and dirty from combat. Her expression is stern, focused, and determined, looking directly forward as if facing an enemy. The background is a burning nighttime battlefield under a deep navy sky with heavy clouds and faint stars, filled with embers, flames, ruined structures, broken spears, scattered swords, and wreckage. Include 2 visible flags in the background with blue fabric and gold heraldic emblems, partially tattered and waving in the smoke. Add subtle blood stains and battle damage on the lower armor, sparks drifting through the air, strong cinematic rim lighting from fires behind her, reflective highlights on the metal, and high-contrast heroic composition. Ultra-detailed polished anime illustration, Fate-inspired knight king aesthetic, intense atmosphere, sharp linework, rich blue-and-gold palette, vertical composition, SFW.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的动漫风格奇幻战斗插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="阿尔托莉雅·潘德拉贡"}，一位拥有翠绿色双眸的年轻女骑士，金发梳成编织发髻，留着松散的刘海和一根呆毛，采用强有力的低角度中景全身构图。她站在画面中央，双手紧握一把巨大的发光金剑，剑身沿画面左侧向上倾斜，带有华丽的蓝色镶嵌和淡淡的符文雕刻。她身着蓝银相间的皇家铠甲：深钴蓝色礼服配金色饰边，抛光的钢制胸甲和裙甲，厚重的装甲护手，以及覆盖躯干和臀部的多层板甲，白色的衬裙部分因战斗而破损且沾满污垢。她表情严肃、专注且坚定，直视前方，仿佛正在面对敌人。背景是深海军蓝夜空下的燃烧战场，云层厚重，隐约可见星光，空气中弥漫着余烬、火焰、废墟结构、断裂的长矛、散落的剑和残骸。背景中包含 2 面可见的旗帜，旗面为蓝色，带有金色纹章，部分破损并在烟雾中飘扬。在下部铠甲上添加细微的血迹和战斗损伤，火花在空中飘散，身后火焰产生的强烈电影感轮廓光，金属上的反射高光，以及高对比度的英雄构图。超精细抛光动漫插画，Fate 风格骑士王美学，氛围紧张，线条锐利，蓝金配色丰富，垂直构图，SFW。

templates.title: Elegant Anime Girl on a Flower Street

titleLocalized.zh: 花街上的优雅动漫少女

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime illustration of a fashionable young woman on an elegant daytime outing in a European-style flower street, shown in a full-body to three-quarter standing pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="deep indigo blue"} hair styled in 2 very long twin-tails with soft shine, loose strands, and white rose-and-frill hair accessories tied with black ribbons. She wears a romantic white mini dress with a fitted corset-like bodice, sweetheart neckline, black bow at the chest, layered ruffles, a dramatic asymmetrical overskirt, and white rose decorations at the waist. Her accessories include 1 black choker with a white flower ornament, 1 black armband on the upper arm, 2 white frilled wrist cuffs, 2 black garter straps, 2 sheer black thigh-high stockings with lace tops, and she carries 1 small black handbag. Her expression should feel delicate, elegant, and slightly shy, with one hand lifting a lock of hair and the other holding the bag. Set her in a sunlit cobblestone shopping lane lined with boutique windows, flower planters, and soft pastel architecture, with 2 visible signs reading "Rose Town" and "Rose Garden". Use luminous spring lighting, cool blue-violet shadows, sparkling highlights, abundant floral details, and a polished painterly anime style with a dreamy, refined, high-end illustration finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫插画，描绘了一位时尚年轻女性在欧式花街上优雅出游的场景，采用全身至四分之三身位的站姿。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深靛蓝色"} 的秀发，发型为两根极长的双马尾，带有柔和的光泽和散落的发丝，并配有系着黑色丝带的白玫瑰与荷叶边发饰。她身穿一件浪漫的白色迷你裙，配有修身的束腰式上衣、心形领口、胸前的黑色蝴蝶结、层叠的荷叶边、极具戏剧性的不对称外裙，以及腰间的白玫瑰装饰。她的配饰包括 1 条带有白色花朵装饰的黑色颈圈、1 个上臂黑色臂环、2 个白色荷叶边腕带、2 条黑色吊带袜、2 只带有蕾丝边的透明黑色过膝袜，并手提 1 个黑色小手袋。她的表情应显得细腻、优雅且略带羞涩，一只手轻撩发丝，另一只手提着包。背景设定在阳光明媚的鹅卵石购物巷，街道两旁是精品店橱窗、花坛和柔和的粉彩色建筑，可见 2 块分别写着“Rose Town”和“Rose Garden”的招牌。采用明亮的春日光影、冷蓝紫色的阴影、闪烁的高光、丰富的花卉细节，以及梦幻、精致、高端的动漫绘画风格。

templates.title: Chaotic Fourth Crusade Parody Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 第四次十字军东征混乱恶搞海报

templates.prompt: A chaotic fictional Japanese movie poster themed around world history, designed like a glossy blockbuster comedy-action epic about the Fourth Crusade getting completely lost and attacking Constantinople instead of reaching Jerusalem. The composition is dense, loud, and satirical, with a dramatic historical battlefield collage under a bright blue sky, flames, smoke, medieval ships, domes, city walls, and crusader armies. In the center foreground, a full-body medieval crusader in a dirty white tunic with a large red cross points directly toward the viewer, surrounded by four other medieval figures in ornate robes, hoods, helmets, and merchant-like clothing; their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blurs, making the poster look like a parody cast reveal. Across the top, huge hot-pink Japanese brush lettering reads {argument name="headline text" default="方向性、完全に迷子。"}, with smaller black Japanese tagline text above and below it. A torn vertical caption on the left side in bold yellow Japanese text explains that they meant to head for Jerusalem but somehow crush the Byzantine Empire. Two large parchment banners cross the upper middle area: one says that the original destination was Jerusalem, and the larger center banner declares in bold red Japanese text that the destination is Jerusalem, followed by smaller black text saying that was supposed to be the plan. On the upper right, a pinned parchment itinerary board contains a 5-step comedic route list with icons and arrows: departure, no money, bowing to Venice, lightly attacking Zara, then Constantinople, ending with a red line implying they somehow arrived there. Around the characters are exactly 8 speech balloons and callout labels: one saying “Eh, huh?”, one saying “No money…”, one saying “By order, let’s go.”, one saying “Slight detour.”, one saying “I failed, lol.”, one saying “Zara? We passed there!”, one label for a “contract” with a note that it is kind of expensive, and one pointing to Venice as a sponsor-like label. Additional wooden or parchment location signs label exactly 3 places: Zara, Venice, and Constantinople, with Japanese side notes identifying them as Christian or Byzantine cities. The lower half becomes darker and more catastrophic, showing a burning Byzantine-style city with a large domed church resembling Hagia Sophia, naval combat, collapsing architecture, orange firelight, and black smoke. At the bottom center, enormous distressed Japanese title typography in yellow and white announces the film as the Fourth Crusade and says Constantinople burns due to getting lost, with gritty texture, heavy drop shadows, and explosive blockbuster poster styling. On the right side of the title area, a red stamped burst says in Japanese that it begins around 1204. Along the very bottom is a narrow cast strip with exactly 6 small cast thumbnails labeled in Japanese, plus tiny fake credits running across the footer. In the bottom right corner, place a bright pink starburst badge with yellow and white Japanese text reading {argument name="badge text" default="史実です。信じられないけど。"}. Overall style: absurd historical parody, cinematic key art, Japanese theatrical poster, high detail, photobashed realism mixed with exaggerated graphic design, weathered paper textures, bold manga-like captions, comedic educational tone, epic war-movie energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张以世界历史为主题的混乱虚构日式电影海报，设计风格如同好莱坞大片般的喜剧动作史诗，讲述了第四次十字军东征彻底迷路，最终攻击了君士坦丁堡而非前往耶路撒冷的故事。构图密集、喧闹且充满讽刺意味，在明亮的蓝天、火焰、浓烟、中世纪船只、圆顶建筑、城墙和十字军大军的背景下，呈现出一幅戏剧性的历史战场拼贴画。在画面中央前景，一名身穿脏兮兮白色束腰外衣、带有大红十字架的中世纪十字军战士全身像正指向观众，周围环绕着另外四名身着华丽长袍、兜帽、头盔和商人服饰的中世纪人物；他们的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，使海报看起来像是一场恶搞的演员阵容揭秘。海报顶部，巨大的亮粉色日文毛笔字写着 {argument name="headline text" default="方向性、完全に迷子。"}，上方和下方配有较小的黑色日文标语。左侧一条撕裂的垂直标题用醒目的黄色日文解释说，他们本打算前往耶路撒冷，却不知为何摧毁了拜占庭帝国。两条巨大的羊皮纸横幅横跨中上部区域：一条写着最初的目的地是耶路撒冷，中间较大的横幅用醒目的红色日文声明目的地是耶路撒冷，随后附有较小的黑色文字说明这本该是计划。右上角，一块钉着的羊皮纸项目板包含了一个 5 步喜剧路线列表，配有图标和箭头：出发、没钱、向威尼斯低头、轻微攻击扎拉，然后是君士坦丁堡，最后用红线暗示他们不知何故抵达了那里。角色周围共有 8 个对话气泡和标注标签：一个写着“诶，哈？”，一个写着“没钱……”，一个写着“奉命行事，走吧。”，一个写着“小绕路。”，一个写着“我搞砸了，哈哈。”，一个写着“扎拉？我们经过那里了！”，一个标注为“合同”并附注价格昂贵，还有一个指向威尼斯作为赞助商标签。额外的木制或羊皮纸地点标志标注了 3 个地点：扎拉、威尼斯和君士坦丁堡，并附有日文侧注，将其标识为基督教或拜占庭城市。下半部分变得更加黑暗和灾难化，展示了一座燃烧的拜占庭风格城市，有着类似圣索菲亚大教堂的大型圆顶教堂、海战、倒塌的建筑、橙色的火光和黑烟。底部中央，巨大的做旧黄色和白色日文标题字体宣布这部电影为《第四次十字军东征》，并称君士坦丁堡因迷路而燃烧，带有粗糙质感、厚重的投影和爆炸性的电影海报风格。标题区域右侧，一个红色印章式爆炸标签用日文写着故事始于 1204 年左右。最底部是一条狭窄的演员栏，包含 6 个带有日文标签的小型演员缩略图，页脚处还有微小的伪造演职员表。右下角放置了一个亮粉色的星形徽章，上面用黄色和白色日文写着 {argument name="badge text" default="史実です。信じられないけど。"}。整体风格：荒诞历史恶搞、电影级主视觉图、日式剧场海报、高细节、照片合成写实主义与夸张平面设计的结合、风化的纸张纹理、醒目的漫画式标题、喜剧教育基调、史诗战争片能量。

templates.title: Schoolgirl With Cat by Sunlit Window

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光窗边的女学生与猫

templates.prompt: A warm, photorealistic indoor portrait beside a large sunlit window, showing a young woman in a Japanese school uniform sitting on a wooden windowsill with a tabby cat on her lap. The woman has a neat chin-length bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} with a side part, and her face is obscured by a simple square blur block centered over it. She wears a white button-up shirt, a large blue-and-green plaid ribbon bow tie, a matching blue-green tartan pleated skirt, and a soft oversized cream knit cardigan. Her posture is relaxed and gentle, with one hand resting on and petting the cat’s head. The cat is a brown and black striped tabby with bright green eyes, facing the camera, dressed in tiny blue denim overalls over a white shirt. Use soft golden-hour natural light streaming through the window from the left, with a lush green garden outside rendered as creamy bokeh. Compose it as a vertical medium shot, cozy and wholesome, with realistic skin, fabric texture, detailed cat fur, shallow depth of field, and a calm candid atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温暖、写实的室内肖像，背景是一扇洒满阳光的大窗户。画面中，一位身穿日本校服的年轻女性坐在木质窗台上，怀里抱着一只虎斑猫。女性留着整洁的齐下巴波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"}，侧分刘海，脸部被一个居中的简单方形模糊块遮挡。她穿着白色衬衫，系着大号蓝绿格纹蝴蝶结，搭配同色系的蓝绿格纹百褶裙，外罩一件柔软的米色大廓形针织开衫。她姿态放松温柔，一只手轻轻抚摸着猫咪的头。这只猫是棕黑色条纹虎斑猫，有着明亮的绿色眼睛，正对着镜头，身上穿着一件套在白衬衫外面的迷你蓝色牛仔背带裤。利用从左侧窗户射入的柔和黄金时刻自然光，窗外郁郁葱葱的花园呈现出奶油般的虚化效果。采用竖构图的中景拍摄，营造出温馨治愈的氛围，展现逼真的皮肤质感、织物纹理、细腻的猫毛细节、浅景深以及宁静自然的抓拍感。

templates.title: Soft Pastel Anime Girl Full Body

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和粉彩动漫少女全身像

templates.prompt: A full-body anime girl character design on a plain white background, centered and floating slightly, drawn in a soft minimalist pastel style with very thin gray linework and delicate flat colors. She has a petite youthful build and a cute, gentle silhouette, with special emphasis on a soft rounded face shape, smooth cheeks, and a softened jawline and chin. Her face is completely obscured by a blank skin-colored rectangular block with no facial features visible. She has short bob hair in {argument name="hair color" default="light ash brown"}, slightly tousled with wispy ends, long bangs covering part of the forehead, and a small ribbon hair tie on the right side in pale blue-gray. She wears 3 visible clothing pieces: an oversized pale blue cardigan with loose sleeves and front buttons, a cream-white slip dress with a scalloped neckline and a tiny button detail at the chest, and a frilled hem with a small ribbon near the right thigh. She is barefoot with slim pale legs, posed front-facing with both arms relaxed slightly outward, open hands, one leg straight and the other gently bent inward for a shy, weightless look. The illustration should feel airy, cute, understated, and clean, like a simple Japanese anime fashion sketch, with lots of negative space and no props, no shadows, and no background elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个全身动漫少女角色设计，背景为纯白色，角色居中且略微悬浮。采用柔和的极简粉彩风格，配以极细的灰色线条和精致的平涂色彩。她拥有娇小年轻的身材和可爱温柔的轮廓，特别强调柔和圆润的脸型、平滑的脸颊以及柔化的下颌线和下巴。她的面部被一块空白的肤色长方形遮挡，没有任何五官细节。她留着短波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅灰棕色"}，发丝微乱且发梢轻盈，长刘海遮住部分额头，右侧系着一个淡蓝灰色的丝带发饰。她穿着 3 件可见的服装：一件超大款淡蓝色开衫，袖口宽松且带有前扣；一件奶油白色吊带裙，领口呈扇贝形，胸前有小纽扣装饰；裙摆带有褶边，右大腿附近饰有一条小丝带。她赤脚，双腿纤细白皙，正面站立，双臂自然向外放松，手掌张开，一条腿伸直，另一条腿向内轻微弯曲，呈现出害羞且轻盈的姿态。整幅插画应给人一种轻盈、可爱、低调且整洁的感觉，如同简单的日式动漫时尚草图，留白充裕，无道具、无阴影，且无背景元素。

templates.title: Full-Body Silver Anime Girl Design

titleLocalized.zh: 全身银发动漫少女设计

templates.prompt: A full-body anime girl character design standing centered on a plain light gray background, facing forward in a neutral symmetrical pose with both arms slightly lowered and hands relaxed outward. She has a soft youthful face, fair skin, large warm brown eyes, and a gentle small smile. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"}, very long and straight, falling past her waist, with heavy side-swept bangs covering her right eye and 2 metallic hairpins clipped on the visible left side. She wears 1 dangling earring on each ear. Her outfit is a cute monochrome idol-inspired dress with subtle pale blue accents: a white short puff-sleeve blouse bodice with a ruffled square neckline and a small black ribbon bow at the center of the chest, a fitted black waist corset belt with a circular silver ring buckle, and a layered short skirt in light gray with ruffled trim and soft volume. Add a thin silver waist chain draped diagonally over the skirt. Around her neck is 1 black choker with a pale blue frill. She wears 2 black fingerless gloves with pale frilled cuffs, 2 white thigh-high stockings held by 2 visible garter straps, and 2 black Mary Jane platform shoes with ankle straps. Use clean cel-shaded anime linework, soft pastel tones, minimal shading, crisp design-sheet presentation, front character reference style, no props, no scenery, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个全身动漫少女角色设计，居中站立在纯浅灰色背景上，正面朝向，姿态中性对称，双臂微垂，双手自然向外放松。她拥有柔和的青春面容、白皙的皮肤、大而温暖的棕色眼睛和温柔的浅笑。她的头发是 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，非常长且直，垂过腰部，厚重的侧分刘海遮住了右眼，可见的左侧别着 2 个金属发夹。她每只耳朵戴着 1 个吊坠耳环。她的服装是一套可爱的单色系偶像风格连衣裙，带有微妙的淡蓝色点缀：白色短泡泡袖衬衫上衣，配有荷叶边方领，胸前中心有一个黑色小蝴蝶结；腰部系着黑色束腰带，配有圆形银色环扣；裙子为浅灰色多层短裙，带有荷叶边饰边，质感蓬松。在裙子上斜挂一条细银色腰链。脖子上戴着 1 个带有淡蓝色荷叶边的黑色颈圈。她戴着 2 只黑色露指手套，配有淡色荷叶边袖口；穿着 2 只白色过膝袜，由 2 条可见的吊袜带固定；脚穿 2 只黑色玛丽珍厚底鞋，配有脚踝绑带。使用干净的赛璐珞动漫线条，柔和的粉彩色调，极简阴影，清晰的设计图呈现，正面角色参考风格，无道具，无背景，无文字。
