templates.title: Anime Campers in a Winter Tent

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格冬日露营

templates.prompt: A cozy winter camping scene inside a large beige canvas tent, rendered as a semi-realistic anime illustration with natural lighting and realistic environmental detail. Show exactly 2 seated young women around a compact kerosene heater used as a camp table, with a large black metal pot resting on top. The viewpoint is a candid wide-angle photo composition from slightly above seated height, making the scene feel like a casual snapshot taken inside the tent. The woman on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose bangs, and wears a fluffy brown fleece jacket, dark pants, and a red lanyard with an ID card. She sits in a low camping chair and leans forward, using chopsticks over a small bowl or food container in her hands. The woman on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} shoulder-length hair and wears a muted purple hoodie layered under a black puffer vest, light gray sweatpants, and dark shoes. She sits in another low camping chair, resting her cheek on one hand in a relaxed, sleepy pose. Keep both faces obscured by a soft rectangular blur block, as if anonymized in a posted photo. Around them, include exactly 4 red beverage cans visible in the scene: 2 on the wooden table planks near the center, 1 cropped in the lower right foreground, and 1 farther back near the right side. Build a low U-shaped arrangement of 3 wooden bench planks surrounding the heater. Add small camping details: 1 olive duffel bag on the left ground, 1 plastic storage box with supplies behind the left woman, 1 white plastic shopping bag on top of the box, 1 small bowl on the table, 1 colorful snack package on the right-side plank, 1 soft brown cloth on the far left floor, and 1 black metal rack frame standing at the back right. The tent interior should have taut canvas walls, visible seams and support poles, a gravel ground, and a warm muted color palette. Preserve the feeling of a real camping photo where only the people have been turned into anime-style characters while the setting remains highly realistic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个温馨的冬日露营场景，位于大型米色帆布帐篷内，呈现为半写实动漫插画风格，具备自然光影和逼真的环境细节。画面中准确展示 2 位年轻女性，她们围坐在一个用作露营桌的小型煤油取暖器旁，取暖器上方放着一个大型黑色金属锅。视角采用略高于坐姿高度的广角抓拍构图，使画面呈现出帐篷内随手拍摄的快照感。左侧女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的高马尾，带有凌乱的刘海，身穿蓬松的棕色抓绒外套、深色长裤，并佩戴着挂有工牌的红色挂绳。她坐在低矮的露营椅上身体前倾，正用筷子夹着手中的小碗或食物容器。右侧女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的齐肩短发，身穿暗紫色连帽衫，外搭黑色羽绒马甲，下身穿着浅灰色运动裤和深色鞋子。她坐在另一把低矮的露营椅上，单手托腮，姿态放松且略显困倦。两人的面部均用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡，如同发布照片时进行了匿名处理。在她们周围，画面中需包含 4 个清晰可见的红色饮料罐：2 个位于中心附近的木质桌板上，1 个位于右下角前景处（部分裁切），另 1 个位于右侧较远位置。取暖器周围环绕着 3 块木质长凳板，呈低矮的 U 型排列。添加细致的露营元素：左侧地面放置 1 个橄榄色行李袋，左侧女性身后放置 1 个装有补给品的塑料收纳箱，箱子上放着 1 个白色塑料购物袋，桌上放着 1 个小碗，右侧木板上放着 1 包色彩鲜艳的零食，最左侧地面铺着 1 块柔软的棕色布料，右后方立着 1 个黑色金属架。帐篷内部应呈现紧绷的帆布墙面、清晰的接缝和支撑杆，地面为碎石，整体色调温暖柔和。保留真实露营照片的质感，仅将人物转化为动漫风格，同时保持环境的高度写实。

templates.title: Monochrome Anime Gothic Dress Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 单色动漫哥特风连衣裙少女

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fashion illustration of a slim young woman standing front-facing in a neutral pose against a clean light gray-white background, centered like a character design sheet. She has very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair that falls past her waist, with soft layered bangs covering one eye and long side sections framing the face. The style is refined, soft-shaded, and highly polished with delicate linework, subtle fabric folds, and a modern idol-goth aesthetic. She wears a short white and pale gray ruffled dress with 8 visible black front buttons, puff short sleeves, frilled sleeve hems, frilled shoulder straps, a square neckline with a small black ribbon bow at the chest, and a layered asymmetrical skirt with multiple airy ruffle tiers. Around her neck is a frilled lace choker. At the waist is a wide black belt with a large silver circular ring buckle and 1 hanging strap ending in a metal ring. She wears 2 black fingerless gloves with frilled cuffs and silver bracelet details, 2 white thigh-high stockings, and 2 black garter straps clipped from the skirt to the stockings, one on each thigh. Her shoes are glossy black Mary Jane heels with ankle straps and small bows on the toes. Add a small dangling cross earring on the visible ear. Keep the palette mostly monochrome white, gray, black, and silver, with a soft elegant mood and a clean studio presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫时尚插画，描绘了一位身材苗条的年轻女性，以中性姿态正面站立在干净的浅灰白色背景前，构图如同角色设计图纸般居中。她拥有非常长的直发，{argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 发丝垂至腰部以下，柔软的层次感刘海遮住了一只眼睛，长长的侧发修饰着脸型。画风精致、柔和阴影且高度润色，线条细腻，布料褶皱微妙，呈现出现代偶像哥特美学。她穿着一件白色与浅灰色相间的短款褶边连衣裙，正面有 8 颗显眼的黑色纽扣，短泡泡袖，袖口有荷叶边，肩带带有褶边，方领口处饰有一个黑色小蝴蝶结，裙摆为多层不对称的轻盈褶边设计。颈部佩戴着褶边蕾丝颈圈。腰间系着一条宽大的黑色腰带，配有巨大的银色圆形环扣，并垂下一条末端带有金属环的带子。她戴着两只带有荷叶边袖口和银色手链细节的黑色露指手套，穿着两只白色过膝袜，裙摆上延伸出两条黑色吊袜带分别固定在双腿的丝袜上。鞋子为漆皮黑色玛丽珍高跟鞋，配有踝带和鞋头小蝴蝶结。在可见的耳朵上添加一个小巧的十字架吊坠耳环。整体色调保持以白色、灰色、黑色和银色为主的单色风格，营造出柔和优雅的氛围和干净的摄影棚展示效果。

templates.title: RPG Map to Anime Event Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 将 RPG 地图转换为动漫事件场景

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the top-down RPG town map into a polished anime-style event illustration from a human eye-level perspective. Keep the same village location and layout cues: the central stone well, the path network, the hedges, the wooden houses, and the narrow water canal on the left. Convert the 2 small sprite characters by the well into 2 full-size fantasy characters in the foreground: a silver-haired mage in a purple robe holding a staff, and a blonde elf in green-and-brown adventurer clothing, both leaning over and looking into the well. Add a cinematic JRPG feel with soft daylight, detailed painterly rendering, clean line art, and gentle depth of field. Preserve the sense that this scene is taking place in the same town square, but enrich it with natural perspective, more environmental detail, and 5 background villagers: 1 man cropped at the far left edge, 2 small figures standing on the center path in the distance, and 2 townspeople talking near the right-side buildings.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将俯视视角的 RPG 城镇地图转换为从人眼高度观察的精致动漫风格事件插画。保留相同的村庄位置和布局线索：中央的石井、路径网络、树篱、木屋以及左侧狭窄的水渠。将井边的 2 个小型像素角色转换为前景中 2 个全尺寸的奇幻角色：一位身穿紫色长袍、手持法杖的银发法师，以及一位身穿绿棕色冒险者服装的金发精灵，两人正俯身看向井内。添加具有电影感的 JRPG 氛围，采用柔和的日光、细腻的绘画渲染、清晰的线条艺术以及柔和的景深效果。保持场景位于同一城镇广场的感觉，但通过自然的透视、更丰富的环境细节进行增强，并加入 5 位背景村民：左侧边缘处截取了 1 名男性，远处中央路径上站着 2 个小人影，右侧建筑旁有 2 位正在交谈的镇民。

templates.title: Anime Characters in Real Izakaya Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 置身于真实居酒屋的动漫角色照片

templates.prompt: A candid indoor restaurant photo in a realistic anime-inspired style, showing two young women seated at a small worn wooden table inside a cozy Japanese izakaya with vertical wood-paneled walls and a clear plastic tent-like curtain on the right side. The camera is slightly above table height and angled diagonally toward the table, creating a casual snapshot feeling. One woman is in the left foreground with her back mostly to the viewer, leaning forward over the table; she has long straight dark hair and wears a bulky dark navy or black puffer jacket with a large hood. The second woman sits across from her on the right, facing the camera with a relaxed posture and one arm bent on the table; she has shoulder-length dark brown to black hair, a center part, a black puffer jacket, and a light inner shirt. Replace only the people with clean, natural-looking anime characters while keeping the restaurant environment photorealistic and unchanged. Preserve the mixed-media look of anime characters composited believably into a real photo. On the table, include 2 stainless steel mugs, 2 pairs of chopsticks, 1 smartphone with a bright blue case near the center-left edge of the table, 1 cigarette pack near the right woman, 1 large oval plate with thinly sliced white onions and a lemon wedge, 1 small dish of green vegetables, 1 small plate of brown food, 1 small plate with toast or grilled bread, 1 small dark bowl, 2 small empty white bowls, and 1 printed handwritten Japanese menu sheet lying on the lower right corner of the table. In the upper left background, include a wooden counter with white ceramic bottles and dishes, plus 1 handwritten Japanese wall menu poster. Warm indoor lighting, everyday nightlife atmosphere, documentary realism, detailed wood grain, slightly cluttered tabletop, authentic casual dining scene in Japan.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用写实动漫风格的室内餐厅抓拍照，展示了两位年轻女性坐在日本居酒屋里一张陈旧的小木桌旁，背景是竖条纹木板墙，右侧有透明的塑料帘。相机位置略高于桌面，呈对角线拍摄，营造出随意的快照感。左侧前景中的女性背对镜头，身体前倾；她留着黑色长直发，身穿一件厚实的深蓝色或黑色羽绒服，戴着大兜帽。第二位女性坐在她对面，面向镜头，姿态放松，一只手臂弯曲放在桌上；她留着齐肩深棕色至黑色中分发型，身穿黑色羽绒服，内搭浅色上衣。仅将人物替换为干净、自然的动漫角色，同时保持餐厅环境的真实摄影质感不变。保留动漫角色与真实照片合成的混合媒介视觉效果。桌上需包含：2 个不锈钢杯子、2 双筷子、桌子中左侧边缘有一部带有亮蓝色手机壳的智能手机、右侧女性旁有一包香烟、1 个盛有薄切白洋葱和柠檬角的大椭圆形盘子、1 小碟绿色蔬菜、1 小碟褐色食物、1 小碟吐司或烤面包、1 个深色小碗、2 个白色空小碗，以及桌子右下角放着一张手写的日文菜单。左上角背景处包含一个摆放着白色陶瓷瓶和餐具的木制柜台，以及 1 张手写的日文墙面菜单海报。温暖的室内灯光，日常夜生活氛围，纪录片式的写实感，细腻的木纹，略显杂乱的桌面，地道的日本休闲餐饮场景。

templates.title: Tech CEO Meme Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 科技公司 CEO 模因照片

templates.prompt: A photorealistic meme-style outdoor close-up of three tech CEOs standing together in a subtly tense but friendly composition. On the left foreground is {argument name="left person" default="Sam Altman"}, shown from the chest up, with short dark wavy hair, pale skin, a dark crewneck shirt, and an exaggerated smug, amused expression with raised eyebrows and a crooked smile, looking toward the man on the right. In the center background is {argument name="center person" default="Satya Nadella"}, bald, wearing black rectangular glasses and a dark jacket, calmly smiling and looking at the man on the right. On the right foreground is {argument name="right person" default="Elon Musk"}, seen mostly from the back and side profile, wearing a black leather jacket, with the center figure’s hand resting on his shoulder in a familiar, slightly possessive gesture. Use shallow depth of field, natural overcast daylight, blurred trees in the background, and a candid press-photo realism. Add exactly 3 bold white labels with thick black outline placed near each person: "{argument name="left label" default="Sam Altman"}" near the left figure, "{argument name="center label" default="Satya Nadella"}" above the center figure, and "{argument name="right label" default="Elon Musk"}" near the right figure. The overall mood should feel like an industry-insider meme, with subtle social dynamics and ironic facial expressions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的模因风格户外特写，三位科技公司 CEO 并肩站立，构图微妙而紧张又不失友好。左侧前景是 {argument name="left person" default="Sam Altman"}，半身像，留着深色短卷发，肤色苍白，身穿深色圆领衫，表情夸张且带有戏谑感，挑着眉毛，嘴角带着一丝歪斜的微笑，正看向右侧的男子。背景中央是 {argument name="center person" default="Satya Nadella"}，秃顶，戴着黑色长方形眼镜，身穿深色夹克，平静地微笑着看向右侧的男子。右侧前景是 {argument name="right person" default="Elon Musk"}，主要呈现背影和侧脸，身穿黑色皮夹克，中间的人物将手搭在他的肩上，姿态显得熟悉且略带占有欲。使用浅景深、自然的阴天日光、背景模糊的树木，以及抓拍的新闻照片质感。在每个人物附近添加 3 个带有黑色粗描边的加粗白色标签：左侧人物旁标注“{argument name="left label" default="Sam Altman"}”，中间人物上方标注“{argument name="center label" default="Satya Nadella"}”，右侧人物旁标注“{argument name="right label" default="Elon Musk"}”。整体氛围应呈现出一种行业内部人士模因的感觉，包含微妙的社交动态和讽刺的面部表情。

templates.title: Nike Surreal Poster From Reference

titleLocalized.zh: 基于参考图的 Nike 超现实海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, regenerate the same Nike surreal fashion ad almost exactly as written, but present it as a polished finished poster: keep the cool light-blue minimalist studio, the single oversized white Nike sneaker standing on its heel at a steep diagonal, the single female model in an all-white outfit leaning back against the shoe in right-facing three-quarter profile, the large background word "NIKE," and the glossy semi-reflective floor. Make the composition tighter and more cinematic, with the giant shoe dominating the left half and the model standing full-body on the right half, her hands in her pockets. Render the background "NIKE" text as 1 huge bold white word spanning behind the subjects, partially obscured by both the sneaker and the model. Add the bottom-center tagline as 2 lines of elegant white sans-serif text: "Made for comfort, worn for confidence." and "Because life feels better when you move without limits." Keep the top-right corner empty and do not add any extra text, logos, watermarks, credits, signatures, or captions. Ultra-clean premium advertising finish, soft diffused cool lighting, subtle floor reflections, high detail, 3:4 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图，几乎完全按照描述重新生成同样的 Nike 超现实时尚广告，并将其呈现为一张精美成品海报：保留冷色调的极简主义摄影棚风格，一只巨大的白色 Nike 运动鞋以陡峭的对角线角度立于鞋跟上，一位身着全白服装的女性模特以右侧四分之三侧面倚靠在鞋子旁，背景为一个巨大的“NIKE”字样，以及光泽感半反射地板。使构图更紧凑、更具电影感，巨大的鞋子占据左半部分，模特全身站立于右半部分，双手插在口袋里。将背景中的“NIKE”文字渲染为一个巨大的粗体白色单词，横跨在主体后方，并被运动鞋和模特部分遮挡。在底部中心添加两行优雅的白色无衬线字体标语：“Made for comfort, worn for confidence.” 以及 “Because life feels better when you move without limits.” 保持右上角留白，不要添加任何额外的文字、Logo、水印、署名、签名或说明文字。超洁净的高级广告质感，柔和的漫反射冷光，细腻的地板倒影，高细节，3:4 宽高比。

templates.title: Gothic Magical Girl with Spell Circle

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风魔法少女与魔法阵

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fantasy illustration of a confident young magical girl standing in the center of a glowing spell circle inside a dark cathedral-like interior. She has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair in twin high ponytails with large curled drill ringlets at the ends, straight bangs, and bright blue eyes, with a calm slightly smug smile. She wears a gothic black and deep navy frilled dress with gold filigree trim, corset lacing on the bodice, layered ruffles, puffed sleeves, black gloves, and multiple dark blue ribbon bows, plus a black lace garter on one thigh and glossy black ankle boots decorated with bows. In her raised right hand she holds an ornate magical staff with a circular head, wing-like ornaments, a star motif, and a glowing pink crystal core. Behind her are 2 large luminous stained-glass-like wing shapes made of intricate white and pink magical lines, creating the impression of angelic wings. Around her body and across the foreground are swirling ribbons of pink-violet magical energy, floating sparkles, and scattered glowing shards. The floor features 1 large intricate magic circle with runic lettering and layered concentric sigils radiating intense pink and lavender light. Compose the image in a dynamic low-angle view with the character centered, one leg forward, skirt flaring outward, and the staff extended toward the viewer. Use dramatic fantasy lighting, high contrast, ultra-detailed polished anime rendering, rich black, violet, and neon pink palette, sharp linework, glossy highlights, and an epic magical transformation atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫奇幻插画，描绘了一位自信的年轻魔法少女，她站在黑暗大教堂内部一个发光的魔法阵中心。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 的双马尾，发梢带有大卷螺旋状卷发，留着齐刘海，拥有一双明亮的蓝色眼睛，嘴角带着从容且略显俏皮的微笑。她身穿一件哥特风黑色与深海军蓝相间的荷叶边连衣裙，饰有金色花丝镶边、紧身胸衣系带、多层褶边、泡泡袖、黑色手套和多个深蓝色丝带蝴蝶结，大腿上系着黑色蕾丝吊带袜，脚蹬饰有蝴蝶结的亮面黑色短靴。她举起的右手握着一根华丽的魔法杖，杖头呈圆形，带有翅膀状装饰、星星图案和一个发光的粉色水晶核心。她身后有 2 个巨大的发光彩色玻璃状翅膀，由错综复杂的白色和粉色魔法线条构成，营造出天使之翼的视觉效果。她的身体周围和前景中环绕着粉紫色的魔法能量带、漂浮的火花和散落的发光碎片。地面上是一个巨大的复杂魔法阵，带有符文和层叠的同心符号，放射出强烈的粉色和淡紫色光芒。画面采用动态的低角度构图，角色居中，一条腿向前迈出，裙摆向外飘扬，法杖向观众方向延伸。采用戏剧性的奇幻光影，高对比度，超精细的动漫渲染风格，丰富的黑色、紫色和霓虹粉色调，锐利的线条，光泽感高光，营造出史诗般的魔法变身氛围。

templates.title: Fantasy Tokyo Coexistence Cityscape

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻东京共存城市景观

templates.prompt: A wide cinematic anime key visual of a bustling modern Tokyo-like district transformed into a multicultural fantasy metropolis under a bright blue midday sky with fluffy clouds. The scene is viewed from street level along a broad pedestrian avenue leading toward a large red torii gate at the center distance, with stone steps, crowds of people, dense commercial buildings, and a Japanese castle rising on a green hill behind the city blocks. A very tall broadcasting tower resembling Tokyo Skytree stands slightly right of center in the background. Fill the sky with exactly 8 airborne fantasy and sci-fi elements: 2 large dragons in flight, 2 winged humanoid angels, 1 huge flying saucer, and 3 smaller UFOs scattered farther away. The city should feel like a coexistence society where humans and fantasy races live together naturally. Add many colorful digital billboards and vertical signs on buildings, including Japanese text and fantasy character advertisements; the largest curved screen on the left should display the text “Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界 ようこそ,” and a lower billboard should reference a multicultural society of different races. In the foreground, place exactly 6 prominent characters across the street scene: on the far left, a tall elf schoolgirl with long brown hair, pointed ears, a white blouse, ribbon tie, and plaid skirt; left-center, a humanoid crocodile or lizard man in casual urban clothes with a jacket and pendant; near him, a small child with animal-like ears wearing a red backpack and scarf; center-left, a white-haired young man with white feathered wings in a light jacket; center-right, a silver-haired cat-eared schoolgirl in a light jacket and dark pleated skirt; right-center, a black-haired teenage boy in a black hoodie with a backpack; and on the far right, a blonde elf schoolgirl with pointed ears, white short-sleeve shirt, tie, and brown plaid skirt. In the midground and background, add a crowd of pedestrians including a few more fantasy species. Also include exactly 3 additional perched or elevated fantasy figures on the right side architecture: 1 dark-clad black-winged girl standing on a ledge, 1 small blonde fairy-like winged girl floating near a rooftop, and 1 tiny golden winged creature near the street. Style: polished high-detail anime illustration, light novel promotional art, sharp linework, vibrant colors, clean atmospheric perspective, crisp sunlight, soft shadows, highly detailed urban signage, a sense of wonder, coexistence, and worldbuilding.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宽幅电影感动漫主视觉图，描绘了一个繁华的现代东京式街区，在明亮的午后蓝天与蓬松云朵下，变身为一座多元文化的奇幻大都市。场景从街道视角展开，沿着宽阔的步行大道望向远方中心的一座大型红色鸟居，周围有石阶、人群、密集的商业建筑，城市街区后的绿山上矗立着一座日本城堡。背景中，一座酷似东京晴空塔的超高广播塔位于中心偏右侧。天空中需精确填充 8 个飞行中的奇幻与科幻元素：2 条大型飞龙、2 位长翅膀的人形天使、1 个巨大的飞碟以及 3 个散落在更远处的较小 UFO。城市应呈现出人类与奇幻种族自然共存的社会氛围。在建筑物上添加许多色彩鲜艳的数字广告牌和竖向招牌，包括日文文本和奇幻角色广告；左侧最大的曲面屏幕应显示文本“Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界 ようこそ”，下方的一个广告牌应提及多元种族共存的社会。在前景中，街道上需放置 6 位显眼的角色：最左侧是一位长棕发、尖耳朵、身穿白衬衫配蝴蝶结和格子裙的高挑精灵女学生；左中是一位身穿休闲装、戴着夹克和吊坠的人形鳄鱼或蜥蜴人；他附近是一个背着红色书包、戴着围巾、长着动物耳朵的小孩；中左是一位身穿浅色夹克、长着白色羽翼的白发少年；中右是一位身穿浅色夹克和深色百褶裙的银发猫耳女学生；右中是一位身穿黑色连帽衫、背着书包的黑发少年；最右侧是一位金发、尖耳朵、身穿白色短袖衬衫配领带和棕色格子裙的精灵女学生。在中景和背景中，添加一群行人，其中包括更多奇幻物种。此外，在右侧建筑上额外添加 3 位栖息或高处的奇幻人物：1 位站在壁架上的黑衣黑翼少女、1 位在屋顶附近漂浮的小型金发精灵状女孩，以及 1 位在街道附近的小型金色带翼生物。风格：精致的高细节动漫插画、轻小说宣传艺术、锐利的线条、鲜艳的色彩、清晰的空气透视、明亮的阳光、柔和的阴影、高度精细的城市标识，充满奇幻感、共存感与世界观构建。

templates.title: Urban Fantasy Coexistence Crossing

titleLocalized.zh: 都市奇幻共存穿越

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style urban fantasy illustration set at a busy Tokyo-style scramble crossing on a bright clear day, viewed at street level with a wide cinematic composition. The city blends modern realism with mythic fantasy: dense high-rise buildings covered in giant billboards, a red broadcast tower in the middle distance, blue sky with fluffy clouds, and a crowded crosswalk full of pedestrians. In the foreground, show 7 prominent character figures: a silver-haired elf woman in a flowing white dress holding an iced drink and tote bag on the far left; a central schoolgirl with long dark hair, black animal ears, a navy school blazer, plaid skirt, blue ribbon, and large navy shoulder bag, lifting one hand to her head; a young man in a dark suit looking down at a smartphone; an androgynous white-haired angelic figure in an elegant white-and-gold ceremonial outfit with large white wings; a small blonde girl in an ornate pastel pink frilled dress beside the angel; a dark-haired woman in a black coat in right foreground profile; and a small blue-haired cat-eared child in a blue dress with a bow standing near a cave entrance on the right. In the midground crowd, include mixed humans and fantasy races walking together naturally. Add 4 clearly visible nonhuman or supernatural background beings: 1 dragon flying in the sky, 1 winged female angel descending above the street, 1 lizard-headed businessman in a suit near the angelic figure, and 1 tall red-skinned horned demon with crossed arms standing by the hillside path. On the right side, transition the city into a lush shrine hillside with large green trees, a red torii gate, stone steps, and a wooden signboard reading Japanese kanji. Below it, place a rocky cave-like tunnel entrance glowing blue, with a wooden sign over the entrance and several figures descending into an underground shared district lit by crystals. Show 6 major billboard/sign elements across the cityscape: a huge left billboard reading "Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界" with a cosmic planet image; a large central political poster with Japanese text and a raised fist icon; 2 rooftop signs reading "未来研究所" on separate buildings; a large right billboard with Japanese text about coexistence and silhouettes of different beings; and 1 vertical banner with Japanese text on a nearby building. Emphasize the theme of coexistence between ordinary modern city life and hidden fantasy societies. Crisp anime linework, polished light novel key visual rendering, rich textures, soft sunlight, subtle atmospheric perspective, vibrant but believable colors, intricate clothing details, and a sense of awe, everyday bustle, and worldbuilding depth.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的动漫风格都市奇幻插画，场景设定在晴朗明亮的东京式繁忙十字路口，采用街头视角和宽幅电影感构图。城市将现代写实与神话奇幻融为一体：高楼林立，外墙挂满巨幅广告牌，远处可见一座红色广播塔，蓝天白云下，人行横道上挤满了行人。前景展示 7 位核心角色：最左侧是一位身穿飘逸白裙、手持冰饮和帆布袋的银发精灵女性；中心是一位留着长黑发、戴着黑色兽耳、身穿海军蓝校服西装、格子裙、蓝色领结并背着大号海军蓝肩包的女生，正抬手触碰头部；旁边是一位低头看手机的深色西装青年；一位中性化的白发天使，身着优雅的白金配色礼服，背负巨大的白色羽翼；天使身旁是一位穿着华丽粉色褶边连衣裙的金发小女孩；右侧前景是一位身穿黑色大衣的侧身黑发女性；最右侧靠近洞穴入口处，站着一位身穿蓝色蝴蝶结连衣裙的蓝发猫耳幼童。中景人群中，人类与奇幻种族自然地混杂在一起。背景中加入 4 个清晰可见的非人或超自然生物：天空中飞翔的 1 条巨龙、街道上方降落的 1 位带翼女性天使、天使角色附近 1 位穿着西装的蜥蜴头商人，以及山坡小径旁 1 位双臂交叉、皮肤通红的高大长角恶魔。画面右侧，城市过渡为郁郁葱葱的神社山坡，点缀着参天大树、红色鸟居、石阶以及写有日文汉字的木制招牌。下方是一个散发着蓝色光芒的岩石洞穴隧道入口，入口上方挂着木牌，几个人影正走入由水晶照亮的地下共享区域。城市景观中展示 6 个主要的广告牌/标志元素：左侧巨大的广告牌写着“Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界”并配有宇宙行星图像；中央是一张带有日文和握拳图标的大型政治海报；两栋不同建筑的屋顶分别设有写着“未来研究所”的标志；右侧是一张写有关于共存的日文内容并带有不同种族剪影的大型广告牌；附近建筑上还悬挂着 1 条写有日文的垂直横幅。强调现代城市日常生活与隐藏奇幻社会共存的主题。画面要求清晰的动漫线条、精致的轻小说主视觉渲染、丰富的质感、柔和的阳光、细腻的空气透视、鲜艳且真实感强的色彩、考究的服饰细节，并营造出令人惊叹的日常喧嚣感与深厚的世界观底蕴。

templates.title: Japanese Classroom Long Hair Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: 日本教室长发快照

templates.prompt: A candid, photorealistic Japanese high school classroom scene in vertical smartphone-photo framing. Three schoolgirls wearing matching traditional navy blue sailor uniforms are the main focus in the foreground. The central standing girl has extremely long, straight, glossy black hair that falls well past her knees, almost to the floor, and she is gently combing the lower section with a small comb while looking downward. A second girl stands behind and slightly to the right, also with long straight black hair, holding an open compact mirror in one hand and adjusting her bangs or hair near her temple with the other. A third girl kneels on the floor at the right front, carefully holding and arranging the central girl’s long hair with both hands. All three wear dark navy sailor-style school uniforms with white stripe trim, pleated skirts, long sleeves, white socks, and indoor school shoes. Their faces are obscured or blurred. In the background, exactly 8 additional students in dark school uniforms sit at desks in small groups, facing away or sideways, creating the feel of an ordinary class period or homeroom. The classroom has wooden desks and chairs, large bright windows along the left side letting in soft daylight, a green chalkboard on the right wall, bulletin papers pinned near the board, and a framed Japanese calligraphy sign above the chalkboard reading {argument name="wall sign text" default="創誠造実"}. The atmosphere is natural and unposed, like a documentary snapshot. Emphasize realistic lighting, fine hair detail, the unusual dramatic length of the central girl’s hair, and a believable everyday school environment.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用竖屏手机摄影构图的抓拍风格、照片级真实的日本高中教室场景。画面前景的主体是三名身穿统一传统深蓝色水手服的女学生。中间站立的女生拥有一头极长、顺滑且富有光泽的黑发，长发垂至膝盖以下，几乎触及地面；她正低头用一把小梳子轻轻梳理发梢。第二名女生站在她身后右侧，同样留着长直黑发，一只手拿着打开的粉饼盒镜子，另一只手正在整理鬓角或刘海。第三名女生跪在右前方地面上，双手小心翼翼地捧着并整理中间女生的长发。三人都穿着深蓝色水手风校服，配有白色条纹装饰、百褶裙、长袖、白袜和室内校鞋。她们的面部被遮挡或模糊处理。背景中，另有 8 名身穿深色校服的学生坐在课桌旁，三五成群，背对或侧对着镜头，营造出普通课堂或班会课的氛围。教室里摆放着木制课桌椅，左侧的大窗户透进柔和的自然光，右侧墙上挂着一块绿色黑板，黑板附近贴着公告纸，黑板上方挂着一块写有 {argument name="wall sign text" default="创诚造实"} 的日本书法牌匾。整体氛围自然且不做作，如同纪录片式的快照。强调写实的灯光、细腻的发丝细节、中间女生长发不同寻常的戏剧性长度，以及真实可信的日常校园环境。

templates.title: Anime PR Representative at Industrial Expo

titleLocalized.zh: 工业博览会上的动漫风公关代表

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style corporate booth illustration with cel shading and controlled highlights, showing a young adult female PR representative standing three-quarters view in a futuristic industrial exhibition space lit with cool purple and blue accent lighting. Her face is obscured by a centered rectangular blur block. She has very long straight dark hair with subtle purple undertones, flowing past her waist, and wears geometric dangling earrings. Her outfit is a sleek black business suit with white piping along the lapels, a dark inner shirt, a fitted pencil skirt, a belt, and a visible lanyard with ID card. On her left arm she wears a white armband printed with the company logo and the words OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES. In one arm she holds a black presentation folder with the same logo and company name, and with her other hand she gestures open-palmed toward the booth displays as if introducing the company. The booth branding is prominent: a large illuminated wall sign in the upper left with the logo, the Japanese company name "大野重工業株式会社", the English name "OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES", and the slogan "BUILDING THE FUTURE. SUPPORTING THE WORLD." Below it is a large poster panel showing an industrial refinery skyline at dusk with Japanese copy reading "技術で支え、未来を創る。" and smaller text beneath. In the lower left foreground, place a standing nameplate sign with the same logo and company name, plus the department line "広報部 | PR DIVISION" and the representative name "雲居 モヤ" with the romanization "KUMOI MOYA". Also show her hanging ID badge with the logo and small text suggesting PR staff credentials. The exhibition floor includes 3 visible industrial display elements: a white robotic construction machine model on a pedestal at left, a smaller mechanical display in the mid-background, and a large white humanoid or armored industrial mech figure on the right background. Use a high-end convention or trade-show setting with glossy reflective surfaces, glass panels, sharp perspective lines, and branded panels throughout. Composition should be vertical, waist-up to near full-body framing, with the character dominating the right-center and the company signage clearly readable on the left. Emphasize refined anime character design, professional corporate ambassador energy, futuristic heavy-industry branding, purple ambient glow, and clean cel-shaded rendering rather than overly sparkly effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格企业展位插画，采用赛璐珞着色和受控的高光处理。画面展示了一位年轻女性公关代表，她以四分之三侧面站立在充满未来感的工业展览空间中，空间内点缀着冷紫色和蓝色的氛围灯光。她的面部被一个居中的矩形模糊块遮挡。她留着极长的直发，发色带有微妙的紫色底色，长发垂至腰部以下，佩戴着几何形状的吊坠耳环。她身穿一套利落的黑色商务套装，翻领处有白色滚边，内搭深色衬衫，下着修身铅笔裙，系着腰带，并佩戴着显眼的挂绳工牌。她的左臂戴着一个白色臂章，上面印有公司 Logo 和“OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES”字样。她的一只手臂抱着一个黑色的展示文件夹，上面同样印有公司 Logo 和名称；另一只手掌心向上，向展位陈列区做出引导动作，仿佛正在介绍公司。展位品牌标识醒目：左上方有一块大型发光墙面招牌，上面印有 Logo、日文公司名“大野重工业株式会社”、英文名“OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES”以及标语“BUILDING THE FUTURE. SUPPORTING THE WORLD.”。下方是一块大型海报展板，展示了黄昏下的工业炼油厂天际线，并配有日文文案“技術で支え、未来を創る。”及下方的小字。在左下角前景处，放置一个立式铭牌，上面印有相同的 Logo 和公司名称，以及部门行“広報部 | PR DIVISION”和代表姓名“雲居 モヤ”（罗马音：KUMOI MOYA）。同时展示她悬挂的 ID 胸牌，上面印有 Logo 和暗示公关人员身份的小字。展览现场包括 3 个可见的工业展示元素：左侧底座上的一台白色建筑机器人模型，中景背景中的小型机械装置，以及右侧背景中一个大型白色人形或装甲工业机甲。采用高端展会或贸易展览场景，具有光泽的反射表面、玻璃面板、锐利的透视线条以及遍布各处的品牌展板。构图采用竖构图，取景范围从腰部以上到近全身，角色占据右中位置，左侧的公司标识清晰可辨。强调精致的动漫角色设计、专业的企业大使气质、未来重工业品牌感、紫色环境光，以及干净的赛璐珞渲染效果，而非过分闪耀的特效。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy PS5 RPG Cover Art

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻风格 PS5 RPG 游戏封面艺术

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese fantasy action RPG key art designed like a PlayStation 5 game cover poster. Vertical composition, ultra-detailed, high-contrast, cinematic dark fantasy. In the background, count 2 enormous black-purple dragons: one dominant dragon on the upper right with mouth wide open, glowing orange fire in its throat, jagged obsidian scales, and blazing eyes; one second dragon silhouette on the upper left with wings spread across the sky. Full moon in the center-top sky, purple nebula clouds, embers, ash, magical sparks, and a ruined gothic castle city on the right background. In the foreground, count 3 female elf warriors standing in a heroic triangular formation, all wearing ornate metallic armor with glossy magenta, silver, and violet tones. Center character: blonde elf princess-warrior, short to medium hair, small crown or jeweled tiara, white fur mantle over shoulders, polished silver armor exposing midriff, black gloves, confident battle stance, wielding a gigantic double-bladed ceremonial axe with intricate filigree, turquoise crystal core, and engraved silver-blue blades. Left character: taller elf archer-warrior with long light brown hair, pointed ears, elaborate rose-magenta armor, large curved fantasy sword in her right hand, and a quiver of pink-fletched arrows on her back. Right character: long dark magenta-haired elf swordswoman with floral hair ornaments, violet-magenta armor, black cape, holding a slender sword angled downward. The image should feel like premium box art for an original game titled {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}. Include visible game-package typography and branding elements: top left white PS5 logo; top right small bracketed studio tag [O-prompt laboratory]; large vertical Japanese slogan on the right side; count 2 lines of Japanese promotional copy on the upper left; the main title in huge glowing gold serif letters across the bottom center reading {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}; a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it; bottom left CERO C rating badge; bottom center count 3 short Japanese feature blurbs separated by diamond icons; bottom right OPL logo. Use a lavish painted-anime-meets-hyperreal style, dense detail, polished reflections, fiery rim light, purple and orange color contrast, and the overall feel of a mature-rated epic console fantasy adventure cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具张力的日式奇幻动作 RPG 主视觉图，设计风格仿照 PlayStation 5 游戏封面海报。竖构图，超高细节，高对比度，电影级暗黑奇幻风格。背景中可见 2 条巨大的黑紫色巨龙：右上方是一条占据主导地位的巨龙，嘴部大张，喉咙中闪烁着橙色的火焰，拥有锯齿状的黑曜石鳞片和燃烧的双眼；左上方是另一条巨龙的剪影，双翼横跨天际。天空中上方中央挂着一轮满月，伴有紫色星云、余烬、灰烬、魔法火花，右侧背景是一座破败的哥特式城堡城市。前景中，3 位精灵女战士呈英雄三角阵型站立，均身穿华丽的金属铠甲，呈现出亮面洋红色、银色和紫罗兰色调。中间角色：金发精灵公主战士，中短发，戴着小皇冠或珠宝头饰，肩披白色皮草斗篷，抛光银色铠甲露出腰部，佩戴黑色手套，姿态自信，手持一把巨大的双刃仪式斧，斧身有复杂的金银丝细工、绿松石水晶核心以及雕刻精美的银蓝色刀刃。左侧角色：身材较高的精灵弓箭手战士，留着浅棕色长发，尖耳朵，身穿精致的玫瑰洋红色铠甲，右手持一把巨大的弯曲奇幻长剑，背上背着装有粉色箭羽箭矢的箭袋。右侧角色：留着深洋红色长发的精灵女剑士，戴着花卉发饰，身穿紫罗兰洋红色铠甲，披着黑色斗篷，手持一把剑尖朝下的细长剑。图像应呈现出名为 {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"} 的原创游戏的高级包装艺术感。包含可见的游戏包装排版和品牌元素：左上角白色 PS5 标志；右上角小型括号内工作室标签 [O-prompt laboratory]；右侧有大型竖排日文标语；左上方有 2 行日文宣传文案；底部中央有巨大的发光金色衬线字体主标题，内容为 {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}；下方有较小的日文副标题；左下角 CERO C 分级标志；底部中央有 3 段由菱形图标分隔的简短日文游戏特色介绍；右下角 OPL 标志。采用华丽的动漫绘画与超写实相结合的风格，细节丰富，反射效果细腻，带有火红色的轮廓光，紫色与橙色的色彩对比，整体呈现出成熟级史诗主机奇幻冒险封面的质感。

templates.title: Fantasy RPG Game Cover with Three Knight Women

titleLocalized.zh: 三位女骑士的奇幻 RPG 游戏封面

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese fantasy action RPG PlayStation 5 game cover poster in a dark ornate high-fantasy style, vertically composed like premium key art. Show three armored warrior women standing heroically in the foreground against a glowing night battlefield and a towering gothic fantasy castle city in the distance, with fireworks, embers, magical light trails, and a star-filled purple-blue sky. The central figure is a blonde elf-like knight with pointed ears, a fur-trimmed collar, silver and gold armor, and a powerful stance, holding an enormous double-headed ceremonial battle axe angled across the lower half of the image; the axe is highly detailed with filigree silver metalwork, turquoise-blue crystal inlays, and an intricate engraved circular blade. On the left stands a second female knight with long dark crimson hair, metallic breastplate armor in steel and burgundy tones, and a sword held downward; behind her looms 1 giant black raven or crow with one glowing blue eye. On the right stands a third female knight with long light brown hair covering her eyes, pointed ears, and glossy magenta-pink armor with revealing fantasy plate design; a quiver of arrows is visible behind her shoulder. Include 2 red flying bird-like creatures or phoenixes in the upper right sky. The mood is epic, intense, and slightly gothic, with dense sparks, glowing particles, rim lighting, and lavish metallic reflections. Add an ornate thin gold border framing the entire cover. At the top left, place a small circular emblem and the text "O-prompt Laboratory". Along the right side, add vertical Japanese tagline text: "絆と力に、運命を斬り拓け". At the bottom center, place the game title in large embossed gold serif letters: "{argument name="game title" default="ELYSION"}", with a subtitle beneath in smaller serif capitals: "{argument name="subtitle" default="REBIRTH"}". Below that, add the Japanese subtitle text "エリシオン・リバース". At the bottom left, include a realistic Japanese age rating badge reading "CERO C" with small text "15才以上対象". Along the bottom, add the Japanese tagline "美しき騎士たちの、終わりなき戦いが今、始まる。" and beneath it the English line "THE ETERNAL BATTLE OF THE KNIGHTS BEGINS NOW.". Make it look like polished AAA console box art for a nonexistent fantasy game, ultra-detailed, cinematic, richly textured, high contrast, with the composition dominated by the three women and the oversized axe.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日式奇幻动作 RPG PlayStation 5 游戏封面海报，采用深色华丽的高奇幻风格，构图呈垂直状，如同高级主视觉艺术。前景中，三位身披铠甲的女战士英勇站立，背景是发光的夜间战场和远处高耸的哥特式奇幻城堡，画面中点缀着烟花、余烬、魔法光迹以及星光璀璨的紫蓝色天空。中心人物是一位金发精灵般的骑士，有着尖耳朵、毛皮饰领、银金相间的铠甲，姿态威武，手中握着一把巨大的双头仪式战斧，横跨画面下半部分；战斧细节丰富，带有银色金属丝工艺、绿松石蓝水晶镶嵌以及复杂的圆形雕刻刀刃。左侧站着第二位女骑士，留着深红色长发，身穿钢色与酒红色调的金属胸甲，手持一把向下垂的剑；她身后隐约可见一只巨大的黑色乌鸦，有着一只发光的蓝色眼睛。右侧站着第三位女骑士，浅棕色长发遮住双眼，有着尖耳朵，身穿亮面洋红色铠甲，设计带有奇幻风格的露肤感；她肩后可见一筒箭矢。在右上方的天空中加入 2 只红色的飞鸟状生物或凤凰。整体氛围史诗、强烈且略带哥特感，充满密集的火花、发光粒子、轮廓光和华丽的金属反射。在封面四周添加一个华丽的细金边框。左上角放置一个小圆形徽标和文字“O-prompt Laboratory”。右侧添加竖排日文标语：“絆と力に、運命を斬り拓け”。底部中央放置巨大的浮雕金色衬线字体游戏标题：“{argument name="game title" default="ELYSION"}”，下方配以较小的衬线大写字母副标题：“{argument name="subtitle" default="REBIRTH"}”。在其下方添加日文副标题“エリシオン・リバース”。左下角包含一个写有“CERO C”的逼真日文年龄分级徽章，并附带小字“15才以上対象”。底部添加日文标语“美しき騎士たちの、終わりなき戦いが今、始まる。”，下方附带英文行“THE ETERNAL BATTLE OF THE KNIGHTS BEGINS NOW.”。使其看起来像是一款虚构奇幻游戏的精致 3A 主机盒装艺术，超精细、电影感、纹理丰富、高对比度，构图以三位女性和超大号战斧为核心。

templates.title: Miami Dock Action Movie Still

titleLocalized.zh: 迈阿密码头动作电影剧照

templates.prompt: A cinematic action movie still on a sunny waterfront dock in {argument name="city" default="Miami"}, shot in a vertical composition. In the foreground, a tough athletic man in his 30s stands in a wide defensive stance, aiming a black semi-automatic pistol with both hands directly off-frame. He has short dark hair, a rugged build, tan skin, light stubble, a silver wristwatch, a white T-shirt, an open short-sleeve blue patterned overshirt, and tan cargo pants. Slightly behind and to his left stands an athletic woman in her 20s or 30s with tan skin and long dark curly hair tied in a high ponytail. She wears a fitted black tank top, denim shorts, a black belt, layered gold necklaces, and holds a black handgun low at her side, ready for action. Set them on a weathered wooden pier beside bright blue water, with 1 large palm tree on the left, 3 modern high-rise buildings in the background, and 1 partially visible police boat on the right edge. Bright midday sunlight, clear blue sky, glossy skin highlights, tense body language, realistic proportions, shallow depth of field, high-detail photorealism, blockbuster buddy-cop energy, crisp focus on the characters, slightly blurred skyline.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在 {argument name="city" default="迈阿密"} 阳光明媚的码头拍摄的电影级动作剧照，采用垂直构图。前景中，一名 30 多岁、体格健壮的硬汉正处于宽大的防御姿态，双手持一把黑色半自动手枪直接瞄准画外。他留着深色短发，身材魁梧，皮肤黝黑，留着浅浅的胡茬，戴着银色腕表，身穿白色 T 恤、敞开的蓝色短袖印花衬衫和卡其色工装裤。在他身后左侧，站着一位 20 多岁或 30 多岁的运动型女性，她皮肤黝黑，深色卷发扎成高马尾。她穿着黑色紧身背心、牛仔短裤、黑色腰带，佩戴叠戴的金项链，右手持一把黑色手枪垂在身侧，随时准备行动。背景设定在明亮蓝色水域旁风化的木质码头上，左侧有一棵高大的棕榈树，背景中有 3 座现代高层建筑，右侧边缘可见一艘局部警用快艇。正午明亮的阳光，湛蓝的天空，皮肤呈现光泽感，肢体语言紧张，比例写实，浅景深，高细节照片级真实感，大片级搭档警匪片氛围，人物焦点清晰，天际线略微模糊。

templates.title: Art Deco Gotham Tram Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 装饰艺术风格哥谭市电车海报

templates.prompt: A vintage Art Deco travel poster in a clean flat 2D 1950s-inspired illustration style, showing an elevated tram entering {argument name="city name" default="Gotham City"} at sunset. Use a tall vertical poster composition with strong geometric symmetry, sharp stepped deco framing, and no 3D relief or realistic textures. At the top, place a large angular Art Deco border in glowing peach-gold lines, with exactly 3 small circular dots centered near the top inside the frame. Inside this frame, set the headline {argument name="headline text" default="WELCOME TO GOTHAM CITY !"} in large elegant Art Deco lettering, stacked across 4 lines reading exactly: “WELCOME”, “TO”, “GOTHAM”, “CITY !”. Keep the typography crisp, centered, and integrated into the poster design. Below, create a stylized skyline of {argument name="city skyline style" default="futuristic Gotham skyscrapers"} with tall narrow towers, stepped crowns, spires, and simplified window slits; count 12 visible building masses across the skyline. Behind the buildings, place a large glowing half-sun low on the horizon. In the foreground, show 1 long streamlined elevated tram stretching diagonally from the lower left toward the lower right, with the front car prominent on the right side. The tram should have glowing cream windows, rounded front corners, exactly 3 circular lights on the front face, and overhead electric lines with elegant sweeping cables crossing the composition. Use exactly 2 visible rail tracks curving toward the viewer at the bottom. Palette: deep indigo, violet, plum, black, peach, amber, and warm cream gradients. Mood: nostalgic, sleek, cinematic, airy, optimistic retro-futurism. Make it look like a polished mid-century flat graphic poster for urban transit tourism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古装饰艺术风格旅行海报，采用 1950 年代风格的简洁平面 2D 插画手法，展示了一辆高架电车在日落时分驶入 {argument name="city name" default="Gotham City"} 的场景。使用高耸的垂直海报构图，强调几何对称性、锐利的阶梯状装饰边框，且不含 3D 浮雕或写实纹理。在顶部放置一个巨大的棱角分明的装饰艺术边框，使用发光的桃金色线条，并在边框顶部中心位置精确放置 3 个小圆点。在此边框内，设置标题 {argument name="headline text" default="WELCOME TO GOTHAM CITY !"}，使用优雅的大号装饰艺术字体，分 4 行堆叠，文字内容精确为：“WELCOME”、“TO”、“GOTHAM”、“CITY !”。保持排版清晰、居中，并与海报设计融为一体。在下方，绘制 {argument name="city skyline style" default="futuristic Gotham skyscrapers"} 的风格化天际线，包含高耸狭窄的塔楼、阶梯状塔冠、尖顶以及简化的窗缝；天际线上可见 12 座建筑主体。在建筑后方，设置一轮低悬于地平线上的巨大发光半圆太阳。在前景中，展示 1 辆长条流线型高架电车，从左下角向右下角呈对角线延伸，车头在右侧突出。电车应具有发光的奶油色车窗、圆润的前角、车头正面精确的 3 个圆形车灯，以及横跨构图的优雅弧形架空电缆。底部使用精确的 2 条向观众弯曲的铁轨。配色方案：深靛蓝、紫罗兰、李子色、黑色、桃色、琥珀色和暖奶油色渐变。氛围：怀旧、流畅、电影感、轻盈、乐观的复古未来主义。使其看起来像一张精致的 20 世纪中叶城市交通旅游平面海报。

templates.title: Censored Man on Crimson Throne

titleLocalized.zh: 深红王座上的审查者

templates.prompt: A dark, expressionist oil painting of a seated older man in a business suit, posed front-facing on an ornate high-backed throne with gilded finials and carved armrests. He wears a black or very deep burgundy suit, a white dress shirt, and a saturated purple tie, with both hands resting heavily on the throne arms. His hair is light blond to gray-blond, swept back loosely. The face is completely obscured by a centered rectangular blur block in muted brown, creating an unsettling censored effect. The setting is a claustrophobic interior rendered in violent vertical strokes of crimson, scarlet, black, and maroon, as if the walls are bleeding paint downward. The floor is a black-and-white checkerboard pattern, partially broken and smeared by rough brushwork. Use thick impasto, aggressive palette-knife texture, smeared edges, high contrast, and a moody, sinister atmosphere. Composition is symmetrical and centered, full seated figure visible, throne dominating the frame, with a museum-scale portrait feeling and psychological horror undertone.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅阴郁的表现主义油画，描绘了一位身着商务西装的老年男子，正面端坐在装饰华丽、带有镀金饰顶和雕花扶手的高背王座上。他身穿黑色或深酒红色的西装，内搭白色衬衫，系着饱和度极高的紫色领带，双手沉重地搭在王座扶手上。他的头发呈浅金至灰金色，向后随意梳理。面部被一个位于中央的暗棕色矩形模糊块完全遮挡，营造出一种令人不安的审查效果。背景是一个幽闭的空间，以深红、猩红、黑色和褐红色的强烈垂直笔触渲染，仿佛墙壁正在向下滴血。地面为黑白棋盘格图案，部分被粗犷的笔触破坏并涂抹。采用厚涂法、极具侵略性的调色刀质感、模糊的边缘、高对比度以及阴郁、邪恶的氛围。构图对称且居中，呈现完整的坐姿人物，王座占据画面主体，具有博物馆级肖像画的质感与心理恐怖的基调。

templates.title: Cyber DJ Beneath a Red Monolith

titleLocalized.zh: 红色巨石下的赛博 DJ

templates.prompt: A moody vertical concert-stage illustration in a dark futuristic painterly anime style, showing a lone electronic musician or DJ performing on a small platform. The performer stands centered behind a folding table, wearing an oversized black hoodie, loose dark pants, and heavy dark shoes, with a glossy black robotic helmet featuring one bright circular blue lens in the middle of the face. One arm is raised dramatically upward toward a massive floating red square panel hanging above the stage, while the other arm rests near the table. The background is filled with thick red and black smoke clouds, creating a dramatic backlit atmosphere with deep crimson glow and heavy shadows. On the table are 5 visible gear elements: an open dark laptop in the center, a white boxy speaker or computer unit on the left, a pair of headphones on the right, a small audio device near the white unit, and a glowing red drink can at the far right edge. Around the stage are 6 additional visible elements: a microphone stand to the left of the performer, a keyboard or piano edge entering from the far left, 2 stacked equipment boxes or amps under and beside the table, a patterned oriental-style rug covering the platform floor, and multiple loose black cables snaking across the stage. Above everything, a huge suspended red square dominates the upper half of the image, slightly tilted in perspective, textured with darker vertical streaks and rough painterly variations. Cinematic low-angle composition, centered subject, dramatic negative space, intense red-and-black palette with one blue accent, soft smoky lighting, high contrast, live experimental music performance energy, mysterious cyberpunk atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满情绪感的竖构图演唱会舞台插画，采用深色未来主义绘画动漫风格，展示了一位孤独的电子音乐人或 DJ 在小型平台上表演。表演者站在折叠桌后方正中央，身穿超大号黑色连帽衫、宽松深色长裤和厚重的深色鞋子，戴着一个光亮的黑色机器人头盔，面部中央有一只明亮的圆形蓝色镜片。一只手臂戏剧性地向上举起，指向舞台上方悬浮的巨大红色方形面板，另一只手臂则靠近桌子。背景充斥着浓厚的红黑烟雾，营造出带有深红色光晕和浓重阴影的戏剧性背光氛围。桌上有 5 个可见的装备元素：中央是一台打开的深色笔记本电脑，左侧是一个白色方形音箱或电脑单元，右侧是一副耳机，白色单元旁有一个小型音频设备，最右侧边缘有一罐发光的红色饮料。舞台周围有 6 个额外的可见元素：表演者左侧的麦克风支架、从最左侧伸入的键盘或钢琴边缘、桌下及桌旁的 2 个堆叠设备箱、覆盖平台地面的东方风格花纹地毯，以及多条散落在舞台上的黑色线缆。在所有物体上方，一个巨大的悬浮红色方形体占据了画面上半部分，透视略微倾斜，表面带有较暗的垂直条纹和粗犷的绘画质感。电影级低角度构图，主体居中，极具戏剧性的留白，强烈的红黑配色辅以蓝色点缀，柔和的烟雾光效，高对比度，充满实验性现场音乐表演的活力，营造出神秘的赛博朋克氛围。

templates.title: Luxury Miniature Dubai City Model

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华迪拜城市微缩模型

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed cinematic isometric miniature city model of {argument name="landmark tower" default="Burj Khalifa"} rising dramatically from the center of a square architectural master-plan board, presented like a luxury urban planning maquette on a black background. The composition shows one dominant ultra-tall silver skyscraper in the exact center, surrounded by a dense ring of modern high-rise towers, illuminated roads, bridges, and glowing warm city lights. Curving turquoise-blue water features and artificial lakes wrap around the central district in multiple connected pools and canals, with one large circular fountain-like feature near the tower base and several small island shapes visible in the water. In the lower right quadrant, include a large low-rise complex with rounded geometric roofs and subtle green-lit sections, connected by multilane roads and looping interchanges. The entire city sits on one square beige map board engraved with faint street grids and planning lines, with the board edges clearly visible and slightly raised. Viewpoint is a high three-quarter isometric angle, centered and symmetrical, with the tower extending far upward into negative space. Lighting is dramatic and luxurious: warm golden edge lights on buildings and roads, cool reflections in the water, crisp metallic highlights on the central tower, and a deep black void surrounding the model. Style should feel like a photorealistic architectural visualization mixed with a premium collectible scale model, extremely intricate, sharp, polished, and elegant.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个超精细的电影级等轴测微缩城市模型，{argument name="landmark tower" default="哈利法塔"} 从方形建筑规划项目中心拔地而起，呈现出奢华城市规划模型的质感，背景为黑色。构图中心是一座高耸的银色摩天大楼，周围环绕着密集的现代高层建筑、照明道路、桥梁以及温暖的城市灯光。弯曲的绿松石色水景和人工湖以多个相连的池塘和运河形式环绕中心区域，塔基附近有一个大型圆形喷泉状景观，水中可见几个小岛形状。在右下象限，包含一个带有圆形几何屋顶和微妙绿光区域的大型低层建筑群，由多车道道路和环形立交桥连接。整个城市坐落在一个方形米色地图项目上，上面刻有淡淡的街道网格和规划线，项目边缘清晰可见且略微凸起。视角为高位四分之三等轴测角度，居中且对称，塔楼向上延伸至负空间。光影效果极具戏剧性和奢华感：建筑和道路上有温暖的金色边缘光，水面有冷色调倒影，中央塔楼有清晰的金属高光，模型周围是深邃的黑色虚空。风格应兼具写实建筑可视化与高端收藏级比例模型的质感，极其复杂、清晰、精致且优雅。

templates.title: Streetwear Sneaker Poster Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 街头风运动鞋海报广告

templates.prompt: Create a bold streetwear poster advertisement for {argument name="brand name" default="NESS STUDIO"} featuring a young adult model seated casually on the ground in a low-angle fashion pose, one knee raised and one leg extended toward the camera so the sneaker in front appears oversized and dominant. The model wears a dark brown oversized leather bomber jacket, a black shirt, light blue loose-fit jeans, white socks, and chunky black-white-gray sneakers with a red accent in the sole and the {argument name="brand name" default="NESS STUDIO"} logo visible on the shoe side and tongue. The face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur block centered over the face. Use an off-white textured paper background with distressed grunge design elements and collage layering. Behind the model, place a large rough red paint brushstroke shape spanning diagonally across the center. Add black ink splatters, sketch circles, torn paper scraps, and hand-painted graffiti accents. Include 4 major graphic doodles: a large black X in the upper right, a hand-drawn upward arrow in the lower left, a rough crown sketch in the lower right, and a circular scribble near the top center. In the upper left, place a stylized eye logo above the text "{argument name="brand name" default="NESS STUDIO"}" and a smaller tagline below reading "A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE". On the left middle area, add the handwritten slogan "INNOVATE CREATE INSPIRE" in stacked black brush lettering. On the right middle area, place a torn black paper patch with the handwritten white slogan "BUILT DIFFERENT MOVE DIFFERENT" and a red underline stroke. In the lower left near the shoe, add a black distressed label sticker containing a globe scribble, the text "{argument name="brand name" default="NESS STUDIO"}", and a barcode. Along the bottom footer, create a clean horizontal strip with 3 social media icons and handles separated by thin vertical dividers: Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter, each followed by "@NESS.STUDIO". The overall style should be edgy, urban, youthful, high-contrast, editorial street fashion, mixing product advertising photography with graffiti poster design, collage textures, and dynamic branding.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="NESS STUDIO"} 创作一张大胆的街头风海报广告。画面中，一位年轻模特以低角度时尚姿势随意坐在地上，一只膝盖弯曲，另一条腿伸向镜头，使前方的运动鞋看起来超大且极具视觉冲击力。模特身穿深棕色廓形皮质飞行员夹克、黑色内搭、浅蓝色宽松牛仔裤和白色袜子，脚蹬黑白灰配色厚底运动鞋，鞋底带有红色点缀，鞋侧和鞋舌处清晰可见 {argument name="brand name" default="NESS STUDIO"} 的品牌 Logo。模特的脸部被中心位置的一个柔和矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。背景采用米白色纹理纸张，融合做旧的 Grunge 风格设计元素与拼贴图层。在模特身后，放置一个横跨画面中心的粗犷红色大号笔触形状。添加黑色墨点、手绘圆圈、撕裂的纸屑和手绘涂鸦装饰。包含 4 个主要图形涂鸦：右上角的一个大号黑色“X”，左下角的一个手绘向上箭头，右下角的一个粗糙皇冠草图，以及顶部中心附近的一个圆形涂鸦。在左上角，放置一个风格化的眼睛 Logo，下方文字为 "{argument name="brand name" default="NESS STUDIO"}"，再下方配有一句较小的标语 "A MOMENT OF YOUR STYLE"。在左侧中部区域，添加手写风格的堆叠式黑色笔刷字体标语 "INNOVATE CREATE INSPIRE"。在右侧中部区域，放置一块撕裂的黑色纸质贴片，上面写有白色手写标语 "BUILT DIFFERENT MOVE DIFFERENT" 并带有红色下划线。在左下角靠近鞋子的地方，添加一张黑色做旧标签贴纸，包含一个地球涂鸦、文字 "{argument name="brand name" default="NESS STUDIO"}" 以及一个条形码。沿底部页脚处，创建一个简洁的水平条，放置 3 个社交媒体图标及账号，中间用细竖线分隔：Instagram、Facebook 和 Twitter，每个图标后均标注 "@NESS.STUDIO"。整体风格应呈现出前卫、都市、年轻、高对比度的编辑级街头时尚感，将产品广告摄影与涂鸦海报设计、拼贴纹理及动态品牌元素完美融合。

templates.title: Neon Nike Lumina Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Nike Lumina 霓虹广告海报

templates.prompt: A high-energy vertical Nike fashion campaign poster featuring a single athletic young woman mid-jump against a futuristic neon studio background. She is captured in a dynamic airborne pose with one knee bent up, the other leg folded back, one arm extended outward and the other bent near her chest, conveying motion and power. Her face is obscured by a clean rectangular blur block centered over the face. She wears a cropped iridescent white hooded windbreaker with a black zipper and small Nike logo on the chest, holographic metallic lavender-blue leggings with a subtle Nike swoosh on the thigh, a black branded waistband visible above the leggings, and white chunky Nike sneakers. Her brown hair is tied in a high ponytail flying outward with the jump. Behind her, enormous glowing white serif letters spell “NIKE” across the upper half, with a small white Nike swoosh centered above the word. Across the middle background, the phrase “LUMINA” appears once in wide bold glowing letters with a horizontal glitch and scanline distortion effect, partially obscured by the model. The color palette is saturated magenta, violet, cyan, and electric blue with strong bloom, glossy highlights, lens flares, and chromatic aberration. Add sweeping circular light trails wrapping around the model’s legs and body, suggesting speed and motion. The overall style is premium sportswear advertising, ultra-polished, cinematic, high contrast, hyperreal retouching, crisp product detail, dramatic rim lighting, and a luminous holographic aesthetic. Place 2 small text lines at the bottom: bottom left reads {argument name="tagline text" default="LIGHT. MOTION. ENERGY."}, bottom right reads {argument name="collection name" default="NIKE LUMINA COLLECTION"} followed by a small Nike swoosh. Include exactly 3 visible Nike swooshes total: 1 above the large NIKE headline, 1 on the jacket chest, and 1 on the leggings.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的 Nike 竖版时尚营销海报，画面中一位年轻的女性运动员在未来主义霓虹影棚背景下腾空跳跃。她呈现出动态的空中姿态：一膝上屈，另一腿向后折叠，一只手臂向外伸展，另一只手臂弯曲靠近胸前，传达出动感与力量。她的面部被一个居中的简洁矩形模糊块遮挡。她身穿一件带有黑色拉链的短款炫彩白色连帽风衣，胸前印有小巧的 Nike 标志；穿着带有淡紫色金属光泽的全息紧身裤，大腿处有隐约的 Nike Swoosh 标志；紧身裤上方露出的黑色品牌腰带清晰可见，脚蹬厚底白色 Nike 运动鞋。她的棕色头发扎成高马尾，随跳跃动作向外飞扬。在她身后，巨大的发光白色衬线字母拼写出“NIKE”，上方居中处有一个小巧的白色 Nike Swoosh。背景中部，“LUMINA”字样以宽大、加粗且发光的形式呈现，带有水平故障和扫描线失真效果，部分被模特遮挡。色调采用高饱和度的洋红色、紫罗兰色、青色和电光蓝，并带有强烈的辉光、光泽高光、镜头光晕和色差效果。在模特腿部和身体周围添加环绕的弧形光轨，以体现速度与动感。整体风格为高端运动服饰广告，极致精致、电影感强、高对比度、超写实修图、产品细节清晰、戏剧性的轮廓光，以及发光的全息美学。在底部放置两行小字：左下角为 {argument name="tagline text" default="LIGHT. MOTION. ENERGY."}，右下角为 {argument name="collection name" default="NIKE LUMINA COLLECTION"}，后跟一个小巧的 Nike Swoosh。画面中总共包含 3 个清晰可见的 Nike Swoosh：1 个位于大型 NIKE 标题上方，1 个位于夹克胸前，1 个位于紧身裤上。

templates.title: Luxury Chronograph Watch Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华计时码表广告

templates.prompt: A dramatic luxury product advertising image for a motorsport-inspired chronograph wristwatch in a dark studio. Center-left foreground, show a single stainless steel chronograph watch standing upright at a slight three-quarter angle, with a black dial, two red-accent subdials, slim silver hour markers, a tachymeter bezel, and visible crown and pushers on the right side. The watch has a black leather strap with bold red stitching along both edges and a sporty premium finish. To the right of the watch, place one black square presentation box slightly behind it, textured like leather, with red stitching around the lid and a silver embossed eye-shaped logo above the text “NESS STUDIO” and smaller red text “TRACK SURFACE.” At the top center of the composition, add the same silver eye logo with the words “NESS STUDIO” and smaller “BY NICOLAS.” Across the background, place one oversized blurred word, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, in large gray capital letters spanning nearly the full width. The scene is set against a deep black background with cinematic red and white horizontal light streaks crossing behind the products from left to right, suggesting speed and racetrack energy. Use a glossy wet ground plane with reflective texture, catching red highlights and mirrorlike reflections beneath the watch and box. At the bottom center, add the text “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” in clean white spaced capitals with thin red horizontal lines extending on both sides, and below it smaller red capitals reading {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Color palette: black, charcoal gray, silver steel, vivid racing red, and a touch of white. Lighting should be high-contrast and premium, with crisp specular highlights on the metal case, subtle soft fill on the box, and moody shadows. Overall style: ultra-polished commercial product photography, luxury watch campaign, sharp focus on the products, sleek branding, high-end automotive aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具张力的奢华产品广告图，展示了暗调摄影棚中赛车灵感计时腕表。画面左前方中心位置，放置一块不锈钢计时码表，呈微微侧向的三分之二角度直立，配有黑色表盘、两个红色点缀的小表盘、纤细的银色时标、测速计表圈，右侧可见表冠和按钮。腕表配有黑色皮质表带，边缘饰有醒目的红色缝线，呈现出运动型高端质感。腕表右侧放置一个略微靠后的黑色方形礼盒，具有皮革纹理，盒盖周围有红色缝线，上方印有银色浮雕眼形徽标，下方文字为“NESS STUDIO”，更小的红色文字为“TRACK SURFACE”。构图顶部中心位置，添加相同的银色眼形徽标，下方配有“NESS STUDIO”字样及较小的“BY NICOLAS”。背景处放置一个超大且模糊的单词，{argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}，采用巨大的灰色大写字母，几乎横跨整个画面宽度。场景设定在深黑色背景下，红色和白色的水平光束从左至右穿过产品后方，营造出速度感和赛道氛围。使用带有反射纹理的亮面湿润地面，在腕表和礼盒下方映出红色高光和镜面反射。底部中心位置添加“CHRONOGRAPH SERIES”字样，采用简洁的白色等间距大写字母，两侧延伸出细长的红色水平线，下方配有较小的红色大写字母 {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}。配色方案：黑色、炭灰色、银色钢质、鲜艳的赛车红以及少许白色。灯光应具备高对比度和高级感，金属表壳上呈现清晰的镜面高光，礼盒上有柔和的补光，并带有深邃的阴影。整体风格：极致精美的商业产品摄影，奢华腕表宣传大片，产品焦点清晰，品牌感流畅，具备高端汽车美学。

templates.title: Math Teacher Grading Papers in Classroom

titleLocalized.zh: 在教室里批改试卷的数学老师

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A realistic classroom photo of a middle-aged male math teacher seated at a wooden desk, grading student papers with his right hand while leaning slightly forward. He has wavy dark brown hair, light skin, and wears a muted blue crew-neck sweater over a checked collared shirt. The face is obscured by a large centered rectangular blur block. On the desk are 2 tall stacks of paper and folders, one on the left and one on the right, an open exam sheet in front of him, 3 loose pens in the foreground in blue, red, and transparent blue, 1 black zip pencil case at the front left, and 1 small black round cap or lid near the center-right of the desk. Behind him is a large dark green chalkboard filled with handwritten French mathematics notes and formulas in white chalk, including a function definition, a square root expression, a list of 5 numbered tasks, and limit notation. The room has soft natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, and a documentary-style academic atmosphere. Composition is landscape, medium shot, teacher centered, desk in the foreground, chalkboard spanning the entire background, highly realistic photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的教室照片，一名中年男性数学老师坐在木质书桌前，身体微微前倾，右手正在批改学生试卷。他留着深棕色波浪卷发，肤色白皙，身穿一件柔和的蓝色圆领毛衣，内搭格子衬衫。面部被一个居中的大号矩形模糊遮挡。桌上有两叠高高的试卷和文件夹，分别位于左右两侧；他面前放着一张摊开的试卷；前景处有 3 支散落的笔，分别为蓝色、红色和透明蓝色；左前方有一个黑色拉链笔袋；桌子中右侧附近有一个黑色小圆盖。他身后是一块巨大的深绿色黑板，上面写满了白色的法文数学笔记和公式，包括函数定义、平方根表达式、一个包含 5 项任务的列表以及极限符号。室内光线柔和自然，景深较浅，呈现出纪录片风格的学术氛围。构图为横向中景，老师居中，书桌位于前景，黑板横跨整个背景，具有高度写实的摄影质感。

templates.title: Dreamy Backlit Editorial Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻背光时尚人像

templates.prompt: A cinematic soft-focus portrait of a woman from behind and slightly in profile, framed from the upper torso up in a vertical composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair styled in a loose messy updo with wispy strands catching the light. Her face is mostly hidden by her pose and hair, with only a small portion of one cheek visible. She wears a {argument name="dress color" default="deep red"} sleeveless dress with an open back or low-cut side, emphasizing her bare shoulder and upper back. One hand is raised delicately near her neck or shoulder, fingers relaxed. Use strong warm backlighting and rim light, with glowing golden highlights around the hair and skin, dreamy lens flare, and large circular bokeh in the blurred background. The image should feel intimate, elegant, and slightly sensual, like a high-end fashion or beauty editorial, with shallow depth of field, creamy blur, warm amber and rose tones, and a soft cinematic glow.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的柔焦人像，拍摄对象为一名女性，视角从后方及侧面切入，采用竖构图，取景范围为上半身。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，梳成随性凌乱的盘发，细碎的发丝捕捉着光线。她的面部大部分被姿势和头发遮挡，仅露出部分脸颊。她身着一件 {argument name="dress color" default="深红色"} 无袖连衣裙，露背或侧面低剪裁设计，突显出裸露的肩膀和上背部。一只手轻柔地抬起靠近颈部或肩部，手指自然放松。运用强烈的暖色背光和轮廓光，头发和皮肤周围环绕着金色的光晕，伴有梦幻的镜头光斑，背景虚化呈现出巨大的圆形光斑。画面应营造出亲密、优雅且略带感性的氛围，如同高端时尚或美妆社论，具有浅景深、奶油般顺滑的虚化效果，色调为温暖的琥珀色与玫瑰色，并带有柔和的电影感光泽。

templates.title: Pastel Blue Crocs Fashion Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 淡蓝色 Crocs 时尚广告

templates.prompt: A high-end studio advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}, in a monochrome pastel blue and white color palette, with a glossy reflective floor and a soft sky-blue backdrop. The background is dominated by the word {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"} in gigantic bold white condensed sans-serif letters spanning nearly the full height of the image. In the top-right corner, add small white text reading "Designed with ChatGPT". Feature 3 adult women with shoulder-length wavy light brown to dark blonde hair, all wearing loose oversized white long-sleeve tops and flowing white wide-leg pants, styled as minimalist fashion models with relaxed neutral expressions. Their faces are intentionally obscured or blurred. One model reclines against an enormous upright white clog shoe on the left side, one model sits casually on top of a giant white clog on the upper right, and one model lounges on the floor at the lower right, leaning back on one arm while seated partly on a glossy blue sphere. Include 2 oversized white clog shoes as hero props: one standing vertically on the left showing the sole and side profile, and one angled on blue crystalline blocks at center-right showing the upper and toe box. Both clogs are classic foam slip-on style with perforation holes, chunky tread, heel straps, and circular logo rivets. The center-right clog is decorated with exactly 8 visible charms pinned to the upper: a blue-green iridescent round charm, a white daisy with yellow center, a black-and-white round emblem near the strap, a small "CROCS" word charm, a dark flower, a peace-hand sign, an orange smiley face, a white cloud, and an orange flower. Scatter exactly 7 glossy floating or grounded blue spheres of varying sizes around the set: one large sphere behind the left model, one medium sphere floating near center, one medium sphere at bottom left foreground, one medium sphere used as a seat under the lower-right model, one small sphere near the upper left, and 2 additional blue spheres integrated into the composition. Add translucent sculptural gel-like forms at the far left and far right edges, plus angular blue crystal-like rocks beneath the right shoe. At the bottom center, place white promotional copy in a clean sans-serif font: {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."} on the first line and {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."} on the second line. Beneath that, show 4 minimalist feature icons with labels in white: "ICONIC COMFORT", "LIGHTWEIGHT", "EASY TO CLEAN", and "UNIQUELY YOU". Place the {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} logo in bold lowercase white at the bottom center with a small trademark symbol. The overall style should feel like a premium surreal fashion campaign, clean editorial lighting, soft shadows, glossy textures, airy composition, and modern lifestyle product advertising.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张为 {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"} 制作的高端摄影广告海报，采用单色淡蓝色与白色调，配有光泽感的反射地面和柔和的天蓝色背景。背景中醒目地展示着巨大的白色粗体无衬线压缩字体 {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"}，几乎占据了整个画面的高度。在右上角添加一行白色小字：“Designed with ChatGPT”。画面中包含 3 位留着齐肩波浪形浅棕色至深金色头发的成年女性，她们均身穿宽松的白色长袖上衣和飘逸的白色阔腿裤，造型如同极简主义时尚模特，表情自然放松。她们的面部被刻意遮挡或模糊处理。一位模特斜靠在左侧巨大的直立白色洞洞鞋上，一位模特随意地坐在右上方的巨大白色洞洞鞋上，另一位模特则斜倚在右下方的地面上，单手撑地，半坐在一个光泽感的蓝色球体上。画面包含 2 只巨大的白色洞洞鞋作为核心道具：一只在左侧垂直站立，展示鞋底和侧面轮廓；另一只在右中部的蓝色水晶块上倾斜放置，展示鞋面和鞋头。两只洞洞鞋均为经典的泡沫套穿款式，带有透气孔、厚实鞋底、后跟带和圆形标志铆钉。右中部的洞洞鞋鞋面上装饰着 8 个清晰可见的鞋花：一个蓝绿色虹彩圆形鞋花、一朵黄色花心的白色雏菊、鞋带附近的一个黑白圆形徽章、一个小型的“CROCS”文字鞋花、一朵深色花朵、一个和平手势标志、一个橙色笑脸、一朵白云以及一朵橙色花朵。在场景周围散布 7 个大小不一、具有光泽感的悬浮或落地蓝色球体：左侧模特身后有一个大球，中心附近悬浮一个中球，左下角前景有一个中球，右下角模特下方用作座椅的一个中球，左上方有一个小球，以及另外 2 个融入构图的蓝色球体。在最左侧和最右侧边缘添加半透明的雕塑感凝胶状形态，并在右侧鞋子下方放置棱角分明的蓝色水晶状岩石。在底部中心，放置简洁的无衬线字体白色宣传文案：第一行为 {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."}，第二行为 {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."}。在其下方，展示 4 个极简主义功能图标及白色标签：“ICONIC COMFORT”（标志性舒适）、“LIGHTWEIGHT”（轻盈）、“EASY TO CLEAN”（易于清洁）和“UNIQUELY YOU”（独一无二的你）。在底部中心放置 {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} 粗体小写白色标志，并带有小型商标符号。整体风格应呈现出高端超现实时尚大片的质感，具备干净的编辑级布光、柔和的阴影、光泽质感、通透的构图以及现代生活方式的产品广告感。

templates.title: Gothic Magical Swordswoman

Her outfit is accented with exactly 3 vivid blue roses: 2 in a black lace headpiece and 1 at the center of her chest. The sword is ornate and elegant, with a silver filigree guard and a luminous blue blade filled with glowing rune-like patterns. Surround her with multiple overlapping circular magic sigils, arcane rings, starfield particles, sparkling shards, and cosmic light trails in a {argument name="background palette" default="violet, indigo, and electric blue"} celestial backdrop. Add crystalline prism fragments and glittering highlights across the scene, with intense bloom, high contrast, intricate lace and fabric detail, and a polished premium gacha-game key visual look. The composition should feel dynamic, cinematic, and magical, as if {argument name="character name" default="a gothic magical swordswoman"} is mid-strike in an astral dimension.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的动漫奇幻动作插画，描绘了一位英姿飒爽的年轻女性挥舞着发光的魔法剑向观众突刺。画面采用极端的低角度透视，剑刃占据前景并直指镜头。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的淡粉色"} 秀发，在风中飘逸散开，眼神明亮且专注， {argument name="eye color" default="蓝绿色"} 的双眸透着坚毅。她身穿精致的黑色哥特洛丽塔战斗裙，配有层叠的荷叶边、蕾丝花边、束腰设计、分离式蕾丝袖或手套、大腿吊带细节以及深色战靴。她的装束点缀着 3 朵鲜艳的蓝色玫瑰：2 朵装饰在黑色蕾丝头饰上，1 朵位于胸前。剑身华丽优雅，配有银色花丝护手，发光的蓝色剑身上布满了符文图案。背景是 {argument name="background palette" default="紫、靛蓝和电光蓝"} 色调的星空，周围环绕着多个重叠的圆形魔法阵、奥术光环、星域粒子、闪烁的碎片以及宇宙光轨。画面中添加了水晶棱镜碎片和闪耀的高光，呈现出强烈的泛光效果、高对比度、精细的蕾丝与布料质感，以及精致的高级抽卡游戏主视觉风格。整体构图动感十足、充满电影质感与魔法氛围，仿佛 {argument name="character name" default="一位哥特魔法女剑士"} 正置身于星界维度中发动致命一击。

templates.title: Absurd Tabloid Panther Newspaper Front Page

titleLocalized.zh: 荒诞小报黑豹新闻头版

templates.prompt:
A realistic, slightly humorous tabloid newspaper front page photographed from above on a wooden table, designed to look like a printed broadsheet with subtle paper texture, fold marks, and mild lens distortion. The masthead at top left reads “The Daily Metro”, the date line near the top center reads “Friday, April 22, 2005”, and the top-right section marker reads “CITY NEWS | 05”. A red banner near the upper left says “EXCLUSIVE STORY”. The dominant oversized black headline spans multiple lines: “Zoo Panther Caught Living Double Life – As a Charming Bar Hopping Casanova!” Below it, a large subheadline reads: ““Marquise” the Panther Escapes Zoo at Night, Spends Eveningsvlenlars, Becomes Heartthrob Among Lonely Women”. The page layout should mimic a sensational tabloid with 1 huge headline area, 1 large main photo on the upper right, 1 small inset photo under the main text on the left, 3 narrow text columns with dense newspaper copy in the center-left, 1 pull-quote box in the middle, 1 lower-left secondary story block with a panther portrait, 3 small bottom photo thumbnails in a row, and 1 right-side sidebar box titled “What’s Next For Mamquiss?”. Keep most body text tiny and partly nonsensical or pseudo-legible like AI-generated newspaper filler, but preserve the major visible headlines exactly.

The main photo on the upper right shows the back view of a glamorous blonde woman in a silky champagne-colored dress standing at a bar beside a large black panther upright on a stool or standing with forepaws elevated near the counter. The bar background contains many liquor bottles and glassware on shelves, warmly lit. The woman’s face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blur/block. The panther is sleek, glossy, and realistically rendered. The inset photo under the headline at left shows the black panther near a zoo exit or pathway sign at night. The lower-left portrait shows a close-up of the panther’s face. The 3 bottom thumbnails show nightlife scenes: the panther moving through a bar interior, the panther seated near two women at a small round table, and the panther lounging in dim warm light.

Use an early-2000s tabloid aesthetic, high-contrast black headline typography, off-white newsprint, red accent rules, narrow columns, and slightly messy authentic newspaper composition. The overall tone is deadpan absurdist journalism, realistic enough to glance as a real newspaper, with the page filling most of the frame and photographed in natural indoor light.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张写实且略带幽默的报纸头版，从上方俯拍于木桌之上，设计呈现出印刷大报的质感，带有细腻的纸张纹理、折痕和轻微的镜头畸变。左上角的报头写着“The Daily Metro”，顶部中央的日期栏写着“2005 年 4 月 22 日，星期五”，右上角的版块标记为“CITY NEWS | 05”。左上方的红色横幅写着“EXCLUSIVE STORY”。醒目的超大黑色标题横跨多行：“动物园黑豹被抓包过双重生活——竟是酒吧里迷人的卡萨诺瓦！”下方的大副标题写着：“黑豹‘Marquise’夜间逃出动物园，流连酒吧，成为孤独女性心中的万人迷”。页面布局应模仿耸人听闻的小报风格，包含 1 个巨大的标题区、右上角 1 张大型主图、左侧正文下方 1 张小型插图、中央偏左 3 列密集的报纸正文、中间 1 个引语框、左下角 1 个带有黑豹肖像的次要新闻块、底部 3 张小型缩略图，以及右侧 1 个标题为“What’s Next For Mamquiss?”的侧边栏。大部分正文应保持微小且部分无意义或呈现 AI 生成的伪文字效果，但必须完整保留主要可见标题。

右上角的主图展示了一位身穿香槟色丝绸礼服的迷人金发女郎背影，她站在酒吧吧台旁，身边是一只直立在凳子上或前爪搭在吧台上的大型黑豹。酒吧背景中有许多酒瓶和玻璃器皿，灯光温暖。女子的面部被刻意用矩形模糊块遮挡。黑豹体态圆润、毛色光亮，渲染得十分逼真。左侧标题下方的插图展示了黑豹在夜间靠近动物园出口或路径指示牌的场景。左下角的肖像展示了黑豹面部的特写。底部的 3 张缩略图展示了夜生活场景：黑豹穿梭在酒吧内部、黑豹与两名女性坐在小圆桌旁、以及黑豹在昏暗暖光下休憩。

采用 21 世纪初的小报美学，使用高对比度的黑色标题字体、米白色新闻纸、红色强调线、窄栏排版以及略显杂乱的真实报纸构图。整体基调为冷面荒诞新闻风格，逼真到足以让人一眼误以为是真实报纸，页面填满大部分画面，并在自然室内光线下拍摄。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫杂志封面

templates.prompt: A high-impact anime magazine cover in a futuristic cyberpunk editorial style, vertical full-page composition with dense Japanese typography and neon graphic design. The main focus is a close-up duo portrait in the foreground: on the left, a handsome anime boy with messy black hair streaked with bright cyan and a bold white front bang, sharp golden eyes, pale skin, a subtle confident smile, silver hoop earrings, and a black streetwear outfit with a hooded jacket, zipper details, layered shirt, and a black choker. On the right, slightly lower and partially overlapping him, a stylish anime girl with long wavy light-blonde hair, a black cap, oversized dark sunglasses, a glossy purple-and-white futuristic jacket, and one gloved finger raised near her lips in a cool pose. Surrounding them are 4 inset character portraits arranged diagonally along the upper-right side: 1 silver-haired anime boy in dark clothing, 1 purple-haired anime girl with violet eyes, 1 small silver-haired anime character with blue and pink highlights in the eyes, and 1 smaller brown-haired character near the lower-right edge. Use a dark black and deep navy background with electric magenta, hot pink, and cyan light streaks, glowing shards, splatter textures, halftone patterns, angular frames, and diagonal UI-like accents. The layout should look like a premium Japanese feature magazine cover, with large distressed metallic-white kanji headline across the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="共鳴する絆"}, smaller Japanese subheads and editorial callouts around the page, a top-right feature block reading “FEATURE VOL. 04 2024 SPRING 創刊号,” a left-side focus block, a bottom-left page marker reading “4/5 PAGE,” and small branding marks and decorative symbols throughout. Strong contrast, glossy print finish, layered depth, dramatic rim lighting, vivid neon reflections, stylish urban sci-fi atmosphere, polished gacha-game or light-novel promotional art quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具视觉冲击力的未来主义赛博朋克风格动漫杂志封面，采用垂直全页构图，配有密集的日文排版和霓虹图形设计。画面焦点是前景中的双人近景肖像：左侧是一位帅气的动漫少年，留着凌乱的黑色短发，挑染着明亮的青色，前额有一撮醒目的白色刘海，拥有锐利的金色双眸、白皙的皮肤、自信的浅笑，佩戴银色圆环耳环，身穿黑色街头风格连帽夹克，带有拉链细节、叠穿内搭和黑色颈圈。右侧略低且部分重叠的是一位时尚的动漫少女，留着波浪长卷发，戴着黑色鸭舌帽和超大号深色墨镜，身穿紫色与白色相间的未来感夹克，戴着手套的手指轻触唇边，姿态冷酷。周围沿右上角对角线排列着 4 个嵌入式角色肖像：1 位身穿深色服装的银发动漫少年，1 位拥有紫罗兰色双眸的紫发动漫少女，1 位眼睛带有蓝粉色高光的银发动漫小角色，以及右下角边缘处 1 位较小的棕发角色。背景采用深黑色和深海军蓝，点缀着电光洋红色、热粉色和青色的光束、发光碎片、喷溅纹理、半调图案、棱角分明的边框以及对角线 UI 风格的装饰。整体布局呈现出高级日本专题杂志封面的质感，顶部印有巨大的做旧金属白汉字标题 {argument name="headline text" default="共鸣する绊"}，页面周围环绕着较小的日文副标题和编辑标注，右上角设有“FEATURE VOL. 04 2024 SPRING 创刊号”专题板块，左侧设有焦点板块，左下角标有“4/5 PAGE”页码，并点缀着各种品牌标识和装饰符号。对比强烈，光泽印刷质感，层次感深厚，边缘光影戏剧化，霓虹反射生动，充满时尚的都市科幻氛围，具备精致的抽卡游戏或轻小说宣传图品质。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a high-impact Japanese anime magazine cover in a futuristic cyberpunk style, vertical portrait format, featuring a close-up ensemble composition of {argument name="main character" default="a pink-haired anime girl"} as the dominant subject. She has a short bob with layered bangs, large violet-pink eyes, pale skin, and a calm but intense expression, wearing a black baseball cap with white text, black X-shaped hairpins, a glossy black streetwear jacket with reflective graphic patches, and a magenta hood. She leans toward the viewer from the upper right-center, with one hand extended toward the camera in dramatic foreshortened perspective. Around her are 4 additional character panels total: 1 partially hidden silver-haired character in the center foreground beneath her, wearing a black cap; 1 silver-haired male character in the lower left triangular panel with dark clothing and earrings; 1 black-haired male character with a bold white forelock and golden eyes in the lower center panel; and 1 blonde female character in the lower right panel with a dark choker and layered fashion styling. Design the image as a glossy magazine cover with dense Japanese typography and editorial layout. Place a very large bold white Japanese headline on the upper left reading {argument name="main headline" default="交差する未来線"}, with smaller Japanese subhead text nearby. Add a top-right issue block reading “FEATURE”, “VOL. 03”, “2024 SPRING”, and “創刊号”. Add vertical Japanese sidebar text along the right edge, a left-side feature box with multiple lines of Japanese copy and a large magenta “5”, a bottom-left page marker reading “3/5 PAGE”, and small English tag labels near the lower panels such as “+ CONNECT”, “+ IDENTITY”, and “+ RESONANCE”. Include a bottom-center Japanese caption strip and a small emblem logo at the bottom right. Use a neon color palette dominated by {argument name="primary color palette" default="electric magenta, violet, black, and cyan"}, with glowing rim light, ink splatter accents, sharp graphic diagonals, halftone textures, glossy highlights, and layered UI-like editorial details. The overall feeling should be edgy, youthful, stylish, and cinematic, like a premium sci-fi visual culture magazine cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有未来赛博朋克风格、极具视觉冲击力的日式动漫杂志封面，采用竖版肖像构图，以 {argument name="main character" default="一位粉色头发的动漫少女"} 作为核心主体进行特写组合。她留着带层次刘海的短波波头，拥有硕大的紫粉色双眸、白皙的皮肤和冷静而深邃的表情，头戴印有白色文字的黑色棒球帽，佩戴黑色 X 型发夹，身穿带有反光图形贴片的亮面黑色街头风夹克，并戴着洋红色兜帽。她从右上侧向观众倾斜，一只手以戏剧性的透视效果伸向镜头。她周围共有 4 个额外的角色面板：下方前景处有一位部分被遮挡的银发角色，头戴黑色帽子；左下角三角形面板中有一位身着深色服装、佩戴耳环的银发男性角色；底部中央面板中有一位留着醒目白色前额发、拥有金色眼眸的黑发男性角色；右下角面板中有一位佩戴深色颈圈、穿着叠搭风格服装的金发女性角色。将图像设计为带有密集日文排版和编辑布局的精美杂志封面。在左上角放置一个非常醒目的白色粗体日文大标题，内容为 {argument name="main headline" default="交差する未来线"}，并在附近配以较小的日文副标题。在右上角添加发行信息块，注明“FEATURE”、“VOL. 03”、“2024 SPRING”和“创刊号”。在右侧边缘添加垂直的日文侧边栏文字，左侧功能框内包含多行日文文案和一个醒目的洋红色“5”，左下角添加页码标记“3/5 PAGE”，并在下方面板附近添加诸如“+ CONNECT”、“+ IDENTITY”和“+ RESONANCE”的小型英文标签。底部中央包含一条日文说明栏，右下角有一个小型徽标。使用以 {argument name="primary color palette" default="电光洋红、紫、黑和青色"} 为主的霓虹色调，辅以发光的轮廓光、墨迹飞溅装饰、锐利的图形对角线、半调纹理、亮面高光以及层叠的 UI 风格编辑细节。整体氛围应前卫、年轻、时尚且具有电影质感，呈现出高端科幻视觉文化杂志封面的效果。

templates.title: Dark Gatorade-Style Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 深色佳得乐风格肖像

templates.prompt: A dramatic, high-contrast studio portrait of a {argument name="subject gender" default="male"} athlete or model in the visual style of a premium sports drink advertisement, centered and facing straight toward the camera in a tight head-and-shoulders crop. The subject has {argument name="hair style" default="short dark hair brushed back"}, visible ears on both sides, and a rugged lower face with a short beard or stubble. Dress him in a dark zip-up athletic jacket with the zipper centered and visible near the collar. Use an almost entirely black background and extremely low-key lighting, with subtle rim light and soft highlights catching the hair, ears, jawline, shoulders, and jacket texture while most facial features remain swallowed by shadow for a mysterious, intense mood. The image should feel monochrome or nearly monochrome, with deep blacks, muted gray highlights, cinematic contrast, gritty texture, and a sleek commercial sports-brand aesthetic reminiscent of a {argument name="brand style" default="Gatorade"} campaign. Vertical composition, minimalist framing, no text, no logo, no props, no visible environment.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性、高对比度的影棚肖像，主角为一名 {argument name="subject gender" default="男性"} 运动员或模特，呈现高端运动饮料广告的视觉风格。主体居中，正对镜头，采用紧凑的头部和肩部特写构图。主体留有 {argument name="hair style" default="向后梳的深色短发"}，双耳清晰可见，下颌轮廓硬朗，带有短胡须或胡茬。身穿一件深色拉链运动夹克，拉链位于中心，在领口处清晰可见。背景几乎全黑，采用极端的低调照明，微妙的轮廓光和柔和的高光勾勒出头发、耳朵、下颌线、肩膀和夹克的纹理，而大部分面部特征则隐没在阴影中，营造出神秘而强烈的氛围。图像应呈现单色或近乎单色的质感，拥有深邃的黑色、柔和的灰色高光、电影级的对比度、粗犷的纹理，以及令人联想到 {argument name="brand style" default="佳得乐"} 广告活动的时尚商业运动品牌美学。竖构图，极简框架，无文字，无 Logo，无道具，无可见环境。

templates.title: Neon Anime Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹动漫杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a high-energy Japanese futuristic anime magazine cover in portrait orientation, designed like a glossy feature issue packed edge to edge with neon cyberpunk graphics. The composition is split into 5 sharp diagonal polygon panels outlined in black, each panel containing a different anime character portrait. At the top, place an oversized bold Japanese masthead reading {argument name="masthead text" default="次元交差"} in huge distressed white lettering with pink paint splatter and motion-streak accents, spanning almost the full width. Above it, add a small Japanese subtitle line in white. In the top right corner, design a magazine issue block with the words "FEATURE", a very large outlined "01", "VOL.", "MEMMODE", "2024 SPRING", and small Japanese text "創刊号" stacked in a clean editorial layout. The background should be dense with electric magenta, hot pink, cyan, blue, and black abstract streaks, halftone dots, glitch textures, floating plus signs, diagonal slashes, and light flares, giving a loud next-generation visual-culture feel. Show exactly 5 characters: 1) upper left panel, a handsome androgynous anime boy with messy layered silver hair, pale skin, black clothing with straps, zippers, layered necklaces, and a cool dark streetwear look; 2) upper right panel, a cute anime girl with light lavender-pink hair in twin braids, large magenta-violet eyes, a black cap labeled {argument name="cap text" default="MEMMODE"}, black X-shaped hairpins, and a black-purple outfit; 3) center panel, the main featured chibi-faced character with short white hair tipped with cyan and pink, one bright blue eye and one pink eye, wearing a glossy black cap and futuristic black outfit, looking directly at the viewer; 4) lower left panel, a serious anime boy with black hair and a bold white forelock, golden amber eyes, earrings, black hoodie and jacket layers, and blue neon rim lighting; 5) lower right panel, a softer feminine character with wavy blond hair under a dark cap, wearing a choker and holding a silver microphone near the chest, styled in pink-purple lighting. Make all characters highly polished, crisp, and vibrant, with large expressive eyes, sharp cel-shaded rendering, glossy highlights, and layered urban-tech fashion details. Add multiple editorial text blocks around the cover: on the left side a feature callout with Japanese text including "特集", a large stacked headline reading "交差する 5つの意志。", and two smaller Japanese lines below; a vertical side label reading "DIMENSION CROSS" and "MAIN"; a lower-left pickup box with "PICK UP", several Japanese lines, and 3 English hashtag lines such as "#IDENTITY #CONNECT #FUTURE", "#NEON #WILL #RESONANCE"; a bold page fraction "1/5 PAGE" at the bottom left; a bottom right focus box with "FOCUS" and small Japanese text; and a bottom-center Japanese tagline {argument name="bottom tagline" default="新たな物語の、はじまり。"}. The overall style should feel like a premium anime feature magazine cover, chaotic but balanced, with aggressive diagonal framing, strong contrast, glossy print design, and a black base flooded with neon pink and cyan energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的日本未来主义动漫杂志封面，采用竖屏构图，设计风格如同光鲜亮丽的专题刊物，画面中充斥着霓虹赛博朋克图形。整体构图被分割为 5 个黑色边框的锐利对角线多边形面板，每个面板内包含不同的动漫角色肖像。在顶部放置一个超大的粗体日文刊名，文字为 {argument name="masthead text" default="次元交差"}，采用巨大的做旧白色字体，并带有粉色油漆飞溅和动态条纹装饰，几乎横跨整个宽度。在其上方添加一行白色的小号日文副标题。在右上角，设计一个杂志期号区块，包含 "FEATURE" 字样、一个非常大的空心 "01"、"VOL."、"MEMMODE"、"2024 SPRING" 以及堆叠在整洁编辑布局中的小号日文 "创刊号"。背景应充满电光洋红色、亮粉色、青色、蓝色和黑色的抽象条纹、半色调圆点、故障纹理、浮动加号、对角斜线和光晕，营造出一种喧闹的次世代视觉文化感。展示 5 个角色：1) 左上角面板，一位英俊的中性风动漫少年，留着凌乱的银色层次感短发，皮肤白皙，身穿带有绑带、拉链和叠戴项链的黑色服装，呈现酷炫的暗黑街头风；2) 右上角面板，一位可爱的动漫少女，留着淡薰衣草粉色双马尾，拥有巨大的洋红紫色眼睛，戴着印有 {argument name="cap text" default="MEMMODE"} 字样的黑色鸭舌帽，佩戴黑色 X 型发夹，身穿黑紫色服装；3) 中心面板，作为主打的 Q 版脸型角色，留着发梢带有青色和粉色的短白发，一只明亮的蓝色眼睛和一只粉色眼睛，戴着光亮的黑色鸭舌帽和未来感黑色服装，直视观众；4) 左下角面板，一位表情严肃的动漫少年，黑发配大胆的白色前额挑染，金琥珀色眼睛，佩戴耳环，身穿黑色连帽衫和叠穿外套，带有蓝色霓虹轮廓光；5) 右下角面板，一位柔美的女性角色，深色鸭舌帽下是波浪状金发，佩戴颈圈，胸前拿着一个银色麦克风，采用粉紫色灯光渲染。所有角色均需高度精致、清晰且色彩鲜艳，拥有大而传神的眼睛、锐利的赛璐珞渲染、光亮的质感以及层次丰富的都市科技时尚细节。在封面周围添加多个编辑文本块：左侧是一个带有日文 "特集" 的专题标注，一个巨大的堆叠标题 "交差する 5つの意志。"，下方有两行较小的日文；一个垂直的侧边标签，写着 "DIMENSION CROSS" 和 "MAIN"；左下角是一个带有 "PICK UP" 字样的拾取框，包含几行日文和 3 行英文标签，如 "#IDENTITY #CONNECT #FUTURE"、"#NEON #WILL #RESONANCE"；左下角有一个粗体的页码分数 "1/5 PAGE"；右下角有一个带有 "FOCUS" 和小号日文的焦点框；底部中心有一句日文标语 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="新たな物語の、はじまり。"}。整体风格应呈现出高端动漫专题杂志封面的质感，混乱中保持平衡，具有强烈的对角线构图、高对比度、光面印刷设计，以及以黑色为底色、被霓虹粉色和青色能量覆盖的视觉效果。
