templates.title: Ink-Wash Tribute Poster for Chen Uen

titleLocalized.zh: 致敬郑问的水墨风格海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a vintage editorial poster on aged rice paper celebrating {argument name="artist name" default="CHEN UEN"}, designed like a museum infographic mixed with Chinese ink wash illustration and calligraphy. The format is a single vertically oriented poster with a weathered parchment background, ink splatters, faded handwritten annotations, red seal stamps, and a scholarly, archival atmosphere. At the very top, place large black Chinese calligraphy for the name 鄭問, followed by a slash and the romanized name {argument name="romanized name" default="CHEN UEN"} in large serif capitals, with a small red seal beside it. Under the title, add the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="The Taiwanese Master Who Turned Comics into Ink-Born Epic"} in elegant reddish-brown serif text. In the center, feature a dramatic painterly scene of 1 seated male artist in a loose white shirt at a desk, holding a brush over paper, his face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. Behind him, surround him with a swirling halo-like storm of monochrome ink-brush warriors and historical figures: exact count 9 visible character figures, including armored generals, swordsmen, and mounted riders, emerging from explosive black brushwork and smoke-like ink textures. On the left side, create a vertical section titled “Life & Milestones” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text. List exactly 6 timeline entries with red year markers and bilingual captions: 1958 born in Taiwan, 1983 Warrior Panther, 1989 Abi Sword, 1990 Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, 1991 Japan Cartoonists Association Award, 2017 legacy continues. Below that, add a small section titled “Ink in Detail” containing exactly 4 boxed brush studies labeled with short English captions: Dry brush texture, Ink wash gradient, Splatter energy, Bold contour line. On the right side, create a vertical section titled “Visual Method” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text. Include exactly 5 stacked boxed studies with image-and-caption layout: Brush as blade, Ink as atmosphere, Anatomy as fate, History as theatre, Speed lines become calligraphy. In the lower center, create a section titled “Major Works Constellation” with a dark brushstroke heading. Arrange exactly 5 circular work nodes around a central ink ring with Chinese calligraphy inside. Label the 5 nodes: Abi Sword, Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, Assassin Biographies, Magical Super Asia, Game character design legacy. Each circle contains a distinct monochrome or muted-color ink illustration, with subtle connecting marks like a constellation diagram. At the lower right, add a section titled “Studio Notes” containing exactly 6 visible objects: 4 hanging calligraphy brushes, 1 ink bowl, and 1 painter’s palette with blue and red pigment; beneath them place a sketchbook page with light pencil figure studies. Across the bottom, add a wide section titled “Why He Matters” with a black brushstroke header and smaller Chinese subtitle text, followed by a paragraph of serif body text in English describing his importance to comics, painting, calligraphy, cinema, and epic storytelling. Use a restrained palette of sepia, black ink, off-white paper, muted gray, with small accents of deep red and occasional blue. The whole image should feel like a refined cultural tribute poster, dense but balanced, highly detailed, painterly, and authentic to Chinese ink aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张印在陈年宣纸上的复古编辑海报，以纪念 {argument name="artist name" default="CHEN UEN"}。设计风格融合了博物馆信息图表、中国水墨插画与书法。海报为单幅竖构图，背景为风化的羊皮纸，带有墨迹飞溅、褪色的手写批注、红色印章，营造出一种学术性的档案氛围。在最上方，放置醒目的黑色书法字体“郑问”，后接斜杠及大号衬线体罗马拼音 {argument name="romanized name" default="CHEN UEN"}，旁边配有一枚小红章。标题下方，添加副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="The Taiwanese Master Who Turned Comics into Ink-Born Epic"}，使用优雅的红褐色衬线字体。画面中心展示一幅充满戏剧性的写意场景：1 位男性艺术家身着宽松白衬衫坐在桌前，手持毛笔悬于纸上，面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理。在他身后，环绕着一圈如同光环般的单色水墨武士与历史人物：共 9 个可见人物，包括披甲将军、剑客和骑兵，从爆发式的黑色笔触和烟雾状墨迹中浮现。在左侧，创建一个标题为“Life & Milestones”的垂直区域，配有黑色笔触标题和较小的中文副标题。列出 6 条时间线，带有红色年份标记和双语说明：1958 年出生于台湾，1983 年《战士黑豹》，1989 年《阿鼻剑》，1990 年《东周英雄传》，1991 年获日本漫画家协会奖，2017 年传奇永存。下方添加一个名为“Ink in Detail”的小节，包含 4 个带框的笔触研究，并配以简短的英文说明：Dry brush texture（干笔纹理）、Ink wash gradient（水墨渐变）、Splatter energy（飞白气势）、Bold contour line（粗犷轮廓线）。在右侧，创建一个标题为“Visual Method”的垂直区域，配有黑色笔触标题和较小的中文副标题。包含 5 个堆叠的带框研究，采用图文布局：Brush as blade（笔如刀）、Ink as atmosphere（墨为境）、Anatomy as fate（骨骼即宿命）、History as theatre（历史即剧场）、Speed lines become calligraphy（速度线化为书法）。在下方中心，创建一个标题为“Major Works Constellation”的区域，配有深色笔触标题。在中央墨环周围排列 5 个圆形作品节点，环内带有书法字。标注 5 个节点：Abi Sword（阿鼻剑）、Heroes of the Eastern Zhou（东周英雄传）、Assassin Biographies（刺客列传）、Magical Super Asia（魔界人）、Game character design legacy（游戏角色设计遗产）。每个圆圈内包含独特的单色或低饱和度水墨插画，并以类似星座图的细线连接。在右下角，添加一个名为“Studio Notes”的区域，包含 6 个可见物品：4 支悬挂的毛笔、1 个墨碗和 1 个带有蓝红颜料的调色盘；下方放置一页带有铅笔人物素描的速写本。在底部，添加一个宽幅区域，标题为“Why He Matters”，配有黑色笔触标题和较小的中文副标题，随后是一段英文衬线体正文，描述他在漫画、绘画、书法、电影和史诗叙事方面的重要性。色调采用克制的棕褐色、水墨黑、米白色、柔和灰，并点缀深红色和少许蓝色。整幅图像应呈现出一种精致的文化致敬海报感，布局紧凑而平衡，细节丰富，具有绘画感，并忠实于中国水墨美学。

titleLocalized.zh: 纽约之秋旅行海报

templates.prompt: A vertical editorial-style travel poster in Spanish for a {argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"} titled “OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK,” designed with a sophisticated urban autumn mood and a premium photography-workshop aesthetic. Use a tall mobile-friendly poster layout with a warm off-white, beige, charcoal, and burnt orange palette. The composition is dominated by oversized condensed black sans-serif typography on the left: small text at the top reading “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO,” then the huge stacked headline “OTOÑO” on top, a smaller “EN” with short horizontal orange lines on both sides, and below it the huge stacked words “NUEVA YORK.” On the right side, place a narrow informational column with exactly 4 short benefit lines in uppercase: “7 NOCHES”, “GRUPO REDUCIDO”, “GUÍAS EXPERTOS”, and “MILES DE FOTOS” with the last line in orange. Below that, add the dates in large orange numbers “17-24” and beneath in black uppercase “DE OCTUBRE” and “DE 2026.” Add a thin vertical line near the far right edge and a tiny orange dot at the top. Integrate a moody New York street photo collage into the lower half and through the typography, centered on the Manhattan Bridge framed by dark brick buildings, wet streets, a few cars, steam rising from the roadway, and a lone photographer seen from behind in the foreground wearing a rust-orange beanie and a backpack, holding a camera toward the bridge. Let giant cropped letterforms from “NYC” or similarly bold graphic shapes blend with the city imagery across the bottom half, creating a layered double-exposure poster effect. Add distressed paper textures, rough torn-edge overlays, brushy white paint textures, and subtle grunge for a handcrafted editorial finish. On the left lower-mid area, place a circular orange stamp containing a small Statue of Liberty torch icon and the curved text “III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK.” Along the bottom, create a dark band with 2 presenter credits, one left and one right, separated by a thin vertical orange line: left “CARLOS SÁNCHEZ” with “@CHOCUTUTS” in orange below, right “JON TARAFA” with “@JONTCPHOTO” in orange below. Centered at the very bottom, add the website “VIAJENY.COM” in spaced orange uppercase letters. Include 2 partially cropped grayscale portrait cutouts in the bottom corners, one on the left and one on the right, blending into the dark footer area. Overall style: cinematic travel advertisement, contemporary magazine poster, bold typographic hierarchy, layered collage, gritty New York autumn atmosphere, high contrast, elegant and dramatic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版编辑风格的西班牙语旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"}，标题为“OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK”（纽约之秋），设计风格融合了精致的都市秋日氛围与高端摄影研讨会美学。采用适合移动端浏览的竖长海报布局，配色方案选用温暖的米白色、米色、炭灰色和焦橙色。构图左侧以超大号紧凑型黑色无衬线字体为主：顶部小字写着“III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO”，下方是巨大的堆叠标题“OTOÑO”，中间是一个较小的“EN”，两侧配有短横线，再下方是巨大的堆叠文字“NUEVA YORK”。在右侧，放置一列狭窄的信息栏，包含 4 行简短的优势说明，全部大写：“7 NOCHES”（7 晚）、“GRUPO REDUCIDO”（小团出行）、“GUÍAS EXPERTOS”（专家向导）和“MILES DE FOTOS”（海量照片），最后一行使用橙色。下方用巨大的橙色数字标注日期“17-24”，并在其下用黑色大写字母标注“DE OCTUBRE”（10 月）和“DE 2026”（2026 年）。在最右侧边缘附近添加一条细竖线，顶部点缀一个小小的橙色圆点。在海报下半部分及字体间融入一张充满情绪感的纽约街头照片拼贴，画面中心为曼哈顿大桥，背景是深色砖墙建筑、湿润的街道、零星车辆和从路面升起的蒸汽；前景中，一名背着背包、戴着铁锈橙色针织帽的摄影师背影正举着相机对准大桥。让“NYC”的巨大裁剪字母或类似的粗体图形与下半部分的城市影像融合，营造出分层的双重曝光海报效果。添加做旧纸张纹理、粗糙的撕边叠加层、笔触感白色涂料纹理以及微妙的污渍效果，打造手工编辑的质感。在左下中部区域，放置一个圆形的橙色印章，内含一个小型的自由女神像火炬图标，并环绕文字“III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK”。底部创建一个深色横条，包含 2 个主讲人信息，左右各一，中间用一条细橙色竖线隔开：左侧为“CARLOS SÁNCHEZ”，下方橙色字体标注“@CHOCUTUTS”；右侧为“JON TARAFA”，下方橙色字体标注“@JONTCPHOTO”。在最底部居中位置，以间距拉开的橙色大写字母添加网址“VIAJENY.COM”。在底部左右两角加入 2 个局部裁剪的灰度肖像剪影，与深色页脚区域自然融合。整体风格：电影感旅行广告、当代杂志海报、大胆的排版层级、分层拼贴、粗粝的纽约秋日氛围、高对比度、优雅且富有戏剧性。

templates.title: Premium Gaming Motherboard Studio Shot

templates.prompt: A high-end enthusiast ATX gaming motherboard product photo on a dark studio background, shown in a three-quarter top-down perspective angled from the lower left toward the upper right. The board is mostly matte black and gunmetal with sharp geometric armor plates, brushed metal textures, and subtle RGB edge lighting in blue, purple, and magenta. Feature an exposed modern Intel-style CPU socket near the upper center, 4 black DIMM memory slots on the right, large VRM heatsinks across the top and upper left, and multiple reinforced PCIe slots in the lower half. Include 3 major branded heatsink zones: a tall rear I/O shroud at upper left with an illuminated RGB eye logo and the text "MAXIMUS HERO", a left-side chipset/slot armor piece with the text "SUPREMEFX", and a large angular lower-right chipset cover with a silver ROG-style emblem plus a lower strip that reads "FOR THOSE WHO DARE". Show detailed capacitors, headers, power connectors, debug display reading "88" at the top right, and a small round start button nearby. Ultra-detailed commercial product photography, crisp focus across the board, realistic reflections on metal, premium luxury tech aesthetic, dramatic low-key lighting, clean black seamless backdrop, no cables, no CPU, no RAM, no other objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端发烧级 ATX 游戏主板产品照片，背景为深色摄影棚环境，采用从左下向右上倾斜的四分之三俯视视角。该项目主体为哑光黑与枪灰色，配有锋利的几何装甲板、拉丝金属纹理，以及蓝色、紫色和洋红色的细微 RGB 边缘灯效。上方中央露出一个现代 Intel 风格 CPU 插槽，右侧设有 4 个黑色 DIMM 内存插槽，顶部和左上方配有大型 VRM 散热片，下半部分有多个加固的 PCIe 插槽。包含 3 个主要的品牌散热片区域：左上方的高大后置 I/O 护罩，带有发光的 RGB 眼睛标志和“MAXIMUS HERO”字样；左侧的芯片组/插槽装甲片，带有“SUPREMEFX”字样；以及右下角大型棱角分明的芯片组盖板，带有银色 ROG 风格徽标和下方写有“FOR THOSE WHO DARE”的条纹。展示详细的电容器、接头、电源接口、右上角显示“88”的调试显示屏，以及附近的一个小型圆形启动按钮。超精细商业产品摄影，全板焦点清晰，金属反射真实，呈现高端奢华科技美感，戏剧性的低调照明，干净的黑色无缝背景，无电缆，无 CPU，无 RAM，无其他杂物。

templates.title: Pixel Art Bolirana Night Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 像素风 Bolirana 夜景

templates.prompt: A moody retro pixel art scene inside a Colombian neighborhood bar at night, shown in portrait orientation from a first-person perspective. In the foreground, a human hand at the bottom center holds a small shiny metal bolirana ball between the thumb and fingers, aimed toward a full bolirana lane machine in the middle of the room. The machine is custom themed with The Simpsons and Duff Beer branding: a red and yellow wooden lane with a large circular scoring hole at the front edge, several smaller scoring holes arranged near the backboard, three upright metal pins or bumpers, a backboard logo that says "Duff," and the text "THE SIMPSONS" near the lower front. The top marquee of the machine says "Tomate tu" and has a built-in digital score screen showing exactly 3 player labels: "JUGADOR 1", "JUGADOR 0", and "JUGADOR 2" with colorful pixelated score graphics. To the left on the brick wall, include a large illuminated beer sign with the eagle logo and the text "AGUILA CERVEZA." On the right side, a young man in a dark hoodie and jeans stands in profile beside the machine, one hand in his pocket and the other pointing at the scoreboard, his face intentionally obscured or blurred. In the lower right foreground, place a small wooden table holding exactly 2 bottles: a tall bottle labeled "AGUARDIENTE AMARILLO MANZANARES" and a brown beer bottle labeled "AGUILA." Add a narrow neon-lit vertical window or light panel in the back right glowing purple and blue. Use low-key warm amber and red bar lighting with deep shadows, brick walls, tiled floor, subtle reflections, and detailed 16-bit / 32-bit era pixel art shading, creating a nostalgic, intimate, slightly cinematic nightlife atmosphere in {argument name="location" default="Duitama, Boyacá"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满怀旧气息的复古像素风场景，描绘了夜晚哥伦比亚社区酒吧的内部，采用竖屏第一人称视角。前景中，画面底部中央的一只人手正用拇指和手指捏着一颗闪亮的小金属 Bolirana 球，瞄准房间中央的一台完整 Bolirana 游戏机。游戏机采用《辛普森一家》和 Duff Beer 主题定制：红黄相间的木制球道，前端有一个大的圆形得分孔，后挡板附近排列着几个较小的得分孔，三个直立的金属销或保险杠，后挡板上有“Duff”标志，下方前端印有“THE SIMPSONS”字样。机器顶部的大招牌写着“Tomate tu”，并配有一个内置数字计分屏，准确显示 3 个玩家标签：“JUGADOR 1”、“JUGADOR 0”和“JUGADOR 2”，以及色彩丰富的像素化分数图形。左侧砖墙上，设有一个巨大的发光啤酒招牌，带有鹰标和“AGUILA CERVEZA”字样。右侧，一名身穿深色连帽衫和牛仔裤的年轻男子侧身站在机器旁，一只手插在口袋里，另一只手指向记分牌，面部刻意模糊处理。右下角前景处，放置一张小木桌，上面摆放着 2 瓶酒：一瓶高大的“AGUARDIENTE AMARILLO MANZANARES”和一瓶棕色“AGUILA”啤酒。在右后方增加一个狭窄的霓虹灯垂直窗户或发光面板，散发着紫色和蓝色的光芒。运用低调的暖琥珀色和红色酒吧灯光，营造出深邃的阴影、砖墙、瓷砖地面、细腻的反射效果，以及精致的 16 位 / 32 位时代像素艺术阴影，在 {argument name="location" default="博亚卡省杜伊塔马"} 营造出一种怀旧、私密且略带电影感的夜生活氛围。

The restaurant should feel warm and nostalgic, with wooden paneling, a shoji-style window on the left, a small potted plant on the windowsill, a back counter with condiments and utensils, and a navy noren curtain on the right bearing large white Japanese text "蕎麦" and smaller vertical text "手打ちそば". templates.title: Vintage Engraved Hoodie Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古雕刻风格连帽衫肖像

templates.prompt: A centered black-and-white vintage engraved portrait of a bearded man wearing a hooded sweatshirt with the hood up and a backward snapback cap visible under the hood. Show only the upper torso and head against a plain off-white paper background with subtle texture. Render the image in detailed pen-and-ink etching style with dense cross-hatching, fine parallel lines, and old book illustration shading. The figure faces forward in a calm, neutral pose. The cap has a visible snap closure band across the forehead area, slicked-back hair is visible above it, and a thick full beard extends below the face. The hoodie has two drawstrings hanging down at the chest. Keep the composition symmetrical and tightly framed like a classic engraved bust portrait, with no color, no modern graphic elements, and no background objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的黑白复古雕刻风格肖像，描绘了一位蓄须男子，他穿着连帽衫并戴着兜帽，兜帽下露出反戴的棒球帽。仅展示头部和上半身，背景为带有细微纹理的素色米白色纸张。以细腻的钢笔画蚀刻风格呈现，运用密集的交叉排线、精细的平行线条以及古籍插画般的阴影效果。人物面朝前方，姿态沉稳自然。棒球帽前额处可见调节扣带，帽檐上方露出向后梳理的头发，面部下方留有浓密的络腮胡。连帽衫胸前垂下两条抽绳。构图保持对称且紧凑，如同经典的雕刻半身像，无色彩，无现代图形元素，背景中无其他物体。

templates.prompt: A black-and-white hand-drawn family portrait in the style of detailed pen-and-ink crosshatching on textured white paper, showing 4 people seated closely together in a casual candid composition. On the left, an adult man in a dark baseball cap worn backward and a dark T-shirt leans into the frame, with a crossbody sling bag worn across his chest and visible zipper details. On the right, an adult woman with curly hair tied up in a loose high bun wears a light T-shirt with large collegiate block letters reading {argument name="shirt text" default="CITY"}. In the center are 2 young children sitting close together, both with short curly hair and matching light-colored T-shirts printed all over with strawberries. The child on the left leans inward with one arm crossing the other child, and the child on the right tilts their head slightly upward. The adults frame the children protectively, creating a warm family snapshot feeling. Render the whole image as a monochrome etched illustration with dense fine-line hatching, engraved shadows, crisp contour lines, and a realistic yet artistic likeness, with no color, no background setting beyond a plain light paper texture, and a vertical portrait crop.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑白手绘全家福，采用细腻的钢笔交叉排线风格，呈现于带有纹理的白纸之上，画面中 4 人紧密坐在一起，构图自然随性。左侧是一位成年男性，头戴反向棒球帽，身穿深色 T 恤，身体向画面中心倾斜，胸前斜挎着一个带有明显拉链细节的单肩包。右侧是一位留着卷发并扎成松散高丸子头的成年女性，身穿浅色 T 恤，上面印有醒目的大号学院风字母 {argument name="shirt text" default="CITY"}。中间坐着两个紧挨在一起的幼童，两人都留着短卷发，穿着印满草莓图案的浅色配套 T 恤。左侧的孩子向内倾斜，一只手臂搭在另一个孩子身上，右侧的孩子头部微微上扬。大人们从两侧保护性地环绕着孩子，营造出温馨的家庭快照氛围。将整张图像渲染为单色蚀刻插画，运用密集的细线排线、雕刻般的阴影和清晰的轮廓线，在保持写实的同时兼具艺术感；画面无色彩，背景仅为纯净的浅色纸张纹理，采用竖构图。

templates.prompt: A high-end editorial product photograph of a single luxury perfume bottle centered in a warm earthy still-life scene. The product is a clear rectangular glass bottle filled with golden amber liquid, topped with a glossy rounded black cap, with a clean white front label that reads "BYREDO", "BAL D’AFRIQUE", and "EAU DE PARFUM". Place the bottle upright on 1 curved piece of pale weathered driftwood, surrounded by a dense carpet of 1 layer of rich green moss covering the foreground and lower frame. Use a minimal studio composition with the product isolated against a smooth warm brown-to-amber gradient background, softly illuminated like sunset light. Light the scene with dramatic directional warm light from the upper right, creating a bright glow on the background, a crisp highlight on the cap, soft reflections in the glass, and gentle shadows across the wood and moss. Keep the framing vertical, the bottle centered slightly low in the composition with generous negative space above, and the overall mood natural, luxurious, earthy, cinematic, and polished like a premium fragrance campaign shot.

The chip bag should be glossy metallic yellow with a large black irregular label shape on the front; inside it place the product name in big distressed white letters “{argument name="brand name" default="ZESTY"}” and below it a red banner with white text “{argument name="product type" default="POTATO CHIPS"}”, then smaller black text near the bottom right reading “{argument name="tagline text" default="BOLD FLAVOR. All four are turned toward the TV with attentive, quiet expressions, seen mostly in side profile or three-quarter back view. Place a vintage wood-framed CRT television on the right side atop a dark cabinet covered with a white floral lace cloth; the screen shows a black-and-white broadcast with a single person speaking. Behind the family, include cream-colored walls, a large old Mao poster on the upper left wall, and a vertical red calligraphy banner near the center reading {argument name="wall banner text" default="四化宏图 振兴中华"}. Add a wooden cabinet beneath a frosted-paned window, with lace runner cloth, enamel cups, a floral thermos flask, small jars, and a small bust decoration. On top of the TV place a square analog clock and a vase of pink flowers. In the foreground, include a simple rectangular coffee table with a lidded enamel mug and a plate piled with peanuts. Use soft indoor tungsten lighting, muted earthy colors, authentic 1980s Chinese household details, slight film grain, and a natural slice-of-life atmosphere. Set the overall scene in {argument name="setting" default="a Chinese family living room in the 1980s"}, with {argument name="family size" default="four family members"}, watching {argument name="tv program" default="a black-and-white television broadcast"}, in a {argument name="visual style" default="photorealistic nostalgic documentary photo"}.

templates.title: Gestural Ink Fashion Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 手势墨水时尚插画

templates.prompt:
ASPECT_RATIO: [{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"}]

SOURCE_IMAGE: [{argument name="reference" default="uploaded photo"}]

ACCENT_COLOR: [{argument name="accent color" default="single vivid highlight color"}]

Use the uploaded photo as the base image and the only identity source. Keep the person exactly the same and clearly recognizable. Ignore the original framing and always recompose into a tight close-up or upper-body editorial crop, with the face dominating the frame. Transform the image into a gestural editorial ink fashion illustration. The style must be built from bold black brushwork, not delicate sketch lines.

Use:

very thick black brush strokes

broad dry-brush sweeps

large asymmetrical black ink masses

long loose calligraphic lines

broken contours

scratchy secondary linework

strong black-on-ivory contrast

smooth monochrome skin

The thick strokes must be clearly dominant. Do not render the portrait mainly with thin contour lines. Do not make it neat, polished, or softly illustrated. The image should feel painted with a loaded brush and finished with sharp expressive pen marks.

Keep the portrait stylish and high-fashion.

Use one hero accessory, preferably oversized translucent tinted sunglasses.

The accent color [ACCENT_COLOR] must live mainly inside that accessory, especially in the lenses, as a bold luminous tint. Only tiny supporting traces of the same color may appear elsewhere.

promptLocalized.zh:
ASPECT_RATIO: [{argument name="长宽比" default="3:4"}]

SOURCE_IMAGE: [{argument name="参考图" default="上传的照片"}]

ACCENT_COLOR: [{argument name="点缀色" default="单一鲜艳的高光色"}]

以上传的照片作为基础图像和唯一的身份来源。保持人物完全一致且清晰可辨。忽略原始构图，始终将其重新构图为紧凑的特写或上半身编辑裁剪，使面部占据画面主体。将图像转化为手势风格的编辑类墨水时尚插画。风格必须由粗犷的黑色笔触构成，而非细腻的素描线条。

使用：

极粗的黑色笔触

宽阔的干擦笔触

大面积不对称的黑色墨块

修长且随性的书法线条

破碎的轮廓

带有刮擦感的辅助线条

强烈的黑白对比（象牙白背景）

平滑的单色皮肤

粗笔触必须占据主导地位。不要主要用细轮廓线来绘制肖像。不要使其显得整洁、精致或柔和。图像应呈现出饱蘸墨水的绘画感，并以锋利且富有表现力的笔触收尾。

保持肖像的时尚感和高定感。

使用一件核心配饰，最好是超大号的半透明有色墨镜。

点缀色 [ACCENT_COLOR] 必须主要体现在该配饰中，尤其是镜片部分，呈现为大胆明亮的色调。仅允许在其他地方出现极少量的同色系辅助痕迹。

Luxury fashion sale poster, premium editorial style. A confident high-fashion female model wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="sleek black leather dress and oversized sunglasses"}, holding a {argument name="handbag color" default="bold red"} designer handbag with metallic chain strap. Pose is slightly turned back, looking over shoulder, strong attitude.

Background: deep burgundy and black gradient with soft vignette, accented by a diagonal metallic gold stripe cutting across the composition. Large oversized faded “SALE” typography in background, partially hidden behind the model.

Top section: Elegant gold serif text “{argument name="brand" default="A & H"}” centered with thin decorative lines on both sides. Below it, large white serif title “FASHION” Under it, cursive gold script “Collection”

Bottom left: “40% OFF” in bold white modern typography, clean and minimal.

Add a handwritten signature “SIGNITURE” in gold at bottom left corner.

Lighting: dramatic studio lighting, soft shadows, high contrast, glossy highlights on leather outfit and handbag.

Color palette: burgundy, black, gold accents, with strong contrast and luxury feel.

Style: ultra-realistic, high-end fashion campaign, magazine-quality, sharp focus, 4K, cinematic depth, premium branding aesthetic.

Composition: vertical poster (2:3 ratio), model slightly right-aligned, text balanced on top and left

promptLocalized.zh:
奢华时尚促销海报，高级编辑风格。一位自信的高端时尚女性模特，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="时髦的黑色皮裙和超大墨镜"}，手提一款 {argument name="handbag color" default="亮红色"} 的设计师手袋，配有金属链条肩带。姿势微微向后转，回眸凝视，气场强大。

背景：深酒红色与黑色渐变，带有柔和的晕影，并饰有一条贯穿构图的对角线金属金条。背景中有巨大的超大号褪色“SALE”字样，部分被模特遮挡。

顶部区域：优雅的金色衬线字体“{argument name="brand" default="A & H"}”居中，两侧饰有细长的装饰线条。下方是巨大的白色衬线标题“FASHION”，其下为金色草书“Collection”。

左下角：“40% OFF”采用粗体白色现代字体，简洁明快。

在左下角添加金色手写签名“SIGNITURE”。

灯光：戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，柔和的阴影，高对比度，皮革服装和手袋上有光泽的亮点。

调色板：酒红色、黑色、金色点缀，具有强烈的对比度和奢华感。

风格：超写实，高端时尚宣传，杂志级品质，焦点清晰，4K，电影级景深，高级品牌美学。

构图：竖版海报（2:3 比例），模特略微右对齐，文字在顶部和左侧保持平衡

templates.title: Luxury Fashion Brand Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 奢侈时尚品牌广告

templates.prompt:
Luxury fashion advertisement poster, vertical composition, a confident young male model standing with arms crossed, wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="red and white vertical striped shirt"} (slightly unbuttoned), beige tailored trousers, brown leather belt.
Face: sharp jawline, light stubble, styled hair OR wearing a black cap (minimal logo), cinematic masculine look.
Background: deep rich red textured wall with dramatic sunlight casting a soft shadow of the model on the left side. Large oversized golden serif letters “{argument name="brand" default="AH"}” in the background (NO ampersand), subtle metallic texture, slightly blurred and blended into background for premium feel.
Lighting: warm, golden hour style lighting, soft highlights on face and fabric, high-end editorial shadows, dramatic but clean.
Typography (premium editorial style, elegant serif font like Didot/Bodoni):
Headline: “{argument name="headline" default="Effortless Dominance."}”
Subtext: “Not just an outfit. A statement of quiet confidence and unmatched presence.”
Brand name at bottom: “A&H”
Tagline: “PREMIUM. POWER. PRESENCE.”
Small footer line: “DESIGNED TO LEAD. MADE TO LAST.”
Color grading: cinematic, warm tones, high contrast, luxury magazine look (Vogue-style).
Style: ultra-realistic, 8k, sharp details, fashion campaign, premium branding, minimal clutter, perfect composition

promptLocalized.zh:
奢侈时尚广告海报，竖构图，一位自信的年轻男性模特双臂交叉站立，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="红白竖条纹衬衫"}（略微解开纽扣）、米色定制长裤、棕色皮带。
面部：轮廓分明的下颌线，轻微胡茬，精心打理的发型或佩戴黑色鸭舌帽（极简 Logo），电影质感的男性形象。
背景：深邃浓郁的红色纹理墙面，戏剧性的阳光在左侧投射出模特柔和的阴影。背景中有巨大的金色衬线体字母 “{argument name="brand" default="AH"}”（无“&”符号），带有微妙的金属质感，略微模糊并融入背景，营造高级感。
灯光：温暖的黄金时刻风格灯光，面部和织物上有柔和的高光，高端编辑风格的阴影，戏剧性且干净。
排版（高级编辑风格，优雅的衬线字体，如 Didot 或 Bodoni）：
标题：“{argument name="headline" default="Effortless Dominance."}”
副标题：“不仅仅是一套服装。这是静谧自信与无与伦比的存在感的宣言。”
底部品牌名称：“A&H”
标语：“PREMIUM. POWER. PRESENCE.”
底部小字：“DESIGNED TO LEAD. MADE TO LAST.”
调色：电影感、暖色调、高对比度、奢侈杂志风格（Vogue 风格）。
风格：超写实、8k 分辨率、细节锐利、时尚大片、高端品牌感、极简布局、完美构图

The soccer ball is massively oversized and zoomed-in in the foreground, dominating the lower part of the frame like viral "giant object" photos, extremely detailed texture, black and white panels, sharp focus. The boy is captured mid-kick with his right leg extended, dirt and grass particles flying dramatically. He wears a {argument name="clothing" default="crisp white t-shirt"} with bold black text "GPT IMAGE 2.0" printed on the chest, black athletic shorts, white socks with black stripes. Dynamic low-angle perspective, vibrant saturated colors, ultra-sharp clarity, high contrast, cinematic lighting with warm golden sun rays breaking through dramatic clouds, shallow depth of field, 8k photorealistic, hyper-detailed, National Geographic style --ar 3:4 --stylize 250 --v 6

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的电影级动作镜头，画面中一位 {argument name="child" default="12 岁男孩"} 留着凌乱的深色头发，正在 {argument name="setting" default="绿草如茵的体育场"} 上于黄金时刻的日落时分奋力踢球。前景中是一个被放大且占据画面下方的超大号足球，呈现出类似病毒式传播的“巨型物体”照片效果，纹理极其细腻，黑白相间的拼接细节清晰可见，焦点锐利。男孩被捕捉到踢球瞬间，右腿伸展，泥土和草屑戏剧性地飞溅。他身穿一件 {argument name="clothing" default="干净的白色 T 恤"}，胸前印有醒目的黑色文字“GPT IMAGE 2.0”，搭配黑色运动短裤和带有黑色条纹的白色球袜。动态低角度视角，色彩鲜艳饱和，清晰度极高，对比度强烈，电影级光影效果，温暖的金色阳光穿透戏剧性的云层，浅景深，8k 写实画质，超精细细节，国家地理杂志风格 --ar 3:4 --stylize 250 --v 6

templates.title: Luxury Skincare Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 高端奢华护肤品广告

templates.prompt:
High-end luxury skincare advertisement featuring a giant, oversized bottle of '{argument name="brand name" default="VELORA Hydrating Skin Cleanser"}' standing approximately 3 feet tall on a premium stone pedestal. The bottle design is sleek and modern, with a glossy finish, and its color perfectly matches the outfit of the model — a soft satin dress in {argument name="color theme" default="warm champagne gold tones"}, reflected identically in the bottle’s body color for a cohesive fashion-forward aesthetic. 

In the background, a {argument name="model description" default="stylish Western woman with glowing sun-kissed skin and blonde hair styled in a loose messy bun"} wears gold-accented sunglasses and a flowing satin dress. She leans elegantly over the oversized bottle, reaching toward the pump with a relaxed, confident pose, creating a striking forced perspective illusion that emphasizes scale and interaction.

The setting is a warm, editorial-style studio environment with earthy luxury tones — beige, sand, terracotta, and soft gold hues. In the foreground, premium natural elements such as sliced oranges, dripping golden honey, chamomile flowers, and smooth stones are arranged artistically on textured sand, enhancing the organic skincare narrative. Subtle condensation droplets are visible on the bottle, adding realism and freshness.

Lighting is cinematic and inspired by golden hour, with soft shadows and a warm glow that highlights both the product texture and the model’s skin. The composition includes intentional negative space for branding text. 

Overlay minimal, elegant advertising text in modern serif font:
'VELORA — Pure Hydration, Elevated.'
'Skin that glows naturally.'

Ultra-realistic, 8K resolution, sharp focus on product details, shallow depth of field, editorial fashion campaign, luxury skincare advertisement, premium branding, Vogue-style composition.

promptLocalized.zh:
高端奢华护肤品广告，画面中心是一个巨大的 '{argument name="brand name" default="VELORA Hydrating Skin Cleanser"}' 产品瓶，高约 3 英尺，矗立在高级石材底座上。瓶身设计时尚现代，表面光泽感强，其颜色与模特穿着的 {argument name="color theme" default="暖香槟金色调"} 柔滑缎面裙完美呼应，瓶身颜色与服装色调高度统一，呈现出前卫的时尚美感。

背景中，一位 {argument name="model description" default="皮肤散发着阳光般光泽、留着金色凌乱丸子头的时尚西方女性"} 佩戴着金色装饰的太阳镜，身着飘逸的缎面裙。她优雅地倚靠在巨大的瓶身旁，姿态从容自信地伸向泵头，通过强迫透视法营造出引人注目的视觉错觉，突显了比例与互动感。

场景设定为温暖的编辑风格摄影棚，采用大地色系的奢华基调——米色、沙色、赤陶色和柔和的金色。前景中，切开的橙子、滴落的金色蜂蜜、洋甘菊和光滑的鹅卵石等优质天然元素艺术化地摆放在质感沙面上，强化了有机护肤的叙事感。瓶身上可见细微的凝露水珠，增添了真实感与清新感。

灯光采用电影级质感，灵感源自黄金时刻，柔和的阴影与温暖的光晕突显了产品质感与模特的肤质。构图中留有刻意的负空间，以便添加品牌文字。

叠加极简、优雅的广告文案，使用现代衬线字体：
'VELORA — Pure Hydration, Elevated.'
'Skin that glows naturally.'

超写实，8K 分辨率，产品细节聚焦清晰，浅景深，编辑类时尚大片，奢华护肤广告，高端品牌质感，Vogue 风格构图。

templates.prompt: A vibrant, colorful digital painting in a lively impressionistic style with bold brush strokes and saturated colors. {argument name="main object" default="Two large crystal wine glasses filled with red sangria"} on a {argument name="setting" default="sunny outdoor Parisian café table"}. The left glass is packed with {argument name="fruits" default="orange slices, kiwi, raspberries, strawberries, and cherries"}, overflowing with fresh mint on top. templates.title: Hyper-Realistic Stoic Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 超写实斯多葛风格肖像

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic, cinematic medium close-up portrait of the uploaded person. The subject is positioned with their torso angled slightly forward, but their head is turned to the side, looking off-camera to the left with a deeply contemplative, serious, and stoic expression. One hand is raised, resting gently against the chin and lower lip in a classic "thinking" gesture, fingers softly curled. On the wrist is a {argument name="accessory" default="prominent, luxurious metallic chronograph watch"} with complex dial details. The subject is wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="sleek, dark black long-sleeved shirt or suit jacket"} that blends into the shadows, with metallic cuff accents catching the light. Background: A minimalist, moody, {argument name="background" default="textured charcoal-grey gradient backdrop"}, featuring a soft, faint vertical strip of light on the far left edge. Camera Angle & Photography: Eye-level angle, amazing high-end commercial portrait photography. Lighting, Editing & Effects: Dramatic chiaroscuro side-lighting illuminating the right side of the subject's face while casting deep, rich shadows on the left. The image features a shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the visible eye and the luxury watch. There is a distinct, heavy foreground blur (a hazy, soft white/grey light leak effect) obscuring the very bottom and bottom-left corner of the frame to create atmospheric depth. High-contrast editing, moody cinematic color grading, and a highly polished, premium aesthetic. ar 4:5

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实、电影质感的中景特写肖像，主体为上传的人物。主体躯干略微前倾，头部转向侧面，看向画框左侧，神情深沉、严肃且具有斯多葛风格。一只手抬起，轻轻托住下巴和下唇，呈现经典的“思考”姿态，手指轻微弯曲。手腕上佩戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="一枚醒目且奢华的金属计时码表"}，表盘细节复杂。主体穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件干练的深黑色长袖衬衫或西装外套"}，与阴影融为一体，金属袖口在光线下闪烁。背景：极简、情绪化的 {argument name="background" default="带纹理的炭灰色渐变背景"}，左侧边缘有一道柔和、微弱的垂直光带。相机角度与摄影：平视角度，顶级商业肖像摄影。灯光、剪辑与效果：戏剧性的明暗对照侧光照亮了主体面部的右侧，同时在左侧投下深邃、浓郁的阴影。图像具有浅景深效果，焦点清晰地落在可见的眼睛和奢华腕表上。前景有明显的重度模糊（一种朦胧、柔和的白/灰色漏光效果），遮挡了画面的最底部和左下角，以营造氛围深度。高对比度剪辑，情绪化的电影级调色，呈现出高度精致的高级质感。ar 4:5

templates.title: Aesthetic Creator Workspace

templates.prompt:
Aesthetic AI workspace scene inside an X (Twitter) profile interface, dark theme UI in the background showing a profile named "Noor 🌸" with a verified badge. In the foreground, a stylized semi-realistic digital girl with {argument name="hair style" default="short messy golden-yellow hair"} and soft glowing skin, wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="sleeveless mustard-yellow top"}, sitting at a desk and working on a laptop with the X logo.

Desk setup includes: a black smartphone with X logo, a minimal glass pen holder with pencil, a yellow pen, sticky notes, stacked notebooks, small yellow cube decor, and a {argument name="decor" default="vase with yellow flowers"}. Lighting is soft, cinematic, warm tones with high contrast against the dark UI.

Composition: centered subject, slightly angled view, sharp focus on the girl, blurred background interface. Hyper-detailed, smooth rendering, 3D + illustration hybrid style, trending on ArtStation, ultra clean, professional, cozy creator workspace vibe.

promptLocalized.zh:
在 X (Twitter) 个人资料界面内的美学 AI 工作空间场景，背景为深色主题 UI，显示着名为“Noor 🌸”且带有认证徽章的个人资料。前景中，一位风格化的半写实数字女孩，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="凌乱的金色短发"}，皮肤散发着柔和的光泽，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="芥末黄无袖上衣"}，正坐在桌前使用带有 X Logo 的笔记本电脑办公。

桌面布置包括：一部带有 X Logo 的黑色智能手机、一个极简玻璃笔筒（内含铅笔）、一支黄色钢笔、便签纸、堆叠的笔记本、小型黄色立方体装饰，以及一个 {argument name="decor" default="插有黄花的装饰花瓶"}。灯光柔和且具有电影感，暖色调与深色 UI 形成高对比度。

构图：主体居中，视角略微倾斜，焦点清晰对准女孩，背景界面虚化。细节丰富，渲染平滑，3D 与插画混合风格，ArtStation 热门趋势，极致简洁，专业且充满温馨的创作者工作空间氛围。

templates.title: Cinematic Tennis Sports Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感网球运动海报

templates.prompt:
Create a premium cinematic tennis sports poster in a bold {argument name="color theme" default="black and orange rainy theme"}. Show one athletic male tennis player in a powerful action pose, lunging forward during heavy rain, holding a tennis racket close to the camera as he strikes a yellow tennis ball. The player wears a {argument name="outfit" default="bright orange sports shirt"}, black shorts, black socks, and black tennis shoes. His body is wet from the rain, with dramatic water droplets, splashes, and motion blur around him. Add a subtle cyan rim light around the player for a sharp energetic outline.

Use a dark gritty textured background with heavy rain streaks, wet court reflections, water splashes, and orange diagonal graphic shapes behind the player. The poster should feel intense, modern, competitive, and social-media-ready.

Use large bold distressed typography on the left side with the main headline:

{argument name="main text" default="PLAY THROUGH THE STORM"}

Make “STORM” the biggest word in a rough brushstroke style. Add the {argument name="date" default="26 APRIL"} below:

Add a small supporting line:

RAIN SESSION

Color palette: deep black, charcoal gray, bright orange, white text, and subtle cyan glow.

Style: premium sports campaign poster, high contrast, gritty editorial design, dramatic rain atmosphere, sharp details, dynamic composition, modern typography, 4:5 vertical poster format.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张高级电影感网球运动海报，采用醒目的 {argument name="color theme" default="黑橙雨天主题"}。画面展示一位运动型男网球选手，处于强有力的动作姿态，在暴雨中向前扑救，手持网球拍靠近镜头击打一颗黄色网球。选手身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="亮橙色运动衫"}、黑色短裤、黑色短袜和黑色网球鞋。他的身体被雨水打湿，周围环绕着极具戏剧性的水滴、水花和动态模糊效果。在选手周围添加微妙的青色轮廓光，以呈现锐利且充满活力的边缘。

使用深色且富有质感的背景，包含密集的雨丝、湿润球场的倒影、水花以及选手身后橙色的对角线图形。海报需营造出强烈、现代、竞争感十足且适合社交媒体分享的氛围。

在左侧使用大号粗体做旧字体，展示主标题：

{argument name="main text" default="PLAY THROUGH THE STORM"}

将“STORM”作为最大的单词，采用粗犷的笔触风格。在下方添加 {argument name="date" default="4 月 26 日"}：

添加一行辅助文字：

RAIN SESSION

配色方案：深黑、炭灰、亮橙、白色文字以及微妙的青色光晕。

风格：高级运动宣传海报、高对比度、粗犷的编辑设计、戏剧性的雨天氛围、锐利细节、动态构图、现代排版、4:5 竖版海报格式。

the vehicle is highly detailed with visible mechanical precision: wide tires, deep rims, brake discs, vents, body kit, sharp reflections defined by clean color blocks and ink lines motion is exaggerated with dense speed lines, tire smoke trails in soft grey tones, asphalt debris, skid marks, and warped perspective lines bending around the car environment features {argument name="surroundings" default="[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]"}, rendered with simplified color blocking, strong perspective, and layered depth reacting to the car’s movement rendering uses bold black ink contour lines, varied line weight, flat color fills with minimal gradients, subtle cel shading, no painterly blending, no photorealism lighting is stylized with sharp highlights and shadow shapes, using color contrast instead of realistic lighting composition is aggressive and diagonal, with strong forward momentum, visual tension, and cinematic framing.

promptLocalized.zh:
高能彩色漫画风格街头赛车插画，主角为一辆改装的 {argument name="car model" default="[汽车型号]"}，主色调为 {argument name="primary color" default="[主色]"}，搭配 {argument name="accent color" default="[点缀色]"}，正以高速在 {argument name="scenery" default="[场景]"} 中漂移，采用极低角度拍摄，前侧 45 度视角，汽车占据画面主体。

templates.title: Hyperrealistic iPhone 17 Pro Max Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 超写实 iPhone 17 Pro Max 广告

templates.prompt: A hyperrealistic {argument name="phone model" default="Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max"} advertisement shot in a dark, moody editorial style. A young stylish woman with a warm complexion and soft upswept brunette hair, wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="dusty mauve velvet off-shoulder mini dress"}, thigh-high taupe suede heeled boots, and a thin black choker necklace, is captured mid-pose extending her arm forward holding an iPhone 17 Pro Max toward the camera in a confident selfie gesture. The phone — featuring a titanium Desert Sand finish with a flush quad-lens camera system and a edge-to-edge ProMotion display glowing with vivid color — dominates the center of the frame. The composition uses shallow depth of field with tack-sharp focus on the phone screen and extended arm, soft cinematic blur on the background figure. The {argument name="background style" default="near-black charcoal"} background is layered with subtle urban texture — faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the phone at different angles reading phrases like "EVERY ANGLE. EVERY MOMENT. EVERY YOU." and "THE SHOT YOU NEVER MISS" — some running vertically, some at 30-degree angles, creating a chaotic yet intentional graphic zine energy. At the upper right, the Apple logo appears in clean brushed silver against the dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation-style text bar reads "PRO CAMERA · TITANIUM BUILD · BEYOND INTELLIGENCE" in spaced all-caps serif font. A large commanding headline is placed center-right — "CAPTURE" in massive ultra-bold white letters followed by "EVERYTHING" in lighter weight creating dramatic type hierarchy. Small yellow plus (+) symbols and diagonal arrows (↗) scattered throughout as accent details. Bottom left features a bold slogan lockup: "YOUR WORLD. YOUR FRAME." in large bold sans-serif white text with a thin subline reading "The most powerful iPhone ever made. Every selfie is a cinematic moment." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional — a single cold key light from the upper left causing the titanium frame to shimmer, the ProMotion display to glow, and the velvet dress to catch a soft warm sheen against the darkness. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution. 3:4 vertical format optimized for social media.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的 {argument name="phone model" default="Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max"} 广告，采用暗调、情绪化的编辑风格拍摄。一位肤色温暖、留着柔和棕色盘发的时尚年轻女性，身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="灰紫色天鹅绒露肩迷你裙"}，脚蹬大腿高灰褐色麂皮高跟靴，颈戴细黑色颈圈，正处于摆拍姿势中，自信地伸出手臂，将 iPhone 17 Pro Max 朝向镜头进行自拍。手机采用钛金属沙漠色饰面，配备平齐的四镜头系统，边缘到边缘的 ProMotion 显示屏闪烁着鲜艳的色彩，占据了画面的中心。构图采用了浅景深，焦点清晰地落在手机屏幕和伸出的手臂上，背景人物则呈现出柔和的电影级虚化效果。{argument name="background style" default="近乎黑色的炭灰色"} 背景叠加了微妙的城市纹理——在浓重的暗色晕影中，隐约可见电光黄和柔和橄榄色的涂鸦笔触。多行超小的全大写排版文字以不同角度环绕手机，写着“EVERY ANGLE. EVERY MOMENT. EVERY YOU.”和“THE SHOT YOU NEVER MISS”等短语——有的垂直排列，有的以 30 度角倾斜，营造出一种混乱而刻意的图形杂志风格。右上角是简洁的拉丝银色 Apple Logo，与深色背景形成对比。顶部中央有一条细长的水平导航式文本栏，以间距宽阔的全大写衬线字体写着“PRO CAMERA · TITANIUM BUILD · BEYOND INTELLIGENCE”。右侧中心位置放置了一个醒目的大标题——“CAPTURE”采用巨大的超粗体白色字母，下方紧跟较细字重的“EVERYTHING”，形成了戏剧性的字体层级。画面中散布着黄色加号 (+) 和对角箭头 (↗) 作为装饰细节。左下角是醒目的标语组合：“YOUR WORLD. YOUR FRAME.”，采用大号粗体无衬线白色文字，下方配有一行细小的副标题：“The most powerful iPhone ever made. Every selfie is a cinematic moment.” 整体光影效果戏剧且具有方向感——来自左上方的冷色主光使钛金属边框闪烁，ProMotion 显示屏发出光芒，天鹅绒裙子在黑暗中捕捉到柔和温暖的光泽。照片级真实感。商业摄影质量。高对比度。4K 分辨率。专为社交媒体优化的 3:4 竖屏格式。

Style: high-end 3D cartoon (Pixar/Disney style), ultra-smooth rendering, subsurface scattering skin, fluffy fabric textures, highly detailed, clean composition. zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet [VISUAL STYLE] A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture. [GRID LAYOUT] Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression. [CHARACTER] Use image1 as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions. [WARDROBE] The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale. [PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME] Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”) Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions [MOTION INDICATORS] Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation. [RENDER QUALITY] High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose. [RESTRICTIONS] No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 舞蹈序列说明表 [视觉风格] 构图包含一位高度精细的 3D 渲染女性舞者。设计风格参考专业舞蹈编排指南，采用技术性、图表式的布局。干净的白色背景，柔和的摄影棚灯光，以及强烈的对比度以突出身体动作和姿态。 [网格布局] 结构化的 4×4 面板网格（共 16 帧），由细黑色分割线均匀隔开。每个面板尺寸相同，并清晰地编号为 1 至 16，以展示连续的舞蹈进程。 [角色] 使用 image1 作为基础角色。同一位女性舞者在所有面板中保持一致，具有准确的肖像特征和比例。 [服装] 舞者穿着时尚且适合表演的服装：修身上衣搭配短款飘逸裙装。造型应现代且具有视觉吸引力，同时兼顾舞蹈动作的实用性。即使在灰度模式下，面料也应微妙地响应动作（呈现轻微的流动感和褶皱）。 [面板结构 – 每一帧] 左上角：步骤编号 + 简短的舞蹈动作名称（例如：“步骤 5 – 旋转过渡”） 中心：捕捉编排中精确瞬间的全身姿态 左下角：3–4 行简洁的动作说明文字 叠加层：用于说明舞者如何过渡的运动箭头和方向引导 [运动指示] 加入用于流畅动作的曲线箭头、用于方向性步伐的直线箭头，以及用于旋转或转圈的圆形指示器。强调节奏、重心转移和身体局部动作。 [渲染质量] 高细节雕刻 3D 风格，具有平滑的灰度阴影、微妙的投影和干净的线条。保持精美的概念艺术级质感，确保每个姿态都清晰可见。 [限制条件] 无颜色，无背景场景，无额外角色，无视觉杂乱，仅保留舞者和说明性元素。

The mane is light and airy, contrasting with the heavy fur of the body. A majestic beast's face with locked brows, sharp glowing eyes, and a fierce yet restrained expression. A pair of curved horns with natural texture on the head. Thick and powerful limbs with golden claws showing slight metallic reflections. The body surface is integrated with Oriental gilded patterns, similar to cloud or ruyi patterns, enhancing the sense of divinity and design. The background is a Chinese landscape artistic conception, with layers of distant mountains, and the ground and space filled with swirling mist and clouds. templates.title: Minimalist Educational Infographic Template

titleLocalized.zh: 极简教育信息图模板

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
A clean educational infographic poster explaining "{argument name="topic" default="Topic"}".

[Overall Style]
Modern minimalist UI style, background in soft light colors (e.g., cream #FAF7F2 / light gray-blue), restrained and comfortable color palette suitable for long reading sessions.

[Core Requirements (Key)]
Naturally organize content modules based on the information structure of the "topic". Do not force a fixed number or order of modules; prioritize clear logical information over formal symmetry.

[Layout (Adaptive)]
- Use grid layout (auto-select 2 columns / 3 columns / irregular distribution)
- Card count adjusts based on content (usually 5–9)
- High information density modules can be enlarged (higher visual weight)
- Simple modules can be shrunk or merged

[Card Design]
- White cards (#FFFFFF)
- Rounded corners + subtle shadows (soft layering)
- Maintain uniform spacing and alignment

[Each Information Module Includes]
- Simple illustrations (unified style)
- Clear headings (strong hierarchy)
- 1–3 core explanatory sentences (avoid wordiness)
- Examples / comparisons / summaries provided where necessary

[Content Organization Principles (Emphasis)]
Auto-select appropriate structure based on theme, e.g.:
- Concept type → definition + principle + characteristics + example
- Contrast type → A vs B (comparative structure)
- Process type → steps / flowcharts
- System type → components + relationships
- Skill type → methods + tips + common mistakes

[Visual Hierarchy]
- Title > Module Title > Main Text > Supporting Information
- Important info can be highlighted with color or icons

[Color Suggestions]
- Primary color: Choose based on theme (Tech=Blue, Learning=Green, Warning=Orange)
- Secondary colors: 1–2 types suffice
- Avoid high saturation and flashiness

[Style Requirements]
- Generous negative space, strong sense of "breathability"
- Unified icons (linear or flat)
- High readability as priority
- Clear educational orientation

[Extra Optimization (Optional)]
- Can include: comparison blocks / process arrows / structure diagrams
- Can have a "Core Summary" module as a visual finale.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张简洁的教育信息图海报，用于解释“{argument name="topic" default="主题"}”。

[整体风格]
现代极简 UI 风格，背景采用柔和的浅色调（例如：奶油色 #FAF7F2 / 浅灰蓝色），配色克制且舒适，适合长时间阅读。

[核心要求 (关键)]
根据“主题”的信息结构自然地组织内容模块。不要强行固定模块的数量或顺序；优先考虑清晰的逻辑信息，而非形式上的对称。

[布局 (自适应)]
- 使用网格布局（自动选择 2 列 / 3 列 / 不规则分布）
- 卡片数量根据内容调整（通常为 5–9 个）
- 高信息密度的模块可以放大（增加视觉权重）
- 简单的模块可以缩小或合并

[卡片设计]
- 白色卡片 (#FFFFFF)
- 圆角 + 微弱阴影（柔和的层次感）
- 保持统一的间距和对齐

[每个信息模块包含]
- 简单的插图（统一风格）
- 清晰的标题（强层级感）
- 1–3 句核心解释性文字（避免冗长）
- 必要时提供示例 / 对比 / 总结

[内容组织原则 (重点)]
根据主题自动选择合适的结构，例如：
- 概念类 → 定义 + 原理 + 特征 + 示例
- 对比类 → A vs B（对比结构）
- 流程类 → 步骤 / 流程图
- 系统类 → 组件 + 关系
- 技能类 → 方法 + 技巧 + 常见错误

[视觉层级]
- 标题 > 模块标题 > 正文 > 辅助信息
- 重要信息可通过颜色或图标进行高亮显示

[配色建议]
- 主色：根据主题选择（科技=蓝色，学习=绿色，警告=橙色）
- 辅色：1–2 种即可
- 避免高饱和度和花哨的配色

[风格要求]
- 留白充足，具有强烈的“呼吸感”
- 统一的图标（线性或扁平化）
- 优先考虑高可读性
- 清晰的教育导向

[额外优化 (可选)]
- 可包含：对比模块 / 流程箭头 / 结构图
- 可设置一个“核心总结”模块作为视觉结尾。

templates.title: Oriental Cyberpunk Character Setting Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 东方赛博朋克角色设定集

templates.prompt: A high-completion character setting breakdown diagram, A4 vertical layout, oriental cyberpunk style, national tide technical style, next-gen 3A sci-fi game character setting collection texture, realistic digital painting, neon cinematic lighting, cold, majestic, and hardcore sci-fi feel. The protagonist is a completely new original image of the {argument name="mythological character" default="Chinese mythological figure 'Erlang Shen Yang Jian'"}, not Sun Wukong, with no monkey characteristics and no Golden Cudgel. The character is set as a high-level tactical executive officer of a conglomerate, with a high-precision holographic scanning prosthetic eye (the third eye) emitting a faint blue light implanted in the forehead, and a neat tactical slick-back hairstyle. Wearing a matte black high-collar bulletproof windbreaker, silver dragon-scale Kevlar bulletproof vest, and military-grade exoskeleton, accompanied by a fully armed cyber-mechanical police dog (Xiaotian Dog). Holding a foldable laser three-pointed double-edged blade, possessing an aura of absolute suppression and cold law enforcement. The primary colors are titanium silver, tactical deep blue, cold white, and warning yellow. The page includes: main visual bust, character name title, basic profile, attribute radar chart, front/side/back three-view drawings, expression set, weapon breakdown, clothing and accessory details, color scheme, and design highlight descriptions. The overall layout is like a high-end sci-fi game setting manual, with a holographic HUD interface style, clear modules, unified borders, a few Chinese labels, clean text, and no garbled code. Realistic textures, including matte composite armor, Kevlar fiber, optical lenses, and rich details of faint blue holographic projections, making it look like a character setting page from a top-tier oriental cyberpunk action game.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高完成度的角色设定拆解图，A4 竖版布局，东方赛博朋克风格，国潮技术流，次世代 3A 科幻游戏角色设定集质感，写实数字绘画，霓虹电影级光效，冷峻、威严且具有硬核科幻感。主角为 {argument name="mythological character" default="中国神话人物‘二郎神杨戬’"} 的全新原创形象，非孙悟空，无猴类特征，无金箍棒。角色设定为企业集团的高级战术执行官，额头植入有发出微弱蓝光的高精度全息扫描义眼（第三只眼），留着干练的战术大背头。身穿哑光黑高领防弹风衣、银色龙鳞凯夫拉防弹背心及军用级外骨骼，随行一只全副武装的赛博机械警犬（哮天犬）。手持可折叠激光三尖两刃刀，散发出绝对压制力和冷酷执法的气场。主色调为钛银色、战术深蓝色、冷白色和警示黄色。页面包含：主视觉半身像、角色名称标题、基本资料、属性雷达图、正/侧/背三视图、表情集、武器拆解、服饰配件细节、配色方案及设计亮点说明。整体布局如同高端科幻游戏设定手册，采用全息 HUD 界面风格，模块清晰，边框统一，带有少量中文标签，文字整洁，无乱码。写实纹理，包括哑光复合装甲、凯夫拉纤维、光学镜片，以及微弱蓝色全息投影的丰富细节，使其看起来如同顶级东方赛博朋克动作游戏的角色设定页。

templates.prompt: A highly detailed 3D digital artwork in a surreal and dynamic style. Capturing the moment a young Japanese man with black hair in an asymmetrical undercut and a sharp, intensely focused expression steps forward, leaning slightly forward as if quiet confidence and energy are exploding from within. Precise and realistic 3D rendering, depicting skin texture, pores, and individual hairs. He wears a loose black zip-up hoodie with a subtle embossed '{argument name="monogram" default="PK"}' monogram on the chest, over a clean white crew-neck T-shirt. Vibrant neon green digital energy and light particles erupt dramatically from behind him, swirling and blending into glitch-like data stream shapes, interacting with his clothes and hair to represent the fusion of technology and humanity. templates.title: Professional Chinese Palmistry Analysis Chart

titleLocalized.zh: 专业中文手相分析图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Please generate a high-definition 3:4 ratio Chinese palmistry analysis chart based on the first palm photo I uploaded, combined with the layout style of the second reference image. Core Requirements: Please use the real palm in the first image as the main object of analysis, trying to preserve the original palm's shape, finger proportions, palm type, skin tone, palm line directions, and realistic texture. The second image is for visual style reference only: Refer to its Chinese metaphysics infographic style, cream-white background, brownish-red font, traditional calligraphy titles, red circular numbering, dotted guide lines, palm line markings, right-side text analysis column, and bottom comprehensive conclusion box. Do not copy the palm from the second image, do not copy watermarks, and do not include platform logos. Visual Style: Overall, create a high-end Chinese metaphysics style 'Palmistry Analysis Chart'. Image Ratio: 3:4. Quality: High-definition, clear details, suitable for posting on Xiaohongshu. Background: Cream-white rice paper texture, faint vintage texture. Main Colors: Dark brown, reddish-brown, light gold, cream-white. Font Style: Titles use Chinese calligraphy style, body text uses clear and readable Chinese Songti/Kaiti style. Overall Feeling: Professional, classical, clean, and high-end, like a palmistry analysis card issued by a traditional fortune-telling master. Title Design: Write the main title at the top: 'Palmistry Analysis Chart'. Write the subtitle: 'Traditional Palmistry · Yi Principles Reference · Trend Analysis'. Add a small red seal next to the title with the text: 'Heavenly Mystery'. Write small text at the bottom: 'For traditional culture and entertainment reference only'. Palm Annotation Requirements: Please use thin reddish-brown lines, dotted lines, dots, and numbers on the palm to mark the following 12 key points. Each number must clearly correspond to the analysis content on the right. 12 points to be marked: 1. Life Line, 2. Wisdom Line, 3. Heart Line, 4. Fate Line, 5. Sun Line, 6. Health Line / Mercury Line, 7. Marriage Line, 8. Mount of Venus, 9. Mount of Jupiter, 10. Mount of the Moon, 11. Thumb Spread / Willpower, 12. Finger Morphology and Palm Type. Annotation Requirements: Lines must fit the general direction of the actual palm lines in the first image, do not draw randomly. Numbers and text must not obstruct the main body of the palm. Dotted guide lines must be clear like a professional diagram. There should be reasonable annotations on the left side, right side, and inside the palm. The overall layout should be like the second image, with the palm analysis diagram on the left and text explanations on the right. Right-side Analysis Text Requirements: Please generate 12 Chinese analyses on the right, each corresponding to a number. The text style should be like an analysis combining traditional palmistry, I Ching, and TCM constitution; the language should be professional, have a sense of warning, and a sense of metaphysics, but not too exaggerated. Each item should be controlled within 2-4 lines with clear and readable text. Please use the following analysis content: 1. Life Line: The arc is large and overall continuous, suggesting the basic physical energy is not bad and recovery under pressure is strong; if the middle and later sections appear fragmented, it suggests periodic fatigue and lifestyle imbalance, so be careful of vitality exhaustion. 2. Wisdom Line: The line is long and slants slightly downward, indicating delicate thinking and strong perception, with observation and imagination in doing things; but it is also easy to overthink, leading to repeated internal conflict under emotional stress. 3. Heart Line: The length is fair; if there is a slight split at the end, it represents being serious and slow-to-warm in relationships, valuing both investment and spiritual compatibility; sensitive at heart, prone to disappointment due to high expectations. 4. Fate Line: The vertical line in the palm is faint, indicating the path in early years was not found in one step, relying more on self-exploration and accumulation; it becomes more stable later, belonging to a pattern of trial and error before finalizing. 5. Sun Line: The sun line is thin, reputation and sense of achievement are late-blooming, not an overnight explosion, but gradually seen through works, reputation, and professional ability. 6. Health Line / Mercury Line: This line is relatively hidden; according to traditional TCM concepts, it mostly suggests that spleen, stomach, sleep, and emotional management should be prioritized; once stressed or staying up late, fatigue and a sense of qi and blood deficiency easily appear. 7. Marriage Line: If there is more than one fine line on the side edge, it represents choices and considerations in emotional experiences, not settling down easily; true stability often comes from value compatibility after maturity. 8. Mount of Venus: The base of the thumb is relatively full, indicating a person who values affection and family, with strong vitality and affinity; it also shows that security and realistic warmth are viewed as quite important. 9. Mount of Jupiter: There is a certain rise below the index finger, representing ambition, self-requirement, and a sense of responsibility that is not low; suitable for organizational, driving, and coordinating roles in a team. 10. Mount of the Moon: The texture below the palm edge is soft, indicating that intuition, empathy, and aesthetic sense are not weak; rich imagination, suitable for content, aesthetics, and communication-related matters. 11. Thumb Spread / Willpower: The angle of the thumb opening is natural, representing a clear sense of independence and executive will; not a follower, once the direction is clearly thought out, often able to continue moving forward. 12. Finger Morphology and Palm Type: The overall palm shape is long and the fingers are slender, belonging to a type that is rational with feelings, valuing both experience and logic; does not like to be too rough in doing things, and financial fortune is more suitable for steady progress. Bottom Comprehensive Conclusion: Please design a classical framed information box at the bottom, with the title: 'Comprehensive Conclusion'. Content: • The overall pattern is upper-middle, with much exploration and change in the early years, gradually becoming clear and moving towards stable accumulation in the middle and later periods. • The character is rational and pragmatic with empathy, suitable for establishing value through professionalism, aesthetics, communication, or long-termism. • Relationships value sincerity and spiritual compatibility, slow-to-warm but committed, easier to gain stable relationships after maturity. • The most important recent focus is adjusting routine, emotions, and spleen/stomach; keep your state, and your fortune will be smoother. Layout Requirements: Left side: Enlarge the main body of the palm, occupying 55%-60% of the screen. Right side: Place 12 numbered analyses, occupying 35%-40% of the screen. Bottom: Place the comprehensive conclusion box. Text must be clear, with no garbled characters, no typos, and no distortion. All numbers, lines, titles, and body text must have a unified Chinese aesthetic. The overall image should look like a professional metaphysical analysis chart, not like a standard phone screenshot. Do not include English. Do not include watermarks. Do not change the basic shape of the original palm. Finally, output a high-definition 3:4 Chinese palmistry analysis poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据我上传的第一张手掌照片，结合第二张参考图的排版风格，生成一张 3:4 比例的高清中文手相分析图。核心要求：请以第一张图中的真实手掌作为分析主体，尽量保留原手掌的形状、手指比例、掌型、肤色、掌纹走向及真实质感。第二张图仅供视觉风格参考：参考其中国玄学信息图风格、米白色背景、棕红色字体、传统书法标题、红色圆形编号、虚线引导线、掌纹标记、右侧文字分析栏以及底部综合结论框。请勿复制第二张图中的手掌，请勿复制水印，且不要包含任何平台 Logo。视觉风格：整体打造高端中国玄学风格的“手相分析图”。图片比例：3:4。画质：高清，细节清晰，适合发布在小红书上。背景：米白色宣纸纹理，带有淡淡的复古质感。主色调：深棕色、红棕色、浅金色、米白色。字体风格：标题使用中国书法风格，正文使用清晰易读的中文宋体/楷体。整体感觉：专业、古典、整洁且高端，如同由传统命理大师出具的手相分析卡。标题设计：顶部书写主标题：“手相分析图”。书写副标题：“传统手相 · 易理参考 · 趋势分析”。在标题旁添加一枚红色小印章，文字为：“天机”。底部书写小字：“仅供传统文化与娱乐参考”。掌纹标注要求：请使用细红棕色线条、虚线、圆点和数字在手掌上标记以下 12 个关键点。每个数字必须清晰对应右侧的分析内容。需标记的 12 个点：1. 生命线，2. 智慧线，3. 感情线，4. 命运线，5. 太阳线，6. 健康线 / 水星线，7. 婚姻线，8. 金星丘，9. 木星丘，10. 月丘，11. 大拇指张角 / 意志力，12. 指形与掌型。标注要求：线条必须符合第一张图中实际掌纹的走向，切勿随意绘制。数字和文字不得遮挡手掌主体。虚线引导线必须清晰，如同专业图表。左侧、右侧及手掌内部应有合理的标注。整体布局应参考第二张图，左侧为手掌分析图，右侧为文字说明。右侧分析文字要求：请在右侧生成 12 条中文分析，每一条对应一个数字。文字风格应结合传统手相、易经及中医体质，语言专业，带有一定的警示感和玄学感，但不过分夸大。每项内容控制在 2-4 行，文字清晰易读。请使用以下分析内容：1. 生命线：弧度较大且整体连贯，说明基础体能尚可，压力下的恢复力较强；若中后段出现断续，提示周期性疲劳及生活节奏失衡，需注意元气损耗。2. 智慧线：线条修长且略微下垂，显示思维细腻、感知力强，做事有观察力和想象力；但也容易思虑过多，在情绪压力下产生反复的内心冲突。3. 感情线：长度适中；若末端有轻微的分叉，代表对待感情认真且慢热，既看重投入也看重精神契合；内心敏感，易因期望过高而产生失落感。4. 命运线：掌中竖线较淡，说明早年路径并非一步到位，更多依赖自我探索与积累；后期趋于稳定，属于先试错后定型的格局。5. 太阳线：太阳线较细，名望与成就感属于晚发型，非一蹴而就，而是通过作品、口碑与专业能力逐渐显现。6. 健康线 / 水星线：此线较为隐蔽；按传统中医理念，多提示脾胃、睡眠与情绪管理需优先关注；一旦劳累或熬夜，易出现疲乏及气血亏虚感。7. 婚姻线：若侧边有不止一条细线，代表在情感经历中有选择与考量，不轻易定性；真正的稳定往往来自成熟后的价值观契合。8. 金星丘：拇指根部较为饱满，说明是一个重情重义之人，生命力与亲和力强；也显示出对安全感与现实温暖较为看重。9. 木星丘：食指下方有一定隆起，代表野心、自我要求以及不低的责任感；适合在团队中担任组织、推动与协调的角色。10. 月丘：掌缘下方质感柔软，说明直觉、共情力与审美感不弱；想象力丰富，适合从事内容、审美及沟通相关事务。11. 拇指张角 / 意志力：拇指张开角度自然，代表独立意识与执行意志明确；非随波逐流者，一旦想清楚方向，往往能持续前行。12. 指形与掌型：整体掌型修长，手指纤细，属于感性与理性并存的类型，既看重体验也讲究逻辑；做事不喜欢过于粗糙，财运更适合稳步推进。底部综合结论：请在底部设计一个古典边框信息框，标题为：“综合结论”。内容：• 整体格局中上，早年多探索与变动，中后期逐渐明朗，向稳步积累迈进。• 性格理性务实且具共情力，适合通过专业度、审美、沟通或长期主义建立价值。• 感情看重真诚与精神契合，慢热但专注，成熟后更易获得稳定关系。• 近期最重要的重点是调整作息、情绪与脾胃；稳住状态，运势会更顺遂。布局要求：左侧：放大手掌主体，占据屏幕 55%-60%。右侧：放置 12 条编号分析，占据屏幕 35%-40%。底部：放置综合结论框。文字必须清晰，无乱码，无错别字，无畸变。所有数字、线条、标题和正文必须具备统一的中国美学风格。整体图像应看起来像专业的玄学分析图，而非标准的手机截图。不要包含英文。不要包含水印。不要改变原手掌的基本形状。最后，输出一张高清 3:4 的中文手相分析海报。

templates.title: French New Wave Torn Poster Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 法国新浪潮风格撕纸拼贴海报

templates.prompt: A vintage 1960s French New Wave cinema poster collage on aged beige paper, designed like a torn-paper art-house one-sheet with analog grain, distressed print texture, rough ripped edges, ink wear, halftone imperfections, and slight misregistration. Center the composition around a large black-and-white portrait of a woman with messy dark hair, hand raised to her face, holding a cigarette, cropped from the chest up, with her face obscured by a rectangular blur block. Use a layered collage layout with exactly 8 major paper elements: 1) a top-left black text block reading "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent" above the large stacked name "ANNA KARINA" and smaller text "dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD"; 2) a red torn quote panel on the left reading "Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD"; 3) a blue torn panel in the upper right with a black label reading "PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962"; 4) a narrow torn newspaper clipping on the upper right reading "l’amour est plus fort que la mort"; 5) a yellow torn panel on the mid-right showing a black silhouette of a man in a hat facing a woman, beside a vertical black filmstrip border with white sprocket holes; 6) a bottom-left black-and-white Paris street photo with wet pavement, a lamppost, pedestrians, and a visible sign reading "HOTEL DU NORD"; 7) a small bottom-left review text block reading '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'; 8) a bottom-right cropped black-and-white portrait of a man in a suit with his face obscured by a rectangular blur block, partially covered by a red torn paper shape. Across the lower middle, place the huge torn-paper title in bold condensed uppercase: "À BOUT DE" in black and "SOUFFLE" in red, slightly angled and spanning most of the width. Under the title, add a blue torn strip with white uppercase text "UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ". At the bottom center, add "COMING SOON" in black uppercase and below it "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR". Limit the palette to faded cream, black, deep ultramarine blue, muted poster red, and mustard yellow. The overall mood is rebellious, romantic, and cinematic, like an iconic French New Wave poster made from ripped magazines, street photography, and bold typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 20 世纪 60 年代法国新浪潮电影海报拼贴画，背景为陈旧的米色纸张，设计风格模仿撕纸艺术电影海报，具有模拟颗粒感、做旧印刷纹理、粗糙的撕裂边缘、油墨磨损、半色调瑕疵以及轻微的套印不准。构图中心为一名留着凌乱深色头发的女子的黑白半身肖像，她抬手遮脸并拿着一支香烟，胸部以上构图，面部被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。采用分层拼贴布局，包含 8 个主要纸张元素：1) 左上角黑色文本块，上方写有“LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent”，下方为堆叠的大字“ANNA KARINA”及较小的文本“dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD”；2) 左侧红色撕裂引用面板，写有“Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD”；3) 右上角蓝色撕裂面板，带有黑色标签“PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962”；4) 右上角狭长的撕裂报纸剪报，写有“l’amour est plus fort que la mort”；5) 中右侧黄色撕裂面板，展示一名戴帽男子面对一名女子的黑色剪影，旁边是带有白色链轮孔的垂直黑色胶片边框；6) 左下角黑白巴黎街景照片，包含潮湿的地面、路灯、行人和清晰可见的“HOTEL DU NORD”标志；7) 左下角小型评论文本块，写有 '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'；8) 右下角裁剪过的黑白男子西装肖像，面部被矩形模糊块遮挡，部分被红色撕裂纸张形状覆盖。在下部中间，放置巨大的撕纸风格标题，使用粗体压缩大写字母：黑色“À BOUT DE”和红色“SOUFFLE”，略微倾斜并横跨大部分宽度。在标题下方，添加一条蓝色撕裂纸条，上面印有白色大写文本“UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ”。在底部中心，添加黑色大写字母“COMING SOON”，下方为“LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR”。调色板限制在褪色的奶油色、黑色、深群青色、柔和的海报红和芥末黄。整体氛围叛逆、浪漫且具有电影感，如同由撕碎的杂志、街头摄影和醒目排版构成的标志性法国新浪潮海报。

templates.title: French New Wave Protest Film Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 法国新浪潮抗议电影海报

templates.prompt: Create a vintage French New Wave political cinema poster as a torn-paper collage, vertical one-sheet composition, aged and distressed like a weathered 1968 street poster pasted on a wall. Use a limited palette of cream paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and muted cobalt blue, with heavy analog film grain, halftone print texture, ink bleed, fold creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, ripped edges, glue stains, and slightly misregistered letterpress typography. In the center, place a large black-and-white portrait of a brooding young man in a dark coat, seen in three-quarter profile, cropped from chest up, with curly dark hair and his face partially obscured by a rectangular censor-like paper block, giving the image a mysterious art-house feel. Surround the portrait with torn collage fragments: at upper left, a red paper panel with a black silhouette of a running protester; beneath it, a narrow off-white text strip reading “PARIS, MAI 68” and smaller French copy “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”; along the far left edge, a vertical black film-strip border with “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” in white; at lower left, a mustard-yellow torn panel with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at upper right, a blue torn panel containing the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.” with “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA” below; directly below that, a tall black-and-white photo fragment of a lone figure walking down a wet Paris street at night under lampposts; near the middle-right, a small torn newsprint block with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE” above a crowd scene; at lower right, a red torn panel with a black silhouette of a domed Paris landmark. Across the very top, centered in narrow black capitals, add the tagline “NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.” Near the lower middle, in small black condensed type, add “A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”. Make the main title dominate the lower half in huge condensed red uppercase letters over torn cream paper: “{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”. Directly underneath, in smaller blue condensed capitals, add the English subtitle “{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”. At the bottom center, place a black strip with large white condensed capitals reading “COMING SOON”, and below it smaller text “ÉTÉ 1968”. In the bottom left corner, include a Cannes-style laurel mark with “SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”. In the bottom right corner, add tiny production credits in French, including “UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”. Keep the whole design asymmetrical, raw, rebellious, and elegant, evoking Godard, Truffaut, May 1968 protest graphics, and handmade French art-house poster collage.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古的法国新浪潮政治电影海报，采用撕纸拼贴风格，垂直单页构图，呈现出如同 1968 年贴在墙上饱经风霜的街头海报般的陈旧感。使用奶油色纸张、褪色的黑色、深红色、芥末黄和柔和的钴蓝色作为有限配色，并添加浓重的模拟胶片颗粒感、半色调印刷纹理、墨水渗漏、折痕、划痕、粗糙的纸张纤维、撕裂的边缘、胶水渍以及略有错位的凸版印刷字体。在中心位置放置一张黑白肖像，画面为一名穿着深色外套、神情忧郁的年轻男子，四分之三侧面，胸部以上剪裁，留着卷曲的深色头发，脸部被一块矩形纸片遮挡，如同审查标记，赋予画面神秘的艺术电影感。在肖像周围环绕撕裂的拼贴碎片：左上方是一个红色纸板，上面有奔跑抗议者的黑色剪影；下方是一条窄窄的灰白色文字条，写着“PARIS, MAI 68”以及较小的法文文案“LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”；最左侧边缘是一条垂直的黑色胶片边框，印有白色的“36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM”；左下方是一个芥末黄色的撕裂纸板，上面有裁剪过的深色剪影肖像；右上方是一个蓝色撕裂纸板，包含引语“UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.”，下方注明“— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA”；其正下方是一张高大的黑白照片碎片，描绘了一个孤独的身影在夜晚的路灯下走过潮湿的巴黎街道；中右侧附近是一个小的撕裂新闻纸块，上面印有法文口号“LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE”，背景是人群场景；右下方是一个红色撕裂纸板，上面有巴黎地标建筑的黑色剪影。在顶部正中，用窄体黑色大写字母添加标语“NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.”。在下方中部附近，用小号黑色压缩字体添加“A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”。让主标题以巨大的红色压缩大写字母占据下半部分，覆盖在撕裂的奶油色纸张上：“{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”。正下方用较小的蓝色压缩大写字母添加英文副标题“{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”。在底部中心放置一条黑色长条，上面印有白色大号压缩大写字母“COMING SOON”，下方是较小的文字“ÉTÉ 1968”。在左下角包含一个戛纳风格的月桂叶标志，写着“SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”。在右下角添加细小的法文制作人员名单，包括“UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”。保持整体设计的不对称性、原始感、叛逆感与优雅感，唤起人们对戈达尔、特吕弗、1968 年 5 月抗议图形以及手工制作的法国艺术电影海报拼贴的记忆。

templates.title: Neon Night Shoulder-Look Portrait

Long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} wavy hair with loose texture and wispy bangs, slightly wind-swept. Natural dewy makeup, minimal styling, wearing an oversized {argument name="jacket material and color" default="black leather jacket"}. Moody urban background with blurred neon signs, streetlights, car headlights and taillights rendered as colorful bokeh, suggesting a lively downtown street. Off-center composition with the subject occupying the left-center of the frame and the street receding into the right side. promptLocalized.zh: 电影感特写肖像，一位年轻女性站在夜晚的城市街道上，采用垂直构图，取景范围从躯干中部向上。身体背对镜头，回眸看向相机，表情柔和而强烈。留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 波浪卷发，质感蓬松，带有凌乱的刘海，略显风吹感。自然水润妆容，极简风格，身穿一件超大号的 {argument name="jacket material and color" default="黑色皮夹克"}。忧郁的城市背景，模糊的霓虹灯招牌、路灯、车头灯和尾灯呈现出绚丽的散景效果，营造出繁华市中心的氛围。非中心构图，主体位于画面左侧中心，街道向右侧延伸。戏剧性的分色光影，一侧头发和夹克上带有冷青蓝色光，另一侧带有暖红洋红色光，呈现出青红色的电影级调色。高对比度，浅景深，细腻的胶片颗粒感，高光处带有轻微光晕，写实摄影风格，如同使用 Sony A7S III 搭配 85mm 镜头拍摄。

templates.title: Streetwear Collage Poster With Gold Bricks

titleLocalized.zh: 带有金砖元素的街头风拼贴海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold streetwear fashion campaign poster with a gritty editorial collage aesthetic. Show a young man from the waist up seated behind a dark table, centered slightly right, with thick dark hair swept back, wearing a black leather biker jacket over a plain white t-shirt. His face is obscured by a rectangular censor-style blur block. His right hand is raised near his face, pinching a tiny gold building brick piece between thumb and index finger, while his left hand rests on the table. On the table, place exactly 1 partially assembled gold brick trophy on a green base at the lower right and exactly 18 scattered small gold brick pieces spread across the tabletop in front of him. Build the background as a layered black-and-electric-blue torn paper collage with rough ripped edges, distressed print texture, halftone dot patterns, white scribble marks, thin grid overlays, and sticker-like graphic elements in neon green, white, and black. Make the oversized headline dominate the left half in stacked typography reading “NO RULES.” in huge distressed white block letters, with a neon green X slashing across the O area, then “JUST” in large neon green hand-painted brush script, and “STYLE” in white brush script beneath it with a neon green underline. Add exactly 8 secondary sticker/text graphics around the composition: 1) top right black taped sticker reading “BREAK THE NORM” in white stacked text with a small neon green smiley face beside it, 2) mid right narrow white vertical label reading “STYLE IS FREEDOM”, 3) mid left black stacked sticker reading “OWN YOUR LOOK. OWN YOUR WORLD.”, 4) lower left blue torn-paper label reading “STREET CODE” with a barcode and small globe icon, 5) bottom center black strip reading “BUILT DIFFERENT.” with neon green script underneath reading “MADE TO STAND OUT.”, 6) bottom right neon green label reading “GLOBAL VIBES” with smaller text “LOCAL ATTITUDE” and a globe icon, 7) bottom right small black stamp reading “EST. 20XX” with tiny subtext, 8) lower left hand-drawn crown doodle. Also add several neon green X marks and white arrow/squiggle doodles as accent graphics. Use a high-contrast palette of electric blue, black, white, and neon green, with the gold bricks as warm metallic accents. The mood should feel youthful, confident, rebellious, energetic, and like a modern Instagram ad for a fashion-forward streetwear brand.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有粗粝编辑风格拼贴美感的醒目街头时尚宣传海报。画面展示一位年轻男性，半身像，坐在深色桌子后方，位置略微偏右，留着厚实的背头，身穿黑色皮质机车夹克，内搭纯白色 T 恤。他的面部被一个矩形马赛克遮挡。他的右手举在脸部附近，拇指和食指捏着一块微小的金色积木，左手放在桌面上。在桌子右下角放置 1 个带有绿色底座的半组装金色积木奖杯，并在他面前的桌面上散落 18 块小型金色积木。背景采用分层的黑色与电光蓝撕纸拼贴效果，边缘粗糙撕裂，带有做旧印刷纹理、半调网点图案、白色涂鸦痕迹、细网格叠加层，以及霓虹绿、白、黑色的贴纸状图形元素。海报左半部分由超大标题占据，采用堆叠排版，巨大的做旧白色块状字体写着“NO RULES.”，其中“O”区域被一个霓虹绿色的“X”划过；下方是巨大的霓虹绿色手绘笔刷字体“JUST”，再下方是白色笔刷字体“STYLE”，并带有霓虹绿色下划线。在构图中添加 8 个辅助贴纸/文字图形：1) 右上角黑色胶带贴纸，写着白色堆叠文字“BREAK THE NORM”，旁边有一个小小的霓虹绿色笑脸；2) 右侧中部狭长的白色垂直标签，写着“STYLE IS FREEDOM”；3) 左侧中部黑色堆叠贴纸，写着“OWN YOUR LOOK. OWN YOUR WORLD.”；4) 左下角蓝色撕纸标签，写着“STREET CODE”，带有条形码和小地球图标；5) 底部中心黑色长条，写着“BUILT DIFFERENT.”，下方有霓虹绿色手写体“MADE TO STAND OUT.”；6) 右下角霓虹绿色标签，写着“GLOBAL VIBES”，下方有较小的文字“LOCAL ATTITUDE”和一个地球图标；7) 右下角小型黑色印章，写着“EST. 20XX”及微小的副标题；8) 左下角手绘皇冠涂鸦。此外，添加若干霓虹绿色“X”标记以及白色箭头/波浪线涂鸦作为装饰图形。使用电光蓝、黑、白和霓虹绿的高对比度配色方案，并将金色积木作为温暖的金属质感点缀。整体氛围应展现出年轻、自信、叛逆、充满活力的感觉，如同现代时尚街头品牌在 Instagram 上的广告。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高端且充满未来感的 {argument name="product name" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"} 产品广告海报，风格参照高端科技杂志封面。采用竖构图，背景为干净柔和的灰色摄影棚背景，边缘带有微妙的彩虹棱镜镜头光晕。背景中央是一位时尚的年轻人，面部被一个简单的矩形模糊块遮挡，戴着亮眼的霓虹青柠色针织帽，留着波浪状的粉色齐肩发，身穿黑白斑马纹上衣。耳朵里可见一只白色无线耳机。在极近的前景中，他们的手伸向镜头，拿着一个打开的亮面白色充电盒，采用戏剧性的浅景深和强制透视拍摄，使充电盒占据画面主体。打开的充电盒内清晰可见 2 只白色耳机。在构图周围添加 4 只较大的悬浮耳机：左侧 2 只，右侧 2 只，带有轻微模糊效果，仿佛悬浮在空中。在顶部放置巨大的粗体白色无衬线标题文字：{argument name="headline text" default="AIRPODS"}。在右上角，添加较小的堆叠式白色无衬线产品文字：{argument name="product label" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}。在左侧中部，添加堆叠式的白色功能标注：{argument name="left feature text" default="顶级音质与降噪功能"}。在右侧，添加 2 个巨大的白色数字功能块：一个写着“30”，下方配有较小的文字“小时电池续航”；另一个写着“1”，下方配有较小的文字“年保修”。采用流畅的商业照明，充电盒呈现亮面反光，产品细节清晰，现代时尚科技美学，精致的 Apple 风格广告设计，照片级真实感，高端编辑级质感。

templates.title: Professional Drink Photo Enhancement

templates.title: Open Manga Spread of Skirt Battle

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构“裙装对决”漫画跨页

templates.prompt: A photorealistic overhead view of an open Japanese manga magazine held in two human hands at the lower left and lower right corners, shown as a dramatic two-page black-and-white comic spread on slightly warm paper with visible page curvature, center gutter distortion, ink texture, screentone shading, and dense speed lines. The magazine fills almost the entire frame on a neutral tabletop. The spread depicts a fictional over-the-top battle sports manga about {argument name="sport name" default="スカートバウト"}, with exaggerated action, intense expressions, and absurdly serious tournament storytelling. In the center across both pages, show 2 main full-body schoolgirl fighters in a chaotic combat scene: on the left page center a long-haired teenage girl in a dark school blazer, ribbon tie, pleated skirt, and loafers spins powerfully with both arms raised overhead, her hair and skirt flaring in a circular arc; on the right page center a second teenage girl in a sailor-style school uniform is upside down in a handstand-like impact pose, one leg thrust high into the air, skirt exploding outward with violent motion lines, as if she has been thrown or is counterattacking. Make the composition packed with explosive radial lines, debris-like ink flecks, dramatic foreshortening, and giant bold Japanese sound-effect typography crossing the gutter. The spread should read like a mainstream shonen battle manga but focused on skirts and rotational motion rather than weapons. Include exactly 8 side panels around the central action: 4 stacked along the far left page and 4 along the far right page. On the left side, panel 1 shows a girl standing under a waterfall in ascetic training, panel 2 shows inverted handstand practice in shallow water, panel 3 shows intense physical training on the ground, panel 4 shows 2 girls in a close emotional conversation. On the right side, panel 1 shows a composed rival girl in portrait close-up, panel 2 shows a roaring audience in stadium stands, panel 3 shows a small comedic rules diagram explaining the sport with 2 simplified girls and a skirt icon, panel 4 shows a shocked face close-up reaction. Render all text as authentic Japanese manga lettering and captions, including vertical title calligraphy, side narration boxes, crowd chants, rule panel labels, and large impact kanji; use the visible phrases as inspiration but do not prioritize perfect legibility. Add one oversized vertical title on the left page reading {argument name="attack name left" default="白鳥の湖"} and one huge central impact phrase on the right page reading {argument name="attack name right" default="倒立回転逆襲"}. Preserve the feeling of a fake magazine feature or serialized manga chapter discovered in print, with believable halftone dots, slightly worn page edges, high contrast black ink, and a humorous yet sincerely epic tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的特写照片，展示了一双人手正翻开一本日本漫画杂志的中心跨页。视角略微从上方俯瞰，可以看到完整的双页黑白漫画，包括书脊的弧度、纸张纹理以及轻微的页面褶皱。跨页描绘了一部夸张的虚构战斗运动漫画，讲述了女孩们仅使用基于裙装的技巧进行战斗的故事，采用了极具张力的少年漫画风格，包含密集的网点纸、速度线、墨点飞溅、夸张的动作以及爆炸性的字体设计。中心动作横跨两页：两名身穿校服的女孩正在交战，左侧的女孩站立，姿态强劲，长发飘逸，身着西装外套和百褶裙，双手高举过头顶，仿佛正在施展必杀技；右侧的女孩则呈倒立旋转状，百褶裙像龙卷风一样向外散开，双腿向上伸展，仿佛正被抛出或在空中旋转。构图应充满混乱与动感，巨大的日文拟声词和攻击文字占据中心位置，特别是巨大的垂直标题式冲击短语“倒立回転衝撃”和另一个巨大的垂直招式名称“白鸟の湖”，并融入动作画面中。主画面周围总共有 8 个较小的侧边分镜：左页堆叠 4 个，右页堆叠 4 个。左页中，分镜 1 展示了女孩在瀑布下进行严酷训练；分镜 2 展示了水中的倒立特训场景；分镜 3 展示了力量训练或类似俯卧撑的练习；分镜 4 展示了两个女孩面对面时的情感特写。在这些左侧分镜旁添加粗体的日文励志标题，包括“天女の滝行!!”、“倒立の特训!!”、“腕の筋トレ!!”、“亲友の想いを胸に…!!”，底部还有一句巨大的情感宣言“努力は里切らない!!! 绝対に胜つんだから!!!”。右页中，分镜 1 是优雅对手冷静说话的特写，配有垂直的日文对话；分镜 2 是咆哮的观众席，挤满了观众和呐喊文字；分镜 3 是一个微小的解释性规则图，标注为“スカートバウト・ルール”，展示了 2 个简化的女孩形象和一个裙子图标，并配有简短的日文规则文本，解释禁止触碰裙子以外的任何部位；分镜 4 是一个震惊的脸部特写，配有黑色爆炸气泡中的反应文字“なっ!?”。在 2 个小脸部区域覆盖一些矩形马赛克，以模仿网上发布的杂志扫描件。漫画应看起来像是在现实生活中拍摄的周刊漫画合集页面，而非干净的数字排版：可见网点、装订线阴影、书页边缘、轻微泛黄的纸张、柔和的环境暖光，以及抓握在两侧下角的真实手指。

templates.title: Ethereal Hijab Portrait in Golden Light

titleLocalized.zh: 金光笼罩下的空灵头巾肖像

templates.prompt: A dreamy, ethereal portrait of a modest woman in side profile wearing a soft flowing hijab and layered scarf in {argument name="garment color" default="pale blush beige"}, standing against a deep midnight-dark background with faint architectural shadows. Her face is mostly turned away and softly obscured, keeping the mood anonymous and serene. She wears a loose long-sleeved dress or abaya in matching light fabric with delicate folds. Surround her with luminous golden particle trails and fine sparkling filaments that sweep diagonally around her body like magical wind, blending into clusters of glowing flowers and butterfly-like forms. The light effects should feel highly detailed and three-dimensional, with warm champagne, rose-gold, and ivory highlights against navy-black shadows. Place approximately 18 visible blossoms floating around and behind her, mixed in size, some sharp and some softly blurred, integrated into the swirling light. Add approximately 6 butterfly-like glowing forms, especially near the lower right and mid-body area, partially abstract and made of glittering light. The composition is vertical, elegant, cinematic, and painterly-photorealistic, with soft focus, bokeh, subtle lens bloom, and rich contrast. Emphasize grace, spirituality, femininity, and wonder, as if the figure is emerging from a constellation of light and flowers. Premium fantasy portrait aesthetic, ultra-detailed fabric texture, fine spark particles, gentle rim lighting, refined color grading, high-end digital art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻且空灵的肖像，描绘了一位侧身站立的端庄女性，她佩戴着柔软飘逸的头巾和多层围巾，颜色为 {argument name="garment color" default="淡腮红米色"}，背景为深邃的午夜黑，带有淡淡的建筑阴影。她的面部大部分背对镜头且被柔和地遮掩，营造出一种匿名而宁静的氛围。她身着宽松的长袖连衣裙或长袍，面料轻盈且带有精致的褶皱。她的周围环绕着发光的金色粒子轨迹和细小的闪烁丝线，如同魔法之风般斜向扫过她的身体，并融入成簇的发光花朵和蝴蝶状形态。光效应具有高度的细节感和三维立体感，在深海军蓝的阴影衬托下，呈现出温暖的香槟色、玫瑰金和象牙白高光。在她的周围和身后放置约 18 朵清晰可见的花朵，大小不一，部分清晰，部分柔和模糊，与旋转的光影融为一体。添加约 6 个蝴蝶状的发光形态，特别是在右下角和身体中部区域，呈现半抽象感，由闪烁的光芒构成。构图为竖向，优雅、具有电影质感且兼具绘画与写实风格，带有柔焦、焦外成像、微妙的镜头光晕和丰富的对比度。强调优雅、灵性、女性美和奇迹感，仿佛人物正从星群般的光芒与花朵中浮现。高级奇幻肖像美学，超精细面料纹理，细腻的火花粒子，柔和的轮廓光，精致的调色，高端数字艺术。
