templates.title: AirPods Style Tech Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: AirPods 风格科技广告海报

templates.prompt: A premium square advertising poster for {argument name="product name" default="AirPods Pro 3"}, styled like a modern tech campaign. Show a young woman centered in a soft studio setting with a smooth cool gray background, wearing a neon lime knit beanie and a black-and-white wavy striped top with lime trim. Her wavy shoulder-length hair is pastel pink, and one white wireless earbud is visible in her ear. Her face is partially obscured by a large centered rectangular blur block in warm beige-tan, covering most facial features. In the extreme foreground, her hand reaches toward the camera holding an open glossy white charging case, presented close to the lens with strong perspective distortion; inside are two white premium wireless earbuds angled visibly, and a tiny green status LED glows on the front of the case. Add two additional floating earbuds in the background on the right side, softly blurred, to suggest product variation and depth. Use shallow depth of field, crisp product highlights, smooth commercial lighting, subtle reflections, and polished high-end product photography mixed with fashion editorial portraiture. Overlay large bold white sans-serif headline text across the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="AIRPODS"}. Place smaller white subheading text at upper right reading {argument name="subheading text" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}. On the left side, add a 3-line white promotional copy block reading {argument name="left promo text" default="Premium sound and noise cancellation"}. On the lower right, add two large stacked numeric feature callouts in white: “30” with smaller text “hours of battery life.” and “1” with smaller text “year warranty.” Include subtle rainbow prism lens flares scattered around the image, especially near the edges and lower center, to create an iridescent futuristic feel. Composition should be clean, bold, glossy, aspirational, and unmistakably like a luxury consumer electronics social media ad.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级方形广告海报，用于 {argument name="product name" default="AirPods Pro 3"}，采用现代科技广告风格。画面中央是一位年轻女性，置身于柔和的摄影棚环境中，背景为平滑的冷灰色。她戴着荧光青柠色针织帽，身穿带有青柠色滚边的黑白波浪条纹上衣。她留着及肩波浪形淡粉色头发，耳朵里戴着一只白色无线耳机。她的面部大部分被一个位于中央的暖米棕色大矩形模糊块遮挡。在极近的前景中，她的手伸向镜头，拿着一个打开的亮面白色充电盒，通过强烈的透视畸变呈现于镜头前；盒内可见两只白色高端无线耳机，充电盒正面有一个微小的绿色状态指示灯在发光。在右侧背景中添加两只额外的悬浮耳机，并进行柔和的模糊处理，以增加产品多样性和深度感。采用浅景深、清晰的产品高光、平滑的商业照明、细腻的反射效果，将精致的高端产品摄影与时尚编辑人像摄影相结合。在顶部叠加醒目的白色无衬线大号标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="AIRPODS"}。在右上角放置较小的白色副标题文字 {argument name="subheading text" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}。在左侧添加一段 3 行的白色促销文案 {argument name="left promo text" default="卓越音质与降噪体验"}。在右下角添加两个堆叠的大号白色数字功能标注：“30”及下方较小的文字“小时续航。”，以及“1”及下方较小的文字“年保修。”。在图像周围（尤其是边缘和下方中心）加入细微的彩虹棱镜镜头光晕，营造出一种虹彩般的未来感。构图应简洁、大胆、光亮、令人向往，呈现出高端消费电子产品社交媒体广告的质感。

templates.title: Parody Isekai Edgelord Novel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 恶搞异世界暗黑风轻小说封面

templates.prompt: A dramatic parody anime light novel cover in a dark gothic romantasy style, designed like an absurdly over-the-top isekai web novel volume cover. Center a handsome young male antihero from the chest up in a heroic three-quarter pose with arms crossed, face mostly obscured by shadow, messy {argument name="hair color" default="black"} emo hair, pale skin, and a cold brooding presence. He wears glossy black armor with large shoulder plates, a black cloak and scarf wrapped high around the neck, dark gauntlets, a diamond-patterned tunic beneath the armor, and a small silver crest pinned at the chest. A massive black battle axe is strapped over one shoulder, with a sword hilt visible near the lower left side. Set him inside a ruined cathedral or castle archway with towering stone columns and a huge circular gothic window behind him, backlit by cold silvery moonlight. In the distant background, show sharp fantasy castle spires fading into mist. Use a palette of black, steel blue, silver, and antique gold, with high contrast rim lighting, subtle magical sparkles, and painterly anime illustration detail. Surround the entire cover with an ornate filigree gold border and elegant flourishes in every corner. Add lavish gold serif and script typography layered over the character like a real fantasy paperback cover. The main title should dominate the lower half in stacked lines with decorative swashes and mixed font sizes: {argument name="title text" default="The Absurdly Overpowered, Excessively Edgelord, Emotionally Constipated, Black-Haired, Red-Eyed, World-Saving, Dragon-Slaying, Harem-Accidentally-Collecting Demon Lord (Who Just Wanted a Nap)"}. In the upper right, add author text reading: {argument name="author name" default="TISAYAI"}. In the upper left, place a small ornate badge with the number {argument name="volume number" default="1"}. Include 3 side text blurbs in small gold type: upper left blurb, “I came to this world to flex my red eyes, emo hair, and godly plot armor. You're welcome.”; lower left oval blurb, “Villains Tremble. Heros Whine. He Yawns.”; lower right blurb, “I don't chose the isekai life, the isekai life made a huge fuss over me.” The overall tone is ironic, melodramatic, gorgeous, and intentionally ridiculous, like a premium fake bestselling isekai romance-action novel cover. Portrait orientation, highly polished, ultra-detailed, cinematic, decorative, readable typography integrated into the artwork.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满戏剧性的恶搞动漫轻小说封面，采用暗黑哥特浪漫奇幻风格，设计成夸张过头的异世界网文卷首封面。画面中心是一位英俊的年轻反英雄，半身像，采取英雄式的四分之三侧身姿势，双臂交叉，面部大部分隐藏在阴影中，留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 情绪化发型，皮肤苍白，散发着冷峻忧郁的气息。他身穿光亮的黑色盔甲，带有巨大的肩甲，黑色斗篷和围巾高高裹住颈部，戴着深色护手，盔甲下是菱形图案的束腰外衣，胸前别着一枚小巧的银色徽章。巨大的黑色战斧斜背在肩上，左下角隐约可见剑柄。背景设定在废弃的大教堂或城堡拱门内，身后是高耸的石柱和巨大的圆形哥特式窗户，被冷冽的银色月光逆光照亮。远景中，尖锐的奇幻城堡尖塔隐没在迷雾中。采用黑色、钢蓝色、银色和古金色调，具有高对比度的轮廓光、细微的魔法闪光以及绘画般的动漫插画细节。整个封面四周环绕着华丽的金色花丝边框，每个角落都有优雅的装饰。添加奢华的金色衬线体和手写体排版，像真实的奇幻平装书封面一样叠加在角色上方。主标题应占据下半部分，采用堆叠行排列，配有装饰性花饰和混合字体大小：{argument name="title text" default="那个（只想睡个午觉的）超级无敌、过度暗黑、情感迟钝、黑发红眼、拯救世界、屠龙、意外收集后宫的魔王"}。在右上角，添加作者文字：{argument name="author name" default="TISAYAI"}。在左上角，放置一枚带有数字 {argument name="volume number" default="1"} 的小型装饰徽章。包含 3 段小号金色字体的侧边文案：左上角文案，“我来到这个世界就是为了炫耀我的红眼、忧郁发型和神级主角光环。不客气。”；左下角椭圆形文案，“反派颤抖。英雄哀鸣。他打了个哈欠。”；右下角文案，“我没有选择异世界生活，是异世界生活非要围着我转。” 整体基调讽刺、夸张、华丽且刻意荒谬，如同高端虚构的畅销异世界浪漫动作小说封面。竖构图，高度精炼，超细节，电影感，装饰性强，排版与艺术作品完美融合。

templates.title: Lin Daiyu Ink-Wash Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 林黛玉水墨海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical poster in elegant Chinese new aesthetic style, blending ink-wash painting and refined digital illustration on a warm off-white rice-paper background. The composition features a single young ancient Chinese woman seated in profile facing left, calm and scholarly, wearing a soft light gray-white hanfu with subtle floral embroidery and long flowing sleeves. She holds an open stitched book in both hands near her lap. Her hair is styled in a classic updo with a low gathered bun and long dark strands trailing behind, decorated with delicate gold and pearl floral hairpins. The face area should remain unobstructed in the final image, with a serene, graceful expression. Build the scene around a dramatic black-and-gray ink rock formation that wraps behind and beneath her like a seat, with soft smoky watercolor edges and a thin winding metallic gold contour line running from upper right to lower center. Add a blossoming plum branch rising diagonally from the right side with small white flowers and dark bark. Near the lower left, include a small pool ripple with one visible water droplet splash. Scatter a few pale falling petals around the woman’s hands and lower left midground. Keep the palette restrained: ivory, ink black, ash gray, muted taupe, and subtle gold accents. The layout should feel airy and asymmetrical with large blank negative space on the left and top. Add Chinese typography integrated into the poster design: on the upper left, 3 very large vertical characters reading {argument name="character name" default="林黛玉"}; beneath them, the romanized name in small spaced serif capitals reading "LIN DAIYU"; beside the name, place a slim vertical poem column in Chinese; on the right lower midsection, add another short vertical Chinese text column; at the bottom center, add one small horizontal Chinese sentence. Include exactly 4 red seal stamps placed as traditional accents: 1 near the left poem column, 1 near the lower left by the water ripple, 1 beside the right text column, and 1 small seal-like accent integrated with the typography area. Also include exactly 2 minimalist gold line ornaments in the lower right quadrant. The overall mood is poetic, fragile, pure, melancholic, and literati-inspired, with museum-poster elegance and high-end editorial polish.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张优雅中式新美学风格的竖版海报，在温暖的米白色宣纸背景上融合水墨画与精致的数字插画。构图主体为一位年轻的中国古代女性，侧身向左端坐，神态安静且富有书卷气，身着浅灰白色汉服，饰有精致的花卉刺绣和长袖。她双手捧着一本翻开的线装书置于膝前。发型为经典的低发髻，长发垂于身后，点缀着精致的金饰和珍珠花卉发簪。最终图像中面部区域应保持清晰，表情宁静优雅。场景构建于一块戏剧性的黑灰色水墨岩石之上，岩石如座椅般环绕在她的身后与下方，边缘呈现柔和的烟雾状水彩效果，一条纤细蜿蜒的金属金线从右上角延伸至左下中心。右侧斜向伸出一枝盛开的梅花，点缀着小白花和深色枝干。左下角附近加入一处水池涟漪，并可见一滴溅起的水珠。在人物双手周围及左下中景处散落几片淡雅的落花。色调保持克制：象牙白、水墨黑、灰烬灰、柔和灰褐色，并辅以细微的金色点缀。布局应具有通透感和不对称性，左侧和顶部留出大面积的负空间。将中文字体融入海报设计：左上方为 3 个巨大的竖排文字，内容为 {argument name="character name" default="林黛玉"}；下方为小号间距的衬线体罗马拼音 "LIN DAIYU"；拼音旁放置一列纤细的竖排中文诗句；右下中段增加另一列简短的竖排中文文本；底部中心添加一句简短的横排中文。包含 4 枚作为传统装饰的红色印章：1 枚靠近左侧诗句，1 枚靠近左下角水涟漪处，1 枚位于右侧文本旁，另有 1 枚小型印章式装饰融入排版区域。此外，在右下象限包含 2 个极简主义金线装饰。整体氛围诗意、脆弱、纯净、忧郁且充满文人气息，具有博物馆海报的优雅感与高端编辑质感。

templates.title: Guangzhou Ink-Wash City Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 广州水墨风城市海报

templates.prompt: A refined vertical poster in contemporary Chinese ink-wash aesthetics, designed like a cultural city branding cover for {argument name="headline text" default="广州"}. Use a soft warm ivory paper background with large areas of negative space, delicate gray watercolor clouds, mist, and sweeping semi-abstract brushstroke arcs edged with muted metallic gold. The composition blends traditional Jiangnan-style ink painting with a modern skyline: on the right-center, depict the Guangzhou skyline emerging from haze across calm water, with the Canton Tower as the dominant tallest structure, slender and highly detailed, surrounded by several modern skyscrapers in pale gray-beige tones. In the lower left over the water, place 1 small traditional covered wooden boat with 1 standing boatman wearing a conical hat, rendered in dark ink silhouette with a subtle reflection. On the lower right foreground, include 1 flowering plum branch extending diagonally inward, with dark twisting bark and small vivid red blossoms. In the open upper-middle sky, add exactly 4 tiny flying birds. Keep the water smooth, reflective, and misty, with the city fading softly into the atmosphere. Along the left side, create elegant vertical typography in a minimalist poster layout: the large main Chinese title {argument name="headline text" default="广州"}, a small red seal-style label reading {argument name="region tag" default="南粤"}, two slim vertical text columns reading "千年商都" and "烟火与潮涌共生", a thin divider line, and small English text "GUANGZHOU" and "CANTON" beneath. Add 2 small seal marks in red near the lower-left text area and 1 tiny minimalist mountain line icon. At the very bottom center, place a faint small Chinese sentence {argument name="bottom quote" default="城在水上，梦在云间，心归岭南。"}. Overall mood: serene, elegant, poetic, high-end editorial poster, balanced asymmetry, light haze, restrained palette of ivory, charcoal gray, warm beige, black ink, cinnabar red, and brushed gold accents.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的竖版现代中式水墨风海报，设计风格如同文化城市品牌的封面，主题为 {argument name="headline text" default="广州"}。使用柔和的暖象牙色纸张作为背景，留出大面积空白，辅以细腻的灰色水彩云雾，以及边缘带有哑光金属金色的半抽象笔触弧线。构图融合了传统江南水墨画与现代天际线：在右中位置，描绘广州天际线在平静水面上的薄雾中显现，广州塔作为最显眼的最高建筑，线条纤细且细节丰富，周围环绕着几座浅灰米色的现代摩天大楼。在左下角的水面上，放置 1 艘传统小型木质篷船，船上有 1 位戴着斗笠的船夫，以深色水墨剪影呈现，并带有微妙的倒影。在右下角前景处，加入 1 枝向内斜伸的梅花，枝干苍劲，点缀着几朵鲜艳的红梅。在上方中间的留白处，添加 4 只飞鸟。保持水面平滑、具有反射感且充满雾气，城市景观柔和地融入大气之中。在左侧，采用极简海报布局设计优雅的竖排文字：大号中文主标题 {argument name="headline text" default="广州"}，一个写有 {argument name="region tag" default="南粤"} 的小型红色印章式标签，两列纤细的竖排文字“千年商都”和“烟火与潮涌共生”，一条细分割线，以及下方的英文小字“GUANGZHOU”和“CANTON”。在左下角文字区域附近添加 2 枚红色小印章和 1 个极简山脉线条图标。在底部正中央，放置一句淡淡的中文短句 {argument name="bottom quote" default="城在水上，梦在云间，心归岭南。"}。整体氛围：宁静、优雅、诗意、高端编辑海报风格，平衡的非对称构图，轻薄雾气，色调克制，包含象牙白、炭灰、暖米色、水墨黑、朱砂红及拉丝金点缀。

templates.title: New Chinese Style Ice Cream Drink Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 新中式冰淇淋饮品海报

templates.prompt: A premium vertical poster advertisement in elegant new Chinese aesthetics, featuring a single plastic cup of strawberry sundae-style ice cream drink as the central product. The cup is placed slightly below center, shot straight-on with soft studio lighting, with glossy white swirled soft serve on top, creamy white layers marbled with vivid strawberry-red streaks inside the cup, and a simple gold line-art mascot printed on the front. In front of the cup are exactly 2 strawberries: 1 whole strawberry and 1 halved strawberry with the cut face visible. The background is a warm ivory rice-paper texture with large areas of negative space. Surround the product with an ink-wash Chinese landscape composition: misty gray-black mountains, a winding brushstroke-like river or road flowing diagonally from lower left to upper right, subtle gold foil accents along the brush edges, a pale circular sun or moon near the upper middle, a small traditional pagoda on a mountain ridge, soft drifting cloud motifs, and blooming white plum blossoms on branches at the right edge and lower left corner. The overall palette is off-white, black ink gray, soft beige, gold, and strawberry red, balancing minimalism and luxury. Add vertical Chinese typography on the upper left with the large main title {argument name="headline text" default="蜜雪冰城"}, and a thinner vertical tagline beside it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="甜如初雪，温暖如常"}. Beneath that, place a small red seal stamp with Chinese characters, and below it a small uppercase serif-style Latin brand line reading {argument name="brand text" default="MIXUE BINGCHENG"}. At the bottom center, add one line of small Chinese slogan text reading {argument name="footer text" default="一杯甜，一座城，温暖每一个平凡的日常"}. Refined commercial poster design, high detail product realism, painterly ink illustration fusion, clean luxury layout, no extra products, no people, no busy background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用优雅新中式美学的高端竖版海报，以单杯塑料杯装草莓圣代冰淇淋作为核心产品。杯子置于画面中下方，采用正面平视拍摄，光线柔和，顶部为光泽感十足的白色螺旋状软冰淇淋，杯内呈现奶油白与鲜艳草莓红交织的纹理，杯身印有简约的金色线条吉祥物。杯子前方摆放着 2 颗草莓：一颗完整草莓，另一颗对半切开并露出切面。背景为温暖的象牙色宣纸质感，留白充裕。产品周围环绕着水墨山水构图：朦胧的灰黑色山峦，一条如笔触般蜿蜒的河流或道路从左下角斜向右上角延伸，笔触边缘点缀着精致的金箔，上方中部有一轮淡雅的圆日或圆月，山脊上矗立着一座小型传统宝塔，伴有柔和的流云纹样，右侧边缘及左下角点缀着盛开的白梅花枝。整体色调为米白色、水墨灰、柔米色、金色与草莓红，平衡了极简主义与奢华感。左上方添加竖排中文字体，大号主标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="蜜雪冰城"}，旁边配以较细的竖排副标题 {argument name="tagline text" default="甜如初雪，温暖如常"}。下方放置一枚小型红色中文字印章，印章下方为一行小号大写衬线体拉丁字母品牌名 {argument name="brand text" default="MIXUE BINGCHENG"}。底部居中处添加一行小型中文标语 {argument name="footer text" default="一杯甜，一座城，温暖每一个平凡的日常"}。精致商业海报设计，产品细节写实，水墨插画风格融合，布局简洁奢华，无多余产品，无人物，背景整洁。

templates.title: New Chinese Golden Staff Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 新中式如意金箍棒海报

templates.prompt: A refined New Chinese aesthetic poster on a warm ivory rice-paper background, minimalist and vertical, featuring a single luxurious golden 如意金箍棒 as the central subject. The staff is placed diagonally from the lower left foreground to the upper right, with the bottom end planted into a dark ink-splashed rocky surface and the top extending upward in a poised, heroic angle. The metal surface is richly engraved with intricate traditional relief patterns, cloud-and-dragon style ornament, polished gold highlights, and subtle glowing reflections. Around the staff, 2 sweeping metallic-gold brushstroke ribbons spiral upward in elegant S-curves, like calligraphic energy trails, partially transparent and painterly. At the base, black and gray ink wash, smoke, mist, and splash textures spread outward in a dramatic burst, blending realism with Chinese ink painting. Keep the composition spacious with strong negative space and a premium gallery-poster feel. Add 5 text groups arranged in traditional poster layout: on the upper left, a large vertical black calligraphy headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="如意金箍棒"}; beside it, a smaller vertical line of Chinese text reading "心有如意，万象皆可破"; below that, a small romanized subtitle in thin uppercase serif/sans style reading "RUYI JINGUBANG"; on the lower right, another vertical poetic line reading "一念起，风云动 / 一棒定，乾坤静"; at the bottom center, a faint small horizontal line reading "自在如意，无所不成". Include 2 red seal stamps, one on the left mid-lower area and one small seal near the lower-right text. Use elegant black typography, subtle gray ink traces, soft diffuse lighting, ultra-detailed product rendering, cultural luxury branding, serene yet powerful mood, and a balanced blend of ancient mythic artifact presentation and contemporary high-end Chinese poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的新中式美学海报，背景为温暖的象牙色宣纸质感，构图极简且呈纵向布局。画面中心为一根奢华的如意金箍棒，金箍棒呈对角线摆放，从左下角前景延伸至右上角，底端插入深色的泼墨岩石表面，顶端向上延伸，呈现出一种沉稳而英勇的角度。金属表面精雕细琢，刻有复杂的传统浮雕纹饰、云龙纹样，并带有抛光的金色高光和微妙的辉光反射。金箍棒周围，两条飘逸的金属质感金色笔触丝带呈 S 型螺旋向上，如同书法般的能量轨迹，半透明且具有绘画感。底部，黑色与灰色的水墨、烟雾、云雾和泼墨纹理向外扩散，形成强烈的视觉冲击，将写实风格与中国水墨画完美融合。保持构图开阔，留白充足，营造出高端画廊海报的质感。按照传统海报布局添加 5 组文字：左上方为巨大的黑色纵向书法标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="如意金箍棒"}；标题旁为一行较小的纵向中文文字“心有如意，万象皆可破”；下方为一行纤细的罗马拼音副标题，采用大写衬线/无衬线字体，内容为“RUYI JINGUBANG”；右下方为另一行纵向诗句“一念起，风云动 / 一棒定，乾坤静”；底部中心为一行淡淡的小字，内容为“自在如意，无所不成”。包含两枚红色印章，一枚位于左侧中下部，另一枚小印章位于右下角文字附近。采用优雅的黑色排版、微妙的灰色墨迹、柔和的漫射光效、超精细的产品渲染，展现文化奢华品牌感，营造出宁静而强大的氛围，完美融合了古代神话文物展示与当代高端中国风海报设计。

templates.title: Autumn Squirrel Child Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 秋日松鼠童装街拍

templates.prompt: A full-body cinematic portrait of an anthropomorphic squirrel child standing centered on a city pedestrian street in autumn, facing the camera with a calm, charming presence and hands tucked into the coat pockets. The character has fluffy squirrel ears, soft tan and cream fur, visible whiskers, and 1 large bushy tail sweeping out to the left side of the frame. Dress the character in a red beret, a blue plaid button-up shirt, brown corduroy overalls, a beige trench coat, and brown leather lace-up boots. Use a warm golden-hour palette with amber sunlight, shallow depth of field, and creamy bokeh. The background is a softly blurred urban shopping street with indistinct pedestrians, storefronts, and hints of red awnings, with fallen leaves scattered on the pavement. Photorealistic fur and fabric detail, storybook charm, fashion editorial styling, centered composition, eye-level camera, vertical portrait framing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的全身肖像，主角是一位拟人化的松鼠儿童，正站在秋季城市步行街的中央，面对镜头，神态从容迷人，双手插在外套口袋里。角色拥有毛茸茸的松鼠耳朵、柔软的棕褐色与奶油色皮毛、清晰可见的胡须，以及一条向画面左侧延伸的大尾巴。角色身穿红色贝雷帽、蓝色格子衬衫、棕色灯芯绒背带裤、米色风衣和棕色系带皮靴。采用温暖的黄金时刻色调，伴随琥珀色阳光、浅景深和柔和的焦外成像效果。背景是模糊的城市商业街，隐约可见行人、店面和红色遮阳篷，地面散落着秋叶。照片级皮毛与织物细节，充满绘本魅力，时尚杂志风格，居中构图，平视视角，竖构图肖像。

templates.title: Censored Monkey Kid in Denim

titleLocalized.zh: 身穿牛仔服的“被审查”小猴子

templates.prompt: A full-body studio portrait of a stylized anthropomorphic monkey child standing front-facing against a clean pastel light-blue seamless background. The character has a slim small body, brown fur on the arms and tail, oversized protruding ears, and a long curved monkey tail visible on the left side. The face is intentionally obscured by a soft blurred square block centered over the head, creating an anonymous censored look. Dress the character in 5 clearly visible fashion items: a blue denim beret, a medium-wash blue denim jacket with metal buttons and chest pockets, a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, matching blue denim jeans with rolled cuffs, and chunky white low-top sneakers. Add 1 silver pendant necklace over the shirt. The pose is relaxed and symmetrical with arms hanging naturally at the sides, feet apart, and the figure centered in frame from head to shoes. The lighting is soft, diffused, and commercial-studio clean, with subtle shadows under the shoes. Render in a hyper-detailed whimsical fashion-editorial style, mixing realistic clothing textures with cute surreal character design, crisp denim stitching, soft fur detail, and premium toy-like proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身工作室肖像，主角为一位风格化的拟人化小猴子，正对镜头站立，背景为干净的浅蓝色无缝背景。角色拥有纤细的小巧身躯，手臂和尾巴上覆盖着棕色皮毛，有着超大的突出耳朵，左侧可见一条长而弯曲的猴尾。面部被一个位于头部的柔和模糊方形色块刻意遮挡，营造出一种匿名的“被审查”感。为角色穿上 5 件清晰可见的时尚单品：一顶蓝色牛仔贝雷帽、一件带有金属纽扣和胸前口袋的中度水洗蓝色牛仔夹克、一件纯白色圆领 T 恤、一条卷边的配套蓝色牛仔裤，以及一双厚底白色低帮运动鞋。在衬衫外添加 1 条银色吊坠项链。姿势放松且对称，双臂自然垂在身体两侧，双脚分开，人物从头到鞋居中于画面。灯光柔和、漫射且具有商业工作室的干净质感，鞋下带有细微阴影。以超细节的异想天开时尚编辑风格渲染，将逼真的服装质感与可爱的超现实角色设计、清晰的牛仔缝线、柔软的皮毛细节以及高级玩具般的比例融为一体。

templates.title: Corporate Meeting Photo Upgrade

titleLocalized.zh: 企业会议照片升级

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, recreate the same business meeting as a polished, high-end corporate publicity photo from a new angle. Move the viewpoint closer to the presentation screen and shift to a wide front-left perspective so the display dominates the left side and the meeting table with the attendees sits on the right near large floor-to-ceiling windows. Replace the dim surveillance-camera look with bright natural daylight, clean modern office lighting, and a professional architectural interior feel. Remove all CCTV overlays, timestamps, recording indicators, floor/device text, and other security-camera artifacts. Upgrade the display content into a sleek keynote-style strategy slide in Chinese with the headline "2026年度战略规划：云端协同与新生态构建". On the left side of the slide, show 1 upward-trending quarterly bar chart labeled with 4 bars: Q1 +15%, Q2 +22%, Q3 +18%, Q4 +25%. On the right side, show 3 text sections with bold headings: "技术驱动创新", "全球化市场拓展", and "用户体验升级", each with short Chinese body copy beneath. Keep the scene photorealistic, with a premium corporate brand aesthetic, neat seating arrangement, and subtle face anonymization/soft blur on the people.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，以全新的视角重新创作同一场商务会议，将其打造为精致的高端企业宣传照。将视角移近演示屏幕，并切换至左前方广角视角，使显示屏占据左侧，会议桌及参会人员位于右侧靠近落地窗的位置。将昏暗的监控摄像头风格替换为明亮的自然光、整洁的现代办公照明以及专业的建筑室内质感。移除所有 CCTV 叠加层、时间戳、录制指示器、地面/设备文字及其他监控摄像头的伪影。将显示内容升级为精美的 Keynote 风格战略 Slides，标题为“2026 年度战略规划：云端协同与新生态构建”。在 Slides 左侧展示 1 个季度增长趋势柱状图，标注 4 个季度：Q1 +15%、Q2 +22%、Q3 +18%、Q4 +25%。在右侧展示 3 个带有加粗标题的文本板块：“技术驱动创新”、“全球化市场拓展”和“用户体验升级”，下方各配有简短的中文正文。保持场景的写实感，呈现高端企业品牌美学，座位布置整齐，并对人物进行细微的匿名化处理或柔焦处理。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Game Crossover Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克游戏联动海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic crossover promotional poster for a gritty sci-fi military game collaboration, designed like a premium Chinese game event key visual. Vertical composition, ultra-detailed, dark futuristic battlefield city at night with rain, smoke, sparks, neon haze, satellite dishes, towers, launch structures, and a war-torn industrial skyline. Two female combat characters stand back-to-back in the center as the main focus. The left character is a tactical recon operative in a black hooded armored stealth suit with layered plates, straps, gauntlets, and glowing blue tech accents, holding a compact high-tech crossbow pointed downward; her silhouette is sleek, lethal, and military. The right character is a cyberpunk female fighter inspired by a punk marksman archetype, with long electric-{argument name="hair color" default="blue"} braided hair, shaved side details, tattoos on her arm, black leather and tactical belts, and a large futuristic minigun-like weapon glowing purple-blue; she feels rebellious, dangerous, and iconic. Their faces are obscured by dark censor-like square blocks, preserving a mysterious meme-poster look. At the very top, small Chinese tagline text reads “两大战场 一种信念”. Dominating the header is enormous distressed metallic Chinese title text reading “三角洲行动 × 英雄联盟”, with the first part in weathered silver and the second part in worn gold. Beneath the headline is a thin line of smaller Chinese slogan text: “战术协同 · 信息制胜 · 突破极限”. On the left midground, include a large luminous blue holographic sign with a geometric logo and the word “HAAVK”. On the right midground, add a purple neon billboard with Chinese text “金克斯·信息位” and smaller subtitle lines beneath it. On the lower left near the left character, add a green-labeled caption box reading “露娜·侦察位”. Across the environment, add red laser streaks in the sky, blue scanning lines, purple atmospheric glow, faint explosions, and dense cinematic volumetric lighting. At the bottom center, place collaboration branding logos and text: “三角洲行动 × 英雄联盟” with English subtitles “DELTA FORCE” and “LEAGUE OF LEGENDS”, followed by the date line “战场集结 6月12日 战场重构”. Beneath that, show exactly 4 small feature badges in a row with icons and bilingual labels: “限定皮肤 / LIMITED SKIN”, “限定任务 / LIMITED MISSIONS”, “专属奖励 / EXCLUSIVE REWARDS”, and “战术协同 / TACTICAL SYNERGY”. Add a final small Chinese footer slogan and tiny copyright text. Overall style: blockbuster game marketing art, hyper-detailed photorealistic concept art, cyberpunk militarism, Tencent-style collaboration poster, dramatic contrast, blue-purple-orange lighting, crisp typography, epic and commercially polished.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的联动宣传海报，展现硬核科幻军事游戏合作，采用高端中式游戏活动主视觉设计。竖构图，超高细节，暗黑未来主义战场城市夜景，伴有雨水、烟雾、火花、霓虹雾气、卫星天线、塔楼、发射装置和饱经战火的工业天际线。两名女性战斗角色背靠背站在画面中心作为视觉焦点。左侧角色为战术侦察兵，身穿黑色连帽装甲隐身服，带有层叠护甲、绑带、护手和发光的蓝色科技元素，手持一把向下指的高科技紧凑型弩；其轮廓干练、致命且充满军事感。右侧角色为赛博朋克女性战士，灵感源自朋克神枪手原型，留着长长的电{argument name="hair color" default="蓝色"}编发，侧面剃发，手臂上有纹身，身穿黑色皮衣和战术腰带，手持一把巨大的、闪烁紫蓝色光芒的未来主义加特林式武器；她看起来叛逆、危险且极具标志性。她们的面部被类似审查方块的黑色方块遮挡，保留了神秘的模因海报风格。在最上方，小巧的中文标语写着“两大战场 一种信念”。占据标题位置的是巨大的做旧金属质感中文标题“三角洲行动 × 英雄联盟”，前半部分为风化的银色，后半部分为磨损的金色。标题下方是一行细小的中文口号：“战术协同 · 信息制胜 · 突破极限”。在左侧中景，加入一个巨大的发光蓝色全息标志，带有几何 Logo 和单词“HAAVK”。在右侧中景，添加一个紫色霓虹灯广告牌，上面写着中文“金克斯·信息位”以及下方的较小副标题行。在左侧角色附近的左下方，添加一个带有绿色标签的说明框，写着“露娜·侦察位”。在整个环境中，添加天空中的红色激光条纹、蓝色扫描线、紫色大气光晕、微弱的爆炸效果以及浓郁的电影级体积光。在底部中心，放置合作品牌 Logo 和文字：“三角洲行动 × 英雄联盟”，配有英文副标题“DELTA FORCE”和“LEAGUE OF LEGENDS”，随后是日期行“战场集结 6月12日 战场重构”。在下方，并排展示 4 个带有图标和双语标签的小型功能徽章：“限定皮肤 / LIMITED SKIN”、“限定任务 / LIMITED MISSIONS”、“专属奖励 / EXCLUSIVE REWARDS”和“战术协同 / TACTICAL SYNERGY”。添加最后的中文页脚标语和微小的版权文字。整体风格：大片级游戏营销美术、超高细节写实概念艺术、赛博朋克军事风、腾讯式合作海报、戏剧性对比、蓝-紫-橙色调灯光、清晰的排版、史诗感且商业化精良。

templates.title: Windblown Blue Gown Desert Editorial

titleLocalized.zh: 沙漠风中蓝色礼服时尚大片

templates.prompt: A high-fashion full-body editorial photograph of a barefoot woman standing and stepping forward on rippled desert sand, wearing a dramatic flowing {argument name="dress color" default="deep sapphire blue"} chiffon gown with a plunging halter neckline, wrapped waist, very high thigh slit, and an extremely long sheer train billowing powerfully to the right in the wind. Her {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is long and loose, blown sideways across the frame, and she wears delicate earrings, a bracelet, and a subtle necklace. Pose her in elegant side profile with her torso lifted, one leg extended through the slit, one hand lightly holding the fabric, creating a sense of motion and grace. Set the scene in a bright open desert or dry lakebed with pale sand, soft distant mountains low on the horizon, and swirling clouds of dust around her feet and behind her. Use warm late-afternoon backlighting with a hazy sunlit sky, soft golden-beige atmosphere, strong fabric translucency, cinematic movement, luxury fashion magazine styling, ultra-realistic texture, and a clean minimal background that emphasizes the dress and wind.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级时尚全身编辑摄影作品，画面中一位赤脚女性正站在起伏的沙漠沙丘上迈步前行，身着一件引人注目的 {argument name="dress color" default="深蓝宝石色"} 雪纺礼服，采用深 V 挂脖领口、裹身腰部设计、超高开叉，以及极长的透明裙摆在风中向右强力飘动。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 长发自然披散，被风吹向画面一侧，佩戴着精致的耳环、手链和简约的项链。让她以优雅的侧面姿态呈现，躯干挺拔，一条腿通过开叉处伸出，一只手轻轻提着裙摆，营造出动感与优雅感。场景设定在明亮开阔的沙漠或干涸湖床上，背景是苍白的沙地、地平线上低矮柔和的远山，以及她脚下和身后盘旋的尘埃。采用温暖的午后逆光，天空阳光朦胧，营造出柔和的金色米色氛围，展现出强烈的面料通透感、电影般的动态效果、奢华时尚杂志风格、超写实纹理，以及简洁的背景，以突出礼服与风的质感。

templates.title: Cherry Blossom Garden Evening Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花庭院晚宴肖像

templates.prompt: A photorealistic outdoor portrait of an elegant young East Asian woman standing in a traditional Japanese courtyard garden during cherry blossom season. She is shown from a three-quarter back view, turning slightly toward the camera, with her face mostly obscured by her angle. She wears a deep wine-red satin evening dress with thin spaghetti straps and a dramatic low open back, fitted closely through the waist and hips with soft reflective fabric highlights. Her hair is styled in a loose, romantic updo with a few wispy strands, decorated with 3 small pink blossom hair ornaments, and she wears delicate dangling earrings and a fine necklace. Surround her with blooming sakura branches heavy with pale pink flowers, with many individual petals drifting through the air. In the background, place a traditional Japanese wooden building with dark beams, shoji-style windows, and a gray tiled roof, softly blurred with shallow depth of field. Include a calm garden pond and stone edging in the lower background. Use warm spring sunlight, soft cinematic bokeh, high detail skin and fabric rendering, graceful posture, refined luxury fashion photography, natural colors, serene atmosphere, square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的户外肖像，展现了一位优雅的年轻东亚女性在樱花季伫立于日本传统庭院中的场景。她以四分之三背影示人，微微转向镜头，面部大部分被角度遮挡。她身穿一件深酒红色缎面晚礼服，配有细肩带和极具视觉冲击力的低露背设计，修身剪裁勾勒出腰部和臀部线条，面料呈现出柔和的反光质感。她的发型是随性浪漫的盘发，垂落几缕发丝，并点缀着 3 枚粉色小花发饰，佩戴着精致的吊坠耳环和细项链。周围环绕着挂满淡粉色花朵的樱花枝，空气中飘落着片片花瓣。背景处是一座带有深色横梁、障子窗和灰色瓦顶的传统日式木建筑，在浅景深效果下呈现出柔和的虚化感。画面下方背景包含一个宁静的庭院池塘和石砌边缘。采用温暖的春日阳光、柔和的电影级焦外成像、高细节的皮肤与面料渲染、优雅的姿态、精致的奢华时尚摄影风格、自然色彩，营造出宁静的氛围，采用方形构图。

templates.title: Clay Astronaut Moon Market

titleLocalized.zh: 黏土宇航员月球市集

templates.prompt: A whimsical handcrafted clay diorama of a {argument name="scene theme" default="night market on the moon"}, photographed like a miniature cinematic set. The ground is dusty gray lunar soil with small craters and uneven texture, and the background is a deep black sky scattered with many tiny warm-white stars plus one visible cratered moon in the upper left. Show 5 small astronauts in chunky vintage-style white spacesuits with rounded helmets and dark glossy visors, posed as market vendors and customers. Build 4 rustic market stalls from rough wood poles and stone-like counters, each topped with draped fabric canopies in muted blue-gray or rusty red tones. Hang warm glowing orange paper lanterns from the stalls and string 6 round bulbs across the back of the market, creating a cozy contrast against the cold lunar setting. In the left foreground, place a large stall with 2 astronauts: 1 vendor behind the counter serving food from bowls and trays, and 1 customer with a backpack facing the stall. In the mid-background, place 2 smaller stalls with 1 astronaut standing between or near them as if browsing or buying. In the right foreground, place 1 red-canopy stall filled with breads, pastries, jars, and baskets. Near the center front, add a rough circular stone table with 4 low round stools; one astronaut sits beside it holding a cup or bowl, and the tabletop holds 4 small plates or food groupings. Scatter several foil-wrapped silver cargo crates around the scene, including 1 in the left foreground and a cluster on the right side. The overall style should feel tactile and handmade, like stop-motion puppets and sculpted clay miniatures, with detailed textures, warm practical lighting from lanterns, shallow depth of field, and a charming, surreal blend of space exploration and cozy street food market.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个充满奇趣的手工黏土立体模型，主题为 {argument name="scene theme" default="月球夜市"}，拍摄效果如同微缩电影布景。地面是布满小型陨石坑且质感不均的灰尘月壤，背景是深邃的黑色天空，点缀着许多微小的暖白色星星，左上方可见一颗布满陨石坑的月球。画面中有 5 个穿着厚实复古风格白色宇航服的小宇航员，他们戴着圆润的头盔和深色光泽面罩，分别扮演市集摊主和顾客。搭建 4 个由粗糙木杆和石质柜台组成的乡村风市集摊位，每个摊位上方都覆盖着柔和的蓝灰色或锈红色织物遮阳棚。摊位上悬挂着暖橙色的纸灯笼，摊位后方串联着 6 个圆形灯泡，与寒冷的月球环境形成舒适的对比。在左侧前景处，放置一个大型摊位，有 2 个宇航员：1 名摊主在柜台后用碗盘盛放食物，1 名背着背包的顾客面向摊位。在中景背景处，放置 2 个较小的摊位，有 1 个宇航员站在摊位之间或附近，仿佛在浏览或购买商品。在右侧前景处，放置一个红色遮阳棚的摊位，摆满了面包、糕点、罐子和篮子。在中心前方附近，添加一张粗糙的圆形石桌和 4 个低矮的圆凳；一个宇航员坐在旁边，手里拿着杯子或碗，桌面上摆放着 4 个小盘子或食物组合。在场景周围散落几个铝箔包裹的银色货箱，包括左侧前景的 1 个和右侧的一组。整体风格应具有触感和手工感，如同定格动画木偶和雕塑黏土微缩模型，具有细腻的纹理、来自灯笼的温暖实用照明、浅景深，以及太空探索与舒适街头美食市集之间迷人而超现实的融合。

templates.title: Zen Tea Ceremony Robot

titleLocalized.zh: 禅意茶道机器人

templates.prompt: A serene Japanese tea room rendered as a refined monochrome ink-and-wash illustration on aged parchment, with soft sepia-gray tones, delicate brush textures, and precise hand-drawn linework. On the right side, a humanoid {argument name="robot type" default="service robot"} kneels in seiza on tatami mats, its smooth white shell and exposed mechanical joints depicted with elegant technical detail, gently bowing its head as it pours hot tea from a cast-iron teapot into a small ceramic cup. The robot wears a simple cloth apron tied at the waist, blending traditional tea ceremony etiquette with futuristic machinery. In the center foreground, a low black wooden tea table holds exactly 5 visible tea objects: 1 dark ceramic vase with a thin branch of sparse leaves, 1 bamboo whisk standing upright, 1 tea bowl, 1 small teacup on a round tray, and 1 cast-iron teapot in the robot’s hands. A faint curl of steam rises from the freshly poured tea. Behind the table, a hanging scroll displays a single enso circle painted in expressive brushwork. On the left, tall shoji screens diffuse soft daylight across the room. The walls are plain plaster with subtle wear and ink-like stains, and the overall composition is calm, balanced, minimalist, and contemplative, combining wabi-sabi Japanese aesthetics with quiet science-fiction. Use a wide cinematic composition, eye-level perspective, lots of negative space, and a meditative mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一间宁静的日式茶室，以精致的单色水墨画风格呈现于陈旧的羊皮纸上，色调为柔和的深褐色与灰色，笔触细腻，线条勾勒精准。在右侧，一个 {argument name="robot type" default="服务型机器人"} 人形机器人正跪坐在榻榻米上，其光滑的白色外壳和裸露的机械关节以优雅的工业细节呈现，它低头垂目，正将热茶从铸铁茶壶中缓缓倒入小巧的陶瓷杯里。机器人腰间系着简单的布围裙，将传统的茶道礼仪与未来主义机械感完美融合。画面中央前景处，一张低矮的黑色木制茶桌上清晰可见 5 件茶具：1 个深色陶瓷花瓶，插着一枝稀疏的叶片；1 个直立的竹制茶筅；1 个茶碗；1 个托盘上的小茶杯；以及机器人手中持有的 1 把铸铁茶壶。刚沏好的茶冒着淡淡的热气。桌后悬挂的卷轴上绘有一个笔触洒脱的圆相（Enso）。左侧，高大的障子门将柔和的日光漫射进室内。墙壁为素雅的灰泥墙，带有细微的磨损和墨渍，整体构图平静、平衡、极简且引人深思，将日式“侘寂”美学与静谧的科幻感融为一体。采用宽银幕电影构图，平视视角，留白充足，营造出一种冥想般的氛围。

templates.title: Fauvist Persimmon Still Life

titleLocalized.zh: 野兽派柿子静物画

templates.prompt: A bold post-impressionist still life painting in thick impasto oil brushstrokes, viewed from slightly above. Center a round turquoise plate holding exactly 3 bright orange persimmons with green leafy tops, arranged in a triangular cluster. Place the plate on a vivid red tablecloth. In the upper left, add a dark green glass bottle casting a soft shadow onto a textured mustard-yellow wall. In the lower left, include a folded cloth napkin with wide cream and muted blue vertical stripes. On the right side of the table, place a kitchen knife with a shiny silver blade and a deep blue handle angled diagonally upward. Use saturated complementary colors, expressive painterly texture, visible palette-knife-like strokes, simplified forms, dark contour accents, and a warm, lively Fauvist color sensibility. The composition should feel handmade, energetic, and slightly naive, like a modern museum-style still life oil painting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅大胆的后印象派静物油画，采用厚涂法笔触，视角略微俯视。画面中央是一个圆形的绿松石色盘子，盘中以三角形簇状摆放着 3 个带有绿色叶顶的亮橙色柿子。将盘子放在鲜红色的桌布上。左上方放置一个深绿色玻璃瓶，在纹理丰富的芥末黄色墙面上投下柔和的阴影。左下方包含一块折叠的餐巾，上面有宽大的奶油色和柔和的蓝色垂直条纹。在桌子的右侧，放置一把厨房刀，银色刀刃闪闪发光，深蓝色刀柄呈对角线向上倾斜。运用饱和的互补色、富有表现力的绘画质感、可见的调色刀笔触、简化的形式、深色的轮廓强调，以及温暖、活泼的野兽派色彩感。构图应呈现出手工制作的质感，充满活力且略显稚拙，如同现代博物馆风格的静物油画。

templates.title: Noir Melting Ink Poster

templates.prompt: A minimalist vintage poster in a vertical 9:16 composition on an off-white paper-textured background. Center a single male figure in side-profile facing right, shown from hat to upper thighs, styled like a 1940s noir intellectual wearing a dark fedora with a light hatband, a black suit jacket, white dress shirt, and dark tie. Use dramatic high-contrast Rembrandt lighting and deep shadows so the face is mostly obscured in black silhouette, with a refined film noir mood. Place 1 large vivid red circle directly behind the head and upper shoulders like a bold halo, perfectly clean and graphic. The lower half of the torso and jacket should dissolve into long vertical black ink drips and splatters, with some gray wash streaks mixed in, creating a melting ink effect that extends downward toward the bottom of the poster. Keep the palette restricted to {argument name="accent color" default="true red"}, deep black, gray wash, and off-white. Add 1 bold uppercase sans-serif title centered near the bottom reading {argument name="headline text" default="THE MID-CENTURY INTELLECTUAL"}. Overall style: mid-century modern poster design, cinematic noir, minimalist editorial art, clean negative space, elegant, haunting, graphic, museum-poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义复古海报，采用 9:16 竖构图，背景为米白色纸张纹理。画面中心为一名男性侧影，面向右侧，展示范围从帽子到大腿上部，造型如同 1940 年代的黑色电影知识分子，头戴深色软呢帽（配浅色帽带），身穿黑色西装外套、白色衬衫和深色领带。运用戏剧性的高对比度伦勃朗光影和深邃阴影，使面部大部分隐没在黑色剪影中，营造出精致的黑色电影氛围。在头部和上肩部正后方放置一个巨大的鲜红色圆圈，如同醒目的光环，线条简洁且具有图形感。躯干和外套的下半部分应溶解为长条状的垂直黑色墨滴和飞溅效果，并混合一些灰色水洗痕迹，形成向下延伸至海报底部的融化墨迹效果。配色方案限制为 {argument name="accent color" default="正红色"}、深黑色、灰色水洗色和米白色。在底部附近居中添加一行醒目的大写无衬线标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="THE MID-CENTURY INTELLECTUAL"}。整体风格：中世纪现代海报设计、电影黑色风格、极简主义编辑艺术、干净的留白、优雅、令人难忘、图形化、博物馆海报品质。

templates.title: Seamless Gold Roses on Navy

titleLocalized.zh: 深蓝底色上的无缝金玫瑰

templates.prompt: A seamless repeating textile pattern designed as a four-way continuous wallpaper or fabric print, featuring vintage botanical rose bouquets in metallic antique gold on a deep midnight navy background. The composition should tile cleanly in all directions with no visible seams, arranged as an elegant all-over repeat of rose clusters, half-open blossoms, small buds, curling stems, and scattered leaves. Use a refined etched or jacquard-like linework texture so the flowers look slightly woven, embroidered, or engraved rather than painted. The bouquets should vary in scale from medium to large, with dense clusters alternating with smaller isolated blooms to create a balanced repeat. Keep the palette restricted to rich dark navy and luminous muted gold, with strong contrast and a luxurious, moody, classic baroque fashion-textile feel. Add very subtle vertical shadowed folds across the surface so it resembles draped fabric or a curtain, while preserving the seamless repeat structure. High detail, ornamental, elegant, regal, seamless pattern swatch, suitable for upholstery, wallpaper, or luxury dress fabric.

promptLocalized.zh: 一种设计为四向连续壁纸或织物印花的无缝重复纺织图案，以深午夜蓝为背景，呈现金属古金色的复古玫瑰花束。构图应在所有方向上整齐平铺，无可见接缝，排列为玫瑰簇、半开花朵、小花蕾、卷曲茎秆和散落叶片的优雅全覆盖重复图案。使用精致的蚀刻或提花风格线条纹理，使花朵看起来像是编织、刺绣或雕刻而成，而非绘画。花束的比例应从中等到大型不等，密集的簇群与较小的独立花朵交替出现，以形成平衡的重复效果。调色板仅限于浓郁的深蓝色和明亮的柔和金色，具有强烈的对比感以及奢华、深沉、经典的巴洛克时尚纺织品质感。在表面添加非常细微的垂直阴影褶皱，使其看起来像垂下的织物或窗帘，同时保持无缝重复结构。高细节、装饰性、优雅、富丽堂皇，无缝图案样本，适用于室内装潢、壁纸或奢华服装面料。

templates.title: Blue Fantasy Hero Splash Poster

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical fantasy game splash-art poster of a single male warrior hero in an icy blue environment, rendered in ultra-detailed polished digital illustration with cinematic lighting and high contrast. The composition is dynamic and slightly diagonal, with the character’s body sweeping across the frame as if diving or lunging through shards of ice and streams of blue energy. He has {argument name="character name" default="澜"}, a youthful handsome face, pale skin, sharp features, and short tousled {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair. His expression is calm, cold, and focused, eyes angled downward as if stalking prey. He wears sleek dark navy and black fantasy armor with metallic silver edges and glowing cyan highlights, including 4 visible major armor pieces: a large right shoulder guard with a circular glowing core, a fitted chest-and-torso suit, a layered waist guard, and armored forearm bracers. His body is turned sideways in a fluid assassin-like pose, one arm extended, with a long glowing blue weapon or energy blade emerging from the lower left. Surround him with sharp translucent ice formations, swirling fabric-like frosty shapes, and floating debris, all illuminated by luminous blue light. Use a cool monochrome palette dominated by sapphire, cobalt, and icy cyan, with glossy reflections and magical glow effects. Add 3 groups of visible Chinese typography integrated like a mobile MOBA hero poster: a large white brush-calligraphy title near the upper center-left reading {argument name="title text" default="澜"}, a thin vertical poetic line beside it reading {argument name="tagline text" default="被灭刃锋，只为永恒"}, and a gold vertical game logo in the upper right reading {argument name="logo text" default="王者荣耀"}. Premium e-sports promotional poster, highly detailed, heroic, elegant, cold, mystical, and powerful.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版幻想游戏海报，描绘了一位身处冰蓝色环境中的男性战士英雄，采用超精细的数字插画渲染，具有电影级光影和高对比度。构图动感且略带斜向，角色身体横跨画面，仿佛正在穿过冰片和蓝色能量流进行俯冲或突刺。他拥有 {argument name="character name" default="澜"}，一张年轻英俊的脸庞、苍白的皮肤、轮廓分明的五官以及凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 短发。他的表情冷静、冷峻且专注，双眼向下俯视，仿佛正在追踪猎物。他身着深海军蓝与黑色相间的流线型幻想盔甲，带有金属银色边缘和发光的青色高光，包括 4 个可见的主要盔甲部件：带有圆形发光核心的大型右肩甲、贴身的胸部与躯干护甲、分层腰甲以及前臂护甲。他的身体以流畅的刺客姿势侧转，一只手臂伸展，一把长长的发光蓝色武器或能量刃从左下方显现。周围环绕着锋利的半透明冰层、旋转的织物状霜花以及漂浮的碎片，所有元素都被明亮的蓝光照亮。使用以蓝宝石色、钴蓝色和冰青色为主的冷色调，并带有光泽反射和魔法发光效果。添加 3 组可见的中文排版，整合如移动端 MOBA 英雄海报：左上方中央附近有一个巨大的白色书法标题 {argument name="title text" default="澜"}，旁边有一行纤细的竖排诗意文字 {argument name="tagline text" default="被灭刃锋，只为永恒"}，右上角有一个金色的竖排游戏 Logo {argument name="logo text" default="王者荣耀"}。高端电竞宣传海报，细节丰富，英雄气概，优雅、冷峻、神秘且强大。

templates.title: Luxury Sakura Yae Miko Collector Poster

templates.prompt: Create a lavish vertical anime character collector poster in a premium magazine-cover and merchandise-catalog style, centered on {argument name="character name" default="Yae Miko"}, a beautiful adult shrine maiden with very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="pink"} hair, violet eyes, and a confident flirtatious expression, seated elegantly on a dark lacquered shrine chest with gold tassels and floral ornamentation. She wears an elaborate sheer sakura-themed ceremonial outfit in layered translucent pink and white fabric, with floral embroidery, ribbons, jeweled accessories, gold details, detached sleeves, a delicate veil, ornate earrings, and strappy high heels, showing a glamorous fashion-illustration silhouette with one leg crossed and one hand near her lips. Surround the whole composition with cherry blossoms, petals, decorative borders, gold filigree, and soft pastel pink lighting. The page should look like a special edition fan collectible poster with many integrated design elements and readable labels. At the top, place giant decorative serif typography reading “YAE MIKO” across the background, plus a small upper-left label “Generalpost • ETERNAL SAKURA” and an upper-right plaque reading “Lady Guuji OF THE GRAND NARUKAMI SHRINE”. On the right side near the character, add one vertical Japanese text line. Include a left-side stamp sheet titled “CHIBI STAMP COLLECTION” containing exactly 6 stamp-style chibi portraits arranged in a 2x3 grid, all of the same character in different cute expressions or poses. Below that, include a section titled “Mini Figure Collection” with exactly 3 small chibi figure variants standing side by side. Below that, include a “Stickers” section with exactly 5 die-cut stickers: 4 chibi character stickers and 1 fox mask sticker. On the right lower side, add a hanging “Character Profile” card with the labels “Birthday”, “Affiliation”, “Vision”, and “Constellation”, plus a short quote line at the bottom. At the bottom edge, include exactly 4 ticket or stamp-like bonus items: 1 round emblem with a fox symbol, 1 commemorative sakura festival ticket, 1 Narukami Shrine special pass, and 1 postage-style stamp marked with the date 27 APR 2024 and a fox motif. Add a limited-edition serial tag on the lower left reading “NO. 08888 / 10000”. Place a detailed white fox mask with red markings and floral decoration in the lower-right foreground. Overall style: ultra-detailed anime illustration, polished gacha-merchandise advertisement design, elegant sakura fantasy aesthetic, pink and rose-gold palette, layered print textures, crisp line art, luxurious shading, high detail, collectible premium poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张奢华的竖版动漫角色收藏海报，采用高级杂志封面与周边商品目录风格。画面中心为 {argument name="character name" default="八重神子"}，一位美丽的成年巫女，拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="粉色"} 秀发、紫罗兰色双眸，神情自信且妩媚，优雅地坐在饰有金色流苏与花卉纹样的深色漆面神社宝箱上。她身着精致的樱花主题仪式礼服，采用层叠的半透明粉白面料，配有花卉刺绣、丝带、珠宝配饰、金色细节、分离式袖子、精致面纱、华丽耳环及系带高跟鞋，展现出迷人的时尚插画轮廓，双腿交叠，一手轻抚唇边。整体构图环绕着樱花、花瓣、装饰边框、金色花丝及柔和的淡粉色光影。画面应呈现出特别版粉丝收藏海报的质感，融合多种设计元素与清晰的标签。顶部背景处放置巨大的装饰性衬线字体“YAE MIKO”，左上角标注“Generalpost • ETERNAL SAKURA”，右上角铭牌书写“Lady Guuji OF THE GRAND NARUKAMI SHRINE”。在角色右侧添加一行竖排日文。左侧包含名为“CHIBI STAMP COLLECTION”的印章页，内含 6 枚 2x3 排列的 Q 版角色印章，展现不同可爱表情或姿势。下方设置“Mini Figure Collection”区域，并排展示 3 款 Q 版小手办。再下方为“Stickers”区域，包含 5 枚模切贴纸：4 枚 Q 版角色贴纸和 1 枚狐狸面具贴纸。右下角添加一张悬挂式“Character Profile”卡片，标注“Birthday”、“Affiliation”、“Vision”和“Constellation”，底部附有一句简短引言。底边包含 4 件票券或印章类赠品：1 枚狐狸纹章圆标、1 张樱花祭纪念票、1 张鸣神大社特别通行证，以及 1 枚标注日期 27 APR 2024 和狐狸图案的邮票式印章。左下角添加限量版序列号标签“NO. 08888 / 10000”。右下角前景处放置一个带有红色纹样与花卉装饰的精致白色狐狸面具。整体风格：超精细动漫插画、精致的抽卡周边广告设计、优雅的樱花幻想美学、粉色与玫瑰金配色、层叠的印刷质感、清晰的线条、奢华的阴影、高细节度、收藏级高级海报构图。

templates.title: Bold Tennis Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 大胆网球时尚海报

templates.prompt: A high-fashion sports editorial poster on a clean off-white studio background with the word {argument name="headline text" default="FOCUS"} in enormous ultra-bold black condensed sans-serif letters filling nearly the entire backdrop from edge to edge. In front of the text, place a tall athletic female tennis player in a confident power pose, full body centered slightly right, with one leg straight on the floor and the other knee raised and resting on the handle throat of an oversized tennis racket standing upright. She is looking to the side with her face turned away, sleek dark hair pulled into a low ponytail, glossy skin, long toned legs, and a luxury campaign aesthetic. Outfit: a fitted white sleeveless V-neck tennis dress with a short pleated skirt, white wristbands on both wrists, white mid-calf sports socks with a black {argument name="brand letter" default="P"} logo, and white tennis sneakers. The tennis racket is white with a dark string bed and leans vertically under her raised leg. On the reflective black court floor, show exactly 5 scattered white tennis balls, each with a small black {argument name="ball logo" default="P"} mark, plus strong mirror-like reflections of the athlete, racket, text, and balls. Add crisp white court lines crossing diagonally near the bottom foreground. Lighting is soft but directional studio lighting with polished highlights on the skin and outfit, creating a premium luxury-athletic advertising mood. Minimal color palette: black, white, warm skin tones, and subtle gray reflections. Composition should feel like a fashion campaign poster, clean, graphic, bold, and striking.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级运动时尚编辑海报，背景为干净的米白色摄影棚，巨大的超粗黑色无衬线压缩字体 {argument name="headline text" default="FOCUS"} 几乎填满了整个背景。在文字前方，放置一位身材高挑的女性网球运动员，她摆出自信的力量姿势，全身位于画面中心偏右位置，一条腿笔直着地，另一条腿屈膝抬起，膝盖搁在竖立的超大号网球拍拍颈上。她侧脸看向一旁，深色秀发梳成低马尾，皮肤光泽，双腿修长健美，呈现出奢华的广告美感。服装：一件修身白色无袖 V 领网球裙，配有短百褶裙摆，双腕佩戴白色护腕，白色中筒运动袜上印有黑色 {argument name="brand letter" default="P"} 标志，脚穿白色网球鞋。网球拍为白色，拍面为深色线床，垂直靠在她抬起的腿下。在反光的黑色球场地面上，散落着 5 个白色网球，每个球上都有一个小的黑色 {argument name="ball logo" default="P"} 标志，并呈现出运动员、球拍、文字和球的清晰镜面反射。在底部前景处添加对角线穿过的清晰白色球场线。灯光采用柔和但具有方向性的摄影棚布光，在皮肤和服装上营造出精致的高光，打造出高端奢华的运动广告氛围。极简配色：黑色、白色、温暖的肤色以及微妙的灰色反射。构图应呈现出时尚广告海报的质感，简洁、图形化、大胆且引人注目。

templates.title: Fashion Tennis Focus Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 时尚网球主题海报

templates.prompt: A high-fashion studio sports portrait of a powerful female tennis player standing center frame against a clean light gray backdrop with the gigantic word {argument name="headline text" default="FOCUS"} in ultra-bold black condensed sans-serif letters filling the entire background from edge to edge. She has {argument name="skin tone" default="deep dark brown"} skin with glossy editorial lighting, an athletic muscular physique, and {argument name="hair style" default="a long sleek high ponytail"}. Her face is intentionally obscured and featureless, like a smooth blurred rectangular mask with no visible eyes, nose, or mouth. She wears a monochrome white tennis outfit consisting of 5 visible pieces: a halter-style sports bra, a pleated mini tennis skirt, one wrist sweatband, ribbed crew socks with a small black letter "P" logo, and white tennis shoes. Pose her in a confident dominant stance with one leg straight and the other knee raised, resting on the throat of a white tennis racket held vertically with one hand on the grip and the racket head touching the floor. The racket strings show a subtle dark geometric logo shape. The floor is a glossy reflective dark surface that mirrors both the player and the oversized text. Place exactly 6 white tennis balls scattered on the floor: 1 partially cropped in the bottom-left corner, 1 near the left side above it, 1 near the lower-left center with a visible "P", 1 near the lower-right center with a visible "P", and 2 clustered on the right side, one with a visible "P" and one with a visible lowercase "b". Use a minimal premium commercial-ad aesthetic, sharp contrast, centered composition, full-body framing, symmetrical balance, and polished magazine-quality lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级时尚摄影风格的运动肖像，画面中心是一位强有力的女性网球运动员，背景为简洁的浅灰色。巨大的单词 {argument name="headline text" default="FOCUS"} 以超粗黑色无衬线压缩字体呈现，从边缘到边缘填满整个背景。她拥有 {argument name="skin tone" default="深棕色"} 的皮肤，呈现出光泽感的编辑级灯光效果，体格健壮，发型为 {argument name="hair style" default="长款利落的高马尾"}。她的面部特意模糊处理，呈现出平滑的矩形遮罩效果，没有可见的眼睛、鼻子或嘴巴。她身穿单色白色网球服，包含 5 个可见部分：挂脖式运动内衣、百褶迷你网球裙、一只护腕、带有黑色小字母“P”标志的罗纹中筒袜以及白色网球鞋。让她摆出自信且具有统治力的姿势：一条腿站直，另一条腿屈膝抬起，脚踩在垂直放置的白色网球拍拍颈上，单手握住拍柄，拍头触地。球拍线呈现出微妙的深色几何标志形状。地面为光泽感反射面，映照出运动员和超大号文字。在地面上散落 6 个白色网球：1 个位于左下角被部分裁剪，1 个位于其上方左侧，1 个位于左下中心附近且带有可见的“P”字样，1 个位于右下中心附近且带有可见的“P”字样，另外 2 个聚集在右侧，其中一个带有可见的“P”，另一个带有可见的小写“b”。采用极简高端商业广告美学，高对比度，居中构图，全身取景，对称平衡，以及杂志级的精修灯光效果。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Crimson Samurai Warlord

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻绯红武士大名

templates.prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy anime illustration of a single samurai warlord in a powerful three-quarter full-body pose, centered and filling the frame, holding 1 unsheathed katana horizontally across the foreground with the blade angled slightly downward toward the right. The character has extremely long, wild, windblown {argument name="hair color" default="crimson red"} hair streaming across the upper right of the composition, with ornate gold hair ornaments and braided details. Dress the figure in lavish layered Japanese court-and-warrior clothing: 1 voluminous white kimono inner layer with subtle patterned fabric, 1 deep indigo and purple outer robe, 2 black lacquered armored forearm guards, 2 elaborate gold shoulder armor pieces, multiple braided cords, tassels, sashes, chains, and gold filigree ornaments around the chest and waist. The sword should have an ornate dark hilt with red wrapping and gilded fittings, and a polished steel blade catching bright highlights. Use a low-angle, heroic composition with sleeves and ribbons billowing outward, emphasizing motion and dominance. The background is a nearly black textured void with 1 large circular crest or moonlike emblem behind the character, painted in distressed gold and shadowy navy, plus scattered embers, ink splatter, and fiery orange sparks around the edges. The palette is rich and restrained: black, deep navy, burgundy, crimson, antique gold, and ivory. Render in ultra-detailed painterly anime style with intricate textile patterns, metallic reflections, dramatic rim lighting, cinematic contrast, and a serious, regal, intimidating mood. Avoid cute styling, avoid bright pastel colors, avoid glossy plastic textures, avoid oversaturated sparkly effects; keep it mature, gritty, elegant, and highly detailed.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具张力的暗黑奇幻动漫插画，描绘了一位武士大名，采用强有力的四分之三全身姿势，居中且填满画面。角色横向持有一把出鞘的武士刀，刀刃略微向下倾斜指向右侧。角色拥有极长且狂野、随风飘动的 {argument name="hair color" default="绯红色"} 头发，发丝流向构图的右上角，并配有华丽的金色发饰和编织细节。为角色穿上奢华且层次分明的日本宫廷与武士服饰：内层为带有精致暗纹的白色和服，外层为深靛蓝与紫色长袍，佩戴 2 个黑色漆面护臂，2 个精巧的金色肩甲，胸部和腰部装饰着多条编织绳、流苏、腰带、链条及金色花丝饰品。武士刀配有华丽的深色刀柄、红色缠带和镀金配件，抛光的钢制刀刃捕捉着明亮的高光。采用低角度的英雄式构图，袖子和丝带向外飘扬，强调动感与统治力。背景为近乎黑色的纹理虚空，角色身后有一个巨大的圆形纹章或类似月亮的标志，以斑驳的金色和阴影般的深蓝色绘制，边缘散落着余烬、墨迹和火红色的火星。色调浓郁且克制：黑色、深海军蓝、酒红色、绯红色、古金色和象牙白。以超精细的油画动漫风格渲染，呈现复杂的织物图案、金属反射、戏剧性的轮廓光、电影级的对比度，以及严肃、威严且令人敬畏的氛围。避免可爱的造型，避免明亮的柔和色彩，避免光泽的塑料质感，避免过度饱和的闪光效果；保持成熟、坚毅、优雅且高度精细的质感。

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, turn the photo into a soft feminine Japanese fashion-check infographic poster while keeping the same person, outfit, indoor window setting, and blurred face censorship. Create a scrapbook/editorial layout on a warm cream background with blush-pink and beige accents. Place the main full-body photo on the left as a slightly tilted printed snapshot with handwritten callouts. Add 4 circular close-up detail crops on the right showing: 1) neckline/chest area, 2) knit shoulder and sleeve texture, 3) waist and jeans area, 4) cardigan hem and pocket area. Add a small extra inset portrait near the bottom center using the same outfit and person in a casual leaning pose. Include Japanese magazine-style typography and decorative doodles throughout. templates.title: Watercolor Minecraft World Cross-Section

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩风格 Minecraft 世界横截面

templates.prompt: A highly detailed watercolor illustration on textured off-white paper, depicting a vertical floating slice of a Minecraft-inspired world framed by a gigantic ruined rectangular stone portal arch. The composition is centered and portrait-oriented, with soft cloudy washes around the edges and crisp voxel-like block detail inside. At the top, the weathered arch is built from mossy stone, cracked bricks, and mineral-stained blocks, opening like a window onto a distant fantasy mountain range with misty spires and 2 small flying birds. On the upper landscape layer, include 2 blocky trees, 2 small village houses with pitched roofs, 1 church-like tower in the middle distance, wooden fences, grassy ledges, a small waterfall on the left, and another waterfall spilling down the right edge. Place 1 Steve-like adventurer near the center-left foreground, seen from behind, wearing a teal shirt and blue pants and holding a pickaxe, gazing into the world beyond the arch. Add 1 pig on the upper left grassy ledge. Beneath the surface, reveal a cutaway cross-section of underground biomes and structures: 1 abandoned mineshaft with timber supports and minecart rails on the left, 1 central cavern with blue water and ladders descending vertically, 1 glowing blue crystal deposit in a lower-left cave, 1 bright orange lava shaft running downward on the right, 1 green creeper in a mid-right cave, 1 white skeleton archer in a small right-side chamber, 1 purple Nether portal near the lower right, and 1 tiny spider in a dim lower chamber. Scatter warm torchlights through the caves for contrast. The palette should mix earthy browns, mossy greens, cool blue mist, and fiery orange lava, with a dreamy atmospheric perspective in the distance. Render the whole scene as a delicate fusion of Minecraft block geometry and traditional watercolor fantasy painting, intricate, magical, nostalgic, and painterly.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅在纹理米白色纸张上绘制的高细节水彩插画，描绘了一个垂直悬浮的 Minecraft 风格世界切片，由一个巨大的废墟矩形石拱门框住。构图居中且呈纵向，边缘有柔和的云雾渲染，内部则有清晰的体素块细节。顶部，风化的拱门由长满苔藓的石头、裂开的砖块和矿物染色方块构成，像窗户一样敞开，展现出远处带有朦胧尖塔的奇幻山脉和 2 只飞鸟。在上层景观中，包含 2 棵方块树、2 座带斜屋顶的小村屋、中景处 1 座教堂式的塔楼、木栅栏、草地边缘，左侧有一条小瀑布，右侧边缘也有一条瀑布倾泻而下。在左中前景处放置 1 位背对着的 Steve 风格冒险家，身穿青色衬衫和蓝色裤子，手持镐子，凝视着拱门外的世界。在左上方的草地上添加 1 只猪。在地表之下，展示地下生物群系和结构的横截面：左侧有 1 个带有木支撑和矿车轨道的废弃矿井，中央洞穴有蓝色的水和垂直向下的梯子，左下角洞穴有 1 处发光的蓝色水晶矿，右侧有 1 条向下延伸的明亮橙色熔岩井，中右侧洞穴有 1 只绿色苦力怕，右侧小房间里有 1 只白色骷髅弓箭手，右下角附近有 1 个紫色的下界传送门，昏暗的下层房间里还有 1 只小蜘蛛。在洞穴中散布温暖的火把光以形成对比。色调应融合泥土棕色、苔藓绿、冷蓝色薄雾和炽热的橙色熔岩，远处呈现出梦幻的大气透视感。将整个场景渲染为 Minecraft 方块几何结构与传统水彩奇幻绘画的精致融合，复杂、神奇、怀旧且富有艺术感。

templates.title: Vinland Saga Thorfinn Storm Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 《海盗战记》托尔芬风暴海报

templates.prompt: A dark, gritty cinematic anime poster in the style of a historical seinen manga cover, inspired by {argument name="series title" default="VINLAND SAGA"}. The composition is vertical and dramatic, with a lone young warrior resembling {argument name="character name" default="THORFINN"} standing on a jagged black rock at the edge of a stormy sea, seen from behind at full body. He wears a weathered brown-grey hooded tunic or cloak with a rough fur-trimmed collar, a belt at the waist, dark trousers, and worn leather boots. His posture is tense but reflective, his right hand holding a short dagger pointed downward, facing violent ocean waves and sea spray under a cold, overcast sky. Behind him and dominating the upper half of the image is a massive close-up side profile of his head and wet, tangled blond hair, rendered with dense ink-like linework and painterly shading, creating a layered double-exposure effect. On the left side, include 4 inset manga-style narrative panels stacked vertically: panel 1 shows a close-up of the same boy gripping a dagger; panel 2 shows him from behind facing a small group of armed men; panel 3 shows an intense close-up of his eyes; panel 4 shows him walking alone among gravestones or stone markers. Add visible typography integrated like a Chinese promotional poster: at the top left, small Japanese title text and the English text "VINLAND SAGA" with "YUKIMURA MAKOTO" beneath it; near the lower left, large distressed block letters reading "THORFINN" with smaller katakana beneath. Add multiple vertical Chinese quote lines in white along the left and right sides, with one emphasized phrase in muted gold. Use a desaturated palette of charcoal black, slate grey, steel blue, dirty white, and faded brown, with high contrast, mist, rain-speck texture, rough brushwork, and an epic melancholy atmosphere about renouncing violence and searching for peace. The overall look should feel like a premium character poster, moody, windswept, somber, and highly detailed.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑暗、坚毅的电影感动漫海报，采用历史青年漫画封面风格，灵感来自 {argument name="series title" default="VINLAND SAGA"}。构图呈垂直且具有戏剧性，一名酷似 {argument name="character name" default="THORFINN"} 的年轻战士背影全景，站在风暴海边嶙峋的黑色岩石上。他身穿一件风化的棕灰色连帽长袍或斗篷，领口带有粗糙的毛皮装饰，腰间系着腰带，穿着深色长裤和磨损的皮靴。他的姿态紧张而沉思，右手握着一把向下指的短剑，面对着阴冷多云天空下汹涌的波涛与海浪飞沫。在他身后，占据图像上半部分的是他头部及湿漉漉、凌乱金发的巨大侧写特写，采用浓密的墨水线条和绘画般的阴影渲染，营造出分层的双重曝光效果。在左侧，包含 4 个垂直堆叠的嵌入式漫画风格叙事分镜：分镜 1 展示了男孩紧握短剑的特写；分镜 2 展示了他背对一小群武装人员的场景；分镜 3 展示了他眼神的强烈特写；分镜 4 展示了他独自走在墓碑或石碑之间。添加与中文宣传海报融为一体的醒目排版：在左上角，放置小型日语标题文字和英文文本 "VINLAND SAGA"，下方标注 "YUKIMURA MAKOTO"；在左下方附近，放置巨大的做旧块状字母 "THORFINN"，下方配有较小的片假名。在左右两侧添加多行白色的垂直中文引语，其中一句以柔和的金色强调。使用去饱和的炭黑、板岩灰、钢蓝、脏白和褪色棕色调，具有高对比度、雾气、雨水纹理、粗犷的笔触，以及关于放弃暴力和寻求和平的史诗般忧郁氛围。整体外观应呈现出高级角色海报的质感，情绪化、风中摇曳、沉郁且细节丰富。

templates.title: Rainy Tokyo Noir Woman

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中东京黑色电影风格女性

templates.prompt: A moody cinematic anime noir illustration of a lone young woman walking straight toward the viewer on a rainy Tokyo street at night, centered in frame, full body visible. She has shoulder-length muted pink hair with straight bangs and slightly tucked sides, and her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She is smoking 1 cigarette held near her mouth with her right hand, with a pale ribbon of smoke curling upward beside her head. She wears a long gray trench coat blowing open to the left, a white button-up dress shirt, a black necktie, and slim dark trousers, creating a sharp urban detective or office-worker silhouette. The street is wet and highly reflective, with heavy rain streaks falling through the whole scene, glossy pavement reflections, dark buildings on both sides, metal railings along the right side, and a gritty monochrome palette with only subtle color accents in the hair and clothing. Include 3 clearly visible street signs in the background: a tall vertical illuminated sign on the left reading "時事通信", a circular speed-limit sign showing "30", and a tall weathered post on the right reading "中央区 京橋 2丁目 / Chuo-ku Kyobashi 2-chome / 17". The atmosphere should feel bleak, mature, introspective, and stylish, like a manga panel fused with realistic urban photography, with detailed ink-like linework, textured shading, subdued contrast, and dramatic rain-soaked noir lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张情绪饱满的电影感动漫黑色电影插画，描绘了一位年轻女性在雨夜的东京街道上径直走向观众，画面居中，全身可见。她留着齐肩的灰粉色直发，带有齐刘海，两侧头发微微内扣，面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。她右手拿着一支烟靠近嘴边，一缕淡淡的烟雾在她头部旁向上缭绕。她身穿一件向左敞开的长款灰色风衣，内搭白色衬衫、黑色领带和修身深色长裤，勾勒出干练的都市侦探或职场女性轮廓。街道湿润且反光强烈，大雨倾盆而下，路面光泽感十足，两侧是深色建筑，右侧设有金属护栏，整体色调为粗粝的单色系，仅在头发和服装上保留细微的色彩点缀。背景中需包含 3 个清晰可见的街道标志：左侧是一个高大的垂直发光标志，写着“時事通信”；一个显示“30”的圆形限速标志；以及右侧一根写有“中央区 京橋 2丁目 / Chuo-ku Kyobashi 2-chome / 17”的高大风化立柱。整体氛围应显得凄凉、成熟、内省且时尚，如同漫画分镜与写实城市摄影的融合，具备细腻的墨水质感线条、纹理阴影、柔和的对比度以及戏剧性的雨中黑色电影灯光。

templates.title: Rainy Manga Alley Woman Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中漫画风巷弄女性肖像

templates.prompt: A gritty manga-style full-body street portrait of a tall young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="soft pink"} hair in a long side braid, walking straight toward the viewer down a narrow rainy Japanese alley at night. Her expression is obscured by a soft mosaic-like blur over the face, creating an anonymous censored look. She wears a long black trench coat over a white dress shirt, black necktie, and high-waisted black trousers, with one hand in her coat pocket and the other holding a lit cigarette low by her side. Thin streams of cigarette smoke curl outward, mixing with the rain. The alley is dense with glowing vertical shop signs and warm lantern light reflected on wet pavement, with overhead wires and dark building facades framing the scene. Include 3 visible background pedestrians with umbrellas: 1 blue umbrella figure on the left midground, 1 reddish-brown umbrella figure in the center-right background, and 1 green umbrella figure on the right midground. Add 1 vertical white sign on the far left with black Japanese text, 1 large stylized black sound-effect text near the upper left, and 1 white speech bubble on the right containing only an ellipsis. Use dramatic noir lighting, heavy black inks, halftone screentone shading, detailed crosshatching, slight paper texture, and the composition of a serialized seinen manga panel, centered and symmetrical, moody, cinematic, and rain-soaked.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张硬核漫画风格的全身街头肖像，主角是一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 长发并扎着侧边长辫的高挑年轻女性，正沿着狭窄的雨夜日本巷弄径直走向镜头。她的面部被一层柔和的马赛克模糊效果遮盖，营造出一种匿名且被审查的神秘感。她身穿黑色长款风衣，内搭白色衬衫、黑色领带及高腰黑色长裤，一只手插在风衣口袋里，另一只手垂在身侧，指间夹着一支点燃的香烟。细长的烟雾袅袅升起，与雨水交织在一起。巷弄中布满了发光的竖排店招，温暖的灯笼光影映照在湿漉漉的地面上，头顶交错的电线与深色的建筑外墙构成了画面的框架。画面中包含 3 位撑伞的背景行人：左侧中景处 1 位撑蓝色雨伞的人，右后方 1 位撑红棕色雨伞的人，以及右侧中景处 1 位撑绿色雨伞的人。最左侧添加 1 个带有黑色日文的竖排白色招牌，左上方添加 1 个巨大的程式化黑色拟声词文字，右侧添加 1 个仅包含省略号的白色对话气泡。采用戏剧性的黑色电影光影、厚重的黑色墨水、网点纸阴影、细致的交叉排线、轻微的纸张纹理，构图呈现出连载青年漫画分镜的对称居中感，整体氛围阴郁、充满电影感且雨意浓郁。

templates.title: Fantasy Anime Movie Poster at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落背景下的奇幻动画电影海报

templates.prompt: A breathtaking vertical Japanese anime film poster for a fantasy adventure movie, painted in a luminous cinematic style with dramatic sunset lighting, painterly clouds, and highly detailed background scenery. The composition features 4 human figures total: 2 large upper-body character portraits dominating the top half, and 1 small full-body girl in the foreground plus 1 tiny implied city crowd only as environmental scale. The main featured characters are a teenage girl and a teenage boy shown back-to-back in profile near the upper center, both facing opposite directions with calm, wistful, serious expressions. The girl has short windblown dark navy-blue hair with soft highlights, a school uniform-style outfit in deep blue with a white collar and a red ribbon bow, and she is positioned larger on the left. The boy is slightly smaller on the right, with tousled light brown hair, a dark high-collar coat or cloak, and a contemplative look. The lower center shows a younger girl standing on a stone overlook from behind, wearing a dark blue coat or dress, ankle socks, dark shoes, and a long red scarf blowing strongly in the wind; beside her sits 1 black cat, both gazing toward the horizon and the city below. The setting is an expansive fantasy city at golden hour, with warm sunlight breaking across a river valley and rooftops, and a towering ornate spiral-like clocktower or fantastical cathedral spire rising on the right side. In the sky are 6 floating islands of varying sizes covered with grass and rocky undersides, scattered across the upper left and upper right sky. Also include 5 white birds flying across the middle and lower sky, plus 1 large gliding bird-like silhouette on the left midground. Frame the foreground with soft blue and white flowers and foliage along the bottom corners. Use a dreamy palette of violet, lavender, peach, gold, and soft blue, with glowing rim light, atmospheric haze, epic scale, emotional fantasy-adventure mood, and premium hand-painted anime poster finish. Add Japanese movie-poster typography integrated into the image: a large vertical tagline in white on the upper right, a large central title in white kanji reading {argument name="title text" default="星を紡ぐ旅人"}, smaller subtitle text beneath it, 3 award-laurel callout blocks in white on the upper left, a release date block on the lower left reading {argument name="release date" default="7.18 FRI"} above ROADSHOW, a short promotional quote in white on the lower right, and a line of film staff credits across the bottom center. Include a small copyright line at the very bottom. Make it feel like an original blockbuster anime movie poster by a prestigious studio, emotionally uplifting, nostalgic, magical, and grand in scale.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊叹的竖版日式动画电影海报，展现奇幻冒险电影主题，采用明亮的电影级画风，配以戏剧性的日落光影、油画质感的云层和细节丰富的背景景观。构图总共包含 4 个人物：上半部分由 2 个醒目的上半身角色肖像占据，前景中有一名小女孩全身像，另有 1 个微小的城市人群作为环境比例参考。主要角色为一名少女和一名少年，两人在上方中心位置背靠背侧身而立，面朝相反方向，表情平静、忧郁且严肃。女孩留着被风吹拂的深海军蓝色短发，带有柔和的高光，身穿深蓝色水手服风格服装，配有白色领子和红色蝴蝶结，位于左侧且比例较大。男孩位于右侧，体型稍小，留着凌乱的浅棕色头发，身穿深色高领外套或斗篷，神情沉思。画面下方中心处，一名年幼的女孩背对镜头站在石制观景台上，身穿深蓝色外套或连衣裙，穿着短袜和深色鞋子，一条红色的长围巾在风中剧烈飘动；她身边坐着 1 只黑猫，两人一同凝视着地平线和下方的城市。背景是一座黄金时刻的宏大奇幻城市，温暖的阳光洒在河谷和屋顶上，右侧矗立着一座华丽的螺旋状钟楼或奇幻大教堂尖塔。天空中散布着 6 座大小不一、覆盖着草地且底部为岩石的浮空岛，分布在左上方和右上方。画面中还有 5 只白鸟飞过中下部天空，左侧中景处有 1 个巨大的滑翔鸟类剪影。前景底部两侧用柔和的蓝白色花卉和叶片装饰。色彩采用梦幻的紫罗兰色、薰衣草色、桃色、金色和柔和的蓝色，带有发光的轮廓光、大气雾气、史诗般的尺度感、感性的奇幻冒险氛围以及高级的手绘动画海报质感。画面中融入日文电影海报排版：右上角为白色大号竖排标语，中央为白色大号日文标题 {argument name="title text" default="星を紡ぐ旅人"}，下方配有较小的副标题，左上角有 3 个白色奖项月桂花环标识，左下角有显示 {argument name="release date" default="7.18 FRI"} 的上映日期块，上方标注 ROADSHOW，右下角有一句简短的白色宣传引语，底部中心有一行电影制作人员名单。最底部包含一行小字版权声明。整体呈现出由知名工作室制作的原创大片级动画电影海报质感，情感动人、怀旧、充满魔力且气势宏大。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫电影海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese anime movie poster for a fictional cyberpunk sci-fi film, vertical one-sheet composition, centered on a young anime girl standing in a ruined neon-lit alley at night beneath a huge glowing full moon. She has a pale face, a serious melancholic expression, bright magenta-pink glowing eyes, and short teal-to-cyan hair in messy twin braids with wispy bangs and luminous highlights. She wears a dark futuristic school-uniform-inspired outfit: a fitted black top, pleated skirt, utility belt with holsters and hanging devices, a loose open coat with insignia patches on the sleeves, and a high-tech glowing collar or headset around her neck. One arm is visibly cybernetic with exposed machinery and pink energy glowing through transparent panels. Her chest has a circular neon core-like device emitting pink light. The environment is dense with holographic screens, broken signage, cables, shards, sparks, and floating pink-blue particles, with towering dark structures framing her and strong rim lighting from the moon behind her head. Use a moody palette of deep indigo, violet, black, cyan, and hot pink, with ultra-detailed painterly anime rendering, glossy reflections, cinematic contrast, volumetric light, drifting debris, and a haunting futuristic atmosphere. Include Japanese poster typography integrated into the artwork: on the right side, a tall vertical tagline in white with one key phrase highlighted in pink; on the upper left, exactly 3 stacked award blurbs in Japanese, each framed by laurel wreaths; near the lower middle, a small line of Japanese text above the title; a giant central title in white kanji reading {argument name="main title" default="未来×回線"} with a glowing pink X in the middle; directly below it, romanized subtitle text reading {argument name="romanized title" default="MIRAI KAISEN"}; below that, a pink Japanese subtitle line reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="—終焉のコード—"}; near the bottom center, a single Japanese promotional sentence with one word highlighted in pink; at the bottom right, a large theatrical release date reading {argument name="release date" default="7.18"} with small [FRI] and ROADSHOW beneath it; and fine-print credits plus a copyright line along the bottom edge. Make it feel like a premium original animated feature poster, emotionally intense, polished, and award-winning.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日本动漫电影海报，用于一部虚构的赛博朋克科幻电影，采用竖版单张构图。画面中心是一位年轻的动漫少女，站在夜晚废弃的霓虹小巷中，头顶是一轮巨大的发光满月。她面色苍白，表情忧郁而严肃，有着明亮的洋红色发光双眼，留着青色渐变至蓝色的短发，扎着凌乱的双麻花辫，配有细碎的刘海和发光的高光。她身穿深色、受未来主义校服启发的服装：修身黑色上衣、百褶裙、带有枪套和悬挂装置的战术腰带、一件袖口带有徽章补丁的宽松开衫，颈部戴着高科技发光项圈或耳机。她的一只手臂明显是赛博格义肢，露出机械结构，透明面板中透出粉色的能量光芒。她的胸前有一个圆形的霓虹核心装置，散发着粉色光芒。环境充斥着全息屏幕、破碎的招牌、电缆、碎片、火花以及漂浮的粉蓝色微粒，高耸的深色建筑环绕着她，月光从她脑后投射出强烈的轮廓光。使用深靛蓝、紫、黑、青和亮粉色的忧郁色调，呈现超精细的绘画感动漫渲染、光泽反射、电影级对比度、体积光、漂浮的残骸以及令人难忘的未来主义氛围。将日文海报排版融入艺术作品中：右侧是一行白色的高大竖排标语，其中一个关键短语以粉色高亮显示；左上方是 3 段堆叠的日文获奖评语，每段都由月桂花环框起；中下方标题上方有一行小字日文；中央是巨大的白色汉字标题 {argument name="main title" default="未来×回线"}，中间带有一个发光的粉色 X；正下方是罗马拼音副标题 {argument name="romanized title" default="MIRAI KAISEN"}；再下方是一行粉色的日文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="—终焉之代码—"}；底部中央是一句日文宣传语，其中一个词以粉色高亮；右下角是醒目的影院上映日期 {argument name="release date" default="7.18"}，下方附有小字 [FRI] 和 ROADSHOW；底部边缘印有细小的制作人员名单和版权信息。整体呈现出高端原创动画长片海报的质感，情感强烈、制作精良且具有获奖作品的风格。

templates.prompt: A cinematic anime-style futuristic surveillance status screen showing a full-body young man standing in the center of a dark industrial corridor, viewed from a slightly high angle as if captured by a security camera. He is a tall, lean, athletic male with messy silver-gray hair, pale skin, and a cool, dangerous presence, wearing a black sleeveless high-neck shirt, black tactical pants with straps and side pockets, a black belt with hanging chain details, heavy black combat boots, and a black jacket slipping off his shoulders. His expression is serious and unreadable, framed by a glowing scan bracket around the face like a live target lock. The overall image is a high-tech HUD dossier overlay in a blue-gray and black palette with subtle cyan interface lines, screen noise, scanlines, and a moody cyberpunk thriller atmosphere. The layout contains 10 distinct UI panels around the character: 1 top-left recording strip with a red REC indicator, timestamp, camera code, location, and video specs; 1 left upper identification panel labeled 観察対象 with subject data including codename Raven and ID; 1 left middle warning panel labeled 重要人物 with risk level A and other threat notes; 1 left lower basic profile panel labeled 基本情報 listing name, age, height, birth date, job, personality, likes, and dislikes; 1 bottom-left vital monitor panel labeled バイタルモニタ with 2 waveform graphs and numeric readouts for heart rate, temperature, and stress; 1 lower-left action log panel labeled 行動ログ with 6 timestamped entries; 1 large upper-right facial recognition panel labeled 顔認識ズーム showing 1 zoomed portrait crop, a match result for RAVEN, a 99.7% accuracy bar, and verified status; 1 right middle identification details panel labeled 識別情報 with ID, codename, affiliation unknown, and a paragraph of notes; 1 right lower target analysis panel labeled ターゲット分析 with 1 wireframe human figure and multiple stat lines including height, weight, body fat, muscle mass, combat ability, mobility, intelligence, danger level, and a large overall evaluation A+; 1 bottom-right current location panel labeled 現在位置 with 1 minimap floor plan, a glowing position dot, and camera label CAM-07. Add 1 bottom-center tracking progress bar reading TRACKING... at 97.6%, 1 bottom-left surveillance memo box labeled 監視メモ with 3 short bullet-style notes, and 1 bottom barcode strip with the code RX-0417-17 / TOP PRIORITY. Include small top-right system text such as SYSTEM ONLINE and SECURE LINK : OK. Use Japanese text throughout the interface, crisp thin-line sci-fi frames, layered transparent screens, realistic lighting on the character, and polished gpt-image-2 anime illustration quality, like a classified character status display for a covert operative named {argument name="character name" default="Raven"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级动漫风格的未来感监控状态屏幕，展示了一名站在黑暗工业走廊中央的年轻男子全身像，视角略高，仿佛被监控摄像头捕捉。他身材高挑、精瘦且健壮，留着凌乱的银灰色短发，皮肤苍白，散发着冷峻危险的气息。他身穿黑色无袖高领衫、带有绑带和侧袋的黑色战术长裤、系着挂链细节的黑色腰带，脚蹬厚重的黑色战术靴，肩上披着一件滑落的黑色夹克。他表情严肃且难以捉摸，面部周围环绕着发光的扫描框，如同实时目标锁定。整体画面呈现为高科技 HUD 档案叠加效果，采用蓝灰色与黑色调，配以微妙的青色界面线条、屏幕噪点、扫描线，营造出赛博朋克惊悚片的氛围。布局在角色周围包含 10 个不同的 UI 面板：1 个左上角录制条，带有红色 REC 指示灯、时间戳、摄像机代码、位置和视频规格；1 个左上方识别面板，标注为“観察対象”，包含代号 Raven 和 ID 等主体数据；1 个左侧中部警告面板，标注为“重要人物”，显示风险等级 A 及其他威胁备注；1 个左侧下部基本资料面板，标注为“基本情報”，列出姓名、年龄、身高、出生日期、职业、性格、喜好和厌恶；1 个左下角生命体征监测面板，标注为“バイタルモニタ”，包含 2 个波形图以及心率、体温和压力的数字读数；1 个左下侧行动日志面板，标注为“行動ログ”，包含 6 条带时间戳的记录；1 个右上角大型面部识别面板，标注为“顔認識ズーム”，显示 1 个放大的人像裁剪图、RAVEN 的匹配结果、99.7% 的准确率进度条以及已验证状态；1 个右侧中部识别详情面板，标注为“識別情報”，包含 ID、代号、所属不明及一段备注；1 个右下角目标分析面板，标注为“ターゲット分析”，包含 1 个线框人体模型及多项统计数据，包括身高、体重、体脂、肌肉量、战斗力、机动性、智力、危险等级及一个巨大的综合评价 A+；1 个右下角当前位置面板，标注为“現在位置”，包含 1 个平面图小地图、一个发光的位置点及摄像机标签 CAM-07。底部中央添加一个显示“TRACKING...”且进度为 97.6% 的追踪进度条，左下角添加一个标注为“監視メモ”的监控备忘录框，内含 3 条简短的要点式备注，底部添加一条带有代码 RX-0417-17 / TOP PRIORITY 的条形码。右上角包含诸如 SYSTEM ONLINE 和 SECURE LINK : OK 等小型系统文本。整个界面使用日文文本、清晰的细线科幻边框、分层透明屏幕，角色光影写实，呈现出精致的 gpt-image-2 动漫插画质量，如同为一名代号为 {argument name="character name" default="Raven"} 的秘密特工制作的机密角色状态显示界面。

templates.title: Luxury Menswear Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华男装街头肖像

templates.prompt: A photorealistic full-body street portrait of a stylish young man standing on an urban sidewalk in front of a grand historic stone building with tall columns, arched windows, and classical architectural detailing. He is centered in the frame, standing with arms crossed, body angled slightly to the side, looking away from the camera. His face is intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur. He has neatly groomed dark brown hair, thick and swept back with volume. He wears a fitted {argument name="jacket color" default="navy blue"} zip-up knit jacket over a matching dark turtleneck, a silver wristwatch with a light dial, and crisp {argument name="pants color" default="white"} trousers. Parked along the curb behind him are exactly 2 vehicles: a silver hatchback on the left and a black off-road SUV with a rear-mounted spare tire on the right. The composition is vertical, fashion-editorial, and slightly shallow depth of field, with the man sharply in focus and the cars and architecture softly blurred. Lighting is soft natural daylight under an overcast sky, with muted tones, realistic skin and fabric texture, subtle luxury menswear styling, clean city atmosphere, and high-end lifestyle photography aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级写实的全景街头肖像，一位时尚的年轻男子站在城市人行道上，背景是一座宏伟的历史石建筑，带有高大的立柱、拱形窗户和古典建筑细节。他位于画面中心，双臂交叉站立，身体略微侧向一边，目光看向镜头外。他的面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理，刻意遮挡。他留着修剪整齐的深棕色头发，发量浓密且向后梳理。他身穿一件修身的 {argument name="jacket color" default="海军蓝"} 拉链针织夹克，内搭同色系深色高领毛衣，佩戴一块浅色表盘的银色腕表，下身穿着干练的 {argument name="pants color" default="白色"} 长裤。他身后的路边停放着 2 辆车：左侧是一辆银色掀背车，右侧是一辆带有后挂式备胎的黑色越野 SUV。构图为竖构图，呈现时尚杂志风格，景深较浅，人物焦点清晰，车辆和建筑背景呈现柔和的虚化效果。光线为阴天下的柔和自然日光，色调沉稳，皮肤和织物纹理真实，展现出精致的奢华男装风格、干净的城市氛围以及高端生活方式摄影美学。

Luxury menswear editorial, candid yet polished, natural proportions, photorealistic, high detail, subtle cinematic mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的编辑风格街头时尚照片，一位身材高挑瘦削的男士站在欧洲城市街道上，背景是一座装饰华丽、带有拱形窗户和精美石雕细节的历史建筑。构图采用垂直全身至大腿中部的中景，他双臂交叉，姿态从容自信，目光微微侧向一边。他的面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理。他留着浓密的深色波浪卷发，中等长度，略显凌乱。他身穿深海军蓝罗纹拉链针织开衫，内搭黑色高领毛衣，下着宽松的高腰米白色长裤，左手腕佩戴银色腕表。他右后方停放着一辆黑色的 Mercedes G-Class SUV，侧面和后部清晰可见；左后方较远处停着一辆银色紧凑型掀背车。街道为沥青路面，光线为柔和的阴天日光，色调柔和、优雅且略微去饱和。采用浅景深效果，主体聚焦，背景建筑和车辆呈现柔和的虚化感。奢华男装编辑风格，随性而不失精致，比例自然，照片级真实感，高细节，微妙的电影质感。

templates.title: Isometric Fantasy RPG Market Bug Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 等距视角奇幻 RPG 市场 Bug 场景

templates.prompt: A top-down isometric fantasy RPG gameplay screenshot set in a rustic medieval market street, with a strong tilt-shift depth-of-field effect that makes the scene look miniature. In the foreground, a tiny chibi-style anime girl adventurer stands facing a merchant stall; she has {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair in twin ponytails with blue ribbon ornaments, very large round eyes, a blue pacifier in her mouth, and a detailed blue-and-white dress with lace trim, puff sleeves, white stockings, dark shoes, and a small brown pouch at her waist. She is positioned slightly left of center, looking up at a male shopkeeper leaning over a long wooden counter covered with a muted green cloth. The shopkeeper wears a white lace-up shirt with rolled sleeves and a brown vest, but his face is unnaturally blurred, smeared, or featureless like a rendering bug. The stall is dense with props: 2 wicker baskets of produce, 2 cloth sacks, 1 loaf of bread on the counter, 1 folded map or paper, 1 small framed chalkboard sign, 2 ceramic bottles or jars in reddish tones, stacked wooden crates, wooden beams, and a round hanging shop sign with a cup emblem. In the background, 1 blurry woman in a long dress walks along the cobblestone street, and a horse-drawn cart or wagon shape is visible in soft focus on the left. The lighting is warm afternoon sunlight with dappled shadows across the stone pavement and stall. Include a full game UI overlay: top-left Japanese quest text reading "各地を冒険し、情報を集めよう", bottom-left circular minimap with 2 small adjacent icons, bottom-center status bar showing "Lv.12" and "1286/1286" with a green HP bar, center-right interaction prompt with a speech bubble icon and the Japanese text "話す" plus an "A" button icon, and bottom-right 4 circular action buttons including 1 large blue sword attack button and 3 smaller skill buttons around it. The overall feeling should be a high-detail JRPG town scene, cozy and painterly, but with one eerie glitched face that makes the image resemble a ghostly bugged screenshot.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张俯视等距视角的奇幻 RPG 游戏截图，背景设定在古朴的中世纪市场街道，带有强烈的移轴景深效果，使场景看起来像微缩模型。前景中，一位娇小的 Q 版动漫风格冒险少女正面对着一个摊位；她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"} 的双马尾，饰有蓝色丝带，有着圆圆的大眼睛，嘴里叼着蓝色奶嘴，身穿细节精致的蓝白相间蕾丝边连衣裙，配有泡泡袖、白丝袜、深色鞋子，腰间挂着一个小棕色小包。她位于画面中心偏左，抬头看着一位俯身在铺着暗绿色桌布的长木柜台后的男性店主。店主穿着白色系带衬衫，袖口卷起，外搭棕色背心，但他的脸部呈现出不自然的模糊、涂抹状或五官缺失，如同渲染 Bug 一般。摊位上摆满了道具：2 个柳条筐装的农产品、2 个布袋、柜台上放着 1 条面包、1 张折叠的地图或纸张、1 个带框的小黑板招牌、2 个红棕色调的陶瓷瓶或罐子、堆叠的木箱、木梁以及一个挂着的圆形杯子图案店铺招牌。背景中，1 位穿着长裙的模糊女性走在鹅卵石街道上，左侧隐约可见一辆马车或货车的轮廓，处于柔焦状态。光线为温暖的午后阳光，在石板路和摊位上投下斑驳的阴影。包含完整的游戏 UI 覆盖层：左上角显示日语任务文本“各地を冒険し、情報を集めよう”，左下角为圆形小地图及 2 个相邻的小图标，底部中心为状态栏，显示“Lv.12”和“1286/1286”以及绿色 HP 条，右侧中心为交互提示，包含一个对话气泡图标和日语文本“話す”以及一个“A”按钮图标，右下角为 4 个圆形动作按钮，包括 1 个大的蓝色剑术攻击按钮和周围 3 个较小的技能按钮。整体氛围应呈现出高细节的 JRPG 城镇场景，温馨且具有绘画感，但其中一个诡异的崩坏面部使图像看起来像是一张带有幽灵般 Bug 的游戏截图。

templates.title: Anime Sakura Thank-You Portrait
