templates.title: Detailed Biographical Infographic Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 详细传记信息图海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Please create an infographic about {argument name="subject name" default="[Name]"} with very rich and deep visual effects. It shouldn't just list information: I need you to dig deep into their life, major achievements, key career milestones, philosophical thoughts, and their unique impact on technology and design. Avoid a rigid block-by-block layout; use diagrams, annotations, and lead lines to organically combine this information. Visual style: Go for a bold, strong, and highly graphical illustration style. Specifically, it should look like this: the central focus is a highly realistic, photo-like portrait of the person. Surrounding this core are elements like timelines, analytical charts, classic products, famous quotes, and concise text. Composition: Keep the background clean. Use layered composition to perfectly mix the realistic portrait with strong graphical elements (like various shapes, icons, large color blocks). The entire image should look full of content, textured, and very professional.

promptLocalized.zh: 请为 {argument name="subject name" default="[姓名]"} 创建一张视觉效果极其丰富且深度的信息图。它不应只是信息的罗列：我需要你深入挖掘他们的生平、主要成就、关键职业里程碑、哲学思想，以及他们对技术和设计产生的独特影响。避免生硬的板块式布局；请使用图表、注释和引导线将这些信息有机地结合起来。视觉风格：采用大胆、有力且极具图形感的插画风格。具体来说，它应该呈现如下效果：中心焦点是该人物高度写实、如照片般的肖像。围绕这一核心的是时间轴、分析图表、经典产品、名言警句和简洁的文字等元素。构图：保持背景简洁。利用分层构图，将写实肖像与强烈的图形元素（如各种形状、图标、大色块）完美融合。整张图像应看起来内容充实、富有质感且非常专业。

templates.title: Luxury Concept Poster Design

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华概念海报设计

templates.prompt:
What you will generate is not a regular illustration, but a high-end concept poster that expresses the meaning and symbolism of the person and name "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as a visual metaphor.

Place the giant letters "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" as the main protagonist of the entire screen. The letters should be thick, powerful sans-serif characters with an overwhelming presence. The background should be {argument name="background color" default="deep black"}, and the characters a slightly yellowish off-white, with paper texture, graininess, and light scuffs like vintage silkscreen printing or old posters.

At the bottom center, place a monochrome portrait of a man reminiscent of Elon Musk. It should have an atmosphere similar to the person himself, with an expression looking up at the future. The face should not be too realistic, but expressed with strong shadows in a print/poster style.

In the upper right, include a composition where a rocket is launching diagonally upward. Use {argument name="accent color" default="red"} as an accent color for the rocket's exhaust flames and smoke, and have it pass through the giant letters as if cutting through them. This visualizes the meaning of "breaking through to the future," "breaking through existing frameworks," and "large-scale challenges."

Make the overall design a minimalist and powerful graphic poster. Do not add too many elements; compose it only with the text, the person, the rocket, and the red smoke. The composition should be bold and designed to leave an impression at a glance, even from a distance.

In the lower left, add small auxiliary text like "VISION / SCALE / MOTION," and in the lower right, "BUILD THE FUTURE." You may discreetly place small symbols associated with Tesla or X if necessary, but the main focus remains the symbolism of the name "ELON MUSK" and the person.

Unify the colors around three main colors: black, off-white, and red. Create a concept poster with a strong visual memory that conveys luxury, futurism, ambition, solitude, a sense of scale, and the energy of destruction and creation.

promptLocalized.zh:
你将生成的不是普通的插画，而是一张高端概念海报，通过视觉隐喻来表达 "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" 这个名字及其背后人物的意义与象征。

将巨大的字母 "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" 作为整个画面的主角。字体应为粗壮、有力且极具存在感的无衬线字体。背景应为 {argument name="background color" default="深黑色"}，字母则采用略带黄色的灰白色，并带有纸张纹理、颗粒感以及类似复古丝网印刷或旧海报的轻微磨损痕迹。

在底部中心位置，放置一张让人联想到 Elon Musk 的单色肖像。它应具有与人物本身相似的氛围，表现出一种仰望未来的神情。面部不宜过于写实，而是以印刷/海报风格通过强烈的阴影来表现。

在右上角，构图应包含一枚向斜上方发射的火箭。使用 {argument name="accent color" default="红色"} 作为火箭尾焰和烟雾的强调色，让它穿过巨大的字母，仿佛将其切开。这象征着“突破未来”、“打破现有框架”以及“大规模挑战”的含义。

整体设计应简洁而有力。不要添加过多元素；仅由文字、人物、火箭和红色烟雾构成。构图要大胆，确保即使在远处也能一眼留下深刻印象。

在左下角添加如 "VISION / SCALE / MOTION" 等小型辅助文字，右下角添加 "BUILD THE FUTURE"。如有必要，可以低调地放置与 Tesla 或 X 相关的小符号，但重点仍应放在 "ELON MUSK" 这个名字及其人物的象征意义上。

将色彩统一在黑、灰白、红三种主色调内。创作一张具有强烈视觉记忆点的概念海报，传达出奢华感、未来主义、雄心壮志、孤独感、宏大的格局感，以及破坏与创造的能量。

templates.title: Premium Korean Palm Reading Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 高级韩语手相分析指南

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create a premium Korean palm reading guide image based on the uploaded palm photo.

All visible text in the final image must be Korean only. Use clean Korean sans-serif typography. The title must be exactly “손금 분석 가이드”.

Create a refined two-panel layout:
Left panel: place the uploaded real palm photo inside a clean rounded card. Preserve the original hand shape, palm lines, skin texture, and natural details. Do not distort or redraw the hand.
Right panel: create a separate black-and-white palm contour interpretation diagram based on the same hand. Highlight the main palm lines with thin precise lines and label them in Korean.

Include Korean labels and sections:
“손금 분석 가이드”, “전체 요약”, “생명선”, “두뇌선”, “감정선”, “운명선”, “재물선”, “태양선”, “결혼선”, “성격”, “직업운”, “재물운”, “연애운”, “조언”, “확인 불가”.

Analyze palm shape, finger proportions, life line, head line, heart line, fate line, wealth line, sun line, marriage line, line depth, length, direction, breaks, branches, and overlaps. If something is unclear, write “확인 불가”. Keep the Korean interpretation short, realistic, calm, and advisory.

Design style:
1:1 square format, white background, black and warm dark gray text, thin hairline dividers, rounded cards, subtle shadows, large margins, generous negative space, precise grid, minimal line pictograms, luxury editorial report, high-end wellness analysis, elegant and expensive-looking.

No English text, no roman letters, no broken Korean, no random glyphs, no colorful decoration, no cartoon style, no occult symbols, no tarot imagery, no horror mood, no messy background, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
根据上传的手掌照片，创建一份高级韩语手相分析指南图像。

最终图像中所有可见文本必须仅使用韩语。请使用简洁的韩语无衬线字体。标题必须完全为“손금 분석 가이드”。

创建精致的双栏布局：
左侧面板：将上传的真实手掌照片放置在一个简洁的圆角卡片内。保留原始手型、掌纹、皮肤纹理及自然细节。请勿扭曲或重绘手部。
右侧面板：基于同一手部创建独立的黑白掌纹轮廓解析图。用细致的线条高亮显示主要掌纹，并用韩语进行标注。

包含以下韩语标签和部分：
“손금 분석 가이드”、“전체 요약”、“생명선”、“두뇌선”、“감정선”、“운명선”、“재물선”、“태양선”、“결혼선”、“성격”、“직업운”、“재물운”、“연애운”、“조언”、“확인 불가”。

分析手型、手指比例、生命线、智慧线、感情线、命运线、财运线、太阳线、婚姻线，以及线条的深度、长度、走向、断裂、分叉和重叠情况。如果某处不清晰，请标注“확인 불가”。韩语解读内容需保持简短、写实、冷静且具有建议性。

设计风格：
1:1 正方形格式，白色背景，黑色及暖深灰色文字，细发丝分割线，圆角卡片，柔和阴影，大页边距，充裕的留白，精准的网格，极简线条图标，奢华编辑报告风格，高端健康分析，优雅且外观昂贵。

禁止出现任何英文字符、罗马字母、错误的韩语、随机符号、彩色装饰、卡通风格、神秘符号、塔罗牌意象、恐怖氛围、杂乱背景或水印。

templates.title: Cinematic Editorial Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级叙事分镜

templates.prompt:
- Character: Oriental female @image_1, black high ponytail, modified Cheongsam {argument name="dress color" default="dark purple"} gown @image_2, gold vintage large hoop earrings, red lips, cold and noble temperament.
- Vehicle: @image_3 {argument name="car model" default="Huawei Zhijie R7"}, Nebula Purple paint, streamlined sedan silhouette, license plate with Chinese characters 'Zhijie R7'.

Scene: Outside a top-tier night award ceremony or international film festival venue. Marble plaza, flanked by media with long lenses and flashlights. Faraway buildings with giant light installations and a red carpet extension.

Storyboard plan, deep black high-end editorial layout, purple and gold color scheme title: "{argument name="storyboard title" default="IGNITE · Zhijie R7 × Grand Ceremony Entrance Blockbuster Project"}"

Section 1 - Character and Vehicle Reference (professional lookbook layout style): Extracting from reference images - front/side of character, full side of vehicle, close-up of front, macro of earrings and handbag.

Section 2 - Divided into left and right parts:
Left: Real scene reference for environment (night lobby atmosphere photo).
Right: Top-down spatial floor plan. Notated with: spatial outlines (stairs/plaza/aisles), initial character position + dashed path arrows, 5 camera positions (number + abbreviation), camera direction arrows, product/prop anchors, highlighted core composition areas.

5-Frame Storyboard (2.39:1 CinemaScope):
Frame 1: Long shot · Moment door opens. Night plaza in a sea of flashes, door opens, purple interior ambient light lights up first, backlit silhouette, hair and hem blowing in wind.
Frame 2: Entrance walk · Low angle shot. Looking up from ground level as she steps down in stilettos, marble reflecting the hem, Zhijie R7 body in back as a glowing backdrop, flashes bursting in distance.
Frame 3: Turn back · 85mm portrait close-up. She turns sideways, looking directly at the camera, gold earrings glint in the flash, very slight curve of the mouth, expression controlling the scene.
Frame 4: Hero shot of car and person. She stands in front of the car, breeze blowing the dress, Zhijie R7 full side glowing behind, Nebula Purple paint and gown forming a high-end chromatic harmony, background media crowd blurred.
Frame 5: Departure end shot. She enters the car, door closes slowly, taillights light up, vehicle slowly drives away from the red carpet amidst flashes, leaving only light trails.

Lighting and Style:
Strong night side-backlight · Instant flash exposure feel. Deep black background · Purple car body as one of the only light sources. 2.39:1 anamorphic wide screen · Large aperture shallow depth of field. Keywords: Absolute protagonist aura · Event-level narrative · Movie premiere quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
- 人物：东方女性 @image_1，黑色高马尾，改良旗袍 {argument name="dress color" default="深紫色"} 礼服 @image_2，金色复古大圆环耳环，红唇，气质清冷高贵。
- 车辆：@image_3 {argument name="car model" default="华为智界 R7"}，星云紫车漆，流线型轿车轮廓，车牌显示汉字“智界 R7”。

场景：顶级夜间颁奖典礼或国际电影节场馆外。大理石广场，两侧是手持长焦镜头和闪光灯的媒体。远处建筑配有巨型灯光装置，红毯延伸至远方。

分镜规划，深黑色高端编辑排版，紫金配色标题：“{argument name="storyboard title" default="IGNITE · 智界 R7 × 盛典入场大片项目"}”

第 1 部分 - 人物与车辆参考（专业 Lookbook 排版风格）：提取自参考图——人物正面/侧面、车辆全侧面、前脸特写、耳环与手提包微距。

第 2 部分 - 分为左右两部分：
左侧：环境真实场景参考（夜间大厅氛围照片）。
右侧：俯视空间平面图。标注内容：空间轮廓（楼梯/广场/通道）、初始人物位置 + 虚线路径箭头、5 个机位（数字 + 缩写）、摄像机方向箭头、产品/道具锚点、高亮核心构图区域。

5 帧分镜（2.39:1 宽银幕）：
第 1 帧：远景 · 开门瞬间。夜间广场闪光灯如海，车门开启，紫色内饰氛围灯率先亮起，背光剪影，发丝与裙摆在风中飘动。
第 2 帧：入场行走 · 低角度拍摄。从地面仰拍，她穿着细高跟鞋走下车，大理石地面映衬着裙摆，智界 R7 车身在后方作为发光的背景，远处闪光灯闪烁。
第 3 帧：回眸 · 85mm 人像特写。她侧身回眸，直视镜头，金色耳环在闪光灯下闪烁，嘴角微微上扬，表情掌控全场。
第 4 帧：人车英雄镜头。她站在车前，微风吹动裙摆，智界 R7 在身后全侧面发光，星云紫车漆与礼服形成高端色彩和谐，背景媒体人群虚化。
第 5 帧：离场尾镜。她进入车内，车门缓缓关闭，尾灯亮起，车辆在闪光灯中缓缓驶离红毯，只留下光影轨迹。

光影与风格：
强烈的夜间侧逆光 · 即时闪光灯曝光感。深黑色背景 · 紫色车身作为仅有的光源之一。2.39:1 变形宽银幕 · 大光圈浅景深。关键词：绝对主角光环 · 盛典级叙事 · 电影首映质感。

templates.title: 1960s Art-House Film Poster

templates.prompt:
Create a vertical poster composition on aged cream paper with a handmade analog feel. Use rough ripped paper edges, layered magazine cutouts, photocopy grain, halftone texture, ink bleed, and slightly imperfect screen-print registration. Keep the subject as the main black-and-white photographic portrait, placed prominently in the center or upper center.

Surround the subject with graphic blocks of deep red, cobalt blue, warm yellow, black, and ivory. Add supporting collage fragments such as a rainy European street, film-strip borders, newspaper clippings, urban silhouettes, and cinematic details, arranged like a handmade 1960s art-house movie poster.

Use bold condensed typography with a strong visual hierarchy. Add large headline text: “{argument name="main title" default="[MAIN TITLE]"}”. Add smaller subtitle text: “{argument name="subtitle" default="[SUBTITLE]"}”. Add bottom text: “{argument name="event details" default="[BRAND NAME / EVENT NAME / COMING SOON / DATE]"}”. If needed, include a small top line reading “[TAGLINE]”.

The final result should feel cinematic, intellectual, rebellious, and editorial — like a lost 1960s European film poster with a strong point of view. Keep it raw, tactile, printed, imperfect, and handmade. Avoid a glossy modern finish.

promptLocalized.zh:
在做旧的奶油色纸张上创作一幅垂直构图的海报，营造出手工模拟的质感。使用粗糙的撕纸边缘、分层的杂志剪贴、复印颗粒感、半色调纹理、墨水渗色以及略有偏差的丝网印刷套色效果。主体应为黑白摄影肖像，置于画面中心或中上方位置。

在主体周围点缀深红、钴蓝、暖黄、黑色和象牙色的图形色块。添加辅助性的拼贴碎片，如雨中的欧洲街道、胶片边框、报纸剪报、城市剪影和电影细节，像 20 世纪 60 年代的艺术电影海报那样进行手工排版。

使用具有强烈视觉层级的粗体压缩字体。添加大号标题文字：“{argument name="main title" default="[主标题]"}”。添加较小的副标题文字：“{argument name="subtitle" default="[副标题]"}”。添加底部文字：“{argument name="event details" default="[品牌名称 / 活动名称 / 即将推出 / 日期]"}”。如有需要，可在顶部添加一行小字：“[标语]”。

最终成品应呈现出电影感、知识分子气息、叛逆感和编辑风格，如同 20 世纪 60 年代一张带有鲜明视角的遗失欧洲电影海报。保持其原始、触感、印刷感、不完美和手工制作的特质。避免使用现代的光泽感饰面。

templates.title: Golden Hour Organic Outdoor Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻户外有机自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic, casual outdoor smartphone selfie of a {argument name="subject age" default="middle-aged woman"} from the chest up, framed slightly off-center and shot at arm’s length on a phone camera. She has voluminous shoulder-length wavy hair in a warm {argument name="hair color" default="auburn red"}, softly tousled by a light breeze and glowing with golden backlight from the low sun behind her. She is wearing a dark {argument name="top color" default="deep forest green"} V-neck knit top or cardigan, a delicate thin chain necklace, and a small hoop earring barely visible through her hair. The setting is an outdoor terrace or walkway beside a pale stone wall, with leafy trees filling most of the background and a faint building partially visible through the branches. The sun appears in the upper left corner, creating natural lens flare, warm rim lighting around the hair, gentle highlights on the shoulders, and realistic late-afternoon golden hour contrast. The composition should feel organic and unpolished rather than studio-perfect: slight handheld phone-camera perspective, natural skin texture, casual posture, authentic lighting, shallow depth from the phone sensor, and a candid everyday social-media selfie aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实、随意的户外智能手机自拍，拍摄对象为 {argument name="subject age" default="中年女性"}，取景范围为胸部以上，构图略微偏离中心，以手机镜头在手臂长度距离拍摄。她留着蓬松的齐肩卷发，发色为温暖的 {argument name="hair color" default="红褐色"}，被微风轻轻吹乱，在身后低垂的太阳照射下，散发出金色的逆光光泽。她身穿一件深 {argument name="top color" default="森林绿"} 的 V 领针织上衣或开衫，佩戴着一条精致的细链项链，透过发丝隐约可见一只小耳圈。背景为户外露台或石墙旁的步道，大部分背景被茂密的树木覆盖，透过枝叶可隐约看到远处的建筑。太阳位于左上角，营造出自然的镜头光晕、发丝周围温暖的轮廓光、肩部柔和的高光，以及写实的傍晚黄金时刻对比度。构图应呈现出有机且未经修饰的质感，而非影棚级的完美效果：带有轻微的手持手机拍摄视角、自然的皮肤纹理、随意的姿态、真实的光影、手机传感器带来的浅景深，以及地道的日常社交媒体自拍美学。

templates.title: Realistic Golden-Hour Indoor Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 写实风格黄金时刻室内自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic casual indoor selfie of a {argument name="person" default="adult woman"} taken at arm’s length on a smartphone, framed from mid-chest up in a square composition. She has shoulder-length, slightly messy wavy {argument name="hair color" default="auburn red"} hair with natural volume and soft frizz, center-parted, lit by warm golden-hour sunlight coming from a large window or sliding glass door on the left side of the frame. She wears a simple {argument name="shirt color" default="white"} short-sleeve V-neck T-shirt. The pose is relaxed and natural with both forearms faintly visible from holding the phone, creating an authentic unpolished selfie perspective. The setting is a real apartment or home interior: bright vertical window and door frames on the left, beige walls, and a dark brown sofa in the back right. Lighting is soft, warm, and organic, with sun highlights on the hair, shoulders, and arms, mild indoor shadows, realistic skin texture, and no glamor retouching. Overall look should feel candid, believable, and minimally styled, like a genuine phone photo rather than a polished AI portrait. Use natural proportions, subtle image noise, ordinary home background detail, and straightforward smartphone camera realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的休闲室内自拍，由 {argument name="person" default="成年女性"} 手持智能手机拍摄，构图为胸部以上的方形画面。她留着齐肩、略显凌乱的波浪卷 {argument name="hair color" default="赤褐色"} 头发，发质自然蓬松且带有轻微毛躁，中分发型。画面左侧的大窗户或推拉玻璃门射入温暖的黄金时刻阳光。她穿着一件简单的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 短袖 V 领 T 恤。姿势放松自然，双前臂隐约可见，呈现出真实的手机自拍视角。场景为真实的公寓或住宅内部：左侧有明亮的垂直窗框和门框，背景为米色墙壁和右后方的深棕色沙发。光线柔和、温暖且自然，阳光照亮了头发、肩膀和手臂，带有轻微的室内阴影，皮肤纹理真实，没有经过美颜修饰。整体观感应显得随性、可信且未经刻意造型，就像一张真实的手机照片，而非精修的 AI 肖像。使用自然的比例、细微的图像噪点、普通的家居背景细节，以及直观的智能手机摄影写实感。

templates.title: Realistic Golden Hour Porch Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 写实的黄金时刻门廊自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic organic selfie of a {argument name="subject age" default="middle-aged"} woman sitting on a house porch during golden hour, photographed at arm’s length with a casual smartphone front camera. She has {argument name="hair color" default="auburn brown"} shoulder-length softly wavy hair with volume and slightly tousled texture, warm sunlit skin, and a natural unpolished everyday appearance. She wears a simple {argument name="top color" default="black"} tank top with bare shoulders visible. The composition is a close chest-up portrait, centered but slightly off-kilter like a real handheld selfie, with one arm partially visible in the foreground. The lighting is low-angle warm evening sunlight casting soft highlights and gentle shadows across the face, chest, and arms. The background shows an outdoor residential porch with white siding on the left, a pale vertical porch column on the right, and a hanging basket or wall planter filled with small pink and purple flowers and green foliage. The image should feel candid, authentic, and minimally processed, with realistic skin texture, natural flyaway hairs, slight asymmetry, and subtle smartphone lens distortion, avoiding glamour retouching, beauty filters, or overly polished AI aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的自然风格自拍，主角是一位 {argument name="subject age" default="中年"} 女性，坐在自家门廊上，拍摄于黄金时刻。照片由手机前置摄像头以手持距离拍摄，显得随性自然。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="红棕色"} 的齐肩微卷发，发型蓬松且略带凌乱感，皮肤在阳光下呈现暖色调，整体形象自然、质朴，如同日常生活中的样子。她穿着一件简单的 {argument name="top color" default="黑色"} 背心，露出双肩。构图为胸部以上的近景肖像，虽然居中但略有倾斜，呈现出真实手持自拍的效果，前景中可见部分手臂。光线为低角度的温暖傍晚阳光，在面部、胸部和手臂上投下柔和的高光与阴影。背景为室外住宅门廊，左侧是白色护墙板，右侧是一根浅色的垂直门廊柱，挂篮或墙上花盆里种着粉色和紫色的小花以及绿植。图像应呈现出抓拍感、真实感，且处理痕迹极少，包含真实的皮肤纹理、自然的碎发、轻微的不对称感以及细微的手机镜头畸变，避免使用美颜滤镜或过度修饰的 AI 审美。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的、原生智能手机自拍，拍摄对象为一位 {argument name="subject age" default="中年"} 女性，她坐在户外门廊或露台上，沐浴在午后温暖的黄金时刻阳光中。构图为胸部以上的休闲正面视角，略带不完美感。她留着齐肩的柔和波浪形赤褐色头发，中分，发质自然，有几缕碎发；皮肤白皙，带有明显的雀斑，胸部和颈部呈现真实的皮肤质感，神态日常且放松。她身穿浅灰色开衫，内搭淡色蕾丝边吊带背心。背景是一扇白色外门和墙壁，左侧可见一把深蓝色布艺椅子或坐垫，强烈的阳光在她的衣物和皮肤上投下柔和的暖色高光和自然阴影。画面应呈现出未经修饰、抓拍且极具真实感的质感，而非精修效果：包含微妙的不对称感、正常的手机镜头透视、略显紧凑的裁剪、真实的家居背景、自然的色彩、柔和的对比度以及纪录片级别的摄影真实感。

templates.title: Origami Pop-Up T-Rex Book Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 折纸立体霸王龙图书广告

templates.prompt: A cinematic studio photograph of an open {argument name="book type" default="pop-up book"} on a clean white surface, viewed from a low front angle, with a dramatic {argument name="main subject" default="T-rex"} made entirely of intricate white origami and laser-cut paper bursting upward from the center fold. The dinosaur is large and dominant, facing right in a roaring pose with open jaws, sharp paper teeth, tiny forearms, powerful legs, and a long tail sweeping left. Its body is built from hundreds of delicate layered paper slats and cutout perforations, glowing from strong internal and under-page illumination so the creature appears backlit and semi-luminous. Around the base, exactly 7 paper plant silhouettes rise from the pages: 3 darker branching shrubs in the foreground and 4 pale fern-like foliage shapes behind them, all also cut from paper. The open pages show faint printed text on the right-hand spread, while the center gutter emits a bright white light that shines upward through the structure. A soft cool-blue ambient environment contrasts with the warm white glow from inside the book, creating a magical children's advertisement feel. Strong spotlighting from above and behind the dinosaur produces crisp shadows cast across the next spread and onto the tabletop. Minimal background, high detail, elegant product-ad aesthetic, volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, monochrome white and blue palette, ultra-clean composition, surreal handcrafted realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的摄影棚照片，展示了一本打开的 {argument name="book type" default="立体书"} 平放在干净的白色表面上，采用低角度正面视角拍摄。画面中心，一只完全由精细的白色折纸和激光切割纸张构成的 {argument name="main subject" default="霸王龙"} 从书页折痕处向上跃出。这只恐龙体型巨大且极具视觉冲击力，面向右侧，呈现出咆哮姿态，张开的下颚露出锋利的纸质牙齿，前肢短小，后腿强壮，长尾向左扫过。其身体由数百层精致的纸条和镂空剪裁构成，在内部和书页下方强光的照射下，呈现出背光和半透明的质感。在底部周围，书页中升起 7 株纸质植物剪影：前景中有 3 株颜色较深的灌木，后方有 4 株浅色的蕨类植物形状，均由纸张剪裁而成。打开的书页右侧印有模糊的文字，书脊中心散发出明亮的白光，向上穿透整个结构。柔和的冷蓝色环境光与书内温暖的白光形成对比，营造出梦幻般的儿童广告氛围。来自恐龙上方和后方的强聚光灯在书页和桌面上投下清晰的阴影。背景极简，细节丰富，具有优雅的商业广告美感，带有体积光雾，景深较浅，采用单色白与蓝的色调，构图极其干净，呈现出超现实的手工写实风格。

templates.title: Origami Dinosaur Pop-Up Book Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 折纸恐龙立体书广告

templates.prompt: A polished children's pop-up book advertisement on a dark studio background, featuring an open hardcover book with thick white pages and a teal-green cover lying on a tabletop. From the center fold, a highly detailed white paper origami T-rex bursts upward in a dynamic roaring pose, mouth wide open with sharp triangular teeth, tiny clawed arms raised, thick folded legs planted in layered paper jungle foliage, and a segmented tail extending backward. The dinosaur should look handcrafted from crisp folded cardstock, with visible geometric paper panels and clean origami seams. Behind it, the right-hand page stands partially upright and catches a dramatic shadow projection of the T-rex profile, creating a large silhouette with open jaws; also include small paper-cut scenery on that page: 3 flying pterosaurs and a simple mountain landscape. Surround the dinosaur base with dense cut-paper plants and grass emerging from both pages. Light the scene with a cinematic warm spotlight from the upper left, leaving the background in deep navy to black, with soft realistic shadows cast across the book and onto the raised page. At the top center, include bold white ad typography in stacked lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}, with a white ribbon banner below that reads {argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}. At the bottom center, place 4 evenly spaced circular feature icons with captions in white: an open book icon labeled "AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS", a hand icon labeled "HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE", a shield icon labeled "DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY", and a light bulb icon labeled "INSPIRES IMAGINATION". Premium toy catalog style, cinematic product photography mixed with paper craft illustration, centered composition, high contrast, ultra-clean, whimsical, family-friendly, realistic paper texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的儿童立体书广告，背景为深色摄影棚风格。画面中，一本带有厚实白页和青绿色封面的精装书平放在桌面上。从书的中心折痕处，一只细节丰富的白色折纸霸王龙以动态咆哮的姿势跃出，它张大嘴巴露出锋利的三角形牙齿，细小的爪子向上抬起，粗壮的折叠腿扎根在层叠的纸质丛林植被中，分段式的尾巴向后延伸。恐龙应呈现出由挺括卡纸手工制作的质感，带有清晰的几何纸板拼接和整洁的折纸缝隙。在它身后，右侧书页部分立起，投射出霸王龙侧影的戏剧性阴影，形成一个张开大嘴的巨大剪影；该页面还包含小型剪纸场景：3 只飞行的翼龙和简单的山脉景观。恐龙底座周围环绕着从书页中生长出的茂密剪纸植物和草丛。场景采用从左上方照射的电影级暖色聚光灯，背景保持深海军蓝至黑色，书本和立起的书页上投射出柔和逼真的阴影。在顶部中心，包含堆叠的粗体白色广告排版，文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}，下方配有一条白色丝带横幅，文字为 {argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}。在底部中心，放置 4 个间距均匀的圆形功能图标，并配有白色标题：一个标有“AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS”的打开书本图标、一个标有“HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE”的手部图标、一个标有“DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY”的盾牌图标，以及一个标有“INSPIRES IMAGINATION”的灯泡图标。高端玩具目录风格，电影级产品摄影与纸艺插画结合，中心构图，高对比度，超洁净，奇幻，适合家庭，逼真的纸张纹理。

templates.title: Luxury Dream Home Real Estate Flyer

titleLocalized.zh: 豪华梦想家园房地产宣传单

templates.prompt: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张精美的竖版房地产宣传单，采用简洁现代的社交媒体广告风格，比例为 4:5 的海报构图。使用明亮的日间户外主题，背景为淡蓝色天空和柔和的云朵，左上角和右上角用绿叶树枝进行点缀。整体布局应呈现出高端房产投资广告的质感，采用醒目的排版、光泽感的营销设计，以及青色、红色、白色和灰色的配色方案。在左上方，放置一个小巧的大写标题 {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}。在其正下方，添加一个非常大的堆叠式主标题：{argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"}（深青色）和 {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"}（鲜红色），使用粗体压缩无衬线字体。下方添加一条青色丝带横幅，上面写着白色大写文字 {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}。在标语下方，水平排列 3 个圆形功能图标，图标之间用细竖线分隔：盾牌图标配文“SECURE YOUR FUTURE”，上升的柱状图图标配文“HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT”，房屋图标配文“MODERN & ELEGANT”。在左侧中部和底部中心，展示一栋大型写实风格的当代豪华住宅，建筑为 2 层，拥有白色和灰色外墙、黑色饰边、大落地窗、阳台、景观灌木和铺设好的车道，以正面四分之三的角度呈现。在右侧，放置一位腰部以上的黑人成年男性，身穿绿色针织毛衣，面向前方，以自信的销售海报姿势直接指向观众；他的身体与房屋重叠并延伸至前景。在他下躯干附近，添加一个带有轻微 3D 效果的光泽红色圆形徽章，内含大号白色大写文字 {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}，并在其底部边缘附加一个深青色的小型斜角横幅，上面写着“LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!”。在底部，创建一个深青色面板，其中包含 3 张带有白色边框且间距相等的圆角矩形房产卡片。卡片 1 应展示一排现代联排别墅，标签为“MODERN TERRACES”，下方放置 2 个小功能点：“Spacious Rooms”和“24/7 Security”。卡片 2 应展示一栋带泳池的豪华别墅，标签为“LUXURY VILLAS”，下方放置 2 个小功能点：“Premium Amenities”和“Prime Locations”。卡片 3 应展示一栋独立的高档现代住宅，标签为“EXCLUSIVE HOMES”，下方放置 2 个小功能点：“Registered Title”和“Trusted Developer”。在最底部，包含一个横跨大部分宽度的空白白色圆角矩形，作为联系方式或页脚信息的占位区域。使整体图像清晰、高对比度、商业化、令人向往，并像高端房地产营销海报一样专业设计。

templates.title: Whimsical Ladybug and Bee Village Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻瓢虫与蜜蜂村庄场景

templates.prompt: A heartwarming stylized 3D animated forest village scene at golden hour, showing 2 adorable insect characters meeting on a cobblestone path between tiny mushroom-roof cottages. In the left foreground, a cute {argument name="main insect type" default="ladybug"} crouches low with an oversized glossy black head, huge expressive brown eyes, a small smiling mouth, short antennae with rounded tips, and a tiny {argument name="accessory color" default="red"} bow near one antenna. Its shell is bright {argument name="shell color" default="red"} with distinct black spots, and its body is dark charcoal black with soft rounded limbs. In the right midground, a cheerful small {argument name="second insect type" default="bee"} hovers slightly above the ground facing the larger insect, with a similarly oversized head, big sparkling eyes, delicate translucent wings, tiny antennae, and little forelegs lifted as if speaking excitedly. The setting is an enchanted bug-sized woodland hamlet with 3 visible cottages, rounded wooden doors, curved stone walls, moss, vines, flowers, and leafy plants framing the path. Warm cinematic sunlight filters through the trees from the upper right, creating glowing rim light, soft bokeh, and floating firefly-like particles. Use a shallow depth of field, low camera angle at insect eye level, rich autumn-green and golden tones, highly detailed textures, soft global illumination, whimsical family-film mood, Pixar-like stylized realism, and a subtle dreamy double-exposure feel with faint overlapping light or ghosted highlights in parts of the frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个温馨的风格化 3D 动画森林村庄场景，时间设定在黄金时刻，展示了 2 只可爱的昆虫角色在鹅卵石小径上相遇，周围是带有蘑菇屋顶的小屋。左侧前景中，一只可爱的 {argument name="main insect type" default="瓢虫"} 低身蹲着，有着超大的亮黑色头部、巨大且富有表现力的棕色眼睛、小巧的微笑嘴巴、末端圆润的短触角，以及靠近其中一根触角处的一个微小的 {argument name="accessory color" default="红色"} 蝴蝶结。它的背壳是鲜艳的 {argument name="shell color" default="红色"}，带有明显的黑色斑点，身体呈深炭黑色，四肢圆润柔软。右侧中景中，一只欢快的小 {argument name="second insect type" default="蜜蜂"} 在离地稍高处盘旋，面对着那只较大的昆虫，有着同样超大的头部、闪烁的大眼睛、精致的半透明翅膀、细小的触角，以及微微抬起的前肢，仿佛正在兴奋地交谈。场景设定在一个迷人的昆虫大小的林地村落中，可见 3 座小屋、圆形的木门、弯曲的石墙、苔藓、藤蔓、花朵和叶片植物环绕着小径。温暖的电影级阳光从右上方的树木间穿过，营造出明亮的轮廓光、柔和的焦外成像以及漂浮的萤火虫般的微粒。使用浅景深，以昆虫视角的低机位拍摄，呈现丰富的秋绿色调和金色调，具有高度细腻的纹理、柔和的全局光照、奇幻的家庭电影氛围、皮克斯风格的写实感，以及微妙的梦幻双重曝光感，画面部分区域带有淡淡的重叠光影或虚影高光。

templates.title: Eggs Benedict Miniature Acrylic Box

titleLocalized.zh: 班尼迪克蛋微缩亚克力盒

templates.prompt: A premium artisan food photography image of a clear acrylic collector box displayed on a rustic wooden table, shot in a clean 4:5 product style with soft natural light and shallow depth of field. The box contains a miniature kitchen diorama dedicated to {argument name="dish name" default="Eggs Benedict"}, with a tiny chef figurine in a white toque and white uniform with a red neckerchief standing at center, mid-preparation, pouring glossy hollandaise sauce over a stacked eggs benedict on an English muffin half. Inside the center kitchen area, include 1 miniature stove, 1 frying pan, 1 small saucepan in the chef’s hand, 1 wooden prep table, 2 knives on the table, 3 hanging metal utensils, 2 stacked plates on the lower shelf, 1 small white bowl, and 2 seasoning mills beneath the table. Surround the center scene with exactly 12 clear ingredient compartments built into the acrylic box walls: top row has 4 compartments containing 2 English muffins, 3 butter cubes, 3 lemon slices, and 3 whole eggs; left side has 4 compartments containing 3 round slices of Canadian bacon, 2 sprigs of parsley, 1 whole egg, and 2 condiment bottles; right side has 4 compartments containing 1 origin map card labeled USA with a red map of the United States and a tiny NYC mark, 1 compartment of chopped chives, 2 spice jars, and 3 cracked egg yolks. The acrylic packaging has bold red, white, and blue trim bands around the top and bottom edges, evoking American flag colors. Add a front label plaque reading {argument name="front label" default="EGGS BENEDICT"} with smaller text {argument name="origin and date" default="USA - 1894"}. Keep the miniature highly detailed, realistic, polished, and luxurious, like a museum-grade culinary collectible or upscale toy packaging, with crisp transparent reflections and a warm editorial tabletop background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级手工美食摄影图片，展示了一个放置在质朴木桌上的透明亚克力收藏盒，采用干净的 4:5 产品风格拍摄，光线柔和自然，景深较浅。盒子内含一个专门展示 {argument name="dish name" default="Eggs Benedict"} 的微缩厨房模型，中心站着一位身穿白色厨师帽和白色制服、系着红色领巾的微型厨师人偶，正处于准备阶段，将光亮的荷兰酱淋在堆叠于英式松饼半块上的班尼迪克蛋上。在中心厨房区域内，包含 1 个微型炉灶、1 个平底锅、厨师手中 1 个小炖锅、1 张木制准备台、桌上 2 把刀、3 个悬挂的金属厨具、下层架子上的 2 个叠放盘子、1 个白色小碗以及桌下的 2 个调味研磨器。在中心场景周围，亚克力盒壁内置了 12 个透明食材格：顶排 4 个格子分别装有 2 个英式松饼、3 块黄油、3 片柠檬和 3 个全蛋；左侧 4 个格子分别装有 3 片圆形加拿大培根、2 枝欧芹、1 个全蛋和 2 瓶调味品；右侧 4 个格子分别装有 1 张标有 USA 的产地地图卡（带有红色美国地图和微小的纽约市标记）、1 格切碎的细香葱、2 个香料罐和 3 个打碎的蛋黄。亚克力包装的顶部和底部边缘带有醒目的红、白、蓝装饰条，呼应美国国旗配色。添加一个正面标签牌，文字为 {argument name="front label" default="EGGS BENEDICT"}，下方附有较小的文字 {argument name="origin and date" default="USA - 1894"}。保持微缩模型的高度细节、逼真、精致且奢华，如同博物馆级的烹饪收藏品或高端玩具包装，具有清晰的透明反射和温暖的编辑风格桌面背景。

templates.title: Empowerment Sports Campaign Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赋能运动主题宣传海报

templates.prompt: Create a high-end global sportswear campaign poster on a clean light gray studio background with a full-body female athlete crouching in the foreground, photographed in a fashion-advertising style. She is a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length slightly tousled hair, wearing a fitted white short-sleeve athletic t-shirt with a small black puma logo on the chest, black leggings, a light gray sweatshirt tied around her waist, and gray running shoes with subtle white branding. Her pose is low and powerful, one knee raised, one hand resting on the lifted knee and the other hanging loosely, facing camera with confident energy. Behind and around her, fill most of the composition with oversized black hand-painted brush lettering in an expressive activist style. The text must read exactly: "WE ARE THE VOICE OF" above, then the huge central word "STRENGTH," then beneath it "UNITY," and "AND CHANGE." Add a bold handwritten hashtag "#OWNYOURPOWER" near the middle-right. In the lower-right corner place the black Puma leaping cat logo above the wordmark "PUMA" and the tagline "FOREVER. FASTER." At the very bottom add 3 small footer text blocks: left "PUMA.COM", center "FOREVER. FASTER. TOGETHER. A GLOBAL MOVEMENT FOR EQUALITY, EMPOWERMENT AND CHANGE.", right "JOIN THE MOVEMENT. #OWNYOURPOWER". Composition should feel like a contemporary empowerment campaign, blending sports fashion editorial photography with protest-style brush typography, minimal palette of white, black, and gray, crisp studio lighting, premium ad layout, vertical poster format.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高端全球运动服饰宣传海报，背景为简洁的浅灰色摄影棚背景，前景为一名蹲姿的全身女性运动员，采用时尚广告摄影风格。她是一位年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 及肩微乱短发，身穿修身白色短袖运动 T 恤，胸前印有黑色小美洲狮标志，下身穿着黑色紧身裤，腰间系着一件浅灰色卫衣，脚穿带有精致白色品牌标识的灰色跑鞋。她的姿势低沉有力，一膝抬起，一只手放在抬起的膝盖上，另一只手自然下垂，自信地面对镜头。在她的身后及周围，用大尺寸黑色手绘毛笔字填满构图的大部分空间，展现出极具表现力的行动主义风格。文字必须严格按照以下排版：上方为“WE ARE THE VOICE OF”，中间为巨大的核心词“STRENGTH”，下方依次为“UNITY”和“AND CHANGE”。在画面中右侧添加一个醒目的手写标签“#OWNYOURPOWER”。在右下角放置黑色 PUMA 跳跃美洲狮标志，上方为“PUMA”字标及口号“FOREVER. FASTER.”。在最底部添加 3 个小型页脚文本块：左侧为“PUMA.COM”，中间为“FOREVER. FASTER. TOGETHER. A GLOBAL MOVEMENT FOR EQUALITY, EMPOWERMENT AND CHANGE.”，右侧为“JOIN THE MOVEMENT. #OWNYOURPOWER”。整体构图应呈现出当代赋能宣传活动的质感，将运动时尚编辑摄影与抗议风格的毛笔字体相结合，采用白、黑、灰极简色调，配合清爽的摄影棚灯光，打造高端广告排版，呈现竖版海报效果。

templates.title: False-Color Garden Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 假色花园肖像

templates.prompt: A surreal medium-format portrait of a woman standing on a narrow garden path surrounded by extremely dense foliage, photographed in a dreamlike false-color film look. She wears a plain bright saturated {argument name="shirt color" default="red"} crew-neck T-shirt and dark black fitted pants, with shoulder-length dark hair that is slightly tousled and parted off-center. Her pose is relaxed and natural, arms hanging loosely at her sides, body facing the camera with a subtle turn, framed from about mid-thigh upward. The setting is an overgrown botanical garden packed with ferns, ivy, shrubs, and flowering plants on both sides of the path; all vegetation is dramatically color-shifted from green into vivid magenta, lavender, pink, and deep purple, creating an unnatural LomoChrome Purple XR aesthetic. Keep the subject's shirt intensely saturated and realistic against the transformed environment for strong visual contrast. Use soft overcast daylight, shallow to moderate depth of field, and medium format rendering with a {argument name="camera" default="Mamiya RB67"} feel, shot with a {argument name="lens" default="90mm lens"} at {argument name="aperture" default="f/5.6"}. Include organic film grain, slight edge halation, gentle vignette, soft bloom in highlights, and subtle vintage film border edges. Composition should be vertical in a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="6:7"} frame, with the subject centered slightly left of the path, foreground and background foliage softly blurred while remaining lush and detailed, producing an eerie, romantic, otherworldly portrait.

templates.title: Ink-Wash Warrior Riding a Tiger

titleLocalized.zh: 水墨骑虎武士

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink-wash fantasy painting on warm off-white rice paper, combining monumental calligraphy with a heroic figure scene. On the right side, a lone ancient warrior in ornate dark robes and layered black armor sits astride a large tiger on the edge of a jagged cliff, both shown in three-quarter back view facing left toward the open landscape. The warrior wears a flowing cape and long ribbon streamers whipping in the wind, and raises a straight sword vertically so that it becomes a brilliant pillar of golden-white light piercing upward into dense storm clouds. The tiger is powerfully built, realistic, alert, and richly detailed with bold stripes, white fur accents, and ceremonial cloth and tack with subtle gold ornament. The sky is filled with smoky gray ink clouds, softly blooming washes, and scattered gold flecks around the glowing sword beam. Below and to the left, a misty shanshui landscape opens into distant mountains, river water, tiny tree clusters, and layered atmospheric haze rendered in pale gray ink. On the left half of the composition, include 2 large vertical columns of expressive black brush-calligraphy in Chinese, bold and irregular, occupying most of the height; add 1 narrower vertical line of smaller calligraphy beside them and 4 red seal stamps total, with 2 small seals near the smaller inscription, 1 seal near the upper right edge, and 1 double-stacked red seal at the lower left. Emphasize high contrast between empty paper space and dark ink masses, literati painting aesthetics, sweeping brush energy, epic martial grandeur, and a subtle modern fantasy finish with restrained metallic gold highlights.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的竖构图中国水墨奇幻画作，绘制于暖米色宣纸上，将宏大的书法与英雄人物场景融为一体。画面右侧，一位身着华丽深色长袍与层叠黑色铠甲的古代孤勇武士骑在一只大老虎背上，立于嶙峋峭壁边缘，两者均以四分之三背面视角呈现，面向左侧的开阔景观。武士披着斗篷，长长的飘带在风中飞舞，他垂直举起一把直剑，剑身化作一道璀璨的金白色光柱，直冲入浓密的风暴云层中。老虎体格健硕、神态逼真且警觉，细节丰富，带有醒目的斑纹、白色毛发点缀，以及带有精致金色装饰的礼仪布饰与马具。天空中弥漫着烟灰色水墨云雾，晕染柔和，发光的剑束周围散布着金色斑点。左下方，朦胧的山水景观向远处的群山、河流、细小的树丛延伸，并以淡灰色水墨渲染出层叠的大气雾霭。在构图的左半部分，包含 2 列巨大的竖排表现力极强的黑色书法，笔触粗犷且不规则，占据了大部分高度；在旁边增加 1 列较窄的竖排小字书法，并总共添加 4 枚红色印章，其中 2 枚小印章靠近较小的题字，1 枚印章靠近右上边缘，1 枚双层红色印章位于左下角。强调留白与浓墨之间的强烈对比、文人画美学、挥洒的笔触气韵、史诗般的武侠气势，以及带有克制金属金高光的现代奇幻质感。

templates.title: Chinese Ink Warrior on Horseback

titleLocalized.zh: 水墨骑马武士

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink wash painting in monochrome black, charcoal, and soft gray on off-white rice paper, in the style of expressive shan shui brush art and heroic historical wuxia illustration. On the right side, a lone armored general sits upright on a dark warhorse atop a rocky cliff, viewed from behind and slightly in profile, looking out over a vast army below. The warrior wears layered black lamellar armor, a flowing windblown cloak, and a topknot with long trailing ribbons; he holds a straight sword angled downward beside the horse. The horse is muscular and glossy black, standing firmly near the cliff edge with its tail and mane subtly swept by the wind. Below and across the lower half of the scene, a dense battlefield mass of soldiers appears as misty silhouettes with upright spears and several battle flags, partially obscured by fog. In the distance, steep mountain peaks emerge through drifting mist on the upper right, with 7 small birds flying across the pale sky near the center. On the left side, include 2 large vertical columns of bold black Chinese calligraphy in wild cursive brush strokes: the main quote reading “一身转战三千里，一剑曾当百万师”, with a smaller vertical signature “王维” below, plus a small red seal stamp. Emphasize strong negative space, textured ink bleeding, splattered brush edges, atmospheric haze, epic solitude, martial grandeur, and a solemn, contemplative mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的竖构图中国水墨画，采用单色黑、炭灰和柔和的灰色调，绘制于米白色宣纸之上，呈现出写意山水笔触与英雄史诗武侠插画的风格。画面右侧，一位身披盔甲的将军骑着战马伫立在岩石悬崖之上，背影略带侧面，正俯瞰着下方广阔的军队。武士身着层叠的黑色札甲，披风在风中飘动，发髻上系着长长的飘带；他手持一把直剑，剑身斜指马侧。战马肌肉发达，通体漆黑，稳稳地立于悬崖边缘，马尾和鬃毛在风中微微拂动。画面下半部分，密集的士兵方阵呈现为朦胧的剪影，长矛林立，战旗飘扬，在雾气中若隐若现。远方，陡峭的山峰在右上角的云雾中隐现，画面中央苍白的天空中飞过 7 只小鸟。画面左侧包含两列巨大的黑色狂草书法：主文为“一身转战三千里，一剑曾当百万师”，下方配有较小的竖排签名“王维”，以及一枚红色印章。强调强烈的留白、水墨晕染的纹理、飞白笔触、大气朦胧感、史诗般的孤独感、武侠的宏大气势以及庄重深沉的意境。

templates.title: Chinese Ink Swordsman and Calligraphy

titleLocalized.zh: 中国水墨剑客与书法

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical Chinese ink-wash painting on aged rice paper, minimalist monochrome with soft warm parchment tones, showing a lone ancient swordsman standing on the edge of a steep dark cliff at the right side of the composition, seen mostly from behind in three-quarter back view. He wears flowing historical robes and a long wind-whipped cloak, with long dark hair tied in a topknot and loose strands streaming sideways in the wind, and he holds a straight sword lowered in his right hand. Below and to the left stretches a vast misty landscape with 1 distant walled frontier city, faint watchtowers and rooftops, a winding river or plain, and layered mountain silhouettes fading into haze. Use expressive black brushwork, splattered ink textures, dry-brush edges, atmospheric empty space, and a powerful contrast between the dense dark figure and cliff and the pale open background. Add 2 large vertical columns of bold black calligraphy on the left half, reading “愿将腰下剑” and “直为斩楼兰。”, plus 1 smaller vertical inscription to the far left reading “塞下曲六首 李白”, and include 2 small red seal stamps, one near the small inscription and one near the upper right corner. The mood is heroic, lonely, contemplative, and defiant, like a Tang-dynasty poet-warrior poster rendered as traditional sumi-e.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖构图中国水墨画，绘制于陈旧的宣纸之上，采用极简的单色风格，带有柔和温暖的羊皮纸色调。画面右侧，一位古代剑客孤身伫立在陡峭的深色悬崖边缘，以四分之三背影为主。他身着飘逸的古装，长长的披风在风中飞舞，束着发髻的长发在风中向侧面飘散，右手垂持一把长剑。左下方延伸出广阔的迷雾景观，可见 1 座遥远的边塞城池、隐约的烽火台与屋顶、蜿蜒的河流或平原，以及层叠隐入烟霭的山峦剪影。运用富有表现力的黑色笔触、泼墨纹理、枯笔边缘、空灵的留白，以及浓重的深色人物与悬崖同苍白开阔背景之间的强烈对比。在左半部分添加 2 列醒目的大字黑色书法，内容为“愿将腰下剑”和“直为斩楼兰。”，并在最左侧添加 1 列较小的竖排题款，内容为“塞下曲六首 李白”，同时包含 2 枚红色印章，一枚靠近小字题款，另一枚靠近右上角。整体意境英雄气概十足，孤独、沉思且充满傲骨，如同将唐代诗人兼战士的形象以传统水墨画风格呈现的海报。

templates.title: Chinese Ink Painting with Calligraphy

titleLocalized.zh: 中国水墨画与书法

templates.prompt: A vertical traditional Chinese ink-wash painting on aged off-white rice paper, minimalist monochrome palette with soft gray washes and deep black brushwork. The composition combines large expressive Chinese calligraphy on the left and center with a misty shanshui landscape on the right. Write the quote in bold hand-brushed characters: “照人如照水，切玉如切泥。” arranged in 2 vertical columns, with 4 large characters in the left column and 4 large characters plus punctuation in the center-right column, each character painted with energetic dry-brush and wet-brush variation, visible tapering strokes, splashes, and ink texture. Add 2 red seal stamps: one small oval seal near the upper left beside the calligraphy, and one square seal near the lower left corner. On the right half, paint towering craggy cliffs with sparse pine trees, drifting fog, and 2 thin waterfalls descending into a calm river. In the lower right foreground, show 2 ancient Chinese scholars in flowing hanfu robes and topknots, seated across a flat stone table on river rocks, leaning over a board game or manuscript in quiet discussion; their forms should be small relative to the landscape. Include still water reflections, distant low islets, and layered atmospheric mist. Overall feeling: contemplative, literati painting, poetic solitude, elegant scholarly mood, Song-dynasty-inspired ink illustration with masterful calligraphy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅竖构图的传统中国水墨画，绘制于陈旧的灰白色宣纸上，采用极简的单色调，结合柔和的灰色渲染与深邃的黑色笔触。构图将左侧和中央大幅奔放的中国书法与右侧烟雾缭绕的山水景观相结合。以粗犷的笔触书写引文：“照人如照水，切玉如切泥。” 排列为 2 列竖行，左列 4 个大字，右侧中央 4 个大字加标点，每个字均以干湿浓淡变化的笔触书写，可见明显的笔锋收尖、墨点与墨迹质感。添加 2 枚红色印章：一枚小椭圆形印章位于左上角书法旁，一枚方形印章位于左下角。右半部分绘制高耸嶙峋的悬崖，点缀稀疏的松树、漂浮的云雾，以及 2 条细长的瀑布汇入平静的河流。右下角前景处，描绘 2 位身着飘逸汉服、梳着发髻的中国古代文人，坐在河边岩石上的平坦石桌旁，俯身对着一个“项目”或手稿进行安静的探讨；他们的人物比例相对于山水景观应较小。包含静水倒影、远处的低矮小岛以及层叠的氛围感云雾。整体意境：沉思、文人画、诗意孤独、优雅的学者氛围，受宋代风格启发的水墨插画，配以精湛的书法。

templates.title: Old Shanghai Fusion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 老上海融合风格海报

templates.prompt: A vertical cultural travel poster on warm off-white textured paper, designed like a handcrafted 3D shadow-box collage that forms the silhouette of the Chinese character for Shanghai. Use a refined old-meets-new Shanghai theme with miniature architecture, street scenes, props, food, and typography, photographed straight-on with soft studio lighting and delicate drop shadows. The composition should feel elegant, editorial, nostalgic, and premium, with muted cream, brass gold, teal green, brick red, jade, and weathered wood tones. At the upper left, build the top section of the character from 1 modern glass skyscraper, 1 tall historic high-rise with a golden crown, 1 domed neoclassical waterfront building, 1 clock-tower civic building, 2 smaller background towers, 2 red vintage Shanghai trams, and 1 rickshaw. Beneath that, create a canal-town section with 2 tall red Oriental Pearl Tower spheres-and-columns motifs, 2 qipao dresses displayed vertically, 4 old shikumen and lane houses, 1 curved waterfront canal, 4 wooden boats on the water, and 2 gramophones placed at the far left and right edges. Across the center, place a large diagonal metallic-gold embossed title reading {argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"} in bold retro 3D lettering. To the right of the upper composition, add hand-lettered vintage script text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}. On the lower left, add serif text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}. The lower half should form the rest of the character using traditional Chinese architectural miniatures and market objects: 1 large classical Chinese roofed building complex, 4 vertical neon-style shop signs with Chinese characters, 2 square decorative plaques, 1 small green ceramic ewer, 2 shallow food trays, 1 rectangular tray of 6 soup dumplings, 1 long tray with 3 white tanghulu-like skewered sweets, 2 round mooncakes, and 1 small sauce dish, 1 rectangular display shelf containing 4 steamed buns, 1 bowl of noodles, 2 golden pastries, 1 plate of white flower-shaped sweets, 1 small doll figurine, and 2 painted opera masks, plus 2 hanging newspapers at the lower right. Keep the background spacious and minimal, with the collage and text arranged diagonally for a sophisticated poster layout. Make the whole image look like a meticulously assembled handmade paper-and-wood diorama, combining Art Deco Shanghai glamour, Republican-era nostalgia, Jiangnan water-town charm, and traditional Chinese market culture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张印在暖色调米白色纹理纸上的竖版文化旅游海报，设计灵感源自手工 3D 剪影盒拼贴画，拼凑出“上海”的汉字轮廓。采用精致的“新旧交融”上海主题，融入微缩建筑、街景、道具、美食和字体，以正面视角拍摄，配以柔和的摄影棚灯光和细腻的投影。整体构图优雅、具有杂志编辑感、怀旧且高级，色调采用柔和的奶油色、黄铜金、青绿色、砖红色、玉色和风化木色。在左上方，用 1 座现代玻璃摩天大楼、1 座带有金色皇冠的高大历史建筑、1 座圆顶新古典主义滨水建筑、1 座钟楼市政建筑、2 座背景小塔、2 辆红色复古上海电车和 1 辆黄包车构建出汉字的上半部分。在其下方，打造一个江南水乡区域，包含 2 个高大的红色东方明珠塔球体与立柱元素、2 件垂直展示的旗袍、4 栋老式石库门和里弄住宅、1 条弯曲的滨水运河、4 艘水上木船，并在最左侧和最右侧各放置 1 台留声机。在画面中心，放置一个巨大的对角线金属质感浮雕标题，以粗体复古 3D 字体显示 {argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"}。在上部构图右侧，添加手写风格的复古文字 {argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}。在左下方，添加衬线字体文字 {argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}。下半部分使用传统中式建筑微缩模型和市井物件拼凑出汉字的剩余部分：1 组大型古典中式屋顶建筑群、4 个带有中文字符的垂直霓虹灯风格店招、2 块方形装饰牌匾、1 个绿色小瓷执壶、2 个浅食盘、1 个长方形托盘（内含 6 个小笼包）、1 个长托盘（内含 3 串白色糖葫芦状甜点）、2 个圆形月饼、1 个小酱料碟、1 个长方形展示架（内含 4 个馒头）、1 碗面条、2 个金色糕点、1 盘白色花朵形状的甜点、1 个小人偶、2 个京剧脸谱，以及右下角悬挂的 2 份报纸。背景保持宽敞简洁，拼贴画和文字呈对角线排列，呈现出精致的海报布局。整张图像看起来像是一个精心组装的手工纸木立体模型，融合了装饰艺术风格的上海魅力、民国时期的怀旧感、江南水乡的韵味以及传统中国市井文化。

templates.title: Beijing Cultural Heritage Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 北京文化遗产海报

templates.prompt: A refined vertical cultural exhibition poster on a warm ivory textured paper background, designed with abundant negative space and an elegant museum-catalog aesthetic. The centerpiece is one monumental piece of Chinese calligraphy formed as sculptural 3D architectural typography, reading {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"} as two large interconnected characters built entirely from miniature Beijing heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes are constructed like carved lacquer and wood architectural fragments in rich vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory, with exquisite relief detail, soft shadows, and a handcrafted collectible feel. Across the calligraphy, integrate iconic Beijing imagery: palace roofs with glazed tiles, temple pavilions, stairways, carved balustrades, watchtowers, a winding section of the Great Wall, ornamental clouds, guardian lion sculptures, small old trees, golden ginkgo branches and leaves, hanging red lanterns, a Beijing opera mask, a skewer of glossy candied hawthorn, the Temple of Heaven, and a plated roast duck tucked into one lower stroke. Make the composition feel like a cultural miniature world embedded inside each brushstroke, with realistic depth, crisp surface detail, and subtle museum lighting from the upper left. Add sparse typography around the main artwork in a sophisticated editorial layout: at upper left, a tiny emblem and the words "BEIJING CHINA", beneath it "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small thin serif capitals; at upper right, a vertical Chinese title reading "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗" with several smaller vertical lines of Chinese copy and a red seal stamp; at lower left, large elegant serif text reading {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} and beneath it {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}, followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER", "NO.2024-001", and tiny heritage-themed footer copy; at lower right, tiny small-cap text reading {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} and "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". Keep the overall style luxurious, poetic, highly detailed, and premium, blending Chinese traditional culture, architectural miniature art, and contemporary poster design.

templates.title: Blue Fantasy Knight Character

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fantasy character design of a young adult male knight-adventurer standing front-facing in a neutral pose on a transparent background with a visible gray checkerboard transparency pattern. He has tousled medium-short {argument name="hair color" default="warm brown"} hair with layered, slightly spiky strands and a refined heroic build. His face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur block centered over the face area. He wears an elaborate royal-blue and dark leather outfit with silver armor and gold filigree trim: 1 long asymmetrical blue cape draped over both shoulders and flowing down both sides, 1 high-collared blue tunic with fitted black-brown leather torso panels, 2 crossed chest straps with buckles, 1 wide layered belt system around the waist, 1 leather side pouch hanging at the left hip, 1 set of silver pauldrons and arm guards, 2 armored gauntlets, 1 split blue tabard skirt with gold edging over dark trousers, 2 silver knee guards, and 2 tall brown armored boots with metallic toe caps and blue gem-like accents. Add intricate fantasy ornamentation throughout, including gold embroidery on the cape and tunic, engraved silver armor details, multiple buckles and straps, and a sunburst-like brooch clasp at the right shoulder. A decorative sword in a blue scabbard hangs at his right hip, with an ornate gold-and-silver hilt visible. The illustration should be clean, highly detailed, polished game character concept art in a refined JRPG style, centered composition, full figure visible from head to toe, crisp linework, soft painterly shading, elegant fantasy aesthetic, no scenery, isolated character cutout.

templates.prompt: A cinematic wide shot of a lone astronaut standing on a rocky ledge and facing away from the camera, looking out across an immense red desert plain on a Mars-like planet. The astronaut is centered in the lower middle of the frame, wearing a realistic white EVA spacesuit with subtle gray panels, a life-support backpack, heavy boots, and dark gloves; the helmet is not visible from the front because the figure is seen from behind. The landscape is vast and barren, covered in rust-red dust, scattered stones, and low rock formations, with a rugged cliff edge on the left foreground, sparse rocky mounds across the middle distance, and hazy mountain ranges stretching along the far horizon. Use soft warm peach and terracotta tones, thin atmospheric haze, and gentle late-afternoon light that casts a long shadow behind the astronaut’s feet. The mood is solitary, awe-filled, and exploratory, like the opening frame of a sci-fi film about first contact with an alien world. templates.prompt: A high-end surreal sports advertising poster in a 3:4 vertical composition featuring an athletic woman frozen mid-jump against a deep moody charcoal-to-violet gradient background. She is centered slightly to the right, with her body stretched dynamically as if sprinting through the air, left arm extended back, right arm bent forward, one leg kicked forward and the other trailing behind. She has {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair in a messy bun with loose wisps, and wears an off-white oversized Nike crewneck sweatshirt, loose violet-gray marbled athletic pants, and clean white Nike sneakers with a subtle violet glow along the soles. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur block, creating an anonymous editorial fashion look. Behind and around her, dramatic electric violet smoke and energy clouds erupt and swirl, wrapping around her torso, legs, and feet, with luminous vapor trails and a storm-like aura that intensifies the motion. Place 1 white Nike swoosh logo in the top-left corner. Integrate 3 huge metallic silver 3D words across the lower middle of the poster reading {argument name="slogan text" default="JUST DO IT"}, split into the visible word blocks “JUST”, “DO”, and “IT”, partially overlapping the athlete’s body and cutting across the composition like bold campaign typography. The overall look is glossy, cinematic, premium, and energetic, with dramatic rim lighting, strong contrast, soft atmospheric haze, fashion-ad realism, and a viral AI-generated sports campaign aesthetic for {argument name="brand name" default="Nike"}.

templates.prompt: A highly detailed layered papercut diorama illustration of a deer family standing on a narrow forest path in deep winter. Show exactly 4 deer facing forward: 1 large stag with tall branching antlers positioned slightly right of center, 1 adult doe on the left, 1 smaller young deer in the middle foreground, and 1 young deer on the right. The scene is built entirely in intricate cut-paper craft style with stacked paper layers, crisp cut edges, sculpted contours, and soft dimensional shadows between layers. The animals are made from warm brown, chestnut, tan, and cream paper with delicately layered chest fur, white muzzles, alert ears, and small patches of snow resting on their heads, backs, and shoulders. Surround them with a dense winter forest of tall bare trees and fir trees, all rendered in layered paper silhouettes. Snow heavily coats the branches, bushes, rocks, and ground. Compose the trees as an enclosing corridor that frames the deer symmetrically, with the snowy path leading from the foreground into the group. Use a restrained cold palette for the environment: white, off-white, pale gray, slate gray, and charcoal, contrasted by the warm brown deer. Add subtle depth haze in the distant trees, clean studio-like lighting, and a calm storybook atmosphere. Ultra-detailed craftsmanship, elegant winter scene, realistic paper texture, refined 3D paper sculpture look, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节极其丰富的层叠剪纸立体透视插画，描绘了一家四口麋鹿站在深冬狭窄的林间小径上。画面中需精确呈现 4 只麋鹿正面向前：1 只体型高大、鹿角分叉的雄鹿位于画面中心偏右位置，1 只成年雌鹿位于左侧，1 只较小的幼鹿位于前景中央，另有 1 只幼鹿位于右侧。整个场景完全采用精致的剪纸工艺风格构建，通过堆叠的纸层、利落的切割边缘、雕塑般的轮廓以及层与层之间柔和的立体阴影呈现。动物由暖棕色、栗色、棕褐色和奶油色的纸张制成，细致地分层表现出胸部皮毛、白色的口鼻部、警觉的耳朵，以及落在它们头部、背部和肩部的点点积雪。周围环绕着茂密的冬日森林，高大的光秃树木和冷杉均以层叠的纸质剪影呈现。树枝、灌木、岩石和地面覆盖着厚厚的积雪。树木构成了环绕式的走廊，对称地框住麋鹿，雪路从前景延伸至鹿群。环境采用克制的冷色调：白色、灰白色、浅灰色、板岩灰和炭灰色，与暖棕色的麋鹿形成对比。远处的树木带有微妙的深度雾感，光线如同摄影棚般干净，营造出宁静的绘本氛围。超精细的工艺，优雅的冬日场景，逼真的纸张质感，精致的 3D 纸雕外观，竖向构图。

templates.title: Minimalist Literary Cover for The Vegetarian

titleLocalized.zh: 《素食者》极简文学风封面

templates.prompt: A minimalist literary book cover for {argument name="book title" default="素食者"}, designed in an elegant East Asian art-book style with muted dark forest green and warm off-white as the only main colors. The composition is vertical and highly refined, with a split layout: the left two-thirds are textured off-white paper, while the right third is a deep green field divided by a rough organic torn-paper edge running vertically from top to bottom. On the lower center-right, place a grayscale side-profile portrait of an East Asian woman facing right, her head slightly tilted upward, eyes closed or nearly closed, with black hair tied in a low bun. Her figure should feel quiet, fragile, and contemplative. The upper part of her head is visually replaced by a torn white paper shape that merges into the page, creating a surreal collage effect. From inside the opening around her head and neck, thin wild plant stems with tiny leaves and buds grow upward diagonally, as if vegetation is emerging from her body. Add subtle paper grain, print texture, and soft tonal fading for a poetic, fine-press look. Set the main Chinese title vertically in very large dark green serif-style characters on the far left: {argument name="title text" default="素食者"}. Near the upper middle-left, add vertically arranged author and translator credits in Chinese, small and elegant: "[韩] 韩江 著" and "胡椒筒｜译". In the upper right on the dark green area, add small Korean and English text in a delicate serif font: {argument name="korean title" default="채식주의자"}, "The Vegetarian", and {argument name="author name" default="Han Kang"}. On the mid-to-lower right, add a short vertical Chinese quote in small type: {argument name="quote" default="我的身体里 有一片荒芜的森林 它枯萎了 我不想吃的东西"}. At the bottom right, place the publisher and year in small Chinese text: "四川文艺出版社" and "2022". Include one small solid dark green dot on the left side below the title as a graphic accent. The overall mood is restrained, melancholic, intelligent, and literary, like an award-winning modern novel cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款极简文学书籍封面，适用于 {argument name="book title" default="素食者"}，采用优雅的东亚艺术画册风格，以柔和的深森林绿与暖米白色为主色调。构图呈垂直布局且极具质感：左侧三分之二为纹理米色纸张，右侧三分之一为深绿色区域，两者由一条从上至下贯穿的粗糙有机撕纸边缘分割。在右下方中心位置，放置一张东亚女性的灰度侧脸肖像，面朝右侧，头部微微上扬，双眼闭合或半闭，黑色长发扎成低发髻。人物形象应显得宁静、脆弱且富有沉思感。她头部的上方与撕裂的白色纸张形状融合，营造出超现实的拼贴效果。从她头部和颈部周围的裂口处，细长的野生植物茎秆带着微小的叶片和花蕾斜向生长，仿佛植物正从她体内萌发。添加细腻的纸张纹理、印刷质感及柔和的色调渐变，呈现出诗意的精品印刷感。在最左侧垂直排版超大号深绿色衬线体中文主标题：{argument name="title text" default="素食者"}。在左侧中上方，垂直排列小巧优雅的作者与译者信息：“[韩] 韩江 著”和“胡椒筒｜译”。在右上方深绿色区域，用精致的衬线字体添加韩文与英文文本：{argument name="korean title" default="채식주의자"}、“The Vegetarian”以及 {argument name="author name" default="Han Kang"}。在右侧中下方，添加一段垂直排版的小字中文引文：{argument name="quote" default="我的身体里 有一片荒芜的森林 它枯萎了 我不想吃的东西"}。在右下角，放置小号中文出版社及年份信息：“四川文艺出版社”和“2022”。在左侧标题下方添加一个小的实心深绿色圆点作为图形点缀。整体氛围克制、忧郁、知性且具有文学气息，宛如获奖现代小说的封面。

templates.title: Minimalist Literary Cover for Educated

titleLocalized.zh: 《Educated》极简文学风封面

templates.prompt: Design a literary Chinese book cover in a refined minimalist collage style on warm off-white textured paper with subtle grain and faint aging. The composition is tall and elegant, with one dominant central-right vertical Chinese title in large distressed black calligraphy-style characters reading “你当像鸟飞往你的山”, arranged in 2 vertical columns, with the right column reading “你当像鸟” and the left column reading “飞往你的山”. A delicate indigo-blue bird flies near the top center, and a thin winding blue dotted flight path snakes diagonally down across the title and toward the lower right, creating a sense of ascent and freedom. In the lower left, place a large triangular mountain form like a torn paper collage or painted wedge, its peak white and snowy, fading into deep ultramarine and navy textures below. Integrate a faint vertical strip of tiny English book text along the mountain’s right edge, as if the mountain is partially constructed from printed pages. Inside the blue mountain, set the original English title in serif type: “Educated” on one line and “A Memoir” below it, in white. On the upper left, add a short vertical block of small Chinese quote text in black, arranged as 6 lines, with a long dash below, then the author name “Tara Westover” in muted blue serif on 2 lines, followed by another dash. Along the lower right edge, add slim vertical credits in small type: Chinese text for the author followed by the English name “Tara Westover” in blue, then translator and publisher lines beneath in black. Keep the layout spacious with strong negative space, asymmetrical balance, and a poetic contemporary publishing aesthetic. Use only 3 main colors: black, off-white, and indigo blue. The overall feeling should be intellectual, restrained, modern, and award-winning, suitable for a premium edition of {argument name="book title" default="Educated"} by {argument name="author name" default="Tara Westover"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 设计一款精致的极简拼贴风格中文文学书籍封面，背景为带有细微颗粒感和淡淡陈旧感的暖白色纹理纸张。构图高挑优雅，右侧居中位置设有一个醒目的竖排中文标题，采用做旧的黑色书法字体，内容为“你当像鸟飞往你的山”，分为两列排版，右列为“你当像鸟”，左列为“飞往你的山”。顶部中央附近有一只精致的靛蓝色飞鸟，一条纤细的蓝色虚线飞行轨迹呈对角线向下延伸，穿过标题并指向右下方，营造出一种升腾与自由的意境。左下方放置一个巨大的三角形山峦形状，如同撕纸拼贴或楔形绘画，山峰呈白色积雪状，向下渐变为深群青色和海军蓝纹理。在山峦右侧边缘融入一条淡淡的竖排英文书籍正文，仿佛山峦是由印刷书页拼凑而成。在蓝色山峦内部，以白色衬线字体排版原始英文标题：第一行“Educated”，下方为“A Memoir”。左上方添加一小块竖排黑色中文引文，排成 6 行，下方加一条长破折号，接着是两行柔和蓝色衬线字体的作者名“Tara Westover”，随后再加一条破折号。右下边缘添加细长的竖排版权信息，包括作者的中文名，后跟蓝色的英文名“Tara Westover”，下方为黑色的译者和出版社信息。保持布局宽敞，利用强烈的留白、不对称平衡感，呈现出诗意的当代出版美学。仅使用 3 种主色：黑色、米白色和靛蓝色。整体氛围应体现出知识分子气息、克制、现代且具有获奖作品的质感，适用于由 {argument name="author name" default="Tara Westover"} 创作的 {argument name="book title" default="Educated"} 高端版本。

templates.title: Minimalist Literary Novel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 极简主义文学小说封面

templates.prompt: A literary book cover in a refined minimalist editorial style, vertically oriented, with a muted palette of deep black, dark green, sepia, and warm cream. The composition is divided by large flowing curtain-like abstract shapes that create dramatic negative space and diagonal wedges of light. On the right side, show an elderly butler-like man seen from behind, standing upright in a formal black tailcoat or tuxedo jacket, white shirt cuffs visible, hands clasped behind his back, facing a tall softly glowing window with sheer curtains. His posture is reserved, dignified, and solitary. On the lower portion, within a triangular beam of light, place a dim still life on a table: exactly 3 objects, a wine glass, a teapot, and a plate, all partially obscured in shadow. The left side should carry elegant vertical Chinese title typography reading {argument name="title text" default="长日将尽"}, set large in pale gold serif-like characters. Beneath it, include smaller Chinese author and translator lines, and a short Chinese quote in small text. Near the lower left, add small English text reading {argument name="english title" default="The Remains of the Day"} and {argument name="author name" default="Kazuo Ishiguro"}, plus a small publisher line and the year {argument name="year" default="2024"}. The image should feel like an award-winning contemporary literary fiction cover: quiet, melancholic, restrained, cinematic, with paper grain texture, soft vignette, subtle painterly shading, and highly intentional asymmetrical layout. Keep the typography integrated into the design, with generous negative space and no bright colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用精致极简编辑风格的文学书籍封面，纵向构图，采用深黑、深绿、棕褐色和暖奶油色的柔和色调。画面由大面积流动的窗帘状抽象形状分割，营造出富有戏剧性的留白和对角线光束。在右侧，展示一位背对观众的老管家形象，他身着正式的黑色燕尾服或礼服外套，露出白色衬衫袖口，双手交叠于背后，面向一扇带有薄纱窗帘、散发柔和光芒的高大窗户。他的姿态矜持、庄重且孤独。在下方的三角光束中，放置一组昏暗的静物：桌上摆放着 3 件物品，分别为酒杯、茶壶和盘子，均部分隐没在阴影中。左侧应呈现优雅的竖排中文标题，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="长日将尽"}，采用大型淡金色衬线字体。下方包含较小的中文作者和译者行，以及一段小字体的中文引语。在左下角附近，添加小型英文文本 {argument name="english title" default="The Remains of the Day"} 和 {argument name="author name" default="Kazuo Ishiguro"}，以及一行小型出版商信息和年份 {argument name="year" default="2024"}。图像应呈现出屡获殊荣的当代文学小说封面质感：安静、忧郁、克制、具有电影感，带有纸张纹理、柔和的暗角、细腻的绘画感阴影以及极具意图的非对称布局。保持排版与设计融为一体，留白充裕，且不使用鲜艳色彩。

一款极简主义文学书籍封面，采用精致的东亚编辑风格，竖构图，背景为温暖的米白色纸张，带有细腻的颗粒印刷质感。画面垂直分割为 2 个大型抽象区域：左上半部分为粗糙的灰色撕纸形状，左下角为深黑色的色块。从黑色区域中浮现出 1 个醒目的白色戏剧面具轮廓，仅留 1 条黑色眼缝，大比例裁剪并向上倾斜，暗示着疏离感与隐藏的身份。在灰色与白色区域交汇的底部中心，放置 1 个身着深色长外套的微小孤独人影，站在狭窄的三角形边缘上，面朝前方，强调孤独与脆弱感。从顶部中心附近，垂下 1 根带有轻微波浪感的细红线，在中间位置连接 1 个柔和的红色圆形印章状圆盘，与下方的人影对齐。在右侧中心设置 1 个醒目的黑色粗体竖排中文书法标题：{argument name="title text" default="人间失格"}。旁边添加 1 行竖排的日文读音：“にんげんしっかく”。在最右侧边缘，添加 1 行竖排的黑色细体引文：“—— 我的不幸，恰恰在于我缺乏拒绝的能力 ——”。在左上角，添加 1 行小号黑色字体的竖排作者与译者信息：“【日】太宰治｜著　杨伟｜译”。下方添加 1 句简短的两行中文：“生而为人

templates.title: Icy Fantasy Anime Woman in Blossom Snow

titleLocalized.zh: 冰雪幻境中的动漫女子与樱花

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime fantasy illustration of a tall elegant woman resembling an ice sorceress or qilin-inspired warrior, shown in a full-body three-quarter back view with her head turned slightly away, standing in a luminous snowy mountain landscape filled with soft pink cherry blossoms. She has {argument name="hair color" default="very light icy blue"} hair, extremely long, thick, and flowing in the wind with layered strands, soft bangs, curled tips, and a loose ahoge on top. Two dark curved horn-like ornaments with subtle red patterning rise from either side of her head. Her face is obscured by a flat rectangular blur block in a pale lavender-gray tone. She wears an ornate fantasy bodysuit and dress in black, white, periwinkle, and sapphire blue with gold filigree armor details: a black fitted chest piece, detached translucent bell sleeves with blue crystal-like feather cuffs, a backless white-and-blue upper garment, intricate gold waist armor with a glowing blue gemstone centerpiece, sheer black tights with gold geometric accents, layered translucent blue fabric panels, and exactly 3 visible red tassel ornaments hanging from the waist and side sashes. Her right arm is extended with an open gloved hand, levitating a glowing translucent blue water sphere containing swirling yin-yang-like currents. Around her are curling arcs of water and icy energy ribbons. The background is a dreamy ethereal alpine scene with 1 distant pagoda-like tower on the right, misty snow-covered peaks, frosted trees, sparkling atmosphere, drifting petals, and pastel blossom clusters framing the foreground and upper left corner. Use soft radiant backlighting, iridescent highlights, polished anime rendering, delicate gradients, crisp decorative costume detail, magical fantasy mood, cool blue and lavender palette with pink accents, vertical composition, no text, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅高度精细的动漫奇幻插画，描绘了一位高挑优雅的女性，宛如冰雪法师或麒麟灵感的战士。画面采用全身四分之三背影视角，她头部微微偏转，伫立在充满柔和粉色樱花的明亮雪山景观中。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极浅的冰蓝色"} 头发，发丝极长且浓密，随风飘逸，层次分明，带有柔和的刘海、卷曲的发梢以及头顶一撮俏皮的呆毛。头部两侧耸立着两个带有细微红色纹饰的深色弯曲角状装饰。她的面部被一块淡薰衣草灰色的扁平矩形模糊块遮挡。她身着华丽的奇幻紧身衣和礼服，配色包含黑色、白色、长春花色和蓝宝石色，并饰有金色花丝盔甲细节：黑色贴身胸甲、分离式半透明钟形袖、带有蓝色水晶羽毛袖口、露背的白蓝上衣、带有发光蓝色宝石核心的精致金色腰甲、带有金色几何装饰的透明黑色连裤袜、层叠的半透明蓝色布料，以及腰部和侧面腰带上悬挂的 3 个清晰可见的红色流苏装饰。她的右臂伸展，手戴手套，掌心悬浮着一个发光的半透明蓝色水球，内部有类似阴阳流动的漩涡。她周围环绕着卷曲的水流弧线和冰冷的能量丝带。背景是梦幻般的空灵高山场景，右侧有一座遥远的塔楼，云雾缭绕的雪峰、挂霜的树木、闪烁的氛围、飘落的花瓣，以及点缀在前景和左上角的淡粉色花簇。采用柔和的背光、虹彩高光、精致的动漫渲染、细腻的渐变、清晰的装饰性服装细节、魔法奇幻氛围、冷蓝色与薰衣草色调搭配粉色点缀，竖向构图，无文字，无额外角色。

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime fantasy portrait of {argument name="character name" default="an elegant blue-haired fantasy woman"}, shown from the back in a three-quarter pose, turning her head over her shoulder to look at the viewer with calm violet eyes and a soft, slightly distant expression. She has very long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="icy pastel blue"} hair with layered wispy bangs, loose windblown strands, one small ahoge on top, and 1 dark curved horn with subtle crimson striping emerging from the left side of her head. Her outfit is a refined, backless fantasy gown with 4 visible main pieces: a dark fitted bodice, a white open-backed outer layer with ornate gold trim and pale embroidered patterns, 2 long detached sleeves that fade into translucent blue-violet pointed cuffs, and red-blue ribbon ornaments tied at the neck and waist. Add delicate jewel-like tassel details at the upper back and trailing ribbon ends drifting in the air. The scene is backlit by soft spring sunlight in a pale stone pavilion or arched balcony, with 1 large arch opening behind her and clusters of {argument name="flower type" default="pink cherry blossoms"} glowing in the top right background. Include a few drifting petals, luminous haze, subtle sparkles, and a dreamy pastel atmosphere. Composition is vertical, upper-thigh portrait, character centered slightly right, hair sweeping broadly across the left side of the frame. Render in a polished ethereal anime illustration style with soft bloom, translucent fabrics, glossy eyes, delicate linework, cool lavender and blue tones, gentle rim light, painterly background blur, and an emphasis on smooth elegant surfaces, clean fabric flow, and minimal wrinkling.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅高度精细的动漫奇幻肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的蓝发奇幻女性"}，以四分之三背影姿态呈现，回眸看向观众，拥有平静的紫罗兰色双眸，表情柔和且略带疏离感。她留着极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="冰感淡蓝色"} 秀发，带有层次感的轻盈刘海，发丝随风飘动，头顶有一根小呆毛，左侧头部生有一只带有深色弯曲纹理及细微深红色条纹的角。她身着精致的露背奇幻礼服，包含 4 个主要可见部分：一件深色修身胸衣，一件带有华丽金边和淡色刺绣图案的白色露背外层，2 只渐变为半透明蓝紫色尖头袖套，以及系在颈部和腰部的红蓝丝带装饰。背部上方添加精致的珠宝状流苏细节，丝带末端在空中飘荡。场景由柔和的春日阳光从背后照亮，背景为淡色石质凉亭或拱形阳台，后方有一个大型拱门，右上角背景处点缀着成簇的 {argument name="flower type" default="粉色樱花"}。画面包含几片飘落的花瓣、发光的薄雾、细微的闪光以及梦幻的柔和色调。构图为竖版，大腿以上肖像，角色略微居右，秀发在画面左侧大面积扫过。以精致的空灵动漫插画风格渲染，具备柔和的光晕、半透明织物、明亮的双眸、细腻的线条、冷薰衣草色与蓝色调、柔和的轮廓光、油画质感的背景虚化，并强调平滑优雅的表面、干净的织物褶皱感以及极少的衣物褶皱。

titleLocalized.zh: 等距视角科学概念立体模型网格

templates.prompt: A clean 2x2 conceptual entity model infographic on a soft light background, showing four separate floating isometric diorama tiles that personify branches of {argument name="theme" default="science"} in a polished 3D illustration style with pastel gradients, glossy materials, soft ambient lighting, subtle shadows, rounded futuristic forms, and high detail. Top left: BIOLOGY, a lush bio-lab island with a large central DNA double helix tower, curved glass greenhouse architecture, spiral stairways, layered organic pathways, greenery, plant beds, and fluid biomorphic structures; the word "BIOLOGY" is integrated on the front edge of the platform. Surrounding this tile are 4 small biology-related icons: a microscope, a DNA symbol, a sprouting plant, and a circular cell or petri-dish symbol. Top right: PHYSICS, a high-tech energy laboratory tile in cool blue tones with a central glowing platform, circular accelerator rings, copper-like electromagnetic coils, stairs leading up to the core, a monitor screen with waveform graphics, and a futuristic industrial base labeled "PHYSICS"; add 4 surrounding physics-themed icons: an atom, a horseshoe magnet, a lightning bolt, and a line graph waveform. Bottom left: CHEMISTRY, a modular molecular research structure in purple and silver, built from spheres-and-rods lattice frameworks, lab columns, beakers, flasks, and a glowing crystalline core; the platform prominently reads "CHEMISTRY" on two visible sides. Surrounding this tile are 4 chemistry-related icons: two molecular diagrams, a pair of lab test tubes or flasks, and a small burner. Bottom right: ASTRONOMY, a rocky lunar observatory island with cratered terrain, a dome observatory, a telescope, stairs carved into the rock, and a circular cosmic starfield backdrop behind it; the front edge reads "ASTRONOMY". Surrounding this tile are 4 astronomy-themed icons: a ringed planet, spark-like stars, a small rocket, and a crescent moon. Keep all 4 tiles evenly spaced in a quadrant layout, each with its own muted geometric backdrop shape, cohesive pastel palette tuned per discipline, and a premium gpt-image-2 style that makes each concept feel like a collectible miniature world. No people, no extra text beyond the four discipline labels.

promptLocalized.zh: 在柔和的浅色背景上呈现一个整洁的 2x2 概念实体模型信息图，展示四个独立的悬浮等距视角立体模型板块，以精美的 3D 插画风格体现 {argument name="theme" default="科学"} 的分支，采用柔和的渐变色、光泽材质、柔和的环境光、细腻的阴影、圆润的未来感造型以及高细节表现。左上角：生物学（BIOLOGY），一个郁郁葱葱的生物实验室岛屿，中心矗立着巨大的 DNA 双螺旋塔，配有弧形玻璃温室建筑、螺旋楼梯、层叠的有机路径、绿植、花坛和流体仿生结构；平台前缘整合了“BIOLOGY”字样。该板块周围环绕 4 个小型生物相关图标：显微镜、DNA 符号、发芽的植物以及圆形细胞或培养皿符号。右上角：物理学（PHYSICS），一个冷色调的高科技能源实验室板块，中心设有发光平台、圆形加速器环、类铜电磁线圈、通往核心的楼梯、带有波形图的显示屏，以及标有“PHYSICS”的未来工业底座；添加 4 个周围的物理主题图标：原子、马蹄形磁铁、闪电和折线波形图。左下角：化学（CHEMISTRY），一个由球棍晶格框架、实验室立柱、烧杯、烧瓶和发光晶体核心构成的紫色与银色模块化分子研究结构；平台两侧显著标有“CHEMISTRY”。该板块周围环绕 4 个化学相关图标：两个分子结构图、一对实验室试管或烧瓶，以及一个小燃烧器。右下角：天文学（ASTRONOMY），一个岩石质感的月球观测岛，拥有陨石坑地形、圆顶天文台、望远镜、刻在岩石上的楼梯，以及背后圆形的宇宙星空背景；前缘标有“ASTRONOMY”。该板块周围环绕 4 个天文主题图标：带环行星、闪烁的星星、小火箭和新月。保持 4 个板块在象限布局中均匀分布，每个板块都有各自柔和的几何背景形状，根据学科调整统一的柔和色调，并采用高级的 gpt-image-2 风格，使每个概念都如同一个可收藏的微型世界。画面中不包含人物，除四个学科标签外无额外文字。

titleLocalized.zh: 雷电将军海滩 Cosplay 封面

templates.prompt: Create a high-fashion magazine cover photo of a glamorous beach cosplay portrait inspired by Raiden Shogun from Genshin Impact. A single adult woman sits on a large dark seaside rock in a three-quarter front pose, one hand resting behind her on the rock and the other relaxed near her side, with one thigh raised prominently toward the camera. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur censor centered over the face. She has very long, rich violet-purple hair with magenta highlights, styled with a thick braid draped over one shoulder and loose windswept strands flowing to the right, decorated with blue flower hair ornaments and gold accessories near one side of the head. She wears an elegant lavender, lilac, and deep purple Raiden Shogun-style cosplay outfit: a low-cut kimono-inspired bodice, translucent flowing sleeves, layered sash and obi with ornate circular gold-and-purple emblem at the waist, a jeweled choker with a purple gem, dangling blue-and-gold earrings, a black armored-looking forearm piece, and sheer purple thigh-high stockings with garter straps and decorative patterns. The lighting is natural golden beach daylight with soft highlights on skin and fabric, shallow depth of field, and a luxurious editorial look. The background is a softly blurred shoreline with pale sand, shimmering water, sea mist, and a distant rocky island or cliff. Compose it as a full magazine cover with elegant fashion typography in dark royal purple. The masthead is huge across the top reading {argument name="magazine title" default="COSPLAY"}, with small top-left text "COSPLAY REALM MAGAZINE" and small top-right text "JANUARY 2024". Add left-side cover lines: "RAIDEN SHOGUN", "COSPLAY BY SAKURA", "BEHIND THE SCENES AT THE BEACH", and "EXCLUSIVE INTERVIEW" followed by smaller text "Sakura talks about her love for Genshin Impact". Add right-side cover lines: "GENSHIN IMPACT" with smaller text "SPECIAL EDITION", and at lower right "TOP COSER OF 2024" with smaller text "Sakura’s rise to stardom". Place a realistic barcode with small pricing text in the bottom-left corner. templates.prompt: A polished Japanese museum exhibition poster in a contemporary anime illustration style, vertical layout, warm ivory and gold color palette with pastel confetti accents, designed like a high-end promotional ad for a spring holiday event. The composition features 4 school-age to young adult female characters in the foreground and one monumental Buddhist statue in the background. At center back is a towering gilded Thousand-Armed Kannon statue with a radiant halo, intricate carved details, many arms fanning outward symmetrically, and hands pressed together in prayer at the chest, glowing with sacred golden light. In the foreground on the right is the largest figure, a friendly young woman guide or older student reaching one hand dramatically toward the viewer in forced perspective; she has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length hair, a blue striped blouse, a cream sweater draped over her shoulders, and a light skirt, with a warm inviting expression. Across the lower middle are 3 younger schoolgirls in matching uniforms: short-sleeve pale blue shirts with navy ribbon ties and dark blue skirts. The left girl points upward excitedly with one arm raised and wears a small shoulder bag; the center girl holds an exhibition booklet upright; the right girl drinks from a clear water bottle while looking toward the scene. Give all 4 girls lively anime-style faces, glossy hair, soft shading, and energetic museum-outing body language. Fill the poster with dense Japanese typography and decorative graphic shapes. Place a large bold main headline on the left reading {argument name="headline text" default="国宝を見に行こう!"}, with oversized gold and black calligraphy-style characters and one red-highlighted character. Above it, add smaller text: "千手観音、祈りの宇宙". Add a red circular callout near the top left that says "はじめての美術館にもおすすめ!" and a white cloud-shaped speech bubble near the top right that says "いっしょに新しい発見をしよう!". Add a gold ribbon banner under the main headline reading "アスキー美術館 GW開催". Include a pale blue circular information box on the left with 5 lines of Japanese copy describing the statue: "国宝 千手観音立像", "千の手が、千年の祈りを", "伝える", "圧巻のスケールを、", "その目で感じてみて。". In the lower left, place a dark rectangular exhibition plaque with gold trim and 5 text lines: "アスキー美術館 GW特別展", the large title "国宝展", then "千手観音、祈りの宇宙", then the date line {argument name="event dates" default="2026.4.26 SAT - 6.15 SUN"}. Along the bottom center, add the museum name in large text: {argument name="museum name" default="アスキー美術館"}, followed by a smaller address line and nearest-station access text in Japanese. Add a red-and-black slogan along the bottom right: "心に残る体験が、きっとここに。". In the lower right, include 3 circular benefit icons with captions: one peach circle with a ticket icon and text "学生はお得! 学生証提示で当日券200円OFF!", one blue circle with a camera icon and text "撮影OK! 一部の作品は写真撮影OK!", and one gold circle with a gift icon and text "来場者プレゼント! オリジナルしおりをプレゼント!". Scatter subtle sparkles, halftone dots, abstract blobs, and confetti shapes around the page. Overall mood: inviting, educational, elegant, and exciting, combining sacred cultural grandeur with cheerful youthful discovery, like a fictional premium museum advertisement generated as a complete poster with integrated typography.
