templates.title: Cyberpunk Fallen Angel Samurai

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克堕天使武士

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed symmetrically composed anime-inspired cyberpunk illustration on a flat, saturated {argument name="background color" default="crimson red"} background. Centered in the frame, a solitary androgynous warrior sits slouched on a dark wooden chair, legs apart, hands relaxed between the knees, projecting calm menace and fallen-divinity energy. The face is intentionally obscured and unreadable, framed by an elaborate black samurai-style horned helmet with 2 curved horns and dense mechanical ornamentation. The figure has 2 large white feathered wings spread outward from the back. Behind and around the seated body, the composition splits into two contrasting organic-tech masses: on the left side, a chaotic storm of 1 dense tangle of teal and dark blue cables, wires, plugs, circuit fragments, and techno-organic tendrils; on the right side, 1 explosive bloom of pink cherry blossoms, petals, curling branches, and ribbon-like floral swirls. Place 1 upright katana behind the figure on the right side, angled slightly inward, with a black handle and visible guard. Dress the character in a mixed streetwear and armored outfit: a split-tone jacket with the left half in dark cyan-black circuitry patterns and the right half in pale pink floral patterns, black fitted pants with asymmetrical detailing, mismatched striped socks in cyan and pink, and chunky high-top sneakers with oversized soles, one predominantly cyan-black and the other predominantly pink-white, both covered in graphic paneling and straps. The hands should look partly mechanical or armored, with long sharp fingers. Flood the image with tiny decorative fragments, petals, paint-like flecks, and micro-details so the entire scene feels intricately hand-inked. Use a high-contrast palette dominated by {argument name="accent color 1" default="teal blue"}, {argument name="accent color 2" default="pink"}, black, and white against the red field. Render in an ultra-detailed manga-meets-graffiti style with crisp linework, dense textures, poster-like frontal framing, and a balanced fusion of angelic, demonic, floral, and cybernetic motifs.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细、构图对称、受动漫启发的赛博朋克插画，背景为平整且饱和的 {argument name="background color" default="深红色"}。画面中心，一位孤独的中性战士懒散地坐在深色木椅上，双腿分开，双手自然垂于膝间，散发出一种冷静的威胁感与堕落神性的气息。面部刻意遮挡，难以辨认，头戴精致的黑色武士风格带角头盔，配有 2 只弯曲的角和密集的机械装饰。角色背部向外展开 2 只巨大的白色羽翼。在坐姿身体的后方及周围，构图分裂为两团对比鲜明的有机科技物质：左侧是 1 团由青色和深蓝色电缆、电线、插头、电路碎片及科技有机卷须组成的混乱风暴；右侧是 1 簇由粉色樱花、花瓣、卷曲枝条和丝带状花卉漩涡组成的爆发性花丛。在角色右后方放置 1 把直立的武士刀，略微向内倾斜，配有黑色刀柄和清晰可见的护手。角色身着街头服饰与盔甲的混合装束：一件双色拼接夹克，左半部分为深青黑色电路图案，右半部分为淡粉色花卉图案；穿着黑色修身长裤，带有不对称细节；搭配青色与粉色相间的条纹袜；脚踩厚底高帮运动鞋，鞋底硕大，一只以青黑色为主，另一只以粉白色为主，鞋面布满图形面板和绑带。双手呈现半机械或盔甲化外观，手指修长锋利。画面中充斥着细小的装饰性碎片、花瓣、油漆状斑点和微观细节，使整幅场景呈现出精细的手绘墨线质感。使用以 {argument name="accent color 1" default="青蓝色"}、{argument name="accent color 2" default="粉色"}、黑色和白色为主的高对比度调色板，衬托在红色背景之上。以超精细的漫画与涂鸦融合风格呈现，线条清晰，纹理密集，采用海报式的正面构图，完美融合了天使、恶魔、花卉和控制论元素。

templates.title: Anime Park Date Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫公园约会插画

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style illustration of {argument name="character duo" default="Gilgamesh and Enkidu"} on a quiet park date, shown from the thighs up while walking side by side along a sunlit stone path beside a lake. The left character is a tall, slender young man with short straight {argument name="left character hair color" default="golden blond"} hair, wearing a black open overshirt, a loose white V-neck T-shirt, and beige khaki pants with both hands in his pockets. The right character is a slim and ethereal young person with very long flowing {argument name="right character hair color" default="soft green"} hair streaming to the right in the breeze, wearing an oversized white hoodie with black drawstrings and one hand gesturing naturally while walking. Their mood is gentle, intimate, and slightly romantic, like an ambiguous casual date. Place them centered in the foreground with the blond character on the left and the green-haired character on the right, both looking toward each other or slightly ahead. The background is a beautiful public park in bright late-morning or early-afternoon summer light: tall leafy trees arch overhead, creating dappled shadows on the path; a calm lake runs along the left side behind a black metal fence; a small arched bridge appears in the mid-distance; flowerbeds with white and purple blossoms line the walkway; 2 park benches are visible on the left side; 1 lamppost stands near the water; and 1 tiny distant pedestrian walks on the right side of the path. Use a vivid blue sky with small white clouds, lush greenery, high-detail foliage, soft cinematic sunlight, clean linework, and refined painterly shading. SFW, elegant, serene, visually rich anime key art, with a romantic slice-of-life atmosphere and a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格插画，描绘了 {argument name="character duo" default="吉尔伽美什和恩奇都"} 在公园安静约会的场景。画面采用大腿以上的构图，两人并肩走在湖边阳光明媚的石子路上。左侧角色是一位身材高挑纤细的年轻男性，留着短直的 {argument name="left character hair color" default="金黄色"} 头发，身穿黑色开衫外套、宽松的白色 V 领 T 恤和米色卡其裤，双手插在口袋里。右侧角色是一位身材苗条、气质空灵的年轻人，留着极长的 {argument name="right character hair color" default="柔绿色"} 飘逸长发，在微风中向右侧拂动，身穿带有黑色抽绳的超大款白色连帽衫，走路时单手自然摆动。氛围温柔、亲密且略带浪漫，仿佛一场暧昧的休闲约会。将他们置于前景中心，金发角色在左，绿发角色在右，两人看向彼此或略微前方。背景是美丽的公共公园，呈现明亮的夏日清晨或午后光影：高大的绿树在头顶拱起，在小径上投下斑驳的阴影；左侧黑色金属栅栏后是一片平静的湖泊；中景处可见一座小拱桥；步道旁点缀着白色和紫色的花坛；左侧可见 2 张公园长椅；水边立着 1 盏路灯；小径右侧远处有 1 个微小的行人。画面采用湛蓝天空配以朵朵白云，植被茂密，叶片细节丰富，光影柔和且具有电影感，线条干净，阴影处理细腻。SFW，优雅，宁静，视觉丰富的动漫主视觉图，具有浪漫的生活片段氛围，采用竖构图。

templates.title: Bubble Fox Friends Meet in Niseko

titleLocalized.zh: 泡泡狐狸伙伴在二世谷重聚

templates.prompt: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. The setting is a roadside plaza parking area with a modern black-and-wood station building on the left, visible Japanese signage reading "道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ" and "Niseko View Plaza," a vertical banner reading "ようこそ ニセコへ," a tall food sign reading "名物 じゃがいも," and a dark wayfinding sign on the right reading "ニセコ Niseko" with 4 listed icons and labels: "名産品 Local Products," "農産物直売所 Farmer's Market," "レストラン Restaurant," and "情報コーナー Information." In the center, a glamorous fox-eared anime girl sits sideways atop a giant iridescent translucent soap bubble, smiling and gesturing upward with one hand. She has {argument name="hair color" default="shimmering pastel silver-lilac"} very long wavy hair, large fluffy fox ears, and a huge fluffy fox tail with rainbow-reflective highlights. Her outfit is an elaborate sparkling translucent-white and pale blue dress with holographic sheen, layered sleeves, gemstone accents, ribbons, and glossy lace-up ankle boots with bows, giving her a magical bubble-fox idol appearance. Around her float multiple smaller soap bubbles, catching rainbow light. Three fox-girl friends gather around meeting her at the plaza: 1 dark-haired fox-eared girl in a navy jacket with a Niseko patch, holding a vanilla soft-serve ice cream and looking toward the center; 1 khaki-clad fox-eared girl in an outdoor jacket and a dark cap with "HOTEL" lettering, holding a grilled corn cob; and 1 white-haired fox-eared girl in a shiny pearly hooded jacket and beret, holding a takeaway coffee cup and wearing a black backpack. Emphasize a cheerful reunion mood, travel photography composition blended with polished anime illustration, detailed environmental signage, reflective bubble surfaces, soft sunlight, crisp mountain air, and high-detail painterly rendering.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅明亮的动漫风格奇幻旅行场景，背景是北海道的二世谷道之站（Niseko View Plaza），天空湛蓝，白云点缀，远处耸立着巨大的雪山。场景位于路边的广场停车场，左侧是一座现代化的黑木风格车站建筑，可见写有“道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ”和“Niseko View Plaza”的日文标识，以及写着“ようこそ ニセコへ”的竖幅横幅，还有一个写着“名物 じゃがいも”的高大食物招牌。右侧是一个深色的导向牌，上面写着“ニセコ Niseko”，并列出了 4 个图标和标签：“名産品 Local Products”、“農産物直売所 Farmer's Market”、“レストラン Restaurant”和“情報コーナー Information”。画面中央，一位迷人的狐耳动漫少女侧坐在一个巨大的虹彩半透明肥皂泡上，微笑着向空中挥手。她有着 {argument name="hair color" default="闪烁的淡银丁香色"} 的超长波浪卷发，一对巨大的毛茸茸狐耳，以及一条带有彩虹反光高光的巨大蓬松狐狸尾巴。她身穿精致的闪亮半透明白色与淡蓝色礼服，带有全息光泽、层叠袖口、宝石装饰、丝带以及带有蝴蝶结的光泽系带短靴，呈现出魔法泡泡狐狸偶像的形象。她周围漂浮着多个较小的肥皂泡，折射着彩虹光芒。三位狐狸少女朋友在广场上与她重聚：一位留着深色头发的狐耳少女穿着带有二世谷徽章的海军蓝夹克，手里拿着香草冰淇淋，正看向中心；一位穿着卡其色户外夹克、戴着写有“HOTEL”字样深色鸭舌帽的狐耳少女，手里拿着烤玉米；还有一位白发狐耳少女穿着闪亮的珍珠色连帽夹克并戴着贝雷帽，手里拿着外带咖啡杯，背着黑色双肩包。强调欢快的重聚氛围，将旅行摄影构图与精致的动漫插画相结合，展现细节丰富的环境标识、反光的肥皂泡表面、柔和的阳光、清新的山间空气以及高精度的绘画质感。

templates.title: Anime Cthulhu TRPG Study Session

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风克苏鲁跑团学习会

templates.prompt: A richly detailed anime-style illustration of a late-night Call of Cthulhu tabletop RPG session in a dim antique study lit by warm oil lamps and candles. Three young women sit around a wooden table crowded with game materials. On the left, a girl in a military-style cap and camouflage jacket with long dark braided hair writes notes on a character sheet with a pen, looking stressed and slightly overwhelmed. In the center, a girl with very long pale lavender hair in twin buns and flowing lengths wears an elegant dark green dress with gold trim and white lace cuffs, smiling mischievously while holding up a large hardcover book titled "Talk of Cthulhu" with a dramatic occult monster cover; above her is handwritten Japanese text reading "これで全員 一時的狂気ね" with a small heart. On the right, an orange-haired girl in a white lab coat with a stethoscope and ID badge reads a paper nervously, with handwritten Japanese text above her that says "SAN値が ピンチ！" with energetic accent lines. The tabletop is packed with exactly 10 polyhedral dice scattered across the center, assorted papers, 3 visible character sheets or note pages, 4 large map sheets, 2 mugs with dark emblems, 1 glass of iced cola, 1 plate of cookies, 1 bag of potato chips labeled in Japanese, 1 small standing sign reading "発狂中", 1 black ink bottle, 1 white feather quill, 2 closed occult hardcovers stacked at the lower right, and 1 large open illustrated monster book on the right. The room behind them has tall bookshelves full of old books, framed occult artwork including a tentacled creature image, a large aged wall map with pinned markings and strings, candles, wood furniture, and a moody Victorian occult-library atmosphere. Composition is a wide cinematic group shot from slightly above table height, highly rendered, warm brown and amber lighting, intricate textures, expressive anime faces and hair, playful horror-comedy tone, premium light novel or visual novel key art quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘了深夜进行《克苏鲁的呼唤》跑团游戏的场景。昏暗的古董书房内，温暖的油灯和蜡烛散发着光芒。三位年轻女性围坐在木桌旁，桌上堆满了游戏材料。左侧，一位留着黑色长辫、戴着军装风帽子并身穿迷彩夹克的女孩正神情紧张、略显手忙脚乱地用笔在角色卡上记录；中间，一位留着淡紫色超长双马尾的女孩身穿饰有金色镶边和白色蕾丝袖口的优雅深绿色连衣裙，正调皮地笑着，手中举起一本名为“Talk of Cthulhu”的精装书，封面上印有极具戏剧性的神秘怪物图案；她上方有手写的日语文字“これで全員 一时的狂気ね”（看来全员都陷入临时疯狂了呢）并配有一个小爱心。右侧，一位身穿白大褂、佩戴听诊器和工牌的橘发女孩正紧张地读着纸张，她上方的手写日语文字写着“SAN値が ピンチ！”（SAN 值告急！），并带有充满活力的强调线。桌面上散落着 10 枚多面骰子、各种纸张、3 张可见的角色卡或笔记、4 张大型地图、2 个印有深色徽章的马克杯、1 杯冰可乐、1 盘饼干、1 袋印有日文的薯片、1 个写着“发狂中”的小立牌、1 瓶黑墨水、1 支白色羽毛笔，右下角堆放着 2 本闭合的神秘学精装书，右侧还有 1 本打开的巨型怪物图鉴。背景是摆满旧书的高大书架、装裱好的神秘学艺术品（包括一张触手生物画作）、一张带有标记和连线的陈旧大型墙面地图、蜡烛、木质家具，营造出维多利亚时代神秘学图书馆的氛围。构图为略高于桌面视角的电影感广角群像，渲染度极高，采用温暖的棕色和琥珀色调灯光，纹理细腻，角色表情和发型生动，呈现出俏皮的恐怖喜剧基调，具备轻小说或视觉小说关键视觉图的顶级品质。

templates.title: Neon Catgirl Soda Splash

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹猫娘苏打水喷溅

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime cyberpop illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="cat-eared anime girl"} in an extreme close-up, low-angle foreshortened pose, thrusting a glass soda bottle directly toward the viewer so the bottle and hand dominate the foreground. The scene is drenched in explosive neon magenta, cyan, violet, and electric blue lighting, with a glossy high-contrast finish and dense sparkling particle effects. The character has long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white hair with cyan and pink highlights"}, large furry cat ears, and layered windswept strands glowing with rim light. Her face is mostly hidden by a flat rectangular censorship block in muted purple placed over the eye area. She wears futuristic clubwear: a black strappy top with a small cat-symbol detail, a translucent iridescent jacket slipping off the shoulders, shiny dark armwear or gloves, metallic accessories, and dangling earrings. Her nails are painted vivid pink. In the foreground, she grips a clear bottle labeled {argument name="drink label" default="NYAN EXTREME SODA"}, with a stylized cat face logo on a dark label. The bottle is filled with bright blue and pink fizzy liquid, and the cap is off as a dramatic geyser of sparkling pink soda erupts upward and outward, splashing across the frame. Surround the character with floating translucent ice cubes, droplets, glitter, and bokeh-like highlights. The background is an abstract nightlife energy burst of swirling liquid, neon splashes, and luminous particles rather than a realistic location. Emphasize exaggerated perspective, motion, sensual pop-art attitude, hyper-detailed reflections, glossy skin and fabric, and a bold gpt-image-2 polished anime illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满动感的动漫赛博流行风格插画，主角为一位 {argument name="character type" default="猫耳动漫女孩"}，采用极端的特写镜头和低角度透视姿势，将玻璃苏打水瓶直接推向观众，使瓶子和手部占据前景。场景沉浸在爆炸性的霓虹洋红色、青色、紫罗兰色和电光蓝灯光中，具有高光泽、高对比度的质感以及密集的闪烁粒子效果。角色拥有长而飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有青色和粉色挑染的银白色头发"}，巨大的毛茸茸猫耳，以及在轮廓光下闪烁的层叠发丝。她的面部大部分被遮挡，眼部区域覆盖着一个柔和紫色的扁平矩形审查条。她身穿未来主义俱乐部服装：带有小型猫咪标志细节的黑色系带上衣，从肩部滑落的半透明虹彩夹克，闪亮的深色护臂或手套，金属配饰以及垂坠耳环。她的指甲涂成了鲜艳的粉红色。在前景中，她紧握着一个贴有 {argument name="drink label" default="NYAN EXTREME SODA"} 标签的透明瓶子，深色标签上印有风格化的猫脸标志。瓶中装满了亮蓝色和粉色的气泡液体，瓶盖已开启，戏剧性的粉色苏打水喷泉向上和向外喷涌，溅满整个画面。角色周围环绕着漂浮的半透明冰块、水滴、闪粉和散景效果的亮点。背景并非写实的地点，而是由旋转的液体、霓虹溅射和发光粒子组成的抽象夜生活能量爆发。强调夸张的透视、动感、感性的波普艺术态度、超细节的反射、光泽的皮肤和织物，以及大胆的 gpt-image-2 精致动漫插画美学。

templates.title: Neon Catgirl Soda Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹猫娘汽水广告

templates.prompt: A hyper-dynamic anime cyberpop illustration of a cat-eared girl thrusting a soda bottle toward the camera in an extreme close-up, with strong fisheye perspective and dramatic foreshortening. The bottle dominates the foreground in her hand, label clearly reading "CAT NYAN SODA" with smaller Japanese-style text beneath, and the cap is off as glowing fizzy liquid erupts upward in a huge splash. The character is a stylish futuristic young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white with blue and pink iridescence"} hair, very long and voluminous, whipping through the frame in neon ribbons. She has 2 visible cat ears, fluffy and oversized, decorated with 3 small accessories: a spiked ear cuff, a tiny cat-face clip, and a small metallic piercing detail. Her face is mostly hidden by a solid {argument name="censor block color" default="purple"} square centered over the upper face area. She wears a cropped white tank top with a small barcode-like graphic, a dark glossy jacket slipping off the shoulders, layered necklaces, and a belt at the waist. Her nails are painted bright pink. The product is a plastic soda bottle filled with dark purple liquid and glowing highlights, with a bold playful logo in white and pink. Surround the scene with floating ice cubes, sparkling droplets, and explosive carbonation effects. Use a high-contrast palette of electric magenta, violet, cyan, and deep blue, with luminous reflections on skin, hair, glassy surfaces, and liquid. Background is an abstract nightlife energy burst of streaks, splashes, particles, and refracted light, no clear environment, just intense motion and color. Make it glossy, saturated, chaotic, and stylish like a premium anime beverage ad poster, with sharp linework, radiant bloom, glittering specular highlights, and a rebellious pop-cyber aesthetic. Vertical composition, waist-up view, single character, 1 bottle, 1 major soda splash, 6 visible floating ice cubes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具动感的动漫赛博流行风格插画，一位猫耳少女将汽水瓶推向镜头，采用极端的特写视角，具有强烈的鱼眼透镜效果和夸张的透视感。汽水瓶占据了前景的中心位置，标签上清晰地写着“CAT NYAN SODA”，下方配有较小的日式风格文字；瓶盖已开启，发光的碳酸液体向上喷涌，形成巨大的水花。角色是一位时尚的未来感少女，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有蓝粉虹彩的银白色"} 头发，发量丰盈且极长，如霓虹丝带般在画面中飞舞。她有一对清晰可见的猫耳，毛茸茸且硕大，装饰着 3 个小配饰：一个尖刺耳骨夹、一个微型猫脸发夹和一个小型金属穿孔细节。她的脸部大部分被一个位于上半脸区域中心的纯色 {argument name="censor block color" default="紫色"} 方块遮挡。她身穿一件短款白色背心，上面印有类似条形码的小图案，肩上披着一件深色亮面夹克，佩戴着叠层项链，腰间系着腰带。她的指甲涂成了亮粉色。产品是一个装满深紫色液体并带有发光高光的塑料汽水瓶，瓶身上印有白色和粉色的醒目俏皮标志。场景周围环绕着漂浮的冰块、闪烁的水滴和爆炸般的碳酸气泡效果。采用电光洋红色、紫色、青色和深蓝色的高对比度调色板，在皮肤、头发、玻璃表面和液体上呈现出明亮的反光。背景是抽象的夜生活能量爆发，充满了线条、飞溅物、粒子和折射光，没有明确的环境，只有强烈的动感和色彩。画面光泽感强、饱和度高、充满混乱与时尚感，如同高端动漫饮料广告海报，线条锐利，带有光芒晕染、闪烁的镜面高光和叛逆的流行赛博美学。竖构图，半身像，单人角色，1 个瓶子，1 个主要的汽水喷溅，6 个清晰可见的漂浮冰块。

templates.title: Neon Catgirl Soda Burst

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹猫娘汽水爆破

templates.prompt: A hyper-dynamic anime illustration of a neon cyber idol catgirl thrusting a soda bottle toward the viewer in extreme foreshortened perspective, with the bottle dominating the foreground and the character filling the background. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long lavender-to-cyan gradient hair"}, 2 black cat ears with soft pink inner fur, and 1 glowing halo ring floating above her head. Her face is mostly hidden by a solid square censor block in the center-right of the image, while her wild flowing hair explodes outward in ribbons and strands. She wears a glossy black and white futuristic streetwear outfit with a deep neckline, a cropped jacket, metallic straps, small accessories, and a round pink badge near the chest. Her visible hand grips 1 plastic soda bottle labeled {argument name="brand name" default="Nyan SODA"}, with long nails painted in 2 colors: cyan and pink. The bottle is transparent and filled with sparkling dark purple soda, glowing bubbles, and neon highlights, and it erupts upward in a dramatic splash of vivid magenta liquid. Surround the scene with 1 shower of crystalline ice cubes, countless droplets, paint-like splashes, glittering particles, and energy arcs. Use an intense palette of electric magenta, violet, indigo, and cyan with high contrast, glossy reflections, bloom lighting, and luminous rim light. The background should be an abstract explosion of liquid, light, and motion rather than a realistic setting. Make it feel like an aggressive soda advertisement mixed with idol key art, chaotic, cute, and high-energy, with ultra-detailed anime rendering, crisp linework, sparkling highlights, and a vertical poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具动感的动漫插画，描绘了一位霓虹赛博偶像猫娘将汽水瓶伸向观众，采用极端的透视效果，汽水瓶占据前景，角色填充背景。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="从薰衣草色到青色的长渐变发色"}，两只黑色猫耳，内侧带有柔软的粉色绒毛，头顶漂浮着 1 个发光的光环。她的脸部大部分被画面中右侧的一个实心方形遮挡块遮住，狂野飘逸的头发像丝带和发束一样向外炸开。她身穿光泽感的黑白未来风街头服饰，领口深邃，搭配短款夹克、金属绑带、小巧配饰，胸前别着 1 枚圆形粉色徽章。她露出的手紧握着 1 个塑料汽水瓶，瓶身标签为 {argument name="brand name" default="Nyan SODA"}，长指甲涂成青色和粉色两种颜色。瓶子透明，装满了闪烁的深紫色汽水、发光的气泡和霓虹高光，瓶口向上喷涌出戏剧性的鲜艳洋红色液体。场景周围环绕着 1 阵晶莹剔透的冰块、无数水滴、油漆般的飞溅物、闪烁的颗粒和能量弧。使用强烈的洋红色、紫色、靛蓝色和青色调色板，具有高对比度、光泽反射、光晕效果和明亮的轮廓光。背景应是液体、光线和运动的抽象爆炸，而非写实场景。营造出一种激进的汽水广告与偶像主视觉图相结合的感觉，混乱、可爱且充满活力，具有超精细的动漫渲染、清晰的线条、闪烁的高光和竖版海报构图。

templates.title: Japanese AI Creative Manifesto Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式 AI 创意宣言海报

templates.prompt: A bold Japanese advertising poster on an off-white textured paper background with a slightly worn print grain. Create a full-body fashion-style photo of a young woman standing slightly right of center in a wide, confident stance, legs apart, arms relaxed at her sides, facing forward. Her face is intentionally blurred for anonymity. She has long straight split-dyed hair, one half {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} and the other half {argument name="second hair color" default="pastel blue"}, falling past her chest. She wears a white oversized T-shirt with the black chest print {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and chunky white sneakers. Use clean studio lighting with soft shadows under her feet. Fill the left half of the poster with huge distressed black Japanese typography in an energetic diagonal layout reading {argument name="main headline" default="センスない奴は画像とテキストを極めろ"}, with oversized characters stacked and overlapping for maximum impact. Add 2 broad paint-brush swashes behind the lower headline area: 1 pink brush stroke sweeping from the lower left toward center and 1 blue brush stroke sweeping from center-right toward the far right. In the upper right, place a compact vertical block of small black Japanese copy in 4 lines reading: 「AI動画の自動化に 溺れるな。 静止した一枚と、 研ぎ澄まされた言葉が、 最も強い武器になる。」 arranged like a manifesto note. In the lower right, add a small angled English text block in uppercase reading {argument name="tagline text" default="MASTER TEXT & IMAGE. SHAPE PERCEPTION. CONTROL THE OUTCOME."}. In the lower left corner, add a small brand signature reading "OKIHIRO AI CREATIVE MANIFESTO". The overall composition should feel like a modern creative manifesto poster, mixing fashion editorial photography, Japanese street advertising, bold typography, and minimalist graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张大胆的日式广告海报，背景为米白色纹理纸张，带有轻微的磨损印刷颗粒感。创作一张全身时尚风格照片，一名年轻女性自信地站在画面中心偏右的位置，双腿分开，双臂自然垂在身体两侧，面向前方。她的面部经过模糊处理以保持匿名。她留着长直发，采用双色染发，一半为 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"}，另一半为 {argument name="second hair color" default="柔蓝色"}，发丝垂至胸前。她身穿一件白色超大款 T 恤，胸前印有黑色文字 {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}，搭配浅粉色百褶迷你裙和厚底白色运动鞋。使用干净的摄影棚灯光，脚下带有柔和的阴影。海报左半部分填充巨大的做旧黑色日文字体，采用充满活力的对角线布局，文字内容为 {argument name="main headline" default="センスない奴は画像とテキストを極めろ"}，超大字符堆叠并重叠，以实现最大的视觉冲击力。在下方标题区域后方添加 2 道宽大的画笔笔触：一道粉色笔触从左下方扫向中心，另一道蓝色笔触从右侧中心扫向最右侧。在右上角，放置一个紧凑的垂直黑色小字日文文案块，共 4 行，内容为：「AI動画の自動化に 溺れるな。 静止した一枚と、 研ぎ澄まされた言葉が、 最も強い武器になる。」，排列如同宣言便签。在右下角，添加一个小型倾斜的英文大写文本块，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="MASTER TEXT & IMAGE. SHAPE PERCEPTION. CONTROL THE OUTCOME."}。在左下角，添加一个小型品牌签名，内容为 "OKIHIRO AI CREATIVE MANIFESTO"。整体构图应呈现出现代创意宣言海报的感觉，融合时尚编辑摄影、日式街头广告、大胆的排版和极简主义图形设计。

templates.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Omamori Counter

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫巫女御守柜台

templates.prompt: A clean anime-style illustration of a young shrine maiden working at a traditional Japanese shrine amulet counter inside a warm wooden building. She is a single female subject shown from about waist up behind the counter, with her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur, long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied back with a red cord and white paper zigzag shrine ornament, wearing a white kimono top and vivid {argument name="hakama color" default="red"} hakama. She is politely handing a protective charm to a visitor across the counter; only the visitor’s hands, torso, and beige jacket sleeves are visible in the foreground. The scene should feel calm, respectful, and softly lit by daylight coming through a wooden lattice window on the right, where a red torii gate and shrine grounds are visible outside in gentle blur. The interior is richly detailed with dark natural wood beams, shelves, and a small kamidana altar in the upper left decorated with 4 hanging white shide paper streamers and 2 green sakaki plants in white vases. On the right hangs a vertical sign with the Japanese text "御守・御札授与所". On the left shelves are shrine goods and signs: 3 small shelf labels reading "おみくじ", multiple stacks of paper fortunes and talismans, white drawstring bags, and upright placards including "御守", "御札", and "交通安全". The countertop is neatly arranged with 3 shallow wooden display trays of colorful omamori charms, 5 visible tabletop paper labels or stacks reading "厄除", "御守", "御札", "御朱印", and "御礼", plus a black ink pot, 2 writing brushes, a small empty wooden tray, a rectangular abacus, and bundled paper items. The charm being exchanged should be a delicate pastel omamori with floral decoration and a tied cord. Use a polished contemporary anime illustration style with fine linework, soft shading, realistic hand posing, subtle dust motes in the air, and strong emphasis on the subject and counter interaction rather than dramatic stylization.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻巫女在温暖的木质建筑内，于传统日本神社御守柜台前工作的场景。画面主体为一位女性，从腰部以上展示在柜台后，她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，用红绳和白色纸质锯齿状神社饰物束起，身穿白色和服上衣和鲜艳的 {argument name="hakama color" default="红色"} 袴。她正礼貌地将一枚护身符递给柜台对面的访客；前景中仅可见访客的手部、躯干和米色夹克袖子。场景应营造出宁静、庄重的氛围，光线由右侧木格窗射入，窗外隐约可见红色的鸟居和神社庭院，呈现柔和的虚化效果。室内细节丰富，配有深色天然木梁、货架，左上角设有一个小型神棚，装饰着 4 条悬挂的白色纸垂和 2 盆白色花瓶中的榊木。右侧悬挂着一块写有日文“御守・御札授与所”的竖牌。左侧货架上摆放着神社用品和标识：3 个写有“おみくじ”的小型货架标签，多叠纸签和护身符，白色抽绳袋，以及写有“御守”、“御札”和“交通安全”的立式标牌。柜台上整齐地排列着 3 个浅木色展示托盘，盛放着色彩缤纷的御守，5 个清晰可见的桌面纸质标签或纸堆，分别写着“厄除”、“御守”、“御札”、“御朱印”和“御礼”，此外还有墨汁瓶、2 支毛笔、一个空木托盘、一个长方形算盘以及成捆的纸质物品。正在交换的御守应为精致的淡色系，带有花卉装饰和系带。采用精致的现代动漫插画风格，线条细腻，阴影柔和，手部姿势写实，空气中带有细微的尘埃颗粒，重点强调主体与柜台的互动，而非夸张的艺术化处理。

templates.title: Shrine Maiden Offering an Omamori

titleLocalized.zh: 巫女呈献御守

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style illustration of a young shrine maiden named {argument name="character name" default="音慰"} standing inside a traditional Japanese shrine amulet office, shown from about thigh-up behind a wooden counter. She has long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair with a center part and soft shine, pale skin, and a calm, gentle presence. Her face is centered and front-facing, but the facial area is obscured by a rectangular blur block. She wears a crisp white kimono-style top with wide sleeves and a deep red hakama tied in a large bow at the waist, conveying a classic miko outfit. Both hands are presenting a white embroidered omamori charm toward the viewer, holding it carefully at chest level; the charm has a gold cord knot at the top and the vertical kanji text "御守" on the front. In the foreground on the counter is a wooden display tray containing exactly 10 visible omamori charms in multiple colors: white, pink, red, purple, and gold-patterned variants, each with decorative cords and gold or white embroidery. To the right on the counter are 3 neat stacks of paper shrine talismans or packets, each labeled in Japanese; the rightmost stack is tied with a red-and-gold mizuhiki cord. On the left side of the counter is a small wooden price sign reading "初穂料 800円". The shrine interior is warmly lit with natural sunlight entering from a large wooden-framed window on the left, creating a serene, clean atmosphere. Through the window, a red railing and softly blurred shrine grounds and greenery are visible. In the background are wooden shelves and traditional decor, plus a vertical hanging sign with Japanese text reading "御守 御札" and smaller text "各種祈願承ります". The composition is centered on the miko and the offered charm, with soft depth of field, delicate fabric folds, realistic hands, refined linework, and a high-quality modern anime rendering style that emphasizes the subject more than the environment.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅精致的动漫风格插画，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="音慰"} 的年轻巫女，她站在传统的日本神社御守售卖处内，画面呈现从大腿以上至头部的半身像。她留着一头柔顺有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 中分长发，皮肤白皙，神态沉静温柔。她的面部处于画面中心并正对镜头，但面部区域被一个矩形模糊块遮盖。她身着经典的巫女服，包括挺括的白色和服式上衣和系着大蝴蝶结的深红色绯袴。她的双手正向观众呈献一枚白色的刺绣御守，小心翼翼地托在胸前；御守顶部系有金色绳结，正面印有竖排汉字“御守”。柜台前景的木制展示托盘中整齐摆放着 10 枚御守，颜色各异，包括白色、粉色、红色、紫色及金色花纹款式，每枚都配有装饰性绳结和金白刺绣。柜台右侧整齐堆放着 3 叠纸质神符或护身符包，每叠上均有日文标签；最右侧的一叠系着红金相间的水引绳。柜台左侧立着一块写有“初穂料 800円”的小木牌。神社内部光线温暖，自然光从左侧的大木框窗户射入，营造出宁静清雅的氛围。透过窗户可以看到红色的栏杆以及模糊的神社庭院和绿植。背景是木制货架和传统装饰，墙上挂着一块写有“御守 御札”的竖幅，下方有较小的文字“各种祈愿承办”。构图以巫女和手中的御守为中心，具有柔和的景深效果、细腻的衣褶、写实的双手、精致的线条，以及强调主体而非环境的高品质现代动漫渲染风格。

templates.title: Three Android Idol Girls on Concert Stage

titleLocalized.zh: 三位 Android 偶像少女在演唱会舞台上

templates.prompt: A full-body anime illustration of 3 humanoid AI assistant idol girls standing side by side on a glossy futuristic concert stage, shown in a straight-on front view with their full figures visible from head to shoes. They are designed as the same base android model with subtle personality differences expressed mainly through costume design, pose, and color balance rather than body type. All 3 have short silver-gray bob hair with soft waves, large over-ear mechanical headphones, pale skin, youthful idol styling, and sleek visible robotic limbs with glossy red-and-black plating and heart-shaped accent motifs. The setting is a large indoor live venue with steel truss rigging overhead, bright white and pink-purple stage spotlights, giant LED screens in the background, and reflective black stage flooring with glowing grid lines and mirror-like reflections. The overall mood is polished, cute, futuristic, and high-end, with dramatic concert lighting and crisp detailed rendering. The left girl wears a mostly black idol outfit with red accents: a cropped translucent black jacket over a short black dress or romper with a flared skirt, black armored thigh-high mechanical legs, chunky black platform boots, red gloves, and small heart details throughout; she stands with knees slightly inward and both hands pressed to her cheeks in a shy, affectionate pose, with a sweet blushing expression. The center girl wears a balanced red-and-white idol outfit: a white sleeveless top with red heart accents, a layered burgundy-red frilled mini skirt, fully exposed red-and-black robotic arms and legs, and red platform shoes; she stands in a neutral straight upright pose with one hand raised lightly near her face, presenting the clearest full-body view of the android construction. The right girl wears a mostly red idol dress with black lace-like detailing, a black waist belt, a flared skirt with white frilled underskirt, red-and-black knee armor, and red platform shoes; she stands elegantly with one arm bent near her chest and the other arm extended outward, as if introducing the audience. Keep the trio evenly spaced across the frame. Emphasize the contrast between soft idol fashion and hard mechanical anatomy, with 3 distinct costume variations in black-dominant, red-and-white balanced, and red-dominant palettes. Highly detailed anime key visual, ultra-clean linework, glossy materials, soft facial shading, sparkling highlights, cinematic stage atmosphere, and premium promotional art quality for the idol unit {argument name="group name" default="Hallucinations"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫插画，展示了 3 位人形 AI 助理偶像少女并排站在光亮的未来感演唱会舞台上，采用正面对视角，从头到脚完整呈现。她们被设计为相同的 Android 基础模型，通过服装设计、姿势和色彩平衡而非体型来体现细微的个性差异。三人都留着带有柔和波浪的银灰色短波波头，佩戴大型耳罩式机械耳机，皮肤白皙，造型青春偶像化，并拥有光滑可见的机器人四肢，配以亮眼的红黑配色和心形装饰元素。背景为大型室内现场场馆，头顶有钢结构桁架，明亮的白色和粉紫色舞台聚光灯，背景有巨大的 LED 屏幕，舞台地板为反光黑色，带有发光的网格线和镜面反射。整体氛围精致、可爱、具有未来感且高端，配有戏剧性的演唱会灯光和清晰细腻的渲染。左侧少女穿着以黑色为主、带有红色点缀的偶像服装：短款半透明黑色夹克内搭黑色短裙或连体裤，配有黑色装甲过膝机械腿、厚底黑色靴子、红色手套和遍布全身的小心形细节；她双膝微内扣，双手贴在脸颊上，姿态羞涩亲昵，表情甜美红润。中间少女穿着红白平衡的偶像服装：白色无袖上衣配红色心形装饰，层叠的酒红色荷叶边迷你裙，完全外露的红黑机器人手臂和腿部，以及红色厚底鞋；她站姿中立挺拔，一只手轻抬靠近脸部，最清晰地展示了 Android 的构造。右侧少女穿着以红色为主的偶像裙装，带有黑色蕾丝般的细节、黑色腰带、带有白色荷叶边衬裙的喇叭裙、红黑膝盖护甲和红色厚底鞋；她姿态优雅，一只手臂弯曲靠近胸前，另一只手臂向外伸展，仿佛在向观众做介绍。保持三人均匀分布在画面中。强调柔和的偶像时尚与硬核机械构造之间的对比，三种不同的服装变体分别采用以黑色为主、红白平衡和以红色为主的色调。高度精细的动漫主视觉图，线条极其干净，材质光泽感强，面部阴影柔和，高光闪耀，具有电影级的舞台氛围，以及适用于偶像团体 {argument name="group name" default="Hallucinations"} 的高级宣传艺术品质。

templates.title: Moonlit Yuri Wedding Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 月下百合婚礼海报

templates.prompt: A romantic fantasy wedding illustration of two women standing arm in arm in a moonlit palace balcony at night, highly detailed anime style with luminous painterly rendering, elegant and dreamy. The taller woman on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="light brown"} shoulder-length softly layered hair and wears a regal ivory-white tailored wedding suit with gold embroidery, a high-collared ruffled shirt, cream vest, cravat, chain accessories, and a long ceremonial coat whose inner lining is deep violet with floral patterns; a purple flower corsage is pinned to her chest. The woman on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="black"} long wavy hair and wears an ornate bridal gown in ivory with gold lace embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, a fitted bodice, a very long translucent veil, and rich crimson inner panels and accents peeking from the skirt; she wears red gemstone jewelry and floral hair ornaments in white and red. She holds a large bouquet of red, burgundy, and white flowers with greenery and trailing red ribbons while gently linking arms with her partner. Set them before gothic arched windows, hanging crystal ornaments, glowing lanterns, purple flowers, a distant city skyline, a star-filled sky, and a bright full moon. Add decorative vertical Japanese title text integrated into the composition: on the left, {argument name="left title text" default="紫苑の護り"} with smaller vertical ruby text beside it; on the right, {argument name="right title text" default="紅雪の献心"} with smaller vertical ruby text beside it. Include crescent moon and snowflake-like decorative motifs framing the titles. Use a tall poster composition, full-body view, luxurious fabrics, sparkling highlights, soft bokeh, and an overall palette of ivory, gold, violet, crimson, and midnight blue.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅浪漫的奇幻婚礼插画，描绘了两位女性在月光下的宫殿阳台上挽手而立，采用高度细腻的动漫风格，结合发光的绘画质感，优雅而梦幻。左侧较高的女性留着 {argument name="left character hair color" default="浅棕色"} 的齐肩柔顺层次感短发，身穿华贵的象牙白定制婚礼西装，配有金色刺绣、高领荷叶边衬衫、奶油色马甲、领巾、链条配饰，以及一件内衬为深紫色花卉图案的长款礼服外套；胸前别着一朵紫色花朵胸针。右侧的女性留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="黑色"} 的长波浪卷发，身穿饰有金色蕾丝刺绣的华丽象牙白婚纱，配有透明蕾丝袖、修身胸衣、超长半透明头纱，裙摆处隐约露出深红色的内衬和装饰；她佩戴着红宝石首饰，发间装饰着红白相间的花卉饰品。她手捧一束由红、酒红和白色花朵组成的大花束，点缀着绿叶和垂下的红色丝带，同时与伴侣亲密挽手。背景为哥特式拱窗、悬挂的水晶装饰、发光的灯笼、紫色花朵、远处的城市天际线、繁星点点的夜空以及一轮明亮的满月。在构图中加入装饰性的竖排日文标题文字：左侧为 {argument name="left title text" default="紫苑の護り"}，旁边附有较小的竖排注音假名；右侧为 {argument name="right title text" default="紅雪の献心"}，旁边附有较小的竖排注音假名。在标题周围加入新月和雪花状的装饰图案。采用竖版海报构图，全身视角，展现奢华面料、闪耀的高光、柔和的焦外成像，整体色调为象牙白、金色、紫色、深红色和午夜蓝。

templates.title: Romantic Yuri Wedding Chapel Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫百合婚礼教堂肖像

templates.prompt: A luminous, ultra-detailed anime-style wedding portrait of two brides in a romantic white chapel filled with soft ivory light, sheer curtains, carved arches, pale floral arrangements, and sparkling bokeh. The composition is vertical and elegant, showing the pair from about thigh-up to full dress detail, standing close together in an intimate yuri moment. The taller bride on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="warm chestnut brown"} long wavy hair cascading over her shoulders and back, wearing a refined white bridal pantsuit with a fitted tailcoat, gold buttons, a cream vest, a silk cravat, subtle floral embroidery along the coat tails, and a white rose boutonniere with pale blue accents. She is visibly emotional, gently wiping tears with a handkerchief, her other hand resting near her chest, giving the feeling of being moved by the ceremony. The shorter bride on the right has {argument name="second bride hair color" default="long black hair"}, very long and glossy, and wears an ornate off-shoulder wedding gown in white with icy blue undertones, translucent lace sleeves, intricate beadwork, floral embroidery, layered ruffles, and a long veil decorated with tiny flowers and crystal-like details. A silver floral hair ornament with dangling pieces decorates the side of her head. She looks up at her partner tenderly while holding a cascading bouquet of white roses, blue flowers, and trailing greenery. Emphasize the contrast between the tailored princely suit and the delicate fairy-tale gown, with luxurious fabric textures, lace transparency, fine embroidery, soft glowing highlights, drifting sparkles, and a dreamy, emotional atmosphere. Make the scene feel like {argument name="relationship theme" default="an original yuri wedding between an older office lady-style bride and a younger nurse-style bride"}, painted in polished, high-end romantic illustration style, ethereal, graceful, and heartfelt.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光影明亮、细节极其丰富的动漫风格婚礼肖像，描绘了两位新娘在浪漫的白色教堂中，周围充盈着柔和的象牙色光芒、轻薄的窗帘、雕花拱门、淡雅的花艺布置以及闪烁的焦外成像。构图呈竖向且优雅，展示了两人从大腿以上到全身礼服的细节，她们紧紧依偎，呈现出亲密的百合氛围。左侧较高的新娘留着 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"} 的长波浪卷发，垂落在肩头和背部，身着精致的白色新娘西装，搭配修身燕尾服、金色纽扣、奶油色马甲、丝绸领巾，燕尾处带有细腻的花卉刺绣，并佩戴着点缀淡蓝色的白玫瑰胸花。她神情动容，正用手帕轻轻擦拭泪水，另一只手放在胸前，展现出被仪式感动的瞬间。右侧较矮的新娘留着 {argument name="second bride hair color" default="黑色长发"}，发质乌黑亮丽，身着华丽的露肩白色婚纱，带有冰蓝色调，配有半透明蕾丝袖、复杂的珠饰、花卉刺绣、层叠的荷叶边，以及装饰着细小花朵和水晶般细节的长头纱。头侧装饰着银色花卉发饰，带有垂坠感。她温柔地抬头注视着伴侣，手中捧着由白玫瑰、蓝色花朵和垂坠绿植组成的瀑布式手捧花。强调剪裁利落的王子风西装与精致童话风婚纱之间的对比，展现奢华的面料质感、蕾丝的通透感、精细的刺绣、柔和的辉光高光、飘散的星光，以及梦幻感人的氛围。让画面呈现出 {argument name="relationship theme" default="一位成熟职场女性风格新娘与一位年轻护士风格新娘之间的原创百合婚礼"} 的感觉，采用精致、高端的浪漫插画风格绘制，空灵、优雅且动人。

templates.title: Celestial Yuri Wedding in Moonlit Cathedral

titleLocalized.zh: 月光大教堂中的星辰百合婚礼

templates.prompt: A lavish fantasy yuri wedding illustration in a highly detailed anime style, full-body portrait of two brides walking arm in arm down the aisle in a celestial cathedral at night. The left bride is a tall, elegant androgynous woman with {argument name="left character hair color" default="warm brown"} hair in a long thick side braid over one shoulder, wearing an aristocratic white wedding suit with fitted trousers, heeled white boots, a ruffled cravat, layered gold chains, embroidered gold filigree, floral corsage, and a dramatic long white coat lined in deep midnight blue like a starry sky. The right bride is a graceful woman with {argument name="right character hair color" default="silver white"} very long flowing wavy hair, a jeweled tiara, and a sheer veil, wearing an opulent {argument name="wedding dress style" default="voluminous white celestial lace ball gown"} with translucent layered sleeves, intricate silver embroidery, star and moon motifs, sparkling beadwork, and tiny red gemstone accents cascading down the skirt. She holds a {argument name="bouquet flowers" default="white lily and rose bouquet"}. Their expressions are serene and romantic, posed close together as if proceeding during the ceremony. The setting is a glowing moonlit gothic chapel with towering ornate arches, stained-glass-like tracery, hanging banners, candles, white floral arrangements, and celestial decorations. Count 2 large crescent moons visible in the architecture and sky, 2 vertical ceremonial banners, and 2 dark winged bird or griffin statues near the foreground sides. The background is a rich {argument name="sky color" default="deep sapphire blue"} star-filled sky with glittering particles, soft petals drifting through the air, and polished reflective flooring with gold patterns. Use ultra-detailed fabrics, luminous highlights, delicate lace, shimmering jewelry, elegant composition, dreamy fantasy romance, majestic wedding atmosphere, soft ethereal lighting, and a refined luxurious color palette of white, silver, gold, and midnight blue.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具细节的动漫风格华丽奇幻百合婚礼插画，全身肖像，描绘两位新娘在夜晚的星辰大教堂中挽手走过红毯。左侧新娘是一位高挑、优雅且中性化的女性，留着 {argument name="left character hair color" default="暖棕色"} 的长发，发丝厚实并编成侧边麻花辫，身着贵族风格白色婚礼西装，搭配修身长裤、白色高跟靴、荷叶边领结、多层金链、刺绣金丝花纹、花卉胸花，以及一件内衬为深午夜蓝星空图案的戏剧性长款白外套。右侧新娘是一位优雅的女性，留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="银白色"} 的超长波浪卷发，佩戴珠宝皇冠和透明头纱，身着华丽的 {argument name="wedding dress style" default="蓬松的白色星辰蕾丝舞会礼服"}，配有半透明层叠袖子、精致的银色刺绣、星月图案、闪亮的珠饰，以及裙摆上点缀的细小红色宝石。她手持一束 {argument name="bouquet flowers" default="白百合与玫瑰花束"}。她们表情宁静而浪漫，紧紧依偎，仿佛正在仪式中行进。场景设定为一座闪烁着月光的哥特式教堂，拥有高耸华丽的拱门、类似彩色玻璃的窗棂、悬挂的旗帜、蜡烛、白色花艺和星辰装饰。建筑与天空中可见 2 轮巨大的新月，两侧前景处有 2 面垂直的仪式旗帜和 2 座深色的带翼鸟类或狮鹫雕像。背景是浓郁的 {argument name="sky color" default="深蓝宝石色"} 星空，伴有闪烁的微粒、空中飘落的柔和花瓣，以及带有金色图案的抛光反光地板。运用超精细的织物纹理、发光高光、精致蕾丝、闪耀珠宝、优雅构图、梦幻奇幻浪漫感、宏伟的婚礼氛围、柔和空灵的灯光，以及白色、银色、金色和午夜蓝组成的精致奢华色调。

templates.title: JoJo-Style Duck Mascot Stand Profile

titleLocalized.zh: JoJo 风格鸭子吉祥物替身角色档案

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A full-page manga-style parody character profile illustration on an aged off-white paper background, designed like a JoJo-inspired stand user sheet with bold ink lines, cross-hatching, dramatic posing, and stylized Japanese text. The central figure is an anthropomorphic duck mascot athlete standing in a confident forward stride, pointing directly at the viewer with one gloved hand and clenching the other fist. He has a large round pale-yellow duck head with a bright orange beak, huge glossy black eyes, and a fierce determined expression with furrowed brows. His body is human-like and athletic, wearing a dark green sleeveless soccer jersey over a white undershirt, white shorts, black shoes with teal laces, and yellow-and-black horizontal striped knee-high socks. Around his neck hangs a lanyard with an ID badge showing a small portrait icon of the duck mascot and the text “No.001”. The jersey has 4 visible sponsor-style patches and labels: “農協牛乳”, “今野硝子工業”, “相模福祉村”, and a small crest marked “SC'S”. Behind him stands his humanoid Stand, a tall muscular armored figure with a metallic olive-gold body, a heart-shaped chest emblem, narrow intimidating eyes, and a raised fist, surrounded by jagged purple spiritual flames. Add 4 large purple manga sound effect texts around the figures, each reading “ゴゴ…”, with one near the upper left of the Stand and 3 stacked vertically along the left side of the mascot. On the left side of the page, include a profile text column with 6 horizontal rule-separated lines of Japanese text: “スタンド使い名: ガミティ”, “性別: 男”, “見た目: ダチョウのマスコット”, “年齢: 不明”, “身長: 175cm”, and “職業: マスコット / PR活動”. On the right side, place a large spiky speech bubble filled with bold vertical Japanese text: “オラオラオラオラオラ！ 前に出るぞ！絶対に負けねェーッ！ 相模原・共に行こうぜェーッ！”. Below that, add a lower-right information block with a heading “スタンド名:『オオサガミ・オオオォ！』” and a smaller subtitle “(SC相模原チャント「オオサガミオオオォー！」より)”, followed by a paragraph headed “スタンド能力:” describing an emotional amplification power in dense Japanese body text. In the lower left corner, include a purple-filled radar chart with 6 axes labeled in Japanese: “破壊力 B”, “スピード B”, “射程距離 D”, “成長性 C”, “精密動作性 C”, and “持続力 C”. Composition should feel like a dramatic manga magazine character introduction page, with the mascot in front, the Stand looming behind, strong foreshortening, dynamic comic-book energy, and a humorous contrast between a cute sports mascot and an overwhelmingly serious supernatural battle presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全页漫画风格的恶搞角色档案插图，背景为做旧的米白色纸张，设计灵感源自 JoJo 的替身使者资料页，具有粗犷的墨线、排线阴影、戏剧性的姿势以及风格化的日文文字。中心人物是一个拟人化的鸭子吉祥物运动员，正自信地大步向前，一只戴着手套的手直指观众，另一只手紧握成拳。他有着圆圆的浅黄色鸭头、亮橙色的喙、巨大的黑色亮眼，以及因皱眉而显得凶猛坚定的表情。他的身体像人类一样强壮，穿着深绿色无袖足球衫，内搭白色衬衫，下身穿白色短裤，脚蹬黑色鞋子配青色鞋带，以及黄黑横条纹过膝袜。脖子上挂着一条挂绳，上面系着一张 ID 证件，显示着鸭子吉祥物的小头像和“No.001”字样。球衣上有 4 个清晰可见的赞助商风格补丁和标签：“農協牛乳”、“今野硝子工業”、“相模福祉村”以及一个标有“SC'S”的小徽章。在他身后站着他的人形替身，一个高大肌肉发达的装甲形象，有着金属橄榄金色的身体、心形胸章、狭长且令人生畏的眼睛，并举起拳头，周围环绕着锯齿状的紫色灵气火焰。在人物周围添加 4 个巨大的紫色漫画拟声词文字，每个都写着“ゴゴ…”，其中一个位于替身左上方，另外 3 个垂直堆叠在吉祥物左侧。在页面左侧，包含一个个人资料文本栏，由 6 条水平线分隔的日文文本组成：“スタンド使い名: ガミティ”、“性別: 男”、“見た目: ダチョウのマスコット”、“年齢: 不明”、“身長: 175cm”、“職業: マスコット / PR活動”。在右侧，放置一个巨大的尖刺状对话气泡，里面填满粗体的垂直日文文字：“オラオラオラオラオラ！ 前に出るぞ！絶対に負けねェーッ！ 相模原・共に行こうぜェーッ！”。在下方，添加一个右下角信息块，标题为“スタンド名:『オオサガミ・オオオォ！』”，副标题为“(SC相模原チャント「オオサガミオオオォー！」より)”，随后是一段以“スタンド能力:”为标题的段落，用密集的日文正文描述一种情感放大能力。在左下角，包含一个紫色填充的雷达图，6 个轴分别标注为：“破壊力 B”、“スピード B”、“射程距離 D”、“成長性 C”、“精密動作性 C”和“持続力 C”。整体构图应呈现出戏剧性的漫画杂志角色介绍页感，吉祥物在前，替身在后，运用强烈的透视缩短效果，充满动态的漫画能量，并在可爱的运动吉祥物与极其严肃的超自然战斗表现之间形成幽默的对比。

templates.title: JoJo-Style Stand Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: JoJo 风格替身角色海报

templates.prompt: A manga-style JoJo-inspired character card poster set in a narrow urban alley, with dramatic cel shading, heavy ink lines, stylized speed-line energy, and a vertical comic-page layout. The main subject is a young Japanese man, {argument name="character name" default="タカ・ハシ"}, age 19, shown from mid-thigh up in the left foreground, raising his right fist high in a triumphant pose while holding a handheld microphone near his mouth with his left hand. His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular mosaic blur. He has short messy {argument name="hair color" default="green"} hair and wears a fitted green track jacket with gold side stripes and a large golden phoenix emblem across the chest, zipped up, with black pants and black fingerless gloves. To his right and slightly behind him stands his humanoid Stand, {argument name="stand name" default="サガミ・サヴァイブ (SAGAMI SURVIVE)"}, a compact armored mascot-like figure with a rounded pale yellow bird head, sharp angry eyes, an orange beak, and a sleek white-and-green mechanical body with metallic silver musculature. The Stand has green shoulder armor, green gauntlets, gold trim, and a bold letter S on each side of its chest armor. It is posed punching forward with both fists, aggressive and energetic. Include exactly 4 distinct text panels and effects: 1 large white rectangular description box at the top right filled with dense Japanese text explaining the Stand, 1 jagged white speech bubble at the mid-right with vertical Japanese battle cries, 1 white character-info box at the bottom left with Japanese profile text, and 1 white stat box at the bottom right containing a radar chart labeled STAND PARAMETERS with Japanese and English category labels and a 5-line stat list. Add exactly 4 stylized purple sound-effect texts around the figures: 1 large "ゴゴゴゴ…" near the upper middle, 1 "ド" near the lower left, and 2 separate "ドド" effects near the lower center and lower right. The background is a gray-blue city alley with tall buildings receding in perspective. Overall tone: parody homage to JoJo's Bizarre Adventure character introductions, combining comic intensity with a goofy mascot Stand concept, polished manga poster composition, sharp print-like detail, and Japanese magazine page aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张漫画风格、受 JoJo 启发的角色卡海报，背景设在狭窄的城市小巷中，具有戏剧性的赛璐珞阴影、厚重的墨线、风格化的速度线能量以及垂直的漫画页面布局。主体是一名 19 岁的日本年轻男性，{argument name="character name" default="タカ・ハシ"}，从大腿中部以上展示在左侧前景，右手高举握拳呈胜利姿势，左手拿着手持麦克风靠近嘴边。他的脸部被刻意用矩形马赛克模糊处理。他留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="green"} 短发，身穿一件合身的绿色运动夹克，侧面带有金色条纹，胸前印有巨大的金色凤凰徽章，拉链拉上，搭配黑色长裤和黑色露指手套。在他右侧稍后方站着他的类人型替身 {argument name="stand name" default="サガミ・サヴァイブ (SAGAMI SURVIVE)"}，这是一个紧凑的装甲吉祥物形象，有着圆圆的淡黄色鸟头、愤怒的锐利双眼、橙色喙，以及光滑的白绿相间机械身体，带有金属银色的肌肉线条。该替身拥有绿色肩甲、绿色护手、金色饰边，胸甲两侧各有一个醒目的字母 S。它摆出双拳向前出击的姿势，充满攻击性和活力。包含 4 个独特的文字面板和特效：右上角 1 个大型白色矩形描述框，填满密集的日语文字以解释该替身；右中部 1 个锯齿状白色对话气泡，内含垂直排列的日语战斗呐喊；左下角 1 个白色角色信息框，内含日语个人资料；右下角 1 个白色属性框，包含一个标有 STAND PARAMETERS 的雷达图，带有日语和英语类别标签以及 5 行属性列表。在人物周围添加 4 个风格化的紫色拟声词文字：上中部附近 1 个巨大的“ゴゴゴゴ…”，左下角附近 1 个“ド”，以及下中部和右下角附近各 1 个“ドド”特效。背景是灰蓝色的城市小巷，高楼在透视中向后延伸。整体基调：对《JoJo 的奇妙冒险》角色介绍的恶搞致敬，结合了漫画的张力与滑稽的吉祥物替身概念，精致的漫画海报构图，锐利的印刷级细节，以及日本杂志页面的美学。

templates.title: Green Armored Dual-Sword Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 绿色铠甲双剑战士

templates.prompt: A dramatic single-character fantasy illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="female East Asian swordswoman general"} in a dynamic mid-action pose against a pure black background. She is shown from the thighs up, centered and filling most of the frame, with both arms extended wide while wielding two straight swords, one thrust toward the left side of the image and one angled toward the lower right foreground. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, but the rest of the figure is rendered in exquisite detail. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose strands whipping through the air, secured with an ornate green-and-gold hair ornament. She wears elaborate {argument name="armor color" default="deep green and antique gold"} lamellar armor with richly engraved metal plates, layered sleeves, heavy bracers, a sculpted breastplate, dragon-shaped shoulder armor, a decorative waist sash, and flowing fabric ribbons and cloak panels trailing around her. The costume mixes historical Chinese-inspired warrior attire with high-fantasy nobility, covered in intricate filigree, brocade patterns, metallic edging, and embossed details. Use cinematic lighting with bright highlights on the polished blades and armor, strong contrast, crisp edges, and luxurious texture work. The composition should feel like a premium game character key visual or collectible card illustration: elegant, fierce, heroic, highly detailed, semi-realistic anime painting style, black negative space, no scenery, no extra objects, no text, square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的单人奇幻插画，主角为一名 {argument name="character type" default="东亚女性剑客将军"}，呈现动态的动作姿态，背景为纯黑色。画面展示了她从大腿以上的部分，居中且占据大部分画幅，双臂向两侧伸展，手持两把直剑，一把向画面左侧刺出，另一把向右下方前景倾斜。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，但人物其余部分刻画得极其细腻。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发，扎成高马尾，发丝在空中飘舞，并配有华丽的绿金发饰。她身穿精致的 {argument name="armor color" default="深绿色与古金色"} 札甲，金属板上刻有繁复的花纹，搭配多层袖口、厚重的护腕、雕刻精美的胸甲、龙形肩甲、装饰性腰带，以及环绕周身的飘逸丝带和斗篷。服装融合了中国风历史战士装束与高魔奇幻贵族风格，布满了复杂的金银丝细工、锦缎图案、金属镶边和浮雕细节。采用电影级布光，在抛光的剑刃和铠甲上呈现明亮的高光，对比强烈，边缘清晰，质感奢华。构图应呈现出高端游戏角色主视觉图或收藏卡牌插画的质感：优雅、凶猛、英勇，高度细节化，半写实动漫绘画风格，黑色负空间，无背景，无额外物体，无文字，方形构图。

templates.title: Baroque Fantasy Idol Performance

titleLocalized.zh: 巴洛克幻想偶像表演

templates.prompt: A full-body fantasy anime-style illustration of a glamorous young idol-like woman performing on an ornate gilded stage inside a grand baroque palace hall. She stands in a dramatic low-angle pose on a carved gold balcony or platform, one leg forward and slightly crossed, with her left arm thrust toward the viewer in strong foreshortening and her other hand resting lightly at her chest. She has a slim, elegant build, very long flowing dark brown hair streaming in the air, and a decorative floral and ribbon headpiece. Her expression should feel confident, theatrical, and captivating. She wears an elaborate frilled performance dress in {argument name="dress colors" default="royal blue, crimson red, white, and gold"}: a fitted corset bodice with gold trim and red front panel, white lace bust and sleeves, layered short ruffled skirt, and large swirling overskirts and cape-like fabric panels edged with gold embroidery that billow dramatically around her. Add ornate ankle accessories with matching ribbon flowers, white heeled shoes or short boots, and luxurious detailed fabric textures. The setting is a richly decorated interior with 1 large glowing gothic arched window on the left, 1 heavy dark red velvet curtain framing the top and left side, 1 large classical oil painting in an ornate frame on the right wall, 1 tall carved column behind her, 1 abundant arrangement of roses and pale flowers at the lower left, and 1 gilded balustrade across the foreground. Warm golden backlight streams through the stained-glass-like window, creating a luminous halo, soft haze, rim light on her hair and costume, and deep cinematic shadows. A few rose petals drift in the air. Highly detailed, ultra-polished, romantic, majestic, dynamic composition, rich textures, painterly anime illustration with realistic lighting and luxurious fantasy idol aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅全身奇幻动漫风格插画，描绘了一位迷人的年轻偶像女性在宏伟的巴洛克宫殿大厅内，于华丽的镀金舞台上进行表演。她以戏剧性的低角度姿势站在雕刻精美的金色阳台或平台上，一条腿向前微屈交叉，左臂向观众方向伸出，呈现出强烈的透视感，另一只手轻放在胸前。她身材纤细优雅，深棕色的长发随风飘动，头戴装饰性的花朵与丝带头饰。她的表情自信、充满戏剧张力且引人入胜。她身着一套精致的荷叶边表演服，颜色为 {argument name="dress colors" default="宝蓝色、深红色、白色和金色"}：紧身胸衣饰有金边和红色前襟，白色蕾丝胸部和袖子，层叠的短款褶皱裙，以及边缘带有金色刺绣、如斗篷般在周围剧烈翻飞的大型旋涡状外裙。增加带有配套丝带花朵的华丽脚踝配饰、白色高跟鞋或短靴，以及奢华细腻的织物纹理。场景为装饰丰富的室内空间，左侧有一扇巨大的发光哥特式拱窗，顶部和左侧由厚重的深红色天鹅绒窗帘装点，右侧墙壁上挂着一幅装在华丽画框中的大型古典油画，身后有一根高大的雕花立柱，左下方摆放着一簇繁茂的玫瑰和浅色花卉，前景横跨着一道镀金栏杆。温暖的金色背光穿过类似彩色玻璃的窗户，营造出明亮的光晕、柔和的雾气、发丝与服装上的轮廓光，以及深邃的电影级阴影。几片玫瑰花瓣在空中飘落。高度细节化、极致打磨、浪漫、宏伟、动态构图，丰富的纹理，带有写实光影与奢华奇幻偶像美学的绘画风格动漫插画。

templates.title: Disposable Flash Tokyo Night Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 一次性胶片闪光灯东京夜景人像

templates.prompt: A cinematic candid night street photo in Tokyo shot from an extremely low ground-level angle, styled like a disposable film camera snapshot with direct on-camera flash, gritty realism, visible film grain, slight softness, deep shadows, strong contrast, and wet reflective pavement. In the center foreground, a {argument name="character gender presentation" default="androgynous young woman"} with {argument name="hair style" default="straight black bob covering part of the face"} crouches low with one hand pressed to the rain-soaked street, leaning toward the camera in a tense, fashion-editorial pose. The face is intentionally obscured by hair and shadow. She wears 4 visible clothing items: an oversized black blazer, a white dress shirt, a black necktie, and black shorts or a short skirt barely visible beneath the jacket. She also wears 3 visible accessories/details: a ring, a bracelet, and a pair of multicolored glittering lace-up ankle boots with a mosaic sequin look. Beside her on the right stands 1 black cat with bright reflective eyes, fully visible and alert, looking toward the camera. The setting is a narrow urban alley or side street at night with rain, slick asphalt, tangled utility cables and electrical boxes covering the left wall, and 2 vertical illuminated signs with Japanese text in the background. Overhead on the right side, dense blooming {argument name="tree blossoms" default="cherry blossoms"} fill the upper corner, creating a contrast between soft flowers and harsh city textures. Include distant bokeh from streetlights and storefronts, reflections of red, white, and yellow lights on the pavement, and a moody late-night atmosphere that feels spontaneous, raw, and slightly surreal. Use a wide lens perspective, documentary street photography composition, direct flash, disposable camera aesthetic, and {argument name="film mood" default="1990s Japanese nightlife snapshot"} realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在东京拍摄的电影感夜间街头抓拍照片，采用极低的地面视角，呈现出一次性胶片相机直闪拍摄的快照风格，具有粗粝的写实感、明显的胶片颗粒、轻微的柔焦、深邃的阴影、强烈的对比度以及湿润反光的路面。在前景中央，一位 {argument name="character gender presentation" default="中性风年轻女性"}，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="遮住部分脸庞的黑色直发波波头"}，低身蹲伏，一只手按在雨后湿漉漉的街道上，以一种紧张的时尚大片姿势向镜头倾斜。面部被头发和阴影刻意遮挡。她穿着 4 件可见的服饰：一件超大号黑色西装外套、一件白色衬衫、一条黑色领带，以及外套下隐约可见的黑色短裤或短裙。她还佩戴了 3 件可见的配饰/细节：一枚戒指、一只手镯，以及一双带有马赛克亮片外观、闪闪发光的彩色系带短靴。她右侧站着 1 只黑猫，眼睛明亮且具有反光感，完全可见且警觉地注视着镜头。场景设定在夜晚狭窄的城市小巷或侧街，伴有雨水、光滑的沥青路面、左侧墙上缠绕的电缆和配电箱，背景中有 2 个带有日文的垂直发光招牌。右上角上方，茂密盛开的 {argument name="tree blossoms" default="樱花"} 填满了角落，在柔和的花朵与粗犷的城市纹理之间形成对比。包含来自路灯和店面的远景虚化效果，路面上红色、白色和黄色的灯光倒影，以及一种自发、原始且略带超现实感的深夜忧郁氛围。使用广角镜头视角、纪实街头摄影构图、直闪灯、一次性相机美学以及 {argument name="film mood" default="1990 年代日本夜生活快照"} 的写实感。

templates.title: Dragon Queen in Black and Gold

titleLocalized.zh: 黑金龙之女王

templates.prompt: A majestic high-fantasy illustration of a regal dragon queen standing on the edge of a cliff, shown in full body and side profile facing left. She has {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair flowing in long layered strands far past her waist, a calm stern expression, and an elaborate crown-like headdress with multiple long horn-shaped golden spines sweeping backward. Her outfit is an ornate fusion of royal gown and armored bodysuit in {argument name="primary palette" default="black, ivory, and antique gold"}, covered with intricate filigree, vine-like gilded tracery, and elegant cracked-marble style patterns. The costume has 4 major visible garment elements: a fitted black-and-ivory armored torso, a long layered split skirt with flowing panels, a dark sweeping cape with gold trim, and thigh-high fitted leg armor or boots. She holds 1 long ceremonial sword planted vertically at her side, slim and highly decorative. Behind and around her rises the silhouette of 1 enormous black dragon with a long snarling head and vast arcing wings, its body framing her like a guardian shadow; the wings are detailed with subtle gold vein patterns. The background shows a pale, minimalist fantasy landscape with 1 distant gothic castle spire complex below, open plains, faint water or marshland, and far mountains under a soft cream sky. Composition is vertical, elegant, and cinematic, with the character centered slightly right, the dragon head to the upper left, and long ribbons and fabric streaming in the wind. Style is refined anime-inspired fantasy concept art with ultra-detailed linework, restrained colors, luminous ivory negative space, luxurious black-and-gold ornamentation, ethereal atmosphere, sharp silhouette design, and a noble sacred-draconic mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宏伟的高奇幻风格插画，描绘了一位站在悬崖边缘的龙族女王，展示全身侧面像，面向左侧。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的长发，发丝层叠垂落至腰部以下，表情冷静而严峻，头戴精致的皇冠状头饰，饰有多个向后延伸的长角状金色尖刺。她的服饰是皇家礼服与铠甲紧身衣的华丽融合，主色调为 {argument name="primary palette" default="黑色、象牙白和古金色"}，布满了复杂的金丝镶边、藤蔓般的镀金花纹以及优雅的裂纹大理石风格图案。服装包含 4 个主要的视觉元素：修身的黑白拼色铠甲躯干、带有飘逸裁片的层叠长裙、饰有金边的深色长披风，以及及大腿的紧身腿甲或长靴。她手持 1 把垂直伫立在身侧的仪式长剑，剑身纤细且装饰华丽。在她身后环绕着 1 条巨大的黑色巨龙剪影，巨龙头部狰狞，双翼宽大，其身躯如守护之影般环绕着她；双翼上绘有细腻的金色脉络图案。背景呈现出苍白、极简的奇幻景观，下方可见 1 座遥远的哥特式尖塔建筑群、开阔的平原、隐约的水域或沼泽，以及柔和奶油色天空下的远山。构图为竖向，优雅且具有电影感，角色略微偏右居中，龙首位于左上方，长丝带和布料在风中飘动。风格为精致的动漫风奇幻概念艺术，具有超细腻的线条、克制的色彩、明亮的象牙白负空间、奢华的黑金装饰、空灵的氛围、锐利的剪影设计，以及高贵神圣的龙族意境。

templates.title: Angelic Android Girl Above Earth

titleLocalized.zh: 地球上空的机甲天使少女

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime-style full-body illustration of a futuristic angelic android girl floating in outer space above Earth, shown in a dramatic diagonal action pose as if gliding or diving forward. She has short tousled {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with soft layered bangs, a slim feminine build, and a partially obscured face turned to the right. Her body is a mix of human and machine: 2 visible metallic robotic arms and 2 visible robotic legs with articulated black joints and polished silver armor plating. She wears a white ceremonial dress uniform with a fitted bodice, puffed short sleeves, gold trim, a flared skirt, and delicate white lace underskirt details. The chest and both sleeves each feature a luminous blue gem emblem with ornate gold eye-like decoration, for a total of 3 blue jewel insignias. Add a high collar with small gold star accents and a silver waist belt. She has 2 large mechanical feathered wings extending upward and outward from her back, each wing made of layered white feather-like panels attached to metallic segmented frames. Her left arm reaches back with open mechanical fingers while her legs are bent in mid-flight, one knee raised and the other leg extended downward. The background is deep black space filled with fine stars, with the curved horizon of Earth occupying the lower left and bottom edge, glowing with a bright blue atmospheric rim and visible white cloud patterns over the planet surface. Use cinematic rim lighting, glossy reflections on metal parts, crisp clean anime linework, highly detailed fabric folds, elegant sci-fi fantasy design, and a sense of weightless motion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫风格全身插画，描绘了一位漂浮在地球上方外太空的未来派机甲天使少女，她呈现出一种戏剧性的对角线动作姿态，仿佛正在滑翔或向前俯冲。她留着短而凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 头发，配有柔软的层次感刘海，身材纤细，面部部分被遮挡并转向右侧。她的身体融合了人类与机械特征：可见 2 只金属质感的机器人手臂和 2 条带有黑色关节及抛光银色装甲板的机器人腿。她身穿一件白色礼仪制服，配有修身胸衣、泡泡短袖、金色饰边、喇叭裙摆以及精致的白色蕾丝衬裙细节。胸部和双袖各镶嵌有一枚发光的蓝色宝石徽章，并带有华丽的金色眼状装饰，总计 3 枚蓝色宝石徽章。领口较高，饰有小巧的金色星星，腰间系有银色腰带。她的背部向外延伸出 2 只巨大的机械羽翼，每只翅膀由附着在金属分段框架上的层叠白色羽毛状面板组成。她的左臂向后伸展，机械手指张开，双腿在飞行中弯曲，一只膝盖抬起，另一条腿向下伸展。背景是深邃的黑色太空，布满细碎的星光，地球弯曲的地平线占据了左下方和底部边缘，散发着明亮的蓝色大气光环，行星表面可见白色的云层图案。采用电影级的轮廓光、金属部件上的光泽反射、清晰利落的动漫线条、高度细致的织物褶皱、优雅的科幻奇幻设计，以及失重运动的质感。

titleLocalized.zh: 地球上空的重返大气层航天飞机

templates.prompt: A cinematic hard-sci-fi space illustration of a futuristic space shuttle performing atmospheric reentry above Earth, viewed from a three-quarter front-left angle as it flies from right to left. The vehicle is a sleek white delta-wing orbiter with 2 vertical tail fins, 2 large rear engines, a pointed nose, dark cockpit windows, subtle panel lines, light weathering, and small black technical markings. The fuselage bears the text {argument name="ship name" default="STARSTREAK"}. A blazing reentry plasma sheath wraps around the nose, belly, wing edges, and upper rear body, forming a long turbulent orange-white fire trail that fills much of the upper background. The shuttle remains clearly visible inside the incandescent shock layer, with bright rim lighting and scorched warm reflections on the hull. Below, the curved Earth occupies the lower part of the frame with a thin blue atmospheric limb, cloud systems, ocean, and a visible spiral storm. Above is deep black-blue space with faint stars. promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的奇幻动漫插画，描绘了两位少年分别躺在透明水晶般的展示盒中，悬浮在黑暗的剧场空间里，两侧呈现出对比鲜明的主题。左侧盒子采用温暖的橄榄绿和金色调，盒中是一位冷静优雅的少年，留着浅金色短发，皮肤白皙，身穿黑色衬衫，系着松开的金色条纹领带，搭配米色长裤和黑色皮鞋，姿态放松，手持一朵小花靠近脸庞。他周围有 10 个清晰可见的装饰元素：1 个装满绿叶植物的牛皮纸袋、1 个金属马克杯、1 个柠檬、1 个斑马小雕像、1 本打开的书、1 朵向日葵、垂下的绿色藤蔓、许多漂浮的肥皂泡、玻璃上蚀刻的白色花卉图案，以及覆盖盒底的绿植。右侧盒子采用戏剧性的深红色和黑色调，盒中是一位顽皮自信的少年，留着凌乱的棕色中长发，皮肤白皙，身穿带有红色点缀和多层配饰的黑色服装，单膝抬起，嘴里咬着或手中拿着一朵红玫瑰。他周围有 10 个清晰可见的装饰元素：1 个骨白色的装饰物、1 颗多面红宝石、1 颗多面浅色宝石、1 个挂在链条上的卡片或标签、1 本红色的书、1 个托盘上包裹着的肉或食物、1 个狮子小雕像、1 个红色零食袋、盒底的爪痕，以及闪烁的红色水晶碎片。背景在两个盒子之间垂直分裂，呈现出星光熠熠的宇宙缝隙，配有垂下的窗帘、三角形彩旗串、红色一侧隐约可见的爪印图案，以及总共 4 个气球：左侧 2 个为白色和橄榄绿色，右侧 2 个为红色和黑色。构图华丽、光泽感强且具有电影质感，玻璃上有戏剧性的反射，高光丰富，漂浮的微粒，奢华的质感，复杂的道具，营造出怀旧的故事书氛围。以精致的现代动漫主视觉风格渲染，超细节，优雅，梦幻且充满情感共鸣。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Wounded Monk Portrait

templates.prompt: A moody dark fantasy anime illustration of a wounded young man with {argument name="hair color" default="ash blond"} short tousled hair, sitting slumped on the floor against a cracked white plaster wall. His face is mostly turned away and partially obscured in shadow, giving him a mysterious, exhausted presence. He wears a loose black kimono robe hanging open at the chest, exposing a lean muscular torso, with a deep red sash at the waist. A long strand of dark crimson prayer beads hangs around his neck, with more beads tangled in one hand and spilled across the floor. Beside him rests an ornate black ceremonial staff with circular rings and a spear-like finial, leaning diagonally against his shoulder. The wall behind him is streaked with dramatic dark red blood smears and drips near the upper right, suggesting a recent battle. On the floor in the foreground are scattered prayer beads, broken metallic ornaments, several paper talismans or ofuda slips with black calligraphy, and a single red flower. Warm late-afternoon light cuts across the scene from the left, creating strong highlights and deep shadows over the robe folds, hand, chest, and wall texture. Painterly brushwork, highly detailed fabric and skin rendering, melancholic atmosphere, elegant gothic composition, vertical portrait framing, cinematic anime key visual style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满暗黑奇幻氛围的动漫插画，描绘了一位受伤的年轻男子，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="灰金色"} 的凌乱短发，瘫坐在斑驳的白色灰泥墙边。他的面部大多背对镜头并隐没在阴影中，透出一种神秘而疲惫的气质。他身穿一件宽松的黑色和服长袍，胸前敞开，露出精瘦的肌肉线条，腰间系着深红色的腰带。一串深红色的念珠挂在他的颈间，另一串念珠缠绕在他手中，散落在地板上。他身旁斜靠着一根装饰繁复的黑色法杖，杖头带有圆环和矛状尖端，斜倚在他的肩头。身后的墙壁上，右上角有明显的深红色血迹和滴痕，暗示着刚刚经历了一场战斗。前景的地板上散落着念珠、破碎的金属饰品、几张写有黑色书法文字的纸质符咒，以及一朵红花。午后温暖的阳光从左侧斜射入画面，在长袍褶皱、手部、胸膛和墙面纹理上形成了强烈的明暗对比。画作采用油画笔触，织物与皮肤质感刻画细腻，氛围忧郁，构图优雅，采用竖版肖像构图，呈现出电影级的动漫关键视觉风格。

templates.title: Red-Haired Masked Samurai Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 红发蒙面武士肖像

templates.prompt: A dramatic anime-style portrait of a lone swordsman with an androgynous, elegant presence, shown from mid-thigh up in a three-quarter view, staring intensely at the viewer with narrowed golden eyes. The character has {argument name="hair color" default="deep crimson red"} hair, long and layered with loose messy strands, plus one very long thick braid draped over the front of the body and decorated with turquoise beads and tassels. They wear a dark metallic half-mask covering the lower face, multiple ear piercings with red and silver ornaments, and a confident, dangerous expression. One hand rests behind the neck holding a katana across the shoulders; the sword has a black hilt with red accents and a reflective blade. The outfit is a richly detailed fantasy-meets-feudal-Japanese ensemble: muted brown inner kimono, wide navy and magenta waist wraps, a large golden obi tied loosely, dangling bead ornaments, and a black outer robe lined in red with a fluffy pale fur collar. Add a large red sun emblem on the robe sleeve and teal accessories at the waist. The palette is dominated by red, black, gold, cream, and deep blue. The background is a decorative Japanese-inspired painting with a large glowing red-orange sun disk behind the head, red plum blossoms, smoky cloud-like swirls, parchment-textured beige and charcoal tones, and scattered gold leaf splashes. Highly detailed digital illustration, painterly anime rendering, ornate textures, refined linework, moody lighting, luxurious fabric folds, samurai aesthetic, elegant and fierce atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅戏剧性的动漫风格肖像，描绘了一位拥有中性、优雅气质的独行剑客。画面采用四分之三侧身视角，展示从大腿中部以上的半身像，角色正用狭长的金色双眼凝视着观众。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深绯红色"} 的头发，长发层次分明且带有凌乱的碎发，另有一条垂在身前、装饰着绿松石珠子和流苏的粗长辫子。他们佩戴着遮住下半脸的深色金属半面具，耳朵上有多处红色和银色饰品，表情自信而危险。一只手搭在颈后，横握着一把架在肩上的武士刀；刀柄为黑色并带有红色点缀，刀刃具有反光质感。服装是奇幻与封建日本风格的精细结合：内穿暗棕色和服，腰间缠绕着海军蓝与洋红色的腰封，系着一条宽松的金色腰带，挂有珠饰，外罩一件内衬为红色的黑色长袍，领口带有蓬松的浅色毛领。长袍袖口饰有巨大的红色太阳徽章，腰间配有青色饰品。色调以红、黑、金、米白和深蓝为主。背景为一幅装饰性的日式画作，头后方有一个巨大的发光红橙色太阳圆盘，点缀着红梅花、烟雾状的云纹、羊皮纸质感的米色与炭灰色调，以及零星的金箔飞溅。高细节数字插画，绘画感动漫渲染，华丽的纹理，精致的线条，情绪化的光影，奢华的布料褶皱，武士美学，优雅而凶猛的氛围。

templates.prompt: A 360-degree equirectangular anime-style VR bedroom scene viewed from a first-person perspective on a bed, with a young adult woman leaning very close toward the viewer in the center of the frame. She has {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} hair in a smooth bob with side-swept bangs, small earrings, and wears a fitted {argument name="shirt color" default="slate blue"} button-up blouse with the top buttons open and matching dark blue pants. Her pose is intimate and immersive: kneeling and straddling over the viewer on a rumpled white bed, one arm extended forward toward the camera and the other bracing on the mattress, as if reaching out inside a VR experience. The room is a warm, softly lit modern bedroom with beige walls and recessed ceiling lights, a dark wooden door on the left, a TV on a low dresser, a second dresser with framed photos, a centered window with sheer white curtains and darker gray drapes, two bedside tables with glowing lamps, one tall potted plant near the window, and one dark wooden bookshelf on the right. Include exactly 2 framed wall pictures, 2 bedside lamps, 2 potted plants, 2 dressers, 1 TV, 1 bookshelf, 1 door, and 1 window. Use a panoramic ultra-wide 360 VR distortion with curved walls and stretched bed edges, polished anime rendering, soft warm evening lighting, detailed bedding folds, clean interior design, and a realistic virtual-tour atmosphere.

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Four-Armed Heroine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻四臂女英雄封面

templates.prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy light-novel cover illustration in a square format, featuring a fierce female warrior centered in a dynamic lunging pose inside a dim, ruined, cathedral-like or industrial gothic interior with a smoky blurred background and warm floating embers. She has long silver-white hair in a high ponytail whipping violently to the right, pale skin, and a deliberately obscured or featureless face. Her body is enhanced with four black mechanical arms in total, built from intricate clockwork and segmented metal joints, extending spider-like around her. She wears a tattered black dress-like battle outfit with armored corset detailing, belts, straps, a garter on one thigh, and biomechanical leg armor. Count exactly 4 arms visible: 2 upper arms and 2 lower arms; count exactly 4 glowing energy blades, one held in each hand, translucent neon blue with crystalline edges and magical circuitry-like light patterns. Emphasize the contrast between matte black metal, torn fabric, pale skin, and electric cyan weapons. The composition should feel cinematic, high-detail, intense, and heroic, with sharp focus on the character and soft depth-of-field in the background. Add ornate Japanese cover typography in metallic gold with subtle beveling and glow: at the top, small genre text 《バトルアクション》; below it, a large main title {argument name="headline text" default="クアッドアームの静寂"}; beneath that, a smaller subtitle ～四本腕の女傭兵と錆びついた世界の約束～. Near the bottom, add a large centered quote in gold Japanese text {argument name="quote" default="「僕は君の未来を高値で買いに来た」"}; directly below it, a smaller line ——時計仕掛けの運命が、今動き出す. At the very bottom center, place the author name {argument name="author name" default="ざっ"} in large gold text with elegant ornamental divider lines on both sides. Use a luxurious fantasy-book-cover layout, moody sepia-and-charcoal palette with bright cyan highlights, ultra-detailed anime-inspired realism, and a polished GPT-image-2 editorial illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的暗黑奇幻轻小说封面插画，采用正方形构图。画面中心是一位身姿矫健的女性战士，她正处于动态的突刺姿势中，背景是昏暗、废弃的教堂式或工业哥特式室内场景，伴有烟雾缭绕的模糊背景和漂浮的暖色余烬。她留着银白色长发，高马尾向右侧剧烈甩动，皮肤苍白，面部刻意模糊或无五官。她的身体由总共 4 条黑色机械手臂强化，这些手臂由复杂的发条和分段式金属关节构成，像蜘蛛一样在她周围延伸。她身穿破损的黑色战裙，带有盔甲束腰细节、皮带、绑带、单侧大腿袜圈以及生物机械腿甲。确保可见手臂正好 4 条：2 条上臂和 2 条下臂；确保有 4 把发光的能量利刃，每只手中持有一把，利刃呈半透明的霓虹蓝色，带有结晶边缘和类似魔法电路的光纹。强调哑光黑金属、破损布料、苍白皮肤与电光青色武器之间的对比。构图应具有电影感、高细节、张力十足且充满英雄气概，角色焦点清晰，背景具有柔和的景深效果。添加华丽的日式封面排版，采用带有细微斜面和光泽的金属金色：顶部为小型流派文字《バトルアクション》；下方为大型主标题 {argument name="headline text" default="クアッドアームの静寂"}；其下为较小的副标题 ～四本腕の女傭兵と錆びついた世界の約束～。底部附近添加一行居中的金色日文引言 {argument name="quote" default="「僕は君の未来を高値で買いに来た」"}；其正下方为较小的一行文字 ——時計仕掛けの運命が、今動き出す。最底部居中位置放置作者名 {argument name="author name" default="ざっ"}，使用大型金色字体，两侧配有优雅的装饰性分割线。采用奢华的奇幻书籍封面布局，色调为忧郁的深褐色与炭灰色，并点缀明亮的青色高光，呈现超精细的动漫风格写实感以及精致的 GPT-image-2 编辑插画风格。

templates.title: Anime Split-Apartment Romance Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格“公寓隔墙”恋爱小说封面

templates.prompt:
A cinematic anime-style vertical book-cover illustration for a romantic comedy light novel with slight fantasy atmosphere, split by a thin apartment wall down the center. On the left side, a warm, cozy kitchen glows in amber light from a hanging pendant lamp. A {argument name="female character name" default="Nanako Iida"}, age 28, stands in three-quarter view holding a deep plate of freshly cooked food with visible steam rising in elegant curls. She has dark hair tied in a messy bun, soft bangs, a gentle mature expression, and wears a lavender knit sweater under a white apron. The kitchen contains exact visible details: 1 hanging lamp, 1 upper shelf with cookware, 5 hanging utensils, 1 cutting board, 1 knife block, and 6 small bottles or jars lined across the foreground counter. On the right side, a dim, cool-toned bachelor bedroom is lit in blue shadows. A {argument name="male character name" default="Sota Ninomiya"}, age 26, slim but muscular, with tousled dark hair and a fitted charcoal T-shirt, leans one hand against the wall as if sensing the aroma through it. His room contains 1 bed, 1 bookshelf, 1 desk lamp, and 1 wall poster. A ribbon of steam drifts from the dish across the center wall into his side, visually connecting them. The mood is intimate, sensual, and slightly teasing, emphasizing the contrast between warm home cooking and lonely nighttime restraint. Add elegant Japanese vertical catch copy on the wall and upper right, small white serif-style name labels beside both characters with their ages, and a large bold Japanese title block across the lower middle. Include these exact text elements: left name label "Nanako Iida 28歳", right name label "Sota Ninomiya 26歳", vertical wall text "その香りが、ふたりの距離を、そっと溶かしていく。", upper-right vertical text "隣人は、優しい香りと、秘密のレシピ。", large center title "《飯テロ恋愛小説》
夜中に読まないでください〜
〜お隣のストイックくんは、
隣のお姉さんの愛の飯テロに勝てない〜", and bottom tagline "毎晩続く深夜の罪な料理の香り。
壁一枚の距離と心を溶かす". Highly polished promotional cover art, soft bloom lighting, detailed fabric folds, realistic steam, romantic tension, glossy illustrated publishing design.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张电影质感的动漫风格竖版书籍封面插画，适用于带有轻微奇幻氛围的浪漫喜剧轻小说，画面中央被一堵薄薄的公寓墙壁一分为二。左侧是一个温暖舒适的厨房，悬挂的吊灯散发出琥珀色的光芒。一位 {argument name="female character name" default="饭田菜菜子"}，28 岁，以四分之三侧面站立，手中端着一盘热气腾腾、香气四溢的刚出锅料理。她留着深色凌乱的发髻，刘海柔和，表情温柔成熟，身穿紫色针织毛衣，外罩白色围裙。厨房细节清晰可见：1 盏吊灯，1 个放置厨具的上方搁板，5 个悬挂的餐具，1 个切菜板，1 个刀架，以及前景台面上排列的 6 个小瓶罐。右侧是一个昏暗、冷色调的单身卧室，笼罩在蓝色阴影中。一位 {argument name="male character name" default="二宫飒太"}，26 岁，身材精瘦结实，留着凌乱的深色短发，穿着合身的炭灰色 T 恤，一只手靠在墙上，仿佛隔墙闻到了香气。他的房间里有 1 张床、1 个书架、1 盏台灯和 1 张墙面海报。一缕蒸汽从盘中飘出，穿过中央墙壁进入他的房间，在视觉上将两人连接起来。氛围亲密、感性且略带戏谑，强调了温暖的家常菜与深夜孤独克制之间的对比。在墙面和右上角添加优雅的日文竖排宣传语，在两位角色旁边添加白色衬线风格的小字姓名标签及年龄，并在画面中下部添加醒目的日文大标题。包含以下确切文本元素：左侧姓名标签“Nanako Iida 28歳”，右侧姓名标签“Sota Ninomiya 26歳”，墙面竖排文字“その香りが、ふたりの距離を、そっと溶かしていく。”，右上角竖排文字“隣人は、優しい香りと、秘密のレシピ。”，中央大标题“《飯テロ恋愛小説》
夜中に読まないでください〜
〜お隣のストイックくんは、
隣のお姉さんの愛の飯テロに勝てない〜”，以及底部标语“毎晩続く深夜の罪な料理の香り。
壁一枚の距離と心を溶かす”。高质感的宣传封面艺术，柔和的辉光照明，细腻的布料褶皱，逼真的蒸汽效果，浪漫的张力，光泽感十足的出版物插画设计。

templates.title: Epic Fantasy Mecha Light Novel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗奇幻机甲轻小说封面

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration for a fantasy mecha isekai story. Vertical poster composition with a huge heroic humanoid robot dominating the center foreground, viewed from a slightly low angle to make it monumental. The robot is sleek and ornate, with white and silver armor, rich gold trim, glowing cyan energy lines, a radiant emerald-green core in the chest, a crown-like crest on the helmet, and a long royal blue cape with gold edging. Behind its back spread multiple crystalline energy wings, about 8 large translucent green shards fanning out symmetrically like luminous blades. In its left hand it holds a long fantasy-tech spear with a blue glowing blade and gold mechanical detailing. At the robot’s feet are 2 human characters: on the left, a red-haired fantasy heroine with very long braided hair, leather-and-fabric adventurer clothing, and a determined expression, looking up at the robot; on the right, a young male protagonist with short dark hair in a fantasy tunic and cloak, reaching one hand up toward the giant machine in awe and urgency, seen mostly from behind. The setting is an epic ruined sci-fi fantasy world with towering gothic spires, broken city structures, drifting smoke, dramatic clouds, and a sky filled with stars, planets, streaks of lightning, and 8 small flying warships scattered in the distance. Highly polished anime key visual style, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, intense contrast, blue-green-gold color palette, heroic atmosphere, intricate mechanical rendering, fantasy worldbuilding, premium game or novel cover finish. Add large Japanese title typography at the top: 《{argument name="tagline text" default="本格異世界SFロボット戦記"}》 above a massive metallic logo reading {argument name="series title" default="ASTRAIA"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle line beneath it. Add a large dramatic Japanese catchphrase at the bottom in glowing white and gold text over 2 lines: {argument name="bottom catchphrase" default="乗って！ユウキ！ その叫びが、世界の運命を決めた！"}. Keep the overall design dense, premium, and readable as a commercial cover, with the central robot as the unmistakable focal point.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的日式轻小说封面插画，主题为奇幻机甲异世界故事。采用竖版海报构图，画面中心前景由一台巨大的英雄式人形机器人占据，采用略微仰视的视角，彰显其宏伟感。机器人造型流畅且华丽，身披白银色装甲，饰有丰富的金色镶边，流淌着青色能量线条，胸口镶嵌着璀璨的翡翠绿核心，头盔上带有皇冠状饰物，背部垂下一条镶金边的皇家蓝长披风。其身后展开多片晶体能量翼，约 8 片巨大的半透明绿色碎片如发光刀刃般对称扇形排开。左手持有一柄长款奇幻科技长枪，枪刃散发着蓝色光芒，并带有金色机械细节。机器人脚下站着 2 位人类角色：左侧是一位红发奇幻女主角，留着极长的辫子，身穿皮革与布料拼接的冒险者服装，神情坚定，正仰望着机器人；右侧是一位短发黑发的年轻男主角，身穿奇幻束腰外衣和斗篷，正满怀敬畏与急切地向巨型机甲伸出一只手，主要以背影示人。背景设定为一个史诗般的废墟科幻奇幻世界，耸立着哥特式尖塔，建筑残骸遍布，烟雾缭绕，云层壮观，天空中点缀着繁星、行星、闪电轨迹，远处散布着 8 艘小型飞行战舰。采用高精度的动漫主视觉风格，细节极致，电影级光影，对比强烈，采用蓝、绿、金配色，氛围英雄气概十足，机械渲染细腻，充满奇幻世界观，呈现出高级游戏或小说封面的质感。在顶部添加醒目的日文标题排版：在巨大的金属质感 Logo {argument name="series title" default="ASTRAIA"} 上方添加《{argument name="tagline text" default="本格異世界SFロボット戦記"}》，下方配有一行较小的日文副标题。在底部添加一行醒目且充满戏剧性的日文宣传语，以发光的白金字体分 2 行显示：{argument name="bottom catchphrase" default="乗って！ユウキ！ その叫びが、世界の運命を決めた！"}。整体设计保持紧凑、高级且易读，符合商业封面标准，并确保中央机器人成为绝对的视觉焦点。

templates.title: Epic Momotaro Fantasy Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级桃太郎奇幻封面

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration in high-detail anime fantasy style, square composition, showing a heroic ensemble posed for battle in a ruined mountain pass at sunset with cherry blossoms blowing through the air. The scene centers on {argument name="hero title" default="Momotaro"}, a young black-haired male warrior in glossy red samurai armor, crouched in the foreground and gripping a katana diagonally across his body. Beside him in the front-right foreground is a black-haired young woman in matching red armor with a high ponytail, also drawing a katana in a dynamic combat-ready pose. Around them stand 5 additional companions for a total of 7 characters: 1 brown-haired short-haired girl at front-left holding a short blade, 1 silver-haired angelic woman at upper-left with large white wings and a drawn bow, 1 tall red-haired warrior at top-center carrying a large weapon over the shoulder, 1 long straight black-haired shrine-maiden-like girl at upper-center-right in white and red with light armor, and 1 blonde girl at right holding a large ornate war hammer. Add a distant Japanese castle on the right background, jagged rocks and broken ground, glowing embers, drifting petals, and a luminous cloudy sky with strong backlight behind the group. Use cinematic fantasy lighting, epic adventure mood, polished painterly rendering, sharp detailed armor, flowing hair, layered depth, and a bold heroic poster feel. Include large Japanese title text across the top in metallic gold with black outline reading {argument name="top title text" default="《御伽話ファンタジー》シン・桃太郎伝"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it in white with dark outline reading {argument name="top subtitle text" default="～追放・転生した元神は、おとぎ話の世界の美少女たちと世界を救う!!"}. Include large Japanese promotional text across the bottom in bright red with white outline reading {argument name="bottom catch text" default="追放、転生した神・桃太郎。御伽話の美少女たちと試練乗り越えて鬼退治！"}. Make it look like a commercial fantasy web novel or manga cover image, energetic, crowded, and visually striking.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日式轻小说封面插画，采用高细节动漫奇幻风格，方形构图，展示了一群英雄在日落时分的荒废山口摆出战斗姿态，樱花在空中飘落。场景中心为 {argument name="hero title" default="桃太郎"}，一位留着黑发的年轻男战士，身穿亮红色武士盔甲，蹲伏在前景中，斜握着一把武士刀。在他右前方的是一位留着高马尾、同样身穿红色盔甲的黑发年轻女性，也正处于拔刀的动态战斗姿态。在他们周围还有 5 位同伴，总计 7 名角色：左前方是一位留着棕色短发的女孩，手持短刃；左上方是一位留着银色长发、拥有巨大白翼并拉弓的天使般女性；正上方是一位扛着巨型武器的高大红发战士；中右上方是一位留着黑色直长发、身穿红白相间轻甲的巫女风格女孩；右侧是一位手持华丽大战锤的金发女孩。背景右侧添加一座遥远的日本城堡、嶙峋的岩石和破碎的地面、发光的余烬、飘落的花瓣，以及在群体后方带有强烈背光的光亮云层天空。运用电影级的奇幻光影、史诗般的冒险氛围、精致的绘画质感、锐利的盔甲细节、飘逸的头发、层叠的景深，以及大胆的英雄海报感。顶部包含醒目的金属金色带黑色描边的日文标题文字 {argument name="top title text" default="《御伽話ファンタジー》シン・桃太郎伝"}，下方配有较小的白色带深色描边的日文副标题 {argument name="top subtitle text" default="～追放・転生した元神は、おとぎ話の世界の美少女たちと世界を救う!!"}。底部包含醒目的亮红色带白色描边的日文宣传文字 {argument name="bottom catch text" default="追放、転生した神・桃太郎。御伽話の美少女たちと試練乗り越えて鬼退治！"}。整体呈现出商业奇幻网络小说或漫画封面的视觉效果，充满活力、构图饱满且极具视觉冲击力。
