templates.title: Painterly Steampunk Girl Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 油画风格蒸汽朋克少女肖像

templates.prompt: A painterly steampunk fantasy portrait of a young woman shown from about thigh-up in side profile, facing left, standing in a narrow workshop filled with mechanical parts and clockwork. She has long, voluminous, curly {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair cascading down her back, with a few loose strands glowing against the background. A pair of large brass aviator goggles with iridescent blue-purple lenses rests on top of her head. Her outfit is a romantic steampunk dress: a rich {argument name="dress color" default="deep cobalt blue"} bodice and skirt, a high-necked white blouse with ruffled trim and puffed sleeves, layered frills at the collar and hem, and multiple tan leather straps and buckles cinched around the waist and torso. She carries a medium brown leather backpack with rounded flap and visible buckles over one shoulder. The setting is dense with industrial details on both sides: exposed pipes, valves, hanging instruments, circular gauges, and several visible gears, including 1 large gear in the upper right and multiple ring-like metal components along the walls. Use an expressive oil-painting style with thick impasto brushstrokes, soft edges, and a dreamy handcrafted texture. The palette should contrast cool dusty blues and teals in the background with warm brass, copper, amber, and honey highlights on the machinery and hair. The mood is whimsical, adventurous, and slightly nostalgic, like a storybook steampunk inventor’s atelier. Vertical composition, character centered slightly right of frame, background softly abstracted but packed with mechanical forms, no readable text, no modern elements, and keep the face obscured by a simple centered rectangular blur block in a muted tan-brown tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张油画风格的蒸汽朋克奇幻肖像，描绘了一位侧身向左、约大腿以上部位的年轻女性，她正站在一个布满机械零件和发条装置的狭窄工作室中。她留着一头浓密卷曲的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 长发，发丝垂落在背部，几缕散落的发丝在背景衬托下闪烁着微光。头顶戴着一副巨大的黄铜飞行员护目镜，镜片呈现出虹彩般的蓝紫色。她穿着一件浪漫的蒸汽朋克风格连衣裙：深 {argument name="dress color" default="钴蓝色"} 的紧身胸衣和裙摆，搭配带有褶边装饰和泡泡袖的高领白色衬衫，领口和下摆处有层叠的荷叶边，腰部和躯干处束有多条棕褐色皮带和扣环。她单肩背着一个带有圆形翻盖和可见扣环的中棕色皮质背包。背景两侧布满了密集的工业细节：裸露的管道、阀门、悬挂的仪器、圆形仪表以及多个清晰可见的齿轮，包括右上角的一个大齿轮和沿墙壁分布的多个环状金属组件。采用富有表现力的油画风格，运用厚涂笔触、柔和的边缘和梦幻般的手工质感。色调上，背景中冷峻的灰蓝色和青色与机械及发丝上温暖的黄铜色、铜色、琥珀色和蜂蜜色高光形成鲜明对比。氛围奇幻、充满冒险感且略带怀旧气息，宛如故事书中蒸汽朋克发明家的工作室。竖构图，角色位于画面中偏右位置，背景经过柔化处理但充满了机械形态，无可见文字，无现代元素，面部由一个位于中心、色调为柔和棕褐色的矩形模糊块遮挡。

templates.title: Steampunk Cat Airship Over the Sea

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克猫咪飞艇掠过海面

templates.prompt: A whimsical fantasy oil painting of a gigantic flying steamship shaped like a cat, drifting above a bright ocean under a clear blue sky filled with soft pink clouds. The vessel dominates the composition in a low-angle three-quarter view from the front-left, making it feel monumental and airborne. Its hull is rounded and bulbous like a zeppelin-ship hybrid, painted pastel pink and lavender with warm peach highlights, and the bow is sculpted into the face of a fluffy cat with pale pink fur, pointed ears, luminous blue eyes, a small nose, and a huge open mouth lined with sharp dark teeth like a bizarre figurehead-jaw entrance. Ornate gilded brass trim, filigree, railings, pipes, rivets, balconies, portholes, hanging ornaments, and decorative mechanical fittings cover the ship. There are 4 tall smokestacks rising from the top deck, each striped in warm copper, red, and gold, releasing thick cotton-candy pink smoke that curls painterly into the sky. The upper deck is crowded with intricate Victorian steampunk details, domes, spires, lamp-like finials, tiny structures, and a small golden cat statue near the front. A suspended gondola or platform hangs beneath the belly of the ship with tiny visible machinery and a reddish-orange base. In the distance, 3 smaller ships appear near the horizon over choppy teal water, reinforcing the scale. The sea below is painted with lively waves and white foam. Use an imaginative storybook steampunk aesthetic with rich impasto brushstrokes, visible painterly texture, glowing sunlight, romantic pastel colors, and a dreamlike mood reminiscent of a fantastical maritime voyage. Vertical composition, highly detailed, magical, surreal, elegant, and playful.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满奇幻色彩的油画，描绘了一艘巨大的猫形蒸汽飞艇，漂浮在晴朗蓝天和柔和粉云下的明亮海洋之上。飞艇以左前方低角度的四分之三视角占据了画面主体，营造出宏伟的空中感。其船体圆润饱满，结合了齐柏林飞艇的造型，呈现出淡粉色和薰衣草色，并带有温暖的桃色高光。船头雕刻成一只毛茸茸的猫脸，拥有浅粉色的皮毛、尖尖的耳朵、明亮的蓝色眼睛、小巧的鼻子，以及一张巨大的、露出锋利深色牙齿的开口，宛如怪诞的船首像入口。船身覆盖着华丽的镀金黄铜饰边、金银丝工艺、栏杆、管道、铆钉、阳台、舷窗、悬挂饰品和装饰性机械配件。顶层甲板耸立着 4 根高大的烟囱，每根烟囱都带有暖铜色、红色和金色的条纹，喷涌出浓厚的棉花糖粉色烟雾，在天空中卷曲出油画般的质感。上层甲板布满了复杂的维多利亚蒸汽朋克细节，包括圆顶、尖塔、灯状饰顶、微型建筑以及船头附近的一座小型金色猫雕像。船腹下方悬挂着一个吊舱或平台，可以看到微小的机械装置和红橙色的底座。远处，波涛汹涌的青色水面上，地平线附近出现了 3 艘较小的船只，进一步突显了比例感。下方的海面描绘着生动的波浪和白色泡沫。采用富有想象力的故事书蒸汽朋克美学，结合浓厚的厚涂笔触、可见的绘画纹理、明亮的阳光、浪漫的柔和色彩，以及令人联想到奇幻海上航行的梦幻氛围。竖构图，高度细节化，充满魔幻、超现实、优雅且俏皮的风格。

templates.prompt: A minimalist cinematic poster on a tall vertical canvas with an off-white textured paper background and a dark matte stage platform at the bottom, dominated by giant condensed black sans-serif letters spelling {argument name="main title" default="SAM ALTMAN"} across nearly the full height of the composition, with the first word stacked above and overlapping the second. Replace one central vertical letterform with a glowing open doorway, outlined in warm orange-red light, revealing a bright sunrise sky and a distant cityscape beyond. On the stage, place 1 lone adult man seen from behind in three-quarter profile, walking toward the doorway, wearing a dark crewneck sweater, dark pants, and light sneakers, with realistic proportions and subtle dramatic rim lighting. To the upper right of the typography, add 3 small lines of spaced uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline line 1" default="AI."}, {argument name="tagline line 2" default="POWER."}, and {argument name="tagline line 3" default="POSSIBILITY."}. In the lower left corner, add 1 small orange credit line reading {argument name="credit text" default="OPENAI CEO"}. Use strong scale contrast, lots of negative space, editorial magazine-cover styling, clean modern layout, muted neutral tones with one warm orange accent, realistic lighting, subtle film grain, and a sophisticated futuristic mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义的电影感海报，采用高垂直画布，背景为米白色纹理纸张，底部为深色哑光舞台平台。画面主体为巨大的黑色紧凑型无衬线字母，拼写出 {argument name="main title" default="SAM ALTMAN"}，几乎占据了整个构图的高度，第一个单词堆叠在第二个单词上方并与之重叠。将其中一个中央垂直字母替换为一个发光的开放式门廊，轮廓呈现温暖的橙红色光芒，显露出明亮的日出天空和远处的城市景观。在舞台上，放置 1 位从背后看去呈四分之三侧面的成年男性，正走向门廊，身穿深色圆领毛衣、深色长裤和浅色运动鞋，比例真实，并带有微妙的戏剧性轮廓光。在排版的右上角，添加 3 行间距较大的大写文本，内容为 {argument name="tagline line 1" default="AI."}，{argument name="tagline line 2" default="POWER."}，以及 {argument name="tagline line 3" default="POSSIBILITY."}。在左下角，添加 1 行小型的橙色致谢文字，内容为 {argument name="credit text" default="OPENAI CEO"}。运用强烈的比例对比、大量的留白、杂志封面式的编辑风格、简洁现代的布局、柔和的中性色调并辅以一抹温暖的橙色点缀，呈现出逼真的光影、细腻的胶片颗粒感以及精致的未来主义氛围。

templates.title: Surreal Clockwork Gentleman on a Gear

titleLocalized.zh: 齿轮上的超现实发条绅士

templates.prompt: A surreal impasto oil painting in the spirit of a late-19th-century post-impressionist masterpiece, showing a stout gentleman in a patterned golden-blue suit and tall top hat balancing awkwardly on a giant bronze gear high above a sunlit canal city. His face is obscured by a centered vertical rectangular censor block in warm brown, creating an intentional anonymous focal interruption. He wears a richly textured jacket with mosaic-like patches of ochre, cobalt, rust, and cream, matching trousers, heavy leather boots, and a waist area that opens into an exposed clockwork mechanism full of gears and ornate brass details. His body leans forward with both hands extended as if trying to keep balance, one boot planted on the gear and the other lifted slightly outward. The background is an airy blue sky with swirling painterly clouds and scattered gold brushstrokes, while below and to the left appears a historic bell tower and arched waterfront architecture, and to the right distant terracotta rooftops beside shimmering water. Use thick visible brushstrokes, luminous warm highlights, bold blue-and-gold contrast, expressive texture, and a whimsical steampunk-meets-Venetian atmosphere. Compose the figure large and central, slightly cropped by the frame, with the giant gear visible beneath him and the city receding below.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超现实主义厚涂油画，带有 19 世纪末后印象派杰作的神韵。画面展示了一位穿着图案华丽的金蓝色西装、戴着高礼帽的健壮绅士，正笨拙地平衡在阳光明媚的运河城市上方的一个巨型青铜齿轮上。他的脸部被一个居中的垂直长方形棕色遮挡块掩盖，营造出一种刻意的匿名焦点中断感。他穿着一件质感丰富的夹克，上面有赭石色、钴蓝色、铁锈色和奶油色的马赛克式补丁，搭配同色系长裤和厚重的皮靴；他的腰部敞开，露出内部充满齿轮和华丽黄铜细节的发条装置。他的身体向前倾斜，双手伸展仿佛在努力保持平衡，一只靴子踩在齿轮上，另一只微微向外抬起。背景是带有漩涡状笔触云朵和散落金色笔触的蔚蓝天空，左下方可见一座历史悠久的钟楼和拱形水岸建筑，右侧则是水波粼粼旁遥远的赤陶色屋顶。画面采用厚重的可见笔触、明亮的暖色高光、大胆的蓝金对比、富有表现力的质感，以及奇幻的蒸汽朋克与威尼斯风情交织的氛围。人物构图居中且硕大，被画框略微裁剪，脚下是清晰可见的巨型齿轮，下方则是向远处延伸的城市景观。

templates.title: Atmospheric Tea Alley Street Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 充满氛围感的茶巷街景

templates.prompt: A photorealistic narrow old alley tea-house scene in a dense East Asian neighborhood, shot at eye level with a slightly telephoto street-photography composition. The lane is cramped, damp, and richly layered with lived-in details: weathered storefronts, aged concrete and brick walls, tangled overhead wires, metal awnings, exposed pipes, hanging signs, and lush green vines and tree branches spilling in from above and along both sides. In the left foreground, place a rustic wooden table set for tea with exactly 1 metal kettle, 1 teapot, 1 tray of small blue-and-white porcelain teacups and small vessels, plus a few extra cups nearby; surround it with potted plants and stacked containers. Above and behind the table, hang exactly 3 illuminated vertical lantern-style signs with black Chinese calligraphy on warm cream paper, the largest reading 茶一味 and the others styled similarly, plus several darker wooden signboards with gold or light lettering. In the center of the alley, show white steam rising dramatically from a pot or food stall, partially obscuring stools and the passageway. On the right side, line up exactly 4 bicycles parked close together beside crates, baskets, and a black trash bin. Deeper in the alley, include exactly 4 visible people sitting or standing casually near tiny tables and stools, adding scale without dominating the image. The stone pavement should look wet and reflective, suggesting recent rain or humid weather. Lighting is soft natural daylight filtering from the bright opening at the far end of the alley, mixed with warm lantern glow, creating a moody cinematic contrast. Emphasize texture, authenticity, atmospheric depth, subtle haze, documentary realism, and a cozy hidden-gem tea-street feeling in {argument name="city style" default="an old Chinese lane"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个照片级写实的东亚老城区狭窄茶馆巷弄场景，采用平视视角，结合轻微长焦的街头摄影构图。巷道狭窄潮湿，充满丰富的生活气息：风化的店面、老旧的混凝土和砖墙、错综复杂的架空电线、金属遮阳棚、裸露的管道、悬挂的招牌，以及从上方和两侧蔓延而来的茂密绿植与树枝。在左侧前景处，放置一张质朴的木桌，上面摆放着茶具，包括 1 个金属水壶、1 个茶壶、1 个托盘，托盘上有几只青花瓷小茶杯和小型器皿，旁边还有几个额外的杯子；周围环绕着盆栽植物和堆叠的容器。在桌子上方和后方，悬挂 3 个发光的垂直灯笼式招牌，上面用黑色毛笔字书写在暖米色纸上，最大的招牌写着“茶一味”，其他招牌风格相似，此外还有几块带有金色或浅色字体的深色木质招牌。在巷子中央，展示从锅或小吃摊升腾而起的浓郁白烟，部分遮挡住凳子和通道。在右侧，整齐排列 4 辆自行车，紧靠着板条箱、篮子和一个黑色垃圾桶。在巷子深处，安排 4 个人在小桌凳旁随意坐着或站着，增加画面比例感且不喧宾夺主。石板路面应呈现湿润且带有反光的效果，暗示刚下过雨或天气潮湿。光线为柔和的自然日光，从巷子尽头的明亮出口透入，与暖色调的灯笼光交织，营造出富有电影感的对比氛围。强调纹理、真实感、空间深度、轻微的雾气、纪录片式的写实风格，以及 {argument name="city style" default="一条中国老巷"} 中那种隐秘茶街的温馨感。

templates.title: Ibaraki Travel Guide Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 茨城旅游指南封面

templates.prompt: A refined Japanese travel guide magazine cover illustration in a soft watercolor-and-ink editorial style, vertical A4 layout, airy pastel palette, elegant tourism-poster composition. The cover headline is dominated by very large serif blue text reading {argument name="main title" default="IBARAKI"}, with large Japanese title text below reading "茨城県 旅行ガイド" and a pale pink cursive English subtitle reading "Ibaraki Travel Guide". At the top left, include two lines of small Japanese copy about nature, history, scenery, and gourmet travel in Ibaraki, accented with a tiny pink cherry blossom icon. At the top right, place a large circular badge with fine dotted border containing Japanese text and the phrase "完全保存版" in the center with a small ribbon flourish underneath. The main subject is a young Japanese woman shown from the chest up, placed slightly right of center, facing left in three-quarter view. She has a chin-length wavy bob in deep dark brown to black, delicate loose strands, soft natural texture, and a calm neutral expression. She wears a light blue cardigan over a white ruffled blouse with a high gathered neckline, plus a thin beige shoulder bag strap. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain vertical rectangular gray censor block centered over the face area. Surround her with a collage of iconic Ibaraki scenery blended seamlessly into the cover art: a vast field of blue nemophila flowers across rolling hills in the upper right with a Ferris wheel in the distance and tiny visitors along the ridge; a traditional temple or pavilion among pink cherry blossoms at mid-right; a bright waterfall and landscaped stream at lower right; a torii gate standing in shallow ocean water at sunset in the lower left; and a mountain landscape near the bottom left center. Add abundant blue flowers in the foreground along the bottom edge and soft pink cherry blossoms framing the right side. Along the left side, include exactly 7 vertically stacked destination list entries in Japanese, each with a colored heading line and smaller descriptive subtext: "国営ひたち海浜公園", "偕楽園", "袋田の滝", "大洗磯前神社", "筑波山", "水郷・霞ヶ浦", and "グルメ・カフェ・おみやげ". At the lower left, place a blue circular badge with white Japanese text reading "モデルコース 4" and smaller itinerary copy below. At the lower right, include exactly 3 horizontal white label tabs with Japanese text and small icons: "絶景スポット", "ご当地グルメ", and "おみやげセレクション". Add a pink ribbon banner near the bottom right with small Japanese promotional text. Use a clean white background for the upper left, elegant magazine typography, delicate linework, dreamy spring atmosphere, polished tourism-cover design, high detail, premium print look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日式旅游杂志封面插图，采用柔和的水彩与水墨编辑风格，A4 竖版布局，轻盈的粉彩色调，优雅的旅游海报构图。封面标题由非常醒目的蓝色衬线大字主导，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="IBARAKI"}，下方配有醒目的日文标题“茨城県 旅行ガイド”，以及粉色的草书英文副标题“Ibaraki Travel Guide”。左上角包含两行关于茨城自然、历史、风景和美食旅游的小字日文文案，并点缀一个微小的粉色樱花图标。右上角放置一个带有细点边框的大型圆形徽章，中心包含日文文字及“完全保存版”字样，下方配有小丝带装饰。主体是一位日本年轻女性，半身像，位于画面右侧偏中位置，侧脸朝左，呈四分之三侧面视角。她留着深棕色至黑色的齐颌波浪短发，发丝细腻自然，表情平静中性。身穿浅蓝色开衫，内搭白色荷叶边高领衬衫，肩背细带米色挎包。她的面部被一个位于面部区域中央的纯灰色垂直矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。周围融合了茨城的标志性风景拼贴画：右上角是连绵起伏的山丘上大片的蓝色粉蝶花海，远处可见摩天轮，山脊上有微小的游客身影；中右侧是粉色樱花丛中的传统寺庙或凉亭；右下侧是明亮的瀑布与景观溪流；左下侧是夕阳下矗立在浅海中的鸟居；左下侧中心附近是山地景观。底部边缘前景处添加丰富的蓝色花朵，右侧由柔和的粉色樱花环绕。左侧包含 7 个垂直排列的日文目的地列表条目，每个条目均配有彩色标题行和较小的描述性副标题：“国営ひたち海浜公園”、“偕楽園”、“袋田の滝”、“大洗磯前神社”、“筑波山”、“水郷・霞ヶ浦”以及“グルメ・カフェ・おみやげ”。左下角放置一个带有白色日文文字“モデルコース 4”的蓝色圆形徽章，下方附有较小的行程文案。右下角包含 3 个带有日文文字和图标的水平白色标签：“絶景スポット”、“ご当地グルメ”和“おみやげセレクション”。右下角附近添加一个粉色丝带横幅，配有简短的日文促销文案。左上角采用简洁的白色背景，优雅的杂志排版，细腻的线条，梦幻的春日氛围，精致的旅游封面设计，高细节，高级印刷质感。

templates.title: Sunlit Luxury Modern Lobby

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光明媚的现代奢华大堂

templates.prompt: A photorealistic wide-angle interior architectural photograph of a luxurious modern lobby flooded with warm late-afternoon sunlight. The space is double-height with an open mezzanine level and clear glass railings above, minimalist cream stone walls, polished gray concrete or stone flooring, and rich reddish-brown wood paneling throughout. On the left side, show a sleek reception desk integrated into a wood-paneled wall, with 2 small lamps on the counter and a subtle recessed niche glowing with warm light. On the right side, create a floor-to-ceiling window wall revealing a soft hazy urban skyline with tall contemporary towers and treetops outside. In the foreground near the windows, place a built-in sunken lounge seating area upholstered in muted salmon, terracotta, and dusty rose tones, including an L-shaped sofa and 1 matching ottoman around a low dark coffee table with a few stacked books. Add 1 small mushroom-shaped table lamp with a glowing cream dome beside the seating. Include multiple indoor plants in long concrete planters along the windows and deeper into the lobby, giving the space a calm biophilic feel. Compose the image from eye level with strong natural light casting long geometric shadows across the floor and walls, emphasizing clean lines, openness, quiet luxury, and a serene high-end hotel or corporate reception atmosphere. Color palette: warm beige, cream, amber sunlight, rose upholstery, dark bronze accents, and natural wood. Ultra-detailed, cinematic, realistic materials, soft atmospheric haze, editorial architectural photography, no people, uncluttered, premium design magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的广角室内建筑摄影作品，展现了一个被温暖的午后阳光洒满的现代奢华大堂。空间为双层挑高，设有开放式夹层和透明玻璃栏杆，采用极简主义奶油色石墙、抛光灰色混凝土或石材地面，以及通体丰富的红棕色木镶板。左侧设有一个融入木镶板墙面的时尚接待台，台面上摆放着 2 盏小台灯，并配有一个散发柔和暖光的嵌入式壁龛。右侧打造一面落地窗墙，展现出窗外朦胧的城市天际线，可见高耸的现代建筑和树梢。在靠近窗户的前景处，放置一个内置的下沉式休息区，配有柔和的鲑鱼色、赤陶色和灰玫瑰色软垫，包括一张 L 型沙发和 1 个配套的脚凳，中间围着一张深色矮咖啡桌，桌上堆放着几本书。在座位旁添加 1 盏带有奶油色发光灯罩的小型蘑菇台灯。沿窗户及大堂深处放置多个长条形混凝土花盆栽种的室内植物，为空间带来宁静的亲生物感。以平视角度构图，强烈的自然光在地面和墙壁上投射出长长的几何阴影，强调简洁的线条、开阔感、静谧的奢华感以及宁静的高端酒店或企业接待氛围。配色方案：暖米色、奶油色、琥珀色阳光、玫瑰色软装、深青铜色点缀以及天然木材。超高细节、电影感、逼真的材质、柔和的大气雾感、建筑杂志级摄影风格，无人物，整洁，高级设计杂志美学。

templates.title: Luxury Office at Dusk Skyline View

titleLocalized.zh: 黄昏天际线景观下的豪华办公室

templates.prompt: A photorealistic modern executive office interior at dusk, viewed from a slightly wide angle inside the room, with floor-to-ceiling corner windows revealing a hazy metropolitan skyline in the distance. The space is minimalist and upscale, with warm ambient lighting, soft sunset tones, and a calm corporate luxury mood. In the center foreground, place a large contemporary desk in matte dark wood or charcoal finish with a clean rectangular shape, a slim task lamp, a closed laptop or folder, and an ergonomic black office chair. Along the left side, include a low modern leather sofa in deep brown and a minimalist metal coffee table holding exactly 3 stacked books or magazines and 1 decorative bowl. On the right side, show a built-in rectangular planter with green foliage in the foreground, and behind it a glass-walled meeting room with red-tinted interior walls and glass double doors. In the back corridor, add built-in wooden shelving with books and a few small decor objects, leading deeper into the office. Use recessed ceiling lights, subtle LED strip lighting near the ceiling edge, polished concrete or smooth stone flooring, and a restrained palette of gray, taupe, dark wood, black, and warm orange reflections from sunset. The windows should dominate the composition, with the skyline softly atmospheric and slightly diffused, emphasizing height, luxury, and quiet evening productivity.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黄昏时分的写实风格现代行政办公室室内图，采用室内微广角视角，落地转角窗外呈现出远处朦胧的都市天际线。空间设计简约且高端，配有温暖的环境照明、柔和的日落色调，营造出宁静的企业奢华氛围。在前景中央，放置一张哑光深木色或炭灰色的现代大办公桌，造型简洁呈长方形，桌上配有一盏纤细的台灯、一台合上的笔记本电脑或文件夹，以及一把人体工学黑色办公椅。左侧放置一张深棕色低矮现代皮质沙发，以及一张简约的金属咖啡桌，桌上整齐摆放着 3 本书籍或杂志和 1 个装饰碗。右侧前景处展示一个内置的长方形花槽，内植绿色植物；其后方是一个玻璃墙会议室，内部墙面呈红色调，配有玻璃双开门。后方走廊设有内置木质书架，摆放着书籍和少量装饰品，延伸至办公室深处。采用嵌入式天花板灯、天花板边缘的隐形 LED 灯带，地面为抛光混凝土或平滑石材，整体色调克制，融合了灰色、灰褐色、深木色、黑色以及日落带来的温暖橙色反光。窗景应占据构图主体，天际线呈现出柔和的大气感并略带漫射效果，突显出高空视野、奢华感以及静谧的夜晚办公氛围。

templates.title: Luxury High-Rise at Hazy Sunrise

titleLocalized.zh: 朦胧晨曦中的豪华高层建筑

templates.prompt: A cinematic architectural cityscape at sunrise, viewed from a high vantage point over a dense modern downtown skyline softened by pale haze. Warm peach, blush, and dusty gold morning light fills the scene, with the sun low behind the buildings and subtle reflections glowing on glass facades. The composition is asymmetrical: the right third of the image is dominated by the close exterior corner of a luxury high-rise residential tower with curved glass windows, muted rose-beige concrete bands, and 3 visible balcony levels. Each balcony has transparent glass railings and a few small potted plants trailing over the edge. Through the large windows, faint interior details are visible, including contemporary furniture and a distinctive red chair in one room. The left and center background show a layered urban skyline with exactly 8 clearly distinguishable high-rise buildings of varying heights and shapes, including a tall rectangular tower with a gridded facade and crown-like top, a dark rounded cylindrical tower near center, and several boxy residential and office buildings fading into atmospheric perspective. The mood is quiet, elegant, and slightly dreamy, like a luxury real-estate editorial photograph. Ultra-realistic, soft contrast, telephoto compression, fine architectural detail, subtle window reflections, no people, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 日出时分的电影级建筑城市景观，从高处俯瞰被淡淡薄雾笼罩的现代市中心天际线。温暖的桃色、绯红和灰金色晨光洒满场景，太阳低垂在建筑群后，玻璃幕墙上闪烁着柔和的倒影。构图采用非对称设计：画面右侧三分之一处，是一座豪华高层住宅楼的近景外立面，拥有弧形玻璃窗、柔和的玫瑰米色混凝土带以及 3 层清晰可见的阳台。每个阳台上都有透明玻璃栏杆和几盆垂下的绿植。透过大窗户，可以隐约看到室内细节，包括现代家具和其中一个房间里醒目的红色椅子。左侧和中心背景展示了层次分明的城市天际线，包含 8 座高度和形状各异、清晰可辨的高层建筑，其中包括一座带有网格立面和皇冠状顶部的长方形高塔、一座位于中心附近的深色圆形塔楼，以及几座逐渐融入大气透视中的方正住宅和办公楼。整体氛围安静、优雅且略带梦幻感，宛如豪华房地产的社论摄影作品。超写实，柔和对比度，长焦压缩感，精致的建筑细节，细腻的窗户倒影，无人物，无文字。

templates.title: Luxury Sunset Rooftop Terrace

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华日落屋顶露台

templates.prompt: A photorealistic luxury high-rise terrace at sunset overlooking a dense modern skyline, viewed from a wide-angle perspective along a curved outdoor walkway. The scene is empty of people and bathed in warm peach, blush, and golden-hour light with gentle atmospheric haze. On the right, a contemporary building facade with smooth beige concrete, a deep overhang, floor-to-ceiling glass, and bold rust-red wall panels curves into the frame. On the left, a clear glass safety railing runs diagonally toward the distance, revealing the city below. Include exactly 3 large circular built-in planters along the terrace edge, each in a muted terracotta tone and filled with ornamental grasses, low shrubs, and small sculptural trees; the nearest planter is prominent in the foreground. In the background, show a cluster of sleek skyscrapers with reflective glass and clean rectangular forms, including 1 especially tall, slender central tower and several slightly shorter towers around it. The floor is smooth pale concrete with long soft shadows and a calm minimalist feel. Architectural photography style, ultra-detailed, realistic materials, subtle reflections, elegant luxury residential design, serene upscale urban atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级真实感的高层奢华露台日落图，俯瞰密集的现代城市天际线，采用沿弧形户外走道的广角视角。场景中无人，沐浴在温暖的桃色、淡粉色和黄金时刻的光线下，带有柔和的大气雾感。右侧是一座现代建筑立面，采用平滑的米色混凝土、深挑檐、落地玻璃以及醒目的铁锈红墙板，呈弧形延伸至画面中。左侧是一道透明玻璃安全护栏，沿对角线向远处延伸，展现下方的城市景观。在露台边缘设置 3 个大型圆形内置花坛，每个花坛呈柔和的赤陶色，种满观赏草、低矮灌木和小型景观树；最近的花坛在前景中尤为突出。背景展示了一组外观时尚、带有反射玻璃和简洁矩形结构的摩天大楼，其中包括 1 座特别高耸纤细的中央塔楼和周围几座略矮的塔楼。地面为平滑的浅色混凝土，带有长而柔和的阴影，营造出宁静简约的氛围。建筑摄影风格，超高细节，真实的材质，细腻的反射，优雅的奢华住宅设计，宁静的高端城市氛围。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Inner Monster Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻“内心怪物”海报

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy gothic poster in a vertical composition, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired style with dramatic lighting and rich texture. At the center is a beautiful young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair, pale skin, and an elegant, calm but dangerous presence. Her face is mostly obscured in shadow and mystery. She wears an ornate black-and-deep-blue crystalline dress with lace, feathered and jagged organic details, semi-transparent flowing sleeves, and glowing blue highlights across the bodice and collar, as if infused with magic. Her right hand is raised slightly with an open gesture, while her left hand rests lower near her waist. Surrounding and partly growing from her are luminous blue butterflies and shard-like petals, creating a sense of transformation and corruption. Behind her looms a gigantic monstrous entity made of darkness, ink, smoke, and cosmic texture, with exactly 7 glowing blue eyes visible and a huge fanged grin packed with sharp icy-blue teeth. The creature feels Lovecraftian, predatory, and intimate, curling around her like a guardian, curse, or inner demon. The palette is dominated by black, midnight navy, indigo, and electric blue, with sparkling highlights like stars or wet paint splatter. Add a decorative antique silver filigree border in all 4 corners and along the edges, making it feel like a sinister book cover or exhibition poster. Place large Japanese title text at the top: {argument name="title text" default="私の中のバケモノ"}. Add 8 blocks of vertical Japanese copy around the figure, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, in elegant white Mincho-style type. Left side text blocks, top to bottom: 「創造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」, 「正しさよりも、心が動く瞬間を信じる。」, 「美しいものに飢えている。」, 「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」. Right side text blocks, top to bottom: 「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」, 「枠を壊し、誰も見たことのない景色を描きたい。」, 「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」, plus a short atmospheric handwritten-style accent near the mid-right edge. At the lower center, add a large Japanese question line: {argument name="bottom question" default="これは、力？それとも、呪い？"}. At the very bottom, add a smaller Japanese line: {argument name="tagline text" default="私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物語を待っている。"}. Make the whole image feel obsessive, beautiful, unsettling, and emotionally intense, like a high-end dark art poster about inner monsters and creative power.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张垂直构图的暗黑奇幻哥特海报，采用细节丰富的动漫风格绘制，光影戏剧性强，质感浓郁。画面中心是一位美丽的年轻女子，留着一头长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 头发，皮肤苍白，气质优雅、冷静却暗藏危险。她的面部大部分隐没在阴影与神秘感中。她身着一件华丽的黑深蓝色水晶礼服，带有蕾丝、羽毛及锯齿状的有机细节，袖子半透明且飘逸，胸衣和领口处闪烁着蓝色的光芒，仿佛注入了魔法。她的右手微微抬起，呈张开姿势，左手则垂在腰间。在她周围，部分从她身上生长出的是发光的蓝色蝴蝶和碎片状花瓣，营造出一种蜕变与腐蚀感。在她身后，矗立着一个由黑暗、墨水、烟雾和宇宙纹理构成的巨大怪物实体，可见 7 只发光的蓝色眼睛，以及一张布满锋利冰蓝色牙齿的巨大獠牙大嘴。这个生物带有洛夫克拉夫特式的掠夺感与亲密感，像守护者、诅咒或内心恶魔一样缠绕着她。色调以黑色、午夜蓝、靛青色和电光蓝为主，点缀着如星辰或湿润颜料飞溅般的闪亮高光。在四个角落和边缘添加装饰性的古董银色花丝边框，使其看起来像是一本邪恶的书籍封面或展览海报。在顶部放置醒目的日文标题文字：{argument name="title text" default="私の中のバケモノ"}。在人物周围添加 8 块垂直的日文文案，左侧 4 块，右侧 4 块，采用优雅的白色明朝体。左侧文案块（从上到下）：「创造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」、「正しさよりも、心が动く瞬间を信じる。」、「美しいものに饥えている。」、「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」。右侧文案块（从上到下）：「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」、「枠を壊し、谁も见たことのない景色を描きたい。」、「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」，并在右中边缘附近添加一小段手写风格的氛围感装饰文字。在底部中央，添加一行醒目的日文提问：{argument name="bottom question" default="これは、力？それとも、呪い？"}。在最底部，添加一行较小的日文标语：{argument name="tagline text" default="私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物语を待っている。"}。整体画面呈现出一种执着、唯美、不安且情感强烈的氛围，如同关于内心怪物与创造力的高端暗黑艺术海报。

templates.title: Visionary Eye Mandala

titleLocalized.zh: 幻象之眼曼陀罗

templates.prompt: A perfectly centered sacred-geometry mandala on a clean white background, rendered as an ultra-detailed visionary ink-and-pointillism illustration. The composition is radially symmetrical and circular overall, glowing with warm gold, saffron, orange, coral, magenta, violet, and hints of cyan at the core. In the exact center, place a radiant circular nucleus with a bright cyan-blue dot surrounded by concentric rings of pink, magenta, orange, and gold, like a luminous spiritual sun. Around it, build many densely packed concentric bands of tiny jewel-like eyes, bead forms, dots, and filigree, all arranged with precise rotational symmetry. Form a four-point diamond structure around the center, with 4 large petal-like flame clusters pointing up, down, left, and right, and 4 smaller curled spiral clusters in the diagonal quadrants. At the outer cardinal points, include 4 larger almond-shaped eye motifs embedded in feathery golden forms. Across the mandala, include dozens of miniature multicolored eyes set into rings, suggesting omniscient awareness. Use extremely fine stippling, micro-linework, ornate feathered textures, and shimmering decorative detail, with the inner structure predominantly luminous gold and ivory, transitioning to a diffuse halo of violet and lavender stippled particles at the outer edge. The image should feel mystical, transcendent, intricate, balanced, and meditative, like a celestial mandala or visionary sacred emblem, with crisp high-detail line art and soft radiant color blending.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纯净的白色背景上，呈现一个完美居中的神圣几何曼陀罗，采用超精细的幻象墨水点彩插画风格渲染。整体构图呈放射状对称的圆形，散发着温暖的金色、藏红花色、橙色、珊瑚色、洋红色、紫罗兰色，核心处带有淡淡的青色。在正中心，放置一个光芒四射的圆形核心，中心是一个明亮的青蓝色圆点，周围环绕着粉色、洋红色、橙色和金色的同心圆，宛如一颗发光的灵性太阳。在其周围，构建许多密集排列的同心圆带，由细小的宝石状眼睛、珠状形态、圆点和金银丝细工组成，所有元素均以精确的旋转对称方式排列。在中心周围形成一个四点菱形结构，上下左右各有 4 簇巨大的花瓣状火焰，对角象限则有 4 簇较小的卷曲螺旋。在最外层的正方向上，包含 4 个嵌入羽毛状金色形态中的大型杏仁状眼睛图案。整个曼陀罗中，包含数十个镶嵌在圆环中的微型彩色眼睛，暗示着全知全能的觉知。采用极细的点画法、微线条、华丽的羽毛纹理和闪烁的装饰细节，内部结构以发光的金色和象牙色为主，向外边缘过渡为紫罗兰色和薰衣草色点状颗粒组成的弥散光晕。图像应具有神秘、超然、复杂、平衡和冥想的质感，如同一个天体曼陀罗或幻象神圣徽章，呈现出清晰的高细节线条艺术与柔和绚丽的色彩融合。

templates.title: Childlike Crayon Portrait on Paper

titleLocalized.zh: 儿童蜡笔画风格肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic overhead photo of a childlike crayon drawing on a slightly wrinkled white sheet of paper placed on a wooden tabletop. The drawing shows a simple portrait of {argument name="character" default="Donald Trump"} in a naive elementary-school style, with messy yellow crayon hair, peach-colored skin, large ears, a blue suit jacket, white shirt collar, and a red necktie. The face is front-facing and fills most of the page, with one raised hand on the left side of the paper making a rude gesture with the middle finger extended. The linework is uneven black pencil or crayon outline, and the coloring is rough, scribbly, and intentionally clumsy, with visible childlike strokes that go outside the lines. On the right side of the page, there is vertical handwritten Japanese text in black that reads {argument name="side text" default="とらんぷさん"}. The composition is a candid smartphone snapshot, not a clean scan, showing the entire sheet of paper, slight perspective distortion, soft indoor lighting, and the texture of the wooden surface around the page. Emphasize the authentic handmade crayon texture, awkward proportions, and convincing “bad but charming” children’s artwork aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的俯拍照片，展示了放置在木质桌面上一张略有褶皱的白纸上的儿童蜡笔画。画作以稚拙的小学风格描绘了 {argument name="character" default="Donald Trump"} 的简单肖像，有着凌乱的黄色蜡笔头发、桃色皮肤、大耳朵、蓝色西装外套、白色衬衫领子和红色领带。面部正对前方并占据了纸张的大部分空间，纸张左侧有一只抬起的手，正竖着中指做出粗鲁的手势。线条是不均匀的黑色铅笔或蜡笔轮廓，上色粗糙、潦草且刻意笨拙，带有明显的儿童笔触，甚至超出了线条范围。纸张右侧有竖排的黑色手写日语文字 {argument name="side text" default="とらんぷさん"}。构图为随意的智能手机快照，而非清晰的扫描件，展现了整张纸、轻微的透视畸变、柔和的室内光线以及纸张周围木质表面的纹理。强调真实的手工蜡笔质感、笨拙的比例以及令人信服的“画得不好但很有魅力”的儿童艺术美感。

templates.title: Anime Rapunzel Tower Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格长发公主高塔场景

templates.prompt: A whimsical anime fairytale illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Rapunzel"} leaning out from a high stone tower window, viewed from outside at a slightly elevated angle. She wears a soft lavender medieval-inspired princess dress with puff sleeves, white lace trim, and a fitted bodice, plus a pink-and-white bunny ear headband. Her extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is styled into a single enormous thick braid that spills over the windowsill and drops straight down the full height of the image. A small fluffy white rabbit sits on her right shoulder, adding a cute fantasy touch. The tower is pale beige stone with a rounded balcony-like window ledge, an arched opening, deep purple interior curtains, and green ivy climbing around the walls and window frame. In the background, show a bright sunlit storybook landscape with a vivid blue sky, scattered white clouds, rolling green hills, a winding river, a stone bridge with 3 arches, and a distant European-style town with a castle or cathedral. The mood is triumphant, charming, and magical, like a polished high-end fantasy anime key visual. Detailed painterly rendering, soft natural daylight, clean linework, gentle atmospheric perspective, lush foliage, elegant composition, vertical format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满奇幻色彩的动漫童话插画，描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="Rapunzel"} 从高耸的石塔窗户探出身子，视角从外部略微仰视。她身穿一件柔和的薰衣草色中世纪风格公主裙，配有泡泡袖、白色蕾丝花边和修身胸衣，头上戴着粉白相间的兔耳朵发箍。她极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发编成了一条巨大的粗辫子，从窗台上垂下，一直延伸到画面底部。一只毛茸茸的小白兔坐在她的右肩上，增添了一抹可爱的奇幻气息。石塔呈浅米色，带有圆形的窗台、拱形窗洞、深紫色的室内窗帘，墙壁和窗框上爬满了绿色的常春藤。背景展现了一幅阳光明媚的童话景观，天空湛蓝，白云朵朵，连绵的青山、蜿蜒的河流、一座三拱石桥，以及远处带有城堡或大教堂的欧式小镇。整体氛围充满胜利感、迷人且富有魔力，如同精致的高端奇幻动漫主视觉图。细节丰富的绘画质感，柔和的自然光，干净的线条，细腻的空气透视，茂密的植被，优雅的构图，竖构图。

templates.title: Anime Summer Soda Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格夏季汽水广告海报

templates.prompt: A bright, high-energy anime-style summer advertisement poster for a sparkling soft drink, set at the seaside under a vivid cobalt-blue sky with towering white cumulus clouds and a blazing sun near the top center creating lens flare and radiant beams. Feature exactly 3 Japanese high school girls in matching summer sailor uniforms: short-sleeved white blouses with navy ribbon bows and dark navy pleated skirts. All three have dark, windblown shoulder-length to long hair and youthful, lively poses. In the left foreground, show one girl from a dramatic low angle thrusting a large plastic soda bottle toward the viewer so it dominates the composition; her hand and the bottle are oversized by perspective. In the middle, show a second girl seated low near the water, one knee raised, drinking from a smaller bottle. On the right, show a third girl standing in profile or three-quarter view, also sipping from a bottle while her hair and skirt stream in the sea breeze. Make the ocean water intensely turquoise and sunlit, with energetic splashes framing the bottom left and bottom right edges, scattered droplets and sparkling highlights across the scene. Add a few small white seabirds in the distant sky. The overall mood is refreshing, nostalgic, youthful, and cinematic, like a premium Japanese beverage commercial key visual. The bottle label should be clean and minimalist white with modern sans-serif typography reading {argument name="brand name" default="ASCII SPARK"}, with smaller flavor text {argument name="flavor text" default="Yuzu White Peach Soda"} and a subtle 500 mL marking. Place the brand logo in the upper left in thin uppercase letters, and add a handwritten-style Japanese tagline in white at the lower left reading {argument name="tagline text" default="夏がくれる、はじけるひととき。"}. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering mixed with painterly light effects, ultra-detailed water droplets on the bottle, condensation, transparent plastic, glittering carbonation bubbles, and dramatic foreshortening.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、充满活力的动漫风格夏季汽水广告海报，背景设定在海边，天空是鲜艳的钴蓝色，点缀着高耸的白色积云，烈日位于顶部中心附近，产生镜头光晕和放射状光束。画面中包含 3 名身穿同款夏季水手服的日本女高中生：短袖白衬衫配海军蓝丝带蝴蝶结和深海军蓝百褶裙。三人的头发均为深色，随风飘动，长度从齐肩到长发不等，姿态青春活泼。左侧前景处，一名女孩以戏剧性的低角度将一个大塑料汽水瓶推向观众，使其在构图中占据主导地位；通过透视效果，她的手和瓶子显得格外巨大。中间位置，第二名女孩低坐于水边，单膝抬起，正喝着一瓶较小的汽水。右侧，第三名女孩以侧面或四分之三侧面站立，同样在喝汽水，她的头发和裙摆在海风中飘动。海水呈现出浓郁的绿松石色，阳光明媚，充满活力的浪花勾勒出左下和右下边缘，画面中散布着水滴和闪烁的光点。远方的天空中点缀着几只白色海鸟。整体氛围清新、怀旧、青春且具有电影感，如同高端日本饮料的商业主视觉。瓶身标签应为简洁的白色极简风格，印有现代无衬线字体 {argument name="brand name" default="ASCII SPARK"}，下方配有较小的风味文字 {argument name="flavor text" default="柚子白桃汽水"} 以及细小的 500 mL 标识。品牌 Logo 置于左上角，采用纤细的大写字母，左下角添加白色手写风格的日文标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="夏がくれる、はじけるひととき。"}。采用清爽的赛璐珞动漫渲染与绘画感光效相结合，瓶身呈现超精细的水滴、冷凝水珠、透明塑料质感、闪烁的碳酸气泡以及极具张力的透视缩短效果。

templates.title: Hidden Duck in Miniature Venice

titleLocalized.zh: 微缩威尼斯里的隐藏小鸭

templates.prompt: A highly detailed isometric miniature diorama illustration of a lively Venetian canal square in warm golden daylight, rendered like an ultra-cute handcrafted travel scene with chibi doll-like tourists, tiny shopfronts, textured stone pavement, flower boxes, striped awnings, and sparkling turquoise water. The composition is densely packed and whimsical, designed as a hidden-object scene titled on a decorative sign in the upper right that reads {argument name="headline text" default="Find the duck! 🐤"}. Show a charming Venice setting with a central arched stone bridge crossing a narrow canal, multiple gondolas in the water, and dozens of small travelers and locals in colorful outfits, hats, sunglasses, cameras, and shopping bags. Place a souvenir kiosk with postcards and signs, a flower stall overflowing with bright bouquets, a café terrace with red-and-white checkered tables, a carnival mask shop display, stacked vintage suitcases near the canal, striped mooring poles, laundry hanging between buildings, wrought-iron street lamps, and old pastel buildings in peach, ochre, and cream with green shutters and terracotta roofs. Include visible storefront signs reading “MASCHERE,” “CAFFÈ,” “SOUVENIRS,” “FIORI,” and “VENEZIA.” Hide exactly {argument name="duck count" default="4"} small yellow rubber ducks throughout the scene as a playful search challenge, with one especially noticeable duck perched near the stacked suitcases and the others subtly blended among the busy market details. Add one tiny fluffy white dog near the flower stall. The overall style should feel like a premium collectible toy-city illustration, richly layered, joyful, cozy, and travel-themed, with soft depth of field, crisp miniature textures, and a bustling storybook atmosphere. promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的等轴测微缩立体模型插画，展现了温暖金色日光下热闹的威尼斯运河广场。画面呈现出超可爱的纯手工旅行场景质感，包含 Q 版玩偶般的游客、微型店面、纹理丰富的石板路、花箱、条纹遮阳篷以及波光粼粼的绿松石色水面。整体构图紧凑且充满奇趣，设计为隐藏物品游戏场景，右上角的装饰牌上写着 {argument name="headline text" default="找到小鸭子！🐤"}。展现迷人的威尼斯风情，中心有一座横跨狭窄运河的拱形石桥，水中有数艘贡多拉，还有数十位身着彩色服装、戴着帽子、墨镜，手持相机和购物袋的游客与当地人。画面中设有摆放明信片和标牌的纪念品亭、鲜花簇拥的花摊、铺着红白格子桌布的咖啡馆露台、狂欢节面具店橱窗、运河边堆叠的复古行李箱、条纹系船柱、建筑间晾晒的衣物、锻铁路灯，以及漆着绿色百叶窗、盖着赤陶瓦屋顶的桃色、赭色和奶油色老建筑。包含清晰可见的店招，写着“MASCHERE”、“CAFFÈ”、“SOUVENIRS”、“FIORI”和“VENEZIA”。在场景中隐藏 {argument name="duck count" default="4"} 只黄色小橡皮鸭作为趣味搜寻挑战，其中一只特别显眼地停在堆叠的行李箱旁，其余则巧妙地融入在繁忙的市场细节中。在花摊旁加入一只毛茸茸的小白狗。整体风格如同高端收藏级玩具城市插画，层次丰富、充满欢乐与温馨的旅行主题，具有柔和的景深、清晰的微缩质感和热闹的童话氛围。以 {argument name="city" default="Venice"} 作为地点灵感，并让人群呈现 {argument name="character style" default="可爱的 Q 版游客"} 风格，展现行走、聊天、拍照、购物、在咖啡馆小坐、站在桥上以及乘坐贡多拉等多种姿态。

templates.prompt: A richly detailed miniature-diorama style illustration of a busy Venetian canal street in warm afternoon light, designed like a whimsical “find the hidden duck” scene. Show a narrow turquoise canal running through the center with 4 black gondolas, each with striped-shirt gondoliers and tiny tourists, crossed by 1 ornate white stone footbridge crowded with people. Fill the scene with dozens of cute chibi travelers and shopkeepers in a handcrafted toy-like style, with oversized heads, soft expressive faces, textured clothing, and highly detailed props. Surround the canal with colorful old Venice buildings in peach, terracotta, cream, and yellow stucco, red tile roofs, green shutters, balconies, flower boxes, laundry lines, lanterns, and narrow shopfronts. Include 6 clearly readable shop or sign texts placed naturally in the environment: “TRATTORIA,” “MASCHERE,” “CALLE DEI COLORI,” “CAFFE LAGUNA,” “VENEZIA,” “FIORI,” plus a small chalkboard sign reading “GONDOLA SERENATA.” On the right, feature a Venetian mask shop overflowing with ornate masks and carnival decorations; on the left, a trattoria with outdoor diners; in the lower left, a small café kiosk; in the lower center, a postcard stand labeled VENEZIA; in the lower right, a flower cart labeled FIORI; near the center bottom, an artist painting at an easel and a street musician with a guitar. Scatter luggage, tables, pastries, postcards, flower pots, market goods, and canal posts throughout the cobblestone street to create a dense travel-market atmosphere. Add a decorative framed game sign in the upper-right corner with a tiny duck icon and the text {argument name="headline text" default="Find the duck!"}. Hide exactly 1 tiny yellow rubber duck subtly among the lower-left luggage area near the café so it is visible but easy to miss. Use a high-angle isometric composition, storybook travel-poster charm, ultra-detailed handcrafted textures, vibrant colors, cozy European ambiance, and a playful seek-and-find aesthetic.

templates.title: Chicken Tikka Masala Mug Desk Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 鸡肉玛萨拉马克杯桌面照片

templates.prompt: A casual smartphone photo in a home office or gaming desk setup, shot vertically from a first-person perspective. A left hand in the foreground is holding a black ceramic mug with partial white logo text, and the mug is absurdly filled to the brim with thick chicken tikka masala instead of a drink. The curry is rich orange-red, creamy, with 3 visible chunks of chicken, a white yogurt swirl on top, and a small garnish of fresh cilantro leaves centered on the surface. The mug is positioned near the center-left of the frame above a medium-brown wooden desk. In the background, show a realistic desk scene: 1 black articulated desk lamp on the left, 1 black wall light switch on an off-white wall, visible white radiator pipes and a radiator, 1 red audio interface with knobs and cables near the back of the desk, 1 white game controller behind the mug, 1 computer monitor on the right edge showing a messaging app interface, several loose cables on the desk, and 1 large dark desk mat with a subtle red ornamental pattern in the lower right. Use warm late-afternoon indoor lighting with soft shadows, slight wide-angle phone camera distortion, shallow depth from the close foreground hand and mug, and a humorous but highly photorealistic everyday snapshot aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在家庭办公室或游戏桌面环境下拍摄的随性智能手机照片，采用第一人称视角垂直拍摄。前景中，一只左手拿着一个印有部分白色标志文字的黑色陶瓷马克杯，杯子里荒谬地装满了浓郁的鸡肉玛萨拉，而不是饮料。咖喱呈浓郁的橘红色，质地奶油般顺滑，可以看到 3 块鸡肉，顶部有白色酸奶漩涡，中心点缀着少量新鲜香菜叶。马克杯位于画面中左侧，放置在深棕色木质桌面上。背景展示了写实的桌面场景：左侧有一盏黑色可调节台灯，米白色墙壁上有一个黑色墙壁开关，可见白色的暖气管道和暖气片，桌面后方有一个带有旋钮和线缆的红色音频接口，马克杯后方有一个白色游戏手柄，右侧边缘有一台显示着即时通讯应用界面的电脑显示器，桌面上散落着几根线缆，右下角有一张带有细微红色装饰图案的大型深色桌垫。采用温暖的午后室内光线，带有柔和的阴影，呈现出轻微的广角手机镜头畸变，前景的手和马克杯具有浅景深效果，整体呈现出一种幽默但高度写实的日常快照美学。

templates.title: Editorial Bridal Portrait with Fascinator

titleLocalized.zh: 佩戴礼帽的时尚新娘肖像

templates.prompt: A high-fashion studio portrait of a young woman reclining sideways on the floor against a seamless light gray background, cropped from about the hat down to the hands, with the face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She wears an elegant white dress with sheer ruched fabric, sculpted floral appliqués along both shoulder straps and the bodice, and a fitted, ethereal silhouette. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown to black"} and styled in 2 long bubble braids, one on each side, each tied off with multiple white bands creating rounded segments. She wears a dramatic white fascinator hat tilted to one side, made of layered mesh, netting, ribbon loops, lace trim, and several airy feather sprays. Pose her leaning on one forearm with the other hand extended near the lower edge of the frame, torso angled diagonally for a refined editorial composition. Use soft diffused studio lighting, smooth skin tones, minimal shadows, luxury bridal-fashion styling, monochrome white wardrobe accents, and a clean polished magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级时尚影棚肖像，拍摄一位年轻女性侧卧在无缝浅灰色背景前的地面上，构图从帽子向下截取至手部，面部特意用柔和的矩形模糊处理。她身着一件优雅的白色礼服，采用透明褶皱面料，肩带和胸前饰有立体花卉贴花，剪裁修身，呈现出空灵的轮廓。她的发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色至黑色"}，梳成两条长长的泡泡辫，两侧各一条，每条辫子用多个白色发圈扎成圆润的节段。她佩戴着一顶倾斜的夸张白色礼帽，由层叠的网纱、网格、丝带环、蕾丝花边和几簇轻盈的羽毛装饰而成。姿势设定为单手肘支撑，另一只手伸向画面下边缘，躯干呈对角线倾斜，以呈现精致的时尚杂志构图。采用柔和的漫射影棚光，平滑的肤色，极简的阴影，奢华的新娘时尚造型，单色白色服装点缀，以及干净利落的杂志美学。

templates.title: Avant-Garde Bridal Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 先锋派新娘肖像

templates.prompt: A high-fashion studio portrait of a seated woman in an ethereal bridal look against a seamless light gray background, framed vertically from headpiece to the trailing ends of her hair. She wears a flowing sleeveless white gown with a high gathered neckline, sheer pleated chiffon over the bodice, delicate white floral appliqué clustered at the neck, chest, waist, and upper skirt, and a soft draped skirt spread around her on the floor. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="deep dark brown"} and styled into 2 extremely long oversized bubble ponytails, one on each side, each segmented with white ties; the left ponytail shows 4 visible bubble sections and the right ponytail shows 3 visible bubble sections, with both tails extending onto the floor in thick glossy loops. She also wears an elaborate white fascinator hat tilted to one side, made of lace, netting, and sculptural floral details. Pose her leaning diagonally with one hand braced on the floor and the torso angled, creating an elegant editorial fashion posture. Keep the mood refined, bridal, and avant-garde, with soft diffused lighting, realistic skin texture, crisp textile detail, minimal shadows, and a clean luxury magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级时装摄影棚肖像，拍摄一位坐在无缝浅灰色背景前的女性，呈现空灵的新娘造型，采用从头饰到发尾的垂直构图。她身着飘逸的无袖白色礼服，高领褶皱设计，胸前覆盖透明褶皱雪纺，颈部、胸部、腰部及裙摆上部点缀着精致的白色花朵贴花，柔软的垂坠裙摆铺散在地面上。她的头发颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，造型为 2 条极长的超大泡泡辫，两侧各一条，每段均用白色发带扎起；左侧辫子可见 4 个泡泡节，右侧辫子可见 3 个泡泡节，两条辫子以厚实光泽的环状延伸至地面。她还佩戴了一顶向一侧倾斜的精致白色礼帽，由蕾丝、网纱和雕塑感花卉细节制成。让她呈对角线倾斜姿势，一只手撑在地面，躯干倾斜，营造出优雅的编辑时尚姿态。保持精致、新娘风与先锋派的格调，采用柔和的漫射光，展现真实的皮肤质感、清晰的织物细节、极简的阴影，以及干净的奢华杂志美学。

templates.title: Protein Powder Splash Hero Shot

titleLocalized.zh: 蛋白粉飞溅效果主图

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic commercial product splash shot of a large white plastic whey protein tub labeled {argument name="brand name" default="PUREZZA"} and {argument name="product name" default="WHEYPRO"}, floating slightly above a glass filled with thick chocolate protein shake. The tub is centered, angled slightly to the right, with a clean glossy surface and a bold blue, white, and black label design. The label should prominently read “100% WPC PROTEIN MILK” and include small nutrition callouts such as “82G PROTEIN,” “2G SUGAR/SERVING,” “119% RDI OF VC,” “100% CHOLINE,” a circular “GMP” badge, a black strip reading “WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE,” another strip reading “LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL,” and a flavor tag reading {argument name="flavor text" default="BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR"}. Surround the tub with an explosive upward and outward splash of glossy chocolate liquid, with dramatic arcs, droplets, and suspended motion frozen in midair. Include exactly 5 whole chocolate sandwich cookies flying around the product and multiple broken cookie chunks and crumbs scattered throughout the scene, with one partially visible cookie near the lower right and another near the upper left. The glass at the bottom should be only partially visible, transparent, and overflowing from the impact of the splash. Use a high-contrast studio background with a dark deep blue gradient on the left fading to bright white on the right, cinematic rim lighting, crisp reflections, ultra-sharp focus on the tub, and detailed texture in the liquid and cookie crumbs. The overall look should be premium sports nutrition advertising, dynamic, energetic, and suitable for a hero image on a modern ecommerce fitness website.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的商业产品飞溅效果图，主体为一个大型白色塑料乳清蛋白桶，标签上印有 {argument name="brand name" default="PUREZZA"} 和 {argument name="product name" default="WHEYPRO"}，悬浮在装满浓稠巧克力蛋白奶昔的玻璃杯上方。蛋白桶居中，略微向右倾斜，表面光洁亮丽，标签采用醒目的蓝、白、黑配色设计。标签应显著标明“100% WPC PROTEIN MILK”，并包含小型营养说明，如“82G PROTEIN”、“2G SUGAR/SERVING”、“119% RDI OF VC”、“100% CHOLINE”、一个圆形的“GMP”徽章、一条印有“WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE”的黑色条纹、另一条印有“LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL”的条纹，以及一个口味标签 {argument name="flavor text" default="BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR"}。蛋白桶周围环绕着向上和向外喷溅的亮面巧克力液体，呈现出富有戏剧性的弧线、液滴，以及定格在空中的动态效果。场景中包含 5 块完整的巧克力夹心饼干，以及散落在各处的饼干碎块和碎屑，右下方和左上方各有一块饼干局部可见。底部的玻璃杯仅露出部分，呈透明状，因飞溅冲击而溢出。使用高对比度的摄影棚背景，左侧为深蓝色渐变，向右过渡至明亮的白色，采用电影级的轮廓光，反射清晰，蛋白桶焦点极其锐利，液体和饼干碎屑的纹理细节丰富。整体风格应呈现高端运动营养广告的质感，充满动感与活力，非常适合作为现代健身电商网站的头图。

templates.title: Night Balcony Flash Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 夜晚阳台闪光灯自拍

templates.prompt: A candid nighttime balcony selfie of a young woman shot from a slightly high handheld phone angle, with the face mostly obscured by shadow and framing, emphasizing the outfit and mood rather than facial detail. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long loose wavy hair falling over both shoulders, medium tan skin, and wears 2 delicate gold necklaces, one a thin chain and one with a small cross pendant, plus a subtle bracelet on the wrist visible near the bottom edge. Her outfit is a fitted white sleeveless cropped tank top and {argument name="bottoms" default="light blue low-rise denim jeans"}, revealing the midriff. The pose is relaxed and slightly leaning, one arm extended to hold the phone, with a casual going-out aesthetic. Set the scene on a modern apartment balcony at night with a glass railing and a blurred distant city skyline filled with small bokeh lights. Use dim ambient lighting with a direct phone flash that illuminates the torso and hair, creating strong contrast, soft grain, slight motion blur, and an authentic late-night social-media selfie look. Vertical smartphone composition, close crop from upper chest to hips, realistic photography, moody, intimate, unpolished, natural proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张年轻女性在夜晚阳台上的抓拍自拍，由手持手机以略高的角度拍摄，面部大部分被阴影和构图遮挡，重点突出穿搭和氛围而非面部细节。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长波浪卷发，自然垂落在双肩，肤色为中等小麦色，佩戴 2 条精致的金项链，一条为细链，另一条带有十字架小吊坠，手腕处可见一条低调的手链。她身穿一件修身的白色无袖短款背心和 {argument name="bottoms" default="浅蓝色低腰牛仔裤"}，露出腰部。姿势放松且略微前倾，一只手臂伸出持机，呈现出休闲的出门穿搭风格。场景设定在夜晚的现代公寓阳台，配有玻璃栏杆，背景是模糊的远方城市天际线，点缀着细小的光斑。使用昏暗的环境光配合手机直闪，照亮躯干和头发，营造出强烈的对比感、柔和的噪点、轻微的动态模糊，以及真实感十足的深夜社交媒体自拍效果。竖屏构图，从上胸部到臀部的近景裁剪，写实摄影，情绪化，私密感，未经修饰，自然比例。

templates.title: Spanish UPS outlet wiring infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 西班牙语 UPS 插座接线信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of the APC Back-UPS, turn it into a clear Spanish annotated setup guide overlaid directly on the photo. Keep the UPS photo realistic and unchanged as the base, but add color-coded callouts showing which outlets are battery-backed versus surge-only. At the top, add 2 header boxes: on the left a dark gray box reading "SOLO PROTECCIÓN (sin batería)", and on the right a green box reading "CON BATERÍA (recomendado para equipos críticos)". Highlight the 4 right-side outlets with a green outline group and individual green outlines, and place 4 numbered green labels on the right: "1 Servidor 1", "2 Servidor 2", "3 Servidor 3", "4 Switch (mover aquí)". On the left, highlight the currently used upper-left outlet with an orange outline and add an orange callout box reading "Switch: mover de aquí", plus a curved arrow from that outlet to the bottom outlet of the right-side green group. Also outline the 3 lower-left outlets in light gray and add 3 gray labels on the left aligned to them: "Solo protección (sin batería)", "No crítico", and "Libre / periféricos". At the bottom, add a large yellow warning box with a caution icon and this text: "Ojo: 3 servidores + 1 switch pueden sobrecargar un Back-UPS ES 700. Si pita o se apaga al probarlo, necesitas un SAI más potente." Clean infographic style, readable bold typography, neat rounded rectangles, high contrast, and practical IT-diagram presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的 APC Back-UPS 参考图片，将其转换为一张清晰的西班牙语标注设置指南，并直接覆盖在照片上。保持 UPS 照片真实且不变作为底图，但添加颜色编码的标注，以显示哪些插座是电池备份的，哪些仅提供浪涌保护。在顶部添加 2 个标题框：左侧为深灰色框，文字为“SOLO PROTECCIÓN (sin batería)”，右侧为绿色框，文字为“CON BATERÍA (recomendado para equipos críticos)”。用绿色轮廓组和单独的绿色轮廓突出显示右侧的 4 个插座，并在右侧放置 4 个带编号的绿色标签：“1 Servidor 1”、“2 Servidor 2”、“3 Servidor 3”、“4 Switch (mover aquí)”。在左侧，用橙色轮廓突出显示当前使用的左上角插座，并添加一个橙色标注框，文字为“Switch: mover de aquí”，同时添加一条从该插座指向右侧绿色组底部插座的弯曲箭头。此外，用浅灰色勾勒出左下方的 3 个插座，并在左侧对齐添加 3 个灰色标签：“Solo protección (sin batería)”、“No crítico”和“Libre / periféricos”。在底部，添加一个带有警告图标的大型黄色警告框，文字如下：“Ojo: 3 servidores + 1 switch pueden sobrecargar un Back-UPS ES 700. Si pita o se apaga al probarlo, necesitas un SAI más potente.” 采用简洁的信息图风格，使用清晰易读的粗体排版、整洁的圆角矩形、高对比度以及实用的 IT 图表呈现方式。

templates.title: Luxury Vitamin C Serum Product Shot

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华维生素 C 精华液产品摄影

templates.prompt: A high-end commercial skincare product photo on a light marble bathroom counter, centered on a clear glass dropper bottle filled with warm amber-orange serum. The bottle is covered in realistic condensation droplets and has a white rubber pipette top with a shiny metallic gold collar. The front label is elegant and minimal, reading {argument name="brand name" default="HydraGlow"} with smaller lines {argument name="product name" default="Vitamin C Serum - 30ml"} and {argument name="benefit line" default="Brightening & Anti-Aging Formula"}, plus a simple gold botanical lotus-style logo above the brand name. Soft natural morning light streams in from the side, creating gentle highlights, subtle shadows, and a clean luxury spa atmosphere. In the blurred background, include 1 ribbed clear glass vase with green leafy branches on the left, 1 stack of 3 folded white towels on the right, 1 shallow white dish with faint gold veining on the left foreground, and 1 small white bowl with a thin gold rim on the right foreground. Use shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the bottle, neutral cream and white palette, premium e-commerce advertising aesthetic, photorealistic textures, and refined wellness branding style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端商业护肤品照片，场景设在浅色大理石浴室台面上，主体为一瓶装有暖琥珀橙色精华液的透明玻璃滴管瓶。瓶身覆盖着逼真的冷凝水珠，配有白色橡胶滴管头和闪亮的金属金色瓶颈。正面标签优雅简约，印有 {argument name="brand name" default="HydraGlow"}，下方较小的文字为 {argument name="product name" default="Vitamin C Serum - 30ml"} 和 {argument name="benefit line" default="Brightening & Anti-Aging Formula"}，品牌名称上方饰有一个简约的金色植物莲花风格标志。柔和的自然晨光从侧面射入，营造出细腻的高光、微妙的阴影以及干净的奢华水疗氛围。在模糊的背景中，左侧放置 1 个带纹理的透明玻璃花瓶，内插绿色叶枝；右侧堆叠 3 条折叠整齐的白毛巾；左前方放置 1 个带有淡淡金纹的浅口白盘；右前方放置 1 个带有细金边的白色小碗。采用浅景深效果，焦点清晰地聚焦在瓶身上，整体色调为中性奶油色和白色，呈现高端电商广告美学、逼真的质感以及精致的健康品牌风格。

templates.title: Luxury Editorial 4:20 Product Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华时尚大片风格 4:20 产品海报

templates.prompt: A high-end editorial product poster in a minimalist studio, featuring an oversized translucent pink glass bong standing on the right side of the frame, nearly as tall as the composition, with a round water chamber half-filled with pale pink liquid, a long vertical neck releasing soft white smoke from the top, and a diagonal downstem visible inside the glass. A slim athletic woman with dark skin and long dreadlocks tied up in a high bun stands leaning casually against the bong near the center-left, her face intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur, wearing a dark olive sports bra, loose cream jogger pants, white crew socks with green stripes, and chunky off-white sneakers. She poses with one leg crossed in front of the other and one arm resting on the bong’s angled bowl. Behind them, place enormous bold dark green condensed numbers reading {argument name="headline text" default="4:20"} spanning almost the full height of the background on a warm light beige wall. In the lower left corner, add a small block of uppercase Spanish copy in a clean sans-serif font reading {argument name="quote" default="DEJÓ DE SER EXCEPCIÓN. — YA FORMA PARTE DEL PAISAJE."}. The overall look should feel like a luxury lifestyle ad campaign: clean composition, muted earthy palette, soft diffused studio lighting, subtle shadows, sharp product detail, fashion-editorial styling, realistic glass reflections, and a polished contemporary cannabis culture aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简摄影棚风格的高端时尚产品海报。画面右侧矗立着一个超大尺寸的半透明粉色玻璃水烟壶，几乎与构图等高，圆形的储水室中盛着半满的淡粉色液体，长长的垂直壶颈顶部散发出柔和的白烟，玻璃内部可见斜向下的导管。一位深色皮肤、留着高发髻脏辫的苗条运动型女性，随性地倚靠在画面中左侧的水烟壶旁，她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，身穿深橄榄色运动内衣、宽松的米色慢跑裤、带有绿色条纹的白色中筒袜以及厚底米白色运动鞋。她的一条腿交叉在另一条腿前，一只手臂搭在水烟壶倾斜的碗状接口上。在他们身后，暖米色的墙面上印有巨大的深绿色粗体压缩数字 {argument name="headline text" default="4:20"}，几乎覆盖了背景的整个高度。在左下角，添加一小段简洁的无衬线字体大写西班牙语文案 {argument name="quote" default="DEJÓ DE SER EXCEPCIÓN. — YA FORMA PARTE DEL PAISAJE."}。整体视觉效果应呈现出奢华生活方式广告大片的质感：构图简洁、大地色系柔和、柔光摄影棚照明、细腻的阴影、清晰的产品细节、时尚杂志造型、逼真的玻璃反射，以及精致的当代大麻文化审美。

templates.title: Editorial Portrait with Retro Handheld

titleLocalized.zh: 复古掌机主题时尚肖像

templates.prompt: A high-fashion studio portrait of a young woman posed from the waist up against a seamless vivid red background, centered in frame, with her face fully obscured by a solid vertical censor rectangle in a warm brown skin-tone color. She has {argument name="hair color" default="copper red"} hair styled in multiple messy mini buns on top with long defined spiral ringlets cascading down both sides, creating a playful Y2K editorial look. She wears black rectangular eyeglasses partially visible at the left edge of the censor bar, and her right ear is covered in stacked silver piercings and one long dangling charm earring. Her outfit is a distressed layered gray ensemble: a sheer mesh short-sleeve top over a fitted inner layer, plus extra-long detached fingerless arm warmers or sleeves with visible overlock seams and worn edges. She also wears layered silver chain necklaces. Her nails are long, sharply tapered acrylics in metallic lavender chrome. In her right hand, held beside her chest, she displays an open {argument name="handheld console" default="blue Game Boy Advance SP"} angled toward the camera, with a dark inactive screen and clearly visible controls. Her left hand rises to her chin in a soft fashion pose, fingers bent delicately. The image should feel like a clean commercial editorial photo with crisp detail, soft even studio lighting, realistic skin and fabric texture, saturated color contrast between the gray clothing and red backdrop, and a cool alt-girl retro-gaming aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高规格的摄影棚时尚肖像，拍摄对象为一位年轻女性的半身照，背景为无缝的鲜红色，人物居中。她的面部被一个暖棕色肤色的实心垂直遮挡矩形完全覆盖。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="铜红色"} 的头发，头顶扎着多个凌乱的小发髻，两侧垂下长而清晰的螺旋卷发，营造出俏皮的 Y2K 时尚编辑风格。她戴着黑色长方形眼镜，在遮挡条左侧隐约可见；右耳戴着叠戴的银色耳钉和一只长款吊坠耳环。她身着做旧的灰色叠穿服装：内层修身，外层为透明网眼短袖上衣，并搭配超长分离式露指袖套，边缘带有明显的包缝线和磨损痕迹。她还佩戴了叠戴的银色链条项链。指甲为长款尖头金属薰衣草色美甲。她的右手置于胸侧，展示着一台朝向镜头的 {argument name="handheld console" default="蓝色 Game Boy Advance SP"}，屏幕呈暗色未激活状态，按键清晰可见。左手轻触下巴，摆出柔和的时尚姿势，手指微弯。图像应呈现出干净的商业摄影质感，细节清晰，光线柔和均匀，皮肤和织物纹理真实，灰色服装与红色背景形成鲜明的色彩对比，整体散发出酷飒的另类复古游戏美学。

templates.title: Whimsical Cottage Valley Sunrise

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻小屋山谷日出

templates.prompt: A cozy storybook-style countryside illustration at golden-hour sunrise, painted in a soft whimsical digital gouache and watercolor look. Show a small cottage nestled in a lush green valley, with a warm red-orange tiled roof, cream plaster walls, a stone chimney releasing a thin curl of smoke, a tiny front porch, and a small upper balcony. Place the cottage in the lower right area of the composition, surrounded by an abundant cottage garden full of wildflowers and tall grasses. In front of the house, show 1 young girl in a simple {argument name="dress color" default="light blue"} dress and apron, gently sweeping the path with a broom. Near the porch, include 1 black cat sitting upright. Beside the path, include 1 small stone well with a wooden roof. On the right side near the house, show 1 laundry line with 2 white sheets hanging to dry. The foreground should be richly framed with leafy branches and flowering plants, especially 2 large clusters of overhanging leaves in the top left and top right corners, creating a natural vignette. A winding dirt path should begin in the foreground, pass by the cottage, and snake into the distance through rolling meadows and forested hills. Fill the midground and background with layered green hills, pine and deciduous trees, soft morning mist settling in the valleys, and distant mountains fading into atmospheric haze. Use warm sunlight streaming from the left, illuminating the grass and rooftops with soft golden highlights, with pastel peach clouds in a pale blue sky. The mood should feel peaceful, idyllic, nostalgic, and magical, like a children’s book landscape. No text, no border, highly detailed foliage, painterly linework, balanced composition, square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温馨的童话风格乡村插画，呈现黄金时刻的日出景象，采用柔和奇幻的数字水粉与水彩画风。画面展示了一座坐落在郁郁葱葱的绿色山谷中的小屋，配有温暖的红橙色瓦片屋顶、奶油色灰泥墙、冒着轻烟的石砌烟囱、一个小门廊和一个小型上层阳台。将小屋置于构图的右下角，周围环绕着开满野花和高草的繁茂花园。在屋前，画 1 位穿着 {argument name="dress color" default="浅蓝色"} 连衣裙和围裙的年轻女孩，正用扫帚轻轻清扫小径。在门廊附近，画 1 只坐姿端正的黑猫。在小径旁，画 1 口带木质屋顶的小石井。在屋子右侧，画 1 条晾衣绳，上面挂着 2 条正在晾晒的白色床单。前景应由茂密的枝叶和花卉植物丰富地勾勒，特别是左上角和右上角各 2 簇悬垂的叶子，营造出自然的暗角效果。一条蜿蜒的泥土小径从前景开始，经过小屋，穿过起伏的草甸和森林覆盖的山丘延伸至远方。中景和背景填充着层叠的绿色山丘、松树和落叶树，柔和的晨雾在山谷中弥漫，远处的山脉在大气朦胧中若隐若现。使用从左侧射入的温暖阳光，以柔和的金色高光照亮草地和屋顶，淡蓝色的天空中飘浮着柔和的桃色云朵。氛围应宁静、田园、怀旧且充满魔力，如同儿童绘本中的景观。无文字，无边框，细节丰富的植被，绘画感的线条，平衡的构图，正方形格式。

templates.title: Fairytale Cottage in an Alpine Valley

titleLocalized.zh: 阿尔卑斯山谷中的童话小屋

templates.prompt: A dreamy storybook landscape painting of a cozy fairytale cottage in a lush alpine valley, rendered in a soft painterly style with warm sunlight and delicate atmospheric haze. The cottage sits slightly left of center beside a winding stone path, with cream-colored plaster walls, a steep mossy thatched roof, a small chimney, curved dormer windows, a teal-blue front door, and climbing flowers around the walls and fence. A large leafy tree frames the left foreground, casting cool shade over wildflowers, grass, and rough wooden posts. On the right, a clear stream flows through the scene beneath a small old stone bridge. In the middle distance, a tiny hillside village with church-like towers nestles among trees. In the background, tall rugged mountains rise dramatically, their slopes softened by mist and crowned with bright white clouds. Use rich greens, sunlit gold, soft blue-gray mountains, and a tranquil pastoral mood, with highly detailed foliage, textured brushwork, and a whimsical classic fantasy illustration feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的绘本风格风景画，描绘了坐落在郁郁葱葱的阿尔卑斯山谷中的温馨童话小屋，采用柔和的绘画风格，呈现出温暖的阳光和细腻的大气雾感。小屋位于画面中心偏左侧，紧邻蜿蜒的石子小路，拥有奶油色的灰泥墙、陡峭且覆盖着苔藓的茅草屋顶、一个小烟囱、弧形老虎窗、青蓝色的大门，墙壁和栅栏周围爬满了鲜花。左侧前景是一棵枝繁叶茂的大树，为野花、草地和粗糙的木桩投下清凉的阴影。右侧，一条清澈的溪流穿过场景，流经一座古老的小石桥。中景处，一个带有教堂式塔楼的小山村掩映在树丛中。背景中，高耸崎岖的山脉巍峨耸立，山坡在薄雾中显得柔和，山顶环绕着洁白的云朵。画面采用浓郁的绿色、阳光般的金色、柔和的蓝灰色山脉，营造出宁静的田园氛围，并具备极高细节的植被、富有质感的笔触以及奇幻经典插画的独特韵味。

templates.title: Blue Pen Campaign Poster

titleLocalized.zh: “蓝笔”竞选海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Brazilian political campaign poster in a square social-media format, hyper-stylized and cinematic, with a dark blue and black color grade, intense contrast, gritty textures, and heroic propaganda-poster composition. On the right half, a middle-aged man wearing a bright royal-blue polo shirt faces the camera from the chest up, extending one hand toward the viewer and prominently holding a blue ballpoint pen upright as the central symbolic object. His pose is confident, assertive, and campaign-like, with the pen close to the lens for forced perspective. Behind him, two large waving flags fill the upper background: the Puerto Rico flag on the upper left side behind the subject and the Brazil flag on the upper right side. The lower background shows a dark crowd silhouette and a distant city skyline at sunset with glowing orange light on the horizon, adding a rally atmosphere. On the left side, create a vertical stack of 4 bold campaign statements, each preceded by a large blue X marker. The 4 text blocks must read exactly: "ELE NÃO TEM A MIDIA", "ELE NÃO TEM PROJETOS", "ELE TAMBÉM NÃO TEM O POVO", and "O RESTO ELE VAI DESCOBRIR NA HORA". Use condensed uppercase typography, mixing white and electric blue emphasis words, with each statement separated by thin horizontal blue divider lines. At the bottom, place an oversized distressed headline in uppercase reading "CANETA AZUL", with "CANETA" in weathered white and "AZUL" in vivid blue, spanning almost the full width. Below it, add a secondary subtitle in uppercase blue italic condensed text reading "PARA DEPUTADO", flanked by thin blue horizontal lines. The overall design should feel like a viral meme campaign ad, bold, satirical, aggressive, and highly shareable, with dramatic rim lighting, sharpened details, realistic skin and fabric texture, and polished poster-quality compositing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张正方形社交媒体格式的巴西政治竞选海报，采用超风格化电影质感，色调为深蓝色与黑色，对比度强烈，纹理粗犷，呈现出英雄主义宣传海报的构图。画面右侧，一名中年男子身穿亮宝蓝色 Polo 衫，半身出镜面向镜头，一只手伸向观众，手中竖直握着一支蓝色圆珠笔作为核心象征物。他的姿态自信、坚定，极具竞选感，笔尖靠近镜头形成强迫透视效果。他身后背景上方悬挂着两面巨大的旗帜：左上方为波多黎各旗帜，右上方为巴西旗帜。背景下方是暗色的群众剪影和日落时分远处的城市天际线，地平线上闪烁着橙色光芒，营造出集会氛围。在左侧，垂直排列 4 条醒目的竞选标语，每条标语前均有一个巨大的蓝色“X”标记。4 段文字内容必须完全一致：“ELE NÃO TEM A MIDIA”、“ELE NÃO TEM PROJETOS”、“ELE TAMBÉM NÃO TEM O POVO”以及“O RESTO ELE VAI DESCOBRIR NA HORA”。使用压缩大写字体，白色与电光蓝文字交替强调，每条标语之间用细蓝色水平线分隔。底部放置一个超大号的做旧大写标题“CANETA AZUL”，其中“CANETA”为风化白色，“AZUL”为鲜艳蓝色，几乎横跨整个宽度。下方添加一行蓝色斜体压缩大写副标题“PARA DEPUTADO”，两侧配有细蓝色水平线。整体设计应呈现出病毒式传播的模因竞选广告风格，大胆、讽刺、具有侵略性且易于分享，具备戏剧性的轮廓光、锐利的细节、逼真的皮肤与织物纹理，以及精致的海报级合成效果。

templates.title: Surreal Orange Puffer Bus Stop Editorial

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实橙色羽绒服公交车站时尚大片

templates.prompt: A surreal high-fashion editorial photograph on an empty roadside in a bleak Icelandic-looking landscape under a flat gray overcast sky. Center the composition on a small brutalist concrete bus stop shelter with stained weathered walls and a simple bench inside, and place 1 slender adult man inside the shelter wearing a tailored black suit, black shirt, and black shoes, standing casually and looking to the side. Draped over the entire bus stop is 1 enormous oversized puffer jacket in vivid burnt orange, inflated and tent-like, forming a monumental sculptural canopy over the shelter; the collar gapes open above the roof, the sleeves slump down on both sides to the wet pavement, and the glossy quilted nylon shows realistic wrinkles, puffed chambers, seams, snaps, and fashion-product detail. The road in the foreground is dark and rain-slick, with subtle reflections and a cold damp atmosphere. In the background, show low barren hills with traces of snow and a remote windswept shoreline feel. Shoot it like a luxury magazine fashion campaign with cinematic realism, centered framing, muted natural light, strong contrast between the monochrome environment and the orange coat, minimal color palette, slightly monumental scale distortion, and crisp editorial photography detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超现实的高级时装摄影作品，背景设定在冰岛风格的荒凉路边，天空阴沉灰暗。构图中心是一个小型粗野主义风格的混凝土公交车站，墙面斑驳风化，内部设有一张简单的长椅。一名身材修长的成年男子站在候车亭内，身穿剪裁考究的黑色西装、黑色衬衫和黑色皮鞋，神态自然地看向一侧。整个公交车站被一件巨大的亮橙色羽绒服覆盖，羽绒服呈充气帐篷状，如同纪念碑式的雕塑顶棚笼罩着候车亭；衣领在屋顶上方敞开，袖子垂落在潮湿的地面上，光泽感的尼龙面料呈现出逼真的褶皱、充绒隔层、接缝、按扣等时尚产品细节。前景中的道路深邃且被雨水打湿，带有细腻的倒影，营造出寒冷潮湿的氛围。背景展现了带有少量积雪的贫瘠丘陵，以及偏远地区被风吹拂的海岸线感。采用奢侈品杂志广告的拍摄手法，强调电影般的写实感、居中构图、柔和的自然光，单色环境与橙色外套形成强烈对比，色彩简约，带有轻微的纪念碑式比例失真，呈现出清晰的时尚摄影细节。

templates.title: Retro Pop-Art Comic Strip

titleLocalized.zh: 复古波普艺术漫画

templates.prompt: A 4-panel comic strip in bold retro Sunday funnies / 1980s pop-art style, thick black outlines, halftone textures, vibrant saturated colors (hot pink, cyan, yellow, teal), dynamic comic lettering. Main character: A stylish young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="wavy mint-green"} hair, wearing oversized black sunglasses and a {argument name="clothing" default="pink polka-dot strapless top"}. Confident expression, glossy lips, dramatic lighting. Secondary character: A cute chibi-style character in a full penguin costume (dark blue body, white belly, yellow beak hood), big sparkling eyes, small body, playful and mischievous vibe. Panel 1 (close-up, bold intro): Zoomed-in portrait of the woman, hair slightly blowing. Bright comic burst background. Text: “THE WIND IS NO MATCH FOR MY SHADES!” Speech bubble: “Bring it, breeze.” Panel 2 (beach chaos begins): Beach setting with strong wind—palm trees bending, hat, towel, and drink flying. Woman standing confidently. Penguin character appears at the side. Text box: “BEACH DAY!” Speech bubble: “Ha! Nice try, wind.” Small penguin text: “awk!” Panel 3 (wind intensifies): Stronger gusts—trash can tipping, seagull mid-air, debris flying. Woman still composed, hair dramatically flowing. Penguin laughing mischievously. Text box: “STRONGER!” Speech bubbles: “Is that all?” / penguin: “hee hee!” Panel 4 (final punchline): Reveal a big electric fan wearing sunglasses blasting air dramatically. Woman surprised. Penguin proudly next to fan. Text box: “ULTIMATE BOSS.” Speech bubbles: “Wait… no!” Big comic text: “YOU GOT BLOWN AWAY!” Caption at bottom: “RESPECT THE FAN.”

promptLocalized.zh: 一个采用大胆复古周日连环画 / 1980 年代波普艺术风格的 4 格漫画，具有粗黑轮廓线、半色调纹理、鲜艳饱和的色彩（亮粉色、青色、黄色、蓝绿色）以及动态漫画字体。主角：一位时尚的年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="波浪状薄荷绿"} 头发，戴着超大号黑色太阳镜，穿着 {argument name="clothing" default="粉色波点抹胸上衣"}。自信的表情，光泽感双唇，戏剧性的光影。次要角色：一个可爱的 Q 版企鹅装扮角色（深蓝色身体、白色肚皮、黄色喙帽），有着闪亮的大眼睛，身形娇小，充满顽皮淘气的氛围。第 1 格（特写，大胆开场）：女性的放大肖像，头发微微飘动。明亮的漫画爆炸背景。文字：“风根本吹不掉我的墨镜！”对话气泡：“来吧，微风。”第 2 格（海滩混乱开始）：强风中的海滩场景——棕榈树弯曲，帽子、毛巾和饮料被吹飞。女性自信地站着。企鹅角色出现在一旁。文本框：“海滩日！”对话气泡：“哈！想得美，风。”小企鹅文字：“嘎！”第 3 格（风力增强）：更强的阵风——垃圾桶倾倒，海鸥在空中，碎片飞舞。女性依然镇定，头发戏剧性地飘动。企鹅顽皮地大笑。文本框：“更强了！”对话气泡：“就这？” / 企鹅：“嘿嘿！”第 4 格（最终笑点）：揭示一个戴着太阳镜的大型电风扇正在戏剧性地吹风。女性感到惊讶。企鹅自豪地站在风扇旁边。文本框：“终极 BOSS。”对话气泡：“等等……不！”大型漫画文字：“你被吹跑了！”底部标题：“尊重风扇。”

templates.prompt:
Design a visually striking “miniature world” composition of {argument name="city name" default="CITY NAME"}, where the city’s most recognizable landmarks and architectural elements wrap organically around a compact, globe-like terrain, creating the illusion of a self-contained urban planet.

Blend the skyline and environment so they curve naturally with the surface, forming a cohesive spherical composition rather than a flat panorama. The perspective should feel elevated and slightly angled, as if captured from a drifting aerial viewpoint, enhancing depth and dimensional distortion.

Incorporate bold, contemporary 3D lettering that spells “{argument name="text" default="CITY NAME"}”, embedding it seamlessly into the cityscape; for example, integrated into streets, rooftops, or terrain, so it feels like a structural part of the environment.
Illuminate the scene with soft daylight under a lightly overcast sky, allowing diffused lighting to create subtle shadows and realistic highlights across buildings, vegetation, and roads.
Surround the miniature planet with an expansive, atmospheric sky that gently transitions into abstract, swirling cloud formations, adding a dreamlike quality without distracting from the central subject.

Use a balanced, lifelike color scheme tailored to {argument name="location" default="CITY NAME"}, featuring natural greens, sky blues, and grounded architectural tones, while maintaining vibrancy and clarity.

Render the final image in ultra-detailed photorealism, emphasizing texture accuracy, depth, and environmental realism, with a polished cinematic finish.

templates.title: Choreography Instruction Sheet Generator

titleLocalized.zh: 舞蹈编排说明表生成器

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet [VISUAL STYLE] {argument name="visual style" default="Monochrome grayscale composition"} featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered {argument name="subject" default="female dancer"}. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture. 
[GRID LAYOUT] Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression. [CHARACTER] Use image1 as the base character. The same {argument name="subject" default="female dancer"} appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions. [WARDROBE] The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: {argument name="outfit" default="a well-fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt"}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale. [PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME] Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”) Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions [MOTION INDICATORS] Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation. [RENDER QUALITY] High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose. [RESTRICTIONS] No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter—only the dancer and instructional elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
舞蹈序列说明表 [视觉风格] {argument name="visual style" default="单色灰度构图"}，展示高度精细的 3D 渲染 {argument name="subject" default="女性舞者"}。设计风格如同专业的舞蹈编排指南，采用技术性、图表式的布局。干净的白色背景，柔和的摄影棚灯光，以及强烈的对比度，以突出身体动作和姿态。
[网格布局] 结构化的 4×4 面板网格（共 16 帧），由细黑分割线均匀间隔。每个面板尺寸相同，并清晰地从 1 到 16 编号，以展示连续的舞蹈进程。[角色] 使用 image1 作为基础角色。同一个 {argument name="subject" default="女性舞者"} 在所有面板中保持一致，具有准确的相似度和比例。[服装] 舞者穿着时尚、适合表演的服装：{argument name="outfit" default="修身上衣搭配短款飘逸裙子"}。造型应看起来现代且具有视觉吸引力，同时便于舞蹈动作。即使在灰度下，织物也应微妙地响应运动（轻微的流动感和褶皱）。[面板结构 – 每一帧] 左上角：步骤编号 + 简短的舞蹈动作标题（例如，“步骤 5 – 旋转过渡”） 中心：捕捉舞蹈编排中精确瞬间的全身姿势 左下角：3–4 行描述该动作的简洁说明 叠加层：说明舞者如何过渡的运动箭头和方向指南 [运动指示器] 加入用于流畅运动的曲线箭头、用于方向性步骤的直线箭头，以及用于旋转或转圈的圆形指示器。强调节奏、重心转移和身体孤立动作。[渲染质量] 高细节雕塑感 3D 风格，具有平滑的灰度阴影、微妙的投影和干净的线条。保持精美的概念艺术级完成度，确保每个姿势都清晰可见。[限制] 无颜色，无背景场景，无额外角色，无视觉杂乱——仅保留舞者和说明性元素。

templates.title: Travel Snapshot Collage Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 旅行快照拼贴提示词

templates.prompt:
A 12-frame collage of candid, emotional snapshots of a young {argument name="ethnicity" default="Chinese"} woman traveling alone in {argument name="location" default="Phuket Island"}, casually captured on a {argument name="device" default="smartphone"}.
Each frame feels like a fleeting personal memory — imperfect, sun-drenched, intimate, and unposed.

The woman has a naturally curvy figure with a soft, feminine silhouette, subtly emphasizing her bust without exaggeration. Her presence feels real and unstyled, like a private photo album.

Scenes include: walking barefoot on the beach, seaside under the strong sunlight, palm trees swaying, overexposed ocean reflections, small local cafés, a modest motel room, sunset the coast,  night markets, views from inside a moving car. 

Shot with a smartphone aesthetic: slight motion blur, soft focus, blown-out highlights from tropical sunlight, lens flare, sun glare, high ISO noise at night, uneven framing, accidental cropping.

Composition feels random and spontaneous — subject sometimes off-center, partially cut off, mid-motion, or obscured by light leaks.

Lighting varies: harsh midday sun, warm golden hour glow, deep sunset tones, humid night street lighting.

Color grading: faded cinematic tones, slightly desaturated with warm highlights, nostalgic film-like look, subtle grain, lifted blacks.

Emotion: solitude, fleeting youth, bittersweet nostalgia, quiet introspection, like memories from a trip taken alone.

Layout: 12 images arranged in a loose, imperfect collage grid, slightly tilted and misaligned like a scrapbook.

No text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张由 12 帧抓拍组成的拼贴画，记录了一位年轻的 {argument name="ethnicity" default="中国籍"} 女性在 {argument name="location" default="普吉岛"} 独自旅行时的感性瞬间，均由 {argument name="device" default="智能手机"} 随手拍摄。
每一帧都如同转瞬即逝的个人记忆——不完美、阳光明媚、亲密且自然，毫无摆拍痕迹。

画面中的女性拥有自然丰满的身材和柔美的轮廓，在不夸张的前提下微妙地突显了胸部线条。她的状态真实且未经修饰，仿佛私人相册中的记录。

场景包括：赤脚走在沙滩上、强光下的海边、摇曳的棕榈树、过曝的海面反光、小型当地咖啡馆、简朴的汽车旅馆房间、海岸日落、夜市、从行驶中的车内向外看的视角。

采用智能手机拍摄美学：轻微的运动模糊、柔焦、热带阳光造成的过曝高光、镜头光晕、眩光、夜间高 ISO 噪点、不均匀的构图、随意的裁剪。

构图呈现出随机与自发感——主体有时偏离中心、部分被遮挡、处于运动中，或被漏光效果遮盖。

光影变化多样：刺眼的午后阳光、温暖的黄金时刻光芒、深沉的日落色调、潮湿的夜间街灯。

色彩分级：褪色的电影质感、略微降低饱和度并带有暖色高光、怀旧的胶片感、细腻的颗粒感、提升的暗部细节。

情感基调：孤独、转瞬即逝的青春、苦乐参半的怀旧感、安静的内省，如同独自旅行时的回忆。

布局：12 张图片以松散、不规则的拼贴网格排列，略微倾斜且不对齐，如同剪贴簿一般。

无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Editable PSD Layer Generation

templates.prompt: Generate an {argument name="file format" default="editable PSD layered file for Photoshop"} based on the reference image. templates.title: Detailed Animal Encyclopedia Generation

titleLocalized.zh: 详细动物百科全书生成

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
[Animal Name]
{argument name="animal name" default="insert animal name here"}

[Objective]
Complete a large-format animal encyclopedia plate at a sellable quality level as a single illustration. Generate a publishing-quality plate that balances scientific accuracy with visual appeal.

[Output Format]
- Include all information in one image
- Aspect Ratio: 16:9
- Quality: High (essential for ensuring precision of small text, fine lines, and labels)

[Screen Design Principles]
Layout, zoning, information priority, margin design, typography, decorative elements, and color palette should all be determined autonomously by GPT based on the animal's characteristics, habitat, and classification. Design a layout best suited for this specific animal without being bound by templates.

[Essential Elements to Include]
Integrate the following elements naturally into one frame:

1. Main Specimen Drawing
- Full body of adult depicted with maximum precision
- Scientifically accurate colors, patterns, and proportions
- Scientific name (italicized), common name, and classification info (Order, Family, Genus)
- Scale bar or size comparison

2. Growth/Development Record
- Step-by-step illustration of changes from juvenile to adult
- Concise labels for each stage

3. Ecological/Behavioral Depiction
- Action scenes in natural environments (foraging, predation, breeding, territoriality, etc.)
- Include habitat vegetation and terrain in the background

4. Morphological Details
- Close-ups of characteristic parts (claws, fangs, feathers, scales, eyes, etc.)
- Magnified depictions of surface textures

5. Distribution/Habitat Range
- World or regional distribution map
- Description of habitat types

6. Data Notations
- Length, weight, lifespan, diet, conservation status (IUCN, etc.)
- Easy-to-read table or icon format

[Style Specification]
- Publisher-quality natural history encyclopedia
- Realistic botanical/naturalist painting touch (19th-century naturalist precision + modern color expression)
- Paper texture: Cream-colored hot-press watercolor paper or parchment style
- Font: Unified serif. Scientific names in italics; data can use mixed small sans-serif fonts
- Border: Thin ink border + classical plate decoration
- Overall color scheme, layout tone, and page design optimized by GPT based on habitat, classification, and ecology

[Most Important Instruction]
Deeply understand the unique ecology, cultural significance, and taxonomic features of this animal to design a page that feels like it was "made just for this animal." Visualize the essence of the animal rather than using a generic template. Ensure all text is actually rendered within the frame, leaving no empty labels.

promptLocalized.zh:
[动物名称]
{argument name="animal name" default="在此处输入动物名称"}

[目标]
完成一张可达到出版质量的大幅动物百科全书图版，作为单幅插图呈现。生成一张兼具科学准确性与视觉美感的出版级图版。

[输出格式]
- 将所有信息包含在一张图像中
- 长宽比：16:9
- 质量：高（对于确保小字、细线和标签的精确度至关重要）

[屏幕设计原则]
布局、分区、信息优先级、页边距设计、排版、装饰元素和配色方案应由 GPT 根据动物的特征、栖息地和分类自主决定。为该特定动物设计最合适的布局，不受模板限制。

[必须包含的基本要素]
将以下要素自然地整合到一个画面中：

1. 主标本绘图
- 以最高精度描绘成体全身
- 科学准确的颜色、图案和比例
- 学名（斜体）、俗名和分类信息（目、科、属）
- 比例尺或尺寸对比

2. 生长/发育记录
- 从幼体到成体变化的逐步插图
- 每个阶段的简洁标签

3. 生态/行为描绘
- 自然环境中的动作场景（觅食、捕食、繁殖、领地行为等）
- 背景中包含栖息地植被和地形

4. 形态细节
- 特征部位的特写（爪、牙、羽毛、鳞片、眼睛等）
- 表面纹理的放大描绘

5. 分布/栖息地范围
- 世界或区域分布图
- 栖息地类型描述

6. 数据标注
- 体长、体重、寿命、饮食、保护状况（IUCN 等）
- 易于阅读的表格或图标格式

[风格规范]
- 出版级自然历史百科全书风格
- 写实的植物/博物学家绘画笔触（19 世纪博物学家的精确度 + 现代色彩表现）
- 纸张质感：奶油色热压水彩纸或羊皮纸风格
- 字体：统一的衬线体。学名使用斜体；数据可使用混合的小号无衬线字体
- 边框：细墨线边框 + 古典图版装饰
- 整体配色、布局基调和页面设计由 GPT 根据栖息地、分类和生态进行优化

[最重要的指令]
深入理解该动物独特的生态、文化意义和分类特征，设计出一个仿佛“专为该动物而作”的页面。可视化该动物的精髓，而不是使用通用的模板。确保所有文本都实际渲染在画面内，不要留下空白标签。
