templates.title: AI Hair and Grooming Diagnosis Report

titleLocalized.zh: AI 发型与仪容诊断报告

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create a beauty diagnosis visual report that analyzes facial features, bone structure, eyes, eyebrows, lips, hair quality, and face line based on the uploaded {argument name="target" default="male"}'s photo, suggesting suitable hairstyles and grooming. 

A4 portrait orientation, sophisticated page design in the style of a Japanese {argument name="gender" default="men's"} visual magazine. White to charcoal base, thin ruled lines, navy/gray accents, and a stylish layout utilizing white space. Include a small English subtitle "AI HAIR & GROOMING DIAGNOSIS". 

Maintain the identity of the person's face, naturally changing only the hairstyle, beard, and atmosphere. Do not turn them into a different person.

Composition is as follows:

1. "Hairstyle Diagnosis" at the top
   - 3-column comparison of "Best Fit," "Average," and "Not Recommended"
   - Apply different hairstyles to the same person
   - Display hairstyle names, short reasons, and star ratings

2. List of hairstyle candidates in the middle
   - Categories: Business / Casual / Trend
   - Grid display of small thumbnails
   - Attach short hairstyle names to each thumbnail

3. "Grooming Analysis Guide" at the bottom
   - Larger portrait
   - Face type diagnosis chart (oval, oblong, round, etc.)
   - Type name (e.g., Clean Sharp)
   - Short analysis comments
   - 4 styling points
   - Visual comparison of suitable vs. unsuitable beard styles

Text should be in Japanese, centered on headings, short sentences, and labels. Avoid long text and keep it concise. Include analysis charts, evaluation stars, and style comparison displays. The overall finish should be cool and reliable, like a feature page in an actual men's visual magazine.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个美容诊断视觉报告，根据上传的 {argument name="target" default="male"} 照片分析面部特征、骨骼结构、眼睛、眉毛、嘴唇、发质和脸部线条，并建议合适的发型和仪容方案。

A4 纵向排版，采用日式 {argument name="gender" default="男士"} 视觉杂志风格的精致页面设计。以白色至炭灰色为基调，搭配细线条、海军蓝/灰色点缀，并利用留白打造时尚布局。包含一行小型英文副标题“AI HAIR & GROOMING DIAGNOSIS”。

保持人物面部特征，仅自然地改变发型、胡须和整体氛围，切勿将其变成另一个人。

排版结构如下：

1. 顶部“发型诊断”
   - “最适合”、“一般”、“不推荐”的三栏对比
   - 对同一个人应用不同发型
   - 显示发型名称、简短理由及星级评分

2. 中部发型候选列表
   - 分类：商务 / 休闲 / 潮流
   - 小型缩略图网格展示
   - 每个缩略图附带简短发型名称

3. 底部“仪容分析指南”
   - 较大的人物肖像
   - 脸型诊断图表（如椭圆形、长方形、圆形等）
   - 类型名称（例如：清爽锐利型）
   - 简短分析评论
   - 4 个造型要点
   - 适合与不适合的胡须样式视觉对比

文字应使用日语，以标题、短句和标签为中心。避免长篇大论，保持简洁。包含分析图表、评价星级和样式对比展示。整体风格应如同男士视觉杂志的专题页面一样，酷炫且具有专业感。

templates.title: Anime School Spy Movie Poster

templates.prompt: A dramatic anime-style Japanese movie poster set in the middle of a modern downtown street canyon under bright afternoon sunlight, with tall office buildings on both sides, dense overhead utility wires, vertical Japanese shop and company signs, and a cinematic vanishing point down the road. In the foreground, two high school girls stand full-body in confident hero poses, framed low-angle like blockbuster poster key art. The girl on the left is slightly taller, with very long black hair flowing in the wind, styled half-up in a bun with a white flower hair ornament, arms crossed, serious and composed expression, wearing a navy school blazer with gold buttons, white shirt, red necktie, and a red plaid pleated skirt. She has bare legs and shiny black loafers. The girl on the right has a short light-brown bob haircut, a softer but determined expression, and holds up a peace sign with her right hand. She wears a matching navy blazer, white shirt, red tie, and red plaid pleated skirt, with navy knee-high socks and brown loafers. Make both characters elegant, stylish, and slightly idealized in polished contemporary anime illustration with crisp linework, rich cel-shading, glossy highlights, and subtle wind movement in hair and clothing. Use strong contrast, blue sky with scattered white clouds, warm sunlit rim light, long street shadows, and a high-budget action-drama poster mood. Add large layered title typography across the lower center, mixing Japanese and English in a bold distressed blockbuster style. Include 1 Japanese tagline above the main title reading "一命と絆とスパイー". Include 1 large Japanese main title reading "私立あかつき学園" with white, red, and cyan-blue emphasis. Include 1 English subtitle block below and overlapping it reading "THE SPY WHO FORGOT THE BONDS" in bold white condensed letters with gritty texture, with the word "SPY" especially large and dominant. The overall composition should feel like a fictional action-school-spy film poster, vertical format, highly polished, dynamic, and theatrical.

One promise."}; at the bottom center, small spaced uppercase credits in light beige reading {argument name="bottom credits" default="A YOUART CINEMATIC PRESENTATION · STORY CHAIN · 2026"}. One promise."}；在底部中心，使用间距较大的小号大写字母作为演职员表，颜色为浅米色，文字内容为 {argument name="bottom credits" default="A YOUART CINEMATIC PRESENTATION · STORY CHAIN · 2026"}。确保文字清晰、居中且高度易读。画面中总共可见 2 把剑：手中 1 把出鞘的武士刀，腰间 1 把带鞘的剑。

templates.title: Anime Suspense Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫悬疑电影海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese movie poster in a polished anime-cinematic style, vertical one-sheet composition, set at night over a glowing futuristic Tokyo and Gunma-themed cityscape filled with blue holographic HUD graphics, star-like particles, and surveillance interface overlays. The poster features 5 visible character elements: 1 dominant oversized close-up of a mysterious woman occupying the entire upper-right background, shown in profile with long dark hair and a huge elegant white wide-brim hat with a dark ribbon, her expression serious and unreadable; 3 teenage students grouped in the left-center foreground wearing Japanese school uniforms with dark blazers, white shirts, and red striped ties — one tall messy-haired boy in the middle, one girl with a black ponytail on the left turned partly away, and one short-haired girl on the right facing forward; and 1 smaller supporting figure in the lower-right corner, a pale-haired violinist in a heavy fur-trimmed winter coat playing the violin. Add a luminous holographic map of Japan across the lower middle with a red target reticle centered over Gunma, plus coordinate and data callouts. Include visible English interface text in small red and blue typography such as “OPERATION AKATSUKI,” “THE BONDS NEVER DIES,” “IN PROGRESS,” “TARGET: AKATSUKI CITY,” “AKATSUKI CITY,” “GUNMA PREFECTURE,” “JAPAN,” and coordinate strings. The skyline on the left should include a Tokyo Tower-like landmark glowing orange-red. Use intense blue, black, silver, and crimson lighting, wet glossy highlights, drifting snow or ash particles, layered depth, and high-contrast painterly detail. At the bottom, create a large bold Japanese title in metallic red, white, and blue: {argument name="headline text" default="私立 あかつき学園"}, with a large metallic silver English subtitle beneath it: {argument name="tagline" default="THE BONDS NEVER DIES"}. Add small Japanese credit lines above the release date, including faux director, screenplay, character design, and cast credits, and place a centered release line at the very bottom reading {argument name="release date" default="12.20 ROADSHOW"}. The overall mood should feel like a high-budget suspense drama, youth ensemble mystery, and techno-thriller anime film poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满戏剧性的日本电影海报，采用精致的动漫电影风格，垂直单页构图。背景设定在夜晚，呈现出闪烁着未来感的东京与群马主题城市景观，画面中布满了蓝色全息 HUD 图形、星光般的粒子以及监控界面叠加效果。海报包含 5 个可见的角色元素：1 位占据右上角整个背景的神秘女性特写，侧脸出镜，留着长长的黑发，戴着一顶优雅的白色宽檐帽，配有深色丝带，表情严肃且难以捉摸；3 名位于左中前景的青少年学生，身穿日本校服（深色西装外套、白衬衫和红条纹领带），中间是一位高个子乱发男孩，左侧是一位扎着黑色马尾辫的女孩，右侧是一位短发女孩正面向前；以及 1 位位于右下角的小型配角，一位穿着厚重毛领冬装、正在拉小提琴的浅发色小提琴手。在画面中下部添加一张发光的日本全息地图，红色目标准星对准群马县，并配有坐标和数据标注。包含可见的红色和蓝色小字英文界面文本，如“OPERATION AKATSUKI”、“THE BONDS NEVER DIES”、“IN PROGRESS”、“TARGET: AKATSUKI CITY”、“AKATSUKI CITY”、“GUNMA PREFECTURE”、“JAPAN”以及坐标字符串。左侧的天际线应包含一个闪烁着橙红色光芒的东京塔式地标。使用强烈的蓝色、黑色、银色和深红色灯光，湿润的亮面高光，飘落的雪花或灰烬粒子，层叠的景深以及高对比度的绘画细节。在底部，创建一个巨大的粗体金属红、白、蓝三色日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="私立 あかつき学園"}，下方配有巨大的金属银色英文副标题：{argument name="tagline" default="THE BONDS NEVER DIES"}。在上映日期上方添加小字日文演职员表，包括虚构的导演、编剧、角色设计和演员名单，并在最底部居中放置上映日期行：{argument name="release date" default="12.20 ROADSHOW"}。整体氛围应呈现出高预算悬疑剧、青春群像推理和科技惊悚动漫电影海报的质感。

templates.title: Burning Anime School Thriller Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 燃烧的动漫校园惊悚片海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese anime movie poster in a dark action-thriller style, vertically composed like a theatrical one-sheet. The background is a school campus and city street engulfed in flames at night, with blazing orange fire, black smoke, flying embers, shattered structures, rain-slick pavement, and a cinematic apocalyptic atmosphere. In the top half, show 2 large opposing character close-ups in profile facing inward: on the left, a teenage boy with tousled medium brown hair, pale skin, and a serious expression, wearing a dark school uniform jacket and white shirt; on the right, a teenage girl with long dark hair tied back, pale skin, and an intense expression, also in a school uniform with a red ribbon at the collar. Between them, place a reflective knife blade angled upward, catching the firelight. Add a vertical Japanese tagline in the upper center, white serif text, reading {argument name="tagline text" default="この夏、隠された絆が運命を変える―"}. Across the middle, place a huge layered title in Japanese with distressed metallic texture, heavy cinematic typography, motion slashes, sparks, and red-to-blue contrast, reading {argument name="main title" default="私立 あかつき学園"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle above it reading "絆とスパイと夏". Directly below, add the English subtitle in bold silver blockbuster lettering: {argument name="english subtitle" default="THE SUMMER WITH SHADOW BONDS"}. In the bottom half, show 1 full-body action scene of a determined teenage schoolgirl riding a blue sport motorcycle at high speed through the burning campus street. She has short brown hair whipping in the wind, a fierce focused stare, a short-sleeved white school shirt, loosened red tie, plaid skirt, fingerless black gloves, and black shoes. Her pose is low and aggressive over the handlebars, as if in pursuit or escape. The motorcycle is sleek and angular with bright headlights and visible decals including "Shinobi" on the fairing and "250R" on the exhaust. Include 1 pursuing police car with flashing red and blue lights in the right background. At the very bottom, add small Japanese film-credit style text lines and a release line in gold and white reading {argument name="release line" default="2025.夏 ROADSHOW"}. Use ultra-detailed anime illustration, high contrast lighting, glossy reflections, dramatic rim light, intense orange-and-blue color grading, dynamic perspective, premium modern anime poster design, and the polished look of a high-budget theatrical key visual.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日本动漫电影海报，采用黑暗动作惊悚风格，构图为垂直的电影单张海报。背景是夜晚被火焰吞噬的校园和城市街道，伴有炽热的橙色火焰、黑色浓烟、飞溅的火星、破碎的建筑、雨后湿滑的路面以及电影般的末日氛围。上半部分展示 2 个大型对立角色的侧脸特写，面朝内侧：左侧是一位留着凌乱棕色中长发、皮肤白皙、表情严肃的少年，身穿深色校服外套和白衬衫；右侧是一位留着长马尾、皮肤白皙、表情强烈的少女，同样身穿校服，领口系着红色丝带。在两人之间，放置一把向上倾斜的反射刀刃，映照着火光。在上方中心添加垂直的日文标语，使用白色衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="この夏、隠された絆が運命を変える―"}。在中间位置，放置一个巨大的分层日文标题，采用磨损的金属质感、厚重的电影排版、动态划痕、火花以及红蓝对比色，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="私立 あかつき学園"}，上方配有较小的日文副标题“絆とスパイと夏”。正下方添加粗体银色大片风格的英文副标题：{argument name="english subtitle" default="THE SUMMER WITH SHADOW BONDS"}。下半部分展示 1 个全身动作场景，一位神情坚定的女高中生正骑着一辆蓝色运动摩托车，在燃烧的校园街道上高速行驶。她留着短棕发，在风中飘动，眼神犀利专注，身穿短袖白衬衫、松开的红领带、格子裙、黑色露指手套和黑色鞋子。她的姿势压得很低，充满侵略性，仿佛正在追逐或逃离。摩托车线条流畅且棱角分明，带有明亮的前灯和清晰可见的贴纸，包括整流罩上的“Shinobi”和排气管上的“250R”。在右侧背景中包含 1 辆闪烁着红蓝警灯的追逐警车。在最底部，添加小号的日文电影演职员表风格文字行，以及金白色的上映日期行，内容为 {argument name="release line" default="2025.夏 ROADSHOW"}。采用超精细的动漫插画、高对比度光影、光泽反射、戏剧性的轮廓光、强烈的橙蓝调色、动态视角、高级现代动漫海报设计，呈现出高预算电影主视觉图的精致质感。

templates.title: Fantasy GPT Image Skills Banner

titleLocalized.zh: Fantasy GPT Image 技能横幅

templates.prompt: A richly detailed fantasy workshop illustration in a wide cinematic banner format, crowded with playful young apprentice characters gathered around an elderly master in the center. The scene has a magical artisan studio atmosphere with warm amber lighting, glowing runes, floating icons, scrolls, framed artworks, and shelves full of tools and curios. At the top center, a dramatic black brushstroke banner carries large hand-painted gold lettering reading {argument name="headline text" default="GPTImage2Skill"}. In the middle sits an old sage-like teacher with white hair in a topknot and a long white beard, wearing layered tan and gray robes, seated calmly on a low stool as if mentoring the group. Around him are 8 chibi-style apprentices with exaggerated expressive faces, black hair tied in small topknots, colorful traditional outfits in purple, green, red, orange, yellow, blue, and teal, each proudly presenting a different creation. Count and show exactly 8 apprentices plus the central master. On the far left, one purple-clad child kneels and holds a framed anime-style action portrait with electric blue effects. Above left, one green-clad child raises a drink poster featuring a matcha beverage and East Asian typography. Near lower left-center, one apprentice in green presents a clean schematic page with small UI-like boxes and diagrams. Near center-right, one orange-red-clad child holds a realistic luxury perfume bottle product shot. To the right of that, one yellow-orange child presents a realistic bird photograph with soft bokeh. Upper center-right, one cheerful child lifts a tablet or framed mobile app screen showing a clean interface. Far right lower side, one blue-clad child displays a dark-themed analytics dashboard full of charts and graphs. On the upper right, a tall regal figure in ornate white-and-gold robes and crown-like headpiece stands holding 2 framed fantasy artworks: one darker landscape scene and one moonlit city or temple scene. Include exactly 2 artworks in this upper-right display. Scatter glowing floating UI-style icons around the room; include exactly 6 floating icon/sign elements: a puzzle-piece icon, a network-node icon, a code window, a cube icon, a glowing sign reading "PLUGIN" beside a puzzle icon, and a glowing star sign reading "SKILL". Also add 2 magical scroll banners with glowing edges, one near the top right and one across the bottom foreground, both covered in stylized code-like colored lines. The environment should feel like a blend of ancient atelier, fantasy library, and creative AI studio, with stone arches, wooden beams, distant mountainous scenery visible through openings, and golden magical particles swirling through the air. Highly polished digital illustration, dense composition, whimsical epic tone, saturated jewel colors, dramatic rim lighting, crisp detail, painterly textures, fantasy promotional poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的奇幻工作室插画，采用宽幅电影横幅格式，画面中一群顽皮的年轻学徒聚集在中央的一位老大师周围。场景营造出一种充满魔力的工匠工作室氛围，配有温暖的琥珀色灯光、发光的符文、漂浮的图标、卷轴、带框艺术品以及摆满工具和古玩的神龛。在顶部中央，一个引人注目的黑色笔触横幅上写着巨大的手绘金色文字 {argument name="headline text" default="GPTImage2Skill"}。中间坐着一位留着发髻、长着白胡子的老圣人，身穿棕褐色和灰色的多层长袍，平静地坐在矮凳上，仿佛正在指导这群学徒。在他周围有 8 位 Q 版学徒，他们表情夸张生动，黑发扎着小发髻，身穿紫色、绿色、红色、橙色、黄色、蓝色和青色的传统服饰，每个人都自豪地展示着不同的作品。请准确绘制并显示 8 位学徒加上中央的大师。最左侧，一名身穿紫衣的孩子跪着，手持一幅带有电光蓝色特效的动漫风格动作肖像。左上方，一名身穿绿衣的孩子举起一张印有抹茶饮品和东亚字体的饮品海报。左下侧附近，一名身穿绿衣的学徒展示了一张带有小型 UI 框和图表的简洁示意图。中右侧附近，一名身穿橙红色衣服的孩子拿着一张逼真的奢华香水瓶产品照。在它右侧，一名身穿黄橙色衣服的孩子展示了一张带有柔和焦外成像效果的逼真鸟类照片。中右上方，一名开朗的孩子举起一个平板电脑或带框的移动应用屏幕，显示着简洁的界面。右下侧，一名身穿蓝衣的孩子展示了一个充满图表和图形的深色主题分析仪表板。右上角，一位身穿华丽白金长袍、头戴皇冠状头饰的高大尊贵人物站着，手持 2 幅奇幻艺术品：一幅是较暗的风景画，另一幅是月光下的城市或寺庙场景。此右上角区域请包含正好 2 幅艺术品。在房间周围散布发光的漂浮 UI 风格图标；请包含正好 6 个漂浮图标/标志元素：一个拼图图标、一个网络节点图标、一个代码窗口、一个立方体图标、一个在拼图图标旁写着 "PLUGIN" 的发光标志，以及一个写着 "SKILL" 的发光星形标志。此外，添加 2 个边缘发光的魔法卷轴横幅，一个在右上角附近，另一个在底部前景，两者都覆盖着程式化的彩色代码线条。环境应感觉像是古代工作室、奇幻图书馆和创意 AI 工作室的结合体，配有石拱门、木梁、透过开口可见的遥远山景，以及在空气中旋转的金色魔法粒子。高度精美的数字插画，构图紧凑，充满奇幻史诗感，色彩饱和，边缘光影效果强烈，细节清晰，具有绘画质感，达到奇幻宣传海报的品质。

templates.title: Anime Girl to Cinematic Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 将动漫少女转化为电影感照片

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, recreate the same girl and black cat in the same seated pose, but transform the flat anime drawing into a realistic cinematic photo. Keep the orange-and-black gothic dress, white frills, lightning armband, headpiece, black cat lying across her knees, white socks, and black Mary Jane shoes consistent with the reference. Place her in a moody vintage interior with a worn wooden floor, aged plaster walls, and 1 tall softly glowing window with sheer curtains on the left casting warm late-afternoon light. Use a nostalgic sepia-orange color grade, subtle film grain, soft shadows, and shallow depth of field for a photoreal editorial look.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，重现相同的少女和黑猫，保持相同的坐姿，但将扁平的动漫绘画转化为写实风格的电影感照片。保持与参考图一致的橙黑配色哥特裙、白色荷叶边、闪电臂章、头饰、横卧在膝盖上的黑猫、白色短袜以及黑色玛丽珍鞋。将她置于一个充满氛围感的复古室内环境中，背景包括磨损的木地板、老旧的灰泥墙，以及左侧一扇透出柔和暖光的落地窗，窗帘轻薄，投射出午后温暖的光影。采用怀旧的深褐色调，加入细腻的胶片颗粒感、柔和的阴影以及浅景深效果，营造出写实的编辑摄影风格。

templates.title: Cinematic Sunset Couple Close-Up

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感日落情侣特写

templates.prompt: A cinematic golden-hour close-up of a young couple in an intimate outdoor moment, framed from the chest up. The main focus is a handsome young man with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} tousled wavy hair, soft defined jawline, smooth light-tan skin, and a calm, distant expression as he gazes slightly upward and off to the left. He wears a black open-collar button-up shirt with a relaxed, elegant fit. Leaning into him is 1 young woman with long dark brown hair, her face mostly hidden against his shoulder and chest, creating a tender, protective mood; only part of her hair, shoulder, and thin black spaghetti-strap dress are visible. Use warm sunset backlighting with the sun low behind them on the left, creating glowing rim light around their hair and shoulders, soft lens flare, amber highlights, shallow depth of field, and a blurred natural landscape in the background with low hills. The composition should feel romantic, editorial, and filmic, like a luxury fragrance or fashion campaign, with soft skin detail, realistic textures, subtle wind in the hair, muted earth tones, and high-end cinematic color grading. Photorealistic, emotional, intimate, 50mm lens look, ultra-detailed, natural light, soft contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一张电影质感的黄金时刻特写，拍摄了一对年轻情侣在户外亲密互动的瞬间，取景范围为胸部以上。画面焦点是一位英俊的年轻男子，他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} 的凌乱波浪卷发，下颌线条柔和分明，肤色呈现细腻的浅棕色，神情平静而深邃，目光微微向上并投向左侧。他身穿一件剪裁宽松优雅的黑色开领衬衫。一名留着深棕色长发的年轻女子依偎在他怀中，她的脸庞大半埋在他的肩头和胸前，营造出一种温柔且充满保护感的氛围；画面中仅可见她的部分秀发、肩膀以及黑色细肩带连衣裙。采用温暖的日落逆光，太阳位于他们左后方的低空，在他们的发丝和肩头勾勒出明亮的轮廓光，伴有柔和的镜头光晕、琥珀色高光、浅景深效果，背景是模糊的自然景观和低矮的山丘。构图应充满浪漫、杂志大片和电影感，如同高端香水或时尚广告，呈现细腻的皮肤质感、逼真的纹理、微风拂过的发丝、柔和的大地色调以及高端的电影级调色。照片级真实感，情感充沛，亲密无间，50mm 镜头视觉，超高细节，自然光，柔和对比度。

templates.title: PSG Transfer Announcement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼 (PSG) 转会官宣海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic football transfer announcement poster in a vertical social-media format, centered on a photorealistic adult male soccer player wearing a modern Paris Saint-Germain home jersey, arms crossed, chest-up framing, strong athletic build, face mostly obscured by a soft rectangular blur block for anonymity, short close-cropped hair visible around the edges. Use a deep navy blue PSG-themed color palette with bold red and white accents. The jersey should feature a central red vertical stripe bordered by white, a red swoosh-style sports logo on the left side from the viewer's perspective, the PSG crest on the opposite chest, and faint sponsor lettering across the torso. Place the player in front of a layered graphic background featuring an oversized faded PSG crest filling most of the upper-right background, a dark Eiffel Tower silhouette on the right side, painterly brush-stroke textures, subtle grunge, and a white vertical paint strip on the left with a rough red brush accent near the middle. Include the PSG club badge near the upper left. Add left-side stacked slogan text in bold uppercase sans serif reading: "NEW CLUB. NEW CHAPTER. PARIS." with the last word in red. Add a huge distressed white block headline across the lower middle reading "{argument name="player surname" default="MBAPPE"}", with smaller spaced uppercase first name above it reading "{argument name="player first name" default="KYLIAN"}". Overlay a red handwritten script across the big surname saying "{argument name="welcome text" default="Welcome To Paris"}". At the bottom center, add small uppercase text "PARIS SAINT-GERMAIN" and beneath it the year "{argument name="year" default="2026"}" in red with thin divider lines on each side. In the lower left, include small stacked text "ICI C'EST PARIS" with "PARIS" in red. In the lower right, add a circular stamp-style badge reading "PARIS IS MAGIQUE". Use cinematic lighting, high contrast, premium sports-brand poster design, sharp fabric texture, moody shadows, gritty editorial finish, and polished transfer-window announcement aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张极具戏剧性的足球转会官宣海报，采用竖版社交媒体格式。画面中心为一名写实的成年男性足球运动员，身穿现代风格的巴黎圣日耳曼主场球衣，双臂交叉，采用胸部以上构图，展现强健的运动体魄。为了保持匿名，面部大部分区域覆盖有柔和的矩形模糊块，边缘可见利落的短发。整体采用深海军蓝色的 PSG 主题配色，辅以醒目的红色和白色点缀。球衣正面应包含一条两侧镶有白边的红色垂直条纹，从观众视角看，左侧饰有红色运动品牌 Logo，右侧胸前饰有 PSG 队徽，躯干处有若隐若现的赞助商文字。将球员置于分层图形背景前，背景右上角填充有巨大的淡化版 PSG 队徽，右侧为深色的埃菲尔铁塔剪影，并融合绘画般的笔触纹理、细腻的颗粒感，以及左侧一条带有粗犷红色笔触的白色垂直涂漆条。左上方放置 PSG 俱乐部徽章。在左侧添加堆叠的粗体大写无衬线标语文字：“NEW CLUB. NEW CHAPTER. PARIS.”，其中最后一个单词为红色。在画面中下部添加一个巨大的做旧白色块标题，内容为“{argument name="player surname" default="MBAPPE"}”，上方配以较小的间距大写名“{argument name="player first name" default="KYLIAN"}”。在大号姓氏上方叠加红色的手写体文字“{argument name="welcome text" default="Welcome To Paris"}”。在底部中心添加小号大写文字“PARIS SAINT-GERMAIN”，下方为红色的年份“{argument name="year" default="2026"}”，两侧配有细分隔线。左下角包含堆叠的小号文字“ICI C'EST PARIS”，其中“PARIS”为红色。右下角添加一个圆形印章风格徽章，文字为“PARIS IS MAGIQUE”。采用电影级布光、高对比度、高级运动品牌海报设计风格，呈现清晰的织物纹理、深邃的阴影、粗粝的编辑质感以及精致的转会窗口官宣美学。

templates.title: Fox-Eared Streetwear Boy in Steampunk City

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克城市中的狐耳街头风少年

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a fashionable fox-eared young man sitting casually on the edge of a floating industrial platform in a vast vertical steampunk city. He has messy layered {argument name="hair color" default="light blond"} hair with a small streak of deep magenta near one side, 2 large fox ears with pale inner fur, and a fluffy cream-colored fox tail curling behind him. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat square censor block centered over the face. He wears a glossy black bomber jacket embroidered with scattered floral patterns in 2 colors, red-pink and violet-blue, with ribbed cuffs and collar striped in dark red and black. Under it is a black graphic T-shirt with ornate gold lettering and emblem details, partially hidden by layered straps and necklaces. His outfit includes loose black cargo-style pants with zipper details, black socks with small gold lettering, and chunky black platform shoes with bright magenta laces. Add multiple silver rings, black suspenders or harness straps with metal buckles, and a long olive-gold hanging belt strap draped off the platform. Pose him in a relaxed seated posture with 1 knee raised and 1 leg extended diagonally downward, left arm resting over the raised knee and right hand planted beside him. The mood is cool, urban, and slightly rebellious. The background is an intricate labyrinth of towering pale teal and off-white mechanical structures, stacked platforms, scaffolding, hanging chains, exposed cables, suspended boxes, and several round clocks embedded in the architecture, creating a dense vertical futuristic-steampunk environment fading into atmospheric haze. Use soft daylight, muted pastel industrial colors, fine linework, delicate ink-and-watercolor rendering, crisp fabric highlights, and a polished contemporary anime illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位时尚的狐耳少年，他正随意地坐在广阔的垂直蒸汽朋克城市中一座悬浮工业平台的边缘。他留着凌乱且富有层次感的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 头发，一侧有一缕深洋红色挑染，长着一对巨大的狐耳，内侧毛发呈浅色，身后蜷缩着一条蓬松的奶油色狐狸尾巴。他的面部被一个位于正中央的扁平方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。他身穿一件亮面黑色飞行员夹克，上面绣有红粉色和紫蓝色两种颜色的零星花卉图案，罗纹袖口和领口带有深红色与黑色的条纹。夹克内搭一件黑色印花 T 恤，上面有华丽的金色字母和徽章细节，被层叠的带子和项链部分遮挡。他的装束包括宽松的黑色工装裤（带有拉链细节）、带有小号金色字母的黑色短袜，以及配有亮洋红色鞋带的厚底黑色鞋。添加多个银色戒指、黑色背带或带有金属扣的束带，以及一条从平台垂下的橄榄金色长腰带。让他保持放松的坐姿，一只膝盖抬起，另一条腿斜向下伸展，左臂搭在抬起的膝盖上，右手撑在身侧。整体氛围酷炫、都市且略带叛逆。背景是一个由高耸的浅青色和灰白色机械结构、堆叠的平台、脚手架、悬挂的链条、裸露的电缆、悬浮的箱子以及嵌入建筑中的几座圆形时钟组成的复杂迷宫，营造出一种融入大气雾霾中的密集垂直未来蒸汽朋克环境。采用柔和的日光、柔和的工业色彩、精细的线条、细腻的墨水与水彩渲染、清晰的织物高光，以及精致的当代动漫插画美学。

templates.title: Surreal Crocs Summer Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实 Crocs 夏季广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a surreal lifestyle fashion advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}. Vertical composition, photorealistic, golden-hour outdoor lighting. A young woman sits relaxed on a grassy lakeside meadow filled with small white daisies, leaning against an enormous oversized foam clog in a pale sage green color. The giant shoe should dominate the scene like a playful sculpture, positioned behind her at a slight angle with the heel strap raised upright and visible round logo rivet on the side. Show realistic Crocs-style details: ventilation holes on top, textured molded foam surface, thick sole, front ports, and side perforations. The model wears matching light green clogs, white scrunched crew socks, a muted sage green cropped tank top, high-waisted cream patterned shorts, an open loose white shirt draped off her shoulders, and a simple necklace. She has dark hair in a messy bun and reclines with one knee bent, gazing upward in a carefree pose. Background: calm lake, distant green hills or low mountains, and a bright blue sky with large soft cumulus clouds. Use a clean editorial ad aesthetic with cheerful, airy summer vibes, shallow depth of field but enough clarity to keep both the model and giant clog sharp. Add centered white brand text at the top: large rounded lowercase logo reading {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} with a small trademark symbol, and beneath it a white slogan line reading {argument name="tagline" default="Come as you are. Comfort follows."}. Emphasize harmony between the model's outfit and the shoe color palette, aspirational comfort, whimsical scale contrast, and polished commercial photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超现实生活方式时尚广告海报，品牌为 {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}。竖版构图，照片级真实感，黄金时刻户外光效。一位年轻女性在开满小白雏菊的湖畔草地上惬意地坐着，倚靠在一只巨大的淡鼠尾草绿色泡沫洞洞鞋旁。这只巨大的鞋子像一件趣味雕塑般占据画面主体，放置在她身后，呈微倾斜角度，后跟带竖起，侧面可见圆形的品牌标志铆钉。展示真实的 Crocs 风格细节：顶部的透气孔、纹理模压泡沫表面、厚鞋底、前部孔洞及侧面穿孔。模特穿着同色系的浅绿色洞洞鞋、白色堆堆袜、柔和的鼠尾草绿短款背心、高腰奶油色印花短裤，肩上披着一件宽松的白色衬衫，佩戴简约项链。她留着深色凌乱丸子头，单膝弯曲斜倚，姿态随性，仰望天空。背景：平静的湖泊、远处的绿色丘陵或低矮山脉，以及点缀着大片柔软积云的明亮蓝天。采用干净的编辑广告美学，营造欢快、轻盈的夏季氛围，景深较浅，但足以确保模特和巨大的鞋子清晰可见。在顶部居中添加白色品牌文字：大号圆润小写标志 {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"}，并带有小型商标符号；下方添加一行白色标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Come as you are. Comfort follows."}。强调模特服装与鞋子配色方案之间的和谐感、令人向往的舒适感、奇幻的比例对比以及精致的商业摄影质感。

templates.title: Editorial Palm Reading Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 编辑级手相解读信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, transform the photographed hand into a clean, editorial palmistry infographic on a light off-white background. Keep the same palm, orientation, skin tone, and black perforated watch band, but cut it out cleanly and place it as the main photo on the left. Build a modern magazine-style one-page layout around it with thin divider lines, rounded light-gray info panels, elegant serif headings, and small minimal line icons. Add these 7 titled sections: "PALM READING GUIDE" at top left with the subtitle "Insights. Strengths. Path."; "AT A GLANCE" in a top-right summary card; "YOUR PALM LINES" with 1 simple line-art hand diagram and 5 labeled lines; "THE MAJOR LINES" with 5 separate cards; "PALM FEATURES" with 4 feature rows; "WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU" with 5 interpretation rows; and "YOUR PATH" as a bottom summary strip. In "YOUR PALM LINES", include exactly 5 labels with short descriptions: HEART LINE, HEAD LINE, LIFE LINE, FATE LINE, SUN LINE. In "THE MAJOR LINES", include exactly 5 cards titled HEART LINE, HEAD LINE, LIFE LINE, FATE LINE, SUN LINE, each with a small icon and short bullet-point interpretations. In "PALM FEATURES", include exactly 4 rows: PALM SHAPE, FINGERS, THUMB, MOUNTS. In "WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU", include exactly 5 rows: STRENGTHS, CHALLENGES, LOVE & RELATIONSHIPS, CAREER & LIFE PATH, GUIDANCE. Fill all body copy with plausible palm-reading text tailored to this hand, written in a polished lifestyle-magazine tone. Make it look like a premium palm reading report generated from the uploaded hand photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0，将拍摄的手部照片转换为背景为浅米白色的简洁编辑级手相信息图。保留相同的手掌、方向、肤色和黑色穿孔表带，将其干净地抠出并放置在左侧作为主图。围绕它构建现代杂志风格的单页布局，使用细分割线、圆角浅灰色信息面板、优雅的衬线标题和小型极简线条图标。添加以下 7 个标题板块：左上角为“PALM READING GUIDE”，副标题为“Insights. Strengths. Path.”；右上角为“AT A GLANCE”摘要卡片；“YOUR PALM LINES”包含 1 个简单的手部线条示意图和 5 条标注线；“THE MAJOR LINES”包含 5 张独立卡片；“PALM FEATURES”包含 4 个特征行；“WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU”包含 5 个解读行；底部摘要条为“YOUR PATH”。在“YOUR PALM LINES”中，包含 5 个带有简短描述的标签：HEART LINE（感情线）、HEAD LINE（智慧线）、LIFE LINE（生命线）、FATE LINE（命运线）、SUN LINE（太阳线）。在“THE MAJOR LINES”中，包含 5 张标题分别为 HEART LINE、HEAD LINE、LIFE LINE、FATE LINE、SUN LINE 的卡片，每张卡片配有小图标和简短的要点解读。在“PALM FEATURES”中，包含 4 个行：PALM SHAPE（手掌形状）、FINGERS（手指）、THUMB（拇指）、MOUNTS（掌丘）。在“WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU”中，包含 5 个行：STRENGTHS（优势）、CHALLENGES（挑战）、LOVE & RELATIONSHIPS（爱情与人际关系）、CAREER & LIFE PATH（事业与人生路径）、GUIDANCE（指引）。使用针对该手部特征、风格优雅的生活方式杂志语调，填充所有正文内容。使其看起来像是一份由上传的手部照片生成的优质手相解读报告。

templates.title: Cinematic Nordic Football Legend Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影质感北欧足球传奇海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic football legend poster designed as a layered double-exposure portrait on a textured off-white paper background. The overall composition is a large side-profile silhouette of {argument name="athlete name" default="Erling Haaland"}, facing right, with the interior of the silhouette filled with a dramatic Nordic football journey montage. Keep the outer head shape realistic, with windswept long blond hair sweeping across the top and back, and a visible ear at the far right edge. Inside the silhouette, build a moody storm-soaked narrative scene in deep navy, charcoal, steel blue, cold gray, and muted gold. At the top of the silhouette, place a rugged mountain landscape under turbulent clouds, a small coastal village with warm lights, and 1 footballer seen from behind standing near a pitch-side area; include a visible sign that reads {argument name="location text" default="BRYNE"}. In the upper-middle area, add 2 figures from a memory scene, an older man with an arm around a child, both seen from behind in mist and rain. Nearby, add 1 smaller action figure in a red football kit running forward in celebration. In the middle-right, place 1 larger action figure in a yellow football kit, sprinting intensely through rain and sparks. Across the central band, incorporate 1 tactical-analysis strip with drawn arrows, circles, dashed passing lines, and small player markers, plus tiny technical text overlays such as sprint speed and top speed values, giving a data-driven elite-athlete feel. In the lower-middle foreground, feature the main hero figure in a dark almost-black football kit, long blond hair tied back, charging diagonally toward the viewer with explosive motion and wet, reflective fabric. Behind him, show a packed stadium with bright floodlights and heavy atmosphere. At the lower-right, depict 1 goalkeeper diving and 1 football blasting into the goal with a bright motion trail. Add subtle rain, mist, embers, spray, and ink-like watercolor edges around the silhouette so the image bleeds organically into the paper. At the bottom center, place an elegant gold serif title in large capital letters reading {argument name="title text" default="THE MACHINE FROM THE NORTH"}, and beneath it a small refined subtitle reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Built In Rain, Finished In Silence"}. The style should feel like an epic sports biopic poster, hyper-detailed, emotional, atmospheric, dramatic lighting, high contrast, painterly photorealism, premium fan-edit aesthetic, cinematic depth, sharp focal subjects, and a mythic Scandinavian tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的足球传奇海报，设计为叠加在纹理米白色纸张背景上的双重曝光肖像。整体构图为一个巨大的 {argument name="athlete name" default="Erling Haaland"} 侧面剪影，面向右侧，剪影内部填充着充满戏剧性的北欧足球之旅蒙太奇画面。保持外侧头部轮廓真实，顶部和后部有被风吹拂的长金发，最右侧边缘可见耳朵。在剪影内部，构建一个深海军蓝、炭黑、钢蓝、冷灰和柔和金色的阴郁暴雨叙事场景。在剪影顶部，放置一个多云天气下的崎岖山地景观、一个带有温暖灯光的小型沿海村庄，以及 1 名从背后看去站在球场边区域的足球运动员；包含一个清晰可见的标志，上面写着 {argument name="location text" default="BRYNE"}。在中上区域，添加 2 个来自记忆场景的人物，一名老人搂着一个孩子，两人都在雾雨中背对镜头。附近添加 1 个较小的身穿红色球衣、正在奔跑庆祝的动作人物。在中右侧，放置 1 个较大的身穿黄色球衣、在雨水和火花中奋力冲刺的动作人物。在中央地带，加入 1 条战术分析带，包含绘制的箭头、圆圈、虚线传球路线和小球员标记，并叠加微小的技术文本（如冲刺速度和最高速度值），营造出数据驱动的精英运动员感。在左中前景处，突出主角人物，身穿深近乎黑色的球衣，长金发扎在脑后，以爆发性的动作斜向冲向观众，衣服湿润且具有反光感。在他身后，展示一个灯火通明、氛围浓厚的拥挤体育场。在右下角，描绘 1 名守门员正在扑救，以及 1 个带着明亮运动轨迹射入球门的足球。在剪影周围添加微妙的雨水、薄雾、余烬、水雾和类似墨水的晕染边缘，使图像自然地融入纸张。在底部中心，放置一个优雅的金色衬线大写标题 {argument name="title text" default="THE MACHINE FROM THE NORTH"}，并在其下方放置一行精致的小副标题 {argument name="tagline text" default="Built In Rain, Finished In Silence"}。整体风格应呈现史诗级体育传记海报感，超高细节、情感丰富、氛围感强、光影戏剧化、高对比度、绘画级写实感、高级粉丝剪辑美学、电影级景深、主体清晰，并带有神话般的斯堪的纳维亚基调。

templates.title: Cinematic Football Legend Silhouette Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影质感足球传奇剪影海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic poster-style digital collage shaped like the side profile silhouette of a male football legend, facing left, on a textured off-white background with rough painterly brush strokes around the silhouette edges. The image uses a luxurious dark navy, sepia, bronze, and gold color palette with dramatic high contrast lighting, glowing highlights, and a prestige editorial feel. Inside the silhouette, build a layered visual journey of ambition and greatness with exactly 8 distinct scene elements: 1) at the upper left inside the head, a young boy in shorts stands on a rocky seaside cliff beside a football, looking toward a glowing coastal mountain landscape at sunset; 2) on the right side of the upper head area, a small boat on the water near the cliffs; 3) in the center, an adult footballer in light kit suspended midair as if striking or controlling the ball, dynamic and heroic; 4) at the mid-left lower area, a lone man standing on a floodlit pitch seen from behind; 5) across the middle, a row of 5 golden Ballon d'Or-style trophy spheres glowing prominently; 6) at the lower left, a football stadium rendered as a bright golden ring of light with a small player silhouette nearby and crashing ocean waves in front; 7) near the lower center, a seated contemplative figure on a jagged rock peak; 8) at the bottom right, a long illuminated road cutting through desert-like terrain toward the horizon. Add an architectural colonnade with warm lights running through the central-right interior of the silhouette, blending into the layered scenes. The hair of the profile should be dark and textured, with the facial silhouette partially open to white negative space on the right for typography. Place large elegant metallic-gold text on the lower right reading {argument name="headline text" default="MADE BY OBSESSION"}, and beneath it a smaller italic serif subtitle reading {argument name="tagline" default="A Life Scored In Gold"}. Make the subject feel like {argument name="athlete name" default="Cristiano Ronaldo"} without using a photoreal likeness, emphasizing mythic legacy, perseverance, football greatness, and a premium sports documentary poster aesthetic. Vertical composition, highly detailed, cinematic atmosphere, fine-art sports poster, subtle grain, painterly compositing, glowing gold accents.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影海报风格的数字拼贴画，主体为一位向左看的男性足球传奇人物的侧面剪影，背景为带有粗糙油画笔触纹理的米白色。画面采用奢华的深海军蓝、棕褐色、青铜色和金色调，配合戏剧性的高对比度光影、发光高光，营造出一种高端的编辑艺术感。在剪影内部，构建一段充满雄心与伟大的分层视觉旅程，包含 8 个独特的场景元素：1) 在头部左上方，一个穿着短裤的小男孩站在岩石海边悬崖旁，身边放着一颗足球，望向日落时分发光的海岸山脉；2) 在头部右上方区域，悬崖附近水面上有一艘小船；3) 在中心位置，一名身着浅色球衣的成年足球运动员悬浮在半空中，仿佛正在击球或控球，动态且英勇；4) 在中左下方区域，一名孤独的男子背对着站在灯火通明的球场上；5) 在画面中部，一排 5 个金色的“金球奖”风格奖杯球体熠熠生辉；6) 在左下方，一座足球场呈现为明亮的金色光环，附近有一个小小的球员剪影，前方是汹涌的海浪；7) 在下部中心附近，一个沉思的身影坐在锯齿状的山峰上；8) 在右下方，一条发光的长路穿过沙漠般的地形延伸向地平线。在剪影中右侧内部添加一排带有暖光的建筑柱廊，与分层场景融为一体。剪影的头发应呈现深色且富有质感，面部剪影右侧部分留白，以便排版。在右下方放置醒目优雅的金属金色文字 {argument name="headline text" default="MADE BY OBSESSION"}，下方配以较小的斜体衬线副标题 {argument name="tagline" default="A Life Scored In Gold"}。使主体呈现出 {argument name="athlete name" default="Cristiano Ronaldo"} 的神韵，无需追求照片级写实，重点强调神话般的传承、毅力、足球伟大成就以及高端体育纪录片海报的美学风格。竖构图，高度精细，电影氛围，美术体育海报，细腻颗粒感，油画合成，金色光影点缀。

The background is a chaotic black concert backdrop filled with paint splatters, sparks, smoke, neon-like color streaks, and a huge rough white brush-lettered band name across the top reading {argument name="band name" default="KESSOKU BAND"}. Show exactly 4 band members standing shoulder to shoulder in performance poses, each wearing dark band T-shirts and casual stage outfits, with stylized colored lighting around them. On the far left is Yamada Ryo with short dark blue hair, holding a cream-colored bass guitar, calm expression, blue paint splash behind her, and her name displayed in Japanese and English: "山田リョウ" and "YAMADA RYO". Second from left is Ijichi Nijika with blonde twin ponytails, energetic pose with one hand raised in a peace sign, warm yellow splash behind her, a large red ribbon at the collar, and her name displayed as "伊地知虹夏" and "IJICHI NIJIKA". Behind the center area place a red drum kit with the band logo on the bass drum. Second from right is Kita Ikuyo with long vivid red hair, playing a blue electric guitar, red splash behind her, and her name displayed as "喜多郁代" and "KITA IKUYO". On the far right is Gotoh Hitori with long flowing pink hair, playing a black electric guitar, pink splash behind her, and her name displayed as "後藤ひとり" and "Gotoh Hitori". At the bottom left, place a huge hot-pink Japanese title in aggressive brush lettering reading "結束バンド", with smaller white Japanese tagline text beneath it. At the bottom right, add a diagonal hot-pink paint-stroke banner with bold black handwritten English slogan text reading {argument name="bottom slogan" default="LIVE IS OUR LIFE, LOUDER THAN YESTERDAY. STRONGER TOGETHER."}. Use a high-contrast manga poster aesthetic, saturated blue-yellow-red-pink accents for each girl, rough halftone texture, distressed paintbrush typography, explosive stage-light atmosphere, and polished anime character rendering. promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的动漫摇滚乐队海报，采用粗粝的泼墨宣传风格，画面呈现结束乐队 (Kessoku Band) 的四位女孩在舞台上的宽幅构图，展现动态的演唱会氛围。背景为混乱的黑色演唱会幕布，布满油漆飞溅、火花、烟雾、霓虹般的色彩线条，顶部横跨巨大的粗犷白色毛笔字样，显示乐队名称 {argument name="band name" default="KESSOKU BAND"}。在左上方添加一个巨大的漫画对话框，内含粗体手绘英文文本 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="KESSOKU BAND WERE CRUSHING IT"}。画面中精准呈现 4 名乐队成员肩并肩站立的表演姿态，每人都穿着深色乐队 T 恤和休闲舞台装，周围环绕着风格化的彩色灯光。最左侧是山田凉 (Yamada Ryo)，留着深蓝色短发，手持奶油色贝斯，表情冷静，身后有蓝色油漆飞溅，并显示其日文和英文名："山田リョウ" 和 "YAMADA RYO"。左二为伊地知虹夏 (Ijichi Nijika)，留着金色双马尾，姿态充满活力，一只手比出胜利手势，身后有温暖的黄色飞溅，领口系着大红丝带，并显示其名称为 "伊地知虹夏" 和 "IJICHI NIJIKA"。中心区域后方放置一套红色鼓组，大鼓上印有乐队标志。右二为喜多郁代 (Kita Ikuyo)，留着鲜艳的红色长发，弹奏蓝色电吉他，身后有红色飞溅，并显示其名称为 "喜多郁代" 和 "KITA IKUYO"。最右侧是后藤一里 (Gotoh Hitori)，留着飘逸的粉色长发，弹奏黑色电吉他，身后有粉色飞溅，并显示其名称为 "後藤ひとり" 和 "Gotoh Hitori"。左下角放置巨大的亮粉色日文标题，采用充满张力的毛笔字书写 "结束バンド"，下方配有较小的白色日文标语。右下角添加一条对角线亮粉色油漆笔触横幅，内含粗体黑色手写英文标语 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="LIVE IS OUR LIFE, LOUDER THAN YESTERDAY. templates.title: Manga Amp Shock Band Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 漫画风格：音箱触电场景

templates.prompt: A black-and-white manga comic panel in a dramatic shonen gag style, showing {argument name="band name on shirts" default="結束バンド"} girls from a high school rock band getting shocked by an overloaded guitar amp during practice. The composition is a single wide panel with 4 girls arranged around a large amplifier in the foreground center, crackling with electricity, smoke, sparks, glowing energy, and jagged lightning bolts wrapping around the scene. Use screentone shading, halftone textures, bold inked outlines, speed-line energy, exaggerated shocked expressions, and chaotic comedy timing. On the far left, 1 partially obscured girl is seated, her face mostly hidden behind a tall rectangular narration box; she wears a dark band T-shirt and dark pants, with one arm bent upward in surprise. Near left-center, 1 girl with long light hair and straight bangs, wearing a dark band T-shirt and a large bow at the collar, stares with spiral eyes and a panicked open mouth, holding one finger up near her lips as if frozen in confusion. Near right-center, 1 shorter girl with messy medium-length dark hair and spiral eyes recoils with both hands raised to her mouth, also wearing a dark band T-shirt. On the far right, 1 long-haired girl in a light zip-up track jacket and skirt sits rigidly with knees together, eyes wide and spiraled, mouth agape, sweat on her face, leaning back in alarm. The amplifier dominates the lower middle, seen front-on with a row of exactly 8 control knobs, a cable plugged into the left side, a cable plugged into the right side, and a small power switch area on the right; bright electrical arcs erupt from the top panel. Include exactly 4 speech or narration text areas: a tall narration box on the upper left reading {argument name="left narration" default="until that day at practice, when the amp overloaded"}, a jagged speech balloon near the lower left reading {argument name="lower left exclamation" default="IT'S ELEC-TRIFIED!"}, a large balloon above the left-center girl reading {argument name="center scream" default="GYAAH!"}, and a large balloon on the upper right reading {argument name="right reaction" default="WHAT THE—?!"}. Also add 1 stylized sound effect near the top center-right reading "ZAP!" with bold Japanese-style impact lettering beside it. Background should be mostly abstract manga effects: dense screentone gradients, electric aura, smoke plumes, and impact bursts rather than a detailed room. Tone: comedic body-swap accident setup, intense but playful, classic manga parody panel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅黑白漫画分镜，采用戏剧性的少年漫恶搞风格，描绘了来自某高中摇滚乐队的 {argument name="band name on shirts" default="結束バンド"} 少女们在练习时因吉他音箱过载而触电的场景。构图为单幅宽画幅，4 位少女围绕着前景中央的大型音箱，音箱周围闪烁着电弧、烟雾、火花、发光能量以及缠绕场景的锯齿状闪电。使用网点纸阴影、半调纹理、粗犷的勾线、速度线效果、夸张的震惊表情以及混乱的喜剧节奏。最左侧，1 位部分被遮挡的少女坐着，脸部大部分被一个高大的长方形旁白框遮住；她穿着深色乐队 T 恤和深色长裤，一只手臂因惊讶而向上弯曲。左中位置，1 位留着浅色长发、平刘海的少女穿着深色乐队 T 恤，领口系着大蝴蝶结，双眼呈螺旋状，张着嘴陷入恐慌，一只手指着嘴唇，仿佛因困惑而僵住。右中位置，1 位留着凌乱中长深色头发的矮个子少女双眼呈螺旋状，双手捂嘴向后退缩，同样穿着深色乐队 T 恤。最右侧，1 位留着长发、身穿浅色拉链运动外套和短裙的少女双膝并拢僵硬地坐着，双眼圆睁呈螺旋状，张着嘴，脸上带着汗珠，惊恐地向后倾斜。音箱位于画面下方中央，正面可见一排整齐的 8 个控制旋钮，左侧插着一根线缆，右侧插着一根线缆，右侧有一个小型电源开关区域；明亮的电弧从顶部面板喷涌而出。包含 4 个对话或旁白文本区域：左上角一个高大的旁白框，内容为 {argument name="left narration" default="直到练习那天，音箱过载了"}，左下方一个锯齿状对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="lower left exclamation" default="触电了！"}，左中少女上方一个大对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="center scream" default="啊啊啊！"}，以及右上角一个大对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="right reaction" default="什么鬼——？！"}。此外，在顶部中右侧添加一个风格化的拟声词，内容为“ZAP！”，旁边配有粗体的日式冲击字体。背景应以抽象的漫画效果为主：密集的网点渐变、电光气场、烟雾和冲击爆发，而非详细的房间细节。基调：喜剧向灵魂互换事故设定，紧张而俏皮，经典的漫画恶搞分镜。

templates.title: Manga Body Swap Band Panic

titleLocalized.zh: 漫画：身体互换大骚乱

templates.prompt: A black-and-white manga comic panel in a clean seinen/anime style, showing 4 girls from a rock band sitting side by side in a cramped music studio right after an electrical accident, with a chaotic body-swap theme. Large hand-lettered title text at the top reads {argument name="headline text" default="BODY SWAP PANIC!"}. The scene is framed as a single wide panel with dramatic speed lines and comic energy. From left to right: girl 1 is a short-haired shy girl in a black band T-shirt and dark pants, staring at her hand and speaking in shock, with a speech bubble that says {argument name="left speech" default="EH?! MY VOICE!?"}; girl 2 is a calm, expressionless blonde girl with long straight hair, wearing a black band T-shirt, scarf, and plaid pants, sitting with one hand on her hip and saying in a smaller speech bubble, "Hmm. This is... loud."; girl 3 is a flustered cheerful girl with medium-length hair in a black band T-shirt and long skirt, blushing, sweating, clutching her hands near her mouth, with a large speech bubble that says {argument name="center speech" default="H-H-HEEEEH?! I'M KITA-CHAN?!"}; girl 4 is a long-haired girl in a zip hoodie and skirt, sitting rigidly with arms crossed and eyes squeezed shut, complaining in a tall speech bubble that says {argument name="right speech" default="BOCCHI-CHAN'S BODY IS SO... CRAMPED!"}. All 4 girls have small circular inset head icons above or near them showing whose mind is inside whose body, for a body-swap explanation device. The band shirts have a simple Japanese logo on the chest. Background shows exactly 3 visible studio elements: a drum kit in the back, an amplifier or speaker cabinet, and cables or equipment edges around the floor and sides. Use monochrome screentone shading, halftone textures, blush marks, sweat drops, bold ink outlines, and expressive manga lettering. The mood is comedic panic, awkward confusion, and post-shock chaos in a rehearsal room. Composition should feel crowded, readable, and like a fan comic inspired by {argument name="series" default="Bocchi the Rock!"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用简洁青年/动漫风格的黑白漫画分镜，描绘了摇滚乐队的 4 位少女在一次电力事故后，挤在狭窄的音乐工作室里，陷入混乱的身体互换主题。顶部有手写的大字标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="身体互换大骚乱！"}。画面为单幅宽画幅，带有戏剧性的速度线和漫画张力。从左到右：女孩 1 是短发羞涩女孩，身穿黑色乐队 T 恤和深色长裤，正盯着自己的手震惊地说话，对话框内容为 {argument name="left speech" default="诶？！我的声音？！"}；女孩 2 是冷静、面无表情的金发长直发女孩，身穿黑色乐队 T 恤、围巾和格子裤，单手叉腰，在较小的对话框中说道：“嗯。这……太吵了。”；女孩 3 是慌乱的开朗女孩，中等长度头发，身穿黑色乐队 T 恤和长裙，脸红、流汗，双手紧贴嘴边，大对话框内容为 {argument name="center speech" default="诶——？！我变成喜多酱了？！"}；女孩 4 是长发女孩，身穿拉链连帽衫和短裙，僵硬地坐着，双臂交叉，双眼紧闭，在一个高大的对话框中抱怨道 {argument name="right speech" default="波奇酱的身体……太挤了！"}。4 位女孩上方或附近都有小圆形的头像图标，用以展示谁的灵魂在谁的身体里，作为身体互换的说明装置。乐队 T 恤胸前印有简单的日文标志。背景展示了 3 个清晰可见的工作室元素：后方的架子鼓、一个扩音器或音箱，以及地板和四周的线缆或设备边缘。使用单色网点纸阴影、半色调纹理、脸红标记、汗滴、粗犷的墨线和富有表现力的漫画字体。氛围为喜剧式的恐慌、尴尬的困惑以及排练室里事故后的混乱。构图应显得拥挤、易读，并具有受 {argument name="series" default="孤独摇滚！"} 启发的同人漫画感。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Mythology Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克神话电影海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic ultra-detailed sci-fi movie poster for {argument name="title text" default="KALKI PROTOCOL"}, designed as a vertical one-sheet with a mythic cyberpunk India aesthetic. Show a back-facing central figure occupying most of the frame, a mysterious warrior in a dark futuristic long coat with a high collar, standing upright and looking toward a sprawling neon megacity. The figure has dark curly hair tied into a rough bun, a glowing circular earring on one ear, and a powerful silhouette with the face mostly hidden in profile shadow. Behind the head, place a huge radiant golden-orange halo made of concentric rings inscribed with Sanskrit-style sacred text and arcane symbols, giving the character a divine, prophetic presence. Inside and around the silhouette, blend a futuristic version of {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"}: dense skyscrapers, holographic billboards, elevated structures, reflective waterways, and a cool blue-violet night atmosphere contrasted against the warm halo. Include exactly 3 flying vehicles: 2 high-speed hoverbikes racing across the lower and middle right area with bright magenta engine trails, and 1 small hovering aircraft farther back in the sky on the right. Add one prominent illuminated billboard reading {argument name="billboard text" default="MUMBAI"} with a smaller Devanagari line beneath it. Scatter additional vertical neon signs with Devanagari text along the buildings. The color palette should be electric cyan, deep indigo, magenta, orange, and gold, with wet reflective surfaces, volumetric haze, dramatic rim lighting, and a polished blockbuster poster finish. Place large futuristic glowing title typography across the lower middle reading {argument name="main title" default="KALKI PROTOCOL"}. Under it, add the tagline {argument name="tagline" default="THE FINAL ERA BEGINS"}, then a release line reading "COMING 3125.11", then a multilingual credit line listing "HINDI - TELUGU - TAMIL - KANNADA - MALAYALAM - ENGLISH", and a small hashtag line at the bottom. High contrast, epic scale, premium concept art, seamless double-exposure composition, cyberpunk Mumbai meets Indian mythology, action-packed and divine.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级超精细科幻电影海报，用于 {argument name="title text" default="KALKI PROTOCOL"}，采用竖版单页设计，融合了神话与赛博朋克风格的印度美学。画面中心展示一个背对观众的人物，这是一位神秘的战士，身穿高领深色未来主义长风衣，笔直站立，凝视着广阔的霓虹大都市。人物留着深色卷发，扎成凌乱的发髻，一侧耳朵戴着发光的圆形耳环，轮廓强健，面部大部分隐藏在侧影阴影中。在头部后方，放置一个巨大的放射状金橙色光环，光环由刻有梵文风格神圣文字和神秘符号的同心圆组成，赋予角色神圣、预言般的特质。在人物轮廓内部及周围，融合未来主义版本的 {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"}：密集的摩天大楼、全息广告牌、高架结构、反射水域，以及与温暖光环形成对比的冷蓝紫色夜色氛围。包含 3 辆飞行载具：2 辆高速悬浮摩托在右侧中下部飞驰，拖着明亮的洋红色引擎尾迹；1 辆小型悬浮飞行器在右侧远方天空中。添加一个醒目的发光广告牌，上面写着 {argument name="billboard text" default="MUMBAI"}，下方附有一行较小的天城体文字。在建筑物沿线散布更多带有天城体文字的垂直霓虹灯招牌。配色方案应为电光青、深靛蓝、洋红、橙色和金色，呈现湿润的反射表面、体积雾、戏剧性的轮廓光以及精致的大片海报质感。在画面中下部放置巨大的未来主义发光标题字体，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="KALKI PROTOCOL"}。在其下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="THE FINAL ERA BEGINS"}，随后是上映日期行“COMING 3125.11”，接着是一行多语言演职员表，列出“HINDI - TELUGU - TAMIL - KANNADA - MALAYALAM - ENGLISH”，底部附有一行小标签。高对比度、史诗级规模、高级概念艺术、无缝双重曝光构图、赛博朋克孟买与印度神话的碰撞，充满动作感与神圣气息。

templates.title: Monochrome Magical Heart Wand

titleLocalized.zh: 单色魔法心形魔杖

templates.prompt: A centered studio render of a magical girl wand or scepter designed like a toy collectible, shown front-facing against a plain light gray background. The wand is monochrome matte white to light gray clay-render style with soft even lighting and gentle shadows, emphasizing sculpted form rather than color. The top has a large circular medallion with a faceted heart-shaped gem in the center, surrounded by an ornate ring featuring exactly 1 large five-pointed star at the top center, 8 small five-pointed stars around the ring, and 4 curling decorative swirl motifs. Small symmetrical angel wings extend left and right from the lower sides of the circular head. Beneath the medallion is a large bow with a small heart-shaped jewel at its center and two ribbon tails hanging down. The handle is long and cylindrical with a spiral twist pattern, with exactly 1 additional heart emblem mounted near the upper part of the grip, and it ends in a rounded bulb-like pommel with vertical grooves. The overall silhouette is cute, symmetrical, elegant, fantasy-inspired, and suitable for a clean product concept render or 3D model showcase.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的魔法少女魔杖或权杖摄影棚渲染图，设计如玩具收藏品般，以纯浅灰色背景为衬托，展示正面视角。魔杖采用单色哑光白至浅灰色的黏土渲染风格，光线柔和均匀，阴影细腻，强调雕刻形态而非色彩。顶部有一个巨大的圆形奖章，中心镶嵌一颗多面心形宝石，周围环绕着华丽的圆环，圆环顶部中心恰好有 1 颗大型五角星，周围分布着 8 颗小型五角星，以及 4 个卷曲的装饰性漩涡纹样。圆形头部下侧左右两侧延伸出对称的小型天使翅膀。奖章下方是一个巨大的蝴蝶结，中心镶嵌一颗心形小宝石，并垂下两条丝带。手柄细长呈圆柱形，带有螺旋扭转纹理，握柄上部额外安装了 1 个心形徽章，末端为带有垂直凹槽的球状柄头。整体轮廓可爱、对称、优雅且充满奇幻感，非常适合用于简洁的产品概念渲染或 3D 模型展示。

templates.title: Rainy Premier League Trophy Celebration

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中英超冠军奖杯庆祝时刻

templates.prompt: A dramatic sports photograph of a {argument name="football player" default="Manchester City player"} in a {argument name="team jersey color" default="sky blue"} kit standing center frame in a rainy stadium, lifting the English Premier League trophy high above his head with both hands. The large silver trophy has a gold crown on top, 2 pale blue ribbons hanging from the handles, and the visible engraved text "Premier League" on the front. The player wears a modern football jersey with dark sponsor text reading "ETIHAD AIRWAYS" and a small chest crest, with arms fully extended upward in a triumphant victory pose. Compose it as a tight vertical crop from mid-torso upward, with the trophy dominating the upper center and partially covering the player's head. Add heavy falling rain, wet reflective metal, moody overcast lighting, shallow depth of field, and a blurred stadium crowd in the background. On the right side of the background, include a bright blue electronic screen with the large glowing word {argument name="scoreboard text" default="GOAL"}. Photorealistic editorial sports photography, high detail, natural stadium colors, celebration moment, slightly telephoto look, crisp focus on the trophy and upper body.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具张力的体育摄影作品，画面中心为一名身穿 {argument name="team jersey color" default="天蓝色"} 球衣的 {argument name="football player" default="曼城球员"}，他站在雨中的球场中央，双手将英超联赛奖杯高高举过头顶。巨大的银色奖杯顶部带有金色皇冠，手柄处悬挂着两条浅蓝色丝带，正面清晰可见刻有“Premier League”字样。球员身穿现代足球球衣，胸前印有深色赞助商文字“ETIHAD AIRWAYS”及小型队徽，双臂完全向上伸展，呈现出胜利的姿态。构图采用从躯干中部向上的紧凑竖向剪裁，奖杯位于画面上方中心，部分遮挡住球员头部。添加大雨倾盆的效果、湿润的金属反光、阴郁的阴天光影、浅景深效果，以及背景中模糊的球场观众。在背景右侧，加入一块发光的蓝色电子屏幕，上面显示着醒目的文字 {argument name="scoreboard text" default="GOAL"}。照片级逼真的体育新闻摄影，高细节，自然的球场色彩，庆祝瞬间，略带长焦镜头感，奖杯和上半身焦点清晰。

templates.title: Epic Milestone X Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级里程碑 X 海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical poster in a dark cinematic graphic-novel style, dominated by a giant red painted X in the upper left and huge distressed Chinese typography across the top reading “关注破2万”, with the number 2 in red and the rest of the characters in rough off-white block letters. Beneath the headline, add a smaller thin white Chinese tagline line: “每一次关注，都是力量的累积。” In the lower half, show an apocalyptic monumental landscape with a colossal metallic X-shaped structure exploding upward from the center, glowing with intense white-gold light at its core, surrounded by flying debris, fractured rock, dust streaks, sparks, and dramatic radial energy beams. Place 1 tiny solitary human silhouette standing at the base of the glowing X on a jagged black rocky platform for scale. Use a palette of black, charcoal, ash gray, off-white, metallic gold, and blood red, with extreme contrast, gritty textures, scratched ink-like brush marks, weathered print distress, and a sense of violent impact and triumph. At the bottom, include another small white Chinese sentence: “真正的影响力，来自持续被看见的价值。” with a short red underline accent beneath it. The composition should feel like an epic announcement poster for reaching {argument name="follower milestone" default="2万"}, with bold propaganda-inspired typography, explosive motion, towering symmetry, and a powerful social-growth metaphor centered on the X symbol.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满戏剧性的竖版海报，采用暗黑电影感图像小说风格。左上方是一个巨大的红色手绘“X”，顶部横跨着巨大的做旧风格中文字体“关注破 2 万”，其中数字“2”为红色，其余字符为粗犷的灰白色块状字体。在标题下方，添加一行较小的白色细体中文标语：“每一次关注，都是力量的累积。”下半部分展示一个末日般的纪念碑式景观，一座巨大的金属 X 型结构从中心向上爆炸，核心散发出强烈的白金色光芒，周围环绕着飞溅的碎片、破碎的岩石、尘埃条纹、火花和极具张力的放射状能量束。在发光的 X 底部，放置一个微小的孤独人类剪影，站在锯齿状的黑色岩石平台上以体现比例感。配色方案采用黑色、炭灰色、灰白色、金属金和血红色，强调极高对比度、粗粝质感、刮擦般的墨迹笔触、风化的印刷磨损感，以及强烈的冲击力和胜利感。在底部，加入另一句白色中文短句：“真正的影响力，来自持续被看见的价值。”并在下方配以一条短红线作为点缀。整体构图应呈现出一种史诗级的公告海报感，用于庆祝达到 {argument name="follower milestone" default="2 万"} 的里程碑，融合了大胆的宣传画风格字体、爆炸性的动态感、高耸的对称性，以及围绕 X 符号构建的强大社交增长隐喻。

templates.title: Scientific Bayberry Anatomy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 杨梅科学解剖海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed scientific botanical poster on a pure black background, featuring a single giant centered cross-section of a Chinese bayberry fruit, dramatic studio lighting, ultra-macro food photography realism, glossy wet surface, rich deep crimson to burgundy tones. The fruit is shown as a half-cut anatomical specimen, filling most of the frame, with the left half showing the intact outer skin covered in countless tightly packed bead-like protrusions, and the right half revealing the translucent red flesh radiating inward in fibrous juicy strands toward a large tan-brown seed in the center cavity. At the top left, elegant Chinese typography in warm ivory reads the title {argument name="headline text" default="杨梅·解剖"}, with a smaller subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="酸与甜的野性平衡"}. Around the fruit are 6 annotated callout sections in Chinese, each with thin ivory leader lines and small pointer dots indicating precise fruit structures. Section 1 is on the upper left labeled "结构 01 果皮突起" with 4 lines of explanatory text. Section 2 is on the upper right labeled "结构 02 多汁果肉" with 4 lines of explanatory text. Section 3 is on the mid-right labeled "结构 03 种子" with 4 lines of explanatory text. Section 4 is on the lower left labeled "结构 04 果肉细胞" with 4 lines of explanatory text. Section 5 is on the lower center labeled "结构 05 果核（内果皮）" with 3 lines of explanatory text. Section 6 is on the lower right labeled "结构 06 维管束" with 3 lines of explanatory text. The text style is refined, slightly calligraphic serif Chinese print, ivory on black, resembling a museum exhibit placard or premium editorial infographic. Composition is symmetrical but organic, minimal negative space, luxurious, educational, tactile, highly detailed, high contrast, no extra objects, no border, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的科学植物学海报，采用纯黑背景，画面中央为一个巨大的杨梅果实横截面，运用戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，呈现超微距食品摄影的真实感，表面湿润有光泽，色调为浓郁的深红至酒红色。果实呈现为半切的解剖标本，占据画面大部分空间；左半部分展示了覆盖着无数紧密排列的珠状突起的完整外皮，右半部分揭示了半透明的红色果肉，呈纤维状多汁纹理向中心腔体内的褐色大果核放射。左上方有优雅的象牙白色中文字体，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="杨梅·解剖"}，下方副标题为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="酸与甜的野性平衡"}。果实周围有 6 个中文标注区域，每个区域均配有纤细的象牙白色引导线和小圆点，指向精确的果实结构。区域 1 位于左上方，标注为“结构 01 果皮突起”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 2 位于右上方，标注为“结构 02 多汁果肉”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 3 位于中右侧，标注为“结构 03 种子”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 4 位于左下方，标注为“结构 04 果肉细胞”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 5 位于下中央，标注为“结构 05 果核（内果皮）”，配有 3 行说明文字。区域 6 位于右下方，标注为“结构 06 维管束”，配有 3 行说明文字。文字风格为精致、略带书法感的衬线中文字体，黑底白字，类似于博物馆展品说明牌或高端编辑信息图。构图对称且自然，负空间极少，质感奢华、具有教育意义、触感真实、细节丰富、对比度高，无多余物体，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Style Spectrum Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Style Spectrum 时尚海报

templates.prompt: A high-end fashion editorial poster in a vertical 9:16 format, set inside a serene futuristic circular gallery with smooth beige stone walls, a large round skylight in the ceiling, soft diffused warm lighting, and a sculptural circular platform at the center. The image shows 7 versions of the same young East Asian woman with long dark wavy hair, each styled as a different personality archetype, arranged around the circular platform in an elegant symmetrical composition. The central and largest figure sits on the edge of the platform facing forward, wearing a loose ivory-white button-front blouse and matching relaxed trousers, calm and introspective, becoming the visual anchor. Around her are 6 alternate style personas: 1 woman on the left in a soft cream dress with hair in a bun, gentle and approachable; 1 woman at the back center standing in a sleeveless black tailored outfit, cool and rational; 1 woman on the upper right seated in a light beige cardigan and pale skirt or trousers, casual and relaxed; 1 woman on the lower left in a sharp black blazer and dark outfit, urban minimalist; 1 woman on the lower right in a taupe oversized suit, mature and confident; 1 woman at the bottom front crouching in a cozy cream knit and loose light pants, everyday comfort style. All seven figures have the same identity but different styling, mood, and pose. Use a muted neutral palette of ivory, cream, taupe, beige, stone gray, and black, with soft atmospheric haze, cinematic depth, luxury magazine aesthetics, minimalism, and polished skin. Add elegant Chinese typography integrated into the composition: top headline {argument name="headline text" default="你不只有一种样子"} with smaller English subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="Explore your style spectrum"}. Place 6 Chinese style labels with short descriptive taglines near the surrounding personas: 温柔氛围, 清冷知性, 松弛韩系, 都市极简, 轻熟气场, 日常休闲. At the bottom add the Chinese call-to-action {argument name="bottom question" default="你最想成为哪一个？"} and smaller line {argument name="bottom caption" default="评论区告诉我"}. Premium poster design, fashion campaign feel, graceful composition, soft focus, refined and aspirational.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 9:16 竖版的高端时尚杂志风格海报，背景设定在一个宁静且充满未来感的圆形画廊中，墙面为平滑的米色石材，天花板设有大型圆形天窗，光线柔和且温暖，中心设有一个雕塑感十足的圆形平台。画面中展示了 7 个同一位年轻东亚女性的形象，她们留着深色长卷发，分别化身为不同的个性原型，以优雅对称的构图环绕在圆形平台周围。位于中心且最显眼的人物坐在平台边缘面向前方，身穿宽松的象牙白衬衫和配套的休闲长裤，神情平静且内敛，成为视觉焦点。围绕着她的另外 6 种风格化身分别为：左侧身穿柔和奶油色连衣裙、发髻高盘的女性，温柔且平易近人；后方中央身穿无袖黑色修身套装的女性，冷静且理性；右上角身穿浅米色开衫搭配浅色裙装或长裤的女性，休闲且松弛；左下角身穿干练黑色西装和深色服饰的女性，都市极简风；右下角身穿灰褐色廓形西装的女性，成熟且自信；底部前方身穿舒适奶油色针织衫搭配宽松浅色长裤的女性，日常舒适风。七个人物拥有相同的面容，但造型、情绪和姿态各异。采用象牙白、奶油色、灰褐色、米色、石灰色和黑色的柔和中性色调，营造出柔和的大气朦胧感、电影级的景深、高端杂志美学、极简主义以及细腻的皮肤质感。在构图中融入优雅的中文字体：顶部标题 {argument name="headline text" default="你不只有一种样子"}，下方配有较小的英文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Explore your style spectrum"}。在周围的人物旁放置 6 个带有简短描述性标语的中文风格标签：温柔氛围、清冷知性、松弛韩系、都市极简、轻熟气场、日常休闲。在底部添加中文行动号召 {argument name="bottom question" default="你最想成为哪一个？"} 以及较小的辅助文案 {argument name="bottom caption" default="评论区告诉我"}。高级海报设计，时尚大片质感，构图优雅，柔焦效果，精致且令人向往。

templates.title: Luxury Skincare Editorial Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华护肤品编辑风格网格

templates.prompt: Create a luxury skincare campaign collage in a 4 by 3 editorial grid with exactly 12 tiles, using a warm ivory, cream, champagne, and soft beige palette. The overall mood is ultra-refined, minimal, sensual, and high-end, with milky diffused lighting, soft cinematic shadows, glossy hydrated skin, and a premium beauty magazine aesthetic. Tile 1: a frosted glass skincare pump bottle standing on a clear shelf, matte cream body, metallic gold pump and collar, elegant serif branding reading {argument name="brand name" default="BLOOMGLOW"}, product name reading {argument name="product name" default="RADIANCE MOISTURIZING EMULSION"}, photographed against a creamy beige wall with diagonal sunlight. Tile 2: a macro swipe of thick white lotion on a smooth cream surface, sculptural texture, soft highlights. Tile 3: a close crop of a woman's head and neck from behind, dark hair in a clean low bun, luminous skin, ear visible, minimal composition. Tile 4: sheer cream curtains lit by sunlight with the shadow silhouette of leaves or flowers cast across them. Tile 5: close-up of a woman's bare shoulder and upper back, dewy glowing skin, one hand touching the shoulder, a thin streak of lotion trailing down the back, intimate skincare editorial framing. Tile 6: a glossy translucent droplet of emulsion resting on a creamy matte surface, macro product texture study. Tile 7: a close crop of the lower face, jawline, neck, and collarbone of the same woman, fingers gently touching the neck, fresh hydrated glow, soft shadow. Tile 8: another macro smear of white cream, smoother and broader than tile 2, with reflective wet highlights. Tile 9: sunlit rippling water in pale champagne tones, abstract liquid texture with sparkling reflections. Tile 10: the same skincare bottle lying diagonally on softly wrinkled satin or silk fabric, gentle sunlight, subtle shadow, branding visible. Tile 11: close-up of hands applying a white oval dollop of lotion onto the back of one hand with the fingertips of the other hand, elegant manicured natural nails. Tile 12: glossy neckline and shoulders of the woman, collarbones highlighted, luminous moisturized skin, dark hair partially visible at the top edge. Keep the composition clean and balanced with thin white dividers between all 12 panels. Style keywords: minimalist luxury, creamy soft light, premium cosmetic advertisement, tactile textures, hydration, skin radiance, cinematic beauty editorial, understated opulence, breathable moisture glow. No clutter, no bright colors, no props beyond bottle, fabric, water, curtains, and skincare textures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 4 x 3 的奢华护肤品营销拼贴网格，包含 12 个方格，使用暖象牙白、奶油色、香槟金和柔和米色的色调。整体氛围极致精致、简约、感性且高端，呈现乳白色漫射光、柔和的电影感阴影、水润光泽的肌肤，以及高端美容杂志的审美。第 1 格：一个磨砂玻璃护肤泵瓶立在透明架子上，哑光奶油色瓶身，金属金泵头和瓶颈，优雅的衬线字体品牌名显示为 {argument name="brand name" default="BLOOMGLOW"}，产品名称显示为 {argument name="product name" default="RADIANCE MOISTURIZING EMULSION"}，以奶油米色墙面为背景，伴有斜射阳光。第 2 格：在光滑奶油色表面上厚涂白色乳液的微距特写，具有雕塑感的质地，柔和的高光。第 3 格：女性头部和颈部的背面特写，深色头发梳成利落的低发髻，肌肤透亮，露出耳朵，构图极简。第 4 格：被阳光照亮的透明奶油色窗帘，叶片或花朵的阴影投射其上。第 5 格：女性裸露肩膀和上背部的特写，肌肤水润发光，一只手触碰肩膀，一抹乳液顺着背部滑落，亲密的护肤编辑视角。第 6 格：一颗晶莹剔透的乳液水滴落在奶油色哑光表面上，微距产品质地研究。第 7 格：同一位女性下颌线、颈部和锁骨的局部特写，手指轻轻触碰颈部，呈现清新水润的光泽，柔和的阴影。第 8 格：另一处白色乳液的微距涂抹，比第 2 格更平滑宽阔，带有反光的湿润高光。第 9 格：淡香槟色调的阳光波光水面，抽象的液体质感，带有闪烁的倒影。第 10 格：同一款护肤瓶斜放在褶皱的缎面或丝绸织物上，柔和的阳光，微妙的阴影，品牌标识清晰可见。第 11 格：手部特写，用另一只手的手指将椭圆形的白色乳液涂抹在手背上，修剪整齐的自然美甲。第 12 格：女性富有光泽的颈部和肩部，锁骨高光突出，肌肤水润透亮，顶部边缘隐约可见深色头发。保持构图简洁平衡，在 12 个面板之间使用细白色分割线。风格关键词：极简奢华、奶油柔光、高端化妆品广告、触感纹理、补水、肌肤光泽、电影感美妆编辑、低调奢华、透气水润光感。无杂乱元素，无明亮色彩，除瓶子、织物、水、窗帘和护肤质地外，不添加其他道具。

templates.title: Poetic Woman in Garden Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 花园中充满诗意的女性肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic outdoor portrait of a thoughtful, naturally beautiful young woman standing on a garden path in soft golden-hour light. She is framed from about mid-thigh upward, centered in the image, facing the camera with a relaxed upright posture. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long, voluminous, loosely curly hair with a slightly tousled texture, falling around her shoulders. Dress her in an oversized cream-white knit sweater with long sleeves and dark high-waisted loose trousers or a flowing skirt-like bottom in deep navy or black. A pair of thin round eyeglasses hangs from the neckline of the sweater. In one hand she holds a sharpened yellow pencil, and in the other she carries an open sketchbook or notebook with slightly worn pages, suggesting she is writing, sketching, or observing nature. The mood should feel literary, artistic, intelligent, and understated rather than glamorous. Place her in a lush garden with 1 visible stone pathway, abundant soft greenery, and blurred flowers in the foreground and background. Use shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, warm sunlight filtering through trees behind her, and gentle natural highlights on her hair and sweater. The image should look like a candid editorial photograph, highly realistic, soft and tasteful, with muted natural colors, subtle texture, and an atmosphere of calm, cultured beauty. Vertical composition, 4:5 portrait orientation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的户外肖像，画面中是一位沉思且自然美丽的年轻女性，她站在花园小径上，沐浴在柔和的黄金时刻光线下。镜头从大腿中部向上取景，她位于画面中心，面向镜头，姿态放松且挺拔。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长发，发量丰盈，呈现出蓬松的微卷质感，自然垂落在肩头。为她穿上一件米白色的宽松针织毛衣，搭配长袖，下身穿着深海军蓝或黑色的高腰宽松长裤或飘逸的裙装。毛衣领口挂着一副细圆框眼镜。她的一只手拿着一支削好的黄色铅笔，另一只手拿着一本页面略显陈旧的素描本或笔记本，暗示她正在写作、素描或观察自然。整体氛围应偏向文学、艺术、知性且低调，而非华丽。将她置于一个郁郁葱葱的花园中，画面可见 1 条石板小径，周围有丰富的柔和绿植，前景和背景中有模糊的花朵。使用浅景深效果，营造出奶油般的虚化背景，温暖的阳光透过她身后的树木洒下，在她的头发和毛衣上形成柔和的自然高光。图像应呈现出抓拍编辑照片的质感，高度写实，风格柔和且有品位，色彩自然柔和，纹理细腻，散发出一种宁静、有修养的美感。竖构图，4:5 肖像比例。

templates.title: Glamorous Woman in Black Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 身着黑色礼服的魅力女性肖像

templates.prompt: A photorealistic half-body portrait of an elegant glamorous woman indoors, framed vertically from the upper chest to just above the head, standing slightly angled toward the camera with a poised, confident presence. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long loose wavy hair with a soft tousled texture, warm lightly tanned skin, and a slender neck and shoulders. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve dress or top with a very deep plunging V neckline in finely pleated fabric, creating a sleek sensual evening look, plus 1 delicate gold chain necklace with 1 small round pendant resting at the base of her neck. Use flattering warm ambient lighting, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, and a luxurious modern interior background with creamy beige walls, a blurred warm lamp glow on the left, and a bright window or doorway edge on the right. The mood is refined, feminine, and high-end, like a fashion editorial portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a beautiful woman"}, shot with realistic skin texture, subtle natural makeup, cinematic bokeh, and premium lifestyle photography styling.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张室内优雅魅力女性的写实半身肖像，采用竖构图，取景范围从胸部上方至头部上方，她微微侧身面对镜头，姿态从容自信。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长款蓬松波浪卷发，发丝质感柔和凌乱，肤色呈现温暖的浅古铜色，颈部与肩部线条纤细。她身着一件修身的黑色长袖连衣裙或上衣，采用精细褶皱面料，深 V 领口设计营造出时尚且性感的晚装风格，颈部佩戴一条精致的金色细链，坠有一枚小巧的圆形吊坠。采用柔和温暖的环境光，阴影处理细腻，景深较浅；背景为奢华的现代室内空间，墙面呈奶油米色，左侧有模糊的暖色灯光，右侧有明亮的窗户或门框边缘。整体氛围精致、柔美且高端，宛如 {argument name="subject" default="一位美女"} 的时尚杂志大片，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、自然的淡妆效果、电影级的焦外成像以及高端生活方式摄影风格。

templates.title: Vintage Hong Kong Actress Tribute Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古香港女星致敬海报

templates.prompt: A vintage Hong Kong cinema tribute poster in elegant 1980s–1990s magazine style, featuring a glamorous close-up half-body portrait of {argument name="celebrity name" default="Rosamund Kwan"} seated indoors against a soft neutral beige background. She has voluminous dark brown wavy shoulder-length hair with a side part, luminous skin, a poised gentle expression, one hand raised lightly near her cheek, and wears a creamy white blazer with large round pearl earrings. Use warm diffused studio lighting, soft focus, refined film-like texture, subtle grain, and luxurious nostalgic color grading in beige, ivory, sepia, and deep plum. Design the composition like a memorial or star-profile poster with typography integrated around the portrait: on the far left, very large vertical Chinese calligraphy-style name text in deep plum reading {argument name="main Chinese name" default="關之琳"}; to its right, a slim vertical line of smaller Chinese text reading {argument name="vertical tagline" default="絕代佳人・風華永恆"}. Below the large title on the left, place the English name in elegant italic serif script reading {argument name="English name" default="Rosamund Kwan"}. Under that, add a two-line Chinese quote in smaller serif text. In the lower left corner, include exactly 3 stacked rectangular film still thumbnails with thin borders, each showing the same actress in different roles; each thumbnail has a narrow vertical Chinese caption strip on its left edge. On the lower right beside the portrait, place a text block with the large Chinese surname and given name split across two lines, the English name beneath, then a birth line and 2 more lines of Chinese descriptive text. Add a handwritten autograph-style signature in dark plum near the bottom right. Along the bottom center, add 2 lines of Chinese slogan text in classic serif style, separated from the main layout with ample negative space. Overall look: classy, sentimental, high-end editorial poster, authentic retro Hong Kong actress homage, balanced typography, premium print design, portrait-dominant layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 1980 年代至 1990 年代优雅杂志风格的复古香港电影致敬海报，画面主体为 {argument name="celebrity name" default="关之琳"} 的迷人半身特写肖像，她坐在室内，背景为柔和的中性米色。她留着蓬松的深棕色中长波浪卷发，侧分发型，皮肤光泽，神情从容温婉，一只手轻抬靠近脸颊，身穿奶油白色西装外套，佩戴大颗圆形珍珠耳环。采用温暖的漫射影棚光，柔焦效果，精致的胶片质感，细腻的颗粒感，以及米色、象牙白、深褐色和深李子色的奢华怀旧色调。构图设计参考纪念或明星档案海报，排版与肖像融为一体：最左侧为非常大的深李子色垂直中式书法风格姓名文字，内容为 {argument name="main Chinese name" default="关之琳"}；其右侧为一行较小的纤细垂直中文文字，内容为 {argument name="vertical tagline" default="绝代佳人・风华永恒"}。在左侧大标题下方，放置优雅的斜体衬线英文名 {argument name="English name" default="Rosamund Kwan"}。在其下方，添加两行较小的衬线字体中文引言。在左下角，包含 3 张堆叠的矩形电影剧照缩略图，带有细边框，每张缩略图展示该女星的不同角色；每张缩略图左侧边缘均有一条狭窄的垂直中文标题条。在肖像右下侧，放置一个文本块，包含分两行排列的大号中文姓氏和名字，下方为英文名，接着是出生日期行以及另外 2 行中文描述文字。在右下角附近添加一个深李子色的手写签名风格签名。在底部中心，添加 2 行经典衬线风格的中文标语，与主体布局之间留有充足的负空间。整体外观：高级、感性、高端编辑海报，地道的复古香港女星致敬风格，排版平衡，优质印刷设计，以肖像为主导的布局。

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the layout, scene, and ad-style template, and REFERENCE_1 as the product source, recreate the same 2-panel fashion marketing collage but replace the original dress with the blouse from REFERENCE_1. Keep the beach-and-poolside lifestyle composition from REFERENCE_0: 1 large upper-left close crop, 1 full-body standing shot in the upper-right beach scene, 1 seated poolside shot in the lower-left, and 3 circular fabric/detail callouts stacked vertically on the right. Preserve the overall premium boho summer campaign look, soft natural sunlight, sandy beach, parasol, deck chair, basket accessories, and resort mood. Restyle the product into realistic lifestyle wear: the same red embroidered V-neck blouse from REFERENCE_1 paired with short denim bottoms in the full-body and seated views, while keeping the woman and styling visually consistent across all panels. Replace all headline and feature copy from the reference with new English fashion-ad text, not copied wording: use a large title {argument name="headline text" default="Holiday"} with a smaller script brand word above it, a short 3-line descriptive subtitle, and 3 feature blurbs matching the circular callouts. The 3 feature headings should emphasize neckline, sleeve length, and embroidery details. Keep the polished ecommerce poster design, rounded white card edges, elegant typography hierarchy, and a handwritten pink tagline at the lower right {argument name="tagline" default="Boho Chic Style"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为布局、场景和广告风格模板，以 REFERENCE_1 作为产品来源，重新创作出同样的双联幅时尚营销拼贴画，但将原图中的连衣裙替换为 REFERENCE_1 中的衬衫。保留 REFERENCE_0 中海滩与池畔的生活方式构图：左上角 1 张大尺寸特写，右上角海滩场景中的 1 张全身站立照，左下角 1 张池畔坐姿照，以及右侧垂直排列的 3 个圆形面料/细节标注。保持整体高端波西米亚夏季广告的质感、柔和的自然光、沙滩、遮阳伞、躺椅、篮子配饰以及度假氛围。将产品重新设计为真实的生活方式穿搭：在全身照和坐姿照中，将 REFERENCE_1 中那件红色刺绣 V 领衬衫与牛仔短裤搭配，同时确保模特和造型在所有画面中保持视觉一致。将参考图中的所有标题和功能文案替换为全新的英文时尚广告文本，切勿直接复制原词：使用一个大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Holiday"}，上方配以较小的手写体品牌词，一个简短的 3 行描述性副标题，以及与 3 个圆形标注相对应的 3 段功能简介。3 个功能标题应重点突出领口、袖长和刺绣细节。保持精致的电商海报设计、圆角白色卡片边缘、优雅的排版层级，并在右下角添加一行粉色手写标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Boho Chic Style"}。

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious concept-entity infographic poster about the {argument name="theme" default="religion"}, arranged as a clean 2x2 grid on a deep navy-to-black cinematic background. Each quadrant contains one floating stone island rendered as a highly detailed miniature monument scene, lit with warm golden rim light and soft volumetric shadows, in an elegant dark fantasy editorial style with realistic materials, symmetrical composition, and refined gold typography. Top left: Islam, featuring a grand ornate mosque with a large central dome, smaller domes, two minarets, arched entry, palm trees, stone steps, and glowing windows, on a circular floating island; on the left side, exactly 3 vertical icon labels reading “TAWHID”, “SALAH”, and “QURAN”; on the right side, one decorative plaque with Arabic calligraphy; at the bottom, a crescent symbol above the large gold title “ISLAM”. Top right: Christianity, featuring a Gothic stone church with tall central steeple topped by a cross, pointed arch doorway, stained-glass style windows, small trees, and a fenced stone path on a floating island; on the left side, exactly 3 vertical icon labels reading “FAITH”, “LOVE”, and “BIBLE”; on the right side, one framed quote plaque reading “FOR GOD SO LOVED THE WORLD THAT HE GAVE HIS ONLY BEGOTTEN SON” and “JOHN 3:16”; at the bottom, a cross symbol integrated into the large gold title “CHRISTIANITY”. Bottom left: Hinduism, featuring an elaborate South Indian temple tower rising above a stepped stone complex with smaller shrines, flags, rocky landscaping, and warm interior glow on a floating island; on the left side, exactly 3 vertical icon labels reading “DHARMA”, “KARMA”, and “MOKSHA”; on the right side, one ornamental mandala-like emblem with the Om symbol; at the bottom, an Om symbol above the large gold title “HINDUISM”. Bottom right: Buddhism, featuring a monumental seated Buddha statue in meditation on a layered stone pedestal, surrounded by rocks, bonsai-like trees, and temple steps on a floating island; on the left side, exactly 3 vertical icon labels reading “MINDFULNESS”, “DHARMA”, and “COMPASSION”; on the right side, one framed quote plaque reading “THE MIND IS EVERYTHING. WHAT YOU THINK YOU BECOME. - BUDDHA -”; at the bottom, a Dharma wheel above the large gold title “BUDDHISM”. Keep all 4 sections visually consistent, with premium gold UI frames, engraved icon badges, polished serif lettering, dramatic studio lighting, high contrast, subtle glow, and immaculate centered presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张关于 {argument name="theme" default="religion"} 的奢华概念实体信息图海报，以整洁的 2x2 网格排列在深海军蓝至黑色的电影级背景上。每个象限包含一座漂浮的石岛，渲染为高度精细的微型纪念碑场景，配以温暖的金色轮廓光和柔和的体积阴影，呈现出优雅的暗黑奇幻编辑风格，具有逼真的材质、对称的构图和精致的金色排版。左上角：伊斯兰教，以一座宏伟华丽的清真寺为特色，拥有一个大型中央圆顶、较小的圆顶、两座宣礼塔、拱形入口、棕榈树、石阶和发光的窗户，位于一个圆形的漂浮岛屿上；左侧有 3 个垂直图标标签，分别写着“TAWHID”、“SALAH”和“QURAN”；右侧有一块装饰性牌匾，上面有阿拉伯书法；底部是一个新月符号，位于金色大标题“ISLAM”上方。右上角：基督教，以一座哥特式石教堂为特色，拥有高耸的中央尖塔和十字架、尖拱门、彩色玻璃风格的窗户、小树和漂浮岛上的围栏石径；左侧有 3 个垂直图标标签，分别写着“FAITH”、“LOVE”和“BIBLE”；右侧有一块带框的引文牌匾，写着“FOR GOD SO LOVED THE WORLD THAT HE GAVE HIS ONLY BEGOTTEN SON”和“JOHN 3:16”；底部是一个十字架符号，融入了金色大标题“CHRISTIANITY”中。左下角：印度教，以一座精致的南印度寺庙塔楼为特色，耸立在带有较小神龛、旗帜、岩石景观和温暖室内光线的阶梯式石制建筑群之上，位于漂浮岛屿上；左侧有 3 个垂直图标标签，分别写着“DHARMA”、“KARMA”和“MOKSHA”；右侧有一个带有“Om”符号的装饰性曼陀罗徽章；底部是一个“Om”符号，位于金色大标题“HINDUISM”上方。右下角：佛教，以一座巨大的坐姿佛像为特色，佛像在分层的石基座上冥想，周围环绕着岩石、盆景般的树木和寺庙台阶，位于漂浮岛屿上；左侧有 3 个垂直图标标签，分别写着“MINDFULNESS”、“DHARMA”和“COMPASSION”；右侧有一块带框的引文牌匾，写着“THE MIND IS EVERYTHING. WHAT YOU THINK YOU BECOME. - BUDDHA -”；底部是一个法轮符号，位于金色大标题“BUDDHISM”上方。保持所有 4 个部分在视觉上的一致性，采用优质的金色 UI 边框、雕刻图标徽章、抛光的衬线字体、戏剧性的摄影棚灯光、高对比度、微妙的光晕和完美的居中呈现。

titleLocalized.zh: 老照片修复为单反级人像

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, restore the damaged old family photo into a natural-looking modern high-resolution portrait while keeping the same 4 people, pose, framing, clothing, and outdoor rural setting unchanged. Remove all visible age damage including tears, cracks, creases, stains, worn paper edges, scratches, and fading. Convert the black-and-white sepia image into realistic soft color, preserving accurate skin tones and neutral earth-toned clothing. Enhance fine detail, sharpen fabric and hair texture, improve contrast and dynamic range, and upscale it to professional DSLR-quality realism with clean focus and a subtle shallow depth of field, as if photographed on a {argument name="camera model" default="Canon EOS R6 II"}. Keep the result highly realistic, natural, and faithful to the original faces and proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将受损的家庭老照片修复为自然、现代的高分辨率人像，同时保持原有的 4 人构图、姿势、取景、服装及户外乡村背景不变。去除所有可见的岁月痕迹，包括撕裂、裂纹、折痕、污渍、磨损的纸张边缘、划痕及褪色。将黑白/棕褐色图像转换为逼真的柔和色彩，保留准确的肤色和中性大地色系的服装。增强细节，锐化织物与头发纹理，改善对比度与动态范围，并将其提升至专业级的 DSLR 画质，实现清晰对焦与微妙的浅景深效果，如同使用 {argument name="camera model" default="Canon EOS R6 II"} 拍摄一般。确保最终结果高度写实、自然，并忠实于原始人物的面部特征与比例。
