templates.title: Shenzhen Heritage Futuristic Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 深圳文化遗产未来感海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical poster-style cityscape of {argument name="city name" default="Shenzhen"} at golden hour, blending traditional Chinese cultural heritage with a futuristic coastal megacity. Compose the scene as a tall, richly layered panoramic collage viewed from an elevated hillside lookout. On the right and center, show a dense modern skyline beside a calm bay, dominated by a sleek bullet-shaped supertall skyscraper, surrounded by glass towers, a long bridge crossing the water, distant mountains, and soft glowing clouds lit by sunrise or sunset. In the midground, include a large contemporary civic building with a flowing white roof and a red accent at its center. In the lower right, show an active container port with blue gantry cranes, ships, and curving roads traced by warm long-exposure light trails. In the lower foreground, place a white high-speed train traveling on an elevated viaduct that curves into the city. On the left, merge in a lush forested mountain slope with a traditional multi-story red pagoda, an old Chinese temple courtyard with gray tiled roofs and red lanterns, and a tall natural stone engraved with red Chinese characters. At the bottom right edge, include exactly 6 small people at the viewpoint, some standing and some sitting, looking out over the city. Use atmospheric mist drifting between the historical hillside and the modern urban core to unify the composition. Add bold black Chinese calligraphy at the upper left reading {argument name="main calligraphy" default="深圳"}, with a small red seal stamp beneath it, and place a vertical column of Chinese slogan text nearby reading {argument name="slogan text" default="敢为人先 开放包容 创新无限 与未来 共生长"}. On the engraved stone, add the red text {argument name="stone inscription" default="大鹏所城"}. Decorate the upper left and lower left borders with expressive gold ink splash and brush textures on a pale parchment-like background that fades into the photo-real city scene. Style it as ultra-detailed cinematic travel-poster concept art, photorealistic architecture, warm amber and teal color grading, crisp lighting, volumetric haze, intricate environmental detail, polished but slightly fantastical montage composition, high contrast, premium tourism campaign aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版海报风格城市景观图，展示了 {argument name="city name" default="深圳"} 在黄金时刻的景象，将中国传统文化遗产与未来感滨海大都市完美融合。画面采用从高处山坡俯瞰的视角，构图为高耸且层次丰富的全景拼贴。右侧及中心区域展示了紧邻宁静海湾的密集现代天际线，一座流线型子弹头状的超高层摩天大楼尤为醒目，周围环绕着玻璃塔楼、横跨水面的长桥、远山以及被日出或日落照亮的柔和云层。中景处包含一座拥有流动白色屋顶且中心带有红色点缀的现代大型市政建筑。右下方展示了一个繁忙的集装箱港口，配有蓝色龙门吊、货轮以及由暖色长曝光光轨勾勒出的蜿蜒道路。前景下方，一列白色高铁行驶在高架桥上，蜿蜒驶入城市。左侧融入了郁郁葱葱的森林山坡，点缀着传统的红墙多层宝塔、带有灰色瓦片屋顶和红灯笼的中国古建筑庭院，以及一块刻有红色汉字的天然高耸石碑。右下角边缘处，放置 6 个站在观景台的小人，有的站立，有的坐着，正眺望整座城市。利用在历史山坡与现代城市核心之间飘动的大气薄雾来统一构图。左上方添加醒目的黑色中国书法，内容为 {argument name="main calligraphy" default="深圳"}，下方配有一枚小红印章，并在附近放置一列竖排中文标语 {argument name="slogan text" default="敢为人先 开放包容 创新无限 与未来 共生长"}。在石碑上添加红色文字 {argument name="stone inscription" default="大鹏所城"}。左上角和左下角边缘装饰有富有表现力的金色水墨飞溅和笔触纹理，背景为淡雅的羊皮纸质感，并逐渐过渡到写实的城市景观中。整体风格为超精细的电影级旅游海报概念艺术，建筑写实，采用暖琥珀色与青色的色调分级，光线清晰，具有体积雾效果，环境细节错综复杂，构图精良但带有轻微的奇幻蒙太奇色彩，对比度高，呈现出高端旅游宣传的审美。

templates.title: Japanese Rainwear Catalog Layout

titleLocalized.zh: 日式雨具产品目录排版

templates.prompt:
Create a clean, high-end Japanese fashion catalog page on a soft warm light-gray background, featuring a coordinated rainwear set laid flat as a product editorial. The central focus is 1 women's hooded raincoat in a muted dusty blue tone, shown front-facing and neatly arranged with sleeves slightly bent inward. The coat is mid-thigh length with a full front zipper, snap-button storm placket details near the collar, a large structured hood, adjustable drawcords at both the hood and waist, two vertical zip pockets, subtle seam construction, and a slightly longer curved back hem with a darker inner lining visible at the bottom opening. Above and to the right, place 1 matching wide-brim rain hat in the same dusty blue, angled slightly, with a darker contrasting brim underside and a small black tag on the crown. Use soft diffused studio lighting with gentle realistic shadows to give a premium product-photography look.

Add editorial typography and callouts around the products in a minimalist Japanese layout. In the upper left, place a small Japanese tagline reading "雨の日も、わたしらしく。" above a large serif English headline reading "OUTDOOR SET UP". Beneath it, add a short vertical block of Japanese body copy describing the stylish functional raincoat-and-hat set. In the lower left, add a serif subheading "DETAILS" with 2 circular inset detail photos stacked vertically: the top circle shows a close-up of the hood and front fastening area with drawcord hardware; the bottom circle shows water droplets beading on the blue waterproof fabric. To the right of each circle, place short Japanese explanatory text. On the right side of the page, add 2 product callout labels in serif English with thin leader lines: "HAT" near the upper-right hat with a short Japanese description below, and "COAT" near the lower-right side of the coat with a short Japanese description below. Keep the layout airy and balanced, with elegant negative space, refined magazine styling, realistic garment textures, and a modern outdoor-luxury aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
在柔和的暖浅灰色背景上，创作一张简洁、高端的日式时尚目录页面，以平铺方式展示一套协调的雨具套装，呈现出产品编辑风格。画面中心为 1 件女性连帽雨衣，呈暗灰蓝色，正面朝上，袖子微微向内弯曲，摆放整齐。雨衣为中长款，配有全前拉链、领口附近的按扣防风门襟细节、结构感十足的大兜帽、兜帽和腰部的可调节抽绳、两个垂直拉链口袋、精致的接缝结构，以及略长的弧形后下摆，底部开口处可见深色内衬。在右上方，放置 1 顶同色系的暗灰蓝色宽檐雨帽，略微倾斜，帽檐内侧颜色较深，帽冠处有一个小黑标。使用柔和的漫射摄影棚灯光，配合细腻逼真的阴影，营造出高级的产品摄影质感。

在产品周围添加编辑风格的排版和标注，采用极简的日式布局。左上角放置一行小字日文标语“雨の日も、わたしらしく。”，其上方为醒目的衬线体英文标题“OUTDOOR SET UP”。下方添加一小段垂直排列的日文正文，描述这款时尚且实用的雨衣雨帽套装。左下角添加衬线体副标题“DETAILS”，并垂直堆叠 2 张圆形内嵌细节图：上方圆圈展示兜帽和前襟抽绳五金件的特写；下方圆圈展示水珠在蓝色防水面料上凝结的效果。每个圆圈右侧配有简短的日文说明文字。页面右侧添加 2 个衬线体英文产品标注，并配有细引线：“HAT”标注在右上方的雨帽旁，下方附带简短日文描述；“COAT”标注在右下方的雨衣旁，下方附带简短日文描述。保持布局通透平衡，留白优雅，展现精致的杂志排版风格、逼真的服装质感以及现代户外奢华美学。

templates.title: Rainy Blue Editorial Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中蓝色时尚人像

templates.prompt: A dreamy fashion editorial portrait of a young woman standing outdoors on a rainy, overcast day beside a shallow reflecting pool and a pebled stone walkway, shown from about mid-thigh up in a vertical composition. She wears a monochrome pale powder-blue rain outfit consisting of a wide-brim waterproof sun hat and a high-collared technical raincoat with a hood, shiny silver front zippers, multiple drawstrings, toggles, and cord details around the waist and chest. The coat is zipped high so the collar covers part of the lower face, giving a cocooned, utilitarian look. Her short dark bob hair peeks out from under the hat. Pose her turned slightly to the side, body angled right, head facing the camera, with a calm, quiet, introspective mood. Use soft diffused light, muted cool tones, misty atmosphere, and very shallow depth of field so the modern architectural structures in the background are blurred and minimal. The setting should feel futuristic and serene, with wet surfaces, faint raindrops, pale gray sky, gentle reflections in the water, and a clean minimalist color palette dominated by {argument name="outfit color" default="pale powder blue"}. Make the image look like high-end contemporary streetwear photography, slightly cinematic, airy, soft focus, delicate contrast, and subtle film-like texture. Add a small handwritten-style watermark reading {argument name="watermark text" default="aichof"} near the right-center edge.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的时尚编辑人像，画面中一位年轻女性站在阴雨天的户外，身旁是一个浅浅的倒影池和鹅卵石步道，采用竖构图，取景范围约为大腿中部以上。她身穿一套单色淡粉蓝色雨衣，包括一顶宽檐防水遮阳帽和一件带有兜帽的高领机能雨衣，配有闪亮的银色前拉链、多条抽绳、调节扣以及胸部和腰部的绳索细节。外套拉链拉高，领口遮住部分下颚，营造出一种包裹感和实用主义风格。她留着深色短波波头，从帽子下露出。姿势略微侧身，身体朝向右侧，头部面向镜头，展现出平静、内敛的情绪。使用柔和的漫射光，冷色调，营造雾蒙蒙的氛围，并使用极浅的景深，使背景中的现代建筑结构呈现出模糊的极简感。场景应具有未来感和宁静感，伴有湿润的表面、细微的雨滴、灰白色的天空、水中柔和的倒影，以及以 {argument name="outfit color" default="pale powder blue"} 为主的干净极简色调。使图像看起来像高端当代街头摄影，略带电影感、轻盈、柔焦、细腻的对比度以及微妙的胶片质感。在右侧边缘附近添加一个手写风格的小水印，内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="aichof"}。

templates.title: Futuristic Shenzhen City Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感深圳城市海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical poster-style digital painting of {argument name="city name" default="Shenzhen"}, blending futuristic urban development with traditional culture at golden hour. At the top center, large expressive Chinese calligraphy reads {argument name="main title" default="深圳"} in textured gold brush strokes, with a small red seal stamp beside it. Directly below, a bold Chinese slogan reads {argument name="subtitle text" default="敢闯敢试，开放包容"} in the same warm gold-white tone. The skyline is dominated by a tall, sleek central skyscraper resembling the Ping An Finance Centre, surrounded by dense modern high-rises under a vast painterly sky of deep stormy blue clouds opening into warm sunset light near the horizon. In the midground and right side, a modern port with exactly 4 red container cranes and stacked shipping containers emphasizes trade and industry. An elevated high-speed train curves from the bottom center toward the skyline, and the rail corridor glows with vivid neon-blue and white light trails that snake through the city in an elegant S-curve, suggesting speed, innovation, and connectivity. In the sky, exactly 11 quadcopter drones fly in loose formation, symbolizing technology and logistics. In the left foreground, include a historic Lingnan-style arcade building with ornate rooflines and warm interior lighting, contrasting old and new architecture. In the lower foreground, add dense greenery and blooming flowers, with especially vivid pink-red blossoms on the bottom right. Use a cinematic, aspirational, polished concept-art style with rich atmospheric perspective, ultra-detailed architecture, luminous highlights, subtle haze, and a blue-gold color palette. The composition should feel grand, optimistic, and visionary, like a tourism or city-branding propaganda poster celebrating innovation, openness, transportation, commerce, and heritage. Include a small white Chinese watermark at the bottom right reading {argument name="watermark text" default="豆包AI生成"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版海报风格数字绘画，展示了 {argument name="city name" default="深圳"}，将未来城市发展与传统文化在黄金时刻完美融合。顶部中央，醒目的中式书法大字写着 {argument name="main title" default="深圳"}，采用质感十足的金色笔触，旁边配有一枚小巧的红色印章。正下方，醒目的中文标语 {argument name="subtitle text" default="敢闯敢试，开放包容"} 以同样的暖金白色调呈现。天际线以一座高耸、流畅的中央摩天大楼（类似平安金融中心）为主体，周围环绕着密集的现代高层建筑，背景是深邃的暴风雨蓝云，在地平线附近向温暖的夕阳余晖敞开。中景和右侧，一个拥有 4 台红色集装箱起重机和堆叠集装箱的现代港口，彰显了贸易与工业实力。一列高铁从底部中央蜿蜒驶向天际线，轨道走廊闪烁着生动的霓虹蓝白光迹，以优美的 S 型曲线穿过城市，象征着速度、创新与互联。天空中，11 架四轴无人机组成松散编队飞行，象征着科技与物流。左侧前景融入了一座历史悠久的岭南风格骑楼，精致的屋檐与温暖的室内灯光，与现代建筑形成鲜明对比。底部前景增加了茂密的绿植和盛开的鲜花，右下角的粉红色花朵尤为鲜艳。采用电影感、励志且精致的概念艺术风格，具备丰富的空气透视感、超精细的建筑细节、明亮的强光、微妙的薄雾以及蓝金配色。构图宏大、乐观且富有远见，如同庆祝创新、开放、交通、商业与文化遗产的旅游或城市品牌宣传海报。右下角包含一个白色小字中文水印，内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="豆包AI生成"}。

templates.title: Retro Japanese Purikura Scrapbook Page

titleLocalized.zh: 复古日式大头贴风格手账页面

templates.prompt: A nostalgic Japanese sticker-photo style scrapbook collage on warm off-white textured paper, designed like a handwritten Heisei-era gyaru purikura page. In the upper left, large hand-drawn Japanese text in a reddish brown crayon style reads "昭和の日。" Beneath it on the left side are 5 stacked handwritten note lines with playful doodles: 1) "先負~~~" in dark gray with a pale blue wavy flourish, 2) "月齢11.6" with a yellow moon doodle, 3) "晴れ20°C" with a small orange sun, a red thermometer, and a white cloud, 4) "昭和の日" with a tiny red flag and an open book icon, 5) "畳の日" with a green tatami mat icon, followed below by "ナポリタンの日" with a fork icon. At the bottom, large handwritten reddish brown text reads "平成ギャルプリクラの落書" with an underline stroke. On the right half, place a square candid photo of a young Japanese woman sitting at a wooden café counter by a sunlit window, her face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She has dark brown hair in a loose messy updo with wispy strands, and wears an oversized beige knit sweater. She holds a cream soda float or pale lemon soda in a stemmed glass with ice cream on top and a red cherry, sipping through a straw while looking toward the window. The café interior is cozy and retro, with warm brown wood, soft natural afternoon light, framed wall art in the background, and a calm Showa-era kissaten atmosphere. Surround the photo with cute hand-drawn doodles in pastel chalk colors: orange sun rays from the top left corner of the photo, 3 yellow stars, 2 pink hearts, blue swirly wind lines at upper right, small green sprouts at the bottom, a simple yellow dog drawing at lower right, and leafy green accents around the page. Overall composition should feel airy, handmade, feminine, nostalgic, and casual, with imperfect marker and crayon strokes, muted earthy colors, and authentic retro Japanese purikura scrapbook energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满怀旧感的日式贴纸照片风格手账拼贴，背景为暖色调的米白色纹理纸，设计灵感源自平成时代的辣妹（gyaru）大头贴涂鸦页面。左上角有红棕色蜡笔风格的手写日文大字“昭和の日。”。下方左侧排列着 5 行带有俏皮涂鸦的手写笔记：1) 深灰色字体的“先负~~~”，配有淡蓝色波浪装饰；2) “月齢11.6”，配有黄色月亮涂鸦；3) “晴れ20°C”，配有小橙色太阳、红色温度计和白色云朵；4) “昭和の日”，配有微型红旗和打开的书本图标；5) “畳の日”，配有绿色榻榻米图标，下方紧接着“ナポリタンの日”及叉子图标。底部有红棕色手写大字“平成ギャルプリクラの落書”，并带有下划线。右半部分放置一张方形抓拍照片，画面中一位年轻日本女性坐在阳光明媚的窗边木质咖啡馆吧台前，面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理。她留着深棕色凌乱盘发，几缕发丝垂落，身穿超大款米色针织毛衣。她正手持一杯加了冰淇淋和红樱桃的奶油苏打或柠檬苏打，透过吸管啜饮，目光望向窗外。咖啡馆内部温馨复古，充满暖棕色木质元素、柔和的午后自然光，背景挂有装饰画，营造出宁静的昭和时代纯喫茶氛围。照片周围环绕着粉彩蜡笔风格的可爱手绘涂鸦：照片左上角的橙色太阳光芒、3 颗黄色星星、2 颗粉色爱心、右上角的蓝色旋风线条、底部的小绿芽、右下角简单的黄色小狗简笔画，以及页面周围的绿叶装饰。整体构图应呈现出轻盈、手工感、女性化、怀旧且随性的氛围，笔触带有马克笔和蜡笔的不完美感，色调柔和且富有大地气息，完美还原地道的复古日式大头贴手账质感。

templates.title: Showa Day Scrapbook Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 昭和之日手账风肖像

templates.prompt: A soft, airy Japanese lifestyle poster with a warm nostalgic mood on a light beige textured paper background. On the right side, show a young woman sitting in a relaxed side pose with one knee raised, wearing an oversized white long-sleeve shirt and blue jeans. Her dark brown hair is tied in a messy bun with loose wisps around the face, and one hand lightly touches her forehead. The face should be de-emphasized or obscured so the overall feeling and styling matter more than identity. Use gentle natural daylight, high-key exposure, and a delicate editorial-photography look mixed with hand-drawn doodles. On the left half, place handwritten Japanese text in a crayon or colored-pencil style. At the top, large orange text reads {argument name="date text" default="4月29日"} and below it {argument name="headline text" default="昭和の日"}. Under that, add a short handwritten message in gray Japanese: "なつかしい風が 心をふわっと ほどいてくれる日。" Below, add 3 small info lines with icons: 1 smiling face icon with "先負", 1 crescent moon icon with "月齢 11.6", and 1 sun icon with "晴れ 20℃". Then add a dashed divider and a handwritten list headed "今日は何の日？" with exactly 4 bullet items: "昭和の日", "畳の日", "ナポリタンの日", and "国際盲導犬の日", each accompanied by tiny doodles such as a flag, tatami mat, pasta plate, and dog. At the bottom left, draw 1 pink cloud-shaped speech bubble containing the handwritten quote {argument name="quote" default="きみのえがおが いちばんだいすきだよ by ○○より"}. Decorate the composition with exactly 2 white cloud doodles near the upper right, 1 yellow sun doodle in the top-right corner, several small green leaf doodles drifting in the air, a few faint wind-swoosh lines near the woman’s head, and exactly 4 flower doodles near the bottom edge around her legs in pink, yellow, and orange. Keep the palette muted and pastel, with orange, pink, olive, gray, cream, and denim blue. The overall result should feel like a sentimental handwritten scrapbook calendar page for a Japanese national holiday, combining minimalist portrait photography with cute childlike illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、轻盈的日式生活方式海报，背景为浅米色纹理纸，营造出温暖的怀旧氛围。右侧展示一位年轻女性，她以放松的侧姿坐着，单膝抬起，身穿超大款白色长袖衬衫和蓝色牛仔裤。她深棕色的头发扎成凌乱的丸子头，脸颊旁散落着几缕发丝，一只手轻轻触碰额头。面部应弱化或遮挡，使整体氛围和造型比个人身份更重要。采用柔和的自然光、高调曝光，以及精致的编辑摄影风格与手绘涂鸦相结合。左半部分放置蜡笔或彩色铅笔风格的日文手写文字。顶部的大号橙色文字为 {argument name="date text" default="4月29日"}，下方为 {argument name="headline text" default="昭和の日"}。在其下方，添加一段灰色的日文手写短句：“なつかしい風が 心をふわっと ほどいてくれる日。”（怀旧的风，让心轻盈舒展的日子。）下方添加 3 行带有图标的小信息：1 个笑脸图标配“先负”，1 个新月图标配“月齢 11.6”，以及 1 个太阳图标配“晴れ 20℃”。接着添加一条虚线分隔符，以及一个标题为“今日は何の日？”（今天是什么日子？）的手写列表，包含 4 个项目符号： “昭和の日”、“畳の日”、“ナポリタンの日”和“国際盲導犬の日”，每一项都配有小涂鸦，如旗帜、榻榻米、意大利面盘和狗。左下角绘制 1 个粉色云朵形状的对话框，包含手写引语 {argument name="quote" default="きみのえがおが いちばんだいすきだよ by ○○より"}。画面装饰包括：右上角附近正好 2 个白色云朵涂鸦，右上角 1 个黄色太阳涂鸦，空中飘浮着几片绿色小叶子，女性头部附近有几条淡淡的风痕线条，底部边缘她腿部周围正好 4 个粉色、黄色和橙色的小花涂鸦。色调保持柔和的粉彩色，使用橙色、粉色、橄榄绿、灰色、奶油色和牛仔蓝。整体效果应呈现为一张充满情感的日式节假日手账日历页，将极简主义肖像摄影与可爱的童趣插画完美融合。

templates.title: AI Supercar Poster Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: AI 超跑海报对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a side-by-side comparison graphic on a black background with a faint gray grid, styled like a Chinese social media benchmark post comparing two AI-generated supercar posters. At the very top, place 2 large headings: on the left in bold yellow text, “GPT image 2”, and on the right in bold white text, “Nano Banana”. Centered beneath them, show 2 distinct vertical racing poster designs placed next to each other with a narrow gap. The left poster should look like a dramatic high-end motorsport advertisement in black, red, and white, featuring a glossy red hypercar speeding on a wet racetrack at dusk with cinematic reflections, motion blur, and aggressive lighting. Include a small brand mark at top left, a giant title “VORTEX X7” with “X7” in bright red, and a subtitle like “BORN FOR SPEED. BUILT TO WIN.” Add 2 laurel-like badges on the right of the title area. In the lower half, include 3 content blocks: a left “SPECIFICATIONS” column with exactly 7 listed rows with icon bullets and labels for engine, horsepower, top speed, acceleration, transmission, drivetrain, curb weight, plus fuel capacity if needed as a compact final row; a middle “FEATURES” column with exactly 5 bullet points; and a bold pricing block with “STARTING AT” and a large red price of {argument name="price" default="$189,900"}. Add 1 limited-production badge, 1 slogan block reading “FEEL THE SPEED. OWN THE TRACK.”, and 1 red call-to-action strip reading “ORDER NOW”. Use tiny footer details and contact-style microtext along the bottom edge. The right poster should look more editorial and technical, in navy blue, charcoal, beige, and orange accents, featuring a dark blue hypercar drifting on a racetrack with smoke and landscape in the background. At the top, use a premium magazine-style header with 3 stacked title lines: “FORMULA APEX | AETHELRED APEX”, “CHAMPIONSHIP HERITAGE”, and a performance subtitle. In the lower portion, create a dense spec-sheet layout with exactly 8 major sections: “SPECIFICATION SHEET”, “COMPETITION PACK OPTIONS”, “ENGINE”, “SUSPENSION”, “CHASSIS”, “DRIVETRAIN”, “LAUNCH EDITION | RESERVE NOW”, and “SERVICE & SUPPORT”. Include a small performance graph, a boxed options panel with 3 icon cards, a launch price line showing {argument name="launch price" default="$2,850,000 USD"}, a build-slots area showing exactly 50 units worldwide, an allocation or progress tracker with segmented bars, a line stating production begins in {argument name="production year" default="2025"}, and dense fine-print technical copy. Beneath both posters, add a rounded rectangular black prompt box outlined in white, spanning most of the width. Attach a yellow rounded label overlapping its top-left corner containing the Chinese text “提示词”. Inside the box, place one line of bold white Chinese text: {argument name="prompt text" default="生成一张赛车海报图片，包含规格参数和价格信息。"}. The whole composition should feel like a polished AI image comparison screenshot for social media, with sharp typography, high contrast, clean alignment, and realistic poster mockup proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个在带有浅灰色网格的黑色背景上的并排对比图，风格类似于中国社交媒体上的基准测试帖，用于比较两张 AI 生成的超跑海报。在最上方放置 2 个大标题：左侧为加粗黄色文字“GPT image 2”，右侧为加粗白色文字“Nano Banana”。在它们下方居中位置，并排展示 2 张不同的垂直赛车海报设计，中间留有窄缝。左侧海报应呈现为高端赛车广告风格，采用黑、红、白配色，画面为一辆亮红色超跑在黄昏时湿滑的赛道上疾驰，带有电影质感的反射、动态模糊和强烈的灯光效果。在左上角加入一个小品牌标志，巨大的标题“VORTEX X7”中“X7”为亮红色，并配有副标题如“BORN FOR SPEED. BUILT TO WIN.”。在标题区域右侧添加 2 个类似月桂叶的徽章。在下半部分，包含 3 个内容区块：左侧为“SPECIFICATIONS”列，包含 7 行带有图标符号和标签的列表，涵盖引擎、马力、最高时速、加速、变速箱、驱动系统、整备质量，并在最后一行紧凑地列出燃油容量（如有需要）；中间为“FEATURES”列，包含 5 个要点；以及一个加粗的价格区块，显示“STARTING AT”和以 {argument name="price" default="$189,900"} 显示的醒目红色价格。添加 1 个限量生产徽章、1 个写有“FEEL THE SPEED. OWN THE TRACK.”的口号区块，以及 1 条写有“ORDER NOW”的红色行动呼吁条。在底部边缘使用微小的页脚细节和联系方式风格的微型文字。右侧海报应看起来更具编辑感和技术感，采用海军蓝、炭灰色、米色和橙色点缀，画面为一辆深蓝色超跑在赛道上漂移，背景带有烟雾和景观。在顶部，使用高级杂志风格的页眉，包含 3 行堆叠标题：“FORMULA APEX | AETHELRED APEX”、“CHAMPIONSHIP HERITAGE”以及一个性能副标题。在下半部分，创建一个密集的规格表布局，包含 8 个主要部分：“SPECIFICATION SHEET”、“COMPETITION PACK OPTIONS”、“ENGINE”、“SUSPENSION”、“CHASSIS”、“DRIVETRAIN”、“LAUNCH EDITION | RESERVE NOW”和“SERVICE & SUPPORT”。包含一张小型性能图表、一个带有 3 个图标卡片的盒装选项面板、一行显示 {argument name="launch price" default="$2,850,000 USD"} 的发布价格、一个显示全球限量 50 台的生产配额区域、一个带有分段条的分配或进度跟踪器、一行说明生产开始于 {argument name="production year" default="2025"} 的文字，以及密集的精细技术说明文字。在两张海报下方，添加一个白色边框的圆角黑色提示词框，横跨大部分宽度。在左上角覆盖一个黄色的圆角标签，内含中文“提示词”。在框内，放置一行加粗的白色中文文字：{argument name="prompt text" default="生成一张赛车海报图片，包含规格参数和价格信息。"}。整体构图应呈现为一张精致的社交媒体 AI 图像对比截图，具备锐利的排版、高对比度、整齐的对齐以及逼真的海报样机比例。

templates.title: Exhausted Girl in a Quiet Room

titleLocalized.zh: 安静房间里疲惫的女孩

templates.prompt: A soft, muted monochrome anime-style illustration of a tired young woman lounging indoors in a quiet room, drawn with delicate sketchy linework and flat subdued shading in warm gray-beige tones. She has long dark brown to nearly black hair with wispy loose strands and soft bangs, pale skin, and half-lidded weary eyes. Her expression is drained and absent-minded, with a slight pout and a feeling of emotional exhaustion. She is slouching sideways in a chair or sofa, leaning her head into one hand with her elbow propped up, her posture loose and unguarded, giving a natural "all the tension has left her body" feeling. She wears an oversized dark charcoal off-shoulder long-sleeve sweatshirt slipping down on one side, exposing one shoulder and collarbone, with a relaxed baggy silhouette. In the foreground is a round table with a plain light-colored mug, 2 small paper wrappers or notes, and 1 small rectangular piece of chocolate. On the left side of the room is a simple vase holding several leafy branches on a small surface. A small hanging note on the wall reads "おつかれわたし". A thought bubble near her head reads "なんもしたくな〜い". The composition is vertical and intimate, like a casual lifestyle illustration or mood drawing, with lots of negative space, a minimalist background, understated domestic details, and a calm, sleepy, emotionally worn-out atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、低饱和度的单色动漫风格插画，描绘了一位在安静房间内慵懒休憩的疲惫年轻女性。画作采用细腻的草图线条和暖灰米色调的平涂阴影。她留着深棕色近乎黑色的长发，发丝凌乱，留着柔软的刘海，皮肤白皙，半睁的眼睛流露出疲惫感。她的表情显得心力交瘁、心不在焉，微微嘟着嘴，透出一种情感上的疲惫。她侧身瘫坐在椅子或沙发上，单手托腮，肘部支撑，姿态松弛自然，给人一种“全身力气都被抽干”的真实感。她穿着一件超大款深炭灰色露肩长袖卫衣，卫衣一侧滑落，露出单侧肩膀和锁骨，整体轮廓宽松。前景是一张圆桌，上面放着一个素色马克杯、2 个小纸包装或便签，以及 1 小块长方形巧克力。房间左侧的小桌面上摆放着一个简单的花瓶，插着几枝绿叶。墙上挂着一张小纸条，写着“おつかれわたし”（辛苦了，我自己）。她头顶附近的对话框写着“なんもしたくな〜い”（什么都不想做）。构图垂直且亲密，宛如随性的生活插画或情绪素描，留白充裕，背景极简，居家细节低调，营造出一种平静、困倦且情感耗竭的氛围。

templates.title: Childlike Pastel Portrait Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 童趣粉彩肖像拼贴

templates.prompt: A dreamy mixed-media pastel illustration on textured white paper with a visible vertical fold down the center, in a naive childlike crayon-and-oil-pastel style. Show a half-hidden portrait of a girl placed slightly left of center, with only part of her face visible because a large soft-edged rectangular blur obscures the middle of the image from forehead to chest. The visible features include dark teal-black hair, one warm brown eye, hints of cheek and neck, and a cream or pale yellow garment. Surround her with loose scribbled botanical lines and abstract strokes in turquoise, olive green, black, white, ochre, and peach. Scatter hand-drawn Japanese hiragana and numbers around the composition like children’s marks on paper: 「新」 and 「し」 in orange at the upper left, 「お」「ば」「ら」 stacked vertically on the upper right in mustard and dark olive, a small turquoise flag shape at mid-right, an orange sun symbol near the lower center-right, the number-like text 「11.6」 in brown at the lower right, and an orange open-book icon at the lower left. Add several sweeping diagonal crayon lines in golden yellow and white crossing behind and around the figure. Keep the composition airy, imperfect, expressive, and slightly melancholic, with rough grainy pigment, visible paper texture, muted earthy colors, and the feel of a child’s memory drawing combined with contemporary art illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的混合媒介粉彩插画，绘制在带有明显中心垂直折痕的白色纹理纸上，呈现出天真烂漫的蜡笔与油画棒风格。画面中，一位女孩的半遮面肖像位于中心偏左位置，由于一个巨大的柔边矩形模糊区域遮挡了从额头到胸部的画面中心，仅露出部分面部特征。可见的细节包括深青黑色头发、一只温暖的棕色眼睛、部分脸颊和颈部，以及一件奶油色或浅黄色的服装。周围环绕着松散的涂鸦植物线条和青绿色、橄榄绿、黑色、白色、赭色及桃色的抽象笔触。画面中散布着手绘的日语平假名和数字，如同儿童在纸上的涂鸦：左上角有橙色的「新」和「し」，右上角垂直堆叠着芥末色和深橄榄色的「お」「ば」「ら」，中右侧有一个小小的青绿色旗帜形状，中右下方有一个橙色太阳符号，右下角有棕色的类似数字的文本「11.6」，左下角有一个橙色的翻开书本图标。在人物背后和周围添加几道金黄色与白色的斜向蜡笔扫痕。保持构图空灵、不完美、富有表现力且略带忧郁感，展现出粗糙的颗粒感颜料、可见的纸张纹理、柔和的大地色调，营造出一种儿童记忆画作与当代艺术插画相结合的氛围。

templates.title: Relaxed Woman on Sofa Sketch

titleLocalized.zh: 沙发上放松的女性素描

templates.prompt: A soft, muted anime-style interior illustration of a young woman lounging sideways on a sofa in a relaxed, unposed way. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long slightly messy hair with loose strands falling over her shoulders, and she is wearing an oversized off-shoulder knit sweater in charcoal gray that slips down to reveal one shoulder, plus loose light beige sweatpants and soft socks. Her pose is casual and limp, with her body curled across the couch, one elbow propped into a large cushion, her hand supporting her cheek, and her legs folded to the side. Her visible expression should feel tired, quiet, introspective, and emotionally drained but comfortable. The scene is framed as a medium full-body shot from the front at sofa height. The room is calm and minimal, with 1 sofa, 3 large cushions, 1 round wooden coffee table in the foreground, 1 ceramic mug on the table with a simple cat doodle and the handwritten text "ねこ", 1 smartphone lying flat on the table, 1 notebook or paperback book with small Japanese handwriting on the cover, 1 small paper note taped to the wall reading "なんとかなるよ", and 1 leafy plant branch entering from the upper right side. Use a desaturated warm gray and beige palette, delicate pencil-like linework, light watercolor wash shading, subtle texture like sketch paper, and a wistful slice-of-life mood. Keep the composition airy, intimate, and understated, like a quiet illustration from a lifestyle art book.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、低饱和度的动漫风格室内插画，描绘了一位年轻女性以放松、随意的姿态侧卧在沙发上。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长发，发丝略显凌乱，几缕发丝垂落在肩头。她穿着一件炭灰色的超大号露肩针织毛衣，毛衣滑落露出单侧肩膀，下身搭配宽松的浅米色运动裤和柔软的袜子。她的姿势随意而慵懒，身体蜷缩在沙发上，一只手肘撑在靠垫上，手掌托着脸颊，双腿向一侧折叠。她露出的表情应显得疲惫、安静、内省，带着一种情感上的疲惫感，却又感到舒适。场景采用沙发高度的正面中景全身构图。房间宁静简约，配有 1 张沙发、3 个大靠垫、前景中 1 张圆形木制咖啡桌；桌上放着 1 个陶瓷马克杯，杯上有简单的猫咪涂鸦和手写文字“ねこ”，1 部平放的智能手机，以及 1 本封面上写有细小日语字迹的笔记本或平装书；墙上贴着 1 张写有“なんとかなるよ”的小纸条，右上角有一枝叶片伸入画面。采用去饱和的暖灰与米色调，运用细腻的铅笔线条、轻盈的水彩晕染、类似素描纸的微妙纹理，营造出一种伤感的日常氛围。构图保持空灵、亲密且低调，如同生活艺术画册中安静的插画。

templates.title: Relaxed Woman on Sofa Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 沙发上放松的女性插画

templates.prompt: A soft, desaturated anime-style illustration of a young woman lounging on a light-colored sofa in a quiet indoor living room, shown in a vertical composition. She has long, slightly messy wet-looking dark brown hair with loose strands falling over her shoulders and chest, a small earring visible on one ear, and a relaxed, drained pose with her head tilted and resting against one hand. Her face is obscured by a flat square censor block in muted taupe-gray centered over the face area. She wears an oversized off-shoulder white shirt slipping low across her body, exposing one thin black camisole strap, with bare legs folded casually on the sofa. Her posture should feel limp and unforced, with a natural sense of loosened tension. In the foreground, place 2 tabletop objects: 1 black mug and 1 closed thick book or binder stacked near the edge of a small table. In the background, include 1 potted leafy houseplant on the left and sheer pale curtains behind the sofa. Use a muted palette of warm gray, cream, off-white, dusty charcoal, and pale taupe, with sketchy pencil-like linework, delicate watercolor wash shading, airy negative space, and a calm intimate mood like a fashion-lifestyle editorial illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅柔和、低饱和度的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性在安静的室内客厅里，慵懒地躺在浅色沙发上的竖构图画面。她留着长长的深棕色湿发，略显凌乱，发丝松散地垂在肩头和胸前，一只耳朵上戴着小耳环。她姿态放松且略显疲惫，头部倾斜，手托着脸颊。她的面部被一个位于中心位置、呈灰褐色的方形遮挡块遮住。她穿着一件宽松的露肩白衬衫，衬衫滑落至身体下方，露出一条细细的黑色吊带，双腿随意地蜷缩在沙发上。她的姿态应显得柔软自然，带有一种松弛感。前景放置 2 件桌面物品：1 个黑色马克杯和 1 本叠放在小桌边缘的厚书或活页夹。背景左侧包含 1 盆绿植，沙发后方挂着半透明的浅色窗帘。整体采用暖灰、奶油色、米白色、灰炭色和浅褐色的柔和色调，结合素描般的线条、细腻的水彩晕染、通透的留白，营造出如同时尚生活方式编辑插画般宁静而亲密的氛围。

templates.title: Spooky Japanese Halloween Logo

titleLocalized.zh: 日式万圣节惊悚主题 Logo

templates.prompt: A playful spooky Japanese title logo on a clean white background, centered composition, featuring the large hiragana text {argument name="main text" default="はるか"} in bold rounded hand-drawn lettering, white letters with icy pale-blue shading, subtle grunge texture, and a thick dark navy outline with luminous blue glow. Surround the text with a Halloween yokai atmosphere: 1 cute white ghost floating at the upper left of the lettering, 1 red-orange paper lantern hanging on the left side with black kanji printed on it, 1 large magnifying glass overlapping the lower right of the text, and 1 haunted castle silhouette in the background with 3 tall spires and warm glowing windows. Add 1 traditional Japanese stone lantern on the right with a lit window, 2 blue ghost-fire torches on the far right, several black bat silhouettes flying around the castle, deep indigo mist, electric blue flames, and an inky dripping shadow base beneath the logo. Use a vibrant neon palette of midnight blue, cyan glow, white, and orange accents, with a polished sticker-like game-logo illustration style, crisp edges, soft airbrushed lighting, whimsical horror mood, and high contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个充满趣味的日式惊悚标题 Logo，置于干净的白色背景上，采用居中构图。主体为粗体圆润手写风格的平假名文字 {argument name="main text" default="はるか"}，白色字体带有冰冷的淡蓝色阴影、细腻的磨损纹理，以及深海军蓝色的粗轮廓和发光的蓝色光晕。文字周围环绕着万圣节妖怪氛围：文字左上方漂浮着 1 个可爱的白色幽灵，左侧悬挂着 1 个印有黑色汉字的红橙色纸灯笼，文字右下方重叠着 1 个大型放大镜，背景中设有 1 座带有 3 座高塔和温暖发光窗户的闹鬼城堡剪影。右侧添加 1 个带有发光窗户的传统日式石灯笼，最右侧放置 2 个蓝色鬼火火把，城堡周围飞舞着几只黑色蝙蝠剪影，伴有深靛色薄雾、电蓝色火焰，以及 Logo 下方墨水滴落般的阴影基底。采用午夜蓝、青色光晕、白色和橙色点缀的鲜艳霓虹配色，呈现出精致的贴纸式游戏 Logo 插画风格，边缘清晰，光影柔和，兼具奇幻恐怖氛围与高对比度。

Keep the same photo as the source image, including the face blur/censor, and place it in a rounded card at the top right. Reformat the output as a white editorial report page with thin gray borders, black typography, and a luxury beauty-consultation layout. Add these 8 report sections: 1) top header with small English text "FACIAL BEAUTY REPORT ✦", the large Japanese title, and the subtitle "あなたらしさを活かし、より魅力的になるための分析レポート"; 2) an OVERVIEW box listing exactly 5 rows: 年齢（推定） 20–24歳, 性別 女性, 顔の形 やや卵型, パーソナル印象 清潔感・親しみやすい・柔らかい, 分析日 2024.05.24; 3) a total score box labeled 総合魅力度スコア with a circular gauge showing {argument name="total score" default="82"}/100 and a small score guide reading 50=平均的 / 70=良い / 85=非常に良い / 90+=優秀; 4) a metrics box with exactly 7 bullet scores: 左右対称性 84/100, 顔の比率（プロポーション） 83/100, 骨格・輪郭 80/100, 肌質 85/100, 目の魅力 85/100, 鼻のバランス 78/100, 口元の魅力 81/100, 全体の調和 83/100; 5) a FACIAL CONTOUR（シンプルライン図） panel showing a simplified line-art face diagram with the blurred face area masked and measurement guides labeled exactly 1/3, 1/3, 1/3 vertically and 1/5 repeated 5 times along the bottom; 6) a 詳細分析 section with exactly 8 rows matching the metrics above and short explanatory Japanese comments; 7) a strengths box titled 強み（あなたの魅力ポイント） with exactly 3 icon-led items: クリアで印象的な目元, なめらかな肌質, バランスの取れた輪郭; 8) an improvements box titled 改善できる点（より魅力を高めるために） with exactly 3 icon-led items: 目の下のクマ, 鼻の立体感, 唇の血色感; 9) a final recommendation row titled 身だしなみ・スタイル改善提案 with exactly 4 columns labeled ヘアスタイル, メイク, スキンケア, ライフスタイル, each with a simple black line icon and short Japanese advice. Add a small footer line on the bottom right reading {argument name="footer text" default="BEAUTY IS BALANCE."}. Overall style: minimalist clinic report, balanced grid layout, soft shadows, rounded panels, black and gray only, highly legible Japanese magazine design.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0，将上传的肖像转换为简洁、高级的日式美学分析面板，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="顔立ち美容レポート"}。保留与源图像相同的照片，包括面部模糊/遮挡效果，并将其放置在右上角的圆角卡片中。将输出格式化为带有细灰色边框、黑色排版和奢华美容咨询布局的白色编辑报告页面。添加以下 8 个报告部分：1) 顶部页眉，包含小号英文文本“FACIAL BEAUTY REPORT ✦”、大号日文标题以及副标题“あなたらしさを活かし、より魅力的になるための分析レポート”；2) 一个 OVERVIEW 框，列出 5 行内容：年齢（推定） 20–24歳, 性別 女性, 顔の形 やや卵型, パーソナル印象 清潔感・親しみやすい・柔らかい, 分析日 2024.05.24；3) 一个标注为 総合魅力度スコア 的总分框，包含一个显示 {argument name="total score" default="82"}/100 的圆形仪表盘，以及一个简短的评分指南：50=平均的 / 70=良い / 85=非常に良い / 90+=優秀；4) 一个包含 7 个项目评分的指标框：左右対称性 84/100, 顔の比率（プロポーション） 83/100, 骨格・輪郭 80/100, 肌質 85/100, 目の魅力 85/100, 鼻のバランス 78/100, 口元の魅力 81/100, 全体の調和 83/100；5) 一个 FACIAL CONTOUR（シンプルライン図）面板，展示简化的线稿面部图，模糊的面部区域被遮盖，并标注测量指南，垂直方向标记为 1/3, 1/3, 1/3，底部重复标记 5 次 1/5；6) 一个 詳細分析 部分，包含与上述指标对应的 8 行内容及简短的日文解释说明；7) 一个标题为 強み（あなたの魅力ポイント） 的优势框，包含 3 个带图标的项目：クリアで印象的な目元, なめらかな肌質, バランスの取れた輪郭；8) 一个标题为 改善できる点（より魅力を高めるために） 的改进建议框，包含 3 个带图标的项目：目の下のクマ, 鼻の立体感, 唇の血色感；9) 一行最终建议，标题为 身だしなみ・スタイル改善提案，包含 4 列，分别标注为 ヘアスタイル, メイク, スキンケア, ライフスタイル，每列配有一个简单的黑色线条图标和简短的日文建议。在右下角添加一行页脚文本：{argument name="footer text" default="BEAUTY IS BALANCE."}。整体风格：极简诊所报告、平衡的网格布局、柔和阴影、圆角面板、仅限黑灰色调、高可读性的日式杂志设计。

templates.title: Manga Panel to Apocalyptic Mecha Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 将漫画分镜转化为末日机甲海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, remake the original manga panel as a dramatic cinematic anime key visual. Keep the same 2 characters, their relative placement, and the exact Japanese dialogue from the speech bubbles, but remove the manga panel borders and speech balloons and recompose the text as 2 large vertical copy blocks floating in the sky: on the right, 「戦争なら だいじょうぶ。 もうすぐ 終わります。」; on the left, 「地は焼かれ 涙と悲鳴は 新たなる争いの 狼煙となるの。」 Transform the simple black-and-white drawing into a highly detailed painted scene with realistic lighting, weathered textures, and an apocalyptic battlefield atmosphere at dusk. Replace the plain background with a colossal Gundam-like mecha towering behind them, covered in sharp wing-like protrusions and glowing magenta energy cracks, with smoke, embers, ruined city debris, and a dark cloudy sky. Upgrade the boy into a full-color anime version wearing a dark military-style uniform with red trim, still smiling and raising one hand. Upgrade the cat-like masked character into a sinister but expressive full-color figure with cracked white armor-like face plating, glowing pale blue eyes, a wide grin, a dark hooded cloak, and a small bell at the neck. Add a red war flag near the lower left background. Make it feel like an epic war poster, low-angle composition, ultra-detailed, high contrast, gritty, ominous, and cinematic.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图，将原始漫画分镜重制为极具戏剧张力的动漫电影海报。保留原有的 2 个角色、他们的相对位置以及对话框中的日语原文，但需移除漫画边框和对话气泡，并将文字重新排版为悬浮在天空中的 2 个大型竖排文本块：右侧为「戦争なら だいじょうぶ。 もうすぐ 終わります。」；左侧为「地は焼かれ 涙と悲鳴は 新たなる争いの 狼煙となるの。」。将简单的黑白线条画转化为细节丰富的绘图场景，呈现逼真的光影、风化质感以及黄昏时分的末日战场氛围。将原本简洁的背景替换为矗立在角色身后、体型巨大的高达风格机甲，机甲覆盖着锋利的翼状突起，闪烁着洋红色的能量裂纹，周围环绕着烟雾、余烬、废墟残骸以及阴沉的云层。将男孩升级为全彩动漫版本，身着带有红色饰边的深色军装，保持微笑并举起一只手。将猫型面具角色升级为既阴森又富有表现力的全彩形象，面部带有碎裂的白色盔甲状面具，双眼泛着淡蓝色的光，咧嘴大笑，身披深色连帽斗篷，颈部挂着一个小铃铛。在左下角背景处添加一面红色战旗。整体风格需呈现史诗级战争海报感，采用低角度构图，超高细节，高对比度，粗犷、阴郁且具有电影质感。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Combining Mecha Lineup

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻合体机甲阵容

templates.prompt:
A dramatic dark fantasy mecha lineup on a black smoky studio-like background, rendered as ultra-detailed concept art with a wide cinematic composition. Show exactly 6 sinister biomechanical figures standing side by side on a glossy reflective floor, all designed as parts or forms of a combining robot set. The overall design language is gothic, infernal, and baroque: blackened steel, tarnished silver armor, serrated edges, thorn-like protrusions, skeletal filigree, red glowing cores and eyes, with subtle white-metal highlights and traces of crimson energy. The mood is ominous, majestic, and apocalyptic.

From left to right: first, a towering humanoid overlord mech, the largest figure in the lineup, with a crown-like halo ring behind the head, huge layered black feathered or blade-like wings draping downward, ornate chest armor with a bright central core, multiple red glowing orbs embedded asymmetrically, and a long staff or spear held diagonally. Second, a tall slender angelic-demonic humanoid mech with an elongated body, spiked antler-like crest, narrow waist, blade-like hanging armor panels, and red glowing shoulder nodes, posed upright and regal. Third, a beast unit on four legs, low and aggressive like a demonic wolf or draconic hound, covered in curved blade armor and long swept-back horns, with glowing red eyes and an arched tail or spine silhouette. Fourth, a heavy quadruped siege unit, bulkier and more armored, with a forward head assembly and two large circular shield-like wheel structures mounted on its sides, full of radial spikes and a glowing red core at the center of one wheel. Fifth, a centaur-like or upright beast warrior mech with long legs, layered armor, horned head, and a sharp avian-draconic profile, slimmer than the heavy unit but still imposing, with red lights in the chest and head. Sixth, a symmetrical winged emblem-like unit resembling a mechanical phoenix crest rather than a humanoid body, with two broad metallic wings spread outward around a central halo ring and a tapered hanging tail piece set with 3 visible red gem-like cores.

Keep the palette nearly monochrome except for the glowing reds. Emphasize razor-sharp silhouettes, intricate engravings, layered armor plates, cables and skeletal mechanical details, smoke drifting behind the figures, and faint reflections beneath their feet. The image should feel like a premium concept sheet for a {argument name="theme" default="dark combining robot"} in the style of hyper-detailed dark fantasy sci-fi illustration. Use a panoramic aspect ratio, front-facing lineup presentation, and high contrast lighting that picks out metallic edges against the deep black background.

promptLocalized.zh:
在黑色烟雾缭绕的摄影棚背景下，呈现出一组极具戏剧性的暗黑奇幻机甲阵容，采用超精细概念艺术渲染，并具备宽幅电影级构图。画面中精确展示了 6 个邪恶的生物机械体，它们并排站立在光亮如镜的地面上，所有设计均为合体机器人套装的部件或形态。整体设计语言呈现出哥特式、地狱风和巴洛克风格：黑钢材质、暗银色装甲、锯齿边缘、荆棘状突起、骨架花丝，以及散发红色光芒的核心与双眼，并点缀着细腻的白金属高光和丝丝深红能量痕迹。整体氛围阴森、宏伟且充满末日感。

从左至右依次为：第一，一座高耸的人形霸主机甲，是阵容中体型最大的角色，头后带有皇冠状光环，巨大的层叠黑色羽翼或刃状翅膀向下垂落，华丽的胸甲中央镶嵌着明亮的核心，不对称地嵌入了多个红色发光球体，手中斜持一根长杖或长矛。第二，一台高挑纤细的天使恶魔型人形机甲，拥有修长的躯体、尖刺状鹿角头冠、窄腰、刃状悬挂装甲板以及发红光的肩部节点，姿态挺拔且威严。第三，一台四足兽型单位，低伏且极具侵略性，宛如恶魔狼或龙形猎犬，覆盖着弯曲的刃状装甲和向后延伸的长角，双眼散发红光，背部轮廓呈拱形。第四，一台重型四足攻城单位，体型更魁梧且装甲厚重，头部组件前伸，两侧安装有两个巨大的圆形盾状轮式结构，布满放射状尖刺，其中一个轮子中心嵌有发红光的核心。第五，一台半人马或直立兽型战士机甲，拥有长腿、层叠装甲、带角头部以及锐利的鸟龙特征，比重型单位更纤细但依然气势逼人，胸部和头部带有红色灯光。第六，一台对称的翼状徽章单位，看起来更像机械凤凰纹章而非人形躯体，两片宽大的金属翅膀围绕中央光环向外展开，尾部悬挂着锥形部件，上面镶嵌着 3 颗清晰可见的红色宝石状核心。

色调保持近乎单色，仅保留发光的红色。强调锋利的轮廓、复杂的雕刻、层叠的装甲板、线缆和骨架机械细节，人物身后飘散着烟雾，脚下映出淡淡的倒影。画面应呈现出 {argument name="theme" default="暗黑合体机器人"} 的高级概念图质感，风格为超精细暗黑奇幻科幻插画。采用全景长宽比、正面阵容展示，并运用高对比度照明，在深邃的黑色背景下凸显金属边缘。

templates.title: Pet Apparel Replacement Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 宠物服装替换效果图

templates.prompt: Create a clean e-commerce mockup on a very light gray background with a simple two-image comparison layout. In the upper right, place 1 small rounded-corner reference photo showing a white fluffy dog from behind, standing on soft light blue fabric and wearing a cream knit pet sweater with pale blue trim. The sweater features a large cartoon dog face patch in brown, black, and white, a red cursive word "Smile," a small red cherry, a blue star, and a yellow crescent moon. Beneath that small reference image, place 1 rounded light-gray text bubble containing Japanese instruction text in black sans-serif: 「画像内のペットを猫に差し替え、元の画像と同じ衣装を着せた状態にする。猫は正面または側面が見える向きで、全身がはっきり見えるようにする。」 In the lower left, place 1 larger rounded-corner final image with a subtle dark border, showing a full-body gray tabby and white cat standing on the same soft light blue fabric backdrop. The cat is facing slightly left but looking directly at the camera, with upright ears, large round eyes, white chest and legs, gray striped back and tail, and a calm alert expression. The cat wears the same cream knitted pet sweater with light blue ribbed trim around the neck, armholes, and hem, fitted neatly around the torso. The sweater artwork matches the reference: the red cursive "Smile" text, a red cherry motif, a blue star, a yellow crescent moon, and a large textured cartoon dog face patch on the side. Lighting is soft and diffuse, like a studio product photo for an online shop, with a realistic fabric texture, minimal shadows, and a polished pet apparel catalog aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个背景为浅灰色的简洁电商效果图，采用简单的双图对比布局。在右上角放置 1 张圆角小尺寸参考图，展示一只白色毛茸茸的狗背影，它站在柔软的浅蓝色布料上，穿着一件带有浅蓝色滚边的米色针织宠物毛衣。毛衣上有一个棕、黑、白三色的大型卡通狗脸贴布，以及红色的草书单词“Smile”、一颗红色小樱桃、一颗蓝色星星和一轮黄色新月。在该参考图下方，放置 1 个圆角浅灰色文本气泡，内含黑色无衬线字体日语说明：“画像内のペットを猫に差し替え、元の画像と同じ衣装を着せた状態にする。猫は正面または側面が見える向きで、全身がはっきり見えるようにする。”（将图片中的宠物替换为猫，并让其穿上与原图相同的服装。猫应面向正面或侧面，全身清晰可见。）在左下角放置 1 张带有细微深色边框的圆角大图，展示一只全身灰虎斑白猫站在同样的柔软浅蓝色布料背景上。猫咪身体略向左侧，但直视镜头，耳朵竖立，圆眼睛大而有神，胸部和四肢为白色，背部和尾巴有灰色条纹，神态平静且机警。猫咪穿着同样的米色针织宠物毛衣，领口、袖口和下摆处有浅蓝色罗纹滚边，贴合身形。毛衣图案与参考图一致：红色的草书“Smile”文字、樱桃图案、蓝色星星、黄色新月，以及侧面带有纹理的大型卡通狗脸贴布。光线柔和且均匀，呈现出网店摄影棚产品照的质感，具有逼真的布料纹理、极简的阴影，整体风格符合宠物服装目录的专业审美。

templates.title: Confused Elf Girl at Pastel Desk

titleLocalized.zh: 书桌前困惑的精灵少女

templates.prompt: A cute pastel anime illustration of a young elf girl streamer or office worker sitting at a desk and typing on a mechanical keyboard in a cozy bedroom workspace, shown from a front three-quarter view with a large black computer monitor in the left foreground partially blocking her body. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="orange"} hair with glossy highlights, pointed elf ears, and a small red flower hair clip on the right side, wearing a light blue pajama-style blouse covered in red heart prints with a very frilly white lace collar and a shiny red ribbon bow at the neck. Her hands are on the keyboard, nails painted soft pink, and she sits in a rounded pink desk chair. Above her head is a speech bubble containing a large question mark, suggesting confusion while working at the computer. The room is soft, bright, and feminine, with a pale pink and cream color palette, shallow depth of field, and delicate line art. In the background, include 1 framed wall picture with a pink animal and heart motif, 1 small potted plant near the center-left, 1 plush toy on a shelf behind her, 2 sticky notes on the upper right wall, one with a plus sign and one reading {argument name="note text" default="がんばろう!"}, 1 blue cat figurine or plush on the right shelf, 1 small potted plant on the right, 4 pastel binders or books on the lower right shelf, and 1 white mug with a pink heart on the desk in the lower right corner. The computer monitor should have a subtle glowing blue heart icon on its back, and the keyboard should have RGB lighting. Clean polished cel-shaded anime style, high detail, soft ambient lighting, cozy gamer desk atmosphere, pastel kawaii decor, 4k illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的粉彩动漫插画，描绘了一位年轻的精灵少女主播或上班族，坐在书桌前使用机械键盘打字，背景是温馨的卧室工作区。画面采用前侧方视角，左前方有一个巨大的黑色电脑显示器，部分遮挡了她的身体。她留着长长的波浪卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="橙色"}，带有光泽感，长着尖尖的精灵耳朵，右侧别着一个小红花发夹。她穿着一件浅蓝色睡衣风格的衬衫，上面印有红色心形图案，领口带有非常精致的白色蕾丝花边，颈部系着一个闪亮的红色蝴蝶结。她的双手放在键盘上，指甲涂成柔和的粉色，坐在圆形的粉色办公椅上。她头顶上方有一个对话气泡，里面有一个大大的问号，暗示她在电脑前工作时感到困惑。房间氛围柔和、明亮且充满少女感，采用浅粉色和奶油色的色调，具有浅景深效果和细腻的线条。背景包括：1 幅挂在墙上的相框，画着粉色动物和心形图案；1 盆靠近左侧的小盆栽；1 个摆在她身后架子上的毛绒玩具；2 张贴在右上角墙上的便签，一张画着加号，另一张写着 {argument name="note text" default="がんばろう!"}；1 个放在右侧架子上的蓝色猫咪手办或毛绒玩具；1 盆放在右侧的小盆栽；4 个放在右下角架子上的粉彩活页夹或书籍；以及 1 个放在右下角桌面上、印有粉色心形的白色马克杯。电脑显示器背面应有一个微妙的蓝色发光心形图标，键盘应带有 RGB 灯光。干净精致的赛璐珞动漫风格，高细节，柔和的环境光，温馨的游戏桌氛围，粉彩可爱风装饰，4k 插画。

templates.title: Iridescent Squirrel Girl Above Sapporo

titleLocalized.zh: 札幌上空的虹彩松鼠少女

templates.prompt: A luminous anime fantasy illustration of an {argument name="animal mascot" default="Ezo flying squirrel girl"} soaring high above {argument name="city" default="Sapporo"} on a brilliant summer day, viewed from a dramatic aerial angle over a long tree-lined boulevard and park with fountains, crowds, flower beds, and the red Sapporo TV Tower rising in the distance. The character is a youthful, ethereal kemonomimi girl with 2 fluffy squirrel ears, 1 large fluffy tail, and long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-blonde"} hair whipping in the wind, posed diagonally across the frame as if gliding or floating through the sky with both arms stretched wide. She wears an intricate, shimmering translucent outfit in {argument name="outfit color" default="iridescent pastel white"}: a jewel-studded fantasy dress with sheer cape-like fabric, delicate straps, frilled shorts, glossy thigh-high stockings, ornate bracelets, gemstone ornaments, and light lace-up shoes. Emphasize highly reflective soap-bubble aesthetics throughout: exactly 18 visible bubbles of varying size floating around her, each with rainbow iridescence, sparkling highlights, and glassy reflections, with additional tiny star-like glints scattered across the scene. The fabrics should look pearlescent and almost bubble-made, with intense prismatic light, glitter, and a polished high-detail gpt-image-2 anime finish. Bright saturated blue sky, fluffy white clouds, crisp sunlight, detailed urban skyline, lush green trees, and a magical airy sense of motion and freedom. Make it feel dazzling, expensive, ornate, whimsical, and celebratory, with the composition centered on the flying character crossing the cityscape in a burst of bubbles and light.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮的动漫奇幻插画，描绘了一位 {argument name="animal mascot" default="虾夷飞鼠少女"} 在阳光明媚的夏日翱翔于 {argument name="city" default="札幌"} 上空。视角采用震撼的航拍角度，俯瞰着长长的林荫大道和公园，公园内有喷泉、人群、花坛，远方矗立着红色的札幌电视塔。角色是一位充满灵气的年轻兽耳少女，长着 2 只毛茸茸的松鼠耳朵、1 条巨大的蓬松尾巴，以及随风飘动的长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银金色"} 秀发。她以对角线姿态横跨画面，仿佛在天空中滑翔或漂浮，双臂向两侧伸展。她身着一套精致且闪烁着半透明光泽的 {argument name="outfit color" default="虹彩浅白色"} 服装：一件镶嵌宝石的奇幻连衣裙，配有薄纱般的斗篷、精致的肩带、荷叶边短裤、亮面过膝袜、华丽的手镯、宝石装饰和轻便的系带鞋。强调整体高度反光的肥皂泡美学：她周围漂浮着 18 个大小不一的泡泡，每一个都带有彩虹般的虹彩、闪烁的高光和玻璃般的反射，场景中还散布着细小的星光闪烁。织物应呈现出珠光感，仿佛由泡泡制成，带有强烈的棱镜光泽、闪粉以及精致的 gpt-image-2 动漫质感。明亮饱和的蓝天、蓬松的白云、清澈的阳光、细致的城市天际线、郁郁葱葱的绿树，以及一种充满魔力的轻盈动感与自由感。整体画面令人眼花缭乱、华丽、奇幻且充满庆典氛围，构图以飞行的角色为中心，在泡泡与光影的迸发中穿过城市景观。

templates.title: Pink-Haired Cathedral Knight

titleLocalized.zh: 粉发大教堂骑士

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fantasy heroine in a grand stained-glass cathedral, viewed from a dramatic low angle. She is a beautiful young knight-princess with very long, flowing twin-tail hair in {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"}, the hair streaming outward in luminous ribbons as if caught by magical wind. Her face is intentionally obscured by a simple rectangular blur block. She wears ornate white and deep royal blue ceremonial armor with lavish gold filigree, a fitted breastplate, layered shoulder armor, long armored sleeves, a short blue skirt with gold trim, white thigh-high stockings with lace tops, and intricate gold knee and shin guards. A large crimson cape with a pale inner lining billows around her. One hand rests near her chest while the other hangs gracefully at her side. At her hip is an elegant sword with a glowing blue blade and a highly decorated gold-and-jewel hilt. The setting is flooded with radiant sunlight pouring through towering multicolored stained-glass windows and gothic arches, filling the scene with sparkling highlights, prism-like reflections, floating glitter, and magical particles. Use an ultra-detailed, highly polished anime illustration style with rich gemlike colors, intense backlighting, glossy surfaces, shimmering metal, dynamic cloth motion, and a majestic holy-fantasy atmosphere. Emphasize cinematic composition, heroic presence, and breathtaking luminous detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 一位全身动漫奇幻女英雄，身处宏伟的彩色玻璃大教堂中，采用戏剧性的低角度视角。她是一位美丽的年轻骑士公主，留着极长的飘逸双马尾，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"}，头发如同被魔法之风吹拂般向外流淌，呈现出明亮的光带。她的面部被一个简单的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。她身穿华丽的白色与深宝蓝色礼仪盔甲，配有奢华的金色花丝、贴合的胸甲、层叠的肩甲、长款盔甲袖、带有金边的蓝色短裙、带有蕾丝边的白色过膝袜，以及精致的金色护膝和护胫。一件带有浅色内衬的大红色斗篷在她周围翻涌。一只手放在胸前，另一只手优雅地垂在身侧。腰间佩戴着一把优雅的剑，剑身闪烁着蓝光，剑柄装饰着华丽的黄金与珠宝。场景中充满了从高耸的多彩彩色玻璃窗和哥特式拱门倾泻而下的灿烂阳光，画面中闪烁着耀眼的光点、棱镜般的反射、漂浮的闪粉和魔法粒子。采用超细节、高质感的动漫插画风格，色彩浓郁如宝石，背光强烈，表面光泽感强，金属闪耀，布料动态自然，营造出庄严的神圣奇幻氛围。强调电影级的构图、英雄般的气场以及令人惊叹的光影细节。

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical fantasy anime illustration of a kneeling female knight in side profile, centered slightly right, holding a massive upright greatsword with both armored hands as if in prayer or solemn resolve. She has very long flowing hair in {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"}, smooth and luminous, cascading down her back almost to the ground. Her face is mostly hidden by the side angle and lowered head, giving a quiet, introspective mood. She wears sleek reflective metallic armor in {argument name="armor color" default="deep cobalt blue"}, highly polished with glossy highlights, including sculpted shoulder plates, long armored gauntlets, a fitted breastplate with exposed side torso cutouts, a segmented waist guard, and thigh-high armored boots. The lower outfit is a short pleated armored skirt in matching blue metal. Her physique is slim and elegant, with a stylized anime beauty aesthetic. The sword is tall, dark steel with a broad blade and ornate crossguard, extending vertically from the ground near the left side of the image to above the frame. The pose is one-knee kneeling, torso upright, head slightly bowed toward the sword, conveying reverence, mourning, or determination. Set in a ruined stone corridor or ancient city passage with towering blurred walls on both sides, soft fog, floating dust motes, and a cold blue-white backlight pouring from above and behind, creating rim light around her hair and armor. Add subtle debris near the ground, cinematic depth of field, high contrast reflections, ethereal atmosphere, ultra-detailed surfaces, polished metal shading, and a premium heroic dark-fantasy mood in the style of {argument name="illustration style" default="high-detail cinematic anime key art"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖构图奇幻动漫插画，描绘了一位侧身跪姿的女骑士，人物略微偏右，双手握着一把巨大的直立巨剑，仿佛在祈祷或展现庄严的决心。她拥有一头长及地面的飘逸长发，颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，质感顺滑且富有光泽。她的面部因侧面角度和低头姿态而大部分被遮挡，营造出一种安静、内省的氛围。她身穿 {argument name="armor color" default="深钴蓝色"} 的流线型反光金属铠甲，打磨得光亮如新，带有高光质感，包括雕刻精美的肩甲、长款金属护手、带有侧身镂空设计的贴身胸甲、分段式腰甲以及过膝金属长靴。下装为同色系的蓝色金属百褶短裙。她的体态纤细优雅，符合动漫美学风格。巨剑高大，由深色钢铁打造，拥有宽阔的剑身和华丽的护手，从画面左侧地面垂直延伸至画框之外。她呈单膝跪地姿态，躯干挺直，头部微微向剑身低垂，传达出敬畏、哀悼或坚定的情绪。背景设定在废弃的石质走廊或古城通道中，两侧是高耸模糊的墙壁，伴有柔和的雾气、漂浮的尘埃，以及从上方和后方倾泻而下的冷蓝白色背光，在她的发丝和铠甲边缘勾勒出轮廓光。画面细节包括地面细微的碎片、电影级的景深效果、高对比度的反光、空灵的氛围、超精细的表面纹理、抛光金属阴影，以及 {argument name="illustration style" default="高细节电影级动漫关键视觉图"} 风格的高级英雄暗黑奇幻氛围。

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style full-body illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="young Native American woman"} standing in a sunlit prairie, with a calm, dignified presence and SFW presentation. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} shoulder-length hair with soft layered strands and side bangs, decorated with 2 feather ornaments and several beaded hair cords in red, blue, and white. Her outfit is a traditional-inspired tan buckskin dress with long fringe in 3 main areas: across the chest, around the waist, and along the skirt hem. The dress includes 4 visible geometric beadwork accents: a patterned neckline trim, a wide beaded belt, a beaded thigh band near the lower skirt, and a matching beaded wrist cuff. She also wears layered beaded necklaces, including 1 large circular medallion pendant and 2 hanging feather-and-bead necklace strands. Place 1 brown-and-white pinto horse standing just behind her right side, clearly visible from head to legs, looking toward the viewer. Set the scene in an open field of tall grass and wildflowers with rolling hills in the distance, under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds. Use warm afternoon sunlight, gentle breeze in the hair and fringe, detailed fabric texture, natural skin shading, and a cinematic composition. The image should feel elegant, respectful, and picturesque, with vibrant colors, high detail, clean linework, soft painterly rendering, and a vertical portrait composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格全身插画，描绘了一位 {argument name="character type" default="年轻的美国原住民女性"} 站在阳光明媚的草原上，气质沉稳庄重，呈现全年龄段（SFW）视觉效果。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的齐肩发，发丝层次柔和，带有侧刘海，装饰着 2 枚羽毛饰品和几根红、蓝、白三色的串珠发绳。她身穿传统风格的棕褐色鹿皮裙，在胸前、腰间和裙摆处有 3 处长流苏装饰。裙装包含 4 处明显的几何串珠点缀：领口花纹镶边、宽串珠腰带、裙摆下方的串珠大腿带以及配套的串珠腕带。她还佩戴着叠戴的串珠项链，包括 1 枚大型圆形吊坠和 2 条垂下的羽毛串珠项链。在她右后方站着 1 匹棕白相间的花斑马，从头部到腿部清晰可见，正看向观者。场景设定在开阔的草地和野花丛中，远处有连绵的丘陵，天空湛蓝，点缀着朵朵白云。采用温暖的午后阳光，发丝和流苏在微风中轻拂，展现细腻的织物纹理、自然的皮肤阴影和电影级的构图。画面应优雅、庄重且如画般美丽，色彩鲜艳，细节丰富，线条干净，渲染风格柔和，采用竖构图。

templates.prompt: A polished anime fantasy key visual in a wide cinematic composition, showing a serene young heroine on the right half of the frame against a vast sky kingdom. She is a beautiful teenage girl with {argument name="hair color" default="long silver-white"} hair, large {argument name="eye color" default="clear blue"} eyes, pale skin, and a calm, slightly wistful smile as she turns her head back toward the viewer over her shoulder. Her hair is very long and windblown, with soft layered bangs and a side ornament: 1 blue crystal hairpiece with silver filigree and trailing blue ribbons. She wears an elegant white-and-blue fantasy outfit with 4 visible main garment elements: 1 white hooded cape draped over her shoulders, 1 deep blue inner dress or tunic, 1 ornate silver armored shoulder and upper sleeve section with engraved details, and 1 blue gemstone brooch set at the chest. The background is a luminous high-altitude fantasy world filled with bright clouds, blue sky, and floating islands; include 3 prominent floating architectural elements: 1 large central floating landmass with castle structures, 1 tall narrow spire emerging from the lower left clouds, and 1 distant towered island near the center. In the upper left sky, depict 1 majestic white dragon with wings spread, flying diagonally above the title area. Add a large stylized Japanese title on the left side with metallic silver and glowing blue typography, reading {argument name="main title" default="白竜の翼と青き記憶"}, with decorative wing motifs integrated into the lettering. Beneath it, add 2 smaller lines of subtitle text in Japanese, centered left: {argument name="episode label" default="第１話"} and {argument name="episode subtitle" default="白銀の空隙"}. Scatter a few white glowing feathers or petals in the air. Use a cool palette of white, silver, and luminous azure, highly detailed linework, soft cel shading, crisp highlights, ethereal lighting, and the feel of a premium light novel cover or fantasy anime promotional poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫幻想主视觉图，采用宽幅电影构图，画面右侧展示了一位宁静的年轻女主角，背景是广阔的天空王国。她是一位美丽的少女，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的银白色"} 头发，大大的 {argument name="eye color" default="清澈蓝色"} 眼睛，皮肤白皙，转头回眸时带着平静而略显忧郁的微笑。她的头发非常长，随风飘动，带有柔软的层次感刘海和侧面装饰：1 个带有银色花丝和飘逸蓝色丝带的蓝色水晶发饰。她穿着优雅的白蓝配色幻想服装，包含 4 个可见的主要服饰元素：1 件披在肩上的白色连帽斗篷，1 件深蓝色内裙或束腰外衣，1 个带有雕刻细节的华丽银色盔甲肩部及上袖部分，以及 1 枚别在胸前的蓝色宝石胸针。背景是一个明亮的高海拔幻想世界，充满了明亮的云朵、蓝天和漂浮的岛屿；包含 3 个显眼的漂浮建筑元素：1 个带有城堡结构的大型中央漂浮陆地，1 个从左下角云层中升起的细长尖塔，以及 1 个靠近中心位置的遥远塔状岛屿。在左上方的天空中，描绘 1 条雄伟的白龙，双翼展开，在标题区域上方斜向飞行。在左侧添加一个大型风格化日文标题，采用金属银色和发光的蓝色字体，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="白竜の翼と青き記憶"}，字母中融入了装饰性的翅膀图案。在其下方，居左添加 2 行较小的日文副标题：{argument name="episode label" default="第１話"} 和 {argument name="episode subtitle" default="白銀の空隙"}。空中散落着几片发光的白色羽毛或花瓣。使用白色、银色和明亮天蓝色的冷色调，具有高度详细的线条、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、清晰的高光、空灵的灯光，以及高级轻小说封面或幻想动漫宣传海报的质感。

templates.title: 8-Panel Luxury Apartment Couple Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 8 宫格豪华公寓情侣拼贴画

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the couple base, place the same man and woman into a warm, luxurious modern high-rise apartment interior and generate an 8-cut collage storyboard focused on both the people and the interior design. Keep their relationship, approximate age, build, hairstyle, and all-white loungewear feeling consistent, but restage them naturally across the apartment at golden hour into evening. Use a cinematic lifestyle/architectural photography look with soft amber lighting, large floor-to-ceiling windows, expansive city skyline views, beige and wood-toned furnishings, and a calm upscale mood. Arrange the collage as 8 equal panels in a clean grid with thin white dividers. Include exactly these 8 scenes: 1) the couple cooking together at the kitchen island, 2) the couple seen from behind sitting on the sofa watching TV at night, 3) the couple sitting together on the sofa in daylight, 4) the couple standing together from behind looking out the window at sunset, 5) an empty wide shot of the living room and dining area with skyline view, 6) the woman sitting alone on the sofa near the kitchen, 7) the couple talking near the kitchen island, 8) an empty sunset wide shot of the living room with sofa, dining counter, TV wall, and skyline. Prioritize interior styling and spatial continuity, with magazine-like composition and realistic photo textures.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 中的情侣为基础，将同一对男女置于温暖、奢华的现代高层公寓室内，生成一个聚焦于人物与室内设计的 8 宫格拼贴故事板。保持他们的关系、大致年龄、体型、发型以及全白休闲装的风格一致，但在公寓的不同区域自然地呈现从黄金时刻到夜晚的场景。采用电影感生活方式/建筑摄影风格，运用柔和的琥珀色灯光、大型落地窗、广阔的城市天际线景观、米色和木色调家具，营造宁静高端的氛围。将拼贴画排列为 8 个等大的方格，并带有细白边分隔。包含以下 8 个精确场景：1) 情侣在厨房岛台一起做饭，2) 夜晚从背后拍摄情侣坐在沙发上看电视，3) 日光下情侣并肩坐在沙发上，4) 日落时分从背后拍摄情侣站在窗前眺望，5) 客厅和用餐区的空镜广角，展现天际线景观，6) 女士独自坐在靠近厨房的沙发上，7) 情侣在厨房岛台旁交谈，8) 日落时分客厅的空镜广角，包含沙发、餐台、电视墙和天际线。优先考虑室内设计风格和空间连续性，呈现杂志般的构图和写实的照片质感。

templates.title: Manga Dog Kick at Sunset Park

titleLocalized.zh: 日落公园里的“踢屎”杰克罗素梗犬漫画

templates.prompt: A two-panel Japanese manga page in a dramatic, semi-realistic black-and-white ink style with warm sepia sunset tones. The setting is a public park at dusk with 1 wooden bench on the far left, 4 glowing lampposts, leafy trees, a dirt walking path, distant city buildings, and a small playground with slides in the background. In the top panel, a small Jack Russell Terrier stands left of center on a leash, just after pooping on the ground; there is 1 small poop pile near its hind legs with comic emphasis marks. The dog has a white coat with dark patches, a collar and leash, eyes squeezed shut, and a mischievous, satisfied expression while one hind leg is lifted and the tail is wagging, suggesting the start of a backward kick. To the right, a young woman with shoulder-length wavy hair crouches while holding an open plastic poop bag in one hand and the leash loop in the other. She wears a cable-knit cardigan, a long floral dress with a ribbon at the collar, and low heels. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur. A large speech balloon in the upper right contains vertical Japanese text: 「よしよし。…さて、ササっと片付けて帰ろっか。」. In the bottom panel, create a sudden close-up action moment: the dog, now on the left side in a low aggressive stance, glares intensely with sharply angled brows, one sweat drop, and puffs of breath from its nose, as if bracing and kicking dirt backward with force. Explosive speed lines radiate across the frame, and a cloud of sand and grit bursts toward the crouching woman on the right. The woman recoils slightly, still holding the bag, with a shocked thought balloon near her head containing vertical Japanese text: 「あ、まずい……」. Next to the dog, place a jagged impact shout balloon with large Japanese text: 「フンッ！」. Emphasize the absurd humor and motion, with detailed fur, textured ground, dynamic debris, expressive manga screentones, bold panel borders, and cinematic action-comedy timing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅两格日本漫画风格的页面，采用戏剧性的半写实黑白水墨画风，并带有温暖的深褐色日落色调。背景是黄昏时的公共公园，最左侧有一张木长椅，配有 4 盏发光的街灯、茂密的树木、一条泥土小径、远处的城市建筑，以及背景中一个带有 Slides 的小型游乐场。在上方分格中，一只杰克罗素梗犬站在画面中左侧，系着牵引绳，刚在地上排完便；它后腿附近有一小堆粪便，并带有漫画式的强调符号。这只狗有着白底深色斑点的毛发，戴着项圈和牵引绳，双眼紧闭，表情顽皮且满足，一条后腿抬起，尾巴摇动，暗示着即将开始向后踢土。在右侧，一位留着齐肩卷发的年轻女性蹲着，一只手拿着打开的塑料拾便袋，另一只手拿着牵引绳环。她穿着麻花针织开衫，搭配饰有领口丝带的长款碎花连衣裙，脚踩低跟鞋。她的脸部被一个柔和的矩形模糊处理。右上角有一个巨大的对话气泡，内含竖排日语文字：「よしよし。…さて、ササっと片付けて帰ろっか。」。在下方分格中，营造一个突如其来的特写动作瞬间：这只狗现在位于左侧，呈现出低姿态的攻击性站位，眉头紧锁，眼神犀利，带有一滴汗珠，鼻孔喷出气流，仿佛正在用力支撑并向后踢土。爆炸性的速度线辐射整个画面，一团沙砾尘土向右侧蹲着的女性喷涌而去。女性微微后仰，手中仍拿着拾便袋，头顶附近有一个震惊的内心独白气泡，内含竖排日语文字：「あ、まずい……」。在狗的旁边，放置一个锯齿状的冲击音效气泡，内含巨大的日语文字：「フンッ！」。强调荒诞的幽默感与动感，细节刻画包括细腻的毛发、有质感的地面、动态的碎片、富有表现力的漫画网点纸、粗犷的分格边框，以及电影般的动作喜剧节奏。

templates.prompt: A moody, cinematic anime-style scene of a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="silver"} chin-length bob hair, sitting in a dim flower-filled room at night during heavy rain. She is draped languidly across a wooden table and a stacked old wooden chest, with one arm hanging down loosely and her posture conveying exhaustion, melancholy, or dreamy stillness. She wears a pale {argument name="dress color" default="light sage green"} off-shoulder Victorian-inspired dress with ruffled sleeves, a fitted bodice, a full ankle-length skirt, white trim, a short white apron-like bustle at the back, and 2 large dark teal ribbon bows, one at the waist and one near the back. She wears black Mary Jane heels. The setting is an indoor conservatory or flower shop with a full wall of tall windowpanes behind her; rain droplets cover the glass, and blurred city lights glow outside in the night. Add 2 strong starburst light flares through the window on the right side, plus scattered reflections on the wet floor. The room contains abundant floral arrangements and loose flowers, with dark red, pink, and cream blossoms placed in shadowy clusters around the left, right, and foreground edges. The floor is glossy and wet, covered with scattered rose petals and puddle-like reflections. The table and chest are damp and glistening, enhancing the rain-soaked atmosphere. Composition is full-body, slightly angled from the front-left, with the character centered-right in frame. Lighting is low-key and dramatic, with bright backlight from the window, soft rim light on the dress and hair, deep shadows, and sparkling highlights on raindrops, petals, and wet surfaces. Highly detailed, realistic fabric folds, reflective water, romantic gothic ambience, elegant but slightly cluttered scene, ultra-detailed digital illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅充满忧郁电影感的动漫风格场景，描绘了一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银色"} 下巴长度波波头的年轻女性，在深夜大雨中坐在昏暗且铺满花朵的房间里。她慵懒地斜倚在一张木桌和一叠旧木箱上，一只手臂无力地垂下，姿态流露出疲惫、忧郁或梦幻般的静谧感。她穿着一件浅 {argument name="dress color" default="浅鼠尾草绿"} 色的维多利亚风格露肩连衣裙，配有荷叶边袖子、修身紧身胸衣、及踝长裙、白色饰边，背部饰有短小的白色围裙式裙撑，以及 2 个深青色大蝴蝶结（分别位于腰部和背部附近）。她穿着黑色玛丽珍鞋。场景设定在一个室内温室或花店，她身后是一整面高大的窗户；玻璃上布满雨滴，窗外模糊的城市灯光在夜色中闪烁。在右侧窗户处增加 2 处强烈的星芒光晕，并在湿润的地面上增加零星的倒影。房间里摆满了丰富的花艺布置和散落的花朵，深红色、粉色和奶油色的花簇分布在左侧、右侧和前景边缘的阴影中。地面光亮潮湿，铺满了散落的玫瑰花瓣和水洼般的倒影。桌子和木箱湿润且闪烁着光泽，增强了雨水浸润的氛围。构图为全身像，从左前方略微倾斜，角色位于画面中右侧。光线低调且富有戏剧性，窗户透出明亮的逆光，裙子和头发上有柔和的轮廓光，阴影深邃，雨滴、花瓣和湿润表面上有闪烁的高光。高度细节化，真实的织物褶皱，反光的水面，浪漫的哥特氛围，优雅但略显凌乱的场景，超精细数字插画。

templates.title: AI Headshot App Store Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: AI 职业照应用 App Store 宣传海报

templates.prompt: Create a polished App Store promotional poster for an AI headshot app called {argument name="app name" default="Shine"}, in a warm minimalist brand style. Use a vertical smartphone screenshot ad layout on a soft beige background with a curved golden-yellow shape rising from the bottom edge. Place a large elegant black serif headline in the upper left, split across 3 lines, reading {argument name="headline text" default="Create pro headshots with Shine"}. Add a white jagged starburst badge to the left-center with black serif text reading {argument name="badge text" default="Before + After"}. On the right side, show a large angled modern smartphone mockup, slightly tilted left, with thin metallic edges and a realistic screen. The phone display should show the app interface for AI-generated professional headshots. At the top of the screen, include a small wordmark reading SHINE, a large serif subheadline saying "Your best self, professionally.", supporting body text saying "Upload a few photos and we’ll create studio-quality headshots.", a small rounded pill in the upper right that says "⚡ 8 credits", and an iPhone-style status bar showing 9:41. In the middle of the phone screen, show a before-and-after comparison card with 2 portrait panels side by side, each labeled exactly once: 1 left label "Before" and 1 right label "After". The left portrait is a casual man in a dark T-shirt against a plain indoor background; the right portrait is the same man transformed into a professional headshot wearing a dark blazer over a light shirt with a warm studio bokeh background. Put a circular swap arrow button centered between the 2 panels. Below that, include a "HOW IT WORKS" section with exactly 3 steps arranged vertically: 1) "1. Upload" with the text "Add 8–12 clear photos of yourself.", 2) "2. We create" with the text "Our AI generates a variety of pro headshots.", 3) "3. Download" with the text "Choose your favorites and download high-res images." Give each step a rounded square pastel icon tile in peach or pink tones. Near the bottom of the phone screen, add a large rounded yellow CTA button reading {argument name="button text" default="Start Shine ✦"}, and beneath it small text saying "8 credits per session". In the lower left foreground, place a cute stylized white mascot character with a rounded body, tiny arms, blush cheeks, dot eyes, and a smiling mouth, wearing a golden-yellow cowboy hat and matching neckerchief; the oversized hat should extend toward the center and overlap the base area in front of the phone. Use soft 3D illustration for the mascot, premium UI design for the phone screen, consistent beige-and-gold branding, subtle shadows, clean spacing, and a refined startup-marketing aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一款名为 {argument name="app name" default="Shine"} 的 AI 职业照应用制作一张精致的 App Store 宣传海报，采用温暖简约的品牌风格。使用垂直手机截图广告布局，背景为柔和的米色，底部边缘有向上延伸的弧形金黄色形状。在左上方放置一个优雅的大号黑色衬线体标题，分为 3 行，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="用 Shine 打造专业职业照"}。在左侧中心添加一个白色锯齿状星形徽章，内含黑色衬线体文字 {argument name="badge text" default="Before + After"}。在右侧，展示一个大型倾斜的现代智能手机模型，向左微倾，带有纤细的金属边框和逼真的屏幕。手机屏幕应显示 AI 生成专业职业照的应用界面。屏幕顶部包含一个小型的 SHINE 字标，一行大号衬线体副标题“展现最专业的你。”，以及辅助正文“上传几张照片，我们将为您生成影棚级职业照。”，右上角有一个小型的圆角胶囊按钮，显示“⚡ 8 积分”，以及显示 9:41 的 iPhone 风格状态栏。在手机屏幕中间，展示一张前后对比卡片，并排两个肖像面板，每个面板各标注一次：左侧标签为“Before”，右侧标签为“After”。左侧肖像是一位穿着深色 T 恤、背景为普通室内的休闲男士；右侧肖像则是同一位男士变身为穿着深色西装外套搭配浅色衬衫、背景为温暖影棚虚化效果的专业职业照。在两个面板之间居中放置一个圆形切换箭头按钮。在下方，包含一个“HOW IT WORKS”部分，垂直排列 3 个步骤：1) “1. Upload”，文字为“上传 8–12 张清晰的个人照片。”，2) “2. We create”，文字为“我们的 AI 将生成多种专业职业照。”，3) “3. Download”，文字为“选择您最喜欢的照片并下载高清图像。”为每个步骤配上桃色或粉色调的圆角方形图标。在手机屏幕底部附近，添加一个大型圆角黄色 CTA 按钮，文字为 {argument name="button text" default="开始 Shine ✦"}，下方小字显示“每场次 8 积分”。在左下角前景处，放置一个可爱的风格化白色吉祥物，身体圆润，手臂短小，脸颊红润，眼睛呈点状，嘴巴微笑着，戴着一顶金黄色牛仔帽和配套的领巾；超大的帽子应向中心延伸，并覆盖在手机前方的底部区域。吉祥物采用柔和的 3D 插画风格，手机屏幕采用高级 UI 设计，保持米色与金色的品牌一致性，辅以细腻的阴影、整洁的间距以及精致的初创公司营销美学。

templates.title: AI Model Router App Store Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: AI 模型路由应用商店截图

templates.prompt: Create a polished App Store promotional screenshot in a warm beige and golden-orange brand palette, portrait orientation, with a premium friendly startup aesthetic. The layout is a single vertically composed marketing graphic with a soft cream background and an orange gradient floor at the bottom. On the left upper side, place a very large elegant black serif headline split across 3 lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="Powered by leading AI models"}. To the right of the headline, add a small white jagged starburst badge with a subtle drop shadow containing 2 lines of serif text: {argument name="badge text" default="Best models"}. Beneath the headline on the left, show a vertical list of exactly 4 AI providers with icon plus name, evenly spaced: Claude with an orange sunburst icon, Gemini with a multicolor four-point sparkle icon, OpenAI with a black knot logo, and Seedance with a purple-blue gradient S icon. Below that, add a left-aligned serif body copy block with 2 parts: first a black text list on 4 lines reading "Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Seedance.", then a final brand-colored orange line reading {argument name="tagline text" default="Empowered by Merl."}. On the right half, place a large realistic modern smartphone angled slightly left, with a reflective silver frame, black screen border, dynamic-island style top cutout, visible side button, and soft shadow. The phone screen should show a clean cream-colored app UI for an AI model-routing app. At the very top of the phone display, include the status time 9:41 and standard signal, wifi, and battery icons. Inside the app, show a tiny greeting line "HEY BESTIE.", then a bold serif question title {argument name="screen title" default="What are we casting?"}, followed by a short sans-serif subtitle about routing the request to the best AI model for the job. Add a small rounded badge in the upper right of the app content reading "+ 8 credits". Below that, include a section label "The model stack" and a stack of exactly 4 rounded cards, each in a lightly tinted pastel background. Card 1: Claude, with orange sunburst icon, description "writing, reasoning, voice-matched outputs", and a small pill label "BEST FOR WRITING". Card 2: Gemini, with multicolor sparkle icon, description "image generation, research, visual tasks", and pill label "BEST FOR IMAGES". Card 3: OpenAI, with black knot icon, description "headshots, image generation, smart creation", and pill label "BEST FOR CREATION". Card 4: Seedance, with purple-blue gradient S icon, description "video generation, motion, AI UGC clips", and pill label "BEST FOR VIDEO". Under the cards, place a large rounded yellow-orange CTA button reading "Start Casting ✦", with a small line below saying "8 credits per session". At the bottom of the phone UI, create a black tab bar with exactly 4 navigation items: home icon, a selected center pill with a small mascot face and the label {argument name="app name" default="Merl"}, a clock/history icon, and a profile icon. In front of the lower left of the phone, place a cute 3D mascot character: a rounded cream-colored blob with tiny feet, dark brown dot eyes, rosy cheeks, and a smiling mouth, wearing a golden wizard hat and matching cape tied with a round clasp. The mascot should overlap the phone slightly and sit on the orange floor, casting a soft shadow. Overall style: luxury-friendly tech branding, crisp typography, subtle realism, soft shadows, clean app mockup, App Store screenshot quality, consistent visual branding, highly legible, high resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个精致的 App Store 宣传截图，采用暖米色和金橙色的品牌色调，纵向构图，呈现高端且友好的初创公司美学。布局为单张垂直构图的营销图形，背景为柔和的奶油色，底部带有橙色渐变地面。在左上方，放置一个非常醒目且优雅的黑色衬线字体标题，分 3 行显示：{argument name="headline text" default="由领先的 AI 模型驱动"}。在标题右侧，添加一个带有细微投影的白色锯齿状星形徽章，内含 2 行衬线文字：{argument name="badge text" default="最佳模型"}。在左侧标题下方，展示一个包含 4 个 AI 服务商的垂直列表，图标加名称，间距均匀：Claude（橙色太阳光芒图标）、Gemini（多色四角星光图标）、OpenAI（黑色结状图标）以及 Seedance（紫蓝色渐变 S 图标）。在其下方，添加一个左对齐的衬线字体正文块，分为两部分：首先是 4 行黑色文本列表，内容为“Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Seedance.”，然后是最后一行品牌色橙色文本：{argument name="tagline text" default="由 Merl 提供支持。"}。在右半部分，放置一部稍微向左倾斜的逼真现代智能手机，带有反光银色边框、黑色屏幕边框、灵动岛风格顶部切口、可见的侧边按钮以及柔和的阴影。手机屏幕应显示一个简洁的奶油色 AI 模型路由应用 UI。在手机屏幕最顶部，包含 9:41 的时间显示以及标准的信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标。在应用内部，显示一行简短的问候语“HEY BESTIE.”，接着是一个粗体衬线字体的问题标题 {argument name="screen title" default="我们要投射什么？"}，随后是一个关于将请求路由至最适合任务的 AI 模型的短小无衬线副标题。在应用内容右上角添加一个小的圆角徽章，显示“+ 8 积分”。在下方，包含一个名为“模型堆栈”的区域标签，以及一叠 4 张圆角卡片，每张卡片都有淡淡的柔和背景色。卡片 1：Claude，带有橙色太阳光芒图标，描述为“写作、推理、语音匹配输出”，并带有小药丸形状标签“最适合写作”。卡片 2：Gemini，带有彩色星光图标，描述为“图像生成、研究、视觉任务”，并带有标签“最适合图像”。卡片 3：OpenAI，带有黑色结状图标，描述为“头像、图像生成、智能创作”，并带有标签“最适合创作”。卡片 4：Seedance，带有紫蓝色渐变 S 图标，描述为“视频生成、动态、AI UGC 短片”，并带有标签“最适合视频”。在卡片下方，放置一个大的圆角黄橙色 CTA 按钮，文字为“开始投射 ✦”，下方有一行小字写着“每场会话 8 积分”。在手机 UI 底部，创建一个黑色标签栏，包含 4 个导航项：主页图标、一个选中的中心药丸形状图标（带有一个小吉祥物脸部和标签 {argument name="app name" default="Merl"}）、时钟/历史记录图标以及个人资料图标。在手机左下方的前方，放置一个可爱的 3D 吉祥物角色：一个圆润的奶油色小球，有小脚、深棕色圆点眼睛、红润的脸颊和微笑的嘴巴，戴着金色的巫师帽，披着同色系的斗篷，斗篷由一个圆形扣环系住。吉祥物应稍微遮挡手机，并坐在橙色地面上，投下柔和的阴影。整体风格：高端友好的科技品牌感、清晰的排版、细腻的写实感、柔和的阴影、简洁的应用模型、App Store 截图质量、一致的视觉品牌形象、高度可读、高分辨率。

templates.title: Minimal AI Lock-In Comparison Slide

titleLocalized.zh: 极简 AI 锁定对比 Slides

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A minimalist editorial presentation slide in 16:9 format with a warm light-gray paper background, lots of negative space, refined Swiss-style grid layout, and high-end PPT/keynote design aesthetics. The slide is a comparison page about lock-in, using elegant Chinese typography mixed with tiny English navigation text. At the top left, place two small uppercase English breadcrumb lines: “COMPARISON · LOCK-IN” and below it “CLOSED VS OPEN”, in a thin sans-serif with wide tracking. At the top right, place the page indicator “04 / 08”. Center-left across the upper half, add a very large bold black Chinese headline: “真正的锁定，不是模型，是记忆。” On the left half below the headline, create a three-row comparison list separated by thin horizontal gray rules. Row 1 has the bold Chinese label “轻度风险” on the left, with the explanatory sentence “状态存在服务端，换模型后无法恢复线程。” to its right, and a tiny uppercase English keyword aligned far right: “STATE”. Row 2 has the bold label “中度风险”, with the sentence “闭源 harness 的记忆形态不可见,难以迁移。” and the far-right keyword “SHAPE”. Row 3 has the bold label “最高风险”, with the sentence “整个 harness 和长期记忆都在 API 后面。” and the far-right keyword “LOCK-IN”. On the right side of the slide, place a small inset comparison diagram card with a white background and subtle border, containing 2 side-by-side system architecture panels. The left panel represents a closed system in dark gray and muted red accents; the right panel represents an open system in deep blue accents. Each panel should have 5 small top icon tabs, a central highlighted harness block, several stacked rounded rectangular modules below, and a bottom row of 4 small capability icons with short Chinese labels. Keep the inset detailed but small, so it reads as a supporting visual rather than the main focus. At the bottom left, add tiny light-gray Chinese footer text: “布局测试 · 顶部标题 + 下方两段式内容”. At the bottom right, place a small page number “04”. Centered near the bottom edge, add a carousel indicator with exactly 7 small dots, where the 4th dot is a short dark rounded pill indicating the active slide and the other 6 dots are pale gray circles. Also add tiny faint navigation hints at the lower right edge reading “← → 翻页   ESC 关闭”. Use crisp vector text rendering, understated contrast, elegant spacing, and a calm premium infographic style suitable for a business presentation about AI platform comparison and API memory lock-in.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 16:9 比例的极简主义编辑风格演示 Slides，采用暖浅灰色纸张背景，留白充裕，布局遵循精致的瑞士风格网格，具备高端 PPT/Keynote 设计美感。该 Slides 为关于“锁定”的对比页面，使用优雅的中文排版并混合微小的英文导航文本。左上角放置两行小型大写英文面包屑导航：“COMPARISON · LOCK-IN”及下方的“CLOSED VS OPEN”，使用字间距较宽的细体无衬线字体。右上角放置页码指示器“04 / 08”。在上半部分居中偏左处，添加一行超大号加粗黑色中文字体标题：“真正的锁定，不是模型，是记忆。”在标题下方的左侧区域，创建三行对比列表，行间以细横线分隔。第一行左侧为加粗中文标签“轻度风险”，右侧为解释说明“状态存在服务端，换模型后无法恢复线程。”，最右侧对齐一个微小的大写英文关键词：“STATE”。第二行左侧为加粗标签“中度风险”，右侧为说明“闭源 harness 的记忆形态不可见，难以迁移。”，最右侧关键词为“SHAPE”。第三行左侧为加粗标签“最高风险”，右侧为说明“整个 harness 和长期记忆都在 API 后面。”，最右侧关键词为“LOCK-IN”。在 Slides 右侧放置一张小型嵌入式对比图表卡片，背景为白色，带有细微边框，包含两个并排的系统架构面板。左侧面板代表封闭系统，采用深灰色和柔和的红色点缀；右侧面板代表开放系统，采用深蓝色点缀。每个面板顶部应有 5 个小型图标标签，中央有一个高亮的 harness 模块，下方堆叠多个圆角矩形模块，底部一行有 4 个带有简短中文标签的小型能力图标。保持嵌入图细节丰富但尺寸较小，使其作为辅助视觉元素而非视觉重心。左下角添加微小的浅灰色中文页脚文本：“布局测试 · 顶部标题 + 下方两段式内容”。右下角放置小型页码“04”。底部边缘居中处添加一个轮播指示器，包含 7 个小圆点，其中第 4 个圆点为短深色圆角胶囊状，表示当前页面，其余 6 个为浅灰色圆点。在右下角边缘添加微弱的导航提示：“← → 翻页   ESC 关闭”。使用清晰的矢量文本渲染、低调的对比度、优雅的间距，以及适合 AI 平台对比与 API 记忆锁定商业演示的冷静高端信息图表风格。

templates.title: Cinematic Memory Loss PPT Slide

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感“记忆缺失”主题 Slides

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist cinematic presentation slide on a deep black background in a premium editorial PPT style, widescreen 16:9. The layout is asymmetrical, with a large text block on the left and one documentary-style photo on the upper right, leaving generous negative space. Use elegant high-contrast Chinese typography with an upscale magazine feel. At the top left, place small uppercase microtext reading "PHOTO • HUMAN STORY". Slightly below it, add another small uppercase line reading "MEMORY HAS WEIGHT". The main headline on the left is very large, bold, white Chinese serif text across 2 lines: {argument name="headline text" default="被删除的不是助手，\n是熟悉感。"}. Beneath it, place a smaller Chinese paragraph in white or light gray, 2 lines, reading: {argument name="body text" default="文章里的邮件助手故事很有力量：同一个模板可以重建，但语气、\n偏好、隐性规则，都要重新教一遍。"}. Below that, add a dark translucent quote box with a thin vertical white line at its left edge; inside, include 2 text levels: the quote in Chinese, {argument name="quote" default="没有记忆,agent 很容易被复制;有了记忆,体验才开始变得专属。"}, and a smaller attribution line reading "配图类型 · 人文纪实照片". On the right, insert a single warm-toned humanistic documentary photo: 1 adult person seen from behind, seated at a desk in a dim office, looking at a computer monitor; a desk lamp stands to the left of the monitor, papers are pinned on the wall, and soft daylight comes through a window. The monitor displays a simple white interface with the centered English message {argument name="screen text" default="Your conversational Assistant has been deleted."}. The photo should feel like film photography, muted browns and grays, intimate, reflective, and slightly melancholic. Add small interface-like pagination details: top right "05 / 08", bottom left microtext "PHOTOGRAPHIC ANCHOR · MEMORY LOSS STORY", bottom right small "05", and at the bottom center 8 tiny pagination dots with the 5th dot highlighted as an elongated white pill while the others are dim gray circles. In the extreme bottom right corner, add tiny navigation hints "← → 翻页 · ESC 关闭". Overall mood: editorial, restrained, cinematic, memory and loss, premium keynote slide design, clean spacing, precise alignment, high-end storytelling presentation aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个极简主义电影感演示 Slides，采用深黑色背景和高端编辑风格 PPT 排版，比例为 16:9 宽屏。布局采用非对称设计，左侧为大面积文本块，右上角放置一张纪实风格照片，留出充裕的负空间。使用优雅且高对比度的中文字体，营造出高端杂志的质感。在左上角放置一行小型大写微型文字：“PHOTO • HUMAN STORY”。在其下方，添加另一行小型大写文字：“MEMORY HAS WEIGHT”。左侧的主标题为非常醒目的白色粗体中文字体，分为两行：{argument name="headline text" default="被删除的不是助手，\n是熟悉感。"}。在标题下方，放置一段较小的白色或浅灰色中文段落，共两行：{argument name="body text" default="文章里的邮件助手故事很有力量：同一个模板可以重建，但语气、\n偏好、隐性规则，都要重新教一遍。"}。下方添加一个深色半透明引用框，左侧边缘带有一条细长的白色垂直线；框内包含两层文本：中文引用内容 {argument name="quote" default="没有记忆, Agent 很容易被复制; 有了记忆, 体验才开始变得专属。"}，以及一行较小的署名文字“配图类型 · 人文纪实照片”。在右侧，插入一张暖色调的人文纪实照片：一名成年人背对镜头，坐在昏暗的办公室书桌前看着电脑显示器；显示器左侧立着一盏台灯，墙上贴着文件，柔和的日光透过窗户洒入。显示器屏幕上显示着简洁的白色界面，居中文字为 {argument name="screen text" default="Your conversational Assistant has been deleted."}。照片应呈现胶片摄影质感，色调为柔和的棕色和灰色，氛围私密、深沉且略带忧郁。添加类似界面的分页细节：右上角显示“05 / 08”，左下角微型文字“PHOTOGRAPHIC ANCHOR · MEMORY LOSS STORY”，右下角小字“05”，底部中心放置 8 个微小的分页圆点，其中第 5 个圆点高亮显示为细长的白色胶囊状，其余为暗灰色圆点。在最右下角，添加微小的导航提示“← → 翻页 · ESC 关闭”。整体氛围：编辑风格、克制、电影感、记忆与缺失、高端 Keynote 幻灯片设计、简洁的间距、精准的对齐、高端叙事演示美学。
