templates.title: Dark AI Product Keynote Slide

titleLocalized.zh: 深色系 AI 产品演示文稿 Slides

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A premium dark presentation slide in a minimalist editorial tech style, widescreen 16:9 layout, matte black background with refined off-white typography and subtle gray divider lines. The overall mood is sleek, cinematic, and high-end, like a product keynote or design-forward AI startup deck. In the top left, place 2 small navigation lines of text: "UI SCENE · OPEN HARNESS" and below it "DEEP AGENTS" in thin uppercase sans serif with generous tracking. In the top right, add a small page indicator reading "07 / 08". The main headline dominates the upper left in large elegant serif Chinese and English mixed typography: {argument name="headline text" default="开放 harness,开放记忆。"}. Below it, add a 2-line Chinese body paragraph in smaller serif text: {argument name="body text" default="解决方案不是让模型供应商替你保管状态,而是把 harness、标准和记忆后端都放回开发者手里。"}. In the left-middle area, create 3 horizontal feature rows separated by thin gray lines, each row using a bold Chinese label on the left, a short Chinese description in the center, and a tiny uppercase English keyword aligned right. Row 1 label: "标准", description: "agents.md / skills 让上下文入口可见。", keyword: "OPEN". Row 2 label: "模型", description: "模型可替换,记忆不应被单一平台绑定。", keyword: "AGNOSTIC". Row 3 label: "存储", description: "Mongo / Postgres / Redis 可作为自有记忆后端。", keyword: "OWNED". On the right side, place a large embedded UI mockup inside a soft light-gray rounded rectangular frame with a subtle shadow, resembling a product dashboard screenshot. The mockup should be monochrome light beige and gray, highly structured, and divided into 3 main columns. Left column: a narrow vertical icon sidebar plus a project/file panel listing items such as "agents.md", "skills", "workflows", "memories", "tools", and a code editor block at the bottom. Center column: a section titled "模型无关" with 4 selectable model rows and small controls, plus 3 feature cards along the bottom. Right column: a section titled "记忆后端" with 3 database cards for MongoDB, Postgres, and Redis, and a lower panel titled "可迁移" showing a code snippet. Include another top card in the mockup titled "开放标准" with tab-like controls. At the bottom left outside the mockup, add a tiny caption line in Chinese and English reading "UI 情景图 · 三张同高画面板测试". At the bottom center, include a carousel indicator made of 8 small dots with the 7th highlighted as a short white pill and the others as dim gray circles. At the bottom right, place a small page number "07". Also add a faint tiny footer note near the lower right edge in Chinese and English, very subtle, such as a presentation metadata line. Use precise grid alignment, lots of negative space, understated luxury, Swiss-style composition, and a polished AI-product keynote aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用极简主义编辑科技风格的高级深色演示幻灯片，16:9 宽屏布局，哑光黑色背景，配以精致的灰白色排版和微妙的灰色分割线。整体氛围时尚、具有电影感且高端，类似于产品发布会或设计感十足的 AI 初创公司演示文稿。在左上角放置两行小型导航文字：“UI SCENE · OPEN HARNESS”，下方为“DEEP AGENTS”，采用纤细的大写无衬线字体，并带有宽阔的字间距。在右上角添加一个小型页面指示器，显示“07 / 08”。主标题占据左上方，采用优雅的大号衬线中英文混合排版：{argument name="headline text" default="开放 harness,开放记忆。"}。在其下方，添加一段 2 行的中文正文，使用较小的衬线字体：{argument name="body text" default="解决方案不是让模型供应商替你保管状态,而是把 harness、标准和记忆后端都放回开发者手里。"}。在左中部区域，创建 3 行由细灰线分隔的水平功能行，每行左侧使用加粗的中文标签，中间为简短的中文描述，右侧对齐一个微小的大写英文关键词。第 1 行标签：“标准”，描述：“agents.md / skills 让上下文入口可见。”，关键词：“OPEN”。第 2 行标签：“模型”，描述：“模型可替换,记忆不应被单一平台绑定。”，关键词：“AGNOSTIC”。第 3 行标签：“存储”，描述：“Mongo / Postgres / Redis 可作为自有记忆后端。”，关键词：“OWNED”。在右侧，将一个大型嵌入式 UI 模型放置在带有微妙阴影的浅灰色圆角矩形框内，类似于产品项目仪表板的截图。模型应为单色浅米色和灰色，结构严谨，分为 3 个主要列。左列：一个狭窄的垂直图标侧边栏，加上一个列出“agents.md”、“skills”、“workflows”、“memories”、“tools”等项目/文件的面板，底部为一个代码编辑器块。中列：一个标题为“模型无关”的部分，包含 4 行可选模型和小型控件，底部有 3 张功能卡片。右列：一个标题为“记忆后端”的部分，包含 MongoDB、Postgres 和 Redis 的 3 张数据库卡片，以及底部一个标题为“可迁移”的面板，显示一段代码片段。在模型中包含另一张顶部卡片，标题为“开放标准”，带有类似标签页的控件。在模型外部的左下角，添加一行微小的中英文说明文字：“UI 情景图 · 三张同高画面板测试”。在底部中心，包含一个由 8 个小圆点组成的轮播指示器，第 7 个点高亮显示为短白色胶囊状，其余为暗灰色圆圈。在右下角放置一个小页码“07”。此外，在右下边缘附近添加一行微弱的微小页脚注释（中英文），非常隐蔽，例如演示元数据行。使用精确的网格对齐、大量的留白、低调的奢华感、瑞士风格的构图以及精致的 Image Prompt Gallery AI 产品主题演讲美学。

"rel=\"stylesheet\">". The center box is a rounded white code panel with a green tab label reading "CSS". Inside, display dark text exactly as: "body {"

Kiwi Maru" in a cute rounded handwritten-style font. Add 2 small sparkle accents to the right of this browser window.

At the bottom, place 4 pill-shaped badges from left to right. Badge 1 is white with a small blue star icon and text "Google Fontsを使うメリット". Badge 2 is pale blue with bold text "無料" followed by a pink heart. Badge 3 is pale green with bold text "すぐ使える" followed by a small clock icon. Badge 4 is pale yellow with bold text "日本語フォントも豊富" followed by a flower icon.

Add 4 extra decorative elements around the canvas: a yellow 3-stroke sparkle near the top left of the headline, a pale blue dotted square grid in the upper left background, a thin light green ring on the left side, and a tiny smiling potted plant illustration in the lower left corner. Keep the whole composition flat vector-like, crisp, cute, and highly legible, in a social-media educational carousel style.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个可爱的柔和日系信息图 Slides，背景为干净的白色，配有淡蓝色、奶油色和浅绿色的柔和圆角抽象色块。设计风格友好、具有教育意义且现代，采用粗圆体日文排版、微妙的投影、细灰色轮廓、虚线分隔符以及小巧的装饰性涂鸦。在顶部中心，放置一个深海军蓝色的醒目大标题，内容为“Google Fontsの使い方”。在其正下方，添加一个蓝色的副标题，内容为“3ステップでかんたん導入”，两侧配有一排蓝色小圆点。在右上角，添加一个圆形的蓝色页面徽章，写着“2/2”。

在上部中间一行排列 3 张圆角矩形步骤卡片，从左到右均匀分布，每张卡片都有淡色背景、柔和边框，并在左上角有一个带数字的彩色圆形徽章。卡片 1 背景为淡蓝色，蓝色徽章内写有“1”。内部展示一个简单的放大镜图标覆盖在“Aa”字母上，并配有一个黄色小星星装饰。粗体标题为“フォントを選ぶ”，下方较小的文字为“Google Fontsで
好きなフォントを探す”。卡片 2 背景为淡绿色，绿色徽章内写有“2”。内部展示一个浏览器窗口图标，包含代码括号“</>”和剪贴板，并配有绿色小动效标记。粗体标题为“コードをコピー”，下方较小的文字为“linkタグや@importを
取得する”。卡片 3 背景为淡奶油色，橙色徽章内写有“3”。内部展示一个标有“CSS”的文档图标，并配有橙色小装饰标记。粗体标题为“CSSで指定”，下方较小的文字为“font-family に設定して
使う”。在 3 张卡片之间放置 2 个中等大小的蓝色三角形箭头以展示流程。

在下部中间，创建 3 个水平对齐的演示框。左侧框是一个圆角白色代码面板，带有一个写着“HTML”的蓝色小标签。内部以蓝色文字显示以下代码，严格分为 3 行：“<link href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/"
"css2?family=Kiwi+Maru&display=swap"
"rel=\"stylesheet\">”。中间框是一个圆角白色代码面板，带有一个写着“CSS”的绿色小标签。内部以深色文字显示：“body {"
"    font-family: 'Kiwi Maru', serif;"
"}”。右侧框是一个圆角白色模拟浏览器窗口，带有淡蓝色标题栏，左上角有 3 个红、黄、绿色的微型圆形窗口按钮。内部显示黑色的日文示例文本“こんにちは、
Kiwi Maru”，使用可爱的圆角手写体。在该浏览器窗口右侧添加 2 个小闪光装饰。

在底部，从左到右放置 4 个药丸形状的徽章。徽章 1 为白色，带有一个蓝色小星星图标和文字“Google Fontsを使うメリット”。徽章 2 为淡蓝色，带有粗体文字“無料”及一颗粉色爱心。徽章 3 为淡绿色，带有粗体文字“すぐ使える”及一个小闹钟图标。徽章 4 为淡黄色，带有粗体文字“日本語フォントも豊富”及一朵小花图标。

在画布周围添加 4 个额外的装饰元素：标题左上方的一个黄色三笔闪光，左上角背景的一个淡蓝色虚线方格网，左侧的一个细浅绿色圆环，以及左下角的一个微型微笑盆栽插图。保持整体构图为扁平矢量风格，清晰、可爱且高度易读，呈现出社交媒体教育轮播图的风格。

templates.prompt: A clean, cute Japanese infographic on a soft off-white background with rounded pastel abstract corner blobs and tiny decorative dots and rings, designed like a friendly web-design explainer poster. At the top center, place a large bold rounded headline in Japanese reading {argument name="headline text" default="Google Fontsってなに？"}, in very dark navy, with a small yellow accent mark near the first word. Directly below it, add a medium-size blue subheading reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="無料で使えるWebフォントサービス"}, with dotted divider lines extending left and right. In the middle, arrange exactly 3 rounded rectangular feature cards in a horizontal row, evenly spaced. Card 1 is pale blue with a blue number badge "1" in the upper left, an icon showing the multicolor Google G beside overlapping font sheets with "Aa", a bold Japanese title "Googleが提供するフォント集", and smaller text below "Webサイトやアプリ、資料づくりに使える". Card 2 is pale mint green with a green number badge "2", an icon of a pink piggy bank with a gold coin labeled "¥0" and small green motion marks, a bold title "無料で利用できる", and smaller text "個人でも企業でも使いやすい". Card 3 is pale warm cream with an orange number badge "3", an icon of a simple browser window with a globe, a bold title "Web上で読み込める", and smaller text "HTMLやCSSに追加してすぐ使える". Below the three cards, place a wide horizontal white code bar with rounded corners and a subtle outline; on the left include a pale blue circular icon containing </>, and to the right show a single line of code in a monospaced style: "<link href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/...\" rel=\"stylesheet\">" with the URL in blue. Under that, add a dashed rounded pill-shaped note box containing a blue star icon and Japanese text {argument name="example text" default="例：Kiwi Maru もGoogle Fontsで使えます"}. At the bottom left, place a tiny smiling potted plant illustration. At the bottom right, add a larger browser-style sample panel with a light blue title bar and three small traffic-light circles in the top left; inside, on the left, show bold Japanese sample copy "やさしい文字で、伝わるデザイン。" and smaller text "Kiwi Maru のサンプル", and on the right a rounded white inset card displaying large black Japanese characters "あア" with the font name {argument name="font sample name" default="Kiwi Maru"} beneath. Scatter 4 small sparkle/star accents around the lower right area. Use a flat vector illustration style, crisp outlines, soft pastel palette, centered composition, generous spacing, rounded sans-serif typography, and a cheerful beginner-friendly tech education aesthetic.

templates.title: Anime Pokémon Shop Outfit Teaser Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 Pokémon 商店服装预告海报

templates.prompt: A dreamy pastel anime fashion announcement poster set inside a bright Pokémon merchandise shop. The composition is vertical and split visually into two zones: a large translucent information panel on the left and a full-body character showcase on the right. The scene has a soft, elegant, airy atmosphere with diffused indoor lighting, creamy highlights, gentle reflections on the polished floor, and a refined shoujo illustration style. In the background, show a clearly recognizable Pokémon store interior with display shelves, the Pokémon logo sign, a large Poké Ball emblem on the wall, potted plants, plush toys, and figures; visible Pokémon merchandise includes exactly 3 prominent character plushies or mascots: Pikachu at the bottom right, plus 2 small shelf plushies resembling Piplup and another pastel blue-green character. The girl stands slightly right of center in a graceful fashion pose with one leg crossing in front of the other, one hand lightly raised near her chest, and the other relaxed outward. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair with loose curls and a delicate feminine look. She wears a refined pastel outfit: a frilled white high-neck blouse with layered ruffles, a light blue sleeveless pinafore-style dress with a fitted waist and a flowing mid-calf flared skirt, a small white crossbody purse with a flap, white ankle socks, and glossy black Mary Jane shoes. Add subtle pink earrings. The outfit should feel classy, fresh, and cute, with gentle fabric movement. On the left, place a frosted semi-transparent poster panel with elegant typography and decorative flourishes. Include exactly 5 text blocks or labeled areas on this panel: 1) a top banner with Japanese text "次回衣装プロンプト公開" above large cursive English text {argument name="headline text" default="Next Outfit"}; 2) a name block with Japanese text "セラス・柳田・リリエンフェルト" and smaller romanized text "Ceras Yanagida Lilienfeld"; 3) a teaser line reading "次回の衣装も お楽しみに！" with a small Poké Ball icon; 4) a bordered description box titled "Next Coordinate" followed by several lines of small Japanese body text; 5) a bottom ribbon reading {argument name="footer text" default="Coming Soon..."} and "STAY TUNED!" with a small Pikachu silhouette. Use pale blue, white, silver-gray, and blush pastel tones throughout. Add faint ornamental corner decorations and a polished promotional layout, like a boutique fashion teaser poster for a themed anime character outfit reveal.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的粉彩动漫时尚发布海报，场景设定在明亮的 Pokémon 商品店内。构图呈垂直状，视觉上分为两个区域：左侧是一个大型半透明信息面板，右侧是全身角色展示。场景氛围柔和、优雅且轻盈，带有漫射的室内光线、奶油色高光、抛光地板上的柔和倒影，以及精致的少女漫画插画风格。背景中展示清晰可辨的 Pokémon 商店内部，包括陈列架、Pokémon 标志、墙上的大型精灵球徽章、盆栽、毛绒玩具和手办；可见的 Pokémon 商品包括 3 个醒目的毛绒玩具或吉祥物：右下角的皮卡丘，以及架子上 2 个类似波加曼和其他粉蓝色调的小型毛绒玩具。女孩站在画面中心偏右的位置，摆出优雅的时尚姿势，一条腿交叉在另一条腿前，一只手轻轻抬起靠近胸前，另一只手自然向外放松。她的面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。她留着长长的波浪卷发，颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"}，发丝卷曲，外形精致柔美。她穿着一套精致的粉彩服装：带有层叠荷叶边的白色高领衬衫、浅蓝色无袖背带连衣裙（收腰设计，配有飘逸的中长款裙摆）、一个带有翻盖的小型白色斜挎包、白色短袜和亮面黑色玛丽珍鞋。佩戴精致的粉色耳环。服装整体感觉优雅、清新且可爱，面料质感轻盈。在左侧放置一个磨砂半透明海报面板，配以优雅的排版和装饰性花纹。面板上包含 5 个明确的文本块或标签区域：1) 顶部横幅，上方是日文“次回衣装プロンプト公開”，下方是大号连体英文文本 {argument name="headline text" default="Next Outfit"}；2) 姓名块，包含日文“セラス・柳田・リリエンフェルト”及较小的罗马拼音“Ceras Yanagida Lilienfeld”；3) 一行预告文字“次回の衣装も お楽しみに！”，并配有一个小型精灵球图标；4) 一个带边框的描述框，标题为“Next Coordinate”，后跟几行小型日文正文；5) 底部丝带，文字为 {argument name="footer text" default="Coming Soon..."} 和“STAY TUNED!”，并配有一个小型皮卡丘剪影。整体采用淡蓝色、白色、银灰色和腮红粉色调。添加淡淡的装饰性边角，呈现出如同精品时尚预告海报般的精致宣传布局，用于主题动漫角色服装揭秘。

templates.title: Civilization-Style Japanese Island City

titleLocalized.zh: 文明系列风格的日本岛屿城市

templates.prompt: A highly detailed isometric grand-strategy game screenshot in the style of a modern historical 4X interface, showing a dense island port city of the {argument name="civilization name" default="Japanese Empire"} during the {argument name="era" default="1260 CE"}. The city fills almost the entire island and is surrounded by vivid turquoise coastal water and darker deep-blue sea. The urban layout is extremely dense and organic, with hundreds of tightly packed low wooden buildings, narrow winding streets, many docks and piers, and bustling harbor infrastructure wrapping around the shoreline. At the center of the island are 4 prominent landmark structures: 3 large traditional East Asian temple or palace buildings with layered green-blue tiled roofs arranged around a broad plaza, and 1 tall red pagoda slightly to the right of center. Include many smaller shrines, courtyards, stone paths, patches of trees, and scattered pale pink cherry blossoms among the rooftops. The island terrain should have slight elevation changes, rocky edges, and several harbor inlets, with bridges and wooden waterfront platforms connecting different neighborhoods. Populate the surrounding waters with exactly 16 visible vessels of mixed sizes: large sailing ships, medium trade ships, and small boats, some docked and some anchored offshore. Show light smoke rising from several points in the city and harbor, suggesting industry and daily activity. The overall lighting is bright afternoon sunlight with crisp shadows and richly saturated colors, emphasizing clear water, weathered wood, ceramic roof tiles, and coastal stone. The camera angle is high, wide, and slightly tilted, like a premium strategy game city overview. Add a full game UI overlay closely resembling a polished civilization-building game: a dark ornate top bar with many resource counters on the left, the text Turn: 103 | {argument name="year label" default="1260 CE"} and 2:51 PM on the right, a vertical quest panel on the upper left titled {argument name="journal title" default="Journal"} with multiple objective lines beneath it, a row of 6 hanging banner icons for rival factions across the upper right-center, a leader portrait panel in the top right for Tokugawa Ieyasu labeled Japanese Empire, a rectangular minimap in the bottom left, and a large circular bronze-and-gold city management button in the bottom right labeled GROW TOWN, with 3 smaller circular action buttons stacked beside it. The image should feel like an authentic gameplay screenshot from a fictional Civilization VII-like game, ultra-detailed, historically grounded, cinematic, and believable.

templates.title: Whimsical Animated Townsfolk Lineup

titleLocalized.zh: 异想天开的动画小镇居民阵容

templates.prompt: A clean character lineup sheet on a pure white background, showing 13 full-body stylized 3D characters in a whimsical stop-motion-inspired design with exaggerated proportions, textured fabrics, worn surfaces, muted earthy colors, and slightly creepy yet charming personality. Arrange them in 2 rows: 7 characters across the top row and 6 across the bottom row, each isolated with soft grounding shadows and plenty of white space, like a studio casting board for an animated film. Top row, left to right: 1) an extremely tall and painfully thin middle-aged man in a shabby brown suit, white shirt, narrow red tie, and checked trousers, with long fingers and slouched posture; 2) a short heavyset older woman with curly reddish hair, wearing a pink cardigan over a floral dress, sensible shoes, and carrying a brown handbag; 3) a very large burly man with tattooed forearms, wearing a red plaid flannel shirt, suspenders, dark worn pants, heavy boots, and a rough worker look; 4) a skinny teenage goth girl with pale skin, black messy ponytail, black jacket, dark shirt, skinny jeans, crossed arms, and a bored expression; 5) a lanky teenage boy in a knit beanie, layered hoodie and jacket, skinny jeans, and sneakers, hands in pockets; 6) a very tall elderly woman with an elegant beehive hairstyle, narrow face, tan blouse, scarf, long brown skirt, heels, handbag, and a cigarette held in one hand; 7) a slim teenage or young adult male with curly dark hair, wearing a striped sweater, narrow pants, and brown shoes. Bottom row, left to right: 8) a gaunt frail old person in ragged layered clothing and a stained apron, stooped forward with tired posture; 9) a thin middle-aged woman with hair in a high bun, mustard cardigan, long blue dress, flats, and a shoulder bag, holding something delicately in front of her chest; 10) a stocky police officer in a bulky navy winter uniform with fur collar, badge, utility belt, dark pants, and black shoes; 11) a chubby curly-haired boy wearing a varsity-style sleeveless jacket over a hoodie, knee-length shorts, socks, and sneakers, gripping his backpack straps; 12) a skeletal elderly man with a cap, huge nose, hunched spine, long coat, skinny trousers, and a cane; 13) a lanky mechanic or gas station worker in a dark blue jumpsuit and cap with the visible text {argument name="cap text" default="GAS"}, holding a wrench. Keep the rendering highly detailed with felt, wool, denim, knit, leather, and dust-like material realism, but maintain caricatured anatomy and expressive silhouettes. Use a subdued palette of browns, rust reds, dusty pinks, charcoal, navy, beige, and faded denim. The overall mood should feel like quirky residents of a rundown small town from a darkly comic animated feature, presented as a polished ensemble cast sheet.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张纯白背景下的清晰角色阵容表，展示了 13 个全身风格化 3D 角色，采用异想天开的定格动画风格设计，具有夸张的比例、纹理织物、磨损表面、柔和的大地色调，以及略带诡异却又迷人的个性。将它们排列成 2 行：顶部一行 7 个角色，底部一行 6 个角色，每个角色都带有柔和的接地阴影并留有充足的留白，就像动画电影的工作室选角项目（casting board）一样。顶部一行，从左到右：1）一个极高且瘦削的中年男子，身穿破旧的棕色西装、白衬衫、窄红领带和格子裤，手指修长，姿态慵懒；2）一个矮胖的老年妇女，留着红色的卷发，穿着粉色开衫搭配碎花连衣裙，穿着舒适的鞋子，拎着棕色手提包；3）一个非常魁梧的壮汉，前臂有纹身，穿着红色格子法兰绒衬衫、背带、深色磨损长裤和厚重的靴子，呈现出粗犷的工人形象；4）一个瘦削的哥特风少女，皮肤苍白，扎着凌乱的黑色马尾，穿着黑色夹克、深色衬衫和紧身牛仔裤，双臂交叉，表情无聊；5）一个瘦长的少年，戴着针织帽，穿着叠穿的连帽衫和夹克，搭配紧身牛仔裤和运动鞋，双手插兜；6）一个非常高大的老妇人，留着优雅的蜂窝头，脸型狭长，穿着棕褐色衬衫、围巾、长棕色裙子，搭配高跟鞋和手提包，一只手拿着香烟；7）一个苗条的青少年或年轻男性，留着深色卷发，穿着条纹毛衣、窄腿裤和棕色鞋子。底部一行，从左到右：8）一个憔悴虚弱的老人，穿着破烂的叠穿衣服和沾有污渍的围裙，身体前倾，姿态疲惫；9）一个瘦削的中年妇女，头发盘成高发髻，穿着芥末黄开衫、蓝色长裙，搭配平底鞋和单肩包，双手在胸前小心翼翼地拿着东西；10）一个敦实的警官，穿着厚重的海军蓝冬季制服，带有毛领、徽章、多功能腰带、深色长裤和黑色鞋子；11）一个胖乎乎的卷发男孩，穿着连帽衫外搭无袖棒球夹克，搭配及膝短裤、袜子和运动鞋，紧紧抓着背包带；12）一个骨瘦如柴的老人，戴着帽子，大鼻子，脊椎佝偻，穿着长外套、紧身裤，拄着拐杖；13）一个瘦长的机械师或加油站工人，穿着深蓝色连体工作服和帽子，帽子上可见文字 {argument name="cap text" default="GAS"}，手里拿着一把扳手。保持渲染的高度细节，展现毛毡、羊毛、牛仔布、针织、皮革和灰尘般的材质真实感，同时保持漫画式的解剖结构和富有表现力的剪影。使用棕色、铁锈红、灰粉色、炭灰色、海军蓝、米色和褪色牛仔布的柔和色调。整体氛围应如同来自一部黑色幽默动画长片中破旧小镇的古怪居民，呈现为一张精致的群像选角项目。

templates.prompt: A stylish young woman wearing a beige hijab and round glasses stands on a quiet urban street lined with modern brick buildings and boutique shops. She wears a maroon long-sleeve sweatshirt with white stripes on the sleeves and a bold graphic logo on the front, paired with loose black pants. She carries a small black shoulder bag and poses casually with one hand in her pocket, looking confidently at the camera. Behind her, there is a vertical vintage-style sign on the building and large glass storefront windows displaying clothing. The street is clean with a soft overcast sky, creating even, natural lighting. The overall aesthetic is minimalist, fashionable, and slightly cinematic, with muted tones and a cozy city vibe.

In her hands she holds a large piece of {argument name="prop" default="flowing black sheer chiffon fabric"} captured mid-motion, the fabric swirling and draping dynamically around her body and arms as if dancing in the air. Soft directional lighting from the upper left creates gentle highlights and soft shadows that sculpt her form beautifully, high-contrast editorial lighting with clean gradients. Minimal and modern high-fashion dance aesthetic, clean studio setting with no distractions, pure white background. templates.title: Playful Hand-Drawn Doodle Overlays

titleLocalized.zh: AI 涂鸦叠加助手

templates.prompt:
Analyze the uploaded image and preserve the original subject, composition, and lighting. Do not alter the identity or structure of the main subject. Add playful, {argument name="doodle style" default="hand-drawn doodles"} that interact directly with the subject in the image. The doodles should mimic, follow, or exaggerate the shapes, gestures, or motion present-such as outlining poses, extending limbs, adding motion lines, or creating imaginative elements that

"respond" to the subject.

Ensure the doodles feel naturally integrated into the scene, as if they were drawn on top of the photo with intention.

Use a sketchy, imperfect, hand-drawn style with organic lines, slightly uneven strokes, and a casual illustrated feel.

Include whimsical handwritten text elements placed around the image. The text should match the mood or implied context of the scene, with a playful and spontaneous tone.

Avoid fixed phrases-generate context-aware, creative, and humorous text that fits each unique image. Maintain a balanced composition so the doodles enhance the image without overwhelming the original subject. Keep the overall aesthetic fun, expressive, and social-media-ready. High resolution, clean overlay, vibrant yet natural color harmony.

promptLocalized.zh:
分析上传的图像，并保留原始主体、构图和光影。请勿改变主体身份或结构。添加 {argument name="doodle style" default="playful, hand-drawn doodles"}，使其与图像中的主体产生直接互动。涂鸦应模仿、跟随或夸大图像中呈现的形状、姿势或动作，例如勾勒姿势、延伸肢体、添加运动线条，或创作出与主体“互动”的创意元素。

确保涂鸦自然地融入场景，仿佛是有意在照片上绘制的一样。

采用草图式、不完美的手绘风格，线条要有机、笔触略显不均匀，并带有随性的插画感。

在图像周围加入灵动的手写文字元素。文字应与场景的氛围或隐含语境相符，语气设定为 {argument name="text tone" default="playful and spontaneous"}。

避免使用固定短语，应根据每张独特的图像生成具有情境感、创意且幽默的文字。保持构图平衡，使涂鸦在增强图像表现力的同时，不会喧宾夺主。整体美学风格应保持趣味性、表现力，并适合社交媒体分享。要求高分辨率、清晰的叠加效果，以及鲜活且自然的色彩协调。

templates.title: Fashion Magazine Collage Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 时尚杂志拼贴画指南

templates.prompt:
An American fashion magazine collage layout featuring {argument name="model name" default="Karina"} on a clean textured white background with subtle grid lines. The bold headline at the top-left reads “{argument name="brand name" default="ZARA"}’S 7-DAY OUTFIT GUIDE” in black and pink fonts, accented with playful star doodles. Beneath it, a small subheading in English reads: “Zara’s weekly style picks ❤️”.

On the right side, a large high-resolution portrait shows Zara in a black sequined strap dress, looking straight at the camera with her hand resting on her chin. The top-right corner includes handwritten-style notes and hashtags like #ZaraStyle #DailyLooks, surrounded by small heart and star doodles.

The center features seven “polaroid-style” photos arranged in two rows, each labeled from MONDAY to SUNDAY. Each image includes short, aesthetic English captions with casual handwritten notes and tiny arrows or heart doodles:

MONDAY: A relaxed “casual vibe” with a navy cap and cream sweatshirt, holding coffee. (“Keep Mondays comfy and easy.”)

TUESDAY: A bold “street style” look in a black nylon jacket. (“Turn up the street vibe.”)

WEDNESDAY: A polished “office look” with a gray blazer and glasses, holding a mug. (“Smart and confident midweek energy.”)

THURSDAY: A soft, feminine outfit with a light blue cardigan. (“Light, soft, and effortlessly pretty.”)

FRIDAY: A sleek “chic & cool” outfit with a black leather jacket. (“All-black, all confidence.”)

SATURDAY: A romantic “date night” look with wavy hair and an off-shoulder white top. (“Cute, flirty weekend mood.”)

SUNDAY: A cozy “relax & unwind” outfit in a cream knit. (“Slow down and stay comfy.”)

At the bottom-left, a black label with “{argument name="brand name" default="ZARA"}” is paired with a short English blurb about her fashion influence. Below that, a “STYLE TIPS” section lists three quick tips in simple English. The bottom edge includes a barcode graphic and the line: “Zara inspo for your everyday style.”

promptLocalized.zh:
一份美式时尚杂志拼贴布局，以 {argument name="model name" default="Karina"} 为主角，背景为带有细微网格线的干净纹理白底。左上角醒目的标题为“{argument name="brand name" default="ZARA"}’S 7-DAY OUTFIT GUIDE”，采用黑色和粉色字体，并点缀着俏皮的星星涂鸦。下方有一行简短的英文副标题：“Zara’s weekly style picks ❤️”。

右侧是一张高清大图，展示了身穿黑色亮片吊带裙的 Zara，她直视镜头，手托下巴。右上角包含手写风格的笔记和 #ZaraStyle #DailyLooks 等标签，周围环绕着小爱心和星星涂鸦。

中心区域展示了七张“拍立得风格”的照片，分两行排列，分别标注从 MONDAY 到 SUNDAY。每张图片都配有简短、美观的英文说明，带有随性的手写笔记以及小箭头或爱心涂鸦：

MONDAY：轻松的“休闲氛围”，戴着海军蓝鸭舌帽，身穿米色卫衣，手拿咖啡。（“Keep Mondays comfy and easy.”）

TUESDAY：大胆的“街头风格”，身穿黑色尼龙夹克。（“Turn up the street vibe.”）

WEDNESDAY：干练的“办公室造型”，身穿灰色西装外套并佩戴眼镜，手拿马克杯。（“Smart and confident midweek energy.”）

THURSDAY：温柔的女性化穿搭，身穿浅蓝色开衫。（“Light, soft, and effortlessly pretty.”）

FRIDAY：利落的“时髦酷感”造型，身穿黑色皮夹克。（“All-black, all confidence.”）

SATURDAY：浪漫的“约会之夜”造型，留着波浪卷发，身穿露肩白色上衣。（“Cute, flirty weekend mood.”）

SUNDAY：舒适的“放松时刻”穿搭，身穿米色针织衫。（“Slow down and stay comfy.”）

左下角是一个带有“{argument name="brand name" default="ZARA"}”字样的黑色标签，配有一段关于她时尚影响力的简短英文介绍。下方是“STYLE TIPS”板块，列出了三条简单的英文小贴士。底部边缘包含一个条形码图形和一行文字：“Zara inspo for your everyday style.”

templates.prompt:
K-Pop Dance 16-Step Instruction Sheet (4×4 Grid)

[VISUAL STYLE]
High-end K-pop choreography guide in monochrome grayscale
Crisp, studio-lit composition with strong contrast
Modern, editorial + performance aesthetic
Clean white background, no distractions

[GRID LAYOUT, STRICT]
{argument name="layout" default="4×4 grid (16 equal panels)"}
Thin black divider lines
Each panel clearly numbered 1–16
Top-left: Step number + short title
Bottom-left: 3–4 short instruction lines
Overlay: arrows + motion guides (curved, straight, circular)

[CHARACTER]
{argument name="dancer description" default="Korean female dancer (K-pop idol look)"}
Slim, athletic build
Long styled hair (soft waves or straight, dynamic movement)
Confident, expressive K-pop performance energy
Same character across all 16 panels (consistent face and proportions)

[WARDROBE  K-POP STYLE]
{argument name="outfit" default="Fitted crop top, high-waisted loose-fit jeans, and sneakers"}
Outfit should feel trendy, idol-stage inspired
Fabric reacts naturally to motion (subtle folds, movement)

🔢 [16 DANCE STEPS, SEQUENCE FLOW]
Starting Pose
Step Touch Right
Step Touch Left
Hip Sway Combo
Body Roll Down
Back Step Sweep
Quarter Turn Pivot
Hair Flip & Pose
Side Step Drag
Cross Behind Unwind
Body Wave Up
Hip Circle
Step Lock Step
Arm Sweep Pose
Chest Pop & Hit
Final Pose

[PANEL STRUCTURE,  EACH FRAME]
Center: full-body pose (clear choreography position)
Bottom-left: short bullet instructions (clean typography)
Motion arrows showing direction, spins, and flow
Emphasize rhythm, weight shift, and sharp K-pop accents

[MOTION STYLE]
Mix of sharp hits + smooth transitions (K-pop signature)
Clean isolations (hips, chest, arms)
Expressive poses with attitude

[RENDER QUALITY]
Ultra-detailed, high-resolution
Sharp anatomy and pose clarity
Smooth grayscale shading
No blur, no distortion, no clutter

[RESTRICTIONS]
No background elements
No extra characters
No color (strict grayscale)
Maintain clean instructional aesthetic

templates.title: Low-Angle Urban Street Photography

templates.prompt:
Ultra-realistic {argument name="angle" default="low-angle"} street photography of a {argument name="subject" default="young man standing confidently"} in the middle of a modern city, surrounded by tall symmetrical high-rise apartment buildings forming a geometric frame around the sky. Shot from ground level looking upward (worm’s-eye view), creating a powerful and dominant perspective.

The subject is a stylish young man with short curly hair and light facial hair, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="yellow-tinted rectangular sunglasses, a plain black oversized t-shirt, beige cargo pants with subtle camo patches"}, and carrying a transparent water bottle in one hand. Black headphones rest around his neck, and a backpack strap is visible on his shoulders.

Expression calm and slightly serious, looking directly into the camera.

Background: bright blue sky with scattered soft clouds, buildings converging inward creating strong leading lines and symmetry. Urban residential towers with repeating windows and light concrete tones.

Lighting: natural daylight, crisp shadows, high contrast, sharp details, HDR look.

Composition: centered subject, vertical framing, strong perspective distortion from wide-angle lens (24mm or wider), cinematic depth.

Style: fashion editorial meets urban realism, ultra-detailed, 8k, sharp focus, realistic skin texture, high dynamic range.

promptLocalized.zh:

拍摄对象是一位留着短卷发、蓄着淡胡茬的时尚年轻男子，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="黄色矩形墨镜、纯黑色廓形 T 恤、带有迷彩补丁的米色工装裤"}，单手拿着一个透明水瓶。脖子上挂着黑色耳机，肩上可见背包带。

表情冷静且略显严肃，直视镜头。

templates.title: Skincare Commercial Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 护肤品广告项目

templates.prompt:
Create a clean, bright {argument name="product type" default="skincare commercial"} storyboard in a 16:9 layout with 9 panels. Use soft natural lighting, minimal aesthetic, and a fresh, airy mood with white and pastel tones. The {argument name="subject" default="main character is a young woman with soft makeup and styled hair"}, wearing light, elegant clothing. The setting is a modern, sunlit interior with large windows and a calm atmosphere. No text or subtitles anywhere.
Show a clear story flow: she starts at her desk looking slightly tired or concerned, then a close-up of her face showing dry or dull skin. She discovers a clear skincare bottle and gently presents it. Show a close-up of the liquid pouring onto her hand, followed by her applying it to her face. After use, her skin looks hydrated, glowing, and smooth. Transition to her feeling confident and refreshed, walking in a bright, clean space with soft breeze and flowing elements. End with a calm product beauty shot on a minimal surface, then a final frame of her smiling softly at the camera while holding the product.
Focus on natural expressions, glowing skin, and a transformation from dull to fresh. Include cinematic close-ups, soft focus, light reflections, and subtle sparkles to enhance the clean beauty feel. Keep everything elegant, minimal, and visually soothing with no branding text.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个简洁明亮的 {argument name="product type" default="护肤品广告"} 项目，采用 16:9 布局，共 9 个分镜。使用柔和的自然光，呈现极简美学，营造清新、轻盈的氛围，色调以白色和柔和色系为主。{argument name="subject" default="主角是一位妆容清透、发型精致的年轻女性"}，身着轻盈优雅的服装。场景设定在现代且阳光充足的室内，配有大窗户，氛围宁静。画面中不包含任何文字或字幕。
展示清晰的叙事流程：她起初在书桌前，显得有些疲惫或困扰，随后镜头特写她的脸部，显示皮肤干燥或暗沉。她发现了透明的护肤品瓶子并轻轻展示。展示液体滴在手上的特写，随后是她将产品涂抹在脸上的画面。使用后，她的皮肤看起来水润、透亮且光滑。转场至她感到自信且焕然一新，在明亮整洁的空间中行走，伴随微风和流动的元素。结尾展示产品在极简平面上的静物美拍，最后一帧是她手持产品对着镜头温柔微笑。
重点表现自然的表情、透亮的肌肤以及从暗沉到清新的蜕变。加入电影感特写、柔焦、光影反射和细微的闪光，以增强纯净美感。保持整体优雅、极简且视觉舒适，且不包含任何品牌文字。

The entire scene is bathed in a {argument name="aesthetic" default="dreamy, analog aesthetic"}, characterized by a soft Pro-Mist filter that creates misty highlights and a radiant glow around the subject's form. Technical photography details include a subtle film grain consistent with high-ISO analog stock, visible chromatic aberration at the frame's edges, and a prismatic lens flare that streaks across the composition, adding to the nostalgic, disposable visual aesthetic. The color palette is a sophisticated balance of cool environmental tones and warm, glowing skin textures, unified by a matte finish and rich ambient occlusion in the folds of the garments. templates.title: Martial Arts Choreography Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 武术动作编排海报

templates.prompt:
A clean instructional poster in a 4x4 grid (16 panels) showing a male martial artist demonstrating Pencak Silat choreography. The subject is a fit man with medium-length dark hair and a beard, wearing a red button-up shirt, beige pants, and white sneakers. Style is semi-realistic illustration mixed with hand-drawn sketch lines, soft shadows, and a light textured paper background. Each panel includes subtle motion arrows and small captions. Minimalist, balanced layout. Top title at top: 'Pencak Silat Choreography – 16 Counts – 10 Seconds – Smooth Flowy Chill'.

Panel 1: wide ready stance, knees bent, one hand guarding forward, focused expression.
Panel 2: step forward with outward block, arm extended defensively.
Panel 3: inside block sweeping upward diagonally, torso rotating.
Panel 4: strong straight punch forward, aligned hips.
Panel 5: side step into low stance, both hands pushing outward.
Panel 6: knee lifted high in chamber position, balanced posture.
Panel 7: front kick extended forward, opposite arm guarding.
Panel 8: step backward into defensive cover, arms crossing.
Panel 9: low block, sweeping arm downward in deep stance.
Panel 10: hook punch across body with hip rotation.
Panel 11: turning body with pivoting feet, circular motion.
Panel 12: forward palm strike, stable stance.
Panel 13: low sweeping motion near ground in squat stance.
Panel 14: rising smoothly from low stance, upward motion.
Panel 15: controlled locking pose, one arm raised defensively.
Panel 16: closing salute, feet together, hands pressed at chest, calm posture.

Include hand-drawn arrows (blue and purple accents), clean infographic layout, evenly spaced panels, consistent character design across all frames.

A focused male martial artist performs a smooth, flowing Pencak Silat sequence in a minimalist studio. He is in his late 20s, athletic build, medium height, warm tan skin, with thick wavy dark hair and a short, well-groomed beard. He wears a fitted deep red button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, beige slim-fit pants with slight wear at the knees, and clean white sneakers. His expression is calm, controlled, and intent. 
The setting is a softly lit neutral studio with an off-white textured backdrop and a slightly worn wooden floor. Lighting is diffused and cinematic, creating gentle shadows and emphasizing fluid motion.
The choreography is continuous and rhythmic, with no abrupt cuts: 
0–2s: Starts in a grounded ready stance, knees bent, one palm forward in guard, eyes locked ahead 
2–4s: steps forward into an outward block, transitioning into an inside sweeping block upward 
4–6s: rotates hips into a straight punch, then shifts weight into a side step with a pushing motion 
6–8s: lifts knee smoothly and extends into a controlled front kick, maintaining balance 
8–10s: steps back into a guarded cover, drops into a low block, then rises into a hook punch 
10–12s: pivots the body with a clean turn, transitioning into a forward palm strike 
12–14s: lowers into a sweeping motion, then rises fluidly into a locking control pose 
14–15s: finishes upright with a respectful closing salute, hands together at chest level 
Movement style is soft, flowing, controlled, with precise martial intention rather than aggression. Emphasis on balance, breath, and continuity. Camera is a steady medium-wide shot with subtle slow tracking, no cuts.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张简洁的教学海报，采用 4x4 网格（16 个面板），展示了一位男性武术家演示 Pencak Silat 动作编排。主角是一位身材健硕、留着中长深色头发和胡须的男性，身穿红色衬衫、米色长裤和白色运动鞋。风格为半写实插画，融合了手绘草图线条、柔和阴影以及浅色纹理纸张背景。每个面板都包含细微的动作箭头和小标题。布局极简且平衡。顶部标题：“Pencak Silat Choreography – 16 Counts – 10 Seconds – Smooth Flowy Chill”。

面板 1：宽大的准备姿势，膝盖弯曲，一只手向前防御，神情专注。
面板 2：向前迈步并进行外格挡，手臂伸展以进行防御。
面板 3：内格挡向上斜向扫动，躯干旋转。
面板 4：强有力的直拳向前，髋部对齐。
面板 5：侧步进入低姿势，双手向外推。
面板 6：膝盖高抬至蓄力位置，姿势平衡。
面板 7：前踢向前伸展，另一只手臂进行防御。
面板 8：向后迈步进入防御掩护，双臂交叉。
面板 9：低位格挡，在深蹲姿势中向下扫动手臂。
面板 10：伴随髋部旋转的横向勾拳。
面板 11：身体转动，双脚旋转，呈现圆周运动。
面板 12：向前掌击，姿势稳定。
面板 13：深蹲姿势下靠近地面的低位扫动。
面板 14：从低姿势平稳起身，向上运动。
面板 15：受控的锁定姿势，一只手臂向上防御。
面板 16：结束礼，双脚并拢，双手按在胸前，姿态从容。

包含手绘箭头（蓝色和紫色点缀）、简洁的信息图布局、间距均匀的面板，以及所有帧中一致的角色设计。

一位专注的男性武术家在极简主义工作室中表演流畅的 Pencak Silat 动作序列。他 20 多岁，体格健壮，中等身高，肤色呈温暖的棕褐色，留着浓密的波浪状深色头发和修剪整齐的短胡须。他穿着一件合身的深红色衬衫，袖子卷至前臂，穿着膝盖处略有磨损的米色修身长裤，以及干净的白色运动鞋。他的表情冷静、受控且专注。
场景是一个光线柔和的中性工作室，背景为米白色纹理墙面，地板为略显陈旧的木质地板。灯光漫射且具有电影感，营造出柔和的阴影，并突显了流畅的动作。
动作编排连续且富有节奏感，没有突兀的剪辑：
0–2 秒：以扎实的准备姿势开始，膝盖弯曲，一只手掌向前防御，双眼注视前方
2–4 秒：向前迈步进入外格挡，过渡到向上扫动的内格挡
4–6 秒：髋部旋转打出直拳，随后重心转移进行侧步并伴随推掌动作
6–8 秒：平稳抬膝并伸展进行受控的前踢，保持平衡
8–10 秒：向后迈步进入防御掩护，下蹲进行低位格挡，随后起身打出勾拳
10–12 秒：身体干净利落地转动，过渡到向前掌击
12–14 秒：降低重心进行扫动，随后流畅起身进入锁定控制姿势
14–15 秒：以恭敬的结束礼收尾，双手在胸前合十
运动风格柔和、流畅、受控，具有精确的武术意图而非攻击性。强调平衡、呼吸和连贯性。摄像机采用稳定的中远景镜头，伴随细微的缓慢追踪，无剪辑。

templates.title: Traditional Chinese Ink Illustration Style

titleLocalized.zh: 中国传统水墨插画风格

templates.prompt:
[Character/Theme] = {argument name="character" default="Master Yi Xuan from Zenless Zone Zero"}.
A colorful East Asian calligraphic linear figure illustration, based on a white-drawing (baimiao) skeleton where line-drawing dominates the form, with freehand-style light coloring. Ink lines from a calligraphy brush, utilizing mixed-hair brush strokes, centered brushwork, with some flying white (feibai) created by side-brushing to achieve a dry-brush texture. Hair is drawn with fine, gossamer lines. The outlines are open with intermittent double lines, creating a play between void and solid. Large areas of negative space on a white paper background. Transparent watercolor glazing, light ink washing, with partial boneless-style coloring. The color layers are transparent and the color blocks are pure with soft edges. Minimal shading, scattered lighting, weak contrast, and flattened coloring. The character is drawn strictly according to original designs for clothing, hairstyle, and accessories, avoiding generic Hanfu templates to preserve the character's unique logic. Hand structures are accurate with five complete and clear fingers, natural joints, and elegant gestures. Fully colored with unified and clear tones for skin, hair, clothing, and accessories.

promptLocalized.zh:
[Character/Theme] = {argument name="character" default="《绝区零》中的玄大师"}。
一幅色彩丰富的东亚书法线条人物插画，基于白描骨架，以线条勾勒为主，辅以写意风格的轻盈着色。使用书法毛笔的墨线，运用兼毫笔触和中锋运笔，部分笔触通过侧锋产生“飞白”效果，以实现干笔纹理。发丝由纤细如游丝的线条勾勒。轮廓线开放且带有间断的双线，营造出虚实相生的效果。白色纸张背景上留有大面积的负空间。采用透明水彩罩染、淡墨渲染，并进行局部没骨法着色。色层透明，色块纯净且边缘柔和。阴影极少，光线散射，对比度弱，色彩扁平。角色严格按照原始设计绘制服装、发型和配饰，避免使用通用的汉服模板，以保持角色独特的逻辑。手部结构准确，五指完整清晰，关节自然，姿态优雅。整体上色，皮肤、头发、服装和配饰的色调统一且清晰。

templates.title: Book Summary Infographic Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 书籍摘要信息图海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Generate a [medium information density] book summary infographic poster with the theme "{argument name="book title" default="Book Title"}".

---

Step 0 (Critical Pre-assessment)

Before starting generation, determine which category this book belongs to (multiple choice possible):
* Cognitive Growth (Thinking / Self-improvement)
* Business / Wealth (Earning / Career / Investment)
* Psychology / Emotion (Relationships / Inner Self / Human Nature)
* Novel / Story (Narrative / Character / Metaphor)

Adjust content logic based on category.

[Overall Style]
Modern Minimalist UI + Light Vintage Illustration style. Soft light backgrounds (Cream / Beige / Light Gray). Low saturation palette (Deep Green / Deep Blue / Brown).
Keywords: Quiet, Substantial, Readable.

[Core Principles]
Do not use fixed module titles. Do not force structural completeness. Organize information naturally based on book type.

[Content Modules]
1. Opening: Book Title, Author, One-sentence insight.
2. Core Understanding: "What this book is really saying is..."
3. Highlights: Key takeaways adjusted by category.
4. Visual Structure: Decision paths, leverage systems, or character maps.
5. Examples/Fragments: Memorable scenes or cases.
6. Quotes: Meaningful sentences.
7. Actions: Practical steps to take after reading.

[Design Details]
Adaptive grid layout, card-based info, 6:4 image-to-text ratio, unified illustration style, clear hierarchy.

[Tone of Voice]
Should sound like a human explaining the book with insight and realization, not like a dry summary.

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一张 [中等信息密度] 的书籍摘要信息图海报，主题为 "{argument name="book title" default="书籍标题"}"。

---

第 0 步（关键预评估）

在开始生成之前，确定该书所属的类别（可多选）：
* 认知成长（思维 / 自我提升）
* 商业 / 财富（赚钱 / 职业 / 投资）
* 心理 / 情感（人际关系 / 内在自我 / 人性）
* 小说 / 故事（叙事 / 角色 / 隐喻）

根据类别调整内容逻辑。

[整体风格]
现代极简 UI + 轻复古插画风格。柔和的浅色背景（奶油色 / 米色 / 浅灰色）。低饱和度色调（深绿色 / 深蓝色 / 棕色）。
关键词：安静、充实、易读。

[核心原则]
不要使用固定的模块标题。不要强求结构的完整性。根据书籍类型自然地组织信息。

[内容模块]
1. 开篇：书籍标题、作者、一句话见解。
2. 核心理解：“这本书真正想表达的是……”
3. 亮点：根据类别调整的关键要点。
4. 视觉结构：决策路径、杠杆系统或角色关系图。
5. 示例 / 片段：令人难忘的场景或案例。
6. 引言：富有深意的句子。
7. 行动：阅读后可采取的实用步骤。

[设计细节]
自适应网格布局，卡片式信息呈现，6:4 的图文比例，统一的插画风格，清晰的层级结构。

[语气语调]
听起来应该像是一个人类在分享对书籍的洞察和感悟，而不是枯燥的总结。

templates.title: Tianjin City Promotional Poster Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 天津城市宣传海报提示词

templates.prompt:
A 2026 Tianjin city promotional poster filled with a festive Spring Festival atmosphere, while combining elegant style and urban cultural heritage.
The overall image uses a 'Guochao' (national tide) illustration + double exposure artistic technique. The composition continues an S-shaped flow, with natural and smooth visual guidance, combining modern design sense with Eastern aesthetic charm.

On a pure white high-grade textured background, the image maintains large areas of white space, making the overall feel fresh, elegant, and transparent.
In the bottom right corner stands a miniature figure in traditional Chinese clothing, with a dynamic posture, waving a long red silk dance ribbon.
This red silk has a soft, elegant, and tense texture, spiraling upward in the air and naturally extending to the top left, forming a highly visually impactful flow trajectory.

As the red silk extends, it gradually transforms into a magnificent Haihe River water vein, while integrating the cultural context and geographical imagery of Tianjin, like an urban scroll connecting the past and present.
In the visual subject formed by the intersection of this 'river' and the silk, a hand-drawn panoramic map of Tianjin city is overlaid, in Guochao style, with rich layers, magnificent momentum, and exquisite, shocking details.

Key landmarks and urban elements of Tianjin are highlighted in the frame:
Tianjin Eye (prominent landmark, highly recognizable)
Haihe River (core water system running through the frame)
Jiefang Bridge (embodying urban history and industrial beauty)
Jinwan Plaza architectural complex (showing modern urban prosperity)
Century Clock (iconic landscape)
Ancient Culture Street (embodying traditional culture)
Five Great Avenues villa complex (embodying the historical style of blending East and West)
Drum Tower (embodying Tianjin's ancient charm)
Italian Style District (adding urban romance and exotic flavor)
Tianjin Port and ocean freighter elements (embodying the city's character of openness, port, and global connectivity)
Appropriately integrate cultural symbols like Yangliuqing New Year paintings, Niren Zhang clay sculptures, crosstalk culture symbols, and fried dough twists (Mahua) as decorative details to enhance regional identity.

The entire image presents a visual mood of 'river, city, bridge, port, and the fusion of past and present,' with light clouds and misty water vapor, carrying the ethereal feel of Eastern aesthetics.
Colors are mainly Chinese red, gold, elegant white, green, and light blue, with warm gold accents in some areas; the overall feel is festive but not vulgar, rich but not cluttered.

Image Requirements:
Rich details, complex structure, clear layers.
The city landscape is fully visible, providing a sense of shock and artistry.
Maintain a Spring Festival atmosphere, modern aesthetics, and promotional poster quality.
Obvious hand-drawn feel, exquisite and beautiful, with collectible visual quality.
Has both the momentum of a city promotional film poster and the high-end feel of tourism posters.

Text Layout Requirements:
Elegant typography in the bottom left for the English title: 'SPRING 2026'.
Accompanied by vertical Chinese promotional slogans, such as:
'River and Sea Jinmen, Charming Tianjin'
or
'Jinmen Hometown, Open Tianjin'
or
'Ancient and Modern Fusion, Myriad Tianjin'.

Text Requirements:
Beautiful and generous layout.
Clear and complete handwriting.
High-end poster design sense.
Harmonious combination of Chinese and English.
No garbled characters, no typos.

Overall Meaning:
Showcase the unique charm of Tianjin as a famous historical and cultural city, an important northern port city, and a modern international metropolis, reflecting the charm of the Haihe River, the ancient charm of Jinmen, and the open and inclusive urban spirit.

Poster Size: 9:16 vertical.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张充满节日春节氛围的 2026 年天津城市宣传海报，融合了优雅风格与城市文化底蕴。
整体画面采用“国潮”插画 + 双重曝光艺术手法。构图延续 S 型流线，视觉引导自然流畅，兼具现代设计感与东方美学韵味。

在纯白高质感背景上，画面保留大面积留白，整体感觉清新、优雅且通透。
右下角站立着一位身着传统中式服装的微缩人物，姿态灵动，挥舞着长长的红色绸缎舞带。
这抹红绸质感柔软、优雅且富有张力，在空中盘旋上升并自然延伸至左上方，形成极具视觉冲击力的流动轨迹。

随着红绸的延伸，它逐渐幻化为壮丽的海河水脉，同时融入天津的文化脉络与地理意象，宛如一幅连接古今的城市长卷。
在这一“河流”与绸缎交织而成的视觉主体中，叠加了一幅国潮风格的天津城市手绘全景地图，层次丰富，气势磅礴，细节精致震撼。

画面中重点突出了天津的关键地标与城市元素：
天津之眼（显著地标，极具辨识度）
海河（贯穿画面的核心水系）
解放桥（体现城市历史与工业之美）
津湾广场建筑群（展现现代城市繁荣）
世纪钟（标志性景观）
古文化街（体现传统文化）
五大道别墅群（体现中西合璧的历史风貌）
鼓楼（体现天津古韵）
意式风情区（增添城市浪漫与异域风情）
天津港与远洋货轮元素（体现城市开放、港口与全球互联的性格）
适当融入杨柳青年画、泥人张彩塑、相声文化符号及麻花等文化符号作为装饰细节，增强地域辨识度。

整幅画面呈现出“河、城、桥、港，古今交融”的视觉意境，伴有轻云与水雾，带有东方美学的空灵感。
色彩以中国红、金色、优雅白、绿色和浅蓝色为主，局部点缀暖金色；整体感觉喜庆而不俗气，丰富而不杂乱。

图像要求：
细节丰富，结构复杂，层次清晰。
城市景观清晰可见，带来震撼感与艺术感。
保持春节氛围、现代美学与宣传海报质感。
具有明显的手绘感，精致美观，具备收藏级的视觉质量。
既有城市宣传片海报的气势，又有旅游海报的高端感。

文字排版要求：
左下角采用优雅的排版呈现英文标题：“SPRING 2026”。
搭配竖排中文宣传标语，例如：
“河海津门，魅力天津”
或
“津门故里，开放天津”
或
“古今交融，万象天津”。

文字要求：
布局美观大方。
笔迹清晰完整。
高端海报设计感。
中英文和谐搭配。
无乱码，无错别字。

整体寓意：
展现天津作为历史文化名城、北方重要港口城市及现代国际大都市的独特魅力，反映海河风情、津门古韵以及开放包容的城市精神。

海报尺寸：9:16 竖版。

templates.title: Double Exposure Character Poster Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 双重曝光角色海报提示词

templates.prompt: A character promotional poster titled “{argument name="poster title" default="INPUT NAME"}”, designed in a unified vertical key visual composition (9:16). Each poster follows a hierarchy of large top and smaller bottom structure: the upper half features the most recognizable element of the character (head, facial contour, mask, or upper-body silhouette) as a dominant oversized visual, forming a highly identifiable silhouette. The middle to lower section contains the full character as a secondary subject, shown in a stable standing pose or with subtle movement, establishing the visual core of the composition. Inside the large silhouette and around the character, use a double-exposure and collage-style narrative composition. Multiple scenes, symbolic imagery, small character interactions, supporting elements, and environmental details are layered and blended into mist, ink wash, and negative space. The left and right sides include complementary secondary elements to create narrative tension and spatial variation. A continuous flowing visual line runs from top to bottom, connecting the main character, internal collage, and the large upper silhouette, enhancing cohesion and guiding the viewer’s eye. The overall composition preserves large areas of negative space. Edges are treated with ink diffusion, soft blurring, and fragmented transitions, creating a balance between presence and absence inspired by Eastern aesthetics. The style is cohesive, refined, and restrained, emphasizing depth, storytelling, strong visual impact, and a consistent series-style poster language.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张名为“{argument name="poster title" default="INPUT NAME"}”的角色宣传海报，采用统一的竖版主视觉构图（9:16）。每张海报均遵循“上大下小”的层级结构：上半部分以角色最具辨识度的元素（头部、面部轮廓、面具或上半身剪影）作为主导的超大视觉焦点，形成极具辨识度的剪影；中下部呈现角色全身作为次要主体，采用稳定的站姿或轻微的动态，确立构图的视觉核心。在大剪影内部及角色周围，运用双重曝光和拼贴式的叙事构图。将多个场景、象征性意象、小型角色互动、辅助元素及环境细节进行分层，并融入烟雾、水墨及留白之中。左右两侧加入互补的次要元素，以营造叙事张力与空间变化。一条连续的流动视觉线贯穿上下，将主角色、内部拼贴及上方大剪影连接起来，增强连贯性并引导观众视线。整体构图保留大面积留白。边缘采用水墨晕染、柔和模糊及碎片化过渡处理，在东方美学的启发下实现“有”与“无”的平衡。整体风格统一、精致且克制，强调深度、叙事感、强烈的视觉冲击力以及连贯的系列海报语言。

templates.title: Modern Esther Writing at a Worktable

titleLocalized.zh: 在工作台前写作的现代版以斯帖

templates.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic modern portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Esther"} reimagined in the present day, seated at a large worktable and leaning forward while sketching or annotating papers with a black pen. She has long, voluminous dark curly hair, medium olive-brown skin, and wears a soft light beige cardigan over a neutral tank top, layered delicate necklaces, and a simple ring. Her pose is candid and focused, with one hand writing and the other resting across a spread of maps, drawings, and printed pages on the table. Frame the image as a medium close-up from slightly above table height, centered on her upper body and hands. Use warm natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, and a softly blurred creative studio or workshop background with earthy brown and amber tones, giving the scene an intimate, thoughtful, contemporary storytelling mood. Emphasize realism, tactile skin and fabric texture, natural curls, documentary-style photography, subtle color grading, and a serious yet calm expression.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感十足、照片级真实的现代肖像，描绘了被重新构想为现代人的 {argument name="character name" default="以斯帖"}。她坐在宽大的工作台前，身体前倾，正用黑色钢笔在纸上素描或批注。她留着浓密的长卷发，皮肤呈中等橄榄棕色，身穿米色柔软开衫，内搭中性色背心，佩戴着精致的叠戴项链和一枚简约戒指。她的姿态自然且专注，一只手在书写，另一只手随意地搭在桌上铺开的地图、画作和打印纸张上。画面采用略高于桌面的中景特写构图，焦点集中在她的上半身和双手。运用温暖的室内自然光，浅景深效果，背景是柔和虚化的创意工作室或工作坊，色调为大地棕色和琥珀色，营造出一种亲密、深思且具有当代叙事感的氛围。强调真实感、皮肤与织物的质感、自然的卷发、纪录片风格的摄影手法、细腻的调色，以及她严肃而平静的神情。

templates.title: Ornate Celestial Card Back

templates.prompt: A vertically oriented mystical card back design centered on a plain light gray background, shown as a single ornate rectangular card with rounded corners and a thick dark charcoal-black beveled border. The card face is an aged smoky gradient from deep gray at the edges to a soft pale silver glow in the center, with a dusty antique texture, faint scratches, subtle speckling, and a starfield-like scatter of tiny light flecks. Add an elegant symmetrical art nouveau and celestial frame in muted gold linework hugging the inner border. Place 4 circular compass-like medallions in the corners, one in each corner, with delicate engraved star motifs inside. Add 2 large partial circular astrolabe-like ornaments emerging from the lower left and lower right corners. Include fine ornamental curls and filigree in all 4 corners. Scatter exactly 9 visible bright star glints across the card face, with warm golden-white four-pointed sparkles of varied size. Add thin faint radiating guide lines converging toward the center and lower center, plus 2 small diamond-shaped star symbols aligned vertically near the top center and lower center. Keep the composition perfectly symmetrical, empty in the middle for title placement, luxurious, magical, vintage, and minimal. High detail, soft glow, refined metallic accents, fantasy tarot or oracle card back aesthetic, clean studio presentation.

templates.prompt: A full-body fashion photo of a stylish mature woman standing on a covered outdoor patio in bright natural daytime light. She has voluminous short platinum-blonde hair and a confident pose with both hands on her hips, one leg crossed casually in front of the other. Her face is softly obscured and not detailed. She wears a fitted long-sleeve cropped top in {argument name="top color" default="warm rust brown"}, high-waisted light blue distressed wide-leg jeans with several ripped areas, and chunky brown platform slide sandals. She is heavily accessorized with layered necklaces including one large statement pendant, multiple stacked bracelets, rings, drop earrings, and a smartwatch. She carries a small beaded drawstring bucket bag in {argument name="bag color" default="cognac brown"} hanging from one hand. The setting is an upscale backyard lounge with woven dark rattan patio furniture, cream cushions, a striped beige outdoor rug, a blue cabinet with a television above it, sliding glass doors, and greenery visible outside. promptLocalized.zh: 史诗级暗黑奇幻海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="关羽"}，以神话动作游戏英雄的风格重新构思。全身低角度构图，居中呈现，高大威猛。身着做旧金与深绿色相间的精美中国古代战甲，饰有龙兽纹样，巨大的肩甲雕刻成咆哮的怪兽造型，层叠的鳞甲，华丽的腰带扣，长长的黑发在风中狂乱飘动，佩戴着褪色的绿色头巾。他一手竖持长柄武器，杆身深色，刀刃处系有红色流苏；另一只手展示着一把巨大的华丽关刀，刀柄雕刻精美，宽阔的弧形钢刃斜向观众。一轮巨大的发光满月在他脑后形成光环，周围环绕着一圈淡淡的中国古代书法。飘动的深红色披风和破碎的红色布带在画面中飞舞，营造出强烈的对角线动感。环境为烟雾缭绕的地狱战场，乌云密布，灰烬飘散，地面附近闪烁着熔岩般的红光，背景中隐现参差不齐的岩石和巨大的阴影雕像或恶魔形态。色调采用磨光金、余烬橙、血红、炭黑和深玉绿。超精细电影级光影，月光带来的戏剧性轮廓光，高对比度，体积烟雾，质感丰富的金属、布料和毛发，超精细奇幻概念艺术，顶级电子游戏主视觉图，竖版海报设计。包含 4 组类似电影/游戏海报的集成文字：月亮周围顶部的弧形中文，中下部的标题行“黑神话”，超大的金色毛笔书法主标题“关公”，以及底部带有中心圆形徽标的小字中文标语。

templates.prompt: Create a clean, premium Chinese editorial book page for a photography tutorial, portrait orientation, minimalist magazine-style layout on an off-white paper background with generous margins and refined typography. The page is a single spread-like design with 5 clearly separated content blocks: a top header, a left text column, one large main portrait on the right, a bottom-left lighting diagram, and a bottom-right area containing 2 thumbnail examples plus 1 tip box. In the top header, place small Chinese text reading "人像摄影实战指南 | Chapter 04 光线与影响的运用". On the upper left, make a large chapter number in muted olive green reading "04-2", followed by a bold black Chinese title split across multiple lines: "自然光下的\n柔美人像". Below it, add a smaller olive-green subtitle: "利用花影与漫射光\n营造温柔氛围". Under the subtitle, include a short Chinese paragraph in black body text describing how natural surroundings and flowers or tree shadows can soften sunlight and create a clean, gentle, atmospheric portrait. Below that, create a section titled "● 拍摄要点" in olive green, followed by 3 numbered tips in Chinese body text: 1 "光线方向" with a sentence about choosing top or upper-side natural light and using floral shadows to soften facial contours; 2 "前景与氛围" with a sentence about using large soft foreground flowers to frame the scene and add depth; 3 "表情与情绪" with a sentence about guiding the model to keep a natural, calm expression and relaxed gaze. On the right side, place one large vertical portrait photo occupying the upper-right half of the page: a soft, airy close portrait of a young East Asian woman with long straight black hair, wearing a pale blush pink top and a delicate necklace, surrounded by abundant white hydrangea-like blossoms in the foreground and overhead, lit by diffused natural daylight with floral shadows and a gentle romantic mood, shallow depth of field, elegant editorial photography. Beneath the main photo, add a single line of small technical camera settings text in Chinese: "● 焦距：85mm   光圈：f/2.8   快门：1/640s   ISO：100   白平衡：自动". In the bottom-left block, place a rounded-corner box containing a simple black-and-white hand-drawn lighting diagram with the title "● 布光示意图". Inside the diagram show 3 elements: a small sun icon at upper left, a camera icon at lower left, and a rear-view sketch of a standing woman centered, with dotted directional lines from the sun and labels in Chinese explaining that natural light from above front is softened by flowers into dappled diffused light, with flowers used as foreground and medium telephoto compression for a virtualized scene. In the bottom-right area, add a section title "● 更多尝试" in olive green above 2 small vertical thumbnail portraits of the same woman among white flowers. Give each thumbnail a short Chinese caption: left "侧光拍摄，光影层次更强", right "逆光拍摄，增加通透感". 创建一个简洁、高级的中文摄影教程书页，采用纵向排版，米白色纸张背景，配以宽裕的页边距和精致的排版，呈现极简杂志风格。页面采用单页跨页式设计，包含 5 个清晰分隔的内容区块：顶部标题栏、左侧文本栏、右侧大幅主图、左下角布光示意图，以及右下角的 2 个缩略图示例和 1 个提示框。在顶部标题栏，放置小号中文文本：“人像摄影实战指南 | Chapter 04 光线与影响的运用”。在左上方，放置一个橄榄绿色的醒目大号章节编号“04-2”，下方紧跟多行排版的黑色粗体中文标题：“自然光下的
柔美人像”。在其下方，添加较小的橄榄绿色副标题：“利用花影与漫射光
营造温柔氛围”。在副标题下方，加入一段黑色正文，描述自然环境、花卉或树影如何柔化阳光，营造出干净、柔和且富有氛围感的人像。下方创建一个橄榄绿色的“● 拍摄要点”标题，随后列出 3 条中文正文提示：1 “光线方向”，说明选择顶部或侧上方自然光，并利用花影柔化面部轮廓；2 “前景与氛围”，说明利用大面积柔和的前景花卉来构图并增加深度；3 “表情与情绪”，说明引导模特保持自然、平静的表情和放松的眼神。在页面右侧，放置一张占据右上半部分的大幅竖构图人像照片：一位年轻东亚女性的柔和、空灵近景人像，留着黑色直长发，身着淡粉色上衣，佩戴精致项链，周围环绕着大量白色绣球花，光线为漫射自然光，伴有花影和浪漫氛围，浅景深，优雅的杂志摄影风格。在主图下方，添加一行小号中文技术参数：“● 焦距：85mm   光圈：f/2.8   快门：1/640s   ISO：100   白平衡：自动”。在左下区块，放置一个圆角框，内含一张简单的黑白手绘布光示意图，标题为“● 布光示意图”。图中展示 3 个元素：左上角的太阳图标、左下角的相机图标，以及居中的女性背影草图，并配有来自太阳的虚线方向指示，以及中文标注，解释如何利用花卉将上方前侧的自然光柔化为斑驳的漫射光，同时利用花卉作为前景，通过中长焦镜头压缩空间，营造虚化效果。在右下区域，添加橄榄绿色的“● 更多尝试”标题，下方放置 2 张该女性在白花丛中的小幅竖向缩略图。每张缩略图配有简短中文说明：左侧为“侧光拍摄，光影层次更强”，右侧为“逆光拍摄，增加通透感”。在缩略图最右侧，放置一个圆角矩形提示框，标题为“✦ 小贴士”，简短建议避免正午强光直射，优先选择清晨或傍晚的柔和光线以获得更温和的画面。在左下角添加页码“086”。采用优雅的中文书籍排版，搭配橄榄绿色点缀、黑色正文、细微的灰色分割线，呈现高端出版设计、平衡的留白、逼真的印刷布局以及精致专业的书籍排版。

templates.title: Overhead Flash Money Bed Editorial

titleLocalized.zh: 俯拍闪光灯钞票床铺时尚大片

templates.prompt: A gritty flash photo shot from directly overhead of a young woman lying on a rumpled white bed, surrounded by scattered U.S. dollar bills. Her long dark black hair is spread out dramatically in all directions like a halo across the sheets. She wears a black cropped tank top or sports bra and low-rise black pants with a visible white waistband, exposing her toned midriff. Her left arm reaches straight up toward the camera with an open hand in strong foreshortened perspective, creating a dynamic in-your-face fashion editorial look. A single blurred banknote flies across the lower foreground near the lens, adding motion and depth. She wears layered silver jewelry: 2 pearl-and-silver necklaces, multiple chunky silver bangles on one wrist, and rings on her fingers. The scene includes approximately 40 scattered U.S. bills, mostly $100 notes with a few lower denominations mixed in. Use harsh direct on-camera flash, high contrast, slight wide-angle distortion, candid luxury streetwear energy, early-2000s paparazzi aesthetic, centered composition, full body cropped from mid-thigh upward, white bedding filling the background, realistic photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张从正上方俯拍的写实闪光灯照片，一名年轻女子躺在褶皱的白色床铺上，周围散落着美元钞票。她乌黑的长发像光环一样戏剧性地向四周散开，铺在床单上。她身穿黑色短款背心或运动内衣，搭配低腰黑色长裤，露出白色的腰边，展现出紧致的腰部线条。她的左臂直伸向镜头，手掌张开，呈现出强烈的透视缩短效果，营造出极具冲击力的时尚大片视觉感。一张模糊的钞票在镜头前方的近景处飞过，增加了动感与深度。她佩戴着叠搭的银饰：两条珍珠银项链、手腕上多枚厚重的银手镯以及手指上的戒指。场景中大约散落着 40 张美元钞票，主要是 100 美元面额，混杂着少量小面额钞票。采用强烈的机顶闪光灯直射，高对比度，轻微的广角畸变，充满随性的奢华街头风格，21 世纪初的狗仔队美学，居中构图，从大腿中部向上截取的全身照，白色寝具填满背景，写实摄影风格。

templates.title: Rainy Night Café 360 Panorama

titleLocalized.zh: 雨夜咖啡馆 360 度全景

templates.prompt: A warm cinematic 360-degree panoramic interior of a cozy café at night, rendered as an immersive equirectangular wide scene with slight fisheye distortion from the panoramic format. The setting is a stylish, softly lit coffee shop with polished wooden floors, curved ceiling details, hanging pendant lamps, bookshelves, plants, small tables, and large rain-speckled windows showing city lights outside. The atmosphere is amber, intimate, and realistic, like a lifestyle panorama photographed indoors on a rainy evening. Populate the scene with exactly 8 appearances of the same young woman, creating a multi-instance storytelling composition across the café. In the center foreground, one version of the woman stands closest to camera and reaches forward with both hands, offering a cup of coffee in one hand and a plate of cut fruit in the other, making direct eye-level engagement. On the far left, a second version operates an espresso machine behind the counter, dressed casually like a barista. Left of center, a third version stands reading or reviewing papers near the bookshelf. In the back center-right, a fourth version stands near a camera tripod, looking at a phone or small device as if preparing content or checking notes. Mid-right, a fifth version sits at a table holding printed pages. Right of her, a sixth version leans over to speak with a seated seventh version who is working at an open laptop with papers spread across the table. On the far right by the window, an eighth version stands in a long light-colored coat, gazing inward. Keep all 8 women visually consistent as the same person with {argument name="character appearance" default="a young East Asian woman with long wavy dark hair and a slim build"}, but vary outfit layering slightly in soft neutral loungewear and casual café attire in cream, beige, gray, and lavender tones. Include visible props: 1 espresso machine, 1 laptop, 1 camera tripod, multiple sheets of paper, 2 cups on tables plus the 1 cup being offered, and 1 small vase of flowers on the right table. Emphasize natural candid poses, environmental storytelling, realistic indoor reflections, low-key tungsten lighting, rainy window highlights, and a welcoming café-workspace mood. Style: ultra-realistic photography, high detail, soft shadows, warm color grading, documentary lifestyle realism. Aspect ratio very wide panoramic, suitable for a full panoramic background or immersive scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温暖且具有电影质感的 360 度咖啡馆室内全景图，渲染为具有沉浸感的等距柱状投影宽幅场景，因全景格式带有轻微的鱼眼畸变。场景设定为一家时尚且灯光柔和的咖啡店，铺设着抛光的木地板，拥有弧形天花板细节、悬挂的吊灯、书架、绿植、小圆桌，以及布满雨滴的大窗户，窗外透出城市灯光。氛围呈现琥珀色，私密且真实，如同在雨夜室内拍摄的生活全景照片。在场景中加入 8 个完全相同的年轻女性形象，在咖啡馆内构成多重叙事的构图。在中心前景处，其中一个女性形象离镜头最近，双手向前伸出，一手端着咖啡，另一手托着一盘切好的水果，与观者进行直接的视线交流。在最左侧，第二个女性形象在柜台后操作浓缩咖啡机，穿着休闲，如同咖啡师。左中位置，第三个女性形象站在书架旁阅读或翻阅文件。在后方中右侧，第四个女性形象站在相机三脚架旁，看着手机或小型设备，仿佛正在准备内容或查看笔记。中右侧，第五个女性形象坐在桌旁拿着打印纸。在她的右侧，第六个女性形象俯身与第七个坐在桌前、正在使用笔记本电脑并摊开文件的女性交谈。在最右侧窗边，第八个女性形象穿着长款浅色外套，向室内凝视。保持所有 8 个女性形象在视觉上的一致性，即 {argument name="character appearance" default="一位留着深色长卷发、身材苗条的年轻东亚女性"}，但服装搭配略有不同，采用奶油色、米色、灰色和薰衣草色的柔软中性居家服及休闲咖啡馆着装。包含可见道具：1 台浓缩咖啡机、1 台笔记本电脑、1 个相机三脚架、多张纸张、桌上的 2 个杯子以及正在被递出的 1 个杯子，右侧桌上还有 1 个小花瓶。强调自然的抓拍姿势、环境叙事、逼真的室内倒影、低调的钨丝灯光、雨窗高光以及温馨的咖啡馆办公氛围。风格：超写实摄影、高细节、柔和阴影、暖色调调色、纪录片式生活写实。长宽比为超宽全景，适用于全景背景或沉浸式场景。

titleLocalized.zh: 植物护肤礼盒广告

templates.prompt: Create a premium e-commerce product advertisement in a clean botanical skincare style, featuring an open gift box of {argument name="product name" default="MONSTER 皮肤精华"} centered on a light stone tabletop. The packaging is pale sage green and off-white with a minimalist luxury aesthetic, soft matte finish, and delicate watercolor leaf illustrations inside the lid and on the sachets. The box lid is open upright, showing elegant typography: the large brand line {argument name="brand text" default="MONSTER 皮肤精华"}, a secondary line {argument name="headline text" default="7天舒缓肌肤"}, smaller Chinese copy beneath, and 3 small circular feature icons aligned horizontally in the center area. Inside the box, show exactly 4 flat sheet-mask sachets stacked on the left and exactly 5 slim glass serum ampoules standing in a row on the right, each with silver caps and vertical label text. On the front lip of the box, print the same product branding in small refined type. On the right side of the composition, place exactly 3 vertically stacked line-art benefit icons with bilingual labels: a leaf icon with {argument name="benefit one" default="舒缓修护"} and the English subtitle "SOOTHING REPAIR", wavy water lines with {argument name="benefit two" default="水润保湿"} and the English subtitle "HYDRATING", and a balance scale icon with the Chinese label "平衡肌肤" and the English subtitle "BALANCE". Surround the scene with a serene natural spa environment: soft-focus green branches entering from the upper left and upper right edges, moss-covered stones on both sides, subtle leaves in the foreground, and diffused daylight on a warm ivory background. Use a balanced front-facing composition, gentle shadows, high-end commercial lighting, crisp packaging detail, muted green palette, and a calm, trustworthy, premium skincare advertisement look.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高端电商产品广告，采用清新的植物护肤风格，画面中心为一个打开的礼盒，放置在浅色石质桌面上。包装采用淡鼠尾草绿与米白色调，呈现极简奢华美学，哑光质感，盒盖内侧及小包装袋上印有精致的水彩叶片插画。盒盖直立打开，展示优雅的排版：大号品牌行 {argument name="product name" default="MONSTER 皮肤精华"}，副标题行 {argument name="headline text" default="7天舒缓肌肤"}，下方配有较小的中文文案，中心区域水平排列 3 个小型圆形功能图标。盒内左侧整齐堆叠 4 袋平铺的面膜，右侧并排竖立 5 支纤细的玻璃精华安瓶，每支均配有银色瓶盖及垂直标签文字。在礼盒前缘，印有同样精致的小号品牌标识。在构图右侧，放置 3 个垂直堆叠的线性功效图标及双语标签：叶片图标配有 {argument name="benefit one" default="舒缓修护"} 及英文副标题 "SOOTHING REPAIR"，波浪水纹图标配有 {argument name="benefit two" default="水润保湿"} 及英文副标题 "HYDRATING"，平衡秤图标配有中文标签 "平衡肌肤" 及英文副标题 "BALANCE"。场景周围营造宁静的自然水疗环境：左上角和右上角伸入虚化的绿色枝叶，两侧点缀苔藓覆盖的石块，前景布置细微叶片，暖象牙色背景下呈现柔和的漫射光。采用平衡的正视构图、柔和阴影、高端商业布光、清晰的包装细节、柔和的绿色调，打造冷静、可信且高端的护肤品广告视觉。

templates.title: Panoramic Tech Event Atrium Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 全景科技活动中庭场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic ultra-wide panoramic scene inside a modern multi-story event atrium at night, photographed like a 360-degree conference showcase with dramatic warm low-key lighting and glossy dark architectural surfaces. In the center foreground, a professional woman in a brown blazer and dark trousers stands confidently and points toward a large flat-screen display on a tripod; the screen shows a twilight city skyline over water. Behind the display is a tall illuminated backdrop with abstract flowing white light ribbons and faint constellation-like gold sparkles. The venue is filled with a seated audience arranged in rows across the background, watching the presentation. On the left foreground, 1 woman in a gray business suit stands beside a round table covered with paperwork, clipboards, a pen, and a small service bell, as if handling registration or event administration. On the right foreground, there are 4 women gathered around two small round tables demonstrating products and hospitality items: 1 athletic woman in a fitted top holds a VR headset, 1 casually dressed woman in a light hoodie holds a controller, 1 woman in a cream cardigan works with cups and utensils, and 1 woman in a light dress stands nearby holding a phone or small object. The right-side tables contain exactly 11 visible items of note: 1 glowing glass orb lamp, 2 VR headsets, 1 rectangular product box, 1 metallic thermos or coffee pot, and 6 white teacups arranged in a row. The scene should feel like an upscale tech lifestyle launch, blending business presentation, immersive gadgets, and cafe service in one space. Use realistic human proportions, documentary-style staging, polished corporate event photography, subtle reflections on the floor, deep depth, and a seamless extra-wide panorama composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级的超广角全景场景，位于夜晚现代化的多层活动中庭内，拍摄效果如同 360 度会议展示，采用戏剧性的暖色调低调照明和光亮的深色建筑表面。在前景中央，一位身穿棕色西装外套和深色长裤的职业女性自信地站立，指向三脚架上的大型平板显示器；屏幕上显示着水面上的暮色城市天际线。显示器后方是一个高大的发光背景板，上面有抽象的流动白色光带和淡淡的星座般金色闪光。场地背景中坐满了成排的观众，正在观看演示。左侧前景中，1 位身穿灰色商务套装的女性站在一张圆桌旁，桌上放着文件、剪贴板、一支笔和一个小型服务铃，仿佛正在处理注册或活动行政事务。右侧前景中，4 位女性聚集在两张小圆桌旁展示产品和接待用品：1 位穿着修身上衣的运动型女性拿着 VR 头显，1 位穿着休闲浅色连帽衫的女性拿着控制器，1 位穿着米色开衫的女性正在摆弄杯子和餐具，另有 1 位身穿浅色连衣裙的女性站在附近，拿着手机或小物件。右侧桌子上共有 11 件显眼的物品：1 个发光的玻璃球灯、2 个 VR 头显、1 个长方形产品盒、1 个金属保温瓶或咖啡壶，以及 6 个排成一行的白色茶杯。整个场景应呈现出高端科技生活方式发布会的氛围，将商务演示、沉浸式小工具和咖啡服务融为一体。使用逼真的人体比例、纪录片风格的布景、精致的企业活动摄影效果、地面上的微妙倒影、深邃的景深以及无缝的超广角全景构图。

templates.title: Cyberpunk AI Typeface Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克 AI 字体海报

templates.prompt: A vertical cyberpunk promotional poster for a custom sci-fi display typeface, set in a neon-drenched future city at sunset. The composition is dominated at the top by huge metallic 3D title text reading AI 超世代, with the English letters "AI" above the Chinese characters, all rendered in a heavy steel mecha-style black font with beveled edges, chrome reflections, deep gunmetal surfaces, electric blue inner glow, cyan rim lighting, and sharp industrial geometry. Below the title, in the foreground, a cute chibi robot mascot stands heroically in the center, white armored body with black joints, glossy black digital face screen, bright cyan glowing eyes with one eye winking, open smiling mouth, gold headphone-like ear discs, and a glowing triangular chest emblem, raising one fist triumphantly while stepping forward. Surrounding it are 6 supporting robot characters and drones: 1 cat-eared chibi robot at bottom left with pink paw pads and joyful glowing face, 1 rabbit-eared chibi robot at bottom right running forward, 1 boxy utility robot vehicle at far bottom right with a small digital face, 1 spherical drone at upper left, 1 spherical drone at upper right, and 1 larger flying robot at mid-left. The background is a dense futuristic city canyon with tall skyscrapers on both sides, elevated roads, holographic billboards, glowing signage, and atmospheric perspective fading into the bright center. Include 3 clearly visible billboard screens: 1 pink neon cat-themed billboard on the left, 1 blue holographic robot schematic billboard on the upper right, and 1 purple neon billboard on the lower right. The street is glossy and reflective with luminous circuit-like lane markings and cyan-magenta light streaks. Use a dramatic low-angle perspective, centered symmetrical poster layout, high contrast, vibrant cyan, magenta, purple, orange, and gold lighting, polished anime-meets-3D illustration style, cinematic sunset clouds, energetic, playful, futuristic, adorable yet epic tech-branding aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版赛博朋克宣传海报，用于展示定制的科幻显示字体，背景设定在日落时分霓虹闪烁的未来城市。构图顶部由巨大的金属质感 3D 标题文字“AI 超世代”占据，英文“AI”位于汉字上方，整体呈现出厚重的钢制机甲风格黑色字体，带有斜角边缘、铬合金反射、深枪灰色表面、电光蓝内发光、青色轮廓光以及锐利的工业几何造型。标题下方的前景中心，一个可爱的 Q 版机器人吉祥物正英勇地站立着，它拥有白色装甲机身和黑色关节、光滑的黑色数字面屏、明亮的青色发光双眼（其中一只眼睛在眨眼）、张开的笑脸、金色的耳机状耳盘以及发光的三角形胸章，正举起一只拳头欢呼并向前迈步。周围环绕着 6 个辅助机器人角色和无人机：左下角有一个带有粉色肉垫和欢快发光表情的猫耳 Q 版机器人，右下角有一个正在奔跑的兔耳 Q 版机器人，右下角远端有一个带有小数字脸的方形多功能机器人车辆，左上角和右上角各有一个球形无人机，左中位置有一个较大的飞行机器人。背景是密集的未来城市峡谷，两侧耸立着高楼大厦、高架道路、全息广告牌、发光标牌，大气透视感向明亮的中心逐渐淡出。画面中包含 3 个清晰可见的广告牌：左侧是一个粉色霓虹猫主题广告牌，右上角是一个蓝色全息机器人结构图广告牌，右下角是一个紫色霓虹广告牌。街道光滑且具有反射感，带有发光的电路状车道标记以及青色与洋红色的光束。采用戏剧性的低角度透视，居中对称的海报布局，高对比度，充满活力的青色、洋红色、紫色、橙色和金色灯光，精致的动漫与 3D 插画风格，电影般的日落云层，展现出充满活力、俏皮、未来感且可爱又宏大的科技品牌美学。

templates.title: Fashion Portrait at a Waterfall

titleLocalized.zh: 瀑布前的时尚人像

templates.prompt: A cinematic fashion photograph of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} standing on a wet dark rock ledge in front of a towering waterfall inside a rocky gorge. Full-body shot, wide horizontal composition, subject placed slightly right of center, with the waterfall occupying most of the left and center background as a huge curtain of white rushing water and mist. The scene feels moody, elegant, and realistic, with natural overcast lighting, cool gray tones in the environment, and subtle contrast against the warm skin tones. She has a slim athletic figure, long legs, and {argument name="hair style" default="dark hair tied in a high messy ponytail"}. Her face is turned slightly to the side for a composed editorial pose. She wears a {argument name="top color" default="dark brown"} asymmetrical one-shoulder ruched crop top, a {argument name="bottom style" default="beige high-waisted wrap mini skirt with a thin belt and short built-in shorts"}, and strappy high-heel sandals. Her skin and outfit are slightly wet from the spray. Pose with one leg extended forward, hips angled, one arm relaxed by her side, the other resting naturally, creating a confident luxury fashion-editorial silhouette. Background details include 1 large waterfall, 1 slick black rock wall on the right, and 1 wet reflective stone platform underfoot. Ultra-realistic photography, high detail, shallow depth of field but with the waterfall still recognizable, soft mist, water droplets, dramatic natural texture, premium magazine shoot aesthetic, muted earthy palette, no text, no extra people, no props.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的时尚摄影作品，画面中一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 站在岩石峡谷内一座高耸瀑布前的湿润深色岩石平台上。全身照，宽幅横向构图，主体略微偏向画面右侧，瀑布作为巨大的白色湍流和水雾幕墙占据了背景的左侧和中心大部分区域。场景氛围忧郁、优雅且写实，采用自然阴天光线，环境呈现冷灰色调，与温暖的肤色形成微妙对比。她身材苗条健美，双腿修长，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="扎成高马尾的深色长发"}。她的脸部略微侧转，呈现出从容的时尚大片姿态。她身穿一件 {argument name="top color" default="深棕色"} 不对称单肩褶皱短款上衣，搭配一条 {argument name="bottom style" default="米色高腰裹身迷你裙，配有细腰带和内置短裤"}，以及系带高跟凉鞋。她的皮肤和服装因水雾而略显湿润。她的一条腿向前伸展，臀部微侧，一只手臂自然垂在身侧，另一只手臂自然放置，勾勒出自信的奢华时尚大片轮廓。背景细节包括 1 座大型瀑布、右侧 1 面光滑的黑色岩壁以及脚下 1 个湿润且具有反光效果的石台。超写实摄影，高细节，浅景深但瀑布依然清晰可辨，柔和的水雾，水滴，极具质感的自然纹理，高级杂志拍摄美学，柔和的大地色调，无文字，无无关人员，无道具。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Vanity Mirror Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹梳妆镜前的赛博朋克少女

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style cyberpunk dressing-room scene viewed from slightly behind a young woman seated at a vanity with a three-panel mirror. She has a short bob haircut in {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"}, with a black X-shaped hair clip on the side, pale skin, and a slim build. Her face is mostly hidden by angle and reflection composition. She wears a futuristic black, white, and neon-accented streetwear jacket with a hood, tech patches, straps, and glossy materials over a revealing top, plus black thigh-highs. Large RGB-lit over-ear headphones rest around her neck, glowing in magenta, cyan, and green. One visible upper arm has luminous holographic tattoo-like circuitry patterns in pink and blue. The mirror creates an infinite reflection tunnel of her repeated image receding into the distance, with at least 8 visible repeated reflections of her head and shoulders in the center panels. In the right mirror panel, her reflected pose shows one hand lifted near her mouth in a thoughtful, slightly shy gesture. The vanity surface is crowded with cosmetics and desk items: around 20 visible objects including lipstick tubes, makeup brushes in holders, perfume or skincare bottles, compact cases, small jars, a keyboard with pink backlighting, and a smartphone or small display device. Add a small round neon cat-face desk clock or speaker on the front right corner glowing cyan and pink. Surround the room with shelves filled with anime figurines and collectible statues on both left and right sides, visible in the background and edges of frame. Lighting is moody and cinematic with saturated purple, pink, and electric blue neon, glossy reflections on glass and plastic, soft bloom, and a cozy futuristic gamer-bedroom atmosphere. Composition should feel intimate, polished, and luxurious, with the seated character centered toward the lower middle, the tri-fold mirror dominating the scene, and the infinite mirror corridor drawing the eye deep into the image. Ultra-detailed, sharp focus on foreground objects and reflections, premium anime illustration, cyberpunk beauty aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫风格赛博朋克梳妆室夜景，画面中心是一位留着短波波头的年轻女性，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和粉色"}，大部分视角从背后拍摄，她正坐在化妆台前，面对着一面三折镜。她的面部因角度和构图而大部分被遮挡，场景侧重于氛围、造型和倒影，而非身份刻画。她穿着一件充满未来感的黑白配色连帽街头风夹克，带有霓虹装饰、层叠绑带、光泽材质和机能风细节，脖子上挂着一副巨大的 RGB 灯效耳机。她的发侧可见一个黑色 X 形发夹，裸露的一侧上臂显示出粉色和青色的发光全息电路纹身图案。三折镜在中间镜面创造出无限延伸的倒影隧道，重复着她坐着的姿态以及远处蓝光笼罩的房间；左侧镜面显示她的后脑勺和夹克背面，右侧镜面则呈现出她四分之三侧面的倒影，她正若有所思地轻触嘴唇。桌面上摆放着 20 件清晰可见的梳妆及桌面物品：1 个紧凑型键盘、1 个小饮料罐、1 部带有明亮动漫风格锁屏界面的智能手机、1 个圆形发光猫耳桌面时钟或音箱、2 个圆形化妆粉饼盒、3 个高瓶身化妆品、4 支竖立的口红或唇彩、3 支插在笔筒里的化妆刷、2 支笔状化妆工具，以及 2 个额外的小型化妆容器。周围的架子上展示着 8 个清晰可见的动漫角色手办或玩偶，强化了御宅族收藏家卧室工作室的氛围。运用洋红色、紫罗兰色和电光蓝的戏剧性霓虹灯光，呈现光泽倒影、电影级光晕、丰富的环境细节，以及受高端游戏原画启发、精致且充满未来感的动漫插画风格。整体氛围应显得私密、时尚、略带忧郁，并深度沉浸在 {argument name="room theme" default="收藏家赛博朋克卧室梳妆台"} 的自我表达之中。

templates.title: Cute Mermaid Puppy Undersea Game Start Screen

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的美人鱼小狗海底游戏启动界面

templates.prompt: A bright, whimsical 3D underwater game start screen in a rounded-rectangle app window, designed like a polished children's casual game landing page. The scene is a colorful seabed with warm sun rays streaming down through clear turquoise water, soft floating bubbles throughout, and a sandy ocean floor covered with pastel coral and shells. On the left side, large bold Chinese title text dominates the composition: “泡泡湾人鱼狗救援队”, with a smaller line above it reading “海底救援开始啦” and a subtitle below reading “和小汪一起收集贝壳、帮助海龟、点亮灯塔。” Keep all text in clean modern UI typography, with the title in very large dark navy characters. On the right side, place a cute mermaid puppy character inspired by a preschool adventure cartoon style: a small smiling puppy with cream and light tan fur, big violet eyes, floppy ears decorated with teal accessories, a tiny purple shell necklace, and a mint-green mermaid tail, floating upright in the water. Surround the character with a magical coral reef environment containing exactly 10 prominent foreground and midground sea elements: 1 purple rock arch on the far left, 1 pink starfish attached to the left coral, 1 lavender clam shell near the bottom left, 1 large pink branching coral in the center foreground, 1 pink shell near the bottom right, 1 orange starfish on the sand near center-right, 1 blue porous rock on the right foreground, 1 cluster of blue tube coral at the far right, 1 tall pink-and-purple coral tower behind the character, and 1 orange flower-shaped coral beside the tower. Use a soft pastel palette of aqua, cyan, pink, lavender, peach, and coral orange, with glossy toy-like materials and gentle depth of field. Add three rounded UI buttons aligned horizontally near the bottom left-center: a yellow primary button labeled “开始” with a play icon, a white secondary button labeled “选关” with a circular target icon, and a white secondary button labeled “贴纸” with a star icon. Also add one small circular settings button with a gear icon in the top-right corner. Overall style: premium children’s mobile game splash screen, playful, comforting, cinematic lighting, high-end 3D illustration, friendly and inviting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、奇幻的 3D 海底游戏启动界面，置于圆角矩形 App 窗口中，设计风格如同精致的儿童休闲游戏登录页面。场景为色彩斑斓的海底，温暖的阳光透过清澈的绿松石色海水倾泻而下，周围漂浮着柔和的气泡，沙质海床上覆盖着柔和色调的珊瑚和贝壳。在左侧，醒目的大号中文标题文字占据了构图中心：“泡泡湾人鱼狗救援队”，上方有一行较小的文字“海底救援开始啦”，下方副标题为“和小汪一起收集贝壳、帮助海龟、点亮灯塔。”所有文字均采用简洁现代的 UI 字体，标题使用非常大的深海军蓝色字符。在右侧，放置一个灵感源自学龄前冒险动画风格的可爱美人鱼小狗角色：一只面带微笑的小狗，拥有奶油色和浅棕色皮毛，大大的紫罗兰色眼睛，垂耳上装饰着青色配饰，戴着一枚紫色小贝壳项链，长着薄荷绿色的美人鱼尾巴，在水中垂直漂浮。角色周围环绕着神奇的珊瑚礁环境，包含 10 个显眼的前景和中景海洋元素：最左侧 1 个紫色岩石拱门，左侧珊瑚上附着 1 个粉色海星，左下角 1 个淡紫色蛤蜊壳，前景中央 1 个大型粉色分枝珊瑚，右下角 1 个粉色贝壳，中右侧沙滩上 1 个橙色海星，右侧前景 1 个蓝色多孔岩石，最右侧 1 簇蓝色管状珊瑚，角色后方 1 座高大的粉紫色珊瑚塔，以及塔旁 1 个橙色花朵状珊瑚。使用水绿色、青色、粉色、淡紫色、桃色和珊瑚橙色的柔和色调，呈现出光泽的玩具质感和柔和的景深效果。在左下方水平排列三个圆角 UI 按钮：一个带有播放图标的黄色主按钮，标注为“开始”；一个带有圆形目标图标的白色次要按钮，标注为“选关”；以及一个带有星星图标的白色次要按钮，标注为“贴纸”。此外，在右上角添加一个带有齿轮图标的小型圆形设置按钮。整体风格：高端儿童手游启动画面，俏皮、治愈、电影级光影、高端 3D 插画，友好且引人入胜。
