templates.prompt: A cute side-view underwater casual game start screen in a soft pastel 3D cartoon style, designed like a polished children's browser game interface. The scene shows a bright ocean floor with sun rays streaming down through clear blue water, floating bubbles, distant tiny fish silhouettes, and a dreamy coral reef environment filled with rounded pink, purple, blue, and mint corals, sea plants, shells, rocks, and sandy ground. Slightly left of center, a small mermaid puppy character inspired by a rescue-dog cartoon floats happily underwater, with a puppy face, big sparkling eyes, floppy ears, a tiny tiara-like head accessory, and a fish tail instead of hind legs, facing forward with a cheerful expression. On the right stands a whimsical candy-like coral lighthouse shaped like a pink-and-cream seashell tower with a glowing lantern room at the top, a pearl on the roof, circular shell windows, a small balcony, a purple door, and decorative coral details around the base. Overlay game UI elements directly on the scene: at top left, 2 rounded white pill buttons, the first reading "去灯塔" and the second showing "0/3"; at top right, 1 circular white pause button with a pause icon. Near the lighthouse, show 4 translucent colored target rings floating over interactive spots: 1 pink ring near the upper middle windows, 1 yellow ring near the upper right lantern area, 1 pale blue ring over a lower right shell window, and 1 large white-outlined ring around a purple jellyfish near the lower center-left. Add 3 collectible pearl-in-shell objects visible in the scene: 1 glowing golden pearl in an open shell near the center, 1 small dark blue pearl shell near the lighthouse base, and 1 red pearl shell resting on the bottom center UI panel. At the bottom center, place 3 rounded white control hint buttons with Chinese text: "方向键 / WASD", "空格 / 回车：放珠", and "Esc 回地图". Include a large semi-transparent rounded white panel behind the bottom controls. The overall image should feel joyful, safe, colorful, and magical, with high polish, gentle depth of field, soft lighting, glossy toy-like materials, and a kid-friendly mobile or web game aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个可爱的侧视角水下休闲游戏开始界面，采用柔和的 3D 卡通风格，设计如同精致的儿童网页游戏界面。场景展示了明亮的海底，阳光透过清澈的蓝色海水倾泻而下，伴有漂浮的气泡、远处细小的鱼群剪影，以及梦幻般的珊瑚礁环境，布满了圆润的粉色、紫色、蓝色和薄荷绿珊瑚、海草、贝壳、岩石和沙地。画面中心偏左处，一只灵感源自救援犬卡通的美人鱼小狗角色在水下快乐地漂浮，它有着小狗的脸庞、闪烁的大眼睛、耷拉的耳朵、头顶小巧的皇冠状饰品，以及代替后腿的鱼尾，正面向前方，表情欢快。右侧矗立着一座奇趣的糖果色珊瑚灯塔，形状像一座粉白相间的贝壳塔，顶部有发光的灯室、屋顶上镶嵌着一颗珍珠、圆形的贝壳窗、小阳台、紫色大门，底部装饰着珊瑚细节。游戏 UI 元素直接叠加在场景上：左上角有 2 个圆润的白色胶囊按钮，第一个写着“去灯塔”，第二个显示“0/3”；右上角有 1 个带有暂停图标的圆形白色暂停按钮。在灯塔附近，展示 4 个漂浮在交互点上的半透明彩色目标环：1 个粉色环靠近中上部窗户，1 个黄色环靠近右上角灯室区域，1 个淡蓝色环覆盖在右下角贝壳窗上，以及 1 个带有白色大轮廓的环围绕着中下部偏左的一只紫色水母。场景中可见 3 个可收集的贝壳珍珠物品：1 颗发光的金色珍珠位于中心处打开的贝壳中，1 个深蓝色小珍珠贝壳位于灯塔底部，以及 1 个红色珍珠贝壳放置在底部中央的 UI 面板上。在底部中央，放置 3 个圆润的白色操作提示按钮，文字分别为：“方向键 / WASD”、“空格 / 回车：放珠”和“Esc 回地图”。在底部操作按钮后方添加一个大型半透明圆润白色面板。整体画面应给人以快乐、安全、多彩且神奇的感觉，具有高度的精致感、柔和的景深、柔和的光影、光泽的玩具质感，以及适合儿童的移动端或网页游戏美学。

templates.title: Cute Underwater Mermaid Puppy Game UI

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的水下美人鱼小狗游戏 UI

templates.prompt: A cute children’s 3D game screenshot in a bright underwater world, shown from a slightly elevated third-person view inside a colorful seaweed maze. The scene has a soft, glossy, toy-like look with rounded shapes, smooth clay-style materials, pastel-saturated colors, and cinematic god rays shining down through clear blue water. In the maze, a small mermaid puppy inspired by Coral from Paw Patrol stands near the lower-left quadrant, smiling with a friendly heroic expression. She has a light tan puppy face, big expressive eyes, pink-purple mermaid-themed accessories, and a small mermaid tail, designed in an adorable family-friendly animated style. Near her on the sandy seabed is a visible pair of scissors, the hidden-object target. The maze walls are made of dense green and teal seaweed with rounded pebble borders, creating winding paths across the center of the scene. The seabed is pale golden sand with caustic light patterns, scattered tiny shells and stones, and many floating air bubbles. Around the maze are whimsical coral-rock formations in blue, purple, and turquoise, including 1 shell-shaped treasure alcove on the left with a starfish above it and 1 large open pink clam shell with a pearl on the right. On the right side of the play area are 2 turtles: 1 larger light-green turtle and 1 smaller brown-green turtle, plus 3 separate clumps of upright sea plants in the open sand. Add a translucent white cross-shaped path marker or objective indicator over the center of the maze. Present it as a polished mobile game interface framed by a rounded rectangular screen. Include 6 UI elements total: top left a pill-shaped white label with the Chinese text “找剪刀”, next to it a white rounded counter reading “0/3”, top right a circular white pause button with a pause icon, and along the bottom center 3 white rounded instruction buttons labeled “方向键 / WASD”, “空格 / 回车：剪刀”, and “Esc 回地图”. The overall mood is comforting, playful, magical, and reassuring, like an educational hide-and-seek mini-game for a sick child, with high-end casual game art and a clean app-store-quality presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的儿童 3D 游戏截图，展现了一个明亮的水下世界，视角为略微俯视的第三人称视角，场景位于色彩斑斓的海草迷宫内。画面具有柔和、光亮、类似玩具的质感，形状圆润，材质呈现平滑的粘土风格，色彩采用高饱和度的柔和色调，电影级的丁达尔效应光束透过清澈的蓝色海水照射下来。在迷宫中，一只灵感来自《汪汪队立大功》中 Coral 的小美人鱼小狗站在左下角附近，脸上带着友好且英勇的微笑。她有着浅棕色的小狗脸庞、大而富有表现力的眼睛、粉紫色的美人鱼主题配饰以及一条小美人鱼尾巴，设计风格为讨人喜欢的合家欢动画风。在她身旁的沙质海床上，可以看到一把剪刀，即隐藏物品的目标。迷宫墙壁由茂密的绿色和蓝绿色海草构成，边缘带有圆润的鹅卵石，在场景中心形成了蜿蜒的路径。海床是浅金色的沙地，上面有焦散光斑、散落的小贝壳和石块，以及许多漂浮的气泡。迷宫周围是奇幻的蓝、紫、青色珊瑚岩结构，包括左侧一个带海星的贝壳状宝藏壁龛，以及右侧一个内含珍珠的大型张开粉色蛤蜊。游戏区域右侧有 2 只海龟：1 只较大的浅绿色海龟和 1 只较小的棕绿色海龟，此外在开阔的沙地上还有 3 丛独立的直立海生植物。在迷宫中心上方添加一个半透明的白色十字形路径标记或目标指示器。将其呈现为由圆角矩形屏幕框住的精致手机游戏界面。总共包含 6 个 UI 元素：左上角是一个药丸形状的白色标签，上面写有中文“找剪刀”，旁边是一个白色的圆角计数器，显示“0/3”；右上角是一个带有暂停图标的圆形白色暂停按钮；底部中心排列着 3 个白色的圆角指令按钮，分别标注为“方向键 / WASD”、“空格 / 回车：剪刀”和“Esc 回地图”。整体氛围舒适、俏皮、充满魔力且令人安心，就像为生病的孩子准备的教育类捉迷藏小游戏，具有高端休闲游戏美术水准和简洁的应用商店级展示效果。

templates.title: Cute Mermaid Puppy Underwater Game Screen

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的美人鱼小狗水下游戏画面

templates.prompt: A bright, whimsical underwater 2D game scene in a polished children’s animation style, shown as a full-screen level screenshot inside a rounded-rectangle game viewport. The setting is a colorful coral reef with a sandy seabed and a pale stone path winding from the foreground into the distance at center, creating depth. Sunbeams stream down through clear blue water from above, with many small air bubbles floating throughout the scene. Surround the path with soft, toy-like coral formations and sea plants in pastel pink, peach, lavender, turquoise, and mint, plus rocky ledges on both sides. Place 2 starfish in the foreground, one purple on the lower left rock and one pink-orange on the lower right. Add 2 translucent pink jellyfish, one left of center and one right of center, both gently glowing. Scatter 6 glowing pink clam shells along and beside the path, each emitting a soft magical aura. Add 4 golden-orange collectible shells with a pearl-like center, positioned near the middle play area. Include 2 large purple balloon-like jelly obstacles with white outlines and short dangling tentacles, one in the lower center-left and one in the mid-right. Near the left-center foreground, place a cute mermaid puppy character inspired by a preschool cartoon rescue dog: small smiling puppy face, big expressive eyes, light brown and cream fur, pink head accessory, teal mermaid tail, playful cheerful pose as if moving forward. On the right side, add a faint dashed circular target marker over the environment. Overlay simple mobile-game UI in Chinese: at the top left, two white rounded pill buttons, one reading "收贝壳" and one reading "1/5"; at the top right, a white circular pause button with "II". At the bottom center, place 3 white rounded instruction buttons with blue-gray text: "方向键 / WASD", "空格 / 回车：泡泡", and "Esc 回地图". Make the whole image glossy, soft-lit, kid-friendly, high-saturation but pastel-balanced, with a dreamy fantasy reef atmosphere and clean casual game-art composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、奇幻的 2D 水下游戏场景，采用精致的儿童动画风格，呈现为圆角矩形游戏视口内的全屏关卡截图。背景为色彩斑斓的珊瑚礁，沙质海床上一条浅色石子路从前景蜿蜒延伸至画面中心，营造出空间深度感。阳光从清澈的蓝色水面上方倾泻而下，许多小气泡在场景中漂浮。道路两侧环绕着柔软、玩具般的珊瑚群和粉色、桃色、淡紫色、绿松石色及薄荷色的海生植物，两侧还有岩石架。在前景放置 2 只海星，左下角岩石上是一只紫色海星，右下角是一只粉橙色海星。添加 2 只半透明的粉色水母，分别位于画面中左和中右位置，散发着柔和的光芒。在道路沿线及周边散落 6 个发光的粉色蛤蜊壳，每个都散发着柔和的魔法光晕。在中间游戏区域附近放置 4 个带有珍珠中心、金橙色的可收集贝壳。在左下中心和中右位置各添加一个大型紫色气球状水母障碍物，带有白色轮廓和短小的触须。在左中前景处，放置一个受学龄前动画救援犬启发的可爱的美人鱼小狗角色：小巧的微笑狗脸、大而有神的眼睛、浅棕色和奶油色皮毛、粉色头饰、青色美人鱼尾巴，姿态俏皮欢快，仿佛正在向前移动。在右侧，在环境上方添加一个淡淡的虚线圆形目标标记。叠加简单的中文手机游戏 UI：左上角有两个白色圆角胶囊按钮，分别显示“收贝壳”和“1/5”；右上角有一个带有“II”的白色圆形暂停按钮。底部中心放置 3 个白色圆角指令按钮，文字为蓝灰色：“方向键 / WASD”、“空格 / 回车：泡泡”和“Esc 回地图”。整体画面光泽感强、光线柔和、适合儿童，色彩饱和度高且平衡，营造出梦幻般的珊瑚礁氛围，构图简洁，符合休闲游戏艺术风格。

templates.title: Insert Reference Person Into Shibuya Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 将参考人物置入涩谷场景

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the base scene, naturally insert the woman from REFERENCE_0 into the busy Shibuya Scramble Crossing crowd as a photorealistic passerby. Match the lighting, perspective, lens feel, scale, and street-photo realism of REFERENCE_1, and keep her outfit, bag, and overall appearance consistent with REFERENCE_0. Place her in the foreground slightly left of center, standing among the pedestrians and facing slightly to the left with a relaxed casual posture, as if she was originally photographed there. Integrate her with realistic shadows, color matching, edge blending, and partial crowd occlusion so she does not look pasted in. Preserve the existing city background, signage, and crowd composition from REFERENCE_1.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为基础场景，将 REFERENCE_0 中的女性自然地插入到涩谷十字路口繁忙的人群中，使其成为一名照片级逼真的路人。匹配 REFERENCE_1 的光影、透视、镜头感、比例及街拍真实感，并保持其服装、包袋和整体外观与 REFERENCE_0 一致。将她放置在前景偏左的位置，置身于行人之中，身体微向左侧，姿态自然放松，仿佛她原本就在那里拍摄的一样。通过逼真的阴影、色彩匹配、边缘融合以及部分人群遮挡处理，使她与环境完美融合，避免产生“抠图感”。保留 REFERENCE_1 中现有的城市背景、标志牌及人群构图。

templates.title: Watercolor Family Riverside Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩风格家庭河畔自拍

templates.prompt: A warm, cheerful watercolor-style family selfie at a shallow riverside on a sunny day, painted with soft washes, delicate paper texture, and gently blended pastel tones. Three people are visible. In the left foreground, a smiling mother leans very close to the camera, filling much of the frame with a friendly face, wearing a dark baseball cap and showing soft pink cheeks, natural makeup, and short reddish-brown hair peeking out. In the upper center, a father stands slightly behind her in the water, smiling directly at the camera, with short dark hair, faint facial hair, a dark long-sleeve rash guard, and one hand raised in a peace sign. On the right, a small child in a pale woven sunhat and coral-pink dress leans in toward the camera and makes peace signs with both hands; the child’s face is obscured by a simple square censor block in a flat tan color. The background shows 1 blue sky with fluffy white clouds, 1 line of green trees, and sunlit shallow water with gentle reflections. Composition like an affectionate vacation snapshot taken at arm’s length, slightly wide-angle perspective, bright natural light, wholesome family outing mood, polished and flattering portrait treatment, soft glowing skin, subtle blush, clean details, and a hand-painted illustration finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨、欢快的水彩风格家庭自拍，背景为阳光明媚日子的浅水河畔，采用柔和的渲染、细腻的纸张纹理以及自然融合的柔和色调绘制。画面中可见三人。左侧前景中，一位面带微笑的母亲非常靠近镜头，友好的面容占据了大部分画面，她戴着深色棒球帽，脸颊泛着柔和的粉色，妆容自然，短红棕色头发从帽檐下露出。上方中央，父亲站在她身后的水中，直视镜头微笑，留着深色短发，有淡淡的胡茬，身穿深色长袖防晒衣，一只手比出剪刀手。右侧，一个戴着浅色编织遮阳帽、身穿珊瑚粉色连衣裙的小孩向镜头靠拢，双手比出剪刀手；小孩的脸部被一个平坦的棕褐色方形遮挡块遮住。背景展示了 1 片蓝天和蓬松的白云、1 排绿树，以及带有柔和倒影的阳光浅水区。构图如同伸手拍摄的亲密度假快照，略带广角视角，明亮的自然光，充满温馨的家庭出游氛围，经过润色和美化的肖像处理，皮肤柔和发光，带有淡淡的腮红，细节清晰，呈现出手绘插画的质感。

templates.title: Dark Japanese Alt-Rock Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日系暗黑风格另类摇滚海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic Japanese alternative rock album promotional poster in a dark cinematic photorealistic style, vertical 2:3 composition, with three young male rock band members posed heroically in the foreground. The center figure stands slightly lower and closest to camera, wearing a black leather biker jacket open at the chest, layered necklaces, a black choker, pale skin, shaggy black hair, and a moody rebellious expression. The left figure is tall and slim with messy ash-blond hair, extensive neck and chest tattoos, a distressed black shirt under a black leather jacket, layered chains, and a belt. The right figure is tall and slim with tousled light brown hair, a gray distressed military-style jacket over a black skull graphic shirt, layered necklaces, rings, visible hand tattoos, and a belt. Behind them is a ruined urban battlefield at dusk or night with smoke, sparks, tattered flags, birds or crows in the sky, crumbling buildings, backlight halos behind the two standing figures, and a gritty apocalyptic atmosphere. Add scratched film texture, cracked glass overlays, dust, embers, and high-contrast moody lighting with desaturated blacks, charcoal gray, sepia bronze, and muted steel tones. Include 13 visible text blocks integrated like a premium music poster: at the very top, small English text reading "ALTERNATIVE ROCK NEW ERA BEGINS"; 3 mid-poster song callouts, left "地上" with romanization "CHIJOU" and two lines of small Japanese copy beneath, center "解放" with romanization "KAIHOU" and two lines of small Japanese copy beneath, right "掲げろ" with romanization "KAKAGERO" and two lines of small Japanese copy beneath; one huge central Japanese headline reading "この声が、時代を変える。"; beneath it one English line "ALTERNATIVE ROCK"; beneath that one Japanese tagline line "三つの歌が、ひとつの未来を創る—"; beneath that one English tagline line "3 SONGS. 3 SOULS. 1 REVOLUTION"; then 3 bottom release blocks labeled "解放", "地上", and "掲げろ", each with its romanization and the date "2025.06.01 RELEASE"; and at the very bottom a boxed banner reading "NEW ALBUM - 2025.06.01 ON SALE". Make the typography metallic, weathered, and luminous, with the large Japanese headline dominating the lower middle. The overall feeling should be epic, rebellious, emotional, and like a high-budget visual key art poster for a {argument name="music project" default="Japanese alternative rock album"} titled around the songs {argument name="song title 1" default="地上"}, {argument name="song title 2" default="解放"}, and {argument name="song title 3" default="掲げろ"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感十足的暗黑写实风格日系另类摇滚专辑宣传海报，采用 2:3 纵向构图，前景为三位年轻摇滚乐队成员的英雄式姿态。中间的人物位置略低且最靠近镜头，身穿黑色皮夹克，敞开胸口，佩戴叠层项链和黑色颈圈，皮肤苍白，留着凌乱的黑色长发，表情叛逆忧郁。左侧人物身材高瘦，留着凌乱的灰金色头发，颈部和胸部有大面积纹身，黑色皮夹克内搭做旧黑色衬衫，佩戴叠层链条和腰带。右侧人物身材高瘦，留着蓬松的浅棕色头发，身穿灰色做旧军装风格夹克，内搭黑色骷髅图案衬衫，佩戴叠层项链和戒指，手部纹身可见，并系有腰带。背景是黄昏或夜晚的废墟战场，伴有烟雾、火星、破烂的旗帜、空中的鸟群或乌鸦、坍塌的建筑物，两位站立的人物身后有逆光光晕，呈现出粗粝的末日氛围。添加划痕胶片质感、碎玻璃叠加效果、灰尘、余烬，以及高对比度的忧郁灯光，色调为去饱和的黑色、炭灰色、棕褐色和柔和的钢灰色。海报中需集成 13 处可见的文字块，呈现高级音乐海报质感：最顶部为小号英文文本“ALTERNATIVE ROCK NEW ERA BEGINS”；海报中部有 3 处歌曲标注，左侧为“地上”（罗马音“CHIJOU”）及下方两行小号日文文案，中间为“解放”（罗马音“KAIHOU”）及下方两行小号日文文案，右侧为“掲げろ”（罗马音“KAKAGERO”）及下方两行小号日文文案；中部有一行巨大的日文标题“この声が、時代を変える。”；下方为一行英文“ALTERNATIVE ROCK”；再下方为一行日文标语“三つの歌が、ひとつの未来を創る—”；接着是一行英文标语“3 SONGS. 3 SOULS. 1 REVOLUTION”；底部为 3 个发行信息块，分别标注“解放”、“地上”和“掲げろ”，每个均包含罗马音及日期“2025.06.01 RELEASE”；最底部为一个盒状横幅，写有“NEW ALBUM - 2025.06.01 ON SALE”。字体设计需呈现金属感、风化感和发光效果，巨大的日文标题应占据中下部视觉中心。整体氛围应史诗、叛逆、充满情感，如同高预算的视觉主打海报，用于 {argument name="music project" default="日系另类摇滚专辑"}，歌曲标题围绕 {argument name="song title 1" default="地上"}、{argument name="song title 2" default="解放"} 和 {argument name="song title 3" default="掲げろ"} 展开。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Bureau Role Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻局角色设定表

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base character sheet, redesign the same male student into a fictional Japanese dark-bureaucratic fantasy worldbuilding dossier. Keep his core body type, hairstyle, and face structure consistent, but replace the school uniform concept with 3 official role variants presented as a professional concept-art document on aged white paper with thin grid lines, black ink, muted grayscale, and deep red accent marks. Create a 3-column layout labeled 01, 02, and 03, each showing full-body front, side, and back views of the same character reimagined for a different job. Role 01 should be a tax collection officer in a long black coat with hanging paperwork, armband, shoulder straps, leather belts, and a compact case. Role 02 should be an arcane audit scribe with glasses, layered robe-like outerwear over formal clothes, dangling seals and inspection documents, a ledger or clipboard, writing tools, and a briefcase. Role 03 should be a sealed artifact courier with a military-style cap, face covering, heavier protective coat, straps, tags, and a large transport case plus a backpack-like cargo unit. Add vertical Japanese side notes beside each role, dense bureaucratic labels, official insignias, stamps, serial numbers, and small English sublabels for the role names. At the bottom, include 3 equipment sections, one under each column: for role 01 show exactly 3 items — a hard case, an official stamp, and 2 paper forms; for role 02 show exactly 4 items — a black device/ledger panel, a set of 4 pens, a tray of 6 seal sticks or cartridges, and 1 blue handbook; for role 03 show exactly 4 items — a transport chest, 2 paper tags/forms, 3 hanging sealing tools, and 2 circular sealing tools plus 1 document card. Include an additional footer strip with exactly 4 color swatches, exactly 3 insignia emblems, a notice block, and publication/record information boxes. Overall style: high-end anime concept sheet mixed with occult government archive design, meticulous costume detailing, restrained composition, realistic textile rendering, and a serious institutional mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为基础角色设定，将同一名男学生重新设计为虚构的日本暗黑官僚奇幻世界观档案。保持其核心体型、发型和面部结构一致，但将校服概念替换为 3 种官方角色变体，并以专业概念艺术文档的形式呈现，背景为带有细网格线的陈旧白纸，采用黑色墨水、柔和的灰度色调以及深红色强调标记。采用 3 列布局，分别标记为 01、02 和 03，每列展示同一角色为不同职位重新构思后的全身正视图、侧视图和背视图。角色 01 为税务征收官，身穿长款黑色大衣，带有悬挂的文件、臂章、肩带、皮带和一个紧凑型箱子。角色 02 为奥术审计书记员，佩戴眼镜，在正装外叠穿长袍式外套，带有悬挂的印章和检查文件、账本或写字板、书写工具以及公文包。角色 03 为封印文物快递员，佩戴军用风格帽子、面罩、厚重的防护外套、绑带、标签，并配有一个大型运输箱以及类似背包的货物单元。在每个角色旁边添加垂直的日语侧注、密集的官僚标签、官方徽章、印章、序列号以及角色名称的英文小副标题。在底部，包含 3 个装备部分，每列下方各一个：角色 01 展示 3 件物品——一个硬质箱子、一枚官方印章和 2 份纸质表格；角色 02 展示 4 件物品——一个黑色设备/账本面板、一套 4 支笔、一个装有 6 根印章棒或墨盒的托盘以及 1 本蓝色手册；角色 03 展示 4 件物品——一个运输箱、2 个纸质标签/表格、3 个悬挂式封印工具以及 2 个圆形封印工具加 1 张文档卡。包含一个额外的页脚条，其中包含 4 个色样、3 个徽章标志、一个通知块以及出版/记录信息框。整体风格：高端动漫概念表与神秘政府档案设计相结合，服装细节考究，构图克制，织物渲染写实，具有严肃的机构氛围。

templates.title: Japanese Creator Interview Magazine Spread

titleLocalized.zh: 日本创作者访谈杂志内页设计

templates.prompt:
Create a polished two-page magazine spread in Japanese, styled like a contemporary creator profile feature in a premium design and culture magazine. The layout is a clean editorial interview spread with a white background, navy blue accents, thin rule lines, elegant typography, and a balanced grid. The overall feeling is sophisticated, modern, and slightly masculine, like a feature on a handsome AI visual creator.

On the left page, place a very large stacked English headline at the top left reading “CREATOR INTERVIEW” in bold condensed sans-serif, with small vertical issue text along the outer margin such as “VOL.23 / MAY 2024.” Beneath and across most of the left page, use a large cinematic photo of a {argument name="creator identity" default="male AI visual creator"} sitting at a desk in a dark hoodie in a moody studio workspace. The face is intentionally soft-blurred or anonymized. The room is warm and dimly lit, with multiple monitors showing image-editing or visual-generation work, a desk lamp, and walls covered in concept art, posters, sketches, and fantasy artwork. Overlay the lower-left of the photo with a large Japanese feature title in white Mincho-style serif text: “Xで世界観を育てる、AI表現の実験室。” Add smaller Japanese body text beneath introducing the account @multusdim_AI and describing an experimental AI art practice that values atmosphere, prompt design, and visual worldbuilding. At the bottom of the left page, include a horizontal block of smaller Japanese editorial text summarizing the creator’s focus and interview context.

On the right page, create 5 clearly separated editorial sections. Section 1 is the main interview column titled “INTERVIEW” at the top in blue uppercase sans-serif. Below it, format 4 Q&A entries in Japanese, each beginning with a blue “Q.” and “A.” The questions and answers should discuss the creator’s reason for posting on X, what they care about when making work, recurring motifs, and what they observe in audience reactions. Midway down this same interview column, add a large blue pull quote in Japanese with oversized quotation marks: “AIでつくるのは画像ではなく、空気ごと伝わる体験。” Section 2 is a top-right image card with a warm café portrait of a soft, elegant maid-themed woman holding a drink, paired with the visible label “MAID” and a short Japanese blurb. Section 3 is a second image card below it showing a rainy retro-futuristic city street with a car and neon reflections, labeled “RETRO FUTURE” with a short Japanese blurb. Section 4 is a third image card below that featuring a detailed steampunk city or giant clockwork structure with smoke and brass machinery, labeled “STEAMPUNK” with a short Japanese blurb. Section 5 is a fourth image card at the bottom showing a casual everyday snapshot of a young woman outdoors in warm sunset light, labeled “EVERYDAY SNAP” with a short Japanese blurb.

At the bottom of the right page, add 3 boxed information panels. The first is a “PROFILE” box with the account name “@multusdim_AI” and several lines of Japanese profile text describing an AI visual creator focused on atmosphere-rich work blending photorealism, retro future, maid aesthetics, and steampunk. The second is a “KEYWORDS” box listing exactly 6 keyword items in Japanese separated by slashes: “フォトリアル / プロンプト設計 / メイド / レトロフューチャー / スチームパンク / X運用 / AIアート” with the same editorial feel. The third is a dark blue horizontal follow banner reading “Follow: @multusdim_AI”. Add page numbers 26 and 27 at the bottom corners and small footer text like “CREATOR INTERVIEW” and “MAY 2024 / VOL.32”. Use realistic magazine print spacing, sharp editorial hierarchy, and a highly believable Japanese magazine layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一款精致的日本双页杂志内页，风格参考高端设计与文化杂志中当代的创作者专题。排版采用简洁的编辑访谈风格，配以白色背景、海军蓝点缀、细线条分割、优雅的排版以及平衡的网格系统。整体氛围精致、现代且略带阳刚之气，如同对一位帅气的 AI 视觉创作者的专题报道。

在左页左上角，放置一个非常醒目的堆叠式英文标题“CREATOR INTERVIEW”，使用粗体压缩无衬线字体，外侧页边距处添加小的垂直期号文本，如“VOL.23 / MAY 2024”。在左页下方及大部分区域，放置一张电影感十足的大图，展示一位 {argument name="creator identity" default="男性 AI 视觉创作者"} 坐在书桌前，身穿深色连帽衫，身处氛围感十足的工作室中。人物面部刻意进行柔焦或匿名化处理。房间光线温暖昏暗，多台显示器上显示着图像编辑或视觉生成的工作界面，桌上摆放着台灯，墙上贴满了概念艺术、海报、草图和奇幻艺术作品。在照片左下角叠加一个巨大的白色明朝体日文专题标题：“X で世界観を育てる、AI 表現の実験室。”（在 X 上培养世界观，AI 表达的实验室。）并在下方添加较小的日文正文，介绍账号 @multusdim_AI，描述一种重视氛围、提示词设计和视觉世界构建的实验性 AI 艺术实践。在左页底部，包含一个水平排列的较小日文编辑文本块，总结创作者的关注点和访谈背景。

在右页，创建 5 个清晰分隔的编辑板块。板块 1 是主访谈栏，顶部标题为蓝色的英文大写无衬线字体“INTERVIEW”。下方格式化 4 条日文问答，每条以蓝色的“Q.”和“A.”开头。问答内容应讨论创作者在 X 上发布作品的原因、创作时的关注点、反复出现的主题以及对观众反应的观察。在访谈栏中部，添加一个巨大的蓝色日文引语，配以超大引号：“AI でつくるのは画像ではなく、空気ごと伝わる体験。”（用 AI 创作的不仅是图像，而是能传达整个氛围的体验。）板块 2 是右上角的图片卡片，展示一张温暖的咖啡馆肖像，画面中是一位柔美优雅的女仆主题女性正拿着饮料，配有可见标签“MAID”和一段简短的日文介绍。板块 3 是下方的第二张图片卡片，展示一条雨中复古未来主义街道，有汽车和霓虹灯倒影，标注“RETRO FUTURE”及简短日文介绍。板块 4 是下方的第三张图片卡片，展示一座细节丰富的蒸汽朋克城市或巨大的发条结构，伴有烟雾和黄铜机械，标注“STEAMPUNK”及简短日文介绍。板块 5 是底部的第四张图片卡片，展示一张年轻女性在温暖夕阳下户外的日常随拍，标注“EVERYDAY SNAP”及简短日文介绍。

在右页底部，添加 3 个带边框的信息面板。第一个是“PROFILE”框，包含账号名“@multusdim_AI”和几行日文简介，描述一位专注于融合写实主义、复古未来、女仆美学和蒸汽朋克的氛围感 AI 视觉创作者。第二个是“KEYWORDS”框，列出 6 个用斜杠分隔的日文关键词：“フォトリアル / プロンプト設計 / メイド / レトロフューチャー / スチームパンク / X運用 / AIアート”（写实 / 提示词设计 / 女仆 / 复古未来 / 蒸汽朋克 / X 运营 / AI 艺术），保持同样的编辑感。第三个是深蓝色水平关注横幅，写着“Follow: @multusdim_AI”。在底部角落添加页码 26 和 27，以及小的页脚文本，如“CREATOR INTERVIEW”和“MAY 2024 / VOL.32”。使用真实的杂志印刷间距、清晰的编辑层级，打造极具信服力的日本杂志排版。

templates.title: Clay Toy Landing Page UI

titleLocalized.zh: 粘土玩具落地页 UI 设计

templates.prompt: Create a warm, playful Japanese landing page for a children's clay toy brand, designed entirely in a handmade soft clay diorama style. The whole interface should look sculpted from pastel modeling clay with rounded edges, slight finger-pressed imperfections, matte texture, soft shadows, and a cozy cream background. At the top, show a pill-shaped navigation bar with a small clay house logo and the brand name "ねんどあそび", followed by 5 navigation items: "商品一覧", "セット内容", "遊び方", "お客様の声", "よくある質問", plus a round cart icon on the far right. In the hero section, place a large dark-brown clay headline on the left reading "こねて、つくって、あそぼう。" and a smaller supporting sentence beneath it reading "手ざわりが楽しい、やさしい粘土のおもちゃセット。" Add 2 rounded clay call-to-action buttons below: "商品を見る" and "ギフトにする" with a small gift icon. On the right side of the hero area, arrange 12 clay toy illustrations: a rainbow with clouds, a lion, an elephant, a block tower with red roof, a green circular badge reading "対象年齢 3+", a beige oval badge reading "安全素材", a white rabbit holding a carrot, a tree, a yellow ball, a blue toy car, a pink donut, and a strawberry, plus a small red star near the lower right. Below, create a 3-card benefits row, each card made from off-white clay with icon, title, and short Japanese description. Card 1 title: "やわらか素材" with a hand holding clay icon. Card 2 title: "くり返し遊べる" with a circular arrow icon. Card 3 title: "想像力を育てる" with a lightbulb icon. Under that, add a centered section title "人気のセットラインナップ" with 4 small colored dots around it. Then show 3 product cards. Card 1 has a blue badge "人気No.1", shows 4 animal figures: lion, elephant, rabbit, giraffe, and includes the title "どうぶつセット" and price "¥2,980" with a teal button "詳しく見る". Card 2 has an orange badge "おすすめ", shows 7 snack items: donut, cake slice, strawberry shortcake, pink ice cream cone, cookie, candy pieces, and small leaves, and includes the title "おやつセット" and price "¥2,680" with an orange button "詳しく見る". Card 3 has a blue badge "NEW", shows 4 vehicle toys: red car, airplane, police car, excavator, and includes the title "のりものセット" and price "¥3,200" with a navy button "詳しく見る". Add a horizontal reassurance strip with 3 items: a heart icon with text about parent-child fun, a gift icon with text about gift popularity, and a shield icon with text about safety and安心・安全. At the bottom, create a large coral clay banner with the headline "お気に入りのセットを見つけよう" and a cream button reading "今すぐチェック". Finally add a slim footer bar with 4 compact items and icons: "5,000円以上で送料無料", "最短当日発送", "30日間返品保証", and "サポート対応". Use a balanced, grid-based web layout, front-facing view, soft natural lighting, subtle shadows, highly polished product-design mockup quality, charming handcrafted claymation aesthetic, and a premium yet child-friendly feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 为儿童粘土玩具品牌创建一个温馨、有趣的日本落地页，整体采用手工软粘土立体模型风格设计。整个界面应呈现出由粉彩造型粘土雕刻而成的外观，具有圆润的边缘、轻微的指压痕迹、哑光质感、柔和的阴影以及舒适的奶油色背景。在顶部，展示一个药丸形状的导航栏，包含一个小粘土房屋 Logo 和品牌名称“ねんどあそび”，随后是 5 个导航项：“商品一覧”、“セット内容”、“遊び方”、“お客様の声”、“よくある質問”，最右侧是一个圆形的购物车图标。在首屏区域，左侧放置一个深棕色粘土大标题，文字为“こねて、つくって、あそぼう。”，下方配有一句较小的辅助文案“手ざわりが楽しい、やさしい粘土のおもちゃセット。”。在下方添加 2 个圆润的粘土 CTA 按钮：“商品を見る”和“ギフトにする”（附带一个小礼物图标）。在首屏区域右侧，排列 12 个粘土玩具插图：彩虹与云朵、狮子、大象、带红屋顶的积木塔、写有“対象年齢 3+”的绿色圆形徽章、写有“安全素材”的米色椭圆形徽章、拿着胡萝卜的白兔、树木、黄球、蓝色玩具车、粉色甜甜圈和草莓，右下角还有一个小红星。在下方，创建一个包含 3 张卡片的优势展示行，每张卡片均由灰白色粘土制成，包含图标、标题和简短的日语描述。卡片 1 标题：“やわらか素材”（配手持粘土图标）。卡片 2 标题：“くり返し遊べる”（配循环箭头图标）。卡片 3 标题：“想像力を育てる”（配灯泡图标）。在此下方，添加一个居中的部分标题“人気のセットラインナップ”，周围环绕 4 个彩色小圆点。随后展示 3 张产品卡片。卡片 1 带有蓝色徽章“人気No.1”，展示 4 个动物模型：狮子、大象、兔子、长颈鹿，标题为“どうぶつセット”，价格为“¥2,980”，配有青色按钮“詳しく見る”。卡片 2 带有橙色徽章“おすすめ”，展示 7 个零食模型：甜甜圈、蛋糕片、草莓奶油蛋糕、粉色冰淇淋蛋筒、饼干、糖果碎片和叶子，标题为“おやつセット”，价格为“¥2,680”，配有橙色按钮“詳しく見る”。卡片 3 带有蓝色徽章“NEW”，展示 4 个交通工具玩具：红色小汽车、飞机、警车、挖掘机，标题为“のりものセット”，价格为“¥3,200”，配有深蓝色按钮“詳しく見る”。添加一个水平保障栏，包含 3 个项目：心形图标配亲子乐趣文案、礼物图标配礼品人气文案、盾牌图标配安心・安全文案。底部创建一个珊瑚色粘土大横幅，标题为“お気に入りのセットを見つけよう”，并配有一个写着“今すぐチェック”的奶油色按钮。最后添加一个纤细的页脚栏，包含 4 个紧凑的项目及图标：“5,000円以上で送料無料”、“最短当日発送”、“30日間返品保証”和“サポート対応”。采用平衡的网格化网页布局、正面视角、柔和的自然光、细腻的阴影，呈现出高水准的产品设计模型质感，兼具迷人的手工定格动画美学与高端且亲近儿童的氛围。

templates.title: Android Engineer in Maintenance Bay

titleLocalized.zh: 维护舱内的 Android 工程师

templates.prompt: A highly detailed futuristic anime-style illustration of a female android engineer in a narrow industrial maintenance room, standing behind a waist-high machine workbench and facing the viewer. She has a sleek short bob haircut with straight bangs, in {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"}, and wears subtle rectangular glasses. Her face is calm and focused. Her body is a glossy white-and-black biomechanical suit with realistic panel seams, exposed mechanical abdomen components, articulated gray robotic hands, and a small chest marking reading "RC19". The overall look is elegant, feminine, and mechanical rather than bulky. She is posed with both hands resting on a large rectangular control platform in front of her, a heavy metallic device with rounded black corner housings, a white top panel, four visible bolt posts, a central circular port, technical printed labels, and an orange front strip labeled {argument name="front machine label" default="MANIC"}. The scene is lit by a single overhead industrial lamp centered above her head, creating dramatic warm highlights on the polished armor and metal surfaces. The room is dense with black pipes and bundled cables running along the ceiling and walls, with metallic wall panels, a small warning plaque on the left wall, a maintenance notice sheet on the right wall, a compact control box, and a floor cable looping near the machine. On the right side, include 1 angled diagnostic monitor displaying a cyan holographic-style interface with a humanoid body diagram, status graphs, and a circular readout showing "98%". Next to it, include 1 small auxiliary console box with buttons and a small illuminated label reading {argument name="console text" default="LINK ONLINE"}. The mood is cybernetic maintenance, precision engineering, and quiet industrial sci-fi realism. Use a centered full-body-to-knees composition, slightly low eye level, crisp linework, glossy reflections, intricate hard-surface detailing, realistic metal textures, cinematic contrast, warm overhead light against cool screen glow, and a polished high-end concept art finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的未来感动漫风格插图，描绘了一位身处狭窄工业维修室的女性 Android 工程师，她站在齐腰高的机器工作台后，面向观众。她留着利落的短波波头，配有直刘海，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，戴着一副精致的矩形眼镜。她的神情冷静而专注。她的身体穿着一套光滑的黑白双色生物机械套装，带有逼真的面板接缝、外露的腹部机械组件、灵活的灰色机械手，胸前有一个写着“RC19”的小型标记。整体外观优雅、柔美，且呈现出机械质感而非臃肿感。她双手撑在面前的大型矩形控制平台上，该平台是一个沉重的金属装置，带有圆润的黑色边角外壳、白色顶板、四个可见的螺栓柱、一个中央圆形接口、技术印刷标签，以及一条写有 {argument name="front machine label" default="MANIC"} 的橙色前条。场景由头顶上方的一盏工业吊灯照明，在抛光的装甲和金属表面上营造出极具戏剧性的暖色高光。房间内布满了沿天花板和墙壁延伸的黑色管道与成捆的电缆，墙面为金属材质，左侧墙上贴有小型警告牌，右侧墙上贴有维修通知单，另有一个紧凑的控制箱，地面上有一根电缆在机器附近盘绕。在右侧，包含 1 台倾斜的诊断显示器，显示着青色的全息风格界面，上面有类人身体图、状态图表和一个显示“98%”的圆形读数。旁边放置 1 个带有按钮的小型辅助控制盒，上面有一个发光的小标签，写着 {argument name="console text" default="LINK ONLINE"}。整体氛围为赛博机械维护、精密工程和静谧的工业科幻写实感。采用居中的半身至膝盖构图，略微低平的视线角度，清晰的线条，光泽的反射，复杂的硬表面细节，逼真的金属纹理，电影级的对比度，暖色顶光与冷色屏幕光交相辉映，呈现出精致的高端概念艺术质感。

templates.title: Japanese Urban Horror Novel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日式都市恐怖小说封面

templates.prompt: A dark psychological horror novel cover illustration in a cinematic, gritty digital-painting style. Create a wide, ominous composite scene set in a decaying modern Japanese environment, blending a commuter train interior on the left and a late-night office on the right, with a ghostly female figure standing in the exact center foreground, shown from behind. Her long dark hair is messy and damp-looking, and her face is completely obscured by a solid black rectangular void. The palette is cold blue-gray, charcoal, dirty white, and desaturated brown, with harsh fluorescent overhead lighting and deep shadow. On the left side, show the inside of a crowded train car with 4 visible commuters: 2 standing men in business suits holding or standing beneath hanging straps, 1 seated woman in muted officewear with her face blurred or obscured, and 1 more distant passenger near the door. Include a row of hanging hand straps above them, grimy metal poles, scratched windows, and a claustrophobic perspective. In the bottom left foreground, place 1 large cracked white flowerpot containing 1 dead, withered plant with curled brown leaves and dry soil. In the center, use the female apparition as a dividing figure between the two spaces; her body and hair merge into black stains and shadow. On the right side, depict a bleak office with 3 visible workers at desks in the background under fluorescent lights, computer monitors, papers, and glass partitions. In the right foreground, show 1 cropped salaryman from chest to thigh, wearing a wrinkled white shirt and loosened dark tie, holding papers at his side; his head is cut off by the top frame, adding unease. Spread black cracks, grime, ink-like tendrils, and water-stain textures across walls, floor, and image borders so the whole scene feels infected or haunted. Add subtle motionless dread, like a cursed presence hiding in everyday life. Overlay large distressed white Japanese title text across the middle: {argument name="title text" default="隙間、そのもの"}. Beneath it, add smaller white subtitle text: {argument name="subtitle text" default="第１日：月曜日"}. Use eroded, cracked, horror-style typography with rough edges, centered over the figure. The overall result should feel like a disturbing literary cover or promotional key art for a terrifying Japanese urban horror story.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有电影质感、粗粝数字绘画风格的暗黑心理恐怖小说封面插画。创作一个宽幅、不祥的复合场景，背景设定在衰败的现代日本环境，左侧融合了通勤列车车厢，右侧则是深夜的办公室，画面正中央前景处站着一位背对观众的女性幽灵。她留着凌乱且看起来湿漉漉的长黑发，脸部被一个实心的黑色矩形虚空完全遮挡。色调采用冷蓝灰色、炭灰色、脏白色和低饱和度的棕色，配以刺眼的荧光顶灯和深邃的阴影。在左侧，展示拥挤的列车车厢内部，可见 4 名通勤者：2 名身穿商务西装的男性正抓着或站在吊环下方，1 名身着素色办公装的女性面部模糊或被遮挡，还有 1 名靠近车门的远景乘客。包含上方的一排吊环、肮脏的金属杆、有划痕的窗户以及令人窒息的透视感。在左下角前景处，放置 1 个巨大的白色裂纹花盆，里面种着 1 株枯萎的植物，叶片卷曲呈棕色，土壤干涸。在中心位置，利用女性幽灵作为两个空间的分隔点；她的身体和头发融入黑色的污渍与阴影中。在右侧，描绘一个凄凉的办公室，背景中有 3 名员工在荧光灯下办公，配有电脑显示器、文件和玻璃隔断。在右侧前景处，展示 1 名从胸部到大腿的上班族，身穿褶皱的白衬衫，领带松垮，手里拿着文件；他的头部被顶部边框切断，增添了不安感。在墙壁、地板和图像边缘散布黑色裂纹、污垢、墨汁般的卷须和水渍纹理，使整个场景感觉像是被感染或闹鬼。加入微妙的静止恐惧感，如同隐藏在日常生活中的诅咒存在。在画面中间叠加巨大的做旧白色日文标题文字：{argument name="title text" default="隙間、そのもの"}。在其下方，添加较小的白色副标题文字：{argument name="subtitle text" default="第１日：月曜日"}。使用边缘粗糙、带有裂纹的恐怖风格字体，居中置于人物上方。整体效果应呈现出一种令人不安的文学封面或恐怖日式都市故事的宣传主视觉图。

templates.title: Leafa Fairy Anime Sky Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 莉法 (Leafa) 动漫风格天空肖像

templates.prompt: A polished anime fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Leafa"} from Sword Art Online, shown as a youthful elf girl with long golden-blonde hair in a very high ponytail tied with a large pale green bow, loose side bangs, and two thin front braids framing her face. She has pointed elf ears, vivid green eyes, and a soft confident smile while looking directly at the viewer. She is posed in midair or perched on a cloud with one knee raised close to her chest and both arms wrapped around her leg, creating a dynamic foreshortened composition from a slightly low angle. Give her translucent pale mint fairy wings glowing behind her, spread wide and luminous. Her outfit is the classic green fairy warrior costume: a deep green tunic dress with white trim and layered skirt panels, white long sleeves, white thigh-high stockings with jagged upper edges, dark brown belts and straps at the waist and thighs, and brown knee-high leather boots. The scene is set high above a sunlit fantasy city with tall stone towers, ornate architecture, bridges, drifting clouds, and warm golden sunset light. Use a soft atmospheric background blur, cinematic rim light, subtle sparkles, and clean high-detail anime rendering with vibrant colors, smooth shading, and an airy heroic mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫奇幻插画，主角是来自《刀剑神域》的 {argument name="character name" default="Leafa"}。她是一位年轻的精灵少女，留着一头金色长发，扎成极高的马尾，并系着一个巨大的浅绿色蝴蝶结，两侧留有松散的刘海，脸颊两侧各有一条细细的编发。她有着尖尖的精灵耳朵、翠绿的眼睛，正对着镜头露出自信温柔的微笑。她悬浮在半空中或栖息在云端，单膝抬起靠近胸前，双臂环抱着腿部，从略微仰视的角度呈现出极具动感的透视构图。为她配上一对半透明的浅薄荷色精灵翅膀，在身后闪耀，舒展且明亮。她的服装是经典的绿色精灵战士装：深绿色束腰连衣裙，配有白色饰边和分层裙摆，白色长袖，边缘呈锯齿状的白色过膝袜，腰部和腿部配有深棕色腰带和绑带，以及棕色过膝皮靴。场景设定在阳光明媚的奇幻城市上空，背景可见高耸的石塔、华丽的建筑、桥梁、漂浮的云朵以及温暖的金色夕阳。采用柔和的背景虚化、电影级轮廓光、细微的闪光效果，以及色彩鲜艳、阴影平滑、充满空灵英雄气息的高细节动漫渲染。

templates.title: Muscular Party Man with Maracas

titleLocalized.zh: 手持沙锤的肌肉派对男

templates.prompt: A hyper-detailed anime-style illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="rugged middle-aged man"} at a wild tropical dance party, shown from a dramatic low angle with the camera close to his torso. He has an extremely muscular, bodybuilder physique with sharply defined abs, broad chest, visible sweat droplets glistening across his skin, a slightly hairy jawline and neck, and messy short light-brown hair. His face is mostly out of frame or obscured, keeping the focus on his physique and action. He wears an open {argument name="shirt style" default="bright floral Hawaiian shirt"} with large multicolored hibiscus flowers, no undershirt, and a gold chain necklace with a round pendant. In both hands he is shaking 2 large maracas, one thrust toward the viewer on the left foreground and one on the right side, each striped in red, yellow, green, and black, with strong motion blur to show energetic movement. The background is a packed nightclub or festival crowd with raised hands, neon laser beams, fireworks-like bursts of light, colorful bokeh, and falling confetti pieces everywhere. Use an explosive palette of magenta, purple, blue, gold, green, and hot pink, with glossy highlights, intense rim lighting, exaggerated perspective, dynamic foreshortening, and a celebratory, over-the-top party atmosphere. Make it look like high-end polished anime key art with crisp linework, dramatic shading, sparkling effects, and maximum energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的动漫风格插图，主角是一位 {argument name="character type" default="粗犷的中年男子"}，身处狂野的热带舞会中。画面采用戏剧性的低角度拍摄，镜头紧贴其躯干。他拥有极其强壮的健美体格，腹肌线条分明，胸部宽阔，皮肤上闪烁着明显的汗珠，下颚和颈部略带胡茬，留着凌乱的浅棕色短发。他的面部大部分处于画面之外或被遮挡，从而将焦点集中在他的体格和动作上。他穿着一件敞开的 {argument name="shirt style" default="明亮的夏威夷花衬衫"}，上面印有大型彩色木槿花，内里未穿衬衫，脖子上戴着一条带有圆形吊坠的金项链。他双手各摇晃着一个大沙锤，左侧前景的一个沙锤向观众方向伸出，右侧的另一个沙锤则向侧面伸展，沙锤上带有红、黄、绿、黑条纹，并带有强烈的动态模糊效果，以展现充满活力的动作。背景是拥挤的夜店或音乐节人群，人们高举双手，霓虹激光束、烟花般的亮光、绚丽的虚化效果以及漫天飞舞的五彩纸屑随处可见。使用洋红色、紫色、蓝色、金色、绿色和亮粉色的爆炸性色调，搭配光泽高光、强烈的轮廓光、夸张的透视、动态的前缩透视，营造出一种欢庆且极致的派对氛围。使其看起来像高端精致的动漫关键视觉图，具备清晰的线条、戏剧性的阴影、闪烁的特效以及极致的能量感。

templates.title: Leafa Flying Above a Golden Sky City

titleLocalized.zh: 莉法飞越金色天空之城

templates.prompt: A breathtaking high-fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Leafa"} soaring high above a vast floating city of ornate gothic towers and cathedral spires rising through a sea of glowing clouds at sunset. The scene is viewed from a dramatic aerial angle, with the character centered slightly right of frame, flying diagonally forward over the city while looking back over her shoulder. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair tied in a very high ponytail with a large pale bow, pointed elf ears, a slim curvy build, and translucent yellow-green fairy wings made of luminous crystalline light. She wears a green and white fantasy outfit with gold trim: a short green dress or tunic, white armored chest detailing, a brown corset-like waist belt, white detached sleeves or fitted arm coverings, white thigh-high stockings with lace tops and dark garter straps, and brown knee-high boots. Her skirt, ribbons, ponytail, and wings stream backward in the wind to emphasize speed and altitude. The background is an immense sunlit aerial kingdom with countless detailed towers, domes, bridges, and castle-like structures piercing the clouds, rendered with intricate architecture and atmospheric depth. Warm golden sunlight pours in from the upper left, creating lens flare, rim light, sparkling dust motes, and glowing highlights across the wings and city. Use highly detailed anime painting, cinematic composition, dynamic foreshortening, soft volumetric clouds, radiant fantasy lighting, vibrant green-and-gold palette, epic adventurous mood, and polished gpt-image-2 quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊叹的高奇幻动漫插画，描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="莉法"} 在夕阳下高高飞越一座广阔的浮空之城，华丽的哥特式塔楼和教堂尖顶从发光的云海中升起。场景采用戏剧性的俯视视角，角色位于画面右侧中心，在飞越城市的同时向后回眸。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 头发，扎成极高的马尾辫，系着一个巨大的浅色蝴蝶结，有着尖尖的精灵耳朵、苗条的身材，以及由发光晶体构成的半透明黄绿色仙女翅膀。她穿着带有金色饰边的绿白相间奇幻服装：短款绿色连衣裙或束腰外衣、白色盔甲胸部细节、棕色束腰带、白色分体式袖子或贴身护臂、带有蕾丝边和深色吊带的白色过膝袜，以及棕色及膝长靴。她的裙摆、丝带、马尾辫和翅膀在风中向后飘动，以强调速度感和高度。背景是一个巨大的阳光普照的空中王国，无数细节丰富的塔楼、圆顶、桥梁和城堡般的建筑穿透云层，呈现出复杂的建筑结构和大气深度。温暖的金色阳光从左上方倾泻而下，产生镜头光晕、轮廓光、闪烁的尘埃微粒，并在翅膀和城市上形成发光的高光。使用高度精细的动漫绘画、电影级构图、动态透视、柔和的体积云、绚丽的奇幻光影、充满活力的绿金配色、史诗般的冒险氛围以及精致的 gpt-image-2 画质。

templates.title: Sleep Cloud Zero-Gravity Bed Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Sleep Cloud 零重力床垫海报

templates.prompt: A clean, high-end Japanese advertising poster for a luxury bed or mattress concept titled {argument name="product title" default="雲の上の眠り"}, with the English subtitle {argument name="english subtitle" default="Sleep Cloud"}, designed around the concept of zero gravity sleep. Use a minimal soft-white background with a pale powder-blue accent palette, airy negative space, and a calm premium wellness aesthetic. The layout is a single elegant poster composition: on the left, large Japanese headline typography in refined serif style, colored dusty pastel blue, with a small line of Japanese copy above it reading 「重力ゼロの、やさしい眠り。」 and the main title 「雲の上の眠り」 followed by the English subtitle centered below, flanked by thin horizontal lines. Beneath that, add two short blocks of Japanese body copy in smaller blue text describing a floating, liberating, comfortable sleep experience. On the right, feature a softly lit 3D-rendered bedroom vignette on a floating rectangular platform: 1 modern white bed with a low headboard, 2 white pillows, white bedding, and 1 light blue throw draped diagonally across the lower half of the bed. Make the bed appear to levitate slightly above the platform with a subtle blue glow underneath to suggest zero gravity. Behind it, place 1 tall arched window opening with a blue interior showing soft white clouds and sky. Add 1 small round bedside table holding 1 tiny vase with delicate stems and 1 small object, plus 1 round cream rug under the bed area, 1 light blue floor cushion, and 2 fluffy cloud props on the platform near the bed. Include additional faint clouds drifting around the poster edges. Along the lower left-to-center area, place exactly 3 circular feature icons with captions beneath them: 1 cloud icon for weightless floating comfort, 1 wavy-line icon for soft enveloping comfort, and 1 leaf icon for safe comfortable materials. At the bottom left, add 1 large rounded blue call-to-action button with white Japanese text {argument name="button text" default="今すぐ体験する"} and a right-facing chevron, plus 1 outlined circular badge beside it reading 「期間限定」. At the lower right, add exactly 3 compact info lines with small icons: 1 delivery truck with 「送料無料」, 1 shield with 「安心の30日間返品保証」, and 1 calendar with the date {argument name="deadline date" default="2025.6.30(月)まで"}. Place a faint white {argument name="brand watermark" default="Pollo.ai"} watermark in the top-right corner. Overall style: soft 3D product visualization, Scandinavian-inspired minimalism, dreamy cloud theme, luxury bedding advertisement, diffused lighting, pastel blue shadows, pristine composition, polished commercial poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁、高端的日式广告海报，用于展示奢华床具或床垫概念，标题为 {argument name="product title" default="雲の上の眠り"}，英文副标题为 {argument name="english subtitle" default="Sleep Cloud"}，围绕零重力睡眠概念设计。采用极简柔白色背景，搭配淡粉蓝色调，营造出轻盈的留白感和宁静的高级健康美学。海报布局优雅：左侧为精致的衬线体日文大标题，颜色为灰粉蓝色，上方配有一行小字「重力ゼロの、やさしい眠り。」，主标题「雲の上の眠り」居中，下方为英文副标题，两侧饰以细横线。其下方添加两段简短的蓝色小字正文，描述悬浮、自由、舒适的睡眠体验。右侧展示一个柔光 3D 渲染的卧室场景，位于一个悬浮的长方形平台上：放置 1 张带有低靠背的现代白色床，配 2 个白色枕头、白色床品，床的下半部分斜搭着 1 条浅蓝色盖毯。让床看起来微微悬浮于平台之上，下方带有淡淡的蓝色光晕，以体现零重力感。背景处设置 1 个高大的拱形窗户，窗内显示蓝天与柔和的白云。床边放置 1 个小型圆形床头柜，上面摆放 1 个插着精致花枝的小花瓶和 1 个小物件，床下铺有 1 张圆形奶油色地毯，配 1 个浅蓝色地板坐垫，平台床边摆放 2 个蓬松的云朵道具。海报边缘漂浮着淡淡的云朵。在左下至中部区域，放置 3 个圆形功能图标及其下方说明：1 个云朵图标代表无重力悬浮舒适感，1 个波浪线图标代表柔软包裹感，1 个叶子图标代表安全舒适的材质。左下角添加 1 个大型圆角蓝色行动呼吁按钮，内含白色日文 {argument name="button text" default="今すぐ体験する"} 及向右的箭头，旁边配有 1 个圆形轮廓徽章，写着「期間限定」。右下角添加 3 行紧凑的信息栏，配有小图标：1 个货车图标配「送料無料」，1 个盾牌图标配「安心の30日間返品保証」，以及 1 个日历图标配日期 {argument name="deadline date" default="2025.6.30(月)まで"}。在右上角添加一个淡淡的白色 {argument name="brand watermark" default="Pollo.ai"} 水印。整体风格：柔和的 3D 产品可视化、受斯堪的纳维亚风格启发的极简主义、梦幻云朵主题、奢华寝具广告、漫射光、淡蓝色阴影、纯净构图、精致的商业海报设计。

templates.title: Pancake Angel Idol Café Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 松饼天使偶像咖啡馆自拍

templates.prompt: A loose watercolor-and-ink anime illustration of a youthful male idol styled as a pancake angel taking a selfie inside a trendy café. He is centered in a close, slightly wide-angle selfie composition with one arm reaching toward the viewer from the left foreground, creating a casual fan-service snapshot feel. He has messy short blond hair and a soft, pretty-boy look, with large white angel wings spreading behind him. On top of his head sits a whimsical stack of {argument name="head accessory" default="golden pancakes with syrup and a square of butter"} like a halo. He wears an oversized white T-shirt printed with the words {argument name="shirt text" default="PANCAKE TENSHI"} and a pancake illustration, plus a thin necklace with a small star charm. The mood is cheerful, dreamy, and slightly idol-like. A hand-drawn speech bubble near his head contains the Japanese text {argument name="speech bubble text" default="今日もふわふわ〜♪ パンケーキパワー！"}. The café interior behind him is bright and sketchy, with a blackboard sign reading {argument name="cafe sign" default="CAFE Pancake Heaven"}, shelves and windows on the left, and 2 background idol performers on the right holding microphones on a tiny stage under hanging lights. In the foreground, show 3 plated or served pancake-themed items: one small decorated pancake dessert with whipped cream and berries at bottom left, one cropped pancake plate at bottom center, and one iced drink in a plastic cup at bottom right labeled {argument name="cup text" default="TENSHI CAFE"} with a tiny wing icon. Add hand-drawn doodles, tiny hearts, sparkles, and handwritten Japanese menu notes around the food, including a small “Set List” card at the lower right. Use expressive pencil lines, soft beige and honey tones, white highlights, slightly messy café sketchbook energy, and charming editorial illustration quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张随性的水彩墨线动漫插画，描绘了一位造型如松饼天使般的年轻男偶像在时尚咖啡馆内的自拍。构图采用近距离、略带广角效果的自拍视角，他的一只手臂从左侧前景伸向观众，营造出一种随性的粉丝福利快照感。他留着凌乱的短金发，长相清秀，身后展开着巨大的白色天使翅膀。头顶上方戴着一叠奇趣的 {argument name="head accessory" default="淋着糖浆、放着黄油块的金黄松饼"}，宛如光环。他穿着一件超大号白色 T 恤，上面印有 {argument name="shirt text" default="PANCAKE TENSHI"} 字样和松饼图案，并佩戴着一条带有小星星吊坠的细项链。整体氛围欢快、梦幻，且带有一丝偶像气息。他头部附近的对话气泡中写着日文 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="今日もふわふわ〜♪ パンケーキパワー！"}。身后的咖啡馆内部明亮且带有速写感，黑板招牌上写着 {argument name="cafe sign" default="CAFE Pancake Heaven"}，左侧有货架和窗户，右侧背景中有 2 位偶像表演者在悬挂灯饰下的小舞台上拿着麦克风。前景展示了 3 份摆盘或供应的松饼主题餐点：左下角是一份装饰有鲜奶油和浆果的小型松饼甜点，底部中央是一盘被截断的松饼，右下角是一杯贴有 {argument name="cup text" default="TENSHI CAFE"} 标签及小翅膀图标的塑料杯冰饮。在食物周围添加手绘涂鸦、小爱心、闪光点和手写日文菜单备注，右下角还包含一张小小的“歌单”卡片。运用富有表现力的铅笔线条、柔和的米色和蜂蜜色调、白色高光，呈现出略显凌乱的咖啡馆速写本风格以及迷人的编辑插画质感。

templates.title: Fictional Triple Crown Horse Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构三冠赛马纪念海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese horse racing champion poster in a cinematic, high-contrast, premium sports-advertising style. The main subject is a powerful dark bay to nearly black Thoroughbred racehorse with a glossy coat, a slightly windswept mane, and a small white star on its forehead, shown in a dominant three-quarter full-body pose facing right-of-camera. The horse wears racing tack and a deep blue saddlecloth marked with a large white number 7 and the horse name in Japanese, {argument name="horse name" default="コントロール"}. Use a dark navy, black, and metallic gold color palette with glowing highlights, mist, sparks, and a night-sky atmosphere to create a legendary, triumphant mood. The layout should feel like an elite championship poster: oversized gold Japanese headline text at the upper left reading {argument name="main headline" default="三冠制覇。"}, with a smaller gold subtitle beneath it reading 「その名は、頂点の制御者。」. On the left side, include 3 laurel-wreath achievement callouts stacked vertically, each in gold: 1) 「皐月賞」 with smaller text 「中山競馬場 芝2000m」, 2) 「日本ダービー」 with smaller text 「東京競馬場 芝2400m」, 3) 「菊花賞」 with smaller text 「京都競馬場 芝3000m」. Across the bottom left to center, place the horse’s name in huge textured metallic gold Japanese lettering, {argument name="horse name large" default="コントロール"}, with the romanized name CONTROL in spaced serif capitals below it. Beneath that, add a pedigree line in gold Japanese text: 「牡・青鹿毛　父：{argument name="sire name" default="チープコンパクト"}」. On the right side, add a large semi-transparent portrait of an older male trainer in a cap and glasses emerging from the dark background, serious and authoritative, with vertical white slogan text along the far right edge reading 「心を制し、レースを支配する。」. Near the trainer portrait, include handwritten-style white calligraphy for the trainer credit: 「調教師」 followed by a large signature-like name {argument name="trainer name" default="夕造"}, and a smaller white phrase beneath: 「信念は、勝利を支配する。」. At the bottom right, show 3 smaller action panels or cutout scenes of the same horse racing with jockey, each tinted in cool blue tones and labeled in gold beneath them: 「皐月賞」, 「日本ダービー」, 「菊花賞」. The composition should be dense but elegant, with layered smoke, stadium lights, gold dust, and sharp contrast, resembling a luxury commemorative poster for a fictional Triple Crown racehorse.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日式赛马冠军海报，采用电影级、高对比度的高端体育广告风格。主体是一匹强壮的深骝色至近乎黑色的纯血赛马，毛色光亮，鬃毛微风拂动，额头有一颗小白星，以霸气的四分之三全身姿态面向镜头右侧。马匹佩戴着赛马装备，深蓝色马鞍垫上印有巨大的白色数字“7”以及日文马名 {argument name="horse name" default="コントロール"}。采用深海军蓝、黑色和金属金配色，辅以发光高光、薄雾、火花和夜空氛围，营造出传奇且凯旋的意境。排版应呈现精英冠军海报的质感：左上方为超大号金色日文标题 {argument name="main headline" default="三冠制覇。"}，下方配有较小的金色副标题「その名は、頂点の制御者。」。在左侧，垂直排列 3 个金色月桂花环成就标注：1) 「皐月賞」及下方小字「中山競馬場 芝2000m」，2) 「日本ダービー」及下方小字「東京競馬場 芝2400m」，3) 「菊花賞」及下方小字「京都競馬場 芝3000m」。在左下至中心位置，放置巨大的金属质感金色日文马名 {argument name="horse name large" default="コントロール"}，下方为间距拉开的衬线体罗马字母名称 CONTROL。其下方添加一行金色日文血统说明：「牡・青鹿毛　父：{argument name="sire name" default="チープコンパクト"}」。在右侧，添加一张戴着帽子和眼镜的年长男性练马师的半透明肖像，从深色背景中浮现，神情严肃且充满权威感；最右侧边缘配有垂直的白色标语「心を制し、レースを支配する。」。在练马师肖像附近，加入手写风格的白色书法练马师署名：「調教師」后接巨大的签名式名称 {argument name="trainer name" default="夕造"}，下方配有一句较小的白色短语：「信念は、勝利を支配する。」。在右下角，展示 3 个较小的动作面板或剪影场景，描绘同一匹马在骑师驾驭下奔跑的画面，每个面板均带有冷蓝色调，下方以金色标注：「皐月賞」、「日本ダービー」、「菊花賞」。整体构图紧凑而优雅，融合了层叠的烟雾、体育场灯光、金粉和强烈的对比，呈现出如同虚构三冠赛马高端纪念海报般的视觉效果。

templates.title: Japanese Inventory App Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式库存管理 App 宣传海报

templates.prompt: A clean mobile app promotional poster on a soft mint-green background, centered and vertically composed, advertising an inventory management app called {argument name="app name" default="Zaiko"}. At the top, place a rounded white pill logo with the app name in green, then a smaller outlined pill beneath it containing a green dot, the number 01, and the Japanese text 見える化. Below that, add a large bold Japanese headline in dark navy: {argument name="headline text" default="買い忘れを、なくす。"}, followed by a smaller gray Japanese subheading: 残り日数で補充タイミングをひと目で確認. Under the subheading, show exactly 3 rounded category chips in one row: a white chip with a red dot and the label 残り日数, a white chip with a yellow dot and the label 通知, and a white chip with a green dot and the label 補充管理. In the center, display a realistic black-bezel smartphone mockup in front view with a grocery and household stock tracking app screen. The phone screen should have a solid green top bar with the app name, a pale information strip below it, then a summary card row with exactly 3 status counters: red-dot 2 要補充, yellow-dot 1 もうすぐ, and green-dot 2 余裕あり. Beneath that, show a vertically scrolling list of exactly 4 inventory item cards with soft rounded corners, subtle shadows, and colored urgency bars: 1) シャンプー with a red status bar and a red badge reading 1日超過, 2) トイレットペーパー with a red status bar and a red badge reading あと2日, 3) 食器用洗剤 with a yellow status bar and a yellow badge reading あと5日, 4) ボディーソープ with a green status bar and a green badge reading あと10日. Each card includes a small circular product icon on the left, Japanese item name and category/date text, and a lower action row with 3 small controls labeled 補充した, まだある, and リスト. Add a floating green circular plus button near the lower right of the phone screen. At the bottom of the app UI, include a green tab bar with exactly 3 navigation items and icons: ホーム, 買い物リスト, and 設定. Place the phone on a glossy rounded green pedestal with soft white side supports and a strong soft shadow, then add a large rounded white call-to-action pill on the pedestal with the Japanese text {argument name="button text" default="そろそろ買うものが、すぐわかる"}. Overall style: polished startup landing-page mockup, iOS app screenshot aesthetic, soft gradients, minimal Japanese UI design, crisp typography, centered composition, gentle ambient shadows, premium app store marketing visual.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的移动端 App 宣传海报，采用柔和的薄荷绿背景，构图居中且呈垂直分布，用于宣传名为 {argument name="app name" default="Zaiko"} 的库存管理 App。顶部放置一个圆角白色胶囊状 Logo，内含绿色的 App 名称；下方是一个较小的轮廓胶囊，包含一个绿点、数字 01 以及日文文本“見える化”。在下方添加一行深海军蓝色的加粗日文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="買い忘れを、なくす。"}，随后是较小的灰色日文副标题：残り日数で補充タイミングをひと目で確認。在副标题下方，横向排列 3 个圆角分类标签：一个带有红点的白色标签，标注为“残り日数”；一个带有黄点的白色标签，标注为“通知”；以及一个带有绿点的白色标签，标注为“補充管理”。在中心位置，展示一个正面的黑色边框智能手机模型，屏幕显示杂货与家庭库存追踪 App 的界面。手机屏幕顶部应有一个纯绿色状态栏，显示 App 名称；下方是一个浅色信息条；接着是一行包含 3 个状态计数器的摘要卡片：红点“2 要補充”、黄点“1 もうすぐ”以及绿点“2 余裕あり”。下方显示一个垂直滚动的列表，包含 4 张带有圆角、细微阴影和彩色紧急状态条的库存物品卡片：1) シャンプー，配有红色状态条和写着“1日超過”的红色徽章；2) トイレットペーパー，配有红色状态条和写着“あと2日”的红色徽章；3) 食器用洗剤，配有黄色状态条和写着“あと5日”的黄色徽章；4) ボディーソープ，配有绿色状态条和写着“あと10日”的绿色徽章。每张卡片左侧包含一个小圆形产品图标、日文物品名称及分类/日期文本，底部操作栏包含 3 个小控件，分别标注为“補充した”、“まだある”和“リスト”。在手机屏幕右下角附近添加一个悬浮的绿色圆形加号按钮。在 App UI 底部，包含一个绿色标签栏，内含 3 个导航项及图标：ホーム、買い物リスト 和 設定。将手机放置在一个带有柔和白色侧支撑和明显柔和阴影的亮面圆角绿色底座上，并在底座上添加一个大型圆角白色行动呼吁（CTA）胶囊，内含日文文本 {argument name="button text" default="そろそろ買うものが、すぐわかる"}。整体风格：精致的初创公司落地页模型、iOS App 截图美学、柔和渐变、极简日式 UI 设计、清晰的排版、居中构图、柔和的环境阴影、优质的应用商店营销视觉图。

templates.title: Japanese app onboarding promo mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 日本应用新手引导宣传图样机

templates.prompt: A clean modern app-promo poster on a very pale mint-blue background, centered and vertically composed like a landing page screenshot for a Japanese inventory app. At the top, place a small rounded white pill logo with soft shadow reading {argument name="app name" default="Zaiko"} in green. Beneath it, add a smaller rounded outlined badge with a blue dot and the text "02 初回ガイド". Below that, set a large bold Japanese headline in dark navy: {argument name="headline text" default="初回ガイドで、すぐ使える。"}, followed by a smaller gray subtitle: "起動したら管理の流れをやさしく案内". Under the subtitle, show exactly 3 small rounded white category chips with soft shadows, evenly spaced: "サンプル" with a green dot, "使い方" with a blue dot, and "すぐ開始" with a dark dot. In the center, show a realistic modern smartphone mockup front view with a black bezel, slightly rounded corners, subtle reflections, and a dramatic soft blue glow under it. The phone screen displays the app UI with a green top bar and the title "Zaiko" in white, iPhone-style status icons at top, and a dimmed app interface behind a centered onboarding modal card. The white modal has rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, with a pale green circular icon area containing a green cube symbol at top. Then a bold welcome title in Japanese, "Zaikoへようこそ！", a smaller subtitle "消耗品管理アプリ", and body text "このアプリは、おうちの消耗品を管理するよ！". Add a light gray rounded list box containing exactly 3 sample inventory items on separate lines with tiny icons: "トイレットペーパー", "シャンプー", and "洗剤". Below that, add a small green-highlighted sentence: "『そろそろ買わなきゃ！』を教えてくれるから、買い忘れなし ✨". At the bottom of the modal, include a large rounded green primary button labeled {argument name="button text" default="使い方を見る"} with a small book icon, and below it a muted text link "スキップ". Behind the modal, the app UI should be visible but subdued: a green header, side category strips, and a bottom tab bar with exactly 3 tabs labeled "ホーム", "買い物リスト", and "設定", each with simple white icons. Beneath the phone, place a large rounded blue callout card with soft shadow and a centered white pill label reading {argument name="footer text" default="はじめての設定も迷わない"}. Use a polished Apple-style SaaS marketing aesthetic, soft gradients, subtle shadows, rounded UI elements, crisp typography, and a friendly trustworthy feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁现代的应用宣传海报，背景为极淡的薄荷蓝色，采用类似日本库存管理应用落地页截图的居中垂直构图。顶部放置一个带有柔和阴影的小型圆角白色胶囊状 Logo，内含绿色文字 {argument name="app name" default="Zaiko"}。下方添加一个较小的圆角轮廓徽章，带有一个蓝点和文字“02 初回ガイド”。再下方设置一个深海军蓝色的粗体日文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="初回ガイドで、すぐ使える。"}，随后是一个较小的灰色副标题：“起動したら管理の流れをやさしく案内”。在副标题下方，均匀排列 3 个带有柔和阴影的小型圆角白色分类标签：带绿点的“サンプル”、带蓝点的“使い方”以及带深色点的“すぐ開始”。中心位置展示一个写实的现代智能手机样机正面视图，黑色边框，圆角设计，带有微妙的反光，手机下方有戏剧性的柔和蓝光。手机屏幕显示应用 UI，顶部为绿色状态栏，标题为白色的“Zaiko”，顶部有 iPhone 风格的状态图标，背景为变暗的应用界面，上方覆盖一个居中的新手引导模态卡片。白色模态卡片具有圆角和柔和的投影，顶部有一个淡绿色圆形图标区域，内含一个绿色立方体符号。接着是粗体的日文欢迎标题“Zaikoへようこそ！”，较小的副标题“消耗品管理アプリ”，以及正文“このアプリは、おうちの消耗品を管理するよ！”。添加一个浅灰色圆角列表框，包含 3 个分行显示的库存示例项目，并配有微型图标：“トイレットペーパー”、“シャンプー”和“洗剤”。下方添加一句带有绿色高亮的句子：“『そろそろ買わなきゃ！』を教えてくれるから、買い忘れなし ✨”。在模态卡片底部，包含一个大型圆角绿色主按钮，标签为 {argument name="button text" default="使い方を見る"}，并配有一个小书本图标，下方是一个柔和的文字链接“スキップ”。在模态卡片后方，应用 UI 隐约可见：绿色页眉、侧边分类条以及底部标签栏，包含 3 个标签，分别标注为“ホーム”、“買い物リスト”和“設定”，每个标签均配有简单的白色图标。在手机下方，放置一张大型圆角蓝色标注卡片，带有柔和阴影和居中的白色胶囊状标签，文字为 {argument name="footer text" default="はじめての設定も迷わない"}。采用精致的 Apple 风格 SaaS 营销美学，结合柔和的渐变、微妙的阴影、圆润的 UI 元素、清晰的排版，营造出友好且值得信赖的氛围。

titleLocalized.zh: 日语版 Pro 计划 App 推广图

templates.prompt: Create a clean modern promotional hero image for a Japanese inventory management app landing page on a soft warm off-white background with a subtle pale mint gradient rising from the bottom. Center the composition vertically. At the top, place a rounded white pill logo with the text "Zaiko" in green. Directly below it, add a small rounded badge with a tiny yellow dot and the text "05 Proで拡張". Then add a large bold Japanese headline in dark navy reading "管理をもっと、快適に。" and a smaller gray subheadline reading "無制限登録・分析・広告なしのProプラン". Under that, show exactly 3 small rounded feature chips in one row: a white chip with a green dot and the label "無制限", a white chip with a yellow dot and the label "分析", and a white chip with a red dot and the label "広告なし". In the center, display a large realistic iPhone front view with thin black bezel, rounded corners, subtle reflections, and a soft shadow. On the phone screen, show an app subscription page in Japanese with the top bar time 1:44, back chevron, a left tab label "(tabs)", and the centered title "Proプラン". The page content should feature a pale gold circular icon with a gold star, the title "Zaiko Pro", and the subtitle "もっと便利に、もっと快適に". Below that, include a rounded white comparison card with 3 feature rows and 3 column headers "機能", "Free", "Pro". The 3 rows should be: "アイテム無制限" with "3個まで" under Free and "無制限" in green under Pro; "消費ベース分析" with "-" under Free and "OK" in green under Pro; "広告非表示" with "広告あり" under Free and "広告なし" in green under Pro. Beneath the card, add a section title "プランを選択" and exactly 2 stacked plan options: a selected annual plan outlined in green with a green radio button, the label "年額プラン", a small red badge "お得", and the price line "¥2,000/年 (月あたり約¥167)"; then an unselected monthly plan with a gray radio button, the label "月額プラン", and the price "¥300/月". Under the plans, place a large rounded green call-to-action button reading "Proにアップグレード". Below it, add a centered text link "以前の購入を復元" and several lines of tiny gray subscription disclaimer text. At the very bottom behind the phone, add a large rounded orange pedestal card with a white pill label containing the text "Proなら広告なしでスムーズ" in green. Use a polished startup-app marketing style, soft shadows, airy spacing, rounded UI, crisp Japanese typography, and a premium minimal aesthetic.

templates.title: Shonen Manga Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 少年漫画杂志封面

templates.prompt:
Create a glossy Japanese weekly shonen manga magazine cover in the style of a high-energy commercial comic anthology, with a dense, crowded layout, explosive typography, and dramatic cover-line design. The cover is portrait orientation, dominated by a huge red masthead at the top with thick black outlines and yellow accents, plus a secondary English subtitle reading “WEEKLY JUMP.” Add many Japanese teaser blurbs, issue-number boxes, starbursts, side callouts, and circular inset previews arranged around the main character, mimicking a real manga magazine cover packed with text and hype. Place issue details in the upper right, including a date and a large issue number, and add multiple bright promotional banners in yellow, red, white, and black.

Main subject: a handsome anime-style teenage boy martial artist in the center, shown from the waist up in a strong fighting stance with both fists thrust toward the viewer. He has messy layered {argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"} hair with long bangs partly covering one eye, sharp amber eyes, a confident smirk, and several ear piercings. He wears a soft white panda hat with black ears and panda eye patches on top, and a vivid red Chinese kung fu shirt with black frog closures and black trim, featuring a large black dragon motif on the chest. His pose should feel dynamic and confrontational, as if ready to strike, with foreshortened fists filling the foreground.

Background: a warm, slightly blurred traditional East Asian street or interior market scene with wooden beams, lantern-like red accents, and golden ambient lighting, kept soft so the character and typography dominate. Use fiery yellow energy bursts, black ink splashes, speed-line accents, and paint-like brush effects around the lower half of the cover to amplify impact.

Typography and cover-line design: include 1 giant vertical brush-calligraphy slogan on the left, 1 very large main title across the lower center in aggressive black and red kanji-style lettering, 1 smaller horizontal tagline beneath it in white and yellow, 1 yellow burst in the lower left promoting circulation or sales, 1 red banner near the lower right promoting a special feature, 1 large yellow-and-green feature box in the upper right, and 2 circular inset character preview portraits stacked along the right side with short Japanese teaser text next to each. Also include 1 small skull-emblem graphic near the top center-right integrated into the masthead area. The overall look must feel like a bestselling action manga issue focused on a new martial-arts series titled {argument name="series title" default="龍拳の咆哮"}, with the lead character {argument name="character name" default="Yume"} presented as a breakout shonen hero. Ultra-saturated colors, crisp anime rendering, polished print-cover finish, dramatic contrast, and authentic magazine-cover composition.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张光泽感十足的日式周刊少年漫画杂志封面，采用高能量商业漫画选集的风格，布局紧凑拥挤，排版充满爆发力，并配有戏剧性的封面标题设计。封面为纵向构图，顶部由巨大的红色刊名占据，带有粗黑边框和黄色点缀，并附有英文副标题“WEEKLY JUMP”。在主角周围添加大量日文预告短语、期号框、星形爆炸框、侧边标注和圆形插图预览，模仿真实漫画杂志封面那种文字密集、充满噱头的效果。将期号详情置于右上角，包括日期和一个大号期号，并添加多个黄色、红色、白色和黑色的醒目宣传横幅。

主体：一位帅气的动漫风格少年武术家位于中心，半身像，摆出强有力的战斗姿态，双拳向观众方向挥出。他留着凌乱的层次感 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 发型，长刘海遮住了一只眼睛，有着锐利的琥珀色双眼、自信的坏笑和多处耳钉。他戴着一顶柔软的白色熊猫帽，帽子上有黑色耳朵和熊猫眼罩，身穿鲜红色的中式功夫衫，配有黑色盘扣和黑色滚边，胸前饰有巨大的黑色龙纹。他的姿势应充满动感和对抗性，仿佛随时准备出击，透视效果的拳头占据了前景。

背景：温暖且略微模糊的传统东亚街道或室内市场场景，带有木梁、灯笼般的红色装饰和金色环境光，背景保持柔和，以突出人物和排版。在封面下半部分使用火热的黄色能量爆发、黑色墨迹飞溅、速度线装饰和类似油漆的笔触效果，以增强视觉冲击力。

排版与封面标题设计：左侧包含 1 个巨大的垂直书法口号，下部中心横跨 1 个非常大的主标题，采用具有侵略性的黑红汉字风格字体，下方配有 1 个较小的白色和黄色水平标语，左下角有 1 个宣传发行量或销量的黄色爆炸框，右下角附近有 1 个宣传特别专题的红色横幅，右上角有 1 个大型黄绿相间的专题框，右侧堆叠 2 个圆形人物预览肖像，旁边配有简短的日文预告文字。此外，在顶部中右侧刊名区域附近集成 1 个小型骷髅徽章图形。整体外观必须呈现出畅销动作漫画期刊的感觉，重点推介一部名为 {argument name="series title" default="龍拳の咆哮"} 的新连载武术漫画，并将主角 {argument name="character name" default="Yume"} 塑造成新一代少年漫画英雄。色彩超饱和，动漫渲染清晰，具有精致的印刷封面质感、强烈的对比度和地道的杂志封面构图。

templates.title: Premium Japanese Gym Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高级日式健身房海报

templates.prompt: A premium vertical poster advertisement for a fictional sports gym brand, photographed in a realistic high-end fitness editorial style. Show a fit athletic adult woman with a toned, curvy physique in a modern gym, captured from upper thighs to head in a dynamic three-quarter pose while performing a cable machine exercise. She has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose strands, lightly glistening skin as if from sweat, and she wears a deep navy blue high-cut one-piece training bodysuit with thin straps. Her right hand grips a black cable handle close to her waist, with the cable extending diagonally down to the right; her left arm is bent and braced outward near the machine column. Use dramatic warm sunlight from the side mixed with cool gym ambient light, strong highlights on shoulders, chest, arms, and thighs, shallow depth of field, blurred weight machines in the background, and a luxurious, motivational commercial fitness atmosphere. Compose the layout like a Japanese gym poster with bold white Mincho-style vertical headline text in the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="整える強さ。"}, a thin blue horizontal line beneath it, and a smaller white subheadline below reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="無理をしない。続ける。"}. In the bottom left, place a minimalist geometric logo mark above the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="NOVAFIT"} in white uppercase sans serif, with the small tagline {argument name="tagline" default="STRENGTH & BALANCE"}. Clean premium typography, strong contrast, aspirational branding, practical ad-poster design, 4:5 vertical format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张为虚构运动健身品牌设计的高级竖版海报，采用写实的高端健身杂志风格拍摄。画面展示了一位身材健美、曲线优美的成年女性，置身于现代健身房中，镜头从大腿上部到头部拍摄，呈现出她在使用绳索训练器时充满动感的四分之三侧身姿态。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 的头发，扎成高马尾，有几缕碎发垂下，皮肤因汗水而微微闪烁，身穿深海军蓝色的高开叉连体训练服，肩带纤细。她的右手在腰部附近紧握黑色绳索手柄，绳索向右下方延伸；左臂弯曲并支撑在训练器立柱旁。运用侧面强烈的暖色阳光与冷色调健身房环境光混合，在肩膀、胸部、手臂和大腿处形成强光，采用浅景深效果，背景中的健身器械虚化，营造出奢华且充满动力的商业健身氛围。排版参考日式健身房海报，左上角使用醒目的白色明朝体竖排标题 {argument name="headline text" default="整える強さ。"}，下方配有一条细蓝色横线，再下方是较小的白色副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="無理をしない。続ける。"}。左下角放置一个极简几何 Logo，下方是白色大写无衬线字体的品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="NOVAFIT"}，以及一行小标语 {argument name="tagline" default="STRENGTH & BALANCE"}。排版简洁高级，对比强烈，具有品牌感和实用的广告海报设计感，4:5 竖版比例。

templates.title: Red Jet Mecha Studio Render

titleLocalized.zh: 红色喷气式机甲摄影棚渲染

templates.prompt: A full-body studio render of a high-detail transforming anime mecha inspired by a red jet fighter robot, standing in a confident three-quarter front pose against a clean light gray seamless background. The robot has a heroic, angular silhouette with 2 tall vertical fins rising behind the head, 2 swept-back airplane wings mounted on the back and shoulders, and 2 forearm-mounted blaster cannons pointing downward. The armor is predominantly {argument name="primary armor color" default="bright red"} with white wing panels and lower legs, dark navy-charcoal inner frame and thighs, small yellow vent details on the chest and shoulders, and a glossy translucent blue cockpit canopy centered on the chest. The head is compact and mechanical with a dark faceplate and helmet-like structure, partially recessed between the shoulder assemblies. Add a small purple Decepticon-style insignia printed on the robot’s right wing. Emphasize hard-surface panel lines, layered mechanical plating, realistic joints, pistons, vents, intakes, and premium plastic-and-metal model-kit textures. The wings should have sharp aerodynamic edges with red striping, the shoulders should look like jet engine housings, and the legs should be bulky and armored with asymmetrical aircraft parts attached, including 2 small side fins near the calves and 1 visible missile-like detail on the outer right shin. Use crisp product-photography lighting, ultra-sharp focus, subtle shadow under the feet, and a polished collectible-toy / concept-art presentation in the style of a modern Japanese mecha design sheet.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身摄影棚渲染图，展示了一个高细节、可变形的动漫机甲，灵感源自红色喷气式战斗机机器人，以自信的四分之三正面姿态站立在干净的浅灰色无缝背景前。该机器人拥有英雄般的棱角轮廓，头部后方竖立着 2 片高大的垂直尾翼，背部和肩部安装有 2 片后掠式飞机机翼，前臂安装有 2 门向下指向的爆能炮。装甲主体为 {argument name="primary armor color" default="亮红色"}，配有白色翼板和小腿，深海军炭灰色内骨架和大腿，胸部和肩部带有小型黄色通风口细节，胸部中央镶嵌着光泽的半透明蓝色驾驶舱盖。头部紧凑且充满机械感，配有深色面罩和头盔状结构，部分嵌入肩部组件之间。在机器人的右翼上印有一个紫色的小型霸天虎风格徽章。强调硬表面刻线、分层机械装甲、逼真的关节、活塞、通风口、进气口以及高级塑料与金属模型套件的质感。机翼应具有带有红色条纹的锋利空气动力学边缘，肩部看起来像喷气发动机外壳，腿部应厚实且带有不对称的飞机部件装甲，包括小腿附近 2 片小型侧鳍和右外胫骨上可见的 1 个导弹状细节。采用清晰的产品摄影布光、超锐利对焦、脚下微妙的阴影，并以现代日本机甲设计图纸的风格呈现出精致的收藏级玩具/概念艺术效果。

templates.title: Rokumeikan Ballroom Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 鹿鸣馆舞厅肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic portrait of a {argument name="ethnicity" default="Japanese"} woman dancing at an opulent Rokumeikan-era ballroom reception in late 19th-century Japan, shown from about the waist up in a three-quarter pose and turning slightly to her left. She wears an elegant {argument name="dress color" default="champagne beige"} Victorian-inspired evening gown with a tightly fitted corseted bodice, soft sheen satin fabric, layered lace ruffles along the neckline and shoulders, decorative buttons and floral trim on the front, and long matching opera gloves. Her hair is dark and styled in a refined formal updo with curled sections and a delicate jeweled hair ornament, and she wears drop earrings plus layered necklaces with a small pendant. She holds a folded fan or small clutch in one gloved hand near her waist. The setting is a grand historic ballroom with warm amber gaslight or chandelier lighting, shallow depth of field, and a softly blurred crowd of exactly 4 visible background guests in formal attire: 2 women and 2 men. Behind her are dark-suited gentlemen, women in period dresses, and a large floral arrangement, all rendered as elegant bokeh shapes. The mood is romantic, nostalgic, and luxurious, with rich sepia-gold tones, soft cinematic contrast, realistic skin and fabric textures, and the feeling of a graceful dance at {argument name="venue style" default="Rokumeikan"}. Compose it like a high-end historical film still, vertical portrait framing, centered heroine, natural posture, poised and aristocratic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级、照片写实风格的肖像，主角是一位 {argument name="ethnicity" default="日本"} 女性，正在 19 世纪末日本奢华的鹿鸣馆时代舞厅招待会上跳舞。画面呈现腰部以上的三分之二侧身姿态，身体微微向左转。她身穿一件优雅的 {argument name="dress color" default="香槟米色"} 维多利亚风格晚礼服，紧身胸衣剪裁合体，采用柔和光泽的缎面材质，领口和肩部饰有层叠的蕾丝花边，前襟带有装饰性纽扣和花卉饰边，并佩戴长款配套歌剧手套。她的深色头发梳成精致的正式盘发，带有卷曲的发丝和精致的珠宝发饰，佩戴水滴状耳环以及带有小吊坠的叠戴项链。她的一只戴着手套的手在腰间拿着一把折扇或一个小手包。背景是一个宏伟的历史舞厅，有着温暖的琥珀色煤气灯或吊灯照明，景深较浅，背景中隐约可见 4 位穿着正式礼服的宾客：2 位女性和 2 位男性。她身后是身着深色西装的绅士、穿着年代礼服的女士以及大型花艺装饰，均呈现为优雅的焦外成像效果。整体氛围浪漫、怀旧且奢华，带有浓郁的深褐色调，柔和的电影级对比度，逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，营造出在 {argument name="venue style" default="鹿鸣馆"} 优雅起舞的意境。构图参考高端历史电影剧照，采用竖向肖像构图，主角居中，姿态自然，优雅且高贵。

templates.title: Anime Girl in a Golden Clockwork World

titleLocalized.zh: 金色发条世界中的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A breathtaking vertical anime illustration of a delicate steampunk time world filled wall-to-wall with enormous interlocking clocks, exposed gears, rotating rings, pendulums, and ornate mechanical structures in polished gold, brass, bronze, and dark steel. The composition is extremely dense and intricate, with exactly 3 dominant oversized clock faces visible: one in the upper left, one large partial clock in the lower right, and one central ring-like clock structure near the upper middle, surrounded by dozens of smaller visible clockworks and gear assemblies layered deep into the background. A radiant shaft of white-gold light pours down from the top center, creating sparkling highlights, rim light, reflections, lens-like glints, and dramatic depth across the metallic machinery. In the lower left floats a young anime girl, about three-quarter full body, with {argument name="hair color" default="soft pastel pink"} long wavy hair streaming outward as if suspended in air, large {argument name="eye color" default="emerald green"} eyes, and a gentle, slightly wistful expression. She wears an elaborate {argument name="dress color" default="dusty rose pink"} lolita-style dress with heavy frills, lace, ribbons, layered ruffles, floral details, puffed sleeves, corset lacing, and matching heeled shoes, plus a flowered bonnet or mini hat tilted on her head. Her pose is light and floating, one arm slightly extended, skirt and hair blown by invisible motion, as if drifting inside a giant celestial clock tower. The mood is magical, luminous, intricate, and romantic, with ultra-detailed linework, high-contrast lighting, rich metallic reflections, fantasy steampunk aesthetics, and painterly anime rendering in the style of a premium key visual. No text, no borders, no extra characters. Emphasize overwhelming scale, dense mechanical complexity, and the contrast between the soft feminine character and the monumental golden machinery.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊叹的竖版动漫插画，描绘了一个精致的蒸汽朋克时间世界，墙壁上布满了巨大的连锁时钟、裸露的齿轮、旋转的圆环、摆钟以及由抛光金、黄铜、青铜和深色钢材构成的华丽机械结构。构图极其密集且复杂，画面中清晰可见 3 个占据主导地位的超大时钟表盘：一个位于左上方，一个巨大的局部时钟位于右下方，还有一个环状时钟结构位于中上方，周围环绕着数十个深层背景中可见的小型发条和齿轮组件。一道耀眼的白金色光束从顶部中心倾泻而下，在金属机械上营造出闪烁的高光、轮廓光、反射、镜头光晕和强烈的深度感。左下方漂浮着一位年轻的动漫少女，约四分之三全身像，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和的粉彩色"} 长波浪卷发，仿佛悬浮在空中，有着一双 {argument name="eye color" default="翡翠绿"} 的大眼睛，表情温柔且略带忧郁。她穿着一件精致的 {argument name="dress color" default="干枯玫瑰粉"} 洛丽塔风格连衣裙，带有厚重的褶边、蕾丝、丝带、层叠的荷叶边、花卉细节、泡泡袖、紧身胸衣系带和配套的高跟鞋，头上还戴着一顶花卉软帽或迷你帽。她的姿态轻盈漂浮，一只手臂微微伸展，裙摆和头发在无形的动作中飘动，仿佛在巨大的天体钟楼内漂流。整体氛围充满魔幻、光影感、复杂且浪漫，具有超精细的线条、高对比度的光影、丰富的金属反射、奇幻蒸汽朋克美学，以及高级主视觉图风格的绘画感动漫渲染。无文字，无边框，无额外字符。强调压倒性的规模感、密集的机械复杂性，以及柔美的女性角色与宏伟的金色机械之间的对比。

templates.title: Ornate Emerald Magical Girl Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 华丽翡翠魔法少女肖像

templates.prompt: A highly polished anime magical-girl portrait in the style of a luxurious shoujo illustration, showing a confident teenage heroine inspired by a planet-themed sailor guardian. She stands in a three-quarter pose from mid-thigh up, centered, with her left hand on her hip and her right hand giving a thumbs-up. She has {argument name="hair color" default="warm chestnut brown"} hair styled in a very high, voluminous ponytail tied with 2 glossy green bead ornaments, with long flowing curls sweeping dramatically to the right. Her outfit is a classic sailor-style magical uniform with 5 clearly visible main clothing elements: a fitted white bodice, a deep emerald-green sailor collar, a large pink chest bow with a round green gem brooch at the center, a short pleated emerald-green skirt, and a large pink back bow visible at the waist. She also wears 4 visible accessories: 2 long white elbow gloves, 2 stacked emerald-green wrist bands, small pink gemstone stud earrings, and a green choker. Render the costume with glossy satin-like highlights and elegant reflective fabric. The character should project bravery, poise, and sparkling heroic charm. Place her against an ornate celestial fantasy background split diagonally into 2 contrasting zones: a dark midnight-blue galaxy field filled with stars, and a luminous iridescent crystal field with prismatic shimmer. Surround the scene with elaborate gold filigree lacework, hanging crystal chains, star pendants, jeweled ornaments, and large faceted gemstones. Include floral crystal decorations in the corners, especially layered translucent flowers and roses in lavender, violet, and icy blue tones. Fill the entire image with intense sparkle effects, lens-like starbursts, glitter dust, and jewel reflections. Use a rich palette of emerald green, blush pink, gold, sapphire, lavender, and pearl white. The composition should feel premium, radiant, ornate, and nostalgic, like a deluxe collector art print of {argument name="character theme" default="emerald planet guardian"}. Ultra-detailed anime illustration, crisp linework, glossy highlights, luminous shading, intricate decorative background, masterpiece quality, square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅高度精致的动漫魔法少女肖像，采用奢华的少女漫插画风格，展现了一位灵感源自行星主题水手守护者的自信少女英雄。她以四分之三侧身姿势站立，取景范围从大腿中部向上，构图居中，左手叉腰，右手竖起大拇指。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"} 的秀发，扎成高耸且蓬松的马尾，并用 2 个亮面绿色珠饰固定，长长的卷发向右侧戏剧性地垂落。她的服装是经典的学院风魔法制服，包含 5 个清晰可见的主要元素：修身的白色上衣、深翡翠绿水手领、胸前带有圆形绿宝石胸针的大型粉色蝴蝶结、短款百褶翡翠绿裙，以及腰间可见的大型粉色后蝴蝶结。她还佩戴了 4 种可见配饰：2 只长款白色肘部手套、2 层叠式翡翠绿腕带、小型粉色宝石耳钉和一条绿色项圈。服装渲染需呈现出缎面般的光泽感和优雅的反射质感。角色应展现出勇敢、从容和闪耀的英雄魅力。背景为华丽的星空奇幻场景，对角线划分为 2 个对比鲜明的区域：充满繁星的深午夜蓝银河，以及带有棱镜光泽的明亮虹彩水晶场。场景周围环绕着精致的金色花丝蕾丝、悬挂的水晶链、星形吊坠、珠宝装饰和大型多面宝石。角落处加入花卉水晶装饰，特别是薰衣草色、紫罗兰色和冰蓝色的层叠半透明花朵与玫瑰。整幅画面充满强烈的闪光特效、镜头星芒、闪粉和珠宝反射。使用翡翠绿、腮红粉、金色、蓝宝石色、薰衣草色和珍珠白的丰富色调。整体构图应呈现出高级、璀璨、华丽且怀旧的质感，如同 {argument name="character theme" default="翡翠行星守护者"} 的豪华收藏级艺术印刷品。超精细动漫插画，清晰的线条，光泽高光，明亮的阴影，复杂的装饰背景，大师级品质，方形构图。

templates.title: Awkward Blurry Nightclub Rainbow Hair Shot

titleLocalized.zh: 尴尬模糊的夜店彩虹发色抓拍

templates.prompt: A candid, badly timed snapshot aesthetic taken from too close and slightly behind, as if someone accidentally photographed a person at the worst possible moment in a dark nightclub. The image is vertically framed and heavily motion-blurred, with the subject filling almost the entire frame. Show only 1 person, turned away from the camera so the face is not visible, with long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="rainbow pastel hair"} transitioning from hot pink and orange at the crown into yellow, green, cyan, blue, and violet through the lengths. The person wears a pale blush-pink top or hoodie, softly lit and also blurred by movement. The composition should feel awkward and intrusive, with the camera too close, the hair dominating the left and center of the frame, and only a partial shoulder and back visible near the bottom right. In the dark background, include 1 dim nightclub bar area with scattered colored lights, shiny bottles, and vague reflective highlights on the right side, all out of focus. Use harsh mixed club lighting, low-light digital camera noise, flash-like exposure on the hair and clothing, strong blur, shallow detail, and an unflattering accidental-phone-photo vibe. Make it feel like a forbidden saved snapshot, messy, spontaneous, and realistically imperfect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍的、时机不佳的快照，拍摄距离过近且略微从后方取景，仿佛有人在昏暗的夜店里最糟糕的时刻意外拍下了一个人。图像采用竖构图，带有强烈的动态模糊，主体几乎填满了整个画面。仅展示 1 个人，背对镜头，因此看不到脸部，留着长波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="彩虹色系发色"} 从头顶的亮粉色和橙色过渡到发梢的黄色、绿色、青色、蓝色和紫色。此人穿着淡腮红粉色的上衣或连帽衫，光线柔和，同样因移动而模糊。构图应显得尴尬且具有侵入感，镜头靠得太近，头发占据了画面的左侧和中心，右下角仅露出部分肩膀和背部。在黑暗的背景中，包含 1 个昏暗的夜店吧台区域，散布着彩色灯光、闪亮的酒瓶和右侧模糊的反光高光，全部处于失焦状态。使用刺眼的混合夜店灯光、低光数字相机噪点、头发和衣服上的闪光灯式曝光、强烈的模糊、浅显的细节以及一种不讨喜的手机意外拍摄氛围。使其感觉像是一张被禁存的快照，凌乱、自发且具有真实的瑕疵感。
