templates.title: Chibi Cat Maid Crayon Art Scene

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版猫耳女仆蜡笔画场景

templates.prompt: A warm, nostalgic anime illustration in a childlike crayon-drawing style on textured beige paper, featuring a super-deformed chibi cat-eared maid girl lying on her stomach and drawing in a large spiral sketchbook. She has oversized cat ears, a frilly white maid headband, twin tails, and multicolored hair in bright pastel rainbow sections of pink, blue, yellow, and orange, with large teal-blue eyes and a calm, focused expression. Her black-and-white maid outfit includes bows, lace, puffy sleeves, fluffy cuffs, and tiny decorative clips. She holds a blue crayon and is drawing a simple crayon character on the open sketchbook page. Around her is a messy tabletop or floor covered with colorful crayon scribbles and loose sheets of paper. Include exactly 6 visible crayons scattered around the scene in different colors, with no crayon box packaging prominently shown. On the left, place a small cardboard box containing a sleepy black cat nestled among crayons, and draw a simple cat-face doodle near it. In the lower left foreground, include 1 small toy-like white robot cat figure with blue accents sitting and watching. In the upper right background, hang exactly 2 children's drawings clipped to a string: one with a pink heart and one with a flower and rainbow. On the upper left, add large handwritten Japanese crayon text reading 「完璧じゃなくて いーんだよ！ だって、今日の わたしは がんばったもん！」 in multicolored crayon lettering. Use soft lighting, cozy craft-room atmosphere, gentle grain, and intentionally rough waxy crayon texture throughout the entire image. Make it adorable, heartfelt, and handmade-looking, with visible uneven outlines and layered scribbles, but do not show realistic crayons being actively presented to the viewer.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温暖且充满怀旧感的动漫插画，采用童趣十足的蜡笔画风格，背景为带有纹理的米色纸张。画面中心是一位超萌的 Q 版猫耳女仆，她趴在地上，正在一本巨大的螺旋素描本上作画。她有着超大的猫耳、蕾丝女仆发带和双马尾，发色为粉、蓝、黄、橙组成的明亮马卡龙色系，拥有一双硕大的青蓝色眼睛，神情专注而平静。她身穿黑白配色的女仆装，装饰着蝴蝶结、蕾丝、泡泡袖、毛绒袖口和精致的小发夹。她手持一支蓝色蜡笔，正在素描本上画着一个简单的蜡笔小人。她周围的桌面或地板上散落着凌乱的蜡笔涂鸦和零散的纸张。画面中需包含 6 支清晰可见、颜色各异的蜡笔，不要出现显眼的蜡笔包装盒。左侧放置一个小型纸板箱，里面有一只睡眼惺忪的黑猫蜷缩在蜡笔中，旁边画有一个简单的猫脸涂鸦。左下角前景处，放置一个带有蓝色点缀的白色玩具机器人猫，正坐着观看。右上角背景处，悬挂着 2 幅用夹子固定在绳子上的儿童画：一幅画着粉色爱心，另一幅画着花朵和彩虹。左上角添加一行巨大的手写日语蜡笔文字：「完璧じゃなくて いーんだよ！ だって、今日の わたしは がんばったもん！」，文字采用彩色蜡笔笔触。整体采用柔和的灯光，营造出舒适的手工室氛围，带有细腻的颗粒感和刻意呈现的粗糙蜡质蜡笔纹理。画面需可爱、走心且具有手工感，线条不均匀且涂鸦层次丰富，但不要展示写实的蜡笔包装盒。

templates.title: Crimson Accent Gothic Bridal Gown

titleLocalized.zh: 深红点缀哥特式婚纱

templates.prompt: A dramatic full-body fantasy bridal portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a young woman"} standing in a ruined gothic cathedral, viewed from a slightly low angle to emphasize the grandeur of the dress. She wears an elaborate wedding gown with a fitted white corset bodice, delicate lace embroidery, off-shoulder lace details, and long translucent lace gloves. The skirt is extremely voluminous and layered with cascading ruffles, sheer fabric, and lace-trimmed panels, featuring a striking {argument name="accent color" default="deep crimson red"} to white gradient concentrated toward the lower inner layers and center front, with rich red fabric visible beneath the white overskirt. Add red rose clusters and ribbon accents at the waist and down the front of the gown, plus a large floral hair ornament made of white flowers and red roses. Her {argument name="hair color" default="dark wine red"} hair is styled in a soft updo with loose strands, and she wears a long cathedral veil edged with intricate lace that spreads behind her. In one hand she holds or rests near a bouquet of red and white roses. Surround her with floating rose petals, mostly red with a few white petals, creating a cinematic sense of motion. The setting is a vast abandoned cathedral interior with towering pointed arches, broken tracery windows, weathered stone, climbing vines, and soft daylight streaming through the openings. The mood is elegant, ethereal, romantic, and slightly gothic, with ultra-detailed fabric rendering, realistic lace texture, soft glow, high contrast, and polished painterly-photoreal fantasy illustration. Keep the red accents clean, luxurious, and floral rather than smeared, avoiding any blood-like appearance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的全身奇幻新娘肖像，主角 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻女性"} 站在废墟哥特式大教堂中，采用略微仰视的视角以突显礼服的宏伟。她身着精致的婚纱，配有修身的白色束胸衣、细腻的蕾丝刺绣、露肩蕾丝细节以及长款半透明蕾丝手套。裙摆极其蓬松，层叠着层叠褶边、透明面料和蕾丝饰边，裙摆内层和前中位置呈现出从 {argument name="accent color" default="深绯红色"} 到白色的惊艳渐变，白色外裙下隐约可见浓郁的红色面料。腰部和裙前点缀着红玫瑰花簇与丝带，并配有由白花和红玫瑰组成的大型花卉头饰。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深酒红色"} 头发梳成柔和的盘发，留有几缕发丝，身披长款大教堂头纱，边缘饰有复杂的蕾丝，在身后铺展开来。她手中拿着或身旁放着一束红白玫瑰花束。周围环绕着漂浮的玫瑰花瓣，以红色为主，间杂少量白色，营造出电影般的动感。背景是广阔的废弃大教堂内部，拥有高耸的尖拱、破碎的窗棂、风化的石材、攀爬的藤蔓，柔和的日光透过开口处倾泻而下。整体氛围优雅、空灵、浪漫且带有轻微的哥特感，呈现出超细节的面料渲染、逼真的蕾丝质感、柔和的光晕、高对比度以及精致的绘画级写实奇幻插画风格。保持红色点缀的干净、奢华与花卉感，避免晕染，杜绝任何类似血迹的视觉效果。

templates.title: Japanese Summer Accessory Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日系夏季配饰广告海报

templates.prompt:
Create a polished Japanese summer fashion advertisement poster in a square 1:1 layout, bright airy coastal lifestyle photography with a luxury catalog feel. Show a young woman from the waist up standing on a tropical beach with turquoise ocean, pale sand, soft sky, and slightly blurred palm leaves in the upper right background. She wears a wide-brim natural straw sun hat with a blue ribbon band, long straight dark hair, and a loose blue-and-white tie-dye top. Her face is obscured by a centered soft rectangular blur block. One hand lightly touches the brim of the hat. Add beachy hair accessories hanging from both sides of the hat and hair: strings with shells, beads, tassels, and round ornaments, including one long white-and-blue braided strand on the right side. She wears 4 visible jewelry items: a silver heart pendant necklace, a stack of beaded and metallic bracelets on one wrist, 1 shell drop earring on the left side, and 1 shell drop earring on the right side. Use soft natural sunlight, clean high-end product-ad styling, gentle skin tones, and refreshing summer blue color grading.

Design the image as a commercial poster with Japanese text and product callouts integrated around the model. In the upper left, place the handwritten English phrase {argument name="tagline" default="Summer Breeze"} in thin elegant white script. Below it, add a large Japanese headline in dark blue Mincho-style serif: {argument name="headline text" default="夏をまとう、私らしい輝き。"}. Under that, add two lines of smaller Japanese body copy in dark gray: "海風に揺れるアクセサリーで、" and "いつものコーデを特別に。".

On the left-middle, create a semi-transparent white rounded panel titled "— おすすめアイテム —" containing exactly 3 product cards arranged horizontally. Card 1 shows a silver heart necklace and the label "Ocean Heart Necklace" with price "¥2,980". Card 2 shows shell drop earrings and the label "Shell Drop Pierce" with price "¥2,480". Card 3 shows a natural bead bracelet and the label "Natural Beads Bracelet" with price "¥1,980".

In the lower left, add a blue circular discount badge with white Japanese text "期間限定" and large text "10% OFF". Overlapping it, place a white coupon pill with a small blue ribbon tab containing "クーポンコード" and the large code {argument name="coupon code" default="SUMMER10"}, plus small text "有効期限：2024.8.31まで".

At the top right, place a translucent aqua-blue circle badge with elegant light text reading "New Collection 2024". In the bottom left, add the brand logo text {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIERE"} in large serif capitals with smaller spaced text "ACCESSORY" beneath it. In the bottom right, place a large white rounded call-to-action button with a teal outline shopping cart icon and Japanese text {argument name="button text" default="今すぐチェック"}, followed by a right-pointing chevron. Keep all typography refined and balanced, with a premium Japanese fashion e-commerce promotional layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张精致的日系夏季时尚广告海报，采用 1:1 正方形布局，呈现明亮通透的海岸生活方式摄影风格，具备高端产品目录的质感。画面展示一位年轻女性的半身像，背景为热带海滩，拥有绿松石色的海洋、浅色沙滩、柔和的天空，右上角背景处有轻微虚化的棕榈叶。她戴着一顶带有蓝色丝带装饰的宽檐天然草编遮阳帽，留着长直黑发，身穿宽松的蓝白扎染上衣。她的面部被居中的柔和矩形模糊块遮挡。一只手轻轻触碰帽檐。在帽子和头发两侧添加海滩风发饰：带有贝壳、珠子、流苏和圆形装饰的挂绳，右侧包含一条长长的白蓝编织发辫。她佩戴 4 件显眼的珠宝：一条银色心形吊坠项链、手腕上叠戴的珠饰与金属手链、左侧一只贝壳垂坠耳环、右侧一只贝壳垂坠耳环。使用柔和的自然光，采用干净的高端产品广告风格，肤色温润，色调为清爽的夏季蓝色。

将图像设计为商业海报，日文文字和产品标注围绕模特进行整合。在左上角，放置手写体英文短语 {argument name="tagline" default="Summer Breeze"}，使用纤细优雅的白色字体。下方添加一行深蓝色明朝体大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="夏をまとう、私らしい輝き。"}。在其下方，添加两行深灰色的日文正文：“海風に揺れるアクセサリーで、” 以及 “いつものコーデを特別に。”。

在左侧中部，创建一个半透明的白色圆角面板，标题为 “— おすすめアイテム —”，其中横向排列 3 张产品卡片。卡片 1 展示银色心形项链，标签为 “Ocean Heart Necklace”，价格为 “¥2,980”。卡片 2 展示贝壳垂坠耳环，标签为 “Shell Drop Pierce”，价格为 “¥2,480”。卡片 3 展示天然珠饰手链，标签为 “Natural Beads Bracelet”，价格为 “¥1,980”。

在左下角，添加一个蓝色圆形折扣徽章，内含白色日文 “期間限定” 和大号文字 “10% OFF”。在其上方叠加一个白色优惠券胶囊标签，带有蓝色小丝带图标，包含 “クーポンコード” 和大号代码 {argument name="coupon code" default="SUMMER10"}，以及小字 “有効期限：2024.8.31まで”。

在右上角，放置一个半透明的水蓝色圆形徽章，带有优雅的浅色文字 “New Collection 2024”。在左下角，添加品牌 Logo 文字 {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIERE"}，使用大号衬线体大写字母，下方配有间距较宽的 “ACCESSORY” 字样。在右下角，放置一个带有青色轮廓购物车图标的白色圆角行动呼吁按钮，文字为 {argument name="button text" default="今すぐチェック"}，后跟一个向右的箭头。保持所有排版精致且平衡，呈现出高端日系时尚电商的促销布局。

templates.title: Anime Creative Team Studio Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫创意团队工作室海报

templates.prompt: A polished anime-style corporate team illustration in a bright modern creative studio, featuring exactly 3 seated women shown from the waist up behind a worktable, arranged left to right as a team introduction poster. The overall mood is elegant, professional, soft, and slightly dreamy, with delicate linework, painterly shading, airy window light, muted pastel colors, and refined visual-novel/key-art rendering. On the left, a stylish digital artist named {argument name="character name" default="Runa"} with voluminous wavy lavender hair in a high ponytail with braided accents and loose strands, wearing a black camisole with lace trim, layered necklaces, and an oversized translucent lavender jacket slipping off the shoulders, holds a stylus in one hand beside a pen-display tablet showing a purple-toned anime illustration. In the center, a virtual singer character named {argument name="character name" default="種守 詩乃"} with very long straight silver-lilac hair, cool pale skin, and a calm expression, wears a black inner top under a glossy translucent jacket with belts and straps, plus delicate star-like hair accessories, posed with one hand near the collar. On the right, an editor/director named {argument name="character name" default="橋本 推"} with short ash-brown hair and a neat side part, wearing a white button-up shirt, dark cardigan, and lanyard, sits thoughtfully with one hand at the chin and the other holding a pen over documents. The office background includes tall bookshelves, binders, a softly glowing large window, a wall planning board with diagrams and notes, stacks of papers, notebooks, mugs, and desk clutter that feels actively used but organized. Add printed branding and editorial layout text integrated into the image like a recruitment or mission poster: top left header "KAMINOOPS STUDIO", below it "クリエイターチーム" and a short Japanese mission paragraph; top right header "Our Mission" with Japanese supporting text; 3 name-card panels aligned below the characters, one for each person, each including the role line, a short Japanese profile paragraph, and age and height details; and a bottom horizontal information band split into exactly 4 boxed sections, including a left title area about team connection, exactly 3 icon-based explanatory boxes in the middle, and a right box titled about team values with exactly 3 bullet points. Use a clean editorial composition with subtle borders and semi-transparent white panels for text, realistic desk perspective, high detail in fabric sheen and hair strands, and a premium Japanese studio brochure aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格企业团队插画，背景为明亮的现代创意工作室，画面中包含 3 位坐在工作台后的女性（半身像），从左至右排列，呈现为团队介绍海报。整体氛围优雅、专业、柔和且略带梦幻感，线条细腻，采用绘画式阴影、通透的窗光、柔和的粉彩色调以及精致的视觉小说/关键视觉图渲染风格。左侧是一位时尚数字艺术家，名为 {argument name="character name" default="Runa"}，留着蓬松的薰衣草色波浪长发，扎着高马尾并带有编发点缀，几缕发丝垂落，身穿黑色蕾丝边吊带背心，佩戴叠层项链，外搭一件滑落肩头的超大款半透明薰衣草色外套，一手拿着触控笔，身旁是显示着紫色调动漫插画的数位屏。中间是一位虚拟歌手角色，名为 {argument name="character name" default="種守 詩乃"}，留着极长的直顺银丁香色头发，肤色冷白，表情平静，内穿黑色上衣，外搭带有皮带和束带的亮面半透明外套，佩戴精致的星形发饰，单手轻触领口。右侧是一位编辑/导演，名为 {argument name="character name" default="橋本 推"}，留着灰棕色短发，侧分整齐，身穿白色衬衫，外搭深色开衫，佩戴挂绳，单手托腮，另一只手拿着笔放在文件上，神情专注。办公室背景包括高大的书架、活页夹、一扇柔和发光的大窗户、墙上挂着图表和笔记的“项目”板、成堆的文件、笔记本、马克杯以及办公桌上虽显杂乱但井然有序的物件。在图像中融入印刷品牌和编辑排版文本，使其看起来像招聘或使命海报：左上角标题为“KAMINOOPS STUDIO”，下方为“クリエイターチーム”及一段简短的日语使命说明；右上角标题为“Our Mission”并配有日语辅助文本；角色下方对齐排列 3 个名片面板，每人一个，包含职位行、简短的日语个人简介以及年龄和身高信息；底部横向信息栏分为 4 个方框区域，包括左侧关于团队连接的标题区、中间 3 个基于图标的说明框，以及右侧关于团队价值的方框，内含 3 个要点。采用整洁的编辑构图，配有细微的边框和半透明白色文本面板，办公桌透视真实，织物光泽和发丝细节丰富，呈现出高端日本工作室宣传册的美学效果。

templates.title: Ink 360 Panorama of Tokyo Backstreet

titleLocalized.zh: 东京后巷水墨 360 度全景

templates.prompt: A monochrome black-ink line drawing designed specifically as a 360-degree panorama in equirectangular projection, with strong panoramic warping and curved architectural lines across the entire extra-wide frame. The scene is a narrow outdoor landing or walkway in a dense Japanese urban residential neighborhood, viewed from eye level, with the left and right edges bending upward as if wrapped for VR or polar panorama conversion. In the left foreground, a young woman with a deliberately blurred face crouches on the concrete floor near a metal railing, wearing a loose short-sleeve T-shirt with a dark chest pocket, shorts, and sneakers; her medium-length dark hair hangs forward. Next to her, exactly 1 black cat sits on the ground facing toward the city view. Also in the left foreground are exactly 1 closed umbrella leaning against the wall, exactly 2 plant pots, exactly 1 outdoor air-conditioning unit, exactly 1 mailbox, exactly 1 doorbell/intercom, and exactly 1 vertical apartment sign reading “201 コーポ ハルカ.” The midground opens to a descending staircase and tightly packed houses and apartment buildings with balconies, awnings, windows, utility boxes, and narrow alleyways. The background is filled with an intricate web of power poles, transformers, and overhead electrical wires stretching across the sky in dramatic arcs. Render everything with fine pen-and-ink hatching, sketchbook crosshatching, architectural detail, and a quiet observational manga-travel-sketch aesthetic on a clean white background, no color, no gray wash except the intentional face blur. Emphasize everyday realism, dense city texture, slight fisheye distortion, and the feeling of standing inside a hand-drawn panoramic slice of Tokyo. Use {argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:1"} panoramic composition and preserve the image as a seamless 360 environment illustration suitable for conversion into a polar panorama. Optionally let the crouching subject be {argument name="character description" default="young woman in casual summer clothes"} and the neighborhood be {argument name="location style" default="dense Japanese residential backstreet"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅单色黑墨线稿，专为等距柱状投影的 360 度全景设计，在超宽画幅中呈现强烈的全景畸变和弯曲的建筑线条。场景为日本密集住宅区内的一处狭窄户外平台或走道，平视视角，左右边缘向上弯曲，仿佛为 VR 或极坐标全景转换而包裹。左侧前景中，一名面部刻意模糊的年轻女性蹲在金属栏杆附近的混凝土路面上，身穿宽松短袖 T 恤（带深色胸袋）、短裤和运动鞋，中长深色头发垂在身前。她旁边，恰好有 1 只黑猫坐在地上，面向城市景观。左侧前景中还有：恰好 1 把靠墙放置的闭合雨伞、恰好 2 个花盆、恰好 1 台室外空调机、恰好 1 个邮箱、恰好 1 个门铃/对讲机，以及 1 个写有“201 コーポ ハルカ”的垂直公寓招牌。中景展现了向下的楼梯以及密集的房屋和公寓楼，配有阳台、遮阳篷、窗户、配电箱和狭窄的小巷。背景中，复杂的电线杆、变压器和架空电线交织成网，在天空中划出戏剧性的弧线。以精细的钢笔水墨排线、速写交叉阴影、建筑细节和安静的观察式漫画旅行素描美学进行渲染，背景为干净的白色，无色彩，除刻意模糊的面部外无灰色渲染。强调日常现实感、密集的城市纹理、轻微的鱼眼畸变，以及置身于手绘东京全景切片中的感觉。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:1"} 全景构图，并将图像保留为适合转换为极坐标全景的无缝 360 度环境插图。可选地，将蹲着的主体设为 {argument name="character description" default="身着休闲夏装的年轻女性"}，将街区设为 {argument name="location style" default="密集的日本住宅后巷"}。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Izanagi Divine Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克伊邪那岐：神之战士

templates.prompt: A cinematic cyberpunk portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Izanagi"} reimagined as a divine futuristic warrior, shown from the back and slightly in profile in a rain-slick neon metropolis at night. The figure stands centered in the foreground with a calm, commanding presence, looking left over one shoulder, with {argument name="hair style" default="messy black layered hair with a braided strand"} and a youthful masculine silhouette. His body is an intricate fusion of human and machine: glossy black biomechanical arms, shoulders, and torso with exposed cables, metallic joints, and elegant gold-lit circuitry. He wears flowing white ceremonial robes inspired by Shinto and imperial Japanese garments, layered in torn, wind-swept translucent fabric with subtle gold embroidery, tassels, cords, and ornamental clasps, draped over the cybernetic body like sacred vestments. In his right hand he holds a luminous katana angled downward, the blade blazing with white-gold energy, with an ornate guard and glowing reflections across the wet ground. Behind his head is a huge radiant circular halo made of holographic golden concentric rings, arcane circuitry, and celestial interface lines, creating the effect of a divine techno-mandala. In the mid-background stands a large red torii gate, framed by towering futuristic skyscrapers covered in dense windows and vertical city lights. The street surface is glossy with rain and mirrors the sword glow and city illumination. Fill the scene with drifting sparks, floating embers, fine mist, cinematic backlighting, and dramatic contrast between dark steel tones and {argument name="accent color" default="white and gold"}. Ultra-detailed, epic, mythic, photorealistic concept art, high contrast, sharp focus, volumetric lighting, reflective surfaces, intricate costume design, Japanese myth fused with sci-fi futurism, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影质感的赛博朋克肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="伊邪那岐"}，被重构为一位未来神之战士。画面展示其背影及略微侧身的姿态，背景是雨后霓虹闪烁的夜间大都市。人物居中伫立于前景，神态从容且威严，回头望向左侧，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="凌乱的黑色层次感短发，带有一缕编发"}，展现出年轻男性的轮廓。他的身体是人类与机械的复杂融合：光泽的黑色生物机械手臂、肩部和躯干，露出电缆、金属关节以及优雅的金色发光电路。他身着受神道教和日本皇室服饰启发的飘逸白色礼袍，层叠的半透明布料在风中飘动，饰有精致的金色刺绣、流苏、绳结和装饰性扣环，如同圣衣般披在机械躯体之上。右手持一把向下倾斜的发光武士刀，刀刃闪烁着白金色的能量，华丽的刀镡在湿润的地面上投射出耀眼的光影。他脑后悬浮着一个巨大的圆形光环，由全息金色同心圆、神秘电路和天体界面线条构成，营造出一种神圣的科技曼陀罗效果。中景处矗立着一座巨大的红色鸟居，背景是布满窗户和垂直城市灯光的高耸未来摩天大楼。街道地面因雨水而光亮，映射着刀光与城市灯火。画面中充斥着飘散的火花、浮动的余烬、细密的薄雾，采用电影级背光，在深色金属色调与 {argument name="accent color" default="白色和金色"} 之间形成强烈的对比。超细节、史诗感、神话风、照片级真实感概念艺术、高对比度、焦点清晰、体积光、反射表面、复杂的服装设计，日本神话与科幻未来的融合，垂直构图。

templates.title: Gothic Anime Figure Before Cathedral

titleLocalized.zh: 大教堂前的哥特风动漫人物

templates.prompt: A full-body dark gothic anime illustration of a slender young man standing confidently in front of a towering ruined cathedral, centered in a vertical composition. He has messy, slightly wavy short hair in {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"}, pale skin, and an androgynous elegant presence. His expression is shadowed and understated, with the face partially obscured by dramatic lighting. He wears an all-black layered outfit: a long tattered overcoat with sharp asymmetrical panels, a high-collared inner jacket, a textured dark shirt, loose cropped trousers gathered at the calves, and polished black lace-up boots. One hand is in his coat pocket while the other arm hangs naturally, giving him a calm, aloof, aristocratic stance. Behind him rises a massive gothic church facade with 5 visible spires including a central cross-topped peak, rendered as if painted in black ink and watercolor washes. The environment is monochrome charcoal, ash gray, and black, with subtle muted brown undertones, heavy paint drips, splattered ink textures, foggy haze, and wet reflective ground at his feet. Use strong backlighting from the upper left to create a halo-like glow around the figure and silhouette the cathedral. The mood is bleak, solemn, mysterious, and cinematic, combining gothic fashion editorial, dark fantasy, and ink wash concept art. Highly detailed fabric folds, painterly brushwork, dramatic contrast, textured grunge background, elegant composition, no text, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身暗黑哥特风动漫插画，描绘了一位身材修长的年轻男子自信地站在高耸的废墟大教堂前，采用垂直构图，人物居中。他留着凌乱且微卷的短发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，皮肤苍白，散发着中性而优雅的气质。他的表情隐没在阴影中，显得低调内敛，面部被戏剧性的光影部分遮挡。他身穿全黑的叠穿服饰：一件带有锋利不对称裁片的破旧长款大衣、高领内搭夹克、质感深色衬衫、在小腿处收紧的宽松七分裤，以及抛光的黑色系带靴。他一只手插在大衣口袋里，另一只手臂自然下垂，呈现出冷静、疏离且贵族般的姿态。在他身后矗立着巨大的哥特式教堂外墙，可见 5 座尖塔，包括中央带有十字架的塔尖，呈现出水墨画般的质感。环境色调为单色木炭灰、灰烬色和黑色，带有微妙的柔和棕色底色，伴有厚重的颜料滴落、墨点纹理、朦胧雾气以及脚下湿润的地面反射。利用左上方的强烈背光在人物周围营造出光环效果，并勾勒出大教堂的剪影。整体氛围凄凉、庄重、神秘且具有电影感，融合了哥特时尚杂志、暗黑奇幻和水墨概念艺术风格。高度细腻的衣褶、写意的笔触、强烈的对比、充满质感的颓废背景、优雅的构图，无文字，无额外角色。

templates.title: Neon Anime Poster with Dual-Protagonist Mood

titleLocalized.zh: 具有双主角氛围的霓虹动漫海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical anime key visual poster for an original TV series titled {argument name="title text" default="ナイトコード：リベラシオン"}, with the English subtitle "Nightcode: Liberation" placed directly beneath the large Japanese logo at the top center. The composition shows 2 main characters standing back to back in a neon cyber city at night. On the left is a slim teenage boy in side profile facing left, with messy black hair, pale skin, sharp violet eyes, and a serious expression, wearing a dark high-collar school-uniform-style jacket. On the right foreground is a slim teenage girl shown from the chest up, facing slightly right but turning away from the boy; her face is obscured by a large soft-edged rectangular blur block, but her body and hair are fully visible. She has extremely long split-color hair, half pastel pink and half dark charcoal gray, styled in loose flowing lengths with a side ponytail on the dark side, and she wears a white sailor school blouse with navy trim, oversized sleeves, a large hot-pink ribbon bow, and a dark pleated skirt. The background is a dense futuristic nighttime skyline with glowing windows, magenta and cyan city lights, haze, lens flares, bokeh, and subtle star-like particles, creating a moody urban fantasy atmosphere. Use a high-contrast palette of black, indigo, violet, cyan, and neon pink, with halftone dot textures in the upper-right and lower-left corners. Add stylized Japanese promotional copy throughout the poster: a short tagline in small text along the top, a vertical slogan on the right side, a circular badge on the left reading {argument name="release month text" default="今夏 7月 放送開始!"}, a left column of staff credits in small Japanese text, a lower-left cast block, a bold large tagline across the bottom reading {argument name="bottom tagline" default="二重人格×魔法×青春＝偽りの救世主、開幕。"}, and small official website and social handle text near the lower right. The logo should be luminous, elegant, and slightly fractured, with a supernatural cyber-magic feel. Render in polished modern anime poster style, cinematic lighting, crisp line art, glossy shading, premium promotional visual design, highly detailed hair and fabric folds, with the central mood of dual identity, magic, adolescence, and a false savior emerging in the neon night.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一张原创电视动画系列的海报，采用戏剧性的垂直构图，标题为 {argument name="title text" default="ナイトコード：リベラシオン"}，英文副标题 “Nightcode: Liberation” 位于顶部中央大型日文 Logo 的正下方。画面构图展示了 2 位主角背靠背站在夜晚的霓虹赛博城市中。左侧是一位侧身向左的瘦削少年，留着凌乱的黑发，皮肤苍白，有着锐利的紫罗兰色双眼，表情严肃，身穿深色高领制服风格外套。右侧前景是一位半身像少女，面部略向右侧，但背对着少年；她的脸部被一个大型边缘柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡，但身体和头发清晰可见。她留着极长的双色头发，一半是柔和的粉色，另一半是深炭灰色，发型自然垂落，深色一侧扎着侧马尾，身穿带有海军蓝饰边的白色水手服上衣，袖子宽大，系着巨大的亮粉色蝴蝶结，下身穿着深色百褶裙。背景是密集的未来主义夜景，点缀着发光的窗户、洋红色和青色的城市灯光、薄雾、镜头光晕、焦外成像以及细微的星状颗粒，营造出一种忧郁的都市奇幻氛围。使用黑色、靛青、紫罗兰、青色和霓虹粉的高对比度配色，并在右上角和左下角加入半调网点纹理。海报各处添加风格化的日文宣传文案：顶部有一行小字短标语，右侧有一条垂直口号，左侧有一个圆形徽章，写着 {argument name="release month text" default="今夏 7月 放送開始!"}，左侧一列为日文小字职员表，左下角为声优阵容，底部横跨一行醒目的大字标语 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="二重人格×魔法×青春＝偽りの救世主、開幕。"}，右下角附近有小型官方网站和社交媒体账号文字。Logo 应呈现出发光、优雅且略带破碎的效果，具有超自然赛博魔法的质感。采用精致的现代动画海报风格渲染，光影电影感强，线条清晰，阴影光泽细腻，具备高级宣传视觉设计水准，头发和衣褶细节丰富，整体基调展现了霓虹之夜下双重身份、魔法、青春以及伪救世主的登场。

templates.title: Minimal Sunscreen Product Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 极简防晒产品封面

templates.prompt: A clean, minimalist product still life for a beauty reel cover, shot in a vertical 9:16 composition. Place exactly 5 sunscreen and UV skincare products standing upright in a straight row on a pale off-white shelf against a warm ivory textured plaster wall. From left to right: 1) a glossy blue-to-gold gradient bottle with a rounded cap, 2) a matte white squeeze tube, 3) a slightly curved white squeeze tube with soft beige tinting and elegant black lettering, 4) a slim beige-pink tube with a metallic gold cap, 5) a white tube with blue labeling. Use soft natural sunlight coming from the left, creating delicate botanical leaf shadows on the upper left side of the wall and faint shadows behind the products. Keep the styling airy, premium, and understated, with lots of negative space above the products for cover text. Neutral cream, white, beige, and blue palette, realistic commercial photography, subtle texture, sharp focus on the packaging, gentle high-end skincare advertising mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张用于美妆短视频封面的干净、极简风格产品静物照，采用 9:16 竖构图。在暖象牙色纹理灰泥墙前的浅灰白色搁板上，将 5 款防晒及紫外线防护护肤品垂直并排摆放成一条直线。从左至右依次为：1) 一个带有圆盖的亮面蓝金渐变瓶；2) 一支哑光白色挤压管；3) 一支带有柔和米色调和优雅黑色字体的微弧形白色挤压管；4) 一支带有金属金盖的纤细米粉色管；5) 一支带有蓝色标签的白色管。使用来自左侧的柔和自然光，在墙壁左上方投射出精致的植物叶片阴影，并在产品后方留下淡淡的投影。整体风格保持通透、高级且低调，产品上方留出大量负空间以便添加封面文字。采用中性奶油色、白色、米色和蓝色调，呈现真实的商业摄影质感，纹理细腻，包装对焦清晰，营造出柔和的高端护肤广告氛围。

templates.title: Japanese Collage Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日式拼贴时尚肖像

templates.prompt: A stylized waist-up to three-quarter portrait of a Japanese woman inspired by {argument name="character name" default="Non, Nōnen Rena"}, centered and facing forward with a calm, poised expression and her hands gently clasped at her waist. She has medium-length dark black hair, softly layered and swept back from the face with a slightly tousled crown, and fair skin. She wears a luxurious deep crimson velvet dress with a dramatic oversized ruffled collar, intricate vertical lace trim down the bodice, and matching lace-trimmed cuffs, giving the look a romantic vintage elegance. Render the figure in a painterly, polished editorial illustration style with realistic anatomy, soft shading, rich fabric texture, and subtle highlights on the velvet. Place her against a handmade torn-paper collage background themed around Japan, composed of layered textured paper in indigo blue, teal, sage green, cream, and gold leaf tones. Include exactly 5 visible torii gate silhouettes scattered across the background, exactly 3 pagoda silhouettes on the right side and lower right, and painted bamboo leaves integrated into several paper layers. The collage should feel artisanal and refined, with irregular ripped edges, overlapping papers, and decorative gold accents. Vertical composition, full image dominated by the figure, with the background serving as a cultural, elegant backdrop. No text, no border, no extra objects, sophisticated museum-poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅风格化的半身至七分身日本女性肖像，灵感源自 {argument name="character name" default="Non, Nōnen Rena"}，人物居中，正对镜头，表情沉稳从容，双手在腰间轻轻交叠。她留着中等长度的乌黑秀发，发丝层次柔和，向后梳理，头顶略显蓬松，肤色白皙。她身着奢华的深红色丝绒礼服，配有夸张的大荷叶边领口，胸前饰有精致的垂直蕾丝边，袖口亦有蕾丝装饰，尽显浪漫的复古优雅。以油画质感的精致编辑插画风格呈现，要求解剖结构真实，阴影柔和，织物纹理丰富，丝绒质感带有细腻的高光。背景采用以日本为主题的手工撕纸拼贴画，由靛蓝、青色、鼠尾草绿、奶油色和金箔色调的层叠纹理纸构成。背景中需包含 5 个清晰可见的鸟居剪影，右侧及右下方分布 3 个宝塔剪影，并将手绘竹叶融入多层纸张中。拼贴画应呈现出精湛的工艺感，边缘不规则撕裂，纸张相互叠加，并点缀装饰性金色元素。垂直构图，人物占据画面主体，背景作为文化底蕴深厚的优雅衬托。无文字，无边框，无多余物体，呈现精致的博物馆海报美学。

templates.title: Japanese Collage Portrait in Crimson

titleLocalized.zh: 深红色的日式拼贴肖像

templates.prompt: A refined vertical fine-art portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a Japanese actress and singer"} shown from about the waist up, centered and facing forward, with dark black wavy mullet-length hair brushed back from the forehead and softly framing the ears and neck, wearing a dramatic deep crimson chiffon blouse or dress with oversized translucent ruffles at the collar, chest, and sleeve cuffs. Her hands are gently folded at the lower center of the frame in a calm formal pose. The face area is deliberately obscured by a flat rectangular skin-toned block with no facial features visible, creating an anonymized editorial-art effect. The background is an elaborate Japanese-inspired collage made of torn washi-paper textures and gilded surfaces, with exactly 2 red torii gates on the right side at different scales, exactly 1 dark five-story pagoda on the left side, red maple leaves across the upper right, bamboo silhouettes on the upper left, and delicate gold botanical motifs in the lower corners. Use a rich palette of burgundy, vermilion, burnt umber, black, teal, parchment, and gold leaf, with painterly brushwork, softly blended shadows, antique screen painting aesthetics, and luxurious museum-quality lighting. The composition should feel elegant, moody, and ceremonial, mixing contemporary portrait photography with traditional Japanese byobu and nihonga influences.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的竖构图艺术肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位日本女演员兼歌手"}，半身像，居中且面向前方。她留着深黑色波浪卷发，长度及鲻鱼头，头发向后梳起，柔和地修饰着耳部和颈部线条。身着一件极具戏剧感的深红色雪纺衬衫或连衣裙，领口、胸前和袖口处饰有夸张的半透明荷叶边。双手在画面下方中心处轻轻交叠，姿态沉静而正式。面部区域被一个平面的肤色矩形色块刻意遮挡，没有任何五官可见，营造出一种匿名编辑艺术的效果。背景是由撕裂的和纸纹理和镀金表面组成的精致日式拼贴画，右侧有 2 座比例不同的红色鸟居，左侧有 1 座深色的五重塔，右上角点缀着红枫叶，左上角有竹影，下角饰有精致的金色植物图案。使用勃艮第红、朱砂红、焦赭色、黑色、青色、羊皮纸色和金箔构成的丰富色调，结合绘画般的笔触、柔和的阴影过渡、古董屏风画美学以及奢华的博物馆级布光。整体构图优雅、深沉且具有仪式感，融合了当代肖像摄影与传统的日式屏风画及日本画风格。

templates.title: Anime Fox Girl at Tropical Beach

titleLocalized.zh: 热带海滩上的动漫狐耳少女

templates.prompt: A vivid anime-style tropical beach illustration under intense midday sunlight, featuring a cheerful fox-eared schoolgirl in the foreground posing as if taking a selfie. She stands on a mosaic-tiled seaside terrace at the edge of a brilliant turquoise lagoon, her body angled slightly to the side, one arm extended dramatically toward the viewer with an open hand in strong foreshortening, and the other hand raised near her face making a peace sign. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="bright auburn-orange"} hair blowing in the ocean breeze, 2 fluffy fox ears with white inner fur, and a large white-and-yellow plumeria flower hair accessory with dangling pearl-like beads on one side. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She wears a semi-sheer white Japanese sailor school uniform top with navy trim and a red neckerchief, a short pleated navy skirt, white socks, brown loafers, and a beaded bracelet. The background shows a luxurious tropical resort cove with 4 thatched beach umbrellas, 6 lounge chairs, lush palm trees, flowering shrubs, white sand, crystal-clear shallow water with visible coral and fish, 3 white yachts anchored offshore, 4 large seagulls flying overhead plus 3 smaller distant birds, and 2 tiny parasailers in the sky. The sky is an intense saturated blue with towering white cumulus clouds, a blazing sun in the upper left, rainbow lens flare rings, and sparkling highlights across the sea. In the bottom foreground on the terrace are 2 black cats seen from behind looking toward the girl, colorful seashells and pebbles embedded around the tiles, and 4 tropical fruit arrangements: a left bowl with mango and passion fruit, a right platter with sliced mango, coconut, and purple passion fruit, plus 2 decorative potted tropical plants. Ultra-detailed, glossy, high-saturation summer fantasy aesthetic, dynamic composition, clean anime linework, luminous water reflections, breezy hair motion, playful vacation mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅生动的动漫风格热带海滩插画，在强烈的正午阳光下，前景中一位开朗的狐耳女学生正摆出仿佛在自拍的姿势。她站在明亮的绿松石色泻湖边缘的马赛克瓷砖海滨露台上，身体微微侧向一边，一只手臂以强烈的透视感向观众伸出，手掌张开，另一只手举在脸旁比出剪刀手。她有着随海风飘动的长发，颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="明亮的赤橙色"}，两只毛茸茸的狐耳内侧为白色，一侧戴着带有珍珠般垂饰的白黄色鸡蛋花发饰。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果遮挡。她穿着半透明的白色日本水手服上衣，配有海军蓝饰边和红色领巾，下身是海军蓝百褶短裙，穿着白袜、棕色乐福鞋，并戴着串珠手链。背景展示了一个豪华的热带度假海湾，有 4 把茅草遮阳伞、6 张躺椅、茂密的棕榈树、开花的灌木丛、白沙滩、可见珊瑚和鱼类的清澈浅水区，离岸停泊着 3 艘白色游艇，头顶有 4 只大鸥鸟和 3 只远处的飞鸟，天空中还有 2 个微小的滑翔伞运动员。天空呈现出浓郁的蓝色，点缀着高耸的白色积云，左上方是炽热的太阳，伴有彩虹色的镜头光晕，海面上闪烁着粼粼波光。露台底部的前景中有 2 只背对观众的黑猫正看向女孩，瓷砖周围嵌入了彩色的贝壳和鹅卵石，并摆放了 4 组热带水果：左侧碗中盛放着芒果和百香果，右侧盘子里有切好的芒果、椰子和紫色百香果，此外还有 2 盆装饰性的热带植物。超精细、光泽感、高饱和度的夏季幻想美学，动态构图，干净的动漫线条，明亮的水面反射，飘逸的头发动态，俏皮的度假氛围。

templates.title: Dark AI Viewer with Course Website Preview

titleLocalized.zh: 深色模式 AI 查看器及课程网站预览

templates.prompt: A dark-mode desktop screenshot of an AI image viewer interface showing a generated website design preview. The overall canvas is charcoal gray with a minimal modern app UI. At the top left, place the heading “Thought for 2m 6s” in small white sans-serif text with a subtle chevron. Center-left, show one large rounded-rectangle preview image with a glossy black luxury editorial web landing page for online courses in Japanese. Inside that preview, the website hero area has a black background, elegant serif and sans-serif typography, and the small English heading “ONLINE COURSES” above a large Japanese headline that reads “デザインとキャリアを、次のステージへ”. Beneath it is a smaller Japanese subheading. The main content area of the website contains exactly 6 course cards arranged in a 3-column by 2-row grid. Each card is dark, cinematic, and premium, with a moody photo, category label, Japanese title, short description, a small circular instructor portrait, and a “詳しく見る →” style link. Card 1 shows UI design imagery and the large title “本質的なUIデザインの思考とプロセス”. Card 2 shows a Figma-related screen image and the title “Figmaマスター講座 実践編”. Card 3 shows writing tools on paper and the title “伝わる構造をつくる 情報設計の技術”. Card 4 shows a STUDIO-themed visual and the title “STUDIOでつくる ノーコードWebデザイン”. Card 5 shows a branding or book-like object and the title “ブランドの価値をつくる 設計と表現”. Card 6 shows a portfolio booklet spread and the title “魅せ方で差がつく ポートフォリオ講座”. Add subtle gold-gray highlights, thin borders, soft reflections, and a refined high-end Japanese design aesthetic. At the lower left inside the preview image, include the white Japanese label “編集”. At the lower right inside the preview image, add a small white share/export icon. On the far right side of the app interface, place exactly 4 vertically stacked rounded-square thumbnails representing alternate generated images; the top 3 thumbnails are pale light-theme page designs, and the 4th thumbnail matches the dark course-grid design. Highlight the 4th thumbnail with a glowing blue selection outline. At the bottom left of the overall screenshot, add exactly 2 small white interface icons: a copy icon and a horizontal three-dots menu. The composition should feel like a real product screenshot from a creative AI tool, with crisp UI spacing, subtle shadows, and accurate screen-capture realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深色模式的桌面端 AI 图像查看器界面截图，展示了生成的网站设计预览。整体画布为炭灰色，采用极简现代应用 UI。左上角放置小号白色无衬线文本标题“Thought for 2m 6s”，并配有细微的折角图标。中左侧展示一张大型圆角矩形预览图，内容为一个日文在线课程的黑色奢华风格网页落地页。在预览图内部，网站首屏区域为黑色背景，采用优雅的衬线与无衬线字体，上方有小型英文标题“ONLINE COURSES”，下方为大型日文主标题“デザインとキャリアを、次のステージへ”，其下配有较小的日文副标题。网站主要内容区域包含 6 张课程卡片，以 3 列 2 行的网格排列。每张卡片风格深邃、具有电影质感且高端，包含氛围感图片、类别标签、日文标题、简短描述、小型圆形讲师头像以及“詳しく見る →”样式的链接。卡片 1 展示 UI 设计图像，大标题为“本質的なUIデザインの思考とプロセス”。卡片 2 展示 Figma 相关屏幕图像，标题为“Figmaマスター講座 実践編”。卡片 3 展示纸面书写工具，标题为“伝わる構造をつくる 情報設計の技術”。卡片 4 展示 STUDIO 主题视觉，标题为“STUDIOでつくる ノーコードWebデザイン”。卡片 5 展示品牌或书籍类物体，标题为“ブランドの価値をつくる 設計と表現”。卡片 6 展示作品集画册，标题为“魅せ方で差がつく ポートフォリオ講座”。添加细微的金灰色高光、细边框、柔和的反射效果，呈现精致的高端日式设计美学。在预览图左下角，包含白色日文标签“編集”。在预览图右下角，添加一个小型白色分享/导出图标。在应用界面的最右侧，垂直堆叠放置 4 个圆角方形缩略图，代表其他生成的图像；前 3 个缩略图为浅色主题页面设计，第 4 个缩略图与深色课程网格设计相匹配。用发光的蓝色选中边框高亮显示第 4 个缩略图。在整体截图的左下角，添加 2 个小型白色界面图标：复制图标和水平三点菜单。整体构图应呈现出真实创意 AI 工具的产品截图质感，具备清晰的 UI 间距、细腻的阴影以及精准的屏幕捕捉真实感。

templates.title: Luxury Black and Gold Sneaker Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华黑金运动鞋广告

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic premium sports shoe advertisement in a dark studio with cinematic black-and-gold lighting. A single athletic male model is captured in an explosive action pose from an extreme low-angle wide-lens perspective, with one oversized sneaker thrust toward the camera so it dominates the foreground. He is mid-leap or lunging forward, one knee bent, one arm stretched outward, wearing a metallic bronze bomber jacket over a black fitted shirt, black athletic shorts, black crew socks with a small gold triangular logo, and sleek black-and-gold running sneakers. The shoe design should feel futuristic and luxury-focused, with black mesh panels, glossy black leather overlays, metallic gold accents, gold eyelets, branded tongue detail, and a sculptural open heel support element. Add glowing gold energy streaks, sparks, debris, and an impact burst radiating from the ground beneath the lead shoe, with a glossy reflective floor catching the highlights. In the background, place huge illuminated golden typography reading {argument name="brand text" default="VOLTEX"} and smaller text reading {argument name="product line" default="ELITE"}, integrated behind the athlete as part of the composition. Use high contrast, sharp detail, commercial fashion photography styling, dynamic motion blur only in the particles and light trails, luxurious premium athletic branding, and a bold hero-shot composition suitable for a footwear campaign. Include 2 visible shoes, 2 visible socks, 1 jacket, 1 shirt, and 1 pair of shorts. Add a small top-right corner watermark area with the text {argument name="watermark brand" default="insMind"} and {argument name="watermark model" default="GPT Image 2"}. Keep the palette predominantly black, bronze, and glowing gold.

templates.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫巫女电影海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, turn it into a dramatic Japanese theatrical movie poster while keeping the same shrine maiden archer-swordswoman, fiery portal, bow, quiver, lightning sword, and shrine setting as the base. Push the image into a much darker, high-contrast, more detailed cinematic poster style with intense red-and-black grading, denser embers, stronger rim lighting, and a more ominous supernatural atmosphere. Add 2 demonic guardian cats in the foreground at the character’s feet: 1 white cat on the left with blue glowing eyes and an open snarling mouth, and 1 black cat on the right with red glowing eyes and an open snarling mouth, both wrapped in crackling red energy. Add shadowy monster and oni faces emerging from the dark forest edges on both sides. Increase the number of flying arrows, talismans, sparks, and glowing red energy trails around the character. Preserve the central heroic composition, but format the whole image as a full Japanese film poster with layered typography. Add the top tagline in Japanese: "禁断の力が、闇を裂く—". Add 2 vertical side taglines: left side "その巫女神より授かりし退魔の刃。" and right side "闇を祓い、すべてを護るために—". Add a small genre line above the title: "退魔×巫女×神域バトルアクション". Add the main title near the bottom center in large distressed kanji: "退魔巫女", with the subtitle beneath it: "—紅蓮の神剣—". Add a credits block in small Japanese text below the title, then add the website "taimamiko-movie.jp" and the release line at the very bottom: "2025.夏　全国ロードショー". Include a small dark rectangular logo block in the top-right corner. Make it look like a polished fantasy-horror action poster for a fictional movie.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其转化为一张极具戏剧性的日式电影海报，同时保留原有的巫女弓箭手兼剑士角色、火之传送门、弓、箭袋、雷霆之剑以及神社背景。将图像风格调整为更暗黑、高对比度且细节更丰富的电影海报质感，采用强烈的红黑调色、更密集的余烬效果、更强的轮廓光以及更具压迫感的超自然氛围。在角色脚下的前景处增加 2 只恶魔守护猫：左侧为一只双眼泛着蓝光、张嘴咆哮的白猫，右侧为一只双眼泛着红光、张嘴咆哮的黑猫，两只猫均被噼啪作响的红色能量环绕。在两侧黑暗森林的边缘，增加隐约浮现的怪物和鬼面。增加角色周围飞舞的箭矢、符咒、火花以及发光的红色能量轨迹。保持中心英雄构图，但将整张图像格式化为带有分层排版的完整日式电影海报。在顶部添加日文标语：“禁断の力が、闇を裂く—”。添加 2 条垂直侧边标语：左侧为“その巫女神より授かりし退魔の刃。”，右侧为“闇を祓い、すべてを護るために—”。在标题上方添加一行小型类型说明：“退魔×巫女×神域バトルアクション”。在底部中心附近添加大型做旧汉字主标题：“退魔巫女”，下方附带副标题：“—紅蓮の神剣—”。在标题下方添加小号日文制作人员名单，随后添加网址“taimamiko-movie.jp”，并在最底部添加上映信息：“2025.夏　全国ロードショー”。在右上角添加一个小型深色矩形标志块。使其看起来像是一张精美的虚构奇幻恐怖动作电影海报。

templates.title: Rolling Steel Gear on Mountain Ridge

titleLocalized.zh: 山脊上滚动的钢铁齿轮

templates.prompt: A cinematic photorealistic action shot of a single large steel gear rolling fast along a narrow rocky mountain ridge, captured at ground level with the gear dominating the right side of the frame. The gear is industrial, metallic, weathered, and heavy, with thick teeth, a circular hub, and visible inner spokes, rendered with realistic brushed steel reflections and slight wear. Show strong motion blur on the spinning gear while the terrain remains mostly sharp, with dust, pebbles, and debris exploding outward from the contact point as it bounces over the dirt trail. The landscape is a dramatic alpine range with jagged peaks stretching across the background, dry grass patches, loose stones, and uneven earth in the foreground. Use warm late-afternoon sunlight, natural earthy colors, shallow atmospheric haze over the mountains, and a wide cinematic aspect ratio. Emphasize speed, weight, impact, and absurd realism, as if a giant machine part were racing through a remote wilderness. No people, no vehicles, no buildings, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级写实动作镜头，展现一个巨大的钢铁齿轮在狭窄的岩石山脊上快速滚动。镜头从地面视角拍摄，齿轮占据了画面的右侧。齿轮呈工业风格，金属质感，饱经风霜且厚重，带有粗大的齿、圆形轮毂和清晰的内部辐条，呈现出逼真的拉丝钢反射效果和轻微磨损。旋转的齿轮带有强烈的动态模糊，而地形保持相对清晰，随着齿轮在泥土小径上弹跳，尘土、碎石和杂物从接触点向外飞溅。背景是连绵起伏、山峰嶙峋的戏剧性高山景观，前景点缀着干草、松散的石块和不平整的土地。采用温暖的午后阳光，自然的大地色调，山间带有浅浅的空气感薄雾，并使用宽屏电影比例。强调速度、重量、冲击力和荒诞的真实感，仿佛一个巨大的机械零件正在偏远的荒野中飞驰。画面中无人、无车辆、无建筑物、无文字。

templates.title: Cyber Bunny Visor Space Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博兔耳护目镜太空战士

templates.prompt: A dramatic anime sci-fi action illustration of a floating girl in deep space, centered in a full-body dynamic pose as if lunging toward the viewer. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short slightly messy bob hair and wears a sleek black futuristic visor headset with 2 glowing horizontal cyan display bars across the eyes, a small red HUD readout showing a heart icon and “356 bpm,” and a small yellow “42” indicator on the lower left of the visor. The headset has 2 upright bunny-ear antennae and round ear-cover side modules. Her expression is calm and confident with only the lower half of her face visible. She wears a long dark high-collar coat with a fitted silhouette, subtle armored folds, and 1 thin glowing blue seam running vertically down the front, along with black gloves and black boots. Her left arm is thrust toward the camera holding 1 oversized futuristic energy pistol with a massive barrel, faceted mechanical body, and intense electric-blue glowing core and muzzle, rendered with strong foreshortening. In her right hand she holds 1 dark katana-like sword angled backward. The coat flares outward in motion, creating a sense of zero gravity and speed. Background is a star-filled cosmic field with a bright orange-and-blue nebula halo directly behind her head and torso, plus several small rocky asteroids scattered around the frame. Dark palette overall with neon blue highlights, high contrast rim lighting, cinematic composition, ultra-detailed anime painting, sharp linework, glossy tech surfaces, action poster energy, vertical portrait format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的动漫科幻动作插画，描绘了一位漂浮在深空中的少女，她处于全身动态姿势的中心，仿佛正向观众冲刺。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的短波波头，略显凌乱，佩戴着一副时髦的黑色未来主义护目镜式耳机，护目镜上有 2 条发光的青色水平显示条，一个小型的红色 HUD 读数显示着一颗心形图标和“356 bpm”，护目镜左下角还有一个黄色的小型“42”指示灯。耳机配有 2 个竖起的兔耳天线和圆形的耳罩侧模块。她的表情冷静而自信，仅露出下半张脸。她穿着一件修身的高领深色长外套，带有精致的装甲褶皱，正面有一条垂直的纤细发光蓝色缝线，并配有黑色手套和黑色靴子。她的左臂向前伸向镜头，握着 1 把超大号的未来主义能量手枪，枪管巨大，机械结构棱角分明，核心和枪口闪烁着强烈的电蓝色光芒，采用了强烈的透视缩短效果。她的右手向后斜持着 1 把深色的武士刀。外套在运动中向外飘散，营造出失重感和速度感。背景是布满星辰的宇宙空间，她的头部和躯干后方有一个明亮的橙蓝色星云光环，周围散布着几颗小型岩石小行星。整体色调深沉，带有霓虹蓝高光，高对比度的轮廓光，电影级构图，超精细的动漫绘画，锐利的线条，光泽感的科技表面，充满动作海报的张力，垂直肖像构图。

templates.title: Cubist Chinese Membership Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 立体主义风格中文会员促销海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold Chinese promotional poster in a chaotic Mondrian-meets-Fauvism-meets-Cubism graphic style, with thick black outlines, irregular geometric color blocks, and a high-contrast palette of red, blue, yellow, white, and black. The layout is a dense single-page vertical membership campaign poster with multiple tilted panels and sharp angular divisions, like cut-paper collage and retro commercial poster design. At the top center, place a huge white trapezoid panel with oversized black Chinese headline text: "大会员" on the first line and "首次招募" on the second line, with the year {argument name="year" default="2026"} in large bright blue numerals integrated into the headline. Along the left side, include 4 decorative icon/mascot elements: 1 circular bear-face logo in a yellow circle at the upper left, 1 blue-and-white clock icon below it, 1 half-body black-and-white bear mascot in the mid-left wearing a blue scarf and raising one arm, and 1 cropped bear mascot face at the bottom left. In the left-center, add a tall red countdown panel with white Chinese text "倒计时仅剩" at the top, an enormous yellow numeral "1" in the middle, and a large white "天" at the bottom. On the upper right, place a large white pricing panel showing the original price line "原价 ¥2999/年" with a strikethrough over 2999, then the discounted line "到手价" above a giant red price "¥1299/年". Beneath that, create a blue header strip labeled "省钱攻略" and divide the area into 3 vertical offer columns labeled 1, 2, and 3. Column 1 shows "领券立减" and a large blue "200" with a percent-style coupon icon below. Column 2 shows "拼团再减" and a large red "1500" with three simplified person icons in blue, yellow, and red below. Column 3 shows "成团即得" and a large red "¥730" with smaller black text "专属赠礼" and a gift box icon below. In the lower left, add a white benefits panel with a blue tab title "核心权益". Inside, place 2 small rectangular portrait thumbnails at the upper left, then to the right list 3 text rows: "AI × 家庭教育 × 元学习", a blue-highlighted name "howie" followed by black Chinese descriptive text, and a red-highlighted name "savage" followed by black Chinese descriptive text. Under these, include 4 bullet-like benefit rows with small blue icons: "全年直播陪伴，会员无限期回看", "会员专享逐字稿 + 三级笔记", "All in One AI 知识库 24*7 答疑", and "免费送一个家庭账号，和队友一起学". Across the lower middle, create a black horizontal strip with white text: "AI 内参 1 年（¥365） + 实物大礼包（¥365）". Below that strip, show 3 product images side by side: 1 magazine-style booklet cover, 1 orange notebook/book cover, and 1 blue book cover, plus 2 small round mascot badges near the products. At the bottom center, place a large blue call-to-action panel with big white Chinese text "扫码立刻拼团" and yellow subtitle text "— 锁定首发价 —", then a smaller line in white and yellow: "平均每天 3.55，撬动全家 AI 学习力！". At the bottom right, add a large black-and-white QR code in a white square. Along the very bottom, create 2 footer bars: on the left a blue strip with a shield icon and white text "价保承诺：180 天降价立即退差价", and on the right a red strip with a card/payment icon and white text "轻松支付：花呗 12 期分期免息". Use very heavy sans-serif Chinese typography, exaggerated scale contrast, dynamic asymmetrical composition, overlapping panels, and an energetic commercial poster feel for social media marketing.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张风格大胆的中文促销海报，采用蒙德里安、野兽派与立体主义相结合的混乱图形风格，配以粗黑轮廓线、不规则几何色块，以及红、蓝、黄、白、黑的高对比度配色。布局为紧凑的单页纵向会员活动海报，包含多个倾斜面板和锐利的角形分割，呈现出剪纸拼贴和复古商业海报的设计感。在顶部中心放置一个巨大的白色梯形面板，内含超大黑色中文标题：第一行“大会员”，第二行“首次招募”，并将年份 {argument name="year" default="2026"} 以醒目的亮蓝色大数字融入标题中。在左侧加入 4 个装饰性图标/吉祥物元素：左上角一个黄色圆圈内的圆形熊脸 Logo，下方一个蓝白相间的时钟图标，左中位置一个戴着蓝色围巾、举起一只手臂的半身黑白熊吉祥物，以及左下角一个裁剪过的熊吉祥物脸部。在左侧中心，添加一个高大的红色倒计时面板，顶部写有白色中文“倒计时仅剩”，中间是一个巨大的黄色数字“1”，底部是一个大号白色“天”字。在右上角，放置一个大型白色价格面板，显示原价行“原价 ¥2999/年”（2999 带有删除线），下方显示“到手价”字样，以及巨大的红色价格“¥1299/年”。在其下方，创建一个标有“省钱攻略”的蓝色标题条，并将该区域分为 3 个垂直优惠栏，分别标注为 1、2 和 3。第 1 栏显示“领券立减”及一个巨大的蓝色“200”数字，下方配有百分号样式的优惠券图标。第 2 栏显示“拼团再减”及一个巨大的红色“1500”数字，下方配有三个蓝、黄、红色的简化人物图标。第 3 栏显示“成团即得”及一个巨大的红色“¥730”数字，下方配有较小的黑色文字“专属赠礼”及一个礼盒图标。在左下角，添加一个带有蓝色标签标题“核心权益”的白色权益面板。内部左上方放置 2 个小型矩形头像缩略图，右侧列出 3 行文字：“AI × 家庭教育 × 元学习”，蓝色高亮名称“howie”后跟黑色中文描述文字，以及红色高亮名称“savage”后跟黑色中文描述文字。在这些文字下方，包含 4 行带有蓝色小图标的权益列表：“全年直播陪伴，会员无限期回看”、“会员专享逐字稿 + 三级笔记”、“All in One AI 知识库 24*7 答疑”以及“免费送一个家庭账号，和队友一起学”。在底部中间横跨处，创建一个黑色水平条，内含白色文字：“AI 内参 1 年（¥365） + 实物大礼包（¥365）”。在该条下方，并排展示 3 个产品图：1 本杂志风格的小册子封面、1 本橙色笔记本/书本封面和 1 本蓝色书本封面，产品旁还有 2 个小型圆形吉祥物徽章。在底部中心，放置一个大型蓝色行动呼吁面板，配有醒目的白色中文“扫码立刻拼团”和黄色副标题“— 锁定首发价 —”，随后是一行较小的白黄相间文字：“平均每天 3.55，撬动全家 AI 学习力！”。在右下角，添加一个白色方框内的黑白二维码。在最底部，创建 2 个页脚栏：左侧为蓝色条，配有盾牌图标和白色文字“价保承诺：180 天降价立即退差价”；右侧为红色条，配有卡片/支付图标和白色文字“轻松支付：花呗 12 期分期免息”。使用极粗的无衬线中文字体、夸张的比例对比、动态非对称构图、重叠面板，营造出充满活力的社交媒体营销商业海报感。

templates.title: Anime AI Idol Magazine Cover

templates.prompt: A glossy Japanese anime magazine cover for a fictional next-generation AI idol magazine, packed edge to edge with bold cover lines and neon cosmic energy. The main masthead is huge serif lettering reading "YUMEKAIRO" across the top in white with a purple glow, with a small pink banner near the top right reading "ゆめかいろマガジン". At the very top, add a slogan in Japanese: "夢がカラフルに動き出す！次世代AIアイドルマガジン". Feature 2 full-body anime girls standing together in the center, holding hands and smiling confidently at the viewer. The left girl has {argument name="hair color" default="deep navy blue"} very long wavy twin-tail hair with star hair clips, large blue-green eyes, a black choker with a gold bow and star charm, an off-shoulder white frilled crop top, dark denim short shorts with a white belt and gold star accessories, black garter straps, galaxy-gradient thigh-high stockings in purple and blue with tiny stars, and white sneakers. The right girl has very long silver-lilac hair, soft teal eyes, futuristic over-ear headphones with glowing accents, an oversized white and lavender hoodie draped off the shoulders, a ribbed gray turtleneck mini dress with side cutout, white thigh-high stockings with lavender stripe markings on one leg, chunky purple sneakers, and a long purple strap accessory with a ring pendant. Give both girls a polished modern VTuber idol aesthetic, slim proportions, youthful faces, gentle blush, crisp cel shading, luminous highlights, and highly detailed fabric folds and accessories. The background is a vivid dreamy space scene with purple, pink, and electric blue nebula swirls, stars, sparkles, light streaks, and glossy magical gradients. Arrange many Japanese magazine cover callouts around the characters in loud, layered typography with white, yellow, cyan, pink, and black text blocks, including exactly 11 major cover lines: "ゆめみなな！100の質問", "ゆめかいろ一期生オーディション", "VTuber EXPO 2026 出展", "AI×アイドルの最前線", "人とAIがつなぐ “夢の回路”", "推す理由", "独占キャッチ", "完全密着", "月窓ろみ デビュー！", "神回連発！名シーン まとめ", "配信裏話 ついに見せた “本気の素顔”", plus a giant playful headline at the lower right reading "かわいすぎ 注意報". In the top right corner, include a publication info block with "発行日 2026/4/29", price "¥777", and publisher text "ゆめかいろ出版". Put a realistic barcode at the bottom right with the digits "4 595315 007777" and along the bottom left add the website and social handle: "https://www.yumekairo.jp" and "@yumekairo_ent". Make it look like a premium commercial manga/anime magazine cover, extremely vibrant, high contrast, dense layout, polished print design, sharp focus, and stylish idol branding.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光泽感十足的日式动漫杂志封面，专为虚构的次世代 AI 偶像杂志设计，版面充实，布满醒目的封面标题和霓虹宇宙能量感。顶部主刊名采用巨大的白色衬线字体“YUMEKAIRO”，带有紫色光晕，右上角配有粉色小横幅，写着“ゆめかいろマガジン”。在最上方添加一句日语标语：“夢がカラフルに動き出す！次世代AIアイドルマガジン”。画面中央站着两位全身动漫少女，她们手牵手，自信地微笑着看向读者。左侧少女拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深海军蓝"} 的超长波浪双马尾，戴着星星发夹，有着大大的蓝绿色眼睛，颈部佩戴带有金色蝴蝶结和星星挂饰的黑色颈圈，身穿露肩白色荷叶边短上衣、深色牛仔短裤，配有白色腰带和金色星星饰品、黑色吊带袜，穿着紫色与蓝色渐变且带有小星星的星系感过膝袜，以及白色运动鞋。右侧少女拥有超长的银丁香色头发，柔和的青色眼睛，戴着带有发光装饰的未来感头戴式耳机，肩上披着超大款白色与淡紫色连帽衫，身穿罗纹灰色高领迷你裙，侧面有镂空设计，穿着白色过膝袜，其中一条腿上有淡紫色条纹标记，脚踩厚底紫色运动鞋，并配有一条带有圆环吊坠的紫色长带饰品。赋予两位少女精致的现代 VTuber 偶像美学，身材苗条，面容青春，带有淡淡的腮红，清晰的赛璐珞阴影，明亮的高光，以及高度细节化的布料褶皱和饰品。背景为生动的梦幻太空场景，充满紫色、粉色和电光蓝色的星云漩涡、星星、闪光、光束以及光泽感十足的魔法渐变。在角色周围布置许多日语杂志封面宣传语，采用醒目且分层的排版，使用白色、黄色、青色、粉色和黑色的文字块，包含 11 条主要封面标题：“ゆめみなな！100の質問”、“ゆめかいろ一期生オーディション”、“VTuber EXPO 2026 出展”、“AI×アイドルの最前線”、“人とAIがつなぐ “夢の回路””、“推す理由”、“独占キャッチ”、“完全密着”、“月窓ろみ デビュー！”、“神回連発！名シーン まとめ”、“配信裏話 ついに見せた “本気の素顔””，并在右下角添加一个巨大的俏皮标题“かわいすぎ 注意報”。在右上角包含一个出版信息块，标有“発行日 2026/4/29”、价格“¥777”以及出版商文字“ゆめかいろ出版”。在右下角放置一个逼真的条形码，数字为“4 595315 007777”，并在左下角添加网址和社交账号：“https://www.yumekairo.jp” 和 “@yumekairo_ent”。使其看起来像是一本高端商业漫画/动漫杂志封面，色彩极其鲜艳，对比度高，布局紧凑，印刷设计精良，焦点清晰，且具有时尚的偶像品牌感。

templates.title: Neon AI Video Workflow Dance Poster

templates.title: Mondrian-Style Chinese Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 蒙德里安风格中文促销海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold Chinese promotional poster in a Mondrian-inspired, Fauvist, slightly cubist graphic style with thick black grid lines, flat primary-color blocks, and a clean white background. Vertical smartphone poster, highly structured layout, retail advertisement aesthetic, high contrast, crisp vector-like edges, playful but aggressive sales design. The headline area at the top center is a large white panel with big black Chinese text reading "大会员 2026 首次招募", and a circular yellow badge at the top right containing a simple black cartoon bear face icon. At the top left, include 3 abstract rectangular blocks stacked in a Mondrian composition: one red square, one white rectangle, and one blue vertical rectangle. On the left side create a tall countdown column with a red header labeled "倒计时", a huge rough-edged red number "1" in the center, a red "天" near the bottom, and a black footer strip with yellow text "过期恢复原价". In the main pricing panel to the right, show small black text "原价 ¥2999/年" with a strikethrough over 2999, then larger black text "到手价", then an oversized red price "¥1299" with "/年" in black, and a smaller black formula line below: "= 领券立减 200 + 拼团立省 1500 + 赠礼价值 730". Beneath that, place a full-width blue section bar labeled "省钱攻略". Under it, build a 3-column savings guide with exactly 3 numbered panels: panel 1 has a blue corner label "1", the text "领券立减 200", a blue button-like strip "扫码领券", a smaller line "先领券，再拼团", and a black-and-white QR code; panel 2 has a yellow corner label "2", the text "拼团再减 1500", and one small book or magazine cover thumbnail at the bottom; panel 3 has a red corner label "3", the text "成团即得 ¥730 专属赠礼", with smaller lines "AI 内参 1 年（¥365）" and "实物大礼包（¥365）", plus exactly 2 small gift thumbnails at the bottom. Add a white strip below the 3 columns with bold black text: "平均每天 3.55，撬动全家 AI 学习力！". In the lower middle section, place 2 host/profile blocks in the left column: the first shows a square avatar, the name "howie" in blue, and smaller black text "领航" plus "武装 AI 新技能" and "向 AI 系统要价值"; the second shows a square avatar, the name "savage" in orange-red, and smaller black text "带你" plus "培养内驱力" and "共建学习型家庭". To the right of these profile blocks, create a benefits list with exactly 4 horizontal rows, each with a colored icon on the left and black Chinese text on white: row 1 uses a blue TV or screen icon and text about full-year live companion sessions, replay access, transcripts, notes, and 24×7 AI knowledge support; row 2 uses a yellow book icon and text about 10 years of deep experience, learning OS, becoming OS, reading OS, variable OS, educating children OS, all in AI knowledge base, and long-term Q&A guidance; row 3 uses a blue people icon and text about member community, practical exchange, group community, and 1v1 consultation; row 4 uses a red people icon and text about a free family account so a teammate can study together. Near the bottom, add a yellow panel on the left with a waving full-body black cartoon bear mascot. Across the bottom center place a large blue call-to-action line "扫码立刻拼团" with smaller black decorative dashes and the subtitle "锁定首发价" beneath it. Put a large black-and-white QR code on the bottom right. Finish with a bottom bar split into 2 colored sections: left blue section with a white shield icon and white text "价保承诺：180 天降价立即退差价"; right red section with a white card/payment icon and white text "轻松支付：花呗 12 期分期免息". Use thick black borders around every block, asymmetrical geometric composition, minimal shading, poster-like typography hierarchy, Chinese e-commerce campaign design, energetic and colorful.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张大胆的中文促销海报，采用蒙德里安风格、野兽派及轻微立体主义的图形设计，配以粗黑网格线、平涂原色块和简洁的白色背景。竖版手机海报，布局高度结构化，具备零售广告美感，高对比度，边缘清晰如矢量图，设计风格俏皮且具有强烈的销售导向。顶部中央的标题区为一个白色大面板，内有醒目的黑色中文大字“大会员 2026 首次招募”，右上角设有一个黄色圆形徽章，内含简单的黑色卡通熊脸图标。左上角包含 3 个抽象矩形块，采用蒙德里安式构图：一个红色正方形、一个白色矩形和一个蓝色竖矩形。左侧创建一个高大的倒计时栏，顶部为红色标题“倒计时”，中央是一个巨大的粗边红色数字“1”，底部附近有一个红色“天”字，底部黑色条纹内有黄色文字“过期恢复原价”。右侧主定价面板中，显示黑色小字“原价 ¥2999/年”并带有删除线，随后是较大的黑色文字“到手价”，以及超大的红色价格“¥1299”，后跟黑色“/年”，下方有一行较小的黑色公式：“= 领券立减 200 + 拼团立省 1500 + 赠礼价值 730”。在此下方，放置一个全宽蓝色分区栏，标注为“省钱攻略”。在其下方，构建一个 3 列省钱指南，包含 3 个编号面板：面板 1 有蓝色角标“1”，文字“领券立减 200”，一个蓝色按钮状条带“扫码领券”，下方小字“先领券，再拼团”，以及一个黑白二维码；面板 2 有黄色角标“2”，文字“拼团再减 1500”，底部有一个小型书籍或杂志封面缩略图；面板 3 有红色角标“3”，文字“成团即得 ¥730 专属赠礼”，下方小字“AI 内参 1 年（¥365）”和“实物大礼包（¥365）”，底部有 2 个小型礼品缩略图。在 3 列下方添加一个白色条带，配以粗体黑字：“平均每天 3.55，撬动全家 AI 学习力！”。在中下部，左侧放置 2 个主持人/个人资料块：第一个显示方形头像，蓝色名字“howie”，以及黑色小字“领航”加“武装 AI 新技能”和“向 AI 系统要价值”；第二个显示方形头像，橙红色名字“savage”，以及黑色小字“带你”加“培养内驱力”和“共建学习型家庭”。在这些资料块右侧，创建一个包含 4 行水平排列的权益列表，每行左侧配有彩色图标，右侧为白底黑字：第 1 行使用蓝色电视或屏幕图标，文字内容关于全年直播陪伴、回放权限、逐字稿、笔记及 24×7 AI 知识支持；第 2 行使用黄色书籍图标，文字内容关于 10 年深度经验、学习 OS、成为 OS、阅读 OS、变量 OS、育儿 OS，全在 AI 知识库中，并提供长期问答指导；第 3 行使用蓝色人物图标，文字内容关于会员社群、实战交流、小组社区及 1 对 1 咨询；第 4 行使用红色人物图标，文字内容关于免费家庭账号，可供队友共同学习。底部附近，左侧添加一个黄色面板，内有挥手的全身黑色卡通熊吉祥物。底部中央放置一行醒目的蓝色行动号召文字“扫码立刻拼团”，下方配有黑色装饰短线及副标题“锁定首发价”。右下角放置一个大型黑白二维码。最后，底部栏分为 2 个彩色区域：左侧蓝色区域配有白色盾牌图标及白色文字“价保承诺：180 天降价立即退差价”；右侧红色区域配有白色卡片/支付图标及白色文字“轻松支付：花呗 12 期分期免息”。每个区块周围使用粗黑边框，不对称几何构图，极简阴影，海报级排版层级，中文电商活动设计，充满活力且色彩丰富。

templates.title: Chibi Dinosaur Museum Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版恐龙博物馆立体模型

templates.prompt:
A highly detailed, warm, whimsical isometric interior of a two-story dinosaur museum packed with chibi anime children and fossil exhibits, rendered like a handcrafted miniature diorama with toy-like figures, glossy eyes, soft rounded faces, and intricate wood-and-brass museum furniture. The scene is viewed from an elevated corner angle looking down into a bustling central hall with exactingly arranged displays and visitors everywhere. Include approximately 52 chibi children scattered throughout the museum, with a crowded upper balcony and busy ground floor, each dressed like young explorers in colorful casual clothes, backpacks, caps, jackets, shorts, and sneakers, many holding guidebooks or pamphlets. The setting should feel cheerful and adventurous, with golden ambient lighting from small hanging lamps, polished wooden railings, staircases on the left, tiled stone flooring, framed dinosaur posters on the walls, educational signs, specimen cases, bookshelves, plants, and gift-shop-like display tables.

Feature 6 major dinosaur skeleton exhibits clearly visible: 1 large Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton dominating the right side upper floor with open jaws, 1 medium theropod skeleton in the center-right ground floor exhibit pit, 1 triceratops skull and partial skeleton display on the lower right, 1 long-necked partial skeleton running vertically along the lower left edge, 1 large fossilized skull display in the lower center foreground, and 1 small fossil or turtle-like specimen on top of a wooden cabinet at the far lower right. Also include 5 glass display cases or tabletop specimen exhibits: 1 central rectangular butterfly or insect specimen table in the lower middle, 1 glass-topped fossil case left of center, 1 smaller blue-topped specimen counter near the middle left, 1 angled educational control panel or fossil information stand beside the central dinosaur pit, and 1 additional exhibit table integrated into the lower-right work area. Add many smaller fossil trays, bones, rocks, and excavation samples across counters and floor exhibits.

The architecture should include 2 visible levels: 1 upper mezzanine balcony wrapping around the back and right sides, and 1 open ground floor exhibition space below. Show 1 staircase ascending along the left side to the balcony. On the upper walls, place several framed dinosaur posters and museum boards, including one prominent poster reading {argument name="poster title" default="DINOSAURS"}. Add an emergency exit sign above a back doorway. Use a rich palette of honey-brown wood, beige fossils, teal and blue exhibit graphics, and pops of red, yellow, and green in the children’s outfits. The overall mood is playful discovery, like a children’s science museum mixed with a collector’s model world, with extreme scene density, crisp focus, high detail, cinematic depth, and premium storybook miniature realism. No adults, no empty space, no modern minimalism; every part of the image should be filled with charming museum activity.

promptLocalized.zh:
这是一个高度精细、温暖且充满奇幻色彩的等轴测视角双层恐龙博物馆内景，挤满了 Q 版动漫儿童和化石展品。画面呈现出手工制作的微缩模型质感，带有玩具般的人偶、闪亮的大眼睛、圆润的脸庞以及精致的木质与黄铜材质博物馆家具。场景采用高处转角俯视视角，可以看到繁忙的中央大厅，展示品和游客摆放得错落有致。场景中包含约 52 名散布在博物馆各处的 Q 版儿童，上层阳台和底层大厅都非常拥挤，每个孩子都打扮成小小探险家的模样，穿着色彩鲜艳的休闲装，背着背包，戴着帽子，穿着夹克、短裤和运动鞋，许多人手里还拿着导览手册或宣传册。整体氛围欢快且充满冒险气息，金色的环境光来自悬挂的小灯，配有抛光的木质栏杆、左侧的楼梯、瓷砖石地板、墙上装裱的恐龙海报、教育标识、标本柜、书架、植物以及礼品店风格的展示桌。

重点展示 6 个清晰可见的大型恐龙骨架展品：右侧上层是一具张开大嘴、占据主导地位的大型霸王龙骨架；中央右侧底层展坑内是一具中型兽脚类恐龙骨架；右下方是一个三角龙颅骨及部分骨架展示；左下边缘垂直排列着一具长颈恐龙的部分骨架；下方中央前景处是一个大型化石颅骨展示；右下角尽头的木柜上是一个小型化石或类似海龟的标本。此外，还包括 5 个玻璃展示柜或桌面标本展品：下方中间是一个中央长方形蝴蝶或昆虫标本桌，中心左侧是一个玻璃顶化石柜，中左侧附近是一个较小的蓝色台面标本柜，恐龙展坑旁是一个倾斜的教育控制面板或化石信息展台，右下方工作区还集成了一个额外的展示桌。在柜台和地面展品上，添加许多较小的化石托盘、骨头、岩石和挖掘样本。

建筑结构应包含 2 个可见楼层：一个环绕后侧和右侧的上层夹层阳台，以及下方开放式的底层展览空间。左侧设有一道通往阳台的楼梯。在上层墙壁上，放置几张装裱好的恐龙海报和博物馆项目，其中包括一张醒目的海报，上面写着 {argument name="poster title" default="DINOSAURS"}。在后门上方添加一个紧急出口标志。使用丰富的色调，包括蜂蜜棕色的木材、米色的化石、青色和蓝色的展览图形，以及孩子们服装上点缀的红色、黄色和绿色。整体氛围是充满童趣的探索感，仿佛儿童科学博物馆与收藏家模型世界的结合，具有极高的场景密度、清晰的焦点、丰富的细节、电影般的景深以及高级的绘本微缩模型写实感。画面中没有成人，没有留白，没有现代极简主义；画面的每一处都应充满迷人的博物馆活动。

templates.title: Richard Feynman Psychic Trading Card

titleLocalized.zh: 理查德·费曼 (Richard Feynman) 灵能交易卡

templates.prompt: A highly polished parody trading card in the style of a classic Pokémon card, featuring {argument name="character name" default="Richard Feynman"} as the subject. Vertical card layout with a thick metallic gold border, rounded corners, glossy collectible finish, and dense printed card UI. At the top left, a silver capsule label reading "BASIC". Across the top, the large bold name "{argument name="character name" default="Richard Feynman"}" in black with white outline, and beneath it a silver banner subtitle reading "{argument name="subtitle" default="Theoretical Physicist"}". Top right shows "HP 120" next to a purple psychic-eye icon. The main illustration is a dramatic painterly portrait of Richard Feynman from the waist up, wearing a slightly wrinkled white short-sleeve button-up shirt with pens in the chest pocket, curly dark hair, and expressive hand gestures as if explaining physics; his face is obscured by a plain rectangular blur/block. The background is split visually: on the left, a dark chalkboard filled with handwritten physics equations and symbols, including a Lagrangian, psi notation, summation, and small Feynman diagram sketches; also visible is a quote in white chalk text, "The Universe is made of atoms, but atoms are made of stories. – R. Feynman". At the lower left of the art box is a stack of books with an atom emblem and a black-and-gold badge reading "LEGEND". On the right side of the art box, a vibrant cosmic scene with glowing particles, orbital paths, spirals, electric curls, and luminous galaxy-like swirls in blue, violet, gold, and orange. At the lower right of the illustration sits a white mug printed with the text "There's Plenty of Room at the Bottom". Beneath the portrait, a narrow silver stat strip reads "NO. 1918 Theoretical Physicist HT: 5’6” WT: 135 lbs.". The lower half of the card has a holographic purple-blue nebula background with card text panels. First is a red gradient pill-shaped label reading "Ability", followed by the ability name in large purple text: "{argument name="ability name" default="Path Integral Intuition"}" with a purple psychic-eye icon to the right. Below it, small black rules text: "Once during your turn, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put them back in any order. Then, you may draw a card. This ability represents Feynman’s mastery of seeing multiple possibilities and choosing elegant paths." Below that are 2 attacks. Attack 1 has 3 cost icons: 2 purple psychic-eye icons and 1 colorless star icon; title "Feynman Diagrams" with damage "60+" on the right; body text: "This attack does 60 more damage for each different type of Pokémon in your opponent’s Active Pokémon’s Retreat Cost." Attack 2 has 3 cost icons: 2 purple psychic-eye icons and 1 colorless star icon; title "There’s Plenty of Room" with damage "100" on the right; body text: "Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck." Near the bottom is an italic flavor quote: "I would rather have questions that can’t be answered than answers that can’t be questioned." – Richard Feynman. The bottom status bar contains exactly 3 labeled sections: weakness with a blue water-drop icon and "×2", resistance with a dark shield icon and "-30", and retreat with 2 colorless star icons. Bottom left has tiny print "Illus. Ben Wootten" and card number text "002/150" with a small star rarity symbol. Bottom right includes a small black silhouette of a standing man gesturing. Overall style: premium fan-made scientist trading card, nostalgic TCG typography, painterly realism for the portrait, holographic galaxy foil textures, crisp printed text, and playful crossover design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张制作精良的恶搞交易卡，采用经典 Pokémon 卡牌风格，以 {argument name="character name" default="理查德·费曼"} 为主题。卡牌采用垂直布局，配有厚实的金属金色边框、圆角设计、光面收藏质感以及密集的印刷卡牌 UI。左上角有一个银色胶囊标签，写着“BASIC”。顶部是醒目的黑色粗体名称“{argument name="character name" default="理查德·费曼"}”（带白色描边），下方是一个银色横幅副标题，写着“{argument name="subtitle" default="理论物理学家"}”。右上角显示“HP 120”，旁边是一个紫色的灵能之眼图标。主插画是理查德·费曼的戏剧性写实肖像，半身像，身穿略显褶皱的白色短袖衬衫，胸前口袋插着钢笔，留着卷曲的深色头发，手势生动，仿佛正在讲解物理学；他的面部被一个简单的矩形模糊块遮挡。背景在视觉上分为两部分：左侧是一块深色黑板，写满了手写的物理方程和符号，包括拉格朗日量、psi 符号、求和符号以及小的费曼图草图；黑板上还有一行白色粉笔字引语：“The Universe is made of atoms, but atoms are made of stories. – R. Feynman”。艺术框左下角是一叠书，上面有一个原子徽章和一个写着“LEGEND”的黑金勋章。艺术框右侧是一个充满活力的宇宙场景，有发光的粒子、轨道路径、螺旋、电荷卷曲以及蓝色、紫色、金色和橙色的发光星系漩涡。插画右下角放着一个白色马克杯，上面印有文字“There's Plenty of Room at the Bottom”。肖像下方是一条窄窄的银色数据条，写着“NO. 1918 Theoretical Physicist HT: 5’6” WT: 135 lbs.”。卡牌下半部分是全息紫蓝色星云背景，配有卡牌文本面板。首先是一个红色渐变药丸状标签，写着“Ability”，随后是紫色大字标题：“{argument name="ability name" default="路径积分直觉"}”，右侧配有一个紫色灵能之眼图标。下方是黑色小字规则文本：“在你的回合中，你可以查看卡组顶部的 4 张卡牌，并以任意顺序放回。然后，你可以抽一张牌。此技能代表了费曼洞察多种可能性并选择优雅路径的精湛能力。”下方是 2 个攻击技能。攻击 1 有 3 个消耗图标：2 个紫色灵能之眼图标和 1 个无色星形图标；标题为“费曼图”，右侧伤害为“60+”；正文：“对手的活跃 Pokémon 每有一种不同的撤退消耗类型，此攻击增加 60 点伤害。”攻击 2 有 3 个消耗图标：2 个紫色灵能之眼图标和 1 个无色星形图标；标题为“There’s Plenty of Room”，右侧伤害为“100”；正文：“从你的卡组中搜索一张基础能量卡，并将其附着在你的 1 只备战 Pokémon 上。然后，洗牌。”底部附近有一句斜体风味引语：“I would rather have questions that can’t be answered than answers that can’t be questioned.” – 理查德·费曼。底部状态栏包含 3 个明确标注的部分：弱点（蓝色水滴图标，“×2”）、抗性（深色盾牌图标，“-30”）和撤退（2 个无色星形图标）。左下角有微小的印刷字“Illus. Ben Wootten”和卡牌编号“002/150”，旁边有一个小星星稀有度符号。右下角包含一个站立男子的黑色小剪影。整体风格：高端粉丝自制科学家交易卡、怀旧 TCG 排版、肖像画写实主义、全息星系箔质感、清晰的印刷文本以及趣味十足的跨界设计。

templates.title: Character Swap Into Period Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 将角色置入古典肖像

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, replace the man with the referenced character while preserving the same standing pose, framing, and realistic photographic look. Transform the scene into an outdoor historical setting with a shallow-depth-of-field forest or garden background. Dress the character in an elaborate dark 18th-century aristocratic outfit: 1 tricorn hat, 1 embroidered long coat, 1 fitted waistcoat with a row of buttons, 1 high-neck cravat, and 2 white ruffled cuffs. Keep the character centered and full of presence, with cinematic lighting and a softly blurred background that includes 1 distant blurred figure on the right.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将原图中的男性替换为指定角色，同时保持相同的站姿、构图和写实的摄影风格。将场景转换为户外历史背景，并配以浅景深的森林或花园背景。为角色穿上精致的 18 世纪深色贵族服饰：1 顶三角帽、1 件刺绣长外套、1 件带有排扣的合身马甲、1 条高领领巾以及 2 只白色荷叶边袖口。保持角色居中且充满气场，运用电影级布光，背景需柔和虚化，并在右侧包含 1 个远处的模糊身影。

templates.title: Mixed Reality Café Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 混合现实咖啡馆插画

templates.prompt:
{argument name="subject" default="A trendy young woman"} sitting at an outdoor café table, holding a hot coffee cup near her lips. She has short curly black hair and wears {argument name="accessory" default="oversized tinted sunglasses"}, a cropped beige sweater, loose brown high-waisted pants, and chunky white sneakers. A tote bag with minimal coffee-themed illustrations hangs on her shoulder.

The scene blends realistic photography with {argument name="overlay style" default="playful 2D cartoon overlays"}. Floating around her are animated coffee elements: a smiling cappuccino cup with heart-shaped latte art, cute coffee beans with tiny faces, and stylized splashes of caramel forming comic-style shapes. Soft doodle steam rises into hearts and stars.

On the table: a croissant, a notebook with sketch drawings, and a second coffee cup.

Background: a realistic cozy café street with brick walls, plants, warm golden hour lighting, and soft shadows. Slight depth of field, subject in sharp focus.

Style: mix of photorealism and vibrant cartoon illustration, pop-art aesthetic, high saturation but warm tones, clean composition, Instagram-worthy, soft glow, 4k detail.

promptLocalized.zh:
{argument name="subject" default="一位时髦的年轻女性"} 坐在户外咖啡馆的桌旁，手持热咖啡杯靠近唇边。她留着黑色短卷发，戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="超大号有色墨镜"}，身穿米色短款毛衣、宽松棕色高腰裤和厚底白色运动鞋。肩上挎着一个印有极简咖啡主题插画的托特包。

场景将写实摄影与 {argument name="overlay style" default="趣味 2D 卡通叠加"} 相结合。她周围漂浮着动画咖啡元素：带有心形拉花的微笑卡布奇诺杯、长着小脸的可爱咖啡豆，以及形成漫画风格形状的焦糖飞溅。柔和的涂鸦蒸汽升腾，化作心形和星星。

桌上摆放着：一个羊角面包、一本带有素描画的笔记本，以及第二个咖啡杯。

背景：写实舒适的咖啡馆街道，有砖墙、植物、温暖的黄金时刻光线和柔和的阴影。轻微的景深效果，主体清晰对焦。

风格：写实主义与活力卡通插画的融合，波普艺术美学，高饱和度但色调温暖，构图简洁，适合 Instagram 发布，柔和光晕，4k 细节。

templates.title: Luxury Skincare Commercial Photography

templates.prompt:
A high-resolution commercial marketing photograph featuring the same {argument name="model description" default="young woman with sleek dark hair, now styled in a soft, natural wave"}. She is wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="minimal beige satin top"} and is positioned in a clean, matte ivory studio setting. The composition places a luxury “{argument name="product name" default="LumiSkin Vitamin C Serum"}” dropper bottle prominently in the foreground, held delicately between her fingers at chest level, angled toward the camera for emphasis.

The visual energy is enhanced with vibrant tangerine-orange graphic accents, including flowing liquid streaks and circular glow elements that suggest radiance and hydration. Floating translucent callouts highlight key features such as “brightening boost” and “24h glow hydration” in bold, modern sans-serif typography.

Lighting is soft yet directional, creating a gentle glow on the model’s skin while producing a crisp, reflective shine on the glass serum bottle, emphasizing its premium finish. The serum inside has a rich amber tone that catches the light beautifully. A large, bold headline in the upper left reads: “Why your skin loves it” in bright orange, adding contrast and visual hierarchy.

The overall aesthetic is clean, luminous, and high-end, with a shallow depth of field that keeps both the product and the model’s confident, natural expression in sharp focus, while the background fades smoothly for a polished, editorial feel.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张高分辨率的商业营销摄影作品，主角为 {argument name="model description" default="一位留着柔顺深色长发、现呈现自然微卷造型的年轻女性"}。她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="极简米色缎面吊带"}，置身于干净的哑光象牙色摄影棚背景中。构图将一款奢华的“{argument name="product name" default="LumiSkin 维生素 C 精华液"}”滴管瓶置于前景显眼位置，她用手指轻巧地将其托在胸前，并向镜头倾斜以突出产品。

视觉活力通过鲜艳的橘色图形元素得到增强，包括流动的液体线条和圆形光晕元素，暗示着光泽与水润感。悬浮的半透明标注框以醒目的现代无衬线字体突出了“提亮增效”和“24 小时水润光泽”等核心卖点。

灯光柔和且具有方向性，在模特肌肤上营造出柔和的光泽，同时在玻璃精华瓶上形成清脆的反射光，强调其高端质感。瓶内的精华液呈浓郁的琥珀色，在光线下熠熠生辉。左上角有一行醒目的大标题：“Why your skin loves it”，采用亮橘色，增加了对比度和视觉层级。

整体美学风格干净、明亮且高端，浅景深效果使产品与模特自信自然的表情保持清晰对焦，而背景平滑虚化，呈现出精致的杂志大片质感。

The subject is seated at a three-quarter angle, leaning slightly forward with a relaxed yet commanding posture. His face is turned away from the lens, with one side of his face clearly illuminated while the other is completely lost in deep, velvety black shadows. His expression is contemplative, not looking at the camera. The pose is precise: his hands are clasped together near his chest; one hand is held straight with fingers slightly tilted, while the other hand is positioned so only the fingers are visible, resting over the first. He wears a {argument name="accessories" default="luxury black chronograph watch with a detailed metal link bracelet, a silver ring, and a beaded bracelet"}. His attire is a {argument name="clothing" default="sharp black suit jacket over a white dress shirt with the top buttons open"}, showing refined fabric textures. The background is a solid, seamless black. THE SPIN — Mid-spin, skirt or outfit fabric wrapping around her body in motion
FREEZE — Sudden sharp freeze pose, one arm extended, other cocked at 90°
GLIDE — Side view of a smooth slide/glide across the floor, low to ground
SLOW MOTION — Extreme close-up hands in slow graceful motion through the air
THE JUMP — Full airborne leap, legs split, arms wide, peak of the jump
THE LAND — Powerful landing, one knee down, dust particle explosion around her
ATTITUDE — Low angle looking up at her standing dominant, chin down, staring into camera
THE BREAKDOWN — Crowd in background reacts, silhouettes with raised hands
FINAL SEQUENCE — Multi-exposure ghost effect showing 3 overlapping positions
LAST EIGHT — Teammates/other dancers blur into frame behind her, energy building
THE FINALE — Full extension final pose, arms stretched to ceiling, head thrown back
UNFORGETTABLE — Wide cinematic shot, spotlight beam, smoke/haze, text overlay reads DANCE

脚步动作 — 地面视角拍摄的快速脚步，运动鞋踢起灰尘/光点
触地 — 她以受控的 Krump 风格胸部着地动作跌落至地面

旋转 — 旋转过程中，裙摆或服装面料随身体运动缠绕
定格 — 突然的锐利定格姿势，一只手臂伸展，另一只手臂弯曲成 90 度
滑行 — 侧面视角展示在地面上平稳的滑动/滑行，身体贴近地面
慢动作 — 双手在空中缓慢优雅移动的极度特写
跳跃 — 全身腾空跳跃，双腿劈叉，双臂张开，处于跳跃最高点
着陆 — 强有力的着陆，单膝跪地，周围灰尘颗粒四溅
态度 — 低角度仰拍她站立的姿态，下巴微收，直视镜头，气场全开
爆发 — 背景中的人群做出反应，剪影中举起双手
最终序列 — 多重曝光的重影效果，展示 3 个重叠的动作位置
最后八拍 — 队友/其他舞者模糊地进入她身后的画面，能量积聚
终章 — 完全伸展的最终姿势，双臂伸向天花板，头部后仰
难忘时刻 — 广角电影镜头，聚光灯束，烟雾/朦胧感，文字叠加显示 DANCE

templates.prompt:
LUXURY PERSONAL COLOR PROFILE — EDITORIAL LAYOUT
Studio portrait of subject as anchor — skin retouched to luminous glass-like perfection, preserved natural structure, realistic pore texture, soft directional key lighting, no facial alteration. Background: warm ecru parchment with subtle linen grain texture. Layout reads like a Vogue Italia beauty supplement printed on heavyweight matte stock. Structured editorial grid, 3-column asymmetric, wide negative space, serif condensed display headers, all labels in spaced uppercase tracking, cohesive warm ivory/sand/ecru background system throughout all panels, ultra-photorealistic 8K, soft diffused studio lighting, flat elegant surfaces, no drop shadows.
PANELS:
① UNDERTONE DIAGNOSIS — Tonal spectrum bar from cool ash to warm amber, precision needle marker on subject's reading. Labels: Cool / Neutral-Cool / Neutral / Neutral-Warm / Warm. Fine annotation text.
② SEASONAL COLOR PALETTE — 10–12 fabric-textured swatches in subject's optimal season. Each labeled with poetic color name and HEX. Grouped: Power Colors / Softest Options / Harmonizing Neutrals.
③ COLORS TO AVOID — Desaturated row of clashing tones with fine editorial strikethrough. Clean, non-harsh presentation.
④ MAKEUP CARTOGRAPHY — Eyeshadow gradient dust swatches / blush tones fanned on skin strip / lip spectrum barely-there to bold / highlighter finishes labeled: champagne, rose gold, pearlescent ivory.
⑤ HAIR COLOR SPECTRUM — Curved gradient strip: base, dimension, highlight, contrast tones. Gold bracket indicators on best options.
⑥ JEWELRY & METAL GUIDE — Flat-lay editorial render: yellow gold, rose gold, oxidized silver, platinum finishes alongside complementary stone tones. Minimal styling.
⑦ YOU IN YOUR PALETTE — 3–4 editorial lookbook frames, subject in palette-correct outfits. Mood labels: Quiet Luxury / Off-Duty Editorial / Evening Presence.
⑧ CAPSULE WARDROBE GRID — Outfit flatlay: tops, bottoms, outerwear, shoes, bag — all palette-correct. Coordinating lines showing interchangeability. Net-a-Porter editorial aesthetic.
⑨ PRINTS & PATTERNS — 4 fabric print thumbnails: micro geometric, tonal abstract, classic stripe, floral scale. One-line styling note per print.
⑩ STYLE ARCHETYPE — Single typographic panel. Style identity title set large (e.g. "Modern Romantic / Warm Classicist"). Three defining aesthetic words. Four-line editorial wardrobe philosophy note.
RENDER SPECS: Ultra-photorealistic, 8K, editorial magazine print quality, warm neutral color grading, soft diffused studio lighting consistent across all panels, one serif display font + one fine sans-serif body font, no gradients, flat matte surfaces only.

promptLocalized.zh:
奢华个人色彩分析 — 编辑排版
以主体摄影棚肖像为核心 — 皮肤修饰至如玻璃般透亮，保留自然结构与真实的毛孔纹理，采用柔和的定向主光，不对面部进行任何改动。背景：带有细腻亚麻纹理的暖色羊皮纸。排版风格如同印在厚重哑光纸张上的《Vogue Italia》美容增刊。结构化编辑网格，3 列非对称布局，宽阔的留白，衬线体压缩标题，所有标签采用宽字间距大写，所有面板采用统一的暖象牙白/沙色/羊皮纸背景系统，超写实 8K 画质，柔和漫射摄影棚光线，平整优雅的表面，无投影。
面板：
① 色调诊断 — 从冷灰到暖琥珀的色调光谱条，主体读数的精密指针标记。标签：冷色 / 中性偏冷 / 中性 / 中性偏暖 / 暖色。精细标注文字。
② 季节性色彩调色板 — 10–12 个主体最佳季节的织物纹理色卡。每个色卡标注诗意的色彩名称和 HEX 值。分组：能量色 / 最柔和选项 / 协调中性色。
③ 避雷色彩 — 一排去饱和的冲突色调，带有精细的编辑删除线。呈现方式简洁且不刺眼。
④ 美妆图谱 — 眼影渐变粉末色卡 / 皮肤上的腮红试色条 / 从若有似无到大胆的唇色光谱 / 高光质感标注：香槟金、玫瑰金、珠光象牙白。
⑤ 发色光谱 — 弧形渐变条：基色、维度色、高光色、对比色。最佳选项处有金色括号标记。
⑥ 珠宝与金属指南 — 平铺编辑渲染图：黄金、玫瑰金、氧化银、铂金饰面，以及互补的宝石色调。极简造型。
⑦ 你的色彩穿搭 — 3–4 个编辑风格的 Lookbook 框架，主体穿着符合调色板的服装。风格标签：静奢风 / 休闲编辑风 / 晚宴气场。
⑧ 胶囊衣橱网格 — 服装平铺图：上装、下装、外套、鞋履、包袋 — 全部符合调色板。展示互搭性的协调线条。Net-a-Porter 编辑审美。
⑨ 印花与图案 — 4 个织物印花缩略图：微几何、色调抽象、经典条纹、花卉比例。每种印花配有一行造型说明。
⑩ 风格原型 — 单一排版面板。风格标识标题字号放大（例如：“现代浪漫 / 温暖古典”）。三个定义美学的词汇。四行编辑风格的衣橱哲学笔记。
渲染规格：超写实，8K，杂志编辑印刷质量，暖中性色调，所有面板保持一致的柔和漫射摄影棚光线，一种衬线标题字体 + 一种精细无衬线正文字体，无渐变，仅平整哑光表面。

templates.title: Low-key monochrome editorial portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 低调单色编辑人像

templates.prompt:
A high-end, cinematic black-and-white editorial portrait of a fit {argument name="subject" default="man"} with a short, styled undercut hairstyle and a well-groomed beard. He is positioned in a three-quarter profile, looking slightly upward with a contemplative and stoic expression, chest front to camera. His arms are confidently crossed over his chest, showcasing smart muscles and a {argument name="accessory" default="premium silver stainless steel watch"} on his wrist.
Wardrobe & Details: Clothing: A simple, high-quality black t-shirt that fits tightly to emphasize his physique. Accessories: A delicate, thin silver curb chain necklace rests over the black shirt, catching the light.
Gaze: The subject is looking away from the camera, directed toward a light source just above eye level.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Style: Low-key lighting with high contrast (Chiaroscuro effect). Background: Deep, solid matte black, creating a seamless "void" look that makes the subject pop.
Technical Details: Shot on a prime 85mm lens for a flattering compression. The lighting should be sharp on one side of his face and arms (rim lighting), with deep, dramatic shadows on the other.
Quality Tags: 8K resolution, hyper-realistic skin texture, dramatic monochrome, sharp focus on eyes and watch, luxury fashion photography style, moody atmosphere. ar 4:5

promptLocalized.zh:
一张高端、电影质感的黑白编辑人像，主角是一位身材健硕的 {argument name="subject" default="男士"}，留着修剪整齐的短发和精心打理的胡须。他呈四分之三侧面站立，微微抬头，表情沉思且坚毅，胸部正对镜头。他自信地交叉双臂于胸前，展现出精干的肌肉线条，手腕上佩戴着一款 {argument name="accessory" default="高级银色不锈钢手表"}。
服装与细节：服装：一件简约的高品质黑色 T 恤，紧身剪裁以突显其体格。配饰：一条精致的细银色古巴链项链垂在黑色 T 恤上，捕捉着光线。
目光：主角视线看向镜头外，朝向视线水平上方的一处光源。
光影与氛围：风格：低调照明，高对比度（明暗对照法效果）。背景：深邃的纯哑光黑色，营造出无缝的“虚空”感，使主角更加突出。
技术细节：使用 85mm 定焦镜头拍摄，以获得更具美感的压缩效果。光线应在脸部一侧和手臂上形成锐利的轮廓光，另一侧则呈现深邃、戏剧性的阴影。
质量标签：8K 分辨率，超写实皮肤纹理，戏剧性单色，焦点清晰聚焦于眼睛和手表，奢华时尚摄影风格，情绪化氛围。ar 4:5

Include portrait view, full body comparison, and cinematic scene variations. Premium black and gold editorial background, luxury magazine infographic style, modern typography, stylish layout, high detail, realistic premium status poster, 4K quality.
