templates.title: Anime Silhouette Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 芙莉莲电影感角色海报提示词

templates.prompt:
Use a cinematic, Kodak film style with slightly reduced saturation, high dynamic range, and realistic contrast.
Lens: 85mm lens, f/1.8 aperture, shallow depth of field, RAW photo-level realism with rich details.

Generate a cinematic character poster of “{argument name="anime character" default="Frieren"}” from {argument name="source series" default="Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End"}.
It should be both a character poster and a reflection of her story.

Use a large, elegant side-profile silhouette of the character’s face occupying half of the frame. Inside it, depict smaller full-body figures and actions with a sense of depth (near large, far small), with a slight ultra-wide lens feeling.

The character’s appearance and clothing must stay true to the original design—intelligent, cool, and refined, with a subtle ink-brush glow. Movements should feel smooth and natural.

Facial features and outfit details should adapt from the original design. She should hold her original weapon, and her expression and pose must match her character personality.

Generate it as a {argument name="poster format" default="9:16"} poster.

promptLocalized.zh:
采用电影感 Kodak 胶片风格，略微降低饱和度，具备高动态范围和逼真的对比度。
镜头：85mm 镜头，f/1.8 光圈，浅景深，RAW 照片级真实感，细节丰富。

生成一张来自《葬送的芙莉莲》中“芙莉莲”的电影感角色海报。
它既要是一张角色海报，也要能反映她的故事。

使用一个优雅的大型侧面剪影占据画面的一半。在剪影内部，描绘较小的全身人物和动作，营造深度感（近大远小），并带有轻微的超广角镜头感。
人物的外观和服装必须忠于原著设计——知性、冷静且精致，带有淡淡的水墨光泽。动作应显得流畅自然。

面部特征和服装细节应根据原著设计进行适配。她应手持原版武器，表情和姿势必须符合她的人物性格。

请生成 9:16 比例的海报。

Face and body exactly same as uploaded image

templates.title: Ultra-Detailed Dewy Skin Portrait

templates.prompt: Ultra-detailed close-up portrait of a young woman’s face captured in profile, based on the provided reference images to maintain accurate facial features. Her dark hair is soaked and naturally clings to her skin, with {argument name="skin texture" default="delicate water droplets and a light sheen of sweat"} creating a realistic, dewy texture. Emphasis on vivid {argument name="eye color" default="green/hazel"} eyes with natural reflections, avoiding overly glossy highlights. Lips appear slightly wet with a soft, natural finish. Lighting is gentle and cool-toned, paired with a subtle {argument name="background" default="light grey/white bokeh"} background for a clean, atmospheric look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超细节的年轻女性侧脸特写肖像，基于提供的参考图像以保持准确的面部特征。她深色的头发湿透并自然地贴在皮肤上，{argument name="skin texture" default="细腻的水珠和轻微的汗水光泽"} 营造出逼真的水光质感。重点刻画生动的 {argument name="eye color" default="绿色/榛色"} 双眼，带有自然反光，避免过于油亮的高光。嘴唇呈现微湿状态，带有柔和自然的质感。光线柔和且呈冷色调，搭配微妙的 {argument name="background" default="浅灰色/白色虚化"} 背景，营造出干净且富有氛围感的视觉效果。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Glitch Art Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克故障艺术肖像

templates.prompt:
Subject: A sharp, high-contrast side-profile portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="handsome man"} with a defined jawline, short stubble, and voluminous, textured {argument name="hair style" default="dark hair styled upwards"}.

Style & Composition: A fusion of realistic photography and abstract digital glitch art. The subject is rendered in stark black and white, set against a clean, minimalist white background.

Color Palette: Strictly monochromatic (deep blacks and bright whites) with aggressive, vibrant splashes of {argument name="accent color" default="crimson red"}.

Graphic Elements: > * Glitch Effect: The back of the head and the lower torso dissolve into abstract geometric shards, pixel sorting, and "glitchy" red brushstrokes.

Texture: Gritty, ink-wash textures and distressed digital overlays that suggest a modern noir or cyberpunk editorial feel.

Lighting & Technicals: > * Lighting: Intense side-lighting (Chiaroscuro) creating deep shadows on the face to highlight bone structure.

Details: Hyper-realistic skin texture, individual hair strands visible, high-grain film aesthetic.

Framing: Vertical aspect ratio, close-up profile shot.

Aspect ratio is 9:16

promptLocalized.zh:
主体：一张清晰、高对比度的侧面肖像，主角为一位 {argument name="subject" default="英俊男子"}，拥有轮廓分明的下颌线、短胡茬以及蓬松且富有质感的 {argument name="hair style" default="向上梳理的深色发型"}。

风格与构图：写实摄影与抽象数字故障艺术的融合。主体以鲜明的黑白风格呈现，背景为简洁的极简主义白色。

色彩搭配：严格的单色调（深黑与亮白），并带有强烈的 {argument name="accent color" default="深红色"} 鲜艳点缀。

图形元素：> * 故障效果：后脑勺和下半身溶解为抽象的几何碎片、像素排序以及“故障感”的红色笔触。

质感：带有颗粒感的墨水洗练纹理和做旧的数字叠加层，营造出一种现代黑色电影或赛博朋克编辑风格。

光影与技术参数：> * 光影：强烈的侧光（明暗对照法），在面部形成深邃阴影，以突出骨骼结构。

细节：超写实的皮肤纹理，可见单根发丝，高颗粒感的胶片美学。

构图：垂直纵横比，近景侧面拍摄。

纵横比为 9:16

titleLocalized.zh: 风格化 3D 卡通人物肖像

templates.prompt: A cute stylized cartoon boy with an oversized head and small body, standing with hands behind his back, leaning slightly forward while making a playful funny face with tongue out. He has messy brown hair, expressive eyes, and a mischievous smile. He is wearing a navy blue t-shirt, blue jeans, and casual sneakers. Background is a soft pastel blue with floating playful elements like rockets, planets, stars, and small toy cars scattered around in a clean pattern. Studio lighting, soft shadows under feet, vibrant colors, smooth 3D cartoon style, Pixar-like character design, ultra-detailed skin texture, high resolution, centered composition. A cute stylized cartoon girl with an oversized head and small body, standing with hands behind her back, leaning forward and making a playful funny face with her tongue out. She has two braided pigtails, soft facial features, and a cheerful expression. She is wearing a pink t-shirt, denim shorts, and pink sneakers. templates.title: Mixed-Reality Comic Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 混合现实漫画风格转换

templates.prompt:
Convert the subject in this image into a 4:5 mixed-reality transformation with a fully realistic background and a realistically rendered face, combined with bold {argument name="style" default="cartoon apparel"}, hand-drawn comic fire effects, and playful cartoon companions. Use a live-action hybrid composition with the subject preserved as the clear identity anchor while the stylized elements read as designed overlays inside one coherent scene.

CHARACTER:
Preserve the subject’s recognizable facial identity, hair state, and facial hair pattern if presented exactly, then re-render the face with realistic live-action AAA structure, natural skin response, and clean hybrid integration. Ensure high brightness, low contrast, medium saturation, low sharpness details. Dress the figure in exaggerated cartoon clothing with simplified seams, and graphic trims that feel intentionally designed rather than photographed. Add funny cartoon characters as supporting visual accents with expressive silhouettes, rounded forms, and lively attitude, while keeping the subject as the primary focal figure. The body should remain human and believable, but the clothing and accessories should carry comic exaggeration and strong graphic personality.

FACE & ANATOMY:
Keep the subject’s core facial proportions, expression logic, and likeness intact, rendered with realistic but controlled hybrid facial detail. Use natural eye depth, believable skin, while avoiding any plastic toy look or full caricature distortion. The body should read as live-action proportioned, with the stylization concentrated in the outfit, props, and surrounding comic elements.

ENVIRONMENT:
Restyle the exact same environment as a realistic setting with clear depth and natural perspective. Build the scene as a mixed-reality stage where comic fire drawings, playful animated accents, and graphic energy bursts sit visibly inside the real space without breaking spatial coherence. Keep the background believable, structured, and physically present, with the stylized elements integrated as deliberate designed interventions.

RENDER PIPELINE:
Use a mixed-reality rendering pipeline that combines realistic plate-like environment treatment with stylized 2D graphic overlays and hybrid character compositing. Preserve live-action shading on the face and background, then layer cartoon clothing, comic effect shapes, and illustrated fire forms with crisp contour control and clean edge separation. The final finish must feel like a polished real-world composite with intentional animated design language, not a pure cartoon render and not a standard photograph.

COLOR & LIGHT:
Use clean low contrast, and bright comic-highlight behavior against a realistic ambient base. Shadows remain natural in the background and face, while the stylized garments and effects carry punchy neon-like energy and high chroma separation.

promptLocalized.zh:
将此图像中的主体转换为 4:5 的混合现实转换效果，背景完全写实，面部渲染逼真，并结合大胆的 {argument name="style" default="卡通服饰"}、手绘漫画火焰特效以及俏皮的卡通同伴。采用真人混合构图，在保持主体作为清晰身份锚点的同时，使风格化元素在统一的场景中呈现为精心设计的叠加层。

角色：
保留主体可识别的面部特征、发型状态以及胡须纹理（若存在），然后以逼真的真人 AAA 级结构、自然的皮肤质感和干净的混合集成方式重新渲染面部。确保高亮度、低对比度、中等饱和度以及低锐度细节。为人物穿上夸张的卡通服装，采用简化的接缝和图形装饰，使其看起来是刻意设计的，而非拍摄出来的。添加有趣的卡通角色作为视觉辅助，赋予其生动的轮廓、圆润的形态和活泼的姿态，同时保持主体作为主要的视觉焦点。身体应保持人类的真实感，但服装和配饰应带有漫画式的夸张感和强烈的图形个性。

面部与解剖结构：
保持主体核心的面部比例、表情逻辑和相似度，以逼真但可控的混合面部细节进行渲染。使用自然的眼部深度和真实的皮肤质感，避免塑料玩具感或完全的漫画式扭曲。身体应呈现真人比例，风格化重点集中在服装、道具和周围的漫画元素上。

环境：
将完全相同的环境重新设计为具有清晰深度和自然透视的写实场景。将场景构建为一个混合现实舞台，漫画火焰绘图、俏皮的动画元素和图形能量爆发在不破坏空间连贯性的前提下，清晰地置于真实空间内。保持背景的可信度、结构感和物理存在感，并将风格化元素作为刻意设计的介入内容进行整合。

渲染流程：
使用混合现实渲染流程，将写实的环境处理与风格化的 2D 图形叠加及混合角色合成相结合。保留面部和背景的真人光影，然后通过清晰的轮廓控制和边缘分离，叠加卡通服装、漫画效果形状和插画火焰形态。最终成品必须呈现出一种经过打磨的真实世界合成感，带有刻意的动画设计语言，既非纯粹的卡通渲染，也非普通的照片。

色彩与光影：
在写实的环境基调下，使用干净的低对比度和明亮的漫画式高光表现。背景和面部的阴影保持自然，而风格化的服装和特效则带有强烈的霓虹般能量和高色度分离。

templates.title: Magnetic Iron Filings Logo Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 磁性铁粉 Logo 场景

templates.prompt:
Transform the {argument name="logo source" default="uploaded logo"} into a hyper-realistic scene where the logo silhouette is formed by {argument name="material" default="iron filings"} reacting to a magnetic field. The logo must keep its exact shape and proportions, appearing as if a magnet shaped like the logo (or hidden beneath the surface) is influencing the filings to align naturally into that recognizable formation. Material details:
Fine iron filings with sharp, spiky, needle-like structures.
Dense clustering along magnetic field lines forming the logo silhouette.
Variation in density — thick near magnetic poles, thinner outward.
Matte dark metallic texture with subtle reflections.

Physics behavior:
Iron filings must follow realistic magnetic field patterns — radial and curved lines forming spikes and ridges.
Stronger attraction zones create thicker, raised clusters.
Outer areas show softer, more dispersed alignment.
Natural randomness and slight irregularity — no perfect edges.
Some loose filings scattered beyond the main shape.

Surface interaction:
Flat surface such as a {argument name="surface type" default="lab table, glass plate, or matte black tray"}.
Filings resting on surface but visibly lifted in areas due to magnetic force (spiky texture).
Subtle dust and micro particles around.

Environment & human presence:
Realistic classroom, science lab, or creative studio environment.
A person partially visible — hands holding or moving a magnet beneath the surface or nearby.
Possibly a child or adult observing or interacting (adds emotional curiosity).
Other subtle elements: notebooks, tools, or lab items out of focus.

Lighting:
Directional overhead light creating shadows from raised filings.
Subtle highlights on metallic edges.
Balanced natural or indoor lighting.

Atmosphere:
Curiosity.
Discovery.
Educational yet visually satisfying.
Quiet but engaging moment.

Camera & composition:
Top-down or slightly angled close-up view.
Logo clearly visible through iron filing formation.
Human hands or interaction slightly off-center for storytelling.

Format:
Aspect ratio: STRICT 4:5 vertical.
No text overlays.

Style:
Hyper-real macro + environmental photography.
Physically accurate magnetic behavior.
Cinematic yet grounded realism.

promptLocalized.zh:
将 {argument name="logo source" default="上传的 logo"} 转换为一个超写实的场景，其中 Logo 轮廓由 {argument name="material" default="铁粉"} 在磁场反应下形成。Logo 必须保持其精确的形状和比例，看起来就像是一个形状与 Logo 相同的磁铁（或隐藏在表面下方）正在影响铁粉，使其自然地排列成可识别的形状。材质细节：
细小的铁粉，具有尖锐、刺状、针状的结构。
沿磁力线密集聚集，形成 Logo 轮廓。
密度变化 —— 磁极附近较厚，向外逐渐变薄。
哑光深金属质感，带有微妙的反光。

物理表现：
铁粉必须遵循真实的磁场模式 —— 形成尖刺和脊状的放射状及曲线线条。
较强的吸引区域形成更厚、隆起的簇状物。
外部区域显示出更柔和、更分散的排列。
自然的随机性和轻微的不规则性 —— 没有完美的边缘。
一些松散的铁粉散落在主体形状之外。

表面交互：
平坦表面，例如 {argument name="surface type" default="实验台、玻璃板或哑光黑色托盘"}。
铁粉静置于表面，但在受磁力影响的区域明显隆起（呈现尖刺质感）。
周围有细微的灰尘和微小颗粒。

环境与人物：
真实的教室、科学实验室或创意工作室环境。
部分可见的人物 —— 手部在表面下方或附近移动磁铁。
可能有一名儿童或成人正在观察或互动（增加情感上的好奇心）。
其他微妙元素：失焦的笔记本、工具或实验室用品。

光影：
定向顶光，使隆起的铁粉产生阴影。
金属边缘有微妙的高光。
平衡的自然光或室内光。

氛围：
好奇心。
探索感。
既具教育意义又在视觉上令人满足。
安静但引人入胜的时刻。

相机与构图：
俯视或略微倾斜的特写镜头。
通过铁粉排列清晰可见 Logo。
人手或互动部分略微偏离中心，以增强叙事感。

格式：
宽高比：严格 4:5 竖屏。
无文字覆盖。

风格：
超写实微距 + 环境摄影。
物理精确的磁性行为。
电影感且扎实的现实主义。

1.Wide shot – model walking into frame on an urban street
2.Mid-wide – approaching camera
3.Medium shot – slow confident walk
4.Slight turn – natural motion blur
5.Close-up – face + upper torso, calm expression

Row 2 (Engagement – Movement):

7. Looking sideways, candid moment
8. Wind blowing t-shirt slightly
9. Hands in pocket, relaxed stance

12. Fabric texture macro shot

14. Over-the-shoulder glance
15. Side profile with soft light

17. Laughing candid moment
18. Leaning against wall, streetwear vibe

templates.title: Premium Sporty Creator Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 高端运动风创作者肖像

templates.prompt: Based on the uploaded personal photo, generate a realistic premium studio {argument name="portrait style" default="sporty creator"} portrait of the same person. Preserve the person’s real identity above all else. Strictly keep the face recognizable, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, and overall likeness. The result must clearly look like the same person, not a different person and not a synthetic AI face. Do not preserve the original facial expression if it looks like an ID photo, a stiff neutral face, an awkward smile, or weak eye contact. Replace it with a refined sporty portrait expression: calm, confident, softly serious, self-possessed, and quietly strong. The eyes should have direct eye contact with the camera, with a steady focused gaze and subtle intensity. The mouth should remain relaxed and closed, without a smile. The overall facial expression should project confidence through restraint, discipline, and composure. Create a clean, healthy, feminine, athletic, premium sporty creator portrait. Hair and grooming: Keep the hairstyle believable for the person. Preserve recognizable hair length, hairline, fringe or bangs if present, overall hair color, and facial framing. templates.title: Epic Narrative Travel Poster

templates.prompt:
[Collection-Grade Travel Epic Poster · Universal Meta Prompt]

Based on the multiple character photos I uploaded, automatically generate a collection-grade epic narrative travel poster.

The silhouette of the first attached image is the default main outline reference. Extract the character's profile, body posture, hair outline, clothing silhouette, and overall temperament to form the main subject silhouette.

Other attached images are used as real photo collage materials. The character's image, posture, clothing, hairstyle, accessories, light, shadow, and action moments in the original photos must be preserved as much as possible. Do not generate strangers, and do not change gender, age, face shape, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, or physique.

Character consistency requirement: All characters appearing must come from the same person or group in the uploaded photos. The model needs to automatically extract character features. Do not beautify the person into a completely different face.

Travel Destination: {argument name="destination" default="Kunming"}

Automatically generate the corresponding travel visual world based on the filled city or attraction, including landmark landscapes, urban landmarks, street atmosphere, architectural styles, cultural symbols, etc.

The visual structure uses 'Main Silhouette Outline + Real Photo Collage + Double Exposure Narrative.'

The character outline from the first image serves as the large main visual, with the complete narrative world of the destination growing naturally inside the silhouette. Other images are embedded as photo collages inside or around the silhouette. Edges can be softly merged with watercolor, paper grain, mist, light spots, film scratches, or journal stickers.

Spatial layers must be clear: Foreground is the real moment of the person; Middle ground is the travel scene (streets, bridges, etc.); Background is the skyline or mountains.

Style: Cinematic travel collection poster, double exposure, real photo collage, light watercolor texture integration. The image should be sophisticated, restrained, poetic, and airy.

Text system combines Chinese and English: Main Title ({argument name="city name" default="Kunming"} + English name), subtitle, and short travel quotes.

Output Ratio: 3:4 or 4:5. Texture: High-definition, collection-grade, cinematic poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh:

基于我上传的多张人物照片，自动生成一张收藏级的史诗叙事感旅行海报。

第一张附件图片的轮廓为默认的主体轮廓参考。请提取人物的侧影、身体姿态、发型轮廓、服装剪影以及整体气质，以构成主要的主体轮廓。

其他附件图片用作真实照片拼贴素材。必须尽可能保留原照片中人物的形象、姿态、服装、发型、配饰、光影及动作瞬间。请勿生成陌生人，也不要更改性别、年龄、脸型、发型、服装、配饰或体型。

人物一致性要求：所有出现的人物必须来自上传照片中的同一人或同一群体。模型需要自动提取人物特征，请勿将人物美化成完全不同的面孔。

旅行目的地：{argument name="destination" default="昆明"}

根据填写的城市或景点，自动生成相应的旅行视觉世界，包括地标景观、城市地标、街道氛围、建筑风格、文化符号等。

视觉结构采用“主体轮廓剪影 + 真实照片拼贴 + 双重曝光叙事”。

以第一张图片的人物轮廓作为大型主视觉，目的地完整的叙事世界在轮廓内自然生长。其他图片作为照片拼贴嵌入轮廓内部或周围。边缘可与水彩、纸张纹理、薄雾、光斑、胶片划痕或旅行日记贴纸进行柔和融合。

空间层次必须清晰：前景为人物的真实瞬间；中景为旅行场景（街道、桥梁等）；背景为天际线或山脉。

风格：电影感旅行收藏海报、双重曝光、真实照片拼贴、轻盈的水彩质感融合。画面应精致、克制、富有诗意且通透。

文字系统结合中英文：主标题（{argument name="city name" default="昆明"} + 英文名称）、副标题及简短的旅行语录。

输出比例：3:4 或 4:5。质感：高清、收藏级、电影海报画质。

templates.title: Impasto Spring Paris Boulevard

titleLocalized.zh: 厚涂法：巴黎春日林荫大道

templates.prompt: A joyful springtime Paris street scene in a richly textured impasto oil painting style, viewed at street level along a sunlit boulevard lined with blooming cherry blossom trees on the left and elegant cream-colored Haussmann buildings on the right. The sky is a vivid saturated blue with large soft white clouds, and pink petals drift through the air and scatter across the pavement. Include a black iron riverside railing and 1 tall vintage streetlamp on the left, bustling outdoor café terraces on the right with awnings and seated patrons, and a grand domed historic building in the distance centered down the avenue. Show a lively crowd of pedestrians strolling in warm weather, including 2 cyclists riding away from the viewer in the foreground and 1 woman in a flowing pink dress and sunhat walking beneath the blossoms. The mood should be bright, romantic, happy, and full of warmth. Use thick visible palette-knife brushstrokes, high color saturation, sunlight and dappled shadows, expressive painterly detail, and a wide cinematic composition that feels like an idyllic Parisian spring day.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅洋溢着春日气息的巴黎街景，采用质感丰富的厚涂油画风格。视角位于街道平面，沿着阳光明媚的林荫大道延伸，左侧是盛开的樱花树，右侧是优雅的奶油色奥斯曼风格建筑。天空呈现出饱和度极高的亮蓝色，点缀着大朵柔软的白云，粉色的花瓣在空气中飘落，散落在人行道上。画面左侧包含黑色铁艺河岸围栏和 1 盏高大的复古路灯，右侧是热闹的户外咖啡馆露台，配有遮阳篷和落座的顾客，远处的街道尽头矗立着一座宏伟的圆顶历史建筑。画面展现了温暖天气下熙熙攘攘的行人，包括前景中 2 位背向观众骑行的骑行者，以及 1 位身穿飘逸粉色长裙、戴着遮阳帽漫步在樱花树下的女士。整体氛围明亮、浪漫、欢快且充满暖意。运用厚重且清晰的调色刀笔触、高色彩饱和度、阳光与斑驳的阴影、极具表现力的绘画细节，以及宽广的电影级构图，营造出如诗如画的巴黎春日景象。

templates.title: Miniature Japanese Canal Town at Dusk

titleLocalized.zh: 黄昏时分的复古日式运河微缩景观

templates.prompt: An ultra-detailed cinematic isometric street-level view of a dense nostalgic Japanese canal-side neighborhood at blue hour, designed like a miniature lived-in urban diorama. The scene is packed with tightly clustered multi-story buildings of varied shapes and ages, with weathered concrete, faded painted walls, patched metal roofs, tiled roofs, small balconies, rooftop tanks, antennas, pipes, exposed wiring, hanging laundry, window air conditioners, satellite dishes, potted plants, vines, and warm glowing interior lights in nearly every window. At the center, place a charming teal-blue shop house with a dark blue tiled roof, rounded windows, exterior stairs, a tiny awning, and a bright retro sign reading {argument name="shop sign text" default="トリナオ"}. Surround it with many neighboring storefronts and residences stacked irregularly at different heights, creating a layered maze of alleys, staircases, landings, bridges, and utility poles. Include exactly 2 vending machines near the lower center-right area, exactly 2 bicycles along the canal-side walkway, exactly 1 satellite dish on an upper roof near the center, exactly 1 large round wall clock mounted on a cylindrical corner building on the right, and exactly 1 canal in the foreground with dark reflective water and a curved concrete embankment. Add numerous vertical Japanese shop signs and lit billboards throughout the composition, including signs resembling {argument name="main vertical sign" default="久保田"}, {argument name="green shop sign" default="山城商店"}, and other retro neighborhood business signage. The architecture should feel hand-crafted, eclectic, slightly whimsical, and deeply lived in, with dense environmental storytelling and no empty space. Lighting is soft dusk light mixed with warm amber practical lights from windows, lanterns, and signs, creating a cozy yet bustling mood. Color palette: teal, muted red, worn cream, mossy green, rust, indigo, and warm tungsten yellow. Style: hyper-detailed photoreal miniature cityscape, cinematic depth, crisp textures, subtle atmospheric haze, high dynamic range, Japanese Showa-era inspired urban nostalgia, richly layered composition, no visible people, wide landscape framing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度细腻的电影级等轴测街景插画，描绘了蓝色时刻下密集的复古日式运河街区，呈现出如同超写实手工微缩景观般的质感，细节丰富且充满生活气息。构图展示了一组紧凑排列的约 {argument name="building count" default="18"} 栋小型多层建筑，它们不规则地堆叠在弯曲的滨水堤岸旁，视角略微俯瞰。画面中心，一座带有深色瓦片的青蓝色房屋作为视觉焦点，周围环绕着狭窄的楼梯、阳台、屋顶棚屋、管道、卫星天线、电线杆、错综复杂的架空电线、空调外机、盆栽、悬挂的灯笼以及风化的混凝土墙。温暖的琥珀色灯光从许多窗户和店铺内部透出，与凉爽的黄昏氛围形成鲜明对比。运河沿着画面底部延伸，水面深邃且具有倒影，石阶向下延伸至水线，一条带有栏杆的狭窄步道沿着河岸曲线蜿蜒。在画面右下方附近包含 2 台自动贩卖机，左侧和右侧边缘各放置 1 辆自行车，最右侧设有一座小型运河桥。店面挤满了垂直的日式招牌和褪色的青色、红色、奶油色及蓝色外墙，可见“山城商店”、“たばこ”、“パン ベーカリー”、“久保田”、“スナック”、“トリノオト”、“久堂”、“ワカミ”和“食堂”等招牌。添加屋顶花园、晾衣杆、藤蔓、花盆、小灯笼、窗帘、海报和磨损的扶手，让每一个角落都充满生活气息。采用忧郁的 {argument name="time of day" default="黄昏蓝色时刻"} 氛围、柔和的体积环境光、错综复杂的照片级表面细节、浅而真实的景深，以及怀旧的 {argument name="setting style" default="昭和时代日式城市小巷"} 格调。整体色调融合了凉爽的靛蓝色阴影与温暖的橙色室内光，以及柔和的风化漆色。使其呈现出一种既神奇又写实的运河区质感，密集、舒适、杂乱且层次丰富，采用宽画幅 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"}，具有极高的细节度，适合作为概念艺术主视觉图，或设定在 {argument name="city inspiration" default="虚构的东京旧水滨区"} 的动画电影定场镜头。

templates.title: Bold Double Cheeseburger Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 醒目双层芝士汉堡广告海报

templates.prompt: A bold, high-impact fast-food advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="McDonald's"}, designed in a dramatic commercial food-photography style. The layout is a single vertical poster with a warm beige textured background, red and yellow brand colors, energetic paint splashes, flying crumbs, and glossy sauce droplets. In the upper left corner, place the iconic red square logo with yellow arches. Across the top half, feature a huge all-caps headline in heavy block typography reading {argument name="headline text" default="BITE INTO PERFECTION."}, with the first line in black and the second line in vivid red, slightly angled and overlapping for maximum impact. Directly beneath it, add a slanted yellow brushstroke banner containing the subheadline in black uppercase text: {argument name="tagline text" default="DOUBLE THE CHEESE. DOUBLE THE CRAVING."}. The main subject is an extreme close-up hero shot of a double cheeseburger occupying the lower right and center of the poster: a glossy sesame seed top bun, orange creamy sauce under the bun, chopped white onions, crisp green leaf lettuce, 2 thick char-grilled beef patties, and 2 layers of molten cheddar cheese dramatically dripping over both patties and down the sides, with a toasted bottom bun visible. Behind and around the burger, add explosive red sauce splashes and golden cheese-like droplets to create motion and indulgence. On the left side, include a large black circular price badge with a rough yellow outline displaying {argument name="price" default="₹179"} in oversized yellow numerals and a white rupee symbol. Near the lower left of the burger, place a stacked product label in bold block text reading {argument name="product name" default="DOUBLE CHEESE STACK"}, with mixed red, black, and yellow rectangular text blocks and a small curved arrow pointing toward the burger. At the bottom left, add a rounded yellow call-to-action button with black text reading "ORDER NOW →". Along the bottom edge, include a red footer bar with small white app and website details, including "Available on app" and "mcdonalds.in". Use ultra-detailed food styling, glossy highlights, crisp texture on the meat and bun, dramatic studio lighting, shallow depth of field, commercial poster composition, and a premium appetizing fast-food ad aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张醒目且极具视觉冲击力的快餐广告海报，适用于 {argument name="brand name" default="McDonald's"}，采用戏剧性的商业食品摄影风格设计。布局为单张垂直海报，背景为暖米色纹理，采用红黄品牌配色，辅以充满活力的油漆飞溅、飞舞的碎屑和光泽感十足的酱汁水滴。左上角放置标志性的红底黄拱门方形 Logo。海报上半部分采用巨大的全大写粗体标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="BITE INTO PERFECTION."}，第一行使用黑色，第二行使用鲜艳的红色，略微倾斜并重叠以实现最大视觉冲击力。在其正下方，添加一个倾斜的黄色笔触横幅，内含黑色大写副标题：{argument name="tagline text" default="DOUBLE THE CHEESE. DOUBLE THE CRAVING."}。主体是位于海报右下角及中心位置的双层芝士汉堡特写镜头：顶部是带有芝麻的光泽面包，面包下层是橙色奶油酱、切碎的白洋葱、清脆的绿叶生菜、2 片厚实的炭烤牛肉饼，以及 2 层融化的切达芝士，芝士戏剧性地从两片肉饼上滴落至侧面，底部可见烘烤过的面包底。在汉堡后方及周围添加爆炸式的红色酱汁飞溅和金色的芝士状水滴，营造出动感与诱人的氛围。左侧包含一个带有粗糙黄色轮廓的黑色圆形价格标签，以超大号黄色数字显示 {argument name="price" default="₹179"}，并配有白色卢比符号。在汉堡左下方，放置一个粗体块状堆叠产品标签，内容为 {argument name="product name" default="DOUBLE CHEESE STACK"}，采用红、黑、黄混合的矩形文本块，并配有一个指向汉堡的小弯箭头。左下角添加一个圆角黄色行动呼吁按钮，文字为“ORDER NOW →”。底部边缘包含一个红色页脚栏，附有白色的小字应用和网站详情，包括“Available on app”和“mcdonalds.in”。使用超精细的食品造型、光泽高光、肉饼和面包的清晰纹理、戏剧性的影棚灯光、浅景深、商业海报构图以及高级诱人的快餐广告美学。

templates.title: Chibi Kids Playing on Exercise Balls

templates.prompt: A cute anime-style chibi illustration of 3 children playing indoors on large exercise balls on a rainy day at home, in a bright cozy living room full of houseplants. Center the scene on 1 black-haired chibi child with messy tousled dark navy-black hair, large violet eyes, and a calm slightly pouty expression, lying forward and hugging a blue exercise ball with both arms while one leg stretches out behind. On the left, show 1 black-haired chibi child with short twin pigtails sitting on a pink exercise ball, wearing a white T-shirt with a small dark rectangular logo and olive cargo pants, hands resting on the ball. On the right, show 1 blonde chibi child with a fluffy short bob, large amber-orange eyes, and a big cheerful smile, sitting on a yellow exercise ball with both arms spread wide in excitement. All 3 children are barefoot and wear casual white T-shirts and rolled olive or khaki cargo pants. The room has soft daylight coming through a large window, with lush green potted plants around the window and corners, a wooden shelf on the left with 2 stuffed toys visible, framed botanical wall art, and colorful interlocking foam floor mats in pastel pink, yellow, blue, and purple. Use warm natural lighting, soft shading, polished digital anime rendering, rounded proportions, oversized heads, expressive eyes, gentle highlights, and a playful wholesome mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的 Q 版动漫插画，描绘了 3 个小孩在雨天的温馨客厅里，在大型健身球上玩耍的室内场景。构图中心位于前景处的一个孩子，他正抱着一个蓝色瑜伽球，留着凌乱的中长黑发，有着大大的紫色眼睛，表情略带困倦和嘟嘴，身穿黑色 T 恤和橄榄色工装裤，赤着脚，身体前倾，双臂搭在球上。左侧放置 1 个孩子，坐在粉色健身球上，留着扎成小巧低双马尾的短黑发，身穿带有黑色和红色小图形标志的白色 T 恤，橄榄色工装裤，赤着脚，双手放在球上。将面部渲染为覆盖整个面部区域的柔和方形模糊遮罩。右侧放置 1 个孩子，坐在黄色健身球上，留着蓬松的金色短发，有着明亮的橙色眼睛，笑容灿烂，双臂兴奋地向外伸展，身穿白色 T 恤，上面印有文字 {argument name="shirt logo" default="AIFEK"}，橄榄色工装裤，赤着脚。使用温暖的阳光室内环境，背景有一扇大窗户，多盆郁郁葱葱的绿色室内植物，木质搁架，带框的植物墙面艺术，包括泰迪熊和绿色青蛙在内的毛绒玩具，色彩缤纷的堆叠玩具，以及互锁的柔和色调泡沫地垫。让房间感觉柔和、安全、充满乐趣且温馨，采用漫射日光、柔和阴影、干净利落的动漫线条、柔和的绘画式阴影、健身球上的光泽高光，以及具有超大头部和生动表情的极具吸引力的 Q 版比例。使用明亮、健康的色调和精致的现代动漫插画风格。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Dot-Art Near Kiss

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克点阵艺术：近距离亲吻

templates.prompt: A vertical close-up digital illustration of two women in profile leaning in for an intimate near-kiss in a futuristic neon city at night, rendered entirely in dense pointillism made of thousands of glowing colored dots. The woman on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="deep black"} hair swept up into a loose messy bun with wispy strands around her face, bare shoulders, and a delicate translucent fin-like ear accessory shaped like a small bat wing or fantasy gill, outlined in pale pink and blue light. The woman on the right has {argument name="second hair color" default="black"} hair styled in an undercut with the side shaved and the longer top pulled back, a visible ear with multiple piercings, and a dark futuristic sleeveless jacket with straps and metallic details. Their faces are very close, lips almost touching, creating a sensual cyberpunk mood. Use a rich palette of electric blue, teal, indigo, violet, magenta, and soft peach skin tones, with the dot pattern varying in size and brightness to define contours, shadows, and highlights. The background shows a blurred neon-drenched cityscape with exactly 3 vertical glowing signs and high-rise lights, all also formed from small luminous dots. Emphasize moody nightlife atmosphere, soft rim lighting, shallow depth of field, intricate stippled texture, and a painterly mosaic effect, as if the whole scene is built from bioluminescent pixels. Style: high-detail cyberpunk pointillist portrait, dreamy, romantic, immersive, cinematic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖构图的近景数字插画，描绘了两位女性在夜晚的未来派霓虹城市中侧身靠近、即将亲吻的亲密瞬间。整幅画面完全由成千上万个发光的彩色点阵构成，呈现出浓郁的点彩画风格。左侧女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑色"} 的头发，随意地盘成凌乱的发髻，几缕发丝散落在脸颊旁；她裸露着双肩，佩戴着精致且半透明的鳍状耳饰，形状如同小蝙蝠翅膀或奇幻鱼鳃，边缘勾勒着淡粉色与蓝色的光芒。右侧女性留着 {argument name="second hair color" default="黑色"} 的头发，侧边剃短的莫霍克发型，长发向后梳起；她露出的耳朵上有多个耳环，身穿带有绑带和金属细节的深色未来派无袖夹克。两人面部贴近，双唇几乎触碰，营造出一种感性的赛博朋克氛围。使用电光蓝、青色、靛蓝、紫罗兰、洋红色以及柔和的桃色肤色调，通过点阵的大小和亮度变化来勾勒轮廓、阴影和高光。背景展示了模糊的霓虹城市景观，包含 3 个垂直发光的标志和高楼灯光，所有元素均由微小的发光点阵组成。强调忧郁的夜生活氛围、柔和的轮廓光、浅景深、错综复杂的点刻纹理以及马赛克般的绘画效果，仿佛整个场景由生物发光像素构建而成。风格：高细节赛博朋克点彩肖像，梦幻、浪漫、沉浸式、电影感。

templates.prompt: A high-quality cinematic portrait in a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio showing {argument name="foreground person" default="Sam Altman"} standing in the left foreground outdoors in front of a traditional ornate dark wood Chinese-style building with intricate green lattice windows and carved architectural details. He faces the camera and wears a black zip-up jacket with a clearly visible white OpenAI logo on the chest. His arm is extended toward the viewer, holding 1 cigarette extremely close to the lens in the lower-left foreground, making the cigarette and hand large, soft, and out of focus with strong depth-of-field blur. Slightly behind him on the right stands {argument name="background person" default="Elon Musk"}, looking at the camera while holding 1 cigarette near his mouth, wearing a black T-shirt with a white xAI logo on the chest, with his other hand tucked into a pocket. Use warm golden-hour sunlight from the side, creating sharp shadows, realistic skin texture, high contrast, and a moody amber tone across the faces, clothing, and wooden facade. The composition should feel candid but polished, tightly cropped from about mid-thigh upward, with the foreground figure dominating the frame and the second figure partially overlapped behind him. Emphasize realistic photography, cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, natural facial proportions, subtle smoke mood, and crisp branding details on the {argument name="left chest logo" default="OpenAI"} jacket and {argument name="right chest logo" default="xAI"} shirt.

templates.title: Classical Chinese Pet Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 古典中国风宠物肖像

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the pet base, transform the cat into a refined traditional Chinese ink-and-color painting in the style of an antique literati portrait. Keep the cat’s identity, silver tabby markings, round face, large eyes, and front-facing seated posture recognizable, but remove all modern indoor objects and place the cat in an elegant classical composition on stone. Add a soft aged rice-paper background, 1 pale full moon near the upper center-left, 1 bamboo cluster along the upper right, 1 ornamental scholar’s rock on the right, and 1 magnolia branch with 3 large white blossoms in the lower left. Add vertical Chinese calligraphy on the upper left with 4 large characters, a second narrower vertical inscription beneath it, and 2 red seal stamps near the inscription. Use delicate brushwork, muted beige-gray tones, subtle washes, fine fur detailing, and a serene poetic atmosphere like an old Eastern painting scroll.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为宠物基础，将猫咪转化为精致的中国传统水墨设色画，呈现出古代文人肖像的风格。保留猫咪的特征、银渐层斑纹、圆脸、大眼睛以及正面坐姿，同时移除所有现代室内物品，将猫咪置于优雅的古典石景构图中。添加柔和的陈旧宣纸背景，左上方靠近中心处添加 1 轮淡月，右上方添加 1 丛竹子，右侧添加 1 块观赏性太湖石，左下方添加 1 枝带有 3 朵大白花的玉兰花枝。在左上方添加竖排中文书法，包含 4 个大字，下方附带第二行较窄的竖排题款，并在题款附近加盖 2 枚红色印章。运用细腻的笔触、柔和的米灰色调、微妙的渲染、精细的毛发细节，营造出如同古老东方画卷般宁静而富有诗意的氛围。

templates.title: Mao-Era Courtyard Meeting Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 毛泽东时代庭院会议照片

templates.prompt: A realistic historical documentary-style photo of {argument name="number of people" default="4"} Chinese people gathered around a rough wooden table in a rural courtyard outside an old whitewashed building with a dark wooden door and a broken lattice window. The scene is set in mid-20th-century China, with muted natural colors, soft daylight, and a candid, observational composition. One person in the right foreground wears an olive-green military-style uniform and matching cap, leaning forward over the table as if speaking or handing something across. Two seated people wear blue-gray Mao-era work jackets and caps, and a fourth figure is partially visible at the far left edge. On the table are exactly 7 visible items: a white enamel teapot, 2 white enamel cups, 1 rectangular metal coffee tin labeled {argument name="tin text" default="COFFEE"}, 1 folded brown leather satchel, 1 white cloth or folded paper bundle, and 1 small dish or ashtray. The table is weathered and uneven, with strong texture and age. The courtyard has packed earth ground, rough plaster walls, creeping greenery at the upper left, and a clothesline or rope crossing diagonally above. Shoot from a seated eye-level angle with a slightly off-center composition, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, and authentic period detail. Emphasize realism, understated tension, lived-in textures, and a cinematic photojournalistic mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的纪录片风格历史照片，展示了 {argument name="number of people" default="4"} 名中国人围坐在一张粗糙的木桌旁。背景是一座带有深色木门和破损格栅窗的古老粉墙乡村庭院。场景设定在 20 世纪中叶的中国，色调柔和自然，光线柔和，构图呈现出一种不经意的观察视角。右前方一人身穿橄榄绿军装风格制服和配套军帽，身体前倾，仿佛正在发言或递送物品。两名坐着的人身穿蓝灰色毛泽东时代工作夹克和帽子，第四个人在最左侧边缘隐约可见。桌上清晰可见 7 件物品：一个白色搪瓷茶壶、2 个白色搪瓷杯、1 个印有 {argument name="tin text" default="COFFEE"} 标签的矩形金属咖啡罐、1 个折叠的棕色皮质挎包、1 个白色布包或折叠纸包，以及 1 个小碟子或烟灰缸。木桌饱经风霜，凹凸不平，质感强烈，充满岁月痕迹。庭院地面为夯土，墙壁为粗糙的灰泥墙，左上方有爬藤植物，上方斜拉着一根晾衣绳。采用坐姿视平线角度拍摄，构图略微偏离中心，浅景深，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和真实的时代细节。强调写实感、低调的张力、生活化的质感以及电影般的纪实摄影氛围。

templates.title: Guangzhou Ink Brush Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 广州水墨笔触旅行海报

templates.prompt: A refined poster-style digital painting on a clean white background, featuring a large traditional calligraphy brush entering from the upper left corner and painting a bold, flowing S-shaped black ink stroke across the page. Inside the ink stroke, reveal a highly detailed panoramic cityscape of {argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"}, blending modern skyline and historic waterside architecture into one continuous composition. In the upper section, show the contemporary skyline at sunrise or sunset with warm golden light, including the slender Canton Tower, dense glass skyscrapers, a river, bridges, and soft glowing clouds. Let the painted stroke curve downward into a scenic river corridor lined with lush green trees, colorful flowering accents, traditional Chinese pavilions, pagoda-style buildings, and elegant waterfront structures. In the lower section, continue the river scene with excursion boats and a red wooden sightseeing boat, then transition into more city landmarks including a large modern arch bridge and clustered high-rises in the distance. Use a fusion of ink wash, watercolor, and ultra-detailed travel-poster illustration, with expressive black splatter edges and dry-brush texture around the painted shape, creating the effect that the city has been painted by the brush in one sweeping gesture. Keep the composition vertically centered with generous negative space around it. At the lower right, place large black Chinese calligraphy reading "广州" with a small red seal stamp beside it; along the bottom center add smaller Chinese text reading "千年商都·活力广州". The overall mood is elegant, cultural, cinematic, and aspirational, combining heritage and futuristic urban beauty.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅精致的海报风格数字绘画，背景为简洁的纯白色。画面左上角伸出一支巨大的传统书法毛笔，挥洒出一道粗犷、流畅的 S 型黑色墨迹。墨迹之中展现出 {argument name="city" default="广州"} 高度细腻的全景城市风貌，将现代天际线与历史悠久的水岸建筑融为一体。上部展现日出或日落时分的现代天际线，沐浴在温暖的金色光辉中，包括纤细的广州塔、密集的玻璃摩天大楼、河流、桥梁以及柔和的云彩。笔触向下延伸至风景秀丽的河道，两岸绿树成荫，点缀着绚丽的花卉，并配有中国传统凉亭、塔式建筑和优雅的水滨结构。下部延续河景，展现游船和红色的木质观光船，随后过渡到更多城市地标，包括一座大型现代拱桥和远处的建筑群。融合水墨画、水彩画和超细腻旅行海报插画风格，在绘制形状的边缘处带有生动的黑色墨点和干笔纹理，营造出城市仿佛由毛笔一气呵成绘就的效果。构图保持垂直居中，周围留有充足的负空间。右下角放置醒目的黑色书法“广州”，旁边配有一枚红色小印章；底部中心添加较小的中文文字“千年商都·活力广州”。整体氛围优雅、充满文化气息、具有电影质感且令人向往，完美结合了历史底蕴与未来城市之美。

templates.title: Ink-Wash Han Li Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 水墨风韩立角色海报

templates.prompt: A vertical new-Chinese-style fantasy character poster on textured xuan paper, rendered in elegant monochrome ink-wash with muted teal accents and very subtle gold line tracery. Center a full-body male cultivator named {argument name="character name" default="韩立"} standing on a dark lakeside rock in a misty mountain landscape. He is tall, calm, and scholarly, with long black hair tied half-up and the rest flowing in the wind, wearing layered hanfu robes in {argument name="robe color" default="deep blue-green and pale gray"}: a dark outer cloak with wide sleeves, a pale inner robe, embroidered trim, ornate waist ornaments, tassels, and flowing translucent fabric ribbons. His expression should feel composed, aloof, and immortal. One hand hangs naturally, while the other is slightly raised, holding a faint swirling magical aura of pale blue-white spiritual energy. The composition uses strong negative space and a refined poster layout: the character slightly right of center, towering ink mountains fading into fog behind him, bamboo on the upper right, a quiet lake below, a small pavilion on a rocky outcrop at the lower right, sparse trees on the left shore, and delicate drifting petals near the ground. Add thin meandering gold decorative lines across the background and foreground. The overall palette is restrained, soft, and atmospheric, with a literati painting mood and cinematic character-poster polish. Include exactly 4 text elements integrated into the design: large vertical black calligraphy on the upper left reading "韩立", a small red seal near it, one vertical poetic line below it reading "青衫临风，道心如渊", a small Romanized name "Han Li" beneath, and one small centered line of Chinese text at the bottom reading {argument name="bottom quote" default="行于凡尘之外，心向大道之巅"}. Make the image feel like a premium series poster for {argument name="series title" default="凡人修仙传"}, with accurate brush-calligraphy typography, soft mist depth, flowing cloth motion, and an ethereal immortal-hero presence.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版新中式仙侠角色海报，背景为纹理质感的宣纸，采用优雅的单色水墨渲染，辅以低饱和度的青色点缀和极细微的金色线条勾勒。画面中心为全身男性修仙者 {argument name="character name" default="韩立"}，他伫立在烟雾缭绕的山水间，脚下一块深色湖畔岩石。他身形高挑，神态沉稳，气质儒雅，长发半束，其余发丝随风飘动，身着 {argument name="robe color" default="深蓝绿色与浅灰色"} 叠穿汉服：外罩宽袖深色长袍，内搭浅色长衫，饰有刺绣边饰、华丽腰饰、流苏以及飘逸的半透明丝带。他的表情应显得从容、清冷且具有仙气。一只手自然下垂，另一只手微微抬起，掌心萦绕着淡淡的淡蓝白色灵气。构图运用了强烈的留白与精致的海报布局：人物略微偏右，身后是隐入云雾的巍峨水墨山峦，右上角点缀竹枝，下方为静谧湖泊，右下角岩石上建有一座小亭，左岸有疏落树木，地面附近有零星花瓣飘落。在背景和前景中加入纤细蜿蜒的金色装饰线条。整体色调克制、柔和且富有氛围感，兼具文人画意境与电影级角色海报的质感。设计中需集成 4 个文字元素：左上角书写醒目的竖排黑色书法“韩立”，旁侧配有一枚小红印，下方配有一行竖排诗句“青衫临风，道心如渊”，下方标注小字罗马拼音“Han Li”，底部居中书写一行小字 {argument name="bottom quote" default="行于凡尘之外，心向大道之巅"}。使画面呈现出 {argument name="series title" default="凡人修仙传"} 高端系列海报的质感，要求书法字体准确、云雾景深层次分明、衣物飘动感自然，并展现出超凡脱俗的仙侠英雄气韵。

templates.title: Bad MS Paint Cat Redraw

titleLocalized.zh: 粗糙的鼠标手绘虎斑猫

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, redraw the same cat as a deliberately clumsy computer-mouse doodle in a simple MS Paint style. Keep the original centered composition and plain light background, but transform the realistic photo into rough hand-drawn line art with visible wobbly strokes, minimal detail, and an amateur low-effort look. Use thin orange outlines for the head, ears, fur stripes, chest fluff, and body edges; pink scribbled inner ears and nose; black curved closed-eye lines and mouth; and light gray whiskers. Preserve the sleepy closed-eye expression and front-facing pose, but make the drawing look awkward, naive, and slightly messy, like a quick bad sketch traced from the photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张刻意粗糙的手绘数字草图，主体为 {argument name="animal" default="虎斑猫"}，居中放置在纯白色背景上，看起来像是用电脑鼠标在基础绘图程序中绘制的。正面坐姿，构图对称，头部较大，身体简化，闭着眼睛微笑，有着小小的粉色三角形鼻子、小巧的黑色嘴巴、长长的灰色胡须、粉色的内耳，额头、脸颊、胸部、腿部和侧面带有橙色虎斑条纹。使用金橙色的细而不匀的轮廓线，线条抖动且摇晃，毛发纹理凌乱涂鸦，比例不完美，充满业余涂鸦的随意感。图像应看起来既可爱又笨拙，如同随意的鼠标手写艺术，画面中包含 1 只猫、2 只耳朵、2 只闭着的眼睛、1 个鼻子、1 张嘴和 6 根可见的胡须。极简构图，无道具，无阴影，无背景，干净的白色画布，简单的平涂色彩，充满俏皮而笨拙的魅力。

templates.title: Minimal Fox Spirit Character Sketch

titleLocalized.zh: 极简狐妖角色草图

templates.prompt: A clean full-body anime character concept sketch on a plain white background, centered with lots of empty space around her. Depict a slender young fox-spirit woman with 2 upright fox ears on top of her head, very long flowing hair in {argument name="hair color" default="silver white"}, and a softly blurred, featureless face for an unfinished design-sheet look. She wears a short wrap-style robe dress inspired by a kimono, with short sleeves, a wide sash belt at the waist, layered asymmetrical skirt panels, and 1 long trailing ribbon or fabric tail drifting to the right. Add knee-high fitted boots with simple angular trim near the knees. Her pose is elegant and relaxed, standing with one leg slightly crossing in front of the other, left arm lowered naturally, right arm raised with palm open. Hover above her raised hand 1 small magical flame spirit, glowing in turquoise and pale gold, with a curled teardrop shape and tiny wisps orbiting it. Render the figure mostly in delicate monochrome pencil or ink line art with very light gray shading, while the floating flame is the only colored element. Minimalist character design sheet aesthetic, refined manga proportions, soft clean outlines, airy negative space, no background objects, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纯白色背景上绘制一张简洁的全身动漫角色概念草图，角色居中，周围留有大量空白。描绘一位身材苗条的年轻狐妖女性，头顶长有 2 只竖立的狐耳，留着一头极长的飘逸秀发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，面部特征模糊，呈现出未完成的设计稿质感。她身穿受和服启发的短款裹身裙，配有短袖、腰间宽腰带、层叠的不对称裙摆，以及 1 条向右飘动的长丝带或布料尾巴。脚穿及膝修身靴，膝盖附近有简单的棱角装饰。她的姿势优雅放松，双腿微交叉站立，左臂自然下垂，右臂抬起，手掌张开。在她抬起的手上方悬浮着 1 团小巧的魔法火焰精灵，呈现青绿色和淡金色光芒，呈卷曲的泪滴状，周围环绕着细小的光丝。人物主体主要采用精致的单色铅笔或墨水线稿渲染，带有极浅的灰色阴影，而悬浮的火焰是唯一的彩色元素。极简主义角色设计风格，精致的漫画比例，柔和清晰的轮廓，通透的留白，无背景物体，无文字。

templates.title: Sleepy Girl at Laptop Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 笔记本电脑前的困倦女孩插画

templates.prompt: A clean minimalist illustration on a light gray background, drawn in a simple hand-drawn line-art style with dark navy blue outlines and selective pastel pink fill. Show a sleepy young woman with a short blunt bob haircut in pastel pink, seated at a desk and working on an open laptop. She is shown in 3/4 view facing left, with droopy half-closed eyes and a tired, unamused expression. She wears a loose cardigan in pastel pink over a simple top, and sits in a lightly sketched chair. On the desk, include exactly 3 objects: 1 open laptop in front of her, 1 takeaway coffee cup with a lid behind the laptop, and 1 smartphone near the lower right corner of the desk. Keep the lines loose, casual, and slightly imperfect, like a stylish editorial doodle. Place large text to the left of the character reading {argument name="headline text" default="NEMUTAI"} in bold uppercase serif letters in dark navy, with the word {argument name="subtitle text" default="girl"} overlapping it in a smaller cursive script in pastel pink. Add a small handwritten artist signature near the bottom right edge of the desk. Lots of negative space, flat colors, no shading, modern feminine mood, sleepy work-from-home vibe, balanced composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅浅灰色背景上的简洁极简主义插画，采用简单的手绘线条风格，带有深海军蓝色的轮廓和局部的柔和粉色填充。画面展示了一位留着柔和粉色短直波波头的困倦年轻女性，坐在桌前使用打开的笔记本电脑。她以 3/4 侧面朝左，双眼半闭，神情疲惫且无奈。她身穿一件套在简约上衣外的柔和粉色宽松开衫，坐在轻描淡写的椅子上。桌面上包含 3 个物体：她面前的 1 台打开的笔记本电脑，笔记本电脑后方的 1 个带盖外带咖啡杯，以及桌面右下角附近的 1 部智能手机。线条保持宽松、随意且略显不完美，如同充满时尚感的编辑涂鸦。在人物左侧放置大号文字 {argument name="headline text" default="NEMUTAI"}，使用深海军蓝色的粗体大写衬线字体，并让单词 {argument name="subtitle text" default="girl"} 以较小的柔和粉色草书字体与其重叠。在桌面右下边缘附近添加一个小的手写艺术家签名。留白充足，平涂色彩，无阴影，现代女性化氛围，困倦的居家办公感，构图平衡。

templates.title: Imperial Chinese Hall Model Render

titleLocalized.zh: 中式皇家宫殿建筑模型渲染

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed single-building architectural model image of a traditional Chinese imperial hall, resembling a Forbidden City palace throne hall, shown from an isometric slightly top-down view. The composition is perfectly centered and symmetrical, with the building occupying more than 70% of the frame. Show only the main building and its immediate stone platform environment on a clean light gray-white studio background, with no cityscape, no surrounding buildings, no people, no vehicles, no text, and no unrelated objects. The hall has a grand double-eaved hip roof with sweeping upturned corners, covered in rich golden-yellow glazed tiles, with ornate ridge decorations and curled roof ornaments at the top corners. Beneath the roof, include vivid blue-green and gold painted dougong bracket details running horizontally under both eaves. The facade is a long frontal elevation with 10 red cylindrical columns across the front, supporting the eaves above 9 red wooden door bays with intricate lattice panels and gold medallion details. The building sits on a tall pale stone platform complex with 3 terrace levels visible in front, all sharply symmetrical. Add a central monumental staircase aligned to the middle axis, with 1 wide carved marble ramp in the center and 2 narrower stair runs flanking it closely, plus additional symmetric side staircases descending from the upper terrace to the lower side platforms. Include white marble balustrades with posts and rails along all terrace edges and staircase sides. The central ramp should feature elaborate low-relief dragon-style stone carving. The stone base plaza should be light gray with subtle tile joints and crisp edges. Lighting is soft, even, and neutral, like a premium museum model render, emphasizing realistic materials and clean geometry. The image should feel like a polished standalone architectural reference render for AI construction animation.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高度精细的单体建筑模型图像，展示一座传统中式皇家大殿，类似于紫禁城宫殿的宝座大厅，采用等轴测略微俯视的视角。构图完美居中且对称，建筑占据画面 70% 以上的区域。仅展示主体建筑及其周围的石质台基环境，背景为干净的浅灰白色摄影棚背景，不包含城市景观、周边建筑、人物、车辆、文字或其他无关物体。大殿拥有宏伟的重檐庑殿顶，屋檐四角微微翘起，覆盖着华丽的金黄色琉璃瓦，屋脊装饰精美，檐角处有卷曲的装饰。屋檐下方展示生动的蓝绿色与金色相间的斗拱细节，横向贯穿于两层屋檐之下。立面为长条形正面，前方有 10 根红色圆柱，支撑着上方 9 间红色木门，门上带有精致的格栅板和金色徽章装饰。建筑坐落于高大的浅色石质台基群上，前方可见 3 层露台，整体高度对称。在中心轴线上添加一座宏伟的中央阶梯，中间设有一条宽阔的雕花大理石御路，两侧紧邻两条较窄的台阶，此外还有从上层露台延伸至下层侧边平台的对称侧阶梯。露台边缘和阶梯两侧设有带有望柱和栏板的白色大理石栏杆。中央御路应包含精细的浅浮雕龙纹石刻。石质广场底座应为浅灰色，带有细微的砖缝和清晰的边缘。光照柔和、均匀且中性，如同高级博物馆模型渲染，强调逼真的材质和整洁的几何结构。图像应呈现出一种精致的独立建筑参考渲染效果，适用于 AI 施工动画。

templates.title: Exploded Imperial Palace Hall Diagram

titleLocalized.zh: 皇宫大殿爆炸图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A highly detailed exploded architectural assembly diagram of {argument name="building name" default="a grand imperial Chinese palace hall"}, shown in a clean studio setting on a pure white background. Use a centered, perfectly symmetrical composition with a slightly elevated isometric front view. The building is vertically separated into 6 clearly distinguishable construction layers, floating one above another with even spacing and precise alignment on the central axis. From bottom to top, show: 1) a large pale stone foundation platform with broad front stairs, carved central ramp, tiled paving, and perimeter edges; 2) a raised white marble terrace layer with multiple staircases, carved balustrades, and layered ceremonial platforms; 3) the main hall facade with a row of red lacquered columns, red doors and wall panels, and richly painted decorative bands; 4) an elaborate blue-green-gold dougong bracket set running across the width of the structure, dense and ornate; 5) a brown wooden roof frame and upper timber skeleton with visible beams, lattice structure, and curved eaves; 6) the finished imperial golden tiled roof floating at the top, with sweeping double-eaved silhouette, ridge ornaments, upturned corners, and finely ribbed tiles. Emphasize realistic materials: pale carved stone, lacquered red wood, painted brackets, raw timber framework, and glazed golden roof tiles. The image should feel like a museum-grade architectural construction explainer or premium reference plate, extremely crisp, elegant, and technical, but without labels, text, people, vehicles, tools, scaffolding, or surrounding buildings.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的 {argument name="building name" default="宏伟的中国皇宫大殿"} 建筑装配爆炸图，展示在纯白色背景的干净摄影棚环境中。采用居中、完全对称的构图，以及略微抬高的等轴测正视图。建筑在垂直方向上被分为 6 个清晰可辨的施工层，各层之间均匀间隔并沿中心轴精确对齐，悬浮排列。从下至上依次展示：1) 带有宽阔前台阶、雕刻御路、铺地砖和周边边缘的大型浅色石基座平台；2) 带有多个台阶、雕刻栏杆和分层礼仪平台的高架汉白玉露台层；3) 带有成排红漆柱、红门和墙板以及装饰华丽的彩绘带的主殿立面；4) 横跨结构宽度、密集且华丽的蓝绿金配色斗拱组；5) 带有可见梁架、格栅结构和飞檐的棕色木质屋顶框架及上部木质骨架；6) 悬浮在最顶部的成品皇室金瓦屋顶，具有优美的双檐轮廓、脊饰、翘角和纹理细腻的瓦片。强调逼真的材质：浅色雕刻石材、红漆木、彩绘斗拱、原木框架和琉璃金瓦。图像应呈现出博物馆级的建筑施工说明图或高级参考图板的质感，极其清晰、优雅且专业，但图中不包含任何标签、文字、人物、车辆、工具、脚手架或周边建筑。

templates.title: Chinese Palace Components Board

templates.prompt: A clean architectural materials and components display board for a traditional Chinese imperial palace hall, shown from a straight-on orthographic presentation on a light warm neutral background. Arrange all parts neatly in separated groups like a high-end construction inventory sheet, with realistic miniature model rendering, crisp edges, natural shadows, and museum-quality detail. The composition features exactly 7 grouped areas: 1 complete assembled building model in the upper left, 2 large roof assemblies at the upper right, 23 golden roof component pieces beneath them, 4 small roof-corner ornament pieces at the far upper right, 2 wooden roof truss frame assemblies in the mid-right, 6 long wooden beam layers plus 2 thin poles below the trusses, and a lower section containing architectural base and facade parts. The complete assembled building is a symmetrical Chinese palace hall with a golden double-eaved hip roof, red columns, blue-green painted bracket details, and a carved white stone terrace platform with central stairs and side stairs. In the lower-left component area, show 1 detached white stone base platform, 4 upright carved balustrade posts, 1 carved stone ramp panel, and 1 narrow stone stair segment. In the painted woodwork area near the bottom left, show 2 long blue-green-gold crossbeams and 10 blue-green-gold dougong bracket sets arranged in two rows. In the lower middle-right, show exactly 9 red cylindrical columns with pale stone bases. Along the bottom row, show exactly 6 red lacquered door and window units: 1 double palace door, 1 narrow lattice window, 1 wide three-panel lattice window, and 3 additional paired lattice window panels, all with ornate gold medallion details at the base. Use highly detailed carved stone textures, lacquered wood, glazed ceramic roof tiles, and aged timber structure. The overall image should feel like a precise palace construction kit sheet, elegant, symmetrical, isolated, and free of people, labels, text, city background, scaffolding, machinery, or unrelated objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张整洁的传统中国皇宫大殿建筑材料与构件展示项目，采用正视图呈现，背景为浅暖中性色。将所有部件像高端建筑清单一样整齐地分为不同组别，具有逼真的微缩模型渲染效果、清晰的边缘、自然的阴影以及博物馆级的细节。构图包含 7 个明确的分组区域：左上角为 1 个完整的建筑模型，右上角为 2 个大型屋顶组件，其下方为 23 个金色屋顶构件，最右上角为 4 个小型屋顶角饰，中右侧为 2 个木质屋顶桁架框架组件，桁架下方为 6 层长木梁及 2 根细柱，底部区域包含建筑基座和立面部件。完整的建筑模型是一座对称的中国宫殿大殿，配有金色重檐庑殿顶、红色柱子、蓝绿色彩画斗拱细节，以及带有中央台阶和侧台阶的雕花白石台基。在左下方的构件区，展示 1 个分离的白石基座平台、4 根竖立的雕花栏杆柱、1 块雕花石坡道板和 1 段窄石阶。在左下方的彩画木构件区，展示 2 根长蓝绿金色横梁和 10 组排列成两行的蓝绿金色斗拱。在右下方的中间位置，展示 9 根带有浅色石基的红色圆柱。在最底行，展示 6 组红色漆面门窗单元：1 对宫殿双扇门、1 扇窄格栅窗、1 扇宽三扇格栅窗以及 3 组额外的成对格栅窗扇，所有门窗底部均带有华丽的金色圆章装饰。使用高细节的雕刻石材纹理、漆木、琉璃瓦和陈年木结构。整体图像应呈现出精确的宫殿建筑套件图风格，优雅、对称、独立，且画面中没有人像、标签、文字、城市背景、脚手架、机械或其他无关物体。

templates.title: Retro Pop Travel Family Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古波普风家庭旅行海报

templates.prompt: A bold, energetic travel poster in a retro pop-art collage style, vertical composition. The background is a vivid saturated orange with layered textured paper grain, halftone dots, paint splatters, rough brush streaks, diagonal stripe patterns, checkerboard accents, abstract blobs, and hand-drawn white doodles including 4 starburst shapes, 3 zigzag marks, and several short accent strokes. Dominating the upper half is the huge word {argument name="headline text" default="Go!"} in oversized comic-style hand-lettered typography, white with rough sketchy brush outlines, slight 3D depth, and yellow paint accents, ending with a dramatic exclamation mark. In the lower right and center foreground, show a cheerful family of 4 on vacation as cutout photo-style figures with thick white sticker outlines: 1 adult man, 1 adult woman, 1 boy, and 1 girl. All four are looking upward and pointing excitedly toward the upper left or upper right, conveying enthusiasm and motion. The man stands on the right, tall, wearing a light cap, white T-shirt, open yellow overshirt, blue jeans, and a backpack strap visible, with one arm raised straight up and finger pointing. The woman stands slightly left of him, wearing a straw hat and a loose white blouse, smiling and pointing upward. In front, the boy wears dark sunglasses, a light jacket over a yellow shirt, and a backpack, pointing diagonally upward. Beside him, the girl wears a straw hat and a yellow-and-white striped top, pointing upward while holding or standing close to a bright yellow hard-shell suitcase with visible telescoping handle in the bottom-right corner. Use a warm palette of orange, yellow, and white with high contrast, playful summer-travel mood, dynamic diagonal flow, poster-like advertising energy, mixed media look combining photographic people and illustrated graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张大胆且充满活力的复古波普拼贴风格旅行海报，采用竖构图。背景为鲜艳的饱和橙色，带有层叠的纸张纹理、半调网点、油漆飞溅、粗犷的笔触、斜条纹图案、棋盘格装饰、抽象色块以及手绘白色涂鸦，包括 4 个星形图案、3 个锯齿标记和若干短促的装饰笔触。上半部分醒目地展示了巨大的 {argument name="headline text" default="Go!"} 字样，采用超大号漫画风格手写字体，白色填充配以粗糙的素描笔触轮廓，带有轻微的 3D 深度感和黄色油漆点缀，末尾是一个夸张的感叹号。在右下方和中心前景处，展示一家四口度假时欢快的情景，人物采用剪纸照片风格，带有厚实的白色贴纸轮廓：包括 1 名成年男性、1 名成年女性、1 名男孩和 1 名女孩。四人都抬头看向左上方或右上方，兴奋地指着前方，传达出热情与动感。男子站在右侧，身材高大，戴着浅色帽子，身穿白色 T 恤、黄色开衫外套、蓝色牛仔裤，背带可见，一只手臂笔直向上指着。女子站在他左侧稍后方，戴着草帽，身穿宽松的白色衬衫，微笑着向上指。前方，男孩戴着深色太阳镜，黄色衬衫外搭浅色夹克，背着背包，斜向上指着。在他身旁，女孩戴着草帽，穿着黄白条纹上衣，向上指着，同时扶着或站在一个亮黄色的硬壳行李箱旁，行李箱的伸缩拉杆在右下角清晰可见。整体采用橙色、黄色和白色的暖色调，对比度高，营造出俏皮的夏季旅行氛围，具有动态的对角线流动感，呈现出海报般的广告张力，以及摄影人物与插画图形设计相结合的混合媒介视觉效果。

templates.title: Surreal Japanese Meme Thumbnail at Pyramid

titleLocalized.zh: 金字塔前的超现实日本梗图缩略图

templates.prompt: A dramatic, absurdist Japanese clickbait-style poster image at sunset in the desert, with the Great Pyramid serving as a massive stone tabletop in the foreground. A messy-haired Japanese man in a dark navy kimono-like robe kneels behind a black plate of translucent squid sashimi, delicately arranging the food with chopsticks. His expression area is obscured by a rectangular blur block, while his wild windblown hair is sharply silhouetted against a glowing orange sky with low sun and scattered clouds. On the plate are neatly piled pale pink squid pieces, a large green shiso leaf, and a small yellow garnish flower. To the right sits a wooden compartment tray with condiments and small dishes. On the left edge of the pyramid surface, show 1 giant human thumbnail standing upright like a monument, and in front of it 1 tiny orchestra of about 10 formally dressed musicians with string instruments and a conductor, staged as if performing on the stone. The visual joke is that the man was supposedly going to conduct an orchestra inside a thumbnail, but is instead decorating salted squid on top of a pyramid. Use hyper-detailed photoreal compositing, exaggerated scale contrast, cinematic sunset rim light, gritty texture, high contrast, and surreal humor. Add large Japanese headline text integrated into the composition in bold, comic YouTube-thumbnail style with thick black outlines, yellow and white lettering, red paint-brush accents, black ink splatter behind the top headline, and a huge red shout at the bottom. Include exactly 6 text blocks: top-left large yellow text "明日も親指の爪の中でオーケストラ指揮しなきゃ!", below it on a red brushstroke "と思ったら", middle-lower large white and yellow text "ピラミッドの頂上でイカの塩辛をデコレーションしてました〜。", bottom very large red text "チクショー!!", and bottom-right yellow hashtag text "#まいにちチクショー". Compose it like an over-the-top viral Japanese meme thumbnail, vertically framed, dense and attention-grabbing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性、荒诞的日本点击诱饵风格海报，背景是沙漠中的日落，巨大的金字塔作为前景中的石制桌面。一名头发凌乱的日本男子身穿深蓝色和服式长袍，跪在盛有半透明鱿鱼刺身的黑色盘子后，正用筷子精细地摆盘。他的面部区域被一个矩形模糊块遮挡，狂乱的头发在低垂的太阳和零散云朵构成的橙色发光天空下形成鲜明的剪影。盘子里整齐地堆放着淡粉色的鱿鱼片、一片巨大的青紫苏叶和一朵黄色装饰花。右侧放着一个带有调味品和小碟子的木制分格托盘。在金字塔表面的左侧边缘，展示 1 个像纪念碑一样竖立的巨大人类大拇指指甲，指甲前有 1 个由约 10 名身着正装的弦乐手和指挥组成的微型管弦乐队，仿佛正在石头上表演。视觉笑点在于：该男子本应在指甲里指挥管弦乐队，结果却在金字塔顶端装饰盐渍鱿鱼。采用超精细的写实合成、夸张的比例对比、电影般的日落轮廓光、粗粝质感、高对比度和超现实幽默感。将醒目的日文标题文字融入构图中，采用粗体、漫画式的 YouTube 缩略图风格，配以粗黑色轮廓、黄白相间的字体、红色画笔点缀、顶部标题后的黑色墨迹飞溅，以及底部巨大的红色呐喊文字。包含 6 个文本块：左上角的大号黄色文字“明日も親指の爪の中でオーケストラ指揮しなきゃ!”，其下方红色笔触上的“と思ったら”，中下部大号白黄色文字“ピラミッドの頂上でイカの塩辛をデコレーションしてました〜。”，底部超大号红色文字“チクショー!!”，以及右下角的黄色标签文字“#まいにちチクショー”。整体构图如同夸张的日本病毒式梗图缩略图，采用竖构图，内容密集且引人注目。

The girl on the left has very long pale silver-white hair fading into vivid electric blue at the ends, styled in 2 small round buns with the rest flowing down, large light blue eyes, and a calm slightly curious expression. She wears a school uniform with a white blouse, a black sleeveless sweater vest, a pleated dark skirt, a bright blue ribbon bow at the collar, white socks, and black loafers, with both hands held behind her back and her body leaning forward slightly. The girl on the right has rich {argument name="hair color" default="deep purple"} hair in a high ponytail with loose layered strands, golden amber eyes, and a cool reserved expression; she wears a metallic hair clip reading {argument name="hair clip text" default="AI"}. Her outfit is a sporty streetwear school look: an oversized white jacket with bold purple trim and hood lining, a gray top underneath, short bottoms mostly hidden by the jacket, white socks, and purple high-top sneakers, with both hands in her jacket pockets. Add abstract black shadow bars and dotted halftone shapes beneath and around them instead of a detailed environment. Emphasize a polished hybrid of manga illustration and contemporary anime key visual design, high contrast, minimal background, fashionable "flashy hair day" mood, and a cool creative duo atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张背景干净的动漫插画，描绘了两位并肩站立的少女，采用略微俯视的三分之二侧面视角。画面呈现出时尚的单色加点缀色风格，线条清晰利落，带有漫画网点阴影和细腻的半调纹理，并加入轻微的青色与洋红色印刷错位效果，营造出摩登的图形质感。左侧少女留着极长的银白色长发，发梢渐变为鲜艳的电光蓝，扎着两个小圆发髻，其余头发自然垂下；她拥有明亮的大眼睛，表情平静且略带好奇。她身穿校服，包括白色衬衫、黑色无袖针织背心、深色百褶裙，领口系着亮蓝色蝴蝶结，搭配白袜和黑色乐福鞋，双手背在身后，身体微微前倾。右侧少女留着浓郁的 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫色"} 高马尾，发丝层次分明，拥有金琥珀色的双眼，表情冷峻内敛；她佩戴着一个金属发夹，上面写着 {argument name="hair clip text" default="AI"}。她的穿搭是运动街头风校服：一件超大款白色夹克，配有醒目的紫色饰边和连帽内衬，内搭灰色上衣，短裤被夹克遮住大半，搭配白袜和紫色高帮运动鞋，双手插在夹克口袋里。保持构图平衡，左侧少女略微偏左，右侧少女略微偏右，两人都抬头看向观众。在她们下方和周围添加抽象的黑色阴影条和点状网点图形，而非详细的环境背景。强调漫画插画与当代动漫关键视觉设计的精致融合，高对比度，极简背景，时尚的“亮眼发色日”氛围，以及酷炫的创意组合感。

templates.title: Celestial Blue Anime Princess

titleLocalized.zh: 天蓝色公主风动漫设计

templates.prompt: A full-body anime character design of a dreamy celestial ice princess standing centered against a clean white background with faint glowing cyan swirls and sparkles. She has very long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="icy gradient blue"} hair that reaches past her knees, with soft volume, glossy strands, a braided side section, and star-shaped hair ornaments. Add a delicate silver crescent-moon headpiece above her head, plus tiny dangling star accessories near the ears. Her face is mostly soft and pretty in shoujo style, but keep it simple and elegant. She wears a short fantasy dress in {argument name="dress color" default="light sky blue and white"}, with a fitted bodice, sweetheart neckline, translucent puff sleeves, lace trim, tiny floral accents at the sleeves, and a sparkling star-shaped ornament at the chest with hanging jewel chains. Around her neck is a moon-and-star choker necklace. The skirt has 2 layers: a short front skirt and a long high-low overskirt draping down on both sides and back. Decorate the dress with celestial motifs including 3 crescent moons on the hem of the short skirt, 1 large central starburst motif, white filigree patterns, glitter, and tiny star-like lights throughout. Add small dangling charms under the skirt hem and overskirt, including stars and teardrop crystals. She wears white thigh-high stockings, with 3 visible star decorations on the upper thigh area of one stocking, and glossy blue high heels with ankle straps, bows, and star ornaments on the toes. Pose her front-facing with one leg slightly forward, arms relaxed naturally, and hair spreading outward in elegant flowing curves. Surround her with 4 larger glowing star sparkles and 2 small snowflake-like motifs. The image should feel ethereal, refined, luminous, pastel, magical-girl inspired, ultra-clean, highly polished, and delicately detailed, with soft gradients, crisp line art, subtle glitter effects, and a premium character-sheet illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫角色设计图，风格为天界冰雪公主，正面站立于干净的白色摄影棚背景中，居中构图，优雅且空灵。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="冰感渐变蓝"} 的头发，极长且蓬松，呈柔软的丝带状波浪垂至膝盖以下，头顶附近有编发设计，配有侧刘海和精致的星形发饰。在头部上方添加微妙的月牙形角状装饰，作为魔法造型的一部分。她的面部大部分被柔和的矩形模糊遮盖，但插画其余部分清晰、精致且细节丰富。她身穿一件闪烁的 {argument name="dress color" default="淡天蓝色"} 幻想礼服，配有合身的紧身胸衣、心形领口、半透明泡泡袖，以及短款前短后长裙摆，裙摆向后延伸出两片长长的垂坠侧裙片。胸衣和裙摆装饰有银色花丝、小星星、雪花闪光、月牙图案、宝石坠饰，胸前饰有巨大的星爆装饰，并垂挂着水晶链。佩戴月亮颈圈和配套耳环。她穿着透明的白色过膝袜，其中一只袜子上装饰着蓝色小星星和类似吊袜带的小图案，脚穿带有脚踝绑带、蝴蝶结和脚尖星形装饰的亮面蓝色高跟鞋。使用由白色、淡蓝色、青色和银色组成的明亮色调，织物间点缀着闪烁的魔法粒子。在她周围环绕 7 个悬浮的天体元素：4 个四角发光星芒和 3 个雪花状符号，身体和裙摆周围环绕着柔和的青色光迹。整体氛围梦幻、神奇、精致且充满公主气息，以高细节动漫插画风格呈现，具有平滑的渐变、细腻的线条、柔和的光效、亮面高光以及优质的角色概念艺术质感。

templates.title: Anime Schoolgirl Hugging Chair

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫女学生抱椅插画

templates.prompt: A full-body anime illustration of a shy schoolgirl with {argument name="hair color" default="soft pink"} hair in 2 long low twin-tails, each tied with a fluffy white pom-pom hair accessory and a pale blue ribbon. She has large warm brown eyes, light blush, and a gentle slightly pouty expression as she sits sideways on a simple classroom chair, hugging the chair back with both arms and resting her chin and forearms on top of it while looking toward the viewer. She wears a Japanese high school uniform: an oversized cream-beige cardigan over a white shirt, a {argument name="neckwear color" default="red"} necktie, a short gray plaid pleated skirt, sheer black tights, and dark brown loafers. Her legs are together and angled forward, emphasizing a neat seated pose. The setting is a softly lit classroom with a warm wooden floor and a blurred neutral-toned background, keeping the focus on the girl and the chair. Use a clean polished modern anime style, soft shading, smooth linework, subtle fabric folds, slightly glossy hair, natural proportions, and warm ambient lighting. Vertical composition, full body centered, chair fully visible, cozy and cute mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫插画，描绘了一位害羞的女学生，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 的长发，扎成两个低双马尾，每个马尾上都系着蓬松的白色毛绒发饰和淡蓝色丝带。她有着温暖的大棕色眼睛，面带轻微红晕，表情温柔且略带嘟嘴，侧身坐在简单的教室椅子上，双臂环抱着椅背，下巴和前臂搁在椅背上方，注视着观众。她身穿日本高中制服：白色衬衫外搭一件超大号米色开衫，系着 {argument name="neckwear color" default="红色"} 领带，穿着灰色格子短百褶裙、黑色透明连裤袜和深棕色乐福鞋。双腿并拢向前倾斜，呈现出端庄的坐姿。背景是光线柔和的教室，铺着温暖的木地板，背景色调中性且模糊，将焦点集中在女孩和椅子上。采用干净精致的现代动漫风格，柔和的阴影、流畅的线条、细腻的布料褶皱、微光泽的头发、自然的比例以及温暖的环境光。竖构图，全身居中，椅子完整可见，营造出温馨可爱的氛围。

templates.title: Dish-to-Couture Fashion Board

titleLocalized.zh: 美食灵感高级定制时尚项目

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of the plated dish, transform the food into a luxury fashion concept board where the dish becomes the direct design inspiration for a couture evening gown. Keep the visual DNA of the ingredients and plating: convert the light green vegetable pieces into layered flowing silk and chiffon panels, the darker greens into a sheer deep green inner layer, the reddish sausage slices into subtle rust-red piping and small accent details, the sesame seeds into delicate bead embroidery, and the blue-and-white porcelain bowl pattern into a printed scarf collar, wide waist belt, and matching handbag. Present 1 full-body female fashion model in the center wearing the dress, with 4 detail close-up panels on the right showing the back view, the waist/belt construction, the embroidery texture, and the handbag. Add a left-side editorial layout with 1 large Chinese headline, 1 English subtitle reading "Fashion Inspired by Flavor," 1 short Chinese descriptive paragraph, and 5 vertical fabric/material swatches derived from the dish colors and bowl pattern. Clean high-fashion lookbook styling, elegant studio background, premium fashion design presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的菜肴参考图，将美食转化为奢华时尚概念项目，使菜肴成为高级定制晚礼服的直接设计灵感。保留食材和摆盘的视觉基因：将浅绿色蔬菜块转化为层叠飘逸的丝绸和雪纺面料，深绿色部分转化为深绿色的透视内层，红色的香肠切片转化为精致的铁锈红滚边和小型装饰细节，芝麻转化为细腻的珠绣，而蓝白瓷碗的图案则转化为印花围巾领、宽腰带及配套手袋。在中心展示 1 位全身女性时尚模特，身着该礼服；右侧设置 4 个细节特写面板，分别展示背面视图、腰部/腰带结构、刺绣纹理以及手袋。左侧添加编辑排版，包含 1 个醒目的中文大标题，1 个英文副标题“Fashion Inspired by Flavor”，1 段简短的中文描述，以及 5 个源自菜肴色彩和碗具图案的垂直布料/材质色卡。整体呈现干净的高级时装画册风格，采用优雅的摄影棚背景，打造高端时尚设计展示效果。

templates.title: Pink Twin-Tail Anime Girl on Chair

titleLocalized.zh: 坐在椅子上的粉色双马尾动漫少女

templates.prompt: A full-body anime illustration of a cute young woman seated backward on a wooden dining chair in a clean studio setting with a soft off-white background. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} hair styled in 2 low twin tails, each tied with 1 fluffy pom-pom hair accessory and 1 blue ribbon, for a total of 2 pom-poms and 2 ribbon bows. Her pose is shy and slightly flirtatious: she straddles the chair facing its backrest, leans forward with both arms folded on top of the chair back, and rests her face on her arms while looking toward the viewer. Her legs are elongated and elegant, extending diagonally forward with the ankles crossed and bare feet visible. She wears an oversized loose {argument name="cardigan color" default="beige"} cardigan slipping off one shoulder, a short {argument name="skirt pattern" default="purple plaid"} pleated mini skirt, a visible thin-strap camisole or bra top underneath, and sheer black pantyhose. Emphasize glossy, silky hair strands, delicate skin shading, subtle fabric folds, and semi-realistic anime rendering with polished soft lighting. The chair is a medium-brown wooden chair with a cushioned beige back panel and seat. Composition is vertical, centered, and fashion-illustration-like, showing the entire chair and full legs and feet, with a minimalist background and no extra objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫插画，描绘了一位可爱的年轻女性反坐在木制餐椅上，背景为简洁的影棚风格，色调为柔和的米白色。她留着非常飘逸的长发，{argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 头发梳成两个低双马尾，每个马尾上各系着 1 个蓬松的毛绒球发饰和 1 条蓝色丝带，总共 2 个毛绒球和 2 个蝴蝶结。她的姿势羞涩且略带俏皮：她跨坐在椅子上，面向椅背，双臂交叉叠放在椅背上方，脸部靠在手臂上看向观众。她的双腿修长优雅，向斜前方伸展，脚踝交叉，露出赤足。她穿着一件宽松的 {argument name="cardigan color" default="米色"} 开衫，开衫从一侧肩膀滑落，搭配一条短款 {argument name="skirt pattern" default="紫色格纹"} 百褶迷你裙，内搭可见细肩带吊带衫或文胸，并穿着透明黑色连裤袜。强调光泽丝滑的发丝、细腻的皮肤阴影、微妙的布料褶皱，以及具有精致柔和光影的半写实动漫渲染效果。椅子为中棕色木椅，配有米色软垫靠背和座垫。构图为垂直居中，呈现时尚插画风格，展示了完整的椅子以及双腿和双脚，背景极简，无多余杂物。

templates.title: Gothic Lolita Twin-Tail Full-Body Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特萝莉双马尾全身肖像

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fashion illustration of a young woman standing centered in a bright white interior with clean wall panel molding, facing forward in a symmetrical pose and lightly holding out both sides of her skirt. She has {argument name="hair color" default="warm chestnut brown"} hair styled in very long high twin tails with soft shine, straight-cut bangs, and loose curled ends flowing down past her waist. Dress her in an elegant black-and-white gothic lolita outfit: a white high-neck blouse with frilled collar, lace trim, ruffled cap-like shoulder flounces, long puffed sleeves, and a vertical row of small buttons; a large black ribbon bow at the neck with an ornate oval cameo brooch at the center; a fitted black corset-style waist cincher with front lacing and 8 visible gold buttons arranged in two vertical columns of 4; a voluminous black bell-shaped skirt with multiple layered ruffles, including 3 prominent black ruffle tiers near the hem and 2 visible white lace underskirt bands between the black layers; draped pearl chains hanging across the hips in 2 swags, plus a small decorative cameo charm at the right hip. She wears black knee-high stockings with lace tops and small ribbon accents, and glossy black Mary Jane shoes with medium platform soles. The mood is refined, sweet, and classic, with delicate fabric rendering, soft studio lighting, clean shadows, highly detailed lace and satin textures, and a polished high-end character fashion sheet aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫时尚全身插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在明亮的白色室内空间中央，背景为简洁的墙面装饰线条。她正面对镜头，姿态对称，双手轻轻提起裙摆两侧。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"} 的长发，发型为极长的双马尾，带有柔和光泽，配有平直的刘海，发梢微卷，垂落至腰部以下。她身着优雅的黑白哥特萝莉装：白色高领衬衫，配有荷叶边领口、蕾丝饰边、褶皱披肩式袖口、长泡泡袖以及一排垂直的小纽扣；颈部系着巨大的黑色丝带蝴蝶结，中心饰有华丽的椭圆形浮雕胸针；穿着紧身黑色束腰，前部系带，并饰有 8 枚金扣，呈两列各 4 枚排列；下身穿着蓬松的黑色钟形裙，裙摆处有多个层次的褶皱，包括靠近裙摆底部的 3 层醒目黑色褶边，以及黑色层之间可见的 2 层白色蕾丝衬裙；臀部垂挂着两串珍珠链，右侧臀部配有一个小型装饰性浮雕吊坠。她穿着带有蕾丝边和丝带装饰的黑色过膝袜，以及带有中等厚底的亮面黑色玛丽珍鞋。整体氛围精致、甜美且经典，呈现出细腻的布料质感、柔和的摄影棚灯光、干净的阴影、高度精细的蕾丝与缎面纹理，以及高端角色时尚展示图的美学风格。

templates.title: Moonlit Gothic Cannon Maiden

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的哥特式炮火少女

templates.prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy anime illustration in a towering vertical composition, viewed from a low angle. A lone ethereal warrior woman stands on the head of a gigantic roaring beast statue or slain monster in the foreground, her pose powerful and steady as she braces an enormous gothic cannon-lance or cathedral-like pillar weapon on her shoulder. The weapon is impossibly tall, blackened iron and stone with ornate spires and filigree, wrapped in glowing red chains, and its top is exploding with violent crimson fire, sparks, and shards. Behind her fills a colossal full moon with a luminous circular crosshair-like sigil etched across its surface, casting cold silver light through turbulent clouds. The woman has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="platinum white"} hair streaming hard to the right in the wind, and wears layered torn black-and-white ceremonial armor robes with feathered and tattered textures, mixing gothic knight, fallen angel, and priestess aesthetics. Her face is mostly obscured, making her feel mysterious and solemn. Surrounding her are ruined gothic cathedral towers, broken flying buttresses, shattered stained-glass fragments, drifting debris, and distant spires fading into a stormy moonlit sky. The palette is desaturated blue-gray, charcoal, silver, and violet, punctuated by intense red glow from the chains and muzzle flare. Rendered as ultra-detailed, high-contrast, painterly concept art with dynamic motion, cinematic lighting, sharp atmospheric perspective, intricate architectural destruction, and a slightly gritty, rough-textured finish that feels intentionally crunchy and dramatic. Emphasize epic scale, apocalyptic grandeur, wind-swept fabric, glowing embers, and a tragic holy-war atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的黑暗奇幻动漫插画，采用高耸的垂直构图，以低角度仰视呈现。前景中，一位孤傲空灵的女战士站在一尊巨大的咆哮野兽雕像或被击杀的怪物首级之上，她姿态强劲而稳健，肩扛着一把巨大的哥特式炮枪或教堂柱状武器。武器高得不可思议，由黑铁和石材打造，饰有华丽的尖塔和花丝，缠绕着发光的红色锁链，顶端喷涌出猛烈的深红色火焰、火花和碎片。她身后是一轮巨大的满月，月面上刻着发光的圆形十字准星状纹章，清冷的银光穿透翻滚的云层。女战士拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金白"} 发丝，在风中向右剧烈飘动，身着层叠破损的黑白礼仪铠甲长袍，带有羽毛和褴褛的质感，融合了哥特骑士、堕天使和女祭司的美学风格。她的面容大部分被遮挡，增添了神秘与庄严感。周围是残破的哥特式教堂塔楼、破碎的飞扶壁、散落的彩色玻璃碎片、漂浮的残骸，以及在暴风雨般的月夜天空中逐渐隐没的远方尖塔。色调以低饱和度的蓝灰色、炭黑色、银色和紫色为主，并点缀着锁链和炮口喷射出的强烈红光。渲染效果呈现为超精细、高对比度、具有绘画感的概念艺术，充满动态感、电影级光影、锐利的大气透视、复杂的建筑破坏细节，以及略带粗粝、质感强烈的视觉效果，营造出一种刻意为之的震撼与戏剧性。强调史诗般的尺度、末日般的宏大感、随风飘动的织物、炽热的余烬以及悲剧性的圣战氛围。

templates.title: Kyoto Tourist Photo Edit

Bright natural midday sunlight, casual smartphone tourist photo, realistic proportions, soft depth of field.

templates.title: Arcade Portrait to Kyoto Travel Photo

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, keep the same person and realistic photographic look, but transform it into a travel snapshot taken outdoors at Kyoto's Kinkaku-ji. Replace the arcade interior with the Golden Pavilion beside a calm pond, with green trees, cloudy daylight sky, and a bamboo fence in the foreground. Recompose to a vertical smartphone photo showing the subject from about mid-thigh up, standing in front of the pavilion and making a peace sign with her left hand near her face. Change the outfit to a white short-sleeve T-shirt under a sleeveless white patterned dress, and add a thin crossbody strap and a bracelet. Remove all subtitles, watermarks, claw machines, and stuffed toys. Keep the face area obscured/blurred as in the reference.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，在保持人物形象和写实摄影风格不变的前提下，将其转换为在京都金阁寺户外拍摄的旅行快照。将街机厅背景替换为宁静池塘边的金阁寺，背景包含绿树、多云的日间天空以及前景的竹篱笆。重新构图为竖屏手机照片，展示人物从大腿中部以上的身体部位，人物站在金阁寺前，左手在脸部附近比出剪刀手。将服装更改为白色短袖 T 恤搭配无袖白色印花连衣裙，并添加细斜挎带和手链。移除所有字幕、水印、抓娃娃机和毛绒玩具。保持面部区域如参考图中所示进行遮挡/模糊处理。

templates.title: Rain-Soaked Dark Western Gunslinger

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中暗黑西部枪手

templates.prompt: A cinematic black-and-white neo-western scene in heavy rain: a lone cowboy gunslinger walks directly toward the camera down a muddy road, centered in the frame, full body visible. He wears a dark wide-brim cowboy hat, a long soaked leather duster coat, dark shirt, dark pants, gloves, and boots, with rainwater glistening across every surface. His face is obscured in deep shadow for an anonymous, intimidating presence. In one hand he carries a revolver pointed downward. Behind him on the right side of the road stands or slowly follows a dark horse, also wet from the rain, slightly out of focus but clearly visible. On the left side of the road is a single wooden grave cross planted in the ground. The landscape is flat, barren, and desolate, with open fields stretching into the distance beneath low storm clouds. The road is filled with puddles and reflective wet mud, with visible splashes around the cowboy’s boots. Use dramatic storm lighting, high contrast, deep blacks, silvery highlights, and a gloomy, brooding atmosphere. Composition should feel like a dark western movie poster, symmetrical and confrontational, with the central figure dominating the image, rain streaks falling vertically across the whole frame, sharp texture on the coat and mud, shallow depth of field in the background, and an overall gritty, somber, menacing tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 一场大雨中电影质感的黑白新西部场景：一位孤独的牛仔枪手正沿着泥泞的道路径直朝镜头走来，位于画面中央，全身可见。他戴着深色宽檐牛仔帽，穿着一件湿透的长款皮质风衣、深色衬衫、深色长裤、手套和靴子，雨水在每一处表面闪烁。他的脸隐藏在深邃的阴影中，营造出一种匿名且威慑的氛围。他的一只手拿着一把向下指的左轮手枪。在他身后道路的右侧，站着或缓慢跟随一匹同样被雨水淋湿的深色马匹，略微失焦但清晰可见。道路左侧插着一个孤零零的木制墓碑十字架。地势平坦、荒凉，低垂的暴风云下，开阔的田野向远方延伸。道路上布满了水坑和反光的湿泥，牛仔靴子周围可见飞溅的水花。使用戏剧性的风暴光影、高对比度、深邃的黑色、银色的高光以及阴郁、沉思的氛围。构图应呈现出暗黑西部电影海报的感觉，对称且具有对抗性，中心人物占据画面主导地位，雨丝垂直穿过整个画面，外套和泥土质感清晰，背景景深较浅，整体呈现出一种坚毅、忧郁且充满威胁的基调。

templates.title: Rain-Soaked Anonymous Cowboy

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中匿名的牛仔

templates.prompt: A cinematic black-and-white portrait of a solitary {argument name="character type" default="cowboy"} standing and walking directly toward the camera on a flooded dirt road in open countryside during heavy rain. He is centered in the frame, full body visible, wearing a dark wide-brimmed cowboy hat, a long soaked leather trench coat layered over dark clothes, and heavy boots splashing through shallow water. His face is completely obscured by a smooth rectangular blur or censor block, creating an anonymous, unsettling presence. To the left side of the road stands 1 simple wooden cross planted in the grass. The background is a bleak flat landscape with low grasses, a winding muddy track disappearing into the distance, and dramatic storm clouds hanging low across the sky. Emphasize wet textures, reflective puddles, raindrops streaking downward, moody contrast, gritty realism, and a stark ominous atmosphere like a neo-western thriller still. Shot straight-on at eye level with symmetrical composition, centered subject, slight depth haze in the distance, high detail, monochrome, photorealistic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的黑白肖像，描绘了一位孤独的 {argument name="character type" default="牛仔"} 正走在开阔乡村被水淹没的土路上，径直走向镜头。他位于画面中心，全身可见，戴着深色宽檐牛仔帽，身穿浸透雨水的长款皮风衣，内搭深色衣物，沉重的靴子溅起浅水。他的面部被一个平滑的矩形模糊或遮挡块完全遮盖，营造出一种匿名且令人不安的存在感。路左侧插着 1 个简单的木制十字架。背景是荒凉平坦的景观，长着低矮的草丛，一条蜿蜒的泥泞小路延伸至远方，戏剧性的风暴云低垂在天空中。强调潮湿的质感、反光的水洼、向下倾泻的雨滴、忧郁的对比度、粗犷的写实感，以及如同新西部惊悚片剧照般严峻而阴郁的氛围。采用平视视角正面拍摄，构图对称，主体居中，远景带有轻微的景深雾气，高细节，单色，照片级写实。
