templates.title: Modern Villa Architecture Presentation Board

titleLocalized.zh: 现代别墅建筑项目

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A polished architectural presentation board for a {argument name="building type" default="modern minimalist villa"}, shown as a photorealistic dusk exterior rendering of a symmetrical two-story luxury house. The main hero image fills the upper portion: a front-facing contemporary home with a clean white and charcoal facade, broad overhanging roof, full-width balcony with glass railing, floor-to-ceiling warm-lit windows, centered dark entry door, landscaped lawn, paved path, subtle garden lights, and visible solar panels covering most of the roof. The mood is elegant, high-end, calm evening blue hour lighting with warm interior glow, realistic materials, soft shadows, and premium real-estate visualization quality. The lower portion is a clean presentation layout on a white background with Chinese labels and thin divider lines, like an architecture concept board. On the left is a text block with 1 title and 3 specification lines: the title reads {argument name="headline text" default="现代极简风格别墅"}, followed by area text, dimensions text, and structure/features text in Chinese. In the center are 2 labeled floor plans, each drawn in grayscale architectural plan style with furniture and room outlines: one labeled "一层平面图" and one labeled "二层平面图", both marked with dimensions 13000 by 10000. On the right side is a vertical column of 4 interior perspective thumbnails, each with Chinese room labels: "客厅", "餐厅", "主卧", "主卧". Along the bottom is a horizontal strip of 4 additional perspective thumbnails labeled "厨房", "楼梯间", "卫生间", "阳台". Total thumbnail renders: 8, total floor plans: 2, total major layout sections: 4. The interior thumbnails should match the same house design language: warm neutral palette, beige and wood tones, minimalist luxury furniture, integrated lighting, clean cabinetry, modern staircase, hotel-like bathroom, and scenic balcony seating. Overall style is a premium developer sales board or architect concept sheet, crisp grid layout, balanced margins, editorial presentation, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个精致的建筑演示项目，展示 {argument name="building type" default="现代极简风格别墅"}，呈现为对称双层豪华住宅的写实黄昏外观渲染图。主视觉图像占据上半部分：一座正面朝向的现代住宅，拥有简洁的白色与炭灰色立面、宽大的屋檐、带玻璃栏杆的全宽阳台、落地暖光窗户、居中的深色入户门、景观草坪、铺设好的小径、精致的庭院灯，屋顶大部分覆盖着太阳能电池板。整体氛围优雅、高端，呈现宁静的傍晚蓝调光影与温暖的室内灯光，材质真实，阴影柔和，具备顶级房地产可视化品质。下半部分为白色背景上的整洁演示布局，配有中文标签和细分割线，如同建筑概念项目。左侧为文本块，包含 1 个标题和 3 行规格说明：标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="现代极简风格别墅"}，随后是中文的面积、尺寸以及结构/特征说明。中间是 2 张带标签的平面图，均以灰度建筑平面图风格绘制，包含家具和房间轮廓：一张标注为“一层平面图”，另一张标注为“二层平面图”，均标有 13000 x 10000 的尺寸。右侧是一列 4 个室内透视缩略图，每个图均配有中文房间标签：“客厅”、“餐厅”、“主卧”、“主卧”。底部是一条横向排列的 4 个额外透视缩略图，分别标注为“厨房”、“楼梯间”、“卫生间”、“阳台”。缩略图渲染总数：8 个，平面图总数：2 张，主要布局区域总数：4 个。室内缩略图应与房屋整体设计语言保持一致：温暖的中性色调、米色与木质色调、极简奢华家具、集成照明、整洁的橱柜、现代楼梯、酒店式卫生间以及景观阳台座位。整体风格为高端开发商销售项目或建筑师概念页，网格布局清晰，边距平衡，具有编辑级演示效果，超细节，写实，高分辨率。

templates.title: Watercolor Fantasy Heroine at Pasta Cafe

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩幻想风女主角在意大利面餐厅

templates.prompt:
A soft watercolor shoujo manga-style illustration of a beautiful adult female fantasy adventurer dining alone in a cozy rustic Italian restaurant. She is shown from the waist up at a wooden table, centered in the frame, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair, delicate features, and a dreamy romantic expression, resting her cheek against one gloved hand while holding a fork in the other. She wears blue fantasy clothing with brown leather armor on the shoulders and chest, fitted long sleeves, and a low-cut white inner garment, styled like an RPG heroine but painted with elegant, feminine shoujo manga sensibility. In front of her is a white plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce, grated cheese, and exactly 2 basil leaves on top, with a small forkful of noodles lifted upward. On the table there is exactly 1 white pasta plate, exactly 1 drinking glass in the lower left foreground, and exactly 1 greenish wine bottle in a wicker holder on the lower right. The background is a warm sunlit trattoria interior rendered in loose transparent watercolor washes, with exactly 1 chalkboard menu on the left reading {argument name="menu board text" default="Menu
Spaghetti
Carbonara
Bolognese
Vongole
Tiramisu
Vino"}, exactly 5 colored bottles on a shelf beneath it, exactly 2 framed wall pictures, exactly 1 hanging lamp in the upper right, and a bright window area with flowers. Use textured paper grain, soft sepia outlines, warm beige and honey lighting, gentle painterly bleed, romantic atmosphere, vertical composition, and the polished look of a high-end少女漫画 watercolor illustration.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张柔和的水彩少女漫画风格插画，描绘了一位美丽的成年幻想女性冒险者在温馨质朴的意大利餐厅独自用餐。画面采用半身构图，她位于木桌中央，拥有飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 长发、精致的五官和梦幻般的浪漫表情，一只戴着手套的手托着脸颊，另一只手拿着叉子。她身穿蓝色幻想风格服装，肩部和胸部配有棕色皮革盔甲，袖子修长合身，内搭低领白色上衣，造型如同 RPG 游戏女主角，但以优雅、柔美的少女漫画感呈现。她面前是一盘白色的番茄酱意大利面，撒有磨碎的奶酪，顶部正好有 2 片罗勒叶，叉子上挑起了一小口面条。桌上正好有 1 个白色意面盘，左下角前景有 1 个水杯，右下角有一个柳条篮装着的 1 瓶绿色葡萄酒。背景是温暖的阳光洒进的餐厅内部，以疏朗透明的水彩渲染，左侧有 1 块写着 {argument name="menu board text" default="菜单
意大利面
卡邦尼
肉酱面
蛤蜊面
提拉米苏
葡萄酒"} 的项目，下方架子上有 5 个彩色瓶子，墙上挂着 2 幅画，右上角有 1 盏吊灯，窗边有鲜花装饰。采用纹理纸张质感、柔和的棕褐色轮廓线、温暖的米色和蜂蜜色灯光、轻柔的绘画晕染效果、浪漫的氛围、竖构图，呈现出高端少女漫画水彩插画的精致感。

templates.title: Chengdu Gourmet Walking Map

titleLocalized.zh: 成都美食漫步地图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: A warm hand-drawn travel food poster in a Japanese watercolor sketchbook style, showing a walking gourmet map of {argument name="city name" default="Chengdu"}. Use a textured beige paper background, ink outlines, loose watercolor washes, handwritten Japanese annotations, small decorative steam swirls, and a dotted orange walking route connecting food spots and sightseeing areas. The composition is a dense single-page illustrated map with many labeled mini-scenes and dishes arranged around the page. At the upper left, large brush-lettered title text reads "Chengdu 成都市 グルメ散歩マップ" with a ribbon subtitle that says "食べて、歩いて、楽しむ成都！" and a small speech bubble near a panda saying "美食の街へようこそ！". Include exactly 11 featured labeled elements across the page: 1) "錦里古街" as a traditional Chinese gate street scene with red lanterns and pedestrians, 2) "人民公園" as an outdoor teahouse with people seated at tables under trees, 3) "担担麺" as a bowl of spicy noodles held by chopsticks, 4) "小籠包" as a bamboo steamer with soup dumplings and a small dipping dish, 5) "茶文化" as a large plastic cup of milk tea with black tapioca pearls and the text "成都 CHENGDU" on the cup, 6) "春熙路" as a modern shopping street scene with several people walking and storefronts, 7) "寛窄巷子" as a historic alley entrance with visitors, 8) "麻婆豆腐" as a plate of mapo tofu topped with green garnish, 9) "四川火鍋" as a split hot pot with vivid red spicy broth on one side and pale broth on the other, surrounded by small ingredient trays, 10) "串串香" as a lively street stall with skewers and two customers, 11) a small panda illustration near the lower middle as a cute mascot resting by the route. Add several short handwritten callouts around the foods such as spicy reactions, recommendations, and tasting notes in Japanese, including phrases like "うま辛!", "熱々!", "じわぁ〜る!", "ピリ辛!", and "ここ行くべき!". Scatter small red chili pepper drawings around the page. Near the bottom left, add a torn-paper note box titled "おすすめルート" with a suggested course written beneath it and a small note saying "※マップはイメージです". At the lower right, add a concluding handwritten slogan reading "美食之都・成都" and a friendly invitation line beneath it. Overall mood: charming, appetizing, cozy, editorial, travel-journal-like, highly detailed but airy, with balanced negative space and an inviting illustrated tourist map layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨的手绘旅行美食海报，采用日式水彩速写风格，展示了 {argument name="city name" default="成都"} 的美食漫步地图。使用带有纹理的米色纸张作为背景，搭配墨水轮廓、写意水彩晕染、手写日文注释、装饰性的小蒸汽漩涡，以及连接美食点和观光区的橙色虚线步行路线。构图为紧凑的单页插画地图，页面周围排列着许多带有标签的微型场景和菜肴。左上角有醒目的毛笔字标题“成都 成都市 グルメ散歩マップ”，下方配有丝带状副标题“食べて、歩いて、楽しむ成都！”，熊猫旁的小对话气泡写着“美食の街へようこそ！”。页面上包含 11 个带标签的特色元素：1) “锦里古街”，表现为挂着红灯笼、行人穿梭的传统中式牌坊街道；2) “人民公园”，表现为树下坐满茶客的户外茶馆；3) “担担面”，表现为被筷子挑起的辛辣面条；4) “小笼包”，表现为装有汤包的竹蒸笼及小蘸碟；5) “茶文化”，表现为印有“成都 CHENGDU”字样、装满珍珠奶茶的大塑料杯；6) “春熙路”，表现为行人往来、店面林立的现代商业街；7) “宽窄巷子”，表现为有游客进出的历史巷弄入口；8) “麻婆豆腐”，表现为撒有绿色点缀的麻婆豆腐盘；9) “四川火锅”，表现为一边红油辣汤、一边清汤的鸳鸯锅，周围摆放着小份食材；10) “串串香”，表现为有顾客光顾的热闹街头摊位；11) 页面中下部有一只可爱的小熊猫插画，作为在路线旁休息的吉祥物。在食物周围散布一些简短的手写标注，包含日文的辛辣反应、推荐和品尝笔记，如“うま辛!”、“熱々!”、“じわぁ〜る!”、“ピリ辛!”和“ここ行くべき!”。页面各处点缀着小红辣椒插画。左下角添加一个标题为“おすすめルート”的撕纸风格便签框，下方写有推荐路线，并附有一行小字“※マップはイメージです”。右下角添加一句手写标语“美食之都・成都”，下方配有一行友好的邀请语。整体氛围：迷人、诱人、舒适、具有编辑感、像旅行日志一样，细节丰富且布局通透，留白平衡，是一张引人入胜的旅游插画地图。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Machine Angel Over Megacity

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克机械天使降临超级都市

templates.prompt: A colossal {argument name="subject type" default="machine angel girl"} hovering above a dense futuristic megacity at night, viewed from a dramatic low angle so she dominates the skyline like a divine apparition. She has a sleek feminine humanoid body made of white, silver, and graphite biomechanical armor with exposed segmented joints, intricate filigree machinery, and glowing cyan energy lines embedded through the torso, hips, thighs, knees, and chest. Her face is smooth and mostly featureless like a blank mask, partially shadowed, with a luminous cyan visor across the eyes and a delicate metallic halo-crown or antennaed headpiece. She has exactly 2 enormous outstretched wings, each composed of layered metallic feathers in black, gray, and silver, with exactly 1 glowing circular cyan techno-emblem embedded near the center of each wing, for a total of 2 wing emblems. Her pose is calm, solemn, and godlike, arms relaxed at her sides, legs extended downward as if descending in silence. Surround her with heavy rain, mist, floating particles, and dramatic storm clouds split by bright celestial light behind her, creating a sacred cyberpunk atmosphere. Below her is a sprawling vertical city of dark skyscrapers packed with thousands of tiny window lights, haze, steam, and wet reflective surfaces. Include exactly 4 visible flying vehicles or drones scattered through the midair cityspace. Add illuminated billboards and neon signage with East Asian urban-future styling, including one large red vertical sign on the left reading "警戒" with small English text "ALERT", one smaller red sign reading "緊急警報", one huge right-side billboard reading "天使, 降臨。", and exactly 2 billboards that depict the same angelic machine figure. Color palette: cold steel gray, midnight blue, black, white, and electric cyan, with sparse red neon accents. Style: ultra-detailed cinematic sci-fi illustration, dystopian cyberpunk-meets-biblical angel imagery, painterly yet crisp, dense atmospheric effects, epic scale, high contrast, rain-soaked, awe-inspiring, haunting, and majestic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一位巨大的 {argument name="subject type" default="机械天使少女"} 悬浮在夜晚密集的未来超级都市上空，采用极具张力的低角度仰拍视角，使她如同神迹般俯瞰整个天际线。她拥有流线型的女性人形躯体，由白色、银色和石墨色生物机械装甲构成，裸露的分段式关节、错综复杂的精密机械结构，以及贯穿躯干、髋部、大腿、膝盖和胸部的发光青色能量线。她的面部平滑，几乎没有五官，宛如一张空白面具，部分隐没在阴影中，双眼处佩戴着发光的青色护目镜，头戴精致的金属光环状头饰或天线装置。她拥有 2 只巨大的伸展羽翼，每只翅膀由黑色、灰色和银色的层叠金属羽毛组成，每只翅膀中心附近各嵌入 1 个发光的圆形青色科技徽章，总计 2 个翅膀徽章。她的姿态沉静、庄严且神圣，双臂自然垂于身侧，双腿向下延伸，仿佛在寂静中降临。周围环绕着大雨、薄雾、漂浮的微粒，以及被身后明亮天光撕裂的戏剧性风暴云，营造出神圣的赛博朋克氛围。下方是广袤的垂直城市，暗色的摩天大楼密布，点缀着成千上万的微小窗灯，弥漫着雾气与蒸汽，地面反射着湿润的光泽。画面中包含 4 架散布在城市半空中的飞行载具或无人机。添加带有东亚未来都市风格的霓虹灯广告牌，包括左侧一个巨大的红色竖排标识，写有“警戒”及小字英文“ALERT”；一个较小的红色标识写有“緊急警報”；右侧一个巨大的广告牌写有“天使, 降臨。”；以及 2 个描绘相同机械天使形象的广告牌。配色方案：冷钢灰色、午夜蓝、黑色、白色和电光青色，辅以零星的红色霓虹灯点缀。风格：超精细电影级科幻插画，反乌托邦赛博朋克与圣经天使意象的结合，兼具绘画感与清晰度，浓郁的大气效果，史诗般的尺度，高对比度，雨水浸润，令人敬畏、难以忘怀且宏伟壮丽。

templates.title: UR Ice Priestess Fantasy Card

titleLocalized.zh: UR 冰霜祭司奇幻卡牌

templates.prompt:
A highly detailed fantasy collectible card illustration in a premium Japanese mobile RPG style, vertical trading-card layout with an ornate gold filigree frame, icy blue jewel accents, and a polished dark navy UI. The main artwork shows {argument name="character name" default="SERA"}, a divine northern priestess-warrior standing in the center foreground in a heroic full-body pose, facing forward. She wears elaborate silver-and-white ceremonial armor with engraved metalwork, fur-trimmed pauldrons, layered white fabric panels, translucent icy crystal decorations, and glowing blue gem insets. She has a very long thick blonde braid draped over the front, pale skin, and a regal, stoic expression. In her right hand she holds a long elegant ice-forged sword angled downward. Behind and beside her is a gigantic guardian tiger with white fur, dark stripes, glowing cyan eyes, and massive jagged blue crystal growths along its head, shoulders, and forelegs, posed protectively and aggressively. The background is a frozen celestial palace landscape with towering ice spires, crystalline architecture, snow particles, cold blue light, and branching lightning across a stormy night sky. The palette is dominated by white, silver, sapphire blue, cyan glow, and gold trim, with extreme detail, crisp linework, luminous magical effects, dramatic contrast, and gacha-game rarity card rendering.

Include exact card UI elements integrated into the image: at the top center a black-and-gold title plaque reading "{argument name="card title" default="神異 - Divine Anomaly -"}"; at top left a huge iridescent gold rarity emblem reading "UR" with 8 gold stars directly beneath it. At the lower center, a large black-and-gold nameplate reading "セラ / {argument name="display name" default="SERA"}" and a subtitle beneath it reading "北の都の巫女 / Priestess of the Northern Capital". Above the bottom stats bar, include 4 rectangular information panels in a 2x2 arrangement with circular icons at the left of each panel: panel 1 label "属性 / Attribute" with value "金・氷・雷" and English line "METAL + ICE + THUNDER"; panel 2 label "守護神 / Guardian Deity" with value "雷晶虎 / Thunder Crystal Tiger"; panel 3 label "役割 / Role" with value "殲滅・制圧 / Attack Control"; panel 4 label "スキル / Skill" with value "零界断罪 / Absolute Zero Verdict". At the very bottom, a 5-part stat bar with icon, label, and value for exactly these stats from left to right: "ATK 980", "DEF 870", "SPD 760", "MAG 930", "SUP 620". Keep all typography elegant, embossed, and high-fantasy, with bilingual Japanese and English text, glossy card-game finish, symmetrical composition, and luxurious premium card presentation.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张细节极其丰富的奇幻收藏卡插画，采用优质日式手游 RPG 风格，垂直集换式卡牌布局，配有华丽的金色花丝边框、冰蓝色宝石装饰以及精致的深海军蓝 UI。主画面展示了 {argument name="character name" default="SERA"}，一位神圣的北方祭司战士，以英雄般的全身姿态屹立在画面中央前景，正视前方。她身穿精美的银白色礼仪铠甲，配有雕刻金属工艺、毛皮镶边肩甲、多层白色布料饰板、半透明冰晶装饰以及发光的蓝色宝石镶嵌。她留着一头极长且浓密的金色长辫垂在身前，皮肤白皙，表情高贵而冷峻。右手握着一把优雅的长柄冰铸剑，剑尖向下倾斜。在她身后和身侧是一只巨大的守护虎，拥有白色皮毛、深色条纹、发光的青色双眼，头部、肩部和前肢长有巨大的锯齿状蓝色水晶，姿态既具保护性又充满攻击性。背景是冰封的星辰宫殿景观，矗立着冰尖塔、水晶建筑，伴有雪花粒子、冷蓝色光芒，以及横跨暴风雨夜空的闪电。色调以白色、银色、蓝宝石色、青色光芒和金色镶边为主，细节极致，线条清晰，具有发光的魔法效果、强烈的对比度以及扭蛋游戏稀有卡牌的渲染效果。

画面中需集成精确的卡牌 UI 元素：顶部中央为黑金配色的标题牌，文字为 "{argument name="card title" default="神異 - Divine Anomaly -"}"；左上角为一个巨大的虹彩金色稀有度徽章，显示 "UR"，下方直接排列 8 颗金星。底部中央为一个大型黑金名牌，文字为 "セラ / {argument name="display name" default="SERA"}"，下方副标题为 "北の都の巫女 / Priestess of the Northern Capital"。在底部属性栏上方，包含 4 个矩形信息面板，呈 2x2 排列，每个面板左侧带有圆形图标：面板 1 标签 "属性 / Attribute"，值为 "金・氷・雷"，英文行 "METAL + ICE + THUNDER"；面板 2 标签 "守護神 / Guardian Deity"，值为 "雷晶虎 / Thunder Crystal Tiger"；面板 3 标签 "役割 / Role"，值为 "殲滅・制圧 / Attack Control"；面板 4 标签 "スキル / Skill"，值为 "零界断罪 / Absolute Zero Verdict"。最底部为 5 部分组成的属性栏，从左至右依次为图标、标签和数值，具体属性如下："ATK 980"、"DEF 870"、"SPD 760"、"MAG 930"、"SUP 620"。保持所有排版优雅、浮雕感强且具有高奇幻质感，采用日英双语文字，呈现出光泽感卡牌游戏质感、对称构图以及奢华的优质卡牌展示效果。

templates.title: Fantasy UR Forest Priestess Card

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻 UR 森林祭司卡牌

templates.prompt:
A lavish high-fantasy collectible character card in a premium mobile RPG style, full-frame vertical composition with an ornate black-and-gold filigree border and luminous emerald accents. The card depicts {argument name="character name" default="リネア / RINEA"}, a mystical forest priestess standing in an enchanted woodland stream, wearing layered flowing robes in ivory, sage green, moss, and muted gold, with long translucent veils, floral embroidery, vine-like trim, delicate beadwork, and many small white blossoms woven through the outfit and hair. Her face is mostly shadowed beneath a hood and veil for an ethereal anonymous look. She holds a slender wooden bow wrapped with vines and blossoms. Behind her stands a majestic spirit deer made of living wood and roots, with branching antlers covered in flowers, glowing pale eyes, and a swirling magical vortex of teal-green light in its chest. The background is a dense sacred forest with tall trees, dappled light rays, floating motes, glowing wisps, circular magic rings, water reflections, and soft green-blue atmospheric mist. Use ultra-detailed fantasy illustration rendering, elegant painterly realism, rich texture, luminous magical effects, intricate costume design, and premium trading-card polish.

At the top center, a dark green nameplate with gold trim reads "神異 - Divine Anomaly -". At the top left, place a very large iridescent rarity mark "UR" with a violet-to-cyan glow and exactly 7 gold stars beneath it. At the top right, add a circular green elemental emblem with white leaf and wind motifs, and beneath it a small plaque reading "属性 木・風 WOOD + WIND". Near the lower center, add a large rounded dark green plaque with gold edging showing the character name "リネア / RINEA" and the subtitle "西の森の巫女 / Priestess of the Western Forest".

Create exactly 3 middle information panels above the stats row, each dark green with gold borders and a circular icon: panel 1 labeled "守護神" with the value "森の精霊鹿" and English subtitle "Forest Spirit Deer"; panel 2 labeled "役割" with the value "浄化・再生" and English subtitle "Purify Regenerate"; panel 3 labeled "スキル" with the value "鎮魂の森風" and English subtitle "Requiem of Verdant Souls".

Create exactly 5 bottom stat panels with icons and large serif numerals, reading from left to right: "ATK 720", "DEF 810", "SPD 840", "MAG 910", "SUP 880". Overall style: premium gacha card UI, sacred nature fantasy, ornate decorative framing, glowing emerald and gold color palette, crisp typography, symmetrical polished layout, highly detailed and majestic.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张采用高级手游 RPG 风格的华丽高奇幻收藏级角色卡，全幅垂直构图，配有华丽的黑金丝网边框和发光的祖母绿装饰。卡牌描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="リネア / RINEA"}，一位站在魔法林间溪流中的神秘森林祭司，身着象牙白、鼠尾草绿、苔藓绿和柔和金色层叠的飘逸长袍，配有长长的半透明面纱、花卉刺绣、藤蔓饰边、精致的珠饰，以及编织在服饰和头发中的许多小白花。她的脸大部分隐藏在兜帽和面纱的阴影下，呈现出一种空灵且神秘的视觉效果。她手持一把缠绕着藤蔓和花朵的纤细木弓。在她身后站着一只由活木和树根构成的雄伟灵鹿，鹿角上覆盖着花朵，双眼闪烁着苍白的光芒，胸前有一个青绿色的魔法漩涡。背景是茂密的神圣森林，有高大的树木、斑驳的光束、漂浮的尘埃、发光的精灵、圆形的魔法环、水面反射和柔和的青绿色大气雾气。采用超精细的奇幻插画渲染、优雅的绘画写实风格、丰富的质感、发光的魔法效果、复杂的服装设计以及高级集换式卡牌的质感。

在顶部中央，有一个带有金色饰边的深绿色铭牌，上面写着“神異 - Divine Anomaly -”。在左上角，放置一个非常大的虹彩稀有度标记“UR”，带有紫到青的辉光，下方有 7 颗金星。在右上角，添加一个带有白色叶子和风图案的圆形绿色元素徽章，下方是一个写着“属性 木・風 WOOD + WIND”的小牌匾。在下部中央附近，添加一个大的圆形深绿色牌匾，带有金色边缘，显示角色名称“リネア / RINEA”和副标题“西の森の巫女 / Priestess of the Western Forest”。

在属性行上方创建 3 个中间信息面板，每个面板均为深绿色，带有金色边框和圆形图标：面板 1 标记为“守護神”，数值为“森の精霊鹿”，英文副标题为“Forest Spirit Deer”；面板 2 标记为“役割”，数值为“浄化・再生”，英文副标题为“Purify Regenerate”；面板 3 标记为“スキル”，数值为“鎮魂の森風”，英文副标题为“Requiem of Verdant Souls”。

在底部创建 5 个带有图标和大型衬线数字的属性面板，从左到右依次为：“ATK 720”、“DEF 810”、“SPD 840”、“MAG 910”、“SUP 880”。整体风格：高级扭蛋卡 UI、神圣自然奇幻、华丽装饰边框、发光的祖母绿与金色配色、清晰的排版、对称且精致的布局，高度精细且庄严。

templates.title: UR Fox Priestess Fantasy Card

titleLocalized.zh: UR 狐仙祭司奇幻卡牌

templates.prompt:
A luxurious fantasy trading card illustration in a premium anime gacha style, vertical format with an ornate gilded frame and jewel insets, designed like an ultra-rare character card. The card shows a full-body shrine maiden priestess named {argument name="character name" default="カヤ / KAYA"} standing slightly right of center in an enchanted pink-and-lilac sacred grove with cherry blossoms, glowing lantern light, mist, a small waterfall, and shrine architecture in the background. She is a beautiful elegant young woman with very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="soft pink"} hair, fox ears, and a white fox mask worn tilted on the side of her head, partially obscuring the upper face area with ceremonial styling. Her outfit is an elaborate layered kimono and priestess robe in pink, rose, plum, and gold with intricate embroidery, armored shoulder pieces, braided cords, paper talismans, decorative tassels, and glowing jewel ornaments. She holds an ornate ritual staff topped with rings, charms, ribbons, and multiple large purple crystal orbs. Beside her on the left sits a divine white fox spirit with nine large luminous tails and delicate gold vine-like markings. The whole image is filled with magical sparkles, soft bloom lighting, shimmering particles, and ethereal pink light effects.

The card layout must include exact visible sections and labels. At the top center, a dark plaque with gold trim reads "神異 - Divine Anomaly -". At the top left, a huge gradient rarity mark reads "UR" with 7 gold stars directly below it. On the left side, include 4 stacked black-and-gold attribute panels with icons and bilingual labels: 1) droplet icon, "属性", "水・祈", "WATER + PRAYER"; 2) fox head icon, "守護神", "黄金の蔓の白狐", "Golden Vine White Fox"; 3) praying hands icon, "役割", "祈癒・支援", "Heal Support"; 4) circular sigil icon, "スキル", "祈灯結界", "Prayer Light Barrier". At the bottom center, a large nameplate reads "カヤ / KAYA" and beneath it the subtitle "東の里の巫女 / Priestess of the Eastern Village". Along the bottom edge, include 5 stat panels with icons and values in this exact order: ATK 760, DEF 690, SPD 820, MAG 960, SUP 990.

Use a highly polished collectible-card aesthetic, dense ornamental filigree, engraved gold borders, gemstone corners, dramatic fantasy lighting, ultra-detailed costume design, soft painterly anime rendering, luminous magical atmosphere, and rich pink, gold, ivory, and violet color harmony. The final image should feel like a high-rarity sacred fox oracle card, majestic, mystical, elegant, and premium.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张奢华的奇幻集换式卡牌插画，采用优质动漫抽卡风格，竖版构图，带有华丽的镀金边框和宝石镶嵌，设计如同超稀有角色卡。卡牌展示了一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="カヤ / KAYA"} 的全身神社祭司，她站在画面中心偏右的位置，背景是充满樱花、发光灯笼、薄雾、小瀑布和神社建筑的梦幻粉紫色圣林。她是一位美丽优雅的年轻女性，拥有非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 长发、狐狸耳朵，头上侧戴着一个白色狐狸面具，以仪式感造型半遮住上半脸。她身着精致的层叠和服与祭司袍，配色为粉色、玫瑰色、梅红色和金色，配有复杂的刺绣、肩甲、编织绳、纸符、装饰性流苏和发光的宝石饰品。她手持一根华丽的仪式法杖，顶端饰有圆环、符咒、丝带和多颗巨大的紫色水晶球。她左侧坐着一只神圣的白狐灵兽，拥有九条巨大的发光尾巴和精致的金色藤蔓状花纹。整幅画面充满了魔法闪光、柔和的泛光照明、闪烁的微粒和空灵的粉色光效。

卡牌布局必须包含精确可见的区域和标签。顶部中央是一块带有金边的深色牌匾，写着“神異 - Divine Anomaly -”。左上角有一个巨大的渐变稀有度标记“UR”，下方直接排列着 7 颗金星。左侧包含 4 个堆叠的黑金属性面板，带有图标和双语标签：1) 水滴图标，“属性”，“水・祈”，“WATER + PRAYER”；2) 狐头图标，“守護神”，“黄金の蔓の白狐”，“Golden Vine White Fox”；3) 合十礼图标，“役割”，“祈癒・支援”，“Heal Support”；4) 圆形印记图标，“技能”，“祈灯结界”，“Prayer Light Barrier”。底部中央是一块大型铭牌，写着“カヤ / KAYA”，下方副标题为“東の里の巫女 / Priestess of the Eastern Village”。沿底部边缘包含 5 个属性面板，按此精确顺序排列图标和数值：ATK 760、DEF 690、SPD 820、MAG 960、SUP 990。

采用高度精炼的收藏级卡牌美学，密集的装饰性花丝、雕刻金边、宝石边角、戏剧性的奇幻光影、超精细的服装设计、柔和的动漫绘画渲染、发光的魔法氛围，以及粉色、金色、象牙白和紫罗兰色的丰富色彩和谐。最终图像应呈现出高稀有度神圣狐仙神谕卡的感觉，宏伟、神秘、优雅且高端。

templates.title: Neon Japanese AI Prompt Promo Banner

titleLocalized.zh: Neon Japanese AI Prompt Promo Banner

templates.prompt:
Create a high-impact Japanese promotional hero banner for a digital product about business infographic and slide prompts, in a futuristic neon tech style. Use a wide 16:9 composition with a deep black background, subtle dark blue grid texture, glowing blue light streaks, and soft green energy waves sweeping across the bottom right. The overall look should feel premium, cyber-luminous, modern SaaS marketing, with crisp contrast and polished UI lighting.

Place the ChatGPT logo and the word "ChatGPT" in the top left, glowing in green and white. Near the upper center, add a rounded glowing blue capsule badge with a small tag that says "NEW" and main text "GPT Images 2.0". In the top right, place a green rounded rectangular app-style badge with the note logo and the word "note".

On the left half, build the main headline stack in Japanese. Add a small green outlined label reading "ChatGPT Images 2.0 特化" above the headline. Then place a very large bold white headline on two lines: "ビジネス図解・スライド" and "プロンプト". Next to the second line, place an oversized glowing electric-blue number "50" with a bright neon rim light and the smaller text "選" attached to its lower right. Below the headline, add a thin horizontal blue neon divider line. Under it, place the subheadline in Japanese: "プロ品質の図解が、秒で完成する。" with the character group "秒で" highlighted in bright blue while the rest remains white.

On the right half, show 3 stacked floating dark UI cards with blue neon outlines, each slightly tilted and glowing, like business slide templates preview thumbnails. Count exactly 3 cards. The top card should show an organization chart template with the title "01 組織体制図のテンプレート", a small subtitle line, a CEO box at top, 4 department boxes beneath it, and 8 member boxes total along the bottom row. The middle card should show a data-analysis dashboard template titled "01 データ分析・グラフ図解のテンプレート", with a green percentage "+32.5%", a monthly vertical bar chart with 6 bars labeled from 1月 to 6月, and a donut chart legend with exactly 4 items. The bottom card should show a business process flow template titled "01 ビジネスプロセス図解のテンプレート", with a 5-step horizontal icon flow connected by arrows and small Japanese labels under each step.

Along the bottom, create a row of exactly 4 feature items separated by thin vertical dividers. Each feature item should have a glowing circular icon and two-line Japanese text in white. The 4 features are: "すぐに使える プロンプト50選", "ビジネス特化の 高精度テンプレート", "時短＆高品質 作業効率を最大化", and "商用利用も安心 そのまま使える". Use icon styles resembling lightning, target/crosshair, clock, and shield respectively.

Typography should be bold, geometric sans-serif, with extremely large Japanese headline text, clean alignment, and strong hierarchy. Emphasize blue and green neon glows, glossy reflections, luminous edges, and a sleek conversion-focused landing-page aesthetic. No people, no photography, only graphic design, UI cards, icons, and Japanese marketing text.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张具有高影响力的日式宣传首屏横幅，用于推广关于商业信息图表和 Slides 提示词的数字产品，采用未来感霓虹科技风格。使用 16:9 的宽屏构图，深黑色背景，带有微妙的深蓝色网格纹理，发光的蓝色光束，以及在右下角扫过的柔和绿色能量波。整体视觉应呈现出高端、赛博发光、现代 SaaS 营销的质感，具备清晰的对比度和精致的 UI 灯光效果。

在左上角放置 ChatGPT Logo 和“ChatGPT”字样，呈现绿色和白色发光效果。在上部中心附近，添加一个圆角发光蓝色胶囊徽章，带有一个写着“NEW”的小标签，主文字为“GPT Images 2.0”。在右上角，放置一个绿色圆角矩形 App 风格徽章，带有 note Logo 和“note”字样。

在左半部分，构建日文主标题堆栈。在标题上方添加一个绿色轮廓的小标签，文字为“ChatGPT Images 2.0 特化”。接着放置一个非常醒目的两行白色粗体大标题：“ビジネス図解・スライド”和“プロンプト”。在第二行旁边，放置一个超大的发光电蓝色数字“50”，带有明亮的霓虹边缘光，右下角附带较小的“選”字。在标题下方，添加一条细长的蓝色霓虹水平分割线。在其下方，放置日文副标题：“プロ品質の図解が、秒で完成する。”，其中“秒で”字符组以亮蓝色高亮显示，其余部分保持白色。

在右半部分，展示 3 张堆叠的悬浮深色 UI 卡片，带有蓝色霓虹轮廓，每张卡片略微倾斜并带有发光效果，如同商业 Slides 模板的预览缩略图。卡片数量严格为 3 张。最上方的卡片应显示组织架构图模板，标题为“01 組織体制図のテンプレート”，包含一行小副标题，顶部有一个 CEO 框，下方有 4 个部门框，最底层总共有 8 个成员框。中间的卡片应显示数据分析仪表板模板，标题为“01 データ分析・グラフ図解のテンプレート”，包含一个绿色百分比“+32.5%”、一个带有 6 根柱状图的月度垂直柱状图（标注 1 月至 6 月），以及一个包含 4 个项目的圆环图图例。最下方的卡片应显示商业流程图模板，标题为“01 ビジネスプロセス図解のテンプレート”，包含一个由箭头连接的 5 步水平图标流程，每个步骤下方有简短的日文标签。

在底部，创建一行由细垂直分割线隔开的 4 个功能项。每个功能项应有一个发光的圆形图标和两行白色日文文本。这 4 个功能分别是：“すぐに使える プロンプト50選”、“ビジネス特化の 高精度テンプレート”、“時短＆高品質 作業効率を最大化”以及“商用利用も安心 そのまま使える”。图标风格分别参考闪电、目标/十字准星、时钟和盾牌。

排版应采用粗体、几何无衬线字体，日文标题文字要极大，对齐整齐，层级分明。强调蓝色和绿色霓虹光效、光泽反射、发光边缘，以及简洁的转化导向型落地页美学。不要出现人物或摄影照片，仅使用图形设计、UI 卡片、图标和日文营销文本。

templates.title: Modern Sukeban Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 现代版太妹（Sukeban）街头肖像

templates.prompt: A full-body fashion-editorial street portrait of a modern-day Japanese delinquent schoolgirl vigilante standing wide-legged in the middle of a busy Tokyo entertainment district intersection, photographed from a slightly low angle for a bold heroic presence. She is a young Japanese woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose strands, wearing a white sailor-style school blouse with a navy collar and a large deep red bow, a short dark navy pleated skirt, an oversized black leather biker jacket, white crew socks, and chunky white sneakers with bright red laces. In one hand she loosely holds a metallic yo-yo hanging by its string as a signature weapon, while her other hand rests in her jacket pocket. The pose is confident, rebellious, and confrontational, like a contemporary reinterpretation of {argument name="character concept" default="Sukeban Deka"}. Set the scene on a real urban Tokyo street with zebra crossing lines under her feet, cars stopped behind her, pedestrians along the sidewalks, and tall buildings packed with vertical Japanese shop signs and billboards fading into the background. Use shallow depth of field so the city remains recognizable but softly blurred, while the subject is crisp and centered. Lighting is bright natural daytime with soft contrast, realistic skin tones, premium fashion photography sharpness, and a cinematic urban cool-girl mood. Emphasize realism, high detail in the leather texture and pleated skirt, subtle wind in the ponytail, and a polished contemporary Japanese street-style aesthetic.

templates.title: Manga Pillar Anime Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Manga Pillar 动漫角色海报

templates.prompt: A full-body anime character poster on a vertical canvas, designed like a dramatic manga-themed hero introduction. At the top left, large bold Japanese title text reads "マンガ柱" with small furigana "ばしら" above it, and beneath it a black nameplate with pink trim reads "漫画咲" with small furigana above the kanji. In the center stands an energetic teenage girl anime swordswoman, facing forward in a confident wide stance, smiling brightly with an open mouth and sparkling eyes. She has very long voluminous twin-tail hair in {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"}, with multicolored streaks of cyan, yellow, and lavender woven through the hair, and many decorative hair clips and ribbons, including small manga-themed tags. Her eye color is large and vivid pink-purple with glossy highlights. She wears a dark navy or black demon-slayer-inspired uniform with gold buttons, a white belt, loose tucked pants, white leg wraps printed with manga sound effects and doodles, and black platform sandals with pink straps. Over the uniform she wears a flowing haori whose entire outer surface is covered in black-and-white manga panels and graphic inked artwork, while the lining is bright pink. She holds 2 katanas: one raised across her shoulders in her right hand and one lowered in her left hand. Both swords have manga-decorated sheaths and hilts with pink accents, and one sheath includes bold Japanese lettering. Add small star-shaped sparkles around her. Surround her with flying loose manga pages and clipped comic panels, scattered diagonally across the composition as if blown by wind. Include 3 large manga sound-effect texts in pink and black: one "ドン!" at lower left, one "ドン!" near the lower right leg, and one "ドン" on the right side of the haori. Also include 2 speech-bubble callouts: one spiky bubble at upper right containing "!!" and one vertical spiky bubble at left containing Japanese dialogue. The background is a soft pink-and-white halftone and ink-splash pattern with dynamic speed lines radiating inward, giving the feel of a manga cover splash page. High-detail polished anime illustration, crisp linework, expressive face, glossy hair, fashionable fantasy styling, playful heroic attitude, vibrant pink-centric palette, poster-quality composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖构图的全身动漫角色海报，设计灵感源自极具张力的漫画英雄登场画面。左上方印有醒目的粗体日文标题“マンガ柱”，上方带有小字假名“ばしら”；下方配有一个带有粉色边框的黑色名牌，上面写着“漫画咲”，汉字上方同样带有假名。画面中央站着一位充满活力的少女动漫剑士，她自信地迈开双腿，正面对着镜头，笑容灿烂，双眼闪烁着光芒。她留着一头极长且蓬松的双马尾，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"}，发间穿插着青色、黄色和淡紫色的挑染，并装饰着许多发夹和丝带，其中包括带有漫画主题的小标签。她的双眼又大又亮，呈现出鲜艳的粉紫色，带有光泽感。她身穿深海军蓝或黑色的鬼灭风格制服，配有金色纽扣、白色腰带、宽松的束脚裤、印有漫画拟声词和涂鸦的白色绑腿，以及带有粉色绑带的黑色厚底凉鞋。制服外罩着一件飘逸的羽织，外层布满了黑白漫画分镜和墨绘图形，内衬则为亮粉色。她双手各持一把武士刀：右手将一把刀横扛在肩上，左手垂下一把刀。两把刀的刀鞘和刀柄均装饰有漫画元素，并带有粉色点缀，其中一个刀鞘上还印有醒目的日文字样。在角色周围添加一些小星星状的闪光。画面中散落着飞舞的漫画书页和剪裁过的漫画分镜，呈对角线分布，仿佛被风吹起。画面中包含 3 处粉色与黑色的大号漫画拟声词：左下方一处“ドン!”，右下腿部附近一处“ドン!”，以及羽织右侧一处“ドン”。此外还包含 2 个对话气泡：右上角一个尖刺状气泡内写着“!!”，左侧一个垂直的尖刺状气泡内写着日文对话。背景为柔和的粉白双色网点与墨迹飞溅图案，并带有向内汇聚的动态速度线，营造出漫画封面跨页的视觉效果。高细节精致动漫插画，线条清晰，表情生动，发丝光泽感强，时尚奇幻造型，俏皮英雄姿态，以粉色为主调的鲜艳配色，海报级构图。

The beast is a chimera with exactly 3 major animal traits combined into one seamless body: the face and fluffy black-and-white mask of a raccoon dog or tanuki, the muscular orange-and-black striped body of a tiger, and 1 long snake tail arcing upward behind it with banded scales. Its fur is dense and realistic, with a dark mane-like ruff around the neck, rounded ears, amber eyes, and an alert, uncanny expression. The front limbs are lifted in motion with oversized curved black claws, emphasizing a stalking, predatory gait. Set the scene in a vast {argument name="mountain setting" default="3,000 meter high cloud-level cliff in a rugged snowy mountain range"}, with steep forested valleys, jagged snowcapped peaks, scattered conifer trees, exposed rock, and bright daylight under a blue sky with soft white clouds. templates.title: Dark Anime Energy Drink Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑动漫风能量饮料海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic commercial anime poster for a fictional energy drink brand, in a black, crimson red, and white limited palette with explosive contrast. The composition is vertical and densely layered like a Japanese street poster. In the foreground, a chibi-goth anime girl with a short blunt bob, pale skin, oversized round goggles with glowing red lenses, and a dark oversized hoodie faces forward and holds a tall black energy drink can close to the viewer in her right hand. Her hoodie has cat-themed details and small accessories, and she is surrounded by hand-drawn white doodle line art: exactly 6 cat faces or cat characters, exactly 4 bats, exactly 4 stars, exactly 2 hearts, and several lightning scribbles and spark marks. The can is black with red accents and a cat logo, labeled in bold English text: "NEKON ENERGY" and "BLACK SHOCK". In the midground and background, a ruined futuristic city canyon stretches inward toward a bright red blast of energy at the center. A lone back-facing human silhouette stands in the center of the street before the explosion, framed by jagged skyscrapers and red shockwave streaks. At the top center, huge distressed white Japanese headline text dominates the poster: {argument name="headline text" default="本能、覚醒。"}. Beneath it, smaller white Japanese subheading text reads: {argument name="tagline text" default="闇を切り裂き、限界を超えろ。"}. In the upper left, create a vertical feature list with 3 benefit blocks, each with a small white icon and Japanese copy. The first block has a lightning-style icon and the heading "最強のエナジー" with smaller text "カフェイン160mg アルギニン配合". The second block has a cat-face icon and the heading "集中力ブースト" with smaller text "ガラナとビタミン群で 脳を覚醒". The third block has a heart icon and the heading "疲労回復サポート" with smaller text "クエン酸＆必須アミノ酸で リカバリー". In the top right, place the white logo text {argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"}. At the bottom, add a massive white Japanese slogan: {argument name="bottom slogan" default="黒の衝撃、全開。"}. Directly below it, set the product name in bold italic red capitals: {argument name="product name" default="NEKON ENERGY BLACK SHOCK"}. Add a small white Japanese footer line centered beneath: "闇を味方に、未来を掴め。". In the lower right corner, place a red paint-splatter badge with black and white Japanese text reading "エナジー売上 No.1 ※自社調べ". The overall style mixes gritty cyberpunk apocalypse illustration, manga key art, and rough white marker doodles over a highly rendered red-black cityscape, with cracked texture on the large typography, cinematic lighting, aggressive depth, and premium commercial poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的虚构能量饮料品牌动漫商业海报，采用黑、深红和白色的限定配色，对比强烈且充满张力。构图为竖版，层次丰富，如同日本街头海报。前景中，一位哥特风 Q 版动漫少女正对着前方，她留着短直发，皮肤苍白，戴着红色镜片发光的超大圆形护目镜，身穿深色超大号连帽衫，右手拿着一罐黑色能量饮料靠近观众。她的连帽衫带有猫咪主题细节和小配饰，周围环绕着手绘白色涂鸦线条：正好 6 个猫脸或猫咪角色、4 只蝙蝠、4 颗星星、2 颗爱心，以及若干闪电涂鸦和火花标记。饮料罐为黑色，带有红色点缀和猫咪标志，罐身上印有粗体英文文本：“NEKON ENERGY” 和 “BLACK SHOCK”。在中景和背景中，一座废弃的未来主义城市峡谷向中心明亮的红色能量爆发点延伸。爆炸前的街道中央站着一个背对观众的人类剪影，周围是锯齿状的摩天大楼和红色的冲击波条纹。在顶部中央，巨大的做旧白色日文标题占据了海报主体：{argument name="headline text" default="本能、覚醒。"}。下方较小的白色日文副标题写着：{argument name="tagline text" default="闇を切り裂き、限界を超えろ。"}。在左上角，创建一个包含 3 个利益点的竖向列表，每个点配有一个白色小图标和日文文案。第一个区块带有闪电图标，标题为“最強のエナジー”，副标题为“カフェイン160mg アルギニン配合”。第二个区块带有猫脸图标，标题为“集中力ブースト”，副标题为“ガラナとビタミン群で 脳を覚醒”。第三个区块带有爱心图标，标题为“疲労回復サポート”，副标题为“クエン酸＆必須アミノ酸で リカバリー”。在右上角，放置白色 Logo 文本 {argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"}。在底部，添加一条巨大的白色日文标语：{argument name="bottom slogan" default="黒の衝撃、全開。"}。在其正下方，以粗体斜体红色大写字母设置产品名称：{argument name="product name" default="NEKON ENERGY BLACK SHOCK"}。在底部中央添加一行小号白色日文页脚：“闇を味方に、未来を掴め。”。在右下角，放置一个红色油漆飞溅徽章，上面写着黑白相间的日文：“エナジー売上 No.1 ※自社調べ”。整体风格融合了粗犷的赛博朋克末日插画、漫画主视觉图以及在高度渲染的红黑色城市景观上叠加的粗糙白色记号笔涂鸦，大号字体带有裂纹质感，光影电影感强，深度感十足，呈现出高级的商业海报设计感。

templates.title: Gothic Visual Novel Character Lineup

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风视觉小说角色阵容

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy visual novel screenshot in polished anime game art, showing 4 girls standing side by side inside a dim, old-fashioned crimson prison mansion lounge with deep red walls, dark wood paneling, a lit fireplace in the center background, and two warm wall lamps glowing on either side. The composition is a front-facing character lineup cropped around the knees, with ornate black filigree shadows and UI decoration around the frame, a silver crest emblem in the top left, interlocking gear motifs in the top right, and a small rounded "Auto" button in the bottom left. Put a Japanese dialogue subtitle across the lower center reading "——エマとシェリー、ハンナが同席だった。" in white Mincho-style text with a subtle glow. The overall mood is gothic, mysterious, and elegant, like a steampunk-inflected otome or dark academy visual novel. Show exactly 4 female characters. Character 1 on the far left: a blonde young woman in a simple white dress with a brown belt, long yellow gloves, and a royal blue hooded cape draped over her shoulders, holding a tall staff topped with a circular metallic ornament containing a glowing pale blue orb and a dangling red crystal; she has a red jewel set on her forehead and a calm upright posture. Character 2 second from left: a cheerful blue-haired girl with bright orange eyes, short twin-tied or bobbed hair adorned with blue roses and ribbons, wearing a small black hat with lace and bows, a navy-and-white layered outfit with capelet, oversized sleeves, bows, a blue plaid skirt, and a crossbody satchel; she smiles openly and holds a small handheld magnifying glass up near her chest. Character 3 second from right: a soft-looking white-haired girl with a short bob that fades to pink at the tips, pink eyes, a black hair clip and flower accessory, wearing a black-and-white outfit with a vest-like top and voluminous translucent sleeves decorated with pale pink blossoms; she gently holds a pink gem pendant or brooch near her collar and smiles subtly. Character 4 on the far right: an ornate doll-like girl in an elaborate green-and-cream layered dress with lace, bows, petal-like trims, white feathered or wing-like accents near the shoulders, and a lavish bonnet covered in flowers, ribbons, and netting; she holds a white lotus-like flower fan or bouquet in front of her torso. Use detailed anime facial rendering, glossy eyes, refined costume textures, crisp linework, warm rim lighting from the lamps and fireplace, and a slightly vignetted, game-screenshot presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫游戏艺术风格的暗黑奇幻视觉小说截图，展示了 4 位少女并排站在昏暗、复古的深红色监狱豪宅休息室中，背景为深红色墙壁、深色木镶板，中央后方有燃烧的壁炉，两侧有两盏发出暖光的壁灯。构图为膝盖以上的正面角色阵容，画面周围有华丽的黑色花丝阴影和 UI 装饰，左上角有银色徽章，右上角有齿轮交错图案，左下角有一个小的圆形“Auto”按钮。在下方中央添加日语对话字幕，内容为“——エマとシェリー、ハンナが同席だった。”，采用带有微弱光晕的白色明朝体文字。整体氛围哥特、神秘且优雅，类似于带有蒸汽朋克色彩的乙女或暗黑学院风视觉小说。展示 4 位女性角色。最左侧角色 1：一位金发年轻女性，身穿简单的白色连衣裙，系棕色腰带，戴长款黄色手套，肩披宝蓝色连帽斗篷，手持一根高大的法杖，杖顶是一个圆形金属装饰，内嵌发光的淡蓝色宝珠和悬挂的红色水晶；她额头镶嵌着一颗红宝石，姿态沉稳端庄。左二角色 2：一位活泼的蓝发女孩，有着明亮的橙色眼睛，短双马尾或波波头，装饰着蓝色玫瑰和丝带，戴着一顶带有蕾丝和蝴蝶结的小黑帽，身穿海军蓝与白色叠层服装，配有小斗篷、超大袖子、蝴蝶结、蓝色格子裙和斜挎包；她笑容灿烂，胸前拿着一个小型手持放大镜。右二角色 3：一位看起来温柔的白发女孩，短波波头，发梢渐变为粉色，粉色眼睛，戴着黑色发夹和花朵配饰，身穿黑白相间的服装，上身为背心式设计，袖子为蓬松的半透明材质，装饰着淡粉色花朵；她轻轻握着领口附近的粉色宝石吊坠或胸针，面带浅笑。最右侧角色 4：一位精致的玩偶般女孩，身穿华丽的绿米色叠层连衣裙，带有蕾丝、蝴蝶结、花瓣状饰边，肩部有白色羽毛或翅膀状装饰，戴着一顶覆盖着花朵、丝带和网纱的奢华软帽；她胸前拿着一把白莲花状的扇子或花束。使用细腻的动漫面部渲染、明亮的眼睛、精致的服装纹理、清晰的线条、来自灯光和壁炉的温暖轮廓光，以及带有轻微暗角的视觉小说游戏截图呈现效果。

templates.title: Monochrome Anime Horror Film Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 单色动漫恐怖电影海报

templates.prompt: A haunting monochrome Japanese animated movie poster in gritty ink-wash and charcoal style, high contrast black, white, and gray only, with a tall vertical composition. The scene is viewed from inside a dark room toward an open doorway. On the right stands a young boy in silhouette, seen from behind in three-quarter view, with short messy hair, wearing a black-and-white horizontal striped T-shirt, loose dark pants, and sneakers, quietly staring out through the door. The left side shows the open wooden door itself, rough and weathered, with a visible round knob and a vertical line of Japanese text painted on it that reads 「開けたのは、ぼくじゃない」. Beyond the doorway is a surreal towering mountain or jagged monolith, centered in the distance, painted like a hand-drawn ink illustration, with a glowing white zigzag path or crack snaking from the base to a bright opening near the summit. Small floating rock fragments hover around the mountain. At the foot of the mountain, exactly 4 tiny human silhouettes stand together on a dark ridge facing it. The bright doorway light spills into the room and transforms into a long black shadow stretching toward the viewer across the wooden floor; at the end of that shadow is a demonic face shape with exactly 2 white almond-shaped eyes embedded in the darkness. The floorboards and walls are crosshatched and heavily textured, creating an eerie psychological horror atmosphere. Add Japanese festival-style laurels and release copy on the upper right in 3 stacked award blocks with elegant serif typography, plus large release date text reading “8.28 ROADSHOW”. Place the film title huge across the lower middle in distressed white hand-painted letters: “{argument name="film title" default="RAISE"}”, with smaller katakana beneath it reading 「レイズ」. Add a Japanese tagline centered along the bottom above the credits: 「君の『影』が、世界を救う。」 Include dense, tiny Japanese credit lines and a website at the very bottom, styled like a real theatrical poster. Overall mood: ominous, poetic, surreal coming-of-age horror fantasy, indie anime film poster, dramatic negative space, cinematic poster design, unsettling but beautiful.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人毛骨悚然的单色日本动画电影海报，采用粗犷的水墨和炭笔风格，仅使用高对比度的黑、白、灰三色，构图呈高耸的垂直状。场景是从黑暗房间内向外望向敞开的门。右侧站着一名小男孩的剪影，背影呈四分之三侧面，留着凌乱的短发，身穿黑白横条纹 T 恤、宽松深色长裤和运动鞋，正静静地凝视着门外。左侧是敞开的木门，质感粗糙且饱经风霜，门上有明显的圆形把手，并竖排写着日文“開けたのは、ぼくじゃない”。门外是一座超现实的巍峨高山或锯齿状巨石，位于远方中心，如同手绘水墨插画，一条发光的白色之字形路径或裂缝从山脚蜿蜒至山顶附近的明亮开口处。山体周围漂浮着细小的岩石碎片。在山脚下，恰好有 4 个微小的人类剪影站在黑暗的山脊上，面对着高山。明亮的门光洒进房间，在地板上拉出一道延伸向观者的长长黑色阴影；阴影尽头是一个恶魔脸庞，黑暗中嵌入了 2 只白色的杏仁状眼睛。地板和墙壁布满交叉排线和厚重的纹理，营造出一种诡异的心理恐怖氛围。在右上角添加 3 块堆叠的奖项区域，配以优雅的衬线字体，展示日本电影节风格的桂冠和发行文案，并加上醒目的发行日期文本“8.28 ROADSHOW”。在画面中下部以巨大的做旧白色手绘字体横跨电影标题：“{argument name="film title" default="RAISE"}”，下方配以较小的片假名“レイズ”。在底部演职员表上方居中添加日文标语：“君の『影』が、世界を救う。”最底部包含密集的微小日文演职员表和网址，呈现出真实电影海报的质感。整体氛围：不祥、诗意、超现实的成长恐怖奇幻，独立动画电影海报，戏剧性的负空间，电影海报设计，不安而唯美。

templates.title: Anime Mecha Game Launch Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫机甲游戏发布海报

templates.prompt: A highly detailed vertical anime game launch poster in a dreamy post-apocalyptic sci-fi style, painted with cinematic lighting and a cool palette of lavender, indigo, silver, and pale pink. In the foreground, 2 teenage schoolgirls kneel face-to-face in shallow reflective water and rubble, creating an intimate emotional centerpiece. The girl on the left has very long flowing dark violet hair, a navy sailor-style school uniform with a pleated skirt, black knee socks, and a serious, tender expression as she gently touches the other girl's face. The girl on the right has long silver-lilac hair, a damaged white-and-gray school uniform with a dark skirt, and a faint glowing halo-like ring behind her head, suggesting an android or supernatural identity. Their foreheads are close, with wind-blown hair and drifting pink flower petals around them. Behind them towers 1 massive broken humanoid mech, white and gray with scratched armor plates, an exposed inner frame, and a slumped ruined head, half-buried in debris. The background shows 2 heavily damaged building facades overgrown with vegetation, broken windows, and a bright cloudy sky with shafts of light, giving a melancholic yet hopeful mood. Add scattered wreckage in the lower corners, including 2 bent classroom chairs partially visible. Use a polished mobile game key art composition with dramatic depth, glossy reflections, soft bloom, volumetric light, and painterly detail. Include Korean promotional typography integrated into the poster: large vertical headline on the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="세계는 그날의 노래로 무너졌다"}, small English tagline on the upper left reading "The world collapsed in that song", small English text on the upper right reading "HOPE WILL FIND US", a large centered title near the bottom reading {argument name="game title" default="스텔라 소라"} with the romanized subtitle "STELLA SORA", a smaller genre line below reading "학원 × 메카닉 × 백합 서사 RPG", a large release date at the bottom center reading {argument name="release date" default="2025.06.25"}, and "GRAND LAUNCH" beneath it. Along the bottom edge, show 4 platform and brand elements: 1 app icon with an anime girl portrait and a small search bar labeled {argument name="search label" default="스텔라 소라"}, 1 App Store badge, 1 Google Play badge, and 1 Windows badge, plus a small publisher logo and copyright on the lower right for {argument name="publisher name" default="YOSTAR VERSE"}.

templates.title: Cyberpunk Tandem Motorcycle Chase

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克双人摩托追逐

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime-style cyberpunk action illustration of 2 riders on 1 futuristic sport motorcycle, speeding through a modern city highway in daylight after rain. The camera is low and close to the front-left wheel in a dramatic wide-angle perspective, making the huge front tire dominate the foreground while the bike leans hard into a turn. The driver is a young man with messy dark burgundy hair, wearing a black high-tech riding jacket and pants with armored panels, glowing magenta and cyan accent lights, black gloves, and subtle printed markings including the number 07 on the jacket and bike fairing. He is actively riding: both hands firmly gripping the handlebars, body crouched forward, and both feet planted on the foot pegs. Behind him is a tandem passenger, a cheerful young woman with short wavy blonde hair, a small ahoge, and colorful triangular hair clips, wearing an oversized white futuristic jacket with purple and cyan graphic accents, a short black outfit underneath, and sporty sneakers with glowing details. She is seated close behind the driver, holding onto him with 1 arm while leaning with the bike, her expression excited and carefree. Neither rider is wearing a helmet. The motorcycle is a sleek black cyberpunk superbike with angular bodywork, enclosed mechanical components, neon pink and blue light strips, tinted windscreen, visible front disc brake, and stylized decals including 07 and sharp geometric markings. The road surface is wet, with dramatic spray and water splashing outward from the tires, streaking behind the bike. Add heavy motion blur in the background and along the road edges to emphasize extreme speed. The environment is a futuristic urban expressway with guardrails, blurred high-rise buildings, elevated roadway structures, and a bright blue sky with soft clouds. Use crisp, polished anime rendering with high detail, glossy reflections, cinematic lighting, speed-line energy, and a vivid palette of black, magenta, cyan, white, and steel gray.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫风格赛博朋克动作插画，描绘了 2 名骑手驾驶 1 辆未来感运动摩托车，在雨后白天的现代城市高速公路上疾驰。镜头位置较低，靠近左前轮，采用戏剧性的广角透视，巨大的前轮占据前景，摩托车正大幅度倾斜过弯。驾驶者是一名年轻男子，留着凌乱的深酒红色头发，身穿黑色高科技骑行夹克和带有装甲板的裤子，点缀着洋红色和青色的发光灯带，佩戴黑色手套，夹克和车身上有微妙的印花标记，包括数字 07。他正在专注驾驶：双手紧握车把，身体前倾，双脚稳稳踩在脚踏上。他身后是一名双人乘客，一位开朗的年轻女性，留着短波浪金发，头顶有一撮呆毛，戴着彩色三角形发夹，身穿超大号白色未来感夹克，配有紫色和青色图形装饰，内搭黑色短装，脚蹬带有发光细节的运动鞋。她紧贴在驾驶者身后，一只手搂着对方，随车身倾斜，表情兴奋且无忧无虑。两名骑手均未佩戴头盔。摩托车是一辆流线型黑色赛博朋克超级摩托车，车身线条硬朗，机械结构封闭，配有霓虹粉色和蓝色灯带、深色挡风玻璃、清晰可见的前盘式制动器，以及包括 07 和锋利几何图形在内的时尚贴纸。路面湿滑，轮胎溅起剧烈的水花，在车后拉出长长的水雾。背景和路缘添加强烈的动态模糊，以强调极速感。环境是未来派城市高速公路，配有护栏、模糊的高层建筑、高架道路结构，以及带有柔和云朵的明亮蓝天。采用清晰、精致的动漫渲染，细节丰富，具有光泽反射、电影级光效、速度线能量感，以及黑色、洋红色、青色、白色和钢灰色的生动配色。

templates.title: Anime Sci-Fi Game Launch Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫科幻游戏发布海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime mobile game advertisement poster set in a ruined sci-fi city at dusk. In the foreground, show 2 teenage schoolgirls inside the broken cockpit of a crashed futuristic vehicle: one girl has long straight black hair and kneels on the left, the other has short blue bobbed hair with a small flower hairpin and sits on the right. They are embracing tightly with frightened, vulnerable expressions, holding hands at the center of the image. Both wear torn Japanese sailor school uniforms with white tops, navy collars, red neckerchiefs, and blue pleated skirts; add visible bandages, scrapes, and dirt on their arms and legs. The cockpit around them is heavily damaged, with exposed wiring, glowing orange and cyan control panels, torn metal, and a partially open canopy framing the pair. In the midground and background, depict a devastated urban battlefield with collapsed buildings, smoke, sparks, rubble, and scattered fires. In the sky, paint a huge swirling blue-white vortex or portal in the upper right, sending down a bright beam of light; add flying debris and a few meteor-like streaks crossing stormy clouds. Use highly polished anime key art styling, cinematic lighting, rich blue and orange contrast, glossy rendering, detailed mechanical textures, emotional storytelling, and a premium Korean gacha game promotional feel. Overlay bold Korean ad text integrated into the composition: at the top, large headline '{argument name="headline text" default="글로벌 런칭"}' with a smaller subtitle below '{argument name="top subtitle" default="지금 다운로드 가능"}'; near the bottom center, a large ornate fantasy title '{argument name="game title" default="하늘의 연가"}' with a smaller subtitle beneath '{argument name="game subtitle" default="세카이의 끝"}'; below that, another bold call to action '{argument name="bottom call to action" default="지금 다운로드 가능"}'. Add a small rounded tag line at the very bottom reading '세카이 계 · 학원물 · 메카닉 · GL'. Make it look like an official app install poster, ultra-detailed, high contrast, emotional, dynamic, and optimized for a smartphone portrait ad.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版动漫手游广告海报，背景设定在黄昏时分废墟般的科幻城市中。前景展示 2 名少女学生坐在坠毁的未来载具破损驾驶舱内：左侧女孩留着黑色长直发，正跪在地上；右侧女孩留着蓝色短波波头，戴着一个小花发夹。她们紧紧相拥，表情惊恐而脆弱，双手在画面中心紧握。两人都穿着破损的日本水手校服，包括白色上衣、海军蓝领子、红色领巾和蓝色百褶裙；手臂和腿部可见明显的绷带、擦伤和污垢。周围的驾驶舱损毁严重，露出电线、发光的橙色和青色控制面板、撕裂的金属，半开的舱盖将两人框在其中。中景和背景描绘了一个荒凉的城市战场，有倒塌的建筑、烟雾、火花、瓦砾和零星的火光。天空中，在右上角绘制一个巨大的蓝白色漩涡或传送门，投射下一道明亮的光束；添加飞舞的碎片和几道划过风暴云层的流星状轨迹。采用高质感的动漫主视觉风格，电影级光影，丰富的蓝橙对比，光泽渲染，细腻的机械纹理，情感叙事，以及高级韩国抽卡手游的宣传感。在构图中叠加醒目的韩文广告文字：顶部是大标题“{argument name="headline text" default="글로벌 런칭"}”，下方是较小的副标题“{argument name="top subtitle" default="지금 다운로드 가능"}”；底部中心附近是一个华丽的大型幻想标题“{argument name="game title" default="하늘의 연가"}”，下方是较小的副标题“{argument name="game subtitle" default="세카이의 끝"}”；再下方是另一个醒目的行动号召语“{argument name="bottom call to action" default="지금 다운로드 가능"}”。在最底部添加一个圆角小标签，写着“세카이 계 · 학원물 · 메카닉 · GL”。使其看起来像一张官方应用安装海报，超精细、高对比度、富有情感、充满动态，并针对智能手机竖屏广告进行了优化。

templates.title: 2D Floor Plan to 3D Real Estate Render

titleLocalized.zh: 将 2D 平面图转换为 3D 房地产效果图

templates.prompt: Using the provided floor plan reference image, convert the 2D black-and-white architectural plan into a clean photorealistic 3D isometric real-estate floor plan render while preserving the original layout, room sizes, labels, and the side-by-side composition of the 1F and 2F plans. Add realistic wall thickness, light wood flooring, soft neutral wall colors, doors and windows with depth, and fully furnished interiors appropriate to each room. Keep all visible Japanese room labels in place, including 1F, 2F, 洗面所, 浴室, 収納, 階段下収納, ホール, 玄関, トイレ, L.D.K (18.0帖), 洋室 (6.0帖) for 2 rooms, ウォークインクローゼット (3.0帖), and 主寝室 (6.0帖). Stage the 1F with 1 kitchen, 1 dining table set for 4, 1 living area with sofa and coffee table, 1 toilet, 1 bathroom with tub, 1 wash area, and small plants. Stage the 2F with 3 sleeping/work rooms total: 1 bedroom with a single bed, 1 room with a desk and chair, and 1 master bedroom with a double bed, plus 2 storage spaces and 1 walk-in closet with shelving. Use a bright catalog-style presentation on a plain light background, viewed from a slightly elevated angled top-down perspective, suitable for a property sales brochure.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的平面图参考图像，将 2D 黑白建筑平面图转换为清晰、逼真的 3D 等轴测房地产平面效果图，同时保留原始布局、房间尺寸、标签以及 1F 和 2F 平面图的并排构图。添加逼真的墙壁厚度、浅色木地板、柔和的中性墙面色彩、具有深度的门窗，以及与各房间功能相符的精美室内陈设。保留所有可见的日语房间标签，包括 1F、2F、洗面所、浴室、収納、階段下収納、ホール、玄関、トイレ、L.D.K (18.0帖)、2 间洋室 (6.0帖)、ウォークインクローゼット (3.0帖) 以及 主寝室 (6.0帖)。1F 布局包括：1 个厨房、1 套 4 人餐桌椅、1 个带沙发和咖啡桌的起居区、1 个卫生间、1 个带浴缸的浴室、1 个洗面区及少量绿植。2F 布局共包含 3 个卧室/工作间：1 间带单人床的卧室、1 间带书桌椅的房间、1 间带双人床的主卧，以及 2 个储物空间和 1 个带货架的步入式衣帽间。采用明亮的目录式呈现风格，背景简洁，视角为略微抬高的斜顶视图，非常适合用于房产销售手册。

templates.title: Anime Now Playing School Route Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格“正在播放”校园路线海报

templates.prompt: A clean, graphic anime illustration poster in a modern Japanese pop-design style, showing a handsome high school boy commuting home while listening to music. The composition is split into 3 tall vertical panels with slightly angled borders, each panel showing the same boy from a different side profile or three-quarter side view as if walking through the same suburban route. He has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short spiky hair, fair skin, a calm cool expression, wired earphones, and wears a white short-sleeve school shirt tucked into light blue-gray slacks with a belt. A semi-transparent crossbody bag with visible contents hangs at his side, and one hand is in his pocket in each pose. His face area is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur block in all 3 panels. The background is a bright summer after-school street scene in Japan with blue sky, white clouds, utility poles and power lines, chain-link fencing, green trees, a school building, a roadside path, and a railroad crossing signal. Use crisp line art, flat cel shading, pale blue and mint-green tones with black accents and small orange safety details. Overlay the whole image with stylish magazine-like typography, graphic stripes, dots, arrows, and signage. At the center, place a bold white rectangular sign with black border reading {argument name="center text" default="now plyaing"}, with a left arrow on the left and a right arrow on the right. Include visible English and Japanese text elements placed around the layout: top left "AFTER SCHOOL ROUTE", left vertical sign "帰り道→", upper middle text "LIKE THE SONG, LIKE MYSELF.", right vertical text "007 :::", right-side vertical sign "踏切注意→", bottom left "MUSIC IS MY ESCAPE", bottom right "KEEP THE BEAT GOING.", and bottom border text "EVERY DAY. DIFFERENT SOUNDTRACK." Add 4 small color dots at the lower right, 4 small rectangular color swatches at the lower left, and decorative black striping in multiple corners. The overall feel is stylish, youthful, urban, refreshing, and slightly editorial, like a playlist cover or social-media music post.

DIFFERENT SOUNDTRACK.”。在右下角添加 4 个小色点，左下角添加 4 个小矩形色块，并在多个角落添加装饰性黑色条纹。整体感觉时尚、青春、都市、清新且具有编辑感，如同播放列表封面或社交媒体音乐帖子。

templates.title: Anime Lo-Fi Now Playing Schoolboys

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 Lo-Fi “正在播放”：男学生

templates.prompt: A stylish anime-inspired lo-fi music visual showing 3 teenage schoolboys walking outdoors on a quiet suburban Japanese street in late afternoon, arranged side by side across the frame with slight pose variation. Each boy has messy short black hair, a faceless dark silhouette treatment with a soft rectangular blur over the face area, white wired earphones, a white long-sleeve school shirt, black trousers, and a black backpack with visible shoulder straps. The left boy faces left in side profile, the center boy faces slightly left with his torso angled forward, and the right boy faces right in side profile, creating a mirrored triptych composition. Place a bold futuristic black UI banner across the center foreground with glowing edge accents and the text {argument name="headline text" default="now p|yaing"} in lowercase white techno typography, intentionally misspelled. Set the scene on a Japanese residential road with utility poles, dense overhead power lines, sidewalk railings, low buildings, trees, and a vertical school-zone style sign on the left that reads 下校中. Use a flat graphic cel-shaded aesthetic with strong black silhouettes, pale sky blue, muted teal, cream, and warm orange accents, including an orange sun in the upper left. Add small decorative graphic elements for a music-player poster feel: dotted grids in 3 places, tiny square markers, short horizontal bars, angular scribble strokes, and minimal HUD-like corner accents. The mood is cool, urban, reflective, and trendy, like cover art for a lo-fi playlist or now-playing social media post.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张时尚的动漫风格 Lo-Fi 音乐视觉图，展示了 3 名少年在傍晚宁静的日本郊区街道上行走，三人并排分布在画面中，姿态略有不同。每位男孩都留着凌乱的黑色短发，采用无面部深色剪影处理，面部区域带有柔和的矩形模糊效果，佩戴白色有线耳机，身穿白色长袖校服衬衫，搭配黑色长裤和带有明显肩带的黑色书包。左侧男孩侧身向左，中间男孩身体微向左倾，右侧男孩侧身向右，形成镜像般的三联画构图。在画面中心前景处放置一个醒目的未来感黑色 UI 横幅，带有发光的边缘装饰，并显示小写白色科技风字体文本 {argument name="headline text" default="now p|yaing"}，故意拼写错误。场景设定在日本住宅区道路，背景包含电线杆、密集的架空电线、人行道护栏、低矮建筑、树木，以及左侧一个写有“下校中”的垂直学校区域标志。采用扁平化图形赛璐珞风格，强调强烈的黑色剪影，色调包含淡天蓝色、柔和的青色、奶油色和温暖的橙色，左上角有一轮橙色太阳。添加小型装饰性图形元素以营造音乐播放器海报感：3 处点阵网格、微小的方形标记、短横条、棱角分明的涂鸦笔触以及极简的 HUD 风格边角装饰。整体氛围酷炫、都市、沉思且潮流，如同 Lo-Fi 歌单封面或社交媒体“正在播放”帖子的配图。

templates.title: Anime Now Playing School Street Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格“正在播放”校园街道海报

templates.prompt: A stylized anime poster of three handsome high school boys wearing white button-up school shirts and black shoulder bags, arranged across a single urban street scene like a music-player cover. The composition shows exactly 3 figures: one on the left in side profile facing left with his eyes obscured by a black censor bar, one in the center turning back toward the viewer with a black backpack and a direct calm gaze, and one on the right in side profile facing right with his chin tilted up. All three have short messy black hair, dark silhouette-like faces and bodies with thin white line details, and small wired earphones in their ears. The setting is a bright suburban school-route street under a pale blue sky, with utility poles and overhead cables, a green roadside sign reading {argument name="street sign text" default="SCHOOL ROUTE"}, fences and trees on the left, and a light green school building on the right. Use a cool pastel palette of sky blue, mint green, pale teal, black, white, and orange accents. Overlay the scene with futuristic graphic-design UI elements: black border panels, dots, stripes, small crosses, playback icons, grid fragments, and decorative techno shapes around all edges. At the top left include a digital timer reading {argument name="timer text" default="00:00:00"}. At the bottom, add a large bold italic techno title reading {argument name="main title text" default="now plyaing"}, intentionally misspelled, stretched across a wide mint-green-and-orange arrow banner with a small play icon beneath it. Give the whole image the look of a sleek lo-fi music visual, anime street fashion poster, and futuristic album-cover graphic, with crisp line art, flat shaded silhouettes, layered transparency effects on the shirts, and a clean high-contrast layout in a 4:3 format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格化的动漫海报，画面中三位帅气的男高中生身穿白色衬衫，背着黑色单肩包，如同音乐播放器封面一般排列在城市街道场景中。构图包含 3 个人物：左侧人物侧身向左，双眼被黑色遮挡条覆盖；中间人物转身面向观众，背着黑色背包，眼神冷静直视前方；右侧人物侧身向右，下巴微抬。三人均留着凌乱的黑色短发，面部和身体呈现出深色剪影效果，并带有白色细线条细节，耳朵上戴着小型有线耳机。背景为明亮的郊区上学路，天空呈淡蓝色，配有电线杆和架空电缆，左侧有绿色路牌，文字为 {argument name="street sign text" default="SCHOOL ROUTE"}，以及围栏和树木，右侧为浅绿色校舍。采用由天蓝、薄荷绿、淡青色、黑色、白色及橙色点缀组成的冷色调柔和配色。画面叠加未来感图形设计 UI 元素：黑色边框面板、圆点、条纹、小十字、播放图标、网格碎片以及环绕四周的装饰性科技感形状。左上角包含一个数字计时器，显示为 {argument name="timer text" default="00:00:00"}。底部添加一个醒目的粗体斜体科技感标题，文字为 {argument name="main title text" default="now plyaing"}（故意拼写错误），横跨在一个宽大的薄荷绿与橙色相间的箭头横幅上，下方配有一个小型播放图标。整体画面呈现出精致的 lo-fi 音乐视觉效果、动漫街头时尚海报及未来感专辑封面风格，线条清晰，采用平涂阴影剪影，衬衫具有层叠透明效果，整体布局简洁且对比度高，比例为 4:3。

The background is a sunlit residential school-route road with utility poles, dense overhead power lines, chain-link fences, trees, sidewalk shadows, and a visible Japanese street sign reading 通学路 and 学園前駅方面. Use a clean cool palette of light blue, gray, black, white, and muted green, accented with bright orange geometric blocks. Frame the image as a graphic design composition with dense UI-like overlays, including a large bottom banner reading {argument name="headline text" default="now playing"}, a large right-side time display reading {argument name="time" default="17 45"}, a top-left label reading AFTER SCHOOL ROUTE / 17:45, a left vertical track list labeled TRACK with 5 numbered entries 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 and 02 highlighted, a top-right phrase reading KEEP THE MUSIC GOING., and a bottom-right black panel reading GOOD VIBES ONLY. Add barcode-like stripes, arrows, chevrons, dotted grids, thin technical lines, cropped corner borders, and layered translucent panels for a modern posterized techno-aesthetic. Make it feel like an ikemen anime playlist cover, calm, urban, fashionable, and cinematic.

templates.title: Chaotic Holiday at Home Manga Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 居家假期混乱漫画场景

templates.prompt: A dramatic manga-style action illustration of a chaotic family apartment during a long holiday at home, shown in a wide cinematic interior shot with exaggerated perspective and motion lines. In the foreground right, a tired adult man in a wrinkled white T-shirt and dark pants slumps over a mop handle, head bowed on his arm, looking physically and emotionally exhausted. In the midground left, 1 wild child is captured midair launching off a torn sofa, wearing a loose red shirt and shorts, arms spread wide like a reckless dive, with explosive speed lines radiating behind him. In the center, 1 second child in a blue T-shirt and dark shorts runs forward through the wreckage with one fist raised, full of chaotic energy. In the background right, 1 adult woman with dark hair tied in a messy bun cooks frantically at the stove in an apron, surrounded by steam, splashing food, and towering stacks of dirty bowls and pots. The room is in total disarray: 1 damaged sofa with stuffing flying out, 1 television with a cracked screen, 1 toppled small table, 1 blue mop bucket, scattered trash, broken glass, papers, toys, food debris, and smeared mess all across the wooden floor. A sliding glass door or window in the back is visibly cracked, adding to the sense of destruction. Use gritty inked linework, rough painterly shading, desaturated browns and grays with muted reds and blues, highly detailed clutter, dynamic anatomy, and intense comic-book energy. The mood should contrast the idea of wanting to relax at home with the reality of nonstop domestic chaos, like an over-the-top Japanese manga cover about family exhaustion during vacation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的漫画风格动作插画，描绘了长假期间居家时混乱的家庭公寓，采用宽幅电影感室内镜头，呈现夸张的透视效果和动态线条。右侧前景中，一名身穿皱巴巴白色 T 恤和深色长裤的疲惫成年男子瘫倒在拖把柄上，头埋在手臂里，看起来身心俱疲。左侧中景中，1 个野孩子正从破损的沙发上腾空跃起，身穿宽松的红色衬衫和短裤，双臂张开如同鲁莽的跳水，身后放射出爆炸性的速度线。中心位置，1 个身穿蓝色 T 恤和深色短裤的孩子正挥舞着拳头穿过残骸向前奔跑，充满混乱的能量。右侧背景中，1 名扎着凌乱发髻的深色头发成年女性正系着围裙在炉灶前疯狂烹饪，周围环绕着蒸汽、飞溅的食物以及堆积如山的脏碗和锅具。房间里一片狼藉：1 个填充物飞出的破损沙发、1 台屏幕破裂的电视、1 张倒塌的小桌子、1 个蓝色拖把桶，木地板上散落着垃圾、碎玻璃、纸张、玩具、食物残渣和污渍。后方的推拉门或窗户明显破裂，增加了破坏感。采用粗犷的墨线勾勒、粗糙的绘画阴影、低饱和度的棕色和灰色，搭配柔和的红色和蓝色，呈现高度细节化的杂乱感、动态的人体结构和强烈的漫画书能量。画面氛围旨在对比“居家放松”的愿望与“不间断家庭混乱”的现实，如同封面夸张的日本漫画，讲述假期期间的家庭疲惫感。

Use soft beauty lighting, realistic skin, commercial headshot polish, and flattering fashion-photography retouching. Keep the crop chest-up and consistent across all 9 images. Arrange the portraits as a clean 3x3 grid with the following visible mood variation: gentle smile, bright open smile, calm neutral, soft laugh, thoughtful side glance, confident smirk, surprised delight, eyes-closed happy smile, and slightly pouty cute expression. {argument name=\"background color\" default=\"light gray\"} seamless studio background. Make it look like a professional talent promo sheet or social-media profile photo set."}

templates.title: Nine-Panel Rainbow Hair Portrait Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 九宫格彩虹发色肖像展示页

templates.prompt: A 3x3 contact-sheet style studio portrait collage with exactly 9 square panels arranged in a clean grid, each panel numbered in black serif numerals from 1 to 9 near the upper left corner. The same woman appears in every panel against a soft light gray seamless studio background, wearing a loose white button-up shirt with natural folds and a casual editorial look. She has long, smooth, slightly wavy hair rendered in vivid neon rainbow gradients, with hot red and orange at the crown transitioning through yellow, lime, cyan, blue, and violet toward the lengths and ends, creating a luminous iridescent effect. The face in every panel is obscured by a centered square mosaic blur block in skin-tone colors, covering the full face area while leaving hair, neck, hands, and clothing visible. Use soft, even beauty lighting, polished commercial photography, high detail, realistic skin and fabric, and a modern promotional headshot aesthetic. The 9 poses are: panel 1, facing front with both hands cupping the cheeks; panel 2, turned slightly left in three-quarter view with one hand lightly touching the neck/collarbone; panel 3, angled right with one arm raised and hand touching the back of the head; panel 4, leaning forward slightly with one hand lifted beside the face, fingers spread in a playful claw-like gesture; panel 5, resting head sideways on folded arms on a white surface, relaxed and dreamy; panel 6, front-facing with one hand supporting the chin or cheek in a thoughtful pose; panel 7, close crop from the left side with one hand lifted near the ear or hair; panel 8, front-facing with one index finger pointing to the cheek; panel 9, right three-quarter view with both hands together near the face as if softly clapping or posing delicately. Keep framing varied but consistent, mostly bust or half-body crops, with the rainbow hair as the central visual feature. Make it look like a nine-variation publicity photo sheet for {argument name="subject type" default="a young woman"}, wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="white button-up shirt"}, with {argument name="hair color" default="neon rainbow gradient hair"}, on a {argument name="background color" default="light gray studio background"}, in a {argument name="photo style" default="clean commercial beauty portrait"} style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 3x3 联络样张风格的工作室肖像拼贴图，包含 9 个排列整齐的方形面板，每个面板左上角附近均有黑色衬线数字 1 到 9 编号。同一位女性出现在每个面板中，背景为柔和的浅灰色无缝工作室背景，身穿带有自然褶皱的宽松白色衬衫，呈现出随性的编辑风格。她留着长而顺滑、微卷的头发，呈现出鲜艳的霓虹彩虹渐变色，从头顶的亮红和橙色过渡到发梢的黄、青柠、青、蓝和紫罗兰色，营造出明亮的虹彩效果。每个面板中的面部都被一个位于中央的肤色马赛克模糊块遮挡，覆盖了整个面部区域，同时露出头发、脖子、手部和衣服。使用柔和均匀的美容布光，精致的商业摄影效果，高细节，逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，以及现代宣传头像的美学风格。9 种姿势分别为：面板 1，正面面对镜头，双手托腮；面板 2，向左微转呈四分之三侧面，一只手轻触脖子/锁骨；面板 3，向右倾斜，一只手臂抬起，手触碰后脑勺；面板 4，身体微前倾，一只手抬至脸旁，手指张开呈俏皮的爪状；面板 5，头部侧向靠在折叠的手臂上，置于白色表面，姿态放松且梦幻；面板 6，正面面对镜头，一只手托住下巴或脸颊，呈思考状；面板 7，左侧近景，一只手抬至耳边或发间；面板 8，正面面对镜头，一只食指指向脸颊；面板 9，右侧四分之三侧面，双手合拢靠近脸部，仿佛在轻拍或优雅地摆姿势。保持构图多样但统一，多为胸像或半身像，以彩虹发色为核心视觉特征。将其制作成一张包含 9 种变化的宣传照，主体为 {argument name="subject type" default="一位年轻女性"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="白色衬衫"}，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="霓虹彩虹渐变发色"}，背景为 {argument name="background color" default="浅灰色工作室背景"}，风格为 {argument name="photo style" default="干净的商业美容肖像"}。

templates.title: Anime Mahjong Loss Consolation Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫麻将落败安慰场景

templates.prompt: A warm, cozy anime-style illustration set inside a traditional Japanese mahjong parlor with polished wood walls, shoji-style windows, bookshelves, framed calligraphy, bottles, flowers, and soft amber ceiling lights. In the center foreground, a sad teenage boy with messy dark navy-black hair and tired eyes sits hunched on a chair, wearing a loose dark indigo hoodie and black pants, holding a ranking sheet close to his chest. The sheet prominently reads "11位" at the top, with a vertical list of placements beneath it and the bottom line reading "11位 神代トウマ". He looks embarrassed and defeated, with small sweat drops on his face and 4 vertical blue stress marks above his head. Behind him stands a cheerful young woman with wavy medium-length chestnut-brown hair, a white flower hairpin, and a cream ribbed sweater, smiling warmly and placing one hand on his shoulder. She wears a name tag that reads "雀和ソリ". Her speech bubble says "トウマくん、ドンマイだよ〜！ 次はきっとツイてるよ♡". To the left sits 1 young man with short dark hair in a white shirt, leaning in with one hand near his face, speaking supportively; his speech bubble says "内容は悪くなかったよ。 オーラスの押し引きもよかったし。". To the right sits 1 young woman in a dark blazer over a white shirt, with neat brown hair tied back, gently touching the central boy’s shoulder and speaking calmly; her speech bubble says "結果より内容が大事よ。 焦らず一歩ずつ進んでいきましょう。". Add 1 small muttering bubble near the central boy that says "うっ…". In the upper left, include a hanging wooden sign decorated with cherry blossoms that reads "雀和荘 ようこそ！". In the upper right, place 1 framed scoreboard on the wall titled "本日の麻雀結果" listing 4 ranking lines for 1位, 2位, 3位, 4位 as dotted blanks, and a final line reading "11位 神代トウマ". In the foreground, show 1 green mahjong table with visible rows of mahjong tiles, including a standing tile labeled "中", a small wooden marker labeled "ドラ", and 1 ceramic cup printed with "雀和荘". On the right front corner, add a small snack setup with 3 boxed sweets or candy packages, 1 bowl of snacks, and 1 small potted plant. Use a soft painterly anime aesthetic, detailed fabric folds, expressive eyes, rich warm lighting, gentle emotional contrast between encouragement and disappointment, and a polished visual-novel illustration feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨舒适的动漫风格插画，背景设定在传统的日式麻将馆内，配有抛光木墙、障子风格窗户、书架、装裱的书法作品、瓶子、花卉以及柔和的琥珀色吸顶灯。画面中央前景处，一名神情沮丧的少年坐在椅子上，留着凌乱的深藏青色头发，眼神疲惫，身穿宽松的深靛蓝色连帽衫和黑色长裤，将一张排名表紧紧抱在胸前。表格顶部醒目地写着“11位”，下方是垂直排列的排名列表，最底行写着“11位 神代トウマ”。他看起来既尴尬又沮丧，脸上带着几滴汗珠，头顶上方有 4 个垂直的蓝色压力符号。他身后站着一位开朗的年轻女性，留着中等长度的栗棕色波浪卷发，别着白色花朵发夹，身穿米色罗纹毛衣，正微笑着温柔地将一只手搭在他的肩膀上。她佩戴的姓名牌上写着“雀和ソリ”。她的对话气泡写着“トウマくん、ドンマイだよ〜！ 次はきっとツイてるよ♡”。左侧坐着一名留着深色短发的年轻男子，身穿白衬衫，身体前倾，一只手靠近脸部，正在给予支持；他的对话气泡写着“内容は悪くなかったよ。 オーラスの押し引きもよかったし。”。右侧坐着一名身穿深色西装外套内搭白衬衫的年轻女性，留着整洁的棕色束发，正轻轻触碰中央少年的肩膀，语气平静地说道；她的对话气泡写着“結果より内容が大事よ。 焦らず一歩ずつ進んでいきましょう。”。在中央少年附近添加一个小小的嘀咕气泡，写着“うっ…”。左上角悬挂着一块装饰有樱花的木牌，上面写着“雀和荘 ようこそ！”。右上角的墙上挂着一块装裱的记分牌，标题为“本日の麻雀結果”，列出了 1 位、2 位、3 位、4 位的 4 行虚线空白，最后一行写着“11位 神代トウマ”。前景展示了一张绿色麻将桌，桌上可见成排的麻将牌，包括一张立着的“中”牌、一个标有“ドラ”的小木牌，以及一个印有“雀和荘”字样的陶瓷杯。右前角放置着一个小零食区，摆放着 3 盒甜点或糖果包装、一碗零食和一盆小盆栽。采用柔和的绘画风动漫美学，注重细腻的布料褶皱、富有表现力的眼睛、浓郁的暖色调光影，营造出鼓励与失落之间的柔和情感对比，呈现出精致的视觉小说插画质感。

templates.title: Football Signing Announcement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 足球签约官宣海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical football club signing announcement poster in a hyper-realistic sports marketing style, 4:5 portrait composition, dominated by intense red and dark green lighting. Center a young Black male footballer from chest-up, standing straight and facing forward, wearing a half-red half-dark-green jersey with subtle camouflage texture, gold trim details, a small gold manufacturer mark on the right chest, and the Canon Sportif de Yaounde crest on the left chest. The player’s face is intentionally obscured by a large soft-edged rectangular blur block, while his ears, neck, hairline, and jersey remain sharply visible. Behind him, place a large Canon Sportif de Yaounde shield logo on the upper left with exactly 4 gold stars above it, and a smaller club crest centered near the top. Across the very top, add spaced uppercase white text reading {argument name="top slogan" default="COMMANDEUR DE L'ORDRE DE LA VALEUR"}. Build a fiery textured red background with smoke, glowing particles, layered stadium atmosphere, and a faint old cannon illustration on the upper right. On the mid-right background, add translucent text reading "SINCE 1930". Over the player’s torso, create the main headline typography in 4 stacked text lines: a gold handwritten script first name {argument name="first name" default="Christian"}, a huge distressed white surname {argument name="last name" default="KOFANE"}, a smaller white uppercase line "SIGNE AU", and a massive bold red uppercase line "CANON", followed by a smaller white uppercase line "SPORTIF DE YAOUNDE". At the bottom foreground, show exactly 3 supporting objects: 1 folded club jersey on the lower left corner, 1 football with club branding on the lower right corner, and 1 printed contract document centered near the bottom on a wooden table with a black-and-gold pen resting diagonally across it; the visible contract title should read "CONTRAT DE PERFORMANCE" and the signature area should show {argument name="signature name" default="Kofanee"}. Add a row of exactly 4 small social media icons on the bottom left followed by the handle {argument name="social handle" default="@CANONSPORTIFOFFICIEL"}. Along the very bottom center, add spaced uppercase white text reading "UN NOUVEAU CHAPITRE COMMENCE" with a small "1930" beneath it. Use cinematic contrast, glossy sports-poster retouching, sharp jersey fabric detail, dramatic rim light, bold editorial typography, and elite African football club announcement aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具张力的竖版足球转会官宣海报，采用高端体育平面设计风格。画面中心为一名半身男性足球运动员，身材健硕，深色皮肤，留着黑色短寸，正面站立，面部模糊或遮挡。他身穿红绿拼接的足球衫，带有微妙的迷彩纹理，左胸处印有金色制造商标志，右胸处印有 Canon Sportif de Yaounde 队徽。背景采用深红色调，营造烟雾缭绕的氛围，配以发光高光、层叠纹理以及隐约的球场或工业元素。在球员身后，左上方放置一个巨大的 Canon Sportif de Yaounde 队徽，上方带有 4 颗金星；右上方放置一个模糊的复古大炮图形，并将“SINCE 1930”字样融入背景中。在海报最上方，添加间距均匀的大写文字“COMMANDEUR DE L’ORDRE DE LA VALEUR”，并在其下方居中放置一个小队徽，队徽上方同样带有 4 颗金星。在球员躯干位置，采用醒目的排版层级：金色手写体名字“Christian”，下方是巨大的做旧白色大写姓氏“KOFANE”，再下方是较小的白色大写文字“SIGNE AU”，接着是超大的红色大写文字“CANON”，最后是较小的白色大写文字“SPORTIF DE YAOUNDE”。在底部前景的桌面上，摆放 3 件支撑物：左下方是一件折叠的红绿配色俱乐部球衣，露出队徽；右下方是一个配色相符的红绿足球，露出队徽；底部中央是一份写有“CONTRAT DE PERFORMANCE”的合同文件，并带有醒目的手写签名。在文件旁斜放一支精致的黑金钢笔。左下方包含社交媒体页脚，带有 4 个白色小圆图标，后接账号“@CANONSPORTIFOFFICIEL”。底部中央添加间距均匀的大写文字“UN NOUVEAU CHAPITRE COMMENCE”，下方以彩色小数字标注年份“1930”。整体视觉效果应呈现出电影质感、光泽感、强烈的冲击力与庆祝氛围，展现专业足球俱乐部的官宣艺术，具备高对比度、戏剧性的红色灯光、逼真的织物纹理、层叠的烟雾以及高级的海报构图。

templates.title: Muscle Lobster Spinach Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 肌肉龙虾菠菜漫画

templates.prompt: A vintage single-panel comic illustration in a mid-century newspaper-cartoon style, showing an anthropomorphic red lobster standing on a wooden dock by the sea and posing like a bodybuilder. The lobster is the only character and fills most of the frame, facing slightly left with an angry, proud expression, narrowed eyes, long curved antennae, whisker-like mouth feelers, huge exaggerated claws, an enormous hyper-muscular torso, oversized biceps, thick chest, and a sharply defined six-pack and obliques. One claw is raised in a flexing pose near a large speech bubble. The speech bubble in the upper left contains exactly this hand-lettered text in bold black comic lettering: “I YAM WHAT I YAM! and I YAM RIPPED!” with “RIPPED!” emphasized larger and underlined. At the lobster’s feet, slightly left of center, place 1 opened can labeled “SPINACH” with green spinach visible inside and the lid peeled back. The dock includes 1 wooden mooring post wrapped with rope on the far left. In the background, show calm blue water, a bright blue sky, and 4 fluffy white clouds spread across the top area. On the far right background across the water, include 1 small cannery or factory building on pilings with a sign reading “SPINACH” and 2 smokestacks, one releasing a puff of gray smoke. Render it with flat comic colors, bold black outlines, slightly aged paper texture, light ink imperfections, and a humorous parody tone reminiscent of 1930s–1950s Popeye-era animation art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅中世纪报纸卡通风格的复古单格漫画插图，画面中一只拟人化的红龙虾站在海边的木码头上，摆出健美运动员的姿势。龙虾是画面中的唯一角色，占据了大部分构图，身体略微朝左，表情愤怒而自豪，眯着眼睛，长着弯曲的触角和胡须状的口器，拥有夸张的巨型钳子、极其发达的肌肉躯干、超大的二头肌、厚实的胸肌以及轮廓分明的六块腹肌和侧腹肌。一只钳子举起，在气泡旁摆出展示肌肉的姿势。左上方的气泡内包含完全一致的手写体粗体黑色漫画文字：“I YAM WHAT I YAM! and I YAM RIPPED!”，其中“RIPPED!”字样经过放大并加了下划线。在龙虾脚下偏左的位置，放置 1 个打开的罐头，标签上写着“SPINACH”，可以看到里面绿色的菠菜，盖子被掀开。码头最左侧有 1 根缠绕着绳索的木制系船柱。背景展示平静的蓝色海水、明亮的蓝天，以及分布在顶部区域的 4 朵蓬松的白云。在背景最右侧的海面上，包含 1 座建在桩基上的小型罐头厂或工厂建筑，上面挂着写有“SPINACH”的招牌，并有 2 根烟囱，其中一根冒出一缕灰烟。采用平涂漫画色彩、粗黑轮廓线、略显陈旧的纸张纹理、轻微的墨水瑕疵进行渲染，呈现出 1930 年代至 1950 年代《大力水手》时代动画艺术风格的幽默恶搞基调。

templates.title: Futuristic Corporate Plaza With Data Billboards

titleLocalized.zh: 充满数据项目展示的未来企业广场

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic near-future corporate city plaza in the morning after rain, viewed at street level in a wide cinematic composition. The scene shows a dense crowd of exactly 6 prominent foreground office workers and dozens more midground pedestrians, mostly East Asian businesspeople in dark suits and beige trench coats, commuting through a polished black stone plaza with wet reflective surfaces and strips of tactile paving. The atmosphere is sleek, orderly, and slightly dystopian-utopian, with bright daylight, soft blue sky, and towering glass-and-steel skyscrapers enclosing the space. Massive vertical digital billboards dominate the architecture: one on the left shows a seated person with the visible text “WELLNESS 83%” and “SLEEP 4.2h”; one in the center shows the visible text “CITY HARMONY INDEX 47/100” with a minimalist graph beneath; one on the right wall is a clean poster reading “A BETTER TOMORROW” with smaller text “Powered by PROGRESS”; and one mid-distance screen displays a woman’s portrait advertisement. Include an elevated skybridge crossing between buildings, planter edges with greenery, slender streetlights, transparent glass lobbies, and layered high-rise facades fading upward into atmospheric haze. Emphasize photorealism, crisp architectural detail, subtle social commentary about quantified wellness and surveillance culture, natural reflections in puddles, realistic crowd spacing, muted business attire, and a polished premium editorial look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的近未来企业城市广场图，时间设定在雨后的清晨，采用宽画幅电影级构图，视角位于街道水平面。场景中展示了密集的人群，包括 6 位位于前景的显著办公室职员，以及数十位位于中景的行人，大部分为身着深色西装和米色风衣的东亚商务人士，他们正穿过铺设了抛光黑色石材、带有湿润反光表面和触觉导盲砖的广场。氛围时尚、有序，带有轻微的反乌托邦与乌托邦交织感，明亮的日光下，湛蓝的天空与高耸的玻璃钢结构摩天大楼环绕着整个空间。巨大的垂直数字项目展示牌主导了建筑外观：左侧显示着一位坐着的人，并带有可见文字“WELLNESS 83%”和“SLEEP 4.2h”；中央显示着可见文字“CITY HARMONY INDEX 47/100”以及下方的极简图表；右侧墙面是一张简洁的海报，写着“A BETTER TOMORROW”，下方有较小的文字“Powered by PROGRESS”；中距离的一块屏幕则展示着一幅女性肖像广告。画面包含连接建筑的高架天桥、带有绿植的种植槽边缘、细长的路灯、透明的玻璃大堂，以及向上方大气雾霾中逐渐淡出的层叠高层建筑立面。强调照片级真实感、清晰的建筑细节、关于量化健康与监控文化的微妙社会评论、水坑中的自然倒影、真实的人群间距、低调的商务着装以及精致的高级社论风格。
