templates.title: Neon GPT 5.5 Celebration Party

titleLocalized.zh: Neon GPT 5.5 庆祝派对

templates.prompt: A vibrant celebratory party poster-style illustration set inside a packed nightclub or event venue, viewed from behind a central person in a light beige or white hoodie and dark jeans, standing in the foreground with one arm raised triumphantly toward the stage. The scene is filled with colorful confetti, curled streamers, balloons, neon signs, and warm marquee lights, with a festive purple, pink, blue, and gold color palette. At the center top, a large glowing marquee sign with a black background and round incandescent bulbs reads “Hosted by” in warm golden script above huge neon letters reading “GPT 5.5,” with “GPT” in electric blue and “5.5” in bright pink-purple. Around the venue are exactly 6 visible text elements besides the main marquee: a tall vertical banner on the left reading “5/5 LET’S CELEBRATE,” a digital clock-like sign in the upper right reading “5:55 PM” with a small party hat icon, a circular neon sign on the right reading “5/5,” a large purple balloon on the lower right reading “LET’S PARTY!,” a framed checklist sign on a small round table at lower left reading “TODAY’S PLAN:” followed by 5 checked lines — “GOOD VIBES,” “GREAT PEOPLE,” “curated MUSIC,” “UNLIMITED FUN,” and “POWERED BY GPT 5.5” with a small heart — and a gift box at lower right labeled “THANK YOU” on top and “FOR BEING PART OF THE FUTURE” on the side. Include a cheering crowd with many raised hands and silhouettes facing a stage with purple-blue concert lighting beams. Add exactly 7 prominent balloon elements: a cluster of 4 balloons on the left in gold, purple, red, and teal; 2 balloons on the lower right in teal and gold; and 1 large purple text balloon on the right. Include a disco ball in the upper right corner, a person on the left wearing a dark cap and dark T-shirt with a glowing robot logo and the text “GPT 5.5” on the back, and a matching branded takeaway cup on the table. The atmosphere should feel like an energetic tech-company celebration or product launch party, cinematic, glossy, highly detailed, whimsical, and polished, with dramatic backlighting, glowing reflections, saturated neon, and a sense of motion from the falling confetti and dancing crowd.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的庆祝派对海报风格插图，场景设定在拥挤的夜店或活动现场。视角位于一名身穿浅米色或白色连帽衫、深色牛仔裤的人身后，此人站在前景中，一只手臂高举向舞台，姿态欢庆。场景中充满了彩色纸屑、卷曲的彩带、气球、霓虹灯和温暖的灯箱，整体色调为喜庆的紫色、粉色、蓝色和金色。在画面顶部中央，有一个巨大的发光灯箱，黑色背景配以圆形白炽灯泡，上方用温暖的金色手写体写着“Hosted by”，下方是巨大的霓虹灯字母“GPT 5.5”，其中“GPT”为电光蓝，“5.5”为亮粉紫色。在主灯箱之外，场地周围清晰可见 6 处文字元素：左侧是一个写着“5/5 LET’S CELEBRATE”的竖长横幅；右上角是一个类似数字时钟的标志，显示“5:55 PM”并配有一个小派对帽图标；右侧是一个写着“5/5”的圆形霓虹灯牌；右下角是一个写着“LET’S PARTY!”的大紫色气球；左下角的小圆桌上放着一个带框的清单牌，上面写着“TODAY’S PLAN:”，下方有 5 行已勾选的内容——“GOOD VIBES”、“GREAT PEOPLE”、“curated MUSIC”、“UNLIMITED FUN”以及带有小爱心的“POWERED BY GPT 5.5”；右下角是一个礼盒，顶部写着“THANK YOU”，侧面写着“FOR BEING PART OF THE FUTURE”。画面包含欢呼的人群，许多人举起双手，剪影面向舞台，舞台上有紫蓝色的演唱会灯光束。包含 7 个显眼的气球元素：左侧有一组金、紫、红、青 4 色气球；右下角有 2 个青色和金色气球；右侧有 1 个巨大的紫色文字气球。右上角有一个迪斯科球，左侧有一人戴着深色帽子，身穿深色 T 恤，背部印有发光的机器人标志和“GPT 5.5”字样，桌上放着配套的品牌外带杯。整体氛围营造出充满活力的科技公司庆典或产品发布派对感，画面具有电影质感、光泽感、细节丰富、奇幻且精致，伴有戏剧性的背光、发光的反射效果、饱和的霓虹色彩，以及飘落的纸屑和舞动的人群带来的动感。

templates.title: Fashion Product Campaign Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 时尚产品广告拼贴画

templates.prompt:
Create a clean editorial collage of 6 fashion-and-beauty product campaign visuals on a light gray studio background, arranged in a balanced magazine-style grid with rounded rectangular image blocks and generous white space. Add elegant serif text at the top left reading "GPT image 2.0" with a smaller handwritten script subtitle reading "Prompt Template". Each panel should combine an oversized foreground product held close to the camera with a full-body fashion model in the background, using forced perspective so the product looks much larger than the person. Use sharp studio lighting, soft shadows, glossy commercial retouching, high-end advertising aesthetics, and vibrant color styling.

Panel 1: a close hand holding a tall rectangular pink lip gloss tube with metallic cap, label visible, in front of a female model wearing a bold monochrome red outfit with a red jacket and shiny red pants, standing in a dynamic leaning pose with pink platform heels.

Panel 2: a close hand holding a frosted skincare essence bottle with a black cap, luxury minimalist label, in front of a female model wearing a red tailored pantsuit and red heels, posed in a fashion-forward stride or lunge.

Panel 3: a close hand holding a square bottle of red nail polish with a black cap and luxury branding, in front of a female model wearing a coral pleated midi skirt, teal top or jacket, a dark quilted handbag, and heeled sandals, posed as if walking.

Panel 4: a larger bottom-left hero panel featuring a close hand holding a large white-and-green pump bottle of facial cleanser with pharmacy-style branding, in front of a female model crouching low in green track pants, white crop top, blue jacket, and white sneakers, with a wide-angle fashion pose.

Panel 5: a close hand holding a red glass skincare serum dropper bottle with white text, in front of a female model in a teal satin-like blouse and flowing coral or red skirt, posed in motion.

Panel 6: a close hand holding a white low-top sneaker with a black swoosh, in front of a female model wearing a white cropped jacket, white top, and dark pleated skirt, posed in a graceful editorial stance.

Overall composition should feel like a social-media-ready campaign template for agencies: modern, premium, minimal, stylish, commercial, and highly polished. Keep the background uncluttered, faces intentionally soft or de-emphasized, and emphasize the contrast between the oversized products and the fashion models behind them.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个简洁的编辑风格拼贴画，在浅灰色摄影棚背景上展示 6 个时尚美妆产品广告视觉图，以平衡的杂志风格网格排列，采用圆角矩形图像块并留有充足的留白。在左上角添加优雅的衬线字体文本“GPT image 2.0”，下方配以较小的手写体副标题“Prompt Template”。每个面板应将近距离拍摄的超大前景产品与背景中的全身时尚模特相结合，利用强制透视法使产品看起来比人物大得多。使用锐利的摄影棚灯光、柔和的阴影、光泽感的商业修图、高端广告美学以及鲜艳的色彩风格。

面板 1：一只近距离的手拿着一支带有金属盖的长方形粉色唇彩管，标签可见，背景是一位身穿大胆单色红色套装的女性模特，穿着红色夹克和亮面红裤，以动态倾斜姿势站立，脚穿粉色厚底高跟鞋。

面板 2：一只近距离的手拿着一个带有黑色盖子的磨砂护肤精华瓶，配有奢华极简标签，背景是一位身穿红色剪裁裤装和红色高跟鞋的女性模特，摆出时尚前卫的跨步或弓步姿势。

面板 3：一只近距离的手拿着一瓶带有黑色盖子和奢华品牌标识的方形红色指甲油，背景是一位身穿珊瑚色百褶中长裙、青色上衣或夹克、背着深色绗缝手提包并穿着高跟凉鞋的女性模特，摆出正在行走的姿势。

面板 4：左下角较大的主视觉面板，展示一只近距离的手拿着一个带有药妆风格品牌标识的白色配绿色泵头洗面奶瓶，背景是一位蹲姿的女性模特，身穿绿色运动裤、白色露脐上衣、蓝色夹克和白色运动鞋，摆出广角时尚姿势。

面板 5：一只近距离的手拿着一个带有白色文字的红色玻璃护肤精华滴管瓶，背景是一位身穿青色缎面衬衫和飘逸珊瑚色或红色裙子的女性模特，摆出动态姿势。

面板 6：一只近距离的手拿着一双带有黑色对勾标志的白色低帮运动鞋，背景是一位身穿白色短款夹克、白色上衣和深色百褶裙的女性模特，摆出优雅的编辑风格姿势。

整体构图应呈现出适合代理商社交媒体使用的广告模板感：现代、高级、极简、时尚、商业化且高度精致。保持背景简洁，模特面部刻意模糊或弱化处理，并强调超大产品与身后时尚模特之间的对比。

templates.title: Pixel Art Sprite Sheet from Cat Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 将猫咪照片转换为像素风精灵图表

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, turn the inserted realistic cat photo and the visible desk scene into a transparent-background pixel-art sprite sheet for PowerPoint. Extract the scene elements and redraw them as clean retro game-style assets arranged on a dark workspace in a tidy grid. Include exactly 7 cat sprites showing different views/poses from the reference cat: 1 sitting front-left, 1 sitting front, 1 sitting back view, 1 sitting side/back view, 1 sitting three-quarter view, 1 walking side view, and 1 lying down side view. Also include the surrounding props from the reference as separate pixel-art items: 1 laptop, 2 wall chart/document panels, 1 pen holder, 1 potted plant, 3 book stacks, and 2 desk pieces in different lengths. Keep the cat recognizable as the same tabby-and-white cat from the reference, but simplify everything into crisp low-resolution pixel art suitable for cutting out and reusing on slides.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图片，将插入的写实猫咪照片及可见的桌面场景转换为适用于 PowerPoint 的透明背景像素风精灵图表。提取场景元素，并将其重绘为整齐排列在深色工作区网格上的简洁复古游戏风格素材。包含 7 个猫咪精灵图，展示参考猫咪的不同视角/姿势：1 个正面左侧坐姿、1 个正面坐姿、1 个背面坐姿、1 个侧后方坐姿、1 个侧前方坐姿、1 个侧面行走姿势以及 1 个侧面卧姿。同时将参考图中的周边道具作为独立的像素艺术项包含在内：1 台笔记本电脑、2 个墙面图表/文档面板、1 个笔筒、1 盆盆栽、3 叠书以及 2 个不同长度的桌面组件。保持猫咪与参考图中那只虎斑白猫的辨识度，并将所有元素简化为清晰的低分辨率像素艺术，以便在 Slides 中进行裁剪和重复使用。

templates.title: Convert Copilot cat image to pixel art

titleLocalized.zh: 将 Copilot 猫咪图片转换为像素艺术

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform only the inserted cat photo into retro pixel art while keeping the overall PowerPoint dark-mode Copilot screenshot layout, interface, and composition unchanged. Preserve the same tabby cat, pose, desk setting, laptop, wall charts, books, and plant, but redraw that image as chunky low-resolution game-style pixel art with visible square pixels, simplified shading, and an 8-bit feel. Also update the visible Japanese Copilot request and response text so the request says 「ピクセルアートにしてください」 and the response explains that the cat image was changed to pixel-art style, with follow-up suggestions mentioning 3 options: 「もっとドットを荒くしたい（8bit風）」, 「背景を単色にしたい」, and 「スライド右下用の小さめサイズにしたい」.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，仅将插入的猫咪照片转换为复古像素艺术，同时保持 PowerPoint 深色模式下 Copilot 的截图布局、界面和构图不变。保留相同的虎斑猫、姿势、桌面设置、笔记本电脑、墙上图表、书籍和植物，但将该图像重绘为具有明显方块像素、简化阴影和 8-bit 风格的粗颗粒低分辨率游戏风格像素艺术。同时更新可见的日语 Copilot 请求和响应文本，使请求变为「ピクセルアートにしてください」，响应说明猫咪图片已更改为像素艺术风格，并提供包含 3 个选项的后续建议：「もっとドットを荒くしたい（8bit風）」、「背景を単色にしたい」以及「スライド右下用の小さめサイズにしたい」。

templates.title: Rainy Alley Grim Reaper Horror Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 雨巷死神恐怖场景

templates.prompt: A dark cinematic horror scene in a narrow rain-soaked urban alley at night, lit almost entirely by dim blue-black ambient light and a warm vertical Japanese hotel sign in the background. The sign glows on the left side and reads ホテル, with smaller vertical text beneath it, while distant city lights blur into soft bokeh through the heavy rain. In the foreground on the right, a {argument name="character type" default="young woman"} sits on the flooded ground with her back against a wet wall, knees bent and head hanging forward in exhaustion or despair. She has soaked shoulder-length dark hair plastered to her face and neck, a black wet jacket, a short plaid skirt, and chunky black lace-up combat boots. Her skin and clothing glisten with rain, and the shallow water on the ground reflects the neon sign and scattered highlights. Looming behind her in the center-left is a tall hooded grim reaper silhouette, draped in long ragged black robes that dissolve into shredded strands, holding one large curved scythe arcing above its head. Keep the reaper mostly in silhouette with only a faint rim light so it feels ghostly and threatening. The overall composition should be vertical, with 2 visible figures total: 1 seated woman and 1 reaper apparition. Style: hyper-realistic cinematic horror, moody noir atmosphere, high contrast, extremely dark shadows, wet textures, volumetric rain, reflective pavement, subtle filmic grain, ominous tension, photoreal lighting. Color palette: near-black, deep navy, muted charcoal, and warm amber highlights from the sign. No gore, no extra people, no daylight, no bright colors, no text overlays except the distant hotel sign.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个暗黑电影风格的恐怖场景，背景是夜晚狭窄且被雨水浸透的城市小巷，光线几乎完全来自昏暗的蓝黑色环境光，以及背景中垂直悬挂的暖色调日本酒店招牌。招牌在左侧发光，写着“ホテル”，下方有较小的垂直文字，远处的城市灯光透过大雨模糊成柔和的焦外成像。在右侧前景中，一位 {argument name="character type" default="年轻女性"} 坐在积水的地面上，背靠湿漉漉的墙壁，双膝弯曲，头因疲惫或绝望而低垂。她齐肩的深色湿发贴在脸颊和脖子上，穿着黑色湿外套、短款格纹裙和厚底黑色系带马丁靴。她的皮肤和衣物上闪烁着雨水的光泽，地面上的浅水倒映着霓虹灯和零星的高光。在左中方逼近的是一个高大的连帽死神剪影，身披长长的破烂黑色长袍，长袍边缘呈碎裂状，手中握着一把巨大的弧形镰刀，悬于头顶上方。死神应保持大部分剪影状态，仅有微弱的轮廓光，以营造鬼魅且具威胁感的氛围。整体构图应为垂直方向，总共 2 个可见人物：1 位坐着的女性和 1 个死神幻影。风格：超写实电影恐怖、暗黑黑色电影氛围、高对比度、极深阴影、湿润质感、体积感雨水、反光路面、细腻的胶片颗粒感、不祥的张力、摄影级布光。色调：近乎黑色、深海军蓝、柔和的炭灰色，以及来自招牌的暖琥珀色高光。无血腥内容，无额外人物，无日光，无明亮色彩，除远处的酒店招牌外，无任何文字叠加。

templates.title: Retro Pixel Cat Game Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古像素猫咪游戏海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the cat and the office-desk setting into a retro 16-bit side-scrolling video game mock poster. Keep the reference cat recognizable as the main character, but redraw everything in detailed pixel art. Build a vertical poster composition with 1 large title at the top reading "CAT QUEST", 1 subtitle ribbon reading "ADVENTURE", 1 HUD row beneath it showing 4 elements: a 1UP icon, a heart counter marked "x3", a horizontal status bar, and a stage/score display reading "Q-1 0750". Turn the reference office scene into a 2-level platform stage using the desk, laptop, charts, books, plant, and room decor as game-environment props. Show 2 playable-cat sprite poses total, one on the upper platform and one on the lower platform, both side-view walking/running. Add 2 gray mouse enemies, one on each platform. Add collectible coin effects around the upper platform and a small question-block style item on the lower platform. At the bottom, include 3 stacked menu buttons labeled "EXPLORE", "COLLECT", and "LEVEL UP!", plus 1 footer tagline reading "AN EPIC RETRO PLATFORMING ADVENTURE!". Use a worn printed-game-poster look with distressed edges, warm arcade colors, and a nostalgic console-game cover aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将猫咪和办公桌场景转换为复古 16 位横版过关电子游戏模拟海报。保持参考猫咪作为主角的可辨识度，但以精细的像素艺术重绘所有元素。构建一个垂直海报构图，顶部设有一个大标题“CAT QUEST”，下方配有一个写着“ADVENTURE”的副标题丝带，以及一行 HUD 显示 4 个元素：一个 1UP 图标、一个标记为“x3”的心形计数器、一个水平状态栏，以及显示“Q-1 0750”的关卡/分数显示。将参考办公场景利用桌子、笔记本电脑、图表、书籍、植物和房间装饰作为游戏环境道具，改造成一个 2 层平台关卡。展示总共 2 个可操作猫咪的精灵图姿势，一个在上层平台，一个在下层平台，均为侧视行走/奔跑状态。添加 2 个灰色老鼠敌人，每个平台各一个。在上层平台周围添加可收集的硬币特效，并在下层平台添加一个小型问号方块风格的道具。在底部，包含 3 个堆叠的菜单按钮，分别标注为“EXPLORE”、“COLLECT”和“LEVEL UP!”，外加 1 行页脚标语“AN EPIC RETRO PLATFORMING ADVENTURE!”。采用磨损的印刷游戏海报外观，带有做旧边缘、温暖的街机配色以及怀旧的家用机游戏封面美学。

templates.title: Bold Fresh Juice Ad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 大胆鲜果汁广告海报

templates.prompt: A bold modern promotional poster for {argument name="brand name" default="VIVAJUICE"} in a bright urban corridor with a polished reflective floor and colorful graffiti mural along the left wall. The composition is a dynamic low-angle lifestyle product ad featuring one crouching young woman in the center background wearing a vivid red windbreaker jacket, white crop top, black jogger pants, and white sneakers, with curly dark hair tied up messily. Her face is intentionally soft and de-emphasized while her hand thrusts a large juice bottle toward the camera in extreme foreground, creating dramatic perspective and making the bottle dominate the frame. The hero bottle is a chilled clear plastic bottle with condensation droplets, black cap, orange juice inside, and a cream label reading {argument name="flavor name" default="SUNRISE MANGO"} with the slogan “Drink Fresh. Live Bold.” and ripe mango fruit illustrations near the bottom. Across the top, place a large oversized headline in two layers: dark green block letters reading {argument name="headline text" default="FRESH"} and a mint-green hand-painted brush script overlay reading {argument name="brush text" default="EVERY SIP"}. Put the logo at the upper left with a simple leaf mark above the wordmark and the tagline beneath it. Below the headline, include exactly 4 minimalist black line-icon feature badges arranged horizontally with captions: “NO ADDED SUGAR”, “100% NATURAL”, “NO PRESERVATIVES”, and “NOT FROM CONCENTRATE”. At the bottom right foreground, place exactly 3 smaller standing bottles in a neat row: a yellow-orange bottle labeled “TROPICAL BURST”, a bright pink-red bottle labeled “BERRY BLISS”, and a light green bottle labeled “KIWI COOLER”. Add small footer text and social/website callouts along the bottom edge, including an Instagram handle, website, and hashtag. Use clean commercial advertising photography, energetic health-brand aesthetics, crisp focus on the products, high contrast, bright natural indoor lighting, fresh green-and-orange color palette, premium beverage branding, sharp typography, and a sleek lifestyle campaign look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张为 {argument name="brand name" default="VIVAJUICE"} 设计的大胆现代宣传海报，背景位于明亮的城市走廊，地面光洁如镜，左侧墙壁绘有彩色涂鸦壁画。构图采用动态的低角度生活方式产品广告视角，画面中心背景处有一位蹲着的年轻女性，身穿鲜红色防风夹克、白色短款上衣、黑色慢跑裤和白色运动鞋，深色卷发凌乱地扎起。她的面部经过柔化处理，并非视觉焦点，而她的一只手将一瓶巨大的果汁推向镜头，置于极近的前景，营造出强烈的透视感，使果汁瓶成为画面主体。主角瓶为带有冷凝水珠的透明塑料瓶，黑色瓶盖，内装橙汁，奶油色标签上印有 {argument name="flavor name" default="SUNRISE MANGO"}，标语为“Drink Fresh. Live Bold.”，底部附近配有成熟芒果的插图。在顶部放置两层超大标题：深绿色块状字体写着 {argument name="headline text" default="FRESH"}，上方叠加薄荷绿色手绘笔刷字体写着 {argument name="brush text" default="EVERY SIP"}。将 Logo 放置在左上角，字标上方有一个简单的叶子标记，下方附带标语。标题下方横向排列 4 个极简黑色线条图标功能徽章，并配有说明文字：“NO ADDED SUGAR”（无添加糖）、“100% NATURAL”（100% 天然）、“NO PRESERVATIVES”（无防腐剂）和“NOT FROM CONCENTRATE”（非浓缩还原）。在右下角前景处整齐排列 3 瓶较小的产品：黄色橙色瓶身标签为“TROPICAL BURST”，亮粉红色瓶身标签为“BERRY BLISS”，浅绿色瓶身标签为“KIWI COOLER”。在底部边缘添加小字页脚及社交媒体/网站引导信息，包括 Instagram 账号、网址和标签。采用干净的商业广告摄影风格，充满活力的健康品牌美学，产品焦点清晰，高对比度，明亮的室内自然光，清新的绿橙色调，高端饮料品牌质感，锐利的排版，以及时尚的生活方式广告视觉效果。

templates.title: Formal Japanese ID Photo Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 正式日式证件照人像

templates.prompt: A formal Japanese-style passport or ID photo of a young adult woman, chest-up and centered, facing straight toward the camera with a neutral professional expression, on a clean light gray studio background. She has straight dark brown to near-black hair, smooth and glossy, parted slightly off-center near the top, with the hair falling evenly past the shoulders on both sides. Her ears are partially visible, with no noticeable accessories. She wears a tailored black business blazer over a plain white crew-neck blouse, creating a conservative job-application or official-document look. The lighting is soft, even, and frontal with minimal shadows, high sharpness, natural skin tones, and a realistic photographic finish. Composition is symmetrical and tightly cropped like an ID photo, showing the top of the head, shoulders, neckline, and upper chest. No smile, no dramatic styling, no props, no text, no border, no background details.

In the foreground, a large wooden worktable is covered with art supplies and finished sketches: exactly 3 paintbrush cups, multiple pencils and pens, watercolor palettes, small paint jars, loose character drawings, and 2 digital drawing tablets. At the center of the table, one large horizontal pen-display tablet shows a colorful pastel illustration in progress. The blue droplet character, with glossy rounded body, tiny arms, rosy cheeks, and a happy open smile, sits on the left holding a paintbrush and giving a high-five to a humanoid robot seated on the right. The robot has a smooth white body with teal glowing accents, a dark face screen with bright cyan smiling eyes, and one hand touching the tablet while the other meets the mascot’s hand, with small celebratory spark lines around the high-five. In the midground on the right, exactly 2 more robots are visible: one seated beside a human artist and one partially visible in the lower-right corner drawing on paper. The human artist is seen from behind, hair in a bun, sitting at a desk near the window and working on a tablet. templates.title: Ordinary Evening Street Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: 平凡傍晚街拍

templates.prompt: A candid, realistic street photo of a {argument name="age vibe" default="young woman in her late teens or early twenties"} standing outdoors in an upscale urban shopping district at blue hour, framed from mid-thigh to head in a vertical smartphone composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown to black"} hair styled in low twin ponytails with soft loose strands, and wears a simple, ordinary campus-style outfit: a white button-up shirt under an oversized dark navy cardigan with visible front buttons, paired with a dark pleated skirt. She carries 1 off-white canvas tote bag over her shoulder, holds 1 takeaway coffee cup with a brown sleeve in one hand, and 1 silver smartphone in the other hand. The mood is natural and unglamorous, like an everyday snapshot, with soft ambient evening light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric textures, and a slightly cool color tone. The background shows softly blurred storefront windows glowing warm yellow on the left, a pedestrian street paved with stone, 4 distant people walking in the background, and a visible illuminated building sign reading {argument name="store sign" default="T-SITE"}. Make the subject look casually stylish but very normal and believable, with a documentary candid-photo feel, subtle bokeh, and no exaggerated fashion pose.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实、自然的街拍照片，主体为一位 {argument name="age vibe" default="十几岁到二十出头的年轻女性"}，正站在蓝调时刻的高档城市商业区户外，采用竖屏构图，取景范围从大腿中部到头部。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色至黑色"} 的头发，扎着低双马尾，有几缕松散的发丝，身穿简约的校园风服饰：白色衬衫外搭一件深蓝色大码开衫（可见前襟纽扣），下身搭配深色百褶裙。她肩背 1 个米白色帆布袋，一手拿着 1 杯带棕色杯套的外带咖啡，另一只手拿着 1 部银色智能手机。整体氛围自然、朴实，如同日常随手拍，光影为柔和的傍晚环境光，具有浅景深效果，皮肤和织物纹理真实，色调略微偏冷。背景中，左侧是光线柔和、透着暖黄色光芒的店面橱窗，地面为石板铺就的步行街，远处有 4 名行人，并可见一个发光的建筑招牌，上面写着 {argument name="store sign" default="T-SITE"}。让主体看起来随性时尚但非常普通且真实，具有纪录片式的抓拍感，带有细腻的虚化效果，且没有夸张的时尚摆拍姿势。

templates.title: Casual Student Uniform Street Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 休闲学生制服街拍

templates.prompt: A candid smartphone photo of a {argument name="subject age and vibe" default="young Japanese woman with an ordinary, understated student look"} sitting outdoors in a modern city plaza on a bright spring or summer day. She is framed in a vertical close medium shot from slightly above, with her upper body filling most of the image. She has straight dark brown to black hair parted near the center, tied into 2 low pigtails, with a few loose strands around her face and neck. Her face is mostly obscured by a plain rectangular privacy blur block in the center, but one ear, her jawline, neck, and part of her cheek remain visible. She is wearing a crisp white short-sleeve blouse, a dark navy ribbon bow tied neatly at the collar, and a dark pleated skirt. Add 1 thin silver necklace with a tiny pendant. Over her left shoulder is 1 dark navy or black leather shoulder bag with a wide strap and visible metal buckle, the bag resting at her side. Her right hand is raised near her face as if adjusting her hair, and her left forearm rests casually across her lap. The mood is natural, modest, and everyday rather than glamorous. The background shows a clean urban office or shopping complex with 2 visible potted green shrubs, glass building facades, pale stone pavement, and soft sunlit shadows. Use realistic photography, soft daylight, gentle contrast, subtle skin tones, shallow depth of field, and a quiet candid social-media snapshot aesthetic. Outfit colors should be {argument name="uniform color palette" default="white blouse, navy ribbon, navy skirt, dark bag"}, the location should feel like {argument name="setting" default="a modern outdoor plaza in front of glass buildings"}, and the camera style should be {argument name="photo style" default="casual iPhone-like portrait photo with soft natural light"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张由智能手机拍摄的抓拍照片，主角是 {argument name="subject age and vibe" default="一位外表朴素、学生打扮的年轻日本女性"}，正坐在明媚春日或夏日的现代城市广场户外。画面采用略微俯视的竖构图近中景，上半身占据画面主体。她留着深棕色至黑色的直发，中分并扎成两个低马尾，脸颊和颈部周围有几缕散落的发丝。她的面部中心被一个简单的矩形隐私模糊块遮挡，但仍可见一只耳朵、下颌线、颈部和部分脸颊。她身穿一件挺括的白色短袖衬衫，领口系着整洁的深蓝色蝴蝶结，下身穿着深色百褶裙。佩戴 1 条带有微小吊坠的细银项链。左肩背着 1 个深蓝色或黑色皮革单肩包，包带较宽且带有明显的金属扣，包身垂在身侧。她的右手抬起靠近脸部，仿佛正在整理头发，左前臂随意地放在膝盖上。整体氛围自然、朴素，更偏向日常感而非华丽感。背景展示了一个整洁的城市办公区或购物中心，可见 2 盆绿色灌木、玻璃建筑外墙、浅色石材路面以及柔和的阳光阴影。采用写实摄影风格，光线柔和，对比度适中，肤色自然，具有浅景深效果，呈现出一种安静的社交媒体抓拍美感。服装配色应为 {argument name="uniform color palette" default="白色衬衫、海军蓝蝴蝶结、海军蓝短裙、深色包袋"}，场景应呈现为 {argument name="setting" default="玻璃建筑前的现代户外广场"}，摄影风格应为 {argument name="photo style" default="带有柔和自然光的休闲 iPhone 风格人像照片"}。

templates.title: Anonymized Business Headshot

titleLocalized.zh: 匿名商务证件照

templates.prompt: A clean studio-style ID photo of a young East Asian woman from the chest up, centered and facing straight toward the camera against a plain light gray-white background. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair parted precisely in the middle and tied into 2 low pigtails hanging over both shoulders, with smooth straight roots and slightly softly curled ends. She wears a {argument name="blazer color" default="black"} tailored business blazer over a {argument name="top color" default="white"} crew-neck blouse, creating a formal job-application or passport-photo look. The composition is symmetrical, evenly lit with soft diffused studio lighting, realistic skin texture, natural color grading, sharp focus, and a minimal professional headshot aesthetic. Frame vertically in a portrait orientation with the top of the head fully visible and the upper torso included. Place a small subtle watermark-like text on the left side reading {argument name="watermark text" default="@yui_ai_model"}. Cover the entire face area from forehead to chin with a large centered rectangular blur block in a beige-brown tone, as if anonymizing the subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张干净的影棚风格证件照，拍摄对象为一位年轻的东亚女性，半身像，居中且正对镜头，背景为纯净的浅灰白色。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，中分发型，扎成两个垂在双肩前的低马尾，发根顺滑笔直，发梢微卷。她身穿 {argument name="blazer color" default="黑色"} 的定制商务西装外套，内搭 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 圆领衬衫，呈现出正式的求职或护照照片风格。构图对称，光线均匀，采用柔和的漫反射影棚照明，皮肤纹理真实，色彩自然，对焦清晰，具有极简的专业肖像美感。采用竖向构图，完整显示头部顶部及上半身。在左侧放置一段微小的水印式文字 {argument name="watermark text" default="@yui_ai_model"}。使用一个居中的米棕色矩形模糊块覆盖从额头到下巴的整个面部区域，以实现对拍摄对象的匿名化处理。

templates.title: Neon GPT Image 2 Promo Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Neon GPT Image 2 宣传海报

templates.prompt: A vibrant futuristic promotional illustration in a wide 16:9 composition, styled like polished anime-tech advertising art. The background is a glowing purple-to-pink-to-orange gradient with neon circuit traces running across the top right and left edges, plus electric lightning effects behind the character and around the interface elements. At the top center, place large luminous headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="GPT IMAGE 2"} in a bold rounded sans-serif font with a pink, cyan, and violet neon glow. In the center-left foreground, show a half-body anime-style businesswoman with {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} shoulder-length hair with soft bangs and slightly curled ends, wearing thin glasses, a navy business suit, and a white button-up shirt. Her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur block, but her pose is energetic and confident: she faces right and points with her right index finger toward a large floating software window. On the right half of the image, show a large glowing futuristic image-generation interface outlined in cyan neon, with a main preview panel displaying a highly detailed 4K photoreal mountain lake landscape at sunset: turquoise water, evergreen forest, dramatic rocky peaks with snow, and warm pink-orange sky reflections. Include 3 small vertical thumbnail previews along the left side of this interface, a slim control bar below the main image, and tiny navigation icons in the lower right of the panel. Around the woman on the left side, add 4 floating neon-outlined feature cards: a top-left slide editor window with the visible title “Slide template” and simple bullet lines, a mid-left export box with the visible text “Export” and “Google Slides / PowerPoint / PDF”, a bottom-left black-and-gold badge reading “4K Resolution”, and a small square image icon near the woman’s pointing hand. Add 3 sparkle stars around the large interface for a glossy premium look. At the bottom center, place large glowing gradient text reading {argument name="bottom text" default="Now on Manus Slides"}. Make the entire scene sleek, high-contrast, glossy, and commercial, with crisp line art, soft cel shading, neon rim lighting, and a clean tech-launch poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的未来感宣传插图，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，风格类似于精致的动漫科技广告艺术。背景为发光的紫-粉-橙渐变色，右上角和左上角有霓虹电路轨迹，角色身后及界面元素周围环绕着电光特效。在顶部中央，放置醒目的大号发光标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT IMAGE 2"}，使用粗体圆角无衬线字体，并带有粉色、青色和紫罗兰色的霓虹光晕。在左侧前景中央，展示一位半身动漫风格的商务女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"} 的齐肩长发，配有柔和的刘海和微卷的发梢，戴着细框眼镜，身穿海军蓝商务套装和白色衬衫。她的面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡，但姿态充满活力与自信：她面向右侧，右手食指指向一个巨大的悬浮软件窗口。在图像右半部分，展示一个巨大的发光未来感图像生成界面，外框为青色霓虹灯，主预览面板显示一张高度精细的 4K 超写实山湖日落景观：绿松石色的湖水、常青森林、壮观的雪山峰峦以及粉橙色天空的倒影。在该界面左侧包含 3 个小型垂直缩略图预览，主图下方设有纤细的控制栏，面板右下角有微小的导航图标。在左侧女性周围，添加 4 张悬浮的霓虹边框功能卡片：左上角是标题为“Slide template”且带有简单项目符号的 Slides 编辑窗口，左侧中部是带有“Export”以及“Google Slides / PowerPoint / PDF”文字的导出框，左下角是写有“4K Resolution”的黑金徽章，女性指向的手部附近有一个小方形图像图标。在大界面周围添加 3 颗闪烁的星星，营造出光泽感和高级感。在底部中央，放置大号发光渐变文本 {argument name="bottom text" default="Now on Manus Slides"}。使整个场景看起来时尚、高对比度、有光泽且具有商业感，具备清晰的线条艺术、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、霓虹边缘光以及简洁的科技发布海报美学。

templates.title: Night Train Racing HUD Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间列车竞速 HUD 场景

templates.prompt:
A cinematic night action scene inspired by arcade street-racing game HUD design, showing 2 Japanese commuter trains racing side by side on elevated urban tracks through a dense city at night. The viewpoint is low and slightly ahead of the trains, angled three-quarters toward their front-left sides, with dramatic motion blur streaking the rails, buildings, and overhead wires to emphasize extreme speed. The left train is a modern bright red commuter train with a cream front panel, route display reading 品川, and the number 2100 on the front. The right train is a deep maroon classic-style commuter train with warm interior lighting, twin headlights, the number 2000 on the front, and a circular headmark reading 競技 with smaller text 久里浜→品川. The maroon train is slightly ahead. The setting is a dark metropolitan skyline with illuminated office windows, railway catenary structures, and a distant Tokyo Tower visible on the right side of the horizon. Use a moody, high-contrast palette of black, charcoal, deep reds, amber window light, and metallic reflections, with a glossy, realistic photographic look.

Overlay a sleek white racing-game interface directly on the image. Include exactly 5 UI components: 1) top-left circular mini-map with a location pin icon, a simple route line, and the text 5.4 km; below it, two lines of Japanese text reading 京急本線 下り and 京急久里浜→品川. 2) top-right speed display showing large numerals 168, smaller km/h, a thin horizontal divider, and below that 4 段. 3) bottom-left vertical control meter labeled BC at the top, with markings 12 through 1 descending, letters B, N, and P on the left side, and a small green indicator near 7. 4) bottom-center horizontal bar meter labeled ブレーキ on the left and パワー on the right, with a blue-to-magenta-to-red gradient fill and a 0 to 200 km/h scale beneath. 5) bottom-right circular pressure-style gauge labeled kPa with markings 0, 200, 400, 800, 1000 and small labels MR and BC beneath, plus a matching vertical numeric scale beside it. Keep the HUD minimal, thin-lined, elegant, and semi-transparent, integrated like a futuristic train racing dashboard. Ultra-detailed, dynamic, realistic, dramatic long-exposure energy, no people in foreground, no extra panels or split layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
这是一场电影级的夜间动作场景，灵感源自街机赛车游戏的 HUD 设计，展示了两列日本通勤列车在密集的夜间城市高架轨道上并排竞速。视角较低且略微领先于列车，呈四分之三侧面角度对准列车左前方，强烈的动态模糊掠过轨道、建筑和高架电线，以强调极速感。左侧列车为现代亮红色通勤列车，配有奶油色前脸，路线显示屏显示“品川”，车头编号为 2100。右侧列车为深栗色经典款通勤列车，车内灯光温暖，配有双头灯，车头编号为 2000，并带有圆形车头标志，写有“竞技”字样，下方有较小的“久里浜→品川”文字。栗色列车略微领先。背景为黑暗的都市天际线，点缀着办公楼的灯光、铁路接触网结构，右侧地平线上可见远处的东京塔。采用黑色、炭灰色、深红色、琥珀色窗灯和金属反射组成的深沉高对比度色调，呈现出光泽感十足的写实摄影风格。

在图像上叠加简洁的白色赛车游戏界面。包含 5 个 UI 组件：1) 左上角圆形小地图，带有位置标记图标、简单的路线线以及“5.4 km”文字；下方有两行日文，分别为“京急本线 下り”和“京急久里浜→品川”。2) 右上角速度显示，显示大号数字“168”，下方较小的“km/h”，中间有细横线分隔，下方显示“4 段”。3) 左下角垂直控制仪表，顶部标有“BC”，刻度从 12 到 1 递减，左侧标有字母 B、N 和 P，7 附近有一个绿色小指示灯。4) 底部中央水平条形仪表，左侧标有“ブレーキ”（制动），右侧标有“パワー”（动力），填充色为蓝-紫-红渐变，下方有 0 到 200 km/h 的刻度。5) 右下角圆形压力表，标有“kPa”，刻度为 0、200、400、800、1000，下方标有“MR”和“BC”，旁边配有对应的垂直数字刻度。HUD 需保持极简、线条纤细、优雅且半透明，如同未来派的列车竞速仪表盘。画面超精细、动态、写实，具有戏剧性的长曝光能量感，前景无人物，无额外面板或分屏布局。

templates.title: Hyper-Realistic Selfie Portrait

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic close-up portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman (use my face)"} with warm, soft indoor lighting. The composition is a half-body shot (chest to head), with a slightly low and tilted camera angle, creating a casual, selfie-like feel. The main focus is on the face and hair. The face features bright, glass-like skin with realistic texture (no over-smoothing). Brown eyes with a {argument name="expression" default="calm, slightly melancholic expression"}, looking directly at the camera. Lips are natural pink with a berry tint in the inner area, slightly parted with a soft, moist finish. Makeup is a natural “no-makeup” look. Hair MUST be highly accurate: {argument name="hair style" default="Short hair above the shoulders (short bob), with an uneven, choppy cut and soft layers"}. Natural dark brown color with subtle warm undertones. The texture looks soft and slightly messy, not overly neat. The front has long bangs, parted asymmetrically, with some strands falling over parts of the eyes and cheeks. Fine strands are scattered around the face, creating an effortless and natural effect. The ends of the hair curve slightly inward and outward irregularly, giving light volume and an airy feel. The hair is not too voluminous but has natural movement, as if gently blown by a breeze.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的特写人像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性（使用我的脸）"}，配以温暖柔和的室内光线。构图为半身照（胸部至头部），采用略微低角度且倾斜的相机视角，营造出随意的自拍感。焦点集中在面部和头发上。面部呈现出明亮、如玻璃般通透的皮肤，具有真实的纹理（无过度磨皮）。棕色眼睛带有 {argument name="expression" default="平静、略带忧郁的表情"}，直视镜头。嘴唇呈自然的粉色，内侧带有浆果色调，微微张开，质感柔软湿润。妆容为自然的“伪素颜”风格。头发必须高度精确：{argument name="hair style" default="肩部以上的短发（短波波头），采用不规则的碎剪和柔和的层次感"}。自然的深棕色，带有微妙的暖色调。发质看起来柔软且略显凌乱，不会过于整齐。前额留有长刘海，不对称分开，几缕发丝落在眼睛和脸颊上。细碎的发丝散落在脸部周围，营造出随性自然的效果。发梢不规则地向内和向外弯曲，带来轻盈的蓬松感和空气感。头发不会过于厚重，但具有自然的动感，仿佛被微风轻轻吹拂。

The model is wearing a coordinated {argument name="outfit color" default="beige"} streetwear outfit (black hiddie and white joggers), with oversized chunky white sneakers that have bold orange accents on the sole and side stripes.

The background is a smooth studio gradient in warm tones, blending {argument name="primary color" default="light green"} and {argument name="accent color" default="vibrant yellow"} for an eye-catching, energetic feel. Dramatic soft studio lighting enhances the subject, with glowing highlights and subtle shadows that complement the outfit and colour palette.

Behind the model, large bold typography is seamlessly integrated into the composition, reading “Shamus” in oversized modern sans-serif font, partially obscured by the subject for depth. Additional small promotional text is placed around the layout in a clean editorial style, such as:

“LET YOU WIN.”
“THE DESTINATION IS YOURS.”
“PREMIUM MATERIALS. RESPONSIVE CUSHIONING. TIMELESS DESIGN.”

At the bottom, a modern sneaker brand logo “SHAMUS” appears with the tagline “MOVE DIFFERENT.”

Add subtle motion effects like dust particles or energy trails beneath the jumping foot to enhance impact. Ultra-realistic detail, sharp focus, high contrast, commercial fashion photography style, magazine-quality composition, 4K resolution.

背景为暖色调的平滑摄影棚渐变效果，融合了 {argument name="primary color" default="浅绿色"} 和 {argument name="accent color" default="活力黄色"}，营造出引人注目且充满活力的氛围。戏剧性的柔和摄影棚灯光增强了主体效果，发光的高光和微妙的阴影与服装及配色方案相得益彰。

模特身后，醒目的大号字体无缝融入构图中，以超大现代无衬线字体写着“Shamus”，部分被主体遮挡以增加深度。其他小型宣传文字以简洁的编辑风格排布在布局周围，例如：

“LET YOU WIN.”
“THE DESTINATION IS YOURS.”
“PREMIUM MATERIALS. RESPONSIVE CUSHIONING. TIMELESS DESIGN.”

templates.title: Chibi Mini Versions Photo Edit

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版迷你形象照片编辑

templates.prompt:
Edit the image while keeping the original photo completely unchanged — including the person, face, body, pose, lighting, and gym background.

Add multiple small, cute chibi-style “mini versions” of her around the image. Each mini character should have a big head, expressive facial features, and match her hairstyle and outfit.

Depict each mini version doing different gym-related activities:

one cheering with arms raised

one running in running shoes

one drinking from a shaker bottle

one wearing sporty running glasses

one climbing near her leg

Enhance the image with playful, hand-drawn doodles and handwritten notes in white and pink ink, in a scrapbook style. Include elements like arrows, stars, hearts, sparkles, and sketchy lines.

Add cute, handwritten gym-themed motivational phrases:

“lift strong”

“stronger every rep”

“no pain no gain”

“sweat now, shine later”

“progress over perfection”

“train hard, stay soft”

templates.title: 3D Rendered Dance Sequence Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 渲染舞蹈动作序列指南

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use image1 as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: same as in refrence image, bottom wears baggies trouser The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
舞蹈动作说明表
[视觉风格]
采用高度精细的 3D 渲染女性舞者构图。设计风格参考专业编舞指南，布局具有技术图表感。纯净的白色背景，柔和的摄影棚灯光，以及强烈的对比度，以突出身体动作和姿态。
[网格布局]
结构化的 4×4 面板网格（共 16 帧），由细黑色分割线均匀隔开。每个面板尺寸相同，并清晰地标有 1 到 16 的数字，以展示连续的舞蹈进程。
[角色]
使用 image1 作为基础角色。同一位女性舞者在所有面板中保持一致，具有准确的相似度和比例。
[服装]
舞者穿着时尚、适合表演的服装：与参考图像相同，下身穿着宽松长裤。整体造型应现代且具有视觉吸引力，同时便于舞蹈动作。即使在灰度模式下，织物也应能微妙地响应动作（呈现轻微的流动感和褶皱）。
[面板结构 – 每一帧]
左上角：步骤编号 + 简短的舞蹈动作标题（例如：“第 5 步 – 旋转过渡”）
中心：捕捉编舞中精确瞬间的全身姿势
左下角：3–4 行简洁的动作说明
叠加层：展示舞者如何过渡的运动箭头和方向指引
[动作指示]
加入用于表示流畅动作的曲线箭头、用于表示方向步骤的直线箭头，以及用于表示旋转或转圈的圆形指示符。强调节奏、重心转移和身体局部动作。
[渲染质量]
高细节雕刻 3D 风格，具有平滑的灰度阴影、微妙的投影和清晰的线条。保持精致的概念艺术级成品，确保每个姿势都清晰可见。
[限制条件]
无颜色，无背景场景，无额外角色，无视觉杂乱，仅包含舞者和教学元素。

templates.title: Candid Convenience Store Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 便利店抓拍人像

templates.prompt:
A beautiful {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} in her early 20s, with the same facial features, skin tone, and overall appearance as the provided reference image, works as a {argument name="occupation" default="convenience store cashier"}. She is wearing a typical {argument name="store brand" default="Seven Eleven"} uniform (white shirt with green, red, and orange accents, name tag reading “MEEM,” hair neatly tied back consistent with her look in the reference).

She stands behind the cashier counter, serving a customer with a friendly, natural expression that matches her personality and facial structure from the reference. On the counter, there is a POS machine, a barcode scanner, and small items such as candy and drinks.

Candid moment: the photo is taken discreetly using a smartphone from a customer’s point of view, with slight foreground blur, imperfect framing, and an unposed, spontaneous feel. The composition should preserve her exact likeness from the reference without distortion.

Lighting: bright, evenly distributed convenience store neon lighting, maintaining realistic skin tones and true-to-reference color accuracy.

Environment: a modern convenience store interior with neatly arranged shelves of products behind the cashier, creating a clean, organized, and well-lit atmosphere.

Photography style: ultra-photorealistic candid photography, shallow depth of field, natural textures, high detail, slight motion blur for realism, subtle smartphone camera noise, 4K quality.

Optional variations:

* slightly tilted angle
* reflections on glass display
* soft motion as she hands a receipt or change
* gentle, natural smile consistent with the reference

promptLocalized.zh:
一位美丽的 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，20 出头，拥有与所提供参考图像一致的面部特征、肤色和整体外貌，职业是 {argument name="occupation" default="便利店收银员"}。她穿着典型的 {argument name="store brand" default="7-Eleven"} 制服（带有绿色、红色和橙色装饰的白衬衫，佩戴写有“MEEM”的工牌，头发整齐地向后扎起，与参考图像中的造型一致）。

她站在收银台后，正为顾客提供服务，表情友好自然，与其参考图像中的个性和面部结构相符。柜台上放着 POS 机、条形码扫描仪以及糖果和饮料等小商品。

抓拍瞬间：照片以顾客视角通过智能手机隐蔽拍摄，前景略带模糊，构图不刻意，呈现出一种未经摆拍的自然感。构图应在不失真的前提下，精准还原参考图像中的人物样貌。

Power duo, slightly competitive vibe, teasing interaction, stage dominance, electric chemistry without romance softness.

Dark concert stage, glossy reflective floor

Lighting:
red spotlight (female focus)
white/blue spotlight (male focus)
strobe flashes on beat drops

Backup dancers: 2–4 silhouettes (optional, low focus)

0–1s
Black → beat drop
Silhouette duo back-to-back
Flash reveal, low-angle cinematic push-in

Lighting flash per impact

3–4s

female left → right
Camera orbit half circle
4–5s

5–6s

female smooth & expressive
male controlled & grounded
→ cross arms then open (BIG synchronized hit)
6–7s

→ female smirks, diva confidence

Quick cuts + micro zoom impact

Backlight sweep across stage
9–10s

templates.title: Artistic Identity Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 艺术感身份肖像

templates.prompt:
A modern digital portrait depicting a {argument name="subject" default="young man"}. Using the submitted reference image strictly for facial identity, it preserves the exact facial features, precise facial structure, and natural realism of the person. The subject has a cheerful, confident smile and wears {argument name="accessory" default="stylish glasses"}, shown in multiple poses.
The central portrait is large, sharp, and highly detailed, illuminated with warm, soft lighting that enhances the facial contours and skin tone. In the background, a semi-transparent profile of the same person blends smoothly into an abstract composition of expressive {argument name="background style" default="red brushstrokes"}.
In the foreground, two smaller versions of the man are included: one standing in casual clothing with a confident posture, and another seated with legs crossed in a thoughtful, pensive pose. The outfits are youthful and casual, featuring light-colored shirts and jeans.
The background combines clean white space with textured elements and bold red brushstrokes, creating a striking and artistic contrast. The overall composition follows a modern poster-style aesthetic, with subtle glow effects, smooth transitions, and a polished, high-end digital art finish.

promptLocalized.zh:
一幅现代数字肖像，描绘了一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男子"}。严格使用提交的参考图像进行面部识别，保留了人物确切的面部特征、精确的面部结构以及自然的真实感。主体面带自信愉悦的微笑，佩戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="时尚眼镜"}，并以多种姿态呈现。
中央肖像画面大、清晰且细节丰富，在温暖柔和的灯光照射下，突显了面部轮廓和肤色。背景中，同一人物的半透明侧影与富有表现力的 {argument name="background style" default="红色笔触"} 抽象构图完美融合。
前景中包含了该男子的两个较小版本：一个身着休闲装，姿态自信；另一个坐着，双腿交叉，神情沉思。服装年轻休闲，以浅色衬衫和牛仔裤为主。
背景将简洁的留白与纹理元素及大胆的红色笔触相结合，营造出引人注目的艺术对比。整体构图遵循现代海报风格，带有微妙的发光效果、平滑的过渡以及精致的高端数字艺术质感。

templates.title: Crumple Paper Furniture Concept Design

titleLocalized.zh: 揉皱纸张家具概念设计

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Design Concept: {argument name="furniture type" default="The Crumple Chair"} Core Philosophy: Translating the "controlled chaos" of a {argument name="inspiration" default="tossed paper ball"} into a sculptural, high-comfort seating experience.

Stage 1: Observation & Morphological Analysis The goal is to deconstruct the image of the crumpled paper into usable geometric data. Crease Mapping: Identify the primary "valley" and "ridge" lines. These represent potential structural ribs or seams in the chair. Faceted Planes: Break down the sphere into a series of non-uniform polygons. Each flat surface of the paper becomes a potential panel for the chair’s upholstery or shell. Shadow Study: Analyze how the "tossed" form creates deep recesses. These natural pockets guide where the user’s weight will be cradled. 

Stage 2: Iterative Form Exploration Moving from a sphere to a seat through "Digital Crumpling." Subtractive Sculpting: Imagine the paper ball as a solid mass. Use Boolean operations to "carve out" a seating cavity that fits the human form while maintaining the external jagged texture. Tension Simulation: Use 3D software (like Rhino or Blender) to simulate a flat sheet of material being compressed. This ensures the folds look authentic and not "modeled." The "Toss" Logic: Experiment with gravity-based simulation dropping a digital mesh to see how it settles naturally, mimicking the "tossed" origin. 

Stage 3: Ergonomic Translation & Blueprinting Refining the raw aesthetic into a functional object. The Comfort Core: Overlay a standard ergonomic template (Seating Angle: 105°–110°) over the crumpled form. Adjust the internal "folds" to provide lumbar support and pressure relief. Blueprint Generation: Create technical orthographic views (Front, Side, Top). Map out the dimensions: Seat Height: 450mm Total Width: 850mm Surface Smoothing: Maintain the sharp "paper edges" on the exterior shell while softening the interior contact points for skin comfort. 

Stage 4: Structural Integration & Scaling Making the concept physically viable. The Skeleton: Design a hidden internal frame (likely CNC-bent steel rods or a 3D-printed lattice) that follows the most prominent ridges of the paper folds to provide rigidity. Material Selection: * Option A (High-End): {argument name="material" default="Faceted, cast aluminum"} with a white powder coat. Option B (Soft): Vacuum-formed recycled plastic shell covered in "memory-fold" technical fabric that retains a wrinkled appearance. 

Stage 5: Final Prototyping & Material Finish Textural Replication: Apply a matte, slightly porous finish to the material to mimic the tactile feel of heavy-bond paper. Lighting Contrast: Use directional studio lighting in the final renders to emphasize the "tossed" shadows, making the chair look like a giant piece of discarded inspiration. Design Tip: To keep the "tossed" look authentic, avoid symmetry.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计概念：{argument name="furniture type" default="揉皱椅"} 核心理念：将 {argument name="inspiration" default="揉成团的纸球"} 的“受控混乱”转化为一种具有雕塑感且高度舒适的座椅体验。

第一阶段：观察与形态分析 目标是将揉皱纸张的意象解构为可用的几何数据。折痕映射：识别主要的“谷线”和“脊线”。这些线条代表了椅子潜在的结构肋条或接缝。多面平面：将球体分解为一系列不规则的多边形。纸张的每一个平面都成为椅子软包或外壳的潜在面板。阴影研究：分析“揉皱”形态如何形成深邃的凹槽。这些天然的口袋引导着用户重量的承托位置。

第二阶段：迭代形态探索 通过“数字揉皱”从球体过渡到座椅。减法雕刻：将纸球想象为一个实体。使用布尔运算“雕刻出”一个既符合人体工学又保持外部锯齿状纹理的座椅凹槽。张力模拟：使用 3D 软件（如 Rhino 或 Blender）模拟一张平面材料被压缩的过程。这能确保折痕看起来真实，而非“建模”出来的。 “抛掷”逻辑：尝试基于重力的模拟，将数字网格落下，观察其自然沉降的状态，以模仿“抛掷”的原始感。

第三阶段：人体工学转换与蓝图绘制 将原始美学升华为功能性物体。舒适核心：在揉皱形态上覆盖标准的工学模板（座椅角度：105°–110°）。调整内部“折痕”以提供腰部支撑和压力缓解。蓝图生成：创建技术正投影视图（前视图、侧视图、顶视图）。规划尺寸：座高：450 mm，总宽：850 mm。表面平滑处理：在外壳上保持锐利的“纸张边缘”，同时软化内部接触点以确保皮肤触感舒适。

第四阶段：结构集成与缩放 使概念具备物理可行性。骨架：设计一个隐藏的内部框架（建议使用 CNC 弯曲钢杆或 3D 打印晶格），使其沿着纸张折痕最明显的脊线分布，以提供刚性。材料选择：* 选项 A（高端）：{argument name="material" default="多面铸铝"}，配以白色粉末涂层。选项 B（柔软）：真空成型的再生塑料外壳，覆盖“记忆折痕”科技面料，以保持褶皱外观。

第五阶段：最终原型与材料饰面 纹理复制：在材料上应用哑光、微孔饰面，以模仿厚重纸张的触感。光影对比：在最终渲染中使用定向摄影棚灯光来强调“揉皱”阴影，使椅子看起来像一件巨大的、被丢弃的灵感作品。设计建议：为了保持“揉皱”外观的真实感，请避免对称。

templates.title: Crayon Drawing Style Redraw

titleLocalized.zh: 儿童蜡笔画风格插图

templates.prompt:
Redraw the original image as a crayon-style illustration, transforming the entire scene into the texture of a ten-year-old's hand-drawing. Keep the shapes simple, with slightly naive and imperfect lines, restoring the natural and casual feel of children's drawings.

Discard the original color scheme and replace it with {argument name="tones" default="bright and lively crayon childlike colors"}, using a clean pure white drawing paper as the background color. The overall style leans towards soft, cute, childlike, and healing.

Add fun elements full of childlike interest: {argument name="decorations" default="stars, candy, rockets, and robots"}, along with other fantasy and cute decorative patterns to set a lively and playful atmosphere.

The final image should be healing, pleasing, and colorful, full of innocent childlike imagination.

promptLocalized.zh: 将原始图像重绘为 {argument name="drawing style" default="蜡笔风格"} 插图，将整个场景转换为 {argument name="artist age" default="十岁"} 儿童手绘的质感。保持形状简洁，线条略显稚拙且不完美，以捕捉儿童艺术的自然随性。摒弃原始配色，改用明亮、活泼且充满童趣的蜡笔色彩，并配以干净的白纸背景。整体风格应柔和、可爱且治愈。添加星星、糖果、火箭、机器人等奇思妙想的元素，营造出俏皮的氛围。最终效果应赏心悦目、色彩丰富，并充满童真想象力。

templates.title: Manhwa Style Fighting Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 韩漫风格格斗分镜

templates.prompt:
Generate a high-quality cinematic storyboard collage in a 16:9 frame, composed of 8–10 connected panels. The entire image should be illustrated in a {argument name="art style" default="stylized Korean manhwa / webtoon-inspired comic style"}, with clean line art, soft cel shading, dynamic action composition, and expressive visual storytelling. Avoid photorealism. Do not use realistic human facial rendering. Keep faces slightly simplified, stylized, and illustrated, while maintaining attractive character design and strong emotional expression. No text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark.

Scene concept:
A freestyle fight between a man and a young Chinese woman, with the woman clearly winning in the end. The tone is intense, stylish, energetic, and dramatic, with strong visual rhythm and clear action storytelling. The setting should be clean and minimal, such as {argument name="setting" default="an urban rooftop at dusk"}, a modern training arena, or an empty industrial platform.

Female lead:
A young adult Chinese woman in her early 20s, clearly adult, illustrated in a Korean comic style. She wears a {argument name="outfit" default="pink Barbie-inspired sporty outfit"} with a fashionable, feminine look. Her design should feel youthful, agile, and confident. She has a light and nimble build, clear body lines, a slim and toned silhouette, and graceful but powerful movement. Her expression and posture should communicate calmness, sharp focus, and quiet confidence.

Male opponent:
An adult man with a physically stronger and more aggressive presence. He should appear forceful and intimidating at first, creating a visual contrast with the woman’s agility, technique, and composure.

Storyboard progression:
Panel 1: Wide establishing shot. The man and the woman stand apart in a tense face-off, dramatic atmosphere, strong composition.
Panel 2: Close-up or medium shot details — stylized eyes, hands tightening, ready stance, subtle body tension before the fight begins.
Panel 3: The man attacks first with aggressive speed and force.
Panel 4: The woman dodges smoothly and precisely, using quick footwork and agile body movement.
Panel 5: A fluid exchange of action — blocks, slips, pivots, and evasive movement, shown with dynamic comic-style angles.
Panel 6: The fight intensifies. The woman remains calm and starts reading his rhythm.
Panel 7: Turning point. She finds an opening and counters with clean, skillful technique.
Panel 8: A visually striking action moment — spin, redirect, sweep, or takedown — showing her taking control.
Panel 9: The man is down or clearly defeated, breathing heavily or collapsed.
Panel 10: Final hero shot. The woman stands strong and composed under dramatic lighting, calm and victorious.

Visual style:
Korean manhwa / webtoon-inspired illustration, cinematic comic storyboard, polished line art, soft cel shading, dramatic lighting, dynamic motion, expressive posing, elegant action choreography, stylish panel composition, clean background design, high detail, vivid but controlled color palette

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一个 16:9 画幅的高质量电影感分镜拼贴图，由 8–10 个连贯的画格组成。整张图像应采用 {argument name="art style" default="风格化的韩漫 / 网络漫画风格"} 进行绘制，具备清晰的线条、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、动态的动作构图以及富有表现力的视觉叙事。避免照片写实感。不要使用写实的人脸渲染。保持面部略微简化、风格化且具有插画感，同时保持吸引人的角色设计和强烈的表情表达。无文字、无字幕、无标题、无水印。

场景概念：
一名男子与一名年轻中国女性之间的自由格斗，最终由女性获胜。基调紧张、时尚、充满活力且富有戏剧性，具有强烈的视觉节奏和清晰的动作叙事。场景应简洁明了，例如 {argument name="setting" default="黄昏时的城市屋顶"}、现代训练场或空旷的工业平台。

女主角：
一名 20 出头的年轻中国女性，成年人，采用韩漫风格绘制。她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="粉色芭比风运动装"}，外观时尚且具有女性魅力。她的设计应体现出年轻、敏捷和自信。她拥有轻盈灵巧的身材、清晰的身体线条、纤细而结实的轮廓，动作优雅且充满力量。她的表情和姿态应传达出冷静、专注和从容的自信。

男性对手：
一名成年男性，体格更强壮，更具攻击性。他起初应显得强硬且具有威慑力，与女性的敏捷、技巧和镇定形成视觉对比。

分镜推进：
第 1 格：广角建立镜头。男子与女子在紧张的对峙中分开站立，氛围戏剧化，构图强烈。
第 2 格：特写或中景细节——风格化的眼睛、紧握的双手、准备姿态、格斗开始前微妙的身体张力。
第 3 格：男子率先发起攻击，速度快且力量大。
第 4 格：女子平稳而精准地闪避，运用敏捷的步法和灵活的身体动作。
第 5 格：流畅的动作交换——格挡、滑步、轴心转动和闪避动作，以动态的漫画视角呈现。
第 6 格：格斗升级。女子保持冷静，开始洞察对方的节奏。
第 7 格：转折点。她找到破绽，并以干净利落的技巧进行反击。
第 8 格：视觉冲击力强的动作瞬间——旋转、重定向、扫腿或击倒——展示她掌控局面。
第 9 格：男子倒地或明显战败，气喘吁吁或瘫倒在地。
第 10 格：最终英雄镜头。女子在戏剧性的光线下站立，姿态从容，冷静且获胜。

视觉风格：
韩漫 / 网络漫画风格插画，电影感漫画分镜，精致的线条，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，戏剧性光影，动态动作，富有表现力的姿势，优雅的动作编排，时尚的分镜构图，简洁的背景设计，高细节，色彩鲜艳但受控

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫世界观构建与角色设定表

templates.prompt:
[Desired Output]
World-building Setting Materials + Original Anime Character Setting Materials
*Please visualize not only the character but also the environment, culture, systems, technology, and sense of daily life of the world in which the character lives.

[Worldview Seed]
Enter here

[Number of Proposals]
Enter here
*E.g., only 1 proposal / wish to compare multiple proposals, etc.

[Number of Characters]
Enter here

[Roles/Occupations]
Enter here

[Setting/Environment]
Enter here
*If details are sparse, design new parameters for climate, terrain, resources, dangers, transportation, and housing styles based on the input keywords.

[Society/Systems]
Enter here
*Design community rules, division of labor, status markers, affiliation marks, exchange methods, and rituals that fit the input.

[Technology/Faith/Taboos]
Enter here
*Derive material processing, recording methods, communication, prayers, taboos, festivals, and body decorations naturally from the input content.

[Lifestyle/Culture]
Enter here
*Housing, diet, transportation, work tools, clothing styles, meaning of ornaments, seasonal events, currency, script, emblems, etc.

[Overall Atmosphere]
Enter here

[Characteristics of the World]
Enter here

[Key Priorities]
Enter here

[Finish Direction]
Enter here
*E.g., emphasize realism/life-like feel, emphasize mysticism, emphasize practical utility of costumes, focus more on architecture, target bright children's content, etc.

[Differentiation Instructions]
Enter here

[Drawing Tone]
Smooth line art, flat anime coloring, minimal cel shading, single-level shadows, no gradients, no thick painting, no realistic texture expressions, no strong light/shadow effects, flat look optimized for animation.

[Anime Conversion Instructions]
While maintaining the structure, motifs, color scheme, roles, and cultural meanings of the original design, simplify the drawing for production animation. Use flat anime coloring and keep shadows to one level. Treat translucent materials or thin fabrics as simplified surfaces in a cel-shaded style rather than realistic textures.

Based on the input above, create an image in the style of "World-building Setting Materials + Character Setting Materials" for an original anime.

Purpose:
To visually communicate the world itself in which the character lives, rather than just the character alone. Create setting materials where the world's environment, culture, lifestyle tools, architecture, transportation, and the origins of clothing appear as a unified whole.

Most Important:
First, extract a "visual rule" unique to that world from the input content. Reflect that visual rule in everything: backgrounds, architecture, tools, costumes, color schemes, materials, emblems, and the overall page layout.

Desired Finish:
- Clothing, tools, and housing should look like things actually used by people living in this world.
- Characters, backgrounds, tools, text, and material samples should appear to belong to the same cultural sphere.
- Convey unique environments, resources, and lifestyle habits born from the worldview seed.
- Shapes should arise from necessity in daily life rather than existing genre tropes.
- Feature a unique shape language, color palette, and material feel recognizable at a glance.

Thought Process:
1. Determine the world's "Environment" from input (climate, terrain, light, seasons, dangers, resource distribution).
2. Determine "Lifestyle" from environment (housing, food, work, transport, storage, exchange, recording, celebrations).
3. Determine "Clothing and Tools" from lifestyle (fastening, layering, carrying, protection, showing status/role).
4. Determine "Character Appearance" from clothing/tools (focus on outfits, equipment, materials, colors, and silhouettes rather than just face/hair).
5. Determine "Page Design" from visual rules (reflect recording media, patterns, white space, and diagram styles of that world).

Diversity Enhancement:
Invent a new cultural sphere for each input. If multiple proposals are requested, ensure each has a distinct principle of living, material logic, and aesthetic.

For each proposal, significantly vary:
- Terrain and climate appearance
- Architecture and cityscape shapes
- Primary materials
- Meaning of colors
- Costume silhouettes
- How tools are held, stored, and carried
- Creation of symbols, scripts, patterns, and emblems
- Format of the page layout

Ideation Candidates (not fixed themes, but materials for inspiration):
Environment: Arid lands, cold regions, highlands, wetlands, volcanic ash zones, mirror lakes, misty valleys, high-wind zones, polar night, low gravity, floating strata, glowing mineral caves, etc.
Materials: Paper, bone, ceramics, leather, resin, glass, shell, bamboo, straw, crystals, recycled fabrics, lacquer, ash, feathers, amber, etc.
Culture: Oral traditions, mask culture, scent-based ID, knot-script, shadow puppet records, seasonal migration, silence rituals, dance contracts, etc.
Structure: Folding, wrapping, weaving, hanging, inserting, tying, layering, sealing, engraving, bundling, inflating, etc.

Mandatory Elements:
1. Worldview Board (symbolic landscape, cityscape, lifestyle tools, emblems, color rules, shape language).
2. Character Setting Materials (full-body standing pose, role-conveying outfits, detail diagrams for equipment/back view/belongings).
3. World-Character Connection (ensure clothes/gear logic stems from the world's tech/faith/environment).
4. Page Design (layout varies with worldview, using appropriate diagram methods and minimal labels/symbols).

Quality Standards:
- Not generic fantasy; the world's origins must be visible.
- Cohesive culture across characters and backgrounds.
- Decorations must have lifestyle, faith, or functional meanings.
- Visual differentiation between multiple world proposals.

Visual Presentation:
- High resolution, anime style, delicate line art, clean cel painting.
- Mixed layout of world boards + full-body character + tool details.
- Minimal text, prioritizing visual concept art sheets.

Final Goal:
Ensure a design where the world's establishment, resident life, material constraints, cultural meanings, and community rules are palpable. Create a unified sense where backgrounds and characters are instantly recognizable as belonging to the same unique world.

promptLocalized.zh:
[期望输出]
世界观设定资料 + 原创动漫角色设定资料
*请不仅要构思角色，还要构思角色所处世界的环境、文化、制度、技术以及日常生活感。

[世界观种子]
在此输入

[方案数量]
在此输入
*例如：仅需 1 个方案 / 希望对比多个方案等

[角色数量]
在此输入

[角色/职业]
在此输入

[设定/环境]
在此输入
*如果细节较少，请根据输入的关键词，为气候、地形、资源、危险因素、交通和居住风格设计新的参数。

[社会/制度]
在此输入
*设计符合输入内容的社区规则、分工、身份标识、归属标记、交流方式和仪式。

[技术/信仰/禁忌]
在此输入
*根据输入内容，自然地推导出材料加工、记录方式、通讯、祈祷、禁忌、节日和身体装饰等。

[生活方式/文化]
在此输入
*居住、饮食、交通、工作工具、服装风格、装饰含义、季节性活动、货币、文字、纹章等。

[整体氛围]
在此输入

[世界特征]
在此输入

[关键优先级]
在此输入

[完成方向]
在此输入
*例如：强调写实感/生活气息、强调神秘感、强调服装的实用性、更侧重建筑、面向儿童的明亮风格等。

[差异化说明]
在此输入

[绘画基调]
流畅的线条、平涂动漫风格、极简赛璐珞阴影、单层阴影、无渐变、无厚涂、无写实纹理表现、无强烈的明暗对比，采用适合动画制作的扁平化视觉效果。

[动漫化转换说明]
在保持原始设计的结构、主题、配色、角色和文化含义的同时，简化绘画以适应动画制作。使用平涂动漫风格，并将阴影保持在单层。将半透明材料或薄织物处理为赛璐珞风格的简化平面，而非写实纹理。

基于上述输入，为原创动漫创作一张“世界观设定资料 + 角色设定资料”风格的图像。

目的：
不仅是展示角色，还要直观地传达角色所处的世界本身。创建一套设定资料，使世界的环境、文化、生活工具、建筑、交通和服装起源呈现为一个统一的整体。

最重要的一点：
首先，从输入内容中提取该世界独有的“视觉规则”。将该视觉规则反映在所有元素中：背景、建筑、工具、服装、配色方案、材料、纹章以及整体页面布局。

期望效果：
- 服装、工具和居住环境应看起来像是生活在这个世界的人们实际使用的物品。
- 角色、背景、工具、文字和材料样本应看起来属于同一个文化圈。
- 传达由世界观种子衍生出的独特环境、资源和生活习惯。
- 形状应源于日常生活中的必要性，而非现有的类型化套路。
- 具备一眼即可识别的独特形状语言、调色板和材质感。

思考过程：
1. 根据输入确定世界的“环境”（气候、地形、光照、季节、危险、资源分布）。
2. 根据环境确定“生活方式”（居住、饮食、工作、交通、存储、交换、记录、庆典）。
3. 根据生活方式确定“服装和工具”（固定方式、层叠、携带、防护、展示身份/角色）。
4. 根据服装/工具确定“角色外观”（重点在于服装、装备、材料、颜色和轮廓，而非仅仅是面部/发型）。
5. 根据视觉规则确定“页面设计”（反映该世界的记录媒介、图案、留白和图表风格）。

多样性增强：
为每个输入发明一个新的文化圈。如果要求多个方案，确保每个方案都有独特的生活原则、材料逻辑和审美。

针对每个方案，显著改变：
- 地形和气候外观
- 建筑和城市景观形状
- 主要材料
- 颜色的含义
- 服装轮廓
- 工具的握持、存储和携带方式
- 符号、文字、图案和纹章的创作
- 页面布局格式

构思候选（非固定主题，仅供灵感参考）：
环境：干旱地带、寒冷地区、高地、湿地、火山灰区、镜面湖、雾谷、强风区、极夜、低重力、浮动地层、发光矿洞等。
材料：纸、骨、陶瓷、皮革、树脂、玻璃、贝壳、竹子、稻草、晶体、再生织物、漆、灰、羽毛、琥珀等。
文化：口头传统、面具文化、气味识别、结绳记事、皮影记录、季节性迁徙、静默仪式、舞蹈契约等。
结构：折叠、包裹、编织、悬挂、插入、捆绑、层叠、密封、雕刻、成捆、充气等。

强制要素：
1. 世界观项目（象征性景观、城市景观、生活工具、纹章、颜色规则、形状语言）。
2. 角色设定资料（全身站姿、传达角色的服装、装备/背面/随身物品的细节图）。
3. 世界-角色连接（确保服装/装备的逻辑源于该世界的科技/信仰/环境）。
4. 页面设计（布局随世界观而变，使用适当的图表方法和极简的标签/符号）。

质量标准：
- 非通用的奇幻风格；必须能看出世界的起源。
- 角色与背景之间具有统一的文化感。
- 装饰必须具有生活、信仰或功能意义。
- 多个世界方案之间应有明显的视觉差异。

视觉呈现：
- 高分辨率、动漫风格、精致的线条、干净的赛璐珞上色。
- 世界项目 + 全身角色 + 工具细节的混合布局。
- 文字极简，优先展示视觉概念设计图。

最终目标：
确保设计能让人直观感受到世界的建立、居民的生活、材料的限制、文化含义和社区规则。创造一种统一感，使背景和角色能被一眼识别为属于同一个独特的世界。

templates.title: Character Promotion Poster Framework

titleLocalized.zh: 角色宣传海报框架

templates.prompt:
[Basic Specifications]
- Character promotion poster
- Vertical (9:16) unified key visual
- Composition intended for series development

[Character Design]
- Faithfully reflect the reference image design (hairstyle/face/outfit/motifs)
- Accurately reproduce distinctive elements for high recognizability

[Compositional Structure]
- Hierarchical structure with 'large top, small bottom'
- Upper half: Enlargement of symbolic elements (head/facial outline/mask/upper body silhouette)
- Lower half: Full-body character placement
- Stable standing pose or light movement

[Main Visual Design]
- Strong iconic giant silhouette at the top
- Focus on visual impact
- Convey the character's symbol at a glance

[Collage/Double Exposure]
- Multiple elements contained within the giant silhouette
- Layering scenes, symbolic motifs, and environments
- Building a narrative
- Integrating into mist, ink, or negative space

[World-Building Expression]
- Multiple scenes based on the character's worldview
- Placement of symbolic motifs
- Movement or staging of smaller characters
- Environmental details (nature/architecture/atmosphere)

[Layout (Left-Right Composition)]
- Complementary elements placed on the left and right
- Providing rhythm to the composition
- Creating narrative tension

[Gaze Direction Design]
- A single visual line flowing from top to bottom
- Upper giant silhouette -> internal collage -> lower full-body character
- Continuous visual guidance design

[Margins & Edge Treatment]
- Large use of negative space
- Edge effects: ink bleeding, soft blur, fragmentary decomposition

[Aesthetics & Concept]
- Reflecting Eastern aesthetics: negative space, presence, imperfection
- Coexistence of silence and tension

[Style & Tone]
- Unified visual appearance
- Refined expression
- Restrained tone, avoiding information overload

[Finish Quality]
- High depth of field expression
- Strong visual impact
- Emphasis on storytelling
- Completion level suitable for a poster series

promptLocalized.zh:
[基本规格]
- 角色宣传海报

- 精准复刻标志性特征，确保高辨识度

[构图结构]
- “上大下小”的层级结构
- 上半部分：标志性元素放大（头部/脸部轮廓/面具/上半身剪影）
- 下半部分：角色全身放置
- 稳定的站姿或轻微动态

[主视觉设计]
- 顶部采用强有力的标志性巨型剪影
- 聚焦视觉冲击力
- 一眼传达角色象征

[拼贴/双重曝光]
- 巨型剪影内包含多种元素
- 场景、象征性图案与环境的层叠
- 构建叙事感
- 融入烟雾、水墨或留白中

[世界观表达]
- 基于角色世界观的多重场景
- 象征性图案的布局
- 次要角色的动态或排布
- 环境细节（自然/建筑/氛围）

[布局（左右构图）]
- 左右两侧放置互补元素
- 为构图提供节奏感
- 营造叙事张力

[视线引导设计]
- 从上到下的单一视觉流线
- 顶部巨型剪影 -> 内部拼贴 -> 下部全身角色
- 连续的视觉引导设计

[留白与边缘处理]
- 大量使用负空间（留白）
- 边缘效果：水墨晕染、柔和模糊、碎片化处理

[美学与理念]
- 体现东方美学：留白、意境、残缺美
- 静谧与张力的共存

[风格与基调]
- 统一的视觉外观
- 精致的表达
- 克制的基调，避免信息过载

[成品质量]
- 高景深表现
- 强烈的视觉冲击力
- 强调叙事性
- 达到适合系列海报的完成度

templates.prompt: Please make the results of the research on {argument name="topic" default="ChatGPT 5.5"} look like a 'children's newspaper' made by a preschooler. It should look like it was drawn on white paper using colored pencils and lead pencils. It is a newspaper, but not a proper one. A child worked hard to make it look like a newspaper. In the center, there is a poorly drawn picture that tried to copy an original image. Please do not make it a clean picture. Do not make it a good drawing. Do not make it cute or tidy. Do not make it a skillful child-style illustration. Please make it look like a truly bad drawing that a kindergartner would make. Please make the title look like it was written by a child. Use a strange title at the top like '{argument name="title" default="I Made a Newspaper"}', 'I worked hard on this', or 'This is an important drawing'. The text should be mostly hiragana. The sizes of the letters should be inconsistent. They should not be lined up straight. They should be slightly tilted. Sometimes a letter is too big, sometimes too small. Inside the newspaper, there are poorly written headings. They should say things like '{argument name="heading" default="I wrote this part"}', 'This part was hard', 'I colored it in', 'I made a small mistake', or 'But I did my best'. The lines should be wiggly. Square boxes should not be straight. Circled parts should be weird ovals. Arrows should point in strange directions. It was meant to mimic an original image, but it didn't turn out well at all. Shapes are not proper. Sizes are inconsistent. Large parts are too big, small parts are too small. Eyes, mouths, or bodies are in slightly weird places. The placement is shifted. Something is just a bit off. Colors should bleed out of the lines. There should be uncolored spots. Some areas are colored heavily, others lightly. There should be visible marks from scrubbing hard with colored pencils. In the corner of the newspaper, there should be small, poorly drawn pictures like a sun, star, flower, heart, a weird face, or unidentifiable circles. But please do not make it clean. Do not organize the layout. Do not make it look like professional design. Do not make it like a professional newspaper or a well-done classroom newsletter. Make it look like a child is showing it to you, saying, 'I made this into a newspaper!' or 'Look, I finished it!'. It is a bit bad. Quite bad. The writing is bad. The drawing is bad. The boxes are bad. But the child worked hard to make it. The background is just plain white paper. Finally, just let it be since they worked hard on it. Let the rest happen as it may.

promptLocalized.zh: 请将关于 {argument name="topic" default="ChatGPT 5.5"} 的研究结果制作成一份学龄前儿童制作的“儿童小报”。它看起来应该像是用彩色铅笔和铅笔在白纸上画出来的。这是一份小报，但不是正规的那种。一个孩子努力想让它看起来像份报纸。在中心位置，有一幅画得很差的图画，试图模仿原始图像。请不要把它画得干净利落。不要画得太好。不要画得可爱或整洁。不要画成那种技巧娴熟的儿童插画。请让它看起来像是一个幼儿园小朋友画的真正糟糕的画。请让标题看起来像是孩子写的。在顶部使用奇怪的标题，例如 '{argument name="title" default="我做了一份报纸"}'、“我为此付出了努力”或“这是一幅重要的画”。文字应以平假名为主。字母大小不一。它们不应该排列整齐。它们应该稍微倾斜。有时字母太大，有时太小。小报里有写得很差的标题。它们应该写着类似 '{argument name="heading" default="这一部分是我写的"}'、“这部分很难”、“我涂了颜色”、“我犯了一个小错误”或“但我尽力了”的内容。线条应该是歪歪扭扭的。方框不应该是直的。圆圈部分应该是奇怪的椭圆形。箭头应该指向奇怪的方向。它本意是模仿原始图像，但结果却一点也不像。形状不规范。大小不一致。大的部分太大，小的部分太小。眼睛、嘴巴或身体的位置稍微有点奇怪。布局发生了偏移。有些地方就是有点不对劲。颜色应该溢出线条。应该有没涂色的地方。有些区域涂得很重，有些则很轻。应该能看到用力涂抹彩色铅笔留下的痕迹。在小报的角落里，应该有一些画得很差的小图，比如太阳、星星、花朵、爱心、奇怪的脸或无法辨认的圆圈。但请不要让它看起来很整洁。不要整理布局。不要让它看起来像专业设计。不要让它看起来像专业报纸或制作精良的班级通讯。让它看起来就像一个孩子拿给你看，说：“我把它做成了一份报纸！”或者“看，我完成了！”。它有点糟糕。相当糟糕。字写得很差。画画得很差。方框画得很差。但孩子为了制作它付出了努力。背景就是普通的白纸。最后，既然孩子付出了努力，就让它保持原样吧。顺其自然就好。

templates.title: Cinematic Seed Life Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感种子生命周期项目

templates.prompt: A 2x5 storyboard grid of 10 frames for a 15-second photorealistic CGI animated short film, {argument name="aesthetic" default="BBC Planet Earth documentary aesthetic"}, macro cinematography, rich greens and golden hour light, natural soft shadows, extreme scale shifts from micro to macro. Theme: {argument name="theme" default="a single seed's journey blown by wind, surviving a storm, slowly growing into a great tree full of life"}. Frames: (1) extreme wide autumn forest, single seed released from a tall tree, golden bokeh background; (2) macro tracking shot - seed floating through air, passing insects and leaves, delicate and small; (3) slow-motion impact - seed lands on soft soil, dirt particles scatter, raindrop falls beside it; (4) surreal underground macro - roots beginning to grow in darkness, microscopic and beautiful; (5) wide dramatic shot - violent storm raging, everything uprooted, but the seed's spot stays still; (6) macro close-up - first green sprout breaking through soil, morning dew on tip, sunlight catching it; (7) accelerated growth sequence - sapling rising, seasons shifting, light and shadow changing, alive; (8) wide shot - juvenile tree now standing, birds arriving, leaves rustling gently in wind; (9) medium warm shot - children playing in the tree's shade, a bird building a nest in the branches; (10) mirror wide shot - framed from the angle of the original tall tree, the new great tree now stands in its place circle of life.

templates.title: Motivational Welcome to May Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 五月励志欢迎海报

templates.prompt:
Design a premium motivational social media poster in a dark cinematic editorial style, vertical 4:5 format. The composition is split into 2 main zones: a left text-heavy layout and a right aspirational visual scene. Use a black to deep charcoal background with subtle texture, faint vertical ribbed wall detail on the right, glossy floor reflections, and elegant neon-lime accent lighting mixed with warm gold highlights.

On the right side, show 1 human figure: a man in silhouette from behind, wearing a fitted dark jacket and pants, walking toward a giant circular portal doorway. The portal should be large, glowing with a warm golden ring and soft inner halo, positioned slightly right of center. Beyond the portal is a bright peaceful nature scene with 1 narrow stepping-stone path leading forward through grass, soft sunlight, distant haze, and leafy green tree branches framing the upper edge. The figure should feel purposeful and contemplative, stepping into a new beginning.

On the left side, create a clean motivational typography layout. At the top, include a small header reading "NEW MONTH" in spaced uppercase sans serif, with a short thin lime line to its left. Below it, place the main headline in 2 lines: "WELCOME TO" in large warm beige uppercase, and "{argument name="headline text" default="MAY"}" in extremely large bold white uppercase, dominating the left half. Add a short glowing lime underline beneath the large month word.

Under the headline, add a motivational paragraph in white sans serif with selected words highlighted in lime green: "May is a fresh start. A new chapter. A greater opportunity to become more, do more and have more." Highlight the words "fresh start," "new," "opportunity," and "more" in lime green.

Below that, place 1 rounded rectangular callout card with a subtle border glow. Inside the card, put 1 circular icon badge containing a simple leaf symbol in lime green. To the right of the icon, add 3 stacked lines of text: "New month.", "Fresh energy.", and "Bigger moves." with the last line in lime green.

Across the lower middle, create 4 evenly spaced value pillars separated by thin vertical dividers. Each pillar contains 1 minimalist lime icon, 1 uppercase title, and 1 short caption. Use these exact 4 items from left to right: 1) target icon, title "CLARITY", caption "Know your direction". 2) calendar icon, title "DISCIPLINE", caption "Stay consistent". 3) upward bar chart icon, title "GROWTH", caption "Keep evolving". 4) fast-forward arrows icon, title "MOMENTUM", caption "Build forward daily".

At the bottom, add a thin horizontal divider line. Under it, place a closing statement in uppercase: "THIS IS YOUR {argument name="month name" default="MAY"}." on one line and "{argument name="closing line" default="STEP INTO IT."}" on the next line. Render most text in white or warm beige, with "MAY" and select accents in lime green.

Overall mood: inspirational, modern, luxurious, focused, forward-moving, social-media-ready, with crisp sans serif typography, high contrast, cinematic glow, and a polished personal development brand aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一张高端励志社交媒体海报，采用深色电影质感编辑风格，比例为 4:5 竖版。画面分为 2 个主要区域：左侧为文字排版区，右侧为愿景视觉区。背景使用黑色至深炭灰色，带有细腻纹理，右侧有淡淡的竖条纹墙面细节，地面有光泽反射，并融合优雅的霓虹青柠色强调光与暖金色高光。

在右侧，展示 1 位人物：一名身穿修身深色夹克和长裤的男性背影，正走向一个巨大的圆形传送门。传送门应足够大，散发着暖金色的光环和柔和的内部光晕，位置略偏右侧。传送门后方是一个宁静明亮的自然场景，有一条狭窄的踏脚石小径向前延伸，穿过草地，伴有柔和的阳光、远处的薄雾，上方边缘由绿叶树枝环绕。人物应呈现出坚定且深思的状态，迈向新的开始。

在左侧，创建简洁的励志排版。顶部包含一个小标题“NEW MONTH”，使用间距较大的大写无衬线字体，左侧配有一条细短的青柠色线条。下方放置 2 行主标题：“WELCOME TO”使用大号暖米色大写字体，以及“{argument name="headline text" default="MAY"}”使用超大加粗白色大写字体，占据左侧半部分的主导地位。在大号月份单词下方添加一条发光的青柠色短下划线。

在标题下方，添加一段白色无衬线字体的励志段落，并将部分词汇高亮为青柠色：“May is a fresh start. A new chapter. A greater opportunity to become more, do more and have more.” 将“fresh start”、“new”、“opportunity”和“more”高亮为青柠色。

在此下方，放置 1 张带有微弱边框光晕的圆角矩形标注卡片。卡片内包含 1 个圆形图标徽章，内含一个简单的青柠色叶子符号。图标右侧添加 3 行堆叠文字：“New month.”、“Fresh energy.” 和 “Bigger moves.”，最后一行使用青柠色。

在画面中下部，创建 4 个等间距的价值支柱，由细竖线分隔。每个支柱包含 1 个极简青柠色图标、1 个大写标题和 1 段简短说明。从左至右依次使用以下 4 项：1) 目标图标，标题“CLARITY”，说明“Know your direction”。2) 日历图标，标题“DISCIPLINE”，说明“Stay consistent”。3) 上升柱状图图标，标题“GROWTH”，说明“Keep evolving”。4) 快进箭头图标，标题“MOMENTUM”，说明“Build forward daily”。

在底部，添加一条细水平分割线。下方放置一行大写结束语：“THIS IS YOUR {argument name="month name" default="MAY"}.”，下一行放置“{argument name="closing line" default="STEP INTO IT."}”。大部分文字使用白色或暖米色，其中“MAY”及部分强调内容使用青柠色。

整体氛围：励志、现代、奢华、专注、积极进取，适合社交媒体发布，具有清晰的无衬线排版、高对比度、电影级光效以及精致的个人成长品牌美学。

templates.prompt: A stylized 3D low-poly cartoon scene of a skinny disheveled young man slouching in a plush blue armchair in a wood-paneled room, viewed in a medium-wide shot from slightly below table height. He has messy dark brown dreadlock-like hair, pale skin, droopy half-lidded eyes, and a huge open mouth showing uneven white teeth, with an exaggerated goofy expression. His pose is loose and lazy: one leg stretched far out and resting on the coffee table, the other bent up on the chair, one hand holding a small smoking item near his face with a tiny red ember, the other hand holding a gray remote control. He wears a {argument name="shirt color" default="royal blue"} T-shirt, {argument name="shorts color" default="mustard yellow"} shorts, long white socks, and oversized red slide sandals. In front of him is a rectangular wooden coffee table with 3 clearly visible items on top: a pile of bright green buds at the center front, 1 folded white paper beside the pile, and 1 round gray ashtray with dark ash near the right side. The room is simple and warm-toned with vertical wooden wall panels, a dark wood floor, soft indoor lighting, and a small cropped section of framed wall decor in the upper right corner. The overall look is humorous, rough-edged, and handcrafted, like an indie animated sitcom made from painted paper-cutout or low-poly clay textures, with muted shadows, slightly worn surfaces, and a casual stoner-lounge vibe.

templates.title: Add Cinematic Centered Title Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 添加电影感居中标题横幅

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base artwork, expand it into a wide cinematic banner while preserving the same surreal abandoned library scene, composition, mood, and painterly lighting. Add a single centered title across the middle: {argument name="headline text" default="MNEMOS"}. Set the text in a tall, clean, widely tracked all-caps sans-serif, bright warm white, sized large enough to span most of the frame width. Make the lettering feel integrated into the scene rather than pasted on: add a very subtle soft glow, a gentle shadow for readability, and a slightly dimmed outline or edge contrast so it sits naturally against the dark shelves and clouds. Keep the background untouched except for any minimal tonal balancing needed to improve text legibility and make the overall image look subtly more polished.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为基础艺术作品，将其扩展为宽屏电影感横幅，同时保留相同的超现实废弃图书馆场景、构图、氛围和绘画感光影。在画面正中央添加一个居中标题：{argument name="headline text" default="MNEMOS"}。文字采用高挑、简洁、字间距较宽的全大写无衬线字体，颜色为明亮的暖白色，大小需足以横跨大部分画面宽度。让文字看起来像是融入场景而非简单粘贴：添加非常柔和的微光、用于提高可读性的轻微阴影，以及略微暗淡的轮廓或边缘对比度，使其自然地置于深色书架和云雾背景之上。保持背景不变，仅进行必要的微小色调平衡，以提升文字易读性，并使整体图像看起来更加精致。

templates.title: Futuristic Life System Hologram Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感生活系统全息肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic vertical night photo of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} sitting indoors in a modern apartment kitchen-living space, looking down at a glowing smartphone held with both hands. Her face is mostly obscured by shadow and framing, with dark hair parted in the middle and pulled into a low bun. She wears a silky slate-blue spaghetti-strap slip dress and layered gold necklaces, including a nameplate necklace that reads {argument name="necklace text" default="Angel"}. The scene is lit by moody blue, violet, and cyan ambient lighting from the room and the phone screen, creating a futuristic cyber-luxury atmosphere. Floating holographic augmented-reality interface panels emerge from the phone and hover in front of her chest and upper torso, semi-transparent neon blue and purple with thin glowing outlines, tiny particles, and digital spark effects. Show exactly 5 visible UI panels and labels: a top-left system label reading {argument name="system label" default="LIFE SYSTEM"}; a large left panel reading "Identity Status: VERIFIED (concept)" with a circular profile icon and a digital globe visualization; a center-right panel reading "Health Sync: STABLE" with a waveform-like pattern; a lower-left panel reading "Finance Flow: ACTIVE" with small bar and line charts; a lower-right panel reading "Access Level: GLOBAL"; and a small narrow panel between them reading "Habits Initialization". Modern dark wood kitchen cabinets and a softly blurred countertop sit in the background, with subtle practical lights and a window glow at left. Shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric texture, premium smartphone photography look, soft bloom, low-light realism, high contrast, futuristic yet believable near-future interface design, vertical 9:16 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感的垂直夜景照片，展示了一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 坐在现代公寓的厨房兼起居空间内，低头看着双手持握的闪光智能手机。她的面部大部分被阴影和构图遮挡，深色头发中分并扎成低发髻。她身穿丝滑的石板蓝细肩带吊带裙，佩戴着叠戴的金项链，其中包括一条刻有 {argument name="necklace text" default="Angel"} 的姓名牌项链。场景由房间和手机屏幕发出的忧郁蓝、紫、青色环境光照亮，营造出一种未来主义的赛博奢华氛围。悬浮的全息增强现实界面面板从手机中浮现，悬浮在她的胸前和上半身，呈现半透明的霓虹蓝紫色，带有纤细的发光轮廓、微小粒子和数字火花效果。展示 5 个清晰可见的 UI 面板和标签：左上角的系统标签显示 {argument name="system label" default="LIFE SYSTEM"}；左侧的大面板显示“Identity Status: VERIFIED (concept)”，配有圆形个人资料图标和数字地球可视化；中右侧面板显示“Health Sync: STABLE”，配有波形图案；左下侧面板显示“Finance Flow: ACTIVE”，配有小型柱状图和折线图；右下侧面板显示“Access Level: GLOBAL”；以及它们之间的一个狭窄小面板，显示“Habits Initialization”。背景是现代深色木质厨房橱柜和柔和模糊的台面，左侧有微妙的实用灯光和窗户余晖。浅景深，逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，高级智能手机摄影质感，柔光效果，低光真实感，高对比度，未来感但可信的近未来界面设计，9:16 垂直构图。
