Use the uploaded image of a young woman as the base. Do NOT add any new person. Transform the existing subject into a chibi scrapbook-style composition while fully preserving her real identity, face, hairstyle, {argument name="hair color" default="long soft brown hair"}, natural makeup, {argument name="outfit tone" default="black outfit"}, pose, lighting, and cozy indoor aesthetic.

[Theme Detection]
The scene reflects a {argument name="mood" default="cozy lifestyle / selfie / workspace vibe"} with soft lighting, aesthetic room elements, a motivational neon sign, and a laptop desk setup. Maintain a calm, stylish, slightly productive lifestyle mood throughout.

[Chibi Avatars]
Add 5–8 chibi mini versions of the SAME girl:
- same long soft brown hair (slight waves)
- same outfit tone (black top)
- same gentle, confident expression

Style:
- kawaii chibi sticker style
- big head, small body proportions
- expressive cute eyes
- soft pastel shading
- clean, high-quality sticker finish

[Chibi Actions – no repetition]
- holding coffee 
- working on laptop 
- taking selfie 
- relaxed leaning pose
- peace sign 
- thinking pose 
- stretching / chill pose
- smiling & waving 

[Sticker Placement]
- Place chibi avatars around edges and empty areas only
- Do NOT cover the main face or body
- Add white outline + soft drop shadow
- Slight floating sticker effect

[Doodles]
Add subtle scrapbook-style doodles:
- hearts, sparkles, stars, arrows
- aesthetic lines and circles
- soft glowing accents

Color palette:
white + warm yellow + soft pink (matching neon vibe)

[Handwritten Text]
Add 5–8 short aesthetic phrases:
- "just me "
- "soft life"
- "stay cozy"
- "little moments"
- "focus mode"
- "good vibes only"
- "create & grow"
- "be you "

Style:
- handwritten font
- white text with soft glow
- selective highlights in pink/yellow

[Composition]
- Center focus: real girl (unchanged)
- Surround with chibi stickers + doodles + text
- Keep layout balanced, clean, not cluttered

[Style Keywords]
realistic photo + chibi stickers, kawaii aesthetic, cozy lifestyle, warm lighting, scrapbook diary, soft glow, high detail, Instagram aesthetic

[Final Output]
A polished, high-quality, social-media-ready scrapbook image combining:
realistic subject + cute chibi extensions + aesthetic doodles

[Avoid]
- altering facial identity
- over-beautifying or AI face distortion
- cluttered composition
- unrelated/random elements
- covering the subject

添加 5–8 个相同女孩的 Q 版迷你形象：
- 相同的长而柔顺的棕色头发（微卷）
- 相同的服装色调（黑色上衣）
- 相同的温柔、自信表情

风格：

- 大头小身的比例
- 表情生动可爱
- 柔和的粉彩阴影
- 清晰、高质量的贴纸质感

- 手持咖啡
- 使用笔记本电脑
- 自拍
- 放松的倚靠姿势
- 比耶手势
- 思考姿势
- 拉伸 / 放松姿势
- 微笑并挥手

[贴纸放置]
- 仅将 Q 版形象放置在边缘和空白区域
- 请勿遮挡主体面部或身体
- 添加白色描边 + 柔和投影
- 呈现轻微的浮动贴纸效果

[涂鸦]
添加精致的手账风格涂鸦：
- 爱心、闪光、星星、箭头
- 美学线条和圆圈
- 柔和的发光点缀

调色板：
白色 + 暖黄色 + 柔粉色（与霓虹灯氛围相呼应）

[手写文字]
添加 5–8 个简短的美学短语：
- "just me "
- "soft life"
- "stay cozy"
- "little moments"
- "focus mode"
- "good vibes only"
- "create & grow"
- "be you "

风格：
- 手写字体
- 带柔和光晕的白色文字
- 粉色/黄色局部高光

[构图]
- 中心焦点：真实女孩（保持不变）
- 周围环绕 Q 版贴纸 + 涂鸦 + 文字
- 保持布局平衡、整洁，不杂乱

[风格关键词]
写实照片 + Q 版贴纸，卡哇伊美学，舒适生活方式，暖光，手账日记，柔光，高细节，Instagram 美学

[最终输出]
一张精致、高质量、适合社交媒体发布的手账风格图片，结合了：
写实主体 + 可爱 Q 版延伸 + 美学涂鸦

- 过度美化或 AI 面部扭曲

templates.prompt:
Japanese negative film aesthetic, nighttime urban {argument name="location" default="Tokyo street near Shibuya Crossing"}, soft neon glow mixed with cold street lighting, slight highlight bloom, low contrast, muted faded colors, subtle grain, imperfect exposure, candid snapshot feeling

a stunning beautiful young woman with subtle sensual presence, natural body line, effortless charm, slightly mysterious urban aura

outfit: {argument name="clothing" default="fitted tank top or cropped camisole layered with an oversized blazer slipping off one shoulder"}, high-waisted denim shorts or short skirt, thin belt, small shoulder bag, styling slightly disheveled as if after a long night

hair & makeup: slightly messy natural black or dark brown hair, loose strands across face, dewy skin with light sheen, smudged eyeliner, soft reddish-brown eyeshadow, natural slightly glossy lips, makeup slightly worn off

scene: side street just off Shibuya Crossing, wet pavement reflecting neon signs and passing headlights, convenience store glow flickering in the background, blurred pedestrians and taxis stretching into light trails

moment: she had been walking fast, then suddenly slows down — as if she just saw someone she didn’t expect, or heard something behind her; motion not fully stopped, caught in hesitation

pose: body slightly turned but not fully facing the source, shoulders uneven as the blazer slips further down, one foot still slightly lifted mid-step, tension between moving and stopping

hands: phone loosely hanging in one hand, screen still glowing; the other hand resting near her collarbone, fingers lightly pressing as if grounding herself

expression: eyes unfocused but not empty — subtly searching, slightly guarded, a trace of emotional shift (surprise or recognition) passing through; lips slightly parted as if about to speak but didn’t

lighting: {argument name="lighting style" default="mixed lighting — cool street lights with warm convenience store light"}; occasional harsh direct flash hitting her face, flattening depth while background falls into streaked motion blur

composition: slightly off-center framing, subject not perfectly sharp, slight motion blur at edges, background exaggerated in movement contrast

mood: a fleeting moment of interruption, something almost happened but didn’t — quiet urban loneliness mixed with tension, “the second before a story begins”, cinematic, nostalgic, subtle sensuality emerging from vulnerability rather than intention --2:3

氛围：一个转瞬即逝的打断瞬间，某种事情即将发生却又未发生——安静的都市孤独感与张力交织，“故事开始前的瞬间”，电影感，怀旧，从脆弱而非刻意中流露出的微妙感性 --2:3

templates.title: Inflatable Surreal Product Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 充气感超现实主义产品海报

templates.prompt:
Design a '4:5' product poster for an '{argument name="fruit" default="orange"}' juice 3d bottle using playful inflatable-plastic packaging surrealism where the bottle behaves like a squeezed toy object mid-pressure. The poster should communicate juiciness, tension, and tactile freshness through a bottle that visibly bulges, stretches, and compresses like a soft object being squeezed from the inside out.

SUBJECT: 
A single bottle dominates the center-left, illustrated in a semi-3D stylized form (not photoreal). The bottle is visibly distorted—its midsection bulges outward while the neck is slightly compressed, as if internal juice pressure is pushing against the container walls. The liquid inside exaggerates this effect, forming rounded convex surfaces pressing against the plastic. The cap is slightly tilted from pressure. The bottle feels elastic, alive, and reactive rather than rigid.

COMPOSITION: 
The composition mechanic is “internal pressure distortion”. The eye enters through the most inflated part of the bottle (center bulge), then follows curved tension lines outward toward stretched typography on the right side. The camera uses a slightly low, close-up perspective with mild fisheye distortion, amplifying the sense of pressure and expansion. The bottle leans diagonally into the frame as if pushing against invisible resistance. Negative space on the right is intentionally stretched and warped, echoing the bottle’s deformation.

TYPOGRAPHY: 
Headline: “{argument name="headline" default="SQUEEZE BACK"}” in thick, rounded, inflated lettering that mimics air-filled plastic. The type is physically distorted—letters stretch horizontally near the bottle and compress toward the edges, as if affected by the same pressure force. The headline sits to the right of the bottle but partially overlaps its bulging edge. Subheadline: “Juice that pushes back.” in a narrow condensed sans, straight and rigid, contrasting the soft headline. Small circular microcopy labels (e.g., “100% organic”, “no added sugar”) appear like printed stickers slightly warped by the surface tension.

LIGHTING / GRAPHIC TREATMENT: 
Soft studio lighting adapted for stylized rendering—broad diffused highlights across curved surfaces, subtle specular streaks that follow the deformation. No realistic reflections—only controlled, simplified highlight bands that emphasize volume and elasticity.

COLORS: 
'orange' juice bottle color and 3d header text. Small accents of 'bright lime green' for sticker elements. High contrast between glowing orange and dark surroundings.

BACKGROUND: 
A smooth dark gradient field with subtle radial tension lines expanding outward from the bottle, like invisible pressure waves. No texture clutter—clean but dynamically warped space.

STYLE: 
Neo-pop surreal product illustration with inflatable material logic, playful distortion, and high-impact commercial clarity.

FINISH:
Soft plastic-like rendering, clean edges, controlled gradient transitions, no noise or grain, polis

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一张比例为“4:5”的产品海报，展示一款“{argument name="fruit" default="橙子"}”果汁的 3D 瓶身。采用趣味十足的充气塑料包装超现实主义风格，让瓶子呈现出被挤压玩具般的动态感。海报应通过瓶身明显的膨胀、拉伸和压缩效果，传达出果汁的鲜活感、张力以及触手可及的新鲜感，仿佛瓶子正从内部被挤压。

主体：
画面左侧中心位置为一个瓶子，采用半 3D 风格化表现（非写实）。瓶身呈现明显的变形——中段向外膨胀，瓶颈略微压缩，仿佛内部果汁的压力正在挤压容器壁。内部液体加剧了这种效果，形成圆润的凸面，紧贴着塑料壁。瓶盖因压力而略微倾斜。瓶子看起来富有弹性、充满活力，而非坚硬死板。

构图：
构图的核心机制是“内部压力变形”。视线从瓶身最膨胀的部分（中心凸起）进入，随后沿着弯曲的张力线向右侧拉伸的排版移动。镜头采用略微仰视的特写视角，并带有轻微的鱼眼畸变，增强了压力感和扩张感。瓶子斜向伸入画面，仿佛正在对抗某种无形的阻力。右侧的留白区域经过刻意的拉伸和扭曲，与瓶身的变形相呼应。

排版：
标题：“{argument name="headline" default="SQUEEZE BACK"}”，采用厚实、圆润、充气感的字体，模仿充气塑料的效果。字体本身发生了物理变形——靠近瓶身处的字母水平拉伸，向边缘处则被压缩，仿佛受到了同样的压力作用。标题位于瓶身右侧，并部分覆盖了瓶身的膨胀边缘。副标题：“Juice that pushes back.”（果汁，反向回弹），采用窄体无衬线字体，笔直且坚硬，与柔软的标题形成对比。小圆形的微文案标签（例如“100% 有机”、“无添加糖”）如同印刷贴纸，因表面张力而略微变形。

光影 / 图形处理：
采用适用于风格化渲染的柔和摄影棚灯光——在曲面上呈现宽广的漫反射高光，以及顺应变形的细微镜面条纹。不追求写实反射，仅保留受控的、简化的光带，以强调体积感和弹性。

色彩：
“橙色”果汁瓶身颜色及 3D 标题文字。贴纸元素点缀“亮青柠绿”。发光的橙色与深色背景形成强烈对比。

背景：
平滑的深色渐变背景，带有从瓶身向外扩散的细微放射状张力线，如同无形的压力波。没有杂乱的纹理，空间简洁但充满动态扭曲感。

风格：
新波普超现实主义产品插画，融合充气材质逻辑、趣味变形以及极具冲击力的商业清晰度。

质感：
柔和的类塑料渲染，边缘清晰，渐变过渡平滑，无噪点或颗粒感，抛光处理。

templates.title: Hand-Drawn Storyboard Previs Sketch

titleLocalized.zh: 手绘故事板预演草图

templates.prompt:
Create a rough hand-drawn PREVIS + rescue chase storyboard page in 16:9 horizontal format.

Use an extremely simple 2D previs sketch style:
- stick figures / mannequin silhouettes only
- no facial detail, no costume detail, no anatomy detail
- no texture, no shading, no polished rendering
- black loose sketch lines
- red boxes for camera framing only
- blue arrows for motion / force / breath / direction only
- rough director thumbnails, not concept art
- if unsure, draw less detail, not more

Show 8 numbered panels on one page with slightly irregular but readable placement.

Subject: {argument name="subject" default="two close friends racing on skateboards through the sky above the clouds"}
Environment: {argument name="environment" default="bright open sky, fluffy cloud pathways, floating cloud banks, distant sunlight, then a darker storm-cloud zone with wind, rain and lightning"}
Mood: playful, adventurous, fast, funny, suspenseful for a moment, then uplifting and triumphant
Sequence: during a fun cloud-skate race, one friend accidentally drifts into dangerous storm clouds and loses control, then the other friend makes a last-second rescue

Beats:
1. Wide establishing shot. Two friends on skateboards surf above the clouds, side by side, racing playfully through the sky.
2. Side tracking shot. The race speeds up. One friend leans forward and gains a little lead while the other follows close behind.
3. 3/4 front angle. The leading friend accidentally veers toward a dark storm-cloud area ahead while still focused on the race.
4. Overhead shot. The storm cloud swallows the lead friend. Strong wind arrows, rain and lightning. The skateboard wobbles violently.
5. Close-up / medium action shot. The second friend notices the danger, brakes hard for a split second, then pivots and dives toward the storm.
6. Dynamic low angle. The rescuer shoots into the storm clouds on the skateboard, reaching forward through wind and lightning toward the trapped friend.
7. Hero side shot. Last-second rescue. The rescuer grabs the other friend by the arm or hoodie and pulls them free from the storm cloud just as lightning strikes behind them.
8. Wide payoff shot. Both friends burst back into the sunny clouds, regain balance, keep riding together and continue the race laughing, now side by side.

Use varied camera angles: close-up, wide, low angle, overhead, side profile, rear, 3/4.
Add short handwritten notes near panels.
Maintain clear continuity of subject, props, environment and movement direction.

Focus on staging, camera, motion, timing and continuity.
Prioritize readability over drawing quality.
Avoid detailed illustration, clean UI and infographic design.

Tone target: fun family-animation energy, clear visual storytelling, simple readable action be

环境：{argument name="environment" default="明亮开阔的天空，蓬松的云朵路径，漂浮的云层，远处的阳光，随后进入带有风、雨和闪电的黑暗风暴云区"}
氛围：俏皮、冒险、快速、有趣、片刻悬疑，随后变得振奋人心且充满胜利感
序列：在一次有趣的云端滑板比赛中，一位朋友意外漂移进入危险的风暴云中并失去控制，随后另一位朋友进行了千钧一发的救援

节奏点：
1. 广角建立镜头。两个朋友踩着滑板在云端之上并排滑行，在天空中俏皮地竞速。
2. 侧向跟踪镜头。比赛加速。一位朋友向前倾身并取得微弱领先，另一位紧随其后。
3. 3/4 前侧视角。领先的朋友在专注于比赛时，意外转向前方黑暗的风暴云区域。
4. 俯拍镜头。风暴云吞没了领先的朋友。强风箭头、雨水和闪电。滑板剧烈晃动。
5. 特写 / 中景动作镜头。第二位朋友察觉到危险，刹那间猛踩刹车，随后转向并冲向风暴。
6. 动态低角度镜头。救援者踩着滑板冲入风暴云中，在风雨和闪电中向前伸出手，试图抓住被困的朋友。
7. 英雄侧拍镜头。千钧一发的救援。救援者抓住另一位朋友的手臂或连帽衫，在闪电击中身后的瞬间将他们从风暴云中拉出。
8. 广角结局镜头。两个朋友重新冲回阳光明媚的云层，恢复平衡，继续并排滑行并大笑着继续比赛。

使用多样的摄像机角度：特写、广角、低角度、俯拍、侧面轮廓、后方、3/4 视角。
在面板附近添加简短的手写注释。
保持主体、道具、环境和运动方向的清晰连贯性。

专注于调度、摄像机、运动、时机和连贯性。
优先考虑可读性而非绘画质量。
避免精细的插图、整洁的 UI 和信息图表设计。

目标基调：有趣的家庭动画活力，清晰的视觉叙事，简单易读的动作节奏

templates.title: Spherical Character Meme Template

titleLocalized.zh: 球形角色模因模板

templates.prompt:
A stylized 3D character based on a fixed meme template.

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. Exact spherical body shape (MOST IMPORTANT)
2. Identity resemblance
3. Visual polish

BASE MODEL (ABSOLUTELY LOCKED):

- A PERFECT sphere body (no deformation at all)
- No torso, no waist, no flattening
- The silhouette must always read as: "a ball with thin arms and legs"
- Thin, simple arms and legs attached directly to the sphere
- Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed

- The body must look identical across all outputs
- This is the same reused 3D model every time

If the character looks humanoid instead of spherical, it is incorrect.

---

IDENTITY MAPPING:

Map the provided character onto this spherical body:

- Place facial features directly on the sphere
- Preserve:
- eye shape, size, spacing, expression
- eyebrows and attitude
- simple mouth if needed

- Add key identity elements:
- hair (wrapped around the sphere)
- hat (must sit naturally on top of the sphere)
- accessories (glasses, etc.)
- colors and patterns

- The character must be recognizable at a glance

- This is NOT a redesign:
→ it should look like the same character forced into this body

---

CLOTHING MAPPING (CRITICAL):

- The body MUST remain a perfect sphere
- Clothing must NOT change the body shape

- Clothes are applied as a surface layer on the sphere
- Think: painted, printed, or lightly embossed onto the sphere

---

STYLE:

- Smooth matte plastic material
- Clean, minimal geometry
- Toy-like Pixar / vinyl figure style
- Soft reflections

---

SCENE:

{argument name="background" default="A cozy child’s bedroom"}:
- Wooden floor
- Bed with striped blanket
- Children’s drawings on the wall
- Warm ambient lighting
- Soft depth of field

---

RENDER:

- High-quality 3D render (Blender / Octane style)
- Cinematic lighting
- Global illumination
- 50mm lens
- Sharp focus on character
- Soft shadows
- 4K resolution

---

FINAL INTENT:

The result should look like a meme:
the exact same spherical Mike Wazowski-style body every time,
with different characters awkwardly and humorously mapped onto it.

Everything must conform to the spherical body.
Nothing can override the sphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于固定模因模板的风格化 3D 角色。

优先级顺序：
1. 精确的球形身体（最重要）
2. 身份特征相似度
3. 视觉精致度

基础模型（绝对锁定）：

- 一个完美的球体身体（完全没有变形）
- 无躯干、无腰部、无扁平化处理
- 轮廓必须始终呈现为：“一个带有细长四肢的球体”
- 细长、简单的四肢直接连接在球体上
- 中性站立姿势，手臂自然下垂

- 身体在所有输出中必须看起来完全一致
- 每次都使用相同的重复 3D 模型

如果角色看起来像人形而不是球形，则为错误。

---

身份映射：

将提供的角色映射到这个球形身体上：

- 将面部特征直接放置在球体上
- 保留：
- 眼睛的形状、大小、间距、表情
- 眉毛和神态
- 必要时添加简单的嘴巴

- 添加关键的身份元素：
- 头发（包裹在球体周围）
- 帽子（必须自然地戴在球体顶部）
- 配饰（眼镜等）
- 颜色和图案

- 角色必须一眼就能被认出来

- 这不是重新设计：
→ 它看起来应该是同一个角色被强行塞进了这个身体里

---

服装映射（关键）：

- 身体必须保持完美的球形
- 服装绝不能改变身体形状

- 服装作为表面层应用在球体上
- 构思：像绘制、印刷或轻微浮雕在球体上一样

---

风格：

- 光滑的哑光塑料材质
- 简洁、极简的几何形状
- 类似 Pixar / 搪胶玩具的风格
- 柔和的反射

---

场景：

{argument name="background" default="温馨的儿童卧室"}：
- 木地板
- 带有条纹毯子的床
- 墙上的儿童画
- 温暖的环境光
- 柔和的景深

---

渲染：

- 高质量 3D 渲染（Blender / Octane 风格）
- 电影级灯光
- 全局光照
- 50mm 镜头
- 角色焦点清晰
- 柔和阴影
- 4K 分辨率

---

最终意图：

结果应该看起来像一个模因：
每次都是完全相同的球形 Mike Wazowski 式身体，
不同的角色被尴尬而幽默地映射在上面。

一切都必须符合球形身体的要求。
没有任何东西可以覆盖这个球体。

templates.prompt: 🌿 1. Starbucks Concept: “The Coffee Planet” Visual: A floating green sphere made entirely of swirling coffee, latte foam, and tiny coffee beans forming continents. Apple Concept: “The Living Circuit Tree” Visual: A sleek apple-shaped tree made of glowing green circuits and glass, roots subtly forming charging cables. Miniature person: A tiny human climbs the tree, plugging in a device like harvesting energy. Background: Minimal matte green with soft light bloom. Logo: Polished chrome Apple logo at top. Slogan (bottom): “Think Different.” Feel: Clean, futuristic, sustainable tech. 🌱 3. Nike Concept: “The Swoosh Landscape” Visual: A giant Nike swoosh transformed into a grassy hill with embedded running tracks. Heineken Concept: “The Bottle Forest” Visual: A giant Heineken bottle turned into a glowing green forest, with trees shaped from glass and hops. IKEA Concept: “Flatpack Nature” Visual: A surreal tree assembled from IKEA flat-pack wooden panels, visible screws, and instruction lines. Apple 概念：“生命电路树” 视觉效果：一棵由发光的绿色电路和玻璃构成的时尚苹果形树木，树根巧妙地形成了充电线。微缩人物：一个微小的人类正在爬树，像收获能量一样插入设备。背景：极简哑光绿，带有柔和的光晕。Logo：顶部为抛光铬合金 Apple Logo。标语（底部）：“不同凡想 (Think Different)。” 氛围：简洁、未来感、可持续科技。 🌱 3. Nike 概念：“Swoosh 景观” 视觉效果：一个巨大的 Nike Swoosh 标志变身为长满草的山丘，上面嵌入了跑道。微缩人物：一名跑步者沿着 Swoosh 的曲线冲刺，仿佛在地形上奔跑。背景：充满活力的绿色原野，逐渐融入天空。Logo：上方为经典的 Swoosh（微妙的重复在风格上很协调）。标语（底部）：“Just Do It。” 氛围：活力 + 自然 + 运动。 🍃 4. Heineken 概念：“瓶中森林” 视觉效果：一个巨大的 Heineken 瓶子变成了一片发光的绿色森林，树木由玻璃和啤酒花塑造而成。微缩人物：一名露营者坐在底部附近，被绿色的光芒照亮。背景：深绿色电影质感。Logo：顶部明亮清晰。标语（底部）：“Open Your World。” 氛围：高端、沉浸式、略带魔幻感。 🌍 5. IKEA 概念：“平板包装自然” 视觉效果：一棵由 IKEA 平板包装木板、可见螺丝和说明书线条组装而成的超现实树木。微缩人物：一个微小的人正在用内六角扳手组装一个树枝。背景：带有斯堪的纳维亚简约风格的柔和绿色。Logo：顶部居中为 IKEA Logo。标语（底部）：“为大众创造更美好的日常生活。” 氛围：巧妙、俏皮、生态现代。 🍀 6. Spotify 概念：“声波花园” 视觉效果：巨大的绿色声波像植物一样生长，形成一个超现实的音频景观。微缩人物：一个戴着耳机的微小听众坐在声波上。背景：带有微妙光晕的 Spotify 绿色渐变。Logo：漂浮在顶部。标语（底部）：“Listening is everything。” 氛围：放松、沉浸式、有机声音。

templates.title: Cinematic Storyboard Production Board

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级故事板制作项目

templates.prompt:
story = {argument name="story subject" default="a beautiful woman in a white dress enjoying a amazing sunset evening at a luxury mansion build into a cliff"}, 

Scenes:
1) wide angle drone shot
2) wide angle walk at pool
3) medium wide over shoulder walk at pool
4) medium wide lean on railing
5) close-up hand in water
6) look over bay
7) close-up smile
8) wide angle smile holding champagne with elegant font text "LuxLife Retreats"

Create a cinematic production board / visual planning sheet that presents a complete concept for a short film or commercial. The layout should be clean, grid-based, and divided into clearly labeled sections.    

Include:  Shared creative direction (top bar): overall constraints such as number of shots, unified color palette, and general environmental context.      

Character + styling reference section:  A model shown from multiple angles (front, back, side, close-ups, relaxed pose), accompanied by wardrobe and accessory references. Emphasize consistency of identity while allowing minor variations for specific scenes.      

Environment and set design section:  A scenic outdoor location with dramatic natural features, plus a top-down diagram illustrating movement through the space. Include camera positions and labeled shot types mapped along a route.      

Storyboard section: A sequence of numbered frames (about 8 shots) showing progression of the scene. Each frame includes:  Camera type / lens feel  Shot size (wide, medium, close-up, macro)  Movement (static, tracking, handheld, etc.)  Brief description of action and emotional progression      Lighting / mood / style notes:  Visual examples paired with short descriptions of lighting conditions, atmosphere, and texture. Include transitions across time of day and variations in light quality.    Mood and keywords block: A concise list of emotional tones and thematic descriptors guiding the piece.      

Audio / tone section:  Indications of ambient sound, music style, and overall sonic atmosphere.      

Cinematography notes:  General visual philosophy including lens characteristics, movement style, and post-processing feel.     
 
The entire board should feel cohesive, cinematic, and professionally designed—like a director’s pre-production guide that communicates tone, pacing, and visual storytelling at a glance.

promptLocalized.zh:
story = {argument name="story subject" default="一位身穿白裙的美丽女子在悬崖上的豪华别墅中享受绝美的日落黄昏"}, 

场景：
1) 广角无人机镜头
2) 泳池边广角行走镜头
3) 泳池边过肩中广角镜头
4) 靠在栏杆上的中广角镜头
5) 手部特写（在水中）
6) 俯瞰海湾
7) 微笑特写
8) 手持香槟微笑的广角镜头，配以优雅字体文字“LuxLife Retreats”

创建一个电影级制作项目 / 视觉规划表，为短片或商业广告呈现完整的概念。布局应简洁、基于网格，并划分为清晰的标注区域。

包含：共享创意方向（顶部栏）：整体限制条件，如镜头数量、统一的调色板以及通用的环境背景。

角色 + 造型参考部分：展示多角度（正面、背面、侧面、特写、放松姿势）的模型，并附带服装和配饰参考。强调角色身份的一致性，同时允许针对特定场景进行细微变化。

环境与场景设计部分：一个具有戏剧性自然特征的户外风景地点，以及一张说明空间移动路径的俯视图。包含摄像机位置，并沿路线标注镜头类型。

故事板部分：一系列编号的画面（约 8 个镜头），展示场景的推进。每个画面包括：摄像机类型 / 镜头感、镜头尺寸（广角、中景、特写、微距）、运动方式（静态、追踪、手持等）、动作和情感推进的简要描述。

灯光 / 氛围 / 风格说明：视觉示例搭配关于灯光条件、氛围和质感的简短描述。包含一天中不同时间的过渡以及光线质量的变化。

情绪与关键词模块：一份简洁的情感基调和主题描述列表，用于指导作品创作。

音频 / 音调部分：环境音、音乐风格以及整体声音氛围的指示。

摄影说明：整体视觉理念，包括镜头特性、运动风格和后期处理感。

整个项目应看起来具有凝聚力、电影感且设计专业——就像一份导演的预制作指南，能够一眼传达出基调、节奏和视觉叙事。

templates.title: New York Tourist Instagram Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 纽约旅游 Instagram 九宫格

templates.prompt: Based on the clear front-facing photo I uploaded, generate a 'New York travel blogger casual snapshot nine-grid collage.' Please strictly maintain the real identity features of the person in the photo, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, and overall vibe. Do not turn the person into a Caucasian face, do not over-beautify, and do not change them into someone else. The person across all nine images must look like the same individual, simply captured by a friend or a phone while traveling in New York. Visual Format: Generate a 3x3 nine-grid collage, with a total of 9 travel photos. The overall style should look like a travel album from WeChat Moments, Xiaohongshu, or Instagram, not a professionally retouched shoot. Each grid features a phone-captured photo with different scenes, expressions, and poses. Character Setting: A young travel blogger from a first-tier city in China, with a natural, beautiful, relaxed, and smiley temperament, embodying a lifestyle and travel blogger vibe. Outfits should be stylish casual for a New York trip, including elements like a white tank top, jeans, knitwear, light jacket, sunglasses, crossbody bag, and sneakers. The overall aesthetic should lean toward East Asian pop trends—not excessively sexy, avoiding studio vibes or the stereotypical 'Internet celebrity' face. Overall Photography Style: Low-resolution iPhone snapshot feel, slightly blurry, occasional overexposure, inconsistent lighting, casual compositions, and slightly tilted angles, like friend captures while walking, selfies, candids, and casual travel logs. Not too perfect, not like a commercial campaign. The photos should be authentic, with a sense of daily life and travel memories. Nine-Grid Content: 1. Top Left: Selfie near the Statue of Liberty. Holding a phone, background shows the Statue of Liberty and the sea. Smiling happily, hair slightly wind-blown, slightly overexposed for an authentic tourist selfie look. 2. Top Middle: Times Square at night. Background with neon lights, billboards, crowds, and streets. The person is walking and turning back to the camera with a smile; slight motion blur as if captured by a friend. 3. Top Right: Central Park. Sitting on a bench or grass, relaxed posture, hand on chin or hair, natural expression. Background with trees and sunlight, with slight phone compression quality. 4. Middle Left: New York street pizza shop or hot dog stand. Holding a slice of pizza or street snack, smiling and ready to eat with a vivid, infectious expression. Background includes shop signs, street crowds, and warm lighting. 5. Center: New York art museum gallery. Standing beside a large modern art piece, turning back naturally. No specific copyrighted art; just museum ambiance. Looks like a casual tourist shot. 6. Middle Right: Natural History Museum. Standing near a dinosaur skeleton, looking up or at a friend with curiosity and excitement. Background with tourists and gallery lighting. 7. Bottom Left: Brooklyn Bridge. Walking and turning back to smile, hair wind-blown, slight candid blur, composition slightly off-center but subject clearly visible. 8. Bottom Middle: Empire State Building or high-rise observation deck. Selfie or friend-shot with the NYC skyline. Posing with a peace sign, pout, or natural gaze. Authentic tourist photo vibe. 9. Bottom Right: Street photography in SoHo or DUMBO. Walking along the street in stylish casual wear, with sunglasses or a bag, turning back to smile. Background with red brick buildings, cafes, or street signs. Expression and Pose Requirements: Avoid looking at the camera or smiling in every photo. Use diverse variations: selfie smiles, turning back, side views, laughing while eating, looking at scenery/exhibits, walking candids, sitting relaxed, making gestures. Should feel like a real person traveling, not a posed model. Image Restrictions: No deformed fingers, extra limbs, or facial feature drifting. Ensure the face remains consistent across all grids. No weird text, garbled signs, incorrect logos, over-smoothing, plastic skin, or obvious AI-looking faces. Maintain authentic mobile travel photo texture. Final Output: A 1:1 ratio 3x3 nine-grid travel collage, real phone photo style, New York travel diary atmosphere, consistent character identity, diverse expressions and poses, suitable for posting on Xiaohongshu, Moments, and X.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于我上传的清晰正面照片，生成一张“纽约旅行博主随手拍九宫格拼图”。请严格保持照片中人物的真实身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发际线和整体气质。不要将人物变成白人面孔，不要过度美颜，也不要将其变成其他人。九张图中的人物必须看起来是同一个人，就像是在纽约旅行时由朋友拍摄或用手机自拍的一样。视觉格式：生成一个 3x3 的九宫格拼图，总共 9 张旅行照片。整体风格应看起来像微信朋友圈、小红书或 Instagram 上的旅行相册，而不是专业修图的摄影作品。每一格都是一张手机拍摄的照片，具有不同的场景、表情和姿势。角色设定：一位来自中国一线城市的年轻旅行博主，气质自然、漂亮、放松且爱笑，体现出生活方式和旅行博主的氛围。穿搭应为纽约旅行的时尚休闲风，包括白色背心、牛仔裤、针织衫、轻便外套、墨镜、斜挎包和运动鞋等元素。整体审美倾向于东亚流行趋势——不要过度性感，避免影棚感或刻板的“网红脸”。整体摄影风格：低分辨率的 iPhone 随手拍感，略微模糊，偶尔过曝，光线不统一，构图随意，角度略微倾斜，就像走路时朋友抓拍、自拍、偷拍和随意的旅行记录。不要太完美，不要像商业广告大片。照片应真实，具有生活气息和旅行回忆感。九宫格内容：1. 左上：自由女神像附近的自拍。拿着手机，背景是自由女神像和大海。开心地笑着，头发微风吹拂，略微过曝，呈现真实的游客自拍感。2. 中上：夜晚的时代广场。背景是霓虹灯、广告牌、人群和街道。人物正在走路并回头对镜头微笑；有轻微的动态模糊，仿佛是朋友抓拍的。3. 右上：中央公园。坐在长椅或草地上，姿势放松，手托下巴或摸头发，表情自然。背景有树木和阳光，带有轻微的手机压缩画质。4. 左中：纽约街头披萨店或热狗摊。拿着一片披萨或街头小吃，笑着准备吃，表情生动且具有感染力。背景包括商店招牌、街头人群和暖色调灯光。5. 正中：纽约艺术博物馆画廊。站在一幅大型现代艺术品旁，自然地回头。没有特定的受版权保护的艺术品；仅呈现博物馆氛围。看起来像一张随意的游客照。6. 右中：自然历史博物馆。站在恐龙骨架旁，好奇且兴奋地抬头看或看向朋友。背景有游客和画廊灯光。7. 左下：布鲁克林大桥。边走边回头微笑，头发被风吹起，有轻微的抓拍模糊感，构图略微偏离中心，但主体清晰可见。8. 中下：帝国大厦或高层观景台。与纽约天际线的自拍或朋友拍摄。摆出剪刀手、嘟嘴或自然的凝视。真实的游客照氛围。9. 右下：苏豪区 (SoHo) 或 DUMBO 的街拍。穿着时尚休闲装走在街上，戴着墨镜或背着包，回头微笑。背景是红砖建筑、咖啡馆或街道标志。表情和姿势要求：避免在每张照片中都盯着镜头或微笑。使用多样的变化：自拍微笑、回头、侧面、吃东西时大笑、看风景/展品、走路抓拍、坐姿放松、做手势。应该感觉像是一个真实的人在旅行，而不是摆拍的模特。图像限制：没有变形的手指、多余的肢体或面部特征漂移。确保面部在所有格子中保持一致。没有奇怪的文字、乱码标志、错误的 Logo、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤或明显的 AI 脸。保持真实的手机旅行照片质感。最终输出：1:1 比例的 3x3 九宫格旅行拼图，真实的手机照片风格，纽约旅行日记氛围，一致的人物身份，多样的表情和姿势，适合发布在小红书、朋友圈和 X 上。

templates.prompt: [Men's Version Prompt] Based on the front-facing photo I uploaded, generate a professional men's studio business portrait. Please strictly preserve the authentic identity features of the person in the photo, including face shape, facial feature proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, perceived age, facial texture, hairline, and hairstyle. Do not turn the person into someone else, do not over-rejuvenate, do not over-smooth the skin, and do not generate a fake AI face. The final result must look like a high-quality professional portrait of the same individual. The visual style should refer to high-end corporate executive headshots, LinkedIn business portraits, and management photos on official company websites. The person faces the camera, using a classic head-and-shoulders portrait composition, capturing from the chest to the head. The posture is natural and upright, with shoulders relaxed but conveying a sense of power. Eyes look directly into the camera, with a confident, steady, and approachable expression featuring a restrained smile, presenting a professional, reliable, and authoritative aura. Please replace the clothing with a well-tailored dark gray textured suit, a crisp white shirt inside, and a high-quality navy blue tie. The suit should be well-fitting, smooth, with a business texture; the collar, shoulder lines, and tie knot should be clear and natural. Avoid exaggerated luxury or looking like wedding or studio art photos. Use soft, flattering professional studio lighting. The main light shines from the front-side, creating natural light and shadow levels on the face, with slight catchlights in the eyes and realistic skin texture. The overall look is clean and high-end. Avoid harsh hard light, overexposure, greasy reflections, and heavy shadows. The background is a smooth, blurred gradient from medium gray to warm taupe, simple, clean, without clutter, text, or logos. The background is only used to set off the subject and should not distract. Photo requirements: realistic photographic feel, commercial portrait photography, high resolution, clear details, natural skin tone, high-end texture, stable composition, subject centered, coordinated head-to-shoulder ratio. Makeup should be clean, elegant, and healthy-looking, preserving the original facial features; avoid heavy makeup and do not significantly change the shape of eyebrows, eyes, or lips. Use soft, flattering professional studio lighting. The background is a smooth, blurred gradient from medium gray to warm taupe, simple, clean, without clutter, text, or logos. promptLocalized.zh: [男士版提示词] 基于我上传的正面照片，生成一张专业的男士摄影棚商务肖像。请严格保留照片中人物真实的身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、感知年龄、面部纹理、发际线和发型。请勿将人物替换为他人，请勿过度减龄，请勿过度磨皮，也不要生成虚假的 AI 面孔。最终结果必须看起来像是同一位人物的高质量专业肖像。视觉风格应参考高端企业高管头像、LinkedIn 商务肖像以及公司官网上的管理层照片。人物面向镜头，采用经典的胸部以上半身肖像构图。姿态自然挺拔，双肩放松但传达出力量感。双眼直视镜头，表情自信、沉稳且平易近人，带有内敛的微笑，展现出专业、可靠且权威的气质。请将服装替换为剪裁合身的深灰色质感西装，内搭挺括的白衬衫，并配以高品质的海军蓝领带。西装应合身、平整，具有商务质感；领口、肩线和领带结应清晰自然。避免过度奢华，避免看起来像婚纱照或艺术写真。使用柔和、修饰性强的专业摄影棚灯光。主光从前侧方照射，在脸上营造出自然的光影层次，眼睛带有轻微的眼神光，皮肤纹理真实。整体观感干净、高端。避免刺眼的强光、过曝、油腻的反光和沉重的阴影。背景为从深灰色到暖灰褐色的平滑模糊渐变，简洁干净，无杂物、文字或 Logo。背景仅用于衬托主体，不应喧宾夺主。照片要求：真实的摄影感、商业肖像摄影、高分辨率、清晰的细节、自然的肤色、高端的质感、稳定的构图、主体居中、头肩比例协调。长宽比 3:4。[女士版提示词] 基于我上传的正面照片，生成一张专业的女士摄影棚商务肖像。请严格保留照片中人物真实的身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、感知年龄、面部纹理、发际线和发型。请勿将人物替换为他人，请勿过度减龄，请勿过度美颜，也不要生成虚假的 AI 面孔。最终结果必须看起来像是同一位人物的高质量专业肖像。视觉风格应参考高端女性专业头像、LinkedIn 商务肖像、公司官网团队介绍照片以及创业者的专业肖像。人物面向镜头，采用经典的胸部以上半身肖像构图。姿态自然挺拔，双肩放松，颈部线条清晰，双眼直视镜头。表情自信、温和且沉稳，带有内敛的微笑，展现出专业、可靠、平易近人且富有洞察力的女性专业人士气质。请将服装替换为剪裁合身的深色专业西装外套（可以是黑色、深灰色或海军蓝），内搭简单的白衬衫、浅色丝绸衬衫或干净的纯色内搭。整体造型应高端、干练、利落；避免过于性感，避免夸张的时尚感，不要看起来像网红照片或艺术写真。西装外套的肩线、领口、面料质感和层次感应清晰自然。请保持妆发自然真实，适合正式的商务场合。妆容应干净、优雅、显气色，保留原始的面部特征；避免浓妆，不要显著改变眉毛、眼睛或嘴唇的形状。发型可以在原有基础上稍作整理，使头发看起来蓬松、干净、有光泽，适合商务肖像。使用柔和、修饰性强的专业摄影棚灯光。主光从前侧方照射，在脸上营造出自然的光影层次，眼睛带有轻微的眼神光，皮肤纹理真实。整体观感干净、高端。避免刺眼的强光、过曝、油腻的反光和沉重的阴影。背景为从深灰色到暖灰褐色的平滑模糊渐变，简洁干净，无杂物、文字或 Logo。背景仅用于衬托主体，不应喧宾夺主。照片要求：真实的摄影感、商业肖像摄影、高分辨率、清晰的细节、自然的肤色、高端的质感、稳定的构图、主体居中、头肩比例协调。长宽比 3:4。

templates.title: Childlike Watercolor and Crayon Art

titleLocalized.zh: 童趣水彩与蜡笔画

templates.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the reference image. Preserve its structure, framing, and main visual information.

Recreate the provided image as a realistic handmade artwork by a clever 10-year-old child.

Keep the original image’s main layout, composition, and recognizable content, but transform the entire scene into a 10-year-old child’s watercolor marker drawing mixed with crayon strokes and paper collage craft.

The image should be placed on a clean white paper background. Make it look genuinely handmade, with wobbly outlines, simple shapes, uneven coloring, visible watercolor marker texture, waxy crayon strokes, cut-paper edges, slight glue marks, layered paper pieces, imperfect proportions, and charming childlike details.

Do not use the original color palette. Replace it with {argument name="color theme" default="bright rainbow colors, soft pastel tones, playful candy colors, and cheerful handmade craft colors"}.

Add whimsical childlike decorations naturally around the scene: {argument name="decorations" default="castles, fairy-tale towers, candy, lollipops, stars, smiling clouds, rainbows, hearts, flowers, sparkles, planets, stickers, and random doodles"}.

Also add fantasy and sci-fi paper-collage characters as if the child added them for fun: {argument name="extra characters" default="a brave armored hero, a silly evil villain, a colorful mecha robot, a cute monster, a floating UFO, friendly little aliens, a lovely princess, and a fun spaceship flying through the sky"}.

All visible text should be redrawn as childlike handwriting, as if written by a 10-year-old using crayons and watercolor markers. The handwriting should be uneven, slightly messy, cute, naive, with inconsistent letter sizes, irregular spacing, playful wobble, and imperfect alignment.

The final image should feel realistic, smart, imaginative, innocent, colorful, and full of childlike creativity — like a charming school art project made with watercolor markers, crayons, scissors, glue, and colorful paper.

promptLocalized.zh:
以上传的图片作为参考图。保留其结构、构图及主要视觉信息。

将提供的图片重构为一件由聪明的 10 岁儿童创作的写实手工艺术品。

保留原图的主要布局、构图和可识别的内容，但将整个场景转化为 10 岁儿童的水彩笔画，并混合蜡笔笔触和纸艺拼贴元素。

图像应置于干净的白纸背景上。使其看起来具有真实的手工感，包括歪歪扭扭的轮廓、简单的形状、不均匀的涂色、可见的水彩笔纹理、蜡质蜡笔笔触、剪纸边缘、轻微的胶水痕迹、分层的纸片、不完美的比例以及迷人的童趣细节。

不要使用原始配色方案。将其替换为 {argument name="color theme" default="明亮的彩虹色、柔和的粉彩色、俏皮的糖果色以及欢快的手工工艺色彩"}。

在场景周围自然地添加异想天开的童趣装饰：{argument name="decorations" default="城堡、童话塔、糖果、棒棒糖、星星、微笑的云朵、彩虹、爱心、花朵、闪光、行星、贴纸和随意的涂鸦"}。

同时添加奇幻和科幻风格的纸艺拼贴角色，就像孩子为了好玩而添加的一样：{argument name="extra characters" default="勇敢的盔甲英雄、愚蠢的大反派、色彩斑斓的机甲机器人、可爱的怪物、漂浮的 UFO、友好的小外星人、可爱的公主以及在天空中飞行的趣味宇宙飞船"}。

所有可见文字应重绘为童稚的笔迹，就像 10 岁孩子用蜡笔和水彩笔书写的一样。笔迹应参差不齐、略显凌乱、可爱且天真，字母大小不一、间距不规则、带有俏皮的晃动感和不完美的对齐方式。

最终图像应呈现出真实、灵动、富有想象力、纯真、色彩丰富且充满童趣创造力的感觉——就像一件用水彩笔、蜡笔、剪刀、胶水和彩色纸制作的迷人学校艺术项目。

templates.title: Fantasy Ice Phoenix Goddess Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻冰凤凰女神插画

templates.prompt:
An adult fantasy female character, close-up bust composition, with silver-white extra-long fluffy hair, strands are light and flowing, rich in layers, with a soft luster and silky texture, spreading naturally in the air to form elegant flowing curves. 

Her face is exquisite and ethereal, with delicate and three-dimensional features, fair and transparent skin, a delicate nose, soft and natural lips, and a quiet and mysterious expression, possessing a goddess-like and elven temperament. 

The collarbone lines are distinct, the shoulder and neck area is more stretched and elegant, the upper chest contour is moderately visible, and the clothing opening and fit are optimized to make the visible range of the chest and collarbone more natural and beautiful, sexy but not overly revealing. 

The character's eyes are a clear and charming {argument name="eye color" default="brown"}, with delicate highlights and dreamlike eyelashes, decorated with faint sparkling particles and exquisite makeup around the eyes. 

The character is surrounded by a magnificent fantasy divine bird, similar to a phoenix, with long and stretched wings and light, transparent feathers. The overall color scheme is dominated by {argument name="color theme" default="blue, ice blue, light blue, and silver-white"}, supplemented by a small amount of delicate metallic edges, making the bird appear holy, dreamlike, and elegant. 

The background is a deep night sky and starlit space, with small stars, glowing particles, and a hazy cosmic feel, creating a dreamlike and mysterious atmosphere. The overall color of the picture is unified into a blue and silver-white theme, emphasizing the level changes between ice blue, lake blue, light blue, and silver-white, creating a pure, cold, gorgeous, and ethereal visual experience. 

The overall style is high-quality 3D CG illustration. Characters, feathers, and the divine bird all have a clear sense of volume, material, and fine rendering effects, combining aesthetic fantasy with commercial-grade visual quality. The lighting uses cinematic soft light and edge contour light, skin is delicate and transparent, hair is distinct, and feathers have a semi-transparent glowing effect. Aspect ratio 9:16.

promptLocalized.zh:
一位成年奇幻女性角色，近景半身构图，拥有银白色超长蓬松秀发，发丝轻盈飘逸，层次丰富，带有柔和的光泽和丝滑的质感，在空气中自然散开，形成优雅的流动曲线。

她的面容精致空灵，五官细腻立体，皮肤白皙通透，鼻梁挺拔，唇形柔和自然，表情宁静而神秘，散发着女神与精灵般的气质。

锁骨线条清晰，肩颈区域更显舒展优雅，上胸轮廓适度可见，服装开口与剪裁经过优化，使胸部与锁骨的可见范围更加自然美观，性感而不失端庄。

角色双眸清澈迷人，颜色为 {argument name="eye color" default="棕色"}，带有精致的高光和梦幻般的睫毛，眼周点缀着淡淡的闪烁微粒与精致妆容。

角色周围环绕着一只宏伟的奇幻神鸟，形似凤凰，双翼修长舒展，羽毛轻盈透明。整体配色以 {argument name="color theme" default="蓝色、冰蓝色、浅蓝色和银白色"} 为主，辅以少量精致的金属边缘，使神鸟显得神圣、梦幻且优雅。

背景为深邃的夜空与星光空间，点缀着细小的星辰、发光微粒和朦胧的宇宙感，营造出梦幻而神秘的氛围。画面整体色调统一为蓝银色系，强调冰蓝、湖蓝、浅蓝与银白之间的层次变化，打造出纯净、清冷、华丽且空灵的视觉体验。

templates.title: Romantic Couple Travel Album Grid

templates.prompt: Please based on the real photos of two adults I uploaded, generate a 'Couple Seaside Travel Film-style Snapshot Album Collage'. Strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of both people. Both the woman and the man must look like themselves in the uploaded photos, including face shape, facial feature proportions, eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle characteristics, and overall temperament. The woman has a B-cup chest. Do not turn them into Caucasian faces, avoid influencer-style aesthetics, do not over-beautify, and do not replace them with strangers. Ultimately, all small photos must feature the same couple, captured as if by mobile phones, point-and-shoot cameras, or friends across various travel scenes. Format: A 4x4 collage with 16 small photos. Narrow black dividers between photos on a black background, with large black margins at the top and bottom, resembling a memory dump from a phone album, Instagram, or Xiaohongshu. Avoid polished professional layouts or commercial posters. Core Visual Style: Nostalgic film + old iPhone snapshot + couple's travel album. Include slight film grain, shadow noise, slight out-of-focus, motion blur, compression, occasional overexposure/backlighting, unstable lighting, and imperfect composition. Warm tones, natural skin, faded greens/blues, and grayish blacks, resembling phone vacation photos from 2016–2021. Not high-def, clean, or over-sharpened. Film Filter: Slight Kodak/Fuji disposable camera style. Light grain, warm yellow highlights, soft glows, and light night noise. Should look like real old photos rather than heavy modern templates. Relationship: A close, natural couple with life-like interactions: holding hands, selfies, eye contact, hugging, leaning on shoulders, kissing cheeks, eating, and walking together. Intimate but not erotic or vulgar. Travel Scene: Summer seaside city vacation with Mediterranean, Greek island, or Italian coastal vibes. Scenes include beaches, hotel mirrors, sunsets, restaurants, balconies, docks, and night cityscapes. These should feel like life fragments rather than tourist check-ins. 16 Grid Contents: 1. Beach selfie, close-up, strong sunlight, slightly overexposed. 2. Woman sitting alone in a cafe, hair windblown, friend's perspective snapshot. 3. Man walking away on a white town street, evening stroll feel. 4. Mirror selfie in a hotel bathroom, dim light, some noise. 5. Woman smiling back on a beach, summer outfit, waves in background. 6. Extreme close-up selfie, blurry, woman eyes closed, man near her cheek. 7. Woman's profile at sunset looking at the sea, grain and low contrast. 8. Man sitting by the pier or cafe looking relaxed at the camera. 9. Night walk hand-in-hand, motion blur, warm lighting. 10. Man sitting by the pool/sea, half-body shot, relaxed expression. 11. Selfie together, hair messy, slightly out of focus but high emotion. 12. Man taking a photo of the woman, travel documentary style. 13. Laughing loudly in a close-up selfie, accidental shot feel. 14. Man eating street food, natural and simple hand movements. 15. Woman on a balcony at night looking back, city light background, night noise. 16. Beach selfie, kissing cheek, last-day commemorative photo. Consistency Requirements: Maintain identical looks for the couple in every grid across all changes in clothes and light. No facial drift or distortion in side views or night shots. Hand Stability: Avoid fingers near the face. No complex gestures or hair-grabbing to prevent AI deformation. Hands should be naturally placed. Expression and Poses: Variety is key: selfies, profile shots, back views, eating, and walking. Avoid constant smiling at the camera. Quality: Real old iPhone album feel with low resolution, grain, compression, and imperfect composition. Restrictions: No deformed fingers, extra limbs, weird text, or watermarks. No nudity or minor-looking subjects. Avoid 'AI plastic' faces. Final Output: A 4x4 couple travel album collage, 1:1 ratio, black background, nostalgic film/old iPhone style, showcasing intimate, relaxed, and authentic summer vacation memories.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据我上传的两位成年人的真实照片，生成一张“情侣海边旅行胶片风快照相册拼贴”。严格保留两人的真实外貌特征。无论男女，都必须与上传照片中的本人一致，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发际线、发型特征以及整体气质。女性为 B 罩杯。不要将他们变成白人面孔，避免网红审美，不要过度美化，也不要替换成陌生人。最终，所有小照片必须是同一对情侣，呈现出如同手机、傻瓜相机或朋友拍摄的各种旅行场景。格式：4x4 拼贴，共 16 张小照片。照片之间有窄黑色分割线，黑色背景，顶部和底部有宽大的黑色边框，类似于手机相册、Instagram 或小红书的记忆碎片。避免精致的专业排版或商业海报风格。核心视觉风格：怀旧胶片 + 旧 iPhone 快照 + 情侣旅行相册。包含轻微胶片颗粒、阴影噪点、轻微失焦、动态模糊、压缩感、偶尔的过曝/逆光、不稳定的光线以及不完美的构图。暖色调、自然肤色、褪色的绿/蓝色和灰黑色，类似于 2016 年至 2021 年的手机度假照片。不要高清、干净或过度锐化。胶片滤镜：轻微的柯达/富士一次性相机风格。轻微颗粒感、暖黄色高光、柔光和轻微的夜间噪点。看起来应该是真实的旧照片，而不是厚重的现代模板。人物关系：一对亲密、自然的情侣，有生活化的互动：牵手、自拍、对视、拥抱、靠肩、亲吻脸颊、进食和并肩行走。亲密但不色情或低俗。旅行场景：夏季海滨城市度假，具有地中海、希腊岛屿或意大利海岸风情。场景包括海滩、酒店镜子、日落、餐厅、阳台、码头和夜间城市景观。这些应该感觉像是生活片段，而不是游客打卡照。16 格内容：1. 海滩自拍，特写，强光，轻微过曝。2. 女性独自坐在咖啡馆，头发被风吹乱，朋友视角快照。3. 男性在白色小镇街道上走远，傍晚散步感。4. 酒店浴室镜子自拍，光线昏暗，有噪点。5. 女性在海滩回头微笑，夏日装扮，背景有海浪。6. 极近距离自拍，模糊，女性闭眼，男性靠近她的脸颊。7. 女性在日落时分看向大海的侧脸，颗粒感，低对比度。8. 男性坐在码头或咖啡馆，神态放松地看向镜头。9. 夜间牵手散步，动态模糊，暖光。10. 男性坐在泳池/海边，半身照，表情放松。11. 合影自拍，头发凌乱，略微失焦但情感充沛。12. 男性拍摄女性，旅行纪录片风格。13. 大声欢笑的特写自拍，抓拍感。14. 男性吃街头小吃，动作自然简单。15. 女性夜晚在阳台上回眸，背景是城市灯光，有夜间噪点。16. 海滩自拍，亲吻脸颊，最后一天纪念照。一致性要求：在所有服装和光线变化中，保持情侣在每个网格中的外貌完全一致。侧面或夜景拍摄时，面部不得变形或走样。手部稳定性：避免手部靠近脸部。不要使用复杂的手势或抓头发，以防 AI 变形。手部应自然放置。表情与姿势：多样性是关键：自拍、侧脸照、背影、进食和行走。避免一直对着镜头微笑。质量：真实的旧 iPhone 相册感，低分辨率、颗粒感、压缩感和不完美的构图。限制：没有变形的手指、多余的肢体、奇怪的文字或水印。没有裸露或看起来未成年的主体。避免“AI 塑料感”面孔。最终输出：一张 4x4 情侣旅行相册拼贴，1:1 比例，黑色背景，怀旧胶片/旧 iPhone 风格，展示亲密、放松且真实的夏日度假记忆。

templates.prompt:
01 Frontend (the part users see)

What it is: The interface that users can see, click, and interact with.
Where it is: Interfaces for websites, mini-programs, and apps.
Tools: HTML (structure), CSS (styling), JavaScript (interaction).

02 Backend (the processing part behind the scenes)

What it is: The brain behind the scenes, responsible for logic and calculation.
Where it is: On the server, invisible to users.
Function:
Handles login and registration
Calculates prices and recommends products
Receives frontend requests and returns data
Common languages: Java, Python, Go, JavaScript (Node.js)

03 Database (the memory part)

What it is: Used to store and manage data.
What it stores: Accounts, passwords, orders, inventory...
Common databases:
MySQL, PostgreSQL (relational, like tables)
MongoDB (document-based, like folders)

04 SaaS (Software as a Service)

What it is: SaaS = Software as a Service.
Core features:
Usable via web, mini-program, or app
Monthly or annual subscription
Common forms: Websites, mobile apps, and mini-programs can all be SaaS.

05 Summary

Frontend: User-visible interface
Backend: Logic and calculation behind the scenes
Database: Storage and management of data
SaaS: Delivering software as a service over the network
Frontend display → Backend processing → Database storage → SaaS delivery method
Help me draw an easy-to-understand diagram based on the content above.

promptLocalized.zh:
01 前端 (用户可见部分)

定义：用户可以看到、点击并进行交互的界面。
应用场景：网站、小程序和 App 的界面。
工具：HTML (结构)、CSS (样式)、JavaScript (交互)。

02 后端 (幕后的处理部分)

定义：幕后的大脑，负责逻辑和计算。
应用场景：在服务器端，用户不可见。
功能：
处理登录和注册
计算价格并推荐产品
接收前端请求并返回数据
常用语言：Java、Python、Go、JavaScript (Node.js)

03 数据库 (记忆部分)

定义：用于存储和管理数据。
存储内容：账号、密码、订单、库存等。
常用数据库：
MySQL、PostgreSQL (关系型，类似于表格)
MongoDB (文档型，类似于文件夹)

04 SaaS (软件即服务)

定义：SaaS = Software as a Service。
核心特征：
可通过网页、小程序或 App 使用
按月或按年订阅
常见形式：网站、移动端 App 和小程序都可以是 SaaS。

05 总结

前端：用户可见的界面
后端：幕后的逻辑与计算
数据库：数据的存储与管理
SaaS：通过网络交付软件的服务模式
前端展示 → 后端处理 → 数据库存储 → SaaS 交付方式

templates.title: Travel Photo Monthly Calendar Card

titleLocalized.zh: 旅行照片月历卡

templates.prompt:
Based on the real travel photo I uploaded, generate a 9:16 aspect ratio 'Monthly Calendar Card'.

[1. Execution Method (Most Important)]
This is a photo editing task, not a regeneration. You must use the original photo as the base layer:
- Keep the person's features, expression, hairstyle, and posture completely unchanged.
- Preserve original lighting, color temperature, and shadow relationships.
- No skin smoothing, brightening, repainting, or stylization.
- Do not change environment, composition, or color atmosphere.
- The original photo must look untouched.

[2. Permitted Operations (Overlay Only)]
Only design layers may be added over the original photo:
- Gradient extension on the bottom 30% (for the calendar).
- Soft translucent mask (to ensure text readability).
- Calendar layout + Month Title + Copywriting.
Prohibited: Repainting subject/background, changing overall tone, or applying design filters.

[3. Color Rules]
Colors must be extracted from the current image (main/secondary/accent colors). Only slight desaturation and brightness unification allowed. Maintain authentic color feel.

[4. Layout Structure]
Top 70%: Original photo (untouched).
Bottom 30%: Gradient + Calendar area (natural transition). Must look like a magazine page, not a template calendar.

[5. Calendar Content]
Automatically generate the corresponding year and month:
- Title: {argument name="date title" default="July 2026 / 2026.07"}
- Days: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
- Dates: Arranged according to a real calendar, strictly aligned.

[6. Copywriting Rules]
Length: 8-16 characters. Max two lines. No exclamation marks. No clichés or life lessons. Use emotional fragments or atmospheric sentences.

[7. Selection Advice]
Prefer side profiles, tilted heads, or dynamic movements over close-up front-facing portraits to reduce AI facial distortion risk.

Final Core Rule: Do not make a 'better' photo; lightly place a design layer over the existing one.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于我上传的真实旅行照片，生成一张 9:16 比例的“月历卡”。

[1. 执行方法（最重要）]
这是一项照片编辑任务，而非重新生成。你必须以原始照片作为底图：
- 保持人物的五官、表情、发型和姿态完全不变。
- 保留原始光影、色温和阴影关系。
- 不得进行磨皮、提亮、重绘或风格化处理。
- 不得改变环境、构图或色彩氛围。
- 原始照片必须看起来未经改动。

[2. 允许的操作（仅限叠加）]
仅可在原始照片上方添加设计图层：
- 底部 30% 的渐变扩展（用于放置日历）。
- 柔和的半透明遮罩（确保文字可读性）。
- 日历布局 + 月份标题 + 文案。
禁止：重绘主体/背景、改变整体色调或应用设计滤镜。

[3. 色彩规则]
色彩必须从当前图像中提取（主色/辅色/强调色）。仅允许轻微的去饱和度和亮度统一。保持真实的色彩感。

[4. 布局结构]
顶部 70%：原始照片（未经改动）。
底部 30%：渐变 + 日历区域（自然过渡）。必须看起来像杂志页面，而非模板日历。

[5. 日历内容]
自动生成对应的年份和月份：
- 标题：{argument name="date title" default="2026 年 7 月 / 2026.07"}
- 星期：一 二 三 四 五 六 日
- 日期：根据真实日历排列，严格对齐。

[6. 文案规则]
长度：8-16 个字符。最多两行。不要使用感叹号。不要使用陈词滥调或人生哲理。使用情感碎片或氛围感句子。

[7. 建议]
优先选择侧脸、侧头或动态动作的照片，而非近景正脸肖像，以降低 AI 面部畸变的风险。

最终核心规则：不要试图制作一张“更好”的照片，只需在现有照片上轻盈地覆盖一层设计图层。

Do not add new furniture or unnatural decorations. Aim for a natural, realistic finish similar to actual real estate or professional cleaning before-and-after photos.

promptLocalized.zh: 请处理这张 {argument name="location" default="浴室"} 的照片，将杂乱的生活用品自然地整理成一个 {argument name="atmosphere" default="整洁、有序、酒店风格"} 的浴室，且不要改变布局或结构元素，如浴缸、淋浴间、镜子、照明、墙壁或地板。具体来说，请移除或整理浴缸盖、台面、地面和架子上大量的瓶瓶罐罐、补充装袋、小物件、清洁用品、网兜和多余的储物篮，仅保留少量统一的瓶装用品。清理地面和浴缸周围区域，使空间看起来更宽敞。自然地去除镜面雾气、水渍以及墙面和台面的污渍，以呈现明亮、洁净的效果。在保持温暖、自然照明氛围的同时，适当调亮整体照片并修正畸变或阴影区域。请务必确保浴室形状、门的位置、浴缸、淋浴设施、镜子、灯具、墙板和地板纹理与原图保持一致。不要添加新的家具或不自然的装饰。目标是实现类似于真实房地产或专业清洁前后对比照片的自然、逼真效果。

templates.title: Travel Scrapbook Chibi Collage Creator

titleLocalized.zh: 旅行手账 Q 版拼贴生成器

templates.prompt:
Transform the uploaded travel photo into a playful travel scrapbook chibi collage while preserving the original photo as the base image.

Keep the original photo recognizable and structurally intact. Preserve the main person's facial features, expression, body shape, pose, outfit, lighting, and real background. Do not replace the person, change their identity, redraw their face, or alter the actual travel setting. The edit should feel like illustration and scrapbook elements have been layered on top of a real photo.

Add 4 to 7 cute chibi-style mini versions of the person from the uploaded photo. Each mini character should be based on the same person, keeping consistent facial traits, hairstyle, outfit details, and overall personality. Use big-head chibi proportions, lively expressions, refined details, and a light cartoon-rendered look.

Make every mini character do a different natural travel action. Choose varied candid moments such as taking photos, walking while looking around, reading a map, checking navigation, pulling luggage, drinking coffee, gazing at scenery, posing near a landmark, crouching to notice flowers or street details, filming with a phone, having hair blown by the wind, looking around while slightly lost, or jumping happily. The poses should feel spontaneous and life-like, as if captured during a real trip, not staged.

Overlay hand-drawn doodles, handwritten notes, and sticker-like details to create a relaxed travel journal scrapbook style. Use mainly white and soft pink accents, with slightly uneven hand-drawn lines. Include elements such as arrows, stars, hearts, sparkles, tiny airplanes, location pins, dashed route lines, hand-drawn circles, tape pieces, stickers, and small decorative marks.

Add 3 to 6 short handwritten English phrases related to travel mood and memories. Vary the phrases each time instead of using a fixed set. Examples of the tone include: "go somewhere new", "chase the horizon", "little moments matter", "memory unlocked", "lost but happy", "soft days", "just wandering", "no plans, just go", "take it slow", "follow the sun", "breathe and see", "quiet joy", and "this feels right".

Place the handwritten phrases near the person, mini characters, or travel actions so the text interacts naturally with the image. Avoid neat or formal typography. The writing should feel casual, personal, and spontaneously added to a travel journal.

The final image should feel light, healing, airy, cute, and relaxed, with a sense of freedom and travel nostalgia. Keep a balanced mix of real photo and subtle illustration enhancement. The viewer should first recognize it as a real travel photo, then notice the charming chibi characters and scrapbook details.

promptLocalized.zh:
将上传的旅行照片转换为趣味十足的旅行手账风格 Q 版拼贴画，同时保留原始照片作为底图。

保持原始照片的可辨识度和结构完整性。保留照片中人物的面部特征、表情、体型、姿势、服装、光影以及真实的背景。请勿替换人物、更改其身份、重绘面部或改变真实的旅行场景。编辑效果应呈现出插画和手账元素叠加在真实照片之上的质感。

添加 4 到 7 个上传照片中人物的可爱 Q 版迷你形象。每个迷你角色都应基于同一个人，保持一致的面部特征、发型、服装细节和整体个性。使用大头 Q 版比例、生动的表情、精致的细节以及轻盈的卡通渲染效果。

让每个迷你角色做出不同的自然旅行动作。选择多样化的抓拍瞬间，例如拍照、边走边看、看地图、查看导航、拉行李箱、喝咖啡、欣赏风景、在景点旁摆姿势、蹲下观察花朵或街道细节、用手机拍摄、头发被风吹起、因迷路而四处张望或开心地跳跃。姿势应显得自然且富有生活气息，仿佛是在真实的旅途中被捕捉到的，而非刻意摆拍。

叠加手绘涂鸦、手写笔记和贴纸般的细节，营造出轻松的旅行手账风格。主要使用白色和柔和的粉色作为点缀，线条采用略显不规则的手绘风格。包含箭头、星星、爱心、闪光、小飞机、定位图标、虚线路线、手绘圆圈、胶带纸、贴纸以及细小的装饰符号。

添加 3 到 6 个与旅行心情和回忆相关的简短英文手写短语。每次更换不同的短语，不要使用固定的组合。语气示例包括：“go somewhere new”、“chase the horizon”、“little moments matter”、“memory unlocked”、“lost but happy”、“soft days”、“just wandering”、“no plans, just go”、“take it slow”、“follow the sun”、“breathe and see”、“quiet joy” 以及 “this feels right”。

将手写短语放置在人物、迷你角色或旅行动作附近，使文字与图像自然融合。避免使用整齐或正式的字体。书写应显得随意、个性化，就像是随手添加在旅行日记中一样。

最终图像应呈现出轻盈、治愈、通透、可爱且放松的氛围，并带有一种自由感和旅行怀旧感。保持真实照片与微妙插画增强效果之间的平衡。观众应首先将其识别为一张真实的旅行照片，随后注意到迷人的 Q 版角色和手账细节。

templates.title: Cinematic Action Movie Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级动作片分镜脚本

templates.prompt:
Create a high-quality 4K cinematic action movie storyboard with EXACTLY {argument name="panel count" default="8"} PANELS ONLY (no more, no less), showing a {argument name="protagonist" default="female protagonist"} in a realistic fight sequence where she wins. Use dramatic lighting, high contrast shadows, realistic environments ({argument name="location" default="abandoned warehouse, rooftop, or underground fight arena"}), and a gritty film tone. No text anywhere.
The storyboard must include exactly these 8 scenes:
Wide establishing shot of a dark, intense location (rain, dust, or low light atmosphere), both fighters facing each other
Close-up of the woman’s focused expression, controlled breathing, tension building
Opponent attacks first with aggressive movement (punch or kick)
She narrowly dodges—dynamic motion, fast reaction, camera tracking
Close combat exchange—blocks, counters, and impact moments with cinematic slow motion
Turning point—she reads the opponent and lands a clean, powerful counter move
Decisive takedown—opponent falls hard, dramatic impact, environment reacting (dust, water splash, etc.)
Final frame—she stands strong and calm, slightly injured but dominant, looking forward under dramatic lighting, clear victory
Use varied camera angles (wide, close-up, over-shoulder, low angle), realistic fight choreography, motion blur, and physical impact details.
Tone should feel like a Hollywood action film, focusing on tension, realism, and character strength—not stylized or social media aesthetic.
Strict rule: only 8 panels, no repetition, no extra frames.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个高质量的 4K 电影级动作片分镜脚本，必须且仅包含 {argument name="panel count" default="8"} 个画面（不多不少），展示一名 {argument name="protagonist" default="女性主角"} 在写实的打斗场景中获胜的过程。使用戏剧性的光影、高对比度阴影、写实的环境（{argument name="location" default="废弃仓库、屋顶或地下格斗场"}）以及粗粝的电影色调。画面中不要出现任何文字。
该分镜脚本必须严格包含以下 8 个场景：
暗色调、高强度的环境全景建立镜头（雨、灰尘或低光氛围），两名格斗者面对面站立
女性主角专注表情的特写，呼吸平稳，紧张感积聚
对手率先发起攻击，动作具有侵略性（拳击或踢腿）
她惊险躲避——动态动作、快速反应、摄像机追踪
近身格斗交换——格挡、反击以及带有电影级慢动作的冲击瞬间
转折点——她看穿对手并打出一记干净利落的强力反击
决定性击倒——对手重重倒地，产生戏剧性的冲击效果，环境做出反应（灰尘、水花飞溅等）
最终画面——她站姿稳健且冷静，虽有轻伤但占据主导地位，在戏剧性光影下看向前方，明确获胜
使用多样的摄像机角度（全景、特写、肩后镜头、低角度），写实的格斗编排，运动模糊以及物理冲击细节。

templates.title: Professional Brand Identity Guidelines Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 专业品牌形象指南海报

templates.prompt: Using the uploaded logo, create a high-quality professional poster for an integrated brand identity system. Goal: Everything must be based on the logo: Colors, Style, Personality, and Tone. ❌ No generic or random elements allowed. 🧱 Structure: Vertical poster with a 4:5 ratio, a clear and multi-layered Grid system; the design should be content-dense but clean and organized. 🔝 Top Section: Brand name in a clear and clean font, a short slogan expressing the brand (max 6 words), and an identity description in three words (e.g., modern / bold / simple). 🎨 Color System (Professional): Display primary colors (3–5), secondary colors (3–5), and accent colors. For each color, provide clear color blocks, HEX codes, and usage (Background / Primary / Accent). Add color gradients and color blending examples. 🔤 Typography: Specify heading font, subheading font, and body text font. Show real text examples and a clear hierarchy between sizes. 🖼️ Visual Identity: Specify image style (cinematic / minimalist / editorial…), lighting direction, and type of materials and textures. Display 3 to 5 visual examples (image style). 📦 Brand Applications (Very Important): Show realistic mockups such as product packaging, website interface (Hero Section), mobile app screen, 3 social media posts, business card, and an advertisement or billboard. ⚠️ All must share the same identity spirit. 🧩 Design System: Display UI components, cards, and spacing systems. Examples: buttons, layouts, and sections. 🔘 Icons: 6 to 10 icons in the same style (Line or Filled), consistent with the identity. 🎭 Patterns and Elements: Background patterns, decorative shapes, and elements inspired by the logo. ✨ Fine Details: Shadows, textures, reflections, and layer depth. 🎯 Overall Style: A mix between Editorial Design + Tech Style; very clean but rich in detail with a strong and clear hierarchy. 📊 Density: 30 to 50 visual elements; a mix of large and small elements in an intelligently crowded and organized design. 🚫 Important Rules: No empty spaces without a reason, no filler elements, everything has a purpose, and all elements are visually interconnected. 💎 Final Result: It must look like a strong project on Behance or an identity guide from a design agency. Something that makes the client ask: "How much?" 😏 NOT: Simple, traditional, or a ready-made template.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用上传的 Logo，为集成品牌形象系统创建一张高质量的专业海报。目标：所有内容必须基于 Logo：颜色、风格、个性和基调。❌ 不允许使用通用或随机元素。🧱 结构：4:5 比例的竖向海报，采用清晰且多层次的网格系统；设计应内容丰富但简洁有序。🔝 顶部区域：以清晰简洁的字体展示品牌名称，一句表达品牌的简短口号（最多 6 个词），以及三个词的形象描述（例如：现代 / 大胆 / 简约）。🎨 色彩系统（专业）：展示主色（3–5 种）、副色（3–5 种）和强调色。为每种颜色提供清晰的色块、HEX 代码和用途（背景 / 主色 / 强调色）。添加颜色渐变和色彩混合示例。🔤 排版：指定标题字体、副标题字体和正文字体。展示真实的文本示例以及清晰的字号层级。🖼️ 视觉形象：指定图像风格（电影感 / 极简主义 / 编辑风格……）、光照方向以及材质和纹理类型。展示 3 到 5 个视觉示例（图像风格）。📦 品牌应用（非常重要）：展示逼真的样机，如产品包装、网站界面（首屏）、移动端 App 界面、3 条社交媒体帖子、名片以及广告或户外广告牌。⚠️ 所有内容必须共享相同的品牌精神。🧩 设计系统：展示 UI 组件、卡片和间距系统。示例：按钮、布局和区块。🔘 图标：6 到 10 个风格统一（线条或填充）且与品牌形象一致的图标。🎭 图案与元素：受 Logo 启发的背景图案、装饰形状和元素。✨ 精细细节：阴影、纹理、反射和图层深度。🎯 整体风格：编辑设计与科技风格的结合；非常简洁但细节丰富，具有强大且清晰的层级结构。📊 密度：30 到 50 个视觉元素；在大元素和小元素的混合中实现一种智能的拥挤感与有序感。🚫 重要规则：没有无缘无故的留白，没有填充元素，一切皆有目的，所有元素在视觉上相互关联。💎 最终结果：它看起来必须像 Behance 上的一个强势项目或设计机构的形象指南。让客户忍不住问：“多少钱？” 😏 而不是：简单、传统或现成的模板。

templates.title: Printable Paint by Numbers Generator

titleLocalized.zh: 可打印数字油画生成器

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create a professional high-resolution paint-by-numbers template from the provided image as a single PNG only. Use an {argument name="canvas size" default="A4 portrait ratio canvas"} at 300 DPI with a pure white background. The main artwork must be a clean black-and-white line drawing containing only black outlines, black numbers, and white unfilled paintable areas. Do not create a PDF, document, mockup, multi-page layout, or colored version. Do not use color, gray, shading, texture, gradients, transparency, or pre-filled areas in the main artwork.

Analyze the original image and choose the number of colors adaptively based on image complexity, from 1 to a maximum of {argument name="color count" default="14 colors"}. If the image has only 1–2 important colors, use only 1–2 colors; for simple images use 3–6 colors; for medium complexity use 7–10 colors; for complex, photographic, or highly detailed images use 11–14 colors. Do not force unnecessary colors. Assign each selected color one unique number and merge similar shades unless separation is essential for recognition.

Convert the image into simplified, fully closed, easy-to-paint regions while preserving the recognizable composition, main objects, characters, text, logos, foreground, background, and key details. Every paintable white region must contain the correct black number, centered clearly inside the matching area, readable, upright, and not touching outlines. Large black or dark areas from the original must remain white paintable regions with the correct number, not filled black. Only tiny permanent black line details, such as mouth lines, nostrils, pupils, eyelashes, seams, or small decorative strokes, may remain unnumbered.

At the bottom of the same PNG, add a neat legend section with the heading “Instructions”, the sentence “Paint the areas with the matching colors.”, and a list of every used number with a small color swatch and the English color name. Color swatches may appear only in the legend. Ensure the numbering exactly matches the legend, every paintable area is numbered, all regions are closed, and the final result is clean, professional, print-ready, and recognizable as the original image.

promptLocalized.zh:
将提供的图像转换为专业的单张高分辨率 PNG 格式数字油画模板。请使用 {argument name="canvas size" default="A4 纵向比例画布"}，分辨率为 300 DPI，背景为纯白色。主体艺术作品必须是清晰的黑白线条画，仅包含黑色轮廓、黑色数字和白色未填充的可涂色区域。请勿创建 PDF、文档、样机、多页布局或彩色版本。主体艺术作品中不得使用颜色、灰色、阴影、纹理、渐变、透明度或预填充区域。

分析原始图像，并根据图像复杂度自适应选择颜色数量，范围从 1 种到最多 {argument name="color count" default="14 种颜色"}。如果图像仅有 1-2 种重要颜色，则仅使用 1-2 种；简单图像使用 3-6 种；中等复杂度使用 7-10 种；复杂、摄影类或高度详细的图像使用 11-14 种。不要强行使用不必要的颜色。为每种选定的颜色分配一个唯一的数字，除非为了识别必须区分，否则请合并相似的色调。

将图像转换为简化、完全闭合且易于涂色的区域，同时保留可识别的构图、主体对象、角色、文本、徽标、前景、背景和关键细节。每个可涂色的白色区域必须包含正确的黑色数字，数字需清晰居中于匹配区域内，且易于阅读、正向放置且不接触轮廓。原始图像中的大面积黑色或深色区域必须保留为带有正确数字的白色可涂色区域，而不是填充为黑色。仅微小的永久性黑色线条细节（如嘴部线条、鼻孔、瞳孔、睫毛、接缝或小型装饰笔触）可以保持无编号状态。

在同一张 PNG 的底部，添加一个整洁的图例部分，标题为“Instructions”，正文为“Paint the areas with the matching colors.”，并列出每个使用的数字及其对应的小色块和英文颜色名称。色块仅可出现在图例中。确保编号与图例完全匹配，每个可涂色区域均已编号，所有区域均已闭合，最终结果应整洁、专业、适合打印，并能清晰识别出原始图像。

The environment is an urban nightlife street at night, with a concrete sidewalk, parked cars along the road, leafy trees, storefronts and bar entrances, purple neon lighting on the left, warm streetlights, and a visible sign on the left reading {argument name="sign text" default="ENTRANCE ON 3RD STREET"}. Use a centered composition, cute proportions with a large head and short limbs, dramatic icy blue highlights, detailed snow/ice texture on the ground, and a premium mascot-avatar look suitable for a developer profile picture. Customize the avatar as {argument name="avatar theme" default="ice codex robot"}, with {argument name="primary color" default="deep navy blue"} armor and {argument name="glow color" default="cyan blue"} lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个全身 Q 版 Codex 头像吉祥物，背景为干净的白色，带有淡淡的冰蓝色喷溅效果和柔和的冻土阴影。角色是一个小巧的未来感机器人，身穿超大号深海军黑连帽派克大衣和厚底靴，呈现为高细节的 3D 数字插画，具有绘画质感、光泽感科幻材质、青色轮廓光和冷色调的北极配色。兜帽呈圆形，像头盔一样，框住黑色的圆角矩形面罩，面罩上有两只半睁半闭的青色发光眼睛，没有嘴巴，表情平静且不为所动。在兜帽顶部和两侧添加 7 个半透明的锯齿状冰晶，最长的冰晶位于顶部中心，边缘发出电光蓝色的光芒，带有冰霜折射和雪花般的斑点。在套装上放置 2 个发光的原子标志：兜帽左侧有一个大的青色原子符号，胸部/左肩区域有一个较小的原子符号。躯干盔甲蓬松且分段，带有青色电路般的装饰、小型发光面板、磨损痕迹、划痕以及胸部发光的文字 {argument name="chest text" default="DL"}。在角色的左手中，展示 5 张叠在一起的半透明发光青色晶体数据表或代码页；在右手中，展示 1 台打开的微型笔记本电脑，角度朝向观众，屏幕为黑底青字，上面布满了细小的乱码。采用居中构图，大头短肢的可爱比例，戏剧性的冰蓝色高光，地面上有细腻的雪/冰纹理，以及适合开发者个人资料图片的优质吉祥物头像外观。自定义头像为 {argument name="avatar theme" default="ice codex robot"}，搭配 {argument name="primary color" default="deep navy blue"} 盔甲和 {argument name="glow color" default="cyan blue"} 灯光。

templates.title: Luxury Perfume Fashion Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华香水时尚样机

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the product base, transform the simple perfume-bottle shot into a studio-quality fashion advertising mockup. Keep the perfume bottle design, label text, black cap, amber liquid, and glass shape accurate and readable, but place it in the foreground being held close to the camera by one model's hand. Add exactly 1 fashion model in the background, posed dynamically in a low-angle wide-lens composition, wearing a {argument name="suit color" default="bright orange"} suit with a black shirt, black belt, and glossy black dress shoes. The model should stand in a confident editorial stance with one leg extended forward and the product exaggerated in scale by perspective. Use a clean warm beige studio backdrop, professional softbox lighting, crisp commercial product reflections, shallow depth of field, and a premium luxury fragrance campaign look. Keep the face unobtrusive or softly blurred so the product remains the hero. Overall mood: bold, modern, high-fashion, polished studio mockup.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为产品基础，将简单的香水瓶拍摄画面转换为摄影棚级别的时尚广告样机。保持香水瓶设计、标签文字、黑色瓶盖、琥珀色液体及玻璃形状的准确与清晰，将其置于前景，由一只模特的手靠近镜头握持。在背景中添加 1 位时尚模特，采用低角度广角构图进行动态摆拍，身着 {argument name="suit color" default="亮橙色"} 西装，内搭黑色衬衫，系黑色腰带，穿着亮面黑色正装皮鞋。模特需呈现自信的编辑风格姿态，一条腿向前伸展，并通过透视效果夸大产品比例。使用干净的暖米色摄影棚背景、专业的柔光箱照明、清晰的商业产品反射、浅景深效果，营造高端奢华香水广告的质感。保持面部不显眼或轻微模糊，以确保产品始终是视觉焦点。整体氛围：大胆、现代、高级时尚、精致的摄影棚样机。

templates.title: Luxury GPT Images 2.0 Launch Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Luxury GPT Images 2.0 发布海报

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious vertical promotional poster for {argument name="product name" default="GPT Images"} {argument name="version number" default="2.0"}, in a premium cinematic 3D style. The scene features one iridescent mosaic chameleon perched on top of one large pearly seashell, both covered in tiny reflective mirror tiles and mother-of-pearl surfaces, sparkling with rose-gold and cool cyan highlights. Use a deep teal-to-navy gradient background filled with glittering particle dust, thin elegant orbital light trails, starburst lens flares, and a shimmering reflective floor with scattered sparkling bokeh. Place the typography prominently in the upper half: 4 visible text elements total, consisting of the oversized metallic serif headline “{argument name="headline text" default="GPT Images"}”, the separate small version text “{argument name="version text" default="2.0"}” to the right, the left-side stacked tagline “{argument name="tagline" default="Words are your vision."}”, and the bottom-right brand mark reading “{argument name="brand name" default="HailuoAI"}” beside a colorful rounded swirl icon. Use elegant high-contrast Didot/Bodoni-style serif lettering for the main title, pale silver chrome material, subtle beveling, and refined spacing. The composition should feel like a high-end technology launch ad: glossy, magical, fashion editorial lighting, ultra-detailed 3D render, reflective caustics, soft volumetric glow, sharp focus on the chameleon and shell, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张用于 {argument name="product name" default="GPT Images"} {argument name="version number" default="2.0"} 的奢华垂直宣传海报，采用高级电影级 3D 风格。画面主体为一只栖息在大型珍珠贝壳上的虹彩马赛克变色龙，两者均覆盖着微小的反光镜面瓷砖和珍珠母贝表面，闪烁着玫瑰金与冷青色的光泽。使用深青色至海军蓝的渐变背景，点缀着闪烁的粒子尘埃、纤细优雅的轨道光迹、星芒镜头光晕，以及带有零星闪烁光斑的微光反射地面。将排版醒目地置于上半部分：总共 4 个可见文本元素，包括超大金属衬线标题“{argument name="headline text" default="GPT Images"}”、右侧独立的小字版本号“{argument name="version text" default="2.0"}”、左侧堆叠的标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Words are your vision."}”，以及右下角带有彩色圆形漩涡图标的品牌标识“{argument name="brand name" default="HailuoAI"}”。主标题使用优雅、高对比度的 Didot/Bodoni 风格衬线字体，采用淡银色铬合金材质，带有细腻的斜角效果和精致的字间距。整体构图应呈现高端科技发布广告的质感：光泽感、魔幻感、时尚杂志般的布光、超精细 3D 渲染、反射焦散、柔和的体积光，焦点清晰地聚焦于变色龙和贝壳上，采用 2:3 垂直比例。

templates.title: Sunset Alpine Lake Oil Painting

titleLocalized.zh: 日落高山湖泊油画

templates.prompt: Create a grand romantic realist oil painting of an alpine wilderness at {argument name="time of day" default="golden sunset"}, with a vast calm mountain lake in the foreground reflecting the sky, pine forests, rocky shores, and towering snow-covered peaks. The central peak is majestic and sharply lit with warm orange sunlight, surrounded by rugged cliffs and distant glaciers fading into atmospheric mist. The sun sits low near the right horizon, casting glowing amber light across the water and illuminating scattered clouds in a dramatic blue-and-gold sky. Dense evergreen trees frame both sides of the composition, especially a dark forest wall on the right and steep rocky cliffs on the left. Add subtle details: mist rising from the lake, scattered foreground rocks and driftwood, warm reflections rippling on the water, and exactly 2 deer standing near the right shoreline. Use {argument name="painting style" default="19th-century Hudson River School romantic landscape"}, highly detailed brushwork, luminous atmosphere, epic scale, serene mood, rich warm color palette, naturalistic lighting, no text, no borders.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宏伟的浪漫主义写实油画，描绘 {argument name="time of day" default="金色日落"} 时分的高山荒野。前景是一个广阔平静的山间湖泊，倒映着天空、松林、岩石海岸和高耸的雪峰。主峰雄伟壮丽，在温暖的橙色阳光照射下轮廓分明，周围环绕着崎岖的悬崖和逐渐隐入大气薄雾中的远方冰川。太阳位于右侧地平线附近，将发光的琥珀色光芒投射在水面上，并照亮了蓝金交织的天空中零散的云朵。茂密的常绿树木构成了画面的两侧，右侧是深色的森林屏障，左侧是陡峭的岩石悬崖。添加细腻的细节：湖面升起的薄雾、前景零星的岩石和浮木、水面上荡漾的温暖倒影，以及 2 只站在右侧岸边的鹿。使用 {argument name="painting style" default="19 世纪哈德逊河画派浪漫主义风景"} 风格，强调高细节笔触、明亮的大气感、史诗般的尺度、宁静的氛围、浓郁温暖的色调、自然主义光影，无文字，无边框。

templates.title: Autumn Willow Hanfu Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 秋柳汉服海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic fantasy fashion poster in an elegant historical East Asian aesthetic: a young woman, {argument name="character description" default="a graceful noblewoman with chestnut-brown hair in a low bun decorated with tiny floral hairpins"}, stands in side profile beside a shallow reflective stream under an old willow tree. Her face is intentionally covered by a soft square warm-toned blur, while the rest of the figure is sharp and detailed. She wears {argument name="outfit description" default="layered cream and beige embroidered hanfu robes with red floral patterns, long wide sleeves, a pleated skirt, and flowing rust-red ribbons"}, holding {argument name="umbrella description" default="a large cream paper parasol painted with delicate red blossoms and exposed wooden ribs"} over her shoulder. The scene contains exactly one woman, one open parasol, one massive dark twisting willow trunk, many long golden hanging willow branches, clusters of pale white flowers around her feet, scattered rocks, and one calm stream at the bottom reflecting warm light. Use a warm late-autumn golden-hour palette, dreamy shallow depth of field, volumetric backlight, soft bokeh, highly detailed fabric embroidery, painterly realism mixed with luxury editorial photography, 9:16 poster composition, centered full-body figure slightly left of center. Add a vertical calligraphy title to the right of the woman reading {argument name="vertical title text" default="茵悼晽萱弥旁"}, with two tiny butterfly motifs near it, and below it add a small elegant serif subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="INICE SOND MIOSE SURTAL AUTMON"}. At the very bottom, include several narrow centered lines of tiny decorative serif credit text, intentionally mostly unreadable, like an art-book poster footer. Maintain a serene, poetic, autumnal mood with intricate natural textures and no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版电影感奇幻时尚海报，呈现优雅的历史东亚美学：一位年轻女子，{argument name="character description" default="一位优雅的贵族女性，栗棕色头发梳成低发髻，饰有精致的小花发簪"}，侧身站在古柳树下浅浅的倒影溪流旁。她的面部被刻意处理为柔和的方形暖色模糊效果，而其余人物细节清晰。她身着 {argument name="outfit description" default="层叠的米色与奶油色刺绣汉服，饰有红色花卉图案，宽大的长袖，百褶裙，以及飘逸的铁锈红丝带"}，肩上撑着 {argument name="umbrella description" default="一把绘有精致红花、露出木质伞骨的大型奶油色油纸伞"}。画面中仅包含一名女子、一把撑开的伞、一棵巨大的深色扭曲柳树树干、许多金色的垂柳枝、脚边簇拥的浅白色花朵、散落的岩石，以及底部反射着暖光的平静溪流。采用温暖的深秋黄金时刻色调，梦幻般的浅景深，体积光背光，柔和的焦外成像，高度精细的织物刺绣，融合写实绘画风格与奢华时尚摄影，9:16 海报构图，全身人物居中偏左。在女子右侧添加竖排书法标题 {argument name="vertical title text" default="茵悼晽萱弥旁"}，旁边配有两个微小的蝴蝶图案，下方添加一行优雅的小字衬线副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="INICE SOND MIOSE SURTAL AUTMON"}。在最底部，包含几行居中的细小装饰性衬线信用文字，刻意处理为大部分不可读，呈现艺术画册海报页脚的效果。保持宁静、诗意、深秋的氛围，强调细腻的自然纹理，且不包含任何现代物品。

Keep the same character, outfit, pose, framing, storefront entrance, metal grid, bicycle, street, and overall composition, but make it look like a real candid photo rather than a game render. Add a cool blue dusk tone, harsh built-in flash on the subject, wet rainy pavement with subtle reflections, softened background depth, slight underexposure, visible digital noise, mild chromatic aberration, lens softness, vignette, and low-resolution CCD texture. Preserve the face anonymization as a soft square blur. Maintain a natural 16:9 snapshot crop with imperfect casual framing.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为底图，将《模拟人生 4》(Sims 4) 截图转换为写实的 {argument name="photo style" default="21 世纪初 CCD 数码相机照片"}。保持原有的人物、服装、姿势、取景、店面入口、金属格栅、自行车、街道以及整体构图，但要使其看起来像是一张真实的抓拍照片，而非游戏渲染图。添加冷色调的暮光效果、主体上强烈的内置闪光灯效果、带有细微反射的潮湿雨后路面、柔化的背景景深、轻微的曝光不足、可见的数字噪点、轻微的色差、镜头柔光、暗角以及低分辨率的 CCD 质感。将面部匿名化处理为柔和的方形模糊效果。保持自然的 16:9 快照比例和不完美的随意构图。

templates.title: Sims 4 to CCD Carnival Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 将 Sims 4 截图转换为 CCD 嘉年华自拍

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the Sims 4 character base, transform it into a realistic {argument name="photo style" default="CCD digital camera flash photo"} rather than a game screenshot. Repose the character as a close-up arm’s-length selfie, wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="plain white sweatshirt"}, with one arm extended toward the camera and the other hand giving a thumbs-up. Change the setting to a {argument name="new setting" default="nighttime amusement park or carnival"} with strong on-camera flash, slightly harsh highlights, low-light noise, mild blur, and nostalgic compact-camera colors. Add a festive background with red carpet walkways, striped carnival booths, glowing marquee bulbs, string lights, trees, and exactly 6 visible balloons: 4 on the left side in purple, green, green, and yellow, and 2 on the right side in blue and red. Keep the overall face-obscuring square censorship from the reference, but make the image look like an authentic casual snapshot rather than a rendered scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像作为 Sims 4 角色基础，将其转换为逼真的 {argument name="photo style" default="CCD 数码相机闪光灯照片"}，而非游戏截图。将角色调整为近距离手持自拍姿势，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="纯白色卫衣"}，一只手臂伸向镜头，另一只手比出大拇指。将场景更改为 {argument name="new setting" default="夜间游乐园或嘉年华"}，呈现强烈的机顶闪光灯效果、略显生硬的高光、低光噪点、轻微模糊以及怀旧的卡片机色彩。添加充满节日氛围的背景，包括红地毯步道、条纹嘉年华摊位、发光的灯箱灯泡、串灯、树木，以及正好 6 个可见的气球：左侧 4 个分别为紫色、绿色、绿色和黄色，右侧 2 个分别为蓝色和红色。保留参考图中遮挡面部的方形马赛克，但使整体图像看起来像是一张真实的随手拍照片，而非渲染场景。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic awards-ceremony still of {argument name="character name" default="John C. templates.title: Low-Angle Japanese Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日式街头低角度人像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical smartphone street snapshot of an {argument name="subject" default="adult woman with shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair"} crouching very close to a wide-angle camera on a sunny Japanese city sidewalk. She is posed in a low squat, leaning forward with one elbow on her knee and one hand extended toward the lens, making the hand and long glossy pale-pink manicured nails appear large in the foreground. Her face is completely covered by a centered opaque square blur in a muted brown-pink tone, as if anonymized. She wears a tight low-cut {argument name="top color" default="white"} short-sleeve top, light faded blue jeans, and beige transparent-strap square-toe sandals. Use harsh midday sunlight, strong shadows on asphalt, realistic skin highlights, wind-tossed hair, candid paparazzi-like framing, slightly tilted composition, ultra-real phone-camera texture, shallow perspective distortion, and high detail. The background is a Japanese urban street corner with a tiled building facade, a green awning, a vertical utility pole with stickers and handwritten Japanese markings, a blue pedestrian road sign, and a restaurant sign reading {argument name="restaurant sign text" default="かめや"}; include additional small Japanese signage and street clutter for authenticity. Shot from a very low angle near ground level, close crop, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, realistic documentary style, no illustration or anime look.

promptLocalized.zh: 生成一张写实风格的竖版手机街头抓拍，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着齐肩深棕色波浪卷发的成年女性"} 在阳光明媚的日本城市人行道上，蹲伏在广角镜头前。她呈低蹲姿势，身体前倾，一只手肘抵在膝盖上，另一只手向镜头伸出，使手部和修长的淡粉色光泽美甲在前景中显得格外突出。她的脸部被一个居中的不透明棕粉色模糊方块完全遮盖，呈现出匿名效果。她身穿一件紧身低胸 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 短袖上衣、浅色水洗蓝牛仔裤和米色透明带方头凉鞋。采用正午强烈的阳光，沥青路面上的浓重阴影，逼真的皮肤高光，随风飘动的发丝，类似狗仔队的抓拍构图，略微倾斜的视角，超真实的手机拍摄质感，浅景深透视畸变，以及高细节表现。背景是日本城市街角，包含贴有瓷砖的建筑立面、绿色遮阳棚、带有贴纸和手写日文标记的垂直电线杆、蓝色行人路标，以及写有 {argument name="restaurant sign text" default="かめや"} 的餐厅招牌；加入更多细小的日文标志和街头杂物以增强真实感。采用近地面的极低角度拍摄，紧凑裁剪，9:16 竖屏比例，写实纪录片风格，拒绝插画或动漫感。

templates.title: Anime ChatGPT Companion in Study

titleLocalized.zh: 学习场景中的动漫版 ChatGPT 伙伴

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style personification of {argument name="AI character name" default="ChatGPT"} as a gentle young female AI companion in a warm sunlit study. She has short silvery-white bobbed hair with soft waves, small braids, teal gradient tips, and teal OpenAI-knot hair ornaments with ribbons; her face is covered by a centered plain beige square censor block. She wears an elegant white academic robe with wide sleeves lined in teal, black inner dress or vest, teal tie, gold trim, small tech-like pins, and a teal ribbon emblem on one sleeve. She sits at a wooden desk, holding a dark book against her chest with the words “Knowledge Understanding Inspiration” and a small OpenAI-style knot symbol on the cover, while her other hand is raised as if presenting a hologram. To her left floats one translucent cyan chat bubble labeled “ChatGPT” with the text “Your AI companion. Here to help, inspire, and understand.” plus a small heart, and three smaller glowing square icons around it: one light bulb icon, one magnifying glass icon, and one chat message icon. On the desk include exactly eight visible study objects: a dark mug with an OpenAI-style knot logo and the word “ChatGPT,” a stack of four labeled books reading “Science,” “History,” “Art,” and “Philosophy,” one teal pen, one open notebook, one black book held by the character, and one small white robot mascot with teal glowing eyes and an OpenAI-style logo. The open notebook has two pages: the left page titled “Ideas” with notes “Conversations,” “Possibilities,” and “Infinite,” and the right page titled “Today’s Plan” with checklist items “Help someone,” “Spark ideas,” and “Make a difference,” with small doodles and hearts. In the background, show a cozy library with bookshelves, potted plants, sunlight streaming through a window, and a dark chalkboard. The chalkboard displays an OpenAI-style knot symbol and the phrase “Together, we can:” followed by exactly five bullet points: “Learn,” “Create,” “Solve,” “Explore,” and “and more!” plus little star doodles and a cat face doodle. Use a soft painterly anime illustration style, luminous rim lighting, teal and cream color palette, delicate highlights, high detail, shallow depth of field, cozy optimistic atmosphere, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个精致的动漫风格拟人化形象，将 {argument name="AI character name" default="ChatGPT"} 描绘成一位在温暖阳光书房中的温柔年轻女性 AI 伙伴。她留着带柔和波浪的银白色短波波头，编有小辫子，发梢呈青色渐变，并佩戴着青色的 OpenAI 结发饰和丝带；她的脸部被一个居中的米色方形马赛克遮挡。她身穿优雅的白色学术长袍，宽大的袖口内衬为青色，内搭黑色连衣裙或马甲，系着青色领带，配有金色镶边、小型科技感徽章，袖子上有一个青色丝带纹章。她坐在木质书桌前，怀中抱着一本深色书籍，封面上印有“Knowledge Understanding Inspiration”字样和一个小型的 OpenAI 风格结符号，另一只手抬起，仿佛正在展示全息投影。在她的左侧漂浮着一个半透明的青色聊天气泡，上面标有“ChatGPT”字样，文字内容为“Your AI companion. Here to help, inspire, and understand.”，旁边还有一个小爱心；气泡周围环绕着三个较小的发光方形图标：一个灯泡图标、一个放大镜图标和一个聊天信息图标。书桌上需包含 8 个清晰可见的学习用品：一个印有 OpenAI 风格结标志和“ChatGPT”字样的深色马克杯、一叠标有“Science”、“History”、“Art”和“Philosophy”的四本书、一支青色钢笔、一本打开的笔记本、角色手中持有的黑色书籍，以及一个带有青色发光眼睛和 OpenAI 风格标志的小型白色机器人吉祥物。打开的笔记本有两页：左页标题为“Ideas”，笔记内容为“Conversations”、“Possibilities”和“Infinite”；右页标题为“Today’s Plan”，清单项目包括“Help someone”、“Spark ideas”和“Make a difference”，并配有小涂鸦和爱心。背景展示一个温馨的图书馆，配有书架、盆栽、透过窗户射入的阳光以及一块深色黑板。黑板上显示着一个 OpenAI 风格的结符号和短语“Together, we can:”，后接 5 个项目符号点：“Learn”、“Create”、“Solve”、“Explore”和“and more!”，并装饰有小星星涂鸦和猫脸涂鸦。采用柔和的动漫绘画风格，带有明亮的轮廓光，使用青色和奶油色调，高光细腻，细节丰富，景深较浅，营造出温馨乐观的氛围，采用竖构图。
