templates.title: Chaotic Manga Uniform Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 混乱漫画制服变身

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the rough composition guide and REFERENCE_1 as the character/pose guide, turn the sketch into a polished, high-energy manga/anime illustration. Keep the same 4-character arrangement: 1 huge muscular student centered in back flexing one arm, 1 small white-haired student at lower left in a crouched/action pose, 1 slim standing student at right raising a fist, and 1 shocked pink-haired close-up face cropped at the bottom left. Convert the loose colored sketch into clean inked line art with vibrant cel shading, sharp comic-panel energy, and exaggerated perspective. Add a chaotic explosion background behind the three full-body characters with orange-yellow fire bursts, smoke puffs, speed lines, impact spikes, and comic burst shapes. Add 2 visible Japanese text elements: a large top-left sound effect {argument name="sound effect text" default="カオス!"} and a jagged speech bubble at bottom right reading {argument name="speech bubble text" default="えぇっ!?\n私の制服!?"}. Preserve the school-uniform theme from REFERENCE_1 but render it as finished clothing: mint sweater and teal skirt styling for the center and left characters, a dark fitted uniform for the right character, and a close-up shocked face in the lower-left foreground. Use a dynamic shonen-comedy manga page style with thick outlines, dramatic motion lines, saturated colors, and layered comic effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为构图参考，REFERENCE_1 作为角色/姿势参考，将草图转化为精美、高能量的漫画/动画插图。保持 4 个角色的排列：中间后方是一个巨大的肌肉发达的学生正在展示手臂，左下角是一个白发小个子学生处于蹲伏/动作姿势，右侧是一个苗条的站立学生正在举起拳头，左下角是一个被裁切的粉发震惊特写脸部。将粗糙的彩色草图转换为干净的墨线稿，并配以鲜艳的赛璐珞阴影、强烈的漫画分镜感和夸张的透视效果。在三个全身角色身后添加混乱的爆炸背景，包括橙黄色火花、烟雾、速度线、冲击尖刺和漫画爆炸形状。添加 2 个可见的日语文本元素：左上角的大型音效 {argument name="sound effect text" default="カオス!"} 和右下角的锯齿状对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="えぇっ!?\n私の制服!?"}。保留 REFERENCE_1 中的校服主题，但将其渲染为成品服装：中间和左侧角色采用薄荷绿毛衣和蓝绿色裙子，右侧角色采用深色修身制服，左下角前景为震惊的特写脸部。采用动态少年喜剧漫画页面风格，使用粗轮廓线、戏剧性的运动线条、饱和的色彩和分层漫画效果。

templates.title: Cinematic Bed Jump Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感跳床摄影

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic ultra-wide low-angle action photograph inside a dimly lit {argument name="room type" default="hotel bedroom"}, looking up from the surface of a messy white bed as {argument name="number of people" default="two"} energetic {argument name="subjects" default="young women"} jump high above the mattress. The larger subject on the right is frozen midair with knees bent, arms spread wide, bare feet visible, long dark hair flinging upward in wild strands, wearing a white sleeveless cropped top and pale yellow shorts. The smaller subject on the left is also jumping on the bed with arms raised, messy dark hair in motion, wearing a yellow camisole with white lace trim and blue denim shorts. Keep both faces indistinct or softly obscured by motion and shadow while emphasizing body movement, flying hair, and playful energy. Use dramatic warm hotel lighting: a bright backlight behind the jumpers creates glowing rim light, lens flare, dust particles in the air, and strong silhouettes; bedside lamps glow warmly on both sides, with curtains on the right, a framed picture on the left wall, dark headboard, rumpled white sheets, and large pillows in the foreground. Make the camera feel very close to the bed with a 24mm wide-angle perspective, dynamic diagonal composition, slight fisheye distortion, shallow depth of field, high ISO film grain, realistic skin tones, crisp fabric texture, motion blur on hair and limbs, and a spontaneous candid snapshot mood. Style: {argument name="visual style" default="photorealistic cinematic editorial photography"}, warm shadows, high contrast, chaotic joyful atmosphere, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感超广角低角度动作照片，场景位于光线昏暗的 {argument name="room type" default="酒店卧室"} 内，从凌乱的白色床面向上仰拍，{argument name="number of people" default="两名"} 充满活力的 {argument name="subjects" default="年轻女性"} 在床垫上方高高跃起。右侧较大的主体在空中定格，双膝弯曲，双臂张开，露出赤脚，长长的黑发凌乱地向上飞扬，身穿白色无袖短款上衣和浅黄色短裤。左侧较小的主体也在床上跳跃，双臂高举，凌乱的黑发随动作摆动，身穿带有白色蕾丝花边的黄色吊带衫和蓝色牛仔短裤。保持两人的面部模糊或被动作与阴影柔和遮挡，同时强调肢体动作、飞扬的头发和俏皮的活力。使用戏剧性的暖色调酒店灯光：跳跃者身后的明亮背光营造出耀眼的轮廓光、镜头光晕、空气中的尘埃颗粒以及强烈的剪影；两侧床头灯发出温暖的光芒，右侧有窗帘，左侧墙上有装裱的画作，深色床头板，凌乱的白色床单，前景中有大枕头。相机视角需极度贴近床面，采用 24mm 广角透视、动态对角线构图、轻微鱼眼畸变、浅景深、高 ISO 胶片颗粒感、真实的肤色、清晰的织物纹理、头发和四肢的动态模糊，以及自发性的抓拍氛围。风格：{argument name="visual style" default="照片级逼真的电影感编辑摄影"}，暖色调阴影，高对比度，混乱而欢乐的氛围，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Nurse Portrait With Stethoscope

titleLocalized.zh: 佩戴听诊器的护士肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, front-facing waist-up portrait photo of a {argument name="profession" default="female nurse or clinician"} standing against a plain off-white textured wall. The subject wears {argument name="scrub color" default="burgundy"} V-neck medical scrubs with short sleeves, a small chest pocket on the viewer's right, and a metal snap detail near the collar. A detailed stethoscope hangs naturally around the neck, with black tubing, silver metal binaurals, gray eartips resting near the pocket, and the round chest piece visible on the viewer's left side. The person has medium brown hair tied back with a few loose strands near the ears, neutral upright posture, shoulders squared, centered composition, cropped from just above the head to mid-torso. The face is intentionally covered by a large square skin-tone privacy mosaic block, hiding all facial features while leaving the hair, ears, neck, clothing, and stethoscope visible. Use soft even indoor lighting, sharp photographic detail, natural colors, minimal background distractions, and a clean clinical profile-photo style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的、正面半身肖像照片，主角为一名 {argument name="profession" default="女性护士或临床医生"}，背景为一面纯色灰白色纹理墙。主体穿着 {argument name="scrub color" default="酒红色"} V 领医疗刷手服，短袖，观察者右侧有一个小胸袋，领口附近有金属按扣细节。一条精致的听诊器自然地挂在脖子上，黑色管路，银色金属耳挂，灰色耳塞靠近口袋，圆形的听诊头位于观察者左侧。人物留着中等长度的棕色头发，向后扎起，耳边有几缕碎发，姿态中立挺拔，双肩平齐，构图居中，裁剪范围从头顶上方到躯干中部。面部被一个大的方形肤色隐私马赛克块有意遮挡，隐藏了所有面部特征，同时保留了头发、耳朵、颈部、服装和听诊器。使用柔和均匀的室内光线，呈现清晰的摄影细节、自然的色彩、极简的背景，以及干净的临床证件照风格。

templates.title: Colored Anime Manga Splash Panel

titleLocalized.zh: 彩色动漫漫画跨页分镜

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the rough composition guide and REFERENCE_1 as the cleaned pose/layout guide, turn the sketch into a polished full-color anime manga panel. Keep the same 4-character arrangement and poses: 1 large muscular student centered in back flexing, 1 blond student on the right flexing, 1 small white-haired student on the left in a crouched power pose, and 1 red-haired character cropped large in the lower-left foreground reacting in shock. Replace the rough construction lines with clean inked line art, cel shading, and finished school-uniform colors. Add a high-energy manga background that was not in the references: dense blue radial speed lines, halftone texture, blue and yellow star shapes, and yellow comic burst accents. Keep 1 jagged speech bubble at the lower right with vertical Japanese text reading {argument name="speech bubble text" default="なにしてんの?"}. Make the final image look like a dramatic comedic shonen manga splash panel, with crisp outlines, saturated colors, and dynamic impact effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为构图参考，REFERENCE_1 作为精细姿势/布局参考，将草图转化为精美的全彩动漫漫画分镜。保持相同的 4 人排列和姿势：中间后方 1 名强壮的学生正在展示肌肉，右侧 1 名金发学生正在展示肌肉，左侧 1 名白发小个子学生呈蹲姿蓄力，左下角前景 1 名红发角色被大面积截取并表现出震惊的表情。将粗糙的结构线替换为干净的墨线、赛璐珞阴影以及完整的校服配色。添加参考图中没有的高能漫画背景：密集的蓝色放射状速度线、网点纹理、蓝黄色星形图案以及黄色漫画爆炸特效。在右下角保留 1 个锯齿状对话框，其中包含垂直排列的日语文本 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="なにしてんの?"}。使最终图像呈现出戏剧性的喜剧少年漫画跨页分镜效果，具备清晰的轮廓、饱和的色彩和动态的视觉冲击力。

templates.title: Anime Hiker Over Scenic Mountain View

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格徒步者与绝美山景

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base landscape, remove all YAMAP branding, date, route, and metric overlay text, then transform the scene into a polished anime-style travel illustration while preserving the mountaintop viewpoint over the city, lake, distant mountains, hazy sky, and green forested foreground. Add one foreground character: a young anime hiker viewed from behind/three-quarter back, standing on an old stone castle-wall lookout and gazing over the scenery. Give the character {argument name="hair color" default="long aqua-blue hair"} in a high ponytail with a blue ribbon and star hair ornament, a light blue hiking shirt, beige cargo hiking pants, brown hiking boots, fingerless gloves, and a large dark hiking backpack. Add exactly 4 visible gear/accessory elements on or near the character: 1 rolled sleeping mat strapped to the backpack, 1 dangling blue star charm, 1 small blue bird-like companion perched near the shoulder, and 1 small hiking pouch/strap detail. Add weathered stone blocks under the character and soft blurred green leaves in the lower foreground for depth. Keep the composition scenic and peaceful, with bright morning light, gentle atmospheric haze, crisp anime linework on the character, and a softly detailed semi-realistic background. Do not include any text, logos, UI, or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为基础景观，移除所有 YAMAP 品牌标识、日期、路线及数据叠加文本，将场景转换为精致的动漫风格旅行插画，同时保留俯瞰城市、湖泊、远山、朦胧天空和绿色森林前景的山顶视角。添加一名前景角色：一位年轻的动漫徒步者，背影/四分之三侧背影，站在古老的石制城堡墙头眺望风景。为角色设置 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的水蓝色头发"}，扎成高马尾，配有蓝色丝带和星星发饰，身穿浅蓝色徒步衬衫、米色工装徒步裤、棕色徒步靴，佩戴露指手套，背着一个大型深色徒步背包。在角色身上或附近添加 4 个清晰可见的装备/配饰元素：1 个绑在背包上的卷起睡垫、1 个悬挂的蓝色星星挂件、1 只停在肩膀附近的小型蓝色鸟类伙伴，以及 1 个小型徒步小包/肩带细节。在角色脚下添加风化的石块，并在下方前景处加入柔和模糊的绿叶以增加景深。保持构图优美宁静，呈现明亮的晨光、柔和的大气朦胧感、角色清晰的动漫线条，以及背景中柔和细腻的半写实风格。不要包含任何文本、Logo、UI 或水印。

templates.title: Victorian Tea Room Waiting Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 维多利亚风格茶室等候壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a vertical smartphone wallpaper-style background illustration of an elegant dark Victorian dressing room prepared for a refined tea-time meeting, with the message {argument name="quote" default="整えた心で、君を待つ。"} in thin white Japanese Mincho-style lettering near the upper left, including a small decorative divider flourish beneath the text. The scene shows one ornate carved chair draped with one black-and-white maid-inspired garment: a black central panel, white apron-like front, wide white ruffled trim, and a large black bow with a gold brooch and dangling chain tassel at the chest. In the foreground place one polished silver serving tray holding exactly four tea service items: one white porcelain teapot with gold ornament, one matching sugar bowl, one teacup filled with amber tea on a saucer, and one small domed gold bell or covered dish, with one ornate spoon beside it. To the right place one folded white lace-trimmed maid accessory or apron with a black strap and gold medallion, and on the vanity place exactly five vanity objects: one glowing table lamp with a cream shade, one large oval mirror with a gold frame, one glass vase of lavender stems, one lace headband with two purple ribbon bows, and three small round gold boxes. Add exactly two flower arrangements: lavender stems in the glass vase and a small black vase of purple crocus-like flowers in the lower right, with a few loose purple petals on the tabletop. Use {argument name="room style" default="dark antique mahogany Victorian interior"}, warm lamplight, soft daylight entering from a tall window with dark curtains on the left, rich carved wood panels, reflective polished metal surfaces, deep shadows, romantic waiting-room atmosphere, and a muted palette of black, ivory, gold, brown, and violet. Compose the image in portrait orientation, 9:16 aspect ratio, with the chair on the left, vanity and mirror on the right, tea tray in the lower foreground, and generous dark negative space around the quote.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张优雅的深色维多利亚风格更衣室竖版手机壁纸，营造出为精致茶会做准备的氛围。在左上方用纤细的白色日文明朝体书写 {argument name="quote" default="整えた心で、君を待つ。"}，并在文字下方添加一个小巧的装饰性分割线。画面中有一把雕花椅子，上面搭着一件黑白配色的女仆风格服饰：黑色中片、白色围裙式前襟、宽大的白色荷叶边，以及胸前饰有金质胸针和垂坠链条流苏的巨大黑色蝴蝶结。前景放置一个抛光的银色托盘，上面精确摆放四件茶具：一个带有金色装饰的白瓷茶壶、一个配套的糖罐、一个盛有琥珀色茶水的茶杯及杯托，以及一个带有圆顶的小金钟或盖碗，旁边放着一把精致的勺子。右侧放置一件折叠好的白色蕾丝边女仆配饰或围裙，带有黑色肩带和金质奖章。梳妆台上精确摆放五件梳妆物品：一盏带有奶油色灯罩的暖光台灯、一面金框大椭圆镜、一个插有薰衣草的花瓶、一个带有两个紫色丝带蝴蝶结的蕾丝发带，以及三个圆形小金盒。添加两处花艺布置：玻璃花瓶中的薰衣草，以及右下角黑色小花瓶中类似紫色藏红花的鲜花，桌面上散落着几片紫色花瓣。使用 {argument name="room style" default="深色古董红木维多利亚室内风格"}，运用温暖的灯光，左侧高窗透入柔和的日光并配有深色窗帘，展现丰富的雕花木板、反光的金属表面、深邃的阴影，营造浪漫的等候室氛围，色调采用黑、象牙白、金、棕和紫色的柔和配色。构图采用竖屏 9:16 比例，椅子位于左侧，梳妆台和镜子位于右侧，茶盘位于前景下方，并在短句周围留出充足的深色负空间。

templates.title: Masquerade Palace Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 假面宫殿壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a vertical smartphone-wallpaper style fantasy background illustration set inside an opulent palace room at golden hour. The scene looks out through a tall arched window with ornate black-gold lattice screens toward a softly blurred domed palace and minarets in the distance. On the left, one large deep crimson patterned curtain is pulled aside, with one hanging tassel near the top center. In the foreground, place one dark carved wooden desk covered with luxurious props: one white sealed envelope with a red wax seal, one stack of scattered letters and papers, one black ink bottle, one black feather quill standing upright, one rolled parchment scroll, one ornate gold-and-black masquerade mask, one half-filled glass of red wine, one tall filigree metal lantern containing a lit candle, and two embroidered fabrics draped over the desk, one red and one black-gold. Use warm amber sunlight, dramatic shadows, dust motes, and a romantic mysterious atmosphere, with rich burgundy, bronze, black, and gold tones. Add elegant Japanese message text on the left over the curtain area reading {argument name="message text" default="仮面の奥に、\n真実を隠して。"}, set in a refined serif style in pale gold, with a thin horizontal gold line and small sparkle beneath it. Make the composition cinematic, quiet, and slightly melancholic, as if hinting at palace intrigue and hidden truth behind a mask.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖屏手机壁纸风格的奇幻背景插画，场景设定在黄金时刻一座富丽堂皇的宫殿房间内。透过带有华丽黑金格栅的高大拱窗，可以看到远处模糊的圆顶宫殿和尖塔。左侧拉开一扇深红色的花纹窗帘，顶部中央悬挂着一个流苏。前景中，放置一张深色雕花木桌，桌上摆满了奢华的道具：一个带有红色火漆印的白色信封、一叠散落的信件和纸张、一个黑色墨水瓶、一支竖立的黑色羽毛笔、一卷羊皮纸、一个华丽的黑金假面舞会面具、半杯红酒、一个装有燃烛的镂空金属灯笼，以及两块分别呈红色和黑金色的刺绣布料。运用温暖的琥珀色阳光、戏剧性的阴影、浮动的尘埃，营造出浪漫而神秘的氛围，色调以浓郁的酒红色、青铜色、黑色和金色为主。在左侧窗帘区域添加优雅的日语寄语文字 {argument name="message text" default="仮面の奥に、\n真実を隠して。"}，采用精致的衬线字体，颜色为淡金色，下方配有一条纤细的水平金线和微小的闪光点。构图需具有电影感、宁静且略带忧郁，仿佛在暗示宫廷阴谋以及面具背后隐藏的真相。

variables.defaultValue: 仮面の奥に、\n真実を隠して。

templates.title: Moonlit Guardian Balcony

titleLocalized.zh: 月光守护者阳台

templates.prompt: Create a vertical fantasy background illustration in a dark romantic gothic style, viewed from a high stone balcony at night. The scene overlooks a vast illuminated castle city with many spires and warm window lights beneath a cloudy deep-blue sky and a bright full moon. In the left foreground place two massive weathered stone columns wrapped with ivy and vines, a black cloak or mantle draped over a chair or railing, and one glowing brass lantern on a wooden chest. Across the lower foreground place one aged parchment map spread on a dark wooden table, one ornate dagger with emerald accents lying diagonally across it, one black leather glove beside it, two rolled scrolls tied with cord, one small metal cup or inkwell near the balcony ledge, one decorative locked treasure chest on the right, and one potted flowering plant with white blossoms. Use warm candlelight in the foreground contrasting with cool moonlight over the distant city, creating a quiet protective mood. Add a short vertical Japanese message on the left column in elegant white serif calligraphy, arranged as two vertical text columns, reading {argument name="message text" default="静かな刃は、君を守る。"}. Make the setting feel like {argument name="setting mood" default="a silent guardian's lookout over a royal capital"}, with {argument name="main foreground item" default="an emerald-inlaid dagger"} as the visual focus, {argument name="sky condition" default="moonlit clouds"}, and {argument name="city style" default="gothic fantasy castle city"}. No characters are visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张深色浪漫哥特风格的垂直奇幻背景插画，视角设在夜晚的高处石质阳台上。场景俯瞰着一座广阔且灯火通明的城堡城市，云层密布的深蓝色天空下，尖塔林立，窗户透出温暖的灯光，一轮满月高悬。左侧前景放置两根缠绕着常春藤和藤蔓的巨大风化石柱，一把椅子或栏杆上披着一件黑色斗篷或披风，木箱上放着一盏发光的黄铜灯。在下方前景处，摆放一张铺在深色木桌上的陈旧羊皮地图，一把饰有祖母绿的华丽匕首斜放在地图上，旁边是一只黑色皮手套、两卷用绳子系着的卷轴、阳台边缘附近的一个小金属杯或墨水瓶，右侧是一个装饰性的锁闭宝箱，以及一盆开着白色花朵的盆栽。前景使用温暖的烛光与远方城市清冷的月光形成对比，营造出一种静谧的守护氛围。在左侧石柱上添加一段优雅的白色衬线书法垂直日文短句，排版为两列垂直文本，内容为 {argument name="message text" default="静かな刃は、君を守る。"}。场景设定为 {argument name="setting mood" default="一位沉默的守护者俯瞰王都"}，以 {argument name="main foreground item" default="一把镶嵌祖母绿的匕首"} 作为视觉焦点，背景为 {argument name="sky condition" default="月光下的云层"} 和 {argument name="city style" default="哥特奇幻城堡城市"}。画面中不出现任何人物。

variables.defaultValue: a silent guardian's lookout over a royal capital

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic square-format anime illustration of a pale elven cyborg girl in extreme close-up, shown from the shoulders up against a deep black abstract ink background. She has {argument name="hair color" default="very light icy blue-white"} messy shoulder-length hair with many loose strands, heavy black ink linework, and one long sharp pointed elf ear extending horizontally to the left, with small mechanical details near the ear. Her face is intentionally obscured by a large vertical rounded-rectangle censor block in flat {argument name="censor block color" default="cool light gray"}, centered over the entire face from the forehead down past the chin, hiding all facial features. Her neck, collarbone, and upper chest are exposed and transformed into intricate black biomechanical circuitry, cables, armor-like fragments, and organic machine patterns over pale skin. Use a high-contrast monochrome manga style with icy blue highlights, scratchy brush strokes, splattered ink, rough hand-drawn contours, dense black shadows, and a gritty cyberpunk dark-fantasy mood. The composition should crop tightly around the head and shoulders, with the elf ear and hair filling the frame, no text, no border, no additional characters.

templates.title: Shih Tzu Park Photo Restoration

titleLocalized.zh: 西施犬公园照片修复

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the dog reference, recreate the same Shih Tzu as a clean, natural color photograph. Remove the telephone-card border, printed numbers, text, scratches, discoloration, and any overlay/censor block. Replace the original card/photo background with a sunny outdoor park setting: the dog lying on vivid green grass, with softly blurred trees and warm sunlight in the distance. Keep the dog centered and front-facing in a similar lying pose, preserving the black-and-white coat pattern and the two black hair bows. Improve the image quality to look like a sharp modern pet portrait with realistic fur detail, natural lighting, and shallow depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图为基础，重现这只西施犬，并将其制作成一张色彩自然、清晰的照片。去除电话卡边框、印刷数字、文字、划痕、变色以及任何遮挡物或马赛克。将原有的卡片/照片背景替换为阳光明媚的户外公园场景：狗狗躺在翠绿的草地上，远处是柔和模糊的树木和温暖的阳光。保持狗狗居中并面向镜头，姿势与原图相似，同时保留其黑白毛色图案和两个黑色发结。提升图像质量，使其呈现出清晰的现代宠物肖像风格，具备逼真的毛发细节、自然光影和浅景深效果。

templates.title: Pastel Neon Angel Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和霓虹天使少女

templates.prompt: Create a vivid anime-style illustration on a pure black background featuring one floating angelic teenage girl with {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} bob-cut hair, blunt bangs, soft pink eyes, and a shy, slightly pouty expression. She wears a {argument name="jacket color" default="bubblegum pink"} zip-up track jacket with white sleeve stripes, a short white pleated skirt, thigh-high white socks with two pink stripes near the top, and chunky pastel pink lace-up platform sneakers. Pose her seated in midair with one knee raised, the other leg bent downward, one hand near her mouth and the other extended outward. Add exactly two white feathered wings behind her and exactly one melting cream-pink halo above her head, with glossy drips. Surround her with a dreamy neon space-candy aura: exactly one small ringed planet near the lower left, exactly three prominent dripping yellow-pink star charms, exactly two puffy pink-purple cloud blobs, and flowing pastel ribbon trails in pink, mint, cyan, and lavender curling around her body. Use saturated kawaii cyber-pop colors, thick clean anime linework, iridescent chromatic aberration outlines in green and magenta, glossy highlights, tiny scattered sparkles, and a sticker-like composition with high contrast against the black background. The overall mood should be cute, celestial, magical, and slightly surreal, like a pastel angel floating through a candy-colored galaxy.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纯黑色背景上创作一张生动的动漫风格插画，主角是一位漂浮的天使少女，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和粉色"} 的波波头，配有齐刘海，拥有柔和的粉色双眸，表情羞涩且略带嘟嘴。她穿着一件 {argument name="jacket color" default="泡泡糖粉色"} 的拉链运动夹克，袖子上有白色条纹，搭配白色短百褶裙、膝上白色长袜（袜口处有两条粉色条纹），以及厚底的柔和粉色系带运动鞋。让她呈现出半空中坐姿，一膝抬起，另一条腿向下弯曲，一只手靠近嘴边，另一只手向外伸展。在她身后添加两只白色羽翼，头顶上方添加一个正在融化的奶油粉色光环，并带有光泽滴落效果。用梦幻般的霓虹糖果空间氛围环绕她：左下方放置一颗带环的小行星，三个醒目的滴落状黄粉色星星挂饰，两团蓬松的粉紫色云朵，以及粉色、薄荷绿、青色和薰衣草紫色的柔和丝带轨迹围绕在她的身体周围。使用高饱和度的可爱赛博流行色彩，粗线条且干净的动漫勾线，带有绿色和洋红色的虹彩像差轮廓，闪亮的高光，零星散布的小火花，以及在黑色背景下具有高对比度的贴纸式构图。整体氛围应可爱、空灵、充满魔力且略带超现实感，宛如一位柔和系天使漂浮在糖果色的银河之中。

templates.title: Sleepy Chibi Angel Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 困倦的 Q 版天使女孩

templates.prompt: Create a cute chibi anime sticker illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a sleepy angel girl"} floating against a flat bright {argument name="background color" default="sky blue"} background. The character has pale skin, half-lidded teal eyes, a tiny neutral mouth, and long {argument name="hair color" default="pale blonde"} twin tails with blunt bangs and face-framing locks, tied with exactly 2 large black ribbon bows. Above her head is 1 thick golden dripping halo, with exactly 3 small golden sparkle stars around it. She has exactly 2 small white feathered angel wings behind her. Dress her in an oversized {argument name="jacket color" default="teal green"} zip-up track jacket with a high collar, silver zipper, and two white stripes down the sleeves, paired with a short black pleated skirt. Pose her seated and floating in midair with one knee raised and the other leg dangling, slightly slouched with a bored, sleepy expression. She wears white knee socks with black horizontal stripes near the top and white sneakers with {argument name="shoelace color" default="yellow"} laces. Use a clean kawaii digital art style with thick black outlines, rounded simplified shapes, soft flat colors, minimal shading, no text, centered composition, full body visible, playful mascot-like proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的 Q 版动漫贴纸插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位困倦的天使女孩"}，悬浮在平整明亮的 {argument name="background color" default="天蓝色"} 背景前。角色拥有白皙的皮肤、半睁的青色眼眸、小巧的中性嘴巴，以及长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 双马尾，配有齐刘海和修饰脸型的发丝，并用 2 个黑色大蝴蝶结扎起。她的头顶上方有一个厚实的金色滴落状光环，周围环绕着 3 颗金色小闪星。她的背后有 2 对白色羽毛小天使翅膀。为她穿上一件超大号的 {argument name="jacket color" default="青绿色"} 拉链运动外套，配有高领、银色拉链和袖子上的两条白色条纹，下身搭配一条黑色短款百褶裙。让她呈现坐姿悬浮在半空中，一只膝盖抬起，另一条腿自然下垂，姿态略显慵懒，表情困倦。她穿着带有黑色横条纹的白色过膝袜，以及配有 {argument name="shoelace color" default="黄色"} 鞋带的白色运动鞋。采用干净的卡哇伊数字艺术风格，线条粗黑，形状圆润简洁，色彩平涂柔和，阴影极少，无文字，构图居中，全身可见，具有俏皮的吉祥物比例。

templates.title: Chibi Angel Girls at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的 Q 版天使女孩

templates.prompt: Create a cozy square anime illustration at sunset on a grassy riverside embankment. The scene features exactly 3 chibi angel girls sitting side by side on the slope with their knees hugged to their chests, facing forward with small dot eyes and gentle smiles. Each girl has one glowing halo above her head and one pair of small white wings on her back, for a total of 3 halos and 3 wing pairs. The left girl has {argument name="left character hair color" default="long aqua blue hair"}, a turquoise zip-up tracksuit jacket with white stripes, a dark pleated skirt, striped knee socks, and teal-accent sneakers. The middle girl has {argument name="middle character hair color" default="long blonde twin tails"} tied with black ribbons, a dark green zip-up tracksuit jacket with white stripes, a black pleated skirt, striped knee socks, and yellow-accent sneakers. The right girl has {argument name="right character hair color" default="long pink hair"}, a coral pink zip-up tracksuit jacket with white stripes, a white pleated skirt, striped knee socks, and pink-accent sneakers. Use a cute soft-lined 2D anime style with warm nostalgic lighting, rounded proportions, clean outlines, and detailed grassy texture dotted with small white daisies. In the background, include a stairway on the left climbing the embankment, a calm river on the right reflecting the orange sun, a bridge in the distance, and a small city skyline under a peach-orange sky with scattered fluffy clouds. The atmosphere should feel peaceful, whimsical, and slightly magical, with the sun low near the horizon and warm golden highlights on the grass and water.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅温馨的正方形动漫插画，背景是日落时分的河畔草坡。画面中共有 3 位 Q 版天使女孩并排坐在坡上，双膝抱胸，面向前方，有着小小的豆豆眼和温柔的微笑。每位女孩头顶上方都有一个发光的头环，背部有一对小巧的白色翅膀，总计 3 个头环和 3 对翅膀。左侧女孩拥有 {argument name="left character hair color" default="长长的水蓝色头发"}，身穿带有白色条纹的青色拉链运动夹克、深色百褶裙、条纹过膝袜和青色点缀的运动鞋。中间女孩拥有 {argument name="middle character hair color" default="系着黑色丝带的长金发双马尾"}，身穿带有白色条纹的深绿色拉链运动夹克、黑色百褶裙、条纹过膝袜和黄色点缀的运动鞋。右侧女孩拥有 {argument name="right character hair color" default="长长的粉色头发"}，身穿带有白色条纹的珊瑚粉拉链运动夹克、白色百褶裙、条纹过膝袜和粉色点缀的运动鞋。采用可爱且线条柔和的 2D 动漫风格，呈现温暖怀旧的灯光、圆润的比例、干净的轮廓，以及点缀着小白雏菊的细腻草地纹理。背景左侧包含一段通往坡上的阶梯，右侧是倒映着橙色太阳的平静河流，远处有一座桥梁，以及在桃橙色天空和零星蓬松云朵下的城市天际线。整体氛围应宁静、奇幻且略带魔力，太阳低垂在地平线附近，草地和水面上闪烁着温暖的金色光芒。

templates.title: Accidental iPhone Selfie Extraction

titleLocalized.zh: 意外的 iPhone 自拍提取

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the source, isolate the lower accidental selfie photo and turn it into the final standalone image: remove the ChatGPT interface, text bubble, download icon, and input bar completely, then uncrop/extend the snapshot so it fills the frame as a vertical iPhone-style photo. Follow the intent described in REFERENCE_0: make it look like an ordinary, slightly failed, unplanned selfie taken while pulling a phone from a pocket, with a careless low angle, messy composition, slight motion blur, uneven lighting, mild overexposure from the room lights, and a very realistic casual phone-camera feel. Keep the same indoor room, ceiling light, wall lamp, and subject from the lower photo, but show more of the face, neck, dark shirt, and a thin chain necklace, with a blurry finger partially covering the lower-left foreground. Avoid making it look posed, polished, cinematic, or intentionally composed.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 为素材源，提取下方意外拍摄的自拍照片并将其转化为最终的独立图像：彻底移除 ChatGPT 界面、文本气泡、下载图标和输入栏，然后对快照进行反裁剪/扩展，使其填满整个画面，呈现为竖屏 iPhone 风格的照片。遵循 REFERENCE_0 中描述的意图：使其看起来像是一张从口袋里掏出手机时无意间拍下的、略显失败的随意自拍，带有随意的低角度、杂乱的构图、轻微的运动模糊、不均匀的灯光、室内灯光造成的轻微过曝，以及非常真实的手机摄像头质感。保留下方照片中的室内环境、吸顶灯、壁灯和主体，但要展示出更多的面部、颈部、深色衬衫和细链项链，并在左下角前景处加入模糊的手指遮挡效果。避免使其看起来像是有意摆拍、经过精修、具有电影感或刻意构图的作品。

templates.title: Accidental ChatGPT Selfie Screen

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 误触自拍界面

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source prompt text and REFERENCE_1 as the app-screen composition reference, generate the resulting ChatGPT mobile conversation screen. Keep the Japanese prompt visible as a small rounded gray message bubble near the upper right, but create a new ordinary, accidental-looking iPhone selfie below it: it should look like the phone was pulled from a pocket and the shutter was pressed unintentionally, with messy tilted framing, slight motion blur, uneven sun flare/overexposure, and no deliberate composition. Make the selfie outdoors in bright daylight on a residential street, with part of a young woman cropped off on the right edge, long dark hair, a beige coat sleeve stretched toward the camera in the foreground, buildings and blue sky in the background. Include the ChatGPT app UI around it: top bar with hamburger button, “ChatGPT” title pill, compose icon, and three-dot menu; below the image include an “編集する” edit button and a centered down-arrow button. Preserve the casual imperfect snapshot feel rather than making it polished or cinematic.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0 作为源提示文本，REFERENCE_1 作为应用界面构图参考，生成最终的 ChatGPT 移动端对话界面。将日语提示词保留在右上角附近，作为一个小巧的灰色圆角消息气泡；在下方生成一张看起来像是从口袋里掏出手机时误触快门拍摄的普通自拍：画面应呈现凌乱的倾斜构图、轻微的运动模糊、不均匀的阳光眩光或过曝，且没有任何刻意的构图感。自拍背景设定在明亮日光的住宅区街道，画面右侧裁切掉了一名年轻女性的部分身影，她留着深色长发，前景中有一只穿着米色外套的袖子伸向镜头，背景是建筑物和蓝天。包含 ChatGPT 应用 UI：顶部栏带有汉堡菜单按钮、“ChatGPT”标题胶囊、撰写图标和三点菜单；在图片下方包含一个“編集する”编辑按钮和一个居中的向下箭头按钮。保持随意的非完美快照感，而非精致或电影级的画面。

templates.title: Rabbit Character Sprite Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 兔子角色精灵图集

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the character-design base, convert the character sheet into a clean 2D game sprite sheet on a {argument name="background color" default="plain white"} background. Preserve the rabbit character’s proportions, black outline style, blue inner ears, blue eyes, small red nose, and fluffy tail, but remove all Japanese labels and reference-sheet headings. Generate {argument name="sprite count" default="57"} separate full-body sprites arranged in a loose grid with transparent-looking spacing between poses. Include these visible rows: 6 small front-facing idle/expression sprites; 8 right-facing running sprites; 8 more right-facing running/stride sprites; 4 front-facing neutral idle sprites; 5 front-facing cute/holding-paws sprites; 8 sleepy, sad, crouching, and low-energy sprites; 6 front-facing cheerful/neutral expression sprites; 6 dynamic running or hopping sprites; and 6 bottom-row cute reaction sprites including shy, surprised, bashful, eyes-closed smiling, tilted-head, and hands-near-mouth poses. Keep the line art simple and consistent, like a hand-drawn cartoon sprite sheet for a {argument name="game type" default="2D platformer or casual mobile game"}, with each sprite isolated and no shadows, props, text, borders, or background scenery.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为角色设计基础，将该角色图转换为背景为 {argument name="background color" default="纯白色"} 的整洁 2D 游戏精灵图集。保留兔子角色的比例、黑色轮廓风格、蓝色耳内侧、蓝色眼睛、红色小鼻子和毛茸茸的尾巴，但需移除所有日语标签和参考图标题。生成 {argument name="sprite count" default="57"} 个独立的全身精灵图，以松散的网格排列，并在姿态之间留出透明间隔。包含以下可见行：6 个小型正面待机/表情精灵；8 个向右奔跑精灵；8 个向右奔跑/跨步精灵；4 个正面中性待机精灵；5 个正面可爱/握爪精灵；8 个困倦、悲伤、蹲伏和低能量精灵；6 个正面愉快/中性表情精灵；6 个动态奔跑或跳跃精灵；以及底部的 6 个可爱反应精灵，包括害羞、惊讶、羞涩、闭眼微笑、歪头和手捂嘴姿势。保持线条艺术简洁且一致，如同用于 {argument name="game type" default="2D 平台游戏或休闲手游"} 的手绘卡通精灵图集，每个精灵均需独立，且不包含阴影、道具、文字、边框或背景场景。

templates.title: Balenciaga Street Fashion Sketch

titleLocalized.zh: Balenciaga 街头时尚素描

templates.prompt: Create a loose, hand-drawn fashion street sketch in a naive black-ink marker style on a white background, showing exactly 2 tall slim young women standing on a rainy neon city sidewalk outside a {argument name="store name" default="BALENCIAGA"} storefront. Put the large handwritten word {argument name="store name" default="BALENCIAGA"} across the upper left. The left woman has a simple visible face, {argument name="hair color" default="bright yellow-blonde"} chin-length hair with bangs, a relaxed tilted pose, very long thin legs, high-heeled open-toe sandals, and an oversized black hoodie or sweatshirt with the small white text {argument name="chest logo text" default="BB BALENCIAGA"} on the chest above a short black skirt. The right woman is taller, with long black braided or dreadlocked hair and a deliberately blurred rectangular face, wearing an oversized black zip jacket, short black skirt, long thin legs, and high-heeled open-toe sandals, leaning casually with hands in pockets. Draw the clothes mostly as dense scribbled black fills with rough white highlights and wobbly outlines. The background should include exactly 5 visible vertical city signs on the left side: one tall white sign with yellow symbols and a red block, one narrow black sign with yellow characters, one white sign with red Japanese katakana reading {argument name="red sign text" default="カラオケ"}, one tiny traffic-light-like sign with red/yellow/green marks, and one small blue sign near the street; add another small blue-and-white sign on the far right edge. Show wet pavement with reflected red, yellow, blue, and gray squiggles, tiny distant pedestrians, simple perspective lines of buildings, and a minimal storefront wall on the right. Keep the composition sketchy, high-fashion, candid, imperfect, with thin black lines, sparse color accents, and lots of white space.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张随性、手绘风格的时尚街头素描，采用朴素的黑色墨水马克笔风格，背景为白色，画面中准确呈现 2 位高挑纤瘦的年轻女性，站在雨中霓虹闪烁的城市人行道上，背景为 {argument name="store name" default="BALENCIAGA"} 店面。在左上方写上醒目的手写单词 {argument name="store name" default="BALENCIAGA"}。左侧女性面部清晰可见，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮金黄色"} 的齐下巴短发并带有刘海，姿态放松且微倾，双腿修长，穿着高跟露趾凉鞋，身穿超大号黑色连帽衫或卫衣，胸前印有白色小字 {argument name="chest logo text" default="BB BALENCIAGA"}，下搭黑色短裙。右侧女性更高，留着黑色长辫或脏辫，面部呈刻意模糊的矩形，身穿超大号黑色拉链夹克和黑色短裙，双腿修长，穿着高跟露趾凉鞋，双手插兜，姿态随意。衣物主要以密集的黑色涂鸦填充，带有粗犷的白色高光和不规则的轮廓线。背景应包含左侧 5 个清晰可见的垂直城市招牌：一个带有黄色符号和红色方块的高大白色招牌，一个带有黄色字符的窄长黑色招牌，一个带有红色日文片假名 {argument name="red sign text" default="カラオケ"} 的白色招牌，一个类似交通灯的小型招牌（带有红/黄/绿标记），以及街边一个蓝色小招牌；在最右侧边缘再添加一个蓝白相间的小招牌。描绘湿漉漉的人行道，上面有红色、黄色、蓝色和灰色的反射波纹，远处有微小的行人，简单的建筑透视线，以及右侧极简的店面墙壁。保持构图的素描感、高级时尚感、抓拍感和不完美感，使用细黑线条，点缀少量色彩，并留出大量空白。

templates.prompt: Create a cozy hand-drawn colored-pencil and crayon style illustration of a cute pastel study room corner, with warm beige paper texture and sketchy brown outlines. Show one young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy light brown hair"} sitting at a wooden desk and writing in an open journal with a black pen; her face is intentionally covered by a plain beige square censor block. She wears a frilly pink gingham dress with lace trim and a bow, seated on a wooden chair over a pink scalloped rug. The room contains exactly 1 large wooden desk with 2 visible drawers, 1 open notebook, 1 closed pink book stack, 1 teacup on a saucer, 1 pen, 1 wooden chair, 1 curtained window with flowers outside, 1 hanging vine, 4 potted plants, 1 bookshelf with colorful books, 1 small framed photo, 1 floral table lamp, and 1 framed flower picture on the wall. Include exactly 2 visible text labels: a pink hanging wall sign reading {argument name="wall sign text" default="luffynodoo"} and a cloud speech-bubble sign reading {argument name="cloud text" default="ももいろ\nメモリーズ♡"}. Surround the scene with kawaii doodles: 4 large pink flowers, 8 yellow stars, 1 blue smiling cloud, 1 pink lollipop, 1 wrapped candy, small hearts and sparkles. Use soft pastel pink, cream, honey brown, pale yellow, mint green, and baby blue, with a whimsical Japanese stationery aesthetic, delicate crosshatching, cozy sunlight, and no photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅温馨的手绘彩色铅笔和蜡笔风格插画，描绘一个可爱的柔和色调学习室角落，具有温暖的米色纸张质感和素描感的棕色轮廓。画面中展示一位年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长波浪浅棕色头发"}，坐在木桌前用黑色钢笔在打开的日记本上书写；她的脸部被一个简单的米色方形遮挡块刻意遮住。她穿着带有蕾丝花边和蝴蝶结的粉色格子荷叶边连衣裙，坐在木椅上，脚下铺着粉色扇形地毯。房间内包含 1 张带 2 个可见抽屉的大木桌、1 本打开的笔记本、1 叠闭合的粉色书籍、1 个带托盘的茶杯、1 支钢笔、1 把木椅、1 个窗外有花的窗帘窗户、1 条悬挂的藤蔓、4 盆盆栽、1 个放着彩色书籍的书架、1 个小相框、1 个花卉台灯以及墙上 1 幅装裱的花卉画。包含 2 个可见的文字标签：一个写着 {argument name="wall sign text" default="luffynodoo"} 的粉色悬挂墙牌，以及一个写着 {argument name="cloud text" default="ももいろ\nメモリーズ♡"} 的云朵对话气泡牌。场景周围环绕着可爱的涂鸦：4 朵大粉花、8 颗黄星星、1 朵蓝色笑脸云、1 根粉色棒棒糖、1 颗包装糖果，以及小爱心和闪光点。采用柔和的粉色、奶油色、蜜棕色、淡黄色、薄荷绿和婴儿蓝，呈现出奇幻的日式文具美学、精致的交叉排线、温暖的阳光，且不追求写实感。

templates.title: Fox Girl Bubble Dream

titleLocalized.zh: 狐耳少女的泡泡梦

templates.prompt: Create a bright, highly detailed anime-style summer scene in a mountain parking lot beside a cable-stayed bridge, under a vivid blue sky with scattered fluffy white clouds. The central subject is {argument name="character name" default="Alma"}, a cheerful young fox-girl with sandy-blonde hair, upright northern fox ears, and a playful carefree pose, wearing an oversized {argument name="hoodie color and pattern" default="red and black plaid hoodie"}, black shorts, and chunky black lace-up boots; she is stepping lightly as if dancing while holding a soap-bubble wand and looking delighted. Around her are exactly 3 other school-age girls playing with bubbles: one on the left with long black hair in a navy jacket, skirt, black socks, and sneakers, raising a bubble wand; one near the center-left with short silvery hair, a gray hoodie, dark skirt, tights, and white sneakers, holding a small bubble bottle; and one on the right in a beige hoodie and dark skirt, reaching up toward the bubbles. Show exactly 4 large prominent soap bubbles: one huge iridescent bubble floating beside the fox-girl at lower right, one large bubble high above her, one large bubble near the upper right, and one medium-large bubble near the left sky; also include about 14 smaller bubbles scattered between them, all transparent with rainbow highlights and glossy reflections of the landscape. The background includes green forested mountains with a little snow on distant peaks, a tall cable-stayed bridge tower and cables on the left, parked cars and vans on the right, white parking-lot lines on asphalt, roadside greenery, and a blue road sign reading {argument name="bridge sign text" default="ニセコ大橋"} with small English text below. Use a cinematic wide-angle composition, low slightly upward viewpoint, crisp sunlight, soft shadows, airy depth, sparkling bubble reflections, and polished modern anime illustration quality with painterly realism and clean detailed linework.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅明亮且高度精细的动漫风格夏日场景，背景位于斜拉桥旁的山间停车场，天空湛蓝，点缀着蓬松的白云。画面中心人物是 {argument name="character name" default="Alma"}，一位开朗的年轻狐耳少女，有着沙金色头发、竖起的北极狐耳朵，姿态俏皮无忧，身穿一件超大号的 {argument name="hoodie color and pattern" default="红黑格纹连帽衫"}、黑色短裤和厚底黑色系带靴；她正轻盈地迈步，仿佛在跳舞，手中拿着泡泡棒，神情愉悦。她周围有 3 位同样学龄的女孩正在玩泡泡：左侧一位留着长黑发，身穿海军蓝夹克、短裙、黑色长袜和运动鞋，正举起泡泡棒；中左侧一位留着银色短发，身穿灰色连帽衫、深色短裙、连裤袜和白色运动鞋，手里拿着一个小泡泡瓶；右侧一位身穿米色连帽衫和深色短裙，正伸手去够泡泡。画面中需包含 4 个醒目的大肥皂泡：一个巨大的彩虹色泡泡漂浮在狐耳少女右下方，一个大泡泡在她头顶上方，一个大泡泡在右上角附近，还有一个中大型泡泡在左侧天空附近；此外还需包含约 14 个散布在它们之间的小泡泡，所有泡泡均呈透明状，带有彩虹高光和景观的亮面反射。背景包括绿树成荫的山脉，远处的山峰覆盖着少量积雪，左侧有一座高大的斜拉桥塔和缆索，右侧停放着轿车和货车，沥青路面上有白色的停车位线，路边有绿植，以及一块蓝色的道路指示牌，上面写着 {argument name="bridge sign text" default="ニセコ大橋"}，下方附有小型英文文本。采用电影级广角构图，低角度略微仰视视角，阳光明媚，阴影柔和，具有通透的景深感，泡泡反射出闪烁的光芒，呈现出精致的现代动漫插画品质，兼具绘画感与清晰细腻的线条。

templates.title: Cozy Pastel Miniature Writing Room

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨柔和色调的微缩书房

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed cozy miniature diorama room in a soft pastel, hand-drawn storybook-anime style, shown in a three-quarter isometric view as a tiny open box with stitched beige fabric walls and floor edges. The scene centers on a young woman seated at a wooden writing desk, wearing a pink pastel plaid dress with ruffled off-shoulder sleeves, lace trim, a bow at the chest, and a delicate necklace; her long {argument name="hair color" default="wavy light brown"} hair falls over her shoulders, and her face is covered by a flat plain tan square censor patch. She is writing with a pen in an open notebook on the desk. The desk contains exactly 10 visible tabletop items: one open notebook, one pen in her hand, one teacup on a saucer filled with tea, one pink closed notebook, two round buttons, one blue wrapped candy, one pink striped candy, one tiny yellow candy, and one small flower. Add a warm wooden window on the left with lace curtains and garden light shining through; outside the window are pink roses and greenery. Include exactly three fluffy white clouds floating near the window, plus small star and flower doodles around the room. On the right wall place a pink stitched name plaque reading {argument name="wall sign text" default="luffynodoo"} with tiny heart doodles around it, plus two blue cloud doodles and two yellow star doodles. Furnish the right side with a small wooden shelf and cabinet containing exactly four upright books, one potted succulent, one lampshade, and one jar labeled {argument name="jar label" default="CANDY"}. Add a woven basket plant on the floor, a wooden chair, a small red rug, scattered embroidery-like flowers, a looping yellow thread, and delicate candy, flower, star, and cloud motifs throughout. Use warm sunlight, soft shadows, realistic miniature textures, embroidered fabric seams, intricate lace, wood grain, pastel pink and beige tones, cute whimsical atmosphere, high detail, square composition, no extra text except the wall sign and candy jar label.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个细节极其丰富的温馨微缩立体模型房间，采用柔和的粉彩色调、手绘故事书动漫风格，以四分之三等轴测视角呈现，如同一个带有米色缝合织物墙壁和地板边缘的微型开口盒子。场景中心是一位坐在木制书桌前的年轻女性，她穿着粉色格子裙，带有荷叶边露肩袖、蕾丝饰边、胸前蝴蝶结和精致的项链；她长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="波浪状浅棕色"} 头发垂在肩上，脸部被一个平坦的棕褐色方形遮挡块覆盖。她正拿着笔在桌上的打开的笔记本上书写。书桌上包含 10 个清晰可见的桌面物品：一本打开的笔记本、她手中的一支笔、一个装有茶的茶托茶杯、一本闭合的粉色笔记本、两颗圆形纽扣、一颗蓝色包装的糖果、一颗粉色条纹糖果、一颗微小的黄色糖果和一朵小花。左侧添加一扇带有蕾丝窗帘的温暖木窗，花园的光线从中透入；窗外是粉色的玫瑰和绿植。在窗户附近添加三朵蓬松的白云，房间周围点缀着小星星和花朵涂鸦。在右侧墙上放置一个粉色缝合的名牌，上面写着 {argument name="wall sign text" default="luffynodoo"}，周围环绕着微小的心形涂鸦，以及两个蓝色云朵涂鸦和两个黄色星星涂鸦。右侧摆放一个小木架和柜子，里面放着四本直立的书、一盆多肉植物、一个灯罩和一个贴有 {argument name="jar label" default="CANDY"} 标签的罐子。地板上放置一个编织植物篮、一把木椅、一块红色小地毯，并散布着刺绣般的小花、环绕的黄色丝线，以及随处可见的精致糖果、花朵、星星和云朵图案。使用温暖的阳光、柔和的阴影、逼真的微缩质感、刺绣织物接缝、精致的蕾丝、木纹、柔和的粉色和米色调，营造可爱奇幻的氛围，高细节，方形构图，除墙面标志和糖果罐标签外，不包含任何额外文字。

templates.title: Cozy Café Window Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨咖啡馆窗边人像

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic editorial lifestyle photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a young woman"} sitting at a rustic wooden café table beside a large old-fashioned window in a cozy wood-paneled coffee shop. She has dark hair tied in a loose messy bun and wears a cream-colored knitted sleeveless V-neck dress with a light blue denim jacket draped over her shoulders, plus delicate gold jewelry including a small pendant necklace, bracelet, and ring. Her pose is relaxed and introspective, leaning her head into one hand with the elbow on the table, seated slightly angled toward the camera; place an opaque square censor block over the face in a skin-tone brown color. On the table are exactly 2 main objects: a ceramic cup of latte with visible latte art on a saucer, and a small glass jar filled with dried white flowers. The background shows exactly 3 key café elements: multi-pane window frames on the left with soft daylight coming through, warm dark wooden wall paneling, and a blurred chalkboard menu on the back wall. Use {argument name="lens focal length" default="35mm"} documentary-style photography, shallow depth of field, natural window light from the left, warm indoor shadows, soft bokeh, realistic skin and fabric textures, vertical portrait composition, slightly high camera angle looking down toward the table, muted earthy tones, cozy rainy-day café atmosphere, and the look of a full-frame camera shot at wide aperture.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度写实的生活方式编辑摄影作品，拍摄 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"} 坐在温馨木质咖啡馆内，靠在一扇大型复古窗户旁的质朴木桌前。她留着深色头发，扎成随意的丸子头，身穿奶油色针织无袖 V 领连衣裙，肩上披着一件浅蓝色牛仔外套，并佩戴精致的金色首饰，包括一条小吊坠项链、手链和戒指。她的姿势放松且沉思，单手托腮，手肘撑在桌面上，身体略微朝向镜头；在面部覆盖一个肤色棕色的不透明方形遮挡块。桌上放置 2 个主要物品：一个带有拉花图案的陶瓷拿铁咖啡杯及托盘，以及一个装有干白花的小玻璃罐。背景呈现 3 个关键咖啡馆元素：左侧透入柔和日光的多格窗框、温暖的深色木质墙板，以及后墙上模糊的黑板菜单。使用 {argument name="lens focal length" default="35mm"} 纪录片风格摄影，浅景深，左侧自然窗光，温暖的室内阴影，柔和的背景虚化，逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，竖构图人像，略微俯视桌面的高机位，柔和的大地色调，温馨的雨天咖啡馆氛围，以及全画幅相机大光圈拍摄的效果。

The room should feel peaceful and lived-in, with golden sunlight streaming through a large open window on the left, white curtains, blue sky and fluffy clouds outside, and leafy green plants on the windowsill and in the foreground. Include exactly two pillows behind the character, one mustard yellow and one green gingham, plus cream bedding and a rounded wooden headboard. On the wall above the bed, include exactly three wall decorations: a cat poster reading {argument name="poster text" default="GOOD DAY"}, a small hanging sign reading "Relax" with a paw print, and a framed landscape picture. On the wall shelf to the upper right, include exactly five visible items: one potted trailing plant, one cat-face plush or ornament, two upright books, and one framed landscape photo. Add a bedside table on the right with a lamp, a small alarm clock, and a cup; place one open beverage can on the bed near the character. In the foreground, include a low table with a mug of tea and a magazine titled {argument name="magazine title" default="NEKO LIFE"} featuring a cat illustration, plus a small potted plant. templates.title: Kasane Teto Pop Idol Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 重音特（Kasane Teto）流行偶像肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant anime close-up portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Kasane Teto"}, a mischievous young virtual singer with vivid {argument name="hair color" default="hot pink"} hair styled into two large glossy drill-twin-tails on both sides, short layered bangs, and loose side strands. She has large pink-red eyes with golden highlights, long black lashes, faint blush, and a playful toothy grin. Pose her leaning toward the viewer in strong perspective, one arm thrust forward with her index finger pointing directly at the camera, the other hand touching her cheek with pink manicured nails. Dress her in a dark navy sleeveless collared shirt with bright magenta piping, magenta buttons, a front placket, and a small chest pocket, with a detached dark navy sleeve visible on one arm. Use a cute pop-idol anime illustration style with clean ink lines, glossy cel shading, soft skin tones, and a thick white sticker-like outline around the character. Set the background to a flat pastel {argument name="background color" default="pink"} with decorative white doodles: exactly 3 outlined stars, 7 four-point sparkles, and 3 short radiating accent lines near the upper right. Make the composition energetic, centered, cropped from the torso upward, with the pointing hand exaggerated large in the foreground and the face framed by the twin drills.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的动漫特写肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="重音特（Kasane Teto）"}，一位调皮的年轻虚拟歌手。她拥有鲜艳的 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色"} 头发，两侧扎成两个硕大且富有光泽的钻头双马尾，配有短碎刘海和松散的侧发。她有着粉红色的大眼睛，带有金色高光、长长的黑色睫毛、淡淡的腮红以及俏皮的露齿笑容。让她以强烈的透视感向观众倾斜，一只手臂向前伸出，食指直指镜头，另一只手轻触脸颊，指甲修剪成粉色。让她身穿深海军蓝无袖翻领衬衫，配有亮洋红色滚边、洋红色纽扣、前襟和胸前小口袋，手臂上可见一只分离式的深海军蓝袖套。采用可爱的流行偶像动漫插画风格，线条清晰，赛璐珞风格光影，肤色柔和，角色周围带有厚实的白色贴纸状轮廓。背景设置为平铺的淡 {argument name="background color" default="粉色"}，并点缀白色涂鸦：精确包含 3 个轮廓星形、7 个四角闪光点以及右上角附近的 3 条短放射状强调线。构图需充满活力，居中对齐，从躯干上方裁剪，前景中放大的指点手势与双钻头马尾环绕的面部形成呼应。

templates.title: Anime Fantasy Ensemble Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Anime Fantasy Ensemble Poster

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime movie poster in a polished modern Japanese fantasy style, with a deep navy, violet, and sunset-orange color palette, cinematic rim lighting, falling red petals, icy crystal shards, and glowing magical particles. The poster features exactly 6 characters arranged in a dense ensemble composition: 1 central black-haired teenage boy in a dark cloak holding a radiant blue crystalline star-shaped weapon at the lower center, his face obscured by a soft square blur; 1 white-haired young man in a white military-style coat on the left, turned in profile, face obscured by a soft square blur; 1 pink-haired young girl in a white academy uniform at the lower left clasping her hands, face obscured by a soft square blur; 1 long dark-blue-haired young woman on the right wearing a black sleeveless outfit and carrying a sword, face visible and looking determined; 1 blond young man in a pale coat at the lower right, face obscured by a soft square blur; and 1 ethereal pale-haired female figure looming behind them at the top, partially hidden, with her face covered by a large muted rectangular block. In the background, show a towering gothic castle or cathedral spire rising into a glowing dusk sky on the right, with dark flowing hair-like shapes and starry night textures sweeping across the upper left. Add exactly 8 text elements: large vertical Japanese slogan on the left reading {argument name="left slogan" default="世界の真実を、取り戻せ。"}, a smaller vertical phrase beside it reading {argument name="small left phrase" default="この運命に、抗え"}, vertical Japanese copy on the right reading {argument name="right slogan" default="絶望が支配する世界で、少年は――"}, small production copy above the title reading {argument name="production line" default="完全新作オリジナルTVアニメーション"}, a large luminous Japanese title at the bottom center reading {argument name="main title" default="星灰のレゾナンス"}, a spaced Roman subtitle below it reading "SEIKAI NO RESONANCE", a release line reading "2025年 TVアニメ放送開始", and tiny staff/cast credits plus a final tagline along the bottom reading "信じる意志が、未来を変える". Use elegant Japanese poster typography, high contrast, layered depth, painterly detail, sharp highlights on fabric and hair, and a premium theatrical key visual composition.

titleLocalized.zh: Crimson Noir Lounge Scene

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic neo-noir film still in a dark, intimate lounge with deep crimson walls and a plush red velvet sofa dominating the foreground. On the right, show {argument name="female subject" default="a blonde woman in a pale champagne silk slip dress"} seated on the sofa, leaning forward with one arm across her lap and holding a lit cigarette delicately in her raised hand; her face is intentionally obscured by a flat dark-brown rectangular privacy block. On the left, near a closed wooden door, place {argument name="male subject" default="a man in a dark suit and tie"} standing in profile with hands in his pockets, mostly in shadow, his face also obscured by a dark privacy block. The room should feel tense and secretive, with warm low-key lighting from a small table lamp behind the sofa casting amber light onto the red wall. Include two framed artworks on the wall, a dark statue or decorative object in the back right, heavy shadows, rich red and brown tones, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, and a widescreen 16:9 composition. Make it look like a moody 1970s psychological thriller scene, elegant but unsettling, with realistic photography, dramatic contrast, and no visible text.

templates.title: Minimal Game Engine Skybox Scene

titleLocalized.zh: Minimal Game Engine Skybox Scene

templates.prompt: Create a wide 16:9 photorealistic game-engine skybox test scene viewed from a low first-person camera on a vast flat, nearly black asphalt or matte platform under a huge open blue sky. The composition is dominated by the sky: bright midday sun glowing slightly left of center near the horizon line, strong lens bloom, pale blue atmospheric gradient, and scattered thin wispy white cirrus clouds across the upper left and upper right. The ground is a dark featureless plane with subtle reflections and faint grid-like seams, stretching to a straight distant horizon. On the right side, place two simple modern industrial cuboid buildings: one large dark gray corrugated metal box building tilted in perspective with small narrow black rectangular windows, a dark doorway, and a few roof vents; farther right, a white rectangular building partially cropped by the frame with sparse vertical black windows. Add a thin glowing pink-red line or laser strip running from the bottom center foreground toward the horizon beside the buildings, creating a strong perspective guide. Include a few tiny floating dark oval objects near the horizon beneath the sun. Use Unreal Engine / Unity-style real-time rendering, crisp shadows, high dynamic range lighting, realistic skybox atmosphere, minimal urban test environment, no people, no text, no vehicles, clean cinematic screenshot aesthetic. The customizable scene should use {argument name="sky condition" default="bright midday blue sky with wispy cirrus clouds"}, {argument name="ground material" default="nearly black asphalt platform"}, {argument name="building style" default="minimal corrugated industrial cuboid buildings"}, {argument name="accent line color" default="glowing pink-red"}, and {argument name="camera perspective" default="low first-person wide-angle view"}.

titleLocalized.zh: AI Cost Reduction Taoist Talisman

templates.prompt: Create a single front-facing Chinese Taoist talisman on an off-white background, centered as a tall vertical rectangle of aged golden-yellow rice paper with subtle fibrous texture, slight mottling, and a thin red outer border plus inner red frame. Use deep cinnabar-red ink for the sacred graphics and mostly black ink for side calligraphy, with a hand-brushed, slightly imperfect printed look. The talisman contains 4 vertical text columns: left black column reading {argument name="left invocation text" default="使天下所有 SOTA 大型模型 成本降為十分之一"}, right black column reading {argument name="right invocation text" default="敕令天曹地府 削減算力消耗 降成本費用"}, a small red boxed column at lower left reading "立降十成", and a small red boxed column at lower right reading "成本大降". In the center, draw a large ornate red Taoist spell glyph with stacked Chinese characters, including a top title {argument name="central title text" default="敕令靈畫"} and the phrase {argument name="central reduction text" default="十分之一"}, shaped like a flowing ritual sigil with angular strokes. Above it place 1 yin-yang symbol inside a red circle, surrounded by 8 red bagua trigrams arranged symmetrically. Add 2 mirrored vertical red circuit-like ritual lines flanking the central glyph, each with circular nodes, giving a mystical-computing hybrid feeling. At the bottom center add 1 red square seal stamp containing four stylized characters, default text {argument name="seal text" default="敕妙降本符"}, and beneath it 1 small trigram mark. Decorate the four corners with 4 red flame-cloud ornaments and add fine red ornamental curls near the bottom corners. The composition should resemble an authentic Daoist paper charm redesigned as a humorous magical cost-reduction talisman for SOTA AI models, cleanly photographed or scanned, flat 2D, high resolution, no perspective distortion.

Show the figure from a dramatic low angle, with one massive articulated hand reaching down toward the viewer in extreme foreshortening, fingers made of cylindrical metal segments and ornate joints. Behind its head, place a circular halo of glowing mechanical rings and sunburst light, sending warm rays through towering dark clouds. Below, depict a vast crowd of robed ancient people in awe, many raising their arms toward the titan; include ruined classical architecture and columns at the left and right edges for scale. Use a cinematic wide composition, chiaroscuro lighting, deep shadows, glowing amber highlights, smoky atmosphere, turbulent clouds, dense painterly brushwork, intricate detail, mythic apocalyptic mood, and museum-quality classical realism. Keep the palette dominated by {argument name="main color palette" default="antique gold, bronze, umber, charcoal gray, and warm celestial amber"}. No modern text, no sci-fi neon, no cartoon styling; make it feel like a lost grand master painting of a divine machine descending from heaven.

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Place the primary chassis or structural platform perfectly centered as the core spine, and position the main body shell separately (left or top), aligned parallel as a reference form while preserving accurate proportions, stance, and geometry of the real vehicle.￼ Design a multi-layered exploded system with components separated across depth (Z-axis) as well as planar spacing, using clear hierarchy: micro hardware (bolts, screws, washers) tightly grouped, functional assemblies moderately spaced, and major systems widely separated.￼ Organize parts into realistic subsystems depending on the {argument name="vehicle type" default="vehicle"} type, including front assembly (suspension, steering, brakes), rear assembly (suspension, drivetrain, differential), chassis/structure (frame, monocoque, subframes), powertrain (engine or motor with slight internal exposure, transmission, intake, exhaust, cooling), electronics (battery, ECU, wiring harness with clean routing), and wheel systems (4 wheels symmetrically placed with tire, rim, and hub separation).￼ Ensure engineering realism by preserving mechanical relationships, aligning shafts and rotational axes, maintaining symmetry across left/right systems, and grouping micro components logically near their assembly points in precise micro-grid arrangements. Avoid random placement. Use a refined, high-end aesthetic: soft {argument name="background gradient" default="neutral gradient"} background (white to light grey or warm beige), studio-grade product lighting with soft top illumination, subtle directional shadows, and controlled reflections. Apply realistic materials such as brushed metal, carbon fiber, rubber, and glass with slight wear—avoid toy-like finishes. Maintain strong horizontal symmetry with controlled depth asymmetry for visual complexity, and ensure balanced negative space to avoid overcrowding. Render in ultra-realistic quality with razor-sharp edges, macro-level detail, subtle ambient occlusion, and ray-traced shadows. Output in 2K or 4K resolution, 4:5 aspect ratio.￼ ￼ No text, no labels, no arrows, no branding overlays, no stylization, no perspective distortion. The environment is quiet, carrying a subtle sense of urban solitude. Cool white store lighting mixes with warmer street lights, creating a soft contrast.

Outfit: A cropped top paired with loose-fit jeans or low-rise cargo pants, layered with a lightweight jacket or bomber. The styling feels clean and effortless, balancing sweetness with a subtle edge. The color palette leans toward white, gray, black, and light blue.

Mood: Quiet, urban, slightly distant yet intimate. A mix of everyday realism and subtle ambiguity, with a calm late-night atmosphere.

Camera: Medium shot or medium close-up, waist-up framing, slight handheld feel, shallow depth of field, documentary-style street photography.

templates.prompt: Create a high-quality 4K cinematic {argument name="sport" default="football (soccer)"} storyboard showing a full sequence from {argument name="start action" default="tackle"} to {argument name="end action" default="goal"}, using dynamic lighting, dramatic stadium atmosphere, and professional sports broadcast style. The scene begins with an intense midfield moment where a defender performs a strong sliding tackle, grass and dirt particles flying in slow motion as the ball is cleanly won. Transition immediately into a fast counterattack: the player recovers, pushes the ball forward, and accelerates past opponents with quick footwork. Show close-ups of boots striking the ball, sweat, and focused expressions, mixed with wide shots of the field opening up. Add a key pass moment where the ball is threaded through defenders, followed by a sprint toward goal with the crowd rising in anticipation. Build tension with a slow-motion approach to the penalty box, then a powerful shot on goal—either a clean strike or a curled finish. Show the ball hitting the net with dramatic impact, net rippling, and goalkeeper reaction. End with an emotional celebration: the scorer running, sliding, or raising arms as teammates join, stadium lights glowing and crowd erupting. Use varied camera angles (wide, tracking, close-up, POV, slow motion), strong motion blur, and realistic physics (ball spin, turf impact).

templates.title: Candid Mall Shopping Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: Candid Mall Shopping Snapshot

templates.prompt: Create a realistic low-resolution candid phone photo of {argument name="people" default="two young adults"} descending an indoor {argument name="location" default="shopping mall escalator"}, captured from a lower diagonal angle across the escalator. The composition should feel accidental and slightly imperfect, with the escalator handrail and glass side panel cutting across the foreground as a strong diagonal obstruction. On the left, show a cheerful young man with short black slightly tousled hair, wearing a dark casual short-sleeve shirt. He is smiling genuinely while carrying several {argument name="products" default="oversized PC hardware boxes"} pressed against his torso, including visible GeForce RTX 4080 graphics card boxes, ASUS or GALAX-style GPU packaging, and a large black AORUS monitor box. His face, neck, forearms, and hands are visible, with natural warm skin tone and practical tension in the hands from holding heavy boxes. On the right, show a slim young woman standing slightly higher on the escalator, calm and composed, looking downward rather than at the camera. She has a neat short dark bob haircut with straight bangs, soft indoor shine, pale warm ivory skin, and an East Asian fashion-editorial inspired makeup style: smooth matte base, subtle eyes, and defined red lips. She wears a fitted sleeveless cream or beige knit top covered with small repeated dark text-like pattern, matching long patterned arm sleeves, and a short black pleated skirt with vivid blue and turquoise plaid paneling, blue trim, and a dark belt. Visible skin includes her face, neck, exposed shoulders, upper arms, a small neckline area, and partially visible thighs above the escalator rail. The skin should look natural and softly matte, as if smooth and cool to the touch, lit by ordinary overhead mall lights rather than beauty lighting. The background is a warm brown wood or laminate wall panel area inside a mall or electronics shopping center, with vertical seams, reflective metal rails, glass panels, and a partial passerby shape near the edge of the frame. Use practical indoor mall lighting: soft overhead illumination, warm reflected light from the brown wall, weak uneven shadows, and broken reflections on the escalator glass and metal. Keep a deep phone-camera-like depth of field where the subjects, boxes, escalator, and background remain mostly readable. The image should preserve compressed social-media photo texture: mild noise, softened details, slightly muddy colors, imperfect framing, and a believable candid snapshot feeling. The emotional tone is a funny, slightly surreal tech purchase moment: the man looks proud and happy after buying expensive gaming hardware, while the woman appears cool, stylish, and detached. It should feel like they had just bought the hardware and were caught by someone passing by before either noticed the camera.

templates.title: Minimalist Studio Editorial Grid

titleLocalized.zh: Minimalist Studio Editorial Grid

templates.prompt:
Please generate a 'Warm Minimalist Studio Fashion Photo Shoot 3x3 Grid Collage' based on the clear photo of the person I uploaded.

Strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of the person in the photo, including face shape, facial feature proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, perceived age, hairline, hairstyle features, and overall temperament. Do not turn the person into someone else; avoid excessive beautification, influencer-style aesthetics, or AI-generated fake faces. The final nine images must feature the same adult person, just presenting different compositions, poses, and local details within the same studio shoot.

Image Format:
Generate a 3x3 fashion photo collage with a 4:5 aspect ratio. The nine photos should look like an editorial moodboard from a magazine page or a contact sheet curated by a photographer. Each cell features the same person in the same studio setting but with different views, including facial close-ups, half-body shots, profile shots, shoulder and neck details, waist details, back views, upper body movement, and two-thirds body compositions.

Character Setting:
An adult East Asian female with a natural, clean, soft, and fashionable temperament, reflecting the aesthetic sense of women from first-tier cities. The overall feeling should be elegant, relaxed, and feminine, but must be high-end, restrained, and natural—not vulgar, not overly sexy, not studio-style kitsch, and without influencer filters.

Hairstyle and Makeup:
Retain the real hairstyle base from the original photo, but it can be slightly styled to be more voluminous, airy, and naturally lustrous. Hair can be naturally loose, slightly messy, with a light wind-blown effect. Makeup should be clean and elegant, skin with a natural glow, preserving real skin texture; no heavy makeup, no exaggerated eye makeup, no plastic skin.

Outfit:
The person wears a white slim-fit cropped tank top, a white knit vest, a white off-the-shoulder top, or a white ribbed sleeveless top, paired with light blue loose jeans. Accessories include minimalist thin necklaces, thin bracelets, or small earrings. The overall outfit is clean, light, and fashionable, like the minimalist female photo style popular in major cities in Korea/Japan/China. Clothing should fit the body naturally but not be overly revealing or sexualized.

Scene:
A clean indoor studio with a background of warm beige, cream, or light camel walls. No clutter, no furniture, no text, no logos. The overall environment is minimalist, warm, and soft, like a high-end fashion magazine shoot set.

Lighting:
Soft warm studio lighting, with light coming softly from the front-side or above, giving the skin a slight creamy texture and natural highlights. Shadows should be soft; no hard flash, no strong contrast. The overall atmosphere is warm, dreamy, and cinematic.

3x3 Grid Content:

Grid 1:
Facial close-up, head slightly turned, hair naturally falling along the side of the face with a slight wind-blown feel. Eyes looking at the camera or slightly away, expression quiet, confident, and soft.

Grid 2:
Profile half-body shot, the person standing, body sideways to the camera, one hand naturally raised to tidy the hair, eyes closed or head slightly lowered, pose elegant and relaxed. Highlight the profile, neck, and upper body lines.

Grid 3:
Shoulder, neck, and collarbone detail, showing only the chin, neck, shoulder line, white top, and thin necklace, without showing the full face. High-end, restrained, with a magazine detail close-up feel.

Grid 4:
Soft emotional facial close-up, eyes closed or half-closed, hair naturally sweeping across the face, relaxed expression, slight soft focus and warm light.

Grid 5:
Half-body fashion shot, one hand naturally placed near the collarbone or lightly resting on the upper chest, the other hand hanging naturally. Movement should be elegant; no exaggerated gestures, expression quiet and atmospheric.

Grid 6:
Two-thirds body or near full-body shot, person in a white cropped top and light blue jeans, hands naturally raised or stretching, posing like a natural stretch in a studio. The image should be fashionable, clean, and light.

Grid 7:
Shoulder, neck, and hand detail, capturing the white top, thin necklace, and fingers lightly touching the collar or shoulder. Hands must be natural and structurally correct, no deformation, not overly sexy.

Grid 8:
Back view or side-back shot, person facing away from the camera, one hand naturally raised to tidy hair, revealing the upper back silhouette and long hair lines. Elegant and restrained, not over-exposed.

Grid 9:
Waist and upper body detail, capturing the white cropped top, light blue jeans, waistline, and fabric details. Composed like a fashion magazine detail outfit shot, no full face needed.

Overall Photography Style:
High-end fashion magazine editorial, warm minimalist studio shoot, slight film feel, soft focus but clear features, natural skin tone, clean visuals, lifestyle moodboard atmosphere. Lens feel like 35mm to 85mm portrait photography, shallow to medium depth of field, sharp subject, simple soft background.

Expression and Pose Requirements:
The nine images should not all have the same expression or angle. There should be variety: looking at the camera, closing eyes, profile, head down, tidying hair, body stretching, back view, and detail shots. Overall natural, relaxed, and elegant; not like an ID photo, not like a Taobao model stiffly posing.

Consistency Requirements:
All nine images must maintain consistency in the same person's face and temperament. Composition, pose, angle, and cropping can change, but do not change face shape, facial feature proportions, nose, lips, eyes, skin tone, or perceived age. Do not make people in different cells look like different individuals.

Hand and Body Stability Requirements:
Hand movements must be simple and natural. Do not generate extra fingers, deformed fingers, broken wrists, misplaced arms, or strange body structures. If hands are prone to error, automatically simplify the movement. Priority is given to the realism and naturalness of the person, followed by pose complexity.

Restrictions:
No other people, no cluttered backgrounds, no text, no watermarks, no logos. No exaggerated heavy makeup, no excessive skin smoothing, no plastic skin, no cartoon style, no vulgarity or pornography, no excessive exposure, no incorrect human anatomy, no blurred low-quality faces.

Final Output:
A single 4:5 vertical 3x3 fashion photography grid collage. The overall effect should be close to a high-end female editorial moodboard in a warm minimalist studio: clean, soft, fashionable, natural, restrained, and atmospheric.
