templates.title: Fujifilm Style Home Couple Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 富士胶片风格居家情侣肖像

templates.prompt:
Based on the real photos of two adult couples uploaded by the user, generate a "{argument name="photo style" default="Fujifilm-style Japanese home couple portrait"} 3x3 grid album collage".

Strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of the two people. Both the girl and the boy must clearly look like the original people in the uploaded photos, including face shape, facial proportions, eye/brow structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle features, and overall temperament. Do not turn them into Western faces, Korean studio styles, influencers, or over-beautified strangers. All 9 final small photos must feature the same real Chinese couple, captured from different angles, distances, and moments during the same home session.

## Visual Format
Generate a 3x3 collage with 9 small photos, overall 1:1 ratio. Use narrow {argument name="border color" default="black"} separator lines between photos, all placed on a {argument name="background color" default="black"} background, like a curated home photo album. Not a commercial poster or studio layout; avoid repetitive templates.

## Core Visual Style
Overall style: Japanese lifestyle photography, Fujifilm camera texture, real home couple portrait, candid shots, gentle, relaxed, quiet, and storytelling.
Focus on the colors and atmosphere of Fujifilm stocks like Superia, Pro 400H, or C200. The images should have low saturation without looking gray, soft natural highlights, transparent but restrained skin tones, slight film grain, slight shadow noise, and soft contrast. It should look like an air-filled, layered Fujifilm lifestyle photo.
Avoid: old iPhone texture, mobile compression, digital sharpness, heavy retro filters, commercial ads, or e-commerce styles.

## Character Relationship
The two are a {argument name="relationship" default="real, intimate, and natural young Chinese couple"}. Each frame should clearly show they are a couple with a sense of familiarity and companionship. Interactions should be realistic and relaxed: leaning in, making eye contact, looking down and laughing, leaning on a shoulder, reading together, passing things, preparing food, adjusting clothes, seeing each other in the mirror, or watching from a doorway. Intimate but restrained—no grease, no eroticism, and no staged wedding-style acting.

## Expressions and Angles
The 9 photos should not all look at the camera or just smile slightly. Expressions must be rich and varied: giggling, being teased, looking down laughing, quiet, daydreaming, gentle staring, relaxed chatting, focused on a task, responding with a look back, closing eyes laughing, looking out the window, or looking at each other.
Facial angles must vary significantly. Do not repeat the same template. Use a mix of: front, semi-front, profile, looking down, looking back, looking up slightly, near-back, mirror angles, distant observation, and close-up life details. Each frame should have a new head direction and visual rhythm.

## Clothing Requirements
Do not use the original clothes from the uploaded photos. Change them into natural Japanese lifestyle outfits: low saturation, neutral colors, soft materials. Colors like creamy white, oatmeal, light gray, pale coffee, misty blue, or charcoal. Items include knit cardigans, soft T-shirts, linen shirts, loungewear, long skirts, or socks. Should look like comfortable clothes a real couple wears at home.

## Home Setting
A clean, tidy apartment with real life traces (not a model home). Include elements like curtains, wood floors, sofas, pillows, blankets, books, albums, cups, plates, plants, bed lamps, mirrors, or tables—all as subtle aids to focus on the couple.

## Content of the 9 Frames
1. Quiet by the window: Boy looks out; girl leans in naturally. Quiet atmosphere.
2. Reading on the sofa: Reading a book together; one leans on the other's shoulder.
3. Passing a plate: At the dining table, passing fruit; active movement and eye contact.
4. Kitchen prep: Preparing food; one cuts fruit while the other watches and laughs.
5. Doorway view: Observer's perspective through a door frame into the living room.
6. Bedroom touch: Sitting on the bed; girl adjusts the boy's collar gently.
7. Floor photos: Sitting on the carpet looking at magazines together; candid sitting poses.
8. Mirror fragment: Captured through a dressing mirror; adjusting hair or a brief look in the mirror.
9. Balcony pause: Standing by the sliding door; one looks out while the other approaches with a smile.

## Consistency and Stability
Keep facial consistency across all 9 frames. Avoid complex hand gestures (no face-touching or finger-crossing). The quality should include slight film grain and scanning texture to feel like a real set, not a perfect AI grid. Avoid digital artifacts, extra limbs, or strange text.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于用户上传的两名成年情侣的真实照片，生成一张“{argument name="photo style" default="富士胶片风格日本居家情侣肖像"} 3x3 网格相册拼贴”。

严格保留两人的真实身份特征。女孩和男孩必须清晰地呈现出上传照片中的本人，包括脸型、面部比例、眼眉结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发际线、发型特征以及整体气质。不要将他们变成西式面孔、韩式影楼风格、网红脸或过度美化的陌生人。所有 9 张最终的小照片必须是同一对真实的中国情侣，从不同的角度、距离和居家生活瞬间捕捉。

## 视觉格式
生成一张 3x3 的拼贴图，包含 9 张小照片，整体比例为 1:1。照片之间使用窄的 {argument name="border color" default="黑色"} 分隔线，并放置在 {argument name="background color" default="黑色"} 背景上，如同精心整理的居家相册。不要使用商业海报或影楼布局；避免重复的模板。

## 核心视觉风格
整体风格：日本生活方式摄影、富士胶片质感、真实的居家情侣肖像、抓拍、温柔、放松、安静且具有叙事感。
聚焦于 Superia、Pro 400H 或 C200 等富士胶片的色彩和氛围。图像应具有低饱和度但不过于灰暗、柔和的自然高光、通透而内敛的肤色、轻微的胶片颗粒感、轻微的阴影噪点以及柔和的对比度。它应该看起来像一张充满空气感、层次丰富的富士胶片生活照。
避免：老旧的 iPhone 质感、手机压缩感、数码锐化、厚重的复古滤镜、商业广告或电商风格。

## 人物关系
两人是 {argument name="relationship" default="一对真实、亲密且自然年轻的中国情侣"}。每一帧都应清晰地展示他们作为情侣的熟悉感和陪伴感。互动应真实且放松：倚靠、眼神交流、低头笑、靠在肩膀上、一起阅读、递东西、准备食物、整理衣物、在镜子中看到对方或在门口注视。亲密但克制——没有油腻感、没有色情意味，也没有刻意的婚纱照式表演。

## 表情与角度
9 张照片不应全部看向镜头或仅仅是微微一笑。表情必须丰富多样：咯咯笑、被逗乐、低头笑、安静、发呆、温柔注视、放松聊天、专注于某项任务、回头回应、闭眼大笑、看向窗外或看向对方。
面部角度必须有显著变化。不要重复相同的模板。使用多种角度组合：正面、半正面、侧面、低头、回头、微仰、近背影、镜面角度、远距离观察和生活细节特写。每一帧都应有新的头部朝向和视觉节奏。

## 服装要求
不要使用上传照片中的原装衣服。将它们更换为自然的日本生活方式服装：低饱和度、中性色、柔软材质。颜色如奶油白、燕麦色、浅灰色、淡咖啡色、雾霾蓝或炭灰色。单品包括针织开衫、柔软 T 恤、亚麻衬衫、家居服、长裙或袜子。看起来应该是真实情侣在家中穿着的舒适服装。

## 居家环境
一个干净整洁、带有真实生活痕迹的公寓（不是样板间）。包含窗帘、木地板、沙发、枕头、毯子、书籍、相册、杯子、盘子、植物、床头灯、镜子或桌子等元素——所有这些都是为了衬托情侣的辅助细节。

## 9 帧内容
1. 窗边安静时刻：男孩看向窗外；女孩自然地倚靠。氛围安静。
2. 沙发阅读：一起看书；一人靠在另一人的肩膀上。
3. 递盘子：在餐桌旁递水果；有动态的动作和眼神交流。
4. 厨房准备：准备食物；一人切水果，另一人看着并大笑。
5. 门口视角：通过门框观察客厅的视角。
6. 卧室触碰：坐在床上；女孩温柔地整理男孩的衣领。
7. 地板照片：坐在地毯上一起看杂志；自然的坐姿。
8. 镜中碎片：通过穿衣镜捕捉；整理头发或在镜中短暂对视。
9. 阳台停顿：站在推拉门旁；一人看向外面，另一人微笑着走近。

## 一致性与稳定性
保持 9 帧中面部的一致性。避免复杂的手部动作（不要触碰脸部或手指交叉）。质量应包含轻微的胶片颗粒和扫描质感，以感觉像是一套真实的照片，而不是完美的 AI 网格。避免数码伪影、多余的肢体或奇怪的文字。

templates.title: Editorial Fashion Flower Field Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 时尚编辑风花海拼贴画

templates.prompt:
A high-quality 3-panel vertical photo collage of a {argument name="subject" default="stunning uploaded woman"} with soft, voluminous wavy hair glowing in golden sunlight. She is styled in a {argument name="outfit" default="cream-colored lace-up vintage blouse"} with delicate textures, olive green high-waisted flowy trousers, and a wide-brimmed straw hat slightly tilted for a fashionable editorial look. Light golden jewelry (thin chains, rings) adds a subtle luxury touch.
The setting is a {argument name="setting" default="dreamy, vibrant yellow mustard flower field"} under a bright blue sky with soft clouds, enhanced by golden hour lighting for a magical glow.
Top panel: Back view of the woman standing in the field with arms wide open, sunlight creating a glowing halo around her hair, slight motion blur in flowers for a cinematic feel.
Middle panel: Close-up portrait, she smiles naturally at the camera, wind softly moving her hair, her hand reaching toward the lens creating depth and a slightly blurred foreground for a DSLR effect.
Bottom panel: Playful pose, she leans sideways in the flowers, making a double peace sign, laughing candidly, capturing an authentic joyful moment.
Add cute, trendy white doodle overlays (smiley faces, sparkles, stars, tiny hearts) with a subtle animated/sketchy feel. Include light leaks, sun flares, and soft film grain for a premium Instagram aesthetic.
Ultra-realistic, 4K, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, natural skin tones, editorial fashion photography, soft pastel color grading.
Aspect ratio: 4:5
Style tags: viral Instagram aesthetic, Pinterest style, dreamy spring vibe, candid luxury

promptLocalized.zh:
一张高质量的 3 联竖版照片拼贴画，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="令人惊艳的上传女性"}，她留着蓬松柔软的波浪卷发，在金色阳光下熠熠生辉。她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="米色系带复古衬衫"}，质感细腻，搭配橄榄绿高腰阔腿裤和一顶微微倾斜的宽檐草帽，尽显时尚编辑风范。轻盈的金色首饰（细链、戒指）增添了一抹低调的奢华感。
场景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="梦幻、鲜艳的黄色芥菜花田"}，背景是蓝天白云，在黄金时刻的灯光映衬下散发出迷人的光芒。
顶部面板：女性背影，站在花田中双臂张开，阳光在她的发丝周围形成光晕，花朵略带动态模糊，营造出电影般的质感。
中间面板：特写肖像，她对着镜头自然微笑，微风轻拂发丝，手部向镜头伸展，营造出深度感和轻微模糊的前景，呈现 DSLR 拍摄效果。
底部面板：俏皮姿势，她侧身倚在花丛中，比出双 V 手势，开怀大笑，捕捉真实快乐的瞬间。
添加可爱、潮流的白色涂鸦叠加效果（笑脸、闪光、星星、小爱心），带有微妙的动画/素描感。加入漏光、镜头光晕和柔和的胶片颗粒，打造高级的 Instagram 审美。
超写实，4K，电影级灯光，浅景深，高动态范围，自然肤色，时尚编辑摄影，柔和的粉彩调色。
长宽比：4:5
风格标签：病毒式 Instagram 审美，Pinterest 风格，梦幻春日氛围，真实奢华感

templates.title: Needle-Felt Country Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: 羊毛毡国家微缩景观

templates.prompt:
Country: {argument name="country" default="[INSERT COUNTRY NAME]"}

A miniature felt diorama made of fluffy yarn, wool, and needlework, designed as a single cohesive small world (not a collage), reflecting the real landscape, culture, and daily life of the country.

Structure:
- Select 4–7 naturally integrated elements (landscape, architecture, transport, street life, culture)
- Everything must flow together as one environment

Foreground:
Everyday life — small shops, cafes, markets, people interacting, local clothing, street details, subtle movement, warm human presence

Midground:
Connecting flow — streets, bridges, rivers, paths, transport, cultural spaces that guide the eye naturally from front to back

Background:
One strong identity anchor — landmark, skyline, mountain, or symbolic landscape clearly representing the country (keep it clean, not overcrowded)

Style:
Handmade wool felt, yarn, needle-felt textures, visible fibers, soft edges, miniature craftsmanship, premium diorama realism

Lighting:
Warm golden hour or bright noon, soft shadows, clear visibility, gentle glow enhancing depth

Color:
Soft but saturated palette reflecting the country’s natural tones (greens, sky blues, architectural hues, cultural accents), warm and balanced

Composition:
Vertical frame, balanced or centered perspective, slight top-down or immersive angle, clear foreground–midground–background depth

Mood:
Warm, emotional, calm, refined — like a handcrafted fairy-tale version of real life (not childish)

Rules:
- No logos or text overlays
- No collage-style composition
- No random symbolic clutter
- Keep it realistic but stylized as a handmade miniature world

Quality:
16K, ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic miniature textures, cinematic depth, sharp focus

output_goal:
A single, cohesive felt diorama world that instantly conveys the identity and atmosphere of the chosen country through integrated landscape, culture, and daily life

promptLocalized.zh:
国家：{argument name="country" default="[请输入国家名称]"}

一个由蓬松纱线、羊毛和针织工艺制成的微缩毛毡景观，设计为一个统一且和谐的小世界（非拼贴画），反映该国真实的景观、文化和日常生活。

结构：
- 选择 4–7 个自然融合的元素（景观、建筑、交通、街头生活、文化）
- 所有元素必须作为一个整体环境自然流动

前景：
日常生活——小店、咖啡馆、集市、互动的人群、当地服饰、街道细节、细微的动态，充满温暖的人文气息

中景：
连接流线——街道、桥梁、河流、路径、交通工具、文化空间，引导视线从前到后自然过渡

背景：
一个强有力的身份锚点——地标、天际线、山脉或象征性景观，清晰地代表该国（保持简洁，避免拥挤）

风格：
手工羊毛毡、纱线、针毡纹理、可见的纤维感、柔和的边缘、微缩工艺、高级微缩模型写实感

光影：
温暖的黄金时刻或明亮的午后，柔和的阴影，清晰的可见度，柔和的光泽增强深度感

色彩：
柔和但饱和的色调，反映该国的自然色调（绿色、天蓝色、建筑色、文化点缀），温暖且平衡

构图：
竖构图，平衡或居中的视角，轻微的俯视或沉浸式角度，清晰的前景、中景、背景深度

氛围：
温暖、感性、宁静、精致——如同现实生活的纯手工童话版本（非低幼感）

规则：
- 无徽标或文字叠加
- 禁止拼贴式构图
- 禁止杂乱的随机符号
- 保持写实感，但呈现为手工微缩世界的风格

质量：
16K，超精细，超写实微缩纹理，电影级深度，清晰对焦

输出目标：
一个单一、和谐的毛毡微缩世界，通过整合景观、文化和日常生活，瞬间传达出所选国家的身份与氛围

templates.title: Surreal Bus Window Selfie

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic image from inside a moving city bus, shot like a wide selfie from a seated passenger beside a large window. The bus interior is visible behind her with patterned seats, yellow handrails, blurred passengers, and shallow depth of field. The large window dominates the right side and acts as both glass and portal: it reflects the subject and bus interior while revealing a surreal city street outside. Beyond the glass, show a wet reflective boulevard lined with elegant old buildings, pedestrians drifting in slow motion, one person holding a red umbrella, and a car with headlights glowing. The ordinary street gradually transforms into a dreamscape with exactly 9 colorful kites floating across a pink-and-blue sunset sky, soft glowing particles suspended in the air, exaggerated warm cinematic colors, and reflections of both the real bus interior and surreal outside world layered on the window. Use {argument name="time of day" default="golden-hour sunset"} lighting with natural daylight on the face blending into a dreamy glow with warm highlights, soft film grain, realistic lens reflections, subtle motion blur, and a peaceful mood of imagination, escape, and quiet happiness.

templates.title: Ancient Tree Guardians at Sunset

templates.prompt: Create an epic romantic fantasy landscape painting in the style of a 19th-century Hudson River School oil masterpiece. The scene shows an ancient enchanted forest at the edge of a mountain valley at {argument name="time of day" default="golden sunset"}. On the left foreground, depict three colossal old oak trees with deeply textured bark, twisted roots, moss, ivy, and autumn foliage; the foremost tree has a solemn humanoid face naturally formed in the trunk, with heavy brow, long nose, carved eyes, and a beard-like cascade of bark, making it feel like a wise forest guardian. The ground is rugged with rocks, roots, ferns, red-brown undergrowth, and a narrow dirt path curving into shadow. Across the lower foreground and middle ground, a wild river rushes over dark boulders in foaming cascades, with mist rising from the rapids. Beyond the water, open into a luminous alpine lake reflecting the sky, framed by evergreen forests, distant tiny trees, and layered blue-gray mountains. On the right, towering jagged peaks catch warm orange light, while cooler shadows fall into the valley. The sky is dramatic and radiant, filled with glowing peach, amber, lavender, and smoky blue clouds around the low sun. templates.title: Retro Anime Space Adventure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古动漫太空冒险海报

templates.prompt: Create a nostalgic 1990s anime-style sci-fi adventure poster set in deep space, with a star-filled blue nebula background, a large Earth-like planet at upper left, a huge cyan-blue alien creature or spacecraft silhouette looming behind the characters, and a futuristic city with antenna towers and domes along the lower horizon. In the foreground, show two adventurous children standing on a reddish rocky cliff: a girl with {argument name="girl outfit" default="a red cropped T-shirt, black pants, pink sneakers, and dark wavy pigtails"} holding a yellow banana-shaped ray gun, and a boy with {argument name="boy outfit" default="a white shirt, brown shorts, white socks, and oversized white sneakers"} raising one hand toward a glowing orange light. Add two cute mascot companions to the right, exactly 2: one tan bear-like mascot with a red shirt and blue scarf, and one smaller gray-brown animal mascot. Fill the sky with a fleet of exactly 24 small triangular cheese-shaped rocket ships, including 3 larger cheese rockets on the left with blue side fins and orange thruster flames, and 21 smaller cheese rockets receding into the distance. Use dramatic hand-painted cel animation colors, high contrast, crisp ink outlines, cosmic blues, orange highlights, retro VHS-era adventure composition, and a theatrical movie-poster feel. Place a large centered vertical rectangular overlay in front of the background and partly covering the giant blue figure and the boy, with a smooth muted gradient from {argument name="overlay left color" default="teal blue"} to {argument name="overlay right color" default="dark gray-purple"}, no text on the rectangle.

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic dreamy lifestyle photograph in a vertical 4:5 frame, shot from a close low-angle perspective, showing {argument name="couple description" default="a young East Asian couple"} sitting casually on the roof edge of a vintage {argument name="van color" default="turquoise"} van in a wildflower field. The man sits on the left in a loose white button-up shirt, cream pants, and white sneakers, one knee raised and one leg hanging over the van; the woman sits on the right in a light pastel yellow floral summer dress and white sneakers, legs dangling naturally, holding a small pink flower near her face while smiling softly toward him. Add a cluster of exactly 7 pastel balloons tied beside the woman on the right: 3 pale blue, 2 cream yellow, and 2 very light aqua balloons, with thin white strings. The background is a wide clean soft blue sky with large negative space and a few faint clouds near the horizon. Integrate white hand-drawn diary-style doodles and text directly into the sky: exactly 4 handwritten phrases reading {argument name="top left text" default="good days"}, {argument name="top center text" default="stay close"}, {argument name="right sky text" default="happy place"}, and {argument name="small doodle text" default="B-"}. Include exactly 15 white doodle elements around the sky: 1 smiley face, 1 outlined flower, 1 heart, 1 cloud, 1 large starburst, 4 small sparkle stars, 1 tiny asterisk sparkle, 3 small hearts under the center phrase, and 2 small flower drawings on balloons. Use bright natural daylight, soft overexposed highlights, dreamy glow, pastel film tones, low contrast, smooth highlight roll-off, airy youthful summer mood, turquoise and sky-blue palette with soft white, pastel yellow, and pastel pink accents. Keep the composition intimate, peaceful, whimsical, and clean, with the couple and van roof occupying the lower half and the illustrated sky filling the upper half.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实、具有电影感的梦幻生活方式照片，采用 4:5 竖构图，以近景低角度拍摄。画面展示了一对 {argument name="couple description" default="年轻的东亚情侣"} 随意地坐在野花丛中一辆复古 {argument name="van color" default="绿松石色"} 房车的车顶边缘。男子坐在左侧，身穿宽松的白色衬衫、米色长裤和白色运动鞋，一条腿屈膝，另一条腿自然垂在车边；女子坐在右侧，身穿浅柔黄色碎花夏裙和白色运动鞋，双腿自然垂下，手持一朵小粉花靠近脸庞，温柔地对着他微笑。在女子右侧系上一束正好 7 个的柔和色调气球：3 个淡蓝色、2 个奶油黄色和 2 个极浅的水蓝色，配有细白线。背景是广阔、干净、柔和的蓝天，留有大面积负空间，地平线附近有几朵淡淡的云。将白色的手绘日记风格涂鸦和文字直接融入天空：正好 4 句手写短语，内容分别为 {argument name="top left text" default="good days"}、{argument name="top center text" default="stay close"}、{argument name="right sky text" default="happy place"} 和 {argument name="small doodle text" default="B-"}。在天空周围加入正好 15 个白色涂鸦元素：1 个笑脸、1 朵轮廓花朵、1 个爱心、1 朵云、1 个大星芒、4 个小闪烁星、1 个微小星号闪光、中心短语下方的 3 个小爱心，以及气球上的 2 个小花朵绘图。使用明亮的自然日光，柔和的过曝高光，梦幻光晕，柔和的胶片色调，低对比度，平滑的高光过渡，营造出轻盈、青春的夏日氛围，以绿松石色和天蓝色为主色调，点缀柔和的白色、奶油黄色和淡粉色。保持构图亲密、宁静、奇幻且简洁，情侣和房车车顶占据画面下半部分，插画天空填充上半部分。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影感梦幻生活方式照片，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位年轻女性"} 独自坐在 {argument name="van color" default="绿松石色"} 复古面包车的车顶边缘，背景是一片广阔的春日花海。采用近距离低角度拍摄，紧凑的竖构图聚焦于她的上半身、悬垂的双腿、白色运动鞋以及面包车车顶部分。她身穿 {argument name="dress description" default="浅色系白色碎花夏日连衣裙"}，姿态随意，一只手撑在身后，另一只手拿着一束小野花，微微抬头，带着柔和自然的微笑，展现出轻松无忧的状态；她长长的深色头发在风中轻轻飘动，裙摆轻柔地起伏。在她身旁系上一束正好 5 个的漂浮柔和色调气球，混合淡蓝色和柔白色气球，配有细细的白色气球绳。背景填充广阔干净的柔和蓝天、零星的蓬松云朵、远处的山丘，以及前景中模糊的粉色和黄色花朵。在天空和主体周围加入与画面融合的白色手绘日记风格涂鸦：正好 4 个可见的手写文字元素，内容分别为 {argument name="sky phrase one" default="my happy place"}、{argument name="sky phrase two" default="bloom"}、{argument name="sky phrase three" default="sunny day"}，以及右下角部分截断的单词片段“LOV”；包含可爱的素描图案，包括 2 个云朵轮廓、1 个笑脸、1 个爱心、6 个简单的花朵涂鸦、3 个闪光/星星标记、2 个微小的蝴蝶状标记，以及气球和裙子附近的小型动态装饰线。使用明亮的自然日光，柔和的过曝高光，梦幻光晕，细腻的柔光效果，柔和的胶片色调，低对比度，平滑的高光过渡，通透的留白，营造出青春宁静的氛围；色调包含绿松石色、天蓝色、柔白色、柔粉色、柔黄色和暖奶油色。

templates.title: Squash and Stretch Jump Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 挤压与拉伸跳跃动作表

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the character base, create a clean animation movement sheet that turns the character into a full-body jump sequence study while preserving the same outfit, badge, bald head, shoes, stylized ink-and-color illustration look, and the censored/blurred face treatment. Expand the view from the cropped portrait into a wide beige paper-textured layout with a ground line, subtle motion lines, small impact marks, and instructional typography. Add the title text {argument name="title text" default="SQUASH AND STRETCH"} at the upper left with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="JUMP SEQUENCE — 7 STAGES"}. Show exactly 7 numbered poses arranged left to right across the page: 1 “ANTICIPATION (CROUCHING)” with the character crouched and arms back; 2 “EXTREME SQUASH (COMPRESSED)” with a deeper compact crouch; 3 “EXTREME STRETCH (TAKEOFF)” with the character elongated upward, arms raised, feet leaving the ground; 4 “APEX (MID-AIR ARC)” with the character tucked in midair; 5 “STRETCH (DOWNWARD ACCELERATION)” with the character stretched vertically while descending; 6 “SQUASH (IMPACT LANDING)” with the character compressed on landing, one hand touching the ground; 7 “RECOVERY (RETURN TO STANCE)” with the character standing relaxed with hands in pockets. Use bold black uppercase labels under each numbered stage, keep consistent character proportions across poses except for the intentional squash-and-stretch deformation, and make the sheet read like a professional 2D animation reference chart.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为角色基础，制作一张清晰的动画动作表，将角色转化为全身跳跃序列研究，同时保留相同的服装、徽章、光头、鞋子、风格化水墨插画外观以及面部遮挡/模糊处理。将视图从裁剪后的肖像扩展为带有地面线、细微运动线、小型冲击标记和教学排版的米色纸张纹理宽幅布局。在左上角添加标题文本 {argument name="title text" default="SQUASH AND STRETCH"} 和副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="JUMP SEQUENCE — 7 STAGES"}。展示从左至右排列的 7 个编号姿势：1 “ANTICIPATION (CROUCHING)”（预备动作：蹲伏），角色蹲伏且双臂后摆；2 “EXTREME SQUASH (COMPRESSED)”（极限挤压：压缩），角色更深地紧凑蹲伏；3 “EXTREME STRETCH (TAKEOFF)”（极限拉伸：起跳），角色向上拉伸，双臂抬起，双脚离地；4 “APEX (MID-AIR ARC)”（顶点：空中弧线），角色在半空中收缩；5 “STRETCH (DOWNWARD ACCELERATION)”（拉伸：向下加速），角色在下降时垂直拉伸；6 “SQUASH (IMPACT LANDING)”（挤压：着陆冲击），角色着陆时压缩，单手触地；7 “RECOVERY (RETURN TO STANCE)”（恢复：回到站姿），角色双手插兜，放松站立。在每个编号阶段下方使用粗体黑色大写标签，除刻意的挤压与拉伸变形外，保持各姿势中角色比例的一致性，并使该表呈现出专业 2D 动画参考图表的效果。

Integrate exactly 16 white doodles around the sky and field: 4 five-point stars, 4 simple flowers, 2 smiley faces, 1 large smile curve near the lower left, 1 sparkle diamond at the bottom right, 1 small butterfly-like mark, and 3 short decorative curved strokes. Keep the doodles hand-drawn, thin, chalky white, naturally composited as if floating in the air. Lighting is bright natural daylight with soft overexposed highlights, dreamy glow, bloom effect, pastel film tones, low contrast, smooth highlight roll-off, airy clean negative space, and a color palette of turquoise, sky blue, soft white, pastel pink, pastel yellow, and warm cream. Make the image peaceful, whimsical, intimate, youthful, and carefree, with crisp realistic subject and vehicle details but soft atmospheric background.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实电影感梦幻生活方式照片，画面主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"} 独自坐在白色车顶上，车子是一辆复古 {argument name="van color" default="绿松石色"} 面包车，背景是广阔的柔和色调野花田。采用近距离低角度人像构图，聚焦于她的上半身、悬垂的双腿以及面包车的车顶/侧窗区域；面包车占据画面下半部分，广阔的柔和蓝天填充上方背景。她随意地坐在车顶边缘，双腿自然下垂，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="淡蓝色无袖夏日连衣裙和白色运动鞋"}，双手捧着一小束混合野花放在膝盖上，微微抬头，面带柔和自然的微笑，展现出轻松年轻的状态。她深色的长发被微风轻轻吹动，裙摆轻盈飘逸。在左侧系上一簇刚好 6 个淡蓝色和白色的柔和色调气球，气球由系在车顶附近的白色细绳牵引。在天空中添加手写白色日记风格的涂鸦文字：头顶上方呈弧形排列 4 个短语 {argument name="main sky phrase" default="my happy place"}，左侧写上“bloom”，右侧写上“sunny day”，并在花束附近添加一个小的弧形运动标记。在天空和花田周围整合刚好 16 个白色涂鸦：4 个五角星、4 朵简单的花、2 个笑脸、左下方 1 个大笑脸曲线、右下方 1 个闪耀钻石、1 个小蝴蝶状标记以及 3 条短装饰弧线。保持涂鸦为手绘风格，线条纤细、呈粉笔白，自然地融合在画面中，仿佛漂浮在空中。光线为明亮的自然日光，带有柔和的过曝高光、梦幻光晕、柔光效果、柔和胶片色调、低对比度、平滑的高光过渡、通透干净的留白，以及由绿松石色、天蓝色、柔白色、淡粉色、淡黄色和暖奶油色组成的调色板。使画面呈现出宁静、奇幻、亲密、年轻且无忧无虑的氛围，主体和车辆细节清晰写实，背景则营造出柔和的氛围感。

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the ordinary phone snapshot into a cinematic cyberpunk movie-poster style edit. Keep the same subject, pose, outfit, helmet, foreground composition, and convention-center setting intact, but dramatically relight and color grade the scene with a dark, moody {argument name="cinematic style" default="Blade Runner-inspired cyberpunk"} atmosphere. Make the background darker and slightly defocused, deepen shadows, add high contrast, cool blue-gray tones, subtle vignette, and a soft filmic texture. Add a small warm amber reflection/glow on the helmet visor area as if from neon or sunset light, while preserving realistic skin texture and photographic detail. Do not change the character design or add text; make it look like a professionally retouched cinematic poster frame rather than a casual outdoor snapshot.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将普通的手机快照转换为具有赛博朋克电影海报风格的编辑作品。保持原有的主体、姿势、服装、头盔、前景构图和会展中心背景不变，但通过戏剧性的重新布光和调色，营造出一种暗黑、忧郁的 {argument name="cinematic style" default="《银翼杀手》风格的赛博朋克"} 氛围。使背景更暗并略微虚化，加深阴影，增加高对比度、冷蓝灰色调、微妙的暗角以及柔和的胶片质感。在头盔面罩区域添加一点温暖的琥珀色反射/光晕，仿佛来自霓虹灯或落日余晖，同时保留真实的皮肤纹理和摄影细节。请勿更改角色设计或添加文字；使其看起来像是一张经过专业修饰的电影海报帧，而不是一张随意的户外快照。

templates.title: Monument Valley Dawn Quote Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 纪念碑谷黎明语录壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a tall vertical inspirational art wallpaper in a serene Monument Valley–inspired style, soft healing fantasy architecture, aspect ratio 9:16. The scene is an impossible pastel city of stacked geometric towers, arches, bridges, stairways, terraces, canals, and small domed pavilions floating in mist, rendered in delicate isometric perspective with clean minimalist forms. Use a warm dawn palette of peach, cream, pale sand, mint green, turquoise, lavender, and deep indigo shadows. At the upper right, a monumental cream-colored arched gate stands high above the city, glowing with sunrise light; the orange sun sits inside the arch, and a long white staircase leads toward it. Include a tiny solitary human figure standing on a mid-level terrace for scale. Add subtle details: thin waterfalls flowing down dark blue interior walls, glowing windows, small gold finials, a bare pink-blossom tree on a balcony, a crescent moon in the hazy sky, and two tiny white birds. Compose the poster with negative space on the left for typography. Add exactly 6 visible text blocks: top-left small serif text “VOL. 02” above “2026”; large vertical Chinese headline {argument name="headline text" default="黎明前的黑暗"} in dark blue-gray; beneath it a short Chinese quote {argument name="Chinese quote" default="不是惩罚，是宇宙在准备更壮丽的日出。"}; a small cursive English quote {argument name="English quote" default="Before dawn, a greater sunrise is being prepared."}; lower-left small text “2026 DAWN” with a vertical Chinese phrase {argument name="vertical phrase" default="向光而行"}; and bottom-right small text “VOL.02”. Use refined editorial poster typography, elegant spacing, subtle paper grain, atmospheric fog, soft bloom, cinematic morning light, quiet meditative mood, ultra-detailed yet minimalist, no borders, no photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的治愈系励志艺术壁纸，风格灵感源自《纪念碑谷》，呈现柔和的奇幻建筑，比例 9:16。画面是一座由堆叠的几何塔楼、拱门、桥梁、阶梯、露台、运河及小型圆顶凉亭组成的“不可能”城市，悬浮在薄雾中，以精致的等轴测视角呈现，线条简洁极简。使用温暖的晨曦色调，包含桃色、奶油色、浅沙色、薄荷绿、绿松石色、薰衣草紫以及深靛蓝色的阴影。在右上角，一座巨大的奶油色拱门高耸于城市之上，在晨光中熠熠生辉；橙色的太阳位于拱门内，一条长长的白色阶梯通向它。在中间层级的露台上加入一个微小的孤独人物作为比例参照。添加细腻的细节：沿深蓝色内墙流下的细小瀑布、发光的窗户、小巧的金色尖顶、阳台上的一棵光秃粉色花树、朦胧天空中的一弯新月以及两只微小的白鸟。构图时在左侧留出负空间以便排版。添加 6 处可见文本块：左上角小号衬线体“VOL. 02”位于“2026”上方；深蓝灰色的竖排大号中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="黎明前的黑暗"}；其下方是一句简短的中文引言 {argument name="Chinese quote" default="不是惩罚，是宇宙在准备更壮丽的日出。"}；一句小型手写体英文引言 {argument name="English quote" default="Before dawn, a greater sunrise is being prepared."}；左下角小号文本“2026 DAWN”搭配竖排中文短语 {argument name="vertical phrase" default="向光而行"}；以及右下角小号文本“VOL.02”。使用精致的编辑排版风格，优雅的字间距，带有细腻的纸张纹理、大气雾气、柔和光晕、电影感晨光，营造宁静冥想的氛围，超细节且极简，无边框，非写实摄影风格。

templates.title: Pastel Abyss Quote Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和深渊语录壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a tall vertical inspirational art wallpaper in a quiet Monument Valley–inspired isometric style, soft healing pastel palette, and lots of misty negative space. The scene is an impossible architectural city made of pale peach, lavender, cream, and powder-blue stone: high narrow towers, arched doorways, bridges, staircases, parapets, and floating platforms arranged around a deep dark vertical abyss in the center. Include exactly one tiny lone human figure standing on an upper bridge, wearing a purple cloak or dress and white head, looking into the abyss. Add one prominent building face near the middle-right with a glowing circular portal like a warm orange-pink eclipse, casting light into the deep shaft. Add exactly two small bare ornamental trees in square planters, one on the lower-left terrace and one on the right terrace. The architecture should include multiple surreal stairways, including one long diagonal staircase in the lower center-left and one stepped staircase climbing the upper-right tower; the tallest tower has a turquoise domed roof and a small spire. Use a pale sun disk near the upper left, atmospheric fog, soft bloom, delicate shadows, and minimal linework. Place large vertical Chinese quote typography on the upper-left in thin elegant gray strokes: {argument name="quote text" default="当你凝视深渊时，深渊也在凝视你。"}. Beneath it, add a small English translation in light gray: {argument name="English translation" default="When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss gazes into you."}. Add small editorial poster details: top-left text {argument name="volume label" default="VOL.01"} with a tiny horizontal line below it, top-right text {argument name="year" default="2026"} with exactly four small vertical dots below, a small left-side keyword block reading “depth” and “gaze,” a bottom-left minimalist circle logo above the words “LOOK DEEP” and “BE SEEN,” and exactly three small horizontal dots at the bottom-right. Keep the overall composition airy, refined, contemplative, and premium, with the quote occupying the left third and the surreal city rising through the center and right.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版励志艺术壁纸，风格为宁静的《纪念碑谷》式等轴测构图，采用柔和治愈的马卡龙色调，并留出大量朦胧的负空间。场景是一座由淡桃色、薰衣草紫、奶油色和粉蓝色石材构成的错觉建筑城市：高耸狭窄的塔楼、拱门、桥梁、阶梯、护墙和浮动平台围绕着中心深邃的垂直深渊排列。画面中仅包含一个站在上方桥梁上的微小孤独人影，身穿紫色斗篷或长裙，头戴白饰，正凝视着深渊。在右中位置添加一个显眼的建筑立面，设有一个发光的圆形入口，宛如温暖的橙粉色日食，将光线投射进深邃的竖井中。在左下平台和右侧平台上各添加一棵方形花盆中的小型光秃装饰树。建筑应包含多个超现实阶梯，包括左下中心的一条长对角线楼梯和攀爬右上塔楼的阶梯；最高的塔楼拥有绿松石色的圆顶和一座小尖塔。左上方使用一个苍白的太阳圆盘，营造出大气雾气、柔和光晕、细腻阴影和极简线条感。在左上方放置大型竖排中文语录，采用纤细优雅的灰色笔触：{argument name="quote text" default="当你凝视深渊时，深渊也在凝视你。"}。在其下方，添加一行浅灰色的英文翻译：{argument name="English translation" default="When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss gazes into you."}。添加小型编辑海报细节：左上角文字 {argument name="volume label" default="VOL.01"} 下方配有一条微小的水平线，右上角文字 {argument name="year" default="2026"} 下方配有四个垂直排列的小圆点，左侧添加一个包含“depth”和“gaze”的关键词块，左下角放置一个极简圆形 Logo，上方标注“LOOK DEEP”和“BE SEEN”，右下角放置三个水平排列的小圆点。保持整体构图空灵、精致、深邃且具有高级感，语录占据左侧三分之一，超现实城市在中心和右侧升起。

templates.title: Electric Blue Lightning Strike VFX

titleLocalized.zh: 电光蓝闪电特效 VFX

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution VFX asset of {argument name="effect type" default="electric lightning strikes"} on a pure black transparent-looking background, designed as a game or compositing effect sheet. Show exactly 5 separate vertical lightning strike columns descending from the top edge to the bottom: one near the far left, one left-of-center, one large brightest strike in the center, one right-of-center, and one near the far right. Each strike has a jagged branching main bolt in intense {argument name="lightning color" default="electric blue"} with a white-hot core, thin secondary forks spreading outward, and soft blue bloom glow. At the bottom of each strike, add a bright starburst impact point sitting on a subtle horizontal glowing line, with faint sparks, tiny particle scatter, and a slight mirrored reflection below the impact. Make the central strike the tallest, thickest, and brightest focal point, while the other four strikes are slightly narrower and evenly spaced. Use a dramatic dark storm-energy look, high contrast, crisp branching detail, luminous aura, volumetric glow, no text, no characters, no scenery, no borders, widescreen 16:9 composition, suitable for overlaying as a visual effects material.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高分辨率的 {argument name="effect type" default="电闪雷鸣"} VFX 素材，背景为纯黑色（呈现透明感），旨在用作游戏或合成特效图。展示 5 条从顶部边缘延伸到底部的独立垂直闪电柱：一条靠近最左侧，一条位于左中，一条位于中心（最大且最亮），一条位于右中，一条靠近最右侧。每条闪电都有锯齿状的分支主闪电，颜色为强烈的 {argument name="lightning color" default="电光蓝"}，核心呈白热色，并带有向外扩散的细小分支以及柔和的蓝色光晕。在每条闪电的底部，添加一个明亮的星爆冲击点，置于一条微妙的水平发光线上，并带有微弱的火花、细小的粒子散射以及冲击点下方轻微的镜像反射。使中心闪电成为最高、最粗、最亮的视觉焦点，其余四条闪电略窄且均匀分布。采用戏剧性的暗黑风暴能量外观，高对比度，清晰的分支细节，发光光环，体积光，无文字，无角色，无场景，无边框，16:9 宽屏构图，适合作为视觉特效素材进行叠加使用。

templates.title: Mini-Me 3D Selfie Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: Mini-Me 3D 自拍变身

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference selfie, keep the original photo composition, outfit, lanyard, badge, hand pose, indoor ceiling background, perspective, and real-world lighting mostly unchanged. Remove the solid face-obscuring square and reconstruct a plausible natural face for the person, matching the hairstyle, head angle, skin tone, and selfie lighting. Add exactly 7 tiny 3D animated “mini-me” versions of the same person in a cute Pixar-like style, integrated into the scene with realistic contact shadows, depth, reflections, and matching warm light: 1 standing on the left shoulder with arms crossed, 1 standing on top of the badge waving, 1 hugging the right edge of the badge with eyes closed, 1 peeking out from the shirt collar, 1 sitting on the lanyard near the badge in a thinking pose, 1 sitting on the front yellow lanyard strap looking upward, and 1 hanging from the lower lanyard strap with both hands. Make the mini characters wear simplified matching dark clothing and tiny lanyards, interacting naturally with the real objects. Add a subtle magical sparkle atmosphere without changing the realistic selfie base. Overall mood: playful, adorable, and convincing as a miniature world inside the original photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于提供的参考自拍，保持原照片的构图、服装、挂绳、工牌、手势、室内天花板背景、透视关系以及真实光影基本不变。去除遮挡面部的实心方块，并重构一张自然且真实的面部，使其发型、头部角度、肤色和自拍光线相匹配。在场景中添加 7 个与本人形象一致的 3D 动画“迷你我”，采用可爱的皮克斯风格，并融入真实接触阴影、景深、反射以及相匹配的暖光效果：1 个站在左肩上交叉双臂，1 个站在工牌上方挥手，1 个闭眼拥抱工牌右侧边缘，1 个从衣领处探出头，1 个坐在靠近工牌的挂绳上呈思考姿势，1 个坐在前侧黄色挂绳带上向上看，1 个双手悬挂在下方的挂绳带上。让这些迷你角色穿着简约的同款深色服装并佩戴微型挂绳，与真实物体自然互动。在不改变真实自拍底图的前提下，添加微妙的魔法闪光氛围。整体氛围：俏皮、可爱，营造出一种置身于原照片中的真实微缩世界感。

templates.title: Electric Blue Lens Flare VFX

titleLocalized.zh: 电光蓝镜头光晕 VFX

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution cinematic VFX asset of a brilliant {argument name="light color" default="electric blue-white"} lens flare on a pure black background. The composition is centered slightly left of frame with an intensely overexposed white core, surrounded by radiant blue glow. A razor-straight horizontal light streak spans edge to edge across the image, intersected by a vertical beam through the center to form a luminous cross. Add many thin radial starburst rays shooting outward from the core, with soft volumetric bloom, subtle blue haze, and faint circular lens artifacts around the center. Include exactly 4 small secondary flare orbs along the horizontal beam: 1 tiny dim orb to the left of the core and 3 brighter blue-white orbs to the right. Keep the background completely black with no text, no objects, no borders, and no visible texture, designed as a transparent-feeling game/anime effect material even though rendered on black. Use a wide 16:9 frame, sharp highlights, realistic optical flare physics, high contrast, glossy sci-fi energy, and clean compositing-ready edges.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高分辨率的电影级 VFX 素材，展示一个绚丽的 {argument name="light color" default="电光蓝白色"} 镜头光晕，背景为纯黑色。构图略微偏向画面左侧，中心为高曝光的白色核心，周围环绕着耀眼的蓝色光芒。一条笔直的水平光束横跨画面边缘，与中心垂直光束交汇形成明亮的十字。在核心周围添加许多向外放射的细长星芒射线，并带有柔和的体积光晕、细腻的蓝色雾气以及中心周围淡淡的圆形镜头伪影。在水平光束上精确添加 4 个小型次级光晕球：核心左侧 1 个微弱的小球，右侧 3 个更明亮的蓝白色球体。保持背景完全黑色，无文字、无物体、无边框且无可见纹理，旨在打造一种即便渲染在黑色背景上也能呈现透明感的动漫/游戏特效素材。采用 16:9 宽屏比例，高光锐利，具备逼真的光学光晕物理效果、高对比度、光泽感的科幻能量，以及适合后期合成的干净边缘。

templates.title: Cinematic Fire Effect Asset

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级火焰特效素材

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution VFX fire effect asset: a wide horizontal wall of intense flames rising from the bottom edge across the full width of the frame, on a pure black background. The fire should have bright yellow-white cores, saturated orange and red outer tongues, and semi-transparent smoky heat wisps fading upward into darkness. Use {argument name="flame height" default="tall varied flame peaks"} with uneven curling shapes, including several large twisting flame columns at the left, center, and right, plus a dense low band of smaller flames along the base. Add many glowing ember particles and sparks drifting upward, with tiny red-orange specks scattered above the flames. Make it look like a realistic cinematic game effect or compositing element, high contrast, sharp detail, natural turbulent motion implied, no objects, no text, no people, no border, centered composition, {argument name="background color" default="pure black"}, {argument name="fire color palette" default="yellow white orange red"}, {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9 wide landscape"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建高分辨率 VFX 火焰特效素材：在纯黑背景下，生成一道从底部边缘升起、横跨整个画面的宽幅水平火焰墙。火焰应具备明亮的黄白色核心、饱和的橙红色外焰，以及向上渐隐至黑暗中的半透明烟雾热浪。使用 {argument name="flame height" default="高低错落的火焰峰值"}，呈现不均匀的卷曲形态，包括左、中、右侧几根巨大的扭曲火柱，以及底部一层密集的小火焰带。添加大量向上飘散的炽热余烬颗粒和火星，火焰上方散布着细小的红橙色斑点。使其看起来像逼真的电影级游戏特效或合成元素，高对比度，细节锐利，蕴含自然的湍流运动感，无物体，无文字，无人物，无边框，居中构图，{argument name="background color" default="纯黑色"}，{argument name="fire color palette" default="黄、白、橙、红"}，{argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9 宽屏横向"}。

templates.title: Anime Countryside Dog Walk T-Shirt Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫乡村遛狗 T 恤场景

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style full-body illustration of {argument name="character description" default="a fashionable young woman with long silvery-gray twin-tails"} walking toward the viewer on a narrow rural village road on a bright summer day, with her face intentionally obscured by a soft square blur. She has voluminous wavy twin-tails tied high, a purple rose hair accessory, pale skin, a black choker, a black scrunchie bracelet, and glossy legs with a black floral vine tattoo on one calf. She wears an oversized slightly translucent wet-look white T-shirt with the bold text {argument name="shirt text" default="HIMAINU"} printed across the chest and a simple emoticon-style face underneath, paired with a short black frilly skirt with pale lavender ruffle trim and black Mary Jane platform shoes. In her left hand she holds a black leash attached to {argument name="dog description" default="a small cream-colored curly toy poodle"} walking beside her, tongue out and looking cheerful. The setting is {argument name="setting" default="a scenic Japanese countryside village with rice fields, traditional wooden houses, roadside flowers, utility poles, and forested mountains"}; include a dirt-and-gravel path, irrigation channels, lush green fields, deep blue sky, bright white cumulus clouds, strong midday sunlight, crisp shadows, vibrant saturated colors, and highly detailed anime background art. Use a vertical composition, eye-level perspective, centered character, dog in the lower left foreground, cinematic summer atmosphere, clean linework, delicate fabric highlights, detailed hair strands, and rich environmental depth.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格全身插画，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着银灰色长双马尾的时尚年轻女性"} 在明媚的夏日正午，沿着狭窄的乡村小道向观众走来，她的面部被刻意处理为柔和的方形模糊效果。她扎着高高的蓬松波浪双马尾，戴着紫色玫瑰发饰，皮肤白皙，颈部佩戴黑色项圈，手腕戴着黑色发圈，双腿光洁亮泽，其中一侧小腿上有黑色花藤纹身。她身穿一件超大号、略带半透明湿感效果的白色 T 恤，胸前印有醒目的 {argument name="shirt text" default="HIMAINU"} 字样，下方配有一个简单的表情符号，下身搭配一条带有淡紫色荷叶边装饰的黑色短褶裙，脚穿黑色玛丽珍厚底鞋。她的左手牵着一根黑色牵引绳，绳子另一端是 {argument name="dog description" default="一只奶油色卷毛玩具贵宾犬"}，小狗正吐着舌头，神情愉悦地走在她身旁。背景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="风景优美的日本乡村，有稻田、传统木屋、路边野花、电线杆和森林覆盖的山脉"}；画面需包含泥土碎石路、灌溉渠、郁郁葱葱的田野、深蓝色的天空、明亮的白色积云、强烈的正午阳光、清晰的阴影、鲜艳饱和的色彩以及细节丰富的动漫背景艺术。采用竖构图、平视视角、角色居中，小狗位于左下角前景，营造出电影般的夏日氛围，线条干净利落，织物高光细腻，发丝细节丰富，环境层次感强。

templates.title: Japanese SNS Automation Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 日本 SNS 自动化缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a high-energy Japanese YouTube thumbnail / social media banner in a 16:9 widescreen format, using a dramatic black, white, and electric yellow color scheme with explosive manga-style speed lines, paint-brush textures, glowing arrows, sparks, and a futuristic AI automation atmosphere. The left half is dominated by huge bold Japanese headline typography reading {argument name="main headline text" default="頑張らない SNS展開"}, with the first line in thick white characters on a black brush-stroke background and “SNS” plus the following characters in oversized bright yellow block letters with black shadowing. Beneath it, add a slanted white brush-stroke strip containing black text reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="GPT Image 2で全部変わった"}. Along the bottom, place a wide black brush-stroke banner with large white and yellow Japanese text reading {argument name="bottom banner text" default="画像も記事もスキルで自動化"}, emphasizing the final yellow phrase. On the right half, show an anime-style young woman with very long flowing split-color hair, pink on the left side and blue on the right side, wearing a white T-shirt printed with {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"} and a pink skirt; her face is intentionally covered by a centered square mosaic-like block in muted pink and gray tones, while her right hand reaches toward the viewer in a dynamic foreshortened pose. Include exactly three floating social media icons: one black square X icon near the top center, one Instagram icon in a rounded white square at the upper right, and one YouTube play icon in a rounded white square at the lower right. Add glowing AI/content automation elements around the center, including a bright open cube with a cloud symbol, floating image cards, yellow directional arrows, and golden light rays radiating outward. Use crisp anime illustration mixed with bold advertising graphic design, high contrast, sharp outlines, saturated colors, motion blur accents, and a polished viral thumbnail composition optimized for clicks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高能量的日本 YouTube 缩略图 / 社交媒体横幅，采用 16:9 宽屏格式，使用戏剧性的黑、白、电光黄配色方案，搭配爆炸性的漫画风格速度线、画笔纹理、发光箭头、火花以及未来感十足的 AI 自动化氛围。左半部分由巨大的粗体日语标题主导，文字为 {argument name="main headline text" default="頑張らない SNS 展開"}，第一行采用黑色笔触背景上的白色粗体字，“SNS”及后续字符采用超大亮黄色块状字体并带有黑色阴影。在其下方，添加一条倾斜的白色笔触带，包含黑色文字 {argument name="subheadline text" default="GPT Image 2 で全部変わった"}。沿底部放置一个宽大的黑色笔触横幅，上面写着醒目的白色和黄色日语文字 {argument name="bottom banner text" default="画像も記事もスキルで自動化"}，强调最后的黄色短语。在右半部分，展示一位动漫风格的年轻女性，留着非常长的飘逸双色头发（左侧粉色，右侧蓝色），身穿印有 {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"} 的白色 T 恤和粉色短裙；她的脸部被一个居中的、呈柔和粉色和灰色调的方形马赛克块遮住，她的右手以动态的透视姿势伸向观众。包含三个悬浮的社交媒体图标：顶部中心附近的一个黑色方形 X 图标，右上角的一个圆形白色方形 Instagram 图标，以及右下角的一个圆形白色方形 YouTube 播放图标。在中心周围添加发光的 AI / 内容自动化元素，包括带有云符号的明亮开口立方体、悬浮图像卡片、黄色方向箭头和向外辐射的金色光芒。采用清晰的动漫插画与大胆的广告图形设计相结合，高对比度、锐利的轮廓、饱和的色彩、运动模糊点缀，以及针对点击率优化的精致病毒式缩略图构图。

templates.title: Crimson Winged Giant Mecha

titleLocalized.zh: 深红之翼巨型机甲

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime mecha illustration of a colossal humanoid robot named {argument name="mecha title" default="Heaven-Piercing Crimson"}, standing in a powerful symmetrical front-facing pose on a futuristic circular launch platform. The robot is primarily {argument name="armor color" default="glossy crimson red"} with white, black, dark gunmetal, and small gold accent panels, covered in intricate hard-surface armor plating, panel lines, vents, exposed mechanical joints, decals, scratches, and tiny warning markings. Give it a sharp Gundam-like heroic silhouette with a horned angular helmet, glowing cyan eyes, a narrow face mask, broad armored shoulders, layered chest armor, long segmented legs, and two large arm-mounted weapons or shield-blade units; one forearm carries a long rifle-like cannon with a cyan energy strip, while the other has a large angular red-and-white shield blade. Add an enormous wing backpack made of six major blade-like wing assemblies: two huge upward red wings, two wide horizontal red-and-white wings, and two long downward tail fins, all edged with white and gold pieces, creating a phoenix-like aerial form. Use a low-angle camera looking up to make the robot feel gigantic, centered composition, dynamic perspective, crisp cel-shaded anime rendering with realistic mechanical detail, high contrast sunlight, glossy reflections, and deep shadows. Set the scene against a bright {argument name="sky setting" default="clear blue sky with scattered white clouds"}, with a distant futuristic base and horizon below, emphasizing scale and grandeur. Style it as a premium Japanese giant robot poster, ultra-detailed, clean line art, vibrant colors, cinematic lighting, no visible text except optional tiny technical markings on the armor.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版动漫机甲插画，主角是一台名为 {argument name="mecha title" default="破天深红"} 的巨型人形机器人，它以充满力量感的对称正面姿态伫立在未来感十足的圆形发射平台上。机器人主体为 {argument name="armor color" default="光泽深红色"}，辅以白色、黑色、深枪灰色及少量的金色装饰面板，全身覆盖着复杂的硬表面装甲、刻线、通风口、外露机械关节、贴纸、划痕以及细小的警示标记。赋予它类似高达的锐利英雄轮廓，配有带角的棱角分明头盔、发光的青色双眼、窄面罩、宽阔的装甲肩部、层叠的胸甲、修长的分段式腿部，以及两件大型手臂武器或盾刃装置；一只前臂装备着带有青色能量条的长管步枪，另一只则配有大型棱角分明的红白盾刃。添加一个由六个主要刃状翼组件构成的巨大背部飞行背包：两片巨大的向上红翼、两片宽阔的水平红白翼以及两片长长的向下尾鳍，所有边缘均饰有白色和金色部件，呈现出凤凰般的空中形态。采用低角度仰拍视角以突显机器人的巨大感，构图居中，透视动态，采用清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染风格，兼具写实的机械细节、高对比度阳光、光泽反射及深邃阴影。场景背景设定为明亮的 {argument name="sky setting" default="晴朗蓝天与零星白云"}，下方可见远处的未来基地与地平线，强调规模与宏大感。整体风格为高端日本巨型机器人海报，超高细节，线条清晰，色彩鲜艳，电影级光影，除装甲上可选的细小技术标记外，不包含任何可见文字。

templates.title: Crimson Moody Double Exposure Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 深红忧郁双重曝光肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic cinematic studio portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young man"} in side profile, wearing {argument name="clothing" default="a black hooded sweatshirt"}, head bowed slightly with one hand pressed to his forehead as if stressed or deep in thought. Use intense {argument name="lighting color" default="deep crimson red"} lighting with strong rim light outlining messy curly dark hair, ear, neck, hand, and hoodie folds, while most of the figure falls into near-black shadow. Add atmospheric smoke or haze swirling through the background, illuminated by the red light, and include a large soft ghostly duplicate silhouette of the same head and shoulders in the background on the right, like a psychological double exposure. The composition is vertical, close-up from chest to head, subject facing left, with high contrast, moody noir styling, shallow depth of field, dark red and black color palette, subtle film grain, realistic photographic texture, and an emotional introspective mood. Keep the face mostly hidden in shadow and pose rather than clearly visible, emphasizing anonymity and tension.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的电影感摄影棚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一名年轻男子"} 的侧面轮廓，身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="黑色连帽卫衣"}，头部微垂，一只手按在额头上，仿佛压力巨大或陷入沉思。使用强烈的 {argument name="lighting color" default="深绯红色"} 灯光，以浓重的轮廓光勾勒出凌乱的深色卷发、耳朵、颈部、手部和卫衣褶皱，而人物主体大部分沉浸在近乎纯黑的阴影中。在背景中加入弥漫的烟雾或薄雾，并被红光照亮；在右侧背景中加入一个巨大的、柔和且幽灵般的同款头部和肩部轮廓，营造出心理层面的双重曝光效果。构图为竖构图，从胸部到头部的特写，主体面向左侧，具有高对比度、忧郁的黑色电影风格、浅景深、深红与黑色调、细腻的胶片颗粒感、逼真的摄影质感以及内省的情绪氛围。保持面部大部分隐藏在阴影和姿势中，而非清晰可见，以强调匿名感和紧张感。

templates.title: Dark Goblin Shaman in Haunted Swamp

titleLocalized.zh: 闹鬼沼泽中的黑暗哥布林萨满

templates.prompt: Create a dark fantasy cinematic illustration of a sinister {argument name="creature type" default="goblin shaman-warrior"} crouching low in a haunted swamp at night, centered in a three-quarter view and staring directly at the viewer with a vicious grin. The creature has mottled green-blue leathery skin, a long hooked nose, glowing icy blue eyes, huge pointed ears with small rings and ornaments, sharp jagged teeth, clawed feet, wiry limbs, and a crown of tangled dreadlock-like tendrils rising from its head. Dress it in tattered tribal leather, ragged cloth strips, bone and metal trinkets, and worn dark shoulder armor. Both forearms are encased in oversized ancient gauntlets made of corroded bronze-black metal, each ending in long claw-like prongs and containing one large circular glowing cyan magical core, for a total of two glowing gauntlet cores. Add wisps of turquoise ghost-fire curling around the gauntlets and drifting through the air. The setting is a misty dead marsh with black mud, shallow reflective water, reeds, twisted leafless trees, hanging moss, and jagged thorn-like silhouettes. In the far background place a looming gothic dark citadel with many needle spires and one bright circular blue arcane sigil glowing on its facade. Use a deep midnight blue palette with cyan rim light and magical glow, wet reflective surfaces, heavy fog, high contrast, ultra-detailed creature anatomy, ornate armor texture, grim fairytale horror mood, dramatic low-angle composition, sharp focus on the goblin, cinematic concept art quality, square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑暗奇幻电影级插画，描绘一个邪恶的 {argument name="creature type" default="哥布林萨满战士"} 在夜晚的闹鬼沼泽中低身蹲伏。画面采用四分之三侧视图，生物居中，正带着凶狠的笑容直视观众。该生物拥有斑驳的蓝绿色皮革皮肤、长而弯曲的鼻子、发着冰蓝色光芒的眼睛、带有小环和装饰的大尖耳、锋利参差的牙齿、爪状足部、精瘦的四肢，头顶长着一簇纠结如脏辫般的触须。为它穿上破烂的部落皮革、褴褛的布条、骨头和金属饰品，以及磨损的深色肩甲。双前臂包裹在由腐蚀的青铜黑色金属制成的超大古代护手内，每个护手末端有长长的爪状尖刺，并各含一个巨大的圆形发光青色魔法核心，总计两个发光的护手核心。在护手周围添加缭绕的绿松石色鬼火，并使其在空气中飘散。背景设定为充满迷雾的死寂沼泽，地面是黑色泥泞，浅水区有倒影，生长着芦苇、扭曲的无叶树木、悬挂的苔藓和锯齿状的荆棘轮廓。在远景处放置一座阴森的哥特式黑暗城堡，城堡有许多针状尖塔，外墙上有一个明亮的圆形蓝色奥术符号在发光。采用深午夜蓝调，搭配青色轮廓光和魔法光效，呈现湿润的反射表面、浓重的雾气、高对比度、超精细的生物解剖结构、华丽的盔甲质感、阴郁的童话恐怖氛围、戏剧性的低角度构图，焦点清晰地对准哥布林，具备电影级概念艺术品质，方形画幅。

Dress it in ragged dark leather and scraps of spiked armor: one bulky spiked shoulder pauldron, heavy mismatched bracers, clawed metal gauntlets, belts, straps, charms, bone details, and battered ornaments. The creature crawls forward with long clawed hands planted on the dirt, one hand near a small skull and wisps of ghostly blue smoke, creating a menacing goblin-art showcase portrait. Set the scene at night under a star-filled teal sky with a large bright moon or glowing orb low on the left horizon, turquoise nebula haze behind the character, scattered bones, skulls, rocks, dead grass, and red-capped mushrooms in the background. Use dramatic rim lighting, cyan bioluminescent glow from the eyes and smoke, high contrast shadows, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed textures, grimy practical fantasy realism, cinematic 3D creature design, wide-angle perspective, centered composition, intense threatening expression, no text, no borders.

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic dark-fantasy 3D character portrait of a feral {argument name="creature type" default="goblin shaman"} crouching low in a swamp at night, lunging toward the viewer with a malicious grin. The creature has mottled green skin, a narrow wrinkled face, sharp fangs, long pointed ears with multiple silver hoop piercings, glowing icy-blue eyes, and wild spiky {argument name="hair color" default="turquoise and magenta"} hair swept upward. Add luminous cyan tribal markings on the forehead, chest, and arms, with the brightest sigil centered above the brow. Dress the goblin in rugged fantasy armor: one large weathered brass shoulder pauldron with rivets, dark leather straps, a circular metal chest device, a tattered red loincloth, and red leather forearm bracers painted with black occult symbols. Both clawed hands should be extended forward, wreathed in smoky orange magical fire, with glowing runes on the wrists and fingertips. Set the scene in a murky marsh with shallow reflective water, mist, reeds, scattered bones, ribs, and skulls, plus clusters of bioluminescent cyan mushrooms and tiny green firefly-like lights. Use a low camera angle, dramatic depth of field, high-detail creature sculpting, wet skin and armor textures, volumetric blue fog, starry night bokeh in the background, and strong contrast between cold cyan magical glow and hot orange hand-fire. Make it a square, ultra-detailed, cinematic fantasy render with an aggressive, menacing mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级暗黑奇幻风格的 3D 角色肖像，描绘一只野性的 {argument name="creature type" default="哥布林萨满"} 在夜晚的沼泽中低身蹲伏，带着邪恶的笑容向观众扑来。该生物拥有斑驳的绿色皮肤、狭窄且布满皱纹的脸庞、锋利的獠牙、带有多个银色圆环穿孔的长尖耳、发着冰蓝色光芒的双眼，以及向上梳起的狂野尖刺状 {argument name="hair color" default="青色和洋红色"} 头发。在前额、胸部和手臂上添加发光的青色部落纹饰，最明亮的符文位于眉心正上方。为哥布林穿上粗犷的奇幻盔甲：一个带有铆钉的大型风化黄铜肩甲、深色皮带、圆形金属胸部装置、破旧的红色缠腰布，以及绘有黑色神秘符号的红色皮革前臂护腕。双爪应向前伸展，缠绕着烟雾缭绕的橙色魔法火焰，手腕和指尖带有发光的符文。场景设定在昏暗的沼泽中，地面有浅浅的反射水面、薄雾、芦苇、散落的骨头、肋骨和头骨，并点缀着成簇的生物发光青色蘑菇和微小的绿色萤火虫状光点。采用低机位拍摄，强调戏剧性的景深，展现高细节的生物雕刻、湿润的皮肤和盔甲质感、体积感十足的蓝色雾气、背景中星光璀璨的虚化效果，以及冷色调青色魔法光芒与暖色调橙色手部火焰之间的强烈对比。将其制作成一张方形、超精细、电影级的奇幻渲染图，营造出一种极具侵略性的威胁氛围。

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic single-panel anime illustration of a stylish young man with messy, voluminous {argument name="hair color" default="black hair with faint purple highlights"}, shown from the waist up on a clean white background. His face is intentionally covered by a large centered square privacy block with a muted dark-to-warm gray gradient, obscuring all facial features. He reaches toward the viewer with one hand in strong foreshortened perspective, holding a sleek black pen or stylus between his fingers as if drawing in midair. Dress him in an oversized glossy {argument name="jacket color" default="white"} techwear jacket layered over a black shirt and hoodie, with visible straps, buckles, zippers, black lining, and several silver chain necklaces with small pendants. Add thin silver rings on his extended fingers. Use energetic sketchy linework, semi-realistic anime rendering, high detail in the hair and hand, soft lavender and pale pink accent strokes, and a fashionable urban sci-fi mood. Surround him with hand-drawn doodles and abstract design marks: exactly 1 small ringed planet near the upper left, 1 pink lightning bolt near the upper right, 2 wireframe geometric polyhedrons near the lower left and right edges, multiple small star sparkles, scattered black dots, diagonal ink splashes, and constellation-like connecting lines. The composition should feel like a modern digital artist avatar or profile illustration, with the pen tip and hand closest to the camera, crisp black-and-white contrast, loose manga sketch textures, and no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动感的单格动漫插画，描绘一位时尚的年轻人，留着凌乱蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有淡紫色挑染的黑发"}，半身像，背景为干净的白色。他的面部被一个居中的大方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖，采用柔和的深灰到暖灰渐变，遮住所有五官。他的一只手以强烈的透视感伸向观众，指间握着一支时尚的黑色画笔或触控笔，仿佛在半空中作画。为他穿上一件超大号的亮面 {argument name="jacket color" default="白色"} 科技风夹克，内搭黑色衬衫和连帽衫，配有明显的绑带、搭扣、拉链、黑色内衬以及几条带有小吊坠的银色项链。在他伸出的手指上添加细银戒指。采用充满活力的草图线条、半写实动漫渲染，头发和手部细节丰富，点缀柔和的薰衣草色和淡粉色笔触，营造出时尚的都市科幻氛围。周围环绕手绘涂鸦和抽象设计符号：左上方正好有 1 个带环行星，右上方有 1 个粉色闪电，左下和右下边缘各有 2 个线框几何多面体，以及多个小星星闪光、散落的黑点、对角线墨水溅射和类似星座的连接线。整体构图应呈现出现代数字艺术家头像或个人资料插画的质感，笔尖和手部最靠近镜头，具有清晰的黑白对比、随性的漫画草图纹理，且不包含任何文字。

templates.prompt: Create a bright studio fashion photo of {argument name="number of cheerleaders" default="three"} young adult female cheerleaders posing together against a seamless vivid {argument name="background color" default="orange"} backdrop. The scene contains exactly three performers: the left cheerleader wears a sparkling blue two-piece cheer uniform with silver-and-white trim and a large blue hair bow, leans diagonally with one arm raised holding a silver pom-pom; the center cheerleader wears a sparkling red two-piece cheer uniform with gold-and-white trim, a red hair bow, stands front and center with one hand on her hip and holds metallic gold pom-poms; the right cheerleader wears a sparkling green two-piece cheer uniform with white-and-silver trim and a green hair bow, performs a dramatic vertical high kick with one leg lifted straight upward, holding white pom-poms. All three wear short pleated skirts, white crew socks with colored stripes matching their outfits, and clean white athletic sneakers. Use glossy sequin fabric, crisp studio lighting, vibrant saturated colors, full-body vertical composition, energetic dance-team pose, dynamic hair movement, polished commercial photography style, sharp details on uniforms and pom-poms, smooth orange floor blending into the backdrop, and faces covered by simple square pixelated blur masks for anonymity.

templates.title: Kirikane Gold Kimono Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 切金工艺金箔和服肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, ultra-detailed Japanese decorative portrait in the style of a luxurious byobu folding screen and kirikane cut-gold leaf craft. Show a young Japanese woman in side profile facing left, wearing an ornate {argument name="kimono color" default="deep vermilion red"} bridal kimono covered with gold leaf, pale cherry blossom patterns, and intricate brocade texture. Her long glossy {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair flows down her back, decorated with an elaborate cluster of red and ivory sakura hair ornaments and many dangling golden kanzashi chains. Place a flat opaque {argument name="face covering" default="warm tan square"} over the center of her face, hiding facial features. The background is a radiant antique gold-leaf landscape with visible cracked foil texture, fine engraved kirikane lines, swirling rivers of gold and cream, distant {argument name="background mountain" default="Mount Fuji"}, dark pine silhouettes, and abundant red and white cherry blossoms blooming across the upper right and lower foreground. Use a dense gilded composition with layered metallic flakes, raised lacquer-like outlines, mosaic gold cracks, delicate floral filigree, and shimmering highlights; make it feel like traditional Japanese nihonga mixed with high-fashion portraiture. Warm golden lighting, extremely ornate surface detail, elegant asymmetrical composition, no modern objects, no text, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅垂直、超精细的日本装饰性肖像，采用奢华的屏风和切金工艺风格。展示一位侧身向左的年轻日本女性，身穿华丽的 {argument name="kimono color" default="深朱红色"} 新娘和服，覆盖着金箔、淡雅的樱花图案和复杂的锦缎纹理。她长而有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 秀发垂在脑后，装饰着一簇精致的红白樱花发饰和许多悬垂的金色簪子链。在她的脸部中央放置一个平坦不透明的 {argument name="face covering" default="暖棕色方块"}，遮住面部特征。背景是光芒四射的古董金箔景观，具有可见的裂纹箔片纹理、精细的切金雕刻线条、流动的金色与奶油色河流、远处的 {argument name="background mountain" default="富士山"}、深色的松树剪影，以及在右上角和左下角前景中盛开的大量红白樱花。采用密集的镀金构图，结合层叠的金属薄片、凸起的漆器质感轮廓、马赛克金裂纹、精致的花卉金银丝细工和闪烁的高光；营造出传统日本画与高级时尚肖像相结合的质感。暖色调的金色光影，极其华丽的表面细节，优雅的非对称构图，无现代物品，无文字，垂直 2:3 纵横比。

templates.title: Warm Living Room Mirror Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨客厅镜面自拍

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, high-end lifestyle mirror selfie photograph of an adult woman lounging sideways on a modern beige sofa in a warm minimalist living room. She has {argument name="hair color" default="short dark brown"} chin-length bob hair and a slim figure, reclining with her upper body propped against the left sofa arm, one hand resting on the cushion and the other holding a dark smartphone in front of her face; her face is intentionally hidden by a plain rectangular privacy blur/censor block. She wears a fitted {argument name="top style" default="white ribbed long-sleeve turtleneck cropped top"} and a {argument name="skirt style" default="brown gray plaid mini skirt"}, with bare legs extended diagonally across the sofa toward the right side of the frame. Compose the image in a wide horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio, full-body from head to toes, slightly low eye-level perspective, casual elegant pose, natural anatomy, soft skin texture, realistic fabric folds. The room has beige plaster walls, a cream sofa with square arms and a matching throw pillow, a black dome table lamp glowing warmly on a dark side table at the far left, wooden flooring, and a tall sculptural gray ceramic vase with delicate leafy branches on the far right. Use warm ambient lighting with soft shadows, cozy evening atmosphere, shallow depth of field, muted neutral palette, editorial interior photography style, ultra-realistic detail, no visible text, no extra people, no distorted hands or feet.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真、高端的生活方式镜面自拍照片，展示一位成年女性侧身斜倚在温馨简约客厅的现代米色沙发上。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色短发"} 的齐下巴波波头，身材苗条，上半身靠在沙发左侧扶手上，一只手放在靠垫上，另一只手拿着深色智能手机挡在脸前；她的面部被一个简洁的矩形隐私模糊/遮挡块刻意遮住。她穿着一件修身的 {argument name="top style" default="白色罗纹长袖高领露脐上衣"} 和一条 {argument name="skirt style" default="棕灰色格纹迷你裙"}，双腿裸露，向画面右侧斜向伸展。构图采用 16:9 宽画幅，全身从头到脚，略微低平的视线角度，姿态休闲优雅，人体结构自然，皮肤纹理细腻，布料褶皱真实。房间墙面为米色灰泥，配有方形扶手的奶油色沙发及同色系抱枕，最左侧深色边几上放着一盏散发温暖光芒的黑色半球形台灯，铺设木地板，最右侧摆放着一个高大的雕塑感灰色陶瓷花瓶，插有精致的枝叶。采用温暖的环境光，阴影柔和，营造舒适的夜晚氛围，浅景深，柔和的中性色调，编辑级室内摄影风格，超逼真细节，无可见文字，无多余人物，无扭曲的手部或脚部。

templates.title: Greenhouse Cyber Streetwear Anime Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 温室赛博街头风动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant full-body anime illustration of a fashionable young girl in a sunlit greenhouse for Greenery Day, surrounded by dense tropical plants, hanging baskets, potted flowers, and glowing firefly-like green light specks. She stands on a tiled garden path in a playful leaning pose, one hand reaching toward a wall of leaves, with dramatic wide-angle perspective and lush foreground foliage framing the scene. Her face is intentionally covered by a soft-edged opaque {argument name="face censor color" default="green"} square blur. She has a short bob haircut with bright {argument name="hair color" default="yellow-green gradient hair with orange tips"}, iridescent crystal cat-ear accessories, and small hair clips. Dress her in cyber streetwear: an oversized glossy black jacket with pixelated neon green, magenta, white, and purple checker patterns, a black cropped top, black mini skirt, pink belt details, dangling zipper tags and charms, white slouchy leg warmers, and chunky black sneakers with pink laces and neon accents. Use {argument name="jacket pattern colors" default="neon green, magenta, white, and purple pixel checker"} as the dominant jacket motif. The greenhouse should be filled with strong diagonal sunbeams through glass roof panels, warm backlighting, sparkling bokeh, saturated greens, pink flower accents, highly detailed leaves, and a polished modern anime style with crisp linework, luminous color grading, and a cheerful spring atmosphere.

templates.title: Cozy Night Living Room Candid

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨夜晚客厅抓拍

templates.prompt: Create a warm, candid, photorealistic vertical 35mm-style indoor snapshot of a cozy, slightly messy apartment living room at night. The main subject is {argument name="subject description" default="a young East Asian woman with black messy hair and round glasses"} lying upside down across a dark gray fabric sofa, head near the front-right edge of the couch, one arm bent behind her head and the other relaxed outward, eyes closed or half-closed with a tired, peaceful expression. She wears {argument name="top color" default="a muted blue sleeveless tank top"} and {argument name="shorts color" default="light gray drawstring lounge shorts"}, bare legs stretched along the sofa, with a rumpled beige throw blanket around her waist and cushions nearby. The room should feel lived-in and intimate: stacks of magazines and papers on a chair and side surfaces, shelves full of books and records in the background, a low wooden coffee table on the right holding exactly three black remote controls and one ceramic mug, and a pile of blankets on an ottoman or floor cushion in the back. Include exactly three warm light sources: a large floor lamp on the left foreground, a small lamp on a cabinet in the rear center, and another glowing lamp near the right rear curtains. Use {argument name="lighting mood" default="warm tungsten evening light"}, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, natural skin tones, slight motion softness, realistic clutter, and an unposed documentary-photo composition shot from above the sofa looking diagonally through the room. Avoid glamour styling; make it feel like an ordinary quiet night at home.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖、真实、抓拍风格的 35mm 胶片感室内快照，呈现夜晚温馨且略显杂乱的公寓客厅。主体为 {argument name="subject description" default="一位留着黑色凌乱短发、戴着圆框眼镜的年轻东亚女性"}，她头朝前右侧边缘，倒卧在深灰色布艺沙发上，一只手臂弯曲在脑后，另一只手臂自然向外舒展，双眼闭合或半闭，表情疲惫而宁静。她身穿 {argument name="top color" default="一件柔和的蓝色无袖背心"} 和 {argument name="shorts color" default="浅灰色抽绳居家短裤"}，赤裸的双腿沿沙发伸展，腰间围着一条褶皱的米色盖毯，身旁放着靠垫。房间应充满生活气息且私密：椅子和侧面桌面上堆放着杂志和纸张，背景书架上摆满了书籍和唱片，右侧的低矮木质咖啡桌上整齐地放着 3 个黑色遥控器和 1 个陶瓷马克杯，后方的脚凳或地垫上堆着一叠毯子。画面需包含 3 个温暖的光源：左前方的落地灯、后方中央柜子上的小台灯，以及右后方窗帘旁发光的另一盏灯。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖的钨丝灯夜光"}，浅景深，柔和的胶片颗粒感，自然的肤色，轻微的动态模糊，真实的杂乱感，以及从沙发上方斜向俯瞰整个房间的非摆拍式纪实构图。避免过度美化，营造出普通而宁静的居家夜晚氛围。

templates.title: Neon Virtual Idol Concert

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹虚拟偶像演唱会

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime concert illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Hatsune Miku"} on a massive futuristic stage, viewed from a very low angle so she looks towering and heroic. She is a petite virtual idol with long glowing {argument name="hair color" default="turquoise"} twin-tails streaming outward like translucent ribbons, bright teal eyes, pale skin, and a confident playful smile. She wears a glossy black and gray cyber-idol outfit with a sleeveless metallic bodice, short pleated skirt with luminous turquoise triangular panels, black thigh-high boots, detached translucent sleeves, futuristic arm panels, a headset microphone, and small angular hair accessories. Her right hand reaches toward the viewer while a microphone cable loops dynamically across the foreground. Surround her with intense cyan and electric-blue light trails, sparkling particles, lens flares, laser beams, and transparent holographic fabric shapes swirling around her body. The background is a packed nighttime stadium concert with glowing audience light sticks, LED screens, rigging arcs, spotlights, and bursts of stage lighting in cyan with small magenta accents. Use high-contrast cinematic lighting, glossy reflections on the stage floor, deep black shadows, vibrant neon glow, sharp anime linework, highly detailed rendering, energetic composition, and a spectacular {argument name="mood" default="near-future virtual idol live performance"} atmosphere. No text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版动漫演唱会插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="初音未来"}，她站在巨大的未来感舞台上，采用极低视角拍摄，使她看起来高大且充满英雄气概。她是一位娇小的虚拟偶像，留着长长的发光 {argument name="hair color" default="青绿色"} 双马尾，发丝如半透明丝带般向外飘散，拥有明亮的青色双眸、白皙的皮肤以及自信俏皮的微笑。她身穿光泽感十足的黑灰色赛博偶像服装，包括无袖金属质感紧身胸衣、带有发光青绿色三角形镶板的短百褶裙、黑色过膝长靴、分离式半透明袖套、未来感手臂护甲、头戴式麦克风以及小型棱角分明的发饰。她的右手向观众伸出，一根麦克风线在前景中动态环绕。周围环绕着强烈的青色和电蓝色光轨、闪烁的粒子、镜头光晕、激光束以及围绕她身体旋转的透明全息织物形状。背景是挤满观众的夜间体育场演唱会，有发光的应援棒、LED 屏幕、舞台桁架、聚光灯以及青色为主、带有少量洋红色点缀的舞台灯光爆发。采用高对比度的电影级布光、舞台地面的光泽反射、深邃的黑色阴影、鲜艳的霓虹光效、锐利的动漫线条、高度精细的渲染、充满活力的构图，以及壮观的 {argument name="mood" default="近未来虚拟偶像现场演出"} 氛围。无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Sci-Fi Corridor Stealth Ambush

titleLocalized.zh: 科幻走廊潜行伏击

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anime-style sci-fi action scene in a dim industrial facility corridor. The composition is wide, with a concrete pillar dividing the image: on the far left foreground, a tense young woman named {argument name="character name" default="blonde covert operative"} hides behind the wall, leaning out cautiously while gripping one black semi-automatic pistol with both hands pointed upward; she has {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair tied in a low ponytail with loose bangs, wears a black sleeveless crop tank top and black tactical shorts, and has visible sweat on her arms and shoulders. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat opaque beige square censor block. In the mid-background on the right side of the corridor stand exactly two uniformed security officers: one brown-haired male officer pointing at one handheld tablet, and one blond officer holding that tablet; both wear dark navy futuristic combat uniforms with light blue piping, armored shoulders, tall black boots, and their faces are also obscured by matching opaque beige square censor blocks. The environment is a long underground military or research-base hallway with polished reflective concrete floor, raw concrete walls, exposed ceiling pipes, bright white fluorescent strip lights, blue glowing access panels, one heavy metal door on the right, and cool blue-gray lighting. Mood is stealthy, suspenseful, and tactical, as if the woman is ambushing or spying on the two guards. Use highly detailed Japanese anime illustration, sharp linework, realistic perspective, dramatic depth, moody shadows, glossy floor reflections, cyberpunk military ambience, widescreen 16:9 framing, no readable text.

templates.title: Blonde Anime Girl with Ice Cream

titleLocalized.zh: 金发动漫少女与冰淇淋

templates.prompt: Create a soft, high-detail anime illustration of a cute young woman sitting at an outdoor café on a sunny day, shown in a close-up upper-body portrait from a slightly elevated angle. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered solid square censor block in a warm peach skin tone, obscuring the eyes, nose, and mouth while leaving the hair, ears, neck, clothing, and ice cream visible. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="pale honey blonde"} hair with fine individual strands, loose bangs, glossy highlights, and warm backlighting. She wears a feminine spring outfit: an off-white cardigan over a white ruffled blouse with small pale floral embroidery and a thin brown shoulder strap crossing diagonally. She holds a vanilla soft-serve ice cream cone near her mouth in one hand; the cone has a pink paper sleeve with small English text reading “ice cream.” In the softly blurred background, include a sidewalk café or dessert shop window, a leafy green potted plant on the right, wooden bench or railing elements, and exactly 1 standing menu sign on the left showing Japanese text “ミルク バニラ” and the price “¥350” with a small vanilla cone illustration. Use pastel colors, delicate line art, luminous golden sunlight, gentle bokeh, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, and a wholesome romantic slice-of-life mood. Vertical composition, polished modern anime style, highly detailed hair and clothing textures, no extra people, no additional signs, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张柔和且高细节的动漫插画，描绘一位可爱的年轻女性在阳光明媚的日子坐在户外咖啡馆，采用略微俯视的角度进行上半身特写。她的面部被一个居中的纯色方形马赛克有意遮挡，马赛克颜色为温暖的桃肤色，遮住了眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，但保留了头发、耳朵、脖子、服装和冰淇淋的可见度。她拥有非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅蜜金色"} 长发，发丝细腻，带有凌乱的刘海、光泽感高光和温暖的背光。她穿着女性化的春季服装：米白色开衫内搭白色荷叶边衬衫，衬衫上有细小的淡色花卉刺绣，并有一条细棕色肩带斜跨。她的一只手拿着一个香草软冰淇淋蛋筒靠近嘴边；蛋筒带有粉色纸套，上面印有英文“ice cream”。在柔和模糊的背景中，包含一家人行道咖啡馆或甜点店橱窗、右侧一盆绿叶盆栽、木质长椅或栏杆元素，以及左侧 1 个立式菜单牌，上面显示日文“ミルク バニラ”和价格“¥350”，并配有小巧的香草冰淇淋插图。使用柔和的色调、细腻的线条、明亮的金色阳光、柔和的焦外成像、柔和的阴影、浅景深以及温馨浪漫的日常番氛围。竖构图，精致的现代动漫风格，高度细腻的头发和服装纹理，画面中没有其他人、没有额外的招牌、没有水印。

templates.title: Censored Dragon Musician Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 被遮挡的龙族音乐家肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical fantasy anime illustration of a {argument name="character name" default="dragon musician"}, a shirtless dark-brown-skinned male humanoid dragon in three-quarter profile facing right, holding a tall black string instrument like a shamisen or lute. His face is deliberately covered by a flat opaque brown square censor block centered over the eyes, nose, and mouth. He has long tousled {argument name="hair color" default="ash brown"} hair swept back, two dark branching antler-like horns rising from his head, one pointed ear visible with a small earring, and a long golden-scaled dragon tail curling behind him on the left. Add four large jagged purple fin-like scales behind his head and neck, with a mesh scale texture, plus gold scale patches on both shoulders, collarbone, chest, and forearms. His torso is muscular and lean with defined abs, bare chest, and warm cel-shaded highlights. Dress him in a vivid draped robe around the waist and arms: {argument name="robe colors" default="orange and magenta"} fabric with gold floral embroidery near the lower left, loose sleeves flowing around the instrument. The instrument is vertical on the right side of the composition, with a black body and neck, gold fittings, visible frets and strings, a decorative headstock, and dark tassel-like horizontal cords near the top; one hand grips the neck while the other rests near the strings. Use elegant Japanese-inspired fantasy character art, clean ink lines, soft painterly cel shading, warm gold accents, high-detail scales and hair strands, a pale off-white background, close cropped composition from thighs to head, dramatic but calm mood, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版奇幻动漫插图，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="龙族音乐家"}，一位赤裸上身、深褐色皮肤的类人龙族男性，呈四分之三侧面朝右，手持一把类似三味线或琵琶的高大黑色弦乐器。他的脸部被一个位于眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴中心的平坦不透明棕色方块遮挡。他留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="灰棕色"} 长发，向后梳理，头上长着两只深色的分叉鹿角状龙角，露出一只尖耳朵并戴着小耳环，身后左侧盘绕着一条长长的金色鳞片龙尾。在他的头部和颈部后方添加四片巨大的锯齿状紫色鳍状鳞片，带有网状鳞片纹理，肩膀、锁骨、胸部和前臂上有金色鳞片斑块。他的躯干肌肉线条分明，腹肌清晰，赤裸胸膛，带有温暖的赛璐珞风格高光。为他穿上一件缠绕在腰部和手臂上的鲜艳长袍：{argument name="robe colors" default="橙色和洋红色"} 面料，左下方有金色花卉刺绣，宽松的袖子围绕着乐器飘动。乐器位于构图右侧，呈垂直状，拥有黑色琴身和琴颈、金色配件、清晰的品位和琴弦、装饰性的琴头，顶部附近有深色流苏状横向绳索；一只手握住琴颈，另一只手放在琴弦附近。采用优雅的日式奇幻角色艺术风格，线条干净利落，柔和的绘画感赛璐珞阴影，温暖的金色点缀，高细节的鳞片和发丝，浅灰白色背景，从大腿到头部的近景构图，氛围戏剧化但宁静，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Melancholic Lin Daiyu Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁林黛玉肖像

templates.prompt: Create a moody cinematic portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Lin Daiyu"}, one of the heroines from Dream of the Red Chamber, seated indoors in an ancient Chinese study. She is a delicate young noblewoman in a translucent pale blue Hanfu with layered gauze sleeves, subtle floral embroidery along the collar, and a soft white inner robe. Her long black hair is styled in an elegant loose updo with wispy strands, decorated with a small floral hairpin, dangling silver ornaments, and a turquoise bead. Her pose is quiet and introspective, one hand raised thoughtfully near her lips and the other resting across her lap beside an open handwritten book on a dark wooden desk. A large flat medium-gray square covers the center of her face, obscuring her facial features. The room is dim and atmospheric, lit by cool bluish window light from the left, with soft haze, shallow depth of field, dark wooden furniture, a blurred hanging calligraphy scroll in the background, and antique objects in the foreground including a stack of old books, a small blue-green ceramic jar, and the edge of a wooden birdcage or shelving piece. Add large vertical off-white Chinese brush calligraphy on the upper left reading {argument name="calligraphy text" default="林黛玉"}, plus one small red seal stamp beneath it also reading {argument name="seal text" default="林黛玉"}. The style should be realistic historical Chinese costume drama photography, melancholic, elegant, poetic, high detail, soft film grain, cool desaturated teal-gray color grading, vertical 2:3 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的忧郁肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="林黛玉"}（《红楼梦》女主角之一），她正端坐在古色古香的中国书房内。她是一位娇弱的贵族少女，身着淡蓝色半透明汉服，袖口层叠轻纱，领口绣有精致花纹，内搭柔软的白色长袍。她乌黑的长发梳成优雅的松散发髻，几缕发丝垂落，点缀着小巧的花朵发簪、银质流苏饰品和一颗绿松石珠。她姿态静谧且深沉，一只手轻托下颌，另一只手放在深色木桌上，身旁摊开着一本手写书。一张巨大的中灰色方形色块遮住了她的面部中心，掩盖了五官。室内光线昏暗且充满氛围感，左侧透入冷调的蓝色窗光，伴有柔和的雾气和浅景深效果；背景是深色木质家具和模糊的悬挂书法卷轴，前景摆放着古董物件，包括一叠旧书、一个小巧的青绿色陶瓷罐，以及木制鸟笼或架子的一角。在左上方添加大型竖排米白色中国毛笔书法，内容为 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="林黛玉"}，下方盖有一枚红色印章，内容同样为 {argument name="seal text" default="林黛玉"}。风格应为写实的中国古装剧摄影，忧郁、优雅、诗意，高细节，带有柔和的胶片颗粒感，采用冷调去饱和的青灰色调，竖构图 2:3。

templates.title: 1990s Akihabara Street Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代秋叶原街景照片

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic documentary street photograph of {argument name="location and era" default="Akihabara, Tokyo in the 1990s"}, shot from eye level in a narrow electronics shopping street at dusk or late afternoon. The scene contains about 30 visible pedestrians, mostly adult men in casual 1990s clothing such as denim jackets, plaid sweaters, light-wash jeans, bomber jackets, business suits, shoulder bags, and shopping bags; faces are soft, indistinct, or motion-blurred like an old candid TV still. The street is packed but not chaotic, with people standing, browsing, walking away from camera, and gathering near storefronts. Both sides of the street are lined with tall commercial buildings covered in dense Japanese electronics-store signage, including large vertical and horizontal signs with readable fragments such as {argument name="main sign text" default="オノデン"}, {argument name="store brand text" default="Panasonic"}, “FAN,” “BEST,” and other katakana shop signs. The left side has a prominent blue and yellow electronics storefront canopy, while the right side has an orange-and-blue shop awning, shelves, posters, and boxed merchandise displayed at the entrance. Overhead utility wires crisscross the bright washed-out sky between mid-rise buildings. Use a realistic 1990s Japanese consumer camcorder or VHS broadcast aesthetic: 4:3 aspect ratio, slightly low resolution, interlaced softness, muted colors, mild film grain, blown highlights in the sky, subtle barrel distortion, natural crowd clutter, and no modern smartphones, LED billboards, contemporary fashion, or futuristic elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级写实的纪录片风格街拍，内容为 {argument name="location and era" default="20 世纪 90 年代的东京秋叶原"}，视角为平视，拍摄于黄昏或傍晚时分狭窄的电子产品购物街。场景中约有 30 名行人，多为穿着 20 世纪 90 年代休闲服饰的成年男性，如牛仔夹克、格纹毛衣、浅色水洗牛仔裤、飞行员夹克、商务西装、单肩包和购物袋；面部柔和、模糊或带有类似旧电视抓拍的动态模糊感。街道拥挤但不混乱，人们有的站立、有的浏览、有的背对镜头行走、有的聚集在店面附近。街道两侧林立着高大的商业建筑，覆盖着密集的日本电子商店招牌，包括大型竖排和横排标志，上面有可辨认的片段，如 {argument name="main sign text" default="オノデン"}、{argument name="store brand text" default="Panasonic"}、“FAN”、“BEST” 以及其他片假名商店招牌。左侧有一个显眼的蓝黄色电子商店雨棚，右侧则有橙蓝色遮阳篷、货架、海报以及陈列在入口处的盒装商品。头顶上方的电线在中层建筑之间交错，映衬着明亮而泛白的天空。采用 20 世纪 90 年代日本消费级摄像机或 VHS 广播美学：4:3 画幅、略低的解析度、交错扫描的柔和感、柔和的色彩、轻微的胶片颗粒感、天空处过曝的高光、细微的桶形畸变、自然的拥挤感，且不包含现代智能手机、LED 广告牌、当代时尚元素或未来主义元素。
