templates.prompt: Create a wide 9-panel cinematic storyboard infographic Use a realistic photography style with warm cinematic colors. Arrange the storyboard in a clean 3x3 grid layout with numbered panels, bold titles, short bullet points, and smooth visual storytelling similar to a professional film-production storyboard. Panel 1 — Eyes in the Storm Ultra-realistic extreme close-up of a female cyclist’s face during a heavy rainstorm at night. Focus on her eyes, soaked eyelashes, wet skin texture, and streams of rainwater running across her face. She wears a baby pink cycling helmet and baby pink face mask. Subtle red reflections from a rear bike light flicker dynamically across her eyes and skin, mixing with cold blue night tones. High contrast cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, hyper-realistic skin texture, macro 85mm lens, intense determined expression. Panel 2 — Aggressive Night Ride Ultra-realistic cinematic medium close-up frontal shot of the female cyclist riding aggressively through heavy rain at night. She pedals hard with strong effort, body leaning forward. Baby pink waterproof cycling jacket glowing subtly under wet reflections. Front bike light cutting through rain and fog, slight flicker creating dynamic illumination. Wet asphalt reflecting red and white lights. Smooth cinematic tracking shot with stable movement and slight natural motion. Panel 3 — Rain Impact Macro Ultra-realistic macro cinematic shot of large heavy raindrops hitting wet asphalt at night. Huge crown-shaped splashes, ripples spreading through puddles, detailed water physics in slow motion. Cool blue cinematic tones with subtle reflections from bike lights. Extremely shallow depth of field, rough wet asphalt texture, dramatic nighttime atmosphere. Locked-off stable macro shot. Panel 4 — Three Cyclists in the Storm Ultra-realistic cinematic shot of three female road cyclists riding fast together at night in a heavy rainstorm. All riders wear baby pink cycling apparel contrasting against the dark blue environment. Strong pedaling, water spraying from wheels, heavy rain illuminated by bike lights. One bike light flickers irregularly, creating unstable lighting changes across the riders and wet road. Smooth stabilized tracking camera from behind and slightly to the side. Cinematic motion blur enhances speed. Panel 5 — Drivetrain Under Pressure Ultra-realistic macro cinematic close-up of a bicycle drivetrain during intense riding in heavy rain at night. Rear cassette, chain, derailleur, and crankset moving aggressively under load. Baby pink cycling shoe partially visible during pedaling. Water droplets, oil, and dirt splashing across the metal surfaces. Flickering light pulses intermittently across spinning components, revealing sharp mechanical detail before fading into darkness. Hyper-realistic wet textures and reflections. Panel 6 — Top-Down Drone Formation Ultra-realistic top-down drone shot of three female cyclists riding in perfect single-file formation on a wet mountain road at night. Baby pink jackets visible against dark reflective asphalt. Perfect vertical 90-degree angle, locked framing, smooth stabilized drone movement with no rotation or perspective shift. Wet road reflections, light rain visible under bike lights, atmospheric fog surrounding the road edges. Panel 7 — Side Tracking Speed Shot Ultra-realistic cinematic side tracking shot of the female cyclists riding at high speed through rain and fog at night. Camera moves parallel to them with stable FPV-style cinematic motion. Baby pink apparel catches occasional highlights from flickering bike lights. Water sprays from tires, rain streaks cutting across frame, strong motion blur in the background emphasizing speed and endurance. Panel 8 — Front Light Through Darkness Ultra-realistic cinematic frontal shot of the lead female cyclist riding directly toward the camera through heavy rain and fog. Her front bike light flickers softly while cutting through darkness. Baby pink jacket soaked with rainwater, droplets flying from the wheels. Focused expression, intense breathing, aggressive forward posture. Wet asphalt shimmering with white and red reflections. Smooth stabilized camera movement with subtle cinematic float. Panel 9 — Final Hero Close-Up Ultra-realistic cinematic hero close-up of the female cyclist slowing slightly after the intense ride. Tight framing on her face and upper body. Baby pink helmet, soaked jacket, wet skin, rainwater dripping from chin and glasses. Red rear light flickering softly behind her, creating subtle red highlights on water droplets and facial contours. Calm but exhausted expression, visible breathing, cinematic low-key lighting, cold blue atmosphere, hyper-realistic detail, premium sports commercial ending shot.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个宽幅 9 宫格电影感分镜信息图。使用写实摄影风格，搭配温暖的电影色调。将分镜排列成整洁的 3x3 网格布局，包含编号面板、粗体标题、简短的项目符号，以及类似于专业电影制作分镜的流畅视觉叙事。面板 1 — 风暴中的双眼：超写实极端特写，展示一名女性骑行者在夜间暴雨中的面部。聚焦于她的眼睛、湿透的睫毛、湿润的皮肤纹理，以及流过脸庞的雨水。她戴着淡粉色的骑行头盔和淡粉色口罩。来自自行车尾灯的微弱红色反射在她的眼睛和皮肤上动态闪烁，与冷蓝色的夜色交织。高对比度电影光效，浅景深，超写实皮肤纹理，85mm 微距镜头，坚毅的表情。面板 2 — 激进的夜骑：超写实电影感中近景正面镜头，展示女性骑行者在夜间暴雨中激进骑行。她用力蹬踏，身体前倾。淡粉色防水骑行夹克在湿润的反光下微微发亮。自行车前灯穿透雨雾，轻微的闪烁营造出动态照明。湿润的沥青路面反射着红白光芒。流畅的电影级追踪镜头，动作稳定且带有自然的轻微晃动。面板 3 — 雨水冲击微距：超写实微距电影镜头，展示夜间大雨滴击中湿润沥青路面的瞬间。巨大的冠状水花、涟漪在水坑中扩散，慢动作呈现细腻的水物理效果。冷蓝色电影色调，带有自行车灯的微弱反射。极浅景深，粗糙的湿沥青纹理，戏剧性的夜间氛围。固定式稳定微距拍摄。面板 4 — 风暴中的三位骑行者：超写实电影镜头，展示三名女性公路骑行者在夜间暴雨中快速并排骑行。所有骑行者都穿着淡粉色骑行装备，与深蓝色的环境形成对比。用力蹬踏，车轮溅起水花，自行车灯照亮大雨。其中一盏车灯不规则地闪烁，在骑行者和湿润路面上产生不稳定的光影变化。从后方及侧后方进行平滑稳定的追踪拍摄。电影级动态模糊增强速度感。面板 5 — 压力下的传动系统：超写实微距电影特写，展示夜间暴雨中高强度骑行时的自行车传动系统。后飞轮、链条、变速器和牙盘在负荷下剧烈运动。蹬踏时部分可见淡粉色骑行鞋。水滴、油污和泥土溅在金属表面。闪烁的光线间歇性地扫过旋转的组件，在消失于黑暗前展现出锐利的机械细节。超写实的湿润纹理和反光。面板 6 — 俯视无人机编队：超写实无人机俯拍镜头，展示三名女性骑行者在夜间湿润的山路上以完美的单列纵队骑行。淡粉色夹克在深色反光沥青路面上清晰可见。完美的 90 度垂直角度，锁定构图，平滑稳定的无人机移动，无旋转或透视偏移。湿润路面反光，自行车灯下可见细雨，道路边缘环绕着大气雾气。面板 7 — 侧向追踪速度镜头：超写实电影侧向追踪镜头，展示女性骑行者在夜间雨雾中高速骑行。摄像机与她们平行移动，具有稳定的 FPV 风格电影运动感。淡粉色装备偶尔捕捉到闪烁车灯的亮点。轮胎溅起水花，雨丝划过画面，背景强烈的动态模糊强调了速度与耐力。面板 8 — 穿透黑暗的前灯：超写实电影正面镜头，展示领头的女性骑行者在暴雨和浓雾中径直朝摄像机骑来。她的自行车前灯在穿透黑暗时柔和地闪烁。淡粉色夹克被雨水浸透，水滴从车轮飞溅而出。专注的表情，急促的呼吸，激进的前倾姿势。湿润的沥青路面闪烁着白色和红色的反光。平滑稳定的摄像机移动，带有微妙的电影级浮动感。面板 9 — 最终英雄特写：超写实电影级英雄特写，展示女性骑行者在剧烈骑行后稍微减速。面部和上半身的紧凑构图。淡粉色头盔、湿透的夹克、湿润的皮肤，雨水从下巴和眼镜上滴落。红色的尾灯在她身后柔和闪烁，在水滴和面部轮廓上营造出微妙的红色高光。平静但疲惫的表情，可见的呼吸，电影级低调照明，冷蓝色氛围，超写实细节，高端运动广告的结尾镜头。

templates.title: Hand-Drawn Interactive Doodles

titleLocalized.zh: 手绘风格互动涂鸦

templates.prompt:
Analyze the uploaded image and preserve the original subject, composition, and lighting. Do not alter the identity or structure of the main subject. Add playful, hand-drawn doodles that interact directly with the subject in the image. The doodles should mimic, follow, or exaggerate the shapes, gestures, or motion present—such as outlining poses, extending limbs, adding motion lines, or creating imaginative elements that “respond” to the subject.(2)

Ensure the doodles feel naturally integrated into the scene, as if they were drawn on top of the photo with intention. Use a {argument name="style" default="sketchy, imperfect, hand-drawn"} style with organic lines, slightly uneven strokes, and a casual illustrated feel. Include whimsical handwritten text elements placed around the image. The text should match the mood or implied context of the scene, with a playful and spontaneous tone.(3) 

Avoid fixed phrases—generate context-aware, creative, and humorous text that fits each unique image. Maintain a balanced composition so the doodles enhance the image without overwhelming the original subject. Keep the overall aesthetic fun, expressive, and social-media-ready. High resolution, clean overlay, vibrant yet natural color harmony.

确保涂鸦与场景自然融合，仿佛是有意在照片上绘制的一样。使用 {argument name="style" default="sketchy, imperfect, hand-drawn"} 风格，线条要自然、笔触略显不规则，并带有随性的插画感。在图像周围加入俏皮的手写文字元素。文字应符合场景的情绪或隐含语境，语气要活泼且随性。(3)

templates.title: Extreme Low Angle Airplane Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 飞机超低角度人像摄影

templates.prompt:
Create a high-quality realistic photo, vertical format, cinematic style, high detail, dynamic scene with a strong sense of presence and intense air movement.
COMPOSITION AND CAMERA ANGLE:
The shot is taken from a very low point extreme low angle the camera is directed upward creating a sense of dominance and scale. In the center of the composition is a {argument name="subject" default="boy"} occupying the lower and middle part of the frame. Above his strictly along the central axis in the upper part of the frame is a huge {argument name="airplane type" default="passenger airplane"} flying at extremely low altitude. The airplane is seen from below its underside fuselage landing gear and two engines on the sides are visible. The perspective enhances the drama the airplane appears massive and looming directly above the subject. The frame is built so that the girl and the airplane form one vertical line strengthening the visual effect.

SCENE AND ATMOSPHERE:
An open outdoor space the sky occupies most of the background. The sky is partly cloudy with soft voluminous clouds the lighting is natural daylight. The atmosphere is tense dynamic with elements of action. Around the subject particles of dust small stones and debris are lifted into the air by the powerful airflow from the airplane engines. Turbulence is felt in the air all elements of the scene appear to be in motion. There is slight motion blur on flying particles creating a sense of speed.

CHARACTER:
A young man with expressive facial features and a calm confident charisma. The face is partially hidden by dark sunglasses with a large frame adding mystery. The skin looks natural with realistic texture. The lips are slightly closed the expression is calm confident and slightly defiant against the chaotic scene.

HAIR:
Stylish thick dark hair and to the sides by the strong airflow from the airplane. Individual strands lift upward creating a sense of chaotic motion and energy.

POSE AND BODY LANGUAGE:
The boy is sitting on an elevated surface such as a parapet concrete curb or platform edge. One leg is bent at the knee and pulled up with the foot placed on the surface. The other leg hangs down creating a relaxed asymmetrical pose. One hand rests on the raised knee the other hangs relaxed. The torso is slightly leaned forward shoulders relaxed the pose is confident and effortless showing control. The head is slightly raised the chin slightly up.

CLOTHING:
Casual style with a slightly rough aesthetic. he is wearing a {argument name="shirt style" default="plaid shirt in red blue white tones"}, Light blue jeans with ripped elements at the knees slightly loose fit. On his feet sneakers in the style of Converse with a recognizable shape and rubber sole. The clothing reacts to the wind fabric is slightly stretched and moving.

LIGHTING:
Natural daylight soft diffused by clouds without harsh shadows. Light contrast emphasizes textures of skin fabric and the metal surface of the airplane. Light falls from above and slightly from the front creating soft modeling of the face and body.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张高质量的写实照片，竖构图，电影质感，高细节，动态场景，具有强烈的临场感和剧烈的气流感。

构图与拍摄角度：
镜头采用极低的角度向上仰拍，营造出一种主导感和宏大的规模感。构图中心是 {argument name="subject" default="男孩"}，占据画面的下部和中部。在他的正上方，沿中心轴线，画面上部是一架巨大的 {argument name="airplane type" default="客机"} 在极低高度飞行。从下方观察飞机，可以看到其机腹、起落架以及两侧的两台发动机。透视效果增强了戏剧性，飞机显得极其庞大，仿佛直接笼罩在主体上方。画面布局使人物与飞机形成一条垂直线，强化了视觉冲击力。

场景与氛围：
开阔的户外空间，天空占据了大部分背景。天空多云，云层柔软蓬松，光线为自然日光。氛围紧张且充满动感，带有动作元素。在主体周围，飞机引擎产生的强大气流将灰尘、小石子和碎片卷入空中。空气中能感受到湍流，场景中的所有元素似乎都在运动。飞扬的颗粒带有轻微的运动模糊，营造出速度感。

人物：
一位面部特征鲜明、沉稳自信的年轻男性。脸部被一副大框深色墨镜部分遮挡，增添了一丝神秘感。皮肤看起来自然，具有真实的质感。嘴唇微闭，表情冷静、自信，在混乱的场景中显得有些不羁。

发型：
时尚的浓密深色头发，被强劲的气流吹向两侧。发丝向上飘动，营造出混乱的动感与能量。

姿势与肢体语言：
男孩坐在一处高起的表面上，例如护墙、混凝土路缘或平台边缘。一条腿膝盖弯曲，脚踩在表面上；另一条腿自然垂下，形成一种放松的非对称姿势。一只手放在抬起的膝盖上，另一只手自然下垂。躯干略微前倾，肩膀放松，姿势自信且从容，展现出掌控力。头部微抬，下巴微微上扬。

服装：
休闲风格，带有略显粗犷的美感。他穿着 {argument name="shirt style" default="红蓝白格纹衬衫"}，浅蓝色牛仔裤，膝盖处有破洞设计，版型略微宽松。脚穿 Converse 风格的运动鞋，鞋型辨识度高，带有橡胶底。服装随风摆动，面料略微拉伸并产生位移。

光线：
自然日光，被云层柔化，没有强烈的阴影。光影对比强调了皮肤、面料和飞机金属表面的质感。光线从上方及前方略微照射，对脸部和身体进行了柔和的塑形。

templates.title: Chinese Conceptual Poster Generator

templates.prompt: Based on the provided [Title], automatically generate a high-end Chinese conceptual poster. User only provides Title: {argument name="title content" default="Enter title here"}. Your task: Understand the theme, mood, social issues, and metaphors behind the title, then complete the visual design. Do not mechanically illustrate the title; translate it into a cinematic, magazine-style visual poster. 1. Style: High-end horizontal concept poster. Mood can range from social issues, psychological insights, humanity, intimacy, to workplace pressure. It should look like a deep-dive article cover or art exhibition visual. 2. Layout: Large title on the left/top, visual metaphor on the right/bottom. Strong relationship between text and image. High impact, memory points, and whitespace. Default to landscape 16:9, 4:3, or 3:1. 3. Typography: Main title must be huge and central. Subtitle generated automatically (max 24 characters) explaining the deep issue. Bottom tags (4-6) separated by vertical lines. Fonts matched to theme (Serif for social critique, bold Sans-serif for psychological insight). 4. Visual Metaphor: Use elements like broken statues, empty chairs, mirrors, night cityscapes, or medical images. Focus on 1 strong metaphor + 2-4 details. 5. Atmosphere: Low saturation, advanced lighting, cinematic grain, depth of emotion. No cute or bright internet template styles. 6. Output: A single high-res 4K complete poster in Chinese. No process explanation, just the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于提供的 [Title]，自动生成一张高端中文概念海报。用户仅需提供标题：{argument name="title content" default="在此输入标题"}。你的任务：理解标题背后的主题、情绪、社会议题及隐喻，随后完成视觉设计。不要机械地描绘标题，而是将其转化为电影杂志风格的视觉海报。1. 风格：高端横版概念海报。情绪可涵盖社会议题、心理洞察、人文关怀、亲密关系或职场压力等。视觉效果应类似于深度报道封面或艺术展览海报。2. 排版：左侧/上方放置大标题，右侧/下方放置视觉隐喻。文字与图像之间需建立强关联。强调视觉冲击力、记忆点及留白。默认为 16:9、4:3 或 3:1 的横向比例。3. 字体排版：主标题必须巨大且居中。自动生成副标题（最多 24 个字符）以阐述深层议题。底部标签（4-6 个）用竖线分隔。字体需与主题匹配（社会批判类使用衬线体，心理洞察类使用粗体无衬线体）。4. 视觉隐喻：使用破碎雕像、空椅子、镜子、夜间城市景观或医疗影像等元素。聚焦于 1 个核心隐喻 + 2-4 个细节。5. 氛围：低饱和度、高级光影、电影质感颗粒、深厚的情感深度。拒绝可爱或明亮的互联网模板风格。6. 输出：一张 4K 高分辨率的完整中文海报。无需解释过程，仅输出图像。

Prominently place large cinematic title text "{argument name="main title" default="Grand Theft Auto VI"}" on the poster, using typography inspired by official AAA video game promotional posters where the full version of "GTA" is explicitly written as "Grand Theft Auto." The font should feel bold, luxurious, modern, and naturally integrated into the poster design, supported by additional smaller decorative text, symbols, tags, and graphic UI-style elements to enhance the authentic game poster atmosphere. The subject must not replicate the exact pose from the reference photo. Create a completely fresh and visually more appealing pose with stronger body language, natural movement, and expressive emotion. The expression should feel vivid, charismatic, confident, and cinematic, rather than stiff, awkward, or flat. The pose must resemble the elegance and attitude of an international fashion model, combining stylish confidence with relaxed realism. Avoid static standing poses. Clothing should feature trendy modern casual fashion with luxury streetwear influences. The attire must feel stylish, youthful, and visually rich, avoiding flat or monotonous looks. Combine varied colors, layered clothing pieces, modern fabric textures, unique patterns, stylish accessories, and contemporary fashion details that complement the GTA VI-inspired vibe. The styling should feel premium, photogenic, and believable, resembling a mix of high-end editorial fashion and modern open-world video game aesthetics. Use cinematic lighting with realistic skin textures, detailed fabric rendering, atmospheric reflections, deeply rich environmental composition, balanced contrast, and ultra-sharp visual details. The poster should feel like official next-gen AAA game promotional art, featuring highly refined rendering quality, immersive visual storytelling, and professional graphic design execution. The image features: Eastern oppression, a cold and stern atmosphere, Chinese street style, high-end fashion magazine visuals, and a cinematic narrative vibe. The composition has high visual impact but remains sophisticated and uncluttered. Main Character (Core Focus): Do not copy reference poses. Redesign the character as a "Ming Dynasty Warrior" transported from ancient battlefields to a futuristic Eastern city. Temperament: cold, oppressive, composed yet dangerous, dignified, and possessing an emperor-like aura with a sense of 'quiet madness' from war. Expression: eyes full of story, indifferent with slight contempt, restrained but dangerous. No exaggerated shouting or traditional poses; it should have the 'effortless' feel of international fashion photography. Movement: natural and weighted, as if caught in a moment of slowly walking toward the camera. Clothing Design (Key Emphasis): Modern New Chinese Warrior outfit. Blending: Ming Dynasty Feiyu suit structure, modified capes, deconstructed Hanfu, Chinese stand-up collars, battle-worn layered fabrics, dragon embroidery, dark ink textures, Chinese frog buttons, functional techwear, Eastern armor details, metal straps, {argument name="clothing details" default="black and red tactical robes"}, and loose draping cuts. Style: "Ancient Eastern Warrior x High-End Streetwear x Asian Futurism". Visual Elements: Incorporate Chinese visual culture: dragon totems, giant black dragon silhouettes, cursive calligraphy, ink splashes, seal stamps, neon Hanzi, graffiti, vintage poster collages, flame patterns, deconstructed clouds, red-black-gold palette, rice paper textures, military symbols, and tattered flags. Background: Futuristic Eastern cyber-urban street: rainy neon alleys, Chinese neon signs, billboards, graffiti walls, damp ground reflections, and fog. Lighting: Cinematic lighting with high contrast, red rim lighting, gold highlights, cold black shadows, and neon contours. Overall feel: "A24 Film + Asian Luxury Ad + Chinese Chic Visual Experiment."

templates.title: Mediterranean Villa Film Panorama

titleLocalized.zh: 地中海别墅电影感全景图

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic photograph with a nostalgic analog film look, showing a sunlit {argument name="building style" default="white modernist stucco villa"} cropped across the lower left, with a deep shadowed balcony opening and thin vertical metal railing. In the foreground, dense {argument name="flower color" default="bright red"} flowering bougainvillea climbs along the roofline and lower edge, partially obscuring the architecture. On the right side, a tall {argument name="tree type" default="fan palm"} rises dramatically against a rich {argument name="sky color" default="deep cobalt blue"} cloudless sky. Use harsh Mediterranean midday sunlight, strong contrast, saturated colors, slight underexposure in shadows, soft lens blur at the edges, subtle film grain, faint dust specks, and a vintage slide-film or disposable-camera aesthetic. Compose the scene low-angle, with the building occupying the left half, the flowers across the lower center, and the palm filling the upper right, no people, no text, dreamy travel-photography mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 3:1 的超宽全景照片，呈现怀旧的模拟胶片质感。画面左下角截取阳光照射下的 {argument name="building style" default="白色现代主义灰泥别墅"}，配有深邃的阴影阳台开口和细长的垂直金属栏杆。前景中，茂密的 {argument name="flower color" default="鲜红色"} 三角梅沿屋顶线和下边缘攀爬，部分遮挡了建筑。右侧，一棵高大的 {argument name="tree type" default="扇叶棕榈"} 在浓郁的 {argument name="sky color" default="深钴蓝色"} 无云天空背景下显得格外引人注目。采用地中海正午强烈的阳光，强调高对比度和饱和色彩，阴影部分略微欠曝，边缘带有柔和的镜头模糊，并加入细微的胶片颗粒和淡淡的灰尘斑点，营造出复古幻灯片或一次性相机的审美。构图采用低角度，建筑占据左半部分，花卉横跨底部中心，棕榈树填充右上角，画面中无人、无文字，呈现梦幻般的旅行摄影氛围。

templates.title: Vintage Panoramic Poolside

titleLocalized.zh: 复古全景泳池

templates.prompt: Create a wide 3:1 cinematic photograph of a quiet outdoor swimming pool in harsh late-afternoon sunlight, shot from a slightly elevated angle looking diagonally across the pool edge. The composition is minimal and atmospheric: the right half is dark teal-blue still pool water, the lower left is a paved stone deck made of square gray tiles, and a pale cream pool coping runs diagonally from lower center toward the upper right. A stainless-steel U-shaped pool ladder with two arched rails sits near the center, bolted into the sunlit edge and descending into the water. Strong geometric shadows cut across the deck, with a large cool blue shadow occupying the left side and warm golden sunlight illuminating the pool rim and upper deck. Include a narrow reflected strip of sky or wall in the water near the top edge, soft film grain, slightly faded colors, subtle blur, and a nostalgic analog-photo look. Use {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:1 panoramic"}, {argument name="pool water color" default="deep teal blue"}, {argument name="lighting mood" default="harsh golden late-afternoon sunlight"}, {argument name="deck material" default="square gray stone tiles"}, and {argument name="camera style" default="soft vintage film photograph"}. No people, no text, no clutter, serene architectural poolside scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 3:1 宽画幅电影感照片，拍摄午后强烈的阳光下宁静的户外游泳池，视角略高，斜向俯瞰泳池边缘。构图极简且富有氛围感：右半部分是深青蓝色的静止池水，左下角是方形灰色石砖铺成的甲板，浅奶油色的泳池压顶从左下方向右上角斜向延伸。一个不锈钢 U 型泳池梯带有两个拱形扶手，位于中心附近，固定在阳光照射的边缘并延伸至水中。强烈的几何阴影切割着甲板，大面积的冷蓝色阴影占据左侧，温暖的金色阳光照亮了池沿和上层甲板。在顶部边缘附近的池水中加入一条狭窄的天空或墙壁倒影，呈现柔和的胶片颗粒感、略微褪色的色彩、细腻的模糊效果以及怀旧的模拟摄影质感。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:1 panoramic"}、{argument name="pool water color" default="deep teal blue"}、{argument name="lighting mood" default="harsh golden late-afternoon sunlight"}、{argument name="deck material" default="square gray stone tiles"} 以及 {argument name="camera style" default="soft vintage film photograph"}。画面中无人，无文字，无杂物，展现宁静的建筑风格泳池场景。

templates.title: Cinematic Desert Nomad at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的电影感沙漠游牧者

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic wide-angle desert landscape at golden hour: a lone {argument name="traveler" default="robed nomad"} seen from behind walks along the crest of a rippled sand dune, leaving a trail of footprints and a long shadow across the foreground. The figure wears flowing earth-toned robes and a wrapped headscarf, slightly backlit by the low sun. In the middle distance, show a small oasis with palm trees and a reflective pool nestled among rolling dunes. The background stretches into endless soft sand hills fading into atmospheric haze, with the bright {argument name="sun position" default="low sun near the upper right horizon"} casting warm orange and amber light over everything. Use photorealistic detail, shallow atmospheric perspective, dramatic cinematic composition, warm desert color grading, subtle lens glow, high dynamic range, natural textures in the sand, and a serene epic travel mood. Aspect ratio 16:9, no text, no borders.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黄金时刻的电影感广角沙漠景观：画面中，一位孤独的 {argument name="traveler" default="身穿长袍的游牧者"} 背对着镜头，沿着起伏的沙丘脊线行走，在前景留下了一串脚印和一道长长的影子。人物身着飘逸的大地色长袍，头戴缠头巾，在低垂的太阳照射下呈现出微微的逆光效果。在中景处，展示一个小小的绿洲，棕榈树和倒映着天空的水池坐落在连绵的沙丘之间。背景延伸至无尽的柔和沙丘，逐渐融入大气朦胧中，明亮的 {argument name="sun position" default="位于右上方地平线附近的低垂太阳"} 为一切笼罩上温暖的橙色和琥珀色光芒。采用照片级写实细节、浅景深大气透视、戏剧性的电影构图、温暖的沙漠色调分级、细腻的镜头光晕、高动态范围、自然的沙地纹理，以及宁静而史诗般的旅行氛围。长宽比 16:9，无文字，无边框。

templates.title: Cinematic Desert Oasis Traveler

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感沙漠绿洲旅人

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic wide shot of {argument name="subject" default="a weary desert traveler"} kneeling at the edge of a shallow oasis pool, leaning forward and cupping water in both hands to drink or wash their face. The subject wears layered, dusty, earth-toned nomadic robes, a wrapped turban, loose trousers, worn fabric scarves, and rough travel clothing, with wet hands and streams of water dripping back into the pool, creating small splashes and concentric ripples. The face is intentionally obscured by a plain dark brown square censor block centered over the head, while the body language remains intimate and exhausted. Set the scene in a lush desert oasis with {argument name="background setting" default="tall palm trees, reeds, shrubs, smooth stones, and reflective still water"}; the low {argument name="time of day" default="golden sunrise"} shines from the right side through the palms, creating warm backlight, lens glow, long shadows, misty atmosphere, and shimmering reflections on the water. Use a dramatic documentary film still style, ultra-realistic textures, shallow depth of field, warm amber and sepia color grading, high dynamic range, detailed fabric fibers, visible droplets, natural dust and grime, 16:9 composition, subject placed on the left foreground with the oasis stretching into the bright background, shot as if on a cinema camera with anamorphic softness and realistic environmental lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感十足的超写实广角镜头，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位疲惫的沙漠旅人"} 跪在浅浅的绿洲水池边，身体前倾，双手捧水饮用或洗脸。主体身着层叠、布满尘土的大地色系游牧长袍，缠着头巾，穿着宽松长裤、破旧的织物围巾及粗糙的旅行服饰；双手湿润，水流滴回池中，激起细小的水花和同心圆涟漪。主体的面部被一个位于头部的深棕色正方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，但肢体语言依然传达出亲密与疲惫感。场景设定在一片郁郁葱葱的沙漠绿洲中，背景包含 {argument name="background setting" default="高大的棕榈树、芦苇、灌木、光滑的石头和倒映着景色的静水"}；低垂的 {argument name="time of day" default="金色日出"} 从右侧穿过棕榈树照射进来，营造出温暖的逆光、镜头光晕、长长的阴影、朦胧的氛围以及水面上波光粼粼的倒影。采用戏剧性的纪录片电影剧照风格，超写实纹理，浅景深，温暖的琥珀色与深褐色调，高动态范围，细腻的织物纤维，清晰可见的水滴，自然的灰尘与污垢，16:9 构图，主体位于左侧前景，绿洲向明亮的背景延伸，拍摄效果如同使用电影摄影机，带有变形镜头的柔和感与真实的自然光影。

templates.title: Rainy Tabby Scooter Ride

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中骑行的橘猫

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, ultra-detailed single-scene image of a cute {argument name="animal" default="orange tabby cat"} riding a {argument name="scooter color" default="yellow"} vintage Vespa-style scooter through a rainy Japanese city street. The cat is upright like a tiny commuter, with realistic fluffy orange-and-white fur, wide expressive eyes, white paws on the handlebars, and a striped tail visible behind the scooter. It wears {argument name="accessories" default="large yellow headphones, a thick mustard-yellow scarf, a transparent hooded raincoat, a yellow tote bag, and yellow clogs"}. The scooter headlight is glowing warmly, water droplets bead on the clear raincoat and scooter body, and the wet asphalt reflects headlights and lane markings. The background shows a misty urban road with passing cars, guardrails, greenery, utility poles, and Japanese traffic signs softened by rain and shallow depth of field. Use cozy slice-of-life anime realism with Studio Ghibli-inspired warmth, photoreal fur detail, believable rain physics, soft gray overcast lighting, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, reflective roads, and 4K movie-quality detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感、超精细的单场景图像，画面中一只可爱的 {argument name="animal" default="橘猫"} 骑着一辆 {argument name="scooter color" default="黄色"} 的复古 Vespa 风格踏板车，穿行在日本雨后的城市街道上。猫咪像通勤者一样直立坐着，拥有逼真的橘白相间蓬松毛发、宽大且富有表现力的眼睛，白色的爪子握在车把上，身后露出一条条纹尾巴。它戴着 {argument name="accessories" default="一副大号黄色耳机、一条厚实的芥末黄围巾、一件透明连帽雨衣、一个黄色帆布袋，并穿着黄色木屐"}。踏板车的车灯发出温暖的光芒，水珠在透明雨衣和车身上凝结，湿漉漉的柏油路面反射着车灯和车道线。背景是朦胧的城市道路，有经过的汽车、护栏、绿植、电线杆以及被雨水和浅景深柔化的日本交通标志。采用温馨的日式生活写实风格，融合吉卜力工作室的温暖感，呈现照片级的毛发细节、真实的雨水物理效果、柔和的阴天光影、电影级构图、浅景深效果、路面反射以及 4K 电影级的画质细节。

templates.title: Futuristic Dark Samurai Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感暗黑武士肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic dark fantasy portrait of a futuristic samurai warrior standing in a smoky interior, framed from mid-torso upward and turned slightly three-quarters to the viewer's left. The warrior wears {argument name="armor color" default="matte black"} tactical samurai armor with layered shoulder plates, small metal charms and engraved plaques, leather straps, buckles, braided rope cords, and a chest plate marked with a {argument name="chest emblem" default="red horned crescent clan symbol"}. The helmet is a modernized kabuto with tall sweeping crescent antlers, a round crest medallion on the brow, scuffed black metal, and a full respirator gas mask with twin circular filters, angular face plating, and a dark tinted visor that hides the eyes. Use richly textured black brocade fabric under the armor, subtle red stitching and accents, worn edges, scratches, dust, and realistic metal reflections. Behind the figure, place one vertical red-orange banner on the left side with large blurred black Japanese calligraphy, reading {argument name="banner text" default="赤砂鬼"}, while the rest of the background fades into deep charcoal shadow. Atmosphere should be moody and cinematic with drifting smoke at the lower left, warm red rim light from the banner side, cool dim fill light from the right, shallow depth of field, high-detail photorealistic rendering, dramatic contrast, square composition, no visible face, no extra characters, no readable text except the banner calligraphy.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级暗黑奇幻风格的未来武士肖像，武士站在烟雾弥漫的室内，构图为半身像，身体向观众左侧略微转动。武士身着 {argument name="armor color" default="哑光黑"} 战术武士盔甲，配有层叠的肩甲、小型金属挂饰、雕刻铭牌、皮带、搭扣、编织绳索，胸甲上印有 {argument name="chest emblem" default="红色带角新月氏族徽章"}。头盔为现代化的兜鍪（kabuto），带有高耸的弧形新月鹿角，额头饰有圆形徽章，金属表面有磨损痕迹，并佩戴全覆盖式防毒面具，面具带有双圆形滤毒罐、棱角分明的面部护板以及遮住双眼的深色护目镜。盔甲下衬有质感丰富的黑色织锦面料，辅以精致的红色缝线和装饰，呈现出磨损边缘、划痕、灰尘以及逼真的金属反光。在人物后方左侧放置一面垂直的红橙色旗帜，上面印有模糊的黑色日文书法，内容为 {argument name="banner text" default="赤砂鬼"}，背景其余部分则融入深炭色的阴影中。整体氛围应 moody 且具有电影感，左下方有漂浮的烟雾，旗帜一侧有温暖的红色轮廓光，右侧有冷色调的暗淡补光，浅景深，高细节照片级渲染，戏剧性对比，方形构图，不可见人脸，无额外角色，除旗帜书法外无其他可读文字。

templates.title: Creepy VHS Bedroom Doorway Figure

titleLocalized.zh: 诡异 VHS 卧室门口人影

templates.prompt: Create a creepy found-footage still from a degraded 1990s VHS home video, showing a dark messy bedroom at night viewed from a low handheld camera angle. The room has dim reddish-brown walls, heavy black shadows, a white metal bed frame and rumpled bed on the left, a few indistinct posters on the wall, and an open wooden door on the right with hanging fabric or clothing. In the center doorway stands {argument name="subject" default="a motionless humanoid figure"} wearing {argument name="costume" default="a pale rabbit-eared hood or bunny mask silhouette"}, a patterned light jacket, dark high-waisted pants, and small pale shoes; the face is deliberately obscured by a flat rectangular censor-like blur, making the figure feel anonymous and unnatural. Use {argument name="lighting" default="very low light with weak camera flash falloff"}, muddy colors, crushed blacks, soft focus, film grain, analog scanlines, chromatic noise, slight lens distortion, vignette, and a black VHS border around the frame. The composition should feel accidental, eerie, and documentary rather than cinematic, like a single unsettling frame from a lost tape, with the doorway figure centered but partially swallowed by darkness.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张来自 20 世纪 90 年代退化 VHS 家庭录像的诡异“拾得录像”静帧，以低角度手持摄像机视角呈现夜晚昏暗凌乱的卧室。房间墙壁呈暗红褐色，阴影深重，左侧有一张白色金属床架和凌乱的床铺，墙上贴着几张模糊的海报，右侧是一扇敞开的木门，挂着布料或衣物。在中央门口站着 {argument name="subject" default="一个静止的人形身影"}，身穿 {argument name="costume" default="带有淡色兔耳兜帽或兔面具的轮廓"}、花纹浅色夹克、深色高腰裤和浅色小鞋；面部被刻意模糊成扁平的矩形遮挡，使该形象显得匿名且不自然。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="极低光照，伴随微弱的相机闪光灯衰减"}、浑浊的色彩、压暗的黑色、柔焦、胶片颗粒、模拟扫描线、色差噪点、轻微镜头畸变、暗角，并在画面周围添加黑色 VHS 边框。构图应呈现出偶然、怪异且纪实的感觉，而非电影感，就像是一盘失落录像带中令人不安的单帧画面，门口的人影居中但部分被黑暗吞没。

templates.title: Wooden Impossible City Knot

titleLocalized.zh: 木质“不可能”城市结

templates.prompt: Create a macro-lens studio photograph of a tabletop sculpture: a closed, continuous, self-intersecting impossible-city manifold shaped like a thick wooden knot or tangled torus, constructed entirely from pale, smooth architectural modeling wood. Uniformly map the urban center of {argument name="urban center" default="Chicago"} across every curved surface of the manifold, with the recognizable skyline, dense downtown blocks, gridded streets, raised rails, and bridge-like infrastructure physically extruded from the wood. Emphasize the spatial paradox that there is no true up direction: skyscrapers, rectangular buildings, street grids, and rail strips protrude inward into hollow openings, outward from the outer rim, and sideways along twisting bands simultaneously, while roads loop back onto themselves around the knot. The sculpture sits on a simple white gallery pedestal, undeniably small-scale and hand-built, with visible wood grain, precise laser-cut grooves, clean beveled edges, and miniature architectural details. Use pristine warm gallery illumination with sharp, complex intersecting shadows cast through the hollow gaps, a neutral taupe background, shallow depth of field, and a three-quarter view that reveals the central voids, overlapping ribbons, and impossible geometry. The mood is elegant, mathematical, architectural, and surreal, rendered as a highly realistic product-style museum photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张桌面雕塑的微距摄影棚照片：一个闭合、连续、自相交的“不可能”城市流形，形状如同一个粗壮的木结或缠绕的环面，完全由浅色、光滑的建筑模型木材制成。将 {argument name="urban center" default="芝加哥"} 的城市中心均匀映射到流形的每一个曲面上，标志性的天际线、密集的市中心街区、网格状街道、高架轨道以及桥梁般的基建结构均从木材中物理挤出。强调空间悖论，即没有真正的“向上”方向：摩天大楼、矩形建筑、街道网格和轨道条同时向内突出到空腔中、向外突出到外缘，并沿着扭曲的带状结构向侧面延伸，而道路则在结的周围循环闭合。雕塑放置在一个简单的白色画廊底座上，具有明显的微缩感和手工制作痕迹，可见木纹、精确的激光切割槽、干净的斜切边缘以及微型建筑细节。使用纯净的暖色调画廊照明，通过空隙投射出锐利且复杂的交叉阴影，背景为中性灰褐色，采用浅景深，并以四分之三视角呈现，展现出中心空洞、重叠的带状结构和不可能的几何形状。整体氛围优雅、严谨、具有建筑感且充满超现实色彩，呈现为一张高度写实的产品级博物馆摄影作品。

templates.title: Impossible Wooden Chicago Knot City

titleLocalized.zh: 不可能的木质芝加哥结城市

templates.prompt: Create a macro-lens photograph of an impossible tabletop sculpture: a closed, continuous, self-intersecting topological knot manifold physically constructed from pale, smooth architectural modeling wood. Uniformly map the urban center of {argument name="urban center" default="Chicago"} across the entire surface of the knot, extruding recognizable skyline towers, dense city blocks, gridded streets, bridges, rail lines, highways, and infrastructure directly from the wooden surface. Make the geometry paradoxical with no true up direction: buildings grow outward, inward into the hollow loops, sideways along the bands, and upside down beneath arches; roads and rail corridors wrap around the manifold and loop back into themselves infinitely. Emphasize Chicago-like landmarks including tall dark wooden skyscraper masses resembling Willis Tower and John Hancock Center with antenna spires, clustered downtown high-rises, river-bridge trusses, and elevated transit-like tracks integrated into the knot. The sculpture should form several interlocking torus-like loops with open hollow gaps, complex internal shadows, and dense miniature architectural detail on every visible surface. Use pristine gallery illumination with sharp intersecting shadows, a neutral gray gallery background, and a clean white square pedestal base to make the scale undeniably that of a handcrafted tabletop architectural model. Materials should be monochrome pale basswood or birch with fine laser-cut texture, tiny window grids, delicate etched roads, and layered wooden strips, photographed from a three-quarter front view with shallow macro depth of field, high realism, crisp detail, and no people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张微距摄影作品，拍摄一个不可能存在的桌面雕塑：一个由浅色、光滑的建筑模型木材手工打造的闭合、连续且自相交的拓扑结流形。将 {argument name="urban center" default="芝加哥"} 的城市中心均匀地映射在结的整个表面上，从木质表面直接挤压出清晰可见的城市天际线塔楼、密集的街区、网格状街道、桥梁、铁路线、高速公路和基础设施。使几何结构呈现出悖论感，没有真正的向上方向：建筑物向外生长，向内延伸至空心环中，沿着带状结构横向延伸，并在拱门下方倒置；道路和铁路走廊环绕着流形，并无限地循环回自身。强调类似芝加哥的地标，包括类似于威利斯大厦 (Willis Tower) 和约翰汉考克中心 (John Hancock Center) 带有天线塔的深色木质摩天大楼群、密集的市中心高层建筑、河桥桁架以及集成在结中的高架轨道。雕塑应形成几个相互交织的环面状圆环，带有开放的空心缝隙、复杂的内部阴影，以及在每个可见表面上密集的微型建筑细节。使用原始的画廊照明，呈现锐利的交叉阴影，搭配中性灰色的画廊背景和干净的白色方形底座，以确保其呈现出纯手工桌面建筑模型的比例。材质应为单色浅色椴木或桦木，具有精细的激光切割纹理、微小的窗格网格、精致的蚀刻道路和分层木条，以四分之三正面视角拍摄，具有浅微距景深、高真实感、清晰的细节，且画面中无人。

templates.title: Candid Classroom Friends Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: 课堂好友抓拍

templates.prompt: Create a candid 35mm disposable-camera style photo of {argument name="group description" default="four young adult women friends"} posing casually in an old Japanese classroom during daytime. The scene has exactly 4 people: one seated at the front left in a white off-shoulder ruffled crop top and denim mini skirt making a peace sign, one standing behind her in a pink fitted V-neck crop top and white pleated mini skirt making double peace signs, one seated center-right in a pale yellow off-shoulder top and black shorts leaning on a desk with one hand near her face, and one standing at the far right leaning forward on a desk in a light blue striped button-up shirt over a white mini skirt. Their faces are intentionally anonymized with soft rectangular blur masks. Use a nostalgic classroom setting with rows of wooden desks and chairs, beige metal lockers along the back wall, large open windows on the right with bright green trees outside, warm afternoon sunlight, dusty air, and a casual after-school atmosphere. Include visible desk objects: exactly 2 plastic drink bottles, 1 magazine with a glamorous cover on the front desk, 1 pink handbag, 1 black hair styling tool or case, 1 blue-covered book on the right desk, and small stationery items. Compose the shot as a wide horizontal snapshot from slightly above desk height with mild wide-angle distortion, tilted framing, natural clutter, film grain, soft focus, harsh flash highlights mixed with window light, muted colors, and realistic analog imperfections. The overall mood should feel like an unposed vacation snapshot among friends in a classroom, fashionable and playful but photorealistic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 35mm 一次性胶片相机风格的抓拍照片，展示 {argument name="group description" default="四位年轻女性好友"} 在日式旧教室中白天的随意摆拍。场景中共有 4 人：一人坐在左前方，身穿白色露肩荷叶边短上衣和牛仔短裙，比着剪刀手；一人站在她身后，身穿粉色修身 V 领短上衣和白色百褶短裙，比着双剪刀手；一人坐在中右侧，身穿淡黄色露肩上衣和黑色短裤，单手托腮靠在课桌上；一人站在最右侧，身穿浅蓝色条纹衬衫搭配白色短裙，身体前倾靠在课桌上。她们的面部均经过柔和的矩形模糊处理，以实现匿名化。使用怀旧的教室背景，包含成排的木制课桌椅、后墙上的米色金属储物柜、右侧宽大的开窗以及窗外翠绿的树木，呈现温暖的午后阳光、空气中的微尘以及随性的放学后氛围。画面中包含清晰可见的课桌物品：2 个塑料饮料瓶、前排课桌上 1 本封面华丽的杂志、1 个粉色手提包、1 个黑色美发工具或收纳盒、右侧课桌上 1 本蓝色封面的书以及少量文具。构图采用略高于课桌高度的宽幅横向抓拍，带有轻微的广角畸变、倾斜的取景、自然的杂乱感、胶片颗粒、柔焦效果，以及闪光灯与窗外光线交织的强光效果，色彩柔和，呈现真实的模拟摄影瑕疵。整体氛围营造出一种好友在教室中不经意间的度假感抓拍，既时尚俏皮又具备照片级的真实感。

templates.title: Candid Classroom Friends Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: 课堂好友抓拍照片

templates.prompt: Create a realistic candid 35mm film photograph of {argument name="number of friends" default="four"} adult women posing together in an old classroom, seated close behind wooden school desks in front of tall sunlit windows and gray metal lockers. The mood is casual, like a snapshot taken during a break, with soft natural daylight, slight wide-angle perspective, visible film grain, muted colors, and a slightly messy environment with chairs, bags, notebooks, magazines, plastic water bottles, and stationery scattered on the desks in the foreground. Count the four people from left to right: 1) a woman leaning in with long dark hair, a white short-sleeve crop top with ruffled neckline, and a light blue denim mini skirt, raising one hand near her head; 2) a woman with medium brown hair wearing a fitted {argument name="center outfit color" default="pink"} crop top and a white pleated mini skirt, making a peace sign; 3) a woman with short dark bob hair wearing a pale yellow strapless crop top and a black mini skirt, raising a peace sign behind the group; 4) a woman with hair tied up wearing an open light blue shirt tied at the waist over a low neckline and a white mini skirt, making a peace sign. Pose them shoulder-to-shoulder in a friendly group-photo composition, facing the camera, with their faces intentionally covered by square pixelated mosaic blur blocks for privacy. Use a Japanese schoolroom or clubroom atmosphere, worn wooden desks, metal locker cabinets, large windows with bright overexposed exterior light, realistic skin texture, natural body proportions, casual styling, and an authentic disposable-camera look. Avoid glamour studio lighting; make it feel like an unpolished real-life snapshot.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的 35mm 胶片抓拍照片，展示 {argument name="number of friends" default="四位"} 成年女性在旧教室中聚在一起，坐在木质课桌后，背景是高大的阳光窗户和灰色金属储物柜。氛围随意，如同课间休息时的抓拍，带有柔和的自然日光、轻微的广角透视、可见的胶片颗粒、柔和的色调，以及略显杂乱的环境，前景的课桌上散落着椅子、包袋、笔记本、杂志、塑料水瓶和文具。从左到右数这四个人：1) 一位留着深色长发、身穿白色短袖荷叶边露脐上衣和浅蓝色牛仔短裙的女性，一只手举在头边；2) 一位留着中长棕色头发、身穿修身 {argument name="center outfit color" default="粉色"} 露脐上衣和白色百褶短裙的女性，正在比剪刀手；3) 一位留着深色短波波头、身穿浅黄色抹胸露脐上衣和黑色短裙的女性，在人群后方比剪刀手；4) 一位扎着头发、身穿敞开式浅蓝色衬衫（腰间打结，内搭低领上衣）和白色短裙的女性，正在比剪刀手。让她们肩并肩组成友好的合影构图，面向镜头，面部刻意用方形像素马赛克模糊块遮挡以保护隐私。营造日本教室或社团活动室的氛围，使用磨损的木桌、金属储物柜、带有明亮过曝室外光的大窗户，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、自然的身体比例、随意的造型以及地道的胶片相机质感。避免使用影棚灯光，使其看起来像是一张未经修饰的真实生活抓拍。

The lake should dominate the foreground, reflecting the entire castle, moonlight, bridge, windows, and towers in shimmering horizontal pixelated ripples. Use a nostalgic VGA pixel-art aesthetic inspired by classic Sierra point-and-click adventure games, with crisp dithering, limited but vibrant blue-purple palette, luminous highlights, high contrast, painterly pixel clusters, romantic fantasy atmosphere, and no modern UI or text.

templates.title: Gritty Claude Prompts Carousel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Gritty Claude Prompts 轮播图封面

templates.prompt: Create a square gritty social media carousel cover poster on aged beige paper with a distressed photocopy/zine aesthetic. The composition has 1 central black-and-white taped photograph, scratched and worn, with a wide gray paint smear obscuring the face; 2 pieces of yellowed masking tape hold it down, one horizontal strip at the top and one torn vertical strip on the right edge. Add 1 large hand-drawn red starburst scribble in the upper left, and use rough stamped typography layered over torn paper scraps. The main headline reads “{argument name="headline text" default="CLAUDE PROMPTS"}” in huge distressed black uppercase letters across the center, partially overlapping the photo. Add the small word “EVERY” above the bottom headline, then a massive red stamped word “{argument name="emphasis word" default="BEGINNER"}” across the lower middle, followed by “NEEDS” in black on the lower right. Include the subtitle “{argument name="subtitle text" default="A STARTER PACK FOR REAL LIFE"}” centered near the bottom in small typewriter-style uppercase letters. Add tiny handwritten footer text “{argument name="footer label" default="CLAUDE • BEGINNER PROMPTS"}” at bottom left, “SWIPE →” at bottom right, and a small page indicator “{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 12"}” in the top right. Use a limited palette of dirty beige, black ink, gray paint, and deep red, with torn edges, ink smudges, rough halftone texture, scratches, tape shadows, and imperfect alignment; make it feel like an underground punk flyer repurposed as a bold AI prompt carousel thumbnail.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个方形的颓废风社交媒体轮播图封面海报，背景为陈旧的米色纸张，呈现出一种复印件/杂志的粗糙美学。构图中心是一张黑白胶带粘贴的照片，照片有刮痕和磨损，并用大面积的灰色油漆涂抹遮挡了面部；照片由两块泛黄的遮蔽胶带固定，上方是一条水平胶带，右侧边缘是一条撕裂的垂直胶带。在左上角添加一个巨大的手绘红色星形涂鸦，并使用层叠在撕裂纸片上的粗糙印章字体。主标题为“{argument name="headline text" default="CLAUDE PROMPTS"}”，采用巨大的黑色颓废风大写字母横跨中心，部分覆盖在照片上。在底部标题上方添加小字“EVERY”，接着在下方中间位置添加一个巨大的红色印章词“{argument name="emphasis word" default="BEGINNER"}”，右下角添加黑色的“NEEDS”。在底部附近居中添加副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="A STARTER PACK FOR REAL LIFE"}”，使用小型打字机风格的大写字母。在左下角添加微小的手写页脚文字“{argument name="footer label" default="CLAUDE • BEGINNER PROMPTS"}”，右下角添加“SWIPE →”，并在右上角添加一个小型的页面指示器“{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 12"}”。使用脏米色、黑色墨水、灰色油漆和深红色的有限调色板，并加入撕裂边缘、墨迹、粗糙的半色调纹理、划痕、胶带阴影和不完美的对齐效果；使其看起来像是一张被重新利用为大胆的 AI 提示词轮播图缩略图的地下朋克传单。

templates.title: Dark Neon Carousel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 深色霓虹轮播图封面

templates.prompt: Create a square 1:1 social media carousel cover with a premium dark tech aesthetic on a nearly black background. Use huge bold uppercase condensed sans-serif typography aligned left in stacked lines reading “{argument name="headline text" default="60 CLAUDE PROMPTS EVERY BEGINNER NEEDS"}”, with the words “60” and “BEGINNER” in vivid glowing orange and the remaining words in bright white. Beneath the headline, add a small widely spaced uppercase subtitle reading “{argument name="subtitle text" default="A STARTER PACK FOR REAL LIFE"}” in pale peach. Add a tiny footer label at bottom left reading “{argument name="footer text" default="CLAUDE · BEGINNER PROMPTS"}” and a bottom-right call to action reading “{argument name="call to action" default="SWIPE →"}” in orange. Include exactly 3 large soft blurred orange-red gradient orb shapes: one partial crescent orb entering from the upper right, one partial hot pink/orange glow entering from the lower right edge, and one small pink glow peeking from the left edge. Include exactly 1 orange outlined eight-point asterisk icon above the headline on the left. Add exactly 4 thin white corner crop marks, one in each corner, plus a small page indicator at the top right reading “{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 12"}”. Overall style: high-contrast black, neon orange glow, clean editorial grid, sharp modern startup branding, minimal futuristic UI details, crisp typography, professional carousel thumbnail design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 1:1 的方形社交媒体轮播图封面，采用近乎黑色的背景，呈现高级的深色科技美学。使用巨大的粗体大写压缩无衬线字体，左对齐并分行排列，文字内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="60 CLAUDE PROMPTS EVERY BEGINNER NEEDS"}”，其中“60”和“BEGINNER”使用鲜艳的橙色发光效果，其余文字使用亮白色。在标题下方，添加一行字间距较宽的小号大写副标题，内容为“{argument name="subtitle text" default="A STARTER PACK FOR REAL LIFE"}”，颜色为淡桃色。在左下角添加一个微小的页脚标签，内容为“{argument name="footer text" default="CLAUDE · BEGINNER PROMPTS"}”，右下角添加橙色的行动号召语“{argument name="call to action" default="SWIPE →"}”。包含 3 个巨大的柔和模糊橙红色渐变球体：一个部分新月形球体从右上角切入，一个部分热粉色/橙色光晕从右下边缘切入，以及一个小粉色光晕从左侧边缘露出。在标题左上方包含 1 个橙色轮廓的八角星图标。在四个角各添加 1 个细白色角标裁剪标记，并在右上角添加一个小的页面指示器，内容为“{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 12"}”。整体风格：高对比度黑色、霓虹橙色光晕、简洁的编辑网格、锐利的现代初创公司品牌感、极简的未来主义 UI 细节、清晰的排版、专业的轮播图缩略图设计。

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 widescreen PowerPoint cover slide in an elegant Chinese traditional craft presentation style, with an ivory rice-paper background, dark teal and gold ornamental border, and decorative Chinese corner brackets. The main headline on the left is large dark blue Chinese calligraphy text reading {argument name="headline text" default="掐丝珐琅"}, with a smaller gold subtitle underneath reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="火与金线中的东方华彩"}. Below it, place a centered rounded label plaque with teal text reading {argument name="section label" default="传统工艺主题分享"}, and a small explanatory line near the lower left reading {argument name="footer note" default="认识一种以金属胎、细丝与珐琅釉色共同构成的华美工艺"}. In the top-right corner, add a small ornate dark teal page indicator reading {argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 10"}. On the right half, feature a highly detailed blue-and-gold cloisonné enamel vase on a dark wooden stand, decorated with lotus flowers, green lotus leaves, curling gold wire patterns, turquoise accents, and ornate gold handles. The tabletop foreground contains exactly 7 discrete craft objects: 1 coil of gold wire, 1 flat cloisonné floral medallion, 1 gold key-shaped ornament, 1 fine metalworking brush or stylus, and 4 small bowls of enamel powder in blue, green, turquoise, and white/gold. Add pale ink-wash mountains, a distant pavilion, soft lotus line art, and floating auspicious cloud motifs in the background. Use a refined museum-course aesthetic, realistic product rendering mixed with delicate Chinese illustration, harmonious cream, deep navy, turquoise, and metallic gold palette, crisp typography, balanced negative space, premium educational PPT title-slide composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 宽屏 PowerPoint 封面幻灯片，采用优雅的中国传统工艺演示风格，背景为象牙色宣纸质感，配有深青色与金色的装饰边框及中式角花。左侧主标题为醒目的深蓝色中式书法字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="掐丝珐琅"}，下方配有较小的金色副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="火与金线中的东方华彩"}。在其下方放置一个居中的圆角标签牌，文字为青色，内容为 {argument name="section label" default="传统工艺主题分享"}；左下角添加一行简短的说明文字 {argument name="footer note" default="认识一种以金属胎、细丝与珐琅釉色共同构成的华美工艺"}。右上角添加一个精致的深青色页码指示器，内容为 {argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 10"}。右半部分展示一个细节极其丰富的蓝金景泰蓝花瓶，置于深色木质底座上，瓶身装饰有莲花、绿色荷叶、卷曲的金丝纹样、绿松石色点缀及华丽的金色把手。桌面前景包含 7 件精细的工艺物件：1 卷金丝、1 个扁平的景泰蓝花卉奖章、1 个钥匙形状的金色饰品、1 支精细的金属工艺笔或触针，以及 4 个分别盛有蓝色、绿色、绿松石色和白/金色珐琅粉末的小碗。背景融入淡雅的水墨山水、远处的凉亭、柔和的莲花线条画以及漂浮的祥云纹样。采用精致的博物馆课程美学，将写实的产品渲染与细腻的中国插画相结合，配色采用和谐的奶油色、深海军蓝、绿松石色与金属金，排版清晰，负空间平衡，呈现出高端教育类 PPT 标题幻灯片的构图。

templates.title: Gothic Maid Acrobatic Kick

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特女仆杂技踢腿

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic vertical anime action illustration of a {argument name="character type" default="pink-haired gothic lolita maid girl"} performing an acrobatic one-handed breakdance handstand kick inside a grand European palace ballroom. The camera is extremely low near the polished marble floor, looking upward with dramatic foreshortening: one booted leg thrusts close to the viewer and is heavily motion-blurred, the other leg extends backward, while one hand presses on the reflective floor and the character looks toward the viewer with a confident fierce expression. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="rose pink"} twin-tail hair whipping through the air, green eyes, frilly white maid headband, and an ornate {argument name="outfit color" default="deep emerald green"} gothic lolita maid dress with puff sleeves, ruffled white lace trim, corset-like bodice, bows, layered skirt, stockings, and lace-up heeled boots. Add bright white circular speed trails and arcing wind ribbons around her spinning body to emphasize high-speed action. The environment is a luxurious sunlit ballroom with tall arched windows on both sides, gilded wall details, high ceiling, chandeliers, dust motes, shafts of light, and glossy patterned marble reflections. Use cinematic lighting, extreme perspective, intense motion blur, sharp focus on the face and supporting hand, detailed fabric folds and lace, elegant fantasy anime rendering, high detail, vertical composition, dramatic action energy, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动态的竖版动漫动作插画，描绘一位 {argument name="character type" default="粉色头发的哥特洛丽塔女仆女孩"} 在宏伟的欧洲宫殿舞厅内表演杂技式单手街舞倒立踢腿。相机视角极低，贴近抛光大理石地面，以戏剧性的透视效果向上仰拍：一只穿着靴子的腿猛然踢向观众方向并带有强烈的动态模糊，另一条腿向后伸展，同时一只手撑在反光地面上，角色带着自信而凌厉的表情看向观众。她拥有随风飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="玫瑰粉色"} 双马尾长发、绿色双眸、荷叶边白色女仆发带，身着华丽的 {argument name="outfit color" default="深祖母绿色"} 哥特洛丽塔女仆裙，配有泡泡袖、白色蕾丝花边装饰、紧身胸衣式上衣、蝴蝶结、多层裙摆、长筒袜和系带高跟靴。在旋转的身体周围添加明亮的白色圆形速度线和弧形风带，以强调高速动作。环境为奢华且阳光明媚的舞厅，两侧有高大的拱形窗户，墙壁带有镀金细节，天花板高耸，悬挂着吊灯，空气中漂浮着尘埃，光束穿透其中，地面反射出光亮的大理石花纹。采用电影级布光、极端透视、强烈的动态模糊、面部与支撑手部清晰对焦、细腻的布料褶皱与蕾丝细节、优雅的奇幻动漫渲染风格、高细节、竖构图、充满戏剧性的动作张力，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Graphic School Trip Schedule Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 图形化修学旅行日程海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference timetable sheet, transform it into a bold contemporary graphic travel poster / magazine-spread design while preserving the overall school-trip schedule structure and key itinerary information. Replace the plain document layout with a dynamic diagonal composition, oversized brush-calligraphy Japanese headline {argument name="headline text" default="旅のしおり"}, and smaller title text for a {argument name="trip duration" default="2泊3日"} trip toward {argument name="destination area" default="関西方面"}. Organize the schedule into exactly 3 large vertical day sections: Day 01 Kyoto, Day 02 Nara / Osaka, and Day 03 Osaka, keeping the times and main activities from the reference but typesetting them as clean poster text with a thin timeline line. Add high-contrast neon accent graphics in hot pink, cyan, yellow, blue, green, and purple, with angular triangles, paint splashes, speed lines, halftone textures, arrows, scribbles, and collage-like overlays. Add photographic/illustrated travel imagery not present in the reference: temples and shrine architecture for Kyoto, a deer for Nara, Osaka Castle, a busy Osaka street scene, and Tsutenkaku/tower imagery, integrated as tilted monochrome or duotone cutout panels. Include small English slogan text such as "SCHOOL TRIP 2024", "MOVE. SEE. FEEL. JOURNEY.", "NO PLAN NO LIFE JUST GO.", and day-theme labels like HISTORY, PAST & PRESENT, and FREEDOM. Keep a mostly off-white paper background, black typography, energetic editorial street-design styling, and make the final result look like a polished youth travel booklet cover/schedule poster rather than a formal handout.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考时间表，将其转化为大胆且现代的图形化旅行海报或杂志排版设计，同时保留修学旅行的整体日程结构和关键行程信息。将原本平淡的文档布局替换为动态的对角线构图，使用超大号毛笔书法风格的日语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="旅のしおり"}，以及针对 {argument name="trip duration" default="2泊3日"} 前往 {argument name="destination area" default="関西方面"} 旅行的小标题。将日程精确划分为 3 个大型垂直日期板块：Day 01 京都、Day 02 奈良 / 大阪、Day 03 大阪，保留参考资料中的时间和主要活动，但以简洁的海报文本形式排版，并配以细线条的时间轴。添加高对比度的霓虹色调装饰图形，包括亮粉色、青色、黄色、蓝色、绿色和紫色，并融入尖角三角形、泼墨效果、速度线、半调纹理、箭头、涂鸦以及拼贴风格的覆盖层。添加参考资料中未包含的摄影或插画类旅行图像：京都的寺庙与神社建筑、奈良的鹿、大阪城、繁华的大阪街景以及通天阁/塔楼图像，以倾斜的单色或双色调剪裁面板形式呈现。加入简短的英文标语，如 "SCHOOL TRIP 2024"、"MOVE. SEE. FEEL. JOURNEY."、"NO PLAN NO LIFE JUST GO."，以及如 HISTORY、PAST & PRESENT 和 FREEDOM 等日期主题标签。背景主要采用米白色纸张质感，搭配黑色字体，呈现出充满活力的编辑类街头设计风格，使最终成品看起来像是一份精致的青年旅行手册封面或日程海报，而非正式的讲义。

templates.title: Manga School Trip Timetable

titleLocalized.zh: 漫画风修学旅行时间表

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source timetable, transform the plain printed school-trip schedule into a dramatic black-and-white Japanese manga page. Keep the same overall trip concept, the 3-day structure, and the main Japanese schedule information, but replace the formal table with an action-manga comic layout full of heavy ink, speed lines, halftone shading, rough paper texture, splatter effects, thick panel borders, and cinematic perspective. Use a large brush-calligraphy headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="修学旅行 タイムスケジュール"}, with a dark subtitle ribbon reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="関西方面　2泊3日"}. Add a gritty manga protagonist close-up in the top-right Day 1 area and convert the schedule into exactly 20 illustrated event panels plus 3 day-title cards: Day 1 has 9 event panels labeled 06:30 school gathering/departure, 08:00 bullet train boarding, 10:30 Kyoto Station arrival, 11:30 Kiyomizu-dera visit, 14:30 Kinkaku-ji visit, 15:45 Fushimi Inari Taisha visit, 17:15 hotel transfer, 19:00 dinner, 20:00 group meeting; Day 2 has 6 event panels labeled 09:30 Todai-ji visit, 12:30 Nara Park walk, 13:30 Osaka Castle visit, 15:00 aquarium visit, 17:30 Dotonbori free walk/dinner, 20:00 hotel return/bath; Day 3 has 5 event panels labeled 09:30 group independent study begins, 12:30 lunch by group, 14:00 Shin-Osaka meeting/roll call, 15:00 bullet train boarding, 18:00 school arrival/dismissal. For each panel, depict the corresponding location or activity with manga-style crowds, trains, temples, city streets, food, or hotel scenes instead of the original plain text rows. Include small Japanese speech bubbles and narration boxes for energy, while keeping the schedule labels legible. End with a bold handwritten bottom slogan reading {argument name="bottom slogan" default="見て、感じて、考えろ。それが、この旅のすべてだ。"}. Overall style: {argument name="manga style" default="gritty seinen travel manga, monochrome ink, high contrast, vintage print texture"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为原始时间表，将平淡的打印版修学旅行日程转化为极具戏剧性的黑白日本漫画页面。保留原有的旅行概念、3 天行程结构以及主要的日文日程信息，但将正式的表格替换为充满浓重墨色、速度线、网点阴影、粗糙纸张纹理、喷溅效果、粗边框和电影般透视感的动作漫画布局。使用大号毛笔书法标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="修学旅行 タイムスケジュール"}，并配以深色副标题丝带，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="関西方面　2泊3日"}。在右上角的第 1 天区域添加一个硬核漫画风格的主角特写，并将日程转换为 20 个插画事件分镜格以及 3 张日期标题卡：第 1 天包含 9 个事件分镜格，标注为 06:30 学校集合/出发、08:00 乘坐新干线、10:30 到达京都站、11:30 参观清水寺、14:30 参观金阁寺、15:45 参观伏见稻荷大社、17:15 酒店接送、19:00 晚餐、20:00 小组会议；第 2 天包含 6 个事件分镜格，标注为 09:30 参观东大寺、12:30 奈良公园散步、13:30 参观大阪城、15:00 参观水族馆、17:30 道顿堀自由活动/晚餐、20:00 返回酒店/沐浴；第 3 天包含 5 个事件分镜格，标注为 09:30 小组自主学习开始、12:30 小组午餐、14:00 新大阪站集合/点名、15:00 乘坐新干线、18:00 到达学校/解散。对于每个分镜格，用漫画风格的人群、列车、寺庙、城市街道、美食或酒店场景来描绘相应的地点或活动，而非使用原本平淡的文字行。加入小巧的日文对话气泡和旁白框以增加活力，同时保持日程标签清晰易读。最后以醒目的手写底部标语结尾，内容为 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="見て、感じて、考えろ。それが、この旅のすべてだ。"}。整体风格：{argument name="manga style" default="gritty seinen travel manga, monochrome ink, high contrast, vintage print texture"}。

Replace the clean worksheet layout with aged beige paper, heavy black ink, distressed halftone texture, bold red-and-black typography, diagonal banners, and revolutionary poster composition. Add a large top headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="修学旅行"} with the subheading {argument name="subheading text" default="タイムスケジュール"}, plus a black banner for {argument name="region label" default="関西方面　2泊3日"}. Split the itinerary into exactly 3 visible schedule panels labeled DAY 1 京都, DAY 2 奈良・大阪, and DAY 3 大阪, keeping the times and activities from the reference legible in each panel. Add propaganda-style supporting imagery not present in the reference: crowds of uniformed students/workers, raised fists, red flags, industrial smokestacks, dramatic city silhouettes, castle illustrations, and a red fist emblem in a star at the lower right. Add exactly 3 slogan areas: a red speech-banner at the upper right reading {argument name="top slogan" default="学ぶことは変えること！団結する者が、未来をつくる！われらの力で、歴史をすすめよ！"}, a large lower-left slogan block reading {argument name="bottom slogan" default="労働する者は団結せよ！学び、考え、行動せよ！未来はわれらの手にある！"}, and a bottom notice box titled 注意事項 with concise school-trip rules. promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为源文档，将普通的修学旅行时间表转换为极具戏剧性的复古社会主义宣传海报风格，同时保留原有的 2 晚 3 天日程内容及日文行程结构。将整洁的工作表布局替换为做旧的米色纸张、厚重的黑色油墨、磨损的半色调纹理、醒目的红黑字体、斜向横幅以及革命海报构图。添加一个醒目的顶部大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="修学旅行"}，副标题为 {argument name="subheading text" default="タイムスケジュール"}，并为 {argument name="region label" default="関西方面　2泊3日"} 添加一个黑色横幅。将行程分为 3 个清晰可见的日程板块，分别标注为 DAY 1 京都、DAY 2 奈良・大阪 和 DAY 3 大阪，并确保参考文档中的时间和活动在每个板块中清晰可辨。添加参考文档中未包含的宣传风格辅助图像：身着制服的学生/工人人群、高举的拳头、红旗、工业烟囱、戏剧性的城市剪影、城堡插画，以及右下角五角星中的红色拳头标志。添加 3 个标语区域：右上角红色演讲横幅，内容为 {argument name="top slogan" default="学ぶことは変えること！団結する者が、未来をつくる！われらの力で、歴史をすすめよ！"}；左下角大型标语块，内容为 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="労働する者は団結せよ！学び、考え、行動せよ！未来はわれらの手にある！"}；以及底部标题为 注意事項 的通知框，列出简洁的修学旅行规则。使海报呈现出扫描后的、磨损的、高对比度孔版印刷/木刻宣传画质感，以红色为主要强调色，并用黑色边框分隔 3 个日程板块。

templates.title: Minimal Clay Animal Trio

titleLocalized.zh: 极简粘土动物三人组

templates.prompt: Create a simple minimalist 3D clay-style illustration of {argument name="three animals" default="a panda, a penguin, and a gray cat"} sitting side by side on a matte beige floor against a plain off-white corner wall. The scene contains exactly 3 cute rounded animals: 1 panda on the left with a white round head, black ears, black eye patches, small black nose and mouth, black arms and legs, sitting with one arm across its belly; 1 penguin in the center with a navy-black outer body, white face and belly, tiny black eyes, a small orange beak, orange feet, and flipper-like wings hanging down; 1 gray cat on the right sitting upright with pointed ears, black dot eyes, small nose and mouth, three whiskers on each side, front paws indicated by subtle lines, and a curved tail resting on the floor. Use soft plush-toy proportions, smooth rounded geometry, no outlines except simple facial marks, muted colors, gentle ambient lighting, very soft shadows, lots of empty negative space above the characters, a calm Scandinavian children’s-room aesthetic, front-facing camera at low eye level, square composition, clean and uncluttered.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简单的极简 3D 粘土风格插画，描绘 {argument name="three animals" default="一只熊猫、一只企鹅和一只灰色小猫"} 并排坐在哑光米色地板上，背景是纯净的灰白色墙角。场景中包含 3 只圆润可爱的动物：左侧是一只熊猫，有着白色的圆脑袋、黑色的耳朵、黑色的眼圈、小巧的黑色鼻子和嘴巴、黑色的四肢，坐姿是一只手横在腹部；中间是一只企鹅，有着深蓝黑色的外表、白色的脸和腹部、细小的黑眼睛、小巧的橙色喙、橙色的脚以及下垂的鳍状翅膀；右侧是一只灰色小猫，直立坐着，有着尖耳朵、黑点眼睛、小巧的鼻子和嘴巴、两侧各有三根胡须、用细线勾勒出的前爪，以及一条弯曲在地面上的尾巴。使用柔软的毛绒玩具比例、平滑的圆润几何形状，除了简单的面部标记外没有轮廓线，采用柔和的色彩、温和的环境光、非常柔和的阴影，角色上方留有大量的负空间，营造出宁静的斯堪的纳维亚儿童房美学，采用低视角的正面相机拍摄，方形构图，画面干净整洁。

Use a cute toy-like 3D rendered style with realistic fur fibers, gentle rim light, shallow depth of field, golden backlighting, soft shadows on the ground, cozy nursery-like atmosphere, centered composition, high detail, cinematic warmth, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温馨且光影柔和的工作室肖像，三只可爱的毛绒质感幼崽并排坐在米色地板上，背景为平滑的米色：左侧是一只坐着的 {argument name="left animal" default="幼年大熊猫"}，拥有黑白相间的毛茸茸皮毛、圆耳朵和短粗的爪子，其面部被一个平坦的不透明棕褐色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖；中间是一只站立的小 {argument name="center animal" default="幼年企鹅"}，有着奶油色的蓬松腹部、深棕黑色的背部和头部、小巧的橙色喙和脚、亮黑色的眼睛，以及垂在身体两侧圆润的鳍状肢；右侧是一只坐姿端正的 {argument name="right animal" default="浅米色小猫"}，拥有圆圆的大眼睛、小耳朵、柔软的短毛、清晰可见的胡须和卷曲的尾巴。采用可爱的玩具风格 3D 渲染，呈现逼真的毛发纤维、柔和的轮廓光、浅景深、金色背光、地面上的柔和阴影、温馨的育婴室氛围、居中构图、高细节、电影般的暖色调，无文字。

templates.title: Fashion Portrait on Grand Staircase

titleLocalized.zh: 宏伟楼梯上的时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution fashion editorial photograph of a slim young woman standing on an ornate indoor staircase in a grand historic mansion. She wears a loose, flowing {argument name="dress color" default="black"} halter mini dress with gathered fabric at the neckline, open sides, a short asymmetric fluttering hem, and side tie details, paired with clean {argument name="shoe style" default="white low-top sneakers"}. Her {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is loosely tied back with wispy strands around the face, and her face is covered by a soft square blur for anonymity. She poses elegantly on gray stone steps with one leg crossed in front of the other, one hand resting on the polished curved wooden banister, photographed from a low slightly wide-angle perspective. The setting features richly carved dark wood railings with circular floral ornament panels, tall cream-colored walls, a large window on the left casting natural daylight, a warm two-bulb wall sconce on the upper right, and a sweeping staircase curve behind her. Use realistic skin tones, detailed fabric folds, glossy carved wood, natural indoor lighting, shallow editorial depth, vertical composition, and upscale lifestyle magazine styling. Add a subtle semi-transparent watermark reading {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} near the lower left on the stairs.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高分辨率的时尚编辑摄影作品，拍摄一名身材苗条的年轻女性站在宏伟历史豪宅的华丽室内楼梯上。她身穿一件宽松飘逸的 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"} 挂脖迷你裙，领口有褶皱设计，侧面镂空，下摆短而不对称且带有飘逸感，并配有侧面系带细节，搭配简洁的 {argument name="shoe style" default="白色低帮运动鞋"}。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，随意地扎在脑后，脸部周围有几缕碎发，面部经过柔和的方形模糊处理以保持匿名。她优雅地站在灰色石阶上，双腿交叉，一只手搭在打磨光滑的弧形木质扶手上，采用低角度略微广角拍摄。场景特色包括雕刻精美的深色木质栏杆，上面装饰着圆形花卉镶板，高大的奶油色墙壁，左侧的大窗户投射出自然日光，右上角有一盏温暖的双灯泡壁灯，身后是蜿蜒的楼梯曲线。使用逼真的肤色、细腻的织物褶皱、光泽的雕刻木材、自然的室内光线、浅景深编辑效果、垂直构图以及高端生活方式杂志的风格。在左下方的楼梯附近添加一个微妙的半透明水印，文字为 {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"}。

templates.title: Mountain Stream Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 山间溪流肖像

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed photorealistic outdoor portrait of an adult {argument name="subject description" default="young East Asian woman"} kneeling in a shallow rocky mountain stream, posed in three-quarter view with one hand resting on a wet rock and the other arm relaxed at her side. She has long dark hair falling naturally over her shoulders and blowing slightly, with her face covered by a centered square pixelated privacy censor block. She wears a fitted {argument name="shirt color" default="white"} short-sleeve T-shirt with a small black “CK” logo on the left chest and light blue denim short shorts; she is barefoot, with her knees and lower legs in the flowing water. The setting is a lush green forest valley with large smooth river stones, whitewater ripples, and softly blurred wooded mountains in the background. Use natural overcast daylight, cool muted colors, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, wet rocks, cinematic bokeh, vertical composition, high-resolution DSLR photography look, 85mm lens feel, soft contrast, and a subtle semi-transparent {argument name="watermark text" default="AIonia"} watermark in the lower left corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度细节化的写实户外肖像，主角是一位 {argument name="subject description" default="年轻东亚女性"}，她跪在浅浅的岩石山溪中，呈四分之三侧面姿势，一只手撑在湿润的岩石上，另一只手臂自然下垂。她留着长长的深色头发，自然垂落在肩头并随风轻拂，面部被一个居中的方形像素化隐私遮挡块覆盖。她身穿一件修身的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 短袖 T 恤，左胸处印有黑色小巧的“CK”标志，下身穿着浅蓝色牛仔短裤；她赤着脚，膝盖和小腿浸在流动的溪水中。背景是郁郁葱葱的绿色森林山谷，布满光滑的大河石，溪水泛起白色的涟漪，远景是柔焦的林木山峦。采用自然阴天光线、冷色调、浅景深、逼真的皮肤纹理、湿润的岩石、电影级虚化效果、竖构图，呈现高分辨率 DSLR 摄影质感，具备 85mm 镜头感，柔和的对比度，并在左下角添加一个半透明的 {argument name="watermark text" default="AIonia"} 水印。

templates.title: Censored Sofa Lifestyle Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 带遮挡效果的沙发生活方式人像

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution, realistic lifestyle photograph of an {argument name="subject" default="adult woman"} reclining sideways on a deep blue fabric sofa in a bright living room. She has {argument name="hair color and style" default="long dark brown slightly wavy hair"} falling around her shoulders, and her face is intentionally covered by a large opaque brown rectangular censor block centered over the head and upper face area. She is wearing a light gray spaghetti-strap camisole and is wrapped modestly across the chest with a soft {argument name="blanket color" default="blue fleece blanket"}, one hand gently holding the blanket near the torso. The composition is a close, intimate crop from the upper body and shoulders, angled slightly from above, with shallow depth of field. The background shows a softly blurred cozy home interior with a wooden shelf, stacked books, a wicker basket, and a hint of green plant, lit by natural daylight. Use photorealistic DSLR quality, soft skin tones, detailed fabric texture, realistic hair strands, calm relaxed mood, and a subtle semi-transparent watermark reading {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} in the lower-left corner.

templates.title: Darwin Tree of Life Podcast Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Darwin Tree of Life 播客封面

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic 16:9 podcast cover illustration in a dark Renaissance natural-history style, like an antique oil painting mixed with fantasy scientific engraving. On the left, show an elderly Victorian-era naturalist resembling Charles Darwin seated in shadow beside stacked leather-bound books, an open sketchbook full of botanical and animal notes, loose papers, brass instruments, and a dim study wall; his face is intentionally covered by a plain vertical brown rectangular block as if redacted. The center and right side open into a glowing seascape at sunset with a sailing ship near distant cliffs, birds in flight, and a huge symbolic tree of life whose twisting branches fill the sky. In the branches place exactly 13 visible natural-history elements: a jaguar or leopard, a monkey, a bear-like mammal, a perched bird, two small birds together, a pangolin-like animal, a fox or small canine, a sea turtle, a large tortoise, a fish, a lizard or reptile, a spiral shell, and a star-shaped botanical specimen. The right background should transition into a deep cosmic blue night sky with stars, a spiral galaxy, circular scientific diagrams, fossils, leaves, insects, roots, and ocean creatures, suggesting evolution, biodiversity, and cosmic time. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, warm gold highlights, teal-green shadows, intricate engraved details, painterly textures, and a mysterious scholarly atmosphere. Across the lower center place large elegant gold Chinese title text {argument name="headline text" default="大自然没有设计师"}, with smaller gold subtitle text beneath it {argument name="subtitle text" default="达尔文与生命之树"}, flanked by thin ornamental divider lines and small decorative flourishes. Keep the typography crisp, centered, luxurious, and readable, like a premium science-history podcast cover. Overall palette: antique amber, dark forest green, deep teal, black, and luminous gold; high detail, cinematic composition, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的电影感播客封面插图，采用深色文艺复兴自然历史风格，融合复古油画与奇幻科学版画质感。左侧展示一位维多利亚时代的年长博物学家，外貌酷似查尔斯·达尔文，他坐在阴影中，身旁堆放着皮质书籍、一本画满植物与动物笔记的敞开素描本、散乱的纸张、黄铜仪器以及昏暗的书房墙壁；他的脸部被一个朴素的垂直棕色长方形色块遮挡，呈现出被涂抹的效果。画面中央及右侧展现出一片夕阳下的发光海景，远处的悬崖边有一艘帆船，空中飞鸟盘旋，一棵巨大的象征性生命之树枝干蜿蜒，铺满天空。在枝干间放置 13 个清晰可见的自然历史元素：一只美洲豹或豹子、一只猴子、一只熊类哺乳动物、一只栖息的鸟、两只在一起的小鸟、一只穿山甲类动物、一只狐狸或小型犬科动物、一只海龟、一只大型陆龟、一条鱼、一只蜥蜴或爬行动物、一个螺旋贝壳以及一个星状植物标本。右侧背景应过渡到深邃的宇宙蓝夜空，点缀着繁星、螺旋星系、圆形科学图表、化石、叶片、昆虫、根系和海洋生物，暗示进化、生物多样性与宇宙时间。运用戏剧性的明暗对比光影、温暖的金色高光、青绿色阴影、精细的雕刻细节、油画质感以及神秘的学术氛围。在画面下方中央放置醒目优雅的金色中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="大自然没有设计师"}，下方配以较小的金色副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="达尔文与生命之树"}，两侧辅以纤细的装饰性分割线和小型花饰。保持排版清晰、居中、奢华且易读，呈现出高端科学历史播客封面的质感。整体色调：复古琥珀色、深森林绿、深青色、黑色与发光的金色；高细节，电影感构图，不包含任何现代物品。

templates.title: Dark Historical Podcast Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑历史播客封面

templates.prompt: Create a dark cinematic podcast cover in a 16:9 horizontal format, painted like a dramatic Baroque oil painting with golden-brown chiaroscuro lighting, aged parchment textures, and a historical mystery atmosphere. The scene shows a weary medieval scholar or miller seated at a rough wooden desk in the right-center foreground, face intentionally obscured by a dark square shadow, one hand pressed to his temple while the other writes with a feather quill on handwritten papers. On the desk include 5 main foreground objects: an open occult notebook filled with diagrams, loose manuscript pages, a burning wax candle, a wedge of hole-filled cheese, and scattered larvae; include exactly 9 clearly visible larvae around the cheese and papers. Behind him, blend a surreal cosmic sky with stars, astrological circles, a cratered moon, golden nebula dust, and faint mathematical manuscript marks, merging into a late-medieval village with a windmill on the lower left and shadowy church officials or inquisitors on the upper right. Add exactly 4 visible text blocks: a large cream-colored Chinese main title on the left reading {argument name="main title" default="奶酪宇宙里的磨坊主"}, a smaller subtitle beneath it reading {argument name="subtitle" default="《奶酪与蛆虫》与普通人的思想史"}, a tiny bottom-left tagline reading {argument name="tagline" default="— 当一个普通人开始解释宇宙，权力便开始不安。"}, and a parchment note on the right reading {argument name="document note" default="审讯记录\n梅诺基奥\n1599年"}. Use elegant traditional Chinese typography, off-white ink for the title, muted gold for the small tagline, high contrast but weathered edges, museum-poster composition, no modern objects, no clean digital gloss, richly detailed, ominous, intellectual, and suitable as a historical philosophy podcast episode cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 横向比例的暗黑电影感播客封面，呈现出戏剧性的巴洛克油画质感，运用金棕色明暗对比照明、陈旧羊皮纸纹理，营造出历史悬疑氛围。画面右中前景处，一位疲惫的中世纪学者或磨坊主坐在粗糙的木桌前，面部被一块深色方形阴影刻意遮挡，一只手按在太阳穴上，另一只手正用羽毛笔在手稿上书写。桌上包含 5 个主要前景物品：一本画满图表的神秘笔记、散落的稿纸、一支燃烧的蜡烛、一块带孔的奶酪以及散落的幼虫；在奶酪和纸张周围精确包含 9 只清晰可见的幼虫。在他身后，将超现实的宇宙星空与星辰、占星圆环、布满陨石坑的月球、金色星云尘埃以及模糊的数学手稿符号融为一体，并过渡到左下方的中世纪晚期村庄和右上方的阴影中的教会官员或宗教裁判官。添加 4 个清晰可见的文本块：左侧是一个巨大的奶油色中文主标题 {argument name="main title" default="奶酪宇宙里的磨坊主"}，下方是一个较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="《奶酪与蛆虫》与普通人的思想史"}，左下角是一行极小的标语 {argument name="tagline" default="— 当一个普通人开始解释宇宙，权力便开始不安。"}，右侧是一张羊皮纸便签 {argument name="document note" default="审讯记录\n梅诺基奥\n1599年"}。使用优雅的繁体中文字体，标题采用灰白色墨迹，小标语采用暗金色，高对比度但边缘呈现风化效果，采用博物馆海报式构图，无现代物品，无干净的数字光泽，细节丰富，氛围阴郁且充满智性，适合作为历史哲学播客的单集封面。

The scene is inside a shadowy cathedral throne room with black stone arches, two tall pointed stained-glass windows, carved gothic architecture, candlelit gold highlights, and a deep black-and-burnished-gold color palette. In the center foreground place the partial bust of an aging king in a heavy fur mantle and ornate collar, facing forward; his head is backed by an intricate oversized golden crown that forms a halo-like architectural diagram, but cover the face with a plain vertical brown rectangle as if anonymized. Behind him blend detailed gold line art of a crown, a grand cathedral-city, a royal seal, manuscript parchment with Latin-like writing, and a crowded medieval court. On the left include one tall heraldic banner with a crowned lion crest and a crown emblem, plus four small seated courtiers at the lower left with their faces obscured by small brown rectangles. Use dramatic chiaroscuro, smoky texture, antique parchment grain, fine engraved details, and luminous metallic gold typography. Add exactly three centered text lines at the bottom: the large main title {argument name="main title" default="王冠之下的不死之身"}, a smaller subtitle between thin horizontal divider lines with arrow ornaments {argument name="subtitle" default="从神学王权到现代国家的诞生"}, and a small author/source line with decorative flourishes {argument name="source line" default="恩斯特·H.坎托洛维奇《国王的两个身体》"}. Make the layout balanced and poster-like, with the title occupying the lower third, the crown halo dominating the upper center, and no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的电影质感播客封面，采用深色中世纪哥特式皇家风格，类似于 HBO 历史纪录片海报。场景位于阴暗的教堂王座大厅内，配有黑色石拱门、两扇高耸的尖顶彩色玻璃窗、雕刻精美的哥特式建筑、烛光下的金色高光，以及深黑与抛光金色的配色方案。前景中央放置一位年迈国王的半身像，他身披厚重的毛皮斗篷，佩戴华丽的领饰，面朝前方；他的头部后方是一个错综复杂的超大金色王冠，形成类似光环的建筑图解，但用一个简单的垂直棕色矩形遮住面部，使其匿名化。在他身后融合精细的金色线条艺术，包括王冠、宏伟的教堂城市、皇家印章、带有类拉丁文的手稿羊皮纸以及拥挤的中世纪宫廷。左侧包含一面高大的纹章旗帜，上面绘有戴冠狮子纹章和王冠标志，左下角有四名坐着的朝臣，他们的面部被小棕色矩形遮挡。运用戏剧性的明暗对比法、烟雾质感、古旧羊皮纸纹理、精细的雕刻细节以及发光的金属金色字体。在底部居中添加三行文字：大号主标题 {argument name="main title" default="王冠之下的不死之身"}，在两条带有箭头装饰的细水平分割线之间添加较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="从神学王权到现代国家的诞生"}，以及一行带有装饰性花纹的小号作者/来源信息 {argument name="source line" default="恩斯特·H.坎托洛维奇《国王的两个身体》"}。布局需平衡且具有海报感，标题占据底部三分之一，王冠光环占据上方中心，画面中不得出现任何现代物品。

templates.title: Modern Concrete Stairwell Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 现代混凝土楼梯间人像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic full-body fashion portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young adult woman"} leaning casually against a large pale concrete pillar in a modern minimalist interior. She has long dark brown wavy hair and an intentionally obscured face covered by a soft rectangular blur, with a relaxed posture, shoulders against the wall, both hands tucked into the front pockets of loose high-waisted wide-leg blue jeans. She wears {argument name="top" default="a plain white short-sleeve T-shirt"} and is barefoot, with one leg crossed slightly in front of the other. The setting is {argument name="location" default="a contemporary concrete stairwell with polished dark floors"}, featuring a wide staircase rising on the right, angular concrete railings, geometric window latticework near the top, and soft natural daylight casting long shadows across the floor and wall. Use realistic proportions, natural skin tones, subtle fabric folds, detailed denim texture, shallow depth of field, muted gray and blue color palette, documentary editorial photography style, vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio. Add a semi-transparent white watermark reading {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} in the bottom-left corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的全身时尚人像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，她正随意地倚靠在现代极简主义室内的一根大型浅色混凝土柱旁。她留着深棕色长波浪卷发，面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡；她姿态放松，双肩靠墙，双手插在宽松的高腰阔腿蓝色牛仔裤前兜里。她身穿 {argument name="top" default="一件纯白色短袖 T 恤"}，赤着双脚，双腿微微交叉。场景设定为 {argument name="location" default="一个带有深色抛光地面的现代混凝土楼梯间"}，右侧设有宽阔的楼梯、棱角分明的混凝土栏杆，顶部附近有几何形状的窗格，柔和的自然光在地面和墙壁上投下长长的阴影。使用真实的比例、自然的肤色、细腻的织物褶皱、详尽的牛仔布纹理、浅景深、柔和的灰蓝色调、纪实编辑摄影风格、竖构图，比例为 4:5。在左下角添加一个半透明的白色水印，文字为 {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"}。

templates.title: Censored Purple Turtleneck Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 紫色高领毛衣遮挡肖像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young adult woman"} seated indoors beside a softly lit window, framed from the upper torso to the top of the head. She has long, thick, wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown hair"} falling over one shoulder, with natural shine and loose strands. She wears a fitted ribbed knit {argument name="sweater color" default="deep purple"} turtleneck sweater with long sleeves, emphasizing the fabric texture, vertical ribbing, and soft folds. Her hands are gently clasped at her waist near the bottom of the frame. The face is deliberately hidden by a large centered opaque square censor block in warm brown tones, covering the eyes, nose, and most facial features while leaving some hair and one ear visible. Use realistic skin texture on the visible hands, shallow depth of field, soft window light from the left, a warm neutral beige interior background, natural shadows, and high-detail DSLR-style photography. Add a faint semi-transparent watermark reading {argument name="watermark text" default="AI conia"} in the lower-left corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的竖构图肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，坐在室内窗边，光线柔和，取景范围从上半身到头部。她留着浓密的长波浪 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色头发"}，自然垂落在肩头，带有自然光泽和零星碎发。她穿着一件修身的罗纹针织 {argument name="sweater color" default="深紫色"} 高领毛衣，长袖设计，强调织物纹理、纵向罗纹和自然的褶皱感。她的双手在画面下方的腰部轻轻交叠。面部被一个位于中心的大型不透明方形马赛克刻意遮挡，色调为暖棕色，遮住了眼睛、鼻子和大部分面部特征，仅露出部分头发和一只耳朵。可见的手部皮肤纹理需真实细腻，采用浅景深效果，左侧柔和的窗光，背景为暖色调的中性米色室内环境，呈现自然阴影，具有高细节的单反相机摄影质感。在左下角添加一个淡淡的半透明水印，内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="AI conia"}。

templates.title: Crouching Outdoor Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 户外时尚蹲姿人像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic full-body outdoor fashion portrait of an {argument name="subject age and gender" default="adult young woman"} crouching low on a pale tiled walkway beside a white lattice fence. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown hair"} falling over her shoulders, her face intentionally obscured by a soft square mosaic blur, and she rests both elbows on her knees with her hands cupping her cheeks in a shy, pensive pose. She wears a fitted {argument name="sweater color" default="navy blue"} knit sweater with ribbed cuffs, a short {argument name="skirt color" default="beige"} skirt, sheer black tights, and black platform high-heel pumps. Use a shallow depth of field with the background softly blurred, natural daylight, muted neutral colors, realistic skin and fabric texture, a candid street-photography feel, vertical 4:3 composition, subject positioned slightly left of center, white geometric fence receding into the background on the right, and a subtle semi-transparent watermark reading {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} in the lower-left corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的全身户外时尚人像，画面中一位 {argument name="subject age and gender" default="成年年轻女性"} 蹲在白色格子栅栏旁浅色的瓷砖人行道上。她留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色头发"}，发丝垂在肩头，面部经过柔和的方形马赛克模糊处理，双手托腮，手肘抵在膝盖上，呈现出害羞而沉思的姿态。她身穿一件修身的 {argument name="sweater color" default="藏青色"} 针织毛衣，袖口有罗纹设计，搭配一条短款 {argument name="skirt color" default="米色"} 短裙、黑色透明连裤袜以及黑色防水台高跟鞋。采用浅景深效果，背景柔和虚化，自然日光照明，色调柔和中性，呈现真实的皮肤和织物纹理，营造出抓拍的街头摄影感。构图采用 4:3 竖幅，主体位于画面中心偏左位置，右侧白色几何栅栏向背景延伸，左下角带有半透明的 {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} 水印。
