templates.title: Neon Cyber-Kawaii VTuber Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹赛博可爱风 VTuber 肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant anime-style vertical streamer portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Miu"}, a cyber-kawaii virtual idol seated at a streaming desk in a neon bedroom studio. She has extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="cotton-candy pink"} twin-tails with flowing strands, oversized black-and-pink star hair clips on both sides, small dangling crystal charms, and a playful ahoge curl on top; her face is deliberately covered by a large flat pastel pink rectangular censor block centered over the entire face. Dress her in a black, white, hot-pink, and cyan oversized techwear hoodie with printed graphics, star patches, zipper details, drawstrings, and glossy trim, worn off the shoulders over a cropped strappy top, layered belts, a pleated black mini skirt, chain accessories, star pendants, a choker, and a glowing star necklace. Include exactly 6 prominent star accessories: two large star hair clips, one star choker charm, one glowing chest necklace charm, one hanging belt-chain star, and one star patch on the sleeve. The scene is a cozy neon livestream setup with a large microphone and pop filter on the left, a bright pink keyboard at the bottom, a mug on the right with Japanese hashtag text, pastel plush cats in the background, and wall monitors filled with cute chat bubbles, hearts, cat icons, and the glowing name logo {argument name="logo text" default="miu"}. Use a saturated magenta, violet, cyan, and electric blue color palette, glossy highlights, detailed linework, dramatic rim lighting, soft bloom, bokeh neon signs, and a high-detail modern anime illustration style. The composition should be a close-up three-quarter bust-to-thigh view, centered on the character, with the background slightly blurred but still readable as a streamer room. Add visible Japanese-style chat messages such as {argument name="chat message" default="こんみう〜!!!"} and pink heart reactions on the right monitor, while keeping the overall mood energetic, cute, futuristic, and idol-streamer themed.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的动漫风格竖版主播肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Miu"}，一位坐在霓虹灯卧室工作室直播桌前的赛博可爱风虚拟偶像。她留着极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="棉花糖粉色"} 双马尾，发丝飘逸，两侧带有超大号黑粉色星星发夹，点缀着小型水晶吊坠，头顶有一撮俏皮的呆毛；她的面部被一个位于正中央的大型扁平柔和粉色矩形马赛克块刻意遮挡。为她穿上一件黑、白、亮粉和青色配色的超大号机能风卫衣，上面印有图案、星星贴布、拉链细节、抽绳和光泽饰边，卫衣以露肩方式穿在短款系带上衣外，搭配叠层腰带、黑色百褶短裙、链条配饰、星星吊坠、颈圈和发光的星星项链。画面中需包含 6 个显眼的星星配饰：两个大号星星发夹、一个星星颈圈吊坠、一个发光的胸前项链吊坠、一个悬挂的腰带链条星星，以及一个袖子上的星星贴布。场景为一个温馨的霓虹灯直播间，左侧配有大型麦克风和防喷罩，底部有一个亮粉色键盘，右侧放着一个带有日文标签文字的马克杯，背景中有柔和色调的毛绒猫咪，墙上的显示器上布满了可爱的聊天气泡、爱心、猫咪图标以及发光的名称 Logo {argument name="logo text" default="miu"}。使用饱和的洋红色、紫色、青色和电光蓝色调，强调光泽高光、细腻的线条、戏剧性的轮廓光、柔和的泛光效果、虚化的霓虹灯招牌，以及高细节的现代动漫插画风格。构图应为四分之三近景（胸部至大腿），以角色为中心，背景略微虚化但仍能清晰辨认出主播房间的氛围。在右侧显示器上添加可见的日式聊天信息，例如 {argument name="chat message" default="こんみう〜!!!"} 和粉色爱心反应，整体氛围保持活力、可爱、未来感和偶像主播主题。

templates.title: Blue-Eyes White Dragon Vortex Art

titleLocalized.zh: 青眼白龙漩涡艺术

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic square-format anime trading-card style illustration of {argument name="creature name" default="Blue-Eyes White Dragon"}, a metallic white and icy blue dragon lunging forward from a swirling dark blue vortex. The dragon has 1 large angular head, 2 glowing sapphire-blue eyes, an open snarling mouth with sharp triangular teeth, 2 long blade-like horns sweeping upward and backward, 2 extra side spikes projecting from the cheek and jaw area, 1 segmented serpentine neck, 2 raised forearms with large curved claws, 2 bent rear legs with talons, and multiple layered armor-like plates along the body and neck. Emphasize a glossy chrome-and-pearl surface with bright white highlights, deep cyan shadows, black ink outlines, and intense specular reflections. The creature should fill almost the entire frame in a dynamic diagonal pose, with its head near the upper center-left, claws reaching toward the viewer, and the tail/body curling into the background. The background is a high-energy circular portal made of luminous blue brush strokes, electric streaks, and radial motion blur, creating a sense of speed and power. Use {argument name="color palette" default="icy white, chrome silver, electric blue, deep navy"}, high contrast, sharp anime linework, fantasy monster design, ultra-detailed scales and armor plates, glowing highlights, polished digital painting, no text, no border.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张正方形构图的动漫集换式卡牌风格插画，主角为 {argument name="creature name" default="青眼白龙"}，这是一条金属白与冰蓝色的巨龙，正从深蓝色的旋转漩涡中猛扑而出。巨龙拥有 1 个硕大的棱角分明的头部，2 只闪烁着蓝宝石光芒的眼睛，张开的咆哮口中长满锋利的三角形牙齿，2 只向后上方延伸的长刃状犄角，2 根从脸颊和下颚处突出的额外尖刺，1 条分节的蛇形脖颈，2 只抬起的前肢配有巨大的弯曲利爪，2 条弯曲的后腿长有爪子，身体和颈部覆盖着多层盔甲状鳞片。强调光泽感十足的铬合金与珍珠质感表面，配以明亮的白色高光、深青色阴影、黑色墨线勾勒以及强烈的镜面反射。生物应以动态的对角线姿势几乎填满整个画面，头部位于左上方附近，利爪伸向观众，尾部和身体卷曲在背景中。背景是一个由发光的蓝色笔触、电光条纹和径向运动模糊构成的充满能量的圆形传送门，营造出速度感与力量感。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="冰雪白、铬银色、电光蓝、深海军蓝"} 配色，高对比度，锐利的动漫线条，奇幻怪物设计，超精细的鳞片与盔甲板，发光高光，精致的数字绘画，无文字，无边框。

templates.title: Layered Paper Alchemist Figurine

titleLocalized.zh: 层叠纸艺炼金术士人偶

templates.prompt: Create a realistic shallow-depth-of-field tabletop photo of a handmade layered paper-cut shadowbox figurine of {argument name="character name" default="a fantasy alchemist girl"} standing on a green self-healing cutting mat in a craft workshop. The figure is built from many stacked cut cardstock layers with visible brown cardboard edges, like a 3D paper model or failed papercraft pattern test, and has a deliberately imperfect construction. She wears a pale mint-green long coat with layered skirt panels, tan leather straps crossing her chest and waist, brown boots and gloves, and a belt full of small potion bottles. Count 7 visible potion bottles: 1 purple bottle raised in her left hand, 1 small bottle on her left hip pouch, 3 bottles hanging across the front belt, and 2 bottles on the right side of the skirt. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="pale icy blue"}, long, wavy, voluminous, and cut into separate stacked paper layers; her face is intentionally hidden by a centered square pixelated beige blur censor block. templates.title: Ame-no-Uzume Sacred Cave Dance

templates.prompt: Create an ornate vertical fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="goddess name" default="Ame-no-Uzume"} dancing in a sacred cave shrine, framed like a luxurious Japanese mythological tarot card. The composition has 1 central female dancer standing on one bare foot on a round wooden kagura stage, her other knee raised, one arm lifted high holding a golden suzu bell wand with trailing red ribbons, and the other arm extended gracefully outward. She wears a revealing layered miko-inspired ceremonial outfit: flowing white kimono sleeves, red inner lining, gold floral embroidery, black-and-gold ornate waist ornaments, braided cords, tassels, anklets, and jewelry; her long dark hair streams dramatically around her body beneath a large floral-gold divine headdress. Her face should be softly obscured or left featureless rather than detailed. Behind her is a blinding warm golden cave opening with a thick shimenawa rope and 6 hanging paper shide streamers above it. Surround the stage with 6 background attendants or deities, 3 on the left and 3 on the right, partially hidden in shadow with indistinct or softly obscured faces, raising hands or instruments as if worshipping and celebrating the dance. Add swirling petals, sparkling star-like lights, mist, ribbons, and a deep indigo-purple cavern filled with magical reflections. Use an extremely elaborate gold filigree border with 4 large corner floral ornaments, dangling tassels, bells, gemstones, and a circular chrysanthemum crest at the top center and bottom center. Lighting is dramatic and divine, with intense backlight, warm gold highlights, cool blue-violet shadows, glossy fabric, intricate ornament detail, dynamic motion, high fantasy, highly detailed anime painting, cinematic vertical poster, no readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张华丽的竖版奇幻动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="goddess name" default="Ame-no-Uzume"} 在神圣的洞穴神社中起舞，画面呈现如奢华的日本神话塔罗牌风格。构图中心为一名女性舞者，她单脚赤足站在圆形的木制神乐台上，另一膝抬起，一只手高举握着带有红色飘带的金色铃铛神杖，另一只手优雅地向外伸展。她身着灵感源自巫女的华丽分层礼服：飘逸的白色和服袖子、红色内衬、金色花卉刺绣、黑金相间的华丽腰饰、编织绳结、流苏、脚链和珠宝；她长长的黑发在巨大的花卉金饰神冠下围绕身体戏剧性地飘动。她的面部应柔化处理或保持无五官细节。背景是耀眼的暖金色洞口，上方挂着粗壮的注连绳和 6 条垂下的纸垂。舞台周围环绕着 6 名背景侍从或神明，左右各 3 名，半隐于阴影中，面部模糊或柔化，双手举起或持乐器，仿佛在崇拜并庆祝这场舞蹈。添加旋转的花瓣、闪烁的星光、薄雾、丝带以及充满魔法倒影的深靛紫色洞穴。使用极其精致的金色花丝边框，四角饰有大型花卉装饰、悬垂的流苏、铃铛和宝石，顶部和底部中心饰有圆形菊花纹章。光影效果戏剧化且神圣，具有强烈的背光、暖金色高光、冷蓝紫色阴影、光泽面料、复杂的装饰细节、动态感、高奇幻风格、高细节动漫绘画、电影感竖版海报，无任何可读文字。

templates.title: Layered Paper Alchemist Figurine

titleLocalized.zh: 层叠纸艺炼金术士手办

templates.prompt: Create a realistic tabletop product photo of a handmade layered craft-paper shadowbox figurine: a dynamic fantasy alchemist girl made from stacked cut cardstock, standing on a small oval layered cardboard base. The character has {argument name="hair color" default="pale icy blue"} long wavy hair made of separate curled paper layers, a mint green long coat with tan leather-like paper straps, belts, buckles, gloves, and brown boots, posed mid-step as if dancing or presenting a toast. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur. She holds 1 purple potion bottle high in her left hand, and her belt carries exactly 6 small potion vials in white, blue, and amber tones, each built from tiny layered paper pieces. The base includes small paper grass tufts and rocks. Place the figure on a green self-healing cutting mat covered with white cut marks, with a warm shallow-depth-of-field craft workspace background. Include exactly 3 prominent tools or supplies around the figure: a white glue bottle on the left with a kraft label reading {argument name="glue label text" default="Beardy Art Premium Craft Glue"}, a silver metal ruler on the right, and a silver precision craft knife at the lower right. Scatter brown kraft-paper offcuts around the mat and show stacked cardboard sheets blurred in the background. Use warm workshop lighting, macro photography, highly detailed paper fibers, visible layered edges, soft shadows, realistic handmade miniature texture, whimsical collectible art style inspired by {argument name="series title" default="Toxic Party"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的桌面产品照片，展示一个手工层叠纸艺阴影盒手办：一个由堆叠切割卡纸制成的动态奇幻炼金术士女孩，站在一个小巧的椭圆形层叠纸板底座上。该角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="淡冰蓝色"} 的长波浪卷发，由独立的卷曲纸层构成；身穿薄荷绿长外套，配有棕褐色仿皮纸质绑带、腰带、搭扣、手套和棕色靴子，姿态处于迈步中，仿佛正在跳舞或举杯。她的面部被刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理。左手高举 1 个紫色药水瓶，腰带上精确携带 6 个白色、蓝色和琥珀色调的小药水瓶，每个瓶子均由微小的层叠纸片拼搭而成。底座包含小纸草丛和岩石。将手办放置在带有白色切割痕迹的绿色自愈切割垫上，背景为温暖的浅景深手工工作区。在手办周围放置 3 个显眼的工具或用品：左侧是一个带有牛皮纸标签的白色胶水瓶，标签上写着 {argument name="glue label text" default="Beardy Art Premium Craft Glue"}，右侧是一把银色金属尺，右下角是一把银色精密美工刀。在垫子上散落棕色牛皮纸边角料，背景中模糊显示着堆叠的纸板。使用温暖的工作室灯光、微距摄影，呈现高度细腻的纸张纤维、清晰可见的层叠边缘、柔和的阴影、逼真的手工微缩质感，以及受 {argument name="series title" default="Toxic Party"} 启发的奇幻收藏艺术风格。

templates.title: Craft Paper Alchemist Shadow Box

titleLocalized.zh: 手工纸艺炼金术士立体剪影盒

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic tabletop product shot of a handmade layered craft-paper shadow box diorama inside a deep square black frame, showing a fantasy alchemist girl from {argument name="series title" default="Toxic Party"} standing in the center of an old laboratory. The character has {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing white hair"}, a partially blurred or softly obscured face, a pale green long coat with split tails, darker green leggings, brown leather boots, crisscrossing chest straps, belt pouches, and exactly 7 small potion bottles strapped around her waist. Pose her dynamically with one arm raised in a greeting or spell-casting gesture and the other arm extended sideways. Build the entire interior as layered cut paper and cardboard with visible stacked depth: arched shelves, gothic window, wooden beams, stone-tile floor, and warm lantern light. Include exactly 24 laboratory vessels and bottles in the diorama: 7 on the left upper shelves, 6 on the left lower shelves and table, 4 on the rear middle shelves, 3 on the right shelves, 2 large floor bottles, and 2 bottles attached to the foreground furniture. Add exactly 5 major foreground props inside the box: an open sketchbook with alchemy diagrams, a low worktable, a small crate, a furnace or brazier with orange flame, and a large round-bottom flask. On the right wall, add a parchment sign reading {argument name="sign text" default="Laboratoire de Saint-Germain Paris, 1768"}. Surround the framed diorama with a real craft workspace: green cutting mat, scattered paper scraps in tan, brown, sage and white, a metal ruler, precision craft knife, tweezers, a bottle of craft glue labeled {argument name="glue label" default="CRAFT GLUE"}, a jar of brushes and pencils, and a cardboard box. Use shallow depth of field, warm studio lighting, realistic paper fibers, subtle shadows between every cut-paper layer, and a cozy handmade shadow-box aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的桌面产品摄影图，展示一个置于深色方形黑框内的手工分层纸艺立体剪影盒，画面中心是一位来自 {argument name="series title" default="Toxic Party"} 的奇幻炼金术士女孩，正站在古老的实验室中。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的飘逸白发"}，面部部分模糊或柔和遮挡，身穿浅绿色长款开叉大衣、深绿色打底裤、棕色皮靴，配有交叉胸带、腰带包，腰间系着 7 个小药水瓶。让她摆出动态姿势，一只手臂抬起做出问候或施法的手势，另一只手臂向侧面伸展。整个内部结构由分层剪纸和硬纸板构建，呈现出明显的堆叠深度：拱形架子、哥特式窗户、木梁、石砖地面和温暖的灯笼光。在立体剪影盒中包含 24 个实验室器皿和瓶子：左侧上层架子 7 个，左侧下层架子及桌上 6 个，后方中间架子 4 个，右侧架子 3 个，地面大瓶 2 个，前景家具上附带 2 个。在盒内添加 5 个主要的前景道具：一本打开的绘有炼金术图表的素描本、一张矮工作台、一个小板条箱、一个带有橙色火焰的熔炉或火盆，以及一个大型圆底烧瓶。在右侧墙壁上，添加一块羊皮纸标志，上面写着 {argument name="sign text" default="Laboratoire de Saint-Germain Paris, 1768"}。在框架式立体剪影盒周围布置一个真实的手工工作台：绿色切割垫、散落的棕褐色、棕色、鼠尾草绿和白色纸屑、一把金属尺、精密美工刀、镊子、一瓶贴有 {argument name="glue label" default="CRAFT GLUE"} 标签的工艺胶水、一个装有画笔和铅笔的罐子以及一个纸板箱。使用浅景深、温暖的摄影棚灯光、逼真的纸张纤维质感、每层剪纸之间微妙的阴影，营造出舒适的手工立体剪影盒美学。

titleLocalized.zh: 空荡的日本柏青哥店过道

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic wide-angle interior photograph of a dim Japanese pachislot parlor aisle during Golden Week, showing exactly {argument name="number of slot machines" default="7"} pirate-themed slot machines lined up side by side against a dark wall and exactly {argument name="number of chairs" default="7"} empty black vinyl swivel chairs in front of them. Each machine has glossy black casing, glowing red LED panels, illuminated reel windows with BAR, cherry, bell, and orange symbols, and ornate pirate ship artwork reading {argument name="machine title text" default="King of Carib"} on the lower display; the top displays show red triple sevens and the words Big Chance. The scene should feel quiet and slightly mysterious, with no people present, deep shadows, red and amber casino lighting, reflections on the polished dark wooden floor, and faint Japanese caution signage above the machines. Use a realistic documentary snapshot style, eye-level perspective, strong contrast, moody low-key exposure, visible machine details, slight lens perspective stretching across the row, and a 16:9 horizontal composition.

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anime-style illustration of a {argument name="subject" default="tired high school soccer player"} drinking directly from an outdoor school water fountain after practice. The scene shows exactly 2 chrome faucets on a rectangular concrete fountain: one upper faucet at mouth height pouring a clear stream of water into his open mouth, and one lower faucet mounted on the front face dripping water. Include exactly 1 dark blue sports water bottle standing on the wet concrete ledge to the left. The boy is bent forward in profile, soaked with sweat and water droplets, with messy wet {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, flushed cheeks, and an exhausted but refreshed expression. He wears a black short-sleeve athletic soccer uniform with blue and white side stripes, black shorts, and a white towel draped around his neck with small Japanese text reading {argument name="towel text" default="青葉高校 サッカー部"}. Set the location beside a school sports field and club building at {argument name="time of day" default="golden-hour sunset"}, with warm orange backlighting, long shadows, distant netting and utility poles, a small wall sign reading 部室, wet splashes on the concrete, sparkling water highlights, shallow depth of field, detailed hand-drawn anime rendering, realistic faucet construction, dramatic rim light, vertical composition, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影级动漫风格插画，描绘一名 {argument name="subject" default="疲惫的高中足球运动员"} 在训练后直接从学校户外喷泉喝水的场景。画面中需精确呈现一个长方形混凝土喷泉上的 2 个铬合金水龙头：上方水龙头位于嘴部高度，正喷出一股清澈的水流进入他张开的嘴里；下方水龙头安装在正面，正滴着水。在左侧潮湿的混凝土台面上放置 1 个深蓝色运动水壶。男孩侧身弯腰，浑身被汗水和水珠浸透，留着凌乱湿润的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发，脸颊泛红，表情疲惫而清爽。他身穿带有蓝白侧条纹的黑色短袖运动足球服，搭配黑色短裤，脖子上挂着一条白色毛巾，上面印有日文 {argument name="towel text" default="青葉高校 サッカー部"}。场景设置在学校运动场和社团大楼旁，时间为 {argument name="time of day" default="黄金时刻的日落"}，带有温暖的橙色背光、长长的阴影、远处的球网和电线杆，墙上挂着写有“部室”的小牌子，混凝土上有水花溅落，水珠闪烁着光芒，浅景深，精细的手绘动漫渲染，写实的水龙头构造，戏剧性的轮廓光，竖构图，画面中无其他人物。

templates.title: Lake Akan Squirrel Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 阿寒湖松鼠导游指南

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style travel illustration set at {argument name="location" default="Lake Akan, Akan-Mashu National Park, Hokkaido"} on a bright clear day. In the foreground, show exactly 4 people: 1 central young female tour guide with realistic squirrel ears, long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="warm brown"} hair, decorative hair clips and dangling earrings, wearing an ornate navy-and-cream Ainu-inspired guide outfit with embroidered geometric trim, tassels, belt cords, and layered sleeves; and 3 tourists listening to her, including a young man in a brown baseball cap on the left, a seated or lower-positioned woman in a beige bucket hat in the center foreground, and a woman with a ponytail holding a pamphlet on the right. The guide stands confidently beside a wooden viewpoint sign, holding a blue travel brochure titled {argument name="brochure title" default="Lake Akan Guide Map"} while extending one arm toward the lake and mountains as if presenting the scenery. Include a wooden sign with Japanese and English text reading {argument name="sign text" default="阿寒摩周国立公園 / Akan-Mashu National Park / 阿寒湖 / Lake Akan"}. Behind them, depict a vivid blue lake with a sightseeing boat, forested green mountains, distant shoreline, railings, and a deep blue sky with wispy white clouds. Add exactly 18 translucent iridescent soap bubbles: 1 enormous squirrel-tail-shaped bubble curling behind the guide on the right, 2 large round bubbles floating high in the sky, 5 medium bubbles around her head and upper body, and 10 tiny bubbles scattered around her hair, sleeves, and waist. Use luminous rainbow reflections on the bubbles, crisp linework, cinematic composition, detailed fabric ornamentation, soft sunlight, high-resolution anime realism, cheerful tourism-poster atmosphere, and a whimsical magical guide concept.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格旅行插画，背景设定在 {argument name="location" default="北海道阿寒摩周国立公园阿寒湖"} 的晴朗明媚之日。画面前景中需精确呈现 4 个人物：中间是一位年轻的女性导游，拥有逼真的松鼠耳朵、一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="暖棕色"} 长发、装饰性发夹和垂坠耳环，身穿一套华丽的深蓝色配米色阿伊努风格导游制服，带有刺绣几何花边、流苏、腰带绳和层叠袖口；另外 3 名游客正在聆听，包括左侧戴着棕色棒球帽的年轻男子、中心前景处坐着或位置较低的戴米色渔夫帽的女性，以及右侧扎着马尾辫、手持宣传册的女性。导游自信地站在木制观景台标志旁，手中拿着一本蓝色的旅行宣传册，标题为 {argument name="brochure title" default="阿寒湖导游地图"}，同时伸出一只手臂指向湖泊和群山，仿佛正在介绍风景。画面中包含一个木制标志，上面用日文和英文写着 {argument name="sign text" default="阿寒摩周国立公園 / Akan-Mashu National Park / 阿寒湖 / Lake Akan"}。背景描绘了湛蓝的湖泊、观光船、翠绿的森林山脉、远处的湖岸线、护栏以及深蓝色的天空和丝缕白云。添加精确的 18 个半透明虹彩肥皂泡：1 个巨大的松鼠尾巴形状的泡泡在导游右后方卷曲，2 个巨大的圆形泡泡高悬在天空中，5 个中型泡泡环绕在她的头部和上半身周围，10 个微小的泡泡散落在她的头发、袖子和腰部周围。运用肥皂泡上的发光彩虹反射、清晰的线条、电影级的构图、细腻的织物装饰、柔和的阳光、高分辨率的动漫写实风格、欢快的旅游海报氛围以及奇幻魔法导游的概念。

templates.title: Retro Galaxy Train Interior

titleLocalized.zh: 复古银河列车内景

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed anime-style cinematic illustration of the interior of a retro fantasy galaxy train carriage, viewed from the center aisle in perfect one-point perspective looking toward the rear door. The scene is empty of passengers and warmly lit by glowing ceiling lamps and wall sconces, with polished varnished wood floors, curved wooden ceiling panels, brass rails, brass seat frames, and ornate vintage fittings. Use {argument name="seat fabric pattern" default="deep navy blue upholstery filled with tiny golden stars and nebula speckles"} for the seats and curtains, making the carriage feel like a celestial observatory. Show exactly 8 visible high-backed passenger bench seats arranged in two rows along the aisle, each with glossy brass armrests and rounded brass finials, plus 1 small wooden table attached at the front-left seat. Show exactly 8 large side windows, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, revealing a vivid outer-space panorama with a bright purple-blue Milky Way, dense stars, and glowing cosmic dust. Add exactly 2 long overhead luggage racks, one on each side, made of brass piping, holding exactly 9 vintage suitcases and trunks in blue, cream, and tan. At the far end, place a wooden door with a small arched window showing stars beyond it, flanked by exactly 2 round wall clocks and small framed astronomical diagrams. Include a glowing station sign above the rear door reading {argument name="rear station sign text" default="星降る駅"} and a side plaque on the right wall reading {argument name="side line sign text" default="天の川線"} with small English text beneath it reading {argument name="line subtitle" default="MILKY WAY LINE"}. The mood should be nostalgic, magical, and luxurious, like a steam-era sleeper train traveling through the galaxy; use warm amber lighting, rich reflections on wood and brass, crisp linework, elaborate background detail, no people, no modern technology, wide-angle composition, 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节高度丰富的动漫风格电影级插图，展现复古奇幻银河列车车厢的内部。视角位于中央过道，采用完美的单点透视，朝向后门望去。场景中没有乘客，由发光的吸顶灯和壁灯提供温暖的照明，地面铺设抛光清漆木地板，配有弧形木质天花板、黄铜扶手、黄铜座椅框架以及华丽的复古配件。座椅和窗帘请使用 {argument name="seat fabric pattern" default="深海军蓝织物，上面布满细小的金色星星和星云斑点"}，使车厢感觉像是一个天体观测台。展示沿过道两排排列的 8 个清晰可见的高背乘客长椅，每个长椅都有光亮的黄铜扶手和圆形的黄铜饰头，并在左前方座椅处附带 1 张小型木桌。展示 8 扇大型侧窗，左右各 4 扇，展现出生动的太空全景，包括明亮的紫蓝色银河、密集的恒星和发光的宇宙尘埃。添加 2 个长长的头顶行李架，两侧各一个，由黄铜管制成，上面放置 9 个蓝色、奶油色和棕褐色的复古手提箱和行李箱。在尽头处放置一扇木门，门上有一个可以看到外面星空的小拱形窗，两侧各挂 1 个圆形挂钟和小型装裱的天文图。在后门上方添加一个发光的车站站牌，文字为 {argument name="rear station sign text" default="星降る駅"}，并在右侧墙壁上添加一个侧面铭牌，文字为 {argument name="side line sign text" default="天の川线"}，下方附带小号英文文本 {argument name="line subtitle" default="MILKY WAY LINE"}。整体氛围应充满怀旧感、魔法感和奢华感，如同蒸汽时代的卧铺列车穿梭于银河之中；使用温暖的琥珀色灯光，木材和黄铜上呈现丰富的反射，线条清晰，背景细节精致，画面中无人，无现代科技，采用广角构图，16:9 纵横比。

promptLocalized.zh: 为夜生活场所的香槟促销活动创作一张奢华浪漫的网站首屏横幅，采用超宽 16:9 构图。场景设定在黄金时刻迷人的粉色樱花林中，顶部中心有耀眼的太阳光晕，地面覆盖着茂密的洋红色花朵，深色的弯曲树干形成天然拱门，花瓣飘落，伴有闪烁的焦外成像、光点和梦幻华丽的氛围。前景中心精确展示 2 瓶并排站立的香槟：左侧瓶身为深宝石红色，配有金箔瓶颈、华丽的金色纹章标签、优雅的字母组合及草书品牌文字；右侧瓶身为淡腮红白色，带有精致的花卉图案，配有绿色瓶颈、华丽的金色纹章标签、优雅的字母组合及草书品牌文字。在上方中心添加醒目的发光日文标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="オリジナルシャンパン♡"}，下方添加第二行较小的文字 {argument name="subheadline text" default="発売中"}；文字风格采用柔和的粉白色霓虹书法，两侧带有装饰性漩涡纹、小爱心和细小的星光闪烁。采用高级商业摄影与奇幻数字艺术相结合的风格，高对比度，玻璃表面有光泽反射，浅景深，充满活力的粉色与金色调色，电影级布光，简洁的商业布局，确保瓶身完美居中，并在标题后方留出足够的留白空间。

templates.title: Japanese Office Outfit Magazine Spread

titleLocalized.zh: 日系职场穿搭杂志排版

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the outfit and model reference, transform it into a bright Japanese fashion-magazine outfit feature page for an office commute look. Keep the same sheer brown blouse and white floral jacquard skirt as the core styling, but rebuild the scene as a clean editorial collage on an off-white background with soft blush-pink accents, thin rounded boxes, handwritten-style English annotations, sparkles, and elegant Japanese typography. Create exactly 3 main photos of the same outfit: 1 full-body outdoor commuting shot on the left with a beige handbag and black pumps, 1 seated office-desk laptop scene in the center, and 1 standing office scene on the right holding a dark folder. Add the article title {argument name="headline text" default="OLかえでさんの 褒められ通勤 Style"}, the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="可愛さもきちんと感も叶える♡大人の華やかフェミニンコーデ"}, and a vertical side catchphrase {argument name="vertical catchphrase" default="透け感ブラウスでつくる、上品あざと可愛い通勤コーデ♡"}. Include exactly 3 outfit detail cards on the right labeled Point 01, Point 02, and Point 03: Point 01 shows a circular close-up of the sheer blouse neckline, Point 02 shows a circular close-up of the white floral skirt texture, and Point 03 shows a circular two-color palette swatch for brown and off-white. Add exactly 2 small profile/rule sections near the top right: a profile box for {argument name="character name" default="KAede"} with {argument name="profile detail" default="27歳・都内勤務のOL"}, and a pink circular 'My Rules!' note. Add exactly 1 pink circular 'Fashion Tips' badge at bottom left with 3 checklist items, and exactly 1 'Today's Schedule' timeline along the bottom with 4 entries: 8:30 出勤, 10:00 会議, 13:00 ランチ, 18:30 退勤後. Make it look like a polished Japanese web article thumbnail or social-media magazine spread, preserving the reference outfit while changing the background, poses, and layout into an informational fashion guide.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为服装和模特参考，将其转换为明亮的日系时尚杂志职场通勤穿搭专题页面。保留相同的透视感棕色衬衫和白色花卉提花半身裙作为核心造型，但将场景重构为干净的编辑拼贴风格，背景采用米白色，搭配柔和的淡粉色点缀、细圆角边框、手写风格的英文注释、闪光特效以及优雅的日文排版。创建 3 张同一穿搭的主图：左侧为手提米色手袋、脚踩黑色高跟鞋的全身户外通勤照，中间为坐在办公桌前使用笔记本电脑的场景，右侧为手持深色文件夹的站立办公场景。添加文章标题 {argument name="headline text" default="OL 枫小姐的受好评通勤 Style"}，副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="兼顾可爱感与正式感♡成熟华丽的女性化穿搭"}，以及侧边竖排标语 {argument name="vertical catchphrase" default="用透视感衬衫打造，优雅又迷人的通勤穿搭♡"}。在右侧添加 3 张服装细节卡片，分别标记为 Point 01、Point 02 和 Point 03：Point 01 展示透视感衬衫领口的圆形特写，Point 02 展示白色花卉半身裙质感的圆形特写，Point 03 展示棕色与米白色的双色调色板圆形色块。在右上角附近添加 2 个小型个人资料/规则板块：一个 {argument name="character name" default="KAede"} 的个人资料框，内容为 {argument name="profile detail" default="27 岁・东京都内工作的 OL"}，以及一个粉色圆形“My Rules!”便签。在左下角添加 1 个粉色圆形“Fashion Tips”徽章，包含 3 项清单，并在底部添加 1 条“Today's Schedule”时间轴，包含 4 个条目：8:30 出勤、10:00 会议、13:00 午餐、18:30 下班。使其看起来像精美的日系网页文章缩略图或社交媒体杂志排版，在保留参考穿搭的同时，将背景、姿势和布局转换为信息丰富的时尚指南。

Add exactly six prominent colored hanging crystal prisms near the right character: red, green, purple, pale blue, dark blue, and clear-blue. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅细节丰富的竖版动漫哥特奇幻插画，描绘两位年轻的吸血鬼姐妹在夜晚华丽的维多利亚式宅邸中面对面站立，闭着双眼开心地大笑，双手紧紧交握在一起。左侧女孩留着 {argument name="left character hair color" default="薰衣草蓝"} 的短波浪波波头，身穿带有红色丝带的粉色荷叶边女仆风连衣裙，戴着饰有红色滚边和巨大深红色蝴蝶结的白色护士帽，背部有小巧的黑色蝙蝠翅膀，露出带有细小尖牙的调皮微笑。右侧女孩留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="金黄色"} 的波浪侧马尾，身穿饰有白色褶边的深绯红色连衣裙，戴着配有巨大深红色蝴蝶结的白色护士帽，身后有黑色翼状水晶框架，露出同样欣喜的尖牙微笑。画面包含两位主角，以对称姿势展现亲密的姐妹时刻，双手在胸前交扣。背景为昏暗奢华的吸血鬼客厅：厚重的酒红色窗帘，高大的窗户映照出多云夜空中巨大的 {argument name="moon color" default="血红色"} 满月，左侧墙上挂着古董肖像画，点燃的蜡烛，饰有许多温暖烛光和悬挂棱镜的华丽吊灯，右侧摆放着复古时钟，配有红色天鹅绒家具、深色木材、金色饰边和带有复古花纹的地毯。在右侧角色附近添加六个显眼的彩色悬挂水晶棱镜：红色、绿色、紫色、浅蓝色、深蓝色和透明蓝色。运用戏剧性的温暖烛光与冷色月光交织，呈现光泽感织物高光、精致的蕾丝与褶边细节、柔和的动漫绘画风格，高细节，营造浪漫的哥特氛围，无文字，无 UI，无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style vertical illustration of two blonde young women in a sunlit forest cottage garden, close-up waist framing, highly detailed hair, expressive faces, soft painterly rendering, dramatic dappled sunlight, lush green background, wooden house and hanging lantern partially visible on the left. The front character is {argument name="front character name" default="a witch girl"}, wearing a large black witch hat with oversized white bow and frilled brim, long golden-blonde hair in a thick side braid tied with a small purple bow, a black sleeveless dress with brass buttons over a puffy white blouse and white apron. The rear character is {argument name="rear character name" default="a doll-like girl"}, standing close behind with one arm wrapped around the front girl's shoulders, wearing a blue dress with white puff sleeves, white lace trim, red waist sash, and a red headband with white lace. She has long flowing golden-blonde hair, sharp blue eyes, flushed cheeks, an annoyed pout, and a small red anger-symbol mark near her temple while pulling the front girl's cheek with her index finger. Emphasize playful rivalry, cute slapstick emotion, glossy eyes, delicate skin highlights, detailed frills, rich fabric folds, warm backlighting, cinematic depth of field, vibrant high-resolution anime illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格竖版插画，场景设在阳光洒满的森林小屋花园中，采用腰部以上的近景构图。画面需包含高精度的发丝细节、生动的面部表情、柔和的绘画质感、富有戏剧性的斑驳光影，以及郁郁葱葱的绿色背景，左侧隐约可见木屋和悬挂的灯笼。前方角色为 {argument name="front character name" default="一位魔女少女"}，头戴巨大的黑色魔女帽，配有超大白色蝴蝶结和荷叶边帽檐，留着金色长发，编成厚实的侧边麻花辫并系着紫色小蝴蝶结，身穿黑色无袖连衣裙，内搭蓬松的白色衬衫和白色围裙，配有黄铜纽扣。她脸颊泛红，正眨着含泪的眼睛，嘴巴张开做出夸张的搞笑哭泣表情，一侧脸颊被对方的手指拉扯，身体因惊讶而前倾。后方角色为 {argument name="rear character name" default="一位人偶般的少女"}，紧贴在前方少女身后，一只手臂环绕着对方的肩膀，身穿蓝色连衣裙，配有白色泡泡袖、白色蕾丝边、红色腰带以及带有白色蕾丝的红色发带。她留着金色长发，有着锐利的蓝色眼睛，脸颊微红，嘟着嘴，太阳穴附近有一个红色的小“愤怒”符号，正用食指拉扯前方少女的脸颊。强调俏皮的竞争感、可爱的闹剧式情感、水润的眼睛、细腻的皮肤高光、精致的荷叶边、丰富的布料褶皱、温暖的逆光效果、电影级的景深，呈现出一幅色彩鲜艳的高分辨率动漫插画。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版、细节极其丰富的奇幻动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Rindou"}，一位光芒四射的年轻女性，正在充满发光蓝色龙胆花、玻璃灯笼、微小星尘和漂浮水晶花瓣的梦幻夜空花园中起舞。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的长发，在风中戏剧性地飘动，姿态充满活力与狂喜，一只手臂伸向观众，另一只手臂向外延展，仿佛在邀请观众共舞。她的服装是一套华丽的 {argument name="outfit color palette" default="白色、蓝宝石色和银色"} 舞者服，配有半透明的层叠面纱、不对称裙摆、珠宝腰带、金属链条、绿松石宝石、护臂、腿带和飘动的丝带；让布料呈现出半透明、轻盈且随风飘动的质感，同时避免画面过于暴露。在她的周围布置恰好 9 个显眼的悬挂或漂浮装饰灯笼及莲花/龙胆花灯：3 盏大型蓝色花朵灯、3 盏华丽的金属玻璃链条灯笼和 3 朵较小的紫色发光花朵，所有装饰都悬挂在闪烁的丝线之间。背景应营造出宇宙庆典的氛围：深靛色的星空、闪烁的尘埃、蓝紫色的光斑、棱镜般的玻璃碎片以及强烈的轮廓光。采用动态的低角度构图、电影级的景深、对角线运动感、流动的布料弧线、高对比度的月光高光、虹彩反射、精致的珠宝细节以及鲜艳的蓝紫色调，呈现出高端动漫游戏主视觉图的质感。

templates.title: Neon Anime Girl Falling Through City Sky

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动态的竖版动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一名蓝眼睛的女学生"} 在超现实的倒置城市天空中漂浮或坠落，采用极广角视角，观众位于她伸出的手下方。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有电光蓝和紫罗兰色挑染的长黑发"}，发丝随风剧烈向上飘散，明亮的青蓝色双眸，表情平静而略带忧郁，指甲涂抹着亮光，手部在强烈的透视感下向镜头伸出。为她穿上 {argument name="outfit" default="深海军蓝色的日本校服，配有蓝色丝带、百褶裙、黑色过膝袜，材质呈现出雨后湿润的光泽感"}。环境是围绕她扭曲的梦幻城市天际线，摩天大楼、轨道、电缆和反光的玻璃平面在构图中弯曲，仿佛重力已经消失。使用鲜明的 {argument name="color palette" default="霓虹钴蓝、紫外紫、热粉红、青色和粉色夕阳余晖"}，高对比度的轮廓光、液体反射、彩虹色棱镜碎片、油漆般的飞溅效果以及发光的云层。包含恰好 10 个可见的透明肥皂泡：左下边缘有 1 个巨大的截断气泡，右下方有 1 个大气泡，左侧头发附近有 1 个中气泡，胸前有 1 个小气泡，伸出的手附近有 1 个微型气泡，头顶上方有 1 个小气泡，右上角有 1 个中气泡，中右侧有 1 个小气泡，以及散落在高空的 2 个微型气泡。在上方中心附近添加一个明亮的星芒太阳，飘落的粉色花瓣或液体斑点，以及前景中晶莹剔透的反射碎片。风格：高度精细的现代动漫主视觉图，电影感构图，超饱和色彩，光泽感数字绘画，锐利的线条与绘画感光影结合，情感丰富且充满幻想的氛围，无文字，无边框。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的竖版动漫插图，描绘 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着超长飘逸黑发、拥有发光洋红色双眼的神秘少女"} 以强烈的低角度透视向观众伸出一只手，仿佛要将观众拉入她的世界。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一套深色哥特式校服风格连衣裙，配有百褶裙、黑色大腿绑带、链条细节、黑色长指甲，身后拖着洋红色的丝带状织物"}。背景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="未来夜景城市上方的天台"}，下方可见栏杆和远处的摩天大楼。在她周围环绕着破碎的黑色羽毛、漂浮的相框、光亮的液体滴和气泡状的心形、墨迹飞溅，以及悬浮在空中的反光玻璃碎片。采用高能量构图，让头发、丝带、羽毛和水滴在画面中呈对角线飞舞，营造出失重的动感和情感波动。调色板应为 {argument name="color palette" default="电钴蓝色、深海军蓝、紫罗兰色、青色、亮洋红色和黑色"}，并带有发光的霓虹轮廓光、光亮的反射、绘画般的喷溅纹理，以及发光背景与深色角色剪影之间的高对比度。以细腻的现代动漫艺术风格渲染，呈现电影级灯光、锐利且富有表现力的双眼、复杂的发丝、伸出手的动态透视，以及超现实的梦幻氛围。纵横比 3:4，超细节，色彩鲜艳，戏剧性，沉浸感，无文字。

Use a hyper-saturated color palette of electric cobalt blue, cyan, violet, hot magenta, and warm peach-orange sunset light, with high contrast rim lighting, glossy reflections, prismatic highlights on every bubble, painterly brush textures, dynamic diagonal composition, cinematic depth of field, intricate hair strands, and highly polished modern anime key visual quality. The mood should feel like {argument name="mood" default="beautiful apocalyptic wonder, weightless longing, and underwater-sky surrealism"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版动漫插画，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着超长飘逸黑发、拥有紫罗兰色双眸的少女"} 采用极端的低角度仰视视角，向观众伸出左手，手指在前景中呈现出夸张的透视感。她神情宁静、充满渴望，带着一丝忧郁，目光越过镜头向上望去。她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="深蓝色日式校服西装外套、白衬衫、松散的领带和百褶裙"}，在强风的吹拂下，外套、领带、裙摆和发丝如丝带般向外飘动。场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="日落时分超现实的城市街道水域"}，远处的建筑和电线杆在画面周围倾斜，下方波光粼粼的水面如同镜面般闪烁。空气中充斥着许多大小不一的虹彩透明泡泡，包括右上角一个巨大的被裁切泡泡、左下角一个大型被裁切泡泡，以及角色周围无数细小的漂浮水滴。在她的上方，加入一个巨大的深色鲸鱼剪影，仿佛在发光的蓝色天空中游动，如同置身水下，增添了梦幻般的尺度感。使用电钴蓝、青色、紫罗兰色、热粉色和温暖的桃橙色日落光影，打造高饱和度的色彩调色板，并结合高对比度的轮廓光、光泽反射、每个泡泡上的棱镜高光、油画质感的笔触、动态的对角线构图、电影级的景深、细腻的发丝纹理，呈现出高度精致的现代动漫主视觉品质。整体氛围应传达出 {argument name="mood" default="美丽的末日奇观、失重的渴望以及水下天空的超现实感"}。

templates.title: Jindaiji Temple Approach Background

titleLocalized.zh: 深大寺参道背景

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed anime-style background illustration of a quiet Japanese temple approach street near {argument name="location" default="Jindaiji Temple approach in Chofu, Tokyo"} on a clear spring or early summer morning. Show a gently curving stone-paved path leading from the foreground toward a set of shrine-temple steps and a thatched-roof gate on the left, with traditional wooden shop buildings lining the right side. The main shop is a soba restaurant with dark timber beams, tiled roofs, warm paper lanterns, a blue noren curtain, menu boards, and visible Japanese signage including {argument name="shop sign text" default="そば処"} and {argument name="temple sign text" default="深大寺参道"}. Include exactly 3 prominent vertical signs: one large wooden temple-approach sign in the left foreground, one pale blue hanging banner on the right shop, and one map/information board at the far right. Add exactly 4 visible shop lanterns around the restaurant frontage. Surround the street with dense leafy green trees, shrubs, potted plants, small white flowers, mossy stones, and a shallow clear water basin or stream at the lower right reflecting sunlight. Use soft dappled light filtering through the tree canopy, realistic perspective, lush layered foliage, intricate roof tiles and wood textures, peaceful nostalgic atmosphere, no people, wide cinematic composition, 16:9 aspect ratio, painterly but crisp Studio Ghibli-inspired Japanese background art.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的动画风格背景插画，描绘 {argument name="location" default="东京调布市深大寺参道"} 附近一条宁静的日本寺庙参道，时间设定在晴朗的春季或初夏早晨。画面中，一条微微弯曲的石板路从前景延伸至左侧的寺庙台阶和茅草屋顶门楼，右侧排列着传统的木质店铺。主店是一家荞麦面馆，拥有深色木梁、瓦片屋顶、温暖的纸灯笼、蓝色暖帘、菜单项目，以及清晰可见的日文招牌，包括 {argument name="shop sign text" default="そば処"} 和 {argument name="temple sign text" default="深大寺参道"}。画面中需包含 3 个醒目的垂直招牌：左侧前景处一个大型木质参道指示牌，右侧店铺上一个淡蓝色悬挂横幅，以及最右侧的一个地图/信息项目。在餐厅门面周围添加 4 个可见的店铺灯笼。街道四周环绕着茂密的绿树、灌木、盆栽、小白花、长满青苔的石头，右下角设有一个清澈的浅水池或溪流，倒映着阳光。运用透过树冠洒下的柔和斑驳光影，采用写实的透视效果，呈现层次丰富的植被、精细的瓦片和木纹质感，营造出宁静怀旧的氛围。画面中无人物，采用宽幅电影构图，16:9 比例，呈现出吉卜力工作室风格的绘画感与清晰度兼备的日本背景艺术。

templates.title: Elf Girl Walking Goat and Robot

titleLocalized.zh: 精灵女孩牵着山羊与机器人

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anime-realistic background scene on a quiet Japanese suburban residential street in {argument name="location" default="Chofu City, near Jindaiji-dori"} on a bright summer afternoon. A small elf girl with {argument name="hair color" default="pale blue bob-cut hair"}, pointed ears, and a calm profile expression walks from right to left across the foreground, wearing a loose white short-sleeved knee-length dress, white socks, and brown lace-up ankle boots. She holds a rope leash attached to a white goat walking beside her; the goat has short curved horns, shaggy fur, and follows obediently in side view. Behind the goat trails a compact dark steampunk robot companion, squat and armored, made of blackened metal plates, exposed gears, pipes, bolts, red lens eyes, and little horn-like antennae, walking like a loyal mechanical pet. The street slopes gently downhill into the distance, lined with concrete block walls, hedges, small two-story houses with tiled roofs, utility poles, overhead power lines, a curved streetlamp, guardrails, drainage grates, and leafy trees casting dappled shadows on the asphalt. The background should feel like a plausible real Japanese neighborhood, with detailed perspective, distant houses and greenery, blue sky, scattered white clouds, warm sunlight, soft atmospheric haze, and highly detailed painterly rendering. Blend whimsical fantasy characters naturally into a realistic urban environment, with consistent lighting and shadows, 16:9 landscape composition, eye-level camera, wide shot, no text, no signage emphasis.

promptLocalized.zh: 在 {argument name="location" default="调布市，近深大寺通"} 的一条宁静日本郊区住宅街道上，创作一个电影级动漫写实背景，时间设定在明亮的夏日午后。一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="淡蓝色波波头"}、长着尖耳朵、侧脸神情平静的小精灵女孩从前景右侧向左走去，她身穿宽松的白色短袖及膝连衣裙，搭配白袜和棕色系带短靴。她手中牵着一根绳子，绳子另一端系着一只走在她身旁的山羊；山羊长有短弯角，毛发蓬松，正侧身顺从地跟随。在山羊身后，跟着一个紧凑的深色蒸汽朋克机器人同伴，它矮小且带有装甲，由黑化的金属板、裸露的齿轮、管道、螺栓、红色镜头眼睛和类似小角的天线组成，像忠诚的机械宠物一样行走。街道向远处平缓下坡，两旁是混凝土砌块墙、树篱、带有瓦屋顶的小型两层住宅、电线杆、架空电线、弯曲的路灯、护栏、排水格栅，以及在沥青路面上投下斑驳阴影的茂密树木。背景应呈现出真实的日本社区质感，具备细腻的透视效果、远处的房屋与绿植、蓝天、零星的白云、温暖的阳光、柔和的大气雾感，以及高度精细的绘画渲染。将奇幻角色自然地融入写实的城市环境中，保持光影一致，采用 16:9 横向构图、平视视角、广角镜头，画面中无文字，不突出任何标识。

templates.title: Moody Censored Streetwear Portrait

templates.prompt: Create a moody cinematic editorial portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young man with messy medium-length dark dreadlocks"} sitting slouched in a worn dark armchair against a gritty teal-gray concrete wall. His face is intentionally obscured by a centered dark blurred square censor block, hiding all facial features. He wears {argument name="outerwear" default="a long deep red overcoat layered over a mustard yellow hoodie"}, loose baggy plaid cargo pants in red, yellow, and green tones, thick pale blue socks, and red-white-black high-top sneakers resembling classic basketball shoes. Pose him with legs spread wide, elbows resting on knees, hands hanging together in the center with realistic fingers, shoulders relaxed and brooding. Use dramatic low-key studio lighting from the upper left, rich shadows, a textured industrial floor with small debris, desaturated teal background, high contrast, photorealistic detail, 35mm editorial fashion photography, shallow depth of field, centered composition with empty negative space on the left, square 1:1 aspect ratio.

Lighting should be warm golden morning sunlight with soft botanical shadows cast across the background wall and can, elegant high-end product photography, shallow depth of field, natural highlights, calm atmosphere, creamy beige monochrome palette, ultra-detailed condensation, realistic reflections, square composition, no people.

The subject has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied back in a low ponytail, a curvy athletic build, natural skin texture, and a neutral pose; her face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular blur for anonymity in both panels. Use crisp smartphone-style documentary photography, realistic indoor pool lighting, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, accurate reflections, wet-look shiny swimsuit fabric, soft highlights on skin, and a clean editorial collage layout with a thin white divider between the two images.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的双联垂直照片拼贴，展示一名成年大码女性在室内游泳池的场景。她身穿一件海军蓝高开叉竞赛级连体泳衣，带有白色滚边，侧面印有 {argument name="swimsuit logo text" default="Queen Giant"} 字样。拼贴画包含 2 个面板：左侧面板为全身四分之三侧身站姿，背景是明亮的蓝色泳道，赤脚站在浅色池畔瓷砖上，一条腿微微前交叉，背景可见拱形玻璃钢结构天花板和泳道线；右侧面板为从上半身到大腿的近景肖像，背景是更衣室或泳池换衣区，带有镜子和白色窗帘，镜中映出她的背影。主体留有 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 的头发，扎成低马尾，拥有曲线优美的运动型身材、自然的皮肤纹理和中性的姿态；为了保持匿名，两个面板中她的面部均被平面的矩形模糊处理。采用清晰的智能手机纪实摄影风格、逼真的室内泳池灯光、浅至中等的景深、精准的反射效果、湿润光泽的泳衣面料、皮肤上的柔和高光，以及带有细白边分割线的简洁编辑风格拼贴布局。

templates.title: Anime Girl Breaking Out of Monitor

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女破屏而出

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic high-detail anime-style wallpaper of an {argument name="character type" default="adult silver-haired twin-tail anime girl"} bursting forward out of a large desktop monitor in an artist’s studio, as if breaking the screen into many sharp floating glass shards. The character has long pale silver hair in voluminous twin ponytails tied with glossy black ribbon bows, black frilly gothic-lolita maid-inspired clothing with white lace trim and a small black bow at the chest, and one arm reaching directly toward the viewer with strong foreshortening while the other hand braces against the monitor frame. Place a flat opaque {argument name="face censor color" default="muted gray-pink"} square over the face, centered and covering the facial features. The background is a cluttered digital art workspace: a large monitor glowing icy blue behind her, shelves with anime figures and posters, paintbrushes in cups, small bottles, pens, cables, and desk tools scattered around. Use cinematic lighting with bright blue screen glow, sparkling reflections on transparent glass fragments, shallow depth of field, motion blur on the closest shards and reaching hand, ultra-detailed hair strands, glossy fabric, realistic studio clutter, dynamic perspective, and a 16:9 desktop wallpaper composition at 1152×768 resolution. Overall mood: surreal, energetic, immersive, as though the anime character is escaping from the digital screen into the real world.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富、具有电影感的动漫风格壁纸，画面中一位 {argument name="character type" default="成年银发双马尾动漫少女"} 正从艺术家工作室的一台大型桌面显示器中向前冲出，仿佛将屏幕撞碎，化作许多锋利的悬浮玻璃碎片。该角色留着长长的浅银色头发，扎成蓬松的双马尾，系着亮面黑色丝带蝴蝶结；身穿黑色蕾丝边哥特洛丽塔风格女仆装，胸前饰有小黑蝴蝶结；一只手臂通过强烈的透视效果直接伸向观众，另一只手撑在显示器边框上。在面部中心位置覆盖一个不透明的 {argument name="face censor color" default="柔和灰粉色"} 正方形，遮住五官。背景是一个凌乱的数字艺术工作空间：她身后是一台发出冰蓝色光芒的大显示器，架子上摆放着动漫手办和海报，桌面上散落着笔筒、小瓶子、钢笔、线缆和各种桌面工具。采用电影级灯光，呈现明亮的屏幕蓝光、透明玻璃碎片上的闪烁反射、浅景深效果，近处的碎片和伸出的手带有动态模糊，发丝细节极致细腻，布料光泽感强，工作室陈设真实，透视感动态十足，构图为 16:9 桌面壁纸，分辨率为 1152×768。整体氛围：超现实、充满活力、沉浸感强，仿佛动漫角色正从数字屏幕中逃离到现实世界。

templates.title: Wukong Calligraphy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 悟空书法海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical vintage Chinese mythic poster on aged beige rice paper with visible fibers, cracks, scratches, and distressed print texture. The composition is dominated by two enormous black Chinese calligraphy characters reading {argument name="main calligraphy text" default="悟空"}, rendered as bold blocky brush typography filling almost the entire background from edge to edge. Place a small heroic Monkey King warrior figure near the lower center, walking left to right across a rough horizontal red cliff or platform; he wears dark ornate armor with ragged flowing red cloth ribbons, a golden headband or crown, and carries a long golden staff angled downward across his body. Behind the right side of the calligraphy, add a worn circular gold ink ring motif, like a faded seal or halo, partially overlapping the negative space of the character. Use a limited palette of matte black, parchment beige, blood red, and tarnished gold, with high contrast, rough screen-printed edges, ink bleed, grunge speckles, and cinematic wuxia energy. Make the figure tiny compared with the monumental typography to emphasize scale and legend. No modern objects, no border, poster-style centered layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版复古中国神话海报，背景为带有明显纤维、裂纹、划痕和做旧印刷质感的米色陈年宣纸。构图主体为两个巨大的黑色中式书法大字，内容为 {argument name="main calligraphy text" default="悟空"}，采用粗犷厚重的笔触，几乎填满整个背景边缘。在画面下方中央位置放置一个渺小的英雄孙悟空战士形象，他正从左向右走在粗糙的红色横向悬崖或平台上；他身穿深色华丽盔甲，配有破旧飘逸的红色绸带和金色头箍，手中横持一根向下倾斜的金色长棍。在书法右侧后方，添加一个磨损的圆形金色墨迹环图案，如同褪色的印章或光环，部分重叠在文字的留白处。采用哑光黑、羊皮纸米色、血红色和暗金色的有限配色方案，强调高对比度、粗糙的丝网印刷边缘、墨迹晕染、污渍斑点以及电影般的武侠气场。人物与宏大的书法字相比显得极其渺小，以突显规模感与传奇色彩。无现代物体，无边框，海报风格居中布局。

templates.title: Forbidden City Typography Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 故宫字体海报

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist cinematic Chinese typography poster on aged warm beige paper, centered on the giant deep vermilion Chinese headline text {argument name="headline text" default="故宫"}. The two massive characters should dominate the frame like monumental palace architecture, with their strokes behaving as red Forbidden City walls. Add traditional golden-glazed imperial rooflines and ornate eaves sitting along the top edges of the characters, including small decorative roof beasts. The characters stand across the far side of a vast empty stone courtyard, with pale marble balustrades and symmetrical terraces at the base. In the exact center foreground, place one tiny solitary person in a dark coat facing the characters to emphasize scale. Use a low, frontal, symmetrical composition, lots of negative space in the upper beige sky, muted historical tones, subtle film grain, worn paper texture, slight weathering on the red paint, and an elegant poster-design aesthetic inspired by Chinese cultural heritage and the Forbidden City. No extra text, no logo, no border.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极简主义电影质感的中国字体海报，背景为陈旧的暖米色纸张，画面中心为巨大的深朱红色中文标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="故宫"}。这两个巨大的字符应像宏伟的宫殿建筑一样占据画面主体，其笔画呈现为红色的故宫宫墙。在字符顶端边缘添加传统的金黄色琉璃瓦屋顶和华丽的檐角，并包含小巧的装饰性屋脊兽。字符矗立在广阔空旷的石质庭院远端，底部配有浅色大理石栏杆和对称的露台。在画面正前方的中心位置，放置一个身穿深色外套的微小孤独身影，以突显比例感。采用低视角、正面、对称的构图，上方米色天空留出大量负空间，运用柔和的历史色调、细腻的胶片颗粒感、磨损的纸张纹理、红色漆面的轻微风化效果，以及受中国文化遗产和故宫启发的优雅海报设计美学。无需额外文字、Logo 或边框。

templates.title: Parallel Protocol Sci-Fi Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Parallel Protocol 科幻电影海报

templates.prompt: Create a gritty retro-futurist deep-sea science fiction movie poster in a tall 2:3 theatrical one-sheet format, with a dark navy-black worn paper background, orange and tan ink, subtle vertical fold marks, scratches, halftone grain, barcode-like production marks, thin technical diagram lines, sonar contour waves, crosshair symbols, small star glints, and wireframe globe icons. At the very top place the tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="TRUST NO SYSTEM. QUESTION EVERYTHING."} in small condensed tan uppercase lettering. Dominating the upper third, use huge jagged orange brush lettering for the title {argument name="movie title" default="PARALLEL PROTOCOL"}, split around a small centered boxed credit reading “A FILM BY N.MART.” The poster features exactly 4 futuristic operatives standing shoulder-to-shoulder in dramatic low-angle lighting: left, a dark armored soldier with long hair, glossy black tactical suit and weapon harness; center-left, the lead woman in a black tailored blazer over a short black dress, lace thigh-high stockings, garters, gloves, braided updo, and a confident commanding stance; center-right, a figure in a flowing white deep-sea pressure coat with blue wave-like patterns, black breathing apparatus and cybernetic gear; right, a black armored female operative with orange illuminated weapon details and heavy tactical cables. Faces should be cinematic but unobscured, with moody rim lighting in burnt orange and cool blue. Add exactly 2 critic quotes: left quote “A VISUALLY STUNNING RIDE.” with attribution “— FILM PULSE,” and right quote “BOLD. STYLISH. UNFORGETTABLE.” with attribution “— INDIE WIRE.” Along the left margin include vertical studio text “N.MART STUDIOS” and the year “2025.” Near the lower character feet place exactly 4 cast names in small orange uppercase: “ELIOT VALE,” “MILES KORBEN,” “JULIAN HART,” and “LEO DRAKE.” In the lower center, add “IN THEATERS” above a huge tan release date {argument name="release date" default="06.27.2025"}, followed by “EXPERIENCE IT IN IMAX AND REALD 3D,” with “IMAX” emphasized in orange. Finish with tiny production credits across the bottom, an “N.MART STUDIOS” logo box on the bottom left, a PG-13 rating box on the bottom right, and a small barcode strip centered near the bottom. templates.title: Gritty Urban Restroom Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 粗粝都市洗手间时尚人像

templates.prompt: A highly detailed cinematic photograph of a {argument name="subject description" default="beautiful young woman with long wavy fiery blonde hair and fair skin with light freckles"}, standing in a {argument name="location" default="uncleaned neglected public restroom with peeling light green tiles covered in colorful graffiti and stickers"}. She is wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="sleek white glitter strapless mini dress"} and applying vibrant red lipstick with a lipstick tube in her right hand while her left hand rests on the edge of a sink. Her head is slightly turned to the side with a confident gaze. The environment features cracked mirrors with reflections, scattered trash and paper on the floor and counters, a little graffiti written 'Keor' somewhere, a pink fluorescent light tube on the ceiling casting dramatic pink and warm lighting, damaged walls, and an overall gritty urban atmosphere with high detail, realistic textures, and moody cinematic composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度细节的电影感摄影照片，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着波浪长发、火红色头发、皮肤白皙且带有淡淡雀斑的年轻美女"}，正站在 {argument name="setting" default="一个未经清理、破败不堪的公共洗手间内，墙面是剥落的浅绿色瓷砖，布满了色彩斑斓的涂鸦和贴纸"}。她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件修身的白色闪亮抹胸迷你裙"}，右手拿着口红管正在涂抹鲜艳的红色口红，左手轻搭在洗手池边缘。她的头微微转向一侧，眼神自信。环境细节包括带有倒影的破碎镜子、地面和台面上散落的垃圾与纸张、某处写着“Keor”的涂鸦、天花板上一根发出戏剧性粉色和暖色调灯光的荧光灯管、受损的墙壁，以及整体呈现出一种粗粝的都市氛围，具有极高的细节、真实的质感和情绪化的电影构图。

templates.title: Luxury Magazine Cover Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华杂志封面变身

templates.prompt: Transform the subject into a high-end magazine cover portrait while preserving 100% facial identity, facial structure, skin tone, proportions, and all unique facial features. Do not alter eyes, nose, mouth, jawline, or facial shape. Maintain realistic skin texture, pores, and natural imperfections. Style the image like a luxury international magazine cover photoshoot, with cinematic studio lighting, premium fashion photography composition, and ultra-clean editorial aesthetics. The subject should appear confident, elegant, and professionally photographed, wearing stylish modern clothing that matches a sophisticated luxury aesthetic. Use soft directional lighting with subtle shadows and depth, creating a polished studio look similar to {argument name="magazine" default="Vogue, GQ, Forbes, or Harper’s Bazaar"} covers. Background should be minimal, elegant, and slightly textured or gradient-based, matching the color palette of the outfit and overall mood. Add authentic magazine cover elements: realistic masthead typography, elegant headlines and feature text, issue number, barcode, and small editorial details, clean layout with professional spacing. Keep all typography subtle and realistic, integrated naturally into the composition. Depth of field should keep the subject in sharp focus while maintaining a premium cinematic atmosphere. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, editorial photography, luxury magazine aesthetic, highly polished, cinematic, 8K quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 将拍摄对象转化为高端杂志封面肖像，同时 100% 保留其面部身份、面部结构、肤色、比例以及所有独特的面部特征。不得改变眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、下颌线或脸型。保持真实的皮肤纹理、毛孔和自然的瑕疵。将图像风格化为奢华国际杂志的封面拍摄效果，采用电影级摄影棚灯光、高级时尚摄影构图以及极简的编辑美学。拍摄对象应看起来自信、优雅，并呈现出专业摄影的效果，穿着与精致奢华美学相符的时尚现代服装。使用柔和的定向光，营造出细微的阴影和深度，打造出类似于 {argument name="magazine" default="Vogue、GQ、Forbes 或 Harper’s Bazaar"} 封面的精致摄影棚质感。背景应简洁、优雅，并带有轻微的纹理或渐变效果，与服装的色调和整体氛围相匹配。添加真实的杂志封面元素：逼真的刊头排版、优雅的标题和专题文字、期号、条形码以及细小的编辑细节，布局整洁且间距专业。保持所有排版微妙且真实，自然地融入构图之中。景深应使拍摄对象保持清晰对焦，同时营造出高级的电影氛围。超细节、照片级真实感、编辑摄影、奢华杂志美学、高度精致、电影感、8K 画质。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Storyboard Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻故事板信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a wide cinematic 9-panel storyboard infographic for a dark fantasy transformation sequence. Style: ultra-realistic photography, cinematic concept art, film-production storyboard aesthetic, hyper-detailed textures, realistic lighting, movie pre-visualization quality. Layout: clean 3x3 grid with evenly spaced frames, each panel clearly numbered with bold cinematic titles and short bullet-point production notes beneath each image. Color grading: cold teal-blue moonlight mixed with warm orange lava glow, dramatic contrast, volumetric fog, realistic shadows, cinematic atmosphere. Aspect ratio: ultra-wide storyboard sheet, professional Hollywood pre-production design. PANEL 1 — “Frozen Ruins” Wide aerial establishing shot of a devastated frozen ruin at night. Shattered icy ground, drifting fog, ancient broken pillars covered in frost, snow blowing through the ruins. Tiny exhausted dark-haired woman visible lying on the ice. Bullet points inside panel: • Wide aerial establishing shot • Blue moonlight reflections • Heavy atmospheric fog • Ancient frozen ruins PANEL 2 — “The Fallen Woman” Medium-wide shot of the exhausted woman lying on cracked ice. Torn black-gray clothing, pale skin, trembling fingers, visible breath in cold air. Emotion: pain, desperation, exhaustion. Bullet points: • Character introduction • Torn dark clothing • Ice texture detail • Emotional vulnerability PANEL 3 — “Pain Awakens” Close-up on her face as she struggles to rise. Frost on skin, strands of dark hair across face, eyes filled with fear. Small glowing orange cracks begin appearing beneath her skin. Bullet points: • Close-up emotional shot • Molten glow beneath skin • Fear and desperation • Cinematic push-in camera PANEL 4 — “Lava Veins” Extreme close-up of glowing lava-like cracks spreading across her arm and neck. Skin illuminated from within by molten orange energy. Ice beneath her starts cracking violently. Bullet points: • Transformation begins • Orange magma veins • Cracking frozen ground • High-detail skin deformation PANEL 5 — “Bone Shift” Dynamic side-angle shot of her spine bending unnaturally while fingers elongate. Bones visibly shifting under skin with realistic body horror deformation. Fog and snow swirl around violently. Bullet points: • Spine deformation • Aggressive morphing • Dynamic camera angle • Violent environmental reaction PANEL 6 — “Flesh to Fur” Mid-transformation sequence. Human body partially dissolving into black fur and panther anatomy. Limbs reshaping fluidly. Embers erupt into the cold air. Bullet points: • Flesh reforming • Fur generation effects • Embers and debris • Seamless morph VFX PANEL 7 — “The Beast Emerges” Full reveal of the massive black panther standing on shattered ice. Glowing lava cracks across body, fiery orange eyes, steam rising from fur. Dramatic moonlight silhouette. Bullet points: • Full creature reveal • Lava crack patterns • Cinematic silhouette • Dark fantasy realism PANEL 8 — “Roar of Fury” Intense close-up action shot of the panther roaring directly toward camera. Motion blur, handheld shake energy, flying debris, glowing embers, ultra-detailed fur simulation. Bullet points: • Aggressive roar shot • Handheld camera shake • Flying debris particles • High-intensity action PANEL 9 — “Storm Transition” Final cinematic frame. The roaring panther sharply turns its head toward the sky as dark storm clouds begin forming overhead. Blue lightning faintly visible in distance. Dramatic ending composition. Bullet points: • Storm clouds forming • Transition setup shot • Blue lightning atmosphere • Cinematic ending frame Overall design requirements: • Professional film storyboard infographic • Clean 3x3 grid composition • Bold numbered panels • Large cinematic titles • Minimal modern typography • Consistent visual continuity between frames • Hyper-realistic dark fantasy style • Realistic photography textures • Volumetric lighting and fog • Warm orange vs cool teal cinematic palette • Production-quality concept art • 8K ultra-detail • Smooth visual storytelling progression • Looks like a Hollywood movie pre-visualization board

templates.title: Urban Fashion Editorial Collage Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 都市时尚编辑风拼贴海报

templates.prompt:
Create a high-resolution 8K portrait poster in an {argument name="editorial style" default="Urban Fashion Editorial Collage"} style, blending contemporary street-fashion aesthetics with premium editorial magazine design. The overall composition should feel bold, stylish, modern, and visually layered, combining elements of luxury fashion campaigns, urban culture, and artistic collage experimentation. Incorporate dynamic poster ornaments and decorative elements that strongly reflect the Urban Fashion Editorial Collage aesthetic, such as ripped paper textures, layered magazine cutouts, abstract geometric accents, expressive brush strokes, typography fragments, street-style graphic overlays, halftone textures, tape effects, paint splashes, handwritten scribbles, and fashionable editorial layout compositions. Every decorative element should feel intentional, stylish, and visually balanced rather than overcrowded. Humanity really looked at torn paper and graffiti textures and decided, “yes, this is luxury now.” Somehow it works.

The subject’s pose must not resemble the reference photo. Create a completely different body posture and facial expression with a more natural, expressive, and emotionally alive presence. Avoid stiff, awkward, flat, or overly symmetrical posing. The subject should radiate the confident elegance of an {argument name="model type" default="international fashion model"}, with fluid body language, subtle movement, and a cinematic editorial attitude. The expression should feel charismatic, effortless, fashionable, and modern, as if captured during a high-end streetwear magazine photoshoot rather than a static studio portrait. Add slight motion energy through posture, clothing movement, hand placement, camera angle, or gaze direction to make the composition feel more alive and dynamic.

The outfit must feature {argument name="clothing style" default="modern casual fashion"} with a stylish and trendy urban aesthetic. Avoid monotonous clothing design, colors, or materials. Combine fashionable layers, contemporary cuts, unique textures, stylish accessories, and varied color palettes that complement the poster composition. The clothing should feel premium, youthful, and fashion-forward, inspired by global streetwear and luxury casual editorial styling. Mix different fabric materials, patterns, and tones naturally to create visual richness without making the outfit look chaotic or overly exaggerated.

Use dramatic editorial lighting with strong contrast and depth to enhance the fashion atmosphere. The background should integrate seamlessly with the collage elements, creating a visually immersive poster composition filled with layered urban energy and modern fashion identity. Maintain a clean balance between subject visibility and decorative complexity so the poster still feels premium and professionally art-directed. The final result should look like a sophisticated international fashion campaign poster with a strong urban editorial character, ultra-detailed textures, crisp focus, cinematic color grading, and highly polished

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张 8K 高分辨率人像海报，风格采用 {argument name="editorial style" default="都市时尚编辑风拼贴"}，融合当代街头时尚美学与高级杂志编辑设计。整体构图应大胆、时髦、现代且具有视觉层次感，结合奢侈时尚大片、都市文化及艺术拼贴实验等元素。融入强力体现“都市时尚编辑风拼贴”美学的动态海报装饰与装饰元素，例如撕纸质感、分层杂志剪贴、抽象几何点缀、表现力十足的笔触、排版碎片、街头风格图形叠加、半色调纹理、胶带效果、油漆飞溅、手写涂鸦以及时尚的编辑排版构图。每一个装饰元素都应显得刻意、时髦且视觉平衡，而非过度堆砌。人类看着撕纸和涂鸦纹理，竟然觉得“没错，这就是奢华”，而且效果出奇地好。

人物姿势不得与参考照片雷同。请创作一个完全不同的身体姿态和面部表情，使其更自然、更具表现力且充满情感生命力。避免僵硬、尴尬、扁平或过于对称的姿势。人物应散发出 {argument name="model type" default="国际时尚模特"} 的自信优雅，具备流畅的肢体语言、细微的动态以及电影级的编辑风态度。表情应充满魅力、自然、时尚且现代，仿佛是在高端街头时尚杂志拍摄现场捕捉到的瞬间，而非静态的影棚肖像。通过姿势、服装动态、手部摆放、拍摄角度或视线方向增加轻微的运动感，使构图更具生命力和张力。

服装必须采用 {argument name="clothing style" default="现代休闲时尚"}，展现时髦且潮流的都市美学。避免单调的服装设计、色彩或材质。结合时尚的叠穿、现代剪裁、独特的纹理、时髦的配饰以及与海报构图相辅相成的多样化配色。服装应体现高级感、年轻化和前卫感，灵感源自全球街头服饰与奢侈休闲编辑造型。自然地混合不同的面料、图案和色调，在不显得混乱或过度夸张的前提下创造视觉丰富度。

使用具有强烈对比度和深度的戏剧性编辑灯光，以增强时尚氛围。背景应与拼贴元素无缝融合，营造出充满都市活力与现代时尚特质的沉浸式海报构图。在主体可见度与装饰复杂性之间保持干净的平衡，使海报依然保持高级感和专业的艺术指导水准。最终成品应呈现为一张精致的国际时尚宣传海报，具备强烈的都市编辑风格、超细腻的纹理、清晰的对焦、电影级的调色以及高度的精致感。

templates.prompt:
Create a high-resolution 8K portrait poster in an {argument name="collage style" default="Urban Fashion Editorial Collage"} style, blending contemporary street-fashion aesthetics with premium editorial magazine design. Every decorative element should feel intentional, stylish, and visually balanced rather than overcrowded. Humanity really looked at torn paper and graffiti textures and decided, “yes, this is luxury now.” Somehow it works.

The subject’s pose must not resemble the reference photo. Create a completely different body posture and facial expression with a more natural, expressive, and emotionally alive presence. Avoid stiff, awkward, flat, or overly symmetrical posing. The subject should radiate the confident elegance of an international fashion model, with fluid body language, subtle movement, and a cinematic editorial attitude. The expression should feel charismatic, effortless, fashionable, and modern, as if captured during a high-end streetwear magazine photoshoot rather than a static studio portrait. Add slight motion energy through posture, clothing movement, hand placement, camera angle, or gaze direction to make the composition feel more alive and dynamic.

The outfit must feature {argument name="clothing style" default="modern casual fashion"} with a stylish and trendy urban aesthetic. Avoid monotonous clothing design, colors, or materials. Combine fashionable layers, contemporary cuts, unique textures, stylish accessories, and varied color palettes that complement the poster composition. The clothing should feel premium, youthful, and fashion-forward, inspired by global streetwear and luxury casual editorial styling. Mix different fabric materials, patterns, and tones naturally to create visual richness without making the outfit look chaotic or overly exaggerated.

Use dramatic editorial lighting with strong contrast and depth to enhance the fashion atmosphere. The background should integrate seamlessly with the collage elements, creating a visually immersive poster composition filled with layered urban energy and modern fashion identity. Maintain a clean balance between subject visibility and decorative complexity so the poster still feels premium and professionally art-directed. The final result should look like a sophisticated international fashion campaign poster with a strong urban editorial character, ultra-detailed textures, crisp focus, cinematic color grading, and highly polished visual storytelling.

创建一个高分辨率 8K 人像海报，风格为 {argument name="collage style" default="Urban Fashion Editorial Collage"}，融合当代街头时尚美学与高端编辑杂志设计。整体构图应大胆、时尚、现代且具有视觉层次感，结合奢侈时尚广告、都市文化和艺术拼贴实验的元素。融入强力体现 Urban Fashion Editorial Collage 美学的动态海报装饰和装饰元素，例如撕纸纹理、分层杂志剪贴画、抽象几何装饰、表现力强的笔触、排版碎片、街头风格图形叠加、半色调纹理、胶带效果、油漆飞溅、手写涂鸦以及时尚的编辑排版构图。每个装饰元素都应显得刻意、时尚且视觉平衡，而非过度拥挤。人类竟然看着撕碎的纸张和涂鸦纹理，然后决定：“没错，这就是奢华。”不知为何，这确实行得通。

主体的姿势不得与参考照片相似。创造一个完全不同的身体姿态和面部表情，使其呈现出更自然、更具表现力且充满情感活力的状态。避免僵硬、尴尬、平淡或过度对称的姿势。主体应散发出国际时尚模特自信的优雅感，展现流畅的肢体语言、细微的动作、以及电影般的编辑态度。表情应显得富有魅力、从容不迫、时尚且现代，仿佛是在高端街头时尚杂志拍摄现场捕捉到的瞬间，而非静态的影棚肖像。通过姿势、服装动态、手部摆放、摄像机角度或视线方向增加轻微的动态能量，使构图看起来更生动、更有活力。

templates.title: Vintage Qipao Mother and Daughter Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古旗袍母女肖像

templates.prompt: Please generate a vintage Qipao-style mother-daughter photo shoot based on the two real female photos uploaded by the user. Character settings: The young woman is the daughter, 28 years old; the older woman is the mother, 56 years old. Please strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of each person, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, sense of age, hairstyle base, and overall temperament. The mother should retain a natural sense of maturity and slight traces of time; nasolabial folds should be shallow, not too heavy, but not completely smoothed out. The daughter should maintain her young, natural, and delicate characteristics. Overall style: Vintage Oriental Qipao photo shoot, quiet, gentle, and dignified, with the atmosphere of a commemorative mother-daughter portrait. The image features soft studio lighting, with a slight film feel and a faint oil painting quality. The background is a grey-green, blue-grey, or slate-grey vintage studio backdrop, potentially including slight flower branches, canvas texture, or Chinese wooden elements. Clothing and hairstyle: The mother wears a light grey-green, lake blue, or grey-blue traditional Qipao; the daughter wears a dark blue, navy, or black-blue improved Qipao. Both outfits belong to the same visual system. Hairstyles should be handled naturally based on original hair length, overall appearing dignified and neat with a Chinese-style updos or gathered feel; long hair can be a low bun or chignon, while short hair maintains its base with a side part, tucked behind the ears, or a vintage short hairstyle. Quality requirements: Realistic photographic texture, low saturation, high-end, and soft; no excessive skin smoothing, no 'fake' faces. Composition 1: Single photo in 3:4 vertical orientation, double half-body composition, characters close together, balanced and relaxed. Content 1: Mother and daughter standing side-by-side, daughter on one side of the mother, body leaning slightly toward her, naturally holding the mother's arm or leaning on her shoulder. Both look at the camera with gentle, quiet, and dignified expressions, carrying a restrained natural smile. Atmosphere 1: This image focuses on the formal, authentic, and dignified visual of a mother-daughter commemorative portrait. Composition 2: Single photo in 3:4 vertical orientation, close-up or near half-body composition, highlighting the relationship between faces, shoulders, and hands. Content 2: Daughter approaches gently from behind or the side-rear of the mother, one hand resting naturally on the mother's shoulder. There should be a natural interactive response: they could be smiling at each other, or the daughter looking tenderly at the mother while the mother turns her head slightly in response. Overall intimate, soft, and companionable. Atmosphere 2: Focuses on the authentic, gentle, and responsive sense of the mother-daughter relationship. Composition 3: Single photo in 3:4 vertical orientation, medium or 3/4 body composition, clearly showing the relationship between sitting and standing postures and displaying part of the Qipao silhouettes. Content 3: Mother sitting on a Chinese wooden chair, daughter standing behind or to the side-rear, one hand resting gently on the mother's shoulder or the chair back. Both look at the camera, with quiet, calm, and dignified expressions. A small side table, blue and white porcelain vase, and white flower branches can be added on one side as accents. Atmosphere 3: Focuses on the layers of the mother-daughter relationship and the vintage sense of ritual. Composition 4: Single photo in 3:4 vertical orientation, full-body or near full-body composition, natural and relaxed proportions, fully displaying the overall styling. Content 4: Mother and daughter standing side-by-side, daughter naturally close to the mother, possibly holding her arm. Mother can naturally hold a round silk fan or have hands naturally folded. Both look at the camera together, with gentle, dignified, and peaceful expressions. Background can include Chinese wooden frames, a side table, blue and white porcelain, or light-colored flower branches to enhance completeness. Atmosphere 4: The complete mother-daughter commemorative portrait of the set, focusing on overall styling, complete composition, and a gentle, dignified mother-daughter temperament.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据用户上传的两张真实女性照片，生成一组复古旗袍风格的母女合影。人物设定：年轻女性为女儿，28 岁；年长女性为母亲，56 岁。请严格保留每个人的真实身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型基础以及整体气质。母亲应保留自然的成熟感和岁月的痕迹；法令纹应较浅，不宜过重，但也不要完全磨平。女儿应保持年轻、自然且精致的特征。整体风格：复古东方旗袍影棚照，安静、温婉、端庄，具有纪念意义的母女肖像氛围。画面采用柔和的影棚光，带有轻微的胶片感和淡淡的油画质感。背景为灰绿色、蓝灰色或板岩灰色的复古影棚背景，可包含少许花枝、帆布纹理或中式木质元素。服装与发型：母亲身着浅灰绿色、湖蓝色或灰蓝色传统旗袍；女儿身着深蓝色、藏青色或墨蓝色改良旗袍。两套服装属于同一视觉体系。发型应根据原有发长自然处理，整体显得端庄整洁，采用中式盘发或聚拢感发型；长发可梳成低发髻或发髻，短发保持原有基础，侧分并别在耳后，或采用复古短发造型。质量要求：写实摄影质感，低饱和度，高级且柔和；无过度磨皮，无“假脸”。构图 1：3:4 竖构图单张照片，双人半身构图，人物靠近，平衡且放松。内容 1：母女并肩站立，女儿站在母亲一侧，身体微微向母亲倾斜，自然地挽着母亲的手臂或靠在母亲肩上。两人看向镜头，表情温婉、安静、端庄，带着克制自然的微笑。氛围 1：此图侧重于母女纪念肖像正式、真实且端庄的视觉效果。构图 2：3:4 竖构图单张照片，特写或近半身构图，突出面部、肩膀和手部的关系。内容 2：女儿从母亲身后或侧后方轻轻靠近，一只手自然地搭在母亲肩上。应有自然的互动反馈：她们可以互相对视微笑，或者女儿温柔地看着母亲，母亲微微转头回应。整体亲密、柔和且具有陪伴感。氛围 2：侧重于母女关系真实、温柔且有互动感的呈现。构图 3：3:4 竖构图单张照片，中景或 3/4 身构图，清晰展示坐姿与站姿的关系，并展示部分旗袍轮廓。内容 3：母亲坐在中式木椅上，女儿站在身后或侧后方，一只手轻轻搭在母亲肩上或椅背上。两人看向镜头，表情安静、从容、端庄。一侧可添加小边桌、青花瓷瓶和白色花枝作为点缀。氛围 3：侧重于母女关系的层次感和复古的仪式感。构图 4：3:4 竖构图单张照片，全身或近全身构图，比例自然放松，完整展示整体造型。内容 4：母女并肩站立，女儿自然地靠近母亲，可能挽着母亲的手臂。母亲可以自然地手持团扇或双手自然交叠。两人一同看向镜头，表情温婉、端庄、平和。背景可包含中式木框、边桌、青花瓷或浅色花枝以增强完整性。氛围 4：该系列完整的母女纪念肖像，侧重于整体造型、完整构图以及温婉端庄的母女气质。

A hand holds a 3D profile card for X (similar to Twitter), which is a rounded rectangle with a square cutout in the middle. Bottom stats: 1,487 Following / {argument name="followers" default="247K"} Followers / 3.1M Likes. Hand-drawn style like, comment, and share icons surround the card, glowing softly. The subject should present an elegant, majestic, and divine temperament with a dignified face, not a common ancient-style beauty. Intricate gold hair crowns, pearl chains, and jewelry are worn. Clothing is luxurious with smooth lines and rhythmic flying celestial qualities.
Gold structure requirements:
Strengthen structural gold usage to form a clear luxurious order. Use gold tracing, liquid gold, and gold leaf on crowns, clothing edges, and embroidery. Sacred elements like halos, lotus petals, and borders should have visible but restrained high-end gold decoration, presenting a 'worn but luxurious' texture.
Color requirements:
Colors include ochre red, cinnabar, stone green, stone blue, and ivory white, supplemented by refined gold. The tone is rich, thick, and elegant.
Decorative elements:
Integrate flying celestials, lotuses, auspicious clouds, and classical border decorations. Keep accompanying figures minimal (e.g., Sudhana) to maintain focus on the main subject.
Texture requirements:
Emphasize old grotto mural and mineral pigment textures, with visible cracks, weathering, and historal patina, while retaining the luster of gold leaf for a high-end artistic feel.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一幅以 [{argument name="core character" default="水月观音"}] 为核心的敦煌壁画风格高端艺术作品。构图采用圆形背光月轮为中心，以主角为唯一的视觉核心，表现其俯瞰清泉、安详静坐的神圣瞬间。氛围应空灵、静谧且圆满，具备博物馆级的审美与文化深度。
人物要求：
主体应呈现优雅、庄严且神圣的气质，面容端庄，而非普通的古风美女。佩戴精致的金质宝冠、珍珠链及珠宝。服饰华丽，线条流畅，具有灵动的飞天质感。
金饰结构要求：
强化结构性金饰的使用，形成清晰的奢华秩序。在宝冠、衣缘和刺绣上运用描金、流金及贴金工艺。光环、莲瓣及边框等神圣元素应具有可见但克制的精致金饰装饰，呈现出“古朴而奢华”的质感。
色彩要求：
色彩包括赭红、朱砂、石绿、石青及象牙白，辅以精炼的金色。色调浓郁、厚重且典雅。
装饰元素：
融入飞天、莲花、祥云及古典边饰。尽量减少陪衬人物（如善财童子），以保持对主体的高度聚焦。
质感要求：
强调古石窟壁画与矿物颜料的质感，呈现可见的裂纹、风化及历史包浆，同时保留金箔的光泽，营造出高端的艺术氛围。

templates.prompt: Create a high-fashion editorial photograph of a tall runway model wearing a dramatic {argument name="gown color" default="crimson red"} silk halter gown with a twisted high neckline, open shoulders, and voluminous flowing fabric caught by the wind, standing ankle-deep in reflective floodwater in {argument name="location" default="a Venetian piazza resembling Piazza San Marco"}. The model is centered in a powerful full-body pose, one side of the dress billowing outward like a sail, wet hem trailing through the water, with the face softly obscured and no visible text. Surround the scene with ornate Venetian arcades, marble columns, historic façades, and the domes and spires of a grand basilica in the background. Use {argument name="lighting" default="golden hour"} warm backlight, glowing haze, long architectural shadows, and shimmering reflections across the water. Style it as a {argument name="editorial style" default="Vogue Italia"} luxury fashion spread shot on {argument name="camera format" default="medium format film"}, with cinematic realism, rich fabric texture, elegant composition, shallow depth of field, symmetrical perspective, natural water ripples, and a refined, dramatic, magazine-cover atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高级时尚编辑摄影照片，画面中一位高挑的 T 台模特身着一件引人注目的 {argument name="gown color" default="深红色"} 丝绸挂脖礼服，礼服采用扭结高领设计，露肩剪裁，飘逸的裙摆在风中飞舞。模特站在 {argument name="location" default="类似圣马可广场的威尼斯广场"} 的积水中，水深没过脚踝。模特位于画面中心，姿态充满张力，全身入镜，裙摆一侧如风帆般向外鼓起，湿润的裙边拖曳在水中，面部轮廓柔和模糊，画面中无任何文字。背景环绕着华丽的威尼斯拱廊、大理石柱、历史悠久的建筑立面以及宏伟的大教堂圆顶和尖塔。采用 {argument name="lighting" default="黄金时刻"} 的暖色背光、发光的雾气、拉长的建筑阴影以及水面上波光粼粼的倒影。风格设定为 {argument name="editorial style" default="Vogue Italia"} 奢华时尚大片，使用 {argument name="camera format" default="中画幅胶片"} 拍摄，呈现电影般的写实感、丰富的面料质感、优雅的构图、浅景深、对称的视角、自然的水波纹，以及精致、戏剧性且适合杂志封面的氛围。

variables.defaultValue: a Venetian piazza resembling Piazza San Marco

templates.title: Whale Shark in Sunbeam

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光下的鲸鲨

templates.prompt: Create a realistic wide-angle underwater wildlife photograph of a {argument name="main animal" default="whale shark"} swimming diagonally through deep blue ocean water, viewed from slightly above and in front so its broad spotted head dominates the lower-left foreground and its tapering body and tail recede toward the lower-right. The whale shark should have accurate white polka-dot and stripe markings across gray-blue skin, visible gill slits, pectoral fins, dorsal fins, and a graceful slow-swimming posture. A single scuba diver silhouette with fins and tank appears far above the shark near the upper center, small for scale. A warm golden sunbeam cuts diagonally from the upper-right toward the lower-left, illuminating suspended particles, bubbles, and plankton in the water. Use natural light, deep turquoise-to-navy color grading, soft underwater haze, realistic caustic glow, cinematic depth, subtle motion blur in drifting particles, and an immersive documentary feel. No text, no borders, no artificial aquarium setting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的广角水下野生动物摄影作品，画面中一只 {argument name="main animal" default="whale shark"} 正斜向游过深蓝色的海水。视角略高于并位于其前方，使其宽阔且带有斑点的头部占据左下角前景，身体和尾部向右下方延伸。鲸鲨的灰蓝色皮肤上应有准确的白色圆点和条纹标记，可见鳃裂、胸鳍、背鳍，并呈现出优雅缓慢的游动姿态。画面上方中央远处可见一个潜水员的剪影（带有脚蹼和气瓶），作为比例参照。一束温暖的金色阳光从右上角斜向射向左下角，照亮了水中的悬浮颗粒、气泡和浮游生物。使用自然光，采用深绿松石色到海军蓝的调色，营造柔和的水下雾气、逼真的焦散光影、电影级的景深，以及漂浮颗粒带来的细微动态模糊，呈现沉浸式的纪录片质感。无文字，无边框，非人工水族馆背景。

templates.title: Candid Night Market Food Stall Friends

titleLocalized.zh: 夜市小摊好友抓拍

templates.prompt: Create an authentic candid daily-life photograph in a realistic documentary style: a medium shot of two young women standing close together at a night market food stall at night, framed from the waist up from a direct frontal angle. The left woman is {argument name="first subject ethnicity" default="East Asian"}, early 20s, wearing an oversized {argument name="left outfit" default="pale cream crew-neck sweatshirt"} with a thin black shoulder bag strap and a small delicate necklace; her dark hair is loosely tied up with a few stray wisps. The right woman is {argument name="second subject ethnicity" default="African"}, early 20s, wearing a fitted {argument name="right outfit" default="dark brown long-sleeve scoop-neck top"} with a black shoulder bag strap and her natural curly hair gathered high into a puff bun. Both lean slightly toward each other, relaxed and unposed, looking downward at a small white paper food tray held between them; the left woman uses a toothpick or small skewer to pick up food while the right woman supports the tray with both hands. Their faces are deliberately covered by two solid opaque rectangular privacy blocks in brown tones, one over each face, matching their approximate skin tones. Behind them is a warmly lit night-market stall with glowing orange paper lanterns, glass display case, trays of fried street food, soft steam or haze, and blurred pedestrians and neon bokeh receding into the dark street. Use warm amber overhead stall lighting from above and behind the counter, strong natural highlights on clothing and hands, shallow depth of field, 35mm documentary photography feel, high ISO night realism, imperfect candid composition, no posing, no glamour styling, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张真实自然的日常抓拍照片，采用写实纪录片风格：中景镜头，两位年轻女性在夜市小摊前并肩而立，从腰部以上进行正面取景。左侧女性为 {argument name="first subject ethnicity" default="东亚裔"}，20 岁出头，身穿超大款 {argument name="left outfit" default="浅米色圆领卫衣"}，背着黑色细肩带挎包，戴着精致的小项链；深色头发随意扎起，留有几缕碎发。右侧女性为 {argument name="second subject ethnicity" default="非洲裔"}，20 岁出头，身穿修身 {argument name="right outfit" default="深棕色长袖圆领上衣"}，背着黑色肩带挎包，自然卷发高高盘成丸子头。两人身体微微向对方倾斜，神态放松，没有摆拍，正低头看着两人手中捧着的一个白色小纸餐盘；左侧女性用牙签或小竹签夹取食物，右侧女性双手托着餐盘。她们的面部被两个棕色调的实心不透明矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖，每个矩形分别覆盖一张脸，颜色与她们各自的肤色相近。背景是灯光温暖的夜市摊位，挂着发光的橙色纸灯笼，陈列着玻璃柜和成盘的油炸街头小吃，空气中弥漫着柔和的蒸汽或雾气，背景是模糊的行人和霓虹灯光散景，延伸至黑暗的街道深处。使用来自柜台上方和后方的暖琥珀色摊位照明，衣物和手部有强烈的自然高光，浅景深，35mm 纪录片摄影质感，高 ISO 夜景写实感，不完美的抓拍构图，无摆拍，无美颜风格，无文字。

templates.title: Scary Hantavirus Microscopic Visualization

titleLocalized.zh: 令人恐惧的汉坦病毒显微可视化

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic macro 3D scientific visualization of {argument name="virus name" default="Hantavirus"} as a frightening spherical viral particle floating in a dark microscopic environment. The central subject is one large virion in sharp focus, with a rough fibrous gray-brown outer shell covered in many translucent red-orange trumpet-shaped spike proteins arranged around the entire circumference. Show a cutaway-like glowing inner core visible through the front surface, filled with warm golden bioluminescent particles and a thick coiled turquoise RNA strand curled in a spiral knot. Surround the main virion with 4 out-of-focus background viral particles: one large blurred particle in the upper left, one large blurred particle in the upper right, one partial blurred particle at the lower left edge, and one partial blurred particle at the right edge. Use cinematic depth of field, volumetric haze, floating dust-like microscopic particles, teal-green and amber color grading, high contrast rim lighting, hyper-detailed textures, semi-realistic biomedical illustration style, scary ominous mood, ultra high resolution, no text, no labels, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有戏剧性的 3D 微距科学可视化图像，展示 {argument name="virus name" default="Hantavirus"}，将其描绘为一个漂浮在黑暗微观环境中的恐怖球形病毒颗粒。主体是一个清晰对焦的大型病毒粒子，具有粗糙的纤维状灰褐色外壳，表面覆盖着许多排列在整个圆周上的半透明红橙色喇叭状刺突蛋白。通过前表面展示一个类似剖面的发光内核，内部充满温暖的金色生物发光颗粒，以及一根盘绕成螺旋结的厚实青绿色 RNA 链。在主病毒粒子周围布置 4 个失焦的背景病毒颗粒：左上方一个大型模糊颗粒，右上方一个大型模糊颗粒，左下边缘一个部分模糊颗粒，以及右边缘一个部分模糊颗粒。采用电影级景深、体积雾、漂浮的尘埃状微观颗粒、青绿色与琥珀色调色、高对比度轮廓光、超精细纹理、半写实生物医学插画风格，营造恐怖阴森的氛围，超高分辨率，无文字，无标签，无水印。

templates.title: Off-Duty Spider-Man Elevator Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 蜘蛛侠下班后的电梯自拍

templates.prompt: Create a realistic high-angle elevator selfie style photo of a young adult woman as an off-duty Spider-Man. She is standing on glossy gray marble tile flooring in a modern elevator or apartment hallway, photographed from above with a wide phone-camera perspective. Her face is intentionally anonymized with a centered square blur censor block. She has {argument name="hair style" default="messy shoulder-length dark wavy hair"} and wears a tight red-and-blue Spider-Man crop top with long sleeves, webbing pattern, raised black spider emblem on the chest, and subtle glossy superhero suit texture. Add black backpack straps over both shoulders, loose black baggy sweatpants, and clean white sneakers. One hand rests in a pocket while the other hand holds a red Spider-Man mask by her side. The environment has beige elevator walls, dark doorway edges, muted indoor lighting, and realistic shadows and reflections on the stone floor. Compose the image vertically, candid and casual, like a normal selfie transformed into a realistic off-duty superhero portrait, with cinematic detail, natural proportions, and no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的高角度电梯自拍风格照片，展现一位处于“下班状态”的年轻女性蜘蛛侠。她站在现代电梯或公寓走廊的亮面灰色大理石瓷砖地板上，采用手机摄像头的广角视角从上方拍摄。她的面部经过处理，使用居中的方形模糊遮挡块进行匿名化处理。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="凌乱的齐肩深色波浪卷发"}，身穿紧身红蓝配色蜘蛛侠短款长袖上衣，带有蛛网图案、胸前凸起的黑色蜘蛛徽标以及细腻的超级英雄战衣质感。双肩背着黑色双肩包带，下身穿着宽松的黑色运动裤，脚踩干净的白色运动鞋。一只手插在口袋里，另一只手在身侧拿着一个红色蜘蛛侠面具。环境背景为米色电梯墙壁、深色门框边缘，配以柔和的室内灯光，石质地板上有写实的阴影和倒影。构图采用垂直视角，呈现出随性自然的自拍感，如同将普通自拍转化为写实的超级英雄下班肖像，具备电影级细节、自然的比例，且画面中无任何文字。
