templates.title: Scary Hantavirus Microscopic Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 恐怖的汉坦病毒显微场景

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a terrifying cinematic microscopic visualization of {argument name="virus name" default="Hantavirus"} inside a human airway or blood vessel, as if seen through an electron microscope blended with dark fantasy medical concept art. Show exactly 9 visible spherical virus particles: 2 large sharply focused foreground virions, one on the lower left tissue ridge and one on the lower right tissue ridge; 1 medium virion floating near the upper center; 1 medium virion near the upper right edge; 1 blurred virion at the upper middle background; 1 small blurred virion at mid left; 1 small blurred virion near center right; 1 medium blurred virion in the central background; and 1 tiny distant virion in the left background. Each virion has a rough mottled membrane, a glowing teal-green spiral core, and many short orange-red club-shaped surface spikes. The environment is a wet organic tunnel made of red swollen tissue cells, translucent membranes, vein-like strands, mucus, and glossy fluid, with golden infectious particles drifting through the air. Use dramatic macro depth of field, strong backlighting from the upper left, amber volumetric glow, high contrast red and gold color grading, extreme biological detail, unsettling horror atmosphere, photorealistic 3D render quality, shallow focus, bokeh, no text, no labels, no humans.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一段令人毛骨悚然的电影级显微可视化画面，展示 {argument name="virus name" default="Hantavirus"} 在人体气道或血管内的形态，仿佛通过电子显微镜观察，并融合了暗黑奇幻医学概念艺术。画面中需清晰可见 9 个球形病毒颗粒：2 个位于前景且聚焦清晰的大型病毒颗粒，分别位于左下和右下的组织脊上；1 个位于上方中心附近的中型病毒颗粒；1 个位于右上边缘附近的中型病毒颗粒；1 个位于中上背景处的模糊病毒颗粒；1 个位于左中位置的小型模糊病毒颗粒；1 个位于中右位置的小型模糊病毒颗粒；1 个位于中央背景处的中型模糊病毒颗粒；以及 1 个位于左侧背景深处的微小病毒颗粒。每个病毒颗粒都具有粗糙的斑驳膜、发着青绿色光芒的螺旋核心，以及许多短小的橙红色棒状表面刺突。环境是一个由红色肿胀组织细胞、半透明膜、静脉状纤维、粘液和光泽液体构成的湿润有机隧道，金色的感染颗粒在空气中漂浮。采用戏剧性的微距景深、左上方的强背光、琥珀色体积光、高对比度的红金配色、极致的生物细节、令人不安的恐怖氛围、照片级 3D 渲染质量、浅焦、散景效果，无文字，无标签，无人物。

templates.title: Masked Wolf Tactical Agent

titleLocalized.zh: Masked Wolf 战术 Agent

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime-style illustration of a tall, muscular anthropomorphic wolf security agent standing in a dark industrial stairwell. The character is a blue-and-white wolf with pale blue fur, white chest and muzzle markings, sharp wolf ears, a large fluffy tail with a white tip, athletic bodybuilder proportions, defined abs and legs, and a confident guarded stance. He wears a black baseball cap, rectangular glasses, a blue medical face mask, black fingerless tactical gloves, a black diagonal shoulder strap, a black utility belt, black thigh straps, a right-thigh holster pouch, minimal tight blue athletic briefs, and red-and-black chunky sneakers. His right hand holds a black pistol upright beside his shoulder while his left fist hangs at his side. Use {argument name="fur color" default="pale blue and white"}, {argument name="mask color" default="blue"}, {argument name="shoe color" default="red and black"}, {argument name="weapon" default="black pistol"}, and {argument name="setting" default="dark concrete industrial stairwell"}. Compose from a low camera angle looking upward to emphasize heroic scale and long legs, with the character leaning slightly near a tall concrete pillar. The background shows metal stairs, railings, overhead pipes, concrete walls, and a cool skylight glow, with moody high-contrast lighting, crisp cel-shaded rendering, detailed fur texture, sharp linework, realistic shadows, cinematic depth, and a serious urban tactical atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满戏剧性的竖版动漫风格插画，描绘一位高大、肌肉发达的拟人化狼型安全 Agent，正站在昏暗的工业楼梯间内。角色是一只蓝白相间的狼，拥有淡蓝色皮毛、白色的胸部和口鼻部斑纹、尖尖的狼耳、带有白色尖端的蓬松大尾巴，具备运动员般的健美体格、清晰的腹肌和腿部线条，姿态自信且警觉。他戴着黑色棒球帽、长方形眼镜、蓝色医用口罩、黑色露指战术手套，身穿黑色斜挎肩带、黑色多功能腰带、黑色大腿绑带，右大腿配有枪套袋，穿着极简的紧身蓝色运动内裤以及红黑配色的厚底运动鞋。他的右手握着一把黑色手枪竖在肩旁，左拳垂在身侧。请使用 {argument name="fur color" default="淡蓝色和白色"}、{argument name="mask color" default="蓝色"}、{argument name="shoe color" default="红色和黑色"}、{argument name="weapon" default="黑色手枪"} 以及 {argument name="setting" default="昏暗的混凝土工业楼梯间"}。采用仰视的低机位构图以强调英雄气概和修长的双腿，角色微微倚靠在粗壮的混凝土柱旁。背景展示了金属楼梯、栏杆、头顶的管道、混凝土墙壁以及天窗透出的冷色光芒，呈现出忧郁的高对比度光影、清晰的赛璐珞渲染、细腻的毛发质感、锐利的线条、逼真的阴影、电影般的景深以及严肃的城市战术氛围。

templates.title: Kawaii Overhead Lolita Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱风 Lolita 俯拍肖像

templates.prompt: Create a sweet kawaii overhead portrait shot from directly above on a warm light-wood plank floor. On the right side, show a young woman lying on her back with her head near the upper right and feet toward the lower right, face softly blurred or featureless for privacy, long dark brown hair in two loose braids with a wavy strand spread beside her head. She wears a pastel pink and white lolita dress with puff sleeves, lace trim, a large waist bow, tiny pastel bows, delicate blue accents, and a full flared skirt decorated with cute bunny and bear motifs; add cream knee socks with pink bow details and glossy pink Mary Jane shoes. Arrange exactly 11 Sanrio-style plush toys in a large crescent arc around the left side of her body, leaving open space between the plush arc and the girl: 1 yellow bear plush in a cream outfit, 1 pink bear plush, 1 small white bear plush with a blue bow tie, 1 pink My Melody plush with floppy ears and bows, 1 My Melody plush in a pink gingham dress, 1 white Hello Kitty plush in a pale yellow dress, 1 pink My Melody plush in a white outfit, 1 brown Rilakkuma-like bear plush with a red bow, 1 pink bear plush in a blue uniform, 1 Hello Kitty plush in a blue outfit, and 1 white Hello Kitty plush with a blue bow. Add a bold subtitle near the bottom over the drawing reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="我们确认一下打节拍的意义"}, styled as thick white Chinese characters with a dark blue outline and yellow emphasis on the first two characters. Use messy wax-crayon texture, simple childlike proportions, imperfect perspective, bright primary colors, and lots of visible scribble strokes; keep the background plain white with no extra objects.

templates.prompt: Create a warm vertical lifestyle couple illustration in a 2.5D flat, hand-drawn storybook doodle style, like a tender diary entry made from an everyday selfie. Show {argument name="couple description" default="a young woman and a young man standing close together"} in the foreground, waist-up, with intentionally simplified or softly blank facial details. The woman is closest to the viewer, taking a selfie with her arm stretched toward the camera so her large thumb fills the lower-left foreground; she has {argument name="woman hair" default="long wavy dark brown hair"} and wears {argument name="woman outfit" default="an oversized olive-green jacket over a dark top and gray plaid skirt"}. The man stands slightly behind her on the right, taller, leaning in gently, with {argument name="man hair" default="messy short black hair"} and wearing {argument name="man outfit" default="a pale beige jacket over a blue collared shirt with brown pants"}. Use soft crayon-like textures, rough sketch outlines, playful brush strokes, cozy pastel colors, and a white background filled with cheerful doodles: exactly 2 trees on the left, 1 small blue car near the lower-left, 1 smiling yellow sun near the top center, 1 blue cloud, 1 pink building with a teal roof and striped awning on the upper-right, 1 potted plant, 5 star doodles, 3 heart doodles, 2 flowers, scattered tiny plus signs and colorful squiggles. The composition should feel intimate, nostalgic, whimsical, and gentle, like a fairy-tale picture book memory hidden in a photo album.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅温暖的 2.5D 平面手绘涂鸦插画，风格类似温柔的童话绘本或日记回忆，采用竖向人像构图，展示 {argument name="couple description" default="一对年轻情侣正在亲密自拍"}。画面中共有 2 位主角：左前方是一位留着深棕色波浪长发的女性，身穿橄榄绿大廓形外套，内搭深色上衣和灰色格子裙，一只手臂向观众伸出，呈现夸张的自拍视角，左下角前景有一个模糊的大拇指；右后方是一位个子较高的男性，留着凌乱的黑发，身穿米色柔软外套，内搭浅蓝色衬衫。保持面部柔和模糊或无五官，仅用温暖的肤色矩形色块代替，强调氛围而非肖像特征。使用干净的白色背景，并点缀俏皮的蜡笔风格涂鸦：左侧有 2 棵叶子茂密的树，树下有 1 辆蓝色小汽车，顶部中央有 1 个微笑的黄色太阳，顶部附近有 1 朵蓝色云彩，右上角有 1 栋带蓝色窗户和黄色条纹遮阳篷的粉色房子，房子旁有 1 盆盆栽，右下角有 1 朵巨大的黄色花朵，底部附近有 2 朵粉色郁金香，以及 3 个轮廓爱心、4 个星星涂鸦，并散布着加号、圆点和细小的波浪线。色调应欢快柔和，包含 {argument name="main jacket color" default="橄榄绿"}、米色、粉色、青色、黄色、蓝色和橙色点缀。呈现明显的粗糙粉彩质感、不均匀的草图线条、手绘笔触和稚拙的装饰符号，营造温馨浪漫的日常生活氛围，拒绝写实感，无硬阴影，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Doodle Couple Diary Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 涂鸦情侣生活方式插画

templates.prompt: Create a warm 2.5D flat hand-drawn doodle illustration like a gentle fairy-tale diary entry, on a clean white background with colorful crayon and marker textures. Show {argument name="couple description" default="a young couple taking a casual daytime selfie-style pose"}: exactly 2 faceless people in the foreground, with softly blurred blank facial areas and expressive body language. The woman stands on the left with long wavy {argument name="woman hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, wearing an olive-green jacket over a brown top, a beige pleated skirt with a black-and-white plaid waistband, and a dark brown quilted shoulder bag; her hands rest confidently on her hips. The man stands on the right, slightly taller, with short black tousled hair, wearing a pale yellow trench coat over a blue-and-white striped shirt, holding one hand close to the viewer in a playful peace sign. Surround them with a cheerful everyday neighborhood doodle scene: exactly 3 rounded trees, 1 smiling orange sun with rays, 1 small blue car, 1 bright yellow cafe building with blue roof trim, blue-and-white striped awning, blue door, white windows, and 1 sidewalk chalkboard sign reading {argument name="sign text" default="CAFE"} with a pink heart. Add exactly 3 pink hearts, exactly 3 star doodles, exactly 1 yellow flower, plus scattered tiny circles, crosses, squiggles, dots, and confetti marks in blue, pink, yellow, orange, green, and purple. Use thick imperfect outlines, visible scribble strokes, soft painterly shading on the people, playful proportions, cozy romantic mood, and a nostalgic scrapbook-photo feeling, as if a real daily snapshot was transformed into a tender children’s picture-book memory. Use a bright palette dominated by {argument name="main palette" default="sunny yellow, olive green, sky blue, pink, and warm brown"}, with no photorealism and no hard shadows.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅欢快、2.5D 平面手绘风格的涂鸦插画，描绘一对年轻情侣像童话绘本里的温馨日常快照一样合影。场景背景简洁明亮，点缀着色彩缤纷的蜡笔涂鸦，营造出柔和亲密的生活氛围。在前景中，左侧展示 {argument name="woman outfit" default="一位留着深棕色长波浪卷发的年轻女性，身穿橄榄绿短款夹克，内搭深棕色上衣，腰间系着黑白格纹衬衫，下穿米色百褶裙，背着一个大型深棕色绗缝单肩包"}，她单手叉腰，姿态放松且自信。在右侧，展示 {argument name="man outfit" default="一位留着凌乱黑发的年轻男性，身穿浅米色风衣，内搭蓝色条纹衬衫"}，他身体前倾，向观众比出一个大大的“V”字手势，手部在前景中被夸张处理。两人面部均采用无五官或柔焦处理，以保留从抓拍照片转化为插画的质感。背景包含精确的 23 个可见涂鸦元素：3 棵树（左上角一棵青色果树、左中一棵较小的浅绿色树、男子身后一棵深绿色树）；1 个位于中上方、带有光芒的微笑橙色太阳；1 座位于右上角的黄色建筑，配有蓝色屋顶和蓝白条纹遮阳篷；1 个写有 {argument name="cafe sign text" default="CAFE"} 字样并带有粉色爱心的黑板咖啡馆招牌；左侧 1 辆蓝色小汽车；3 个大爱心（情侣之间一个粉色轮廓爱心，右侧两个粉色爱心）；2 颗蓝色星星（分别位于中左侧和左下侧）；左下角 1 朵黄色花朵；右下角 1 枝绿色叶子；左侧 1 丛粉色灌木；汽车旁 1 朵白色云朵；以及散落在周围的 8 个由彩色加号、圆点、波浪线和短笔触组成的装饰性小标记。采用生动的童趣色彩、粗犷不均匀的马克笔轮廓、柔和的蜡笔质感、人物身上略带立体感的阴影、俏皮的比例、圆润的形状，营造出舒适浪漫的晴天氛围，拒绝写实风格。

His messy dark hair is backlit and wind-tossed, and his face is intentionally hidden by a centered opaque muted gray square censor block. The scene is set under a vast starry night sky with turquoise aurora curtains, purple nebula clouds, distant mountains, and a large circular golden astrolabe or celestial gate framing the background. On the table, draw exactly 8 glowing miniature Earth-like glass spheres: one medium sphere at the far left edge, one tiny purple-blue sphere just to its right, one large sphere in the left mid-foreground, one very large sphere at the bottom-left foreground, one small sphere near the center rear, one large sphere at the bottom center foreground, one large sphere on the right foreground, and one small sphere at the far right rear; additionally, the sorcerer delicately holds exactly 1 floating Earth sphere between the fingers of his right hand, for a total of 9 Earth spheres. His left hand holds a slender pointer wand touching a bright golden star point at the center of the engraved map table. His right hand holds a slender gold-and-black wand or pointer angled downward, while his left hand touches a glowing astrological circle on the tabletop. Include two vertical hanging banners in the background: the left banner reads {argument name="left banner text" default="星文祓禮"} and the right banner reads {argument name="right banner text" default="天水星朱"}. Use a cinematic composition, intense electric-blue rim lighting, bright gold accents, sparkling particles, reflective glass, intricate linework, elegant Japanese fantasy aesthetics, ultra-detailed anime rendering, dramatic depth of field, and a mystical star-sorcery atmosphere.

templates.title: Censored Cafe Portrait Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆肖像遮挡照片

templates.prompt: Create a realistic candid portrait photograph of a young East Asian woman seated indoors in a cozy cafe or lounge, framed from chest up in a vertical 3:4 composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long straight black hair"} with soft natural shine, slightly tousled strands, and hair falling over both shoulders. Her face is intentionally covered by a large centered opaque square privacy mask in a muted brown-to-taupe gradient, obscuring all facial features. She wears a loose {argument name="shirt color" default="white"} crewneck T-shirt with a colorful floral graphic on the chest. The background is softly blurred with warm ambient lighting, golden yellow wall tones on the left, neutral shelves in the upper right, and a brown leather or vinyl sofa behind her. Use shallow depth of field, natural indoor light, realistic skin and hair texture, DSLR portrait look, soft bokeh, casual intimate mood. Add a semi-transparent white watermark reading {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} in the bottom-left corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张年轻东亚女性在舒适咖啡馆或休息室内的写实抓拍肖像，采用 3:4 竖构图，取景范围为胸部以上。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长直黑发"}，发丝带有柔和的自然光泽，略显凌乱，头发垂落在双肩。她的面部被一个位于中央的大型不透明方形隐私遮罩刻意遮挡，遮罩呈现柔和的棕色至灰褐色渐变，完全遮盖了所有面部特征。她穿着一件宽松的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 圆领 T 恤，胸前带有彩色花卉图案。背景经过柔焦处理，带有温暖的环境光，左侧为金黄色墙面，右上角为中性色调的搁架，身后是棕色皮革或人造革沙发。使用浅景深、自然室内光、写实的皮肤和头发质感、单反肖像风格、柔和的焦外成像，营造休闲亲密的氛围。在左下角添加一个半透明的白色水印，文字内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"}。

templates.title: Censored Cinematic Bob Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 带遮挡效果的波波头电影感肖像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic close-up portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young East Asian woman"} with a short chin-length black bob haircut and soft natural skin tones, framed from the upper chest upward in a vertical 4:5 composition. Her face is intentionally obscured by a large centered opaque square censor block in a muted brown gradient, covering nearly the entire face from forehead to chin while leaving the hair, neck, shoulders, and clothing visible. She wears a black pleated textured blouse with a subtle ruffled neckline, photographed in dim soft indoor light with shallow depth of field and a blurred neutral beige-gray background. Use cinematic realism, natural shadows, muted colors, gentle contrast, fine hair detail, and a moody intimate editorial style. Add the word {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} in bold light gray sans-serif lettering at the bottom left like a watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻东亚女性"} 的写实特写肖像，她留着齐下巴的黑色波波头，肤色自然柔和，采用 4:5 竖构图，取景范围从上半身胸部以上。她的面部被一个位于中心、带有柔和棕色渐变的巨大不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮挡范围几乎覆盖了从额头到下巴的整个面部，同时保留了头发、颈部、肩膀和衣物可见。她身穿一件黑色褶皱纹理衬衫，领口带有细微的荷叶边设计，在昏暗柔和的室内光线下拍摄，具有浅景深效果，背景为模糊的中性米灰色。运用电影级写实手法，呈现自然阴影、柔和色彩、细腻对比度、精细发丝细节以及充满情绪感的亲密编辑风格。在左下角添加 {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} 字样作为水印，使用粗体浅灰色无衬线字体。

templates.title: Anime Sky City Fantasy

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风天空之城奇幻场景

templates.prompt: Create a breathtaking ultra-wide anime fantasy illustration of a radiant sky city above the clouds, a futuristic magical floating metropolis made of transparent glass platforms, glowing cyan holographic cubes, pastel pixel blocks, suspended towers, and circular sky bridges. In the foreground, place {argument name="main characters" default="two anime teenagers, a boy and a girl"} standing from behind on a glassy prismatic platform, gazing over the vast world; the boy has short dark hair, a white-and-blue jacket, shorts, and boots, and the girl has long flowing dark blue hair, a white dress with blue trim, and a soft glowing accessory. Surround them with exactly 5 prominent cute mascot creatures in the foreground and near foreground: a small white cat-like creature at center front, a yellow-green rabbit-like creature at bottom center, a pink rabbit-cat creature on the right block, a pink blob creature on the left platform, and a small yellow floating creature near the right midground. Add at least 20 tiny anime adventurers scattered across platforms and flying through the sky, including winged characters, students, and miniature riders, plus exactly 4 large floating crystalline cubes visible in the sky and city. The environment should feel like a cheerful fantasy MMO hub in the clouds, with enormous floating islands on the left and right, a grand circular tower-city at upper right spilling vertical streams of light and water, smaller levitating buildings in the distance, luminous rail trails curving through the air, waterfalls of light, and sparkling particles. Use {argument name="color palette" default="brilliant sky blue, cyan, white, lavender, and pastel rainbow highlights"}, high-key daylight, huge fluffy cumulus clouds, clear saturated blue sky, shimmering reflections, iridescent glass, soft bloom, magical holographic UI-like fragments, and exquisite tiny details. Style: {argument name="art style" default="highly detailed anime key visual, fantasy sci-fi concept art"}, expansive cinematic composition, 16:9 aspect ratio, crisp linework blended with painterly lighting, joyful sense of wonder, no text, no logo, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅令人惊叹的超宽幅动漫奇幻插画，描绘云端之上的璀璨天空之城。这是一座充满未来感的魔法浮空大都市，由透明玻璃平台、发光的青色全息立方体、柔和的像素块、悬浮塔楼和环形空中桥梁组成。在前景处，放置 {argument name="main characters" default="两位动漫少年，一男一女"}，让他们背对镜头站在玻璃棱镜平台上，眺望广阔的世界；男孩留着黑色短发，身穿白蓝相间夹克、短裤和靴子；女孩留着飘逸的深蓝色长发，身穿带有蓝色镶边的白色连衣裙，佩戴着柔和的发光饰品。在前景和近景处围绕他们放置 5 只醒目的可爱吉祥物：正前方是一只白色小猫状生物，底部中心是一只黄绿色兔状生物，右侧方块上是一只粉色兔猫生物，左侧平台上是一只粉色团子生物，右侧中景附近有一只黄色小型浮空生物。在平台各处及空中散布至少 20 位微型动漫冒险者，包括带翅膀的角色、学生和迷你骑手，并添加 4 个在天空和城市中可见的大型浮空水晶立方体。环境应呈现出云端欢乐奇幻 MMO 中心城的氛围，左右两侧有巨大的浮空岛，右上角有一座宏伟的圆形塔城，倾泻出垂直的光流和水流，远处有较小的悬浮建筑，空中蜿蜒着发光的轨道轨迹、光之瀑布和闪烁的粒子。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="明亮的天蓝色、青色、白色、薰衣草色和柔和的彩虹高光"}，高调日光，巨大的蓬松积云，清澈饱和的蓝天，闪烁的倒影，虹彩玻璃，柔和的光晕，魔法全息 UI 碎片，以及精致的微小细节。风格：{argument name="art style" default="高细节动漫主视觉图，奇幻科幻概念艺术"}，广阔的电影级构图，16:9 纵横比，清晰的线条与绘画感光影融合，充满愉悦的奇迹感，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Crystal Sky City Anime Vista

titleLocalized.zh: 水晶天空之城动漫景观

templates.prompt: Create a wide cinematic fantasy anime illustration of a radiant sky-city made of translucent glass cubes, floating platforms, and suspended crystal architecture under a vivid turquoise-blue sky. In the foreground, show two human children standing on a blocky tiled ledge, one boy with dark tousled hair, shorts, backpack and sneakers, and one girl with a bob haircut, school-like outfit and small satchel, both seen from behind as they gaze into the vast aerial world. Add a small white rounded robot or mascot sitting beside them. Populate the scene with exactly 14 visible small figures scattered across the platforms and sky: foreground boy, foreground girl, white mascot, left helmeted child, two small children walking together on the left path, tiny yellow-hatted child near center-left, child in white walking away at center, tiny green-capped child near lower center, yellow-cloaked pointed-hat traveler near center-right, small floating orange fairy-like figure in midair, right-side hovering helmeted child, yellow bird-hooded character at lower right, and cropped orange-hooded figure at the far right edge. The environment should feature huge floating city towers with circular ring roads and bridges, distant stacked observatories, aerial rails, glowing arcs, waterfalls spilling from glass platforms, hanging vines and greenery, transparent cyan and pink cubes, rainbow-tinted reflections, fluffy cumulus clouds rising through the city, and tiny flying vehicles or birds. Use {argument name="art style" default="high-detail Japanese fantasy anime concept art"}, luminous cel-shaded lighting, vibrant cyan, aquamarine, white, gold, and soft magenta palette, magical utopian atmosphere, immense scale, intricate background detail, sparkling particles, sunlit clouds, volumetric light, crisp linework, painterly texture, ultra-wide 16:9 composition, awe and wonder, no text, no watermark.

titleLocalized.zh: 将草图分镜转化为精美漫画页面

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a rough manga storyboard, turn it into a clean black-and-white manga page with polished line art, screentone shading, and crisp rectangular panel borders. Keep the same 5-panel story structure and visible circled panel numbers: 1 landscape scene with mountains, houses, a small car, and a cheerful woman leaning in from the right waving; 2 a compact car driving; 3 a small bird with a camera-like beak; 4 an announcer holding a microphone beside a street-food stall; 5 the woman in front of a large explosion. Preserve the rough layout order and the intended character/object positions, but render everything as finished manga art. Keep the faces in panels 4 and 5 intentionally obscured by a soft gray rectangular blur. Add Japanese text on the stall awning reading {argument name="stall sign text" default="ラテスカーどっぐ"}. Make the page monochrome, high-detail, print-ready, with dynamic speed lines and explosion effects where indicated.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为漫画分镜草图，将其转化为一张清晰的黑白漫画页面，包含精美的线条、网点纸阴影以及利落的矩形分镜框。保持相同的 5 格故事结构和可见的圆形分镜编号：第 1 格为包含山脉、房屋、小型汽车以及一名从右侧探身挥手的开朗女性的风景画面；第 2 格为一辆小型汽车在行驶；第 3 格为一只长着相机状鸟喙的小鸟；第 4 格为一名播音员在街头小吃摊旁手持麦克风；第 5 格为该女性站在一场大爆炸前。保留原始的布局顺序和预期的角色/物体位置，但以成品漫画艺术风格进行渲染。将第 4 格和第 5 格中的面部特意用柔和的灰色矩形模糊处理。在摊位遮阳棚上添加日语文字 {argument name="stall sign text" default="ラテスカーどっぐ"}。页面需为黑白、高细节、可印刷格式，并根据指示添加动态速度线和爆炸效果。

templates.title: Sarcastic Anime Camera Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 讽刺风格动漫摄影少女

templates.prompt: Create a single-panel anime-style social media illustration set on a bright modern Japanese city street resembling Shibuya or a busy shopping district, with colorful storefront signs, soft depth-of-field pedestrians, trees, and a vivid blue sky in the background. In the foreground, show a young woman photographer from the waist up, holding a large black Sony-style mirrorless camera with a prominent wide lens toward the viewer; the camera strap hangs around her neck. She has a short blonde bob haircut with layered ends and side-swept bangs, small earrings, and wears a cream cable-knit cardigan over a gray-and-white checkered button-up shirt. Her face is deliberately covered by a flat opaque rectangular censor block in a skin-tone beige, centered over the face. Use polished Japanese anime/manga line art with clean outlines, glossy highlights, saturated daylight colors, and a slightly teasing comedic tone. Include exactly 2 white manga speech bubbles with thick black outlines: the large left bubble says {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="カメラが高感度競争してるのに すっごい明るいレンズ 自慢してるのオモロッ♥"} with small sparkle icons and a pink heart, and the smaller upper-right bubble says {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="どうせ NDフィルター 付けちゃうんでしょ？"}. Add a few decorative sparkle symbols around the dialogue and near the bottom right. Compose the image in a wide 16:9 aspect ratio, with the camera and character dominating the center-left and center, speech bubbles occupying the upper left and upper right, and the city background blurred enough to keep focus on the character and dialogue.

templates.prompt: A cinematic ultra-detailed science fiction alien landscape at twilight on a distant planet: a gigantic sleek futuristic spaceship floats low across the sky from left to right above a mirror-still lake, its elongated dark metallic hull covered in intricate layered armor plates, vents, windows, exposed mechanical ribs, glowing blue and violet lights, and luminous engine details. The lake below reflects the entire spacecraft, the pastel sky, and a huge pink-purple ringed planet dominating the upper right, with two small moons nearby and a star-filled nebula sky in teal, indigo, lavender, and magenta. The foreground is a rocky alien shoreline covered with dense bioluminescent extraterrestrial plants: purple grasses, blue moss, glowing spherical flower tips, tiny luminous blossoms, and crystalline shrubs. In the middle distance, high cliffs stretch across the horizon with multiple thin waterfalls dropping into misty basins, low fog drifting over the water, and layered mountains fading into the distance. Lighting is dreamy but photorealistic, with soft sunrise/sunset colors, crisp reflections, volumetric mist, high dynamic range, extreme environmental detail, wide-angle composition, epic scale, 16:9 aspect ratio, no text, no people. Customize the scene with a {argument name="spaceship color" default="dark gunmetal with blue and violet lights"}, {argument name="planet color" default="pink-purple"}, {argument name="alien plant color palette" default="purple, blue, lavender, and cyan bioluminescence"}, {argument name="time of day" default="twilight"}, and {argument name="overall style" default="cinematic photorealistic space opera concept art"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 遥远星球黄昏时分，电影级超精细科幻外星景观：一艘巨大的流线型未来派宇宙飞船正从左至右低空掠过一面如镜般的静谧湖泊，其修长的深色金属船体上覆盖着错综复杂的层叠装甲板、通风口、舷窗、外露的机械肋条、闪烁的蓝紫色灯光以及发光的引擎细节。湖面映照出整艘飞船、柔和的天空，以及占据右上方的巨大粉紫色带环行星，附近还有两颗小卫星，星云密布的天空呈现青色、靛蓝、薰衣草色和洋红色。前景是岩石嶙峋的外星海岸线，覆盖着茂密的生物发光地外植物：紫色草丛、蓝色苔藓、发光的球形花尖、微小的发光花朵和晶莹剔透的灌木。中景处，高耸的悬崖横跨地平线，多条细长的瀑布倾泻入雾气缭绕的盆地，薄雾在水面漂浮，层峦叠嶂的山脉向远方延伸。光影梦幻且写实，带有柔和的日出/日落色调、清晰的倒影、体积雾、高动态范围、极致的环境细节、广角构图、史诗般的规模，16:9 纵横比，无文字，无人物。可通过以下参数自定义场景：{argument name="spaceship color" default="带有蓝紫色灯光的深枪灰色"}、{argument name="planet color" default="粉紫色"}、{argument name="alien plant color palette" default="紫色、蓝色、薰衣草色和青色的生物发光"}、{argument name="time of day" default="黄昏"} 以及 {argument name="overall style" default="电影级写实太空歌剧概念艺术"}。

templates.title: Neon Midnight Anime Streetwear Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹午夜动漫街头风少女

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant anime-style full-body illustration of a fashionable young woman on a midnight stroll through a futuristic neon city, centered in the frame and floating or stepping midair with one knee bent and one boot extended downward. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="black hair with violet and hot-pink ombré ends"}, glossy highlights, and wind-swept strands streaming to the right; her face is intentionally soft-blurred and featureless like a privacy blur. Dress her in a cropped white sleeveless button shirt, loose black bomber jacket slipping off the shoulders with pink lace-up details on one sleeve, black cargo jogger pants with pockets, straps, a belt, silver chain accessories, a purple thigh strap, white slouch socks, and chunky black lace-up boots. Add punk streetwear jewelry: rings, bracelets, ear piercings, and small metal accents. The background is a deep purple night skyline with scattered glowing particles like snow or city sparks, soft bokeh lights, and five prominent neon sign elements: one tall rounded pink Japanese-style sign on the left, one vertical pink sign with Japanese-style characters near the lower center, one tall pink sign behind her on the right, one cyan vertical sign reading {argument name="cyan sign text" default="GUNAD"}, and one low foreground building sign made of bright cyan and pink horizontal bars. Use saturated magenta, violet, cyan, and electric blue lighting, strong rim light on the hair and jacket, clean cel-shaded anime rendering, crisp line art, luminous gradients, cinematic depth of field, and a dynamic urban night atmosphere. Overall mood: {argument name="mood" default="cool, dreamy, rebellious midnight fashion"}.

templates.title: Glowing Butterfly Marionette Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 发光的蝴蝶提线木偶少女

templates.prompt: Create a dark, cinematic anime-style portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young marionette woman"} seated upright like a suspended puppet, framed from head to thighs in a vertical composition. She has short wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark teal hair with warm copper tips"}, a delicate neck, bare shoulders, and wears a pale ruffled {argument name="dress style" default="lolita ballet tutu dress"} with puffed sheer sleeves, a fitted bodice, frilled neckline, and layered skirt. Her face is deliberately hidden by a centered opaque dark square, making her identity anonymous and unsettling. Four long black marionette strings descend vertically from the top of the frame around her body, two crossing near the left side and two falling straight near the right, emphasizing that she is controlled. The dress is filled with dozens of glowing golden butterfly-shaped lights, concentrated across the bodice, waist, and skirt, casting warm amber illumination through translucent fabric and onto her skin. Use a moody teal-green studio background with soft vignette darkness, high contrast between cool shadows and warm butterfly glow, dreamy volumetric haze, rim lighting on hair and shoulders, painterly semi-realistic anime rendering, delicate fabric texture, melancholic atmosphere, and the emotional theme "{argument name="theme phrase" default="I thought I was free"}". No visible typography, no extra characters, no scenery beyond the dark background.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑暗、电影质感的动漫风格肖像，主角为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻的提线木偶女性"}，她像被悬挂的木偶一样端坐着，构图采用从头部到大腿的竖向取景。她留着短卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深青色发梢带暖铜色"}，有着纤细的脖颈和裸露的肩膀，身穿一件浅色荷叶边 {argument name="dress style" default="洛丽塔芭蕾舞裙"}，配有蓬松的透明袖子、紧身胸衣、褶皱领口和多层裙摆。她的脸部被一个居中的不透明黑色方块刻意遮挡，使其身份显得匿名且令人不安。四根长长的黑色提线从画面顶部垂直垂下，环绕在她的身体周围，其中两根在左侧交叉，两根在右侧直垂，强调她正处于被操控的状态。裙子上布满了数十个发光的金色蝴蝶状灯光，集中在胸衣、腰部和裙摆处，将温暖的琥珀色光芒投射在半透明的织物上以及她的皮肤上。使用忧郁的青绿色摄影棚背景，带有柔和的暗角效果，冷色调阴影与暖色调蝴蝶光芒形成强烈对比，营造出梦幻的体积雾感，头发和肩膀处有轮廓光，采用绘画感半写实动漫渲染风格，展现细腻的织物纹理，营造忧郁的氛围，并融入情感主题“{argument name="theme phrase" default="我以为我自由了"}”。画面中不包含任何可见文字，无多余字符，深色背景之外无其他场景。

templates.title: Moonlight Blue Anime Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 月光蓝动漫封面

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime-style light novel or illustration collection cover set on a moonlit beach at night, dominated by deep cobalt and navy blue tones. At the top, place the large elegant cursive title {argument name="title text" default="Moonlight Blue"} in glowing pale blue-white calligraphy, with long sweeping flourishes, and add the small lowercase author name {argument name="author name" default="yurara"} on the upper left beneath the title. In the upper right sky, include a bright crescent moon surrounded by tiny stars and subtle atmospheric glow. The central subject is a teenage anime girl standing waist-up on the shoreline, reaching one hand toward the viewer in a dramatic invitation pose; her long {argument name="hair color" default="silvery pale blue"} hair is windswept in many fine strands across the image, catching moonlight. Her face is covered by a centered opaque muted blue-gray square censor block, hiding the facial features. She wears a white short-sleeved sailor school uniform with a light blue collar and a soft gold ribbon bow, plus a dark skirt visible at the bottom. Behind her, render dark rolling ocean waves, wet sand, and a shimmering path of moonlight reflected on the water. Use soft painterly anime rendering, luminous rim lighting, cinematic composition, delicate hair detail, romantic melancholy mood, and high-resolution book-cover typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版动漫风格的轻小说或插画集封面，背景设定在月光下的海滩之夜，以深钴蓝色和海军蓝为主色调。在顶部，放置醒目且优雅的连体草书标题 {argument name="title text" default="Moonlight Blue"}，采用发光的淡蓝白色书法字体，带有长长的飘逸笔触；在标题左下方添加小号小写作者名 {argument name="author name" default="yurara"}。在右上方的天空中，加入一轮明亮的弯月，周围环绕着细小的繁星和柔和的大气光晕。画面中心是一位半身动漫少女，站在海岸线上，一只手向观众伸出，呈现出戏剧性的邀请姿势；她长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银淡蓝色"} 头发在风中飘散，发丝细腻，映衬着月光。她的面部被一个居中的不透明哑光蓝灰色方块遮挡，隐藏了五官。她身穿白色短袖水手校服，配有浅蓝色领子和柔和的金色丝带蝴蝶结，底部可见深色裙摆。在她身后，渲染出深色的翻滚海浪、湿润的沙滩，以及水面上波光粼粼的月光路径。采用柔和的绘画感动漫渲染、明亮的轮廓光、电影级构图、细腻的发丝细节、浪漫忧郁的氛围以及高分辨率的书籍封面排版。

templates.title: Monochrome Anime Couple Sketch

titleLocalized.zh: 单色动漫情侣素描

templates.prompt: Create a monochrome rough hand-drawn anime line-art illustration on a clean white background, as if sketched with a fine dip pen. Show two close-up characters in an intimate couple pose: a shorter youthful character on the left with messy short hair and a loose hoodie with drawstrings, leaning upward toward a taller character on the right; the taller character has very long flowing hair, visible ear detail, and a loose kimono-like robe, bending down close to the shorter character as if about to kiss or whisper. Keep the faces deliberately covered by two soft light-gray rectangular censor blocks, one medium rectangle over the left character’s face and one larger vertical rectangle over the taller character’s face, partially overlapping near the center. Use loose, energetic black sketch lines with visible construction strokes, delicate hair strands, minimal shading, and a light airy feeling. Add a small hand-drawn heart on the left side and three short emphasis marks near the taller character’s head on the upper right. Place elegant cursive text in the upper left reading {argument name="couple name" default="Mai & Koyo"}. Add a faint circular watermark-like emblem behind the characters and a bold copyright line along the bottom reading {argument name="copyright text" default="©ImaginaryGate | ProjectMRA | Mai"}. Overall composition should be horizontal, close-cropped, romantic, black-and-white, sketchbook-style, with the taller character dominating the right side and the shorter character filling the lower left.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅在纯白背景上的单色手绘风格动漫线稿插画，呈现出如同使用精细蘸水笔勾勒的效果。展示两个特写角色处于亲密的情侣姿势：左侧是一位身材较矮、留着凌乱短发并穿着宽松连帽衫（带抽绳）的年轻角色，正向上倾斜靠近右侧较高的角色；右侧较高的角色留着飘逸的长发，耳朵细节清晰可见，身着宽松的和服式长袍，正向下俯身靠近左侧角色，仿佛即将亲吻或耳语。刻意用两个柔和的浅灰色矩形遮挡块覆盖面部，左侧角色面部覆盖一个中等矩形，右侧角色面部覆盖一个较大的垂直矩形，两者在中心附近部分重叠。使用松散、充满活力的黑色线条，保留可见的构图笔触、细腻的发丝、极简的阴影，营造出轻盈通透的氛围。在左侧添加一个小巧的手绘爱心，并在右上角较高角色的头部附近添加三个简短的强调符号。在左上角放置优雅的草书文本 {argument name="couple name" default="Mai & Koyo"}。在角色后方添加一个淡淡的圆形水印状徽标，并在底部沿边添加一行粗体的版权声明 {argument name="copyright text" default="©ImaginaryGate | ProjectMRA | Mai"}。整体构图应为横向、紧凑特写、浪漫风格、黑白素描质感，较高角色占据右侧，较矮角色填充左下方。

The left character is a tall slim demon-like young man with messy {argument name="male hair color" default="black"} hair, pale skin, exposed chest and abs under sheer black lace, layered chokers and necklaces with cross and pentagram pendants, many rings, black leather pants with zippers, belts, chains, buckles, and a deep navy-black fur-trimmed jacket; one large black bat wing rises behind his left shoulder. The right character is a petite gothic lolita girl leaning against him, with long wavy {argument name="female hair color" default="dark brown"} hair braided and decorated with many tiny pink bows and heart clips, wearing a black lace bodice, pink ribbons, layered pink-and-black tutu skirt, fishnet stockings, strapped platform boots, chains, star charms, and an oversized pale pink fur-trimmed coat; one pale feathered angel wing is visible behind her right shoulder. templates.title: Side-by-Side Glow-Up Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 并排对比的“焕新”肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic side-by-side photographic glow-up comparison of the same young woman, split vertically into exactly 2 equal panels. The left panel shows her as {argument name="time label left" default="today"}: casual, slightly unpolished, dark brown hair in a messy high bun with loose flyaway strands, wearing an oversized light gray crewneck sweatshirt, neutral gray indoor wall background, soft flat daylight, shoulders-up portrait crop. The right panel shows her as {argument name="time label right" default="5 years later"}: confident and polished, long glossy dark brown hair worn down with a center part, wearing a tailored black blazer over a black satin camisole, warmer studio lighting with dramatic sunlight and shadow on a taupe wall, shoulders-up portrait crop. Keep the same body type, skin tone, posture, and camera angle across both panels so she is clearly the same person after a glow-up. Obscure the face in each panel with a centered solid rectangular privacy block matching the surrounding skin tone, covering the eyes, nose, and mouth. Use a clean vertical divider between the two panels, natural editorial fashion photography, realistic texture, no text, no logos, landscape 3:2 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的并排摄影风格“焕新”对比图，展示同一位年轻女性，垂直平分为 2 个等大的面板。左侧面板展示 {argument name="time label left" default="今日"} 的她：休闲、略显随意，深棕色头发扎成凌乱的高丸子头，有几缕碎发散落，身穿超大号浅灰色圆领卫衣，背景为中性灰色的室内墙面，柔和的自然光，肩部以上肖像构图。右侧面板展示 {argument name="time label right" default="5 年后"} 的她：自信且精致，深棕色长发光泽顺滑并中分，身穿黑色修身西装外套搭配黑色缎面吊带衫，温暖的摄影棚灯光，在灰褐色墙面上投下富有戏剧性的光影，肩部以上肖像构图。确保两个面板中的体型、肤色、姿态和拍摄角度保持一致，以便清晰地看出是同一个人在“焕新”后的状态。在每个面板的脸部中心位置，使用与周围肤色相近的纯色矩形遮挡块遮住眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴。两个面板之间使用清晰的垂直分隔线，采用自然的时尚杂志摄影风格，纹理逼真，无文字，无 Logo，横向 3:2 构图。

templates.title: Whimsical Crayon Utopia Quote

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻蜡笔乌托邦引言

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a cheerful childlike wax-crayon illustration on white textured paper in a naive hand-drawn style, using pastel scribbly strokes and soft uneven outlines. Show three storybook children across the upper middle: on the left, a child in a purple wide-brim hat and purple cloak holding a tiny teacup, with the face replaced by a plain beige square; in the center, a boy in a green cap and green jacket with yellow suspenders, touching his mouth thoughtfully; on the right, a smiling child in profile wearing a pink feathered beret and a blue striped shirt with pink-and-black suspenders. Surround them with playful doodles: 2 smiling clouds, 1 smiling sun, 2 smiling yellow stars, 1 plain yellow star, 1 small blue star, 1 purple asterisk star, 2 large flowers, 3 small flowers, 1 teddy bear with a purple bow, 1 lollipop, 1 wrapped candy, 1 tulip, 1 pink ribbon bow, green grass, leafy vines, small dots and curls, and many pink hearts. In the center-lower area place a large scalloped pink crayon frame decorated with green vine flourishes and a bow at the top; inside it write the hand-lettered French quote {argument name="quote" default="Notre tâche la plus importante, pour le moment, est de bâtir des châteaux en Espagne."} in dark gray, with the attribution below in purple and pink: {argument name="attribution" default="Lewis Mumford, The Story of Utopias (1922)"}. Keep the mood whimsical, optimistic, handmade, and nursery-wall friendly, with imperfect crayon texture, rounded cute faces, rosy cheeks, and no photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 在白色纹理纸上创作一幅欢快的儿童蜡笔画，采用稚拙的手绘风格，使用柔和的涂鸦笔触和柔软不规则的轮廓。在画面中上部展示三位故事书中的孩子：左侧是一位戴着紫色宽檐帽和紫色斗篷的孩子，手持一个小茶杯，脸部被一个简单的米色正方形取代；中间是一位戴着绿色帽子、身穿绿色夹克并配有黄色背带的男孩，正若有所思地摸着嘴；右侧是一位侧面的微笑孩子，戴着粉色羽毛贝雷帽，身穿蓝色条纹衬衫，配有粉黑相间的背带。周围环绕着俏皮的涂鸦：2 朵微笑的云、1 个微笑的太阳、2 颗微笑的黄色星星、1 颗普通的黄色星星、1 颗蓝色小星星、1 颗紫色星号、2 朵大花、3 朵小花、1 只系着紫色蝴蝶结的泰迪熊、1 根棒棒糖、1 颗包装好的糖果、1 朵郁金香、1 个粉色丝带蝴蝶结、绿草、叶蔓、小圆点和卷曲纹，以及许多粉色爱心。在画面中下方放置一个大的扇形粉色蜡笔边框，并用绿色藤蔓和顶部的蝴蝶结装饰；在边框内用手写体书写法语引言 {argument name="quote" default="Notre tâche la plus importante, pour le moment, est de bâtir des châteaux en Espagne."}，颜色为深灰色，下方用紫色和粉色标注出处：{argument name="attribution" default="Lewis Mumford, The Story of Utopias (1922)"}。保持奇幻、乐观、手工制作的氛围，适合装饰育儿室墙面，呈现不完美的蜡笔质感、圆润可爱的脸庞、红润的脸颊，且不追求写实效果。

templates.title: Red Dragon Lighthouse Storm

titleLocalized.zh: 红龙灯塔风暴

templates.prompt: Create a dark fantasy concept art scene of a colossal {argument name="dragon color" default="red"} dragon coiled tightly around a weathered medieval stone lighthouse on a jagged sea cliff. The dragon has enormous outstretched batlike wings spanning nearly the full width of the image, leathery torn membranes, black horned spines along its head and neck, sharp claws gripping the tower, and a serpentine body wrapped in a spiral around the lighthouse. Its head bends downward beside the tower with a fierce predatory expression, glowing eyes, ridged scales, and wet highlights from heavy rain. The lighthouse is ancient gray stone with small arched windows, ruined battlements and castle-like masonry at its base, and a bright warm lantern glowing at the top, partially encircled by the dragon. Set the scene during a violent {argument name="storm type" default="thunderstorm"} at night, with a dramatic purple-black sky filled with multiple branching lightning bolts behind the dragon, diagonal sheets of rain, mist, and storm clouds illuminated from within. Below, huge ocean waves crash against the rocky cliff, sending white spray upward; the sea is dark navy with foaming surf. Add distant rocky silhouettes and faint ruined coastal structures on the horizon for scale. Use cinematic vertical-square composition, high contrast, epic fantasy realism, painterly digital concept art, intricate scale detail, moody violet and crimson color palette, backlit lightning, wet reflective surfaces, volumetric atmosphere, dramatic perspective, no text, no border.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个黑暗奇幻概念艺术场景，画面中一条巨大的 {argument name="dragon color" default="red"} 巨龙紧紧盘绕在一座位于崎岖海崖上的风化中世纪石制灯塔上。巨龙拥有巨大的蝙蝠状双翼，翼展几乎覆盖整个画面宽度，翼膜皮革质感且有破损，头部和颈部布满黑色角刺，锋利的爪子紧扣塔身，蛇形躯体呈螺旋状缠绕在灯塔周围。它的头部在塔旁向下弯曲，表情凶猛且具有掠食性，双眼闪烁着光芒，鳞片隆起，在暴雨中呈现出湿润的质感。灯塔由古老的灰色石块建成，带有拱形小窗、残破的城垛和底部的城堡式砖石结构，塔顶亮着温暖的灯光，部分被巨龙环绕。场景设定在夜晚一场猛烈的 {argument name="storm type" default="thunderstorm"} 中，背景是戏剧性的紫黑色天空，巨龙身后布满分叉的闪电、倾斜的雨幕、薄雾以及被内部照亮的风暴云。下方，巨大的海浪拍打着岩石峭壁，激起白色的浪花；大海呈深海军蓝，伴有泡沫翻涌。在地平线上添加远处的岩石剪影和模糊的残破海岸建筑以体现比例感。采用电影级垂直方形构图，高对比度，史诗奇幻写实风格，绘画感数字概念艺术，精细的鳞片细节，深沉的紫红色调，背光闪电，湿润的反射表面，体积感氛围，戏剧性的透视效果，无文字，无边框。

templates.title: Dragon-Coiled Lighthouse Storm

titleLocalized.zh: 盘龙灯塔风暴

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic high-fantasy concept art scene of a {argument name="dragon color" default="red"} dragon coiled tightly around a weathered medieval stone lighthouse on a jagged sea cliff. The dragon is enormous, serpentine, and menacing, with glossy crimson scales, sharp horns and spines, glowing eyes, an open roaring mouth, clawed feet gripping the masonry, a long tail wrapped around the tower base, and one vast torn membrane wing spread across the right side of the composition. The lighthouse is old gray stone with cracks, arched windows glowing warm amber, a circular balcony, and a glass lantern room at the top. Place the scene during a violent {argument name="storm type" default="thunderstorm"} at night: diagonal sheets of heavy rain, purple-black storm clouds, bright branching lightning bolts behind the dragon and tower, and turbulent ocean waves exploding against the cliff below in white foam. Use a low-angle cinematic composition, the lighthouse centered, the dragon wrapping around it in an S-curve, the wing silhouetted against lightning, with intense contrast between cold blue-purple storm light and warm lantern glow. Render in highly detailed fantasy realism with dramatic lighting, sharp textures, wet stone, reflective scales, sea spray, motion in the rain, epic scale, and a dark atmospheric mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅极具戏剧性的高奇幻概念艺术场景，画面中一条 {argument name="dragon color" default="红"} 色的巨龙紧紧盘绕在一座位于崎岖海崖上的斑驳中世纪石质灯塔上。巨龙体型巨大，呈蛇形，神态凶猛，拥有光泽的深红色鳞片、锋利的角和背棘、发光的双眼、张开咆哮的巨口，利爪紧扣砖石，长尾缠绕在塔基，一侧巨大的破损翼膜在画面右侧展开。灯塔由古老的灰色石块堆砌而成，布满裂纹，拱形窗户透出温暖的琥珀色光芒，设有圆形阳台，顶部为玻璃灯室。场景设定在夜晚一场猛烈的 {argument name="storm type" default="雷暴"} 中：斜向的暴雨如注，紫黑色的风暴云层翻滚，明亮的树枝状闪电在巨龙与灯塔后方划破长空，汹涌的海浪在下方崖壁上激起层层白色浪花。采用低角度电影级构图，灯塔位于画面中心，巨龙呈 S 型盘绕其上，翅膀在闪电映衬下呈现剪影，冷色调的蓝紫色风暴光影与暖色调的灯光形成强烈对比。以高度细腻的奇幻写实风格渲染，强调戏剧性光影、锐利的纹理、湿润的石材、反光的鳞片、海浪喷雾、雨中的动态感、史诗般的宏大尺度以及阴郁的氛围感。

templates.title: Monochrome Luxury Studio Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黑白奢华影棚肖像

templates.prompt: A dramatic black-and-white studio portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="confident bearded man wearing unique, thin-framed gold round sunglasses with dark tinted lenses and a tailored dark suit"}, captured in a close-up composition with a shallow depth of field. He is positioned slightly to the right side of the frame, photographed at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens look. His head is turned to the left in profile view, gazing off-camera with a calm, contemplative expression, chin slightly raised. His left hand is loosely clenched near his chin, adding intensity and sophistication to the pose. The lighting is classic Rembrandt-style side lighting, soft yet highly directional, creating deep cinematic shadows across the right side of his face and neck while illuminating the left side of his face, forehead, nose bridge, and knuckles. Strong catchlights in the eyes are essential. The portrait should feel moody, elegant, and editorial, with rich tonal contrast and crisp texture detail. His beard is meticulously groomed with visible individual hairs and realistic skin texture including pores, eyelashes, and subtle facial lines. He has a messy hair and wears a {argument name="accessory" default="luxury metal wristwatch"} on his left wrist with reflective metallic surfaces, visible bezel details, and a polished bracelet. On the cuff of his dark jacket, a silver-toned Roman numeral “III” detail appears vertically in a bold serif style. The suit fabric is matte black with subtle folds and stitched cuff details. The watch crystal and metal edges catch highlights naturally while the clothing remains mostly matte. The overall palette is monochrome only: deep blacks, bright whites, and rich greys with very high contrast. The background is a dark studio backdrop with soft mottled texture fading into near-black shadows and a heavy vignette on the right side. Slight soft-focus blur appears in the extreme foreground near the bottom edge, adding depth and realism. Ultra-realistic photography, cinematic portrait style, luxury fashion editorial aesthetic, extremely detailed beard texture, realistic skin micro-details, sharp focus on the eyes and face, high dynamic range monochrome tones, no visible noise, no compression artifacts.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧张力的黑白影棚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位自信的蓄须男士，佩戴着独特的细框金色圆框深色墨镜，身着剪裁考究的深色西装"}，采用浅景深特写构图。他位于画面右侧，以 85mm 肖像镜头视角平视拍摄。头部转向左侧呈侧面轮廓，目光看向画外，神情沉静而深邃，下巴微抬。左手在下巴附近轻握，为姿态增添了张力与高级感。光影采用经典的伦勃朗式侧光，柔和且具有极强的方向性，在面部和颈部右侧投下深邃的电影感阴影，同时照亮左侧面部、额头、鼻梁及指关节。眼部的强高光至关重要。肖像应呈现出忧郁、优雅的杂志大片质感，具备丰富的色调对比与清晰的纹理细节。胡须修剪得一丝不苟，可见清晰的单根毛发，皮肤纹理真实，包含毛孔、睫毛及细微的面部线条。他留着凌乱的发型，左手腕佩戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="奢华金属腕表"}，表盘具有金属反射光泽、清晰的表圈细节及抛光表带。深色西装袖口处，垂直装饰着银色罗马数字“III”，采用醒目的衬线字体。西装面料为哑光黑色，带有细微的褶皱与缝合袖口细节。表镜与金属边缘自然捕捉高光，而衣物保持哑光质感。整体色调仅为单色：深黑、亮白与丰富的灰色，对比度极高。背景为带有柔和斑驳纹理的深色影棚背景，向右侧渐变为近乎纯黑的阴影并带有浓重的暗角。画面底部极近处有轻微的柔焦模糊，增加了深度与真实感。超写实摄影，电影级肖像风格，奢华时尚杂志美学，极度细腻的胡须质感，真实的皮肤微观细节，焦点精准对准眼睛与面部，高动态范围黑白影调，无可见噪点，无压缩伪影。

templates.title: Minimalist Cave Painting Style Avatar

titleLocalized.zh: 极简洞穴壁画线条艺术

templates.prompt:
Transform the input image into a {argument name="ratio" default="1:1"} minimalist symbolic line illustration suitable for social media avatars. The subject can be a person, animal, or plant. Do not replicate the exact form, describe details, or use complete outlines. Instead, like early murals or primitive carvings, extract the most essential expression, posture, and contour features of the subject, leaving marks with a minimal number of lines. The goal is not to draw the whole subject but to create a refined symbolic image where just a few strokes reveal its temperament and charm.

The number of lines must be extremely small, ideally within {argument name="line count" default="3 to 6 strokes"}. Every stroke should be simple, direct, and decisive, as if drawn in one go, with natural pauses and slight fluctuations. It should not be mechanical, polished, overly smooth, or form a modern logo-style closed outline. Allow for breaks, white space, and omissions to participate in the expression. Do not draw facial details, hair texture, clothing folds, leaf veins, or other explanatory details; retain only the most critical contour turns and expressive pivot points.

The overall vibe should be primitive, direct, restrained, and accurate, like a primal visual language. The background should remain simple, quiet, and steady, using a {argument name="background color" default="deep red"}, stone wall color, gray-white, dark tone, or other plain colors that can highlight the lines. The main lines should be clear, simple, and have a sense of presence. Avoid realism, shadows, volume, complex decorations, or modern graphic design styles. The final effect should be an extremely refined symbolic mark: minimal, accurate, powerful, and quiet, extracting the essence of the subject in just a few strokes.

promptLocalized.zh: 将输入图像转换为适合社交媒体头像的 1:1 极简象征性线条插画。主体可以是人物、动物或植物。不要复制物理形态，不要描述细节，也不要使用完整的轮廓；相反，要像早期壁画或原始雕刻那样，提取主体最本质的神韵、姿态和轮廓特征，用最少的线条直接刻画。目标不是完成一幅画，而是一个精炼的具象符号，仅需几笔即可辨认出气质与精髓。线条数量必须极少，最好在 3 到 6 笔之间。每一笔都应简单、直接、果断，仿佛一气呵成，带有自然的停顿和轻微的起伏——既不机械也不圆滑，不过分平整，也不是现代 Logo 风格的闭合轮廓。允许断笔、留白和省略，让空白处参与表达。不要绘制面部特征、头发纹理、衣褶、叶脉或其他描述性细节；仅保留最关键的轮廓转折和情感焦点。整体审美应原始、直接、克制且精准，如同祖先的视觉语言。背景应保持简洁、安静、稳重，使用纯净的浅地色、石墙色、灰白色、深色调或其他能衬托线条的素色。主线条应清晰、简洁且有力。避免写实、阴影、体积感、复杂的装饰或现代图形设计风格。最终结果应是一个极其精炼的具象符号：稀疏、准确、锐利且宁静，以寥寥数笔捕捉主体的精髓。深红色背景。长宽比 9:10。

templates.prompt:
{argument name="person name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}.
Act as a premium sports graphic designer making a conceptual tribute poster. Style: an intricate "double-exposure photo-grid composite" blending mixed-media textures.

CENTER (THE VESSEL):
A large, high-contrast black-and-white portrait silhouette of {argument name="person name" default="[PERSON NAME]"} dominates the frame. This silhouette serves as the container holding everything else.

GRID INTERIOR (MIXED MEDIA):
Fill the inside of the silhouette with a dense photo-mosaic grid of career action moments.
TEXTURE RULE: do not drop in flat images. Vary the cells with tactile, collage-style finishes:
Halftone Dots: comic-book raster patterns on select cells.
Fabric / Embroidery: faint thread or canvas weave evoking a jersey or patch.
Film Grain: heavy noise on certain high-contrast action shots.

COLOR STRATEGY:
Anchor the piece in monochrome B&W. Drop selective color overlays (team or flag tones) onto a few isolated grid cells ONLY, creating visual rhythm.

TYPOGRAPHY & BRANDING (STRICT MICRO-SCALING):
Top Left (The Name): set "{argument name="person name" default="[PERSON NAME]"}" strictly in Inter Semibold.
Kerning: tight negative kearning (-4%).
Size: SMALL and understated. It must occupy MAXIMUM 20% of the canvas width. Do NOT make it large or loud.
Top Right (The Symbol): place the primary logo (Team/Brand/Flag).
Size: VERY SMALL. It must occupy MAXIMUM 10% of the canvas width.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND:
Background: off-white or light grey with a visible high-quality paper or concrete texture. It should not be flat digital white.
Alignment: figure perfectly centered. Maintain wide negative space around the object.

Organic branching structural columns mimicking tree trunks and limbs, cantilevered volumes projecting asymmetrically, full-height glass curtain walls with slim mullions, exposed board-formed concrete cores, warm-toned timber cladding panels, green terraces cascading at each floor level, rooftop garden with native planting, elevated platform volumes integrated between existing trees, natural cross-ventilation cutaways shown in section, passive solar and sustainable strategy diagrams annotated with arrows, floor plan levels clearly marked, structural grid expressed through glazing.

炭灰色和深石墨色调的纸张纹理，绘图后方隐约可见的蓝图网格线，淡淡的施工参考线，优雅的单色调配色（黑色、灰色、米白色），并点缀选择性的暖琥珀色和木质色调高光，无杂乱感，高级工作室展示品质。

templates.title: Minimalist Single Line Social Media Avatar

titleLocalized.zh: 极简单线社交媒体头像

templates.prompt: Please transform the input image into a minimalist single-line illustration suitable for social media avatars, with a default aspect ratio of 1:1. The subject can be a person, cat, dog, other animals, or plants. Based on the input subject type, automatically extract the most recognizable outer contours and key features, and summarize them into an artistic, minimalist single-line avatar/image illustration. The overall goal is not mechanical outlining, but retaining the subject's charm and recognizability, reconstructing it with higher elegance and spirit through single lines. [Subject Processing Logic] If the subject is a person: retain key contours such as face shape, forehead, bridge of the nose, mouth transitions, chin, ears, hairstyle, keeping only necessary facial features to avoid cluttered details. If the subject is an animal: retain head shape, ears, muzzle contours, eye expressions, and the main flow of fur to avoid complex details. If the subject is a plant: retain the most recognizable morphological features of flowers, leaves, branches, or fruits, summarizing their posture and rhythm with simple lines. [Line Style Requirements] Lines must be smooth, rounded, stretched, bold, and natural, as continuous as possible, with a sense of breath and improvisation. Use soft arcs mainly, avoiding sharp, stiff, or rigid lines. Do not draw as a rigid logo-style outline. Lines should be simple but vital, with a touch of casual artistic flair, looking relaxed and collectible. [Composition and Avatar Adaptation] 1:1 square design. The subject should be clear, concentrated, and prominent. Centered or slightly centered composition with clear visual focus and sufficient white space. [Background Logic] Do not fix the color to one type (not always blue). Select dark-toned background logic based on the image's temperament. Avoid neon or cheap bright colors. [Line Color Logic] Use thin white lines or light-colored lines contrasting with the background. [Embellishment Logic] Add small, random, colorful dots, arcs, stars, or geometric symbols to enhance spirit and fun. Keep them sparse and natural. [Overall Goal] Minimalist, light, modern, and artistic. Suitable for social media: eye-catching, recognizable, and fun. [Avoid] Realism, shadows, textures, complex scenes, mechanical outlining. Ratio 16:9

promptLocalized.zh: 请将输入图像转换为适合社交媒体头像的极简单线插画，默认长宽比为 1:1。主体可以是人物、猫、狗、其他动物或植物。根据输入主体的类型，自动提取最具辨识度的外轮廓和关键特征，并将其概括为艺术化的极简单线头像/插画。总体目标不是机械地描边，而是保留主体的神韵和辨识度，通过单线以更优雅、更有灵气的方式进行重构。[主体处理逻辑] 若主体为人物：保留脸型、额头、鼻梁过渡、嘴部过渡、下巴、耳朵、发型等关键轮廓，仅保留必要的面部特征，避免细节杂乱。若主体为动物：保留头部形状、耳朵、口鼻轮廓、眼神以及毛发的主要走向，避免复杂细节。若主体为植物：保留花朵、叶片、枝干或果实最具辨识度的形态特征，用简洁的线条概括其姿态与韵律。[线条风格要求] 线条必须圆润、舒展、粗犷且自然，尽可能连贯，带有呼吸感和即兴感。主要使用柔和的弧线，避免尖锐、生硬或刻板的线条。不要画成死板的 Logo 式轮廓。线条应简洁而富有生命力，带有一丝随性的艺术气息，看起来轻松且具有收藏价值。[构图与头像适配] 1:1 正方形设计。主体应清晰、集中且突出。采用居中或微偏构图，视觉焦点明确，留白充足。[背景逻辑] 不要将颜色固定为某一种（不一定总是蓝色）。根据图像的气质选择深色调背景逻辑。避免使用霓虹色或廉价的亮色。[线条颜色逻辑] 使用与背景形成对比的细白线或浅色线条。[点缀逻辑] 添加少量随机的彩色圆点、弧线、星星或几何符号，以增强灵气和趣味性。保持稀疏自然。[总体目标] 极简、轻盈、现代且艺术化。适合社交媒体：引人注目、易于识别且有趣。[避免] 写实、阴影、纹理、复杂场景、机械描边。比例 16:9

The four small images must feature the same woman, strictly preserving her face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, {argument name="age feel" default="50-65 years old"}, basic hairstyle, body type, and overall temperament. Do not transform her into a stranger, do not make her younger, do not use an influencer look, and do not over-smooth the skin. The overall style is a New Chinese Qipao retro studio portrait. The images should be exquisite and natural, with the feel of traditional photo studios, retro Chinese magazine shoots, a slight film grain, and a soft oil painting texture. Clothing should be dignified modified Qipao or New Chinese suits in colors like {argument name="clothing colors" default="dark green, navy blue, wine red, pearl white, or lotus pink"}. Props can include folding fans, Magnolia flowers, orchids, pearl necklaces, wooden chairs, and vases. The background should be unified in colors like {argument name="background color" default="dark green, black, misty blue, deep purple, retro red, or warm caramel"}. The four images must have distinct variations in poses (seated full body, half-body holding flowers, profile view, front half-body), expressions, and angles while maintaining consistent lighting, wardrobe, and scene style. Keep the skin realistic with slight signs of aging and a mature temperament. Avoid cheap studio vibes, heavy makeup, or excessive flamboyance.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于用户上传的真实照片，生成 2×2 的“新中式复古妈妈人像”网格。四张小图必须为同一位女性，严格保留其脸型、五官比例、眼鼻唇、肤色、{argument name="age feel" default="50-65 岁"}、基础发型、体型及整体气质。严禁将人物面部特征改变为他人，严禁过度年轻化，严禁网红脸，严禁过度磨皮。整体风格为新中式旗袍复古影楼人像。画面需精致自然，呈现传统影楼质感、复古中国风杂志大片感，带有轻微胶片颗粒感和柔和的油画质感。服装应为端庄的改良旗袍或新中式套装，颜色可选 {argument name="clothing colors" default="墨绿、藏青、酒红、珍珠白或藕粉色"}。道具可包含折扇、玉兰花、兰花、珍珠项链、木椅及花瓶。背景色调需统一，可选 {argument name="background color" default="深绿、黑色、雾霾蓝、深紫、复古红或暖焦糖色"}。四张图片需在姿势（坐姿全身、手持花卉半身、侧颜、正面半身）、表情和角度上有所区别，同时保持灯光、服装和场景风格的一致性。保持皮肤真实质感，呈现适度的岁月痕迹与成熟气质。避免廉价影楼感、浓妆艳抹或过度浮夸的风格。

templates.title: Conceptual Crowd Portrait Installation Art

titleLocalized.zh: 概念化人群肖像装置艺术

templates.prompt: # Conceptual Crowd Portrait Please generate a visually impactful "Conceptual Crowd Portrait" based on a clear real-life photo uploaded by the user. ## I. Identity Requirements Strictly refer to the real identity characteristics of the person in the uploaded photo, including: - Facial contour - Facial proportions - Eye and brow structure - Nose shape - Lip shape - Hairstyle foundation - Skin tone and sense of age - Gaze and temperament - Overall character recognizability The final image must allow the viewer to immediately recognize the person from the uploaded photo. Do not turn them into a stranger, do not Westernize, do not idolize/beautify excessively, and do not generate a fake AI face. ## II. Core Concept Recreate the portrait as a large-scale conceptual installation art piece. The entire portrait head is composed of thousands of miniature people, arranged densely like a crowd formation. Through different positions, clothing shades, crowd density, and shadow variations, they collectively form the face, hair, features, glasses, beard, clothing outlines, and overall expression of the person in the photo. The image looks like a giant portrait made of a real crowd, or a contemporary art installation placed in a minimalist white space. ## III. Composition - Vertical composition, suitable for visual posters or conceptual covers. - Aerial view / Isometric top-down view. - The portrait head occupies the main subject of the frame. - Background is a minimalist pure white space with significant negative space. - A few small people are scattered around the portrait to enhance the sense of spatial proportion and realistic scale. - The crowd as a whole forms a clear outline, and facial features must be accurately placed. ## IV. Visual Elements ### Crowd Structure - Use dense crowds to form hair, eyebrows, eyes, bridge of the nose, lips, jawline, and clothes. - Dark-clothed people form hair, glasses, collars, and shadow areas. - Light-clothed people form facial highlights and skin areas. - The arrangement should be natural, with a realistic sense of crowding and small random variations. - Each miniature person should have an independent posture, clothing, and direction, avoiding a copy-paste look. ### Lighting Effects - Soft cinematic lighting. - Low-angle long shadows. - Natural shadows cast at the feet of the crowd. - Unified shadow direction to enhance spatial realism. - Overall clean, high-end, and quiet aesthetic. ### Color Style - Warm neutral tones. - Primarily off-white, light brown, gray, and charcoal black. - Dark clothing used to strengthen character outlines. - Skin areas transitioned with light beige and warm gray crowds. - Restrained color palette, avoiding excessive vibrancy. ## V. Art Style Overall style references: - Contemporary conceptual art. - Museum-grade installation art. - Hyper-realistic crowd simulation. - Minimalist visual posters. - High-end digital art. - Social metaphor visual works. - Cinematic conceptual photography. The image should have a strong visual metaphor: An individual's image is composed of countless tiny individuals, offering both the shock of a macro portrait and the explorability of micro-crowd details. ## VI. Mood Overall atmospheric keywords: - Surreal - Profound - Quiet - High-end - Modern - Thought-provoking - Cinematic - Visually shocking - Shareable ## VII. Rendering Quality - Ultra-high detail. - 8K texture. - Realistic crowd simulation. - Deep focus, ensuring the entire crowd portrait is clearly visible. - Rich details in miniature figures. - Realistic spatial proportions. - Clean image with no cluttered background. - High-end commercial visual quality. - Similar to Octane Render / high-end 3D conceptual rendering effects. ## VIII. Negative Constraints Please avoid the following: - Do not turn the person into a stranger. - Do not just generate a normal portrait. - Do not generate simple collages. - Do not let the crowd lose the portrait outline. - No misplacement of facial features. - No blurred facial structures. - No exaggerated cartoon style. - No low-resolution posters. - No messy backgrounds. - Do not make all miniature people look identical. - No text, watermarks, or logos. - No excessive beautification. - Do not change the person's sense of age or authentic temperament.

promptLocalized.zh: # 概念化人群肖像 请根据用户上传的清晰真实照片，生成一张具有强烈视觉冲击力的“概念化人群肖像”。 ## I. 身份要求 严格参考上传照片中人物的真实身份特征，包括： - 面部轮廓 - 面部比例 - 眉眼结构 - 鼻型 - 唇形 - 发型基础 - 肤色与年龄感 - 眼神与气质 - 整体人物辨识度 最终生成的图像必须让观众一眼就能认出照片中的人物。请勿将其变成陌生人，请勿西化，请勿过度偶像化/美化，也请勿生成虚假的 AI 面孔。 ## II. 核心概念 将肖像重构为大型概念装置艺术作品。整个肖像头部由成千上万个微小人物组成，像人群方阵一样密集排列。通过不同的位置、服装深浅、人群密度和阴影变化，共同勾勒出照片中人物的面部、头发、五官、眼镜、胡须、服装轮廓及整体表情。图像看起来像是一个由真实人群组成的巨型肖像，或是一件置于极简白色空间中的当代艺术装置。 ## III. 构图 - 竖构图，适合视觉海报或概念封面。 - 俯视视角 / 等轴测顶视图。 - 肖像头部占据画面主体。 - 背景为极简纯白空间，留有大量负空间。 - 肖像周围散布少量微小人物，以增强空间比例感和真实尺度感。 - 人群整体形成清晰的轮廓，五官位置必须精准。 ## IV. 视觉元素 ### 人群结构 - 使用密集的人群构成头发、眉毛、眼睛、鼻梁、嘴唇、下颌线和衣服。 - 深色服装的人群构成头发、眼镜、衣领和阴影区域。 - 浅色服装的人群构成面部高光和皮肤区域。 - 排列应自然，具有真实的人群拥挤感和细微的随机变化。 - 每个微小人物都应有独立的姿态、服装和朝向，避免复制粘贴感。 ### 灯光效果 - 柔和的电影级灯光。 - 低角度长投影。 - 人群脚下投射出自然的阴影。 - 统一的阴影方向以增强空间真实感。 - 整体风格干净、高端且宁静。 ### 色彩风格 - 暖中性色调。 - 以米白色、浅棕色、灰色和炭黑色为主。 - 使用深色服装加强人物轮廓。 - 皮肤区域用浅米色和暖灰色人群过渡。 - 色调克制，避免过度鲜艳。 ## V. 艺术风格 整体风格参考： - 当代概念艺术。 - 博物馆级装置艺术。 - 超写实人群模拟。 - 极简主义视觉海报。 - 高端数字艺术。 - 社会隐喻视觉作品。 - 电影级概念摄影。 图像应具有强烈的视觉隐喻：个体的形象由无数微小的个体组成，既有宏观肖像的震撼感，又有微观人群细节的可探索性。 ## VI. 氛围 整体氛围关键词： - 超现实 - 深邃 - 宁静 - 高端 - 现代 - 发人深省 - 电影感 - 视觉震撼 - 易于传播 ## VII. 渲染质量 - 超高细节。 - 8K 纹理。 - 真实的人群模拟。 - 深焦距，确保整个人群肖像清晰可见。 - 微小人物的丰富细节。 - 真实的比例感。 - 画面干净，无杂乱背景。 - 高端商业视觉品质。 - 类似于 Octane Render / 高端 3D 概念渲染效果。 ## VIII. 负面约束 请避免以下情况： - 请勿将人物变成陌生人。 - 请勿仅生成普通肖像。 - 请勿生成简单的拼贴画。 - 请勿让人群失去肖像轮廓。 - 五官不得错位。 - 面部结构不得模糊。 - 不得使用夸张的卡通风格。 - 不得使用低分辨率海报。 - 不得使用杂乱背景。 - 请勿让所有微小人物看起来完全相同。 - 不得包含文字、水印或 Logo。 - 请勿过度美化。 - 请勿改变人物的年龄感或真实气质。

templates.prompt: Please convert this illustration into a {argument name="style" default="Wireframe"} style. Express the outline and internal structure with thin, precise lines, and draw polygon edges and geometric lines overlaid throughout like a 3D model. Lines should be uniform and sharp, emphasizing three-dimensionality and depth through intersecting lines, making it look like a light, transparent structure. templates.title: Misordered Image Relay Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 错位图像接力网格

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Based on the attached image, arrange {argument name="quantity" default="12 versions"} in a {argument name="grid" default="3x4"} grid. Express this as if the image were passed sequentially to 12 different people, each looking only at what the previous person made and mistakenly assuming 'this must be what was requested' or 'this is meant for this purpose,' leading them to redesign it. Start the first frame with an atmosphere very close to the original. As the frames progress, have the shape, color, expression, pose, composition, motifs, and mood of the original image gradually be misunderstood, simplified, converted for different uses, and move away from its original meaning and appearance. Each frame should look like it was remade by a person who only saw the previous frame and judged 'this must have been the request.' Naturally change it according to the content of the original image, whether it's a person, character, pet, food, landscape, building, or profile image. Do not fix the intermediate changes too strictly. It's okay to misunderstand it as an illustration in one frame, a mascot in the next, a commercial product, a sign, a flyer, a stuffed toy, food packaging, tourist goods, a warning sign, a game character, a mysterious toy, a reference icon, or a handmade craft. The direction of change should be naturally associated with the appearance of the original and the previous frame. As the frames progress, make it look like 'you can tell someone was trying to make it properly, but they slightly misunderstood what the request was.' Let the shapes, proportions, eyes, mouths, outlines, color placement, textures, uses, decorations, and compositions shift bit by bit, leading to an unexpected and humorous appearance in the latter half. The key is not just image degradation or noise, but to make it look like it's collapsing because humans misinterpreted the previous result while rebuilding it for a different purpose. In the latter half, do not completely erase the characteristics of the original image, but unnaturally leave one or two elements like color, outline, expression, hairstyle, clothes, accessories, pose, composition, or motif. Meanwhile, other elements can be boldly omitted, transformed, misunderstood, or turned into something else. Make the 12th frame bold enough that only someone who knows the original image can barely sense the original source, while appearing as a completely different mysterious entity, product, character, craft, icon, or mascot to a first-time viewer. End with an unexpected and slightly funny landing that makes people think 'Why did it end up like this?!' Make each frame look different. Keep the background white and simple, organized into a 3x4 grid for easy viewing of the 12 variations. In the later frames, don't make them too neat; instead, let one person's misunderstanding be further misunderstood by the next. In the 12th frame, change it so boldly that while one feature of the original remains strangely, everything else is almost entirely different.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于所附图像，排列 {argument name="quantity" default="12 个版本"} 并放入一个 {argument name="grid" default="3x4"} 的网格中。请将其表现为图像被依次传递给 12 个不同的人，每个人只看前一个人制作的内容，并错误地认为“这一定是所要求的”或“这是用于此目的的”，从而对其进行重新设计。第一帧的氛围应非常接近原图。随着帧数的推进，让原图的形状、颜色、表情、姿势、构图、主题和情绪逐渐被误解、简化、转换为不同用途，并偏离其原始含义和外观。每一帧都应看起来像是被一个只看过前一帧并判断“这一定是要求”的人重新制作的。根据原图的内容（无论是人物、角色、宠物、食物、风景、建筑还是个人头像），自然地进行改变。不要太严格地固定中间的变化。可以在某一帧将其误解为插画，下一帧误解为吉祥物，或者商业产品、标志、传单、毛绒玩具、食品包装、旅游商品、警告标志、游戏角色、神秘玩具、参考图标或手工制品。变化的走向应与原图及前一帧的外观自然关联。随着帧数的推进，使其看起来像是“你能看出有人在努力做好，但他们稍微误解了要求”。让形状、比例、眼睛、嘴巴、轮廓、颜色布局、纹理、用途、装饰和构图一点点偏移，导致后半部分出现意想不到且幽默的外观。关键不在于图像的退化或噪点，而在于让它看起来像是人类在为不同目的重建时，因为误解了前一个结果而导致的崩坏。在后半部分，不要完全抹去原图的特征，而是不自然地保留一两个元素，如颜色、轮廓、表情、发型、衣服、配饰、姿势、构图或主题。同时，其他元素可以大胆地省略、转换、误解或变成其他东西。让第 12 帧足够大胆，以至于只有了解原图的人才能勉强感知到原始来源，而对于初次观看者来说，它看起来是一个完全不同的神秘实体、产品、角色、工艺品、图标或吉祥物。以一个意想不到且略带滑稽的结局收尾，让人不禁感叹“为什么会变成这样？！”。让每一帧看起来都不同。保持背景为白色且简洁，组织成 3x4 网格以便于查看 12 种变化。在后面的帧中，不要做得太整洁；相反，让一个人的误解被下一个人进一步误解。在第 12 帧中，进行大胆的改变，使得原图的一个特征奇怪地保留了下来，而其他一切几乎完全不同。

templates.prompt:
Based on the real photo I provide, generate a top-bottom split travel photography poster, referencing a "city check-in / fridge magnet / minimalist collage" style. 
[Structure] Vertical composition, 3:4 ratio, divided into two halves. 
The top 50% is a minimalist solid color background. 
The bottom 50% retains the original photo without modification. 
[Top Half: Fridge Magnet Icon] Extract the most recognizable subject from the bottom photo and transform it into a minimalist "fridge magnet style icon." 
1. Keep core outlines; 2. Clean and simple; 3. Slight 3D effect/shadow; 4. Clear white or light outline; 5. Moderate detail; 6. Centered in top half; 7. Small and delicate with ample white space. 
[Background] Use the primary memory color from the photo for the top half background. Use solid, saturated colors like the subject's clothing or environment. 
[Typography] Add elegant handwritten English text below the icon: "{argument name="text" default="spicycandy"}". 
[Aesthetic] High-end travel card vibe: real photo + minimalist magnet icon + solid background + light typography.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于我提供的真实照片，生成一张上下分屏的旅行摄影海报，整体参考 “{argument name="style" default="城市打卡 / 冰箱贴 / 极简拼贴"}” 风格。
[构图] 图片采用 3:4 比例的竖版布局，分为上、下两部分。
上半部分占据约 50%，采用极简纯色背景；
下半部分占据约 50%，保留原始照片，不做任何修改。
[上半部分：冰箱贴图标] 提取下半部分真实照片中最具辨识度的核心元素。将该建筑或主体元素转化为简单的 “冰箱贴风格角色图标”。
1. 保留核心轮廓和标志性特征；
2. 设计简洁明快，如同旅行纪念品冰箱贴；
3. 带有轻微的 3D 效果和投影；
4. 边缘清晰，带有白色或浅色描边；
5. 对细节进行适度简化；
6. 图标居中放置在上半部分的中心偏上位置；
7. 图标尺寸小巧精致，留白充裕。
[背景颜色] 从照片中提取最主要、最令人印象深刻的颜色作为上半部分的背景（例如服装颜色或强烈的环境色）。颜色应为纯色、饱和且干净，如同明信片一般。不要使用渐变或复杂的图案。
[排版] 在图标下方添加一行优雅的英文手写文字：“{argument name="handwritten text" default="spicycandy"}”
[整体美学] 高端旅行摄影卡片：真实照片 + 极简磁贴图标 + 原色背景 + 轻盈排版。清新、整洁、明亮，充满城市漫游氛围。强调辨识度、色彩记忆和旅行氛围。
[避免] 普通的拼贴画、复杂的上半部分、多余的装饰、修改下半部分的照片、乱码文字、过度的卡通化、图标过大或文字遮挡主体。

The same boy appears in every outfit with consistent facial features, medium-length textured hair, natural smile, and relaxed poses. The collage should feel warm, effortless, modern, and Pinterest-style.

Outfits include:

1. oversized white linen shirt with light blue wide-leg jeans and white sneakers
2. fitted black basic tee with beige pleated trousers and canvas shoes
3. oversized gray sweatshirt with black shorts, crew socks, and chunky sneakers
4. striped long sleeve shirt with loose white trousers and sneakers
5. fitted white tank top with relaxed blue jeans and shoulder bag
6. layered outfit with light blue overshirt, white tee, black wide trousers, sneakers
7. cream knit cardigan with relaxed denim jeans and casual shoes
8. navy button-up shirt with beige shorts, white socks, and retro sneakers

Add subtle handwritten annotations around outfits in a brown ink style, such as:

* “linen shirt”
* “basic tee”
* “oversized sweatshirt”
* “layered look”
* “neutrals always work”
* “shorts + sneakers”
* “effortless everyday essentials”

promptLocalized.zh:

6. 叠穿造型：浅蓝色外搭衬衫、白色 T 恤、黑色阔腿裤、运动鞋

加入指向穿搭细节的小箭头和涂鸦。

templates.title: Clean Authenticator Onboarding UI Mockups

titleLocalized.zh: 简洁的身份验证器入门引导 UI 模型

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 and REFERENCE_1 as the design references, recreate the same 4 mobile onboarding screens as clean, high-fidelity UI mockups instead of a photographed laptop screen. Remove all perspective distortion, laptop/browser surroundings, glare, and camera artifacts. Present the four iPhone-style screens front-facing, evenly spaced in one horizontal row on a light gray canvas, preserving the dark-mode version from REFERENCE_0 and the same screen order, typography hierarchy, blue security visual style, rounded phone frames, status bars, skip links, bottom home indicators, and CTA structure. Keep exactly 4 screens: 1) authenticator account protection with “Get Started”, 2) timely alerts with notification toggle and “Continue”, 3) end-to-end encryption with shield/lock and social icons plus “Continue”, 4) Face ID protection quick setup with scan overlay, toggle, and “Continue”. Make the UI crisp, polished, app-store-presentation ready, with sharp readable text and consistent spacing.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 和 REFERENCE_1 作为设计参考，重新创建相同的 4 个移动端入门引导屏幕，制作成简洁的高保真 UI 模型，而非拍摄的笔记本电脑屏幕。去除所有透视畸变、笔记本电脑/浏览器背景、反光及相机伪影。将四个 iPhone 风格的屏幕正面朝上，均匀分布在浅灰色画布上，并排成一行。请保留 REFERENCE_0 中的深色模式版本，以及相同的屏幕顺序、排版层级、蓝色安全视觉风格、圆角手机边框、状态栏、跳过链接、底部主页指示器和 CTA 结构。严格保留 4 个屏幕：1) 带有“开始使用”的身份验证器账户保护页，2) 带有通知开关和“继续”的及时提醒页，3) 带有盾牌/锁图标、社交图标及“继续”的端到端加密页，4) 带有扫描覆盖层、开关和“继续”的 Face ID 快速设置页。确保 UI 清晰、精致，达到应用商店展示标准，文字锐利易读，间距统一。

templates.title: Candid Night Market Food Offering

titleLocalized.zh: 夜市街头抓拍美食分享

templates.prompt: Create an authentic candid daily-life photograph at a lively night market at night, showing a three-quarter body shot of two young women interacting mid-gesture beside glowing food stalls. The woman on the left is an {argument name="left woman ethnicity" default="East Asian"} young woman in her early 20s with messy dark hair tied in a loose bun, wearing an oversized light gray zip-up hoodie with drawstrings and a black shoulder bag strap; her face is anonymized by a flat opaque dark-brown rectangular block. She stands slightly turned toward the right, holding out one small bamboo skewer with a bite-sized piece of grilled street food at the tip, arm extended at chest height in a casual offering gesture. The woman on the right is an {argument name="right woman ethnicity" default="African"} young woman in her early 20s with a high natural curly puff, wearing a black bomber jacket over a white basic T-shirt and carrying a black shoulder bag; her face is also anonymized by a flat opaque dark-brown rectangular block. She leans slightly toward the skewer, one hand raised with fingers loosely open as if about to accept the food, body language suggesting surprise, amusement, and appetite. Use warm amber stall lighting from the left, visible specular highlights on clothing and skin, deep night shadows, and a strong cinematic contrast between orange food-stall glow and cool blue background lights. The background should include one busy street-food stall on the left with trays of food, metal framing, bright exposed bulbs, and blurred shoppers; on the right and far background include dark market silhouettes, neon signage, bokeh lights, and shallow depth of field. Compose from a three-quarter side angle, waist-up to thigh-up framing, natural handheld street photography, realistic lens perspective, candid timing, slight motion in stray hairs and hands, high detail, photorealistic texture, documentary style, no posing, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张真实自然的夜市生活抓拍照片，展现两名年轻女性在灯火通明的摊位旁互动的半身像。左侧女性为 {argument name="left woman ethnicity" default="东亚裔"}，20 岁出头，凌乱的深色头发扎成松散的发髻，身穿超大号浅灰色拉链连帽衫，系着抽绳，背着黑色单肩包；她的面部被一个扁平的不透明深棕色长方形遮挡。她身体微向右转，手持一根竹签，签头串着一小块烤制街头美食，手臂在胸前伸出，做出随意的分享姿势。右侧女性为 {argument name="right woman ethnicity" default="非洲裔"}，20 岁出头，留着高耸的天然卷发，身穿黑色飞行员夹克，内搭白色基础款 T 恤，背着黑色单肩包；她的面部同样被一个扁平的不透明深棕色长方形遮挡。她微微前倾靠近竹签，一只手抬起，手指自然张开，仿佛正准备接过食物，肢体语言流露出惊喜、愉悦和食欲。使用来自左侧的温暖琥珀色摊位灯光，衣服和皮肤上可见高光，夜色阴影深邃，橙色的摊位暖光与冷色调的背景灯光形成强烈的电影感对比。背景包括左侧一个繁忙的街头美食摊位，陈列着食物托盘、金属框架、明亮的裸露灯泡以及模糊的购物者；右侧及远景包含黑暗的市场剪影、霓虹灯招牌、光斑效果和浅景深。采用四分之三侧面角度构图，腰部至大腿以上的取景，自然的手持街拍视角，真实的镜头透视，抓拍瞬间，发丝和手部带有轻微动态，高细节，照片级质感，纪录片风格，无摆拍，无文字。

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference photo as the source plant, transform it into a clean plant-identification infographic poster. Isolate the fuzzy green spherical Dianthus stems from the busy street/florist background, retouch them into a crisp studio botanical cutout, and place them on a soft pale green botanical layout with rounded information cards, leaf-line decorations, small green icons, and a trustworthy plant-app aesthetic. Use Simplified Chinese typography. Main headline: {argument name="headline text" default="绿毛球石竹"}; Latin name subtitle: {argument name="latin name" default="Dianthus barbatus ‘Green Trick’"}; show a confidence badge at the upper right reading high-confidence identification. Add exactly 9 content panels: 1 top-left identification recommendation summary, 2 classification judgment, 3 key identification evidence, 4 similar plant distinction, 5 basic file, 6 growth habits and care, 7 risk warning, 8 how to confirm, and 9 bottom fun-fact strip. Keep the infographic text dense but neatly aligned, with numbered green circle markers for panels 2 through 8, icons matching each topic, and the plant image as the central visual focus. Plant identity to present: {argument name="identified plant" default="Dianthus barbatus ‘Green Trick’, also called Green Trick"}; family/genus line: {argument name="taxonomy line" default="Caryophyllaceae | Dianthus | sweet william / Dianthus barbatus horticultural cultivar"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考照片为源植物，将其转换为一张简洁的植物识别信息图海报。将杂乱的街道/花店背景中的毛茸茸绿色球状石竹茎提取出来，修饰成清晰的摄影棚级植物剪影，并将其置于柔和的淡绿色植物布局中，搭配圆角信息卡片、叶脉装饰、小型绿色图标，呈现出值得信赖的植物 App 美学风格。使用简体中文排版。主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="绿毛球石竹"}；拉丁学名副标题：{argument name="latin name" default="Dianthus barbatus ‘Green Trick’"}；在右上角显示一个标有“高置信度识别”的徽章。添加 9 个内容板块：1 左上角识别推荐摘要，2 分类判断，3 关键识别证据，4 相似植物辨析，5 基础档案，6 生长习性与养护，7 风险提示，8 如何确认，以及 9 底部趣味知识条。保持信息图文字紧凑且对齐整齐，板块 2 至 8 使用带编号的绿色圆点标记，每个主题配以相应图标，并以植物图像作为视觉中心。呈现的植物身份：{argument name="identified plant" default="Dianthus barbatus ‘Green Trick’，又称绿毛球石竹"}；科/属信息行：{argument name="taxonomy line" default="石竹科 | 石竹属 | 须苞石竹 / 须苞石竹园艺品种"}。

templates.title: Gritty Naruto Poster Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 硬核风格《火影忍者》海报插画

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic full-body anime character illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Naruto Uzumaki"} standing on a dark curved rooftop or giant pipe, facing forward with a calm, intense expression and blue eyes. He has spiky {argument name="hair color" default="blond"} hair, a black forehead protector with a metal plate and spiral leaf symbol, and three whisker-like marks on each cheek. Pose him with one hand raised in a vertical ninja hand sign in front of his mouth while the other arm crosses his body. Dress him in an orange shinobi jumpsuit partly covered by a long black, ragged, wind-torn cloak with a high collar, loose black scarf ribbons streaming leftward, black boots, and bandage wraps around one thigh; include a circular red-orange spiral patch on the upper sleeve. Use a dark desaturated blue-gray background with no scenery except atmospheric texture. Surround the character with exactly 1 orange chakra-like spiral streak wrapping around his body and exactly 8 small orange leaf or ember fragments scattered in the air. Render in a gritty high-contrast ink-and-gouache anime style: rough black brush strokes, scratched dry-brush edges, painterly orange highlights, deep shadows, limited palette of charcoal black, muted navy, tan skin, and burnt orange. Composition is vertical poster format, character centered slightly right, viewed from a low angle so the legs and cloak feel imposing. Add faint handwritten text in the upper left reading {argument name="upper left text" default="漩涡鸣人\nNaruto Uzumaki"} and a subtle signature-like mark near the lower right reading {argument name="signature text" default="- PLAYFORGE -"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的全身动漫角色插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="漩涡鸣人"}，他站在黑暗的弧形屋顶或巨型管道上，正面朝向前方，神情冷静而专注，双眼呈蓝色。他留着标志性的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 刺猬头，佩戴带有金属片和螺旋叶片符号的黑色护额，双颊各有三道胡须状印记。姿势设定为一只手在嘴前结出垂直的忍者手印，另一只手臂横过身体。身穿橙色忍者服，外罩一件长款黑色、破损且随风飘动的斗篷，斗篷带有高领，松散的黑色围巾丝带向左飘动，脚穿黑色靴子，大腿缠绕绷带；上袖处饰有圆形的红橙色螺旋补丁。背景采用深色低饱和度的蓝灰色，除大气纹理外无其他景物。角色周围环绕着 1 条橙色查克拉状螺旋光束，空中散布着 8 片橙色叶子或余烬碎片。采用硬核高对比度的水墨与水粉动漫风格渲染：粗犷的黑色笔触、干擦画法的边缘、油画质感的橙色高光、深邃的阴影，色调限制在炭黑色、柔和的藏青色、棕褐色皮肤和焦橙色。构图为竖版海报格式，角色略微居右，采用低角度仰视视角，使腿部和斗篷显得气势磅礴。在左上角添加淡淡的手写文字 {argument name="upper left text" default="漩涡鸣人\nNaruto Uzumaki"}，并在右下角附近添加一个类似签名的细微标记 {argument name="signature text" default="- PLAYFORGE -"}。
