templates.title: Dark Kushina Chakra Chain Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑风玖辛奈查克拉锁链海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical dark anime character poster of {argument name="character name" default="Kushina Uzumaki"}, a powerful red-haired kunoichi woman in a dramatic three-quarter pose, shown from thighs up against a deep blue-black smoky background. She has extremely long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="crimson red"} hair whipping across the entire composition in thick ribbon-like strands, partially covering her face, with a large muted square blur censoring the central face area. Her expression is mostly hidden, but the pose feels intense and commanding: torso turned sideways, one bare arm extended toward the viewer with long fingers splayed in forced perspective. She wears a dark sleeveless shinobi-inspired dress with a high pale collar, fitted black bodice, layered black and dark red skirt panels, side slits, and visible black fishnet mesh at the chest and thigh. Surround her with one continuous glowing red chakra chain looping diagonally around her body, with bright segmented links and smoky red energy trails; add three floating paper talismans with handwritten sealing symbols, including one tag near the upper right, one at lower left, and one near the lower right. In the upper left corner, add faint handwritten text reading “漩涡玖辛奈 / Kushina Uzumaki”. Use a moody desaturated color palette, rough ink linework, painterly anime shading, dynamic hair motion, subtle grain, cinematic lighting, and a dark occult ninja atmosphere, with a small artist-signature-like mark in the lower right.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版暗黑动漫角色海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="漩涡玖辛奈"}，一位强大的红发女忍者。她以充满张力的四分之三侧身姿态呈现，画面从大腿处向上截取，背景为深蓝黑色的烟雾。她拥有极长的、飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="绯红色"} 秀发，如丝带般粗壮的发丝横贯整个画面，部分遮挡住脸部，面部中心区域有模糊的方形遮挡。她的表情大半被遮掩，但姿态显得强烈而威严：躯干侧转，一只裸露的手臂向观众伸出，长指张开，呈现出强烈的透视感。她身穿深色无袖忍者风格长裙，配有浅色高领、修身黑色紧身胸衣、层叠的黑红裙摆、侧开叉，胸部和腿部可见黑色渔网纹理。在她周围环绕着一条连续发光的红色查克拉锁链，锁链呈对角线缠绕身体，带有明亮的分段连接处和烟雾状的红色能量轨迹；添加三张漂浮的纸质符咒，上面写有手写封印符号，分别位于右上角、左下角和右下角附近。在左上角，添加模糊的手写文字“漩涡玖辛奈 / Kushina Uzumaki”。使用低饱和度的情绪化色调、粗犷的墨线风格、绘画感动漫阴影、动态的发丝运动、细腻的颗粒感、电影级光影以及暗黑神秘的忍者氛围，右下角带有小型的艺术家签名式标记。

templates.title: Hanfu Reclining Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 汉服侧卧肖像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic, vertical full-body portrait of an adult East Asian woman in elegant traditional Hanfu reclining on a carved dark-wood daybed inside a quiet classical Chinese room. She wears a layered {argument name="hanfu color palette" default="cream, pale peach, soft pink, and faint turquoise"} outfit with translucent flowing sleeves, embroidered floral details, a low but tasteful wrapped bodice, and a long gauzy pink shawl spilling over the edge of the couch onto the floor. Her face is deliberately obscured with a smooth rectangular blur while her black hair is styled in an ornate updo with small pale flower hairpins and dangling ornaments. Pose her diagonally across the couch, one elbow resting on a cream brocade cushion, relaxed hands in her lap, long skirt draped over her legs, and bare feet visible at the far right end of the daybed. The setting includes exactly two tall wooden lattice windows with sheer white curtains glowing in warm daylight on the left and rear, one carved wooden daybed with cream patterned upholstery, two visible cushions consisting of one square pillow and one long cylindrical bolster, and one rear console table holding a silver vase with green branches beneath a framed floral painting. Use {argument name="lighting style" default="soft warm window light"}, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric texture, carved furniture detail, muted antique browns, creamy whites, and a refined intimate boudoir atmosphere, photographed as if on a high-end editorial camera in a 9:16 composition.

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a luxurious 3D pop-up picture book scene where {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} appears to spring out from an open fairy-tale book, like a personalized storybook diorama.

Canvas: Square image, warm cinematic lighting, high-detail fantasy illustration mixed with realistic handcrafted paper art. The camera looks down at a three-quarter angle onto an open book lying on a dark antique wooden table. The overall palette is rose red, antique cream, gold, walnut brown, and midnight blue.

Main subject: In the center, a beautiful anime-style princess character rises from the pop-up book as a layered paper cutout. She wears a dramatic sparkling {argument name="dress color and style" default="deep ruby-red ruffled ball gown with gold glitter accents"}, a jeweled necklace, long soft brown hair, and elegant gloves. Her pose is graceful, seated among the paper layers with one hand near her face. Keep the face softly blurred or simplified as a privacy-safe placeholder, while preserving the elegant silhouette and hair details.

Pop-up book construction: The open book contains exactly 6 major pop-up structures: 1 large central princess cutout, 1 arched night-sky backdrop with a crescent moon and dangling stars, 1 ornate cream sofa on the right, 1 small castle cutout on the left, 1 decorative staircase/path rising from the book center, and 1 golden pumpkin carriage illustration on the lower right page. Surround these with layered paper clouds, scalloped edges, roses, gold filigree, and tiny star confetti.

Text content: Add Japanese storybook typography on cream parchment panels. Large headline on the upper left banner: 「ようこそ、のぞむの世界へ」. Smaller subtitle below it: 「夢と魔法のはじまり」. Include exactly 4 visible story text panels: 1 small left pop-up plaque titled 「のぞむ」, 1 right standing plaque titled 「第1章 のぞむと赤いドレスの夜」, 1 lower-left page block beginning with a large decorative 「む」, and 1 lower-right page block with a ribbon label 「のぞむのものがたり」. The Japanese text should look like printed children’s-book prose; it does not need to be fully readable except for the specified titles.

Background: Behind the book, show an antique storybook room with warm candle lanterns, vintage books, roses, lace, a gilded mirror or frame, and a standing book in the upper right reading {argument name="French book title" default="Conte de Rêves"}. Use shallow depth of field so the background glows softly.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed romantic anime fantasy, ornate Victorian fairy-tale design, paper-theater craftsmanship, embossed gold edges, watercolor-and-gouache textures, soft bloom, candlelit ambience, delicate rose decorations, magical dust sparkles, premium art-book quality.

Constraints: Keep the composition centered on the open book and pop-up princess. Use exactly 6 major pop-up structures and exactly 4 visible story text panels. Do not add modern objects, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, or extra characters.

Keep the composition airy, elegant, feminine, modern Japanese editorial style, with crisp typography, realistic flower texture, subtle shadows, and a premium greeting-card aesthetic.

With all my love."}，右上角为 {argument name="top right message" default="MOTHER’S DAY THANK YOU ALWAYS."}，左下角为 {argument name="bottom left message" default="You are my love, my strength, my everything."}，右下角为 {argument name="bottom right message" default="Wishing you a beautiful day filled with love and happiness."}。保持构图空灵、优雅、柔美，呈现现代日式编辑风格，具备清晰的排版、逼真的花卉质感、微妙的阴影以及高端贺卡的审美。

templates.title: Twin Kimono Sakura Watercolor

titleLocalized.zh: 双子和服樱花水彩

templates.prompt: Create a delicate anime-style Japanese ink wash and watercolor illustration on warm off-white textured paper. The scene features exactly 2 young twin-like girls standing close together in the foreground, gently holding hands and leaning their heads together with soft, tired but content smiles. The left girl has {argument name="left hair color" default="short powder-blue hair"}, blue eyes, and a blue floral kimono with a large blue obi bow, white sakura patterns, tassel ornaments, and small cherry blossoms pinned in her hair. The right girl has {argument name="right hair color" default="short pastel-pink hair"}, pink eyes, and a pale pink floral kimono with a large rose-pink obi bow, gold accents, tassel ornaments, and cherry blossom hair accessories. Use refined linework, translucent watercolor washes, splattered ink textures, and soft luminous shading. Behind them, paint a misty monochrome sumi-e landscape with exactly 3 main background elements: a pale red sun or moon near the upper left-center, a faint mountain range in gray ink, and a distant Japanese temple gate or shrine structure on the upper right. Add cherry blossom branches across the top and right side, with many soft pink blossoms and dark expressive ink strokes. On the left side, include one vertical column of bold black Japanese brush calligraphy reading {argument name="calligraphy text" default="本日もお疲れさまでした"}, plus a small red seal stamp near the lower left. Composition should be vertical portrait format, romantic and serene, blending traditional Japanese sumi-e, watercolor, and polished modern anime character art, with an elegant spring-night farewell atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格日本水墨水彩插画，背景为温暖的米白色纹理纸。画面前景中精确描绘了 2 名长相相似的年轻双胞胎女孩，她们紧紧站在一起，轻轻牵着手，头靠着头，脸上带着温柔、疲惫但满足的微笑。左侧女孩拥有 {argument name="left hair color" default="短粉蓝色头发"}、蓝色眼睛，身着带有大蓝色腰带结、白色樱花图案、流苏装饰的蓝色花卉和服，发间别着小樱花。右侧女孩拥有 {argument name="right hair color" default="短柔粉色头发"}、粉色眼睛，身着带有大玫瑰粉色腰带结、金色点缀、流苏装饰的淡粉色花卉和服，并配有樱花发饰。采用细腻的线条、半透明的水彩渲染、泼墨质感以及柔和明亮的阴影。在她们身后，绘制一幅朦胧的单色水墨山水画，包含 3 个主要的背景元素：左上方偏中心处的一轮淡红色太阳或月亮、灰墨色的隐约山脉，以及右上方远处的日本寺庙大门或神社建筑。在顶部和右侧添加樱花枝，点缀许多柔和的粉色花瓣和深色写意的墨迹。在左侧，加入一列竖排的粗体黑色日本毛笔书法，内容为 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="本日もお疲れさまでした"}，并在左下角附近盖上一枚红色印章。构图应为竖向肖像格式，浪漫而宁静，融合了传统的日本水墨画、水彩画和精致的现代动漫人物艺术，营造出优雅的春夜告别氛围。

variables.defaultValue: 本日もお疲れさまでした

templates.title: Comedic Manga Roadside Horse Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 搞笑漫画路边马匹场景

templates.prompt: Create a black-and-white manga page panel in detailed seinen line art with halftone shading and a thick black rectangular border. The scene is a rural fantasy roadside under a bright cloudy sky, with distant hills, trees, fence posts, rocks, grass tufts, and a wooden sign pointing right that reads {argument name="road sign text" default="希望に向かう道（たぶん）→"}. In the center foreground lies one large dead horse collapsed on its side, eyes closed, legs bent, with a tiny ghost-like soul puff rising from its back showing a dizzy dead expression. On the left stands one elegant blonde noblewoman in a frilled gothic-lolita dress, dark jacket, corseted waist, ribbons, and curled hair tied with a bow; her face is obscured by a soft gray rectangular blur, she folds her arms confidently, and a sparkle mark near her suggests smug certainty. Above her is one oval vertical Japanese speech bubble containing {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="これは生殺しです"}. On the right stands one long black-haired young woman in a simple blouse and pinafore dress, also with her face obscured by a soft gray rectangular blur; she raises one finger to her chin in confusion, with a small question mark above her head. Above her is one oval vertical Japanese speech bubble containing {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="これは何ですか？"}. Include exactly 2 human characters, exactly 2 large speech bubbles, exactly 1 question mark symbol, exactly 1 sparkle symbol, exactly 1 wooden sign, exactly 1 dead horse, and exactly 1 ghost puff. Use crisp ink outlines, expressive manga composition, realistic background texture, comedic absurd fantasy tone, and high-resolution monochrome print style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅黑白漫画单格，采用精细的青年漫画（seinen）线条艺术，带有网点阴影和粗黑矩形边框。场景设定在明亮多云天空下的乡村奇幻路边，背景有远山、树木、栅栏柱、岩石、草丛，以及一个指向右侧的木制路标，上面写着 {argument name="road sign text" default="希望に向かう道（たぶん）→"}。前景中央躺着一匹巨大的死马，侧身倒地，双眼紧闭，腿部弯曲，背部升起一团微小的幽灵状灵魂，显示出眩晕的死亡表情。左侧站着一位优雅的金发贵族女性，身穿荷叶边哥特萝莉裙、深色外套、束腰、系着丝带，卷发扎着蝴蝶结；她的面部被柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮挡，她自信地交叉双臂，身旁的一个闪光符号暗示着她那沾沾自喜的笃定。她上方有一个垂直的椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="これは生殺しです"}。右侧站着一位留着长黑发的年轻女性，身穿简单的衬衫和背心裙，面部同样被柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮挡；她困惑地抬起一根手指抵住下巴，头顶上方有一个小问号。她上方有一个垂直的椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="これは何ですか？"}。画面需包含恰好 2 名人类角色、恰好 2 个大型对话气泡、恰好 1 个问号符号、恰好 1 个闪光符号、恰好 1 个木制路标、恰好 1 匹死马以及恰好 1 团幽灵烟雾。采用清晰的墨线勾勒、富有表现力的漫画构图、写实的背景纹理、荒诞的奇幻喜剧基调以及高分辨率的单色印刷风格。

templates.title: Anime Schoolgirl on Pink Slime

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色史莱姆上的动漫女学生

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style illustration of a young schoolgirl with {argument name="hair color" default="glossy black"} wavy bob-length hair, loose curled side strands, and a small pink cherry-blossom hair clip, seated in a cute pose on a large translucent pink slime mascot. Her face is intentionally covered by a soft square privacy blur, while the rest of the character is sharply rendered. She wears a Japanese sailor school uniform with a white long-sleeve top, navy collar and cuffs, a bright aqua neckerchief, a dark navy pleated skirt, white ankle socks, and chunky gray sneakers with pink accents. In her left hand she holds a tall strawberry soft-serve ice cream cone with pink cone wrapper and heart motif. The slime is round, glossy, bubble-like, and semi-transparent, with a simple happy face, tiny blush cheeks, and bright white highlights. The character sits slightly turned to the side with one hand resting on the slime and both feet on the ground. Use a soft warm gray studio background, subtle white sparkles, two golden star-shaped glints on either side of the character, delicate rim lighting, pastel colors, clean linework, high-detail fabric folds, glossy reflections, and a charming kawaii mood. Square composition, full body visible, centered subject, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格插画，描绘一位年轻女学生，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮黑色"} 的波浪短发，两侧有松散的卷发，佩戴着一枚粉色樱花发夹，以可爱的姿势坐在一个巨大的半透明粉色史莱姆吉祥物上。她的脸部被柔和的方形隐私模糊效果遮盖，而角色的其余部分则呈现出清晰的细节。她身穿日本水手校服，包括白色长袖上衣、海军蓝领口和袖口、亮水蓝色领巾、深海军蓝百褶裙、白色短袜以及带有粉色点缀的厚底灰色运动鞋。她的左手拿着一个高高的草莓软冰淇淋，配有粉色蛋筒包装纸和爱心图案。史莱姆呈圆形，具有光泽感和气泡感，半透明，带有简单的笑脸、微小的腮红和明亮的白色高光。角色身体略微侧转，一只手放在史莱姆上，双脚着地。采用柔和的暖灰色摄影棚背景，点缀细微的白色闪光，角色两侧各有一颗金色星形闪光，配以精致的轮廓光、粉彩配色、干净的线条、高细节的褶皱、光泽反射，营造出迷人的卡哇伊氛围。方形构图，全身可见，主体居中，无文字。

templates.title: Cyber Cat Maid Peace Pose

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博猫娘女仆比耶姿势

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant single-panel anime sticker-style illustration of a cheerful cat-eared maid idol in an energetic pop-art composition. The character is a young anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="bright hot pink"} short bob hair, fluffy cat ears, a white frilled maid headband, blue star hair clips, huge sparkling blue eyes with yellow star-shaped pupils, tiny fangs, and a joyful open-mouth smile. She wears a navy-and-white futuristic maid dress with puff sleeves, white apron, ruffled trim, a large {argument name="bow color" default="electric blue"} bow at the collar, neon cyan and magenta geometric accents, wrist cuffs, and a small cat-robot pouch clipped at the waist. Pose her in a dynamic close-up fisheye perspective, leaning toward the viewer, making a large two-finger peace sign with one hand in the foreground and another peace sign near her face, emphasizing exaggerated foreshortening and playful idol energy. Include exactly 2 cute floating robot cat mascots: one in a white speech-bubble-like outline on the upper left with a black digital smiling face and headphones, and one smaller matching robot-cat pouch at her waist. Surround her with a thick white sticker outline and bold black shadow lines. The background should be a high-saturation comic pop-art explosion with {argument name="main background colors" default="electric blue, hot pink, yellow, and white"}, halftone dots, jagged lightning bolts, angular speed lines, and graphic decals. Include exactly 3 prominent star decals: one pink outlined star near the top, one yellow star on the left-center, and one small white sparkle near the top; include exactly 1 pink heart decal on the lower left. Use crisp clean line art, glossy highlights, cel shading, ultra-bright contrast, kawaii cyber-maid aesthetics, vertical portrait composition, no text, no watermark.

templates.title: Bleak Manga Panel with Dead Horse

titleLocalized.zh: 凄凉的漫画分镜：死马

templates.prompt: Create a stark black-and-white manga panel in fine pen-and-ink line art with screentone shading, framed by a thin rectangular border on a mostly empty white background. In the center foreground lies a dead, emaciated horse or donkey collapsed on its side, ribs and bones visible, legs bent awkwardly, head down in a dark pool of blood or shadow with scattered dirt and small stones around it; render the animal with gritty crosshatching and realistic anatomical detail. On the left stands a young woman in profile facing right, wearing a dark long-sleeved blouse, long dark skirt, and black ankle boots, with straight long black hair and hands in her pockets; place an opaque soft gray rectangular blur over her face. On the right stands a second young woman in profile facing left, wearing a light blouse with billowy sleeves, a high-waisted long dark skirt, socks, and flat shoes, with short wavy light hair; place an opaque soft gray rectangular blur over her face. Add exactly 2 vertical Japanese speech bubbles: the left bubble beside the dark-haired woman says {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="これは生殺しです"}, and the right bubble beside the short-haired woman says {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="これは何ですか？"}. Keep the composition quiet, clinical, and unsettling, like a seinen manga scene, with high contrast, minimal background detail, crisp ink outlines, and subtle halftone textures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅黑白分明的漫画分镜，采用精细的钢笔线条艺术和网点纸阴影效果，画面由细长的矩形边框勾勒，背景大面积留白。画面中心前景处躺着一匹瘦骨嶙峋、侧卧的死马或驴，肋骨和骨骼清晰可见，四肢弯曲姿态怪异，头部沉入一滩深色的血迹或阴影中，周围散落着泥土和小石块；使用粗犷的交叉排线和写实的解剖细节来渲染动物。左侧站着一名侧身向右的年轻女性，身穿深色长袖衬衫、长裙和黑色短靴，留着直长黑发，双手插在口袋里；在其面部覆盖一层不透明的柔灰色矩形模糊遮罩。右侧站着另一名侧身向左的年轻女性，身穿浅色灯笼袖衬衫、高腰长裙、短袜和平底鞋，留着短卷发；在其面部覆盖一层不透明的柔灰色矩形模糊遮罩。添加 2 个垂直的日语对话气泡：左侧深发女性旁的气泡内容为 {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="这是生不如死"}，右侧短发女性旁的气泡内容为 {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="这是什么？"}。保持构图安静、冷静且令人不安，呈现出青年漫画的风格，具备高对比度、极简的背景细节、清晰的墨线勾勒以及细腻的网点纹理。

titleLocalized.zh: 猫耳少女 Hardbass 巷舞者

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic urban night scene in a narrow wet brick alley after rain, with exactly two young anime-inspired cat-eared female street dancers as the main subjects, both faces obscured by soft square blur blocks. The left dancer wears a {argument name="left outfit color" default="white"} zip-up tracksuit with black triple side stripes, white sneakers, a small black paw-print emblem on the chest, black cat ears, and very long black hair with red streaks, red bead tassels, and floral hair ornaments; she is squatting low in a dynamic breakdance pose with one leg kicked toward the camera, one arm raised in a hand sign, and the other arm bent across her face. The right dancer wears a {argument name="right outfit color" default="black"} zip-up tracksuit with white triple side stripes, black chunky shoes, a white paw-print emblem on the chest, white cat ears, and extremely long flowing silver-white hair with black floral hair ornaments; she mirrors the same low squat dance pose with one leg extended forward, one arm raised in a hand sign, and the other arm bent across her face. Include exactly five blurred background onlookers in dark streetwear: one standing in the center distance, one crouching behind the dancers, one small figure between them, and two figures on the far right. Place a dark old sedan on the left with bright headlights and a visible Russian-style license plate, beside graffiti reading {argument name="graffiti text" default="HARD BASS"} and {argument name="secondary graffiti" default="CYKA"} with a simple cat doodle. The alley should have black brick walls, metal fire escapes, overhead industrial lamps, misty backlight, puddles, glossy reflections, dramatic rim lighting, shallow depth of field, motion blur in the kicking shoes and flying hair, high-contrast cyberpunk street photography, ultra-detailed fabric folds, wet asphalt texture, and a low wide-angle camera viewpoint at ground level. Use a gritty but polished 2026 AI-image aesthetic, realistic lighting, 4:3 composition, no extra main characters, no readable text besides the graffiti and license plate.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级的写实城市夜景，场景位于雨后狭窄潮湿的砖砌巷弄中，主角为两名动漫风格的猫耳街舞少女，面部均由柔和的方形模糊块遮挡。左侧舞者身穿 {argument name="left outfit color" default="白色"} 拉链运动服，配有黑色三条纹、白色运动鞋，胸前有小型黑色爪印徽章，佩戴黑色猫耳，留着极长的黑发，发间带有红色挑染、红色珠串流苏及花朵发饰；她以动态的霹雳舞姿势低蹲，一条腿向镜头踢出，一只手举起做手势，另一只手弯曲遮住面部。右侧舞者身穿 {argument name="right outfit color" default="黑色"} 拉链运动服，配有白色三条纹、黑色厚底鞋，胸前有白色爪印徽章，佩戴白色猫耳，留着极长的银白色飘逸长发，带有黑色花朵发饰；她以同样的低蹲舞姿镜像呈现，一条腿向前伸展，一只手举起做手势，另一只手弯曲遮住面部。背景中包含 5 名穿着深色街头服饰的模糊路人：一人站在中心远处，一人蹲在舞者身后，一人位于两人之间，两人位于最右侧。左侧放置一辆深色旧轿车，车头灯明亮，挂有清晰的俄式车牌，旁边涂鸦写着 {argument name="graffiti text" default="HARD BASS"} 和 {argument name="secondary graffiti" default="CYKA"}，并附有一个简单的猫咪涂鸦。巷弄应具备黑色砖墙、金属消防梯、头顶工业灯、朦胧的背光、水洼、光亮的倒影、戏剧性的轮廓光、浅景深，踢出的鞋子和飞扬的头发带有动态模糊，呈现高对比度的赛博朋克街头摄影风格，布料褶皱极其细腻，具有湿润的沥青质感，采用地面低角度广角拍摄。使用 2026 年 AI 图像的粗砺而精致的美学风格，写实光影，4:3 构图，除涂鸦和车牌外，画面中不包含其他可辨识的文字，且没有额外的主角。

titleLocalized.zh: Sakura School Dating Sim 缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a bright anime-style YouTube thumbnail illustration in 16:9 landscape format, set at the entrance of a Japanese school during spring cherry blossom season. Show exactly 4 high-school girls standing side by side on the right half of the image, each wearing the same uniform: dark green sailor-style blazer with white trim, large burgundy bow, mustard-yellow pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers, and each holding a brown leather school satchel in front of her. Give the 4 girls distinct hairstyles and hair colors: long flowing pink hair, short wavy light brown hair, long blonde hair, and long straight black hair. Keep their faces softly blurred or featureless so the thumbnail emphasizes the concept rather than individual identities. The background should feature a school gate, school building hints, blue sky, sunlight, abundant pink cherry blossom trees, and many falling sakura petals, with a polished colorful anime-game look, high saturation, crisp lighting, and cheerful romantic spring atmosphere. On the left half, add large bold Japanese thumbnail text reading {argument name="headline text" default="もっと！モット！ときめき'99"}, using thick rounded lettering, white fill with vivid pink outline and warm orange shadow, arranged dynamically with oversized emphasis on “モット!” and “'99”. Add small decorative hearts, sparkles, and an underline swoosh around the text. Compose it like a clickable nostalgic dating-sim themed thumbnail: characters on the right, text dominating the left, energetic diagonal layout, glossy highlights, clean readable typography, cinematic depth, floating petals in the foreground, no extra characters, no logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 横屏比例的明亮动漫风格 YouTube 缩略图，背景设定在春季樱花盛开的日本学校门口。在画面右侧并排站立 4 名高中女生，她们穿着统一的制服：深绿色水手风西装外套配白色滚边、深酒红色大蝴蝶结、芥末黄色百褶裙、白色短袜、棕色乐福鞋，每人手中都在身前拿着一个棕色皮质书包。4 名少女需拥有不同的发型和发色：长长的飘逸粉发、短波浪浅棕发、长金发以及长直黑发。保持她们的面部轻微模糊或无五官，以便缩略图强调概念而非个人身份。背景应包含校门、学校建筑轮廓、蓝天、阳光、繁茂的粉色樱花树以及纷飞的樱花瓣，呈现出精致的彩色动漫游戏质感、高饱和度、清晰的灯光效果以及欢快浪漫的春日氛围。在画面左侧，添加醒目的日文大号缩略图文字 {argument name="headline text" default="もっと！モット！ときめき'99"}，使用粗圆体字，白色填充，配以鲜艳的粉色描边和暖橙色阴影，动态排列并着重突出“モット!”和“'99”。在文字周围添加小巧的装饰性爱心、闪光和下划线扫尾效果。整体构图参考具有点击欲望的怀旧恋爱模拟游戏风格：角色位于右侧，文字占据左侧主导地位，采用充满活力的对角线布局，具有光泽感的高光、清晰易读的排版、电影般的景深，前景点缀漂浮的花瓣，画面中不包含额外角色、Logo 或水印。

templates.title: Steampunk Robot Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克机器人电影海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical animated movie poster in a warm Disney/Pixar-inspired 3D adventure style, set in a vast whimsical steampunk robot city at sunset with glowing clouds, distant towers, bridges, pipes, floating airships, tiny flying drones, flowers, and lush greenery in the foreground. In the lower left foreground, show a young boy named {argument name="character name" default="Bokuto"} crouching on a grassy rooftop ledge, wearing a blue hoodie, tan shorts, gray sneakers, and tousled brown hair; his face is deliberately obscured by a smooth rectangular blur/blank mask, while he gently holds hands with a small rusty spherical-headed robot sitting opposite him. The main robot has a weathered metal body, round head, one glowing blue camera eye, antenna wire, jointed arms and legs, scratches, dents, rivets, and a tender emotional pose. Add two small side companions near the lower right: a fluffy small dog and a tiny boxy black-screen robot with green eyes. The background should feel enormous and magical, with towering industrial buildings full of tiny lights, balconies, antennas, and signs, bathed in golden sunrise/sunset rim light and soft atmospheric haze. Place Japanese poster copy at the top center reading {argument name="top tagline" default="キミがいれば、きっと、どこへでも行ける。"}, and a glowing sign on the left building reading {argument name="side sign text" default="壊れていても、心は動く。"}. At the bottom center, add a realistic movie-logo layout: small studio text “Disney PIXAR”, then the title line “ぼくと” above a huge hand-painted Japanese main title {argument name="main title" default="おんぼろロボット"}, with the first character in warm yellow and the rest in off-white textured lettering. Beneath it add the tagline {argument name="bottom tagline" default="きみがくれた、たからもの。"}, a block of tiny faux credits, and the release line “2025年 春 感動の冒険へ”. Use dramatic composition, high detail, depth of field, volumetric light, painterly realism, emotional family-film tone, and authentic Japanese theatrical poster typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级竖版动画电影海报，采用温馨的迪士尼/皮克斯风格 3D 冒险视觉效果。背景设定在日落时分广阔而奇幻的蒸汽朋克机器人城市中，云层闪烁着光芒，远处矗立着高塔、桥梁、管道，空中飞艇与小型无人机穿梭其中，前景点缀着花朵与茂密的绿植。在左下角前景处，展示一名名为 {argument name="character name" default="Bokuto"} 的小男孩，他蹲在长满草的屋顶边缘，身穿蓝色连帽衫、卡其色短裤和灰色运动鞋，留着凌乱的棕色头发；他的脸部特意用平滑的矩形模糊/空白遮盖，正温柔地牵着对面一个生锈的球头小机器人。主角机器人拥有金属质感的身体、圆头、一只发光的蓝色摄像头眼睛、天线、关节手臂与腿部，身上布满划痕、凹痕和铆钉，姿态充满温情。在右下角附近添加两个小型伙伴：一只毛茸茸的小狗和一个带有绿色眼睛的方块状黑屏小机器人。背景应营造出宏大而神奇的氛围，高耸的工业建筑上布满了微小的灯光、阳台、天线和招牌，沐浴在金色的日出/日落轮廓光和柔和的大气薄雾中。在顶部中央放置日文海报文案 {argument name="top tagline" default="キミがいれば、きっと、どこへでも行ける。"}，并在左侧建筑上放置一个发光的招牌，文字为 {argument name="side sign text" default="壊れていても、心は動く。"}。在底部中央，添加逼真的电影 Logo 排版：上方是小号工作室文字“Disney PIXAR”，接着是标题行“ぼくと”，上方是巨大的手绘日文主标题 {argument name="main title" default="おんぼろロボット"}，其中第一个字符为暖黄色，其余为米白色纹理字体。下方添加标语 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="きみがくれた、たからもの。"}、一小块伪造的演职员表，以及上映信息“2025年 春 感動の冒険へ”。采用戏剧性的构图、高细节、景深、体积光、绘画般的写实感、感人的家庭电影基调以及地道的日式电影海报排版。

templates.title: Rainy Cat-Ear Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中猫耳街头肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic photorealistic fashion portrait in a rainy city alley, with a {argument name="character name" default="young adult woman"} crouching low on wet asphalt under one large transparent plastic umbrella covered in raindrops. She has long damp {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with straight bangs, wears oversized black headphones topped with sleek black cat-ear attachments, and her face is intentionally soft and obscured by shadow/blur for an anonymous editorial look. Her outfit is a {argument name="outfit color" default="dusty blue"} cropped hoodie with distressed cold-shoulder cutouts and matching short shorts, black ankle socks, and chunky lavender, white, and black futuristic sneakers; one sneaker is exaggerated in the foreground with strong wide-angle perspective. She hugs the umbrella handle while crouching with knees forward, and one small gray tabby kitten sits tucked inside the partially zipped hoodie at her chest, looking directly at the viewer. The scene contains exactly one umbrella, one kitten, one pair of cat-ear headphones, one pair of chunky sneakers, and five visible floating transparent bubbles around the subject. Add scattered pale pink cherry blossom petals on the wet ground, puddle reflections, falling rain streaks, misty gray urban buildings blurred in the background, cool blue-gray color grading, shallow depth of field, glossy wet textures, emotional melancholic atmosphere, soft diffused overcast lighting, ultra-detailed raindrops on the umbrella, realistic fabric texture, and a dreamy high-fashion street photography composition shot from a low angle with a vertical 9:16 frame.

The composition is a tight vertical bust shot from slightly above, with turquoise ocean, blue sky, palm trees, and a wooden seaside railing blurred in the background. She wears a navy blazer with gold trim over an open white shirt and a large navy ribbon bow, with a gold chain necklace holding a blue star pendant and matching dangling star earrings. Her skin is sunlit and glossy with water droplets on her neck and chest, suggesting she just came from the beach or pool. In the lower right foreground, show a paper cup holding pink speckled ice cream scoops, and in the lower left foreground show a hand holding a rectangular card or note toward the viewer. The card is positioned directly in front of her face, completely covering the facial features with a plain peach-beige rectangle, while her hair, ears, jewelry, shoulders, and outfit remain visible around it. Use vibrant saturated colors, high-detail anime rendering, soft depth of field, sparkling highlights, warm sunlight, and a playful summer vacation mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格夏季特写肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Riona"}，一位迷人的年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="湿润的短款白金发"}，背景设在明亮的热带海滩咖啡馆。构图为从上方略微俯拍的紧凑垂直半身像，背景是模糊的绿松石色海洋、蓝天、棕榈树和木质海滨护栏。她身穿带有金色镶边的海军蓝西装外套，内搭敞开的白衬衫，系着一个大大的海军蓝丝带蝴蝶结，佩戴着挂有蓝色星星吊坠的金链项链以及配套的星星吊坠耳环。她的皮肤在阳光下闪烁着光泽，颈部和胸前带有水珠，暗示她刚从海滩或泳池回来。右下角前景展示一个纸杯，里面装着带有斑点的粉色冰淇淋球；左下角前景展示一只手正向观众展示一张长方形卡片或便签。卡片直接放置在她的脸部前方，用一个纯桃米色的长方形完全遮住了五官，而她的头发、耳朵、珠宝、肩膀和服装在卡片周围清晰可见。采用鲜艳饱和的色彩、高细节的动漫渲染、柔和的景深、闪烁的高光、温暖的阳光，营造出俏皮的暑假氛围。

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style illustration arranged as two horizontal stacked panels separated by a thin white divider, showing the same {argument name="character name" default="Riona"}, a blonde schoolgirl in a bright classroom on a sunny day. There are exactly 2 panels: the top panel is a high-angle view from above her right side as she sits on a wooden classroom chair beside a large sunlit window, holding a pale blue popsicle near her mouth; the bottom panel is a closer chest-up portrait from the front with the same popsicle held in one hand, classroom desks and a chalkboard softly blurred behind her, and a vivid blue sky with white clouds visible through the window. She has short, slightly messy wet-looking {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} bob hair catching warm sunlight, a fair complexion, and wears a damp-looking white gym shirt with navy collar and sleeve trim plus navy athletic shorts. Add exactly 2 star accessories: one blue-and-gold star necklace pendant and one matching dangling star earring. The scene should feel summery and nostalgic, with warm afternoon light, glossy highlights, parquet classroom floor, wooden desks, a chalkboard in the background, and soft depth of field. Place flat opaque tan censor rectangles over the face area in both panels, matching the skin-tone block style visible in the image, while keeping the hair, ear, jewelry, outfit, hand, popsicle, classroom, and window lighting visible. Use detailed semi-realistic anime rendering, soft painterly shading, high-resolution vertical composition, {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} aspect ratio, and a bright clean color palette centered on white, navy blue, gold, and sky blue.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格插画，采用两格水平堆叠的布局，中间由细白色分割线隔开，展示同一位 {argument name="character name" default="Riona"}，即阳光明媚的教室里的一位金发女学生。画面共 2 格：上格为从她右上方俯视的高角度镜头，她坐在木制教室椅子上，身旁是洒满阳光的大窗户，手中拿着一支淡蓝色冰棒靠近嘴边；下格为从正面拍摄的胸部以上特写，她单手拿着同样的冰棒，背景是模糊的教室课桌和黑板，窗外可见湛蓝的天空和朵朵白云。她留着一头略显凌乱、带有湿润感的 {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} 金色短波波头，在温暖的阳光下闪烁光泽，肤色白皙，身穿一件看起来湿漉漉的白色运动衫，领口和袖口有海军蓝镶边，下身穿着海军蓝运动短裤。添加 2 个星星配饰：一个蓝金配色的星星项链吊坠和一只配套的星星吊坠耳环。场景应充满夏日怀旧气息，配以温暖的午后光线、光泽感高光、拼花木教室地板、木制课桌、背景黑板以及柔和的景深效果。在两格画面的面部区域放置平整的不透明棕褐色遮挡矩形，与图片中可见的肤色遮挡块风格一致，同时保留头发、耳朵、首饰、服装、手部、冰棒、教室和窗户光影的可见度。采用细腻的半写实动漫渲染、柔和的绘画式阴影、高分辨率垂直构图、{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} 宽高比，以及以白色、海军蓝、金色和天蓝色为主调的明亮干净配色。

templates.prompt:
Create a polished semi-realistic anime illustration in a sunlit Japanese high school classroom. The main subject is {argument name="character name" default="Riona"}, a curvy adult female teacher with a short tousled {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} bob haircut, standing confidently in front of a green chalkboard; her face is intentionally covered by a plain peach-colored rectangular censor block with no facial features. She wears a fitted ribbed cream V-neck knit top with three-quarter sleeves, high-waisted beige slacks with a belt, a small turquoise star pendant necklace, a bracelet, and a ring; pose her with one hand on her hip and the other hand raised with the index finger pointing upward as if scolding or explaining classroom rules. In the foreground at lower left, show exactly 1 seated male student in a dark school uniform, seen from behind and in profile with messy black hair, holding exactly 1 mint-chocolate-chip ice cream cone in a pink cone wrapper while looking up at the teacher. The classroom contains wooden desks and chairs, an open notebook on the student's desk, and exactly 1 navy pencil case centered on the front desk. On the chalkboard, include the Japanese classroom-rule writing {argument name="chalkboard text" default="授業中の注意事項
私語厳禁
飲食禁止
携帯電話の使用禁止
ルールを守って
気持ちよく授業を
受けましょう！"}; on the wall by the window, include exactly 1 white paper notice titled 学級目標 with exactly 5 bullet points: 時間を守る, 挨拶をする, 整理整頓, 思いやり, 全力で取り組む. Use warm late-afternoon sunlight streaming through tall classroom windows on the left, soft dust motes, strong rim light on the blonde hair, realistic fabric folds, detailed chalk texture, cinematic composition, vertical portrait framing, high-detail anime rendering, gentle pastel colors, and a nostalgic summer classroom atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张精致的半写实动漫插画，场景设定在阳光明媚的日本高中教室。主体是 {argument name="character name" default="Riona"}，一位身材丰满的成年女性教师，留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 波波头，自信地站在绿色黑板前；她的脸部被一个纯桃色的矩形遮挡块刻意遮住，没有任何面部特征。她穿着一件修身的米色 V 领针织上衣，袖长至七分，搭配高腰米色长裤和腰带，佩戴一条小巧的绿松石星形吊坠项链、手链和戒指；姿势设定为一只手叉腰，另一只手食指向上指，仿佛在训斥或讲解课堂规则。在左下角的前景中，展示 1 名穿着深色校服的男学生，从背面和侧面视角呈现，留着凌乱的黑发，手里拿着 1 个薄荷巧克力碎冰淇淋，包装纸为粉色，正抬头看着老师。教室里有木制的课桌和椅子，学生桌上放着一本打开的笔记本，前桌中央放着 1 个海军蓝色的铅笔盒。黑板上包含日语课堂规则文字 {argument name="chalkboard text" default="授業中の注意事項
私語厳禁
飲食禁止
携帯電話の使用禁止
ルールを守って
気持ちよく授業を
受けましょう！"}；窗边的墙上贴着 1 张标题为“学級目標”的白纸通知，包含 5 个要点：時間を守る, 挨拶をする, 整理整頓, 思いやり, 全力で取り組む。利用左侧高大教室窗户射入的温暖午后阳光，营造柔和的尘埃微粒感，金发上带有强烈的轮廓光，展现逼真的布料褶皱、细腻的粉笔质感、电影级构图、竖向肖像画幅、高细节动漫渲染、柔和的粉彩色调以及怀旧的夏季教室氛围。

templates.title: Aqua-Haired Anime Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 青绿色头发动漫街头肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant vertical anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Mahilo"}, a stylish teenage girl standing in profile on a bright Japanese shopping street, viewed from mid-thigh up with a dynamic low-angle fashion-photo composition. She has extremely long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="turquoise aqua"} hair streaming dramatically to the left in the wind, with glossy highlights, loose strands, and a few ahoge flyaways; her face is intentionally hidden by a soft-edged pale beige square censor block centered over the eyes, nose, and mouth. She wears an oversized shiny white track jacket with two bold cyan stripes running down each sleeve, ribbed cuffs and hem, a slightly wrinkled glossy fabric texture, and a high collar; pair it with tight black shiny short shorts. Add a black backpack with thin straps over both shoulders, visible side pockets, zipper pulls, and one yellow chick-shaped charm keychain hanging on the back. Pose her with one hand tucked into the jacket pocket, hips angled, torso turned slightly away from the viewer, conveying casual confidence. The background is a sunlit narrow urban street in Japan with tall buildings on both sides, strong perspective lines, blue sky glow, overhead wires, storefront signs, and shallow depth of field; include exactly six visible street-sign elements: one large red sign on the left, one blue vertical sign with the number 2 on the upper right, one red circular upward-chevron sign, one blue circular upward-arrow sign, one red-and-white no-entry sign on the left, and one small green diamond sign on the right. Use saturated cyan-and-white color grading, crisp anime linework, glossy cel shading, high contrast sunlight, sparkling dust particles, motion in the hair, and a polished gpt-image-2 anime key visual style. Aspect ratio 9:16, clean composition, no extra characters, no text overlays besides blurred environmental signage.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的竖版动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Mahilo"}，一位时尚的少女。她侧身站在明亮的日本商业街上，采用中景构图，呈现出动态的低角度时尚摄影视角。她拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="青绿色"} 头发，在风中向左剧烈飘动，带有光泽感的高光、散落的发丝以及几根呆毛；她的面部被一个位于眼、鼻、口中心的柔边浅米色方形遮挡块刻意隐藏。她身穿一件超大号亮面白色运动夹克，每条袖子上都有两条醒目的青色条纹，配有罗纹袖口和下摆，面料呈现出略带褶皱的光泽感，并带有高领设计；下身搭配紧身黑色亮面短裤。背上一个黑色双肩背包，肩带纤细，侧袋清晰可见，带有拉链头，背包上挂着一个黄色小鸡形状的挂件。让她的一只手插在夹克口袋里，臀部微侧，躯干稍微背对观众，展现出随性的自信。背景是阳光明媚的日本狭窄城市街道，两侧高楼林立，透视感强烈，带有蓝天光晕、头顶电线、店面招牌以及浅景深效果；画面中需包含精确的六个可见街道标志元素：左侧一个大型红色标志，右上角一个带有数字 2 的蓝色竖向标志，一个红色圆形向上人字形标志，一个蓝色圆形向上箭头标志，左侧一个红白相间的禁止进入标志，以及右侧一个小型绿色菱形标志。采用饱和的青色与白色调，清晰的动漫线条，光泽感的赛璐珞阴影，高对比度的阳光，闪烁的尘埃粒子，头发的动态感，以及精致的 gpt-image-2 动漫主视觉风格。比例 9:16，构图简洁，无多余角色，除模糊的环境标识外无任何文字覆盖。

templates.title: Blue Arcane Spellcaster in Rainy Alley

titleLocalized.zh: 雨巷中的蓝色奥术施法者

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime-style dark fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious female spellcaster"} standing in a rain-slicked narrow old-city alley at night, surrounded by warm gas-lamp light and deep blue shadows. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing black hair"} whipping in the wind, with her face deliberately hidden by a soft square blur for anonymity. She wears a sleek layered {argument name="outfit color" default="black"} gothic mage outfit: high-collared coat, fitted bodice, belts and buckles, fingerless glove, small leather pouches, hanging charms, and a blue crystal pendant plus small glowing potion bottles at her waist. Her right hand is thrust toward the viewer in foreshortened perspective, casting a brilliant {argument name="magic color" default="electric blue"} arcane spell made of one large circular magic sigil, several concentric rings, rune-like markings, geometric lines, star points, and many swirling light trails wrapping around her body. The wet cobblestone street reflects the lamps and blue magic, with rain streaks, mist, cinematic rim lighting, sparkling particles, high contrast, ultra-detailed painterly rendering, sharp fabric and leather textures, dynamic composition, fantasy action atmosphere, and a small subtle artist-style monogram watermark in the lower right.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有戏剧张力的竖版动漫风格暗黑奇幻插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的女施法者"} 站在夜晚雨后湿滑的狭窄老城巷弄中，周围环绕着温暖的煤气灯光和深蓝色的阴影。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长黑发"} 在风中飞舞，面部特意用柔和的方形模糊处理以保持匿名。她穿着一套利落的叠层 {argument name="outfit color" default="黑色"} 哥特式法师服装：高领外套、修身胸衣、腰带与搭扣、露指手套、小型皮袋、悬挂的饰品，以及腰间佩戴的蓝色水晶吊坠和发光的小药水瓶。她的右手以透视缩短法伸向观众，施展出绚丽的 {argument name="magic color" default="电光蓝"} 奥术魔法，魔法由一个巨大的圆形魔法符文、数个同心圆环、符文状标记、几何线条、星点以及环绕她身体的许多旋转光迹组成。湿润的鹅卵石街道反射着灯光和蓝色魔法，画面中包含雨丝、薄雾、电影级轮廓光、闪烁的粒子、高对比度、超精细的绘画质感、清晰的布料与皮革纹理、动态构图、奇幻动作氛围，并在右下角带有细微的艺术家风格字母组合水印。

templates.title: Anime Schoolgirl Guitarist on Stage

titleLocalized.zh: 舞台上的动漫女高中生吉他手

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style vertical illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a teenage schoolgirl guitarist"} standing on a dark concert stage under soft overhead spotlights. She has {argument name="hair color" default="glossy black"} hair in a short bob with straight blunt bangs and a side ponytail she is tying up with both arms raised, pale skin, large muted gray eyes, and a small blue hair tie held in her mouth, giving a shy focused expression. She wears a crisp white Japanese sailor-style school uniform top with short sleeves and a bright turquoise neckerchief, paired with a high-waisted dark navy pleated skirt. A black guitar strap crosses her shoulder, holding a bright {argument name="guitar color" default="turquoise blue"} electric guitar with a white pickguard, chrome hardware, maple neck, and cable plugged in, angled diagonally across her body from lower left to upper right. Place one silver vocal microphone on a black stand to her left, and one black Marshall-style guitar amplifier with cream control panel to her right in the background. Use a mostly black stage backdrop with tiny floating dust-like white specks, dramatic rim lighting, clean cel-shaded anime rendering, delicate highlights on hair and guitar, realistic instrument details, soft shadows, and a slightly low portrait composition focused on the character from thighs up.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的竖版动漫风格插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位十几岁的女高中生吉他手"} 站在昏暗的演唱会舞台上，头顶柔和的聚光灯照耀着她。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="乌黑亮丽"} 的短波波头，有着平直的齐刘海，正用双手举起扎着侧马尾，皮肤白皙，有着一双灰色的柔和大眼睛，嘴里衔着一个蓝色发圈，表情羞涩而专注。她穿着一件干练的白色日式水手服短袖上衣，系着亮青色领巾，搭配高腰深蓝色百褶裙。黑色的吉他背带斜跨在肩上，怀抱着一把亮 {argument name="guitar color" default="青蓝色"} 的电吉他，吉他配有白色护板、镀铬金属件和枫木琴颈，连接着吉他线，从左下向右上斜挎在身前。在她的左侧放置一个黑色支架上的银色人声麦克风，右侧背景中放置一个带有奶油色控制面板的黑色 Marshall 风格吉他音箱。使用以黑色为主的舞台背景，点缀着微小的漂浮尘埃状白点，采用戏剧性的轮廓光、干净的赛璐珞动漫渲染，在头发和吉他上添加细腻的高光，展现写实的乐器细节，营造柔和的阴影，并采用略微仰视的肖像构图，聚焦于角色大腿以上的部分。

templates.title: Golden Hour Guitar Bedroom Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻卧室吉他场景

templates.prompt: Create a warm cinematic anime-style illustration of {argument name="character description" default="a young woman with dark brown hair tied in a high ponytail"} sitting sideways on an unmade bed in a small cozy bedroom, playing {argument name="instrument" default="a natural wood acoustic guitar"}. She wears {argument name="outfit" default="an oversized cream long-sleeve shirt and light denim shorts"}, with relaxed posture, one hand strumming and the other on the fretboard; her face is intentionally covered by a solid dark brown rectangular censor block. The room is lit by intense golden-hour sunlight streaming through two windows, creating dramatic lens flare, glowing dust particles, long shadows, and bright rim light on her hair and sleeves. Include dark curtains, a potted plant silhouetted on the left windowsill, a small bedside shelf with bottles, rumpled white bedding, a framed sunset picture, and a simple ocean poster on the wall with faint text reading {argument name="poster text" default="SAJEN ROOM"}. Use painterly digital art, soft brushwork, rich amber tones, realistic anatomy, intimate quiet mood, detailed fabric folds, glossy guitar highlights, and a vertical portrait composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温馨的电影感动漫风格插画，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位扎着高马尾、深棕色头发的年轻女性"} 侧坐在狭小舒适卧室里凌乱的床上，正在弹奏 {argument name="instrument" default="一把原木色木吉他"}。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件米色超大款长袖衬衫和浅色牛仔短裤"}，姿态放松，一只手扫弦，另一只手按在指板上；她的脸部被一个实心深棕色矩形遮挡块刻意遮住。房间被透过两扇窗户射入的强烈黄金时刻阳光照亮，营造出戏剧性的镜头光晕、发光的尘埃颗粒、长长的阴影，以及头发和袖口上明亮的轮廓光。画面包含深色窗帘、左侧窗台上剪影般的盆栽、带有瓶子的小床头架、褶皱的白色床品、一张带框的夕阳画，以及墙上一张简单的海洋海报，海报上印有模糊的文字 {argument name="poster text" default="SAJEN ROOM"}。采用绘画感数字艺术风格，笔触柔和，色调呈现浓郁的琥珀色，人体结构写实，氛围静谧亲密，织物褶皱细节丰富，吉他高光质感通透，采用竖构图。

templates.title: Misty Medieval Village Establishing Shot

titleLocalized.zh: 迷雾中世纪村庄定场镜头

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic wide establishing shot of a quiet {argument name="setting" default="medieval European village square"} on a cold misty morning, rendered in realistic dark fantasy style. The scene centers on a circular stone well with a wooden frame, hanging rope, bucket, and small barrels beside it, placed on an uneven cobblestone path that forks between rustic half-timbered houses. Show at least four visible timber-and-plaster buildings: a large weathered two-story house on the right with a sagging shingled roof, porch, barrels, crates, and a small table; two smaller cottages on the left and midground with fenced yards; and a stone church in the background with a bell tower and cross. Add wooden split-rail fences, muddy grass patches, scattered stones, worn steps, smoke rising from chimneys, and distant tree silhouettes fading into fog. Use a muted palette of gray, brown, moss green, and charcoal, with overcast sky, damp ground, soft diffuse light, low contrast, subtle haze, and a slightly desaturated film look. No people are visible, making the village feel abandoned or early before dawn. Compose as a wide 16:9 storyboard frame with the well in the lower center foreground, buildings framing both sides, the church tower near the central background, and atmospheric depth created by mist and smoke. Overall mood: {argument name="mood" default="somber, quiet, and ominous"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级广角定场镜头，展现一个安静的 {argument name="setting" default="中世纪欧洲村庄广场"} 在寒冷多雾的清晨景象，采用写实的黑暗奇幻风格渲染。场景中心是一个带有木框架、悬挂绳索和水桶的圆形石井，井旁放置着小木桶，位于在乡村半木结构房屋间分叉的崎岖鹅卵石路上。展示至少四座可见的木质灰泥建筑：右侧是一座大型风化的两层房屋，带有下垂的木瓦屋顶、门廊、木桶、板条箱和一个小桌子；左侧和中景有两座带围栏院落的小屋；背景中有一座带有钟楼和十字架的石砌教堂。添加木制劈裂栅栏、泥泞的草地、散落的石块、磨损的台阶、从烟囱升起的炊烟，以及在雾气中隐约可见的远处树木剪影。使用灰色、棕色、苔藓绿和炭黑色的柔和色调，配合阴天、潮湿的地面、柔和的漫射光、低对比度、微妙的雾霾以及略微去饱和的电影质感。画面中无人，营造出村庄被遗弃或黎明前的宁静感。构图采用 16:9 的宽屏故事板比例，水井位于下方中心前景，建筑分布在两侧，教堂塔楼位于背景中心，通过雾气和烟雾营造出大气深度。整体氛围：{argument name="mood" default="阴郁、宁静且不祥"}。

templates.title: Chibi Angel Three-View Turnaround

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版天使三视图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the character base, transform the angel character sheet into a cute chibi three-view turnaround. Keep the original angel design, white feather wings, long pale hair, flower hair accessory, white dress, blue ribbons, barefoot look, soft pastel anime rendering, and plain white background. Change the body proportions to super-deformed chibi style with a large head, small childlike body, simplified hands and feet, and rounder silhouette while preserving the same delicate details. Arrange exactly 3 full-body views horizontally: front view on the left, side profile in the center, and back view on the right. Maintain clean character-reference-sheet spacing, high detail, soft lighting, and 4K-quality finish.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为角色基础，将该天使角色设计图转换为可爱的 Q 版三视图。保留原有的天使设计、白色羽翼、淡色长发、花朵发饰、白色连衣裙、蓝色丝带、赤脚造型、柔和的淡彩动漫渲染风格以及纯白背景。将身体比例调整为超变形 Q 版风格，即大头、小巧的儿童身形、简化的手脚以及更圆润的轮廓，同时保留精致的细节。水平排列 3 个全身视图：左侧为正面，中间为侧面，右侧为背面。保持清晰的角色参考图间距、高细节、柔和光影以及 4K 质量的成品效果。

templates.title: Red Hoodie Dragon-Wolf Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 红色连帽衫龙狼战士

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic full-body anime poster illustration of {argument name="character type" default="an anthropomorphic dragon-wolf hybrid warrior"} on a clean white background, posed in a powerful crouching action stance with one knee raised, one hand reaching forward with sharp claws, and the other hand tucked into the hoodie pocket. The character has dark charcoal-black scales or fur, a long thick tail with red markings, spiky swept-back red hair and mane-like neck spikes, tall pointed red-and-black horns, angular black cheek fins, glowing red eyes, a snarling mouth with visible sharp teeth, and red claw tips. Dress the character in {argument name="hoodie color" default="a deep red oversized hoodie"} with white drawstrings, a front pouch pocket, heavy folds, and a centered chest graphic of the character’s own fierce dragon head logo inside a circular emblem; add a small heart-like patch on the upper sleeve and a dark rectangular patch below it. Pair it with black tactical cargo pants featuring multiple straps, buckles, knee padding, thigh pouches, utility pockets, and loose gathered fabric, plus white athletic sneakers with red accents and gray laces. Surround the figure with bold red painterly slash effects, curved energy arcs, ink splatters, small black debris flecks, and two sharp red starburst spark shapes, emphasizing speed and aggression. Use crisp cel-shaded anime line art, high-contrast lighting, dramatic foreshortening, saturated red highlights, detailed clothing wrinkles, clean white negative space, and a polished character-poster composition with no readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满动感的全身动漫海报插图，主体为 {argument name="character type" default="一位拟人化的龙狼混血战士"}，背景为干净的白色。角色呈现出强有力的蹲姿，一膝抬起，一只手伸向前方露出锋利的爪子，另一只手插在连帽衫口袋里。角色拥有深炭黑色的鳞片或皮毛，长而粗的尾巴带有红色斑纹，红色的尖刺状后掠发型和鬃毛般的颈部尖刺，高耸的红黑双角，棱角分明的黑色颊鳍，发光的红色双眼，龇牙咧嘴露出锋利的牙齿，爪尖为红色。为角色穿上 {argument name="hoodie color" default="一件深红色超大款连帽衫"}，配有白色抽绳、前袋、厚重的褶皱，胸前正中印有角色自身凶猛龙头的圆形标志；上袖处添加一个小巧的心形补丁，下方配有一个深色长方形补丁。搭配黑色战术工装裤，裤身带有多个绑带、扣环、护膝、大腿袋、多功能口袋和宽松的褶皱布料，脚穿带有红色点缀和灰色鞋带的白色运动鞋。角色周围环绕着醒目的红色笔触式斜线特效、弯曲的能量弧、墨迹飞溅、细小的黑色碎屑以及两个锋利的红色星芒火花形状，强调速度感与攻击性。采用清晰的赛璐珞动漫线条艺术、高对比度光影、戏剧性的透视缩短、饱和的红色高光、细腻的衣物褶皱、干净的白色负空间，以及精致的角色海报构图，且不包含任何可读文字。

templates.title: Red Hoodie Lava Dragon Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 红色连帽衫熔岩龙海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold anime streetwear poster on a clean white background featuring a single anthropomorphic black dragon character in a three-quarter upper-body pose, leaning forward with hands in the hoodie pockets and a confident snarling grin. The dragon has dark charcoal scales, glowing red lava-like crack patterns across the face, neck, tail, and horns, sharp angular red eyes, white fangs, tall pointed ears, two long red-and-black horns, a spiky red mane, and a long curved tail with a red spear-shaped tip entering from the left. Dress the character in a glossy oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="crimson red"} zip-up hoodie with the hood up, white drawstrings, heavy folds, a front pocket, and black technical cargo pants; show exactly 4 visible clothing markings: a circular black-and-white emblem patch on the upper sleeve, a black rectangular sleeve patch with distorted white lettering, a small triangular chest logo, and a small white chest wordmark. Add dynamic red paint-splatter strokes around the character, especially one large splash on the right and smaller droplets near the left horn area. At the top, design a magazine-cover style typographic layout with one huge bold condensed red headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="HAROS MRNG"}, one small black uppercase line above it with intentionally imperfect pseudo-text, one small black subheading block on the upper left reading {argument name="subheading text" default="STRENH BLACK"} with a second smaller garbled line below, and a black issue number {argument name="issue number" default="12"} on the upper right. Use high-contrast cel-shaded anime rendering, sharp black outlines, dramatic red highlights, glossy fabric reflections, clean poster composition, and a modern character-design magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张大胆的动漫街头风格海报，背景为干净的白色，主角为一只拟人化的黑龙，采用四分之三上半身姿势，身体前倾，双手插在连帽衫口袋中，露出自信的咆哮笑容。龙拥有深炭色鳞片，面部、颈部、尾巴和角上布满发光的红色熔岩状裂纹，长着锐利的红色棱角眼睛、白色獠牙、高耸的尖耳朵、两只长长的红黑相间角、尖刺状的红色鬃毛，以及一条从左侧伸入、末端呈红色矛状的弯曲长尾。角色身穿一件亮面超大款 {argument name="hoodie color" default="深红色"} 拉链连帽衫，戴着兜帽，配有白色抽绳、厚重的褶皱、前口袋以及黑色机能工装裤；展示 4 处清晰可见的服装标识：上袖处有一个黑白圆形徽章贴片，黑色矩形袖标上带有扭曲的白色字母，胸前有一个小型三角形标志，以及一个小型白色胸前文字标识。在角色周围添加动态的红色喷溅笔触，特别是在右侧添加一个大面积喷溅，左侧角部附近添加较小的液滴。在顶部设计杂志封面风格的排版布局，包含一行巨大的粗体压缩红色标题 {argument name="headline text" default="HAROS MRNG"}，上方有一行故意设计成不完美伪文字的小型黑色大写字母，左上方有一个小型黑色副标题块 {argument name="subheading text" default="STRENH BLACK"}，下方附带第二行较小的乱码文字，右上角标注黑色期号 {argument name="issue number" default="12"}。采用高对比度赛璐珞动漫渲染、锐利的黑色轮廓线、戏剧性的红色高光、光泽面料反射、简洁的海报构图以及现代角色设计杂志美学。

templates.title: Gothic Anime Superhero Landing

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风动漫超级英雄落地

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a gothic twin-tail schoolgirl"} performing a powerful superhero landing in a shattered urban crater. She is centered in a low-angle dynamic pose with one fist smashed into cracked pavement, one knee down, the other leg raised forward, conveying explosive impact and confidence. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair styled into two huge high curly twin-tails with glossy highlights, each tied with a {argument name="bow color" default="purple"} bow and pearl-like bead, with loose strands flying upward from the force. Her face is covered by a large soft-edged dark square censor block centered over the head, hiding all facial features. Dress her in a dark gothic street-school outfit: oversized black hooded jacket, deep purple top, purple-and-black plaid pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, and chunky black lace-up combat boots. The scene erupts with broken stone slabs, flying rocks, dust, sparks, and debris suspended around her, with a vertical surge of violet lightning and purple energy behind her. Use intense cinematic lighting, high contrast, rim light on hair and clothing, motion blur on debris, detailed rubble texture, dark purple and black color palette, dramatic manga/anime rendering, ultra-detailed digital painting, energetic composition, portrait orientation, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的戏剧性动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位哥特风双马尾女学生"} 在破碎的城市陨石坑中完成震撼的超级英雄落地动作。她处于画面中心，以低角度动态姿势呈现：一只拳头砸向龟裂的路面，单膝跪地，另一条腿向前抬起，展现出爆发性的冲击力和自信感。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，梳成两个巨大的高卷双马尾，带有光泽感，每侧发束系着一个 {argument name="bow color" default="紫色"} 蝴蝶结和珍珠状珠饰，发丝因冲击力向上飞扬。她的面部被一个位于头部中央、边缘柔和的深色方形遮挡块覆盖，隐藏了所有五官。为她穿上深色哥特街头校园装：超大号黑色连帽夹克、深紫色上衣、紫黑格纹百褶裙、黑色过膝袜以及厚底黑色系带战斗靴。场景中喷涌出破碎的石板、飞溅的岩石、尘埃、火花和悬浮的碎片，身后伴随着垂直涌动的紫色闪电和紫色能量。采用强烈的电影级光影，高对比度，头发和服装上的轮廓光，碎片处的动态模糊，细腻的碎石纹理，深紫色与黑色调色板，戏剧性的漫画/动漫渲染，超精细数字绘画，充满活力的构图，竖屏方向，无文字。

templates.title: Cute Takoyaki Photo With Doodle Octopus

titleLocalized.zh: 带有涂鸦章鱼的可爱章鱼烧照片

templates.prompt: Create a vertical smartphone-style food photo of {argument name="dish" default="homemade takoyaki"} served on a plain round white ceramic plate on a gray stainless-steel kitchen counter. The takoyaki is piled high and looks glossy and appetizing, covered with dark brown takoyaki sauce, thick pale yellow mayonnaise zigzags, fluttery bonito flakes, green aonori seasoning, and sliced green onion rings spilling over the plate edge. Add cute hand-drawn white doodle illustrations over the photo as if drawn with a marker: exactly 2 round octopus mascot characters wearing festival headbands, one large octopus peeking from behind the upper right of the plate holding 1 takoyaki skewer and looking surprised, and one smaller octopus at the lower left leaning against the plate; include exactly 2 small doodled takoyaki balls, one circled near the bottom center of the plate and one smiling ball at the lower right. Surround the dish with playful white outline decorations, including approximately 11 stars, 5 hearts, 3 flower-like puffs, 4 small bubbles or circles, and several motion/splash marks, all floating around the food without covering the main toppings. Keep the lighting casual and realistic, with shallow phone-camera perspective from slightly above, warm indoor color, crisp food texture, and a whimsical cozy social-media aesthetic. No printed text or labels.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖屏手机风格的美食照片，展示放在灰色不锈钢厨房台面上纯白色圆形陶瓷盘里的 {argument name="dish" default="自制章鱼烧"}。章鱼烧堆叠得很高，看起来光泽诱人，上面覆盖着深棕色的章鱼烧酱、浓稠的浅黄色蛋黄酱线条、飘动的木鱼花、绿色青海苔粉以及溢出盘缘的葱花圈。在照片上添加可爱的白色手绘涂鸦插图，就像用记号笔画上去的一样：画面中要有 2 个戴着祭典头带的圆形章鱼吉祥物，其中一个大章鱼从盘子右上方探出头，手里拿着 1 根章鱼烧签子，表情惊讶；另一个较小的章鱼在左下方靠着盘子。另外包含 2 个涂鸦章鱼烧小球，一个圈在盘子底部中央附近，另一个在右下方，表情带笑。在食物周围环绕俏皮的白色轮廓装饰，包括约 11 颗星星、5 颗爱心、3 朵花状云团、4 个小气泡或圆圈，以及几个动效/飞溅标记，所有装饰都漂浮在食物周围，且不遮挡主要配料。保持光线自然真实，采用手机摄像头从上方略微俯拍的视角，呈现温暖的室内色调、清晰的食物质感以及温馨有趣的社交媒体美学。画面中不包含任何印刷文字或标签。

templates.title: Gothic Maid Superhero Landing

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Noel"}, a blonde gothic-lolita maid heroine performing a superhero landing in the middle of a ruined city street. She is crouched low with one fist smashed into cracked pavement, one knee forward, the other leg bent back, body leaning toward the viewer in a powerful dynamic perspective. Her face is deliberately obscured by a centered opaque tan square censor block, while her long curly {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair explodes upward and outward from the impact, decorated with a frilly white maid headpiece. She wears an elaborate {argument name="outfit colors" default="black, pale pink, white, and gold"} frilled maid dress with layered ruffles, puffed sleeves, gold trim, a black bodice, pink-and-white apron details, white thigh-high stockings, glossy black Mary Jane shoes, and white cuffs with gold buttons. The environment is a cinematic disaster scene: tall shattered buildings forming a narrow urban canyon, broken stone slabs, dust clouds, debris and chunks of asphalt suspended in the air, impact cracks radiating from her fist, and a thin vertical blue-white energy beam descending from the sky behind her head. Use extreme low-angle perspective, intense motion, wind-swept fabric, flying rubble, volumetric sunlight breaking through smoke, high-detail anime rendering, sharp linework, glossy highlights, ornate costume details, dramatic backlighting, and a sense of explosive impact. Aspect ratio 3:4, full-body composition, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的竖版动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Noel"}，一位金发哥特萝莉女仆英雄，正在废墟城市街道中央进行超级英雄落地。她低身蹲伏，一只拳头砸在开裂的地面上，一膝在前，另一条腿向后弯曲，身体向观众倾斜，呈现出强有力的动态视角。她的脸部被一个居中的不透明棕褐色方块遮挡，她长长的卷曲 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 头发因冲击力向四周炸开，头上戴着白色的荷叶边女仆头饰。她穿着一套精致的 {argument name="outfit colors" default="黑色、淡粉色、白色和金色"} 荷叶边女仆装，带有层叠的褶边、泡泡袖、金色饰边、黑色紧身胸衣、粉白相间的围裙细节、白色过膝袜、亮面黑色玛丽珍鞋以及带有金色纽扣的白色袖口。环境是一个电影级的灾难场景：高耸破碎的建筑物形成狭窄的城市峡谷，破碎的石板、尘云、悬浮在空中的碎石和沥青块，冲击裂纹从她的拳头向四周辐射，一道细长的蓝白色能量光束从她脑后的天空中垂直降下。采用极端的低角度视角、强烈的动感、随风飘动的布料、飞溅的瓦砾、穿透烟雾的体积光、高细节动漫渲染、锐利的线条、光泽高光、华丽的服装细节、戏剧性的逆光以及强烈的爆炸冲击感。长宽比 3:4，全身构图，无文字。

templates.title: Barbarian and Dragon Knight Battlefield Duel

titleLocalized.zh: 野蛮人与龙骑士的战场对决

templates.prompt: Create a dark cinematic high-fantasy battlefield scene titled {argument name="scene title" default="Alliance with the Barbarian 4"}: in the midground, two powerful warriors fight back-to-back as allies, crossing swords against unseen enemies amid dust and flying sparks. On the left is a massive horned {argument name="barbarian type" default="demon-like barbarian"}, bare-chested, extremely muscular, scarred and muddy, with reddish-brown skin, long wild black hair, small curved horns, a snarling face, leather-and-fur loincloth, bone and skull belt ornaments, wrist wraps, and a heavy sword gripped in both hands. On the right is a towering {argument name="creature warrior" default="dragon-headed reptilian knight"} wearing dark layered scale armor and spiked pauldrons, with a fierce open-jawed reptile head, ridged horns, clawed hands, and a sword locked with the barbarian's blade in a dramatic crossed composition. In the foreground, show one fallen {argument name="fallen warrior" default="blonde female knight"} lying on rocky mud in blackened plate armor and chainmail, long golden hair spread across the ground, one hand outstretched, a sword dropped near her body, and her face intentionally obscured by a plain solid dark-brown square censor block. The setting is a chaotic medieval war zone with tattered battle banners on poles, distant mountains, smoke, dirt, and a huge army blurred in the background. Use a low-angle epic composition, vertical 2:3 framing, gritty photorealistic fantasy concept art, ultra-detailed armor scratches, wet mud, sweat, bloodless but brutal atmosphere, dramatic backlighting from a bright sun breaking through storm clouds directly behind the crossed swords, high contrast, volumetric dust, sharp focus on the duel, shallow depth of field, cinematic color grading, no readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个黑暗电影级的高奇幻战场场景，标题为 {argument name="scene title" default="与野蛮人的联盟 4"}：在中景处，两名强大的战士背靠背并肩作战，在尘土与飞溅的火花中挥剑抵御看不见的敌人。左侧是一名魁梧且长角的 {argument name="barbarian type" default="恶魔般的野蛮人"}，赤裸上身，肌肉极其发达，身上布满伤疤与泥土，皮肤呈红褐色，留着凌乱的长黑发，长有小巧的弯角，面目狰狞，身穿皮革与毛皮缠腰布，佩戴骨头与头骨装饰的腰带，手腕缠着绷带，双手紧握一把重剑。右侧是一名高大的 {argument name="creature warrior" default="龙首爬行动物骑士"}，身穿深色层叠鳞甲和带刺的肩甲，拥有凶猛且张开大嘴的爬行动物头部、脊状角、利爪，手中的剑与野蛮人的剑在戏剧性的交叉构图中锁在一起。在前景处，展示一名倒下的 {argument name="fallen warrior" default="金发女骑士"}，她躺在布满岩石的泥地上，身穿发黑的板甲和锁子甲，金色的长发散落在地面上，一只手伸向前方，身旁掉落着一把剑，她的脸被一个纯深棕色的方形遮挡块刻意遮住。背景是一个混乱的中世纪战区，插着破烂的战旗，远处有山脉、烟雾、尘土，以及背景中模糊的庞大军队。采用低角度的史诗构图，2:3 竖向画幅，粗犷的写实奇幻概念艺术，超细节的盔甲划痕、湿泥、汗水，营造出一种无血但残酷的氛围，戏剧性的逆光效果来自直接穿过交叉剑锋后方风暴云层的明亮太阳，高对比度，体积感尘埃，对决焦点清晰，浅景深，电影级调色，无任何可读文字。

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime-style street fashion illustration of {argument name="character description" default="a young woman with pale skin and long silver-white hair"} standing in the middle of a busy modern Japanese city crossing, surrounded by softly blurred pedestrians and tall buildings covered in colorful billboards. She wears an oversized {argument name="hoodie style" default="black zip-up hoodie with cat-ear hood, red piping, white drawstrings, patch emblems on the chest and sleeve, and bulky sleeves"}, a red graphic T-shirt with a simple white skull-like mascot face, and loose black cargo pants with a small red accent at the waistband. Her hood is up, forming sharp black cat ears, with a small ahoge strand of hair at the top and white hair falling around her shoulders; her face is intentionally hidden by a centered opaque pale beige square censor block. Pose her walking toward the viewer with a relaxed urban attitude, holding {argument name="left hand object" default="a black umbrella handle"} in one hand and {argument name="right hand object" default="a glossy black handbag"} in the other. Use a bright daytime Shibuya-like setting with crosswalk lines, glass towers, red and blue signage, atmospheric haze, depth of field, soft rim lighting, clean linework, smooth cel shading, fashionable youth-culture mood, and a polished GPT-image-2 anime illustration look.

templates.prompt: Create a vertical pastel anime social-media greeting illustration of a youthful androgynous character with {argument name="hair color" default="bright cyan blue"} fluffy bob-length hair, wearing a loose dark navy beret, an oversized navy haori-style cardigan over a white shirt, and a small blue crystal pendant necklace. The character is shown from chest up in a sunny softly blurred room by a window, warm golden morning light and bokeh in the background, holding one hand beside the cheek in a V-sign peace pose. Place a large soft-edged square privacy block over the center of the face, colored as a muted blue-to-pink gradient, hiding the facial features. Use glossy modern anime rendering, delicate linework, luminous highlights, soft sparkles, and a cute sticker-decorated layout. Add exactly 2 Japanese text stickers: a large puffy rounded headline at the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="おはようございます"} in blue and pink letters with a thick white outline, and a cloud speech bubble at lower left reading {argument name="bubble text" default="ぴっぴ"} with a small pink heart. Add exactly 3 sun doodle marks near the top headline: one simple yellow sun with rays above the hair, one small yellow burst near the left side, and one curved pink heart-arrow flourish at the lower right. Add exactly 4 small flower doodles scattered around the image, plus tiny plus signs, dots, hearts, and star sparkles for a cheerful morning sticker aesthetic. Use a vertical 9:16 composition, close crop, dreamy pastel palette, high detail, clean illustration, no photorealism.

templates.title: Cosmic Flowering Bonsai with Sleeping Cat

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻宇宙盆景与沉睡的猫

templates.prompt: Create a lavish vertical fantasy illustration of one enormous flowering bonsai tree in a wide porcelain planter, set in a dreamy cosmic night garden. The bonsai has a twisted, glossy, rose-gold trunk and branching limbs, with a dense rounded canopy made from countless succulent-like rosette blossoms in {argument name="flower colors" default="pearl pink, lavender, lilac, peach, and opalescent white"}; the petals should look translucent, dewy, and jewel-like with sparkling highlights. Add many long hanging crystal-bead strands and delicate dripping garlands beneath the branches, like luminous wisteria made of pearls and glass. The planter is one large pale pink-lavender bowl with ornate silver baroque floral metal ornaments on the front, sitting on an intricately carved circular silver pedestal. At the lower right, place exactly one sleeping {argument name="animal" default="white fluffy cat"} curled peacefully on the pedestal beside a few pastel pearl spheres. The background is a deep starry galaxy sky filled with glowing bokeh, tiny stars, floating petals, and magical dust, with exactly one large pale moon partially visible in the upper right corner. Surround the base with soft clusters of pink and purple blossoms and glowing pearls. Use an ultra-detailed anime fantasy art style, romantic and ethereal, high saturation pastels, iridescent lighting, soft bloom, crystalline sparkle, ornate decorative craftsmanship, serene bedtime mood, vertical composition, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅华丽的竖版奇幻插画，描绘一棵巨大的开花盆景树，置于宽大的瓷质花盆中，背景为梦幻般的宇宙夜花园。盆景拥有扭曲且富有光泽的玫瑰金树干和枝干，茂密的圆形树冠由无数多肉植物般的莲座花朵组成，颜色为 {argument name="flower colors" default="珍珠粉、薰衣草紫、丁香紫、桃色和蛋白石白"}；花瓣应呈现半透明、带露水且如宝石般闪烁的效果。在枝干下方添加许多长长的悬垂水晶珠串和精致的滴落花环，如同由珍珠和玻璃制成的发光紫藤。花盆为一个巨大的浅粉薰衣草色碗，正面饰有华丽的银色巴洛克风格花卉金属装饰，放置在雕刻精美的圆形银色底座上。在右下方，放置一只正在沉睡的 {argument name="animal" default="白色毛茸茸的猫"}，它在底座上平静地蜷缩着，旁边有几颗柔和的珍珠球。背景是深邃的星系天空，布满了发光的虚化效果、细小的星星、漂浮的花瓣和魔法尘埃，右上角隐约可见一轮巨大的苍白月亮。在底座周围环绕着粉色和紫色花簇以及发光的珍珠。采用超精细的动漫奇幻艺术风格，浪漫而空灵，高饱和度的柔和色彩，虹彩光效，柔光效果，晶莹剔透的闪光，华丽的装饰工艺，宁静的睡前氛围，竖构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Moonlit Anime Martial Artist Kick

titleLocalized.zh: 月下动漫武术家踢击

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic vertical anime action illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a pink-haired female martial artist"} in a dramatic low-angle composition, wearing a glossy {argument name="outfit color" default="deep magenta"} floral Chinese-inspired qipao mini dress with gold embroidery, black thigh-high stockings, garter details, and black shoes. She is captured mid-spinning high kick, with one leg thrust directly toward the camera so the sole dominates the upper center of the frame, her other knee bent near the ground, long flowing pink hair and ribbons whipping around her, and her face deliberately covered by a flat rose-pink square censor block. Surround her with one sweeping circular ribbon of {argument name="energy color" default="neon pink"} magical slash energy, bright sparks, motion trails, shattered stone fragments, and flying pink petals. Include exactly one airborne {argument name="opponent" default="dark-clothed male ninja opponent"} in the upper right being knocked backward by the kick. Set the scene in {argument name="setting" default="a moonlit ancient East Asian street"} with tiled rooftops, red lantern glow, wooden architecture, a single large full moon in the cloudy night sky, cracked pavement, cinematic debris, strong foreshortening, intense perspective, ultra-detailed anime rendering, high contrast magenta lighting, dramatic action blur, glossy highlights, and a polished fantasy battle poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动态竖屏动漫动作插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位粉色头发的女性武术家"}，采用极具张力的低角度构图。她身穿一件富有光泽的 {argument name="outfit color" default="深洋红色"} 花卉图案中式旗袍短裙，配有金色刺绣、黑色过膝袜、吊带细节和黑色鞋子。画面捕捉她侧身回旋高踢的瞬间，一条腿直接冲向镜头，脚底占据画面上方中心位置，另一条膝盖弯曲靠近地面，长长的粉色秀发和丝带随风飘动，她的脸部被一个平面的玫瑰粉色方形遮挡块刻意遮住。在她周围环绕着一道 {argument name="energy color" default="霓虹粉色"} 的圆形魔法斩击能量带，伴随着明亮的火花、动态轨迹、破碎的石块碎片和飞舞的粉色花瓣。画面右上角包含一个被踢击击退的 {argument name="opponent" default="身着深色服装的男性忍者对手"}。场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="月光下的古老东亚街道"}，背景包括瓦片屋顶、红灯笼光芒、木质建筑、云层密布的夜空中一轮巨大的满月、开裂的地面、电影感碎片、强烈的透视缩短效果、极具冲击力的视角、超精细动漫渲染、高对比度洋红色光影、戏剧性的动作模糊、光泽高光以及精致的奇幻战斗海报美学。

templates.title: Vintage Saint Quote Card

titleLocalized.zh: 复古圣人语录卡片

templates.prompt: Create a vertical vintage religious icon-style portrait card of an elderly male saint or philosopher, painted like a Renaissance devotional illustration on aged parchment. The central figure has short gray hair and a partial gray beard, with his face deliberately covered by a flat opaque tan rectangle, standing before a radiant golden halo with sunburst rays against a soft blue sky with clouds. He wears a cream tunic with gold trim and a deep blue draped robe, raises his left hand with one finger pointing upward, and holds a curled parchment scroll in his right arm. The scroll contains a centered serif quote in 5 visible lines: “{argument name="quote" default="Good ideas aren't validated by opinions. They're validated by customers willing to pay."}” with a small ornamental divider beneath. At the bottom, include a cream nameplate with large spaced serif capitals reading “{argument name="person name" default="STEVE BLANK"}”. Frame the image with an ornate gold rectangular border, scalloped cream outer edge, and exactly 4 decorative floral corner clusters: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right, each with roses, white lilies, green leaves, and gold filigree. Use warm muted colors, aged paper grain, hand-painted brush texture, devotional holy-card composition, soft glow, symmetrical layout, and elegant antique typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直的复古宗教圣像风格肖像卡片，描绘一位年长的男性圣人或哲学家，画风如同文艺复兴时期的虔诚插画，背景为陈旧的羊皮纸。中心人物留着灰色的短发和部分灰色胡须，面部被一个平坦的不透明棕褐色矩形刻意遮挡，站在柔和的蓝天白云背景下，身后是带有太阳光芒的金色光环。他身穿带有金色饰边的奶油色长袍和深蓝色披肩，左手抬起，一根手指指向天空，右臂抱着一卷卷起的羊皮纸卷轴。卷轴上包含一行居中的衬线字体语录，共 5 行可见内容：“{argument name="quote" default="Good ideas aren't validated by opinions. They're validated by customers willing to pay."}”，下方有一个小型装饰性分隔符。在底部，包含一个奶油色的铭牌，上面写着大号且间距宽阔的衬线大写字母：“{argument name="person name" default="STEVE BLANK"}”。用华丽的金色矩形边框、扇形奶油色外缘装饰图像，并在左上角、右上角、左下角和右下角各放置 4 簇装饰性花卉，每簇包含玫瑰、白百合、绿叶和金色花丝。使用温暖柔和的色调、陈旧的纸张纹理、手绘笔触、虔诚圣像构图、柔和光晕、对称布局以及优雅的古董排版。

templates.title: Sleepy Cat Hoodie Anime Girl in Bed

titleLocalized.zh: 床上困倦的猫咪连帽衫动漫女孩

templates.prompt: Create a cozy nighttime bedroom scene in a hybrid photorealistic environment with a crisp anime sticker character composited into the bed. The main subject is a sleepy chibi anime {argument name="character name" default="cat-eared girl"} tucked under a fluffy beige comforter, visible from the chest up, clutching the blanket with both small hands and wearing an oversized {argument name="hoodie design" default="cream cat hood with black ears, pink inner ears, blue paw-like spots, and a dark pajama top covered in neon pink and blue triangle patterns"}. She has {argument name="hair color" default="bright pink-purple"} short bob hair with messy bangs, blue starry half-lidded eyes, a tiny relaxed smile, faint blush, and colorful triangular hair clips. Render the character as a glossy 2D anime cutout with a thick white outline and clean cel shading, contrasting against the realistic bedding. The bedroom is warm and peaceful: rumpled pillows, soft beige sheets, chunky knitted throw blanket in the foreground, wooden headboard, potted plants on and near the nightstand, framed wall art, heavy curtains, and a window showing dark city bokeh lights. A glowing bedside table lamp with a pleated cream shade casts warm amber light across the bed, balanced with cool blue night shadows. Mood is drowsy, healed, gentle, and cute, like saying good night. Use vertical composition, intimate close-up from slightly above bed level, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic lighting, highly detailed fabric folds, cozy realism, adorable anime expression, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个温馨的夜间卧室场景，背景为半写实照片，并合成一个生动的动漫贴纸角色。一个困倦的 Q 版动漫女孩，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色"} 的短波波头和柔和的刘海，蜷缩在柔软的米色羽绒被中，双手紧紧抓着毯子，半睁着星光熠熠的蓝色双眼，带着猫咪般的小小微笑和淡淡的红晕，昏昏欲睡地注视着前方。她穿着一件超大的 {argument name="hoodie design" default="奶油色猫耳连帽衫，带有蓝色爪印般的眼部斑点、粉色内耳，以及深海军蓝色的睡衣连帽衫，上面覆盖着霓虹粉和青色的三角形图案"}；添加可爱的蓝色和粉色三角形几何发夹。将角色渲染为清晰的 2D 动漫剪纸，带有厚实的白色贴纸轮廓和深色边缘阴影，自然地放置在床上。房间温暖而宁静：凌乱的枕头、柔软的米色床上用品、前景中的粗针织毯、木质床头、带有发光布艺灯罩的床头柜、窗边和床头附近的盆栽植物、深色窗帘，以及窗外模糊的城市灯光。使用温暖的琥珀色灯光与冷蓝色的夜间阴影相结合，浅景深，高细节的织物纹理，宁静的睡前氛围，竖版构图，略微俯视的中近景，可爱舒适的氛围，无可见文字。

templates.title: Late-Night Graphite Portrait Workspace

titleLocalized.zh: 深夜石墨肖像画工作台

templates.prompt: Create a moody monochrome overhead photo-realistic scene of a late-night artist workspace: a textured off-white sheet of drawing paper lies diagonally on a worn gray desk, holding an unfinished graphite portrait of {argument name="subject description" default="a young woman with shoulder-length wavy dark hair, bare shoulder, and a black camisole strap"}. The drawing is highly detailed in the hair, neck, shoulder, and clothing, with visible layered graphite strokes, smudging, paper grain, and soft unfinished shading. A realistic right hand enters from the lower right, actively drawing with a black pencil near the portrait’s cheek and neck area. Place a black smartphone at the upper right showing the matching black-and-white reference photo of the same subject. Add exactly two opaque soft-edged gray privacy rectangles: one large square covering the face in the pencil portrait and one smaller rectangle covering the face on the phone screen. Surround the paper with a believable artist’s desk arrangement: one metal pencil sharpener near the top, one kneaded eraser or small stone near the bottom, one open pencil tin at the lower left, five loose black graphite pencils, two brushes, and two metallic drawing tools scattered naturally around the paper. Use {argument name="lighting mood" default="dim warm desk-lamp lighting"}, deep shadows, subtle vignette, intimate private-work-in-progress atmosphere, realistic paper texture, charcoal and graphite tones, shallow depth of field, high-resolution editorial photography style, no visible text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个充满情绪感的单色俯视写实场景，展现深夜艺术家工作台：一张纹理质感的灰白色绘图纸斜放在磨损的灰色桌面上，纸上绘有一幅未完成的石墨肖像，描绘对象为 {argument name="subject description" default="一位留着齐肩波浪卷深色头发、露肩、穿着黑色吊带背心的年轻女性"}。肖像在头发、颈部、肩部和衣物细节上刻画入微，呈现出明显的层叠石墨笔触、涂抹痕迹、纸张纹理以及柔和的未完成阴影。一只逼真的右手从右下角伸入，正拿着一支黑色铅笔在肖像的脸颊和颈部区域进行绘制。在右上角放置一部黑色智能手机，屏幕上显示着同一对象的黑白参考照片。添加两个不透明且边缘柔和的灰色隐私遮盖矩形：一个较大的正方形遮盖铅笔肖像的面部，另一个较小的矩形遮盖手机屏幕上的面部。在纸张周围布置写实的艺术家桌面：顶部放置一个金属卷笔刀，底部放置一块可塑橡皮或小石头，左下角放置一个打开的铅笔盒，五支散落的黑色石墨铅笔、两支画笔以及两件金属绘图工具自然地散布在纸张周围。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="昏暗温暖的台灯照明"}，营造深邃阴影、微妙暗角、私密创作过程的氛围，强调真实的纸张质感、炭笔与石墨色调、浅景深，呈现高分辨率的编辑摄影风格，画面中无可见文字。

templates.prompt: Create a vertical close-medium authentic daily-life photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a young Japanese woman in her early 20s"} sitting sideways on the edge of an unmade bed in a small bedroom on an ordinary morning. Shoot from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, as if captured candidly, with her posture relaxed and sleepy, leaning forward a little, knees together, one hand resting on her knee and the other loosely holding a dark smartphone near her thigh. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular privacy blur, while her naturally straight black hair is loosely gathered and messy from sleep, with stray strands around her cheek and neck. She wears {argument name="sleepwear" default="an oversized loose white cotton T-shirt and light gray soft shorts"}, unstyled and casual. The room feels lived-in: there is exactly 1 large window on the left with bright morning daylight, exactly 1 potted plant on the windowsill, exactly 1 small green bottle near the window, exactly 1 cluttered bedside table with small bottles, jars, and daily items, and an unmade bed with cream pillows and {argument name="blanket color" default="muted sage green"} rumpled bedding. Use soft directional morning window light from the left, a cool-to-warm transition, visible dust and haze, gentle shadows across the shirt and legs, realistic skin texture on the hands and collarbone, natural fabric wrinkles, shallow depth of field, muted colors, slight grain, documentary realism, no posing, no glamour styling, no makeup, no artificial studio lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图、中近景、真实感十足的日常生活照片，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位 20 出头的日本年轻女性"} 在一个普通的早晨，侧身坐在小卧室凌乱的床边。采用略微俯视的三分之四角度拍摄，营造出一种随手抓拍的真实感。她姿态放松、睡意朦胧，身体微微前倾，双膝并拢，一只手放在膝盖上，另一只手松弛地握着深色智能手机，靠近大腿。她的面部被柔和的矩形隐私模糊处理，自然垂顺的黑发凌乱地扎起，脸颊和颈部散落着几缕发丝。她穿着 {argument name="sleepwear" default="一件宽松的白色纯棉 T 恤和浅灰色柔软短裤"}，不加修饰，随性自然。房间充满生活气息：左侧有 1 扇大窗户，透进明亮的晨光；窗台上放着 1 盆植物和 1 个绿色小瓶子；床头柜上摆满了瓶瓶罐罐等日常杂物；床上铺着奶油色枕头和 {argument name="blanket color" default="柔和鼠尾草绿"} 的褶皱被褥。光线采用从左侧射入的柔和晨光，呈现冷暖过渡，画面中可见微尘和薄雾，衬衫和腿部有柔和的阴影，手部和锁骨呈现真实的皮肤纹理，布料褶皱自然，浅景深，色调柔和，带有轻微颗粒感，呈现纪实风格，无摆拍，无美颜修饰，无妆容，无人工摄影棚灯光。
