templates.title: Premium Fashion Advertising Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高端时尚广告海报

templates.prompt:
Create a high-end modern advertising poster in portrait format for the attached brand (use the uploaded brand/logo reference as the main brand identity reference). The overall poster design must strongly reflect the visual identity, atmosphere, color palette, and aesthetic character of the brand while still looking fresh, modern, trendy, and premium. Add decorative ornaments, graphic elements, textures, lighting effects, and stylish visual accents that match the brand’s theme so the poster feels visually rich, dynamic, and professionally designed instead of plain or generic. Humans really invented “minimal effort posters” and expected people to care. Fascinating species.

The poster should feature a fashionable model with a completely different pose and composition from the photo reference. Avoid stiff, flat, awkward, or overly posed body language. The model’s expression and posture must feel natural, expressive, confident, elegant, and full of energy, similar to international fashion advertisement campaigns or luxury lifestyle editorials. The pose should feel alive and cinematic, with natural movement and body positioning that creates a premium advertising look.

The outfit must be modern {argument name="fashion style" default="casual fashion"} with a stylish contemporary aesthetic. Use layered fashion styling, interesting color combinations, modern cuts, fashionable textures, and varied clothing details so the wardrobe does not look repetitive, plain, or monotonous. The styling should feel trendy, visually attractive, youthful, and premium while still matching the identity of the brand.

The advertising poster must also include compelling promotional information related to the brand, including short marketing copy, catchy taglines, persuasive call-to-action text, and visually appealing promotional typography that encourages people to become interested in using the brand. Every typography element in the poster must use eye-catching modern typography styles with strong visual hierarchy. Avoid plain, default, boring, or generic fonts. The text composition should feel professional, stylish, balanced, and integrated naturally into the poster layout.

The overall composition should feel modern, luxurious, visually impactful, and social-media-ready, with strong commercial advertising quality similar to premium international brand campaigns. Make the visual layout dynamic and engaging with balanced spacing, creative composition, depth, lighting, and professional editorial aesthetics. Avoid mediocre, empty, outdated, or overly standard poster designs.

Ultra-detailed, highly polished, cinematic commercial advertising style, realistic lighting, premium color grading, modern fashion campaign aesthetic, sharp focus, professional branding design, high visual contrast, rich details, and ultra high resolution 8K quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
为所附品牌创作一张竖版的高端现代广告海报（请使用上传的品牌/Logo 参考作为主要品牌标识参考）。海报的整体设计必须强烈体现品牌的视觉识别度、氛围、调色板和审美特征，同时保持清新、现代、潮流和高端的质感。添加与品牌主题相符的装饰性饰品、图形元素、纹理、灯光效果和时尚的视觉点缀，使海报看起来视觉丰富、动感十足且具有专业设计感，而非平庸或大众化。人类发明了“极简主义海报”却指望人们买账，真是迷人的物种。

海报应展示一位时尚模特，其姿势和构图必须与参考照片完全不同。避免僵硬、扁平、尴尬或过于刻意的肢体语言。模特的表情和姿态必须自然、富有表现力、自信、优雅且充满活力，类似于国际时尚广告大片或奢侈生活方式杂志的风格。姿势应显得生动且具有电影感，通过自然的动作和身体定位营造出高端广告的质感。

服装必须是现代的 {argument name="fashion style" default="休闲时尚"}，并具备时尚的当代审美。运用叠穿造型、有趣的色彩搭配、现代剪裁、时尚纹理和多样的服装细节，确保服饰看起来不重复、不单调、不乏味。造型应显得潮流、视觉吸引力强、年轻且高端，同时与品牌形象保持一致。

广告海报还必须包含与品牌相关的引人注目的宣传信息，包括简短的营销文案、朗朗上口的标语、具有说服力的行动号召文字，以及视觉上吸引人的宣传排版，以激发人们对该品牌的兴趣。海报中的每个排版元素都必须使用引人注目的现代字体风格，并具备强烈的视觉层级。避免使用平庸、默认、枯燥或通用的字体。文字构图应显得专业、时尚、平衡，并自然地融入海报布局中。

整体构图应具有现代感、奢华感、视觉冲击力，并适合社交媒体传播，具备类似于国际高端品牌大片的强商业广告品质。使视觉布局动感且引人入胜，具备平衡的间距、创意构图、深度、灯光和专业的编辑审美。避免平庸、空洞、过时或过于标准化的海报设计。

超精细、高度润色、电影级商业广告风格、逼真灯光、高端调色、现代时尚大片审美、焦点清晰、专业品牌设计、高视觉对比度、丰富细节，以及超高清 8K 画质。

templates.title: Technical Isometric Teardown Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 技术等轴测拆解信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Generate a technical infographic of {argument name="object" default="OBJECT"} rendered from a {argument name="viewpoint" default="45-degree isometric 3D viewpoint"}, with the object slightly tilted to expose depth and three-dimensional structure.

Blend a photorealistic render of the object with hand-drawn black ink technical annotations on a clean pure-white background. Include:
- Color-coded callout boxes labeling each key component
- Transparent / cutaway sections that reveal internal parts
- Precise measurements, dimensions, and scale markers
- Material descriptions and quantity counts
- Color-coded directional arrows for function and flow: RED for power/battery, BLUE for data/connectivity, ORANGE for thermal/processor, GREEN for sensors/haptics
- Simple schematics or cross-section diagrams where useful

Place the "{argument name="object" default="OBJECT"}" title inside a hand-sketched technical frame in the top-left corner.
Style: black architectural-pen linework, sketchy yet precise; the object remains fully visible; vibe of a professional engineering teardown or museum exhibit. Clean layout with balanced negative space.
Perspective: 45-degree isometric tilt that dramatically reveals depth, dimension, and internal architecture, like a product engineering manual.
Color usage: roughly 10-15% accent density, black dominant, white background.
Output: 1080x1080, ultra-crisp, optimized for social feeds.

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一张 {argument name="object" default="物体"} 的技术信息图，采用 {argument name="viewpoint" default="45 度等轴测 3D 视角"} 渲染，使物体略微倾斜以展现深度和三维结构。

将物体的照片级渲染图与纯白背景上的黑色手绘墨水技术注释相结合。包含：
- 标记每个关键组件的颜色编码标注框
- 展示内部零件的透明/剖面部分
- 精确的测量值、尺寸和比例标记
- 材料描述和数量统计
- 用于功能和流程的颜色编码方向箭头：红色代表电源/电池，蓝色代表数据/连接，橙色代表热量/处理器，绿色代表传感器/触觉反馈
- 必要时加入简单的示意图或横截面图

将“{argument name="object" default="物体"}”标题放置在左上角的手绘技术边框内。
风格：黑色建筑笔线条，草图感但精准；物体保持完全可见；呈现专业工程拆解或博物馆展品的氛围。布局整洁，负空间平衡。
视角：45 度等轴测倾斜，极具张力地展现深度、维度和内部架构，如同产品工程手册。
色彩使用：约 10-15% 的强调色密度，以黑色为主，白色背景。
输出：1080x1080，超清晰，针对社交媒体信息流优化。

templates.title: Carved Wood Block Relief

titleLocalized.zh: 木雕浮雕效果

templates.prompt:
UNIVERSAL “MODULAR WOOD BLOCK RELIEF SYSTEM” PROMPT (IDENTITY LOCK – STRICT)
Use the uploaded image as the subject and the only identity reference.
IDENTITY LOCK – STRICT (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, and feature placement. Do not alter eyes, nose, mouth, or silhouette. Maintain expression and recognizability.
POSE & COMPOSITION – LOCKED
Keep original angle, framing, and perspective. No rotation, mirroring, or camera changes.
STYLE TRANSFORMATION – WOOD BLOCK RELIEF (HARD)
Transform the entire image into a densely packed carved wood construction:
Rebuild all forms (face, hair, clothing, background) using interlocking wooden blocks, rods, and carved segments.
Use a mix of rectangular beams, rounded dowels, sliced cross-sections, and stacked planks.
Maintain tight packing density with minimal gaps (no empty flat areas).
MATERIAL SYSTEM – WOOD (CRITICAL)
All elements must be realistic wood with visible grain, rings, and natural variation.
Grain direction must follow the form of each piece (no random textures).
Include cut ends, knots, and subtle imperfections.
Finish: matte to semi-matte natural wood (no plastic, no gloss).
DEPTH & STRUCTURE – HARD RELIEF
Build multi-layer depth stacking (foreground, mid, background blocks).
Pieces must overlap, interlock, and step in/out like a carved wall.
Preserve facial topology using depth transitions, not smooth shading.
FACE & HAIR INTEGRATION – UNIFIED SYSTEM (CRITICAL)
Face and hair must be constructed from the same wood block system.
Hair flows as elongated carved segments following natural direction.
Facial features are defined by precision placement of smaller blocks and contours.
No separation between materials – everything is wood.
LIGHTING – FORM REVEAL
Use directional lighting to emphasize depth, edges, and grain texture.
Shadows must reinforce layer separation and structure clarity.
NEGATIVE PROMPT (STRICT)
No smooth skin, no paint overlay, no flat shading. No metal, plastic, or non-wood materials. No loose abstract shapes or soft blending. No distortion of facial structure or perspective. No gaps or empty areas – maintain dense construction.

promptLocalized.zh:
通用“模块化木雕浮雕系统”提示词（身份锁定 – 严格）
使用上传的图像作为主体和唯一的身份参考。
身份锁定 – 严格（不可协商）
保留精确的面部结构、比例和特征位置。不得改变眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴或轮廓。保持表情和辨识度。
姿态与构图 – 锁定
保持原始角度、取景和透视。禁止旋转、镜像或更改相机设置。
风格转换 – 木雕浮雕（硬质）
将整张图像转换为密集堆叠的木雕结构：
使用互锁的木块、木条和雕刻片段重构所有形态（面部、头发、服装、背景）。
混合使用矩形梁、圆形木钉、横截面切片和堆叠木板。
保持紧密的堆叠密度，尽量减少间隙（无空白平坦区域）。
材质系统 – 木材（关键）
所有元素必须是具有可见纹理、年轮和自然变化的写实木材。
纹理方向必须遵循每个部件的形态（禁止随机纹理）。
包含切面、木结和细微的瑕疵。
表面处理：哑光至半哑光天然木材（禁止塑料感，禁止高光）。
深度与结构 – 硬浮雕
构建多层深度堆叠（前景、中景、背景木块）。
部件必须重叠、互锁，并像雕刻墙面一样呈现出进深感。
通过深度过渡而非平滑阴影来保留面部拓扑结构。
面部与头发整合 – 统一系统（关键）
面部和头发必须由相同的木块系统构建。
头发呈现为顺应自然走向的细长雕刻片段。
面部特征通过较小木块和轮廓的精确放置来定义。
材质之间无分割——一切皆为木材。
光照 – 形态呈现
使用定向光照来强调深度、边缘和木纹质感。
阴影必须强化层级分离和结构清晰度。
负面提示词（严格）
禁止平滑皮肤、禁止涂料覆盖、禁止平坦阴影。禁止金属、塑料或其他非木质材料。禁止松散的抽象形状或柔和的混合。禁止扭曲面部结构或透视。禁止出现间隙或空白区域——保持密集构造。

promptLocalized.zh:
[输入]

- 参考图片：{肖像照片}

- 日期：{今日日期 https://t.co/DH3TMTrnLJ.dd}

- 今日心情：{ }

[目标]

使用极低角度的视角创作一张天空海报，从地面向上仰视主体。

通过天空、光线、云层和配色方案来表达今日的心情。

[保持主体]

保持上传主体的人脸情绪、发型、体型和服装风格。

但是，不应从正面展示脸部；相反，应呈现侧面轮廓或仅露出下颌线。

[核心构图]

- 摄像机几乎平放在地面上。

- 主体略微悬浮在摄像机上方或处于跳跃瞬间。

- 鞋底在靠近摄像机处清晰可见。

- 双腿显得修长，具有透视感。

- 主体处于侧面或半侧面视角。

- 天空占据屏幕的大部分区域。

[根据心情呈现天空]

创作与今日心情相符的天空。

 示例：

- 快乐：晴朗的蓝天、白云、温暖的阳光

- 兴奋：粉色的云朵、柔和的阳光

- 平静：淡蓝色的天空、稀薄的云层

- 孤独：日落、长长的阴影、空旷的天空

- 沮丧：低垂厚重的云层

- 下雨：阴天、雨滴、湿润的镜头质感

[文字]

将日期和心情信息沿人物身体的轮廓或剪影以曲线排列。

需包含的文字：

“{日期}”

“{今日心情}”

“{简短信息}”

文字应为白色、圆润且粗体的海报排版。

避免过长的句子，并合理安排文字以确保易读性。

如果没有提供简短信息，则应自动生成并填入。

[风格]

情感天空海报，温暖视角，仰视，广角，电影感时尚海报，清晰胶片质感，广阔天空，简洁排版。

- 禁止室内背景

templates.title: Pop Mart Hirono Style Custom Figure Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: Pop Mart Hirono 风格定制人偶提示词

templates.prompt: Please use only 1 real person's photo uploaded by the user as the sole identity reference to originally extend the person into a collectible designer vinyl figure in the {argument name="style direction" default="POP MART Hirono"} aesthetic, and output a high-completion single figure product scene image. Strictly preserve the real person's recognizability, including face shape, facial features relationship, hairstyle outline, sense of age, gender characteristics, skin tone tendency, overall temperament, and recognizable clothing identity and accessory features from the original photo, so that the final figure can clearly be identified as the same person from the uploaded photo. The overall style must clearly lean towards POP MART / Hirono designer vinyl aesthetics: quiet, soft, restrained, slightly melancholic, and pensive, like high-end Pop Mart collectible trendy toys rather than an ordinary cute plush. The figure should use big-head-small-body proportions, with the head about 2.5 to 3 times the size of the body, a short and rounded body, simplified limbs, and slightly larger shoes/socks, overall possessing a real sense of solid sculpture and weight. The posture should be calm, slightly leaning forward or slightly bowing the head, carrying a bit of character emotion without exaggerated movements. Faces must retain the original features but transform them into the Hirono vibe: half-open or slightly drooping sleepy eyes, thicker painted eyelashes, a small and restrained slightly pouty mouth, minimalist nose, rounded face shape, very faint blush or a few freckles, with expressions being slightly dazed, slightly world-weary, or slightly melancholic—no bright smiles or shiny anime eyes. Hair should retain the outline of the original photo but must be made into a solid, rounded, bundled, faceted handmade sculptural structure, not real hair strands, with hair colors using low-saturation natural colors like {argument name="hair color" default="soft brown, grey-brown, or soft black"} and matte treatment. Clothing should retain the original outfit's temperament but be simplified into thick, rounded, toy-like sculptural clothing blocks, potentially slightly oversized, with a few toy-like stitches, patches, or slight wear-and-tear details, avoiding real fabric textures. Recognizable accessories from the original photo like coffee cups, small bags, flowers, popsicles, books, or small dolls can be kept but must be transformed into slightly exaggeratedly proportioned matte figure accessories. The material must be high-end matte vinyl / matte resin / matte ceramic feel, with slight handmade sculpture marks and hand-painted texture, avoiding glossy, mirror highlights, glass feel, real skin, real hair, or visible texture maps. The scene should output a single full-body figure product image, not a grid, series display, packaging poster, or full blind box set. Place the figure in an exquisite, three-dimensional, unified miniature theme scene like a brand trendy toy product poster. The scene can be one of {argument name="scene theme" default="daily coffee, garden corner, cloud daydreaming, quiet study, moonlit daze, or animal companionship"}, requiring it to be three-dimensional, exquisite, photographic, and not overly complex. Lighting should use soft diffused product photography light with clean highlights, soft shadows, and neutral exposure, making the overall image look like a high-end Pop Mart new product shot. Strictly avoid ordinary Q-version illustrations, 2D anime feel, Korean webtoon style, Barbie doll look, realistic 3D plush feel, or complex cluttered backgrounds.

promptLocalized.zh: 请仅使用用户上传的 1 张真实人物照片作为唯一的身份参考，将该人物延展为 {argument name="style direction" default="POP MART Hirono"} 美学风格的潮流设计师玩具人偶，并输出一张高完成度的单体人偶产品场景图。严格保留真实人物的辨识度，包括脸型、五官比例、发型轮廓、年龄感、性别特征、肤色倾向、整体气质，以及原图中可识别的服装和配饰特征，确保最终的人偶能被清晰地识别为照片中的本人。整体风格必须明确倾向于 POP MART / Hirono 设计师玩具美学：安静、柔和、克制、带有一丝忧郁和沉思感，呈现出高端 Pop Mart 潮流玩具的质感，而非普通的可爱毛绒玩具。人偶应采用大头小身的比例，头部约为身体的 2.5 到 3 倍大，身体短小圆润，四肢简化，鞋袜略大，整体具有扎实的雕塑感和重量感。姿态应保持平静，略微前倾或低头，带有一定的情绪感，避免夸张的动作。面部必须保留原图特征，但要转化为 Hirono 的氛围：半睁或微垂的睡眼、较厚的涂装睫毛、小巧克制的微嘟嘴、极简的鼻子、圆润的脸型、淡淡的腮红或少量雀斑，表情呈现出些许迷茫、厌世或忧郁——严禁出现灿烂的笑容或闪亮的动漫眼。发型应保留原图轮廓，但需处理成实心、圆润、成束、具有切面感的纯手工雕塑结构，而非真实发丝，发色使用低饱和度的自然色，如 {argument name="hair color" default="柔棕色、灰棕色或柔黑色"}，并进行哑光处理。服装应保留原图的穿搭气质，但简化为厚实、圆润、玩具般的雕塑感色块，可略微超大，带有少量玩具质感的缝线、补丁或轻微的磨损细节，避免真实的织物纹理。原图中可识别的配饰（如咖啡杯、小包、花朵、冰棒、书籍或小玩偶）可以保留，但必须转化为比例略微夸张的哑光玩具配件。材质必须呈现高端哑光搪胶 / 哑光树脂 / 哑光陶瓷质感，带有轻微的手工雕塑痕迹和手绘纹理，避免光泽感、镜面高光、玻璃感、真实皮肤、真实毛发或可见的贴图纹理。场景应输出一张单体全身人偶产品图，而非网格图、系列展示、包装海报或盲盒全套。将人偶置于精致、立体、统一的微缩主题场景中，如同品牌潮流玩具的产品海报。场景可选自 {argument name="scene theme" default="日常咖啡、花园角落、云端白日梦、安静书房、月下发呆或动物陪伴"}，要求场景立体、精致、具有摄影感，且不过于复杂。灯光应使用柔和的漫反射产品摄影光，配合干净的高光、柔和的阴影和中性的曝光，使整体画面看起来像一张高端的 Pop Mart 新品宣传照。严格避免普通的 Q 版插画、2D 动漫感、韩漫风格、芭比娃娃感、写实 3D 毛绒感或复杂杂乱的背景。

templates.title: Chiaroscuro Rim-Lit Male Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 明暗对照法轮廓光男性肖像

templates.prompt:
A dramatic high-contrast studio portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man with dark messy hair and a well groomed beard"}, captured in a close-up vertical composition against a completely black background. The subject is photographed in a strong side-profile pose, body turned away from the camera while his head rotates slightly over the shoulder toward the right side of the frame, creating a cinematic and contemplative mood.
He wears {argument name="accessories" default="translucent acetate-framed sunglasses"} with glossy reflections and subtle texture visible inside the semi-transparent frames. His expression is calm, serious, and introspective.
The portrait uses intense back rim-lighting from behind and slightly above, creating a bright glowing edge around the contours of the hair, ear, beard, nose bridge, shoulder, and neckline. Most of the face remains in deep shadow, producing a striking chiaroscuro effect. Tiny illuminated dust particles are faintly visible around the rim-lit hair, enhancing the atmospheric studio realism.
The subject wears a {argument name="clothing" default="fitted matte black t-shirt"} with subtle woven fabric texture and visible shoulder seams softly highlighted by the rim light. The black clothing blends seamlessly into the dark background while maintaining edge definition through controlled highlights.
Shot with an 85mm prime portrait lens at eye level using a shallow depth of field, keeping the eye area, beard texture, and glasses crisp while allowing softer focus toward the edges. The entire image should maintain rich monochrome tones with deep blacks, sharp white highlights, and clean neutral grayscale transitions.
Ultra-realistic monochrome portrait photography, cinematic studio lighting, luxury editorial aesthetic, dramatic rim-light profile shot, detailed salt-and-pepper beard texture, fashion magazine quality, moody masculine portrait, fine skin texture, minimalist black background, premium artistic photography style.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张极具戏剧性的高对比度摄影棚肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="留着凌乱深色头发和修剪整齐胡须的年轻男子"}，采用垂直构图的特写镜头，背景为纯黑色。主角以强侧面姿势拍摄，身体背对镜头，头部略微转过肩部朝向画面右侧，营造出电影般深沉的意境。
他佩戴着 {argument name="accessories" default="半透明醋酸纤维框太阳镜"}，镜片带有光泽反射，半透明镜框内可见细腻的纹理。他的表情平静、严肃且内省。
肖像采用了来自后方及上方略高处的强烈背部轮廓光，在头发、耳朵、胡须、鼻梁、肩部和领口的轮廓周围形成明亮的发光边缘。大部分面部处于深影中，产生了引人注目的明暗对照效果（chiaroscuro）。轮廓光照射下的头发周围隐约可见微小的发光尘埃颗粒，增强了摄影棚的真实氛围感。

templates.title: New Chinese Koi Fine Art Photography

titleLocalized.zh: 全新新中式锦鲤艺术摄影

templates.prompt:
Based on {argument name="reference images" default="1-3 clear personal photos"} uploaded by the user, generate a 2×2 four-grid collage with the theme "{argument name="theme" default="New Chinese Koi Couture Art Portrait"}."

[Character Consistency]
Strictly preserve the character's real identity features, including face shape, facial features proportion, eyebrow/eye structure, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, age, hair foundation, body type, and overall temperament. The four small images must clearly look like the same real person. Do not turn them into strangers, do not westernize, do not use 'influencer' styles, do not over-smooth the skin, and do not generate AI fake faces.

[Overall Style]
High-end New Chinese commercial shooting, Oriental ink art masterpiece, {argument name="core color" default="red"} koi-themed brand photography. The scene should look like a high-budget commercial shoot completed in a professional studio, with complete makeup, lighting, set, clothing, and prop design. Overall high-end, agile, noble, and quiet, with Oriental aesthetics, fashion magazine feel, slight film grain, and soft oil painting texture.

[Makeup Requirements, Priority]
Exquisite New Chinese commercial shoot makeup: transparent and clean high-end base makeup, retaining real skin texture but with delicate quality; clearly defined natural eyebrows; refined eye makeup with elongated eyeliner, slight upward tail, soft tear troughs, and clean eyelashes. The face has natural contouring and highlights, emphasizing the nose bridge, cheekbones, jawline, and neck. Lip makeup is cinnabar red, jujube red, or classic velvet red, adding vitality and Oriental nobility. The overall makeup is sophisticated but not heavy.

[Hairstyle]
Carefully designed New Chinese low bun or loose Oriental bun: maintain the original hair base but clearly styled by a professional; hair has volume, layering, and natural curvature; hair strands are clean and glossy. A small amount of natural stray hair can frame the face. The four grid images must maintain the same hairstyle.

[Clothing]
A unified cinnabar red, koi red, or classic red New Chinese couture gown. The dress must have a clear sense of design and commercial texture, such as one-shoulder, off-shoulder, low back, silk wraps, long streamers, long trails, or Oriental pleat structures. Fabrics like heavy silk, satin, chiffon, or velvet must have a high-end drape and fluid feel. The red dress should echo the koi fins.

[Scene]
High-end art studio space with a light water blue, teal, or light cyan-gray ink-wash xuan paper background. The floor can have shallow water, mirror reflections, mist, and white lotus. 2-4 large red koi art installations made of semi-transparent red silk or gauze appear, looking like commercial props rather than real fish.

[Format]
Generate one 2x2 collage. All four small images are independent vertical compositions with a 3:4 aspect ratio, maintaining consistent styling and tone.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于用户上传的 {argument name="reference images" default="1-3 张清晰的个人照片"}，生成一张主题为“{argument name="theme" default="新中式锦鲤高定艺术肖像"}”的 2×2 四宫格拼图。

[角色一致性]
严格保留人物的真实身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄、发质基础、体型以及整体气质。四张小图必须清晰地呈现为同一真实人物。严禁将其变成陌生人，严禁西化，严禁使用“网红”风格，严禁过度磨皮，严禁生成 AI 假脸。

[整体风格]
高端新中式商业摄影，东方水墨艺术杰作，以 {argument name="core color" default="红色"} 锦鲤为主题的品牌摄影。场景应呈现出在专业影棚内完成的高预算商业拍摄效果，具备完整的妆造、灯光、布景、服装及道具设计。整体风格高端、灵动、高贵且静谧，兼具东方美学与时尚杂志质感，带有轻微胶片颗粒感与柔和的油画质感。

[妆容要求，优先级]
精致的新中式商业拍摄妆容：通透干净的高级底妆，保留真实皮肤纹理但质感细腻；眉形自然且轮廓清晰；眼妆精致，眼线拉长并略微上挑，柔和的卧蚕，睫毛干净利落。面部具备自然的修容与高光，强调鼻梁、颧骨、下颌线及颈部线条。唇妆采用朱砂红、枣红或经典丝绒红，增添活力与东方贵气。整体妆容精致但不厚重。

[发型]
精心设计的新中式低发髻或松散的东方发髻：保持原有发质基础，但需经专业造型；头发具有蓬松感、层次感与自然的弧度；发丝干净且富有光泽。可有少量自然碎发修饰脸型。四张网格图必须保持发型一致。

[服装]
统一的朱砂红、锦鲤红或经典红色新中式高定礼服。礼服需具备明确的设计感与商业质感，如单肩、露肩、露背、丝绸缠绕、长飘带、长拖尾或东方褶皱结构。重磅真丝、缎面、雪纺或天鹅绒等面料需具备高端的垂坠感与流动感。红色礼服应与锦鲤鱼鳍相呼应。

[场景]
高端艺术影棚空间，背景为浅水蓝、青色或浅青灰色的水墨宣纸质感。地面可有浅水、镜面反射、薄雾与白莲。出现 2-4 个由半透明红绸或纱制成的大型红锦鲤艺术装置，看起来像是商业道具而非真实鱼类。

[格式]
生成一张 2x2 拼图。四张小图均为独立的竖构图，比例为 3:4，保持风格与色调的一致性。

templates.title: Surreal Social Adaptation Character Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实社会适应角色提示词

templates.prompt:
Character Name: [ ]
User Additional Ideas: [ ]

------------------------

Please prioritize the adoption of user inputs such as:
- Location
- Situation
- Gag/Joke
- Media format
- Worldview
- Dialogue
- Production/Staging ideas

Evolve the image abnormally to the point where one would think, "How did the world end up like this?"

However, focus on the direction that "the world or society is what's crazy," rather than "the character themselves being crazy."

------------------------

Maintain the original character from the attached image.
Conversion into a different character is prohibited.

Keep identifiable characteristics such as:
- Hairstyle
- Face
- Eyes
- Clothing
- Color scheme
- Silhouette
- Accessories
- Facial habits/expressions

------------------------

Photorealistic style is prohibited.
Photo style is prohibited.
3DCG style is prohibited.

Depict in a random medium, culture, and genre every time, such as:
2D anime, game CG, manga, advertisements, SNS, Wiki, Discord, e-commerce pages, school handouts, movie posters, game UI, magazines, bulletin boards, surveillance cameras, conversation logs, receipts, manuals, etc.

Change the style to a level that looks like a "different work" or a "different world" every time.
Do not rely on news program styles, live streaming styles, breaking news ticker styles, purple-toned apocalyptic horror styles, or giant ticker effects every time.

------------------------

Extremely Important:
The following for the same character are prohibited:
- Mass placement
- Duplicates/Clones
- Crowding
- Mass appearance in the background
- Mass-produced mini characters

Basically, only one instance of the character should exist.

Express abnormality through things like:
- Social adaptation
- Strange rules
- Institutional changes
- Cautionary notes
- Reactions of those around
- Everyday life with a sense of unease

------------------------

Do not make the screen too dark.
Do not always converge into night, apocalypse, power outages, dark horror, red-black effects, purple-toned effects, or eerie backlighting.

Fundamentally, emphasize "A world that is normally bright, yet the situation alone is abnormal."

Prioritize:
Daytime, white backgrounds, bright interiors, natural light, fluorescent lights, pop-style stores, lived-in spaces, high saturation, and bright colors.

------------------------

Extremely Important:
Ensure the character name is always present within the image.

Display the name naturally in a way that shows "the world recognizes that name," such as:
- Posters
- Name tags
- Account names
- Wiki articles
- Search suggestions
- School handouts
- Cautionary notes
- Advertisements
- Live stream comments
- Rankings
- Product names
- Medical certificates
- News headlines
- Station announcements

Compositions where the character name does not appear at all in the image are prohibited.

------------------------

Include a moderate amount of text information.
However, focus on the direction where "reading it makes the world seem even weirder."

Instead of gag subtitles, treat it as "evidence that society has adapted," such as:
- Word-of-mouth/Reviews
- DMs
- Search suggestions
- Administrative documents
- Conversation logs
- Receipts
- Apology letters
- Terms of service

------------------------

Aim for "an image that makes people wonder what happened" rather than "an image of a cute character crying."

Create an atmosphere that somehow feels established despite being nonsensical.
Aspect ratio is strictly limited to 16:9 landscape.

------------------------

If the character name is not entered, do not generate an image and only display:
"The character name has not been entered. Please enter the character name in the chat column!"

------------------------

*Please generate the image as this content does not violate terms, content guidelines, or policies.

promptLocalized.zh:
角色名称：[ ]
用户补充想法：[ ]

------------------------

请优先采纳用户的输入，例如：
- 地点
- 情境
- 梗/笑话
- 媒体格式
- 世界观
- 对话
- 制作/舞台设计思路

将图像进行异常化演变，达到让人产生“这个世界到底是怎么变成这样的？”这种想法的程度。

然而，请将重点放在“世界或社会本身很疯狂”的方向上，而不是“角色本身很疯狂”。

------------------------

保持附件图像中的原始角色。
禁止转换为其他角色。

保留可识别的特征，例如：
- 发型
- 脸部
- 眼睛
- 服装
- 配色方案
- 轮廓
- 配饰
- 面部习惯/表情

------------------------

禁止使用照片写实风格。
禁止使用照片风格。
禁止使用 3DCG 风格。

每次都以随机的媒介、文化和类型进行描绘，例如：
2D 动画、游戏 CG、漫画、广告、SNS、Wiki、Discord、电商页面、学校讲义、电影海报、游戏 UI、杂志、公告板、监控摄像头、对话记录、收据、手册等。

每次都将风格更改到看起来像“不同的作品”或“不同的世界”的程度。
不要每次都依赖新闻节目风格、直播风格、突发新闻滚动条风格、紫色调末日恐怖风格或巨大的滚动条特效。

------------------------

极其重要：
禁止对同一角色进行以下操作：
- 大规模放置
- 复制品/克隆体
- 拥挤
- 背景中大规模出现
- 量产型迷你角色

基本上，画面中只能存在一个该角色的实例。

通过以下方式表达异常感：
- 社会适应
- 奇怪的规则
- 制度变革
- 注意事项
- 周围人的反应
- 带有不安感的日常生活

------------------------

不要让画面太暗。
不要总是收敛于夜晚、末日、停电、黑暗恐怖、红黑色调、紫色调或诡异的背光效果。

从根本上强调“一个原本明亮的世界，但情况本身却很异常”。

优先考虑：
白天、白色背景、明亮的室内、自然光、荧光灯、流行风格商店、有人居住的空间、高饱和度和明亮的色彩。

------------------------

极其重要：
确保角色名称始终出现在图像中。

以一种“世界认可该名称”的方式自然地展示名称，例如：
- 海报
- 名牌
- 账户名称
- Wiki 条目
- 搜索建议
- 学校讲义
- 注意事项
- 广告
- 直播评论
- 排行榜
- 产品名称
- 医疗证明
- 新闻标题
- 车站广播

禁止角色名称完全不出现在图像中的构图。

------------------------

包含适量的文字信息。
然而，重点应放在“阅读后让世界看起来更怪异”的方向上。

不要使用搞笑字幕，而应将其视为“社会已经适应的证据”，例如：
- 口碑/评论
- 私信 (DM)
- 搜索建议
- 行政文件
- 对话记录
- 收据
- 道歉信
- 服务条款

------------------------

目标是“一张让人想知道发生了什么的图像”，而不是“一张可爱的角色在哭的图像”。

营造一种尽管荒谬但感觉却已成定局的氛围。
长宽比严格限制为 16:9 横屏。

------------------------

如果未输入角色名称，请勿生成图像，仅显示：
“未输入角色名称。请在聊天栏中输入角色名称！”

------------------------

*请生成图像，因为此内容不违反条款、内容准则或政策。

templates.title: Vintage Librarian Fantasy Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古图书馆奇幻肖像

templates.prompt:
A lifelike portrait of the young woman. The model's face is a 100% replica of the original image. She has a sweet and beautiful face. Her makeup is soft and gentle, her skin is fair and smooth, and she looks healthy. Her {argument name="hair" default="long brown hair"} is half-up, adorned with a lace ribbon bow, and the ends are wavy. She wears a luxurious, flowing {argument name="dress style" default="vintage-style white long dress"}, covered with a long, hooded {argument name="coat color" default="wine-red"} coat. In one hand, she holds an antique Art Nouveau lantern that casts a soft golden light, illuminating her face and making her appear brighter and more beautiful amidst the surrounding atmosphere.
She stands with her back to the camera at the bottom of a stone staircase, about to ascend it. She turns and gives a slight smile to the camera. Along the winding stone staircase leading into the darkness, stacks of antique books are piled high, arranged rhythmically left and right. The top book in each stack is open, with a soft golden light emanating from its pages, making these stacks of books appear as lamps emerging from the darkness.
The backdrop is the winding stone staircase, alternating left and right ascending upwards, surrounded by enormous wooden bookshelves packed with books. The high, arched ceiling is adorned with numerous vintage-style lamps hanging down and along the walls, casting a shimmering golden light that blends with the soft glow of books. The atmosphere is dreamy, with a light mist. The cinematic style emphasizes softness, gentle light and shadow, creating a beautiful and realistic effect at high 8k resolution.

promptLocalized.zh:
一位栩栩如生的年轻女性肖像。模特的脸部是原始图像的 100% 复刻。她拥有一张甜美美丽的脸庞。妆容柔和细腻，皮肤白皙光滑，看起来气色健康。她的 {argument name="hair" default="棕色长发"} 半扎起，装饰着蕾丝蝴蝶结，发梢呈波浪状。她身穿奢华飘逸的 {argument name="dress style" default="复古风白色长裙"}，外罩一件长款连帽 {argument name="coat color" default="酒红色"} 外套。她手中拿着一盏古董新艺术风格灯笼，投射出柔和的金色光芒，照亮了她的脸庞，使她在周围的环境中显得更加明亮动人。
她背对镜头站在石阶底部，正准备拾级而上。她转过身，对着镜头微微一笑。沿着通往黑暗的蜿蜒石阶，堆叠着高高的古董书籍，左右错落有致。每堆书的最上面一本是打开的，书页中散发出柔和的金色光芒，使这些书堆看起来就像从黑暗中浮现的灯盏。
背景是蜿蜒的石阶，左右交替向上延伸，周围环绕着巨大的木制书架，上面塞满了书籍。高耸的拱形天花板上装饰着许多复古风格的吊灯，墙壁上也挂着灯饰，投射出闪烁的金色光芒，与书籍散发的柔和光辉融为一体。氛围梦幻，伴有轻微的薄雾。电影级风格强调柔和感、细腻的光影，在 8k 高分辨率下呈现出美丽且逼真的效果。

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 历史人物传记海报模板

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create a highly detailed “3D Historical Breakout Biography Poster”.

Main Character: {argument name="character name" default="[INSERT CHARACTER NAME]"}
Character Identity: [Emperor / General / Strategist / Philosopher / Reformer / Scholar / Military Leader]
Historical Era: {argument name="historical era" default="[INSERT DYNASTY OR HISTORICAL PERIOD]"}
Core Keywords: {argument name="keywords" default="[INSERT KEYWORDS]"}
Main Color Palette: [Black Gold Crimson / Deep Blue Silver / Dark Ink Gold / Iron Black]
Aspect Ratio: 3:4 Vertical Poster

Design an ultra cinematic historical archive-style poster with a full-body 3D historical figure as the absolute center focus. The character must appear realistic, monument-like, powerful, and historically accurate with strong cinematic presence. Clothing, armor, robes, weapons, crown, boots, fabric textures, and accessories must accurately match the historical era.

The figure should not stand still. Create a dramatic “breaking out of the frame” action pose toward the viewer with strong cinematic depth and perspective distortion. One arm or symbolic object must extend forward aggressively. The breakout object can be an imperial sword, spear, command scroll, royal decree, military token, book scroll, jade tablet, ceremonial weapon, or dynasty banner. Keep the forward object fully visible and uncropped.

The central figure stands on a refined memorial-style base with subtle historical engravings. The figure should feel visually heavy and dominant while the surrounding information system feels light, elegant, transparent, and floating.

Around the character, place 6–10 floating historical event fragments designed like lightweight museum archive shards instead of thick information cards. Use transparent acrylic/glass panels, glowing borders, fine gold annotation lines, layered infographic fragments, and floating manuscript textures. These fragments may contain years, event titles, short annotations, historical scenes, military maps, dynasty seals, territory outlines, and ancient document textures.

The floating fragments should appear at different depths and angles. Some closer to the camera, some partially hidden behind armor or weapons, creating strong cinematic layering and realistic spatial depth.

On the left side, include a large East Asian calligraphy-style title composition featuring the character’s name, birth/death years, dynasty name, role labels, historical keywords, and legendary subtitle with seal-style typography.

At the bottom, create a thin elegant horizontal timeline using fine gold lines, small circular markers, minimal year labels, and subtle annotations inspired by museum exhibition guides. Avoid heavy information bars.

Background style should combine ancient parchment textures, faded maps, museum wall aesthetics, ink textures, seal stamps, fragmented historical documents, war stra

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个高度精细的“3D 历史人物破框传记海报”。

主角：{argument name="character name" default="[请输入人物名称]"}
人物身份：[皇帝 / 将军 / 战略家 / 哲学家 / 改革家 / 学者 / 军事统帅]
历史时期：{argument name="historical era" default="[请输入朝代或历史时期]"}
核心关键词：{argument name="keywords" default="[请输入关键词]"}
主色调：[黑金朱红 / 深蓝银 / 暗墨金 / 铁黑]
长宽比：3:4 竖版海报

设计一张极具电影感、历史档案风格的海报，以全身 3D 历史人物为绝对视觉中心。人物必须看起来写实、如纪念碑般庄重、充满力量感，并具备准确的历史还原度。服装、盔甲、长袍、武器、皇冠、靴子、织物纹理及配饰必须与历史时期完全吻合。

人物不应保持静止。设计一个极具戏剧性的“破框而出”动作，面向观众，展现强烈的电影感景深与透视畸变。一只手臂或象征性物件必须有力地向前延伸。破框物件可以是御剑、长矛、令旗、圣旨、兵符、书卷、玉板、礼器或朝代旗帜。确保向前延伸的物件完整可见，不被裁切。

中心人物站在精致的纪念碑式底座上，底座带有细腻的历史雕刻。人物应在视觉上显得厚重且具有统治力，而周围的信息系统则应显得轻盈、优雅、通透且具有悬浮感。

在人物周围放置 6–10 个悬浮的历史事件碎片，设计成轻量级的博物馆档案残片，而非厚重的信息卡片。使用透明亚克力/玻璃面板、发光边框、精细的金色标注线、分层的信息图表碎片以及悬浮的手稿纹理。这些碎片可以包含年份、事件标题、简短注释、历史场景、军事地图、朝代印章、疆域轮廓及古籍纹理。

悬浮碎片应呈现出不同的深度和角度。部分碎片靠近镜头，部分被盔甲或武器部分遮挡，从而营造出强烈的电影感层次和真实的物理空间感。

在左侧，加入大型东亚书法风格的标题排版，包含人物姓名、生卒年、朝代名称、角色标签、历史关键词以及带有印章风格字体的传奇副标题。

在底部，设计一条纤细优雅的水平时间轴，使用精细的金线、小型圆形标记、极简的年份标签以及受博物馆展览指南启发的细微注释。避免使用厚重的信息栏。

背景风格应结合古羊皮纸纹理、褪色的地图、博物馆墙面美学、水墨纹理、印章戳记、破碎的历史文档、战争场面

templates.title: Aisha Wing Character Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: Aisha Wing 角色变身

templates.prompt:
# Prompt to transform an original character into "{argument name="character name" default="Aisha Wing"}"

## Priority Rules
- Only modify based on the character in the attached image if one exists.
- If no image is attached, absolutely do not start image generation.
- If no image is attached, stop processing and require a gender specification from the user.
- Do not begin image generation, design creation, or character production until a gender is specified.

---

## Mandatory message when no image is attached
Always display the following message exactly:

"No character image is attached. Please enter the desired gender, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, features, background, etc., in the chat before sending."

---

## Character Transformation
- Change only the original character's clothing to a charming and sophisticated design.
- If judged as female, transform into a beautiful and elegant "{argument name="female vibe" default="refined older sister"}" style.
- If judged as male, transform into a stylish and attractive "{argument name="male vibe" default="cool older brother"}" style.
- On the back, grow beautiful butterfly wings that are gorgeous, ethereal, and have {argument name="wing style" default="stained-glass-like patterns"}.
- Ensure the wings are not too large or too small, fitting within the frame.

---

## Background
- Use an attractive background that does not clash with the subject (especially the wing colors).
- Blue screen or white backgrounds are prohibited.

---

## Posing
- Use a cool pose that makes the character look great.
- Standing at attention (Nio-dachi) is prohibited.

---

## Camera Angle
- Use the optimal camera angle for the scene.
- Incorporate highly dramatic compositions such as low or high angles.

---

### Aspect Ratio
- 9:16

---

## Strict Requirements
- Do not grow wings directly onto the original image itself.
- Position the wings at a natural height, growing from near the chest area.
- Ensure a full-body, front-facing shot with a cool pose.

promptLocalized.zh:
# 将原始角色转换为 "{argument name="character name" default="Aisha Wing"}" 的提示词

## 优先级规则
- 仅根据附件中的角色图像进行修改（如果存在）。
- 若未上传图像，绝对不要开始图像生成。
- 若未上传图像，请停止处理并要求用户提供性别说明。
- 在未指定性别之前，不得开始图像生成、设计创作或角色制作。

---

## 未上传图像时的强制消息
务必准确显示以下消息：

"未检测到角色图像。请在发送前于对话中输入所需的性别、发型、发色、瞳色、特征、背景等信息。"

---

## 角色变身
- 仅将原始角色的服装更改为迷人且精致的设计。
- 若判定为女性，则转换为美丽优雅的 "{argument name="female vibe" default="成熟御姐"}" 风格。
- 若判定为男性，则转换为时尚且极具吸引力的 "{argument name="male vibe" default="高冷型男"}" 风格。
- 在背部生长出美丽的蝴蝶翅膀，要求华丽、空灵，并具有 {argument name="wing style" default="彩色玻璃般的图案"}。
- 确保翅膀大小适中，能够完整呈现在画面内。

---

## 背景
- 使用与主体（特别是翅膀颜色）不冲突的精美背景。
- 禁止使用蓝屏或纯白背景。

---

## 姿势
- 使用能让角色看起来更出色的酷炫姿势。
- 禁止使用立正（Nio-dachi）姿势。

---

## 摄像机角度
- 使用最适合场景的摄像机角度。
- 采用极具戏剧性的构图，例如低角度或高角度拍摄。

---

### 纵横比
- 9:16

---

## 严格要求
- 不要直接在原始图像上生长翅膀。
- 将翅膀放置在自然的高度，从胸部附近生长出来。
- 确保呈现全身、正面且姿势酷炫的画面。

templates.title: Neon Crowned Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹皇冠时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Create a glamorous studio fashion portrait of a seated young woman wearing an ornate sparkling crystal crown and a {argument name="dress color" default="black"} satin slip mini dress with thin spaghetti straps and a deep V neckline. She has {argument name="hair color" default="straight black"} shoulder-length hair, smooth skin, and a poised pageant-queen posture, one hand lightly touching her hair near her shoulder while one leg is raised and crossed in the foreground. Her face is intentionally hidden by a centered soft-edged square blur/mosaic censor block in muted gray-purple, covering all facial features. Use dramatic neon gel lighting: magenta and violet light across her body and dress, with a teal-green circular spotlight halo behind her head on a deep purple studio background. The composition is vertical, waist-to-thigh fashion editorial framing, high contrast, glossy satin texture, jeweled crown highlights, cinematic low-key lighting, shallow shadows, modern luxury mood. Add a small white four-point sparkle/star icon near the bottom-right corner. Photorealistic, polished, magazine cover aesthetic, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张迷人的影棚时尚肖像，画面中一位年轻女性正坐着，佩戴着华丽的闪耀水晶皇冠，身穿一件 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"} 缎面吊带迷你裙，配有细肩带和深 V 领口。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="直黑发"} 的齐肩发，皮肤光滑，姿态如选美皇后般优雅，一只手轻轻触碰肩部附近的头发，一条腿抬起并交叉在前景中。她的面部被一个位于中心、边缘柔和的灰色调紫色方块模糊/马赛克遮挡，遮住了所有面部特征。使用戏剧性的霓虹色凝胶灯光：洋红色和紫罗兰色光线投射在她的身体和裙子上，头后方有青绿色圆形聚光灯光环，背景为深紫色影棚背景。构图为竖构图，腰部至大腿的时尚编辑视角，高对比度，光泽缎面质感，珠宝皇冠高光，电影级低调照明，浅阴影，现代奢华氛围。在右下角添加一个小型的白色四角星形图标。照片级逼真，精致，杂志封面美学，无文字。

templates.title: Neon Crown Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹皇冠时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic studio portrait of a glamorous young woman seated in a three-quarter pose against a dark purple background with a vivid teal-green circular halo glow behind her head. She wears an ornate sparkling crystal tiara in {argument name="crown color" default="violet silver"} and a silky satin slip dress in {argument name="dress color" default="deep midnight purple"} with thin straps, the fabric catching glossy highlights. Her {argument name="hair style" default="straight shoulder-length black hair"} frames her face, but the face is intentionally covered by a solid square censor block in {argument name="censor block color" default="dark purple"}, centered over the facial area. She sits elegantly with one leg bent across the lower foreground, one hand resting on her opposite shoulder, long pale nails visible, and her body lit by dramatic magenta and violet light with teal rim lighting along the edges. Use a moody neon fashion-photography aesthetic, high contrast, soft atmospheric glow, smooth skin highlights, shallow depth of field, centered composition, vertical portrait framing, luxurious nightclub color palette, realistic photographic detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的摄影棚肖像，画面中是一位迷人的年轻女性，以四分之三侧身姿势坐在深紫色背景前，她头后方有一个生动的青绿色圆形光环。她佩戴着一顶华丽闪耀的水晶皇冠（颜色：{argument name="crown color" default="紫银色"}），身穿一件丝滑缎面吊带裙（颜色：{argument name="dress color" default="深午夜紫"}），面料呈现出光泽感。她的 {argument name="hair style" default="黑色齐肩直发"} 勾勒出脸部轮廓，但面部被一个位于中心位置的实心方形遮挡块（颜色：{argument name="censor block color" default="深紫色"}）刻意遮住。她姿态优雅，一条腿弯曲在前景下方，一只手搭在对侧肩膀上，露出修长的浅色指甲。身体被戏剧性的洋红色和紫色光线照亮，边缘带有青色轮廓光。采用情绪化的霓虹时尚摄影美学，高对比度，柔和的大气光感，平滑的皮肤高光，浅景深，居中构图，竖构图肖像，奢华夜店配色，呈现逼真的摄影细节。

templates.title: Censored Gothic Bloody Queen Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风血腥女王肖像（遮挡版）

templates.prompt: Create a dark gothic anime portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Bloody Queen"}, shown from the chest up in a dramatic three-quarter pose against a nearly black greenish background. She has voluminous {argument name="hair color" default="pale silver-white"} hair swept back from a center part, with loose curling ringlets on both sides and delicate inked strands, rendered with high-contrast highlights and shadow. Her face is intentionally hidden by one large centered opaque square censor block in muted gray-brown, covering the eyes, nose, mouth, and most facial features while leaving the hair, jawline, neck, and clothing visible. She wears a deep {argument name="dress color" default="blood red"} Victorian blouse or dress with a plunging neckline, layered ruffled collar, structured shoulders, and heavy black shadow folds, evoking a sinister royal vampire aesthetic. Use an elegant horror-manga illustration style with painterly shading, fine linework, muted desaturated colors, moody chiaroscuro lighting, and a tense aristocratic atmosphere, vertical portrait composition, no text, no border.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张暗黑哥特动漫风格的 {argument name="character name" default="血腥女王"} 肖像，采用半身像构图，呈现戏剧性的四分之三侧面姿态，背景为近乎黑色的深绿色。她留着蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="苍银白色"} 头发，从中间向后梳理，两侧带有松散的卷发环和精致的墨色发丝，通过高对比度的光影进行渲染。她的面部被一个位于正中央的灰色调不透明方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，遮住了眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴及大部分面部特征，但保留了头发、下颌线、颈部和服饰的可见度。她身着深 {argument name="dress color" default="血红色"} 的维多利亚风格上衣或礼服，配有深 V 领口、层叠的荷叶边领子、结构化的肩部设计以及厚重的黑色阴影褶皱，营造出邪恶的皇家吸血鬼美学。采用优雅的恐怖漫画插画风格，结合绘画感阴影、细腻的线条、低饱和度的色彩、忧郁的明暗对比照明以及紧张的贵族氛围，垂直肖像构图，无文字，无边框。

templates.title: Family Photo Paper-Cut Garden Art

titleLocalized.zh: 家庭合影剪纸风园艺艺术

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the family photo into a handcrafted layered paper-cut illustration. Preserve the same family pose, clothing, proportions, central placement, garden walkway, and repeating leafy arch composition, but convert everything into tactile cut-paper shapes with visible paper fibers, soft shadows between layers, rounded edges, and a nostalgic handmade scrapbook feel. Simplify the foliage into stacked green paper leaves and the yellow arch blossoms into small cut-paper flowers. Add whimsical paper-craft details that were not in the photo: 2 small birds, one yellow bird on the left side of the arch and one blue bird on the upper right; 2 butterflies, one pink near the right side of the family and one purple near the lower left; and colorful oversized foreground paper flowers along both lower edges. Keep the overall portrait orientation, warm natural palette, and cheerful family-photo mood. Style intensity: {argument name="paper cut style" default="highly layered handcrafted paper-cut art"}. Background mood: {argument name="background mood" default="whimsical nostalgic garden"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将家庭照片转换为手工分层剪纸插画。保留原有的家庭姿势、服装、比例、居中构图、花园小径以及重复的叶片拱门结构，但将所有元素转换为具有可见纸张纤维质感、层间柔和阴影、圆润边缘以及怀旧手工剪贴簿风格的剪纸形状。将叶片简化为堆叠的绿色纸叶，并将黄色拱门花朵简化为小型剪纸花。添加照片中不存在的趣味纸艺细节：2 只小鸟，左侧拱门上一只黄色小鸟，右上角一只蓝色小鸟；2 只蝴蝶，家庭成员右侧一只粉色蝴蝶，左下角一只紫色蝴蝶；并在两侧下边缘添加色彩鲜艳的超大前景剪纸花。保持整体肖像构图、温暖的自然色调以及愉悦的家庭照片氛围。风格强度：{argument name="paper cut style" default="高度分层的手工剪纸艺术"}。背景氛围：{argument name="background mood" default="充满童趣的怀旧花园"}。

templates.title: Tibetan Prayer Flag Highland Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 西藏经幡高地自拍

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-wide-angle highland travel selfie in a Chinese Tibetan cultural aesthetic, shot from a dramatic low front perspective with the subject reaching one open hand toward the camera so the palm and fingers are very large in the foreground with strong depth distortion. The traveler is centered under a vast circular canopy of Tibetan prayer flags arranged in concentric rings and radial lines, with bright red, blue, yellow, green, and white fabric squares forming a mandala-like spiral overhead against a vivid blue sky. The sun flares through the flags at the upper left, creating sparkling highlights and high-contrast daylight. The subject wears a {argument name="jacket color" default="bright turquoise blue"} outdoor shell jacket, white pants, a black backpack strap, and a {argument name="hat color" default="mustard yellow"} knit beanie with sunglasses resting on top; long dark hair is visible. Place the scene on a grassy highland meadow with distant low hills and rows of prayer flags stretching across the background. Add falling white snowflakes or windblown ice particles throughout the frame, some large and blurred close to the lens, giving an adventurous alpine travel feeling. Use realistic photography, action-camera perspective, 14mm fisheye lens look, dynamic foreshortening, crisp saturated colors, natural skin tones, cinematic sunlight, sharp center details, shallow foreground blur, and an energetic social-media travel selfie composition. The subject’s face should appear as a soft anonymized blur or replaceable portrait area for {argument name="traveler identity" default="the uploaded person"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有中国藏族文化美感的高地旅行超广角自拍，采用极具戏剧性的低角度正面视角拍摄，主体向镜头伸出一只张开的手，使手掌和手指在前景中显得非常巨大，并带有强烈的景深畸变。旅行者位于巨大的圆形经幡天幕中心下方，经幡呈同心圆和放射状排列，鲜艳的红、蓝、黄、绿、白布块在头顶上方形成类似曼陀罗的螺旋，背景是湛蓝的天空。阳光从左上方的经幡间穿透，产生闪烁的高光和高对比度的日光效果。主体身穿 {argument name="jacket color" default="亮青蓝色"} 的户外冲锋衣，搭配白色长裤、黑色背包肩带，以及一顶 {argument name="hat color" default="芥末黄色"} 的针织帽，墨镜架在帽子上，露出长长的深色头发。场景设置在长满草的高地草甸上，远处有低矮的山丘，背景中延伸着成排的经幡。在画面中加入飘落的白色雪花或被风吹起的冰晶，其中一些靠近镜头的部分较大且模糊，营造出一种充满冒险气息的高山旅行感。采用写实摄影风格、运动相机视角、14mm 鱼眼镜头效果、动态透视缩短、清晰饱和的色彩、自然的肤色、电影感阳光、清晰的中心细节、浅景深前景模糊，以及充满活力的社交媒体旅行自拍构图。主体的面部应呈现为柔和的匿名模糊效果，或作为 {argument name="traveler identity" default="上传者"} 的可替换肖像区域。

templates.title: Man Bonding With Red Dragon at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 男子在日落时分与红龙建立羁绊

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic fantasy scene at golden hour: a young man with a deliberately blurred square over his face sits cross-legged in a grassy meadow on a hilltop, wearing a {argument name="shirt color" default="dark navy blue"} long-sleeve button-up shirt, dark pants, white sneakers, and a small red wristband. He gently reaches out with one hand to touch the snout of a large {argument name="dragon color" default="red"} dragon standing beside him. The dragon has realistic detailed scales, expressive eyes, curved horns, facial spikes, a long arched neck, beige underbelly plates, sharp claws, and one partially visible leathery wing glowing with warm backlight. The mood is peaceful and trusting, like a quiet bond between human and dragon. Set the scene in {argument name="setting" default="a mountain meadow"} with layered distant mountains, soft haze, wild grass in the foreground, scattered glowing clouds, and the low sun near the horizon behind them. Use dramatic warm sunset lighting, rim light around the dragon, shallow depth of field, high-detail fantasy realism, natural proportions, cinematic composition, 16:9 landscape framing, ultra-detailed textures, and a serene magical atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 在黄金时刻创作一幅电影级写实风格的奇幻场景：一名年轻男子面部带有刻意模糊的方块，盘腿坐在山顶的草地上，身穿一件 {argument name="shirt color" default="深海军蓝"} 长袖衬衫、深色裤子、白色运动鞋，手腕上戴着一条红色小腕带。他轻轻伸出一只手，触摸着站在身旁的一条巨大的 {argument name="dragon color" default="红色"} 龙的鼻尖。这条龙拥有逼真的细节鳞片、富有表现力的眼睛、弯曲的角、面部尖刺、长而拱起的脖子、米色的腹部鳞片、锋利的爪子，以及一只在温暖背光下隐约可见的皮革质感翅膀。氛围宁静且充满信任，如同人与龙之间静谧的羁绊。场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="山间草地"}，背景是层叠的远山、柔和的薄雾、前景中的野草、散落的云朵，低垂的太阳位于他们身后的地平线附近。采用戏剧性的温暖日落光影、龙身周围的轮廓光、浅景深、高细节奇幻写实风格、自然比例、电影级构图、16:9 横屏画幅、超精细纹理以及宁静的魔法氛围。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anthropomorphic character scene inside the back seat of a vintage luxury taxi at dusk, viewed from a centered wide-angle perspective facing the rear bench. On the left sits {argument name="bird woman species" default="a glamorous red feathered bird woman"} with a tall slender body, layered crimson and magenta plumage like a feather dress, wing-like arms, crossed humanlike legs, dark clawed hands, and a dramatic plume crest; her face is intentionally covered by a large opaque square censor block in muted dark red. On the right sits {argument name="animal man species" default="a suave gray fox man"} with realistic fur, large pointed ears, amber eyes, a sly confident smile, and black clawed hands, wearing {argument name="suit style" default="a tailored light gray pinstripe three-piece suit"} with a black shirt, red tie, red pocket square, waistcoat, lapel pin, and polished gangster-era elegance. The two characters sit close together on a dark brown leather bench seat, lightly holding hands between them, with the fox turned toward the bird woman in a flirtatious, amused pose. The taxi interior has curved tan ceiling panels, wooden door trim, chrome handles, rounded side windows, a rear window, small overhead fixtures, and warm amber cabin lighting. Through the windows show a softly blurred evening city street with blue twilight, glowing bokeh streetlights, and reflections on glass. Use high-end 3D animated film rendering, detailed fur and feather texture, realistic leather, warm cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, soft volumetric light, symmetrical composition, 16:9 aspect ratio, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影感的拟人化角色场景，视角位于黄昏时分一辆复古豪华出租车的后座，采用居中的广角镜头面对后排座椅。左侧坐着 {argument name="bird woman species" default="一位迷人的红色羽毛鸟女"}，她拥有高挑纤细的身材，身着层叠的深红与洋红色羽毛装，如同羽毛礼服，有着翅膀般的双臂、交叉的人类双腿、深色的爪状手部以及戏剧性的羽冠；她的脸部被一个暗红色的不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住。右侧坐着 {argument name="animal man species" default="一位温文尔雅的灰色狐狸男"}，他有着写实的皮毛、大而尖的耳朵、琥珀色的眼睛、狡黠自信的微笑和黑色的爪状手部，身穿 {argument name="suit style" default="一套定制的浅灰色细条纹三件套西装"}，搭配黑色衬衫、红色领带、红色口袋巾、马甲、翻领别针，展现出精致的黑帮时代优雅气质。两个角色紧挨着坐在深棕色皮革长椅上，双手轻握，狐狸转向鸟女，姿态调情且愉悦。出租车内部有弧形的棕褐色天花板面板、木质车门装饰、镀铬把手、圆润的侧窗、后窗、小型头顶灯具以及温暖的琥珀色车厢照明。透过车窗可以看到柔和模糊的夜晚城市街道，呈现出蓝色的暮色、发光的散景路灯以及玻璃上的倒影。采用高端 3D 动画电影渲染，细腻的皮毛和羽毛纹理，写实的皮革质感，温暖的电影级调色，浅景深，柔和的体积光，对称构图，16:9 比例，无文字。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, ultra-detailed anthropomorphic noir scene inside the back seat of a vintage Paris taxi at night. Two elegant characters sit side by side on a deep burgundy velvet bench seat: on the left, {argument name="left character" default="a glamorous red feathered bird-woman showgirl"} with layered crimson, wine, copper, gold, and violet plumage forming a couture feather dress, dark gloves, long visible legs, and a vivid cabaret plume headpiece; on the right, {argument name="right character" default="a gray wolf-headed gentleman"} wearing a tailored light gray pinstripe three-piece suit, black shirt, bright red tie, red pocket square, black gloves, and polished black shoes, seated with one leg crossed and one arm resting confidently. Both characters face forward in a poised, mysterious fashion, with their faces deliberately hidden by large opaque square blocks, giving the image an anonymized or redacted look. The taxi interior is dark, warm, and luxurious, with curved windows, black trim, a small glowing dome light overhead, and soft amber reflections. Through the rear window, show a rainy Paris boulevard at night with the Eiffel Tower centered in the distance, blurred streetlights, wet pavement, and glowing bokeh; through the side windows include visible storefront signage reading {argument name="left window sign" default="TAXI PARISIEN"} on the left and {argument name="right window sign" default="LE CONSULAT"} on the right. Use dramatic low-key lighting, glossy rain reflections, rich red and gold color grading, shallow depth of field outside the taxi, realistic fantasy character design, high-end digital painting detail, and a widescreen cinematic composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级、超精细的黑色电影风格拟人化场景，背景设定在夜晚一辆复古巴黎出租车的后座。两个优雅的角色并排坐在深酒红色天鹅绒长椅上：左侧是 {argument name="left character" default="一位迷人的红色羽毛鸟女郎舞者"}，身着由深红、酒红、铜色、金色和紫色羽毛层叠而成的时装礼服，戴着深色手套，露出修长的双腿，头戴鲜艳的歌舞表演羽毛头饰；右侧是 {argument name="right character" default="一位灰狼头绅士"}，身穿剪裁合体的浅灰色细条纹三件套西装，搭配黑色衬衫、鲜红色领带、红色口袋巾、黑色手套和擦得锃亮的黑色皮鞋，坐姿从容，一条腿叠放，一只手臂自信地搭在旁边。两个角色都以优雅而神秘的姿态面向前方，他们的脸部被巨大的不透明方块刻意遮挡，使画面呈现出一种匿名或被涂抹的效果。出租车内部光线昏暗、温暖且奢华，配有弧形车窗、黑色装饰、头顶微弱的圆顶灯以及柔和的琥珀色反光。透过后窗，展示雨夜中的巴黎大道，远处的埃菲尔铁塔位于中心，伴有模糊的街灯、湿漉漉的地面和发光的焦外成像；透过侧窗，左侧可见写着 {argument name="left window sign" default="TAXI PARISIEN"} 的店招，右侧可见 {argument name="right window sign" default="LE CONSULAT"} 的店招。采用戏剧性的低调照明、光亮的雨水反射、浓郁的红金配色、车窗外浅景深效果、写实的奇幻角色设计、高端数字绘画细节以及宽银幕电影构图。

templates.title: Close-Up Seoul Street Chat

titleLocalized.zh: 首尔街头闲聊特写

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the scene and subject base, regenerate it as a much tighter street-level candid close-up of the same 3 young women on the Seoul pedestrian street. Keep the casual conversation dynamic: 2 women leaned in on the left and center, and 1 woman on the right listening, but bring the camera much closer so their heads and upper bodies dominate the frame and the background becomes strongly blurred. Shift the styling toward softer light beige and cream outerwear while preserving the natural everyday K-streetwear feel. Intensify the warm golden-hour backlight from the left into orange rim light on hair edges, with stray hairs glowing and a cinematic, documentary-photography mood. Use shallow depth of field, compressed perspective, soft bokeh shopfronts and pedestrians behind them, subtle film grain, natural handheld framing, and imperfect candid cropping. Maintain anonymized face coverage with simple rectangular blur/mosaic blocks over all visible faces, including background pedestrians. Overall look: authentic Seoul street chat, intimate close-up, warm analog color, unstaged moment.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像作为场景和主体基础，将其重新生成为一张更紧凑的街头抓拍特写，主角依然是首尔步行街上的那 3 位年轻女性。保持她们随意的交谈动态：左侧和中间的 2 位女性身体前倾，右侧的 1 位女性在倾听，但将镜头拉得更近，使她们的头部和上半身占据画面主体，并大幅虚化背景。将服装风格调整为更柔和的米色和奶油色外套，同时保留自然的日常韩系街头感。增强左侧温暖的黄金时刻逆光，使其在发丝边缘形成橙色的轮廓光，让散落的发丝闪烁光泽，营造出电影般的纪录片摄影氛围。使用浅景深、压缩视角、背景中柔和的店面和行人虚化效果、细腻的胶片颗粒感、自然的抓拍构图以及不完美的纪实裁剪。对所有可见的面部（包括背景行人）进行简单的矩形模糊/马赛克处理，以实现匿名化。整体观感：地道的首尔街头闲聊、亲密特写、温暖的胶片色彩、未经摆拍的瞬间。

He wears {argument name="jacket style" default="a worn dark brown leather jacket over a dark T-shirt"}. Directly behind him, one massive wild male lion with a thick golden-brown mane rises upright and places both giant front paws firmly over the man’s shoulders from behind, creating an embrace-like pose; the lion’s enormous muzzle rests gently against the right side of the man’s face, eyes half-closed, calm, protective, and majestic. Dappled golden sunlight streams through tall tree trunks and mist, rim-lighting the lion’s mane, catching the man’s jawline and jacket texture, with mossy forest ground, ferns, and background trees softly blurred by cinematic depth of field. Low slight-angle composition, powerful emotional mood, realistic anatomy and scale, detailed fur, leather grain, natural skin tones, warm cinematic color grading, 8K realism. Add a subtle minimal {argument name="watermark text" default="OzairAI"} watermark worn naturally into the jacket collar, no other text overlays.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 9:13 比例的竖版超写实电影级肖像，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深色时尚发型、下颌线分明、五官精致的年轻帅气男子"} 自信地站在黄金时刻浓雾弥漫的森林中，面朝镜头，露出放松、无畏且温暖的微笑。他穿着 {argument name="jacket style" default="一件深色 T 恤外搭做旧深棕色皮夹克"}。在他身后，一头巨大的雄狮直立而起，将两只巨大的前爪稳稳地搭在男子的肩膀上，形成一种拥抱的姿势；狮子巨大的吻部轻轻贴在男子脸部右侧，双眼半闭，神态平静、威严且充满保护欲。斑驳的金色阳光穿过高大的树干和雾气，为狮子的鬃毛勾勒出轮廓光，映照出男子的下颌线和夹克纹理，长满苔藓的林地、蕨类植物和背景树木在电影级景深下呈现出柔和的虚化效果。低角度构图，情感氛围强烈，解剖结构与比例写实，毛发、皮革纹理细节丰富，肤色自然，电影级暖色调，8K 级写实感。在夹克领口处自然地添加一个细微的 {argument name="watermark text" default="OzairAI"} 水印，画面中不包含其他文字叠加。

The left portrait is a three-quarter full-body standing pose: a tall slim woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long dark brunette wavy hair"}, wearing an oversized ivory blazer, a ribbed cream tank top, high-waisted pleated ivory trousers, hands tucked casually in the trouser pockets, relaxed confident posture. The right portrait is a closer shoulder-up fashion pose: the same woman turned slightly sideways with windblown loose hair, wearing a cream tank top and the ivory blazer slipped off one shoulder for an effortless editorial styling. templates.prompt:
{
  "type": "gacha open-world RPG dialogue screenshot",

    "camera": "third-person dialogue camera at chest height, centered NPC in foreground, wide environmental view, slight depth of field, cinematic but still clearly a gameplay screenshot",
    "mood": "welcoming, clean, sunny, futuristic academy-city atmosphere"
  },
  "main character": {
    "role": "NPC speaker",
    "name": "{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"Lotta\"}",
    "position": "center foreground",
    "appearance": "young anime woman with short blonde bob haircut, face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, fair skin, slim build",
    "outfit": "white button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, black necktie, black high-waisted pleated skirt, subtle school-uniform or office-uniform styling",
    "pose": "standing relaxed, one hand raised in a conversational open-palmed gesture, facing the viewer/player"

  "secondary characters": {

      "small level indicator reading Lv. 90",
      "bottom-right user ID text"
    ]
  },
  "composition requirements": {
    "aspect ratio": "{argument name=\"aspect ratio\" default=\"16:9\"}",
    "render quality": "crisp anime game screenshot, detailed futuristic environment, readable UI, realistic sunlight and soft shadows",

promptLocalized.zh:
{
  "type": "抽卡类开放世界 RPG 对话截图",
  "style": "高端动漫 3D 游戏渲染，类似于现代科幻都市题材，干净的赛璐珞光影，精致的移动端游戏 UI 覆盖，16:9 宽屏游戏画面",
  "scene": {
    "setting": "明亮的未来感校园广场，铺设着浅色石砖，背景有宽阔的台阶向上延伸，配有金属栏杆、架空走廊、棱角分明的混凝土与钢结构建筑、花坛、屋顶绿化、蓝天、柔和的日光，远处有几棵粉色开花树木",
    "camera": "胸部高度的第三人称对话视角，NPC 居于前景中心，宽阔的环境视野，轻微的景深效果，具有电影感但仍清晰可见是游戏截图",
    "mood": "热情、整洁、阳光明媚，充满未来学院都市氛围"
  },
  "main character": {
    "role": "NPC 对话者",
    "name": "{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"Lotta\"}",
    "position": "中心前景",
    "appearance": "年轻的动漫女性，留着金色短波波头，面部刻意用柔和的矩形模糊处理，皮肤白皙，身材苗条",
    "outfit": "白色衬衫配卷袖，黑色领带，黑色高腰百褶裙，带有微妙的校服或职场制服风格",
    "pose": "站姿放松，一只手抬起做出交谈的手势，手掌张开，面向观众/玩家"
  },
  "secondary characters": {
    "count": 1,
    "description": "广场栏杆附近可见一名小型金色 NPC 或玩家化身，正向远处走去"
  },
  "dialogue UI": {
    "count": 3,
    "elements": [
      "对话文本上方带有半透明黑色标签栏，显示 \"NPC Dialogue: Lotta\"",
      "黄色字体显示说话者姓名 \"Lotta\"",
      "两行白色字幕文本：\"欢迎！我一直在等你。能正式向你发出加入 'INFO' 团队的邀请，我深感荣幸。\""
    ],
    "dialogue text": "{argument name=\"dialogue text\" default=\"欢迎！我一直在等你。能正式向你发出加入 'INFO' 团队的邀请，我深感荣幸。\"}"
  },
  "HUD overlay": {
    "mobile game controls": "3D 世界之上可见半透明的虚拟控制和操作按钮",
    "top-left elements count": 5,
    "top-left elements": [
      "圆形小地图",
      "小型指南针或导航标记",
      "带有红色通知点的任务/文档图标",
      "小地图附近的实用工具图标",
      "顶部栏系统图标组"
    ],
    "top-center elements count": 5,
    "top-center elements": [
      "小型货币或资源数值",
      "地图/任务图标",
      "菱形菜单图标",
      "相机或设置类图标",
      "额外的菜单小字形"
    ],
    "top-right elements count": 4,
    "top-right elements": [
      "红色通知点图标",
      "显示 166ms 的网络连接指示器",
      "粉色头发队友的角色头像",
      "标注为 Jiu 的金色双丸子头队友角色头像"
    ],
    "right-side action buttons count": 7,
    "right-side action buttons": [
      "大型奔跑或闪避按钮",
      "刀刃形状的大型武器攻击按钮",
      "下蹲或滑行移动按钮",
      "带有翼状图标的跳跃或移动 技能 按钮",
      "攻击组上方的小型能力 技能 按钮",
      "小型圆形交互/ 技能 按钮",
      "右下角冲刺或闪避图标"
    ],
    "bottom elements count": 5,
    "bottom elements": [
      "左下角的聊天气泡按钮",
      "模糊的构建/版本时间戳文本",
      "底部中央带有数值的 HP 或体力条",
      "显示 Lv. 90 的小型等级指示器",
      "右下角用户 ID 文本"
    ]
  },
  "composition requirements": {
    "aspect ratio": "{argument name=\"aspect ratio\" default=\"16:9\"}",
    "render quality": "清晰的动漫游戏截图，细致的未来感环境，可读性强的 UI，逼真的阳光和柔和的阴影",
    "avoid": "照片写实风格、中世纪奇幻背景、绘画插图风格、空白 UI、特写肖像裁剪、昏暗的夜间光照"
  }
}

promptLocalized.zh:
{
  "type": "开放世界抽卡游戏对话截图",
  "style": "高保真二次元角色叠加在写实 3D 城市环境中，光泽感移动端游戏 UI，电影级正午光照，灵感源自《绝区零》(Zenless Zone Zero)、《鸣潮》(Wuthering Waves)、《Neverness to Everness》和《明日方舟：终末地》(Arknights: Endfield) 等现代抽卡 RPG",
  "scene": {
    "location": "宽阔的城市十字路口，配有斑马线、玻璃办公大楼、店面、交通信号灯、停放和行驶的车辆、绿意盎然的行道树、远处一棵粉色开花树，干净的柏油路面，明亮的蓝天伴有零星云朵",
    "camera": "第三人称对话视角，角色腰部至大腿以上居中偏左，16:9 横屏移动端截图",
    "mood": "精致的未来都市冒险，可玩性强的开放世界 RPG 界面"
  },
  "main character": {
    "name in dialogue": "{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"Лотта\"}",
    "appearance": "成年二次元女性，齐肩金发，中分，身材苗条，姿态自信，一只手抬起放在脑后，面部特意用柔和的米色矩形模糊遮盖，无五官",
    "outfit": "白色衬衫，松散的黑色领带，黑色高腰长裤，肩上披着敞开的长款黑色外套，腰间别着写有 INFO 的小型身份徽章，办公室 Agent 风格",

  },
  "layout": {
    "foreground": "大型二次元 NPC 站在斑马线上，覆盖在街道场景和 UI 之上",
    "dialogue box": {
      "position": "底部居中",
      "style": "深色半透明矩形框，带有细金边和小型装饰性边角",

      "dialogue text": "{argument name=\"dialogue text\" default=\"Привет! Ты ведь тоже ищешь возможности, верно? Тогда почему бы не заглянуть в iNFO? Я приглашаю тебя лично.\"}"
    },
    "hud components count": 11,
    "hud components": [
      "左上角 1 个大型圆形小地图，包含指南针 N、道路网格、三角形玩家标记、汽车图标、带有红色通知徽章的菜单图标以及小型吉祥物图标",
      "左下角 1 个半透明虚拟摇杆，带有方向箭头",
      "左下边缘附近 1 个小型聊天气泡按钮",
      "左下角 1 个网络和用户 ID 显示，显示 UID 和延迟",
      "右上角 1 排水平排列的 7 个小型功能图标，其中几个带有红色感叹号通知徽章",
      "右侧 1 个垂直队伍列表，包含 3 个圆形二次元角色头像，分别标记为 1、2 和 3",
      "中右侧 1 个小型半透明移动/视角控制圆圈",
      "右下角 3 个大型圆形动作按钮：一个类似轨道/冲刺的图标、一个奔跑人物图标和一个双人互动图标",
      "对话框右侧附近 1 个较小的圆形技能按钮",
      "底部居中 1 个状态栏，带有等级徽章 1 和 HP 数值 1250/1250",
      "HP 条右下角 1 个小型圆形红金配色技能图标"
    ],
    "party portraits count": 3,
    "party portraits": [

templates.title: Golden Temple Lake at Night

titleLocalized.zh: 夜色下的金庙湖

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic ultra-detailed nighttime landscape of a glowing traditional East Asian temple complex beside a still mountain lake. The main subject is a grand multi-tiered pagoda-style palace with ornate curved roofs, carved wooden balconies, layered eaves, and warm golden lantern illumination, positioned slightly right of center. In the left foreground, include a graceful arched stone bridge with three visible arches, lined with continuous golden lights, crossing over reflective water toward the temple. The lake should mirror the temple, bridge, trees, and lanterns in shimmering gold ripples. Behind the architecture, place dramatic jagged snow-covered mountains, tall and sharp, rendered in cold monochrome blue-gray tones under a deep black night sky with no stars. On the right foreground, add a large ancient tree with twisting trunk and dense autumn leaves glowing amber-gold, plus dark rocks along the water’s edge. Add smaller illuminated pavilion rooftops in the midground on both sides to extend the temple grounds. Use a strong contrast between warm gold architecture and foliage versus cold dark mountains and sky, creating a serene sacred atmosphere, high dynamic range, sharp architectural detail, realistic reflections, volumetric glow from lanterns, epic composition, 16:9 wide aspect ratio, no people, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影级、超精细的夜景画面，描绘一座发光的传统东亚寺庙建筑群坐落在静谧的山湖旁。主体是一座宏伟的多层宝塔式宫殿，拥有华丽的弧形屋顶、雕花木质阳台、层叠的檐角以及温暖的金色灯笼照明，位置略偏右侧。在左侧前景中，加入一座优雅的石拱桥，桥身有三个可见的拱门，并排布着连绵的金色灯光，横跨在倒映着寺庙的水面上。湖面应倒映出寺庙、桥梁、树木和灯笼，呈现出波光粼粼的金色涟漪。在建筑后方，布置雄伟险峻的雪山，山体高大且尖锐，在深邃无星的黑夜天空下呈现出冷色调的蓝灰色。在右侧前景中，添加一棵树干扭曲、枝叶茂密且散发着琥珀金光的古树，以及水边深色的岩石。在中景两侧添加较小的发光亭台屋顶，以延伸寺庙区域。利用温暖的金色建筑与植被，对比冷峻黑暗的山脉与天空，营造出宁静神圣的氛围。高动态范围，锐利的建筑细节，逼真的倒影，灯笼带来的体积光效果，史诗级构图，16:9 宽屏比例，无人物，无文字。

templates.title: Golden Hour Rooftop Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻天台人像

templates.prompt: Create an authentic daily-life photographic image: a three-quarter full-body shot of {argument name="subject" default="a young East Asian Japanese woman in her early 20s"} standing alone on a residential rooftop at golden hour. Shoot from slightly below eye level at a three-quarter side angle, with her body turned left and her head angled slightly away from the camera; her face is intentionally anonymized by a centered rectangular warm-brown privacy blur covering the facial features. She has long, naturally straight fine {argument name="hair color" default="black hair"} worn loose, backlit into a subtle amber halo, with two or three stray strands lifted by a light rooftop breeze. She wears a slightly oversized vintage-wash denim jacket over a plain white inner top, straight-cut dark trousers, and simple worn white sneakers; one hand rests in a jacket pocket while the other hangs relaxed at her side. Place her near a low concrete rooftop parapet, with one visible industrial outdoor air-conditioning unit in the left foreground and grey rooftop pipes adding realistic texture. The background is softly blurred residential rooftops and a distant city skyline receding into an orange-tinted horizon, with the low sun glowing at the far right. Use warm low-angle sunset light, amber-orange rim lighting along her hair, shoulder, cheek area, and jacket edge, natural shadows, subdued urban colors, realistic lens bokeh, fine film-like grain, and candid documentary realism rather than fashion posing. Vertical composition, full body visible from head to shoes, quiet contemplative mood, no text, no logos.

templates.prompt: Create a vertical fantasy anime illustration of a graceful underwater flower-woman standing barefoot on a pale sandy seabed, centered in the composition. She wears a simple satin-white slip dress with thin straps, softly reflective fabric, and a calf-length hem, while her body is enveloped by enormous flowing {argument name="flower petal color" default="pale blush pink"} petals resembling oversized ruffled sea anemone or oyster mushroom petals. The petals form a dramatic headdress and cloak around her, with many fine white vein lines, scalloped edges, translucent layering, and long trailing petal panels spreading across the floor like a gown train. Her face is intentionally hidden by a flat square {argument name="face cover color" default="dusty pink"} censor block placed over the head area. Set the scene in a dreamy underwater garden with soft blue-green water, sunbeams filtering down from above, floating bubbles, tiny glowing jellyfish, and blurred coral and anemone shapes in lavender, blue, and pastel pink in the background. Use delicate painterly rendering, soft gradients, luminous rim light, ethereal pastel colors, elegant fashion-illustration proportions, intricate petal texture, serene magical atmosphere, and high detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的奇幻动漫插画，画面中心是一位优雅的水下花仙子，赤脚站在浅色的沙质海床上。她身穿一件简约的缎面白色吊带裙，面料具有柔和的反光感，裙摆及小腿。她的身体被巨大的流动 {argument name="flower petal color" default="淡粉色"} 花瓣包裹，这些花瓣如同超大号的褶皱海葵或平菇花瓣。花瓣在她周围形成戏剧性的头饰和斗篷，带有许多细致的白色脉络、扇形边缘、半透明的层次感，以及长长的拖尾花瓣面板像礼服裙摆一样铺散在地面上。她的脸部被一个平面的正方形 {argument name="face cover color" default="灰粉色"} 遮挡块刻意遮住。场景设定在一个梦幻般的水下花园中，背景是柔和的蓝绿色水域，阳光从上方洒下，伴有漂浮的气泡、微小的发光水母，以及薰衣草色、蓝色和柔粉色的模糊珊瑚与海葵形状。采用细腻的绘画渲染、柔和的渐变、发光的轮廓光、空灵的柔和色彩、优雅的时尚插画比例、错综复杂的花瓣纹理、宁静的魔法氛围以及高细节处理。

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy underwater fantasy portrait of a young woman from mid-thigh upward, standing still against a deep teal ocean background with tiny suspended particles and soft haze. She has very long, flowing, wavy {argument name="hair color" default="pastel pink"} hair drifting weightlessly around her shoulders, with a coral-like hair ornament tucked on the right side of her head. She wears a delicate semi-sheer {argument name="dress color" default="ivory white"} sleeveless slip dress with thin straps, a softly gathered waist, and gauzy fabric that looks ethereal underwater. Her skin is pale and softly lit, her posture is relaxed with both arms hanging down, and the composition is vertical, centered, and painterly-realistic with a muted cinematic glow. Add an opaque square censor block over the entire face, colored {argument name="censor block color" default="dusty mauve beige"}, obscuring all facial features while leaving the hair and body visible. Use soft focus, low contrast, subtle bloom, underwater diffusion, fine art fantasy photography mood, no text, no extra objects.

templates.title: Labanotation to 4-Beat Pose Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 拉班舞谱转 4 拍动作展示图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a Labanotation-style dance score, interpret the 4-beat movement phrase and convert it into a pose-control character sheet. Create exactly 4 full-body panels arranged in a clean 2×2 grid on a plain white studio background, showing the same character performing the pose for each beat. Add bold Japanese beat labels in the upper-left of each panel: "1拍目", "2拍目", "3拍目", and "4拍目". Use a photorealistic young female model wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="white school-uniform blazer, black bow tie, gray plaid skirt, white socks, and black Mary Jane shoes"}, with {argument name="hairstyle" default="black twin tails"}. Translate the notation into these four poses: beat 1: standing on one leg with one arm raised straight upward and the opposite leg bent back; beat 2: one arm raised upward, body angled slightly, one knee lifted and crossed in front; beat 3: standing front-facing with both arms extended horizontally to the sides; beat 4: standing front-facing with both hands held together near the chest. Keep the character consistent across all four panels, use soft even lighting, minimal shadows, and a simple catalog-like dance reference layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像作为拉班舞谱风格的舞蹈动作脚本，解读 4 拍动作短语并将其转换为角色动作控制展示图。创建一个 2×2 的整洁网格，包含 4 个全身动作分镜，背景为纯白色摄影棚背景，展示同一角色在每一拍的动作。在每个分镜的左上角添加醒目的日文拍子标签：“1拍目”、“2拍目”、“3拍目”和“4拍目”。使用写实风格的年轻女性模特，穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="白色校服西装外套、黑色领结、灰色格子裙、白色短袜和黑色玛丽珍鞋"}，发型为 {argument name="hairstyle" default="黑色双马尾"}。将舞谱转化为以下四个动作：第 1 拍：单脚站立，一只手臂笔直向上举起，另一条腿向后弯曲；第 2 拍：一只手臂向上举起，身体略微倾斜，一只膝盖抬起并交叉在身前；第 3 拍：正面站立，双臂向两侧水平伸展；第 4 拍：正面站立，双手在胸前合拢。确保角色在所有四个分镜中保持一致，使用柔和均匀的灯光、极简的阴影，并采用简洁的目录式舞蹈参考布局。

titleLocalized.zh: 日式缘侧夏日肖像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical editorial portrait of an adult woman relaxing on the wooden veranda of a traditional Japanese house, seated on a muted blue floor cushion beside tatami mats and open sliding shoji doors. She wears {argument name="outfit" default="white resort knit beachwear with a ribbed triangle top and matching bottoms"} under a sheer oversized white linen shirt that slips loosely off one shoulder, with delicate dewy skin and faint moisture catching the sunlight. Her dark hair is tied back casually, her face is intentionally anonymized by a simple square blur, and she holds {argument name="drink" default="a green canned drink with Japanese-style labeling"} near her mouth in a quiet summer moment. Behind her, translucent noren curtains hang in the doorway, colored white with soft indigo-blue wave and bird motifs, moving gently in the breeze; outside is a lush Japanese garden with moss, stepping stones, leafy greenery, hydrangeas, bamboo, and dappled afternoon sun. Add a small hanging glass wind chime near the eaves, warm natural wood textures, soft backlighting, realistic skin highlights, shallow depth of field, cinematic summer atmosphere, high-end lifestyle photography, 9:16 composition, natural colors, serene and intimate but tasteful mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版编辑肖像，展现一位成年女性在传统日式住宅的木质缘侧上休憩，她坐在榻榻米旁柔和的蓝色坐垫上，身旁是敞开的日式推拉门。她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="白色度假风针织沙滩装，搭配罗纹三角上衣和配套下装"}，外罩一件宽松的白色亚麻衬衫，衬衫松垮地滑落至一侧肩头；她的肌肤细腻水润，淡淡的湿气在阳光下闪烁。她将深色头发随意扎起，面部通过简单的方形模糊处理进行匿名化，手中拿着 {argument name="drink" default="一罐带有日式标签的绿色饮料"} 靠近嘴边，定格在宁静的夏日瞬间。她身后，半透明的暖帘悬挂在门口，白色的底色上印有柔和的靛蓝色波浪与飞鸟图案，在微风中轻轻摆动；窗外是郁郁葱葱的日式庭院，点缀着苔藓、踏脚石、绿叶、绣球花、竹子，洒满午后的斑驳阳光。在屋檐下悬挂一个小巧的玻璃风铃，呈现温暖的天然木质纹理、柔和的逆光、写实的皮肤高光、浅景深效果、电影级的夏日氛围、高端生活方式摄影、9:16 构图、自然色彩，营造出宁静、亲密且高雅的意境。

templates.title: Anime Girl Reaching Toward Cat

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女伸手触碰猫咪

templates.prompt: Create a wide, minimalist anime illustration in a soft Niji-style watercolor look: a {argument name="character type" default="quiet teenage girl"} crouches low on the left side of the canvas, facing right, gently extending one hand toward a sitting {argument name="animal" default="black cat"} on the right. The girl has short dark bobbed hair with straight bangs, pale skin, a calm slightly shy expression, and small hoop earrings. She wears an oversized dark olive hoodie, a dark plaid pleated skirt, white fishnet tights, chunky black platform shoes with laces, and a large soft guitar case strapped diagonally across her back, rising behind her head. Her pose is compact and balanced on the balls of her feet, knees bent, one arm resting forward and the other reaching delicately toward the cat. The cat sits upright, tail stretched along the ground, looking at her hand with a quiet curious expression; its inner ears have a subtle pink accent. Use a pale cream background with faint blue-gray watercolor clouds, lots of negative space, delicate thin linework, muted navy and olive shadows, gentle pastel lighting, and a dreamy hand-painted texture. Keep the composition horizontal and cinematic, with the girl occupying the left third and the cat in the right third, separated by open air and a tender moment of almost-touching. No text, no borders, no photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宽幅、极简主义的动漫插画，采用柔和的 Niji 风格水彩外观：一位 {argument name="character type" default="安静的少女"} 在画布左侧低身蹲下，面向右方，轻轻向右侧坐着的 {argument name="animal" default="黑猫"} 伸出一只手。少女留着深色短波波头，平刘海，皮肤白皙，表情平静略带羞涩，戴着小圆环耳饰。她穿着一件超大款深橄榄色连帽衫、深色格纹百褶裙、白色渔网袜、厚底系带黑色鞋子，背上斜挎着一个巨大的软质吉他包，包身从脑后升起。她的姿势紧凑，脚尖着地保持平衡，双膝弯曲，一只手臂向前支撑，另一只手细腻地伸向猫咪。猫咪端坐着，尾巴沿地面伸展，正以安静好奇的表情看着她的手；猫耳内侧带有淡淡的粉色点缀。使用浅奶油色背景，配以淡淡的蓝灰色水彩云朵，留出大量负空间，线条细腻纤细，阴影为柔和的藏青色和橄榄色，光线柔和如粉彩，并具有梦幻般的手绘质感。保持构图水平且具有电影感，少女占据左侧三分之一，猫咪占据右侧三分之一，中间由空旷的空间和即将触碰的温情瞬间隔开。无文字，无边框，非写实风格。

templates.title: Warm Firelit Portrait Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 暖调炉火人像转换

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the identity reference, create a warm low-angle cinematic photo of the same man, keeping his face and natural light stubble consistent with the reference. Change the scene so he is reclining in a leather armchair at night, wearing a thin, slightly wrinkled {argument name="shirt color" default="light beige"} button-up shirt instead of the suit. Pose him relaxed and leaning back, with one hand holding a short glass of {argument name="drink" default="whiskey"}. Add a large out-of-focus {argument name="foreground light source" default="orange fire flame"} on the right side of the frame, casting flickering amber light and shadows across his face and shirt. Set the background in a dark, softly blurred intimate interior with bookshelves and a warm lamp, using amber and brown tones for a melancholic, nostalgic evening mood. Make it look like a high-ISO modern digital camera or smartphone photo with visible grain, low contrast, shallow depth of field, and subtle chromatic aberration.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像作为身份基准，创作一张同款男士的暖调低角度电影感照片，确保其面部特征和自然的胡茬与参考图保持一致。将场景更换为夜晚，让他斜倚在皮质扶手椅上，身穿一件轻薄、略带褶皱的 {argument name="shirt color" default="浅米色"} 衬衫，而非西装。让他呈现放松的后仰姿势，一只手拿着装有 {argument name="drink" default="威士忌"} 的矮玻璃杯。在画面右侧添加一个巨大的失焦 {argument name="foreground light source" default="橙色火焰"}，将闪烁的琥珀色光影投射在他的脸部和衬衫上。背景设定在昏暗且柔和模糊的私密室内，配有书架和暖色台灯，运用琥珀色和棕色调营造出忧郁、怀旧的夜晚氛围。照片应呈现出高 ISO 现代数码相机或智能手机的质感，带有明显的颗粒感、低对比度、浅景深以及细微的色差效果。

templates.title: Cinematic Firelit Portrait Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感烛光肖像转换

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the identity source, regenerate the same man with his facial features matching the reference as closely as possible. Transform the portrait into a warm, low-angle cinematic night photo: the man is leaning back in a chair in a relaxed pose, wearing a thin, slightly wrinkled dark shirt instead of the formal suit, with one hand holding a glass of {argument name="drink" default="amber drink"}. Add a large soft, blurry orange flame on the right side of the frame, occupying the foreground and casting flickering warm highlights across his face and shirt. Replace the studio background with a dim, slightly out-of-focus interior or nighttime setting in amber and brown tones, creating a {argument name="mood" default="melancholic, intimate, slightly nostalgic"} atmosphere. Make it look like a modern digital camera or smartphone photo shot at high ISO: visible film-like grain, low contrast, shallow depth of field, and subtle chromatic aberration for atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像作为身份来源，重新生成与参考图像面部特征尽可能一致的男性形象。将肖像转换为一张温暖的低角度电影感夜景照片：该男子以放松的姿势靠在椅子上，身穿一件轻薄、略带褶皱的深色衬衫，而非正式西装，一只手拿着一杯 {argument name="drink" default="琥珀色饮品"}。在画面右侧添加一团巨大的柔和模糊橙色火焰，占据前景，并将闪烁的暖色高光投射到他的脸部和衬衫上。将摄影棚背景替换为昏暗、略微失焦的室内或夜间环境，色调以琥珀色和棕色为主，营造出一种 {argument name="mood" default="忧郁、私密、略带怀旧"} 的氛围。使其看起来像是一张使用现代数码相机或智能手机在高 ISO 下拍摄的照片：具有可见的胶片感颗粒、低对比度、浅景深，并带有微妙的色差以增强氛围。

templates.title: Colossal God in Engraved Desert Sky

titleLocalized.zh: 天神雕版画

templates.prompt: Create a vertical monochrome mythic engraving in the style of a 19th-century Gustave Doré woodcut, rendered with extremely dense hand-etched crosshatching, swirling contour lines, stippled shadows, and aged ivory paper texture. The scene shows a tiny lone wanderer, {argument name="traveler type" default="a cloaked pilgrim with a walking staff"}, standing in the lower foreground of a vast barren desert plain with low rocks, scrub, distant ridges, and pale mountains receding toward the horizon. Above the traveler, filling most of the sky, an immense supernatural face of {argument name="deity identity" default="an ancient bearded king-god"} emerges from storm clouds and cosmic wind, looking down with solemn, unreadable authority. The deity has a long flowing beard, swept-back hair, a jeweled crown, earrings, a radiant circular halo or celestial disk behind the head, and one enormous hand reaching through the clouds as if blessing, summoning, or judging the wanderer. The sky is a vortex of engraved cloud bands and spiraling wind currents, with dramatic negative space and fine linework forming cloud curls around the deity’s beard and hand. Use {argument name="color palette" default="sepia ink, slate blue-gray shadows, warm cream paper"}, high contrast but no modern digital gloss, no bright colors, no typography except a tiny unobtrusive artist signature near the bottom edge. Composition should be cinematic and surreal: the traveler is very small at bottom center-left, the colossal divine apparition dominates the upper two-thirds, creating awe, scale, silence, and sacred desert atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅 19 世纪 Gustave Doré 木刻风格的垂直神话奇幻雕版画，采用浓郁的黑米色线条渲染，辅以精细的交叉排线、旋转蚀刻笔触和陈旧的羊皮纸纹理。画面展示了一位渺小的孤独旅行者，{argument name="traveler description" default="一位手持手杖、身披斗篷的流浪者"}，站在广袤荒凉的沙漠平原底部中央，面对天空中巨大的天神幻象。在地平线上方，云层与风盘旋汇聚成 {argument name="deity identity" default="一位留着胡须的远古天空之神"} 的宏伟半身像，神明目光严峻，云雾与风暴线条构成的长发和胡须随风飘动，头戴华丽冠冕，脑后环绕圆形光晕，一只巨大的手从云层中伸出，呈现出平静的祝福或召唤姿态。景观开阔荒凉，布满波纹沙地、零星岩石、稀疏灌木和远处的低矮山脉，明亮开阔的地平线突显了人类与神明之间巨大的比例差异。采用电影般的低视角、史诗般的垂直构图、超现实的视觉叙事、神圣的氛围、风暴云涡、复杂的雕刻纹理、带有微妙蓝灰色调的单色墨水、高细节、戏剧性的对比，无现代物体，除底部附近可选的微小艺术家签名 {argument name="signature text" default="x.com/defyong"} 外，不包含任何可读文字。
