templates.title: Tomato Cauliflower Anime Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 番茄与花菜动漫漫画

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the cauliflower character source and REFERENCE_1 as the tomato character source, transform the ordinary market produce into a cute children's anime story comic. Anthropomorphize one red tomato and one white cauliflower as expressive chibi friends with faces, arms, legs, and lively emotions, while keeping their recognizable vegetable shapes and colors. Create a warm 3x3 storyboard grid with exactly 9 numbered panels, rounded borders, cozy market/kitchen lighting, speech bubbles and narration boxes, in a polished picture-book anime style. The story should show them meeting in the vegetable market, becoming friends, washing and preparing ingredients, cooking together in a pan, creating a colorful tomato-cauliflower dish, tasting it, and ending with a dream of becoming tiny super-chef heroes. Include the following 9 panel texts in Chinese as visible captions/dialogue: {argument name="nine panel Chinese story text" default="1 在菜市场里，西红柿和花菜相遇了。 你好吗！ 嗨~ | 2 西红柿好奇地问：‘你为什么长得像小树呀？’ 因为我有花椰朵朵呀~ | 3 ‘我们一起做菜吧！’ 西红柿提议。 好呀好呀！ | 4 他们洗干净，切一切，准备大显身手！ | 5 下锅啦~滋滋滋——香味四溢！ | 6 色香味俱全的‘西红柿炒花菜’出锅啦！ | 7 尝一口，嗯~真好吃！ | 8 从此，他们成了最好的朋友！ | 9 他们还有一个小小的梦想：成为超级美味料理侠！"}. Make the tone cheerful, educational, and suitable for young children, with bright colors, sparkles, hearts, and soft cinematic lighting. Use the reference images only as ingredient inspiration; do not keep the original photo background except where reimagined as a cozy illustrated vegetable market.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0 作为花菜角色的素材，REFERENCE_1 作为番茄角色的素材，将普通的市场农产品转化为可爱的儿童动漫故事漫画。将一个红番茄和一个白花菜拟人化为表情丰富的 Q 版好友，赋予它们面部、手臂、双腿和生动的表情，同时保留它们可辨认的蔬菜形状和颜色。创建一个温馨的 3x3 分镜网格，包含 9 个带编号的圆角边框面板，营造舒适的市场/厨房灯光，并配有对话气泡和旁白框，呈现精致的绘本动漫风格。故事应展示它们在菜市场相遇、成为朋友、清洗并准备食材、在锅中一起烹饪、制作出一道色彩鲜艳的番茄炒花菜、品尝美食，最后以成为小小超级厨师英雄的梦想作为结尾。请包含以下 9 个面板的中文文本作为可见的标题/对话：{argument name="nine panel Chinese story text" default="1 在菜市场里，西红柿和花菜相遇了。 你好吗！ 嗨~ | 2 西红柿好奇地问：‘你为什么长得像小树呀？’ 因为我有花椰朵朵呀~ | 3 ‘我们一起做菜吧！’ 西红柿提议。 好呀好呀！ | 4 他们洗干净，切一切，准备大显身手！ | 5 下锅啦~滋滋滋——香味四溢！ | 6 色香味俱全的‘西红柿炒花菜’出锅啦！ | 7 尝一口，嗯~真好吃！ | 8 从此，他们成了最好的朋友！ | 9 他们还有一个小小的梦想：成为超级美味料理侠！"}。整体基调要欢快、具有教育意义，适合幼儿观看，并运用明亮的色彩、闪光、爱心和柔和的电影级灯光。仅将参考图像作为食材灵感；除非重构为温馨的插画风格菜市场，否则请勿保留原始照片背景。

templates.title: Japanese Wind Chime Calligraphy Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 日式风铃书法摄影图

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic, cinematic street photograph of a traditional Japanese summer wind chime hanging in the open doorway of an old wooden shop or house. The small clear glass bell has blue floral decoration and a narrow rectangular paper strip dangling below it, printed with a blue ocean wave pattern. Behind it is a textured beige plaster wall framed by dark aged wood, with a black metal pendant lamp near the top right. Through the doorway on the left, show a softly blurred quiet Japanese lane with wooden buildings, green trees, bright daylight, and shallow depth of field. Overlay one huge bold white brush-calligraphy character across the center and lower half of the image, reading {argument name="calligraphy character" default="风"}, partially surrounding the wind chime as if painted on glass; the strokes are thick, clean, and luminous white. Use natural summer light, realistic textures, muted warm tones, wide horizontal composition, documentary photography style, high detail, peaceful nostalgic atmosphere, no people, no extra text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有电影质感的写实街头摄影作品，画面展示了一个悬挂在古老木质店铺或民居门口的传统日式夏季风铃。这个小巧透明的玻璃风铃上绘有蓝色花卉装饰，下方垂着一条细长的矩形纸条，上面印有蓝色海浪图案。背景是深色陈旧木框下的米色纹理灰泥墙，右上角附近有一盏黑色金属吊灯。通过左侧的门洞，展示出一条光影柔和、宁静的日本小巷，巷内有木质建筑和绿树，光线明亮，景深较浅。在图像的中心和下半部分叠加一个巨大的粗体白色书法汉字，内容为 {argument name="calligraphy character" default="风"}，汉字仿佛绘制在玻璃上，部分环绕着风铃；笔触厚实、清晰且呈现出明亮的白色。采用自然夏季光线，纹理逼真，色调温暖柔和，宽幅横向构图，纪实摄影风格，高细节，营造出宁静怀旧的氛围，画面中无人，无额外文字。

templates.title: Cherry Blossom Street Kanji Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花街道汉字海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic spring street scene in a quiet traditional Japanese neighborhood, shot in landscape 16:9. The view looks down a narrow residential lane lined with old wooden houses, plaster walls, sliding lattice windows, a low wall on the right, and a dark utility pole near the center-right with black-and-yellow safety stripes at its base. Pale pink cherry blossom branches fill the upper left foreground and continue as soft blooming trees into the distance, with delicate petals catching warm morning sunlight. Use shallow depth of field: the foreground blossoms and nearby house details are sharp while the street and background buildings fade into gentle bokeh. Overlay exactly 1 large white Japanese kanji character in the center, reading {argument name="main character" default="花"}, set in a bold elegant Mincho-style serif calligraphic font with clean high-contrast strokes. The character should be opaque white, vertically and horizontally centered, large enough to dominate the composition while still allowing blossoms and the street to remain visible around and behind it. Atmosphere: serene, nostalgic, airy, early spring in Kyoto-like backstreets, natural colors, soft highlights, realistic photography, no people, no vehicles, no extra text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级照片真实感的春季街道场景，背景为宁静的日本传统街区，采用 16:9 横屏构图。视角俯瞰一条狭窄的住宅巷道，两侧是古老的木屋、灰泥墙和格子推拉窗；右侧有一堵矮墙，中右侧立着一根深色电线杆，底部带有黑黄相间的安全条纹。淡粉色的樱花枝条填满左上角前景，并作为柔和的盛开树木延伸至远方，娇嫩的花瓣捕捉着温暖的晨光。使用浅景深效果：前景的樱花和近处的房屋细节清晰，而街道和背景建筑则淡化为柔和的虚化效果。在画面中心叠加 1 个巨大的白色日文汉字，内容为 {argument name="main character" default="花"}，使用优雅且笔画清晰高对比度的明朝体书法字体。该汉字应为不透明白色，垂直和水平居中，大小需足以占据构图主体，同时确保周围和背后的樱花与街道依然可见。氛围：宁静、怀旧、轻盈，宛如京都早春的后巷，自然色彩，柔和高光，写实摄影，无人物，无车辆，无额外文字。

templates.title: Mount Fuji Street With Cloud Kanji

titleLocalized.zh: 富士山街道与云朵汉字

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic wide-angle street photograph in a quiet traditional Japanese neighborhood, looking straight down an empty residential road lined with old wooden houses, tiled roofs, concrete walls, small gardens, utility poles, overhead power lines, a streetlamp, parked compact cars, and a blue no-parking road sign. In the far background, place a large snow-capped {argument name="mountain" default="Mount Fuji"} centered at the end of the street under a clear deep blue sky. Across the upper sky, form one enormous white cloud-like Japanese character reading {argument name="sky character" default="雪"}, as if written with soft fluffy clouds or vapor trails, semi-translucent and naturally lit, spanning almost the full width of the frame above the mountain. Use realistic midday sunlight with crisp shadows, documentary travel-photography composition, high detail, natural colors, atmospheric depth, and no people in the foreground.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级真实的广角街道摄影作品，场景设定在安静的日本传统街区。镜头直视一条空旷的住宅街道，两侧排列着古老的木屋、瓦片屋顶、混凝土墙、小花园、电线杆、架空电线、路灯、停放的微型车以及蓝色的禁止停车标志。在远景背景中，将一座巨大的积雪山峰 {argument name="mountain" default="Mount Fuji"} 置于街道尽头的中心位置，上方是清澈的深蓝色天空。在天空上方，形成一个由巨大的白色云朵组成的汉字 {argument name="sky character" default="雪"}，看起来就像是用柔软蓬松的云朵或尾迹云写成，半透明且自然采光，横跨山峰上方几乎整个画幅。使用真实的午间阳光，呈现清晰的阴影、纪实旅行摄影构图、高细节、自然色彩、大气深度，且前景中不出现人物。

templates.title: Moon Kanji Lakeside Night

titleLocalized.zh: 月字湖畔之夜

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic night scene beside a quiet lake at blue hour, with a narrow curving roadside on the left, a lit streetlamp, dark trees, utility poles and wires, a low guardrail along the water, distant mountains silhouetted across the lake, and small town lights reflecting on the shoreline. A bright full moon hangs above the water and casts a long golden reflection across the dark blue lake. Center the composition on one enormous crisp white Japanese kanji character {argument name="central character" default="月"}, rendered like a clean high-contrast typography overlay with thick elegant strokes; place it in front of the landscape so the real full moon appears framed inside the upper opening of the character. Use {argument name="time of day" default="deep blue twilight night"}, a moody realistic travel-photography style, cool navy tones, subtle film grain, natural streetlight glow, sharp typography, and a wide 16:9 landscape composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感十足、照片级逼真的湖畔夜景，时间设定在蓝调时刻。画面左侧为蜿蜒的窄路，配有明亮的路灯、深色树木、电线杆和电线，水边设有低矮的护栏，远处的山峦在湖对岸形成剪影，岸边倒映着小镇的灯光。一轮明亮的满月悬挂在水面上方，在深蓝色的湖面上投下长长的金色倒影。构图中心为一个巨大的、清晰的白色日文汉字 {argument name="central character" default="月"}，呈现出干净、高对比度的排版叠加效果，笔触粗犷而优雅；将其置于风景前方，使真实的满月恰好被框在汉字上方的开口处。使用 {argument name="time of day" default="深蓝暮色之夜"}，营造出忧郁而真实的旅行摄影风格，采用冷海军蓝调，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感、自然的路灯光晕、锐利的排版，以及 16:9 的宽屏风景构图。

templates.title: Fisheye Shibuya Yokai Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 鱼眼镜头下的涩谷妖怪自拍

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic ultra-wide fisheye action selfie photo at {argument name="location" default="Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo"} on a bright sunny day, shot from a low front-facing camera with strong circular lens vignetting and exaggerated perspective. In the foreground, show one fashionable teenage schoolgirl with {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy pastel-blonde hair"}, wearing a Japanese school uniform with a gray cardigan, white shirt, dark bow tie, blue plaid skirt, knee socks, black loafers, and a small brown shoulder bag. Her face is intentionally covered by a flat square privacy blur/censor block, while her nearest hand reaches dramatically toward the camera, huge from perspective distortion, with glossy manicured nails; her other arm stretches outward as if posing mid-crosswalk. Behind her, place one enormous floating fantasy yokai/kaiju creature towering above the city buildings: a cute but strange green-and-brown owl-deer-dragon spirit with antlers, crescent horn shapes, leaf-feather body patterns, long ribbon-like tendrils, glowing lime outlines, and a calm smiling face. Surround the scene with dense pedestrian traffic, zebra crossing stripes, tall commercial buildings, colorful Japanese signage, glass façades, realistic street shadows, and midday urban energy. Blend photorealistic street photography with a flat 2D illustrated monster composited convincingly into the sky, using crisp daylight, high detail, motion-filled crowds, playful surreal scale contrast, and a viral social-media snapshot feeling. The creature’s palette should emphasize {argument name="creature accent color" default="neon lime green"}, and the overall mood should feel {argument name="mood" default="whimsical, chaotic, and cinematic"}.

templates.title: Crowd Mosaic Selfie Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 人群马赛克自拍肖像

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution surreal aerial crowd mosaic artwork: from far away it reads as a casual selfie of {argument name="number of friends" default="two"} young women sitting close together at a small café table, one holding a smartphone out toward the viewer as if taking the selfie, the other leaning in beside her. Their faces are intentionally covered by plain soft-edged rectangular privacy blocks in muted taupe. From close up, every tonal area of the image is made from thousands of tiny individual pedestrians seen from above, each person casting a small shadow on a pale off-white ground; the dark hair areas are dense clusters of people in dark clothing, the skin and clothing tones are formed by lighter and colored crowds, and scattered lone pedestrians surround the portrait in the empty background. Include visible café details suggested through the crowd arrangement: a round wooden tabletop, a cup or small drink container near the center, arms, sleeves, long dark hair, and casual striped clothing. Use a top-down orthographic perspective, miniature-human photomosaic style, realistic lighting, soft daylight, subtle long shadows, extremely detailed crowd texture, emotional blend of loneliness and collective presence, no text, no logos, no border. Overall composition should resemble a vertical smartphone selfie portrait while remaining clearly built from countless tiny passersby.

templates.title: Anime Phoenix Girl Ruins Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫凤凰少女废墟场景

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anime-style fantasy illustration in a 16:9 landscape frame. A young female character, {argument name="character name" default="unnamed white-haired phoenix girl"}, stands in the foreground turned slightly left in a heroic half-body pose, with shoulder-length wavy {argument name="hair color" default="white hair"} tipped with deep red ends, a red hibiscus flower hair ornament, and a flowing red scarf. She wears a dark black jacket or cape over a white ruffled blouse and high-waisted black skirt or trousers, with warm sunset rim lighting on her clothing. Her face is intentionally obscured by a large centered square skin-toned censor block, and there is also a small semi-transparent vertical rectangular blur block near the upper left edge of the sky. Behind her, one enormous fiery phoenix wing made of red, orange, and yellow flame sweeps dramatically from her back toward the upper right, with glowing embers floating around it. The background shows a ruined stone arch and broken rocky landscape under a blue sky with soft clouds at golden hour, combining epic fantasy atmosphere, dynamic fire effects, polished digital painting, high-detail anime rendering, strong orange-blue color contrast, dramatic lighting, and a stable video-generation-friendly composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 横屏电影级动漫风格奇幻插画。一位年轻女性角色，{argument name="character name" default="未命名的白发凤凰少女"}，站在前景中，身体略微向左转，呈现英雄般的半身姿态，留着齐肩波浪状的 {argument name="hair color" default="白发"}，发梢为深红色，佩戴红色木槿花发饰，系着飘逸的红围巾。她身穿黑色夹克或斗篷，内搭白色荷叶边衬衫，下身穿着高腰黑色裙子或长裤，衣物上带有温暖的日落轮廓光。她的面部被一个居中的大号方形肤色遮挡块刻意遮盖，天空左上角边缘附近还有一个半透明的小型垂直矩形模糊块。在她身后，一只由红、橙、黄三色火焰组成的巨大凤凰翅膀从她背部向右上角戏剧性地展开，周围漂浮着发光的余烬。背景展示了黄金时刻下，蓝色天空与柔和云层映衬下的废墟石拱门和破碎的岩石景观，融合了史诗般的奇幻氛围、动态火焰特效、精致的数字绘画、高细节动漫渲染、强烈的橙蓝色色彩对比、戏剧性的光影效果，以及适合视频生成的稳定构图。

templates.title: Surreal Blue Fish Hat Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实蓝色鱼帽肖像

templates.prompt: Create a surreal high-fashion studio portrait on a pure white background: a slender {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} shown from the upper torso upward in side profile facing left, with her face deliberately covered by a flat opaque rectangular privacy block in muted taupe. On her head rests an enormous vivid {argument name="fish species" default="blue parrotfish"} like an extravagant sculptural hat, oriented horizontally with its head to the left and tail to the right, much larger than the human head. The fish is hyper-detailed and glossy, painted in electric cobalt, turquoise, cyan, ultramarine, and hints of violet, with visible scales, fins, round eye, slightly open mouth, dorsal fin, tail fin, and wet reflective texture. Surround the fish and figure with energetic abstract paint splashes, drips, tangled ink lines, and thin looping splatter strands in {argument name="accent colors" default="magenta, orange, gold, black, teal, and blue"}, as if liquid paint is exploding and running downward from the fish, hair, neck, and clothing. The subject has messy dark wet hair, visible ear, long neck, and wears a dark blue-black shirt or jacket covered in the same colorful paint. Use crisp editorial lighting, high-resolution photorealistic detail mixed with expressive acrylic splash art, strong contrast, clean negative space, and a vertical poster composition. Add a small handwritten artist signature and date in the lower right reading {argument name="signature and date" default="May 10, 2026 Oyagi"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张纯白背景下的超现实高级时装摄影肖像：一位身材苗条的 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，展示上半身侧面，面向左侧，面部被一块哑光灰褐色的不透明矩形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖。她头上戴着一条巨大的亮色 {argument name="fish species" default="蓝鹦嘴鱼"}，宛如一顶夸张的雕塑帽，水平放置，鱼头朝左，鱼尾朝右，体积远大于人头。这条鱼细节丰富且富有光泽，以电钴蓝、绿松石色、青色、群青色和少许紫罗兰色绘制，清晰可见鱼鳞、鱼鳍、圆眼、微张的嘴、背鳍、尾鳍以及湿润的反射质感。在鱼和人物周围环绕着充满活力的抽象油漆飞溅、滴落、纠缠的墨线以及细长的循环喷溅线条，颜色为 {argument name="accent colors" default="洋红色、橙色、金色、黑色、青色和蓝色"}，仿佛液态颜料正从鱼身、头发、颈部和衣物上炸裂并向下流淌。主体留着凌乱的深色湿发，露出耳朵，颈部修长，身穿深蓝黑色衬衫或夹克，上面同样覆盖着五彩斑斓的颜料。采用清晰的编辑摄影布光，将高分辨率的照片级真实细节与表现力十足的丙烯酸喷溅艺术相结合，对比强烈，留白干净，采用垂直海报构图。在右下角添加一个小的手写艺术家签名和日期，内容为 {argument name="signature and date" default="2026 年 5 月 10 日 Oyagi"}。

She has short, wind-tossed {argument name="hair color" default="pale white with red inner streaks"} hair, a red hibiscus-like flower hair ornament, and wears a white collared dress with a pleated skirt, a large red ribbon bow at the neck, and a dramatic black hooded cloak with deep crimson lining billowing in the wind. Behind her, a huge fiery dragon made of swirling orange-red flames arcs across the sky, its head and wing-like flame trails glowing intensely as embers scatter. The setting is a ruined fantasy landscape with broken stone arches and crumbling masonry on both sides, sparse dead branches and grasses, warm golden sunset clouds, deep blue upper sky, and strong orange rim lighting. Use a low-angle heroic composition, dynamic cloak movement, high-detail painterly anime rendering, dramatic lighting, sharp foreground character detail, atmospheric depth, and an epic magical adventure mood in a 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级宽屏动漫奇幻插画，画面前景中站着 {argument name="character name" default="一位白发法师少女"}，背景是日落时分的古老石制遗迹。她留着随风飘动的短发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅白色并带有红色挑染"}，佩戴着红色的芙蓉花发饰，身穿白色翻领连衣裙，裙摆带有褶皱，颈部系着巨大的红色蝴蝶结，外披一件在风中翻涌的黑色连帽斗篷，内衬为深绯红色。她的面部被一个位于正中央的哑光鲑鱼粉色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。在她身后，一条由翻腾的橙红色火焰组成的巨大火龙在天空中划出弧线，其头部和翼状火焰轨迹发出强光，火星四溅。场景设定为破败的奇幻景观，两侧是破碎的石拱门和坍塌的砖石，点缀着稀疏的枯枝和杂草，天空呈现温暖的金色日落云彩与深蓝色天幕，并带有强烈的橙色轮廓光。采用低角度英雄式构图，斗篷动态飘逸，高细节绘画风动漫渲染，戏剧性光影，前景角色细节锐利，具有大气深度和史诗般的魔法冒险氛围，比例为 16:9。

templates.title: Crayon Chibi Angel Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 蜡笔画风 Q 版天使女孩

templates.prompt: Create a full-body portrait of a cute chibi angel girl in a deliberately childlike crayon drawing style on a plain white paper background. The character has very long {argument name="hair color" default="bright sky blue"} hair with thick scribbly strokes, long bangs framing her face, and one small ahoge curl rising from the top of her head. She has oversized sparkling blue anime eyes, black crayon outlines, rosy pink cheek marks, and a tiny smiling red mouth. Above her head floats a rough hand-drawn {argument name="halo color" default="golden yellow"} oval halo. Add two small white feathered wings behind her shoulders, outlined and shaded with light blue crayon. Dress her in a white angelic military-inspired dress with a fluffy ruffled collar, short puff sleeves, gold-brown trim, small round gold buttons down the bodice and skirt, diagonal gold-brown chest accents, a flared skirt with scalloped light-blue edging, and matching white gloves; her hands are clasped politely in front of her waist. She wears white thigh-high stockings and white boots with soft gray outlines, fuzzy cuffs, dangling pom-pom ornaments, and small yellow-and-green bow details near the ankles. Use rough wax-crayon texture, uneven sketchy lines, visible scribble shading, simple proportions, a sweet innocent expression, centered vertical composition, no background objects, no text, and a charming handmade kindergarten-doodle aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的全身 Q 版天使女孩肖像，采用刻意模仿儿童蜡笔画的风格，背景为纯白纸张。角色拥有非常长的 {argument name="hair color" default="亮天蓝色"} 头发，笔触厚重且带有涂鸦感，长刘海修饰脸型，头顶有一撮小小的呆毛。她有着超大的闪亮蓝色动漫眼睛、黑色蜡笔轮廓、粉红色的脸颊印记以及小巧的红色微笑嘴巴。头顶上方悬浮着一个粗糙手绘的 {argument name="halo color" default="金黄色"} 椭圆形光环。在她的肩膀后方添加一对白色小羽翼，并用浅蓝色蜡笔勾勒和阴影处理。为她穿上一件白色天使风军装连衣裙，配有蓬松的荷叶边领口、短泡泡袖、金棕色镶边、胸前和裙摆处有圆形小金扣、斜向金棕色胸部装饰、带有扇形浅蓝色边缘的喇叭裙，以及配套的白色手套；她的双手礼貌地交叠在腰前。她穿着白色过膝袜和白色靴子，靴子带有柔和的灰色轮廓、毛绒袖口、悬挂的绒球装饰以及脚踝处的小黄绿色蝴蝶结细节。使用粗糙的蜡笔质感、不均匀的草图线条、可见的涂鸦阴影、简单的比例、甜美无辜的表情、居中的垂直构图，无背景物体，无文字，呈现出迷人的手工幼儿园涂鸦美学。

templates.title: Anime Night Observatory Over Hakodate

titleLocalized.zh: 函馆山顶的动漫风夜景

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anime-style night landscape from a high mountain observation deck overlooking {argument name="city name" default="Hakodate"}. The scene contains exactly 1 teenage girl seen from behind, exactly 1 coin-operated public telescope in front of her, exactly 1 curved metal safety railing, and exactly 1 information signboard on the left with the visible Japanese title {argument name="signboard text" default="函館山展望台"}. The girl has {argument name="hair color" default="long dark brown hair"} blowing gently in the wind, and wears a light gray hoodie, short dark pleated skirt, white socks, and black sneakers; she stands quietly with a contemplative posture, looking out over the glowing city and harbor below. The foreground deck is dimly lit in cool blue shadows, with the telescope centered slightly right and aimed toward the horizon. Beyond the railing, render a vast coastal city at night with dense warm orange and white streetlights, winding roads, a bright shoreline, a calm bay on the right, distant dark mountain silhouettes, and a faint purple-blue twilight band near the horizon. Above, fill the sky with countless sharp stars and a dramatic Milky Way sweeping diagonally from the upper left toward the center, with deep navy blues and subtle violet nebula tones. Use a wide 4:3 composition, highly detailed background, soft atmospheric perspective, gentle rim lighting on the girl, tranquil mood, crisp anime film still quality, realistic lighting, no text overlays except the signboard.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影感动漫风格的夜景，视角位于高山观景台，俯瞰 {argument name="city name" default="函馆"}。画面包含：1 位背对镜头的少女，她前方有 1 台投币式公共望远镜，1 处弧形金属安全护栏，以及左侧 1 块信息指示牌，上面清晰可见日文标题 {argument name="signboard text" default="函馆山展望台"}。少女留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色长发"}，在风中轻轻飘动；她身穿浅灰色连帽衫、深色百褶短裙、白色短袜和黑色运动鞋；她静静地站着，姿态沉思，眺望着下方灯火辉煌的城市与港口。前景的观景台处于冷蓝色阴影中，光线昏暗，望远镜略微偏右，指向地平线。护栏之外，渲染出一座广阔的沿海夜城，布满密集的暖橙色和白色路灯、蜿蜒的道路、明亮的海岸线、右侧平静的海湾、远处深色的山峦剪影，以及地平线附近淡淡的紫蓝色暮光带。天空布满无数清晰的繁星，一道壮观的银河从左上角向中心斜向横跨，呈现出深海军蓝和微妙的紫罗兰色星云色调。采用宽幅 4:3 构图，背景高度精细，具有柔和的大气透视感，少女身上带有柔和的轮廓光，氛围宁静，呈现出清晰的动漫电影剧照画质，光影写实，除指示牌外无任何文字遮罩。

templates.title: Editorial Fashion Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 编辑风时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the portrait source, transform it into a high-end editorial fashion magazine cover while preserving the person, pose, hat, shirt, lighting direction, shadow, and face-obscuring blur. Crop closer into a vertical cover layout and place the subject slightly right of center. Add a gritty off-white paper texture, bold black condensed typography, and neon yellow-green accent bars.

Create a magazine cover titled {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFSET"} in huge black letters across the top, partially behind the subject's head. Add the issue line at upper right: {argument name="issue line" default="ISSUE 07 / OCT 2026"}. Add a vertical neon-green strip at the far left with Japanese copy: {argument name="left vertical tagline" default="静けさは、時に最も鋭い。"}. Add a large bottom-left cover headline: {argument name="main cover headline" default="QUIET PROVOCATION"}, with the yellow subtitle {argument name="subtitle" default="Stillness cuts deeper than noise."}.

Include exactly 5 numbered article teasers in a left column: 01 FORM / PATTERN / RESTRAINT; 02 THE NEW CODE OF SOFT POWER; 03 CITY UNIFORM, REWRITTEN; 04 SHADOW PLAY IN SILVER THREAD; 05 INTERVIEW: ON STYLE WITHOUT PERFORMANCE. Add exactly 1 barcode block with price text “¥1200 (税込)” under it. Add exactly 1 vertical Japanese quote block on the upper right: “装うことは、主張ではなく編集である。” Add exactly 1 small black-and-white city-building photo inset on the lower right with a neon-green side accent. Add exactly 3 tiny editorial text clusters on the lower/right area: “OBSERVE. EDIT. INTENT. REPEAT.”, “CITY AS TEXTURE. SILENCE AS LANGUAGE. STYLE AS EDIT.”, and a small paragraph under page number. Add exactly 1 large page number “014” in neon yellow-green at the bottom right. Keep the design minimalist, modern, Japanese street-fashion magazine style, with realistic print grain, slightly distressed ink, and strong contrast.

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为肖像素材，将其转化为高端编辑风时尚杂志封面，同时保留人物、姿势、帽子、衬衫、光照方向、阴影以及遮挡面部的模糊效果。将画面裁剪为更紧凑的竖版封面布局，并将主体置于略微偏右的位置。添加粗犷的灰白色纸张纹理、醒目的黑色压缩字体以及霓虹黄绿色装饰条。

在顶部以巨大的黑色字母创建杂志标题 {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFSET"}，部分置于主体头部后方。在右上角添加期号：{argument name="issue line" default="ISSUE 07 / OCT 2026"}。在最左侧添加一条垂直的霓虹绿色长条，并配以日文文案：{argument name="left vertical tagline" default="静けさは、時に最も鋭い。"}。在左下角添加醒目的封面主标题：{argument name="main cover headline" default="QUIET PROVOCATION"}，以及黄色副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="Stillness cuts deeper than noise."}。

在左侧栏包含 5 条带编号的文章预告：01 FORM / PATTERN / RESTRAINT；02 THE NEW CODE OF SOFT POWER；03 CITY UNIFORM, REWRITTEN；04 SHADOW PLAY IN SILVER THREAD；05 INTERVIEW: ON STYLE WITHOUT PERFORMANCE。添加 1 个条形码区块，下方标注价格文本 “¥1200 (税込)”。在右上角添加 1 个垂直日文引言块：“装うことは、主張ではなく編集である。” 在右下角添加 1 个带有霓虹绿色侧边装饰的小型黑白城市建筑照片插图。在右下区域添加 3 组小型编辑文本：“OBSERVE. templates.title: UV Resin Cityscape Orb

titleLocalized.zh: UV 树脂城市景观球

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic close-up product-style image of a perfectly clear spherical UV resin art orb sitting on a glossy dark wooden tabletop. Inside the transparent sphere, encapsulate a miniature panoramic {argument name="embedded scene" default="modern city skyline beside a green park under a vivid blue sky"}, with tall glass skyscrapers, a low urban horizon, bright grass in the foreground, and a distinctive curved dome-like architectural structure on the right. The sphere should look like polished resin or glass, with strong refraction, lens distortion, magnified internal scenery, tiny suspended gold glitter and micro-bubbles throughout, and sparkling highlights around the rim. Use {argument name="lighting mode" default="lighting on"}: warm indoor illumination with bright specular reflections, a glowing highlight on the left edge of the orb, and shimmering gold flecks. Place the orb centered slightly low in the frame on a richly grained varnished wooden table with visible scratches, reflections, and warm amber tones. The background should be softly blurred with cozy dark-brown interior objects, including an out-of-focus decorative container on the left and a small round metallic object on the right, creating shallow depth of field and bokeh. Compose as a realistic macro photograph, 4:3 aspect ratio, high detail, crisp sphere, blurred background, luxurious handmade resin craft aesthetic, magical miniature world trapped inside a crystal ball.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的产品风格微距图像，展示一个放置在光亮深色木质桌面上的透明 UV 树脂艺术球。在透明球体内部，封装一个微缩全景 {argument name="embedded scene" default="蓝天白云下，绿地旁现代化的城市天际线"}，包含高耸的玻璃摩天大楼、低矮的城市地平线、前景中翠绿的草地，以及右侧一个独特的弧形圆顶建筑结构。球体应呈现出抛光树脂或玻璃的质感，具有强烈的折射效果、镜头畸变、放大的内部景观，球体内悬浮着细小的金色闪粉和微小气泡，边缘处带有闪烁的高光。使用 {argument name="lighting mode" default="开启灯光"}：温暖的室内照明，带有明亮的镜面反射，球体左侧边缘有发光高光，并点缀着闪烁的金色斑点。将球体置于画面偏下方，放置在纹理丰富、带有可见划痕、反射和温暖琥珀色调的漆面木桌上。背景应进行柔焦处理，呈现舒适的深棕色室内环境，包括左侧失焦的装饰容器和右侧的一个小型圆形金属物体，营造出浅景深和焦外成像效果。构图采用写实微距摄影风格，4:3 画幅，高细节，球体清晰，背景虚化，展现奢华的手工树脂工艺美学，仿佛一个被困在水晶球中的梦幻微缩世界。

The lion has a huge scruffy mane in ochre, burnt orange, brown, black, and yellow, with spiky hair tufts radiating upward, asymmetrical wide circular eyes, a long yellow muzzle, a black nose, thin whiskers, and clenched vertical teeth like a grimace. Use dense scratched linework, splattered paint, dry-brush texture, scraped marks, drips, cracks, and chaotic graffiti-like scribbles across the whole surface, evoking Jean-Michel Basquiat-inspired outsider art. The background is a distressed cream wall filled with exactly 6 small doodle elements: a black-rayed sun in the upper left, a red circular face-like symbol on the left, a blue rectangular figure with a tiny face on the mid-left, a black boxed face near the lower left, a tall stick-figure face in the upper right, and a black rectangular panel with white occult-like symbols in the lower right. Keep the composition square, tightly cropped around the lion's face, with high contrast, messy hand-drawn energy, no clean digital polish, and a gritty gallery-painting texture. Customize the subject as {argument name="animal subject" default="lion"}, the emotional expression as {argument name="expression" default="gaunt and exhausted"}, the dominant palette as {argument name="color palette" default="ochre, burnt orange, brown, black, yellow, and dirty cream"}, the art style as {argument name="art style" default="neo-expressionist mixed-media graffiti painting"}, and the canvas format as {argument name="canvas format" default="square"}.

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic dark-fantasy battle scene titled by mood as {argument name="scene title" default="Cooperation with the Barbarian 5"}: two mounted warriors charge side by side through a muddy battlefield toward the viewer. Count exactly 2 riders and 2 horses: the front-right rider is a blond knight in dark steel plate armor and chainmail with a black-blue cloak streaming violently behind him, riding a white warhorse with leather bridle and studded tack; the rear-left rider is a bare-chested muscular barbarian with wild curly black hair, leather straps, fur and rough metal accessories, riding a black horse and raising a long blood-stained sword overhead. Both riders' faces are deliberately obscured by plain solid brown square censor blocks. The knight thrusts a long shining sword diagonally down across the foreground, catching a bright lens flare on the blade, while the barbarian's raised sword points into the sky. Fill the background with a vast blurred medieval army, dust, flying dirt, spears, and exactly 2 visible tattered battle flags, one on the far left and one on the far right. Use dramatic low-angle action composition, extreme motion, galloping hooves kicking up gravel and mud, windblown hair and cloak, gritty realism, high-detail horse armor and leatherwork, epic fantasy war atmosphere, backlit sunlight breaking through bright clouds, shallow depth of field, cinematic contrast, photorealistic rendering, 2:3 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Pastel Anime Cherry Blossom Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和动漫樱花肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy widescreen anime illustration in a soft pastel palette, showing a close-up portrait of a young girl with {argument name="hair color" default="silvery white with pale pink and lavender highlights"} long flowing hair, loose twin-tail-like locks, and delicate strands blowing across the frame. The scene is filled with {argument name="flower type" default="cherry blossoms"}: count 2 visible blossom branches crossing the upper left and upper right background, with many glowing petals drifting through the foreground and background. Use strong backlighting from the upper right, pearly bloom, lens flare, bokeh sparkles, translucent ribbons of light, and a shallow depth of field for an ethereal spring atmosphere. The composition is an intimate over-the-shoulder or three-quarter close-up, with the girl’s face mostly hidden by exactly 1 large opaque square overlay centered on the image, colored {argument name="overlay color" default="muted pastel pink"}, covering the facial features from forehead to chin. Add hints of a pale blue-white school-uniform-style collar and soft pink accent near the lower center. Render in high-detail modern anime key visual style, luminous painterly shading, delicate linework, cinematic lighting, romantic and serene mood, 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻般的宽屏动漫插画，采用柔和的粉彩色调，展示一位年轻女孩的肖像特写，她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有淡粉色和薰衣草色高光的银白色"} 长发，发丝飘逸，呈现出松散的双马尾状，细腻的发丝在画面中随风摆动。场景中充满了 {argument name="flower type" default="樱花"}：画面左上角和右上角各有 2 枝可见的樱花枝，前景和背景中飘散着许多发光的花瓣。运用来自右上方的强烈逆光、珍珠般的光晕、镜头光斑、散景闪光、半透明的光带以及浅景深，营造出空灵的春日氛围。构图为亲密的过肩或四分之三特写，女孩的面部大部分被图像中心的一个大型不透明正方形覆盖层遮挡，颜色为 {argument name="overlay color" default="柔和的粉色"}，覆盖了从额头到下巴的面部特征。在下方中心附近添加淡蓝白色的校服风格领口和柔和的粉色点缀。以高细节的现代动漫关键视觉风格渲染，呈现明亮的绘画感阴影、细腻的线条、电影级光影，营造浪漫宁静的氛围，比例为 16:9。

templates.title: Mystic Astrologer at Cosmic Table

titleLocalized.zh: Cosmic Table 上的神秘占星师

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical fantasy anime illustration of {argument name="character description" default="a mysterious young male astrologer with tousled black hair and a deliberately shadowed, obscured face"} seated at an ornate cosmic divination table. He wears {argument name="robe color" default="layered deep navy and black silk robes"} with flowing sleeves, gold embroidery, celestial patterns, delicate chains, tassels, and dangling jewel earrings, giving the clothing an elegant but smooth, not bulky, appearance. His left hand reaches forward to hover over a large glowing Earth-like glass planet, while his right hand is poised above the table as if controlling an orrery. The tabletop is a polished dark star-map surface covered with clean, crisp golden astrological circles, constellation lines, zodiac-like symbols, orbital rings, and fine geometric markings. Show exactly 7 visible luminous globe planets on or partly on the table: one dominant large globe beneath the left hand, one small globe at the far left edge, one medium globe near the center-right, one small globe behind it, one larger globe at the right edge, one large globe in the lower-right foreground, and one partially cropped globe in the lower-left foreground. The background is a vast blue cosmic chamber with stars, nebula clouds, aurora-like turquoise light, floating golden astrolabe rings, suspended chains, crystal ornaments, and a dragon-shaped celestial ornament on the right. Use dramatic blue and cyan rim lighting, sparkling highlights, transparent glass glow, intricate gold linework, deep shadows, cinematic depth, and an epic mystical atmosphere. Composition should be the same: character centered behind the table, upper body leaning forward, face area dark and unreadable, hands and glowing planets in the foreground, richly detailed but clean planetary drawings on the tabletop. {argument name="art style" default="luxury dark fantasy anime, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting"}, vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的竖版奇幻动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character description" default="一位神秘的年轻男性占星师，留着凌乱的黑发，面部刻意隐藏在阴影中"} 坐在华丽的宇宙占卜桌前。他身穿 {argument name="robe color" default="深海军蓝与黑色丝绸叠层长袍"}，袖口宽大，饰有金色刺绣、天体图案、精致链条、流苏和垂坠的宝石耳环，使服装看起来优雅流畅，而不显臃肿。他的左手向前伸出，悬浮在一个巨大的发光类地玻璃行星上方，右手则悬在桌面上方，仿佛在操控一台太阳系仪。桌面是抛光的深色星图表面，上面覆盖着清晰利落的金色占星圆环、星座连线、黄道十二宫符号、轨道环和精细的几何标记。画面中需清晰展示 7 个位于桌上或部分位于桌上的发光球体行星：左手下方一个主导的大球体，最左侧边缘一个小球体，中右侧一个中型球体，其后方一个小球体，右侧边缘一个较大的球体，右下前景一个大球体，以及左下前景一个被部分裁剪的球体。背景是一个广阔的蓝色宇宙空间，点缀着星星、星云、极光般的青绿色光芒、漂浮的金色星盘环、悬挂的链条、水晶装饰，以及右侧一个龙形天体饰物。运用戏剧性的蓝色和青色轮廓光、闪烁的高光、透明玻璃质感、精细的金色线条、深邃的阴影、电影般的景深以及宏大的神秘氛围。构图保持一致：角色位于桌后中心，上半身前倾，面部区域阴暗不可见，手部和发光的行星位于前景，桌面上的行星绘图细节丰富且清晰。{argument name="art style" default="奢华暗黑奇幻动漫，超精细，电影级光影"}，竖版 3:4 比例。

templates.title: Modern Atomic Age Space Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 现代原子时代太空时尚海报

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant contemporary Atomic Age pop-art fashion illustration on a clean white background, mixing black-and-white retro photography with neon vector graphics and halftone printing. Center a floating mid-century space-age woman, {argument name="character description" default="a slim young woman with pale grayscale skin, glossy black bobbed hair, and a small black pillbox hat"}, posed diagonally as if dancing in zero gravity with one arm raised and the other extended. Her face is intentionally covered by a soft-edged dark gray square blur. Dress her in {argument name="outfit" default="a short white 1960s mod mini dress with bold black trim, a vertical black stripe down the front, black sleeve cuffs, black hem, white knee-high go-go boots, and small black heels"}. Surround her with an energetic atomic-age space collage in {argument name="color palette" default="hot magenta, cyan turquoise, lime yellow, orange, black, and white"}: exactly 1 lime rocket with magenta fins and orange exhaust on the left, exactly 2 flying saucers including a large lime-and-black saucer at lower right with a pink dome and a smaller pink saucer near the bottom center, exactly 1 black atomic orbit diagram with a magenta nucleus at mid-right, exactly 4 large foreground antenna-orb spheres in cyan, magenta, lime, and orange near the bottom and left edges, plus many black dots, tiny planets, orbital lines, and needle-like starbursts. Use oversized Ben-Day halftone circles and radial dot fields, especially a huge hot-pink burst in the upper right, cyan dot clouds on the left, and orange-pink gradients at the lower right. Add crisp black radiating lines, retro Sputnik shapes, small colored balls, and thin orbital curves for a playful 1950s sci-fi poster feel updated with glossy modern contrast. Composition should be portrait-oriented, dynamic, high-energy, sharp, clean, graphic, fashion editorial meets vintage space race poster. Include a small handwritten signature and date in the lower right reading {argument name="date text" default="May 10, 2026"} and {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的白色背景上创作一张充满活力的当代原子时代波普艺术时尚插画，融合黑白复古摄影与霓虹矢量图形及半色调印刷效果。画面中心为一位漂浮的世纪中期太空时代女性，{argument name="character description" default="一位身材苗条的年轻女性，拥有苍白的灰度肤色、光泽的黑色波波头，戴着一顶黑色小圆帽"}，呈对角线姿势，仿佛在零重力下跳舞，一只手臂抬起，另一只手臂伸展。她的脸部被一个边缘柔和的深灰色方形模糊处理有意遮挡。为她穿上 {argument name="outfit" default="一件 1960 年代白色摩登迷你裙，带有醒目的黑色饰边、前襟垂直黑条纹、黑色袖口、黑色下摆、白色过膝高筒靴和黑色小高跟鞋"}。用 {argument name="color palette" default="洋红色、青绿色、青柠黄、橙色、黑色和白色"} 的原子时代太空拼贴画环绕她：左侧精确放置 1 枚带有洋红色尾翼和橙色尾焰的青柠色火箭；右下角放置 2 个飞碟，包括一个带有粉色圆顶的大型青柠色配黑色飞碟，以及底部中心附近的一个较小的粉色飞碟；中右侧放置 1 个带有洋红色原子核的黑色原子轨道图；底部和左侧边缘附近放置 4 个巨大的前景天线球体，颜色分别为青色、洋红色、青柠色和橙色；此外还有许多黑点、微型行星、轨道线和针状星爆。使用超大号的 Ben-Day 半色调圆点和放射状点阵，特别是右上角巨大的热粉色爆发效果、左侧的青色点云以及右下角的橙粉色渐变。添加清晰的黑色放射线、复古人造卫星形状、彩色小球和细长的轨道曲线，营造出一种既有 1950 年代科幻海报质感，又具备现代光泽对比的俏皮感。构图应为纵向，动感十足、高能量、锐利、简洁，呈现时尚编辑风格与复古太空竞赛海报的结合。在右下角包含一个小的手写签名和日期，内容为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 10 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。

templates.title: Retro Space Bunny Anime Mascot

titleLocalized.zh: 复古太空兔动漫吉祥物

templates.prompt: Create a clean retro-futuristic 2D anime illustration on a white background featuring one cheerful space-age bunny girl mascot, {argument name="character name" default="Oyagi"}, in a dynamic full-body pin-up pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="soft blonde"} short fluffy bobbed hair with curled ends and side-swept bangs, huge glossy teal eyes, rosy cheeks, a small open smiling mouth with tiny bunny teeth, and a cute energetic expression. She wears a white rabbit-ear helmet with two tall upright ears lined in peach pink, a turquoise headband trim, and one black circular ear-side badge with a pink starburst; add small white bunny gloves, a sleeveless white mod minidress with turquoise side panels, pink piping, a black waist belt, a black-and-pink starburst emblem on the chest, a fluffy white cotton tail, and white mid-calf boots with turquoise heels and matching starburst emblems. Pose her standing on one leg on a flat turquoise oval shadow, the other leg bent up behind her, left hand pointing upward with one finger, right hand open outward as if presenting the scene. Surround her with a playful 1960s atomic space graphic design: one large soft pink circle behind her body, one large tilted turquoise oval behind her head and shoulder, two yellow orbital rings sweeping diagonally across the composition, and two atom diagrams made of colored dots and orbit lines, one on the right and one near the lower left. Include exactly 17 decorative star/sparkle elements: one large black eight-point star at upper left with colored rays, one small black four-point star at upper right, three teal four-point sparkles, three pink four-point sparkles, three yellow four-point sparkles, three peach-orange four-point sparkles, and three tiny white glints. Include exactly 10 separate colored circular dots: four turquoise dots, three pink dots, two peach dots, and one tiny black dot. Use crisp black line art, glossy cel shading, pastel turquoise, bubblegum pink, lemon yellow, black accents, and a high-resolution kawaii anime poster style. Add a small handwritten signature and date in the lower right reading {argument name="date text" default="May 10, 2026"} and {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简洁的复古未来主义 2D 动漫插画，背景为白色，主体是一位欢快的太空时代兔女郎吉祥物，{argument name="character name" default="Oyagi"}，采用动态的全身海报姿势。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和金色"} 的短款蓬松波波头，发尾卷曲，带有斜刘海；拥有一双巨大的亮青色眼睛、红润的脸颊、微张的笑脸露出小小的兔牙，表情可爱且充满活力。她戴着一个白色兔耳头盔，两只高耸的耳朵内衬为桃粉色，配有青绿色头带装饰，耳朵侧面有一个带有粉色星爆图案的黑色圆形徽章；配戴白色小兔手套，身穿无袖白色摩登迷你裙，侧面有青绿色拼接，粉色滚边，黑色腰带，胸前饰有黑粉相间的星爆徽章，身后有一个蓬松的白色棉花尾巴，脚穿白色中筒靴，配有青绿色鞋跟和同款星爆徽章。让她单脚站在一个扁平的青绿色椭圆形阴影上，另一条腿向后弯曲，左手食指向上指，右手向外张开，仿佛在展示场景。周围环绕着俏皮的 1960 年代原子太空图形设计：身体后方有一个巨大的柔和粉色圆圈，头部和肩后有一个巨大的倾斜青绿色椭圆，两个黄色轨道环斜向穿过画面，还有两个由彩色圆点和轨道线组成的原子图，一个位于右侧，另一个位于左下方。包含 17 个装饰性的星星/闪光元素：左上方有一个带彩色光芒的黑色八角星，右上方有一个黑色四角星，三个青绿色四角闪光，三个粉色四角闪光，三个黄色四角闪光，三个桃橙色四角闪光，以及三个微小的白色闪光。包含 10 个独立的彩色圆点：四个青绿色圆点，三个粉色圆点，两个桃色圆点，以及一个微小的黑色圆点。使用清晰的黑色线条、亮面赛璐珞上色，色调采用柔和的青绿色、泡泡糖粉色、柠檬黄，点缀黑色，呈现高分辨率的可爱动漫海报风格。在右下角添加一个小巧的手写签名和日期，内容为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 10 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。

templates.title: Colorful Annotated Scone Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 色彩丰富的司康饼标注照片

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, keep the same scone photo and composition, but redesign the overlaid annotations to look more polished, colorful, and social-media-worthy, as if drawn with bright marker pens and sticker-like doodles. Clearly indicate that the scones on the left are cheese scones and the scones on the right are chocolate-and-raisin scones. Replace the previous handwriting with exactly 8 visible Japanese text callouts: {argument name="left scone label" default="こっちはチーズスコーン"}, "外サク、中フワ、チーズたっぷり", {argument name="cheese headline" default="うまチーズ!"}, {argument name="bottom headline" default="焼きたて！スコーン・コレクション"}, {argument name="right scone label" default="濃厚チョコ！&ジューシーレーズン"}, "チョコ＆レーズン", and two small "甘いひととき" notes near the chocolate-raisin scones. Add cute illustrated accents that were not in the original: a small cheese wedge on the cheese scone, two clusters of chocolate-chip doodles, a raisin/nut doodle, curved arrows pointing to each scone type, sparkles, hearts, confetti, and a party-popper accent. Use thick white outlines and drop shadows around the lettering so the annotations pop, while keeping the baked scones realistic and unobscured.

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed ethereal fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="the goddess of garments"}, a divine feminine figure standing front-facing in a misty dark gray void, dressed entirely in luminous ivory and pearl-white ceremonial fabric. She wears an extravagant translucent veil and headdress made from layered lace, embroidered mesh, white flowers, pearls, silver filigree, and tiny crystal ornaments; her face is hidden behind the dense veil and floral headpiece, creating a mysterious sacred presence. Behind her head is a large circular halo shaped like an ornate lace crown, with intricate gothic filigree, delicate pointed arches, floral tracery, and sparkling beadwork. Her outfit is a luxurious bridal-goddess ensemble: flowing sheer bell sleeves, gauzy draped cape fabric, a fitted jeweled bodice with silver embroidery, pearl chains, lace appliqué, ornate waist ornaments, and a long narrow white skirt falling vertically. One hand is lifted near the veil as if gently adjusting it, while the other rests lower at the waist holding or touching a dangling silver lace ornament. Use a soft monochrome palette of {argument name="main color palette" default="ivory white, pearl silver, pale champagne, and smoky charcoal gray"}, with glowing highlights, mist, glittering dust particles, and translucent fabric edges. The style should be romantic dark fantasy, ultra-fine lace detail, elegant anime-inspired concept art, delicate watercolor softness mixed with polished digital painting, high fashion couture, sacred bridal goddess atmosphere, vertical portrait composition, no text, no modern objects, no harsh outlines.

templates.title: Dreamy Anime Selfie With Face Overlay

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻动漫自拍与面部遮罩

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy anime-style close-up selfie portrait of a young schoolgirl in a soft spring atmosphere, as if the camera is held very close and slightly above her. The character has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="pastel blonde with pink and lavender highlights"} hair whipping across the frame in loose strands, with a small ahoge curl visible near the top, wearing a pale {argument name="outfit" default="sailor school uniform with a red necktie"}. The face is deliberately obscured by a large centered opaque square overlay in muted lavender-pink, covering most of the head and upper torso area. The background is a glowing bokeh scene of {argument name="seasonal setting" default="cherry blossoms under a bright blue and pink sky"}, with soft petals drifting through the air, intense backlighting from the upper left, pastel purple and rose color grading, shallow depth of field, bloom, lens softness, and gentle motion blur. Composition should feel natural and candid, like a spontaneous selfie captured in magical sunset light, with the character filling most of the frame and hair extending to both edges. Use high-quality anime illustration rendering, ethereal lighting, soft focus, luminous highlights, and a romantic pastel palette.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻动漫风格的年轻女学生近景自拍肖像，营造柔和的春日氛围，仿佛相机正从上方近距离拍摄。角色拥有一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有粉色和薰衣草色挑染的柔和金发"}，发丝在画面中随风飞舞，头顶可见一撮呆毛，身穿浅色 {argument name="outfit" default="带有红色领结的水手校服"}。面部被一个位于中心的大型不透明薰衣草粉色方块遮挡，覆盖了头部和上半身的大部分区域。背景为 {argument name="seasonal setting" default="明亮蓝粉色天空下的樱花"} 散景，花瓣在空中飘落，左上方有强烈的逆光，采用柔和的紫色和玫瑰色调，具有浅景深、光晕、镜头柔化和轻微的动态模糊效果。构图应自然且随性，如同在魔法般的夕阳下捕捉到的自拍，角色填满大部分画面，发丝延伸至两侧边缘。采用高质量动漫插画渲染，光影空灵，焦点柔和，高光亮丽，并使用浪漫的粉彩调色。

templates.title: Alternate 1990s Futuristic Shibuya

titleLocalized.zh: 平行时空的 1990 年代未来涩谷

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic cinematic night street scene of {argument name="city and district" default="Shibuya, Tokyo"} as if Japan remained culturally frozen in the 1990s but reached {argument name="future year" default="2026"}: no smartphones, no modern LED minimalism, only flip phones, pagers, taxis, buses, analog nightlife, and dense Showa-to-Heisei era signage beneath newer high-rise towers. The viewpoint is from a wet pedestrian crossing after rain, looking into a crowded neon entertainment district with glossy reflections on black pavement. Include exactly 4 prominent vehicles: 1 red-and-cream taxi in the lower left foreground, 1 city bus with headlights in the center distance, and 2 dark sedans in the midground traffic. Include a large crowd of commuters and nightlife pedestrians in 1990s clothing; foreground has 2 main figures seen from behind, a young woman with long hair and a shoulder bag on the left and a young man in a denim jacket holding a shopping bag in the center. Architecture should mix towering 2020s-scale skyscrapers in the background with 1990s Japanese commercial buildings covered in vertical signs, karaoke ads, hostess-club notices, CD-shop-style posters, pachinko and entertainment billboards. Include exactly 3 dominant billboard clusters: a curved building on the left with red Japanese characters and a large washed-out screen, a central blue idol-group billboard reading {argument name="central billboard text" default="青い風"}, and a tall cylindrical right-side billboard with bold red Japanese lettering and an illustrated retro anime-style woman. Use Japanese text throughout the signage, but make it slightly imperfect and atmospheric rather than clean typography. Lighting should be moody, humid, and filmic, with amber taxi lights, cyan-blue signs, red neon, halation, deep shadows, visible grain, slight lens softness, and a nostalgic 35mm film look. Composition should feel like a documentary photograph from an alternate-history Tokyo, crowded, vertical, overwhelming, and realistic, with {argument name="weather mood" default="rain-soaked streets and humid night air"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有照片级真实感的电影质感夜间街景，地点为 {argument name="city and district" default="东京涩谷"}，设定为日本文化停留在 1990 年代但科技发展至 {argument name="future year" default="2026 年"} 的平行时空：没有智能手机，没有现代简约的 LED 灯光，只有翻盖手机、寻呼机、出租车、公交车、模拟时代的夜生活，以及在新建的高层塔楼下密集的昭和至平成时代风格招牌。视角位于雨后潮湿的人行横道，望向拥挤的霓虹娱乐区，黑色路面上映出绚丽的倒影。画面中需包含 4 辆显眼的车辆：左下角前景处一辆红白相间的出租车，中心远景处一辆开启前灯的城市公交车，以及中景车流中的 2 辆深色轿车。包含大量身着 1990 年代服饰的通勤者和夜生活行人；前景有 2 位背对镜头的核心人物，左侧是一位留着长发、背着单肩包的年轻女性，中心是一位穿着牛仔夹克、手提购物袋的年轻男性。建筑风格应将背景中 2020 年代规模的摩天大楼与覆盖着垂直招牌、卡拉 OK 广告、夜店告示、CD 店风格海报、弹珠机及娱乐广告牌的 1990 年代日本商业建筑融合在一起。包含 3 组核心广告牌：左侧一座带有红色日文字符和大型褪色屏幕的弧形建筑，中心一块写有 {argument name="central billboard text" default="青い風"} 的蓝色偶像团体广告牌，以及右侧一座带有醒目红色日文字体和复古动漫风格女性插画的高大圆柱形广告牌。所有招牌均使用日文，但字体应略显不完美且具有氛围感，而非整齐划一的排版。灯光应呈现出阴郁、潮湿且具有电影感的氛围，包含琥珀色的出租车灯、青蓝色的招牌、红色霓虹灯、光晕效果、深邃的阴影、可见的颗粒感、轻微的镜头柔焦以及怀旧的 35 毫米胶片质感。构图应如同架空历史东京的纪实摄影，拥挤、垂直、令人震撼且真实，并呈现 {argument name="weather mood" default="雨水浸润的街道和潮湿的夜空气"}。

templates.prompt: Create a dark epic fantasy 2D concept-art illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a silver-haired storm queen"} standing in heavy rain on a gothic castle rooftop or battlement, shown from the thighs up in a dramatic three-quarter pose. She has very long {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair braided over one shoulder, a delicate spiked crown, pale skin, and an intentionally obscured face covered by a flat muted gray rectangular mask with no facial features. Dress her in ornate royal battle regalia: a fitted white and midnight-navy corset gown, layered skirt panels, gold filigree chains and thornlike metal ornaments, jeweled arm guards, clawed gauntlets, a fur-trimmed shoulder mantle, and a long dark cape flowing violently in the wind. In her left hand she holds a tall jagged magical staff or spear made of black metal and glowing {argument name="magic color" default="magenta-pink"} crystal, surrounded by spiraling energy rings, sparks, and floating shard fragments. The background is a stormy medieval-fantasy cityscape with sharp cathedral towers, fortress spires, hanging banners, distant rooftops, rain streaks, and turbulent moonlit clouds; use cold violet-gray lighting with bright magenta highlights, cinematic backlight, rim lighting on wet armor, high contrast, intricate detail, painterly anime game art style, ultra-detailed fantasy character design, dynamic composition, widescreen 16:9.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张暗黑史诗奇幻 2D 概念艺术插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位银发风暴女王"} 站在哥特式城堡屋顶或城垛的暴雨中，以戏剧性的四分之三侧身姿势展示大腿以上部位。她留着极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 编发垂在肩头，戴着精致的尖刺王冠，皮肤苍白，面部被一个平坦、柔和的灰色长方形面具刻意遮挡，没有任何五官。为她穿上华丽的皇家战斗礼服：修身的白色与午夜蓝束腰长裙、层叠的裙摆、金色花丝链条和荆棘般的金属装饰、镶嵌珠宝的护臂、利爪护手、毛皮镶边肩披，以及在风中剧烈飘动的长款深色斗篷。她左手握着一根高大的锯齿状魔法杖或长矛，由黑色金属和发光的 {argument name="magic color" default="洋红色"} 晶体构成，周围环绕着螺旋状能量环、火花和漂浮的碎片。背景是暴风雨中的中世纪奇幻城市景观，包含尖锐的大教堂塔楼、堡垒尖塔、悬挂的旗帜、远处的屋顶、雨痕和动荡的月光云层；使用冷紫灰色调，搭配明亮的洋红色高光、电影级背光、湿润盔甲上的轮廓光、高对比度、精细细节、绘画感动漫游戏艺术风格、超精细奇幻角色设计、动态构图，宽屏 16:9。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"复古插画教育三联海报","theme":"关于皇家海军舰猫的真实历史事实","overall_style":"温暖的棕褐色手绘故事书雕版风格，高度精细的交叉排线，陈旧羊皮纸背景，深色木质内饰，航海物品，既奇趣又写实的虎斑猫解剖结构，博物馆印刷构图","title_banner":"{argument name=\"poster title\" default=\"真实且奇特\"}","layout":{"format":"宽幅横向海报，顶部有三个等大的边框面板，底部有一块长条说明牌","panel_count":3,"top_panels":[{"label":"1. 正式船员","position":"左","scene":"一只骄傲的虎斑舰猫戴着皇家海军风格的船长帽，坐在狭窄的船舱木桌前，手持白色羽毛笔，展示着一份羊皮纸船员名单。桌上放着一个印有 H.M.S. AMETHYST 和锚图案的马克杯、黄铜望远镜、标有 INK 的墨水瓶、硬币、绳索、航海工具，背景是一个舷窗。墙上的标牌写着：忠诚、勇敢且专业。羊皮纸标题写着：H.M.S. AMETHYST 船员名单，下方有手写的船员姓名和军衔。"},{"label":"2. 卓越贡献","position":"中","scene":"同一只戴着海军帽的虎斑猫，端坐在木质储藏室里，周围摆满了木桶、悬挂的平底锅、灯笼、货架和温暖的灯光。猫咪抬起一只爪子，仿佛在指挥或祝福一群船鼠。画面中共有 7 只清晰可见的老鼠：一只站在猫咪旁手持小白旗，两只坐在猫咪身后的货架上，一只在左下角抬头仰望，一只在前景正下方，一只在右下角前景，还有一只小老鼠在持旗者附近。氛围幽默且庄重。"},{"label":"3. 应得的休息","position":"右","scene":"虎斑猫蜷缩在铺满地图的桌子上的海军军官帽里睡觉，身处月光照耀的船长室。右侧有一盏温暖的黄铜灯笼在发光，窗外是深蓝色的夜空和满月，墙上挂着装裱好的帆船画和航海装饰。背景中有一位面部被棕色方块遮挡的睡眠中海军军官。猫咪附近有一个写着 DICKIN MEDAL 1949 的小奖章或标签。"}],"bottom_caption":{"position":"面板下方的全宽羊皮纸条","text":"{argument name=\"fact caption\" default=\"真实事实 #3：猫咪在皇家海军舰艇上正式服役至 1975 年。HMS Amethyst 号的 Simon 在战斗中幸存，鼓舞了船员士气，并被授予了相当于维多利亚十字勋章的动物奖章。\"}","decoration":"两端带有锚图标，并有细致的装饰边框"}},"subject":{"animal":"{argument name=\"main animal\" default=\"棕色虎斑猫\"}","name":"{argument name=\"cat name\" default=\"HMS Amethyst 号的 Simon\"}","costume":"带有金色徽章和深色海军饰边的皇家海军军官帽","expression_progression":"面板 1 中权威且骄傲，面板 2 中庄重且威严，面板 3 中平静且疲惫"},"color_palette":"陈旧奶油色羊皮纸、胡桃木棕色、黄铜金、墨水黑、海军蓝点缀、温暖的灯笼橙色、柔和的月光蓝","rendering_instructions":"使所有文字看起来像是印制或手写在羊皮纸标签上，精确保留三个带编号的面板标签，确保猫咪在所有面板中的角色设计一致，强调迷人的历史奇特性和海军真实感，增加细微的纸张纹理、圆角黑色面板边框以及古董海报的磨损感。"}

templates.title: Gothic Rainy Yami Sign Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中哥特风 Yami 标牌肖像

templates.prompt: Create a moody photorealistic cinematic portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Yami"}, a small gothic girl sitting on a rain-soaked riverside walkway at dusk, centered in the frame and facing the viewer. She has very long messy {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair falling over her shoulders, wears a layered black lace dress or mourning-style outfit with black shoes, and her face is deliberately hidden by a dark blurred square censor block, giving an eerie anonymous feeling. She holds one aged rectangular wooden sign with worn brown edges and off-white painted surface; the sign has handwritten Japanese brush text reading {argument name="sign text" default="今日は、泣いてもいい。理由なんて、あとからでいい。- yami"} plus a small black ink splatter beside the signature. Count exactly 3 main foreground objects: the seated girl, the wooden sign, and one dark plush rabbit doll sitting on the wet ground to her left with floppy ears, stitched X details, and a worn handmade look. The environment is rainy and melancholic, with glossy puddles reflecting the girl, sign, Japanese writing, and warm lamp glow on the pavement. Use a shallow depth of field: a blurred bridge or railing recedes along the left background, and exactly 2 visible old-fashioned street lamps glow warmly on the right side against a cold gray-blue overcast sky. Style should be realistic, dark, soft, emotional, slightly gothic, with muted colors, wet textures, bokeh lights, low camera angle, portrait orientation, and a quiet lonely atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的宽屏动漫风格数字插画，描绘一个宏大的 {argument name="venue type" default="VTuber 演唱会竞技场舞台"}，设计如同华丽的格斗游戏竞技场，采用从中心视角出发的完美对称正面构图。场景前景为平整的抛光表演地板，铺设着光泽感十足的反光瓷砖，镶嵌有金色几何图案，中心处绘有一个巨大的星星图案，并呈现出强烈的粉紫色倒影。背景是一个装饰华丽的抬高舞台，两侧各有一道楼梯通向平台，平台由金色桁架、黑色音箱塔、装饰着星形徽章的栏杆环绕，中央设有一块巨大的 LED 屏幕，显示着 {argument name="screen colors" default="粉色、紫色、青色和金色"} 的闪耀柔和星爆效果。添加三块可见的 LED 屏幕：一块大型中央屏幕和两块左右侧的小型屏幕，全部显示相同的璀璨星光演唱会视觉效果。在主屏幕上方，正中央放置一颗大金星，周围环绕着超大的洋红色缎面蝴蝶结和垂坠的帷幕，两侧上方配有额外的粉色帷幔和悬挂的星形装饰。用戏剧性的舞台灯光填满竞技场：包含大量聚光灯、镜头光晕、彩色光束、成排的小灯泡、闪烁的粒子，营造出 {argument name="lighting mood" default="霓虹洋红色和电光蓝色"} 的节日氛围。底部和远侧可见观众，表现为手持彩色荧光棒（特别是粉色、蓝色、黄色和紫色）的深色剪影，营造出座无虚席的现场活动感。采用高细节的动漫背景艺术、清晰的线条、饱和的偶像舞台色彩、电影般的景深、反光表面、超干净的渲染效果，竞技场地板上无角色、无文字、无标志、无水印。

templates.title: Glowing 3D Heartbeat App Icon

templates.prompt: Create a clean 3D app-icon style hero image on a wide 16:9 canvas. Center a single floating rounded-square icon with glossy beveled edges, colored {argument name="icon color" default="electric violet blue"}, with a subtle translucent rim, soft inner highlights, and four tiny circular screw-like dots near the rounded corners. On the face of the icon place a raised glowing white heartbeat waveform symbol, thick and smooth, casting a gentle shadow on the icon surface. The icon should hover slightly above the background with a soft purple glow and drop shadow. Use a dark cinematic abstract background: nearly black at the top fading into deep purple and magenta, with blurred neon blue-violet wave shapes along the bottom edge and a faint central haze. Lighting should feel premium, futuristic, minimal, and polished, with no text, no people, no extra objects, and generous negative space around the centered icon.

templates.prompt: Create a realistic courtside event photograph at a professional basketball all-star game inside a packed indoor arena. In the foreground, show two men posing together on the hardwood court: a very tall East Asian former basketball-player type in a dark navy suit and white dress shirt, standing on the right with one arm resting on the shoulder of the shorter man; and a shorter stylish man on the left wearing a glossy black satin button-up shirt with the top buttons open, layered silver necklaces, cream high-waisted trousers, and hands in pockets. Both faces should be anonymized with smooth rectangular skin-tone blur blocks, as if celebrity faces were censored or failed to generate. The background should show a lively stadium crowd in dark seating, scattered arena lights, staff and spectators standing along the sideline, folding chairs, and the polished basketball court with white boundary lines. Use a candid sports-event press-photo style, wide horizontal composition, realistic lighting, shallow-to-medium depth of field, high detail, natural colors, and the feeling of a VIP courtside group photo. Customize the scene with {argument name="event setting" default="professional basketball all-star game"}, {argument name="tall subject outfit" default="dark navy suit with white dress shirt"}, {argument name="short subject outfit" default="black satin shirt and cream trousers"}, {argument name="face anonymization style" default="smooth rectangular skin-tone blur blocks"}, and {argument name="photo style" default="realistic courtside press photograph"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张在室内拥挤的专业篮球全明星赛场边拍摄的逼真活动照片。前景中，两名男子在硬木球场上合影：右侧是一位身材高大的东亚裔前篮球运动员，身穿深海军蓝西装和白色衬衫，一只手搭在左侧较矮男子的肩膀上；左侧是一位时尚的较矮男子，身穿黑色光面缎面衬衫，领口敞开，佩戴叠层银色项链，穿着奶油色高腰长裤，双手插兜。两人的脸部应使用平滑的矩形肤色模糊块进行匿名化处理，呈现出名人脸部被遮挡或生成失败的效果。背景应展示充满活力的体育场观众席、昏暗的座位、零星的场馆灯光、沿边线站立的工作人员和观众、折叠椅以及带有白色界线的抛光篮球场。采用抓拍式体育赛事新闻摄影风格，宽幅横向构图，逼真的光影，中浅景深，高细节，自然色彩，营造出 VIP 场边合影的氛围。通过以下参数自定义场景：{argument name="event setting" default="专业篮球全明星赛"}，{argument name="tall subject outfit" default="深海军蓝西装配白色衬衫"}，{argument name="short subject outfit" default="黑色缎面衬衫配奶油色长裤"}，{argument name="face anonymization style" default="平滑的矩形肤色模糊块"}，以及 {argument name="photo style" default="逼真的场边新闻摄影"}。

Background should feel atmospheric yet not distracting.
Each of the 16 panels should show unique K-pop dance movements:
Intro pose
Hand wave motion
Hip sway
Side step
Hair flip
Arm extension
Spin transition
Mid-dance jump
Sharp choreography pose
Body roll
Footwork move
Dynamic lean
Turning pose
Confident close stance
Ending flourish
Final cinematic pose facing camera

Ultra realistic, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, premium K-drama + K-pop MV atmosphere, high detail, photorealistic, dynamic motion capture feeling, stylish urban night aesthetic.

templates.title: Cinematic Character Design Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级角色设计图

templates.prompt: Create a high-end cinematic character design sheet intended for a premium film production. The layout should feel like a curated art direction board rather than a rigid template. Avoid symmetrical grids, uniform spacing, or overly structured presentation. Instead, the composition should feel organic, slightly asymmetrical, and thoughtfully arranged like a real Hollywood concept pitch. Design a grounded, realistic human character with believable body proportions, natural imperfections, and expressive performance-driven presence—like a professional actor captured during emotional and physical performance moments rather than a posed mannequin. Use a bright, clean, and well-lit background that enhances clarity and gives the sheet a fresh, modern studio feel. Include: • Full-body turnaround views (front, 3/4 front, side, back, 3/4 back) • Multiple expressive facial studies from different angles showing emotional range • A cinematic hero portrait with strong character focus • Detailed breakdown of costume, accessories, and key props • Close-up studies of materials such as fabric texture, skin detail, and surface realism • Handwritten-style annotation notes, production markings, and design insights •A clear height reference scale integrated naturally into the composition The character should feel like a real person existing in a film world—authentic, grounded, and emotionally alive rather than stylized or overly idealized. Art direction style: Semi-realistic cinematic design, high-budget film production quality, soft natural studio lighting with a bright tone, subtle depth of field, realistic material rendering, and emotionally readable expressions. Presentation should feel like a professional concept art portfolio used in major film pre-production. Consistency requirement: Maintain perfect continuity in facial identity, body proportions, hairstyle, outfit design, and material details across all angles and studies.

promptLocalized.zh: 为高端电影制作创建一张电影级角色设计图。布局应呈现出精心策划的艺术指导项目感，而非刻板的模板。避免使用对称网格、统一间距或过于结构化的展示方式。相反，构图应感觉自然、略带不对称，并像真正的好莱坞概念提案一样经过深思熟虑的排列。设计一个扎实、写实的人类角色，具备可信的身体比例、自然的瑕疵以及富有表现力的表演感——就像一位专业演员在情感和肢体表演瞬间被捕捉到的状态，而非摆拍的人偶。使用明亮、整洁且光线充足的背景，以增强清晰度，并赋予设计图清新、现代的工作室质感。包含：• 全身多角度视图（正面、前侧面、侧面、背面、后侧面）• 从不同角度展示情感范围的多个表情研究 • 一张以角色为核心的电影级英雄肖像 • 服装、配饰和关键道具的详细拆解 • 材质（如织物纹理、皮肤细节和表面真实感）的特写研究 • 手写风格的注释、制作标记和设计见解 • 自然融入构图的清晰身高参考比例尺。角色应感觉像是真实存在于电影世界中的人——真实、扎实且充满情感，而非风格化或过度理想化。艺术指导风格：半写实电影设计，高预算电影制作质量，柔和的自然工作室光效，明亮的色调，微妙的景深，逼真的材质渲染，以及易于解读的情感表达。展示效果应如同大型电影前期制作中使用的专业概念艺术作品集。一致性要求：确保所有角度和研究中的面部特征、身体比例、发型、服装设计和材质细节保持完美连贯。

templates.title: Photo-to-LEGO Minifigure Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 照片转 LEGO 小人仔

templates.prompt:
Use the user uploaded image as the only subject reference. Transform the person in the uploaded image into a realistic LEGO style minifigure while preserving their recognizable identity and outfit. Preserve the subject's facial likeness as much as possible within LEGO minifigure design limits, maintaining the same hairstyle and hair color adapted into a LEGO hairpiece, facial expression, clothing colors, clothing design and patterns, and any visible accessories. The result should clearly represent the same person translated into LEGO form. The character must follow authentic LEGO minifigure proportions, including a cylindrical yellow or skin tone LEGO style head, simple printed facial features adapted from the subject, a block shaped torso with printed clothing details, standard LEGO minifigure arms with curved hands, short LEGO minifigure legs, and a distinct molded plastic hairpiece matching the subject's hairstyle.
Render the figure using realistic LEGO plastic material with a slight glossy sheen, subtle molded seams, and natural toy surface reflections. The face and torso should include printed details typical of LEGO minifigures, and the hairpiece should appear as molded plastic. The final image should be a high quality realistic 3D toy render with soft diffused studio lighting, subtle shadows that emphasize shape and plastic texture, and clean sharp focus with crisp detail. The framing must show the full body minifigure from head to feet in a centered composition with the entire figure fully visible. Use a plain white background with no scenery, no props, and no additional elements. The final style should feel like a photorealistic LEGO minifigure toy render with highly detailed plastic texture and studio lighting.

promptLocalized.zh:
仅使用用户上传的图片作为主体参考。将上传图片中的人物转换为逼真的 LEGO 风格小人仔，同时保留其可辨识的身份和装束。在 LEGO 小人仔的设计限制内，尽可能保留主体的面部相似度，并保持相同的发型和发色（适配为 LEGO 发饰）、面部表情、服装颜色、服装设计和图案，以及任何可见的配饰。最终结果应清晰地呈现出该人物的 LEGO 化形象。角色必须遵循正宗的 LEGO 小人仔比例，包括圆柱形的黄色或肤色 LEGO 风格头部、根据主体特征适配的简洁印刷面部细节、带有印刷服装细节的块状躯干、标准的 LEGO 小人仔手臂及弯曲手部、短款 LEGO 小人仔腿部，以及与主体发型相符的独特模塑塑料发饰。
使用逼真的 LEGO 塑料材质进行渲染，带有轻微的光泽感、细微的模塑接缝以及自然的玩具表面反射。面部和躯干应包含 LEGO 小人仔典型的印刷细节，发饰应呈现出模塑塑料的质感。最终图像应为高质量的逼真 3D 玩具渲染图，采用柔和的漫射摄影棚灯光、强调形状和塑料纹理的细微阴影，以及清晰锐利的对焦和精致的细节。构图必须展示从头到脚的全身小人仔，居中对齐，确保整个形象完全可见。使用纯白色背景，不包含任何场景、道具或其他元素。最终风格应呈现为具有高度细节塑料纹理和摄影棚灯光的逼真 LEGO 小人仔玩具渲染图。

templates.title: Technical Fashion Specification Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 服装技术规格书

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Generate a single-page technical specification sheet, A3 portrait, aspect ratio 1:1.4, black line art on white background with Pantone chips.

Style: LX-DR-01, evening gown, 1970s Halston bias drape combined with 2025 circular design principles.

Layout:
  left: front flat and back flat at 1:6 scale
  center: detail views at 1:2 scale (cowl neck, bishop sleeve cuff, detachable train attachment, side slit)
  right: bill of materials, measurement chart, title block

1970s elements:
  - bias-cut silhouette with cowl neckline depth 18 cm from HPS
  - long bishop sleeves gathered into 6 cm cuff height with covered button closure
  - empire seam positioned 5 cm below bust line
  - floor length with 20 cm side slit at left leg
  - bias drape at hip

2025 elements:
  - shell 19 momme 100 percent recycled silk charmeuse with blockchain traceability, Pantone 19-5408 TCX Deep Emerald
  - lining 100 percent cupro bemberg Pantone 11-0602 TCX Gardenia
  - detachable train length 80 cm with hidden magnetic closure at center back waist
  - 3D-knitted internal bodice support at bust
  - zero-waste pattern layout noted at 92 percent efficiency
  - NFC authenticity chip encased in right side seam
  - printed QR code care label

Measurements size FR 38:
  center back length 150 cm from nape to hem, bust 1/2 43 cm, waist 1/2 34 cm, hip 1/2 46 cm,
  sleeve length 62 cm from shoulder point, sleeve cuff circumference 18 cm, sweep 1/2 75 cm, slit height 20 cm

Construction:
  French seams throughout body using 301 lockstitch at 14 spi, seam allowance 1 cm
  hand-rolled hem 3 mm at bottom and train edge
  invisible zipper center back length 55 cm
  bar tack at slit top

Materials and color:
  thread 100 percent silk size 120 to match shell
  hardware: two covered buttons 12 mm diameter one per cuff, six pairs neodymium magnets 8 mm diameter for train

Labels:
  main label center back neck, care label left side seam with text "Dry clean only. 100 percent recycled silk." in English and French and Italian

Render annotations in 8pt sans-serif horizontal with leader lines, no shading.

Generate a full-length editorial image, aspect ratio 3:4, of a female model age 24 height 178 cm measurements 86-61-88 cm.

Garment exact specification LX-DR-01:
  - bias-cut evening gown in 19 momme 100 percent recycled silk charmeuse with blockchain traceability Pantone 19-5408 TCX Deep Emerald, lining 100 percent cupro bemberg Pantone 11-0602 TCX Gardenia
  - cowl neckline depth 18 cm from HPS, empire seam 5 cm below bust line
  - long bishop sleeves gathered into cuff height 6 cm with two covered buttons 12 mm diameter one per cuff, sleeve length 62 cm from shoulder point, cuff circumference 18 cm
  - floor length center back 150 cm from nape to hem, sweep 1/2 75 cm, 20 cm side slit at left leg with bar tack at slit top
  - detachable train length 80 cm attached at center back waist with hidden magnetic closure using six pairs neodymium magnets 8 mm diameter
  - internal 3D-knitted bodice support at bust, French seams throughout with 301 lockstitch at 14 spi seam allowance 1 cm, hand-rolled hem 3 mm at bottom and train edge, invisible zipper 55 cm center back
  - zero-waste pattern layout 92 percent efficiency, NFC authenticity chip in right side seam, printed QR care label left side seam, main label center back neck, thread 100 percent silk size 120

Styling: paired with 1970s satin strappy heels in champagne, 2025 recycled gold ear cuffs, hair in low sleek chignon.

Pose: standing in contrapposto, left leg forward to show side slit, right hand lightly holding train to reveal magnetic attachment point, gaze to camera, professional runway posture.

Environment: 1970s marble staircase with brass railing, updated with LED cove lighting, evening ambient light.

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一份单页技术规格书，A3 纵向，长宽比 1:1.4，白色背景上的黑色线条图，包含 Pantone 色卡。

款式：LX-DR-01，晚礼服，结合了 1970 年代 Halston 斜裁垂坠感与 2025 年循环设计原则。

布局：
  左侧：1:6 比例的正反面平面图
  中央：1:2 比例的细节视图（垂坠领口、主教袖袖口、可拆卸拖尾连接处、侧开叉）
  右侧：物料清单、尺寸表、标题栏

1970 年代元素：
  - 斜裁廓形，垂坠领口深度为从 HPS（肩颈点）起 18 厘米
  - 长主教袖，收褶至 6 厘米高的袖口，配包布纽扣
  - 帝国腰线，位于胸线下方 5 厘米处
  - 地板长度，左腿侧开叉 20 厘米
  - 臀部斜裁垂坠

2025 年元素：
  - 面料：19 姆米 100% 再生真丝双绉，具备区块链溯源功能，Pantone 19-5408 TCX 深祖母绿
  - 里料：100% 铜氨纤维 (Cupro Bemberg)，Pantone 11-0602 TCX 栀子花白
  - 可拆卸拖尾，长度 80 厘米，后腰中心处配有隐藏式磁吸扣
  - 胸部内置 3D 针织支撑结构
  - 零浪费排料，利用率达 92%
  - 右侧缝内置 NFC 真伪验证芯片
  - 印有 QR 码的洗涤标签

FR 38 码尺寸：
  后中长 150 厘米（从颈后点到下摆），胸围 1/2 为 43 厘米，腰围 1/2 为 34 厘米，臀围 1/2 为 46 厘米，
  袖长 62 厘米（从肩点起），袖口周长 18 厘米，下摆 1/2 为 75 厘米，开叉高度 20 厘米

工艺：
  全身采用法式缝，使用 301 锁式线迹，每英寸 14 针，缝份 1 厘米
  底边及拖尾边缘采用 3 毫米手工卷边
  后中隐形拉链，长度 55 厘米
  开叉顶部加固打枣

材料与颜色：
  缝纫线：100% 真丝，120 号，颜色与面料匹配
  辅料：两个 12 毫米直径包布纽扣（每侧袖口一个），六对 8 毫米直径钕磁铁（用于拖尾）

标签：
  主标位于后颈中心，洗涤标签位于左侧缝，文字包含“仅限干洗。100% 再生真丝。”（英语、法语和意大利语）

标注要求：使用 8pt 无衬线字体水平标注，配引线，无阴影。

生成一张全身时尚大片，长宽比 3:4，模特为 24 岁女性，身高 178 厘米，三围 86-61-88 厘米。

服装精确规格 LX-DR-01：
  - 斜裁晚礼服，采用 19 姆米 100% 再生真丝双绉，具备区块链溯源功能，Pantone 19-5408 TCX 深祖母绿；里料为 100% 铜氨纤维，Pantone 11-0602 TCX 栀子花白
  - 垂坠领口深度为从 HPS 起 18 厘米，帝国腰线位于胸线下方 5 厘米处
  - 长主教袖，收褶至 6 厘米高的袖口，配两个 12 毫米直径包布纽扣（每侧袖口一个），袖长 62 厘米（从肩点起），袖口周长 18 厘米
  - 地板长度，后中长 150 厘米（从颈后点到下摆），下摆 1/2 为 75 厘米，左腿侧开叉 20 厘米，开叉顶部打枣加固
  - 可拆卸拖尾，长度 80 厘米，通过后腰中心处的六对 8 毫米直径钕磁铁隐藏式磁吸扣连接
  - 胸部内置 3D 针织支撑，全身法式缝，使用 301 锁式线迹，每英寸 14 针，缝份 1 厘米，底边及拖尾边缘 3 毫米手工卷边，后中 55 厘米隐形拉链
  - 零浪费排料，利用率 92%，右侧缝内置 NFC 真伪芯片，左侧缝印有 QR 码洗涤标签，后颈中心主标，120 号 100% 真丝缝纫线

造型：搭配 1970 年代香槟色缎面系带高跟鞋，2025 年款再生金耳骨夹，发型为低位利落发髻。

姿势：站立于重心偏移姿态 (contrapposto)，左腿向前以展示侧开叉，右手轻提拖尾以露出磁吸连接点，注视镜头，专业 T 台姿态。

环境：1970 年代风格大理石楼梯，配黄铜扶手，融合 LED 凹槽灯光，呈现晚间环境光。

templates.title: Demon Slayer Anime Character Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 《鬼灭之刃》动画风格角色肖像

templates.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the only {argument name="identity reference" default="identity reference"} and transform the subject into a character rendered in the official {argument name="anime series" default="Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba"} anime TV series style. The visual execution must strictly match the Demon Slayer aesthetic, featuring clean and crisp linework, high quality cel shading, and saturated yet balanced colors with a polished TV series anime finish. Do not include any manga style sketching, cross hatching, grayscale, or black and white rendering. The subject's identity must be fully preserved, including their clothing design, hairstyle and hair color, accessories, skin tone, facial expression, and pose, with no replacements or removals of any items.
The existing outfit should be subtly stylized with Demon Slayer Corps inspired detailing, such as sharper fabric folds, slightly reinforced layered textures, and clean anime fabric finishes, while keeping the original outfit clearly recognizable. The character must follow accurate Demon Slayer proportions, including a lean and agile body type, natural anime anatomy, expressive anime eyes with strong highlights, stylized brows, and simplified anime nose and mouth.
The composition is critical and must show the character fully from head to toe, with feet, legs, torso, arms, and head all visible. The framing should not crop any part of the body, and the camera distance must be wide enough to capture the entire figure, leaving a small amount of empty space above the head and below the feet so the character fits comfortably within the frame. The output must be a single full body illustration with the character centered against a {argument name="background" default="plain white background only"}, with no ground plane, shadows, scenery, props, weapons, objects, effects, aura, particles, motion lines, or environmental details. The final image should contain only the character, and must not include cropped framing, multiple characters, multi panel outputs, other anime styles such as Dragon Ball, Naruto, or One Piece, photorealism, painterly or textured rendering, or any background elements or objects.

promptLocalized.zh:
将上传的图片作为唯一的 {argument name="identity reference" default="身份参考"}，并将主体转换为采用官方 {argument name="anime series" default="《鬼灭之刃》"} 动画剧集风格渲染的角色。视觉表现必须严格符合《鬼灭之刃》的美学，呈现清晰利落的线条、高质量的赛璐珞阴影，以及饱和度适中且平衡的色彩，并具有精致的电视动画质感。请勿包含任何漫画风格的素描、排线、灰度或黑白渲染。必须完整保留主体的个人特征，包括服装设计、发型和发色、配饰、肤色、面部表情和姿势，不得替换或移除任何元素。

现有的服装应巧妙地融入《鬼灭之刃》鬼杀队风格的细节，例如更锐利的布料褶皱、略微加强的层叠质感以及干净的动画布料质感，同时确保原始服装清晰可辨。角色必须遵循准确的《鬼灭之刃》比例，包括精瘦敏捷的体型、自然的动画人体结构、带有强烈高光的生动动画眼睛、风格化的眉毛，以及简化的动画鼻部和嘴部。

构图至关重要，必须从头到脚完整展示角色，确保脚部、腿部、躯干、手臂和头部全部可见。画面不应裁剪身体的任何部分，摄像机距离必须足够宽，以捕捉整个身形，并在头顶上方和脚底下方留出少量空白，使角色舒适地置于画面内。输出结果必须是一张完整的全身插画，角色居中，背景为 {argument name="background" default="纯白色背景"}，不得包含地面、阴影、场景、道具、武器、物体、特效、光环、粒子、动态线或环境细节。最终图像应仅包含该角色，且不得包含裁剪构图、多个人物、多格输出、其他动画风格（如《龙珠》、《火影忍者》或《海贼王》）、照片写实主义、绘画感或纹理渲染，以及任何背景元素或物体。

templates.title: Realistic High-End Nail Art Generator

titleLocalized.zh: 写实高端美甲生成器

templates.prompt:
Please generate a realistic close-up of hand nail art, with the theme inspiration: {argument name="theme" default="jellyfish"}.

The main subject is a close-up of a meticulously cared-for female hand. The nails feature high-end gel designs, centered around {argument name="theme" default="jellyfish"}, presenting an elegant, clean, refined visual effect characteristic of fashion magazines. Emphasize the detail of the nail art, the glossy texture, and the consistency with the theme's atmosphere.

Composition and Subject Requirements:
The focus is on the hand and nail close-up. Finger gestures are natural and elegant, conveying a sense of luxury. Each nail is designed around the theme, using combinations like hand-painted elements, solid bases with glitter/foil accents, and varied but cohesive styles. Designs should include premium base gel, delicate painting, and matching decorations like sequins or metallic foil. The style must be professional and sophisticated, not cheap or juvenile.

Lighting and Photography:
Soft natural light, no harsh shadows, shallow depth of field, and sharp focus on nail details and gloss. High-end beauty editorial style, professional commercial photography, realistic skin textures, and 4K ultra HD clarity.

Background:
A soft, blurred background that echoes the {argument name="theme" default="jellyfish"} without distracting from the main subject.

Overall Style:
Photorealistic, glossy gel finish, elegant, and clean. Avoid cartoon/illustration styles, distorted fingers, or low-quality textures.

Aspect Ratio: {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"}

promptLocalized.zh:
请生成一张写实的美甲特写图像，主题灵感为：{argument name="theme" default="水母"}。

主体为一只精心护理的女性手部特写。指甲采用高端凝胶设计，围绕 {argument name="theme" default="水母"} 展开，呈现出时尚杂志所特有的优雅、干净、精致的视觉效果。请强调美甲的细节、光泽质感以及与主题氛围的一致性。

构图与主体要求：
聚焦于手部和指甲特写。手指姿态自然优雅，传达出奢华感。每枚指甲均围绕主题进行设计，结合手绘元素、纯色底色搭配闪粉/箔片装饰，风格多变且协调。设计应包含优质底胶、精致彩绘以及亮片或金属箔等配套装饰。风格必须专业且高级，避免廉价或幼稚感。

光影与摄影：
柔和的自然光，无生硬阴影，浅景深，焦点清晰地落在指甲细节和光泽上。高端美容编辑风格，专业商业摄影，真实的皮肤纹理，4K 超高清画质。

背景：
柔和的虚化背景，呼应 {argument name="theme" default="水母"} 主题，且不会喧宾夺主。

整体风格：
照片级写实，光泽凝胶质感，优雅且干净。避免卡通/插画风格、手指变形或低质量纹理。

长宽比：{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"}

promptLocalized.zh: 一个超现实街头时尚场景，三名年轻男子并排站在 {argument name="location" default="欧洲城市街道"} 上，每个人都拿着一个超大号的自身头部剪纸放在身体上方，营造出一种俏皮且夸张的比例效果。他们真实的身体在下方清晰可见，身穿 {argument name="clothing style" default="复古风格街头服饰"}，包括喇叭牛仔裤、棕色和黑色调的叠穿夹克、长款大衣以及复古配饰。每个超大头部都有独特的造型：一人留着短脏辫并佩戴 {argument name="accessory" default="醒目的白色太阳镜"}，一人戴着黑色杜拉格头巾和透明眼镜，另一人戴着黑色鸭舌帽和有色太阳镜。背景是带有电车轨道的城市街道，远处有行人，建筑为经典的欧洲风格，具有质感的立面和招牌。构图居中且对称，采用平视视角拍摄。光线为自然日光，阴影柔和，色调写实。风格超细节、照片级真实，带有轻微的超现实/艺术感，纹理清晰，皮肤细节自然，是高级时尚大片与街头摄影的结合，4K 画质。

templates.title: Cinematic Brand City Takeover Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级品牌城市霸屏海报

templates.prompt:
Using the {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}, create a highly detailed cinematic poster:

“HOW {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"} TAKES OVER A CITY”

GOAL:
Show the brand expanding across an entire city ecosystem until it becomes impossible to ignore.

This must feel like:
global campaign rollout + futuristic city domination + luxury advertising ecosystem.

The brand should appear integrated naturally into the city, not random logo placement.

CORE RULE:

Everything must be visually inspired by the brand identity of “{argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}”:

brand colors

typography style

design language

visual energy

aesthetic mood

The city itself should begin to feel transformed by the brand identity.

MAIN STRUCTURE:

Vertical 4:5 poster
Dense multi layered composition
Huge cinematic city scene mixed with many smaller detail panels

TOP SECTION:

Include:

“{argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"}” logo or wordmark

Campaign title
