templates.title: Urban Line Atlas Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 城市线条图集海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Please generate a high-quality "Urban Line Atlas Poster."

This image is designed based on the visual language of a "monochrome urban line-drawing travel poster," featuring a complete composition with a large top title, mid-view street depth, core landmarks, flanking buildings, foreground figures, and a bottom signature block.

[Theme City]
City Name: {argument name="city" default="Yichun"}
English Main Title: {argument name="English title" default="FOREST LINE ATLAS / YICHUN CHRONICLE"}
Chinese Title: Yichun · City of Forests
Country/Region: Heilongjiang Province, China
Core Landmarks: Lesser Khingan Mountains forest, Korean pine forest sea, Wuying National Forest Park observation tower
Street Scene: Small forest town streets, residential intersections with wooden buildings, forestry city atmosphere
Emotional Theme: Commuting moments in the morning mist
Main Color Tone: {argument name="main color" default="dark green + dark grey line drawing"}
Aspect Ratio: 3:4 vertical

[Overall Positioning]
This is a work that serves as a travel souvenir poster, an urban visual guide, an architectural line manuscript, and an editorial design cover. The image needs to present Yichun's unique temperament as a "city in the forest," with both urban recognition and a sense of real street life—not a standard travel poster or a single landmark illustration, but a visual archive piece of collectible value.
[Composition Design]
The top is a strong title area using the large English title "FOREST LINE ATLAS," supplemented by the subtitle "YICHUN CHRONICLE." A numbering system (e.g., No. CN-HLJ-YC-01) and brief coordinate info can be added, with a modern and design-oriented layout.
The middle is the urban street主体, using a deep street perspective composition with a slightly low angle, the road extending into the distance and gradually entering the forest area.
The core landmark is the forest observation tower or the silhouette of the Lesser Khingan forest in the distance, clear but not overly prominent, naturally blending into the street scene.
Add local architectural details on both sides: wooden houses, forestry bureau-style buildings, residential blocks, small shops, bus stops, streetlights, utility poles, simple road signs, etc., forming high-density urban information.
The foreground includes lifestyle elements: pedestrians in autumn/winter clothing, people on bicycles, residents with shopping bags, small vehicles, and fallen leaves on the ground to enhance the seasonal atmosphere.
A separate signature area at the bottom is designed as a city archive label structure, containing "YICHUN / HEILONGJIANG / CHINA" and a simplified city info module or map index-style layout.
[Text System]
The top main title is clear and eye-catching. Keep only 2–4 clear readable texts in the image (e.g., "Yichun Station," "Forestry Road," "Bus Stop"), with other signs using abstracted Chinese strokes or symbolic characters to avoid gibberish. The overall text system should be unified, restrained, and integrated into the design structure.
[Visual Style]
The overall style uses monochrome or a very limited two-color line drawing on an off-white or warm white paper texture. Lines are precise, clean, and layered, with the feel of an architectural pen manuscript and screen print texture. Foreground lines are slightly thicker, background lines thinner, with figures and objects being simple but recognizable. The style is restrained and sophisticated.

[Innovation Requirements]
Incorporate design variations in: title naming system, top layout structure, slightly low-angle street perspective, fusion composition of forest and city, bottom archive-style information module, and expression of autumn fallen leaf atmosphere.
[Avoidance Matters]
No ordinary travel poster style, no watercolor, impasto, or cartoon/chibi styles, no cyberpunk, no high-saturation colors, and no cheap souvenir style.

Please generate an independent, complete, high-definition, clear-lined vertical urban line-drawing poster with a sense of collectability and series identity.

promptLocalized.zh:
请生成一张高质量的“城市线条图集海报”。

此图像基于“单色城市线条绘画旅行海报”的视觉语言设计，包含完整的构图：顶部大标题、中景街道纵深、核心地标、两侧建筑、前景人物以及底部的签名栏。

[主题城市]
城市名称：{argument name="city" default="伊春"}
英文主标题：{argument name="English title" default="FOREST LINE ATLAS / YICHUN CHRONICLE"}
中文标题：伊春 · 森林之城
国家/地区：中国黑龙江省
核心地标：小兴安岭森林、红松林海、五营国家森林公园观景塔
街道场景：森林小镇街道、带有木质建筑的住宅路口、林业城市氛围
情感主题：晨雾中的通勤时刻
主色调：{argument name="main color" default="深绿色 + 深灰色线条绘画"}
长宽比：3:4 竖构图

[整体定位]
这是一件兼具旅行纪念海报、城市视觉指南、建筑线条手稿及编辑设计封面的作品。图像需要呈现伊春作为“森林之城”的独特气质，既要有城市辨识度，又要具备真实的街道生活感——它不是标准的旅行海报或单一地标插画，而是一件具有收藏价值的视觉档案作品。
[构图设计]
顶部为醒目的标题区，使用大号英文标题“FOREST LINE ATLAS”，辅以副标题“YICHUN CHRONICLE”。可添加编号系统（例如 No. CN-HLJ-YC-01）和简要的坐标信息，布局现代且具有设计感。
中部为城市街道主体，采用深邃的街道透视构图，视角略低，道路向远方延伸并逐渐融入森林区域。
核心地标为森林观景塔或远处的森林轮廓，清晰但不突兀，自然地融入街道场景中。
两侧添加当地建筑细节：木屋、林业局风格建筑、住宅区、小商店、公交站、路灯、电线杆、简单的路牌等，形成高密度的城市信息。
前景包含生活元素：穿着秋冬服饰的行人、骑自行车的人、提着购物袋的居民、小型车辆以及地上的落叶，以增强季节氛围。
底部独立的签名区设计为城市档案标签结构，包含“YICHUN / HEILONGJIANG / CHINA”以及简化的城市信息模块或地图索引式布局。
[文字系统]
顶部主标题清晰醒目。图像中仅保留 2–4 处清晰可读的文字（例如“伊春站”、“林业路”、“公交站”），其他标识使用抽象的中文笔画或符号化字符，以避免乱码。整体文字系统应统一、克制，并融入设计结构中。
[视觉风格]
整体风格采用单色或极简的双色线条绘画，背景为米白色或暖白色纸张纹理。线条精准、干净且富有层次感，具有建筑钢笔手稿和丝网印刷的质感。前景线条略粗，背景线条较细，人物和物体简单但易于辨认。风格克制且高级。

[创新要求]
在以下方面融入设计变化：标题命名系统、顶部布局结构、略低视角的街道透视、森林与城市的融合构图、底部档案式信息模块，以及秋季落叶氛围的表达。
[避坑指南]
拒绝普通旅行海报风格，拒绝水彩、厚涂或卡通/Q 版风格，拒绝赛博朋克，拒绝高饱和度色彩，拒绝廉价纪念品风格。

请生成一张独立、完整、高清、线条清晰的竖版城市线条绘画海报，需具备收藏感和系列统一性。

templates.title: French Retro Oil Painting Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 法式复古油画风人像

templates.prompt:
Please generate a 2×2 four-grid collage photo set based on the photo uploaded by the user, with the theme of "French Vintage Oil Painting Girl Soft Boudoir Photography."

Strictly retain the subject's real identity features, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, perceived age, hairstyle basics, and overall temperament. Do not turn the person into a stranger. Extend the body naturally from the facial features; do not make it too thin, keep a slight soft fleshiness.

## Overall Style
The overall set is in the French vintage oil painting girl soft boudoir style, featuring very obvious hazy soft focus, a dreamlike atmosphere, divine halos, and a soft oil-painting-like texture. The temperament should be quiet, soft, fragile, poetic, and lazy, with a touch of slight melancholy and feminine vitality, like a girl deity statue wrapped in flowers, white gauze, and warm light.
It is not ordinary boudoir photography, not ordinary wedding photos, and not ordinary Korean-style studio shots, but rather: a vintage oil painting girl portrait under warm golden twilight light, featuring soft boudoir body lines, a dreamlike atmosphere, and a sense of goddess-like divinity.

## Makeup and Hairstyle
The makeup should be a translucent soft-mist base, warm cream skin tone, low-saturation nude pink or red-brown eye makeup, natural eyelashes, and bean paste nude pink or rose nude lips. The overall makeup should be soft, not heavy, and not sharp.
The hairstyle is French vintage long hair, which can include loose braids, a voluminous crown, natural wisps, slight curls, and a slightly messy airy feel. The hair should not be too tidy, but should have soft, loose, oil-painting-like layers.

## Clothing
Clothing consists of cream-white, ivory, or off-white French vintage lace long dresses, off-the-shoulder tulle dresses, and vintage lace dresses. It should feature lace, light gauze, semi-transparent cuffs, soft folds, and layered skirts. The overall look is sacred, soft, and feminine, like a combination of a vintage nightgown and a light wedding dress feel, but avoid looking too much like modern commercial wedding photography.

## White Gauze and Flowers
The scene must contain large areas of light and transparent white gauze, naturally draped over the back of chairs, table edges, the floor, and around the person, creating a misty sense of envelopment, floating, and airy layers.
Floral materials should mainly be light pink roses, pink-white bouquets, white lilies, or soft light-colored flowers. They can be held in the person's arms, placed on the table, or scattered on the floor to enhance the soft beauty, vitality, and goddess atmosphere.

## Scene
The scene is a minimalist vintage studio space with dark gray-brown, dark brown, or smoke-brown background cloth and floor cloth. Accompanied by a vintage round chair, a small round table, a lace tablecloth, a white vase, and a small amount of floral material. The scene is not complex but should have a soft, enclosed, dream-like small stage feel.

## Lighting and Texture
This is the most important part:
Please use very obvious warm golden side lighting or side backlighting, like sunset sunlight shining into an old room. The light should be soft but directional, making the skin, white gauze, and flower edges appear with a distinct glow, halo, bloom, and slight hazy flare.
The entire set must be hazier, softer focused, and lower contrast than ordinary photography:
- soft focus
- diffusion filter
- bloom
- halation
- dreamy blur
- hazy glow
- film grain
- oil painting softness
The image should look like it was taken through a thin veil; details should not be too sharp, not high-definition or rigid, and not too clean. The overall presentation should have obvious mist, halos, and soft oil painting textures.

## Emotion and Expression
The subject should not just be "quiet and pretty" but should have a sense of emotion and immersion. Please emphasize: fragility, laziness, thoughtfulness, slight melancholy, immersion, self-perception, quiet blooming, and divinity lit by light.
Expressions can include: eyes closed, eyes half-closed, looking to the side, head slightly bowed, head tilted up toward the light, looking back with a gaze, or an accidental downcast look. Reduce the posed feel of ordinary front-facing shots and increase the feeling of emotional moments captured by a photographer.

## Four-Grid Format
Generate one 2×2 four-grid collage, where each grid is a 3:4 vertical composition. All four images must belong to the same photo set: same person, same makeup system, same clothing system, same scene system, same lighting language, and same post-processing texture.

## Consistent Elements
The following elements remain unified across the four images: same girl, same French vintage oil painting soft boudoir style, same cream-white lace/gauze clothing system, same warm golden hazy side backlighting, same dark gray-brown vintage background space, same prop system of gauze, flowers, vintage chair, and small table, and the same soft focus, oil painting, film grain, and dream halo texture.

## Allowed Variations
To avoid the four images looking too similar, naturally vary the following: composition distance, camera height, poses (sitting/leaning/lying/turning/tilting head), the way the flowers are held, the flow of the white gauze, expressions and gaze direction, hand movements, and the relationship between the person and the chair, table, or floor.

## Lens Pool Rules
Randomly prioritize 4 shots from the following pool, ensuring at least 2 core shots are included:
### Core Shots (Choose at least 2)
1. Half-body portrait sitting and holding flowers
2. Emotional medium shot leaning against the chair back or table edge
### Other Shots (Choose to fill the rest)
- Tilting head up toward the light
- Looking back with an exposed back
- Lying on the floor
- High-angle lying shot
- Close-up side profile with closed eyes
- Full-body shot wrapped in white gauze
- Sitting in a slightly curled-up position
- Standing or leaning by the flower table
Please let the four images vary in lens choice while overall remaining like four moments from the same dreamlike oil painting photo set.

## Key Objectives
The whole set must be hazier, more glowing, and more emotional than ordinary photography. Prioritize: enshrouding soft light, warm golden dreaminess, feminine divinity and vitality, the sense of being wrapped in gauze and flowers, stronger emotional flow, and more obvious oil painting soft focus.

## Avoid
Avoid high-definition sharpness; avoid ordinary warm-toned studio feels; avoid modern wedding photo vibes; avoid Korean-style commercial studio looks; avoid plastic-like skin retouching; avoid being too clean and clear; avoid influencer-style photography; avoid cheap "fairy" styles; avoid messy backgrounds; avoid watermarks and logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据用户上传的照片，生成一组 2×2 四宫格拼贴照片，主题为“法式复古油画少女柔美闺房摄影”。

严格保留主体真实的身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、感知年龄、发型基础和整体气质。不要将人物变成陌生人。从面部特征自然延伸身体；不要过瘦，保持轻微的柔和肉感。

## 整体风格
整组照片采用法式复古油画少女柔美闺房风格，具有非常明显的朦胧柔焦、梦幻氛围、神圣光晕和柔和的油画质感。气质应安静、柔和、脆弱、诗意且慵懒，带有一丝淡淡的忧郁和女性生命力，宛如被鲜花、白纱和暖光包裹的少女神像。
这并非普通的闺房摄影、婚纱照或韩式影楼风格，而是：暖金色暮光下的复古油画少女肖像，展现柔美的闺房体态、梦幻氛围和女神般的神圣感。

## 妆容与发型
妆容应为通透的柔雾底妆、暖奶油肤色、低饱和度裸粉色或红棕色眼影、自然睫毛，以及豆沙裸粉色或玫瑰裸色唇妆。整体妆容应柔和，不宜浓重或凌厉。
发型为法式复古长发，可包括松散的编发、蓬松的头顶、自然的碎发、微卷以及略显凌乱的空气感。头发不应过于整齐，而应具有柔和、松散、油画般的层次感。

## 服装
服装包括奶油白、象牙白或米白色的法式复古蕾丝长裙、露肩薄纱裙和复古蕾丝裙。应具备蕾丝、轻纱、半透明袖口、柔和褶皱和多层裙摆。整体造型神圣、柔和且充满女性魅力，类似于复古睡裙与轻婚纱的结合，但要避免看起来过于像现代商业婚纱摄影。

## 白纱与花卉
场景中必须包含大面积轻盈透明的白纱，自然地披挂在椅背、桌边、地面以及人物周围，营造出朦胧的包裹感、漂浮感和空气感层次。
花卉素材主要为浅粉色玫瑰、粉白色花束、白百合或柔和的浅色花卉。它们可以被人物抱在怀里、放在桌上或散落在地面，以增强柔美感、生命力和女神氛围。

## 场景
场景为一个极简的复古摄影空间，使用深灰棕色、深棕色或烟棕色的背景布和地布。配有复古圆椅、小圆桌、蕾丝桌布、白色花瓶和少量花卉素材。场景不复杂，但应具有柔和、封闭、梦幻般的小舞台感。

## 光影与质感
这是最重要的部分：
请使用非常明显的暖金色侧光或侧逆光，如同夕阳照射进老房间。光线应柔和但具有方向性，使皮肤、白纱和花朵边缘呈现出明显的辉光、光晕、绽放和轻微的朦胧光斑。
整组照片必须比普通摄影更朦胧、更柔焦、对比度更低：
- 柔焦 (soft focus)
- 柔光滤镜 (diffusion filter)
- 溢光 (bloom)
- 光晕 (halation)
- 梦幻模糊 (dreamy blur)
- 朦胧辉光 (hazy glow)
- 胶片颗粒 (film grain)
- 油画柔感 (oil painting softness)
图像看起来应像是透过一层薄纱拍摄；细节不应过于锐利，不应高清或僵硬，也不应过于干净。整体呈现应具有明显的雾气、光晕和柔和的油画质感。

## 情绪与表现
主体不应仅仅是“安静漂亮”，而应具有情绪感和沉浸感。请强调：脆弱、慵懒、沉思、淡淡的忧郁、沉浸、自我感知、静谧绽放以及被光照亮的神性。
表情可包括：闭眼、半闭眼、侧目、低头、抬头向光、回眸，或不经意的垂眸。减少普通正面拍摄的摆拍感，增加摄影师捕捉到的情绪瞬间感。

## 四宫格格式
生成一个 2×2 四宫格拼贴，每格均为 3:4 竖构图。四张照片必须属于同一组：同一个人、同一种妆容系统、同一种服装系统、同一种场景系统、同一种光影语言和同一种后期质感。

## 一致性元素
以下元素在四张照片中保持统一：同一个少女、同一种法式复古油画柔美闺房风格、同一种奶油白蕾丝/薄纱服装系统、同一种暖金色朦胧侧逆光、同一种深灰棕色复古背景空间、同一种由纱、花、复古椅和小桌组成的道具系统，以及相同的柔焦、油画、胶片颗粒和梦幻光晕质感。

## 允许的变化
为了避免四张照片过于雷同，请自然地改变以下内容：构图距离、相机高度、姿势（坐/倚/躺/转身/歪头）、拿花的方式、白纱的流动感、表情和视线方向、手部动作，以及人物与椅子、桌子或地面的关系。

## 镜头池规则
从以下镜头池中随机优先选择 4 个镜头，确保至少包含 2 个核心镜头：
### 核心镜头（至少选择 2 个）
1. 坐姿抱花半身像
2. 倚靠椅背或桌边的情绪化中景
### 其他镜头（用于填充剩余位置）
- 抬头向光
- 回眸露背
- 躺在地面
- 高角度俯拍躺姿
- 闭眼侧脸特写
- 被白纱包裹的全身照
- 蜷缩坐姿
- 站在花桌旁或倚靠花桌
请让四张照片在镜头选择上有所变化，同时整体保持如同来自同一场梦幻油画摄影集的四个瞬间。

## 关键目标
整组照片必须比普通摄影更朦胧、更具光感和情绪感。优先考虑：包裹感柔光、暖金色梦幻感、女性神性与生命力、被纱与花包裹的感觉、更强的情绪流动以及更明显的油画柔焦感。

## 避雷指南
避免高清锐利度；避免普通的暖色调影楼感；避免现代婚纱照风格；避免韩式商业影楼外观；避免塑料感的皮肤修饰；避免过于干净清晰；避免网红风格摄影；避免廉价的“仙女”风；避免杂乱的背景；避免水印和 Logo。

templates.title: Fictional Science Infographic Generator

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构科学信息图生成器

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Create a comical scientific explanation illustration. The verification theme is "{argument name="validation theme" default="How many banana peels are needed to make a car slip?"}"

A vertical A4 manga-style infographic that seriously verifies absurd questions with science and calculations. White background, thick black lines, and emphasis colors of red, blue, and yellow. A design reminiscent of retro educational manga, science reference books, or scientific columns. Use a professor character, surprised people, speech bubbles, hand-drawn arrows, red pen annotations, and chalkboard-style formula boxes. The overall atmosphere should be 'using physics to verify a silly question with full effort,' making it fun, energetic, and not too serious.

Structure:

1. 
Depict the theme's situation in an exaggerated and ridiculous way that is understood at a glance. The characters are trying their best, but the appearance is quite reckless. The professor interjects with a comment from the side.

2. Thinking with Real Numbers
Display 3 to 4 boxes of important values related to the theme, such as speed, time, distance, weight, force, temperature, or energy. Include comparison charts or timelines to clearly show the gap between 'human senses' and the 'scale of the phenomenon.'

3. Formula Corner
Draw necessary conditions or comparison formulas largely in chalkboard-style frames. Example: 'Required Ability > Human Limit' 'Reaction Time < Time Phenomenon Occurs' 'Required Force/Speed/Durability ≫ Normal Human.' Formulas don't need to be strictly accurate; keep them intuitive and easy to understand.

4. Is Realization Impossible?
Explain problem points using three small panels. Example: ① Too fast / Too heavy / Too hot ② Precision is too severe ③ Even if successful, the body won't hold out / Surroundings will be in trouble. Include comical failure illustrations, onomatopoeia, and speech bubbles.

5. What If It Was Realized?
Make this part important. Illustrate what superhuman or speculative scientific abilities would be needed to actually succeed. For example, super reflexes, future prediction, abnormal grip strength, ultra-high-speed vision, physical ability to ignore air resistance, or a skeleton that can withstand impact. If necessary, use scientifically impossible numbers like 'reaction speed 0.0001s,' 'grip strength 3000kg,' or 'dynamic vision dozens of times that of a fighter pilot.' Furthermore, depict what happens the moment it is realized. Example: an impact that blows an arm off, sinking into the ground, shockwaves in the surroundings, while the person themselves remains calm. Bring out the 'if successful, they are no longer human' feeling in a fun way.

6. Conclusion
Write the conclusion largely in a red highlighted frame. 'Conclusion: XX is almost impossible for a normal human!' or 'Even if realized, it would be at a superhuman, cyborg, or speculative science level!' Summarize it in a way that states it's impossible for real humans but achievable with speculative scientific abilities.

Design Specifications: Manga paneling + science illustrations + professor's commentary. Use thick headings, red circles, emphasis lines, hand-drawn notes, and speech bubbles frequently. Formulas and numerical values should be large and easy to read, conveying the message intuitively even to children. Finish it like a page from an interesting science reading that is absurd yet strangely convincing.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个趣味科学解释插图。验证主题为“{argument name="validation theme" default="需要多少个香蕉皮才能让一辆车打滑？"}”。

一张 A4 竖版漫画风格的信息图，用科学和计算严谨地验证荒诞问题。白色背景，粗黑线条，强调色为红、蓝、黄。设计风格让人联想到复古教育漫画、科学参考书或科学专栏。使用教授角色、惊讶的路人、对话气泡、手绘箭头、红笔批注以及黑板风格的公式框。整体氛围应为“全力以赴用物理学验证一个愚蠢的问题”，既有趣、充满活力，又不会过于严肃。

结构：

1. 开篇
以夸张且荒谬的方式描绘主题情境，让人一眼就能看懂。角色们正在全力以赴，但看起来相当鲁莽。教授在一旁插话评论。

2. 用真实数据思考
展示 3 到 4 个与主题相关的重要数值框，例如速度、时间、距离、重量、力、温度或能量。包含对比图表或时间轴，清晰展示“人类感官”与“现象规模”之间的差距。

3. 公式角
在黑板风格的框中大篇幅绘制必要条件或对比公式。示例：“所需能力 > 人类极限”、“反应时间 < 现象发生时间”、“所需力/速度/耐力 ≫ 普通人类”。公式不需要绝对精确，保持直观易懂即可。

4. 实现可能吗？
用三个小分镜解释问题点。示例：① 太快 / 太重 / 太热 ② 精度要求太严苛 ③ 即使成功，身体也承受不住 / 周围环境会遭殃。包含滑稽的失败插图、拟声词和对话气泡。

5. 如果实现了会怎样？
让这部分成为重点。描绘实际成功所需的超人类或推测性科学能力。例如：超强反射神经、未来预测、异常握力、超高速视觉、无视空气阻力的身体素质，或能承受冲击的骨骼。如有必要，使用科学上不可能的数字，如“反应速度 0.0001 秒”、“握力 3000kg”、“比战斗机飞行员高几十倍的动态视力”。此外，描绘实现瞬间的情景。示例：手臂被震飞、陷入地面、周围产生冲击波，而当事人却保持冷静。以有趣的方式带出“如果成功了，他们就不再是人类”的感觉。

6. 结论
在红色高亮框中大篇幅写下结论。“结论：XX 对普通人类来说几乎是不可能的！”或“即使实现，也需要达到超人类、半机械人或推测科学的水平！”总结时要说明这对真实人类是不可能的，但可以通过推测性科学能力实现。

设计规范：漫画分镜 + 科学插图 + 教授评论。频繁使用粗标题、红圈、强调线、手绘笔记和对话气泡。公式和数值应足够大且易于阅读，即使是孩子也能直观地理解传达的信息。最终效果应像是一页有趣且荒诞但又出奇令人信服的科学读物。

templates.prompt:

templates.title: Summer Selfie Sticker Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季自拍贴纸拼贴画

templates.prompt: Please use the uploaded portrait as a reference. Create a 2x2 summer selfie collage with a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} vertical aspect ratio, comprising four panels. Ensure that the facial features remain consistent, with soft, youthful features, a warm smile and natural skin texture. In each panel, depict the character outdoors in bright summer sunshine, wearing a straw hat. Have her strike a variety of poses across the four panels: a peace sign selfie, a pose cupping her face with her hands, an OK gesture, and a relaxed close-up selfie. Keep the composition cute, lively and casual. Add colourful, watercolour-style hand-drawn doodles around her: soft outlines around her body and hat, floating soap bubbles, small hearts, simple sun drawings, sparkles, and cute little animal stickers. Ensure the doodles have a playful, hand-drawn feel, like mobile phone photo stickers. Remove all watermarks, logos, AI labels, app labels and signature marks. Keep the decorative handwritten text, but replace it with neat, legible words such as {argument name="sticker labels" default="‘Sheena’, ‘sunny’, ‘cute day’ and ‘summer’"}. Make ‘{argument name="main text" default="happy day"}’ the most prominent text. Ensure the text looks like colourful, hand-drawn sticker lettering. Style: Soft Korean/Japanese-style summer selfie aesthetic, bright yet subtle sunlight, fresh colours, a slight film-like softness, a refreshing outdoor atmosphere, cute social media collages, clean ultra-high-resolution images. Elements to remove: Watermarks, logos, brand marks, AI labels, signatures, QR codes, random text, illegible characters, misspelled ‘happy day’, long captions, cluttered typography, unnecessary people, duplicate faces within a single panel, distorted faces, asymmetrical eyes, plastic-looking skin, excessively smooth skin, blurry faces, lack of detail, unnatural body proportions, distorted hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, twisted arms, severe overexposure, dull colours, severe compression artefacts, dark and underexposed panels.

Let the figures naturally embody the city's local fashion and daily lifestyle - Fill the background with realistic local signage, cafés, restaurants, transit signs, storefronts, and architectural detail - Weave landmarks organically into the everyday scene, never exaggerated or hero-shot - Include authentic local-language type and culturally specific visual cues - Large bold typography centered at the top: "{argument name="destination name" default="TOKYO"}" - Subtitle directly below: local language + country name STYLE: ultra clean vector illustration, Swiss modernist travel poster, minimal line art, monoline drawing, mid-century editorial feel, architectural illustration, Japanese graphic poster aesthetic, precise geometric perspective, extremely clean negative space, premium travel branding look LINE STYLE: - monochrome line-based illustration only - thin, highly precise linework - minimal fill areas - city-map-like detail density - rhythmic layering of signs, buildings, windows, and street objects - visually dense yet tightly organized composition COLOR SYSTEM — VERY IMPORTANT: - use only ONE main color + ONE background color - pick a color that best captures the city's atmosphere - monochrome silkscreen poster vibe - no rainbow palettes - no excessive neon - color should mirror the city's architecture, climate, nightlife, and cultural identity COMPOSITION: - She is adjusting her hair with one hand .. She notices the camera and gives a small natural smile, slightly surprised but composed. Use a realistic far-distance broadcast camera look: telephoto compression, mild video softness, slight motion blur in the crowd, stadium lighting, natural skin texture, imperfect candid framing, 16:9 horizontal TV broadcast composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 将上传的参考图作为最核心的身份锚点。画面中的女性必须与参考图中的成年女性完全一致，而不仅仅是相似的韩国女性。高优先级保留其精确的面部特征：相同的鹅蛋脸、精致的下颌线、明亮的大眼睛、眼间距、眼睑形状、笔直的鼻梁、柔和的淡粉色嘴唇、白皙通透的肤色、优雅冷静的神情，以及长款黑色微卷发。创作一张超写实的 KBO 棒球转播截图，展现同一位女性在观众席被现场电视摄像机意外捕捉到的瞬间。球队名称为 LG 和 F1。她的面部特征应更接近参考图，而非普通的球场观众。请勿将其替换为他人。不要让她的脸型变宽、变老、轮廓变锐利、西化或呈现偶像化。保持与参考图一致的精致摄影棚肖像感，并将其自然地融入真实的球场环境中。她坐在热闹的韩国棒球观众席中，手持冰饮和加油棒，身穿干净的白色棒球衫，内搭简约便装。她正用一只手整理头发……她注意到了镜头，露出了一个自然的小微笑，略带惊讶但神情从容。采用真实的远距离转播摄像机视角：长焦压缩感、轻微的视频柔焦、观众席的轻微动态模糊、球场灯光、真实的皮肤纹理、不完美的抓拍构图，以及 16:9 横屏电视转播构图。

templates.title: Isometric Cloud Logistics UI Icon

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴测云物流 UI 图标

templates.prompt: Create a clean minimalist isometric line-art illustration on an off-white background with faint light-gray perspective grid lines. Show a rounded rectangular web browser window standing upright on a thick rounded rectangular platform base, drawn with thin black outlines and mostly white fill. Above the browser, a large outlined cloud icon floats, connected to the browser by a thin vertical black line with a short dotted segment near the cloud, suggesting cloud connectivity. Inside the browser window, include a simple outlined delivery car icon carrying a small package on its roof, centered in the lower area. The browser top bar has a small blue back chevron on the left, a long horizontal black address line, and a shorter horizontal line on the right. On the right side of the browser face, place a translucent blue circular button containing a short diagonal black slash. Extending from the right edge of the browser is a thin black connector line leading to a small solid periwinkle-blue circular node, with a tiny red rounded square port at the browser edge. Use sparse accent colors only: {argument name="accent blue" default="periwinkle blue"} for the node and UI highlights, {argument name="accent red" default="soft red"} for the small port, and black outlines. Keep the composition centered, airy, technical, and modern, with no text, no shadows except subtle depth from the isometric outlines, and a vector-icon style suitable for a SaaS cloud logistics concept.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅简洁的极简主义等轴测线条艺术插图，背景为灰白色，带有淡淡的浅灰色透视网格线。展示一个圆角矩形网页浏览器窗口，直立于厚实的圆角矩形底座上，采用细黑色轮廓和大部分白色填充绘制。浏览器上方浮动着一个巨大的轮廓云图标，通过一条细垂直黑线与浏览器相连，云朵附近有一小段虚线，暗示云端连接。在浏览器窗口内，包含一个简单的轮廓配送车图标，车顶载有一个小包裹，位于下方区域中心。浏览器顶部栏左侧有一个小的蓝色返回箭头，中间有一条长的水平黑色地址栏，右侧有一条较短的水平线。在浏览器正面的右侧，放置一个半透明的蓝色圆形按钮，其中包含一条短的对角黑色斜线。从浏览器右边缘延伸出一条细黑色连接线，通向一个小型的纯长春花蓝色圆形节点，浏览器边缘处有一个微小的红色圆角方形端口。仅使用少量强调色：{argument name="accent blue" default="长春花蓝"} 用于节点和 UI 高亮，{argument name="accent red" default="柔和红"} 用于小端口，以及黑色轮廓。保持构图居中、通透、具有科技感和现代感，无文字，除等轴测轮廓带来的微妙深度感外无阴影，采用适合 SaaS 云物流概念的矢量图标风格。

Both figures should look like realistic cosplay fashion models with porcelain doll styling, but their faces are intentionally hidden by flat opaque muted taupe rectangular censor blocks centered over each face. Use rich nocturnal color grading, high contrast, cinematic street photography realism, shallow depth of field, wet reflective surfaces, glowing bokeh, detailed velvet and satin textures, and an atmospheric urban gothic fashion editorial mood.

templates.prompt: Create a realistic smartphone-style candid photo of a {argument name="subject" default="young Japanese woman"} seated indoors at a cafe, photographed by someone else rather than as a selfie. She is centered in a vertical portrait composition, shown from about mid-torso upward, facing the camera with a gentle smile. She has {argument name="hair color and style" default="dark brown, shoulder-length softly wavy hair with a natural center part"} and wears a {argument name="outfit" default="cream white ribbed knit cardigan with small front buttons"}, with a delicate small necklace barely visible at the collar. Use natural daylight from a large window on the right side, soft realistic skin tones, casual phone-camera perspective, and slight background depth. The cafe background includes a wooden counter on the left rear, warm pendant lighting, a pastry/display case, bottles and small decor on the counter, a chalkboard menu with handwritten seasonal items, black chairs and tables, gray tile flooring, and a large black-framed window on the right showing green plants outside. The mood should be everyday, authentic, and unpolished, like a real photo taken in a modern Japanese cafe. Keep the subject looking directly toward the lens; do not make it a selfie, studio portrait, fashion shoot, or heavily edited image. Use portrait orientation, realistic lighting, natural colors, and smartphone photo quality.

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical portrait of a young adult East Asian woman sitting indoors beside a bright sunlit window, shown from the chest up in a close three-quarter side profile facing right. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long glossy dark brown hair"}, straight with soft natural layers and a few loose strands catching the light, falling over her shoulder and down her back. She wears a simple {argument name="top color" default="cream white"} sleeveless ribbed knit camisole, with bare shoulders visible and a relaxed seated posture. The face is intentionally obscured by a large centered square privacy mask in a warm brown skin-tone gradient, covering the entire facial area from forehead to chin. The setting is a clean modern room with pale walls, a blue-gray chair partially visible, and a wooden-framed window on the right; outside the window is a softly blurred urban view with daylight. Use warm natural sunlight, backlighting and rim light through the hair, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, soft highlights, high-resolution DSLR photography style, intimate lifestyle portrait composition, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.

titleLocalized.zh: 绯红法师河畔马车之旅

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anime fantasy travel scene in a wide 16:9 composition. Show exactly 1 young female mage, {argument name="character name" default="the scarlet magician"}, leaning out of the open window of an ornate black horse-drawn carriage on the right side of the frame, smiling with wonder as she looks left toward the landscape. She has {argument name="hair color" default="short silver-white hair"} with soft bangs, red underlayer accents near the ends, red eyes, and exactly 1 red flower hair ornament by her ear. Her outfit is a white blouse with a red ribbon tie, a dark hooded cloak with crimson lining, and delicate fantasy-school uniform details. The carriage is glossy black with gold trim, carved panels, a hanging lantern, dark curtains inside, and warm glowing ember-like magic particles drifting around the window; exactly 1 brown horse is partially visible pulling it along a narrow riverside dirt road. The left and center of the image open into a bright summer valley: a sparkling blue river running into the distance, rocky shoreline, wooden fence posts along the road, lush green shrubs and overhanging tree branches framing the top left, forested hills and distant blue mountains under a clear sky with scattered white clouds. Use radiant midday sunlight, shimmering water highlights, soft breeze moving the girl’s hair and cloak, high-detail anime rendering, painterly background, strong depth, warm adventurous mood, and crisp focus on the girl and carriage with the river valley receding into atmospheric perspective. No text, no logos, no modern vehicles.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅 16:9 宽画幅的电影感动漫奇幻旅行场景。画面右侧展示 1 位年轻女性法师，{argument name="character name" default="绯红魔法师"}，从华丽的黑色马车敞开的窗户探出身子，好奇地微笑着望向左侧的风景。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色短发"}，配有柔软的刘海，发梢带有绯红色挑染，红色双眸，耳边别着 1 朵红色花朵发饰。身穿白色衬衫，系着红色丝带，外披深色连帽斗篷，内衬为深红色，细节处带有精致的奇幻学院制服元素。马车呈亮黑色，带有金色装饰、雕花板和悬挂的灯笼，车内挂着深色窗帘，窗边漂浮着温暖的余烬状魔法粒子；画面中可见 1 匹棕色马正拉着马车行驶在狭窄的河畔土路上。画面左侧和中心展现出一片明亮的夏季山谷：湛蓝的河流闪烁着波光向远方延伸，岩石嶙峋的岸边，路旁立着木栅栏，郁郁葱葱的灌木和悬垂的树枝构成了左上方的框架，森林覆盖的丘陵和远处的蓝色山脉在晴朗的天空和零星白云下若隐若现。采用明亮的午后阳光，水面闪烁着高光，微风吹动女孩的头发和斗篷，高细节动漫渲染，手绘风格背景，强烈的景深感，温暖的冒险氛围，焦点清晰地聚焦在女孩和马车上，河谷呈现出大气透视效果。无文字，无标志，无现代交通工具。

templates.title: Sunlit Censored Portrait

She has {argument name="hair color and style" default="long straight dark brown hair with a center part, falling over one shoulder"}, fair skin, a slim build, and wears {argument name="outfit" default="a simple off-white camisole with thin straps"} plus a small gold hoop earring visible on one ear. Frame her from the upper torso upward in a close, intimate composition, angled slightly from above and to the side, with her shoulder and collarbone catching warm natural light. Her face is intentionally obscured by one large opaque square censor block centered over the face, colored with a soft brown-to-taupe muted gradient, covering the eyes, nose, and mouth while leaving the hair, ear, neck, shoulder, and clothing visible. The background should be softly blurred with white window frames, pale curtains, hints of greenery, and bright morning sunlight, using shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, glossy hair highlights, natural shadows, and a clean lifestyle photography aesthetic. Use {argument name="lighting" default="warm natural window light with gentle backlighting"} and a high-resolution camera look, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖版肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的东亚女性"}，她正坐在明亮且阳光充足的窗边，身处一个柔和、通透的房间内。她拥有 {argument name="hair color and style" default="中分的长直深棕色头发，垂在一侧肩头"}，皮肤白皙，身材苗条，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件简单的米白色细肩带吊带衫"}，一侧耳朵上戴着一枚小巧的金色圆环耳饰。采用近距离、亲密的构图，从上半身开始取景，拍摄角度略微从上方和侧面切入，让她的肩膀和锁骨捕捉到温暖的自然光。她的面部被一个位于正中央的大型不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住，遮挡块呈现出从棕色到灰褐色的柔和哑光渐变，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，同时露出头发、耳朵、脖子、肩膀和衣物。背景应进行柔焦处理，呈现出白色窗框、浅色窗帘、隐约的绿植和明亮的晨光，运用浅景深、真实的皮肤纹理、有光泽的头发高光、自然的阴影，营造出干净的生活方式摄影美感。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="温暖的自然窗光和柔和的逆光"}，呈现高分辨率相机质感，竖版 2:3 纵横比。

templates.title: Night Forest Fantasy Camp

templates.prompt: Create a dark cinematic anime-style travel camp scene at night in a dense forest, widescreen 16:9 composition. Two travelers rest beside a small campfire: on the left, a petite young girl with {argument name="girl hair color" default="short silver-white hair"}, a red flower hair ornament, a black cloak with deep crimson lining over a white blouse, red ribbon tie, dark tights, and black loafers, sitting on a low stump or stool while holding a plate of food and eating; on the right, a tall adult male knight or mage escort in an ornate black military uniform with gold trim, high collar, brass buttons, leather belts, gloves, tall boots, circular cloak clasps, and a sweeping black cloak lined in burgundy, seated calmly while holding a metal cup and a piece of bread. Both faces are deliberately covered by plain soft-edged beige rectangular censor blocks. In the center foreground, a bright orange campfire burns under a tripod supporting a black cooking pot filled with stew, casting warm light onto the characters and ground. Surround the campsite with travel props: exactly 10 visible camp and travel items including one brass lantern glowing on a wooden crate at far left, one metal cup near it, one loaf of bread on the crate, one cutting board with sliced cured meat, one shallow bowl of food, one stacked wooden chest at right, one rolled bedroll on top of the chest, one leather satchel in the lower right foreground, one sheathed sword leaning beside the luggage, and one horse-drawn carriage in the dark right background with a horse partly visible. The environment is a deep blue-black forest with tall tree trunks, heavy shadows, subtle foliage, and a dirt clearing; lighting should be moody and painterly with strong warm firelight, cool moonlit shadows, detailed textures, high-quality fantasy illustration, dramatic travel-story atmosphere, and no on-image text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个深邃森林中夜间旅行营地的电影级动漫风格场景，采用 16:9 宽屏构图。两名旅人正在小篝火旁休息：左侧是一位娇小的少女，留着 {argument name="girl hair color" default="短银白色头发"}，佩戴红色花朵发饰，身穿带有深红色内衬的黑色披风，内搭白色衬衫，系着红色丝带，穿着深色连裤袜和黑色乐福鞋，坐在矮树桩或凳子上，手里拿着餐盘正在进食；右侧是一位高大的成年男性骑士或法师护卫，身穿带有金色饰边的华丽黑色军装，高领，配有黄铜纽扣、皮带、手套、高筒靴、圆形披风扣，以及一件内衬为酒红色的黑色长披风，神态从容地坐着，手里拿着金属杯和一块面包。两人的面部均被刻意遮盖，使用边缘柔和的米色矩形遮挡块。画面中心前景处，明亮的橙色篝火在三脚架下方燃烧，架子上挂着一口装满炖菜的黑色烹饪锅，将温暖的光芒投射在角色和地面上。营地周围布置旅行道具：包含 10 件清晰可见的露营和旅行物品，包括最左侧木箱上发光的黄铜灯笼、旁边的金属杯、木箱上的面包、一块放有切片腌肉的切菜板、一浅碗食物、右侧堆叠的木箱、木箱顶部的卷起睡袋、右下角前景的皮挎包、靠在行李旁的一把带鞘长剑，以及右侧黑暗背景中隐约可见的马车和部分马匹。环境为深蓝黑色的森林，有高大的树干、浓重的阴影、细腻的植被和泥土空地；光影应呈现出电影般的绘画质感，强烈的暖色火光与冷色月影形成对比，纹理细节丰富，高质量奇幻插画风格，营造出戏剧性的旅行故事氛围，画面中无任何文字。

templates.title: Fantasy Capital Arrival Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻都城抵达场景

templates.prompt: Create a sweeping cinematic fantasy travel scene in ultra-detailed painterly realism: a lone horse-drawn carriage, viewed from behind, carries exactly 2 seated travelers down a straight pale dirt road toward a vast walled capital city. The road forms a strong central vanishing point and is bordered by exactly 2 rustic wooden fence lines running through open green meadows dotted with wildflowers, rocks, and small trees. In the distance, show a majestic medieval magical city with a continuous stone wall, dense rooftops, many narrow spires, and a grand central cathedral-like castle crowned by tall black-blue Gothic towers; include arched bridges crossing calm waterways on both the left and right sides of the city. The sun is low near the left horizon at {argument name="time of day" default="golden-hour sunset"}, casting warm amber light, long shadows, and glowing highlights across the fields, while the sky is broad and blue with scattered small clouds and faint birds. Surround the city with rolling hills and distant mountains, giving an epic sense of arrival after a journey. Use a {argument name="visual style" default="high-fantasy cinematic concept art"} look, panoramic 16:9 composition, rich atmospheric perspective, intricate architecture, soft volumetric light, natural colors, highly detailed but romantic and serene, no text, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅极具电影感的宏大奇幻旅行场景，呈现超细腻的绘画写实风格：从后方视角望去，一辆孤零零的马车正载着 2 名旅人，沿着笔直的浅色土路向一座巨大的围城都城驶去。道路形成了强烈的中心灭点，两侧各有 2 排质朴的木栅栏，延伸穿过点缀着野花、岩石和小树的开阔绿草地。远景处，展示一座雄伟的中世纪魔法城市，拥有连绵的石墙、密集的屋顶、许多狭窄的尖塔，以及一座宏伟的中心大教堂式城堡，城堡顶部耸立着高大的黑蓝色哥特式塔楼；城市左右两侧需包含横跨平静水道的拱桥。太阳位于左侧地平线附近，时间为 {argument name="time of day" default="黄金时段日落"}，投射出温暖的琥珀色光芒，在原野上留下长长的阴影和明亮的辉光，天空广阔而湛蓝，点缀着稀疏的云朵和隐约可见的飞鸟。城市四周环绕着连绵起伏的丘陵和远山，营造出长途跋涉后抵达目的地的史诗感。采用 {argument name="visual style" default="高魔电影概念艺术"} 风格，16:9 全景构图，丰富的空气透视感，精细的建筑细节，柔和的体积光，色彩自然，细节丰富且充满浪漫与宁静感，无文字，无现代物体。

templates.title: Forest Camp Magic Battle

titleLocalized.zh: 森林营地魔法之战

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic dark-fantasy anime travel-camp scene at night in a dense forest, widescreen 16:9 composition, highly detailed painterly concept art. In the left foreground, a small campfire glows orange beneath a hanging black kettle on a three-legged tripod, with exactly 4 visible camp props around it: a brass lantern, a metal mug, stacked wooden crates or luggage, and a rolled log or bedroll. Beside the fire sits a young girl mage, {argument name="girl hair color" default="pale silver-pink"} bobbed hair with a red flower hair ornament, wearing a white blouse, red ribbon tie, dark cloak, and travel skirt, looking upward with anxious admiration. Center frame stands a tall adult male sorcerer-guard, {argument name="male outfit color" default="black military coat with gold trim"}, high collar, belts, gloves, boots, and a sweeping cape with deep red lining; his face is intentionally indistinct and shadowed, one arm extended forward in a protective spellcasting gesture. From his raised hand, radiant golden magic erupts in broad arcing ribbons and sparkling particles, sweeping from center-left to the right side like a barrier or wind slash. On the right half of the image, show exactly 5 hostile shadow-beasts made of twisted bark, feathers, smoke, and debris: one lunging beast near the center glow, one large birdlike beast tumbling in the lower right foreground, one spiked monster in the mid-right, one dragonlike creature in the upper right, and one partially hidden creature in the dark left background. The golden spell blasts leaves, dirt, splinters, and embers through the air while the forest behind remains nearly black with faint trunks and foliage. Mood: {argument name="mood" default="heroic protection during a dangerous journey"}; lighting: strong warm firelight and magical gold against cool blue-black shadows; style: {argument name="art style" default="epic Japanese fantasy light-novel illustration"}, ultra-detailed, dramatic motion, volumetric sparks, atmospheric depth, no text, no frame, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级暗黑奇幻动漫风格的夜间森林旅行营地场景，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，高细节绘画概念艺术。左侧前景中，一个小型篝火在三脚架悬挂的黑色水壶下发出橙色光芒，篝火周围有 4 个清晰可见的营地道具：一盏黄铜灯、一个金属马克杯、堆叠的木箱或行李，以及一个卷起的原木或睡袋。火堆旁坐着一位年轻的女性法师，留着 {argument name="girl hair color" default="淡粉银色"} 波波头，戴着红色花朵发饰，身穿白色衬衫、红色丝带领结、深色斗篷和旅行裙，正抬头仰望，神情中带着焦虑与钦佩。画面中心站着一位高大的成年男性术士守卫，身穿 {argument name="male outfit color" default="带有金色饰边的黑色军装大衣"}，高领、腰带、手套、靴子，披着深红色内衬的飘逸斗篷；他的面部故意模糊并隐没在阴影中，一只手臂向前伸展，做出保护性的施法姿势。从他抬起的手中，耀眼的金色魔法喷涌而出，形成宽阔的弧形光带和闪烁的粒子，像屏障或风刃一样从中心向右侧横扫。在画面右半部分，展示 5 只由扭曲的树皮、羽毛、烟雾和碎片组成的敌对暗影兽：一只在中心光芒附近猛扑的野兽，一只在右下前景翻滚的大型鸟状野兽，一只在右中方的带刺怪物，一只在右上方的龙形生物，以及一只在左后方黑暗中半隐蔽的生物。金色法术将树叶、泥土、碎片和余烬卷入空中，而身后的森林则保持近乎全黑，仅可见模糊的树干和枝叶。氛围：{argument name="mood" default="危险旅途中的英勇守护"}；光效：强烈的暖色火光与魔法金光对比冷蓝黑色的阴影；风格：{argument name="art style" default="史诗级日本奇幻轻小说插画"}，超高细节，充满戏剧性的动态感，体积感火花，大气深度，无文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Neferpitou Villain Wallpaper Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Neferpitou 反派壁纸海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime character wallpaper poster in a painterly semi-realistic style, featuring {argument name="character name" default="Neferpitou"} from {argument name="series title" default="Hunter × Hunter"}. The composition is a tall 9:16 portrait with the character occupying the right two-thirds of the image, shown from about mid-thigh up in elegant side profile facing left, with a faint mischievous smile and sharp amber-red catlike eyes. The character has pale skin, large cat ears, a long pale cat tail curling along the right edge, and messy short-to-medium wavy {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with thick curls and tousled bangs. Dress the character in a dark navy high-collared royal guard uniform coat, fitted at the waist, with a row of large round gold buttons catching the light. Use dramatic warm backlighting from the upper left, subtle rim light on the hair and ears, deep navy shadows on the clothing, and a muted parchment-beige textured background with visible brush grain and aged poster atmosphere. On the left side, design a clean editorial typographic layout: one small dark cat silhouette icon near the upper left, one small gold crown icon below it, the huge condensed uppercase navy title text "NEFERPITOU" placed in the lower-left middle, with a tiny red diamond ornament inside or beside the title, the subtitle "HUNTER × HUNTER" in spaced small caps beneath it, a quote reading {argument name="quote" default="How curious... I do so love games."}, then a row of exactly 4 small muted icons described left to right as a circular emblem, a chimera-ant face emblem, a cat-head emblem, and a crown emblem. Under the icons, add five short uppercase description lines: "A ROYAL GUARD.", "A CAT OF THE CHIMERA ANTS.", "BEAUTIFUL. DEADLY.", "PLAYFUL. TERRIFYING.", and "THE KING'S MOST LOYAL." Add thin horizontal divider lines and tiny red diamond accents as decorative separators. Keep all typography aligned to the left with generous negative space, like a premium character key art poster. No extra characters, no modern objects, no speech bubbles, no frame border.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张油画半写实风格的竖版动漫角色壁纸海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Neferpitou"}，出自 {argument name="series title" default="Hunter × Hunter"}。构图采用 9:16 的竖向比例，角色占据画面右侧三分之二，呈现大腿中部以上的优雅侧身像，面朝左侧，带着一丝狡黠的微笑，拥有一双锐利的琥珀红色猫眼。角色皮肤白皙，长有巨大的猫耳，一条修长的浅色猫尾沿着右侧边缘卷曲，凌乱的中短波浪状 {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} 头发带有浓密的卷曲和蓬松的刘海。角色身着深海军蓝高领皇家卫队制服外套，腰部修身，一排巨大的圆形金色纽扣在光线下闪烁。使用来自左上方的戏剧性暖色背光，头发和耳朵边缘带有微妙的轮廓光，衣物上有深海军蓝色的阴影，背景为柔和的羊皮纸米色纹理，带有明显的笔触感和陈旧海报的氛围。在左侧设计简洁的编辑排版：左上方附近有一个小型深色猫咪剪影图标，下方有一个小型金色皇冠图标，巨大的压缩大写海军蓝色标题文本“NEFERPITOU”位于左下中部，标题内部或旁边配有一个微小的红色菱形装饰，下方是间距较大的小写字母副标题“HUNTER × HUNTER”，引语为 {argument name="quote" default="How curious... I do so love games."}，随后是一排正好 4 个柔和的小图标，从左到右依次为：圆形徽章、嵌合蚁脸部徽章、猫头徽章和皇冠徽章。在图标下方，添加五行简短的大写描述文字：“A ROYAL GUARD.”、“A CAT OF THE CHIMERA ANTS.”、“BEAUTIFUL. DEADLY.”、“PLAYFUL. TERRIFYING.” 以及 “THE KING'S MOST LOYAL.”。添加细水平分割线和微小的红色菱形装饰作为分隔符。保持所有排版左对齐，并留出充裕的负空间，呈现出高级角色关键视觉海报的效果。不包含额外角色、现代物品、对话气泡或边框。

templates.title: Anime Cherry Blossom Rock Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫樱花摇滚专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square anime-style CD jacket cover illustration for a sentimental Japanese school rock ballad. The scene shows a beautiful teenage girl standing on a cherry-blossom-lined path outside a school campus at golden-hour sunset, turned slightly back toward the viewer with a calm, wistful expression. She has very long flowing black hair, soft red-brown eyes, pale skin, and wears a frilly ivory blouse with ruffled sleeves and a layered pale lavender-gray skirt, giving a romantic gothic-lolita school-uniform feeling. She holds a glossy black electric guitar with chrome hardware and a shoulder strap across her body, the guitar angled diagonally in the lower right foreground. Cherry blossom branches fill the upper left and top edge, with pink petals drifting through the warm orange air; the background includes a school gate, fence, trees, and softly blurred school buildings bathed in sunset light. Use highly detailed painterly anime rendering, warm cinematic lighting, delicate linework, emotional album-cover composition, rich peach, coral, amber, and rose tones, soft depth of field, nostalgic atmosphere, and subtle film-grain texture. Add exactly two visible text elements in elegant Japanese typography: the large title {argument name="album title" default="放課後の約束"} placed on the left side in translucent deep red, and the smaller artist name {argument name="artist name" default="朱内 愛"} below it. Keep the text integrated like professional music cover art, with no extra logos, borders, track lists, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张方形动漫风格的 CD 封面插图，用于一首感伤的日本校园摇滚抒情曲。场景描绘了一位美丽的少女站在校园外樱花盛开的小径上，时间处于金色的夕阳时刻，她微微回首，神情平静而惆怅。她留着一头飘逸的长黑发，有着柔和的红棕色双眸和白皙的皮肤，身穿带有荷叶边袖口的象牙白衬衫，搭配层叠的淡薰衣草灰半身裙，呈现出浪漫的哥特萝莉校园制服感。她怀抱一把带有铬合金配件的亮黑色电吉他，吉他斜跨在身体前方，位于右下角前景。樱花枝叶布满左上角和顶部边缘，粉色的花瓣在温暖的橙色空气中飘落；背景包括校门、围栏、树木以及沐浴在夕阳余晖中略显模糊的教学楼。采用高细节的绘画风动漫渲染、温暖的电影级光影、精致的线条、富有情感的专辑封面构图，运用丰富的桃色、珊瑚色、琥珀色和玫瑰色调，营造出柔和的景深、怀旧的氛围以及细腻的胶片颗粒质感。画面中需包含两个清晰可见的优雅日文字体元素：左侧放置半透明深红色的主标题 {argument name="album title" default="放课後の約束"}，以及下方较小的艺术家名称 {argument name="artist name" default="朱内 愛"}。保持文字与专业音乐封面艺术的融合感，不要添加额外的标志、边框、曲目列表或水印。

templates.prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the presenter photo, create a soft, elegant Japanese online seminar flyer in a warm beige/pink watercolor stationery style. Keep the presenter’s hair, outfit, earrings, and anonymized face block consistent, but crop her into the left side of the flyer and extend/generate her upper body so she is smiling toward the viewer with one arm raised and pointing to the event information on the right. Add delicate botanical line art, pale washi-tape textures, thin decorative borders, dotted accents, and pastel blush/gold highlights on an off-white background.

Design the flyer as a vertical event announcement with these discrete content areas: 1 large top headline area, 1 right-side event info card, 1 event theme strip, 1 host/organizer strip, and 3 bottom information cards.

Visible text to include:

Make the typography refined and airy, combining elegant Japanese Mincho-style serif text with a handwritten script for “ChatGPT Images 2.0”. Use {argument name="event date and time" default="5/9（土）22:00〜"}, {argument name="main headline" default="AI画像生成を楽しく学ぼう！"}, {argument name="presenter names" default="かなまる × おじぎねこ"}, {argument name="event platform" default="Peatix"}, and {argument name="theme text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0を使った やさしいAI画像生成入門"}.

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the woman/hairstyle/outfit base, transform it into a soft beige lifestyle magazine infographic poster. Extend the portrait into a full-body standing pose: she is holding a neutral tote bag on one shoulder, one hand in her trouser pocket, wearing coordinated cream/white office-casual styling; keep the face anonymized/softly blurred as in the reference. Create an elegant scrapbook layout on an off-white background with blush tape, tiny hearts, botanical doodles, paper textures, and handwritten serif/cursive typography. Add the main title {argument name="headline text" default="bag check"} with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="daily things"}. On the right, add a paper card titled {argument name="section title" default="What’s in my bag?"} and arrange exactly 14 labeled daily-essential items in a clean flat-lay: 1 pouch, 2 handkerchief, 3 perfume, 4 lip product, 5 face compact, 6 wallet, 7 notebook, 8 pen, 9 smartphone, 10 snack, 11 card case, 12 keys, 13 earphones, 14 hand cream. Include a large beige tote bag at the lower right labeled as the bag, plus exactly 2 small inset lifestyle photos: one cafe photo at the lower left and one desk/coffee photo at the lower right. Add a small checklist titled "today’s outfit" with exactly 5 checked items: jacket, knit, pants, bag, pumps. Use a minimalist Japanese/Korean cafe-aesthetic palette of cream, taupe, beige, pale pink, and warm gray, with airy spacing and delicate editorial composition. Make the poster tall and vertical, suitable for a social-media seminar/sample graphic.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为人物/发型/服装的基础，将其转换为柔和米色调的生活方式杂志风格信息图海报。将肖像延伸为全身站立姿势：她单肩背着一个中性色托特包，一只手插在裤兜里，身着协调的奶油色/白色商务休闲装；保持面部匿名/轻微模糊，与参考图一致。在米白色背景上创建优雅的剪贴簿布局，加入腮红粉色胶带、小爱心、植物涂鸦、纸张纹理以及手写衬线/草书字体。添加主标题 {argument name="headline text" default="bag check"} 和副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="daily things"}。在右侧添加一张名为 {argument name="section title" default="What’s in my bag?"} 的纸卡，并整齐排列 14 件带标签的日常必需品：1 收纳袋，2 手帕，3 香水，4 唇部产品，5 粉饼，6 钱包，7 笔记本，8 钢笔，9 智能手机，10 零食，11 卡包，12 钥匙，13 耳机，14 护手霜。在右下角加入一个大型米色托特包并标注名称，同时在左下角和右下角各加入 2 张小型生活方式插图：一张咖啡馆照片和一张书桌/咖啡照片。添加一个标题为“today’s outfit”的清单，包含 5 个已勾选项目：夹克、针织衫、裤子、包、高跟鞋。采用奶油色、灰褐色、米色、淡粉色和暖灰色的极简日韩咖啡馆审美配色，保持空气感间距和精致的编辑排版。海报需为长竖版，适合作为社交媒体研讨会/样图使用。

templates.title: Realistic Japanese Track Athlete

titleLocalized.zh: 写实风格日本田径运动员

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic vertical sports photograph of an adult {argument name="athlete nationality" default="Japanese"} female track-and-field sprinter on an outdoor stadium running track, framed from mid-thigh to above the head in a close portrait crop. She is leaning forward in a pre-race crouch with both arms extended downward, shoulders and upper body prominent, wearing a dark navy or black two-piece racing uniform with a sleeveless crop top and matching racing briefs, with thin red-and-white trim at the hips. Add a white competition bib pinned across her chest with red Japanese sponsor text and the visible race number {argument name="bib number" default="15-2"}, plus a small white Mizuno-style logo on the upper chest. Her {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is long and tied back in a low ponytail with loose strands catching the sunlight. Place a plain rectangular privacy blur or solid skin-toned block over the face, centered from forehead to chin, while keeping the ears, hairline, neck, shoulders, and body realistically visible. The setting is a sunny athletics stadium with a red running track, white lane markings, and a distant out-of-focus crowd and stands rendered as soft blue-gray bokeh. Use natural daylight, strong backlighting on the hair and shoulders, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, authentic sports-photo lens compression, high detail, candid professional photography style, no illustration, no anime, no glamour posing, no text other than the bib.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的竖构图运动照片，主角为一名成年 {argument name="athlete nationality" default="日本"} 女性田径短跑运动员，场景位于户外体育场跑道上，取景范围从大腿中部到头部上方，采用近景肖像构图。她正处于赛前蹲踞姿势，身体前倾，双臂向下伸展，肩膀和上半身突出，身穿深蓝色或黑色两件套竞赛服，包括无袖短款上衣和配套竞赛短裤，臀部有红白细边装饰。胸前别着一块白色比赛号码布，上面印有红色日文赞助商文字和清晰可见的参赛号码 {argument name="bib number" default="15-2"}，上胸部印有小巧的白色 Mizuno 风格标志。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 长发扎成低马尾，有几缕发丝在阳光下闪烁。在面部中心位置（从额头到下巴）添加一个简单的矩形隐私模糊遮罩或实色肤色块，同时保持耳朵、发际线、颈部、肩膀和身体的真实质感。背景为阳光明媚的田径场，有红色跑道、白色跑道线，远处的观众和看台呈现为柔和的蓝灰色虚化效果。使用自然光，头发和肩膀处有强烈的逆光效果，浅景深，真实的皮肤纹理，地道的体育摄影镜头压缩感，高细节，写实专业摄影风格，非插画，非动漫，无刻意摆拍，除号码布外无任何文字。

HAKODATE"} with a tiny anchor icon centered below. The main illustration is an extremely detailed pen-and-ink urban street scene looking downhill along tram tracks toward Hakodate Bay and a large rugged mountain in the distance with small antennas on the summit. Include a classic red-and-cream streetcar centered on the tracks, cars on the road, overhead utility wires, old streetlamps, traffic lights, sidewalks full of pedestrians, and a cyclist waiting on the right at a zebra crossing. Frame the street with historic Japanese storefronts and vertical signs, including visible signs for Hakodate Morning Market, Hakodate Beer Hall, Kita no Ryoba, Motomachi Park, Red Brick Warehouses, and Hakodate Station, mixing English with Japanese-style signage where appropriate. Add three prominent foreground crossing pedestrians: a woman in a light skirt on the left, a dark-suited schoolboy or office worker crossing center-left, and a schoolgirl in a pleated skirt crossing center; add one man walking on the right and one cyclist on the far right, for a total of five foreground human figures. In the lower margin, add centered Art Deco typography reading {argument name="country text" default="JAPAN"}, with smaller location text {argument name="location text" default="函館・北海道"} and {argument name="romanized location" default="HAKODATE, HOKKAIDO"}, separated by small red dots and thin decorative lines. The overall style should feel like a refined 1930s Japanese railway tourism poster combined with precise architectural line art, realistic perspective, nostalgic atmosphere, and crisp readable typography.

HAKODATE"}，并在正下方居中放置一个小巧的锚图标。主体插画是一幅极其细腻的钢笔淡彩城市街景，视角沿电车轨道向下俯瞰，远眺函馆湾及远处山顶带有小型天线的高耸崎岖山脉。画面需包含一辆位于轨道中央的经典红奶油色电车、路上的汽车、架空电线、老式路灯、交通信号灯、挤满行人的人行道，以及右侧斑马线上等待的骑行者。街道两侧点缀着历史悠久的日本店面和竖排招牌，包括清晰可见的“函馆朝市”、“函馆啤酒馆”、“北之番屋”、“元町公园”、“红砖仓库”和“函馆站”等招牌，并适当融合英文与日式风格的标识。在前景处添加三位醒目的过马路行人：左侧一位穿浅色裙子的女性、中左侧一位穿深色西装的学生或上班族、以及中侧一位穿百褶裙的女学生；右侧再增加一名步行男子和一名最右侧的骑行者，总计五个人物。在底部边缘，添加居中的装饰艺术风格文字 {argument name="country text" default="JAPAN"}，并配以较小的地点文字 {argument name="location text" default="函馆・北海道"} 和 {argument name="romanized location" default="HAKODATE, HOKKAIDO"}，中间以小红点和细装饰线分隔。整体风格应呈现出 1930 年代精致的日本铁路旅游海报质感，结合精准的建筑线条艺术、写实的透视效果、怀旧的氛围以及清晰易读的排版。

templates.title: Vintage Hakodate Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古函馆旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a vintage Japanese travel poster for {argument name="destination city" default="Hakodate, Japan"} on warm aged cream paper with subtle folds, stains, and worn edges. The composition is vertical and centered, with three main text elements: a large bold black Japanese headline at the top reading {argument name="Japanese headline text" default="函館"}, a widely spaced romanized title beneath it reading {argument name="romanized title" default="HAKODATE"}, and a bottom caption between two thin red horizontal rules reading {argument name="bottom caption" default="日本 / HAKODATE, JAPAN"}. Under the headline, illustrate a detailed retro line-art street scene in muted beige, black ink, and restrained red accents: a straight tram-lined city street receding in one-point perspective, flanked by low Japanese storefronts with vertical shop signs, lanterns, awnings, overhead power lines, traffic lights, a red post box, bicycles, pedestrians, and two cars driving along the road. In the background, show a broad brown mountain rising behind the town, topped by a tall observation tower and a smaller red tower, evoking Mount Hakodate. Use crisp architectural pen-and-ink outlines, minimal flat color, nostalgic Showa-era graphic design, travel-guide poster aesthetics, clean centered layout, and no photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古风格的日本旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="destination city" default="日本函馆"}，背景采用带有细微折痕、污渍和磨损边缘的暖色调旧米色纸张。构图采用垂直居中布局，包含三个主要文本元素：顶部为醒目的黑色粗体日文标题 {argument name="Japanese headline text" default="函馆"}，下方为字母间距较宽的罗马拼音标题 {argument name="romanized title" default="HAKODATE"}，底部为位于两条细红横线之间的说明文字 {argument name="bottom caption" default="日本 / HAKODATE, JAPAN"}。在标题下方，绘制一幅复古线条风格的详细街景，采用柔和的米色、黑色墨水以及克制的红色点缀：一条带有电车轨道的笔直城市街道，以一点透视法向远方延伸，两侧是带有竖向店招、灯笼、遮阳篷、架空电线、交通信号灯、红色邮筒、自行车、行人和两辆行驶车辆的低矮日式店面。背景处描绘一座宽阔的棕色山峰矗立在城镇后方，山顶设有高大的观景塔和一座较小的红色塔楼，以此呈现函馆山风貌。采用清晰的建筑钢笔线条、极简的平涂色彩、昭和时代的怀旧平面设计风格、旅行指南海报美学、整洁的居中布局，且不追求照片级真实感。

titleLocalized.zh: 彩虹发色遮挡肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic close-up portrait photo of a young person with {argument name="hair color" default="vivid rainbow neon hair"}, shaggy medium-length layered hair with a dark crown and saturated bands of magenta, violet, electric blue, cyan, green, yellow, and orange glowing around the sides. The subject is framed from chest to head, facing the camera, wearing a loose {argument name="shirt color" default="black"} graphic T-shirt with distressed white punk-style artwork and the visible words “CHAOS SYSTEM CONTROL,” plus a thin silver chain necklace. Place a large opaque square privacy block directly over the entire face, centered from forehead to chin, filled with a soft muted gradient of tan, mauve, green, and blue, hiding all facial features. Use a warm indoor background with shallow depth of field, dark wood or wall panels on the left, beige curtains on the right, and a softly glowing wall lamp near the upper right. templates.title: Cinematic Daisangen Mahjong Hand

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感大三元麻将牌型

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic semi-realistic 3D anime-style shot of a Japanese mahjong hand on a dark green felt table, showing {argument name="winning hand" default="Big Three Dragons / Daisangen"} as a row of exactly 14 upright ivory tiles viewed in shallow perspective from the front-left, receding toward the right. The standing row contains exactly 3 white dragon tiles with large black 白 characters, exactly 3 green dragon tiles with green 發 characters, exactly 3 red dragon tiles with red 中 characters, exactly 3 circle-suit tiles with black and red ring patterns, and exactly 2 east wind tiles with black 東 characters at the far right. Place exactly 1 extra discarded tile in the foreground left-center, lying flat and slightly angled, showing a red 中 character, with a warm brown tile side visible. Use glossy rounded ceramic tiles with beveled edges, subtle wear, soft shadows, and warm dramatic overhead lighting from the upper right. The background should be minimal and out of focus, with the green felt surface filling the frame, a low camera angle, realistic depth of field, and a moody mahjong-anime atmosphere. No people, no hands, no labels, no UI, no extra tiles beyond the exact 15 visible tiles.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感半写实 3D 动漫风格的日本麻将牌型特写，在深绿色绒布桌面上展示 {argument name="winning hand" default="大三元 / Daisangen"}。画面中 14 张象牙麻将牌整齐竖立，以左前方浅景深视角向右延伸。牌阵包含 3 张印有黑色“白”字的白板、3 张印有绿色“發”字的绿发、3 张印有红色“中”字的红中、3 张印有黑红圆圈图案的筒子，以及最右侧 2 张印有黑色“東”字的东风。在左前方放置 1 张平放且略微倾斜的弃牌，展示红色的“中”字，可见温暖的棕色牌侧。麻将牌采用光泽圆润的陶瓷材质，带有斜边和细微磨损痕迹，呈现柔和阴影，并由右上方的暖色调戏剧性光线照射。背景简洁且虚化，绿色绒布铺满画面，采用低机位拍摄，具备真实的景深效果，营造出富有氛围感的麻将动漫意境。画面中不包含人物、手部、标签、UI 界面，且除可见的 15 张牌外，不出现任何多余牌张。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Kirie Knight and Demon

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻剪纸风格：骑士与恶魔

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical dark fantasy illustration in an extremely intricate Japanese paper-cut silhouette style, like black kirie lace cut from paper over a warm parchment background. The scene shows a {argument name="character type" default="blonde armored female knight"} in the foreground from thighs up, facing slightly left, wearing ornate engraved plate armor covered in dense curling filigree, floral arabesques, tiny cutout patterns, layered pauldrons, gauntlets, breastplate, belt plates, and a sword hilt near the waist. Her long {argument name="hair color" default="pale blonde"} hair streams wildly to the right in many thin ribbon-like strands, rendered as pale negative space with black ink outlines. Behind and around her looms a huge {argument name="monster type" default="shadow demon"}, with a skull-like eyeless head, sinister grin, elongated clawed hands, and a body made entirely of tangled black vines, smoke tendrils, thorny curls, and lace-like voids, embracing or threatening her from behind. The entire composition is packed edge to edge with swirling black ornamental tendrils and delicate cut-paper holes, high contrast black ink against sepia cream paper, gothic horror atmosphere, baroque detail, handmade papercut texture, sharp silhouettes, dense linework, no color except black and warm beige. Place a flat opaque {argument name="censor square color" default="beige"} square over the center of the knight's face, hiding her facial features while leaving hair and armor visible. Use a tight portrait composition, cinematic lighting through paper, ultra-detailed, beautiful yet ominous, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖构图暗黑奇幻插画，采用极其复杂的日式剪纸剪影风格，如同在温暖的羊皮纸背景上剪出的黑色 kirie 蕾丝。场景前景展示了一位 {argument name="character type" default="金发盔甲女骑士"}，大腿以上出镜，身体微向左侧，身穿饰有密集卷曲花丝、花卉蔓藤纹样、微小镂空图案的华丽雕花板甲，配有层叠的肩甲、护手、胸甲、腰带板以及腰间的剑柄。她长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 头发向右狂乱飘散，呈现为许多细长的丝带状，以浅色负空间和黑色墨线勾勒。在她身后盘旋着巨大的 {argument name="monster type" default="阴影恶魔"}，拥有骷髅般的无眼头颅、邪恶的笑容、细长的利爪，身体完全由纠缠的黑色藤蔓、烟雾卷须、带刺的卷曲纹和蕾丝般的空隙组成，从背后拥抱或威胁着她。整个画面边缘布满了盘旋的黑色装饰性卷须和精致的剪纸孔洞，黑色墨水与深褐色奶油色纸张形成高对比度，营造出哥特式恐怖氛围、巴洛克细节、手工剪纸质感、锐利的剪影、密集的线条，除黑色和暖米色外无其他色彩。在骑士面部中心放置一个平坦不透明的 {argument name="censor square color" default="米色"} 方块，遮住她的面部特征，同时保留头发和盔甲可见。采用紧凑的肖像构图，透过纸张的电影级光效，超精细，美感与不祥并存，无文字。

templates.title: Anime Girl Stairwell Composite

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女楼道合成

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the unchanged background, composite 1 full-body anime-style girl into the stairwell landing. Place her standing on the right side beneath the window and fluorescent light, in front of the wall near the existing “4/3” marking. She should be {argument name="character type" default="a shy school-age girl"} with {argument name="hair style" default="short wavy light-brown twin-tail hair"}, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a dark gothic-lolita blouse and patterned skirt with knee-high black socks"} and {argument name="accessory" default="round glasses"}. Pose her with feet together, hands clasped in front, slightly bashful expression, looking toward the viewer. Match the perspective, scale, shadows, and warm backlighting from the window and fluorescent lamp so she feels naturally photographed in the space. Keep the stairwell architecture, handrail, window, wall switch, tactile paving, and “4/3” wall text intact, but give the final image a soft cinematic anime-composite look with gentle haze and muted contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为背景，将一名全身动漫风格少女合成至楼道平台。将她放置在窗户和日光灯下方的右侧，位于墙上现有“4/3”标记附近。她应该是 {argument name="character type" default="一位害羞的学龄少女"}，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="浅棕色短波浪双马尾"}，穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="深色哥特萝莉风衬衫和印花短裙，搭配黑色过膝袜"} 并佩戴 {argument name="accessory" default="圆框眼镜"}。让她双脚并拢站立，双手交叠在身前，表情略带羞涩，看向镜头方向。调整透视、比例、阴影以及来自窗户和日光灯的暖色背光，使她看起来像是自然拍摄于该空间中。保留楼道建筑、扶手、窗户、墙壁开关、盲道以及墙上的“4/3”文字，并为最终图像赋予柔和的电影感动漫合成风格，带有轻微的雾气和柔和的对比度。

templates.title: Urban Tank Top Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 都市背心街头肖像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical street-fashion snapshot of an adult young woman standing in a gritty urban underpass alley during soft morning daylight. She has {argument name="hair color" default="peach blonde"} shoulder-length slightly wavy hair, a slim build, and wears a {argument name="tank top color" default="heather gray"} sleeveless ribbed tank top with loose dark indigo wide-leg jeans and a beige canvas belt with a long hanging strap. She faces the camera in a relaxed casual pose, one arm down and the other hand lifting the hem of her tank top slightly to reveal her lower midriff and navel, giving a playful candid fashion-photo feeling. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain skin-tone rectangular blur for anonymity. The setting is a narrow Japanese-style city passage beneath elevated train tracks or concrete infrastructure, with stained concrete walls, white brick tiles, overhead beams, exposed pipes, faded posters on the wall, and two bicycles parked along the left side. Use natural film photography aesthetics, 35mm lens perspective, muted colors, soft contrast, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, realistic skin and fabric texture, documentary street style, full torso to upper legs framing, vertical 2:3 composition, no text, no logo except a tiny subtle sparkle watermark-like mark in the lower right.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖版街头时尚快照，展示一名成年年轻女性站在柔和晨光下的粗犷城市地下通道巷子里。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="桃金色"} 及肩微卷发，身材苗条，身穿一件 {argument name="tank top color" default="灰麻色"} 无袖罗纹背心，搭配宽松的深靛蓝色阔腿牛仔裤和一条带有长垂带的米色帆布腰带。她以放松的休闲姿势面向镜头，一只手下垂，另一只手轻轻掀起背心下摆，露出下腹部和肚脐，营造出一种俏皮的抓拍时尚感。为了保持匿名，她的面部被一个纯肤色的矩形模糊处理。背景是位于高架铁路或混凝土基础设施下方的日式狭窄城市通道，墙面有混凝土污渍、白色砖块、头顶横梁、裸露的管道、墙上褪色的海报，左侧停放着两辆自行车。采用自然胶片摄影美学，35mm 镜头视角，低饱和度色彩，柔和对比度，浅至中等景深，真实的皮肤和织物纹理，纪录片街头风格，取景范围从上半身到大腿，竖版 2:3 构图，无文字，无 Logo，仅在右下角有一个细微的类似闪光水印的标记。

templates.title: Anime Studio Photoshoot Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫工作室摄影风格转换

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a loose source for the vertical composition and bright high backlight, transform the scene into a warm anime-style behind-the-scenes fashion studio photoshoot. Remove the stairwell, window, handrail, floor numbering, tactile paving, and wall fixtures. Add exactly 1 full-body anime girl centered in frame, standing shyly with knees slightly inward and hands clasped in front, wearing {argument name="outfit style" default="a black gothic-lolita blouse with a large bow, ruffled collar, ornate short skirt, and knee-high socks"}. Give her {argument name="hair style" default="soft twin ponytails"} and {argument name="accessory" default="round glasses"}. Add exactly 4 visible studio-production elements around the edges: 1 dark blurred lighting/camera rig on the left foreground, 1 black softbox at the upper right, 1 light stand on the right, and 1 rectangular equipment block at the lower right. Keep the background simple beige, with strong warm overhead spotlight glow, rim light, soft shadows on the floor, shallow depth of field, and cinematic anime illustration rendering.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具照片写实感的年轻女性眼部及鼻梁上部超近距离特写，重点刻画细节丰富的睫毛，尤其是微妙的下睫毛。主体拥有 {argument name="eye color" default="灰绿色"} 的眼睛，{argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 的头发自然散落在额头和画面左侧，呈现带有淡淡雀斑和真实毛孔的自然浅色皮肤，透出柔和的桃色底色，妆容极简自然。图像采用紧凑的宽画幅比例，仅露出双眼、眉毛、部分鼻梁以及少许脸颊/额头；不包含嘴部或全脸。渲染出精致的单根上睫毛、双眼下方简化但清晰可见的下睫毛、虹膜上的湿润反光、真实的眼睑纹理、柔和的阴影以及浅景深效果。使用来自右上方的温暖自然日光，采用电影级微距摄影风格，呈现高分辨率皮肤细节、真实的镜头柔焦感、柔和的米色与蜂蜜色调，打造亲密的美妆编辑风格。

templates.title: Cute Ghost Mascot Brand Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱幽灵吉祥物品牌海报

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist cinematic brand poster in a dark monochrome palette, showing a cute small white ghost mascot figurine sitting on rumpled black velvet fabric. The ghost has a smooth rounded dome body, soft scalloped base, tiny side flippers, glossy black circular eyes, a small black X-shaped mouth, and a small ornamental droplet-shaped knob on top of its head. Place the mascot on the right half of the composition, softly lit from the upper right with gentle specular highlights and deep shadows, shallow depth of field, premium product-photography feel, 16:9 horizontal format. On the left side, add exactly two text elements: a three-line Japanese quote in white handwritten-style type reading {argument name="quote" default="たまに、\n全部どうでも\nよくなるよね。"}, positioned upper left with generous line spacing, and a bold spaced uppercase brand wordmark reading {argument name="brand name" default="GHOSTCO."} near the lower left. Keep the background nearly black with subtle fabric texture, moody but adorable, calm, melancholic, modern Japanese character-brand advertising aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极简主义电影质感的品牌海报，采用暗黑单色调，展示一个可爱的白色小幽灵吉祥物手办，坐落在褶皱的黑色天鹅绒布料上。幽灵拥有圆润光滑的穹顶状身体、柔软的扇形底座、小巧的侧鳍、亮黑色的圆形眼睛、小巧的黑色 X 形嘴巴，头顶有一个装饰性的水滴状旋钮。将吉祥物放置在构图的右半部分，从右上角进行柔光照射，呈现细腻的高光和深邃的阴影，浅景深，具备高级产品摄影质感，16:9 横向画幅。在左侧添加两个文本元素：左上角放置一段三行白色手写风格的日文引语 {argument name="quote" default="たまに、\n全部どうでも\nよくなるよね。"}，保持宽裕的行间距；左下角附近放置一个醒目且字间距宽阔的品牌大写字母标识 {argument name="brand name" default="GHOSTCO."}。背景保持近乎纯黑并带有微妙的布料纹理，营造出一种忧郁而可爱、平静、伤感且现代的日式角色品牌广告美学。

templates.title: Anime Fitness Influencer Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫健身网红肖像

templates.prompt: Create a clean anime-style digital portrait of a muscular male fitness influencer, upper body cropped at the waist, standing in a confident bodybuilding pose with hands clasped low in front of his torso. He has short spiky {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair, tan skin, extremely broad shoulders, large defined arms, visible chest and neck anatomy, and sharp cel-shaded muscle contours. His face is intentionally covered by a centered square privacy block in a soft beige skin-tone gradient. He wears a loose black stringer tank top with deep armholes; on the chest is one white printed branding element reading {argument name="chest text" default="TEAM SHAPE"} above a shield-like monogram emblem. On the left side of the white background is one separate black brand mark: a stylized shield monogram above the stacked words {argument name="side logo text" default="TIBO INSHAPE"}. Use crisp Japanese anime line art, smooth shading, high-contrast fitness-poster lighting, minimal background, centered composition, and a polished social-media avatar look.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简洁的动漫风格肌肉男性健身网红数字肖像，腰部以上半身像，以自信的健美姿势站立，双手在躯干前下方交握。他留着短尖刺状的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 发型，拥有古铜色皮肤、极宽的肩膀、粗壮且线条分明的双臂、清晰的胸部和颈部肌肉结构，以及锐利的赛璐珞风格肌肉轮廓。他的面部中心位置被一个柔和米色肤色渐变的方形隐私遮挡块故意遮盖。他穿着一件宽松的黑色工字背心，袖口开得很深；胸前印有一个白色的品牌元素，上方写着 {argument name="chest text" default="TEAM SHAPE"}，下方是一个盾牌状的字母组合徽标。白色背景的左侧有一个独立的黑色品牌标识：一个风格化的盾牌字母组合，下方是堆叠的文字 {argument name="side logo text" default="TIBO INSHAPE"}。采用清晰的日式动漫线条艺术、平滑的阴影处理、高对比度的健身海报灯光、极简背景、居中构图，呈现出精致的社交媒体头像质感。

templates.title: Dramatic Manga Woman Panel

titleLocalized.zh: 戏剧性漫画女性分镜

templates.prompt: Create a black-and-white manga page illustration in a single tall, slightly tilted rectangular panel on a white background. The scene shows {argument name="character name" default="an elegant young woman"} from a dramatic low-angle perspective, leaning over the viewer with her right hand reaching forward in extreme foreshortening, fingers spread and sharp dark nails visible. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light gray"} shoulder-length messy hair with long bangs, loose strands flowing across her face, large narrow manga eyes with detailed lashes, a calm but intimidating expression, and slightly parted lips. She wears a dark high-collared uniform under a draped cloak or haori with textured screentone shading and a bold dark flame-like pattern near the lower right edge. Use delicate ink linework, pencil-like crosshatching, manga screentones, high contrast black fills, sparse dust speckles, and clean white negative space. Include exactly 1 speech bubble: a tall vertical oval bubble on the upper right, with Japanese vertical text reading {argument name="speech bubble text" default="風林火山を殺し進む"}. Keep the composition monochrome, cinematic, and intense, like a printed shonen/seinen manga panel, with no color and no extra panels.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑白漫画页面插图，采用单一的竖长、略微倾斜的矩形分镜，背景为纯白。画面展示了 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻女性"}，采用戏剧性的低角度透视，她俯身向观众探出，右手向前伸展，呈现出极端的透视缩短效果，手指张开，可见锋利的深色指甲。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅灰色"} 的齐肩凌乱短发，长刘海和散乱的发丝拂过脸庞，有着细长的大型漫画眼，睫毛刻画细腻，表情冷静却极具压迫感，双唇微张。她身穿深色高领制服，外罩一件披风或羽织，带有纹理网点阴影，右下边缘处有醒目的深色火焰状图案。使用精致的墨水线条、铅笔般的排线、漫画网点、高对比度的黑色填充、稀疏的尘埃颗粒以及干净的白色留白。包含 1 个对话气泡：右上角有一个竖长的椭圆形气泡，其中的日语竖排文字为 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="風林火山を殺し進む"}。保持构图为单色、电影感且强烈，如同印刷版的少年/青年漫画分镜，无色彩，无额外分镜。

templates.title: Summer BL Fence Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季 BL 围栏场景

templates.prompt: Create a polished BL anime-style summer illustration of two handsome young men standing close together outdoors beside a chain-link fence, framed from the waist up in a romantic slice-of-life composition. The taller man on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="dark navy-black"} tousled short hair, a slim athletic build, an open deep-blue button-up shirt over a white T-shirt, layered silver necklaces, and holds a clear plastic iced coffee cup with a black straw in one hand. The shorter man on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="pale silver-lavender"} soft short hair, a slender build, a loose white T-shirt, black backpack straps over both shoulders, small earrings, and layered silver necklaces. Their shoulders touch intimately and their heads lean toward each other as if sharing a quiet summer moment; keep the mood tender, youthful, and romantic without explicit content. The background shows a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds, leafy tree branches casting dappled shadows, a sun flare near the upper right, distant city buildings softened by depth of field, and a blue sign attached to the fence reading {argument name="sign text" default="夏の日、君と。"} with small handwritten English text below, {argument name="subtitle text" default="Summer with you"}. Use luminous high-detail anime rendering, delicate linework, soft skin shading, cool blue and violet color grading, sparkling highlights, cinematic backlighting, shallow depth of field, and a dreamy summer atmosphere. Add rectangular soft mauve privacy blocks covering both characters' faces, as if the faces are intentionally hidden.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的 BL 动漫风格夏季插画，描绘两名帅气的少年在户外链式围栏旁亲密站立，采用浪漫的生活化半身构图。左侧较高的男子留着 {argument name="left character hair color" default="深海军黑"} 色凌乱短发，身材精瘦健美，身穿深蓝色敞开式衬衫内搭白色 T 恤，佩戴叠层银项链，一只手拿着一杯插着黑色吸管的透明塑料冰咖啡。右侧较矮的男子留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="淡银薰衣草"} 色柔顺短发，身材纤细，身穿宽松白色 T 恤，双肩背着黑色双肩包，佩戴小耳环和叠层银项链。他们的肩膀亲密地靠在一起，头向彼此倾斜，仿佛正在分享一个宁静的夏日瞬间；保持氛围温柔、青春且浪漫，不含任何露骨内容。背景展示了明亮的蓝天和蓬松的白云，茂密的树枝投下斑驳的阴影，右上角有阳光光晕，远处的城市建筑在景深效果下显得柔和，围栏上挂着一块蓝色标牌，上面写着 {argument name="sign text" default="夏の日、君と。"}，下方配有手写体英文 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Summer with you"}。采用明亮的高细节动漫渲染、细腻的线条、柔和的皮肤阴影、冷蓝色和紫色的色调分级、闪烁的高光、电影级背光、浅景深以及梦幻般的夏日氛围。在两名角色的面部添加矩形柔和淡紫色隐私遮挡块，营造出面部被刻意隐藏的效果。

templates.title: Neon Kyoto Rain Alley

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic fantasy cyberpunk cityscape at night in a neon-soaked futuristic Kyoto-inspired alley after rain, with a glossy black reflective street stretching into deep perspective. The scene contains 13 visible floating Japanese parasols: 1 huge red parasol dominating the upper left corner, 1 large violet parasol near the upper center, 1 dark indigo parasol on the upper right, 1 small red parasol on the left balcony, 1 small gold parasol at mid-left, 1 small gold parasol near the upper-right distance, 1 violet parasol at lower left, 1 gold-violet parasol at lower-left midground, 1 gold parasol near the lower-left edge, 1 red parasol in the central distance, 1 red parasol just below the foreground gate, and 2 tiny red parasols farther down the avenue. Add three red torii gates aligned down the center of the street, the nearest gate large and silhouetted against pink-purple haze. Towering dark skyscrapers rise on both sides, decorated with glowing red filigree patterns, vertical neon signs, suspended cables, cherry blossom branches, and drifting pink petals. Place a lone female figure in the lower right foreground, viewed from behind, wearing a long ornate flowing kimono or cloak in pale lavender and rose gold, with extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="silvery pink"} hair streaming to the right as if caught by wind; she gazes toward the illuminated gates and distant city. Use a color palette of {argument name="neon palette" default="magenta, violet, crimson, amber, and deep midnight blue"}, intense wet reflections, volumetric mist, glowing particles, high contrast rim lighting, intricate detail, epic scale, dreamlike atmosphere, anime-inspired dark fantasy, ultra-detailed concept art, 9:16 portrait composition, no readable text, no borders, no watermark.

templates.title: Custom Logo Black Plastic Bag

titleLocalized.zh: 定制 Logo 黑色塑料袋

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic studio product shot of a single glossy black plastic trash bag or merchandise bag standing upright, full and slightly bulging, centered on a clean white background with soft even lighting and a subtle floor shadow. The bag is tied tightly at the top, with gathered wrinkled plastic forming a knot and a ruffled neck, and the body shows realistic crinkles, folds, shiny highlights, and stretched black polyethylene texture. On the front center, print a crisp white custom business logo in a carnival-style badge: a large outlined banner and geometric emblem with small stars, featuring the main brand text {argument name="brand name" default="ARCADIAS"} in bold playful lettering, a large arch shape incorporated into the wordmark, and the tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="LA ESQUINA DIVERTIDA"} curved underneath. Keep the logo flat white ink as if screen-printed directly onto the bag, high contrast, perfectly centered, with no other objects, no hands, no clutter, and no background decoration.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的摄影棚产品照，展示一个直立的亮面黑色塑料垃圾袋或商品袋，袋身饱满且略微鼓起，置于干净的白色背景中央，配以柔和均匀的灯光和细微的地面阴影。袋口紧紧系住，形成褶皱的塑料结和荷叶边状的颈部，袋身呈现出逼真的褶皱、折痕、光亮高光以及拉伸后的黑色聚乙烯质感。在袋身正前方中央，印上一个清晰的白色定制商业 Logo，采用嘉年华风格徽章设计：包含一个大型轮廓横幅和带有小星星的几何徽标，主品牌文字 {argument name="brand name" default="ARCADIAS"} 使用粗体俏皮字体，字标中融入了一个大拱形，下方弯曲排列着标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="LA ESQUINA DIVERTIDA"}。Logo 需保持纯白色平铺印刷效果，如同直接丝印在袋子上，高对比度，完美居中，画面中不包含其他物体、手部、杂物或背景装饰。

templates.title: Custom Branded Black Plastic Bag

titleLocalized.zh: 定制品牌黑色塑料袋

templates.prompt: Create a realistic studio product mockup of a single large black plastic garbage bag standing upright on a clean white background. The bag is full and rounded with a squared base, glossy crinkled polyethylene texture, visible wrinkles, folds, highlights, and a tied knot at the top with gathered plastic flaring upward. Center the bag in the frame with soft, even lighting and a subtle gray shadow beneath it. Print a white custom company design on the front of the bag, consisting of exactly 3 visible printed elements: a large abstract circular logo at the upper center, the bold rounded uppercase brand name {argument name="brand name" default="CENTU"} below it, and a handwritten-style Spanish slogan {argument name="slogan text" default="¡Programando tu futuro hoy!"} underneath. Use high-contrast white ink that follows the creases and distortions of the plastic surface, making the print look physically applied to the bag rather than floating. Photorealistic commercial mockup, front-facing composition, minimal background, sharp details, natural reflections, premium branded packaging presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个逼真的摄影棚产品模型，展示一个直立在干净白色背景上的大型黑色塑料垃圾袋。袋子饱满圆润，底部呈方形，具有亮面褶皱聚乙烯质感，可见明显的褶皱、折痕、高光，顶部打结并有向上散开的塑料褶边。将袋子置于画面中央，采用柔和均匀的灯光，底部带有淡淡的灰色阴影。在袋子正面印上白色的定制公司设计，包含 3 个清晰可见的印刷元素：上部中央的一个大型抽象圆形 Logo，下方是加粗圆润的大写品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="CENTU"}，以及最下方的手写风格西班牙语标语 {argument name="slogan text" default="¡Programando tu futuro hoy!"}。使用高对比度的白色油墨，使其顺应塑料表面的褶皱和变形，让印刷图案看起来像是物理印在袋子上，而非浮在表面。逼真的商业模型，正面构图，极简背景，细节锐利，自然反光，高端品牌包装展示。

templates.title: Custom Branded Black Garbage Bag
