templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic studio product shot of a single large black plastic garbage bag standing upright on a clean white seamless background. The bag is overfilled into a rounded rectangular sack shape with a flat heavy base, glossy crinkled polyethylene texture, sharp specular highlights, many wrinkles and folds, and the top gathered tightly and tied into a small knotted tuft. Centered on the front is a bold white custom printed logo: the words {argument name="brand text" default="GO GO RICO"} in chunky rounded block letters, arranged as two stacked “GO” words above a shield-shaped badge containing “RICO”; include a simple tropical palm tree graphic and angular geometric outline behind the lettering. Make the print look like real white ink on black plastic, slightly distorted by the wrinkles and bag curvature. Use front-facing composition, full bag visible, soft studio lighting, subtle floor shadow, high contrast black-and-white branding, minimal commercial mockup style, no extra objects, no people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的摄影级产品照，展示一个直立在干净白色无缝背景上的大型黑色塑料垃圾袋。袋子被撑得鼓鼓的，呈圆角矩形，底部平坦厚实，具有亮面褶皱聚乙烯质感，带有清晰的镜面高光，布满褶皱和折痕，顶部紧紧收拢并打成一个小结。袋子正面居中印有醒目的白色定制 Logo：{argument name="brand text" default="GO GO RICO"}，采用厚实的圆角块状字体，两行“GO”字样位于盾牌形状的徽章上方，徽章内写有“RICO”；文字后方包含简单的热带棕榈树图形和几何轮廓。让印刷效果看起来像是在黑色塑料上真实的白色油墨，并因袋子的褶皱和弧度产生轻微变形。采用正面构图，完整展示袋子，使用柔和的摄影棚灯光，带有微妙的地面阴影，高对比度的黑白品牌设计，极简商业模型风格，无多余物品，无人物。

templates.prompt: Create a gritty photorealistic street portrait of {argument name="character description" default="an elderly skater man with curly gray hair"} crouching in a concrete skatepark under an overpass, framed from head to shoes in a vertical 4:5 composition. His face is covered by a centered opaque rectangular privacy block in muted brown, while gray curls remain visible around the top and sides. He wears layered black urban skatewear: a black windbreaker jacket over a gray hoodie, a dark T-shirt with a small white graphic, loose black cargo pants, a wristwatch, rings, and black-and-white Vans Old Skool sneakers with white laces. He squats low on a concrete ledge with one knee raised, relaxed hands hanging forward, and one hand resting near a worn old skateboard standing upright beside him. Include exactly 1 skateboard: a battered black deck with dirty beige wheels, scraped trucks, distressed graphics, and the visible word {argument name="skateboard logo text" default="THRASHER"} near the top. Add exactly 1 social media tag sticker: a rounded white rectangle near the lower right of the subject with bold black text {argument name="social handle" default="@giuliannolano"}. The background is a shallow-depth-of-field urban skate bowl covered in blurred colorful graffiti, dark concrete beams overhead, moody natural light, cinematic contrast, realistic fabric wrinkles, scuffed shoes, textured aging hands, documentary street-fashion photography, 85mm lens look, soft bokeh, high detail, no extra people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张粗粝且写实的街头肖像，主角是 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着灰色卷发的老年滑板男士"}，他蹲在立交桥下的混凝土滑板公园里，采用 4:5 的竖构图，从头到脚完整入镜。他的脸部被一个居中的不透明棕色矩形遮挡，仅露出顶部和两侧的灰色卷发。他身着叠穿的黑色城市滑板服：黑色防风外套内搭灰色连帽衫，深色 T 恤上印有小巧的白色图案，穿着宽松的黑色工装裤，佩戴手表和戒指，脚蹬黑白配色的 Vans Old Skool 滑板鞋，系着白色鞋带。他低蹲在混凝土台阶上，单膝抬起，双手自然下垂，一只手放在身旁竖立的破旧滑板附近。画面中需包含 1 个滑板：一块磨损的黑色板面，带有脏兮兮的米色轮子、刮花的支架、做旧的图案，且在顶部清晰可见 {argument name="skateboard logo text" default="THRASHER"} 字样。在主体右下角附近添加 1 个社交媒体标签贴纸：一个圆角白色矩形，上面印有加粗的黑色文字 {argument name="social handle" default="@giuliannolano"}。背景为浅景深的城市滑板碗池，布满了模糊的彩色涂鸦，上方是深色的混凝土横梁，呈现出忧郁的自然光感、电影级的对比度，展现真实的衣物褶皱、磨损的鞋子、充满纹理的老年双手，具有纪录片式的街头时尚摄影风格，呈现 85mm 镜头效果，柔和的焦外成像，细节丰富，画面中无其他人物。

templates.title: Istanbul Typographic Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 伊斯坦布尔排版旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a premium editorial illustrated travel poster for {argument name="city name" default="ISTANBUL"}, built around 8 enormous tall block capital letters spelling “ISTANBUL” across a wide horizontal cream canvas. Use each letter as a vertical window filled with detailed Istanbul scenery: 1) I shows the Maiden’s Tower on the Bosphorus with a Turkish flag and ferry boats, 2) S shows hillside waterfront neighborhoods, domes, minarets, clouds, and birds, 3) T shows Galata Tower above narrow streets with a red vintage tram in the foreground, 4) A shows the Bosphorus with ferries, sailboats, bridges, and distant skyline, 5) N shows Hagia Sophia and layered mosque domes in warm peach and stone tones, 6) B shows the Bosphorus Bridge, water, a ferry, and waterfront palaces, 7) U shows steep historic streets, colorful stacked houses, greenery, and a large tree, 8) L shows Ortaköy Mosque by the waterfront with two minarets and flying seagulls. Above the title, add a thin minimalist skyline strip containing 13 small illustrated elements from left to right: trees, a small domed pavilion, a teal car, a red tram, distant city towers, a ferry, a suspension bridge, Maiden’s Tower, another teal car, a grand mosque with multiple minarets, a peach sun, a round green tree, and a final mosque minaret. Style it as a refined mid-century travel poster with clean vector-like illustration, soft muted palette of teal blue, sea green, dusty peach, terracotta, warm cream, and charcoal linework; crisp geometry, subtle paper grain, elegant negative space, tiny birds and clouds, no photorealism, no extra text besides the city name.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="city name" default="ISTANBUL"} 创建一张高级编辑风格的插画旅行海报，海报主体由 8 个巨大的竖向大写字母组成，在宽幅奶油色画布上拼写出“ISTANBUL”。将每个字母作为一扇垂直的窗口，填充伊斯坦布尔的细节风景：1) I 展示了博斯普鲁斯海峡上的少女塔、土耳其国旗和渡轮；2) S 展示了山坡上的滨水街区、圆顶、尖塔、云朵和飞鸟；3) T 展示了狭窄街道上方的加拉塔塔，前景中有一辆红色复古电车；4) A 展示了博斯普鲁斯海峡、渡轮、帆船、大桥和远处的城市天际线；5) N 展示了圣索菲亚大教堂和层叠的清真寺圆顶，色调为温暖的桃色和石色；6) B 展示了博斯普鲁斯大桥、水面、渡轮和滨水宫殿；7) U 展示了陡峭的历史街道、色彩斑斓的叠层房屋、绿植和一棵大树；8) L 展示了滨水区的奥尔塔科伊清真寺，带有两座尖塔和飞翔的海鸥。在标题上方，添加一条极简主义的天际线细条，从左到右包含 13 个小型插画元素：树木、一座小型圆顶凉亭、一辆青色汽车、一辆红色电车、远处的城市塔楼、一艘渡轮、一座悬索桥、少女塔、另一辆青色汽车、一座带有多个尖塔的大型清真寺、一颗桃色太阳、一棵圆形绿树，以及最后一座清真寺尖塔。整体风格为精致的中世纪旅行海报，采用简洁的矢量插画风格，配色为柔和的青蓝色、海绿色、灰桃色、赤陶色、暖奶油色，并辅以炭灰色线条；构图几何感强，带有细腻的纸张纹理，优雅的留白，点缀着微小的飞鸟和云朵，拒绝写实摄影风格，除城市名称外不包含任何额外文字。

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic fantasy portrait of {argument name="character description" default="a graceful young woman with shoulder-length brown hair"} viewed from a dramatic low angle, standing beneath a brilliant midday sky filled with fluffy white clouds. Around her body swirl luminous ribbons of water and sparkling crystal-like droplets, forming spirals and arcs that lead toward a radiant sun halo above her raised hand. Use {argument name="color palette" default="sky blue, white, violet, indigo, gold, and iridescent highlights"}, ethereal fantasy lighting, lens flare, glittering particles, translucent fabric motion, highly detailed costume textures, photorealistic anime-realism, dynamic composition, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, dramatic backlighting, 9:16 aspect ratio.

Nearly half of her body is dissolving into extremely thick, cloud-like grey smoke filled with glowing yellow dust particles. Her left arm, shoulder, torso, legs, and part of her hair become transparent as they break into luminous particles, suggesting active disintegration.

Behind and partially surrounding her is a massive glowing eclipse-like ring, emitting fiery golden-white plasma light. This object acts as a powerful rim and backlight, dramatically illuminating the smoke, dust, and silhouette.

The setting is minimal and cinematic: a desolate concrete surface beneath a heavily overcast sky. The {argument name="color palette" default="color palette is dominated by monochrome greys, deep blues, and whites, contrasted with intense amber-gold glow"}. 她近半个身体正在消散成极其浓郁、云雾般的灰色烟雾，其中夹杂着发光的黄色尘埃微粒。她的左臂、肩膀、躯干、双腿以及部分头发随着化作发光微粒而变得透明，呈现出正在消散的动态感。

在她身后并部分环绕着她的，是一个巨大的、类似日食的发光圆环，散发着炽热的金白色等离子光芒。该物体作为强有力的轮廓光和背光，戏剧性地照亮了烟雾、尘埃和人物剪影。

templates.title: Japanese Graffiti Art Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日式涂鸦艺术肖像

templates.prompt:
Create a high-detail portrait poster in a bold {argument name="art style" default="Japanese graffiti-inspired art style"}, combining modern urban street aesthetics with expressive Japanese visual culture. The poster should feature dynamic graffiti typography, layered spray-paint textures, hand-drawn symbols, abstract paint splashes, neon brush strokes, urban sticker elements, Japanese calligraphy accents, and decorative ornaments that strongly reinforce the energetic atmosphere of the design. The overall composition should feel artistic, rebellious, fashionable, and visually striking, while still maintaining a premium editorial poster quality instead of looking messy or overdone. Humanity somehow turned vandalism into luxury wall art. Impressive species.

The subject must not replicate the exact pose or expression from the reference photo. Instead, create a completely new {argument name="pose" default="half body pose three quarter body and both hands in pocket"} that feels natural, confident, and full of life. The expression should appear emotionally expressive, charismatic, and engaging, avoiding stiff, awkward, flat, or emotionless body language. The pose should reflect the elegance and sophistication commonly seen in international fashion models, with stylish posture, natural movement, and subtle attitude that enhances the overall cinematic fashion aesthetic.

The outfit should feature contemporary stylish casual fashion with strong visual appeal. Avoid plain or repetitive clothing designs. Use fashionable layering, modern streetwear inspiration, premium casual styling, and a balanced combination of colors, patterns, textures, and fabric types that create a rich and non-monotonous appearance. The clothing should feel trendy, fashionable, youthful, and visually premium while still fitting naturally into the Japanese graffiti poster concept.

The background and poster decorations should be filled with thematic urban Japanese-inspired visual elements such as graffiti walls, spray textures, painted symbols, urban signage, layered stickers, modern Japanese graphic motifs, abstract shapes, paint drips, street fashion aesthetics, and stylish decorative compositions that enhance depth and artistic intensity without distracting from the subject.

Lighting should feel cinematic and fashionable, with strong contrast, clean highlights, realistic skin texture, and high-end editorial poster quality. The final result must look like a premium modern street-fashion campaign poster with highly detailed textures, balanced composition, vibrant color harmony, realistic proportions, ultra-sharp focus, and immersive visual storytelling.

Ultra-detailed, highly aesthetic, premium composition, realistic texture rendering, fashionable urban atmosphere, cinematic quality, poster-ready design, 8K ultra high resolution.

{argument name="additional props" default="a skateboard leaning on wall with dark themed graffiti on it. And a party speaker in hand with RGB"}

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张高细节的肖像海报，采用大胆的 {argument name="art style" default="日式涂鸦艺术风格"}，融合现代都市街头美学与富有表现力的日本视觉文化。海报应包含动态的涂鸦字体、分层的喷漆纹理、手绘符号、抽象的油漆飞溅、霓虹笔触、都市贴纸元素、日式书法点缀以及装饰性元素，以强烈烘托出设计的活力氛围。整体构图应具有艺术感、叛逆感、时尚感且视觉冲击力强，同时保持高端编辑海报的质感，避免杂乱或过度堆砌。人类竟将破坏行为转化为了奢华的墙面艺术，真是令人印象深刻的物种。

主体不得复制参考照片中的确切姿势或表情。相反，请创建一个全新的 {argument name="pose" default="半身姿势，四分之三身位，双手插兜"}，使其看起来自然、自信且充满活力。表情应富有情感表现力、魅力十足且引人入胜，避免僵硬、尴尬、平淡或毫无表情的肢体语言。姿势应体现国际时尚模特常见的优雅与精致，通过时尚的体态、自然的动作和微妙的态度，增强整体的电影级时尚美感。

服装应采用具有强烈视觉吸引力的当代时尚休闲装。避免平庸或重复的服装设计。运用时尚的叠穿、现代街头服饰灵感、高端休闲造型，以及色彩、图案、纹理和面料类型的平衡组合，打造出丰富且不单调的外观。服装应显得潮流、时尚、年轻且具有高端视觉质感，同时与日式涂鸦海报的概念自然契合。

背景和海报装饰应充满主题性的日式都市视觉元素，如涂鸦墙、喷漆纹理、手绘符号、城市标牌、分层贴纸、现代日式图形图案、抽象形状、油漆滴落、街头时尚美学以及时尚的装饰性构图，在不分散主体注意力的情况下增强深度和艺术张力。

灯光应具有电影感和时尚感，对比强烈，高光清晰，皮肤纹理真实，呈现高端编辑海报品质。最终效果必须看起来像一张高端现代街头时尚宣传海报，具有高度细节的纹理、平衡的构图、鲜艳的色彩和谐度、真实的比例、超清晰的焦点以及沉浸式的视觉叙事。

超细节，高审美，高级构图，真实纹理渲染，时尚都市氛围，电影级品质，海报级设计，8K 超高分辨率。

{argument name="additional props" default="一个靠在墙上的滑板，上面有深色主题的涂鸦。手中拿着一个带有 RGB 灯效的派对音箱。"}

templates.title: MS Paint Style Redraw

titleLocalized.zh: MS Paint 风格重绘

templates.prompt: Redraw the attached image in the most {argument name="style description" default="clumsy, scribbly, and utterly pathetic"} way possible. Use a {argument name="background" default="white background"}, and make it look like it was drawn in {argument name="software" default="MS Paint with a mouse"}. It should be vaguely similar but also not really, kind of matching but also off in a confusing, awkward way, with that low-quality pixel-by-pixel feel that really emphasizes how ridiculously bad it is. Actually, you know what, whatever, just draw it however you want.

promptLocalized.zh: 以尽可能 {argument name="style description" default="笨拙、潦草且极其拙劣"} 的方式重绘所附图像。使用 {argument name="background" default="白色背景"}，并使其看起来像是用 {argument name="software" default="鼠标在 MS Paint 中"} 绘制的。它应该看起来似是而非，既有点匹配又在某种令人困惑、尴尬的层面上显得格格不入，并带有那种真正强调其荒谬糟糕程度的低质量像素感。算了，随便吧，你想怎么画就怎么画。

templates.title: Dreamy Birthday Princess Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻生日公主肖像

templates.prompt:
Use the uploaded portrait only as the face identity and hairstyle reference. Preserve the person’s facial structure, skin tone, facial features, and hairstyle accurately, but completely regenerate the outfit, body pose, scene, lighting, props, and atmosphere.

Create a realistic vertical 9:16 birthday princess portrait inspired by a dreamy indoor birthday party photo. The person is sitting slightly sideways in a {argument name="location" default="luxurious warm hotel banquet room"}, holding a {argument name="flowers" default="large bouquet of pale pink roses wrapped in translucent glossy pink paper with a big white bow"}. Surround the person with many deep red roses, red and pink balloons, including a metallic red heart-shaped balloon. Add a soft birthday party background with warm ceiling lights, elegant wall panels, a blurred “Happy Birthday” banner, and a white birthday welcome board with subtle readable text: “{argument name="welcome text" default="Welcome to my Birthday Party"}”.

The person wears a romantic red-pink tulle princess dress with soft layered fabric, a delicate silver tiara, and a pearl necklace. The pose is elegant and slightly dreamy, head gently tilted, soft natural gaze, calm facial expression, realistic human skin texture, natural lips, refined makeup, long voluminous black hair with slight messy texture.

Shot like a real flash photography birthday portrait, slightly overexposed soft flash on the face, warm ambient hotel lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic shadows, natural skin pores, soft cinematic glow, high-end social media portrait style, dreamy romantic atmosphere, ultra-realistic, high detail, clean composition, no AI look.

promptLocalized.zh:
仅将上传的肖像作为面部特征和发型的参考。请准确保留人物的面部结构、肤色、五官和发型，但需完全重新生成服装、身体姿势、场景、灯光、道具和氛围。

创作一张写实的 9:16 竖版生日公主肖像，灵感来源于梦幻的室内生日派对照片。人物侧身坐在 {argument name="location" default="奢华温暖的酒店宴会厅"} 中，手中拿着 {argument name="flowers" default="一大束用半透明亮面粉色包装纸包裹并系着大白蝴蝶结的淡粉色玫瑰"}。人物周围环绕着许多深红色玫瑰、红色和粉色气球，包括一个金属质感的红色心形气球。添加柔和的生日派对背景，配以温暖的吸顶灯、优雅的墙板、模糊的“Happy Birthday”横幅，以及一个带有微妙可读文字的白色生日欢迎项目：“{argument name="welcome text" default="Welcome to my Birthday Party"}”。

templates.title: Expressionist Sketch Art Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 表现主义素描艺术海报

templates.prompt:
EXPRESSIONIST SKETCH PORTRAIT
Subject name: {argument name="subject name" default="[Enter Name Here]"}
Create a 4:5 vertical portrait art poster in the style of {argument name="art style" default="Expressionist drawing, inspired by Egon Schiele"}. The medium should evoke rough white sketch paper texture, using a high contrast monochromatic palette of deep black ink, charcoal grey, and raw white with raw emotional energy and a bold, gallery-quality feel.
Based on the uploaded reference photo, faithfully preserve the subject’s facial features, hairstyle, and personal aura in a half-body portrait composition. The rendering style is expressionist ink and charcoal portraiture, not photography, not cartoon, not anime. Facial details should be rendered with loose gestural lines, visible sketch marks, deliberate smudges, and intentionally unfinished areas that give the subject life and emotional intensity.
On the left side of the composition, write the subject’s full name in large bold expressive brushstroke lettering as a vertical column, with raw ink energy, line variation, and deliberate imperfection that matches the gestural drawing style. The name strokes should feel like they are drawn with the same hand and the same urgency as the portrait itself.
Based on the subject’s name, overall mood, and personal aura, automatically generate one elegant poetic English phrase of 8 to 12 words. The phrase should feel emotionally resonant and not modern colloquial, raw and honest and not overly obscure or kitschy, and deeply evocative of the subject’s inner spirit and temperament. Only this one generated phrase should appear in the composition with no repetition and no full-page text coverage.
This poetic phrase must be rendered in bold expressive brushstroke script and organically compose the contours of the figure, with the gestural letterforms bleeding directly into and tracing the subject’s head silhouette, hair flow, facial outline, neck, shoulder, and upper body lines. The viewer should feel as if the written words and the drawn figure share the same raw ink energy, as if the act of writing the phrase was the same act as drawing the person into existence.
Preserve large areas of raw open white space. In the lower left add loose gestural sketch marks suggesting ground or shadow. In the upper right add sparse expressive mark-making that suggests space and atmosphere without forming a clear image. These background elements must be raw and minimal and must never compete with the portrait.
Style keywords: Expressionist sketch portrait, Schiele-inspired drawing, gestural brushstroke lettering figure construction, high contrast ink and charcoal, figure outline formed by expressive letterforms, raw energy, emotional, bold, gallery-quality art poster.
Avoid: any Chinese characters or Asian script, cartoon or anime style, vivid colors, clean modern fonts, repetitive or excessive text, cluttered composition, overly refined digital art feel, commercial poster kitsch.

promptLocalized.zh:
表现主义素描肖像
主体名称：{argument name="subject name" default="[在此输入姓名]"}
创作一张 4:5 比例的竖版肖像艺术海报，风格为 {argument name="art style" default="表现主义绘画，灵感源自埃贡·席勒"}。媒介应呈现粗糙的白色素描纸质感，使用深黑墨水、炭灰色和原始白色的高对比度单色调，展现原始的情感能量与大胆的画廊级质感。
基于上传的参考照片，在半身肖像构图中忠实保留主体的面部特征、发型和个人气质。渲染风格应为表现主义水墨炭笔肖像，而非摄影、卡通或动漫。面部细节应通过松散的手绘线条、可见的素描痕迹、刻意的涂抹以及有意留出的未完成区域来呈现，赋予主体生命力与情感强度。
在构图左侧，以大号、粗体且富有表现力的笔触书写主体的全名，呈垂直列排布，展现原始的墨水张力、线条变化以及与手绘风格相契合的刻意瑕疵。名字的笔触应如同与肖像出自同一人之手，且带有同样的紧迫感。
根据主体的姓名、整体氛围和个人气质，自动生成一句 8 到 12 个单词的优雅英文诗意短语。该短语应具有情感共鸣，避免现代口语，保持原始与真诚，不应过于晦涩或庸俗，并能深刻唤起主体内在的精神与气质。画面中仅出现这一句生成的短语，不得重复，且不可覆盖整个页面。
此诗意短语必须以粗体且富有表现力的笔触书写，并有机地构成人物轮廓，手绘字形直接融入并勾勒出主体的头部轮廓、发丝流向、面部线条、颈部、肩部及上半身线条。观者应感受到文字与人物肖像共享着同样的原始墨水能量，仿佛书写短语的过程与将人物绘入画中的过程是浑然一体的。
保留大面积的原始留白。在左下角添加松散的手绘痕迹，暗示地面或阴影。在右上角添加稀疏的表现性标记，营造空间感与氛围，而不形成具体的图像。这些背景元素必须保持原始且极简，绝不能喧宾夺主。
风格关键词：表现主义素描肖像，席勒风格绘画，手绘笔触字形构图，高对比度水墨与炭笔，由表现性字形构成的轮廓，原始能量，情感化，大胆，画廊级艺术海报。
避免：任何中文字符或亚洲文字、卡通或动漫风格、鲜艳色彩、整洁的现代字体、重复或过多的文字、杂乱的构图、过于精致的数字艺术感、商业海报的庸俗感。

templates.prompt: Create a clean technical system diagram of a residential {argument name="system type" default="greywater recycling system"} for toilet flushing. Show {argument name="sources" default="three water sources"} on the left: kitchen vegetable washing sink, bathroom wash basin, and washing machine. Each source connects through a diverter valve to either the original sewer drain or the greywater recycling line. The greywater line goes into a pre-filter module with coarse mesh filter, sediment trap, washable cartridge filter, and grease separator for kitchen water. Then show a low-level greywater collection tank with overflow pipe to sewer, high and low water level sensors, and inspection cover. From this tank, show a greywater transfer pump sending water upward into a large white plastic storage tank. The large tank has low, middle, and high water level sensors, overflow to sewer, drain outlet, optional UV disinfection module, and ventilation. From the storage tank, show a pump or gravity outlet feeding the toilet cistern. Include a backup clean water supply with air gap and backflow prevention to the toilet cistern. Show a {argument name="controller" default="Raspberry Pi 4 controller"} connected with signal lines to sensors, solenoid valves, pumps, leak sensor, and alarm. Use blue arrows for water flow, red arrows for overflow/emergency drain, dotted black lines for electronic control. Style: modern engineering schematic, white background, labeled components, clear arrows, minimal but detailed.

templates.title: French Style Spring Forest Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 法式春日森林人像

templates.prompt:
Please generate a single high-end portrait in a 3:4 vertical composition based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, with the theme "{argument name="theme" default="Spring/Summer window-side forest-style French light boudoir portrait"}".

[Character Consistency]
Please strictly preserve the user's authentic physical characteristics, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, perceived age, hairstyle foundation, and overall temperament. The result must clearly look like the same real girl, not a stranger, not Westernized, not influencer-style, without excessive skin smoothing or an artificial AI face.

[Core Style]
The overall style is a spring/summer window-side, forest-inspired, French light-retro girl's boudoir photoshoot. The vibe is fresh, soft, quiet, and ethereal, with a hint of laziness, shyness, relaxation, pensiveness, and a sense of being gently wrapped in natural light. The image should look like a candid moment captured by a photographer with a camera in a real bedroom on a spring or early summer afternoon.

[Image Quality & Lighting Focus]
Please prioritize replicating the soft, hazy, glowing texture of a real camera rather than a standard clear AI portrait.

[Makeup]
The makeup should be {argument name="makeup" default="very light and transparent nude makeup, close to a no-makeup look"}. The base should be sheer and natural, preserving some real skin texture and natural shadows.

[Clothing]
The clothing should be {argument name="clothing" default="white, off-white, or beige French-style light boudoir attire"}, such as lace nightgowns, sheer slip dresses, off-shoulder tulle tops, or soft layered short skirts. Materials should focus on lace, gauze, thin cotton, and soft pleats.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，生成一张 3:4 竖构图的高端人像，主题为“{argument name="theme" default="春夏窗边森林系法式轻复古闺房人像"}”。

[人物一致性]
请严格保留用户真实的身体特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、感知年龄、发型基础以及整体气质。最终效果必须明确是同一位真实女性，而非陌生人，不得过度西化或呈现网红感，严禁过度磨皮或出现人工 AI 脸。

[核心风格]
整体风格为春夏窗边、森林灵感、法式轻复古少女闺房摄影。氛围清新、柔和、宁静且空灵，带有一丝慵懒、羞涩、放松、沉思感，仿佛被自然光温柔包裹。画面应呈现出摄影师在春夏午后的真实卧室中，用相机捕捉到的抓拍瞬间。

[图像质量与光影重点]
请优先还原真实相机拍摄的柔和、朦胧、带有光晕的质感，而非标准的清晰 AI 人像。

[妆容]
妆容应为“{argument name="makeup" default="非常清透的裸妆，接近素颜感"}”。底妆应轻薄自然，保留真实的皮肤纹理和自然阴影。

templates.title: 1970s Occult Children's Book Page

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Using this character, draw {argument name="theme" default="a page from a 1970s-era children's book about the occult, future science, or paranormal phenomena"}.

Do not use the reference image as is; create a situation and composition that suits the content of the page.

Important: The content should be interpreted by a 1970s children's book editor who forcibly links the reference image to paranormal phenomena or future science.

Make the page look as if an adult at the time saw this character, assumed it was a meaningful entity, and developed strange theories, super-logic, or occult interpretations.

Focus on leaps of logic that seem plausible yet are nonsensical.

The content should be random each time, with the editor's delusions and assertions running wild. Include assertive text designed to provoke children's curiosity.

The layout should be in the style of a 1970s children's book. Include old paper textures, misaligned printing, fading, crude illustrations, red and blue ink, hand-drawn arrows, and nonsensical charts.

Each time:
- Different far-fetched interpretations
- Different page layouts
- Different assertions
- Different strange theories
- Different camera angles

Important: Prioritize the feeling of a 'strange children's book that might have actually existed.' Instead of orthodox sci-fi, prioritize the enthusiasm of an occult editor with strange theories, forced connections, and leaps of logic.

promptLocalized.zh:
使用此角色，绘制 {argument name="theme" default="一页关于神秘学、未来科学或超自然现象的 20 世纪 70 年代儿童读物"}。

不要直接使用参考图像，请根据页面内容构思合适的场景和构图。

重要提示：内容应由一名 20 世纪 70 年代的儿童读物编辑进行解读，他会强行将参考图像与超自然现象或未来科学联系起来。

让页面看起来像是当时的一位成年人看到了这个角色，便将其认定为某种有意义的实体，并由此衍生出各种奇怪的理论、超逻辑或神秘学解读。

重点突出那些看似合理实则荒谬的逻辑跳跃。

每次生成的内容都应随机，展现编辑天马行空的妄想与断言。包含旨在激发儿童好奇心的断言性文字。

排版应采用 20 世纪 70 年代儿童读物的风格。包含旧纸张纹理、印刷错位、褪色、粗糙的插图、红蓝油墨、手绘箭头以及毫无意义的图表。

每次生成需包含：
- 不同的牵强解读
- 不同的页面布局
- 不同的断言
- 不同的奇怪理论
- 不同的拍摄角度

重要提示：优先体现“一本可能真实存在过的奇怪儿童读物”的感觉。不要追求正统的科幻感，而应优先展现一位神秘学编辑的热情，通过奇怪的理论、强行的关联和逻辑跳跃来呈现内容。

templates.title: Realistic Mac Webcam Photo Edit

titleLocalized.zh: 带马赛克视频窗口的 MacBook 视频截图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the base, regenerate it as a cleaner, more realistic low-light phone photo of the same laptop screen. Keep the overall concept of a Mac desktop with a floating webcam window and the same anonymized square blur over the face, but change the scene as follows: crop in closer on the laptop so the right side of the screen and bezel dominate the frame, remove the bottom dock from view, and use a dark macOS desert-at-night wallpaper instead of the lake wallpaper. Make the webcam window much smaller and centered on the desktop, with only the three traffic-light buttons visible at the top left and no title text. Inside the webcam window, keep the same person as the subject but change the shirt to a {argument name="shirt style" default="black sleeveless tank top"}, show more shoulders/upper arms, and add a visible tattoo on the subject’s right upper arm. Reposition the desk lamp so it appears on the left side inside the webcam frame with warm light. Update the menu bar so it looks minimal and shows {argument name="date and time" default="11 May 9:37"}. Preserve the candid handheld camera look, warm room lighting, laptop bezel, keyboard edge at the bottom, mild screen dust/reflections, and natural photo imperfections; avoid adding extra UI windows, dock icons, or sharp studio-clean rendering.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的手持智能手机拍摄照片，画面中是一台在昏暗、温暖的室内夜晚打开的 {argument name="device" default="MacBook 笔记本电脑"}。镜头从右上方近距离拍摄，露出黑色边框、屏幕右侧边缘以及部分键盘/触控栏。屏幕显示深色的 macOS 沙丘夜景壁纸，背景为山脉和星光熠熠的蓝黑色天空。屏幕中央有一个小型悬浮视频通话/照片窗口，带有圆角和细边框；窗口左上角有三个 macOS 标志性的红、黄、绿交通灯按钮。窗口内坐着一名成年男子，身穿 {argument name="shirt color" default="黑色"} 背心，露出肩膀和手臂上的纹身；他身后左侧有一盏温暖的台灯，背景为米色墙壁；他的脸部被一个 {argument name="censor color" default="中等棕色肤色"} 的方形像素马赛克遮挡。在笔记本电脑屏幕右上角的菜单栏中，包含七个小型状态图标：一个圆形播放图标、电池图标、蓝牙图标、Wi-Fi 图标、放大镜搜索图标、控制中心风格的切换图标，以及日期/时间文本 {argument name="date and time text" default="5 月 11 日 9:37"}。照片应呈现出不完美且真实的质感，带有轻微的屏幕反光、灰尘颗粒、低光噪点、边框上的暖色环境反射、浅景深，避免过于精致的摄影棚效果。

templates.title: Floating Instagram Creator Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 悬浮 Instagram 创作者肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D social-media creator portrait set in a pastel sunset sky above soft pink clouds. A young woman influencer, {argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"}, is seated sideways on the edge of a glossy floating metallic platform, seen from behind in a three-quarter view, holding a smartphone that shows an Instagram-like profile screen. Her face is intentionally obscured with a smooth neutral blur rectangle, while her long wavy dark brown hair falls over a pale pink and white hoodie. The hoodie has raised embossed back text reading “HANIA AI”. She wears coordinated pastel pink cargo joggers with strap details and pink-and-white sneakers, relaxed pose with one leg bent on the platform and one foot hanging down. Behind her, place a huge glowing 3D Instagram-style app logo in a pink-orange-purple gradient with rounded corners and neon rim lighting, towering like a futuristic sign. Surround the scene with exactly 12 floating social UI elements: 1 red like notification bubble with a white heart and number “1”, 1 red comment bubble, 1 pale square comment icon, 1 glossy reels/video icon cube, 1 translucent follower card reading “Followers 100K”, 4 circular avatar story thumbnails along the lower left edge, and 3 thin white outline navigation icons along the lower right/center area for bookmark, paper-plane share, and app navigation. Add a bottom floating nameplate plaque beneath the platform with glowing text “{argument name="nameplate text" default="HANIA AI"}” and subtitle “{argument name="subtitle text" default="Digital Creator"}”. Use soft volumetric clouds, sparkles, lens glow, warm rim light, reflective chrome edges, pink lavender orange color palette, high-detail semi-realistic 3D render, polished influencer branding aesthetic, shallow depth of field, ultra-clean composition, no extra readable text besides the specified labels.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻般的 9:16 竖屏电影感 3D 社交媒体创作者肖像，背景设定在柔和粉色云层之上的粉彩日落天空。一位年轻的女性网红 {argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"} 侧身坐在一个光亮的悬浮金属平台边缘，以四分之三的背影视角呈现，手中拿着一部显示类似 Instagram 个人资料界面的智能手机。她的面部被一个平滑的中性模糊矩形刻意遮挡，长长的深棕色波浪卷发垂在淡粉色和白色的连帽衫上。连帽衫背面有凸起的浮雕文字“HANIA AI”。她穿着配套的粉彩粉色工装慢跑裤，带有绑带细节和粉白相间的运动鞋，姿势放松，一条腿弯曲在平台上，另一只脚垂下。在她身后，放置一个巨大的发光 3D Instagram 风格应用 Logo，采用粉-橙-紫渐变色，带有圆角和霓虹边缘灯光，像未来主义标志一样高耸。场景周围环绕着 12 个悬浮的社交 UI 元素：1 个带有白色爱心和数字“1”的红色点赞通知气泡、1 个红色评论气泡、1 个浅色方形评论图标、1 个光亮的 Reels/视频图标立方体、1 张写有“Followers 100K”的半透明粉丝卡片、左下边缘的 4 个圆形头像快拍缩略图，以及右下/中心区域用于书签、纸飞机分享和应用导航的 3 个细白色轮廓导航图标。在平台下方添加一个悬浮的底部铭牌，上面有发光文字“{argument name="nameplate text" default="HANIA AI"}”和副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="Digital Creator"}”。使用柔和的体积云、闪光、镜头光晕、温暖的边缘光、反光的铬合金边缘、粉色薰衣草橙色调色板、高细节半写实 3D 渲染、精致的网红品牌美学、浅景深、超简洁构图，除指定的标签外，不包含任何额外的可读文本。

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic dark fantasy anime key art illustration in the style of high-detail Korean action RPG promotional art, featuring {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious female archmage"} standing in a ruined cathedral under a starry night sky. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing silver-white hair with lavender highlights"}, an elegant curvy silhouette, and a white-and-black ornate sorceress outfit: cropped white hooded cloak with gold embroidery, black corset bodice, layered white skirt panels, belts, chains, dangling charms, thigh straps, sheer black stockings, and tall dark boots. Her face is intentionally covered by a soft-edged square blur censor block, while her body and costume remain sharply detailed. She extends her left hand toward the viewer, conjuring a glowing purple magical orb inside a golden astrolabe-like ring with sparks and arcane energy; her right hand holds an ancient dark spellbook with gold filigree. Behind her is a huge circular celestial clock or magic sigil halo with radial lines and constellations, broken stone pillars, flying parchment, torn white ribbons, violet smoke, and distant ruins. Add the white stylized logo text {argument name="logo text" default="Dungeon & Fighter"} in the top-left corner. Use cinematic rim lighting, purple and gold highlights, high contrast shadows, intricate linework, dynamic flowing hair and fabric, ultra-detailed fantasy illustration, vertical poster composition, polished game splash art quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的暗黑奇幻动漫主视觉插画，风格参考高细节韩国动作 RPG 宣传艺术。画面主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的女大魔导师"}，她站在星空下的废墟大教堂中。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长银白发，带有淡紫色挑染"}，身姿优雅曼妙，身着黑白配色的华丽法师服：短款白色连帽斗篷配金色刺绣、黑色束腰胸衣、层叠的白色裙摆、腰带、链条、垂坠饰品、腿带、黑色透肉丝袜以及深色高筒靴。她的面部被刻意处理为柔边方形模糊遮挡，而身体和服饰保持极高细节。她向观众伸出左手，在金色的星盘状圆环中凝聚出一颗发光的紫色魔法球，伴有火花和奥术能量；右手持有一本带有金色花丝的古老暗黑法术书。她身后是一个巨大的圆形天体时钟或魔法符文光环，带有放射状线条和星座图案，背景包含破碎的石柱、飞舞的羊皮纸、撕裂的白色丝带、紫色的烟雾以及远处的废墟。在左上角添加白色风格化标志文本 {argument name="logo text" default="Dungeon & Fighter"}。采用电影级轮廓光、紫色与金色高光、高对比度阴影、精细的线条、动态飘逸的头发与布料，呈现超精细奇幻插画效果，采用竖版海报构图，达到精美的游戏宣传画品质。

templates.title: Blue Jays Broadcast Crowd Shot

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝鸟队转播观众镜头

templates.prompt: Create a realistic broadcast TV screenshot from a Major League Baseball crowd shot at a {argument name="team name" default="Toronto Blue Jays"} home game, framed in a 16:9 HD sports-telecast crop with shallow stadium lighting and slight compression blur. The scene shows two young adult male fans seated side by side in the lower bowl, both faces anonymized by flat medium-brown rectangular blocks. The left fan has medium-length dark hair and wears a light powder-blue Blue Jays button-up jersey over a black hoodie, holding a clear plastic cup of beer with both hands near his lap. The right fan has short curly dark hair and wears a royal-blue Blue Jays Nike T-shirt, sitting upright and looking toward the field. Around them are other spectators in blue, white, and gray clothing, including a person behind them in a gray Toronto hoodie, a fan at left wearing a blue Blue Jays jersey with the bird-and-maple-leaf logo, and partial foreground heads at the bottom and right; include exactly 3 visible anonymized face blocks total, two large blocks over the central fans and one partial block on the right edge. Add an authentic TV scoreboard bug in the upper-left corner with a dark blue and white Sportsnet style: {argument name="away team abbreviation" default="NYY"} score {argument name="away score" default="3"}, {argument name="home team abbreviation" default="TOR"} score {argument name="home score" default="2"}, the Sportsnet SN logo on the right, and a lower line reading "▼ 5TH   1-1   1 OUT". Make it look like a paused live broadcast crowd reaction shot, not a posed photo, with realistic stadium seats, team logos, natural shadows, and telephoto lens perspective.

promptLocalized.zh: 生成一张逼真的电视转播截图，画面为美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）{argument name="team name" default="多伦多蓝鸟队"} 主场比赛的观众镜头，采用 16:9 高清体育转播画幅，呈现浅景深体育场灯光和轻微的压缩模糊效果。场景中两名年轻男性球迷并排坐在下层看台，两人的面部均被平面的中棕色矩形色块遮挡。左侧球迷留着中长深色头发，身穿浅粉蓝色蓝鸟队纽扣球衣，内搭黑色连帽衫，双手捧着一个透明塑料啤酒杯放在膝盖附近。右侧球迷留着深色短卷发，身穿宝蓝色蓝鸟队 Nike T 恤，坐姿端正，望向赛场。周围是其他身穿蓝色、白色和灰色服装的观众，包括身后一名穿着灰色多伦多连帽衫的人，左侧一名身穿带有鸟与枫叶标志的蓝色蓝鸟队球衣的球迷，以及底部和右侧局部的头部；画面中总共包含 3 个可见的匿名面部遮挡块，两个较大的遮挡块位于中央球迷脸上，一个局部遮挡块位于右侧边缘。在左上角添加一个地道的电视记分牌，采用深蓝色和白色的 Sportsnet 风格：{argument name="away team abbreviation" default="NYY"} 得分 {argument name="away score" default="3"}，{argument name="home team abbreviation" default="TOR"} 得分 {argument name="home score" default="2"}，右侧带有 Sportsnet SN 标志，下方一行显示“▼ 5TH   1-1   1 OUT”。使其看起来像是一张暂停的现场转播观众反应镜头，而非摆拍照片，并具备逼真的体育场座椅、球队标志、自然阴影和长焦镜头视角。

She is a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="short chestnut brown hair"}, wearing a white off-shoulder summoner-style robe with long draped sleeves, a purple and pink layered skirt with floral embroidery, a colorful obi sash and large patterned bow on the back, bead tassel details, a small necklace, and black ankle boots. She sits sideways on the stone railing with her legs crossed, one elbow resting on her knee and her hand near her chin in a quiet contemplative pose, while holding a tall blue ceremonial staff with gold metal ends and an ornate circular gold crest at the top. The background shows a moonlit ocean with shimmering reflections, distant clouds, a tiny sailboat silhouette, rocky coastline, and old stone balusters, with cool blue cinematic lighting, soft rim light on hair and shoulders, realistic fabric texture, shallow depth of field, dramatic fantasy atmosphere, high-detail digital photography style, 9:16 composition. Include a large opaque square censor block covering the center of the face, matching the look of a failed or glitched image generation result. Add a subtle artist signature reading {argument name="signature text" default="AI.na"} in the lower right corner.

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed vertical fantasy portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Yuna"}, a young woman styled as an ornate royal sorceress or shrine maiden, shown from the chest up in a dark blue and gold baroque floral setting. She has long glossy {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair with loose wet-looking strands, elaborate blue flower hair ornaments, dangling gold chains, lapis-blue beads, and tassels framing her head. Her face is completely hidden by a centered opaque square block in a muted brown skin-tone color, covering the facial features from forehead to chin while leaving the hair, neck, hands, costume, and accessories visible. She wears a luxurious pale silver-white kimono robe embroidered with metallic gold filigree and deep cobalt-blue floral appliqués, with layered fabric folds and a refined ceremonial collar. In her left hand she holds a tall dark navy staff or scepter with polished gold bands, topped by an intricate circular gold astrolabe-like ornament with concentric rings, filigree, tiny blue gemstones, and a hanging blue tassel. Surround her with dense decorative elements: blue and crimson flowers, gilded curling vines, ornate scrollwork, jewel-like beads, and blurred floral ornaments in the foreground and background. Use {argument name="color palette" default="deep sapphire blue, antique gold, silver white, crimson accents"}, dramatic cinematic lighting, warm highlights on metal, shallow depth of field, hyperrealistic texture, high-fashion fantasy photography, extremely crisp embroidery and jewelry details, dark moody background, vertical 9:16 composition, premium gpt-image-2 detail level.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超精细的竖版奇幻肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Yuna"}，一位年轻女性，造型为华丽的皇家女巫或巫女，半身像，背景为深蓝色和金色的巴洛克花卉风格。她拥有长而有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 头发，带有湿润感的散发，头部周围装饰着精致的蓝色花朵发饰、垂下的金链、青金石蓝珠子和流苏。她的脸部完全被一个位于中央的不透明方形色块遮挡，色调为柔和的棕色肤色，覆盖了从额头到下巴的面部特征，但保留了头发、颈部、双手、服装和配饰的可见度。她穿着一件奢华的浅银白色和服长袍，上面绣有金属金丝和深钴蓝色花卉贴花，具有层叠的织物褶皱和精致的礼仪领口。她的左手拿着一根高大的深海军蓝权杖或节杖，带有抛光的金带，顶部是一个复杂的圆形金质星盘状装饰，带有同心圆、金丝、微小的蓝色宝石和悬挂的蓝色流苏。周围环绕着密集的装饰元素：蓝色和深红色的花朵、镀金的卷曲藤蔓、华丽的卷轴装饰、珠宝般的珠子，以及前景和背景中模糊的花卉装饰。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="深蓝宝石色、古金色、银白色、深红色点缀"}，戏剧性的电影级灯光，金属上的暖色高光，浅景深，超写实纹理，高级时尚奇幻摄影，极其清晰的刺绣和珠宝细节，深沉忧郁的背景，9:16 竖版构图，premium gpt-image-2 细节级别。

templates.prompt: {"type":"dark fantasy concept art diptych","format":"two stacked widescreen panels separated by a thin black divider, painterly illustration, muted olive-green palette, intricate ink-like linework, cinematic scale, no captions or UI text","overall_mood":"ancient, mythic, mournful, eldritch nature magic in a ruined wasteland under a large pale moon","layout":{"panel_count":2,"panels":[{"position":"top panel","scene":"A colossal tree-bodied guardian stands in a desolate rocky valley, shown from mid-distance with its body filling the right half of the frame. It wears a massive dark moss-green cloak that streams dramatically leftward in the wind; the inner lining is black with glowing yellow-green vein patterns like constellations or living roots. Across its body it holds an enormous staff or mace horizontally with both hands. The weapon has a dark gnarled shaft, a black spiked stone head near center-left, and a wide luminous turquoise crystal blade or broom-like cluster of shard leaves extending to the far left. Small bones and skeletal remains lie in the foreground, with distant jagged ruins in fog. A tiny torch-bearing human figure stands at the lower right for scale. A golden dust trail arcs across the sky behind the guardian.","discrete_visible_elements":{"giant_guardians":1,"tiny_human_figures":1,"major_weapon":1,"large_moon":1,"golden_sky_trails":1}},{"position":"bottom panel","scene":"A second colossal forest revenant or ancient druidic titan advances through a graveyard-like wasteland. The figure is centered-right, hunched and towering, built from dark bark, moss, roots, cracked stone armor, hanging vines, and glowing yellow-green fissures. Its head and crown are a tangle of dead black branches, with ragged foliage and roots cascading down its face. It wears a torn, windblown dark green cloak sweeping left, decorated with small circular eye-like markings and faint golden root patterns. promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"神奇的“迷你我”社交媒体肖像，融合可爱 3D 动画微型克隆体的逼真照片合成","scene":"一张温馨舒适的室内肖像，主角是一位身穿超大号橄榄棕色风衣的年轻女性，在柔和的金色窗光照耀下。主角的面部被特意保留为平面的匿名方形遮罩。在她周围，6 个与她外貌相同的 3D 风格微型动画角色活灵活现，与房间和她的服装进行互动，她们都留着同样的棕色波浪卷发，穿着微型风衣、牛仔裤和运动鞋。保持主体肖像的逼真感，除添加的微型角色外不做改动，确保具有真实的景深、接触阴影、柔和的环境光遮蔽，以及梦幻般的社交媒体故事感。","customizable_subject":{"main person":"{argument name=\"main person\" default=\"棕色波浪卷发的年轻女性\"}","outfit":"{argument name=\"outfit\" default=\"浅色上衣外搭超大号橄榄棕色风衣\"}","room mood":"{argument name=\"room mood\" default=\"充满金色阳光的温馨米色卧室角落\"}"},"mini_characters":{"count":6,"items":[{"position":"最左侧，站在外带咖啡杯上","action":"单手举着横幅，表情欢快且充满鼓励","prop_text":"{argument name=\"left note text\" default=\"你可以的！♡\"}"},{"position":"左下角，坐在镜子前的梳妆台上","action":"放松的坐姿，双腿向前，靠近一张手写便条"},{"position":"顶部中央，像坐在柔软的巢穴中一样坐在主角头发上","action":"微小的坐姿，双手放在头发上，看起来可爱又平静"},{"position":"右侧，靠在主角的头发和肩膀上","action":"一只手热情地向观众挥手"},{"position":"肩膀中下方，坐在主角的风衣翻领上","action":"双手捧着一本打开的小棕色书阅读"},{"position":"右下角，坐在棕色皮质手提包里","action":"害羞地探出头，双手靠近脸部，舒适又俏皮"}]},"background_details":{"left":"梳妆台上的木框镜子，带有简单涂鸦脸的咖啡杯，镜中可见反射的微型人像，手写卡片上写着“专注与闪耀”","right":"小盆栽，贴在墙上的微型角色拍立得照片，墙上的黄色便利贴","right_note_text":"{argument name=\"right note text\" default=\"别想太多 ♡\"}"},"style":"以写实肖像为基础，融合奇幻精致的 3D 卡通微型人偶，柔和圆润的特征，逼真的织物纹理，电影感暖米色调，浅景深，真实的比例，自然的阴影，舒适的魔幻现实主义，方形构图，适合 Instagram 的故事感审美","negative_prompt":"不要改变主角的姿势或房间布局，除了指定的 6 个微型角色外不要添加额外角色，没有生硬的轮廓，没有塑料玩具感，没有扭曲的手部，没有没有阴影的悬浮角色，背景不要杂乱，主要便条文字必须清晰可读"}

templates.title: Izakaya Pose Variation

titleLocalized.zh: 居酒屋姿势变体

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, create a realistic photo variation in the same dim Japanese bar setting, keeping the woman's outfit, hairstyle, stool, lighting, and candid smartphone-flash look consistent. Change her pose so she is turned more toward the man on the right and extends one arm forward, gently placing her hand on his shoulder as if getting his attention. Keep the man in the right foreground closer to the camera and partially blocking the view, with anonymized/blurred faces as in the reference. Preserve the cramped izakaya atmosphere, wall menus, bottles, dark wood, and casual candid composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，在相同的昏暗日式酒吧环境中创作一张逼真的照片变体，保持女性的服装、发型、凳子、灯光以及手机闪光灯下的抓拍质感一致。改变她的姿势，使她更多地转向右侧的男性，并将一只手臂向前伸出，轻轻地将手放在他的肩膀上，仿佛在引起他的注意。保持右侧前景中的男性靠近镜头并部分遮挡视野，同时像参考图中那样对人脸进行匿名化/模糊处理。保留狭窄的居酒屋氛围、墙上的菜单、酒瓶、深色木材以及随意的抓拍构图。

templates.title: Ornate Blue Belly Dancer Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 华丽的蓝色肚皮舞者插画

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical anime-style illustration of a glamorous {argument name="character description" default="young female belly dancer"} in an ornate cool-toned costume, shown in a dramatic close-up cropped composition from upper thighs to head area, with the face and central upper body intentionally covered by a large opaque gray rectangular censor block. The palette is dominated by deep navy, teal, aqua, silver, and pale icy blue. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="ash brown"} hair with soft curls spilling across the right side, decorated with delicate silver chains, tiny blue flower charms, dangling beads, and jeweled head ornaments. Her outfit is an intricate {argument name="costume style" default="fantasy belly dancer costume"}: a dark navy fitted bodice, sheer turquoise veils wrapping around the shoulders and arms, layered translucent ruffles, white lace trim, and a richly decorated arm sleeve covered in silver filigree, pearls, oval metal coins, blue gemstones, floral motifs, and geometric diamond panels. Include a large pale blue fabric flower with a round silver medallion center on the upper left, flowing gauzy scarves, scattered coin ornaments, small pink triangular accents on the veil, and a dark flowing skirt at the bottom. Her hand appears near the lower center with delicate fingers and pale nails. Use an elegant high-detail digital painting style with smooth shading, crisp linework, glossy jewel highlights, ornate textile patterns, fantasy illustration polish, soft lighting, and a refined luxurious mood. The composition should feel intimate and decorative, with dense ornamental detail filling the frame and no background text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的竖版动漫风格插画，主角是一位迷人的 {argument name="character description" default="年轻女性肚皮舞者"}，身着华丽的冷色调服装。画面采用从大腿上部到头部的戏剧性特写构图，面部及上半身中央区域被一个巨大的不透明灰色矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。色调以深海军蓝、青色、水绿色、银色和浅冰蓝色为主。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="灰棕色"} 飘逸卷发，发丝柔和地垂落在右侧，装饰着精致的银链、细小的蓝色花朵吊坠、悬垂的珠子和珠宝头饰。她的服装是精致的 {argument name="costume style" default="奇幻肚皮舞服"}：深海军蓝紧身胸衣，肩部和手臂缠绕着透明的绿松石色面纱，层叠的半透明荷叶边，白色蕾丝饰边，以及覆盖着银色花丝、珍珠、椭圆形金属硬币、蓝色宝石、花卉图案和几何菱形镶板的华丽袖套。左上方饰有一朵巨大的浅蓝色布艺花朵，中心镶嵌着圆形银质奖章，配以飘逸的薄纱围巾、散落的硬币装饰、面纱上细小的粉色三角形点缀，底部为深色的飘逸裙摆。她的手出现在画面下方中央，手指纤细，指甲呈浅色。采用优雅的高细节数字绘画风格，具有平滑的阴影、清晰的线条、光泽的珠宝高光、华丽的纺织品纹理、奇幻插画的质感、柔和的灯光以及精致奢华的氛围。构图应显得亲密且具有装饰性，密集的装饰细节填满画面，背景无任何文字。

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical anime sci-fi illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young cybernetic girl"} standing full-body on a wet, broken metal pier above a stormy ocean, in a ruined futuristic harbor. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long dark navy hair"} flowing in the wind, pale skin, large melancholy blue eyes, and a calm serious expression. She wears a white, black, and blue tactical cyber-armor outfit with many straps, belts, pouches, buckles, glowing blue tech accents, mechanical leg armor, armored boots, thigh-high dark stockings, and small wing-like hair ornaments. In her left hand she holds a large futuristic rifle pointed downward; on her raised right hand perches a small blue mechanical bird with spread wings. The background is an immense dystopian seaport filled with towering decayed megastructures, suspended scaffolding, cables, ruined ships, tilted industrial towers, and a massive broken circular arch structure looming through mist. The sea is dark and turbulent with scattered lights, sparks, smoke, rain haze, and reflective puddles on the foreground floor. Use a {argument name="mood" default="dark cinematic post-apocalyptic"} atmosphere, dramatic backlighting from a cloudy sunset sky, cold blue-gray tones with small warm orange lights, intricate mechanical detail, painterly anime realism, sharp focus on the character, deep perspective, epic scale, high contrast, ultra-detailed concept art, 9:16 vertical composition.

templates.title: Anonymous Night Radio Doll Host

titleLocalized.zh: 匿名深夜电台玩偶主播

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic night-time radio studio scene in vertical portrait composition. A realistic ball-jointed female doll host with a short {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} bob haircut and straight bangs sits in a black leather chair at a wooden broadcast desk, wearing large over-ear headphones and a subtly sparkling black short-sleeve dress with a delicate necklace and bracelet; her face is intentionally covered by a plain centered {argument name="face cover color" default="dark brown"} rectangular block, as if anonymized. Place a large professional condenser microphone with shock mount and boom arm directly in front of her mouth, plus a mixing console in the foreground with glowing colored buttons. Include exactly 6 prominent desk/studio props: a red illuminated "ON AIR" sign, a digital clock reading "20:03:15", a white mug labeled "Night Radio", a clear plastic water bottle, handwritten notes with a pen, and a small stack of papers or notebook. The studio interior should feel cramped, warm, and atmospheric, with posters and notices on the wall, an analog clock in the upper left, shelves of CDs or records at the right edge, and reflections on polished wood. Through the large window behind her, show a rainy {argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} night street with wet pavement, blurred traffic lights, high-rise office buildings full of lit windows, and vertical Japanese-style neon signs including blue karaoke signage. Use moody low-key lighting, warm tungsten highlights inside the studio contrasting with cool blue city lights outside, shallow depth of field, realistic glass reflections, highly detailed textures, and the feeling of an intimate late-night broadcast where the host is reading listener mail. Add optional Japanese radio-show mood text context: {argument name="quote" default="次のお便りは異教徒さんから〜"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个垂直构图的电影级写实深夜电台直播间场景。一位逼真的球形关节女性玩偶主播，留着短款 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 波波头和直刘海，坐在黑色皮椅上，面前是木质广播台，佩戴着大型头戴式耳机，身穿一件带有细微闪光效果的黑色短袖连衣裙，搭配精致的项链和手链；她的脸部被一个居中的 {argument name="face cover color" default="深棕色"} 长方形色块刻意遮挡，呈现出匿名状态。在她的嘴部正前方放置一个带有防震架和悬臂支架的大型专业电容麦克风，前景处放置一个带有发光彩色按钮的调音台。画面中需包含 6 个显眼的桌面/工作室道具：一个红色的“ON AIR”发光标牌、一个显示为“20:03:15”的数字时钟、一个印有“Night Radio”字样的白色马克杯、一个透明塑料水瓶、带有钢笔的手写笔记，以及一小叠纸张或笔记本。工作室内部应营造出狭窄、温暖且富有氛围感的感觉，墙上贴有海报和通知，左上角挂着一个模拟时钟，右侧边缘有 CD 或唱片架，抛光的木质表面上有倒影。透过她身后的巨大窗户，展示一个下雨的 {argument name="city" default="东京"} 夜晚街道，地面湿润，交通灯光模糊，高层办公楼窗户灯火通明，并可见垂直的日式霓虹灯招牌，包括蓝色的卡拉 OK 招牌。使用情绪化的低调照明，室内温暖的钨丝灯高光与室外冷色调的城市灯光形成对比，采用浅景深效果，呈现逼真的玻璃反射和高细节纹理，营造出一种主播正在阅读听众来信的私密深夜广播氛围。添加可选的日语广播节目情绪文字内容：{argument name="quote" default="次のお便りは異教徒さんから〜"}。

templates.title: Warm Anime Vintage Bar Interior

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨复古动漫酒吧内景

templates.prompt: Create a richly detailed anime-style illustration of a cozy vintage wooden bar interior at night, viewed in wide landscape composition from the customer side of the counter. The scene features {argument name="character name" default="an elegant young barmaid"} sitting behind the polished L-shaped wooden bar, leaning on one elbow with one hand near her cheek, wearing a loose olive camisole and a pale headband, with {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy platinum-blonde hair"} cascading over her shoulders; her face is softly obscured and featureless, as if intentionally blurred. Use warm amber lighting from exactly 4 hanging lanterns suspended from dark ceiling beams, creating cohesive golden highlights and shadows across the character, bottles, shelves, counter, and wood-paneled walls. Include exactly 3 round wooden bar stools in the foreground. Behind the character, show a dense back bar with exactly 3 main horizontal bottle shelves on the left, 1 tall ornate bottle cabinet on the right with 3 shelves, and about 55 visible liquor bottles total, mixing whiskey, sake, ceramic flasks, decanters, and small labeled glass bottles. Add bar accessories on the counter and shelves: 1 brass desk lamp on the far left, 1 small gumball or candy box, 1 bowl of citrus fruit with oranges and limes, cocktail shakers, small jars, straws, bells, and hanging utensils. On the left wall include framed vintage alcohol posters and labels; on the right include a closed wooden door with a small diamond-pattern glass window and brass hinges. Render in a hand-drawn cinematic anime background style with intricate linework, dark brown wood grain, realistic perspective, warm reflections on varnished surfaces, nostalgic speakeasy atmosphere, high detail, integrated character-and-background lighting, no modern objects, no text overlays.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富、充满动漫风格的插画，描绘夜晚温馨的复古木质酒吧内景，采用从吧台顾客视角出发的宽幅横向构图。场景中，{argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻酒保"} 坐在打磨光滑的 L 型木质吧台后，单手托腮，身穿宽松的橄榄色吊带背心，戴着浅色发带，{argument name="hair color" default="一头波浪长卷发呈铂金色"} 垂落在肩头；她的面部柔和地模糊处理，没有具体五官。使用来自悬挂在深色天花板横梁上的 4 盏灯笼发出的暖琥珀色灯光，在角色、酒瓶、货架、吧台和木镶板墙壁上营造出和谐的金色高光与阴影。前景中包含 3 张圆木吧台椅。在角色身后，展示一个密集的后吧台，左侧有 3 层主要水平酒架，右侧有一个带 3 层隔板的高大华丽酒柜，总共可见约 55 个酒瓶，混合了威士忌、清酒、陶瓷酒壶、醒酒器和带有小标签的玻璃瓶。吧台和货架上添加吧台配件：最左侧放置 1 盏黄铜台灯，1 个小型口香糖或糖果盒，1 碗装有橙子和青柠的柑橘类水果，鸡尾酒摇酒壶、小罐子、吸管、铃铛和悬挂的餐具。左侧墙壁上挂有复古酒精海报和标签；右侧有一扇带菱形玻璃窗和黄铜合页的封闭木门。以手绘电影感动漫背景风格渲染，具有复杂的线条、深棕色木纹、逼真的透视效果、漆面上的温暖反射、怀旧的地下酒吧氛围、高细节度、一体化的角色与背景灯光，无现代物品，无文字覆盖。

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹朋克少女与哈士奇

templates.prompt: Create a high-energy anime street-art illustration featuring exactly two main subjects: a punk fashion girl and a large wolf-like dog. The girl is {argument name="character age and style" default="a teenage goth-punk anime girl"} crouching low in the center-right foreground, leaning forward with one hand near her mouth in a cool, defiant pose. She has {argument name="hair color and style" default="long black twin-tails with vivid hot-pink streaks"}, messy layered bangs, sharp magenta eyes, pale skin, multiple ear piercings, hairpins, rings, and a slightly mischievous expression. Dress her in an oversized black streetwear jacket covered in neon pink, cyan, and yellow graphic patches, off-shoulder styling, straps, buckles, a short dark outfit underneath, chunky high-top sneakers with hot-pink laces, and bold punk accessories. Beside her on the left is {argument name="animal companion" default="a large black, cream, and gray husky-wolf dog"} lying calmly but alert, facing left in profile with pointed ears, yellow eyes, fluffy fur, and matching neon pink and yellow paint-like accents integrated into its coat. Set them against {argument name="background style" default="a chaotic graffiti mural wall"} filled with explosive geometric street-art shapes, arrows, halftone dots, paint splatters, jagged lightning forms, layered posters, and abstract blocks. Use an intense neon palette of hot pink, cyan, yellow, black, cream, and purple, with crisp anime linework, glossy highlights, dramatic shadows, dense detail, and a dynamic urban poster composition. The image should feel like a fashionable cyberpunk graffiti album cover, wide landscape format, ultra-detailed, vibrant, edgy, and polished.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅充满活力的动漫街头艺术插画，画面中必须包含两个主体：一位朋克风少女和一只大型狼系犬。少女 {argument name="character age and style" default="一位十几岁的哥特朋克动漫少女"} 蹲在画面中右侧前景，身体前倾，一只手靠近嘴边，摆出酷炫且不羁的姿势。她留着 {argument name="hair color and style" default="黑色长双马尾，带有鲜艳的亮粉色挑染"}，凌乱的层次感刘海，锐利的洋红色双眼，皮肤白皙，佩戴多枚耳环、发夹和戒指，表情略带顽皮。她身穿一件超大号黑色街头风夹克，上面布满霓虹粉、青色和黄色的图形补丁，采用露肩设计，配有绑带、搭扣，内搭短款深色服装，脚蹬厚底高帮运动鞋，系着亮粉色鞋带，并佩戴醒目的朋克饰品。在她左侧是 {argument name="animal companion" default="一只大型黑、米、灰三色哈士奇狼犬"}，它冷静而警觉地侧卧着，侧脸朝左，竖起耳朵，有着黄色的眼睛、蓬松的毛发，皮毛上融入了与少女相呼应的霓虹粉和黄色涂鸦式点缀。背景设定为 {argument name="background style" default="一面混乱的涂鸦壁画墙"}，墙上充满爆炸性的几何街头艺术形状、箭头、半调网点、油漆飞溅、锯齿状闪电图案、层叠的海报和抽象色块。使用强烈的霓虹色调，包括亮粉色、青色、黄色、黑色、米色和紫色，配合清晰的动漫线条、光泽高光、戏剧性阴影、丰富的细节以及动态的城市海报构图。整张图片应呈现出时尚的赛博朋克涂鸦专辑封面质感，采用宽屏横向构图，超高细节，色彩鲜艳，前卫且精致。

templates.title: Good Morning Bird VTuber Frame

titleLocalized.zh: 早安小鸟 VTuber 边框

templates.prompt: Create a bright square VTuber “good morning” social media frame in a soft anime watercolor style, with a wide open center-right area of clear blue sky for placing a character or photo. The scene is a cheerful spring morning landscape viewed from a leafy garden: sunlit green branches and small white blossoms frame the top-left and left edge, with glowing lens flare, drifting petals, white feathers, and scattered green leaves across the sky. Add exactly 7 birds: 3 small birds perched on a flowering branch at left-middle, colored blue, white, and yellow; 3 birds perched on a rustic wooden sign at bottom-left, a brown sparrow, a pale yellow cockatiel with orange cheeks, and a blue budgerigar; and 1 swallow flying in the upper-right sky. In the upper-left, place elegant white hand-lettered script reading {argument name="headline text" default="Good Morning!"}, decorated with tiny leaves and sparkles, with a teal ribbon underneath containing the Japanese text {argument name="ribbon text" default="素敵な一日になりますように♪"}. At the bottom-left, make a weathered wooden plank sign wrapped with small flowers, vines, a white laurel motif, and a feather, with white script text {argument name="event title" default="Bind Week"} and a smaller date line {argument name="date range" default="5.10 (Sat) - 5.16 (Fri)"}. The background should show a soft distant town, lake or river, and pale mountains under fluffy white clouds, with daisies and yellow flowers blooming in the lower-right foreground. Use a fresh pastel palette, airy composition, high detail, gentle sunlight, clean decorative typography, and leave the center of the sky mostly uncluttered for overlay use.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个明亮的方形 VTuber “早安”社交媒体边框，采用柔和的动漫水彩风格，并在中右侧留出大片清澈的蓝天区域，以便放置角色或照片。场景设定为从绿意盎然的庭院望向充满活力的春日清晨：阳光照耀的绿色枝叶和小巧的白花点缀在左上角和左侧边缘，伴有闪烁的镜头光晕、飘落的花瓣、白色羽毛以及散落在天空中的绿叶。请添加 7 只小鸟：左中部的开花枝头栖息着 3 只蓝色、白色和黄色的小鸟；左下角的质朴木牌上栖息着 3 只鸟，分别为棕色麻雀、脸颊带橙色的淡黄色玄凤鹦鹉和蓝色虎皮鹦鹉；右上方的天空中有一只飞翔的燕子。在左上角，放置优雅的白色手写体文本 {argument name="headline text" default="Good Morning!"}，并以细小的叶片和闪光点缀，下方配有一条青色丝带，丝带内包含日文文本 {argument name="ribbon text" default="素敵な一日になりますように♪"}。在左下角，制作一块风化的木板招牌，上面缠绕着小花、藤蔓、白色月桂图案和羽毛，并配有白色手写体文本 {argument name="event title" default="Bind Week"} 以及较小的日期行 {argument name="date range" default="5.10 (Sat) - 5.16 (Fri)"}。背景应呈现出远处柔和的城镇、湖泊或河流，以及蓬松白云下的淡色山脉，右下角前景处盛开着雏菊和黄色花朵。采用清新的柔和色调、通透的构图、高细节表现、柔和的阳光以及整洁的装饰性排版，并保持天空中心区域大部分留白，以便进行叠加使用。

templates.prompt: Create a richly detailed anime-style illustration of an elegant cool-toned young woman, {argument name="character name" default="unnamed heroine"}, seated at a wooden table in a warm sunlit café or conservatory, reading an ornate dark blue hardcover book. She has very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep violet-black"} hair with glossy purple highlights, loose strands, and a decorative floral jeweled hairpin with a dark ribbon near one side. Her face is intentionally obscured by a centered square privacy block with a soft muted purple-to-rose gradient, covering the facial features while leaving the hair, chin area, hand, and outfit visible. She wears a refined Victorian-inspired blouse and dress: a white ruffled high-collar blouse with delicate lace trim, puffed sleeves and gold cuff buttons, a dark navy fitted vest or pinafore, a blue ribbon bow at the collar, and an oval sapphire-like brooch. Her posture is quiet and graceful, one hand holding the open book and the other resting thoughtfully near her lips. The setting is cozy and luminous, with tall wooden window frames on the right, golden afternoon sunlight streaming through, sparkling dust motes, soft lens flare, and blurred flowering garden scenery outside. On the table are exactly four visible still-life objects: one open ornate book in her hands, one floral teacup on a saucer filled with tea, one stack of two closed books with a red book on top and a dark blue book beneath, and one clear glass vase full of pastel hydrangea-like flowers. In the background, include softly blurred shelves, café items, and warm hanging lights. Use highly polished Japanese anime art, delicate linework, painterly lighting, intricate fabric folds, luminous highlights in the hair, shallow depth of field, romantic atmosphere, warm gold and lavender color palette, cinematic composition, 16:9 landscape framing, ultra-detailed, no visible text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘一位优雅且色调冷峻的年轻女性，{argument name="character name" default="未命名女主角"}，她坐在温暖阳光照射的咖啡馆或温室里的木桌旁，正在阅读一本精致的深蓝色精装书。她拥有一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫黑色"} 长发，带有亮泽的紫色高光，发丝自然垂落，一侧别着一枚带有深色丝带的装饰性花朵宝石发卡。她的面部被一个位于中心的正方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮挡块呈现柔和的紫到玫瑰色渐变，在遮住五官的同时保留了头发、下巴区域、手部和服装的可见度。她穿着精致的维多利亚风格衬衫和裙装：带有精致蕾丝花边的白色荷叶边高领衬衫、泡泡袖和金色袖扣，一件深海军蓝色的修身马甲或围裙，领口系着蓝色丝带蝴蝶结，并佩戴一枚椭圆形的蓝宝石胸针。她的姿态安静而优雅，一只手拿着打开的书，另一只手若有所思地放在唇边。场景温馨明亮，右侧有高大的木质窗框，金色的午后阳光倾泻而入，空气中漂浮着闪烁的尘埃，带有柔和的镜头光晕，窗外是模糊的花园景观。桌上清晰可见四件静物：她手中打开的装饰书、一杯盛有茶水的花卉茶杯、一叠两本的书（上面是红色的书，下面是深蓝色的书），以及一个插满淡紫色绣球花状花朵的透明玻璃花瓶。背景中包含柔和模糊的架子、咖啡馆用品和温暖的吊灯。采用高水准的日本动漫艺术风格，细腻的线条，油画般的灯光，复杂的布料褶皱，头发上的明亮高光，浅景深，浪漫氛围，温暖的金色与薰衣草色调，电影级构图，16:9 横向画幅，超高细节，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Ultra-Dense Japanese Maze Puzzle

templates.prompt: Create a square black-and-white puzzle poster in the style of an extremely intricate hand-drawn notebook maze, clean monochrome ink on white paper. At the top center, place a bold Japanese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="この問題、あなたは正解できますか？"} in a Mincho-style serif font. Below it, fill almost the entire page with one huge rectangular maze inside a thin double-line border, made from thousands of tiny orthogonal corridors, micro-grid strokes, dead ends, and tight right-angle passages, like a 2026 upgraded version of a middle-school original maze. The maze should be overwhelmingly dense and difficult, with no color and no shading except black linework. Include exactly 15 larger embedded maze motifs visible within the dense field: 4 concentric square spiral targets, 3 circular spiral targets, 2 large X-shaped starburst maze structures, 1 tall rectangular diamond/chevron maze block, 1 central nested-square pyramid-like maze, 1 large asymmetric diamond spiral maze in the lower-left center, 1 large diagonal crossing X near the lower center, and 2 horizontal ladder/grid maze blocks. Add faint long straight divider-like corridors running vertically and horizontally through the maze, plus diagonal corridor cuts, while keeping every area packed with tiny solvable-looking paths. Overall composition: crisp scan-like puzzle sheet, centered, high contrast, no illustrations, no characters, no gradients, no background texture beyond the maze lines.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张正方形黑白谜题海报，风格为极其复杂的手绘笔记本迷宫，白纸上印有干净的单色墨线。在顶部中心位置，放置一个醒目的日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="この問題、あなたは正解できますか？"}，使用明朝体衬线字体。下方填充几乎整个页面，在细双线边框内绘制一个巨大的矩形迷宫，由数千条微小的正交走廊、微网格笔触、死胡同和紧凑的直角通道组成，宛如 2026 年升级版的中学原创迷宫。迷宫应极其密集且困难，除黑色线条外，无任何颜色或阴影。在密集区域内精确嵌入 15 个较大的迷宫图案：4 个同心方形螺旋目标、3 个圆形螺旋目标、2 个大型 X 形星爆迷宫结构、1 个高矩形菱形/人字形迷宫块、1 个中央嵌套方形金字塔状迷宫、1 个位于左下方的巨大非对称菱形螺旋迷宫、1 个位于下部中心附近的巨大对角交叉 X 形迷宫，以及 2 个水平梯形/网格迷宫块。添加贯穿迷宫的细长直线型分隔走廊以及对角线走廊切口，同时保持每个区域都布满看起来可解的微小路径。整体构图：清晰的扫描级谜题纸，居中，高对比度，无插图，无角色，无渐变，除迷宫线条外无背景纹理。

templates.title: Rainstorm Ronin Bridge Scene

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic monochrome ink illustration in the style of a gritty Japanese samurai manga: a lone {argument name="character type" default="ronin samurai"} stands in profile on a narrow wooden bridge spanning a rocky mountain gorge during heavy rain. The figure is a tall black silhouette with messy tied-up hair, a long tattered cloak whipping violently to the right, layered ragged robes, and two swords at the waist, one hand near the katana hilt. Use extreme black-and-white contrast, scratchy brushwork, splattered ink, and fine diagonal rain streaks across the entire scene. The bridge has wet planks, rough rail posts, and dark reflective puddles; below it, whitewater rapids churn between jagged cliffs. In the background, misty forested mountains fade into pale gray wash, with a small traditional Japanese temple or pavilion partly hidden among trees on the left cliff. Composition is vertical and cinematic, with the samurai slightly right of center, lots of pale empty rainy sky above, atmospheric fog, stormy motion, and no color except black, white, and gray. Mood: {argument name="mood" default="melancholic, lethal, and solitary"}.

The scene is shot from sidewalk level with a slight wide-angle perspective, wet black pavement filling the foreground and reflecting neon signs, store lights, and street lamps. The storefront occupies the right side with glass doors, posters, trash bins, vending or ATM-like machines, and a green entrance mat; the large facade sign reads “FamilyMart.” On the upper left, include one hanging illuminated sign made of exactly 3 stacked panels labeled “FamilyMart,” “酒 たばこ,” and “銀行ATM.” Add a receding row of blurry illuminated shop signs and streetlights down the left side for depth. Use a moody neo-noir atmosphere, heavy rain, visible raindrops on the umbrella, glossy reflections, soft haze, analog film grain, slight chromatic aberration, muted teal-green and warm fluorescent tones, shallow depth of field, realistic photography, 35mm film look, subtle motion blur, high contrast, vertical 9:16 composition.

templates.title: Victorian Railroad Ceremony Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 维多利亚时代铁路通车仪式场景

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic historical scene in a wide, cinematic 19th-century style: {argument name="central figure" default="an elderly bearded man in a black frock coat and tall top hat"} stands dramatically at the center on a rough wooden railroad track, legs spread in a triumphant pose, raising {argument name="raised object" default="an oversized sledgehammer"} high above his head with both hands as if about to drive the final railroad spike. Around him are exactly 22 visible onlookers, mostly men in Victorian-era suits, waistcoats, bowler hats, top hats, cowboy hats, and one blue military officer uniform, arranged in a semicircle on both sides of the track; several hold canes or walking sticks, and some faces are partly obscured at the edges. In the foreground, steel rails curve inward toward a bright golden ceremonial spike or coupling fixture positioned between the rails. The setting is an open, arid plain with sparse scrub, backed by a majestic range of snow-covered mountains under a clear pale-blue sky with wispy clouds. Use realistic lighting, crisp documentary detail, slightly humorous surreal scale for the raised hammer, natural earth tones, black and brown period clothing, and a sharp focus on the central pose, resembling a staged commemorative photograph of the transcontinental railroad ceremony in {argument name="historical era" default="the late 1800s"}.

templates.title: Rooftop Bar Night Cityscape Couple

titleLocalized.zh: Rooftop Bar Night Cityscape Couple

templates.prompt:
A wide half-body shot of two young people standing at the railing of an open-air rooftop club bar, authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. She leans back lightly against him — both looking out at the city lights below, drinks in hand, a comfortable weight to the silence between them.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, slightly elongated eye corners, expression soft and open — the kind of face that appears when the music is behind you and the city is in front. Straight refined nose with a delicate bridge. Skin tone fair to light beige (NC10–NC20). Skin subsurface scattering visible under warm rooftop bar light mixed with distant city glow, specular micro-highlights on her bare shoulders and collarbone, fine foundation powder grain perceptible. She wears a rose-gold satin slip dress on thin straps — the fabric catching the city light, hem above the knee, moving faintly in the night breeze. He stands close behind her, hands loosely on the railing beside hers. Two or three stray hairs lift and cross her cheek displaced by the rooftop breeze, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.
Mixed artificial light sources — warm amber rooftop bar lanterns cast a soft glow across both figures from behind. The vast city light grid spreads below and behind them, bokeh points of orange and white light filling the distance. A light wind is implied in the fabric movement and lifted hair. The mood is gentle and warm — quiet contentment, a small almost-smile, sense of stillness above the city. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 3:2. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

templates.title: Kawaii Glass Dollhouse Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: Kawaii Glass Dollhouse Diorama

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed vertical photorealistic miniature diorama inside a clear glass display case, styled like a warm pastel Japanese kawaii room box, with the feeling of a cozy personal world.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 composition, close-up front view through transparent glass, shallow depth of field, warm golden afternoon light, soft bokeh fairy lights, ultra-detailed handcrafted textures, realistic reflections on the acrylic/glass walls.

Main subject: A seated teenage girl miniature with a softly obscured/featureless face, shoulder-length {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, wearing a cream Japanese sailor school uniform with gray collar trim, a large {argument name="bow color" default="pink"} chest bow, gray pleated skirt, white socks, sitting sideways on a cream lace-covered armchair. Her left arm reaches outward holding a tiny pink flower or wand-like blossom; her right hand rests on her knee. Pose is gentle, relaxed, and inviting.

Companion subject: One small floating fairy-like robot girl to the right of the seated girl, also with a softly obscured/featureless face, short brown bob hair, translucent insect wings, white-and-silver futuristic body armor, tiny mechanical limbs, hovering above a small round flying base. Make it cute, delicate, and toy-like rather than threatening.

Display case and room: The scene is enclosed in a rectangular glass case with a wooden base and ornate gold vine decoration along the bottom. Inside is a miniature living room with a sofa/armchair, lace curtains, sunny window, bookshelves, framed photos, houseplants, cushions, a small wooden coffee table, pastel boxes, a cup and saucer, tiny cosmetics or perfume bottles, and a soft cream rug. Use peach, ivory, blush pink, champagne gold, and pale green as the main palette.

Decorative arch: At the top front of the case is a floral arch made of vines, pearls, crystal drops, warm micro string lights, and many small white and pink flowers. Add one ornate oval sign centered at the top reading {argument name="top sign text" default="まるこのおうち時間"}, with a small cursive English subtitle reading "Maruko's little world". Add one matching name plaque near the bottom front reading {argument name="name plaque text" default="まるこ"} with "Maruko" underneath.

Counted visible focal elements: Include exactly 2 human-like figures: 1 seated schoolgirl miniature and 1 floating winged robot fairy. Include exactly 1 sleeping white cat curled in a small woven basket on the floor near the girl's feet. Include exactly 2 readable signs: the top oval title sign and the bottom name plaque. Include exactly 1 small wooden coffee table, 1 cup-and-saucer set, 1 armchair, 1 window with lace curtains, and 1 wooden display-case base.

Style and lighting: Premium collectible dollhouse photography, hyperrealistic miniature craftsmanship, romantic kawaii aesthetic, cinematic warm sunlight from the back window, glowing fairy lights, crisp foreground details with soft background blur, glass reflections and refractions, delicate lace, pearl, resin, and gold-metal textures.

Constraints: Do not add extra characters, do not make it a flat illustration, do not use harsh colors, avoid horror or cyberpunk mood, keep both faces intentionally soft/blurred and non-identifiable, preserve the cute handcrafted display-case look.

templates.title: Neo-Noir Character Design Board

Create a cinematic realistic character design board for a high-budget neo-noir film production set in a rain-soaked futuristic city.

Avoid generic grids or symmetrical layouts; composition should feel like a stylized director’s pitch board.

templates.title: Premium Graphic Design Portfolio Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 高端平面设计作品集样机

templates.prompt:
Create a premium graphic design portfolio mockup in a professional creative studio style. Show a clean, elegant workspace presentation featuring multiple graphic design project cards arranged in a refined grid layout, a modern laptop screen displaying a portfolio homepage, and several printed posters laid out neatly on the desk and mounted on the wall.

Use a polished creative-director aesthetic with soft shadows, subtle depth, realistic materials, and a high-end studio atmosphere. Include sleek typography placeholders, branding samples, editorial-style poster designs, business cards, stationery, notebook, pen, coffee cup, desk lamp, and small plant for a realistic studio setup.

The design should have a clean grid layout, balanced spacing, soft realistic shadows, premium lighting, and neutral luxury tones such as black, white, warm beige, gray, champagne, and cream. Make the laptop screen show a minimal portfolio interface with project thumbnails, navigation menu, and bold hero text.

Add multiple portfolio project cards such as logo design, brand identity, poster design, packaging design, social media design, UI/UX design, and advertising campaign mockups. Arrange everything professionally with a modern minimalist style, sharp details, clean typography, elegant composition, and a premium creative agency presentation look.

Style: high-end graphic design portfolio, modern creative studio, luxury branding mockup, clean desk setup, realistic shadows, editorial layout, minimalist premium design, professional presentation, 4K, ultra-detailed.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个专业创意工作室风格的高端平面设计作品集样机。展示一个整洁、优雅的工作空间，其中包含以精致网格布局排列的多个平面设计项目卡片、显示作品集主页的现代笔记本电脑屏幕，以及整齐摆放在桌面上和挂在墙上的多张印刷海报。

采用精致的创意总监美学，运用柔和的阴影、微妙的景深、逼真的材质和高端的工作室氛围。包含时尚的排版占位符、品牌样本、编辑风格的海报设计、名片、文具、笔记本、钢笔、咖啡杯、台灯和小盆栽，以营造逼真的工作室场景。

设计应具备整洁的网格布局、均衡的间距、柔和逼真的阴影、优质的灯光，以及黑色、白色、暖米色、灰色、香槟色和奶油色等中性奢华色调。笔记本电脑屏幕应显示极简的作品集界面，包含项目缩略图、导航菜单和醒目的主标题文字。

添加多个作品集项目卡片，例如 Logo 设计、品牌识别、海报设计、包装设计、社交媒体设计、UI/UX 设计和广告活动样机。以现代极简风格专业地排列所有元素，呈现清晰的细节、整洁的排版、优雅的构图以及高端创意代理公司的展示效果。

风格：高端平面设计作品集、现代创意工作室、奢华品牌样机、整洁桌面布置、逼真阴影、编辑排版、极简高端设计、专业展示、4K、超精细。

templates.title: 1990s Flash Camera Snapshot Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 90 年代闪光灯抓拍人像

templates.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the main reference. 

Transform the uploaded photo into a realistic candid portrait with an early 1990s digital camera aesthetic. Preserve the subject’s identity, facial features, pose, outfit, and overall composition, but restyle the image with harsh blown-out flash highlights, subtle red-eye effect, low-resolution image quality, raw snapshot imperfections, nostalgic flash-filter styling, and a vintage timestamp look.

The final image should feel candid, imperfect, and authentic, like an old retro party or personal snapshot taken with an early consumer digital camera. Keep the background dark or naturally subdued when appropriate, maintain a direct-flash look, and give the image a raw, unpolished, memory-like atmosphere.

Include:
- harsh direct camera flash
- overexposed or blown-out highlights
- subtle red-eye effect
- low-resolution / soft digital detail
- slight grain or noisy texture
- authentic retro snapshot feeling
- vintage date/timestamp aesthetic in one corner
- candid, natural, imperfect energy

Avoid:
- cartoon or anime style
- overly polished beauty retouching
- studio lighting
- ultra-sharp modern DSLR look
- glossy AI skin
- text, logos, watermarks, or graphic overlays other than the timestamp aesthetic
- distorted anatomy or altered identity

Make the aspect ratio 3:4

promptLocalized.zh:
请使用上传的图像作为主要参考。

将上传的照片转换为具有 90 年代初数码相机美感的写实抓拍人像。保留拍摄对象的身份、面部特征、姿势、服装和整体构图，但通过强烈的闪光灯高光、轻微的红眼效果、低分辨率画质、原始抓拍瑕疵、怀旧闪光灯滤镜风格以及复古时间戳外观来重塑图像。

最终图像应呈现出一种随意、不完美且真实的质感，就像是用早期消费级数码相机拍摄的复古派对或个人快照。在适当的情况下保持背景昏暗或自然柔和，维持直接闪光灯的视觉效果，并赋予图像一种原始、未经修饰、如同记忆般的氛围。

包含：
- 强烈的直接相机闪光灯
- 过曝或高光溢出
- 轻微的红眼效果
- 低分辨率 / 柔和的数码细节
- 轻微的颗粒感或噪点纹理

- 边角处复古日期/时间戳美学
- 随意、自然、不完美的能量感

避免：
- 卡通或动漫风格
- 过度修饰的美容美颜
- 摄影棚灯光

[Character]
[Pose & Outfit] Create an original Y2K-style scrapbook collage poster featuring the side profile of a {argument name="subject" default="stylish person peacefully enjoying music with their eyes closed while wearing large wireless headphones"}. Style them in a relaxed streetwear look with an {argument name="outfit" default="oversized vintage jacket featuring visible stitch details"}.

[Expression & Design] Depict the character as a high-contrast black-and-white photo cutout with a thick white sticker-style outline around the entire body to create a trendy collage aesthetic. Use a clean and vivid {argument name="background colors" default="turquoise/aqua blue and deep pastel pink"} background. Surround the character with playful white hand-drawn doodles such as planets, rings, stars, Jupiter rings, constellations, meteors, rockets, astronauts, satellites, orbit lines, abstract swirls, sparkles, and music notes. Add dynamic sketch arrows, crown doodles, motion lines, and layered graphic elements around the head and body to create youthful energy and movement. Some doodles should naturally overlap the character for a realistic scrapbook effect.

Integrate modern Gen-Z typography using a mix of handwritten fonts and bubbly sticker-style text. Include original phrases such as:

“Dream explore repeat”
“cosmic soul”
“beyond the stars”

Y2K collage aesthetics, indie music poster vibes, scrapbook journal style, modern streetwear editorial design, cute doodle graphics, trendy Gen-Z branding, minimalist yet stylish, dreamy youthful atmosphere.

Thick white outline cutout around the character, white doodle overlays, clean negative space, soft grain texture, high-resolution denim texture, hand-drawn imperfect sketch lines, dynamic asymmetrical composition, professional graphic design layout, aesthetic optimized for viral social media, high-resolution print-quality artwork. templates.title: Bangkok Night Market Street Photography

titleLocalized.zh: 曼谷夜市街头摄影

templates.prompt: A candid street photograph of a {argument name="subject" default="young Thai woman"} at a {argument name="location" default="Bangkok night market food stall"}, well past midnight. The subject leans slightly forward examining {argument name="food item" default="charcoal-grilled skewers"}, wearing a casual crop top and denim shorts, expression relaxed and completely natural, not posed. The setting is a narrow market alley: charcoal smoke rising from the grill, handwritten Thai-script price tags taped to the stall edge, a neon beer sign partially visible in the far background. Lighting comes from the amber charcoal grill below her face mixing with a cool fluorescent tube above the stall, creating dual-toned shadows along her neck and jaw. Composition: medium close-up, eye-level, subject occupies left two-thirds of frame, blurred vendor and food stall crowd filling right side. Color palette: warm amber, deep shadow zones, subtle cool neon accent in distance, muted earthy market tones. Render with photographic realism: subtle film grain throughout, avoid over-smoothed CG textures, preserve natural imperfections. Skin should show subsurface scattering and micro-texture, not digital smoothing. Hair: subtle natural imperfection, not geometric perfection. Photorealistic rendering, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在午夜时分，于 {argument name="location" default="曼谷夜市小吃摊"} 拍摄的 {argument name="subject" default="年轻泰国女性"} 的真实街头摄影。主体微微前倾，正在端详 {argument name="food item" default="炭烤串"}，身穿休闲露脐上衣和牛仔短裤，表情放松且完全自然，非摆拍。场景为狭窄的市场小巷：炭火烟雾从烤架升起，手写的泰文价签贴在摊位边缘，远景中隐约可见霓虹灯啤酒招牌。光线来自她脸部下方琥珀色的炭火烤架，与摊位上方冷色调的日光灯管交织，在她的颈部和下颌处形成双色调阴影。构图：中近景，平视视角，主体占据画面左侧三分之二，模糊的摊贩和夜市人群填充右侧。色调：温暖的琥珀色、深邃的阴影区、远处微妙的冷色霓虹点缀，以及柔和的大地色系。渲染要求：具备摄影真实感，整体带有细腻的胶片颗粒感，避免过度平滑的 CG 质感，保留自然的瑕疵。皮肤应呈现次表面散射和微观纹理，而非数字平滑处理。头发：呈现微妙的自然不完美感，而非几何般的完美。照片级渲染，无水印。

templates.title: Modern Geometric Polygon Portrait

templates.prompt: Please create a {argument name="style" default="modern geometric polygon style"} portrait art poster based on the uploaded photo.
