The overall style leans towards "contemporary geometric portrait + fashion magazine illustration + gallery art poster." The face consists of simplified polygon facets, geometric color blocks, and clear outlines, maintaining a degree of abstraction while keeping person recognition. Features can be moderately simplified, such as eyes, nose, and mouth being generalized graphically without losing personal expression. Hair can be treated with a geometric sense of mass and polygonal silhouettes, with facial structure emphasizing faceted planes and abstract polygon composition. The overall image uses flat color blocks, clean vector shapes, clear outlines, white space, and poster-level composition. Slight oil pastel grains, screen printing noise, handwritten graffiti traces, and pigment textures are allowed to make it look like a high-end art print poster. Recommended color palettes should be limited but distinct, using black, charcoal grey, cream white, cobalt blue, brick red, mustard yellow, sage green, coral pink, warm beige, etc. The background can be deep matte black, dark charcoal, or premium solid colors to enhance the gallery poster and fashion cover feel. The composition should resemble high-end art posters or fashion covers, with the subject as the focus, leaving room for title and subtitle layout, feeling modern, artistic, and fashionable. Avoid: realistic rendering, 3D effects, anime style, cheap cartoon feel, excessive cubism, direct Picasso imitation, complex cluttered backgrounds, or overly distorted features.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据上传的照片创作一张 {argument name="style" default="现代几何多边形风格"} 的肖像艺术海报。必须严格保留人物特征，包括脸型、五官比例、发型轮廓、表情及整体气质，确保最终图像能清晰辨识出是同一人或公众人物。整体风格倾向于“当代几何肖像 + 时尚杂志插画 + 画廊艺术海报”。面部由简化的多边形切面、几何色块和清晰的轮廓线构成，在保持一定抽象感的同时保留人物辨识度。五官可适度简化，例如将眼、鼻、口进行图形化概括，但不失个人神韵。头发可处理为具有几何体块感和多边形轮廓，面部结构强调切面感和抽象多边形构成。整体画面采用平涂色块、干净的矢量形状、清晰的轮廓线、留白以及海报级构图。允许加入轻微的油画棒颗粒感、丝网印刷噪点、手绘涂鸦痕迹和颜料质感，使其呈现出高端艺术印刷海报的效果。建议配色方案应简洁且鲜明，可使用黑色、炭灰色、奶油白、钴蓝色、砖红色、芥末黄、鼠尾草绿、珊瑚粉、暖米色等。背景可采用深哑光黑、深炭灰或高级纯色，以增强画廊海报和时尚封面的质感。构图应类似高端艺术海报或时尚封面，以主体为核心，留出标题和副标题的排版空间，营造现代、艺术且时尚的氛围。避免：写实渲染、3D 效果、动漫风格、廉价卡通感、过度立体主义、直接模仿毕加索、复杂杂乱的背景或过度扭曲的特征。

promptLocalized.zh: 高端电影级 {argument name="character" default="西部亡命之徒"} 海报，垂直 2:3 构图，暗黑西部游戏角色设定风格。一位神秘的蒙面牛仔与一匹黑马伫立在沙漠边缘，全身正面视角，宽檐牛仔帽压得很低，花纹头巾遮住下半张脸，深色长发，黑色皮手套，黑色西部夹克搭配多层皮革装备、子弹带、左轮手枪枪套、金属皮带扣、厚重靴子，肩披红棕色几何图案斗篷，边缘破损且随风飘动。姿态冷静而危险，一只手靠近枪套。黑马半身位于画面右侧，额头有白色斑纹，缰绳细节清晰。背景为风暴中的西部沙漠，闪电、乌云、远处的峡谷岩壁、枯树、沙尘、烟雾、火花、泥泞倒影，营造出压抑的史诗氛围。画面左侧为复古羊皮纸留白，右侧为暗黑风暴场景，明暗对比强烈。包含大型垂直英文标题、悬赏信息、角色档案、坐标、地图网格、细线边框、圆形指南针图形、红色小标记、签名印章以及其他高端海报排版元素。风格：黑色墨迹飞溅、旧纸张纹理、电影级写实、暗黑西部、强对比度、皮革与金属超精细细节、灰尘、泥点、划痕、烟雾、火花、边缘轮廓光、高端收藏级游戏海报、《荒野大镖客》氛围、艺术画册级质量、8K、高细节。

templates.title: Playful Hanfu Graduation Photo Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 趣味汉服毕业照九宫格

templates.prompt:
Based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, generate a 2x2 collage photoshoot with a 3:4 aspect ratio per image, themed around '{argument name="theme" default="playful Hanfu graduation photo"}'.

[Character Consistency]
Strictly preserve the user's real identity features, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, age appearance, hairstyle foundation, and overall temperament. In all four small images, it must clearly look like the same real girl, not a stranger, not Westernized, not overly airbrushed, and without an AI 'fake face' look.

[Overall Style]
New Chinese-style graduation photo style popular on Chinese social media, featuring playful, agile, energetic, cute, and pleasing vibes. The image should look like a relaxed and fun set of creative graduation photos suitable for sharing, generally clean and bright with a subtle Chinese sweet aesthetic.

[Makeup]
Sweet and clear youth makeup. Light and transparent base with natural skin color. Eye makeup in light apricot pink, peach pink, or warm brown tones with soft eyeliner and naturally curled lashes. Peach or apple pink blush, and cream pink, peach, or coral lip color. Overall look should be young and lively.

[Hairstyle]
Natural extension of original hair length from uploaded photos, but prioritized for styles that fit graduation caps decorated with flowers.
- Long hair: Semi-updo, double side braids, low double buns, or soft updo with loose strands.
- Mid-length hair: Half-tied, double braids, or low position updo.
- Short hair: Tucked behind ears or French short curls with small flower caps.
Avoid heavy hair covering the cap or face in all four images.

[Clothing & Accessories]
Playful Hanfu graduation outfits in light green, pink-white, light yellow, or milk white colors. Lightweight fabrics with embroidery, wraps, wide sleeves, and pattern details. Must pair with a flower-decorated academic cap or graduation hat with minor tassels.

[Scene & Props]
Clean and bright Chinese-style studio space with beige, warm white, or light wood backgrounds. Decorative elements include cherry blossom branches, small wooden tables, flower vases, books, and scrolls. Props include brushes, scrolls, and wooden quote boards using traditional Chinese calligraphy like 'Happy Graduation' or 'Bright Future'.

[Lighting & Texture]
Soft and bright lighting, overall clear and gentle. Detailed fabric and accessory textures. A slight soft focus effect, but not sharp or commercial advertisement style.

[Fixed 4-Grid Shots]
1. Top-Left: Close-up main vision. Person looking at the camera with a gentle smile, holding a small wooden quote board. Focus on facial identity and cap.
2. Top-Right: Full body pose. Showing the full outfit and cap, holding a brush and scroll with a natural bright smile. Agile posture.
3. Bottom-Left: Playful action shot. 3/4 side view, tilting head or winking to emphasize playfulness.
4. Bottom-Right: Interaction with books/scrolls. Seated or leaning on a table, reading or looking at the camera gently with foreground flowers for depth.

[Consistency]
Keep the person, outfit, cap, makeup, and scene color consistent across all four images.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，生成一个 2x2 的拼图写真，单张图片比例为 3:4，主题为“{argument name="theme" default="趣味汉服毕业照"}”。

[人物一致性]
严格保留用户的真实身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型基础及整体气质。在四张小图中，必须清晰地呈现为同一位真实的女孩，不能是陌生人，不能有西化感，不能过度磨皮，且不能有 AI 的“假脸”感。

[整体风格]
中国社交媒体上流行的“新中式”毕业照风格，主打俏皮、灵动、元气、可爱且讨喜的氛围。画面应呈现出一组轻松有趣的创意毕业照，适合分享，整体干净明亮，带有微妙的中国式甜美审美。

[妆容]
甜美清透的少女妆。轻薄通透的底妆，保留自然肤色。眼妆采用浅杏粉、桃粉或暖棕色调，搭配柔和的眼线和自然卷翘的睫毛。腮红为桃色或苹果粉，唇色为奶油粉、桃色或珊瑚色。整体妆容应显得年轻且充满活力。

[发型]
在上传照片原有的发长基础上自然延伸，优先考虑适合佩戴装饰花朵学士帽的发型。
- 长发：半扎发、双侧麻花辫、低双丸子头或带有碎发的柔和盘发。
- 中长发：半扎发、双麻花辫或低位盘发。
- 短发：别在耳后或法式短卷发，搭配小型花朵帽。
在四张图中均应避免头发过度遮挡学士帽或面部。

[服装与配饰]
趣味汉服毕业装，颜色选用浅绿、粉白、浅黄或奶白色。轻盈的面料配以刺绣、交领、广袖及细节纹样。必须搭配装饰有花朵的学士帽或带有少量流苏的毕业帽。

[场景与道具]
干净明亮的中国风摄影棚空间，背景为米色、暖白色或浅木色。装饰元素包括樱花枝、小木桌、花瓶、书籍和卷轴。道具包括毛笔、卷轴以及写有传统书法（如“毕业快乐”或“前程似锦”）的木质项目。

[光影与质感]
柔和明亮的光线，整体清晰温润。呈现细腻的布料和配饰质感。带有轻微的柔焦效果，但避免过于锐利或商业广告感。

[固定 4 格构图]

templates.title: Pasta Maker Evolution Sprite Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Pasta Maker 进化精灵图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an isometric object evolution sprite sheet for a Merge 2 cooking game, showing a progression from a simple rolling pin to advanced pasta-making machines.

Canvas: 4:3 horizontal canvas, light neutral gray background, no borders, no text, no watermark. Arrange the sprites in a clean 3-row by 4-column grid with generous spacing and soft shadows under each object.

Visual style: Polished mobile game asset style, semi-realistic cartoon rendering, isometric three-quarter view, crisp outlines, warm highlights, detailed materials, consistent scale, clean cutout sprites suitable for a casual merge game inventory.

Subject details: Show exactly 12 discrete evolution stages, left to right and top to bottom:
1. A simple wooden rolling pin with rounded handles.
2. A wooden rolling pin beside one smooth ball of pale dough.
3. A wooden rolling pin on a rectangular wooden board flattening a sheet of dough.
4. A small wooden manual pasta roller with two shiny metal rollers, crank handle, and one flat sheet of pasta feeding out.
5. A compact gray metal manual pasta cutter with crank handle, producing flat ribbon noodles.
6. A teal-blue manual noodle cutter with silver rollers and crank handle, producing curly spaghetti-like strands.
7. A cream-and-teal electric stand pasta extruder with a metal mixing bowl, extruding short strands into the bowl.
8. A cream-and-teal countertop electric pasta extruder with transparent top lid, round front nozzle, side button, and spaghetti strands coming out.
9. A beige electric pasta sheet roller with silver top rollers, front noodle sheet output, side dial, plus two small removable cutter attachments placed beside it.
10. A heavy polished silver manual pasta machine with broad rollers, crank handle, black knob, and multiple flat noodle ribbons exiting the front.
11. A modern stainless-steel automatic pasta maker with dark side panels, transparent lid, small blue digital display, control buttons, front extrusion nozzle, and several noodle strands coming out.
12. A premium black-and-gold luxury automatic pasta machine with transparent lid, crown emblem on the front panel, glowing controls, gold trim, and thick flat noodles flowing from the front.

Constraints: Keep all objects isolated as individual sprites, maintain the same isometric perspective and lighting across all 12 stages, emphasize the visual upgrade path, and avoid adding labels, arrows, hands, people, or kitchen backgrounds.

promptLocalized.zh:

画布：4:3 横向画布，浅中性灰背景，无边框，无文字，无水印。将精灵图排列成整齐的 3 行 4 列网格，保持充裕的间距，并在每个物体下方添加柔和阴影。

视觉风格：精致的手机游戏资源风格，半写实卡通渲染，等距四分之三视角，清晰的轮廓，温暖的高光，细腻的材质，统一的比例，适合休闲合成游戏库存的干净抠图精灵。

主体细节：展示 12 个独立的进化阶段，从左到右，从上到下：
1. 一根带有圆润手柄的简单木制擀面杖。
2. 一根木制擀面杖旁边放着一个光滑的浅色面团球。
3. 一根木制擀面杖放在长方形木制项目上，正在压平一张面皮。
4. 一台小型木制手动压面机，带有两个闪亮的金属滚轴、曲柄手柄，以及一张正在输出的扁平意大利面皮。
5. 一台紧凑型灰色金属手动切面机，带有曲柄手柄，可制作扁平的丝带状面条。
6. 一台青蓝色手动切面机，带有银色滚轴和曲柄手柄，可制作卷曲的意大利面条。
7. 一台奶油色与青色相间的电动立式压面机，配有金属搅拌碗，将短面条挤压到碗中。
8. 一台奶油色与青色相间的台式电动压面机，带有透明顶盖、圆形前喷嘴、侧面按钮，并有意大利面条流出。
9. 一台米色电动压面机，带有银色顶部滚轴、前部面皮出口、侧面旋钮，旁边放置两个可拆卸的小型切面附件。
10. 一台厚重的抛光银色手动压面机，带有宽滚轴、曲柄手柄、黑色旋钮，前端输出多条扁平的面带。
11. 一台现代不锈钢全自动 Pasta Maker，带有深色侧板、透明盖、小型蓝色数字显示屏、控制按钮、前部挤压喷嘴，并有几根面条流出。
12. 一台高端黑金配色豪华全自动 Pasta Maker，带有透明盖、前面板上的皇冠标志、发光的控制面板、金色装饰，以及从前端流出的粗扁面条。

约束：保持所有物体作为独立的精灵图，在所有 12 个阶段中保持相同的等距视角和光照，强调视觉升级路径，避免添加标签、箭头、手部、人物或厨房背景。

templates.title: Mystic Ruins Platformer Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: Mystic Ruins 平台游戏截图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 2D side-scrolling platformer concept screenshot for a fantasy game level called {argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"}, showing a playable prototype scene with HUD elements overlaid.

Canvas: Wide cinematic 24:9 game screenshot, approximately 1200×450 px. Use a layered parallax composition with strong depth: dark foreground silhouettes, midground playable platforms, and a misty glowing background. No borders or watermark.

Scene: A magical ancient forest ruin at sunset/night, with warm orange, magenta, purple, and deep navy lighting. The environment is dense with gnarled trees, hanging vines, moss, floating dust/fireflies, crumbling stone arches, waterfalls in the distance, and oversized bioluminescent mushrooms glowing pink, violet, and amber. The mood is cozy, mysterious, adventurous, and high-fantasy.

Layout and counted scene elements: Include exactly 4 main walkable platforms: 1 large dark mossy ledge on the upper left with a giant glowing purple-pink mushroom on it, 1 central moss-covered platform where the hero stands, 1 elevated upper-right ruined stone platform with a broken stone column and hanging lantern, and 1 lower-right mossy platform with glowing mushrooms. Add distant ruined arches and cliffs in the background, but keep them non-playable and atmospheric. Place the hero slightly left of center on the central platform.

Hero character: A small cute anthropomorphic fox adventurer, chibi proportions, orange fur, cream muzzle and tail tip, wearing a small brown adventurer outfit with boots, belt, scarf or capelet, and holding a warm glowing lantern. The character should face right in an idle pose, readable as a playable sprite against the environment.

HUD and text content: Top left HUD has the label “HEALTH” in small pale-gold pixel/fantasy UI text, with exactly 3 glowing heart icons underneath. Below that show “LIVES 03”. Bottom left HUD has the label “ABILITIES” and exactly 2 square ability icons: one dash/slash icon and one lantern/light icon. Top right HUD shows a small gold coin icon followed by “128”, and below it “SCORE 02450”. Bottom right shows the level title “{argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"}” in widely spaced white-gold capitals with a thin decorative line beneath it.

Visual style: High-quality painterly 2D game art, whimsical platformer concept art, soft bloom, volumetric mist, cinematic rim lighting, sharp readable silhouettes, detailed foliage and moss, glowing particles, warm lantern light, vibrant fantasy color grading, suitable for a playable 2D platformer prototype.

Constraints: Keep the image as a single gameplay screenshot, not a menu or poster. Make all HUD text clean and legible. Do not add extra hearts, ability icons, characters, enemies, dialogue boxes, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"} 的奇幻游戏关卡创建一个精致的 2D 横版平台游戏概念截图，展示带有 HUD 元素的试玩原型场景。

画布：宽屏电影级 24:9 游戏截图，尺寸约为 1200×450 像素。使用具有强烈纵深感的分层视差构图：深色前景剪影、中景可玩平台以及雾气缭绕的发光背景。无边框或水印。

场景：日落/夜晚的魔法古森林遗迹，采用暖橙色、洋红色、紫色和深海军蓝色的灯光。环境中有茂密的扭曲树木、悬挂的藤蔓、苔藓、漂浮的尘埃/萤火虫、破碎的石拱门、远处的瀑布，以及散发着粉色、紫色和琥珀色光芒的超大生物发光蘑菇。氛围舒适、神秘、充满冒险感且具有高奇幻色彩。

布局与场景元素统计：包含 4 个主要的可行走平台：左上方有一个巨大的长满苔藓的深色岩架，上面有一朵巨大的发光紫粉色蘑菇；中心是一个英雄站立的苔藓覆盖平台；右上角是一个升高的废弃石制平台，带有断裂的石柱和悬挂的灯笼；右下方是一个长满苔藓的平台，上面有发光蘑菇。背景中加入远处的废弃拱门和悬崖，但保持其为不可玩且具有氛围感的背景。将英雄放置在中心平台偏左的位置。

英雄角色：一只小巧可爱的拟人化狐狸冒险家，Q 版比例，橙色皮毛，奶油色的口鼻部和尾尖，穿着棕色冒险家服装，配有靴子、腰带、围巾或小披肩，手持一盏发出暖光的灯笼。角色应面向右侧处于待机姿势，作为可玩精灵在环境中清晰可见。

HUD 与文本内容：左上角 HUD 带有小号淡金色像素/奇幻 UI 字体的“HEALTH”标签，下方有 3 个发光的心形图标。下方显示“LIVES 03”。左下角 HUD 带有“ABILITIES”标签和 2 个方形技能图标：一个冲刺/斩击图标和一个灯笼/光照图标。右上角 HUD 显示一个小金币图标，后跟“128”，下方显示“SCORE 02450”。右下角显示关卡标题“{argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"}”，采用间距较宽的白金色大写字母，下方有一条细装饰线。

视觉风格：高质量绘画风格 2D 游戏美术，异想天开的平台游戏概念艺术，柔和的辉光效果，体积雾，电影级边缘光，清晰易读的剪影，细腻的植被和苔藓，发光粒子，温暖的灯笼光，鲜艳的奇幻色彩分级，适合 2D 平台游戏原型。

约束：保持图像为单张游戏截图，而非菜单或海报。确保所有 HUD 文本清晰易读。不要添加额外的爱心、技能图标、角色、敌人、对话框、徽标或水印。

templates.title: 16-Panel Football Dream Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 16 格足球梦想项目

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic 4x4 storyboard poster for an emotional sports-anime video about {argument name="character name" default="a young yellow-haired girl"} who struggles to become a professional football player, turning rejection, pain, injuries, and loneliness into determination and success.

Canvas: Vertical poster in a 4:5 ratio, dark cinematic color grade, realistic anime aesthetics, warm golden highlights, deep shadows, dramatic rain and stadium lighting. Divide the canvas into exactly 16 equal panels in a black grid, numbered 1 through 16 in small black square badges at the top-left of each panel. Each panel has a bold yellow uppercase title and short white bullet text on the left side, with an emotional scene illustration filling the panel. Add a full-width bottom banner titled “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)” with a paragraph prompt and a soccer ball graphic on the right.

Main character: A teenage girl with messy short golden-yellow hair, athletic but small build, expressive emotional body language, usually wearing dark football training clothes or a black football jersey with number 7. Her face may be softly obscured or shadowed for cinematic focus. Show her growing from lonely beginner to celebrated star.

Storyboard panels: Use exactly 16 panels with these visible numbered chapters and scene concepts:
1. “A DREAM BEGINS” — girl at night holding a soccer ball beside an urban fence, watching football on a glowing screen in the distance; bullet points: dreams of becoming a football star, watches matches late at night, practices alone in empty streets, believes football is her destiny.
2. “NOBODY SUPPORTS HER” — girl standing with folded arms while classmates or family silhouettes mock or ignore her; bullet points: people say football is not for girls, friends laugh at her dreams, family worries about her future, but she never gives up.
3. “TRAINING EVERY DAY” — rainy street training scene, girl dribbling intensely through puddles before sunrise; bullet points: wakes up before sunrise, runs in rain and cold mornings, practices dribbling for hours, learns discipline and patience.
4. “FIRST BIG FAILURE” — girl crying alone by a chain-link fence after rejection, soccer ball near her feet and a paper marked “REJECTED”; bullet points: gets rejected from a local academy, cries alone after the trials, feels broken and exhausted, decides to try again stronger.
5. “THE HARDEST PHASE” — exhausted girl studying at a desk under a lamp with books and football notes, showing balance between school and sport; bullet points: balances studies, work and football, shoes become old and torn, trains on rough grounds, keeps chasing her dream silently.
6. “A SMALL OPPORTUNITY” — local coach standing beside her on a muddy practice field, noticing her talent; bullet points: a local coach notices her talent, gets invited to a small girls’ team, starts learning real teamwork, slowly gains confidence.
7. “BUILDING HERSELF” — intense gym/training scene with weights or a stationary bike, sweat and dramatic lighting; bullet points: improves speed and stamina, learns powerful shooting techniques, studies professional players, becomes mentally stronger.
8. “FIRST TOURNAMENT” — girl in black number 7 jersey celebrating or kicking during her first match under stadium lights; bullet points: plays her first important match, feels nervous before kickoff, scores her first goal, her team finally believes in her.
9. “INJURED BUT UNBROKEN” — girl seated with bandaged leg or ankle, injured yet determined, watching from sidelines; bullet points: suffers a painful injury, cannot play for weeks, watches others from the sidelines, fights through pain and recovery.
10. “RETURN TO THE FIELD” — sunset practice field, girl in number 7 jersey seen from behind rejoining teammates; bullet points: comes back stronger than before, trains harder every single day, earns respect from teammates, becomes the team’s key player.
11. “VIRAL RECOGNITION” — close-up of a smartphone showing her match clip going viral, social media hearts and comments around the screen; bullet points: match clips go viral online, people start noticing her talent, gains followers and supporters, her story inspires young girls.
12. “CHAMPIONSHIP MATCH” — massive stadium under bright lights, girl number 7 scoring or celebrating a winning goal with sparks and cheering crowd; bullet points: plays in the biggest match of her life, stadium lights shine brightly, scores the winning goal, crowd cheers her name loudly.
13. “NATIONAL SELECTION” — girl with backpack at sunset city skyline, leaving for bigger competition; include a subtle “INDIA” marking on clothing or bag if desired; bullet points: gets selected for a national camp, travels to bigger cities, faces stronger competition, pushes beyond her limits.
14. “BECOMING A STAR” — magazine cover or interview scene with her holding a soccer ball, headline like “SPORTS WEEKLY” and inspirational slogan “NO DREAM IS TOO BIG”; bullet points: appears in interviews and magazines, signs with a professional club, inspires millions of girls, proves dreams have no gender.
15. “LIVING HER DREAM” — wide stadium shot from behind, girl number 7 raising both arms triumphantly before a huge crowd; bullet points: plays in massive stadiums, supports her family proudly, smiles remembering her struggles, finally lives the life she imagined.
16. “A PROUD MOMENT” — emotional close-up of the now-successful player holding a ball against stadium light, remembering her younger self; bullet points: looks at her younger self’s old football, remembers every failure and sacrifice, realizes the struggle made her stronger, her dream finally became reality.

Bottom banner: Add a dark rectangular banner spanning the full width beneath the 16 panels. Title in bold yellow: “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”. Body text in small white type: “Create a cinematic and emotional video about a young girl with yellow hair who struggles to become a professional football player. Show her journey from being ignored, facing failures, injuries, and rejections to rising as a star through hard work and determination. Include training, emotions, matches, crowds, celebrations, and real-life struggles. End with her living her dream and inspiring millions. The video should be motivational, emotional, and visually stunning.” Place a realistic soccer ball on grass at the far right of the banner.

Visual style: Realistic anime sports-drama storyboard, emotional closeups, dynamic camera angles, gritty textures, rain, mud, glowing stadium lights, warm amber rim light, dark blue night shadows, high contrast cinematic composition, motivational atmosphere.

Constraints: Keep exactly 16 numbered panels plus one bottom prompt banner. Use the same young yellow-haired football girl throughout. Keep text legible but compact. No extra panels, no watermark, no unrelated characters, no comedy tone.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部情感丰富的体育动漫视频创建一个电影感 4x4 项目海报，讲述 {argument name="character name" default="一位金发少女"} 如何克服拒绝、痛苦、伤病和孤独，最终通过努力成为职业足球运动员并取得成功的故事。

画布：4:5 比例的竖版海报，深色电影级调色，写实动漫美学，温暖的金色高光，深邃的阴影，戏剧性的雨景和体育场灯光。将画布精确划分为 16 个相等的黑色网格面板，每个面板左上角用黑色小方块标注 1 到 16 的数字。每个面板左侧配有醒目的黄色大写标题和简短的白色要点文字，面板主体为情感场景插图。底部添加一个全宽横幅，标题为“VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”，包含一段提示词，右侧配有一个足球图形。

主角：一位十几岁的少女，留着凌乱的短金发，身材娇小但运动感十足，肢体语言富有表现力，通常穿着深色足球训练服或印有 7 号的黑色足球球衣。她的面部可能被柔和地遮挡或处于阴影中，以突出电影感。展示她从孤独的初学者成长为备受瞩目的明星的过程。

项目面板：使用 16 个带有编号的章节和场景概念：
1. “梦想启航” — 女孩在夜晚的城市围栏旁抱着足球，注视着远处发光屏幕上的足球比赛；要点：梦想成为足球明星，深夜观看比赛，在空旷的街道独自练习，坚信足球是她的命运。
2. “无人支持” — 女孩双臂交叉站立，周围是嘲笑或无视她的同学或家人的剪影；要点：人们说足球不适合女孩，朋友嘲笑她的梦想，家人担心她的未来，但她从未放弃。
3. “每日训练” — 雨中街头训练场景，女孩在日出前奋力带球穿过水坑；要点：日出前起床，在雨中和寒冷的清晨奔跑，练习带球数小时，学会自律与耐心。
4. “首次重大挫折” — 女孩在被拒绝后独自坐在铁丝网旁哭泣，脚边放着足球和一张写着“REJECTED”的纸；要点：被当地足球学院拒绝，选拔赛后独自哭泣，感到心碎和疲惫，决定变得更强后再次尝试。
5. “最艰难的阶段” — 疲惫的女孩在台灯下伏案学习，桌上堆满书籍和足球笔记，展示学业与运动的平衡；要点：平衡学业、工作和足球，鞋子变得破旧，在粗糙的场地上训练，默默追逐梦想。
6. “微小的机会” — 当地教练站在泥泞的训练场旁，注意到了她的天赋；要点：当地教练发现了她的天赋，受邀加入一支小型女子球队，开始学习真正的团队合作，逐渐建立自信。
7. “自我塑造” — 激烈的健身/训练场景，使用哑铃或动感单车，汗水与戏剧性的灯光；要点：提高速度和耐力，学习强力射门技术，研究职业球员，变得更加坚强。
8. “首次锦标赛” — 女孩身穿 7 号黑色球衣，在体育场灯光下庆祝或射门；要点：参加第一场重要比赛，开球前感到紧张，打进首个进球，队友终于认可了她。
9. “受伤但未被击垮” — 女孩腿部或脚踝缠着绷带坐在场边，受伤但神情坚定；要点：遭受痛苦的伤病，几周无法上场，在场边注视他人，在痛苦与康复中坚持战斗。
10. “重返赛场” — 日落时的训练场，身穿 7 号球衣的女孩背影，重新加入队友行列；要点：变得比以前更强，每天加倍训练，赢得队友尊重，成为球队核心球员。
11. “病毒式传播” — 智能手机特写，显示她的比赛片段走红，屏幕周围环绕着社交媒体的点赞和评论；要点：比赛片段在网上疯传，人们开始关注她的天赋，获得粉丝和支持者，她的故事激励了年轻女孩。
12. “冠军争夺战” — 灯火通明的巨大体育场，7 号女孩在火花和欢呼声中打入制胜球或庆祝；要点：参加人生中最重要的比赛，体育场灯光闪耀，打入制胜一球，全场高呼她的名字。
13. “国家队选拔” — 女孩背着背包站在日落的城市天际线前，准备前往更大的赛场；如果需要，可在服装或包上添加隐约的“INDIA”标志；要点：入选国家集训队，前往大城市，面对更强对手，突破自身极限。
14. “成为明星” — 杂志封面或采访场景，她抱着足球，标题如“SPORTS WEEKLY”和励志口号“NO DREAM IS TOO BIG”；要点：出现在采访和杂志中，与职业俱乐部签约，激励数百万女孩，证明梦想不分性别。
15. “实现梦想” — 体育场全景背影，7 号女孩在观众欢呼声中高举双臂；要点：在大型体育场比赛，自豪地支持家人，微笑着回忆过往的挣扎，终于过上了她想象中的生活。
16. “自豪时刻” — 功成名就的球员在体育场灯光下抱着球的情感特写，回忆起年轻时的自己；要点：看着年轻时的旧足球，铭记每一次失败与牺牲，意识到挣扎让她变得更强，梦想终于成为现实。

底部横幅：在 16 个面板下方添加一个横跨全宽的深色矩形横幅。黄色粗体标题：“VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”。白色小字正文：“创作一部电影感且感人的视频，讲述一位金发少女努力成为职业足球运动员的故事。展示她从被忽视、面对失败、伤病和拒绝，到通过努力和决心崛起为明星的历程。包含训练、情感、比赛、人群、庆祝和现实生活中的挣扎。以她实现梦想并激励数百万人作为结尾。视频应具有激励性、情感共鸣且视觉效果震撼。”在横幅最右侧放置一个草地上的写实足球。

视觉风格：写实动漫体育剧项目，情感特写，动态摄像机角度，粗粝质感，雨水，泥土，发光的体育场灯光，温暖的琥珀色轮廓光，深蓝色夜间阴影，高对比度电影构图，励志氛围。

约束：保持 16 个带编号的面板加一个底部提示横幅。始终使用同一个金发足球少女。文字需清晰但紧凑。无额外面板，无水印，无无关角色，无喜剧基调。

templates.title: Faceless Shinobi Character Redesign

titleLocalized.zh: 无面忍者角色重设计

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a refreshed old-anime character design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="a rugged wandering shinobi"}, shown as two depictions on one wide canvas: exactly 1 large cropped portrait on the left and exactly 1 full-body crouching pose on the right.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image, muted gray paper-texture background, no border, no logo, no captions. Use painterly high-detail anime concept art with crisp ink-like linework, layered cel shading, weathered fabric textures, and warm rim light from the upper left.

Layout: The left half is dominated by a close-up bust portrait cropped at the top and bottom, with the face intentionally covered by a large plain rectangular censor block in muted dark brown. The right half shows the same character in a low squat, facing forward, also with the face covered by a smaller plain rectangular censor block. Keep the two views side by side like a character redesign comparison sheet.

Subject details: The character is an older battle-worn ninja or ronin with spiky gray-white hair flaring out from beneath a deep indigo head wrap. A small pointed white beard is visible below the face-covering block. Outfit color theme: {argument name="main cloth color" default="deep indigo blue"}, charcoal gray, muted brown leather, dusty beige bandages, and dark red accents. Clothing consists of exactly 8 visible outfit/gear elements: 1 wrapped headband/turban, 1 heavy layered scarf around the neck and shoulders, 1 loose cloak or poncho-like robe, 1 dark inner tunic, 1 pair of baggy charcoal pants, 1 pair of wrapped forearms and hands, 1 pair of wrapped boots, and 1 set of leather knee armor on the left knee. Add exactly 2 round red shoulder patches, one on each upper sleeve, each with a pale flower crest. Add exactly 1 sheathed katana strapped diagonally behind the character’s back on the right-side full-body view, with a patterned handle and small guard.

Pose and expression: The face is not visible; imply a calm, intimidating veteran presence through posture. In the full-body view, the character squats low with elbows resting near the knees, bandaged hands clasped loosely in front, knees spread, feet grounded, cloak draping between the legs. In the close-up view, emphasize layered folds of the scarf, stray hair strands, and the beard below the censor block.

Visual style: Modern high-end anime redesign, similar to a polished samurai fantasy production sheet; detailed cloth folds, scuffed boots, dusty bandages, worn leather, subtle scratches, restrained palette, dramatic but soft lighting, clean silhouette, no photorealism.

Constraints: Include exactly 2 character depictions, exactly 1 katana, exactly 2 red floral shoulder emblems, and exactly 2 rectangular face-covering blocks. Do not add text, speech bubbles, UI, extra weapons, extra characters, or background scenery.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="一位粗犷的流浪忍者"} 创作一张焕然一新的旧式动漫角色设计图，在同一张宽幅画布上展示两个形象：左侧为 1 个大型裁剪肖像，右侧为 1 个全身蹲姿。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向图像，哑光灰色纸张纹理背景，无边框，无 Logo，无标题。采用具有高细节的动漫概念艺术风格，线条清晰如墨，层叠赛璐珞阴影，风化的织物纹理，以及来自左上方的温暖轮廓光。

布局：左半部分主要为顶部和底部裁剪的半身肖像，面部被一个哑光深棕色的大型纯色矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。右半部分展示了同一角色正面蹲姿，面部同样被一个较小的纯色矩形遮挡块遮盖。将两个视图并排呈现，如同角色重设计对比图。

主体细节：该角色是一位饱经风霜的年长忍者或浪人，深靛蓝色头巾下露出凌乱的灰白色尖刺短发。遮挡块下方可见一小撮尖尖的白胡子。服装配色方案：{argument name="main cloth color" default="深靛蓝色"}、炭灰色、哑光棕色皮革、灰米色绷带以及深红色点缀。服装包含 8 个清晰可见的部件：1 个缠绕式头带/头巾，1 个颈部和肩部的厚重层叠围巾，1 个宽松的斗篷或披风式长袍，1 件深色内衬短衫，1 条宽松的炭灰色长裤，1 双缠绕式护臂和手部绷带，1 双缠绕式靴子，以及左膝上的 1 套皮革护膝。在左右上袖各添加 1 个圆形红色肩章，每个肩章上均带有淡色花朵纹章。在右侧全身视图中，角色背部斜挎 1 把带花纹刀柄和小型护手的武士刀。

姿态与表情：面部不可见；通过姿态传达出冷静、威严的资深忍者气质。在全身视图中，角色低蹲，肘部靠近膝盖，缠着绷带的双手松弛地交握在身前，双膝分开，双脚着地，斗篷垂在双腿之间。在特写视图中，强调围巾的层叠褶皱、散落的发丝以及遮挡块下方的胡须。

视觉风格：现代高端动漫重设计，类似于精致的武士奇幻作品设定集；细腻的布料褶皱、磨损的靴子、沾满灰尘的绷带、陈旧的皮革、细微的划痕、克制的色调、戏剧性但柔和的灯光、干净的轮廓，非写实风格。

约束条件：包含 2 个角色形象，1 把武士刀，2 个红色花卉肩章，以及 2 个矩形面部遮挡块。不要添加任何文字、对话气泡、UI、额外武器、额外角色或背景景观。

templates.title: Surreal Luxe Mouth Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实奢华 Mouth 杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic surreal luxury fashion magazine cover portrait. Extreme close-up of a woman's open mouth filling the entire vertical frame, with glossy {argument name="lip color" default="deep burgundy red"} lipstick, wet specular highlights, visible skin texture, and dramatic studio lighting. The upper teeth wear exactly 9 visible gold-and-diamond grillz caps: 2 partial side caps at the far left and far right edges, 4 rounded pavé diamond caps, 2 rectangular baguette-diamond caps, and 1 large central rounded pavé cap, all outlined in polished yellow gold with bright gem sparkle. Inside the dark open mouth, place a full-body miniature {argument name="inner figure" default="man in a navy blue suit, white shirt, black tie, and black leather gloves"} crouching forward as if emerging from the mouth, one gloved hand resting on the glossy lower lip, cinematic scale contrast, shadowy black background inside the mouth. Use an editorial high-fashion look with ultra-sharp macro detail, rich contrast, photoreal skin and lipstick texture, luxurious jewelry reflections, and a surreal advertising aesthetic. Add large white masthead text across the top reading {argument name="magazine title" default="LUXE"}, with smaller spaced text beneath the left side reading "MAGAZINE" and tiny text near the upper right reading {argument name="issue text" default="SUMMER 2024"}. The masthead should overlap the lips slightly like a real magazine cover. Vertical 4:5 cover composition, centered symmetry, no extra cover lines, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实超现实的奢华时尚杂志封面肖像。画面为女性张开嘴部的极致特写，填满整个竖构图，涂抹着光泽感 {argument name="lip color" default="深酒红色"} 唇膏，带有湿润的镜面高光，皮肤纹理清晰可见，并采用戏剧性的影棚灯光。上排牙齿佩戴着 9 颗清晰可见的金钻牙套：最左侧和最右侧各 2 颗局部侧牙套，4 颗圆形密镶钻石牙套，2 颗长方形梯钻牙套，以及 1 颗位于中央的大型圆形密镶钻石牙套，所有牙套均以抛光黄金勾勒轮廓，闪烁着明亮的宝石光芒。在黑暗的口腔内部，放置一个全身微型 {argument name="inner figure" default="身穿海军蓝西装、白衬衫、黑领带并戴着黑色皮手套的男子"}，他向前蜷缩，仿佛正从口中探出，一只戴着手套的手搁在光泽感的下唇上，呈现电影级的比例对比，口腔内部背景阴暗。采用编辑类高定时尚风格，具备超清晰的微距细节、丰富的对比度、写实的皮肤与唇膏质感、奢华的珠宝反光以及超现实的广告美学。在顶部添加醒目的白色刊头文字 {argument name="magazine title" default="LUXE"}，左下方添加较小的间距文字 "MAGAZINE"，右上角附近添加微小的文字 {argument name="issue text" default="2024 年夏季"}。刊头应像真实的杂志封面一样略微覆盖在嘴唇上方。采用 4:5 竖版封面构图，居中对称，无额外封面标题，无水印。

templates.title: Isometric Krakow Market Square Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴测克拉科夫中央集市广场立体模型

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed isometric miniature diorama of {argument name="city square" default="Krakow Main Market Square, Poland"} at warm golden lunch hour, viewed from above at a three-quarter angle like a handcrafted architectural model on a dark square display base. Show ornate European old-town architecture with pastel townhouses along the back and right edges, red tiled roofs, decorative gables, cobblestone paving, and soft shallow-depth-of-field lighting. The main landmarks should be a long Renaissance cloth hall with arcaded sides and an ornate roofline, plus a large brick Gothic basilica with exactly 2 unequal tall towers, dark spires, onion domes, and gilded details. In the open square include exactly 1 central stone monument with a standing statue, exactly 5 horse-drawn carriages, exactly 6 small market stalls or flower kiosks with pale yellow awnings, and exactly 7 white café umbrellas around outdoor seating. Fill the plaza with many tiny colorful pedestrians in summer clothing, clustered naturally around stalls, cafés, the monument, carriages, and church entrances. Use {argument name="visual style" default="ultra-detailed tilt-shift miniature, photorealistic 3D render"}, with warm sunlight, crisp shadows, rich brick and pastel colors, tiny flowers and greenery, and a charming lunch-time tourist atmosphere. Avoid readable signage, modern cars, oversized people, watermarks, or text overlays.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高度精细的等轴测微缩立体模型，主题为 {argument name="city square" default="波兰克拉科夫中央集市广场"}，时间设定在温暖的午后黄金时刻，以俯视的三分之四角度呈现，如同放置在深色方形展示底座上的手工建筑模型。展示华丽的欧洲老城建筑，背景和右侧边缘排列着柔和色调的联排别墅、红瓦屋顶、装饰性山墙、鹅卵石路面，并配以柔和的浅景深光效。主要地标应包括一座带有拱廊侧面和华丽屋顶线的长条形文艺复兴时期纺织会馆，以及一座巨大的砖砌哥特式大教堂，教堂需具备 2 座高度不等的高塔、深色尖顶、洋葱头圆顶和镀金细节。在开阔的广场中，包含 1 座中心石质纪念碑及站立雕像、5 辆马车、6 个带有淡黄色遮阳棚的小型集市摊位或花卉亭，以及 7 把环绕户外座位的白色咖啡馆遮阳伞。广场上布满许多身着夏装的微小彩色行人，自然地聚集在摊位、咖啡馆、纪念碑、马车和教堂入口周围。使用 {argument name="visual style" default="超精细移轴微缩景观，照片级 3D 渲染"}，呈现温暖的阳光、清晰的阴影、丰富的砖红色和柔和色调、微小的花卉与绿植，以及迷人的午间游客氛围。避免出现可辨认的标牌、现代汽车、比例过大的人物、水印或文字覆盖。

templates.title: Minimal Director-Led AI Studio Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 极简导演主导型 AI 工作室封面

templates.prompt: Create a realistic editorial print mockup photographed from above at a slight angle: a single white landscape-format card or magazine cover lying on a pale gray tabletop, with soft studio lighting, subtle paper texture, a thin shadow under the lower and right edges, and lots of clean negative space. The design is minimalist black-and-white with a small color accent. Place all typography flush left in the upper-left quadrant: a small italic serif kicker reading “{argument name="section label" default="Industry — Director Spotlight"}”, then a very large bold black modern sans-serif headline on three lines reading “{argument name="headline text" default="The Director-Led AI Studio Coming Out of London"}”, followed by a smaller gray-black sans-serif subheading on two lines reading “{argument name="subheading text" default="Future Video Media builds launch films, identity systems, and brand worlds in one week."}”. In the lower-left area beneath the copy, add exactly 1 black geometric film/play icon: a right-pointing triangular play symbol with three small square film perforations along its left edge. Under the icon add exactly 3 thin horizontal color stripes, stacked with small gaps: top stripe magenta fading into red and yellow, middle stripe deep blue, bottom stripe cyan/teal. Keep the card edges crisp, the background neutral, the overall style like a premium magazine feature cover or agency one-sheet, with no extra text, no people, no watermark, and no additional logos.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个从上方微倾斜角度拍摄的写实编辑印刷样机：一张横向的白色卡片或杂志封面平放在浅灰色桌面上，配以柔和的摄影棚灯光、细腻的纸张纹理、下边缘和右边缘的细微阴影，以及大量留白。设计采用极简的黑白风格，并带有少量色彩点缀。将所有排版左对齐放置在左上象限：一个小型的斜体衬线体引语，内容为“{argument name="section label" default="行业 — 导演聚焦"}”，随后是一个非常醒目的黑色粗体现代无衬线标题，分三行排列，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="来自伦敦的导演主导型 AI 工作室"}”，紧接着是一个较小的灰黑色无衬线副标题，分两行排列，内容为“{argument name="subheading text" default="Future Video Media 在一周内构建发布影片、识别系统和品牌世界。"}”。在文案下方的左下区域，添加 1 个黑色的几何电影/播放图标：一个向右的三角形播放符号，其左侧边缘带有三个小方形电影齿孔。在图标下方添加 3 条细长的水平色带，垂直堆叠并留有小间隙：顶部色带为从洋红色渐变到红色和黄色，中间色带为深蓝色，底部色带为青色/蓝绿色。保持卡片边缘清晰，背景中性，整体风格如同高端杂志专题封面或代理商单页，不包含额外文字、人物、水印或任何其他标志。

templates.title: London Nocturnal Urban Archive Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: 伦敦夜间城市档案立体模型

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic physical museum-diorama map titled {argument name="city title" default="LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}, showing London at night as a raised 3D architectural archive model on a flat cartographic board.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image, three-quarter overhead perspective, the entire board visible on a dark matte tabletop. Use a restrained nocturnal palette: deep navy paper, charcoal streets, warm amber city lights, muted gold cartographic lines, dark blue water, and subtle off-white typography.

Main scene: Build a detailed miniature relief map of central London with the River Thames curving across the lower-middle and right side. Streets should appear as dense fine-line grids with thousands of tiny warm lights. Parks are dark green recessed areas. Buildings are low matte extrusions with key landmarks rising taller and more sculptural. Make the model feel tactile and physical: paper grain, beveled board edges, cast shadows, tiny boats on the river, and realistic museum-display lighting.

Landmarks and callouts: Include exactly 6 vertical top annotation callouts with thin gold leader lines and small uppercase labels: 1) Buckingham Palace, 2) Big Ben / Palace of Westminster, 3) St. Paul's Cathedral, 4) The Shard, 5) The Gherkin, 6) Canary Wharf. Place them left to right across the top border. Represent the Palace of Westminster and Big Ben near the Thames with warm illumination, St. Paul's with a glowing dome, The Shard as a tall sharp glass spire, The Gherkin as a rounded bullet-shaped tower, Canary Wharf as a cluster of golden high-rises, and Tower Bridge as a lit bridge crossing the Thames.

Map labels: Add small uppercase neighborhood and place labels directly on the map, including Regent's Park, Marylebone, Oxford Street, Paddington, Hyde Park, Green Park, St. James's Park, Buckingham Palace, Kensington, Victoria, Westminster, Southwark, City of London, London Bridge, Tower Bridge, Bermondsey, Greenwich, River Thames, The Shard, The Gherkin, and The Tower of London. Use subtle cream or pale gold type that follows the archival map aesthetic.

Grid and border system: Overlay a precise atlas-style index grid with letters along the top and numbers down the sides. Use thin gold grid lines, double-line borders, and an engraved archival drafting style. The board should look like a premium landscape archive model, not a digital screenshot.

Bottom information band: Reserve a full-width cartographic footer divided into framed panels. Left panel contains a legend with exactly 6 symbol entries: Major landmark, Historic building, Park / green space, Water body, Bridge, Railway station. Center panel contains the large title {argument name="city title" default="LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}, a subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL / 地景檔案模型"}, an archive code reading {argument name="archive code" default="ARCHIVE CODE: LDN-NAM-2024-001"}, and a scale bar labeled in miles and kilometers from 0 to 3 miles and 0 to 3 km. Right side contains a compass rose, a small inset index grid map, and a coordinate note reading {argument name="coordinate note" default="COORDINATE SYSTEM — BRITISH NATIONAL GRID — TRANSVERSE MERCATOR — OSGB 1936"}.

Style constraints: Ultra-detailed editorial product photography, realistic miniature materials, crisp but tiny readable typography, warm amber highlights against cool navy shadows, shallow depth of field only at the extreme edges, no people, no modern UI, no watermark, no extra legends or extra landmark callouts beyond the specified counts.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个名为 {argument name="city title" default="LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"} 的电影级实体博物馆立体模型地图，将伦敦呈现为放置在平面地图项目上的 3D 建筑档案模型。

画布：宽屏 16:9 水平图像，四分之三俯视视角，整个项目在深色哑光桌面上清晰可见。使用克制的夜间色调：深海军蓝纸张、炭灰色街道、温暖的琥珀色城市灯光、柔和的金色地图线条、深蓝色水域以及精致的灰白色字体。

主场景：构建一个伦敦市中心的精细微缩浮雕地图，泰晤士河在左下方和右侧蜿蜒流过。街道应呈现为密集的细线网格，并点缀着数千盏微小的暖色灯光。公园是深绿色的凹陷区域。建筑物为低矮的哑光凸起，关键地标则更高、更具雕塑感。让模型具有触感和实体感：纸张纹理、斜切的项目边缘、投影、河上的微型船只以及逼真的博物馆展示照明。

地标与标注：包含 6 个垂直向上的注释标注，带有细金色引导线和小号大写标签：1) Buckingham Palace，2) Big Ben / Palace of Westminster，3) St. Paul's Cathedral，4) The Shard，5) The Gherkin，6) Canary Wharf。将它们从左到右放置在顶部边缘。泰晤士河附近的威斯敏斯特宫和 Big Ben 需有温暖的照明，St. Paul's Cathedral 带有发光的圆顶，The Shard 为高耸尖锐的玻璃尖塔，The Gherkin 为圆润的子弹形塔楼，Canary Wharf 为一组金色高层建筑，Tower Bridge 为横跨泰晤士河的照明桥梁。

地图标签：在地图上直接添加小号大写字母的街区和地点标签，包括 Regent's Park、Marylebone、Oxford Street、Paddington、Hyde Park、Green Park、St. James's Park、Buckingham Palace、Kensington、Victoria、Westminster、Southwark、City of London、London Bridge、Tower Bridge、Bermondsey、Greenwich、River Thames、The Shard、The Gherkin 和 The Tower of London。使用符合档案地图美学的柔和奶油色或浅金色字体。

网格与边框系统：叠加一个精确的地图集风格索引网格，顶部为字母，侧面为数字。使用细金色网格线、双线边框和雕刻般的档案绘图风格。项目应看起来像一个高级景观档案模型，而非数字截图。

底部信息栏：保留一个全宽的地图页脚，分为多个框架面板。左侧面板包含一个包含 6 个符号条目的图例：主要地标、历史建筑、公园/绿地、水体、桥梁、火车站。中心面板包含大标题 {argument name="city title" default="LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}、副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL / 地景档案模型"}、档案代码 {argument name="archive code" default="ARCHIVE CODE: LDN-NAM-2024-001"} 以及标注为英里和公里的比例尺（0 到 3 英里和 0 到 3 公里）。右侧包含一个罗盘玫瑰、一个小插图索引网格地图以及坐标说明 {argument name="coordinate note" default="COORDINATE SYSTEM — BRITISH NATIONAL GRID — TRANSVERSE MERCATOR — OSGB 1936"}。

风格限制：超精细的编辑级产品摄影，逼真的微缩材料，清晰但微小的可读字体，冷海军蓝阴影下的暖琥珀色高光，仅在极边缘处有浅景深，无人像，无现代 UI，无水印，除指定数量外，不得添加额外的图例或地标标注。

variables.defaultValue: LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL / 地景檔案模型

variables.defaultValue: COORDINATE SYSTEM — BRITISH NATIONAL GRID — TRANSVERSE MERCATOR — OSGB 1936

templates.title: Nocturnal New York Archive Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: 纽约夜景档案立体模型

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed physical museum-diorama style archival city map of {argument name="city name" default="New York City"} at night, titled as a “Landscape Archive Model / Nocturnal Urban Archive.” The image should look like a photographed, handcrafted architectural archive board: a flat printed map base with a raised 3D miniature city model emerging from it, illuminated by tiny warm building lights and cool navy ambient lighting.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape photograph, three-quarter overhead view, the entire rectangular archive board visible on a dark tabletop. Use a deep navy, charcoal, brass, and warm amber palette. The board has a thick dark frame, subtle paper grain, bevelled edges, cast shadows, and tactile museum-model realism.

Layout: Center the raised 3D miniature of Manhattan, surrounded by flat engraved map regions and waterways. The rivers should be dark glossy blue with subtle reflections. The background map includes fine street grids, coordinate lines, latitude/longitude style guide marks, and archival border numbering. Add a precise top-and-side grid system with letters along the top and bottom and numbers down the left and right edges. Include thin brass annotation lines connecting labels to landmarks.

Main subject details: Show Manhattan as a dense raised cluster of miniature buildings with glowing windows. Make the Empire State Building stand tall near the center with a bright lit crown. Include One World Trade Center near the lower-left Manhattan area, the Chrysler Building to the right of Midtown, Times Square as a glowing central district, Central Park as a dark rectangular green-black void in upper Manhattan, and the Brooklyn Bridge crossing the East River toward Brooklyn. Surrounding borough and regional labels should appear flat on the map.

Text content and labels: Use elegant uppercase archival typography in off-white and brass. Include exactly 18 visible labeled map/annotation elements: 1) main title “NEW YORK CITY”, 2) subtitle “NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE”, 3) archive ID “NYC-NAM-2024-001”, 4) top micro-label “LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL”, 5) “EAST RIVER CORRIDOR STUDY / EDITION 01”, 6) “EMPIRE STATE BUILDING / 1,454 ft / 443 m”, 7) “TIMES SQUARE / THEATER DISTRICT”, 8) “ONE WORLD TRADE CENTER / 1,776 ft / 541 m”, 9) “CENTRAL PARK”, 10) “CHRYSLER BUILDING / 1,046 ft / 319 m”, 11) “BROOKLYN BRIDGE / 1,595 ft / 486 m”, 12) “NEW JERSEY / HUDSON COUNTY”, 13) “HUDSON RIVER”, 14) “EAST RIVER”, 15) “QUEENS / LONG ISLAND CITY”, 16) “BROOKLYN / DOWNTOWN BROOKLYN”, 17) “LEGEND”, and 18) “ARCHIVE NOTES”.

Inset panels: Include exactly 4 boxed information panels integrated into the board: a title panel in the upper left, a legend panel in the lower left, a scale-and-north-arrow panel along the bottom left, and an archive-notes/model-code panel in the lower right. The legend panel should contain exactly 6 line/icon entries: primary road, secondary road, rail line, water body, park/green space, and major landmark/building footprint. The lower-right archive panel should include model code “NYC-NAM-2024-001”, model number “001”, and sheet number “01 / 01”.

Lighting and material style: Nighttime editorial photography, warm amber city lights, cool blue shadows, crisp miniature details, realistic depth of field, slight vignette, matte printed paper texture, metallic ink lines, raised resin/wood model buildings, tiny glowing windows, and realistic cast shadows. The overall result should feel like a production-quality architectural archive model photographed in a museum studio.

Constraints: Keep the design restrained, precise, and premium. Do not add people, vehicles, logos, watermarks, or modern UI elements. Preserve a consistent archival map language, make all text look printed on the board, and avoid fantasy or sci-fi styling.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个高度精细的物理博物馆立体模型风格的城市档案地图，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="New York City"} 的夜景，标题为“景观档案模型 / 夜间城市档案”。图像应呈现为一张经过摄影的、手工制作的建筑档案项目：底座为平面印刷地图，上方浮现出 3D 微缩城市模型，由微小的暖色建筑灯光和冷色调海军蓝环境光照亮。

画布：宽屏 16:9 风景摄影，四分之三俯视视角，整个矩形档案项目完整呈现在深色桌面上。使用深海军蓝、炭灰、黄铜和暖琥珀色调。项目带有厚实的深色边框、细腻的纸张纹理、斜切边缘、投影效果以及博物馆模型般的真实质感。

布局：将曼哈顿的 3D 微缩模型置于中心，周围环绕着平面的雕刻地图区域和水道。河流应呈现为深光泽蓝色，带有细微的反射。背景地图包含精细的街道网格、坐标线、经纬度风格的引导标记以及档案边框编号。添加精确的顶部和侧面网格系统，顶部和底部标有字母，左右边缘标有数字。包含连接标签与地标的细黄铜注释线。

主体细节：将曼哈顿展示为密集且隆起的微缩建筑群，窗户散发着光芒。帝国大厦（Empire State Building）应在中心附近高耸，塔尖灯光璀璨。在曼哈顿左下区域包含世界贸易中心一号大楼（One World Trade Center），中城右侧为克莱斯勒大厦（Chrysler Building），时代广场（Times Square）作为发光的中心区域，中央公园（Central Park）表现为曼哈顿上城的一块深色矩形绿黑色空地，布鲁克林大桥（Brooklyn Bridge）横跨东河（East River）通往布鲁克林。周围行政区和区域标签应平铺在地图上。

文本内容与标签：使用优雅的米白色和黄铜色大写档案字体。包含 18 个可见的标签/注释元素：1) 主标题“NEW YORK CITY”，2) 副标题“NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE”，3) 档案 ID “NYC-NAM-2024-001”，4) 顶部微型标签“LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL”，5) “EAST RIVER CORRIDOR STUDY / EDITION 01”，6) “EMPIRE STATE BUILDING / 1,454 ft / 443 m”，7) “TIMES SQUARE / THEATER DISTRICT”，8) “ONE WORLD TRADE CENTER / 1,776 ft / 541 m”，9) “CENTRAL PARK”，10) “CHRYSLER BUILDING / 1,046 ft / 319 m”，11) “BROOKLYN BRIDGE / 1,595 ft / 486 m”，12) “NEW JERSEY / HUDSON COUNTY”，13) “HUDSON RIVER”，14) “EAST RIVER”，15) “QUEENS / LONG ISLAND CITY”，16) “BROOKLYN / DOWNTOWN BROOKLYN”，17) “LEGEND”，以及 18) “ARCHIVE NOTES”。

嵌入面板：在项目上集成 4 个方框信息面板：左上角的标题面板、左下角的图例面板、左下方的比例尺和指北针面板，以及右下角的档案备注/模型代码面板。图例面板应包含 6 个线条/图标条目：主干道、次干道、铁路线、水体、公园/绿地以及主要地标/建筑占地。右下角的档案面板应包含模型代码“NYC-NAM-2024-001”、模型编号“001”和页码“01 / 01”。

templates.title: Paris Nocturnal Urban Archive Map

titleLocalized.zh: 巴黎夜间城市档案地图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a museum-quality physical diorama map titled {argument name="map title" default="PARIS – NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}, showing {argument name="city" default="Paris"} at night as an architectural archive model with glowing streets, miniature landmarks, and engraved cartographic annotations.

Canvas: Horizontal 3:2 image, photographed from a high oblique angle like a premium tabletop exhibit. The map is a thick rectangular board on a dark studio surface, with a black-navy base, warm gold linework, subtle paper grain, raised relief terrain, cast shadows, and matte museum-display realism.

Layout: Fill the frame with one large rectangular archival city map bordered by a double gold frame. Add an alphanumeric grid around the map edges: letters A–K across the top and numbers 1–8 down both sides. The city occupies the upper three quarters; a structured information band occupies the bottom quarter.

Main city model: Render the Seine as a deep navy-blue river crossing horizontally through the lower middle with glowing embankments and bridges. Streets form a dense, accurate-looking Haussmann-style network of thin amber illuminated lines. Major boulevards glow brighter and have small engraved labels. Parks are darker textured green-black areas. Buildings are low, dark, and finely extruded, creating a tactile 3D archive model.

Count and place exactly 4 raised illuminated landmark models: 1) Eiffel Tower in the lower-left/left-center near the river, tallest and glowing gold; 2) Arc de Triomphe in the upper-left quadrant with radiating avenues; 3) Notre-Dame Cathedral on the island/river area near the center-right; 4) Sacré-Cœur / Montmartre basilica in the upper-right quadrant on a raised area.

Count and label exactly 15 district/area annotations in small serif gold type: “XVII BATIGNOLLES MONCEAU”, “VIII ELYSEE”, “IX OPERA”, “XVIII MONTMARTRE”, “XIX LA VILLETTE”, “X ENTREPOT”, “III TEMPLE”, “IV HOTEL DE VILLE”, “XI BASTILLE”, “XII REUILLY”, “XIII GOBELINS”, “V PANTHEON”, “VI LUXEMBOURG”, “VII PALAIS BOURBON”, “XVI PASSY”. Also label “BOIS DE BOULOGNE” in the large dark park on the left.

Major route labels: Include “CHAMPS-ELYSEES” leading from Arc de Triomphe, “BOULEVARD HAUSSMANN” across the upper middle, “BOULEVARD SAINT-GERMAIN” in the lower middle, and “BOULEVARD BOURDON” or a similar small boulevard label near the right river edge.

Bottom information band: Divide the band into 5 visible panels from left to right: 1) legend panel, 2) compass panel, 3) central title panel, 4) scale/inset grid panel, 5) miniature regional locator map panel.

Bottom panel details: The legend panel must list exactly 5 symbol categories: Monument, Major axis, Boulevard, Bridge, Park / Garden, plus a water swatch beneath if space allows. The compass panel contains one ornate gold compass rose with N/E/S/W markings. The central panel contains the large title {argument name="map title" default="PARIS – NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}, the subtitle “CITY OF LIGHTS · HISTORIC CORE · HAUSSMANN NETWORK”, and the archive code {argument name="archive code" default="PAR-NAM-2024-001"}. The scale panel shows “SCALE 1:10,000” and a segmented bar from 0 to 1000 m. The locator panel shows a small outline map labeled “CENTRAL PARIS FRANCE”.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed physical miniature, not a flat digital map. Use restrained nocturnal colors: charcoal black, navy water, antique brass gold, amber lights, and muted dark green parks. Lighting should feel like tiny embedded LEDs along streets and monuments, with realistic shadows, bevels, engraved typography, and archival cartographic precision.

Constraints: Keep all text in English or French-style Latin lettering as specified. No people, no cars, no modern UI, no watermark. Maintain a consistent premium editorial archive-map series aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张博物馆级的实体立体模型地图，标题为 {argument name="map title" default="PARIS – NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}，展示 {argument name="city" default="Paris"} 的夜景，呈现为建筑档案模型，带有发光的街道、微型地标以及雕刻般的制图注释。

画布：横向 3:2 图像，以类似高级桌面展品的高仰角拍摄。地图是一个放置在深色工作室平面上的厚矩形项目，具有黑海军蓝底色、暖金色线条、细腻的纸张纹理、浮雕地形、投影效果以及哑光博物馆展示的真实感。

布局：用一张大型矩形档案城市地图填满画面，并配以双层金色边框。在地图边缘添加字母数字网格：顶部为 A–K，两侧为 1–8。城市占据上方四分之三的区域；结构化的信息栏占据底部四分之一。

城市主体模型：将塞纳河渲染为深海军蓝色的河流，横向穿过中下部，带有发光的河岸和桥梁。街道形成密集且精确的奥斯曼风格网络，由细小的琥珀色发光线条组成。主要大道发光更亮，并带有小型雕刻标签。公园是纹理较暗的深绿色区域。建筑物低矮、深色且经过精细挤压，营造出触感真实的 3D 档案模型。

计数并放置 4 个凸起的发光地标模型：1) 左下/中左侧靠近河流的埃菲尔铁塔，最高且呈金色发光；2) 左上象限的凯旋门，带有放射状大道；3) 中右侧岛屿/河流区域的巴黎圣母院；4) 右上象限高处的圣心大教堂/蒙马特大教堂。

计数并标注 15 个区域注释，使用小型衬线金色字体：“XVII BATIGNOLLES MONCEAU”、“VIII ELYSEE”、“IX OPERA”、“XVIII MONTMARTRE”、“XIX LA VILLETTE”、“X ENTREPOT”、“III TEMPLE”、“IV HOTEL DE VILLE”、“XI BASTILLE”、“XII REUILLY”、“XIII GOBELINS”、“V PANTHEON”、“VI LUXEMBOURG”、“VII PALAIS BOURBON”、“XVI PASSY”。同时在左侧大型深色公园标注“BOIS DE BOULOGNE”。

主要路线标签：包括从凯旋门延伸出的“CHAMPS-ELYSEES”、横跨中上部的“BOULEVARD HAUSSMANN”、中下部的“BOULEVARD SAINT-GERMAIN”，以及靠近右侧河岸的“BOULEVARD BOURDON”或类似的小型大道标签。

底部信息栏：将信息栏从左至右分为 5 个可见面板：1) 图例面板，2) 指南针面板，3) 中央标题面板，4) 比例尺/插图网格面板，5) 微型区域定位地图面板。

底部面板细节：图例面板必须列出 5 个符号类别：纪念碑、主轴线、大道、桥梁、公园/花园，如果空间允许，下方可添加水域色块。指南针面板包含一个带有 N/E/S/W 标记的华丽金色罗盘玫瑰。中央面板包含大标题 {argument name="map title" default="PARIS – NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}、副标题“CITY OF LIGHTS · HISTORIC CORE · HAUSSMANN NETWORK”以及档案代码 {argument name="archive code" default="PAR-NAM-2024-001"}。比例尺面板显示“SCALE 1:10,000”以及 0 到 1000 米的分段条。定位面板显示一张标有“CENTRAL PARIS FRANCE”的小型轮廓地图。

视觉风格：超精细实体微缩模型，而非平面数字地图。使用克制的夜间色调：炭黑色、海军蓝水域、古铜金色、琥珀色灯光以及柔和的深绿色公园。灯光应呈现出沿街道和纪念碑嵌入的微型 LED 效果，并具有真实的阴影、斜角、雕刻字体和档案制图精度。

约束：所有文字保持为英语或法语风格的拉丁字母。没有人像、没有汽车、没有现代 UI、没有水印。保持一致的高级编辑档案地图系列美学。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版赛博朋克时尚书籍封面/海报，致敬 {argument name="book author" default="William Gibson"}，灵感源自黑暗霓虹的《神经漫游者》美学。采用低角度全身英雄视角，拍摄一名年轻男性赛博朋克特工，双腿分开站在光亮的反光地面上，俯视镜头；身穿超大号黑紫色皮质风衣（配半透明紫色内衬）、短款战术上衣、黑色绑带工装裤，配有大量搭扣和拉链，穿着厚底战斗靴、露指手套，其中一只伸出的手上长有金属质感的长爪状机械手指。面部刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理，露出短而尖的黑色头发。整体色调为黑色、紫外光色、电紫色和烟蓝色，带有戏剧性的轮廓光、地面上的体积雾、雨水湿润的反光、高对比度、电影级照片写实细节以及光泽感的编辑风格。在他身后，墙面上放置巨大的半透明发光块状字母，拼写出 {argument name="giant background word" default="MOLLY"}，部分位于角色后方，仿佛由磨砂紫色霓虹玻璃制成。底部添加一个大号且字间距宽的标题 {argument name="bottom title" default="NEUROMANCER"}，使用纤细的未来感大写字母，并带有紫色光晕。在海报周围添加 8 个小型排版元素：1 左上角的一句韩文引语 {argument name="Korean quote" default="사이버펑크는 죽지 않는다 그것은 진화한다"}；2 一组小型地理位置堆叠文字 “SEOUL / LONDON / NEW YORK”；3 一个小型地球仪图标；4 一个微型标签 “COLLECTION: NEUROMANCER _001”；5 一个加号十字准星符号；6 小型堆叠文字 “SYSTEM OVERRIDE / REALITY IS OPTIONAL”；7 右侧文字 “FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN”；8 一条垂直微型文字条 “NEO SEOUL PROTOCOL 2084”。添加 5 个页脚细节：“NMCR_001”、“SPRING / SUMMER 2084”、“DATA THIEF / SOLO OPERATIVE”、一个小地球仪图标以及一个标注为 “NMCR 001” 的条形码。构图应呈现出高级科幻小说封面与奢华街头服饰广告相结合的质感，要求超高细节、锐利、情绪化，除指定的排版内容外，不添加额外角色或主文本。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly realistic physical museum-diorama map titled {argument name="city archive title" default="TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}, showing {argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} at night as a dense 3D architectural landscape archive model, photographed from an elevated oblique angle on a dark tabletop.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 3:2 composition, like a premium architectural archive board. The map fills most of the frame, with a thick dark border, thin cream drafting lines, coordinate ticks, and a bottom information strip. Use a restrained night palette: charcoal black paper, deep navy water, warm amber street lights, cool white building lights, subtle blue accents, and matte model textures.

Main scene: A detailed miniature city map combining a flat printed street plan with raised 3D building clusters. Roads glow as fine golden and white illuminated lines. Water areas are dark navy with glossy reflections. The terrain should feel tactile, with paper grain, tiny cast shadows, and realistic model-making materials. Include three prominent illuminated 3D landmarks: Tokyo Tower glowing warm orange near the lower center-left, Tokyo Skytree glowing cool blue and violet near the upper-right waterfront, and Rainbow Bridge crossing the bay in the lower-right. Include dense high-rise clusters around Shinjuku and central Tokyo, plus many low-rise city blocks.

Layout and labels: Add exactly 9 black rectangular callout labels with thin cream borders, each with Japanese text above small English text: 1) Shinjuku, 2) Shibuya, 3) Ueno, 4) Asakusa, 5) Tokyo Skytree, 6) Imperial Palace, 7) Ginza, 8) Odaiba, 9) Tokyo Bay. Place them near their corresponding areas, with subtle pointer alignment but no clutter.

Map grid: Add an archive-style index grid around the map. Use column numbers 1 through 10 along the top edge and row letters A through E down the left edge. Add small coordinate markings along the border, including latitude and longitude-style numbers. In the bottom-right information strip, include a small Index Grid box showing exactly 25 cells labeled A1 through A5, B1 through B5, C1 through C5, D1 through D5, and E1 through E5.

Bottom information strip: Along the bottom, create an archival legend and title block. Include a left legend box titled “Legend” with exactly 8 listed items and colored line samples: 1) JR Yamanote Line, 2) JR Chuo Line, 3) Ginza Line, 4) Asakusa Line, 5) Yurikamome Line, 6) Water, 7) Major Road, 8) Expressway, plus a small Park / Green swatch if space allows. Center-left title text should read {argument name="main title text" default="TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}. Below it, add “Landscape Archive Model” and an archive code reading {argument name="archive code" default="Archive Code: TKY-NAM-2024-001"}. Add a scale bar labeled “Scale 1:25,000” with distance ticks from 0 to 2.5 km. Add a north arrow in its own box near the right.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed editorial product photography, crisp focus, realistic depth, soft directional studio lighting from upper left, warm city glow, delicate shadows from raised structures, luxurious matte black board, cream ink drafting lines, museum exhibit quality. Avoid people, vehicles large enough to dominate, cartoon styling, bright daylight, messy typography, or extra landmarks beyond the labeled set.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个高度逼真的博物馆级立体模型地图，标题为 {argument name="city archive title" default="TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}，展示 {argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} 在夜间作为密集 3D 建筑景观档案模型的样子，并从高处斜角拍摄于深色桌面上。

画布：宽幅 3:2 水平构图，如同高级建筑档案项目。地图填满大部分画面，带有厚实的深色边框、奶油色细制图线、坐标刻度以及底部的资料条。使用克制的夜间色调：炭黑色纸张、深海军蓝水域、暖琥珀色路灯、冷白色建筑灯光、微妙的蓝色点缀以及哑光模型纹理。

主场景：一张精细的微缩城市地图，结合了平面印刷的街道规划与凸起的 3D 建筑群。道路呈现为发光的金色和白色细线。水域为深海军蓝色，带有光泽反射。地形应具有触感，体现纸张纹理、微小的投影以及逼真的模型制作材料。包含三个突出的发光 3D 地标：左下中心附近发出暖橙色光芒的东京塔，右上水岸附近发出冷蓝色和紫色光芒的东京晴空塔，以及右下角横跨海湾的彩虹大桥。包含新宿和东京市中心周围密集的摩天大楼群，以及许多低层城市街区。

布局与标注：添加 9 个带有奶油色细边框的黑色矩形标注框，每个标注框上方为日文，下方为英文小字：1) 新宿，2) 涩谷，3) 上野，4) 浅草，5) 东京晴空塔，6) 皇居，7) 银座，8) 台场，9) 东京湾。将它们放置在相应区域附近，带有微妙的指示线，但避免杂乱。

地图网格：在地图周围添加档案风格的索引网格。顶部边缘使用 1 到 10 的列数字，左侧边缘使用 A 到 E 的行字母。沿边框添加小型坐标标记，包括纬度和经度风格的数字。在右下角的资料条中，包含一个小型索引网格框，精确显示 25 个单元格，标记为 A1 到 A5、B1 到 B5、C1 到 C5、D1 到 D5 以及 E1 到 E5。

底部资料条：沿底部创建一个档案图例和标题栏。左侧图例框标题为“Legend”，列出 8 个项目及彩色线条样本：1) JR 山手线，2) JR 中央线，3) 银座线，4) 浅草线，5) 百合海鸥线，6) 水域，7) 主干道，8) 高速公路，如果空间允许，添加一个小型的公园/绿地色块。左中标题文字应为 {argument name="main title text" default="TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}。下方添加“Landscape Archive Model”以及档案代码 {argument name="archive code" default="Archive Code: TKY-NAM-2024-001"}。添加一个标注为“Scale 1:25,000”的比例尺，距离刻度从 0 到 2.5 公里。在右侧的独立框中添加一个指北针。

视觉风格：超精细的编辑类产品摄影，清晰对焦，逼真的景深，来自左上方的柔和定向影棚灯光，温暖的城市光芒，凸起结构产生的细腻阴影，奢华的哑光黑项目板，奶油色墨水制图线条，博物馆展品质量。避免出现人物、过大的车辆、卡通风格、明亮的日光、杂乱的排版，或除标注地标之外的额外地标。

Keep the face intentionally obscured or anonymized while preserving the iconic football-star silhouette and emotion.

Layout and counted storyboard panels: Include exactly 8 numbered cinematic moments, each with a large gold number, bold white uppercase title, and a short white subtitle. Arrange them as overlapping diagonal film-strip panels across the left half and lower half of the poster:
1. "STADIUM IGNITION" — "LIGHTS. FIRE. 80,000 HEARTS. ONE DREAM." Wide aerial stadium packed with fans and fireworks bursting above the roof.
2. "THE WALKOUT" — "NO WORDS. JUST DESTINY." Players walking through rain and tunnel light, central France number 10 silhouette leading.
3. "FIRST TOUCH" — "THE MOMENT EVERYTHING BEGINS." Extreme close-up of a boot striking or trapping a football on wet grass with spray.
4. "THE BREAKAWAY" — "SPEED. SKILL. HE CAN'T BE STOPPED." The France player sprinting past defenders with golden motion streaks.
5. "COLLISION" — "PAIN. IMPACT. NO TURNING BACK." A muddy sliding tackle and bodies crashing on the pitch.
6. "FINAL SHOT" — "ONE STRIKE. ETERNITY." Dynamic shooting pose, leg extended, ball rocketing toward goal in a stadium.
7. "THE GOAL" — "EXPLOSION. HISTORY!" Football smashing into the net with a burst of sparks and glowing impact lines.
8. "IMMORTAL" — "LEGENDS AREN'T BORN. THEY ARE MADE. IN THE FINAL MINUTE." Player sliding on knees in celebration amid gold confetti and roaring crowd.

Right-side broadcast overlay: Add a compact vertical scoreboard HUD near the upper-right edge with a small World Cup trophy icon and text "FIFA WORLD CUP QATAR 2022". Below it place a boxed label "FINAL", a large timer "89:59", an added-time line "+6", then two score rows: "FRA" with French flag and score "2", and "ARG" with Argentina flag and score "2". Beneath the scoreboard add a red audio waveform and small labels reading "CROWD NOISE LEVEL" and "MAXIMUM". Add tiny technical text below, such as "CAMERA 7", "SLOW MOTION", and "180 FPS".

Bottom title area: Across the lower center, place a massive distressed white title {argument name="main title" default="FINAL MINUTE"} in bold condensed sports typography with rough texture. Under it, add the tagline {argument name="tagline" default="90 MINUTES. ONE MOMENT THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING."} with the words "CHANGES EVERYTHING" highlighted in gold. At the very bottom, add a tiny production credit line: {argument name="credit line" default="CRAFTED WITH GPT IMAGE 2 + SEEDANCE 2.0"}.

Visual style: Premium cinematic football poster, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, dark HDR grading, shallow depth of field, rain particles, sparks, smoke, stadium floodlights, explosive gold confetti, diagonal editorial composition, crisp typography, intense motion, viral sports social-media aesthetic.

Constraints: Use exactly 8 numbered panels plus the single large heroic portrait panel. Keep all text legible, uppercase, and integrated into the design. Do not add extra storyboard numbers, extra teams, watermarks, app UI, or unrelated logos. Maintain a vertical social-media poster format and a dramatic final-minute World Cup atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为关于 {argument name="football star" default="Kylian Mbappe"} 在世界杯决赛中表现的 AI 生成足球电影，创作一张 9:16 竖版分屏布局的社交媒体展示图，融合电影海报、项目和体育转播图形的视觉冲击力。

画布：竖版海报，黑暗电影感球场氛围，高对比度，雨水与火花，金橙色高光，深海军蓝与黑色阴影，写实体育摄影质感，带有戏剧性的运动模糊、镜头光晕、飞溅的草皮、五彩纸屑和爆炸性的灯光。左侧和底部使用倾斜的矩形面板拼贴，由细金边分隔，右侧设有一个大型英雄肖像面板。

主体：一名身穿深海军蓝法国队球衣、背号为金色 10 号的法国足球运动员，拥有健硕的体格，皮肤和球衣被雨水浸透，站在夜晚灯火通明的拥挤球场中。在右侧的大面板中，他从胸部以上出镜，拳头紧贴胸口，背景是球场泛光灯，雨滴清晰可见，神情胜利且专注。在保留标志性的足球明星轮廓和情绪的同时，刻意模糊或匿名化面部。

布局与编号项目面板：包含 8 个带编号的电影感瞬间，每个瞬间配有一个大号金色数字、醒目的白色大写标题和简短的白色副标题。将它们排列为重叠的对角线胶片条，分布在海报的左半部分和下半部分：
1. “STADIUM IGNITION”（球场点燃）——“灯光。火焰。8 万颗心。一个梦想。” 俯瞰球场，观众席座无虚席，屋顶上方烟花绽放。
2. “THE WALKOUT”（入场）——“无需言语。唯有命运。” 球员们走过雨中和通道灯光，中央是法国队 10 号的剪影。
3. “FIRST TOUCH”（首次触球）——“一切开始的瞬间。” 极致特写，球鞋在湿草地上击球或停球，伴随水雾飞溅。
4. “THE BREAKAWAY”（突破）——“速度。技能。他势不可挡。” 法国球员带着金色运动轨迹冲过防守队员。
5. “COLLISION”（碰撞）——“疼痛。冲击。没有回头路。” 泥泞中的滑铲和球场上身体碰撞的瞬间。
6. “FINAL SHOT”（最终射门）——“一击。永恒。” 动态射门姿势，腿部伸展，足球在球场中向球门疾驰。
7. “THE GOAL”（进球）——“爆炸。历史！” 足球冲入球网，伴随火花和发光的冲击线。
8. “IMMORTAL”（不朽）——“传奇并非天生。而是造就。在最后一分钟。” 球员在金色的五彩纸屑和欢呼的人群中跪地滑行庆祝。

右侧转播叠加层：在右上边缘附近添加一个紧凑的竖版比分 HUD，带有一个小的世界杯奖杯图标和文字“FIFA WORLD CUP QATAR 2022”。下方放置一个带框标签“FINAL”，一个大计时器“89:59”，补时线“+6”，以及两行比分：“FRA”配法国国旗和比分“2”，“ARG”配阿根廷国旗和比分“2”。在比分牌下方添加红色音频波形，以及标有“CROWD NOISE LEVEL”（观众噪音水平）和“MAXIMUM”（最大值）的小标签。在下方添加微小的技术文字，如“CAMERA 7”、“SLOW MOTION”和“180 FPS”。

底部标题区域：在底部中心横跨放置一个巨大的做旧白色标题 {argument name="main title" default="FINAL MINUTE"}，采用粗体压缩体育字体，带有粗糙纹理。下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="90 MINUTES. ONE MOMENT THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING."}，其中“CHANGES EVERYTHING”以金色高亮显示。在最底部，添加一行微小的制作人员名单：{argument name="credit line" default="CRAFTED WITH GPT IMAGE 2 + SEEDANCE 2.0"}。

视觉风格：高级电影感足球海报，超细节，照片级真实感，深色 HDR 分级，浅景深，雨滴颗粒，火花，烟雾，球场泛光灯，爆炸性的金色五彩纸屑，对角线编辑构图，清晰的排版，强烈的运动感，病毒式体育社交媒体美学。

约束：使用 8 个带编号的面板加上单个大型英雄肖像面板。保持所有文字清晰、大写并融入设计中。不要添加额外的项目编号、额外的球队、水印、应用 UI 或不相关的标志。保持竖版社交媒体海报格式和戏剧性的世界杯最后一分钟氛围。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Neuromancer Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克《神经漫游者》时尚海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical cyberpunk fashion editorial poster for {argument name="book title" default="NEUROMANCER"}, with a full-body male model posed in front of enormous glowing letterforms spelling the title behind him.

Canvas: Portrait 4:5 poster, glossy cinematic lighting, high resolution, dark blue, black, white, and electric cyan palette. Low camera angle looking upward, making the figure heroic and towering.

Main subject: One young adult male cyberpunk model standing center, slightly leaning back with one hand in his pocket. His face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur/mosaic censor block. He has messy dark hair and wears a full black futuristic outfit: 6 visible outfit pieces total — shiny cropped leather jacket with high collar, black layered shirt, belted utility pants with zipper pockets and straps, black belt with metal buckle, tall lace-up combat boots, and small hanging strap/accessory details. Wet, reflective, high-fashion material textures.

Background and layout: Split background with a pale cracked concrete wall on the left and a deep smoky blue-black digital void on the right. Behind the model, use huge vertical neon-outline typography, partially hidden by the figure, forming the word from {argument name="giant background letters" default="CASE"}; the letters are white on the left and electric blue on the right, glowing strongly with bloom. Add blue fog at floor level and a wet reflective floor mirroring the boots and neon.

Poster text: At the bottom center, place wide-spaced glowing title text: {argument name="bottom title text" default="NEUROMANCER"}. Add thin horizontal rule lines and tiny sci-fi footer captions. Include exactly 5 bottom footer text groups: left tiny code “NM-024 DATA COLLECTION”, center-left “//”, center “SPRING / SUMMER 2025 COLLECTION”, center-right “SYSTEM COLLAPSE USER AWAKENS”, and far-right “NEUROMANCER © ALL RIGHTS RESERVED”.

Micro interface details: Add exactly 14 small HUD text/graphic elements around the margins: 1 small crosshair at top left, 1 block reading “DATA RUNNER // USER ID: CASE_024”, 1 coordinate block, 1 location block reading “SEOUL / NEW HONGDAE / DISTRICT”, 1 vertical dash scale, 1 block reading “4TH CORPORATE WAR SURVIVOR”, 1 circular schematic line graphic, 1 system-code block reading “SYS-8X 87 A2”, 1 globe icon, 1 crosshair at top right, 1 city-list block reading “NEO-TOKYO / SEOUL / CHIBA CITY / NEW YORK / LONDON”, 1 vertical Asian-character label with “//0024”, 1 small square outline icon, and 1 block reading “YOUTH / ISOLATION / INTERFACE / REALITY / GLITCH”. Keep all micro text tiny and decorative, like a futuristic data dossier.

Style: Photorealistic editorial fashion photography mixed with graphic design, dystopian cyberpunk book-cover aesthetic, neon rim light, volumetric haze, scratched concrete, subtle data-chart lines, high contrast, sharp boot detail, dramatic blue glow. Avoid extra people, avoid readable brand logos, avoid changing the censored face effect.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="book title" default="NEUROMANCER"} 创建一张竖版赛博朋克时尚编辑海报，模特为全身男性，姿态位于其身后拼写出标题的巨大发光字体前。

画布：4:5 竖版海报，光泽感电影级布光，高分辨率，深蓝、黑、白与电光青色调。低机位仰拍视角，使人物显得高大且具有英雄气概。

主体：一位年轻的男性赛博朋克模特站在中心，身体微向后倾，单手插兜。他的面部被刻意用柔和的方形模糊/马赛克遮挡。他留着凌乱的深色短发，身着全黑未来感服装：共 6 件可见服装单品——高领亮面皮夹克、黑色叠穿衬衫、带有拉链口袋和绑带的工装裤、带金属扣的黑色腰带、高帮系带作战靴以及细小的挂带/配饰细节。湿润、反光的高级时装材质纹理。

背景与布局：背景采用左右分割设计，左侧为浅色裂纹混凝土墙，右侧为深邃烟雾状的蓝黑色数字虚空。在模特身后，使用巨大的垂直霓虹轮廓字体，部分被人物遮挡，组成 {argument name="giant background letters" default="CASE"} 字样；字母左侧为白色，右侧为电光蓝色，带有强烈的辉光效果。在地板高度添加蓝色雾气，湿润的反光地面映衬出靴子和霓虹灯的倒影。

海报文字：在底部中心放置宽间距的发光标题文字：{argument name="bottom title text" default="NEUROMANCER"}。添加细水平线和微小的科幻风格页脚说明。包含 5 组底部页脚文字：左侧微型代码“NM-024 DATA COLLECTION”，中左侧“//”，中心“SPRING / SUMMER 2025 COLLECTION”，中右侧“SYSTEM COLLAPSE USER AWAKENS”，最右侧“NEUROMANCER © ALL RIGHTS RESERVED”。

微型界面细节：在边缘处添加 14 个微型 HUD 文字/图形元素：左上角 1 个十字准星，1 个显示“DATA RUNNER // USER ID: CASE_024”的方块，1 个坐标块，1 个显示“SEOUL / NEW HONGDAE / DISTRICT”的位置块，1 个垂直刻度尺，1 个显示“4TH CORPORATE WAR SURVIVOR”的方块，1 个圆形示意图线条图形，1 个显示“SYS-8X 87 A2”的系统代码块，1 个地球仪图标，右上角 1 个十字准星，1 个显示“NEO-TOKYO / SEOUL / CHIBA CITY / NEW YORK / LONDON”的城市列表块，1 个带有“//0024”的垂直亚洲字符标签，1 个小方形轮廓图标，以及 1 个显示“YOUTH / ISOLATION / INTERFACE / REALITY / GLITCH”的方块。所有微型文字保持细小且具装饰性，如同未来派数据档案。

风格：照片级真实的时尚编辑摄影与平面设计相结合，反乌托邦赛博朋克书籍封面美学，霓虹轮廓光，体积雾，划痕混凝土，微妙的数据图表线条，高对比度，清晰的靴子细节，戏剧性的蓝色辉光。避免出现额外人物，避免出现可识别的品牌 Logo，避免更改被遮挡的面部效果。

templates.title: Flash Photo School Hallway Uniform

titleLocalized.zh: 闪光灯摄影风格：学校走廊制服照

templates.prompt: Create a gritty flash-photography candid photo in a dim high school hallway, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio, with a teenage student in a dark Korean/Japanese-inspired school uniform posing full-body beside a long wall of pale blue-gray metal lockers covered with stickers, labels, tape marks, doodles, and scratches. The main subject is centered slightly right, leaning one hand against the lockers with one leg crossed in front, wearing {argument name="school uniform style" default="black blazer with gold buttons, white button-up shirt, loose black necktie with a crest, dark pleated mini skirt"}, black thigh-high socks, chunky black-and-white platform sneakers, and carrying a glossy black shoulder bag with silver chain straps. She has {argument name="hair color and style" default="long messy black hair with small white hair clips"}; her face is intentionally anonymized by a square gray blur. The corridor recedes deeply into the background with fluorescent ceiling lights, reflective gray floor tiles, scattered papers on the floor, and groups of other students in uniforms standing and talking on the left side, their faces also soft or blurred. On the right edge include a red fire extinguisher and a Korean emergency sign with a downward arrow. Use a raw 2000s digital-camera look: harsh direct flash, cool desaturated colors, strong shadows, slight grain, imperfect composition, realistic school clutter, no glamour retouching, documentary snapshot mood. Add a small subtle watermark-like text reading {argument name="watermark text" default="PromptHero"} in the bottom-left corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有粗粝感的闪光灯抓拍照片，场景位于昏暗的高中走廊，采用 2:3 纵向比例。画面中，一名身着韩式/日式风格深色校服的青少年学生全身出镜，倚靠在贴满贴纸、标签、胶带痕迹、涂鸦和划痕的浅蓝灰色金属储物柜长墙旁。主体略微偏右居中，单手撑在储物柜上，双腿交叉，身穿 {argument name="school uniform style" default="黑色西装外套配金色纽扣、白色衬衫、带有徽章的宽松黑色领带、深色百褶短裙"}，搭配黑色过膝袜和黑白厚底运动鞋，肩背带有银色链条的亮面黑色单肩包。她留着 {argument name="hair color and style" default="凌乱的长黑发，别着几个白色小发夹"}；面部刻意使用方形灰色模糊处理以隐藏身份。走廊向背景深处延伸，配有天花板荧光灯、反光的灰色地砖、散落在地的纸张，左侧有成群结队谈话的学生，他们的面部同样经过柔化或模糊处理。右侧边缘包含一个红色灭火器和一个带有向下箭头的韩语紧急出口标志。采用 2000 年代数码相机的原始质感：强烈的直射闪光灯、冷色调、高对比阴影、轻微噪点、不完美的构图、真实的校园杂乱感，拒绝过度修图，营造纪录片式的抓拍氛围。在左下角添加一行细微的类似水印的文字 {argument name="watermark text" default="PromptHero"}。

templates.title: Pastel Kitten Café iPhone Lock Screen

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调小猫咖啡馆 iPhone 锁屏壁纸

templates.prompt:
Create a vertical 9:16 ultra-soft iPhone lock screen wallpaper showcase in a dreamy pastel iOS aesthetic. Show a translucent rounded-corner iPhone screen floating over a heavily blurred warm pink-and-cream background. Inside the phone, paint a soft Japanese watercolor café window scene in flat 2D with glowing morning sunlight, peach, blush pink, ivory, and honey-gold tones. The main subject is an adorable fluffy kitten with cream-and-gray fur, huge glossy eyes, tiny pink nose, paws resting on a wooden windowsill, wearing a pink bow on one ear and a pink collar with a small heart charm. Surround the kitten with a cozy dessert still life: exactly 8 visible food and drink items including 3 stacked pastel macarons on a small stand, 1 strawberry jam jar, 1 whipped cream dessert cup with strawberry, 1 croissant plate with 2 croissants counted as one plate item, 1 pink whipped drink or dessert cup, and 1 small jar or cup at the lower left. Add exactly 2 floral décor elements: a ceramic pitcher bouquet of small white flowers and pink roses on the left, and tiny white blossoms near the right edge. Include a softly blurred street or bakery exterior beyond the window for depth.

Overlay realistic white iOS lock screen UI on top of the illustration: status bar with Chinese carrier text “中国移动” on the left, cellular bars, “5G”, and battery icon on the right; small lock icon centered near the top; date text “Wednesday 7 September”; very large time “12:57”; a small headphone battery widget on the left reading “50 %” and “WH-1000XM5” with a short progress line; a circular activity-style widget in the center; a “50%” text widget on the right with tiny sparkle marks; bottom flashlight and camera circular buttons; and a thin white home indicator bar. Use frosted glass transparency for the phone frame and UI, soft bloom, gentle haze, delicate bokeh, rounded Apple-inspired minimal design, healing atmosphere, no harsh outlines, no extra text, no watermark. Allow customization of {argument name="time" default="12:57"}, {argument name="date" default="Wednesday 7 September"}, {argument name="main animal" default="fluffy cream-and-gray kitten"}, {argument name="dessert theme" default="pink café pastries and macarons"}, and {argument name="color palette" default="peach blush ivory honey gold"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个 9:16 竖屏的超柔和 iPhone 锁屏壁纸展示，呈现梦幻般的柔和 iOS 美学。画面展示一个半透明圆角 iPhone 屏幕悬浮在模糊的暖粉色与奶油色背景之上。手机内部绘制一幅柔和的日式水彩咖啡馆窗景，采用扁平 2D 风格，带有明媚的晨光，色调为桃色、腮红粉、象牙白和蜂蜜金。主体是一只可爱的毛茸茸小猫，拥有奶油灰色的皮毛、明亮的大眼睛、粉色小鼻子，爪子搭在木质窗台上，耳朵上戴着粉色蝴蝶结，脖子上戴着带有小爱心吊坠的粉色项圈。小猫周围环绕着温馨的甜点静物：共 8 个可见的食物和饮品，包括小支架上的 3 个叠放马卡龙、1 罐草莓果酱、1 杯带草莓的奶油甜点、1 个放有 2 个可颂的面包盘（计为 1 个盘子项目）、1 杯粉色奶油饮品或甜点，以及左下角的一个小罐子或杯子。添加 2 个花卉装饰元素：左侧是一个装有小白花和粉玫瑰的陶瓷花瓶，右侧边缘附近有一些细小的白色花朵。窗外呈现模糊的街道或面包店外观，以增加深度感。

在插图上方叠加逼真的白色 iOS 锁屏 UI：状态栏左侧显示中文运营商文字“中国移动”，右侧显示信号格、“5G”和电池图标；顶部中央有一个小锁图标；日期文字“9 月 7 日 星期三”；超大时间“12:57”；左侧有一个小型耳机电池小组件，显示“50 %”和“WH-1000XM5”以及一条短进度线；中央有一个圆形活动类小组件；右侧有一个显示“50%”的文字小组件，带有细小的闪光标记；底部为手电筒和相机圆形按钮；以及一条细长的白色主屏幕指示条。手机边框和 UI 使用磨砂玻璃透明效果，带有柔和的光晕、轻微的雾气、细腻的焦外成像，采用苹果风格的简约设计，营造治愈氛围，无生硬轮廓，无额外文字，无水印。支持自定义 {argument name="time" default="12:57"}、{argument name="date" default="9 月 7 日 星期三"}、{argument name="main animal" default="毛茸茸的奶油灰色小猫"}、{argument name="dessert theme" default="粉色咖啡馆糕点和马卡龙"} 以及 {argument name="color palette" default="桃色、腮红粉、象牙白、蜂蜜金"}。

templates.title: Anime Duo School Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫双人校园海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2D anime-style duo movie poster featuring exactly 2 teenage characters in a dramatic school-universe setting at golden-hour sunset. The first character is {argument name="male character name" default="Danny"}, a short, stocky boy standing on the left in a confident pose, pointing toward the viewer with one hand and keeping the other hand in his pocket; he has messy dark curly hair, a black oversized T-shirt with a colorful graffiti smiley face and crown graphic, olive cargo pants with a chain accessory, chunky high-top sneakers in purple, orange, white, and black, and a silver chain necklace. The second character is {argument name="female character name" default="Juliet"}, a tall slim girl standing on the right with long flowing red hair, one arm casually resting on the boy’s shoulder, wearing a navy private-school blazer with pink piping and crest, white shirt, pink tie, plaid pleated skirt, white socks, white sneakers, and a navy backpack with pink trim and crest. Both faces should be covered by smooth rectangular skin-toned blur masks, as if censored, while the rest of the characters remain highly detailed. Background: a romantic urban academy campus with a clocktower on the left, a school flag bearing an ornate monogram, city skyscrapers in the distance, a canal or river reflecting warm light, cherry blossom trees, and pink petals drifting through the foreground. Lighting and style: cinematic anime illustration, polished poster art, warm orange-pink sunset sky with glowing clouds, rim lighting around the characters, detailed clothing folds, saturated colors, high contrast, soft atmospheric depth, subtle film-poster composition. Bottom typography: include exactly 2 lines of text. The first line is a large title, “{argument name="poster title" default="DANNY & JULIET"}”, with “DANNY” in bold yellow-orange dripping graffiti brush lettering, an ampersand in white, and “JULIET” in large pink serif letters with paint splatter texture. The second line is the tagline “{argument name="tagline" default="Chaos meets discipline."}” in smaller mixed yellow, white, and pink lettering with tiny decorative divider ornaments. Keep the poster clean and centered, no extra characters, no extra logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版 2D 动漫风格的双人电影海报，画面中包含 2 名处于戏剧性校园背景下、正值黄金落日时刻的青少年角色。第一位角色是 {argument name="male character name" default="Danny"}，一个身材矮壮的男孩，站在左侧，姿态自信，一只手指向观众，另一只手插在口袋里；他留着凌乱的深色卷发，身穿黑色超大款 T 恤，上面印有彩色涂鸦笑脸和皇冠图案，搭配橄榄色工装裤和链条配饰，脚踩紫色、橙色、白色和黑色相间的厚底高帮运动鞋，颈部佩戴银色项链。第二位角色是 {argument name="female character name" default="Juliet"}，一个高挑苗条的女孩，站在右侧，留着飘逸的红色长发，一只手臂随意地搭在男孩的肩膀上，身穿带有粉色滚边和徽章的海军蓝私立学校西装外套，内搭白衬衫，系粉色领带，穿着格子百褶裙、白袜、白球鞋，背着带有粉色饰边和徽章的海军蓝背包。两个角色的面部均应被平滑的矩形肤色模糊遮罩覆盖，如同被审查一样，而角色的其余部分保持高度细节化。背景：浪漫的城市学院校园，左侧有一座钟楼，学校旗帜上印有华丽的字母组合，远处是城市摩天大楼，运河或河流反射着温暖的光芒，樱花树盛开，粉色的花瓣在前景中飘落。灯光与风格：电影级动漫插画，精致的海报艺术，温暖的橙粉色落日天空，云朵发光，角色边缘有轮廓光，衣物褶皱细节丰富，色彩饱和，高对比度，柔和的大气深度，微妙的电影海报构图。底部排版：包含 2 行文字。第一行是大标题“{argument name="poster title" default="DANNY & JULIET"}”，其中“DANNY”采用粗体黄橙色滴落涂鸦笔刷字体，“&”为白色，“JULIET”为带有油漆飞溅质感的大号粉色衬线字体。第二行是标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Chaos meets discipline."}”，采用较小的黄色、白色和粉色混合字体，并带有微小的装饰性分隔符。保持海报整洁且居中，不要添加额外角色、额外标志或水印。

templates.title: Goth Girl by City Window

titleLocalized.zh: 城市窗边的哥特女孩

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 semi-realistic anime-style illustration of a goth/alt young woman lounging in a bright high-rise apartment by tall floor-to-ceiling windows, with a sunny blue sky, fluffy clouds, and a distant city skyline outside. The woman has {argument name="hair color" default="long wet-looking black hair"}, very detailed but not overly frizzy strands, pale skin, and her face intentionally covered by a soft rectangular blur/censor block. She wears a black crop camisole with a small white cross-like emblem, loose black cargo pants, a black belt with a silver buckle and dangling chain, a black choker with a small pendant, multiple ear piercings, black nail polish, and an oversized black puffer jacket slipping off her shoulders. Her pose is relaxed and slightly reclined on a white couch, one knee raised close to the camera, one hand resting near a small round table. Add a large intricate black tattoo sleeve on her visible upper arm. The room is sunlit with strong natural light, soft shadows, and crisp highlights. Include exactly 6 notable background/foreground objects: 1 large wall poster reading “DON’T OVERTHINK SHIT.” with tiny text below, 1 small pink-purple neon heart sign on the wall, 2 small square photo prints below the neon sign, 1 black Monster Energy can on the table, and 1 smartphone with a black-and-purple graphic case on the table. Add large green plant leaves entering from the upper right. Use a stylish Japanese digital-art look, high-detail fabric folds, glossy hair, clean linework, realistic lighting, and a cool urban bedroom atmosphere. Keep the composition cropped like a candid fashion portrait, no watermark, no extra characters, no extra text beyond the poster and tiny wall details.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 垂直构图的半写实动漫风格插画，描绘一位哥特/另类风格的年轻女性，她正慵懒地待在明亮的高层公寓里，身旁是高大的落地窗，窗外是晴朗的蓝天、蓬松的云朵和远处的城市天际线。女性拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长款湿发感的黑色头发"}，发丝细节丰富但不过分毛躁，皮肤白皙，面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊/遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身穿黑色短款吊带背心，上面有一个白色的小十字形徽章，搭配宽松的黑色工装裤、带有银色扣环和悬挂链条的黑色腰带、带有小吊坠的黑色颈圈，佩戴多个耳环，涂着黑色指甲油，肩上滑落一件超大款黑色羽绒服。她的姿势放松，斜靠在白色沙发上，一只膝盖抬起靠近镜头，一只手放在小圆桌旁。在她可见的上臂处添加一个大面积且复杂的黑色纹身袖。房间阳光充足，自然光强烈，阴影柔和，高光清晰。画面中需包含 6 个显著的背景/前景物体：1 张写有“DON’T OVERTHINK SHIT.”的大型墙面海报（下方有微小文字），墙上 1 个粉紫色的小型心形霓虹灯牌，霓虹灯牌下方 2 张小方形照片打印件，桌上 1 罐黑色 Monster Energy 饮料，以及桌上 1 部带有黑紫色图案手机壳的智能手机。从右上角加入大片绿色植物叶片。采用时尚的日系数字艺术风格，展现高细节的布料褶皱、光泽感发丝、干净的线条、写实的灯光以及酷炫的都市卧室氛围。构图保持类似抓拍时尚肖像的裁剪效果，无水印，无额外角色，除海报和墙面细节文字外，不包含任何额外文字。

templates.title: Indoor Arena Cheerleader Performance

titleLocalized.zh: 室内体育馆啦啦队表演

templates.prompt: Create a realistic high-resolution sports event photograph of {argument name="team name" default="BEARS"} cheerleaders performing during a basketball game inside a large indoor arena. Show exactly 7 adult female cheerleaders: 2 central foreground cheerleaders standing very close together with their backs and shoulders angled toward the camera, wearing matching navy, white, and red cropped cheer tops and pleated mini skirts; 2 main jumpers at the far left and far right with arms raised in a V pose, one leg bent behind or lifted, white sneakers and white socks; 1 background cheerleader near center-left mid-jump; 1 partial cheerleader cropped at the far left edge; and 1 small distant cheerleader standing near the back of the court. The uniforms should be navy blue with red and white trim, pleated skirts, white athletic shoes, and red-white-blue hair bows, with the word {argument name="uniform text" default="BEARS"} clearly printed on the front of the visible tops. Set the scene on a glossy wooden basketball court with court lines and reflections, crowded stadium seating, overhead steel trusses, bright arena lights, and blue advertising boards in the background. Use dynamic action photography, wide-angle perspective, shallow depth of field, natural indoor lighting, crisp fabric detail, energetic game-day atmosphere, and realistic motion poses. Keep all performers clearly adult, avoid logos other than the customizable team text, and do not add extra people in the foreground.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的高分辨率体育赛事照片，展示 {argument name="team name" default="BEARS"} 啦啦队在大型室内体育馆的篮球比赛期间进行表演。画面中需包含 7 名成年女性啦啦队员：2 名位于前景中央的啦啦队员背对镜头，肩部微侧，紧靠在一起，身穿海军蓝、白色和红色相间的露脐啦啦队上衣及百褶短裙；最左侧和最右侧各有 1 名主要跳跃队员，双臂举成 V 字型，一条腿向后弯曲或抬起，穿着白色运动鞋和白色短袜；左中位置有 1 名正在跳跃的背景啦啦队员；最左侧边缘有 1 名被截断的啦啦队员；球场后方还有 1 名较小的远景啦啦队员。制服应为海军蓝色，配有红白饰边、百褶裙、白色运动鞋和红白蓝相间的发带，可见的上衣正面需清晰印有 {argument name="uniform text" default="BEARS"} 字样。场景设定在带有球场线条和倒影的光滑木质篮球场上，背景为拥挤的体育馆看台、头顶的钢制桁架、明亮的场馆灯光以及蓝色的广告项目。采用动态动作摄影、广角视角、浅景深、自然室内光线、清晰的织物细节、充满活力的比赛日氛围以及逼真的动态姿势。确保所有表演者均为成年人，除可自定义的团队文字外，请勿添加其他标志，且不要在前景中添加额外人物。
