templates.title: Modern MPLUS Link UI Redesign

titleLocalized.zh: MPLUS Link 现代 UI 重新设计

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source UI, redesign the Teams-like internal/external collaboration system into a cleaner, more modern product mockup while preserving the MPLUS Link brand, the dark navy left sidebar navigation, and the overall set of app functions. Create a polished 2-column by 3-row presentation showing exactly 6 redesigned screens: 1) a welcome/login landing screen with a large hero card, Japanese headline {argument name="headline text" default="社外パートナー連携を、招待制の専用ワークスペースで一元化"}, login tabs/buttons, and a realistic desktop-monitor hero image; 2) a project bridge chat screen with right-aligned chat cards, action chips, and a message composer; 3) a team list screen simplified into two clean team cards; 4) a materials/document list screen with upload controls, search/filter area, and file rows; 5) a shared collaboration room screen titled {argument name="room title" default="MPI 共同開発ルーム"} with a project overview card and compact member/status list; 6) a user management screen titled {argument name="admin title" default="ユーザー管理"} with user rows and an empty detail panel. Make the new mockups much more spacious than the reference: fewer table rows, larger margins, softer dividers, pale blue-gray backgrounds, white rounded cards, subtle shadows, and small blue/green accent buttons. Keep the Japanese enterprise SaaS feel and dummy-data nature, but remove the dense micromanaged tables and replace them with simplified, presentable mock UI suitable for a design-improvement comparison. Use brand name {argument name="brand name" default="MPLUS Link"} in the sidebar, keep the sidebar consistent on every screen, and avoid adding unrelated features, watermarks, or decorative clutter.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为源 UI，将类似 Teams 的内部/外部协作系统重新设计为更简洁、更现代的产品模型，同时保留 MPLUS Link 品牌、深蓝色左侧导航栏以及整体应用功能。制作一个精致的 2 列 3 行演示，展示 6 个重新设计的屏幕：1) 带有大型主视觉卡片、日语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="社外パートナー連携を、招待制の専用ワークスペースで一元化"}、登录选项卡/按钮以及逼真的桌面显示器主视觉图像的欢迎/登录落地页；2) 带有右对齐聊天卡片、操作芯片和消息编辑器的项目桥接聊天屏幕；3) 简化为两个简洁团队卡片的团队列表屏幕；4) 带有上传控件、搜索/筛选区域和文件行的资料/文档列表屏幕；5) 标题为 {argument name="room title" default="MPI 共同開発ルーム"} 的共享协作室屏幕，包含项目概览卡片和紧凑的成员/状态列表；6) 标题为 {argument name="admin title" default="ユーザー管理"} 的用户管理屏幕，包含用户行和空白详情面板。使新模型比参考图更宽敞：减少表格行数、增加边距、使用更柔和的分隔线、淡蓝灰色背景、白色圆角卡片、细腻的阴影以及小巧的蓝/绿色强调按钮。保持日本企业级 SaaS 的质感和虚拟数据属性，但去除密集且琐碎的表格，取而代之以适合设计改进对比的简化、美观的 UI 模型。在侧边栏中使用品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="MPLUS Link"}，确保侧边栏在每个屏幕上保持一致，并避免添加无关功能、水印或装饰性杂物。

templates.title: Disposable Film Sailor Cosplay Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 一次性胶片风格水手服 Cosplay 人像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic candid 35mm disposable-film style street portrait of a cute young woman in {argument name="outfit" default="a Japanese navy-and-white sailor school uniform cosplay with a short-sleeve white blouse, navy sailor collar with white stripes, navy ribbon bow, and navy pleated mini skirt"} standing shyly outside a small neighborhood cafe on a sunny Japanese residential street. She is centered full-body from mid-thigh up, holding both hands together in front of her while gripping the light gray handles of a dark navy school bag at the bottom edge of the frame. Her {argument name="hair style" default="medium-length brown hair, softly messy and half tied back with loose strands"} catches warm sunlight, and her face is covered by a large soft square blur/mosaic for privacy. The setting includes a narrow asphalt street on the left with a red-tinted road lane, curb, utility pole, low concrete walls, houses, plants, and bright summer greenery; on the right is a cozy cafe entrance with wooden glass doors, a wooden chair, potted shrubs, a service window, cups and cafe objects visible inside, and warm interior lights. Use natural daylight, gentle shadows, warm nostalgic color grading, slight film grain, realistic skin and fabric texture, casual snapshot composition, vertical 4:5 framing, shallow-to-medium depth of field, and an authentic Fujifilm disposable camera look. No text, no watermark, no extra people as main subjects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的 35mm 一次性胶片感街头抓拍人像，主角是一位可爱的年轻女性，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="日本海军风蓝白水手校服，短袖白衬衫，带有白色条纹的海军风水手领，海军蓝丝带蝴蝶结，以及海军蓝百褶短裙"}，羞涩地站在日本住宅区街道旁的一家小型社区咖啡馆外。画面采用中景构图，从大腿中部以上拍摄全身，她双手合十握住深蓝色书包的浅灰色提手，书包位于画面底部边缘。她的 {argument name="hair style" default="中长棕色头发，略显凌乱，半扎起并留有几缕碎发"} 在温暖的阳光下闪烁，面部经过柔和的方形模糊/马赛克处理以保护隐私。场景包括左侧狭窄的沥青街道，带有红色的车道线、路缘石、电线杆、低矮的混凝土墙、房屋、植物和明亮的夏季绿植；右侧是温馨的咖啡馆入口，配有木质玻璃门、木椅、盆栽灌木、服务窗口，透过窗户可以看到杯子和咖啡馆陈设，室内灯光温暖。采用自然日光、柔和阴影、温暖的怀旧色调、轻微的胶片颗粒感、真实的皮肤和织物纹理、随意的抓拍构图、竖向 4:5 画幅、浅至中等的景深，呈现地道的 Fujifilm 一次性相机质感。画面无文字，无水印，无其他人物作为主体。

templates.title: Disposable Camera Magical Girl Cosplay

titleLocalized.zh: 一次性胶片相机风格魔法少女 Cosplay

templates.prompt: Create a nostalgic disposable-camera style night portrait of a young woman cosplaying as a magical girl in a pink-and-white idol costume, photographed outdoors in a dark park or garden with warm fairy lights wrapped around trees in the background. She stands centered in a three-quarter waist-up pose, holding a heart-shaped magical wand with a gold handle and pink heart ornament in both gloved hands near her chest. Her outfit is glossy satin and organza: a pastel pink flared skirt, white iridescent bodice, large pink bow with a red heart jewel at the chest, frilly puff sleeves, lace trim, translucent ruffled overskirt panels, white satin gloves with pink lace cuffs, and a matching headband with a large pale pink bow. She has long dark wavy hair falling over her shoulders, but her face is intentionally covered by a soft square privacy blur. Use harsh direct flash, high ISO grain, slight underexposure, warm orange bokeh lights, deep black shadows, candid amateur cosplay event photography, 4:5 vertical composition, realistic fabric shine, slightly imperfect framing, no text or watermark. Customize the costume palette as {argument name="costume colors" default="pastel pink and white"}, the prop as {argument name="magical prop" default="heart-shaped wand"}, the setting as {argument name="night location" default="dark park with fairy lights"}, the camera look as {argument name="camera style" default="disposable film camera flash"}, and the face treatment as {argument name="face treatment" default="soft square privacy blur"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张怀旧的一次性胶片相机风格夜间人像，主角是一位身着粉白配色偶像装的年轻女性，正在进行魔法少女 Cosplay。拍摄地点位于户外昏暗的公园或花园，背景中的树木缠绕着温暖的仙女灯。她以半身像姿势居中站立，戴着手套的双手捧在胸前，握着一支带有金色手柄和粉色心形装饰的心形魔法棒。服装材质为光泽缎面和欧根纱：淡粉色百褶裙、白色虹彩紧身胸衣、胸前饰有红心宝石的大粉色蝴蝶结、荷叶边泡泡袖、蕾丝饰边、半透明褶皱罩裙、白色缎面手套配粉色蕾丝袖口，以及带有大号淡粉色蝴蝶结的配套发带。她留着长长的深色波浪卷发，垂落在肩头，但面部刻意采用了柔和的方形隐私模糊处理。使用强烈的直射闪光灯、高 ISO 噪点、轻微曝光不足、温暖的橙色光斑虚化、深邃的黑色阴影，呈现出抓拍风格的业余 Cosplay 活动摄影效果，4:5 竖构图，逼真的面料光泽，略显随意的构图，无文字或水印。可通过以下参数自定义：{argument name="costume colors" default="淡粉色和白色"}（服装颜色）、{argument name="magical prop" default="心形魔法棒"}（道具）、{argument name="night location" default="带有仙女灯的昏暗公园"}（场景）、{argument name="camera style" default="一次性胶片相机闪光灯"}（相机风格）以及 {argument name="face treatment" default="柔和方形隐私模糊"}（面部处理）。

templates.title: Sound Connects Humanity Poster

titleLocalized.zh: “声音连接人类”海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed vertical music-community poster about sound crossing eras, borders, gender, age, analog media, and digital media, with a luminous fantasy-realism collage of humanity connected by music.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, cinematic ultra-detailed digital painting, warm sunset golds blended with neon blues, purples, and pinks. No margins; fill the entire canvas with layered scenes and glowing musical motion.

Central composition: Place a large radiant white-gold circular burst in the exact center, like a sun made of sound waves and stardust. Over it, set the main Japanese headline {argument name="headline text" default="音で繋がれ"} in large dark navy calligraphic serif characters. Beneath it, place three centered smaller Japanese lines: {argument name="subheading line one" default="時代も国境も性別も年齢も"}, {argument name="subheading line two" default="アナログもデジタルも"}, and {argument name="subheading line three" default="「音」は垣根を超えて届く"}. Keep the text crisp and readable against the glowing center.

Main visual motif: A huge spiral ribbon of light and music notation wraps around the poster from lower left to center, then across the middle and upper right, then back through the bottom. The ribbon contains glowing staff lines, eighth notes, treble-like music symbols, particles, waveform sparks, small app-like music icons, and digital pixels. It should feel like sound physically connecting every scene.

Layout: Build exactly 7 major connected scene zones around the central headline:
1. Upper left prehistoric / tribal campfire music: people dancing, drumming, singing around a fire under a starry sky.
2. Upper center ancient classical world: ruins resembling Greek or Roman columns, musicians with cello, flute, hand drums, and traditional string instruments under a golden sunset.
3. Upper right East Asian historical music scene: Japanese temple roofs, pagoda, cherry blossoms, shamisen players, kimono-like clothing, and lantern glow.
4. Middle left ancient desert / world heritage scene: pyramids in the background, musicians with guitar-like and percussion instruments, travelers and dancers.
5. Middle center modern global city concert: skyline, high-rises, diverse band members, singers, guitarists, saxophone, brass, and crowd energy.
6. Middle right futuristic digital DJ / electronic music scene: DJ at a glowing mixer, laptop-like screens, neon equalizers, holographic icons, synthesizer lights, and cyberpunk purple-blue ambience.
7. Bottom global community gathering: children, adults, elders, people of different cultures and abilities sitting and standing in a circle, including a wheelchair user, acoustic guitars, headphones, a laptop music workstation, city lights, temples, domes, and a final row of silhouettes holding hands along the horizon.

People and instruments: Show a large diverse ensemble of roughly 70 visible people total across the poster, mixing ages from children to elders, different skin tones, body types, genders, historical costumes, modern streetwear, traditional clothing, and futuristic outfits. Include exactly 16 clearly featured instrument or music-making categories: hand drums, frame drums, flute, cello, shamisen, lute-like instrument, acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass guitar, saxophone, trumpet, violin, microphone singing, DJ controller, laptop digital audio workstation, and headphones. Some faces may be small or impressionistic, but the mood must be joyful, communal, and inclusive.

Style: Epic fantasy realism meets Japanese festival poster and generative-AI music community art. Extremely dense, ornate, and luminous; painterly yet sharp; dramatic sky gradients; sparkling particles; cinematic rim light; rich historical detail; neon digital overlays; sweeping depth from foreground to distant skyline. Use vibrant contrast between ancient firelight, sunset gold, and futuristic cyan-magenta glow.

Constraints: Do not leave empty space except for the central text glow. Keep all typography in Japanese exactly as specified. Avoid logos, watermarks, brand names, random extra text, malformed music notation dominating the headline, or horror/dark dystopian mood. The final image should communicate: sound connects everyone beyond time, nations, gender, age, analog, and digital.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张细节极其丰富的竖版音乐社区海报，主题为声音跨越时代、国界、性别、年龄、模拟媒介与数字媒介，通过发光的奇幻现实主义拼贴画，展现人类因音乐而紧密相连。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，电影级超精细数字绘画，温暖的夕阳金与霓虹蓝、紫、粉色交织。无边距；用分层场景和发光的音乐动效填满整个画布。

中心构图：在正中心放置一个巨大的放射状白金色圆形光晕，如同由声波和星尘组成的太阳。在其上方，设置主要的日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="音で繋がれ"}，使用深海军蓝色的书法衬线字体。在标题下方，居中放置三行较小的日文副标题：{argument name="subheading line one" default="時代も国境も性別も年齢も"}，{argument name="subheading line two" default="アナログもデジタルも"}，以及 {argument name="subheading line three" default="「音」は垣根を超えて届く"}。确保文字在发光的中心背景下清晰易读。

主要视觉元素：一条巨大的光与乐谱螺旋丝带从左下角绕向中心，穿过中部和右上角，再回到底部。丝带中包含发光的五线谱、八分音符、高音谱号类音乐符号、粒子、波形火花、小型应用类音乐图标及数字像素。它应给人一种声音在物理层面连接每一个场景的质感。

布局：在中心标题周围构建 7 个相互连接的主要场景区域：
1. 左上角史前/部落篝火音乐：人们在星空下的篝火旁跳舞、击鼓、歌唱。
2. 上方中心古代古典世界：类似希腊或罗马柱的遗迹，音乐家在金色夕阳下演奏大提琴、长笛、手鼓及传统弦乐器。
3. 右上角东亚历史音乐场景：日本寺庙屋顶、宝塔、樱花、三味线演奏者、和服风格服饰及灯笼光芒。
4. 中左侧古代沙漠/世界遗产场景：背景为金字塔，音乐家演奏吉他类和打击乐器，伴有旅行者和舞者。
5. 中间中心现代全球城市演唱会：天际线、高楼大厦、多元化的乐队成员、歌手、吉他手、萨克斯风、铜管乐器及人群的活力。
6. 中右侧未来主义数字 DJ/电子音乐场景：DJ 在发光的调音台前，配有笔记本电脑式屏幕、霓虹均衡器、全息图标、合成器灯光及赛博朋克风格的紫蓝色氛围。
7. 底部全球社区聚会：儿童、成人、长者，不同文化背景和能力的人们（包括轮椅使用者）围坐或站立成一个圆圈，配有木吉他、耳机、笔记本电脑音乐工作站、城市灯光、寺庙、圆顶建筑，以及地平线上手拉手的一排剪影。

人物与乐器：海报中总共展示约 70 位多元化的人物，涵盖从儿童到长者的不同年龄段、不同肤色、体型、性别，身着历史服饰、现代街头服饰、传统服装及未来主义装束。包含 16 类明确的乐器或音乐制作类别：手鼓、框鼓、长笛、大提琴、三味线、琵琶类乐器、木吉他、电吉他、贝斯、萨克斯风、小号、小提琴、麦克风演唱、DJ 控制器、笔记本数字音频工作站及耳机。部分面孔可以较小或采用印象派手法，但整体氛围必须是欢快、社区化且包容的。

风格：史诗般的奇幻现实主义与日式节日海报及生成式 AI 音乐社区艺术的结合。极其密集、华丽且发光；具有绘画感但线条锐利；戏剧性的天空渐变；闪烁的粒子；电影级的轮廓光；丰富的历史细节；霓虹数字叠加；从前景到远方天际线的深远层次感。在古代火光、夕阳金与未来主义青品红光之间运用鲜明的对比。

限制：除中心文字光晕外，不要留出空白区域。所有日文排版必须严格按照指定内容执行。避免出现标志、水印、品牌名称、随机的额外文字、破坏标题的畸形乐谱，或恐怖/阴暗的反乌托邦氛围。最终图像应传达：声音跨越时间、国家、性别、年龄、模拟与数字，将所有人连接在一起。

templates.title: Cyber Maid Cosplay Flash Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博女仆 Cosplay 闪光灯人像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic disposable-camera-style cosplay portrait of a young adult woman wearing a futuristic white cyber maid costume in a modern high-rise apartment kitchen at night. She stands centered from mid-thigh up, facing the camera, holding a round stainless-steel serving tray with both hands at waist level. Her outfit is glossy white with silver hardware: a white ruffled maid headband, long dark wavy hair, white structured bodice with translucent ruffle shoulder straps, a white choker with a large metal ring, silver chain details, metallic wrist cuffs, an upper-arm band, white apron panel, short layered skirt with translucent frills, and black-and-silver garter-like cyber accessories. Use {argument name="costume color" default="white and silver"} as the main outfit palette and {argument name="hair color" default="long dark brown"} hair. The setting is a sleek stainless-steel kitchen with a range hood and reflective metal backsplash on the right, warm under-cabinet lighting, wood lower cabinets, and a large dark window on the left showing a nighttime city skyline with scattered building lights. The image should feel like an amateur flash photo taken on a compact disposable camera: direct flash, slight grain, warm indoor highlights, high contrast, mild lens distortion, candid cosplay event energy, realistic skin and fabric textures. Keep the composition vertical, intimate, and documentary, with the subject occupying most of the frame. Add a large soft rectangular blur over the face to anonymize identity, while leaving hair, costume, and background visible. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, extra people, or exaggerated fantasy anatomy.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有一次性相机风格的写实 Cosplay 人像，画面中是一位身穿未来感白色赛博女仆装的年轻女性，场景位于现代高层公寓的夜间厨房。她位于画面中央，取景范围从大腿中部到头部，正对镜头，双手在腰部位置托着一个圆形不锈钢托盘。她的服装为亮面白色，配有银色金属配件：白色荷叶边女仆发箍、深色长波浪卷发、白色结构化紧身胸衣配半透明荷叶边肩带、带有大金属环的白色颈圈、银色链条细节、金属腕带、上臂带、白色围裙饰片、带有半透明褶边的短款多层裙，以及黑银配色的赛博风格吊带饰品。使用 {argument name="costume color" default="白色和银色"} 作为服装主色调，并使用 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色长发"}。背景是一个时尚的不锈钢厨房，右侧有抽油烟机和反光金属防溅板，配有温暖的橱柜下照明、木质下橱柜，左侧是一扇巨大的深色窗户，可以看到点缀着建筑灯光的夜间城市天际线。图像应呈现出使用便携式一次性相机拍摄的业余闪光灯照片质感：直射闪光、轻微颗粒感、温暖的室内高光、高对比度、轻微的镜头畸变，以及随性的 Cosplay 活动氛围，并展现真实的皮肤和织物纹理。保持垂直构图，营造亲密且纪实的感觉，主体占据画面大部分空间。在面部添加一个大的柔和矩形模糊效果以隐藏身份，同时保留头发、服装和背景的可见性。避免出现文字、Logo、水印、多余人物或夸张的幻想解剖结构。

templates.title: Luxury Smartwatch Lifestyle Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华智能手表生活方式广告

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury lifestyle advertisement featuring a {argument name="smartwatch model" default="black Apple Watch Ultra-style smartwatch"} worn on the left wrist of a well-groomed adult man. The watch must be the hero object: a rounded-square black case with a dark inactive glass screen, thick rugged bezel, side crown and buttons, and a black leather or textured band with subtle warm brown edge accents; preserve the case shape, band shape, materials, and tactile textures exactly. Show the man's hand resting elegantly on a polished wooden table, fingers extended naturally, with realistic skin pores, veins, knuckles, nails, and soft highlights. He wears a {argument name="suit color" default="deep navy suit"} with a crisp white shirt cuff visible behind the watch. Set the scene in an upscale private lounge or hotel club with warm wood paneling, brown leather armchairs, a side table, soft curtains, a green plant, and glowing table lamps in the blurred background. Use shallow depth of field, warm amber indoor lighting, cinematic bokeh, premium editorial composition, and a close-up three-quarter angle from slightly above the table. Keep the watch sharply focused while the background is softly defocused. No text, no logo emphasis, no extra accessories, no distorted anatomy, no changed watch proportions, no added screen UI.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的奢华生活方式广告，展示一位仪表堂堂的成年男士左手腕上佩戴的 {argument name="smartwatch model" default="黑色 Apple Watch Ultra 风格智能手表"}。手表必须作为核心主体：采用圆角方形黑色表壳，配有深色未点亮的玻璃屏幕、厚实的硬核表圈、侧面表冠和按钮，以及带有细腻暖棕色边缘装饰的黑色皮革或纹理表带；必须精准还原表壳形状、表带形状、材质及触感纹理。展示男士的手优雅地放在抛光的木桌上，手指自然伸展，呈现真实的皮肤毛孔、静脉、指关节、指甲和柔和的高光。他身着 {argument name="suit color" default="深海军蓝西装"}，手表后方可见挺括的白色衬衫袖口。场景设定在高档私人休息室或酒店俱乐部，背景为模糊的温暖木质镶板、棕色皮扶手椅、边桌、柔和的窗帘、绿色植物和发光的台灯。采用浅景深、温暖的琥珀色室内光线、电影级焦外成像、高级编辑构图，以及从桌面上方略微俯视的四分之三特写角度。保持手表清晰对焦，背景柔和虚化。画面中不得包含文字、不得强调 Logo、不得添加额外配饰、不得出现人体结构扭曲、不得改变手表比例、不得添加屏幕 UI。

templates.title: Soft Censored Bridal Kiss Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和遮挡的新娘之吻插画

templates.prompt: Create a delicate vertical romantic anime-style watercolor illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young bride"} and {argument name="partner" default="a pale-haired young man"} standing very close in a sunlit interior, as if about to kiss or sharing a private breath. The bride is shown from behind and slightly in profile, with dark brown hair gathered into a loose low bun, many wispy strands, and an ornate white floral hair ornament with dangling pearl-like beads; she wears a sheer ivory wedding kimono or bridal robe with soft translucent fabric and fine sketched folds. The partner appears on the upper right edge, only partially visible with light blond or silver hair and a gentle lowered face. Cover the central face-contact area with one large opaque square censor block in warm beige, positioned over both faces and spanning the center-right of the image. Use a muted cream, beige, ivory, and pale gold palette, very soft backlighting, dusty sunbeams, faint floral wallpaper or window reflections in the background, and a quiet nostalgic atmosphere suggesting restrained longing and tenderness. The style should be fine-lined, airy, painterly, highly detailed in hair strands and accessories, with low contrast, translucent washes, and no visible text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅细腻的竖版浪漫动漫风格水彩插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻新娘"} 和 {argument name="partner" default="一位浅发青年"} 在阳光明媚的室内近距离站立，仿佛即将亲吻或共享私密气息的场景。新娘以背影及侧面呈现，深棕色长发盘成松散的低发髻，带有许多细碎发丝，佩戴着饰有珍珠般垂坠珠饰的华丽白色花卉发饰；她身着质感轻盈、褶皱细腻的象牙白婚纱和服或礼袍。伴侣出现在右上角边缘，仅露出部分浅金或银色头发及低垂的温和面容。在画面中心两人接触的区域覆盖一个大型不透明米色方形遮挡块，遮住两人的面部，位置横跨画面中右侧。采用柔和的奶油色、米色、象牙白和浅金色调，运用柔和的背光、尘埃般的阳光、背景中隐约的花卉壁纸或窗户倒影，营造出一种含蓄渴望与温柔的静谧怀旧氛围。风格应追求细线条、通透感、绘画性，发丝与配饰细节丰富，低对比度，呈现半透明水彩质感，且画面中不含任何文字或水印。

templates.title: Japanese School Pool Cleaning Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 日本学校泳池清洁场景

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical smartphone photo in the style of a bright Japanese summer beverage commercial, showing {argument name="number of students" default="three"} cheerful high school girls cleaning an outdoor school swimming pool deck on a sunny day. The scene is candid and ultra-realistic, with natural daylight, blue sky, soft white clouds, wet reflective concrete, sparkling water spray, and a fresh youthful atmosphere. All students wear matching Japanese school uniforms: white short-sleeve button-up shirts, loosened navy striped neckties, blue plaid pleated skirts, and they are barefoot on the wet poolside. Count exactly three girls: the center girl is closest to camera, leaning forward while pushing a long-handled deck brush toward the viewer, with a short dark bob haircut and rolled-up sleeves; the left girl stands near a chain-link fence holding a running blue hose, spraying water onto the ground, with a navy school bag hanging from her shoulder and small cute keychains attached; the right girl stands upright with one hand on her waist, holding a cup of iced bubble tea with a straw in the other hand, long dark hair tied back, relaxed confident pose. Include exactly three main cleaning/drink props: one deck brush, one blue hose spraying water, and one bubble tea cup. Add one bright blue plastic bucket at the lower right edge. Background details: turquoise chain-link fence along the left side, school buildings and pool structures in the distance, bright blue swimming pool visible behind the girls. Composition: low eye-level to slightly low-angle full-body shot, 9:16 vertical framing, center subject dominant, left and right girls balancing the composition, shallow but realistic depth of field. Visual style: photorealistic Japanese commercial photography, crisp skin and fabric texture, glossy wet floor reflections, high dynamic range, clean color grading, summery blue-and-white palette, no text, no watermark, no extra people. Faces should be naturally attractive and realistic, with the option to customize {argument name="center hairstyle" default="short dark bob"}, {argument name="left hairstyle" default="dark ponytail"}, {argument name="right hairstyle" default="long dark hair tied back"}, and {argument name="setting" default="outdoor Japanese high school poolside"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版手机摄影图，呈现明亮的日本夏季饮料广告质感，画面展示了 {argument name="number of students" default="三名"} 活泼的高中女生在阳光明媚的日子里清洁户外学校游泳池甲板的场景。画面自然且极具真实感，包含自然日光、蓝天、柔软的白云、湿润的反射混凝土、闪烁的水花以及清新青春的氛围。所有学生均穿着统一的日本校服：白色短袖衬衫、松开的海军蓝条纹领带、蓝色格子百褶裙，且在湿润的池边赤脚站立。画面中必须正好有三名女生：中间的女生距离镜头最近，身体前倾，正向观众方向推着一把长柄甲板刷，留着深色短波波头，袖口卷起；左侧女生站在铁丝网旁，手持正在喷水的蓝色软管，肩上挂着海军蓝书包，包上挂着可爱的小挂件；右侧女生站姿挺拔，一手叉腰，另一只手拿着一杯插着吸管的冰珍珠奶茶，留着深色长发并扎起，姿态轻松自信。包含正好三个主要的清洁/饮料道具：一把甲板刷、一根正在喷水的蓝色软管，以及一杯珍珠奶茶。在右下角边缘添加一个亮蓝色塑料桶。背景细节：左侧沿着铁丝网，远处可见学校建筑和泳池设施，女生身后可见明亮的蓝色游泳池。构图：低视平线至略微仰角的全身照，9:16 竖构图，中间主体突出，左右两侧女生平衡构图，景深浅但真实。视觉风格：写实风格的日本商业摄影，清晰的皮肤和织物纹理，光亮的湿地反射，高动态范围，干净的色彩分级，夏季蓝白色调，无文字，无水印，无无关人员。面部应自然美观且真实，并支持自定义 {argument name="center hairstyle" default="深色短波波头"}、{argument name="left hairstyle" default="深色马尾"}、{argument name="right hairstyle" default="深色长发扎起"} 以及 {argument name="setting" default="户外日本高中泳池边"}。

templates.title: Kawaii Sheep Girl Portal Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱羊角少女传送门漫画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cute vertical four-panel manga comic about a sheep girl and her tiny sheep encountering a magical portal and a cat.

Canvas: Portrait comic page, 768 x 1152 style, warm pastel colors, thin dark brown panel borders, soft cel-shaded anime illustration, cozy slice-of-life fantasy mood. Arrange exactly 4 horizontal panels stacked vertically with narrow white gutters.

Main characters: A chibi sheep-horned girl named {argument name="character name" default="HITSURO"}, with cream-white bobbed hair, curled ram horns on both sides, small pointed elf ears, large brown eyes, a white blouse, pale pink apron with pocket and bow, dark pleated skirt, knee socks, and soft shoes. Her face in the first panel is intentionally obscured by a plain beige rectangular censor block. A tiny fluffy white sheep companion with round black eyes, pink cheeks, small floppy ears, and a stubby tail appears in every panel. A calico cat appears in panels 3 and 4, white with orange and dark brown patches, round eyes, and a playful expression.

Layout and story: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Panel 1: Cozy room interior with wooden floor, bookshelf, bottles, potted plants, framed wall art, curtain, and window. The sheep girl stands on the right facing away/sideways, her face covered by a beige rectangle. The tiny sheep stands on the floor to her left, trembling slightly with motion marks. Add a tall vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right containing {argument name="panel 1 dialogue" default="…揺れてる…ね"}.
2. Panel 2: The wooden floor has cracked open into a glowing jagged hole filled with a purple starry galaxy. The tiny sheep is partly emerging from or leaning over the hole, sparkling. The sheep girl crouches on the right, concerned, reaching toward it. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right containing {argument name="panel 2 dialogue" default="ひつ郎、近づいちゃだめ"}.
3. Panel 3: A vertical oval purple portal opens on the left, filled with a starry night sky and a glowing yellow star. A calico cat leaps out of the portal toward the room, with speed lines radiating dramatically. The tiny sheep stands near the center-right, startled and shaking. The sheep girl stands on the far right, surprised. Include exactly 2 speech bubbles: a small bubble near the cat saying {argument name="cat sound" default="ニャッ"}, and a tall vertical bubble on the right saying {argument name="panel 3 dialogue" default="…どこの子？"}.
4. Panel 4: The portal remains glowing on the left side of the cozy room. The tiny sheep floats or jumps out from the portal while the sheep girl kneels on the right and hugs the calico cat protectively. The cat looks pleased with closed eyes. Small glowing stars sparkle around them, and a few scattered small objects lie on the floor, such as a spool, coin-like circles, a small cloth, and a tiny container. Add a tall vertical speech bubble on the right containing Japanese text meaning “Hey, stop that,” using 「こら、やめなさい」.

Visual style: Soft kawaii manga, rounded character proportions, expressive eyes, cream and beige room palette, gentle brown line art, pastel purple magical glow, subtle sparkles, clean readable speech bubbles with vertical Japanese text. Keep the page wholesome and humorous.

Constraints: Include exactly 4 panels, exactly 3 recurring characters total across the story: the sheep girl, the tiny sheep, and the calico cat. Count the major repeated elements as follows: 4 speech bubbles total on the right side, 1 small cat sound bubble, 2 magical portal/hole events before the final panel, and 1 beige face-obscuring rectangle in the first panel only. Do not add extra panels, extra characters, watermarks, logos, or narration boxes.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一部可爱的竖版四格漫画，讲述羊角少女和她的小绵羊偶遇魔法传送门与猫咪的故事。

画布：竖版漫画页面，768 x 1152 风格，温暖的柔和色调，深棕色细边框，柔和的赛璐珞动漫插画，温馨的日常奇幻氛围。将 4 个横向画格垂直堆叠，中间留有窄小的白色间隙。

主要角色：一名名为 {argument name="character name" default="HITSURO"} 的 Q 版羊角少女，留着奶油白色的波波头，两侧长着卷曲的公羊角，有着尖尖的小精灵耳朵、棕色大眼睛，身穿白色衬衫、带有口袋和蝴蝶结的淡粉色围裙、深色百褶裙、过膝袜和软底鞋。第一格中，她的脸被一个米色的矩形遮挡块刻意遮住。一只毛茸茸的小白羊出现在每一格中，它有着圆圆的黑眼睛、粉红色的脸颊、小小的垂耳和短短的尾巴。一只三花猫出现在第 3 和第 4 格，身上有白色、橙色和深棕色的斑块，圆圆的眼睛，表情俏皮。

布局与故事：使用 4 个画格。
1. 第 1 格：温馨的房间内景，有木地板、书架、瓶子、盆栽、墙上挂画、窗帘和窗户。羊角少女站在右侧，背对或侧对镜头，脸部被米色矩形遮住。小绵羊站在她左侧的地板上，带着动效线微微颤抖。在右侧添加一个竖向的日文对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="panel 1 dialogue" default="…揺れてる…ね"}。
2. 第 2 格：木地板裂开，出现一个闪烁着紫色星系光芒的锯齿状洞口。小绵羊正从洞中探出或探身查看，身上闪烁着光芒。羊角少女在右侧蹲下，神情担忧，伸手向洞口探去。在右侧添加一个竖向对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="panel 2 dialogue" default="ひつ郎、近づいちゃだめ"}。
3. 第 3 格：左侧打开了一个竖向的椭圆形紫色传送门，门内是布满星星的夜空和一颗发光的黄色星星。一只三花猫从传送门中跃出，冲向房间，带有夸张的放射状速度线。小绵羊站在中右侧，惊慌颤抖。羊角少女站在最右侧，一脸惊讶。包含 2 个对话气泡：猫咪旁边的一个小气泡，内容为 {argument name="cat sound" default="ニャッ"}，以及右侧的一个竖向长气泡，内容为 {argument name="panel 3 dialogue" default="…どこの子？"}。
4. 第 4 格：传送门在温馨房间的左侧持续发光。小绵羊从传送门中漂浮或跳出，羊角少女在右侧跪下，保护性地抱住三花猫。猫咪闭着眼睛，看起来很满足。周围闪烁着小星星，地板上散落着一些小物件，如线轴、硬币状圆片、小布块和一个小容器。在右侧添加一个竖向长气泡，内容为日文“Hey, stop that”，即「こら、やめなさい」。

视觉风格：柔和的可爱风漫画，圆润的角色比例，富有表现力的眼睛，奶油色和米色的房间色调，柔和的棕色线条，柔和的紫色魔法光效，细微的闪光，整洁易读的竖排日文对话气泡。保持页面风格治愈且幽默。

约束条件：包含 4 个画格，故事中总共只有 3 个循环角色：羊角少女、小绵羊和三花猫。主要重复元素统计如下：右侧总共 4 个对话气泡，1 个猫咪叫声小气泡，最终画格前有 2 次魔法传送门/洞口事件，且仅在第一格中有一个遮挡脸部的米色矩形。不要添加额外的画格、角色、水印、Logo 或旁白框。

Keep the actual meal, plate, cup, and tabletop composition essentially the same, but remove the decorative sticker row at the bottom: exactly 6 sheep stickers and 1 pizza sticker must be gone. Add a warm, magazine-like food-photo finish with slightly cleaner lighting and sharper appetizing detail.

Overlay casual white handwritten Japanese annotations directly on the photo, as if drawn with a marker pen, with thin arrows, dotted circles, hearts, underline strokes, and one cloud-shaped callout. Use exactly 10 visible annotation text groups:
1. Large top-left headline: {argument name="headline text" default="朝のトーストアート*"}
2. Small subtitle under it: {argument name="subtitle text" default="チーズと野菜のとろ〜りピザトースト"}

templates.title: Fire Knight vs Ice Warrior Battle

titleLocalized.zh: 火焰骑士与冰霜战士之战

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-wide cinematic anime fantasy battle scene in a dark ruined volcanic battlefield at night, aspect ratio about 2.4:1. Show exactly two female warriors clashing in midair among jagged black rocks, smoke, sparks, embers, and distant fires. On the left, {argument name="left warrior" default="a fierce red-haired fire knight"} with long windblown crimson hair, ornate gold plate armor, a flowing burgundy cape and skirt cloth, lunging forward with a glowing orange fire sword and a swirling flame aura behind her. On the right, {argument name="right warrior" default="a silver-haired ice warrior"} with very long flowing silver-white hair, glossy black-and-white battle armor with blue crystal accents, crouching and bracing with one arm extended; place a flat dark gray square censor block over her face. Between them, render a large circular blue magic shield sigil made of intricate glowing runes and geometric rings, struck by the fire blade with bright orange sparks at the impact point. Add exactly two elemental effects: orange fire around the left warrior and blue ice crystals around the right warrior, including sharp translucent shards bursting outward behind her. Use high-detail Japanese anime key visual style, dramatic rim lighting, dynamic perspective, sharp linework, painterly rendering, intense motion, high contrast orange-and-cyan color grading, cinematic depth of field, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个超宽画幅的电影级动漫奇幻战斗场景，背景为夜晚黑暗荒凉的火山战场，长宽比约为 2.4:1。画面中展示两名女性战士在崎岖的黑色岩石、烟雾、火花、余烬和远处的火光中于半空中交锋。左侧是 {argument name="left warrior" default="一位凶猛的红发火焰骑士"}，留着随风飘动的深红色长发，身穿华丽的金色板甲，披着酒红色的斗篷和裙摆，正挥舞着发光的橙色火焰之剑向前突刺，身后环绕着旋转的火焰光环。右侧是 {argument name="right warrior" default="一位银发冰霜战士"}，留着极长的银白色飘逸长发，身穿带有蓝色水晶装饰的光泽黑白战甲，正蹲伏并单臂伸展进行防御；在她的面部放置一个平坦的深灰色方形遮挡块。在两人之间，渲染一个由复杂的发光符文和几何环组成的巨大圆形蓝色魔法盾徽，火焰之剑击中盾徽，撞击点迸发出明亮的橙色火花。添加两种元素特效：左侧战士周围环绕橙色火焰，右侧战士周围环绕蓝色冰晶，包括她身后向外迸发的锋利半透明碎片。采用高细节的日本动漫关键视觉风格，戏剧性的轮廓光，动态视角，锐利的线条，绘画质感渲染，强烈的动感，高对比度的橙青色调，电影级景深，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Blue Gothic Lolita Victorian Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色哥特洛丽塔维多利亚风格肖像

templates.prompt: Create a full-body vertical fashion portrait of {argument name="character name" default="an elegant gothic lolita young woman"} standing in a dark Victorian room, facing the camera with a graceful doll-like pose, one hand lightly holding out the skirt and the other relaxed at her side. She wears an elaborate black-and-royal-blue aristocratic gothic lolita dress with gold embroidery, a fitted corset bodice with crisscross gold lacing, long flared sleeves, white lace cuffs, a high white ruffled collar, a large satin blue bow at the neck with a jeweled brooch, and a second large blue waist bow with dangling gold tassels. The skirt is dramatic and layered: black outer overskirt with ornate gold filigree trim, deep royal-blue ruffle tiers, translucent pale-blue lace layers, and white lace edging, forming a high-low bell silhouette. Add black floral lace thigh-high stockings, black glossy platform Mary Jane shoes with buckles, and delicate gold jewelry. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown wavy twin-tail hair"}, decorated with exactly 4 visible head accessories: a small tilted black top hat with a blue band, a black lace veil, a cluster of blue roses, and gold filigree hair ornaments. Use a refined color palette of {argument name="main colors" default="black, deep royal blue, antique gold, and white lace"}. The setting is an ornate gothic Victorian interior with exactly 6 prominent decor elements: a carved black-and-gold cabinet on the left, lit silver candelabras with candles, dark blue roses in a vase, heavy navy velvet curtains, a tall arched leaded-glass window on the right, and a small black-and-gold side table holding a blue rose. Add a patterned blue-and-gold rug on a dark floor. Lighting should be moody candlelit chiaroscuro with cool window light, rich shadows, luxurious textures, ultra-detailed fabric, realistic photography, sharp full-body composition, vertical 9:16 framing. Include the visible white watermark text {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} in the top-right corner. Do not add extra people, extra text, modern objects, or a visible face blur; keep the face naturally rendered if possible.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全身垂直时尚肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的哥特洛丽塔少女"}，她站在深色的维多利亚风格房间中，面向镜头，姿态优雅如玩偶，一只手轻轻提起裙摆，另一只手自然垂在身侧。她身穿精致的黑蓝配色贵族哥特洛丽塔礼服，配有金色刺绣、带有交叉金色系带的紧身胸衣、长款喇叭袖、白色蕾丝袖口、高领白色荷叶边领口，颈部饰有巨大的缎面蓝色蝴蝶结及珠宝胸针，腰部配有第二个巨大的蓝色蝴蝶结，并垂下金色流苏。裙摆层次丰富且充满戏剧性：黑色外层裙摆饰有华丽的金色花丝镶边，深宝蓝色荷叶边层，半透明浅蓝色蕾丝层，以及白色蕾丝边缘，形成前短后长的钟形轮廓。搭配黑色花卉蕾丝大腿袜、黑色亮面搭扣玛丽珍厚底鞋以及精致的金色首饰。她的发型为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色波浪双马尾"}，装饰有 4 件清晰可见的头部配饰：一顶带有蓝色饰带的小巧倾斜黑色礼帽、黑色蕾丝面纱、一簇蓝色玫瑰以及金色花丝发饰。使用 {argument name="main colors" default="黑色、深宝蓝色、古董金和白色蕾丝"} 的精致配色方案。场景为华丽的哥特式维多利亚室内，包含 6 个显著的装饰元素：左侧雕刻精美的黑金橱柜、点燃的银色烛台、花瓶中的深蓝色玫瑰、厚重的海军蓝天鹅绒窗帘、右侧高大的拱形铅条玻璃窗，以及摆放着一朵蓝色玫瑰的小型黑金边桌。深色地板上铺有蓝金图案的地毯。光影采用忧郁的烛光明暗对比法，结合冷色调窗光，呈现丰富的阴影、奢华的质感、超精细的织物细节、写实摄影风格，构图为清晰的全身照，采用 9:16 垂直构图。在右上角包含可见的白色水印文本 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"}。请勿添加额外人物、额外文字、现代物品或可见的面部模糊；尽可能保持面部自然呈现。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Character Dossier

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫角色档案

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-impact anime character dossier poster for {argument name="character name" default="RIONA"}, a cyberpunk tactical female fighter named Riona Cyan, shown in an extreme dynamic foreshortened action pose as if leaping or drop-kicking toward the viewer.

Canvas: Vertical poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, clean white background with black, cyan-blue, and gray accents. Use a crisp premium character-key-visual style, like a futuristic game operator profile sheet.

Layout: Put a huge bold black sans-serif title “{argument name="character name" default="RIONA"}” in the upper left, with smaller subtitle “RIONA CYAN” underneath. The character dominates the center and right side, overlapping the typography. Add thin technical UI lines, crosshair marks, barcode-like details, tiny serial numbers, and scattered glass or metal shards across the poster. On the left side, include a compact profile column with a cyan-and-black emblem logo and the label “CYAN REAPER,” followed by dossier fields. On the right edge, add one vertical Japanese-style motto text column using {argument name="vertical motto" default="〈青狩〉は政府に属さない独立治安部隊で、表に出せない事件や戦術任務を請け負う。"}. At the bottom left, include the slogan “CLEAR. CALCULATED. DEADLY.” and two short Japanese-style microtext lines; at the bottom right, add tiny unit ID text “UNIT ID : CR-0722.”

Character details: A young adult woman, age 22, athletic and lean with visible toned abdomen, pale skin, black hair with electric cyan-blue dyed ends, messy windblown medium-length hair, and a deliberately obscured face covered by a soft rectangular blur censor block. She wears a black cropped tactical top, a cropped black bomber jacket with cyan trim and small square cyan patches, loose black cargo pants with straps, belt, chain, pouches, holster-like utility bags, fingerless black gloves, and heavy black combat boots with thick soles and cyan laces. The most prominent boot sole is huge in the foreground, facing the viewer, with detailed tread and a small cyan square mark. Her pose is aggressive and airborne: one leg thrust forward toward the camera, the other bent high, one arm extended back for balance, and the other holding a short electrified baton or compact blade with a glowing cyan tip.

Visible counted elements: Include exactly 1 main character, exactly 1 huge foreground boot sole, exactly 1 secondary raised boot, exactly 1 handheld cyan-glowing weapon, exactly 1 cyan-and-black “CYAN REAPER” logo, exactly 1 large title word, exactly 1 left dossier column, exactly 1 right vertical motto column, exactly 3 small crosshair UI markers, exactly 1 barcode block, and many small shard fragments dispersed diagonally around the character.

Left dossier text: Use these readable English field labels and values: “AFFILIATION: Independent Security Force (Blue Hunt)”; “CODE NAME: Cyan Reaper”; “AGE: 22”; “HEIGHT: 168cm”; “WEAPON: Arc baton / short blade / electromagnetic tool”; “PERSONALITY: Calm, confident, rational.” Keep the text tiny but legible, like a military database printout.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed anime illustration, sharp inked linework, dramatic perspective, high contrast black clothing against white negative space, cyan rim lighting, glossy fabric highlights, technical graphic design, clean editorial poster composition, subtle motion arcs and blue slash trails near the lower right. Make the image feel like a polished sci-fi character profile splash art.

Constraints: Keep the background mostly white and uncluttered, preserve the bold typography hierarchy, do not add extra characters, do not add a realistic photo style, do not remove the intentional face blur, and avoid excessive readable text beyond the specified dossier and poster labels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="RIONA"} 创建一张极具视觉冲击力的动漫角色档案海报，角色名为 Riona Cyan，是一位赛博朋克风格的女性战术战士，呈现出一种极具动态的透视动作姿态，仿佛正向观众飞跃或进行跳踢。

画布：竖版海报，比例约为 2:3，干净的白色背景，配以黑色、青蓝色和灰色点缀。采用清晰的高级角色主视觉风格，类似于未来感游戏特工档案页。

布局：在左上角放置一个巨大的粗体黑色无衬线标题 “{argument name="character name" default="RIONA"}”，下方配以较小的副标题 “RIONA CYAN”。角色占据中心和右侧，与排版重叠。添加细致的科技感 UI 线条、准星标记、条形码细节、微小的序列号，以及散布在海报上的玻璃或金属碎片。在左侧，包含一个紧凑的档案栏，配有青黑色的徽章标志和标签 “CYAN REAPER”，随后是档案字段。在右侧边缘，添加一列垂直的日式座右铭文字，使用 {argument name="vertical motto" default="〈青狩〉は政府に属さない独立治安部隊で、表に出せない事件や戦術任務を請け負う。"}。在左下角，包含口号 “CLEAR. CALCULATED. DEADLY.” 和两行简短的日式微型文字；在右下角，添加微小的单位 ID 文字 “UNIT ID : CR-0722。”

角色细节：一位 22 岁的年轻女性，身材健美匀称，腹肌线条可见，皮肤白皙，黑色头发，发梢染成电光青蓝色，中长发凌乱且带有风吹感，面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身穿黑色露脐战术上衣、带有青色饰边和小型方形青色补丁的黑色短款飞行夹克、带有绑带、腰带、链条、小包和枪套式功能袋的宽松黑色工装裤、露指黑色手套，以及鞋底厚实且带有青色鞋带的黑色重型作战靴。最突出的靴底在前景中显得巨大，正对观众，带有详细的纹路和一个小的青色方形标记。她的姿势极具攻击性且处于空中：一条腿向镜头猛力踢出，另一条腿高高弯曲，一只手臂向后伸展以保持平衡，另一只手握着一根短小的带电警棍或带有发光青色尖端的紧凑型刀刃。

可见计数元素：包含 1 个主要角色，1 个巨大的前景靴底，1 个抬起的次要靴子，1 个手持的青色发光武器，1 个青黑色 “CYAN REAPER” 标志，1 个大标题词，1 个左侧档案栏，1 个右侧垂直座右铭栏，3 个小型准星 UI 标记，1 个条形码块，以及许多沿对角线散布在角色周围的小碎片。

左侧档案文字：使用以下可读的英文标签和值：“AFFILIATION: Independent Security Force (Blue Hunt)”; “CODE NAME: Cyan Reaper”; “AGE: 22”; “HEIGHT: 168cm”; “WEAPON: Arc baton / short blade / electromagnetic tool”; “PERSONALITY: Calm, confident, rational.” 文字需保持微小但清晰，如同军事数据库的打印件。

视觉风格：超精细动漫插画，锐利的墨线，戏剧性的透视，白色负空间中高对比度的黑色服装，青色轮廓光，光泽面料高光，科技感图形设计，干净的编辑海报构图，右下角有微妙的运动弧线和蓝色斩击轨迹。使图像呈现出精致的科幻角色档案宣传图质感。

约束条件：保持背景大部分为白色且简洁，保留粗体排版层级，不要添加额外角色，不要使用写实照片风格，不要移除刻意的面部模糊，并避免在指定的档案和海报标签之外添加过多的可读文字。

She holds an empty round silver serving tray with both hands at chest height, angled slightly toward the camera. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered rectangular pixelated privacy blur in muted brown tones. The setting includes a dark granite countertop, sink and faucet, dark wood lower cabinets, a white wall with a light switch on the right, and large floor-to-ceiling windows showing a nighttime city skyline with scattered lights. Use a vertical smartphone snapshot composition, slightly wide-angle perspective from above chest level, direct on-camera flash, high detail, realistic skin and fabric reflections, intimate indoor party/cosplay photo mood. Customize the outfit as {argument name="maid outfit color" default="glossy silver and white"}, the setting as {argument name="background location" default="modern high-rise apartment kitchenette at night"}, the prop as {argument name="serving prop" default="empty round silver serving tray"}, the privacy treatment as {argument name="face treatment" default="centered rectangular pixelated privacy blur"}, and the lighting style as {argument name="lighting style" default="direct on-camera flash smartphone photo"}. Ensure the subject is clearly an adult, keep the pose non-explicit, include exactly one person and one tray, and do not add extra text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的闪光灯摄影肖像，主角是一位身穿亮面银白配色女仆装的成年女性，场景设定在夜间现代高层公寓的小厨房内。她佩戴着带有黑色丝带装饰的白色荷叶边女仆发箍，留着深色齐肩波浪卷发，身着闪亮的金属银色紧身胸衣，配有白色荷叶边饰边、透明白色围裙、白色颈圈，两侧垂挂着长丝带。她双手在胸前托着一个空的圆形银色托盘，并略微向镜头倾斜。她的面部被一个居中的矩形棕色调像素化模糊遮挡。背景包括深色花岗岩台面、水槽和水龙头、深色木质底柜、右侧带有电灯开关的白墙，以及展示着零星灯光的夜间城市天际线的落地大窗。采用竖屏智能手机快照构图，从胸部以上位置进行轻微广角拍摄，使用直射机顶闪光灯，高细节，呈现真实的皮肤和织物反光，营造出私密的室内派对/Cosplay 照片氛围。可自定义服装为 {argument name="maid outfit color" default="glossy silver and white"}，场景为 {argument name="background location" default="modern high-rise apartment kitchenette at night"}，道具为 {argument name="serving prop" default="empty round silver serving tray"}，隐私处理方式为 {argument name="face treatment" default="centered rectangular pixelated privacy blur"}，以及灯光风格为 {argument name="lighting style" default="direct on-camera flash smartphone photo"}。确保主体明确为成年人，姿势保持非色情，画面仅包含一人一托盘，且不要添加任何额外文字或水印。

templates.title: Business Presentation Icon Set

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean vector icon set for business presentation illustrations, suitable for slide decks and documents.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 white background, evenly spaced grid layout with 40 discrete icons arranged in 5 rows and 8 columns. Use generous margins and consistent icon sizing.

Visual style: Flat modern corporate vector style with rounded shapes, minimal shading, crisp edges, and a friendly SaaS/business look. Use a limited palette of {argument name="primary blue" default="bright blue"}, {argument name="accent green" default="fresh green"}, {argument name="accent orange" default="vivid orange"}, dark navy outlines, light gray UI details, and occasional yellow. No text labels, no watermark, no realistic texture.

Icon contents: Include exactly 40 icons in this order, left to right by row:
Row 1: 1) three people meeting at a table with speech bubbles, 2) bar chart with upward growth arrow, 3) line graph with three colored points and rising arrow, 4) three vertical upward arrows in blue green orange, 5) presentation screen with pie chart and pointer, 6) laptop with dashboard cards, 7) tablet with colored dashboard blocks.
Row 2: 8) kanban board with three columns and colored task cards, 9) glowing light bulb idea icon, 10) target with arrow hitting bullseye, 11) handshake with blue and green sleeves, 12) monthly calendar grid with one orange date, 13) document page with blue folded corner and lines, 14) checklist document with green check marks.
Row 3: 15) cloud upload icon with upward arrow, 16) dark blue gear settings icon, 17) magnifying glass search icon, 18) blue envelope email icon, 19) video conference monitor with four participants, 20) gold trophy award icon, 21) four-piece puzzle in blue green orange.
Row 4: 22) green circle check mark, 23) pie chart in blue green orange, 24) organization chart with connected colored nodes, 25) thumbs-up approval icon, 26) team/group icon with three people, 27) bar chart with rising green arrow, 28) green shield with white check mark.
Row 5: 29) money bag with dollar sign and stacked coins, 30) calculator with orange key, 31) analog clock, 32) yellow file folder, 33) overlapping chat bubbles with ellipsis, 34) dark blue briefcase with yellow clasp, 35) blue globe wireframe.

Layout constraints: Maintain a balanced grid and consistent visual weight; leave open white space between icons; keep all icons centered in their cells; avoid adding captions or extra elements. The final image should feel like a reusable {argument name="asset type" default="business icon library"} for {argument name="use case" default="presentation materials"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一套简洁的矢量图标集，用于商务演示插图，适用于 Slides 和文档。

画布：16:9 宽屏白色背景，采用均匀分布的网格布局，包含 40 个独立图标，排列为 5 行 8 列。使用宽裕的边距和统一的图标尺寸。

视觉风格：扁平化现代企业矢量风格，具有圆润的形状、极简的阴影、清晰的边缘，以及亲和的 SaaS/商务外观。使用有限的调色板：{argument name="primary blue" default="亮蓝色"}、{argument name="accent green" default="清新绿"}、{argument name="accent orange" default="鲜橙色"}、深海军蓝轮廓、浅灰色 UI 细节以及点缀的黄色。无文字标签，无水印，无写实纹理。

图标内容：按从左到右、从上到下的顺序包含 40 个图标：
第 1 行：1) 三人在桌前开会并带有对话气泡，2) 带有上升增长箭头的柱状图，3) 带有三个彩色点和上升箭头的折线图，4) 蓝、绿、橙三色垂直上升箭头，5) 带有饼图和指针的演示屏幕，6) 带有仪表盘卡片的笔记本电脑，7) 带有彩色仪表盘模块的平板电脑。
第 2 行：8) 带有三列和彩色任务卡片的看板项目 (kanban board)，9) 发光的灯泡创意图标，10) 箭中靶心的目标图标，11) 穿着蓝绿袖口的握手图标，12) 带有橙色日期的月度日历网格，13) 带有蓝色折角和线条的文档页面，14) 带有绿色勾选标记的清单文档。
第 3 行：15) 带有向上箭头的云端上传图标，16) 深蓝色齿轮设置图标，17) 放大镜搜索图标，18) 蓝色信封邮件图标，19) 带有四名参与者的视频会议显示器，20) 金色奖杯奖励图标，21) 蓝、绿、橙四块拼图。
第 4 行：22) 绿色圆形勾选标记，23) 蓝、绿、橙三色饼图，24) 带有连接彩色节点的组织架构图，25) 点赞审批图标，26) 包含三人的团队/群组图标，27) 带有上升绿色箭头的柱状图，28) 带有白色勾选标记的绿色盾牌。
第 5 行：29) 带有美元符号和堆叠硬币的钱袋，30) 带有橙色按键的计算器，31) 模拟时钟，32) 黄色文件夹，33) 带有省略号的重叠聊天气泡，34) 带有黄色扣环的深蓝色公文包，35) 蓝色地球仪线框图。

布局约束：保持平衡的网格和一致的视觉权重；在图标之间留出空白；保持所有图标在其单元格中居中；避免添加标题或额外元素。最终图像应呈现为可复用的 {argument name="asset type" default="商务图标库"}，适用于 {argument name="use case" default="演示材料"}。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Storyboard and Video Preview

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻故事板与视频预览

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark cinematic AI-drama workflow showcase image: a 3×3 fantasy storyboard grid on the left and a widescreen video-preview frame on the right, demonstrating how a still storyboard becomes an animated scene.

Canvas: Wide horizontal composition, roughly 2:1 aspect ratio, with a black background and thin white outer border. The left half contains a square storyboard contact sheet; the right half contains a large embedded video-player still with black letterboxing and a small playback time indicator.

Left storyboard layout: Use exactly 9 numbered panels arranged in a 3×3 grid, each separated by thin white borders and marked with small white number tags from 1 to 9 in the upper-left corner. The panels should depict a gothic xianxia / dark fantasy romance narrative featuring {argument name="female character" default="a veiled bride in ornate crimson robes"} and {argument name="male character" default="a cold white-haired immortal man in dark robes"}. Add small cinematic Chinese-style subtitle text in one or two panels, but keep it tiny and secondary. The 9 panels are: 1) extreme close-up of the crimson veiled bride covering part of her face with her sleeve, red candlelight and rainlike texture; 2) the bride seated or leaning in a dim chamber near a window, a pale white-haired figure behind her, faint subtitle line near the bottom; 3) the bride turning toward a red-lit palace interior with long black hair and red veil flowing; 4) a tall dark-robed figure standing before a lattice window, backlit by cold blue moonlight; 5) the bride kneeling or collapsing beneath a red veil, one hand on the floor, dramatic red fabric; 6) intimate close-up of the white-haired immortal touching the bride’s chin, their faces close, tense romantic mood; 7) close-up of the white-haired man holding a vertical talisman or paper slip with Chinese characters; 8) two dark silhouettes facing each other in rain or mist, a red candle or ember glowing at the bottom; 9) the bride in red standing on a high balcony or rooftop, long robe and hair blown by wind, overlooking a stormy blue cityscape.

Right video-preview layout: Place one large widescreen cinematic frame occupying the right half. It shows the same crimson bride from behind or three-quarter view inside a red wooden palace chamber, with black hair and a thorny dark headdress or tangled veil, red robes glittering with embroidery, blue moonlight visible through lattice windows, and tiny distant figures in the background. Add thick black letterbox space above and below the frame. In the lower-left of the black player area, show a white pause icon and the timestamp “0:13”. Include a small faint label in the top-left of the video frame, like an AI-generation tag.

Visual style: Ultra-dramatic Chinese dark fantasy, gothic romance, high-contrast red and blue lighting, candlelit interiors, rain, mist, ornate robes, cinematic depth of field, moody shadows, film still texture, high detail, atmospheric fantasy drama. Use {argument name="primary color palette" default="crimson red, cold blue, black, and pale silver"}.

Face treatment: Every visible human face should be deliberately obscured by a soft square gray blur, as if anonymized in a screenshot. Keep the blur blocks centered over faces and consistent across both storyboard and video frame.

Text constraints: Keep all text minimal and small, except the visible timestamp “0:13” and the storyboard numbers 1 through 9. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra UI panels, or additional storyboard frames.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个暗黑电影感 AI 剧集工作流展示图：左侧为 3×3 奇幻故事板网格，右侧为宽屏视频预览框，演示静态故事板如何转化为动画场景。

画布：宽横向构图，比例约为 2:1，黑色背景，带有细白色外边框。左半部分包含一个方形故事板联系表；右半部分包含一个大型嵌入式视频播放器截图，带有黑色遮幅和小型播放时间指示器。

左侧故事板布局：使用 9 个编号面板，排列成 3×3 网格，每个面板由细白色边框分隔，并在左上角标有 1 到 9 的白色小数字标签。面板应描绘一个哥特仙侠 / 暗黑奇幻浪漫叙事，主角为 {argument name="female character" default="一位身着华丽绯红长袍、戴着面纱的新娘"} 和 {argument name="male character" default="一位身着暗色长袍、冷峻的白发仙人"}。在其中一两个面板中加入细小的电影感中式字幕，但需保持微小且作为次要元素。9 个面板内容如下：1) 绯红面纱新娘的特写，衣袖遮住部分面部，带有红烛光和雨水质感；2) 新娘坐在或倚靠在窗边昏暗的房间里，身后是一个苍白的白发身影，底部有模糊的字幕行；3) 新娘转向红光笼罩的宫殿内部，长长的黑发和红纱飘动；4) 一个高大的暗袍身影站在格子窗前，背景是冷冽的蓝色月光；5) 新娘跪在或倒在红纱下，一只手撑地，红色的织物充满戏剧感；6) 白发仙人触碰新娘下巴的亲密特写，两人面部靠近，浪漫氛围紧张；7) 白发男子手持一张带有汉字的垂直符咒或纸条的特写；8) 两个暗色剪影在雨中或雾中相对而立，底部有一支红烛或余烬在发光；9) 身着红衣的新娘站在高处阳台或屋顶，长袍和头发被风吹动，俯瞰着暴风雨中的蓝色城市景观。

右侧视频预览布局：在右半部分放置一个大型宽屏电影画框。画面展示了同一个绯红新娘的背影或四分之三侧面，场景位于红色木质宫殿内，黑发配有带刺的暗色头饰或缠绕的面纱，红袍上绣花闪烁，格子窗外可见蓝色月光，背景中有微小的远景人物。在画框上下添加厚实的黑色遮幅。在黑色播放器区域的左下角，显示一个白色暂停图标和时间戳“0:13”。在视频画框的左上角包含一个微小模糊的标签，例如 AI 生成标识。

视觉风格：极具戏剧性的中式暗黑奇幻、哥特浪漫、高对比度的红蓝光影、烛光内景、雨、雾、华丽长袍、电影级景深、忧郁的阴影、电影剧照质感、高细节、氛围感奇幻剧。使用 {argument name="primary color palette" default="绯红、冷蓝、黑色和苍银色"}。

面部处理：所有可见的人脸都应刻意用柔和的方形灰色模糊遮盖，如同截图中进行了匿名化处理。模糊块需居中覆盖在面部上，并确保在故事板和视频画框中保持一致。

文本限制：保持所有文字极简且微小，除了可见的时间戳“0:13”和 1 到 9 的故事板编号。不要添加任何徽标、水印、额外的 UI 面板或额外的故事板帧。

templates.title: Floral Aqua Dome Anime Knight

titleLocalized.zh: 花卉水族穹顶动漫骑士

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 ultra-detailed anime fantasy illustration of a delicate miniature aqua dome containing the world of {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"}. Inside a clear oval glass cloche on an ornate white-and-gold base, place exactly 1 young magical-girl knight as the central subject, exactly 1 oversized silver broadsword held upright in front of her, exactly 1 ornate oval name plaque at the bottom, exactly 2 slender gold candle stands, and exactly 1 arched cathedral-like background window. The character has {argument name="hair color" default="pale golden blonde"} long voluminous twin-tail hair, a wreath of small white flowers with pale blue and blush pink blossoms, a soft pearl-white and translucent pale-blue dress with layered ruffled skirt, floral corsage belt, arm garlands, white gloves, and silver-gold filigree armor accents. Her face is intentionally covered by a flat skin-toned rectangular blank mask with no facial features, centered over the face. The sword is elegant and ceremonial, with a long satin-silver blade, gold cross ornaments, dangling chains, and a bouquet of pale blue roses and white flowers wrapped around the hilt. Fill the dome with an ethereal sanctuary garden: abundant white blossoms, pale blue roses, pearly petals, tiny white butterflies, crystal droplets, sparkling beads, soft hanging ornaments, and dreamy bokeh lights. The plaque should display {argument name="plaque text" default="のぞむの花の聖域 / のぞむ"} in delicate gold lettering. Use a luminous pastel palette of ivory, silver, champagne gold, pale blue, blush pink, and transparent glass highlights. Style: high-end Japanese anime figure illustration, ornate shoujo fantasy, soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, glossy glass reflections, intricate floral details, magical aquarium-dome atmosphere, no watermark, no extra characters, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 纵向、超精细的动漫奇幻插图，描绘一个精致的微型水族穹顶，其中包含 {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} 的世界。在一个带有华丽白金底座的透明椭圆形玻璃罩内，放置 1 位年轻的魔法少女骑士作为中心主体，前方竖直放置 1 把超大的银色阔剑，底部放置 1 块华丽的椭圆形铭牌，两侧各放置 1 个纤细的金色烛台，背景为 1 扇拱形大教堂风格的窗户。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="淡金黄色"} 的长款蓬松双马尾，戴着由小白花、淡蓝色和淡粉色花朵组成的花环，身穿珍珠白与半透明淡蓝色层叠荷叶边裙，配有花卉胸花腰带、手臂花环、白手套以及银金色花丝铠甲装饰。她的脸部被一个平坦的肤色长方形空白面具遮住，面具上没有任何五官，位于脸部中央。剑身优雅且具有仪式感，配有长长的缎银色剑刃、金色十字装饰、悬挂的链条，以及缠绕在剑柄上的淡蓝色玫瑰和白色花束。穹顶内充满空灵的圣殿花园：繁茂的白色花朵、淡蓝色玫瑰、珍珠般的花瓣、细小的白色蝴蝶、水晶水滴、闪亮的珠子、柔软的悬挂装饰和梦幻般的焦外成像光斑。铭牌上应以精致的金色字体显示 {argument name="plaque text" default="のぞむの花の聖域 / のぞむ"}。使用象牙白、银色、香槟金、淡蓝色、淡粉色和透明玻璃高光的明亮柔和色调。风格：高端日本动漫手办插画、华丽少女奇幻、柔和的电影级灯光、浅景深、光亮的玻璃反射、错综复杂的花卉细节、神奇的水族穹顶氛围，无水印，无额外角色，无现代物品。

templates.title: Group Photo Inside Retro Flip Phone

titleLocalized.zh: 复古翻盖手机内的合影

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the base object and style reference, create a clean standalone illustration of the open Japanese flip phone, removing the surrounding infographic layout, captions, detail panels, borders, and all printed text. Replace the phone's screen content with the group photo from REFERENCE_0, fitted naturally inside the display as if it is being viewed in the phone gallery. Preserve the old silver-blue clamshell phone's angle, keypad, hinge, translucent worn plastic texture, small scratches, and blue star charm strap from REFERENCE_1. Keep the image in the same soft watercolor/anime concept-art style with a pale white background, faint blue shadows, and a few drifting translucent petals. The screen should show exactly 4 people from the group photo: blue-haired girl, black-haired boy, brown-haired girl, and brown-haired boy. Do not add UI text, labels, borders, page decorations, or extra objects beyond the phone, charm, subtle shadow, and petals. Optional customization: use {argument name="screen photo" default="the four-person summer group photo from REFERENCE_0"} on the phone display, with the phone model/color remaining {argument name="phone color" default="silver-blue translucent flip phone"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为基础对象和风格参考，创作一张简洁的日式翻盖手机独立插画，去除周围的信息图布局、标题、细节面板、边框以及所有印刷文字。将手机屏幕内容替换为 REFERENCE_0 中的合影，使其自然地嵌入显示屏中，呈现出正在手机相册中查看的效果。保留 REFERENCE_1 中旧款银蓝色翻盖手机的角度、键盘、铰链、半透明磨损塑料质感、细微划痕以及蓝色星星挂饰。保持图像为柔和的水彩/动漫概念艺术风格，背景为淡白色，带有淡淡的蓝色阴影和几片飘落的半透明花瓣。屏幕应准确显示合影中的 4 个人：蓝发女孩、黑发男孩、棕发女孩和棕发男孩。除手机、挂饰、柔和阴影和花瓣外，请勿添加任何 UI 文字、标签、边框、页面装饰或其他多余物体。可选自定义：在手机显示屏上使用 {argument name="screen photo" default="来自 REFERENCE_0 的四人夏季合影"}，手机型号/颜色保持为 {argument name="phone color" default="银蓝色半透明翻盖手机"}。

templates.title: Two Girls in Ink Storm

titleLocalized.zh: 墨雨中的少女

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic square anime illustration of exactly two teenage girls in dynamic motion, seen from a low, tilted angle as if they are falling, floating, or dancing through an abstract storm of ink. The first girl has {argument name="light-haired girl hair color" default="pale blonde hair"} tied in a messy high ponytail with loose strands covering part of her face; she wears a white Japanese sailor school uniform with dark collar trim, a tied neckerchief, a pleated skirt, white socks, and black shoes. She is positioned on the upper-right side, body angled diagonally, one knee bent, one arm extended back, looking downward with a soft serious expression. The second girl has {argument name="dark-haired girl hair color" default="long black hair"} flowing wildly across the left side; her face is mostly hidden in shadow and hair. She wears a dark, tattered school-uniform-like dress or blouse and skirt, rendered almost as a black silhouette, with deep crimson tones around the lower fabric. Place her on the lower-left side, reaching or drifting toward the blonde girl, creating an intimate but tense two-character composition. Use a gritty monochrome palette of warm ivory, charcoal black, sepia brown, and muted blood-red accents. Style it as expressive Japanese anime concept art mixed with ink wash, scratchy pen lines, watercolor stains, splattered black ink, rough brush textures, distressed paper grain, and high-contrast chiaroscuro. Background is mostly off-white empty space with explosive black and brown ink splashes concentrated in the upper-right and lower-left corners, diagonal motion streaks, and scattered speckles. Emphasize flowing hair, pleated fabric movement, dramatic shadows, delicate faces, painterly anatomy, and a cinematic, melancholic atmosphere. No text, no border, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的方形动漫插画，画面中恰好有两名处于动态中的少女，采用低角度倾斜视角，仿佛她们正坠落、漂浮或在抽象的水墨风暴中起舞。第一名女孩拥有 {argument name="light-haired girl hair color" default="浅金色头发"}，扎着凌乱的高马尾，几缕发丝遮住部分脸庞；她身穿白色日式水手校服，配有深色领边、领巾、百褶裙、白袜和黑鞋。她位于右上角，身体呈对角线倾斜，单膝弯曲，一只手臂向后伸展，神情柔和而严肃地向下注视。第二名女孩拥有 {argument name="dark-haired girl hair color" default="黑色长发"}，在左侧狂乱飘动；她的脸大部分隐藏在阴影和发丝中。她身穿深色、破损的校服式连衣裙或衬衫裙，渲染得几乎像一个黑色剪影，下摆带有深红色的色调。将她置于左下角，向金发女孩伸手或漂浮过去，营造出一种亲密而紧张的双人构图。使用暖象牙白、炭黑、深褐色和柔和血红色点缀的粗犷单色调。风格为富有表现力的日式动漫概念艺术，融合水墨画、潦草的钢笔线条、水彩污渍、飞溅的黑墨、粗糙的笔触、做旧的纸张纹理以及高对比度的明暗对照法。背景主要是灰白色的留白，右上角和左下角集中着爆炸性的黑褐色墨迹，带有对角线运动轨迹和散落的斑点。强调飘逸的头发、百褶裙的动态、戏剧性的阴影、精致的面部、写意的解剖结构以及电影般忧郁的氛围。无文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Minecraft Voxel Wedding Ceremony

titleLocalized.zh: Minecraft 体素风婚礼仪式

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic Minecraft-inspired voxel wedding scene that blends realistic newlyweds with a blocky game world. In the center foreground, show a groom in a black suit lifting and carrying a bride in a flowing white lace wedding dress; the couple should be the only mostly realistic photographic figures, with softly anonymized/blurred faces, while the environment and guests are fully voxel/block-style. The bride wears a long white veil, delicate hair accessory, sleeveless lace bodice, and voluminous skirt lifted by motion; the groom faces away slightly, holding her romantically. Place them on a grassy aisle covered with scattered white flower petals, leading toward a square wooden floral wedding arch decorated with dense green leaves, white blossoms, and hanging flower strands. Surround the aisle with exactly two rows of wooden benches, one row on the left and one on the right, filled with blocky Minecraft-style wedding guests in dark formal suits and white shirts, clapping and smiling; include visible lanterns on posts near the seating. Add abundant blocky flowers along both sides of the aisle, mostly white daisies with a few pink blossoms. The background should show cubic trees, layered voxel foliage, wooden blocks, a bright blue sky with rectangular clouds, warm daylight, soft depth of field, and a joyful romantic atmosphere. Use a square-to-landscape 4:3 composition, centered perspective down the aisle, high-detail voxel textures, vibrant greens, warm highlights, realistic fabric detail on the bride and groom, and a seamless blend of real wedding photography with Minecraft game-map aesthetics. No text, no watermark, no UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级的 Minecraft 风格体素婚礼场景，将写实的新人与方块游戏世界完美融合。在画面前景中央，一位身穿黑色西装的新郎正抱着身穿飘逸白色蕾丝婚纱的新娘；这对新人应是画面中仅有的写实摄影风格人物，面部需进行柔和的匿名化/模糊处理，而周围环境和宾客则完全呈现为体素/方块风格。新娘佩戴长款白纱和精致发饰，身着无袖蕾丝上衣，蓬松的裙摆因动作而扬起；新郎微微侧身，浪漫地抱着她。将他们置于铺满白色花瓣的草地过道上，过道通向一个方形木制花卉婚礼拱门，拱门装饰着茂密的绿叶、白色花朵和悬垂的花串。过道两侧各放置一排木制长椅，坐满了身穿深色正装、白衬衫的方块风格 Minecraft 宾客，他们正在鼓掌微笑；座位附近的柱子上挂着显眼的灯笼。在过道两侧添加丰富的方块花卉，以白色雏菊为主，点缀少量粉色花朵。背景应呈现立方体树木、层叠的体素植被、木块，以及带有长方形云朵的明亮蓝天，营造温暖的日光、柔和的景深和欢乐浪漫的氛围。采用 4:3 的方形至横向构图，以过道为中心的透视视角，展现高细节的体素纹理、鲜艳的绿色、温暖的高光，以及新人身上写实的布料细节，实现真实婚礼摄影与 Minecraft 游戏地图美学的无缝融合。画面中无文字、无水印、无 UI 元素。

templates.title: UNVOID Glitch Streetwear Poster

titleLocalized.zh: UNVOID Glitch 街头服饰海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-fashion streetwear campaign poster for {argument name="brand name" default="UNVOID"}, with a dark cyber-glitch identity and editorial magazine cover styling.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, realistic photographic base, muted gray concrete architecture background, centered full-body model, sharp white typography overlays, subtle film grain and shallow depth of field.

Main subject: A young female model stands front-facing in the center on a concrete ramp outside a modern brutalist storefront. Her face is obscured by a black horizontal glitch/void mask across the eyes and nose. She has straight black bob-length hair with bangs. Outfit: exactly 4 visible clothing pieces — oversized cropped brown short-sleeve top layered over a black shirt, black mini skirt with white abstract topographic floral line art, black ankle socks, black chunky ankle boots. Pose is neutral and confident, arms relaxed, legs slightly apart.

Background: Modern gray concrete building facade with large dark windows and a storefront entrance. A blurred sign behind the model also reads the brand name, reinforcing the campaign identity. The environment feels urban, minimal, and slightly dystopian.

Typography and layout: Use exactly 8 text elements: 1) enormous white all-caps masthead at the top: {argument name="brand name" default="UNVOID"}, spanning nearly the full width, with a tiny registered trademark mark near the upper-right of the word; 2) small text at upper left: {argument name="season text" default="SPRING SUMMER 2026"}; 3) thin horizontal divider line across the upper middle; 4) small text at upper right: {argument name="collection text" default="COLLECTION 06"}; 5) small vertical slogan on left side: “IDENTITY IS NOT STATIC — IT GLITCHES.”; 6) small stacked slogan on right side: “WEAR THE ERROR. OWN THE VOID.”; 7) large distressed glitch headline at lower left: {argument name="campaign headline" default="ERROR SKIN"}, with broken horizontal scanline fragments; 8) footer microcopy: lower left “UNVOID® / ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.” and lower right “COLLECTION 06 / SPRING SUMMER 2026” with a small white toggle-switch icon above it.

Visual style: Premium fashion lookbook meets cyberpunk glitch branding. White Helvetica/Grotesk bold typography, high contrast but subdued palette: concrete gray, black, white, muted brown. Add horizontal digital distortion only to the face mask and the lower-left campaign headline. Keep the composition clean, editorial, and campaign-ready.

Constraints: Do not add extra models, props, logos, or additional text. Keep all typography legible and aligned like a luxury streetwear poster. Preserve the model centered under the giant masthead.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="UNVOID"} 创作一张高街时尚宣传海报，融合暗黑赛博故障风格与杂志封面排版。

画布：垂直 4:5 海报，写实摄影底图，背景为柔和的灰色混凝土建筑，居中全身模特，叠加锐利的白色排版，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和浅景深效果。

主体：一位年轻女性模特正面站立在现代粗野主义店面外的混凝土坡道中央。她的眼睛和鼻子被一道黑色的水平故障/虚空遮罩遮住。留着黑色直发波波头，带有刘海。服装：共 4 件可见单品——超大廓形棕色短袖上衣叠穿黑色内搭，黑色迷你裙，裙身带有白色抽象地形花卉线条艺术，黑色短袜，黑色厚底短靴。姿势中性且自信，手臂自然下垂，双腿微张。

背景：现代灰色混凝土建筑外墙，配有大型深色窗户和店面入口。模特身后模糊的招牌上同样印有品牌名称，强化品牌宣传标识。环境呈现出城市化、极简且略带反乌托邦的氛围。

排版与布局：使用 8 个文本元素：1) 顶部巨大的白色全大写报头：{argument name="brand name" default="UNVOID"}，横跨几乎整个宽度，单词右上角带有微小的注册商标符号；2) 左上角小字：{argument name="season text" default="SPRING SUMMER 2026"}；3) 上部中间的细水平分割线；4) 右上角小字：{argument name="collection text" default="COLLECTION 06"}；5) 左侧垂直排列的小标语：“IDENTITY IS NOT STATIC — IT GLITCHES.”；6) 右侧堆叠的小标语：“WEAR THE ERROR. OWN THE VOID.”；7) 左下角巨大的做旧故障风格标题：{argument name="campaign headline" default="ERROR SKIN"}，带有破碎的水平扫描线碎片；8) 底部微型文案：左下角为“UNVOID® / ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.”，右下角为“COLLECTION 06 / SPRING SUMMER 2026”，上方配有一个白色小切换开关图标。

视觉风格：高端时尚画册与赛博朋克故障风格的结合。白色 Helvetica/Grotesk 粗体排版，高对比度但色调柔和：混凝土灰、黑、白、哑光棕。仅在面部遮罩和左下角宣传标题处添加水平数字失真效果。保持构图简洁、具有杂志编辑感且符合宣传标准。

约束条件：不要添加额外的模特、道具、Logo 或其他文本。保持所有排版清晰易读，并像豪华街头服饰海报一样对齐。确保模特居中于巨大的报头下方。

templates.title: Japanese Thermometer Day Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日本“温度计之日”宣传海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese awareness poster for {argument name="observance date" default="May 14"}, Thermometer Day, combining a clean educational infographic with a realistic model wearing a themed T-shirt.

Canvas: Tall vertical social-media poster, 9:16 aspect ratio, pale ice-blue background, soft clinical lighting, clean magazine-style layout, blue and red accent palette.

Main subject: On the right half, place a realistic young Japanese woman with a neat chin-length black bob haircut, facing forward from upper thighs up. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur/mosaic block. She wears a fitted short-sleeve gradient T-shirt fading from sky blue on the left to pink/red on the right. The shirt text reads exactly: “5/14” on the first line, “温度計の日” large below, and “ドイツの物理学者 ファーレンハイトの誕生日” in small text underneath. She holds a white digital thermometer delicately near her shoulder in her right hand.

Top section: On the left, large Japanese headline text reads “5月14日は” and then “温度計の日”, with “温度計” in dark blue and “の日” in red. Add a small line-art thermometer icon above/right of the headline with “°C”. Subtitle below: “— 暮らしを支える、温度のものさし —”. Add a short explanatory paragraph in small Japanese text describing that May 14 is Thermometer Day, related to the German physicist Fahrenheit and the importance of temperature measurement for science, personal life, safety, and comfort.

Decorative icons: Include exactly 3 pale blue scientific/weather icons in the upper-middle left background: 1 vertical thermometer icon, 1 globe icon, and 1 laboratory flask icon.

Middle infographic section: Add a heading “温度計が活躍する場面” with a yellow underline. Beneath it, create exactly 3 rounded rectangular cards in a row, each with a blue outline, a small icon, a bold Japanese title, explanatory text, and a photo thumbnail:
1. Heart icon, title “健康管理に”, text about measuring body temperature and noticing changes early, thumbnail of a digital thermometer on a soft towel showing 36.5.
2. Cooking pot icon, title “料理・暮らしに”, text about cooking temperature control and bath temperature adjustment, thumbnail of a thermometer inserted into a steaming cooking pot.
3. Lab flask icon, title “研究・産業に”, text about accurate temperature measurement supporting technology and products, thumbnail of glass beakers/test tubes with a pipette.

Bottom section: Add a closing heading “温度を知ることは、未来を守ること” in dark blue, a thin horizontal rule, two lines of smaller Japanese explanatory text about climate awareness and protecting life and Earth’s future, and a final red call-to-action line: “今日は温度計に、ちょっと注目してみませんか?” Place a faint green-blue Earth-with-sprout icon at the bottom right.

Visual style: Clean Japanese public-information poster, realistic photography for the woman and card thumbnails, flat minimalist icons, soft shadows, rounded card corners, plenty of white space, professional print layout, no watermark, no extra logos. Use crisp readable Japanese typography and keep the exact visible section count: one top headline section, one model figure, three decorative icons, three application cards, and one bottom message section.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="observance date" default="5 月 14 日"} “温度计之日”创作一张垂直构图的日本宣传海报，将简洁的教育信息图表与身着主题 T 恤的写实模特相结合。

画布：高垂直比例社交媒体海报，9:16 纵横比，淡冰蓝色背景，柔和的临床医学风格光影，简洁的杂志式排版，蓝红配色方案。

主体：在右半部分，放置一位写实风格的年轻日本女性，留着整洁的下巴长度黑色波波头，从大腿上方起正面朝向镜头。她的面部被刻意用一个简单的矩形模糊/马赛克块遮挡。她穿着一件修身的短袖渐变 T 恤，颜色从左侧的天蓝色渐变到右侧的粉/红色。T 恤上的文字需准确显示：第一行“5/14”，下方大字“温度計の日”，底部小字“ドイツの物理学者 ファーレンハイトの誕生日”。她右手在肩部附近轻握一支白色电子温度计。

顶部区域：左侧放置醒目的日文标题“5月14日は”和“温度計の日”，其中“温度計”为深蓝色，“の日”为红色。在标题上方/右侧添加一个小型线条风格的温度计图标，并标注“°C”。下方副标题：“— 暮らしを支える、温度のものさし —”。添加一段简短的日文说明文字，介绍 5 月 14 日是温度计之日，与德国物理学家华氏（Fahrenheit）的生日有关，并强调温度测量对于科学、日常生活、安全和舒适的重要性。

装饰图标：在左上方背景中添加 3 个淡蓝色科学/天气图标：1 个垂直温度计图标、1 个地球图标和 1 个实验室烧瓶图标。

中部信息图表区域：添加标题“温度計が活躍する場面”，下方带有黄色下划线。在其下方，横向排列 3 个圆角矩形卡片，每个卡片均带有蓝色边框、小图标、加粗的日文标题、说明文字和照片缩略图：
1. 爱心图标，标题“健康管理に”，文字内容关于测量体温及及早发现身体变化，缩略图为放在柔软毛巾上显示 36.5 度的电子温度计。
2. 烹饪锅图标，标题“料理・暮らしに”，文字内容关于烹饪温度控制和洗澡水温调节，缩略图为插入冒着热气的烹饪锅中的温度计。
3. 实验室烧瓶图标，标题“研究・産業に”，文字内容关于精确的温度测量如何支持技术与产品研发，缩略图为带有移液管的玻璃烧杯/试管。

底部区域：添加深蓝色结束语标题“温度を知ることは、未来を守ること”，下方加一条细水平线，两行较小的日文说明文字，内容关于气候意识以及保护生命和地球的未来，最后是一行红色的行动号召语：“今日は温度計に、ちょっと注目してみませんか?” 在右下角放置一个淡淡的绿蓝色“地球与嫩芽”图标。

视觉风格：简洁的日本公共信息海报，模特和卡片缩略图采用写实摄影风格，扁平化极简图标，柔和阴影，圆角卡片，留白充足，专业印刷排版，无水印，无额外 Logo。使用清晰易读的日文字体，并严格保持以下板块布局：一个顶部标题区、一个模特形象、三个装饰图标、三个应用场景卡片以及一个底部信息区。

templates.title: NOVALITH Mobile SaaS Onboarding Screen

titleLocalized.zh: NOVALITH 移动端 SaaS 入门引导页

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished mobile onboarding/top screen for a fictional B2B data platform named {argument name="brand name" default="NOVALITH"}, in a premium Japanese SaaS visual style.

Canvas: Vertical smartphone screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, white background, iOS status bar at the top showing 9:41 with signal, Wi-Fi, and battery icons. Use generous margins and a clean app-advertising composition.

Layout: Place the NOVALITH logo near the top left, with a geometric turquoise-blue “N” mark and wide-spaced navy wordmark. Below it, set a large bold Japanese headline in dark navy: {argument name="headline text" default="データを、未来の意思決定に変える。"}. Under the headline, add a smaller two-line Japanese description: {argument name="body text" default="開発・運用・データの複雑さを解消し、信頼できるデータ基盤で、事業の成長を加速させます。"}. On the lower left, show exactly 3 feature blurbs with thin cyan outline icons: 1) stacked layers icon, title “統合された基盤”, description “データとシステムを一元的に統合”; 2) shield check icon, title “堅牢なガバナンス”, description “セキュリティと品質を標準で確保”; 3) rising bar chart icon, title “高速な意思決定”, description “信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速”.

Hero visual: On the right half, create a large glossy 3D smartphone card tilted slightly backward, overlapping a translucent teal-blue architectural block and a giant faceted 3D letter N behind it. The phone screen shows a Japanese dashboard UI with exactly 4 dashboard sections: 1) top metric cards, with “データパイプライン 128 +2.4%” and “データ品質スコア 98.6% +2.4%”; 2) pipeline status row with three connected icons labeled “データソース 24”, “処理中 128”, and “出力先 36”, plus small status dots; 3) line chart titled “データ量の推移” with dates from 5/06 to 5/12; 4) donut chart titled “データソース健全性” showing “96% 健全” and a legend with “健全 46”, “警告 3”, “エラー 1”. Keep the dashboard text small but believable and neatly aligned.

Bottom navigation and actions: Center exactly 3 small carousel dots above the buttons; the first dot is teal and active, the other two are pale gray. Add exactly 2 rounded buttons at the bottom: a filled teal gradient primary button labeled {argument name="primary button label" default="はじめる"} with a right arrow icon, and a white secondary button with teal outline labeled {argument name="secondary button label" default="あとで始める"}.

Visual style: Futuristic enterprise data analytics, crisp vector UI mixed with soft 3D glassmorphism. Palette is white, deep navy, cyan, teal, and aqua gradients. Add subtle polygon network lines, tiny nodes, faint dotted patterns, and light geometric overlays across the background. Use soft shadows, clean Japanese typography, high contrast, and a premium App Store marketing feel. Avoid clutter, avoid extra buttons, avoid extra feature items, and do not add watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="NOVALITH"} 的虚构 B2B 数据平台创建一个精致的移动端入门/首屏页面，采用高级日式 SaaS 视觉风格。

画布：竖屏智能手机截图，9:16 比例，白色背景，顶部 iOS 状态栏显示 9:41，包含信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标。使用宽裕的边距和简洁的 App 广告排版。

布局：将 NOVALITH 标志放置在左上角附近，包含几何青蓝色“N”图标和宽间距的深蓝色文字标识。在下方设置一个深蓝色的大号加粗日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="データを、未来の意思決定に変える。"}。在标题下方，添加一段较小的两行日文描述：{argument name="body text" default="開発・運用・データの複雑さを解消し、信頼できるデータ基盤で、事業の成長を加速させます。"}。在左下方，展示 3 个带有细青色轮廓图标的功能简介：1) 堆叠图层图标，标题“統合された基盤”，描述“データとシステムを一元的に統合”；2) 盾牌勾选图标，标题“堅牢なガバナンス”，描述“セキュリティと品質を標準で確保”；3) 上升柱状图图标，标题“高速な意思決定”，描述“信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速”。

主视觉：在右半部分，创建一个大型光泽 3D 智能手机卡片，略微向后倾斜，与半透明青蓝色建筑块以及后方巨大的多面 3D 字母 N 重叠。手机屏幕显示一个日文仪表盘 UI，包含 4 个仪表盘区域：1) 顶部指标卡片，显示“データパイプライン 128 +2.4%”和“データ品質スコア 98.6% +2.4%”；2) 管道状态行，带有三个连接的图标，分别标注“データソース 24”、“処理中 128”和“出力先 36”，并带有小状态点；3) 标题为“データ量の推移”的折线图，日期从 5/06 到 5/12；4) 标题为“データソース健全性”的环形图，显示“96% 健全”以及图例“健全 46”、“警告 3”、“エラー 1”。保持仪表盘文字精简且真实，对齐整齐。

底部导航与操作：在按钮上方居中放置 3 个小型轮播点；第一个点为青色且处于激活状态，其余两个为浅灰色。底部添加 2 个圆角按钮：一个填充青色渐变的主按钮，标注 {argument name="primary button label" default="はじめる"} 并带有向右箭头图标；以及一个带有青色轮廓的白色次要按钮，标注 {argument name="secondary button label" default="あとで始める"}。

视觉风格：未来感企业级数据分析，清晰的矢量 UI 结合柔和的 3D 玻璃拟态。调色板为白色、深海军蓝、青色、蓝绿色和水绿色渐变。在背景中添加细微的多边形网络线、微小节点、淡淡的圆点图案和轻盈的几何叠加层。使用柔和的阴影、整洁的日文字体、高对比度，营造高级的 App Store 营销感。避免杂乱，避免多余的按钮，避免多余的功能项，且不要添加水印。

Goal: Create a polished fictional SaaS landing page hero for a data infrastructure and analytics platform named {argument name="brand name" default="NOVALITH"}, in a premium Japanese B2B technology style.

Canvas: Wide desktop web landing page, 16:9 aspect ratio, clean white background with pale cyan gradients, subtle network-line geometry, faint dot matrices, and glossy floor reflections. Use a futuristic corporate palette of deep navy, teal, cyan, and white.

Header: Top-left logo with a large angular gradient cyan-to-navy “N” icon followed by spaced uppercase wordmark “NOVALITH”. Across the top center place exactly five Japanese navigation items: 「プロダクト」, 「ソリューション」, 「ドキュメント」, 「リソース」, 「会社情報」. Top-right has 「ログイン」 and a rounded teal CTA button labeled {argument name="contact button text" default="お問い合わせ"} with a right arrow.

Hero layout: Left side contains a large bold navy Japanese headline in two lines: {argument name="headline text" default="データを、未来の意思決定に変える。"}. Under it place a smaller Japanese subheadline: {argument name="subheadline text" default="NOVALITHは、開発・運用・データの複雑さを解消し、信頼できるデータ基盤で、事業の成長を加速させます。"}

Feature row: Beneath the subheadline show exactly three compact feature blocks, each with a thin teal line icon, bold Japanese title, and two-line description. The three blocks are: 1) stacked-layers icon, title 「統合された基盤」, description 「データとシステムを一元的に統合」; 2) shield-check icon, title 「堅牢なガバナンス」, description 「セキュリティと品質を標準で確保」; 3) rising chart arrow icon, title 「高速な意思決定」, description 「信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速」.

Hero buttons: Below the feature row place exactly two rounded buttons: a filled teal primary button labeled {argument name="primary cta text" default="プロダクトを見る"} with a right arrow, and a white outlined secondary button labeled 「資料をダウンロード」 with a download icon.

Right side visual: Create a large tilted floating dashboard panel with rounded corners, soft shadow, and a glossy white UI. Behind it place a monumental 3D translucent teal/navy “N” structure and angular cyan glass panels, extending off the right edge. The dashboard should show a sidebar, top utility icons, analytics cards, line charts, a pipeline diagram, an alert table, and a donut chart.

Dashboard details: Include exactly six sidebar menu items: 「ダッシュボード」 highlighted in teal, 「データカタログ」, 「パイプライン」, 「モニタリング」, 「ガバナンス」, 「アラート」. Include exactly four top statistic cards with labels and values: 「データパイプライン」 128, 「データ品質スコア」 98.6%, 「アクティブユーザー」 1,256, 「処理データ量」 2.45 PB. Include exactly three nodes in the pipeline diagram connected by lines, an alert table with exactly four rows, and a donut chart labeled 96% with a three-item legend.

Visual style: Crisp vector-like UI mixed with photorealistic 3D glass, airy spacing, premium startup landing page aesthetics, high readability, soft shadows, subtle cyan glow, accurate Japanese typography, no people, no clutter, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="NOVALITH"} 的数据基础设施与分析平台，创建一个精致的虚构 SaaS 着陆页首屏，采用优质的日本 B2B 科技风格。

画布：宽屏桌面网页，16:9 比例，简洁的白色背景搭配淡青色渐变，辅以微妙的网格线条几何图形、浅淡的点阵以及光洁的地面反射。使用深蓝、青色、蓝绿色和白色的未来感企业配色方案。

页眉：左上角放置 Logo，包含一个大型棱角分明的青色至深蓝色渐变“N”图标，后接间距适中的大写字母商标“NOVALITH”。顶部中央放置五个日语导航项： 「プロダクト」、「ソリューション」、「ドキュメント」、「リソース」、「会社情報」。右上角设有 「ログイン」 以及一个圆角青色 CTA 按钮，标签为 {argument name="contact button text" default="お問い合わせ"}，并带有向右箭头。

首屏布局：左侧包含两行醒目的深蓝色日语大标题： {argument name="headline text" default="データを、未来の意思決定に変える。"}。下方放置一行较小的日语副标题： {argument name="subheadline text" default="NOVALITHは、開発・運用・データの複雑さを解消し、信頼できるデータ基盤で、事業の成長を加速させます。"}

功能行：在副标题下方展示三个紧凑的功能模块，每个模块配有细青色线条图标、加粗的日语标题和两行描述。这三个模块分别为：1) 堆叠层图标，标题 「統合された基盤」，描述 「データとシステムを一元的に統合」；2) 盾牌勾选图标，标题 「堅牢なガバナンス」，描述 「セキュリティと品質を標準で確保」；3) 上升趋势图图标，标题 「高速な意思決定」，描述 「信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速」。

首屏按钮：在功能行下方放置两个圆角按钮：一个填充青色的主按钮，标签为 {argument name="primary cta text" default="プロダクトを見る"}，并带有向右箭头；以及一个白色轮廓的次要按钮，标签为 「資料をダウンロード」，并带有下载图标。

右侧视觉：创建一个大型倾斜悬浮的仪表盘面板，具有圆角、柔和阴影和光洁的白色 UI。其后方放置一个巨大的 3D 半透明青色/深蓝色“N”结构和棱角分明的青色玻璃面板，延伸至右侧边缘。仪表盘应显示侧边栏、顶部实用图标、分析卡片、折线图、流水线图、警报表格和环形图。

仪表盘细节：包含六个侧边栏菜单项：以青色高亮的 「ダッシュボード」、「データカタログ」、「パイプライン」、「モニタリング」、「ガバナンス」、「アラート」。包含四个顶部统计卡片，带有标签和数值： 「データパイプライン」 128、「データ品質スコア」 98.6%、「アクティブユーザー」 1,256、「処理データ量」 2.45 PB。流水线图中包含三个由线条连接的节点，警报表格包含四行数据，环形图标注为 96% 并配有三项图例。

视觉风格：清晰的矢量风格 UI 结合写实的 3D 玻璃质感，布局通透，具备优质初创公司着陆页的美学特征，高可读性，柔和阴影，微妙的青色光晕，准确的日语排版，无人物，无杂乱元素，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫巫女角色设定集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an anime character reference sheet featuring {argument name="character name" default="a young shrine maiden girl"} in a consistent red-and-white miko outfit, shown as a collection of full-body poses and expression variations on a clean white background.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, high-resolution, white background with a very faint pale-gray grid and thin rectangular panel divisions like a character design board. Use crisp clean anime line art, soft cel shading, polished digital illustration, and consistent proportions across all versions.

Layout: Arrange exactly 15 full-body character figures in a loose 5-column by 3-row reference-sheet composition. The central figure is the largest and tallest, placed in the middle, front-facing, occupying most of the vertical height. The other 14 figures are smaller surrounding pose variations, each inside its own faint panel. Keep generous white space and avoid any text labels.

Subject details: The character is a petite teenage anime girl with very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair reaching past the waist, blunt bangs, small side locks, pale skin, and red eyes when visible. She wears a traditional shrine maiden outfit: white kimono-style top with wide sleeves, red trim and red stitch-like sleeve markings, red hakama skirt with deep pleats, a large red waist bow/sash, white tabi socks, and red-and-white sandals. The outfit should remain consistent in every pose.

Pose and expression count: Include exactly 15 discrete figures: 1 large central front-facing neutral full-body pose with a softly blurred/featureless face; 2 top-left jumping pose with clenched fists and blurred face; 3 top-second standing pose with one hand on hip and blurred face; 4 top-center close-up standing pose with blurred face; 5 top-fourth small front-facing neutral pose with visible calm face; 6 top-right shy standing pose with clenched fists and blurred face; 7 middle-left embarrassed side pose with visible blushing face and one raised hand; 8 middle-second smiling bashful pose with visible closed eyes; 9 middle-fourth small front-facing curious pose with visible open eyes; 10 middle-right crying flustered pose with both hands raised and visible tears; 11 bottom-left hand-on-hip standing pose with blurred face; 12 bottom-second side-facing pointing pose with blurred face; 13 bottom-center small hand-on-hip pose with blurred face; 14 bottom-fourth simple standing pose with blurred face; 15 bottom-right dynamic playful pose with visible face, flowing hair, one hand making a peace sign and the other arm extended.

Visual style: Modern Japanese anime character-sheet style, glossy dark hair highlights, soft blush where visible, clean red-and-white color palette, elegant shrine maiden aesthetic, balanced proportions, subtle shadows beneath feet, no background scenery.

Constraints: No words, no logos, no watermark, no extra characters, no props. Keep all 15 figures recognizable as the same character and keep the miko outfit identical across every pose.
