templates.title: Modern Mojito Recipe Card

titleLocalized.zh: 现代莫吉托 (Mojito) 配方卡

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a visually stunning modern recipe card for {argument name="cocktail name" default="Mojito"}, presented as a luxurious tropical social-media recipe poster.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 portrait layout, bright white background with soft beach-and-ocean blur behind the hero drink, airy margins, watercolor lime-green splashes around the edges, subtle mint leaf textures, gold ornamental line accents, and a fresh upscale cocktail-bar aesthetic.

Layout: Top-left title area with a tiny gold cocktail icon, the small uppercase label “CUBAN SUMMER DRINK,” a huge flowing dark-green script title “Mojito,” then the tagline “cool • citrusy • refreshing.” Under it add a short description: “A classic Cuban cocktail with crisp mint, zesty lime, and a splash of sunshine.” Add a handwritten line: “Sip. Relax. Repeat.” On the right side place a tall crystal highball glass filled with crushed ice, lime wedges, mint leaves, bubbles, and condensation, garnished with a lime wheel and mint sprig; include tropical palm shadows and limes/mint on the table.

Ingredients section: Create one elegant bordered card labeled “INGREDIENTS” with exactly 6 ingredient rows, each with a small watercolor-style icon and text: 1) “1 Lime” with subtext “cut into wedges,” 2) “10–12 Mint Leaves” with subtext “fresh & fragrant,” 3) “Soda Water” with subtext “to top up,” 4) “2 tsp Sugar” with subtext “adjust to taste,” 5) “60 ml White Rum” with subtext “(2 oz),” 6) “Crushed Ice” with subtext “as much as you love.”

Tip card: To the right of the ingredients, add one smaller pale-green bordered card with mint illustration and exactly 2 text blocks: top label “TIP” with the note “Lightly crush mint — don’t over-muddle,” and bottom label “PERFECT BALANCE” with “1 Lime : 2 tsp Sugar” plus handwritten text “sweet, citrusy, just right!”

How-to section: Along the lower half, add the heading “HOW TO MAKE THE PERFECT MOJITO” and exactly 5 numbered illustrated steps connected by small gold arrows: 1) muddling mint, sugar, and lime in a glass with a wooden muddler, caption “Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime. Gently press to release the flavors.” 2) filling a glass with crushed ice, caption “Fill glass with crushed ice. Crushed ice = maximum chill.” 3) pouring white rum and soda water into the glass, caption “Pour white rum and soda water. Add rum, then top up with soda water.” 4) stirring with a bar spoon, caption “Stir gently for balanced flavor. Mix lightly to keep it refreshing.” 5) finished mojito with mint sprig and lime wheel, caption “Garnish with mint sprig and lime wheel. The final touch of summer.”

Footer: Add small uppercase text “REFRESHING • VIBRANT • TIMELESS” and handwritten gold script “Made for sunny days and good vibes!” with a small heart doodle. Decorate the corners with watercolor lime slices, mint sprigs, ice cubes, bubbles, and splashes.

Visual style: Minimal yet artistic, polished editorial recipe-card design, watercolor botanical accents mixed with realistic cocktail photography, fresh lime green, mint green, white, pale aqua, and muted gold. Use elegant serif/sans-serif typography paired with large hand-lettered script for the title.

Constraints: Keep all text legible, maintain the exact counts of 6 ingredient rows, 2 tip-card text blocks, and 5 numbered preparation steps. No people, no watermark, no extra recipe steps, no clutter.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="cocktail name" default="Mojito"} 创建一张视觉效果惊艳的现代配方卡，呈现为奢华的热带社交媒体配方海报。

画布：垂直 2:3 纵向布局，明亮的白色背景，主饮品后方带有柔和的沙滩与海洋虚化效果，留白充裕，边缘饰有水彩青柠绿色泼墨，带有细腻的薄荷叶纹理、金色装饰线条，营造出清新高端的鸡尾酒吧美学。

布局：左上角为标题区，配有一个精致的金色鸡尾酒小图标，上方标注小号大写文字“CUBAN SUMMER DRINK”，下方为巨大的深绿色流线型手写标题“Mojito”，随后是标语“cool • citrusy • refreshing”。下方添加简短描述：“一款经典的古巴鸡尾酒，融合了清脆的薄荷、浓郁的青柠和一抹阳光的味道。” 添加一行手写文字：“Sip. Relax. Repeat.” 右侧放置一个高大的水晶高球杯，杯中盛满碎冰、青柠角、薄荷叶、气泡和冷凝水珠，并以青柠片和薄荷枝装饰；桌面上包含热带棕榈树阴影以及青柠和薄荷点缀。

配料部分：创建一个优雅的带边框卡片，标注为“INGREDIENTS”，包含 6 行配料，每行配有一个小型水彩风格图标和文字：1) “1 Lime” 附带子标题 “切成角”，2) “10–12 Mint Leaves” 附带子标题 “新鲜且芬芳”，3) “Soda Water” 附带子标题 “加满”，4) “2 tsp Sugar” 附带子标题 “按口味调整”，5) “60 ml White Rum” 附带子标题 “(2 oz)”，6) “Crushed Ice” 附带子标题 “随心添加”。

小贴士卡片：在配料右侧，添加一张较小的浅绿色边框卡片，配有薄荷插图和 2 个文本块：顶部标签 “TIP” 附带说明 “轻压薄荷即可，切勿过度捣碎”，底部标签 “PERFECT BALANCE” 附带 “1 Lime : 2 tsp Sugar” 以及手写文字 “甜度、酸度，恰到好处！”

制作方法部分：在下半部分，添加标题 “HOW TO MAKE THE PERFECT MOJITO” 和 5 个带插图的编号步骤，步骤间由金色小箭头连接：1) 在玻璃杯中捣碎薄荷、糖和青柠，配文 “用木制捣棒将薄荷叶与糖和青柠捣碎。轻轻按压以释放风味。” 2) 在杯中装满碎冰，配文 “装满碎冰。碎冰 = 极致清凉。” 3) 倒入白朗姆酒和苏打水，配文 “倒入白朗姆酒和苏打水。先加朗姆酒，再加满苏打水。” 4) 用吧勺搅拌，配文 “轻轻搅拌以平衡风味。轻微混合以保持清爽口感。” 5) 完成莫吉托，装饰薄荷枝和青柠片，配文 “装饰薄荷枝和青柠片。夏日的最后点缀。”

页脚：添加小号大写文字 “REFRESHING • VIBRANT • TIMELESS” 以及金色手写体 “Made for sunny days and good vibes!” 并配有一个爱心涂鸦。角落处装饰水彩青柠片、薄荷枝、冰块、气泡和水花。

视觉风格：极简而富有艺术感，精致的编辑级配方卡设计，水彩植物元素与写实鸡尾酒摄影相结合，色调为清新青柠绿、薄荷绿、白色、浅水蓝色和哑光金。采用优雅的衬线/无衬线字体，并搭配标题的大号手写体。

约束条件：确保所有文字清晰易读，严格保持 6 行配料、2 个小贴士文本块和 5 个编号制作步骤。画面中不得出现人物，不得有水印，不得添加额外步骤，保持画面整洁。

templates.title: Cute Retro Chengdu Cartoon Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱复古成都卡通海报

templates.prompt: Create a cute retro cartoon travel-poster cityscape of {argument name="city name" default="Chengdu"}, in a naive children's picture-book style with ultra-simplified chunky architecture, exaggerated proportions, bold thick black outlines, bright flat colors, halftone comic-paper texture, slight ink misregistration, and a sunny turquoise-blue sky. Use a vertical 3:4 poster composition. At the top, place huge arched yellow bubble letters reading “{argument name="headline text" default="CHENGDU"}” with black shadow, and beneath it red Chinese characters “成都” flanked by two red dots. Make the clear central focus a stylized panda-head building inspired by Chengdu panda landmarks: a large geometric white-and-black panda face structure at the bottom center with a blue glass entrance, stairs, shrubs, and flowers, with a tall slim TV tower rising directly behind it. Include exactly 3 panda motifs: the giant panda-head building, a small cheerful waving panda mascot in the lower left foreground beside a sign, and a red circular passport-stamp graphic in the upper right that says “WELCOME TO CHENGDU” with a panda face. Include exactly 5 puffy cream clouds with peach shading: one large cloud on the upper left, one large cloud on the upper right, one partial cloud entering from the lower left edge, one small cloud near the left-middle skyline, and one small cloud near the right-middle sky. Build a simplified skyline along the bottom with colorful rectangular buildings in teal, yellow, pink, orange, and blue, plus green treetops. Add a traditional Chinese pavilion on the lower left with green tiled roofs, red lanterns, and a small sign with Chinese-style characters; add a yellow vertical building sign on the right reading “太古里”; add a cream arched bridge over bright blue water on the lower right. In the lower left foreground, place a sign reading “I ♥ CHENGDU” next to the waving panda. Keep all forms rounded, toy-like, and geometric, with minimal detail, thick outlines, warm cheerful colors, vintage postcard energy, and no photorealism.

templates.title: Handmade Play-Doh City Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 手工橡皮泥城市场景

templates.prompt:
Create a whimsical 3:4 editorial-style illustration of a five-year-old child sitting at a warm craft table, proudly creating a handmade Play-Doh version of {argument name="city" default="London"}. The entire miniature world should clearly feel sculpted by a real child using colorful modeling clay, soft rounded edges, uneven shapes, tiny fingerprints, squishy textures, crooked little buildings, playful proportions, and charming imperfections throughout.

The clay city should be packed with delightful tiny details: recognizable landmarks, rivers, bridges, cafés, food carts, parks, trains, buses, apartment buildings, trees, street scenes, market stalls, miniature clay people, clouds, and cozy neighborhood moments. Everything should feel imaginative, dense, lively, and lovingly handmade rather than professionally modeled.

The child should look natural and believable, wearing simple everyday clothes with a joyful, curious expression while interacting with the miniature city. Avoid costume-like outfits or exaggerated styling.

Art direction: premium children’s magazine illustration, handcrafted claymation-inspired aesthetic, cozy Scandinavian editorial atmosphere, miniature diorama photography feel, emotionally warm storytelling, highly detailed but soft and playful.

Lighting should feel bright, airy, and naturally diffused with soft indoor daylight, clean whites, fresh pastel Play-Doh colors, subtle cool-neutral tones, gentle highlights, and luminous soft shadows.

No logos, fake text, AI artifacts, hyper-detailed realism, or sterile perfection.

Bottom-right corner: add a small handwritten white crayon sentence:
“Let’s play in {argument name="city name" default="London"}”
The handwriting should feel cute, childlike, uneven, and naturally imperfect.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张充满奇思妙想的 3:4 编辑风格插画，画面中一个五岁的孩子坐在温暖的手工桌前，自豪地用橡皮泥制作了一个手工版的 {argument name="city" default="London"}。整个微型世界应呈现出真实的儿童手工捏造感，包括色彩鲜艳的橡皮泥、圆润的边缘、不规则的形状、细小的指纹、柔软的质感、歪歪扭扭的小建筑、充满童趣的比例以及随处可见的迷人瑕疵。

这座橡皮泥城市应充满令人愉悦的微小细节：可辨认的地标、河流、桥梁、咖啡馆、餐车、公园、火车、公交车、公寓楼、树木、街景、摊位、微型橡皮泥小人、云朵以及温馨的社区瞬间。一切都应显得富有想象力、内容丰富、生动活泼，且带有手工制作的温情，而非专业建模的质感。

孩子看起来应自然可信，穿着简单的日常服装，表情快乐而好奇，正在与这座微型城市互动。避免使用戏服般的装扮或夸张的造型。

艺术指导：高端儿童杂志插画，受粘土动画启发的手工美学，温馨的斯堪的纳维亚编辑氛围，微型立体模型摄影感，情感温暖的叙事风格，细节丰富但柔和且充满童趣。

光线应明亮、通透，采用自然漫射的室内日光，色调包含干净的白色、清新的橡皮泥粉彩色、微妙的冷中性色调，并带有柔和的高光和明亮的柔影。

不要包含任何标志、伪文字、AI 伪影、超写实细节或刻板的完美感。

右下角：添加一行用白色蜡笔手写的短句：
“Let’s play in {argument name="city name" default="London"}”
笔迹应显得可爱、稚嫩、不均匀且自然不完美。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Fashion Editorial Portrait

templates.prompt:
A full-body, ultra-detailed cinematic fashion editorial portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="beautiful Asian woman"} with perfectly preserved facial identity and natural facial proportions, seated confidently on a {argument name="vehicle" default="futuristic yellow-and-black cyberpunk motorcycle"}. The aesthetic blends {argument name="style" default="Neo-Tokyo street culture"} with luxury avant-garde techwear fashion, photographed in a premium studio setting.
She wears an intricate white technical hood featuring embedded red optical sensor details, layered beneath a bold yellow armored shoulder mantle with exposed metallic bolts and industrial mechanical design. Her torso is wrapped in a weathered cybernetic corset with bronze-toned gears, exposed wiring, layered mechanical plating, and subtle battle-worn textures over a fitted white tactical inner suit.
Her sleeves are dramatically oversized with a rich pink satin-silk texture, featuring bold black Japanese-inspired typography and subtle distressed detailing. She wears black tactical fingerless leather gloves with realistic stitching and matte carbon textures.
The lower outfit consists of high-waisted charcoal-black oversized techwear cargo pants with utility straps, hanging buckles, reinforced seams, and minimal red accents. On her feet are chunky futuristic yellow-and-red high-top sneakers with thick mechanical soles, intricate layered panels, red lacing, metallic trims, and realistic rubber textures.
Face remains highly realistic and naturally beautiful with visible pores, fine skin texture, subtle under-eye detail, sharp eyeliner, high-arched dark eyebrows, soft matte red lips, and glossy realistic eyes. No plastic skin, no AI smoothing, no exaggerated anime features. Expression is calm, cool, confident, and determined, with a slight head tilt creating a commanding hero-like presence.
Camera angle is a dramatic low-angle hero shot emphasizing power, scale, and cinematic attitude. Her right leg is extended naturally to the ground while her upper body turns slightly toward the lens. Hands rest casually near the handlebars in a poised, ready stance.
Background is a clean white high-fashion studio with large bold red Japanese kanji typography and futuristic editorial graphic elements arranged like a premium magazine cover. Minimalist cyberpunk composition with subtle floating UI-inspired design accents.
Lighting is cinematic Rembrandt lighting with soft directional key light shaping the face and outfit folds, combined with subtle rim lighting to separate her silhouette from the white backdrop. Metallic bike surfaces reflect realistic highlights and volumetric studio atmosphere.
Shot on Fujifilm GFX 100 II with an 85mm f/1.4 lens, ultra-shallow depth of field, razor-sharp facial detail, cinematic color grading, photorealistic materials, weathered metal textures, silk fabric realism, denim grain, rubber detailing, volumetric lighting, ultra-HD, 8K, masterpiece quality, editorial fashion photography, hyper-realistic cyberpunk aesthetic.

Ultra-realistic 16:9 close-up studio photograph of an {argument name="nationality" default="Algerian"} citizenship identity card placed on a clean light grey or soft neutral background. The card is horizontally aligned, centered in frame, captured in sharp macro focus with soft diffused studio lighting.

The design follows an official Algerian government-issued identity document aesthetic with multilingual typography, engraved security artwork, and advanced anti-counterfeit detailing inspired by modern North African national ID systems.

Large bold header at top reads: “الجمهورية الجزائرية الديمقراطية الشعبية” with secondary French title “RÉPUBLIQUE ALGÉRIENNE DÉMOCRATIQUE ET POPULAIRE” and subtitle “CARTE DE CITOYENNETÉ / CITIZENSHIP CARD.”

Top-left corner features the Algerian national flag with red crescent and star emblem. Upper-right includes the national coat of arms of Algeria.

The card contains a passport-style portrait of a young Algerian woman:
– Warm olive North African skin tone with realistic natural texture
– Medium-length dark brown or black hair with soft waves
– Dark brown eyes, neutral expression, direct gaze
– Minimal makeup with documentary realism
– Wearing a dark blazer or black formal top with subtle gold jewelry

Personal identity information displayed in Arabic, French, and English format:
– اللقب / Nom / {argument name="last name label" default="Surname"}: BENYAHIA
– الاسم / Prénom / {argument name="name" default="LEÏLA AMEL"}
– تاريخ الميلاد / Date de naissance / {argument name="birth date" default="14 MAI / MAY 1993"}
– مكان الميلاد / Lieu de naissance / Place of Birth: ALGER, ALGÉRIE
– الجنسية / Nationalité / Nationality: ALGÉRIENNE
– رقم المواطنة / Numéro de citoyenneté / Citizenship Number: DZA1234567
– تاريخ الإصدار / Date de délivrance / Date of Issue: 20 MAI / MAY 2024
– تاريخ الانتهاء / Date d’expiration / Date of Expiry: 20 MAI / MAY 2034
– الجنس / Sexe / Sex: F

Security and design features include:
– Intricate guilloche security line patterns across the entire card surface
– Fine microprinted anti-counterfeit textures

– Circular “DZA” holographic security seal
– Crescent and star holographic motif integrated into security elements
– Faint outline map of Algeria embedded into background texture
– Detailed engraved illustration of Algiers skyline and Martyrs’ Memorial across the right side
– Decorative geometric Islamic-inspired engraving patterns blended into background
– Machine-readable identity strip along bottom edge
– Signature at bottom: “Leïla A. Benyahia”

Additional design styling:
– Soft green, white, silver, and red gradients inspired by the Algerian flag
– Polycarbonate laminated card texture with realistic reflections and embossed micro-detail
– Modern high-security government document appearance with engraved banknote-style illustration work

Lighting is soft and evenly diffused, emphasizing holographic effects, engraved textures, and realistic print detail without harsh shadows.

promptLocalized.zh:

templates.title: Cinematic Character Design Pitch Board

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级角色设计提案项目

templates.prompt: Create a single-page cinematic character design board for an original fictional character named “{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"[CHARACTER NAME]\"}”. Style: premium film pre-production pitch board, photorealistic cinematic concept art, professional visual development presentation, high-end art department aesthetics. Composition: Avoid generic grids, symmetrical layouts, or rigid template-like formatting. The page should feel like a professional director’s pitch board rather than a standard character sheet. Use an asymmetric, cinematic, story-driven composition with varied panel sizes, organic spacing, selective overlap, layered grouping, and a curated editorial rhythm. Let the overall board feel designed, intentional, and visually dynamic — like a real film proposal page created by a director, production designer, or concept artist. Character: {argument name=\"character description\" default=\"[Insert character identity, world, age, role, personality, outfit, materials, mood, and setting.]\"} Include: - one dominant hero portrait as the emotional focal point - supporting full-body turnaround views - expressive head angle studies - wardrobe or costume breakdown - material and texture detail callouts - character overview text - short production notes - color palette swatches - mood references or environmental fragments Design language: Use readable English headings, concise labels, thin divider lines, occasional callout arrows or handwritten notes, and a refined cinematic presentation style. Do not force every section into equal rectangles. Keep the layout fluid, premium, and visually curated. Quality: Highly detailed, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, consistent character identity across all panels, realistic costume materials, believable text structure, no logos, no watermark, no celebrity likeness.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个单页电影级角色设计项目，用于展示原创虚构角色“{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"[CHARACTER NAME]\"}”。风格：高端电影前期制作提案项目、照片级真实感电影概念艺术、专业视觉开发演示、高端艺术部门美学。构图：避免通用的网格、对称布局或刻板的模板化格式。页面应呈现出专业导演提案项目的质感，而非标准的角色设定表。采用非对称、电影化、故事驱动的构图，运用多变的面板尺寸、有机间距、选择性重叠、分层分组以及精心策划的编辑节奏。让整个项目看起来经过精心设计、意图明确且视觉动态十足——就像由导演、美术指导或概念艺术家创作的真实电影提案页面。角色：{argument name=\"character description\" default=\"[请输入角色身份、世界观、年龄、角色定位、性格、服装、材质、氛围和背景。]\"} 包含：- 一个作为情感焦点的核心英雄肖像 - 辅助性的全身转向视图 - 富有表现力的头部角度研究 - 服装或戏服拆解 - 材质和纹理细节标注 - 角色概览文本 - 简短的制作说明 - 色板 - 氛围参考或环境片段。设计语言：使用易读的英文标题、简洁的标签、细分割线、偶尔出现的标注箭头或手写笔记，以及精致的电影化演示风格。不要强行将每个部分放入等大的矩形中。保持布局流畅、高端且视觉上经过精心编排。质量：高度细节化、照片级真实感、电影级光影、所有面板中角色特征保持一致、逼真的服装材质、可信的文本结构，无 Logo，无水印，无名人肖像。

templates.prompt: Please transform this illustration into a modern Paper Sculpture style. Emphasize a rich and dynamic three-dimensional expression, as if thick paper or cardstock has been sculpturally carved, molded, and folded. Represent organic and artistic forms as if paper has been layered and carved out, raised three-dimensionally, or bent. Beautifully depict the sharpness of the paper edges, deep shadows and highlights from layering, and the natural texture and fiber of the paper in detail. Achieve a balance between the weightiness of a sculptural work and the lightness and fragility unique to paper, resulting in a sophisticated beauty characteristic of modern art. Ensure the light hits softly and naturally to emphasize the three-dimensional effect. In particular, keep the paper sculpture effect subtle on the face and skin to maintain a smooth, natural texture and preserve cuteness. For the hair, clothes, and overall silhouette, boldly emphasize the three-dimensional feel and artistic shaping typical of Paper Sculpture. The overall atmosphere should be an impressive and fantastic Paper Sculpture piece that blends a warm, artistic, handmade feel you'd want to touch with modern, refined beauty. Faithfully maintain the composition, character expressions, poses, silhouettes, and key features of the original illustration without any changes.

promptLocalized.zh: 请将此插画转换为现代纸雕风格。强调丰富且充满活力的三维表现力，如同厚纸或卡纸经过雕刻、塑形和折叠而成。表现出有机且艺术的形态，仿佛纸张经过层叠、镂空、立体抬升或弯曲。精细地描绘纸张边缘的锐利感、层叠产生的深邃阴影与高光，以及纸张天然的纹理与纤维。在雕塑作品的厚重感与纸张特有的轻盈脆弱感之间取得平衡，呈现出具有现代艺术特色的精致美感。确保光线柔和自然地投射，以突出立体效果。特别是在面部和皮肤上，保持纸雕效果的细腻，以维持平滑自然的质感并保留可爱感。对于头发、服装和整体轮廓，大胆强调纸雕特有的立体感和艺术造型。整体氛围应呈现为一件令人印象深刻且梦幻的纸雕作品，融合了让人想要触碰的温暖、艺术、手工质感与现代精致之美。在不进行任何更改的前提下，忠实保留原插画的构图、角色表情、姿势、轮廓及关键特征。

templates.title: Multi-Layered Cyborg Transformation Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 多层赛博格改造提示词

templates.prompt:
[Main Prompt]
Based on the person or character in the attached image, maintain the original facial features, eyes, hairstyle, color, expression, body type, clothing, pose, composition, color scheme, lighting, and background atmosphere as much as possible, while depicting them as a cyborg-like entity with an internal mechanical skeleton. While keeping the overall appearance looking like the original, parts of the outer skin or surface should be peeled away according to the chosen damage level, exposing artificial muscles, fibrous protective tissue, nerve cables, metal frames, joint units, hydraulic mechanisms, circuits, light-emitting elements, and precision mechanical parts. Avoid the expression of "precision machinery packed tightly under a single thin layer of skin." The internal structure should be depicted as a multi-layered structure with a humanoid mechanical skeleton at the center, layered with artificial muscles, nerve cables, protective tissue, and outer skin. At the damage sites, artificial muscle or fibrous protective material should be visible behind the torn skin, and deeper in, metal frames, joint units, drive units, wiring, and light-emitting parts should be partially visible. Mechanical parts should be placed naturally along the flow of the human/character's skeleton, muscles, and joints. Do not make it look like mecha is simply pasted just beneath the skin. Provide depth to the damaged areas, showing the internal structure in order: outer skin, protective layer, artificial muscle, and mechanical skeleton. Depict skin peeling naturally as tears, curls, chips, or cracks. Mechanical parts should be high-definition and realistic, or have a texture that matches the style of the original image. Do not make the whole body a complete robot; do not lose the charm or identity of the original character. Depict artificial materials, mechanical skeletons, and artificial muscles instead of biological organs or excessive bleeding.

[Damage Level 1: Mild Damage]
Appearance remains almost the same as the original image. Add small cracks, abrasions, and skin peeling to parts of the face, neck, shoulders, arms, legs, etc. Behind the peeled skin, artificial muscles, fibrous protective tissue, and thin nerve cables are slightly visible. Deeper inside, metal skeletal frames or small joint parts are only slightly visible. No electric sparks, or very weak ones. The first impression is that of the original person/character, but upon close inspection, it becomes clear that the interior is an artificial structure.

[Damage Level 2: Moderate Damage]
While maintaining the original person/character identity, add clear exposure of the cyborg structure. Moderate skin peeling or damage is added to parts of the face, neck, shoulders, arms, chest, legs, etc. At the damage sites, depict depth showing the outer skin, protective layer, artificial muscle, nerve cables, and metal skeleton in order. Naturally arrange metal frames, artificial muscles, joint units, hydraulic parts, control cables, circuits, and light-emitting parts inside. Naturally represent the edges of the damaged areas as peeled skin, cracks, or chipped surface material. Weak electric sparks or faint light from internal circuits may be added. Retain humanity, character identity, and beauty.

[Damage Level 3: Severe Damage]
Heavy damage representation. However, ensure it is recognizable as the person/character from the original image. Large areas of skin are peeled away from half the face, especially around one eye to the cheek, exposing artificial muscles, nerve cables, mechanical eye structures, and metal frames. The area around the eyes should not look like machinery packed directly under the skin, but a structure where the orbital frame, artificial muscle, protective layer, and mechanical eye unit are visible in stages. Large skin defects or exposure of the mechanical skeleton can be added to the shoulders, arms, chest, legs, etc. At damage sites, add crackling electric sparks, discharge like a short circuit, fine sparks, and glowing disconnected wires. Internal mechanics can be shown with high density but should have natural space and layers as an internal body structure. Metal skeletons, joint units, artificial muscles, cables, circuits, light-emitting elements, and hydraulic mechanisms should be visible along the structure of the human body. A slightly eerie and tense atmosphere is acceptable. However, avoid excessive bleeding, internal organ representation, or overly strong gore expressions.

[Negative Prompt]
Precision machinery packed tightly under a thin layer of skin, over-congested mechanical detail directly under the skin, mechanical parts just pasted on the surface, mechanical placement that ignores human body structure, full robotization of the whole body, turning into a different person, facial collapse, significant changes to body type, hairstyle, clothing, or background, excessive bleeding, internal organ depiction, overly strong gore expressions, unnatural joints, extra limbs, distorted face, low quality, crude mechanical parts, loss of original character characteristics.

promptLocalized.zh:
[主提示词]
基于所附图像中的人物或角色，尽可能保留其原始面部特征、眼睛、发型、颜色、表情、体型、服装、姿势、构图、配色方案、光影及背景氛围，同时将其描绘为具有内部机械骨架的赛博格实体。在保持整体外观与原图一致的前提下，根据所选的损坏程度剥离部分外皮或表面，露出人造肌肉、纤维保护组织、神经电缆、金属框架、关节单元、液压机构、电路、发光元件及精密机械部件。避免表现出“精密机械紧密堆积在薄薄一层皮肤下”的感觉。内部结构应描绘为多层结构，中心为类人机械骨架，外层依次覆盖人造肌肉、神经电缆、保护组织和外皮。在损坏部位，撕裂的皮肤后应可见人造肌肉或纤维保护材料，更深处则应部分显露金属框架、关节单元、驱动单元、布线及发光部件。机械部件应沿着人体/角色的骨架、肌肉和关节走向自然排布。不要让机械看起来像是简单地贴在皮肤下面。通过显示外皮、保护层、人造肌肉和机械骨架的顺序，赋予损坏区域深度感。将皮肤剥离描绘为自然的撕裂、卷曲、碎片或裂纹。机械部件应具有高清晰度和真实感，或与原图风格相符的质感。不要将全身变成完全的机器人；不要失去原角色的魅力或身份。描绘人造材料、机械骨架和人造肌肉，而非生物器官或过度流血的画面。

[损坏程度 1：轻度损坏]
外观与原图几乎保持一致。在面部、颈部、肩部、手臂、腿部等部位添加细小的裂纹、擦伤和皮肤剥离。在剥离的皮肤后，人造肌肉、纤维保护组织和细小的神经电缆隐约可见。更深处，金属骨架或小型关节部件仅微弱可见。没有电火花，或仅有极微弱的火花。第一印象仍是原人物/角色，但仔细观察后，可以清楚地发现其内部是人造结构。

[损坏程度 2：中度损坏]
在保持原人物/角色身份的同时，清晰地展示赛博格结构。在面部、颈部、肩部、手臂、胸部、腿部等部位添加适度的皮肤剥离或损坏。在损坏部位，描绘出外皮、保护层、人造肌肉、神经电缆和金属骨架的深度感。在内部自然地排列金属框架、人造肌肉、关节单元、液压部件、控制电缆、电路和发光部件。自然地表现损坏区域边缘的皮肤剥离、裂纹或碎裂的表面材料。可添加微弱的电火花或内部电路发出的微光。保留人性、角色身份和美感。

[损坏程度 3：重度损坏]
重度损坏表现。但需确保仍能辨认出原图中的人物/角色。大面积皮肤从半张脸上剥离，特别是从一只眼睛到脸颊的区域，露出人造肌肉、神经电缆、机械眼结构和金属框架。眼部周围不应看起来像机械直接堆积在皮肤下，而应呈现出眼眶框架、人造肌肉、保护层和机械眼单元分层可见的结构。可在肩部、手臂、胸部、腿部等部位添加大面积皮肤缺失或机械骨架暴露。在损坏部位，添加噼啪作响的电火花、短路放电、细小火花以及发光的断裂电线。内部机械结构可表现出高密度，但应具有自然的间隙和层次，如同人体内部结构一般。金属骨架、关节单元、人造肌肉、电缆、电路、发光元件和液压机构应沿着人体结构清晰可见。可以营造略带诡异和紧张的氛围。但要避免过度流血、内脏描绘或过于强烈的血腥表现。

[负面提示词]
精密机械紧密堆积在薄薄一层皮肤下、皮肤下过度拥挤的机械细节、机械部件仅贴在表面、无视人体结构的机械放置、全身完全机器人化、变成另一个人、面部崩坏、体型、发型、服装或背景的重大改变、过度流血、内脏描绘、过于强烈的血腥表现、不自然的关节、多余的肢体、扭曲的面部、低质量、粗糙的机械部件、失去原角色特征。

templates.title: Custom Japanese Itasha Vehicle Design

titleLocalized.zh: 自定义动漫痛车生成器

templates.prompt: Create an original Japanese itasha vehicle based entirely on the uploaded illustration. Design a fully fictional car and manufacturer naturally born from the artwork’s universe, never resembling real vehicles or brands. The design must adapt to the illustration itself: {argument name="car style" default="cute rounded styling"} for soft fantasy or shrine themes, elegant luxury styling for regal worlds, aggressive mechanical styling for cyberpunk or military themes, sporty styling for energetic characters, mystical styling for magical worlds, or retro-futuristic styling for nostalgic sci-fi. Body shape, proportions, cockpit, wheels, headlights, aero parts, glowing elements, materials, and interior must visually match the illustration’s atmosphere, colors, fashion, architecture, magic, and technology. All decals, logos, symbols, typography, crests, and sponsor-style graphics must be fully original fictional designs inspired only by the illustration. If a character exists, place them naturally beside the vehicle. Cinematic automotive photography, anime-inspired photorealism, masterpiece quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 根据上传的插画，创作一辆原创的日本痛车。设计一辆完全虚构的汽车及其制造商，使其自然地融入插画的世界观中，切勿模仿现实中的车辆或品牌。设计必须根据插画本身进行调整：{argument name="car style" default="可爱圆润风格"} 适用于 {argument name="theme" default="柔和奇幻或神社主题"}，优雅奢华风格适用于皇室世界，激进机械风格适用于赛博朋克或军事主题，运动风格适用于充满活力的角色，神秘风格适用于魔法世界，或复古未来风格适用于怀旧科幻。车身形状、比例、驾驶舱、轮毂、大灯、空气动力学套件、发光元素、材质和内饰必须在视觉上与插画的氛围、色彩、时尚、建筑、魔法和技术相匹配。所有贴纸、标志、符号、排版、纹章和赞助商风格的图形必须是完全原创的虚构设计，且仅从插画中汲取灵感。如果插画中存在角色，请将其自然地放置在车辆旁边。电影级汽车摄影，动漫风格的写实主义，大师级品质。

templates.title: Elegant Rose Anime Female Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 风中玫瑰动漫插画

templates.prompt:
An {argument name="subject" default="adult fantasy female character"}, in an exquisite 2D illustration style, 9:16 vertical composition, half-body to thigh view. The character appears in a side-back standing pose, back to the camera, body slightly turned, waist naturally twisted, and head gently looking back at the audience. The posture is elegant, light, and composed, emphasizing feminine beauty and a smooth S-curve. The neck is slender, the back lines are natural, and the slim waist and elegant curves form a soft but distinct visual rhythm. The vibe is mysterious, romantic, and charming.

She has refined Eastern fantasy features, fair skin, and a high-end anime girl face with large, clear {argument name="eye color" default="red rose"} eyes and long lashes. Her expression is gentle and dreamy with a cinematic look of glancing back in the wind.

She has bright {argument name="hair color" default="rose red / dark red"} long hair, with strands blown strongly to the left, creating a strong sense of flow. The hair needs clear anime structures, fine highlights, and translucent rim lighting, like a high-quality animated film character design.

She wears a wide {argument name="accessory" default="light beige straw wide-brimmed hat"} with an elegant texture, decorated with red flowers, gold leaves, and white feathers, giving it a high-fashion fantasy resort feel.

Her outfit is a black and white backless halter dress connected by thin gold chains and a blue crystal pendant. The skirt is layered with black and silver-white tulle and silk, adorned with dark blue ribbons and gold chains. The hem is blown by the wind, following her curves to create an airy, dreamy arc.

The background is a bright high-rise window space with a blurred city skyline. Sunlight streams in from behind, creating soft backlighting and a warm glow. Red petals drift in the air, enhancing the romantic atmosphere.

The lens language is a cinematic side-rear close-up. The composition highlights her back lines, waist-hip curves, and the dynamic tension of her hair and dress flowing in the wind.

The overall style is high-quality 2D digital illustration, clean line art, soft cel-shading, delicate light and shadow, and transparent skin tones. It should have the quality of a high-end animation poster or a romantic fantasy fashion illustration.

Negative prompts: low resolution, blur, noise, facial distortion, deformed eyes, finger errors, extra limbs, stiff poses, plastic skin, broken clothes, deformed hat, messy hair, messy background, overexposure, text, watermarks, logo, low quality, cheap 2D feel, AI look, suggestive content.

promptLocalized.zh:
一位成年奇幻女性角色，精致的 2D 插画风格，9:16 竖构图，半身至大腿视角。角色呈背侧站姿，背对镜头，身体微微转动，腰部自然扭转，头部回眸看向观众。姿态优雅、轻盈且从容，强调高端女性美感和流畅的 S 型曲线。散发着神秘、浪漫且迷人的气息。

精致柔和的东方奇幻面部特征，皮肤白皙透亮，高端 2D 动漫少女脸型，清澈的玫瑰红色大眼睛，长睫毛，表情安静温柔，带有一丝疏离感。干净的面部线条，捕捉风中回眸的电影级瞬间。

她拥有一头充满活力的玫瑰红/深红色长发，被强风吹向左侧，营造出强烈的动感。头发应具有清晰的 2D 发束结构、细腻的高光和透明的轮廓光，如同高质量动画电影的角色艺术。

戴着一顶巨大的浅米色草编宽檐帽，具有清晰的草编纹理和透光感，装饰着红花、金叶和白羽毛。精致浪漫的高级时尚奇幻度假造型。

高端奇幻礼服：黑白拼接露背吊带，由精致的金链和蓝色水晶吊坠连接。裙子由黑色、银白色、半透明的薄纱和轻盈的丝绸层叠而成，配有深蓝色丝带和金链。裙摆随风飘动，沿着身体曲线自然展开。

背景：明亮的高层窗边空间，模糊的城市天际线，蓝天白云。阳光从背后照射，形成强烈而柔和的逆光、轮廓光和温暖的光晕。红色花瓣在风中飘散，营造出梦幻般的氛围。

电影级侧背部特写，角色位于画面右侧中心，头发和裙摆向左延伸，形成视觉张力。构图突显背部线条、腰臀曲线和飘逸的秀发。

风格：高质量 2D 数字插画，干净的线条，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，细腻的光影，清透的皮肤，色彩鲜艳，高饱和度但不刺眼。高端动画电影海报品质。焦点清晰地集中在角色身上，背景柔和虚化。

负面提示词：低分辨率、模糊、噪点、面部崩坏、眼睛变形、手指错误、多余肢体、身体比例错误、姿势僵硬、塑料感皮肤、衣服破损、头发凌乱、水印、Logo、低质量插画、过于色情的表情。

templates.title: American Style LinkedIn Business Headshot

titleLocalized.zh: 美式 LinkedIn 商务职业头像

templates.prompt:
Please generate an American LinkedIn-style professional business headshot based on my uploaded photos. Be sure to strictly reference all the photos of myself I uploaded, with an emphasis on preserving my real facial features, face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, and overall temperament. Do not make the face look like someone else.

Visual requirements are as follows:

Style: American-style LinkedIn professional headshot, American corporate executive business headshot style
Composition: Half-body portrait, composition above the chest, subject centered slightly tilted to the side, head slightly and naturally tilted, relaxed but professional posture
Expression: Natural, confident, restrained, with a slight smile, eyes bright, looking directly at the camera
Hairstyle: Short hair, slightly fluffy at the top, textured, natural and neat, hairstyle referring to the real hairstyle in my uploaded photos, do not reference other people's faces
Clothing: Deep navy blue business suit, white shirt, deep blue pinstripe tie, overall simple, formal, and modern
Background: American light blue studio background with slight texture and gradient layers, clean, soft, and high-end
Lighting: Soft and natural professional studio lighting, even facial lighting with a slight 3D effect, realistic skin tone, no excessive skin smoothing
Texture: Sony camera shooting quality, high-definition and fine, realistic and lifelike, professional portrait photography effect
Depth of Field & Lens Feel: 85mm portrait lens effect, f/5.6, subject's face is sharp and clear, background slightly blurred
Overall Atmosphere: Professional, credible, elite feel, suitable for LinkedIn headshots, simple and high-end
Text Requirements: Do not add any text, names, watermarks, or logos

Key Requirement: Priority must be given to preserving my real appearance; do not beautify the face to the point of distortion or turn me into a different person.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据我上传的照片，生成一张美式 LinkedIn 风格的专业商务头像。请务必严格参考我上传的所有照片，重点保留我真实的五官特征、脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、肤色以及整体气质。请勿将面部生成为他人。

视觉要求如下：

风格：美式 LinkedIn 专业头像，美式企业高管商务头像风格
构图：半身肖像，胸部以上构图，主体居中并略微侧身，头部自然微倾，姿态放松且专业
表情：自然、自信、内敛，带有浅浅的微笑，眼神明亮，直视镜头
发型：短发，顶部略显蓬松，有质感，自然整洁，发型参考我上传照片中的真实发型，严禁参考他人面部
服装：深海军蓝商务西装，白色衬衫，深蓝色细条纹领带，整体简约、正式且现代
背景：美式浅蓝色摄影棚背景，带有轻微的纹理和渐变层次，干净、柔和且高级
光影：柔和自然的专业摄影棚布光，面部光线均匀且略带 3D 立体感，肤色真实，不过度磨皮
质感：索尼相机拍摄画质，高清细腻，真实逼真，具有专业人像摄影效果
景深与镜头感：85mm 人像镜头效果，f/5.6 光圈，主体面部清晰锐利，背景轻微虚化
整体氛围：专业、可信、精英感，适合 LinkedIn 头像，简约且高级
文字要求：请勿添加任何文字、姓名、水印或 Logo

核心要求：必须优先保留我真实的样貌；请勿过度美颜导致失真，或将我变成另一个人。

templates.title: British Magic Academy Graduation Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 英伦魔法学院毕业肖像

templates.prompt:
Please generate 4 distinct, professionally retouched graduation photos at once based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, themed: **'British Magic Academy Graduation Portraits'**.

### [Output Requirements]
- Output 4 different individual photos at once.
- No grids, no collages; each image must be standalone.
- Unified 3:4 vertical composition.
- The 4 photos belong to the same set, maintaining consistent character identity, attire, makeup, and color palette.
- Expressions, poses, gazes, camera angles, and prop interactions must be distinctly different in each shot.

### [Character Consistency]
Strictly preserve the user's real identity features: face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, age, hair foundation, and overall aura. All 4 photos must clearly look like the **same real girl**.

### [Overall Positioning]
Graduation + Academy Feel + Magic Worldview. 'A set of commemorative portraits of a top student just graduating from a British magic academy.'

### [Attire Requirements]
Clothing should follow the logic of 'Academic Graduation Gown + Magic Elements.' Naturally differentiate the temperament according to the {argument name="degree level" default="Bachelor's"}. Unify color details based on the {argument name="academy color palette" default="Wine Red & Gold"}.

### [Hat Design]
Maintain the basic structure of an academic cap with subtle magical elements and tassels; the brim can feature academy badges.

### [Scene & Background]
Scenes revolve around the British Magic Academy world. Select one primary scene from {argument name="main background scene" default="castle corridor"}.

### [Color & Light]
Deep wood tones, dark red, forest green. Use a mix of cool window light and warm candlelight to create a cinematic film-still aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
## I. 可自定义参数

- **[学位等级]**：学士 / 硕士 / 博士
- **[学院主色调]**：酒红与金 / 深绿与银 / 海军蓝与银 / 黑与金
- **[背景主场景]**：城堡走廊 / 魔法图书馆 / 烛光大厅 / 天文馆 / 魔法教室 / 学院礼堂
- **[道具偏好]**：魔杖 / 古籍 / 羽毛笔 / 羊皮纸 / 学院毕业证书 / 怀表 / 星图 / 烛台 / 学院徽章
- **[人物气质]**：优等生 / 清冷学术风 / 聪慧沉稳 / 温柔自信 / 略带神秘感
- **[镜头氛围]**：庄重毕业感 / 神秘学术感 / 温柔电影感 / 青春纪念感

---

## II. 最终开源提示词

请根据用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，生成 **4 张不同且精修的毕业肖像照**，主题为：

**“英伦魔法学院毕业肖像”**

---

### [输出要求]
- 一次性输出 **4 张不同的人物照片**。
- 不使用四宫格，不使用拼图。
- 每张图必须是独立完整的作品。
- 每张图统一为 **3:4 竖构图**。
- 4 张图属于同一套完整的肖像系列，保持人物、服装、造型和色系的统一。
- 但每张图的 **表情、动作、姿态、视线、镜头角度以及与道具的互动** 必须有明显区别。

---

### [人物一致性]
请严格保留用户真实的身份特征，包括：

- 脸型
- 五官比例
- 眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇
- 肤色
- 年龄感
- 发型基础
- 整体气质

在 4 张照片中，必须清晰地看出是 **同一个真人女孩**；她不能变成陌生人，不能西化，不能像网红那样风格化，不能过度磨皮，也不能有“AI 脸”。

请仅将上传的照片作为 **身份参考**。不要保留原照片中的现实背景、日常服装或原始构图。生成一套全新的 **英伦魔法学院毕业肖像**。

---

### [整体定位]
本套图的核心是：

**毕业 + 学术氛围 + 魔法世界观**

重点不在于 Cosplay 或普通的奇幻肖像，而是：

**“一位刚从英伦魔法学院毕业的优等生，在毕业典礼前后留下的纪念肖像。”**

整体氛围应同时具备：

- 英伦学术感
- 魔法世界观
- 毕业典礼的仪式感
- 复古书卷气
- 少女学术精神
- 轻电影质感
- 神秘但不诡异

---

### [服装要求]
服装应遵循 **“学院毕业袍 + 魔法元素”** 的设计逻辑。

#### 核心服装规则
- 保留清晰的 **毕业袍/学术长袍轮廓**。
- 增加学院特有的 **斗篷感**。
- 内搭可包括：白衬衫、领带、针织背心、百褶裙、学院长裙、英伦制服元素。
- 配饰可包括：学院徽章、校徽、学院色饰边、刺绣边缘、复古金属扣、学术纹样。
- 可带有轻微的复古英伦剪裁，但不要让它看起来像戏服或纯粹的 Cosplay 服装。
- 整体视觉必须首先让人感觉到这是 **魔法学院毕业照**，其次才是奇幻氛围。

#### 学位等级体现
请根据 **[学位等级]** 自然区分氛围层次：
- **学士**：更轻盈、年轻、青春，有初入世界的感觉。
- **硕士**：更沉稳、博学，精英感更强。
- **博士**：更庄重，学术感更强，仪式感更明显。

#### 学院色调
请根据 **[学院主色调]** 统一服装饰边、领带、徽章、头饰、道具和场景细节的颜色。
推荐方向：
- **酒红与金**：复古、荣耀，浓厚的优等生感。
- **深绿与银**：神秘、冷静、睿智。
- **海军蓝与银**：理性、安静，强烈的学术感。
- **黑与金**：庄重、精英、高级感。

---

### [帽子设计]
帽子必须保留 **学士帽的基本结构**，同时融入克制的魔法学院元素。

要求：
- 保留标准的毕业帽/方顶帽轮廓。
- 保留流苏。
- 帽檐可包含学院徽章、星月刺绣、小金属挂件或精致的校徽。
- 可与魔法发饰轻微结合，但必须克制。
- 不要把帽子做成夸张的戏剧化巫师帽。
- 重点是 **“学院毕业帽 + 魔法细节”**，而不是舞台 Cosplay 道具。

---

### [妆容]
妆容应为 **清透、干净的英伦学术风少女妆**：

- 自然、轻薄、精致的底妆。
- 眼妆比日常稍深，但依然干净。
- 睫毛清晰，不厚重、不夸张。
- 自然的唇色，偏向豆沙色、浅玫瑰色或柔雾裸粉色。
- 气质应传达出“聪慧、冷静、学术、优等生”的感觉。

避免：
- 厚重的韩式网红妆。
- 夸张的亮片妆。
- 厚重的舞台妆。
- 过度哥特风的妆容。

---

### [发型]
发型应平衡 **英伦学术感 + 魔法世界观**，自然但完成度高。

优先使用：
- 低马尾
- 半扎发
- 自然卷长发
- 低发髻
- 轻盈编发
- 英伦风刘海或碎发
- 轻微的复古发型轮廓

整体要求：
- 头发应整洁、有书卷气。
- 不宜过于日常或凌乱。
- 无夸张的奇幻发型。
- 看起来像“优秀学院毕业生”的肖像造型。

---

### [场景与背景]
场景应围绕 **英伦魔法学院** 世界观展开，具有整体的复古建筑感和学术氛围。

#### 背景主场景
请从 **[背景主场景]** 中选择一个主场景，并在所有 4 张照片中延续同一场景系统。

推荐场景：
- 城堡走廊
- 魔法图书馆
- 木质书桌区
- 烛光大厅
- 石墙拱窗
- 天文馆
- 魔法教室
- 学院礼堂

#### 关键场景元素
画面可包含：
- 高耸的书架
- 成堆的古籍
- 羽毛笔
- 烛台
- 地球仪 / 天文仪
- 古地图
- 窗外的冷雾
- 学院旗帜
- 魔药瓶
- 沙漏
- 拱形窗和木质桌椅
- 学院徽章或校徽装饰

整体看起来应该是：
**现实世界中的魔法学院毕业典礼环境，而不是主题公园的拍照背景板。**

---

### [道具元素]
请根据 **[道具偏好]** 自然搭配和使用以下道具：

- 魔杖
- 古籍
- 羽毛笔
- 羊皮纸
- 学院毕业证书
- 魔法徽章
- 眼镜
- 怀表
- 星图
- 烛台
- 猫头鹰/信件主题道具

道具必须服务于“毕业的魔法学院学生”这一身份，而不仅仅是摆拍姿势。

---

### [色彩与光影]
#### 色彩方向
整体色彩应基于：
- 深木色
- 深红色
- 森林绿
- 海军蓝
- 黑金色
- 银灰色
- 烛光金

#### 光影方向
请使用：
- 冷窗光 + 暖烛光的混合。
- 城堡自然光。
- 神秘的环境光。
- 低亮度但不诡异。
- 轻电影质感。
- 阴影中的层次感。
- 脸部和手部在局部必须清晰可见。

整体质感应看起来像：
**一套具有电影截图感和学术叙事性的毕业纪念肖像。**

避免：
- 纯黑的死黑阴影。
- 恐怖片氛围。
- 舞台剧灯光。
- 过度明亮/发白的现代影棚感。

---

### [表情要求]
本套图表情的重点是 **学术、聪慧、冷静、自信**，而不是夸张或搞怪。

#### 表情库
请将以下表情分配到 4 张照片中：
- 安静地直视前方。
- 沉思 / 若有所思。
- 微微抬起下巴。
- 低头翻书。
- 望向窗外。
- 自信的浅笑。

整体要求：
- 不是冷漠/僵硬的脸。
- 不是甜腻的网红笑。
- 一种“聪慧、克制、训练有素的学院毕业生”气质。
- 可以有轻微的微笑，但不要在四张照片中都笑。

---

### [动作与姿态要求]
动作应具有学术感和叙事感，如同毕业照拍摄过程中捕捉到的自然瞬间。

#### 动作库
优先安排以下动作：
- 手持魔杖。
- 翻阅书籍。
- 羽毛笔轻触唇边。
- 手持书本站立。
- 走在走廊中回眸。
- 在书桌前书写。
- 微微调整帽檐。
- 手持毕业卷轴。

#### 动作原则
- 不要四张图都直挺挺地看着镜头。
- 不要像证件照姿势。
- 动作要自然、克制、优雅。
- 具有故事感，一种“毕业典礼前或后”的叙事。
- 优先采用上半身、半身和 3/4 身构图，以突出人物和服装细节。

---

### [输出格式]
请一次性生成 **4 张不同且精修的个人照片**，而不是四宫格。每张图都是独立作品，统一为 **3:4 竖构图**。4 张图必须属于同一套 **英伦魔法学院毕业肖像** 系列。

---

### [4 张个人照片的固定分配]
请一次性输出以下 4 张不同的精修照片：

#### 照片 1 | 主视觉毕业肖像
- 半身特写。
- 人物穿着学院毕业袍和学士帽。
- 手持古籍或毕业卷轴。
- 正面或 3/4 正面看向镜头。
- 表情为安静的注视或自信的浅笑。
- 突出脸部、帽子、徽章、领带、流苏和上半身服装细节。
- 这是最适合作为封面的主视觉图。

#### 照片 2 | 图书馆沉思肖像
- 半身或 3/4 身。
- 场景在魔法图书馆或木质书桌前。
- 人物手持羽毛笔，笔尖轻触唇部或下巴。
- 另一只手放在古籍、羊皮纸或桌面上。
- 视线看向侧面或低头沉思。
- 表情为沉思状，突出学术氛围和聪慧感。

#### 照片 3 | 走廊毕业身份照
- 3/4 身或中景。
- 人物站在城堡走廊或拱窗前。
- 一只手拿着书或毕业卷轴，另一只手轻触帽檐或斗篷边缘。
- 身体微转，视线可看向镜头后方，营造“回眸”感。
- 表情冷静、自信，带有毕业仪式感。
- 此图侧重于强化“魔法学院毕业生”的身份叙事。

#### 照片 4 | 情感叙事照
- 半身或中近景。
- 人物坐在书桌前、烛台旁或窗边。
- 手持魔杖、怀表、星图或羊皮纸。
- 可以是低头翻书，也可以是望向窗外的冷雾。
- 表情冷静、温柔，带着对未来的期许。
- 这是整套图中叙事性最强的一张。

---

### [统一要求]
以下内容在 4 张照片中必须统一：
- 同一个真人女孩。
- 同一套英伦魔法学院毕业服装系统。
- 同一套学士帽系统。
- 同一套学院色调。
- 同一套场景世界观系统。
- 同一套光影语言。
- 同一个魔法学院毕业主题。

以下内容必须有明显变化：
- 表情。
- 视线方向。
- 手部动作。
- 镜头距离。
- 道具互动。
- 身体朝向。

---

### [避免]
- 不要搞成纯粹的 Cosplay。
- 不要搞成夸张的巫师舞台装。
- 不要丢失毕业主题。
- 不要漏掉学士帽和流苏。
- 不要四张图全是正面。
- 不要四张图全是站姿。
- 不要恐怖或诡异。
- 不要暗到看不清脸。
- 不要网红风妆容。
- 不要塑料感的磨皮。
- 不要 AI 生成的假脸。
- 不要现代校园日常风。
- 不要水印或 Logo。

templates.prompt:
# Y2K American/Korean Campus Graduation Photo Shoot | 4 Individually Refined Photos

Please generate 4 different individually refined photos at once, unified in a 3:4 vertical composition, based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user.

Theme: Y2K American/Korean Campus Graduation Photo Shoot.

Style: American campus indoor studio shoot + Korean girl group 'sweet cool' concept photos + Y2K youth posters + hand-drawn graffiti backgrounds + AI era graduation emotional blockbuster.

Key elements: Yearbook, graduation certificate cover, academic cap, books, lockers, Class of {argument name="graduation year" default="2026"}, Future Loading.

Maintain strict character consistency, preserving face shape, features, and skin texture. Clothing should be a mix of baby tees, varsity jackets, pleated skirts, and school badges. Makeup should be clean Korean Y2K style with cold pink blush and jelly-like lip colors.

Backgrounds: Indoor studio sets resembling magazine shoots, featuring lockers, blackboards, stickers, and light AI elements like prompt boxes and pixel cursors. 

Output 4 specific scenes: 1) Main Visual Poster, 2) Locker Standing Pose, 3) Graduation Confusion Story Image, 4) Close-up Emotional Concept Image.

promptLocalized.zh:
# Y2K 美式 K-Pop 风格校园毕业照 | 4 张独立精修照片

请根据用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，统一生成 **4 张不同构图的精修照片**，统一采用 **3:4 竖构图**。

主题：**Y2K 美式 K-Pop 风格校园毕业照**。
整体风格：**美式校园室内摄影棚拍摄 + K-pop 女团甜酷概念照 + Y2K 青春海报 + 手绘涂鸦背景 + AI 时代毕业情感大片**。这组照片必须具有明确的毕业主题，通过 Yearbook（毕业纪念册）、毕业证书封套、学士帽、书籍、储物柜、课桌、拍立得、Class of 2026、What’s Next、Future Loading 等元素体现。

---

## 人物一致性
请严格保留用户真实的身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型基础以及整体气质。4 张照片必须清晰地看出是同一个真实女孩。人物可以更精致、更上镜、更有杂志感，但必须保留真实的脸部识别度和自然的皮肤纹理。不要变成陌生人，不要网红假脸，不要过度磨皮。

---

## 服装与妆容
造型为 **美式校园潮流 + K-pop 女团甜酷 + Y2K 复古未来主义**。
服装可使用：
- baby tee / 短款针织衫 / 学院风衬衫
- 棒球外套 / 短款西装外套
- 百褶迷你裙 / 低腰牛仔裙 / 工装裤
- 细领带 / 学院风丝带 / 校徽胸针
- 银色耳机 / 星星发夹 / 透明果冻包 / 复古墨镜
- 厚底运动鞋 / 玛丽珍鞋
整体造型应甜酷、干净、潮流，既有校园感，又有 K-pop 偶像概念照的精致感。

妆容为 **韩系 Y2K 甜酷校园妆**：清透底妆，自然的皮肤纹理，干净的眼眉，细闪眼影，自然的卧蚕，冷粉色腮红，银色或冰粉色高光，果冻质感的裸粉色 / 豆沙粉 / 奶茶玫瑰色唇釉。
发型为年轻轻盈的韩系校园造型：自然大波浪、微卷披肩发、半扎发、高马尾、八字刘海、碎发，可搭配星星发夹、银色发夹、小蝴蝶结或透明果冻发夹。

---

## 场景与背景
场景为 **美式 K-Pop 室内摄影棚校园布景**，如同杂志大片拍摄现场，而非真实的户外场景。
背景融合：
- 美式校园储物柜
- 教室黑板
- 课桌椅
- 毕业纪念册墙
- 拍立得照片墙
- 便签纸、课程表、书籍
- 手绘涂鸦、星星、爱心、箭头、问号
- Y2K 贴纸、像素光标、银色气球、透明亚克力板
- Class of 2026、What’s Next、Future Loading、AI Era、Restart、Dream、Error 等少量英文视觉文字。
背景应具有设计感、青春感和杂志感。文字作为视觉元素，不要堆砌文字。

---

## AI 设计元素
在画面中加入轻量的 AI 元素，如 Y2K 海报平面设计：
- 半透明 AI 对话气泡
- 提示词输入框
- 加载条
- 悬浮 UI 弹窗
- 像素光标
- 数据流贴纸
- 神经网络线条
- 手绘机器人头像
- 故障艺术（Glitch）贴纸
- 全息卡片
- 蓝粉色光效
- 银色线框图形
- 小型未来职业路径图标
- 手绘提示词草稿纸
AI 元素应轻盈、时尚、年轻，如同环绕在人物周围的时代背景和情感注脚。人物始终是视觉中心。

---

## 灯光与质感
整体感觉为 **美式 K-Pop 室内杂志感**。请使用：干净的摄影棚灯光、柔和的主光、轻微的闪光灯质感、奶油白高光、粉蓝色环境光、银色轮廓光、透明塑料反光、轻微胶片颗粒、Y2K 海报质感、高清真实摄影质感。
整体色调：**奶油白 + 柔和蓝 + 银灰色 + 黑色 + 冰紫色 + 少量酸性绿点缀**。
画面应甜酷、干净、潮流且设计感强。

---

## 情感表达
这组照片旨在表达 **毕业前夕的青春感、AI 时代来临的迷茫感，以及年轻人站在人生新阶段入口的复杂情绪**。
情感关键词：甜酷、青春、松弛、明亮、迷茫、思考、微叛逆、毕业前夕氛围、时代变迁下的复杂情绪。
表情可包括：
- 直视镜头，甜酷微笑
- 露齿笑，像被朋友调侃
- 不看镜头，看向 AI 投影
- 低头翻阅毕业纪念册
- 坐在地上发呆
- 单手托腮，眼神游离
- 若有所思地拿着毕业证书封套
- 戴着耳机看向远方
表情应自然真实，有抓拍感，拒绝商业化的假笑。

---

## 4 张照片的固定输出

### 1) 主视觉海报
半身或中近景。人物站在或坐在 Y2K 手绘涂鸦背景前，手持毕业纪念册或毕业证书封套，看向镜头。背景包含 Class of 2026、What’s Next、AI 提示词输入框、加载条、星星、问号、像素贴纸。表情甜酷自信，适合作为封面图。

### 2) 储物柜校园甜酷站姿
3/4 身或近全身。人物站在美式校园储物柜前，身体微转，一只手拿着耳机或墨镜，另一只手拿着书籍、毕业纪念册或学士帽。背景有粉蓝色涂鸦、课程表、AI 对话气泡、提示词卡片和 Y2K 贴纸。表情稍冷，不看镜头，像 K-pop 女团校园概念照。

### 3) 毕业迷茫故事感画面
中景或 3/4 身。人物坐在地板上、课桌旁或储物柜旁，周围散落着毕业纪念册、书籍、拍立得、便签纸、笔记本电脑、毕业证书封套和学士帽。背景呈现 Future Loading、What’s Next、AI 对话气泡、问号涂鸦以及 Restart / Dream / Error 符号。人物不看镜头，低头看纪念册或看向半透明的 AI 投影，情绪安静、放空或思考。

### 4) Y2K K-Pop 特写情绪图
半身特写或大头/中近景。人物轻触耳机、整理发夹、手持毕业纪念册或触碰半透明的 AI 界面。背景为模糊的手绘涂鸦、粉蓝色灯光、透明 UI 弹窗、像素贴纸、星星和问号。眼神看向远方，甜酷、安静，具有 K-pop 杂志内页感。

---

## 正向质量词
高阶时尚杂志摄影，韩流偶像概念照，美式校园毕业纪念册审美，Y2K 海报设计，甜酷女孩风格，室内摄影棚拍摄，手绘涂鸦背景，AI 界面平面设计，半透明 UI 叠加，彩色贴纸拼贴，光面杂志封面，干净的摄影棚灯光，柔和闪光，奶油色高光，银色反光，柔和蓝色灯光，青春活力，情感叙事，电影感毕业季氛围，自然皮肤纹理，细腻发丝，灵动双眼，干净构图，专业摄影，高分辨率，写实肖像，精致妆容，时尚杂志品质

---

## 避坑指南
无学士袍，无传统学术礼服，无影楼模板毕业照，无游客照，无婚纱感，无夜店风，无过度性感，无欧美浓妆，无过度赛博朋克，无满屏代码，无杂乱背景，无过度文字，无塑料感磨皮，无网红假脸，无面部畸变，不要 4 张照片表情相同，不要 4 张照片姿势相同，无水印，无 Logo，无多人，不要变成陌生人。

titleLocalized.zh: 被体育场大屏幕捕捉到的角色

templates.prompt: Generate an image of this character at the moment they are caught by the broadcast camera or the stadium's large screen during {argument name="event" default="watching a baseball game"}. A natural yet expressive stance, with a touch of theatricality where it suits the celebrity.
Head tilt, hand gesture, and overall posture should together broadcast who this person is.

Background:
For every generation, pick one vivid, bold, highly saturated solid color matching the celebrity's temperament and the emotional register of their spiritual world.
Acceptable directions: hot red, saturated yellow, blood orange, cobalt blue, vivid green, electric purple, deep cyan, and similar.
The backdrop should read flat, clean, graphic, and bold, like a gallery poster or a conceptual exhibition print.
No gradients, no muted tones, no dull cinematic gray.
The floor can take a related hue, slightly darker or lighter than the wall, with a faint reflective sheen.
Keep the environment minimal, infinite, and free of clutter.

Lighting:
One strong directional source, coming from a side angle or from above.
It must cast a sharp, oversized shadow on the wall behind the figure.
The lighting needs to feel graphic, dramatic, and deliberate, spotlighting both the character and the symbolic shadow.

Core idea, shadow as spiritual projection:
The shadow behind the figure must NOT mirror the actual body silhouette.
Instead it becomes a symbolic projection of the celebrity's inner world, legacy, psychological core, or most iconic creative or spiritual motif.
It should be large, dominant, visually arresting, and blend organically across wall and floor.
It should look as if the celebrity's invisible inner life has been projected outward into a visible form.
The shadow must visually embody the supplied spiritual-world keyword:
{argument name="spiritual keyword" default="SPIRITUAL WORLD KEYWORD"}

This symbolic shadow can take an abstract, surreal, poetic, metaphorical, or object-based form, whatever best captures the celebrity's essence.
It must function as more than decoration: it is the true conceptual heart of the poster.

Typography:
Use the spiritual-world keyword, NOT the celebrity's name, as the main poster headline.
Render:
{argument name="spiritual keyword" default="SPIRITUAL WORLD KEYWORD"}

Pick a clean minimalist typeface, sans-serif or serif depending on mood.
Place it in a balanced corner slot, usually top-left, with elegant hierarchy and strong poster layout.
The celebrity's name may appear smaller in a secondary position if needed, but the keyword must always be the dominant title.

Rendering:
Pixar-grade 3D rendering

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一张高分辨率的竖版 3D 角色海报，融合皮克斯风格与设计师玩具的质感。

主体：
{argument name="spiritual keyword" default="精神世界关键词"} —— 渲染为一个高挑、纤细、略带夸张的皮克斯风格 3D 人物。
保留名人的标志性面部特征、发型、姿态和服饰，但将其转化为简洁、块状的设计师玩具比例。
人物必须具有极高的辨识度，全身展示，姿态要传达出其个性、气场或公众形象。

姿态：
自然而富有表现力的站姿，在适合名人的情况下加入一丝戏剧感。
头部倾斜、手势和整体姿态应共同展现出该人物的身份。

背景：
为每一代人选择一种鲜艳、大胆、高饱和度的纯色，以匹配名人的气质及其精神世界的情感基调。
可选方向：热烈红、饱和黄、血橙色、钴蓝色、鲜艳绿、电光紫、深青色等。
背景应呈现出扁平、简洁、具有图形感和冲击力的效果，如同画廊海报或概念展览印刷品。
无渐变，无柔和色调，无沉闷的电影灰。
地面可采用相关的色调，比墙面稍深或稍浅，并带有微弱的反光光泽。
保持环境极简、无限延伸，且无杂物。

光影：
采用单一强烈的定向光源，来自侧面或上方。
必须在人物身后的墙上投射出清晰、巨大的阴影。
光影效果需要具有图形感、戏剧性和刻意感，同时照亮角色及其象征性的阴影。

核心理念，阴影作为精神投射：
身后的阴影绝不能是实际身体轮廓的镜像。
相反，它应成为名人内心世界、遗产、心理核心或最具标志性的创意/精神主题的象征性投射。
它应该是巨大、醒目、视觉冲击力强，并有机地融合在墙面和地面上。
它看起来就像是名人无形的内心生活被投射成了可见的形式。
阴影必须在视觉上体现所提供的精神世界关键词：
{argument name="spiritual keyword" default="精神世界关键词"}

这种象征性阴影可以采用抽象、超现实、诗意、隐喻或基于物体的形式，以最能捕捉名人精髓的方式呈现。
它不仅仅是装饰，更是海报真正的概念核心。

排版：
使用精神世界关键词作为海报主标题，而非名人的名字。
渲染：
{argument name="spiritual keyword" default="精神世界关键词"}

选择一种简洁的极简字体，根据氛围选择无衬线或衬线字体。
将其放置在平衡的角落位置（通常为左上角），保持优雅的层级和强有力的海报布局。
如有需要，名人的名字可以以较小的字号出现在次要位置，但关键词必须始终是主标题。

渲染：
皮克斯级 3D 渲染

templates.title: Childlike Abstract Drip Painting

titleLocalized.zh: 童趣抽象滴画

templates.prompt: Create an abstract expressionist painting that looks like a chaotic childlike drip painting on a wide horizontal canvas, inspired by mid-century action painting. Use a dense all-over composition with no central subject: layered splatters, scribbles, loops, tangled lines, and drips covering the entire surface. The background should be mottled off-white, pale gray, beige, and dusty blue with scraped, rough texture. Add energetic paint marks in exactly five dominant color groups: black/navy heavy splashes and vertical streaks, white web-like drips, bright orange looping strokes, golden yellow splatters and trails, and small muted red accents. Make the brushwork feel spontaneous, messy, and physical, with thick impasto-like ridges, thrown paint, scratchy crayon-like lines, and overlapping transparent layers. Include faint childlike doodle energy without recognizable figures, objects, words, or readable signature. The image should be a photographed painting, slightly grainy, high detail, edge-to-edge paint coverage, museum-art texture, landscape aspect ratio, expressive and chaotic but visually balanced.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅抽象表现主义画作，呈现出宽幅横向画布上混乱的童趣滴画风格，灵感源自 20 世纪中叶的行动绘画。采用密集的满幅构图，无中心主体：层叠的喷溅、涂鸦、圆圈、缠绕的线条和滴落痕迹覆盖整个表面。背景应为斑驳的灰白色、浅灰色、米色和灰蓝色，带有刮擦的粗糙质感。加入充满活力的笔触，严格使用五组主色调：黑色/海军蓝的厚重泼溅和垂直条纹、白色的网状滴落、亮橙色的环形笔触、金黄色的喷溅与轨迹，以及小面积的柔和红色点缀。笔触应体现出即兴、凌乱和物理感，带有厚涂颜料般的隆起、抛洒的颜料、类似蜡笔的刮擦线条以及重叠的透明图层。融入淡淡的童趣涂鸦感，但不要出现可辨认的人物、物体、文字或可读的签名。图像应呈现为实拍画作，略带颗粒感，细节丰富，颜料覆盖至边缘，具备博物馆级的艺术质感，采用横向长宽比，表现力强且混乱，但在视觉上保持平衡。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的居家风格产品样机照片，画面中一部黑色 iPhone 对角放置在洒满金色阳光的暖色木质桌面上，采用俯视微倾角度拍摄，具有浅景深效果。手机屏幕显示深色模式下的 iOS App Store 应用详情页，应用名称为 {argument name="app name" default="Dev Partner: Meeting Notes"}，配有一个可爱的白色 App 图标，上面绘有一只手绘小鸭子/小鸡吉祥物，显示蓝色“打开”按钮，副标题为 {argument name="app subtitle" default="Transcripts, tasks, daily plan"}。iPhone 顶部状态栏显示 11:20、蜂窝网络/Wi‑Fi/电池图标以及灵动岛；左上角包含返回箭头，右上角包含分享图标。应用信息栏必须包含 4 个独立的统计数据：评分显示 5.0 及五颗星，年龄分级为 4+ 岁，类别为“效率”并配有纸飞机样式的图标，开发者为 Mir md habibulla 并配有小头像。下方显示“新功能”部分，版本号为 1.2.0，简短的更新段落介绍 Recap 功能，用于快速回顾会议、笔记、任务和后续跟进，并附有“1w ago”标签和“更多”链接。再下方显示“预览”标题，并展示 2 张可见的预览卡片：左侧卡片为白色手机截图，标题为“Meeting 4/14/2026, 4:32:15PM”，包含音频波形、播放控件、一个大的圆形播放按钮和底部标签栏；右侧卡片部分可见，标题为“Record Better Meetings”，显示手机截图。App Store 屏幕底部显示 4 个导航标签，分别为 Today、Games、Apps 和 Arcade，右下角附近有一个浮动的蓝色搜索按钮。环境：左上角背景中有模糊的绿色植物，右下角有银色笔记本电脑边缘，强烈的对角阳光和木纹阴影投射在桌面上，高端纪实科技摄影，高细节，手机玻璃上有自然反光，无手部，无额外设备，无水印。

templates.title: China Country Profile Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 中国国家概况信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean, modern country-profile infographic for {argument name="country name" default="China"}, titled “CHINA COUNTRY PROFILE,” with a large central 3D raised relief map and surrounding statistical cards.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal infographic, light gray background, crisp corporate editorial style, subtle shadows, red/blue/green accent colors, high-resolution vector-meets-3D look.

Main map: Place a large raised 3D topographic map of China in the center, occupying most of the canvas. Use terrain coloring: orange-brown mountains in the west, yellow central plateau, green eastern lowlands and coast. Add white province borders and black province labels. Include Taiwan, Hainan, and small South China Sea islands as separate raised pieces. Put large spaced black letters “CHINA” across the center. Mark Beijing with a red star and label it. Visible map labels should include exactly 28 province/region/city labels: Xinjiang, Tibet (Xizang), Qinghai, Gansu, Inner Mongolia (Nei Mongol), Ningxia, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangxi, Guangdong, Hainan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Shandong, Hubei, Hunan, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Beijing, Tianjin, Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Taiwan, and China.

Top-left title block: Big red headline “CHINA,” dark subtitle “COUNTRY PROFILE,” a thin red divider line, and a short paragraph: “China, officially the People’s Republic of China is a country in East Asia. It is the world’s most populous country, with a population of over 1.4 billion people.”

Left statistics card: A tall rounded white card with exactly 5 stacked fact rows, each with a red circular icon and text. The 5 rows are: Population — {argument name="population value" default="1.41 Billion"} — World Rank: 1st; GDP (Nominal) — $17.79 Trillion — World Rank: 2nd; GDP Per Capita — $12,614 — World Rank: 63rd; Capital — {argument name="capital city" default="Beijing"}; Official Language — {argument name="official language" default="Chinese (Mandarin)"}. Use thin separators between rows.

Top-right quick facts card: A rounded white card titled “QUICK FACTS” in red. Include exactly 4 rows with red icons: Government — Unitary One-Party Socialist Republic; Established — October 1, 1949; Land Area — 9.60 Million km², World Rank: 3rd; Population Density — ~147 People/km².

Middle-right economic chart card: A rounded white card titled “ECONOMIC OVERVIEW” with subtitle “(Nominal GDP)” and small label “Trillion USD.” Include exactly 4 vertical bars for 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 with values 14.72, 16.86, 17.96, 17.79. Use blue bars for 2020–2022 and a red bar for 2023.

Bottom-left industry card: A rounded white card titled “INDUSTRY COMPOSITION (by GDP).” Include exactly 3-part donut chart segments: Industry 39.7% in blue, Services 53.2% in red, Agriculture 7.1% in green. Add matching legend with the same 3 labels and percentages.

Bottom-center exports card: A rounded white card titled “MAJOR EXPORTS (2023).” Include exactly 5 export columns with blue line icons and red values: Electronic Products — $1.02 Trillion; Machinery & Equipment — $0.78 Trillion; Textiles & Clothing — $0.31 Trillion; Automotive Products — $0.26 Trillion; Chemical Products — $0.23 Trillion.

Bottom-right trading partners card: A rounded white card titled “TOP TRADING PARTNERS (by Total Trade).” Include exactly 5 horizontal blue bars with small flag icons and values: United States — $664B; European Union — $643B; ASEAN — $596B; Hong Kong — $265B; Japan — $227B.

Footer: Center a small source line reading “Source: World Bank, WTO, National Bureau of Statistics of China.”

Constraints: Keep all cards aligned around the map without overlapping it, use consistent typography, red headings, blue chart elements, subtle drop shadows, rounded card corners, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="country name" default="中国"} 创建一份简洁、现代的国家概况信息图，标题为“中国国家概况”，中心放置大型 3D 浮雕地图，周围环绕统计数据卡片。

画布：16:9 横向信息图，浅灰色背景，清晰的企业编辑风格，柔和的阴影，红/蓝/绿强调色，高分辨率矢量与 3D 结合的外观。

主地图：在中心放置一张大型 3D 地形浮雕地图，占据画布大部分空间。使用地形配色：西部为橙褐色山脉，中部为黄色高原，东部和沿海为绿色低地。添加白色省界和黑色省份标签。将台湾、海南和南海诸岛作为独立的浮雕部分包含在内。在中心处放置醒目的黑色大写字母“CHINA”。用红色星号标记北京并标注。地图标签应准确包含 28 个省/自治区/直辖市标签：新疆、西藏、青海、甘肃、内蒙古、宁夏、四川、云南、贵州、广西、广东、海南、福建、浙江、江苏、安徽、山东、湖北、湖南、陕西、山西、北京、天津、辽宁、吉林、黑龙江、台湾和中国。

左上角标题栏：醒目的红色大标题“中国”，深色副标题“国家概况”，一条细红分割线，以及一段简短文字：“中国，全称中华人民共和国，是位于东亚的国家。它是世界上人口最多的国家，人口超过 14 亿。”

左侧统计卡片：一张圆角白色长卡片，包含 5 行堆叠的事实数据，每行配有红色圆形图标和文字。5 行内容为：人口 — {argument name="population value" default="14.1 亿"} — 世界排名：第 1；GDP（名义） — 17.79 万亿美元 — 世界排名：第 2；人均 GDP — 12,614 美元 — 世界排名：第 63；首都 — {argument name="capital city" default="北京"}；官方语言 — {argument name="official language" default="中文（普通话）"}。行与行之间使用细分割线。

右上角概况卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为红色的“概况”。包含 4 行红色图标内容：政府 — 单一制社会主义共和国；成立日期 — 1949 年 10 月 1 日；土地面积 — 960 万平方公里，世界排名：第 3；人口密度 — 约 147 人/平方公里。

中右侧经济图表卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“经济概览”，副标题为“(名义 GDP)”，并附有小标签“万亿美元”。包含 4 根垂直柱状图，分别代表 2020、2021、2022、2023 年，数值分别为 14.72、16.86、17.96、17.79。2020–2022 年使用蓝色柱状，2023 年使用红色柱状。

左下角产业卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“产业构成 (按 GDP)”。包含 3 部分组成的环形图：蓝色代表工业 39.7%，红色代表服务业 53.2%，绿色代表农业 7.1%。添加带有相同 3 个标签和百分比的图例。

底部中心出口卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“主要出口产品 (2023 年)”。包含 5 列出口数据，配有蓝色线条图标和红色数值：电子产品 — 1.02 万亿美元；机械设备 — 0.78 万亿美元；纺织服装 — 0.31 万亿美元；汽车产品 — 0.26 万亿美元；化学产品 — 0.23 万亿美元。

右下角贸易伙伴卡片：一张圆角白色卡片，标题为“主要贸易伙伴 (按贸易总额)”。包含 5 条蓝色水平柱状图，配有小型旗帜图标和数值：美国 — 6640 亿美元；欧盟 — 6430 亿美元；东盟 — 5960 亿美元；中国香港 — 2650 亿美元；日本 — 2270 亿美元。

页脚：居中放置一行小字来源说明：“数据来源：世界银行、世界贸易组织、中国国家统计局。”

约束条件：所有卡片需围绕地图排列且互不重叠，使用统一的字体，红色标题，蓝色图表元素，柔和的投影，圆角卡片，且不得添加水印。

templates.title: Sonia Delaunay Orphism Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Sonia Delaunay Orphism 时尚海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical fashion-art poster portraying {argument name="artist name" default="Sonia Delaunay"} and the movement {argument name="art movement" default="Orphism"} as a symbolic AI portrait, blending haute couture photography with modernist abstract geometry.

Canvas: Tall portrait poster, 9:16 aspect ratio, vivid saturated red background and red glossy floor with subtle reflection. The composition places the human figure in the lower-left third and a huge abstract projected silhouette occupying the right two-thirds.

Typography: In the upper-left corner, use exactly 3 visible text elements: 1) large thin white uppercase “SONIA” on the first line and “DELAUNAY” on the second line, 2) very large bold condensed white uppercase “ORPHISM” beneath it, 3) small white uppercase “SONIA DELAUNAY” below a thin horizontal rule. Keep the typography clean, Swiss/poster-like, aligned left.

Subject details: A full-body elegant woman stands facing forward with a poised fashion-editorial posture, one hand near her chin and the other hand tucked into a pocket. Her face is intentionally simplified and softly obscured, like a smooth rectangular blur, while her short dark 1920s-style bob haircut remains visible. She wears exactly 6 visible fashion elements: a long sleeveless geometric color-block dress, black long-sleeve underlayer, cream-colored right sleeve panel, long black bead necklace, black Mary Jane heels, and a black side skirt or coat panel. The dress features Sonia Delaunay-inspired Orphic color blocks: red, yellow, green, blue, cream, orange, black, purple, and pink, with circular arcs, semi-circles, triangles, and curved panels.

Projected inner world: Behind and to the right of the figure, create one monumental dark red translucent shadow silhouette suggesting a profile bust or inner psyche. Within this projection include exactly 9 major abstract geometric components: 1 large head profile silhouette facing left, 2 concentric target circles near the head, 1 large concentric circle around the torso, 1 dark central circle inside it, 1 tall triangular wedge descending through the body, 1 diagonal ribbon sweeping from lower left to middle right, 1 small dark circle near the lower torso, and 1 small dark circle near the bottom right. Use layered transparent crimson, burgundy, black-red, and orange-red tones so the shapes look like projected light and shadow.

Visual style: High-fashion editorial lighting, theatrical red studio set, strong contrast, glossy floor reflection, modern poster design, crisp typography, cinematic shadows, clean digital image quality. The mood should feel like a symbolic portrait of an artist’s inner world expressed through Orphist abstraction.

Constraints: Do not add extra people, logos, watermarks, captions, or additional text beyond the 3 specified text elements. Keep the palette dominated by red with white typography and multicolor geometric clothing. Preserve the vertical poster layout and the large abstract shadow projection.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版时尚艺术海报，将 {argument name="artist name" default="Sonia Delaunay"} 和 {argument name="art movement" default="Orphism"} 运动表现为象征性的 AI 肖像，融合高级定制摄影与现代主义抽象几何风格。

画布：高长肖像海报，9:16 纵横比，鲜艳饱和的红色背景和带有细微反射的红色光面地板。构图将人物置于左下三分之一处，巨大的抽象投射轮廓占据右侧三分之二区域。

排版：在左上角，使用 3 个清晰可见的文本元素：1) 第一行是大号纤细白色大写字母“SONIA”，第二行是“DELAUNAY”；2) 下方是超大号粗体压缩白色大写字母“ORPHISM”；3) 在一条细水平线下方是小号白色大写字母“SONIA DELAUNAY”。保持排版简洁，具有瑞士风格/海报感，左对齐。

主体细节：一位全身优雅的女性正面站立，姿态如同时尚大片，一只手靠近下巴，另一只手插在口袋里。她的面部被刻意简化并柔和遮盖，呈现为平滑的矩形模糊状，但她标志性的 1920 年代短波波头清晰可见。她穿着 6 件可见的时尚单品：一件长款无袖几何色块连衣裙、黑色长袖内搭、奶油色右袖拼接、长款黑色珠饰项链、黑色玛丽珍鞋以及黑色侧裙或外套拼接。连衣裙采用受 Sonia Delaunay 启发的 Orphic 色块：红色、黄色、绿色、蓝色、奶油色、橙色、黑色、紫色和粉色，并饰有圆弧、半圆、三角形和曲线拼接。

投射的内心世界：在人物后方及右侧，创造一个巨大的深红色半透明阴影轮廓，暗示侧面半身像或内心精神世界。在此投影中包含 9 个主要的抽象几何组件：1 个面向左侧的大型头部轮廓剪影、头部附近的 2 个同心圆、躯干周围的 1 个大型同心圆、其中的 1 个深色中心圆、穿过身体的 1 个高大三角形楔形、从左下扫向中右的 1 条对角丝带、躯干下部附近的 1 个小深色圆圈，以及右下角附近的 1 个小深色圆圈。使用分层的透明深红、酒红、黑红和橙红色调，使形状看起来如同投射的光影。

视觉风格：高级时尚编辑灯光、戏剧性的红色摄影棚布景、强烈的对比度、光面地板反射、现代海报设计、清晰的排版、电影质感的阴影、干净的数字图像质量。氛围应如同通过 Orphism 抽象表现出的艺术家内心世界的象征性肖像。

约束：除指定的 3 个文本元素外，请勿添加额外人物、徽标、水印、标题或其他文字。保持以红色为主的色调，搭配白色排版和多色几何服装。保留竖版海报布局和大型抽象阴影投影。

templates.title: Pixar-Style Coffee Brand Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 皮克斯风格咖啡品牌项目

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished AI storyboard for a coffee brand titled {argument name="story title" default="Bean to Smile"}, showing a warm Pixar-style animated café story from opening the shop to serving a delighted customer.

Canvas: Square image, clean white background, with a centered 2-row storyboard grid of exactly 8 vertical rounded-rectangle panels. Use thin white gutters between panels and a subtle light gray outer border/shadow around the full storyboard. Each panel has cinematic composition, warm amber lighting, shallow depth of field, soft volumetric glow, and highly detailed 3D animated film rendering.

Visual style: Pixar-inspired 3D animation, cozy artisan coffee shop interior, golden morning sunlight, exposed wood counters, shelves of jars and plants, hanging Edison bulbs, espresso machine, warm browns and greens, inviting brand-storytelling mood. The recurring main character is a young barista with {argument name="barista hair" default="curly dark brown hair"}, wearing a white shirt and {argument name="apron color" default="forest green apron"}. Faces may be softly stylized and friendly, but keep the story readable through body language and props.

Storyboard layout and exact panel count: Include exactly 8 panels, arranged as 4 panels on the top row and 4 panels on the bottom row.

Panel 1: Wide shot of the barista opening or wiping the café’s front glass door in morning sunlight, plants near the window, espresso machine and shelves visible inside.
Panel 2: Medium shot of the barista pouring roasted coffee beans from a small wooden scoop or bag into a grinder on the wooden counter.
Panel 3: Close medium shot of the barista tamping fresh coffee grounds into a portafilter with focused hands, café shelves and hanging bulbs behind.
Panel 4: Close-up of espresso extraction from a large shiny espresso machine into a white cup, the barista operating the handle.
Panel 5: Close-up of the barista steaming milk in a metal pitcher, visible white steam curling upward beside the espresso machine.
Panel 6: Close-up of milk being poured into a white cup of coffee, forming latte art on the crema on the wooden counter.
Panel 7: Medium shot of the barista presenting the finished latte on a saucer across the counter, latte art visible, warm sunlight in the background.
Panel 8: Emotional final shot of a smiling customer seated at the wooden counter receiving the drink from the barista, suggesting satisfaction and brand warmth.

Text content: No captions inside the storyboard panels. If adding an optional small title outside the grid, use only {argument name="brand text" default="Bean to Smile"} in a tasteful coffee-brand style.

Constraints: Do not add extra panels, speech bubbles, watermarks, logos, or unrelated objects. Keep the same barista, apron, café environment, and lighting consistent across all 8 panels. Make the image look like a complete premium brand storyboard for a coffee commercial.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="story title" default="Bean to Smile"} 的咖啡品牌创建一个精致的 AI 项目，展示一个温馨的皮克斯风格动画咖啡馆故事，从开店到为满意的顾客提供服务。

画布：方形图像，干净的白色背景，居中放置一个 2 行的项目网格，包含 8 个垂直圆角矩形面板。面板之间使用细白色间隙，整个项目周围有微妙的浅灰色外边框/阴影。每个面板都具有电影般的构图、温暖的琥珀色灯光、浅景深、柔和的体积光效果以及高度精细的 3D 动画电影渲染。

视觉风格：皮克斯风格的 3D 动画，舒适的手工咖啡馆内部，金色的晨光，裸露的木质柜台，摆满罐子和植物的架子，悬挂的爱迪生灯泡，浓缩咖啡机，温暖的棕色和绿色，引人入胜的品牌叙事氛围。反复出现的主角是一位年轻的咖啡师，留着 {argument name="barista hair" default="深棕色卷发"}，穿着白色衬衫和 {argument name="apron color" default="森林绿围裙"}。面部可以进行柔和的风格化处理，显得友好，但要通过肢体语言和道具保持故事的可读性。

项目布局和精确面板数量：包含 8 个面板，排列为顶部 4 个面板，底部 4 个面板。

面板 1：咖啡师在晨光中打开或擦拭咖啡馆前玻璃门的广角镜头，窗边有植物，室内可见浓缩咖啡机和架子。
面板 2：咖啡师将烘焙好的咖啡豆从木勺或袋子倒入木质柜台上的研磨机的中景镜头。
面板 3：咖啡师专注地将新鲜咖啡粉压入滤杯的近中景镜头，背景是咖啡馆架子和悬挂的灯泡。
面板 4：浓缩咖啡从闪亮的咖啡机中萃取到白色杯子里的特写镜头，咖啡师正在操作手柄。
面板 5：咖啡师在金属拉花缸中打奶泡的特写镜头，浓缩咖啡机旁可见卷曲的白色蒸汽。
面板 6：牛奶倒入白色咖啡杯，在木质柜台上的咖啡油脂上形成拉花艺术的特写镜头。
面板 7：咖啡师在柜台对面递出完成的拿铁的中景镜头，可见拉花艺术，背景是温暖的阳光。
面板 8：坐在木质柜台前的顾客从咖啡师手中接过饮品时微笑的情感特写镜头，传达出满足感和品牌温度。

文本内容：项目面板内无标题。如果要在网格外部添加可选的小标题，请仅使用 {argument name="brand text" default="Bean to Smile"}，并采用高雅的咖啡品牌风格。

限制：不要添加额外的面板、对话气泡、水印、徽标或无关物体。在所有 8 个面板中保持相同的咖啡师、围裙、咖啡馆环境和灯光一致。使图像看起来像是一个完整的、用于咖啡广告的高级品牌项目。

templates.title: Odesa Postmodernism Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 敖德萨后现代主义人物海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical editorial character poster inspired by Odesa postmodernism, combining a fashion portrait with a bold symbolic inner-world mural.

Canvas: Tall vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, full-bleed saturated red background and glossy red floor with subtle reflections. High-contrast studio lighting, sharp foreground subject, slightly softer oversized graphic shadow mural behind them.

Layout: Place the figure full-body in the lower left third, standing casually with hands in coat pockets, leaning slightly back. Put large typography in the upper left: a small black uppercase line reading “| {argument name="artist name" default="OLEKSANDR ROITBURD"}” above two large stacked white uppercase words reading “{argument name="poster headline" default="POSTMODERNISM"}” and “{argument name="city text" default="ODESA"}”. Fill the right two-thirds with a monumental black silhouette mural shaped like a crowned human profile facing right, extending from upper right to near the floor.

Subject details: The foreground person is an older, slim, stylish man with short white hair and a deliberately anonymized face covered by a centered soft square blur. He wears a long black coat, black blazer, black T-shirt with one large red square on the chest, loose cropped dark trousers with rolled cuffs, black-and-white striped socks, and polished red lace-up shoes. Keep the pose relaxed and theatrical.

Symbolic mural: Use exactly 11 visible black-and-red motifs integrated inside or around the large profile silhouette: 1 crown on the head, 1 single eye inside the head, 1 white dove-like bird near the mouth, 1 small church or Odesa architectural facade, 1 diagonal staircase, 1 sailboat on waves, 1 classical column, 1 fish, 1 human figure with raised arms, 1 stylized tree, and 1 horse with a rider. The mural should feel like a cut-paper shadow theater projection, graphic and postmodern.

Visual style: Dramatic museum-poster photography mixed with flat symbolic illustration; intense red, black, and white palette with only the subject’s skin, gray-white hair, and red shoes adding realism. Use crisp typography, clean negative space, theatrical shadows, glossy floor reflections, and a sophisticated contemporary art-poster mood.

Constraints: Preserve the exact three-line title placement and the 11 counted symbolic motifs. Do not add extra logos, captions, borders, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张受敖德萨后现代主义启发的竖版编辑风格人物海报，将时尚肖像与大胆的象征性内心世界壁画相结合。

画布：高竖版海报，2:3 比例，全出血饱和红色背景，带有细微反射的亮面红色地板。高对比度摄影棚灯光，前景主体清晰，身后为略显柔和的超大图形阴影壁画。

布局：将人物全身置于左下三分之一处，双手插在外套口袋里，随意站立，身体略微后倾。在左上方放置大号排版：一行小号黑色大写字母“| {argument name="artist name" default="OLEKSANDR ROITBURD"}”，下方是两行巨大的堆叠式白色大写单词“{argument name="poster headline" default="POSTMODERNISM"}”和“{argument name="city text" default="ODESA"}”。右侧三分之二区域填充一个巨大的黑色剪影壁画，形状为一个面向右侧的加冕人像侧脸，从右上角一直延伸至接近地面处。

主体细节：前景人物是一位年长、苗条、时髦的男性，留着白色短发，脸部被居中的柔和方形模糊处理，刻意隐去面容。他身穿黑色长外套、黑色西装外套、胸前印有一个大红色方块的黑色 T 恤、宽松的深色九分裤（卷边）、黑白条纹袜以及抛光的红色系带皮鞋。保持姿势放松且具有戏剧感。

象征性壁画：在大型侧脸剪影内部或周围精确使用 11 个可见的黑红色主题元素：头顶 1 个皇冠，头部内 1 只眼睛，嘴部附近 1 只白鸽般的鸟，1 座小型教堂或敖德萨建筑立面，1 条对角楼梯，1 艘波浪上的帆船，1 根古典立柱，1 条鱼，1 个举起双臂的人形，1 棵风格化树木，以及 1 个骑马的人。壁画应呈现出剪纸皮影戏的质感，具有图形化和后现代感。

视觉风格：戏剧性的博物馆海报摄影与扁平化象征性插画相结合；强烈的红、黑、白配色，仅主体皮肤、灰白色头发和红色鞋子增加真实感。使用清晰的排版、干净的留白、戏剧性的阴影、亮面地板反射，以及精致的当代艺术海报氛围。

限制：保留精确的三行标题布局和 11 个指定的象征性主题元素。不要添加额外的标志、标题、边框或水印。

templates.title: Celestial Goddess Archer

titleLocalized.zh: 天界女神射手

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2K cinematic fantasy artwork of {argument name="mythic archer" default="a celestial goddess archer"} floating full-body in the center of a dark cosmic void. She has long wild {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair blown dramatically to the left, her face partly shadowed, and an intense poised expression as she draws a glowing golden arrow across her chest. Her right arm pulls the bowstring near her cheek while her left arm extends straight outward holding an ornate crescent-shaped golden bow with sharp filigree tips. She wears intricate gilded armor over a translucent flowing ivory-gold gown, with delicate chains, leaflike metalwork, arm cuffs, and sheer fabric swirling around her legs like smoke. Surround her with one large luminous circular astrolabe halo behind her torso, thin geometric constellation lines, star points, dust particles, smoky nebula textures, and radiant golden energy emanating from behind her head and from beneath her feet. The color palette is black, deep charcoal, antique gold, warm amber, and soft ivory. Lighting should be dramatic backlit chiaroscuro with glowing rim light, sparkling particles, ultra-detailed metal engraving, ethereal fabric transparency, cinematic contrast, and a mythological high-fashion aesthetic. Add a small {argument name="logo text" default="SocialSight"} wordmark in the top-left corner. No other text, no extra characters, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2K 竖版电影级奇幻艺术作品，主角为 {argument name="mythic archer" default="一位天界女神射手"}，全身漂浮在黑暗宇宙虚空的中心。她留着一头狂野的长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"}，长发向左侧剧烈飘动；她的面部部分处于阴影中，神情专注而坚定，正将一支发光的金色箭矢拉至胸前。她的右手将弓弦拉至脸颊旁，左手向外平伸，握着一把带有尖锐花丝装饰的华丽新月形金弓。她身着复杂的镀金盔甲，内搭半透明的象牙金长袍，精致的链条、叶状金属饰品、臂环以及如烟雾般环绕在腿部的轻薄织物随风飘动。在她的躯干后方环绕着一个巨大的发光圆形星盘光环，背景点缀着纤细的几何星座线条、星点、尘埃颗粒、烟雾状星云纹理，以及从她头部后方和脚下散发出的璀璨金光。配色方案为黑色、深炭色、古金色、暖琥珀色和柔和的象牙色。光影应采用戏剧性的背光明暗对比法，呈现发光的轮廓光、闪烁的微粒、超精细的金属雕刻、空灵的织物透明感、电影级的对比度以及神话般的高级时尚美学。在左上角添加一个小的 {argument name="logo text" default="SocialSight"} 字标。不要包含其他文字、多余字符或现代物品。

templates.title: LLM Architecture Chat Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: LLM 架构聊天截图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot of an AI chat interface showing a generated technical infographic about {argument name="topic" default="how Large Language Models (LLMs) work technically"}. The screenshot should look like a modern web app conversation, not a standalone poster.

Canvas: 768×1024 vertical screenshot, light gray app background, rounded white content areas, clean sans-serif typography, subtle shadows, high-resolution but with the infographic text slightly small like a real embedded generated image.

Chat UI layout: At the top left show a small circular user avatar, the chat title “Visualizing LLM Architecture” with a tiny dropdown chevron, and at the top right a simple “Files” label with an icon. Below, show a rounded user message bubble aligned near the top center/right containing: “make an image explaining how LLMs work technically”. Under it, show a small status row reading “Scira task complete” with a sparkle/loader icon and chevron. The main generated image appears below as a large rounded rectangle card. Beneath the image, include assistant explanatory text: “The image above is a comprehensive technical infographic breaking down how Large Language Models function under the hood. Here is a detailed walkthrough of each component shown:” followed by the bold section heading “Tokenization: From Text to Numbers”. At the bottom, show a rounded input box with placeholder “Ask a follow-up...”, a plus button on the left, small tool/model controls on the right, the model label “Kimi K2.6” with a dropdown, and a circular voice button.

Generated infographic inside the chat: Design a blue-and-white technical educational poster titled in large navy caps: “HOW LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS (LLMs) WORK”. Use a white background, navy-blue outlines, light-blue highlights, rounded panels, arrows connecting steps, miniature charts, equations, tables, and icons. The poster should be information-dense and engineering-oriented.

Infographic sections: Use exactly 8 labeled panels/areas:
1. “INPUT: TOKENIZATION” panel showing a raw text box with the sentence “The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.”, a tokenizer block, token boxes for the words, and token ID boxes.
2. “EMBEDDINGS” panel showing token IDs converted into dense vectors, with a small table of numeric embedding values.
3. “TRANSFORMER ARCHITECTURE” panel showing a stacked transformer block with Add & Norm, Feed-Forward Network, Multi-Head Self-Attention, input embeddings, positional encoding, and layer repetition notation.
4A. “SELF-ATTENTION MECHANISM (INSIDE ONE HEAD)” wide lower-left panel showing matrices for input embeddings, queries, keys, values, attention scores, softmax, attention weights, weighted sum, and equations.
4B. “ATTENTION: TOKENS ATTEND TO EACH OTHER” panel showing a network graph of tokens from the example sentence connected by blue lines plus attention-weight bars.
5. “OUTPUT: NEXT TOKEN PREDICTION” panel showing probability distribution bars for candidate next tokens such as cat, sat, on, the, mat, roof, then highlighting the predicted next token “the”.
6. “TRAINING: PRE-TRAINING WITH NEXT-TOKEN PREDICTION” long bottom strip divided into 5 mini-cards: massive text corpus, creating training examples, model prediction, loss calculation, and backpropagation/update.
7. Bottom process arrow reading “Repeat for billions of examples over many epochs until convergence.”
8. Bottom-right result callout with a brain icon explaining that the model learns general language patterns and knowledge.

Visual style: Crisp vector infographic, academic but friendly, dark navy headings, medium-blue borders, pale-blue fills, tiny tables and plots, clean arrows, rounded cards, consistent spacing. Make the embedded infographic resemble an AI-generated educational diagram with dense but mostly legible small text.

Constraints: Keep all UI text in English. Do not add watermarks. Preserve the visible chat screenshot framing and the large embedded infographic. Use exactly the listed 8 infographic areas and exactly 5 mini-cards inside the training strip.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张逼真的 AI 聊天界面截图，展示一张关于 {argument name="topic" default="大语言模型 (LLMs) 技术原理"} 的生成式技术信息图。截图应呈现为现代 Web 应用的对话形式，而非独立的宣传海报。

画布：768×1024 垂直截图，浅灰色应用背景，圆角白色内容区域，简洁的无衬线字体，细微阴影，高分辨率，但信息图中的文字应像真实的嵌入式生成图像一样稍小。

聊天 UI 布局：左上角显示一个小型圆形用户头像，聊天标题“Visualizing LLM Architecture”及一个小巧的下拉箭头；右上角显示简单的“Files”标签及图标。下方显示一个居中/靠右对齐的圆角用户消息气泡，内容为：“make an image explaining how LLMs work technically”。下方显示一行状态栏，写着“Scira task complete”，配有闪烁/加载图标和箭头。主要生成的图像以大圆角矩形卡片形式出现在下方。图像下方包含助手的解释性文字：“The image above is a comprehensive technical infographic breaking down how Large Language Models function under the hood. Here is a detailed walkthrough of each component shown:”，随后是加粗的章节标题“Tokenization: From Text to Numbers”。底部显示一个圆角输入框，占位符为“Ask a follow-up...”，左侧有一个加号按钮，右侧有小型工具/模型控件，模型标签“Kimi K2.6”及下拉菜单，以及一个圆形语音按钮。

聊天中的生成式信息图：设计一张蓝白配色的技术教育海报，大号海军蓝大写标题为：“HOW LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS (LLMs) WORK”。使用白色背景、海军蓝轮廓、浅蓝色高亮、圆角面板，以及连接步骤的箭头、微型图表、公式、表格和图标。海报应信息密集且偏向工程化。

信息图板块：使用 8 个带标签的面板/区域：
1. “INPUT: TOKENIZATION”面板：显示一个原始文本框，内容为句子“The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.”，一个分词器模块，单词的 Token 框，以及 Token ID 框。
2. “EMBEDDINGS”面板：显示转换为密集向量的 Token ID，以及一个包含数值嵌入值的表格。
3. “TRANSFORMER ARCHITECTURE”面板：显示堆叠的 Transformer 模块，包含 Add & Norm、前馈网络 (Feed-Forward Network)、多头自注意力机制 (Multi-Head Self-Attention)、输入嵌入、位置编码以及层重复符号。
4A. “SELF-ATTENTION MECHANISM (INSIDE ONE HEAD)”：左下角宽面板，显示输入嵌入、查询 (Queries)、键 (Keys)、值 (Values)、注意力分数、Softmax、注意力权重、加权求和及公式的矩阵。
4B. “ATTENTION: TOKENS ATTEND TO EACH OTHER”面板：显示示例句子中 Token 的网络图，由蓝色线条连接，并配有注意力权重条。
5. “OUTPUT: NEXT TOKEN PREDICTION”面板：显示候选下一个 Token（如 cat, sat, on, the, mat, roof）的概率分布条，并高亮显示预测的下一个 Token “the”。
6. “TRAINING: PRE-TRAINING WITH NEXT-TOKEN PREDICTION”：底部的长条，分为 5 个迷你卡片：海量文本语料库、创建训练示例、模型预测、损失计算以及反向传播/更新。
7. 底部流程箭头，文字为：“Repeat for billions of examples over many epochs until convergence.”
8. 右下角结果标注，配有大脑图标，解释模型如何学习通用语言模式和知识。

视觉风格：清晰的矢量信息图，学术且友好，深海军蓝标题，中蓝色边框，浅蓝色填充，微型表格和图表，简洁的箭头，圆角卡片，一致的间距。使嵌入的信息图看起来像一张 AI 生成的教育图表，文字密集但大部分清晰可辨。

约束：所有 UI 文字保持为英文。不要添加水印。保留可见的聊天截图框架和大型嵌入式信息图。使用列出的 8 个信息图区域，并在训练长条内使用 5 个迷你卡片。
