templates.title: Executive AI Operating Readout

titleLocalized.zh: 高管 AI 运营解读

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a hand-drawn strategy infographic titled {argument name="headline text" default="EXECUTIVE READOUT"} with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="Your Current Operating Identity"}, summarizing an AI/business operating identity in a playful consulting whiteboard style.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, white background, thick black rounded outer border, black hand-lettered typography with blue accents, red inference badges, green confirmation badges, and small doodle icons around the margins. Use a clean sketchnote style with marker-like outlines, subtle off-white card fills, and lightly colored icon panels.

Layout: Divide the page into four large rounded rectangular panels in a 2-by-2 grid, plus one full-width label guide strip at the bottom. Each main panel has a blue numbered circle at top left. Add decorative icons around the top edge: exactly 11 visible doodles/icons consisting of a large blue gear, a small gray gear, a red star, two molecule/network icons, a yellow lightbulb, two sparkle marks, a rising bar chart with red arrow, a red target with arrow, and a rocket.

Panel 1: Numbered “1.” and titled “CONFIRMED: WHAT YOU OPERATE ACROSS.” Add the explanatory text: “You operate at the intersection of AI storytelling, prompt engineering, digital product building, B2B lifecycle & retention strategy, marketplace monetization, SEO/content systems, and visual campaign creation.” Show a central circular portrait of a smiling professional with white hair wearing a blue jacket and red tie, pointing upward, surrounded by connected nodes. Include exactly 7 labeled capability boxes around the portrait: “AI Storytelling,” “Prompt Engineering,” “Digital Products,” “B2B Retention Strategy,” “Marketplace Monetization,” “SEO / Content Systems,” and “Visual Campaign Creation.” Add a green pill label reading “CONFIRMED.”

Panel 2: Numbered “2.” and titled “STRONGEST FUTURE ADVANTAGE.” Add the text: “Your edge is not just prompting. It is turning AI into repeatable business systems.” Show a left-to-right flow with three large elements: a thought cloud labeled “Ideas / Prompts,” a central factory/machine with gears, and a chart card labeled “Repeatable Business Systems,” connected by blue arrows. Below it show exactly 5 output cards labeled “Productized Assistants,” “Campaign Kits,” “Visual Storytelling Engines,” “Retention Frameworks,” and “Marketplace-Ready Workflows.” Add a red badge at the bottom reading “STRONG INFERENCE.”

Panel 3: Numbered “3.” and titled “BIGGEST BOTTLENECK.” Add the text: “Your bottleneck is not creativity. It is systemization.” Split the panel with a dotted vertical divider. Left side has a green header “Creativity = Strong” and shows the same person from behind amid idea doodles such as a lightbulb, pencil, notes, sparkles, and a target. Right side has a red header “Systemization Needs Work” and shows the person looking stressed with question marks and a stack of process cards. Include exactly 4 process cards: “Packaging ideas into reusable assets,” “Automating delivery,” “Reducing rework,” and “Building one repeatable operating system.” Put a spiky “VS.” burst in the center. Bottom callout with target icon: “The goal: stop restarting from scratch for every product, prompt, deck, or campaign.” Add a red badge “STRONG INFERENCE.”

Panel 4: Numbered “4.” and titled “IDEAL AI SETUP.” Add the text: “You do not need one chatbot. You need a small AI operating team configured around your real work.” Show a central blue circle labeled {argument name="central system name" default="AI OPERATING TEAM"} with small person dots inside, connected to exactly 8 role cards arranged around it: “Execution Manager,” “Research Strategist,” “Product Architect,” “Creative Director,” “Prompt Engineer,” “Workflow Builder,” “Copy Chief,” and “SEO Operator.” Use thin connector lines with colored nodes. Add a red badge “STRONG INFERENCE.”

Bottom label guide: Full-width rounded strip titled “LABEL GUIDE” with a clipboard icon on the left. Include exactly 2 legend entries: green check icon with “Confirmed = directly supported by repeated historical context” and red star icon with “Strong inference = pattern-based conclusion from recurring behavior.” Add three decorative icons at the right: a magnifying glass and two gears, plus tiny sparkles.

Visual style: playful executive whiteboard infographic, thick black marker outlines, rounded cards, bright but restrained palette of sky blue, red, green, yellow, and gray, hand-drawn business icons, dense but readable composition, no photorealism, no shadows beyond simple marker shading.

Constraints: Keep all text in English, preserve the exact four-panel structure, use exactly 4 main panels and exactly 7 capability boxes, 5 output cards, 4 process cards, 8 AI role cards, and 2 legend entries. Avoid extra sections, watermarks, logos, or unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张手绘风格的战略信息图，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="高管解读"}，副标题为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="你当前的运营身份"}，以趣味性的咨询白板风格总结 AI / 业务运营身份。

画布：方形 1:1 图像，白色背景，粗黑色圆角外边框，黑色手写字体配蓝色点缀，红色推理徽章，绿色确认徽章，边缘装饰有小型涂鸦图标。采用简洁的速记风格，带有马克笔般的轮廓、微妙的灰白色卡片填充和浅色图标面板。

布局：将页面分为四个大型圆角矩形面板（2x2 网格），底部设有一个全宽标签指南条。每个主面板左上角都有一个蓝色数字圆圈。顶部边缘添加装饰性图标：共 11 个可见涂鸦/图标，包括一个大蓝色齿轮、一个小灰色齿轮、一颗红星、两个分子/网络图标、一个黄色灯泡、两个闪光符号、一个带有红色箭头的上升柱状图、一个带有箭头的红色靶心以及一个火箭。

面板 1：编号“1.”，标题为“已确认：你的运营领域”。添加说明文字：“你处于 AI 叙事、Prompt Engineering、数字产品构建、B2B 生命周期与留存策略、市场变现、SEO / 内容系统以及视觉营销创作的交叉点。”展示一个中心圆形肖像，主角是一位面带微笑、白发、身穿蓝色夹克系红领带的专业人士，指向前方，周围环绕着连接节点。肖像周围包含 7 个带标签的能力框：“AI 叙事”、“Prompt Engineering”、“数字产品”、“B2B 留存策略”、“市场变现”、“SEO / 内容系统”和“视觉营销创作”。添加一个绿色药丸状标签，写着“已确认”。

面板 2：编号“2.”，标题为“最强的未来优势”。添加文字：“你的优势不仅仅在于提示词。而是将 AI 转化为可重复的业务系统。”展示一个从左到右的流程，包含三个大元素：标有“创意 / Prompts”的思维云图、一个带有齿轮的中央工厂/机器，以及一张标有“可重复业务系统”的图表卡片，由蓝色箭头连接。下方展示 5 张输出卡片，分别标为“产品化 Assistants”、“营销工具包”、“视觉叙事引擎”、“留存框架”和“市场就绪工作流”。底部添加一个红色徽章，写着“强推理”。

面板 3：编号“3.”，标题为“最大的瓶颈”。添加文字：“你的瓶颈不是创造力。而是系统化。”用虚线垂直分隔线将面板一分为二。左侧带有绿色标题“创造力 = 强”，展示同一人物背影，周围环绕着灯泡、铅笔、笔记、闪光和靶心等创意涂鸦。右侧带有红色标题“系统化需改进”，展示该人物看起来压力很大，周围有问号和一叠流程卡片。包含 4 张流程卡片：“将创意打包为可复用资产”、“自动化交付”、“减少返工”和“构建一套可重复的操作系统”。中心放置一个尖刺状的“VS.”爆发图标。底部标注目标图标：“目标：停止为每个产品、Prompt、演示文稿或营销活动从零开始。”添加红色徽章“强推理”。

面板 4：编号“4.”，标题为“理想的 AI 配置”。添加文字：“你不需要一个聊天机器人。你需要一个围绕你实际工作配置的小型 AI 运营团队。”展示一个中央蓝色圆圈，标有 {argument name="central system name" default="AI 运营团队"}，内部有小人点，连接到周围的 8 张角色卡片：“执行经理”、“研究策略师”、“产品架构师”、“创意总监”、“Prompt Engineer”、“工作流构建师”、“文案主管”和“SEO 运营”。使用带有彩色节点的细连接线。添加红色徽章“强推理”。

底部标签指南：全宽圆角条，标题为“标签指南”，左侧带有剪贴板图标。包含 2 个图例条目：绿色勾选图标对应“已确认 = 由重复的历史背景直接支持”，红色星形图标对应“强推理 = 基于重复行为的模式化结论”。右侧添加三个装饰图标：一个放大镜和两个齿轮，以及微小的闪光符号。

视觉风格：趣味性高管白板信息图，粗黑色马克笔轮廓，圆角卡片，天蓝、红、绿、黄、灰组成的明亮但克制的调色板，手绘商业图标，构图紧凑但易读，无照片写实感，除简单的马克笔阴影外无其他阴影。

约束：保持所有文字为英文（注：此处按要求翻译为中文），保留精确的四面板结构，使用 4 个主面板、7 个能力框、5 个输出卡片、4 个流程卡片、8 个 AI 角色卡片和 2 个图例条目。避免额外的部分、水印、徽标或无关文本。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic widescreen film still of a glamorous {argument name="character description" default="platinum blonde woman with a 1960s bouffant hairstyle"} leaning against a wall in a dim interior, positioned on the far left third of the frame with large negative space to the right. She is bare-shouldered, wearing chunky gold jewelry including exactly 2 visible accessories: a gold chain necklace and a large gold ring, and she holds exactly 1 lit white cigarette beside her cheek with faint smoke drifting upward. Her face is intentionally obscured by exactly 1 opaque square censor block in muted brown, centered over the face and covering the eyes, nose, and mouth while leaving the hair, hand, shoulder, and jewelry visible. Use moody teal-and-gold color grading, low-key directional window light, soft haze, deep shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and hair texture, vintage noir glamour, 35mm anamorphic cinema look, subtle film grain, natural lens softness, dark architectural background with blurred horizontal and diagonal shapes, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张宽银幕电影剧照，画面主体为一位迷人的 {argument name="character description" default="留着 1960 年代蓬松发型的白金发色女性"}，她倚靠在昏暗室内的墙边，位于画面左侧三分之一处，右侧留有大面积负空间。她裸露双肩，佩戴着粗犷的金色首饰，包括 2 件清晰可见的配饰：一条金链项链和一枚大金戒指；她手持 1 支点燃的白色香烟置于脸颊旁，有淡淡的烟雾向上飘散。她的面部被 1 个哑光棕色的方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮挡块位于面部中心，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，但保留了头发、手部、肩膀和首饰的可见度。采用忧郁的青金色调，低调的窗户定向光，柔和的雾气，深邃的阴影，浅景深，逼真的皮肤和头发纹理，复古黑色电影魅力，35mm 变形宽银幕电影质感，细腻的胶片颗粒，自然的镜头柔光，背景为带有模糊水平和对角线形状的深色建筑，无文字，无水印。

The wet or glossy stone steps catch strong orange-pink sunset reflections, creating long dark shadows stretching toward the viewer. Frame the path with exactly two prominent traditional houses, one on the left with a gray tiled roof and one on the right with dark wooden siding and a balcony-like facade; include stone walls, metal handrails, utility poles, small rooftops, and dense greenery along the narrow slope. Overhead, dark tree branches and leaves form a natural silhouette canopy across the top of the image. In the distance, show a calm ocean bay with a glowing vertical trail of sunlight on the water, a low sun near the horizon, small islands or headlands, and a compact coastal neighborhood below. Use {argument name="sunset color palette" default="warm pink, peach, lavender, and deep indigo"}, cinematic natural light, high contrast silhouettes, soft haze over the sea, realistic texture in the stones and rooftops, and a quiet nostalgic Japanese summer atmosphere. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张名为“初夏”的怀旧、照片级写实的竖构图场景：夕阳下，一条陡峭的古老石阶穿过宁静的日本海滨小镇向下延伸，视角从后方略高处俯瞰，{argument name="number of schoolgirls" default="两名"}日本女学生并肩走下坡。女孩们穿着夏季校服：白色短袖衬衫、深色格纹百褶裙、深色袜子和鞋子，每人背着一个深色书包；她们乌黑的长发和放松的姿态展现出放学回家的情景。潮湿或光亮的石阶映衬出浓郁的橙粉色夕阳倒影，投下向观者延伸的长长暗影。画面两侧各有一座显眼的传统房屋，左侧为灰色瓦顶，右侧为深色木质外墙及阳台式立面；沿狭窄的坡道加入石墙、金属扶手、电线杆、小型屋顶和茂密的植被。头顶上方，深色的树枝和叶片在画面顶部形成天然的剪影遮蔽。远处展示平静的海湾，水面上有一道发光的垂直阳光轨迹，低垂的太阳靠近地平线，点缀着小岛或岬角，下方是紧凑的沿海社区。使用 {argument name="sunset color palette" default="暖粉色、桃色、淡紫色和深靛蓝色"}，电影般的自然光，高对比度剪影，海面上的柔和薄雾，石块和屋顶的写实纹理，营造出宁静的怀旧日式夏日氛围。画面中无文字、无水印、无现代标识，除两名女孩外无其他人物。

templates.title: Misty Floral Stand Spirit Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 迷雾花卉 Stand 灵体海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an atmospheric vertical “stand guardian spirit” character setting poster based on a gentle, misty feminine aura, combining a realistic fashion portrait with an ethereal mythical companion. The central concept is {argument name="stand name" default="彼岸花・霧"} with the romanized subtitle “Higanbana · Wu,” presented like a delicate fantasy character profile sheet.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, cinematic editorial composition, soft gray-green palette, dreamy backlit mist, shallow depth of field, high-detail photorealism mixed with fantasy illustration. Background is a quiet riverside or pond garden with dark water, willow branches hanging from above, floating petals, haze, and glowing dust motes.

Main subject: A young woman sits on a stone embankment in the lower center, elegant and calm, face intentionally obscured by a plain soft brown rectangular censor block. She has dark brown hair in a loose low bun with wispy strands. Outfit includes exactly 3 visible pieces: a white spaghetti-strap ruched mini dress with tiny pale floral print, an oversized off-white knitted cardigan slipped off the shoulders, and delicate thin shoulder straps. Pose is relaxed and graceful, one hand resting on the stone edge, legs angled forward, soft sunlight outlining her shoulders and hair.

Guardian spirit: Behind and to the upper right of the woman, create one large translucent white dragon/deer-like floral spirit, long and serpentine with an elegant skull-like face, closed or lowered eyes, tall branch-like horns, feathered or veil-like fins, and flowing gauze ribbons. It should look protective, silent, and otherworldly rather than aggressive. Decorate it with exactly 5 main ornament types: white blossoms, pearl chains, dangling tassels, sheer silk veils, and fine silver branches. The spirit curves around the woman like mist, framing her without covering the text.

Layout and typography: Design the poster as an information-dense character sheet with refined Chinese/Japanese editorial typography, thin white divider lines, small vertical annotation boxes, and elegant serif lettering. Use off-white text with subtle glow and high legibility. Include exactly 5 text zones: 1) top-left title block, 2) mid-left description block, 3) lower-left special ability block, 4) bottom-left design keywords and color palette, 5) right-side vertical lore panel plus bottom-right quote/profile card.

Text content: Top-left title block shows “替身設定” with small English “STAND NAME,” then the large title {argument name="stand name" default="彼岸花・霧"}, and the subtitle “Higanbana · Wu.” Mid-left description reads in Chinese poetic lines about her guardian spirit being like mist and silk, circling her silently, elegant and watchful. Lower-left section title is “特殊能力,” ability name {argument name="ability name" default="花影迷離"}, romanization “Hua Ying Mi Li,” followed by short Chinese ability notes describing petals, gentle illusions, blurred distance, and disappearing footprints. Bottom-left section title is “設計關聯,” followed by exactly 5 bullet points: floral elements, soft palette, mist connection, emotional symbolism, and guardian/dream motifs. Beneath it place exactly 7 circular color swatches: white, ivory, pale cream, muted blush, cool gray, sage gray-green, and deep taupe. Right side has a narrow vertical Chinese text panel describing the spirit’s form and temperament. Bottom-right includes the quote {argument name="quote" default="你看到的美好，也許只是我編織的夢。"} and a profile card titled “少女檔案” listing exactly 5 traits: personality, image, aura, temperament, and preference.

Visual style: Soft romantic dark-fantasy fashion editorial, ornate but restrained, like a luxury game character concept poster. Use luminous fog, translucent fabric, bokeh, film grain, fine paper texture, and subtle vignetting. The overall feeling should be tender, melancholic, mysterious, and protective.

Constraints: Keep the woman’s face covered by a simple rectangle; do not show a recognizable face. Do not add extra characters. Maintain exactly one guardian spirit, exactly 7 color swatches, exactly 5 bullet points in the design section, exactly 5 profile traits, and exactly 5 text zones. Avoid logos, watermarks, modern UI icons, or cluttered unreadable text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：基于柔和、迷雾般的女性氛围，创作一张氛围感十足的竖版“Stand 守护灵”角色设定海报，将写实时尚人像与空灵的神话伴侣相结合。核心概念为 {argument name="stand name" default="彼岸花・霧"}，并配以罗马拼音副标题“Higanbana · Wu”，呈现出精致的奇幻角色档案页风格。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，电影级编辑构图，柔和的灰绿色调，梦幻的背光迷雾，浅景深，高细节写实摄影与奇幻插画结合。背景为宁静的河岸或池塘花园，水色深沉，上方垂下柳枝，飘浮的花瓣、薄雾和发光的尘埃。

主体：一位年轻女性坐在画面下方中央的石堤上，优雅从容，面部特意用一个简洁的浅棕色矩形色块遮挡。她留着深棕色头发，梳成松散的低发髻，有几缕碎发垂下。服装包含 3 件可见单品：一件带有细小淡色花卉印花的白色细肩带褶皱迷你裙，一件从肩头滑落的超大号米白色针织开衫，以及精致的细肩带。姿势放松优雅，一只手撑在石沿上，双腿向侧前方伸展，柔和的阳光勾勒出她的肩膀和发丝轮廓。

守护灵：在女性后方及右上方，创作一个大型半透明白色龙/鹿状花卉灵体，修长且呈蛇形，拥有优雅的颅骨状面部，双眼闭合或低垂，长有高耸的树枝状角，带有羽毛或面纱般的鳍，以及飘逸的薄纱丝带。它看起来应具有保护性、静谧且超凡脱俗，而非具有攻击性。用 5 种主要装饰元素点缀：白色花朵、珍珠链、垂坠流苏、透明丝绸面纱和细银枝。灵体如迷雾般环绕在女性周围，在不遮挡文字的情况下将其框入画面。

排版与字体：将海报设计为信息密集型的角色档案页，采用精致的中/日式编辑排版，细白分割线，小型垂直注释框，以及优雅的衬线字体。使用带有微弱光晕且清晰易读的米白色文字。包含 5 个文本区域：1) 左上角标题栏，2) 左侧中部描述栏，3) 左侧下部特殊能力栏，4) 左下角设计关键词与色板，5) 右侧垂直背景故事栏及右下角引言/档案卡。

文本内容：左上角标题栏显示“替身设定”，下方配有小号英文“STAND NAME”，接着是大号标题 {argument name="stand name" default="彼岸花・霧"}，以及副标题“Higanbana · Wu”。左侧中部描述栏以中文诗意语言描写她的守护灵如同迷雾与丝绸，静静环绕着她，优雅而警觉。左侧下部区域标题为“特殊能力”，能力名称 {argument name="ability name" default="花影迷離"}，罗马拼音“Hua Ying Mi Li”，后接简短的中文能力说明，描述花瓣、柔和幻象、模糊的距离感以及消失的足迹。左下角区域标题为“設計關聯”，后接 5 个要点：花卉元素、柔和色调、迷雾关联、情感象征、守护/梦境主题。下方放置 7 个圆形色块：白色、象牙白、淡奶油色、柔和腮红粉、冷灰色、鼠尾草灰绿色和深灰褐色。右侧设有一个狭长的垂直中文文本栏，描述灵体的形态与性格。右下角包含引言 {argument name="quote" default="你看到的美好，也许只是我編織的夢。"} 以及标题为“少女檔案”的档案卡，列出 5 项特征：性格、形象、氛围、气质和偏好。

视觉风格：柔和浪漫的暗黑奇幻时尚大片风格，华丽但克制，如同奢华游戏的角色概念海报。使用发光雾气、半透明织物、焦外成像、胶片颗粒、细腻纸张纹理和微妙的暗角效果。整体感觉温柔、忧郁、神秘且具有保护色彩。

约束：保持女性面部被简单的矩形遮挡；不要展示可辨认的面部。不要添加额外角色。保持恰好一个守护灵、7 个色块、设计部分 5 个要点、5 项档案特征以及 5 个文本区域。避免使用 Logo、水印、现代 UI 图标或杂乱难读的文字。

templates.title: Dark Stand Guardian Profile Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑替身守护者档案海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark cinematic anime-style “guardian spirit / Stand profile” poster for {argument name="character name" default="幻想郷の夜・绯"}, combining a realistic seated airline-uniform woman in the foreground with a huge supernatural winged female entity behind her.

Canvas: Vertical poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, dark navy/black palette, thin decorative border lines and corner ornaments, premium game-character dossier layout. Use dramatic rim lighting, red glowing accents, storm clouds, and a bright circular airplane-window-like opening on the right showing sunset sky and clouds.

Main subjects: Foreground subject is one seated adult woman, face deliberately covered by a plain rectangular blur/censor block. She wears a pale blue short-sleeve flight-attendant shirt, dark navy skirt, red/navy neck scarf, black waist belt, wing-shaped name badge, and sits in an airplane seat with one visible armrest and a small control panel. Behind her is exactly one enormous guardian spirit: a dark elegant humanoid female monster with long black hair, fragmented black feather/metal wings, thorny tendrils, chains, red gemstone lights, black armor-like dress, pale face, and a dangerous calm expression. The spirit should feel protective, ominous, graceful, and predatory.

Layout and text sections: Use a polished character-sheet composition with exactly 8 visible information zones: 1 top-left title block, 1 left-middle Stand setting text block, 1 center-right quote block, 1 lower-left ability evaluation radar chart, 1 lower-left design relation box, 1 lower-right special ability block, 1 bottom-right file/personality box, and 1 bottom color palette row.

Visible typography: Mix elegant serif English labels with East Asian display text. Include the top-left label “STAND NAME”, the large title {argument name="stand name text" default="幻想郷の夜・绯"}, and the romanized subtitle “Gensokyo no Yoru · Fei”. Add Chinese dossier-style copy in the other sections. Include a quote on the right: {argument name="quote" default="「航線由我指引，目的地由我決定。」"}. Include the lower-right ability title {argument name="ability title" default="夜航領域"} with romanization “Ye Hang Ling Yu”. Include a bottom-right file box headed “檔案 / FILE”.

Counted graphic elements: The radar chart must have exactly 6 labeled axes: destructive power, growth potential, precision, stamina, range, and speed. The color palette row must contain exactly 6 circular swatches: dark navy, light blue, white, crimson red, muted gold, and near-black brown. The guardian design should include multiple chain arcs but one dominant chain crossing the upper body, several red glowing nodes, and scattered black feather shards.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed dark fantasy illustration, semi-realistic anime rendering, glossy metallic feather textures, smoky atmosphere, cinematic depth of field, high contrast, red ember highlights, occult fashion editorial mood, no cartoon simplification. Keep the foreground human realistic and the guardian spirit more painterly/anime. The poster should resemble a premium RPG/JoJo-like Stand ability dossier.

Constraints: Do not add extra characters, do not leave the face visible, do not use bright cheerful colors, keep all text integrated into the poster design, and maintain the exact 8 information zones, 6 radar axes, and 6 palette swatches.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="幻想郷の夜・绯"} 创作一张暗黑电影感动漫风格的“守护灵 / 替身档案”海报，将前景中写实的空乘制服女性与身后巨大的超自然带翼女性实体相结合。

画布：竖版海报，比例约为 2:3，采用深海军蓝/黑色调，配有精致的装饰边框和边角纹饰，呈现高端游戏角色档案布局。运用戏剧性的轮廓光、红色发光点缀、风暴云层，以及右侧一个明亮的圆形飞机舷窗，展示出日落天空与云层。

主体：前景主体为一名就座的成年女性，面部刻意用矩形模糊/遮挡块遮盖。她身穿浅蓝色短袖空乘衬衫、深海军蓝短裙、红蓝相间领巾、黑色腰带，佩戴翼形名牌，坐在飞机座椅上，可见一侧扶手及小型控制面板。她身后是唯一的巨大守护灵：一个优雅而暗黑的人形女性怪物，拥有黑色长发、破碎的黑色羽毛/金属翅膀、荆棘卷须、锁链、红色宝石光点、黑色盔甲状长裙、苍白的脸庞以及危险而冷静的表情。守护灵应给人一种既具保护性又充满不祥、优雅且具有掠夺性的感觉。

布局与文字区域：采用精致的角色档案排版，包含 8 个可见信息区：1 个左上角标题块、1 个左中侧替身设定文本块、1 个中右侧引言块、1 个左下角能力评估雷达图、1 个左下角设计关联框、1 个右下角特殊能力块、1 个右下角档案/个性框，以及 1 个底部色板行。

可见排版：将优雅的衬线英文字体与东亚展示文本相结合。包含左上角标签“STAND NAME”、大标题 {argument name="stand name text" default="幻想郷の夜・绯"} 以及罗马音副标题“Gensokyo no Yoru · Fei”。在其他区域加入中文档案风格文案。右侧包含引言：{argument name="quote" default="「航線由我指引，目的地由我決定。」"}。右下角包含能力标题 {argument name="ability title" default="夜航領域"} 及其罗马音“Ye Hang Ling Yu”。右下角包含标题为“檔案 / FILE”的档案框。

图形元素统计：雷达图必须包含 6 个明确标注的轴：破坏力、成长性、精密度、持续力、射程距离和速度。色板行必须包含 6 个圆形色块：深海军蓝、浅蓝色、白色、深红色、柔和金色和近黑色棕色。守护灵设计应包含多条锁链弧线，其中一条主锁链横跨上身，并带有若干红色发光节点及散落的黑色羽毛碎片。

视觉风格：超精细暗黑奇幻插画，半写实动漫渲染，光泽金属羽毛质感，烟雾缭绕的氛围，电影级景深，高对比度，红色余烬高光，神秘时尚杂志风格，拒绝卡通化简化。保持前景人物的写实感，守护灵则更具绘画感/动漫感。海报应呈现出高端 RPG 或类似《JoJo 的奇妙冒险》替身能力档案的质感。

约束条件：不要添加额外角色，不要露出面部，不要使用明亮欢快的颜色，所有文字必须融入海报设计中，并严格保持 8 个信息区、6 个雷达轴和 6 个色板色块。

templates.title: Gothic Stand Guardian Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特式 Stand 守护灵海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark gothic fantasy “stand / guardian spirit” character setting poster for {argument name="character name" default="Lin Wan Tang"}, combining a seated fashion portrait with an eerie humanoid guardian spirit named {argument name="stand name" default="Bad Apple!! Shadow"}. The design should feel like a luxury occult character dossier, emotional, mysterious, dangerous, and elegant.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 ratio, dark blue-gray and black palette with warm beige typography, thin decorative border lines, subtle film grain, scratches, pearls, chains, sparkles, and faint mystical diagrams. Use a cinematic editorial composition with high detail and layered shadows.

Main layout: On the left foreground, show the stand master: a young woman seated on a black leather chair, legs crossed, wearing a loose beige knit sweater with large black heart shapes, sheer dark stockings, and pointed black high heels. She has long wavy dark brown hair falling over her shoulders, a quiet melancholic pose, and an intentionally blurred or obscured face. Behind and to the right, towering over her, show the guardian spirit: a tall slender feminine humanoid doll-creature with a porcelain mask face, long wild black hair flowing like smoke, a black heart motif on the face and chest, pale stitched skin, black glossy heart-shaped bodice, skeletal mechanical arms, pearl and chain ornaments, translucent shredded black veils, and a thin rapier-like weapon held downward. The guardian’s silhouette should be both graceful and grotesque, like a cursed bridal puppet.

Text and typography: Use elegant serif and small-caps typography mixed with delicate Chinese dossier text. Include large Chinese name text on the upper left, romanized name beneath it, and the label “STAND MASTER.” Include a quoted line in Chinese-style typography near the left side. On the upper right, place the heading for the stand name with the large text “Bad Apple!! • Shadow” and a short subtitle about the stand’s existence as a tangible embodiment of the silent heart realm. Along the bottom center, place the large spaced title “BAD APPLE!! • Shadow” and the subtitle “SILENT HEART REALM.” Keep text decorative and legible enough to suggest a character sheet, but do not overcrowd the poster.

Information panels and counted elements: Include exactly 7 visible character profile rows in a small rectangular panel on the left: birthday, height, zodiac sign, temperament, traits, stand type, and stand attribute. Include exactly 6 small color palette swatches below that panel, in dark navy, charcoal, beige, pearl gray, muted brown, and steel blue. Include exactly 1 radar chart at the lower left with 6 labeled ability axes. Include exactly 3 rectangular ability-visualization thumbnails along the bottom left: a black heart core, a circular time-gear diagram, and a shadowy cocoon or veil form. Include exactly 4 circular detail callouts on the right side, each connected to the guardian by fine lines: porcelain face mask, black heart chest pattern, mechanical needle or rapier structure, and shadow silk ribbons. Include exactly 3 small heart-bullet ability descriptions in the lower right text block. Include exactly 1 ornate tarot-card-like inset illustration in the lower right showing a black heart trapped in a delicate frame of chains and thorns.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed dark fantasy concept art blended with fashion editorial photography, gothic lolita occult aesthetics, Art Nouveau dossier framing, JoJo-like stand design energy, porcelain doll horror, black-heart symbolism, smoky hair and fabric motion, soft spotlighting from above left, cool shadows, high contrast, intricate linework, elegant poster typography.

Constraints: The final image must look like a finished character setting sheet rather than a simple portrait. Maintain exactly one human stand master and exactly one guardian spirit. Keep the guardian much taller than the seated woman. Use the theme {argument name="symbolic theme" default="silent heart realm, rotten sweetness, dangerous tenderness"}. Use the primary palette {argument name="color palette" default="black, smoky navy, pearl gray, beige, and muted gold"}. Avoid bright colors, modern UI styling, extra characters, weapons besides the single rapier, and any readable watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="林婉棠"} 创作一张暗黑哥特奇幻风格的“Stand / 守护灵”角色设定海报，将坐姿时尚肖像与名为 {argument name="stand name" default="Bad Apple!! Shadow"} 的诡异人形守护灵相结合。设计应呈现出奢华的神秘学角色档案质感，充满情感、神秘、危险且优雅的氛围。

画布：竖版海报，4:5 比例，深蓝灰色与黑色调，搭配暖米色排版，细装饰边框，带有细微的胶片颗粒、划痕、珍珠、锁链、闪光和淡淡的神秘图表。采用电影级编辑构图，注重高细节和层次分明的阴影。

主体布局：左侧前景展示 Stand 使者：一位年轻女性坐在黑色皮椅上，双腿交叠，身穿宽松的米色针织毛衣（带有大号黑色心形图案）、透明深色丝袜和黑色尖头高跟鞋。她留着深棕色长卷发，姿态安静忧郁，面部刻意模糊或遮挡。在她的后方右侧，高耸着守护灵：一个高挑纤细的女性人形玩偶生物，戴着瓷质面具，长长的黑色乱发如烟雾般飘动，面部和胸口有黑色心形图案，苍白的缝合皮肤，黑色光泽心形胸衣，骨骼状机械手臂，珍珠与锁链装饰，半透明的黑色碎面纱，手中向下持有一把细长的刺剑状武器。守护灵的轮廓应兼具优雅与怪诞，宛如一个被诅咒的新娘木偶。

文字与排版：使用优雅的衬线字体和小写字母，并混合精致的中文档案文字。左上方包含醒目的中文姓名，下方标注罗马拼音及“STAND MASTER”标签。左侧附近加入一行中文风格的引用文字。右上方放置 Stand 名称标题，大字显示“Bad Apple!! • Shadow”，并配有关于该 Stand 作为静默心境具象化存在的简短副标题。底部中央放置大间距标题“BAD APPLE!! • Shadow”及副标题“SILENT HEART REALM”。文字应具有装饰性且清晰可辨，以呈现角色设定表的效果，但不要使海报过于拥挤。

信息面板与计数元素：在左侧小矩形面板中包含 7 行可见的角色资料：生日、身高、星座、气质、特征、Stand 类型和 Stand 属性。在该面板下方包含 6 个小型色卡，颜色为深海军蓝、炭黑、米色、珍珠灰、柔和棕和钢蓝色。左下方包含 1 张带有 6 个能力轴标签的雷达图。底部左侧包含 3 个矩形能力可视化缩略图：黑色心脏核心、圆形时间齿轮图表以及阴影茧或面纱形态。右侧包含 4 个圆形细节标注，通过细线与守护灵连接：瓷质面具、黑色心形胸部图案、机械针或刺剑结构、以及阴影丝带。右下角文本块中包含 3 个小型心形项目符号的能力描述。右下角包含 1 张华丽的塔罗牌式插图，展示了一个被困在精致锁链与荆棘框架中的黑色心脏。

视觉风格：超精细暗黑奇幻概念艺术，融合时尚编辑摄影、哥特洛丽塔神秘美学、新艺术运动风格档案边框、类似 JoJo 的 Stand 设计能量、瓷娃娃恐怖感、黑心象征主义、烟雾状发丝与织物动态、左上方柔和聚光灯、冷色调阴影、高对比度、复杂的线条、优雅的海报排版。

约束条件：最终图像必须看起来像一张完整的角色设定表，而非简单的肖像。保持仅有一名人类 Stand 使者和一名守护灵。守护灵的身高必须远高于坐着的女性。使用主题 {argument name="symbolic theme" default="静默心境，腐烂的甜蜜，危险的温柔"}。使用主色调 {argument name="color palette" default="黑色、烟熏海军蓝、珍珠灰、米色和柔和金"}。避免使用鲜艳色彩、现代 UI 样式、额外角色、除刺剑外的武器以及任何可读的水印。

templates.title: Yokohama Pop Summer Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 横滨流行夏季海报

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant retro Japanese pop-art travel poster for {argument name="city theme" default="Yokohama"}, in a bold comic-book style with thick black outlines, saturated summer colors, halftone dot textures, crisp cel shading, and dynamic layered typography. Use a vertical 3:4 poster canvas. The sky is bright cyan with white clouds, seabirds, speed-line shapes, and two tall palm trees framing the scene. At the top, place huge stacked headline text: “YOKOHAMA” in hot pink block letters with white and black outline, “POP” in oversized yellow halftone letters, and a tilted banner reading “SUMMER CITY” in blue on white. Below it, add a starburst label with the exact text “ZOMBIE GIRL & CHAPPIE” in pink, blue, and green. The main foreground features exactly two characters: a cute chibi zombie girl with pale blue skin, black bob hair, visible stitch marks on her face and limbs, huge round black-and-white eyes, a cheerful open smile, a pink short-sleeve dress covered in white hearts, black trim, white socks, black Mary Jane shoes, and one hand making a peace sign; beside her stands a tall friendly futuristic robot named {argument name="robot name" default="Chappie"}, with a sleek silver and charcoal humanoid body, rounded shoulder armor, black mechanical joints, green glowing cable accents, an OpenAI-style green emblem on the chest, one hand on hip, and the other hand holding a green glass soda bottle with a red-and-white straw and label reading “SODA”; leave the robot face intentionally blank/obscured by a neutral gray rectangular censor-like patch. Behind them, place a glossy {argument name="car color" default="pink"} 1950s American convertible with chrome grille, bumper, headlights, whitewall tires, and a small front plate reading “YOKOHAMA SUMMER.” The background should show Yokohama waterfront landmarks: a blue bay with railing, a skyline of modern high-rise buildings, the Cosmo Clock-style ferris wheel on the left, red brick warehouse buildings on the right, and a harbor promenade. Add exactly one pair of pink sunglasses lying on the pavement in the bottom left foreground, plus flower planters near the car. Make the composition busy but readable, like a collectible summer city poster, with no extra characters and no additional large text beyond the specified wording.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的复古日式波普艺术旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="city theme" default="横滨"}。采用大胆的漫画风格，配以粗黑线条、饱和的夏季色彩、半调网点纹理、清晰的赛璐珞阴影以及动态的分层排版。使用 3:4 的竖版海报画布。天空呈现明亮的青色，点缀着白云、海鸟、速度线形状，两侧由两棵高大的棕榈树勾勒出场景。顶部放置巨大的堆叠标题文字：用带有白黑轮廓的亮粉色块状字母书写“YOKOHAMA”，用超大号黄色半调字母书写“POP”，并配有一个蓝底白字的倾斜横幅，上面写着“SUMMER CITY”。在下方，添加一个星爆标签，上面写着准确的文字“ZOMBIE GIRL & CHAPPIE”，颜色为粉色、蓝色和绿色。前景主要展示两个角色：一个可爱的 Q 版僵尸女孩，皮肤呈淡蓝色，留着黑色波波头，脸部和四肢有明显的缝合痕迹，有着巨大的黑白圆眼，笑容灿烂，身穿印有白心的粉色短袖连衣裙，配有黑色饰边、白袜、黑色玛丽珍鞋，一只手比着剪刀手；她身边站着一个高大友好的未来派机器人，名为 {argument name="robot name" default="Chappie"}，拥有光滑的银色和炭灰色人形机身，圆润的肩甲，黑色机械关节，绿色发光的电缆装饰，胸前有一个 OpenAI 风格的绿色徽章，一只手叉腰，另一只手拿着一瓶绿色玻璃汽水，配有红白相间的吸管，标签上写着“SODA”；机器人的脸部特意留白，或被一块中性灰色的矩形遮挡物遮住。在他们身后，放置一辆光泽亮丽的 {argument name="car color" default="粉色"} 1950 年代美式敞篷车，配有镀铬格栅、保险杠、前大灯、白壁轮胎，以及一块写着“YOKOHAMA SUMMER”的小型前车牌。背景应展示横滨海滨地标：带有栏杆的蓝色海湾、现代高层建筑的天际线、左侧的 Cosmo Clock 风格摩天轮、右侧的红砖仓库建筑以及海港长廊。在左下角前景的地面上添加一副粉色太阳镜，并在车旁放置花盆。构图要丰富但清晰，如同收藏级的夏季城市海报，除指定的文字外，不要添加额外角色或多余的大号文字。

templates.title: Exploding Maneki Neko Pop Art

titleLocalized.zh: 爆炸感招财猫波普艺术

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic pop-art 3D illustration of exactly 36 Japanese maneki-neko lucky cat figurines exploding outward through a white space, as if floating in zero gravity. The main subject is one giant glossy ceramic lucky cat in the center foreground, smiling, with a raised left paw, white body covered in fine black contour-line engraving, red inner ears, yellow-black eyes, a pink nose, black whisker marks, a red collar with gold studs and a gold bell, gold oval chest medallion with bold black Japanese-style characters, and orange-black circular coin-like spots on the body. Surround it with 35 additional maneki-neko figurines at different scales and rotations: 6 large cats near the edges, 12 medium cats scattered through the middle depth, and 17 tiny cats receding into the background. All cats share the same white ceramic, red collar, gold bell, gold medallion, yellow eyes, red ears, and graphic contour-line texture; vary their orientation so some are upside down, sideways, cropped by the frame, or flying toward the viewer. Use a tall vertical poster canvas, {argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:3 vertical"}, with an energetic wide-angle perspective and strong depth, the central cat occupying most of the middle. The background is pure white filled with explosive graphic design elements: hot magenta diagonal bars, neon yellow slashes, black speed lines, cyan/magenta/yellow halftone dots, radial arcs, comic-book motion streaks, and layered glitch-like offset outlines around objects. Use bright CMYK print colors, high contrast, crisp detail, glossy reflections, playful maximalism, and a futuristic Japanese pop-art advertising style. Add subtle chromatic aberration and rainbow edge fringing on the cats and linework. Include small printed text in the bottom-right corner reading {argument name="date text" default="May 14, 2026"} above a loose black cursive artist signature {argument name="signature" default="Oyagi"}. Keep the composition clean enough that every cat remains recognizable, with no humans, no scenery, no extra text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满动感的 3D 波普艺术插画，画面中正好有 36 个日本招财猫雕像在白色空间中向外爆炸，仿佛漂浮在零重力状态下。主体是前景中央的一只巨大的光泽陶瓷招财猫，它面带微笑，左爪抬起，白色身体上覆盖着精细的黑色轮廓雕刻线条，内耳为红色，眼睛呈黄黑色，鼻子为粉色，带有黑色胡须标记，佩戴着带有金色铆钉和金色铃铛的红色项圈，胸前有印着粗体黑色日式文字的金色椭圆形奖章，身上还有橙黑色的圆形钱币状斑点。在它周围环绕着 35 个不同比例和旋转角度的招财猫：边缘附近有 6 只大猫，中景散布着 12 只中型猫，背景中还有 17 只微型猫。所有猫都具有相同的白色陶瓷质感、红色项圈、金色铃铛、金色奖章、黄色眼睛、红色耳朵和图形轮廓线条纹理；改变它们的方向，使一些猫倒置、侧向、被画框裁剪或飞向观众。使用竖版长海报画布，{argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:3 竖版"}，采用充满活力的广角透视和强烈的纵深感，中央的猫占据大部分中间位置。背景为纯白色，填充着爆炸性的图形设计元素：亮洋红色对角条纹、霓虹黄色斜线、黑色速度线、青色/洋红色/黄色半调圆点、放射状弧线、漫画风格的运动轨迹，以及物体周围分层的故障艺术风格偏移轮廓。使用明亮的 CMYK 印刷色彩，高对比度，细节清晰，具有光泽反射、俏皮的极繁主义和未来派日本波普艺术广告风格。在猫和线条上添加细微的色差和彩虹边缘晕影。在右下角包含一行小字 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 14 日"}，上方是随意的黑色草书艺术家签名 {argument name="signature" default="Oyagi"}。保持构图足够简洁，确保每只猫都清晰可辨，画面中不包含人物、风景、额外文字或水印。

templates.title: Flaming Burger Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: Flaming Burger 项目

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic storyboard/spec sheet for a 10-second food commercial about a flaming cheeseburger, titled across the top with “PART 1 | 10 SECONDS | 12 PANELS”.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 black canvas with a thin warm-gold border, dark premium film-treatment background, subtle smoky texture, and elegant serif typography in muted gold. Use a grid of exactly 12 storyboard panels arranged in 3 rows by 4 columns, each panel outlined in thin gold lines and numbered 01 through 12 in the top-left corner.

Subject: A dramatic gourmet burger with sesame bun, charred beef patty, melted cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato/onion accents, smoke, sparks, and flames. The burger should look hyper-real, glossy, high contrast, and shot like a luxury food commercial. Use {argument name="burger style" default="a flaming gourmet cheeseburger with sesame bun, charred patty, melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato, smoke, sparks, and fire"}. Overall palette is black, amber, orange flame, molten cheese yellow, and deep red highlights.

Layout and panel content: Include exactly 12 panels, each with a large cinematic image area and a compact bottom metadata strip divided into four labeled boxes: CAMERA, ACTION, SOUND, TRANSITION. Use small gold icons beside these labels, tiny readable notes, and thin dividers. The 12 visible panels are:
01: Low-angle hero burger reveal in darkness, flames rising around the patty, smoke behind it; notes suggest “Low-Angle Hero / Slow Reveal”, “Darkness and embers. Flames rise to reveal the hero”, “Ember crackle, flame whoosh, low cinematic hum”, “Heat shimmer push to next.”
02: Macro low push-in of burger with cheese dripping and flames licking the bun; action says flames lick the bun, smoke drifts; sound flame whoosh and bun sizzle; transition cut.
03: Extreme macro of sesame bun with steam curls and glowing background; action sesame bun glows, smoke curls; sound sizzle echo and soft hiss; transition push-in.
04: Extreme macro of molten cheese stretching down between charred meat layers; action cheese melts and drips between patties; sound cheese sizzle and juicy crackle; transition match cut.
05: Close side-up profile of burger layers, lettuce and red onion/tomato visible, juicy patty in focus; action layers stack up juicy, fresh, vibrant; sound juicy drip and soft crunch; transition cut.
06: Centered medium hero shot of burger surrounded by flames; action burger breathes with fire and smoke; sound low rumble and ember crack; transition push cut.
07: Extreme macro rack focus on charred patty and cheese stretch; action sizzle and sear, cheese stretch; sound juicy sear pop and crackle; transition cut.
08: Low-angle hero shot with smoke curling around the burger; action smoke rises around the hero; sound ember flow and soft whoosh; transition push-in.
09: Macro orbit shot, three-quarter view, burger emerging from smoke and fire; action glistening highlights and deep contrast; sound cinematic hum and soft crackle; transition orbit to front.
10: Front centered locked-off burger with intensifying ring of fire; action fire ring intensifies, smoke wraps the burger; sound flame whoosh and impact accent; transition cut.
11: Hero beauty sight push-in, burger perfectly centered amid flames; action climax, fiery glory, everything looks perfect; sound impact hit and low cinematic hum; transition push-in to lock-off.
12: Final centered hero lock-off of the burger as flames settle and smoke rises; action hero holds, end beat; sound ember fade and soft tail; transition settle.

Visual style: Premium cinematic food photography storyboard, ultra-detailed burger texture, shallow depth of field, crisp highlights on grease and cheese, floating embers, realistic fire simulation, smoky black background, high-end commercial treatment. Make the board look like a professional director’s shot plan rather than a comic page. Use {argument name="top title" default="PART 1 | 10 SECONDS | 12 PANELS"} and {argument name="visual mood" default="dark luxury cinematic fire-and-smoke food commercial"}.

Text constraints: Keep all visible text in English. Use gold serif numbers and headings. The metadata notes should be small but visually plausible, aligned neatly under each panel. Do not add extra panels, logos, watermarks, people, utensils, plates, or restaurant branding.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一段 10 秒的火烤芝士汉堡美食广告创建一个电影感项目/规格表，顶部标题为“PART 1 | 10 SECONDS | 12 PANELS”。

画布：宽屏 16:9 黑色画布，带有细暖金色边框，深色高端电影质感背景，细腻的烟雾纹理，以及优雅的哑光金色衬线字体。使用精确的 12 帧项目网格，排列为 3 行 4 列，每个面板用细金线勾勒，并在左上角标注 01 到 12 的序号。

主体：一个极具戏剧性的美食汉堡，配有芝麻面包、炭烤牛肉饼、融化的切达干酪、生菜、番茄/洋葱点缀，以及烟雾、火星和火焰。汉堡应呈现超写实、光泽感、高对比度的效果，拍摄风格如同高端美食广告。使用 {argument name="burger style" default="a flaming gourmet cheeseburger with sesame bun, charred patty, melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato, smoke, sparks, and fire"}。整体色调为黑色、琥珀色、橙色火焰、熔岩芝士黄和深红色高光。

布局与面板内容：包含精确的 12 个面板，每个面板都有一个大型电影感图像区域和一个紧凑的底部元数据条，分为四个标签框：CAMERA（摄像）、ACTION（动作）、SOUND（声音）、TRANSITION（转场）。在这些标签旁使用小型金色图标、微小易读的注释以及细分隔线。12 个可见面板如下：
01：黑暗中低角度英雄汉堡特写，肉饼周围火焰升腾，背景有烟雾；注释建议“Low-Angle Hero / Slow Reveal”（低角度英雄/缓慢揭示），“Darkness and embers. Flames rise to reveal the hero”（黑暗与余烬。火焰升起揭示主角），“Ember crackle, flame whoosh, low cinematic hum”（余烬噼啪声、火焰呼啸声、低沉电影感嗡嗡声），“Heat shimmer push to next”（热浪闪烁推进至下一帧）。
02：汉堡宏观低推镜头，芝士滴落，火焰舔舐面包；动作描述火焰舔舐面包，烟雾缭绕；声音为火焰呼啸和面包滋滋声；转场为切镜。
03：芝麻面包的极度宏观特写，带有蒸汽卷和发光背景；动作描述芝麻面包发光，烟雾缭绕；声音为滋滋声回响和柔和的嘶嘶声；转场为推入。
04：融化芝士在炭烤肉层间拉丝的极度宏观特写；动作描述芝士融化并从肉饼间滴落；声音为芝士滋滋声和多汁的噼啪声；转场为匹配剪辑。
05：汉堡侧面轮廓特写，可见生菜、红洋葱/番茄，多汁肉饼处于焦点；动作描述层层堆叠，多汁、新鲜、充满活力；声音为多汁滴落声和柔和的脆响；转场为切镜。
06：居中中景英雄镜头，汉堡被火焰包围；动作描述汉堡在火与烟中呼吸；声音为低沉轰鸣和余烬碎裂声；转场为推入剪辑。
07：炭烤肉饼和芝士拉丝的极度宏观焦点切换；动作描述滋滋作响，芝士拉丝；声音为多汁的灼烧爆裂声和噼啪声；转场为切镜。
08：低角度英雄镜头，烟雾在汉堡周围缭绕；动作描述烟雾在主角周围升起；声音为余烬流动和柔和的呼啸声；转场为推入。
09：宏观环绕镜头，四分之三侧视图，汉堡从烟火中浮现；动作描述闪亮的高光和深邃的对比度；声音为电影感嗡嗡声和柔和的噼啪声；转场为环绕至正面。
10：正面居中锁定镜头，汉堡周围火圈加强；动作描述火圈加强，烟雾包裹汉堡；声音为火焰呼啸和冲击感音效；转场为切镜。
11：英雄美学推入镜头，汉堡在火焰中完美居中；动作描述高潮，火热的荣耀，一切看起来完美无瑕；声音为冲击撞击声和低沉的电影感嗡嗡声；转场为推入锁定。
12：最终居中英雄锁定镜头，火焰平息，烟雾升起；动作描述主角定格，结尾节拍；声音为余烬消散和柔和的尾音；转场为平息。

视觉风格：高端电影感美食摄影项目，超细腻的汉堡纹理，浅景深，油脂和芝士上的清脆高光，漂浮的余烬，逼真的火焰模拟，烟雾缭绕的黑色背景，高端商业处理。使该项目看起来像专业导演的拍摄计划，而不是漫画页面。使用 {argument name="top title" default="PART 1 | 10 SECONDS | 12 PANELS"} 和 {argument name="visual mood" default="dark luxury cinematic fire-and-smoke food commercial"}。

文本限制：所有可见文本保持英文。使用金色衬线数字和标题。元数据注释应小巧但视觉上合理，整齐地排列在每个面板下方。不要添加额外的面板、徽标、水印、人物、餐具、盘子或餐厅品牌。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Spellblade at Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落下的暗黑奇幻魔剑士

templates.prompt: Create an epic dark-fantasy cinematic key art scene in a wide 16:9 format. A lone armored spellblade, {argument name="character name" default="Hermes"}, stands full-body in the foreground on wet ruined stone, facing the viewer in a heroic stance. The character wears ornate blackened steel and bronze plate armor with layered leather belts, pouches, engraved pauldrons, tall boots, and a tattered windblown dark navy cloak and scarf. Their face is deliberately obscured by a soft rectangular blur, while dark hair is visible above it. In the left hand they hold a long silver sword angled downward; in the right hand they raise a twisted black mage staff topped with a bright circular blue magical sigil, glowing runes, sparks, and swirling energy. The background is a vast gothic fantasy landscape at sunset: misty valleys, jagged snowy mountains, a distant cathedral-like castle with spires, ancient ruined arches and towers on the left, broken statues and rocks on the right, and low fog drifting across the ground. Lighting is dramatic, with orange-pink sunset clouds behind the mountains contrasted against cool blue magical light from the staff reflecting on armor and puddles. Use ultra-detailed realistic digital painting, high contrast, volumetric fog, cinematic composition, sharp armor details, moody atmosphere, no text, no watermark. Customize the sky mood as {argument name="sky mood" default="stormy orange and violet sunset"}, the magic color as {argument name="magic color" default="electric blue"}, the armor style as {argument name="armor style" default="ornate dark medieval plate armor"}, and the background landmark as {argument name="background landmark" default="distant gothic castle in the mountains"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张史诗级的暗黑奇幻电影感主视觉图，采用 16:9 宽屏比例。一位孤身一人的重甲魔剑士 {argument name="character name" default="Hermes"} 全身像立于前景的湿润废墟石板上，以英雄姿态面向观众。角色身穿装饰华丽的黑钢与青铜板甲，配有层叠的皮带、小包、雕刻肩甲、高筒靴，以及一件随风飘动的破旧深海军蓝斗篷和围巾。其面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，仅能看到上方的深色头发。左手向下斜持一把长银剑；右手举起一根扭曲的黑色法师长杖，杖顶带有明亮的圆形蓝色魔法印记、发光符文、火花及旋转的能量。背景是日落时分广阔的哥特式奇幻景观：雾气缭绕的山谷、锯齿状的雪山、远处带有尖塔的教堂式城堡，左侧是古老的废墟拱门与塔楼，右侧是破碎的雕像与岩石，地面上有低垂的薄雾飘过。光影效果极具戏剧性，山后的橙粉色落日云彩与法杖发出的冷蓝色魔法光芒形成对比，并映照在铠甲与水洼上。使用超精细的写实数字绘画风格，高对比度，体积雾，电影级构图，锐利的铠甲细节，阴郁的氛围，无文字，无水印。自定义天空氛围为 {argument name="sky mood" default="暴风雨般的橙紫色日落"}，魔法颜色为 {argument name="magic color" default="电光蓝"}，铠甲风格为 {argument name="armor style" default="华丽的暗黑中世纪板甲"}，背景地标为 {argument name="background landmark" default="山中遥远的哥特式城堡"}。

templates.title: Armored Cosplayer in Ikebukuro

titleLocalized.zh: 池袋的盔甲 Cosplayer

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical street-fashion/cosplay photograph set in {argument name="location" default="Ikebukuro Station East Exit, Tokyo"} on a clear sunny day. The scene shows a busy Japanese city sidewalk in Ikebukuro with tall commercial buildings, dense vertical shop signs, pedestrians, traffic, street trees, yellow tactile paving, and a prominent blue station sign in the upper left reading “Ikebukuro Sta. E.” with Japanese characters above it; beneath it is a white arrow sign reading “Sunshine-dori Ave.” Include recognizable urban details such as the LABI Ikebukuro building sign in the distance and colorful karaoke/retail signage. In the foreground, a single adult woman cosplayer walks confidently toward the camera on the sidewalk, centered slightly right, wearing {argument name="costume style" default="ornate medieval fantasy knight armor"}: polished dark-silver plate armor with engraved details, articulated gauntlets, breastplate, shoulder armor, thigh and shin guards, black boots, and a long dark cloak or split skirt flowing behind her. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy blonde hair"} catching the sunlight, while her face is intentionally obscured by a smooth neutral blur with no facial features. The mood is a believable candid city snapshot where an elaborate fantasy armored cosplayer blends into everyday Ikebukuro foot traffic. The character is a cute anime girl named {argument name="character name" default="unnamed blonde twin-tail girl"}: long blonde twin tails with lavender gradient ends, pastel purple ribbon bows, turquoise eyes, soft blush, white ruffled sleeveless top with vertical buttons, mint turquoise high-waisted skirt with frilled hem and asymmetrical trailing fabric, slim legs, white ankle-strap sandals with small turquoise accents. promptLocalized.zh:

顶部状态栏：左上角显示时间“2:50”，旁边是一个静音铃铛图标；右上角显示 3 个状态指示器：信号格、Wi‑Fi 和显示“95”的黑色电池图标。

顶部 UI：在状态栏下方，放置 4 个浮动的圆角控件：左侧是一个圆形汉堡菜单按钮，中间是一个标有蓝色“Thinking”字样的白色胶囊按钮，右侧是一个包含轮廓编辑/铅笔图标的白色胶囊按钮，以及一个带有三个点的菜单按钮。

templates.title: 7-Eleven Net Print Instruction Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 7-Eleven 网络打印操作指南

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a friendly Japanese step-by-step instruction sheet for printing two reserved net-print documents at a 7-Eleven multifunction copier, designed so an elderly parent can understand it just by looking.

Canvas: Square 1:1 infographic, white background with teal borders and rounded cards, bold teal section headers, red emphasis text, simple flat vector icons. Overall style is clean, high-contrast, large readable Japanese typography, like a laminated how-to guide.

Main header: At the top, a dark teal banner with a circular 7-Eleven storefront icon on the left and a printer icon on the right. Center the large white headline {argument name="headline text" default="セブンで印刷する手順"}. Under it place a pale yellow rounded pill subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="この画像を見ながら操作すればOK！"}.

Section 1, top left card, title {argument name="section one title" default="① まず覚えること"}: Include exactly 4 teal bullet points and 1 yellow warning box. The bullets say, in Japanese, that there are 2 things to print, enter reservation numbers one at a time, the size is A4 black-and-white one copy each, and the expiration deadline is 2026/05/16 23:59. Emphasize the numbers 2, 1, A4, black-and-white, one copy each, and the date in red. The warning box contains a teal exclamation icon and text warning that printing becomes unavailable after the expiration date, so print early.

Section 2, top right card, title {argument name="section two title" default="② 予約番号"}: Show exactly 2 large reservation-number rows with teal circled numbers: row 1 is {argument name="first reservation number" default="ABCD1234"}, row 2 is {argument name="second reservation number" default="EFGH5678"}. Each row is inside a white rounded rectangle with teal outline. Add a red note below: print these two in order.

Section 3, middle full-width card, title in Japanese meaning store workflow: Show exactly 6 numbered vertical steps separated by thin teal lines, each with a teal circle number at the top. Step 1: go to 7-Eleven, with storefront icon. Step 2: on the multifunction copier screen choose “Net Print,” with copier touchscreen icon and pointing hand. Step 3: enter the reservation number, with keypad screen showing ABCD1234 and a pointing hand pressing confirm. Step 4: confirm A4 black-and-white and print, with settings panel and printer output icon. Step 5: after the first one finishes, enter the second reservation number the same way, with circular repeat arrows and text indicating print 1 then 2 in order. Step 6: insert money and receive the printout, with banknote, coins, downward arrow, paper sheet, and sparkle icons.

Section 4, lower card, title in Japanese meaning print contents: Show exactly 2 contents items. Item 1: teal circled 1, large text “A4 black-and-white 1 copy,” small paper icon. Item 2: teal circled 2, large text “A4 black-and-white 1 copy,” small paper icon. Separate the two items with a dotted teal divider.

Bottom help strip: Pale yellow rounded rectangle with two friendly elderly people icons on the left, faces intentionally blurred or simplified. Add a teal headline saying that if they are confused, they only need to look at these two numbers. Show exactly 2 large bordered boxes containing ABCD1234 and EFGH5678.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 major numbered sections plus the bottom help strip, exactly 2 reservation numbers, exactly 6 workflow steps, exactly 2 print-content items, exactly 4 bullet points in Section 1, and no extra logos except the simplified 7-Eleven storefront motif. Keep all Japanese text large, readable, and neatly aligned.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一份友好的日文分步操作指南，用于在 7-Eleven 多功能复印机上打印两份预留的网络打印文档，设计风格需确保老年长辈仅通过查看即可理解。

画布：正方形 1:1 信息图，白色背景，配有青色边框和圆角卡片，粗体青色章节标题，红色强调文字，简洁的扁平化矢量图标。整体风格整洁、高对比度，采用大号易读的日文字体，类似于塑封的操作指南。

主标题：顶部为一个深青色横幅，左侧带有圆形 7-Eleven 店面图标，右侧为打印机图标。居中放置大号白色标题 {argument name="headline text" default="セブンで印刷する手順"}。下方放置一个浅黄色圆角胶囊形副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="この画像を見ながら操作すればOK！"}。

第 1 部分，左上角卡片，标题 {argument name="section one title" default="① まず覚えること"}：包含 4 个青色项目符号和 1 个黄色警告框。项目符号内容为日文，说明共有 2 份文件需要打印，需逐个输入预约号码，规格为 A4 黑白各 1 份，过期时间为 2026 年 5 月 16 日 23:59。用红色强调数字 2、1、A4、黑白、各 1 份以及日期。警告框包含一个青色感叹号图标和文字，提示过期后将无法打印，请尽早打印。

第 2 部分，右上角卡片，标题 {argument name="section two title" default="② 予約番号"}：展示 2 行带有青色圆圈数字的大号预约号码：第 1 行是 {argument name="first reservation number" default="ABCD1234"}，第 2 行是 {argument name="second reservation number" default="EFGH5678"}。每行位于带有青色轮廓的白色圆角矩形内。下方添加红色备注：请按顺序打印这两份文件。

第 3 部分，中间全宽卡片，标题为日文的“店内操作流程”：展示 6 个带编号的垂直步骤，步骤间以细青色线条分隔，每步上方带有青色圆圈数字。步骤 1：前往 7-Eleven，配店面图标。步骤 2：在多功能复印机屏幕上选择“Net Print”，配复印机触摸屏和手指点击图标。步骤 3：输入预约号码，配显示 ABCD1234 的键盘屏幕和手指点击确认图标。步骤 4：确认 A4 黑白并打印，配设置面板和打印输出图标。步骤 5：第一份完成后，以同样方式输入第二个预约号码，配循环箭头和提示按 1 到 2 顺序打印的文字。步骤 6：投入硬币并取走打印件，配纸币、硬币、向下箭头、纸张和闪光图标。

第 4 部分，下方卡片，标题为日文的“打印内容”：展示 2 个内容项。项目 1：青色圆圈 1，大号文字“A4 黑白 1 份”，配小纸张图标。项目 2：青色圆圈 2，大号文字“A4 黑白 1 份”，配小纸张图标。两项之间用青色虚线分隔。

底部帮助条：浅黄色圆角矩形，左侧带有两个友好的老年人图标，面部模糊或简化处理。添加青色标题，提示如果感到困惑，只需查看这两个号码即可。展示 2 个带有边框的大号方框，分别包含 ABCD1234 和 EFGH5678。

约束：使用 4 个主要编号章节加上底部帮助条，正好 2 个预约号码，正好 6 个工作流程步骤，正好 2 个打印内容项，第 1 部分正好 4 个项目符号，除简化的 7-Eleven 店面图案外不添加额外标志。保持所有日文文字大号、易读且整齐对齐。

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic square anime fantasy action illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a magical girl heroine"} rendered as a living polished gold statue, lunging forward in a ruined gothic cathedral. The main subject is one full-body character: a young anime girl with huge expressive golden eyes, open shouting mouth, long wind-swept twin-tail hair tied with an oversized bow, star-shaped hair ornaments, frilled magical-girl dress, cape-like ribbons, gloves, thigh-high boots, and ornate armor-like details, all made from highly reflective molten gold metal with engraved linework and mirror highlights. She thrusts one ornate wand or short scepter directly toward the viewer in extreme foreshortening, creating a dynamic low-angle close-up; bright golden energy rings, sparks, and diagonal light streaks explode from the wand and wrap around her body. Include exactly one inset portrait in the upper right: a white-bordered, irregular sticker-like cutout showing the same girl in normal colors, with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, red eyes, a red-and-white outfit, and a winking determined expression, placed over a small red background. The background is a dark, blurred medieval cathedral interior with tall arched stained-glass windows, stone floor tiles, rubble, and cool blue-purple shadows, contrasting with the warm gold character. Use highly detailed Japanese anime key visual style, sharp line art, glossy metallic texture, cinematic lighting, intense motion, sparkling particles, shallow depth of field, high contrast, and ultra-detailed rendering. Composition should be crowded and energetic with the gold wand and hand dominating the lower center foreground, hair sweeping across the top, one leg extended to the right, and no readable text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的方形动漫奇幻动作插画，主角 {argument name="character name" default="一位魔法少女英雄"} 呈现为一座栩栩如生的抛光金像，正冲向一座废弃的哥特式大教堂。主体为一名全身角色：一位年轻的动漫少女，拥有巨大的表现力金色双眼、张开大喊的嘴、被风吹拂的长双马尾（系着超大蝴蝶结）、星形发饰、荷叶边魔法少女裙、披风状丝带、手套、过膝长靴以及华丽的盔甲细节，全身由高反光熔金金属制成，带有雕刻线条和镜面高光。她将一支华丽的魔杖或短权杖直接指向观众，形成极端的透视效果，营造出动态的低角度特写；明亮的金色能量环、火花和对角线光束从魔杖中迸发并环绕她的身体。在右上角包含一个嵌入式肖像：一个带有白色边框、不规则贴纸状的剪影，展示了相同女孩的正常色彩形象，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发、红色眼睛、红白相间的服装以及眨眼且坚定的表情，置于一个小红色背景之上。背景是昏暗模糊的中世纪大教堂内部，有高大的拱形彩色玻璃窗、石质地砖、瓦砾以及冷蓝紫色的阴影，与温暖的金色角色形成对比。采用高度精细的日本动漫关键视觉风格、锐利的线条、光泽金属质感、电影级灯光、强烈的动感、闪烁的粒子、浅景深、高对比度和超精细渲染。构图应紧凑且充满活力，金色的魔杖和手部占据下方的中心前景，头发横扫顶部，一条腿向右伸展，画面中不包含任何可读文字或水印。

templates.title: Pop Art Shigaraki Tanuki Statue

titleLocalized.zh: 波普艺术风格信乐烧狸猫雕像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical poster-style AI artwork on a clean white background featuring a highly detailed Shigaraki ware tanuki ceramic statue centered full-body, photographed/illustrated like a glossy speckled pottery object with beige belly, dark brown limbs, mottled glaze, rounded belly, small navel, large straw hat, sake bottle in one paw, and a tokkuri flask or ledger-like accessory in the other. The tanuki’s face is deliberately obscured by a perfectly centered opaque square censor block in {argument name="censor block color" default="warm taupe brown"}, covering the upper torso and face area while leaving the hat rim visible behind it. Surround the statue with energetic abstract graphic-design elements: concentric halftone circles, black-and-white diagonal stripes, dotted gradients, thin radial sunburst lines behind the hat, hot pink and orange blocks, yellow arcs, black rings, magenta splatter, small crosses, grid textures, and subtle glitch-like cyan/magenta color offsets around the statue edges. Use a high-contrast mixed-media style combining realistic ceramic texture with modern pop-art poster graphics, crisp studio lighting, sharp details, and a balanced symmetrical composition. Add a small handwritten signature and date in the bottom right reading {argument name="date text" default="May 14, 2026"} and {argument name="signature text" default="Ogygia"}. Keep the background mostly white, no extra characters, no readable text beyond the date/signature and the bottle markings, and emphasize the unique quality of a {argument name="ceramic subject" default="Shigaraki ware tanuki statue"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版海报风格的 AI 艺术作品，背景为纯净的白色。画面中心是一尊高度写实的信乐烧狸猫陶瓷雕像全身照，呈现出带有斑点的光泽陶器质感，拥有米色的肚子、深棕色的四肢、斑驳的釉面、圆滚滚的腹部、小巧的肚脐，头戴大斗笠，一只爪子拿着酒瓶，另一只爪子拿着德利酒壶或类似账本的配件。狸猫的面部被一个完美居中的不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住，颜色为 {argument name="censor block color" default="暖灰褐色"}，遮挡区域覆盖上半身及面部，同时保留后方可见的斗笠边缘。在雕像周围环绕充满活力的抽象平面设计元素：同心半调圆点、黑白斜条纹、点状渐变、斗笠后方的细长放射状太阳光线、亮粉色和橙色色块、黄色弧线、黑色圆环、洋红色喷溅、小十字架、网格纹理，以及雕像边缘微妙的故障风格青色/洋红色色彩偏移。采用高对比度的混合媒介风格，将逼真的陶瓷质感与现代波普艺术海报图形相结合，呈现清晰的影棚灯光、锐利的细节和平衡的对称构图。在右下角添加一个小巧的手写签名和日期，内容为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 14 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Ogygia"}。背景保持大面积留白，不要添加额外角色，除了日期/签名和酒瓶上的标记外，不要出现可读文字，并强调 {argument name="ceramic subject" default="信乐烧狸猫雕像"} 的独特品质。

templates.title: Winged Mecha Beam Cannon Battle

titleLocalized.zh: 翼装机甲光束炮激战

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic high-detail anime mecha battle illustration in a cinematic 4:3 landscape frame. Show a single futuristic humanoid giant robot resembling a dark navy blue and white super robot, with angular Gundam-like armor, sharp V-fin helmet, glowing green forehead and chest sensors, yellow accent panels, red chin detail, layered shoulder armor, large wing-like backpack thrusters, and bulky mechanical legs. The mecha is flying diagonally from the upper left toward the lower right, viewed from a low three-quarter front angle, gripping an oversized rectangular beam cannon with both hands. The cannon fires one enormous blinding {argument name="beam color" default="hot pink and white"} energy blast to the right edge of the image, surrounded by a circular glowing energy ring, electric arcs, streaking particles, and radial motion lines. Add two bright blue thruster flames from the rear backpack on the left side. The background is a chaotic aerial battlefield at sunset or dusk with smoky purple clouds, orange explosions, burning debris, sparks, and small dark fragments flying through the sky. Use dramatic foreshortening, intense motion blur on the energy beam, crisp cel-shaded anime linework, highly polished mechanical panel detail, high contrast lighting, vibrant neon effects, and epic sci-fi action composition. The main subject should be {argument name="mecha design" default="dark navy angular winged humanoid battle robot"}; keep exactly one robot, one beam cannon, one main energy beam, one circular energy ring, and two visible blue thruster plumes. No text, no logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅动态且高细节的动漫机甲战斗插画，采用电影感 4:3 横向画幅。画面主体为一个未来感十足的人形巨型机器人，外观类似于深海军蓝与白色相间的超级机甲，拥有棱角分明的敢达风格装甲、锐利的 V 字天线头盔、发光的绿色额头与胸部传感器、黄色装饰面板、红色下巴细节、层叠的肩甲、巨大的翼状背包推进器以及厚重的机械腿。机甲正从左上方向右下方斜向飞行，采用低角度四分之三正面视角，双手紧握一把超大型长方形光束炮。光束炮向画面右侧边缘发射出一道耀眼的 {argument name="beam color" default="亮粉色与白色"} 能量冲击波，周围环绕着圆形的能量光环、电弧、流光粒子以及放射状运动线条。在左侧的后背推进器处添加两道明亮的蓝色推进火焰。背景是黄昏或暮色下混乱的空中战场，布满烟雾缭绕的紫色云层、橙色爆炸、燃烧的残骸、火花以及在天空中飞溅的小块碎片。运用戏剧性的透视缩短效果、能量束上的强烈运动模糊、清晰的赛璐璐动漫线条、高度抛光的机械面板细节、高对比度光影、鲜艳的霓虹效果以及史诗级的科幻动作构图。主体应为 {argument name="mecha design" default="深海军蓝棱角分明的翼装人形战斗机器人"}；画面中仅保留一个机器人、一把光束炮、一道主能量束、一个圆形能量环以及两道可见的蓝色推进器尾焰。无文字、无标志、无水印。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Character Select Screen

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫角色选择界面

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical cyberpunk anime fighting game character select screen for a fictional game titled {argument name="game logo text" default="SynClub"}, styled like a glossy arcade versus menu.

Canvas: Tall 2:3 mobile-poster composition, 675×1200 style, dark futuristic neon city background split diagonally into blue left side and hot pink/red right side, with glowing HUD lines, scanlines, sparks, particles, and high-contrast rim lighting.

Layout: At the very top, place angular metallic logo text “SynClub” with electric blue highlights, and beneath it the title “CHARACTER SELECT”. Put “PLAYER 1” in a blue sci-fi tab at the top-left and “PLAYER 2” in a pink sci-fi tab at the top-right. The screen is divided into two large featured character areas: left selected fighter for Player 1 in blue, right selected fighter for Player 2 in red. In the center lower half, place a character portrait selection grid with glowing frames. At the bottom center, place a large luminous “VS”. Along the bottom edge, add a game controller command bar with five options: select, confirm, back, random, option, each with small PlayStation-style button icons.

Main characters: Player 1 is {argument name="player one character name" default="REGULUS"}, a dark hooded anime fighter with black cloak, chains, metallic accessories, glowing blue highlights, pale shadowed face, red eyes, one gloved hand lifting the hood, mysterious assassin/rogue mood. Add the Japanese reading “レグルス” under the name. Player 2 is {argument name="player two character name" default="MERU"}, a blonde gothic-lolita anime girl with long twin-tail hair, red and black frilled dress, rose accessories, black gloves, choker, heart gem, playful elegant pose with one hand near her face. Add the Japanese reading “める” under the name.

Stats panels: Under each large character name, include a compact rectangular stat box with exactly 5 labeled rows: TYPE, POWER, SPEED, RANGE, TECHNIQUE. For Regulus, the TYPE value is “スピード” and the bars glow blue. For Meru, the TYPE value is “トリッキー” and the bars glow red.

Character select grid: Include exactly 14 selectable tiles in the central grid, each with a glowing sci-fi border. Count and arrange them as follows: Row 1 has 3 tiles: hooded dark male portrait, blonde female portrait, dark masked/obscured portrait. Row 2 has 3 tiles: silver-haired maid girl, selected Regulus tile marked with a blue “P1” tag, selected Meru tile marked with a red “P2” tag. Row 3 has 5 tiles: robot/cyborg head, witch girl with hat, blond male portrait, black-haired masked fighter, tan spiky-haired boy. Row 4 has 3 tiles: turquoise aquatic/mermaid-like girl, pale white-haired character, and a black silhouette tile with a question mark labeled “Random”. Use blue selection glow around P1 and red selection glow around P2.

Bottom versus panels: Bottom-left blue player panel reads “PLAYER 1 REGULUS レグルス” with an emblem and a weapon box labeled “MAIN WEAPON” showing {argument name="player one weapon" default="黒剣 -ノクターナル-"} beside a sleek dark sword illustration. Bottom-right red player panel reads “PLAYER 2 MERU める” with a rose emblem and a weapon box labeled “MAIN WEAPON” showing {argument name="player two weapon" default="ローズマイク"} beside a rose-themed microphone weapon illustration.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed anime key art, glossy UI, esports fighting game interface, neon blue versus neon magenta palette, sharp angular frames, glowing typography, dramatic lighting, dense futuristic city details, polished game-menu screenshot look.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and aligned like a real character select UI. Use exactly 2 large featured characters and exactly 14 central selectable tiles. Do not add extra characters outside the grid. No watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个竖屏赛博朋克动漫格斗游戏角色选择界面，用于一款名为 {argument name="game logo text" default="SynClub"} 的虚构游戏，风格仿照光泽感十足的街机对战菜单。

画布：高比例 2:3 手机海报构图，675×1200 风格，深色未来感霓虹城市背景，对角线分割为左侧蓝色和右侧亮粉/红色，带有发光的 HUD 线条、扫描线、火花、粒子和高对比度的轮廓光。

布局：在最顶部放置带有电光蓝高光的金属质感 Logo 文字“SynClub”，下方为标题“CHARACTER SELECT”。左上角放置蓝色科幻标签“PLAYER 1”，右上角放置粉色科幻标签“PLAYER 2”。屏幕分为两个大型特色角色区域：左侧为 Player 1 选定的蓝色系战士，右侧为 Player 2 选定的红色系战士。在中心下半部分，放置一个带有发光边框的角色头像选择网格。底部中心放置一个巨大的发光“VS”。沿底部边缘添加一个游戏手柄指令栏，包含五个选项：选择、确认、返回、随机、选项，每个选项配有小型 PlayStation 风格的按钮图标。

主要角色：Player 1 为 {argument name="player one character name" default="REGULUS"}，一名身穿黑色斗篷、带有锁链和金属配饰的暗黑兜帽动漫战士，散发蓝色荧光，面部苍白阴郁，红色双眼，一只戴手套的手正掀起兜帽，呈现神秘刺客/游侠氛围。在名字下方添加日语读音“レグルス”。Player 2 为 {argument name="player two character name" default="MERU"}，一名金发哥特萝莉动漫少女，留着长双马尾，身穿红黑相间的荷叶边连衣裙，配有玫瑰饰品、黑色手套、颈圈和心形宝石，姿态俏皮优雅，一只手靠近脸庞。在名字下方添加日语读音“める”。

属性面板：在每个大型角色名称下方，包含一个紧凑的矩形属性框，精确标注 5 行：TYPE（类型）、POWER（力量）、SPEED（速度）、RANGE（范围）、TECHNIQUE（技巧）。对于 Regulus，TYPE 值为“スピード”（速度型），属性条发出蓝光。对于 Meru，TYPE 值为“トリッキー”（技巧型），属性条发出红光。

角色选择网格：在中心网格中包含精确的 14 个可选方块，每个方块都有发光的科幻边框。排列方式如下：第 1 行 3 个方块：兜帽暗黑男性头像、金发女性头像、暗黑蒙面/遮挡头像。第 2 行 3 个方块：银发女仆头像、标有蓝色“P1”标签的 Regulus 选中方块、标有红色“P2”标签的 Meru 选中方块。第 3 行 5 个方块：机器人/赛博格头部、戴帽子的魔女、金发男性头像、黑发蒙面战士、棕色刺猬头男孩。第 4 行 3 个方块：青绿色水生/人鱼风格女孩、苍白白发角色，以及一个带有问号并标注“Random”的黑色剪影方块。P1 周围使用蓝色选择光效，P2 周围使用红色选择光效。

底部对战面板：左下角蓝色玩家面板显示“PLAYER 1 REGULUS レグルス”，配有徽章和标注为“MAIN WEAPON”的武器框，展示 {argument name="player one weapon" default="黒剣 -ノクターナル-"} 以及一把精致的暗黑剑插图。右下角红色玩家面板显示“PLAYER 2 MERU める”，配有玫瑰徽章和标注为“MAIN WEAPON”的武器框，展示 {argument name="player two weapon" default="ローズマイク"} 以及一把玫瑰主题的麦克风武器插图。

视觉风格：超精细动漫关键视觉图、光泽感 UI、电竞格斗游戏界面、霓虹蓝对比霓虹洋红配色、锐利的棱角边框、发光字体、戏剧性光影、密集的未来城市细节、精致的游戏菜单截图外观。

约束：保持所有文字清晰可辨，并像真实的选人 UI 一样对齐。使用精确的 2 个大型特色角色和 14 个中心可选方块。不要在网格之外添加额外角色。无水印。

templates.title: 12-Style Anime Photo Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 12 种风格动漫照片拼贴

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Using the provided reference photo as the subject base, create a vertical 3-column by 4-row comparison collage that transforms the same child-and-dog scene into exactly 12 popular animation/game-inspired visual styles. Keep the child and dog recognizable in pose, relative placement, clothing, and outdoor park feeling, and preserve any existing face anonymization/privacy masking from the reference rather than inventing facial details. Add a bold style-title logo at the top of each panel.

Canvas and layout: Use a tall poster layout with 12 equal rectangular panels separated by thin white grid lines, arranged as 3 columns x 4 rows. Each panel should show the same subject pairing from the reference but redrawn in a different style, with bright saturated colors and clean promotional collage composition.

Panels, in order from top-left to bottom-right, exactly 12:
1. “STUDIO GHIBLI” — soft hand-painted fantasy countryside look.
2. “PIXAR” — polished 3D animated movie look.
3. “DRAGON BALL” — dynamic action-anime look with speed lines and rocky landscape.
4. “ONE PIECE” — adventurous nautical anime look with ship/sea elements.
5. “NARUTO” — ninja-anime look with village background and orange/black outfit influence.
6. “ドラえもん” — cheerful rounded Japanese cartoon suburb style.
7. “サザエさん” — classic family-anime neighborhood style.
8. “Lilo&Stitch” — tropical island cartoon look with beach and palm trees.
9. “POKÉMON” — bright monster-adventure world look; add a cap/backpack vibe to the child and a cute creature-like treatment for the dog.
10. “鬼滅の刃” — dramatic sword-anime look with purple lighting and patterned haori influence.
11. “クレヨンしんちゃん” — simple cute children’s cartoon style with big expressive shapes.
12. “MINECRAFT” — blocky voxel game style with cubic characters and environment.

Customizable text: Use {argument name="collage title style" default="anime style comparison poster"} as the overall design intent, and keep the panel labels exactly as listed unless replaced by {argument name="panel label set" default="STUDIO GHIBLI, PIXAR, DRAGON BALL, ONE PIECE, NARUTO, ドラえもん, サザエさん, Lilo&Stitch, POKÉMON, 鬼滅の刃, クレヨンしんちゃん, MINECRAFT"}.

Constraints: Do not add extra panels, extra people, or extra pets. Keep the dog’s happy expression and fluffy tan appearance consistent across panels. Keep the child close to the dog in every panel. Maintain visible privacy blocks/anonymization over faces if present in the reference. Make the final image look like a shareable social media collage showcasing one photo converted into many animation styles.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考照片为基础，创建一个 3 列 4 行的垂直对比拼贴图，将同一组儿童与狗的场景转换为 12 种热门动画/游戏视觉风格。确保儿童和狗的姿势、相对位置、服装以及户外公园的氛围清晰可辨，并保留参考图中现有的面部匿名化/隐私遮盖处理，不要自行添加面部细节。在每个面板顶部添加醒目的风格标题标识。

画布与布局：使用长海报布局，包含 12 个相等的矩形面板，由细白网格线分隔，排列为 3 列 x 4 行。每个面板应展示参考图中相同的对象组合，但以不同的风格重绘，色彩明亮饱和，构图简洁，具有宣传拼贴画的质感。

面板顺序（从左上到右下，共 12 个）：
1. “STUDIO GHIBLI” — 柔和的手绘奇幻乡村风格。
2. “PIXAR” — 精致的 3D 动画电影风格。
3. “DRAGON BALL” — 充满动感的动作动漫风格，带有速度线和岩石景观。
4. “ONE PIECE” — 充满冒险气息的航海动漫风格，带有船只/海洋元素。
5. “NARUTO” — 忍者动漫风格，带有村庄背景及橙/黑色服装元素。
6. “ドラえもん” — 欢快圆润的日本卡通郊区风格。
7. “サザエさん” — 经典的家庭动漫邻里风格。
8. “Lilo&Stitch” — 热带岛屿卡通风格，带有海滩和棕榈树。
9. “POKÉMON” — 明亮的怪物冒险世界风格；为儿童添加帽子/背包元素，并将狗处理成可爱的生物形象。
10. “鬼滅の刃” — 戏剧性的剑术动漫风格，带有紫色光影和羽织图案影响。
11. “クレヨンしんちゃん” — 简洁可爱的儿童卡通风格，具有夸张的表现力。
12. “MINECRAFT” — 方块像素游戏风格，角色和环境均为立方体结构。

可自定义文本：使用 {argument name="collage title style" default="anime style comparison poster"} 作为整体设计意图，并保持面板标签与上述列表完全一致，除非被 {argument name="panel label set" default="STUDIO GHIBLI, PIXAR, DRAGON BALL, ONE PIECE, NARUTO, ドラえもん, サザエさん, Lilo&Stitch, POKÉMON, 鬼滅の刃, クレヨンしんちゃん, MINECRAFT"} 替换。

约束条件：不要添加额外的面板、人物或宠物。确保狗的快乐表情和蓬松的棕褐色外观在所有面板中保持一致。在每个面板中，儿童必须靠近狗。如果参考图中存在面部隐私遮盖/匿名化处理，请务必保留。最终图像应呈现为一张适合在社交媒体分享的拼贴画，展示一张照片如何被转换为多种动画风格。

templates.title: Blood-Red Western Gunslinger Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 血红色西部神枪手海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical western action character poster in Rockstar Games official concept-art style, polished hard-boiled graphic novel rendering. A confident male gunslinger, {argument name="character identity" default="a faceless placeholder man with a smooth tan rectangular mask covering the face"}, stands in a low-angle heroic pose occupying the lower 75% of the frame. The top 25% must remain a strictly empty solid blood-red sky with no text, logos, clouds, or objects. He holds exactly 2 ornate long-barrel revolvers: one raised upright in his left hand on the viewer’s left, and one raised upright in his right hand on the viewer’s right, both with engraved gold-and-steel details and ivory grips. Attire: {argument name="outfit" default="cream off-white wrinkled button-up shirt, dark navy neckerchief, wide dark leather gun belt with two buckles, black trousers, and a brown leather holster on the left hip"}. Background: {argument name="setting" default="red desert canyon with tall rocky spires and saguaro cacti at sunset"}, dark silhouettes and orange rim light behind the character. Composition should crop close from thighs to above the head, with the head centered, shoulders broad, weapons extending toward the upper corners, and the viewer looking upward at the character. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, heavy ink-like shadows, warm orange highlights, painterly halftone texture, gritty western poster finish, sharp costume folds, detailed leather tooling, and no readable text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直的西部动作角色海报，采用 Rockstar Games 官方概念艺术风格，呈现精致的硬汉派图像小说渲染效果。一位自信的男性神枪手，{argument name="character identity" default="一个面部带有光滑棕褐色长方形面具的无名男子"}，以低角度的英雄姿态占据画面下方 75% 的位置。上方 25% 必须保持为纯粹的血红色天空，不得包含任何文字、标志、云朵或物体。他手持 2 把装饰华丽的长管左轮手枪：左手持一把直立于观众左侧，右手持一把直立于观众右侧，枪身带有雕刻的黄金与钢铁细节，并配有象牙枪柄。服装：{argument name="outfit" default="米白色褶皱衬衫、深蓝色领巾、带有两个扣环的宽大深色皮质枪带、黑色长裤，左侧腰间配有棕色皮质枪套"}。背景：{argument name="setting" default="日落时分的红色沙漠峡谷，背景为高耸的岩石尖塔和巨人柱仙人掌"}，角色身后为深色剪影和橙色轮廓光。构图需从大腿处到头部上方进行近景裁剪，头部居中，双肩宽阔，武器向画面上方两侧延伸，视角为仰视角色。运用戏剧性的明暗对比照明、厚重的墨水感阴影、温暖的橙色高光、绘画般的半色调纹理、粗犷的西部海报质感、清晰的服装褶皱、精细的皮革雕花，且画面中不得出现任何可读文字或水印。

templates.title: Cinematic Hinata Anime Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感日向雏田动漫肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic anime-style portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Hinata Hyuga"} from Naruto, shown in a close-up three-quarter view from the chest up, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="dark indigo-purple"} hair and straight bangs blowing dramatically across the frame. Her face is intentionally covered by a large centered opaque square censor block in deep muted purple, hiding the eyes, nose, and mouth. She wears a pale lavender-and-white shinobi jacket with a high collar, a visible Leaf Village metal forehead-protector plate worn around the neck, dark mesh undershirt, and a circular sleeve emblem on the upper arm. The scene is filled with glowing violet-white petals, soft particles, and streaks of light swirling around her hair, with strong backlighting from the upper left creating glossy highlights and a dreamy ethereal atmosphere. Use a cool purple-blue color palette, high-detail semi-realistic anime rendering, shallow depth of field, luminous bloom, motion-blurred hair strands, and soft bokeh. Add subtle vertical Japanese text near the upper right reading {argument name="vertical text" default="日向雛田"} with a small Leaf Village symbol beneath it. No extra characters, no watermark, no modern objects, maintain the large square face obstruction exactly in the center.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 比例的竖版电影感动漫风格肖像，主角为《火影忍者》中的 {argument name="character name" default="日向雏田"}，采用胸部以上的四分之三侧面特写视角。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深靛紫色"} 飘逸秀发，平刘海在画面中戏剧性地随风飘动。她的面部被一个位于中心的大型不透明深哑光紫色方块刻意遮挡，隐藏了眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴。她身穿淡紫色与白色相间的忍者夹克，高领设计，颈部佩戴着清晰可见的木叶村金属护额，内搭深色网状内衣，上臂处有圆形袖章。场景中充满了发光的紫白色花瓣、柔和的微粒以及环绕在她发丝间的流光，左上方的强背光营造出光泽感和梦幻空灵的氛围。采用冷紫蓝色调，高细节半写实动漫渲染，浅景深，发光晕影，动态模糊的发丝以及柔和的焦外成像。在右上角附近添加细小的竖排日文 {argument name="vertical text" default="日向雛田"}，下方配有一个小型的木叶村标志。画面中不得出现额外角色、水印或现代物品，务必保持大型方形遮挡物位于画面正中心。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Flash Sale Landing Hero

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克风格限时闪购落地页首屏

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cyberpunk e-commerce desktop first-view landing page for {argument name="brand name" default="NEXA"}, promoting a limited-time {argument name="campaign name" default="CYBER FLASH CAMPAIGN"} in a neon futuristic style.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 website hero screen, dark black/navy background, full-bleed cyber grid floor receding in perspective, glowing magenta and cyan circuitry framing the edges. High contrast, glossy reflections, electric neon bloom, futuristic HUD aesthetic.

Layout: Top navigation bar with the brand logo on the left and exactly 5 navigation items on the right: “SALE”, “FEATURE”, “ITEMS”, “FAQ”, and a bordered neon button “CHECK NOW”. The hero section is split into two columns: left text-and-CTA area, right large promotional banner graphic.

Left hero content: Add a small rounded pill label reading {argument name="campaign name" default="CYBER FLASH CAMPAIGN"}. Main headline in Japanese and English: “今だけの” above huge bold “FLASH SALE”, white letters with hot-pink glow. Below it, two short Japanese description lines: “対象アイテムが期間限定でスペシャルプライス。” and “7/15(火) 13:59までの限定オファーをお見逃しなく。” Add a neon outlined limited-time bar with a clock icon and text “LIMITED TIME : 7/15(火) 13:59まで”. Beneath are exactly 2 CTA buttons: a hot-pink filled glowing button “今すぐチェック ›” and a cyan outlined button “対象商品を見る ›”. At the bottom of the left column, show exactly 3 small benefit chips with icons: truck icon “送料無料”, user icon “会員限定特典”, gift icon “数量限定”.

Right promotional graphic: A large square/near-square neon poster card with a glowing magenta border and cyan HUD corner details, set slightly right of center. Inside the card, show a futuristic city street at night with skyscrapers, magenta/cyan lights, and a perspective grid road. Center a large neon alarm clock outline containing bold stacked text “FLASH SALE” and cyan text “LIMITED OFFER”. Below it, add Japanese “期間限定”, then the deadline {argument name="deadline text" default="7/15(火) 13:59まで"}, then a bright magenta rounded button “CHECK NOW”. Include small decorative HUD charts, circular targets, circuit marks, and arrows around the poster, but keep all text legible.

Visual style: Use black, deep navy, hot magenta, electric cyan, and white. Typography should be bold condensed sans-serif for English sale text, clean modern Japanese sans-serif for Japanese copy. Add strong neon glows, thin circuit-line borders, chromatic highlights, and polished reflections on the grid floor.

Constraints: Desktop website first-view only, no browser chrome, no people, no extra product images, no watermark. Keep the exact visible counts: 5 navigation items, 2 CTA buttons, 3 benefit chips, and 1 large right-side sale poster. Make the composition feel like a finished PC landing page hero based on a banner design.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="NEXA"} 创建一个赛博朋克风格的桌面端电商首屏落地页，以霓虹未来主义风格推广限时 {argument name="campaign name" default="CYBER FLASH CAMPAIGN"} 活动。

画布：16:9 宽屏网站首屏，深黑/深海军蓝背景，全屏铺满透视效果的赛博网格地面，边缘由发光的洋红色和青色电路环绕。高对比度，光泽反射，电光霓虹晕影，未来感 HUD 美学。

布局：顶部导航栏，左侧为品牌 Logo，右侧包含 5 个导航项：“SALE”、“FEATURE”、“ITEMS”、“FAQ”以及一个带霓虹边框的按钮“CHECK NOW”。首屏分为左右两栏：左侧为文案与 CTA 区域，右侧为大型促销海报图。

左侧首屏内容：添加一个小的圆角胶囊标签，文字为 {argument name="campaign name" default="CYBER FLASH CAMPAIGN"}。主标题采用日文与英文结合：“今だけの”位于巨大的粗体“FLASH SALE”上方，白色字母带有洋红色光晕。下方是两行简短的日文描述：“対象アイテムが期間限定でスペシャルプライス。”以及“7/15(火) 13:59までの限定オファーをお見逃しなく。”添加一个带有时钟图标和文字“LIMITED TIME : 7/15(火) 13:59まで”的霓虹边框限时条。下方设有 2 个 CTA 按钮：一个洋红色填充的发光按钮“今すぐチェック ›”和一个青色边框按钮“対象商品を見る ›”。左栏底部展示 3 个带有图标的小型权益标签：卡车图标“送料無料”、用户图标“会員限定特典”、礼品图标“数量限定”。

右侧宣传图：一张大型方形/近方形的霓虹海报卡片，带有发光的洋红色边框和青色 HUD 角落细节，位于画面中心偏右。卡片内部展示未来感夜间城市街道，包含摩天大楼、洋红色/青色灯光和透视网格道路。中心放置一个巨大的霓虹闹钟轮廓，内部堆叠粗体文字“FLASH SALE”和青色文字“LIMITED OFFER”。下方添加日文“期間限定”，随后是截止日期 {argument name="deadline text" default="7/15(火) 13:59まで"}，以及一个亮洋红色的圆角按钮“CHECK NOW”。海报周围包含装饰性的 HUD 图表、圆形目标、电路标记和箭头，但需确保所有文字清晰可读。

视觉风格：使用黑色、深海军蓝、亮洋红、电光青和白色。英文促销文字使用粗体压缩无衬线字体，日文文案使用简洁的现代日文无衬线字体。添加强烈的霓虹光晕、细电路边框、色差高光以及网格地面上的抛光反射效果。

约束：仅限桌面端网站首屏，无浏览器边框，无人像，无额外产品图，无水印。保持精确的可见数量：5 个导航项，2 个 CTA 按钮，3 个权益标签，以及 1 张右侧大型促销海报。构图需呈现出基于横幅设计完成的 PC 端落地页首屏效果。

templates.title: Pink Mecha Idol Wedding Dress Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色机甲偶像婚纱设计图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical anime bridal fashion character sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Roboco-san"}, a cybernetic idol bride in a soft pink mecha-themed wedding dress, presented as a luxury magazine design board titled {argument name="headline text" default="WEDDING DRESS Collection"}.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, pale blush-pink border with ornate thin lines, rose motifs, delicate filigree corners, glossy high-resolution anime illustration. Use a dreamy cathedral wedding atmosphere with stained-glass windows, sheer curtains, sparkling floor reflections, floating petals, soft bloom lighting, and a romantic pink-white color palette.

Main layout: Split the page into two major columns. The left column is a large full-body hero illustration taking about half the canvas width. The right column is a detailed fashion-spec panel with title, description text, and multiple labeled inset views. Add a bottom information strip spanning the page.

Hero illustration: Show one full-body anime bride with very long {argument name="hair color" default="brown to rose-pink gradient hair"}, flowing waist-length twin-tail-like hair strands, a pink rose flower crown, translucent veil, and a gentle bridal pose holding a large bouquet. Her face should be softly obscured or simplified with no sharp facial detail. She wears a white and blush-pink asymmetrical wedding dress with a corset bodice, heart-shaped neckline, off-shoulder puff sleeves, layered ruffled skirt, translucent overskirt, pink ribbons, rose decorations, pearl-like trim, silver mechanical accents, and one visible cybernetic/mecha leg. Include high-heeled platform bridal shoes with pink roses and ankle straps. Bouquet should be round and dense with pink roses, white filler flowers, green leaves, and long trailing pink ribbons.

Visible text and typography: Use elegant serif and script typography in dusty rose. Large title on the right reads “WEDDING DRESS” with “Collection” below in cursive. Include smaller English text “Roboco-san Bridal Style 2024” and Japanese-style descriptive body copy as decorative filler. Add vertical Japanese quote on the left side of the hero illustration: {argument name="side quote" default="キミとなら、未来もずっと幸せでいられる気がするの……♡"}. Add bottom center quote: {argument name="bottom quote" default="キミの隣で、ずっと笑っていられますように。"}. Add bottom-left name label “Roboco-san” and “Bridal Style 2024”.

Right-side fashion panels: Include exactly 10 labeled inset panels. The first row has 3 full-body turnaround panels labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”. Below them are 7 detail panels labeled “BOUQUET”, “SHOULDER & BODICE”, “MECHA LEG”, “SHOES”, “BACK STYLE”, and “RIBBON DETAIL”, with the “SHOES” section split into two small shoe close-up images inside one labeled panel. The detail panels show close-ups of the bouquet, corset bust and shoulders, robotic leg joint, bridal platform heels, rear hair-and-dress silhouette, and a large pink bow with roses.

Bottom-left design information: Add a framed “Design Point” card containing exactly 4 Japanese bullet-style lines with small pink flower/star bullets. Below it add a “Color Palette” row with exactly 5 rectangular swatches labeled “Rose Pink”, “Blush Pink”, “Pearl White”, “Silver”, and “Light Rose”.

Bottom-right stats card: Add a small framed profile box with exactly 3 lines: “Height: 152cm”, “Birthday: 5 / 23”, and “Favorite: …” as tiny decorative text. Add small rose icons around the bottom strip.

Style constraints: Keep everything cohesive in pastel pink, pearl white, silver, and light rose. Use ornate bridal catalog aesthetics, clean panel borders, soft glitter, highly detailed lace and ruffles, delicate cybernetic parts, and no dark or harsh colors. The image should feel like an official idol wedding dress collection sheet rather than a simple portrait.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Roboco-san"} 创建一张竖版动漫新娘时尚角色设计图，她是一位身着柔粉色机甲主题婚纱的赛博格偶像新娘，以豪华杂志设计项目（board）的形式呈现，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="WEDDING DRESS Collection"}。

画布：3:4 竖构图，淡腮红粉色边框，配有华丽的细线条、玫瑰图案、精致的镂空花纹边角，呈现高分辨率光泽感的动漫插画。营造梦幻般的教堂婚礼氛围，背景包含彩色玻璃窗、透明窗帘、闪烁的地板倒影、漂浮的花瓣、柔和的泛光照明以及浪漫的粉白色调。

主要布局：将页面分为两个主要栏目。左栏为占据约一半画布宽度的全尺寸全身主图。右栏为详细的时尚规格面板，包含标题、描述文字和多个带标签的嵌入式视图。页面底部添加横跨全页的信息条。

主图：展示一位全身动漫新娘，拥有极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="棕色至玫瑰粉色渐变发色"}，飘逸的腰部长度双马尾发束，佩戴粉色玫瑰花冠、透明面纱，姿态优雅，手持大束捧花。面部应柔和处理或简化，不带尖锐的面部细节。她身着白色与腮红粉色不对称婚纱，配有束腰胸衣、心形领口、露肩泡泡袖、多层荷叶边裙摆、透明罩裙、粉色丝带、玫瑰装饰、珍珠饰边、银色机械配件，并露出一只可见的赛博格/机甲腿。包含配有粉色玫瑰和踝带的高跟厚底婚纱鞋。捧花应圆润饱满，由粉色玫瑰、白色填充花卉、绿叶及长长的垂坠粉色丝带组成。

可见文字与排版：使用优雅的衬线字体和手写体，颜色为干枯玫瑰色。右侧大标题为“WEDDING DRESS”，下方以草书书写“Collection”。包含较小的英文文本“Roboco-san Bridal Style 2024”以及作为装饰填充的日式描述性正文。在主图左侧添加竖排日语引言：{argument name="side quote" default="キミとなら、未来もずっと幸せでいられる気がするの……♡"}。底部居中添加引言：{argument name="bottom quote" default="キミの隣で、ずっと笑っていられますように。"}。左下角添加名称标签“Roboco-san”和“Bridal Style 2024”。

右侧时尚面板：包含 10 个带标签的嵌入式面板。第一行有 3 个全身转向图面板，分别标记为“FRONT”、“SIDE”和“BACK”。下方是 7 个细节面板，分别标记为“BOUQUET”、“SHOULDER & BODICE”、“MECHA LEG”、“SHOES”、“BACK STYLE”和“RIBBON DETAIL”，其中“SHOES”部分在同一个标签面板内拆分为两个小的鞋部特写图。细节面板展示了捧花、胸衣与肩部、机械腿关节、婚纱厚底高跟鞋、背部发型与裙摆轮廓，以及带有玫瑰的大型粉色蝴蝶结。

左下角设计信息：添加一个带边框的“Design Point”卡片，包含 4 行日式项目符号文本，使用小粉花/星星作为项目符号。下方添加“Color Palette”行，包含 5 个矩形色块，分别标记为“Rose Pink”、“Blush Pink”、“Pearl White”、“Silver”和“Light Rose”。

右下角属性卡：添加一个带边框的小型个人资料框，包含 3 行内容：“Height: 152cm”、“Birthday: 5 / 23”以及作为微小装饰文本的“Favorite: …”。在底部信息条周围添加小型玫瑰图标。

风格约束：整体保持柔和粉色、珍珠白、银色和浅玫瑰色的协调感。采用华丽的婚纱目录美学，清晰的面板边框，柔和的闪光效果，高度精细的蕾丝与荷叶边，精致的赛博格部件，避免使用深色或刺眼的颜色。图像应呈现为官方偶像婚纱系列设计图，而非简单的肖像画。
