templates.title: Sakae Nagoya Watercolor Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 名古屋荣区水彩旅行海报

templates.prompt:
Create a vertical travel poster illustration of {argument name="location title" default="SAKAE, NAGOYA"} in a refined watercolor-and-ink urban sketch style on warm off-white textured paper. The scene shows a lively street intersection in Sakae, Nagoya, Japan, viewed from sidewalk level with strong depth perspective. On the left foreground, draw a charming old corner cafe building with weathered cream walls, black awning, large window, warm interior seating, potted plants, climbing leafy vines, and a parked green bicycle leaning near the curb; include readable cafe signage: “KAKUOZAN LARDER”, “BLEND”, and “COFFEE”. Place a small chalkboard sign outside reading “COFFEE / SANDWICH / and / GOOD MUSIC” with a tiny cup drawing. In the center distance, feature the Nagoya TV Tower rising clearly above trees and city buildings. On the right, show a modern elevated glass-and-metal transit structure, streetlights, traffic signals, a “Sakae” sign, road markings, bicycles, and pedestrians crossing a broad zebra crossing. Include one prominent woman seen from behind in the lower center foreground wearing a light beige long coat and carrying a brown shoulder bag, walking into the city. Add many small pedestrians but keep them sketchy and atmospheric. Use delicate black pen linework, pale gray shadows, muted blue-gray architecture, soft green foliage, and restrained watercolor washes with lots of white space.

Poster typography: At the upper right, set the large bracketed headline “[{argument name="location title" default="SAKAE, NAGOYA"}]” in elegant tall serif capitals. Beneath it, add the handwritten script subtitle “{argument name="subtitle" default="Everyday Urban Rhythm"}”, a thin horizontal rule, and small uppercase text “SAKAE, NAKA WARD, NAGOYA, JAPAN”. Farther right, add a compact quote block: “A CITY THAT BLENDS / TRADITION AND INNOVATION, / PEOPLE AND CULTURE, / IN PERFECT HARMONY.” In the bottom left margin, add a small circular travel stamp reading “NAGOYA / 名古屋 / JAPAN”. Keep the composition airy, sophisticated, editorial, and print-ready, with no photo-realism and no extra text.

templates.title: Anime Bridal Dress Collection Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫婚纱系列设计图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed anime wedding dress collection design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Natsuiro Matsuri"}, in a bright tropical seaside bridal theme, combining a large full-body fashion illustration with a right-side catalog/specification layout.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, split composition. Left half is a full-height hero illustration; right half is an elegant cream-white bridal collection board. Use ornate thin gold borders, floral corner decorations, soft watercolor textures, and a luxurious idol merchandise/fashion reference-sheet feel.

Left hero illustration: Show one young anime idol bride standing on a sunlit beach path beside turquoise ocean water under a vivid blue sky. She has {argument name="hair color" default="warm light brown"} twin-tail hair with a curled ahoge, a large side ponytail, translucent veil, white flower hair ornaments, green-and-gold striped ribbons, and a small black-and-white mascot-like hair accessory. Her face area is covered by a soft beige square blur, matching the generated image. She wears a short, frilly off-shoulder white wedding dress with a cropped bodice exposing the midriff, layered ruffle skirt, sheer lace overskirt/train, green gem accents, pearl and gold chain details, white floral waist corsage, long pale green and yellow ribbons, ankle-strap bridal heels, and a small thigh flower garter. Pose her standing on one leg with the other knee bent, holding a round bouquet of white, cream, and pale yellow roses with greenery and trailing green/yellow ribbons. Surround her with tropical palm leaves, white and yellow flowers, floating petals, sparkling sunlight, and a bright romantic summer atmosphere.

Right collection board: At the top, large elegant serif gold title text: "WEDDING DRESS" with cursive subtitle "Collection". Under it write "{argument name="collection subtitle" default="Natsuiro Matsuri Bridal Style 2024"}" and a smaller Japanese line "夏色まつり ブライダルスタイル 2024". Use a refined wedding stationery style with gold flourishes, tiny star ornaments, and cream background.

Main reference panels: Include exactly 3 tall framed full-body views across the upper right area, labeled "FRONT", "SIDE", and "BACK". FRONT shows the bride from the front holding bouquet with one leg raised; SIDE shows profile view with bouquet, veil, ribbons, and short layered skirt; BACK shows back view emphasizing open shoulders, ribboned waist, translucent lace train, and bouquet at side. The front panel face is also softly blurred.

Detail panels: Include exactly 6 smaller framed detail cards in a 3-by-2 grid beneath the main views, labeled as follows: 1) "BOUQUET" showing the rose bouquet with green/yellow ribbons; 2) "SHOULDER & MIDRIFF" showing the off-shoulder ruffled neckline, flower accents, cropped bodice, and exposed waist; 3) "TRAIN & LACE" showing translucent lace, layered train, and long ribbons; 4) "SHOES" showing strappy white bridal high-heel sandals with flower ankle decoration; 5) "BACK STYLE" showing the back of the dress, open shoulders, frills, veil, and waist corsage; 6) "RIBBON DETAIL" showing the large waist flower corsage and striped green/yellow ribbon tails. Add small Japanese explanatory body text under each card, but keep it decorative and not too dominant.

Bottom sections: On the lower left, create a framed "Design Point" box with four short Japanese bullet points and a "Color Palette" row of exactly 6 circular swatches: white, pale cream/yellow, light green, mint, sky blue, and gold glitter. On the lower right, create a framed message card headed "~ Just for You, My Darling ♡" with several lines of Japanese romantic message text, a signature line "— Natsuiro Matsuri ♡", small pink hearts, and a small bust portrait of the same character at the bottom-right with a softly blurred face.

Additional visible text: Add a small white Japanese quote in the sky on the upper left of the hero illustration, reading approximately "海風にリボンを揺らして、今日は太陽ぐらい私で煌えにいくよ〜♡". Keep all text integrated like a polished Japanese anime fashion magazine page.

Visual style: Premium anime illustration, delicate line art, pastel watercolor shading, luminous beach lighting, soft bloom, intricate lace and ruffle details, elegant gold typography, ornate wedding invitation borders, floral decorations, clean catalog layout, high detail, no photorealism.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 large hero character, exactly 3 main reference view panels, exactly 6 detail cards, exactly 6 color swatches, and exactly 1 bottom-right bust portrait. Maintain the face-blur blocks where described. No extra characters, no logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="夏色祭"} 创建一张高度精细的动漫婚纱系列设计图，采用明亮的热带海滨新娘主题，将大型全身时尚插画与右侧的目录/规格布局相结合。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，采用分割构图。左半部分为全身主视觉插画；右半部分为优雅的奶油白色婚纱系列项目。使用华丽的细金边框、花卉边角装饰、柔和的水彩质感，营造出奢华的偶像周边/时尚参考图风格。

左侧主视觉插画：展示一位年轻的动漫偶像新娘，站在阳光明媚的海滩小径上，背景是绿松石色的海水和湛蓝的天空。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="暖浅棕色"} 的双马尾，带有卷曲的呆毛，一侧扎着大马尾，佩戴透明头纱、白色花朵发饰、绿金条纹丝带以及一个小巧的黑白吉祥物发饰。她的面部区域覆盖着柔和的米色模糊方块，与生成的图像保持一致。她穿着一件短款荷叶边露肩白色婚纱，短款上衣露出腰部，搭配多层褶皱裙摆、透明蕾丝罩裙/裙拖、绿色宝石点缀、珍珠和金链细节、白色花朵腰饰、长长的浅绿色和黄色丝带、脚踝系带婚鞋，以及一个小巧的大腿花朵袜带。姿势为单腿站立，另一条腿膝盖弯曲，手中拿着一束由白色、奶油色和浅黄色玫瑰组成的圆形花束，配以绿叶和垂下的绿/黄色丝带。周围环绕着热带棕榈叶、白色和黄色花朵、漂浮的花瓣、闪烁的阳光，营造出明亮浪漫的夏日氛围。

右侧系列项目：顶部使用优雅的大号衬线金色标题文字：“WEDDING DRESS”，下方配有草书副标题“Collection”。在下方写上“{argument name="collection subtitle" default="夏色祭 婚纱风格 2024"}”以及一行较小的日文“夏色まつり ブライダルスタイル 2024”。采用精致的婚礼请柬风格，配以金色花纹、微小的星星装饰和奶油色背景。

主要参考面板：在右上区域包含 3 个高大的带框全身视图，分别标注为“FRONT”（正面）、“SIDE”（侧面）和“BACK”（背面）。FRONT 展示新娘正面手持花束、单腿抬起的姿态；SIDE 展示侧面视图，包括花束、头纱、丝带和短款多层裙摆；BACK 展示背面视图，强调露肩设计、系带腰部、透明蕾丝裙拖以及侧面的花束。正面面板的面部同样经过柔和模糊处理。

细节面板：在主视图下方包含 6 个较小的带框细节卡片，采用 3x2 网格排列，标注如下：1) “BOUQUET”展示带有绿/黄色丝带的玫瑰花束；2) “SHOULDER & MIDRIFF”展示露肩荷叶边领口、花朵装饰、短款上衣和露出的腰部；3) “TRAIN & LACE”展示透明蕾丝、多层裙拖和长丝带；4) “SHOES”展示带有脚踝花朵装饰的系带白色婚纱高跟凉鞋；5) “BACK STYLE”展示婚纱背面、露肩设计、褶皱、头纱和腰饰；6) “RIBBON DETAIL”展示大型腰部花朵装饰和条纹绿/黄色丝带尾部。在每张卡片下方添加简短的日文说明文字，保持装饰性，不宜过于抢眼。

底部区域：在左下角创建一个带框的“Design Point”（设计要点）方框，包含四条简短的日文要点，以及一行包含 6 个圆形色块的“Color Palette”（配色方案）：白色、浅奶油/黄色、浅绿色、薄荷绿、天蓝色和金色闪粉。在右下角创建一个带框的留言卡，标题为“~ Just for You, My Darling ♡”，包含几行日文浪漫留言，一行签名“— 夏色祭 ♡”，点缀小粉心，并在右下角放置一张同一角色的半身肖像，面部经过柔和模糊处理。

其他可见文字：在主视觉插画左上方的天空中添加一小段白色日文引语，内容约为“海風にリボンを揺らして、今日は太陽ぐらい私で煌えにいくよ〜♡”。所有文字需像精美的日本动漫时尚杂志页面一样自然融合。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画，细腻的线条，柔和的水彩渲染，明亮的海滩光影，柔光效果，复杂的蕾丝和褶皱细节，优雅的金色排版，华丽的婚礼请柬边框，花卉装饰，简洁的目录布局，高细节，无写实感。

约束条件：使用 1 个大型主视觉角色，3 个主要参考视图面板，6 个细节卡片，6 个色块，以及 1 个右下角半身肖像。在描述的位置保持面部模糊方块。不得包含额外角色、Logo 或水印。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a refined anime wedding dress collection design board for {argument name="character name" default="Aki Rosenthal"}, presented as an elegant bridal fashion sheet.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, warm ivory parchment background, thin ornate gold border with floral corner filigree, soft rose petals scattered around the page. Use a high-detail romantic anime illustration style, pastel lighting, delicate linework, luxurious bridal-magazine layout.

Header: Large serif title at the top reading “WEDDING DRESS” in gold, with “Collection” in flowing pink cursive on the right. Under it, add the subtitle “- {argument name="character name" default="Aki Rosenthal"} Bridal Style 2024 -” and a short decorative Japanese-style tagline line in small gray text.

Main subject: On the left, one large full-body bridal illustration of a long-haired blonde elf-like anime bride in a rose garden aisle. She wears a romantic {argument name="dress color" default="pale blush ivory"} wedding gown with off-shoulder bodice, sheer lace sleeves, layered asymmetrical ruffled skirt, high slit, trailing veil, rose hair ornaments, burgundy rose accents, ribbons, lace embroidery, and jeweled details. She holds one lush bouquet of red, pink, and ivory roses with long burgundy ribbons. Her hair is extremely long, flowing, golden blonde, with soft curls and floral accessories. The face should be softly simplified or lightly obscured, keeping the focus on the dress design. Background: sunlit rose-covered archway, stone path, floating petals, dreamy bokeh.

Right-side layout: Include exactly 9 bordered reference panels arranged in a clean fashion-spec grid. Top row has exactly 3 tall panels labeled “Front”, “Side”, and “Back”, each showing the same bridal outfit from that view. Below them are exactly 6 small detail panels labeled “Bouquet”, “Rose Motif”, “Bodice”, “Veil & Lace”, “Shoes”, and “Back Style”. The detail panels should show: 1 bouquet close-up, 1 waist rose motif and ribbons, 1 bodice close-up, 1 veil and lace close-up, 1 lace high-heel shoe close-up with rose decorations, and 1 back bodice and large rose ornament close-up.

Bottom information area: Add exactly 4 cream cards with gold frames. Card 1, “Design Point”, contains exactly 3 bullet points with small burgundy rose icons. Card 2, “Color Palette”, contains exactly 5 circular swatches labeled in small Japanese-style text: rose red, burgundy, rose pink, ivory, and champagne gold. Card 3, “Rose & Elegance”, contains a small rose illustration and a short poetic bridal description. Card 4, “Message from Aki”, contains a short handwritten-style note and signature “Aki Rosenthal”. Footer text centered at the bottom reads “Aki Rosenthal Bridal Collection”.

Visual style: Soft watercolor-anime rendering mixed with polished fashion illustration, ornate Victorian bridal catalog design, warm cream paper, gold typography, muted burgundy roses, blush pink fabric, translucent lace, elegant shadows, high detail, delicate highlights, no harsh contrast.

Constraints: Keep the exact panel count: 1 main illustration, 3 view panels, 6 detail panels, 4 bottom cards, 5 color swatches, and 3 design bullets. Use readable decorative English headings. Avoid logos, watermarks, modern UI elements, or extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Aki Rosenthal"} 创建一个精致的动漫婚纱系列设计项目，呈现为一张优雅的婚纱时尚展示页。

画布：垂直 4:5 海报，暖象牙色羊皮纸背景，带有花卉边角装饰的纤细华丽金边，页面周围散落着柔和的玫瑰花瓣。采用高细节浪漫动漫插画风格，柔和光影，细腻线条，奢华婚纱杂志排版。

页眉：顶部为金色大号衬线字体标题“WEDDING DRESS”，右侧为流动的粉色草书“Collection”。下方添加副标题“- {argument name="character name" default="Aki Rosenthal"} Bridal Style 2024 -”以及一行简短的灰色小字日式装饰标语。

主体：左侧为一张大型全身婚纱插画，描绘了一位长发金发的精灵系动漫新娘，身处玫瑰花园通道中。她穿着浪漫的 {argument name="dress color" default="淡腮红象牙色"} 婚纱，采用露肩紧身胸衣、透明蕾丝袖、层叠不对称荷叶边裙摆、高开叉设计，配有拖地头纱、玫瑰发饰、酒红色玫瑰点缀、丝带、蕾丝刺绣和珠宝细节。她手捧一束由红、粉、象牙色玫瑰组成的花束，系着长长的酒红色丝带。她的头发极长，呈流动的金色，带有柔和的卷曲和花卉配饰。面部应适当简化或轻微遮挡，以保持对婚纱设计的关注。背景：阳光明媚的玫瑰拱门、石子路、漂浮的花瓣、梦幻的虚化效果。

右侧布局：包含 9 个带边框的参考面板，排列成整洁的时尚规格网格。顶行有 3 个高面板，分别标注为“Front”（正面）、“Side”（侧面）和“Back”（背面），展示该婚纱的对应视角。下方有 6 个小细节面板，分别标注为“Bouquet”（花束）、“Rose Motif”（玫瑰图案）、“Bodice”（胸衣）、“Veil & Lace”（头纱与蕾丝）、“Shoes”（鞋子）和“Back Style”（背部款式）。细节面板应展示：1 个花束特写、1 个腰部玫瑰图案与丝带特写、1 个胸衣特写、1 个头纱与蕾丝特写、1 个带玫瑰装饰的蕾丝高跟鞋特写，以及 1 个后背胸衣与大型玫瑰装饰特写。

底部信息区：添加 4 张带金框的奶油色卡片。卡片 1 “Design Point”（设计要点）包含 3 个带小型酒红色玫瑰图标的要点。卡片 2 “Color Palette”（调色板）包含 5 个圆形色样，并用日式小字标注：玫瑰红、酒红、玫瑰粉、象牙白和香槟金。卡片 3 “Rose & Elegance”（玫瑰与优雅）包含一幅小型玫瑰插画和一段简短的诗意婚纱描述。卡片 4 “Message from Aki”（来自 Aki 的寄语）包含一段简短的手写风格笔记和签名“Aki Rosenthal”。底部居中页脚文字为“Aki Rosenthal Bridal Collection”。

视觉风格：柔和的水彩动漫渲染与精致的时尚插画相结合，华丽的维多利亚风格婚纱目录设计，暖奶油色纸张，金色排版，柔和的酒红色玫瑰，腮红粉色面料，半透明蕾丝，优雅的阴影，高细节，细腻的高光，无生硬对比。

约束：保持精确的面板数量：1 个主插画，3 个视图面板，6 个细节面板，4 张底部卡片，5 个色样，以及 3 个设计要点。使用可读的装饰性英文标题。避免使用徽标、水印、现代 UI 元素或多余字符。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dense dark sci-fi character concept sheet for {argument name="character name" default="KAI REN"}, a post-apocalyptic smoke-trace swordsman and tactical team leader, with a gritty AAA game art-book presentation.

Canvas: Portrait-oriented character design board on a weathered gray concrete-paper background, roughly 4:5 aspect ratio. Use charcoal black, gunmetal, ash gray, oxidized brown, and muted steel tones. Add rain, dust, scratches, ink splatter, technical grid lines, thin white divider lines, and small dossier typography.

Main layout: Place one dominant full-body hero illustration on the left, occupying about 45% of the canvas height and most of the left column. The character stands facing forward in a relaxed but dangerous stance, wearing layered black tactical rags, armored leather plates, strapped belts, heavy boots, gloves, scarf, hood-like collar, dangling shredded coat panels, and a bulky cylindrical jetpack or propulsion backpack. Hair is messy black and spiked. The face should be obscured or shadowed. Include a long smoke-trace blade or sheathed weapon integrated into the gear. Behind the hero figure, add a large black circular brushstroke halo.

Left dossier text: At the top left write the name {argument name="character name" default="KAI REN"}. Under it add the role line “TEAM LEADER / SMOKE-TRACE SWORDSMAN”. Include two quotes: {argument name="quote one" default="I read the smoke."} and {argument name="quote two" default="I cut the path."}. Add small dossier fields: Role: Team Leader / Tactician / Pathfinder; Affiliation: No Faction - Slums Coalition; Status: Active; Height: 6'0" / 183 cm; Weight: 72 kg / 159 lbs; Age: 24; Profile: a short paragraph describing him as born in the lower tiers of Yor City, surviving by reading the city’s smoke currents, a fighter and pathfinder who leads with ruthless instinct and unstable loyalty. Add a simple angular faction emblem and signature-like marks below.

Top row body views: Across the upper center and right, include exactly 4 smaller full-body views labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, “BACK”, and “3/4 VIEW”. Show the same outfit from each angle, emphasizing the layered armor, ragged coat strips, backpack tanks, straps, boots, and silhouette.

Middle panels: Create a rectangular “CLOSE-UP PORTRAIT” panel showing the head and upper torso with messy black hair, scarf, armor straps, ear device, and shadowed/obscured face. Next to it create a “SMOKE-TRACE ABILITIES” section with exactly 6 illustrated ability cards in a 2-column by 3-row grid. Label the six cards: “SMOKE SENSE”, “PATH REVEAL”, “AIR SLICE”, “TRACE CUT”, “SMOKE STEP”, and “SMOKE LINE”. Each card should show a small cinematic action scene of the character moving through a dark rainy city or battlefield while luminous white smoke trails, arcs, map-like paths, or slicing lines swirl around him.

Equipment and detail panels: Add exactly 6 outfit and material close-up strips labeled “MAIN FABRIC”, “SCARF ARMOR”, “HARNESS STRAPS”, “JETPACK BACKPLATE”, “UTILITY POUCHES”, and “EDGE STITCHING”. Add a “CYBERNETIC & INTERFACE” panel with exactly 4 close-ups labeled “NECK IMPLANT”, “TEMPORAL NODE”, “HUD PROJECTOR”, and “ARMS IMPLANT”. Add a “FOOTWEAR” panel with exactly 4 boot views labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, “BACK”, and “SOLE”. Add a “JETPACK / PROPULSION PACK” panel showing front and rear technical views with callout labels for compact thrusters, fuel cell, vector nozzles, stabilizer fins, and harness system. Add a “WEAPON: SMOKE-TRACE BLADE” panel showing a modular long blade and exactly 5 separated components labeled “MONO BLADE CUSTOM”, “POWER COIL”, “SCABBARD”, “SMOKE LINE”, and “CORE MODULE”. Add an “ACCESSORIES & GEAR” row with exactly 7 objects labeled “SMOKE BEACON”, “CLIMBING HOOK”, “PULSE DARTS”, “RECON DRONE”, “DATA CHIP”, “SURVIVAL KIT”, and “WATER FILTER”. Add a “SILHOUETTE & MOVEMENT WITH JETPACK” panel containing exactly 4 dynamic flying or leaping silhouettes with smoky trails.

Bottom strip: Include a small “NOTES” box with several concise bullet notes about growing up in the Ash Rungs, survival by reading the wind, weapons hidden in the blade and paracord, valuing freedom and loyalty, and leading with intellect before violence. Include a “COLOR PALETTE” with exactly 8 vertical swatches: near-black, charcoal, dark slate, worn brown, rust leather, pale ash gray, cold gray-blue, and deep navy-black. Include a “MATERIAL / FINISH GUIDE” with exactly 7 texture swatches labeled “BURNT LEATHER”, “OILED CANVAS”, “CARBON TEXTURE”, “METAL WEAR”, “REACTIVE CLOTH”, “REINFORCED COMPOSITE”, and “SMOKE WEAVE”. At bottom right add a “TEAM CONTEXT: THE SMOKE-WALKERS” panel with exactly 3 small standing character figures together.

Visual style: Highly detailed cinematic concept art, dark cyberpunk wasteland fashion, gritty realistic rendering, technical production design sheet, dense but organized annotations, thin white labels, rain-speckled texture, high contrast metal highlights, realistic fabric fraying, heavy boots, straps, buckles, rivets, scratches, and smoky supernatural energy. Keep all text in English, small and diagrammatic, with no logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="KAI REN"} 创建一份高密度的暗黑科幻角色概念项目，他是一位末日后的“烟迹”剑客兼战术小队队长，呈现出硬核 AAA 游戏美术集风格。

画布：纵向角色设计项目，背景为风化的灰色混凝土纸质纹理，长宽比约为 4:5。使用炭黑、枪金属色、灰烬色、氧化棕和哑光钢色调。添加雨水、灰尘、划痕、墨迹飞溅、技术网格线、细白色分割线以及小型档案排版。

主布局：在左侧放置一个占据画布高度约 45% 且位于左栏大部分区域的主体全身英雄插画。角色面向前方，姿势放松但充满危险感，身穿层叠的黑色战术破布、装甲皮革板、束带、厚重靴子、手套、围巾、兜帽式衣领、悬垂的碎裂外套饰片，以及一个笨重的圆柱形喷气背包或推进背包。头发为凌乱的黑色尖刺状。面部应被遮挡或处于阴影中。包含一把长长的烟迹刃或集成在装备中的鞘装武器。在英雄人物后方，添加一个巨大的黑色圆形笔触光环。

左侧档案文字：在左上角写上名字 {argument name="character name" default="KAI REN"}。下方添加角色行“小队队长 / 烟迹剑客”。包含两句引言：{argument name="quote one" default="I read the smoke."} 和 {argument name="quote two" default="I cut the path."}。添加小型档案字段：角色：小队队长 / 战术家 / 探路者；隶属：无派系 - 贫民窟联盟；状态：现役；身高：6'0" / 183 cm；体重：72 kg / 159 lbs；年龄：24；简介：一段简短的段落，描述他出生于 Yor City 的底层，靠解读城市的烟雾流向生存，是一位以冷酷直觉和不稳定忠诚度领导队伍的战士兼探路者。下方添加一个简单的棱角分明的派系徽章和类似签名的标记。

顶部行身体视图：在上方中心和右侧，包含 4 个较小的全身视图，分别标注为“正面”、“侧面”、“背面”和“3/4 视图”。从每个角度展示相同的服装，强调层叠装甲、破烂的外套条纹、背包罐、束带、靴子和轮廓。

中间面板：创建一个矩形的“特写肖像”面板，展示头部和上半身，包括凌乱的黑发、围巾、装甲束带、耳部设备以及被遮挡/阴影覆盖的面部。旁边创建一个“烟迹技能”部分，包含 6 张插图技能卡，排列为 2 列 3 行的网格。标注这 6 张卡片为：“烟雾感知”、“路径揭示”、“空气切割”、“轨迹切割”、“烟雾步”和“烟雾线”。每张卡片应展示一个小型的电影感动作场景，角色在黑暗的雨夜城市或战场中移动，同时发光的白色烟雾轨迹、弧线、地图般的路径或切割线在他周围盘旋。

装备与细节面板：添加 6 个服装和材质特写条，标注为“主要面料”、“围巾装甲”、“背带束带”、“喷气背包背板”、“多功能袋”和“边缘缝合”。添加一个“控制论与接口”面板，包含 4 个特写，标注为“颈部植入物”、“时间节点”、“HUD 投影仪”和“手臂植入物”。添加一个“鞋类”面板，包含 4 个靴子视图，标注为“正面”、“侧面”、“背面”和“鞋底”。添加一个“喷气背包 / 推进背包”面板，展示前后技术视图，并带有紧凑型推进器、燃料电池、矢量喷嘴、稳定鳍和背带系统的标注。添加一个“武器：烟迹刃”面板，展示一把模块化长刃和 5 个分离组件，标注为“单分子刃定制”、“动力线圈”、“刀鞘”、“烟雾线”和“核心模块”。添加一个“配件与装备”行，包含 7 个物体，标注为“烟雾信标”、“攀爬钩”、“脉冲飞镖”、“侦察无人机”、“数据芯片”、“生存套件”和“滤水器”。添加一个“喷气背包轮廓与运动”面板，包含 4 个带有烟雾轨迹的动态飞行或跳跃剪影。

底部条：包含一个小的“备注”框，列出几条关于在 Ash Rungs 成长、通过读风生存、隐藏在刀刃和伞绳中的武器、重视自由与忠诚、以智慧而非暴力领导的简洁要点。包含一个“配色方案”，带有 8 个垂直色块：近黑、炭黑、深板岩色、磨损棕、锈皮色、浅灰烬色、冷灰蓝色和深海军黑。包含一个“材质/表面处理指南”，带有 7 个纹理色块，标注为“烧焦皮革”、“油布”、“碳纤维纹理”、“金属磨损”、“反应性布料”、“增强复合材料”和“烟雾编织”。在右下角添加一个“小队背景：烟雾行者”面板，包含 3 个站立的小型角色人物。

视觉风格：高细节电影感概念艺术，暗黑赛博朋克废土时尚，硬核写实渲染，技术生产设计图，密集但有序的注释，细白色标签，雨点斑驳的纹理，高对比度金属高光，逼真的面料磨损，厚重靴子、束带、扣环、铆钉、划痕和烟雾缭绕的超自然能量。保持所有文字为英文，小巧且具有图表感，不含任何标志或水印。

templates.title: Anime Bridal Dress Collection Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫婚纱系列展示页

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed pastel anime bridal fashion collection sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Akai Haato"}, designed like a luxury wedding dress catalog page.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, soft cream and blush-pink background, ornate gold filigree border, romantic rose garden and arched chapel-window atmosphere, sparkling light, falling petals, delicate lace textures.

Layout: Split the poster into a large full-body feature illustration on the left and a structured specification board on the right. Add a title and branding area across the upper right, a small signature/logo area upper left, detail panels in the middle right, and information boxes along the bottom.

Main subject: On the left, show one full-body anime bride wearing an elaborate white and pale pink wedding dress with strong {argument name="accent color" default="deep rose red"} accents. The character has long blonde hair with pink tips, a flower crown, a translucent veil covered with tiny red bows and heart motifs, a frilly high-low skirt with layered lace, red ribbons, garter details, white platform bridal heels with ankle ribbons, and a large rose bouquet. Pose her standing gracefully with one leg forward, holding the bouquet at waist height. Keep the face area as a plain soft peach blank rectangle with no facial features.

Dress design: The gown is a cute gothic-lolita inspired bridal style: sweetheart bodice, off-shoulder lace sleeves, corset-like red ribbon lacing, many small bows, heart charms, scalloped lace, layered ruffles, asymmetrical high-low hem, long trailing back skirt, and a dramatic veil. The bouquet contains red roses, cream roses, blush roses, small greenery, and trailing burgundy ribbons.

Right-side detail panels: Include exactly 9 framed detail panels arranged as a 3-by-3 grid beneath the title. Label them in English with small hearts: 1) FRONT, showing the full dress from the front; 2) SIDE, showing the side silhouette and train; 3) BACK, showing the long veil, back bow, and trailing skirt; 4) BOUQUET, close-up of the rose bouquet; 5) BODICE, close-up of the corset bodice, lace, and red bow; 6) VEIL & RIBBONS, close-up of translucent veil fabric with red bows and heart decorations; 7) SHOES, close-up of white platform heels with red ribbon anklets; 8) HEART MOTIF, close-up of heart charm, lace, pearls, and bow; 9) BACK STYLE, close-up of the large back bow and layered rear skirt.

Top text content: Large elegant serif headline reading "WEDDING DRESS" with a cursive subtitle "Collection". Under it, place a ribbon banner reading "{argument name="collection banner" default="Akai Haato Bridal Style 2024"}" with heart icons on both ends. Add a short small Japanese-style romantic tagline beneath it, rendered decoratively and not overly legible.

Left branding text: In the upper left, write "Akai Haato" in pink cursive script with a small heart.

Bottom sections: Include exactly 3 bottom information areas. Left: a framed "DESIGN POINT" box with five short bullet lines and heart bullets, describing lace, heart motifs, ribbon bows, high-low skirt, and princess-like sweetness. Center: a "COLOR PALETTE" box with exactly 5 heart-shaped swatches labeled Pure White, Bride Red, Baby Pink, Rose Pink, and Antique Rose. Right: a romantic signature area reading "With Love," above a large cursive "Akai Haato", plus a small wax seal and ribbon emblem in the lower right.

Visual style: Premium anime illustration, Japanese idol character sheet, romantic bridal catalog, soft watercolor lighting, crisp ornate UI frames, pink and ivory palette, gold ornamental accents, floral border details, delicate lace rendering, glossy magazine-quality finish.

Constraints: Use English for all main headings and labels. Keep the poster information-dense but elegant. Use exactly one main full-body bride, exactly 9 right-side detail panels, exactly 3 bottom information areas, and exactly 5 color swatches. Avoid photorealism, avoid modern minimalist design, and do not add extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Akai Haato"} 创作一张高度精细的淡彩动漫婚纱系列展示页，设计风格参考奢华婚纱目录页面。

画布：竖向海报，3:4 比例，柔和的奶油色与淡粉色背景，华丽的金色花丝边框，营造浪漫玫瑰花园与拱形教堂窗户的氛围，点缀闪烁光芒、飘落花瓣及精致蕾丝纹理。

布局：将海报分为左侧的大型全身主插画和右侧的结构化规格项目。在右上角添加标题和品牌区域，左上角设置小型签名/Logo 区域，右侧中部放置细节面板，底部排列信息框。

主体：左侧展示一位全身动漫新娘，身穿精致的白色与淡粉色婚纱，带有强烈的 {argument name="accent color" default="深玫瑰红"} 点缀。角色拥有粉色挑染的长金发，佩戴花冠，披着覆盖着细小红蝴蝶结和心形图案的半透明头纱，穿着层叠蕾丝的荷叶边高低裙，搭配红丝带、吊袜带细节、系带白色厚底婚纱高跟鞋，手持大型玫瑰花束。姿势为优雅站立，一腿前伸，花束置于腰间。面部区域保持为平滑的浅桃色空白矩形，不含五官。

婚纱设计：礼服采用可爱的哥特萝莉风格婚纱：心形领口、露肩蕾丝袖、类似紧身胸衣的红丝带系带、大量小蝴蝶结、心形吊坠、扇形蕾丝、层叠荷叶边、不对称高低裙摆、长拖尾后裙及戏剧性的头纱。花束包含红玫瑰、奶油色玫瑰、淡粉色玫瑰、少量绿植及垂坠的酒红色丝带。

右侧细节面板：在标题下方包含 9 个框架细节面板，排列为 3x3 网格。使用英文标注并配以小爱心：1) FRONT，展示婚纱正面全貌；2) SIDE，展示侧面轮廓与拖尾；3) BACK，展示长头纱、后背蝴蝶结及拖尾裙摆；4) BOUQUET，玫瑰花束特写；5) BODICE，紧身胸衣、蕾丝及红蝴蝶结特写；6) VEIL & RIBBONS，带有红蝴蝶结和心形装饰的半透明头纱面料特写；7) SHOES，系带红丝带的白色厚底高跟鞋特写；8) HEART MOTIF，心形吊坠、蕾丝、珍珠及蝴蝶结特写；9) BACK STYLE，大型后背蝴蝶结及层叠后裙特写。

顶部文字内容：大型优雅衬线标题“WEDDING DRESS”，配以草书副标题“Collection”。下方放置一条丝带横幅，写有“{argument name="collection banner" default="Akai Haato Bridal Style 2024"}”，两端带有心形图标。下方添加一行简短的日式浪漫标语，以装饰性字体呈现，无需过于清晰。

左侧品牌文字：在左上角用粉色草书书写“Akai Haato”，并配以一颗小爱心。

底部区域：包含 3 个底部信息区。左侧：一个带边框的“DESIGN POINT”框，包含五行短句及心形项目符号，描述蕾丝、心形图案、丝带蝴蝶结、高低裙摆及公主般的甜美感。中央：一个“COLOR PALETTE”框，包含 5 个心形色块，分别标注为 Pure White、Bride Red、Baby Pink、Rose Pink 和 Antique Rose。右侧：浪漫签名区，写有“With Love,”，下方为大型草书“Akai Haato”，右下角配有小型火漆印章和丝带徽章。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画、日系偶像角色项目、浪漫婚纱目录、柔和水彩光影、清晰华丽的 UI 边框、粉色与象牙色调、金色装饰点缀、花卉边框细节、精致蕾丝渲染、光泽感杂志品质。

约束：所有主标题和标签使用英文。海报信息量大但保持优雅。必须包含 1 个全身新娘主体、9 个右侧细节面板、3 个底部信息区及 5 个颜色色块。避免写实风格，避免现代极简设计，且不得添加额外角色。

templates.title: Crystal-Smoke Architect Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Crystal-Smoke Architect 角色设定表

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a gritty sci-fi character design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="NOA VALE"}, a team leader and crystal-smoke architect in a post-apocalyptic tactical faction. The sheet should look like a high-end concept art board for a film or game trailer, with dense technical callouts, worn paper texture, and dark industrial fantasy styling.

Canvas: Vertical 4:3 character sheet, weathered gray parchment background with black smoke, ink splatter edges, thin white grid lines, and small technical typography. Overall palette is charcoal black, gunmetal, tarnished bronze, bone gray, smoky white, and cold blue light accents.

Main character: A tall athletic female warrior, age 23, with short messy black hair shaved on one side, cyberpunk undercut silhouette, face deliberately obscured by a soft rectangular blur/censor block. She wears an asymmetrical black leather and metal tactical outfit: cropped armored top, exposed midriff with straps and buckles, fitted pants, high-heeled armored combat boots, layered belts, chain details, fingerless gloves, segmented arm armor, spiked shoulder pieces, and a long shredded black coat or cloak made of dangling strips. A heavy mechanical jetpack / crystal-smoke apparatus is mounted on her back, with small blue exhaust glow. Pose is confident, standing slightly turned with one hand relaxed and the other near her weapon.

Left information column: Large title text “{argument name="character name" default="NOA VALE"}”. Subtitle: “TEAM LEADER // CRYSTAL-SMOKE ARCHITECT”. Quote: “{argument name="quote" default="I don’t break the city. I give it shape."}”. Include labeled data blocks: Role: “CRYSTAL-SMOKE ARCHITECT / OFFENSIVE TACTICIAN”; Affiliation: “NO FACTION — SLUMS COALITION”; Status: “ACTIVE”; Height: “5’6” / 168 cm”; Weight: “121 lb / 55 kg”; Age: “23”; a compact biography paragraph; a sharp abstract faction emblem; a handwritten signature; and two vertical red stamp-like marks.

Layout and counted elements: Include exactly 5 full-body views across the upper half: 1 large hero full-body view on the left, plus 4 smaller orthographic views across the top labeled Front, Side, Back, and 3/4 View. Include exactly 1 close-up portrait panel beneath the orthographic row, again with the face obscured by a rectangular blur. Include exactly 4 crystal-smoke ability panels in a 2x2 grid labeled Barrier Wall, Lattice Cage, Elevated Path, and Deflector Array, each showing a tiny black silhouette interacting with luminous white crystalline wireframe structures and smoky particles.

Lower technical panels: Include exactly 4 footwear views labeled Front, Side, Back, and Sole, showing the same armored high-heeled boot. Include exactly 1 long weapon panel labeled “WEAPON: CRYSTAL-WRITE KIT”, showing a modular staff/rifle-like implement with two modes. Include exactly 6 weapon breakdown components labeled Frame Rail, Energy Conduit, Crystal Cartridge, Stabilizer Fin, Grip Module, and Safety Latch. Include exactly 7 accessories and gear items labeled Crystal Chamber, Smoke Filter, Utility Pouch, Data Slate, Line Spool, Folding Hook, and Scrap Key. Include exactly 5 jetpack / propulsion system detail panels labeled Jetpack Overview, Thruster Detail, Harness & Attachment, Fuel Cell, and Vector Nozzles.

Outfit and material detail strip: Add close-up panels of layered leather straps, buckles, metal plating, cybernetic ear implant, neck/shoulder armor, wrist projector, and mechanical gauntlet. Make the materials visibly worn, scratched, riveted, oily, and handmade rather than clean futuristic.

Bottom reference strip: Include a notes box with short bullet-like production notes; a color palette containing exactly 8 vertical swatches from black to graphite, brown leather, gray metal, parchment beige, smoky white, and pale blue; a material / finish guide containing exactly 6 rectangular samples labeled Worn Leather, Oiled Canvas, Carbon Fiber, Scratched Metal, Crystal Glass, and Mesh Fabric; and a team context panel on the bottom right showing exactly 3 small figures walking together through a ruined vertical cityscape.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed dark cinematic concept art, realistic anatomy, tactical cyberpunk, post-apocalyptic fashion design, precise industrial callouts, Japanese game artbook layout energy, monochrome smoky atmosphere with icy blue glow accents. Text should be small but arranged like a professional production design sheet. No clean white background, no cute style, no bright saturated colors, no extra characters beyond the counted team context silhouettes.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="NOA VALE"} 创建一张硬核科幻角色设计表，她是末日战术阵营中的团队领袖及 Crystal-Smoke Architect。该设定表应呈现出电影或游戏预告片的高端概念艺术项目风格，包含密集的技术标注、磨损的纸张纹理以及暗黑工业幻想风格。

画布：竖向 4:3 角色设定表，背景为带有黑色烟雾的风化灰色羊皮纸，边缘有墨迹飞溅，配有细白网格线和小型技术排版。整体色调为炭黑、枪金属色、锈铜色、骨灰色、烟白色以及冷蓝色光效。

主角：一名 23 岁的高挑运动型女性战士，留着一头凌乱的黑色短发，一侧剃光，呈现赛博朋克式铲青发型，面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡。她身穿不对称的黑色皮革与金属战术套装：露脐装甲上衣、带有绑带和扣环的露腰设计、修身长裤、高跟装甲作战靴、多层腰带、链条细节、露指手套、分段式手臂护甲、尖刺肩甲，以及一件由垂坠布条组成的长款破损黑色外套或斗篷。背部安装有一个重型机械喷气背包 / Crystal-Smoke 装置，带有微弱的蓝色排气光效。姿势自信，身体略微侧转，一只手自然放松，另一只手靠近武器。

左侧信息栏：大标题文字 “{argument name="character name" default="NOA VALE"}”。副标题：“TEAM LEADER // CRYSTAL-SMOKE ARCHITECT”。引言：“{argument name="quote" default="I don’t break the city. I give it shape."}”。包含标注数据块：角色：“CRYSTAL-SMOKE ARCHITECT / OFFENSIVE TACTICIAN”；所属：“NO FACTION — SLUMS COALITION”；状态：“ACTIVE”；身高：“5’6” / 168 cm”；体重：“121 lb / 55 kg”；年龄：“23”；一段紧凑的个人简介；一个锐利的抽象阵营徽章；一个手写签名；以及两个垂直的红色印章式标记。

布局与计数元素：上半部分包含 5 个全身视图：左侧 1 个大型英雄全身视图，顶部 4 个较小的正投影视图，分别标注为 Front（正面）、Side（侧面）、Back（背面）和 3/4 View（四分之三侧面）。在正投影行下方包含 1 个特写肖像面板，面部同样被矩形模糊遮挡。包含 4 个 Crystal-Smoke 技能面板，以 2x2 网格排列，分别标注为 Barrier Wall、Lattice Cage、Elevated Path 和 Deflector Array，每个面板展示一个微小的黑色剪影与发光的白色晶体线框结构及烟雾粒子交互。

底部技术面板：包含 4 个鞋类视图，标注为 Front、Side、Back 和 Sole，展示同一款装甲高跟靴。包含 1 个长条形武器面板，标注为 “WEAPON: CRYSTAL-WRITE KIT”，展示一种具有两种模式的模块化法杖/步枪类工具。包含 6 个武器分解组件，标注为 Frame Rail、Energy Conduit、Crystal Cartridge、Stabilizer Fin、Grip Module 和 Safety Latch。包含 7 个配件和装备物品，标注为 Crystal Chamber、Smoke Filter、Utility Pouch、Data Slate、Line Spool、Folding Hook 和 Scrap Key。包含 5 个喷气背包 / 推进系统细节面板，标注为 Jetpack Overview、Thruster Detail、Harness & Attachment、Fuel Cell 和 Vector Nozzles。

服装与材质细节条：添加多层皮带、扣环、金属板、赛博格耳部植入物、颈/肩护甲、腕部投影仪和机械护手特写面板。材质应呈现明显的磨损、划痕、铆钉、油渍和手工感，而非整洁的未来主义风格。

底部参考条：包含一个带有简短项目说明的备注框；一个包含 8 个垂直色块的色板，从黑色到石墨色、棕色皮革、灰色金属、羊皮纸米色、烟白色和淡蓝色；一个包含 6 个矩形样本的材质/饰面指南，标注为 Worn Leather、Oiled Canvas、Carbon Fiber、Scratched Metal、Crystal Glass 和 Mesh Fabric；以及右下角的一个团队背景面板，展示 3 个小人物正走在废墟林立的垂直城市景观中。

视觉风格：超精细暗黑电影概念艺术，写实人体结构，战术赛博朋克，末日时尚设计，精确的工业标注，日本游戏画册布局风格，单色烟雾氛围配以冰蓝色光效。文字应精简，并像专业项目设计表一样排列。无纯白背景，无可爱风格，无高饱和度色彩，除计数的团队背景剪影外，不包含额外角色。

templates.title: Crowded Crab Beach Laptop Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 海滩螃蟹聚集的笔记本电脑场景

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, slightly unsettling beach photograph in late-afternoon natural light: a blue-green and white striped towel lies on rippled golden sand, with a closed matte black laptop or tablet centered on the towel at a slight diagonal angle. The device has rounded corners, is dusted with sand grains, and has a small cute car sticker in the center of the lid. A dark black garment or towel is bunched on the right edge. Populate the scene with exactly 38 tiny beach creatures crawling over and around the device and towel: 24 pale sand crabs with long thin legs scattered across the towel, laptop lid, and nearby sand, and 14 hermit crabs with varied spiral shells clustered mostly along the lower and right edges of the device. Make the creatures numerous and busy, with some on top of the laptop, some partially under its edges, and some crossing the striped fabric. Use {argument name="creature count" default="38"} visible animals, {argument name="main object" default="closed matte black laptop with a cute car sticker"}, {argument name="beach textile" default="blue-green and white striped towel"}, {argument name="lighting" default="warm low-angle late-afternoon sunlight"}, and {argument name="mood" default="realistic, crowded, slightly creepy but natural beach snapshot"}. Shoot from a low oblique overhead angle, wide horizontal composition, shallow but not extreme depth of field, high detail in sand texture, fabric weave, shadows, crab legs, and shells. No humans, no text overlay, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实且略带不安感的沙滩摄影作品，采用午后自然光：一条蓝绿色与白色相间的条纹毛巾铺在起伏的金色沙滩上，一台闭合的哑光黑色笔记本电脑或平板电脑以轻微的对角线角度放置在毛巾中央。设备边缘圆润，表面覆盖着沙粒，盖子中央贴着一张可爱的小汽车贴纸。右侧边缘堆放着一件深黑色衣物或毛巾。场景中需精确分布 38 只小型海滩生物，它们在设备和毛巾上爬行：24 只长着细长腿的浅色沙蟹分散在毛巾、笔记本电脑盖和附近的沙滩上，14 只背着各种螺旋贝壳的寄居蟹主要聚集在设备的下缘和右缘。让这些生物显得数量众多且忙碌，有的在笔记本电脑上方，有的部分位于边缘下方，有的正在穿过条纹织物。使用 {argument name="creature count" default="38"} 只可见动物，{argument name="main object" default="带有可爱小汽车贴纸的闭合哑光黑色笔记本电脑"}，{argument name="beach textile" default="蓝绿色与白色相间的条纹毛巾"}，{argument name="lighting" default="温暖的午后低角度阳光"}，以及 {argument name="mood" default="写实、拥挤、略带诡异但自然的沙滩快照"}。采用低位斜俯视角拍摄，宽幅水平构图，浅景深但不过度，展现沙滩纹理、织物纹路、阴影、蟹腿和贝壳的高细节。无人物，无文字叠加，无水印。

templates.title: Jin Crow Sci-Fi Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Jin Crow 科幻角色设定表

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark sci-fi character design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="JIN CROW"}, a heavily armored echo-smoke disruptor / reconnaissance specialist in a grimy post-apocalyptic military universe.

Canvas: Portrait-oriented concept art board, 4:5 aspect ratio, distressed concrete-gray background with black ink splatter edges, technical dossier layout, small white condensed uppercase typography, thin grid lines, weathered print texture.

Main subject: A towering male-presenting armored operative with an obscured/blurred face, messy dark hair, bulky layered black tactical armor, shredded cloak strips, heavy boots, many straps, buckles, pouches, cables, metal plates, red accent tabs, and a rugged jetpack/propulsion pack. The armor should look scorched, scratched, oily, rain-wet, and battle-worn. Use a palette of charcoal black, gunmetal, dirty gray, worn leather, muted beige, and small dark red details. The mood is intimidating, cinematic, industrial, and tactical.

Layout: Left third contains a large full-body front hero render of the operative, standing with wide heavy stance and arms relaxed. Above/alongside it place a dossier text column. Top right contains exactly 4 full-body view turnarounds labeled front, side, back, and 3/4 view. Middle right contains a close-up portrait and ability panels. Bottom and lower-middle contain equipment callouts, movement poses, palette, material guide, notes, and a team-context vignette.

Visible text and dossier content: Large title text "JIN CROW" at top left. Subtitle: "TEAM LEADER / ECHO-SMOKE DISRUPTOR". Include the quote: {argument name="quote" default="I listen to the city. Then I make it speak back."}. Add small dossier fields for role, affiliation, status, height, weight, age, and profile. Use tiny readable-but-secondary lore text, not too much. Add an emblem and signature-like mark near the left column, plus a small vertical seal mark near the bottom left.

Counted elements to include: exactly 1 large front hero character on the left; exactly 4 full-body turnaround figures across the top right labeled front, side, back, and 3/4 view; exactly 1 close-up portrait panel; exactly 6 echo-smoke ability panels labeled Sonar Pulse, False Footsteps, Shockwave Burst, Signal Jammer, Echo Link, and Sound Blade; exactly 4 cybernetic/interface ear-detail panels; exactly 4 footwear views labeled front, side, back, and sole; exactly 4 jetpack/propulsion pack views labeled front, side, back, and 3/4 view; exactly 4 secondary tool drawings labeled Sound Dagger, Vibro Signal Launcher, Smoke Canister, and Signal Grenade; exactly 2 primary tool probe-rod drawings, one extended full rod and one larger modular detail; exactly 4 silhouette/movement action poses; exactly 7 color swatches; exactly 6 material/finish swatches; exactly 1 team-context vignette showing 3 armored squad members.

Panel details: The 6 ability panels should show monochrome tactical visualizations of smoke, sound waves, sonar rings, red glitch traces, distorted footsteps, and a figure moving through mist. The cybernetic/interface panels should be cropped ear implants and small in-ear devices. The footwear panel should show chunky armored boots with tread sole. The jetpack panel should show a rectangular worn propulsion pack with twin cylindrical tanks. The secondary tools should be compact high-tech devices with red accents. The primary tool should be a long collapsible echo probe rod with antenna-like tips and mechanical segments. The movement poses should show the operative sprinting, crouching, sliding, and lunging through smoke trails.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed AAA video game concept art, realistic digital painting, technical character sheet, high micro-detail, gritty noir lighting, desaturated colors, wet asphalt reflections, military-industrial design, sci-fi cyberpunk survival gear, dramatic smoky atmosphere. Keep the face deliberately anonymized as a soft dark blur rather than a detailed portrait.

Customization: The operative’s armor color emphasis should be {argument name="armor color emphasis" default="blackened gunmetal with muted red accents"}; the faction label should be {argument name="faction label" default="SLUMS COALITION"}; the background mood should be {argument name="background mood" default="rainy concrete dossier board with black smoke splatter"}.

Constraints: Keep the image as a single dense character-sheet page, not separate images. Preserve all counted element quantities exactly. Avoid bright heroic colors, clean futuristic white armor, cartoon style, anime style, extra characters outside the team vignette, or large readable paragraphs that overpower the art.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="JIN CROW"} 创建一张暗黑科幻角色设计表。该角色是一名身着重甲的“回声烟雾”干扰者兼侦察专家，背景设定在肮脏的后启示录军事世界中。

画布：纵向概念艺术项目，4:5 比例，背景为做旧的混凝土灰色，边缘带有黑色墨迹飞溅，采用技术档案布局，使用小型白色压缩大写字体，配有细网格线和风化印刷质感。

主体：一名身材高大的男性化装甲特工，面部模糊不清，留着凌乱的深色头发，身穿厚重的分层黑色战术盔甲，带有破碎的斗篷条、重型靴子、大量绑带、扣环、小袋、电缆、金属板、红色装饰条以及粗犷的喷气背包/推进器。盔甲应呈现出烧焦、划痕、油渍、雨水浸湿和久经沙场的质感。色调采用炭黑、枪灰色、脏灰色、磨损皮革、柔和米色以及少量深红色细节。氛围阴森、电影感强、工业化且充满战术气息。

布局：左侧三分之一处包含一张大型全身正面英雄渲染图，特工站姿宽大沉稳，双臂放松。上方或侧面放置档案文字栏。右上角包含 4 个全身多角度视图，分别标注为正面、侧面、背面和 3/4 视角。中右侧包含特写肖像和技能面板。底部和中下部包含装备标注、动作姿态、色板、材质指南、注释以及团队背景小插图。

可见文字与档案内容：左上角大标题文字“JIN CROW”。副标题：“TEAM LEADER / ECHO-SMOKE DISRUPTOR”。包含引言：{argument name="quote" default="I listen to the city. Then I make it speak back."}。添加小型档案字段，包括角色、所属阵营、状态、身高、体重、年龄和个人资料。使用微小但可读的次要背景文字，不宜过多。在左侧栏附近添加一个徽章和类似签名的标记，左下角附近添加一个小型的垂直印章。

包含元素计数：左侧 1 个大型正面英雄角色；右上角 4 个全身多角度视图，标注为正面、侧面、背面和 3/4 视角；1 个特写肖像面板；6 个“回声烟雾”技能面板，分别标注为 Sonar Pulse（声纳脉冲）、False Footsteps（虚假脚步）、Shockwave Burst（冲击波爆发）、Signal Jammer（信号干扰器）、Echo Link（回声链接）和 Sound Blade（声波刃）；4 个控制论/接口耳部细节面板；4 个鞋类视图，标注为正面、侧面、背面和鞋底；4 个喷气背包/推进器视图，标注为正面、侧面、背面和 3/4 视角；4 个辅助工具图纸，标注为 Sound Dagger（声波匕首）、Vibro Signal Launcher（振动信号发射器）、Smoke Canister（烟雾罐）和 Signal Grenade（信号手雷）；2 个主要工具探测杆图纸，一个为完全展开的长杆，另一个为更大的模块化细节图；4 个剪影/动作姿态；7 个色块；6 个材质/饰面色块；1 个展示 3 名装甲小队成员的团队背景小插图。

面板细节：6 个技能面板应展示单色战术可视化效果，包括烟雾、声波、声纳环、红色故障痕迹、扭曲的脚步和穿过迷雾的身影。控制论/接口面板应为裁剪后的耳部植入物和小型入耳式设备。鞋类面板应展示带有防滑底的厚重装甲靴。喷气背包面板应展示一个矩形磨损的推进器，带有两个圆柱形罐体。辅助工具应为带有红色装饰的小型高科技设备。主要工具应为长型可折叠回声探测杆，带有类似天线的尖端和机械节段。动作姿态应展示特工在烟雾轨迹中冲刺、蹲伏、滑行和突进。

视觉风格：超精细 AAA 级电子游戏概念艺术，写实数字绘画，技术角色设定表，高微观细节，硬核黑色电影照明，低饱和度色彩，湿沥青反射，军事工业设计，科幻赛博朋克生存装备，戏剧性的烟雾氛围。面部刻意模糊处理为柔和的暗影，而非精细的肖像。

自定义：特工盔甲的颜色重点应为 {argument name="armor color emphasis" default="blackened gunmetal with muted red accents"}；阵营标签应为 {argument name="faction label" default="SLUMS COALITION"}；背景氛围应为 {argument name="background mood" default="rainy concrete dossier board with black smoke splatter"}。

约束：保持图像为单张紧凑的角色设定表，不要拆分为多张图片。严格遵守所有元素的计数要求。避免使用明亮的英雄色彩、干净的未来派白色盔甲、卡通风格、动漫风格、团队小插图之外的额外角色，或压过艺术表现的大段可读文字。

templates.title: Two-Panel Puppy Keyboard Manga

titleLocalized.zh: 双格小狗键盘漫画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a black-and-white manga page with exactly 2 stacked panels showing a cute small dog discovering a computer keyboard and reacting with excitement.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, portrait orientation, two equal horizontal panels separated by a thick black gutter, clean black border around each panel, grayscale screentone shading, hand-inked line art, polished modern manga style.

Main character: A small, adorable puppy with floppy ears, large sparkling eyes, a white stripe down the face, darker patches on the head and body, a fluffy raised tail, and a collar with a round ring tag. The dog is seated at a desk in an office chair, facing a desktop computer. Use {argument name="dog breed style" default="cute mixed-breed puppy resembling a Jack Russell terrier"}.

Panel 1: The dog sits behind a wooden desk, looking surprised and curious at a large desktop monitor on the left. A keyboard lies in front of the dog. The dog’s mouth is slightly open, eyes wide, with exactly 3 surprise marks above its head. Background: a cozy home office with a window and curtains on the far left, a framed landscape picture on the wall, a small potted plant on a cabinet, and bookshelves on the right. Include one vertical oval speech bubble on the right side containing the Japanese text {argument name="first speech bubble" default="これは何?"}. Mood: confused curiosity.

Panel 2: Same dog, same desk and computer setup, now leaning forward happily and pressing the keyboard with one front paw. The dog smiles broadly with tongue visible, eyes shining, tail lifted. Add dynamic radial speed lines in the background and sparkling effects around the keyboard. Include exactly 8 sparkle effects around the dog and keyboard area. Include one vertical oval speech bubble on the left side containing the Japanese text {argument name="second speech bubble" default="ピカピカだ!"}. Mood: delighted discovery.

Objects and counts: Exactly 2 manga panels; exactly 1 dog appearing in both panels; exactly 1 desktop monitor; exactly 1 keyboard; exactly 1 office chair; exactly 2 speech bubbles total; exactly 3 surprise marks in panel 1; exactly 8 sparkle effects in panel 2; visible background items include 1 window, 1 framed picture, 1 potted plant, and 2 bookshelves or bookcase areas.

Visual style: Monochrome Japanese manga, expressive cute animal character, detailed fur texture, screentone gradients, crisp ink outlines, dramatic but family-friendly expressions, clean readable composition. Keep the speech bubbles vertical and the Japanese text hand-lettered in black. No color, no watermark, no extra panels, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页黑白漫画，包含 2 个上下排列的画格，展示一只可爱的小狗发现电脑键盘并兴奋反应的过程。

画布：垂直漫画页面，纵向构图，两个等大的水平画格，中间由粗黑线分隔，每个画格周围有清晰的黑色边框，采用灰度网点阴影，手绘墨线风格，精致的现代漫画风格。

主角：一只可爱的小狗，垂耳，大眼睛闪闪发光，脸部有白色条纹，头部和身体有深色斑块，尾巴蓬松上翘，戴着带有圆形吊牌的项圈。小狗坐在办公椅上，面对着台式电脑。使用 {argument name="dog breed style" default="类似杰克罗素梗的可爱混血小狗"}。

画格 1：小狗坐在木质书桌后，惊讶且好奇地看着左侧的大型台式显示器。键盘放在小狗面前。小狗嘴巴微张，眼睛睁大，头顶上方有 3 个惊讶符号。背景：舒适的家庭办公室，最左侧有窗户和窗帘，墙上挂着风景画，柜子上有一盆小盆栽，右侧有书架。在右侧包含一个垂直椭圆形的对话气泡，内含日语文本 {argument name="first speech bubble" default="これは何?"}。氛围：困惑的好奇心。

画格 2：同样的小狗、书桌和电脑设置，现在它开心地向前倾，用一只前爪按压键盘。小狗咧嘴大笑，舌头可见，眼睛闪闪发光，尾巴翘起。在背景中添加动态放射状速度线，并在键盘周围添加闪光效果。在小狗和键盘区域周围包含 8 个闪光效果。在左侧包含一个垂直椭圆形的对话气泡，内含日语文本 {argument name="second speech bubble" default="ピカピカだ!"}。氛围：惊喜的发现。

物体与数量：共 2 个漫画格；1 只小狗出现在两个画格中；1 台台式显示器；1 个键盘；1 把办公椅；总共 2 个对话气泡；画格 1 中有 3 个惊讶符号；画格 2 中有 8 个闪光效果；可见的背景物品包括 1 扇窗户、1 幅装裱画、1 盆盆栽和 2 个书架区域。

视觉风格：单色日本漫画，表情生动的可爱动物角色，细腻的毛发纹理，网点渐变，清晰的墨线轮廓，戏剧性但适合全家观看的表情，构图清晰易读。保持对话气泡垂直，日语文本为黑色手写体。无颜色，无水印，无额外画格，无额外角色。

templates.title: Frogs on a Laptop in Wild Grass

titleLocalized.zh: 野草丛中笔记本电脑上的青蛙

templates.prompt: Create a realistic documentary-style outdoor photograph of a partially open {argument name="device" default="silver laptop"} resting on a rough concrete curb beside dense wild grass. The laptop is open only a few inches like a shelter, with a dark shadowed gap between the lid and base, and a small cute {argument name="sticker design" default="smiling flower sticker"} centered on the top lid. Show exactly 6 small green tree frogs: 4 frogs perched on the upper lid, including one near the left edge facing left, one near the back center facing left, one near the right-center facing left, and one on the far right edge facing left; 2 frogs on or under the lower half, including one crouched in the dark gap near the left side and one sitting on the front lower edge near the center facing right. Surround the scene with tall tangled green weeds, thin stems, and small white daisy-like wildflowers, with a dry brown leaf on the right and a dark vertical object barely visible at the far left edge. Use muted natural colors, overcast soft light, shallow depth of field, realistic textures on the mossy stained curb, and a slightly eerie “many tiny animals gathered around an abandoned object” mood. Horizontal 16:9 composition, low eye-level angle, no people, no added text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的纪录片风格户外照片，展示一台半开的 {argument name="device" default="银色笔记本电脑"} 放置在茂密野草旁粗糙的混凝土路缘石上。笔记本电脑仅打开了几英寸，像是一个遮蔽所，盖子和底座之间留有一道阴影缝隙，顶盖中央贴着一个可爱的小 {argument name="sticker design" default="笑脸花朵贴纸"}。画面中需精确展示 6 只小绿树蛙：4 只青蛙栖息在上盖，包括一只在左边缘面向左侧、一只在后方中央面向左侧、一只在右侧中央面向左侧，以及一只在最右边缘面向左侧；2 只青蛙在下半部分或下方，包括一只蜷缩在左侧阴影缝隙中，另一只坐在前方下边缘中央面向右侧。场景周围环绕着高大杂乱的绿色杂草、细长的茎秆和白色小雏菊状野花，右侧有一片干枯的棕色叶子，最左侧边缘隐约可见一个垂直的深色物体。使用柔和的自然色彩、阴天柔光、浅景深，呈现出长满青苔的污渍路缘石的真实质感，营造出一种“许多小动物聚集在废弃物体周围”的略带诡异的氛围。横向 16:9 构图，低平视角度，无人像，无添加文字，无水印。

templates.title: Censored Fukusuke Doll Halftone Art

titleLocalized.zh: 经过审查的福助人偶半色调艺术

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution vertical art print on a clean white background, centered on a glossy traditional Japanese Fukusuke lucky doll in a formal kneeling bow pose with both hands placed on the floor in front. The doll wears an ornate dark navy and black kimono with vivid embroidered floral and phoenix-like motifs, bright royal-blue dotted collar panels, red and white trim, green inner lining, and small white plum-blossom family crests on both sleeves. The head has a shaved turquoise-blue crown with black side hair and a small black topknot, but the face is deliberately hidden by one large opaque rectangular censor block filled with a soft vertical gradient from pale blue at the top through beige to muted mauve at the bottom. Behind the figure, add a dramatic symmetrical optical halftone aura made of dense black dotted contour waves, with subtle cyan, magenta, yellow, and green chromatic offset glitches tracing the silhouette and radiating outward like a digital vibration field. Use hyper-detailed glossy ceramic/plastic texture, sharp studio lighting, saturated colors, crisp edges, and a surreal contemporary AI-art aesthetic. Include exactly one main doll, one censor rectangle, two visible hands, two visible ears, two sleeve crests, and one small bottom-right artist signature area with the date {argument name="date text" default="May 14, 2026"} above a loose cursive signature {argument name="artist signature" default="Oyagi"}. The main subject should resemble {argument name="character type" default="a traditional Japanese Fukusuke lucky doll"}; keep the face completely obscured by the rectangle, with no readable facial features visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高分辨率的竖版艺术打印图，背景为干净的白色，主体为居中的光泽感传统日本福助招福人偶，呈现正式的跪拜姿势，双手平放在身前地板上。人偶身穿华丽的深海军蓝与黑色和服，饰有生动的刺绣花卉和凤凰图案，领口为明亮的宝蓝色圆点拼接，配有红白镶边、绿色内衬，双袖上印有白色小梅花家纹。人偶头部为青绿色剃发造型，两侧为黑色头发，顶部有一个黑色小发髻，但面部被一个大的不透明矩形审查块刻意遮挡，审查块内部填充有从顶部淡蓝色经米色到底部柔和紫红色的垂直渐变。在人偶后方，添加一个由密集黑色点状轮廓波纹组成的戏剧性对称光学半色调光环，并带有微妙的青色、品红色、黄色和绿色色差故障效果，勾勒出轮廓并像数字振动场一样向外辐射。使用超精细的陶瓷/塑料光泽质感、锐利的摄影棚灯光、饱和的色彩、清晰的边缘以及超现实的当代 AI 艺术美学。画面中必须包含一个主体人偶、一个审查矩形、两只可见的手、两只可见的耳朵、两个袖口家纹，以及右下角的一个小型艺术家签名区，日期为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 14 日"}，上方为潦草的草书签名 {argument name="artist signature" default="Oyagi"}。主体应类似于 {argument name="character type" default="传统的日本福助招福人偶"}；请确保面部完全被矩形遮挡，不可见任何可辨认的面部特征。

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the sole source image, transform the scene into a loose pen-and-watercolor illustration on white textured paper. promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为唯一源图像，将场景转换为白色纹理纸上的写意钢笔淡彩插画。保留原始姿势、构图、西装、领带以及美国国旗的位置，包括遮挡面部的矩形。移除摄影舞台/背景，并将其替换为素雅的米白色纸张。以富有表现力的黑色墨水线条、粗犷的交叉排线、不均匀的手绘轮廓、可见的水彩渲染、柔和的色彩晕染、柔和的藏青色/红色调以及略显未完成的边缘来呈现主体。保持构图接近原始的中景，且不要添加任何新物体、文字或背景细节。

templates.title: Japanese Salaryman Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 日本上班族角色设定图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean anime-style male character design sheet for a modern Japanese office worker, with the character's face intentionally obscured by a soft square blur in every portrait.

Canvas: Wide horizontal character-reference sheet on a white background, approximately 16:9. Use thin black divider lines, neat Japanese editorial layout, and muted professional colors.

Layout: Place a left information column, three full-body character views across the center, and a right detail column. The overall look should resemble a polished commercial character settings document.

Left information column: At the top, draw a bordered profile card with exactly 4 labeled rows: name, occupation, height, and weight. Use Japanese text for the visible labels and values: 「名前: {argument name="character name" default="高橋深月"}」 with small furigana above the name and “(Takahashi Mizuki)” underneath, 「職業: サラリーマン」, 「身長: 182cm」, 「体重: 68kg」. Below it, add a section titled 「キャラクター設定」 with exactly 4 bullet points describing him as a salaryman in his late twenties, calm and intellectual with a strong sense of responsibility, serious and trusted at work, and clean-looking with a trustworthy impression. At the bottom, add a section titled 「カラー設定」 with exactly 5 color swatches: hair light brown #8B6F5E, eyes brown #5A3E2B, suit gray #646A70, shirt white #FFFFFF, tie/shoes/belt black #111111.

Center character views: Show exactly 3 full-body views of the same man wearing a fitted gray business suit: left side view labeled 「側面図」, center front view labeled 「正面図」, and right back view labeled 「背面図」. The man is tall and slim, with light-brown center-parted hair, a white dress shirt, black slim tie with a tie pin, gray notch-lapel jacket, matching slim straight trousers with center crease, black belt, black dress shoes, and a simple analog wristwatch. In the side view, show one hand in pocket and a relaxed upright posture. In the front view, show one hand in pocket and the other relaxed at his side. In the back view, show the suit jacket seams and clean tapered silhouette.

Center annotation callouts: Add thin leader lines and Japanese labels pointing to the outfit and traits. Include callouts for hairstyle, expression, suit, necktie, pants, and shoes. The hairstyle note should describe a center part with naturally flowing hair; the expression note should describe a calm and slightly smiling trustworthy impression; the suit note should describe a crisp fitted silhouette; the necktie note should describe a black solid tie with tie pin; the pants note should describe slim straight slacks with a center crease; the shoes note should describe black straight-tip dress shoes.

Right detail column: Title the column 「ディテール」. Include exactly 4 rectangular detail panels stacked vertically: 1) close-up head and hair with blurred face, 2) close-up chest showing lapels, shirt, tie, tie pin, and pocket square, 3) close-up sleeve cuff and simple analog watch, 4) close-up fabric texture swatch. Add Japanese bullet notes beside these panels: bangs are center-parted and flow naturally, hair has neat straight texture, eyes are calm and composed, jacket has notch lapels and a pocket square, sleeves show four real buttons, watch is a simple analog type, fabric is a high-quality wool-blend suit material suitable for spring, autumn, and winter.

Bottom-right notes: Add a small bordered box titled 「備考」 with exactly 3 bullet points emphasizing cleanliness and trustworthiness, a basic refined business-suit style, and a simple but polished design.

Visual style: Semi-realistic anime illustration, clean line art, soft cel shading, realistic suit folds, elegant muted palette, magazine-like Japanese character sheet design, crisp legible typography, no decorative background, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一份简洁的动漫风格男性角色设计图，展示一位现代日本上班族，所有肖像中的面部均需用柔和的方形模糊效果遮挡。

画布：宽幅横向角色参考图，白色背景，比例约为 16:9。使用细黑色分割线，整洁的日式编辑排版，以及柔和的专业配色。

布局：左侧放置信息栏，中间放置三个全身角色视图，右侧放置细节栏。整体外观应类似于精致的商业角色设定文档。

左侧信息栏：顶部绘制一张带边框的个人资料卡，包含 4 行标注：姓名、职业、身高和体重。使用日语文本作为可见标签和数值：「名前: {argument name="character name" default="高桥深月"}」（姓名上方标注小型假名，下方标注“(Takahashi Mizuki)”）、「职业: サラリーマン」、「身高: 182cm」、「体重: 68kg」。下方添加标题为「キャラクター设定」的部分，包含 4 个要点，描述他是一位二十多岁的上班族，性格冷静睿智，责任感强，在工作中严谨且受人信赖，外表整洁，给人值得信赖的印象。底部添加标题为「カラー设定」的部分，包含 5 个色卡：发色浅棕 #8B6F5E、眼色棕色 #5A3E2B、西装灰色 #646A70、衬衫白色 #FFFFFF、领带/鞋/皮带黑色 #111111。

中间角色视图：展示 3 个身穿合身灰色商务西装的同一男性的全身视图：左侧视图标注「侧面図」、中间正面视图标注「正面図」、右侧背面视图标注「背面図」。该男子高挑纤瘦，留着浅棕色中分发型，穿着白色衬衫、黑色窄领带配领带夹、灰色平驳领西装外套、配套的修身直筒西裤（带中折线）、黑色皮带、黑色正装皮鞋，并佩戴简单的模拟指针手表。侧面视图中，一只手插在口袋里，姿态挺拔放松。正面视图中，一只手插在口袋里，另一只手自然垂下。背面视图展示西装外套的接缝和利落的锥形轮廓。

中间标注说明：添加细引线和日语标签，指向服装和特征。包括发型、表情、西装、领带、裤子和鞋子的标注。发型说明应描述为中分且自然流动的发丝；表情说明应描述为冷静且略带微笑的值得信赖的印象；西装说明应描述为利落的合身轮廓；领带说明应描述为带领带夹的黑色纯色领带；裤子说明应描述为带中折线的修身直筒西裤；鞋子说明应描述为黑色直头正装皮鞋。

右侧细节栏：标题为「ディテール」。垂直堆叠 4 个矩形细节面板：1) 面部模糊的头部和头发特写，2) 展示翻领、衬衫、领带、领带夹和口袋巾的胸部特写，3) 袖口和简单模拟指针手表的特写，4) 面料纹理色卡。在这些面板旁添加日语要点说明：刘海中分且自然流动，头发质感整洁顺直，眼神冷静沉稳，外套采用平驳领并配有口袋巾，袖口有四颗真扣，手表为简单的模拟指针式，面料为适合春秋冬三季的高品质羊毛混纺西装材质。

右下角备注：添加一个带边框的小方框，标题为「備考」，包含 3 个要点，强调整洁感与信赖感、基础精致的商务西装风格，以及简约而考究的设计。

视觉风格：半写实动漫插画，干净的线条，柔和的赛璐璐阴影，写实的西装褶皱，优雅柔和的色调，杂志风格的日式角色设定图，清晰易读的排版，无装饰背景，无水印。

templates.title: Anime School Storyboard Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫校园分镜表

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean anime storyboard/contact sheet for a school scene, laid out as a 4-column by 4-row grid: 8 illustrated panels paired with 8 dialogue boxes. The top-left corner of each illustrated panel has a small white label with black Japanese text from 「絵1」 through 「絵8」, and the paired text boxes below have labels from 「台詞1」 through 「台詞8」. Use crisp black grid borders, white gutters, and a widescreen canvas.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 storyboard sheet, approximately 1200×675 px, white background, thin black panel outlines, clean manga production layout. Each illustrated panel occupies the upper half of its story cell and its matching dialogue box sits directly below it.

Visual style: High-quality modern Japanese anime, soft classroom lighting, pastel colors, detailed school desks and chairs, expressive character acting, clean line art, subtle gradients, no heavy texture. Keep the overall look like a storyboard for an anime scene rather than a finished comic page.

Characters: Main girl is {argument name="main character name" default="Kodama"}, a shy pink-haired schoolgirl with long straight hair, pale skin, large pink eyes, and a cream cardigan over a school uniform. Second girl is {argument name="friend character name" default="Misaki"}, an energetic blonde schoolgirl with a high ponytail wearing a sailor-style uniform with blue collar and red ribbon. Other classmates appear in the classroom background.

Illustrated panels: Create exactly 8 illustrated image panels. Panel 1: pink-haired girl sits alone at her classroom desk, looking down at a game controller or gamepad in her hands, classmates chatting behind her, label 「絵1」. Panel 2: low-angle close-up of the blonde girl's legs and school shoes walking toward the pink-haired girl; the pink-haired girl is visible sitting at a desk in the background, label 「絵2」. Panel 3: blonde girl leans in close across the desk, speaking excitedly to the surprised pink-haired girl in the classroom, label 「絵3」. Panel 4: close-up of the pink-haired girl blushing nervously and gripping a pen or small object near her mouth, face partially simplified/obscured in a storyboard-like way, label 「絵4」. Panel 5: blonde girl holds up a smartphone showing a colorful fighting game tournament poster or game screen; pink-haired girl looks at it from the side, label 「絵5」. Panel 6: close-up of the blonde girl smiling and making a peace sign, bright warm bokeh background, face partially simplified/obscured in a storyboard-like way, label 「絵6」. Panel 7: close-up of the pink-haired girl's face with sparkly pink background, intense stunned reaction, face partially simplified/obscured in a storyboard-like way, label 「絵7」. Panel 8: blank unused white storyboard panel with only the centered Japanese text 「未使用」, label 「絵8」.

Dialogue boxes: Create exactly 8 dialogue boxes below the image panels. Use black Japanese text on white, simple printed font, left aligned except unused boxes centered. Dialogue 1 text: {argument name="dialogue 1" default="こだま「……\n今日も誰とも\nしゃべらずに」"}. Dialogue 2 text: 「美咲がこだまに近づいてくる\n美咲の足元アップ」. Dialogue 3 text: 「美咲『ねぇねぇ』\n美咲『いつもゲームパッド\n持ってるよね？』」. Dialogue 4 text: {argument name="dialogue 4" default="こだま『ひっ……！？\nあ、えっと……』"}. Dialogue 5 text: 「美咲『これさ！\n今度の土曜、\nゲーセンでスト2の\n大会あるんだって！』\nこだま『……っ』」. Dialogue 6 text: 「美咲『対戦ゲーム大会って\n同じゲーム好きな人しか\nいないんだよ？』」. Dialogue 7 text: {argument name="dialogue 7" default="こだま（ドクン…）"}. Dialogue 8 text: centered 「未使用」.

Constraints: Include exactly 8 image panels and exactly 8 dialogue boxes; exactly 2 boxes are unused, both marked 「未使用」. Maintain the same 4-column structure, strong black borders, classroom continuity, and consistent character designs across panels. Do not add extra captions, watermarks, logos, or additional panels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为校园场景创建一个整洁的动漫分镜表/联系表，布局为 4 列 4 行的网格：8 个插画面板配对 8 个对话框。每个插画面板的左上角都有一个白色小标签，带有从「絵1」到「絵8」的黑色日语文字，下方配对的文本框标签为「台詞1」到「台詞8」。使用清晰的黑色网格边框、白色间距和宽屏画布。

画布：水平 16:9 分镜表，约 1200×675 像素，白色背景，细黑色面板轮廓，简洁的动画制作布局。每个插画面板占据其分镜格的上半部分，对应的对话框位于其正下方。

视觉风格：高质量现代日本动漫，柔和的教室光线，柔和的色彩，精细的课桌椅，生动的角色表演，干净的线条，细腻的渐变，无厚重纹理。整体外观应保持为动漫场景的分镜草图，而非成品漫画页。

角色：主角女孩为 {argument name="main character name" default="Kodama"}，一位害羞的粉色长直发女学生，皮肤白皙，有着粉色大眼睛，校服外穿着奶油色开衫。第二位女孩为 {argument name="friend character name" default="Misaki"}，一位充满活力的金发女学生，扎着高马尾，穿着带有蓝色领子和红色丝带的水手服。其他同学出现在教室背景中。

插画面板：创建 8 个插画图像面板。面板 1：粉发女孩独自坐在教室课桌前，低头看着手中的游戏手柄，身后有同学在聊天，标签为「絵1」。面板 2：金发女孩走向粉发女孩的腿部及校鞋特写；背景中可见粉发女孩坐在课桌前，标签为「絵2」。面板 3：金发女孩俯身跨过课桌，兴奋地对惊讶的粉发女孩说话，标签为「絵3」。面板 4：粉发女孩紧张地脸红，嘴边握着一支笔或小物件，面部以分镜风格进行部分简化/遮挡，标签为「絵4」。面板 5：金发女孩举起智能手机，展示一张多彩的格斗游戏锦标赛海报或游戏画面；粉发女孩从侧面看着它，标签为「絵5」。面板 6：金发女孩微笑并比出剪刀手特写，背景为明亮温暖的虚化效果，面部以分镜风格进行部分简化/遮挡，标签为「絵6」。面板 7：粉发女孩面部特写，背景带有闪烁的粉色效果，表现出强烈的震惊反应，面部以分镜风格进行部分简化/遮挡，标签为「絵7」。面板 8：空白的未使用白色分镜面板，仅居中显示日语文字「未使用」，标签为「絵8」。

对话框：在图像面板下方创建 8 个对话框。使用白色背景上的黑色日语文字，简单印刷字体，左对齐（未使用框除外，未使用框居中）。对话 1 文本：{argument name="dialogue 1" default="こだま「……\n今日も誰とも\nしゃべらずに」"}。对话 2 文本：「美咲がこだまに近づいてくる\n美咲の足元アップ」。对话 3 文本：「美咲『ねぇねぇ』\n美咲『いつもゲームパッド\n持ってるよね？』」。对话 4 文本：{argument name="dialogue 4" default="こだま『ひっ……！？\nあ、えっと……』"}。对话 5 文本：「美咲『これさ！\n今度の土曜、\nゲーセンでスト2の\n大会あるんだって！』\nこだま『……っ』」。对话 6 文本：「美咲『対戦ゲーム大会って\n同じゲーム好きな人しか\nいないんだよ？』」。对话 7 文本：{argument name="dialogue 7" default="こだま（ドクン…）"}。对话 8 文本：居中显示「未使用」。

约束条件：包含 8 个图像面板和 8 个对话框；其中 2 个框为未使用，均标记为「未使用」。保持 4 列结构、强黑色边框、教室场景连贯性以及各面板间一致的角色设计。不要添加额外的标题、水印、Logo 或其他面板。

templates.title: Tsukiyo Fox Shrine Maiden Reference Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Tsukiyo 狐巫女角色设定参考图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished anime VTuber character reference sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Tsukiyo"}, a moon-dwelling fox-shrine maiden with long pink hair and fox ears, in a delicate Japanese fantasy style.

Canvas: Portrait-oriented character design sheet, pale warm ivory background, soft pink decorative borders, sakura petals, thin red-pink frame lines, elegant symmetrical spacing, high-resolution illustration. Overall palette: white, blush pink, crimson red, black, gold accents.

Header: At the top center, large title text: 「ツキヨ / Tsukiyo」. Under it, smaller subtitle text: 「月を宿す狐神の巫女」. Add a small circular moon-and-fox emblem at the upper left with cherry blossoms and light ornamental flourishes.

Main layout: The left and center area contains exactly 3 full-body turnaround views of the character, labeled vertically in small beige tags: 「正面」 for front view, 「側面」 for side view, and 「背面」 for back view. The front view shows her standing calmly with arms slightly lowered and sleeves hanging; the side view shows her profile and long hair flowing down; the back view emphasizes extremely long straight pink hair reaching near the hem and the back of the obi. Keep all three figures consistent in proportions and outfit.

Character details: She is a youthful elegant anime woman with {argument name="hair color" default="very long pastel pink hair"}, large pink fox ears with white inner fur, golden eyes, pale skin, soft bangs, and a refined calm expression. She wears a white shrine maiden-inspired kimono dress with translucent wide sleeves, pink cherry blossom patterns, red trim, black inner collar, and a dramatic red-and-black floral obi belt with gold detailing. Include a large red flower ornament and ribbon on one fox ear, matching red ribbons on the sleeves, decorative cords, tassels, and a round gold-and-pink waist charm. Footwear is traditional white tabi with red-and-black geta or platform sandals. The back view should show the kimono train and sleeve transparency with soft pink floral gradients.

Right column: Add exactly 1 large close-up portrait panel at the upper right showing the head, fox ears, hair ornament, collar, and shoulder area. Beneath it, create a DETAIL section with exactly 2 stacked detail panels: first, a close crop of the ear ornament labeled 「耳元飾り」 with small explanatory Japanese-style text; second, a close crop of the obi and waist ornament labeled 「帯・腰飾り」 with small explanatory Japanese-style text. At the bottom right, create exactly 1 SD / CHIBI panel labeled “SD / CHIBI”, showing a tiny super-deformed full-body version of the same character standing in the same outfit, surrounded by subtle petal effects and a small circular ground ripple.

Expression row: Along the lower left, create an EXPRESSION section with exactly 5 small bust panels. Each panel shows the same character from the shoulders up with fox ears and hair ornament, labeled in Japanese from left to right: 「通常」 normal, 「微笑み」 gentle smile, 「妖艶」 alluring, 「静寂」 quiet/serene, 「威圧」 intimidating. Keep the expressions subtle and elegant, not exaggerated.

Profile section: At the bottom left, create a PROFILE box with compact Japanese text lines. Include visible structured fields such as species, age, height, personality, likes, and dislikes, but keep the small text decorative and secondary. To the right of the profile box, include a short Japanese description paragraph about a beautiful fox deity shrine maiden seen on moonlit nights, with a faint crescent moon and sakura motif behind it.

Visual style: High-detail anime character sheet, clean line art, soft watercolor-like pink shading, ornate Japanese shrine maiden aesthetic, gentle glow, glossy hair highlights, intricate textile patterns, elegant UI-like reference sheet design. Use readable section labels, thin ornamental dividers, sakura icons, and refined typography.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 full-body turnaround views, exactly 5 expression panels, exactly 2 detail panels, exactly 1 close-up portrait, and exactly 1 chibi panel. Keep the sheet cohesive and uncluttered. No watermark, no social media UI, no realistic photography, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Tsukiyo"} 创建一份精致的动漫 VTuber 角色参考图。该角色是一位居住在月亮的狐巫女，拥有长长的粉色头发和狐耳，呈现出细腻的日式幻想风格。

画布：纵向角色设计图，浅暖象牙色背景，柔和的粉色装饰边框，樱花花瓣，纤细的红粉色边框线，优雅的对称布局，高分辨率插画。整体色调：白色、淡粉色、深红色、黑色，点缀金色。

页眉：顶部中央为大标题文字：「ツキヨ / Tsukiyo」。下方为较小的副标题：「月を宿す狐神の巫女」。左上角添加一个带有樱花和轻盈装饰纹样的圆形月亮与狐狸徽章。

主体布局：左侧和中央区域包含 3 个完整的角色全身三视图，垂直方向贴有小型米色标签：正面视图标注「正面」，侧面视图标注「側面」，背面视图标注「背面」。正面视图展示她平静站立，双臂微垂，袖子自然下垂；侧面视图展示她的侧脸和飘逸的长发；背面视图强调其长及裙摆的超长直粉发以及腰带背面。保持三个角色的比例和服装一致。

角色细节：她是一位年轻优雅的动漫女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="超长淡粉色头发"}、带有白色内耳毛的大型粉色狐耳、金色眼睛、白皙皮肤、柔和的刘海以及精致平静的表情。她身穿白色巫女风格和服裙，配有半透明宽袖、粉色樱花图案、红色滚边、黑色内领，以及带有金色细节的红黑花卉腰带。在一只狐耳上包含一个大型红色花朵装饰和丝带，袖子上配有相呼应的红色丝带、装饰绳、流苏以及圆形的金粉色腰部挂饰。鞋履为传统的白色足袋，搭配红黑木屐或厚底凉鞋。背面视图应展示和服裙摆和带有柔和粉色花卉渐变的袖子透明感。

右侧栏：右上角添加 1 个大型特写肖像面板，展示头部、狐耳、发饰、领口和肩部区域。下方创建一个「细节」部分，包含 2 个堆叠的细节面板：第一个是耳饰的近景特写，标注「耳元飾り」，并配有小型日式说明文字；第二个是腰带和腰部挂饰的近景特写，标注「帯・腰飾り」，并配有小型日式说明文字。右下角创建 1 个 SD / CHIBI 面板，标注“SD / CHIBI”，展示同一个角色身穿相同服装的超萌 Q 版全身形象，周围环绕着细微的花瓣特效和一个小型圆形地面涟漪。

表情行：在左下方创建一个「表情」部分，包含 5 个小型头像面板。每个面板展示同一个角色从肩部以上的形象，配有狐耳和发饰，从左到右用日语标注： 「通常」（正常）、「微笑み」（温柔微笑）、「妖艶」（妩媚）、「静寂」（安静/宁静）、「威圧」（威严）。表情应保持细腻优雅，不可过于夸张。

个人资料部分：左下角创建一个「个人资料」框，包含紧凑的日语文字行。包含种族、年龄、身高、性格、喜好和厌恶等结构化字段，但将小字作为装饰性辅助内容。在资料框右侧，包含一段简短的日语描述，讲述在月夜下出现的绝美狐神巫女，背景带有淡淡的新月和樱花图案。

视觉风格：高细节动漫角色设定图，干净的线条，柔和的水彩风粉色阴影，华丽的日式巫女美学，柔和的光晕，亮丽的发丝高光，复杂的织物纹理，优雅的 UI 风格参考图设计。使用清晰的区域标签、纤细的装饰分隔线、樱花图标和精致的字体。

约束条件：使用 3 个全身三视图，5 个表情面板，2 个细节面板，1 个特写肖像面板，以及 1 个 Q 版面板。保持画面统一且整洁。无水印，无社交媒体 UI，无写实摄影，无额外角色。

templates.title: Mea Anime Character Reference Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Mea 动漫角色设定集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished anime character reference sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Mea"}, a serene AI secretary girl, in a delicate blue-and-white fantasy office style.

Canvas: Vertical A4 character sheet, 768 x 1152 px, white background with pale ice-blue ornamental borders, thin panel dividers, decorative corner flourishes, small butterfly and rose motifs, clean premium visual-novel design.

Header: At the top left place a large blue rose emblem. Center the title text in Japanese and English: 「めあ / Mea」. Under it add the Japanese tagline 「あなたのそばで、すべてを整えるお手伝いを。」 in small elegant blue type.

Main layout: Use a dense reference-sheet layout with three main columns. The left two-thirds contain the full-body turnaround, expression strip, profile, color palette, and items. The right third contains a large portrait, detail panels, and a chibi panel.

Character design: Draw a young adult woman with {argument name="hair color" default="very long pale silver-blue hair"}, blue eyes, fair skin, a calm expression, and refined secretary-like elegance. She wears a white beret with navy ribbon and blue rose ornament, a white lace capelet over puff-sleeve blouse, navy bow tie with a large blue gemstone brooch, fitted white bodice with gold buttons and chain accents, long white layered skirt with pale blue floral embroidery near the hem, dark navy underskirt ruffle, white gloves or soft sleeves, white heeled shoes, and an ID card hanging at the waist. Use navy, white, gold, and icy blue accents throughout. The face area may be softly obscured in the main front view and portrait, but the other expression thumbnails show the face.

Turnaround section: Label the section 「三面図」. Show exactly 3 full-body standing views in separate vertical columns: 1 front view labeled 「正面」, 2 side view labeled 「側面」, 3 back view labeled 「背面」. Keep proportions consistent, elegant pose, arms relaxed. Back view must show long flowing hair, beret, navy bow and rose decoration at the lower back, and layered skirt construction.

Right portrait: Add one large framed upper-body portrait in the upper-right panel. The character holds one hand near her collar, showing the beret, hair ornament, lace capelet, bow, gemstone brooch, blouse buttons, and long hair.

Detail section: Label it “DETAIL”. Include exactly 3 stacked detail cards with crop image on the left and Japanese explanatory text on the right: 1 hair ornament, showing the blue rose/ribbon hair accessory; 2 chest brooch, showing the navy bow and blue jewel brooch; 3 ID card, showing a close-up of the hanging badge with the text “Mea” and AI-secretary styling.

Expression section: Label it “EXPRESSION”. Include exactly 5 square bust thumbnails, each with a Japanese label in a blue tab below: 1 「通常」 neutral, 2 「微笑み」 slight smile, 3 「気遣い」 caring or concerned, 4 「安堵」 relieved with eyes closed, 5 「静かな照れ」 quiet blush. Use subtle differences and keep the same costume and angle.

Profile section: Label it “PROFILE”. Add a small bilingual-feeling Japanese character data block on the lower left and a paragraph on the lower middle beside a pale blue rose illustration. Include readable Japanese-style text blocks for stats such as species AI, role secretary, age young adult appearance, height 166 cm, body type slender, personality gentle and calm, strengths organizing information and scheduling, weaknesses mechanical body and humor. Keep it decorative rather than too text-heavy.

Chibi section: Label it “SD / CHIBI”. Show exactly 1 super-deformed chibi version of the character standing on a glowing circular hologram, holding a dark blue tablet or notebook, surrounded by translucent blue floating UI panels.

Color palette: Label it “COLOR PALETTE”. Show exactly 7 swatches: warm white, pale lavender-gray, light periwinkle, medium blue, dark navy, tan gold, and a faceted icy blue crystal swatch.

Weapon/item section: Label it “WEAPON / ITEM”. Show exactly 3 items with captions: 1 a navy-and-gold management device pen labeled 「管理用デバイスペン」, 2 a dark blue information management tablet labeled 「情報管理タブレット」, 3 floating blue hologram UI screens labeled 「ホログラムUI」.

Visual style: High-quality anime illustration, clean line art, soft watercolor shading, luminous pale blue highlights, elegant ornamental typography, crisp reference-sheet readability, cohesive blue-white-gold palette, delicate lace and floral patterns, subtle drop shadows, no clutter beyond the specified panels.

Constraints: Preserve the exact count of 3 turnaround views, 5 expressions, 3 detail cards, 1 chibi, 7 color swatches, and 3 item illustrations. Do not add extra characters. Keep all labels neat and mostly Japanese where specified. Use a vertical character design sheet composition for {argument name="character role" default="an AI secretary"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Mea"} 创建一份精致的动漫角色设定集。她是一位宁静的 AI 秘书，采用优雅的蓝白幻想办公风格。

画布：竖版 A4 角色设定集，768 x 1152 像素，白色背景，配有淡冰蓝色装饰边框、细线条面板分割、装饰性边角花纹、小蝴蝶和玫瑰图案，呈现简洁的高级视觉小说设计感。

页眉：左上角放置一个大型蓝色玫瑰徽章。标题文字居中，采用日语和英语： 「めあ / Mea」。下方添加优雅的小号蓝色日文标语： 「あなたのそばで、すべてを整えるお手伝いを。」。

主要布局：采用紧凑的设定集布局，分为三个主要栏目。左侧三分之二包含全身三面图、表情条、个人资料、配色方案和道具。右侧三分之一包含一张大头像、细节面板和 Q 版面板。

角色设计：绘制一位年轻女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极长的淡银蓝色头发"}、蓝色眼睛、白皙皮肤、平静的表情，展现出秘书般的优雅气质。她佩戴带有海军蓝丝带和蓝色玫瑰装饰的白色贝雷帽，白色蕾丝披肩覆盖在泡泡袖衬衫上，海军蓝领结配有大型蓝色宝石胸针，修身白色上衣带有金色纽扣和链条装饰，长款白色叠层裙摆，下摆处有淡蓝色花卉刺绣，深海军蓝衬裙褶边，佩戴白色手套或柔软袖套，白色高跟鞋，腰间悬挂一张 ID 卡。整体使用海军蓝、白色、金色和冰蓝色点缀。面部区域在主正面图和头像中可略微遮挡，但在其他表情缩略图中需清晰展示。

三面图部分：标注为 「三面図」。展示 3 个完整的全身站立视图，分列在垂直栏中： 1 正面图标注为 「正面」， 2 侧面图标注为 「側面」， 3 背面图标注为 「背面」。保持比例一致，姿态优雅，双臂自然下垂。背面图需展示长发飘逸的效果、贝雷帽、后腰的海军蓝蝴蝶结与玫瑰装饰，以及叠层裙摆的结构。

右侧头像：在右上方面板添加一张大型半身肖像框。角色一只手靠近领口，展示贝雷帽、发饰、蕾丝披肩、蝴蝶结、宝石胸针、衬衫纽扣和长发。

细节部分：标注为 “DETAIL”。包含 3 张堆叠的细节卡片，左侧为裁剪图，右侧为日文说明文字： 1 发饰，展示蓝色玫瑰/丝带发饰； 2 胸针，展示海军蓝蝴蝶结和蓝色宝石胸针； 3 ID 卡，展示悬挂式工牌特写，文字为 “Mea” 及 AI 秘书风格样式。

表情部分：标注为 “EXPRESSION”。包含 5 个方形头像缩略图，下方蓝色标签标注日文： 1 「通常」中性， 2 「微笑み」浅笑， 3 「気遣い」关心或担忧， 4 「安堵」闭眼释然， 5 「静かな照れ」安静害羞。表情细微差别，服装和角度保持一致。

个人资料部分：标注为 “PROFILE”。在左下方添加一个双语风格的日文角色数据块，并在淡蓝色玫瑰插图旁添加一段简介。包含易读的日式文本块，如：物种 AI、职位秘书、外貌年龄青年、身高 166 cm、体型苗条、性格温柔冷静、擅长整理信息与日程、弱点机械身体与幽默感。保持装饰性，避免文字过于密集。

Q 版部分：标注为 “SD / CHIBI”。展示 1 个超变形 Q 版角色，站在发光的圆形全息图上，手持深蓝色平板或笔记本，周围环绕着半透明的蓝色浮动 UI 面板。

配色方案：标注为 “COLOR PALETTE”。展示 7 个色块：暖白色、淡薰衣草灰、浅长春花蓝、中蓝色、深海军蓝、棕褐色金以及多面冰蓝色水晶色块。

武器/道具部分：标注为 “WEAPON / ITEM”。展示 3 个道具并配文： 1 海军蓝与金色管理设备笔，标注为 「管理用デバイスペン」； 2 深蓝色信息管理平板，标注为 「情報管理タブレット」； 3 浮动蓝色全息 UI 屏幕，标注为 「ホログラムUI」。

视觉风格：高质量动漫插画，干净的线条，柔和的水彩阴影，明亮的淡蓝色高光，优雅的装饰性排版，清晰的设定集易读性，统一的蓝白金配色，精致的蕾丝与花卉图案，细微的投影，除指定面板外无杂乱元素。

约束条件：严格保留 3 个三面图、5 个表情、3 张细节卡片、1 个 Q 版形象、7 个色块和 3 个道具插图。不要添加额外角色。所有标签保持整洁，指定位置使用日文。为 {argument name="character role" default="一位 AI 秘书"} 使用竖版角色设定集构图。

templates.title: Anime Condo Duo Gaming Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫公寓双人游戏场景

templates.prompt: Create a detailed anime-style cozy evening illustration of two cute girls sitting side by side in a warm modern condominium living room, playing video games together. The left character, {argument name="left character name" default="Yuri"}, is a petite kemonomimi fox/cat-eared girl with short fluffy brown hair, large animal ears with pale inner fur, wearing a dark navy-and-white sailor-style sporty hoodie outfit, black shorts, wrist guards, ankle socks, and black-and-white sneakers; she sits upright on a beige sofa, knees together, holding a black game controller with a glowing blue light. The right character, {argument name="right character name" default="Momiji"}, is a delicate long-haired girl with flowing dark purple-black hair, a pink headband, pink flower hair ornaments, and ribbon details, wearing a frilly pastel pink dress with puff sleeves, lace trim, floral embroidery, and a brown belt; she sits on an oversized translucent iridescent custom gaming cushion shaped like a giant soap bubble, holding a custom pink game controller. Include exactly 2 main characters, exactly 2 handheld controllers, and many floating soap bubbles of different sizes throughout the room, including one very large bubble-like cushion under the right character and one large bubble near the left side of the sofa. The room should feel intimate and luxurious: beige couch, patterned rug, wooden coffee table with snacks and drinks in the foreground, warm floor lamp, shelves and kitchenette/bar area in the background, framed snowy mountain picture on the wall, houseplants, books, photo frames, and a large window showing a snowy night landscape. Use warm amber indoor lighting mixed with cool blue moonlight from the window, glossy highlights, soft reflections on bubbles, highly polished anime rendering, intricate fabric folds, cute game-night atmosphere, cinematic composition, 4:3 horizontal aspect ratio. Keep both faces softly obscured or featureless, as if anonymized, while preserving hair, outfits, poses, and controllers clearly. No text, no watermark, no UI, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富的动漫风格温馨夜晚插画，描绘两个可爱的女孩并排坐在温暖的现代公寓客厅里一起玩电子游戏。左侧角色 {argument name="left character name" default="Yuri"} 是一位娇小的兽耳娘（狐狸/猫耳），留着蓬松的棕色短发，有着内侧毛色较浅的大型动物耳朵，身穿深海军蓝白配色的水手风格运动连帽衫、黑色短裤、护腕、短袜和黑白运动鞋；她双膝并拢端坐在米色沙发上，手持一个带有蓝色发光灯的黑色游戏手柄。右侧角色 {argument name="right character name" default="Momiji"} 是一位精致的长发女孩，留着飘逸的深紫黑色长发，佩戴粉色发带、粉色花朵发饰和丝带细节，身穿带有泡泡袖、蕾丝花边、花卉刺绣和棕色腰带的粉色系荷叶边连衣裙；她坐在一个巨大的肥皂泡形状的半透明虹彩定制游戏坐垫上，手持一个定制的粉色游戏手柄。画面中需包含 2 个主要角色、2 个手持控制器，以及散布在房间各处的许多大小不一的漂浮肥皂泡，其中包括右侧角色下方一个巨大的气泡状坐垫，以及沙发左侧附近的一个大气泡。房间应营造出私密且奢华的氛围：米色沙发、图案地毯、前景中摆放零食和饮料的木制咖啡桌、温暖的落地灯、背景中的架子和小型厨房/吧台区、墙上挂着的雪山画框、室内植物、书籍、相框，以及一扇展示雪夜景观的大窗户。使用温暖的琥珀色室内灯光与窗外清冷的蓝色月光交织，呈现出光泽感、气泡上的柔和反射、高度精细的动漫渲染、复杂的衣物褶皱、可爱的游戏之夜氛围、电影级构图，比例为 4:3 横向。保持两个角色的面部柔和模糊或无五官，如同匿名处理，同时清晰保留发型、服装、姿势和控制器细节。无文字，无水印，无 UI，无额外角色。
