templates.title: Kawaii Tomato Cat Perfume Flyer

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱番茄猫香水宣传单

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cute Japanese perfume advertising flyer for an original tomato-cat fragrance, like a soft commercial poster for a kawaii cosmetic brand. Use {argument name="product name" default="TOMATONYAN"} as the perfume name and keep the overall feeling warm, sweet, and slightly premium.

Canvas: Wide horizontal flyer, 16:9 aspect ratio, divided into a large left hero advertisement panel and a narrower right information panel. Background is warm cream with peach tones, soft sunlight, shallow depth of field, blurred tomato vines and greenery around the edges, and a clean magazine-layout finish.

Main left hero panel: Feature exactly 2 main tomato-cat characters in the center-left area: 1 glossy red tomato cat sitting on a round glass perfume bottle, and 1 larger tomato cat wearing a pale cream hoodie with cat ears. Both characters have tomato stems as leafy hair, tiny black glossy eyes, small white mouths, blush cheeks, and cute rounded bodies. The perfume bottle is transparent glass with pale peach liquid, a tomato-shaped red cap/character head, and white branding text reading “TOMATONYAN EAU DE PARFUM” plus a tiny tomato icon. Add a dotted circular “NEW” badge on the lower left of the hero area with Japanese product/price text. Add a large handwritten-style Japanese headline near the upper left: {argument name="headline text" default="トマトにゃん、はじめての香り。"}. Add smaller Japanese copy above and below it, including a cute heart. Near the bottom center of the hero area, add a short handwritten Japanese message beside tiny paw-print accents.

Bottom left brand strip: Add a full-width muted coral rectangle at the bottom of the left panel. Include a small tomato icon, the large serif brand text “TOMATONYAN”, smaller text “EAU DE PARFUM”, and two short Japanese tagline lines in white.

Right information panel layout: Arrange exactly 6 rounded rectangular cream cards on a pale peach background, separated by clean gutters. Use delicate red-brown serif English headings with tiny paw/flower ornaments and smaller Japanese subtitles. The 6 cards are: 1 “FRAGRANCE” scent notes card, 1 “POINT” recommendation card, 1 “DESIGN” design explanation card, 1 “ABOUT” character story card, 1 “HOW TO USE” usage card, and 1 message card from the tomato cat.

Card details and counts: The “FRAGRANCE” card contains exactly 3 scent note rows labeled TOP, MIDDLE, and LAST, each with a small ingredient icon: tomato for TOP, flowers for MIDDLE, and a pale citrus/wood-like icon for LAST. The “POINT” card contains exactly 4 recommendation rows with circular line icons: handbag, sparkle, heart, and gift. The “DESIGN” card contains a large product photo-style illustration of the tomato-cat perfume bottle plus exactly 2 small thumbnail images underneath/near it: one bottle thumbnail and one tomato-stem close-up thumbnail. The “ABOUT” card contains Japanese explanatory text and 1 small full-body tomato-cat in a cream hoodie at the bottom. The “HOW TO USE” card contains exactly 3 usage icons with Japanese captions: wrist/neck spray, hair/clothing scent, and after-bath relaxation. The message card contains Japanese message text and 1 small tomato-cat in a hoodie on the right.

Visual style: Combine watercolor-like kawaii character illustration with polished cosmetic product photography. Use glossy highlights on the red tomato surfaces and glass bottle, soft shadows on the table, warm beige paper texture, muted coral accents, and elegant brown typography. The characters should look adorable and rounded, with subtle droplets/highlights on the tomato skin. Keep the flyer clean, balanced, and commercial, as if advertising a limited-edition fragrance.

Constraints: English section headings may be used, but most body copy should appear as neat Japanese advertising text. Avoid real-world logos, barcodes, watermarks, or extra characters. Keep the exact visible item counts listed above. The overall palette should be cream, peach, tomato red, warm brown, and leafy green.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款原创番茄猫香水创作一张可爱的日式香水广告宣传单，风格类似于可爱化妆品品牌的柔和商业海报。使用 {argument name="product name" default="TOMATONYAN"} 作为香水名称，整体氛围保持温暖、甜美且略带高级感。

画布：宽幅横向宣传单，16:9 比例，分为左侧大型主视觉广告区和右侧较窄的信息区。背景为暖奶油色调，带有桃色光晕、柔和的阳光、浅景深效果，边缘有模糊的番茄藤蔓和绿植，呈现出干净的杂志排版质感。

左侧主视觉区：在左中区域放置 2 个主要的番茄猫角色：1 只光泽感十足的红色番茄猫坐在圆形的玻璃香水瓶上，另 1 只较大的番茄猫穿着带猫耳的浅奶油色连帽衫。两个角色都有番茄蒂作为叶子状的头发，黑色亮面小眼睛，白色小嘴，腮红，以及圆润可爱的身体。香水瓶为透明玻璃材质，内含浅桃色液体，瓶盖为番茄形状的红色角色头，瓶身印有白色品牌文字“TOMATONYAN EAU DE PARFUM”以及一个小番茄图标。在主视觉区左下角添加一个圆形的虚线“NEW”标签，包含日文产品/价格文字。在左上方添加一个醒目的手写风格日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="トマトにゃん、はじめての香り。"}。在标题上方和下方添加较小的日文文案，并加入一颗可爱的心形符号。在主视觉区底部中心附近，添加一段简短的手写日文寄语，旁边点缀小巧的爪印。

底部左侧品牌条：在左侧面板底部添加一个全宽的柔和珊瑚色矩形。包含一个小番茄图标、大号衬线字体品牌名“TOMATONYAN”、较小的“EAU DE PARFUM”文字，以及两行白色的简短日文标语。

右侧信息区布局：在浅桃色背景上排列 6 张圆角奶油色矩形卡片，卡片间留有整洁的间距。使用精致的红棕色衬线英文标题，搭配微小的爪印/花朵装饰以及较小的日文副标题。这 6 张卡片分别是：1 张“FRAGRANCE”（香调）卡片、1 张“POINT”（推荐点）卡片、1 张“DESIGN”（设计说明）卡片、1 张“ABOUT”（角色故事）卡片、1 张“HOW TO USE”（使用方法）卡片，以及 1 张来自番茄猫的寄语卡片。

卡片细节与数量： “FRAGRANCE”卡片包含 3 行香调说明，分别标注为 TOP、MIDDLE 和 LAST，每行配有一个小成分图标：TOP 为番茄，MIDDLE 为花朵，LAST 为浅柑橘/木质图标。“POINT”卡片包含 4 行推荐说明，配有圆形线条图标：手提包、闪光、心形和礼物。“DESIGN”卡片包含一张大尺寸的产品摄影风格番茄猫香水瓶插图，下方/附近配有 2 张小缩略图：一张瓶身缩略图和一张番茄蒂特写缩略图。“ABOUT”卡片包含日文说明文字，底部配有 1 只穿着连帽衫的番茄猫全身小图。“HOW TO USE”卡片包含 3 个使用场景图标及日文说明：手腕/颈部喷洒、头发/衣物留香、沐浴后放松。“MESSAGE”卡片包含日文寄语文字，右侧配有 1 只穿着连帽衫的番茄猫小图。

视觉风格：将水彩风格的可爱角色插画与精致的化妆品产品摄影相结合。在红色番茄表面和玻璃瓶上使用高光处理，桌面带有柔和阴影，采用暖米色纸张纹理、柔和的珊瑚色点缀以及优雅的棕色排版。角色应看起来圆润可爱，番茄皮肤上有细腻的水滴/高光。保持宣传单整洁、平衡且具有商业感，如同在推广一款限量版香水。

约束条件：可以使用英文章节标题，但大部分正文应以整洁的日文广告文案呈现。避免出现现实世界的商标、条形码、水印或多余字符。保持上述列出的可见项目数量准确。整体色调应为奶油色、桃色、番茄红、暖棕色和叶绿色。

templates.title: Gilgamesh and Enkidu Dinner Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 吉尔伽美什与恩奇都的晚餐场景

templates.prompt: Create a polished SFW anime-style illustration of {argument name="characters" default="Gilgamesh and Enkidu"} having an elegant dinner together in a luxury high-rise restaurant at night. The composition is a medium two-shot at a white table: on the left sits a blond young man in a sleek black suit, black shirt, black tie, gold earrings, and a decorative gold lapel pin, leaning his cheek on one hand with a relaxed, slightly amused posture; on the right sits a long-haired green-haired young man in a crisp white suit and white shirt, wearing delicate necklaces, turned toward the blond man in quiet conversation. Their faces are intentionally covered by two plain opaque square blocks in muted beige tones, one over each face, while the rest of the characters remain detailed. The table contains exactly 8 visible dining elements: 1 plated steak entree in front of the blond man, 1 plated gourmet seafood or dumpling-style entree in front of the green-haired man, 1 red wine glass, 2 white wine glasses, 1 lit candle in a small glass holder, 1 metallic vase of white flowers and greenery, and visible silverware beside the plates. Set the scene against floor-to-ceiling windows showing a dark blue city skyline, scattered building lights, a bright full moon, and a large warm chandelier reflected above them. Use {argument name="lighting mood" default="warm candlelit golden lighting with cool moonlit city contrast"}, refined romantic restaurant atmosphere, cinematic depth of field, detailed fabric folds, glossy wine glass reflections, soft bokeh, high-end visual novel key art quality, 16:9 horizontal canvas, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅精致的 SFW 动漫风格插画，描绘 {argument name="characters" default="吉尔伽美什与恩奇都"} 在夜晚的高层豪华餐厅中优雅共进晚餐。构图为两人坐在白色餐桌前的中景镜头：左侧坐着一位金发青年，身穿利落的黑色西装、黑色衬衫，系着黑色领带，佩戴金色耳环和装饰性金色翻领别针，单手托腮，姿态放松且略带笑意；右侧坐着一位长发绿发青年，身穿干练的白色西装和白色衬衫，佩戴精致的项链，正转向金发青年进行安静的交谈。他们的面部特意被两个柔和米色的纯色不透明方块遮挡，每人脸部各一个，而角色的其余部分保持细节丰富。餐桌上包含 8 个清晰可见的用餐元素：金发青年面前有一份摆盘好的牛排主菜，绿发青年面前有一份摆盘好的精致海鲜或饺子类主菜，1 个红酒杯，2 个白葡萄酒杯，1 个放在小玻璃托架里的点燃蜡烛，1 个装有白花和绿植的金属花瓶，以及盘子旁可见的银质餐具。场景背景为落地窗，展示了深蓝色的城市天际线、零星的建筑灯光、一轮明亮的满月，以及上方反射出的巨大暖色吊灯。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖的烛光金色照明与清冷的月光城市对比"}，营造精致的浪漫餐厅氛围，具有电影般的景深效果，细腻的织物褶皱，光泽的酒杯反射，柔和的虚化效果，高端视觉小说关键视觉图品质，16:9 横向画布，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Four Anime Bookshelf Recommendations

titleLocalized.zh: 四款动漫风格书架推荐

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 2x2 anime illustration collage showing four young women standing in front of personalized bookshelves, each introducing one recommended book. The mood is warm, cozy, bookish, and character-focused, like a social-media character recommendation graphic.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 image, about 768×1024 px, divided into exactly four equal rectangular panels with thin white gutters between panels. Each panel shows a waist-up anime girl in front of a wooden bookshelf. Use soft indoor lighting, gentle shadows, detailed book spines, and a calm library/cafe atmosphere. Each character’s face is intentionally covered by a centered soft dark square blur/censor block, while hair, clothing, hands, and books remain visible.

Layout: Four panels arranged in a strict grid: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. In every panel, place a rounded white caption card with a subtle colored outline near the bottom, containing the recommender name, the book title in Japanese quotation marks, and a short recommendation sentence. Do not fill every shelf completely; leave believable gaps, varied book heights, and some partially empty spaces for realism.

Panel details, exactly 4 recommendation scenes:
1. Top-left: A gentle girl with black hair in low side buns and loose curls, wearing a pale lavender cardigan over a white floral dress, holding a landscape book showing Mount Fuji, a lake, and flowers. Bookshelf behind her includes travel, world architecture, and art books. Caption card with purple outline: 「紫苑リンのおすすめ」, 「『美しい日本の風景』」, 「美しい景色を見ると、心が癒されます。」
2. Top-right: A fashionable girl with very long straight black hair, pink ribbon bows, and a soft pink cardigan, holding a beige fashion book with a girl illustration on the cover. Bookshelf behind her includes beauty, makeup, fashion, and comic volumes. Caption card with pink outline: 「紫苑レイのおすすめ」, 「『大人かわいいの作り方』」, 「おしゃれは、自分をもっと好きになる魔法。」
3. Bottom-left: A sporty/energetic short-haired black-haired girl in a white hoodie, holding up a dark science-fiction adventure book with a starry galaxy cover and pointing at it. Bookshelf behind her includes space, adventure, and mystery titles. Caption card with red outline: 「深絆アキラのおすすめ」, 「『銀河英雄伝説 １』」, 「壮大な物語に、いつもワクワクします！」
4. Bottom-right: A quiet, melancholic girl with long black hair partly covering her face, wearing a muted gray-brown sweater, resting one cheek on her hand while holding a tan lifestyle book. Bookshelf behind her includes simple living, cooking, and lifestyle books; a small cup sits on the table edge. Caption card with gray outline: 「黒波凪紗のおすすめ」, 「『暮らしを整える』」, 「シンプルな暮らしが、いちばん心地いい。」

Visual style: High-quality Japanese anime illustration, semi-realistic soft rendering, delicate line art, detailed hands and books, natural muted colors, warm wooden shelves, readable Japanese typography, cozy slice-of-life atmosphere. Keep the characters distinct through hair, clothing, pose, and book choice.

Customizable elements: Use the character group theme {argument name="character group theme" default="four young women with black hair and cozy bookish personalities"}, the bookshelf setting {argument name="bookshelf setting" default="warm wooden bookshelves in a quiet library room"}, the caption language {argument name="caption language" default="Japanese"}, the illustration style {argument name="illustration style" default="soft polished Japanese anime illustration"}, and the face treatment {argument name="face treatment" default="centered soft dark square blur covering each face"}.

Constraints: Use exactly four panels and exactly four featured books. Keep all caption cards visible and legible. Do not add extra panels, extra characters, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, or decorative stickers. Keep the shelves realistic rather than packed edge-to-edge with books.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张精致的 2x2 动漫插画拼贴图，展示四位年轻女性站在个性化书架前，每人介绍一本推荐书籍。氛围温暖、舒适、书卷气浓厚且以角色为中心，类似于社交媒体上的角色推荐图。

画布：垂直 4:5 比例图像，约 768×1024 像素，精确划分为四个相等的矩形面板，面板间有细白边。每个面板展示一位半身动漫少女，背景为木质书架。使用柔和的室内光线、轻柔的阴影、细节丰富的书脊，营造宁静的图书馆/咖啡馆氛围。每位角色的面部均由居中的柔和深色方形模糊/遮挡块覆盖，但头发、服装、手部和书籍保持可见。

布局：四个面板严格排列为网格：左上、右上、左下、右下。在每个面板底部放置一张带有细微彩色轮廓的圆角白色说明卡，包含推荐人姓名、日文书名（使用引号）以及简短的推荐语。不要填满书架，留出合理的空隙、参差不齐的书籍高度以及部分空白区域，以增加真实感。

面板细节，共 4 个推荐场景：
1. 左上：一位温柔的黑发少女，梳着低双丸子头，留着松散的卷发，身穿白色碎花裙外搭淡紫色开衫，手里拿着一本展示富士山、湖泊和花卉的风景书。身后的书架包含旅游、世界建筑和艺术类书籍。紫色轮廓说明卡：「紫苑リンのおすすめ」, 「『美しい日本の風景』」, 「美しい景色を見ると、心が癒されます。」
2. 右上：一位时尚的黑发少女，留着极长的直发，系着粉色蝴蝶结，身穿柔粉色开衫，手里拿着一本封面印有少女插画的米色时尚书籍。身后的书架包含美妆、时尚和漫画书。粉色轮廓说明卡：「紫苑レイのおすすめ」, 「『大人かわいいの作り方』」, 「おしゃれは、自分をもっと好きになる魔法。」
3. 左下：一位充满活力、留着短发的黑发少女，身穿白色连帽衫，手里举着一本封面为星系图案的深色科幻冒险书并指向它。身后的书架包含太空、冒险和悬疑类书籍。红色轮廓说明卡：「深絆アキラのおすすめ」, 「『銀河英雄伝説 １』」, 「壮大な物語に、いつもワクワクします！」
4. 右下：一位安静、忧郁的少女，长长的黑发遮住部分面部，身穿灰棕色毛衣，一手托腮，另一只手拿着一本浅棕色的生活方式书籍。身后的书架包含极简生活、烹饪和生活类书籍；桌边放着一个小杯子。灰色轮廓说明卡：「黒波凪紗のおすすめ」, 「『暮らしを整える』」, 「シンプルな暮らしが、いちばん心地いい。」

视觉风格：高质量日本动漫插画，半写实柔和渲染，细腻的线条，细节丰富的手部和书籍，自然柔和的色调，温暖的木质书架，清晰易读的日文字体，温馨的生活气息。通过发型、服装、姿势和书籍选择，保持角色的独特性。

可自定义元素：使用角色群体主题 {argument name="character group theme" default="四位黑发且具有书卷气性格的年轻女性"}，书架背景 {argument name="bookshelf setting" default="安静图书馆内温暖的木质书架"}，说明卡语言 {argument name="caption language" default="日语"}，插画风格 {argument name="illustration style" default="柔和精致的日本动漫插画"}，以及面部处理 {argument name="face treatment" default="居中的柔和深色方形模糊遮挡面部"}。

约束：使用精确的四个面板和四本推荐书籍。确保所有说明卡可见且易读。不要添加额外的面板、角色、标志、水印、对话气泡或装饰贴纸。书架应保持真实感，不要塞得太满。

templates.title: Water Bottle Spilling in Desert

titleLocalized.zh: 沙漠中倾倒的水瓶

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic documentary-style photograph of a clear plastic water bottle lying horizontally on its side in a dry desert, pouring water from its open mouth onto cracked sandy ground. The bottle should be on the right side of the frame, transparent with blue-tinted threads at the neck, ridged sides, visible highlights and refractions, and partially filled with water. A continuous stream of water spills onto the foreground, forming a shallow muddy puddle with ripples, wet sand, small stones, and bright sparkling sunlight reflections. The camera is very low to the ground with a wide-angle close-up perspective and shallow depth of field: sharp focus on the bottle opening, water stream, puddle ripples, pebbles, and gritty desert texture, while the distant background is softly blurred. The environment is an arid desert plain under intense midday sun, with sparse dry shrubs, distant reddish-brown mountains along the horizon, and a clear saturated blue sky. Place the bright sun high in the upper left corner with starburst lens flare and harsh natural shadows. Use photorealistic lighting, crisp detail, realistic water physics, heat-dry atmosphere, no people, no labels or text on the bottle, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度写实的纪录片风格照片，画面中一个透明塑料水瓶横卧在干燥的沙漠中，瓶口敞开，水正倾泻在开裂的沙地上。水瓶位于画面右侧，瓶身透明，瓶颈处带有蓝色纹路，侧面有棱纹，呈现出清晰的亮光和折射效果，瓶内尚有部分余水。一股连续的水流倾泻至前景，形成浅浅的泥泞水洼，伴有涟漪、湿沙、小石子以及明亮闪烁的阳光反射。相机以极低的角度进行广角特写拍摄，并采用浅景深效果：焦点清晰地对准瓶口、水流、水洼涟漪、碎石和粗糙的沙漠质感，而远景则呈现柔和的虚化效果。环境为烈日下的干旱沙漠平原，点缀着稀疏的干枯灌木，地平线上可见红褐色的远山，天空呈现饱和的湛蓝色。明亮的太阳位于左上角，带有星芒状的镜头光晕和强烈的自然阴影。要求使用写实的布光，细节清晰，水体物理效果真实，营造出炎热干燥的氛围；画面中无人，瓶身无标签或文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Guitar Idol Contact Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫吉他偶像联系表

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ornate anime-style character contact sheet / film proof layout featuring {argument name="character name" default="Akari"}, a young female rock idol guitarist on a warm theater stage, with her face intentionally obscured by a soft square blur in every panel.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, dark black-brown background with thin antique gold borders, decorative corner flourishes, subtle film-strip motifs along the left side, a small crown icon near the upper left, a small sparkle icon, and a circular star emblem near the lower left. Use a polished cinematic anime illustration style with warm amber lighting.

Layout: Use exactly 7 image panels. Panel 1 is a large dominant portrait panel occupying the upper-left and center-left area. The other 6 panels are smaller alternate crops arranged as thumbnails: three stacked vertically on the right labeled 1, 2, 3, and three along the bottom labeled 4, 5, 6. Each panel has a thin gold frame, rounded corners, and small gold number plaques on the numbered thumbnails. Keep the layout slightly like a vintage film contact sheet or idol photo selection board.

Subject details: The same character appears in all 7 panels. She has {argument name="hair color" default="short chestnut-brown bob hair"} with small hair clips, a black lace choker, earrings, and a cute stage outfit: ivory puff-sleeve blouse with ruffles and a brown ribbon bow at the chest, black suspenders, brown plaid high-waisted mini skirt with belt, white thigh-high stockings, and subtle gold accessories. She holds a {argument name="guitar color" default="black electric guitar with white pickguard"} on a shoulder strap and stands at a microphone on a stand. Her pose varies slightly across panels: holding the mic, gripping the guitar neck, angled toward the viewer, and performing as if singing.

Background and lighting: In every panel, place her on a stage with tall golden curtains, strong vertical warm spotlight beams behind her, glowing amber backlight, and a few visible stage equipment details such as an amplifier at the edge. The atmosphere should feel like a dramatic live concert photo shoot.

Panel count and visible elements: Include exactly 7 repeated character images total: 1 large main image plus 6 smaller numbered thumbnails labeled 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. Include exactly 1 crown icon, 1 circular star emblem, and decorative film-strip graphics on the left border.

Constraints: Keep all text limited to the small numbers 1 through 6 only; do not add captions, logos, watermarks, or extra labels. Maintain consistent character design across all panels while allowing slightly different crops and poses. Use warm gold, black, cream, and brown as the main palette. The face must remain anonymized with a soft square blur in each panel.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个华丽的动漫风格角色联系表 / 样片布局，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Akari"}，一位在温暖剧院舞台上的年轻女性摇滚偶像吉他手，每个面板中她的面部均通过柔和的方形模糊处理进行遮挡。

画布：垂直 4:5 海报，深黑褐色背景，配有细致的古董金边、装饰性边角花纹、左侧微妙的胶片条纹图案、左上角附近的小皇冠图标、一个小闪光图标以及左下角附近的圆形星形徽章。采用精致的电影级动漫插画风格，配以温暖的琥珀色灯光。

布局：使用 7 个图像面板。面板 1 是占据左上和中左区域的大型主肖像面板。其他 6 个面板是作为缩略图排列的较小备选剪裁：右侧垂直堆叠三个，分别标记为 1、2、3；底部排列三个，分别标记为 4、5、6。每个面板都有细金框、圆角，编号缩略图上带有小型金色数字铭牌。布局需保持类似复古胶片联系表或偶像照片选择项目（board）的风格。

主体细节：同一角色出现在所有 7 个面板中。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色短波波头"}，戴着小发夹、黑色蕾丝颈圈、耳环，穿着可爱的舞台服装：象牙色泡泡袖衬衫，带有荷叶边和胸前的棕色丝带蝴蝶结、黑色背带、棕色格子高腰迷你裙、白色过膝袜以及精致的金色配饰。她肩背着一把 {argument name="guitar color" default="带白色护板的黑色电吉他"}，站在麦克风支架前。她的姿势在不同面板中略有变化：手持麦克风、握住吉他琴颈、侧向观众以及表演演唱时的姿态。

背景与灯光：在每个面板中，将她置于带有高大金色幕布的舞台上，身后有强烈的垂直暖色聚光灯束、发光的琥珀色背光，以及一些可见的舞台设备细节，如边缘的放大器。氛围应呈现出戏剧性的现场演唱会摄影感。

面板数量与可见元素：总共包含 7 个重复的角色图像：1 张大型主图加上 6 张编号为 1、2、3、4、5 和 6 的较小缩略图。包含 1 个皇冠图标、1 个圆形星形徽章以及左侧边框的装饰性胶片条纹图形。

约束：所有文字仅限于 1 到 6 的小数字；不要添加标题、Logo、水印或额外的标签。在保持所有面板中角色设计一致的同时，允许略有不同的剪裁和姿势。使用暖金色、黑色、奶油色和棕色作为主色调。每个面板中的面部必须通过柔和的方形模糊保持匿名化。

templates.title: Celestial Anime Idol Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 天体动漫偶像拼贴画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ornate anime idol character collage featuring {argument name="character name" default="Akari"}, a long-haired gothic star-themed performer shown in multiple poses like a collectible photo card layout.

Canvas: Vertical portrait image, roughly 3:4 aspect ratio, dark navy and warm gold palette, high-detail anime illustration with glossy lighting. Use a grand cathedral or concert-hall interior in the background, with tall arched windows, columns, warm backlight, floating confetti, tiny stars, and magical sparkle effects.

Layout: Build a symmetrical scrapbook/contact-sheet composition with exactly 7 character images total: 1 large central full-body panel and 6 smaller surrounding numbered panels. The 6 small panels are labeled in gold as 01 top-left, 02 top-right, 03 middle-left, 04 middle-right, 05 bottom-left, and 06 bottom-right. Each panel has a thin ornate gold frame, rounded corners, and small film-strip details along some edges. The central panel is the tallest, framed with decorative gold filigree at the top and a small plaque beneath it containing 5 icons: star, star, crown, star, star. At the bottom center between the lower panels, add a decorative gold eight-point star emblem, laurel branches, and a small curved film ribbon.

Subject details: The same anime girl appears in every panel. She has {argument name="hair color" default="very long black hair with cool blue highlights"}, straight glossy hair flowing past the waist, hair clips shaped like stars and crosses, pale skin, and a soft idol-girl presence. Her face should be visible and beautiful in the generated artwork, not obscured. Outfit: white puff-sleeve blouse with ruffled neckline, black ribbon bow at the chest, black choker with frills, high-waisted navy-black flared skirt with white ruffle hem and starry galaxy gradient, wide black belt with silver ring buckle, dangling star-chain accessories at the hip, black fingerless gloves, bracelets, thigh straps or garter details, and subtle silver jewelry. Overall theme: gothic-lolita idol, celestial night-sky motifs, elegant yet energetic.

Panel contents: Show exactly these 7 poses: central full-body pose facing forward, making a peace sign near her face with one hand; panel 01 upper-body pose holding a microphone near her waist; panel 02 upper-body pose with one hand near her collar or choker; panel 03 half-body pose holding a microphone downward; panel 04 upper-body pose with one gloved hand raised near her face; panel 05 side/back three-quarter pose looking over her shoulder with hair flowing dramatically; panel 06 upper-body cheerful idol pose with both hands raised in small finger-heart or pointing gestures and a large microphone floating or angled at the lower right.

Visual style: Premium Japanese anime key visual, crisp linework, luminous eyes, polished skin shading, layered hair highlights, intricate clothing folds, deep navy shadows, gold trim, cinematic rim lighting, soft bokeh, sparkles, confetti, and a luxurious idol trading-card aesthetic. Use high resolution and dense decorative detail without clutter.

Text content: Only include the small gold panel numbers 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06 and the tiny symbolic plaque icons under the central panel; avoid extra readable text.

Constraints: Keep exactly 7 character depictions and exactly 6 numbered small panels. Maintain one consistent character and outfit across all panels. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, or modern UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张华丽的动漫偶像角色拼贴画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Akari"}，一位长发的哥特星空主题表演者，以类似收藏卡片的布局展示多种姿势。

画布：竖向肖像图，比例约为 3:4，采用深海军蓝与暖金色调，高细节动漫插画，带有光泽感光效。背景使用宏伟的大教堂或音乐厅室内场景，配有高大的拱形窗户、立柱、温暖的背光、漂浮的五彩纸屑、微小的星星以及魔法闪光效果。

布局：构建一个对称的剪贴簿/联系表构图，总共包含 7 个角色图像：1 个大型中央全身图，以及 6 个周围较小的编号图格。6 个小图格以金色标注为 01 左上、02 右上、03 左中、04 右中、05 左下和 06 右下。每个图格都有细致的金色边框、圆角，部分边缘带有胶片条细节。中央图格最高，顶部饰有装饰性金色花丝，下方有一块小铭牌，包含 5 个图标：星星、星星、皇冠、星星、星星。在底部中央两个下层图格之间，添加一个装饰性的金色八角星徽章、月桂枝和一条弯曲的胶片丝带。

主体细节：每个图格中均为同一位动漫少女。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有冷蓝色挑染的超长黑发"}，直顺且富有光泽的长发垂至腰间，佩戴星星和十字架形状的发夹，肤色白皙，散发着温柔的偶像气质。在生成的艺术作品中，她的面部应清晰可见且美丽，不被遮挡。服装：白色泡泡袖衬衫，领口有荷叶边，胸前系黑色丝带蝴蝶结，佩戴带有褶边的黑色颈圈，高腰海军黑百褶裙，裙摆带有白色荷叶边和星系渐变，宽大的黑色腰带配银色环扣，腰间有垂坠的星形链条配饰，黑色露指手套，手镯，大腿绑带或吊袜带细节，以及精致的银饰。整体主题：哥特洛丽塔偶像，天体夜空元素，优雅而充满活力。

图格内容：展示以下 7 种姿势：中央全身姿势正面朝向，一只手在脸旁比出剪刀手；图格 01 上半身姿势，腰间拿着麦克风；图格 02 上半身姿势，一只手靠近领口或颈圈；图格 03 半身姿势，麦克风向下握持；图格 04 上半身姿势，一只戴手套的手举在脸旁；图格 05 侧面/背面四分之三姿势，回眸看向肩后，头发戏剧性地飘动；图格 06 上半身欢快的偶像姿势，双手举起比出小指心或指向手势，右下角有一个悬浮或倾斜的大麦克风。

视觉风格：优质日本动漫主视觉图，线条清晰，眼睛明亮，皮肤阴影细腻，头发高光分层，衣褶复杂，深海军蓝阴影，金色装饰，电影级轮廓光，柔和的虚化效果，闪光，五彩纸屑，以及奢华的偶像集换式卡牌美学。使用高分辨率，在不杂乱的前提下呈现密集的装饰细节。

文本内容：仅包含小型的金色图格编号 01、02、03、04、05、06 以及中央图格下方微小的符号铭牌图标；避免添加额外的可读文本。

约束：保持恰好 7 个角色描绘和恰好 6 个编号小图格。在所有图格中保持角色和服装的一致性。不要添加额外的角色、徽标、水印、对话气泡或现代 UI 元素。

templates.title: Chibi Sparrow Four-Pose Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版麻雀四姿态展示图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean character pose sheet of a cute chibi sparrow mascot, showing exactly 4 discrete poses on a plain white background.

Canvas: Square 1:1 canvas, high resolution, no border, no text, no shadows or scenery. Arrange the bird poses in a balanced 2-by-2 grid with generous white space between them.

Subject details: The character is a round, front-facing chibi {argument name="bird species" default="sparrow"} with an oversized head and tiny body. It has a warm chestnut-brown head, glossy black bead eyes with small white highlights, a short dark charcoal beak, cream-colored cheeks and fluffy cream belly, dark cheek patches, tiny brown feet with little claws, and layered orange-brown wings with darker feather tips. Use a cute sticker-like anime illustration style with clean dark outlines, soft cel shading, painterly feather details, and a polished mascot design.

Pose count and layout: Include exactly 4 separate full-body bird drawings: 1) top left, wings raised high vertically in an excited upward flap; 2) top right, wings spread straight outward horizontally; 3) bottom left, wings hanging downward along the sides in a resting/downstroke pose; 4) bottom right, wings spread outward again in a symmetrical mid-flap pose. All 4 birds should face forward and keep the same facial expression and proportions.

Visual style: Adorable Japanese game mascot / sticker art, crisp linework, warm natural browns and creams, detailed layered feathers, soft highlights, clean white background, centered composition.

Constraints: Show exactly four poses, no extra birds, no labels, no accessories, no environment, no watermark, no cropped wings or feet.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的 Q 版麻雀吉祥物角色姿态展示图，在纯白背景上精确展示 4 种不同的姿态。

画布：1:1 正方形画布，高分辨率，无边框，无文字，无阴影或背景。将鸟类姿态以 2x2 网格均衡排列，并留出充足的留白。

主体细节：该角色为一个圆润、正面朝向的 Q 版 {argument name="bird species" default="麻雀"}，拥有超大的头部和娇小的身体。它有着温暖的栗棕色头部、带有白色高光的亮黑色豆豆眼、短小的深炭灰色喙、奶油色的脸颊和蓬松的奶油色腹部、深色颊斑、带有小爪子的棕色细足，以及带有深色羽尖的层叠橙棕色翅膀。采用可爱的贴纸风格动漫插画，线条清晰，带有柔和的赛璐珞阴影、细腻的羽毛细节以及精致的吉祥物设计。

姿态数量与布局：包含 4 个完整的全身鸟类绘图：1) 左上角，翅膀高高竖起，呈兴奋的向上拍打状；2) 右上角，翅膀向两侧水平伸展；3) 左下角，翅膀沿身体两侧下垂，呈休息/下拍姿态；4) 右下角，翅膀再次向外伸展，呈对称的中拍姿态。所有 4 只鸟均需正面朝向，并保持相同的面部表情和比例。

视觉风格：可爱的日本游戏吉祥物/贴纸艺术，线条利落，温暖的自然棕色与奶油色调，细腻的层叠羽毛，柔和的高光，纯净的白色背景，构图居中。

约束条件：仅展示四种姿态，不得包含多余的鸟类、标签、配饰、环境、水印，且翅膀或足部不得被裁剪。

templates.title: Stylish Japanese Summer Fan Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 时尚日式夏季团扇插画

templates.prompt: Create a stylish contemporary Japanese summer illustration on a clean white vertical canvas, centered on one traditional round uchiwa fan with a bamboo handle. The fan face should be teal and deep blue with layered translucent graphic shapes, combining ukiyo-e-inspired motifs and modern poster design. Show exactly 6 main decorative motif groups on and around the fan: 1) a white flowing river or wave ribbon sweeping from the lower left across the fan, 2) green bamboo leaves clustered across the upper left edge, 3) morning glory flowers on the right side with one large pink bloom, one large navy bloom, and several small dark blue blossoms, 4) round green leaves near the flowers and lower left, 5) a partial pale parasol-like circular arc with cream and coral bands behind the upper right of the fan, and 6) abstract halftone dots, splatter marks, and diagonal geometric strokes in turquoise, lime green, coral pink, and navy around the fan. Render the fan ribs and frame as realistic pale bamboo, with many thin spokes radiating from the base, a small turquoise binding at the handle joint, and a natural bamboo handle extending downward. Use a crisp mixed-media look: flat vector illustration blended with subtle paper texture, screen-print halftones, translucent overlays, fine white vertical fan fold lines, and slight shadows to give the fan depth. Keep the composition airy and elegant with generous white space. Add a small date and artist signature in the bottom right reading {argument name="date text" default="May 15, 2026"} and {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}. Use a refined fashionable illustration mood inspired by Japanese summer, with dominant colors {argument name="main palette" default="teal, indigo, lime green, white, coral pink"}. No extra text, no watermark, no border.

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的白色竖构图画布上创作一幅时尚的当代日式夏季插画，画面中心为一把带有竹柄的传统圆形团扇。扇面应呈现青色和深蓝色，并带有层叠的半透明图形形状，融合浮世绘风格的图案与现代海报设计。在扇面及周围展示 6 组主要的装饰图案：1）一条从左下角横跨扇面的白色流动河流或波浪丝带，2）簇拥在左上边缘的绿色竹叶，3）右侧的牵牛花，包含一朵大的粉色花朵、一朵大的深蓝色花朵以及几朵小型的深蓝色花苞，4）花朵附近和左下角的圆形绿叶，5）扇面上方右侧背景中带有奶油色和珊瑚色条纹的半圆形遮阳伞状弧线，以及 6）扇面周围青绿色、亮绿色、珊瑚粉色和深蓝色的抽象半调圆点、喷溅痕迹和对角线几何笔触。将扇骨和框架渲染为写实的浅色竹子，底部放射出许多细密的扇骨，手柄连接处有小巧的青绿色绑带，天然竹柄向下延伸。采用清爽的混合媒介风格：扁平矢量插画与细腻的纸张纹理、丝网印刷半调、半透明叠加层、细微的白色竖向扇褶线条相结合，并添加轻微阴影以赋予团扇深度感。保持构图空灵优雅，留出充足的空白。在右下角添加日期和艺术家签名，内容分别为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 15 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。采用受日式夏季启发的高雅时尚插画氛围，主色调为 {argument name="main palette" default="青色、靛蓝色、亮绿色、白色、珊瑚粉色"}。无额外文字，无水印，无边框。

templates.title: Chronowa Black Cat Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Chronowa 黑猫角色设定表

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a monochrome-and-red Japanese character reference sheet for {argument name="character name" default="CHRONOWA"}, a cute cool black cat mascot who listens to night sounds, wearing white sunglasses and red headphones.

Canvas: Vertical A4 poster / character sheet, off-white paper background with thin black border, red corner accents, small halftone dots, barcode, waveform graphics, tiny city skyline silhouettes, and a red crescent moon. Palette is strict: black, white, gray, and vivid red only. Style is clean vector mascot design mixed with Japanese graphic-design infographic aesthetics.

Top header: Large Japanese title 「クロノワ」 followed by “/ {argument name="romanized name" default="CHRONOWA"}”. Subtitle underneath: 「夜の音を聴く黒猫」 with a small red audio waveform line. Add a black city skyline at the top right under a red crescent moon.

Main subject: Center the largest full-body front view of the black cat, sitting upright with a curled tail, large pointed ears, thin whiskers, oversized white sunglasses with black lenses and white highlights, and red-and-black headphones resting around the neck. Label this central view 「正面」.

Left column poses: Include exactly 3 smaller pose panels with black label tabs: 1) 「側面」 side view, sitting profile, wearing white sunglasses and red headphones around the neck; 2) 「リスニング」 listening pose, headphones worn over the ears, paws touching headphones, small music note; 3) 「リラックス」 relaxed lying pose, sunglasses on, headphones around neck.

Right column item and mood panels: Include an item box labeled 「アイテム」 with exactly 2 items: 1) white sunglasses labeled 「白いサングラス」, 2) red headphones labeled 「赤いヘッドホン」. Below it, include a mood icon box labeled 「表情・ムードアイコン」 with exactly 6 small black cat icons in a 2-column by 3-row grid, each wearing sunglasses: 1) 「ごきげん」 with music note and raised tail, 2) 「気まぐれ」 sitting with subtle motion marks, 3) 「照れ」 shy blushing / embarrassed pose, 4) 「警戒」 alert pose with motion marks, 5) 「やさしい」 gentle pose with a small red heart, 6) 「生意気」 cocky/annoyed pose with red anger mark.

Bottom information grid: Create exactly 8 bordered information cards with black angled headers and red section numbers. Card 01 「プロフィール」 lists: 種族：黒猫, 性別：不詳, 年齢：不明, 一人称：ボク, 住処：夜の街. Card 02 「性格」 lists exactly 5 bullet points: クール, 気まぐれ, 照れ屋, 実はやさしい, 少し生意気. Card 03 「特徴」 lists exactly 4 bullet points: 白いサングラス, 赤いヘッドホン, 音の色が見える, 街の感情を聴ける. Card 04 「好きなもの」 lists exactly 4 lines: 夜の街 / 音楽 / 屋上 / 赤いもの / 雨上がりの道路, plus a red hand-drawn heart. Card 05 「苦手なもの」 lists exactly 3 lines: 強い日差し / 大きすぎる音 / しつこい相手, with a red sun warning icon. Card 06 「能力」 lists exactly 4 bullet points: 音を聴き分ける, 夜道に詳しい, 気配を消すのが得意, 小さな幸運を運ぶ, plus a tiny cat silhouette and red star. Card 07 「設定」 contains a compact Japanese backstory about red headphones collecting memories and emotions of the city at night, and how the cat sees sound colors through white sunglasses. Card 08 「セリフ」 contains exactly 4 quotes: 「今夜の音、悪くないね」, 「昼は苦手。」, 「世界が明るすぎる」, 「いい夜だね。少しだけ、歩こうか」, with a red paw print.

Footer: Add a barcode at bottom left, the word “CHRONOWA”, a red handwritten “meow”, a small black skyline silhouette along the bottom, and “LISTEN TO THE NIGHT.” at the bottom right.

Visual style: Sharp flat vector shapes, slightly imperfect printed zine texture, clean Japanese UI label tabs, thin technical lines, red accents on tabs and icons, high contrast silhouette cat. Keep text legible, preserve all Japanese labels exactly, and do not add extra characters or extra panels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="CHRONOWA"} 创建一份黑红配色的日式角色参考表。这是一只可爱又酷的黑猫吉祥物，喜欢聆听夜晚的声音，佩戴白色太阳镜和红色耳机。

画布：竖版 A4 海报 / 角色设定表，米白色纸张背景，带有黑色细边框、红色边角装饰、细小的半调网点、条形码、波形图、微型城市天际线剪影以及一轮红色新月。配色严格限制：仅限黑色、白色、灰色和鲜红色。风格为简洁的矢量吉祥物设计，融合日式平面设计信息图美学。

顶部标题：大号日文标题「クロノワ」，后接“/ {argument name="romanized name" default="CHRONOWA"}”。下方副标题：「夜の音を聴く黒猫」，配有一条红色的小型音频波形线。在红色新月下方右侧添加黑色城市天际线。

主体：中心放置最大的黑猫全身正面图，坐姿挺拔，尾巴卷曲，尖耳朵，细胡须，佩戴超大号白色太阳镜（黑色镜片，带白色高光），脖子上挂着红黑配色的耳机。该中心视图标注为「正面」。

左侧栏姿势：包含 3 个带黑色标签的小型姿势面板：1) 「側面」侧视图，坐姿侧影，佩戴白色太阳镜，耳机挂在脖子上；2) 「リスニング」聆听姿势，耳机戴在耳朵上，爪子触碰耳机，配有小音符；3) 「リラックス」放松的躺姿，戴着太阳镜，耳机挂在脖子上。

右侧栏道具与情绪面板：包含一个标注为「アイテム」的道具框，内含 2 件道具：1) 标注为「白いサングラス」的白色太阳镜，2) 标注为「赤いヘッドホン」的红色耳机。下方包含一个标注为「表情・ムードアイコン」的情绪图标框，采用 2 列 3 行的网格排列 6 个佩戴太阳镜的小黑猫图标：1) 「ごきげん」（带音符和翘起的尾巴），2) 「気まぐれ」（坐姿，带细微动作线），3) 「照れ」（害羞脸红），4) 「警戒」（警觉姿势，带动作线），5) 「やさしい」（温柔姿势，带一颗红色小爱心），6) 「生意気」（傲慢/烦躁姿势，带红色愤怒标记）。

底部信息网格：创建 8 个带黑色斜角标题和红色章节编号的边框信息卡。卡片 01 「プロフィール」列出：种族：黑猫，性别：不详，年龄：不明，第一人称：ボク，住处：夜之街。卡片 02 「性格」列出 5 个要点：酷、随性、害羞、其实很温柔、有点傲慢。卡片 03 「特徴」列出 4 个要点：白色太阳镜、红色耳机、能看到声音的颜色、能听见城市的感情。卡片 04 「好きなもの」列出 4 行：夜之街 / 音乐 / 屋顶 / 红色物品 / 雨后的道路，并配有一颗手绘红色爱心。卡片 05 「苦手なもの」列出 3 行：强烈的阳光 / 过大的声音 / 纠缠不休的人，并配有一个红色太阳警告图标。卡片 06 「能力」列出 4 个要点：分辨声音、熟悉夜路、擅长消除气息、带来小小的幸运，并配有一个微型猫剪影和红色星星。卡片 07 「設定」包含一段简短的日文背景故事，讲述红色耳机收集夜晚城市的记忆与情感，以及黑猫如何通过白色太阳镜看到声音的颜色。卡片 08 「セリフ」包含 4 句台词：「今夜の音、悪くないね」、「昼は苦手。」、「世界が明るすぎる」、「いい夜だね。少しだけ、歩こうか」，并配有一个红色猫爪印。

页脚：左下角添加条形码，文字“CHRONOWA”，手写红色“meow”，底部沿线添加小型黑色天际线，右下角标注“LISTEN TO THE NIGHT.”。

视觉风格：锐利的扁平矢量图形，带有轻微不完美的印刷杂志质感，简洁的日式 UI 标签，细致的技术线条，标签和图标上的红色点缀，高对比度猫咪剪影。保持文字清晰易读，完整保留所有日文标签，不要添加额外的字符或面板。

templates.title: Subway Idol Birthday Billboard

titleLocalized.zh: 地铁偶像生日应援灯箱

templates.prompt: Create a realistic wide-angle documentary photo inside a clean Korean subway station corridor with tiled walls, ceiling panels, polished gray floor, and platform signage in the background. On the left foreground stands a young woman with long dark hair, wearing an oversized blue denim jacket, white graphic T-shirt, black mini skirt, and casual shoes, smiling but with her face anonymized by a soft rectangular blur; she poses with both hands pointing toward a giant illuminated wall billboard. The billboard fills the right two-thirds of the image, framed in black, and shows a pastel idol birthday advertisement with a large portrait of the same young woman also anonymized by a rectangular blur over the face, long dark hair, denim jacket, and white shirt. The billboard design has a dreamy pink-to-turquoise blue gradient background with sparkles, bokeh, floating petals, small wing and heart decorations, and a small crown above a pink ribbon banner. Include Korean fan-ad typography: the ribbon reads “여신 탄신일”, the huge central name reads “윤슬”, smaller Korean congratulatory lines sit beneath it, and the large date reads “1996.02.15”; along the bottom edge include tiny English text like “YOONSEUL DAY • ALWAYS BE WITH YOU • FROM YOUR STARLIGHT”. Make the scene feel like a celebratory K-pop fan subway birthday ad photo, with natural station lighting, slight lens distortion, realistic reflections, sharp billboard text, and no extra people in the foreground. Customizable details: use the featured name {argument name="character name" default="윤슬"}, birthday date {argument name="birthday date" default="1996.02.15"}, ribbon text {argument name="ribbon text" default="여신 탄신일"}, billboard color palette {argument name="billboard color palette" default="pastel pink and turquoise blue"}, and outfit {argument name="outfit" default="oversized blue denim jacket, white graphic T-shirt, and black mini skirt"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的广角纪实照片，背景为整洁的韩国地铁站走廊，包含瓷砖墙面、天花板面板、抛光灰色地面以及背景中的站台标识。左侧前景站着一位留着深色长发的年轻女性，身穿超大款蓝色牛仔外套、白色印花 T 恤、黑色短裙和休闲鞋，面带微笑，但面部通过柔和的矩形模糊处理进行了匿名化；她双手指向一侧巨大的发光墙面灯箱。灯箱占据了图像右侧三分之二的区域，带有黑色边框，展示着一张粉彩色的偶像生日应援广告，上面印有同一位年轻女性的大幅肖像，其面部同样经过矩形模糊处理，保留长发、牛仔外套和白色衬衫的特征。灯箱设计采用梦幻般的粉色到青蓝色渐变背景，带有闪光、光斑、漂浮花瓣、小型翅膀和爱心装饰，粉色丝带横幅上方有一个小皇冠。包含韩语粉丝应援排版：丝带上写着“여신 탄신일”，中央巨大的名字写着“윤슬”，下方配有较小的韩语祝贺语，大号日期写着“1996.02.15”；底部边缘包含细小的英文文本，如“YOONSEUL DAY • ALWAYS BE WITH YOU • FROM YOUR STARLIGHT”。营造出 K-pop 粉丝地铁生日应援照片的庆祝氛围，具备自然的车站照明、轻微的镜头畸变、写实的反射效果、清晰的灯箱文字，且前景中没有其他行人。可自定义细节：使用角色名称 {argument name="character name" default="윤슬"}、生日日期 {argument name="birthday date" default="1996.02.15"}、丝带文字 {argument name="ribbon text" default="여신 탄신일"}、灯箱配色方案 {argument name="billboard color palette" default="粉色与青蓝色"} 以及服装 {argument name="outfit" default="超大款蓝色牛仔外套、白色印花 T 恤和黑色短裙"}。

titleLocalized.zh: 地铁生日应援灯箱照片

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic candid photo in a subway or underground station hallway showing a young woman posing beside a large digital birthday advertisement billboard for herself.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 photo, eye-level perspective, wide framing. Beige tiled station wall with grout lines and a polished gray floor. Fluorescent ceiling reflections and clean public-transit interior lighting.

Main subject: One young Korean woman stands on the left side of the frame, full body visible from head to upper thighs. She has long dark hair and wears a fitted black long-sleeve top, light blue high-waisted denim shorts with frayed hems, and a small black shoulder bag. Her face is covered by a rectangular soft blur privacy block. She smiles/poses toward the camera and points with both hands toward the billboard.

Billboard: One large horizontal digital screen mounted on the wall to the right, with a thick black frame. The billboard shows a pastel birthday fan-ad design for {argument name="character name" default="윤슬"}. The design is pink on the left blending into blue on the right, with dreamy clouds, sparkles, hearts, bubbles, and a large portrait of the same woman on the right side of the billboard. The portrait face is also covered by a large rectangular soft blur privacy block.

Text content on billboard: Include exactly 6 visible text groups: 1) small English text “HAPPY BIRTHDAY” near the upper left, 2) very large Korean name “윤슬” centered-left in pink and blue bubble lettering, 3) date “1996.02.15” below the name, 4) pink ribbon label “여신 탄신일”, 5) small handwritten Korean line near the lower left, “세상에서 가장 빛나는 순간, 언제나 윤슬과 함께할게 ♡”, 6) handwritten Korean message on the right, “윤슬아, 생일 축하해! 너의 모든 순간을 응원해. 사랑해 ♡”.

Visual style: Photorealistic smartphone travel snapshot, natural station lighting, slight wide-angle lens, realistic reflections on the billboard glass, subtle depth of field but most elements readable. The birthday billboard should look professionally designed and luminous, while the surrounding subway wall remains neutral and realistic.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 posing woman, exactly 1 wall-mounted digital billboard, exactly 2 blurred face privacy rectangles, and exactly 6 billboard text groups. Do not add extra people, extra signs, watermarks, logos, or unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：在地铁或地下车站走廊中创作一张写实的抓拍照片，展示一位年轻女性站在自己大型数字生日应援灯箱旁摆拍的场景。

画布：横向 16:9 照片，平视视角，广角构图。米色瓷砖车站墙面带有缝隙，地面为抛光灰色。带有天花板荧光灯反射，呈现干净的公共交通内部照明效果。

主体：一位年轻韩国女性站在画面左侧，全身可见（从头部到大腿上部）。她留着长黑发，身穿黑色修身长袖上衣、浅蓝色高腰牛仔短裤（带毛边），背着一个小号黑色单肩包。她的面部被一个长方形的柔和模糊遮挡块覆盖。她对着镜头微笑/摆姿势，双手指向灯箱。

灯箱：右侧墙上安装着一块大型横向数字屏幕，带有厚实的黑色边框。灯箱展示了为 {argument name="character name" default="윤슬"} 设计的粉彩风格生日应援海报。设计左侧为粉色，向右过渡为蓝色，带有梦幻云朵、闪光、爱心、泡泡，右侧是同一位女性的大幅肖像。肖像面部同样被一个长方形的柔和模糊遮挡块覆盖。

灯箱文字内容：包含 6 组清晰可见的文字：1) 左上角的小号英文“HAPPY BIRTHDAY”，2) 左侧居中位置用粉蓝泡泡字体书写的超大韩文名字“윤슬”，3) 名字下方的日期“1996.02.15”，4) 粉色丝带标签“여신 탄신일”，5) 左下角的手写韩文短句“세상에서 가장 빛나는 순간, 언제나 윤슬과 함께할게 ♡”，6) 右侧的手写韩文寄语“윤슬아, 생일 축하해! 너의 모든 순간을 응원해. 사랑해 ♡”。

视觉风格：写实的智能手机旅行快照，自然的车站照明，轻微广角镜头，灯箱玻璃上有真实的反射，具有细微的景深效果，但大部分元素清晰可辨。生日灯箱应看起来设计专业且明亮，同时周围的地铁墙面保持中性且写实。

约束条件：仅使用 1 位摆姿势的女性，仅使用 1 个壁挂式数字灯箱，仅使用 2 个模糊面部的隐私遮挡块，且灯箱文字必须包含 6 组。请勿添加额外人物、额外标志、水印、Logo 或无关文字。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic smartphone-style photo taken in a subway station, showing a young woman posing beside a large wall-mounted digital birthday advertisement for a K-pop idol.

Canvas: Horizontal 3:2 photo, eye-level perspective, natural indoor station lighting, slight wide-angle lens look.

Setting: Clean subway corridor with glossy off-white square tiled walls and dark grout, gray stone floor, black base trim, ceiling panels visible at the top, and a small green rectangular sign on the left wall. A large black-framed digital billboard is mounted on the tiled wall, occupying most of the right side of the image.

Main subject: One young woman stands on the left side of the frame in front of the billboard. She has long dark wavy hair and wears a sleeveless short white summer dress with thin straps and a small bow at the chest. She smiles toward the camera, but her face is covered by a soft-edged opaque taupe privacy rectangle. Billboard design: The digital screen shows a pastel pink-and-sky-blue birthday fan ad with sparkles, stars, soft clouds, translucent heart shapes, and a magical swoosh arc in the top-right. On the left half of the billboard is a large glamour portrait of a young woman with long dark hair and bare shoulders; her face is also covered by a large opaque taupe privacy rectangle. The billboard has exactly six visible text elements: 1) small English greeting at the top, 2) large Korean name in teal, 3) date line, 4) large Korean birthday phrase, 5) smaller Korean congratulatory message, 6) teal rounded footer label.

Text content: Use the top greeting {argument name="top greeting" default="Happy Seul Day"}. Use the large central Korean name {argument name="idol name text" default="윤슬"}. Use the date {argument name="birthday date" default="1996.02.15"}. Use the birthday phrase {argument name="birthday phrase" default="여신 탄신일"}. Use the small message and footer text {argument name="fan message" default="사랑스러운 윤슬아, 생일 축하해! 언제나 빛나는 너를 응원해 ♥ / from. 슬의 모든 순간을 사랑하는 팬들"}. Visual style: Photorealistic candid fan photo, realistic shadows and reflections on the digital screen, crisp billboard details, slightly muted station colors contrasted with the bright pastel ad. Do not add extra people, extra posters, watermarks, or additional text beyond the six specified text elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张在地铁站拍摄的写实风格手机照片，展示一位年轻女性站在大型墙面数字生日应援广告牌旁摆拍。

画布：水平 3:2 照片，平视视角，自然室内车站灯光，轻微广角镜头感。

场景：整洁的地铁走廊，配有光面灰白色方形瓷砖墙和深色填缝剂，灰色石材地面，黑色踢脚线，顶部可见天花板面板，左侧墙上有一个小型绿色长方形标志。墙上安装了一个大型黑色边框数字广告牌，占据了图像右侧的大部分区域。

主体：一位年轻女性站在画面左侧，广告牌前方。她留着深色长卷发，身穿无袖短款白色夏日吊带裙，胸前有一个小蝴蝶结。她对着镜头微笑，但面部被一个边缘柔和的不透明灰褐色隐私遮挡块遮住。她的姿势包含两个明确的指向动作：左手横过身体指向广告牌，右手向上指向广告牌。

广告牌设计：数字屏幕显示一张粉色与天蓝色调的生日粉丝应援广告，带有闪光、星星、柔和云朵、半透明心形图案，以及右上角的梦幻弧线。广告牌左半部分是一位年轻女性的大幅魅力肖像，她留着深色长发，露出双肩；她的脸部同样被一个大型不透明灰褐色隐私遮挡块遮住。广告牌上有 6 个可见的文字元素：1) 顶部的简短英文问候，2) 青色的大号韩文名字，3) 日期行，4) 大号韩文生日短语，5) 较小的韩文祝贺信息，6) 青色圆角页脚标签。

文本内容：使用顶部问候语 {argument name="top greeting" default="Happy Seul Day"}。使用中央大号韩文名字 {argument name="idol name text" default="윤슬"}。使用日期 {argument name="birthday date" default="1996.02.15"}。使用生日短语 {argument name="birthday phrase" default="여신 탄신일"}。使用小号信息和页脚文本 {argument name="fan message" default="사랑스러운 윤슬아, 생일 축하해! 언제나 빛나는 너를 응원해 ♥ / from. 슬의 모든 순간을 사랑하는 팬들"}。排版应采用优雅的青色衬线风格韩文字体，名字最大，生日短语次之，页脚文本为白色并置于青色圆角矩形内。

视觉风格：写实风格的粉丝抓拍照片，数字屏幕上有逼真的阴影和反光，广告牌细节清晰，车站色彩略显柔和，与明亮的粉彩色广告形成对比。请勿添加额外人物、海报、水印或除上述 6 个指定文本元素之外的任何额外文字。

templates.title: Desert Military Outpost

titleLocalized.zh: 沙漠军事前哨站

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic wide-angle scene of a fortified desert military communications outpost at golden hour, inspired by a modern tactical video game environment. The camera is low to the ground and slightly Dutch-tilted, looking up a dusty dirt road toward a concrete checkpoint compound with a central watchtower/control building, an open dark garage door, stacked concrete barriers, sand-filled blast walls, chain-link fencing, metal catwalks, pipes, antennas, and a large parabolic satellite dish on the roof to the right. Add exactly 2 visible text markings: a concrete barrier in the lower left reading “{argument name="barrier text" default="G.T.I HAWK"}” and a vertical banner on the tower reading “{argument name="banner text" default="G.T.I HAWK"}” with a simple hawk-like emblem. Surround the base with arid desert details: rocky cliffs on the left, several palm trees, scrub grass, dry weeds, scattered crates and utility boxes, worn road tracks, and tan stone walls framing the foreground. Use warm orange sunset light, dramatic partly cloudy sky, long shadows, dusty atmospheric haze, realistic weathered concrete and metal textures, high dynamic range, sharp environmental detail, no people, no vehicles, no UI, no watermark. Overall mood: tense, abandoned, tactical, sun-baked desert base in {argument name="setting" default="Middle Eastern desert"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级、写实风格的广角场景，描绘一个处于黄金时刻的沙漠军事通信前哨站，灵感源自现代战术电子游戏环境。摄像机位置贴近地面并略微倾斜（Dutch-tilted），沿着尘土飞扬的土路向上拍摄，视野中是一个带有混凝土检查站的复合建筑，包含一个中央哨塔/控制楼、一扇敞开的深色车库门、堆叠的混凝土路障、防爆沙墙、铁丝网围栏、金属猫道、管道、天线，以及右侧屋顶上巨大的抛物面卫星天线。添加 2 处清晰可见的文字标记：左下方的混凝土路障上写着“{argument name="barrier text" default="G.T.I HAWK"}”，塔楼上的垂直横幅写着“{argument name="banner text" default="G.T.I HAWK"}”并配有一个简单的鹰形徽章。基地周围环绕着干旱的沙漠细节：左侧的岩石悬崖、几棵棕榈树、灌木丛、干草、散落的板条箱和工具箱、磨损的车辙，以及构成前景框架的黄褐色石墙。使用温暖的橙色夕阳灯光、戏剧性的多云天空、长长的阴影、尘土飞扬的大气雾霾、逼真的风化混凝土和金属纹理、高动态范围、清晰的环境细节，画面中无人、无车辆、无 UI、无水印。整体氛围：紧张、废弃、战术感，位于 {argument name="setting" default="中东沙漠"} 中被烈日炙烤的沙漠基地。

templates.title: Hanfu Selfie With Privacy Block

titleLocalized.zh: 汉服自拍（带隐私遮挡）

templates.prompt: Create a warm cinematic vertical selfie portrait of a young woman in ornate Chinese hanfu, shot from a high close-up angle with her left arm extended toward the camera. Her face is completely covered by a centered opaque square privacy block in medium warm brown, hiding all facial features. She has dark brown to black hair styled in an elaborate half-up traditional updo with long loose strands falling over both shoulders. Add exactly two large pale aqua-and-white floral hair ornaments, one on each side of the updo, with gold filigree branches, pearl beads, and exactly two long dangling tassel accessories visible, one on the left side and one on the right side. She wears a delicate pale mint blue embroidered hanfu with sheer flowing sleeves, peach-gold floral embroidery, translucent layers, a high collar, and a decorative chest panel with gold trim, pearl-like beads, and a central dangling pale blue pendant. The setting is an intimate traditional East Asian room with warm amber candlelight, wooden window lattice panels in the background, a calligraphy scroll on the left wall with black brush characters, and a glowing paper lantern plus two small candles on a low table. Use shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, warm highlights on hair jewelry, realistic fabric texture, romantic historical-drama styling, and a cozy golden-hour interior atmosphere. Make the composition feel like an accidental elegant selfie, with the sleeve and arm slightly blurred in the foreground and the ornate costume details sharply visible. Use {argument name="outfit color" default="pale mint blue"}, {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown to black"}, {argument name="privacy block color" default="warm medium brown"}, {argument name="room lighting" default="warm amber candlelight"}, and {argument name="background decor" default="calligraphy scroll, wooden lattice windows, paper lantern, and two candles"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖且具有电影质感的竖屏自拍肖像，主角是一位身着华丽中国汉服的年轻女性，采用高位特写角度拍摄，左臂向镜头方向伸展。她的面部被一个位于中心位置、中等暖棕色的不透明隐私方块完全遮挡，隐藏了所有面部特征。她留着深棕色至黑色的长发，梳成精致的半盘传统发髻，长发丝垂落在双肩。在发髻两侧各添加一个大型淡青色与白色相间的花卉发饰，配有金色花丝枝条、珍珠珠饰，并清晰可见左右两侧各一个长流苏挂饰。她身着精致的淡薄荷蓝刺绣汉服，袖口轻盈飘逸，饰有桃金色花卉刺绣和半透明层叠设计，高领口，胸前有装饰性面板，配有金边、珍珠状珠饰及中央垂下的淡蓝色吊坠。场景设定在一个温馨的传统东亚风格房间，充满温暖的琥珀色烛光，背景为木质窗棂，左侧墙上挂着带有黑色毛笔字的字画卷轴，低矮的桌上放着一个发光的纸灯笼和两支小蜡烛。使用浅景深、柔和的焦外成像效果，发饰上带有温暖的高光，呈现真实的织物纹理，营造浪漫的历史剧风格和舒适的黄金时刻室内氛围。构图呈现出一种随性优雅的自拍感，前景中的袖子和手臂略微模糊，而华丽的服装细节清晰可见。使用 {argument name="outfit color" default="淡薄荷蓝"}、{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色至黑色"}、{argument name="privacy block color" default="暖中棕色"}、{argument name="room lighting" default="温暖的琥珀色烛光"} 以及 {argument name="background decor" default="字画卷轴、木质窗棂、纸灯笼和两支蜡烛"}。

templates.title: Futuristic Military Watchtower

titleLocalized.zh: 未来主义军事瞭望塔

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic ultra-realistic wide-angle concept art scene of a futuristic concrete military checkpoint and watchtower in a remote rocky landscape. The main subject is a massive brutalist guard tower labeled {argument name="tower number" default="01"}, centered slightly right, with sloped reinforced concrete supports, weathered beige-gray surfaces, dark metal braces, antennae on the roof, and a glass observation deck wrapping around the top. Surround it with a fortified perimeter wall, a large industrial gate, railings, a raised pedestrian walkway on the left, stacked cargo crates and sandbag barriers near the base, and a sloped vehicle ramp on the right leading into the compound. The foreground is muddy dirt with shallow puddles reflecting the sky, tire marks, gravel, and worn concrete edges. Add a distant rocky mountain on the far right horizon and a deep blue sky with scattered soft clouds. Lighting should be late-afternoon golden sunlight from the left, creating long shadows, realistic highlights on glass, and atmospheric haze. Style: high-end AAA game environment art, photorealistic, detailed hard-surface architecture, no people visible, no vehicles, no extra text except the tower number, 16:9 widescreen composition, low camera angle looking upward for scale, sharp focus, natural color grading.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级超写实广角概念艺术场景，描绘偏远岩石地貌中一座未来主义混凝土军事检查站和瞭望塔。主体是一座巨大的粗野主义风格岗哨塔，标记为 {argument name="tower number" default="01"}，位置略微偏右，配有倾斜的钢筋混凝土支撑结构、风化的米灰色表面、深色金属支架、屋顶天线以及环绕顶部的玻璃观景台。周围环绕着加固的周边围墙、大型工业大门、栏杆、左侧升高的行人通道、底座附近的堆叠货箱和沙袋屏障，以及右侧通往大院的倾斜车辆坡道。前景为泥泞的土地，带有反射天空的浅水坑、轮胎痕迹、碎石和磨损的混凝土边缘。远处的右侧地平线上添加一座岩石山脉，以及带有零星柔云的深蓝色天空。光照应为左侧傍晚的金色阳光，营造出长长的阴影、玻璃上逼真的高光以及大气雾霾。风格：高端 AAA 游戏环境艺术，超写实，精细的硬表面建筑，画面中无人，无车辆，除塔号外无额外文字，16:9 宽屏构图，低机位仰拍以展现规模感，清晰对焦，自然色彩分级。

templates.title: Desert Tactical Command Base

titleLocalized.zh: 沙漠战术指挥基地

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic wide shot of a futuristic military command compound in a desert canyon at golden hour. The scene shows a massive concrete-and-steel tactical base stretching diagonally from center-left to upper-right, with angular brutalist architecture, weathered tan concrete, dark metal trim, industrial vents, armored doors, railings, antenna masts, floodlights, and a tall control tower near the upper center. Add exactly 4 prominent text markings on the facility: a black sign reading {argument name="facility name" default="DELTA FORCE"} with smaller text "TACTICAL COMMAND CENTER" beneath it, a large blue wall panel labeled {argument name="sector label" default="A2"} with small "SECTOR" text below, a large orange door number {argument name="door number" default="12"}, and a small triangular warning-style emblem on the control tower. In the foreground, place one large concrete road barrier spanning the lower frame, painted with diagonal black-and-yellow hazard stripes and showing grime, chips, and two metal lifting loops. Behind it, include an empty paved road curving along the base, low security fencing, bollards, stacked crates, and industrial yard details. The background has rocky desert cliffs on the left, a few sparse palm trees, and a warm orange sunset sky with the sun low near the left horizon and soft clouds. Use a slightly tilted dynamic camera angle, 16:9 aspect ratio, low-to-mid viewpoint, high-detail game cinematic realism, dramatic warm rim light, long shadows, crisp textures, realistic dust and weathering, no people, no vehicles, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级写实风格的广角镜头，展示位于沙漠峡谷中、处于黄金时刻的未来感军事指挥大院。场景中，一座巨大的混凝土与钢结构战术基地从左中向右上对角延伸，建筑采用粗野主义风格，带有风化的棕褐色混凝土、深色金属饰边、工业通风口、装甲门、栏杆、天线塔、泛光灯，以及位于上方中心附近的控制塔。在设施上添加 4 处醒目的文字标记：一个黑色标牌，上面写着 {argument name="facility name" default="DELTA FORCE"}，下方附有较小的文字 "TACTICAL COMMAND CENTER"；一块标有 {argument name="sector label" default="A2"} 的大型蓝色墙板，下方带有较小的 "SECTOR" 文字；一个大型橙色门牌号 {argument name="door number" default="12"}；以及控制塔上一个小型三角形警告风格的徽标。在前景中，放置一个横跨下画面的大型混凝土路障，上面涂有黑黄相间的对角危险条纹，并带有污垢、缺口和两个金属吊环。在其后方，包含一条沿着基地弯曲的空旷铺装道路、低矮的安全围栏、护柱、堆叠的板条箱以及工业堆场的细节。背景左侧有岩石沙漠悬崖，几棵稀疏的棕榈树，以及温暖的橙色日落天空，太阳位于左侧地平线附近，伴有柔和的云层。使用略微倾斜的动态摄像机角度，16:9 纵横比，中低视角，高细节游戏电影级写实感，戏剧性的暖色轮廓光，长阴影，清晰的纹理，逼真的灰尘和风化效果，无人，无车辆，无水印。

templates.title: Coastal Sci-Fi Communications Base

titleLocalized.zh: 海岸科幻通信基地

templates.prompt: Create a wide cinematic sci-fi environment concept art scene of a massive concrete-and-metal military communications base on a coastal mountain plateau. The camera is low and slightly tilted, using a 16:9 widescreen composition, looking across an empty industrial landing pad toward angular brutalist buildings. The main structure sits right of center: a fortified bunker-like complex with sloped concrete walls, armored panel seams, a tall central doorway, narrow dark horizontal windows, industrial stairs and ramps, and a large painted number {argument name="building number" default="03"} on the right wall. On the roof, place a tall lattice communications tower crowded with antennas, satellite dishes, vertical masts, cables, and signal equipment. Add a smaller outbuilding to the left with its own antennas, plus a raised bridge or catwalk extending from the right side of the base. In the foreground include exactly 7 discrete industrial objects: 3 rectangular cargo crates on the far left, 2 low concrete barricades with yellow-and-black hazard stripes in the center, and 2 greenish metal equipment cases on the lower right. The setting is a remote coastline with a calm ocean and hazy snow-capped mountains visible on the left horizon. Lighting is golden-hour sunrise or sunset from the far left, creating warm rim light, long shadows, lens haze, and a bright washed-out glow near the horizon. Use a realistic AAA video game / cinematic concept art style, highly detailed hard-surface design, weathered beige-gray concrete, metal grime, subtle panel lines, bolts, vents, railings, and no people or vehicles. Keep the sky deep blue overhead with sparse wispy clouds, high dynamic range, sharp architectural detail, atmospheric depth, and an epic near-future military outpost mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级的科幻环境概念艺术场景，描绘一座位于海岸山地高原上的大型混凝土与金属军事通信基地。相机位置较低且略微倾斜，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，横跨空旷的工业停机坪，望向棱角分明的粗野主义建筑。主体结构位于画面中心偏右：一个堡垒般的复合建筑，拥有倾斜的混凝土墙面、装甲板接缝、高大的中央入口、狭窄的深色横向窗户、工业楼梯和坡道，右侧墙面上绘有巨大的数字 {argument name="building number" default="03"}。在屋顶上，放置一座高大的网格状通信塔，上面挤满了天线、卫星碟、垂直桅杆、电缆和信号设备。在左侧添加一个较小的附属建筑，配有独立天线，并从基地右侧延伸出一座抬高的桥梁或走道。前景中包含 7 个独立的工业物体：最左侧有 3 个长方形货运箱，中心有 2 个带有黄黑危险警示条纹的低矮混凝土路障，右下方有 2 个泛绿色的金属设备箱。背景为偏远的海岸线，左侧地平线上可见平静的海洋和朦胧的雪山。光照为远左侧的黄金时段日出或日落，营造出温暖的轮廓光、长长的阴影、镜头雾霾以及地平线附近明亮且泛白的光晕。采用写实的 AAA 级电子游戏 / 电影概念艺术风格，具有高度精细的硬表面设计，呈现风化的米灰色混凝土、金属污垢、细腻的板材线条、螺栓、通风口、栏杆，画面中不包含人物或车辆。头顶天空保持深蓝色，点缀着稀疏的卷云，具备高动态范围、锐利的建筑细节、大气深度以及史诗般的近未来军事前哨氛围。

templates.title: Retro Kawaii Tokyo Postcard

titleLocalized.zh: 复古可爱风东京明信片

templates.prompt: Create a cute retro cartoon postcard cityscape of {argument name="city name" default="Tokyo"}, with the city’s most iconic landmark as the clear central focus: a kawaii Tokyo Tower in the middle, red and white lattice structure, simplified chunky geometry, thick black outlines, a smiling face with rosy cheeks on the observation deck, and exaggerated children’s picture-book proportions. Use a vertical 2:3 postcard composition with a turquoise-blue sky, cream paper border, visible vintage print texture, halftone dots, slight ink misregistration, and bold pop-art colors. At the top left, add large tilted red block letters spelling {argument name="headline text" default="TOKYO"} with black outline, and below it large yellow Japanese characters {argument name="local city text" default="東京"}. Surround the tower with an ultra-simplified skyline of colorful rectangular buildings in blues, pinks, oranges, and yellows. Include exactly 5 visible sign or billboard text elements in the city: a red vertical sign reading 「カラオケ」, a pink vertical sign reading 「原宿」, a yellow horizontal sign reading “SHIBUYA”, a blue billboard with a cute cat face, and a red vertical sign reading 「秋葉原」. Add exactly 2 cream-colored rounded cartoon clouds, one on the left and one on the right. In the foreground, create a band of bright green rounded treetops, a blue river or canal with small white water strokes, and a cute green-and-cream commuter train at the bottom right with a smiling face, black tracks, and rounded windows. Keep all architecture extremely simplified with minimal detail, chunky geometric shapes, naive children’s illustration style, bold thick black outlines, cheerful kawaii expressions, retro comic halftone shading, saturated pop palette, and no photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的复古卡通明信片城市景观，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="Tokyo"}，并将该城市最具标志性的地标作为画面中心：画面中央是一座可爱的东京塔，采用红白格纹结构、简化的块状几何图形、粗黑线条勾勒，观景台上有带红晕的笑脸，并运用夸张的儿童绘本比例。采用 2:3 的竖版明信片构图，配以绿松石蓝的天空、奶油色纸张边框、可见的复古印刷纹理、网点效果、轻微的油墨套印偏差以及大胆的波普艺术色彩。在左上角添加倾斜的红色大号块状字母，拼写为 {argument name="headline text" default="TOKYO"}，并带有黑色描边；下方添加醒目的黄色日文 {argument name="local city text" default="東京"}。在塔的周围环绕着极简风格的天际线，由蓝色、粉色、橙色和黄色的矩形建筑组成。城市中包含 5 个清晰可见的招牌或广告牌元素：一个写有「カラオケ」的红色竖招牌、一个写有「原宿」的粉色竖招牌、一个写有“SHIBUYA”的黄色横招牌、一个带有可爱猫脸的蓝色广告牌，以及一个写有「秋葉原」的红色竖招牌。添加 2 朵奶油色的圆形卡通云，左右各一。前景处绘制一排亮绿色的圆形树冠、一条带有白色水纹的蓝色河流或运河，以及右下角一列带有笑脸、黑色轨道和圆形车窗的可爱绿奶油色通勤火车。所有建筑保持极度简化，细节极少，采用块状几何形状、稚拙的儿童插画风格、粗黑线条、欢快的可爱表情、复古漫画网点阴影、高饱和度的波普配色，且完全不追求写实感。

templates.title: Elegant White Qipao Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅白色旗袍人像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical photorealistic portrait of an elegant adult woman seated on the floor in a traditional Chinese-style wooden room, wearing a glossy white silk qipao-inspired bridal outfit with delicate frog closures, pearl accents, tassels, and a high side slit. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered opaque square censor block in a muted brown skin-tone color. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair flowing over her shoulders, decorated with exactly two white floral pearl hair ornaments and exactly two translucent white ribbon bows. She wears exactly two sheer white opera gloves, exactly two white high-heeled Mary Jane shoes with ankle straps, and a sheer white stocking detail with pearl-and-flower trim on one thigh. Pose her sitting low with both knees raised close to the camera, one gloved hand near her face, creating a soft fashion editorial composition. The setting includes exactly one warm glowing paper lantern on a wooden table to the left, exactly one small white teapot on a low table in the background, dark wooden furniture, shoji-style window grids, hanging calligraphy scrolls, and white blossom branches on the right. Use warm natural window light, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, realistic skin and fabric texture, high-end cosplay photography aesthetics, muted beige and ivory tones, and a 9:16 vertical crop. Keep the mood graceful, serene, and luxurious; no extra text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版写实人像，画面中一位优雅的成年女性坐在传统中式木质房间的地面上，身穿一件带有光泽感的白色丝绸旗袍风格婚纱，配有精致的盘扣、珍珠装饰、流苏以及高开叉设计。她的面部被一个位于正中央、颜色为柔和肤色的不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她留着长波浪卷发（{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}），发丝垂落在肩头，装饰着恰好两枚白色花朵珍珠发饰和恰好两个半透明白色丝带蝴蝶结。她佩戴着恰好两只透明白色歌剧手套，穿着恰好两双带有踝带的白色高跟玛丽珍鞋，其中一条大腿上饰有带有珍珠和花朵装饰的透明白色长筒袜细节。让她保持低坐姿势，双膝抬起靠近镜头，一只戴着手套的手靠近脸部，营造出柔和的时尚杂志大片构图。场景包括左侧木桌上恰好一盏温暖发光的纸灯笼，背景低矮桌面上恰好一个白色小茶壶，以及深色木质家具、障子风格窗格、悬挂的书法卷轴和右侧的白色花枝。使用温暖的自然窗光，浅景深，奶油般虚化的背景，逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，高端 Cosplay 摄影美学，柔和的米色和象牙色调，以及 9:16 的竖版裁剪。保持优雅、宁静和奢华的氛围；不要添加任何额外文字或水印。

templates.title: NOXEN Four Dimensions Watch Ad

titleLocalized.zh: NOXEN 四维腕表广告

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a luxury square advertising collage for a futuristic wristwatch brand, showing one premium chronograph watch across four elemental dimensions. Use the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="NOXEN"} and the monogram {argument name="brand monogram" default="N"}.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image divided into exactly 4 equal panels in a clean 2x2 grid, separated by thin white divider lines. Each panel is a cinematic product poster with dramatic lighting, high contrast, sharp watch detail, and premium commercial photography realism.

Overall subject: A masculine luxury stainless-steel chronograph wristwatch with integrated metal bracelet, octagonal/rounded bezel with small screws, black dial, three subdials, baton hour markers, central hands, crown and pushers on the right side, and subtle brand text on the dial. The watch should remain recognizable as the same model in all 4 panels while material color and environment change.

Panel count and details: Exactly 4 distinct watch posters:
1. Top-left panel: matte black watch in a dark smoky void, surrounded by black dust, volcanic ash, floating debris, and mist. Monochrome black-and-charcoal palette with silver highlights. Place the monogram above the brand name near the top center. Add the small tagline {argument name="darkness tagline" default="ENGINEERED IN DARKNESS"} near the bottom center.
2. Top-right panel: polished gold watch surrounded by a dramatic splash of liquid gold, bubbles, and warm amber reflections. Black background with intense golden highlights. Place the monogram above the brand name near the top center. Add the small tagline {argument name="gold tagline" default="CRAFTED IN GOLD"} near the bottom center.
3. Bottom-left panel: silver steel watch frozen inside a translucent block of cracked blue ice, with frosty mist, icy rock texture, and cold blue lighting. Place a large monogram above the brand name near the bottom center, with the small tagline {argument name="time tagline" default="BUILT BEYOND TIME"} beneath it.
4. Bottom-right panel: black and dark steel watch with neon green accents in a cyberpunk futuristic city at night, glowing skyscrapers, circuit-like lines, holographic HUD rings, and emerald light beams. Place a large glowing monogram above the brand name near the top center. Add the small tagline {argument name="future tagline" default="FUTURE. ENGINEERED."} near the bottom center.

Typography: Elegant luxury serif or widely spaced uppercase lettering for the brand name, thin uppercase tracking for taglines, centered and minimal. Text must be crisp and legible: brand name appears in all 4 panels, the monogram appears in all 4 panels, and each panel has exactly one tagline as listed.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic high-end watch advertising, macro product photography, cinematic lighting, glossy reflections, deep blacks, premium contrast, sharp metal textures, atmospheric particles, no people, no extra logos, no watermark, no additional text beyond the specified brand, monogram, and four taglines.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为未来感腕表品牌创作一张豪华方形广告拼贴图，通过四个元素维度展示同一款高端计时码表。使用品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="NOXEN"} 和品牌字母组合 {argument name="brand monogram" default="N"}。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，通过细白色分割线精确划分为 4 个相等的 2x2 网格。每个面板均为电影质感的商业产品海报，具有戏剧性光影、高对比度、锐利的腕表细节以及高端商业摄影的真实感。

整体主题：一款阳刚的豪华不锈钢计时码表，配有集成金属表带、带小螺丝的八角形/圆形表圈、黑色表盘、三个小表盘、条形时标、中央指针、右侧表冠和按钮，表盘上有精致的品牌文字。腕表在 4 个面板中应保持为同一型号，但材质颜色和环境会发生变化。

面板数量及细节：共 4 张独特的腕表海报：
1. 左上角面板：哑光黑色腕表置于暗黑烟雾虚空中，周围环绕着黑色尘埃、火山灰、漂浮碎片和薄雾。采用单色黑与炭灰色调，配以银色高光。将字母组合置于品牌名称上方，靠近顶部中心。在底部中心附近添加小标语 {argument name="darkness tagline" default="ENGINEERED IN DARKNESS"}。
2. 右上角面板：抛光金色腕表，周围环绕着戏剧性的液态金飞溅、气泡和温暖的琥珀色反射。黑色背景，带有强烈的金色高光。将字母组合置于品牌名称上方，靠近顶部中心。在底部中心附近添加小标语 {argument name="gold tagline" default="CRAFTED IN GOLD"}。
3. 左下角面板：银色钢制腕表冻结在半透明的裂纹蓝冰块中，带有霜雾、冰岩纹理和冷蓝色光影。将大号字母组合置于品牌名称上方，靠近底部中心，下方附带小标语 {argument name="time tagline" default="BUILT BEYOND TIME"}。
4. 右下角面板：带有荧光绿点缀的黑钢腕表，置于夜晚的赛博朋克未来城市中，背景为发光的摩天大楼、电路状线条、全息 HUD 圆环和翡翠色光束。将大号发光字母组合置于品牌名称上方，靠近顶部中心。在底部中心附近添加小标语 {argument name="future tagline" default="FUTURE. ENGINEERED."}。

排版：品牌名称采用优雅的豪华衬线字体或宽间距大写字母，标语采用纤细的大写字母，居中且极简。文字必须清晰易读：品牌名称出现在所有 4 个面板中，字母组合出现在所有 4 个面板中，且每个面板各包含一个指定的标语。

视觉风格：超写实高端腕表广告，微距产品摄影，电影级光影，光泽反射，深邃黑色，高级对比度，锐利的金属质感，大气粒子效果，无人物，无额外标志，无水印，除指定的品牌名称、字母组合和四个标语外，不包含任何额外文字。

templates.title: Scorpion Combat Robot Spec Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Scorpion 战斗机器人规格表

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a detailed military-industrial specification sheet for a fictional autonomous scorpion-shaped combat robot named {argument name="platform name" default="Дигваранз-1.6"}, with the subtitle “Autonomous Combat Platform.”

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 technical presentation board on a warm light beige background, thin gray panel borders, clean infographic layout, realistic hard-surface concept art mixed with labeled engineering diagram. Use tan, dark bronze, black, gunmetal, and muted military colors. The overall look should feel like a defense robotics brochure or field manual page.

Main subject: Center a large scorpion-inspired autonomous combat platform in three-quarter view, facing left. It has a low armored body, segmented tan modular armor panels with rivets and dark mechanical joints, six numbered legs, hybrid wheel-and-leg mobility, and a high curved scorpion tail ending in a stabilized turret weapon. The weapon is a compact 30 mm autocannon with a red sensor or muzzle detail. The robot should look rugged, heavy, realistic, and operational, with subtle floor shadows. Add circular callout markers for exactly 6 leg positions: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. Include a ground-clearance measurement arrow beneath the center body reading “GROUND CLEARANCE 0.50 m (19.7 in).”

Top-left title block: Add a small black scorpion icon, then the large Cyrillic title “{argument name="platform name" default="Дигваранз-1.6"}” and the English subtitle “Autonomous Combat Platform.” Under it, show exactly 6 feature bullets: “Scorpion-Inspired Mobility,” “Hybrid Wheel-Leg System,” “Stabilized Weapon System,” “Modular Armor,” “All-Terrain Operations,” and “Autonomous Targeting & Navigation.”

Left specifications panel: A bordered box titled “SPECIFICATIONS” with exactly 9 rows: “HEIGHT (TO TOP OF TURRET) 1.0 m (3.28 ft),” “LENGTH 2.0 m (6.56 ft),” “WIDTH 1.6 m (5.25 ft),” “WEIGHT ~350 kg (771 lb),” “GROUND CLEARANCE 0.50 m (19.7 in),” “MAX SPEED 20 km/h (12.4 mph),” “ENDURANCE 6–8 hours,” “PRIMARY ARMAMENT 30mm Autocannon / Energy Weapon (Optional),” and “POWER SOURCE Hybrid (Battery + Generator).”

Top-right comparison panel: A bordered inset titled “DIMENSIONS & COMPARISON.” Show exactly 2 figures inside: the scorpion combat robot beside a standing armored soldier holding a rifle. Add height guides labeled “1.0 m (3.28 ft)” for the robot and “Average Human Height 1.75 m (5.74 ft)” for the soldier.

Right-middle leg configuration panel: A small bordered box titled “LEG CONFIGURATION” with exactly 2 numbered lines: “1, 3, 4, 6 – Wheel Legs” and “2, 5 – Articulated Legs (Middle Legs).”

Bottom row: Add exactly 5 bordered feature cards spanning the width. Each card contains a small realistic render and a caption. Card 1 title “HYBRID MOBILITY,” image of the robot driving across rough ground, caption “Wheel legs for speed and efficiency on flat terrain.” Card 2 title “ARTICULATED MIDDLE LEGS,” image focused on the middle walking legs, caption “Enhanced stability and obstacle climbing capability.” Card 3 title “STABILIZED WEAPON SYSTEM,” image close-up of the tail turret, caption “Low-profile turret with stabilized autocannon for high accuracy.” Card 4 title “ADVANCED SENSORS,” image close-up of the front sensor array with cameras, caption “360° awareness with multi-spectral cameras, LIDAR, and threat detection.” Card 5 title “MODULAR ARMOR,” image close-up of armor plates, caption “Modular armor panels for mission adaptability and protection.”

Style constraints: Use crisp sans-serif typography, black and dark gray text, precise labels, thin leader lines, and realistic lighting. Keep all text legible and aligned. Do not add extra logos, watermarks, explosions, battlefield smoke, or human gore. Maintain a clean concept-sheet presentation for {argument name="robot role" default="autonomous combat platform"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="platform name" default="Дигваранз-1.6"} 的虚构蝎形自主战斗机器人创建一份详细的军工规格表，副标题为“自主战斗平台”。

画布：横向 4:3 技术演示项目，采用暖浅米色背景，细灰色面板边框，简洁的信息图布局，逼真的硬表面概念艺术与标注工程图相结合。使用棕褐色、深青铜色、黑色、枪灰色和柔和的军用色调。整体外观应呈现出防御机器人手册或现场操作手册页面的质感。

主体：中心放置一个大型蝎子仿生自主战斗平台，呈四分之三视角，面向左侧。它具有低矮的装甲车身、带有铆钉和深色机械关节的模块化棕褐色装甲板、六条编号的腿、轮腿混合移动系统，以及末端带有稳定炮塔武器的高弯曲蝎尾。武器为紧凑型 30 mm 自动加农炮，带有红色传感器或枪口细节。机器人应看起来坚固、沉重、逼真且处于可操作状态，并带有细微的地面阴影。为 6 个腿部位置添加圆形标注标记：1、2、3、4、5 和 6。在车身下方包含一个离地间隙测量箭头，标注为“GROUND CLEARANCE 0.50 m (19.7 in)”。

左上角标题栏：添加一个小型黑色蝎子图标，随后是大型西里尔文标题“{argument name="platform name" default="Дигваранз-1.6"}”和英文副标题“Autonomous Combat Platform”。在下方展示 6 个功能要点：“Scorpion-Inspired Mobility”（蝎子仿生机动性）、“Hybrid Wheel-Leg System”（轮腿混合系统）、“Stabilized Weapon System”（稳定武器系统）、“Modular Armor”（模块化装甲）、“All-Terrain Operations”（全地形作业）以及“Autonomous Targeting & Navigation”（自主瞄准与导航）。

左侧规格面板：一个带边框的方框，标题为“SPECIFICATIONS”（规格），包含 9 行内容：“HEIGHT (TO TOP OF TURRET) 1.0 m (3.28 ft)”、“LENGTH 2.0 m (6.56 ft)”、“WIDTH 1.6 m (5.25 ft)”、“WEIGHT ~350 kg (771 lb)”、“GROUND CLEARANCE 0.50 m (19.7 in)”、“MAX SPEED 20 km/h (12.4 mph)”、“ENDURANCE 6–8 hours”、“PRIMARY ARMAMENT 30mm Autocannon / Energy Weapon (Optional)”以及“POWER SOURCE Hybrid (Battery + Generator)”。

右上角对比面板：一个带边框的插图，标题为“DIMENSIONS & COMPARISON”（尺寸与对比）。内部展示 2 个图形：蝎子战斗机器人与一名手持步枪的武装士兵并排。添加高度参考线，机器人标注为“1.0 m (3.28 ft)”，士兵标注为“Average Human Height 1.75 m (5.74 ft)”。

中右侧腿部配置面板：一个带边框的小方框，标题为“LEG CONFIGURATION”（腿部配置），包含 2 行编号内容：“1, 3, 4, 6 – Wheel Legs”（轮式腿）和“2, 5 – Articulated Legs (Middle Legs)”（关节式腿/中腿）。

底行：添加 5 张横跨宽度的带边框功能卡片。每张卡片包含一张逼真的渲染图和说明文字。卡片 1 标题“HYBRID MOBILITY”，图片为机器人在崎岖地面行驶，说明“用于平坦地形的轮式腿，具备速度与效率优势”。卡片 2 标题“ARTICULATED MIDDLE LEGS”，图片聚焦于中间的行走腿，说明“增强了稳定性和障碍物攀爬能力”。卡片 3 标题“STABILIZED WEAPON SYSTEM”，图片为尾部炮塔特写，说明“带有稳定自动加农炮的低轮廓炮塔，确保高精度”。卡片 4 标题“ADVANCED SENSORS”，图片为带有摄像头的正面传感器阵列特写，说明“通过多光谱摄像头、激光雷达和威胁检测实现 360° 感知”。卡片 5 标题“MODULAR ARMOR”，图片为装甲板特写，说明“用于任务适应性和防护的模块化装甲板”。

风格约束：使用清晰的无衬线字体，黑色和深灰色文本，精确的标签，细引导线和逼真的光影。保持所有文本清晰易读且对齐。不要添加额外的徽标、水印、爆炸效果、战场烟雾或人体血腥内容。为 {argument name="robot role" default="autonomous combat platform"} 保持简洁的概念表演示风格。

templates.title: Smart Doorbell Enclosure Product Render

titleLocalized.zh: 智能门铃外壳产品渲染图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean studio product render of a custom DIY smart doorbell / intercom enclosure, shown as an exploded multi-view product lineup.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 composition on a light gray seamless studio background, soft floor shadow, orthographic product-render look, no people, no branding watermark.

Subject: A compact rectangular electronics enclosure with rounded corners, matte {argument name="enclosure color" default="light gray"} plastic, slightly beveled edges, realistic 3D CAD rendering, subtle rough texture.

Layout: Show exactly 5 discrete enclosure views arranged left to right with even spacing: 1) a very thin left side profile standing upright with two stacked circular speaker or sensor grilles; 2) the main front face standing upright, slightly angled, with visible functional details; 3) a narrow side profile with a recessed USB-C port; 4) the rear cover plate standing upright with four corner screw holes and a side cutout; 5) the open back housing/case interior showing electronics installed in the top compartment and an empty lower compartment.

Front face details: On the main front view, include exactly 4 visible feature groups: a small round camera lens near the top center; a square black display/window below it showing two cute cartoon eyes; a large circular illuminated doorbell button below the display with a white glowing ring; and a horizontal speaker grille near the bottom made of short black slits in multiple rows. Add two small round side holes on the left edge of the main body.

Interior electronics: In the open back housing, include exactly 2 circuit boards and visible wiring: the top board is labeled {argument name="camera module label" default="ESP32-CAM"} with a small camera module, and the lower board is labeled {argument name="controller board label" default="DFPlayer Mini"}. Add neatly routed black, white, gray, and red wires around the boards. The interior should have a horizontal divider shelf separating the electronics bay from a larger empty lower cavity. Add four corner screw posts/holes inside the open case.

Style: Photorealistic 3D product visualization, high-detail industrial design concept, soft studio lighting from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, crisp edges, realistic plastic material, neutral gray palette, shallow but clear shadows, centered composition.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 product views, keep all objects upright, no hands, no extra text beyond the two board labels, no logos, no decorative background objects.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个简洁的定制 DIY 智能门铃 / 对讲机外壳的摄影棚产品渲染图，以爆炸式多视图产品阵列形式呈现。

画布：宽屏 16:9 构图，浅灰色无缝摄影棚背景，柔和的地面阴影，正交产品渲染外观，无人像，无品牌水印。

主体：一个带有圆角的紧凑型矩形电子产品外壳，哑光 {argument name="enclosure color" default="浅灰色"} 塑料材质，边缘略带倒角，逼真的 3D CAD 渲染效果，具有细微的粗糙质感。

布局：从左到右均匀排列 5 个独立的外壳视图：1) 一个非常薄的左侧轮廓，垂直站立，带有两个堆叠的圆形扬声器或传感器格栅；2) 正面主视图，垂直站立，略微倾斜，带有可见的功能细节；3) 一个狭窄的侧面轮廓，带有凹陷的 USB-C 接口；4) 后盖板垂直站立，带有四个角部螺丝孔和一个侧面切口；5) 打开的后壳/外壳内部，显示安装在顶部隔间中的电子元件和一个空的下部隔间。

正面细节：在正面主视图上，包含 4 组可见的功能特征：顶部中心附近的一个小圆形摄像头镜头；下方一个方形黑色显示屏/窗口，显示两只可爱的卡通眼睛；显示屏下方一个大的圆形发光门铃按钮，带有白色光环；以及底部附近由多排短黑色缝隙组成的水平扬声器格栅。在主体左边缘增加两个小圆孔。

内部电子元件：在打开的后壳中，包含 2 个电路板和可见的布线：顶部电路板标记为 {argument name="camera module label" default="ESP32-CAM"}，带有小型摄像头模块；下部电路板标记为 {argument name="controller board label" default="DFPlayer Mini"}。在电路板周围添加整齐排列的黑色、白色、灰色和红色导线。内部应有一个水平隔板，将电子元件舱与下方较大的空腔隔开。在打开的外壳内部添加四个角部螺丝柱/孔。

风格：逼真的 3D 产品可视化，高细节工业设计概念，来自左上方的柔和摄影棚灯光，柔和的环境光遮蔽，清晰的边缘，逼真的塑料材质，中性灰配色，浅而清晰的阴影，居中构图。

约束：使用 5 个产品视图，保持所有物体垂直，无人手，除两个电路板标签外无额外文字，无 Logo，无装饰性背景物体。

templates.title: Planetary Anchor Station Cutaway

titleLocalized.zh: 行星锚定站剖面图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean sci-fi technical cutaway diagram of a massive No Man's Sky-inspired space megastructure labeled as {argument name="station name" default="PLANETARY ANCHOR STATION"}, showing a deep-foundation orbital tether/logistics hub in precise industrial detail.

Canvas: Wide 3:2 landscape technical poster on a white background, high-resolution, with generous empty space for labels. Use a realistic hard-surface concept-art style with crisp black leader lines, small circular callout dots, thin technical typography, and subtle shadows under the structure.

Main subject: A huge cross-sectioned vertical space station tilted diagonally from lower left to upper right, with two long horizontal arms extending left and right through the central tower. The structure is blue-gray, gunmetal, white, and dark steel, with exposed copper, orange, green, and black utility piping. The central tower is partially cut away to reveal stacked cylindrical machinery, conduits, elevator shafts, reactor sections, service decks, truss frames, and glowing industrial interiors. The left arm shows many exposed utility pipes inside segmented conduit housing. The right arm is a heavier rectangular radiator/armature with panel plating, circular ports, and mechanical seams. The lower end has a bulky blue anchor base with landing-foot-like supports and shock absorber details.

Top-left text: Large bold uppercase title: {argument name="station name" default="PLANETARY ANCHOR STATION"}. Directly below it, smaller uppercase subtitle: {argument name="diagram subtitle" default="CUTAWAY DIAGRAM"}. Under the subtitle, add a short paragraph: {argument name="description text" default="A deep-foundation megastructure that secures the station to a planetary body and extends high into the atmosphere or low orbit. It functions as a logistics hub, energy collector, and tether anchor."}

Callouts: Include exactly 9 labeled callouts with leader lines and small dot markers, using compact uppercase headings plus one short explanatory sentence each: 1. COMMAND & CONTROL NODE — Navigation, communications, and station management. 2. UPPER TOWER MODULES — Habitation, laboratories, and specialized facilities. 3. DOCKING & MAINTENANCE HUB — Accommodates spacecraft docking, servicing bays, and robotic cranes. 4. STRUCTURAL SPINE — Reinforced central truss that provides strength and alignment for the entire structure. 5. UTILITY CONDUITS — Power cables, coolant pipes, and data lines run through protected conduits. 6. RADIATOR WING — Heat rejection panels with integrated coolant channels. 7. ENERGY CORE — Fusion or high-output power plant providing electricity for the station. 8. ANCHOR BASE — Interface to planetary surface or seabed. Contains anchoring mechanisms and shock absorbers. 9. MAGLEV ELEVATOR SHAFT — Transports personnel and materials along the vertical axis.

Specification box: Place a bordered white box in the lower-right corner titled SPECIFICATIONS. Include exactly 5 rows with small monochrome icons and values: Height (Above Surface) — {argument name="station height" default="~ 6.2 km"}; Span (Arm to Arm) — ~ 7.8 km; Mass — ~ 9.5 million tonnes; Primary Materials — Titanium alloys, Composite ceramics, Reinforced polymers; Power Output — ~ 12.4 GW.

Visual style: Futuristic aerospace engineering diagram, photorealistic 3D model render mixed with infographic annotation, sharp panel lines, exposed mechanical innards, realistic scale, no people, no planets, no starfield, no watermark. Keep the background plain white and the typography clean, black, and highly legible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的科幻技术剖面图，展示一个受《无人深空》（No Man's Sky）启发的巨型太空结构，标注为 {argument name="station name" default="行星锚定站"}，精确呈现深地基轨道系留/物流枢纽的工业细节。

画布：宽幅 3:2 横向技术海报，白色背景，高分辨率，留有充足的标注空间。采用写实的硬表面概念艺术风格，配以清晰的黑色引导线、小型圆形标注点、纤细的技术字体以及结构下方的微妙阴影。

主体：一座巨大的垂直空间站横截面，从左下向右上倾斜，两条长长的水平臂从中央塔楼向左右延伸。结构呈蓝灰色、枪灰色、白色和深钢色，带有外露的铜色、橙色、绿色和黑色公用管道。中央塔楼部分被切开，露出堆叠的圆柱形机械、导管、电梯井、反应堆部分、服务甲板、桁架结构和发光的工业内部。左臂显示了分段导管外壳内许多外露的公用管道。右臂是一个更厚重的矩形散热器/电枢，带有面板镀层、圆形端口和机械接缝。下端有一个笨重的蓝色锚定底座，带有类似着陆脚的支撑和减震器细节。

左上角文字：大号粗体大写标题：{argument name="station name" default="行星锚定站"}。正下方为较小的副标题：{argument name="diagram subtitle" default="剖面图"}。在副标题下方，添加一段简短说明：{argument name="description text" default="一种将空间站固定在行星天体上并延伸至高层大气或低轨道的深地基巨型结构。它兼具物流枢纽、能量收集器和系留锚点的功能。"}

标注：包含 9 个带有引导线和圆点标记的标注，使用紧凑的大写标题，每项配有一句简短的解释性说明：1. 指挥与控制节点 — 导航、通信和空间站管理。2. 上层塔楼模块 — 居住区、实验室和专业设施。3. 对接与维护枢纽 — 用于航天器对接、维修舱和机器人起重机。4. 结构脊柱 — 加固的中央桁架，为整个结构提供强度和对齐支撑。5. 公用导管 — 电力电缆、冷却剂管道和数据线穿过受保护的导管。6. 散热翼 — 带有集成冷却通道的散热面板。7. 能源核心 — 为空间站提供电力的聚变或高输出发电厂。8. 锚定底座 — 与行星表面或海床的接口。包含锚定机构和减震器。9. 磁悬浮电梯井 — 沿垂直轴运送人员和物资。

规格框：在右下角放置一个带边框的白色方框，标题为“规格”。包含 5 行带有小型单色图标和数值的内容：高度（地表以上）— {argument name="station height" default="~ 6.2 公里"}；跨度（臂展）— ~ 7.8 公里；质量 — ~ 950 万吨；主要材料 — 钛合金、复合陶瓷、增强聚合物；功率输出 — ~ 12.4 吉瓦。

视觉风格：未来派航空航天工程图，写实 3D 模型渲染与信息图表标注相结合，清晰的面板线条，外露的机械内部结构，真实的比例，无人像，无行星，无星空背景，无水印。保持背景为纯白色，字体清晰、黑色且易于阅读。
