templates.title: Guan Yu Historical Infographic Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 关羽历史信息图海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical historical Chinese epic infographic poster about {argument name="character name" default="Guan Yu"}, combining a cinematic Three Kingdoms warrior portrait with parchment-style chronology panels.

Canvas: Tall portrait poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, aged beige rice-paper background with ink wash stains, faint mountains, smoke, battlefield silhouettes, and a museum-scroll texture. Overall palette is sepia, charcoal, dark olive green, bronze, and muted blood-brown.

Main subject: A hyper-detailed armored Chinese general, {argument name="character name" default="Guan Yu"}, dominates the center, riding a powerful dark brown war horse. He wears layered dark green robes, ornate blackened bronze lamellar armor, engraved shoulder guards, leather straps, metal studs, and a green headwrap with long ribbons streaming to the right. Long black hair and beard flow in the wind; the face area is intentionally softened/obscured like a smooth blurred mask, while the armor and clothing remain sharply detailed. He holds a massive ornate guandao polearm angled from the center toward the lower left foreground; the crescent blade is oversized, silver, engraved with gold filigree, and strongly foreshortened. The horse has glossy musculature, an alert expression, ornate bridle, bronze medallions, decorative leather tack, and one raised front leg, facing slightly right.

Left title area: Place a huge vertical black ink-brush calligraphy title reading {argument name="large calligraphy title" default="关羽"} on the upper left. Beside it, add smaller vertical text in Chinese reading “武圣·忠义·威震华夏”, with a small red seal stamp below. Under the title, include a short biographical text block: “关羽生平 / 约160年—220年 / 字云长，本字长生 / 河东解县（今山西运城）人 / 蜀汉名将，五虎上将之首 / 以忠义仁勇著称 / 后世尊为 武圣 / 与‘文圣’孔子齐名”.

Chronology panels: Use exactly 8 translucent rectangular parchment cards arranged around the main rider, each with a large two-digit number, a bold Chinese event title, a year, 2–4 lines of smaller Chinese notes, and a faded monochrome battle illustration behind the text. The cards should look like layered glass-paper frames with thin white borders and ink-wash war scenes.
1. Top center-left card: “01 桃园结义”, year “约184年”, showing three sworn brothers under trees.
2. Mid left card: “02 温酒斩华雄”, year “190年”, showing generals and soldiers near a battlefield standard.
3. Lower left card: “03 过五关斩六将”, year “200年”, showing riders passing through a gate or fortress battle.
4. Bottom left card: “04 单刀赴会”, year “215年”, showing a dramatic riverside or military meeting scene.
5. Top right card: “05 水淹七军”, year “219年”, showing flooded armies, ships, and chaos.
6. Upper-mid right card: “06 刮骨疗毒”, year “219年”, showing a medical treatment scene with soldiers nearby.
7. Mid-lower right card: “07 威震华夏”, year “219年”, showing a smoky battlefield and massed troops.
8. Bottom right card: “08 败走麦城”, year “220年”, showing a seated general and tragic final-campaign atmosphere.

Bottom timeline: Add a thin horizontal timeline along the entire bottom edge with exactly 8 labeled points matching the events: “约160年 生于河东解县”, “184年 桃园结义”, “190年 温酒斩华雄”, “200年 过五关斩六将”, “215年 单刀赴会”, “219年 水淹七军”, “219年 威震华夏”, “220年 败走麦城”. Use small gold dots connected by a fine line, with compact serif Chinese captions.

Visual style: Epic historical fantasy realism, Chinese ink-wash poster design, cinematic lighting, high-detail metal engraving, smoky atmosphere, battlefield dust, layered parchment collage, elegant typography. The central rider and horse are high-contrast and sharp; the background cards are slightly faded and desaturated.

Constraints: Keep exactly 8 chronology cards and exactly 8 bottom timeline points. Do not add modern objects, logos, watermarks, or extra characters in the foreground. Preserve the Chinese text content as visible poster typography, while all composition instructions remain in English.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于 {argument name="character name" default="关羽"} 的竖版中国史诗级信息图海报，将电影感的三国武将肖像与羊皮纸风格的编年史面板相结合。

画布：高竖版海报，3:4 比例，背景为陈旧的米色宣纸，带有水墨污渍、隐约的山峦、烟雾、战场剪影以及博物馆卷轴的质感。整体色调为深褐色、炭灰色、暗橄榄绿、青铜色和柔和的血褐色。

主体：一位细节极其丰富的中国古代将军 {argument name="character name" default="关羽"} 占据画面中心，骑着一匹强壮的深褐色战马。他身穿层叠的深绿色长袍，外罩华丽的黑青铜鳞甲，配有雕花护肩、皮带、金属铆钉，头戴绿色头巾，长长的系带向右飘动。黑色的长发和胡须在风中飘扬；面部区域特意处理得柔和模糊，如同平滑的面具，而盔甲和衣物则保持锐利的细节。他手持一把巨大的华丽关刀，从中心向左下角前景延伸；刀刃巨大，呈银色，刻有金色花纹，并运用了强烈的透视缩短效果。战马肌肉线条流畅，神情警觉，配有华丽的缰绳、青铜饰牌和装饰性皮具，前腿抬起，身体略微朝向右侧。

左侧标题区：在左上方放置一个巨大的竖排黑色水墨书法标题 {argument name="large calligraphy title" default="关羽"}。旁边添加较小的竖排中文文字“武圣·忠义·威震华夏”，下方盖有一枚红色小印章。标题下方包含一段简短的生平文字：“关羽生平 / 约160年—220年 / 字云长，本字长生 / 河东解县（今山西运城）人 / 蜀汉名将，五虎上将之首 / 以忠义仁勇著称 / 后世尊为 武圣 / 与‘文圣’孔子齐名”。

编年史面板：使用 8 张半透明的矩形羊皮纸卡片围绕中心骑马者排列，每张卡片包含一个两位数编号、一个醒目的中文事件标题、年份、2–4 行较小的中文注释，以及文字背后淡化的单色战场插画。卡片应呈现为带有细白边框和水墨战争场景的层叠玻璃纸框架。
1. 左上方卡片：“01 桃园结义”，年份“约184年”，展示树下的三位结拜兄弟。
2. 左侧中部卡片：“02 温酒斩华雄”，年份“190年”，展示战场旗帜附近的将军与士兵。
3. 左侧下部卡片：“03 过五关斩六将”，年份“200年”，展示骑兵穿过关隘或堡垒的战斗场景。
4. 左下角卡片：“04 单刀赴会”，年份“215年”，展示戏剧性的江边或军事会面场景。
5. 右上方卡片：“05 水淹七军”，年份“219年”，展示洪水中的军队、船只和混乱场面。
6. 右侧中上部卡片：“06 刮骨疗毒”，年份“219年”，展示医疗场景及旁边的士兵。
7. 右侧中下部卡片：“07 威震华夏”，年份“219年”，展示烟雾缭绕的战场和密集的军队。
8. 右下角卡片：“08 败走麦城”，年份“220年”，展示坐着的将军和悲壮的最后战役氛围。

底部时间轴：在底部边缘添加一条细长的水平时间轴，包含与事件对应的 8 个标注点：“约160年 生于河东解县”、“184年 桃园结义”、“190年 温酒斩华雄”、“200年 过五关斩六将”、“215年 单刀赴会”、“219年 水淹七军”、“219年 威震华夏”、“220年 败走麦城”。使用细线连接的小金点，配以紧凑的衬线体中文说明。

视觉风格：史诗级历史奇幻写实风格，中国水墨海报设计，电影级布光，高细节金属雕刻，烟雾缭绕的氛围，战场尘土，层叠的羊皮纸拼贴，优雅的排版。中心骑马者和战马对比强烈且清晰；背景卡片略微褪色并降低饱和度。

约束条件：保持 8 张编年史卡片和 8 个底部时间轴点。不要添加现代物品、标志、水印或前景中的额外人物。保留中文文本内容作为海报排版，所有构图说明保持为英文。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic Chinese historical-warrior infographic poster about {argument name="character name" default="Zhao Yun"}, showing a heroic armored cavalry general charging toward the viewer on a white horse, surrounded by semi-transparent holographic chronology panels.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, cinematic high detail, cool gray-blue palette, smoky battlefield background, dust and debris at the bottom, bright rim lighting and icy glowing UI edges. The composition is dense but readable, with the mounted warrior centered and the horse and spear projecting forward in strong perspective.

Main subject: A Chinese Three Kingdoms-style general in ornate silver lamellar armor and layered white-gray robes rides a powerful white horse. He has long flowing silver-white hair tied with a decorative crown. The face area is deliberately obscured by a soft rectangular blur. He grips an extremely long silver spear angled from upper left toward the lower right foreground, with the spearhead close to the viewer. The horse wears elaborate silver tack, engraved bridle plates, tassels, and a chest ornament; its mane blows wildly. Mood: fearless, legendary, stormy, heroic.

Left title column: Large black ink-brush calligraphy reading {argument name="main calligraphy" default="赵云"}. Beside it, vertical text reads “常胜将军 · 独胆英雄 · 银枪白马”. Add a small red seal stamp reading “子龙”. Below, include a short biography block titled “蜀汉名将” with small Chinese body text describing him as a lifelong loyal general of the Shu Han, called the “常胜将军”, with an eight-foot stature, majestic appearance, and a silver spear in hand.

Floating chronology panels: Use exactly 8 translucent glass-like rectangular panels with cyan glowing borders, each containing a numbered title, several short Chinese lines, a year, and a small monochrome battle illustration in the background. Arrange them around the rider without covering the main horse head or spear: upper left, upper right, mid left, mid right, lower left, lower right, bottom left, bottom right. The 8 visible panels are: 01 “初出茅庐”, includes “随公孙瓒 / 建功立业 / 约184年”; 02 “长坂救救主”, includes “曹操大军来袭 / 七进七出 / 救出刘备幼子阿斗 / 208年”; 03 “汉水之战”, includes “以少胜多 / 大破曹军 / 晋夺城 / 208年”; 04 “单骑救阿斗”, includes “单枪匹马 / 深入敌阵 / 护阿斗安全脱险 / 208年”; 05 “智取桂阳”, includes “智取赵范 / 平定桂阳 / 功勋卓著 / 214年”; 06 “助攻取益州”, includes “随军入川 / 攻城拔寨 / 立下赫赫战功 / 214年”; 07 “箕谷之战”, includes “镇守箕谷 / 击退魏军 / 保蜀汉后方 / 228年”; 08 “北伐中原”, includes “随诸葛亮北伐 / 屡建奇功 / 威震中原 / 228年–231年”.

Bottom timeline: Add a thin gold horizontal timeline with exactly 7 marked date points and labels: “?–184 常山真定人”, “184 随公孙瓒 初出茅庐”, “208 长坂坡之战 救主立功”, “214 智取桂阳 助攻益州”, “228 箕谷之战 北伐开始”, “231 北伐中原 屡建奇功”, “229–? 病逝成都 追谥顺平侯”.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed fantasy-realistic Chinese historical illustration mixed with futuristic transparent infographic overlays, metallic armor detail, painterly smoke, engraved textures, cold glowing highlights, high contrast, sharp spear perspective, epic poster design. Avoid modern weapons, avoid cartoon style, avoid extra panels, avoid English text in the artwork.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的中国历史武将信息图海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="赵云"}，展现一位英勇的披甲骑兵将军骑着白马向观众冲锋，周围环绕着半透明的全息纪年面板。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 比例，电影级高细节，冷灰蓝色调，烟雾缭绕的战场背景，底部有尘土和碎石，明亮的轮廓光和冰冷的 UI 发光边缘。构图紧凑且易读，骑马的武将居中，马匹和长枪以强烈的透视感向前突出。

主体：一位中国三国风格的将军，身穿华丽的银色鳞甲和层叠的灰白色长袍，骑着一匹强壮的白马。他留着飘逸的银白色长发，戴着装饰性的头冠。面部区域特意用柔和的矩形模糊处理。他紧握一杆极长的银枪，从左上角斜向右下角前景，枪尖靠近观众。马匹佩戴着精致的银色马具、雕花缰绳、流苏和胸饰；马鬃在风中狂乱飘动。氛围：无畏、传奇、风暴、英勇。

左侧标题栏：巨大的黑色水墨书法，书写 {argument name="main calligraphy" default="赵云"}。旁边竖排文字写着“常胜将军 · 独胆英雄 · 银枪白马”。添加一枚红色小印章，写着“子龙”。下方包含一个名为“蜀汉名将”的简短传记块，配以简短的中文正文，描述他作为蜀汉终身忠诚的将军，被称为“常胜将军”，身长八尺，相貌堂堂，手持银枪。

浮动纪年面板：使用 8 个半透明玻璃质感的矩形面板，带有青色发光边框，每个面板包含一个带编号的标题、几行简短的中文、年份以及背景中的小型单色战斗插图。将它们排列在骑手周围，不要遮挡马头或长枪：左上、右上、左中、右中、左下、右下、底部左侧、底部右侧。8 个可见面板为：01 “初出茅庐”，包含“随公孙瓒 / 建功立业 / 约 184 年”；02 “长坂救主”，包含“曹操大军来袭 / 七进七出 / 救出刘备幼子阿斗 / 208 年”；03 “汉水之战”，包含“以少胜多 / 大破曹军 / 晋夺城 / 208 年”；04 “单骑救阿斗”，包含“单枪匹马 / 深入敌阵 / 护阿斗安全脱险 / 208 年”；05 “智取桂阳”，包含“智取赵范 / 平定桂阳 / 功勋卓著 / 214 年”；06 “助攻取益州”，包含“随军入川 / 攻城拔寨 / 立下赫赫战功 / 214 年”；07 “箕谷之战”，包含“镇守箕谷 / 击退魏军 / 保蜀汉后方 / 228 年”；08 “北伐中原”，包含“随诸葛亮北伐 / 屡建奇功 / 威震中原 / 228 年–231 年”。

底部时间轴：添加一条细长的金色水平时间轴，标有 7 个日期点和标签：“?–184 常山真定人”、“184 随公孙瓒 初出茅庐”、“208 长坂坡之战 救主立功”、“214 智取桂阳 助攻益州”、“228 箕谷之战 北伐开始”、“231 北伐中原 屡建奇功”、“229–? 病逝成都 追谥顺平侯”。

视觉风格：超细节的奇幻写实中国历史插画，融合未来感透明信息图叠加层、金属盔甲细节、绘画感烟雾、雕刻纹理、冷色调发光高光、高对比度、锐利的长枪透视、史诗般的海报设计。避免使用现代武器，避免卡通风格，避免添加额外面板，避免在艺术作品中出现英文字符。

templates.title: Planetary Survey Outpost Cutaway

titleLocalized.zh: 行星勘测前哨站剖面图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean sci-fi technical cutaway infographic for a No Man's Sky–inspired facility titled {argument name="headline text" default="PLANETARY SURVEY OUTPOST"}, showing a hardened planetary survey base with a large central dome and swept wing structures, as if from an aerospace architecture manual.

Canvas: Wide landscape 16:9 poster on a white background, high-resolution concept-art rendering combined with crisp editorial diagram typography. Use muted olive-gray armor panels, dark graphite structural ribs, warm interior lighting, and purple sensor glow accents.

Main layout: Place the huge facility cross-section across the center, spanning nearly the full width. The center is a semi-circular reinforced dome sliced open to reveal 4 stacked interior levels: 1) top sensor and telescope chamber, 2) crew/lab rooms, 3) operations/control floor with blue monitors, 4) lower power/storage machinery bay. Attach two broad angular wings: the left wing is pale green reinforced armor, the right wing is darker with an open cutaway sensor bay near the tip. Add thin leader lines and small technical labels around the structure.

Top-left text block: Under the headline, add the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="CUTAWAY DIAGRAM"}. Include a short paragraph: "A hardened, low-profile facility built for long-term planetary observation and data collection. The reinforced dome and wing structures house sensors, living quarters, and support systems while withstanding harsh surface conditions."

Callouts: Include exactly 9 labeled callouts around the main cutaway, each with a short description: 1) "REINFORCED WING STRUCTURE" — composite armor and load-bearing struts provide durability and impact resistance; 2) "OBSERVATION BAYS" — deployable sensor pods for atmospheric and terrain analysis; 3) "CENTRAL SENSOR DOME" — rotating sensor array and high-resolution scanning instruments; 4) "COMMUNICATION ARRAY" — high-gain antenna systems for long-range data transmission; 5) "HABITATION DECK" — crew quarters, galley, recreation, and medical facilities; 6) "OPERATIONS DECK" — command center, data analysis labs, and mission planning; 7) "POWER CORE" — compact fission reactor providing power to all systems; 8) "STORAGE & WORKSHOP" — equipment storage, fabrication lab, and maintenance bay; 9) "DEPLOYABLE SENSOR POD" — autonomous pod for atmospheric sampling, terrain mapping, and surface scanning.

Inset panels: Add exactly 3 framed inset panels. Bottom-left panel shows a separate small render of a deployable sensor pod on landing skids labeled "DEPLOYABLE SENSOR POD". Upper-right panel is a "SPECIFICATIONS" card with exactly 6 rows: Diameter (Dome) ~ 68 m; Wingspan ~ 140 m; Height ~ 35 m; Mass ~ 24,000 tonnes; Crew Capacity 24; Power Output ~ 3.2 MW. Bottom-right panel is a top-view facility layout labeled "FACILITY LAYOUT (TOP VIEW)", showing the round central dome and two wings, with labels for Left Wing (Sensor Bays), Right Wing (Comm Array & Support), and Central Dome (Operations & Core).

Visual style: Realistic sci-fi concept art mixed with technical blueprint infographic design, sharp cross-section details, small human-scale rooms and equipment, subtle shadows under the base, thin purple-gray leader lines, compact uppercase sans-serif labels, and a polished magazine-spread composition.

Constraints: Keep all text in English, make the diagram readable and information-dense, do not add logos, watermarks, people in the foreground, or extra inset panels. The subject should feel like a planetary facility from {argument name="game inspiration" default="No Man's Sky"} but remain original.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的科幻技术剖面信息图，展示一个受《No Man's Sky》启发的设施，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="PLANETARY SURVEY OUTPOST"}，呈现一个带有大型中央穹顶和后掠翼结构的加固型行星勘测基地，风格如同航空航天建筑手册。

画布：白色背景下的 16:9 宽幅横向海报，结合高分辨率概念艺术渲染与清晰的编辑类图表排版。使用柔和的橄榄灰色装甲板、深石墨色结构肋条、温暖的室内照明以及紫色的传感器光效。

主要布局：将巨大的设施横截面放置在中心，横跨几乎整个宽度。中心是一个半圆形的加固穹顶，剖开后露出 4 层堆叠的内部空间：1) 顶部的传感器和望远镜室，2) 船员/实验室房间，3) 带有蓝色显示器的操作/控制层，4) 底部的动力/存储机械舱。连接两个宽大的角形机翼：左翼为淡绿色加固装甲，右翼颜色较深，尖端附近有开放式传感器舱剖面。在结构周围添加细引线和小型技术标签。

左上角文本块：在标题下方，添加副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="CUTAWAY DIAGRAM"}。包含一段简短的文字：“一个加固的低矮型设施，专为长期行星观测和数据收集而建。加固的穹顶和机翼结构容纳了传感器、生活区和支持系统，能够抵御恶劣的表面环境。”

标注：在主剖面图周围包含 9 个带标签的标注，每个标注配有简短说明：1) “REINFORCED WING STRUCTURE”（加固机翼结构）— 复合装甲和承重支柱提供耐用性和抗冲击性；2) “OBSERVATION BAYS”（观测舱）— 用于大气和地形分析的可部署传感器吊舱；3) “CENTRAL SENSOR DOME”（中央传感器穹顶）— 旋转传感器阵列和高分辨率扫描仪器；4) “COMMUNICATION ARRAY”（通信阵列）— 用于远程数据传输的高增益天线系统；5) “HABITATION DECK”（居住层）— 船员宿舍、厨房、娱乐和医疗设施；6) “OPERATIONS DECK”（操作层）— 指挥中心、数据分析实验室和任务规划室；7) “POWER CORE”（动力核心）— 为所有系统供电的紧凑型裂变反应堆；8) “STORAGE & WORKSHOP”（存储与车间）— 设备存储、制造实验室和维护舱；9) “DEPLOYABLE SENSOR POD”（可部署传感器吊舱）— 用于大气采样、地形测绘和表面扫描的自主吊舱。

内嵌面板：添加 3 个带边框的内嵌面板。左下角面板显示一个带有起落架的可部署传感器吊舱的独立小渲染图，标注为“DEPLOYABLE SENSOR POD”。右上角面板为“SPECIFICATIONS”（规格）卡片，包含 6 行数据：穹顶直径约 68 米；翼展约 140 米；高度约 35 米；质量约 24,000 吨；船员容量 24 人；功率输出约 3.2 MW。右下角面板为设施布局顶视图，标注为“FACILITY LAYOUT (TOP VIEW)”，显示圆形的中央穹顶和两个机翼，并标注了左翼（传感器舱）、右翼（通信阵列与支持）和中央穹顶（操作与核心）。

视觉风格：写实的科幻概念艺术与技术蓝图信息图设计相结合，锐利的横截面细节，小比例的人类尺度房间和设备，基地下方微妙的阴影，纤细的紫灰色引线，紧凑的大写无衬线字体标签，以及精致的杂志排版构图。

约束：保持所有文本为英文，使图表易于阅读且信息密集，不要添加徽标、水印、前景人物或额外的内嵌面板。主体应呈现出 {argument name="game inspiration" default="No Man's Sky"} 中行星设施的感觉，但需保持原创性。

templates.title: Lü Bu Historical Warrior Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 吕布历史武将海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic vertical historical-warrior poster infographic about {argument name="character name" default="吕布"}, the legendary Three Kingdoms general, combining cinematic fantasy realism with aged Chinese manuscript design.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, parchment-gray textured background with ink wash stains, dust, smoke, battlefield grit, and faint cracks. Use a high-contrast cinematic composition with the main figure exploding forward from the center.

Main subject: A powerful armored Chinese cavalry general charges directly toward the viewer on a dark chestnut warhorse. The rider wears ornate dark bronze and black lamellar armor with red cloth accents, chains, metal shoulder guards, and an elaborate crown/helmet with two extremely long red pheasant-plume antennae rising high and curving outward. His face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur/mask while the rest of the image is sharp. He thrusts a massive ornate halberd toward the camera, creating extreme foreground perspective: the weapon blade is huge, blurred by depth of field, and extends from the lower left toward the rider’s hand. The horse has windblown reddish mane, decorated bridle, metal ornaments, tassels, and raised front legs, kicking up mud and smoke.

Left typography: Large black calligraphic Chinese title {argument name="main title" default="吕布"} arranged vertically on the left side, bold brush texture. Beside it place a smaller vertical phrase {argument name="vertical subtitle" default="飞将 · 猛将 · 乱世枭雄"}. Add red seal stamps and a short biography block in Chinese beneath the title, including “三国第一猛将”, “约160年–199年”, and several lines of small serif Chinese text.

Infographic panels: Include exactly 7 semi-transparent parchment event cards around the central rider, each with a thin pale-gold rectangular border, a large two-digit number, Chinese event title, year, small descriptive Chinese lines, and a monochrome sketch-like battle illustration. The 7 visible cards are: 01 “九原出身” with “约160年” near the upper left; 02 “并州骁将” with “184年” near the upper right; 03 “诛董卓” with “189年” at mid-left; 04 “虎牢关之战” with “190年” at mid-right; 05 “辕门射戟” with “191年” at lower left; 06 “下邳之战” with “194年” at lower right; 07 “白门楼殒命” with “199年” at bottom right. Keep the panels slightly tilted in perspective as if floating behind the warrior, partially obscured by smoke and the horse.

Bottom timeline: Add exactly 7 timeline milestones across the bottom edge in muted gold, matching the cards: “约160年 九原出身”, “184年 并州从军”, “189年 诛董卓”, “190年 虎牢关之战”, “191年 辕门射戟”, “194年 下邳之战”, “199年 白门楼殒命”. Use small dots connected by a thin horizontal line, with a subtle decorative flourish centered below.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed cinematic Chinese historical fantasy, realistic armor and horse anatomy, dynamic motion, shallow depth of field, smoky battlefield atmosphere, muted sepia parchment palette with black ink, dark bronze, oxblood red, and pale gold highlights. Make the background panels look like archival sketches printed on old paper.

Constraints: Use Chinese text as visible graphic elements, keep the exact count of 7 event cards and 7 timeline milestones, no modern objects, no logos or watermarks, no extra characters in the foreground, and maintain a poster-like editorial infographic layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于 {argument name="character name" default="吕布"}（三国传奇名将）的戏剧性竖版历史武将信息图海报，将电影级奇幻写实风格与古风手稿设计相结合。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，羊皮纸灰纹理背景，带有水墨污渍、尘土、烟雾、战场沙砾及隐约的裂纹。采用高对比度的电影构图，主体人物从中心向外爆发式冲锋。

主体：一位威武的中国古代重装骑兵将军骑着深栗色战马，正向观众直冲而来。骑手身着华丽的深青铜色与黑色扎甲，配有红色布饰、锁链、金属肩甲，以及一顶带有两根极长红色雉鸡翎、向上高耸并向外弯曲的精致头盔。他的面部被刻意用柔和的矩形模糊/遮罩处理，而图像其余部分保持清晰。他将一把巨大的华丽方天画戟刺向镜头，营造出极端的近景透视：武器刃部巨大，因景深效果而模糊，从左下方延伸至骑手手中。战马鬃毛随风飘动，配有装饰性的缰绳、金属饰品、流苏，前腿抬起，扬起泥土与烟雾。

左侧排版：左侧垂直排列巨大的黑色书法标题 {argument name="main title" default="吕布"}，笔触粗犷。旁边放置较小的垂直短语 {argument name="vertical subtitle" default="飞将 · 猛将 · 乱世枭雄"}。标题下方添加红色印章及一段中文简介，包括“三国第一猛将”、“约160年–199年”以及几行小型衬线中文文本。

信息图面板：在中央骑手周围放置 7 个半透明的羊皮纸事件卡片，每张卡片带有细淡金色矩形边框、大号两位数字、中文事件标题、年份、简短中文描述及单色素描风格的战斗插图。7 张可见卡片为：01 “九原出身”及“约160年”（左上）；02 “并州骁将”及“184年”（右上）；03 “诛董卓”及“189年”（中左）；04 “虎牢关之战”及“190年”（中右）；05 “辕门射戟”及“191年”（左下）；06 “下邳之战”及“194年”（右下）；07 “白门楼殒命”及“199年”（右下）。面板需保持透视倾斜，仿佛悬浮在武将身后，并被烟雾和马匹部分遮挡。

底部时间轴：在底部边缘添加 7 个柔和金色的时间轴里程碑，与卡片对应：“约160年 九原出身”、“184年 并州从军”、“189年 诛董卓”、“190年 虎牢关之战”、“191年 辕门射戟”、“194年 下邳之战”、“199年 白门楼殒命”。使用小圆点连接细水平线，中心下方配有微妙的装饰性花纹。

视觉风格：超精细电影级中国历史奇幻风格，写实的盔甲与马匹解剖结构，动态感，浅景深，烟雾缭绕的战场氛围，以深褐色羊皮纸为基调，辅以水墨黑、深青铜色、牛血红及淡金色高光。背景面板呈现出印在旧纸张上的档案素描质感。

约束：使用中文作为可见图形元素，严格保持 7 个事件卡片和 7 个时间轴里程碑的数量，无现代物品，无 Logo 或水印，前景无额外角色，并保持海报式的编辑信息图布局。

templates.title: Ma Chao Historical Cavalry Timeline Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 马超历史骑兵时间线海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical historical hero infographic poster about {argument name="character name" default="马超"}, a fierce ancient Chinese cavalry general, combining cinematic fantasy realism with an antique manuscript timeline design.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, aged beige parchment background with faint map lines, battle sketches, dust, ink wash texture, and subtle sepia-gray atmosphere. High-detail digital painting / cinematic historical concept art, dramatic depth of field, gritty battlefield energy.

Main subject: Center composition shows {argument name="character name" default="马超"} charging forward on a powerful black warhorse. The rider wears ornate dark silver lamellar armor with engraved patterns, layered pauldrons, leather straps, flowing dark cloak, and a high tied topknot with loose windblown hair. His face is partially covered by a centered dark rectangular censor/blur block. He thrusts a long silver spear directly toward the viewer, creating strong foreshortening; the spear tip dominates the lower-right foreground. The black horse has elaborate metal head armor, reins, ornamental tack, flared nostrils, and galloping motion with dust and debris underfoot.

Left title area: Large vertical black Chinese calligraphy reading {argument name="main calligraphy title" default="马超"} along the upper-left side. Beside it, smaller vertical text reads “西凉锦马超 · 骁勇 · 俊烈” with a small red seal stamp beneath. Below, add a short Chinese biography block in small serif-style text beginning with “西凉铁骑的骄子” and mentioning “约176年—222年”; keep it visually authentic, compact, and slightly faded.

Timeline/event cards: Add exactly 8 translucent parchment cards around the rider, each with a thin pale-gold border, a large two-digit number, a Chinese title, a year, several tiny Chinese annotation lines, and a small monochrome ink-battle illustration. The 8 cards are:
1. “01 扶风茂陵”, year “约176年”, upper left of rider.
2. “02 西凉名将”, year “191年”, upper right.
3. “03 潼关之战”, year “211年”, mid right.
4. “04 割须弃袍”, year “211年”, lower left-center.
5. “05 凉州军”, year “211年”, lower left.
6. “06 归附刘备”, year “214年”, lower right-center.
7. “07 射鹤乡侯”, year “219年”, bottom left-center.
8. “08 蜀汉名将”, year “222年”, bottom right.

Bottom timeline: Along the bottom edge, create a thin horizontal gold timeline with exactly 8 marked dots and labels matching the same sequence and years: “约176年 扶风茂陵”, “191年 西凉名将”, “211年 潼关之战”, “211年 割须弃袍”, “211年 凉州军”, “214年 归附刘备”, “219年 射鹤乡侯”, “222年 蜀汉名将”. Add a small ornamental flourish centered below the line.

Visual style: Realistic Chinese historical war epic, antique museum-poster layout, muted beige, charcoal, steel blue, black, and pale gold palette. Use dust, torn-paper translucency, faint battlefield silhouettes, and ink-wash overlays. The central rider and horse should be sharp and dramatic, while background cards and maps are slightly faded.

Constraints: Use exactly 8 event cards and 8 bottom timeline markers. Keep all visible typography Chinese-style and integrated into the poster. No modern objects, no watermark, no logo, no extra characters in the foreground, no bright saturated colors.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于 {argument name="character name" default="马超"} 的竖版历史英雄信息图海报。马超是一位勇猛的中国古代骑兵将军，设计需结合电影奇幻写实风格与古籍手稿时间线布局。

画布：3:4 竖版海报，背景为陈旧的米色羊皮纸，带有隐约的地图线条、战斗草图、灰尘、水墨纹理以及微妙的深褐色与灰色调。高细节数字绘画 / 电影级历史概念艺术，具有强烈的景深感和粗犷的战场氛围。

主体：构图中心展示 {argument name="character name" default="马超"} 骑着一匹强壮的黑色战马向前冲锋。骑手身穿华丽的深银色鳞甲，带有雕刻纹路、层叠的肩甲、皮带、飘逸的深色披风，以及高高束起的发髻，发丝随风飘动。他的面部被一个居中的深色矩形遮挡块部分遮盖。他将一杆长银枪直刺向观众，形成强烈的透视缩短效果；枪尖占据了右下方的近景。黑马佩戴着精致的金属马面甲、缰绳和装饰性马具，鼻孔张开，奔跑时脚下尘土飞扬。

左侧标题区：左上方有巨大的竖排黑色中国书法，书写着 {argument name="main calligraphy title" default="马超"}。旁边有较小的竖排文字“西凉锦马超 · 骁勇 · 俊烈”，下方盖有一枚红色小印章。下方添加一段简短的中文传记，使用小号衬线字体，开头为“西凉铁骑的骄子”，并提及“约 176 年—222 年”；保持视觉上的真实感、紧凑且略带褪色效果。

时间线/事件卡片：在骑手周围添加 8 张半透明的羊皮纸卡片，每张卡片带有细细的淡金色边框、一个两位数编号、一个中文标题、年份、几行细小的中文注释以及一幅小型单色水墨战斗插图。8 张卡片分别为：
1. “01 扶风茂陵”，年份“约 176 年”，位于骑手左上方。
2. “02 西凉名将”，年份“191 年”，位于右上方。
3. “03 潼关之战”，年份“211 年”，位于右侧中部。
4. “04 割须弃袍”，年份“211 年”，位于左下中部。
5. “05 凉州军”，年份“211 年”，位于左下方。
6. “06 归附刘备”，年份“214 年”，位于右下中部。
7. “07 射鹤乡侯”，年份“219 年”，位于底部左侧中部。
8. “08 蜀汉名将”，年份“222 年”，位于右下方。

底部时间线：沿底边创建一条细长的水平金色时间线，带有 8 个标记点和标签，顺序与年份对应：“约 176 年 扶风茂陵”、“191 年 西凉名将”、“211 年 潼关之战”、“211 年 割须弃袍”、“211 年 凉州军”、“214 年 归附刘备”、“219 年 射鹤乡侯”、“222 年 蜀汉名将”。在线条下方居中添加一个小型的装饰性花纹。

视觉风格：写实的中国历史战争史诗，古董博物馆海报布局，采用米色、炭色、钢蓝色、黑色和淡金色调。使用灰尘、破损纸张的半透明感、隐约的战场剪影和水墨叠加效果。中央的骑手和战马应清晰且具有戏剧性，而背景卡片和地图则略显褪色。

约束：使用 8 张事件卡片和 8 个底部时间线标记。所有可见排版均需采用中式风格并融入海报中。禁止出现现代物品、水印、Logo、前景中不得有额外字符，禁止使用高饱和度的亮色。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Assassin With Neon Glass Dagger

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克刺客与霓虹玻璃匕首

templates.prompt: Create a hyperreal cinematic close-up portrait of {argument name="character" default="a rain-soaked cyberpunk female assassin"} holding {argument name="object" default="a translucent neon glass dagger"} with intense, deliberate intent. The composition is very tight and vertical, focused on the left side of the character’s wet face, ear, neck, shoulder, and hand gripping the weapon; most of the face is obscured by a large centered square censor-like overlay, about two thirds of the image width, filled with a dark navy-to-muted-blue gradient. Show slick black wet hair clinging to skin, a visible ear with two small metallic piercings, glossy black leather or tactical collar around the neck, bare wet shoulder, subtle tattoos on the upper chest, and water droplets across skin and clothing. The dagger is held upright along the right side of the frame, close to the face, made of clear glass or crystal with glowing cyan and magenta circuitry-like reflections inside it. Use {argument name="lighting" default="electric blue and hot magenta neon rim lighting"}, with strong reflections on wet skin, hair, leather, and the blade. Add {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="mist, rain droplets, tiny floating particles, and blue haze"} drifting through the frame to create a moody futuristic noir tone. The visible eye area is hidden by the square overlay, but the body language should imply {argument name="emotion" default="cold determination"}. Shallow depth of field, dramatic high contrast, ultra-detailed skin texture, glossy specular highlights, bokeh neon background, hyperreal photography style, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影感特写肖像，主角为 {argument name="character" default="一名被雨水浸透的赛博朋克女性刺客"}，手持 {argument name="object" default="一把半透明的霓虹玻璃匕首"}，神情专注且坚定。构图非常紧凑且呈垂直状，聚焦于角色湿润面部左侧、耳朵、颈部、肩膀以及握住武器的手；大部分面部被一个位于中心的大型方形遮挡物（类似审查遮盖）所遮蔽，该遮挡物约占图像宽度的三分之二，填充着深海军蓝到柔和蓝色的渐变色。展现紧贴皮肤的油亮湿发、带有两个小型金属穿孔的可见耳朵、颈部周围光滑的黑色皮革或战术项圈、裸露的湿润肩膀、上胸部的细微纹身，以及遍布皮肤和衣物的雨滴。匕首垂直握在画面右侧，靠近面部，由透明玻璃或水晶制成，内部带有发光的青色和洋红色电路状反射。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="电光蓝和热烈洋红的霓虹轮廓光"}，在湿润的皮肤、头发、皮革和刀刃上形成强烈的反射。添加 {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="薄雾、雨滴、微小的漂浮颗粒和蓝色雾气"} 在画面中飘动，营造出忧郁的未来主义黑色电影基调。可见的眼睛区域被方形遮挡物隐藏，但肢体语言应暗示出 {argument name="emotion" default="冷酷的决心"}。浅景深，戏剧性的高对比度，超细腻的皮肤纹理，光泽的镜面高光，虚化的霓虹背景，超写实摄影风格，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Obscured Mystic Holding Artifact

titleLocalized.zh: 手持神器的神秘隐匿者

templates.prompt: Create a hyperreal cinematic close-up portrait of an elderly mystical figure, mostly obscured by a large solid matte brown square censor block centered over the face and upper torso. The visible parts show long wild gray-white hair framing both sides, a dirt- and ash-smeared forehead at the top edge, and weathered grimy hands at the bottom holding an ornate engraved brass or gold spherical artifact with intent. Use {argument name="character" default="an elderly mystical figure"}, {argument name="object" default="an ornate engraved brass sphere"}, and {argument name="lighting" default="warm firelight mixed with dim smoky shadows"}. Subtle metallic reflections catch on the artifact, dirty fingernails, skin texture, and stray hair. Orange sparks and faint smoke drift through a dark background, with shallow depth of field and blurred golden foreground bokeh. The mood is tense, ancient, ritualistic, and mysterious; the hidden eyes should be implied to convey {argument name="emotion" default="intense determination"}. Vertical 3:4 composition, macro lens realism, gritty skin detail, high contrast, cinematic color grading, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实电影感特写肖像，描绘一位年迈的神秘人物，其面部和上半身被一个位于画面中心的大型纯哑光棕色遮挡方块所掩盖。可见部分展示了从两侧垂下的凌乱灰白长发、顶部边缘布满污垢和灰烬的前额，以及底部那双饱经风霜、沾满污垢的手，正专注地捧着一件雕刻精美的黄铜或金色球形神器。请使用 {argument name="character" default="一位年迈的神秘人物"}、{argument name="object" default="一颗雕刻精美的黄铜球体"} 以及 {argument name="lighting" default="温暖的火光与昏暗烟雾阴影交织"}。神器、脏乱的指甲、皮肤纹理和零散的发丝上捕捉到细微的金属反光。橙色的火花和淡淡的烟雾在深色背景中飘动，伴随浅景深和模糊的金色前景光斑。整体氛围紧张、古老、充满仪式感且神秘；应暗示被遮挡的双眼以传达 {argument name="emotion" default="强烈的决心"}。垂直 3:4 构图，微距镜头真实感，粗犷的皮肤细节，高对比度，电影级调色，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Deep-Sea Diver Artifact Close-Up

titleLocalized.zh: 深海潜水员与神秘文物特写

templates.prompt: Cinematic hyperreal close-up portrait of {argument name="character" default="an antique deep-sea diver in a weathered brass diving helmet"} holding {argument name="object" default="a dark mysterious square artifact"} directly in front of the face with intent. The object is centered and blocks most of the visor, appearing as a flat near-black charcoal square with a subtle vertical gradient, sharp clean edges, and no markings. Show the diver’s wet gloved hands at the bottom foreground, fingers curled around the artifact, with realistic skin/leather texture, droplets, grime, and specular highlights. The helmet fills the frame: aged bronze and blackened metal, round rivets, ornate circular side fittings, corroded seams, scratches, algae-like residue, and a glass porthole rim barely visible around the square. Illuminate the scene with {argument name="lighting" default="cold blue underwater light from the left with warm amber reflections along the brass rim"}. Add {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="suspended bubbles, drifting particles, and murky underwater haze"} throughout the frame. The mood is tense and enigmatic; any visible eyes behind the glass should convey {argument name="emotion" default="focused obsession and dread"}. Use shallow depth of field, macro-level detail, cinematic contrast, teal-blue color grading, glossy wet surfaces, volumetric underwater ambience, no text, no watermark, vertical 4:5 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 电影级超写实特写肖像，画面主体为 {argument name="character" default="一名戴着风化黄铜潜水头盔的古董深海潜水员"}，正全神贯注地将 {argument name="object" default="一块神秘的深色方形文物"} 举在脸部正前方。该物体位于画面中心，遮挡了大部分面罩，呈现为一块平整、近乎黑色的炭灰色方形，边缘锐利整洁，表面无任何标记。画面底部前景展示潜水员湿润的戴手套双手，手指紧扣文物，呈现出逼真的皮肤/皮革纹理、水滴、污垢及高光反射。头盔充满整个画面：陈旧的青铜与发黑的金属材质，圆形的铆钉，华丽的圆形侧面配件，腐蚀的接缝，划痕，类似藻类的残留物，以及在方形物体周围隐约可见的玻璃舷窗边缘。场景光效为 {argument name="lighting" default="左侧冷蓝色水下光线，黄铜边缘带有温暖的琥珀色反射"}。画面中添加 {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="悬浮的气泡、漂浮的微粒和浑浊的水下雾气"}。整体氛围紧张且神秘；玻璃后若隐隐可见双眼，应传达出 {argument name="emotion" default="专注的执念与恐惧"}。采用浅景深、微距级细节、电影级对比度、青蓝色调分级、光泽湿润的表面、体积感水下氛围，无文字，无水印，垂直 4:5 构图。

templates.title: Pop Art Maneki-Neko Explosion

titleLocalized.zh: 波普艺术招财猫大爆发

templates.prompt:
Create a vibrant vertical poster illustration of a swarm of {argument name="lucky cat count" default="42"} Japanese maneki-neko lucky cat statues floating and tumbling through a white space, as if exploding outward from the center for a good-luck blessing. The main subject is one oversized white ceramic lucky cat in the foreground, centered slightly low, smiling with yellow-black eyes, red inner ears, pink nose, black whisker marks, a raised left paw, a red collar with gold studs and a gold bell, and a large oval gold coin on its chest with bold black Japanese-style characters. Surround it with exactly 41 smaller matching lucky cats at different scales and rotations: 6 large supporting cats near the edges, 11 medium cats in the midground, and 24 tiny distant cats scattered through the background. All cats should share the same glossy white ceramic body, red collars, gold bells, gold coin plaques, yellow eyes, red ears, and black calligraphic markings, but vary their pose between raised left paw, raised right paw, frontal sitting pose, side view, upside-down tumbling pose, and partial cropped close-up paws or bodies. Use a dramatic fisheye wide-angle perspective with the central cat closest to the viewer and many cats receding into depth.

Visual style: hyper-detailed 3D ceramic pop-art rendering with fine engraved contour-line patterns wrapping over the cats, subtle iridescent rainbow chromatic aberration, glossy highlights, and crisp high-contrast lighting. Add energetic Japanese graphic-design elements behind and between the cats: hot pink diagonal stripes, yellow arcs, black line bursts, cyan/magenta halftone dots, radial speed lines, geometric rectangles, and scattered neon print textures on a clean white background. The composition should feel joyful, chaotic, lucky, celebratory, and maximalist, like a futuristic maneki-neko blessing poster.

Canvas: vertical 2:3 poster, full bleed, high resolution, dense but readable composition. Place a small handwritten signature/date mark in the bottom-right corner reading {argument name="date text" default="May 14, 2026"} and {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}. Use no other English text besides the date/signature; Japanese-style characters may appear only as decorative black glyphs on the gold coins. Keep the foreground cat sharp, with smaller cats and background patterns layered behind it, and avoid photorealistic fur, humans, scenery, borders, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张充满活力的垂直海报插画，画面中一群 {argument name="lucky cat count" default="42"} 只日本招财猫雕像在白色空间中漂浮翻滚，仿佛从中心向外爆发，带来好运的祝福。主体是前景中一只超大的白色陶瓷招财猫，位置略微偏下，它有着黄黑色的眼睛、红色的耳内侧、粉色的鼻子、黑色的胡须纹路、抬起的左爪、带有金色铆钉和金铃铛的红色项圈，胸前挂着一枚巨大的椭圆形金币，上面印有醒目的黑色日式文字。在它周围环绕着 41 只大小和旋转角度各异的同款招财猫：边缘处有 6 只大型辅助猫，中景有 11 只中型猫，背景中散布着 24 只微小的远景猫。所有猫咪都应具有相同的光泽白色陶瓷质感、红色项圈、金铃铛、金币牌、黄色眼睛、红色耳朵和黑色书法纹样，但姿态各异，包括抬左爪、抬右爪、正面坐姿、侧面视角、倒立翻滚姿势，以及局部截取的爪子或身体特写。采用戏剧性的鱼眼广角透视，中央的猫咪离观众最近，其余猫咪向纵深处退去。

视觉风格：超精细的 3D 陶瓷波普艺术渲染，猫身上包裹着精细的雕刻轮廓线条图案，带有微妙的彩虹色色差、光泽高光和清脆的高对比度照明。在猫咪身后和缝隙间加入充满活力的日本平面设计元素：亮粉色斜条纹、黄色弧线、黑色线条爆发、青色/洋红色半调网点、放射状速度线、几何矩形以及散布在纯白背景上的霓虹印刷纹理。整体构图应充满欢乐、混沌、幸运和庆典感，如同未来主义的招财猫祝福海报。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，全出血设计，高分辨率，构图密集但清晰易读。在右下角放置一个小的手写签名/日期标记，内容为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 14 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。除日期/签名外，不要使用任何其他英文文本；日式文字仅可作为金币上的装饰性黑色字形出现。保持前景猫咪清晰锐利，较小的猫咪和背景图案层叠在后方，避免出现照片级写实的毛发、人物、风景、边框或水印。

templates.title: Cracked Porcelain Girl Holding Heart

titleLocalized.zh: 手捧心脏的破碎瓷偶少女

templates.prompt: Cinematic hyperreal close-up portrait of a fragile porcelain gothic doll-like woman, {argument name="character" default="a pale cracked porcelain android girl"} holding {argument name="object" default="a cracked white ceramic anatomical heart"} with intense, careful intent. She has a short black bob haircut with blunt bangs, translucent pale skin with fine fracture lines across her cheeks and nose, glossy parted lips, one dark human eye and one clouded broken glass eye surrounded by branching cracks and dark tear-like stains. Her black lace-gloved hands cradle the heart in the foreground; the ceramic heart is fractured, chipped, and glowing faintly red from within through one crack. She wears dark Victorian lace, metal chain earrings, dangling beads, and tarnished ornamental accessories, with subtle wet reflections on the porcelain face, eye, lips, gloves, chains, and cracked heart. Illuminate the scene with {argument name="lighting" default="cold blue-gray side lighting with a faint internal red glow"}, creating deep shadows, soft rim light, and a moody chiaroscuro effect. Add {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="tiny drifting red embers, dust motes, and floating glass-like droplets"} throughout the frame. Her eyes convey {argument name="emotion" default="melancholy obsession and quiet longing"}. Macro lens feel, shallow depth of field, highly detailed skin cracks, ceramic texture, lace fibers, reflective highlights, dark desaturated palette with small red accents, 4:5 vertical composition, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 电影级超写实特写肖像，描绘了一位脆弱的哥特风格瓷偶女性，{argument name="character" default="一位面色苍白、布满裂纹的瓷质仿生少女"} 正怀抱着 {argument name="object" default="一颗破碎的白色陶瓷解剖心脏"}，神情专注而凝重。她留着黑色短波波头，配有整齐的刘海；半透明的苍白皮肤上，脸颊和鼻梁处布满了细密的裂纹；双唇微张，泛着光泽；一只眼睛是深邃的人类眼眸，另一只则是被裂纹环绕、浑浊如碎玻璃般的眼球，周围伴有放射状裂痕和深色的泪痕。她戴着黑色蕾丝手套的双手在前景中捧着心脏；陶瓷心脏表面有裂纹和缺口，其中一道裂缝透出微弱的红光。她身着深色维多利亚风格蕾丝服饰，佩戴金属链条耳环、垂坠珠饰及陈旧的装饰品；瓷质面部、眼部、唇部、手套、链条及破碎的心脏上均有细腻的湿润反光。场景采用 {argument name="lighting" default="冷蓝灰色侧光，伴随微弱的内部红光"} 照明，营造出深邃的阴影、柔和的轮廓光以及忧郁的明暗对照效果。画面中加入 {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="细小的红色余烬、尘埃微粒以及漂浮的玻璃状液滴"}。她的眼神传达出 {argument name="emotion" default="忧郁的执念与静谧的渴望"}。微距镜头质感，浅景深，高度还原皮肤裂纹、陶瓷质感、蕾丝纤维及反光高光，采用深色去饱和色调并点缀红色，4:5 竖构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: PhonePe Split Billing Party Ad

titleLocalized.zh: PhonePe 分摊账单派对广告

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished vertical social media advertisement for {argument name="brand name" default="PhonePe"}, promoting instant group bill splitting for UPI payments with a bold party/nightlife energy.

Canvas: Square 1:1 digital ad, high-resolution, deep purple and neon violet color palette, glossy fintech campaign style, dramatic depth of field. Background is a rooftop restaurant or lounge at night with city lights, purple bokeh, and a group of friends at a dinner table.

Layout: Top left show the PhonePe logo mark and wordmark in white. Top right show a small shield icon with the text "Trusted UPI". Behind the subject, place huge oversized semi-transparent purple typography reading "NO DRAMA" tilted slightly and filling the upper-left background. On the upper-right, place the main headline in bold white uppercase: "PAY YOUR PART. KEEP THE VIBE." with the subheading below: "One tap and everyone’s sorted." Add a short decorative underline under the subheading.

Main subject: A young woman in the foreground stands confidently at a party table, wearing a purple varsity jacket over a white crop top and light denim jeans, with black nail polish. She holds a large smartphone close to the camera in her left hand, making it the dominant foreground object, while pointing playfully with her other hand. Her face should be covered by a flat rectangular anonymization block in a natural skin-tone brown, and the visible faces of three seated friends in the background should also be covered by similar rectangular skin-tone blocks. Keep the pose, outfit, and lighting stylish and youthful.

Phone screen: Show a purple PhonePe-style bill split interface titled "Dinner Split". At the top display the time "9:41". Large amount: "₹3240". Under it: "8 friends • ₹405 each". A green success card reads "Paid by everyone" and "Completed instantly". Below it, show exactly 8 itemized friend rows, each with a tiny circular avatar, name, amount "₹405", and a green checkmark: 1) Ananya, 2) Rohan, 3) Karan, 4) Meera, 5) Arjun, 6) Simran, 7) Vikram, 8) Neha. At the bottom of the screen, add a purple rounded button labeled "Split Again" with a white shield/check icon.

Floating UI elements: Add exactly 3 glowing purple transaction cards connected by dotted curved lines and small circular avatar bubbles: 1) "Payment Sent ₹405" with a lightning icon, 2) "Paid ₹405" with a green check icon, 3) "All Settled! Everyone Paid" with a green check icon. Make them hover around the subject’s pointing hand on the right side.

Call to action: Near the lower-right center, place a large white pill-shaped button with purple text "Split in Seconds" and a right arrow icon.

Bottom information bar: Add one translucent rounded purple strip containing exactly 4 feature capsules/icons from left to right: 1) lightning icon with "Instant settlements", 2) group icon with "Group friendly", 3) shield icon with "Safe UPI payments", 4) phone icon with "Everywhere accepted". Beneath or beside it show a small group icon with "500M+ Indians use PhonePe". At the bottom right, include exactly 2 app store badges: "GET IT ON Google Play" and "Download on the App Store".

Side text: Along the left edge, add small vertical white text reading "PHONEPE • SPLIT BILLING • SOCIAL PAY • 2026".

Visual style: Premium hyper-realistic advertising composite, cinematic purple rim lighting, glossy UI overlays, neon glow, energetic nightlife mood, sharp foreground phone, blurred background friends and city lights, crisp readable typography.

Constraints: Use the exact visible counts: 8 friend rows on the phone, 3 floating payment cards, 4 bottom feature items, 2 store badges, and 4 anonymized face blocks total. Avoid extra logos, extra payment cards, or extra feature pills.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="PhonePe"} 制作一个精致的竖版社交媒体广告，以大胆的派对/夜生活氛围推广 UPI 支付的即时群组账单分摊功能。

画布：1:1 正方形数字广告，高分辨率，深紫色和霓虹紫配色，光泽感金融科技营销风格，具有戏剧性的景深效果。背景为夜晚的屋顶餐厅或酒廊，带有紫色光斑，以及餐桌旁的一群朋友。

布局：左上角显示白色的 PhonePe 标志和文字标识。右上角显示一个带有“Trusted UPI”文字的小盾牌图标。在主体后方，放置巨大的半透明紫色文字“NO DRAMA”，稍微倾斜并填充左上角背景。在右上角，放置加粗的白色大写主标题：“PAY YOUR PART. KEEP THE VIBE.”，下方为副标题：“One tap and everyone’s sorted.”。在副标题下方添加一条简短的装饰性下划线。

主体：前景中一位年轻女性自信地站在派对桌旁，身穿紫色棒球夹克，内搭白色露脐上衣和浅色牛仔裤，涂着黑色指甲油。她左手将一部大屏智能手机靠近镜头，使其成为前景的主导物体，同时另一只手俏皮地指向前方。她的脸部应被一个自然的肤色棕色矩形遮挡块覆盖，背景中三位坐着的朋友的可见脸部也应被类似的肤色矩形块覆盖。保持姿势、服装和灯光时尚且年轻化。

手机屏幕：展示一个紫色的 PhonePe 风格账单分摊界面，标题为“Dinner Split”。顶部显示时间“9:41”。大额金额：“₹3240”。下方显示：“8 friends • ₹405 each”。一张绿色成功卡片显示“Paid by everyone”和“Completed instantly”。在下方，准确显示 8 行分项好友列表，每行包含一个小圆形头像、姓名、金额“₹405”和一个绿色对勾：1) Ananya, 2) Rohan, 3) Karan, 4) Meera, 5) Arjun, 6) Simran, 7) Vikram, 8) Neha。在屏幕底部，添加一个紫色的圆角按钮，标注为“Split Again”，并带有白色盾牌/对勾图标。

浮动 UI 元素：添加 3 张发光的紫色交易卡片，通过虚线曲线和小圆形头像气泡连接：1) 带有闪电图标的“Payment Sent ₹405”，2) 带有绿色对勾图标的“Paid ₹405”，3) 带有绿色对勾图标的“All Settled! Everyone Paid”。让它们悬浮在右侧主体指向的手部周围。

号召性用语 (CTA)：在右下角中心附近，放置一个大的白色药丸状按钮，带有紫色文字“Split in Seconds”和一个向右的箭头图标。

底部信息栏：添加一个半透明的圆角紫色长条，从左到右包含 4 个功能胶囊/图标：1) 带有“Instant settlements”的闪电图标，2) 带有“Group friendly”的群组图标，3) 带有“Safe UPI payments”的盾牌图标，4) 带有“Everywhere accepted”的手机图标。在其下方或旁边显示一个小群组图标，标注“500M+ Indians use PhonePe”。在右下角，包含 2 个应用商店徽章：“GET IT ON Google Play”和“Download on the App Store”。

侧边文字：沿左侧边缘，添加白色小字竖排文字：“PHONEPE • SPLIT BILLING • SOCIAL PAY • 2026”。

视觉风格：高级超写实广告合成，电影级紫色轮廓光，光泽感 UI 叠加，霓虹光效，充满活力的夜生活氛围，清晰的前景手机，模糊的背景朋友和城市灯光，清晰易读的排版。

约束条件：使用精确的可见数量：手机上有 8 行好友列表，3 张浮动支付卡片，4 个底部功能项，2 个商店徽章，总共 4 个遮挡脸部的方块。避免添加额外的标志、额外的支付卡片或额外的功能胶囊。

templates.title: Mini World Foodscape Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 迷你世界美食景观网格

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a 2x2 grid of four surreal miniature edible city foodscapes, each city rising from a vast desert of fine golden cane sugar, photographed like a premium macro diorama with cinematic lighting. Use {argument name="overall theme" default="Universal Mini World Foodscape"} as the concept: iconic landmarks and skyscrapers are meticulously crafted from colorful candies, pastries, vegetables, spices, biscuits, sugar glass, jellies, and confectionery materials.

Canvas: Square image, four equal panels separated by thick black gutters, each panel a polished miniature scene with shallow depth of field, glowing city lights, sparkling sugar grains, tiny trees, and dreamy atmospheric haze. High-detail macro photography look, saturated jewel tones, warm highlights, dark vignette edges, no people except miniature statues or landmark replicas.

Layout: Exactly 4 labeled panels in a 2x2 arrangement. Count and labels: 1) top-left: “MINI NYC”; 2) top-right: “MINI LONDON”; 3) bottom-left: “MINI BEIJING”; 4) bottom-right: “MINI TOKYO”. Each title appears in elegant white serif uppercase lettering near the upper-left of its panel, with “MINI” smaller where appropriate. Keep the labels readable and spelled exactly.

Panel details: Top-left “MINI NYC” shows a miniature New York skyline beside a turquoise lake, with a tiny Statue of Liberty on a small island in the foreground, an Empire State Building-like candy skyscraper, Chrysler Building-like spire, assorted cylindrical candy towers, palm-like edible plants, broccoli-like trees, glowing windows, and rolling sugar dunes behind the skyline. Use {argument name="first city label" default="MINI NYC"} for the visible title.

Top-right “MINI LONDON” shows edible London landmarks on golden sugar terrain with a small river or lagoon in front: Tower Bridge made from orange biscuit/candy, a Big Ben/Elizabeth Tower-style clock tower, the tall Shard-shaped sugar-glass tower, the Gherkin with diamond icing pattern, red-orange skyscrapers, tiny trees, and moody night sky with pink and red bokeh lights. Use {argument name="second city label" default="MINI LONDON"} for the visible title.

Bottom-left “MINI BEIJING” shows a miniature Beijing foodscape with a grand circular Temple of Heaven-style structure, ornate red-and-gold palace roofs, pagoda-like towers, a CCTV Headquarters-style angular building in the background, a red Chinese gate bridge over blue water in the foreground, lush edible greenery, sugar dunes, mist, and warm lantern-like glow. Use {argument name="third city label" default="MINI BEIJING"} for the visible title.

Bottom-right “MINI TOKYO” shows a miniature Tokyo foodscape at dusk with a vivid red Tokyo Tower at center, a pale Tokyo Skytree-like tower to the right, dense candy skyscrapers, a red torii gate over dark blue water in the foreground, koi fish-shaped sweets, pink blossom-like candy flowers, manicured edible shrubs, and a purple-blue neon skyline glow. Use {argument name="fourth city label" default="MINI TOKYO"} for the visible title.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed macro diorama, whimsical surreal food art, photorealistic textures, edible architecture, sparkling granulated sugar sand, dramatic studio lighting, soft fog, miniature scale, tilt-shift depth of field, rich contrast, high saturation, crisp landmarks, fantasy travel-poster mood.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 panels and exactly the 4 city titles listed. Do not add extra panels, captions, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or real humans. Preserve black borders between panels. Make every city visually distinct and recognizable through its landmarks while keeping all structures edible and miniature.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个 2x2 的网格，展示四个超现实的微缩可食用城市美食景观，每座城市都从广阔的精细金色蔗糖沙漠中升起，并以高端微缩模型的方式进行拍摄，呈现电影般的灯光效果。使用 {argument name="overall theme" default="Universal Mini World Foodscape"} 作为概念：标志性地标和摩天大楼由色彩缤纷的糖果、糕点、蔬菜、香料、饼干、糖玻璃、果冻和糖果材料精心制作而成。

画布：正方形图像，四个相等的面板由粗黑边隔开，每个面板都是一个精致的微缩场景，具有浅景深、发光的城市灯光、闪烁的糖粒、微小的树木和梦幻般的大气薄雾。高细节微缩摄影外观，饱和的宝石色调，温暖的高光，深色晕影边缘，除微型雕像或地标复制品外，不包含人物。

布局：精确的 4 个带标签面板，呈 2x2 排列。计数和标签：1) 左上： “MINI NYC”；2) 右上： “MINI LONDON”；3) 左下： “MINI BEIJING”；4) 右下： “MINI TOKYO”。每个标题均以优雅的白色衬线大写字母显示在面板左上方，必要时“MINI”字样较小。保持标签清晰且拼写准确。

面板细节：左上角的“MINI NYC”展示了绿松石色湖泊旁的微缩纽约天际线，前景中有一个小岛上的微型自由女神像，一座类似帝国大厦的糖果摩天大楼，类似克莱斯勒大厦的尖顶，各种圆柱形糖果塔，棕榈状的可食用植物，西兰花状的树木，发光的窗户，以及天际线后起伏的糖沙丘。使用 {argument name="first city label" default="MINI NYC"} 作为可见标题。

右上角的“MINI LONDON”展示了金色糖沙地形上的可食用伦敦地标，前方有一条小河或泻湖：由橙色饼干/糖果制成的塔桥，大本钟/伊丽莎白塔风格的钟楼，高耸的碎片大厦风格糖玻璃塔，带有菱形糖霜图案的“小黄瓜”大楼，红橙色的摩天大楼，微小的树木，以及带有粉色和红色散景灯光的忧郁夜空。使用 {argument name="second city label" default="MINI LONDON"} 作为可见标题。

左下角的“MINI BEIJING”展示了微缩北京美食景观，包括宏伟的圆形天坛风格建筑，华丽的红金宫殿屋顶，宝塔状塔楼，背景中 CCTV 总部风格的角状建筑，前景中横跨蓝色水域的红色中国门桥，郁郁葱葱的可食用绿植，糖沙丘，薄雾和温暖的灯笼状光芒。使用 {argument name="third city label" default="MINI BEIJING"} 作为可见标题。

右下角的“MINI TOKYO”展示了黄昏时分的微缩东京美食景观，中心是鲜红色的东京塔，右侧是苍白的东京晴空塔风格塔楼，密集的糖果摩天大楼，前景中横跨深蓝色水域的红色鸟居，锦鲤形状的甜点，粉色花朵般的糖果花，修剪整齐的可食用灌木，以及紫蓝色的霓虹天际线光芒。使用 {argument name="fourth city label" default="MINI TOKYO"} 作为可见标题。

视觉风格：超细节微缩模型，异想天开的超现实美食艺术，照片级真实纹理，可食用建筑，闪烁的砂糖沙，戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，柔和的雾气，微缩比例，移轴景深，丰富的对比度，高饱和度，清晰的地标，奇幻旅行海报氛围。

约束：使用精确的 4 个面板和列出的 4 个城市标题。不要添加额外的面板、标题、徽标、水印、UI 元素或真实人物。保留面板之间的黑色边框。通过地标使每个城市在视觉上独特且可辨认，同时保持所有结构的可食用性和微缩感。

templates.title: Mini London Sugar Landscape

titleLocalized.zh: 迷你伦敦糖果景观

templates.prompt: Create a square cinematic macro photograph of a surreal miniature food-landscape titled {argument name="title text" default="MINI LONDON"}, showing London rising from a vast desert of fine sparkling golden cane sugar. The scene contains exactly 7 recognizable landmark miniatures: 1) Tower Bridge in the front-left made from orange-red candy sticks with pale sugar-cable suspension lines, 2) Big Ben / Elizabeth Tower as the central centerpiece made from stacked glossy red candy wafers with cream icing trim and a readable clock face, 3) The Shard behind it on the right as a tall translucent faceted sugar-glass shard glowing warm white, 4) 30 St Mary Axe / the Gherkin on the far right made from dark green and pale green checker-patterned candy scales, 5) a small red British telephone booth beside a turquoise pond in the foreground, 6) a red rounded modern tower in the mid-background, and 7) a cluster of smaller colorful London skyscrapers and cathedral-like towers made from edible sweets. Surround the buildings with exactly 3 main natural miniature areas: a turquoise sugar-water pond in the foreground center, dense broccoli-like green shrubs and trees around it and between buildings, and scattered palm-like sugar plants sprouting from the sand. Use {argument name="main edible material" default="fine golden cane sugar"} for the desert base, with visible sugar crystals and shallow dunes. Add theatrical colored mist and bokeh lights in the background, with deep black, purple, blue, and magenta haze, plus warm golden highlights on the sugar and landmarks. Place the title text in the upper-left in large elegant white serif capitals, two lines, reading MINI above LONDON. Use a shallow depth of field, tilt-shift miniature scale, ultra-detailed edible textures, glossy candy surfaces, dramatic studio lighting, photoreal macro realism, no people, no watermark, no extra text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张方形电影质感微距摄影作品，呈现一个名为 {argument name="title text" default="MINI LONDON"} 的超现实微缩美食景观，展示伦敦从一片广阔的精细闪亮金色蔗糖沙漠中升起。场景中包含 7 个清晰可辨的地标微缩模型：1) 左前方由橙红色糖条制成、带有淡色糖丝悬索的伦敦塔桥；2) 中央核心位置由堆叠的亮面红色糖片制成、带有奶油糖霜装饰且时钟清晰可见的大本钟/伊丽莎白塔；3) 右后方发着暖白光、呈半透明多面糖玻璃状的碎片大厦；4) 最右侧由深绿色和浅绿色棋盘格糖鳞片制成的 30 圣玛丽斧街大楼/小黄瓜大楼；5) 前景中一个位于绿松石色水池旁的小型红色英式电话亭；6) 中后方一座圆形的红色现代塔楼；以及 7) 一组由可食用糖果制成的、较小的彩色伦敦摩天大楼和教堂式塔楼。在建筑物周围布置 3 个主要的自然微缩区域：前景中央的一个绿松石色糖水池，周围及建筑物之间茂密的西兰花状绿色灌木和树木，以及从沙地中长出的散落棕榈状糖植物。使用 {argument name="main edible material" default="精细金色蔗糖"} 作为沙漠基底，呈现可见的糖晶体和浅沙丘。在背景中添加戏剧性的彩色薄雾和焦外成像光斑，伴有深黑、紫、蓝和洋红色的雾气，以及落在糖果和地标上的暖金色高光。将标题文字置于左上方，使用大型优雅的白色衬线大写字母，分为两行，上方为 MINI，下方为 LONDON。采用浅景深、移轴微缩比例、超精细可食用纹理、光泽糖果表面、戏剧性摄影棚灯光、超写实微距效果，画面中无人像、无水印、无额外文字。

templates.title: Mini NYC Food Landscape

titleLocalized.zh: 迷你纽约美食景观

templates.prompt: Create a square cinematic macro photograph of a surreal miniature New York City food-landscape rising from a vast desert of fine golden cane sugar. The scene is a detailed diorama viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle with shallow depth of field, atmospheric haze, and warm glowing city lights. Add large elegant white serif text in the upper left reading {argument name="title text" default="MINI NYC"}. Build a miniature Manhattan skyline from edible materials: a central Empire State Building made from stacked glossy purple onion layers with a sparkling sugar-dusted spire; a cream-white Chrysler Building made from carved layered onion or pastry scales with a pointed spire; surrounding towers made from cucumber slices, corn cobs, stacked zucchini rounds, carrots, sugar cubes, wafers, translucent candy blocks, and vegetable cylinders. Include exactly one Statue of Liberty in the foreground, carved from bright orange carrot, standing on a tiny sugar island in a turquoise-blue lagoon. Surround the city with rolling dunes of cane sugar like sand, broccoli florets as clusters of trees, rosemary sprigs as miniature palms and street plantings, cherry tomatoes stacked vertically as a red skyscraper, and glowing miniature Times Square-style billboards along a waterfront street. The composition should feature a turquoise lagoon across the bottom third, dense edible greenery at the lower edges, the tallest purple onion tower near center-left, the white Chrysler-style tower to its right, and warm golden lights at street level. Use hyperreal macro food photography, tilt-shift miniature effect, crisp edible textures, sparkling sugar granules, soft dramatic backlighting, teal shadows, warm amber highlights, whimsical but photorealistic detail, no people, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张方形电影级微距摄影作品，展现一个超现实的迷你纽约市美食景观，从广阔的金色细砂糖沙漠中拔地而起。场景为一个细节丰富的立体模型，采用略微俯视的四分之三角度拍摄，具有浅景深、大气雾霾和温暖的城市灯光效果。在左上角添加优雅的白色大号衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="MINI NYC"}。用可食用材料构建迷你曼哈顿天际线：中央的帝国大厦由层叠的亮紫色洋葱片制成，顶部带有闪闪发光的糖粉尖顶；白奶油色的克莱斯勒大厦由雕刻的洋葱层或糕点鳞片制成，带有尖顶；周围的塔楼由黄瓜片、玉米棒、层叠的西葫芦圆片、胡萝卜、方糖、威化饼、半透明糖块和蔬菜圆柱体组成。在前景中包含一座由亮橙色胡萝卜雕刻而成的自由女神像，矗立在绿松石色泻湖中的一个小糖岛上。城市周围环绕着如沙丘般的甘蔗糖堆、作为树丛的西兰花小花、作为迷你棕榈树和街道绿化的迷迭香枝、垂直堆叠的樱桃番茄红摩天大楼，以及沿海街道上发光的迷你时代广场风格广告牌。构图应在底部三分之一处呈现绿松石色泻湖，下边缘有茂密的可食用绿植，最高的紫色洋葱塔位于中左侧，白色的克莱斯勒风格塔楼位于其右侧，街道层面有温暖的金色灯光。采用超写实微距美食摄影风格，具备移轴微缩效果，清晰的可食用纹理，闪烁的糖颗粒，柔和的戏剧性背光，青色阴影，温暖的琥珀色高光，奇幻而逼真的细节，无人物，无水印。

templates.title: Mini Beijing Sugar Cityscape

templates.prompt: Create a surreal macro food-art miniature cityscape titled {argument name="headline text" default="MINI BEIJING"}, showing Beijing rising from a vast desert of fine golden cane sugar. The centerpiece is a detailed edible Temple of Heaven in the middle: round tiered white sugar-stone terraces, carved staircases, a circular white balustrade, and a dark indigo-purple ridged roof with a golden finial. Surround it with exactly 12 distinct miniature edible Beijing-inspired structures and landmarks: 1 white pagoda tower on the left, 1 small red-and-gold palace pavilion in the front-left, 1 larger red-and-gold palace hall on the right, 2 small red temple buildings flanking the central temple, 1 orange-red ceremonial gate in the foreground over a turquoise pond, 1 green lattice-pattern modern arch resembling the CCTV Headquarters on the right, 1 tall golden needle-like skyscraper in the rear-left center, 1 glowing red tiered tower in the rear center, 1 tall amber-lit skyscraper in the rear-right, 1 purple-lit vertical tower in the far background, and 1 rounded glass dome building behind the temple. Make all architecture appear crafted from edible materials such as sugar crystals, candy, wafer, icing, jelly, fondant, sesame, and translucent hard candy, with warm glowing windows and candy-like details. The ground is a textured golden sugar desert with scattered white sugar pearls around the central plaza, orange candy-brick paths, tiny green broccoli-like trees and shrubs, edible grass reeds, small rocks, and a shallow bright turquoise candy-water pond at the bottom. Use cinematic shallow depth of field: sharp focus on the Temple of Heaven and foreground gate, softly blurred skyscraper skyline in the back, atmospheric pink-purple mist and warm orange light, high contrast, glossy macro photography look, square composition. Place the headline text in the upper-left corner in elegant spaced white serif capitals, two lines, reading exactly {argument name="headline text" default="MINI BEIJING"}. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个超现实的微距美食艺术微型城市景观，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="MINI BEIJING"}，展示北京从一片广阔的金色细砂糖沙漠中升起。中心是一座精致的可食用天坛：圆形的层叠白糖石露台、雕刻的台阶、圆形的白色栏杆，以及带有金色顶饰的深靛紫色脊屋顶。周围环绕着 12 个独特的微型可食用北京风格建筑和地标：左侧 1 座白塔，左前方 1 座红色和金色的宫殿亭，右侧 1 座较大的红色和金色宫殿大厅，中央寺庙两侧各有 1 座红色小寺庙建筑，前景中有一个横跨绿松石色池塘的橙红色仪式门，右侧有 1 座类似中央电视台总部的绿色网格状现代拱门，后左侧中心有 1 座高大的金色针状摩天大楼，后中心有 1 座发光的红色层叠塔，后右侧有 1 座高大的琥珀色灯光摩天大楼，远景背景中有 1 座紫色灯光的垂直塔，寺庙后方有 1 座圆形的玻璃穹顶建筑。使所有建筑看起来都由可食用材料制成，如糖晶体、糖果、威化饼、糖霜、果冻、翻糖、芝麻和半透明硬糖，并带有温暖的发光窗户和糖果般的细节。地面是质感丰富的金色糖沙漠，中央广场周围散布着白色糖珠、橙色糖果砖路径、微小的西兰花状树木和灌木、可食用草芦、小石块，底部有一个浅浅的明亮绿松石色糖果水池。使用电影级的浅景深：焦点清晰地对准天坛和前景的大门，背景中的摩天大楼天际线柔和模糊，营造出大气感的粉紫色薄雾和温暖的橙色光线，高对比度，具有光泽的微距摄影外观，方形构图。将标题文本放置在左上角，使用优雅且带有间距的白色衬线大写字母，分为两行，内容完全为 {argument name="headline text" default="MINI BEIJING"}。画面中没有人、车辆、额外的标签或水印。

templates.title: Needle-Felt Selfie Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: 羊毛毡自拍微缩模型

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the entire photo into a whimsical handmade needle-felt / wool-felt miniature diorama. Preserve the original composition, selfie camera angle, perspective, pose, subject placement, outfit, facial expression, hairstyle, lighting direction, and recognizable setting, but reinterpret every surface as soft felted wool with visible fibers, plush seams, rounded handmade edges, and miniature craft textures. Keep the foreground arm, bracelet, main person, background companion, long arched-column interior, warm amber lighting, and distant visitors in the same relative positions. Convert the architecture into felt columns and arches with stitched stone-block details and colorful felt trim; convert the floor, railings, plants, lights, and background figures into tiny handcrafted diorama pieces. Maintain the same shallow depth of field and tilted wide-angle selfie feel, with soft bokeh and cozy toy-like realism. Do not add text, logos, or extra characters beyond the people already present in the reference.

promptLocalized.zh: 根据提供的参考图片，将整张照片转化为充满奇趣的手工针毡 / 羊毛毡微缩模型。保留原始构图、自拍视角、透视关系、姿势、主体位置、服装、面部表情、发型、光照方向以及可辨识的场景，但将所有表面重新诠释为带有可见纤维、毛绒接缝、圆润手工边缘和微缩工艺质感的柔软羊毛毡。保持前景手臂、手链、主角、背景同伴、长拱柱室内空间、温暖的琥珀色灯光以及远处游客的相对位置不变。将建筑转化为带有缝合石块细节和彩色毛毡饰边的毛毡柱与拱门；将地板、栏杆、植物、灯光和背景人物转化为精致的手工微缩模型组件。保持相同的浅景深和倾斜的广角自拍感，呈现柔和的焦外成像和温馨的玩具般写实效果。除参考图中已存在的人物外，请勿添加任何文字、Logo 或额外角色。

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个名为 {argument name="title text" default="MINI TOKYO"} 的超现实微距迷你美食景观，展现东京从一片广阔的细金白色蔗糖结晶地面上升起，如同夜晚的沙漠。构图为方形电影级立体模型，具有浅景深、戏剧性的蓝紫色烟雾背景、建筑间柔和的雾气，以及温暖的粉红色与红色可食用灯光。中心矗立着 1 座主导的东京塔，由堆叠的亮面红椒条和浅色糖圈精心构建，底部发出橙色光芒。右侧矗立着 1 座由浅色糖棒和白色糖果棒制成的高大东京晴空塔。在朦胧的背景中环绕 16 座迷你可食用摩天大楼和塔楼，包括 1 座黑白交叉椭圆形塔、1 座红白条纹圆柱形塔、1 座小型钟楼式建筑、2 座宝塔式塔楼、1 座标有 {argument name="storefront label" default="PRADA"} 的绿色玻璃奢侈品店，以及由威化饼、软糖、棉花糖、饼干和辣椒片制成的额外糖果块高层建筑。在前景中，用西兰花、香草、绿叶蔬菜、花椰菜小花、粉色腌姜和糖果状灌木制作一个微型日式花园。在光亮的深青色池塘边缘添加 1 座红色鸟居，旁边有 2 盏发光的红灯笼，水中漂浮着 3 艘寿司形状的小船。使用 {argument name="main color palette" default="深海军蓝、洋红色、糖果红、糖白色、苔藓绿和暖橙色"}。将标题文本置于左上角，采用优雅的白色衬线字体，小写字母“MINI”位于大写且字间距拉开的“TOKYO”上方。超精细美食造型，微距摄影真实感，奇幻可食用建筑，魔幻微缩比例，清晰的前景纹理，散景城市深度，无人物，无水印。

templates.title: Kawaii Mother's Day Bento Food Art

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱风母亲节便当食玩艺术

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed handcrafted edible art world celebrating {argument name="celebration" default="Mother's Day"} in a kawaii Japanese spring bento style, transforming a full meal into a cute character centerpiece made entirely from real foods.

Canvas: Square 1:1 overhead food photography composition, bright pastel color palette, soft natural light, shallow depth but all main foods readable, festive blue tablecloth background covered with cherry blossoms, pink carnations, doodled hearts, clouds, sparkles, and tiny celebration decorations.

Main centerpiece: In the center of a large round pink bento plate, make one large edible girl character: rice face with shiny black eyes, lashes, rosy cheeks, smiling mouth, long blonde hair made from thin omelet/noodle strands, pink flower hair decoration, pink heart earrings, kimono-like outfit made from pink ham and blue rice/crepe layers, holding a bouquet of pink carnation flowers tied with a bow. The character should feel like a lovingly made Mother’s Day food-art doll.

Food elements to include, exactly 15 visible edible feature groups: 1) central girl character, 2) two smiling rice-ball onigiri behind her with nori rectangles and green shiso leaves, 3) small basket of strawberries with one halved strawberry, 4) heart-topped custard pudding on a pink saucer, 5) red sausage octopus with a face and bow tie, 6) cluster of cherry tomatoes and vegetable flowers, 7) pink carnation bouquet in the character’s hands, 8) rolled omelet/noodle roses near the top center, 9) pink bowl of fruit containing green grape, orange segments, and a pink heart sweet, 10) heart-shaped tamagoyaki block with two small red hearts, 11) two breaded fried shrimp with orange tails, 12) broccoli and lemon wedge garnish, 13) pink fluted cup of spaghetti napolitan with peas and flower-shaped toppings, 14) small rice or dumpling hand beside the pasta, 15) separate small plate at bottom right with sakura mochi wrapped in a leaf and topped with a pink flower.

Non-food props and decorations to include, exactly 8 visible groups: 1) teacup at upper right with warm tea and a cute anime girl illustration plus floral print, 2) woven coaster under the cup, 3) triangular pink bunting flags across the upper background, 4) two small fluffy white cloud cutouts near the Japanese writing, 5) floral greeting card sign in the strawberry basket, 6) floral apology/thanks card at bottom left tied with a pink ribbon, 7) two carp-streamer decorations at bottom center, 8) pink-handled small brush on floral paper at bottom right.

Text content: Add handwritten Japanese text in the sky area reading {argument name="background Japanese message" default="おかあさんへ いつもありがとう！！"}. Add a pink heart speech bubble near the top right reading {argument name="heart speech bubble" default="だいすき だよ〜♡"}. Add a small floral card in the strawberry basket reading {argument name="card text" default="Happy Mother's Day"}. Add a bottom-left floral card reading {argument name="bottom card Japanese text" default="感謝をこめて…"}. Keep text hand-drawn, cute, slightly imperfect, and integrated naturally into the scene.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed kawaii edible miniature art, Japanese bento craftsmanship, pastel pink and sky blue, glossy rice grains, crisp fried textures, soft omelet strands, realistic fruit and tea, abundant sakura and carnation motifs, whimsical hearts and sparkles. Make everything look handmade from food, cheerful, warm, and celebratory.

Constraints: Use an overhead flat-lay angle, no humans, no utensils except the small decorative brush, no watermark, no extra text beyond the specified messages, keep all counted food and prop groups clearly visible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一个超精细的手工可食用艺术世界，以可爱的日式春季便当风格庆祝 {argument name="celebration" default="母亲节"}，将一顿完整的餐点转化为完全由真实食物制成的可爱角色中心装饰。

画面：1:1 正方形俯视美食摄影构图，明亮的柔和色调，柔和的自然光，浅景深但所有主要食物清晰可见，节日蓝色桌布背景，上面覆盖着樱花、粉色康乃馨、涂鸦爱心、云朵、闪光和微小的庆典装饰。

主要中心装饰：在一个大型圆形粉色便当盘中央，制作一个大型可食用女孩角色：米饭做的脸，有着闪亮的黑色眼睛、睫毛、红润的脸颊、微笑的嘴巴，用薄蛋皮/面条丝制成的长金发，粉色花朵发饰，粉色爱心耳环，由粉色火腿和蓝色米饭/可丽饼层制成的和服式服装，手里捧着一束系着蝴蝶结的粉色康乃馨花束。该角色应呈现出一种充满爱意的母亲节食物艺术玩偶的感觉。

需包含的食物元素，共 15 组可见的可食用特征：1) 中央女孩角色，2) 她身后两个带有海苔长方形和青紫苏叶的微笑饭团，3) 一小篮草莓，其中一颗已切半，4) 粉色碟子上的心形布丁，5) 带有表情和领结的红色章鱼香肠，6) 一簇圣女果和蔬菜花，7) 角色手中的粉色康乃馨花束，8) 顶部中央附近的蛋卷/面条玫瑰，9) 粉色水果碗，内含青葡萄、橙子瓣和一颗粉色爱心糖果，10) 带有两个小红心的心形玉子烧，11) 两只带橙色尾巴的炸虾，12) 西兰花和柠檬角装饰，13) 粉色波纹杯装的拿坡里意面，配有豌豆和花形配料，14) 意面旁边的一小团米饭或饺子，15) 右下角单独的小盘子，上面放着包裹在叶子里并饰有粉色花朵的樱饼。

需包含的非食物道具和装饰，共 8 组可见元素：1) 右上角的茶杯，内有热茶，杯身有可爱的动漫女孩插画和花卉图案，2) 杯子下的编织杯垫，3) 背景上方横跨的三角形粉色旗帜，4) 日文文字附近的两个蓬松小白云剪纸，5) 草莓篮中的花卉贺卡，6) 左下角系着粉色丝带的花卉致谢卡，7) 底部中央的两个鲤鱼旗装饰，8) 右下角花卉纸上的粉色小刷子。

文字内容：在天空区域添加手写日文 {argument name="background Japanese message" default="おかあさんへ いつもありがとう！！"}。在右上角附近添加一个粉色爱心对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="heart speech bubble" default="だいすき だよ〜♡"}。在草莓篮中添加一张小花卡片，内容为 {argument name="card text" default="Happy Mother's Day"}。在左下角添加一张花卉卡片，内容为 {argument name="bottom card Japanese text" default="感謝をこめて…"}。保持文字手绘风格，可爱且略带不完美感，并自然地融入场景中。

视觉风格：超精细可爱风可食用微缩艺术，日式便当工艺，柔和粉色和天蓝色，光泽感米粒，酥脆的油炸质感，柔软的蛋皮丝，逼真的水果和茶，丰富的樱花和康乃馨图案，奇思妙想的爱心和闪光。让一切看起来都像是用食物手工制作的，充满欢快、温馨和庆典氛围。

约束条件：使用俯视平铺角度，无人物，除装饰用小刷子外无餐具，无水印，除指定的文字外无额外文字，确保所有统计的食物和道具组清晰可见。

templates.title: Isometric Security Icon Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴测安全图标网格

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a modern isometric illustration sheet on a clean light gray background, showing a seamless grid of cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance icons with soft shadows, glossy 3D materials, rounded edges, and a blue, white, gray, red, and orange accent palette. Use a wide horizontal canvas, evenly spaced rows and columns, with no border or watermark. Include exactly 15 discrete icons arranged in a 3-row by 5-column grid: top row: 1) a blue padlock with silver shackle and black keyhole, 2) a blue shield badge with a white check mark and metallic rim, 3) a silver key angled diagonally, 4) a dark smartphone-like biometric panel showing a glowing blue fingerprint scan line, 5) a desktop monitor login screen with a lock icon, password dots, and a blue button labeled “LOGIN”; middle row: 6) a white document page with folded corner, blue lock icon, and label “ENCRYPTED”, 7) a red brick firewall with an orange flame in front, 8) a white surveillance camera with blue lens mounted on a small wall bracket, 9) an ID badge with clip, portrait thumbnail, text lines, and barcode, 10) a red triangular warning sign with black exclamation mark; bottom row: 11) a dark server stack with colored status lights and a blue shield check badge in front, 12) a clipboard checklist labeled “COMPLIANCE” with green checkboxes, 13) a dark smartphone facial-recognition screen showing a wireframe face, scan brackets, and “VERIFYING...” text, 14) an alert dashboard card labeled “ALERT” with a magnifying glass inspecting the list, 15) a gray safe/vault box with round combination dial beside a white policy document labeled “POLICY” with gray lines and green check mark. Keep all icons consistent in isometric perspective, miniature object scale, polished SaaS/security branding style, crisp edges, ambient occlusion, and subtle contact shadows. Text should be minimal and legible only where specified. Theme customization: {argument name="theme" default="security and compliance"}; primary color customization: {argument name="primary color" default="deep blue"}; background customization: {argument name="background color" default="light gray"}.

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic widescreen film still of a glamorous mid-century blonde woman leaning against a dark window frame on the far left of the composition, with most of the right side filled by an out-of-focus teal-green urban window or wall. She has a voluminous 1960s platinum-blonde beehive hairstyle with soft curls, bare shoulders suggesting an elegant strapless outfit, gold jewelry including a chunky chain necklace and rings, and she holds a lit cigarette near her face with faint smoke drifting upward. Her face is deliberately covered by a large opaque square censorship block in muted brown, centered over the facial area and extending from the eyes down past the mouth. Use moody low-key lighting with warm sunlight grazing her hair and shoulder, deep shadows, teal-and-gold color grading, shallow depth of field, realistic film grain, anamorphic cinematic framing, and a tense vintage noir atmosphere. The scene should feel like a still from an art-house period drama, with no text, no watermark, and no extra people. Customize the subject as {argument name="character description" default="glamorous mid-century platinum-blonde woman"}, the face covering as {argument name="censorship block color" default="muted brown"}, the prop as {argument name="handheld prop" default="lit cigarette"}, the mood as {argument name="cinematic mood" default="tense vintage noir"}, and the color grade as {argument name="color grade" default="teal and gold"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影宽银幕剧照，画面左侧是一位迷人的 20 世纪中期金发女性，正倚靠在深色窗框旁，画面右侧大部分区域为失焦的青绿色城市窗户或墙壁。她留着 20 世纪 60 年代蓬松的白金发蜂窝头，带有柔和的卷发；裸露的肩膀暗示着她穿着优雅的抹胸装，佩戴着金饰，包括粗链项链和戒指；她手持一支点燃的香烟靠近面部，淡淡的烟雾向上飘散。她的面部被一个位于面部区域中心、从眼睛一直延伸到嘴部下方的巨大不透明棕色方形审查块刻意遮挡。采用低调的电影布光，温暖的阳光掠过她的头发和肩膀，形成深邃的阴影；使用青金色的色调分级、浅景深、逼真的胶片颗粒感、变形宽银幕构图，营造出紧张的复古黑色电影氛围。场景应如同艺术电影的剧照，无文字、无水印、无额外人物。自定义主体为 {argument name="character description" default="迷人的 20 世纪中期白金发女性"}，面部遮挡物为 {argument name="censorship block color" default="柔和棕色"}，道具为 {argument name="handheld prop" default="点燃的香烟"}，氛围为 {argument name="cinematic mood" default="紧张的复古黑色电影"}，色调为 {argument name="color grade" default="青金色"}。

templates.title: Nostalgic Japanese Seaside Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧日本海滨日落

templates.prompt: Create a nostalgic vertical 9:16 cinematic photograph of {argument name="location" default="a quiet Japanese seaside hillside town"} at sunset, viewed from the top of a steep old stone-paved stairway descending toward the ocean. In the foreground, exactly 2 schoolgirls walk away from the camera side by side down the steps; both wear white short-sleeve blouses, dark plaid skirts, dark socks and shoes, and carry dark school bags, with long soft shadows stretching toward the viewer. The wet-looking cobblestone steps glisten with warm orange-pink sunset reflections. Frame the scene with dark leafy tree branches forming a natural canopy across the top and left side, a stone wall along the left, a metal handrail along the right, and traditional Japanese wooden houses with tiled roofs on both sides. In the distance, show a compact coastal neighborhood, utility poles, rooftops, a calm sea, a small harbor, and a low island or headland on the horizon. The sun sits low over the water, creating a bright vertical golden reflection path across the sea. Use {argument name="mood" default="nostalgic and peaceful"} atmosphere, rich dusk colors of rose, lavender, peach, and gold, deep foreground silhouettes, realistic photographic detail, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, natural lens perspective, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张怀旧的 9:16 竖屏电影质感照片，场景为 {argument name="location" default="一个宁静的日本海滨山城"} 的日落时分，视角从通往大海的陡峭古老石阶顶部向下俯瞰。前景中，两名女学生并排背对镜头走下台阶；她们都穿着白色短袖衬衫、深色格子裙、深色袜子和鞋子，背着深色书包，长长的柔和阴影向观众方向延伸。湿润的鹅卵石台阶闪烁着温暖的橙粉色夕阳倒影。画面顶部和左侧由深色茂密的树枝形成天然遮蔽，左侧为石墙，右侧为金属扶手，两侧是带有瓦片的传统日本木屋。远处展示紧凑的沿海社区、电线杆、屋顶、平静的海面、小港口以及地平线上的低矮岛屿或岬角。太阳低悬于水面之上，在海面上形成一道明亮的垂直金色反光路径。使用 {argument name="mood" default="怀旧且宁静"} 的氛围，呈现玫瑰色、薰衣草色、桃色和金色的浓郁暮色，深邃的前景剪影，逼真的摄影细节，细腻的胶片颗粒感，高动态范围，自然的镜头透视，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Censored Vintage Film Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古风遮挡肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic pro-film photography portrait in a widescreen 16:9 frame. A glamorous vintage blonde woman stands at the far left edge of the composition, leaning against a vertical wall or window frame in deep shadow, with most of the frame occupied by an abstract dark teal architectural background. She has a large 1960s bouffant hairstyle in pale {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"}, bare shoulders, warm tan skin, gold jewelry including a chunky necklace and rings, and she holds a lit cigarette near her face with faint smoke drifting upward. Her face is deliberately obscured by a centered rectangular censor block in muted brown, covering the facial features while leaving the hair, hand, cigarette, neck, and shoulders visible. Use moody low-key lighting with warm sunlight grazing her hair and skin from the upper left, strong teal-and-gold color grading, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, subtle halation, and a still from a 1970s arthouse thriller or fashion editorial. The background should be minimal and out of focus, with dark geometric shadows, no text, no watermark, no extra people, and a tense, elegant atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 宽画幅的电影级专业摄影肖像。画面最左侧站着一位迷人的复古金发女性，她倚靠在深色阴影中的垂直墙壁或窗框旁，画面大部分空间由抽象的深青色建筑背景占据。她留着 1960 年代标志性的蓬松发型，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"}，裸露双肩，拥有温暖的古铜色皮肤，佩戴着厚重的金项链和戒指。她手持一支点燃的香烟靠近面部，淡淡的烟雾向上飘散。她的面部被一个位于中央的棕色矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮住了五官，但保留了头发、手部、香烟、颈部和肩膀的可见度。采用忧郁的低调照明，温暖的阳光从左上方掠过她的头发和皮肤，呈现强烈的青金配色调，浅景深，柔和的胶片颗粒感，微妙的光晕效果，呈现出 1970 年代艺术惊悚片或时尚杂志大片的质感。背景应简洁且虚化，带有深色的几何阴影，无文字，无水印，无其他人物，营造出一种紧张而优雅的氛围。

templates.title: Early 2000s Party Photo UI

titleLocalized.zh: 21 世纪初派对照片 UI

templates.prompt: Create a nostalgic early-2000s candid point-and-shoot flash photograph of {argument name="number of friends" default="three friends"} posing close together at a casual house party against a plain beige wall. The photo should look like a low-resolution disposable-camera snapshot with harsh direct flash, warm indoor color cast, slight grain, soft focus, mild overexposure on skin, and a dark vignette. Show one blonde woman on the left wearing a brown trucker cap with a small vintage logo patch, a green tank top over a white underlayer, and jewelry; one man in the center with short spiky dark hair wearing a black Hurley-style T-shirt, arms around both friends; and one brunette woman on the right wearing a brown halter top over white lace and a turquoise pendant necklace. Obscure each face with a flat rectangular skin-tone censor block, exactly 3 censor rectangles total. Add an orange digital camera date stamp in the bottom-right reading {argument name="date stamp" default="05 14 2003"}. Below the photo, include a modern rounded white prompt input bar as if in an AI image app, containing the text {argument name="input prompt text" default="early 2000s flash photo, red eyes, friends at a house party, point-and-shoot camera"}, with a vertical cursor at the end and a circular send button on the right containing a black arrow icon. Use a landscape 16:9 composition with the photo occupying the upper portion and the UI prompt bar occupying the lower portion.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张怀旧的 21 世纪初抓拍风格闪光灯照片，画面中 {argument name="number of friends" default="三位好友"} 在随意的家庭派对上紧靠在一起，背景是一面素色米色墙壁。照片应呈现出低分辨率一次性相机的快照质感，带有强烈的直射闪光、温暖的室内色调、轻微噪点、柔焦、皮肤轻微过曝以及暗角效果。左侧是一位金发女性，戴着带有复古小标志贴片的棕色卡车司机帽，身穿白色内搭和绿色背心，佩戴首饰；中间是一位留着黑色短刺猬头的男性，身穿黑色 Hurley 风格 T 恤，双臂搂着两位好友；右侧是一位深棕色头发的女性，身穿白色蕾丝内搭和棕色挂脖上衣，佩戴绿松石吊坠项链。用扁平的矩形肤色遮挡块遮住每张脸，总共 3 个遮挡矩形。在右下角添加一个橙色的数码相机日期戳，显示为 {argument name="date stamp" default="05 14 2003"}。在照片下方，包含一个现代圆角白色提示词输入栏，看起来就像 AI 图像应用中的界面，其中包含文本 {argument name="input prompt text" default="early 2000s flash photo, red eyes, friends at a house party, point-and-shoot camera"}，末尾有一个垂直光标，右侧有一个包含黑色箭头图标的圆形发送按钮。采用 16:9 横向构图，照片占据上方区域，UI 提示词输入栏占据下方区域。

templates.title: Minimal Pour-Over Coffee Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 极简手冲咖啡场景

templates.prompt: Create a realistic lifestyle product photograph of a calm morning coffee scene on a gray concrete kitchen countertop. In the foreground, place exactly 3 white ceramic coffee items: 1 plain white mug on the left filled with black coffee, 1 taller off-white speckled ceramic mug on the right, and 1 white ceramic pour-over dripper sitting on top of the taller mug. Use {argument name="coffee setup" default="a white ceramic pour-over dripper on an off-white mug beside a white coffee mug"} as the central subject. The scene should feel minimalist, cozy, and natural, with soft diffused daylight coming from a window on the right. In the background, include exactly 5 supporting objects: 2 wooden cutting boards leaning against a gray wall on the left, 1 matte black kettle behind the left mug, 1 small white ceramic jar with a brown lid near the cutting boards, and 1 beige potted green plant by the bright window on the right. Add 1 folded dark gray cloth napkin at the bottom-right edge of the counter. Use a muted neutral color palette of {argument name="color palette" default="warm whites, stone gray, beige, natural wood, matte black, and leafy green"}. Set the environment in a {argument name="room style" default="minimal modern kitchen with concrete surfaces"}. Shoot at eye-level with a slight front angle, shallow depth of field, realistic shadows, soft background blur, no people, no text, no logos, no extra cups or objects. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的生活方式产品摄影图，呈现灰色混凝土厨房台面上宁静的清晨咖啡场景。在前景处，放置 3 件白色陶瓷咖啡器具：左侧放 1 个装满黑咖啡的纯白马克杯，右侧放 1 个较高的米白色斑点陶瓷马克杯，并在该马克杯上方放置 1 个白色陶瓷手冲滤杯。滤杯内装有棕褐色滤纸，可见深色咖啡粉和已冲泡的咖啡，并有缕缕细微的蒸汽向上升腾。以 {argument name="coffee setup" default="一个放在米白色马克杯上的白色陶瓷手冲滤杯，旁边还有一个白色咖啡杯"} 作为中心主体。场景应营造出极简、舒适且自然的氛围，右侧窗户透入柔和的漫射日光。在背景中，包含 5 个辅助物体：左侧靠在灰色墙壁上的 2 个木制项目，左侧马克杯后方的 1 个哑光黑色水壶，靠近项目处 1 个带棕色盖子的小型白色陶瓷罐，以及右侧明亮窗边 1 盆米色花盆的绿植。在台面右下边缘添加 1 条折叠的深灰色布艺餐巾。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="暖白色、石灰色、米色、原木色、哑光黑色和叶绿色"} 的柔和中性色调。将环境设定为 {argument name="room style" default="带有混凝土表面的极简现代厨房"}。采用平视角度并略带正面倾斜拍摄，浅景深，呈现写实的阴影和柔和的背景虚化，画面中无人、无文字、无 Logo，且没有多余的杯子或其他物品。使其看起来像是一张高端咖啡广告大片，通过自然光拍摄，杯子和滤杯焦点清晰，带有细腻的蒸汽，营造出宁静祥和的氛围。

The face of the human subject is intentionally covered by a solid medium-brown rectangular privacy block. Lighting should be soft, cinematic, cozy, and slightly dim, like an evening bedroom scene. No text, no watermark, no extra people, no additional animals.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的温馨室内生活照，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位成年女性"} 侧卧在温馨卧室的米色床上，正温柔地与 {argument name="pet" default="一只橘色虎斑小猫"} 玩耍。主体留着齐肩浅棕色长发，身穿简单的白色无袖背心和深蓝色短裤，侧身姿势，一只手臂支撑身体，另一只手拿着细绳玩具靠近小猫。小猫躺在她身旁的床上，警觉地面对镜头，身上有明显的橘色条纹和柔软的毛发。人物面部特意用一个纯中棕色的矩形隐私遮挡块遮住。采用竖向人像构图，腰部至大腿取景，浅景深效果，自然的肤色，写实的布料褶皱，营造出宁静亲密的氛围。背景中包含一盏发光的床头灯，在米色墙壁上投射出温暖的黄色光芒，可见枕头和凌乱的米色床上用品。光线应柔和、具有电影感、温馨且略显昏暗，呈现出傍晚卧室的场景。无文字，无水印，无额外人物，无其他动物。
