templates.title: Ethereal Stand Profile Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Ethereal Stand 个人档案海报

templates.prompt:
Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic fantasy character-design poster for a guardian spirit called a Stand, blending ethereal Chinese typography with soft fashion photography and mythic creature design. The main subject is {argument name="character name" default="Higanbana · Wu"}, a young woman seated on a rough stone ledge beside a misty pond or stream, wearing a white ruched floral mini dress with thin straps and an oversized off-white knit cardigan slipping from one shoulder. Her hair is medium brown, loosely tied in a low messy bun with soft strands around the face; pose is elegant, quiet, slightly melancholic, hands resting on the ledge, legs angled forward. Hide or softly blur the face if needed, keeping the mood anonymous and poetic.

Behind and above her right shoulder, create the Stand: a large translucent white dragon-deer / fox-dragon guardian spirit with an elongated delicate snout, flowing feather-like mane, branching antler or horn shapes, veil-like fins, silk ribbons, dangling gold chains and tassels, and many small white flowers blooming along its head and body. It should feel like fog, petals, and moonlight given animal form: beautiful, fragile, protective, slightly uncanny, not cartoonish. The spirit curves around the woman as if guarding her, occupying the upper-right half of the poster.

Environment and lighting: a shaded waterside garden with drooping willow branches, dark green foliage, reflective water, floating mist, translucent gauze ribbons, tiny glowing petals or fireflies, and warm morning backlight filtering through haze. Use a palette of ivory, pearl white, champagne beige, pale blush, muted moss green, smoky gray, and soft gold. Overall atmosphere: serene, romantic, spectral, elegant, dreamlike, with a faint sense of grief and distance.

Design the poster as an information-rich Stand profile sheet with refined white serif typography and thin decorative rules. Include exactly 6 text blocks: 1) upper-left small label in Chinese and English, “替身設定 / STAND NAME”; 2) large title “彼岸花・霧” with smaller romanization “Higanbana · Wu”; 3) a short poetic Chinese paragraph beneath the title; 4) mid-left section titled “特殊能力” with ability name “花影迷離” and romanization “Hua Ying Mi Li,” followed by a concise ability description; 5) bottom-left section titled “設計關聯” with several short bullet-like Chinese lines and exactly 7 circular color swatches in ivory, cream, warm beige, dusty pink, gray-green, deep moss, and taupe; 6) bottom-right quote box containing “「你看到的美好，也許只是我編織的夢。」” plus a smaller boxed profile headed “少女檔案” with brief attributes such as personality, image, aura, and preferences. Add one narrow vertical Chinese text panel on the right side over the spirit, framed by thin lines. Text should be decorative and readable enough to evoke a luxury editorial character sheet, without overwhelming the image.

Visual style: high-end fantasy editorial poster, ultra-detailed, soft-focus photorealism mixed with delicate illustration, translucent layers, bokeh, shallow depth of field, fine ornamental linework, elegant Chinese book-design aesthetics, no harsh neon colors, no modern UI, no watermark. Use {argument name="main title" default="彼岸花・霧"} as the largest title, {argument name="ability name" default="花影迷離"} as the ability heading, and make the Stand feel like {argument name="guardian spirit motif" default="a white mist dragon-deer covered in flowers"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张 2:3 竖版电影感奇幻角色设计海报，展示名为 Stand 的守护灵，融合空灵的中文排版、柔和的时尚摄影风格与神话生物设计。主体为 {argument name="character name" default="Higanbana · Wu"}，一位年轻女性坐在多石的岩架上，身旁是雾气缭绕的池塘或溪流。她身穿白色褶皱花卉吊带短裙，外搭一件从单肩滑落的米白色大廓形针织开衫。她留着中棕色头发，随意扎成低发髻，脸颊两侧留有柔和的发丝；姿态优雅、安静且略带忧郁，双手放在岩架上，双腿向前倾斜。如有必要，可隐藏或柔焦面部，保持整体氛围的匿名感与诗意。

在她右肩后方及上方，创作 Stand：一个巨大的半透明白色龙鹿/狐龙守护灵，拥有细长的吻部、飘逸如羽毛的鬃毛、分叉的鹿角或角状物、面纱般的鳍、丝带、悬垂的金链与流苏，其头部和身体上绽放着许多小白花。它应呈现出雾气、花瓣与月光凝结成兽形的质感：美丽、脆弱、具有保护性、略带神秘感，而非卡通化。守护灵环绕在女性周围，仿佛在守护她，占据海报右上半部分。

环境与光影：阴凉的水畔花园，垂下的柳枝、深绿色叶片、倒映的水面、漂浮的雾气、半透明的纱带、细小的发光花瓣或萤火虫，以及透过薄雾过滤的温暖晨光。色调采用象牙白、珍珠白、香槟米色、淡腮红、柔和苔藓绿、烟灰色与柔金色。整体氛围：宁静、浪漫、幽灵般、优雅、梦幻，带有一丝淡淡的哀伤与疏离感。

将海报设计为信息丰富的 Stand 档案页，采用精致的白色衬线字体与纤细的装饰线条。包含 6 个文本区块：1) 左上角小型标签，中英文对照“替身设定 / STAND NAME”；2) 大标题“彼岸花・霧”及较小的罗马拼音“Higanbana · Wu”；3) 标题下方的一段简短中文诗意文字；4) 左中部标题“特殊能力”，包含能力名称“花影迷离”及罗马拼音“Hua Ying Mi Li”，后接简明的能力描述；5) 左下部标题“設計關聯”，包含几行简短的中文要点，以及 7 个圆形色卡，颜色分别为象牙白、奶油色、暖米色、灰粉色、灰绿色、深苔藓绿与灰褐色；6) 右下角引语框，内容为“「你看到的美好，也许只是我編織的夢。」”，并附带一个较小的“少女檔案”方框，包含性格、形象、气场与偏好等简要属性。在右侧守护灵上方添加一个狭窄的竖排中文文本栏，由细线框起。文字应具有装饰性且清晰易读，以营造奢华的编辑类角色档案感，同时不喧宾夺主。

视觉风格：高端奇幻编辑海报，超精细，柔焦写实与精致插画结合，半透明图层，焦外成像，浅景深，精细的装饰线条，优雅的中文书籍设计美学，无刺眼的霓虹色，无现代 UI，无水印。使用 {argument name="main title" default="彼岸花・霧"} 作为最大标题，{argument name="ability name" default="花影迷離"} 作为能力标题，并使 Stand 呈现出 {argument name="guardian spirit motif" default="a white mist dragon-deer covered in flowers"} 的感觉。

templates.title: French Indie Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 法式独立音乐专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square album cover for a melancholic indie/alternative single. Canvas: 1:1 ratio, softly textured paper background fading from warm cream on the left to pale powder blue on the right, with subtle film grain and a vintage editorial finish. Composition: place a blurred, painterly portrait of a person on the right two-thirds of the cover, cropped from mid-torso upward, head tilted back and turned slightly upward, with short dark messy hair forming a soft silhouette. The face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular frosted blur block in the upper-right area, semi-opaque with muted beige, gray, and brown tones. Clothing: a richly textured mustard-gold faux-fur coat or shawl sweeping dramatically from the lower-left corner across the body toward the right, with motion blur and warm amber shadows; underneath, a dark patterned high-neck garment in burgundy, green, and charcoal. Typography: on the left side, set exactly 2 text elements. Text element 1 is the title {argument name="album title" default="Encore Une Fois"}, stacked across three lines, very large, elegant high-contrast serif typeface, thin strokes, dark charcoal gray, aligned left, occupying the upper-left quadrant. Text element 2 is the artist name {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}, small uppercase serif letters with wide tracking, placed below the title near the left-center. Visual style: romantic, cinematic, slightly surreal, soft-focus photographic painting, warm ochre and burnt orange contrasted with cool blue, nostalgic French art-pop mood. Constraints: keep the design readable at thumbnail size, preserve generous negative space around the typography, no extra logos, no barcode, no additional text.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一首忧郁的独立/另类单曲创作一张方形专辑封面。画布：1:1 比例，纸张背景带有柔和纹理，从左侧的暖奶油色渐变至右侧的淡粉蓝色，并带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和复古编辑风格。构图：在封面右侧三分之二处放置一张模糊的油画感人物肖像，从躯干中部向上裁剪，头部后仰并略微向上转动，深色短发凌乱，形成柔和的轮廓。面部被右上角一个矩形的磨砂模糊块刻意遮挡，呈现半透明的柔和米色、灰色和棕色调。服装：一件质感丰富的芥末金人造皮草大衣或披肩，从左下角戏剧性地横跨身体向右延伸，带有动态模糊和温暖的琥珀色阴影；内搭一件深色图案的高领服装，色调为酒红、绿色和炭灰色。排版：在左侧设置 2 个文本元素。文本元素 1 为标题 {argument name="album title" default="Encore Une Fois"}，分三行堆叠，字体非常大，采用优雅的高对比度衬线字体，笔画纤细，深炭灰色，左对齐，占据左上象限。文本元素 2 为艺术家名称 {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}，采用小型大写衬线字母，字间距较宽，放置在标题下方靠近左侧中心的位置。视觉风格：浪漫、电影感、略带超现实主义、柔焦摄影绘画，暖赭色和焦橙色与冷蓝色形成对比，营造出怀旧的法式艺术流行氛围。限制条件：确保设计在缩略图尺寸下清晰易读，在排版周围保留充足的留白，不要添加额外的徽标、条形码或任何其他文本。

templates.title: Neon Disco Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹迪斯科专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square 1:1 synthwave disco album cover for a track titled {argument name="song title" default="MIRROR MIRROR"} by {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}. Show two stylish adult figures standing back-to-back in a smoky nightclub beneath a huge mirrored disco ball that dominates the upper center of the frame. The left figure is a woman with voluminous shoulder-length auburn curls wearing a glossy red leather jacket, angled slightly left with one hand near her pocket; the right figure is a man with slick dark hair wearing a glossy black leather blazer over an open white shirt, angled slightly right. Their faces should be intentionally obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks, preserving the anonymous editorial look. Use dramatic magenta, violet, electric blue, and hot pink lighting, with horizontal neon tube lights in the background, thick purple fog, reflective highlights on the leather, and a cinematic 1980s club atmosphere. Place exactly 2 text elements: the large title “MIRROR MIRROR” across the lower third in italic all-caps futuristic neon typography, white core with pink glow and slight bevel; and the smaller artist text “PZF” centered beneath it near the bottom in spaced-out italic letters. Keep the composition symmetrical, glossy, high contrast, and photo-realistic, with no extra logos, borders, stickers, or additional text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 正方形的合成波迪斯科专辑封面，用于名为 {argument name="song title" default="MIRROR MIRROR"} 的曲目，演唱者为 {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}。画面展示两个时尚的成年人背靠背站在烟雾缭绕的夜店中，头顶上方是一个巨大的镜面迪斯科球，占据了画面的上部中心。左侧人物是一位留着蓬松红棕色齐肩卷发的女性，身穿亮面红色皮夹克，身体微向左倾，一只手靠近口袋；右侧人物是一位留着油头深色短发的男性，身穿黑色亮面皮西装，内搭敞开的白色衬衫，身体微向右倾。他们的面部应通过柔和的矩形模糊块进行遮挡，以保持匿名编辑风格。使用戏剧性的洋红色、紫色、电光蓝和亮粉色灯光，背景配有水平霓虹灯管、浓厚的紫色烟雾、皮革上的反光高光，营造出 20 世纪 80 年代的电影感夜店氛围。放置 2 个文本元素：位于画面下三分之一处的大标题“MIRROR MIRROR”，采用斜体全大写未来感霓虹字体，白色核心配以粉色光晕和轻微斜角；以及位于其下方底部居中的较小艺术家文本“PZF”，采用字间距拉开的斜体字母。保持构图对称、质感光亮、高对比度且具有照片级真实感，不要添加任何额外的徽标、边框、贴纸或其他文本。

templates.title: Romantic Sunset Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫日落专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square cinematic album cover for a romantic indie pop song titled {argument name="song title" default="TWO HEARTS, ONE SUN"}. The scene shows two lovers as a single dark silhouette embracing and kissing or leaning forehead-to-forehead in the exact center of the frame, standing in soft wild grass by a calm sea at sunset. A huge glowing sun sits directly behind their bodies on the horizon, creating a bright golden halo that merges their silhouettes. The sky is a smooth dramatic gradient from deep navy blue at the top through violet and rose into saturated orange near the horizon, with subtle haze, lens flare orbs, and dreamy atmospheric bloom. Low dark island silhouettes appear far left and far right across the water. The foreground is shadowy, with delicate out-of-focus grasses, seed heads, and small bokeh highlights, creating depth. Use warm orange, gold, and red tones contrasted with cool blue shadows; romantic, nostalgic, cinematic, slightly painterly-photographic, soft focus, high dynamic range, no hard outlines. Add centered bottom typography: the title in widely spaced uppercase elegant sans-serif letters, glowing pale gold, and a smaller artist name beneath it reading {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}. Keep the composition minimal and symmetrical, with the couple and sun perfectly aligned, no extra people, no buildings, no border, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张方形电影质感的专辑封面，用于名为 {argument name="song title" default="TWO HEARTS, ONE SUN"} 的浪漫独立流行歌曲。画面中心展示了一对恋人的深色剪影，他们正在拥吻或额头相抵，站在日落时分平静海边的柔软野草丛中。一轮巨大的发光太阳位于地平线上，正好处于他们身后，形成明亮的金色光环，将两人的剪影融为一体。天空呈现出平滑且富有戏剧性的渐变色，从顶部的深海军蓝过渡到紫罗兰色和玫瑰色，再到地平线附近的饱和橙色，伴有细腻的薄雾、镜头光晕和梦幻的大气光晕。远处的左右两侧海面上隐约可见深色的小岛剪影。前景处于阴影中，点缀着虚化的精致草叶、草籽和微小的焦外成像光斑，营造出空间深度。使用温暖的橙色、金色和红色调，与冷蓝色的阴影形成对比；风格浪漫、怀旧、电影感，兼具绘画与摄影质感，柔焦，高动态范围，无硬轮廓。在底部居中添加排版：标题使用字间距较宽的优雅大写无衬线字体，呈现淡金色光泽；下方标注较小的艺人名称 {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}。保持构图简洁对称，恋人与太阳完美对齐，画面中不包含其他人物、建筑物，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Velvet Signal Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Velvet Signal 专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square album-cover image with a moody cinematic close-up of a person wearing large black over-ear studio headphones, centered and cropped tightly so the headphones fill the left and right edges and long dark hair falls down both sides. The face is intentionally hidden by one large opaque centered square block in a warm dark brown gradient, covering most of the upper and middle portrait from near the top edge to above the title area. Use soft warm backlighting, muted cream background, dark shadows, slight vintage film grain, shallow depth of field, and an intimate late-night listening-session mood. At the bottom center, add exactly two text elements: the large elegant serif title “{argument name="album title" default="Velvet Signal"}” in pale cream/gold lettering, and directly underneath it the smaller spaced artist name “{argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}”. Keep the typography refined, minimal, and centered, with the title occupying the lower third and no other text, logos, stickers, borders, or watermarks. Overall color palette: black headphones and hair, warm beige background, deep brown face-obscuring square, and soft ivory-gold typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张方形专辑封面图像，画面为一位佩戴大型黑色包耳式录音室耳机的人物的电影感特写。构图采用紧凑的居中裁剪，使耳机填满左右边缘，深色长发垂在两侧。人物脸部被一个位于画面中央、呈暖深棕色渐变的不透明大方块刻意遮挡，覆盖了从顶部边缘附近到标题区域上方的大部分上半部和中部肖像。采用柔和的暖色背光、柔和的奶油色背景、深色阴影、轻微的复古胶片颗粒感、浅景深，营造出深夜聆听音乐的私密氛围。在底部中心，添加两个文本元素：用浅奶油色/金色字体书写的优雅大号衬线标题“{argument name="album title" default="Velvet Signal"}”，以及在其正下方较小的、字间距拉开的艺术家名称“{argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}”。保持排版精致、简约且居中，标题占据下三分之一区域，画面中不得出现其他文字、Logo、贴纸、边框或水印。整体色调：黑色耳机和头发，暖米色背景，遮挡脸部的深棕色方块，以及柔和的象牙金色字体。

templates.title: Minimal Astronaut Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 极简宇航员专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square cinematic electronic music album cover on a pure black background. Center a single astronaut floating upright in space, full body visible, facing directly toward the viewer with arms slightly lowered and spread, legs together, and a realistic bulky white EVA suit with ribbed fabric, gloves, boots, chest control panel, hoses, and backpack life-support unit. The helmet should be glossy white with a reflective gold visor, no face visible. Add a strong white rim light and soft halo glow around the astronaut, especially behind the helmet and suit edges, while keeping the surrounding space nearly empty with only subtle black texture and no stars. Place minimalist typography at the top center: large widely spaced uppercase title text {argument name="album title" default="ALIGN"} in thin futuristic white sans-serif letters with a faint glow, and directly underneath it smaller spaced uppercase artist text {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}. Keep the composition symmetrical, high contrast, premium sci-fi, dark ambient, clean and uncluttered, with the astronaut occupying the central lower half and the title occupying the upper third. No extra objects, no planets, no watermark, no additional text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张方形的电影感电子音乐专辑封面，背景为纯黑色。画面中央放置一名在太空中垂直漂浮的宇航员，全身可见，正面对向观众，双臂微垂并向两侧展开，双腿并拢。宇航员身穿写实的白色笨重 EVA 宇航服，细节包括罗纹织物、手套、靴子、胸部控制面板、软管及背部生命维持装置。头盔应为亮白色，配有反光的金色面罩，面部不可见。在宇航员周围添加强烈的白色轮廓光和柔和的光晕，特别是头盔后方和宇航服边缘，同时保持周围空间近乎空旷，仅保留细微的黑色纹理，不要星星。在顶部中心放置极简排版：上方为大号、字间距宽阔的 {argument name="album title" default="ALIGN"} 大写标题文本，使用纤细的未来感白色无衬线字体，带有微弱光晕；正下方为较小的、字间距宽阔的 {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"} 大写艺术家名称文本。构图保持对称，高对比度，呈现高级科幻、暗黑氛围感，画面简洁清爽。宇航员占据画面中央下半部分，标题占据上半部分的三分之一。无需额外物体，无行星，无水印，无其他文字。

templates.title: Orange Smoke Streetwear Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 橙色烟雾街头风海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical fashion poster featuring {argument name="character name" default="Hania"} as the huge background title, with a stylish young woman seated confidently in a low black chair amid dense orange smoke clouds.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, high-resolution editorial streetwear style, saturated monochrome orange background, dramatic studio lighting, sharp subject detail, deep shadows, premium magazine-cover composition.

Main subject: One young woman centered in the lower half, relaxed dominant pose, leaning back in a black metal-framed chair with one leg extended toward the camera and the other bent. Her face is covered by a centered opaque medium-brown square censor block. She has long dark wavy hair visible around the block. Outfit: exactly 5 visible fashion pieces — oversized glossy {argument name="jacket color" default="orange"} puffer jacket, fitted black shirt, dark black cargo pants, silver chain necklace, and white-orange-black chunky sneakers. One hand rests on the chair arm, the other relaxed near her lap.

Environment: Thick orange smoke clouds surround the chair and legs, especially dense along the bottom edge, left side, and right lower corner. Use a warm orange gradient backdrop with darker smoky shadows near the floor.

Typography and layout: Place one enormous white italic bold sans-serif word “{argument name="headline text" default="Hania"}” behind the subject, spanning almost the full width, cropped slightly by the edges and partly hidden behind her head and jacket. The word should be tilted subtly and feel like a sportswear campaign headline.

HUD / graphic overlays: Add thin white futuristic interface lines, tiny labels, boxes, and symbols around the edges. Include exactly 12 discrete overlay groups: 1) top-left small square icon with the stacked words “DISCIPLINE / FOCUS / CONFIDENCE / SUCCESS”; 2) top-center thin horizontal progress line with small blocks and dots; 3) top-right “07” with “LIMITLESS / EDITION”; 4) left-middle slogan “BE YOU / DO YOU / FOR YOU”; 5) left-lower outlined status card showing “% / 100 / FOCUS / MODE / ON”; 6) lower-left small quote “DON’T STOP / UNTIL YOU’RE / PROUD.” with tiny dot marks; 7) bottom-left small globe icon and caption “BUILDING MY / DREAM LIFE”; 8) right-upper tiny line and stacked words “MIND / ENERGY / AMBITION / DISCIPLINE”; 9) right-middle circular globe target icon; 10) right-middle vertical plus, line, arrow, and the words “HUSTLE / SILENCE / RESULTS”; 11) right-lower small geometric squares and the words “TRUST / THE PROCESS”; 12) bottom-right outlined data card reading “B SYS / 07”, “STAY FOCUSED / STAY HUNGRY / STAY HUMBLE”, plus tiny square indicators.

Visual style: Cinematic streetwear advertising poster, bold orange-and-white color palette, clean futuristic microtypography, crisp high-contrast lighting, realistic fabric texture on the puffer jacket, volumetric smoke, shallow depth of field, no extra people, no watermark. Keep all overlay text white and small, with the giant title as the dominant graphic element.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张电影感十足的竖版时尚海报，以 {argument name="character name" default="Hania"} 作为巨大的背景标题，画面中心是一位自信地坐在黑色矮椅上的时尚年轻女性，周围环绕着浓密的橙色烟雾。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，高分辨率编辑类街头风格，饱和的单色橙色背景，戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，主体细节锐利，深邃的阴影，高级杂志封面构图。

主体：一位年轻女性位于下半部分中心，姿态放松且充满掌控力，斜靠在金属框架的黑色椅子上，一条腿向镜头伸展，另一条腿弯曲。她的脸部被一个居中的不透明中棕色方形遮挡块覆盖。遮挡块周围可见其长长的深色波浪卷发。服装：包含 5 件清晰可见的时尚单品——超大款亮面 {argument name="jacket color" default="orange"} 羽绒服、修身黑色上衣、深黑色工装裤、银色链条项链以及白橙黑拼色厚底运动鞋。一只手放在椅扶手上，另一只手自然放松地放在膝盖附近。

环境：浓厚的橙色烟雾环绕着椅子和双腿，底部边缘、左侧及右下角尤为浓密。使用暖橙色渐变背景，地板附近带有更深色的烟雾阴影。

排版与布局：在主体后方放置一个巨大的白色斜体粗体无衬线单词“{argument name="headline text" default="Hania"}”，横跨几乎整个宽度，边缘略微裁剪，并部分隐藏在她的头部和羽绒服后方。文字应略微倾斜，呈现出运动品牌广告标题的质感。

HUD / 图形叠加：在边缘添加细长的白色未来感界面线条、微小标签、方框和符号。包含 12 组独立的叠加元素：1) 左上角小方块图标，内含堆叠文字“DISCIPLINE / FOCUS / CONFIDENCE / SUCCESS”；2) 顶部中心细水平进度条，带有小方块和圆点；3) 右上角“07”及“LIMITLESS / EDITION”；4) 左侧中间标语“BE YOU / DO YOU / FOR YOU”；5) 左下侧轮廓状态卡片，显示“% / 100 / FOCUS / MODE / ON”；6) 左下角小引语“DON’T STOP / UNTIL YOU’RE / PROUD.”及微小圆点标记；7) 左下角小地球仪图标及标题“BUILDING MY / DREAM LIFE”；8) 右上角细线及堆叠文字“MIND / ENERGY / AMBITION / DISCIPLINE”；9) 右侧中间圆形地球仪目标图标；10) 右侧中间垂直加号、线条、箭头及文字“HUSTLE / SILENCE / RESULTS”；11) 右下角小几何方块及文字“TRUST / THE PROCESS”；12) 右下角轮廓数据卡片，显示“B SYS / 07”、“STAY FOCUSED / STAY HUNGRY / STAY HUMBLE”以及微小方形指示器。

视觉风格：电影感街头时尚广告海报，醒目的橙白配色，简洁的未来感微排版，清晰的高对比度灯光，羽绒服上真实的织物纹理，体积感烟雾，浅景深，无额外人物，无水印。所有叠加文字保持白色且微小，巨大的标题作为主要的图形元素。

templates.title: Portugal World Cup Squad Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 葡萄牙世界杯阵容海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an official cinematic national football team squad poster for {argument name="team name" default="Portugal"} and its FIFA World Cup 2026 campaign, using a dramatic heroic sports-poster style.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, dark high-contrast stadium atmosphere, smoky vignette edges, glowing floodlights, sparks, and a large waving national flag filling the background. Use Portugal’s green-and-red flag colors with a large coat-of-arms shield behind the players. Add the Portugal federation crest at the top left and a gold FIFA World Cup trophy emblem with the text “FIFA WORLD CUP 2026” at the top right.

Layout: Arrange exactly 11 starting players in a commanding pyramid formation, all facing forward with serious expressions and powerful upright poses. The captain is elevated at the top center with a blazing backlight halo. The goalkeeper is front-center holding a football with both gloved hands. Build the squad in four visible tiers: 1 top captain, 3 upper attacking/midfield players, 5 middle/back-line players, and 2 front players flanking the goalkeeper, with the goalkeeper centered in front.

Player count and visible kit labels: Include exactly 11 players wearing Portugal red home shirts except the goalkeeper in a dark black patterned keeper kit. Visible shirt numbers and labels should be: 7 RONALDO at the top center with captain armband; 10 BERNARDO upper left; 8 B. FERNANDES upper center; 15 JOÃO NEVES upper right; 19 N. MENDES middle far left; 14 INÁCIO middle left; 3 RÚBEN DIAS middle right; 20 JOÃO CANCELO middle far right; 23 VITINHA front left; 1 DIOGO COSTA front-center goalkeeper; 17 R. LEÃO front right. Use gold numbering and small white/gold name text beneath each number. Faces may be realistic but keep them cleanly visible and not distorted.

Uniform details: Red Puma-style Portugal kit with green-and-gold collar trim, Portugal crest on the chest, Puma-style cat logo, subtle fabric texture, athletic fit, shorts mostly cropped out. Goalkeeper wears black long-sleeve jersey with subtle diagonal pattern, Portugal crest, number 1, padded gloves, and holds a modern patterned match ball.

Text content: Large distressed cream headline across the lower third: “{argument name="headline text" default="ONE NATION. ONE DREAM."}”. Under it, smaller red tracking-spaced subtitle: “{argument name="campaign line" default="ROAD TO FIFA WORLD CUP 2026"}”. Below that in small white spaced letters: “UNITED STATES · CANADA · MEXICO”. Bottom center sponsor strip with a gold Puma-style logo, Portugal crest, and the text “PORTUGAL FPF”.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic composite photography, epic sports marketing poster, cinematic orange rim light behind the captain, deep shadows, stadium crowd bokeh, smoke, embers, dramatic contrast, sharp jersey details, premium official-tournament feel.

Constraints: Keep exactly 11 players, exactly the listed visible shirt numbers and names, no extra athletes, no extra logos beyond the football federation crest, trophy emblem, and kit/sponsor-style marks. Preserve the bold pyramid composition and the large bottom slogan.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="team name" default="葡萄牙"} 及其 2026 年国际足联世界杯征程创作一张官方电影质感的国家足球队阵容海报，采用戏剧性的英雄式体育海报风格。

画布：垂直海报，2:3 纵横比，黑暗高对比度球场氛围，烟雾缭绕的暗角，发光的泛光灯，火花，以及背景中一面巨大的飘扬国旗。使用葡萄牙绿红相间的国旗配色，球员身后带有巨大的盾形国徽。左上角添加葡萄牙足协徽章，右上角添加金色的国际足联世界杯奖杯标志，并附带文字“FIFA WORLD CUP 2026”。

布局：将 11 名首发球员精确排列成威严的金字塔阵型，所有人面向前方，表情严肃，姿态挺拔有力。队长位于顶部中央，带有耀眼的背光光环。守门员位于前排中央，双手戴着手套抱着足球。将阵容分为四个可见层级：1 名顶端队长，3 名上层进攻/中场球员，5 名中/后场球员，以及 2 名守门员两侧的前场球员，守门员居中位于最前方。

球员人数与可见球衣标签：包含 11 名身穿葡萄牙红色主场球衣的球员，守门员除外，守门员身穿深黑色图案守门员球衣。可见的球衣号码和标签应为：顶部中央 7 号 RONALDO（带队长袖标）；左上 10 号 BERNARDO；上中 8 号 B. FERNANDES；右上 15 号 JOÃO NEVES；中左侧 19 号 N. MENDES；中左 14 号 INÁCIO；中右 3 号 RÚBEN DIAS；中右侧 20 号 JOÃO CANCELO；前左 23 号 VITINHA；前中 1 号守门员 DIOGO COSTA；前右 17 号 R. LEÃO。使用金色号码，并在每个号码下方标注小号的白色/金色姓名文字。面部可以写实，但需保持清晰可见且不失真。

球衣细节：红色 Puma 风格葡萄牙球衣，配有绿金相间的衣领饰边，胸前印有葡萄牙徽章、Puma 风格美洲狮标志，具有细腻的织物纹理，运动剪裁，短裤大部分被裁剪掉。守门员身穿黑色长袖球衣，带有细微的斜纹图案，印有葡萄牙徽章、1 号号码、加厚手套，并手持现代图案比赛用球。

文字内容：下三分之一处印有巨大的做旧奶油色标题：“{argument name="headline text" default="ONE NATION. ONE DREAM."}”。下方是较小的红色宽间距副标题：“{argument name="campaign line" default="ROAD TO FIFA WORLD CUP 2026"}”。再下方是白色小号宽间距字母：“UNITED STATES · CANADA · MEXICO”。底部中央为赞助商条，带有金色 Puma 风格标志、葡萄牙徽章以及文字“PORTUGAL FPF”。

视觉风格：超写实合成摄影，史诗级体育营销海报，队长身后有电影质感的橙色轮廓光，深邃阴影，球场观众虚化效果，烟雾，余烬，戏剧性对比，清晰的球衣细节，高级官方赛事质感。

约束条件：保持 11 名球员，严格使用列出的可见球衣号码和姓名，不得增加额外运动员，除足协徽章、奖杯标志及球衣/赞助商风格标识外，不得添加额外标志。保留鲜明的金字塔构图和底部的大型标语。

templates.title: Punk Gunslinger in Steampunk Undercity

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克地下城的朋克枪手

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic dark fantasy steampunk alley scene in a gritty undercity at night, in the style of high-end animated game concept art. A punk young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="bright magenta-pink"} short spiky hair stands in the foreground from a dramatic low angle, aiming an oversized brass-and-black revolver directly toward the viewer so the gun barrel dominates the upper left foreground with strong foreshortening. Her face is deliberately obscured by a flat opaque square censor block in muted reddish-brown, centered over the face. She wears a sleeveless off-white shirt, dark cropped vest, fingerless bandage wraps around both hands and forearms, belts and holsters at the waist, dark purple striped trousers, and visible arm tattoos; her posture is tense, aggressive, and confrontational. The background is a dense industrial undercity street with towering arched architecture, pipes, catwalks, hanging lamps, smoke, warm window lights, teal-blue atmospheric glow, and neon signs. Include exactly three readable/sign-like elements: one torn poster on a barrel at far left reading “WANTED” with smaller rough text “PILTOVER ENFORCERS” and “VI”, one pink circular neon sign on the right reading {argument name="neon bar sign" default="THE LAST DROP"}, and one small blue circular neon face icon with X eyes and an O mouth. Use moody blue-green and amber lighting, volumetric haze, painterly detail, dynamic perspective, sharp focus on the weapon and character, wide cinematic 16:9 composition, no extra characters, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级的暗黑奇幻蒸汽朋克巷道场景，背景是夜晚阴暗的地下城，采用高端动画游戏概念艺术风格。一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮洋红色"} 短刺猬头的朋克年轻女性站在前景，以戏剧性的低角度呈现，正将一把超大号黄铜与黑色左轮手枪直接对准观众，枪管通过强烈的透视缩短效果占据左上方前景。她的脸部被一个位于面部中心的暗红褐色平坦不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住。她身穿无袖米白色衬衫、深色短马甲，双手和前臂缠着露指绷带，腰间系着皮带和枪套，穿着深紫色条纹长裤，手臂上有明显的纹身；她的姿态紧张、充满攻击性且具有对抗感。背景是密集的工业地下城街道，拥有高耸的拱形建筑、管道、猫道、悬挂的灯具、烟雾、温暖的窗灯、青蓝色的大气光晕和霓虹灯招牌。包含三个清晰可见的标志性元素：左侧桶上的一张破损海报，上面写着“WANTED”，下方有较小的粗体文字“PILTOVER ENFORCERS”和“VI”；右侧一个粉色圆形霓虹灯招牌，上面写着 {argument name="neon bar sign" default="THE LAST DROP"}；以及一个带有 X 形眼睛和 O 形嘴的小型蓝色圆形霓虹灯人脸图标。使用忧郁的蓝绿色和琥珀色灯光、体积雾、绘画般的细节、动态视角，聚焦于武器和角色，采用 16:9 宽银幕构图，无额外角色，无水印。

templates.title: Low-Angle Varsity Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 低角度校园风时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Create a low-angle cinematic fashion portrait of a stylish {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} seated on a large matte geometric cube pedestal in a minimal studio. Use a solid {argument name="background color" default="golden-yellow"} seamless backdrop and matching yellow floor, with soft studio shadows. The camera is very low and close to the subject’s extended foot, using a wide-angle perspective so the foreground white sneaker appears oversized and dominant while the upper body recedes. The subject sits casually with one leg stretched toward the lens and the other knee raised, relaxed hand resting over the bent knee. Outfit: a premium oversized black varsity-style jacket with mustard-yellow panels, white stripe trim on collar, cuffs, sleeves and hem, snap buttons, and a collegiate letter patch on the chest; cream oversized wide-leg pants; white ribbed socks; clean white leather Nike-style low-top sneakers with laces and perforated toe box; simple white top underneath; small hoop earrings and a short necklace. Hair is dark, long, wavy, loosely tied back with strands falling around the face. The face should be deliberately anonymized/obscured with a smooth centered rectangular blur/mosaic patch while preserving the fashion pose. Lighting is polished editorial studio lighting, warm and high-end, with crisp fabric detail, realistic leather texture, shallow depth of field, slight foreground emphasis, vertical 2:3 composition, no text, no watermark, no extra objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张低角度电影感时尚肖像，主角为一位时尚的 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，她坐在一个极简摄影棚内的大型哑光几何立方体底座上。使用纯色 {argument name="background color" default="金黄色"} 无缝背景布和相匹配的黄色地面，并带有柔和的摄影棚阴影。相机位置非常低且靠近主角伸出的脚，采用广角透视，使前景中的白色运动鞋看起来超大且占据主导地位，而上半身则向后退缩。主角姿态随意，一条腿伸向镜头，另一条膝盖弯曲，放松的手放在弯曲的膝盖上。服装：一件高级超大款黑色棒球风格夹克，带有芥末黄色拼接，领口、袖口、袖子和下摆有白色条纹装饰，按扣设计，胸前有学院风字母贴布；奶油色超大款阔腿裤；白色罗纹袜；干净的白色皮革 Nike 风格低帮运动鞋，带有鞋带和打孔鞋头；内搭简约白色上衣；佩戴小圆环耳环和短项链。头发为深色、长波浪卷，松散地束在脑后，发丝散落在脸庞周围。脸部应通过平滑的居中矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡进行刻意匿名化处理，同时保留时尚姿势。灯光采用精致的编辑类摄影棚布光，温暖且高端，呈现清晰的织物细节、逼真的皮革质感、浅景深、轻微的前景强调，采用 2:3 竖构图，无文字，无水印，无多余物体。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Future Ready Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克“未来就绪”时尚海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cyberpunk streetwear fashion poster of a young model crouching low on a Tokyo-inspired rooftop at twilight, shot from a dramatic low angle with the neon green chunky sneaker oversized in the foreground. The model has {argument name="hair color" default="neon pink"} messy shoulder-length hair and bold urban styling, with the face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. Outfit: a reflective metallic silver oversized puffer jacket with crinkled mirror texture catching magenta and cyan highlights, black cargo pants with buckles, straps, and hanging webbing, and {argument name="shoe color" default="neon lime green"} futuristic platform sneakers. Background: dense futuristic Tokyo skyline with dark blue-purple sky, glowing skyscrapers, rooftop railings, and Tokyo Tower illuminated in orange-red behind the model. Add strong glitch-art effects: horizontal magenta, cyan, green, and white scanline artifacts across the frame, especially around the headline and bottom edge. Place a huge distressed white all-caps headline at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="FUTURE READY"}, split across two lines, with digital fragmentation and broken pixel edges. Include exactly 6 visible neon sign elements: 1 vertical hot-pink Japanese sign on the left reading 「未来準備完了」, 1 small lower-left sign reading 「東京」 with “TOKYO” beneath it, 1 vertical hot-pink sign on the right with a cat face icon plus Japanese text and “2077”, 1 small cyan-pink sign near the lower right reading “ネオン”, 1 blue sign at the bottom right reading “GAME OVER”, and 1 small glowing cyan city sign in the far background. Use high-contrast cinematic lighting, saturated magenta and electric blue reflections, glossy wet rooftop surface, gritty urban texture, sharp fashion-editorial detail, and a 2:3 poster composition with no border or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版赛博朋克街头时尚海报，画面中一位年轻模特在黄昏时分蹲在东京风格的屋顶上，采用极具戏剧性的低角度拍摄，前景突出展示一双超大号的霓虹绿厚底运动鞋。模特留着 {argument name="hair color" default="霓虹粉"} 的凌乱齐肩发，造型大胆前卫，面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。服装：一件带有褶皱镜面质感的反光金属银色超大羽绒服，反射着品红和青色的光泽；黑色工装裤配有搭扣、绑带和垂挂织带；脚穿 {argument name="shoe color" default="霓虹青柠绿"} 的未来感厚底运动鞋。背景：密集的未来感东京天际线，深蓝紫色的天空，发光的摩天大楼，屋顶栏杆，以及模特身后被点亮的橙红色东京塔。添加强烈的故障艺术效果：画面中（尤其是标题周围和底部边缘）布满品红、青、绿、白色的水平扫描线伪影。在顶部放置一个巨大的做旧白色全大写标题 {argument name="headline text" default="FUTURE READY"}，分为两行，带有数字碎片化和像素破损边缘。包含 6 个清晰可见的霓虹灯元素：左侧一个写有「未来準備完了」的垂直亮粉色日文招牌，左下角一个写有「東京」及其下方“TOKYO”的小招牌，右侧一个带有猫脸图标、日文和“2077”的垂直亮粉色招牌，右下角附近一个写有“ネオン”的小型青粉色招牌，右下角一个写有“GAME OVER”的蓝色招牌，以及远景中一个发着微光的青色城市招牌。采用高对比度的电影级布光，饱和的品红和电光蓝反射，湿润的屋顶表面，粗砺的城市质感，锐利的时尚编辑级细节，以及 2:3 的海报构图，无边框或水印。

templates.title: Neon Cyberpunk Future Hoodie Portrait

Her face is intentionally hidden by a centered opaque muted-purple square censor block, while dark messy hair and wispy curls are visible around it. The hoodie has a bright glowing handwritten logo reading {argument name="hoodie logo" default="Future"} across the chest in electric magenta-purple. Behind her, fill most of the background with massive rough brushstroke typography reading {argument name="background word" default="FUTURE"}, painted in vivid neon violet with splattered edges and intense glow. Preserve the dog’s happy expression and fluffy toy-poodle silhouette across panels, adapting only the rendering style. Do not add extra panels, extra labels, watermarks, captions, or unrelated characters.

promptLocalized.zh:

面板顺序从左上到右下，必须包含以下 12 个可见的标题标签：
1. {argument name="style label 1" default="吉卜力工作室"} — 柔和的手绘奇幻乡村风格。

templates.title: Censored Watercolor Romance Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 带遮挡的水彩浪漫肖像

templates.prompt: Create a soft, ethereal watercolor-style romantic illustration of two young adults standing very close together in a sunlit garden or veranda, their foreheads nearly touching and their faces mostly obscured by a large opaque beige square censorship block centered over the upper-middle of the image. The main subject is a young woman in profile from the left, wearing a delicate pale kimono or light traditional robe, with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair gathered into a loose, messy low bun decorated with small white blossoms, pearl-like dangling ornaments, and fine hairpins; loose wisps fall around her neck and cheeks. On the right edge, show a second person with {argument name="second character hair color" default="pale blond"} messy hair leaning in tenderly, only partially visible. The atmosphere should suggest quiet affection, hidden emotions, and a fragile intimate relationship rather than overt drama. Use a muted cream, beige, and sepia palette, high-key backlighting, translucent paper texture, pencil-like linework, delicate floral background patterns, and a faint wooden railing or bench behind them. Composition should be vertical portrait format, close-up crop, with the woman’s head and bun occupying the left half, the second person entering from the upper right, and the censorship square covering the faces as a flat matte rectangle in {argument name="censor block color" default="warm beige"}. Keep the image dreamy, nostalgic, low contrast, and painterly, with no readable text and no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅柔和、空灵的水彩风格浪漫插画，描绘两名年轻人站在阳光明媚的花园或阳台上，距离非常近，额头几乎相触，面部大部分被图像中上部的一个大型不透明米色方形遮挡块所遮盖。主体为左侧的一名年轻女性侧影，身着精致的浅色和服或轻薄的传统长袍，{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发盘成松散凌乱的低发髻，装饰着小白花、珍珠般的垂饰和精致的发簪；几缕发丝垂落在她的颈部和脸颊旁。在右侧边缘，展示第二个人，其 {argument name="second character hair color" default="浅金色"} 的凌乱头发温柔地靠过来，仅部分可见。氛围应传达出安静的爱意、隐藏的情感和脆弱的亲密关系，而非明显的戏剧性。使用柔和的奶油色、米色和棕褐色调，高调背光，半透明纸张纹理，铅笔般的线条，精致的花卉背景图案，以及他们身后隐约可见的木质栏杆或长椅。构图应为竖向肖像格式，近景裁剪，女性的头部和发髻占据左半部分，第二个人从右上角切入，遮挡方块作为 {argument name="censor block color" default="暖米色"} 的平铺哑光矩形覆盖在面部。保持画面梦幻、怀旧、低对比度且具有绘画感，不要出现可读文字或现代物品。

templates.title: 12-Style Anime Pet Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 12 种风格动漫宠物拼贴画

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Using the provided reference image as the subject base, transform it into a 3-column by 4-row comparison collage showing the same child-and-dog pose reimagined in exactly 12 different famous animation/game-inspired visual styles. Preserve the composition relationship between the child and the dog, and preserve any existing face-obscuring privacy blocks rather than revealing or inventing facial details.

Canvas and layout: Create a vertical poster collage with 12 equal square panels, thin white dividers, bright cheerful colors, and each panel labeled at the top with the corresponding style title.

Panels, in order from left to right, top to bottom:
1. {argument name="style label 1" default="STUDIO GHIBLI"} — soft hand-painted Japanese fantasy animation look with lush park greenery.
2. {argument name="style label 2" default="PIXAR"} — polished 3D family animation look, closest to the original photo composition.
3. {argument name="style label 3" default="DRAGON BALL"} — bold action-anime lines, dynamic blue sky and rocky background.
4. ONE PIECE — adventurous pirate-anime style with ships, seagulls, and ocean elements.
5. NARUTO — ninja-anime style with orange/black outfit accents, village rooftops, leaves in the air.
6. ドラえもん — clean rounded children’s anime style with a sunny suburban street.
7. サザエさん — retro family-anime style with simple expressive linework and neighborhood houses.
8. Lilo & Stitch — tropical island cartoon style with beach, palm trees, and bright ocean colors.
9. Pokémon — monster-adventure anime style with a trainer-like cap and backpack, path and Poké Ball-like scenery details.
10. 鬼滅の刃 — dramatic dark fantasy anime style with glowing purple forest lighting and patterned cloak accents.
11. クレヨンしんちゃん — simple playful children’s cartoon style with rounded faces and suburban background.
12. {argument name="style label 12" default="MINECRAFT"} — voxel/blocky game style with cubic characters, blocky dog, village and trees.

Constraints: Keep the child and dog recognizable from the reference in every panel, keep the dog cheerful, do not add extra panels, do not change the 3x4 grid, and make the style names large and readable.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图像为基础，将其转换为 3 列 4 行的对比拼贴画，展示同一组儿童与狗的姿势在 12 种不同著名动画/游戏视觉风格下的重构效果。保留儿童与狗之间的构图关系，并保留现有的面部隐私遮挡，不要揭示或虚构面部细节。

画布与布局：创建一个包含 12 个等大方形面板的垂直海报拼贴画，使用细白色分隔线，色彩明亮欢快，每个面板顶部标注相应的风格名称。

面板顺序（从左到右，从上到下）：
1. {argument name="style label 1" default="吉卜力工作室 (STUDIO GHIBLI)"} — 柔和的手绘日本奇幻动画风格，配以郁郁葱葱的公园绿植。
2. {argument name="style label 2" default="皮克斯 (PIXAR)"} — 精致的 3D 家庭动画风格，最贴近原始照片构图。

5. 火影忍者 (NARUTO) — 忍者动漫风格，带有橙色/黑色服装点缀、村庄屋顶和空中飘落的树叶。
6. 哆啦A梦 (ドラえもん) — 简洁圆润的儿童动漫风格，配以阳光明媚的郊区街道。

9. 宝可梦 (Pokémon) — 怪兽冒险动漫风格，带有训练师风格的帽子和背包，以及小径和精灵球风格的场景细节。

11. 蜡笔小新 (クレヨンしんちゃん) — 简洁俏皮的儿童卡通风格，面部圆润，配以郊区背景。

templates.title: Blood Red Western Gunslinger

titleLocalized.zh: 血色西部神枪手

templates.prompt: Create a vertical portrait in polished hard-boiled graphic novel concept-art style inspired by Rockstar Games key art: a stern adult Western gunslinger fills the lower 75% of the frame, viewed from a low heroic angle, centered and cropped from thighs upward. The top 25% of the image must be strictly empty solid {argument name="background color" default="blood red"}, with no text or objects. The character has slicked-back dark hair and a deliberately featureless flat {argument name="face mask color" default="warm tan"} rectangular face area obscuring all facial features. Pose: both arms raised, each hand holding one ornate long-barrel revolver vertically beside the head, barrels angled slightly outward; exactly 2 visible revolvers, one in each hand, with engraved metal details and ivory grips. Attire: {argument name="shirt color" default="cream white"} long-sleeve button-up shirt with rolled cuffs, dark blue neckerchief tied at the collar, high-waisted black trousers, wide double leather gun belt with two large buckles, and one visible brown holster on the left hip. Setting: stylized desert canyon at sunset behind the figure, with jagged red rock formations and exactly 6 visible saguaro cacti distributed near the lower left and lower right edges. Use dramatic golden rim light, deep black shadows, heavy ink-like outlines, painterly poster texture, high contrast, cinematic Western mood, no typography, no logo, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅垂直构图的肖像，采用受 Rockstar Games 关键视觉图启发的精致硬汉派漫画概念艺术风格：画面下方 75% 的区域由一位严肃的成年西部神枪手占据，采用低角度英雄视角，居中构图，从大腿向上截取。图像上方 25% 的区域必须严格保持为空白纯色 {argument name="background color" default="血红色"}，不得包含任何文字或物体。角色留着向后梳的深色头发，面部区域为一个刻意平整且无特征的 {argument name="face mask color" default="暖棕褐色"} 长方形遮罩，遮挡了所有五官。姿势：双臂抬起，双手各持一把华丽的长管左轮手枪垂直置于头部两侧，枪管略微向外倾斜；画面中可见 2 把左轮手枪，左右手各一把，带有雕刻金属细节和象牙枪柄。服饰：{argument name="shirt color" default="奶油白色"} 长袖衬衫，袖口卷起，领口系着深蓝色领巾，高腰黑色长裤，宽大的双皮质枪带配有两个大扣环，左侧腰间可见一个棕色枪套。背景：人物身后为日落时分的风格化沙漠峡谷，有锯齿状的红色岩层，画面左下角和右下角分布着 6 株仙人掌。运用戏剧性的金色轮廓光、深邃的黑色阴影、厚重的墨水感线条、绘画般的招贴画质感、高对比度、电影级西部氛围，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Cyber Angel Mecha Battle HUD

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博天使机甲战斗 HUD

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a widescreen futuristic anime action game screenshot of a cybernetic aerial battle, like a polished sci-fi hack-and-slash rhythm combat HUD.

Canvas: 16:9 landscape frame, dark teal and black digital arena viewed from a high three-quarter camera angle. The background is a vast circular cyber grid made of concentric rings, circuit-board patterns, holographic city blocks, and vertical equalizer-like teal light bars around the horizon.

Main subject: At the center, an anime-style female cyber angel named {argument name="character name" default="Xione Origin"} with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair, pale skin, sharp futuristic armor, and translucent mechanical wing blades. She is mid-flight in a dynamic pose, wielding glowing energy blades and controlling four small white blade drones orbiting her. Her color palette is black, gunmetal, white, and neon cyan, with bright teal thruster trails and gold spark impacts.

Action composition: Show exactly 5 hostile mecha enemies: 1 large armored enemy in the upper right being struck by a bright explosion, 1 large bulky enemy in the lower left, 1 medium enemy on the right edge, 1 medium enemy lower right, and 1 smaller enemy near the mid-right. Add red targeting lines, red warning labels, triangular danger icons, and laser beams pointing toward the player. The central attack forms a huge sweeping cyan crescent slash and circular arc around the heroine, while exactly 4 white blade drones leave golden trails: one upper left, one left-middle, one bottom center, and one lower right. Include particle sparks, lens flares, motion blur, and curved light ribbons to emphasize speed.

HUD and text elements: Add a complete game interface overlay with crisp futuristic typography. Top left: character portrait, label “XIONE ORIGIN”, health “4200 / 4200”, “100%”, and “CODE SYNC — OK”. Left center: “COMBO” with large number {argument name="combo count" default="256"} and small “EXCELLENT”. Top right: “TIME” with {argument name="time remaining" default="04:37"}, “SCORE” with {argument name="score" default="238,650"}, and “MULTIPLIER x4.8”. Right center: “ENEMY 12” and “+120”. Bottom right: circular radar/minimap with teal cone indicator and red enemy dots. Bottom left: exactly 4 ability icons labeled “QUANTUM EDGE”, “PHOTON CHARGE”, “PHASE BREAK”, and “ORIGIN DRIVE”, each with small keyboard prompts such as Z, X, C, and SPACE.

Visual style: High-detail anime sci-fi illustration blended with AAA game UI concept art, dark cinematic lighting, neon cyan accents, red enemy warnings, golden impact sparks, clean sharp linework, dense holographic details, ultra-wide battlefield readability, dramatic depth, no borders, no watermark.

Constraints: Keep all visible text in English, make the interface look like an actual action-game screenshot, preserve the exact counts of 5 enemies, 4 blade drones, and 4 ability icons, and avoid adding extra characters or extra UI panels beyond the described HUD.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张宽屏未来风动漫动作游戏截图，展现一场赛博空战，呈现出精致的科幻动作砍杀节奏战斗 HUD 效果。

画布：16:9 横屏构图，从高处四分之三视角俯瞰深青色与黑色的数字竞技场。背景是一个巨大的圆形赛博网格，由同心圆、电路板图案、全息城市街区以及地平线上垂直的均衡器式青色光条组成。

主体：中心处是一位动漫风格的女性赛博天使，名为 {argument name="character name" default="Xione Origin"}，拥有飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} 长发、白皙的皮肤、锋利的未来感盔甲以及半透明的机械翼刃。她处于飞行状态，姿态动感，挥舞着发光的能量刃，并操控着环绕在身边的 4 个小型白色刀锋无人机。她的配色方案为黑色、枪灰色、白色和霓虹青色，带有明亮的青色推进器尾迹和金色的火花撞击效果。

动作构图：展示 5 个敌对机甲敌人：右上角 1 个大型装甲敌人正受到剧烈爆炸冲击，左下角 1 个大型笨重敌人，右边缘 1 个中型敌人，右下方 1 个中型敌人，以及中右侧 1 个小型敌人。添加红色的瞄准线、红色警告标签、三角形危险图标以及指向玩家的激光束。中央攻击形成巨大的青色新月形斩击，环绕女主角形成圆弧，同时 4 个白色刀锋无人机留下金色轨迹：一个在左上，一个在中左，一个在底部中央，一个在右下。包含粒子火花、镜头光晕、动态模糊和弯曲的光带以强调速度感。

HUD 与文字元素：添加完整的游戏界面覆盖，采用清晰的未来感字体。左上角：角色头像，标签“XIONE ORIGIN”，生命值“4200 / 4200”、“100%”以及“CODE SYNC — OK”。左侧中央：“COMBO”配以大数字 {argument name="combo count" default="256"} 和小字“EXCELLENT”。右上角：“TIME”显示 {argument name="time remaining" default="04:37"}，“SCORE”显示 {argument name="score" default="238,650"} 以及“MULTIPLIER x4.8”。右侧中央：“ENEMY 12”和“+120”。右下角：圆形雷达/小地图，带有青色扇形指示器和红色敌方点。左下角：4 个技能图标，分别标注为“QUANTUM EDGE”、“PHOTON CHARGE”、“PHASE BREAK”和“ORIGIN DRIVE”，每个图标配有 Z、X、C 和 SPACE 等小型键盘提示。

视觉风格：高细节动漫科幻插画与 3A 游戏 UI 概念艺术相结合，深色电影级光影，霓虹青色点缀，红色敌方警告，金色撞击火花，干净锐利的线条，密集的全息细节，超宽战场可读性，戏剧性的深度，无边框，无水印。

约束：保持所有可见文字为英文，使界面看起来像真实的动作游戏截图，严格遵守 5 个敌人、4 个刀锋无人机和 4 个技能图标的数量要求，避免在描述的 HUD 之外添加额外角色或额外的 UI 面板。

templates.title: 12-Style Anime Photo Transformation Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 12 种动漫风格照片转换网格

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Using the provided reference photo, create a single vertical comparison sheet that transforms the boy-and-dog photo into a 3-column by 4-row grid of exactly 12 square panels, each panel showing the same composition reimagined in a different popular animation/game style. Keep the boy and dog as the recognizable subjects from the reference, preserving their relative pose and closeness, but render each panel in the requested style with matching backgrounds, linework, colors, and character proportions. Add a bold style title/logo at the top of each panel.

Canvas and layout: Make a vertical collage with 12 equal panels, thin white gutters, arranged left-to-right and top-to-bottom.

Panel styles and visible labels, exactly 12:
1. Studio Ghibli — label: “STUDIO GHIBLI”, soft hand-painted pastoral anime look.
2. Pixar — label: “PIXAR”, polished 3D family-animation look.
3. Dragon Ball — label: “DRAGON BALL”, dynamic shonen action look with speed lines and rocky landscape.
4. One Piece — label: “ONE PIECE”, nautical adventure anime look with ship elements.
5. Naruto — label: “NARUTO”, ninja anime look with village rooftops and headband styling.
6. Doraemon — label: “ドラえもん”, bright suburban children’s anime look.
7. Sazae-san — label: “サザエさん”, classic Japanese family anime look.
8. Lilo & Stitch — label: “Lilo & Stitch”, tropical island animation look.
9. Pokémon — label: “POKÉMON”, colorful trainer-and-companion adventure look.
10. Demon Slayer — label: “鬼滅の刃”, dramatic dark fantasy anime look with glowing particles.
11. Crayon Shin-chan — label: “クレヨンしんちゃん”, simple rounded children’s anime look.
12. Minecraft — label: “MINECRAFT”, blocky voxel game style.

Customizable text: Use {argument name="first style label" default="STUDIO GHIBLI"}, {argument name="second style label" default="PIXAR"}, {argument name="third style label" default="DRAGON BALL"}, {argument name="ninth style label" default="POKÉMON"}, and {argument name="twelfth style label" default="MINECRAFT"} where those panel titles appear.

Constraints: Do not add extra panels or extra labels. Preserve the reference subjects in every panel, including the boy with the dog, while changing only the art style, environment details, and franchise-inspired visual language. Keep the collage clean, colorful, and poster-like.

promptLocalized.zh:
使用提供的参考照片，创建一个垂直对比图，将男孩与狗的照片转换为 3 列 4 行、共 12 个正方形面板的网格，每个面板展示以不同流行动漫/游戏风格重新构思的相同构图。保持男孩和狗作为参考照片中可识别的主体，保留他们相对的姿势和亲密度，但以要求的风格渲染每个面板，并配以相符的背景、线条、色彩和角色比例。在每个面板顶部添加醒目的风格标题/Logo。

画布与布局：制作一个包含 12 个等大面板的垂直拼贴画，面板间留有细白边，按从左到右、从上到下的顺序排列。

面板风格及可见标签（共 12 个）：
1. 吉卜力工作室 — 标签：“STUDIO GHIBLI”，柔和的手绘田园动漫风格。
2. 皮克斯 — 标签：“PIXAR”，精致的 3D 家庭动画风格。
3. 七龙珠 — 标签：“DRAGON BALL”，带有速度线和岩石景观的动态少年动作风格。
4. 海贼王 — 标签：“ONE PIECE”，带有船只元素的航海冒险动漫风格。
5. 火影忍者 — 标签：“NARUTO”，带有村庄屋顶和护额造型的忍者动漫风格。
6. 哆啦 A 梦 — 标签：“ドラえもん”，明亮的郊区儿童动漫风格。
7. 海螺小姐 — 标签：“サザエさん”，经典的日本家庭动漫风格。
8. 星际宝贝 — 标签：“Lilo & Stitch”，热带岛屿动画风格。
9. 宝可梦 — 标签：“POKÉMON”，色彩丰富的训练师与伙伴冒险风格。
10. 鬼灭之刃 — 标签：“鬼滅の刃”，带有发光粒子的戏剧性暗黑奇幻动漫风格。
11. 蜡笔小新 — 标签：“クレヨンしんちゃん”，简洁圆润的儿童动漫风格。
12. 我的世界 — 标签：“MINECRAFT”，方块体素游戏风格。

可自定义文本：在面板标题出现的位置使用 {argument name="first style label" default="STUDIO GHIBLI"}、{argument name="second style label" default="PIXAR"}、{argument name="third style label" default="DRAGON BALL"}、{argument name="ninth style label" default="POKÉMON"} 以及 {argument name="twelfth style label" default="MINECRAFT"}。

约束条件：不要添加额外的面板或标签。在每个面板中保留参考主体，包括男孩和狗，仅改变艺术风格、环境细节和受特许经营启发的视觉语言。保持拼贴画整洁、色彩丰富且具有海报感。

templates.title: Western Outlaw Revolver Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 西部亡命之徒左轮手枪海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical hard-boiled western outlaw poster in polished Rockstar Games official concept art style, dramatic graphic-novel rendering with crisp inked edges, high contrast, painterly highlights, and gritty cinematic shading. A single cowboy gunslinger occupies the lower 75% of the frame while the top 25% remains strictly empty solid blood-red background. The character is centered and viewed from the waist up, looming forward in a confrontational pose, aiming a large silver revolver directly at the viewer with strong foreshortening so the gun barrel dominates the foreground and the hand is large and detailed. The face is intentionally obscured by a centered rectangular censor block with a dark-to-brown vertical gradient, covering the face from below the hat brim to the upper chest. The outlaw wears a glossy black wide-brim cowboy hat, dark blue long-sleeve shirt, deep red waistcoat, black neck scarf, and a brown diagonal bandolier loaded with individual brass bullets across the chest. Behind him is a large rough-edged golden-yellow circular sunset disk with black pine tree silhouettes at its lower edge, set against a deep red grunge sky. Along the bottom foreground, add exactly seven black silhouettes of mounted riders on horseback crossing a curved ridge line. No text, no logo, no watermark, no extra characters besides the main gunslinger and the seven rider silhouettes. Use {argument name="background color" default="solid blood-red"}, {argument name="sun disk color" default="golden yellow"}, {argument name="weapon" default="large silver revolver"}, {argument name="outfit accent color" default="deep red waistcoat"}, and {argument name="face covering" default="centered dark-to-brown rectangular censor block"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版硬派西部亡命之徒海报，采用精致的 Rockstar Games 官方概念艺术风格，呈现具有鲜明墨线边缘、高对比度、绘画感高光和粗粝电影感阴影的戏剧性图画小说渲染效果。画面下方 75% 为一名牛仔枪手，上方 25% 保持纯粹的血红色背景。角色居中，半身像，以对抗姿态向前逼近，正用一把巨大的银色左轮手枪直接瞄准观众，通过强烈的透视缩短效果，使枪管占据前景，手部细节丰富且硕大。面部被一个居中的矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖，该遮挡块带有从深色到棕色的垂直渐变，覆盖了从帽檐下方到上胸部的区域。这位亡命之徒戴着一顶亮面黑色宽檐牛仔帽，身穿深蓝色长袖衬衫、深红色马甲、黑色领巾，胸前斜跨着一条装满独立黄铜子弹的棕色子弹带。在他身后是一个巨大的、边缘粗糙的金黄色圆形落日圆盘，圆盘下缘有黑色松树剪影，背景为深红色的颓废风格天空。在底部前景处，添加七个骑马者的黑色剪影，正穿过一条弯曲的山脊线。画面中不含任何文字、标志、水印，除主要枪手和七个骑马者剪影外，不包含其他额外角色。使用 {argument name="background color" default="solid blood-red"}、{argument name="sun disk color" default="golden yellow"}、{argument name="weapon" default="large silver revolver"}、{argument name="outfit accent color" default="deep red waistcoat"} 以及 {argument name="face covering" default="centered dark-to-brown rectangular censor block"}。

templates.title: Faceless Outlaw Graphic Novel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: “无面亡命徒”图形小说海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical polished hard-boiled graphic-novel character poster in the style of official Rockstar Games concept art. Show one intimidating outlaw/gunslinger figure centered in the frame, occupying the lower 75% of the image, while the top 25% remains mostly empty solid blood-red background with subtle gritty black brush smears and splatter texture near the horizon. The character wears a glossy black wide-brim cowboy hat, black leather trench coat with sharp lapels, black pinstripe waistcoat, black shirt, black neck scarf or tie, and black leather gloves. The face is deliberately hidden by a centered dark brown-to-black square censor block covering the entire facial area from below the hat brim to the chin, leaving only ears and a small hint of lower jaw visible. Pose: front-facing, shoulders squared, stern and statuesque, both arms bent at the waist while holding exactly two long-barreled revolvers crossed in an X shape across the torso, barrels angled upward toward opposite sides, wooden grips visible near the bottom. Use dramatic noir lighting, deep shadows, high-contrast inked outlines, painterly highlights on the shiny leather and gunmetal, gritty western crime mood, cinematic poster composition, no text, no logo, no watermark. Character details may be customized as {argument name="character type" default="faceless black-clad outlaw gunslinger"}, weapon as {argument name="weapon" default="two long-barreled revolvers crossed across the chest"}, attire as {argument name="attire" default="glossy black cowboy hat, leather trench coat, pinstripe waistcoat, black shirt, neck scarf, and leather gloves"}, background color as {argument name="background color" default="solid blood-red"}, and pose as {argument name="pose" default="front-facing with squared shoulders and crossed revolvers"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直、精致且硬汉派的图形小说角色海报，风格参考 Rockstar Games 的官方概念艺术。画面中心展示一名极具威慑力的亡命徒/枪手形象，占据画面下方的 75%，上方 25% 保持大面积纯血红色背景，地平线附近带有微妙的黑色粗糙笔触和喷溅纹理。角色头戴光亮的黑色宽檐牛仔帽，身穿带有尖领的黑色皮质风衣、黑色细条纹马甲、黑色衬衫、黑色领巾或领带，以及黑色皮手套。面部被一个位于正中央的深棕色至黑色方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，遮盖范围从帽檐下方至下巴，仅露出耳朵和少许下颌轮廓。姿势：正面朝向，双肩平齐，神情严峻且如雕塑般伫立，双臂在腰间弯曲，手中交叉握着两把长管左轮手枪，呈 X 型横跨躯干，枪管斜向上指向两侧，底部可见木质枪柄。采用戏剧性的黑色电影光影、深邃的阴影、高对比度的墨线勾勒，在光亮的皮革和枪金属上添加绘画质感的高光，营造粗犷的西部犯罪氛围，构图符合电影海报标准，无文字、无 Logo、无水印。角色细节可自定义为 {argument name="character type" default="无面黑衣亡命枪手"}，武器为 {argument name="weapon" default="胸前交叉的两把长管左轮手枪"}，服装为 {argument name="attire" default="光亮黑色牛仔帽、皮质风衣、细条纹马甲、黑色衬衫、领巾和皮手套"}，背景颜色为 {argument name="background color" default="纯血红色"}，姿势为 {argument name="pose" default="正面朝向、双肩平齐且交叉握着左轮手枪"}。

templates.title: Crowd-Built Anime Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 人群拼贴动漫肖像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic conceptual crowd portrait on a square canvas: an aerial/isometric view of a giant anime-inspired male bust formed entirely from thousands of tiny standing people. The character is shown from the shoulders up in three-quarter side profile facing right, with exaggerated tall spiky white hair, a visible left ear, pale skin tones suggested by lighter-clothed crowds, and a massive high black coat collar and dark jacket suggested by densely packed black-clothed crowds. The whole portrait is built from countless individual human figures arranged like pointillist pixels, with the hair spikes and coat edges sharply readable from above. Place the formation on a vast matte off-white floor with empty negative space around it, scattered with a small number of lone pedestrians walking away from the crowd and casting long thin shadows. Add a large opaque warm-gray square censor block centered over the face area, covering most facial features from forehead to chin while leaving the hair, ear, collar, shoulders, and surrounding people visible. Use cinematic minimalist lighting, soft high-angle sunlight, realistic tiny shadows, ultra-detailed installation-art texture, muted beige, white, black, and charcoal palette, no text, no logos, no border. The portrait subject may be customized as {argument name="character archetype" default="spiky-haired anime male with high collar"}, with {argument name="hair color" default="white"}, {argument name="coat color" default="black"}, {argument name="floor color" default="warm off-white"}, and {argument name="censor block color" default="warm gray"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 在方形画布上创作一幅照片级真实感的概念人群肖像：俯瞰/等轴测视角，展示一个由数千个微小站立人群组成的巨大动漫风格男性半身像。角色呈肩部以上四分之三侧面，面向右侧，拥有夸张的高耸尖刺白发、清晰可见的左耳；通过浅色着装人群呈现苍白肤色，通过密集排列的黑色着装人群呈现巨大的黑色高领和深色外套。整幅肖像由无数个体人形像点彩像素般排列而成，从上方看，发丝尖端和外套边缘清晰可辨。将该造型置于广阔的哑光灰白色地面上，周围留有空白负空间，零星散布着几个远离人群的行人，投下细长的阴影。在面部区域中心添加一个巨大的不透明暖灰色方形遮挡块，覆盖从前额到下巴的大部分面部特征，同时保持头发、耳朵、衣领、肩膀及周围人群可见。采用电影级极简照明、柔和的高角度阳光、逼真的微小阴影、超精细的装置艺术质感，色调为柔和的米色、白色、黑色和炭灰色，无文字，无标识，无边框。肖像主体可自定义为 {argument name="character archetype" default="spiky-haired anime male with high collar"}，并可设置 {argument name="hair color" default="white"}、{argument name="coat color" default="black"}、{argument name="floor color" default="warm off-white"} 以及 {argument name="censor block color" default="warm gray"}。

templates.title: Four-Panel Bankrupt Mouse Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 四格“破产小鼠”故事板

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a warm cinematic 2x2 storyboard image for a short animated scene titled {argument name="scene title" default="Zero Balance Despair"}, featuring three cute anthropomorphic mice in a quaint stone village and bank-world setting.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image divided into exactly 4 equal panels with thin white gutters, like a polished animated film storyboard. Use high-detail 3D character animation, soft fur, expressive faces, shallow depth of field, golden-hour lighting, warm orange highlights, and cozy fantasy village textures.

Characters: Use exactly 3 recurring mouse characters throughout: 1 small mouse wearing a green patterned cloak/scarf, 1 larger central mouse wearing a {argument name="central outfit color" default="red patterned cloak/scarf"}, and 1 small mouse wearing a blue patterned cloak/scarf. All have tan-brown fur, huge round ears, shiny black eyes, tiny pink noses, visible whiskers, little paws, and childlike proportions. Keep their designs consistent across panels. In panels where the central mouse face is hidden, cover only the face with a plain soft-edged square privacy block in {argument name="face cover color" default="warm brown"}.

Panel layout and action: Panel 1, top-left: exactly 3 mice huddle close under a dark wooden overhang or doorway. The green-cloaked mouse on the left looks worried with paws near mouth; the central red-cloaked mouse stands in the middle with face covered by a square block; the blue-cloaked mouse on the right points toward the central mouse with a concerned expression. Warm indoor shadows, stone floor, intimate anxious mood. Panel 2, top-right: exactly 3 mice stand outside in a sunny old stone street with blurred bunting flags overhead. The green mouse stands left with arms folded, the red central mouse stands proudly in the middle smiling, and the blue mouse stands right looking stern or suspicious with arms folded. Panel 3, bottom-left: exactly 3 mice run left-to-right across a stone ledge or step, motion-filled and energetic. The blue mouse leads at far left, the red mouse runs in the middle, and the green mouse runs at right, all with fluttering cloaks and excited expressions. Panel 4, bottom-right: exactly 3 mice celebrate among scattered gold coins and colorful confetti. The green mouse at left laughs with eyes closed and holds the central red cloak, the central red-cloaked mouse stands in the middle with face covered by the same square block, and the blue mouse at right smiles with open mouth and clasped paws. Background is a golden bank or treasure-like interior with bokeh lights.

Visual style: Pixar-like but original, adorable cinematic 3D rendering, realistic plush fur, detailed cloth embroidery, warm fantasy lighting, crisp characters with softly blurred backgrounds, expressive gestures, emotional storytelling, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 panels and exactly 3 mice in every panel. The visible repeated cloak colors must be green, red, and blue. Include exactly 2 face-cover blocks total, one in panel 1 and one in panel 4. Do not add extra characters, captions, speech bubbles, or UI elements. Overall mood should move from anxiety to confidence, action, and joyful relief about {argument name="financial theme" default="a bankrupt mouse discovering coins"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="scene title" default="零余额的绝望"} 的短动画场景创作一张温暖的 2x2 电影感故事板图像，主角是三只可爱的拟人化小鼠，背景设定在古朴的石砌村庄和银行世界中。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，通过细白线分割成 4 个相等的面板，呈现出精致动画电影故事板的质感。采用高细节 3D 角色动画，表现柔软的皮毛、生动的表情、浅景深、黄金时刻光影、温暖的橙色高光以及舒适的奇幻村庄纹理。

角色：在所有面板中保持 3 只小鼠角色的一致性：1 只小鼠穿着绿色花纹斗篷/围巾，1 只较大的中心小鼠穿着 {argument name="central outfit color" default="红色花纹斗篷/围巾"}，以及 1 只小鼠穿着蓝色花纹斗篷/围巾。它们都有棕褐色皮毛、巨大的圆耳朵、闪亮的黑眼睛、小巧的粉色鼻子、清晰的胡须、小爪子和童趣的比例。确保它们在各面板中的设计保持一致。在中心小鼠面部被遮挡的面板中，仅用 {argument name="face cover color" default="暖棕色"} 的柔边方形遮挡块覆盖面部。

面板布局与动作：面板 1（左上）：3 只小鼠紧紧挤在深色木质屋檐或门口下。左侧穿绿色斗篷的小鼠神情忧虑，爪子靠近嘴边；中间穿红色斗篷的小鼠面部被方形遮挡块覆盖；右侧穿蓝色斗篷的小鼠表情关切，指向中间的小鼠。温暖的室内阴影，石质地面，营造出亲密而焦虑的氛围。面板 2（右上）：3 只小鼠站在阳光明媚的古老石街上，上方有模糊的彩旗。绿色小鼠站在左侧双臂交叉，红色中心小鼠站在中间自豪地微笑，蓝色小鼠站在右侧，双臂交叉，表情严肃或多疑。面板 3（左下）：3 只小鼠在石台阶上从左向右奔跑，充满动感与活力。蓝色小鼠在最左侧领跑，红色小鼠在中间，绿色小鼠在右侧，斗篷随风飘动，表情兴奋。面板 4（右下）：3 只小鼠在散落的金币和彩色纸屑中庆祝。左侧的绿色小鼠闭眼大笑，抓着中间红色斗篷小鼠的衣角，中间穿红色斗篷的小鼠面部同样被方形遮挡块覆盖，右侧的蓝色小鼠张嘴微笑，双手合十。背景是金色的银行或类似宝库的室内场景，带有散景光效。

视觉风格：皮克斯风格但具有原创性，可爱的电影级 3D 渲染，逼真的毛绒质感，精细的布料刺绣，温暖的奇幻光影，清晰的角色主体与柔和模糊的背景，生动的姿态，情感叙事，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

约束条件：每个面板必须包含 4 个分格和 3 只小鼠。重复出现的斗篷颜色必须为绿色、红色和蓝色。总共包含 2 个面部遮挡块，分别位于面板 1 和面板 4。不要添加额外角色、标题、对话气泡或 UI 元素。整体氛围应从焦虑转变为自信、行动，以及关于 {argument name="financial theme" default="破产小鼠发现金币"} 的快乐解脱。

templates.title: Zero Balance Bank Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: “零余额”银行故事板

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic 2x2 storyboard collage for a short dramatic video titled {argument name="story title" default="Zero Balance Despair"}, showing one Japanese salaryman discovering he has no money and falling into despair.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, divided into exactly 4 equal panels with thin white gutters. Photorealistic, high-resolution, cinematic lighting, realistic Japanese urban bank environment. Keep the same main character, outfit, hairstyle, watch, and brown leather shoulder bag across all panels. The character’s face should be intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur/mosaic block in every panel for anonymity.

Main character: A young adult Japanese businessman, {argument name="character description" default="messy black hair, navy suit, white dress shirt, loosened navy tie, brown dress shoes, silver wristwatch, brown leather shoulder bag"}. He looks exhausted, panicked, and emotionally overwhelmed.

Panel count and contents: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Top-left panel: Inside or beside a bank ATM booth. The ATM screen clearly displays a large red “0” on a pale blue screen, indicating a zero balance. The businessman stands close to the ATM, shoulders tense, looking devastated, with his leather bag strap over one shoulder.
2. Top-right panel: At a bank service counter. The businessman leans forward toward a female bank clerk in a navy uniform, gesturing desperately with both hands open. The bank interior is clean and modern, with a blue counter, glass partitions, small signage, and warm office lighting.
3. Bottom-left panel: Outside the bank entrance. A blue sign above the door reads {argument name="bank sign text" default="BANK"}. The businessman stands on the sidewalk in front of the bank with both arms thrown upward in panic, tie loosened, jacket open, brown shoulder bag hanging at his side. Bright daylight, urban street details, bollards, paving stones, and greenery.
4. Bottom-right panel: In a quiet park. The businessman sits slumped on a wooden bench, head bowed, arms hanging down, defeated. His brown leather bag rests on the bench beside him. Include trees, dappled sunlight, green shrubs, and a calm background that contrasts with his despair.

Visual style: Photorealistic Japanese commercial-drama stills, consistent character continuity, natural depth of field, sharp clothing detail, realistic bank and park locations, vivid but believable colors, emotional storytelling. No cartoon style, no extra panels, no captions except the ATM “0” and the exterior bank sign.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部名为 {argument name="story title" default="零余额绝望"} 的短篇剧情视频创建一个 2x2 的电影级故事板拼图，展示一名日本上班族发现自己身无分文并陷入绝望的过程。

画布：正方形 1:1 图像，精确划分为 4 个相等的面板，面板间有细白色间隙。照片级真实感，高分辨率，电影级布光，真实的日本城市银行环境。确保所有面板中的主角、服装、发型、手表和棕色皮革单肩包保持一致。为保护匿名，主角的面部在每个面板中都应刻意用柔和的矩形模糊/马赛克块遮挡。

主角：一名年轻的日本上班族，{argument name="character description" default="凌乱的黑发，海军蓝西装，白色衬衫，松开的海军蓝领带，棕色皮鞋，银色腕表，棕色皮革单肩包"}。他看起来精疲力竭、惊慌失措且情绪崩溃。

面板数量及内容：使用精确的 4 个面板。
1. 左上角面板：在银行 ATM 机内或旁边。ATM 屏幕在淡蓝色背景上清晰地显示出一个巨大的红色“0”，表示余额为零。上班族紧贴 ATM 机站立，双肩紧绷，神情沮丧，棕色皮包带子斜挎在肩上。
2. 右上角面板：在银行服务柜台。上班族向前倾身，面对一名身穿海军蓝制服的女银行职员，双手摊开，神情绝望地比划着。银行内部环境整洁现代，配有蓝色柜台、玻璃隔断、小型标识和温暖的办公照明。
3. 左下角面板：在银行入口外。门上方的蓝色招牌写着 {argument name="bank sign text" default="BANK"}。上班族站在银行前的人行道上，双臂因惊慌而向上挥舞，领带松开，外套敞开，棕色单肩包垂在身侧。明亮的日光，城市街道细节，防撞柱，铺路石和绿植。
4. 右下角面板：在安静的公园里。上班族瘫坐在木长椅上，低着头，双臂下垂，神情颓废。他的棕色皮革包放在身旁的长椅上。包含树木、斑驳的阳光、绿色灌木，以及与他的绝望形成鲜明对比的宁静背景。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的日本商业剧情剧照，角色连贯性一致，自然的景深，清晰的服装细节，真实的银行和公园场景，生动但可信的色彩，情感叙事。禁止使用卡通风格，禁止增加额外面板，除 ATM 屏幕上的“0”和银行外部招牌外，禁止添加任何文字说明。

templates.title: Chronowa Black Cat Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Chronowa 黑猫角色设定集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean monochrome-and-red Japanese character reference sheet poster for a cute black cat mascot named {argument name="character name" default="Chronowa"}, a night-music themed black cat wearing white sunglasses and red headphones.

Canvas: Vertical A4-style poster, white/off-white background, thin black border, subtle red corner marks, small halftone dots, diagonal tech lines, tiny skyline silhouettes, waveform accents, barcode at bottom left, and a black footer strip reading in English “LISTEN TO THE NIGHT.” Use a crisp vector/ink illustration style with limited palette: black, white, gray, and accent red.

Main layout: Place a large central full-body front-view black cat as the hero subject, sitting upright with a curled tail, oversized pointed ears, long whiskers, white angular sunglasses with black lenses and reflective highlights, and red-and-black headphones resting around the neck. Add a bold top title in Japanese plus English using {argument name="main title text" default="クロノワ / CHRONOWA"}, with a smaller tagline beneath using {argument name="tagline text" default="夜の音を聴く黒猫"}. Add a red crescent moon and black city skyline silhouette in the upper right.

Left character views: Include exactly 3 smaller cat pose panels stacked vertically on the left, each with a black label tab and red accent: 1) side view, cat sitting in profile wearing white sunglasses with headphones around neck; 2) listening pose, cat wearing red headphones over ears, paws touching headphones, small music note nearby; 3) relax pose, cat lying down with headphones around neck.

Right item box: Include exactly 2 item illustrations inside a bordered box: 1) white sunglasses; 2) red headphones. Label them in Japanese using the same graphic style.

Right mood icon box: Include exactly 6 small chibi mood icons in a 2-column by 3-row grid, all black cat icons with white sunglasses: 1) good mood with music note; 2) cool but moody; 3) shy/embarrassed; 4) alert with motion marks; 5) kind with small red heart; 6) slightly angry with red anger symbol.

Bottom information cards: Create exactly 8 bordered info cards across the lower third, numbered 01 through 08 with black slanted header tabs and red number accents. The 8 cards are: 01 profile; 02 personality; 03 features; 04 favorite things; 05 dislikes; 06 abilities; 07 setting; 08 quotes. Use compact Japanese text inside the cards, with small decorative icons such as a waveform, paw print, sun warning symbol, small cat silhouette, and red paw mark. For the quote card, include three short Japanese quote lines using {argument name="quote text" default="『今夜の音、悪くないね』 / 『星は苦手。世界が明るすぎる』 / 『いい夜だね。少しだけ、歩こうか』"}.

Text style: Use strong Japanese display typography, black labels with red side bars, small red waveform graphics, and clean technical annotation lines. Keep the poster readable but allow tiny Japanese text to feel like a designed reference sheet.

Constraints: Use exactly one central hero cat, exactly 3 left pose panels, exactly 2 item illustrations, exactly 6 mood icons, and exactly 8 bottom info cards. No humans, no extra characters, no full-color background, no photorealism, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的黑白红配色日式角色参考海报，主角是名为 {argument name="character name" default="Chronowa"} 的可爱黑猫吉祥物，这是一只以夜间音乐为主题、佩戴白色太阳镜和红色耳机的黑猫。

画布：竖版 A4 风格海报，白色/米白色背景，细黑边框，精致的红色角标，细小的半调网点，对角线科技线条，微小的城市天际线剪影，波形装饰，左下角条形码，底部黑色页脚条，用英文写着“LISTEN TO THE NIGHT”。采用清晰的矢量/墨水插画风格，配色方案有限：黑色、白色、灰色和红色点缀。

主要布局：在中心放置一个大型全身正面黑猫作为主角，坐姿端正，尾巴卷曲，超大的尖耳朵，长胡须，佩戴白色棱角分明的太阳镜（黑色镜片带反光高光），颈部挂着红黑相间的耳机。在顶部添加醒目的日文加英文标题 {argument name="main title text" default="クロノワ / CHRONOWA"}，下方使用 {argument name="tagline text" default="夜の音を聴く黒猫"} 作为副标题。右上角添加一个红色新月和黑色城市天际线剪影。

左侧角色视图：在左侧垂直堆叠 3 个较小的猫咪姿势面板，每个面板都有黑色标签页和红色装饰：1) 侧视图，猫咪侧坐，佩戴白色太阳镜，耳机挂在颈部；2) 聆听姿势，猫咪佩戴红色耳机，爪子触碰耳机，旁边有小音符；3) 放松姿势，猫咪躺下，耳机挂在颈部。

右侧物品栏：在一个带边框的方框内包含 2 个物品插图：1) 白色太阳镜；2) 红色耳机。使用相同的图形风格进行日文标注。

右侧心情图标栏：包含 6 个 2 列 3 行排列的小型 Q 版心情图标，均为佩戴白色太阳镜的黑猫：1) 听音乐心情好；2) 冷酷但忧郁；3) 害羞/尴尬；4) 警觉并带有动作标记；5) 友善并带有红色小爱心；6) 微怒并带有红色愤怒符号。

底部信息卡：在底部三分之一处创建 8 个带边框的信息卡，编号从 01 到 08，带有黑色斜向标题栏和红色数字装饰。8 张卡片分别为：01 个人资料；02 性格；03 特征；04 喜好；05 厌恶；06 能力；07 背景设定；08 语录。卡片内使用紧凑的日文文本，并配有波形、爪印、太阳警告符号、小猫剪影和红色爪印等小型装饰图标。语录卡片包含三行简短的日文引用，使用 {argument name="quote text" default="『今夜の音、悪くないね』 / 『星は苦手。世界が明るすぎる』 / 『いい夜だね。少しだけ、歩こうか』"}。

文字风格：使用强烈的日式展示排版，黑色标签配红色侧边栏，小型红色波形图形，以及清晰的技术标注线。保持海报的可读性，同时让微小的日文文本呈现出设计感十足的参考表效果。

约束条件：必须包含 1 个中心主角猫，3 个左侧姿势面板，2 个物品插图，6 个心情图标，以及 8 个底部信息卡。禁止出现人类，禁止出现额外角色，禁止使用全彩背景，禁止写实风格，禁止添加水印。

templates.title: Four-Panel Bank World Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 四格银行世界项目

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 2x2 storyboard-style image sheet for a short video scene about {argument name="scene theme" default="the despair of a zero bank balance"}, set in a modern blue-themed bank world.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, four equal panels separated by clean white gutters, bright cinematic 3D-rendered realism with slightly idealized commercial lighting, high detail, sharp focus, saturated blue bank branding, no captions or speech bubbles.

Layout: Use exactly 4 panels in a grid.
1. Top-left panel: Interior ATM area with exactly 3 visible ATM machines in a row, each built into gray wall bays with bold blue vertical dividers. The nearest ATM screen prominently shows a large red “0” on a pale cyan screen, implying an empty balance. Include tiled floor, ceiling lights, and a small potted plant in the background.
2. Top-right panel: Bank service counter with exactly 1 female bank clerk seated behind a beige stone counter. She wears a navy suit, white shirt, blue striped scarf or tie, and a small gold nameplate. Her face is intentionally featureless/softly blurred for anonymity. Include exactly 1 computer monitor, 1 keyboard, 1 blue document tray, and 1 potted plant on or near the counter. Behind her are glass office partitions, blue chairs, certificates on the wall, and warm office lighting.
3. Bottom-left panel: Exterior of a contemporary city bank branch on a sunny street corner. Show a blue horizontal sign band above glass doors, gray stone facade, street crosswalk markings, sidewalk bollards, leafy trees, and black street lamps. The entrance should feel clean, corporate, and Japanese urban but without readable signage.
4. Bottom-right panel: Fantasy bank vault interior with an oversized round open vault door in bronze and steel. Inside the vault are stacks of cash and gold, warm golden lighting, shelves, and treasure props. Include exactly 3 small cute animal mascots standing near the vault entrance, wearing colorful tiny outfits, plus visible piles of bundled banknotes, coins, a chest, and a money bag.

Visual style: High-end 3D illustration, cinematic render, bank commercial aesthetic mixed with whimsical storybook detail in the vault panel, realistic materials, glossy glass, polished stone, metallic vault surfaces, warm highlights, deep blue brand accents.

Subject details: The bank’s dominant brand color is {argument name="brand color" default="royal blue"}. The ATM screen should display {argument name="balance number" default="0"} in red. The bank clerk outfit should be {argument name="clerk outfit" default="navy suit with blue striped scarf"}. The vault should contain {argument name="vault contents" default="bundled cash, coins, treasure chest, and money bag"}.

Constraints: No extra panels, no visible watermarks, no logos, no readable text except the red balance number on the ATM screen, keep the four-panel sheet coherent as one bank-themed storyboard, maintain clean white borders between panels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为关于 {argument name="scene theme" default="零余额的绝望"} 的短视频场景创建一个精致的 2x2 项目风格图像表，背景设定在现代蓝色主题的银行世界中。

画布：方形 1:1 构图，四个相等的面板由整洁的白色间隙分隔，明亮的电影级 3D 渲染写实风格，带有略微理想化的商业照明，高细节，清晰对焦，饱和的蓝色银行品牌色，无标题或对话气泡。

布局：使用 4 个面板的网格布局。
1. 左上角面板：室内 ATM 区域，一排有 3 台清晰可见的 ATM 机，每台都嵌入灰色墙壁隔间中，并带有醒目的蓝色垂直分隔条。最近的 ATM 屏幕在浅青色屏幕上醒目地显示一个大大的红色“0”，暗示余额为零。包含瓷砖地板、天花板灯和背景中的一盆小盆栽。
2. 右上角面板：银行服务柜台，有 1 名女性银行职员坐在米色石质柜台后。她身穿海军蓝西装、白衬衫、蓝色条纹围巾或领带，并佩戴一个小金质名牌。她的面部特征被刻意模糊处理以保持匿名。柜台上或附近包含 1 台电脑显示器、1 个键盘、1 个蓝色文件托盘和 1 盆盆栽。她身后是玻璃办公室隔断、蓝色椅子、墙上的证书和温暖的办公室照明。
3. 左下角面板：阳光明媚的街角，现代城市银行分行的外观。展示玻璃门上方的蓝色水平招牌带、灰色石材外墙、街道人行横道标记、人行道护柱、绿树和黑色路灯。入口应给人一种整洁、企业化且具有日本城市风格的感觉，但没有可辨认的文字招牌。
4. 右下角面板：奇幻银行金库内部，有一个超大的青铜和钢制圆形开放式金库门。金库内堆满了现金和黄金，配有温暖的金色灯光、货架和宝藏道具。包含 3 个站在金库入口附近的可爱小动物吉祥物，它们穿着色彩鲜艳的小套装，此外还有可见的成捆钞票、硬币、宝箱和钱袋。

视觉风格：高端 3D 插画，电影级渲染，银行商业美学与金库面板中奇幻故事书细节的结合，写实材质，光泽玻璃，抛光石材，金属金库表面，温暖的高光，深蓝色品牌点缀。

主体细节：银行的主导品牌颜色为 {argument name="brand color" default="宝蓝色"}。ATM 屏幕应以红色显示 {argument name="balance number" default="0"}。银行职员的服装应为 {argument name="clerk outfit" default="海军蓝西装配蓝色条纹围巾"}。金库应包含 {argument name="vault contents" default="成捆现金、硬币、宝箱和钱袋"}。

约束：无额外面板，无可见水印，无 Logo，除 ATM 屏幕上的红色余额数字外无任何可读文字，保持四格表作为一个银行主题项目的连贯性，保持面板之间整洁的白色边框。

templates.title: Cinematic Baijiu 9-Panel Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感白酒 9 格分镜脚本

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic 16:9 storyboard contact sheet showing the complete premium Chinese baijiu product experience, from unboxing to pouring, tasting, and dining, featuring {argument name="character description" default="an elegant Chinese woman in a sleeveless beige qipao-style top, hair in a neat updo, gold drop earrings"}.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 image divided into exactly 9 storyboard panels in a 3-by-3 grid, separated by thin white borders. Add small white panel numbers 1 through 9 in the lower-left corner of each panel. Warm amber lighting, shallow depth of field, luxury restaurant/private dining room atmosphere, dark wood furniture, soft lantern glow, refined Chinese décor, cinematic lensing, premium commercial photography look.

Product: A high-end baijiu gift set branded {argument name="product name" default="山河酿"}. Use a dark navy-black bottle and gift box with gold foil accents, mountain-and-river illustration patterns, a vertical cream-gold label with Chinese calligraphy, and a metallic gold cap. Keep the bottle shape consistent across panels.

Storyboard layout: Include exactly 9 distinct panels:
1. Close-up overhead angle of the closed luxury gift box on a dark wooden table, the woman’s hands gently touching the box lid, with delicate gold landscape line art and the vertical Chinese label visible.
2. Medium shot of the woman opening the gift box, revealing the baijiu bottle inside a fitted presentation case; include an inner paper panel with elegant Chinese poem-like text and subtle ink landscape artwork.
3. Close-up of both hands holding the bottle upright in front of the open box, emphasizing the dark ceramic texture, gold cap, gold label, and mountain illustration.
4. Medium portrait shot of the woman unscrewing or lifting the gold cap from the bottle, graceful hand pose, warm restaurant background bokeh.
5. Extreme close-up of the bottle neck pouring clear baijiu into a small stemmed tasting glass; show sparkling liquid stream and bubbles, with the bottle label partially visible.
6. Medium close-up of the woman smelling the baijiu from a small tulip-shaped glass, elegant profile, soft golden lamp glow behind her.
7. Portrait close-up of the woman tasting the baijiu, glass raised to lips, serene refined expression implied, warm shallow-focus background.
8. Still-life dining table scene with the baijiu bottle standing centered among Chinese dishes, small tasting glasses, and tableware; include exactly 4 visible plated dishes: braised meat, stir-fried vegetables, sauced seafood or chicken, and a larger central shared dish.
9. Wide dining scene with the woman seated at the table holding a tasting glass, the baijiu bottle placed on the right side of the table, multiple dishes and small cups in front, city night lights or elegant window background.

Visual style: Premium cinematic advertising, realistic photography, rich warm color grading, high-end liquor commercial, soft highlights on glass and gold foil, dark mahogany and amber palette, elegant composition, crisp product details, no cartoon style.

Constraints: The final image must be one 9-panel storyboard, not nine separate files. Use exactly 9 panels, exactly 9 visible panel numbers, and exactly 4 plated dishes in panel 8. Keep all text minimal except the Chinese product name {argument name="product name on label" default="山河酿"}. Do not add watermarks, logos from real brands, subtitles, or extra captions.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个 16:9 的电影感分镜脚本联系表，展示完整的中国高端白酒产品体验，从开箱到斟酒、品鉴及用餐，主角为 {argument name="character description" default="一位优雅的中国女性，身着米色无袖旗袍式上衣，发髻整洁，佩戴金色水滴耳环"}。

画布：宽屏 16:9 图像，分为 3x3 网格共 9 个分镜面板，面板间以细白线分隔。在每个面板的左下角添加 1 到 9 的小型白色面板编号。暖琥珀色灯光，浅景深，豪华餐厅/私人包间氛围，深色木质家具，柔和的灯笼光，精致的中式装饰，电影级镜头感，高端商业摄影风格。

产品：一款高端白酒礼盒，品牌名为 {argument name="product name" default="山河酿"}。使用深藏青黑色瓶身及礼盒，配有烫金装饰、山水插画图案、带有中式书法的垂直奶油金色标签以及金属金瓶盖。确保瓶身在各面板中保持一致。

分镜布局：包含 9 个不同的面板：
1. 深色木桌上闭合豪华礼盒的俯视特写，女性双手轻触盒盖，可见精致的金色山水线条艺术和垂直中式标签。
2. 女性打开礼盒的中景镜头，露出礼盒内衬中的白酒瓶；包含一张带有优雅中式诗词文字和淡雅水墨山水画的内衬纸板。
3. 双手在打开的礼盒前竖直握住瓶身的特写，强调深色陶瓷质感、金色瓶盖、金色标签和山水插画。
4. 女性旋开或取下瓶盖的中景肖像，手势优雅，背景为温暖的餐厅虚化光斑。
5. 瓶颈将清澈白酒倒入小高脚品鉴杯的极度特写；展示闪烁的酒液流和气泡，部分可见瓶身标签。
6. 女性从郁金香型小酒杯中闻酒香的中景特写，优雅侧颜，身后有柔和的金色灯光。
7. 女性品鉴白酒的肖像特写，酒杯举至唇边，神情宁静优雅，背景为温暖的浅景深效果。
8. 餐桌静物场景，白酒瓶置于中式菜肴、小酒杯和餐具中央；包含 4 道可见的盘装菜肴：红烧肉、炒时蔬、酱汁海鲜或鸡肉，以及一道较大的中央共享菜肴。
9. 宽幅用餐场景，女性坐在桌前手持酒杯，白酒瓶放置在桌子右侧，面前摆放多道菜肴和小杯，背景为城市夜景或优雅的窗景。

视觉风格：高端电影广告，写实摄影，浓郁的暖色调，高端酒类商业广告，玻璃和烫金上的柔和高光，深红木与琥珀色调，优雅构图，清晰的产品细节，非卡通风格。

约束条件：最终图像必须是一张 9 格分镜脚本，而非 9 个单独的文件。使用 9 个面板，9 个可见的面板编号，且第 8 个面板中必须有 4 道盘装菜肴。除中式产品名称 {argument name="product name on label" default="山河酿"} 外，保持所有文字最少化。不要添加水印、真实品牌 Logo、字幕或额外说明文字。
