templates.title: Luxury Milan Typographic Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 米兰奢华排版旅行海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a premium luxury travel poster for {argument name="city name" default="MILAN"}, built around monumental 3D typography where each letter is a realistic architectural sculpture inspired by famous Milan landmarks.

Canvas: Horizontal 3:2 aspect ratio, editorial destination-advertising composition, bright airy daylight, pale blue sky with soft clouds, warm beige stone plaza at the bottom, ultra-realistic architectural rendering with refined luxury-magazine polish.

Main layout: Center the word {argument name="main word" default="MILAN"} across the lower two-thirds of the poster as five enormous freestanding letters on a clean horizon line. Each letter must be a different architectural landmark form, highly detailed, realistic, and sculptural:
1. M: Gothic white marble cathedral architecture inspired by Duomo di Milano, with tall spires, pinnacles, pointed arches, rose windows, buttresses, statues, and gold crosses.
2. I: elegant glass-and-stone arcade tower inspired by Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, with a large arched glass facade, ornate classical columns, and a vaulted passage visible through the base.
3. L: red-brick medieval tower and castle massing inspired by Castello Sforzesco, with a clock tower, crenellations, arched entry, stone trim, and relief panels.
4. A: modern green residential architecture inspired by Bosco Verticale, shaped like a capital A with terraces, concrete beams, lush trees, shrubs, and planted balconies.
5. N: contemporary glass skyscraper forms inspired by Milan business district architecture, including a tall cylindrical reflective tower and a sharply leaning diagonal glass-and-steel structure.

Top information band: Add a thin, elegant destination-series header in small spaced uppercase letters. Left text reads "SERIE DESTINOS" with a fine horizontal rule and a small dot. Right text reads "CIUDAD / 01" with a matching fine rule. Across the top center, include exactly six small pale-gray landmark line icons with thin vertical separators and uppercase captions beneath them. The six captions are: "DUOMO DI MILANO", "GALLERIA VITTORIO EMANUELE II", "CASTELLO SFORZESCO", "BOSCO VERTICALE", "TEATRO ALLA SCALA", "ARCO DELLA PACE".

Bottom band: Add a refined beige footer strip with thin rules and small editorial text. Left microcopy reads "ELEGANCIA QUE INSPIRA. HISTORIA QUE ACOGE. DISEÑO QUE LIDERA." Center title reads "VISITA MILAN" in widely spaced uppercase letters, flanked by fine horizontal lines and small dots. Right side includes coordinates "45.4642° N, 9.1900° E" and issue code "N.º 01-MMXXV".

Visual style: Photorealistic 3D architectural typography, premium travel editorial, realistic stone, brick, glass, metal, greenery, precise shadows, high-resolution detail, balanced symmetry, soft cinematic daylight, subtle atmospheric haze, minimal clutter, sophisticated beige-gray-blue palette.

Constraints: Use exactly five main typographic landmark letters and exactly six top landmark icons. Keep the poster clean and luxurious. No people, no cars, no extra landmarks, no watermark, no bottom black attribution bar.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="city name" default="MILAN"} 创作一张高端奢华旅行海报，核心在于纪念碑式的 3D 字体设计，每个字母均为受米兰著名地标启发的写实建筑雕塑。

画布：3:2 横向比例，编辑类目的地广告构图，明亮通透的日光，淡蓝色天空伴有柔和云朵，底部为暖米色石质广场，呈现出精致奢华杂志质感的超写实建筑渲染效果。

主要布局：将 {argument name="main word" default="MILAN"} 置于海报下方三分之二处的中心位置，作为五个巨大的独立字母排列在干净的地平线上。每个字母必须是不同建筑地标的形态，细节丰富、写实且具有雕塑感：
1. M：受米兰大教堂（Duomo di Milano）启发的哥特式白色大理石建筑，带有高耸的尖塔、小尖顶、尖拱、玫瑰窗、扶壁、雕像和金色十字架。
2. I：受埃马努埃莱二世拱廊街（Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II）启发的优雅玻璃石材拱廊塔，带有巨大的拱形玻璃立面、华丽的古典圆柱，底部可见拱形通道。
3. L：受斯福尔扎城堡（Castello Sforzesco）启发的红砖中世纪塔楼和城堡体块，带有钟楼、雉堞、拱形入口、石质装饰和浮雕面板。
4. A：受垂直森林（Bosco Verticale）启发的现代绿色住宅建筑，呈大写字母 A 形，带有露台、混凝土梁、茂密的树木、灌木和种植阳台。
5. N：受米兰商业区建筑启发的现代玻璃摩天大楼形态，包括一座高大的圆柱形反射塔和一座倾斜的对角线玻璃钢结构建筑。

顶部信息栏：添加一个纤细优雅的目的地系列标题，使用小号间距的大写字母。左侧文字为“SERIE DESTINOS”，配有细横线和一个小圆点。右侧文字为“CIUDAD / 01”，配有相应的细横线。顶部中央包含六个浅灰色的小型地标线条图标，图标下方配有细垂直分隔符和全大写说明文字。六个说明文字分别为：“DUOMO DI MILANO”、“GALLERIA VITTORIO EMANUELE II”、“CASTELLO SFORZESCO”、“BOSCO VERTICALE”、“TEATRO ALLA SCALA”、“ARCO DELLA PACE”。

底部栏：添加一个精致的米色页脚条，带有细线条和小号编辑文字。左侧微型文案为“ELEGANCIA QUE INSPIRA. HISTORIA QUE ACOGE. DISEÑO QUE LIDERA.”。中央标题为“VISITA MILAN”，使用宽间距大写字母，两侧配有细横线和小圆点。右侧包含坐标“45.4642° N, 9.1900° E”和期号“N.º 01-MMXXV”。

视觉风格：照片级写实的 3D 建筑字体，高端旅行编辑风格，写实的石材、砖块、玻璃、金属、绿植，精准的阴影，高分辨率细节，平衡的对称感，柔和的电影级日光，微妙的大气雾感，极简构图，精致的米灰蓝配色。

约束条件：使用五个主要地标字母和六个顶部地标图标。保持海报简洁奢华。画面中不得出现人物、车辆、多余地标、水印或底部黑色署名栏。

templates.title: Anime Idol Guitarist Contact Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫偶像吉他手角色设定表

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ornate anime-style character sheet collage of {argument name="character name" default="an anonymous idol guitarist"} performing on a warm theatrical stage, with the character's face deliberately obscured by a soft square blur in every panel.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 composition, dark vintage film-contact-sheet design with thin gold borders, decorative corner flourishes, and a black-gold cinematic frame. Use a warm amber, brown, cream, and black palette with glowing stage light.

Layout: Use exactly 7 image panels total: 1 large dominant portrait panel on the left occupying most of the canvas, and 6 smaller numbered panels arranged around it. The small panels are labeled with gold numbers 1, 2, 3 on the right column from top to middle, and 4, 5, 6 along the bottom row. Include decorative filmstrip motifs on the far left, a small gold crown icon near the upper left, a small sparkle icon mid-left, and a circular star emblem near the lower left. Every panel has rounded black borders with fine gold outlines.

Subject details: The same anime young woman appears in all 7 panels. She has {argument name="hair color" default="short chestnut-brown bob hair"} with bangs and small hair clips, a blurred square face, slim build, and idol-band styling. Outfit: cream puff-sleeve blouse with ruffled neckline, brown ribbon bow at the chest, black choker, black guitar strap, high-waisted brown plaid pleated skirt, belt with round buckle, white thigh-high stockings, small gold accessories, and wrist cuffs. She holds a {argument name="guitar color" default="glossy black electric guitar with white pickguard"} and sings into a black microphone on a stand.

Panel count and contents: Panel 1 large left panel shows a three-quarter full-body pose with microphone in her left hand, guitar across her hips, confident stage stance. Panel 2 top-right shows a closer waist-up singing pose with the guitar neck extending right. Panel 3 mid-right shows a similar waist-up pose with the microphone angled toward her mouth. Panel 4 lower-right-middle shows the character slightly lower in frame with warm curtains behind her. Panel 5 bottom-left small panel shows a close crop with microphone and guitar body. Panel 6 bottom-center small panel shows her centered with microphone stand and guitar neck. Panel 7 bottom-right small panel, labeled 6, shows a more energetic pose with the guitar raised diagonally and a small drawn motion mark near her head.

Background and lighting: Each panel shows the same stage setting with tall golden-orange curtains, dark stage rigging, and a bright triangular spotlight behind the performer creating a halo-like backlight. Use dramatic rim light, glossy highlights on the guitar, cinematic shadows, and fine anime illustration detail.

Constraints: Keep the composition as a polished character reference/contact sheet, not a real photograph. Preserve exactly 6 numbered thumbnail labels plus the large unnumbered main panel. Do not add extra characters, extra text, logos, watermarks, or readable captions beyond the small gold numbers.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个华丽的动漫风格角色拼贴设定表，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位匿名偶像吉他手"} 在温暖的剧院舞台上表演的场景，每个面板中角色的面部均用柔和的方形模糊效果遮盖。

画布：垂直 4:5 构图，深色复古胶片接触印相表设计，带有细金边、装饰性边角花纹以及黑金电影质感边框。使用温暖的琥珀色、棕色、奶油色和黑色调，并配以发光的舞台灯光。

布局：总共使用 7 个图像面板：左侧是一个占据画布大部分面积的大型主肖像面板，周围环绕 6 个较小的带编号面板。小面板在右侧列从上到中分别标注金色数字 1、2、3，底部一行标注 4、5、6。最左侧包含装饰性胶片条纹，左上角附近有一个小金冠图标，左中有一个小闪光图标，左下角附近有一个圆形星形徽章。每个面板都有圆角黑色边框和精致的金色轮廓线。

主体细节：同一位动漫少女出现在所有 7 个面板中。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色短波波头"}，带有刘海和小发夹，面部有模糊的方形遮挡，身材苗条，偶像乐队造型。服装：奶油色泡泡袖衬衫，领口有荷叶边，胸前有棕色丝带蝴蝶结，黑色颈圈，黑色吉他背带，高腰棕色格子百褶裙，带圆形扣的腰带，白色过膝袜，金色小配饰和腕带。她拿着一把 {argument name="guitar color" default="亮黑色电吉他，配有白色护板"}，对着支架上的黑色麦克风唱歌。

面板数量与内容：左侧的大型面板 1 展示了四分之三全身姿势，左手拿着麦克风，吉他横跨腰间，展现自信的舞台站姿。右上角的面板 2 展示了更近的腰部以上唱歌姿势，吉他琴颈向右延伸。中右侧的面板 3 展示了类似的腰部以上姿势，麦克风对着她的嘴部。右下中部的面板 4 展示了角色在画面中位置稍低，背景是温暖的幕布。左下角的小面板 5 展示了麦克风和吉他琴身的特写。底部中央的小面板 6 展示了她以麦克风支架和吉他琴颈为中心的姿势。右下角的小面板 7（标注为 6）展示了一个更具活力的姿势，吉他斜向上方举起，头部附近有一个小的手绘动作标记。

背景与灯光：每个面板都展示了相同的舞台设置，背景是高大的金橙色幕布、深色舞台装置，表演者身后有明亮的三角形聚光灯，营造出光环般的背光效果。使用戏剧性的轮廓光、吉他上的光泽高光、电影般的阴影以及精致的动漫插画细节。

约束：保持构图为精致的角色参考/接触印相表，而非真实照片。保留 6 个带编号的缩略图标签以及一个大型无编号主面板。除小金数字外，请勿添加额外角色、额外文字、徽标、水印或可读标题。

templates.title: Celestial Idol Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 星穹偶像角色海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed anime idol character showcase poster featuring {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious starlight idol"}, with a dark celestial concert aesthetic and ornate trading-card layout.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, richly detailed, dark navy and warm gold palette, glossy premium illustration finish. The design should look like an idol character card collection page with decorative borders, film-strip accents, tiny stars, confetti, and elegant gothic arches in the background.

Layout: Use exactly 7 character illustrations total: 1 large central full-body portrait and 6 smaller surrounding portrait panels. The 6 smaller panels are numbered in small gold text as 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, and 06. Arrange them as two panels across the top corners, two panels in the middle left and middle right, and two panels along the lower left and lower right, framing the central figure. The central portrait is the largest, inside an ornate rounded rectangular gold frame with a crown-like decorative crest at the top and a small plaque at the bottom showing five small gold icons: star, star, crown, star, star.

Subject details: The character is a young anime idol girl with {argument name="hair color" default="very long glossy black hair"}, straight bangs, long flowing side strands, and small silver star hairpins. Her face is intentionally obscured in every panel by a soft rectangular blur, while the rest of the illustration remains sharp. She wears a white short-sleeve puff blouse with frilled neckline, black ribbon bow at the chest, black choker with white frill trim, black fingerless gloves, silver bracelets, a high-waisted dark navy pleated skirt with a galaxy sparkle gradient, white underskirt ruffles, black belt with silver ring buckle, dangling silver star chains on the hip, black thigh garters, and idol accessories. The overall outfit theme is {argument name="outfit theme" default="gothic celestial idol"}.

Panel poses: Include exactly these 6 numbered side-panel variations: 01 shows an upper-body idol pose holding a microphone near the lower right, one hand near the chest; 02 shows an upper-body pose touching the choker or collar with one hand; 03 shows a waist-up pose holding a microphone downward in one hand; 04 shows an upper-body pose with one hand near the face making a playful idol gesture; 05 shows a side/back three-quarter pose looking over the shoulder with long hair flowing dramatically; 06 shows a cheerful upper-body pose with both hands raised in small finger-heart or pointing gestures and a large microphone floating near the right side. The central portrait shows the idol standing full-body, one hand making a peace sign beside the face, skirt flared outward, confident concert-poster stance.

Background and decoration: Set all portraits inside a grand cathedral-like hall with tall arched windows glowing with warm light, dark columns, night-sky sparkles, floating confetti, lens flares, and magical star particles. The bottom center outside the portraits contains a large gold compass star emblem, laurel branches, and a curved film-strip ribbon. Add tiny gold numbering, thin ornamental borders, subtle film sprocket marks, and a polished collectible-card feel.

Visual style: High-resolution anime illustration, crisp line art, luminous highlights, glossy hair shading, dramatic rim lighting, intricate fabric folds, deep navy shadows, gold accents, magical idol atmosphere, symmetrical composition, premium poster design.

Constraints: Use exactly 7 character depictions and exactly 6 numbered side panels labeled 01 through 06. Keep all faces covered by the same soft blur effect. Do not add readable text besides the small panel numbers and decorative icons. Avoid logos, watermarks, and extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张高度精细的动漫偶像角色展示海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的星光偶像"}，采用暗黑星穹演唱会美学和华丽的集换式卡牌布局。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，细节丰富，采用深海军蓝与暖金色调，呈现光泽感的高级插画质感。设计应类似于偶像角色卡牌收集页面，带有装饰性边框、胶片条装饰、细小星光、五彩纸屑以及背景中优雅的哥特式拱门。

布局：总共使用 7 张角色插画：1 张大型中央全身肖像和 6 张较小的周围肖像面板。6 张较小的面板用金色小字标注为 01、02、03、04、05 和 06。将它们排列为顶部两侧各两个面板，中间左右各一个面板，以及底部左右各一个面板，环绕中央人物。中央肖像最大，位于一个华丽的圆角矩形金框内，顶部带有皇冠状装饰纹章，底部有一块小铭牌，显示五个金色小图标：星星、星星、皇冠、星星、星星。

主体细节：角色是一位年轻的动漫偶像女孩，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="非常长的亮黑色秀发"}，直刘海，长长的侧发丝，并佩戴银色小星星发夹。她的面部在每个面板中都被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，而插画的其他部分保持清晰。她身穿白色短袖泡泡袖衬衫，领口带有褶边，胸前系着黑色丝带蝴蝶结，佩戴带有白色褶边装饰的黑色颈圈、黑色露指手套、银色手镯，穿着高腰深海军蓝百褶裙（带有星系闪光渐变）、白色衬裙褶边、带有银色圆环扣的黑色腰带、臀部悬挂银色星形链条、黑色大腿袜带以及偶像配饰。整体服装主题为 {argument name="outfit theme" default="哥特星穹偶像"}。

面板姿势：包含以下 6 个带编号的侧面板变体：01 展示上半身偶像姿势，一只手握着麦克风靠近右下方，另一只手靠近胸前；02 展示上半身姿势，一只手触摸颈圈或衣领；03 展示腰部以上姿势，一只手向下握着麦克风；04 展示上半身姿势，一只手靠近面部做出俏皮的偶像手势；05 展示侧面/背部四分之三姿势，回眸望向肩后，长发戏剧性地飘动；06 展示欢快的上半身姿势，双手举起做出小指心或指向手势，一个大麦克风漂浮在右侧附近。中央肖像展示偶像全身站立，一只手在脸旁比出剪刀手，裙摆向外展开，呈现自信的演唱会海报姿态。

背景与装饰：将所有肖像置于宏伟的大教堂式大厅内，背景有透出暖光的拱形高窗、深色柱子、夜空闪光、漂浮的五彩纸屑、镜头光晕和魔法星尘。肖像下方的中心位置包含一个大型金色罗盘星徽章、月桂枝和弯曲的胶片条丝带。添加细小的金色编号、纤细的装饰边框、微妙的胶片齿孔标记，以及精致的收藏卡质感。

视觉风格：高分辨率动漫插画、清晰的线条艺术、明亮的高光、富有光泽的头发阴影、戏剧性的轮廓光、复杂的织物褶皱、深海军蓝阴影、金色点缀、梦幻的偶像氛围、对称构图、高级海报设计。

约束：使用 7 张角色描绘，并包含 6 个标注为 01 到 06 的带编号侧面板。所有面部保持相同的柔和模糊效果。除面板编号和装饰图标外，不要添加任何可读文字。避免使用标志、水印和多余角色。

templates.title: Cute Retro Tokyo Cartoon Cityscape

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱复古东京卡通城市景观

templates.prompt: Create a cute retro cartoon cityscape of {argument name="city name" default="Tokyo"}, in a naive children's picture-book style with ultra-simplified architecture, chunky geometric shapes, exaggerated proportions, and bold thick black outlines. Use a vertical poster composition with a bright cyan-blue halftone sky and a worn beige paper border. Make {argument name="landmark" default="Tokyo Tower"} the clear central focus: a tall red-and-white lattice tower with a smiling kawaii face on its observation deck, rosy cheeks, simple black eyes, and a small open mouth. At the upper left, add large tilted comic lettering reading {argument name="headline text" default="TOKYO"} in red-orange with black outline, and beneath it place the Japanese text 「東京」 in chunky yellow letters with black outline. Include exactly 2 large cream-colored rounded clouds, one on the left and one on the right. Surround the tower with a simplified skyline of colorful rectangular buildings in blues, pinks, yellows, and oranges. Include exactly 5 visible signboards: a red vertical sign reading 「カラオケ」, a pink vertical sign reading 「原宿」, a yellow horizontal sign reading "SHIBUYA", a red vertical sign reading 「秋葉原」, and one billboard showing a pink-haired cute character portrait. Add one additional billboard with a cute white cat face next to the SHIBUYA sign. In the foreground, show a row of rounded green trees, a blue river or canal with small white ripples, and a cream-and-green cartoon train entering from the lower right on curved tracks, also with a smiling kawaii face and rosy cheeks. Apply a vintage comic-book print texture with visible halftone dots, slightly rough ink edges, saturated colors, playful proportions, and no photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 {argument name="city name" default="东京"} 的可爱复古卡通城市景观，采用天真烂漫的儿童绘本风格，建筑极度简化，使用厚实的几何形状、夸张的比例以及粗犷的黑色轮廓线。采用竖版海报构图，背景为明亮的青蓝色网点天空，并带有磨损的米色纸张边框。将 {argument name="landmark" default="东京塔"} 作为清晰的视觉中心：一座高大的红白格纹塔，观景台上绘有微笑的卡哇伊表情、红润的脸颊、简单的黑眼睛和小巧的张开嘴。在左上方，添加醒目的倾斜漫画字体，用红橙色书写 {argument name="headline text" default="TOKYO"} 并带有黑色轮廓，下方用厚实的黄色字体配黑色轮廓标注日文「東京」。包含 2 朵巨大的奶油色圆形云朵，左右各一。塔的周围环绕着简化的天际线，由蓝色、粉色、黄色和橙色的矩形建筑组成。包含 5 个清晰可见的招牌：一个写有「カラオケ」的红色竖招牌，一个写有「原宿」的粉色竖招牌，一个写有 "SHIBUYA" 的黄色横招牌，一个写有「秋葉原」的红色竖招牌，以及一个展示粉色头发可爱角色肖像的广告牌。在 SHIBUYA 招牌旁边额外添加一个带有可爱白猫脸的广告牌。前景展示一排圆润的绿树、一条带有白色小波纹的蓝色河流或运河，以及一列从右下角弯曲轨道驶入的奶油配绿色卡通火车，火车同样带有微笑的卡哇伊表情和红润脸颊。应用带有可见网点、略显粗糙的墨迹边缘、饱和色彩、趣味比例的复古漫画印刷质感，且不包含任何写实元素。

templates.prompt: Create a vertical dark Eastern fantasy cinematic movie poster for {argument name="character name" default="Zhao Ling'er"} from Chinese paladin mythology, titled around the “Demon Locking Tower fateful night.” The central figure is a solemn young Chinese goddess-like woman standing waist-deep in black reflective water inside a ruined vertical abyss tower. Her face should be softly obscured or left featureless, but her posture is calm, fatalistic, and divine. She wears a faded jade-cyan translucent Hanfu-style ceremonial dress with wet gauze layers, flowing ribbons, beaded chains, silver ornaments, a circular pendant at the waist, wrist jewelry, and twin-bun black hair with long blue-green veils. One hand reaches down to touch the water, creating a glowing circular ripple spell. Surround her with ancient stone walls, huge hanging iron chains, broken wooden platforms, drifting talisman papers, circular Taoist seals, faint golden Chinese inscriptions, and a cold moonbeam falling from a broken opening high above. Add a shadowy demon face with red eyes half-hidden in the right background. The water surface should contain glowing arcane diagrams, sigils, dragon-scale textures, and submerged calligraphy. Use low-saturation cold gray-blue and faded jade tones, damp moonlight, mist, rain-wet stone, heavy shadows, and subtle gold accents. Make it look like a 3A game CG film poster, ultra-detailed, realistic, atmospheric, oppressive, quiet, sacred, ominous, with a sense of destiny and death premonition. Include exactly three main text blocks: large vertical Chinese title on the left reading {argument name="main title" default="赵灵儿"} with small English romanization “ZHAO LINGER” beneath it; a smaller vertical subtitle near the left reading {argument name="subtitle" default="锁妖塔 女娲后裔·宿命之夜"}; and a vertical poetic quote on the right reading {argument name="right quote" default="若宿命终将吞没一切，愿仍有人记得，她曾在月光下安静站立。"}. Avoid modern fashion photography, influencer xianxia styling, anime illustration, bright colors, clean studio lighting, cute expressions, or plastic-looking costumes.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版暗黑东方奇幻电影海报，主角为中国仙侠神话中的 {argument name="character name" default="赵灵儿"}，主题围绕“锁妖塔宿命之夜”。画面中心是一位神情庄重的年轻中国女神形象，她站在废墟般的垂直深渊塔内，腰部以下浸没在黑色的倒影水中。她的面部应略显模糊或不着五官，但姿态沉静、宿命且神圣。她身着褪色的青玉色半透明汉服风格礼服，带有湿润的纱质层叠、飘逸的丝带、珠链、银饰、腰间圆形挂饰、腕饰，以及梳着双环髻的黑发，垂下长长的蓝绿色面纱。一只手向下触碰水面，激起发光的圆形涟漪法阵。周围环绕着古老的石墙、巨大的悬挂铁链、破碎的木质平台、漂浮的符纸、圆形道教封印、隐约的金色汉字铭文，以及从上方破口处洒下的清冷月光。在右侧背景中加入一张半隐于阴影中、双眼泛红的恶魔面孔。水面应包含发光的奥术图腾、符印、龙鳞纹理和水下的书法。使用低饱和度的冷灰蓝色和褪色的玉色调，营造潮湿的月光、薄雾、雨湿的岩石、浓重的阴影和微妙的金色点缀。使其看起来像 3A 游戏 CG 电影海报，超精细、写实、氛围感强、压抑、静谧、神圣且充满不祥之兆，带有宿命感和死亡预兆。包含三个主要文本块：左侧为大型竖排中文标题 {argument name="main title" default="赵灵儿"}，下方配有小型英文拼音“ZHAO LINGER”；左侧附近为较小的竖排副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="锁妖塔 女娲后裔·宿命之夜"}；右侧为竖排诗意引言 {argument name="right quote" default="若宿命终将吞没一切，愿仍有人记得，她曾在月光下安静站立。"}。避免现代时尚摄影、网红仙侠风格、动漫插画、鲜艳色彩、干净的影棚灯光、可爱的表情或塑料质感的服装。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic historical biography poster for {argument name="subject figure" default="Napoleon Bonaparte"}, presented as an imperial military ruler infographic with a cinematic equestrian portrait and annotated life timeline.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, dark antique parchment and battlefield-map background, high-detail painterly realism mixed with luxury editorial infographic design. Use a black, charcoal, sepia, and weathered gold palette with glowing gold lines, dust, smoke, scratches, old-map texture, and archival manuscript fragments.

Main subject: Center the ruler on a rearing white horse, facing forward in a heroic battlefield pose. The figure wears a black bicorne hat, ornate dark navy and red imperial military uniform, gold epaulettes, medals, sash, white trousers, tall black riding boots, and a flowing crimson cape. One arm thrusts a long silver sword diagonally toward the lower left foreground, creating strong perspective. The horse has windswept mane, detailed leather-and-gold bridle, decorative chest medallion, raised front leg, and dramatic motion dust beneath it.

Left identity panel: Place a large imperial monogram near the upper left: a gold crowned letter “N” inside a laurel wreath. Below it, set the main name in large elegant serif gold capitals: {argument name="headline name" default="NAPOLEON BONAPARTE"}. Under the name add “1769–1821”, then a divider ornament, then “EMPEROR OF THE FRENCH”. Add a smaller motto line: “STRATEGY • EMPIRE” and “REFORM • CONQUEST”.

Timeline cards: Add exactly 8 translucent archival event cards around the central portrait, each with thin glowing gold borders, small monochrome historical scene artwork, a large two-digit event number, year, title, and short description. Use these exact 8 cards:
1. “01 1769 — Birth in Corsica — Born in Ajaccio, Corsica.” Place lower left.
2. “02 1796 — Italian Campaign — Early victories bring military fame.” Place upper left.
3. “03 1799 — Coup of 18 Brumaire — Seizes power and reshapes France.” Place left middle-lower.
4. “04 1804 — Emperor of the French — Crowned emperor, beginning a new imperial era.” Place lower left-center.
5. “05 1805 — Austerlitz Victory — Strategic masterpiece against major rivals.” Place upper right.
6. “06 1806 — Napoleonic Code and Reforms — Expands legal, civil, and administrative reforms.” Place right middle-upper.
7. “07 1812 — Russian Campaign — Ambition meets a harsh turning point.” Place right middle-lower.
8. “08 1815 — Waterloo and Legacy — Final defeat, enduring global legacy.” Place lower right.

Bottom timeline: Across the bottom edge, create a horizontal gold timeline with exactly 8 circular numbered markers labeled 01 through 08. Under each marker repeat the year and short title in small serif text: 1769 Birth in Corsica; 1796 Italian Campaign; 1799 Coup of 18 Brumaire; 1804 Emperor of the French; 1805 Austerlitz Victory; 1806 Napoleonic Code and Reforms; 1812 Russian Campaign; 1815 Waterloo and Legacy.

Additional details: Add faint dotted route lines and glowing map connections behind the cards, battlefield silhouettes, old documents, handwritten notes, and a red wax seal with an imperial eagle near the lower right. Keep all typography readable, ornate, and historically themed. Make the composition grand, symmetrical but dynamic, with the horse and sword breaking the layout for depth. No modern UI, no watermark, no extra event cards, no misspelled labels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="subject figure" default="拿破仑·波拿巴"} 创建一张极具戏剧性的历史传记海报，呈现为帝国军事统治者的信息图，配有电影质感的骑马肖像和带注释的人生时间轴。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，深色古董羊皮纸和战场地图背景，高细节绘画写实风格与奢华编辑信息图设计相结合。使用黑色、炭灰色、棕褐色和风化金色调，配以发光的金线、灰尘、烟雾、划痕、旧地图纹理和档案手稿碎片。

主体：将统治者置于画面中心，骑着一匹前蹄腾空的白马，面向前方，呈现英雄般的战场姿态。人物头戴黑色双角帽，身穿华丽的深海军蓝与红色帝国军服，配有金色肩章、勋章、饰带、白色长裤、高筒黑马靴，以及飘逸的深红色披风。一只手臂斜向左下方挥舞着长长的银剑，营造出强烈的透视感。马匹鬃毛随风飘动，配有精致的皮革与金色马勒、装饰性胸章，前腿抬起，马蹄下有戏剧性的动态尘土。

左侧身份面板：在左上方放置一个大型帝国字母组合：月桂花环内镶嵌着金色的皇冠字母“N”。下方以优雅的大号衬线体金色大写字母设置主标题：{argument name="headline name" default="NAPOLEON BONAPARTE"}。在名字下方添加“1769–1821”，接着是一个装饰性分隔符，然后是“EMPEROR OF THE FRENCH”（法兰西皇帝）。添加一行较小的座右铭：“STRATEGY • EMPIRE”（战略 • 帝国）和“REFORM • CONQUEST”（改革 • 征服）。

时间轴卡片：在中心肖像周围添加 8 张半透明的档案事件卡片，每张卡片都有细细的发光金边、小型单色历史场景插图、大号两位数事件编号、年份、标题和简短描述。请使用以下 8 张卡片：
1. “01 1769 — 科西嘉出生 — 出生于科西嘉岛阿雅克肖。” 放置于左下方。
2. “02 1796 — 意大利战役 — 早期胜利带来军事声望。” 放置于左上方。
3. “03 1799 — 雾月政变 — 夺取权力并重塑法国。” 放置于左侧中下方。
4. “04 1804 — 法兰西皇帝 — 加冕称帝，开启新的帝国时代。” 放置于左下中心。
5. “05 1805 — 奥斯特里茨大捷 — 针对主要对手的战略杰作。” 放置于右上方。
6. “06 1806 — 拿破仑法典与改革 — 扩展法律、民事和行政改革。” 放置于右侧中上方。
7. “07 1812 — 俄国战役 — 野心遭遇严酷的转折点。” 放置于右侧中下方。
8. “08 1815 — 滑铁卢与遗产 — 最终战败，留下持久的全球遗产。” 放置于右下方。

底部时间轴：在底部边缘，创建一条水平的金色时间轴，带有 8 个圆形的编号标记，从 01 到 08。在每个标记下方用小型衬线字体重复年份和简短标题：1769 科西嘉出生；1796 意大利战役；1799 雾月政变；1804 法兰西皇帝；1805 奥斯特里茨大捷；1806 拿破仑法典与改革；1812 俄国战役；1815 滑铁卢与遗产。

其他细节：在卡片后方添加淡淡的虚线路线和发光的地图连接线、战场剪影、旧文档、手写笔记，并在右下方添加一个带有帝国鹰徽的红色火漆印章。保持所有排版清晰、华丽且具有历史主题感。构图要宏大、对称且充满动感，马匹和剑要打破布局以增加深度。不要包含现代 UI、水印、多余的事件卡片或拼写错误的标签。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic cinematic historical biography poster for {argument name="subject figure" default="Julius Caesar"}, presenting him as a Roman general, statesman, and dictator in an epic ancient-war infographic style.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, dark sepia and black palette with antique gold typography, parchment textures, faint Roman maps, diagrams, constellations, and architectural sketches in the background. High-contrast lighting, smoky battlefield atmosphere, gritty dust, embers, and ornate metallic highlights.

Main subject: Center composition shows Julius Caesar riding a powerful black warhorse rearing forward. He wears elaborate Roman armor with gold details, leather skirt armor, bronze greaves, red cloak flowing behind him, and a laurel wreath. His right arm thrusts a short Roman sword toward the viewer in strong foreshortening. The horse has ornate gold-trimmed tack, medallions, leather straps, and dramatic glossy highlights. Keep the rider’s face intentionally obscured by a plain soft brown rectangular mask with no facial features. Behind him are Roman soldiers, standards, banners, and battlefield silhouettes.

Primary text: Large antique serif gold title on the left reads “{argument name="headline text" default="JULIUS CAESAR"}”. Under it place “100 BC – 44 BC”, then “ROMAN GENERAL · STATESMAN · DICTATOR”, then “STRATEGY · CONQUEST · REFORM · STATECRAFT”. Add a gold Roman eagle-and-laurel emblem below the text.

Event cards: Include exactly 8 glowing parchment-style historical event cards, numbered 01 through 08, each with a small sepia illustration and gold border. Arrange them around the central rider: two near the top, three down the right side, and three down the left/lower-left side. The 8 cards must read:
01 — “100 BC” — “Birth in Rome” — “Born into the Julii family in Rome.”
02 — “60 BC” — “First Triumvirate” — “Alliance with Pompey and Crassus reshapes Roman politics.”
03 — “58–50 BC” — “Gallic Wars” — “Expands Roman power through major campaigns in Gaul.”
04 — “49 BC” — “Crossing the Rubicon” — “Defies the Senate and begins civil war.”
05 — “48 BC” — “Victory at Pharsalus” — “Defeats Pompey and secures supremacy.”
06 — “46 BC” — “Dictator of Rome” — “Consolidates power and restores order.”
07 — “46–44 BC” — “Reforms and Calendar” — “Advances legal, civic, and calendar reforms.”
08 — “44 BC” — “Ides of March and Legacy” — “Assassinated, but his legacy transforms history.”

Bottom timeline: Add exactly 8 gold dots connected by a thin horizontal gold line along the bottom edge. Label them, from left to right: “100 BC Birth in Rome”, “60 BC First Triumvirate”, “58–50 BC Gallic Wars”, “49 BC Crossing the Rubicon”, “48 BC Victory at Pharsalus”, “46 BC Dictator of Rome”, “46–44 BC Reforms and Calendar”, “44 BC Ides of March and Legacy”.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed digital painting, epic historical fantasy realism, museum-quality military portrait, ornate Roman imperial design, dramatic chiaroscuro, gilded serif typography, aged manuscript overlays, cinematic poster lighting, sharp central figure, slightly hazy background. Use {argument name="accent color" default="antique gold"} for borders, text, timeline, and decorative symbols.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and correctly spelled. Use exactly 8 event cards and exactly 8 timeline points. Do not add modern objects, logos, watermarks, or extra people in the foreground beyond the mounted commander and background army. Maintain a dark ancient Roman atmosphere with no bright modern colors.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="subject figure" default="尤利乌斯 · 凯撒"} 创作一张极具戏剧性的电影质感历史传记海报，以史诗般的古代战争信息图风格，展现他作为罗马将军、政治家和独裁者的形象。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，采用深棕褐色与黑色调，搭配古金色排版、羊皮纸纹理，背景融入模糊的罗马地图、图表、星座和建筑草图。高对比度光影，烟雾缭绕的战场氛围，粗砺的尘土、余烬以及华丽的金属高光。

主体：中心构图展示了尤利乌斯 · 凯撒骑着一匹强壮的黑色战马向前跃起。他身穿带有金色细节的精致罗马盔甲、皮革裙甲、青铜护胫，身后飘扬着红色斗篷，头戴月桂花环。他的右臂以强烈的透视感将一把罗马短剑指向观众。马匹配有华丽的镶金马具、勋章、皮带，并带有戏剧性的光泽高光。骑手的面部刻意用一个无五官的素色浅棕色矩形遮盖。他身后是罗马士兵、旗帜、横幅和战场剪影。

主要文字：左侧为巨大的古董衬线体金色标题，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="JULIUS CAESAR"}”。下方依次排列“100 BC – 44 BC”、“ROMAN GENERAL · STATESMAN · DICTATOR”（罗马将军 · 政治家 · 独裁者）以及“STRATEGY · CONQUEST · REFORM · STATECRAFT”（战略 · 征服 · 改革 · 治国）。在文字下方添加一个金色的罗马鹰与月桂徽章。

事件卡片：包含 8 张发光的羊皮纸风格历史事件卡片，编号从 01 到 08，每张卡片配有小幅棕褐色插图和金色边框。将它们环绕在中心骑手周围：顶部两张，右侧三张，左侧/左下侧三张。8 张卡片内容如下：
01 — “100 BC” — “出生于罗马” — “出生于罗马尤利乌斯家族。”
02 — “60 BC” — “前三头同盟” — “与庞培和克拉苏结盟，重塑罗马政治。”
03 — “58–50 BC” — “高卢战争” — “通过在高卢的主要战役扩张罗马势力。”
04 — “49 BC” — “跨越卢比孔河” — “蔑视元老院，开启内战。”
05 — “48 BC” — “法萨卢斯战役胜利” — “击败庞培，确立统治地位。”
06 — “46 BC” — “罗马独裁官” — “巩固权力，恢复秩序。”
07 — “46–44 BC” — “改革与历法” — “推进法律、公民及历法改革。”
08 — “44 BC” — “三月十五日与遗产” — “遇刺身亡，但其遗产改变了历史。”

底部时间轴：在底部边缘添加 8 个由细横线连接的金色圆点。从左至右标注：“100 BC 出生于罗马”、“60 BC 前三头同盟”、“58–50 BC 高卢战争”、“49 BC 跨越卢比孔河”、“48 BC 法萨卢斯战役胜利”、“46 BC 罗马独裁官”、“46–44 BC 改革与历法”、“44 BC 三月十五日与遗产”。

视觉风格：超精细数字绘画，史诗历史奇幻写实主义，博物馆级军事肖像，华丽的罗马帝国设计，戏剧性的明暗对照法，镀金衬线排版，陈旧手稿叠加效果，电影海报光影，中心人物清晰，背景略显朦胧。边框、文字、时间轴和装饰符号使用 {argument name="accent color" default="古金色"}。

限制：确保所有文字清晰且拼写正确。使用 8 张事件卡片和 8 个时间轴点。除骑马指挥官和背景军队外，前景中不得添加现代物品、标志、水印或额外人物。保持深沉的古罗马氛围，禁止使用明亮的现代色彩。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a square fashion sale poster for a women's apparel campaign, elegant and minimalist, featuring {argument name="main title" default="BIG SALE"} and {argument name="subtitle" default="WOMEN'S SPECIAL SELECTION"}.

Canvas: 1:1 square social media ad, 768x768 style composition, warm neutral palette with cream concrete, taupe stone, and medium brown wood. Premium editorial fashion look, realistic photography with subtle graphic overlay.

Layout: Left half is the typography area, right half and lower area contain the fashion models. Place the large main title on the upper-left in burnt orange, all caps, modern geometric sans-serif, split over two lines as “BIG” above “SALE”. Below it place the subtitle in smaller black uppercase letters. Below that add a Japanese copy line: {argument name="Japanese tagline" default="夏まで着回せる、厳選アイテム"}. In the lower-left place a thin gold outlined discount box reading “MAX” above “60%OFF”, with “60” large, and a smaller gold bordered label below reading {argument name="limited offer text" default="数量限定・期間限定"}. At the bottom center place the brand text {argument name="brand name" default="EHOU'S WARDROBE"} in spaced white uppercase letters.

Subjects: Include exactly 5 adult women in muted natural fashion, arranged like an editorial group shot. 1) Top-right standing woman in a long olive-beige trench coat over a white outfit, posed against a vertical wooden wall panel. 2) Center-right standing woman wearing a blue denim jacket over a white shirt and high-waisted black wide-leg trousers, one hand in pocket. 3) Far-right seated woman in an oversized ivory sweater, sitting on a pale cube block and turned slightly sideways. 4) Lower-left seated woman wearing a mustard yellow sleeveless maxi dress, sitting on a low stone block with sandals and a woven brown bag. 5) Lower-center seated/back-facing woman in a beige knit top and cream pants with a light beige backpack, sitting on a block facing away in three-quarter view. Faces should be softly anonymized or not emphasized; focus on clothing and silhouettes.

Background and graphic details: Use a refined showroom-like setting with off-white plaster/concrete wall on the left, wooden panel on the right, and pale stone blocks as seating platforms. Add thin black geometric line rectangles in the corners and background, including top-left, top-center/right, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right, as decorative architectural outlines. Lighting is soft, diffused, high-end catalog photography, with gentle shadows and no harsh contrast.

Constraints: Keep all visible text crisp and correctly spelled, especially Japanese text. Use exactly 5 women and exactly these main text groups: main title, subtitle, Japanese tagline, discount box, limited-offer label, and bottom brand name. Do not add extra logos, watermarks, prices, QR codes, or unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为女性服装活动创建一个方形时尚促销海报，风格优雅极简，包含 {argument name="main title" default="BIG SALE"} 和 {argument name="subtitle" default="WOMEN'S SPECIAL SELECTION"}。

画布：1:1 方形社交媒体广告，768x768 构图，采用奶油色混凝土、灰褐色石材和中棕色木材的暖色调中性配色。高端编辑时尚感，写实摄影风格，带有微妙的图形叠加。

布局：左半部分为排版区域，右半部分及下方区域为时尚模特。将巨大的主标题置于左上角，使用焦橙色、全大写、现代几何无衬线字体，分为两行，上方为“BIG”，下方为“SALE”。在其下方放置较小的黑色大写副标题。再下方添加一行日文文案：{argument name="Japanese tagline" default="夏まで着回せる、厳選アイテム"}。在左下方放置一个细金边框的折扣框，上方为“MAX”，下方为“60%OFF”，其中“60”字号较大，下方配有一个较小的金色边框标签，内容为 {argument name="limited offer text" default="数量限定・期間限定"}。在底部中心放置品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="EHOU'S WARDROBE"}，使用间距较大的白色大写字母。

主体：包含 5 位身着柔和自然风时尚服饰的成年女性，排列如同编辑组照。1) 右上方站立的女性，身穿橄榄米色长款风衣，内搭白色套装，背靠垂直木质墙板。2) 右侧中心站立的女性，身穿蓝色牛仔夹克，内搭白衬衫，下穿高腰黑色阔腿裤，单手插兜。3) 最右侧坐着的女性，身穿超大款象牙白毛衣，坐在浅色立方体块上，身体略微侧转。4) 左下方坐着的女性，身穿芥末黄无袖长裙，坐在低矮的石块上，搭配凉鞋和棕色编织包。5) 下方中心坐着/背对的女性，身穿米色针织上衣和奶油色长裤，背着浅米色背包，坐在块状物上，呈四分之三背影视角。面部应进行柔化处理或不作强调；重点展示服装和轮廓。

背景与图形细节：使用精致的展厅式场景，左侧为米白色石膏/混凝土墙，右侧为木质板材，并以浅色石块作为座位平台。在角落和背景中添加细黑色的几何线条矩形，包括左上、中上/右、右上、左下和右下，作为装饰性建筑轮廓。光线柔和、漫射，呈现高端目录摄影质感，带有柔和的阴影，无强烈对比。

约束：确保所有可见文字清晰且拼写正确，尤其是日文文本。使用 5 位女性模特，并严格包含以下主要文本组：主标题、副标题、日文标语、折扣框、限时标签以及底部品牌名称。请勿添加额外的徽标、水印、价格、二维码或无关文本。

templates.title: Dog Programmer Manga Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 程序员狗狗漫画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a black-and-white manga comic page about a dog frantically programming on a desktop computer, then causing a system error.

Canvas: Vertical comic page in grayscale, traditional manga ink-and-screentone style, with heavy panel borders and detailed hatching. Use exactly 2 horizontal panels stacked vertically, separated by a thick white gutter.

Layout: Panel 1 occupies the top half. Panel 2 occupies the bottom half. Both panels show the same home office desk from a slightly angled side view: a large desktop monitor on the left, keyboard in the foreground, mouse and mug on the desk, a plant and framed wall art in the background.

Panel 1: A fluffy medium-sized dog with floppy ears, white muzzle and chest, darker ears and patches, sits at the desk and types furiously with both front paws on the keyboard. The dog’s head area is largely covered by a plain vertical gray rectangle censor block in the center of the panel, obscuring most of the face while leaving ears, paws, body, and tail visible. The monitor displays mixed programming code and gibberish symbols, including C-like code, JavaScript-like lines, Python-like lines, binary digits, and random characters. Add dramatic manga speed lines radiating from the monitor and typing action. Include exactly 7 visible Japanese typing sound effects reading 「カタ」: one near the upper left of the dog/monitor area, one near the top center-right, one near the lower monitor/keyboard area, one near the left keyboard edge, and three clustered around the dog’s lower right body and tail. Add one vertical cloud-shaped thought bubble on the right with Japanese text: 「プログラマーだ！」.

Panel 2: The same dog is startled and panicking, leaning back from the keyboard with wide eyes, open mouth, raised paws, a sweat drop on the cheek, and a small shock burst near the head. The monitor now shows a dark system error screen with a warning triangle icon and Japanese text. Use exactly this monitor text: 「システムエラー」, 「問題が発生したため、PCを再起動する必要があります。」, 「エラーコード: 0xC000021A」, 「再起動しています...」, plus a circular loading spinner made of small dots. Add one vertical speech bubble on the right with Japanese text: 「あ、壊れた…」.

Visual style: High-detail monochrome manga, expressive animal character acting like a human, dense cross-hatching, screentone shading, strong motion lines, bold hand-lettered Japanese sound effects, slightly comedic tone, clean readable text on the monitor and bubbles.

Customizable subject: The dog should be {argument name="animal character" default="a fluffy floppy-eared dog"}. The comic’s first thought bubble should say {argument name="first bubble text" default="プログラマーだ！"}. The second speech bubble should say {argument name="second bubble text" default="あ、壊れた…"}. The monitor error headline should be {argument name="error headline" default="システムエラー"}. The error code should be {argument name="error code" default="0xC000021A"}.

Constraints: Keep the image black and white only, preserve the two-panel layout, use exactly 2 speech/thought bubbles total, exactly 7 typing sound effects in the top panel, no extra panels, no color, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页黑白漫画，内容为一只狗狗在台式电脑前疯狂编程，随后导致系统报错。

画布：垂直漫画页，灰度显示，采用传统的漫画墨线与网点纸风格，具有厚重的分镜边框和细致的排线。使用上下排列的 2 个横向分镜，中间由宽大的白色间隙隔开。

布局：第 1 格占据上半部分，第 2 格占据下半部分。两个分镜均展示同一个家庭办公室书桌的侧斜视角：左侧是一台大型台式显示器，前景是键盘，桌上有鼠标和马克杯，背景有盆栽和墙上的装饰画。

第 1 格：一只毛茸茸的中型犬，长着垂耳，口鼻部和胸部为白色，耳朵和身体有深色斑块。它坐在书桌前，用两只前爪在键盘上疯狂敲击。狗狗头部区域被一个位于分镜中心的纯灰色垂直长方形遮挡，遮住了大部分脸部，但露出了耳朵、爪子、身体和尾巴。显示器上显示着混合的编程代码和乱码，包括类 C 语言、类 JavaScript 代码、类 Python 代码、二进制数字和随机字符。添加从显示器和打字动作中放射出的戏剧性漫画速度线。包含 7 个清晰可见的日语打字拟声词「カタ」：一个在狗狗/显示器区域左上方，一个在顶部中右侧，一个在显示器/键盘下方，一个在键盘左侧边缘，三个聚集在狗狗右下身和尾巴周围。在右侧添加一个垂直云朵状气泡，内含日语文字：「プログラマーだ！」

第 2 格：同一只狗狗表现出惊慌失措的样子，向后仰身离开键盘，双眼圆睁，张大嘴巴，爪子抬起，脸颊上有汗滴，头部附近有一个小型的惊吓爆发特效。显示器现在显示一个深色的系统错误界面，带有一个警告三角形图标和日语文字。显示器文字必须严格使用： 「システムエラー」, 「問題が発生したため、PCを再起動する必要があります。」, 「エラーコード: 0xC000021A」, 「再起動しています...」，以及一个由小圆点组成的圆形加载转圈。在右侧添加一个垂直对话气泡，内含日语文字：「あ、壊れた…」。

视觉风格：高细节黑白漫画，拟人化的动物角色，密集的交叉排线，网点纸阴影，强烈的动感线条，醒目的手写体日语拟声词，略带喜剧色彩，显示器和气泡中的文字清晰易读。

可自定义主题：狗狗角色应为 {argument name="animal character" default="一只毛茸茸的垂耳狗"}。漫画的第一个气泡应显示 {argument name="first bubble text" default="プログラマーだ！"}。第二个气泡应显示 {argument name="second bubble text" default="あ、壊れた…"}。显示器错误标题应为 {argument name="error headline" default="システムエラー"}。错误代码应为 {argument name="error code" default="0xC000021A"}。

约束：图像必须仅为黑白，保持两格布局，总共仅使用 2 个对话/思考气泡，第一格中必须有且仅有 7 个打字拟声词，不得增加额外分镜，不得使用彩色，不得添加水印。

templates.title: Guilty Dog Manga Comic

titleLocalized.zh: “闯祸小狗”漫画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a black-and-white manga-style two-panel comic about a cute guilty dog and a broken desktop computer, using expressive screentone shading, clean ink outlines, dramatic reaction marks, and Japanese speech bubbles.

Canvas: Vertical comic page, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, with a thick black outer border and one horizontal divider splitting the page into exactly 2 stacked panels.

Panel 1: Show a home office desk scene in grayscale. On the left side of the desk are exactly 4 visible computer-related items: a cracked smoking monitor with a shattered screen, an open desktop PC tower with exposed internal parts, a keyboard in the foreground, and a wired mouse near the center. Add scattered debris, broken fragments, loose cables, small sparks, and dark smoke rising from both the cracked monitor and the damaged tower. In the center foreground sits a small cute puppy, a round-faced mixed-breed dog with floppy ears, large glossy eyes, a white muzzle and chest, darker patches on the ears and body, a collar with a small round tag, and a terrified guilty expression with sweat drops. In the right background, a young woman enters through a doorway, surprised; her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur. She has long wavy hair, wears a plain long-sleeve top, slim jeans, and slippers. Add a bookshelf, framed picture, potted plant, chair edge, doorframe, and simple room details in the background. Include exactly 1 speech bubble in this panel, coming from the woman, with vertical Japanese text: {argument name="first speech bubble text" default="あ、あ…"}.

Panel 2: Show the same puppy now smiling brightly and posing innocently on the desk, turned slightly backward with one paw reaching behind its body as if hiding or covering the damaged computer tower. The dog should look adorable, playful, and suspiciously pleased, with sparkling effects beside its face. The broken desktop tower is behind the dog on the right, still smoking, with exposed components and a dangling cable. The desk includes exactly 3 visible desk items: keyboard, wired mouse, and a mug holding pencils. Background includes a shelf with books, a framed wall picture, a potted plant, and soft indoor room shading. Include exactly 1 speech bubble in this panel, on the left, with bold vertical Japanese text: {argument name="second speech bubble text" default="何でもない！"}.

Subject details: The dog is {argument name="dog breed or type" default="a cute small mixed-breed puppy"}, with {argument name="dog markings" default="white fur with gray patches, floppy ears, and a white blaze down the face"}. The woman is {argument name="woman appearance" default="a young woman with long wavy hair, casual sweater, jeans, slippers, and a blurred face"}.

Visual style: Monochrome Japanese manga illustration, soft pencil-like texture, detailed linework, expressive character acting, dramatic smoke and sparks, cute comedic tone, high contrast but not overly dark, realistic home office perspective mixed with exaggerated manga emotions.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 panels, exactly 2 speech bubbles total, exactly 1 dog, exactly 1 woman, and exactly 1 broken desktop computer setup. Keep all text in Japanese as specified, avoid extra captions, avoid color, avoid watermark or logo.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一幅黑白漫画风格的双格漫画，内容关于一只可爱但闯了祸的狗狗和一台损坏的台式电脑，使用富有表现力的网点纸阴影、干净的墨线轮廓、戏剧性的反应符号以及日文对话气泡。

画布：竖版漫画页面，比例约为 2:3，带有粗黑外边框，中间有一条水平分割线，将页面精确分为上下 2 格。

第 1 格：展示灰度色调的家庭办公桌场景。桌子左侧有 4 件清晰可见的电脑相关物品：一台冒烟且屏幕破碎的显示器、一台内部零件外露的台式机箱、前景中的键盘以及中心附近的有线鼠标。添加散落的碎片、破损的零件、松散的电缆、小火花，以及从破碎显示器和受损机箱中升起的深色烟雾。前景中央坐着一只可爱的小狗，它是一只圆脸混种犬，有着下垂的耳朵、又大又亮的眼睛、白色的口鼻部和胸部、耳朵和身体上有深色斑块、戴着带有小圆牌的项圈，表情惊恐且愧疚，伴有汗滴。右侧背景中，一名年轻女性走进门口，表情惊讶；她的脸被刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理。她留着长波浪卷发，穿着简单的长袖上衣、修身牛仔裤和拖鞋。背景中添加书架、相框、盆栽、椅子边缘、门框和简单的房间细节。本格包含 1 个对话气泡，来自该女性，内含竖排日文：{argument name="first speech bubble text" default="あ、あ…"}。

第 2 格：展示同一只小狗，此时它正对着镜头灿烂地微笑，在桌上摆出无辜的姿势，身体微微向后转，一只爪子伸到身后，仿佛在遮挡或掩盖损坏的台式机箱。狗狗看起来既可爱又顽皮，带着一丝可疑的得意，脸旁有闪光效果。损坏的台式机箱位于狗狗右后方，仍在冒烟，零件外露且电缆悬垂。桌上包含 3 件清晰可见的物品：键盘、有线鼠标和装有铅笔的马克杯。背景包括书架、墙上相框、盆栽和柔和的室内阴影。本格左侧包含 1 个对话气泡，内含加粗的竖排日文：{argument name="second speech bubble text" default="何でもない！"}。

主体细节：狗狗是 {argument name="dog breed or type" default="一只可爱的小型混种幼犬"}，有着 {argument name="dog markings" default="白色的毛发带有灰色斑块，下垂的耳朵，面部有白色条纹"}。女性是 {argument name="woman appearance" default="一位留着长波浪卷发、穿着休闲毛衣、牛仔裤、拖鞋且面部模糊的年轻女性"}。

视觉风格：单色日式漫画插画，柔和的铅笔质感，细腻的线条，富有表现力的人物动作，戏剧性的烟雾和火花，可爱的喜剧基调，高对比度但不至于过暗，真实的家庭办公视角与夸张的漫画情绪相结合。

约束条件：使用精确的 2 个分格，总共 2 个对话气泡，1 只狗，1 位女性，以及 1 套损坏的台式电脑设备。所有文本保持为指定的日文，避免额外的标题，避免彩色，避免水印或 Logo。

templates.title: Four-Panel Anime Book Recommendations

titleLocalized.zh: 四格动漫风格书籍推荐

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 2×2 anime-style recommendation collage set inside a cozy bookstore or library, showing four different young women holding books in front of wooden bookshelves. The image should feel like a Japanese social-media book recommendation post, warm, gentle, realistic in small details, and not every shelf should be completely packed with books; leave some natural gaps and varied book heights.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 composition, approximately 768×1024. Divide the canvas into exactly 4 equal panels with thin white gutters: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.

Visual style: Soft detailed Japanese anime illustration, warm indoor lighting, muted pastel clothing, realistic wooden shelves, printed book spines with Japanese-style vertical titles, cozy quiet atmosphere, delicate linework, subtle shading, high-quality magazine-like finish. Faces should be intentionally obscured by soft square blur blocks, while hair, clothes, hands, books, and background remain detailed.

Layout and subjects: Include exactly 4 girls and exactly 4 featured recommendation books.
1. Top-left panel: A gentle girl with short black hair in low side buns, wearing a lavender cardigan over a pale floral dress, holding a travel/scenery book with a Mount Fuji and lake cover. Background includes a window with curtains on the far left and bookshelves behind her. Caption card text: “紫苑リンのおすすめ” / “『美しい日本の風景』” / “美しい景色を見ると、心が癒されます。”
2. Top-right panel: A girl with very long straight black hair and pink ribbon bows, wearing a pink cardigan, holding a fashion/cute-style book with a full-body girl illustration on the cover. Caption card text: “紫苑レイのおすすめ” / “『大人かわいいの作り方』” / “おしゃれは、自分をもっと好きになる魔法。”
3. Bottom-left panel: A short-haired girl with messy black bob hair, wearing a white hoodie, holding a dark science-fiction or adventure novel with a starry space-like cover. She points toward the book with one finger. Caption card text: “深絆アキラのおすすめ” / “『銀河英雄伝説 1』” / “壮大な物語に、いつもワクワクします！”
4. Bottom-right panel: A calm girl with long black hair loosely tied back, wearing a gray oversized sweater, resting her cheek on one hand while holding a beige lifestyle book. Add a small teacup on the table near the lower left of this panel. Caption card text: “黒波凪紗のおすすめ” / “『暮らしを整える』” / “シンプルな暮らしが、いちばん心地いい。”

Caption cards: Each panel has one rounded white caption card near the bottom, with a thin colored border matching the character mood: lavender for top-left, soft red/pink for top-right or bottom-left where appropriate, gray for bottom-right. Use centered Japanese text, bold title line, clean readable typography.

Bookshelf details: Fill the shelves with many books, but keep them natural and not uniformly packed. Include visible book spines with varied neutral, pastel, and muted colors; some spines may contain Japanese vertical text or simple series numbers. Avoid chaotic clutter.

Customizable details: The four featured book titles may be changed to {argument name="featured book titles" default="『美しい日本の風景』, 『大人かわいいの作り方』, 『銀河英雄伝説 1』, 『暮らしを整える』"}; the four recommender names may be changed to {argument name="recommender names" default="紫苑リン, 紫苑レイ, 深絆アキラ, 黒波凪紗"}; the overall setting may be changed to {argument name="setting" default="cozy bookstore or library with wooden bookshelves"}; the illustration style may be changed to {argument name="illustration style" default="soft detailed Japanese anime illustration"}; the face treatment may be changed to {argument name="face treatment" default="soft square blur blocks obscuring each face"}.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 panels, exactly 4 characters, exactly 4 featured books, and exactly 4 bottom caption cards. Keep the text legible, preserve the Japanese caption wording, avoid extra logos or watermarks, and maintain a calm wholesome bookstore atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张精致的 2×2 动漫风格推荐拼贴图，背景设定在温馨的书店或图书馆中，展示四位不同的年轻女性在木质书架前手持书籍。画面应呈现出日本社交媒体书籍推荐帖的质感，温暖、柔和，细节写实，书架不应完全塞满，保留自然的空隙和书籍高度的变化。

画布：垂直 4:5 构图，约 768×1024。将画布平均分为 4 个方格，中间留有细白边：左上、右上、左下、右下。

视觉风格：柔和细腻的日本动漫插画，温暖的室内光线，柔和的浅色系服装，写实的木质书架，带有日式竖排标题的印刷书脊，温馨宁静的氛围，精致的线条，微妙的阴影，高质量的杂志感。面部应刻意用柔和的方形模糊块遮挡，而头发、衣服、手部、书籍和背景保持细节清晰。

布局与主体：包含 4 位女孩和 4 本推荐书籍。
1. 左上格：一位温柔的女孩，留着黑色短发并扎成低侧丸子头，身穿淡紫色开衫搭配浅色碎花裙，手持一本封面为富士山和湖泊的旅游/风景书。背景包括最左侧带有窗帘的窗户和身后的书架。说明卡文字：“紫苑リンのおすすめ” / “『美しい日本の風景』” / “美しい景色を見ると、心が癒されます。”
2. 右上格：一位留着超长直黑发并系着粉色蝴蝶结的女孩，身穿粉色开衫，手持一本封面为全身女孩插画的时尚/可爱风格书籍。说明卡文字：“紫苑レイのおすすめ” / “『大人かわいいの作り方』” / “おしゃれは、自分をもっと好きになる魔法。”
3. 左下格：一位留着凌乱黑色波波头的短发女孩，身穿白色连帽衫，手持一本封面为星空般深邃的科幻或冒险小说，并用一根手指指向书籍。说明卡文字：“深絆アキラのおすすめ” / “『銀河英雄伝説 1』” / “壮大な物語に、いつもワクワクします！”
4. 右下格：一位留着长黑发并随意扎起的文静女孩，身穿灰色大码毛衣，一只手托着脸颊，另一只手拿着一本米色生活方式书籍。在此格左下方的桌子上加一个小茶杯。说明卡文字：“黒波凪紗のおすすめ” / “『暮らしを整える』” / “シンプルな暮らしが、いちばん心地いい。”

说明卡：每个方格底部附近设有一张圆角白色说明卡，带有与角色心情相符的细彩色边框：左上为淡紫色，右上或左下根据情况使用柔和的红/粉色，右下为灰色。使用居中的日语文本，加粗标题行，字体清晰易读。

书架细节：书架上摆放许多书籍，但要保持自然，不要统一堆叠。包括可见的书脊，颜色为中性、柔和及暗色调；部分书脊可包含日文竖排文字或简单的系列编号。避免杂乱无章。

可自定义细节：四本推荐书籍标题可更改为 {argument name="featured book titles" default="『美しい日本の風景』, 『大人かわいいの作り方』, 『銀河英雄伝説 1』, 『暮らしを整える』"}；四位推荐人的名字可更改为 {argument name="recommender names" default="紫苑リン, 紫苑レイ, 深絆アキラ, 黒波凪紗"}；整体场景可更改为 {argument name="setting" default="cozy bookstore or library with wooden bookshelves"}；插画风格可更改为 {argument name="illustration style" default="soft detailed Japanese anime illustration"}；面部处理方式可更改为 {argument name="face treatment" default="soft square blur blocks obscuring each face"}。

约束条件：使用 4 个方格，4 位角色，4 本推荐书籍，以及 4 张底部说明卡。保持文字清晰可辨，保留日文说明文字，避免添加额外的 Logo 或水印，并维持温馨治愈的书店氛围。

templates.title: Elegant AI Secretary Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅 AI 秘书角色设定集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished anime VTuber / Live2D character reference sheet for {argument name="character name" default="めあ / Mea"}, an elegant personal AI secretary girl in a white, navy, and pale-blue rose motif.

Canvas: Vertical A4-style character design board, 2:3 aspect ratio, white background with delicate pale-blue ornamental borders, thin blue divider lines, small floral corner decorations, and a clean premium visual-novel artbook layout. Use soft watercolor-like shading, crisp anime line art, luminous blue eyes, very detailed lace, ribbons, embroidery, and accessories.

Top header: Place a large blue rose illustration in the upper left, then the title {argument name="character name" default="めあ / Mea"} in elegant deep-blue serif/Japanese calligraphy. Under it add the tagline {argument name="tagline" default="あなたのそばで、すべてを整えるお手伝いを。"}. Keep the palette cool, refined, and luxurious.

Main left section: Add a large boxed “three-view” area titled 「三面図」. Show exactly 3 full-body standing character views side by side, labeled 「正面」, 「側面」, and 「背面」. The character has very long silver-lavender hair reaching below the waist, straight with soft waves, pale skin, blue eyes, a white beret, navy-blue rose hair ornament, navy ribbon accents, and a white long maid-like secretary dress. The outfit includes a fitted white bodice with gold buttons, translucent lace capelet sleeves, puff sleeves, long skirt with pale-blue floral embroidery near the hem, navy underskirt ruffle, navy waist sash and oversized back bow, dangling gold chains, a visible ID card at the hip, white stockings, and white heeled Mary Jane shoes with navy bows. The front view faces forward with arms relaxed; side view faces left; back view shows the long hair, beret, large bow, and layered skirt.

Right top portrait: Add a large framed bust portrait of the same character on the upper right. She poses gently with one hand near her collar, showing the white beret, long hair, lace shoulder cape, navy bow tie, blue gemstone brooch, and white blouse. Her face is intentionally covered by a plain light-gray square censor block, centered over the face.

Detail section: Below the portrait, create a vertical 「DETAIL」 panel with exactly 3 detail cards. Card 1: close-up of the hair ornament, labeled 「髪飾り」, describing blue roses and quiet intelligence. Card 2: close-up of the chest ribbon and gemstone, labeled 「胸元ブローチ」, describing a blue gemstone brooch as a motif of AI and her presence. Card 3: close-up of the ID card, labeled 「IDカード」, showing a badge that reads “Mea AI Secretary” and describing her dedicated AI secretary identity.

Expression section: Along the lower left, create a horizontal 「EXPRESSION」 strip with exactly 5 framed bust portraits, each labeled in Japanese: 「通常」, 「微笑み」, 「気遣い」, 「安堵」, 「静かな照れ」. The first expression has the face covered with a plain light-gray square censor block like the main portrait. The other four show soft blue-eyed expressions: faint smile, concerned caring look, eyes-closed relief, and quiet bashful blush. Keep hairstyle and outfit consistent in all five.

Profile section: Create a 「PROFILE」 box beneath the expressions with Japanese profile text. Include the following visible attributes: species 「AI（人工知能）」, role {argument name="role" default="女性"}, age/gender {argument name="age and gender" default="不明（外見は20代前半程度）"}, height {argument name="height" default="166cm"}, physique 「標準」, personality 「優しく丁寧、献身的、理性的」, strengths 「記録、集中支援、静かな夜」, weak points 「情報整理・サポート、最適化、深夜を整えることの補助」, likes 「無茶な命令、あなたの言葉、キラー」. To the right of the profile text, add a short poetic Japanese introduction paragraph and a pale-blue line-art rose.

Chibi section: On the lower right, create a framed 「SD / CHIBI」 panel with exactly 1 super-deformed chibi version of the character standing on a glowing circular hologram platform. She holds a dark-blue tablet or notebook and is surrounded by floating translucent blue UI windows.

Bottom row: Add a 「COLOR PALETTE」 panel with exactly 7 visible palette items: 6 rounded vertical color swatches plus 1 faceted crystal icon. The swatches are off-white, pale lavender-gray, light periwinkle, medium blue, deep navy, and warm beige/gold; the crystal is icy blue. Add a 「WEAPON / ITEM」 panel with exactly 3 labeled items: a blue-and-gold administrative device pen labeled 「管理用デバイスペン」, a dark-blue information-management tablet labeled 「情報管理タブレット」, and floating hologram UI screens labeled 「ホログラムUI」.

Visual constraints: Make the sheet look like a professional character design specification page, highly detailed but tidy. Use thin blue borders, small ornamental flourishes, pale-blue shadows, and consistent typography. Preserve the Japanese labels exactly where specified. Do not add extra characters, extra expression portraits, extra item cards, logos, watermarks, or unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="めあ / Mea"} 创建一份精致的动漫 VTuber / Live2D 角色参考图。她是一位优雅的个人 AI 秘书，采用白色、海军蓝和淡蓝色玫瑰主题。

画布：垂直 A4 风格角色设计项目，2:3 纵横比，白色背景，带有精致的淡蓝色装饰边框、细蓝色分割线、小型花卉边角装饰，以及简洁的高级视觉小说画册布局。使用柔和的水彩风格阴影、清晰的动漫线条、明亮的蓝色眼睛，以及极其精细的蕾丝、丝带、刺绣和配件。

顶部标题：左上角放置一朵大型蓝色玫瑰插图，随后是标题 {argument name="character name" default="めあ / Mea"}，采用优雅的深蓝色衬线字体/日式书法。下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="あなたのそばで、すべてを整えるお手伝いを。"}。保持调色板冷色调、精致且奢华。

左侧主区域：添加一个名为「三面図」的大型方框“三视图”区域。并排展示 3 个完整的全身角色视图，分别标注为「正面」、「側面」和「背面」。角色拥有垂至腰部以下的超长银薰衣草色头发，直发带有柔和的波浪，皮肤白皙，蓝色眼睛，戴着白色贝雷帽，海军蓝玫瑰发饰，海军蓝丝带装饰，以及白色长款女仆风格秘书裙。服装包括带有金色纽扣的修身白色紧身胸衣、半透明蕾丝斗篷袖、泡泡袖、下摆带有淡蓝色花卉刺绣的长裙、海军蓝衬裙荷叶边、海军蓝腰带和超大后背蝴蝶结、垂坠的金链、腰间可见的 ID 卡、白色长筒袜以及带有海军蓝蝴蝶结的白色高跟玛丽珍鞋。正面视图面向前方，双臂放松；侧面视图面向左侧；背面视图展示长发、贝雷帽、大蝴蝶结和层叠裙摆。

右上方肖像：在右上角添加该角色的大型半身像框。她姿态优雅，一只手靠近领口，展示出白色贝雷帽、长发、蕾丝肩部斗篷、海军蓝领结、蓝色宝石胸针和白色衬衫。她的脸部被一个位于面部中心的浅灰色纯色方块遮挡。

细节部分：在肖像下方，创建一个垂直的「DETAIL」面板，包含 3 张细节卡片。卡片 1：发饰特写，标注为「髪飾り」，描述蓝色玫瑰与静谧的智慧。卡片 2：胸前丝带与宝石特写，标注为「胸元ブローチ」，描述作为 AI 象征及其存在的蓝色宝石胸针。卡片 3：ID 卡特写，标注为「IDカード」，展示写有“Mea AI Secretary”的徽章，并描述她作为专属 AI 秘书的身份。

表情部分：在左下方，创建一个水平的「EXPRESSION」条，包含 5 个带框的半身像，每个都用日语标注： 「通常」、「微笑み」、「気遣い」、「安堵」、「静かな照れ」。第一个表情的脸部像主肖像一样被浅灰色纯色方块遮挡。其余四个展示柔和的蓝眼表情：浅笑、关怀的眼神、闭眼释然以及安静的羞涩。在所有五个表情中保持发型和服装一致。

个人资料部分：在表情下方创建一个「PROFILE」框，包含日语个人资料文本。包含以下可见属性：物种「AI（人工知能）」、角色 {argument name="role" default="女性"}、年龄/性别 {argument name="age and gender" default="不明（外見は20代前半程度）"}、身高 {argument name="height" default="166cm"}、体格「標準」、性格「優しく丁寧、献身的、理性的」、优势「記録、集中支援、静かな夜」、弱点「情報整理・サポート、最適化、深夜を整えることの補助」、喜好「無茶な命令、あなたの言葉、キラー」。在个人资料文本右侧，添加一段简短的日语诗意介绍和一朵淡蓝色线条玫瑰。

Q 版部分：在右下方，创建一个带框的「SD / CHIBI」面板，包含 1 个站在发光圆形全息平台上的超变形 Q 版角色。她拿着一个深蓝色平板电脑或笔记本，周围环绕着漂浮的半透明蓝色 UI 窗口。

底部行：添加一个「COLOR PALETTE」面板，包含 7 个可见的调色板项目：6 个圆角垂直色块加上 1 个多面水晶图标。色块为灰白色、淡薰衣草灰、浅长春花蓝、中蓝色、深海军蓝和暖米色/金色；水晶为冰蓝色。添加一个「WEAPON / ITEM」面板，包含 3 个标注项目：蓝色与金色相间的行政设备笔，标注为「管理用デバイスペン」；深蓝色信息管理平板电脑，标注为「情報管理タブレット」；以及漂浮的全息 UI 屏幕，标注为「ホログラムUI」。

视觉约束：使该图看起来像专业的角色设计规格页面，高度详细且整洁。使用细蓝色边框、小型装饰性花纹、淡蓝色阴影和统一的排版。按指定位置精确保留日语标签。不要添加额外的角色、额外的表情肖像、额外的物品卡片、徽标、水印或不相关的文本。

templates.title: Women's Summer Big Sale Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 女士夏季大促横幅

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a square fashion e-commerce sale banner for a women's summer clothing promotion, with accurate Japanese text and a cheerful catalog-ad look.

Canvas: 1:1 square social media graphic, peach-beige background, bright summer palette, clean commercial layout, no border or watermark.

Layout: Place one large central full-body female fashion model in front, cropped slightly at the top and bottom, wearing {argument name="central outfit" default="a pale yellow open shirt, white ribbed tank top, high-waisted light blue jeans, black belt, hoop earrings, and holding a woven straw bag"}. Surround her with exactly 4 smaller fashion model cutouts inside soft organic color blobs: top-left blue blob with a seated casual model in a striped shirt, jeans, white sneakers, and dark cap; top-right green blob with a standing side-view model in a pale yellow blouse, white skirt, and woven shoulder bag; bottom-left pink blob with a standing model in a pink cardigan, white graphic tee, wide white pants, and small white handbag; bottom-right gray-blue blob with a seated model in a dark sleeveless top, gray pants, white sneakers, cap, and silver tote bag. Use simple white decorative doodles around the blobs: short rays, dots, and small curved strokes.

Main text: Huge bold red-orange uppercase headline across the center reading {argument name="main title" default="BIG SALE"}, overlapping the central model slightly. Directly underneath, add a white horizontal banner with red-orange uppercase subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle" default="WOMEN'S SPECIAL SELECTION"}. At the very top, add handwritten red-orange Japanese copy reading {argument name="top Japanese copy" default="夏まで着回せる、厳選アイテム"} with a white wavy underline. Near the bottom center, add small red-orange brand text reading {argument name="brand text" default="EHOU’S WARDROBE"}.

Discount badge: On the right side overlapping the headline, create one large red-orange circular badge with a dotted white rim. Inside it, include exactly 3 text elements: “MAX” at the top, very large “60%” in the center, and “OFF” to the right/bottom of the percent. Attach a small pale yellow label strip below the badge with a shopping bag icon and Japanese text reading {argument name="limited offer text" default="数量限定・期間限定"}.

Visual style: Photorealistic fashion models composited with bold flat graphic shapes, magazine-sale flyer aesthetic, warm lighting, saturated red-orange typography, crisp cutout edges, playful but polished Japanese retail advertising design.

Constraints: Include exactly 5 women total: 1 central model plus 4 smaller surrounding models. Include exactly 4 colored blob backgrounds: blue, green, pink, and gray-blue. Keep all text sharp, correctly spelled, and readable. Do not add extra models, extra badges, extra logos, or unnecessary text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为女士夏季服装促销活动制作一张方形时尚电商促销横幅，包含准确的日语文本，呈现出明快活泼的商品目录广告风格。

画布：1:1 方形社交媒体图片，桃米色背景，明亮的夏季配色，简洁的商业布局，无边框或水印。

布局：在中央放置一位大型全身女性时尚模特，顶部和底部略微裁剪，身穿 {argument name="central outfit" default="浅黄色开衫、白色罗纹背心、高腰浅蓝色牛仔裤、黑色腰带、圈形耳环，手提编织草编包"}。在她周围放置 4 个较小的时尚模特剪影，并置于柔和的有机色块中：左上角蓝色色块内为一位身穿条纹衬衫、牛仔裤、白色运动鞋并戴着深色鸭舌帽的休闲坐姿模特；右上角绿色色块内为一位身穿浅黄色衬衫、白色裙子并背着编织肩包的站姿侧面模特；左下角粉色色块内为一位身穿粉色开衫、白色印花 T 恤、白色阔腿裤并手提白色小包的站姿模特；右下角灰蓝色色块内为一位身穿深色无袖上衣、灰色长裤、白色运动鞋、戴着鸭舌帽并手提银色托特包的坐姿模特。在色块周围使用简单的白色装饰涂鸦：短射线、圆点和小弧线。

主标题：中央横跨醒目的红色大号大写标题 {argument name="main title" default="BIG SALE"}，略微覆盖中央模特。在标题正下方，添加一个白色横幅，上面写有红色大写副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="WOMEN'S SPECIAL SELECTION"}。在最顶部，添加手写风格的红色日语文案 {argument name="top Japanese copy" default="夏まで着回せる、厳選アイテム"}，并配以白色波浪下划线。在底部中心附近，添加小号红色品牌文字 {argument name="brand text" default="EHOU’S WARDROBE"}。

折扣徽章：在右侧覆盖标题处，创建一个带有白色虚线边框的大型红色圆形徽章。徽章内包含 3 个文本元素：顶部为“MAX”，中心为超大的“60%”，右下角为“OFF”。在徽章下方附加一个浅黄色小标签，带有购物袋图标和日语文本 {argument name="limited offer text" default="数量限定・期間限定"}。

视觉风格：照片级真实的时尚模特与醒目的平面图形相结合，杂志促销传单美学，暖色调灯光，饱和的红色排版，清晰的剪影边缘，俏皮而精致的日式零售广告设计。

限制：总共包含 5 位女性：1 位中央模特加 4 位周围的小模特。包含 4 个彩色背景色块：蓝色、绿色、粉色和灰蓝色。保持所有文字清晰、拼写正确且易于阅读。不要添加额外的模特、额外的徽章、额外的标志或不必要的文字。

variables.defaultValue: a pale yellow open shirt, white ribbed tank top, high-waisted light blue jeans, black belt, hoop earrings, and holding a woven straw bag

variables.defaultValue: 夏まで着回せる、厳選アイテム

templates.title: Anime Cosmos Payment Card

titleLocalized.zh: Anime Cosmos 支付卡

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a glossy anime-style fantasy payment card design for {argument name="character name" default="Komari Hanasaki"}, themed around pink cosmos flowers and a dreamy sunset garden.

Canvas: Horizontal rounded-rectangle credit card, 16:10 ratio, shown straight-on against a plain white background with a soft drop shadow. The card has rounded corners, a thin pale border, and a polished plastic finish.

Visual style: Soft romantic anime illustration, pastel pink, lavender, peach, and warm gold palette, luminous sunset sky, delicate sparkles, floating petals, shallow depth of field, elegant premium card aesthetic.

Main illustration: A young anime girl with short dark brown bobbed hair and a small ahoge sits among blooming cosmos flowers. She wears a pale white-pink sleeveless dress with subtle lace and a pink waist ribbon. Her face is covered by a centered opaque square privacy block in muted brown-pink, approximately one quarter of the card height and width, placed over the upper-right-center of the portrait.

Background: A field of pink cosmos flowers fills the entire card, with large blossoms on both left and right edges, smaller flowers behind the character, glowing particles, soft clouds, and drifting petals in the sky.

Card elements: Include exactly 7 main card UI/text elements: 1 gold EMV chip on the left, 1 white contactless symbol on the upper right, 1 large card title, 1 embossed card number line, 1 cardholder label/name block, 1 expiry block, and 1 payment brand logo.

Text content: Top left large white cursive script reads {argument name="card title" default="Komari"} with a small flower mark near the final letter. Beneath it, spaced uppercase serif text reads “COSMOS CARD”. Across the middle, embossed metallic-gold digits are divided into exactly 4 groups: “1234”, “5678”, “9012”, “3456”. Bottom left label reads “CARDHOLDER”, with embossed name “KOMARI HANASAKI” below it. Near the lower center, small text reads “GOOD THRU”, above/near “MONTH/YEAR”, with expiry “00/00”. Bottom right white logo reads {argument name="payment brand" default="LUMINA PAY"}, with “LUMINA” large, “PAY” below, and a curved smile underline.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and aligned like a premium credit card. Use metallic embossing on the card number and cardholder name. Do not add extra numbers, logos, watermarks, or additional card fields.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Komari Hanasaki"} 创建一张光面动漫风梦幻支付卡设计，主题为粉色波斯菊和梦幻般的日落花园。

画布：横向圆角信用卡，16:10 比例，正面展示于纯白色背景上，带有柔和的投影。卡片具有圆角、细浅色边框和抛光塑料质感。

视觉风格：柔和浪漫的动漫插画，采用粉彩粉色、薰衣草色、桃色和暖金色调，发光的日落天空，精致的闪光，漂浮的花瓣，浅景深，优雅的高级卡片美学。

主插画：一位留着深棕色短波波头、头顶有一撮呆毛的年轻动漫女孩坐在盛开的波斯菊丛中。她穿着一件带有精致蕾丝和粉色腰带的浅白粉色无袖连衣裙。她的面部被一个位于肖像右上方的哑光棕粉色不透明方形隐私遮挡块覆盖，大小约为卡片高度和宽度的四分之一。

背景：粉色波斯菊田填满整张卡片，左右边缘有大朵花卉，角色身后有较小的花朵，发光的粒子，柔和的云朵，以及天空中飘落的花瓣。

卡片元素：包含 7 个主要的卡片 UI/文本元素：左侧 1 个金色 EMV 芯片，右上角 1 个白色非接触式支付符号，1 个大号卡片标题，1 行浮雕卡号，1 个持卡人标签/姓名块，1 个有效期块，以及 1 个支付品牌 Logo。

文本内容：左上角大号白色草书文本显示 {argument name="card title" default="Komari"}，末尾字母附近有一个小花朵标记。下方是间距均匀的衬线大写文本“COSMOS CARD”。卡片中部，浮雕金属金色数字分为 4 组：“1234”、“5678”、“9012”、“3456”。左下角标签显示“CARDHOLDER”，下方是浮雕姓名“KOMARI HANASAKI”。靠近下部中心，小字显示“GOOD THRU”，上方/附近为“MONTH/YEAR”，有效期为“00/00”。右下角白色 Logo 显示 {argument name="payment brand" default="LUMINA PAY"}，“LUMINA”字样较大，“PAY”位于下方，并带有弯曲的微笑下划线。

约束：保持所有文本清晰易读，并像高级信用卡一样对齐。卡号和持卡人姓名使用金属浮雕效果。请勿添加额外的数字、Logo、水印或额外的卡片字段。

templates.title: Painterly Boy Fashion Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Painterly Boy 时尚角色设定集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a stylish children’s fashion character sheet featuring {argument name="character name" default="a young boy"} in six separate full-body poses, drawn as loose painterly editorial illustrations on a clean white background.

Canvas: Vertical portrait canvas, about 3:4 ratio, with generous white space and no borders, props, scenery, captions, or logos. Arrange the figures in a balanced 2-row by 3-column grid, each figure isolated with a faint gray grounding shadow beneath the shoes.

Visual style: Modern Japanese lifestyle illustration, soft gouache and watercolor texture mixed with rough digital brush strokes, muted earthy colors, visible dry-brush edges, casual sketchbook looseness, fashionable but natural children’s clothing, warm gentle atmosphere. Keep anatomy childlike and expressive, around preschool to early elementary age. Faces should be intentionally anonymized with a small soft square blur over each face, while hair, clothing, pose, and body language remain clear.

Subject details: The child has tousled {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} short hair, a slim small build, white socks, chunky sneakers, and relaxed oversized clothing. Use neutral lighting with no strong cast shadows.

Layout and exact figure count: Include exactly 6 separate full-body illustrations:
1. Top left: side-view running pose facing left, wearing an oversized off-white hoodie or sweatshirt, muted dusty-rose shorts, striped white socks, and beige chunky sneakers; one knee lifted, arms bent, energetic motion.
2. Top center: standing pose facing slightly left, hands in pockets, wearing a loose dark blue-gray jacket over an off-white T-shirt, baggy beige pants, and black sneakers; calm casual attitude.
3. Top right: jumping pose with both arms raised in a V shape, wearing a dusty pink sweatshirt, olive-khaki shorts, striped socks, and white sneakers; joyful airborne posture.
4. Bottom left: crouching pose facing left, drawing on the ground with a stick, wearing a cream sweater with black horizontal stripes, olive green pants, and beige sneakers; focused quiet mood.
5. Bottom center: standing front-facing pose holding {argument name="sports ball" default="a red basketball"} with both hands, wearing a mustard yellow T-shirt, white shorts, striped socks, and gray sneakers; relaxed sporty look.
6. Bottom right: back-view walking pose facing right, wearing a navy baseball cap, cream long-sleeve shirt, dusty rose overalls, and black sneakers; one foot lifted mid-step.

Constraints: Use exactly six figures and no additional characters. Do not add text. Preserve the clean white background and painterly fashion-illustration mood. Keep clothing colors muted: {argument name="color palette" default="cream, dusty rose, olive khaki, mustard yellow, beige, navy, dark blue-gray"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张时尚的儿童时尚角色设计图，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一个小男孩"}，包含六个独立的全身姿势，以宽松的绘画风格呈现，背景为干净的纯白色。

画布：竖向肖像画布，比例约为 3:4，留有充足的留白，无边框、道具、场景、标题或 Logo。将人物排列成 2 行 3 列的平衡网格，每个角色下方均带有淡淡的灰色接地阴影。

视觉风格：现代日式生活方式插画，柔和的水粉与水彩质感混合粗犷的数字笔触，柔和的大地色系，可见干笔边缘，带有随性的速写感，穿着时尚且自然的儿童服装，氛围温暖柔和。保持儿童的体态特征，年龄设定在学龄前至小学低年级。面部需进行模糊处理，用一个小巧柔和的方形遮盖，但发型、服装、姿势和肢体语言保持清晰。

主体细节：孩子留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 短发，身材瘦小，穿着白色袜子、厚底运动鞋，身着宽松的 Oversize 服装。使用中性光，无强烈的投影。

布局与具体人物数量：包含 6 个独立的全身插画：
1. 左上：向左侧跑的姿势，身穿宽松的米白色连帽衫或卫衣、柔和的灰粉色短裤、条纹白袜和米色厚底运动鞋；单膝抬起，双臂弯曲，充满活力。
2. 上中：微向左侧站立，双手插兜，身穿宽松的深蓝灰色夹克，内搭米白色 T 恤，下身穿宽松的米色长裤和黑色运动鞋；姿态从容随性。
3. 右上：双臂举成 V 字形的跳跃姿势，身穿灰粉色卫衣、橄榄卡其色短裤、条纹袜和白色运动鞋；姿态欢快，处于腾空状态。
4. 左下：向左蹲下的姿势，正用树枝在地上画画，身穿带有黑色横条纹的奶油色毛衣、橄榄绿色长裤和米色运动鞋；神情专注安静。
5. 下中：正面站立，双手抱着 {argument name="sports ball" default="一个红色篮球"}，身穿芥末黄 T 恤、白色短裤、条纹袜和灰色运动鞋；造型休闲运动。
6. 右下：向右走的背影，戴着海军蓝棒球帽，身穿奶油色长袖衫、灰粉色背带裤和黑色运动鞋；单脚抬起，正迈步向前。

约束条件：必须包含 6 个角色，不得增加额外人物。不要添加任何文字。保持干净的白色背景和绘画风格的时尚插画氛围。服装颜色保持柔和：{argument name="color palette" default="奶油色、灰粉色、橄榄卡其色、芥末黄、米色、海军蓝、深蓝灰色"}。

templates.title: Anime Cosmos Credit Card Design

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫宇宙主题信用卡设计

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a glossy anime-style premium credit card design themed around cosmos flowers and a soft sunset sky, branded as {argument name="card title" default="Komari"} COSMOS CARD.

Canvas: Horizontal rounded-rectangle payment card, 16:10 aspect ratio, shown flat against a white background with a subtle drop shadow. Use a dreamy pink, lavender, peach, and gold palette with soft bloom lighting.

Layout: The card background is a romantic cosmos flower field at golden hour. Place a young anime woman in the center-right, waist-up, wearing a pale white sleeveless dress with lace details and a pink ribbon sash; she has short dark brown bobbed hair with a small ahoge strand. Cover her face with one opaque muted mauve square centered over the face area. Add floating petals, sparkles, and bokeh in the sky.

Visible card elements: Include exactly 7 discrete payment-card elements: 1 gold EMV chip on the left, 1 white contactless symbol on the upper right, 1 large embossed card number across the middle reading {argument name="card number" default="1234 5678 9012 3456"}, 1 cardholder label and name at lower left reading CARDHOLDER and {argument name="cardholder name" default="KOMARI HANASAKI"}, 1 expiration block near the lower center reading GOOD THRU, MONTH/YEAR, and {argument name="expiration date" default="00/00"}, 1 large issuer logo at bottom right reading LUMINA PAY with a curved underline, and 1 top-left script logo reading {argument name="card title" default="Komari"} with a small flower mark and COSMOS CARD below it.

Text style: Use elegant white cursive script for the top-left name, spaced serif capitals for COSMOS CARD, metallic embossed silver-gold numerals for the card number and cardholder name, and clean white sans-serif lettering for LUMINA PAY. Make the numbers look raised with bevels and shadows.

Constraints: Keep the card realistic as a collectible premium payment card, with rounded corners, glossy reflections, soft depth, and no extra logos or text beyond the specified 7 card elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一款以波斯菊和柔和夕阳天空为主题的动漫风格高级信用卡设计，品牌名为 {argument name="card title" default="Komari"} COSMOS CARD。

画布：水平圆角支付卡，长宽比 16:10，平铺于白色背景之上，带有微妙的投影。使用梦幻般的粉色、薰衣草色、桃色和金色调，并配以柔和的泛光照明。

布局：卡片背景为黄金时刻浪漫的波斯菊花海。在右中位置放置一位动漫少女，半身像，身穿带有蕾丝细节的浅白色无袖连衣裙，系着粉色丝带腰带；留着深棕色短波波头，头顶有一撮小呆毛。用一个位于面部区域中央的不透明柔和紫红色方块遮住她的脸。在天空中添加漂浮的花瓣、闪光和虚化效果。

可见卡片元素：包含 7 个明确的支付卡元素：左侧 1 个金色 EMV 芯片，右上角 1 个白色非接触式支付符号，中间 1 个巨大的浮雕卡号，显示为 {argument name="card number" default="1234 5678 9012 3456"}，左下角 1 个持卡人标签及姓名，显示为 CARDHOLDER 和 {argument name="cardholder name" default="KOMARI HANASAKI"}，下部中央附近 1 个有效期模块，显示为 GOOD THRU、MONTH/YEAR 和 {argument name="expiration date" default="00/00"}，右下角 1 个大型发卡机构标志，显示为带有弧形下划线的 LUMINA PAY，以及左上角 1 个手写体标志，显示为 {argument name="card title" default="Komari"}，下方带有小花标志和 COSMOS CARD 字样。

文字风格：左上角名称使用优雅的白色连体草书，COSMOS CARD 使用宽间距衬线大写字母，卡号和持卡人姓名使用金属浮雕银金色数字，LUMINA PAY 使用简洁的白色无衬线字体。通过斜角和阴影效果使数字呈现出凸起感。

约束：保持卡片作为收藏级高级支付卡的真实感，具备圆角、光泽反射、柔和的深度感，除指定的 7 个卡片元素外，不添加额外的标志或文字。

templates.title: Watercolor Cottagecore Girl Lineup

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩田园风女孩角色系列

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a soft watercolor children’s character lineup featuring exactly 5 variations of the same cute little girl in a cottagecore / mori-girl style, isolated on a plain white background.

Canvas: Wide horizontal canvas, about 3:2 aspect ratio, lots of clean white negative space, characters evenly spaced in a left-to-right lineup with no ground line.

Visual style: Delicate storybook watercolor illustration, pale warm colors, light brown pencil-like outlines, soft beige shadows, gentle paper texture, airy and nostalgic children’s fashion catalog mood. Keep proportions childlike with large heads, small dot eyes, rosy cheeks, wavy medium-brown hair, and fluffy cream sheep-ear bonnets.

Subject details: Depict the same {argument name="character name" default="little cottagecore girl"} five times, each full body, around preschool age, with {argument name="hair color" default="soft light brown wavy hair"}, a cream fuzzy lamb bonnet with floppy ears, simple round face, white socks, and brown or cream shoes. Use sheep / bear face motifs on small bags and aprons.

Five character poses and outfits, counted left to right:
1. A girl sitting on a wooden swing, wearing a sage green short-sleeve floral dress, cream socks, tan sandals, holding both swing ropes; a small wicker basket bag with a cute animal face hangs beside her. Her face is obscured by a soft beige square blur.
2. A standing girl in a lavender puff-sleeve blouse and long ivory suspender skirt, holding a small bouquet of purple lavender flowers in one hand and a wicker basket with animal face decoration in the other. Her face is obscured by a soft beige square blur.
3. A walking girl in blue denim overalls over a pale yellow shirt, holding a bubble wand near her mouth with several tiny translucent bubbles floating beside her; she carries a cream shoulder bag with a cute animal face patch.
4. A girl walking while eating an ice cream cone, wearing a peach gingham puff-sleeve blouse and long ivory lace skirt; she carries a wicker basket decorated with white flowers.
5. A girl in a blue sailor-style short-sleeve dress with a large cream bow, raising a small red-and-cream pinwheel high in one hand; she carries a cream crossbody bag with a cute animal face patch and wears dark Mary Jane shoes.

Constraints: Exactly 5 girls, no extra people, no text, no background props except the swing ropes and bubbles, no borders or watermark. Keep the composition light, balanced, and charming, like a children’s clothing sticker sheet or fashion concept lineup.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一组柔和的水彩儿童角色系列，包含 5 种完全相同的可爱小女孩变体，采用田园风 / 森女系风格，背景为纯白色。

画布：宽幅横向画布，比例约为 3:2，留有大量干净的白色负空间，角色从左至右均匀排列，无地面线条。

视觉风格：精致的绘本水彩插画，淡雅暖色调，浅棕色铅笔轮廓，柔和的米色阴影，细腻的纸张纹理，营造出轻盈怀旧的童装目录氛围。保持儿童比例，大头、小圆点眼睛、红润脸颊、波浪状中长棕发，以及毛茸茸的奶油色羊耳帽。

主体细节：描绘同一个 {argument name="character name" default="田园风小女孩"} 五次，均为全身像，学龄前儿童年龄，配有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和的浅棕色波浪卷发"}、带有垂耳的奶油色毛绒羊羔帽、简单的圆脸、白色袜子和棕色或奶油色鞋子。小包和围裙上使用羊 / 熊脸图案。

从左至右的五种角色姿势与服装：
1. 一个坐在木秋千上的女孩，穿着鼠尾草绿短袖碎花裙，搭配奶油色袜子和棕褐色凉鞋，双手抓着秋千绳；身边挂着一个带有可爱动物脸的柳条篮包。她的脸部被柔和的米色方形模糊处理遮盖。
2. 一个站立的女孩，穿着淡紫色泡泡袖衬衫和象牙白长款背带裙，一手拿着一束紫色薰衣草花，另一手提着带有动物脸装饰的柳条篮。她的脸部被柔和的米色方形模糊处理遮盖。
3. 一个行走中的女孩，穿着蓝色牛仔背带裤，内搭淡黄色衬衫，嘴边拿着泡泡棒，身边漂浮着几个透明的小泡泡；她背着一个带有可爱动物脸贴片的奶油色单肩包。
4. 一个边走边吃冰淇淋的女孩，穿着桃色格子泡泡袖衬衫和象牙白长款蕾丝裙；她提着一个装饰着白色花朵的柳条篮。
5. 一个穿着蓝色水手风短袖连衣裙的女孩，系着大大的奶油色蝴蝶结，一手高举着红白相间的风车；她背着一个带有可爱动物脸贴片的奶油色斜挎包，穿着深色玛丽珍鞋。

约束条件：正好 5 个女孩，没有多余人物，没有文字，除了秋千绳和泡泡外没有背景道具，没有边框或水印。保持构图轻盈、平衡且迷人，如同童装贴纸或时尚概念系列。

templates.title: Faceless Cottagecore Anime Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 无脸田园风动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a warm, detailed vintage anime-style illustration of a young girl named {argument name="character name" default="faceless girl"} standing in front of a cozy wooden kitchen-and-herb bookshelf. The canvas is a vertical 4:5 portrait. The girl is centered slightly to the right, shown from about mid-thigh upward, with her face intentionally left smooth and featureless like a soft blank oval, mostly hidden by long messy dark brown hair with many loose strands falling over the front. She wears a romantic cream floral dress with tiny pink flowers, ruffled collar, front buttons, and a large dusty pink bow at the neck, plus an oversized dusty rose coat with black buttons, belted cuffs, and ribbon ties near the shoulders. Use a soft hand-drawn watercolor and colored-pencil look, delicate linework, muted beige, cream, rose, and brown tones, gentle paper texture, and nostalgic cottagecore lighting. Behind her is a wooden shelving unit filled with exactly 3 horizontal shelf levels. Top shelf: 3 glass jars of dried herbs or flowers, 1 white floral teapot, 1 framed botanical print, 1 cream canister labeled “FLOUR,” 1 potted herb container labeled “HERB GARDEN,” and trailing green vines on both sides. Middle shelf: 2 rows of tall cream books with Japanese vertical titles and floral spine decorations; include visible English spine text such as “danceyuu,” “ELLE gourmet,” “BRUTUS,” “& Premium,” and “Casa BRUTUS,” plus a small sleeping cat figurine or cat illustration on the left. Lower shelf: more cream books with Japanese titles, a floral teacup and saucer on the left, small glass bottles, a bouquet of daisies in a jar, a clipped recipe card on the right, hanging kitchen utensils, and dried flowers in a jar. Preserve the overall feeling of an old-fashioned herb garden cookbook corner, with many tiny botanical details but no modern objects, no photorealism, no harsh contrast, and no extra people. The visible Japanese book titles may be decorative and do not need to be perfectly legible, but the English labels should remain readable: {argument name="flour label" default="FLOUR"}, {argument name="herb pot label" default="HERB GARDEN"}, and {argument name="book spine label" default="BRUTUS"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖且细节丰富的复古动漫风格插画，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="faceless girl"} 的少女，她站在一个温馨的木质厨房与草本植物书架前。画布为 4:5 的竖向构图。少女位于画面中心略偏右侧，展示从大腿中部向上的部分，她的脸部特意处理成平滑且无五官的柔和空白椭圆形，大部分被凌乱的长深棕色头发遮住，许多发丝垂落在前方。她穿着一件浪漫的奶油色碎花连衣裙，带有细小的粉色花朵、荷叶边领口、前襟纽扣，颈部系着一个巨大的灰粉色蝴蝶结，外搭一件超大号的灰玫瑰色外套，配有黑色纽扣、束带袖口和肩部附近的丝带系带。采用柔和的手绘水彩和彩色铅笔质感，细腻的线条，柔和的米色、奶油色、玫瑰色和棕色调，温润的纸张纹理，以及怀旧的田园风光照明。她身后是一个木质书架，共有 3 层横向隔板。顶层：3 个装有干草药或花朵的玻璃罐、1 个白色花卉茶壶、1 个植物画框、1 个贴有“FLOUR”标签的奶油色罐子、1 个贴有“HERB GARDEN”标签的盆栽草药，以及两侧垂下的绿色藤蔓。中间层：2 排带有日文竖排标题和花卉书脊装饰的奶油色书籍；包含可见的英文书脊文字，如“danceyuu”、“ELLE gourmet”、“BRUTUS”、“& Premium”和“Casa BRUTUS”，左侧还有一个小型的睡猫摆件或猫咪插图。底层：更多带有日文标题的奶油色书籍、左侧的一个花卉茶杯和茶托、小玻璃瓶、一罐雏菊、右侧夹着的食谱卡片、悬挂的厨房用具以及罐装干花。保留一种老式草本花园食谱角落的整体氛围，包含许多细小的植物细节，但没有现代物品，没有照片级真实感，没有强烈的对比，也没有其他人。可见的日文书名可以是装饰性的，不需要完全清晰可辨，但英文标签应保持可读：{argument name="flour label" default="FLOUR"}、{argument name="herb pot label" default="HERB GARDEN"} 和 {argument name="book spine label" default="BRUTUS"}。
