Visual style: High-detail kawaii anime game asset sheet, crisp ink lines, soft cel shading, glossy eyes, luminous neon effects, gold metallic details, clean typography, production-ready character turnaround. Keep the overall palette {argument name="main palette" default="hot pink, black navy, gold, cream wool, and warm tan skin"}. No photo realism, no 3D render, no watermark, no extra characters, and do not add more than the 4 labeled views or 5 palette swatches.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Party Sheep"} 创建一张精致的动漫角色设计图，这是一个名为 {argument name="Japanese character name" default="パリピ羊"} 的 AC Sheep 吉祥物，主题为“社交能量连接者”。

画布：宽幅横向白色设计项目画布，尺寸约 1000×560 像素，呈现整洁的制作资产展示效果，留有大量空白，点缀粉色和金色装饰、细小闪光、音符及虚线分隔线。

布局：左上角放置大型标题块，以优雅的衬线字体书写“PARTY SHEEP”，其中“PARTY”为亮粉色，“SHEEP”为金色渐变。下方放置“AC Sheep”，接着是亮粉色的大号日文名“パリピ羊”。在其下方，添加一条带有金色星星的黑色丝带横幅，副标题为“The Social Energy Connector”。在左侧添加一段简短的描述：“一只为连接和良好氛围而生的活力绵羊。Party Sheep 将人们聚集在一起，分享能量，并将任何时刻变成庆典。交流 (connection) は energy！”

角色视角：在底部展示 4 个完整的 Q 版动漫全身视图，每个视图下方用带有粉色星星分隔符的小号衬线字体标注：1) 最左侧为正面视图，姿势较小，眨眼，比出剪刀手并拿着装饰过的智能手机；2) 中左侧为 3/4 侧视图，这是最大的主姿势，眨眼并张嘴微笑，比出剪刀手，另一只手拿着手机；3) 中右侧为侧面视图，侧身向左看并拿着手机；4) 最右侧为背面视图，展示夹克背面和后脑勺发型轮廓。保持所有四个视图的比例、服装、颜色、配饰和面部特征一致。

主体细节：角色是一个可爱的深棕色 Q 版绵羊女孩，拥有蓬松的奶油色和粉色羊毛发型，大而有光泽的洋红色眼睛，正面和 3/4 侧面姿势中有一只眼睛在眨眼，有羊耳朵、细小的黑色卷尾，以及一条发光的霓虹粉色波浪形“AC wave”图案像发带一样流过头发。服装：超大款黑色短款皮夹克，覆盖着金色铆钉、链条、小星星、补丁和亮粉色发光波浪图案；黑粉色派对上衣；带有蕾丝/褶边的叠层短裙或短裤；带有金色搭扣和发光亮粉色鞋底的厚底黑色靴子；多条金色项链和链条；圈形耳环；包括一个小毛绒绵羊钥匙扣在内的挂饰；带有粉色和黄色贴纸的装饰性黑色智能手机。在角色周围，特别是在手机和尾巴附近，添加霓虹粉色无线信号弧线，外加细小的闪光和音符。

信息卡：在上方中间，包含一个带有细粉色轮廓的圆角矩形资料卡。它必须包含 5 行带标签的内容：“SPECIES: Party Sheep (パリピ羊)”；“PERSONALITY: Outgoing, Warm, Charismatic”；“LIKES: Parties, People, Music, Good Vibes, QR codes, Dance, Sharing energy”；“DISLIKES: Awkward silence, Boring plans, Low battery”；“SPECIAL TRAIT: AC Wave Wool -- energy flows through connection. The more friends, the brighter the wave!” 在卡片右侧添加一个带有白色波浪标记的亮粉色圆形图标。

调色板：在右上角，以粉色衬线字体标注“COLOR PALETTE”。在一行中准确展示 5 个圆形色块，下方带有小的十六进制颜色代码标签：1) 近黑色海军蓝“#1A1A2E”，2) 深板岩色“#2D2D44”，3) 亮粉色“#FF69B4”，4) 金黄色“#FFD700”，5) 暖奶油色/白色“#FFF4E6”。

视觉风格：高细节可爱动漫游戏资产图，清晰的墨线，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，明亮的眼睛，发光的霓虹效果，金色金属细节，整洁的排版，适合制作的角色三视图。保持整体色调为 {argument name="main palette" default="亮粉色、黑色海军蓝、金色、奶油色羊毛和暖棕色皮肤"}。无照片写实感，无 3D 渲染，无水印，无额外角色，且不要添加超过 4 个标注视图或 5 个调色板色块。

The more friends, the brighter the wave!” Add a hot-pink circular icon on the right side of the card containing a white sine-wave symbol.

Color palette: In the upper right, add the heading “COLOR PALETTE” and exactly 5 circular color swatches arranged horizontally. Label the first 4 clearly as “#1A1A2E” dark navy, “#2D2D44” charcoal purple, “#FF69B4” hot pink, and “#FFD700” gold; include a fifth pale cream/white swatch at the far right, partially near the edge, labeled with a cropped hex beginning with “#FF”.

Character views: Show exactly 4 full-body chibi character views along the bottom, each with a pink caption: 1) “FRONT VIEW” small front-facing pose at far left, 2) “3/4 VIEW” larger energetic pose near center-left, 3) “SIDE VIEW” profile pose near center-right, and 4) “BACK VIEW” rear pose at far right. The 3/4 view should be the largest hero pose.

Subject details: The character is a small tan-skinned sheep-girl mascot with floppy sheep ears, curly voluminous wool hair in cream blond with hot-pink lower curls, and a glowing pink AC sine-wave pattern across the bangs. She has huge sparkling pink eyes, one eye winking in the hero pose, an open cheerful smile, and a playful party expression. She holds a black smartphone decorated with pink/gold stickers and QR-like details. Add neon pink wireless-wave energy arcs near her hand/tail area, and small music notes around her.

Style constraints: Match the clean character reference sheet look exactly: white background, no scene environment, no extra characters, no random text beyond the specified labels, no watermark, no photorealism. Keep all lettering legible, colorful, and integrated into the design.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Party Sheep"} 创建一张精致的可爱动漫角色设计图。这是一个被称为“AC Sheep”的吉祥物，日文名为“パリピ羊”，主题为社交能量连接者，融合了派对、音乐、二维码和霓虹波纹元素。

画布：宽幅横向白色角色设计画布，比例约为 2:1，采用简洁的编辑排版，留有大量空白，配有粉色细引导线以及装饰性的小闪光、音符、星星和波浪装饰符号。采用明亮的日本流行偶像/街头时尚插画风格，线条清晰，带有柔和的赛璐珞阴影、光泽高光和贴纸般的质感。

布局：在左上角放置一个大型装饰性标题栏，用华丽的衬线字体书写“Party Sheep”，其中“Party”为荧光粉色，“Sheep”为金色。下方放置“AC Sheep”和巨大的日文“パリピ羊”。在名称下方，添加一个带有金色饰边的黑色丝带标签，上面写着“The Social Energy Connector”。在下方添加一段简短的描述：“一只为连接和美好氛围而生的活力小羊。Party Sheep 将人们聚集在一起，分享能量，并将任何时刻变成庆典。交流 (connection) は energy！”

顶部信息卡：在上方中间位置，绘制一个带有粉色轮廓的圆角矩形个人资料卡。包含 5 行明确标注的文字：“SPECIES: Party Sheep (パリピ羊)”、“PERSONALITY: Outgoing, Warm, Charismatic”、“LIKES: Parties, People, Music, Good Vibes, QR codes, Dance, Sharing energy”、“DISLIKES: Awkward silence, Boring plans, Low battery”以及“SPECIAL TRAIT: AC Wave Wool -- energy flows through connection. The more friends, the brighter the wave!” 在卡片右侧添加一个荧光粉色圆形图标，内含白色正弦波符号。

调色板：在右上角添加标题“COLOR PALETTE”，并水平排列 5 个圆形色块。前 4 个色块需清晰标注：“#1A1A2E”深海军蓝、“#2D2D44”炭紫色、“#FF69B4”荧光粉色和“#FFD700”金色；最右侧包含第五个浅奶油色/白色色块，部分靠近边缘，标注以“#FF”开头的截断十六进制代码。

角色视图：在底部展示 4 个全身 Q 版角色视图，每个视图下方配有粉色标题：1) 最左侧为“FRONT VIEW”正面小姿势，2) 中左侧为“3/4 VIEW”较大的活力姿势，3) 中右侧为“SIDE VIEW”侧面姿势，4) 最右侧为“BACK VIEW”背面姿势。3/4 视图应作为最大的主视觉姿势。

主体细节：该角色是一位肤色偏棕的小羊少女吉祥物，拥有下垂的羊耳朵，奶油金色的卷曲蓬松羊毛发，发帘上有发光的粉色 AC 正弦波图案。她有着巨大的闪亮粉色眼睛，主视觉姿势中一只眼睛眨眼，张开嘴露出开心的笑容，表情俏皮。服装：黑色短款街头风夹克，带有金色铆钉、链条、星星补丁、霓虹粉色波纹图案和光泽高光；黑色上衣，胸前有明显的二维码面板；带有荷叶边的短层叠裙或短裤；厚底黑色靴子，配有金色五金件和发光的粉色鞋底；露指手套；金色链条和吊饰；圈形耳环，其中一个带有小迪斯科球吊饰。她拿着一部装饰有粉色/金色贴纸和二维码细节的黑色智能手机。在她的手部/尾部区域添加霓虹粉色无线电波能量弧，周围环绕着小音符。

风格限制：严格匹配简洁的角色参考图外观：白色背景，无场景环境，无额外角色，除指定标签外无随机文字，无水印，无写实感。保持所有文字清晰易读、色彩丰富，并与设计融为一体。

templates.title: Japanese Pool Interview Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 日式泳池采访缩略图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bright Japanese YouTube-style thumbnail for a public outdoor pool interview segment, featuring {argument name="number of women" default="three"} adult women in competitive one-piece swimsuits standing on a pool deck, with their faces anonymized by soft rectangular blur. The mood is sunny, casual, and documentary-like, as if captured during a summer pool event.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal image, high-resolution, realistic photo style, daylight, vivid colors, sharp focus, slight wide-angle perspective. Include a thin desktop window/title-bar strip at the very top with small text resembling a computer screenshot timestamp and location.

Layout: Place the three women across the foreground, full body from head to upper thighs or knees. The left woman stands in a navy blue racing swimsuit with white side accents, short black hair, facing slightly toward the center. The center woman stands in a glossy taupe/gray racing swimsuit, tied-back brown hair, one hand raised near her chest as if being interviewed. The right woman is taller, wearing a black racing swimsuit with bright blue side panels, shoulder-length black hair, hands behind her back, facing slightly toward the center. Add rectangular blurred mosaics over all 3 faces.

Background: A busy outdoor municipal pool on a sunny day with pale concrete decking, blue swimming pools, swimmers, families, umbrellas, trees, a chain-link fence, a white arched pedestrian bridge over the pool, and multiple blue safety cones. Include exactly 4 prominent blue cones in the midground: one near the left deck, one behind the center-left area, one near the center-right, and one farther right near the pool edge.

Text content: Add a bold colorful Japanese headline at the top left in two lines: {argument name="top headline" default="フレッシュプール撮影会\n水着美女にインタビュー!!"}. Use thick rounded lettering with white fill, black outline, red/pink/yellow accents, and a playful variety-show style. Add a large bottom caption spanning nearly the full width: {argument name="bottom caption" default="『ちっぱい番付』に出ています"}. Make the bottom text white with black outline, with key pink emphasis on selected characters, matching Japanese variety TV subtitles.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic summer pool photography mixed with Japanese TV-show thumbnail graphics, bright saturated blues and greens, strong sunlight, clean skin highlights, realistic swimsuit fabric shine, energetic composition.

Constraints: All women must appear as adults, non-explicit, standing naturally, no nudity, no suggestive posing, no extra foreground people, keep the 3 blurred faces and exactly 3 main swimsuit interview subjects.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为公共户外泳池采访环节制作一张明亮的日式 YouTube 风格缩略图，画面中包含 {argument name="number of women" default="三位"} 身着竞技连体泳装的成年女性站在泳池边，她们的面部均经过柔和的矩形模糊处理。氛围阳光、休闲且具有纪录片感，仿佛是在夏季泳池活动中拍摄的。

画布：16:9 横向图像，高分辨率，写实摄影风格，日光，色彩鲜艳，焦点清晰，略带广角透视。在最顶部添加一条细长的桌面窗口/标题栏，包含类似电脑截图的时间戳和位置的小字。

布局：将三位女性置于前景，展示从头部到大腿上部或膝盖的全身像。左侧女性身穿带有白色侧边装饰的深蓝色竞速泳装，短发，黑色，身体微向中心转动。中间女性身穿亮面灰褐色竞速泳装，棕色头发扎起，一只手靠近胸前，仿佛正在接受采访。右侧女性较高，身穿带有亮蓝色侧板的黑色竞速泳装，齐肩黑发，双手背在身后，身体微向中心转动。为所有 3 个面部添加矩形马赛克模糊效果。

背景：阳光明媚的一天，繁忙的户外市政泳池，有浅色混凝土甲板、蓝色泳池、游泳者、家庭、遮阳伞、树木、铁丝网围栏、横跨泳池的白色拱形人行桥以及多个蓝色安全锥。在中景处准确放置 4 个显眼的蓝色安全锥：一个在左侧甲板附近，一个在左中区域后方，一个在右中区域附近，另一个在更靠右的泳池边缘附近。

文字内容：在左上角添加两行醒目的彩色日文标题：{argument name="top headline" default="フレッシュプール撮影会\n水着美女にインタビュー!!"}。使用粗圆字体，白色填充，黑色描边，配以红/粉/黄装饰，呈现俏皮的综艺节目风格。在底部添加一行几乎横跨整个宽度的巨大字幕：{argument name="bottom caption" default="『ちっぱい番付』に出ています"}。底部文字设为白色带黑色描边，并在选定字符上使用粉色强调，以匹配日式综艺节目的字幕效果。

视觉风格：超写实的夏季泳池摄影与日式电视节目缩略图图形相结合，明亮饱和的蓝色和绿色，强烈的阳光，清晰的皮肤高光，写实的泳装面料光泽，充满活力的构图。

约束条件：所有女性必须表现为成年人，内容非色情，站姿自然，无裸露，无暗示性姿势，前景中不得有额外人员，必须保留 3 个模糊的面部以及 3 位主要的泳装采访对象。

目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Party Sheep"} 设计一张色彩缤纷的可爱角色设定图，这是一个以音乐、连接和派对氛围为主题的充满活力的社交吉祥物。

画布：宽幅横向角色设定图，比例约为 16:9，白色背景，点缀粉色和金色闪光、音符、小星星以及俏皮的装饰性花纹。采用精致的动漫/Q 版概念艺术风格，线条清晰，高光亮丽，阴影柔和，呈现出贴纸般的质感。

左上角标题区：大型装饰性标题文字“PARTY SHEEP”，采用粉色到金色的优雅衬线字体，周围环绕小闪光和音符。下方是较小的文字“AC Sheep”，然后是亮粉色的大号日文“パリピ羊”。再下方是一个带有金色饰边的黑色丝带横幅，上面写着“The Social Energy Connector”。添加一个简短的描述块：“一只为连接和美好氛围而生的活力小羊。Party Sheep 将人们聚在一起，分享能量，让每一刻都变成庆典。交流 (connection) 就是能量！”

顶部中央资料卡：柔粉色圆角矩形边框，包含 5 行标签：1) 物种：Party Sheep (パリピ羊)，2) 性格：外向、热情、有魅力，3) 喜好：派对、人群、音乐、美好氛围、二维码、舞蹈、分享能量，4) 讨厌：尴尬的沉默、无聊的计划、电量低，5) 特殊特质：AC 波浪羊毛——能量通过连接流动。朋友越多，波浪越亮！在卡片内包含一个带有白色发光波浪符号的粉色圆形图标。

右上角调色板：添加粉色标题“COLOR PALETTE”。横向展示 5 个圆形色样，下方标注小号十六进制颜色代码：1) 深海军蓝“#1A1A2E”，2) 炭紫色“#2D2D44”，3) 亮粉色“#FF69B4”，4) 金黄色“#FFD700”，5) 浅白或奶油色点缀，位于右侧边缘附近。

主体角色：一位 Q 版小羊女孩吉祥物，拥有小麦色皮肤，大而有光泽的洋红色眼睛，部分视角中一只眼睛在眨眼，蓬松的奶油色羊毛头发带有鲜艳的粉色卷发，刘海处有发光的霓虹粉色波浪图案。她有羊耳朵，卷发中隐藏着小角，张嘴开心地笑着，还有一条黑色的小羊尾巴。服装：黑色超大款派对夹克，带有金色铆钉、链条、星星贴片、粉色霓虹波浪图案，黑色露脐上衣，带有褶边的短裙或短裤，厚底黑色松糕鞋，鞋底发出亮粉色光芒，佩戴金色首饰、圆环耳环、手链、吊饰，以及一个小型手机或二维码配件。角色应给人以魅力十足、善于社交且充满音乐感的感觉，周围环绕着亮粉色的无线信号弧线。

角色三视图布局：底部展示 4 个全身 Q 版视图，每个视图均用粉色文字和闪光标记：1) 最左侧为正面视图，较小的姿势，比着剪刀手并拿着手机，2) 左中为 3/4 侧视图，最大的姿势，眨眼微笑，拿着智能手机并比着剪刀手，3) 右中为侧视图，侧面姿势拿着手机，展示蓬松的羊毛体积和夹克细节，4) 最右侧为背面视图，展示夹克背面，带有霓虹波浪图案、蓬松的粉色和奶油色羊毛、尾巴、靴子以及粉色信号弧线。

视觉风格：可爱的日式角色设定图，精致的吉祥物试镜艺术作品，高能量的偶像街头服饰美学，清晰易读的排版，亮粉色和金色点缀，干净的白色留白，布局平衡。

约束：保持 4 个视图的三视图布局和 5 行资料卡。确保所有可见的英文和日文文字清晰可辨。不要添加额外的角色、额外的视图、水印、Logo 或写实渲染。

templates.title: Japanese Pool Interview Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 日式泳池采访缩略图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic Japanese YouTube-style variety/interview thumbnail at an outdoor public swimming pool, showing three adult women in competitive one-piece swimsuits standing on a pool deck during a sunny summer day.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 image, bright daylight, high-resolution photorealistic look with a slightly over-saturated online thumbnail finish. Include a thin computer-window title bar at the very top with small system text, as if the image is a screenshot.

Main subjects: Exactly 3 adult women stand in the foreground, all with intentionally blurred/pixelated faces for privacy. Left woman: short black hair, navy blue athletic one-piece swimsuit with white side accents, standing turned slightly toward the center. Center woman: tied-back brown hair, glossy taupe/gray one-piece swimsuit, one hand raised near her chest, standing on a green pool mat. Right woman: tall woman with shoulder-length black hair, black one-piece swimsuit with bright blue side panels and thin gray curves, hands behind her back, facing toward the center. The three subjects should appear to be casually talking during an interview, not posing like a fashion shoot.

Background: Outdoor public pool complex with pale concrete deck, turquoise swimming pools, many distant swimmers and families, blue traffic cones around the deck, a white arched pedestrian bridge over the pool, chain-link fence on the left, dense green trees, blue sky with light clouds, and summer event atmosphere.

Text content: Add large Japanese variety-show thumbnail text. Top-left headline in two lines: {argument name="top headline text" default="フレッシュプール撮影会"} and {argument name="subheadline text" default="水着美女にインタビュー!!"}. Use bold rounded Japanese lettering with white fill, thick black outline, and bright pink/yellow accent strokes. Bottom caption across the lower third: {argument name="bottom caption text" default="『ちっぱい番付』に出ています"}. Make the bottom caption very large, white and pink characters with a heavy black outline and slight drop shadow, matching Japanese TV variety aesthetics.

Visual style: Photorealistic camera shot, wide-angle documentary composition, bright summer colors, crisp poolside details, strong thumbnail contrast, playful entertainment-news design. Keep the faces blurred as rectangular soft mosaic blocks. Do not add extra people in the foreground beyond the 3 women, and do not add any logos or watermarks other than the small swimsuit brand-like marks already implied by the suits.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张逼真的日式 YouTube 综艺/采访风格缩略图，场景设定在户外公共游泳池，展示三位身穿竞技连体泳衣的成年女性在夏日阳光下的泳池甲板上。

画布：16:9 宽屏图像，明亮的日光，高分辨率写实风格，带有略微过饱和的在线缩略图质感。顶部包含一个细长的电脑窗口标题栏，带有小型系统文字，营造出截图的视觉效果。

主体：前景中站立着 3 位成年女性，为了保护隐私，她们的面部均经过模糊/马赛克处理。左侧女性：短黑发，身穿带有白色侧边装饰的藏青色运动连体泳衣，身体略微转向中心。中间女性：棕色扎发，身穿亮面灰褐色连体泳衣，一只手靠近胸前，站在绿色泳池垫上。右侧女性：高个子，齐肩黑发，身穿带有亮蓝色侧边和灰色细曲线的黑色连体泳衣，双手背在身后，面向中心。三位主体应呈现出采访时随意的交谈状态，而非时尚大片的摆拍姿势。

背景：户外公共泳池设施，浅色混凝土甲板，绿松石色的游泳池，远处有许多游泳者和家庭，甲板周围摆放着蓝色交通锥，泳池上方有一座白色拱形人行桥，左侧为铁丝网围栏，茂密的绿树，蓝天白云，充满夏季活动氛围。

文字内容：添加醒目的日式综艺节目缩略图文字。左上角标题分为两行：{argument name="top headline text" default="フレッシュプール撮影会"} 和 {argument name="subheadline text" default="水着美女にインタビュー!!"}。使用粗圆体日文字体，白色填充，黑色粗描边，并带有亮粉色/黄色的强调笔触。底部横跨下三分之一处的字幕：{argument name="bottom caption text" default="『ちっぱい番付』に出ています"}。底部字幕需非常醒目，采用白字粉边、黑色粗描边并带有轻微投影，以符合日本电视综艺的美学风格。

视觉风格：写实摄影，广角纪录片构图，明亮的夏季色彩，清晰的泳池细节，强烈的缩略图对比度，趣味性的娱乐新闻设计。保持面部为矩形柔和马赛克模糊处理。除这 3 位女性外，前景不要添加额外人物，除泳衣上隐含的品牌标志外，不要添加任何其他 Logo 或水印。

templates.title: Gothic Cyberpunk Duo in Ruined City

titleLocalized.zh: 废墟都市中的哥特赛博朋克双人组

templates.prompt: Create a vertical dark fantasy cyberpunk anime illustration of two full-body characters walking toward the viewer through a shattered digital city at night. The scene contains exactly 2 main characters: a tall male-presenting figure on the left and a slightly shorter female-presenting figure on the right. The left character has {argument name="male hair color" default="messy black hair"}, a slim elegant build, an all-black gothic suit with a long torn feathered coat, sharp layered lapels, belts, gloves, boots, dangling chains, glossy armor-like details, and violet highlights; his left hand is raised in a graceful open gesture. The right character has {argument name="female hair color" default="long flowing platinum-blonde hair"}, a pale elegant build, a revealing black-and-lavender gothic dress with a high slit, translucent flowing sleeves and cape panels, ornate black metallic chest ornaments, thigh straps, jewelry-like accents, and pointed heels. Add exactly 2 opaque square face-obscuring blocks, one centered over each character’s face, in muted purple-gray tones. The background is a ruined futuristic megacity filled with glitch artifacts, vertical neon data streaks, cracked reality-like lightning fractures, reflective wet pavement, and floating broken architectural fragments; include exactly 7 prominent debris pieces: two large slabs at the upper right, one hovering craft-like fragment near the upper center-right, one dark platform on the left edge, one flat shard on the mid-right edge, one broken chunk near the lower left, and one dark slab near the lower right. Use a palette of deep black, violet, indigo, lavender, electric purple, and scattered chromatic RGB glitch speckles. Lighting should be dramatic and backlit, with high contrast, iridescent reflections, intricate painterly detail, torn fabric motion, and a melancholic apocalyptic atmosphere. Style: highly detailed Japanese anime key visual, gothic couture, cyberpunk ruin, painterly digital art, cinematic composition, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的暗黑奇幻赛博朋克动漫插画，描绘两名全身角色在夜晚穿过破碎的数字城市，向观众走来。场景中包含 2 名主要角色：左侧为一名高大的男性化形象，右侧为一名稍矮的女性化形象。左侧角色拥有 {argument name="male hair color" default="凌乱的黑发"}，身材修长优雅，身着全黑哥特式套装，配有长款破损羽毛大衣、锋利的叠层翻领、皮带、手套、靴子、悬挂的链条、光泽感盔甲细节以及紫罗兰色高光；他的左手优雅地抬起，呈张开姿势。右侧角色拥有 {argument name="female hair color" default="飘逸的长白金发"}，身材苍白优雅，身着露肤的黑紫色哥特长裙，带有高开叉、半透明的飘逸袖子和斗篷裁片、华丽的黑色金属胸饰、大腿绑带、珠宝装饰以及尖头高跟鞋。在每位角色的面部中心各添加 1 个不透明的方形遮挡块，色调为柔和的紫灰色。背景是一座充满故障伪影、垂直霓虹数据流、如现实裂痕般的闪电、反光的湿润路面以及漂浮的破碎建筑碎片的未来主义废墟巨型都市；包含 7 个显著的碎片：右上角两块大板、中上方附近一个类似飞行器的碎片、左边缘一个深色平台、中右边缘一个扁平碎片、左下方一个破碎块以及右下方一个深色板。使用深黑、紫罗兰、靛蓝、薰衣草紫、电光紫以及散落的 RGB 色差故障斑点调色板。光影应具有戏剧性的背光效果，高对比度，带有虹彩反射、复杂的绘画细节、撕裂的织物动感以及忧郁的末日氛围。风格：高细节日本动漫关键视觉图、哥特时装、赛博朋克废墟、绘画感数字艺术、电影级构图、无文字、无水印。

templates.title: Japanese Manga Creation App Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 日式漫画创作 App 截图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical smartphone app screenshot showing a completed manga creation preview inside a Japanese UI, with an anime-style comic page about a blonde schoolgirl meeting an elegant elf-like character at an AI character festival.

Canvas: Tall mobile screenshot, approximately 9:16 aspect ratio, white app background. At the very top is a simple app header: a black “×” close icon on the left and the centered Japanese title “漫画を作成(1/1)” in bold black text. At the bottom is a large rounded coral-to-pink gradient button labeled “公開” in white.

Main comic layout: The comic page occupies most of the screen between the header and the publish button. Use crisp black manga panel borders. There are exactly 3 visible comic areas: 1) a narrow cropped top-left area showing part of the schoolgirl and a speech bubble, 2) a top section split diagonally between the elf character close-up and the festival booth scene, and 3) one large bottom panel showing a handshake.

Characters: Include exactly 2 main characters, repeated across the panels. Character A is a cute blonde teenage schoolgirl with twin ponytails, pink-dipped hair ends, blue eyes, a white short-sleeve shirt, navy tie, dark pleated skirt, and a small teddy-bear badge on her shirt. Character B is a tall beautiful elf-like fantasy person with very long blond hair, pointed ears, blue crystal hair ornaments, pale skin, and ornate silver-white futuristic armor with glowing blue gems and cape-like details. Cover the faces of the close-up characters with flat beige rectangular privacy blocks, as if anonymized.

Top comic section: On the right side, show Character A standing in a convention or festival hall holding a smartphone. Behind her is a warm blurred booth sign reading “SynClub” and indistinct people. Add an orange rectangular caption box at the lower right of this top section reading “SynClub in\nAIキャラクターフェスティバル”. On the left/center of the top section, show Character B from the front and back in a dramatic diagonal split-panel composition, with glowing blue fantasy details.

Bottom comic panel: Show Character A and Character B facing each other and shaking hands warmly. Character A looks excited and friendly; Character B looks slightly shy or nervous. The background is a bright pastel burst of warm light, sparkles, and celebratory rays.

Text content: Use exactly 5 speech bubbles with Japanese text: 1) cropped bubble at left: “一緒について行ってもいいですか？” 2) vertical bubble near Character B in top section: “実はボク…迷子になっちゃって” 3) top-right bubble near Character A: “あの…すみません” 4) bottom-center bubble from Character A: “いいよ！私、心愛姫ここあ！よろしくね！あなたは？” 5) bottom-right bubble from Character B: “…し…シンクラ”.

Visual style: Polished modern Japanese anime and webtoon style, clean line art, glossy lighting, soft gradients, warm convention lighting, bright fantasy blue accents, high detail clothing, expressive manga speech bubbles, smartphone screenshot realism.

Constraints: Keep the UI text and button clearly legible. Use exactly 5 speech bubbles, exactly 2 main character designs, and the 3 comic areas described. Do not add extra panels, extra major characters, watermarks, or English translations inside the image. Customizable app title: {argument name="app title" default="漫画を作成(1/1)"}. Customizable booth name: {argument name="booth name" default="SynClub"}. Customizable event caption: {argument name="event caption" default="SynClub in AIキャラクターフェスティバル"}. Customizable publish button text: {argument name="publish button text" default="公開"}. Customizable elf name line: {argument name="elf name line" default="…し…シンクラ"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张垂直智能手机 App 截图，展示在日式 UI 内完成的漫画创作预览，内容为关于一名金发女学生在 AI 角色节上偶遇一位优雅精灵般角色的动漫风格漫画页面。

画布：长款手机截图，比例约为 9:16，白色 App 背景。最顶部是一个简洁的 App 标题栏：左侧为黑色“×”关闭图标，中间为加粗黑色日文标题“漫画を作成(1/1)”。底部是一个大的圆角珊瑚粉至粉色渐变按钮，上面标有白色文字“公开”。

漫画主布局：漫画页面占据标题栏和发布按钮之间的大部分屏幕空间。使用清晰的黑色漫画分镜边框。共有 3 个可见的漫画区域：1) 左上角狭窄的裁剪区域，展示女学生和对话气泡；2) 顶部区域，对角线分割为精灵角色特写和节日展位场景；3) 底部一个大分镜，展示握手画面。

角色：包含 2 个主要角色，在不同分镜中重复出现。角色 A 是一位可爱的金发少女，扎着双马尾，发梢带有粉色挑染，蓝色眼睛，身穿白色短袖衬衫、海军蓝领带、深色百褶裙，衬衫上别着一个小泰迪熊徽章。角色 B 是一位高挑美丽的精灵般奇幻角色，留着极长的金发，尖耳朵，佩戴蓝色水晶发饰，皮肤白皙，身穿华丽的银白色未来感盔甲，带有发光的蓝色宝石和斗篷细节。将特写角色的面部用平面的米色矩形遮挡块覆盖，以示匿名处理。

漫画顶部区域：右侧展示角色 A 站在展会或节日大厅中拿着智能手机。她身后是一个模糊的暖色调展位招牌，写着“SynClub”，背景中有模糊的人群。在该顶部区域的右下角添加一个橙色矩形说明框，写着“SynClub in\nAIキャラクターフェスティバル”。在顶部区域的左侧/中间，以戏剧性的对角线分割构图展示角色 B 的正面和背面，并带有发光的蓝色奇幻细节。

漫画底部区域：展示角色 A 和角色 B 面对面热情握手。角色 A 看起来兴奋且友好；角色 B 看起来有些害羞或紧张。背景是明亮的柔和光芒、闪光和庆祝的光束。

文本内容：使用 5 个带有日文文本的对话气泡：1) 左侧裁剪气泡：“一緒について行ってもいいですか？” 2) 顶部区域角色 B 附近的垂直气泡：“実はボク…迷子になっちゃって” 3) 角色 A 右上方的气泡：“あの…すみません” 4) 角色 A 底部中间的气泡：“いいよ！私、心愛姫ここあ！よろしくね！あなたは？” 5) 角色 B 右下方的气泡：“…し…シンクラ”。

视觉风格：精致的现代日式动漫和条漫风格，干净的线条，光泽感光影，柔和的渐变，温暖的展会灯光，明亮的奇幻蓝色点缀，高细节服装，生动的漫画对话气泡，真实的智能手机截图感。

约束条件：保持 UI 文本和按钮清晰可辨。使用 5 个对话气泡，2 个主要角色设计，以及描述的 3 个漫画区域。不要添加额外的分镜、额外的主要角色、水印或图像内的英文翻译。可自定义 App 标题：{argument name="app title" default="漫画を作成(1/1)"}。可自定义展位名称：{argument name="booth name" default="SynClub"}。可自定义活动说明：{argument name="event caption" default="SynClub in AIキャラクターフェスティバル"}。可自定义发布按钮文本：{argument name="publish button text" default="公开"}。可自定义精灵名称行：{argument name="elf name line" default="…し…シンクラ"}。

templates.title: Anime Manga Festival Meeting Page

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫漫画节相遇页面

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished vertical anime manga page in a romantic fantasy-meets-school-event style, showing a shy elf knight meeting a cheerful schoolgirl at an AI character festival. Use clean manga panel borders, soft lighting, expressive speech bubbles, and a bright shoujo atmosphere.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page, approximately 9:16 aspect ratio. Divide the page into exactly three panels: two smaller panels across the top separated by a diagonal black gutter, and one large full-width panel on the bottom. Use crisp black panel borders and white gutters.

Characters: Feature exactly two main characters. Character 1 is a tall, slender blonde elf woman named {argument name="elf character name" default="Shinkura"}, with very long pale-blonde hair, pointed ears, blue eyes, delicate blush, and ornate silver fantasy armor with glowing cyan-blue crystal details, a white-and-blue cape, and decorative blue hair ornaments. Character 2 is a petite blonde schoolgirl named {argument name="schoolgirl character name" default="Kokoro Hime"}, with twin ponytails fading into pink tips, a white short-sleeve school shirt, navy tie, dark pleated skirt, small earrings, pink nail polish, and a cute bear patch on her shirt labeled “AIORA.” Faces may be softly anonymized with beige rectangular censor blocks over both characters’ faces while preserving hair, body language, and outfits.

Layout and panel content: Top-left panel: close side view of the schoolgirl looking up at the elf knight, who faces her while holding one hand near her chest; warm sparkles in the background. Add two vertical Japanese speech bubbles: schoolgirl says {argument name="schoolgirl invitation text" default="一緒について行ってもいいですか？"}; elf says {argument name="elf shy reply text" default="実はボク…迷子になっちゃって"}. Top-right panel: rear view of the elf knight from behind, showing her long hair and pointed ear, looking toward the schoolgirl standing in front of a blurred convention venue entrance with an orange sign partially reading “SynClu.” The schoolgirl holds a smartphone with both hands. Add one speech bubble from the schoolgirl saying “あの…すみません”. Add an orange rectangular caption box at the lower right reading “SynClub in AIキャラクターフェスティバル”. Bottom panel: large emotional meeting scene with the schoolgirl and elf facing each other and shaking hands at center. The schoolgirl smiles confidently; the elf blushes shyly with sweat-drop marks. Radiant golden-pink burst background with sparkles. Add exactly two vertical speech bubbles: schoolgirl says {argument name="handshake promise text" default="いいよ！私、心愛姫（ここあ）！よろしくね！あなたは？"}; elf says “:し…シンクラ”.

Visual style: High-quality Japanese anime illustration, clean line art, glossy eyes, soft gradients, detailed costume rendering, warm pastel highlights, cinematic depth of field in the convention background, shoujo manga sparkle effects, professional webcomic finish.

Constraints: Keep exactly three panels, exactly two main characters, exactly five speech bubbles plus one orange caption box. Preserve the visible Japanese text exactly where specified. Do not add extra characters in the foreground, extra dialogue, watermarks, page navigation buttons, or logos beyond the small shirt patch and partial venue sign.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一个精致的竖版动漫漫画页面，风格融合浪漫奇幻与校园活动，展现一位害羞的精灵骑士在 AI 角色节上与一位开朗女高中生相遇的场景。使用清晰的漫画分镜边框、柔和的灯光、富有表现力的对话气泡以及明亮的少女漫氛围。

画布：高竖版漫画页面，比例约为 9:16。将页面精确划分为三格：顶部两个较小的分格，中间由对角线黑色间隙隔开；底部为一个全宽的大分格。使用清晰的黑色分镜边框和白色间隙。

角色：包含两个主要角色。角色 1 是一位身材高挑纤细的金色精灵女性，名为 {argument name="elf character name" default="Shinkura"}，拥有极长的浅金色长发、尖耳朵、蓝色眼睛、精致的红晕，身穿带有发光青蓝色水晶细节的华丽银色奇幻盔甲，披着白蓝相间的斗篷，佩戴装饰性蓝色发饰。角色 2 是一位娇小的金发女高中生，名为 {argument name="schoolgirl character name" default="Kokoro Hime"}，留着发梢渐变为粉色的双马尾，身穿白色短袖校服衬衫、海军蓝领带、深色百褶裙，戴着小耳环，涂着粉色指甲油，衬衫上有一个写着“AIORA”的可爱小熊贴布。角色面部可用米色矩形遮挡块进行柔和处理，同时保留发型、肢体语言和服装细节。

布局与分镜内容：左上格：侧面特写，女高中生抬头看向精灵骑士，精灵骑士面对着她，一手放在胸前；背景中有温暖的闪光。添加两个竖排日语对话气泡：女高中生说 {argument name="schoolgirl invitation text" default="一緒について行ってもいいですか？"}；精灵说 {argument name="elf shy reply text" default="実はボク…迷子になっちゃって"}。右上格：精灵骑士的背影，展示其长发和尖耳朵，看向站在模糊的展会入口前的女高中生，入口处有部分写着“SynClu”的橙色招牌。女高中生双手拿着智能手机。添加一个女高中生的对话气泡，写着“あの…すみません”。在右下角添加一个橙色矩形标题框，写着“SynClub in AIキャラクターフェスティバル”。底部大格：充满情感的相遇场景，女高中生与精灵面对面，在画面中心握手。女高中生自信地微笑着；精灵害羞地脸红并带有汗滴符号。背景为光芒四射的金色粉色爆发效果，伴有闪光。添加两个竖排对话气泡：女高中生说 {argument name="handshake promise text" default="いいよ！私、心愛姫（ここあ）！よろしくね！あなたは？"}；精灵说“:し…シンクラ”。

视觉风格：高质量日本动漫插画，干净的线条艺术，闪亮的眼睛，柔和的渐变，细腻的服装渲染，温暖的柔和高光，展会背景具有电影感的景深，少女漫画闪光效果，专业的网络漫画质感。

约束条件：保持精确的三格分镜，精确的两个主要角色，精确的五个对话气泡外加一个橙色标题框。严格保留指定位置的日语文本。前景中不得添加额外角色、额外对话、水印、页面导航按钮，或除衬衫小贴布和部分展会招牌以外的任何标志。

templates.title: SynClub Anime Character QR Poster

titleLocalized.zh: SynClub 动漫角色二维码海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical anime-style mobile app promotional poster for SynClub featuring one original character, {argument name="character name" default="神崎 心愛姫"}, in front of a brightly lit arcade sign.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, approximately 768×1024, full-bleed illustration with a dark translucent gradient overlay at the bottom for readable text. High saturation, glossy anime game-ad aesthetic.

Main subject: Exactly 1 anime girl centered in close-up from upper torso upward. She has long blonde hair in exactly 2 high twin-tails tied with dark bands, soft peach-pink tips, large purple heart-shaped sunglasses resting on top of her head, visible ears with small black earrings, and a white open-collar top. Her face is intentionally covered by one large centered rectangular privacy mask, a flat semi-opaque gray-to-warm-gray block occupying most of the face and chest area. Her right hand is raised near the lower left foreground, making a playful pointing gesture toward the viewer, with pink manicured nails. The character should feel cute, flashy, confident, and idol-like.

Background: Neon arcade or entertainment venue interior, slightly blurred. At the very top is a huge cropped sign with rounded red-and-white lettering suggesting “SynClub” or a similar bubbly logo. Below it is a bright cyan glowing sign band with pale white lettering. On both left and right edges, include soft-focus arcade-machine panels with blue, purple, and pink lights.

Visible text and graphic elements: Include exactly 5 text/graphic blocks: 1) faint small white disclaimer text near the top left reading {argument name="disclaimer text" default="この画像はAIによって生成されたものです"}; 2) large white Japanese name text on the lower left reading {argument name="display name text" default="神崎 心愛姫"}; 3) two lines of smaller white Japanese profile copy beneath/around the name, partially obscured by the character and gradient, reading as a poetic teaser; 4) bottom-left SynClub logo consisting of a small coral-red rounded gamepad/chat icon followed by the wordmark “SynClub” in white, with “Club” bold; 5) bottom-right white square QR-code card with a black QR pattern and a small coral SynClub icon in the center, with white Japanese call-to-action text to its left reading {argument name="call to action text" default="今すぐチャットしよう！"}.

Composition: Character dominates the frame, with her twin-tails filling both sides. The large gray rectangle must sit exactly over the central face area and obscure the eyes, nose, mouth, and much of the torso. Place the QR code in the lower-right corner, the SynClub logo in the lower-left corner, and the character name above the logo. Use clean white typography with a subtle glow or shadow for legibility.

Visual style: Polished Japanese anime illustration, mobile game ad, glossy highlights on hair, soft rim lighting, neon cyan and magenta color palette, shallow depth of field, dramatic poster lighting, crisp foreground character against blurred arcade background.

Constraints: Do not add extra characters. Keep exactly 1 QR code, exactly 1 face-obscuring rectangle, exactly 1 bottom-left SynClub logo, and exactly 1 main character name. No watermark beyond the intentional app branding and disclaimer.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 SynClub 创建一张竖版动漫风格的移动端 App 宣传海报，主角为一名原创角色 {argument name="character name" default="神崎 心爱姫"}，背景为灯火通明的游戏厅招牌。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，尺寸约为 768×1024，全出血插画，底部带有深色半透明渐变遮罩，以确保文字清晰可读。高饱和度，具有光泽感的动漫游戏广告美学。

主体：画面中心为 1 名动漫少女的半身特写（从上躯干向上）。她留着长长的金色双马尾，发梢带有柔和的桃粉色，头顶架着一副巨大的紫色心形太阳镜，耳朵上戴着小巧的黑色耳环，身穿白色翻领上衣。她的脸部被一个居中的大型长方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮住，这是一个平面的半透明灰色至暖灰色色块，占据了大部分面部和胸部区域。她的右手抬起靠近左下角前景，做出俏皮的指向观众的手势，指甲涂成粉色。角色应呈现出可爱、华丽、自信且偶像化的气质。

背景：霓虹灯闪烁的游戏厅或娱乐场所内部，略带模糊。最上方是一个巨大的裁剪招牌，带有圆润的红白相间文字，暗示“SynClub”或类似的泡泡字体 Logo。下方是一条明亮的青色发光灯带，上面有浅白色的文字。左右两侧包含柔焦的游戏机面板，带有蓝色、紫色和粉色的灯光。

可见文字与图形元素：包含 5 个文字/图形区块：1) 左上角附近微小的白色免责声明文字，内容为 {argument name="disclaimer text" default="この画像はAIによって生成されたものです"}；2) 左下角醒目的白色日文名称，内容为 {argument name="display name text" default="神崎 心愛姫"}；3) 名称下方/周围两行较小的白色日文简介文案，部分被角色和渐变遮挡，作为诗意的预告；4) 左下角的 SynClub Logo，包含一个小巧的珊瑚红色圆润游戏手柄/聊天图标，后跟白色“SynClub”字标，其中“Club”为加粗字体；5) 右下角的白色方形二维码卡片，带有黑色二维码图案，中心有一个小巧的珊瑚色 SynClub 图标，左侧配有白色日文行动呼吁文字 {argument name="call to action text" default="今すぐチャットしよう！"}。

构图：角色占据画面主体，双马尾填充两侧空间。巨大的灰色长方形必须精确覆盖面部中心区域，遮挡眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴以及大部分躯干。将二维码放置在右下角，SynClub Logo 放置在左下角，角色名称位于 Logo 上方。使用清晰的白色字体，并带有微弱的辉光或阴影以提高可读性。

视觉风格：精致的日式动漫插画，移动游戏广告风格，头发带有光泽高光，柔和的轮廓光，霓虹青色与洋红色调，浅景深，戏剧性的海报灯光，清晰的前景角色与模糊的游戏厅背景形成对比。

约束：不要添加额外角色。保持 1 个二维码、1 个遮挡面部的长方形、1 个左下角 SynClub Logo 以及 1 个主要角色名称。除预设的 App 品牌标识和免责声明外，不得包含任何水印。

templates.title: SynClub Elf Character Promo Card

titleLocalized.zh: SynClub 精灵角色宣传卡

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical promotional character card for SynClub featuring an original elf AI character in a dark fantasy forest.

Canvas: Portrait smartphone-poster format, 3:4 aspect ratio, about 768×1024 px. Use a cinematic anime illustration style with soft bloom, high-detail hair, shallow depth of field, and moody teal-green lighting.

Main subject: A close-up bust portrait of {argument name="character name" default="シンクラ"}, an elegant elf girl facing slightly to the right. She has very long silky {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} hair, pale skin, and one large pointed elf ear extending sharply to the right with warm pink-orange inner-ear shading. Her face is intentionally hidden by a large opaque gray-beige rectangular block centered over the face, covering from forehead to below the nose area. Her clothing is dark and partially visible near the bottom, with a delicate fantasy-collar impression.

Background: A dim enchanted forest with tall dark tree trunks, blue-green haze, scattered soft light rays from above, and tiny floating specks of light. Keep the background blurred and atmospheric so the character and typography stand out.

Text content and placement: Add exactly 6 text groups. 1) Top-left small translucent white disclaimer: 「この画像はAIによって生成されるものです」. 2) Left-middle large bold white character name: 「シンク」. 3) Below the name, smaller white label: 「AIキャラ」. 4) Across the lower middle in white Japanese body copy over the character: 「SynClubのエルフ。会場で彷徨っていたところへ、偶然アナタが通りかかり、一緒にブース巡りをす…」 with the same truncated feeling. 5) Bottom-left SynClub branding: a coral-red chat-face logo icon followed by “SynClub” in white, with “Club” bold. 6) Bottom-right call to action in white beside the QR code: 「今すぐチャットしよう！」 split across two short lines.

QR and branding details: Place a white rounded-square QR code block at the bottom right, about one fifth of the canvas width, with black QR modules and a small coral SynClub-style icon in the center. The call-to-action text sits immediately to the left of the QR code.

Visual style: Polished AI-anime promotional banner, fantasy character app advertisement, soft glow, high contrast between white text and dark forest, clean modern typography, no extra characters, no additional logos beyond SynClub, no watermark except the visible AI-generated disclaimer.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 SynClub 创建一张竖版角色宣传卡，展示一位置身于暗黑奇幻森林中的原创 AI 精灵角色。

画布：竖屏手机海报格式，3:4 比例，约 768×1024 像素。采用电影级动漫插画风格，带有柔和光晕、高细节发丝、浅景深以及忧郁的青绿色调灯光。

主体：{argument name="character name" default="シンクラ"} 的半身特写肖像，一位优雅的精灵少女，面部略微朝向右侧。她拥有非常长且丝滑的 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"} 头发，皮肤白皙，右侧有一只尖尖的大精灵耳朵，耳内侧带有温暖的粉橙色阴影。她的面部被一个位于中心、从额头覆盖至鼻下区域的不透明灰米色矩形色块刻意遮挡。她的服装颜色较深，在底部隐约可见，带有精致的奇幻领口设计。

背景：昏暗的魔法森林，有高大的深色树干、蓝绿色薄雾、从上方洒下的柔和光束以及微小的漂浮光点。背景需保持模糊且富有氛围感，以突出角色和排版。

文字内容与排版：添加 6 组文字。1) 左上角小型半透明白色免责声明：「この画像はAIによって生成されるものです」。2) 左侧中部大型加粗白色角色名：「シンク」。3) 名字下方较小的白色标签：「AIキャラ」。4) 下部中间覆盖在角色身上的白色日文正文：「SynClubのエルフ。会場で彷徨っていたところへ、偶然アナタが通りかかり、一緒にブース巡りをす…」（保持截断感）。5) 左下角 SynClub 品牌标识：一个珊瑚红色的聊天表情图标，后接白色“SynClub”字样，其中“Club”加粗。6) 右下角二维码旁边的白色行动号召文字：「今すぐチャットしよう！」（分两行排列）。

二维码与品牌细节：在右下角放置一个白色圆角正方形二维码，约占画布宽度的五分之一，二维码模块为黑色，中心带有小型的珊瑚色 SynClub 风格图标。行动号召文字位于二维码正左侧。

视觉风格：精致的 AI 动漫宣传横幅，奇幻角色应用广告，柔和光效，白色文字与深色森林形成高对比，简洁现代的排版，无多余角色，除 SynClub 外无其他标识，除可见的 AI 生成免责声明外无水印。

templates.title: Annotated Manga App Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 带标注的漫画 App 截图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a tall smartphone screenshot showing a manga/comic preview inside a mobile app, with an instructional annotation pointing to a menu icon at the top.

Canvas: Vertical 9:16 mobile screenshot, white app background, high-resolution anime manga art framed by a phone UI. The top navigation bar is about 80 px tall with a back chevron on the far left, a centered Japanese title, and two icons on the right.

Top app UI: Show exactly 4 top-bar elements: 1 black back arrow on the left, 1 centered title reading {argument name="screen title" default="みんな来てね(GPT ver) (1..."}, 1 black list/menu icon near the upper right, and 1 black share/export icon at the far right. Add exactly 1 bright magenta circle around the list/menu icon and exactly 1 oversized hot-pink arrow pointing diagonally upward toward that circled icon from the manga area.

Main comic layout: A full-color anime manga page divided into exactly 3 diagonal panels with thick black panel borders. The art style is glossy, detailed, romantic fantasy shoujo manga with soft lighting, sparkles, pink heart effects, and a convention/exhibition setting.

Panel 1: Wide top panel showing a busy futuristic convention booth for an AI character festival. In the foreground, show a blonde teenage girl from behind with twin ponytails fading into pink tips, wearing a white shirt with “A.C.F” printed on the back and holding a smartphone. To her right stands a tall elegant male elf with very long silver-white hair, pointed ears, ornate silver armor, and blue crystal details, seen from behind/side. Booth signage should include “SynClub” and “SynClub in AIキャラクターフェスティバル.” Include exactly 1 speech bubble in this panel near the elf, with Japanese text beginning “あの…”. The large hot-pink arrow partially covers the upper-right area of this panel.

Panel 2: Middle diagonal panel with a close-up of the girl on the left and the elf facing her on the right, against a dreamy pastel background. The girl has heart-shaped blue-purple sunglasses pushed on her head, blonde twin tails with pink ends, earrings, and an excited expression area obscured. The elf wears ornate silver clothing and holds or touches a glowing blue crystal at his chest. Add exactly 2 speech bubbles in this panel: one near the elf reading “実はボク…迷子になっちゃって 一緒について行ってもいいですか?” and one small decorative vertical pink reaction text reading “うわ…♥”. Place exactly 2 beige rectangular face-censor blocks in this panel, one over each character’s face.

Panel 3: Large bottom panel with energetic pink speed lines and hearts. The girl reaches one hand forward toward the viewer, wearing a white blouse, navy tie, blue skirt, heart sunglasses on her head, and an A.C.F badge with a small teddy bear. The elf is seen from behind/right with long silver hair and pointed ear, looking at her. Add exactly 2 speech bubbles: the girl’s bubble on the left reading “いいよ! 私、心愛姫(ここあ)! よろしくね! あなたは?” and the elf’s bubble on the lower right reading “…し…シンクラ”. Place exactly 1 beige rectangular face-censor block over the girl’s face. Overlay exactly 2 dark gray circular carousel navigation buttons near the bottom center, one with a white left chevron and one with a white right chevron.

Visible repeated elements count: exactly 3 manga panels, exactly 5 speech bubbles total, exactly 3 beige face-censor rectangles, exactly 2 carousel buttons, exactly 1 magenta circle, exactly 1 hot-pink arrow, exactly 4 top navigation elements.

Visual style: polished anime illustration, crisp smartphone screenshot, saturated pink annotation graphics, detailed lighting, convention crowd blur in the background, clean app UI. Keep the image vertically cropped like a social media screenshot, with no extra watermark beyond the visible booth and comic text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张竖版智能手机截图，展示移动 App 内的漫画/连环画预览，并添加指向顶部菜单图标的说明性标注。

画布：9:16 竖版手机截图，白色 App 背景，高分辨率动漫漫画艺术，由手机 UI 框定。顶部导航栏高度约为 80 像素，最左侧有一个返回箭头，中间为日语标题，右侧有两个图标。

顶部 App UI：准确显示 4 个顶部栏元素：左侧 1 个黑色返回箭头，中间 1 个标题显示为 {argument name="screen title" default="みんな来てね(GPT ver) (1..."}，右上角附近 1 个黑色列表/菜单图标，最右侧 1 个黑色分享/导出图标。在列表/菜单图标周围添加 1 个亮洋红色圆圈，并从漫画区域添加 1 个超大的亮粉色箭头，斜向上指向该圆圈图标。

主要漫画布局：全彩动漫漫画页面，由 3 个对角线面板组成，面板边框为粗黑色。艺术风格为光泽、细腻的浪漫奇幻少女漫画，带有柔和的灯光、闪光、粉色爱心特效以及展会/展览背景。

Visual style: crisp high-detail pixel art / 16-bit inspired game asset, dramatic blue lighting, strong contrast, no blur, no UI, no spaceships, no characters, no text, no watermark. promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个垂直复古像素风太空射击游戏背景，采用 9:16 移动游戏比例，设计为具有无缝滚动感的关卡背景。场景为深邃的外太空，背景为深海军蓝至黑色的星空，中央留有宽阔的空白飞行通道以供游戏进行。在通道左中和右中边缘垂直添加两条发光的蓝色星云流，并点缀青色粒子、明亮的小星星和偶尔闪烁的星光。在通道周围布置小行星带：共计 34 颗可见的岩石小行星，大小不一，形状不规则且呈锯齿状，表面为深炭灰色，边缘带有电光蓝色的轮廓光。具体布局如下：左上角 1 颗巨大的被裁剪小行星，左侧边缘中部 1 颗巨大的被裁剪小行星，左下边缘附近 1 颗大型小行星，左下角 1 颗大型被裁剪小行星，右上边缘附近 1 颗大型小行星，右侧边缘中部 1 颗大型小行星，右下边缘 1 颗大型被裁剪小行星，右下角附近 1 颗大型小行星，外加 26 颗较小的小行星散布在左右两侧，同时保持中央区域开阔。在右上象限包含一颗被裁剪的巨大蓝色行星，具有发光的大气边缘、可见的弧形地平线、细腻的表面纹理以及明亮的青色边缘光。视觉风格：清晰的高细节像素艺术 / 16 位游戏资产风格，戏剧性的蓝色光效，强对比度，无模糊，无 UI，无飞船，无角色，无文字，无水印。使用 {argument name="dominant color" default="电光蓝与深海军蓝"}, {argument name="aspect ratio" default="垂直 9:16"}, {argument name="central gameplay corridor" default="宽阔的垂直空白通道"}, {argument name="planet position" default="右上象限"}, 以及 {argument name="asteroid count" default="34 颗可见小行星"}。

templates.title: Retro Space Shooter VFX Sprite Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 复古太空射击游戏 VFX 精灵图集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean white-background production asset sheet for a vertical retro pixel-art space shooter, showing separate glowing projectile, explosion, pickup, asteroid, and particle-effect sprites in a consistent 2D pixel-art style.

Canvas: Square 1:1 sprite sheet, about 768×768 px, pure white background, no grid, no labels, no borders, sprites evenly spaced in horizontal rows with transparent-looking whitespace around each asset.

Visual style: High-resolution retro pixel art with crisp edges, neon glow, saturated colors, arcade shoot’em-up VFX, black or dark outlines only where needed, additive bloom-like halos, no text.

Color palette: Use three main energy colors: {argument name="cyan energy color" default="electric cyan"}, {argument name="purple energy color" default="magenta violet"}, and {argument name="green energy color" default="lime green"}, plus orange/yellow fire for explosions and gray-brown rocks for asteroids.

Layout and exact asset count: Arrange exactly 103 visible sprites in 8 rows. Row 1: 17 cyan player-shot sprites, including tiny bullets, small teardrop shots, medium diamonds, paired vertical bolts, triple clusters, grouped shard volleys, three narrow exclamation-like bolts, two long laser beams, one large missile-like glowing spear, and two cyan starburst impact flashes. Row 2: 16 purple enemy-shot sprites, including small round bullets, larger orbs, a thin diamond bolt, paired bolts, triple grouped bolts, clustered shards, three vertical capsules, three single vertical bolts, and two purple starburst impacts. Row 3: 16 green enemy-shot sprites matching the purple row types: small diamonds, larger diamonds, a bright spear bolt, paired bolts, triple grouped bolts, clustered shards, three capsules, three single vertical bolts, and two green starburst impacts. Row 4: 15 special energy sprites: three circular neon orbs in cyan, purple, and green; three larger cracked plasma orbs in cyan, purple, and green; three vertical ground-strike laser columns in cyan, purple, and green with splashing bases; one solid cyan vertical beam; and three droplet-over-ring portal effects in cyan, purple, and green. Row 5: 9 explosion and impact sprites: five orange fire explosions decreasing from very large to tiny, followed by four purple electric impact bursts decreasing from medium to tiny plus a small diamond sparkle at the end. Row 6: 10 gameplay objects and small shots: one green health pickup icon with a white plus sign, one green mechanical power-up module, one dark spiked mine, four orange arrow/fireball projectile frames facing right, and three purple homing/particle projectile clusters. Row 7: 10 asteroid/debris sprites: six rocky asteroids decreasing from large to pebble size, followed by four broken debris clusters of scattered rock fragments. Row 8: 10 particle sparkle clusters: two cyan sparkle clusters, two purple sparkle clusters, two green sparkle clusters, two orange sparkle clusters, and two sparse orange trailing sparkle clusters.

Subject details: Make the projectiles readable as individual game sprites, each centered in its own whitespace area. Energy bullets should be symmetrical, vertically oriented where appropriate, and glow softly. Explosions should use layered yellow cores, orange petals, red outlines, and scattered sparks. Asteroids should be irregular dark rock forms with pixel highlights and shadows. Pickups should be bolder and more icon-like than projectiles.

Constraints: Generate only the sprite sheet assets, not a gameplay screenshot. No background scene, no UI, no characters, no ships, no typography, no watermark. Keep every asset isolated and production-ready for cutting into tiles or sprites.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为竖版复古像素风太空射击游戏创建一套干净的白色背景生产素材图集，展示独立的流光弹幕、爆炸、拾取物、小行星和粒子特效，并保持统一的 2D 像素艺术风格。

画布：1:1 正方形精灵图集，约 768×768 像素，纯白背景，无网格、无标签、无边框，素材在水平行中均匀分布，每个素材周围留有透明感的空白区域。

视觉风格：高分辨率复古像素艺术，边缘清晰，带有霓虹光效，色彩饱和，街机射击游戏 VFX 风格，仅在必要处使用黑色或深色轮廓，带有加法混合的辉光光晕，无文字。

调色板：使用三种主要能量色：{argument name="cyan energy color" default="电光青"}、{argument name="purple energy color" default="洋紫罗兰"} 和 {argument name="green energy color" default="亮柠檬绿"}，外加用于爆炸的橙色/黄色以及用于小行星的灰褐色。

布局与精确素材数量：在 8 行中排列 103 个可见精灵。第 1 行：17 个青色玩家射击精灵，包括微型子弹、小水滴弹、中型菱形弹、成对垂直弹、三连簇射、碎片齐射、三个窄感叹号状弹、两条长激光束、一个大型发光导弹状长矛和两个青色星爆冲击闪光。第 2 行：16 个紫色敌方射击精灵，包括小圆弹、大型球体、细菱形弹、成对弹、三连簇射、碎片簇、三个垂直胶囊弹、三个单发垂直弹和两个紫色星爆冲击。第 3 行：16 个与紫色行类型匹配的绿色敌方射击精灵：小菱形弹、大型菱形弹、明亮长矛弹、成对弹、三连簇射、碎片簇、三个胶囊弹、三个单发垂直弹和两个绿色星爆冲击。第 4 行：15 个特殊能量精灵：三个青、紫、绿色的圆形霓虹球；三个青、紫、绿色的裂纹等离子球；三个青、紫、绿色的垂直地面打击激光柱（带溅射底座）；一个实心青色垂直光束；以及三个青、紫、绿色的环上水滴传送门特效。第 5 行：9 个爆炸与冲击精灵：五个从大到小的橙色火焰爆炸，随后是四个从中到小的紫色电击冲击爆发，末尾带有一个小菱形闪光。第 6 行：10 个游戏对象和小弹幕：一个带白色加号的绿色生命拾取图标、一个绿色机械强化模块、一个深色尖刺地雷、四个朝右的橙色箭头/火球弹幕帧，以及三个紫色追踪/粒子弹幕簇。第 7 行：10 个小行星/碎片精灵：六个从大到鹅卵石大小的岩石小行星，随后是四个破碎的岩石碎片簇。第 8 行：10 个粒子闪光簇：两个青色闪光簇、两个紫色闪光簇、两个绿色闪光簇、两个橙色闪光簇和两个稀疏的橙色拖尾闪光簇。

主体细节：确保弹幕作为独立的游戏精灵清晰可辨，每个精灵都居中于其空白区域内。能量子弹应保持对称，在适当的情况下垂直定向，并带有柔和的光晕。爆炸应使用分层的黄色核心、橙色花瓣、红色轮廓和散落的火花。小行星应为不规则的深色岩石形态，带有像素高光和阴影。拾取物应比弹幕更醒目、更具图标感。

约束：仅生成精灵图集素材，而非游戏截图。无背景场景、无 UI、无角色、无飞船、无排版、无水印。保持每个素材独立，并可直接用于切割成瓦片或精灵。

templates.title: Vertical Pixel Space Shooter Background

titleLocalized.zh: 竖版像素风太空射击游戏背景

templates.prompt: Create a vertical retro pixel-art space shooter scrolling background, designed as a seamless mobile game asset. The canvas is a tall 9:16 portrait frame with a dark central flight corridor left mostly open for gameplay. Fill the scene with a deep black starfield, hundreds of tiny white, blue, and violet pixel stars, and two luminous vertical nebula streams: one winding down the left side in electric purple and blue, and one winding down the right side in purple with cyan highlights. Add exactly 3 visible planets: a large purple cratered planet near the upper left edge, a large blue-purple rim-lit planet partially cropped on the lower right edge, and a small purple moon just below that lower-right planet. Add exactly 22 rocky asteroids of varied sizes, irregular cratered gray-brown forms with purple shadowing, distributed around the border while keeping the center mostly clear: 1 huge asteroid near the upper right, 1 medium asteroid at the right-middle edge, 1 medium asteroid at the lower left edge, 1 large asteroid cropped at the bottom left corner, 1 large asteroid cropped at the lower right corner, plus 17 smaller asteroids scattered near the top edge, side edges, and lower border. Use crisp pixel-art rendering with high-detail dithering, chunky jagged silhouettes, bright rim highlights, no outlines that look vector-smooth, no ships, no UI, no text, no watermark. Color palette: black space, violet and magenta nebula clouds, electric blue accents, white star glints, gray rocky asteroids with cool purple shadows. The image should feel production-ready as a vertical shoot ’em up background tile, dramatic but readable, with the gameplay lane clear in the center.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版复古像素风太空射击游戏滚动背景，设计为无缝衔接的移动端游戏素材。画布采用 9:16 的高比例竖屏框架，深色的中央飞行通道保持大部分留白，以供游戏操作。场景填充深邃的黑色星空，点缀数百颗细小的白色、蓝色和紫色像素星点，以及两条发光的垂直星云流：左侧是一条蜿蜒而下的电光紫蓝色星云，右侧是一条带有青色高光的紫色星云。添加 3 颗清晰可见的行星：左上方边缘有一颗巨大的紫色陨石坑行星，右下方边缘有一颗被部分裁剪的蓝紫色轮廓光行星，以及在那颗右下行星下方的一颗小型紫色卫星。添加 22 颗大小不一的岩石小行星，形状为带有紫色阴影的不规则灰褐色坑洼状，分布在边界周围，同时保持中心区域开阔：右上角附近 1 颗巨大陨石，右侧中部边缘 1 颗中型陨石，左下边缘 1 颗中型陨石，左下角 1 颗被裁剪的大型陨石，右下角 1 颗被裁剪的大型陨石，其余 17 颗较小陨石散布在顶部边缘、侧边和底部边界。采用清晰的像素艺术渲染，具备高细节的抖动效果、厚实的锯齿轮廓、明亮的边缘高光，无矢量平滑轮廓，无飞船，无 UI，无文字，无水印。调色板：黑色太空、紫红色星云云团、电光蓝点缀、白色星光闪烁、带有冷紫色阴影的灰色岩石小行星。图像应呈现出可直接用于生产的竖版飞行射击游戏背景图效果，既具戏剧性又具备良好的可读性，确保中心游戏通道清晰。

templates.title: Retro Pixel Space Shooter Sprites

titleLocalized.zh: 复古像素风太空射击游戏精灵图

templates.prompt:
Create a clean sprite-sheet style asset image for a vertical retro pixel-art space shooter, on a plain white background with no grid and no labels. Show exactly 11 separate pixel-art spaceship and power-up sprites arranged in three rows, all with crisp black outlines, high-contrast shading, metallic panels, tiny vents, glowing cores, and 16-bit arcade detailing. Use a saturated sci-fi palette dominated by {argument name="main ship color" default="deep violet purple"}, teal/cyan, dark navy, black, gold/orange armor accents, and neon green energy lights.

Layout: top row contains exactly 3 large player/enemy ships: left is a small blue-white-and-gold triangular fighter with three bright cyan engine flames; center is the largest wide boss ship, symmetrical and heavily armored, purple and teal with multiple wing spikes, twin side cannons, gold trim, and a large glowing green hexagonal reactor in the middle; right is a tall vertical purple capital ship with pointed nose, side fins, teal panels, gold details, and a glowing green central reactor. Middle row contains exactly 4 medium enemy ships: a crescent-shaped teal and purple craft with two upward curved horns and a green cockpit glow; a compact rear-view purple winged fighter with side thrusters; a squat central gunship with teal cockpit dome, purple wings, gold barrels, and twin cannons; a broad purple bomber with swept wings, side engine pods, and a large dark central intake. Bottom row contains exactly 4 small collectible or module sprites: two square neon-green reactor power-up tiles with beveled purple/teal/gold frames, followed by two identical small cylindrical engine or booster pods with teal top caps, purple bodies, gold front panels, black exhausts, and tiny side fins.

Style constraints: production-ready pixel art, orthographic/top-down view, transparent-asset feel but rendered on white, sharp square pixels, no anti-aliased painterly look, no text, no watermark, no shadows beyond pixel-art contact shading, consistent scale hierarchy and spacing, like a polished mobile shoot’em-up tileset.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个干净的精灵图风格素材图像，用于竖版复古像素风太空射击游戏，背景为纯白色，无网格，无标签。展示 11 个独立的像素艺术宇宙飞船和道具精灵图，排列成三行，均具有清晰的黑色轮廓、高对比度阴影、金属面板、微小通风口、发光核心和 16 位街机细节。使用饱和的科幻配色方案，主色调为 {argument name="main ship color" default="深紫罗兰色"}，辅以青色/蓝绿色、深海军蓝、黑色、金色/橙色装甲点缀以及霓虹绿能量灯。

布局：顶行包含 3 个大型玩家/敌方飞船：左侧为小型蓝白金三色三角形战斗机，带有三个明亮的青色引擎火焰；中间为最大的宽体 Boss 飞船，对称且装甲厚重，紫色与青色相间，带有多个翼尖、双侧炮、金色装饰以及中央一个巨大的发光绿色六边形反应堆；右侧为高大的垂直紫色主力舰，带有尖头、侧鳍、青色面板、金色细节和发光绿色中央反应堆。中间行包含 4 个中型敌方飞船：一个新月形的青紫色飞行器，带有两个向上弯曲的角和绿色的驾驶舱光芒；一个紧凑的后视紫色翼型战斗机，带有侧推进器；一个矮胖的中央炮艇，带有青色驾驶舱圆顶、紫色机翼、金色炮管和双联装火炮；一个宽大的紫色轰炸机，带有后掠翼、侧引擎舱和巨大的深色中央进气口。底行包含 4 个小型可收集道具或模块精灵图：两个方形霓虹绿反应堆道具块，带有斜面紫色/青色/金色边框；随后是两个相同的圆柱形引擎或助推器舱，带有青色顶盖、紫色主体、金色前板、黑色排气口和微小的侧鳍。

风格限制：生产级像素艺术，正交/俯视视角，具有透明素材感但渲染在白色背景上，清晰的方形像素，无抗锯齿绘画感，无文字，无水印，除像素艺术接触阴影外无其他阴影，保持一致的比例层级和间距，呈现出精致的移动端射击游戏图集效果。

templates.title: Vintage Golden Era Icon Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古黄金时代偶像海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical vintage cinematic celebrity poster styled like an aged “Golden Era Icon” archive file, featuring {argument name="celebrity name" default="KYRIE CHEUNG"} as the dominant typography and a moody side-profile portrait on the right.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, dark sepia and burnt-red palette, distressed paper texture, worn edges, scratches, dust, faded ink, subtle vignette, archival classified-document aesthetic.

Layout: Left third is typography-heavy; right two-thirds show a young East Asian man standing in profile facing left. Top left contains a boxed label reading “GOLDEN ERA ICON” with thin horizontal rules, two small stars, and a circular dragon emblem. Below it, place huge stacked condensed block letters: “KYRIE” on top and “CHEUNG” below, in tall vintage gold type. Under the name, add a thin divider with a small star, then the decade label “2020s”. Beneath that, add the quote {argument name="quote text" default="“世人皆 Gay, 我独Straight”"} in gold, mixing Chinese characters with the English words Gay and Straight. Lower left includes a faded red circular stamp reading “ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD”. Bottom left reads {argument name="file label" default="FILE No.01"} with thin decorative lines and small star/floral ornaments.

Subject details: The person is a slim young adult East Asian male with dark slightly messy medium-length hair, shown from head to thigh in right-side profile. His face is deliberately blurred/obscured by a rectangular soft blur block. He wears a loose off-white long-sleeve button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, tucked into dark high-waisted trousers with a black belt. One hand rests in his trouser pocket, and a wristwatch is visible. Pose is relaxed, elegant, and introspective.

Background: Dark old Chinese architectural setting with a deep red wall, shadowy roof eaves at the top, decorative circular roof ornaments and patterned trim. Lighting is low, dramatic, warm, and directional, casting soft shadows and emphasizing the vintage poster mood.

Visual style: 1930s–1970s Chinese noir poster meets modern editorial photography, grainy film texture, letterpress typography, aged gold ink, high contrast, cinematic shadows, historical archive design. Use exactly 1 portrait figure, 1 dragon emblem, 2 large name words, 1 decade label, 1 quote block, 1 circular classified stamp, and 1 file-number block. No extra logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张垂直的复古电影名人海报，风格仿照陈旧的“黄金时代偶像”档案文件，以 {argument name="celebrity name" default="KYRIE CHEUNG"} 作为主要排版，右侧配以忧郁的侧面肖像。

画布：肖像海报，2:3 纵横比，深褐色与焦红色调，做旧纸张纹理，磨损边缘，划痕，灰尘，褪色墨迹，微妙的暗角，档案机密文件美学。

布局：左侧三分之一为重排版区域；右侧三分之二展示一名年轻东亚男性侧身站立，面向左侧。左上角包含一个带细横线、两颗小星和一个圆形龙纹徽章的方框标签，内写“GOLDEN ERA ICON”。下方放置巨大的堆叠压缩块状字母：“KYRIE”在上，“CHEUNG”在下，采用高大的复古金色字体。在名字下方，添加一条带有小星的细分隔线，然后是年代标签“2020s”。在其下方，添加引语 {argument name="quote text" default="“世人皆 Gay, 我独Straight”"}，采用金色字体，混合中文字符与英文单词 Gay 和 Straight。左下角包含一个褪色的红色圆形印章，写着“ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD”。底部左侧写有 {argument name="file label" default="FILE No.01"}，配以细装饰线和小型星形/花卉装饰。

主体细节：人物为一名身材苗条的年轻东亚男性，留着深色、略显凌乱的中长发，从头部到大腿的右侧侧面展示。他的面部被一个矩形柔焦块刻意模糊/遮挡。他穿着一件宽松的米白色长袖衬衫，袖口卷起，束在深色高腰长裤内，系着黑色皮带。一只手插在裤兜里，手腕上戴着手表。姿态放松、优雅且内敛。

背景：深色的中国古代建筑场景，配有深红色墙壁、顶部的阴影屋檐、装饰性圆形屋顶饰物和图案饰边。光线昏暗、戏剧化、温暖且具有方向性，投射出柔和的阴影，强调复古海报的氛围。

视觉风格：1930 年代至 1970 年代的中国黑色电影海报与现代编辑摄影的结合，颗粒感胶片纹理，凸版印刷排版，陈旧的金色墨水，高对比度，电影级阴影，历史档案设计。使用 1 个肖像人物、1 个龙纹徽章、2 个大型名字单词、1 个年代标签、1 个引语块、1 个圆形机密印章和 1 个文件编号块。不含额外的标志或水印。

templates.title: TinyToes Giant Baby Shoes Ad

titleLocalized.zh: TinyToes 巨型婴儿鞋广告

templates.prompt: Create a vertical heartwarming baby product advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="TINYTOES"}. Use a soft cream studio background with oversized pale pink rounded typography repeating the brand name in five large horizontal rows behind the subject, partially obscured by the foreground. In the center foreground, show exactly two enormous plush pastel pink baby Mary Jane shoes, about 2.5 times the height of the kneeling adult, made of fuzzy fleece fabric with rounded toes, padded collars, pull tabs, and wide Velcro straps. Embroider the brand name in raised white letters on each strap, and add one tiny pink bow on the outer side of each strap, for exactly two bows total. A young mother with long brown hair kneels on the left beside the giant shoes, smiling warmly and leaning close to them; she wears a cream ribbed knit sweater, beige pants, and socks, with a gentle lifestyle-ad pose. Scatter playful nursery decorations around the scene: exactly six floating puffy hearts in pastel blue, pink, and yellow; exactly two small puffy stars; and small confetti pieces on the background and floor. Keep the lighting bright, soft, and airy, with subtle shadows, premium product-photography realism, pastel colors, cozy texture detail, and a wholesome baby-brand mood. Add the bottom slogan in large muted rose rounded letters: {argument name="slogan text" default="Every tiny step matters."}. Ensure the poster feels like a polished baby-shoes campaign, no extra logos, no watermark, no harsh colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="TINYTOES"} 创建一张竖版温馨的婴儿产品广告海报。使用柔和的奶油色摄影棚背景，背景中以五行巨大的淡粉色圆体字重复品牌名称，并被前景部分遮挡。在前景中央，展示两只巨大的毛绒淡粉色婴儿玛丽珍鞋，高度约为跪姿成年人的 2.5 倍，采用毛绒材质，圆头设计，配有加厚鞋口、提拉环和宽大的魔术贴绑带。在每条绑带上用凸起的白色字母绣上品牌名称，并在每条绑带外侧各加一个小粉色蝴蝶结，总共两个蝴蝶结。一位留着棕色长发的年轻母亲跪在左侧，靠在巨型鞋子旁，面带温暖的微笑，身体微微前倾；她穿着奶油色罗纹针织衫、米色裤子和袜子，呈现出柔和的生活方式广告姿态。在场景周围散布俏皮的育儿装饰：六个漂浮的淡蓝色、粉色和黄色蓬松爱心；两个小巧的蓬松星星；以及背景和地面上的小纸屑。保持光线明亮、柔和、通透，带有微妙的阴影，呈现高端产品摄影的真实感、柔和的色彩、舒适的质感细节以及温馨的婴儿品牌氛围。在底部添加大号柔和玫瑰色圆体字标语：{argument name="slogan text" default="Every tiny step matters."}。确保海报呈现出精致的婴儿鞋广告质感，无额外标志，无水印，无刺眼的颜色。

templates.title: Vintage Golden Era Icon Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古黄金时代偶像海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical vintage celebrity archive poster for {argument name="character name" default="Kyrie Cheung"}, styled like a worn Golden Era film-icon dossier.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 poster, dark sepia and burnt-red palette, heavy grunge texture, scratched paper edges, faded ink, dust, stains, and distressed print aging. Use dramatic low-key lighting and cinematic shadows.

Layout: Split composition with typography dominating the left half and a full-body fashion portrait on the right. The left side contains exactly 6 text/graphic blocks: 1) a small top badge reading “GOLDEN ERA ICON” with a circular dragon emblem, two horizontal rules, and 2 small stars; 2) a huge stacked condensed serif title reading “KYRIE” above “CHEUNG”; 3) a small divider with 1 centered star and the text “2020s”; 4) a quotation block reading {argument name="quote" default="“世人皆 Gay, 我独Straight”"}; 5) a red circular stamped seal reading “ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD”; 6) a bottom file label reading {argument name="file number" default="FILE No.01"} with thin lines and tiny decorative stars/floral marks.

Subject details: On the right side, show one slim young East Asian man in profile facing left, standing with relaxed posture and one hand in his trouser pocket. He wears an off-white wrinkled button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, high-waisted dark trousers, a black belt, and a wristwatch. His hair is short, thick, and black, slightly messy. Cover or censor the face with a soft rectangular blur/pixelated block in a brown skin-tone color so facial identity is obscured.

Background and ornaments: The background is a dim red-brown interior wall with a traditional Chinese roof-eave detail across the top. Include exactly 4 visible circular roof ornaments along the upper edge with patterned cloth-like trim beneath them. Add a dark shadow behind the figure on the right.

Visual style: Retro Asian noir poster, 1930s-to-1970s archive aesthetic, tall bold letterpress typography, muted gold ink, blackened corners, worn border, subtle vignette, realistic portrait photography mixed with graphic poster design.

Constraints: Keep all visible text legible and distressed, preserve the Chinese quote exactly as written, do not add extra people, do not add modern clean UI elements, and avoid bright saturated colors.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Kyrie Cheung"} 创建一张竖版复古名人档案海报，风格仿照磨损的黄金时代电影偶像档案。

画布：2:3 比例肖像海报，深棕褐色与焦红色调，厚重的颗粒质感，磨损的纸张边缘，褪色的墨迹、灰尘、污渍以及做旧的印刷老化效果。使用戏剧性的低调照明和电影感阴影。

布局：分割构图，左侧以排版为主，右侧为全身时尚肖像。左侧包含 6 个精确的文字/图形区块：1) 顶部一个小徽章，写有“GOLDEN ERA ICON”，配有圆形龙纹徽标、两条水平线和 2 颗小星星；2) 一个巨大的堆叠式紧凑衬线字体标题，上方为“KYRIE”，下方为“CHEUNG”；3) 一个小型分隔符，中间有一颗星，文字为“2020s”；4) 一个引语区块，内容为 {argument name="quote" default="“世人皆 Gay, 我独Straight”"}；5) 一个红色的圆形印章，写有“ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD”；6) 底部一个文件标签，内容为 {argument name="file number" default="FILE No.01"}，配有细线和微小的装饰性星形/花卉标记。

主体细节：在右侧，展示一名身材瘦削的年轻东亚男性侧影，面朝左侧，姿态放松，一只手插在裤兜里。他穿着一件米白色褶皱衬衫，袖子卷至前臂，搭配高腰深色长裤、黑色腰带和手表。他的头发短而浓密，黑色，略显凌乱。用棕色肤色的柔和矩形模糊/像素块遮盖或审查面部，以隐藏身份。

背景与装饰：背景为昏暗的红棕色室内墙壁，顶部带有传统中式屋檐细节。在上边缘包含 4 个清晰可见的圆形屋顶装饰，下方有类似布艺的饰边。在右侧人物身后添加深色阴影。

视觉风格：复古亚洲黑色电影海报，1930 年代至 1970 年代的档案美学，高大的粗体活字印刷排版，暗金色墨水，黑化的边角，磨损的边框，微妙的暗角，写实人像摄影与图形海报设计的结合。

约束条件：保持所有可见文字清晰且具有做旧感，完整保留中文引语，不要添加额外人物，不要添加现代简洁的 UI 元素，避免使用明亮饱和的色彩。

templates.title: Peach Blossom Xianxia First Encounter

titleLocalized.zh: 桃花仙侠初遇

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic romantic xianxia poster of {argument name="character name" default="Zhao Ling'er"} during a peach-blossom first encounter, vertical 2:3 composition. Show a young, innocent, gentle Chinese fairy-like woman in a flowing {argument name="dress color" default="pale blue and white"} hanfu, standing beside a clear turquoise stream and turning back toward the viewer with one arm extended forward as if inviting the viewer to take her hand. Her long dark hair is half-up in an elegant bun with floral hairpins, silver ornaments, beads, and long translucent blue ribbons streaming in the breeze; her skirt and sleeves are layered, sheer, and luminous, with a dark waist sash and delicate fantasy embroidery. The face area is covered by a simple square soft brown censor block centered over the face. Surround her with abundant pink peach blossoms: branches arch across the top and sides, blossoms frame the foreground with dreamy bokeh, and loose petals drift through the air. Background: an idyllic ancient Chinese garden valley with traditional wooden pavilions on the left and mid-distance, an arched stone bridge over the stream, mossy rocks, sparkling water reflections, and misty green mountains fading into bright morning haze. Mood: not dark, not oppressive, not cold or tragic; instead pure, tender, lively, lovable, heart-stirring, and innocent. Use ultra-detailed cinematic realism, soft pastel colors, luminous backlight from the upper right, shallow depth of field, gentle lens bloom, sparkling water highlights, floating petals, ethereal fairy-tale atmosphere, high-end movie poster quality. No text, no logo, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感浪漫仙侠海报，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="赵灵儿"} 在桃花初遇时的场景，采用 2:3 竖构图。画面中是一位年轻、纯真、温婉的中国仙女，身着飘逸的 {argument name="dress color" default="浅蓝白色"} 汉服，站在清澈的绿松石色溪流旁，回眸看向观众，一只手臂向前伸出，仿佛在邀请观众牵起她的手。她乌黑的长发半挽成优雅的发髻，饰有花朵发簪、银饰、珠串，长长的半透明蓝色丝带在微风中飘动；裙摆和袖口层叠、轻盈且富有光泽，配有深色腰封和精致的奇幻刺绣。面部区域覆盖着一个简单的方形浅棕色马赛克遮挡块。周围环绕着繁茂的粉色桃花：枝条在顶部和两侧拱起，花朵以梦幻的虚化效果构筑前景，零星花瓣在空中飘落。背景：一个田园诗般的中国古代山谷，左侧和中景处有传统木质亭台，溪流上有拱形石桥，布满青苔的岩石，波光粼粼的水面反射，以及在明亮晨雾中隐约可见的青翠山峦。氛围：非阴暗、非压抑、非冷峻或悲剧感；而是纯净、温柔、生动、可爱、动人心弦且天真烂漫。采用超细节的电影级写实风格，柔和的粉彩色调，右上方的明亮背光，浅景深，柔和的镜头光晕，闪烁的水面高光，飘落的花瓣，空灵的童话氛围，高端电影海报质感。无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: AI Chat Screenshot With Censored Women

titleLocalized.zh: 带有遮挡女性的 AI 对话截图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot-style image of a clean AI image generation chat interface showing a generated photo result.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9-ish white interface, approximately 1200×690 pixels, with lots of white space and a single generated image card on the left-center.

Top prompt bubble: Place a rounded light-gray user message bubble near the top right containing Japanese text: {argument name="prompt text" default="二人の女性が向かい合って座っている。お互い相手の唇に人差し指をあてている"}. To the right/below the bubble, show exactly 2 small outline action icons: a copy icon inside a rounded square and a pencil/edit icon. Add a black tooltip under the copy icon with white Japanese text: 「メッセージをコピーする」.

Status text: On the left above the image card, write “Thought for 34s ›” in light gray.

Generated image card: A large rounded-corner photo card positioned left-center. Inside it, depict exactly 2 adult women sitting face-to-face in a warm studio portrait, cropped from about mid-torso upward. The left woman has dark brown hair in a messy bun, wears a black robe or blouse with lace trim, and faces right in profile. The right woman has blonde-highlighted hair in a loose bun, wears a white robe or blouse with lace trim, and faces left in profile. They are very close together, each raising one hand so that exactly 2 index fingers are visible total: the left woman’s index finger touches or points toward the right woman’s lips, and the right woman’s index finger touches or points toward the left woman’s lips. Use soft natural lighting, beige-gray studio background, realistic skin and fabric detail. Cover each woman’s face with a vertical rectangular blur/mosaic censor block matching skin tones, exactly 2 censor blocks total, obscuring facial features while leaving hair and hands visible.

Image-card overlays: In the bottom-left corner of the photo card, add the white Japanese label 「編集」. In the bottom-right corner of the photo card, add one semi-transparent circular download/share button with a white upward-arrow icon.

Bottom interface controls: Below the image card on the left, show exactly 2 small controls: an outline copy/duplicate icon and a three-dot ellipsis icon.

Visual style: Minimal modern web UI, white background, rounded corners, subtle shadows, muted gray typography, photorealistic generated image embedded inside the interface.

Constraints: Keep all visible text exactly as specified, preserve the Japanese characters, do not add extra people, do not add extra fingers or UI buttons, and keep the faces censored with rectangular blur blocks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张逼真的截图风格图像，展示一个简洁的 AI 图像生成对话界面，其中包含一张生成的照片结果。

画布：宽屏 16:9 左右的白色界面，尺寸约为 1200×690 像素，留白较多，左侧居中位置有一张生成的图像卡片。

顶部提示词气泡：在右上角附近放置一个圆角浅灰色用户消息气泡，内含日语文本：{argument name="prompt text" default="二人の女性が向かい合って座っている。お互い相手の唇に人差し指をあてている"}。在气泡的右侧或下方，显示 2 个小型的轮廓操作图标：一个圆角正方形内的复制图标和一个铅笔/编辑图标。在复制图标下方添加一个黑色工具提示框，内含白色日语文本：「メッセージをコピーする」。

状态文本：在图像卡片左上方，用浅灰色书写“Thought for 34s ›”。

生成的图像卡片：一张位于左侧居中的大圆角照片卡片。卡片内描绘 2 名成年女性在温暖的摄影棚肖像中面对面坐着，画面从躯干中部向上裁剪。左侧女性留着深棕色凌乱发髻，穿着黑色蕾丝边长袍或衬衫，侧身向右。右侧女性留着金色挑染的松散发髻，穿着白色蕾丝边长袍或衬衫，侧身向左。她们靠得非常近，每人举起一只手，总共可见 2 根食指：左侧女性的食指触碰或指向右侧女性的嘴唇，右侧女性的食指触碰或指向左侧女性的嘴唇。使用柔和的自然光，米灰色摄影棚背景，呈现逼真的皮肤和织物细节。用垂直矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡块覆盖每位女性的面部，遮挡块颜色与肤色匹配，总共 2 个遮挡块，在遮挡面部特征的同时保留头发和手部可见。

图像卡片叠加层：在照片卡片的左下角，添加白色日语标签「編集」。在照片卡片的右下角，添加一个带有白色向上箭头图标的半透明圆形下载/分享按钮。

底部界面控件：在图像卡片左下方，显示 2 个小型控件：一个轮廓复制/重复图标和一个三点省略号图标。

视觉风格：极简现代网页 UI，白色背景，圆角设计，细微阴影，柔和的灰色排版，界面内嵌入逼真的生成图像。

限制：保持所有可见文本与指定内容完全一致，保留日语字符，不要添加额外的人员，不要添加额外的手指或 UI 按钮，并确保面部使用矩形模糊块进行遮挡。

templates.title: Japanese AI Image Result UI

titleLocalized.zh: 日语 AI 图像结果 UI

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean screenshot-style web interface showing an AI image-generation result for the prompt {argument name="prompt text" default="二人の女性が向かい合って座っている。お互い相手の唇に人差し指をあてている"}.

Canvas: 1030×630 landscape screenshot on a white background, minimal modern chat UI, generous empty space, no browser chrome or watermark.

Layout: Place a rounded light blue-gray user prompt bubble near the top right, about 605 px wide and 90 px tall, containing the Japanese prompt text in dark gray. Below and left, add a small blue gradient sparkle icon followed by the Japanese label 「思考プロセスを表示」 and a small downward chevron. Center-left beneath that, place one generated image card with rounded corners, about 570×310 px. At the bottom left under the image, show exactly 4 feedback/action icons in a row: thumbs up, thumbs down, circular regenerate arrow, and vertical three-dot menu.

Generated image card content: A realistic candid cafe photograph of exactly 2 adult women sitting face-to-face at a small wooden table by a large window. The woman on the left has {argument name="left woman outfit" default="a cream knit sweater and dark skirt"}; the woman on the right has {argument name="right woman outfit" default="a blue denim jacket over a white top"}. They are leaning toward each other and each places one index finger gently on the other woman's lips at the same time, creating a playful intimate mirrored gesture. Their faces are intentionally anonymized with exactly 2 soft rectangular pixel/blur masks, one over each face. On the table include exactly 4 visible tabletop items: one glass of water, one small white cup, one saucer or small plate, and one smartphone. The cafe background is warm and cozy with wooden furniture, cushions, bookshelves, plants, window daylight, and a few softly blurred patrons in the distance.

Visual style: The surrounding interface should be crisp, flat, and Google-like, while the image card should look photorealistic with warm natural lighting, shallow depth of field, and documentary realism. Use Japanese UI text exactly where specified. Keep the composition faithful to a generated image result embedded inside a chat interface.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个简洁的截图风格网页界面，展示针对提示词 {argument name="prompt text" default="二人の女性が向かい合って座っている。お互い相手の唇に人差し指をあてている"} 的 AI 图像生成结果。

画布：1030×630 横向截图，白色背景，极简现代聊天 UI，留白充足，无浏览器边框或水印。

布局：在右上角附近放置一个圆角浅蓝灰色用户提示气泡，宽约 605 px，高约 90 px，内含深灰色日语提示文本。在下方左侧，添加一个小的蓝色渐变闪烁图标，后跟日语标签「思考プロセスを表示」以及一个小向下箭头。在该图标左下方居中位置，放置一张圆角生成的图像卡片，尺寸约为 570×310 px。在图像下方的左侧，并排显示 4 个反馈/操作图标：点赞、点踩、圆形重新生成箭头以及垂直三点菜单。

生成的图像卡片内容：一张写实的咖啡馆抓拍照片，画面中有 2 名成年女性面对面坐在大窗户旁的木制小桌前。左侧女性穿着 {argument name="left woman outfit" default="米色针织衫和深色裙子"}；右侧女性穿着 {argument name="right woman outfit" default="白色上衣外搭蓝色牛仔夹克"}。她们向对方倾身，同时将食指轻轻放在对方的嘴唇上，形成一种俏皮且亲密的镜像姿势。她们的面部经过刻意匿名处理，每张脸上各有一个柔和的矩形像素/模糊遮罩。桌面上包含 4 件可见物品：一杯水、一个小白杯、一个茶托或小盘子，以及一部智能手机。咖啡馆背景温暖舒适，配有木制家具、靠垫、书架、植物、窗外自然光，远处有几位模糊的顾客。

视觉风格：周围界面应清晰、扁平且具有 Google 风格，而图像卡片应呈现写实感，具备温暖的自然光、浅景深和纪实写实风格。在指定位置准确使用日语 UI 文本。构图需忠实于嵌入在聊天界面中的 AI 图像生成结果。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Elf and War Machine

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克精灵与战争机器

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed dark sci-fi anime illustration of a lone cyberpunk elf girl standing on an industrial metal platform in front of an enormous biomechanical war machine. The character is {argument name="character type" default="a petite blue-haired elf girl"} with pale skin, long pointed ears, a short chin-length bob haircut with bangs, red eyes, and a calm, slightly melancholic expression. She wears elaborate black gothic cyber-armor: spiked segmented shoulder pieces, a black armored bodice with red glowing jewel-like nodes, chainmail-like mechanical plating, torn sheer black skirt panels, asymmetrical thigh straps, sheer stockings, and sharp black high-heeled armored boots. Add small hair ornaments and many tiny metallic details, chains, buckles, spikes, skull motifs, and red accents throughout the outfit. Behind her, place {argument name="background machine" default="a colossal black insectoid/mecha battleship with horn-like fins and glowing red seams"}, filling most of the background and dwarfing the character. The environment is a towering dystopian shipyard or megastructure with cranes, scaffolding, pipes, hanging chains, catwalks, warning signs, and layered industrial platforms fading into cold blue haze. Use a vertical portrait composition, full-body view, character slightly right of center, low-angle cinematic perspective, with the giant machine looming diagonally behind her. Lighting should be moody and atmospheric: cool misty daylight from the upper left, deep shadows, subtle rim light, and scattered crimson glows from machinery and armor. Style: ultra-detailed anime concept art, dark fantasy cyberpunk, intricate mechanical design, sharp linework, painterly realism, high contrast, metallic textures, dramatic scale, no extra characters, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节极其丰富的暗黑科幻动漫插画，描绘一位孤独的赛博朋克精灵少女站在工业金属平台上，面对一台巨大的生物机械战争机器。角色为 {argument name="character type" default="一位娇小的蓝发精灵少女"}，拥有苍白的皮肤、长长的尖耳朵、齐下巴的波波头短发配刘海、红色的眼睛，表情平静且略带忧郁。她身穿精致的黑色哥特式赛博盔甲：带有尖刺的分段式肩甲、带有红色发光宝石节点的黑色盔甲胸衣、类似锁子甲的机械镀层、破损的黑色透视裙摆、不对称的大腿绑带、透视丝袜以及尖锐的黑色高跟盔甲靴。在服装各处添加小巧的发饰以及许多细小的金属细节、链条、扣环、尖刺、骷髅图案和红色点缀。在她身后，放置 {argument name="background machine" default="一艘巨大的黑色昆虫状/机甲战舰，带有角状鳍片和发光的红色接缝"}，占据大部分背景，使角色显得极其渺小。环境是一个高耸的反乌托邦造船厂或巨型建筑，布满起重机、脚手架、管道、悬挂的链条、猫道、警示标志和层叠的工业平台，逐渐消失在冰冷的蓝色雾气中。采用垂直肖像构图，全身视角，角色位于中心偏右，低角度电影化视角，巨大的机器在身后呈对角线耸立。灯光应具有情绪感和氛围感：左上方射入清冷的雾气日光，深邃的阴影，微妙的轮廓光，以及来自机械和盔甲的零星深红色光芒。风格：超精细动漫概念艺术、暗黑奇幻赛博朋克、复杂的机械设计、锐利的线条、绘画感写实、高对比度、金属质感、宏大的比例，无额外角色，无水印。

templates.title: Neon Anime Idol Fan Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹动漫偶像应援海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vivid, high-density anime-style digital illustration of a neon idol fan poster centered on a fashionable cyberpunk girl named {argument name="character name" default="Neo"}.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 composition, close-up waist-up framing, intense magenta, purple, cyan, and black color palette, glossy lighting, crowded concert atmosphere, glowing rounded rectangular neon border around the entire image.

Main subject: A stylish anime girl with short dark purple-black hair with electric violet highlights and some cyan streaks, wearing yellow-rimmed goggles on top of her head. She wears a black cropped top with a purple skull-bunny emblem, a black-and-purple oversized jacket covered with small punk patches, bunny/skull motifs, zippers, pins, and glossy reflections, plus a choker with a small purple flower-like charm. Her two hands are raised close to the camera and form a heart shape in front of her face, heavily foreshortened and softly blurred by depth of field. Place a large muted mauve square censor/placeholder block over the central face area, covering most facial features while leaving hair, goggles, hands, neck, chest, and outfit visible.

Visible text and graphic elements: Include exactly 3 major glowing fan-message elements: 1) a pink neon heart speech bubble in the upper left containing Japanese text 「今日はネオだけ見ててね？約束だよっ♡」, 2) a black round fan sign in the lower left with bright pink neon Japanese text 「ネオ」 and smaller white text 「しか勝たん」 plus tiny hearts and bunny doodles, 3) a rounded neon nameplate in the lower right containing a small pixel heart, the cyan-and-white Japanese name 「ネオ」, and a pink skull-bunny icon. Use the character name consistently in these signs if customized.

Foreground crowd details: Show exactly 4 visible glow sticks at the bottom/front: two bright purple sticks near the center, one cyan-blue stick at the lower right edge, and one small pink/purple stick partially visible. Add soft bokeh, luminous hearts, scribbles, and concert light streaks in the background.

Style: Hyper-saturated Japanese anime illustration, glossy idol-concert aesthetic, sharp detail on clothing and neon signage, soft motion blur on the hands and glow sticks, vibrant rim lighting, high contrast, energetic composition, cute-yet-edgy cyberpunk-punk mood.

Constraints: Keep the central mauve square face block clearly visible and rectangular; do not add extra large signs beyond the 3 specified message elements; keep the overall image packed with neon details but maintain the main heart-hand pose as the focal point.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张生动、高密度的动漫风格数字插画，制作一张以时尚赛博朋克少女 {argument name="character name" default="Neo"} 为中心的霓虹偶像应援海报。

画布：竖向 4:5 构图，腰部以上特写，采用强烈的洋红色、紫色、青色和黑色调，光泽感灯光，拥挤的演唱会氛围，整张图片周围环绕着发光的圆角矩形霓虹边框。

主体：一位时尚的动漫少女，留着深紫黑色短发，带有电光紫挑染和青色发丝，头戴黄色边框护目镜。她身穿黑色露脐上衣，上面印有紫色骷髅兔标志；外搭一件黑紫拼色超大款夹克，夹克上布满了朋克风格的小补丁、兔子/骷髅图案、拉链、徽章以及光泽感反光，颈部佩戴着带有紫色小花吊坠的颈圈。她的双手抬起靠近镜头，在脸前比出一个心形，运用强烈的透视缩短效果，并因景深效果而略显模糊。在面部中央区域放置一个大的柔和紫红色方形遮挡块/占位符，遮住大部分面部特征，但保留头发、护目镜、双手、颈部、胸部和服装的可见度。

可见文字与图形元素：包含 3 个主要的发光应援信息元素：1) 左上角一个粉色霓虹心形对话框，内含日文 「今日はネオだけ見ててね？約束だよっ♡」；2) 左下角一个黑色圆形应援牌，上面有亮粉色霓虹日文 「ネオ」 和较小的白色文字 「しか勝たん」，以及微小的心形和兔子涂鸦；3) 右下角一个圆角霓虹名牌，内含一个小像素心、青白色的日文名 「ネオ」 以及一个粉色骷髅兔图标。如果自定义了角色名，请在这些标志中保持一致。

前景人群细节：底部/前方展示 4 根清晰可见的荧光棒：中心附近两根亮紫色荧光棒，右下边缘一根青蓝色荧光棒，以及一根部分可见的小型粉/紫色荧光棒。背景添加柔和的虚化光斑、发光心形、涂鸦和演唱会光束。

风格：高饱和度日本动漫插画，光泽感偶像演唱会美学，服装和霓虹招牌细节锐利，手部和荧光棒带有柔和的动态模糊，充满活力的轮廓光，高对比度，充满能量的构图，可爱又前卫的赛博朋克风格。

约束条件：保持中央紫红色方形遮挡块清晰可见且呈矩形；除指定的 3 个信息元素外，不要添加额外的大型标志；保持整体画面充满霓虹细节，但确保以比心的手势作为视觉焦点。
