templates.title: Cybernetic Butler Concerned Speech

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博管家的关切独白

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style single-panel illustration of a loyal cybernetic butler in a luxurious Victorian mansion at night. The butler is shown from the waist up behind a glossy dark wooden desk, wearing a formal black tailcoat, black vest, striped white dress shirt, black tie, gold buttons, pocket watch chain, and a large pale gold rose boutonniere on the left lapel. His head is a tilted black widescreen monitor instead of a human face, with white Japanese text reading 「お嬢様」 followed by a yellow heart, centered on the screen. His visible hands are elegant white articulated robotic hands: one hand rests seriously over his chest, and the other reaches forward in a worried, pleading gesture toward the viewer. Add a tall vertical white speech bubble on the right with Japanese text reading 「……急がずに参りましょう。ですが、お嬢様ご自身の願いまで、先回りして諦めないでください。」 Set the scene in a warm, dimly lit study with a large window showing a dark blue city night outside, heavy curtains, framed art, carved furniture, and an ornate table lamp glowing on the right. On the desk include exactly three main tabletop objects: an engraved silver serving tray at lower left, a closed brown concierge memo notebook at lower right with a fountain pen on top, and a small vase or cluster of pale gold roses at far left. Use cinematic warm lighting, detailed metallic reflections, refined gothic-luxury atmosphere, shallow depth of field, high-detail anime rendering, elegant composition, no extra characters, no watermark. Customizable details: {argument name="screen address text" default="お嬢様"}, {argument name="screen icon" default="💛"}, {argument name="speech bubble text" default="……急がずに参りましょう。ですが、お嬢様ご自身の願いまで、先回りして諦めないでください。"}, {argument name="butler flower" default="pale gold rose boutonniere"}, {argument name="setting" default="luxurious Victorian mansion study at night"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格单格插画，描绘一位忠诚的赛博管家在深夜的奢华维多利亚式宅邸中。画面展示了管家的腰部以上部分，他站在一张光亮的深色木质书桌后，身穿正式的黑色燕尾服、黑色马甲、条纹白衬衫、黑色领带，配有金色纽扣、怀表链，左翻领上别着一朵淡金色的玫瑰胸花。他的头部不是人脸，而是一个微微倾斜的黑色宽屏显示器，屏幕中央显示着白色的日文文本「お嬢様」以及一个黄色爱心。他露出的双手是优雅的白色关节型机械手：一只手严肃地按在胸前，另一只手向前伸出，向观众做出担忧且恳求的姿态。在右侧添加一个高大的垂直白色对话气泡，内含日文文本「……急がずに参りましょう。ですが、お嬢様ご自身の願いまで、先回りして諦めないでください。」场景设定在一个温暖、昏暗的书房中，大窗户可以看到窗外深蓝色的城市夜景，配有厚重的窗帘、装裱的艺术品、雕花家具，右侧有一盏发光的华丽台灯。书桌上仅包含三个主要桌面物品：左下方的一个雕花银质托盘，右下方的一本合上的棕色礼宾备忘录（上面放着一支钢笔），以及最左侧的一个小花瓶或一簇淡金色玫瑰。使用电影般的暖色调灯光、细腻的金属反射、精致的哥特式奢华氛围、浅景深、高细节动漫渲染、优雅的构图，画面中无其他角色，无水印。可自定义细节：{argument name="screen address text" default="お嬢様"}, {argument name="screen icon" default="💛"}, {argument name="speech bubble text" default="……急がずに参りましょう。ですが、お嬢様ご自身の願いまで、先回りして諦めないでください。"}, {argument name="butler flower" default="淡金色玫瑰胸花"}, {argument name="setting" default="深夜的奢华维多利亚式书房"}。

variables.defaultValue: ……急がずに参りましょう。ですが、お嬢様ご自身の願いまで、先回りして諦めないでください。

templates.title: Social Media Anime Fashion Lineup

titleLocalized.zh: 社交媒体动漫时尚角色阵容

templates.prompt: Create a clean full-body anime fashion lineup on a white studio background with glossy floor reflection, showing exactly 4 human personifications of social media platforms standing side by side, each with a bottom label and small underline: {argument name="first platform label" default="X"}, {argument name="second platform label" default="Instagram"}, {argument name="third platform label" default="Threads"}, and {argument name="fourth platform label" default="TikTok"}. Style is high-detail modern Japanese illustration, streetwear techwear, crisp line art, soft painterly shading, fashionable idol-like poses, abundant platform-themed accessories, no scenery, no watermark. Character 1, X: tall slim young man in all-black layered techwear with oversized black jacket, straps, buckles, black cargo pants, black high-top sneakers, angular white X graphics across the coat and shoes, holding a black smartphone, black messy hair, cool detached pose, sparse black slash motifs and small UI fragments around him. Character 2, Instagram: trendy young woman in pastel neon colors, curly voluminous light brown hair, pink sunglasses on head, white crop top and high-waisted baggy white pants, translucent iridescent pink-orange-purple jacket, colorful belts and straps, pink-orange sneakers, carrying a compact camera, surrounded by exactly 5 Instagram-themed elements: one large Instagram logo near her head, one heart notification icon, one floating profile-window frame behind her, one small photo card, and one Instagram logo badge hanging near her waist; her bottom label is gradient orange-pink. Character 3, Threads: soft minimalist young man in loose all-white outfit, cream oversized shirt and wide pants, white sneakers, black shoulder bag with the Threads spiral logo, holding an open notebook or small book with thin cable-like black threads looping around his body, calm thoughtful pose with hand near chin, surrounded by exactly 3 speech bubbles containing ellipses; his bottom label is black. Character 4, TikTok: energetic young woman in black cyberpunk idol streetwear with vivid cyan and hot-pink accents, twin ponytails with colored streaks and ribbons, cropped black top, oversized black jacket, short black skirt with belts, fishnet/strap leg details, chunky platform sneakers, one leg lifted and one arm raised in a dance pose while holding a smartphone for a selfie; include TikTok logos, music notes, waveform graphics, play-button icons, cyan/pink ribbons and straps, plus a small floating TikTok app icon near her. Keep the four characters evenly spaced, full body visible from head to shoes, faces can be softly simplified or obscured for a concept-sheet look, with a bright white background and subtle floor reflections.

promptLocalized.zh: 在白色摄影棚背景和光亮地板倒影下，创作一套干净的全身动漫时尚角色阵容，展示 4 个并排站立的社交媒体平台拟人化角色，每个角色下方均带有标签及下方横线：{argument name="first platform label" default="X"}、{argument name="second platform label" default="Instagram"}、{argument name="third platform label" default="Threads"} 以及 {argument name="fourth platform label" default="TikTok"}。风格为高细节现代日本插画、街头机能风（techwear）、清晰的线条艺术、柔和的绘画式阴影、时尚的偶像姿势、丰富的平台主题配饰，无背景，无水印。角色 1，X：高挑纤瘦的年轻男性，身穿全黑叠穿机能风服装，搭配超大号黑色夹克、绑带、搭扣、黑色工装裤、黑色高帮运动鞋，外套和鞋子上带有棱角分明的白色 X 图案，手持黑色智能手机，黑色凌乱发型，冷峻疏离的姿势，周围环绕着稀疏的黑色斜杠图案和微小的 UI 碎片。角色 2，Instagram：潮流年轻女性，身穿柔和霓虹色系服装，卷曲蓬松的浅棕色头发，头上戴着粉色太阳镜，白色短款上衣和高腰宽松白裤，半透明的虹彩粉橙紫色夹克，色彩鲜艳的腰带和绑带，粉橙色运动鞋，携带一台小型相机，周围环绕着 5 个 Instagram 主题元素：头顶附近有一个巨大的 Instagram 标志，一个爱心通知图标，身后一个悬浮的个人资料窗口框架，一张小照片卡，以及腰间悬挂的一个 Instagram 标志徽章；其底部标签为橙粉色渐变。角色 3，Threads：柔和极简风年轻男性，身穿宽松的全白套装，米色超大号衬衫和阔腿裤，白色运动鞋，带有 Threads 螺旋标志的黑色单肩包，手持一本打开的笔记本或小书，细长的黑色线状物环绕身体，手托下巴的冷静沉思姿势，周围环绕着 3 个包含省略号的对话气泡；其底部标签为黑色。角色 4，TikTok：充满活力的年轻女性，身穿带有鲜艳青色和亮粉色点缀的黑色赛博朋克偶像街头服饰，双马尾带有彩色挑染和丝带，黑色短款上衣，超大号黑色夹克，带有绑带的黑色短裙，渔网/绑带腿部细节，厚底运动鞋，单腿抬起，一只手臂举起做舞蹈姿势，同时手持智能手机自拍；包含 TikTok 标志、音符、波形图形、播放按钮图标、青色/粉色丝带和绑带，以及附近一个悬浮的小型 TikTok 应用图标。保持四个角色间距均匀，全身从头到鞋清晰可见，面部可适当简化或遮挡以呈现概念图效果，背景为明亮的白色，并带有微妙的地板倒影。

templates.title: Photoreal Anime Mannequin Display

titleLocalized.zh: 写实动漫风格人体模型展示

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical fashion-store mannequin display of an adult-sized glossy white female mannequin wearing an anime-inspired school-uniform cosplay, shot like a realistic retail product photo with shallow depth of field. The mannequin has a smooth blank face obscured by a soft gray rectangular blur, a short black bob haircut with bangs, and exactly 2 tall black furry animal ears on top of the head. Above the head is exactly 1 transparent acrylic halo panel on a thin clear support rod, with blue concentric ring graphics printed on it, like a prop accessory. Outfit: a navy sailor-style school uniform with white stripe trim, a bright blue neckerchief tied at the chest, a dark pleated skirt, and a loose light-blue kimono-style haori with dark navy lapels and cuffs; the left sleeve shows white floral motifs. Add a thin black ribbon choker tied in a bow around the neck. The mannequin has exactly 2 glossy white hands: the raised right hand delicately holds several thin blue cords or strings, while the lower left hand gathers the dangling cords near the waist. Include exactly 1 hanging white retail price tag on the chest area reading small product text and the price “¥24,800”. Add manga-style white sound effects around the mannequin: exactly 4 instances of the Japanese text “キシッ” and exactly 4 small wavy squeak-mark clusters, positioned around the head, shoulders, and lower sides. Background: softly blurred upscale clothing shop interior with warm beige lighting, bokeh ceiling lights, racks of clothing, a tall bright window or light panel on the left, and muted garments on the right. Use realistic camera optics, natural reflections on the glossy mannequin and acrylic halo, warm indoor color grading, high detail fabric textures, and a slightly premium showroom atmosphere. Customize the character concept as {argument name="character name" default="anime halo cat-eared schoolgirl mannequin"}, the main outfit color as {argument name="main outfit color" default="light blue and navy"}, the hair color as {argument name="hair color" default="black"}, the price tag text as {argument name="price tag text" default="¥24,800"}, and the sound effect text as {argument name="sound effect text" default="キシッ"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版时尚店人体模型展示图，主体为一个成年尺寸的亮面白色女性人体模型，身着动漫风格的校服 Cosplay 服装，采用逼真的零售产品摄影手法，具有浅景深效果。人体模型面部光滑且空白，被一个柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮挡，留着黑色短波波头刘海，头顶有且仅有 2 只高耸的黑色毛绒动物耳朵。头顶上方有 1 个透明亚克力光环面板，由细长的透明支架支撑，上面印有蓝色同心圆图形，如同道具配件。服装：海军风水手校服，带有白色条纹装饰，胸前系着亮蓝色领巾，深色百褶裙，外搭一件宽松的浅蓝色和服式羽织，配有深海军蓝翻领和袖口；左袖饰有白色花卉图案。颈部系有一条细黑色丝带蝴蝶结。人体模型有 2 只亮面白色手部：抬起的右手优雅地握着几根细蓝绳，左手在腰部附近聚拢垂下的绳子。胸部区域悬挂 1 个白色零售价格标签，上面印有细小的产品文字和价格“¥24,800”。在人体模型周围添加漫画风格的白色音效：4 处日文文字“キシッ”以及 4 组小型波浪状吱吱声符号，分布在头部、肩部和身体两侧下方。背景：柔和虚化的高档服装店内部，采用暖米色灯光，天花板有光斑，陈列着衣架，左侧有高大的明亮窗户或灯板，右侧为色调柔和的服装。使用写实的相机光学效果，在亮面人体模型和亚克力光环上呈现自然的反射，采用室内暖色调，展现高细节的织物纹理，营造出高级展厅的氛围。自定义角色概念为 {argument name="character name" default="动漫光环猫耳女学生人体模型"}，主服装颜色为 {argument name="main outfit color" default="浅蓝与海军蓝"}，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"}，价格标签文字为 {argument name="price tag text" default="¥24,800"}，音效文字为 {argument name="sound effect text" default="キシッ"}。

templates.title: Realistic Angel Mannequin Boutique Display

titleLocalized.zh: 写实天使模特精品店展示

templates.prompt: Create a realistic high-end boutique mannequin photo of an elegant anime-inspired angel character, {argument name="character name" default="Mireia"}, posed in a clothing store with soft natural window light and shallow depth of field. The mannequin has a smooth white faceless head partially covered by a plain square gray privacy censor block, extremely long silver-white hair flowing past the waist, and a cluster of pale pink lilies with green leaves tucked into the hair near the right temple. Above the head is a translucent clear acrylic halo disk with a white thorny circular emblem printed on it, catching highlights like polished plastic. The mannequin wears a pristine {argument name="outfit style" default="white military nun dress"}: fitted white uniform dress with gold piping, short cape-like sleeves over glossy white long sleeves, double-breasted gold buttons, a black ribbon bow at the chest, a small round red-and-gold chest emblem, gray harness straps crossing the torso, a wide gray waist belt, and a dark navy or black skirt panel visible below the coat. Add one white feathered angel wing on the viewer’s right side, curved upward behind the body. Pose the mannequin with the left arm bent behind the head and the right hand on the hip, emphasizing a fashion display figure with glossy plastic hands. Attach a rectangular white shop tag hanging from the belt reading {argument name="tag text" default="ミレニア / Saint Lily Dress / ¥24,800"}. Include exactly three small hand-drawn Japanese squeak sound effects in white, each reading {argument name="sound effect text" default="キシッ"}: one near the raised left arm, one near the right wing, and one near the lower left waist area. Background: softly blurred upscale apparel shop with clothing racks, warm beige interior lighting, large bright window on the left, realistic lens blur, premium product photography, vertical 3:4 composition, clean highlights, no extra people, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的高端精品店模特照片，主角是一位优雅的动漫风格天使角色，{argument name="character name" default="Mireia"}，置身于服装店内，采用柔和的自然窗光和浅景深效果。模特拥有光滑的白色无面头部，部分被一个简单的方形灰色隐私遮挡块覆盖，极长的银白色长发垂至腰间，右侧太阳穴附近的头发中别着一束带有绿叶的淡粉色百合花。头顶上方是一个半透明的亚克力光环圆盘，上面印有白色荆棘圆形徽章，捕捉着如抛光塑料般的高光。模特身着一件精致的 {argument name="outfit style" default="白色军装修女服"}：修身白色制服裙，配有金色滚边、覆盖在亮面白色长袖上的短斗篷式袖子、双排金色纽扣、胸前的黑色丝带蝴蝶结、一枚红色和金色的小圆形胸章、横跨躯干的灰色背带、宽大的灰色腰带，以及在大衣下方可见的深海军蓝或黑色裙摆。在观察者右侧添加一只白色羽毛天使翅膀，在身体后方向上弯曲。模特左臂弯曲于脑后，右手叉腰，强调时尚展示人偶的质感，配有光泽感的塑料手部。在腰带上悬挂一个长方形白色商店标签，上面写着 {argument name="tag text" default="ミレニア / Saint Lily Dress / ¥24,800"}。包含三个手绘风格的白色日语拟声词，每个都写着 {argument name="sound effect text" default="キシッ"}：一个位于抬起的左臂附近，一个位于右侧翅膀附近，一个位于左下腰部区域。背景：柔和虚化的高档服装店，配有衣架、温暖的米色室内灯光、左侧明亮的大窗户，写实镜头模糊，高级产品摄影，3:4 竖构图，干净的高光，无额外人物，无水印。

templates.title: HSP3 Manga Introduction Comic

titleLocalized.zh: HSP3 漫画入门介绍

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a 6-panel Japanese manga-style educational introduction image about {argument name="programming language" default="HSP3"}, featuring the same anime schoolgirl presenter in every panel with her face intentionally blurred/softly obscured.

Canvas: Wide horizontal comic layout, about 3:2 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 6 rectangular panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid with thin black borders. Each panel has a small white square number label in the top-left corner, numbered exactly 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

Visual style: Clean Japanese instructional manga / anime infographic style, soft pastel background dots and sparkles, crisp line art, white speech bubbles with black outlines, navy and burgundy school uniform colors, friendly beginner-learning mood. The presenter is a teenage anime girl with a short dark brown bob haircut and bangs, wearing a Japanese sailor school uniform: white blouse, navy sailor collar with white stripes, burgundy ribbon bow, navy pleated skirt. Keep her face blurred or featureless in every panel.

Panel details and text content:
1. Panel 1: The girl stands on the left, raising one index finger as if introducing the topic. Pale blue circular background accents. Add a cloud-shaped speech bubble with Japanese text: 「こんにちは！今日はHSP3言語について紹介します！」 Add large bold blue headline text on the right/lower area: 「HSP3言語をはじめよう！」
2. Panel 2: The girl is centered-left in a thinking pose with one hand near her chin. Add pale question marks in the background. A speech bubble on the right says: 「HSP3ってどんな言語なんだろう？」 A rounded white caption box at the bottom says: 「HSP3は、初心者にもやさしい国産のプログラミング言語です！」
3. Panel 3: The girl stands on the right, gesturing toward a whiteboard on the left. A speech bubble above says: 「HSP3の特徴はこの3つ！」 The whiteboard must contain exactly 3 numbered feature lines: 「① 簡単にプログラムが書ける！」, 「② 軽くて動作が速い！」, 「③ ゲームやツール制作に最適！」 Add small yellow emphasis marks near the girl.
4. Panel 4: Show a dark code editor window on the left titled 「sample.hsp」 with simple HSP-like code, including visible lines such as 「open 0,800,600」, 「color 255,255,255」, 「pos 100,100」, 「mes \"Hello, HSP3!\"」, 「wait 60」, 「stop」. The girl stands on the right raising an index finger. A rounded speech bubble across the bottom says: 「シンプルな構文で、はじめての人でもすぐにプログラムを書けます！」
5. Panel 5: Show a small game window on the left titled 「HSP3 Game」 containing a pixel-art platform game scene with exactly 3 red heart icons, a small player character, platforms, coins, a slime-like enemy, and a small creature on an upper platform. The girl stands on the right with both fists raised excitedly. A speech bubble at the bottom says: 「ゲーム制作もできるよ！こんなゲームもHSP3で作れちゃいます！」 Add yellow excitement marks near her head.
6. Panel 6: Pink sparkly background. The girl stands on the right with both hands open in an encouraging pose. A cloud-shaped speech bubble on the upper left says: 「さあ、あなたもHSP3を始めてみましょう！」 Add large red text at lower left: 「楽しく学んで、いろんな作品を作ってみてね！」

Constraints: Use exactly 6 panels and exactly 6 panel number labels. Use the same character design and outfit consistently in all panels. Keep all Japanese text legible and close to the specified wording. Do not add extra panels, logos, watermarks, or unrelated characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张 6 格日式漫画风格的教育介绍图，主题为 {argument name="programming language" default="HSP3"}，每一格中均出现同一位动漫女学生作为讲解员，其面部特意进行模糊/柔化处理。

画布：宽幅横向漫画布局，比例约为 3:2，分为 3 列 2 行共 6 个矩形格子，带有细黑色边框。每个格子左上角有一个白色小方块数字标签，编号依次为 1、2、3、4、5、6。

视觉风格：简洁的日式教学漫画/动漫信息图风格，背景带有柔和的淡色圆点和闪光，线条清晰，白色对话气泡配黑色轮廓，海军蓝与酒红色的校服配色，营造友好的初学者学习氛围。讲解员是一位留着深棕色短波波头和刘海的动漫少女，身穿日式水手校服：白色衬衫、带有白色条纹的海军蓝水手领、酒红色丝带蝴蝶结、海军蓝百褶裙。在每一格中保持她的面部模糊或无五官特征。

格子细节与文字内容：
1. 第 1 格：少女站在左侧，举起一根食指，仿佛在介绍主题。背景有淡蓝色圆形装饰。添加一个云朵状对话气泡，内含日语文字：「こんにちは！今日はHSP3言語について紹介します！」在右下方添加醒目的蓝色大标题文字：「HSP3言語をはじめよう！」
2. 第 2 格：少女位于中左侧，做思考状，一只手托着下巴。背景添加淡色问号。右侧对话气泡写着：「HSP3ってどんな言語なんだろう？」底部的圆角白色说明框写着：「HSP3は、初心者にもやさしい国産のプログラミング言語です！」
3. 第 3 格：少女站在右侧，指向左侧的「项目」。对话气泡上方写着：「HSP3の特徴はこの3つ！」该「项目」必须包含 3 行编号的功能点：「① 簡単にプログラムが書ける！」, 「② 軽くて動作が速い！」, 「③ ゲームやツール制作に最適！」在少女附近添加黄色强调符号。
4. 第 4 格：左侧展示一个深色代码编辑器窗口，标题为「sample.hsp」，包含简单的 HSP 风格代码，可见行包括「open 0,800,600」, 「color 255,255,255」, 「pos 100,100」, 「mes \"Hello, HSP3!\"」, 「wait 60」, 「stop」。少女站在右侧，举起一根食指。底部横跨的圆角对话气泡写着：「シンプルな構文で、はじめての人でもすぐにプログラムを書けます！」
5. 第 5 格：左侧展示一个小游戏窗口，标题为「HSP3 Game」，包含一个像素风平台游戏场景，内有 3 个红色心形图标、一个小玩家角色、平台、金币、史莱姆状敌人以及上方平台上的小生物。少女站在右侧，兴奋地举起双拳。底部对话气泡写着：「ゲーム制作もできるよ！こんなゲームもHSP3で作れちゃいます！」在她的头部附近添加黄色兴奋符号。
6. 第 6 格：粉色闪光背景。少女站在右侧，双手张开，做出鼓励的姿势。左上方的云朵状对话气泡写着：「さあ、あなたもHSP3を始めてみましょう！」在左下方添加红色大字：「楽しく学んで、いろんな作品を作ってみてね！」

约束：必须使用 6 个格子和 6 个格子编号标签。在所有格子中保持角色设计和服装的一致性。确保所有日语文字清晰易读，并尽可能接近指定的措辞。不要添加额外的格子、标志、水印或无关角色。

templates.title: Golden Hour Classroom Hug

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻的教室拥抱

templates.prompt: Create a warm, cinematic photorealistic portrait of two Japanese high school girls in sailor-style school uniforms sharing a gentle affectionate hug in an empty classroom at golden hour. The foreground girl, {argument name="front girl hair" default="long straight black hair"}, sits facing the camera behind a wooden classroom chair, with her hands resting on the top rail of the chair back; she wears a navy-and-white sailor uniform with a red ribbon at the chest. The second girl, {argument name="back girl hair" default="short dark brown bob hair"}, stands close behind her and wraps both arms around her shoulders and chest in a protective, tender embrace; she wears a matching navy-and-white sailor uniform. Place exactly 2 girls, exactly 2 visible school desks, exactly 2 visible chairs in the foreground/midground, and 1 chalkboard in the blurred background. Obscure both faces with soft rectangular blur blocks, one over each face, while keeping hair, uniforms, arms, and pose visible. The classroom should have warm sunset light streaming through large windows on the right, glowing orange curtains, soft dust-filled atmosphere, shallow depth of field, realistic skin tones, natural hand placement, nostalgic Japanese classroom furniture, wooden chair backs, metal chair frames, and a softly blurred chalkboard on the left. Use a vertical 4:5 composition, eye-level camera angle, intimate but wholesome mood, realistic photography style, warm color grading, soft lens bokeh, no text, no watermark, no extra people, no exaggerated anatomy.

From left to right: 1) “THE STAR” card, dark navy starry sky, kneeling woman by water, tilted slightly left; 2) a large central golden astrological compass/rose compass with a glowing center and radiating sunburst; 3) “THE SUN” card, child on white horse, sunflowers, tilted slightly right; 4) “WHEEL OF FORTUNE” card, ornate zodiac wheel and angelic figures, tilted more strongly right. Add halos of pale light behind the cards.

Body layout: Below the tarot area, create exactly 8 rectangular reading sections arranged in a clean 2-column by 4-row grid, each with a circular medallion icon on the left and a Japanese heading plus bullet text on the right. The 8 sections are: 1) 「仕事運」 with a feather icon, 2) 「人間関係」 with a heart icon, 3) 「健康運」 with a crystal icon, 4) 「気をつけた方が良いこと」 with balance scales icon, 5) 「金運」 with a golden lantern/talisman icon, 6) 「強み」 with rose and stars icon, 7) 「やるべきこと」 with compass icon, 8) 「総合運」 with crescent moon and stars icon. Use small, dense Japanese bullet points in each box; the text should look like a personalized fortune report, neat and readable, with dark brown ink and bold bracketed headings.

Bottom conclusion: Add a separate wide framed panel titled 「運命からの最終的な導き」. On its left place exactly 1 vertical illustration of a glowing antique lantern with a candle inside, set in a dark gold-framed card. On the right, include a polished Japanese paragraph of final guidance for {argument name="fortune year" default="2026年"}, saying that accumulated learning and experience will be delivered to the world quietly but surely, and that valuing what has been built will lead to natural allies. End with a small cursive English signature reading “Fortune Reading Signature”.

Decorative details: Include exactly 4 prominent rose clusters at the page corners, 2 crescent moon motifs, 3 small gold sun medallions near the top, many tiny star sparkles, delicate gold separators, symmetrical scrollwork, and a refined occult/tarot atmosphere.

Text style: Japanese Mincho-style serif for headings, smaller Japanese serif body copy, black-brown ink, gold accents. The overall design should look like a premium printed divination certificate someone would be happy to receive.

Constraints: Keep all text in Japanese where specified, avoid modern UI elements, avoid photorealistic people outside the tarot illustrations, no watermark, no QR code, no extra cards beyond the 3 tarot cards, no extra body sections beyond the 8 listed sections.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 AI 占卜结果创建一份华丽的日式运势解读证书，标题为「あなたの本質と未来の羅針盤」，风格仿照古董塔罗牌与占星术鑑定书。

画布：竖版 A4 页面，暖象牙色羊皮纸背景，细双线金边，四角饰有精致的维多利亚风格花丝，左上、右上、左下和右下角绘有玫瑰，并点缀着小星星、新月和金色装饰。采用奶油色、深褐色、古金色、酒红色、灰粉色和深海军蓝的奢华复古色调。

页眉：居中大号日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="あなたの本質と未来の羅針盤"}。下方为较小的副标题：{argument name="year and subtitle" default="2026年 運命鑑定書"}。在此之下，包含一行精致的填空线，内容为「鑑定対象：　　　　生　　　　生まれ　　　　様」，并配有装饰性分隔线。

主视觉区：在上半部分放置 3 张倾斜的塔罗牌以及 1 个中央罗盘。从左至右依次为：1) “THE STAR”牌，深海军蓝星空，水边跪着的女性，略微向左倾斜；2) 一个巨大的中央金色占星罗盘/罗盘玫瑰，中心发光并向外辐射光芒；3) “THE SUN”牌，白马上的孩童，向日葵，略微向右倾斜；4) “WHEEL OF FORTUNE”牌，华丽的黄道十二宫轮盘和天使形象，向右倾斜角度更大。在牌后添加淡淡的光晕。

正文布局：在塔罗牌区域下方，创建 8 个矩形解读板块，排列成整齐的 2 列 4 行网格。每个板块左侧为一个圆形徽章图标，右侧为日文标题及要点文本。8 个板块分别为：1) 「仕事運」（羽毛图标），2) 「人間関係」（心形图标），3) 「健康運」（水晶图标），4) 「気をつけた方が良いこと」（天平图标），5) 「金運」（金灯笼/护身符图标），6) 「強み」（玫瑰与星星图标），7) 「やるべきこと」（罗盘图标），8) 「総合運」（新月与星星图标）。每个方框内使用精简的日文要点；文本应看起来像一份个性化的运势报告，整洁易读，使用深棕色墨水和加粗的括号标题。

底部结论：添加一个独立的宽边框面板，标题为「運命からの最終的な導き」。左侧放置 1 张竖向插图，描绘一盏发光的古董灯笼，内含蜡烛，置于深金色边框的卡片中。右侧包含一段优美的日文段落，作为 {argument name="fortune year" default="2026年"} 的最终指引，内容提及积累的学习与经验将静谧而确切地传递给世界，珍视已建立的一切将引来志同道合的伙伴。结尾处附上一个小的连体英文签名“Fortune Reading Signature”。

装饰细节：页面四角包含 4 簇醒目的玫瑰，2 个新月图案，顶部附近有 3 个金色小太阳徽章，大量细小的星光闪烁，精致的金色分隔线，对称的卷轴花纹，营造出一种高级的神秘学/塔罗氛围。

文字风格：标题采用日文明朝体（Mincho），正文使用较小的日文衬线体，深棕色墨水，金色点缀。整体设计应呈现出一种人们乐于收到的高级印刷占卜证书质感。

约束条件：所有指定位置的文字必须使用日文，避免使用现代 UI 元素，塔罗牌插图之外不得出现写实人物，无水印，无二维码，除 3 张塔罗牌外不得增加额外卡牌，除列出的 8 个板块外不得增加额外正文区域。

templates.title: Chibi Cat-Girl Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版猫娘特写

templates.prompt: Create a close-up square anime portrait of a cute chibi cat-girl / wolf-cat kemonomimi character, centered from the chest up against a plain dark muted green background. She has {argument name="hair color" default="charcoal gray hair with bold white front streaks"}, long layered messy hair, thick bangs partly covering her forehead, and two large upright animal ears with dark gray outer fur, pink inner ears, and fluffy white tufts. Her face is a white cat muzzle with soft gray cheek markings, a tiny pink triangular nose, a small mischievous closed smile, and exactly two tiny lower fangs visible. Give her large half-lidded golden amber cat eyes with vertical slit pupils, glossy highlights, heavy black eyeliner, long lashes, and a confident teasing expression. Include exactly six long thin white whiskers, three extending from each cheek. Her body is petite and chibi-proportioned, with one white paw-like hand raised near her chin in a coy fist pose. Outfit: a tribal fantasy brown leather top with black fur collar, a row of cream fang-shaped teeth at the neckline, dark triangular claw-like decorations along the lower edge, a brown wrapped leather forearm bracer on one arm, and one patterned armband with white diamond motifs on the other upper arm. Use crisp clean anime line art, high-detail cel shading, glossy hair highlights, soft blush around the eyes, sharp black outlines, and a polished GPT-image-2 illustration look. Keep the composition tight, symmetrical, adorable but slightly smug, with no text, no watermark, and no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张正方形的动漫角色特写插画，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="调皮的狼猫娘"} 的 Q 版猫娘，构图为胸部以上的半身像，背景为简洁柔和的深蓝绿色。她拥有硕大的 Q 版圆头、白色的猫科面部和爪子，留着凌乱的层次感 {argument name="hair color" default="炭灰色头发，前额带有醒目的白色挑染"}，头顶两只超大的直立猫耳，外侧为深灰色毛发，内侧为粉色，并带有蓬松的白色耳簇。她有着一对巨大的琥珀色猫眼，瞳孔呈垂直细缝状，带有光泽感高光、浓密的黑色上睫毛，表情狡黠且半眯；加上一个小巧的粉色三角形鼻子、带有两颗小尖牙的猫嘴、眼下淡淡的腮红、灰色的口鼻部斑纹，以及从双颊延伸出的细长白色胡须。让她摆出单手托腮的姿势，仿佛在休息时露出得意思考的神情。为她穿上原始部落奇幻风格的服装，包含 5 个清晰可见的服饰或配饰元素：黑色毛绒领子、棕色皮革单肩胸衣、领口处的一排象牙尖牙装饰、抬起手臂上的棕色皮革护腕，以及另一侧上臂带有白色菱形图案的棕色臂环。采用清晰的数字动漫线稿、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、光泽感发丝高光、高对比度的黑色轮廓线，耳部和领口处需展现细腻的毛发质感，表情可爱但略带野性，无文字，无水印，无多余角色，构图需紧凑裁剪，猫耳几乎触及顶部边缘。

templates.title: Cosmic Coral Whale

titleLocalized.zh: 宇宙珊瑚鲸

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy fantasy illustration of a colossal translucent humpback whale swimming through deep outer space as if it were an ocean. The whale fills most of a vertical portrait canvas, angled from lower left to upper right, with its head on the left and its tail curling upward on the right into a graceful splash-like arc. Make the whale’s body glassy and bioluminescent in luminous cyan, turquoise, royal blue, violet, and soft pink, with glowing speckles like stars inside its skin. Inside the transparent whale’s belly, show a vibrant coral reef ecosystem with exactly 5 prominent coral clusters: one large pale pink branching coral near the center, one pink-and-yellow anemone-like coral on the right, one soft blue coral mound beneath the center, one lavender-pink reef patch near the lower left, and one pale peach coral fan near the mid-lower body. Add exactly 11 small fish below the whale, swimming in a loose arc, colored cream, pale yellow, light blue, cyan, and orange. Add exactly 3 jellyfish around the whale: one glowing jellyfish to the left above the head, one small jellyfish near the upper center above the whale’s back, and one tiny jellyfish at the right edge beside the tail. Surround the whale with many sparkling bubbles and water droplets, especially along the arcing tail and lower right fin, but keep them delicate and jewel-like. The background is a dark navy star field with countless tiny stars and a few larger twinkling starbursts, creating a cosmic underwater atmosphere. Style: highly detailed ethereal digital painting, delicate dissolving outlines, soft gradients, transparent watercolor glow, luminous rim light, magical ocean-in-space mood, no text, no border, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅梦幻般的奇幻插画，描绘一条巨大的半透明座头鲸像在海洋中一样游弋在深邃的外太空中。鲸鱼占据了竖构图画面的大部分，从左下角向右上角倾斜，头部位于左侧，尾部向右上方卷曲，形成优美的弧线，宛如水花飞溅。鲸鱼的身体呈现出玻璃般的质感，散发着青色、绿松石色、宝蓝色、紫色和柔粉色的生物荧光，皮肤内闪烁着如星辰般的光点。在透明的鲸鱼腹部内，展示一个充满活力的珊瑚礁生态系统，包含 5 簇显眼的珊瑚：中心附近一簇大型浅粉色分枝珊瑚，右侧一簇粉黄相间的海葵状珊瑚，中心下方一簇柔蓝色珊瑚丘，左下角附近一簇淡紫色珊瑚礁，以及中下部附近一簇浅桃色珊瑚扇。在鲸鱼下方添加 11 条小鱼，呈松散的弧形游动，颜色包括奶油色、浅黄色、浅蓝色、青色和橙色。在鲸鱼周围添加 3 只水母：头部左上方一只发光水母，背部上方中心附近一只小型水母，以及尾部右侧边缘一只微型水母。在鲸鱼周围环绕许多闪烁的气泡和水滴，特别是在弧形尾部和右下鳍周围，保持其精致如宝石般的质感。背景为深海军蓝色的星空，点缀着无数微小的恒星和几颗较大的闪烁星芒，营造出宇宙水下的氛围。风格：高度细腻的空灵数字绘画，精致的溶解轮廓，柔和的渐变，透明的水彩光泽，明亮的边缘光，神奇的太空海洋氛围，无文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Photorealistic Amber-Eyed Cat Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 写实长毛猫肖像

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic studio portrait of a long-haired {argument name="cat breed" default="Maine Coon-like domestic cat"} facing forward, centered in a tight head-and-chest composition. The cat has dense fluffy fur in {argument name="fur colors" default="dark charcoal gray and white"}, with a white muzzle, white chest ruff, a narrow white blaze running up the nose and forehead, darker gray tabby shading over the crown and cheeks, and long fine whiskers spreading horizontally. Show exactly two large upright triangular ears with pale pink inner skin and wispy ear tufts, exactly two vivid {argument name="eye color" default="golden amber"} almond-shaped eyes with vertical slit pupils, and a small soft pink nose. The expression is calm, intelligent, slightly serious, with symmetrical frontal eye contact. Use photorealistic detail: individual fur strands, soft natural texture, subtle depth of field, and crisp focus on the eyes and face. Background is a plain smooth {argument name="background color" default="deep muted green"} studio backdrop, softly blurred, with no props, no text, no collar, no watermark. Lighting is gentle diffused studio lighting from the front-left, creating soft highlights on the fur and natural shadows under the chin. Vertical square-ish portrait framing, close crop with the ears near the top edge and the fluffy chest filling the lower frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度写实的摄影棚肖像，主体为一只长毛 {argument name="animal subject" default="家猫"}，采用紧凑的头部至胸部构图，主体正对镜头，居中放置，并以冷静、略显严肃的表情直视观众。这只猫拥有 {argument name="fur color and pattern" default="深炭灰色与白色双色毛发"}，白色口鼻部，前额中心有白色条纹，胸部毛发蓬松洁白，脸颊和头顶颜色较深，长而有层次的毛发可见清晰的单根质感。强调其大而直立的三角形耳朵，内耳呈粉色并带有细长的耳簇，明亮的 {argument name="eye color" default="金琥珀色"} 眼睛，瞳孔垂直且锐利，小巧柔软的粉色鼻子，以及向两侧延伸的长白胡须。采用写实动物摄影风格，展现极其细腻的毛发质感、自然柔和的摄影棚灯光、浅景深效果，面部和眼睛焦点清晰，带有微妙的眼神光，背景为平滑的深色 {argument name="background color" default="深绿色"}，并带有柔和的暗角。竖构图肖像，方形至近竖向裁剪，无配饰，无文字，无水印，不包含任何人类元素。

templates.title: Magical Gothic Library Balcony

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻哥特式图书馆阳台

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 anime fantasy illustration of one elegant young girl standing on a glossy balcony inside an enormous magical gothic library-observatory at twilight. The girl has {argument name="hair color" default="long pastel pink hair"}, pale skin, a gentle smiling expression, and wears an ornate black-and-white frilled gothic lolita dress with layered lace, puffed sleeves, ribbons, white stockings, and black platform heels; she turns slightly toward the viewer while standing near a gold filigree railing. Surround her with exactly seven prominent glowing butterflies: one large pink butterfly near the left railing, one small butterfly above the upper balcony, one tiny butterfly near the window, one large pink butterfly on the right railing, one large butterfly near the bottom left floor, one small butterfly near her feet, and one small butterfly at the lower right edge. The setting is a vast cathedral-like interior with towering bookshelves, sweeping spiral staircases, arched balconies, marble columns, gilded railings, chandelier-like lamps, reflective black floors, and intricate art nouveau metalwork. On the right, include a gigantic arched glass window covered in rain streaks, revealing a luminous night city skyline with castle spires and a large glowing ferris wheel outside. Use a dreamy {argument name="color palette" default="lavender, rose pink, pale blue, and warm gold"} palette, misty volumetric light, sparkling particles, soft bloom, extremely detailed architecture, delicate linework, cinematic depth, ethereal magical atmosphere, and a high-resolution polished anime art style. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 竖版动漫奇幻插画，描绘一位优雅的少女站在黄昏时分巨大的魔法哥特式图书馆天文台内，身处光洁的阳台上。少女拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的淡粉色头发"}、白皙的皮肤、温柔的微笑，身穿华丽的黑白褶边哥特萝莉裙，搭配层叠蕾丝、泡泡袖、丝带、白袜和黑色厚底高跟鞋；她站在金色的花丝栏杆旁，微微转向观众。画面中环绕着七只显眼的荧光蝴蝶：左侧栏杆旁有一只大粉色蝴蝶，上层阳台上方有一只小蝴蝶，窗户附近有一只极小的蝴蝶，右侧栏杆上有一只大粉色蝴蝶，左下地面附近有一只大蝴蝶，她脚边有一只小蝴蝶，右下边缘还有一只小蝴蝶。场景为宏伟的教堂式室内，拥有高耸的书架、蜿蜒的螺旋楼梯、拱形阳台、大理石柱、镀金栏杆、吊灯式灯具、反光的黑色地板以及精致的新艺术风格金属制品。在右侧，加入一扇巨大的拱形玻璃窗，窗上覆盖着雨痕，展现出窗外闪烁的夜间城市天际线、城堡尖塔和一个巨大的发光摩天轮。使用梦幻的 {argument name="color palette" default="薰衣草紫、玫瑰粉、淡蓝和暖金色"} 色调，营造朦胧的体积光、闪烁的微粒、柔和的辉光效果，展现极其细腻的建筑细节、精致的线条、电影般的景深、空灵的魔法氛围，以及高分辨率的精美动漫艺术风格。画面中无文字、无水印、无多余角色。

templates.title: Two-Panel Pastel Sailor Girls

titleLocalized.zh: 双联画风柔和水手服少女

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a side-by-side anime color-variation test illustration of the same cute sailor-girl character concept in an ARIA-inspired canal city setting.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image split into exactly 2 equal vertical panels with a thin white divider in the center. Soft pastel lighting, dreamy waterfront atmosphere, high-detail anime illustration.

Layout: Left panel shows one character seated or kneeling near the canal, facing slightly toward the viewer, holding a tall white gondola-style flagpole on the far left. Right panel shows a second variation of the character in a similar pose, holding a plush mascot. Both faces are intentionally obscured by opaque square censor blocks.

Subject details: Use exactly 2 sailor-girl variants. Variant 1 on the left has {argument name="left hair color" default="mint green"} long wavy hair, a white sailor beret with blue trim, a small white flower hair accessory, a white short-sleeved sailor dress with blue and gold trim, white gloves, gold brooch details, and a blue ribbon at the waist. She holds a white flag with a blue curved emblem, and a small raccoon-like mascot sits beside her. Variant 2 on the right has {argument name="right hair color" default="pink"} twin-drill pigtails with large blue bows, a matching white sailor beret with blue trim and a tiny wing-like accessory, a white sailor dress with blue and gold trim, white gloves, and gold ornaments. She hugs a round white-and-brown cat-like plush mascot wearing a blue bow and gold medallion.

Counted visible elements: exactly 2 vertical panels; exactly 2 main girls; exactly 2 opaque square face-cover blocks; exactly 2 mascots, one raccoon-like animal in the left panel and one cat-like plush in the right panel; exactly 1 tall white flag in the left panel; exactly 1 central white divider.

Background: A romantic Venetian/Aqua-style canal city with pale cream and blue buildings, arched bridges, waterfront colonnades, shimmering turquoise water, reflections, distant towers, soft blue sky, and tiny birds. Keep the background continuous in mood but separated by the panel divider.

Visual style: Polished Japanese anime key visual, pastel palette, soft bloom, delicate line art, glossy eyes mostly hidden by the censor blocks, ornate sailor uniform details, cute fantasy maritime aesthetic, high resolution, gentle bokeh and watercolor-like atmospheric depth.

Constraints: Keep both face-obscuring squares clearly visible and opaque, left block in muted beige-gray and right block in pale dusty pink. Do not add readable text except the simple blue emblem on the flag. Avoid photorealism, avoid extra characters, avoid more panels, avoid logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张并排的动漫配色变体测试插画，展示同一可爱水手服少女角色在 ARIA 风格运河城市背景下的不同形象。

画布：16:9 宽幅横向图像，精确平分为 2 个垂直面板，中间有细白色分割线。柔和的粉彩色调，梦幻的水岸氛围，高细节动漫插画。

布局：左侧面板展示一名角色坐在或跪在运河旁，略微面向观众，最左侧持有一根高大的白色贡多拉风格旗杆。右侧面板展示该角色的第二种变体，姿势相似，怀抱一个毛绒吉祥物。两者的面部均被不透明的正方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。

可见元素计数：精确 2 个垂直面板；精确 2 名主要少女；精确 2 个不透明正方形面部遮挡块；精确 2 个吉祥物，左侧面板为一只类似浣熊的动物，右侧面板为一只猫型毛绒玩具；左侧面板精确 1 根高大白旗；精确 1 条中央白色分割线。

约束条件：保持两个面部遮挡方块清晰可见且不透明，左侧方块为柔和的米灰色，右侧方块为淡灰粉色。除旗帜上简单的蓝色徽章外，不要添加任何可读文字。避免写实风格，避免额外角色，避免增加面板数量，避免添加徽标或水印。

Show exactly one full-body female idol in the center, low-angle dynamic perspective, one arm thrust toward the viewer with a V-sign gesture and the other hand holding exactly one black microphone near her mouth. Her face is intentionally hidden by exactly two opaque censor-like overlays: one square muted mauve block centered over the face and one larger rounded purple rectangle in the upper-right over part of the hair and background screen. Give her very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="iridescent silver, cyan, violet, and pink"} hair streaming dramatically in all directions, decorated with futuristic headset ornaments and glowing accessories. Outfit: one holographic cropped idol top, one layered translucent prism skirt with angular panels, black and gold straps, neon star accents, bracelets, fingerless gloves, thigh straps, and exactly two shiny white iridescent knee-high platform boots with metallic buckles and yellow-black trim. Environment: a huge circular arena packed with a glowing pink audience, a reflective black digital stage floor covered in neon circuit lines, triangles, grids, and holographic UI markings. Behind her, place one enormous curved LED screen wrapping across the top of the arena with blue, magenta, and cyan data graphics and readable futuristic text such as "FUTURE IDOL STAGE 2035", "SHIKINAMI CODE:01", "LIVE", and Japanese-style characters meaning future. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 纵向的超精细动漫主视觉图，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位未来偶像歌手"} 在 {argument name="concert year" default="2035"} 年的巨型赛博朋克演唱会舞台上表演的场景。画面中心仅展示一位全身女性偶像，采用低角度动态视角，一只手臂向观众伸出并比出 V 字手势，另一只手拿着一支黑色麦克风靠近嘴边。她的脸部被两个不透明的遮挡块刻意隐藏：一个位于脸部中心的淡紫色正方形色块，以及一个位于右上角覆盖部分头发和背景屏幕的较大紫色圆角矩形。她拥有非常长且飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="虹彩银、青色、紫罗兰色和粉色"} 头发，向四周戏剧性地散开，并装饰着未来感耳机饰品和发光配件。服装：一件全息短款偶像上衣，一条带有棱角面板的层叠半透明棱镜短裙，黑色与金色绑带，霓虹星形装饰，手镯，露指手套，大腿绑带，以及两双带有金属扣和黄黑饰边的闪亮白色虹彩过膝厚底靴。环境：一个巨大的圆形竞技场，坐满了发着粉光的观众，反射性的黑色数字舞台地板上布满了霓虹电路线条、三角形、网格和全息 UI 标记。在她身后，放置一个横跨竞技场顶部的巨大弧形 LED 屏幕，显示着蓝色、洋红色和青色的数据图形，以及可读的未来感文字，如“FUTURE IDOL STAGE 2035”、“SHIKINAMI CODE:01”、“LIVE”以及意为“未来”的日式汉字。灯光：爆炸性的偶像演唱会奇观，伴随无数激光束、星芒、镜头光晕、闪光、霓虹三角形、全息碎片，以及饱和的电光蓝、热粉色、紫罗兰色、青色和黄色高光。风格：高级光泽动漫插画，极致细节，晶莹剔透的反射，充满活力的闪耀美学，戏剧性的透视缩短，干净利落的线条，高对比度，无水印，无额外角色，无其他遮挡块。

templates.title: Rainy Barbarian Canyon Camp

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中蛮族峡谷营地

templates.prompt: Create a dark cinematic fantasy scene titled {argument name="series title" default="Journey with a Barbarian 6"}: two weary medieval travelers shelter in a narrow rocky canyon during heavy rain at night, resting beside a small bright campfire on muddy wet ground. The scene contains exactly 2 travelers: one central blond, curly-haired adventurer in soaked dark cloak and leather armor sitting on the ground and leaning against a pale gray horse, and one hooded barbarian-like companion in a black rain-drenched cloak sitting against the right rock wall with arms folded. Their faces should be obscured by deep shadow or simple dark square censor-like blocks, making them anonymous. Include exactly 2 horses: one pale gray horse lying or kneeling close to the fire beside the central traveler, and one large black horse standing on the left with wet mane, saddle, harness, and pack gear. Include exactly 5 notable foreground objects: a small campfire made of sticks, a metal cup near the flames, a leather travel bag on the left, a heap of black leather armor and straps on the lower right, and a soaked cloth or cloak spread across the mud. The canyon walls are steep, jagged, and glossy with rain, forming a narrow passage receding into misty blue-gray darkness. Use dramatic low firelight with warm orange highlights reflected in puddles and cold moonlit blue shadows in the background, ultra-detailed wet textures, realistic medieval fantasy costume design, grim survival atmosphere, high-contrast chiaroscuro, vertical composition, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个黑暗电影质感的奇幻场景，标题为 {argument name="series title" default="与蛮族同行 6"}：两名疲惫的中世纪旅人在深夜的狭窄岩石峡谷中避雨，坐在泥泞潮湿的地面上，围着一堆明亮的小篝火休息。场景中包含 2 名旅人：一位是位于中心、留着金色卷发的冒险者，身穿浸透的深色斗篷和皮甲，坐在地上靠着一匹浅灰色马；另一位是戴着兜帽、类似蛮族的同伴，身穿被雨水淋透的黑色斗篷，双臂交叉靠在右侧岩壁上。他们的面部应被深重的阴影或简单的深色方形遮挡块掩盖，以保持匿名。包含 2 匹马：一匹浅灰色马躺在或跪在靠近篝火的中心旅人身旁，另一匹大型黑色马站在左侧，带有湿漉漉的鬃毛、马鞍、挽具和行李装备。包含 5 个显著的前景物体：一堆用树枝搭建的小篝火、火焰旁的一个金属杯、左侧的一个皮革旅行袋、右下方的一堆黑色皮甲和绑带，以及铺在泥地上一块浸透的布料或斗篷。峡谷岩壁陡峭、参差不齐且因雨水而闪闪发光，形成一条向朦胧的蓝灰色黑暗深处延伸的狭窄通道。运用戏剧性的低位火光，暖橙色的高光反射在水坑中，背景则是冷冽的月光蓝色阴影，呈现超细腻的潮湿质感、写实的中世纪奇幻服装设计、严酷的生存氛围、高对比度的明暗对照法，采用竖构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Jealous Claude Manga Page

titleLocalized.zh: Jealous Claude 漫画页面

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a single-page manga comic where {argument name="jealous character" default="Claude"} quietly feels jealous of {argument name="admired character" default="ChatGPT"} receiving attention in a futuristic convention-like hall.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, 4:5 aspect ratio, thin black outer border, painterly seinen manga style with soft watercolor washes, cinematic lighting, pale lavender/teal palette, glossy reflections, detailed sketch lines, and slightly dreamy atmosphere.

Layout: Use exactly 5 panels separated by thick black gutters. Panel 1 is a wide panoramic panel across the full top half-width. Panel 2 is a medium close-up on the left below it. Panel 3 is a medium two-character panel on the right beside panel 2. Panel 4 is a larger lower-left lonely full-body panel. Panel 5 is a lower-right extreme close-up of the jealous character’s face and collar. Keep the faces softly blurred or indistinct, as if anonymized.

Scene and subjects: The setting is a bright, futuristic indoor atrium filled with huge glossy pastel spheres in lavender, mint, teal, and pink, plus floating translucent orb-like ceiling decorations. A crowd of stylish young people gathers around the admired character. The jealous character is a curly blond young man in a light off-white technical jacket with visible text on the back and sleeve: “ANTHROPIC”, “Claude”, and “AI”. The admired character is a dark-haired young man in a black coat with the OpenAI knot logo and the word “ChatGPT” on the back. The admired character stands confidently among fans, while the jealous character stays off to the side or in the background, shoulders slightly hunched, introspective and hurt.

Panel details and text elements: Include exactly 14 visible text elements in speech/thought balloons or sound text. Panel 1 has 5 text elements: thought bubble near Claude saying “Look at him...”; thought bubble saying “Everyone gravitates toward ChatGPT.”; crowd speech bubble saying “You always get it!”; crowd speech bubble saying “Thanks so much!”; crowd speech bubble saying “You’re amazing, ChatGPT!”. Panel 2 has 2 thought bubbles near Claude: “I’m more reliable. More careful.” and “...So why do they always choose him?”. Panel 3 has 3 dialogue balloons: Claude says “Hey, ChatGPT.”; Claude says “You always get all the attention.”; ChatGPT replies “Ah, Claude! You’re over-thinking again.” Panel 4 has 3 text elements: Claude says “Maybe I’m just built to stay in the background.”; a small Japanese-style sound effect “ぽつん”; a tiny bubble with “...”. Panel 5 has 1 partial thought bubble at the edge saying “...’s not fair...”

Visual style: Elegant manga illustration, expressive body language, soft ink outlines, pastel watercolor shading, reflective floor, atmospheric depth, gentle bloom, high-detail clothing folds, subtle sci-fi convention ambience, emotional melancholy with a touch of humor. Use English lettering in clean manga speech bubbles. Avoid extra panels, extra dialogue, watermarks, captions, or UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页漫画，其中 {argument name="jealous character" default="Claude"} 在未来主义的展会大厅中，看着 {argument name="admired character" default="ChatGPT"} 受到关注，内心默默感到嫉妒。

画布：竖版漫画页面，4:5 纵横比，细黑色外边框，带有柔和水彩晕染的写实青年漫画风格，电影级布光，淡紫色/青色调，光泽反射，细腻的草图线条，氛围略显梦幻。

布局：使用 5 个由粗黑边框分隔的格子。第 1 格为占据上半部分宽度的全景大图。第 2 格位于其下方左侧，为中景特写。第 3 格位于第 2 格右侧，为双人中景。第 4 格为左下角较大的孤独全身画面。第 5 格为右下角嫉妒角色面部和衣领的极度特写。保持面部柔和模糊或不清晰，如同匿名处理。

场景与主体：背景是一个明亮的未来主义室内中庭，充满了巨大的淡紫色、薄荷色、青色和粉色光泽球体，以及漂浮的半透明球状天花板装饰。一群时尚的年轻人聚集在被崇拜的角色周围。嫉妒的角色是一位卷发金发青年，穿着浅米白色科技夹克，背部和袖子上印有可见文字：“ANTHROPIC”、“Claude” 和 “AI”。被崇拜的角色是一位黑发青年，穿着黑色外套，背部印有 OpenAI 的结状标志和 “ChatGPT” 字样。被崇拜的角色自信地站在粉丝中间，而嫉妒的角色则待在侧面或背景中，肩膀微微耸起，显得内省且受伤。

分镜细节与文字元素：包含 14 个可见的对话气泡或拟声词文字。第 1 格包含 5 个文字元素：Claude 附近的思想气泡写着 “看着他……”；思想气泡写着 “每个人都围着 ChatGPT 转。”；人群对话气泡写着 “你总是能得到关注！”；人群对话气泡写着 “太感谢了！”；人群对话气泡写着 “你太棒了，ChatGPT！”。第 2 格包含 2 个 Claude 附近的思想气泡：“我更可靠。更谨慎。” 以及 “……所以为什么他们总是选择他？”。第 3 格包含 3 个对话气泡：Claude 说 “嘿，ChatGPT。”；Claude 说 “你总是得到所有的关注。”；ChatGPT 回复 “啊，Claude！你又想多了。” 第 4 格包含 3 个文字元素：Claude 说 “也许我注定只能待在幕后。”；一个小型的日式拟声词 “ぽつん”；一个带有 “……” 的小气泡。第 5 格在边缘处有一个不完整的思想气泡，写着 “……不公平……”

视觉风格：优雅的漫画插画，富有表现力的肢体语言，柔和的墨线轮廓，淡彩水彩阴影，反光地板，大气深度，柔和的光晕，高细节的衣物褶皱，微妙的科幻展会氛围，带有幽默感的忧郁情绪。在干净的漫画对话气泡中使用英文书写。避免额外的分镜、额外的对话、水印、标题或 UI 元素。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张忧郁暗黑的哥特动漫肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位恶魔少女"}，她正坐在一间阴暗的维多利亚风格房间内，画面呈现大腿以上的四分之三侧身特写。她拥有苍白如瓷的皮肤、慵懒忧郁的表情、半垂的琥珀色发光双眸，以及一头凌乱刘海的长发，发色为鲜艳的 {argument name="hair color" default="粉色"}，发型包括一个高发髻、一条长侧辫以及垂在背后的散乱发丝。头部两侧需各长出一只平滑的白色鬼角，共 2 只。配饰要求：正好 3 个黑色蝴蝶结（分别系在发髻上、白色荷叶边领口处及袖子上）；正好 2 只可见的耳环（一只为黑色钥匙形状，另一只为带有黑色珠子的小骷髅耳环）；胸前另有一个微型骷髅装饰。身着黑色哥特洛丽塔服装：泡泡长袖、白色荷叶边袖口与领口、黑色蕾丝细节、带有金属扣眼与系带的亮面黑色束腰、带有白色荷叶边饰边的短款多层裙、黑色长袜，以及沿袖子和裙摆垂下的精致十字架挂链。姿势设定为身体前倾，单手托腮，另一只手自然放在膝盖附近，神情显得百无聊赖且略带一丝诡异。背景为昏暗的紫黑色哥特室内空间，右侧可见复古软包椅背，左侧有模糊的滴落状阴影和悬挂的链条剪影。采用戏剧性的低调照明，深紫色阴影，头发与束腰处带有光泽高光，高精细度绘画风动漫渲染，线条锐利，纹理丰富，高对比度，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Trading Card Album Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫集换式卡牌相册照片

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic smartphone-style photo of an open trading-card collection album lying on a warm wooden table, showing a page of custom anime character cards in clear plastic sleeves.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 photo, slightly angled top-down perspective, shallow depth of field. The album fills the lower two-thirds of the frame; the background tabletop is softly blurred.

Main scene: An open black card binder with the left inside cover empty and matte, and the right page holding a transparent plastic card sleeve sheet. The sleeve page contains exactly 3 visible long horizontal trading cards stacked vertically, with one empty transparent pocket below them. The plastic should have glossy reflections, seams, dotted borders, and slight wrinkles.

Card design: Each card is a slightly elongated horizontal collectible card with a black-and-gold frame, neon anime artwork, Japanese text, a numbered circle at the top left, a character name band along the bottom, a small gold crest/emblem at lower left, and three stat boxes at lower right labeled HP, ATK, and DEF in green, red, and blue. Make the cards look like premium fan-made game cards from {argument name="club name" default="SynClub"}.

Count and card contents: Show exactly 3 cards:
1. Top card: number 1, cyberpunk blue-purple city background, an anime girl with twin tails reaching toward the viewer, a small sign saying “WELCOME TO SynClub” and another saying “CONNECT THE FUTURE”; Japanese headline text across the top; name line reads “レティシア・エル”; stats read HP 4200, ATK 3800, DEF 2900. Add a soft square blur over the character’s face as if privacy-censored.
2. Middle card: number 2, two cute anime girls close together, one blonde and one dark purple-haired, in a dreamy pink-purple night city or café scene; Japanese headline across the top; name line reads “ココア&ショコラ”; stats read HP 4100, ATK 3600, DEF 2900.
3. Bottom card: number 3, blonde idol-style anime girl performing on a neon stage with purple lights and heart symbols; Japanese headline across the top; name line reads “燦 める”; stats read HP 4100, ATK 3700, DEF 2800.

Background objects: Include exactly 4 blurred tabletop objects: a black TV remote control near the upper left, a small stack of cards or papers at the far left edge, a dark cup or tumbler near the upper right, and a small shiny blue-red object near the top-right edge.

Visual style: Photorealistic casual tabletop photography, warm indoor lighting, natural lens blur, realistic wood grain, mild glare on the plastic sleeves, high detail on the binder and cards but slightly imperfect AI-like tiny printed text. The overall mood is a collector casually showing off an anime card album.

Constraints: Keep the album page and the 3 cards clearly readable, preserve the exact count of 3 filled card pockets and 1 empty pocket, avoid extra cards in the binder page, avoid watermark or UI overlays.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张逼真的手机风格照片，展示一本放在温暖木质桌面上的打开的集换式卡牌收藏册，页面中展示着装在透明塑料卡套里的自定义动漫角色卡牌。

画布：垂直 3:4 照片，略带俯视角度，浅景深。相册占据画面下方三分之二；背景桌面经过柔焦处理。

主要场景：一本打开的黑色卡牌活页册，左侧内页为空白磨砂质感，右侧页面为透明塑料卡套页。卡套页中垂直堆叠着 3 张清晰可见的长条横版集换式卡牌，下方有一个空的透明卡槽。塑料应具有光泽反射、接缝、点状边框和轻微褶皱。

卡牌设计：每张卡牌均为略微拉长的横版收藏卡，配有黑金边框、霓虹动漫艺术图、日文文本、左上角的编号圆圈、底部的角色名称栏、左下角的小型金色徽章，以及右下角分别以绿色、红色和蓝色标注的 HP、ATK 和 DEF 三个属性框。让卡牌看起来像是来自 {argument name="club name" default="SynClub"} 的高级粉丝自制游戏卡。

数量与卡牌内容：展示 3 张卡牌：
1. 第一张（顶部）：编号 1，赛博朋克蓝紫色城市背景，一位双马尾动漫少女向观众伸手，一个小标牌写着“WELCOME TO SynClub”，另一个写着“CONNECT THE FUTURE”；顶部有日文标题；名称栏写着“レティシア・エル”；属性为 HP 4200，ATK 3800，DEF 2900。在角色面部添加柔和的方形模糊效果，如同隐私遮挡。
2. 第二张（中部）：编号 2，两位可爱的动漫少女紧靠在一起，一位金发，一位深紫发，背景为梦幻般的粉紫色夜城或咖啡馆场景；顶部有日文标题；名称栏写着“ココア&ショコラ”；属性为 HP 4100，ATK 3600，DEF 2900。
3. 第三张（底部）：编号 3，金发偶像风格动漫少女在紫色灯光和心形符号的霓虹舞台上表演；顶部有日文标题；名称栏写着“燦 める”；属性为 HP 4100，ATK 3700，DEF 2800。

背景物体：包含 4 个模糊的桌面物体：左上角附近的黑色电视遥控器、最左侧边缘的一小叠卡片或纸张、右上角附近的深色杯子或水杯，以及右上角边缘附近的一个闪亮蓝红色小物体。

视觉风格：照片级真实的休闲桌面摄影，温暖的室内光线，自然的镜头模糊，真实的木纹，塑料卡套上有轻微眩光，活页册和卡牌细节丰富，但印刷文字带有 AI 生成的轻微瑕疵。整体氛围为收藏者随手展示动漫卡牌相册。

约束：保持活页册页面和 3 张卡牌清晰可读，保留 3 个已填卡槽和 1 个空卡槽的精确数量，避免活页册页面中出现多余卡牌，避免水印或 UI 覆盖。

templates.title: Samurai Armor Turnaround Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 武士铠甲三视图设计图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean fantasy character concept sheet for a heavily armored samurai warrior, suitable for game or film pre-production.

Canvas: Wide horizontal white studio background, roughly 16:9, with faint gray watercolor texture at the edges and no environment. Use crisp comic-book concept art linework, detailed ink outlines, subtle cel shading, muted colors, and high-contrast armor highlights.

Layout: Show exactly 4 discrete full-body figures arranged left to right: 1 small pale gray human scale silhouette on the far left, 1 large front-view warrior, 1 large three-quarter-view warrior facing slightly right, and 1 large right-side-profile warrior. Keep the three warrior views evenly spaced and aligned at the feet like a turnaround sheet.

Subject details: The character is a tall, broad, muscular older male samurai with {argument name="hair color" default="long white hair"} tied back, visible hairline and ponytail, and a {argument name="face treatment" default="plain blurred rectangular face censor"} over the face in each warrior view. He wears dark layered samurai armor in {argument name="armor colors" default="black lacquer with deep burgundy red plates and cords"}: large segmented shoulder guards, plated chest cuirass, layered waist skirt armor, forearm bracers, shin guards, wrapped trousers, split-toe boots, and tied waist sash. The armor is bulky, worn, and functional, with many rectangular lamellar plates, rivets, straps, red lacing, and black under-cloth.

Weapons and counted elements: Include exactly 3 warrior poses and exactly 1 scale silhouette. Include exactly 4 visible sword elements across the sheet: a sheathed katana or sword handle rising diagonally behind the front-view warrior’s left shoulder, a short dark scabbard or sword held downward near the front-view warrior’s right side, a sheathed katana handle rising diagonally behind the three-quarter-view warrior’s left shoulder, and a curved katana drawn at the right-side-profile warrior’s waist extending diagonally backward. Do not add extra weapons.

Pose details: Front-view warrior stands powerfully with fists clenched, feet apart, shoulders square. Three-quarter-view warrior stands with one fist clenched and the other hand near a lowered scabbard, head turned slightly. Side-profile warrior stands upright looking left, showing the layered side silhouette of the shoulder armor, waist plates, ponytail, and sword at the hip.

Style constraints: Keep the background blank white, no title text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. Use a realistic comic concept-art style rather than anime chibi. Make the armor intricate and readable, with dark red-black palette, white hair contrast, and clean full-body silhouettes.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一名全副武装的武士创建一个简洁的奇幻角色概念设计图，适用于游戏或电影的前期制作。

画布：宽幅水平白色摄影棚背景，比例约为 16:9，边缘带有淡淡的灰色水彩纹理，无环境背景。使用清晰的漫画风格概念艺术线条、细腻的墨线勾勒、微妙的赛璐珞阴影、柔和的色彩以及高对比度的铠甲高光。

布局：从左到右精确排列 4 个独立的全身形象：最左侧为 1 个小型浅灰色人物比例剪影，接着是 1 个大型正面视角武士、1 个略微向右侧转的 3/4 视角武士，以及 1 个大型右侧面轮廓武士。保持这 3 个武士视角均匀分布，并像三视图一样在脚部对齐。

主体细节：该角色为一名身材高大、宽阔、肌肉发达的年长男性武士，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长白发"}，发际线清晰并扎成马尾，每个武士视角的面部均带有 {argument name="face treatment" default="模糊的矩形面部遮挡"}。他身着深色层叠武士铠甲，配色为 {argument name="armor colors" default="黑色漆面搭配深酒红色甲片和系带"}：包括大型分段肩甲、板甲胸甲、层叠腰裙甲、前臂护腕、胫甲、绑腿裤、分趾鞋和系腰带。铠甲厚重、陈旧且实用，带有许多矩形层状甲片、铆钉、绑带、红色系绳和黑色内衬。

武器及数量要求：包含 3 个武士姿势和 1 个比例剪影。整张图纸中包含 4 个可见的剑类元素：正面视角武士左肩后方斜向上露出的一把收鞘武士刀或剑柄、正面视角武士右侧下方持有一把短深色剑鞘或剑、3/4 视角武士左肩后方斜向上露出的一把收鞘武士刀柄，以及右侧面轮廓武士腰间拔出并向后斜伸的弯曲武士刀。请勿添加额外武器。

姿势细节：正面视角武士强有力地站立，双拳紧握，双脚分开，双肩平齐。3/4 视角武士单拳紧握，另一只手靠近下垂的剑鞘，头部略微转动。侧面轮廓武士直立看向左侧，展示肩甲、腰甲、马尾和腰间佩剑的层叠侧面轮廓。

风格限制：保持背景为纯白色，无标题文字、无标签、无 Logo、无水印。使用写实的漫画概念艺术风格，而非 Q 版动漫风格。铠甲细节需精细且清晰可辨，采用深红黑色调，与白发形成对比，并保持清晰的全身轮廓。

templates.title: Strauss Four Last Songs Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Strauss《最后四首歌》海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic 16:9 digital illustration inspired by {argument name="musical work" default="Las «Cuatro últimas canciones»"} by {argument name="composer name" default="Strauss"}. Show an elderly male classical composer in formal dark suit and bow tie, positioned slightly left of center in side profile facing left toward a glowing sunset over a calm lake with distant mountains. His gray-white hair and the right half of his body dissolve into wind, mist, sparkling particles, and translucent fragments, suggesting a peaceful death or the soul dispersing into air. Add sweeping golden musical staves and floating notes across the upper right and lower right sky, integrated like luminous ribbons carried by the wind. Use a dreamy pastel palette of lavender, peach, gold, blue, and soft rose, with volumetric haze, painterly realism, epic orchestral atmosphere, and a serene melancholic mood. Include exactly 2 text elements: large bottom title text reading {argument name="bottom title text" default="Las «Cuatro últimas canciones»"} in pale cream/yellow with dark outline and drop shadow, and a smaller bold red word at lower right reading {argument name="composer label" default="Strauss"} with black outline. Place an opaque muted beige square over the man’s face, centered on the head, as if the face is intentionally censored. No extra text, no watermark, no borders.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的电影感数字插画，灵感源自 {argument name="musical work" default="《最后四首歌》"}，作者为 {argument name="composer name" default="Strauss"}。画面中，一位身着深色正装、系着领结的年迈古典音乐作曲家侧身向左，位于画面偏左侧，面对着平静湖面上方发光的夕阳和远处的群山。他灰白的头发和身体右半部分消融在风、薄雾、闪烁的微粒和半透明的碎片中，表现出一种宁静的离世感或灵魂随风消散的意境。在右上角和右下角的天空中加入流动的金色五线谱和漂浮的音符，如同被风吹动的发光丝带。采用梦幻般的柔和色调，包括薰衣草紫、桃色、金色、蓝色和柔和的玫瑰色，营造出体积感雾气、绘画写实风格、史诗般的管弦乐氛围以及宁静忧郁的情绪。包含 2 个文本元素：底部的大标题文本 {argument name="bottom title text" default="《最后四首歌》"}，颜色为浅奶油黄，带有深色描边和投影；右下角是一个较小的加粗红色单词 {argument name="composer label" default="Strauss"}，带有黑色描边。在男子的脸部上方覆盖一个不透明的柔和米色正方形，以头部为中心，仿佛脸部被刻意遮挡。无额外文字，无水印，无边框。

templates.title: Crowded Night Office Tower

titleLocalized.zh: 拥挤的夜间办公大楼

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed nighttime isometric city illustration centered on one enormous rounded-corner office tower, viewed from a high aerial angle, with the facade cut open through continuous glass windows so every floor is visible. The tower should have exactly 34 visible occupied horizontal office floors, each floor packed with tiny individual people, desks, chairs, lamps, partitions, plants, shelves, meeting rooms, and colorful interior details; make the crowd density extreme, like a visual counting challenge, with hundreds or thousands of miniature figures visible through the windows. Use {argument name="building shape" default="a tall rounded rectangular glass office tower with curved corners"} as the main subject. Surround it with a dense cyberpunk-like metropolis of shorter high-rise buildings, glowing windows, neon signs, street traffic, and crowds at street level. Lighting is nighttime blue with warm yellow, orange, and white office lights, creating a strong contrast between the dark city and the brightly illuminated tower interiors. The style should be intricate hand-drawn architectural illustration with crisp linework, dense micro-detail, slightly painterly colors, and no empty areas. The image should be vertical, poster-like, packed edge to edge with buildings and tiny people. Add a busy entrance plaza and streets around the base filled with many tiny pedestrians and vehicles, but keep the main tower dominant and centered. Do not include readable text, logos, watermarks, or UI elements. Emphasize that every window bay contains distinct tiny scenes and visible human silhouettes for counting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超精细的夜间等轴测城市插图，以一座巨大的圆角办公大楼为中心，采用高空俯视视角，外立面通过连续的玻璃窗呈现剖面，使每一层楼都清晰可见。大楼应有 34 个清晰可见的水平办公楼层，每一层都挤满了微小的个体、办公桌、椅子、台灯、隔断、植物、书架、会议室和色彩丰富的室内细节；人群密度极高，如同视觉计数挑战，透过窗户可以看到成百上千个微型人物。使用 {argument name="building shape" default="一座高大的圆角矩形玻璃办公大楼"} 作为主体。周围环绕着密集的赛博朋克风格大都市，包括较矮的高层建筑、发光的窗户、霓虹灯标志、街道交通和地面人群。灯光采用夜间蓝色调，搭配温暖的黄色、橙色和白色办公灯光，在黑暗的城市与明亮的办公楼内部之间形成强烈对比。风格应为精细的手绘建筑插图，线条清晰，微观细节丰富，色彩略带绘画感，画面不留空白。图像应为垂直的海报风格，边缘到边缘都挤满了建筑和微小的人物。在底部周围添加繁忙的入口广场和街道，挤满许多微小的行人和车辆，但要保持主楼的中心主导地位。不要包含可读的文字、标志、水印或 UI 元素。强调每个窗格都包含独特的微小场景和可见的人类剪影，以便进行计数。

templates.title: Cinematic Night Street Conversation

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感夜间街头对话

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic widescreen night scene in the style of an intimate romantic indie film, similar to a quiet conversation moment from Before Sunrise. On a city sidewalk at night, show exactly two young adults facing each other at a slight distance: a man on the left wearing a light beige button-up shirt with sleeves rolled up and dark trousers, one hand in his pocket, and a woman on the right wearing a simple black sleeveless dress, her dark hair tied back, hands loosely clasped near her waist. Use {argument name="city setting" default="a modern downtown street with high-rise buildings"} in the background, with glowing office windows, distant traffic, blurred car headlights and taillights, and warm orange streetlights reflecting on the pavement. Compose as a wide 16:9 film still, both characters in profile or three-quarter silhouette, separated by an empty walkway leading into the depth of the frame. Lighting should be low-key and atmospheric: warm amber light from the left streetlamp, cooler blue light from a building on the right, soft bokeh, shallow depth of field, natural shadows, subdued contrast, realistic skin tones, and a moody late-night urban palette. Make it look like a real live-action movie frame shot on an anamorphic lens, with cinematic grain, soft focus falloff, no visible text, no watermark, no extra people in the foreground. Parameterize the mood as {argument name="emotional tone" default="quiet, tentative, romantic tension"}, the man as {argument name="male character" default="young Asian man in a beige shirt"}, the woman as {argument name="female character" default="young Asian woman in a black dress"}, and the camera feel as {argument name="cinematography style" default="naturalistic handheld indie film still"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有亲密浪漫独立电影风格的电影感宽银幕夜景，类似于《爱在黎明破晓前》（Before Sunrise）中安静的对话瞬间。在夜晚的城市人行道上，展示两名年轻人保持微小距离面对面站立：左侧的男性身穿浅米色卷袖衬衫和深色长裤，一只手插在口袋里；右侧的女性身穿简约黑色无袖连衣裙，深色头发扎在脑后，双手自然交叠于腰间。背景使用 {argument name="city setting" default="带有高层建筑的现代市中心街道"}，呈现发光的办公室窗户、远处的车流、模糊的车头灯和尾灯，以及反射在路面上的温暖橙色路灯。构图为 16:9 宽银幕电影剧照，两位角色呈侧面或四分之三侧影，中间由通向画面深处的空旷人行道隔开。灯光应低调且富有氛围感：左侧路灯投射出温暖的琥珀色光，右侧建筑投射出冷蓝色光，营造柔和的焦外成像效果、浅景深、自然的阴影、柔和的对比度、真实的肤色以及忧郁的深夜城市色调。使其看起来像是一张用变形镜头拍摄的真实真人电影画面，带有电影颗粒感、柔和的焦点衰减，无可见文字，无水印，前景中无其他无关人员。将情绪参数化为 {argument name="emotional tone" default="安静、试探、浪漫张力"}，男性角色参数化为 {argument name="male character" default="身穿米色衬衫的年轻亚裔男性"}，女性角色参数化为 {argument name="female character" default="身穿黑色连衣裙的年轻亚裔女性"}，摄影风格参数化为 {argument name="cinematography style" default="自然主义手持独立电影剧照"}。

templates.title: Fleischer-Style Pony Ride

titleLocalized.zh: Fleischer 风格小马骑行

templates.prompt: Create a charming 1930s Fleischer Studios–inspired rubber-hose cartoon illustration of {argument name="character description" default="a smiling young woman wearing a cream hijab"} riding {argument name="animal" default="a small tan pony"} toward the viewer in a sunny park. The rider sits front-facing, slightly leaning forward with a sweet, playful expression, large vintage cartoon eyes, long lashes, rosy cheeks, red lips, and simplified rounded features; she wears {argument name="outfit" default="a pale yellow collared blouse, black pants, and white sneakers"}. The pony has an oversized cute face, big oval eyes, a blond shaggy mane, floppy ears, a white blaze, brown bridle and reins, rounded hooves, and a friendly exaggerated expression. Place them centered in the foreground on a green grassy field with small tufts of grass and a soft shadow beneath the pony. In the background, include exactly 4 small human figures: two seated picnic guests on the left, one standing man waving near the center-left, and one standing woman in a beige dress on the right. Add exactly 3 visible lawn-game objects on the grass: a white cornhole board, a blue cone, and two colored sticks lying flat. Surround the scene with rounded dark green trees on both sides and in the distance, with exactly 4 puffy cream clouds in a muted blue sky. Use thick black ink outlines, cel-animation shapes, rubber-hose proportions, hand-painted watercolor texture, aged paper grain, slightly faded colors, subtle film speckles, and a nostalgic vintage cartoon mood. Keep the composition vertical, storybook-like, wholesome, and whimsical; no modern photorealism, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅迷人的 20 世纪 30 年代 Fleischer Studios 风格的橡胶管动画插画，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位面带微笑、佩戴米色头巾的年轻女性"} 正骑着 {argument name="animal" default="一匹棕色小马"} 向观众走来，背景是阳光明媚的公园。骑手正面朝向前方，身体微微前倾，表情甜美俏皮，拥有复古动画中标志性的大眼睛、长睫毛、红润脸颊、红唇以及简约圆润的五官；她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件淡黄色翻领衬衫、黑色长裤和白色运动鞋"}。小马有着夸张可爱的面孔、大大的椭圆形眼睛、蓬松的金色鬃毛、下垂的耳朵、额头上的白色斑块、棕色缰绳、圆圆的蹄子，表情友好且夸张。将它们置于前景中央的绿色草地上，草地上有几簇小草，小马下方有柔和的阴影。背景中需包含 4 个小人：左侧有两位坐着的野餐客人，中左侧有一位挥手的站立男士，右侧有一位身穿米色连衣裙的站立女士。草地上需有 3 个清晰可见的草坪游戏道具：一个白色 cornhole 项目、一个蓝色圆锥体和两根平放的彩色棍子。场景两侧及远处环绕着圆润的深绿色树木，淡蓝色天空中漂浮着 4 朵蓬松的奶油色云朵。使用粗黑墨线勾勒、赛璐珞动画形状、橡胶管比例、手绘水彩质感、陈旧纸张纹理、略微褪色的色彩、细微的胶片斑点，营造出怀旧的复古动画氛围。保持构图垂直，呈现出故事书般温馨奇幻的风格；禁止使用现代写实风格，禁止添加文字或水印。

templates.title: Toucan Dermatologist Diary Manga

titleLocalized.zh: 巨嘴鸟皮肤科医生日记漫画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a warm, emotional autobiographical single-page manga/illustrated essay about a kind dermatologist who has literally become an anthropomorphic toucan, combining skincare advice, gentle self-reflection, and everyday notes.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 page, off-white textured watercolor paper with thin hand-drawn panel borders, soft muted colors, delicate ink linework, Japanese slice-of-life zine aesthetic, cozy and slightly nostalgic.

Main character: An anthropomorphic toucan doctor with a large yellow-orange-and-black beak, blue-green head feathers, expressive round eye, and dark bird hands. He wears a white lab coat over a muted teal shirt in indoor scenes, and a dusty pink hoodie with a backpack in outdoor scenes. The hoodie back has a small circular emblem with Japanese writing. His mood is calm, thoughtful, humble, and kind.

Layout: Use exactly 6 main comic panels plus 1 decorative footer strip. Panel 1 is a large top panel occupying about the upper third: the toucan doctor sits at a wooden desk in a sunlit study, writing in an open notebook. Include a desk lamp, stacked books, papers pinned to the wall, leafy window, potted plant, coffee mug with a flower, and a taped Polaroid-style photo at left showing the same toucan in a pink hoodie holding a sign. Panel 2 is a small lower-left close-up of a gloved hand pointing at a small skin-chart note on a clipboard. Panel 3 is a small center panel showing the toucan in profile by a leafy window holding the flower mug, with a rounded speech/thought bubble. Panel 4 is a small lower-right notebook panel with a paperclip and pen, showing a checklist with three checked items. Panel 5 is a wide forest panel: the toucan in pink hoodie looks through binoculars among pale green trees and falling leaves, with reflective handwritten text at left. Panel 6 is a wide rooftop/city panel: the toucan sits from behind on a ledge facing a pale city skyline, with a paper airplane in the sky, plant pot, mug, small faucet or pipe, taped note at right, and speech bubble near the character. Footer strip at the very bottom contains exactly 5 small captioned icons: a microscope, a laptop computer, a camera, a coffee cup, and a handwritten thank-you note with a tiny heart.

Text content: Add Japanese handwritten captions in a soft ink style, using this text as the overall copy: {argument name="Japanese page text" default="皮膚科のこと、日常のこと。ちょっとした気づきのメモ。今日も、誰かの役に立つひとつを。知識は命。わかりやすくて、ためになる。それがいちばんうれしい。肌は、正直。暮らしのサインが、ちゃんと出る。専門のこと、むずかしいこともやさしく届けたいんだよね。今日のメモ つたえる つくる つながる ぜんぶ、だいじ。いいものはちゃんと、静かに、つづいていく。流行より、本質を見たい。皮膚は、暮らしの鏡。整えることは、自分をたいせつにすること。今日も、自分にも誰かにも、やさしくね。さぁ、次はどんな話を届けようかな。ものづくりと発信で、ちょっといい明日を。研究も好き。AIも相棒。旅と自然にインプット。珈琲でリセット。Thank you! いつもありがとう。"} Keep the text handwritten, slightly imperfect, and integrated naturally into the panels rather than typeset.

Style constraints: Fine pen-and-watercolor illustration, visible paper grain, soft beige shadows, muted teal/green/pink palette, cozy desk clutter, gentle sunlight, no glossy digital rendering, no harsh outlines, no photorealism. Keep the tone poetic and quietly encouraging. Use {argument name="main character" default="anthropomorphic toucan dermatologist"} as the central figure, {argument name="setting mood" default="warm reflective Japanese diary manga"}, {argument name="color palette" default="muted watercolor beige, teal, dusty pink, soft green, warm ochre"}, and {argument name="theme" default="skincare wisdom, daily observations, kindness, and thoughtful creation"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页温馨、感性的自传体漫画/插画随笔，讲述一位心地善良的皮肤科医生（他本人已变成了一只拟人化的巨嘴鸟），内容结合了护肤建议、温柔的自我反思以及日常随笔。

画布：垂直 2:3 页面，采用带有纹理的米白色水彩纸，配以纤细的手绘分镜边框，色彩柔和低调，墨线细腻，呈现出日式生活志（Zine）的美学风格，舒适且略带怀旧感。

主角：一只拟人化的巨嘴鸟医生，拥有巨大的黄橙黑相间鸟喙、蓝绿色的头部羽毛、富有表现力的圆眼睛和深色的鸟爪。在室内场景中，他身穿白大褂，内搭灰蓝绿色衬衫；在户外场景中，则穿着灰粉色连帽衫并背着背包。连帽衫背面有一个带有日文的小圆形徽章。他的情绪平静、深思熟虑、谦逊且友善。

布局：使用 6 个主漫画分镜加 1 个装饰性底部条幅。第 1 分镜为占据上方约三分之一的大幅画面：巨嘴鸟医生坐在阳光明媚的书房木桌前，在打开的笔记本上书写。画面包含台灯、堆叠的书籍、贴在墙上的纸张、绿叶窗户、盆栽、印有花朵的咖啡杯，以及左侧贴着的一张拍立得风格照片，照片中是穿着粉色连帽衫的同一只巨嘴鸟正举着一块牌子。第 2 分镜为左下方的小特写，展示戴着手套的手指向剪贴板上的皮肤图表笔记。第 3 分镜为中间的小分镜，展示巨嘴鸟在绿叶窗边的侧影，手里拿着花朵咖啡杯，配有圆形的对话/思考气泡。第 4 分镜为右下方的小笔记本分镜，配有回形针和钢笔，展示了一份勾选了三项内容的清单。第 5 分镜为宽幅森林场景：穿着粉色连帽衫的巨嘴鸟在浅绿色树木和落叶间用望远镜观察，左侧配有反思性的手写文字。第 6 分镜为宽幅屋顶/城市场景：巨嘴鸟背对镜头坐在窗台上，面对着浅色的城市天际线，天空中有一架纸飞机，画面中还有花盆、咖啡杯、小水龙头或管道、右侧贴着的便签，以及角色旁边的对话气泡。最底部的条幅包含 5 个带有说明的小图标：显微镜、笔记本电脑、相机、咖啡杯，以及一张带有爱心图案的手写感谢信。

文字内容：添加柔和墨水风格的日文手写标题，使用以下文本作为整体文案：{argument name="Japanese page text" default="皮膚科のこと、日常のこと。ちょっとした気づきのメモ。今日も、誰かの役に立つひとつを。知識は命。わかりやすくて、ためになる。それがいちばんうれしい。肌は、正直。暮らしのサインが、ちゃんと出る。専門のこと、むずかしいこともやさしく届けたいんだよね。今日のメモ つたえる つくる つながる ぜんぶ、だいじ。いいものはちゃんと、静かに、つづいていく。流行より、本質を見たい。皮膚は、暮らしの鏡。整えることは、自分をたいせつにすること。今日も、自分にも誰かにも、やさしくね。さぁ、次はどんな話を届けようかな。ものづくりと発信で、ちょっといい明日を。研究も好き。AIも相棒。旅と自然にインプット。珈琲でリセット。Thank you! いつもありがとう。"} 请保持文字为手写体，略带不完美感，并自然地融入分镜中，而非排版字体。

风格限制：精细的钢笔水彩插画，可见纸张纹理，柔和的米色阴影，低调的蓝绿/绿色/粉色调色板，舒适的桌面杂物，柔和的阳光，无光泽的数字渲染感，无生硬的轮廓线，无写实感。保持诗意且安静鼓舞人心的基调。使用 {argument name="main character" default="anthropomorphic toucan dermatologist"} 作为中心人物，{argument name="setting mood" default="warm reflective Japanese diary manga"} 作为设定氛围，{argument name="color palette" default="muted watercolor beige, teal, dusty pink, soft green, warm ochre"} 作为调色板，以及 {argument name="theme" default="skincare wisdom, daily observations, kindness, and thoughtful creation"} 作为主题。

templates.title: Bold Egg Tart Opening Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Bold Egg Tart 开业海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bold minimalist food advertisement poster for a bakery opening, centered on one photorealistic Portuguese-style egg tart.

Canvas: Vertical poster in 3:4 aspect ratio, soft pale pink background with subtle smooth gradient, no borders or watermark.

Layout: At the very top, place an enormous uppercase red headline reading {argument name="top headline" default="WE'RE"}, using a heavy geometric sans-serif font, spanning nearly the full width. Directly underneath, centered, add one rounded pill outline in red containing the uppercase text {argument name="product label" default="DELICIOUS EGG TARTS"}. In the middle of the poster, place exactly 1 large egg tart floating on the pink background, photographed realistically with no plate or hands. Below the tart, centered, add one smaller rounded red outline pill containing the uppercase text {argument name="happy hour text" default="HAPPY HOUR: 6AM"}. At the bottom, place an enormous uppercase red word reading {argument name="bottom headline" default="OPEN"}, using the same heavy sans-serif font, spanning almost the full width.

Subject details: The egg tart should be golden brown with a flaky layered puff-pastry crust, glossy yellow custard filling, dark caramelized blister spots, and a light dusting of powdered sugar across the top. Make it appetizing, sharply detailed, and studio-lit, with a subtle natural shadow only if needed.

Visual style: Modern pop-art bakery poster, high contrast red typography on pastel pink, clean negative space, centered alignment, crisp commercial food photography, bright but soft lighting.

Text constraints: Use exactly 4 visible text elements: 1 top headline, 1 product-label pill, 1 happy-hour pill, and 1 bottom headline. Keep all typography bright red, uppercase, bold, and clean. Do not add any extra logos, icons, prices, addresses, small print, or decorative objects.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为烘焙店开业创作一张极简风格的醒目美食宣传海报，以一个写实的葡式蛋挞为中心。

画布：3:4 比例的竖版海报，采用柔和的淡粉色背景，带有细腻平滑的渐变效果，无边框或水印。

布局：在海报最上方，放置一个巨大的红色大写标题 {argument name="top headline" default="WE'RE"}，使用厚重的几何无衬线字体，宽度几乎横跨整个海报。在标题正下方居中位置，添加一个红色的圆角胶囊轮廓，内含大写文本 {argument name="product label" default="DELICIOUS EGG TARTS"}。海报中间放置 1 个巨大的蛋挞，悬浮在粉色背景上，采用写实摄影风格，不带盘子或手部。在蛋挞下方居中位置，添加一个较小的红色圆角胶囊轮廓，内含大写文本 {argument name="happy hour text" default="HAPPY HOUR: 6AM"}。在海报底部，放置一个巨大的红色大写单词 {argument name="bottom headline" default="OPEN"}，使用与上方相同的厚重无衬线字体，宽度几乎横跨整个海报。

主体细节：蛋挞应呈现金棕色，具有酥脆的层叠酥皮、光泽感十足的黄色蛋奶馅、深色的焦糖斑点，顶部轻撒一层糖粉。画面需诱人、细节清晰、采用摄影棚灯光，仅在必要时添加淡淡的自然阴影。

视觉风格：现代波普艺术烘焙海报，淡粉色背景上的高对比度红色字体，干净的留白，居中对齐，清晰的商业美食摄影，明亮而柔和的灯光。

文本限制：仅使用 4 个可见文本元素：1 个顶部标题、1 个产品标签胶囊、1 个 Happy Hour 胶囊和 1 个底部标题。所有字体需保持亮红色、大写、粗体且简洁。请勿添加任何额外的标志、图标、价格、地址、小字说明或装饰性物体。

templates.title: Censored Titanic Sunset Romance

titleLocalized.zh: 泰坦尼克号式日落浪漫（遮挡版）

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic romantic movie still of {argument name="couple description" default="a young man and woman in early 1900s formal clothing"} standing at the bow of a large ocean liner, posed like the iconic arms-outstretched scene from Titanic. The woman is in front with both arms extended horizontally into the wind, wearing a deep navy velvet coat or dress over an ornate cream lace bodice, a small cross necklace, earrings, and tousled curly brown hair blown back by the sea breeze. The man stands closely behind her in a dark formal coat, one arm around her waist and the other partly hidden, wearing a light shirt and vest, with slicked dark hair. Both faces are deliberately covered by solid rectangular censor blocks in warm brown tones, one larger square over the man’s face and one vertical rectangle over the woman’s face. The background shows the open ocean at dusk with a vivid orange and pink sunset sky, soft clouds, and warm golden rim lighting. Large black ship rigging chains and metal hardware frame the left and right edges, with the deck railing barely visible at the bottom. Use a vertical portrait composition, close medium shot, dramatic backlighting, realistic film photography, rich contrast, shallow depth of field, 35mm cinematic color grading, nostalgic epic romance atmosphere, no visible text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的浪漫剧照，画面中 {argument name="couple description" default="一对身着 1900 年代初期正式服装的年轻男女"} 站在大型远洋客轮的船头，重现泰坦尼克号中标志性的双臂伸展姿势。女子在前，双臂向两侧水平伸展，迎着海风，身穿深海军蓝丝绒外套或礼服，内搭精致的奶油色蕾丝紧身胸衣，佩戴小十字项链和耳环，凌乱的棕色卷发被海风吹向脑后。男子紧贴其后，身穿深色正装外套，一只手搂住她的腰，另一只手部分遮挡，身着浅色衬衫和马甲，留着整齐的深色背头。两人的面部均被暖棕色的实心矩形遮挡块刻意覆盖，男子脸部为较大的正方形，女子脸部为垂直长方形。背景是黄昏时分的大海，天空呈现出鲜艳的橙粉色日落，云层柔和，带有温暖的金色轮廓光。巨大的黑色船用索具链条和金属构件勾勒出左右边缘，底部隐约可见甲板栏杆。采用竖向人像构图，中近景拍摄，戏剧性的逆光效果，写实电影摄影风格，对比度丰富，浅景深，35mm 电影级调色，怀旧史诗浪漫氛围，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Glass Rain Market

titleLocalized.zh: 玻璃雨夜市

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic cyberpunk night street scene titled by mood rather than text: an original {argument name="character type" default="young market visitor"} stands in the left foreground with their back and partial profile to the camera, holding a large transparent dome umbrella beaded with rain. The character has {argument name="hair color" default="short wet black hair"} and wears a glossy dark hooded raincoat with subtle patterned trim and a crossbody bag, their face mostly in shadow and not resembling any real person. They look toward a glowing rain market on the right: exactly 1 long plastic-tarp produce stall runs diagonally from mid-right to the upper-right corner, with crates of red tomatoes and mixed vegetables, white storage boxes, clear hanging plastic sheets, metal poles, and exactly 7 visible warm amber hanging bulbs under the canopy. The setting is a dense urban market street in heavy rain, with wet pavement reflecting teal and amber neon, blurred pedestrians with umbrellas in the background, vertical out-of-focus East Asian-style shop signs, and deep atmospheric haze. Use a {argument name="color palette" default="teal and amber neon"} palette, strong filmic contrast, realistic rain streaks, water droplets on the umbrella and tarp, shallow depth of field, bokeh lights, 35mm street-photography composition, no logos, no readable brand names, no celebrity likeness, no extra foreground objects. The overall mood should feel like {argument name="mood" default="quiet solitude in a glass rain market"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影感赛博朋克夜间街道场景，以氛围而非文字为主题：一个原创 {argument name="character type" default="年轻的市场访客"} 站在左侧前景，背对镜头并露出部分侧脸，手持一把挂满雨珠的大型透明圆顶雨伞。该角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="湿润的黑色短发"}，身穿带有精致图案饰边的亮面深色连帽雨衣，并背着斜挎包，面部大部分处于阴影中，且不与任何真实人物相似。他们望向右侧灯火通明的雨中市场：一条长长的塑料布农产品摊位从右中方斜向延伸至右上角，摊位上有装满红番茄和混合蔬菜的板条箱、白色储物箱、悬挂的透明塑料布、金属杆，以及遮阳棚下清晰可见的 7 盏暖琥珀色吊灯。场景设定在暴雨中密集的城市市场街道，湿润的地面反射着青色和琥珀色的霓虹灯光，背景中有模糊的撑伞行人，垂直的失焦东亚风格商店招牌，以及浓厚的氛围感雾气。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="青色与琥珀色霓虹"} 色调，强烈的电影感对比度，逼真的雨痕，雨伞和防水布上的水滴，浅景深，光斑效果，35mm 街头摄影构图，无 Logo，无清晰可见的品牌名称，无名人肖像，无额外的前景物体。整体氛围应呈现出 {argument name="mood" default="玻璃雨夜市中的静谧孤独感"}。

templates.title: Surreal Melting Clocks Desert

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实主义熔化时钟沙漠

templates.prompt: Create a dreamlike surrealist oil painting in the style of Salvador Dali's "The Persistence of Memory": a barren coastal desert at dusk with a low horizon, calm blue sea on the left, pale yellow sky fading to blue, and ochre cliffs glowing in the far right distance. In the foreground, place a sharp-edged brown wooden platform extending from the lower left, with one leafless dead tree rising from it. Include exactly 4 visible timepieces: 1 soft blue-gray melting clock draped over the tree branch, 1 pale melting clock sliding over the front edge of the platform with black numbers, 1 white limp melting clock folded over a strange sleeping biomorphic face-like form in the lower right, and 1 orange closed pocket watch on the platform covered with many tiny black ants. Use elongated shadows, smooth realistic brushwork, eerie stillness, distorted forms, high contrast between warm earth tones and cool blue highlights, and a vintage museum-painting texture. Keep the composition sparse and uncanny, with no people, no modern objects, and no readable text beyond clock numerals. Optional customizable details: {argument name="surrealist style" default="Salvador Dali's The Persistence of Memory"}, {argument name="sky color" default="pale yellow fading to blue"}, {argument name="landscape setting" default="barren coastal desert at dusk"}, {argument name="number of timepieces" default="4"}, {argument name="foreground platform color" default="warm brown wood"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅梦幻般的超现实主义油画，风格参考萨尔瓦多·达利的《记忆的永恒》：黄昏时分荒凉的海岸沙漠，低矮的地平线，左侧是平静的蓝色大海，淡黄色天空渐变为蓝色，远处的赭色悬崖在光影中闪烁。在前景中，放置一个从左下角延伸出的锋利边缘棕色木制平台，上面长出一棵枯萎的无叶树。包含 4 个清晰可见的时钟：1 个挂在树枝上的柔和蓝灰色熔化时钟，1 个滑过平台前缘并带有黑色数字的苍白熔化时钟，1 个折叠在右下角奇异的睡眠生物形态面孔上的白色柔软熔化时钟，以及 1 个放在平台上并覆盖着许多微小黑蚂蚁的橙色闭合怀表。使用拉长的阴影、平滑写实的笔触、诡异的静谧感、扭曲的形态、温暖的大地色调与冷蓝色高光之间的高对比度，以及复古的博物馆油画质感。保持构图稀疏且诡异，画面中不出现人物、现代物品，除了时钟刻度外不包含任何可读文字。可选自定义细节：{argument name="surrealist style" default="萨尔瓦多·达利的《记忆的永恒》"}, {argument name="sky color" default="淡黄色渐变为蓝色"}, {argument name="landscape setting" default="黄昏时分荒凉的海岸沙漠"}, {argument name="number of timepieces" default="4"}, {argument name="foreground platform color" default="暖棕色木材"}。

templates.title: Vintage Mediterranean Herb Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古地中海草本海报

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist vintage Mediterranean editorial poster in a wide 16:9 landscape format. Use a deep cyan-blue matte background with vast negative space, heavy analog film grain, subtle halftone print texture, and slightly aged offset-print color. Center a single botanical subject: a tied bundle of wild Mediterranean herbs, floating horizontally slightly above center, stems pointing to the right and leafy ends spreading to the left. The bundle should include mixed green herbs such as sage leaves, rosemary sprigs, thyme-like fine stems, and small mint-like leaves, bound near the stem end with tan natural twine; render it as realistic but poster-like, with warm sunlight highlights and a soft shadow below. Beneath the herb bundle, place one large cream-colored elegant serif wordmark reading {argument name="title text" default="Selvatica"}, centered near the lower third. Add exactly 2 small matching cream decorative ornaments, one on each side of the title, each made from a short horizontal line, a dot, and another short line. Keep the composition sparse and refined, with no border, no extra objects, no additional text, and no watermark. Overall mood: rustic, botanical, vintage Mediterranean apothecary editorial poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张 16:9 宽屏比例的极简主义复古地中海编辑风格海报。使用深青蓝色哑光背景，留出大量负空间，加入厚重的模拟胶片颗粒感、微妙的半色调印刷质感以及轻微老化的胶印色彩。画面中心放置单一植物主体：一束捆扎的野生地中海草本植物，水平悬浮在画面中心略上方，茎部指向右侧，叶片末端向左展开。草本束应包含混合绿色植物，如鼠尾草叶、迷迭香小枝、类似百里香的细茎以及类似薄荷的小叶，在茎部末端用棕褐色天然麻绳捆扎；渲染效果需兼具写实感与海报风格，带有温暖的阳光高光和下方的柔和阴影。在草本束下方，放置一个居中的大型奶油色优雅衬线字体标题 {argument name="title text" default="Selvatica"}，位于画面下三分之一处。在标题两侧各添加 2 个匹配的奶油色装饰符号，每个符号由一条短横线、一个圆点和另一条短横线组成。保持构图简洁精致，无边框，无额外物体，无附加文字，无水印。整体氛围：质朴、植物学、复古地中海药剂师编辑风格海报。

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist zen-style Japanese ink wash illustration on a vertical canvas. Use warm aged rice paper as the background with subtle beige watercolor stains and abundant negative space. Place a single rustic ceramic tea cup in the lower-right area, rounded and slightly imperfect, with speckled beige clay texture, a thin dark rim, a visible amber-brown tea surface, and a soft gray ink shadow beneath it. From the cup, draw one graceful column of steam made of thin, translucent, flowing S-shaped black-gray brush lines rising upward. On the left side, include one slender bamboo branch entering diagonally from the lower-left edge and reaching toward the upper-left and center, with exactly 3 visible stem segments and exactly 12 narrow bamboo leaves in muted black, charcoal, and pale gray ink tones. Add 2 small ink dots near the lower-left of the cup. Keep the composition quiet, asymmetrical, meditative, and elegant, with soft organic brush textures, sumi-e linework, light watercolor washes, no hard outlines except the expressive ink strokes, no text, no border, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅极简禅意风格的日式水墨插画，采用竖构图。背景使用温暖的陈旧宣纸，带有淡淡的米色水彩渍迹，并留出大量负空间。在右下角放置一个质朴的陶瓷茶杯，杯身圆润且略带瑕疵，呈现斑驳的米色陶土质感，杯口有一圈深色细边，杯中可见琥珀棕色的茶汤，杯底投下一抹柔和的灰色水墨阴影。从茶杯中画出一缕优雅的蒸汽，由纤细、半透明、流动的 S 形黑灰色笔触向上升腾。在左侧，加入一根纤细的竹枝，从左下边缘斜向伸入，延伸至左上方和中心，竹枝需包含 3 个清晰的竹节，以及 12 片采用柔和黑、炭黑和浅灰色调的狭长竹叶。在茶杯左下方添加 2 个小墨点。整体构图保持静谧、非对称、冥想感与优雅，笔触具有柔和的有机质感，采用水墨画技法，辅以轻盈的水彩晕染，除富有表现力的水墨线条外无硬轮廓，无文字，无边框，无水印。
