templates.title: Censored Dragon Skull Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 受审查的龙骨战士

templates.prompt: Create a dark cinematic fantasy close-up in a 16:9 widescreen frame: a rugged warrior or shaman stands on the left side of the composition, partially turned in profile, wearing a massive weathered dragon-skull headdress that extends to the right with bony teeth, spikes, horns, cracked scales, and reddish thorn-like protrusions. The character has long dark hair with one visible thick reddish-brown braid, a visible ear, and a rough fur cloak over the shoulder. Place a large opaque dark olive-black rectangular block over the center of the image, covering most of the character’s face and torso area like an intentional censor mask. The background is out of focus, foggy, and teal-green, suggesting a bleak outdoor medieval or tribal battlefield setting with vague silhouettes of posts or structures. Use shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, muted green-brown color grading, gritty texture, realistic creature-bone detail, and an ominous atmospheric tone inspired by {argument name="director mood" default="grim mythic fantasy cinema"}. The headdress should have exactly one prominent dragon skull head visible on the right, one visible braid, one fur shoulder mass, and one central censor rectangle. No text, no watermark, no bright colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 宽屏比例的暗黑电影感奇幻特写：画面左侧站着一名粗犷的战士或萨满，身体呈侧面，戴着巨大的风化龙骨头饰，头饰向右延伸，带有骨齿、尖刺、犄角、裂纹鳞片和红色的荆棘状突起。角色留着深色长发，可见一根粗壮的红棕色辫子，露出一只耳朵，肩上披着粗糙的毛皮斗篷。在图像中心放置一个巨大的不透明深橄榄黑色矩形块，像刻意的审查遮罩一样覆盖住角色大部分的面部和躯干区域。背景虚化，雾气缭绕，呈青绿色，暗示着一个荒凉的户外中世纪或部落战场，隐约可见柱子或建筑的轮廓。使用浅景深、忧郁的低调照明、柔和的绿褐色调、粗砺的质感、逼真的生物骨骼细节，以及受 {argument name="director mood" default="冷峻神话奇幻电影"} 启发的险恶氛围。头饰右侧应清晰可见一个突出的龙骨头，画面中包含一根辫子、一团毛皮肩饰和一个中央审查矩形。无文字，无水印，无鲜艳色彩。

templates.title: Surreal Ocean Wall in Rainy City

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中城市的超现实海洋之墙

templates.prompt: Create a hyperreal cinematic nighttime photograph of {argument name="city setting" default="a modern downtown avenue between two massive glass skyscrapers"} during heavy rain, viewed from street level with a centered one-point perspective down the road. The scene shows exactly two towering dark office buildings forming a canyon on the left and right, with illuminated office windows and wet reflective facades. Between them rises one enormous vertical wall of ocean water, like a suspended aquarium or tidal wave stretching upward into the sky, its foamy rim curling at the top under a bright full moon partially veiled by clouds. Inside the blue-black water are three clearly visible whales: one large central whale swimming diagonally toward the viewer, one smaller whale below it, and one smaller whale higher in the distance; include many tiny fish silhouettes around them. The rain-soaked street below is glossy with mirror reflections of red traffic lights, car taillights, building lights, and moonlit blue water. Add a realistic urban traffic scene with several cars moving away from the viewer, including one prominent dark sedan in the lower center with glowing red taillights, and scattered pedestrians on both sidewalks and crosswalk areas holding umbrellas. Use {argument name="mood" default="awe-inspiring, surreal, dramatic, and ominous"}, deep navy and steel-blue color grading, high contrast, volumetric mist, street steam, rain streaks, sharp architectural detail, realistic reflections, and a 35mm cinematic lens look. No text, no watermark, no illustration style; make it feel like an impossible but photoreal event captured in a high-budget disaster-fantasy film.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实电影级夜景照片，场景设定为 {argument name="city setting" default="两座巨大玻璃摩天大楼之间的现代市中心大道"}，正值大雨倾盆。从街道视角出发，采用居中的单点透视，沿道路纵深延伸。画面两侧是两座高耸的深色办公大楼，形成一道峡谷，办公楼窗户透出灯光，外墙湿润且带有倒影。两楼之间耸立着一道巨大的垂直海水之墙，宛如悬浮的水族箱或潮汐波，向上延伸至天空，顶部泡沫翻滚，在被云层半遮的明亮满月下显得格外壮观。在蓝黑色的水体中，清晰可见三头鲸鱼：一头巨大的鲸鱼位于中央，正斜向游向观众；下方有一头较小的鲸鱼，远处高处还有一头较小的鲸鱼；周围点缀着许多细小的鱼群剪影。下方雨水浸润的街道光亮如镜，倒映着红色的交通灯、汽车尾灯、建筑灯光以及月光下的蓝色海水。添加真实的城市交通场景，几辆汽车正远离观众行驶，其中画面下方中央有一辆显眼的深色轿车，亮着红色尾灯；人行道和斑马线上有零星行人撑伞走过。运用 {argument name="mood" default="令人敬畏、超现实、戏剧性且带有不祥之感"} 的氛围，采用深海军蓝和钢蓝色的色调，高对比度，加入体积雾、街道蒸汽、雨丝、锐利的建筑细节、逼真的倒影，并呈现 35mm 电影镜头的质感。画面中不含文字、水印或插画风格；使其看起来像是高预算灾难奇幻电影中捕捉到的一个不可能发生的写实瞬间。

templates.title: Cinematic Astronauts on Alien Ice World

titleLocalized.zh: 外星冰雪世界中的电影感宇航员

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-cinematic surreal sci-fi landscape in a square composition, showing {argument name="number of astronauts" default="14"} armored astronauts marching in a single diagonal line across a glossy black reflective ice plain toward the viewer, the lead astronaut large in the foreground and the rest receding into misty distance. The astronauts wear bulky white and dark graphite space armor with black visors, orange glowing suit seams, chest lights, and rifles held low, with crisp reflections beneath their boots. The environment is a vast alien frozen battlefield under a deep blue-black starfield: a colossal cracked planet dominates the sky behind them, with glowing orange lava-like fissures, pale blue rim light, and sweeping planetary rings cutting across the frame. Add jagged black floating rock formations hanging from the top edge like inverted mountains, plus several vertical monolithic towers rising from the horizon. Include exactly 3 major vertical light-beam or impact columns: one fiery explosion plume on the left horizon, one tall white beam near the right side, and one smaller bright impact flare near the far-right horizon. Add a luminous spiral galaxy in the upper right, distant nebula clouds, scattered meteor streaks, tiny far-off human silhouettes on the right horizon, and orange sparks embedded in the reflective ground. Use a grand, high-budget movie concept-art style with extreme scale, atmospheric fog, volumetric lighting, sharp foreground detail, blue-silver color grading with small orange accents, dramatic depth, realistic reflections, and no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅超电影感的超现实科幻景观，采用方形构图，展示 {argument name="number of astronauts" default="14"} 名身穿盔甲的宇航员排成一条对角线，在光亮的黑色反光冰原上向观众走来，领头的宇航员位于前景，体型较大，其余宇航员向雾气弥漫的远方延伸。宇航员穿着厚重的白色和深石墨色太空盔甲，配有黑色面罩、橙色发光接缝、胸灯，手持低垂的步枪，靴子下方有清晰的倒影。环境是一个深蓝黑色星空下广阔的外星冰冻战场：一颗巨大的破碎星球悬浮在他们身后的天空中，带有发光的橙色熔岩状裂缝、淡蓝色边缘光，以及横跨画面的行星环。在顶部边缘添加悬挂的锯齿状黑色浮石，如同倒置的山脉，并从地平线上升起几座垂直的巨石塔。包含 3 根主要的垂直光束或撞击柱：左侧地平线上的一团火热爆炸烟柱，右侧附近的一根高大白光束，以及远右侧地平线附近的一个较小的明亮撞击闪光。在右上角添加一个发光的螺旋星系、遥远的星云、散落的流星轨迹、右侧地平线上微小的人类剪影，以及嵌入反光地面中的橙色火花。采用宏大、高预算的电影概念艺术风格，强调极端的比例感、大气雾气、体积光、锐利的前景细节、蓝银色调配色并点缀少量橙色，营造出戏剧性的深度和逼真的反射效果，画面中不包含任何文字或水印。

templates.title: Lakers Arena Candid Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 湖人队主场抓拍肖像

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic vertical smartphone photo of {argument name="character description" default="a young Asian woman"} sitting courtside/in the lower audience section at a packed Los Angeles Lakers NBA game, framed waist-up in a close candid closeup. She is centered in the foreground, seated on a black arena chair, wearing {argument name="team hoodie" default="a black cropped Los Angeles Lakers hoodie with purple-and-gold sleeve stripes and a large number 23 on the front"}, black leather-look pants, and gold accessories including exactly 2 visible jewelry pieces: a thin gold necklace with a round pendant and a dangling gold earring. Her hair is dark, slightly messy, pulled back into a sleek ponytail with loose strands around the ears. Show her posture as calm and focused, hands resting low near her lap, watching the game action off-camera. Include exactly 3 prominent foreground spectators: the main woman in the center, a young man on the left in a purple Lakers hoodie looking left, and a young man on the right in a black Lakers zip hoodie holding a phone; obscure exactly 2 faces with flat rectangular skin-tone privacy blocks, one over the main woman's face and one over the right spectator's face. The background is a densely crowded basketball arena with hundreds of fans, upper seating tiers, bright stadium lights, LED ribbon boards, and readable arena signage such as {argument name="arena signage" default="LOS ANGELES LAKERS"} and a Toyota logo near the scoreboard. Use realistic indoor arena lighting, natural phone-camera perspective, high detail fabric texture, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, slight wide-angle distortion, authentic candid sports-event atmosphere, no glamour studio lighting, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张超逼真的竖版手机摄影照片，主角是 {argument name="character description" default="一名年轻亚裔女性"}，她正坐在拥挤的洛杉矶湖人队 NBA 比赛场边/低层观众席，采用腰部以上的近距离抓拍构图。她位于前景中心，坐在黑色的场馆座椅上，身穿 {argument name="team hoodie" default="一件黑色短款洛杉矶湖人队连帽衫，袖口带有紫金条纹，正面印有醒目的 23 号字样"}，搭配黑色皮质感长裤，佩戴金色配饰，包括 2 件清晰可见的珠宝：一条带有圆形吊坠的细金项链和一只垂坠感金耳环。她留着深色头发，略显凌乱，扎成利落的马尾辫，耳边有几缕碎发。展现她冷静专注的姿态，双手低垂放在膝盖附近，注视着镜头外正在进行的比赛。前景包含 3 名显眼的观众：中间的主角女性，左侧一名身穿紫色湖人队连帽衫并向左看的年轻男子，以及右侧一名身穿黑色湖人队拉链连帽衫并拿着手机的年轻男子；用扁平的肤色矩形隐私遮挡块遮住 2 张面孔，分别位于主角女性和右侧观众的脸上。背景是拥挤的篮球场馆，有数百名观众、上层看台、明亮的体育馆灯光、LED 环形屏，以及清晰可见的场馆标识，如 {argument name="arena signage" default="LOS ANGELES LAKERS"} 和记分牌附近的 Toyota 标志。使用逼真的室内场馆灯光、自然的手机拍摄视角、高细节的织物纹理、浅至中等的景深、轻微的广角畸变，营造真实的体育赛事抓拍氛围，无影棚灯光，无水印。

templates.title: Miniature Workers Sculpt Giant McDonald's Drumstick

titleLocalized.zh: 微型工人雕琢巨型 McDonald's 鸡腿

templates.prompt: Create a vertical hyper-realistic macro diorama photograph of miniature construction workers sculpting a gigantic {argument name="food item" default="crispy McDonald's fried chicken drumstick"} as if it were a construction site. templates.title: Neon Street Pop Fashion Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹街头流行时尚拼贴画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical street-pop fashion collage poster featuring {argument name="character name" default="a young woman"} in five separate cutout portrait poses, styled as an urban neon girl-power magazine edit.

Canvas: Tall vertical 9:16 poster, high-resolution, with a black and hot-pink neon border rounded at the corners. Use a dense graffiti alley background with brick walls, spray paint, torn-paper textures, white scribble outlines, pink light streaks, and sticker-like graphic elements.

Subject details: The same young woman appears in all five images, with light-to-medium skin, long dark brown hair in two braids, hoop earrings, a white knit beanie with a black graffiti tag logo, silver over-ear headphones, and edgy streetwear. Outfit: black cropped tank top with a distressed pink graffiti graphic, loose dark gray cargo pants, black grommet belt with a metal buckle, silver chain accessories, and black-and-white sneakers. Overall mood is confident, youthful, urban, and pop-punk.

Layout: Use exactly 5 discrete appearances of the woman:
1. Large close-up portrait on the upper left, cropped at the chest, wearing the white beanie and silver headphones around her neck.
2. Full-body standing pose on the upper right, leaning casually with hands in pockets, headphones around her neck, cargo pants fully visible.
3. Central mid-shot cutout, holding white sunglasses near her face, outlined with an irregular white torn-paper border.
4. Lower-left seated or crouched pose, one hand touching the beanie, headphones around her neck.
5. Lower-right waist-up pose, both hands lifting or adjusting the headphones near her ears.

Graphic text content: Include exactly 4 main neon typography phrases in hand-lettered graffiti style: “NEON VIBE” large on the left in pink, white, and purple; “STREET POP” near the upper center-right in glowing pink; “URBAN MOOD” on the right-middle in glowing pink; and “GIRL POWER” near the bottom center in pink and white with paint splatter and a small crown doodle.

Visual style: Bright cyberpunk pink neon lighting, glossy magazine collage, high-contrast black shadows, magenta highlights, white sketch arrows, star doodles, smiley doodles, hearts, paint splatters, torn photo edges, and layered sticker aesthetics. The final image should feel like a Y2K streetwear poster, energetic and polished, with all five cutouts clearly separated but visually connected by neon scribbles.

Constraints: Keep the same identity and outfit consistent across all five appearances. Do not add extra people. Do not add additional large text beyond the four listed phrases. Make the face natural and realistic, not anime or cartoon. Avoid watermarks, logos from real brands, or readable text other than the intended graffiti-style phrases.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张垂直的街头流行时尚拼贴海报，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻女性"} 的五种独立剪影肖像造型，风格为都市霓虹少女力量杂志编辑风格。

画布：高分辨率 9:16 垂直海报，带有圆角黑色及亮粉色霓虹边框。使用密集的涂鸦巷道作为背景，包含砖墙、喷漆、撕纸纹理、白色涂鸦轮廓、粉色光束以及贴纸般的图形元素。

主体细节：同一位年轻女性出现在所有五张图像中，肤色为浅至中等，留着深棕色长发并编成两条辫子，佩戴圆环耳环、带有黑色涂鸦标签标志的白色针织冷帽、银色头戴式耳机，身着前卫的街头服饰。服装：带有磨损感粉色涂鸦图案的黑色短款背心、宽松深灰色工装裤、带有金属扣的黑色孔眼腰带、银色链条配饰以及黑白运动鞋。整体氛围自信、年轻、都市且具有流行朋克感。

布局：使用该女性的 5 个独立造型：
1. 左上角的大幅特写肖像，胸部以上剪裁，佩戴白色冷帽，银色耳机挂在脖子上。
2. 右上角的全身站立姿势，双手插兜，姿态随意，耳机挂在脖子上，完整展示工装裤。
3. 中央半身剪影，手持白色太阳镜靠近脸部，边缘带有不规则的白色撕纸边框。
4. 左下角的坐姿或蹲姿，一只手触碰冷帽，耳机挂在脖子上。
5. 右下角的腰部以上姿势，双手正在调整靠近耳朵的耳机。

图形文字内容：包含 4 个手写涂鸦风格的霓虹排版短语：“NEON VIBE”位于左侧，字体较大，采用粉色、白色和紫色；“STREET POP”位于中上方偏右，呈现发光粉色；“URBAN MOOD”位于右侧中部，呈现发光粉色；“GIRL POWER”位于底部中央，采用粉色和白色，带有油漆飞溅效果和一个小皇冠涂鸦。

视觉风格：明亮的赛博朋克粉色霓虹灯光、光面杂志拼贴、高对比度黑色阴影、洋红色高光、白色草图箭头、星星涂鸦、笑脸涂鸦、爱心、油漆飞溅、撕裂的照片边缘以及分层贴纸美学。最终图像应具有 Y2K 街头服饰海报的质感，充满活力且精致，所有五个剪影清晰分离，并通过霓虹涂鸦在视觉上相互连接。

约束条件：在所有五个造型中保持相同的人物身份和服装一致性。不要添加额外人物。除上述四个短语外，不要添加其他大型文字。面部需自然逼真，不得采用动漫或卡通风格。避免出现水印、真实品牌标志或除指定涂鸦风格短语之外的可读文本。

templates.title: Zippered Coca-Cola World Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实 Coca-Cola 拉链广告

templates.prompt: Create a premium conceptual beverage advertisement for {argument name="brand name" default="Coca-Cola"} on a vertical 4:5 canvas, with a deep red studio background and a cold red soda can centered in the frame. The can is covered in realistic condensation droplets, lit like a high-end FMCG product shot, with crisp metallic highlights on the rim, pull tab, and bottom edge. Place the white scripted {argument name="can logo text" default="Coca-Cola"} logo across the can, with small white text reading “ORIGINAL TASTE” below it. Add a surreal zipper opening across the middle of the composition: a shiny silver zipper runs horizontally from the left edge, crosses the front of the can, then curves upward and outward to the right, with the zipper pull positioned near the center-front of the can. The zipper divides two worlds: on the left, an orange sunset landscape with a glowing sun near the horizon, warm water or flat terrain, and a faint distant city skyline; on the right, an icy blue winter mountain scene with snow-covered pine trees, frosty mountains, mist, and cold condensation. The right zipper flap should look like a curved blue panel peeled open from the red surface, with droplets and zipper teeth along the edge. Use cinematic advertising lighting, ultra-realistic product photography, glossy condensation, shallow studio depth, and a clean Apple-level minimalist composition. Include exactly three visible text groups: top centered slogan “open happiness” with “happiness” in bold, main can logo and “ORIGINAL TASTE,” and bottom centered copy “real magic is inside” with “inside” in bold plus a tiny brand script beneath. No extra text, no people, no clutter, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="Coca-Cola"} 创作一张高端概念饮料广告海报，采用屡获殊荣的全球快速消费品（FMCG）营销风格，具备 Apple 级别的极简艺术指导、奢华的静物产品摄影以及超现实的视觉叙事。

画布：竖版 4:5 海报，浓郁的红色摄影棚背景，居中的产品构图，清晰的高分辨率商业摄影，呈现戏剧性的冷凝水珠细节和精致的布光。

布局：在前景中心放置 1 罐红色铝制汽水罐，主体突出且极具质感，罐身布满冷凝水珠。罐身应展示白色的手写体标志 {argument name="can logo text" default="Coca-Cola"}，以及较小的“ORIGINAL TASTE”字样。在罐身上方顶部居中位置添加标题“open happiness”，其中“open”为纤细的白色小写字体，“happiness”为加粗的白色小写字体。在底部中心添加两行白色小字：“real magic” 和 “is inside”，其中“inside”加粗，并在下方添加一个微小的白色品牌手写体标志。

超现实概念：一条金属拉链横向穿过海报，并穿过罐身中心，仿佛拉开了现实世界与罐内空间。在罐身前方中心略下方位置放置 1 个拉链头。拉链齿应呈现锐利、逼真且具反射感的金属质感，在画面中形成 S 型开口。

可见世界：通过拉链展示 2 个对比鲜明的景观场景。在拉链开口左侧，展示温暖的橙色日落场景，地平线上悬挂着发光的太阳，水面平静，远处可见城市天际线剪影。在拉链开口右侧，展示寒冷的蓝色冬季山景，覆盖积雪的松树、冰冷的雾气以及远处的阿尔卑斯山峰。温暖的左侧场景与寒冷的右侧场景在产品周围交汇，暗示这款饮品蕴含着神奇的情感世界。

视觉风格：超写实广告摄影，光亮的红色罐身，微距冷凝水珠，逼真的铝制罐沿和拉环，高端摄影棚布光，强烈的红色品牌色调，橙色暖意与冰蓝色冷感之间的电影级对比，浅景深，干净的留白，无杂乱元素。

约束条件：包含 1 罐汽水、1 条拉链、1 个拉链头、2 个展示的景观场景，以及 4 个主要文本元素：顶部标题、罐身标志、罐身口味文字、底部标语。保持构图对称且奢华，画面中不出现人物、多余产品、水印或无关文字。

templates.title: Malta Guinness Inner Strength Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Malta Guinness 力量主题广告

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a premium conceptual FMCG beverage advertisement for {argument name="product name" default="Malta Guinness"}, communicating inner strength, nourishment, vitality, and energy through a dramatic product reveal.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, centered composition, warm monochrome golden-yellow studio background with a subtle floor shadow and soft gradient lighting. Use high-end commercial product photography realism, Cannes Lions advertising craft, minimal Apple-like art direction, crisp typography, and cinematic contrast.

Main subject: Place exactly 1 cold aluminum beverage can in the center, upright and front-facing. The can is golden on the upper two-thirds and deep dark red on the lower third, covered with realistic condensation droplets. Add metallic rim highlights, realistic can curvature, and a grounded shadow beneath it.

Product branding and label details: On the can, show the Guinness harp icon above the large word “Malta,” with “GUINNESS” underneath. The lower red section contains exactly 3 benefit words separated by dots: “VITALITY · GOODNESS · ENERGY,” plus a small barley-like icon and the line “NON ALCOHOLIC MALT DRINK.” Keep all label text sharp and legible.

Conceptual reveal: Across the middle of the can, create exactly 1 horizontal torn-paper opening ripped through the label, with rough fibrous edges and curled paper flaps extending to the left and right. Inside the torn opening, show exactly 1 silhouetted athlete sprinting forward through glowing amber light, dust, and radiant sunburst beams, suggesting strength coming from within the drink. The interior scene should be cinematic and bright, contrasting with the realistic can exterior.

Text content: Add exactly 2 headline blocks outside the can. At the top, centered above the can, write “nourishment” on the first line and “that strengthens” on the second line, with “strengthens” in bold dark type. At the bottom, centered below the can, write “real strength” on the first line and “starts within” on the second line, with “within” in bold dark type. Use a clean modern sans-serif font, lowercase styling, dark brown/near-black color, generous spacing, and no extra copy.

Visual style: Hyper-real product advertising, warm golden palette, dramatic backlighting, shallow studio depth, immaculate retouching, tactile torn-paper texture, condensation detail, elegant minimalist layout. The mood is empowering, nourishing, premium, and universally understandable.

Constraints: Include exactly 1 can, exactly 1 torn opening, exactly 1 runner silhouette, exactly 2 external headline blocks, and exactly 3 benefit words on the label. Do not add hands, people outside the torn opening, extra products, splashes, fruit, ice cubes, logos beyond the can branding, watermarks, or additional text.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="product name" default="Malta Guinness"} 创作一则高端概念快消品饮料广告，采用奢华摄影棚产品照风格，背景为单色金橙色。画面中心垂直放置一罐冰镇铝罐，占据 4:5 竖构图的大部分空间，罐身覆盖着逼真的冷凝水珠和光泽高光。罐身设计上半部分为金色，下半部分为深暗红色，大号字标“Malta”上方有一个黑色竖琴徽章，“GUINNESS”位于字标下方。在罐身中部，将印刷标签处理成物理撕裂状，如同卷曲的纸张，边缘呈现粗糙的纤维撕裂感，并向左延伸出两个卷曲的纸瓣；在水平撕裂处，展现一个戏剧性的发光场景：仅有 1 位运动员剪影在晨曦中穿过尘土疾驰，象征内在力量。在标志后方的罐体表面添加微妙的太阳光芒。在下部标签上包含 3 个简短的益处词：“VITALITY · GOODNESS · ENERGY”，以及小字“NON ALCOHOLIC MALT DRINK”。在罐身上方放置极简的活动文案“nourishment that strengthens”，其中“strengthens”加粗、颜色更深且字重更重。在罐身下方放置文案“real strength starts within”，其中“within”加粗。采用戛纳国际创意节获奖级别的广告艺术指导：干净的留白、聚焦的产品主体、温暖的电影级布光、高端修图、逼真的纸张撕裂质感，撕裂场景外无人物，无多余罐体，无杂乱元素，无水印。

templates.title: Sprite Heat Pause Beverage Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Sprite “PAUSE THE HEAT” 广告

templates.prompt: Create a high-end conceptual beverage advertisement for {argument name="brand name" default="Sprite"} with a single cold green soda can as the hero product, centered slightly below mid-frame on a vertical 3:4 canvas. The can is glossy emerald green aluminum with realistic condensation droplets, a silver rim and base, and the white {argument name="brand logo text" default="Sprite"} logo large across the front with a small yellow-green lemon-lime icon above it. The scene contrasts heat versus refreshment: the left half of the ground is dry, cracked desert earth in warm ochre and burnt orange tones with golden dust particles rising, while the right half is wet, icy, and teal-blue with splashing water mist, crushed ice pieces, and a cool vapor cloud exploding behind the can. Use a rich green gradient background, darker at the edges and brighter behind the product, with cinematic studio lighting, crisp commercial photography realism, high contrast, and shallow depth of field. Add exactly one text block in the upper left corner reading {argument name="headline text" default="PAUSE\nTHE\nHEAT."}; set it in bold uppercase sans-serif, left aligned, with “PAUSE” and “THE” in white and “HEAT.” in yellow-green. Keep the composition minimalist and premium, Apple-level advertising art direction, no extra objects, no people, no watermark, no additional text, ultra-detailed droplets and ice, sharp product focus, dramatic refreshing energy.

promptLocalized.zh:
为 {argument name="brand name" default="Sprite"} 创建一个高端概念饮料广告，拍摄风格对标戛纳国际创意节获奖的快速消费品（FMCG）广告，并采用 Apple 级别的极简艺术指导。使用 3:4 竖屏画布。画面中心放置一罐垂直站立的冰镇绿色汽水罐，置于两个对立环境的交界处：左半部分是焦灼的酷热环境，地面干裂，伴有橙黄色尘土和温暖的金色微粒；右半部分是清凉的冰爽环境，地面湿润且呈现光泽的绿色，散落着冰块、水雾、喷溅的水花，罐身背后有冷色调的白蓝色蒸汽爆发。罐身布满浓密的冷凝水珠和细微高光，带有银色罐口和底座，白色斜体品牌 Logo，顶部附近有黄绿色柠檬青柠叶图标。在前景湿润的地面上添加罐身的柔和倒影。背景为深祖母绿渐变色，边缘较暗，整体简洁明快。在左上角放置一个标题块，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="PAUSE
THE
HEAT."}；标题分为三行堆叠，采用粗体大写无衬线字体，“PAUSE”和“THE”为白色，“HEAT.”为黄绿色。灯光采用戏剧性的摄影棚产品布光：左前方有清晰的高光，右侧有冷色调轮廓光，左侧有暖色调光晕，高对比度，逼真的水珠，电影质感的尘埃和水雾微粒，罐身细节锐利，浅景深氛围，画面中无人，无其他额外产品，无水印。

templates.title: Recharge Naturally Juice Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Recharge Naturally 饮料广告

templates.prompt: Create a premium conceptual FMCG beverage advertisement on a vertical 4:5 canvas. Use a deep cobalt-blue studio background and matching glossy blue tabletop, lit like a high-end Apple-style product campaign with clean negative space. On the left, show an exhausted young Black man in a plain white long-sleeve shirt, seated at the table with his head down resting on folded arms, body leaning horizontally toward the product. On the right, place one upright 1-liter carton of {argument name="product name" default="Chivita active"} juice, sharply lit and facing forward, with white packaging, blue vertical “active” branding, small red brand text, orange splash graphics, citrus and grapefruit fruit imagery near the bottom, a white screw cap, and a small “fortified with vitamin C” note. Add a glowing orange-yellow neon charging cable visual: the line emerges from the carton cap, arcs upward and left, then plugs into a large glowing battery icon over the man’s back/shoulder area. The battery icon must show exactly 6 visible internal charge segments, all filled with warm orange glow, plus a rounded terminal on the right; make the glow cast subtle light on the white shirt. In the upper left, add the headline text exactly “{argument name="headline text" default="recharge naturally."}” with “recharge” in thin lowercase white type, “naturally” in bold lowercase white type, and the final period in orange. At the bottom center, add the small brand line “{argument name="tagline text" default="active starts here."}” with “active” in bold white, “starts here.” in thin white, and a small turquoise leaf/accent above the word. Keep the composition minimalist, realistic, cinematic, and highly polished, with no extra objects, no clutter, no watermark, and no additional text beyond the headline, packaging, and bottom tagline.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的 FMCG 饮料概念广告，采用 4:5 竖版画布。使用深钴蓝色摄影棚背景和带有细微反射的同色系光面桌面，呈现 Apple 级别的极简艺术指导、清晰的商业摄影风格、高对比度以及简洁的留白。画面左中位置，展示一名疲惫的年轻黑人男性，身穿纯白色长袖衬衫，坐在桌前，头埋在交叉的双臂中，身体前倾，仿佛精疲力竭。右前方放置一盒 1 升装的 {argument name="beverage brand" default="Chivita Active"} 橙柑橘果汁，包装为白色盒身，底部带有橙子飞溅、柑橘和葡萄柚图案，顶部配有白色旋盖，并印有垂直的蓝色 “active” 品牌标识。在男性的背部和前臂区域添加一个发光的霓虹橙色电池图标，图标轮廓内有 5 个清晰可见的电池格，呈现出部分充电且发光的状态。从电池引出一条明亮的橙色发光电缆弧线，向上弯曲并视觉上插入果汁盒盖，暗示饮料正在为他“充电”。在左上方添加标题文字 “{argument name="headline text" default="recharge naturally."}”，其中 “recharge” 使用纤细的白色小写字体，“naturally” 使用加粗的白色小写字体，末尾的句号为橙色。在底部中心添加一行小的标语/ Logo，内容为 “{argument name="bottom tagline" default="active starts here."}”，其中 “active” 采用加粗的白/蓝色品牌风格，“starts here.” 使用纤细的白色字体。灯光应为高端摄影棚灯光，带有柔和的阴影，产品细节真实，焦点清晰地对准果汁盒和发光图形，画面中无多余物体，除该休息的男性外无其他人，无杂乱元素，无水印。

templates.title: Carpe Diem Fashion Typography Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Carpe Diem 时尚排版海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bold editorial fashion poster / magazine cover for a motivational design project, featuring a full-body studio portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Akinbinu Akintayo"} standing confidently in front of oversized typography.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, bright cyan-blue seamless studio background with a darker blue floor plane and soft vignette/shadowing near the bottom. High-contrast modern layout, cropped poster typography extending off the edges.

Main subject: One tall Black male model, full body, centered slightly right, standing upright with both hands in trouser pockets. He wears a dark olive-green button-up shirt tucked into matching tailored trousers with a black belt and polished black dress shoes. Short curly black hair. Face is intentionally obscured by a vertical soft-blurred rectangular block over the center of the face, while ears, hairline, neck, and outfit remain visible. Studio lighting from upper left, realistic shadows on the floor.

Typography style: Use huge uppercase condensed sans-serif lettering in fluorescent yellow-lime, bold and clean, layered behind and around the figure. Some words are partially hidden by the model or cropped by poster edges. Keep the typography flat, sharp, and poster-like.

Text content: Include exactly 9 visible text blocks: 1) top left small text: "A DESIGN BY AKINBINU AKINTAYO"; 2) top right huge title: "CARPE DIEM"; 3) left middle huge cropped text: "BEC-"; 4) center-right huge cropped text partly behind model: "MING"; 5) left lower-middle small text: "PROJECT BECOMING"; 6) right lower-middle small text: "AKINBINU AKINTAYO"; 7) lower left small text: "EP 27"; 8) center lower huge text: "OMING"; 9) bottom right huge title: "CARPE DIEM". Add two extra small motto lines at the very bottom left as part of the final block area: "MEMENTO MORI" and "MEMENTO VIVERE". Add a small lower-right phrase: "THE TIME IS COMING". The overall poster concept implies the phrase "BECOMING" split across the composition.

Layout: Place the model in the foreground so the typography is partially occluded by his body. The top-right "CARPE DIEM" should dominate the upper half, while another cropped "CARPE DIEM" anchors the bottom-right corner. The left-side "BEC-" should be very large and cropped off the left edge. The word fragments "MING" and "OMING" should appear in the middle and lower center, creating a layered typographic rhythm.

Color palette: Cyan-blue background, neon yellow-lime text, dark olive outfit, black shoes. Minimal colors, clean commercial poster finish.

Constraints: No logos, no watermark, no extra people, no props, no additional text beyond the specified typography. Preserve the bold fashion-editorial look and the intentionally obscured face.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为励志设计项目创作一张大胆的编辑风格时尚海报/杂志封面，主体为 {argument name="character name" default="Akinbinu Akintayo"} 的全身摄影棚肖像，他自信地站在超大号排版文字前。

画布：垂直 4:5 海报，明亮的青蓝色无缝摄影棚背景，配有深蓝色地面平面，底部有柔和的晕影/阴影。高对比度现代布局，裁剪后的海报排版文字延伸至边缘之外。

主体：一位高大的黑人男性模特，全身，略微偏右居中，直立，双手插在裤兜里。他身穿深橄榄绿色衬衫，塞进配套的定制长裤中，系着黑色腰带，穿着抛光的黑色正装皮鞋。短卷黑发。面部被故意遮挡，脸部中心覆盖着一个垂直的柔焦矩形块，但耳朵、发际线、颈部和服装保持可见。摄影棚灯光来自左上方，地面上有逼真的阴影。

排版风格：使用巨大的荧光黄绿色大写无衬线字体，粗体且简洁，层叠在人物身后和周围。部分文字被模特部分遮挡或被海报边缘裁剪。保持排版平整、锐利，具有海报质感。

文本内容：包含 9 个可见文本块：1) 左上角小字：“A DESIGN BY AKINBINU AKINTAYO”；2) 右上角巨大标题：“CARPE DIEM”；3) 左侧中部巨大裁剪文字：“BEC-”；4) 中右侧巨大裁剪文字，部分位于模特身后：“MING”；5) 左侧中下部小字：“PROJECT BECOMING”；6) 右侧中下部小字：“AKINBINU AKINTAYO”；7) 左下角小字：“EP 27”；8) 中心底部巨大文字：“OMING”；9) 右下角巨大标题：“CARPE DIEM”。在最左下角添加两行额外的小座右铭作为最终区块的一部分：“MEMENTO MORI” 和 “MEMENTO VIVERE”。在右下角添加一个小短语：“THE TIME IS COMING”。整体海报概念暗示了贯穿构图的 “BECOMING” 一词。

布局：将模特置于前景，使排版文字被其身体部分遮挡。右上角的 “CARPE DIEM” 应占据上半部分，而另一个裁剪后的 “CARPE DIEM” 则固定在右下角。左侧的 “BEC-” 应非常大并从左边缘裁剪。文字片段 “MING” 和 “OMING” 应出现在中部和下中心，营造出层次分明的排版节奏。

调色板：青蓝色背景，霓虹黄绿色文字，深橄榄色服装，黑色鞋子。色彩极简，呈现干净的商业海报质感。

约束：无 Logo，无水印，无额外人物，无道具，除指定的排版外无额外文本。保留大胆的时尚编辑外观和故意遮挡的面部效果。

templates.title: Luxury Beijing Apartment Brochure

titleLocalized.zh: 北京高端公寓宣传册

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished luxury real-estate brochure board for {argument name="residence name" default="京軌天璽"}, an upscale apartment development branded as {argument name="English subtitle" default="Beijing South Railway Station Residences"}. The design should look like a premium Beijing apartment sales brochure, with architectural visualization, floor plans, interior renders, and rooftop amenities.

Canvas: Wide horizontal brochure, approximately 16:9 ratio, dark charcoal and navy palette with thin gold divider lines and refined white typography. Use a clean grid layout with three main vertical zones: floor plans on the left, hero architecture in the center, and interior/amenity preview images on the right. Add a slim footer bar across the full width.

Layout: Left column contains exactly 2 stacked black-background architectural floor plan diagrams with white blueprint linework. The top floor plan is labeled “PREMIUM UNIT - 3LDK” and shows labeled rooms including bath room, powder room, balcony, master bedroom, bedroom, bedroom, living dining kitchen, terrace, closet areas, and small fixtures. The lower floor plan is labeled “STANDARD UNIT - 2LDK” and shows labeled rooms including bath room, powder room, shoe closet, master bedroom, bedroom, living dining kitchen, closet/storage, and fixtures. Make the floor plans technical, precise, and dense, with small room labels and dimensions.

Center panel: A large dusk hero render of a futuristic glass mixed-use residential tower complex above Beijing South Railway Station. Show multiple illuminated high-rise blocks with cantilevered volumes, sky terraces, warm interior lights, and podium levels. In the foreground, include exactly 7 visible high-speed train sets or train streaks on parallel rail tracks beneath the complex, conveying a major transport hub. Place the large Chinese title “京軌天璽” near the top in elegant gold serif lettering, with the subtitle “Beijing South Railway Station Residences” below it in smaller gold serif type. Include station signage on the building facade reading “北京南站” and “BEIJING SOUTH RAILWAY STATION”.

Right column: Arrange exactly 6 preview image panels. Top row has 2 panels: “ENTRANCE” showing a warm modern apartment hallway with console table, plants, wood cabinetry, recessed lighting, and a dark entry door; “FAMILY ROOM” showing a luxurious living room with sofa, bookcase, coffee table, city view windows, and the large white logo text “Pollo.ai” overlaid. Middle row has 2 panels: “BEDROOM” showing a modern bedroom with a neatly made bed, bedside lamp, warm wood tones, and a city skyline view; “BATHROOM” showing a sleek stone bathroom with vanity, mirror, glass shower, toilet, warm lighting, and beige-brown tiles. Bottom section has 2 stacked labels/panels: a dark header labeled “ROOFTOP AMENITIES”, and a wide image labeled “ROOFTOP GARDEN” showing a landscaped rooftop terrace with planters, seating, pergola canopy, railings, and a panoramic city and railway-station view at dusk.

Footer: Add a thin full-width black footer bar divided into three text zones by vertical gold lines. Left text: “Beijing South Railway Station”. Center text: {argument name="district text" default="北京市丰台区"}. Right text: {argument name="contact email" default="info@jingguitianxi.com"}.

Visual style: Photorealistic architectural visualization mixed with brochure graphic design, high-end real estate marketing, sharp lines, realistic lighting, glossy glass towers, warm interiors, cinematic dusk atmosphere, subtle gold accents, precise typography, no people. Keep all panel labels in uppercase white sans-serif except the main Chinese title in gold serif. Maintain clean margins, straight grid alignment, and a premium corporate presentation.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="residence name" default="京軌天璽"} 创建一个精致的高端房地产宣传册项目，该项目定位为 {argument name="English subtitle" default="Beijing South Railway Station Residences"}。设计应呈现出北京高端公寓销售手册的质感，包含建筑可视化效果、户型图、室内渲染图及屋顶配套设施。

画布：宽幅横向宣传册，比例约为 16:9，采用深炭灰与海军蓝配色，搭配纤细的金色分割线和精致的白色排版。使用简洁的网格布局，分为三个主要垂直区域：左侧为户型图，中央为建筑主体效果图，右侧为室内及配套设施预览图。底部添加一条贯穿全宽的纤细页脚栏。

布局：左侧栏包含 2 个堆叠的黑色背景建筑户型图，配以白色蓝图线条。上方户型图标注为“PREMIUM UNIT - 3LDK”，显示各房间名称，包括浴室、化妆间、阳台、主卧、卧室、卧室、客餐厅、露台、衣帽间及小型设施。下方户型图标注为“STANDARD UNIT - 2LDK”，显示各房间名称，包括浴室、化妆间、鞋柜、主卧、卧室、客餐厅、衣帽间/储藏室及设施。户型图需具备技术性、精确性和密集感，并标注小型房间名称及尺寸。

中央面板：一张北京南站上方未来感玻璃综合体住宅塔楼的黄昏主视觉渲染图。展示多栋发光的超高层建筑，带有悬挑体量、空中露台、温暖的室内灯光及裙楼。前景中包含 7 列清晰可见的高速列车组或轨道下方的列车光轨，传达出大型交通枢纽的特征。在顶部附近放置醒目的金色衬线字体中文标题“京軌天璽”，下方配以较小的金色衬线字体副标题“Beijing South Railway Station Residences”。建筑立面上包含标有“北京南站”和“BEIJING SOUTH RAILWAY STATION”的车站标识。

右侧栏：排列 6 个预览图像面板。顶行 2 个面板：“ENTRANCE”展示带有玄关桌、绿植、木质橱柜、嵌入式照明及深色入户门的温馨现代公寓走廊；“FAMILY ROOM”展示带有沙发、书柜、咖啡桌、城市景观窗的豪华客厅，并叠加显示白色大号文字 Logo“Pollo.ai”。中行 2 个面板：“BEDROOM”展示带有整洁床铺、床头灯、暖木色调及城市天际线景观的现代卧室；“BATHROOM”展示带有洗漱台、镜子、玻璃淋浴间、马桶、暖光及米棕色瓷砖的时尚石材浴室。底部区域包含 2 个堆叠的标签/面板：一个标有“ROOFTOP AMENITIES”的深色标题栏，以及一张标有“ROOFTOP GARDEN”的宽幅图像，展示带有花坛、座椅、凉棚、栏杆及黄昏时分城市与火车站全景的景观屋顶露台。

页脚：添加一条全宽的黑色纤细页脚栏，通过垂直金线分为三个文本区。左侧文本：“Beijing South Railway Station”。中央文本：{argument name="district text" default="北京市丰台区"}。右侧文本：{argument name="contact email" default="info@jingguitianxi.com"}。

视觉风格：照片级建筑可视化与宣传册平面设计的结合，高端房地产营销风格，线条锐利，光影写实，玻璃塔楼质感通透，室内氛围温暖，电影感黄昏氛围，点缀低调金色，排版精准，画面中不含人物。除主标题使用金色衬线字体外，所有面板标签均使用白色无衬线大写字母。保持整洁的页边距、严谨的网格对齐及高端企业演示风格。

templates.title: Moonlit Anime Chocolate Box

titleLocalized.zh: 月光动漫巧克力礼盒

templates.prompt: Create a premium luxury patisserie product photograph of a limited-edition chocolate box inspired by an original anime-style girl character named {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"}. The box is open on an elegant dark satin tabletop with crystal glassware, soft flowers, scattered sparkles, and a pale satin ribbon, photographed like a real high-end department-store confectionery gift set. The inside lid features a large illustrated package design: a dreamy moonlit night sky with teal-to-navy gradient, crescent moon, hanging gold stars, city skyline silhouettes, ornate gold corner filigree, pale pink and blue flowers, and an anime girl with long dark bluish-black hair with pink highlights, floral hair accessories, and an off-shoulder white ruffled dress; leave the face unobstructed in the generated image unless a privacy-safe blank face placeholder is desired. Add elegant gold Japanese-style branding text on the lid: {argument name="main name text" default="のぞむ"}, small romanized text {argument name="romanized name text" default="NOZOMU"}, script subtitle {argument name="collection title" default="Moonlit Dream"}, and small uppercase text "CHOCOLATE COLLECTION". In the lower tray, show exactly 10 luxury chocolates in a 2-by-5 grid with gold dividers and black paper cups: 1 glossy sky-blue dome with gold leaf, 2 cream rose-shaped chocolate, 3 faceted pale blue crystal chocolate, 4 dark round chocolate with gold crescent moon and starry night surface, 5 white daisy flower chocolate with gold center, 6 pale blue-white speckled dome, 7 pink flower chocolate with gold center, 8 glossy purple-blue heart chocolate with tiny star speckles, 9 faceted pale blush crystal chocolate with gold flecks, and 10 sky-blue marbled dome with gold constellation lines. Include a matching small display card in front of the box with the same branding text and moon motif. Use soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic reflections, delicate gold foil details, pastel celestial palette, ultra-detailed premium packaging, and a romantic fantasy luxury chocolate aesthetic. Avoid extra chocolates, avoid modern logos, avoid cluttered typography, and keep the box and all 10 chocolates sharply visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高级奢华甜点产品摄影图，展示一款以原创动漫风格少女角色 {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} 为灵感的限量版巧克力礼盒。礼盒放置在优雅的深色缎面桌面上，周围摆放着水晶玻璃器皿、柔和的花朵、散落的闪光点和淡色缎带，拍摄效果如同高端百货商店的糖果礼盒。盒盖内侧展示精美的包装设计：梦幻般的月光夜空，采用青色到深蓝色的渐变，点缀着新月、悬挂的金星、城市天际线剪影、华丽的金色边角花纹、淡粉色和蓝色的花朵，以及一位留着深蓝黑色长发（带有粉色挑染）、佩戴花朵发饰、身穿露肩白色荷叶边连衣裙的动漫少女；除非需要隐私保护的空白面部占位符，否则请确保生成的图像中面部清晰可见。在盒盖上添加优雅的日式金色品牌文字：{argument name="main name text" default="のぞむ"}，小型罗马拼音文字 {argument name="romanized name text" default="NOZOMU"}，手写体副标题 {argument name="collection title" default="Moonlit Dream"}，以及小型大写文字 "CHOCOLATE COLLECTION"。在下层托盘中，展示 10 颗奢华巧克力，排列为 2x5 的网格，配有金色隔板和黑色纸托：1 颗带有金箔的光泽天蓝色圆顶巧克力，2 颗奶油玫瑰花形巧克力，3 颗多面淡蓝色水晶巧克力，4 颗带有金色新月和星空表面的深色圆形巧克力，5 颗金色花心的白色雏菊巧克力，6 颗淡蓝白色斑点圆顶巧克力，7 颗金色花心的粉色花朵巧克力，8 颗带有微小星点光泽的紫蓝色心形巧克力，9 颗带有金粉的多面淡腮红水晶巧克力，以及 10 颗带有金色星座线条的天蓝色大理石纹圆顶巧克力。在礼盒前方放置一张配套的小型展示卡，上面印有相同的品牌文字和月亮图案。采用柔和的电影级布光、浅景深、逼真的反射效果、精致的烫金细节、柔和的天体色调、超精细的高级包装，营造出浪漫梦幻的奢华巧克力美学。避免多余的巧克力，避免现代 Logo，避免杂乱的排版，并确保礼盒和所有 10 颗巧克力清晰可见。

templates.title: Cozy Pixel Farm Island Village

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨像素农场海岛村庄

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bright cozy pixel-art farming village map on small islands in a blue ocean, like a top-down/isometric 16-bit life-sim game screenshot.

Canvas: 4:3 landscape image, about 1024×768, crisp pixel art with no UI overlay, no borders, no watermark. Use a vibrant turquoise ocean background with gentle wave highlights, ripples around shores, scattered lily pads, and small rocks.

Layout: Show exactly 6 grassy/sandy islands connected by wooden bridges and docks. The largest central island sits in the middle and contains the main house, paths, a fenced crop field, a well, a signpost, a human character, and a dog. Four smaller grassy islands surround it at upper left, upper right, lower left, and right. One small sandy beach island sits near the bottom center.

Island count and contents:
1. Central island: irregular grassy island with dirt paths forming a crossroad. Place a cozy blue-roof cottage near the top center with a chimney puffing smoke, round attic window, wooden front door, flower boxes, shrubs, and a short fence behind it. Put a small pixel farmer character named {argument name="character name" default="young farmer"} standing slightly below center beside a corgi-like dog. Add a fenced crop plot at the lower center with exactly 4 crop rows: leafy green vegetables, white turnips, orange carrots, and golden wheat. Add a stone well to the left of the crop plot, a wooden signpost with a hanging lantern near the left-center path, bushes with flowers, small stones, and daisies.
2. Upper-left island: red-roof barn with open double doors, hay bales, a fenced pen, and exactly 1 black-and-white cow. Include a large leafy tree, crates, flowers, and a wooden bridge connecting to the central island.
3. Upper-right island: village shop with purple roof, striped purple-and-white awning, front door, window display, flower pots, barrel, and a freestanding signboard. The sign above the awning must read {argument name="shop sign text" default="SHOP"}. Include a fruit tree with red apples and a bridge connecting to the central island.
4. Lower-left island: fishing dock island with a wooden pier, a lamppost, barrels, crates, small tackle box/sign, and exactly 1 small wooden rowboat tied near the dock. Connect this island to the central island with a wooden bridge.
5. Right island: small orange-roof cottage with chimney, round attic window, front door, blue window, flower box, small fence, trees, flowers, and a wooden bridge connecting to the central island.
6. Bottom-center island: tiny sandy beach with a palm tree, red-and-white beach umbrella, blue-striped lounge chair, starfish, shell, and grass around the edges; it is not connected by a bridge.

Discrete element counts to preserve: exactly 6 islands, exactly 4 bridges connecting to the central island, exactly 4 buildings total (barn, blue-roof cottage, purple shop, orange-roof cottage), exactly 1 human character, exactly 2 animals (1 cow and 1 dog), exactly 1 rowboat, exactly 1 crop field with 4 visible crop types, exactly 1 well, exactly 1 signpost lantern, exactly 1 beach umbrella, exactly 1 lounge chair, exactly 1 palm tree.

Visual style: Cute high-detail pixel art, top-down three-quarter perspective, warm sunny daylight, saturated colors, soft shadows, chunky readable shapes, detailed grass texture, tiny flowers, rounded shoreline outlines, and animated-game charm. Use {argument name="water color" default="bright turquoise blue"} for the surrounding ocean, {argument name="main roof color" default="blue"} for the central cottage roof, and {argument name="overall mood" default="cheerful cozy farming adventure"} as the emotional tone.

Constraints: Keep the whole scene visible as a single map-like composition. Do not add interface buttons, text besides the shop sign, extra characters, extra animals, vehicles, modern objects, or photorealism.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个明亮温馨的像素风农场村庄地图，坐落在蓝色海洋的小岛上，呈现出 16-bit 生活模拟类游戏俯视/等距视角的游戏截图效果。

画布：4:3 横向图像，约 1024×768 分辨率，清晰的像素艺术，无 UI 覆盖，无边框，无水印。使用充满活力的绿松石色海洋作为背景，带有柔和的波浪高光、岸边的涟漪、散落的睡莲叶和小型岩石。

布局：展示 6 个由木桥和码头连接的草地/沙滩岛屿。最大的中央岛屿位于正中，包含主屋、小路、带围栏的农田、水井、路标、一个人类角色和一只狗。四个较小的草地岛屿分布在左上、右上、左下和右侧。一个小型沙滩岛屿位于底部中心。

岛屿数量及内容：
1. 中央岛屿：不规则的草地岛，泥土小路形成十字路口。在顶部中心放置一间温馨的蓝色屋顶小屋，烟囱冒着烟，有圆形阁楼窗、木质前门、花箱、灌木丛和屋后的矮栅栏。在中心偏下方放置一个名为 {argument name="character name" default="年轻农夫"} 的像素农夫角色，旁边跟着一只柯基犬。在下方中心添加一个带围栏的农田，正好有 4 行作物：绿叶蔬菜、白萝卜、橙色胡萝卜和金色小麦。在农田左侧添加一口石井，左侧小路旁放置一个挂着灯笼的木制路标，以及带花的灌木丛、小石头和雏菊。
2. 左上岛屿：红色屋顶的谷仓，有双开门、干草堆、带围栏的畜栏和正好 1 头黑白花奶牛。包含一棵大叶树、木箱、花朵，以及一座连接到中央岛屿的木桥。
3. 右上岛屿：村庄商店，紫色屋顶，紫色和白色条纹遮阳篷，前门，橱窗展示，花盆，木桶和独立式招牌。遮阳篷上方的招牌必须写着 {argument name="shop sign text" default="商店"}。包含一棵结有红苹果的果树，以及一座连接到中央岛屿的木桥。
4. 左下岛屿：渔港岛，有木质码头、路灯、木桶、木箱、小型工具箱/标志，以及正好 1 艘系在码头附近的小木划艇。通过一座木桥将此岛与中央岛屿连接。
5. 右侧岛屿：小型橙色屋顶小屋，带烟囱、圆形阁楼窗、前门、蓝色窗户、花箱、矮栅栏、树木、花朵，以及一座连接到中央岛屿的木桥。
6. 底部中心岛屿：微型沙滩，有一棵棕榈树、红白相间的遮阳伞、蓝色条纹躺椅、海星、贝壳和边缘的草地；该岛不通过桥梁连接。

需保留的离散元素数量：正好 6 个岛屿，正好 4 座连接中央岛屿的桥梁，总共正好 4 栋建筑（谷仓、蓝色屋顶小屋、紫色商店、橙色屋顶小屋），正好 1 个角色，正好 2 只动物（1 头奶牛和 1 只狗），正好 1 艘划艇，正好 1 块农田包含 4 种可见作物，正好 1 口水井，正好 1 个带灯笼的路标，正好 1 把遮阳伞，正好 1 把躺椅，正好 1 棵棕榈树。

视觉风格：可爱的精细像素艺术，俯视 45 度视角，温暖的阳光，饱和的色彩，柔和的阴影，块状且易于辨认的形状，细致的草地纹理，小花，圆润的海岸线轮廓，以及动画游戏般的魅力。使用 {argument name="water color" default="明亮的绿松石蓝"} 作为周围海洋的颜色，{argument name="main roof color" default="蓝色"} 作为中央小屋的屋顶颜色，并将 {argument name="overall mood" default="欢快温馨的农场冒险"} 作为整体情感基调。

约束：保持整个场景作为单一的地图式构图可见。不要添加界面按钮、商店招牌以外的文字、额外的角色、额外的动物、车辆、现代物体或写实风格。

templates.title: Met Gala Couture Triptych

titleLocalized.zh: Met Gala 高定三联画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic editorial triptych of Met Gala red-carpet couture photographs featuring the same glamorous woman in three different luxury gowns, arranged as three equal vertical panels separated by thin black borders.

Canvas: Wide horizontal collage, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio, with three side-by-side full-height photo panels. Use hyper-realistic DSLR event photography, candid celebrity gala lighting, shallow depth of field, flash highlights, warm indoor museum tones, and crowded paparazzi backgrounds. Faces of background guests and photographers may be softly blurred, while the main subject remains sharp.

Layout: Exactly 3 discrete panels. Panel 1 on the left shows a front-facing red-carpet pose; Panel 2 in the center shows a rear three-quarter walking pose; Panel 3 on the right shows a formal full-body staircase pose.

Subject details: The same adult woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brunette"} hair and an elegant celebrity presence appears in all three panels. Keep the face softly anonymized or unfocused, but preserve realistic skin, posture, jewelry, and couture styling.

Panel 1 outfit: A dramatic {argument name="red gown color" default="scarlet red"} strapless couture ball gown with a sweetheart neckline, structured corset bodice, refined gold embroidery, glittering crystal accents, sheer red tulle volume, and a romantic flowing skirt. The woman stands on a red-carpet staircase area, one hand lifted near her chin and the other near her waist. Add diamond necklace and bracelet. Background includes paparazzi, guests in black formalwear, camera flashes, and green hedge decor with red flowers.

Panel 2 outfit: A luminous {argument name="silver gown color" default="pearl silver"} off-the-shoulder couture gown photographed from behind and slightly to the side. The dress has crystal embroidery, delicate short draped sleeves, a fitted sparkling bodice, a high leg slit, sheer flowing cape-like train, long translucent fabric pooling across the carpet, and moon/star-like celestial embellishments. The woman holds part of the train while walking. Background includes dense paparazzi, bright flash bursts, white floral hedge decor, and a dark blue gala carpet.

Panel 3 outfit: A black off-the-shoulder mermaid gown with ornate metallic {argument name="embroidery color" default="antique gold"} baroque embroidery, long sleeves, fitted silhouette, dramatic circular chest motifs, and a small sweeping train. The woman stands centered on cream marble stairs with a red-carpet runner, hands posed gracefully in front. Background includes museum architecture, warm wall sconces, velvet ropes, trimmed greenery, and tuxedoed attendants.

Visual style: Photorealistic, high-fashion celebrity event photography, Met Gala atmosphere, luxurious couture textures, realistic fabric weight, sparkling beadwork, accurate red-carpet lighting, cinematic paparazzi flashes, vertical fashion-magazine composition inside each panel.

Constraints: Include exactly 3 panels and exactly 3 couture gowns: 1 scarlet-red gold-embroidered ball gown, 1 pearl-silver celestial train gown, and 1 black-and-gold baroque mermaid gown. Do not add captions, logos, watermarks, or extra text. Keep the collage seamless and realistic, with thin black dividers between panels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张逼真的 Met Gala 红毯高定摄影三联画，展示同一位迷人女性身着三套不同奢华礼服，以三个等宽的垂直面板排列，并由细黑边分隔。

画布：宽幅横向拼贴，比例约为 3:2，包含三个并排的全高照片面板。采用超写实 DSLR 活动摄影风格，捕捉名人晚宴的抓拍灯光、浅景深、闪光灯高光、温暖的室内博物馆色调以及拥挤的狗仔队背景。背景中宾客和摄影师的面部可进行柔焦处理，同时确保主体清晰。

布局：精确的 3 个独立面板。左侧面板 1 展示正面红毯姿势；中间面板 2 展示背部四分之三侧身行走姿势；右侧面板 3 展示正式的全身楼梯姿势。

主体细节：同一位成年女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发，展现优雅的名人气质，出现在所有三个面板中。保持面部柔和模糊或非聚焦状态，但保留真实的皮肤质感、姿态、珠宝和高定造型。

面板 1 服装：一件引人注目的 {argument name="red gown color" default="绯红色"} 无肩带高定舞会礼服，采用心形领口、结构化紧身胸衣、精致的金线刺绣、闪亮的晶体装饰、透明红色薄纱体积感以及浪漫的飘逸裙摆。女性站在红毯楼梯区域，一只手抬至下巴附近，另一只手放在腰部附近。搭配钻石项链和手链。背景包括狗仔队、身着黑色正装的宾客、相机闪光灯以及带有红花的绿色树篱装饰。

面板 2 服装：一件明亮的 {argument name="silver gown color" default="珍珠银"} 一字肩高定礼服，从后方及侧后方拍摄。礼服饰有水晶刺绣、精致的短款垂坠袖、修身闪亮胸衣、高开叉、透明飘逸的斗篷式拖尾、在地毯上铺开的长款半透明面料以及月亮/星星般的星象装饰。女性行走时手提裙摆。背景包括密集的狗仔队、明亮的闪光灯爆点、白色花卉树篱装饰以及深蓝色晚宴地毯。

面板 3 服装：一件黑色一字肩美人鱼礼服，饰有华丽的金属色 {argument name="embroidery color" default="古金色"} 巴洛克刺绣、长袖、修身剪裁、引人注目的圆形胸部图案以及小巧的扫地拖尾。女性站在奶油色大理石楼梯中央，铺有红毯，双手优雅地置于身前。背景包括博物馆建筑、温暖的壁灯、天鹅绒绳索、修剪整齐的绿植以及身着燕尾服的服务人员。

视觉风格：照片级逼真，高级时装名人活动摄影，Met Gala 氛围，奢华高定质感，真实的面料垂坠感，闪亮的珠饰，精准的红毯灯光，电影级狗仔队闪光效果，每个面板内采用垂直时尚杂志构图。

约束条件：包含精确的 3 个面板和 3 套高定礼服：1 套绯红色金绣舞会礼服，1 套珍珠银星象拖尾礼服，以及 1 套黑金巴洛克美人鱼礼服。不要添加任何标题、Logo、水印或额外文字。保持拼贴画无缝且逼真，面板之间使用细黑线分隔。

templates.title: Cozy Farming Village Pixel Asset Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨农场村庄像素素材表

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean reusable 2D pixel-art game asset sheet for a cozy farming village tileset, labeled and organized on a plain white background. Use crisp 32-bit style pixel art, orthographic/front-facing RPG perspective, consistent scale, soft outlines, warm saturated colors, and no shadows outside the sprites. Theme: {argument name="tileset theme" default="cozy farming village"}.

Canvas: Landscape asset sheet, 4:3 ratio, white background, neatly spaced rows and columns. Add small green sprout icons before each section label. Use dark pixel-font labels in English.

Layout and required sections:
- HOUSES: exactly 5 small cottage buildings, each front-facing with different roof colors and details: 1 blue-roof cottage, 1 golden-yellow roof cottage, 1 green roof cottage with planter boxes, 1 orange-red roof cottage with flowers, 1 purple roof cottage with flowers.
- SHOP: exactly 1 shop building with a purple roof, striped purple awning, hanging sign reading “SHOP”, flower pots, and a small sidewalk sign.
- BARN: exactly 1 red barn with orange roof, large double doors, side hardware, and one hay pile.
- FARM PLOTS: exactly 3 fenced rectangular farm plots: 1 planted vegetable plot with greens, wheat, and root crops; 1 tilled plot with small sprouts; 1 empty tilled soil plot.
- SOIL TILES: exactly 8 square terrain tiles in a 2-row grid: 4 plain tiles on the top row, showing dark soil, medium dirt, light sand, and grass; 4 planted or transition tiles on the bottom row, showing seeded soil variations and a dirt-to-grass transition.
- TREES: exactly 4 leafy fruit/deciduous trees: 1 round dark green tree, 1 larger bright green tree, 1 smaller yellow-green tree, and 1 apple tree with red fruit.
- BUSHES: exactly 3 round bushes: 1 plain green bush, 1 flowering bush with pale blossoms, 1 berry bush with red berries.
- SPECIAL TREE: exactly 1 palm tree with a curved brown trunk and green fronds.
- LOGS & STUMPS: exactly 5 items: 1 long log, 1 cut log, 1 hollow log, 1 large stump, 1 small sprouting stump.
- BEACH PROPS: exactly 5 items: 1 red-and-white beach umbrella, 1 blue striped lounge chair, 1 pink starfish, 1 pink shell, 1 beige shell.
- FLOWERS: exactly 6 small flower sprites: white daisies, yellow flowers, pink flowers, orange-red flowers, purple lavender, and a pink tulip.
- VILLAGE PROPS: exactly 18 village objects in two rows: wooden signpost, lantern post, mailbox, chalkboard sign, wooden crate, barrel, burlap sack, flower pot, wooden bench, stone well, bucket, produce cart, clay pot, flower planter box, round flower planter, market stall, blue-checkered table with flowers, and another lantern post.
- FARM PROPS: exactly 9 farm objects: hay bale, blue water trough, hay cart, short wooden fence segment, milk can, pitchfork, shovel, blue watering can, and long wooden planter box.
- SMALL DETAILS: exactly 12 ground-detail sprites: 4 rocks, 1 tiny sprout, 1 tall reed clump, 1 grass tuft, 1 red mushroom cluster, 1 yellow flower patch, 1 white flower patch, 1 lily pad, and 1 lily pad with pink water lily.
- FENCES: exactly 4 fence sprites: rail fence, vertical plank fence, rope-post fence, and short gate/fence section.

Visual style: {argument name="visual style" default="cute high-quality pixel art game tileset"}. Keep every asset isolated, centered in its own space, and ready to cut out for game use. Use consistent outlines, consistent lighting from upper left, and no overlapping sprites. Text labels should use a pixel font with the section names exactly as listed. Avoid extra decorative background elements, watermarks, mockup UI, or perspective distortions.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为温馨农场村庄 tileset 创建一张干净、可复用的 2D 像素风游戏素材表，在纯白背景上进行标注和排版。使用清晰的 32 位风格像素艺术、正交/正面 RPG 视角、统一比例、柔和轮廓、温暖饱和的色彩，且精灵图外无阴影。主题：{argument name="tileset theme" default="cozy farming village"}。

画布：横向素材表，4:3 比例，白色背景，行与列间距整齐。在每个部分标签前添加绿色小嫩芽图标。使用深色像素字体进行英文标注。

布局及所需部分：
- HOUSES（房屋）：5 栋小型村舍，均为正面视角，具有不同的屋顶颜色和细节：1 栋蓝色屋顶村舍、1 栋金黄色屋顶村舍、1 栋带花箱的绿色屋顶村舍、1 栋带花的橙红色屋顶村舍、1 栋带花的紫色屋顶村舍。
- SHOP（商店）：1 栋商店建筑，紫色屋顶，紫色条纹遮阳篷，悬挂写有“SHOP”的招牌，配有花盆和小型人行道立牌。
- BARN（谷仓）：1 栋红色谷仓，橙色屋顶，大型双开门，侧面五金件，以及一堆干草。
- FARM PLOTS（农田）：3 块矩形栅栏农田：1 块种有蔬菜、小麦和根茎作物的种植田；1 块带有小嫩芽的耕作田；1 块空的耕作土壤田。
- SOIL TILES（土壤图块）：8 块方形地形图块，排列为 2 行：顶行 4 块基础图块，展示深色土壤、中色泥土、浅色沙地和草地；底行 4 块种植或过渡图块，展示播种后的土壤变化及泥土到草地的过渡。
- TREES（树木）：4 棵多叶果树/落叶树：1 棵圆形深绿色树、1 棵较大的亮绿色树、1 棵较小的黄绿色树、1 棵结有红色果实的苹果树。
- BUSHES（灌木）：3 丛圆形灌木：1 丛普通绿灌木、1 丛开着淡色花朵的灌木、1 丛结有红色浆果的浆果灌木。
- SPECIAL TREE（特殊树木）：1 棵棕色弯曲树干、绿色叶片的棕榈树。
- LOGS & STUMPS（原木与树桩）：5 个物品：1 根长原木、1 根切断的原木、1 根空心原木、1 个大树桩、1 个长出嫩芽的小树桩。
- BEACH PROPS（海滩道具）：5 个物品：1 把红白相间沙滩伞、1 把蓝色条纹躺椅、1 个粉色海星、1 个粉色贝壳、1 个米色贝壳。
- FLOWERS（花卉）：6 个小型花卉精灵图：白色雏菊、黄色花朵、粉色花朵、橙红色花朵、紫色薰衣草和一朵粉色郁金香。
- VILLAGE PROPS（村庄道具）：18 个村庄物品，分两行排列：木制路标、灯柱、邮箱、黑板招牌、木箱、木桶、麻袋、花盆、木长椅、石井、水桶、农产品推车、陶罐、木制花箱、圆形花盆、市场摊位、带花的蓝格子桌子，以及另一个灯柱。
- FARM PROPS（农场道具）：9 个农场物品：干草捆、蓝色水槽、干草车、短木栅栏段、牛奶罐、干草叉、铲子、蓝色洒水壶和长木花箱。
- SMALL DETAILS（小型细节）：12 个地面细节精灵图：4 块岩石、1 个微小嫩芽、1 丛高芦苇、1 簇草丛、1 丛红蘑菇、1 片黄色花丛、1 片白色花丛、1 片睡莲叶、1 片带粉色睡莲的叶子。
- FENCES（栅栏）：4 个栅栏精灵图：栏杆栅栏、垂直木板栅栏、绳索立柱栅栏、短门/栅栏段。

视觉风格：{argument name="visual style" default="cute high-quality pixel art game tileset"}。保持每个素材独立，居中放置在各自空间内，以便于游戏使用时裁剪。使用一致的轮廓线，统一的左上方光源，且精灵图之间互不重叠。文本标签应使用像素字体，并严格按照列出的部分名称命名。避免添加额外的装饰性背景元素、水印、样机 UI 或透视畸变。

templates.title: Met Gala Couture Triptych

titleLocalized.zh: Met Gala 高定三联画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a three-panel editorial fashion collage of hyper-realistic glamorous female Met Gala portraits inspired by {argument name="theme" default="Heavenly Bodies meets Futuristic Royalty"}, with the same anonymous woman transformed into three ultra-luxury haute couture looks. Faces should be intentionally anonymized with soft rectangular blur masks over each face, while the gowns, jewelry, lighting, and event atmosphere remain sharp and realistic.

Canvas: Wide horizontal triptych, 3:2 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 3 equal vertical panels with thin dark separators. Photorealistic DSLR red-carpet photography, shallow depth of field, warm indoor gala lighting, paparazzi flashes, luxury museum staircase and floral backdrops.

Panel count and contents: Exactly 3 full-body or near-full-body female fashion portraits.
1. Left panel: Front-facing woman on a red carpet wearing a dramatic {argument name="left gown color" default="deep crimson red"} strapless couture ball gown with a plunging sweetheart neckline, gold baroque embroidery, ornate beaded corset bodice, sheer red tulle skirt volume, and a sculptural bustle or train. She has long dark wavy hair, a diamond necklace and bracelet, one hand near her mouth and one hand resting near her waist. Background includes paparazzi, guests in formalwear, hedge greenery, red carpet, and bright camera lights.
2. Center panel: Rear three-quarter pose of the woman as an ethereal moon goddess wearing an icy {argument name="center gown color" default="silver white"} off-shoulder celestial couture gown with crystal beadwork, sheer shimmering cape, long flowing train, high slit, sparkling high heels, and embroidered crescent moon and star details on the translucent fabric. She looks back over her shoulder, holding the train lightly. Background is packed with photographers, white flowers, dark blue carpet with star motifs, and intense flash photography.
3. Right panel: Front-facing woman standing on an elegant staircase wearing a fitted {argument name="right gown color" default="black and antique gold"} off-shoulder mermaid gown with long sleeves, heavy symmetrical gold embroidery, celestial circular motifs on the bodice, structured neckline, narrow silhouette, and a small trailing train. Her hair is styled in a sleek low updo. Background includes cream marble stairs, red carpet runner, gold stanchions, guards or attendants in black suits, and warm wall sconces.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic, luxury fashion magazine editorial, Met Gala atmosphere, ornate couture construction, intricate metallic embroidery, sparkling crystals, cinematic warm highlights, realistic fabric textures, high dynamic range, elegant posing, polished celebrity-event photography.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 vertical panels and exactly 3 couture looks; no visible readable text, no logos, no watermark. Keep all faces anonymized with soft blur blocks. Do not add extra panels, extra subjects as main models, or cartoon styling.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张三联版面编辑类时尚拼贴画，展示超写实、充满魅力的 Met Gala 女性肖像，灵感源自 {argument name="theme" default="天体与未来皇室的碰撞"}，通过同一位匿名女性演绎三套极致奢华的高级定制造型。面部需通过柔和的矩形模糊遮罩进行刻意匿名化处理，同时礼服、珠宝、灯光及活动氛围保持清晰且真实。

画布：宽幅横向三联画，3:2 纵横比，由细深色分隔线划分为 3 个等宽的垂直面板。照片级真实感的单反红毯摄影，浅景深，温暖的室内晚宴灯光，狗仔队闪光灯，奢华的博物馆楼梯和花卉背景。

面板数量及内容：共 3 幅全身或近全身的女性时尚肖像。
1. 左侧面板：正面朝向的女性站在红毯上，身着引人注目的 {argument name="left gown color" default="深绯红色"} 无肩带高定舞会礼服，配有深心形领口、金色巴洛克刺绣、华丽的珠饰紧身胸衣、蓬松的红色透明薄纱裙摆，以及雕塑感的裙撑或拖尾。她留着深色长波浪卷发，佩戴钻石项链和手链，一只手靠近嘴部，另一只手轻放在腰间。背景包括狗仔队、身着正装的宾客、绿篱、红毯和明亮的相机闪光灯。
2. 中央面板：女性以背影四分之三侧身姿态呈现，宛如空灵的月亮女神，身着冰冷的 {argument name="center gown color" default="银白色"} 一字肩星空高定礼服，配有水晶珠饰、闪烁的透明披肩、长长的飘逸拖尾、高开叉、闪亮的高跟鞋，以及半透明面料上绣着的月牙和星星图案。她回眸看向肩后，轻轻提着裙摆。背景挤满了摄影师、白花、带有星形图案的深蓝色地毯以及强烈的闪光灯摄影。
3. 右侧面板：女性正面站在优雅的楼梯上，身着合身的 {argument name="right gown color" default="黑色与古金色"} 一字肩美人鱼礼服，长袖设计，饰有厚重的对称金色刺绣、胸前的星空圆形图案、结构化的领口、修身的轮廓以及小拖尾。她梳着利落的低发髻。背景包括奶油色大理石楼梯、红毯跑道、金色立柱、身着黑色西装的警卫或服务人员以及温暖的壁灯。

视觉风格：超写实、奢华时尚杂志编辑风、Met Gala 氛围、华丽的高定剪裁、精致的金属刺绣、闪耀的水晶、电影级暖色高光、逼真的面料质感、高动态范围、优雅的姿态、精致的名人活动摄影。

约束条件：使用 3 个垂直面板和 3 套高定造型；无可见的可读文本、无 Logo、无水印。所有面部必须使用柔和的模糊块进行匿名化处理。请勿添加额外的面板、额外的模特主体或卡通风格。

templates.title: Met Gala Couture Triptych

titleLocalized.zh: Met Gala 高定三联画

templates.prompt:
Create a high-fashion editorial triptych showing exactly 3 full-body or three-quarter red-carpet portraits of fictional female models at the 2026 Met Gala inside and around the Metropolitan Museum of Art. Canvas is a wide horizontal 3-panel collage, roughly 3:2 aspect ratio, with thin black vertical dividers between panels and no captions or logos. Overall style is photorealistic luxury event photography with warm evening gala lighting, paparazzi flashes, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric texture, and intentionally anonymized soft-blurred faces.

Left panel: A dark-haired model in a dramatic {argument name="red gown color" default="deep crimson red"} Renaissance-inspired velvet and tulle ball gown, strapless sweetheart neckline, structured corset bodice, ornate antique-gold embroidery radiating across the torso, voluminous skirt, sparkling necklace and bracelet. She poses on red-carpeted museum steps with one hand near her mouth and one hand at her waist. Background includes photographers, guests in formalwear, red carpet, hedge-like greenery, and small red flowers.

Center panel: A model seen in an elegant over-the-shoulder pose wearing a luminous {argument name="center gown color" default="icy silver-white"} off-shoulder couture gown with sheer cape-like draping, crystal beading, embroidered celestial details, high leg slit, long transparent train, and metallic high heels. She stands on a dark gala carpet with star motifs, surrounded by white floral arrangements and a dense crowd of photographers with bright camera flashes.

Right panel: A model standing front-facing on grand cream stone stairs in an opulent {argument name="right gown color" default="black and antique gold"} fitted off-shoulder Renaissance velvet gown, long sleeves, mermaid silhouette, elaborate baroque gold scroll embroidery, oval black-and-gold chest motifs, and a small trailing train. Background shows an indoor museum staircase with red carpet runners, rope barriers, security staff in black suits, warm wall sconces, and polished architectural arches.

Environment details: The setting should evoke the actual Metropolitan Museum of Art gala atmosphere: grand stone steps, tan stone architecture, museum interiors, red carpet accents, formal guests, press cameras, hedges, flowers, and warm golden lighting. Counted visible subjects: exactly 3 main models, one per panel; exactly 3 couture gowns; exactly 3 distinct gala locations; many background guests and photographers kept secondary and slightly blurred. Use {argument name="event theme" default="Renaissance portrait-inspired velvet couture"} as the unifying fashion concept. Keep the image realistic, glamorous, and editorial, with no readable text, no watermark, no extra panels, and no celebrity likeness.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一组高定时尚三联画，展示 2026 年 Met Gala 期间，在大都会艺术博物馆内外拍摄的 3 张全身或四分之三身长的红毯肖像，模特均为虚构人物。画面为宽幅水平 3 联拼贴，比例约为 3:2，面板间有细黑色垂直分割线，无标题或 Logo。整体风格为照片级写实的奢华活动摄影，采用温暖的晚宴灯光、狗仔队闪光灯、浅景深、逼真的面料质感，并刻意对人物面部进行了柔焦模糊处理以保持匿名。

左侧面板：一位深色头发的模特，身着一件戏剧性的 {argument name="red gown color" default="深绯红色"} 文艺复兴风格天鹅绒与薄纱舞会礼服，抹胸心形领口，结构化紧身胸衣，华丽的古金色刺绣从躯干向外放射，裙摆蓬松，佩戴闪亮的项链和手镯。她站在铺着红毯的博物馆台阶上，一只手靠近嘴边，另一只手叉腰。背景包括摄影师、身着正装的嘉宾、红毯、树篱状绿植和红色小花。

中央面板：一位模特以优雅的回眸姿势出镜，身着一件光彩夺目的 {argument name="center gown color" default="冰银白色"} 一字肩高定礼服，配有透明斗篷式披肩、水晶串珠、星象刺绣细节、高开叉、长拖尾和金属质感高跟鞋。她站在铺有星形图案的深色晚宴地毯上，周围环绕着白色花艺装饰和密集的摄影师人群，伴有明亮的相机闪光灯。

右侧面板：一位模特正面站立在宏伟的奶油色石阶上，身着一件奢华的 {argument name="right gown color" default="黑色与古金色"} 修身一字肩文艺复兴天鹅绒礼服，长袖，鱼尾剪裁，饰有精致的巴洛克式金色卷草刺绣、椭圆形黑金胸部图案，并带有小拖尾。背景展示了室内博物馆楼梯，铺有红毯，设有绳索护栏、身着黑色西装的安保人员、温暖的壁灯和抛光的建筑拱门。

环境细节：场景应营造出大都会艺术博物馆晚宴的真实氛围：宏伟的石阶、棕褐色石材建筑、博物馆内饰、红毯点缀、正式嘉宾、媒体相机、树篱、鲜花和温暖的金色灯光。可见主体数量：恰好 3 位主要模特，每面板一位；恰好 3 件高定礼服；恰好 3 个不同的晚宴场景；背景中的嘉宾和摄影师应作为次要元素，并保持轻微模糊。使用 {argument name="event theme" default="文艺复兴肖像风格天鹅绒高定"} 作为统一的时尚概念。保持图像的真实感、魅力和编辑感，不要包含可读文字、水印、额外面板或任何名人的肖像。

templates.title: Four-Theme Newborn Portrait Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 四主题新生儿肖像拼贴

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a 2x2 square collage of four highly realistic fine-art newborn photography portraits featuring the same newborn baby, with the baby’s face intentionally covered by a soft-edged square privacy blur in each panel while preserving a warm, dreamy, premium studio look.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, divided into exactly 4 equal panels with no visible border lines, each panel a different themed newborn setup. Photorealistic DSLR newborn portrait style, shallow depth of field, soft diffused lighting, warm highlights, creamy bokeh, extremely detailed fabrics and props.

Subject: The same {argument name="baby age" default="newborn baby"} appears in all four panels, tiny and peacefully posed, with delicate hands and feet visible. Use {argument name="skin tone" default="warm light-to-medium newborn skin tone"}. The face in every panel must be obscured by a centered square blur/privacy block matching nearby skin colors, so no facial details are visible.

Layout and exact panel count: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Top-left panel: A dreamy night-sky moon setup. The baby sleeps curled on a large ivory crescent moon prop, wrapped in a soft powder-blue knit swaddle with a matching blue sleeping cap. The background is deep navy with small golden stars, fluffy white clouds, and glowing fairy lights. Include the baby’s folded arms and blue pom-pom wrap details.
2. Top-right panel: A woodland nest setup. The baby is wrapped in muted sage-green fabric and nestled inside a chunky woven basket or nest, wearing a beige knit bonnet. Surround the baby with dark green foliage, small wildflowers, warm golden firefly-like lights, tree bark textures, and an enchanted forest atmosphere. Visible tiny hands and bare feet peek out from the wrap.
3. Bottom-left panel: A soft ivory-and-blush princess setup. The baby lies on a plush white feathered blanket, dressed in pale pink lace and embroidered tulle with pearls and delicate beadwork, wearing a matching ornate bonnet. Surround with pastel pink flowers, white feathers, cream clouds, soft drapery, and a fairytale nursery background with very bright airy lighting.
4. Bottom-right panel: A floral garden basket setup. The baby rests on a pink knitted cushion in a wicker basket, wearing a sheer blush lace outfit and a pink floral crown. Surround with roses, pale pink blossoms, greenery, and a softly blurred white garden bench or crib in the background. The baby’s arms rest in front, with a serene posed newborn photography composition.

Visual style: Luxury newborn photography, whimsical fairytale themes, ultra-realistic fabric texture, soft pastel palette, cinematic warm glow, high detail, gentle vignetting, creamy background blur, professional studio retouching.

Constraints: Generate exactly four distinct themed newborn portraits in one 2x2 collage. Keep all faces covered by square privacy blur blocks. No text, no watermark, no logos, no extra panels, no adult hands, no distorted limbs. Overall mood should be tender, magical, and elegant. Use {argument name="overall color mood" default="soft pastel blue, sage green, ivory, and blush pink"} and {argument name="lighting style" default="warm diffused fairy-tale studio lighting"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张 2x2 的正方形拼贴图，包含四张高度写实的新生儿艺术摄影肖像。每张图中的婴儿为同一人，且每张图中的婴儿面部均需使用柔边方形隐私模糊遮挡，同时保持温暖、梦幻的高级摄影棚质感。

画布：正方形 1:1 图像，精确划分为 4 个等大的面板，无可见边框线，每个面板呈现不同的新生儿主题场景。采用超写实单反新生儿摄影风格，浅景深，柔和漫射光，暖色高光，奶油般虚化效果，展现极其细腻的织物与道具纹理。

主体：同一位 {argument name="baby age" default="新生儿"} 出现在所有四个面板中，姿态安详，露出精致的手脚。使用 {argument name="skin tone" default="温暖的浅至中等肤色"}。每个面板中的面部必须被居中的方形模糊/隐私遮挡块遮盖，使其与周围肤色融合，确保无法辨认面部细节。

布局与面板数量：使用 4 个面板。
1. 左上角面板：梦幻夜空月亮场景。婴儿蜷缩在巨大的象牙白新月道具上，包裹在柔软的粉蓝色针织襁褓中，戴着配套的蓝色睡帽。背景为深海军蓝，点缀着金色小星星、蓬松白云和闪烁的仙女灯。展示婴儿折叠的双臂和蓝色绒球襁褓细节。
2. 右上角面板：森林鸟巢场景。婴儿包裹在柔和的鼠尾草绿织物中，蜷缩在粗编织篮或鸟巢内，戴着米色针织帽。周围环绕深绿色叶片、小野花、温暖的金色萤火虫灯光、树皮纹理，营造出迷人的森林氛围。襁褓中露出细小的手和赤裸的脚。
3. 左下角面板：柔和象牙白与腮红粉公主场景。婴儿躺在毛绒白色羽毛毯上，身穿淡粉色蕾丝和绣花薄纱，点缀珍珠与精致珠饰，戴着配套的华丽帽子。周围环绕粉色花朵、白色羽毛、奶油色云朵、柔和帷幔，背景为明亮通透的童话育婴室。
4. 右下角面板：花卉花园篮场景。婴儿躺在柳条篮里的粉色针织垫上，身穿透明腮红粉色蕾丝装，戴着粉色花环。周围环绕玫瑰、淡粉色花朵、绿植，背景为虚化的白色花园长椅或婴儿床。婴儿双臂置于身前，呈现宁静的新生儿摄影构图。

视觉风格：奢华新生儿摄影，奇幻童话主题，超写实织物纹理，柔和粉彩配色，电影级暖光，高细节，轻微暗角，奶油般背景虚化，专业摄影棚修图。

约束条件：在 2x2 拼贴中生成 4 张不同的主题新生儿肖像。所有面部必须用方形隐私模糊块遮盖。无文字、无水印、无 Logo、无额外面板、无成人手部、无肢体畸变。整体氛围应温柔、梦幻且优雅。使用 {argument name="overall color mood" default="柔和粉蓝、鼠尾草绿、象牙白和腮红粉"} 以及 {argument name="lighting style" default="温暖漫射的童话摄影棚灯光"}。

templates.title: Natural Recharge Drink Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 天然能量饮料广告

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a premium conceptual beverage advertisement for {argument name="brand name" default="Chivita Active"}, showing the drink as a natural energy recharge solution.

Canvas: Square 4:5 vertical social ad composition, deep cobalt-blue studio background and matching glossy blue tabletop, clean Apple-like commercial lighting, lots of negative space in the upper half.

Layout: Place the main human subject on the lower left and center: exactly 1 exhausted young Black man in a plain white long-sleeve shirt, seated at a table with his head down on folded arms, body leaning forward, face mostly hidden, curly short hair visible. Place exactly 1 tall beverage carton upright on the lower right, sharply lit and fully readable. Between the man and carton, add exactly 1 glowing orange-yellow energy cable that arcs from the carton cap toward the man’s shoulder and forms exactly 1 luminous battery icon over his upper arm. The battery icon should contain 6 filled charge bars plus a small terminal on the right, glowing like neon.

Product details: The carton is a 1 liter fruit juice carton with white upper packaging, orange fruit graphics at the bottom, citrus and grapefruit imagery, a white screw cap, splashes of orange liquid near the top, and vertical blue lettering reading “active”; include smaller red brand text “chivita,” a side phrase “power of 6,” and small text “fortified with vitamin C.” Keep the carton realistic, glossy, and photographed like a professional FMCG packshot.

Text content: Add exactly 2 text areas. Top left headline reads “{argument name="headline text" default="recharge naturally."}” with “recharge” in thin white lowercase, “naturally” in bold white lowercase, and the period in orange. Bottom center tagline reads “{argument name="tagline text" default="active starts here."}” with “active” bold white, “starts here.” thin white, plus a small turquoise accent above the word active.

Visual style: Cannes Lions-level conceptual drink advertising, minimalist luxury still life, photorealistic studio photography, crisp product rendering, saturated blue-and-orange complementary palette, soft shadows, subtle tabletop reflection, high contrast, precise typography, no clutter.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 person, 1 beverage carton, 1 glowing cable arc, 1 battery icon with 6 bars, and 2 text areas. Do not add extra products, hands holding the carton, additional logos, extra people, scenery, or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="Chivita Active"} 创建一个高端概念性饮料广告，将该饮料展示为一种天然的能量补充方案。

画布：4:5 比例的竖版社交媒体广告构图，深钴蓝色摄影棚背景及配套的亮面蓝色桌面，采用类似 Apple 商业广告的简洁布光，上半部分留有大量负空间。

布局：将主体人物放置在左下方及中心位置：画面中仅有 1 位疲惫的年轻黑人男性，身穿纯白色长袖衬衫，头埋在交叉的双臂上伏在桌前，身体前倾，面部大部分被遮挡，可见短卷发。在右下方放置 1 个竖立的饮料盒，光线明亮且文字清晰可见。在人物与饮料盒之间，添加 1 条发光的橙黄色能量线，从饮料盒盖弧形延伸至男性的肩膀，并在其上臂上方形成 1 个发光的电池图标。电池图标应包含 6 个充满的电量格，右侧带有小型接线端，呈现霓虹灯般的发光效果。

产品细节：饮料盒为 1 升装果汁盒，顶部为白色包装，底部有橙色水果图案、柑橘和葡萄柚图像，配有白色螺旋盖，顶部附近有橙色液体飞溅，垂直蓝色字体印有“active”；包含较小的红色品牌文字“chivita”、侧面短语“power of 6”以及小字“fortified with vitamin C”。保持饮料盒真实、有光泽，并像专业快速消费品（FMCG）产品照一样进行拍摄。

文字内容：添加 2 个文字区域。左上角标题为“{argument name="headline text" default="recharge naturally."}”，其中“recharge”使用细体白色小写字母，“naturally”使用粗体白色小写字母，句号为橙色。底部中心标语为“{argument name="tagline text" default="active starts here."}”，其中“active”为粗体白色，“starts here.”为细体白色，并在“active”一词上方添加一个小的青绿色装饰点。

视觉风格：戛纳狮子奖级别的概念性饮料广告，极简主义奢华静物，照片级真实感的摄影棚摄影，清晰的产品渲染，饱和的蓝橙互补色调，柔和的阴影，细腻的桌面反射，高对比度，精准的排版，无杂乱元素。

限制条件：仅使用 1 个人物、1 个饮料盒、1 条发光电缆弧线、1 个带有 6 个电量格的电池图标以及 2 个文字区域。请勿添加额外的产品、手持饮料盒的动作、额外的标志、多余的人物、背景或水印。

templates.title: Sprite Pause the Heat Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Sprite “Pause the Heat” 广告

templates.prompt: Create a premium conceptual beverage advertisement in a vertical 3:4 composition. Center exactly one chilled {argument name="drink can" default="Sprite can"} standing upright on a glossy wet surface, photographed as a luxury FMCG still-life hero product. The can is vivid emerald green with realistic aluminum rim and base, dense condensation droplets, and the white Sprite logo visible across the front with a yellow-green lemon-lime icon above it. Use a dramatic split-environment concept: the left side of the ground is dry, cracked, dusty, and orange-yellow like extreme heat, while the right side is cold, wet, icy, and misty with splashing frost and scattered ice fragments. Behind the can, create a dynamic horizontal burst of powdery vapor and water spray, warm golden dust on the left blending into cool white-blue mist on the right. The background is a deep green studio gradient with subtle vignetting and cinematic lighting. In the upper left, place one bold slogan block with exactly 3 stacked lines of uppercase sans-serif text: line 1 “{argument name="slogan line one" default="PAUSE"}” in white, line 2 “{argument name="slogan line two" default="THE"}” in white, line 3 “{argument name="slogan line three" default="HEAT."}” in bright yellow-green. Keep the design minimalist, high-contrast, crisp, and award-winning, with Apple-level commercial polish, realistic reflections, sharp product focus, shallow depth of field, and no extra logos, people, hands, straws, fruit slices, or additional cans.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 3:4 竖构图的高端概念饮料广告。画面中心垂直放置一罐冰镇 {argument name="drink can" default="Sprite 易拉罐"}，将其作为奢侈快消品静物主视觉进行拍摄。易拉罐呈现鲜艳的翠绿色，具有逼真的铝制边缘和底座，表面布满浓密的冷凝水珠，正面清晰可见白色的 Sprite 标志，上方配有黄绿色的柠檬青柠图标。采用戏剧性的左右环境对比概念：地面左侧干燥、开裂、布满尘土，呈现出极度炎热的橙黄色；右侧则寒冷、潮湿、冰封，伴有飞溅的霜花和零散的冰块。在易拉罐后方，营造出动态的水平喷雾与水汽爆发效果，左侧温暖的金色尘埃与右侧清冷的蓝白色雾气交融。背景为深绿色摄影棚渐变色，带有微妙的暗角和电影级布光。在左上方放置一个醒目的标语块，包含 3 行堆叠的无衬线大写文本：第 1 行 “{argument name="slogan line one" default="PAUSE"}” 为白色，第 2 行 “{argument name="slogan line two" default="THE"}” 为白色，第 3 行 “{argument name="slogan line three" default="HEAT."}” 为亮黄绿色。设计保持极简、高对比度、清晰且具有获奖水准，具备 Apple 级别的商业质感，拥有逼真的反射效果、锐利的产品焦点、浅景深，且画面中不包含额外的标志、人物、手部、吸管、水果切片或其他易拉罐。

templates.title: Malta Guinness Inner Strength Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Malta Guinness 内在力量广告

templates.prompt: Create a premium conceptual drink advertisement for {argument name="product name" default="Malta Guinness"}, centered on a single cold aluminum can against a seamless saturated golden-orange studio background. The can is upright, front-facing, large in frame, with realistic condensation droplets, a metallic rim, and a warm shadow on the surface below. The label is golden on the upper half and deep dark red on the lower half, featuring a black harp icon above the bold wordmark “Malta” and “GUINNESS” underneath. Across the middle of the can, the label appears torn open horizontally like thick paper, with curled ripped edges extending left and right; inside the tear is a glowing cinematic scene of one athletic runner silhouette sprinting through dust toward a radiant sunset, symbolizing inner power and stamina. Use dramatic golden backlight rays from inside the can, high-end FMCG photography, luxury still-life styling, sharp product detail, clean minimalist composition, and Apple-level commercial polish. Include exactly 5 visible text elements: 1) top headline “nourishment that strengthens” with “strengthens” in bold, 2) main product wordmark “Malta”, 3) brand text “GUINNESS”, 4) lower label line “VITALITY · GOODNESS · ENERGY” plus small “NON ALCOHOLIC MALT DRINK”, and 5) bottom tagline “real strength starts within” with “within” in bold. Keep typography modern, dark brown/black, centered, and spacious. The emotional concept should be {argument name="concept" default="real strength starts within"}; the drink type should read as {argument name="drink type" default="non alcoholic malt drink"}. Avoid extra cans, extra athletes, clutter, hands, ice cubes, water splashes, or additional text.

templates.title: Identity-Consistent Caricature Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 保持身份一致的漫画肖像

templates.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference for the subject’s face, hairstyle, facial structure, and overall impression. Create a high-quality lifestyle editorial portrait of the same person sitting outdoors beside a wooden easel displaying a colorful street-style caricature portrait of them. The real person and the caricature must clearly resemble the same individual. Scene: - the person is seated on a simple wooden folding chair - beside them is a wooden easel holding a large caricature drawing - the setting is a sentimental urban art market - include illustration booths, handmade craft stalls, sketch displays, posters, cozy creative shopfronts, and a few softly blurred pedestrians - lively but not crowded - bright soft daylight, warm natural tones, shallow depth of field - realistic photography for the person and environment - vertical composition showing both the person and the caricature clearly Subject: - preserve the uploaded person’s recognizable identity - natural pose - calm, relaxed, slightly amused expression - stylish casual outfit that suits the subject - clean editorial lifestyle photography - do not force the same pose or expression for every subject Caricature direction: - the drawing on the easel must be a true observational street caricature, not a generic cute cartoon - the caricature artist should exaggerate the subject’s actual most recognizable facial traits - analyze the uploaded face and exaggerate only 2–4 distinctive features, such as eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, cheeks, jawline, chin, ears, hairstyle, or facial proportions - each caricature should feel custom-made for that specific person - avoid using the same default cute face for every person - avoid generic big eyes plus tongue-out expression - the caricature should be funny because it captures the person’s unique features, not because it uses a random silly pose Caricature style: - oversized head with smaller simplified body - playful but recognizable facial proportions - bold hand-drawn marker lines - quick sketchy pen strokes - colored pencil texture - lively street-artist energy - humorous but flattering - witty, expressive, and personality-driven - charming handmade imperfections - colorful accent doodles may be added, but keep the focus on the face Expression in the caricature: - choose a natural funny expression that fits the person’s facial character - possible expressions: raised eyebrow, shy smile, surprised eyes, confident smirk, awkward polite smile, exaggerated calm face, pouty lips, confused cute face, or gentle blank stare - the expression should vary depending on the subject - do not always use a tongue-out face - do not always use the same wide-eyed cute expression Caricature canvas: - large vertical drawing board or canvas on a wooden easel - the caricature should be clearly visible and occupy a major part of the image - it should immediately read as a funny street caricature - it should be more exaggerated than a portrait sketch - it should not look like a realistic fashion illustration - it should not look like a polished beauty drawing Important: - the caricature must be custom to the uploaded person - preserve recognizable identity through the exaggerated features - prioritize personality, likeness, and humor over generic cuteness - make the caricature feel like a real street artist observed the person and drew a witty exaggerated version Negative prompt: - no generic cute chibi face - no repeated default caricature face - no tongue-out pose - no identical silly expression for every subject - no random anime expression - no realistic portrait sketch - no polished fashion illustration - no beauty sketch - no weak exaggeration - no scary grotesque distortion - no ugly horror exaggeration - no distorted anatomy of the real person - no extra fingers - no badly drawn hands - no messy crowded background - no text - no watermark - no Eiffel Tower - no famous landmarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用上传的肖像作为主体面部、发型、面部结构和整体印象的身份参考。创作一张高质量的生活方式编辑风格肖像，展示同一个人坐在户外，旁边是一个木制画架，上面展示着一张色彩鲜艳的街头风格漫画肖像。真人与漫画必须清楚地呈现为同一个人。场景：- 人物坐在一把简单的木制折叠椅上 - 旁边是一个放置着大型漫画画作的木制画架 - 背景是一个充满情怀的城市艺术市集 - 包含插画摊位、手工工艺品摊位、素描展示、海报、温馨的创意店面，以及少量柔和模糊的行人 - 氛围活跃但不拥挤 - 明亮柔和的日光，温暖的自然色调，浅景深 - 人物和环境采用写实摄影风格 - 垂直构图，清晰展示人物和漫画。主体：- 保留上传人物可识别的身份特征 - 自然的姿势 - 冷静、放松、略带愉悦的表情 - 适合主体的时尚休闲装扮 - 干净的编辑风格生活照 - 不要强求每个主体都采用相同的姿势或表情。漫画方向：- 画架上的画作必须是真实的街头观察漫画，而非通用的可爱卡通 - 漫画家应夸大主体最显著的面部特征 - 分析上传的面部，仅夸大 2–4 个独特特征，例如眼形、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、脸颊、下颌线、下巴、耳朵、发型或面部比例 - 每张漫画都应感觉是为该特定人物量身定制的 - 避免对每个人使用相同的默认可爱脸型 - 避免通用的“大眼睛加吐舌头”表情 - 漫画之所以有趣，是因为它捕捉到了人物独特的特征，而不是因为它使用了随机的滑稽姿势。漫画风格：- 大头小身体的比例 - 有趣但可识别的面部比例 - 大胆的手绘马克笔线条 - 快速的素描笔触 - 彩色铅笔质感 - 活跃的街头艺术家风格 - 幽默且讨喜 - 诙谐、富有表现力且充满个性 - 迷人的手工不完美感 - 可以添加色彩鲜艳的装饰涂鸦，但重点应放在面部。漫画表情：- 选择符合人物面部特征的自然幽默表情 - 可选表情：挑眉、羞涩微笑、惊讶眼神、自信坏笑、尴尬礼貌微笑、夸张的冷静脸、嘟嘴、困惑可爱的脸或温柔的呆滞凝视 - 表情应根据主体而变化 - 不要总是使用吐舌头表情 - 不要总是使用相同的瞪大眼睛的可爱表情。漫画画布：- 木制画架上的大型垂直画板或画布 - 漫画应清晰可见，并占据画面的主要部分 - 应能一眼看出是滑稽的街头漫画 - 应比肖像素描更具夸张感 - 不应看起来像写实的时尚插画 - 不应看起来像精致的美妆画作。重要提示：- 漫画必须是针对上传人物的定制作品 - 通过夸张的特征保留可识别的身份 - 优先考虑个性、相似度和幽默感，而非通用的可爱感 - 让漫画看起来像是真实的街头艺术家观察了该人物并画出的诙谐夸张版本。负面提示：- 没有通用的可爱 Q 版脸 - 没有重复的默认漫画脸 - 没有吐舌头姿势 - 没有对每个主体使用相同的滑稽表情 - 没有随机的动漫表情 - 没有写实肖像素描 - 没有精致的时尚插画 - 没有美妆素描 - 没有微弱的夸张 - 没有可怕的怪诞扭曲 - 没有丑陋的恐怖夸张 - 没有真人身体结构的扭曲 - 没有多余的手指 - 没有画得糟糕的手 - 没有杂乱拥挤的背景 - 没有文字 - 没有水印 - 没有埃菲尔铁塔 - 没有著名地标。
