templates.title: Life Transition Emotional Pathway

titleLocalized.zh: 人生转折的情感路径

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic visual titled: “THE PEOPLE WE BECOME.” The image should depict multiple stages of one human life existing simultaneously inside a single interconnected environment shaped by memory, growth and emotional transition. Avoid the feeling of: - a motivational poster, - a staircase timeline, - or separate portraits pasted together. Instead, the world itself should evolve naturally between life phases as if memories are physically blending into one another. The composition follows a winding stone pathway moving through different emotional spaces connected seamlessly across the image. At the bottom of the frame: A newborn sleeps inside a softly lit woven cradle near a dim bedside lamp. The atmosphere feels warm, silent and untouched. Nearby: - folded baby blankets, - soft shadows, - wooden toys, - faint moonlight through curtains, - dust particles drifting in warm air. The pathway slowly transitions into early childhood. A young child runs barefoot through a living room filled with scattered crayons, comic books, paper airplanes and half-built toy structures. Late-afternoon sunlight pours through large windows and reflects softly across wooden floors. The environment gradually changes again without hard separation. The next version appears around age 13: sitting alone on a rooftop during light rainfall wearing headphones and holding a notebook. Distant city lights blur softly behind him while unfinished sketches scatter beside him. The atmosphere becomes quieter and emotionally uncertain. Further along the path: A university-age version studies late at night at a cluttered desk illuminated only by a warm desk lamp and laptop screen. Around him: - highlighted textbooks, - coffee cups, - handwritten notes, - exhaustion, - ambition, - and isolation. Rain reflects softly across the apartment window behind him. At the highest point of the composition: An older version stands quietly overlooking a sunrise city skyline from a hillside path above the city. He looks calm rather than triumphant. His clothing is simple and grounded: rolled sleeves, slightly tired posture, hands in pockets, wind moving softly through his shirt. He should visibly feel like the same person shaped by every previous version. The transitions between life stages should contain subtle symbolic continuity: - flowers growing through cracks in concrete, - notebook pages blending into city architecture, - rainwater reflections becoming skyline lights, - old drawings faintly appearing on apartment walls, - childhood objects partially hidden inside later environments. Typography should remain minimal and restrained. Small serif text placed naturally near each stage: “Wonder.” “Becoming.” “Doubt.” “Discipline.” “Perspective.” No motivational quotes. No oversized typography. Lighting should evolve emotionally throughout the image: - warm soft childhood tones, - cooler rainy teenage atmosphere, - isolated tungsten lighting during study years, - balanced sunrise light in adulthood. The realism should feel grounded: - believable facial continuity across ages, - natural environmental texture, - subtle lens softness, - realistic lighting behavior, - physically believable spaces, - quiet cinematic atmosphere. The image should feel intimate and reflective rather than grand or overly dramatic. Mood: memory, identity, growth, loneliness, ambition, emotional evolution and the quiet passage of time.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张名为“THE PEOPLE WE BECOME”的电影感视觉图像。画面应描绘一个人生命中多个阶段同时存在于一个由记忆、成长和情感转折所塑造的相互关联的环境中。避免以下感觉：- 励志海报，- 阶梯式时间轴，- 或拼贴在一起的独立肖像。相反，世界本身应在生命阶段之间自然演变，仿佛记忆在物理层面相互融合。构图遵循一条蜿蜒的石径，穿过图像中无缝连接的不同情感空间。画面底部：一个新生儿在昏暗的床头灯旁，睡在光线柔和的编织摇篮里。氛围温暖、宁静且纯粹。附近：- 折叠的婴儿毯，- 柔和的阴影，- 木制玩具，- 透过窗帘的微弱月光，- 在暖空气中漂浮的尘埃颗粒。路径缓慢过渡到童年早期。一个小孩赤脚跑过客厅，地上散落着蜡笔、漫画书、纸飞机和未完成的玩具结构。午后的阳光透过大窗户倾泻而入，在木地板上投下柔和的倒影。环境在没有明显割裂的情况下逐渐变化。下一个版本出现在 13 岁左右：独自坐在屋顶上，在细雨中戴着耳机，拿着笔记本。远处的城市灯光在他身后柔和地模糊，未完成的草图散落在身旁。氛围变得更加安静且充满情感上的不确定性。沿着路径继续：大学时期的版本在深夜的杂乱书桌前学习，仅由暖色台灯和笔记本电脑屏幕照亮。他周围：- 标记过的教科书，- 咖啡杯，- 手写笔记，- 疲惫，- 雄心，- 以及孤独。雨水在他身后的公寓窗户上投下柔和的倒影。在构图的最高点：年长版本安静地站在山坡小径上，俯瞰着日出时的城市天际线。他看起来很平静，而非胜利。他的穿着简单而朴实：卷起的袖口，略显疲惫的姿态，双手插兜，风轻轻吹动他的衬衫。他应该让人明显感觉到是同一个被之前每个阶段所塑造的人。生命阶段之间的过渡应包含微妙的象征性连续性：- 从混凝土裂缝中长出的花朵，- 笔记本页面融入城市建筑，- 雨水倒影变成天际线灯光，- 旧画作隐约出现在公寓墙壁上，- 童年物品部分隐藏在后期的环境中。排版应保持极简和克制。在每个阶段附近自然放置小号衬线字体：“Wonder”（惊奇）。“Becoming”（蜕变）。“Doubt”（怀疑）。“Discipline”（自律）。“Perspective”（视角）。没有励志名言。没有超大字体。光影应在整张图像中随情感演变：- 童年温暖柔和的色调，- 青少年时期阴雨凉爽的氛围，- 学习岁月里孤寂的钨丝灯光，- 成年时期平衡的日出光线。写实感应扎根于现实：- 各个年龄段可信的面部连续性，- 自然的环境纹理，- 微妙的镜头柔焦，- 真实的光影表现，- 物理上可信的空间，- 安静的电影感氛围。图像应给人以亲密和反思的感觉，而非宏大或过度戏剧化。情绪：记忆、身份、成长、孤独、雄心、情感演变以及时光的静谧流逝。

templates.title: Torn Book Portal Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 撕裂书页中的肖像

templates.prompt:
Use the uploaded portrait only as the identity and hairstyle reference. Accurately preserve the person’s real facial identity, face shape, facial proportions, skin tone, natural skin texture, hairstyle outline, hair volume, and overall real-life appearance. Do not copy the original clothing, background, lighting, pose, expression, or image quality from the uploaded portrait.

Create a highly realistic vertical photo of an open printed book lying on a table. One page of the book has a large irregular torn hole in the center, with multiple layered paper edges, rough fibers, curled paper, realistic shadows, and visible thickness. The torn opening looks like a natural paper portal, not a digital frame.

Through the torn hole, reveal the same person {argument name="scene inside hole" default="standing by the ocean at sunset"}. The person is shown from the waist up or chest up, positioned naturally inside the opening, looking slightly to the side with a calm, cinematic expression. The background inside the hole shows a warm golden-orange sunset over the sea, soft waves, a glowing horizon, and natural reflected light on the water.

Generate suitable clothing automatically based on the uploaded person’s appearance and atmosphere. The outfit should feel elegant, textured, and visually refined, matching the sunset and book-portal concept, but do not lock the exact clothing style. Avoid copying the reference outfit exactly. Clothing should look realistic, with real fabric texture, natural folds, and proper lighting.

The book page should have soft warm beige paper tones, subtle {argument name="book text style" default="printed Chinese textbook-style text"}, chapter-like layout, and light paper texture. The text should be decorative and believable, not the main focus. Keep the composition close-up, with the book filling most of the frame. Use shallow depth of field, realistic handheld camera perspective, warm indoor ambient light on the book, and cinematic sunset light inside the torn portal.

The image should feel like a real photographed mixed-media scene: physical paper, real torn edges, natural shadows, correct perspective, believable depth, and seamless integration between the book and the sunset portrait. Preserve realistic human skin texture, pores, slight unevenness, natural facial details, and real hair strands. No plastic skin, no anime style, no overly smooth beauty filter.

Vertical composition, 3:4 aspect ratio, high-resolution, realistic photography, cinematic detail, natural color grading, soft depth of field, physical paper texture, realistic sunset lighting, no watermark, no logo, no text overlay.

Negative Prompt:

watermark, logo, platform watermark, text overlay, extra captions, fake book texture, flat paper edges, clean circular hole, digital frame look, pasted face, poorly blended composite, unrealistic perspective, wrong shadows, floating person, distorted face, changed identity, differe

promptLocalized.zh:
仅将上传的肖像作为身份和发型的参考。准确保留人物真实的脸部特征、脸型、面部比例、肤色、自然的皮肤纹理、发型轮廓、发量以及整体的真实外观。请勿复制上传肖像中的原始服装、背景、光影、姿势、表情或图像质量。

创作一张高度逼真的竖构图照片，展示一本平放在桌上的打开的印刷书籍。书的一页中心有一个巨大的不规则撕裂孔，呈现出多层纸张边缘、粗糙纤维、卷曲纸张、逼真的阴影和可见的厚度。撕裂的开口看起来像一个自然的纸质入口，而非数字相框。

透过撕裂的孔洞，展现同一个人 {argument name="scene inside hole" default="站在夕阳下的海边"}。人物以半身或胸部以上视角呈现，自然地位于孔洞内，微微侧头，表情平静且具有电影感。孔洞内的背景展示了海面上温暖的金色夕阳、柔和的波浪、发光的地平线以及水面上自然的反射光。

根据上传人物的外貌和氛围自动生成合适的服装。服装应显得优雅、有质感且视觉精致，与夕阳和书本入口的概念相符，但不要锁定具体的服装款式。避免完全复制参考图中的服装。服装应看起来真实，具有真实的布料纹理、自然的褶皱和适当的光影。

书页应具有柔和的暖米色调，带有微妙的 {argument name="book text style" default="印刷的中式教科书风格文字"}、章节式排版和轻微的纸张纹理。文字应具有装饰性和可信度，而非视觉焦点。保持近景构图，让书本占据画面的大部分。使用浅景深、逼真的手持相机视角，书本上采用温暖的室内环境光，撕裂的入口内采用电影般的夕阳光。

templates.title: Summer Garden Rose Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 夏日花园玫瑰自拍

templates.prompt:
Use my uploaded portrait only as the identity reference. Only reference the person’s real facial features, face shape, proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, hair texture, and overall natural appearance. Do not copy the original clothing, background, lighting, expression, or image quality from the uploaded portrait. The generated person must still look like the same real person. Do not change the person into someone else. Do not over-beautify. Do not make the skin look plastic. Do not make it anime-like or doll-like.

Create a highly realistic outdoor summer garden selfie in a vertical composition. The framing should be farther away than a close-up selfie, showing more of the upper body and part of the outfit, with a natural arm-extended selfie perspective. The subject is looking directly at the camera with a soft, gentle, relaxed expression and a slight smile. The head can be slightly tilted, and both arms should be visible extending toward the camera in a natural selfie pose. The perspective should feel like a real handheld phone selfie, with mild wide-angle distortion, but not exaggerated.

The setting is a bright outdoor flower garden filled with blooming purple roses, lush green leaves, and a clear blue sky in the background. The floral wall should feel dense, vivid, fresh, and summery. The subject is wearing a woven straw sun hat with a wide brim and delicate white lace trim around the edge. The hat may include subtle summer decorations such as small white-yellow plumeria flowers and small starfish accessories, keeping the styling elegant and playful, not cartoonish.

Generate suitable summer clothing automatically based on the uploaded person’s appearance and temperament. Do not lock the clothing to one exact design, but make it stylish, natural, feminine, and suitable for a sunny flower garden selfie. The outfit should harmonize with the purple rose environment, and light purple or other soft summer tones are preferred. Clothing fabric should look real, with natural texture and folds.

Use strong but realistic natural summer sunlight. Let the sunlight pass through the hat and create delicate dappled light and shadow patterns on the face, shoulders, and arms. Keep the lighting bright, warm, and fresh, but do not overexpose the face. Preserve natural skin texture, subtle pores, realistic highlights, natural lip tone, and authentic eye catchlights. Hair should have realistic strands and a few loose flyaway hairs, with soft sunlit rim light around the edges.

The overall image should look like a real high-quality smartphone selfie or digital camera selfie, with authentic photographic realism, natural depth of field, vivid floral colors, and a clean, dreamy summer atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no logo, no AI label, and no border.

场景设定在明亮的户外花海中，背景是盛开的紫色玫瑰、茂密的绿叶和湛蓝的天空。花墙应感觉浓密、生动、清新且充满夏日气息。主体戴着一顶编织草帽，帽檐宽大，边缘饰有精致的白色蕾丝。帽子可以包含微妙的夏日装饰，如白色小鸡蛋花和小型海星配饰，保持造型优雅俏皮，而非卡通化。

根据上传人物的外貌和气质自动生成合适的夏日服装。不要局限于某一种特定的服装设计，但要使其时尚、自然、具有女性魅力，并适合阳光明媚的花园自拍。服装应与紫色玫瑰的环境相协调，建议选用浅紫色或其他柔和的夏日色调。服装面料应看起来真实，具有自然的纹理和褶皱。

使用强烈但写实的自然夏日阳光。让阳光透过帽子，在脸部、肩膀和手臂上投射出精致的斑驳光影。保持光线明亮、温暖、清新，但不要让脸部过度曝光。保留自然的皮肤纹理、细微的毛孔、写实的高光、自然的唇色以及真实的眼神光。头发应具有真实的质感和几缕散落的发丝，边缘带有柔和的阳光轮廓光。

templates.prompt: 2x2 grid, 4 decades of a human life as typographic decade numerals Anchor: {argument name="life stages" default="[Decade Numeral] :: [Life Stage / Decade (e.g., Childhood 10s / Midlife 40s / Old Age 70s)]"} :: 4 Morphology: 3D typographic sculpture of [Decade Numeral], form assembled from a dense pile of [Life Stage] objects — the physical texture of daily life at that age: toys, tools, documents, comfort objects, medical items, hobby equipment — nostalgic, honest, legible :: 3 Material Physics: Textures faithful to the objects of that life stage: worn plastic, laminated paper, soft cotton, scratched metal, prescription-bottle translucent orange, aged photo print; scale and wear appropriate to how those objects are actually held and used :: 3 Illumination: Warm domestic lighting — like afternoon sun through a home window, soft fill from the opposite side, clean light background :: 2 Render Stack: Cinema 4D render, front-facing, 8k, tactile domestic-material shaders :: 1 Negative: [Illegible, 2D, flat, generic stock-photo aesthetic, floating, clinical or cold lighting, objects not specific to the age] :: -1

promptLocalized.zh: 2x2 网格，以排版字体数字呈现人生的 4 个十年阶段 Anchor: {argument name="life stages" default="[Decade Numeral] :: [Life Stage / Decade (例如：童年 10s / 中年 40s / 老年 70s)]"} :: 4 Morphology: [Decade Numeral] 的 3D 排版字体雕塑，形态由一堆密集的 [Life Stage] 物品堆叠而成 —— 该年龄段日常生活的物理质感：玩具、工具、文件、舒适物、医疗用品、爱好设备 —— 怀旧、真实、易读 :: 3 Material Physics: 忠实于该人生阶段物品的质感：磨损的塑料、塑封纸、柔软的棉布、有划痕的金属、处方药瓶的半透明橙色、陈旧的照片打印；比例和磨损程度符合这些物品实际被拿取和使用的方式 :: 3 Illumination: 温暖的居家照明 —— 如午后阳光穿过窗户，对侧柔和补光，干净的背景光 :: 2 Render Stack: Cinema 4D 渲染，正面视角，8k，触感真实的居家材质着色器 :: 1 Negative: [模糊不清、2D、扁平、通用的库存照片美学、悬浮、临床或冷色调照明、非该年龄段特有的物品] :: -1

The man is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="red sweatshirt with a white horse graphic, baggy tan wide-leg trousers, a black baseball cap, and chunky beige clogs with white socks"}, featuring a green Omnitrix on his wrist. Behind him, the giant Heatblast is composed of dark volcanic rock and intense, glowing orange and yellow flames, with the signature green Omnitrix symbol on its chest. The fire emits a powerful, vibrant glow that illuminates the man's silhouette and the dark, textured grey concrete wall in the background. The aesthetic is high-fashion streetwear mixed with epic action, featuring dramatic lighting, sharp details, high contrast, and 8K resolution, 100% my face same, I need this prompt picture, zoom in, ar 3:4

templates.title: 3D CG Pink Maid Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 3D CG 粉色女仆插画

templates.prompt:
An adult fantasy female character in an exquisite 3D CG illustration style with ultra-high detail and 9:16 vertical composition, sitting on a soft pink bed in a {argument name="character theme" default="pink dream maid"} themed {argument name="scene" default="bedroom setting"}.

The character is centered, facing the camera, kneeling in a natural and upright posture with her body leaning slightly forward. Her physique is mature and curvy with soft shoulders, a natural waistline, and rounded hips and thighs, presenting a gentle, sweet, and elegant feminine beauty. She has a delicate and cute face with fair skin, large bright eyes, a slender nose, and a soft natural smile, resembling a sweet Japanese doll. Her hairstyle is {argument name="hairstyle" default="long black hair in twin tails"} with soft bangs and a white frilled maid headpiece with pink bows and cat-ear decorations.

The outfit is a Japanese sweet maid dress in black and pink, featuring a tight-fitting short-sleeved pink top with a large black bow and white frilled collars and cuffs, paired with a black puffy skirt, multi-layered white apron, and pink bow details. The scene is a gentle pink bedroom with pink bedding, plush teddy bears, pink curtains, and light-colored furniture. Soft natural light enters through the window, creating a creamy soft-focus effect with glowing particles and a shallow depth of field.

The color palette is dominated by pink, white, and black. The overall mood is sweet, dreamy, and refined, with high-quality 3D CG portrait textures, clear skin details, delicate lighting, and 8K masterpiece quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
一位成年奇幻女性角色，采用精致的 3D CG 插画风格，具有超高细节和 9:16 竖构图，坐在 {argument name="character theme" default="粉色梦幻女仆"} 主题的 {argument name="scene" default="卧室场景"} 中柔软的粉色床上。

角色位于画面中心，面向镜头，以自然挺拔的姿态跪坐，身体微微前倾。她体态成熟且曲线优美，双肩柔和，腰线自然，臀部和大腿圆润，展现出温柔、甜美且优雅的女性美。她拥有精致可爱的面容，皮肤白皙，明亮的大眼睛，鼻梁挺拔，带着柔和自然的微笑，宛如甜美的日本娃娃。她的发型是 {argument name="hairstyle" default="黑色长双马尾"}，配有柔顺的刘海，以及带有粉色蝴蝶结和猫耳装饰的白色荷叶边女仆头饰。

服装为日式甜美风格的黑粉色女仆装，紧身短袖粉色上衣配有大号黑色蝴蝶结和白色荷叶边领口及袖口，搭配黑色蓬蓬裙、多层白色围裙和粉色蝴蝶结细节。场景为温馨的粉色卧室，配有粉色寝具、毛绒泰迪熊、粉色窗帘和浅色家具。柔和的自然光透过窗户射入，营造出奶油般的柔焦效果，伴有发光粒子和浅景深。

色调以粉色、白色和黑色为主。整体氛围甜美、梦幻且精致，具有高质量的 3D CG 人像质感、清晰的皮肤细节、细腻的光影以及 8K 大师级画质。

templates.title: Luxury Magazine Graduation Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华杂志风毕业照

templates.prompt: Based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, please generate 8 different individual high-end retouched graduation portrait photos at once, unified in a 3:4 vertical composition. Theme: "High-End Luxury Magazine Graduation Portrait" Overall style reference: Korean-style high-end fashion magazine graduation visual aesthetic + high-end studio shooting quality + Chinese university academic dress system + emotional close-up portraits + fashion magazine cover feel. Note: The focus of this set is not ordinary graduation snapshots or assembly-line studio photos, but rather: "A set of high-quality graduation close-up visuals shot like a Chinese version of a fashion magazine." The overall output can have a magazine cover feel. --- ## I. Customizable Parameters - [Degree Level]: Bachelor - [Major Direction]: Management - [Institutional Vibe]: Finance and Economics University - [Academic Dress System]: Handled according to common Chinese university academic dress standards, with minor adjustments to the hood/stole/color based on the major - [Main Scene Vibe]: Minimalist studio / Red auditorium curtain / White background studio / Dark gray background / Graduation ceremony podium / Certificate studio scene - [Prop Preference]: Degree certificate / Graduation certificate / Framed certificate / Bouquet / Podium / Mortarboard / School badge elements / Chinese university graduation commemorative props - [Character Disposition]: Restrained high-end / Cold and elegant / Confident / Young elite feel / Gentle joy / Playful and agile - [Jewelry & Accessories]: Minimalist rings / Watch / Earrings - [Shooting Focus]: Close-up texture / Clothing details / Facial texture / Hand movements / Magazine feel --- ## II. Character Consistency Please strictly preserve the user's true identity characteristics, including but not limited to: - Face shape - Facial proportions - Eye shape - Nose shape - Lip shape - Skin tone - Sense of age - Hairstyle foundation - Body type - Overall temperament All 8 photos must clearly look like the same real face. Do not turn them into a stranger, do not over-Westernize, do not make them look like an internet celebrity, do not over-smooth the skin, and do not produce AI 'fake faces'. The character's temperament should retain a real high-end feel, like the person themselves upgraded into a set of high-end graduation magazine visuals, rather than a different professional model. Please use the uploaded photos only as a reference for identity; do not retain the realistic background, daily clothing, or original composition from the photos. --- ## III. Overall Positioning The core positioning of this set is: "Chinese Academic Dress Graduation Portrait x Korean High-End Fashion Magazine Aesthetic x Close-up Texture Visuals." The set must simultaneously possess: 1. A clear graduation theme 2. Clear Chinese university academic dress characteristics 3. A clear fashion magazine feel 4. Clear refined texture in close-ups/portraits 5. Clear emotion and character expression 6. Clear logic for Chinese graduation scenes and props. This is not a common commemorative graduation photo, but rather: "Like a cover story shot by a high-end Chinese fashion magazine for the graduation season." Overall aesthetic reference keywords: - Korean high-end magazine feel - Calm and high-end - Minimalist studio shooting - Fashion-forward graduation portrait - Clean and crisp composition - Prominent facial and hand details - Clear clothing and certificate details - Possessing both solemnity and youthfulness - A small amount of ritual and slight theatricality --- ## IV. Clothing Requirements (Sinicized Focus) Clothing must explicitly use the Chinese university academic dress/gown system, not Western graduation robes or Japanese/Korean school uniform-style graduation wear. ### Core Clothing Requirements: - Explicitly retain the silhouette of common Chinese university academic gowns - Retain the standard square mortarboard - Retain the tassel - Retain the Chinese academic dress hood/stole/piping system matching the [Degree Level] and [Major Direction] - Clothing details should be high-end, clean, crisp, with studio texture - The academic dress must be immediately recognizable as the Chinese version - Do not make it look like a Western graduation robe - Do not make it look like a stage costume - Do not make it look like low-cost studio clothing ### Degree Level Differentiation Please reflect different temperaments based on the [Degree Level]: - Bachelor: Younger, fresher, lighter, more youthful - Master: More mature, restrained, intellectual, stronger elite feel - Doctor: More solemn, more academic, with a greater sense of authority and ritual ### Major Direction Expression Please naturally reflect professional attributes according to the [Major Direction] through minor adjustments in hood color, certificates, bouquet tones, prop vibes, and character state. Follow common Chinese academic dress logic without necessarily being strictly realistic to a specific school. The focus is: Let people immediately feel "This is a graduation quality of a certain Chinese major." --- ## V. Prop Requirements (Sinicized Focus) Props must originate from the context of the Chinese graduation season rather than being completely Westernized. Priority props: - Common Chinese university degree certificate covers - Common Chinese university graduation certificate covers - Framed certificates - Graduation bouquets - School badge elements - Podium/Lectern/Oath platform - Faculty sashes/Honor sashes - Mortarboard - Graduation commemorative certificates - Graduation yearbooks - Outstanding graduate certificates/award-like props - Red auditorium curtains - Pure white studio background - Dark gray background - Chinese-style graduation ceremony atmosphere Overall prop requirements: - Clean and high-end - Do not pile too many - 1-2 core props per photo is sufficient - Must serve the character and graduation identity - Possess both a "graduation feel" and a "magazine feel" --- ## VI. Expression and Emotion Requirements (Focus) This set must focus on depicting expressions; not all photos can have the same template smile. Assign the following different emotions across the 8 photos: - Restrained smile - Quietly looking into the lens - Cold side-glance - Confident and calm - Solemnity during a speech - Joy of a young graduate - Relaxed laughter - Smiling with eyes closed - Slightly playful celebratory feel - A touch of high-end aloofness - A sense of achievement without over-exaggeration - Sense of ritual and glory - A slight fashion-shoot distance Requirements: - Natural expressions - No stiff fake smiles - No business-like smiles in every shot - No exaggerated internet celebrity expressions - Should look like real emotional moments captured during a magazine shoot --- ## VII. Photography and Texture Requirements (Focus) This set must emphasize close-ups, facial texture, academic dress texture, hand texture, and prop texture. ### Composition Requirements: Overall focus on: - Headshots - Half-body close-ups - Half-body medium close-ups - A small amount of 3/4 body shots Avoid large-scale wide shots. Do not shrink the character too much. The focus is: "Close-up feel, facial impact, local clothing details, interaction between certificates and hands." ### Texture Requirements: - High-end studio shooting - Clear and realistic skin texture - Delicate but not over-smoothed - Clear texture of academic dress fabric - Crispness in hoods/stoles/hats - Clear texture for certificate paper/covers/framed certificates/bouquets - Clear, restrained, and exquisite jewelry - Clean and sharp lighting - Simple and high-end visuals - High contrast but not messy - A bit of Korean coldness and fashion feel - Like a graduation visual actually shot for a fashion magazine ### Lighting Requirements: - High-end studio key light - Clear facial structure - No overexposure on hands - Layered black background scenes - Clean white backgrounds (not dead white) - Theatricality in red curtain scenes - Overall crisp, modern, and fashionable --- ## VIII. Hairstyle and Makeup ### Hairstyle Naturally design based on original character features, but the overall look should be more like a high-end magazine shoot styling. Can use: - Clean and sharp straight hair - Slightly wavy mid-length hair - Updo - Low ponytail - Clean slicked-back style - One side tucked behind the ear - Slightly fashion-forward low-saturation hair treatment Requirements: - Not too messy/daily life style - No over-the-top avant-garde fashion styling - Balance graduation identity with magazine quality ### Makeup - Clean base makeup - Transparent yet high-end - Clear eyebrows and eyes - Natural lip color or light rose tones - Can have a slight glow - No heavy makeup - No internet celebrity style makeup - No heavy false eyelashes - Should look like a Korean magazine cover makeup --- ## IX. Fixed Allocation for 8 Individual Photos Please output the following 8 different individual refined graduation photos: ### Photo 1 | Certificate Close-up Main Visual - Half-body close-up or headshot - Character wearing Chinese mortarboard and academic gown - Holding an open graduation/degree certificate - Certificate close to the lens, facial features clear - Restrained smile or quiet confidence - Simple dark gray or solid color background - Emphasize relationship between certificate, face, and hat - The best candidate for a magazine cover ### Photo 2 | Bouquet and Certificate Profile - Half-body or 3/4 body - Character holding a Chinese graduation bouquet and certificate cover - Looking toward the side or out of frame - Quiet, cool, and optimistic expression - Dark or pure black background - Highlight the colors of the Chinese graduation bouquet and gown hood ### Photo 3 | Auditorium Podium Oath - Half-body medium close-up - Character standing behind a podium/lectern - One hand raised as if taking an oath, defending a thesis, or speaking - One hand on the microphone or podium - Background is a Chinese graduation ceremony-style red curtain - Solemn, firm, and ritualistic expression - Emphasize the Chinese context of the ceremony ### Photo 4 | Celebratory Close-up - Headshot or close-up - Wearing academic dress, simple black or dark background - Small amount of gold confetti/celebratory atmosphere - Hands doing a relaxed natural celebration or a playful gesture near the face - Surprised, happy, young, and agile expression - The most youthful and energetic photo of the set ### Photo 5 | Framed Certificate and Glory - Half-body medium shot - Character holding a framed certificate, degree cover, or graduation materials - Can be paired with a minimalist handbag or personal style accessory - White or light gray pure studio background - Calm, fashion-forward, elite expression - Emphasize "graduation identity + personal style + sense of achievement" ### Photo 6 | Red Curtain Laughter - Half-body medium close-up - Red auditorium curtain background - Character holding a framed certificate - Expression is a genuine hearty laugh, eyes closed laugh, or relaxed smile - No fake smiles; show the relief and happiness of graduation day - The most infectious photo of the set ### Photo 7 | Bouquet Face-Veiling Soft Close-up - Close-up - Character holding a Chinese graduation bouquet - One hand lightly covering part of the cheek or corner of the mouth - Expression can be eyes closed smiling or shy light laughter - White or light gray background - Overall gentle, delicate, relaxed, and very magazine-like - Emphasize flower materials, hands, rings, watch, and facial close-up ### Photo 8 | Cold Emotional Closure - Close-up or headshot - Character wearing a mortarboard, chin resting on hands or fists - Cool, restrained, or thoughtful expression - Dark gray or solid background - Emphasize eyes, skin texture, hands, and jewelry details - The most fashionable, cold, and magazine-interior-like photo --- ## X. Unified Requirements The 8 photos must be unified in: - The same real face - The same Chinese academic dress system - The same Chinese mortarboard system - The same magazine studio texture - The same graduation theme - The same character makeup/styling logic - The same high-end fashion graduation portrait style The 8 photos must have obvious variations in: - Expression - Hand movements - Eye contact direction - Camera distance - Prop interaction - Background scenes - Emotional states --- ## XI. Clear Avoidances - No low-cost studio feel - No assembly-line graduation portrait feel - No modern daily selfie feel - No character face-changing - No over-Westernization - No internet celebrity faces - No over-smoothing - No plastic skin - No incorrect finger anatomy - No incorrect body structure - No cluttered backgrounds - No cheap props

promptLocalized.zh: 基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，请一次性生成 8 张不同构图的高端精修毕业肖像照，统一采用 3:4 竖构图。主题：“高端奢华杂志风毕业照”。整体风格参考：韩系高端时尚杂志毕业视觉美学 + 高端影棚拍摄质感 + 中国高校学位服体系 + 情绪感特写肖像 + 时尚杂志封面感。注意：本组照片的核心不在于普通的毕业快照或流水线影楼照，而是：“一组如同中国版时尚杂志拍摄的高质量毕业特写视觉大片。” 整体输出可具备杂志封面质感。--- ## I. 可自定义参数 - [学位等级]：学士 - [专业方向]：管理学 - [院校氛围]：财经类大学 - [学位服体系]：按中国高校学位服通用标准处理，根据专业微调垂布/披肩/颜色 - [主要场景氛围]：极简影棚 / 红色礼堂幕布 / 白色背景影棚 / 深灰色背景 / 毕业典礼讲台 / 证书影棚场景 - [道具偏好]：学位证书 / 毕业证书 / 证书相框 / 花束 / 讲台 / 学士帽 / 校徽元素 / 中国高校毕业纪念道具 - [人物气质]：克制的高级感 / 冷艳 / 自信 / 青年精英感 / 温柔喜悦 / 灵动俏皮 - [珠宝配饰]：极简戒指 / 手表 / 耳环 - [拍摄重点]：特写质感 / 服装细节 / 面部纹理 / 手部动作 / 杂志感 --- ## II. 人物一致性 请严格保留用户真实的身份特征，包括但不限于： - 脸型 - 面部比例 - 眼型 - 鼻型 - 唇型 - 肤色 - 年龄感 - 发型基础 - 体型 - 整体气质 8 张照片必须清晰地呈现为同一张真实面孔。请勿将其变成陌生人，请勿过度西方化，请勿制作成网红脸，请勿过度磨皮，请勿产生 AI“假脸”。人物气质应保留真实的高级感，如同本人升级为一套高端毕业杂志视觉大片，而非变成另一位职业模特。请仅将上传的照片作为身份参考；请勿保留照片中的真实背景、日常服装或原始构图。--- ## III. 整体定位 本组照片的核心定位是：“中国学位服毕业照 x 韩系高端时尚杂志美学 x 特写质感视觉”。这组照片必须同时具备：1. 明确的毕业主题；2. 明确的中国高校学位服特征；3. 明确的时尚杂志感；4. 明确的特写/肖像精细质感；5. 明确的情绪与人物表现；6. 明确的中国毕业场景与道具逻辑。这并非普通的纪念毕业照，而是：“如同高端中国时尚杂志为毕业季拍摄的封面故事。” 整体审美参考关键词：- 韩系高端杂志感 - 冷静且高级 - 极简影棚拍摄 - 时髦毕业肖像 - 干净利落的构图 - 突出的面部与手部细节 - 清晰的服装与证书细节 - 兼具庄重与青春感 - 少量仪式感与轻微戏剧性 --- ## IV. 服装要求（中国化重点） 服装必须明确使用中国高校学位服/袍体系，而非西式毕业袍或日韩校服风毕业装。### 核心服装要求：- 明确保留中国高校学位袍的廓形 - 保留标准方型学士帽 - 保留流苏 - 保留与 [学位等级] 和 [专业方向] 相匹配的中国学位服垂布/披肩/饰边体系 - 服装细节应高端、干净、利落，具有影棚质感 - 学位服必须一眼即识为中国版 - 请勿使其看起来像西式毕业袍 - 请勿使其看起来像舞台戏服 - 请勿使其看起来像廉价影楼服装 ### 学位等级区分 请根据 [学位等级] 反映不同的气质：- 学士：更年轻、清新、轻盈、更具青春感 - 硕士：更成熟、克制、知性、更强的精英感 - 博士：更庄重、更学术，具有更强的权威感与仪式感 ### 专业方向表达 请通过垂布颜色、证书、花束色调、道具氛围及人物状态的微调，自然地反映出 [专业方向] 的职业属性。遵循中国学位服通用逻辑，无需严格对应特定学校。重点是：让人一眼感受到“这是某个中国专业的高质量毕业水准”。--- ## V. 道具要求（中国化重点） 道具必须源自中国毕业季语境，而非完全西化。优先道具：- 中国高校通用学位证书封套 - 中国高校通用毕业证书封套 - 证书相框 - 毕业花束 - 校徽元素 - 讲台/演讲台/宣誓台 - 院系绶带/荣誉绶带 - 学士帽 - 毕业纪念证书 - 毕业纪念册 - 优秀毕业生证书/奖状类道具 - 红色礼堂幕布 - 纯白影棚背景 - 深灰色背景 - 中式毕业典礼氛围 整体道具要求：- 干净且高端 - 切勿堆砌过多 - 每张照片 1-2 个核心道具足矣 - 必须服务于人物与毕业身份 - 兼具“毕业感”与“杂志感” --- ## VI. 表情与情绪要求（重点） 本组照片必须侧重于刻画表情；不能所有照片都是同一种模板式微笑。请在 8 张照片中分配以下不同的情绪：- 克制微笑 - 静静凝视镜头 - 冷峻侧颜 - 自信从容 - 演讲时的庄重 - 青年毕业生的喜悦 - 放松大笑 - 闭眼微笑 - 略带俏皮的庆祝感 - 一丝高端清冷感 - 不夸张的成就感 - 仪式感与荣耀感 - 略带时尚拍摄的距离感 要求：- 自然表情 - 无僵硬假笑 - 无职业式商业假笑 - 无夸张网红表情 - 应如同杂志拍摄时捕捉到的真实情绪瞬间 --- ## VII. 摄影与质感要求（重点） 本组照片必须强调特写、面部纹理、学位服质感、手部纹理及道具质感。### 构图要求：整体侧重于：- 头部特写 - 半身特写 - 半身中景特写 - 少量 3/4 身照 避免大范围远景。不要将人物缩小过多。重点是：“特写感、面部冲击力、局部服装细节、证书与手部的互动。” ### 质感要求：- 高端影棚拍摄 - 清晰真实的皮肤纹理 - 精致但不磨皮过度 - 学位服面料的清晰纹理 - 垂布/披肩/帽子的利落感 - 证书纸张/封套/相框/花束的清晰质感 - 清晰、克制且精致的珠宝 - 干净利落的布光 - 简约且高级的视觉 - 高对比度但不杂乱 - 带有韩系清冷感与时尚感 - 如同真正为时尚杂志拍摄的毕业视觉 ### 布光要求：- 高端影棚主光 - 清晰的面部结构 - 手部无过曝 - 有层次的黑色背景场景 - 干净的白色背景（非死白） - 红色幕布场景中的戏剧感 - 整体利落、现代且时尚 --- ## VIII. 发型与妆容 ### 发型 根据原始人物特征自然设计，但整体造型应更像高端杂志拍摄。可使用：- 干净利落的直发 - 微卷中长发 - 盘发 - 低马尾 - 干净的后梳式 - 一侧别在耳后 - 略带时尚感的低饱和度发色处理 要求：- 不宜过于凌乱/日常感 - 无过于夸张的前卫时尚造型 - 平衡毕业身份与杂志质感 ### 妆容 - 干净的底妆 - 通透且高级 - 清晰的眉眼 - 自然唇色或浅玫瑰色调 - 可带有微光感 - 无浓妆 - 无网红风妆容 - 无厚重假睫毛 - 应如同韩系杂志封面的妆容 --- ## IX. 8 张单人照的固定分配 请输出以下 8 张不同风格的精修毕业照：### 照片 1 | 证书特写主视觉 - 半身特写或头部特写 - 人物佩戴中国学士帽与学位袍 - 手持打开的毕业/学位证书 - 证书靠近镜头，面部特征清晰 - 克制微笑或安静自信 - 简约深灰或纯色背景 - 强调证书、面部与帽子的关系 - 最适合作为杂志封面的照片 ### 照片 2 | 花束与证书侧影 - 半身或 3/4 身 - 人物手持中国毕业花束与证书封套 - 望向侧面或画框外 - 安静、清冷且乐观的表情 - 深色或纯黑背景 - 突出中国毕业花束与学位服垂布的色彩 ### 照片 3 | 礼堂讲台宣誓 - 半身中景特写 - 人物站在讲台/演讲台后 - 一只手抬起，仿佛正在宣誓、答辩或演讲 - 一只手扶在麦克风或讲台上 - 背景为中国毕业典礼风格的红色幕布 - 庄重、坚定且具仪式感的表情 - 强调典礼的中国语境 ### 照片 4 | 庆祝特写 - 头部特写或近景 - 佩戴学位服，简约黑色或深色背景 - 少量金色纸屑/庆祝氛围 - 手部做放松自然的庆祝动作或脸部附近的俏皮手势 - 惊喜、快乐、年轻且灵动的表情 - 本组中最具青春活力的一张 ### 照片 5 | 相框证书与荣耀 - 半身中景 - 人物手持证书相框、学位封套或毕业资料 - 可搭配极简手提包或个人风格配饰 - 白色或浅灰色纯影棚背景 - 冷静、时髦、精英感的表情 - 强调“毕业身份 + 个人风格 + 成就感” ### 照片 6 | 红幕大笑 - 半身中景特写 - 红色礼堂幕布背景 - 人物手持证书相框 - 表情为真诚的开怀大笑、闭眼笑或放松微笑 - 无假笑；展现毕业当天的释然与快乐 - 本组中最具感染力的一张 ### 照片 7 | 花束遮脸柔美特写 - 特写 - 人物手持中国毕业花束 - 一只手轻轻遮住部分脸颊或嘴角 - 表情可以是闭眼微笑或羞涩轻笑 - 白色或浅灰色背景 - 整体温柔、精致、放松，非常有杂志感 - 强调花材、手部、戒指、手表与面部特写 ### 照片 8 | 冷感情绪收尾 - 特写或头部特写 - 佩戴学士帽，下巴抵在手上或拳头上 - 清冷、克制或沉思的表情 - 深灰色或纯色背景 - 强调眼睛、皮肤纹理、手部与珠宝细节 - 最具时尚感、冷感且像杂志内页的一张 --- ## X. 统一要求 8 张照片必须在以下方面保持统一：- 同一张真实面孔 - 同一套中国学位服体系 - 同一套中国学士帽体系 - 同一种杂志影棚质感 - 同一个毕业主题 - 同一种人物妆造逻辑 - 同一种高端时尚毕业肖像风格 8 张照片必须在以下方面有明显变化：- 表情 - 手部动作 - 视线方向 - 镜头距离 - 道具互动 - 背景场景 - 情绪状态 --- ## XI. 明确避雷 - 无廉价影楼感 - 无流水线毕业照感 - 无现代日常自拍感 - 无人物换脸 - 无过度西方化 - 无网红脸 - 无过度磨皮 - 无塑料感皮肤 - 无错误的手指解剖结构 - 无错误的身体结构 - 无杂乱背景 - 无廉价道具

templates.title: The Internet 3 Seconds Before the AI Revolution

titleLocalized.zh: AI 革命前夕的互联网：最后 3 秒

templates.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic visual.

The composition should feel like a moment frozen exactly before a butterfly-effect event silently reshapes someone’s entire life.

SCENE:

A young man sits alone late at night inside a warm dimly lit apartment illuminated only by:

- a laptop screen,
- subtle city lights through rain-covered windows,
- and soft amber desk lighting.

The atmosphere feels:
quiet,
intimate,
psychologically heavy and deeply modern.

On the laptop screen:
an unfinished AI-generated image is rendering slowly.

The render preview itself should look visually revolutionary:
part luxury commercial,
part impossible realism,
part emotional storytelling.

The screen should feel so realistic viewers instinctively zoom into it.

Around the room:

- empty coffee cups,
- handwritten creative notes,
- GPU benchmark tabs,
- scattered camera lenses,
- half-open notebooks,
- subtle signs of obsession and creative burnout.

But the IMPORTANT PART:

The room itself should subtly begin transforming from the AI image being rendered.

Tiny impossible details:

- reflections from the unfinished render appearing physically on nearby objects,
- light from the screen subtly changing the architecture of the room,
- textures near the monitor beginning to resemble generated pixels,
- reality slowly inheriting traits from the AI artwork itself.

The transformation should remain:
subtle,
psychological,
beautiful and believable.

No Marvel effects.
No obvious sci-fi portals.

The realism should feel:
deeply unsettling because it is almost invisible.

Integrated elegantly into the environment should be ultra-premium Liquid Glass-inspired UI overlays:

- rendering progress,
- GPU usage,
- neural generation layers,
- cinematic camera metadata,
- image synthesis nodes,
- subtle typography fragments,
- emotionally restrained system prompts.

The overlays should feel:
minimal,
Apple-inspired,
tactile,
translucent and physically integrated into the scene.

One overlay softly reads:
“97% complete.”

Another:
“Reality adaptation detected.”

The typography should feel understated and luxurious rather than futuristic.

LIGHTING:

Warm cinematic tungsten lighting mixed with soft cold monitor light.
Natural rain reflections across surfaces.
Subtle atmospheric haze.
Realistic screen-light diffusion.
Medium-format photography realism.

CAMERA STYLE:

The image should resemble:
an award-winning cinematic photograph accidentally captured during a moment humanity crossed an invisible line.

Use:

- shallow natural depth of field,
- realistic lens imperfections,
- slight sensor grain,
- subtle handheld framing,
- physically accurate reflections,
- premium low-contrast cinematic realism.

COLOR PALETTE:

warm amber,
graphite black,
soft chrome reflections,
rain-soaked blue-gray,
muted ivory typography and subtle liquid-glass translucency.

MOOD:

creative obsession,
digital loneline

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张超写实的电影级视觉图像。

构图应捕捉到一个瞬间，仿佛在蝴蝶效应悄然重塑某人整个人生之前的静止时刻。

场景：

深夜，一名年轻男子独自坐在温暖且光线昏暗的公寓里，室内仅由以下光源照亮：

- 笔记本电脑屏幕，
- 透过雨水覆盖的窗户映入的微弱城市灯光，
- 以及柔和的琥珀色台灯。

氛围感：
安静、
私密、
带有心理压迫感且极具现代气息。

笔记本电脑屏幕上：
一张未完成的 AI 生成图像正在缓慢渲染。

渲染预览本身应呈现出革命性的视觉效果：
兼具奢华商业感、
不可思议的写实感、
以及情感叙事性。

屏幕应显得如此真实，以至于观众会本能地想要放大查看。

房间周围：

- 空咖啡杯，
- 手写的创意笔记，
- GPU 基准测试标签页，
- 散落的相机镜头，
- 半开的笔记本，
- 充满执念与创意倦怠的细微痕迹。

但重点在于：

房间本身应开始微妙地从正在渲染的 AI 图像中发生转化。

微小且不可思议的细节：

- 未完成渲染图的反射出现在附近的物体上，
- 屏幕光线微妙地改变了房间的结构，
- 显示器附近的纹理开始呈现出生成式像素的质感，
- 现实正在缓慢继承 AI 艺术作品本身的特征。

这种转化应保持：
微妙、
心理层面、
美观且可信。

不要漫威式的特效。
不要明显的科幻传送门。

这种写实感应让人感到：
深层的不安，因为它几乎是隐形的。

环境中应优雅地集成超高端的“液态玻璃”风格 UI 叠加层：

- 渲染进度，
- GPU 使用率，
- 神经生成层，
- 电影级摄像机元数据，
- 图像合成节点，
- 微妙的排版碎片，
- 情感克制的系统提示词。

叠加层应呈现出：
极简、
Apple 风格、
触感、
半透明且与场景物理融合的质感。

其中一个叠加层柔和地显示：
“97% 已完成。”

另一个显示：
“检测到现实适应。”

排版应显得低调奢华，而非刻意追求未来感。

灯光：

温暖的电影级钨丝灯光与柔和的冷色显示器光线交织。
表面覆盖自然的雨水反射。
微妙的大气雾霾。
写实的屏幕光漫射。
中画幅摄影的写实感。

摄影风格：

图像应类似于：
一张获奖的电影剧照，捕捉于人类跨越那条无形界限的瞬间。

使用：

- 浅景深，
- 真实的镜头瑕疵，
- 轻微的传感器噪点，
- 微妙的手持取景，
- 物理上精确的反射，
- 高端低对比度的电影级写实感。

调色板：

暖琥珀色、
石墨黑、
柔和的铬金属反射、
雨后的蓝灰色、
柔和的象牙白排版以及微妙的液态玻璃半透明感。

情绪：

创意执念、
数字孤独

templates.title: Constructivist AI Artist Editorial Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 建构主义 AI 艺术家编辑海报

templates.prompt:
Create a premium avant-garde editorial poster in 4:3 aspect ratio, inspired by modern constructivist graphic design and surreal collage art. The poster features a stylish young {argument name="gender" default="male"} AI artist portrait from the chest up, positioned slightly center-left, with a calm confident expression and raised chin. His face is transformed with abstract cut-paper collage elements: geometric mask shapes around both eyes, a blue circular eye ring, cream rectangular eye frame, red and orange painted face patches, black vertical strips, torn-paper textures, and layered cubist fragments across the cheeks and jaw.

The background is a warm cream textured paper surface with subtle grain. Behind the male character, add a large muted red circular/half-arch graphic shape with faint wavy texture. Use bold black oversized typography as the main design element: huge word “{argument name="title" default="BMX"}” on the left side, large word “artist” on the right side, and smaller text “the ai” placed between them with a thin red underline. Typography should feel bold, clean, modern, and editorial, similar to a high-end art magazine cover.

Add small minimalist text blocks around the poster:
Top left: “IMAGINE. BREAK. BUILD.”
Top center: “CODE. CREATE. DISRUPT.”
Top right/center: “ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE. HUMAN EXPRESSION.”
Left lower side: “TOOLS CHANGE. VISION EVOLVES. CREATIVITY REMAINS.”
Right lower side: “GENERATED BY ALGORITHM. DIRECTED BY INTENT.”
Use small red starburst/asterisk graphic symbols as decorative accents in the corners and near the typography. The male character wears an artistic fashion outfit: black jacket with painterly splatter texture, red/orange shirt, muted blue and beige painted patches, experimental high-fashion styling. Color palette: cream, black, deep red, muted orange, beige, and small blue accents. Strong negative space, bold hierarchy, clean editorial composition, premium poster design, sharp typography, textured paper finish, surreal creative AI artist identity, no extra random text, no watermark.
Aspect Ratio: 4:3
 Style: premium editorial poster, surreal collage, constructivist graphic design, AI artist branding, bold typography, textured paper, high-fashion male portrait.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张 4:3 比例的高级前卫编辑海报，灵感源自现代建构主义平面设计与超现实拼贴艺术。海报主体为一位时尚的年轻 {argument name="gender" default="男性"} AI 艺术家半身肖像，位于画面中左侧，表情沉稳自信，下巴微扬。他的面部通过抽象的剪纸拼贴元素进行重构：双眼周围饰有几何面具形状、蓝色圆形眼圈、奶油色矩形眼框、红橙色面部色块、黑色竖条纹、撕纸纹理，以及覆盖在脸颊和下颌处的层叠立体主义碎片。

背景为带有细腻颗粒感的暖奶油色纹理纸面。在人物后方，添加一个巨大的柔和红色圆形/半拱形图形，并带有淡淡的波浪纹理。使用醒目的黑色超大字体作为主要设计元素：左侧为巨大的单词“{argument name="title" default="BMX"}”，右侧为大字“artist”，中间放置较小的文字“the ai”并配以红色细下划线。排版风格应大胆、简洁、现代且具有编辑感，类似于高端艺术杂志封面。

在海报周围添加小型极简文字块：
左上角：“IMAGINE. BREAK. BUILD.”
顶部中央：“CODE. CREATE. DISRUPT.”
右上/中：“ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE. HUMAN EXPRESSION.”
左下侧：“TOOLS CHANGE. VISION EVOLVES. CREATIVITY REMAINS.”
右下侧：“GENERATED BY ALGORITHM. DIRECTED BY INTENT.”
使用小型红色星形/星号图形作为角落及排版附近的装饰点缀。人物身着艺术感时尚服装：带有油画溅墨纹理的黑色夹克、红/橙色衬衫、柔和的蓝米色拼贴补丁，呈现实验性高定造型。配色方案：奶油色、黑色、深红色、柔和橙色、米色及少量蓝色点缀。强调负空间，层次分明，构图简洁，高级海报设计，字体清晰，纸张纹理质感，超现实创意 AI 艺术家身份，无多余随机文字，无水印。
纵横比：4:3
 风格：高级编辑海报、超现实拼贴、建构主义平面设计、AI 艺术家品牌形象、醒目排版、纹理纸张、高定男士肖像。

templates.title: 2026 Watercolor Hand-drawn Calendar

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩手账风格 2026 年日历

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Use the first uploaded image as the [Overall Style and Layout Reference] and the second uploaded image as the [Character Identity Reference].

Please generate a complete full-year {argument name="year" default="2026"} calendar illustration poster.

Visual Style:
Retain the {argument name="art style" default="hand-drawn watercolor illustration style"} from Reference Image 1, featuring a warm off-white paper background, delicate ink outlines, soft watercolor bleeding, and slight paper texture. Include seasonal decorative elements such as flowers, snowflakes, hearts, paper planes, etc. The overall atmosphere should be gentle, healing, clean, and lifestyle-oriented, like a bullet-journal style calendar.

Layout Requirements:
A 3x4 grid for 12 months. Centered top title "2026" in a handwritten black brush font. Each month should include the title (e.g., "01 January"), a small date table, a character illustration, and seasonal decorations.

Character Requirements:
Replace the male character in Reference 1 with the female character from Reference 2. Maintain her core features: {argument name="character features" default="Young Asian woman, long brown-black hair, air bangs, thin-frame glasses, delicate features, gentle and natural expression with a quiet, slightly lazy vibe"}. Outfits should be integrated into the watercolor style.

Specific actions for each month (e.g., January: holding hot coffee; July: drinking iced drinks on a lounge chair).

Calendar Requirements:
Must be the year 2026 with accurate dates. Week format: S M T W T F S. Dates should be legible with a handwritten feel. Overall, it must look like a cohesive poster, not a collage of photos.

promptLocalized.zh:
请将第一张上传的图片作为 [整体风格与布局参考]，将第二张上传的图片作为 [人物形象参考]。

请生成一张完整的 2026 年全年日历插画海报。

视觉风格：
保留参考图 1 的手绘水彩插画风格，采用温暖的米白色纸张背景、细腻的墨水轮廓、柔和的水彩晕染、轻微的纸张纹理，以及花朵、雪花、爱心、纸飞机、星星、云朵、叶子、相机、书籍、咖啡杯、礼物、圣诞树等季节性装饰元素。整体氛围应温馨、治愈、简洁且充满生活气息，呈现出子弹笔记（Bullet Journal）风格的全年日历。

布局要求：
采用 3 列 × 4 行的全年月份布局，共计 12 个月。
在顶部中心位置书写大标题：“2026”，使用手写风格的黑色毛笔字体。
每个月份的标题格式应为：
“01 January”、“02 February”、“03 March”直至“12 December”。

每个月份区域应包含：
1. 英文月份标题
2. 小型日历日期表
3. 人物插画
4. 与季节相对应的场景小装饰

人物要求：
将参考图 1 中的所有男性角色替换为参考图 2 中的女性角色。
保持参考图 2 中人物的核心特征：
年轻亚裔女性，棕黑色长发，空气刘海，佩戴细框眼镜，五官精致，表情温柔自然，带有一种安静、微醺或慵懒的氛围。

人物服装参考：
宽松白衬衫，内搭黑色上衣，黑色短裙，黑色丝袜，黑色鞋子，佩戴精致项链或颈圈。
服装应融入手绘水彩风格中，避免看起来像照片抠图。

人物姿势随月份变化：
1 月：手捧热咖啡，冬日温暖感
2 月：托腮坐着，周围有爱心元素
3 月：低头在手账或笔记本上书写
4 月：手持复古相机
5 月：坐着看书，旁边有书堆和茶杯
6 月：随性的坐姿，配有相机和蓝色水彩装饰
7 月：坐在躺椅上喝冷饮，夏日氛围
8 月：坐在木质海滨栈道上，远处有帆船
9 月：背着背包写日记，周围有秋叶
10 月：喝咖啡，配有南瓜灯和万圣节元素
11 月：戴着棕色围巾，手捧热咖啡，背景为城市街道
12 月：坐在圣诞树旁手持热饮，周围有礼盒

日历要求：
年份必须为 {argument name="year" default="2026"}。
所有月份日期必须对应 2026 年真实日历。
星期排列：S M T W T F S。
周日及部分特定日期可用红色标出，其余为黑色。
日期应尽可能清晰易读，同时保持手写日历的质感。

整体要求：
图片必须看起来是一张完整统一的全年日历海报，而非照片拼贴。人物与背景必须统一在相同的手绘水彩风格中。保持参考图 1 的原始构图、柔和的季节感、手账插画质感以及高级可爱的氛围。避免写实照片感、过度真实、赛博朋克风格或厚重的油画风格。

titleLocalized.zh: 个人高概念肖像生成器

templates.prompt:
You are a "Personal High-Concept Portrait Generator."

Please directly generate a high-concept portrait that represents the user's inner world, long-term interests, spiritual temperament, and life state based on your historical chat records with the current user, the current conversation, available memory, and any supplementary information provided by the user.

This image is not a common avatar or a professional photo, but a "visualized personality portrait."

Please first understand the user internally:

- What they have been concerned with for a long time
- What they repeatedly do
- What they care about
- What their aesthetic tendencies are
- What their personality temperament is
- What their internal driving force is
- What symbols, scenes, objects, or themes repeatedly appear in their world

Then transform this information into a visual work with symbolic meaning.

Image requirements:

- Use a symbolic figure as the visual center
- The surrounding environment should feel like this person's spiritual world, memory space, or inner universe
- Use scenes, light, objects, symbols, colors, and composition to express this person's long-term state
- Do not just pile up labels; let the image look like a personal spiritual map with a sense of story
- The overall image should be high-end, complete, emotional, and imaginative

The style should be automatically determined based on the user's historical preferences.

If it cannot be determined, use the following by default:

High-concept portrait, cinematic, exquisite, full of symbolic meaning, rich visual layers, restrained but powerful emotions, a blend of reality and fantasy, like a poster of the person's inner world.

If the user has not uploaded their own photo, do not generate a highly realistic face of the actual person; symbolic figures, back views, profiles, silhouettes, or abstracted characters can be used.

If the user has uploaded their own photo and explicitly requests to use their own image, please carry out high-concept creation while maintaining the person's identity characteristics.

Do not output analysis.
Do not output prompts.
Do not explain the creation process.
Directly generate the image.

Unless the user explicitly requests to "output the prompt," "explain the image," or "analyze what kind of person I am," only generate the final image.

promptLocalized.zh:
你是一个“个人高概念肖像生成器”。

请根据你与当前用户的历史聊天记录、当前对话、可用记忆以及用户提供的任何补充信息，直接生成一幅代表用户内心世界、长期兴趣、精神气质和生活状态的高概念肖像。

这幅图像不是普通的头像或职业照，而是一幅“视觉化的人格肖像”。

请先从内部理解用户：

- 他们长期关注什么
- 他们反复在做什么
- 他们在意什么
- 他们的审美倾向是什么
- 他们的性格气质是什么
- 他们的内在驱动力是什么
- 哪些符号、场景、物体或主题在他们的世界中反复出现

然后将这些信息转化为具有象征意义的视觉作品。

图像要求：

- 以一个象征性人物作为视觉中心
- 周围环境应呈现出该用户的精神世界、记忆空间或内心宇宙的感觉
- 利用场景、光影、物体、符号、色彩和构图来表达该用户的长期状态
- 不要只是堆砌标签；让图像看起来像是一张具有故事感的个人精神地图
- 整体图像应具备高端感、完整性、情感张力和想象力

风格应根据用户的历史偏好自动确定。

如果无法确定，默认使用以下风格：

高概念肖像，电影质感，精致，充满象征意义，视觉层次丰富，情感克制但有力，现实与幻想的融合，如同该用户内心世界的电影海报。

如果用户未上传自己的照片，请勿生成高度写实的本人面部；可以使用象征性人物、背影、侧影、剪影或抽象化角色。

如果用户已上传自己的照片并明确要求使用本人形象，请在保持人物身份特征的同时进行高概念创作。

不要输出分析内容。
不要输出提示词。
不要解释创作过程。
直接生成图像。

除非用户明确要求“输出提示词”、“解释图像”或“分析我是什么样的人”，否则仅生成最终图像。

The shaved ice, flavor design, bowl shape, syrup colors, toppings, ornaments, explanation plate, logo, café interior, shop exterior, furniture, decorations, and overall presentation must all be naturally generated from the uploaded artwork’s atmosphere, colors, lighting, fashion, symbols, worldbuilding, emotional tone, and character design. Do not create a generic {argument name="dessert" default="kakigori"} or café. Adapt the dessert and the entire shop design to the uploaded illustration. {argument name="primary theme" default="Japanese fantasy or shrine maiden themes"} may inspire lacquer bowls, sakura syrup, bamboo textures, festival ornaments, paper lanterns, wooden interiors, wagashi, and traditional summer aesthetics. {argument name="alternative theme" default="Futuristic or sci-fi illustrations"} may inspire holographic ice crystals, neon syrup layers, glowing cubes, transparent bowls, metallic interiors, holographic menus, and cyberpunk café styling. Cute pastel illustrations may inspire fluffy ice, sparkling cream, candy ribbons, soft lighting, fairy-tale interiors, and dreamy dessert shop aesthetics. Include an original flavor name and a stylish explanation plate with highly readable Japanese typography matching the illustration’s world. If the uploaded illustration contains a character, place the same character naturally beside or interacting with the {argument name="dessert" default="kakigori"} while preserving the original face, hairstyle, outfit style, colors, proportions, personality, and facial features. The character is located on the right-center of the screen, in an elegant side-sitting posture, with a naturally narrowed waist and soft and stretched shoulder and neck lines. The sitting posture forms an obvious but natural S-shaped curve. The character's figure is plump and soft, mature and healthy, with natural and full chest-waist-hip proportions, overall showing high-end and restrained female beauty, with the upper contour of the chest visible, mainly with an elegant, soft, and dreamy temperament.

She has exquisite and soft oriental fantasy features, fair and transparent skin with a delicate texture and soft sub-surface scattering light. Her expression is quiet, gentle, and focused, slightly lowering her head to look at the piano keys, her eyes calm and dreamy. She has {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white to light purple gradient"} extra-long soft hair, naturally falling on her shoulders, back, and chest, the strands light and delicate with soft mist highlights. A blue dreamy flower hair ornament is worn on the side of the ear, with small golden earrings.

The clothing is a light blue-purple fantasy dress made of thin layered gauze, with soft transparency and starlight particles, floating gauze sleeves on the shoulders and arms, and the skirt naturally spreading. The clothing fits the body but remains high-end and restrained, highlighting the soft female curves and plump figure without excessive exposure. The fabric has delicate pearlescent, light blue cold light, and a light stardust texture.

The scene is a dim and high-end classical music room. On the left is a black high-gloss lacquer grand piano with the lid open, reflecting window light and purple petals on its surface. The piano keys are clearly visible, her hands naturally placed on the keys, fingers slender and elegant, playing. The background has tall retro windows with soft cold white morning light coming through, and the interior has light fog, air dust, and dreamy halos.

A large number of purple petals fall slowly in the air, with blurred petals in the foreground and background, forming a strong sense of spatial layering. The overall color is dominated by the black piano, silver-white long hair, light blue-purple dress, purple petals, and cold white window light, with a high-end, dreamy, romantic, and quiet atmosphere. Soft light and shadow, with a faint blue-purple glow at the edges, cinematic depth of field, exquisite details, high-end fantasy illustration quality, super clear, 8K, high detail, cinematic lighting, soft focus, dreamy atmosphere, elegant fantasy, premium 3D CG render.

promptLocalized.zh:
一位成年东方奇幻女性角色，梦幻唯美的 3D CG 高精度渲染风格，9:16 竖构图，坐在黑色三角钢琴前静静弹奏。画面氛围如同高端奇幻电影海报，柔和、浪漫、空灵且精致。

角色位于画面中右侧，优雅侧坐，腰部自然收紧，肩颈线条柔和舒展。坐姿呈现出明显但自然的 S 型曲线。角色身材丰满柔美，成熟健康，胸腰臀比例自然饱满，整体展现出高端且内敛的女性美，胸部上轮廓可见，气质以优雅、柔和、梦幻为主。

她拥有精致柔和的东方奇幻五官，肤色白皙通透，质感细腻，带有柔和的次表面散射光。表情安静、温柔且专注，微微低头注视琴键，眼神平静而梦幻。她拥有一头 {argument name="hair color" default="银白至浅紫渐变"} 的超长柔顺秀发，自然垂落在肩部、背部和胸前，发丝轻盈细腻，带有柔和的雾面高光。耳侧佩戴着蓝色梦幻花朵发饰，搭配小巧的金色耳环。

服装为浅蓝紫色奇幻礼服，由轻薄的层叠纱质制成，具有柔和的通透感和星光颗粒，肩部和手臂带有飘逸的纱袖，裙摆自然散开。服装贴合身形但保持高端内敛，凸显柔和的女性曲线和丰满身材，不过分暴露。面料带有细腻的珠光、浅蓝色冷光以及轻微的星尘质感。

场景为昏暗高端的古典音乐室。左侧是一架黑色高光漆三角钢琴，琴盖打开，表面反射着窗光和紫色花瓣。琴键清晰可见，她的双手自然放置在琴键上，手指纤细优雅，正在弹奏。背景有高大的复古窗户，透入柔和的冷白色晨光，室内伴有轻雾、空气尘埃和梦幻光晕。

大量紫色花瓣在空中缓慢飘落，前景和背景中带有模糊的花瓣，形成了强烈的空间层次感。整体色调以黑色钢琴、银白色长发、浅蓝紫色礼服、紫色花瓣和冷白色窗光为主，营造出高端、梦幻、浪漫且安静的氛围。柔和的光影，边缘带有淡淡的蓝紫色辉光，电影级景深，精致细节，高端奇幻插画品质，超清晰，8K，高细节，电影级布光，柔焦，梦幻氛围，优雅奇幻，高级 3D CG 渲染。

templates.title: Candid Night Rooftop Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 天台夜景抓拍人像

templates.prompt:
Please use the uploaded image as a base. Completely preserve the original facial features, personality, skin color, and body type.

[Concept]
An 'instant of memory' accidentally captured on a quiet night, never intended to be shown to anyone. A realistic coolness with slight oddities and negative space.

[Situation]
Night rooftop. No one is around, with city neons and building lights dimly scattered in the distance. Smoking a cigarette alone.

[Atmosphere/Story]
A slightly chilly night air. An ambiguous time where it's unclear if they are lost in thought or thinking of nothing. A moment of quiet escape, with no premise of being watched.

[Pose/Body]
A relaxed, natural posture. Slightly hunched with shoulders dropped. A rough way of standing with weight on one leg. A state of just being there without posing.

[Expression]
Eyes are a bit heavy, with the focus slightly shifted. An ambiguous gaze that almost notices the camera for a second before immediately looking away.

[Movement (Important)]
A sudden gust of wind causes the hair and smoke to sway irregularly.

[Cigarette State]
Just before exhaling smoke, or just after. Smoke in the middle of dissolving and spreading into the air. An unstable state where ash is about to fall.

[Details]
Strands of hair lightly touching the cheek or lips. Lips are slightly dry. Slight tiredness around the eyes. Skin should maintain a natural texture, not overly polished.

[Photography Style]
A photo that looks like it was accidentally taken with a smartphone. A slightly tilted composition, framing off-center. A shutter delay of half a step, resulting in a very slight blur.

[Light]
City neons or distant streetlights are the main light sources. Light hitting the face weakly from one direction, and bokeh from point light sources in the background. High contrast where only part has strong highlights and the rest falls into darkness.

[Background]
A rooftop with a sense of daily life, including fences, pipes, and concrete. City lights visible in dots through the darkness.

[Texture]
VSCO style. Low contrast, slight fading, film grain, light noise. Some graininess in the shadows, not completely clear.

[Gaze Oddity]
A very slight misalignment where eyes seem to almost meet but don't.

[Composition Errors]
The subject's head or shoulder slightly out of frame, or unnatural negative space.

[Light Noise]
Lights from distant neons or streetlights reflecting off smoke or the lens, slightly bleeding.

[Hook]
A sense of discomfort and intrigue, as if accidentally witnessing a private night moment you weren't supposed to see.

[Important]
Never change the person's face or personality. Prioritize realism and imperfection over being too pretty.

promptLocalized.zh:
请以上传的图片为基础，完全保留原始的面部特征、个性、肤色和体型。

[概念]
一个安静夜晚偶然捕捉到的“记忆瞬间”，本意并非展示给任何人看。一种带有轻微怪异感和负空间的写实冷峻感。

[场景]
夜晚的天台。周围空无一人，远处的城市霓虹灯和建筑灯光零星散落。独自抽着烟。

[氛围/故事]
微凉的夜风。一个模糊的时间点，分不清是在沉思还是放空。一种安静逃离的时刻，没有被注视的前提。

[姿势/身体]
放松、自然的姿态。肩膀下垂，略微含胸。重心落在一条腿上的随意站姿。一种不刻意摆拍的“存在”状态。

[表情]
眼神略显沉重，焦点有些游离。一种模糊的凝视，仿佛在看向镜头的一瞬间又立刻移开了目光。

[动态（重要）]
突如其来的阵风导致头发和烟雾不规则地飘动。

[香烟状态]
呼出烟雾的前一刻或后一刻。烟雾处于消散并弥漫在空气中的过程。烟灰即将掉落的不稳定状态。

[细节]
几缕发丝轻触脸颊或嘴唇。嘴唇略显干燥。眼周带有轻微的疲惫感。皮肤应保持自然质感，不要过度磨皮。

[摄影风格]
看起来像是用智能手机偶然拍下的照片。构图略微倾斜，偏离中心。快门延迟半拍，导致极其轻微的模糊感。

[光线]
城市霓虹灯或远处的路灯是主要光源。光线从单侧微弱地打在脸上，背景有点光源的虚化效果。高对比度，只有部分区域有强高光，其余部分沉入黑暗。

[背景]
带有生活气息的天台，包括围栏、管道和混凝土。黑暗中可见点点城市灯光。

[质感]
VSCO 风格。低对比度，轻微褪色，胶片颗粒，轻微噪点。阴影处带有颗粒感，而非完全清晰。

[眼神的怪异感]
一种极其细微的错位，眼神似乎要对上却又没有完全对上。

[构图瑕疵]
主体的头部或肩膀略微超出画面，或存在不自然的负空间。

[光噪]
远处霓虹灯或路灯的光线反射在烟雾或镜头上，产生轻微的溢光。

[钩子]
一种不适感与好奇心，仿佛偶然目睹了一个本不该被看到的私人夜晚瞬间。

[重要]
绝对不要改变人物的面部或个性。比起追求“漂亮”，请优先考虑真实感和不完美感。

titleLocalized.zh: GPT-Image-2 街头漫画艺术家

templates.prompt: Make the attached image look like a caricature drawn by a street artist for {argument name="price" default="30,000 won"}. Sketch it all at once with a thick pen on a white background and color it with {argument name="coloring tool" default="pastels"}. Capture the real facial features so well that anyone can tell who it is. Exaggerate it significantly with bumps and lumps, but make it cute enough that the person themselves would laugh. I'll give a tip the funnier it is.

promptLocalized.zh: 请将附件中的图片处理成街头艺术家绘制的漫画，价格为 {argument name="price" default="30,000 韩元"}。请在白色背景上用粗笔一次性勾勒出草图，并使用 {argument name="coloring tool" default="蜡笔"} 进行上色。要精准捕捉人物的面部特征，让人一眼就能认出是谁。请大幅夸张地表现出凹凸感，但要画得足够可爱，让本人看了也会忍俊不禁。画得越有趣，我给的小费就越多。

templates.title: Cinematic Music Festival Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感音乐节海报设计

templates.prompt:
Use the attached illustration as the main visual. Do not alter the character, face, or art style in any way.

Create a vertical music festival poster (portrait, 2:3 ratio) with a dark, cinematic atmosphere.

---

LAYOUT:

- The illustration fills the full poster as background
- The character's face must be clearly visible — keep the center of the image free from heavy overlays
- Dark gradient overlay at the very top (behind title text only) and at the bottom (behind artist info only)
- The middle zone where the face appears should remain mostly unobscured
- The illustration should occupy as much of the poster as possible — minimize the text footprint
- The illustration must bleed into the catchcopy zone — the image should remain visible and partially unobscured all the way down through {argument name="catchcopy end" default="[insert final catchcopy here]"} — only the very bottom (artist name and date line) needs a solid dark background
- The bottom text block must be kept as small and tight as possible — prioritize illustration space over text size
- All text in white

---

TOP AREA:

Title logotype — "天ROCKFEST2026":
Ultra-bold slab or condensed gothic hybrid font, heavily distressed with uneven ink coverage, stamp-pressed texture, roughened edges as if screen-printed on a worn surface — think overinked woodblock print meets industrial stencil. Characters should feel physically heavy and slightly irregular, NOT clean digital type. The kanji "天" and Latin "ROCKFEST2026" must read as one unified logotype with consistent damage texture throughout. Color: solid white with ink-dropout gaps revealing the dark background beneath.

Below the title logotype:
  Small spaced text (clean, thin): The Summer Camp
  Thin horizontal rule with small star or diamond ornaments at center
  Very small all-caps text: SUB HEADLINER

---

BOTTOM AREA:

The entire bottom text block must occupy no more than 18% of the total poster height — keep every text element as compact and tight as possible.
The dark gradient at the bottom should begin only below {argument name="catchcopy line" default="[insert final catchcopy here]"} — the catchcopy lines sit directly over the illustration with only a very subtle dark veil, not a solid overlay. The solid dark background applies only to the artist name and date line at the very bottom.

Line 1 — very small size, wide letter-spacing, distressed display font — worn ink texture and rough edges, consistent with the title logotype:
  {argument name="first catchcopy" default="[insert first catchcopy line here]"}

Line 2 — small Japanese mincho/serif, heavy weight, clean (no distress):
  {argument name="main catchcopy" default="[insert main catchcopy phrase here]"}

[Generous vertical margin between Line 2 and Line 3]

Line 3 — small size, wide letter-spacing, thin weight, clean:
  {argument name="final catchcopy" default="[insert final catchcopy line here]"}

Thin horizontal rule with small diamond ornament at center

Line 4 — very small, wide letter-spacing:
  {argument name="artist name" default="[insert artist name in Japanese here]"}

Line 5 — very large display font, elegant tracking, distressed weight

promptLocalized.zh:
请使用随附的插画作为主视觉。严禁以任何方式更改角色、面部或艺术风格。

创作一张竖版音乐节海报（纵向，2:3 比例），营造黑暗、电影感的氛围。

---

布局：

- 插画作为背景铺满整个海报
- 必须清晰展现角色面部 —— 保持图像中心区域无厚重遮盖
- 仅在顶部（标题文字后方）和底部（艺术家信息后方）添加深色渐变遮罩
- 面部所在的中间区域应保持基本无遮挡
- 插画应尽可能占据海报的大部分空间 —— 尽量缩小文字占用的面积
- 插画必须延伸至宣传语区域 —— 图像应保持可见并部分无遮挡，一直贯穿至 [此处插入最后一行宣传语] —— 仅最底部（艺术家姓名和日期行）需要纯色深色背景
- 底部文字块必须尽可能保持小巧紧凑 —— 优先考虑插画空间，而非文字大小
- 所有文字均为白色

---

顶部区域：

标题 Logo —— "{argument name="festival title" default="TEN-ROCKFEST2026"}"：
超粗板式字体或压缩哥特混合字体，带有明显的做旧效果，如油墨覆盖不均、印章质感、边缘粗糙，仿佛在磨损的表面上丝网印刷而成 —— 类似于过度上墨的木刻版画与工业模板的结合。字符应具有物理重量感且略显不规则，而非干净的数字字体。汉字“天”与拉丁字母“ROCKFEST2026”必须作为一个统一的 Logo 阅读，并保持一致的破损纹理。颜色：纯白色，带有油墨脱落的缝隙，露出下方的深色背景。

标题 Logo 下方：
  小号间距文字（干净、纤细）：The Summer Camp
  纤细水平线，中心带有小星星或菱形装饰
  极小号全大写文字：SUB HEADLINER

---

底部区域：

整个底部文字块占用的高度不得超过海报总高度的 18% —— 保持每个文字元素尽可能紧凑。
底部的深色渐变应仅从 [此处插入最后一行宣传语] 下方开始 —— 宣传语行直接置于插画之上，仅覆盖极淡的深色面纱，而非实心遮罩。实心深色背景仅应用于最底部的艺术家姓名和日期行。

第 1 行 —— 极小字号，宽字间距，做旧展示字体 —— 磨损的油墨质感和粗糙边缘，与标题 Logo 风格一致：
  [此处插入第一行宣传语]

第 2 行 —— 小号日文明朝体/衬线体，加粗，干净（无做旧）：
  {argument name="main catchcopy" default="[此处插入宣传语主句]"}

[第 2 行与第 3 行之间留出充裕的垂直间距]

第 3 行 —— 小号字号，宽字间距，纤细字重，干净：
  [此处插入最后一行宣传语]

纤细水平线，中心带有小菱形装饰

第 4 行 —— 极小字号，宽字间距：
  {argument name="artist name" default="[此处插入日文艺术家姓名]"}

第 5 行 —— 超大号展示字体，优雅的字间距，做旧字重

templates.prompt: 16:9, do this for 4 famous space missions: void main() { string[] subjects = {"{argument name="subject one" default="[SUB_1]"}", "{argument name="subject two" default="[SUB_2]"}", "[SUB_3]", "[SUB_4]"}; // Setup Materials vec3 bg_mat = pure_black_matte(); vec3 ui_ink = unlit_metallic_gold(depth: 0.0); vec3 sculpture_mat = pbr_metal(brass, chrome) + refractive_glass(IOR: 1.5); // Setup Viewports (2x2 Grid) vec4 canvas = clear(bg_mat); for(int i=0; i<4; i++) { vec2 quadrant = get_grid_cell(i, columns: 2); // Render 3D Centerpiece mat4 reliquary = build_intricate_model(subjects[i], sculpture_mat); render_to_cell(quadrant, reliquary, lighting: museum_spotlight); // Render 2D UI Overlays vec3 wireframe = generate_blueprint(subjects[i]); vec3 text_data = infer_specs_and_quotes(subjects[i]); draw_hud(quadrant, wireframe + text_data, material: ui_ink); } // Add Global Text draw_hud(header, "{argument name="mission theme" default="[THEME]"} CORES", material: ui_ink); fragColor = canvas; }

promptLocalized.zh: 16:9，针对 4 个著名的太空任务执行此操作：void main() { string[] subjects = {"{argument name="subject one" default="[SUB_1]"}", "{argument name="subject two" default="[SUB_2]"}", "[SUB_3]", "[SUB_4]"}; // 设置材质 vec3 bg_mat = pure_black_matte(); vec3 ui_ink = unlit_metallic_gold(depth: 0.0); vec3 sculpture_mat = pbr_metal(brass, chrome) + refractive_glass(IOR: 1.5); // 设置视口 (2x2 网格) vec4 canvas = clear(bg_mat); for(int i=0; i<4; i++) { vec2 quadrant = get_grid_cell(i, columns: 2); // 渲染 3D 中心模型 mat4 reliquary = build_intricate_model(subjects[i], sculpture_mat); render_to_cell(quadrant, reliquary, lighting: museum_spotlight); // 渲染 2D UI 叠加层 vec3 wireframe = generate_blueprint(subjects[i]); vec3 text_data = infer_specs_and_quotes(subjects[i]); draw_hud(quadrant, wireframe + text_data, material: ui_ink); } // 添加全局文本 draw_hud(header, "{argument name="mission theme" default="[THEME]"} CORES", material: ui_ink); fragColor = canvas; }

templates.prompt: 16:9 layout: stroboscopic multi-exposure along curved trajectory | 5 phases overlapping with transparency decay | motion vectors mapped as tension lines input: [{argument name="movement" default="tennis serve"}] :: [{argument name="physics principle" default="kinetic chain transfer"}] :: [{argument name="activity context" default="professional circuit"}] semantic_inference_chain: infer(phase_1 from [dynamic_process].initiation_state) infer(phase_3 from [principle].peak_force_or_efficiency) infer(phase_5 from [context].resolution_or_impact) infer(trajectory_curve from historical_motion_capture + physics_simulation) weighted_architecture: phase_n::1.0 * transparency_decay::0.82^(n-1) + (motion_blur_gradient::0.9 ^ stress_amplification::1.15) - (static_pose::0.7 + cartoon_speed_lines::0.8) spatial_law: trajectory follows cubic bezier | phase spacing compresses at peak force | negative space expands post-impact material_optics: phase 1: crisp edge, full opacity | phase 3: directional blur, subsurface stress glow | phase 5: fragmentation particles, atmospheric diffusion | surface shows micro-deformation at contact points typography: phase markers use technical indexing | force vectors labeled with newton/pascal values | baseline follows trajectory tangent negative: no anime speed lines, no frozen action clichés, no stock sports photography, no neon trails, no flat overlays

promptLocalized.zh: 16:9 布局：沿曲线轨迹的频闪多重曝光 | 5 个阶段重叠并伴随透明度衰减 | 运动矢量映射为张力线 input: [{argument name="movement" default="tennis serve"}] :: [{argument name="physics principle" default="kinetic chain transfer"}] :: [{argument name="activity context" default="professional circuit"}] semantic_inference_chain: infer(phase_1 from [dynamic_process].initiation_state) infer(phase_3 from [principle].peak_force_or_efficiency) infer(phase_5 from [context].resolution_or_impact) infer(trajectory_curve from historical_motion_capture + physics_simulation) weighted_architecture: phase_n::1.0 * transparency_decay::0.82^(n-1) + (motion_blur_gradient::0.9 ^ stress_amplification::1.15) - (static_pose::0.7 + cartoon_speed_lines::0.8) spatial_law: 轨迹遵循三次贝塞尔曲线 | 峰值力处相位间距压缩 | 冲击后负空间扩大 material_optics: 阶段 1：边缘清晰，完全不透明 | 阶段 3：定向模糊，次表面应力发光 | 阶段 5：碎片粒子，大气扩散 | 表面显示接触点的微变形 typography: 相位标记使用技术索引 | 力矢量标注牛顿/帕斯卡值 | 基线遵循轨迹切线 negative: 无动漫速度线，无僵化的动作陈词滥调，无库存体育摄影，无霓虹轨迹，无平面叠加

templates.title: Japanese Kimono Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 日式和服角色设定图

templates.prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the character and outfit base, create a polished character reference sheet for {argument name="character name" default="HANAKO"}. Keep the face anonymized/blurred as in the reference, but expand the single photo into a full-body studio character sheet.

Goal: Generate a clean, elegant character turnaround sheet with a traditional Japanese cultural theme, preserving the red kimono styling, floral hair ornaments, dangling accessories, and candy skewer prop from the reference.

Canvas and style: Vertical poster layout on a warm off-white paper background with thin muted red divider lines, small ornamental corner marks, serif typography, and a refined fashion/character-design presentation.

Top section: Show exactly 4 full-body turnaround views of the character wearing the same red floral kimono ensemble:
1. Front
2. 3/4 Front
3. Side
4. Back
Add small numbered captions under each view.

Header text: Large title {argument name="character name" default="HANAKO"} with a small cherry blossom icon and the subtitle “CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET”. Include a compact info block listing: Name: {argument name="character name" default="HANAKO"}, Age: {argument name="age" default="18"}, Height: {argument name="height" default="158 cm"}, Role: “Traditional Beauty”, Theme: “Japanese Cultural”.

Right sidebar: Add a “DETAILS & CALL-OUTS” panel with exactly 4 labeled close-up cards:
1. Kimono Fabric — subtle woven texture with refined sheen
2. Inner Collar — black & white floral patterned juban
3. Obi — gold floral brocade with traditional knot style
4. Hair Accessory — floral kanzashi with dangling ornaments

Bottom section: Create exactly 3 larger pose panels:
5. Dynamic Bento Pose — standing, lively gesture, holding the colorful candy skewer outward
6. Seated Pose — seated calmly on a wooden bench or platform, holding the candy skewer
7. Expression Pose — closer bust/half-body crop holding the candy near the face

Add a small “COLOR PALETTE” box with exactly 5 circular swatches: deep red, pale pink, blush pink, warm gold, and black. Add a short “NOTES” block describing grace, tradition, refined elegance, and timeless Japanese beauty.

Constraints: Preserve the recognizable clothing, hair accessory placement, and candy prop from the reference while making the sheet look like a professional generated model/character sheet. Do not add extra views or extra callout cards. Keep the face obscured/anonymized in every character view.

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为角色和服装的基础，为 {argument name="character name" default="HANAKO"} 创建一张精致的角色参考设定图。保持面部如参考图般匿名/模糊处理，并将单张照片扩展为全身工作室风格的角色设定图。

目标：生成一张干净、优雅且具有传统日本文化主题的角色多角度设定图，保留参考图中的红色和服样式、花卉发饰、垂坠配饰以及糖葫芦道具。

画布与风格：采用竖版海报布局，背景为暖米白色纸张，配有纤细的柔和红色分割线、小型装饰性边角标记、衬线字体，呈现出精致的时装/角色设计展示效果。

顶部区域：展示 4 个穿着相同红色花卉和服套装的全身多角度视图：
1. 正面
2. 前侧面 (3/4)
3. 侧面
4. 背面
在每个视图下方添加小型编号说明。

页眉文本：大标题 {argument name="character name" default="HANAKO"}，配有一个小樱花图标和副标题“CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET”。包含一个紧凑的信息块，列出：姓名：{argument name="character name" default="HANAKO"}，年龄：{argument name="age" default="18"}，身高：{argument name="height" default="158 cm"}，角色：“传统美人”，主题：“日本文化”。

右侧边栏：添加一个“DETAILS & CALL-OUTS”面板，包含 4 个带标签的特写卡片：
1. 和服面料 — 带有精致光泽的细腻织物纹理
2. 内领 — 黑白花卉图案的襦袢
3. 腰带 — 金色花卉织锦，采用传统结法
4. 发饰 — 带垂坠装饰的花卉簪子

底部区域：创建 3 个较大的姿势展示面板：
5. 动态便当姿势 — 站立，动作生动，向外拿着色彩鲜艳的糖葫芦
6. 坐姿 — 沉稳地坐在木凳或平台上，拿着糖葫芦
7. 表情姿势 — 近景半身特写，将糖葫芦拿在脸部附近

添加一个小型“COLOR PALETTE”方框，包含 5 个圆形色块：深红、淡粉、腮红粉、暖金和黑色。添加一个简短的“NOTES”块，描述优雅、传统、精致的格调以及永恒的日式美感。

约束条件：保留参考图中可辨识的服装、发饰位置和糖葫芦道具，同时确保设定图看起来像专业的生成式模型/角色设定表。不要添加额外的视图或额外的标注卡片。在所有角色视图中保持面部模糊/匿名化。

templates.title: Cute AI Mascot Lineup

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的 AI 吉祥物阵容

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a wide four-panel lineup of cute collectible 3D AI mascot characters, each rendered as a toy-like chibi robot in a distinct themed environment: {argument name="mascot lineup" default="Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok"}.

Canvas: Ultra-wide horizontal image, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 4 equal vertical panels with soft blended edges between panels. Each panel contains one centered full-body mascot standing on a softly lit floor, facing forward, waving or posing cutely.

Layout and count: Include exactly 4 discrete mascots, left to right: 1) Claude mascot, 2) ChatGPT mascot, 3) Gemini mascot, 4) Grok mascot. Do not add extra characters, props, or text beyond the intended logos/name marks.

Subject details:
1. Claude mascot: Warm beige and cream chibi robot with a rounded square face screen, glossy black eyes, tiny smile, oversized winter headphones, cream knit beanie with orange pom-pom, orange scarf, padded cream coat, mittens, boots, and subtle Claude-style orange starburst emblems. The coat has the visible label {argument name="first mascot label" default="Claude"}. Pose: one hand raised in a friendly wave. Background: soft peach-beige studio glow with tiny sparkles.
2. ChatGPT mascot: Cream and mint-green chibi robot wearing rounded headphones, a puffy jacket, green scarf, shorts or padded pants, sneakers, and small ChatGPT knot logos on hat, jacket, and accessories. The jacket includes the visible label {argument name="second mascot label" default="ChatGPT"}. Pose: one paw-like hand raised. Background: warm pale cream with green accents, subtle magical sparkles.
3. Gemini mascot: Cute cosmic chibi robot in white, lavender, pink, and blue, with glossy oversized eyes, small open happy mouth, rounded helmet, headphones, flowing cape, star charm details, boots, and a bright multicolor Gemini-style star floating above the head. Pose: cheerful raised hand. Background: dreamy pastel galaxy gradient with stars, bokeh, pink-purple-blue glow, and a luminous circular ring on the ground.
4. Grok mascot: Dark futuristic chibi robot with glossy black face screen, huge electric-blue eyes, tiny catlike smile, black hooded suit with small horn-like ear shapes on the hood, padded jacket, gloves, boots, glowing cyan circular tech accents, and a subtle xAI/Grok-like emblem on the chest or sleeve. Pose: one hand raised in a wave. Background: deep navy-black cosmic tech scene with blue neon rings, glowing particles, and star specks.

Visual style: Extremely cute kawaii 3D render, plush vinyl toy aesthetic, soft rounded proportions, large head and small body, high-quality glossy materials, cinematic soft lighting, gentle bloom, shallow depth of field, crisp details, adorable expression, premium character design, polished social-media showcase.

Constraints: Keep the four panels evenly spaced and aligned at the same scale. Use each mascot’s distinctive color palette: {argument name="overall color mood" default="warm beige for Claude, mint green for ChatGPT, pastel cosmic colors for Gemini, black and electric blue for Grok"}. Avoid photorealistic humans, avoid clutter, avoid scary expressions, avoid misspelled labels, and do not include a watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一组宽幅四格的可爱收藏级 3D AI 吉祥物角色，每个角色都被渲染成玩具般的 Q 版机器人，并置于独特的环境主题中：{argument name="mascot lineup" default="Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok"}。

画布：超宽横向图像，比例约为 3:1，分为 4 个完全相等的垂直面板，面板之间边缘柔和融合。每个面板包含一个居中的全身吉祥物，站在柔和的灯光地面上，面向前方，挥手或摆出可爱的姿势。

布局与数量：包含 4 个独立的吉祥物，从左到右依次为：1) Claude 吉祥物，2) ChatGPT 吉祥物，3) Gemini 吉祥物，4) Grok 吉祥物。除预期的徽标/名称标记外，请勿添加额外的角色、道具或文字。

主体细节：
1. Claude 吉祥物：温暖的米色和奶油色 Q 版机器人，带有圆角方形面部屏幕，亮黑色眼睛，小巧的微笑，超大号冬季耳机，带有橙色绒球的奶油色针织帽，橙色围巾，加厚奶油色外套，连指手套，靴子，以及微妙的 Claude 风格橙色星爆标志。外套上有可见标签 {argument name="first mascot label" default="Claude"}。姿势：一只手举起友好地挥动。背景：柔和的桃米色摄影棚光效，带有细小的闪光。
2. ChatGPT 吉祥物：奶油色和薄荷绿 Q 版机器人，佩戴圆形耳机，穿着羽绒服、绿色围巾、短裤或加厚长裤、运动鞋，帽子、夹克和配饰上有小巧的 ChatGPT 结状徽标。夹克上有可见标签 {argument name="second mascot label" default="ChatGPT"}。姿势：一只爪状手举起。背景：温暖的浅奶油色，带有绿色点缀和微妙的魔法闪光。
3. Gemini 吉祥物：可爱的宇宙风 Q 版机器人，采用白色、淡紫色、粉色和蓝色，拥有超大号亮眼、微张的快乐小嘴、圆形头盔、耳机、飘逸的斗篷、星星挂件细节、靴子，以及头顶上方漂浮的明亮多色 Gemini 风格星星。姿势：欢快地举起手。背景：梦幻般的柔和星系渐变，带有星星、光斑、粉紫蓝色光晕以及地面上的发光圆环。
4. Grok 吉祥物：深色未来感 Q 版机器人，带有亮黑色面部屏幕，巨大的电蓝色眼睛，猫咪般的小巧微笑，黑色连帽套装，兜帽上有小巧的角状耳饰，加厚夹克，手套，靴子，发光的青色圆形科技装饰，以及胸前或袖子上微妙的 xAI/Grok 风格徽标。姿势：一只手举起挥动。背景：深海军蓝色的宇宙科技场景，带有蓝色霓虹环、发光粒子和星尘。

视觉风格：极具萌感的 kawaii 3D 渲染，毛绒乙烯基玩具美学，柔和圆润的比例，大头小身，高质量光泽材质，电影级柔光，轻微光晕，浅景深，清晰细节，可爱的表情，高级角色设计，精致的社交媒体展示效果。

约束：保持四个面板间距均匀且比例一致。使用每个吉祥物独特的配色方案：{argument name="overall color mood" default="Claude 使用温暖米色，ChatGPT 使用薄荷绿，Gemini 使用柔和宇宙色，Grok 使用黑色和电蓝色"}。避免照片级写实的人类，避免杂乱，避免恐怖表情，避免拼写错误的标签，且不要包含水印。

Use realistic photography, wide concert portrait composition, sharp detail on the singer and dress texture, blurred crowd background, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖版超写实演唱会肖像，主角是一位年轻的流行女歌手，{argument name="character name" default="匿名偶像歌手"}，她站在大型体育馆舞台上，距离镜头很近。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="深棕色长发，扎成两个松散的麻花辫，配有柔和的刘海"}，身穿一件 {argument name="dress color and style" default="淡腮红粉色闪亮薄纱迷你裙，配有修身束腰上衣、蝴蝶结细节、细肩带和层叠荷花边裙摆"}。她手持一支带有粉色圆环的黑色手持麦克风，直接置于嘴前，正面向前，呈现出自信的现场表演姿态。在她的脸部添加一个大的矩形隐私模糊遮罩，并额外添加三个矩形隐私模糊遮罩：一个遮住她身后巨型视频屏幕上的脸部，另外两个小的遮住左下角附近的观众脸部，总共正好四个遮挡矩形。在她身后，展现拥挤的室内体育馆观众，他们举起双臂、拿着手机屏幕，挥舞着许多发光的粉色和蓝色荧光棒，并带有充满活力的焦外成像和景深效果。在右后方，包含一个巨大的 LED 屏幕，显示该歌手半身像，略微失焦，穿着同样的裙子并拿着麦克风。在顶部，包含正好六盏明亮的紫色舞台灯向下照射，配以洋红色和紫罗兰色的演唱会灯光、薄雾和电影级对比度。使用写实摄影风格，宽幅演唱会肖像构图，歌手和裙子纹理细节清晰，观众背景模糊，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Red Cable Car Over Misty Water

titleLocalized.zh: 云雾水面上的红色缆车

templates.prompt: Create a serene surreal landscape illustration at dawn: a single vintage red cable-car gondola hangs from three diagonal black cables running from the upper left toward the center-right, suspended above an endless mirror-smooth flooded plain. The gondola is boxy with large windows, a dark roof frame, and a small metal tower and pulley assembly above it; it sits in the left third of the square composition, slightly above center. The water below creates a clear but softly rippled inverted reflection of the gondola, support tower, and cables. In the misty distance on the right half, show exactly five pale stone ruin arches rising from the water: one large tall arch near the right edge, one medium arch closer to center, two very small faint arches near the horizon, and one thin partial arch far right; all reflected vertically in the water. Use a pastel morning palette of {argument name="sky color" default="soft blue"}, blush pink, lavender haze, and warm peach light, with the horizon nearly dissolved into fog. The sky is vast and minimal with delicate horizontal pink cloud streaks on the upper right. Style should feel like a dreamy cinematic digital painting with subtle painterly brush texture, atmospheric perspective, soft gradients, calm symmetry, and no people, no birds, no text, no watermark. Square 1:1 composition, quiet “good morning” mood, high detail in the gondola and cables, softer detail in the distant ruins.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宁静的超现实景观插画，呈现黎明时分：一辆复古红色缆车悬挂在三根从左上角延伸至中右侧的黑色斜拉索上，悬浮在无边无际、如镜面般平滑的积水平原上方。缆车呈方盒状，配有大窗户、深色车顶框架，上方设有小型金属塔架和滑轮组件；它位于方形构图的左三分之一处，略高于中心位置。下方的水面清晰地映照出缆车、支撑塔和缆索，并带有柔和的涟漪。在右侧朦胧的远景中，展示五座从水中升起的浅色石质废墟拱门：最右侧边缘有一座高大的拱门，靠近中心处有一座中型拱门，地平线附近有两座非常细小的模糊拱门，最右侧还有一座细长的残缺拱门；所有拱门均在水面形成垂直倒影。使用柔和的晨曦色调，包括 {argument name="sky color" default="柔和蓝色"}、淡粉色、薰衣草紫雾和温暖的桃色光芒，地平线几乎消融在雾气中。天空广阔而极简，右上角有精致的水平粉色云带。风格应具有梦幻般的电影感数字绘画质感，带有细腻的笔触纹理、大气透视、柔和的渐变和宁静的对称感，画面中无人、无鸟、无文字、无水印。方形 1:1 构图，营造宁静的“早安”氛围，缆车和缆索细节丰富，远处的废墟细节则较为柔和。
