templates.prompt: Create a clean anime-style character base portrait for modular facial-part generation: a centered front-facing bust of {argument name="character name" default="an unnamed young woman"} with a deliberately empty face area covered by a large vertical rounded rectangle mask, so the eyes, nose, and mouth are absent and can be added separately later. The character has shoulder-length soft layered {argument name="hair color" default="white hair fading into pale ice blue at the tips"}, airy translucent strands, long side locks, subtle loose curls, and visible ears partially covered by hair. Use a pale skin tone and a calm neutral pose, cropped from the top of the head to the upper chest. Dress her in a futuristic high-collar {argument name="outfit" default="white zip-up jacket"} with light blue accents, a central zipper, a small rectangular collar tab with a blue triangle symbol, and delicate seam lines. The blank face mask should be exactly one large central rounded rectangle, softly filled with a vertical gradient from warm pale peach near the top to cool pale blue near the bottom, aligned over the facial features and extending from the forehead area down past the chin, while still showing hair and ears around it. Background is a simple light gray studio backdrop with soft lighting, thin refined line art, watercolor-like anime rendering, gentle shadows, high resolution, no text, no UI, no watermark, and no extra facial features visible inside the blank mask.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个简洁的动漫风格角色底图，用于模块化面部部件生成：一个居中的正面半身像，角色为 {argument name="character name" default="一位未命名的年轻女性"}，面部区域刻意留空并覆盖有一个大型垂直圆角矩形遮罩，因此眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴均缺失，可稍后单独添加。角色拥有齐肩的柔软分层 {argument name="hair color" default="发梢渐变为淡冰蓝色的白发"}，发丝轻盈通透，长侧鬓角，带有微妙的松散卷度，耳朵在发丝间隐约可见。使用白皙肤色，姿态沉静自然，构图从头顶裁剪至上胸部。身着具有未来感的高领 {argument name="outfit" default="白色拉链夹克"}，带有浅蓝色点缀、中央拉链、带有蓝色三角形符号的小型矩形领扣以及精致的缝合线。空白面部遮罩应为一个完整的大型中央圆角矩形，内部柔和地填充从顶部暖浅桃色到底部冷浅蓝色的垂直渐变，对齐面部特征区域并从额头延伸至下巴下方，同时保留周围的头发和耳朵。背景为简单的浅灰色摄影棚背景，光线柔和，线条精致细腻，采用水彩风格动漫渲染，阴影柔和，高分辨率，无文字，无 UI，无水印，且空白遮罩内不显示任何额外的面部特征。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖版肖像照片，主体为一名 {argument name="student subject" default="日本高中女生"}，她站在明亮的教室高窗旁，沐浴在温暖的晨光中。画面取景约为大腿中部以上，采用四分之三背侧面姿势，她微微看向镜头，一只手轻放在白色窗台上。她的面部经过刻意匿名处理，使用了一个位于中心、边缘柔和的方形模糊/马赛克块，色调与自然肤色一致，覆盖了整个面部，但保留了头发和耳朵的可见度。她留着深棕色至黑色的直长发，垂至肩下，带有光泽感。她身着 {argument name="school uniform" default="海军蓝西装外套，内搭白色翻领衬衫，下配灰色格纹百褶裙"}；细节需包含西装袖口纽扣、合身接缝、小口袋盖以及清晰的布料质感。背景为一间日本教室，地面为浅色木地板，右侧是成排的木制课桌和金属框架椅，背景中可见绿色黑板和贴有文件的软木板，左侧的大窗户透出柔和模糊的城市或校园景观。采用浅景深、自然窗光、柔和阴影、写实的相机视角、细微的镜头模糊、高细节、宁静的抓拍氛围以及干净的摄影风格。画布比例为竖版 3:4，全彩，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: Six-Panel Drunken Kung Fu Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 六格醉拳分镜故事板

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean rough storyboard sheet for an anime/comedy action sequence, like a production planning board for a spin-off episode. The theme is a clumsy drunk performance in front of a traditional Japanese temple, using stick-figure acting over pencil background art.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 storyboard page on warm off-white paper, thin gray border lines, monochrome pencil-drawing aesthetic with a few colored motion arrows. Top title bar reads: “{argument name="project title" default="mMansion Spin-off｜新大家 nO「酔拳の演舞」ラフストーリーボード"}”. Under it, add small production notes in Japanese: “15秒 / 16:9 / 棒人間演技設計 / 未成年キャラのため飲酒なし・酔ったふりの演舞として設計”.

Layout: Exactly 6 storyboard panels arranged in a 3 columns × 2 rows grid. Each panel is a rounded rectangle card with a black shot label badge in the upper left, a Japanese shot title beside it, a grayscale pencil temple courtyard background, a black stick figure performing exaggerated drunken kung-fu movements, and colored annotations. Beneath each drawing area, include compact Japanese production notes labeled like acting memo, camera, and background. Maintain a rough animation-planning look, not a polished comic.

Scene background: Every panel shows the same traditional Japanese temple approach: large temple gate or hall in the center background, stone steps, stone lanterns on both sides, gravel courtyard, subtle trees, and architectural details drawn in thin gray pencil lines. Keep the background consistent across panels, with slight framing changes. Use black line art for the stick figure, green arrows for body flow or weight shift, red arrows/arcs for major motion, and occasional blue arrows for secondary motion.

Panel count and contents, exactly 6 panels:
1. Panel labeled “SHOT 01 0.0–2.0s” with title “千鳥足で登場”. Stick figure staggers in from the left with one arm raised, leaning off balance, feet sliding with red foot marks. Include three small white note strips inside the drawing: “重心→左へ流す”, “肩を抜く”, “足は一歩遅れて着地”.
2. Panel labeled “SHOT 02 2.0–4.0s” with title “杯をかわす構え”. Stick figure raises one hand as if holding an invisible cup while stepping wide; green arrows show the torso twisting and weight transfer, blue mark near the hand. Include three white note strips: “空の盃を持つ”, “顔はふにゃっと”, “腰は右に逃がす”.
3. Panel labeled “SHOT 03 4.0–6.5s” with title “崩れ落ち→低い払い”. Stick figure drops into a very low sweeping pose, one leg extended, torso tilted, red curved arrow sweeping across the ground and green vertical balance arrow. Include three white note strips: “落ちるフリ”, “胸が半円に流れる”, “手で床を探る”.
4. Panel labeled “SHOT 04 6.5–9.0s” with title “ふらつき回転”. Stick figure spins unsteadily in the center with a large red circular arrow around the body and a small blue counter-arrow near the head. Include three white note strips: “上体は遅れる”, “回転矢印”, “視線だけ先行”.
5. Panel labeled “SHOT 05 9.0–12.0s” with title “酔い避け→掌底”. Stick figure leans back in an evasive drunken sway while extending one palm strike to the right; long red arrow indicates the palm movement, green arrow shows S-shaped torso flow. Include three white note strips: “S字の体軸”, “避ける→返す”, “掌底は寸止め”. Add a narrow vertical temple signboard in the right background.
6. Panel labeled “SHOT 06 12.0–15s” with title “家賃回収拳の決め”. Stick figure finishes in a comic triumphant stance, one arm raised holding a small yellow paper sign marked “札”, body upright but still tipsy; red arcs near the feet show wobbling. Include three white note strips: “止まれない決めポーズ”, “お札を見せる”, “最後にドヤ顔”.

Text and notes: Use Japanese visible text for the title, shot labels, shot subtitles, note strips, and production memos. The small memo text should look authentic but can be partially tiny and hard to read. At the bottom of the page, add a single Japanese direction line: “演出方針：酔拳らしい『脱力・遅れ・崩れ・戻り』を、攻撃ではなくコミカルな演舞として見せる。実飲酒表現は入れない。”

Visual style: Rough monochrome storyboard, clean production-design sheet, faint beige background, thin gray panel borders, black stick figures, hand-drawn temple pencil art, minimal color accents in red, green, blue, and yellow. Slightly imperfect linework, readable composition, professional animation previsualization feel.

Constraints: Use exactly 6 panels, exactly the listed shot labels and time ranges, keep the character a simple stick figure with no detailed face, avoid photorealism, avoid modern city elements, avoid extra panels, avoid a manga speech-bubble style, and do not depict actual drinking or alcohol consumption.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为动画/喜剧动作序列创建一个简洁的粗略分镜表，类似于衍生剧集的项目策划板。主题是在日本传统寺庙前进行的滑稽醉拳表演，使用火柴人动作配合铅笔背景艺术。

画布：宽屏 16:9 分镜页面，采用暖米白色纸张，带有细灰色边框，单色铅笔画风格，辅以少量彩色运动箭头。顶部标题栏显示：“{argument name="project title" default="mMansion Spin-off｜新大家 nO「酔拳の演舞」ラフストーリーボード"}”。下方添加日语小字制作备注：“15秒 / 16:9 / 棒人間演技設計 / 未成年キャラのため飲酒なし・酔ったふりの演舞として設計”。

布局：精确的 6 格分镜，排列为 3 列 × 2 行的网格。每个分镜是一个圆角矩形卡片，左上角带有黑色镜头标签徽章，旁边是日语镜头标题，背景为灰度铅笔绘制的寺庙庭院，画面中是执行夸张醉拳动作的黑色火柴人，并配有彩色标注。在每个绘图区域下方，包含紧凑的日语制作备注，标注为表演备忘录、摄像机和背景。保持粗略的动画策划外观，而非精细的漫画。

场景背景：每个分镜展示相同的日本传统寺庙入口：背景中央为大型寺庙门或大殿，两侧有石阶、石灯笼、砾石庭院、精致的树木，建筑细节以细灰色铅笔线条绘制。保持背景在各分镜间的一致性，仅有细微的构图变化。使用黑色线条绘制火柴人，绿色箭头表示身体流动或重心转移，红色箭头/弧线表示主要动作，蓝色箭头表示次要动作。

分镜数量及内容，共 6 格：
1. 标签为“SHOT 01 0.0–2.0s”，标题为“千鳥足で登場”。火柴人从左侧摇晃入场，单臂举起，身体倾斜失去平衡，脚下有红色足迹标记。绘图内包含三张白色小纸条备注：“重心→左へ流す”、“肩を抜く”、“足は一歩遅れて着地”。
2. 标签为“SHOT 02 2.0–4.0s”，标题为“杯をかわす構え”。火柴人举起一只手，仿佛拿着隐形的杯子，同时大步跨出；绿色箭头显示躯干扭转和重心转移，手部附近有蓝色标记。包含三张白色纸条：“空の盃を持つ”、“顔はふにゃっと”、“腰は右に逃がす”。
3. 标签为“SHOT 03 4.0–6.5s”，标题为“崩れ落ち→低い払い”。火柴人跌入极低的扫堂腿姿势，一条腿伸展，躯干倾斜，红色弧形箭头扫过地面，配有绿色垂直平衡箭头。包含三张白色纸条：“落ちるフリ”、“胸が半円に流れる”、“手で床を探る”。
4. 标签为“SHOT 04 6.5–9.0s”，标题为“ふらつき回転”。火柴人在中心不稳定地旋转，身体周围有一个大的红色圆形箭头，头部附近有一个小的蓝色反向箭头。包含三张白色纸条：“上体は遅れる”、“回転矢印”、“視線だけ先行”。
5. 标签为“SHOT 05 9.0–12.0s”，标题为“酔い避け→掌底”。火柴人向后倾斜进行醉酒式闪避，同时向右伸出一记掌击；长红色箭头指示掌部动作，绿色箭头显示 S 型躯干流动。包含三张白色纸条：“S字の体軸”、“避ける→返す”、“掌底は寸止め”。在右侧背景添加一个狭长的垂直寺庙招牌。
6. 标签为“SHOT 06 12.0–15s”，标题为“家賃回収拳の決め”。火柴人以滑稽的胜利姿势结束，一只手举起拿着一张写有“札”字的小黄纸条，身体直立但仍带醉意；脚部附近的红色弧线显示摇晃。包含三张白色纸条：“止まれない決めポーズ”、“お札を見せる”、“最後にドヤ顔”。

文字与备注：标题、镜头标签、镜头副标题、纸条备注和制作备忘录均使用日语可见文字。备忘录文字应看起来真实，但部分内容可极小且难以辨认。在页面底部，添加一行日语导演指令：“演出方針：酔拳らしい『脱力・遅れ・崩れ・戻り』を、攻撃ではなくコミカルな演舞として見せる。実飲酒表現は入れない。”

视觉风格：粗略的单色分镜，简洁的制作设计表，淡淡的米色背景，细灰色分镜边框，黑色火柴人，手绘铅笔寺庙艺术，红色、绿色、蓝色和黄色的极简色彩点缀。线条略显不完美，构图清晰，具有专业的动画预演感。

约束条件：使用精确的 6 个分镜，严格遵守列出的镜头标签和时间范围，保持角色为简单的火柴人且无详细面部特征，避免照片写实主义，避免现代城市元素，避免额外分镜，避免漫画气泡风格，且不得描绘实际饮酒或酒精消费行为。

templates.title: Golden Snapchat Creator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 金色 Snapchat 创作者海报

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-high-quality cinematic 3D digital social-media poster featuring a stylish young male creator sitting confidently on glossy black steps in a vibrant yellow-and-gold Snapchat-inspired environment. The man wears a {argument name="hoodie color" default="bright yellow"} hoodie with a small white ghost logo on the chest, clean white jogger trousers, white sneakers with yellow accents and a small ghost logo, a wristwatch, and modern dark hair; his face is intentionally covered by a soft rectangular blur for anonymity. He sits relaxed with one knee raised, one hand resting near his leg, and the other hand raised in a peace sign. Behind him, place a huge glowing rounded-square yellow icon with a white ghost silhouette, rim-lit with intense neon yellow. On the left side, create exactly 5 stacked rounded glassmorphism statistic cards plus 1 circular crown badge above them: card 1 reads “{argument name="likes count" default="9.8K"} Likes” with a heart icon, card 2 reads “Capture Fun” with a smiling emoji, card 3 reads “Stay Playful” with a sunglasses emoji, card 4 reads “{argument name="followers count" default="2.3K"} Followers” with an add-person icon, and card 5 reads “{argument name="views count" default="1.1M"} Views” with a rising chart icon. Add exactly 8 floating glossy yellow emoji spheres around the scene: one laughing face near the top center-left, one sunglasses face near the upper left, one smiling face near the top right, one large winking/laughing face on the right, one small smiley near the seated figure’s left leg, one laughing face near the lower right, one large blurred foreground laughing face at the bottom left, and one partial blurred yellow emoji sphere at the bottom right edge. Add tiny glowing dots, stars, sparkles, and bokeh throughout the golden background. Across the lower center, write the creator name “{argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}” in large handwritten neon yellow script, with “{argument name="profession subtitle" default="AI Creator"}” underneath in clean white sans-serif text flanked by short yellow lines. Use dramatic studio lighting, warm golden color grading, high contrast, glossy reflections, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition, vertical poster aspect ratio, sharp 3D realism, no extra text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超高质量的电影级 3D 数字社交媒体海报，画面中一位时尚的年轻男性创作者自信地坐在光亮的黑色台阶上，置身于充满活力的黄金色 Snapchat 风格环境中。该男子身穿一件 {argument name="hoodie color" default="亮黄色"} 连帽衫，胸前印有白色小幽灵标志，搭配干净的白色慢跑裤、带有黄色点缀及小幽灵标志的白色运动鞋、腕表，留着现代感的深色短发；他的面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理以保持匿名。他姿态放松，一膝抬起，一只手放在腿旁，另一只手比出剪刀手。在他身后，放置一个巨大的发光圆角方形黄色图标，中间为白色幽灵剪影，边缘带有强烈的霓虹黄轮廓光。在左侧，创建 5 张堆叠的圆角磨砂玻璃质感统计卡片，并在其上方放置 1 枚圆形皇冠徽章：第 1 张卡片显示“{argument name="likes count" default="9.8K"} 点赞”并配有爱心图标，第 2 张卡片显示“Capture Fun”并配有微笑表情，第 3 张卡片显示“Stay Playful”并配有墨镜表情，第 4 张卡片显示“{argument name="followers count" default="2.3K"} 粉丝”并配有添加好友图标，第 5 张卡片显示“{argument name="views count" default="1.1M"} 观看量”并配有上升趋势图图标。在场景周围添加 8 个漂浮的亮面黄色表情符号球体：顶部中左侧为一个大笑表情，左上方为一个墨镜表情，右上方为一个微笑表情，右侧为一个巨大的眨眼大笑表情，创作者左腿旁为一个小型笑脸，右下方为一个大笑表情，左下角为一个巨大的模糊前景大笑表情，右下边缘为一个部分模糊的黄色表情球体。在金色背景中加入细小的发光点、星星、闪光和焦外成像效果。在底部中央，用醒目的手写体霓虹黄字体写上创作者名字“{argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}”，下方配以简洁的白色无衬线字体“{argument name="profession subtitle" default="AI Creator"}”，两侧饰以短横线。采用戏剧性的摄影棚灯光、暖金色调、高对比度、光泽反射、浅景深、电影级构图、竖版海报比例，呈现清晰的 3D 写实效果，无额外文字，无水印。

templates.title: Neon AI Creator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹 AI 创作者海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic 3D digital social-media creator poster featuring {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"} as a stylish young male AI creator seated confidently in a futuristic neon Instagram-themed studio.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, glossy high-resolution 3D render with dramatic depth of field, dark purple-black environment, reflective floor, magenta and pink neon rim lighting.

Main subject: A fashionable young man sitting on the floor in a relaxed confident pose, one knee raised and one leg extended toward the viewer. He wears modern glasses implied by the style, a fitted white tank top, trendy {argument name="trouser color" default="pink"} trousers, white socks with pink stripes, a wristwatch, a thin necklace, and custom white-and-pink sneakers with a stylized pink logo on the side. His face is intentionally covered by a centered soft-edged square censor block in muted brown-pink, while the hair, ears, neck, arms, and outfit remain visible. Use realistic skin, athletic slim build, cinematic fashion-poster posing, and premium influencer branding.

Background: Place a giant glowing Instagram-style app icon behind him, oversized and slightly blurred, with a gradient of hot pink, purple, orange, and yellow neon. Add floating social media reaction bubbles, glowing heart icons, and small pink notification particles throughout the dark studio.

Left-side interface panels: Include exactly 5 translucent rounded rectangular neon UI cards stacked vertically on the left side, outlined in pink-white glow. Card 1: text “9.8K Likes” with a heart notification icon. Card 2: camera icon, text “Capture Moments”, subtext “Stay creative”. Card 3: paper-plane icon, text “Share Your Story”, subtext “Connect globally”. Card 4: people/network icon, text “Inspire Daily”, subtext “Motivate others”. Card 5: bar chart icon, text “Engagement +248%”, subtext “This Week”.

Floating reaction elements: Include exactly 5 visible floating heart-notification bubbles outside the left UI stack: one small heart bubble near the center-left beside the subject, one small heart bubble near the upper-right side with the number “1”, one small heart bubble mid-right, one large heart bubble near the bottom-right foreground, and one small heart bubble near the lower-left foreground with the number “1”.

Bottom typography: At the bottom center, write the creator name {argument name="bottom signature text" default="Mr Tariq"} in large glowing handwritten neon script, colored pink-white. Directly below it, write {argument name="subtitle text" default="AI Creator"} in a futuristic sans-serif neon font. Keep the typography crisp, centered, and integrated with the floor glow.

Visual style: Hyper-real cinematic 3D, glossy neon cyber-studio, influencer marketing aesthetic, pink and purple color palette, volumetric light, reflections, bloom, shallow depth of field, sharp detailed clothing and shoes, high contrast, premium digital poster look.

Constraints: Preserve all visible English text exactly as specified, keep the subject seated in the foreground, keep the giant Instagram icon dominant in the background, do not add extra UI cards, do not add watermarks or unrelated logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张超精细的电影级 3D 数字社交媒体创作者海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}，展现一位时尚的年轻男性 AI 创作者，自信地坐在充满未来感的霓虹 Instagram 主题工作室中。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 纵横比，光泽感高分辨率 3D 渲染，具有强烈的景深效果，深紫黑色环境，反光地面，洋红色和粉色霓虹轮廓光。

主体：一位时尚的年轻男子以放松且自信的姿势坐在地板上，一膝抬起，另一条腿向观众方向伸展。他佩戴着符合整体风格的现代眼镜，身穿修身白色背心、潮流的 {argument name="trouser color" default="pink"} 长裤、带有粉色条纹的白袜、手表、细项链，以及定制的白粉配色运动鞋，鞋侧带有风格化的粉色标志。他的面部被一个位于中心、边缘柔和的棕粉色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，但头发、耳朵、颈部、手臂和服装清晰可见。使用逼真的皮肤质感、健美修长的身材、电影级时尚海报姿势以及高端网红品牌感。

背景：在他身后放置一个巨大的发光 Instagram 风格应用图标，图标超大且略带模糊，呈现热粉色、紫色、橙色和黄色的霓虹渐变效果。在整个暗色工作室中添加漂浮的社交媒体互动气泡、发光的心形图标以及细小的粉色通知粒子。

左侧界面面板：在左侧垂直堆叠 5 个半透明圆角矩形霓虹 UI 卡片，边缘带有粉白色光晕。卡片 1：文字“9.8K Likes”，配有心形通知图标。卡片 2：相机图标，文字“Capture Moments”，副标题“Stay creative”。卡片 3：纸飞机图标，文字“Share Your Story”，副标题“Connect globally”。卡片 4：人物/网络图标，文字“Inspire Daily”，副标题“Motivate others”。卡片 5：柱状图图标，文字“Engagement +248%”，副标题“This Week”。

漂浮互动元素：在左侧 UI 堆叠外包含 5 个清晰可见的漂浮心形通知气泡：主体左侧中心附近有一个小爱心气泡，右上侧附近有一个带有数字“1”的小爱心气泡，右侧中部有一个小爱心气泡，右下角前景处有一个大爱心气泡，左下角前景处有一个带有数字“1”的小爱心气泡。

底部排版：在底部中心，用粉白色的大号发光手写霓虹字体书写创作者名称 {argument name="bottom signature text" default="Mr Tariq"}。在其正下方，用未来感无衬线霓虹字体书写 {argument name="subtitle text" default="AI Creator"}。保持排版清晰、居中，并与地面光效融为一体。

视觉风格：超写实电影级 3D，光泽感霓虹赛博工作室，网红营销美学，粉紫色调，体积光，反射，光晕，浅景深，清晰细腻的衣物和鞋履，高对比度，高端数字海报质感。

约束：严格保留所有指定的英文文本，保持主体位于前景，保持巨大的 Instagram 图标在背景中占据主导地位，不得添加额外的 UI 卡片，不得添加水印或无关的标志。

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic 3D digital poster of a stylish young male AI creator in a futuristic dark studio, seated in a relaxed confident pose at the center. The subject wears a sleek black hoodie with a small X emblem on the chest, a black bucket hat with an X logo, modern glasses partially hidden by shadow, beige cargo jogger pants, a black wristwatch, black socks with X marks, and custom black high-top sneakers with white laces, white soles, and glowing cyan X accents. Behind him, place one huge metallic 3D glowing X logo with cyan neon edge lighting, forming the main backdrop. The environment is glossy black, reflective, and cyberpunk, with floating holographic UI panels, digital scan lines, tiny particles, cyan circuitry, and reflections on the wet floor. Include exactly 6 floating graphic elements: 1 left stats panel showing “28.5K LIKES”, “12.1K REPOSTS”, and “8.7M IMPRESSIONS” with heart, repost, and eye icons; 1 right strategy panel listing “GO VIRAL / MAXIMIZE REACH”, “BUILD INFLUENCE / GROW YOUR BRAND”, and “TREND THE WORLD / LEAD THE FUTURE” with rocket, people, and globe icons; 1 small lower-left analytics card reading “TRENDING TOP 1% CREATOR” with an upward bar chart; 1 standalone X logo on the lower left; 1 glowing heart outline on the lower right; and 1 upward arrow/share icon near the lower right. At the bottom, add a large cyan neon handwritten signature reading {argument name="creator signature" default="Mr Tariq"}, with smaller white spaced text below reading {argument name="role text" default="AI CREATOR"}. Use a dramatic low-angle composition, high contrast black-and-cyan palette, volumetric rim lighting, sharp glossy 3D rendering, realistic fabric folds, premium sneaker detail, shallow depth of field, and a vertical poster aspect ratio. Do not add extra panels, extra people, watermarks, or unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超精细的电影级 3D 数字海报，画面中心是一位坐在未来感暗色调工作室中、姿态从容自信的年轻男性 AI 创作者。主体身穿一件简洁的黑色连帽衫，胸前带有小巧的 X 徽标，头戴印有 X 标志的黑色渔夫帽，现代感眼镜部分隐于阴影中，穿着米色工装慢跑裤、黑色腕表、带有 X 标记的黑色短袜，以及定制的黑色高帮运动鞋（配有白色鞋带、白色鞋底和发光的青色 X 点缀）。保持面部柔和遮蔽或处于阴影中，同时呈现高级时尚海报的质感。在他身后，放置一个巨大的金属质感 3D 发光 X 标志，边缘带有青色霓虹灯光，作为主要背景。环境为光泽感黑色、具有反射效果的赛博朋克风格，伴有悬浮的全息 UI 面板、数字扫描线、微小粒子、青色电路以及湿润地面上的倒影。包含 6 个精确的悬浮图形元素：左侧 1 个统计面板，显示“28.5K LIKES”、“12.1K REPOSTS”和“8.7M IMPRESSIONS”，配有心形、转发和眼睛图标；右侧 1 个策略面板，列出“GO VIRAL / MAXIMIZE REACH”、“BUILD INFLUENCE / GROW YOUR BRAND”和“TREND THE WORLD / LEAD THE FUTURE”，配有火箭、人群和地球图标；左下方 1 个小型分析卡片，显示“TRENDING TOP 1% CREATOR”及上升的柱状图；左下方 1 个独立的 X 标志；右下方 1 个发光的心形轮廓；以及右下方附近 1 个向上的箭头/分享图标。在底部，添加一个巨大的青色霓虹手写签名 {argument name="creator signature" default="Mr Tariq"}，下方配有较小的白色间距文本 {argument name="role text" default="AI CREATOR"}。采用戏剧性的低角度构图，高对比度的黑青色调，体积轮廓光，锐利的光泽感 3D 渲染，逼真的织物褶皱，高级运动鞋细节，浅景深，以及竖版海报比例。请勿添加额外的面板、额外的人物、水印或无关文本。

templates.title: Neon WhatsApp AI Creator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹风格 WhatsApp AI 创作者海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-high-quality cinematic 3D digital poster for a personal brand profile, featuring {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"} as an {argument name="profession title" default="AI Creator"} with a glossy WhatsApp-inspired neon green theme.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster composition, dark black-to-deep-green studio background, reflective floor, dramatic rim lighting, high contrast, premium social-media promotional look.

Main subject: A stylish young adult man seated in a relaxed professional pose on a dark green modern swivel lounge chair. He wears modern glasses if visible, a light sage-green polo shirt with a small WhatsApp logo on the chest, crisp white trousers, and white low-top sneakers with green accents and small WhatsApp logos. He holds a white coffee mug in his right hand, also printed with a small green WhatsApp logo. His legs are crossed casually, one hand resting near his lap, wearing a dark wristwatch. Use a photorealistic 3D-rendered body with polished cinematic lighting; keep the face unobtrusive or customizable rather than highly detailed.

Background focal element: A huge glossy 3D WhatsApp-style icon behind the subject on the right, glowing with a bright white rim and green circular body, partially cropped by the canvas edge. Add luminous green rings and arcs sweeping around the floor and background to create depth and motion.

Text content: In the upper left, write the name {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"} in large neon handwritten script, glowing bright green. Directly below it, write {argument name="profession title" default="AI Creator"} in clean white sans-serif text.

Left-side social stats panel: Include exactly 5 stacked rounded glassmorphism cards with neon green outlines and soft glow. Card 1 has a heart icon and text "9.8K" with label "Likes". Card 2 has a user icon and text "6.7K" with label "Followers". Card 3 has a paper-plane icon and text "3.2K" with label "Shares". Card 4 has an upward chart icon and text "Stay Connected" with smaller line "Grow Together". Card 5 has a group/network icon and text "Build Connections" with smaller line "Inspire the World".

Floating icons: Add exactly 7 floating chat/message elements around the poster: one small chat bubble near the top center, one medium chat bubble left of the subject near the upper torso, one small chat bubble near the lower left edge, one small chat bubble near the left side of the subject's knee area, one medium chat bubble on the right side near the chair arm, one circular profile-chat icon near the lower right of the subject, and one larger tilted chat bubble near the bottom right corner. All should be glossy dark green with neon green outlines and white dot/message details.

Visual style: Hyper-real cinematic 3D render, glossy surfaces, volumetric green glow, premium tech influencer aesthetic, shallow depth of field, sharp subject, realistic clothing folds, clean typography, black and neon-green palette with white accents.

Constraints: Use only WhatsApp-inspired visual branding without adding extra logos beyond the shirt, mug, shoes, large background icon, and floating chat motifs. Keep the layout clean and readable, no watermark, no extra people, no additional statistics beyond the 5 listed cards.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为个人品牌资料创建一个超高质量的电影级 3D 数字海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}，身份是 {argument name="profession title" default="AI Creator"}，采用亮面 WhatsApp 风格的霓虹绿主题。

画布：垂直 4:5 海报构图，深黑至深绿色的摄影棚背景，反光地板，戏剧性的轮廓光，高对比度，高级社交媒体宣传外观。

主体：一位时尚的年轻男性，以放松且专业的姿势坐在深绿色现代旋转休闲椅上。他佩戴着现代感眼镜（如可见），身穿浅鼠尾草绿色的 Polo 衫，胸前印有小巧的 WhatsApp 标志，穿着干练的白色长裤，以及带有绿色点缀和小型 WhatsApp 标志的白色低帮运动鞋。他右手拿着一个白色咖啡杯，杯上也印有小巧的绿色 WhatsApp 标志。他双腿随意交叉，一只手放在膝盖附近，佩戴着深色手表。使用照片级 3D 渲染身体，配合精致的电影级灯光；保持面部不突兀或可自定义，而非过度细节化。

背景焦点元素：主体右后方有一个巨大的亮面 3D WhatsApp 风格图标，带有明亮的白色轮廓和绿色圆形主体，被画布边缘部分裁剪。在地面和背景周围添加发光的绿色圆环和弧线，以营造深度和动感。

文字内容：在左上角，用醒目的霓虹绿色手写字体书写 {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}。在其正下方，用简洁的白色无衬线字体书写 {argument name="profession title" default="AI Creator"}。

左侧社交数据面板：包含 5 张堆叠的圆角玻璃拟态卡片，带有霓虹绿轮廓和柔和光晕。第 1 张卡片带有心形图标和文字“9.8K”，标签为“Likes”。第 2 张卡片带有用户图标和文字“6.7K”，标签为“Followers”。第 3 张卡片带有纸飞机图标和文字“3.2K”，标签为“Shares”。第 4 张卡片带有向上图表图标和文字“Stay Connected”，下方小字为“Grow Together”。第 5 张卡片带有群组/网络图标和文字“Build Connections”，下方小字为“Inspire the World”。

浮动图标：在海报周围添加 7 个浮动聊天/消息元素：顶部中心附近一个小聊天气泡，主体左侧上半身附近一个中等聊天气泡，左下边缘附近一个小聊天气泡，主体膝盖区域左侧附近一个小聊天气泡，椅子扶手右侧附近一个中等聊天气泡，主体右下角附近一个圆形个人资料聊天图标，以及右下角附近一个较大的倾斜聊天气泡。所有元素均应为亮面深绿色，带有霓虹绿轮廓和白色点/消息细节。

视觉风格：超写实电影级 3D 渲染，亮面材质，体积感绿色光晕，高端科技网红美学，浅景深，主体清晰，逼真的衣物褶皱，简洁的排版，黑色与霓虹绿配色，点缀白色。

约束：仅使用 WhatsApp 风格的视觉品牌元素，除衬衫、杯子、鞋子、大型背景图标和浮动聊天图案外，不得添加额外标志。保持布局整洁易读，无水印，无额外人物，除列出的 5 张卡片外，不得添加额外统计数据。

templates.title: Neon Facebook Creator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹 Facebook 创作者海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic 3D digital poster for a social media content creator, centered on a stylish young man squatting confidently in a futuristic neon-lit studio dominated by Facebook-like branding.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, high-resolution glossy 3D render, deep electric-blue color palette, bright white neon highlights, reflective black-blue floor, shallow depth of field, dramatic rim lighting, floating holographic UI elements, energetic social-media atmosphere.

Main subject: A fashionable young man with short dark hair and modern styling, face intentionally covered by a soft rectangular blur/mosaic censor block. He is squatting in a confident pose, one arm resting across his knee and one hand hanging relaxed. Outfit: shiny {argument name="jacket color" default="electric blue"} oversized puffer jacket with a small white “facebook” wordmark on the chest, white T-shirt, fitted blue jogger pants, and custom blue-and-white high-top sneakers. The sneakers have a bold lowercase {argument name="platform logo letter" default="f"} on the side panels. Make the fabric glossy and premium, with realistic folds and reflections.

Background centerpiece: A huge glowing white lowercase {argument name="platform logo letter" default="f"} standing behind the subject like a luminous monument, with thick 3D depth and blue rim glow.

Foreground title typography: Across the lower center, overlay a large elegant glowing cursive signature reading {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}. Directly below it, add smaller futuristic block lettering reading {argument name="role text" default="CONTENT CREATOR"}. Both text layers should be bright neon blue-white and partially overlap the subject’s legs.

Left-side holographic analytics panels: Include exactly 4 stacked rectangular blue neon dashboard cards with these visible labels and values: 1) “9.8K Likes” with a rising line chart and arrow, 2) “Engagement +256% vs last month” with vertical bar chart, 3) “Followers 125K Total Audience” with two-person icon, 4) “Content Reach 2.4M People Reached” with rising line chart. Beneath them, include exactly 4 smaller rounded motivational buttons: 1) “Imagine — Visualize your dreams” with star icon, 2) “Create — Make it happen” with compass/target icon, 3) “Inspire — Motivate others” with spark icon, 4) “Elevate — Reach new heights” with rocket icon.

Right-side holographic panels: Include exactly 4 small floating message cards: 1) “Stay Focused — Keep Creating”, 2) “Dream Big — Work Smart”, 3) “No Limits — Just Passion”, 4) “Messages 99+ — New Messages”. Style them as glowing rounded blue speech bubbles with tiny icons.

Floating social reactions: Add exactly 12 visible reaction elements distributed around the scene: 4 thumbs-up icons, 3 heart icons, 3 laughing-face emojis, 1 small profile notification dot, and 1 chat/message bubble. Include a large 3D blue thumbs-up cube in the bottom-left foreground and a partially cropped red heart reaction sphere in the bottom-right foreground.

Visual style: Hyper-polished cinematic 3D advertising poster, glossy blue neon reflections, volumetric light beams, bokeh particles, holographic UI glow, futuristic creator economy aesthetic, crisp typography, premium render quality, no extra people, no watermark, no unintended text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为社交媒体内容创作者创作一张超精细的电影级 3D 数字海报，画面中心是一位自信蹲在未来感霓虹灯工作室里的时尚青年，工作室以 Facebook 风格的品牌元素为主导。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 长宽比，高分辨率光泽 3D 渲染，深电光蓝配色，明亮的白色霓虹高光，反光的蓝黑色地面，浅景深，戏剧性的轮廓光，悬浮的全息 UI 元素，充满活力的社交媒体氛围。

主体：一位留着黑色短发、造型现代的时尚青年，面部特意用柔和的矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡。他以自信的姿势蹲着，一只手臂搭在膝盖上，另一只手自然下垂。服装：闪亮的 {argument name="jacket color" default="电光蓝"} 超大款羽绒服，胸前带有小巧的白色 “facebook” 字样，白色 T 恤，修身蓝色慢跑裤，以及定制的蓝白配色高帮运动鞋。运动鞋侧面印有醒目的小写 {argument name="platform logo letter" default="f"}。面料需呈现光泽感和高级感，并带有逼真的褶皱和反光。

背景核心：一个巨大的发光白色小写 {argument name="platform logo letter" default="f"} 像一座发光的纪念碑一样矗立在主体身后，具有厚实的 3D 深度和蓝色轮廓光。

前景标题排版：在画面下部中心，叠加一个优雅且发光的草书签名，内容为 {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}。在其正下方，添加较小的未来感块状字体，内容为 {argument name="role text" default="CONTENT CREATOR"}。两层文字均应为明亮的霓虹蓝白色，并部分覆盖在主体的腿部上方。

左侧全息分析面板：包含 4 个堆叠的矩形蓝色霓虹仪表盘卡片，带有清晰的标签和数值：1) “9.8K Likes”，配有上升折线图和箭头；2) “Engagement +256% vs last month”，配有垂直柱状图；3) “Followers 125K Total Audience”，配有双人图标；4) “Content Reach 2.4M People Reached”，配有上升折线图。在它们下方，包含 4 个较小的圆形激励按钮：1) “Imagine — Visualize your dreams”，配有星星图标；2) “Create — Make it happen”，配有指南针/目标图标；3) “Inspire — Motivate others”，配有火花图标；4) “Elevate — Reach new heights”，配有火箭图标。

右侧全息面板：包含 4 个悬浮的小型消息卡片：1) “Stay Focused — Keep Creating”，2) “Dream Big — Work Smart”，3) “No Limits — Just Passion”，4) “Messages 99+ — New Messages”。样式为带有微小图标的发光圆形蓝色气泡。

悬浮社交互动元素：在场景中分布 12 个可见的互动元素：4 个点赞图标、3 个爱心图标、3 个大笑表情符号、1 个小型个人资料通知点和 1 个聊天/消息气泡。在左下角前景处加入一个巨大的 3D 蓝色点赞立方体，右下角前景处加入一个被部分裁剪的红色爱心互动球。

视觉风格：超精细的电影级 3D 广告海报，光泽感的蓝色霓虹反射，体积光束，散景粒子，全息 UI 发光效果，未来感创作者经济美学，清晰的排版，高级渲染质量，无多余人物，无水印，无无关文字。

templates.title: Rustic Pasta Tutorial Reference Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 乡村风意面制作教程参考板

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create one single composite reference sheet for a {argument name="video duration" default="15-second"} realistic pasta-making tutorial video, designed as a clean high-end production reference board rather than a poster. The board should communicate story sequence, character styling, location mood, aspect ratio, and filming constraints at a glance.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal reference sheet with elegant white margins and crisp white gutters between panels. Use warm cinematic rustic lighting, realistic photography, shallow depth of field, earthy browns, flour whites, copper highlights, antique wood textures, and a premium food-film look.

Top sequence strip: Include exactly 9 small numbered process panels across the top, each with a white circular number badge in the upper-left corner. The 9 panels are: 1) a mound of flour with a well on a wooden table, 2) hands cracking eggs into the flour well, 3) a fork mixing egg into flour, 4) floury hands kneading dough, 5) a smooth round pasta dough ball resting on a floured board, 6) hands rolling dough with a wooden rolling pin, 7) hands cutting or separating long fresh pasta strands, 8) fresh pasta being lifted from a copper pot of boiling water, 9) plated pasta finished with garnish and sauce.

Middle reference row: Use a collage of exactly 5 larger reference panels. Panel 1 is a tight portrait crop of the host, a rustic young woman with long wavy dark brown hair, soft linen blouse, delicate necklace, and face intentionally left as an indistinct blocked placeholder for identity flexibility. Panel 2 is a full-body wardrobe reference of the same host wearing a cream embroidered apron or tunic over an olive-green skirt and brown boots, standing in a rustic kitchen. Panel 3 is a medium action shot of the host rolling or preparing pasta at the wooden table, also with an indistinct face placeholder. Panel 4 is a rear-view costume reference showing long wavy hair tied partly back, cream blouse, dark green skirt, and apron ties. Panel 5 is a wide environment reference of a cozy old-world farmhouse kitchen with rough plaster walls, exposed timber beams, shelves of bowls and jars, hanging herbs, copper pots, a vintage stove, a wooden worktable, flour, eggs, and warm sunlight through a window.

Bottom production-spec band: Leave a clean white band along the bottom with exactly 5 simple black-outline icons and labels or implied labels: 1) a circular badge reading "15 SEC", 2) a rectangular badge reading "16:9", 3) a vintage movie camera icon, 4) a sun/daylight icon, 5) a steaming bowl of pasta icon. At the far bottom-right, add a camera-lens mark with the visible brand text {argument name="brand text" default="BudgetPixel"}.

Subject details: The host should feel like {argument name="host style" default="a rustic young Italian farmhouse cook"}; wardrobe should be natural linen, cream embroidery, olive green skirt, apron ties, and worn leather boots. The kitchen should feel {argument name="kitchen style" default="rustic Tuscan farmhouse"}, with practical food-prep clutter but still art-directed and elegant.

Visual style: Realistic cinematic photography, warm golden window light, soft contrast, tactile flour and dough textures, copper cookware, weathered wood, handmade pasta authenticity, editorial production-board composition. Keep typography minimal and functional.

Constraints: Do not create a text-heavy poster. Preserve the exact count of 9 top step panels, 5 middle reference panels, and 5 bottom icons. Maintain clean white gutters, white margins, numbered process badges, realistic food styling, and a professional video production reference-sheet layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部 {argument name="video duration" default="15 秒"} 的写实意面制作教程视频创建一个综合参考项目，设计为简洁的高端制作参考项目，而非海报。该项目应能一目了然地传达故事顺序、角色造型、场景氛围、长宽比和拍摄限制。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向参考项目，带有优雅的白色边距和面板间清晰的白色间隙。采用温暖的电影感乡村照明、写实摄影、浅景深、大地棕色、面粉白色、铜色高光、古董木纹以及高级美食电影质感。

顶部序列条：顶部包含 9 个编号的小型制作面板，每个面板左上角均带有白色圆形数字徽章。9 个面板分别为：1) 木桌上堆成小山的面粉坑，2) 双手将鸡蛋打入面粉坑，3) 用叉子将鸡蛋与面粉混合，4) 沾满面粉的双手揉面，5) 一个光滑的圆形意面面团放在撒了面粉的“项目”上，6) 双手用木制擀面杖擀面，7) 双手切割或分离长条新鲜意面，8) 新鲜意面从沸腾的铜锅中捞出，9) 装盘并配上装饰和酱汁的意面。

中间参考行：使用 5 个较大的参考面板拼贴。面板 1 是主持人的特写肖像，一位乡村风格的年轻女性，留着波浪长卷发，穿着柔软的亚麻衬衫，佩戴精致项链，脸部特意留白作为模糊占位符，以便灵活设定身份。面板 2 是同一主持人的全身服装参考，穿着奶油色刺绣围裙或束腰外衣，搭配橄榄绿裙子和棕色靴子，站在乡村厨房中。面板 3 是主持人在木桌上擀面或准备意面的中景动作镜头，脸部同样为模糊占位符。面板 4 是服装背部参考，展示部分扎起的波浪长发、奶油色衬衫、深绿色裙子和围裙系带。面板 5 是温馨旧世界农舍厨房的环境全景，带有粗糙的灰泥墙、裸露的木梁、摆放碗罐的架子、悬挂的香草、铜锅、复古炉灶、木制工作台、面粉、鸡蛋以及透过窗户射入的温暖阳光。

底部制作规格带：底部留出干净的白色区域，包含 5 个简单的黑色轮廓图标及标签或隐含标签：1) 标有“15 SEC”的圆形徽章，2) 标有“16:9”的矩形徽章，3) 复古电影摄像机图标，4) 太阳/日光图标，5) 冒着热气的意面图标。在右下角最远处，添加一个带有可见品牌文本 {argument name="brand text" default="BudgetPixel"} 的相机镜头标记。

主体细节：主持人应呈现为 {argument name="host style" default="乡村风格的意大利年轻农舍厨师"}；服装应为天然亚麻、奶油色刺绣、橄榄绿裙子、围裙系带和磨损的皮靴。厨房应呈现为 {argument name="kitchen style" default="乡村托斯卡纳农舍"}，带有实用的食物准备杂乱感，但仍需经过艺术指导并保持优雅。

视觉风格：写实电影摄影、温暖的金色窗光、柔和对比度、真实的面粉和面团质感、铜制炊具、风化木材、手工意面的真实感、编辑制作项目构图。保持排版简洁且功能化。

限制：不要制作文字过多的海报。保留顶部 9 个步骤面板、中间 5 个参考面板和底部 5 个图标的精确数量。保持干净的白色间隙、白色边距、编号流程徽章、写实的美食造型以及专业的视频制作参考项目布局。

templates.title: Post-Apocalyptic Alien Wasteland Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 末日废土外星战士

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical sci-fi movie poster of {argument name="character name" default="a muscular lone male survivor"} crouching on a jagged rocky outcrop in a desolate alien wasteland. He is posed low and powerful, one knee bent forward, one hand braced on the ground, the other hand gripping a curved bone-handled knife with a dark blade pointed downward. His face is deliberately covered by a flat, centered, featureless rectangular mask in warm brown tones, while short dark hair remains visible above it. Dress him in {argument name="armor color" default="weathered olive-green and brown"} post-apocalyptic armor: bulky layered shoulder plates, intricate woven netting and cord patterns across the shoulders and chest, leather straps, metal rings, buckles, forearm bracers, fingerless gloves, rugged tactical pants, heavy boots, and a cloak or pack draped behind him. The setting is {argument name="planetary landscape" default="a barren rocky desert with distant jagged spires and eroded mountains"}, lit by a dramatic golden sunset with dust and haze. In the sky, show exactly two large celestial bodies: one enormous rusty orange planet dominating the upper left background and one smaller gray-brown moon in the upper right. Use epic high-contrast cinematic lighting, warm sepia and bronze color grading, sharp detailed textures, volumetric clouds, gritty realism, dramatic depth of field, and a heroic poster composition with no visible title text, logo, watermark, or extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级竖版科幻电影海报，画面展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位肌肉发达的孤独男性幸存者"} 蹲伏在荒凉外星废土的崎岖岩石上。他姿态低沉有力，单膝前屈，一手撑地，另一手紧握一把刀刃漆黑、带有弯曲骨柄的匕首，刀尖向下。他的面部被一个平整、居中、无特征的暖棕色长方形面具遮住，上方露出短促的深色头发。为他穿上 {argument name="armor color" default="风化橄榄绿与棕色"} 的末日废土风格装甲：厚重的分层肩甲，肩部和胸部布满错综复杂的编织网和绳索图案，配有皮带、金属环、搭扣、前臂护腕、露指手套、粗犷的战术长裤、重型靴子，身后披着斗篷或背着行囊。背景设定为 {argument name="planetary landscape" default="一片荒芜的岩石沙漠，远处可见崎岖的尖塔和被侵蚀的山脉"}，在金色的落日余晖与尘雾笼罩下。天空中需呈现两颗巨大的天体：左上方背景中是一颗巨大的锈橙色行星，右上方是一颗较小的灰褐色卫星。采用史诗级高对比度电影光效，色调为暖棕褐色与青铜色，纹理清晰细腻，呈现体积云效果、写实的粗粝感、极具张力的景深，以及英雄式的海报构图，画面中不应包含任何标题文字、Logo、水印或多余字符。

templates.title: Four Chibi AI Mascot Robots

titleLocalized.zh: 四个 Q 版 AI 吉祥物机器人

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a wide four-panel lineup of cute collectible chibi AI mascot robots, each standing front-facing in its own vertical slice, like a polished 3D toy render for social media.

Canvas: Ultra-wide horizontal banner, 4:1 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 4 equal vertical panels with no visible borders, each panel using a different color theme and lighting mood.

Layout: Show exactly 4 discrete mascots, one centered in each panel, all full-body, rounded helmet-like heads, oversized glossy eyes, tiny smiling mouths, short plush proportions, winter/sci-fi clothing, soft studio lighting, high-detail toy materials, shallow depth of field, and magical sparkles.

Mascot 1: A warm beige and cream robot mascot inspired by {argument name="first mascot" default="Claude by Anthropic"}, wearing a knit winter beanie with a pom-pom, padded headphones, thick orange scarf, mittens, boots, and a cream coat. Include a simple orange sunburst logo on the beanie and coat, with small readable text “Claude” and “BY ANTHROPIC” on the front patch. The robot is waving with one hand. Background is soft peach beige with subtle star glints.

Mascot 2: A green and cream robot mascot inspired by {argument name="second mascot" default="ChatGPT"}, wearing large headphones, a hooded winter jacket, green scarf, shorts or padded pants, sneakers, and small tech badges. Place a green knot-style OpenAI-like emblem on the forehead area and jacket, and small readable text “ChatGPT” on the chest. The character raises one paw-like hand in greeting. Background is warm cream with golden bokeh, and a tiny green sprout accent appears near the helmet.

Mascot 3: A magical pastel robot mascot inspired by {argument name="third mascot" default="Grok"}, with a white helmet, big blue-purple glossy eyes, a rainbow star floating above the head, a small star mark on the forehead, lavender headphones, a flowing white cape with pink and violet underside, star charms, glowing bracelets, and white boots. The mascot waves cheerfully while standing inside a glowing rainbow ring. Background is dreamy pink, purple, and blue nebula gradients with many sparkles.

Mascot 4: A dark futuristic robot mascot inspired by {argument name="fourth mascot" default="xAI"}, wearing a glossy black cat-eared helmet or hood, black puffer jacket, gloves, boots, and neon blue circular accents. The face is black glass with luminous blue eyes and a tiny glowing mouth. Add subtle xAI-like markings on the jacket sleeve, and make the character wave with one hand. Background is deep navy-black space with electric blue rings, stars, and neon rim lighting.

Visual style: High-end cute 3D rendering, toy photography, kawaii collectible figurines, rounded forms, soft vinyl/plush textures mixed with glossy robot visors, cinematic lighting, crisp details, vibrant but harmonious colors, adorable expressive faces.

Constraints: Keep exactly 4 panels and exactly 4 mascots; no extra characters; each mascot should be visibly distinct by color palette and branding; use only the specified small text labels; avoid watermarks, captions, UI elements, or photorealistic humans.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一组宽幅四格的可爱 Q 版 AI 吉祥物机器人，每个机器人独立站立于各自的垂直区域内，呈现出类似精致 3D 玩具渲染图的效果，适合社交媒体使用。

画布：超宽横向横幅，4:1 纵横比，平均分为 4 个垂直面板，无明显边框，每个面板采用不同的配色方案和灯光氛围。

布局：展示 4 个独立的吉祥物，每个面板中心各一个，均为全身像，头部呈圆润头盔状，拥有超大光泽感眼睛、微小的微笑嘴型、短小的毛绒比例、冬季/科幻风格服装、柔和的摄影棚灯光、高细节玩具材质、浅景深以及梦幻闪光效果。

吉祥物 1：一个暖米色和奶油色的机器人吉祥物，灵感源自 {argument name="first mascot" default="Claude by Anthropic"}，戴着带绒球的针织冬帽、头戴式耳机、厚实的橙色围巾、连指手套、靴子和奶油色外套。帽子和外套上印有简单的橙色太阳光芒标志，胸前贴片上有清晰可见的“Claude”和“BY ANTHROPIC”小字。机器人正挥手致意。背景为柔和的桃米色，带有细微的星光闪烁。

吉祥物 2：一个绿色和奶油色的机器人吉祥物，灵感源自 {argument name="second mascot" default="ChatGPT"}，戴着大耳机、连帽冬装夹克、绿色围巾、短裤或加厚长裤、运动鞋以及小型科技徽章。前额区域和夹克上饰有绿色结状的 OpenAI 风格徽标，胸前有清晰可见的“ChatGPT”小字。角色举起一只爪子状的手打招呼。背景为带有金色光斑的暖奶油色，头盔旁有一个微小的绿色嫩芽装饰。

吉祥物 3：一个梦幻般的柔和色调机器人吉祥物，灵感源自 {argument name="third mascot" default="Grok"}，戴着白色头盔，拥有蓝色与紫色交织的大眼睛，头顶漂浮着一颗彩虹星，前额有小星星标记，戴着淡紫色耳机，披着内衬为粉色和紫罗兰色的白色斗篷，饰有星星挂件、发光手环和白色靴子。吉祥物站在发光的彩虹环中欢快地挥手。背景为梦幻般的粉色、紫色和蓝色星云渐变，带有大量闪光。

吉祥物 4：一个深色未来感机器人吉祥物，灵感源自 {argument name="fourth mascot" default="xAI"}，戴着光泽感的黑色猫耳头盔或兜帽，穿着黑色羽绒服、手套、靴子，并带有霓虹蓝圆形装饰。面部为黑色玻璃材质，拥有发光的蓝色眼睛和微小的发光嘴部。夹克袖子上带有微妙的 xAI 风格标记，角色正挥手致意。背景为深海军蓝色的太空，带有电光蓝色的光环、星星和霓虹边缘光。

视觉风格：高端可爱 3D 渲染，玩具摄影，卡哇伊收藏级手办，圆润造型，软乙烯基/毛绒质感与光泽感机器人面罩相结合，电影级灯光，细节清晰，色彩鲜艳且和谐，表情可爱生动。

约束条件：保持 4 个面板和 4 个吉祥物；不要添加额外角色；每个吉祥物应通过配色方案和品牌标识清晰区分；仅使用指定的微小文字标签；避免水印、标题、UI 元素或照片级真实感的人类。

templates.title: Neon Instagram Magic Heart Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹 Instagram 魔法爱心肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical fantasy photo-composite of a {argument name="character description" default="handsome young man"} sitting cross-legged on a dark reflective floor, centered in the frame, wearing a {argument name="shirt style" default="dark green floral button-up shirt with red and gold flowers, open at the collar"}, fitted black pants, and black loafers. His black hair is neatly styled and swept to one side, but his face is covered by a flat opaque medium-brown rectangular censor block. He holds a transparent glass tilted downward in his raised left hand, pouring a stream of clear water into a glowing magical heart hovering above his cupped right hand at chest level. The heart is made of fiery orange-red light with green electric sparks, golden embers, splashing water, mist, and smoke swirling around it. Surround the subject with exactly 8 floating neon Instagram-style camera logos: one large tilted partial logo at bottom left, one large tilted partial logo at bottom right foreground, one large tilted logo on the left side, one medium logo at upper left, one large logo at upper right, one small logo at mid-right, one medium logo at right center, and one small logo at lower right. Use a dark smoky background filled with orange sparks, bokeh particles, and cinematic rim lighting. The overall style should be hyperrealistic, glossy, high contrast, moody, magical, and social-media themed, with vivid magenta, orange, yellow, and purple neon glow. Use a shallow depth of field so foreground logos are slightly blurred while the man and glowing heart remain sharp. No readable text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版奇幻合成照片，画面中心是一位 {argument name="character description" default="英俊的年轻男子"}，他盘腿坐在深色反光地板上，身穿一件 {argument name="shirt style" default="深绿色花卉纽扣衬衫，饰有红色和金色花朵，领口敞开"}，搭配修身黑色长裤和黑色乐福鞋。他留着整齐的侧分黑发，但面部被一个平坦、不透明的中棕色矩形遮挡块覆盖。他左手抬起，将一个透明玻璃杯向下倾斜，将一股清澈的水流倒入悬浮在他胸前右手掌心上方的一颗发光魔法爱心中。这颗爱心由炽热的橙红色光芒组成，伴随着绿色电火花、金色余烬、飞溅的水花、薄雾和烟雾缭绕。在主体周围环绕 8 个悬浮的霓虹灯风格 Instagram 相机图标：左下角有一个大型倾斜的局部图标，右下角前景有一个大型倾斜的局部图标，左侧有一个大型倾斜图标，左上方有一个中型图标，右上方有一个大型图标，中右侧有一个小型图标，右侧中心有一个中型图标，右下角有一个小型图标。使用充满橙色火花、焦外成像颗粒和电影级轮廓光的深色烟雾背景。整体风格应呈现超写实、光泽感、高对比度、情绪化、魔幻且具有社交媒体主题，并带有鲜艳的洋红色、橙色、黄色和紫色霓虹光效。使用浅景深效果，使前景的图标略显模糊，而人物和发光的爱心保持清晰。画面中无任何可读文字，无水印。

templates.title: Barcelona Fans Stadium Broadcast Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 巴塞罗那球迷体育场转播照片

templates.prompt: Create a detailed, high-quality vertical sports broadcast photograph of {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} fans packed tightly in a stadium crowd during a match. Center the image on a young blonde woman and a young dark-haired bearded man posing together in the stands, both wearing the club’s blue-and-claret striped home jerseys with the crest, yellow Nike swoosh, and Spotify sponsor. The man stands slightly behind and to the right with his arm around the woman’s shoulders; the woman leans into him with one arm across his waist, wearing a delicate necklace and flower-shaped earrings. Surround them with other supporters in the same jerseys, including one fan at left raising an arm, one fan at right holding a clear plastic cup of beer, and a partially visible fan cap at bottom left with a yellow band reading “FCBARCELONA.” Use a realistic telephoto stadium-crowd composition, shallow depth of field, natural arena lighting, saturated club colors, and documentary sports-photo detail. Add broadcast graphics: a green scoreboard overlay in the top left showing UEFA Champions League styling, “BAR 2 - 1” and “MANCHESTER CITY,” a white Korean-style TV network bug in the top right, and a white “TUDN EN VIVO” watermark at the bottom left. Include exactly four rectangular blurred face/privacy blocks: one large block over the central man’s face, one medium block over the central woman’s face, one tall block over the raised-arm fan’s face in the upper left-center, and one medium block over the fan’s face in the upper right. Do not add extra people in the foreground, do not change the central couple’s pose, and keep all visible branding consistent with {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富、高质量的竖版体育转播照片，展示 {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} 球迷在比赛期间挤满体育场看台的场景。画面中心为一名年轻的金发女性和一名年轻的深色头发蓄须男性，两人在看台上合影，均身穿该俱乐部的蓝红条纹主场球衣，球衣上带有队徽、黄色 Nike 对勾标志和 Spotify 赞助商标志。男性站在后方略偏右侧，手臂搂着女性的肩膀；女性向他靠拢，一只手搭在他的腰间，佩戴着精致的项链和花朵形状的耳环。周围是身穿同款球衣的其他支持者，包括左侧一名举起手臂的球迷、右侧一名手持透明塑料啤酒杯的球迷，以及左下角部分可见的带有黄色条纹的球迷帽，上面写着“FCBARCELONA”。采用逼真的长焦体育场观众构图、浅景深、自然的竞技场光线、饱和的俱乐部色彩以及纪实体育摄影的细节。添加转播图形：左上角显示 UEFA Champions League 风格的绿色记分牌叠加图层，显示“BAR 2 - 1”和“MANCHESTER CITY”，右上角有一个白色的韩式电视频道台标，左下角有一个白色的“TUDN EN VIVO”水印。包含精确的四个矩形模糊面部/隐私遮挡块：中心男性面部上方一个大遮挡块，中心女性面部上方一个中等遮挡块，左中上方举臂球迷面部上方一个高遮挡块，以及右上角球迷面部上方一个中等遮挡块。不要在前景中添加额外人物，不要改变中心情侣的姿势，并保持所有可见品牌与 {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} 的一致性。

templates.title: Man Pouring Water on Magic Heart

titleLocalized.zh: 男子向魔法之心浇水

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic cinematic fantasy portrait of a {argument name="character description" default="handsome young man"} sitting cross-legged on a wet dark ground at night in a moody forest or dim urban woodland setting, wearing a {argument name="shirt style" default="dark emerald green floral button-up shirt, open at the collar"}, fitted black pants, and black shoes. He has thick black hair swept upward and to one side, but his face is completely hidden by a large opaque medium-brown square censor block centered over the entire face. His left hand is cupped low in front of his lap, holding a glowing magical heart made of fire, emerald-green energy, smoke, and molten light; the heart emits orange flames, teal mist, golden sparks, and bright radiant highlights. His right hand is raised near his chest, tilting a transparent glass tumbler and pouring a stream of water downward directly onto the flaming heart, creating a bright splash, steam, and magical energy burst where water meets fire. Use warm amber backlighting, shallow depth of field, soft circular bokeh lights in the background, rain-wet reflections on the ground, high contrast, realistic skin and fabric texture, detailed hands, dynamic particles, smoke wisps, and cinematic color grading with orange fire versus teal-green magic. Vertical portrait composition, full seated body visible from head to shoes, subject centered, ultra-realistic fantasy photo style, no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅极具电影感的奇幻肖像，画面中一位 {argument name="character description" default="英俊的年轻男子"} 在夜晚的阴郁森林或昏暗的城市林地中，盘腿坐在潮湿的深色地面上。他身穿一件 {argument name="shirt style" default="深翡翠绿色花卉图案衬衫，领口敞开"}，搭配修身黑色长裤和黑色鞋子。他留着浓密的黑色头发，发丝向一侧梳起，但他的面部被一个位于正中央、不透明的中褐色方形遮挡块完全遮住。他的左手低垂在膝前，捧着一颗由火焰、翡翠绿能量、烟雾和熔融光芒构成的发光魔法之心；心脏散发出橙色火焰、青色薄雾、金色火花和明亮的光芒。他的右手抬至胸前，倾斜着一个透明玻璃杯，将水流直接浇在燃烧的心脏上，在水火交融处激起明亮的水花、蒸汽和魔法能量爆发。使用温暖的琥珀色背光，浅景深效果，背景带有柔和的圆形光斑，地面呈现雨后的湿润倒影，高对比度，展现逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，精细的手部细节，动态粒子，缕缕烟雾，以及橙色火焰与青绿色魔法对比的电影级调色。竖构图，全身坐姿，从头部到鞋子清晰可见，主体居中，超写实奇幻摄影风格，无文字或水印。

templates.title: Luxury Jamaican Festival Bread Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华牙买加 Festival Bread 海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a premium luxury food advertising poster for a Jamaican street food brand, centered on a close-up hero shot of golden fried Jamaican festival bread resting on thick slices of soft white sandwich bread, with a dark cinematic background and warm orange-gold lighting.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, high-resolution, dark moody food photography aesthetic. Use a black and deep-brown rustic wooden table background with smoky atmospheric haze, dramatic side lighting, shallow depth of field, and glossy highlights on the fried bread.

Main subject: In the right-center foreground, place one large oval piece of golden Jamaican festival bread with a crisp bubbled crust, sitting on two stacked thick slices of white bread. Add a small black bowl of yellow dipping sauce at the lower right edge, partly cropped. Add additional blurred fried festival breads in the upper-right background inside a dark rustic bowl and one very blurred fried bread in the bottom foreground for depth.

Branding and text: Top left, place a gold line-art logo for {argument name="brand name" default="Marcellina’s Kitchen"}, featuring a Jamaican woman chef illustration inside a rounded arch frame, with small text below reading “JAMAICAN GOODNESS.” Large headline on the left: script word “Jamaican” in golden handwritten lettering, then huge distressed cream block text “FESTIVAL BREAD.” Under the headline, add the tagline {argument name="tagline" default="Golden. Soft. Irresistible."} in small golden italic text.

Badges: Include exactly 2 round badges in the upper-right area: 1) a thin gold circular stamp reading “MADE WITH LOVE” at top and “TASTE OF HOME” at bottom, with a hand-drawn heart in the center; 2) a scalloped gold seal reading “FRESHLY MADE DAILY” with a small heart above.

Information panel: On the lower-left, add a rough gold brush-stroke label reading “WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT.” Beneath it list exactly 4 benefit rows with small circular gold icons and white text: 1) “Authentic Recipe,” 2) “Soft & Fluffy Interior,” 3) “Freshly Made,” 4) “Perfect Pairing.” Add a short paragraph below: {argument name="description text" default="A classic Jamaican favorite with a soft interior and golden crispy exterior. Best enjoyed with cheese, butter, honey, jam, or dipping sauce."}

Bottom feature strip: Along the lower section, show exactly 4 small gold icon features separated by thin vertical lines: 1) leaf icon “NO PRESERVATIVES,” 2) shield icon “QUALITY INGREDIENTS,” 3) heart icon “MADE WITH LOVE,” 4) clock icon “FRESH DAILY.”

Call to action and footer: Bottom left, create a bold gold paint-brush button reading {argument name="call to action" default="ORDER NOW"} with a black circular arrow icon. Bottom center, add “FOLLOW US” above exactly 5 white social media icons: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp, and a generic chat/message icon. Bottom right, add “CONTACT US” with phone and email lines: {argument name="contact details" default="(876) 555-1234 · marcellinaskitchen@gmail.com"}. Very bottom, add tiny spaced-out text “REAL INGREDIENTS. REAL FLAVOR. REAL JAMAICAN.” followed by a small Jamaican flag mark.

Visual style: Premium Caribbean food advertisement, high contrast, black-and-gold palette, cream distressed typography, golden handwritten accents, rustic wood texture, appetizing macro detail, cinematic steam and glow, luxury street-food branding. Keep all text legible and spelled correctly. Avoid extra foods, extra badges, extra icons, or clutter.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为牙买加街头美食品牌创作一张高端奢华的美食广告海报，以放置在厚实软白面包片上的金黄炸牙买加 festival bread 特写镜头为核心，背景采用暗调电影感风格，并辅以温暖的橙金色灯光。

画布：1:1 正方形海报，高分辨率，暗调情绪化美食摄影美学。使用黑色和深棕色质感木桌作为背景，营造烟雾缭绕的氛围感，采用戏剧性的侧光、浅景深，并突出炸面包上的光泽感。

主体：在右中前景处，放置一块巨大的椭圆形金黄牙买加 festival bread，表皮酥脆且带有气泡，置于两片叠放的厚白面包之上。右下边缘放置一个小黑碗，内盛黄色蘸酱，进行局部裁剪。在右上背景的深色质感碗中增加额外的模糊炸 festival bread，并在底部前景增加一个非常模糊的炸面包以增强景深。

品牌与文字：左上角放置 {argument name="brand name" default="Marcellina’s Kitchen"} 的金色线条艺术 Logo，包含一个圆拱框内的牙买加女厨师插画，下方小字标注“JAMAICAN GOODNESS”。左侧大标题：金色手写体“Jamaican”，下方为巨大的做旧奶油色块文字“FESTIVAL BREAD”。标题下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Golden. Soft. Irresistible."}，使用小型金色斜体字。

徽标：在右上区域包含 2 个圆形徽标：1) 一个细金圆环印章，顶部写有“MADE WITH LOVE”，底部写有“TASTE OF HOME”，中心有一个手绘心形；2) 一个扇形金色印章，写有“FRESHLY MADE DAILY”，上方有一个小爱心。

信息面板：在左下角，添加一个粗糙的金色笔触标签，写着“WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT”。下方列出 4 行优势，配以小型圆形金色图标和白色文字：1) “Authentic Recipe”（正宗配方），2) “Soft & Fluffy Interior”（内里松软），3) “Freshly Made”（新鲜制作），4) “Perfect Pairing”（完美搭配）。下方添加一段简短说明：{argument name="description text" default="A classic Jamaican favorite with a soft interior and golden crispy exterior. Best enjoyed with cheese, butter, honey, jam, or dipping sauce."}

底部功能条：在底部区域，展示 4 个由细竖线分隔的小型金色图标功能：1) 叶子图标“NO PRESERVATIVES”（无防腐剂），2) 盾牌图标“QUALITY INGREDIENTS”（优质原料），3) 心形图标“MADE WITH LOVE”（用心制作），4) 时钟图标“FRESH DAILY”（每日新鲜）。

号召性用语与页脚：左下角创建一个粗体金色画笔按钮，写着 {argument name="call to action" default="ORDER NOW"}，并配有一个黑色圆形箭头图标。底部中心添加“FOLLOW US”，上方排列 5 个白色社交媒体图标：Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、WhatsApp 和一个通用聊天/消息图标。右下角添加“CONTACT US”，附带电话和电子邮件行：{argument name="contact details" default="(876) 555-1234 · marcellinaskitchen@gmail.com"}。最底部添加微小的间距文字“REAL INGREDIENTS. REAL FLAVOR. REAL JAMAICAN.”，后跟一个小牙买加国旗标志。

视觉风格：高端加勒比美食广告，高对比度，黑金配色，奶油色做旧排版，金色手写点缀，质感木纹，诱人的微距细节，电影感蒸汽与光泽，奢华街头美食品牌感。确保所有文字清晰且拼写正确。避免添加多余的食物、徽标、图标或杂乱元素。

templates.title: Luxury Snapchat Neon Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华 Snapchat 霓虹时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic luxury futuristic portrait of a stylish young woman standing full-body in a glowing Snapchat-inspired social media universe. The subject is {argument name="character description" default="a fashionable young woman with long wavy brown hair"}, centered slightly right, facing forward with a calm confident pose, her face intentionally obscured by a soft square blur. She wears an oversized {argument name="outfit color" default="cream-white"} streetwear set: loose hoodie with drawstrings and kangaroo pocket, matching jogger cargo pants with side pockets, chunky white-and-beige luxury sneakers, layered gold chain necklaces with a round pendant, gold hoop earrings, and subtle premium accessories. The scene is set on a glossy reflective rooftop or glass platform high above a modern city skyline at golden hour, with warm sunset haze, skyscrapers in soft focus, and yellow light reflecting on the floor. Surround her with exactly 7 floating translucent Snapchat-style yellow holographic UI elements: 1 large glowing ghost logo on the upper left, 1 notification card on the left reading “Notifications” and “Collsar 6 minutes ago” with bell and play icons, 1 square app tile with a ghost logo at lower left, 1 chat bubble card at upper right with a small ghost avatar and three text lines plus an alert badge, 1 small yellow streaking ghost icon near the right side, 1 white outlined chat bubble with pale blue text lines at lower right, and 1 smaller yellow chat bubble overlapping it with two yellow text lines. Use a premium 3D neon aesthetic with glassmorphism, transparent yellow panels, rounded corners, soft bloom, rim lighting, volumetric sunlight, realistic fabric texture, polished reflections, shallow depth of field, and cinematic editorial fashion photography. Color palette should be {argument name="accent color" default="Snapchat yellow"}, warm cream, gold, soft beige, and sunset orange. Vertical 3:4 composition, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, luxury social media campaign look, no watermark, no extra text beyond the specified UI labels.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的奢华未来感肖像，展现一位时尚年轻女性在充满 Snapchat 风格的社交媒体宇宙中的全身照。主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着棕色长波浪卷发的时尚年轻女性"}，位于画面偏右侧，正面对镜头，姿态冷静自信，面部刻意经过柔和的方块模糊处理。她身着超大款 {argument name="outfit color" default="奶油白色"} 街头套装：宽松连帽衫配抽绳和袋鼠口袋，同款慢跑工装裤配侧袋，厚底白米色奢华运动鞋，叠戴金链项链配圆形吊坠，金色圆环耳环，以及精致的高级配饰。场景设定在黄金时段现代化城市天际线上方光洁明亮的屋顶或玻璃平台上，伴有温暖的日落薄雾，背景摩天大楼虚化，地面反射着黄色光芒。在她周围环绕 7 个半透明的 Snapchat 风格黄色全息 UI 元素：左上方 1 个巨大的发光幽灵 Logo，左侧 1 张显示“Notifications”和“Collsar 6 minutes ago”的通知卡片（带有铃铛和播放图标），左下方 1 个带有幽灵 Logo 的方形应用磁贴，右上方 1 张带有小型幽灵头像、三行文本及提醒徽章的聊天气泡卡片，右侧附近 1 个小型黄色流光幽灵图标，右下方 1 个带有浅蓝色文本行的白色轮廓聊天气泡，以及 1 个与其重叠的较小黄色聊天气泡（内含两行黄色文本）。采用高级 3D 霓虹美学，结合玻璃拟态、透明黄色面板、圆角设计、柔和光晕、边缘光、体积光、逼真的织物纹理、抛光反射、浅景深以及电影级时尚摄影质感。配色方案为 {argument name="accent color" default="Snapchat 黄色"}、暖奶油色、金色、柔米色和日落橙色。垂直 3:4 构图，超精细，照片级真实感，奢华社交媒体广告风格，无水印，除指定的 UI 标签外无额外文字。

templates.title: Holographic Fashion Brand Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 全息时尚品牌海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a premium Instagram-inspired cinematic fashion poster featuring {argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"}, a glamorous young woman standing confidently on a floating transparent glass platform above soft clouds at golden hour, surrounded by glowing social-media holograms and monumental typography.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, high-fashion editorial composition, full-body subject centered slightly lower than the huge background letters. Warm peach, champagne, blush pink, rose-gold, and violet-blue sunset palette. Ultra-polished, glossy, cinematic lighting with lens bloom and reflections.

Main subject: A stylish young woman with softly styled wavy brown hair, wearing an elegant cream-white oversized blazer, pale pink satin/camisole top, high-waisted cream wide-leg trousers, layered gold necklaces, bracelets, and transparent high-heel sandals. She holds a small structured cream handbag with a gold chain and gold clasp. Pose is confident and relaxed, one hand in pocket, one hand holding the bag, looking toward camera.

Environment: Futuristic luxury city skyline above the clouds, viewed from a rooftop-height fantasy perspective. The subject stands on exactly 1 rounded-square floating glass platform with glowing rose-gold illuminated edges, glossy reflections, and clouds visible underneath. Background sky is sunset with dramatic soft clouds and warm rim light.

Typography installation: Behind the subject, create exactly 2 massive glossy translucent neon typography layers spelling {argument name="brand name" default="HANIA AI"}: the dominant oversized word “HANIA” across the upper background and a second huge stacked “AI” behind the subject on the right. Letters are 3D glass/acrylic, peach-pink illuminated from within, with rose-gold metallic outlines, bolts, and bright edge highlights.

Top text: Add a small centered header near the top reading “HANIA AI” with spaced letters, and a smaller tagline beneath reading {argument name="tagline" default="MADE TO INSPIRE"}.

Holographic interface elements: Include exactly 7 translucent glass UI panels/icons around the subject, all with soft glowing peach-white outlines: 1) left vertical neon quote panel reading “Influence. Inspire. Illuminate.” in handwritten script; 2) lower-left Instagram profile card with circular avatar, name “HANIA AI”, bio-style microtext, stats “850 Posts”, “1.2M Followers”, “320 Following”, and a pink-orange “Follow” button; 3) bottom-left rounded navigation bar with exactly 3 icons: heart, search, and paper-plane/send; 4) upper-right square Reels panel with a reels icon and the word “REELS”; 5) mid-right quote panel reading “Dream. Create. Inspire.”; 6) right engagement panel titled “ENGAGEMENT” listing exactly 3 metrics: heart “98.7K Likes”, comment “2.3K Comments”, share “1.1K Shares”; 7) bottom-right handle card with an Instagram icon, “@HANIA.AI”, and the small phrase “Aesthetic. Elegant. Empowering.”

Style: Premium luxury social-media campaign, cinematic photorealism mixed with glossy holographic UI design, Instagram creator-brand aesthetic, soft bloom, atmospheric depth, reflective glass, rose-gold highlights, elegant fashion-magazine finish.

Constraints: Keep all visible text crisp and legible, do not add extra UI panels beyond the exact 7 listed, do not add additional people, keep the platform floating above clouds, and maintain a polished aspirational fashion-poster mood.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张以 Instagram 为灵感的电影级高端时尚海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"}，一位魅力十足的年轻女性，在黄金时刻自信地站在云层之上的悬浮透明玻璃平台上，周围环绕着发光的社交媒体全息图和巨型排版文字。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，高级时尚编辑构图，全身主体位于巨大背景文字的略下方中心位置。采用暖桃色、香槟色、淡粉色、玫瑰金和紫蓝色组成的日落色调。超精致、光泽感，电影级灯光效果，带有镜头光晕和反射。

主体：一位时尚的年轻女性，留着柔顺的棕色波浪卷发，身穿优雅的奶油白色廓形西装外套、淡粉色缎面吊带背心、高腰奶油色阔腿裤，佩戴叠戴金项链、手镯和透明高跟凉鞋。她手提一个带有金链和金扣的精致奶油色小方包。姿态自信从容，一手插兜，一手提包，看向镜头。

环境：云层之上的未来主义奢华城市天际线，从屋顶高度的奇幻视角俯瞰。主体站在 1 个圆角方形悬浮玻璃平台上，平台边缘带有发光的玫瑰金灯带，表面有光泽反射，下方可见云层。背景天空为日落时分，伴有戏剧性的柔和云彩和温暖的轮廓光。

排版装置：在主体后方，创建 2 层巨大的光泽半透明霓虹排版文字，拼写出 {argument name="brand name" default="HANIA AI"}：背景上方为醒目的超大单词“HANIA”，主体右后方为第二个巨大的堆叠文字“AI”。字母为 3D 玻璃/亚克力材质，内部发出桃粉色光芒，带有玫瑰金金属轮廓、螺栓和明亮的边缘高光。

顶部文字：在顶部附近添加一个小型的居中标题，显示“HANIA AI”，字母间距拉开；下方添加较小的标语 {argument name="tagline" default="MADE TO INSPIRE"}。

全息界面元素：在主体周围包含 7 个半透明玻璃 UI 面板/图标，均带有柔和发光的桃白色轮廓：1) 左侧垂直霓虹引用面板，手写体显示“Influence. Inspire. Illuminate.”；2) 左下方 Instagram 个人资料卡，包含圆形头像、名称“HANIA AI”、简介风格微型文字、统计数据“850 Posts”、“1.2M Followers”、“320 Following”以及一个粉橙色“Follow”按钮；3) 左下角圆角导航栏，包含 3 个图标：心形、搜索和纸飞机/发送；4) 右上方方形 Reels 面板，带有 Reels 图标和单词“REELS”；5) 右侧中部引用面板，显示“Dream. Create. Inspire.”；6) 右侧互动面板，标题为“ENGAGEMENT”，列出 3 项指标：心形“98.7K Likes”、评论“2.3K Comments”、分享“1.1K Shares”；7) 右下角账号卡片，带有 Instagram 图标、“@HANIA.AI”以及短语“Aesthetic. Elegant. Empowering.”。

风格：高端奢华社交媒体广告，电影级写实主义与光泽感全息 UI 设计相结合，Instagram 创作者品牌美学，柔和光晕，大气深度，反射玻璃，玫瑰金高光，优雅时尚杂志质感。

约束：保持所有可见文字清晰易读，不要添加除上述 7 个面板之外的额外 UI 面板，不要添加其他人，保持平台悬浮于云层之上，并维持精致、令人向往的时尚海报氛围。

templates.title: Pastel Luxury AI Branding Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Pastel Luxury AI 品牌海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-resolution photorealistic luxury AI branding poster featuring a confident fashion-forward woman in a dreamy pastel futuristic environment.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, cinematic wide-angle view from slightly above, ultra-polished commercial advertising quality, soft pastel palette, glossy glass reflections, volumetric clouds, glowing holograms, no black borders.

Main subject: A glamorous young woman named {argument name="character name" default="Hania"} stands confidently near the front edge of a transparent floating glass platform above soft clouds. She has long flowing dark brown hair, soft glamorous makeup, elegant pearl jewelry, and a poised influencer/CEO posture. Her face should be intentionally softly obscured or blurred for privacy while the rest of the image remains sharp. She wears a cream tailored pantsuit with mint inner top and peach pocket accents, white pointed heels, layered necklaces, and small earrings. One hand touches her hair or sunglasses near her temple; the other holds a transparent glowing tablet displaying minimal AI interface graphics.

Layout: Place the woman centered foreground, full body visible. Behind her, create giant translucent 3D glowing letters spelling {argument name="headline text" default="HANIA AI"}, with the first word across the upper background and the second word large behind her lower torso. The letters are pastel cyan, peach, lavender, and mint, with luminous edges and glass-like material. Build the scene as a futuristic floating social-media control deck with rounded platforms, soft clouds below, and minimal sci-fi architectural elements on the right.

Discrete visible elements to include: exactly 1 central woman; exactly 2 rows of giant headline letters, reading “HANIA” on the top row and “AI” on the lower row; exactly 1 transparent tablet in her hand; exactly 1 large curved quote panel on the right; exactly 1 front-left branding panel; exactly 1 front-right social-media panel; exactly 2 wireframe globe graphics; exactly 2 small floating translucent UI cards on the left; exactly 1 large rounded rectangular HUD frame behind the left side of the headline; exactly 1 futuristic column-and-canopy structure in the upper-right background.

Text content: The giant background headline reads {argument name="headline text" default="HANIA AI"}. The curved translucent quote panel on the right reads {argument name="quote" default="Create trends, don’t follow them."}. The front-left floating panel reads “AI HANIA” with a circular AI icon. The front-right panel title reads “SOCIAL MEDIA” and includes exactly 4 small social icons underneath. Keep text clean, bold, white or softly glowing, and legible.

Visual style: Fresh pastel luxury aesthetic, cinematic art direction, photorealistic fashion editorial mixed with futuristic UI design. Use glassmorphism, translucent acrylic surfaces, glowing neon outlines, subtle bokeh particles, soft sunrise sky gradients, pearlescent highlights, and gentle reflections on the platform. Color palette should emphasize {argument name="pastel color palette" default="mint, lavender, peach, powder blue, and warm cream"}.

Constraints: Do not add extra people, extra headline words, cluttered text, watermarks, or logos beyond the specified brand panels. Keep the composition airy, aspirational, premium, and social-media-ready, with sharp clothing details and intentionally blurred facial identity.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张高分辨率、照片级写实的奢华 AI 品牌海报，展现一位自信且引领时尚的女性置身于梦幻般的柔和色彩未来环境中。

画布：3:4 竖版海报，电影级广角俯视视角，超精致商业广告品质，柔和的马卡龙色调，光亮的玻璃反射，体积云，发光全息图，无黑边。

主体：一位迷人的年轻女性（{argument name="character name" default="Hania"}）自信地站在云端上方透明悬浮玻璃平台的边缘。她留着飘逸的深棕色长发，妆容精致迷人，佩戴优雅的珍珠首饰，姿态从容，展现出网红或 CEO 的气质。为了保护隐私，她的面部应刻意保持柔和的模糊处理，而画面其余部分则保持清晰。她身穿奶油色定制西装，内搭薄荷绿上衣，配以桃色口袋装饰，脚穿白色尖头高跟鞋，佩戴叠层项链和小巧耳环。一只手轻触鬓角的头发或太阳镜，另一只手拿着一块透明的发光平板电脑，上面显示着极简的 AI 界面图形。

布局：将女性置于前景中心，全身可见。在她身后，创建巨大的半透明 3D 发光字母，拼写出 {argument name="headline text" default="HANIA AI"}，第一个词位于背景上方，第二个词位于她下半身后的较大位置。字母呈现马卡龙青色、桃色、薰衣草色和薄荷色，边缘发光，材质如玻璃般通透。将场景构建为一个未来感的社交媒体控制台，带有圆形平台、下方的柔和云层以及右侧极简的科幻建筑元素。

需包含的明确可见元素：1 位中心女性；2 行巨大的标题字母，顶行显示“HANIA”，底行显示“AI”；手中 1 块透明平板电脑；右侧 1 个大型弧形引语面板；左前方 1 个品牌面板；右前方 1 个社交媒体面板；2 个线框地球仪图形；左侧 2 张小型漂浮半透明 UI 卡片；标题左侧后方 1 个大型圆角矩形 HUD 框架；右上角背景中 1 个未来感柱状天篷结构。

文本内容：巨大的背景标题显示为 {argument name="headline text" default="HANIA AI"}。右侧弧形半透明引语面板显示 {argument name="quote" default="Create trends, don’t follow them."}。左前方悬浮面板显示“AI HANIA”及一个圆形 AI 图标。右前方面板标题显示“SOCIAL MEDIA”，下方包含 4 个小型社交图标。保持文本整洁、加粗、白色或柔和发光，且易于阅读。

视觉风格：清新的马卡龙奢华美学，电影级艺术指导，照片级写实时尚大片与未来感 UI 设计的融合。使用玻璃拟态、半透明亚克力表面、发光霓虹轮廓、细腻的散景粒子、柔和的日出天空渐变、珠光高光以及平台上柔和的反射。配色方案应强调 {argument name="pastel color palette" default="薄荷绿、薰衣草紫、桃色、粉蓝色和暖奶油色"}。

约束：不要添加额外人物、额外的标题词、杂乱的文字、水印或指定品牌面板之外的任何 Logo。保持构图通透、具有抱负感、高端且适合社交媒体发布，服装细节要清晰，面部身份要刻意模糊。

templates.title: Anime Comeback Posting Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格回归发布横幅

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean 16:9 anime-style social media banner about taking a one-day break from posting but returning anyway.

Canvas: Wide landscape canvas, pale warm off-white background, minimalist editorial magazine layout with muted burgundy accents, thin gray lines, small dot grids, and lots of negative space.

Main subject: A half-body anime illustration of {argument name="character description" default="a young woman with shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, wearing a black ribbed turtleneck sweater tucked into high-waisted camel-brown trousers with a black belt"}. Place her slightly right of center, facing the viewer. Her right arm reaches forward toward the camera with her index finger pointing directly outward, creating strong perspective foreshortening. Her left hand rests casually in a trouser pocket. Add soft painted shadows behind her and subtle hair strands around the face. Cover the upper face area with a large centered square mosaic/blur block in muted taupe, obscuring the face while leaving hair, ears, neck, and pointing finger visible.

Layout and text: Use exactly 5 main text groups. 1) On the left, a large vertical Japanese headline in brush-calligraphy style reading {argument name="left Japanese headline" default="1日投稿できませんでした、"}, with the numeral “1” large and burgundy and the remaining Japanese characters mostly black. 2) On the right side, large burgundy handwritten Japanese text reading {argument name="right Japanese phrase" default="でも…"}. 3) Along the far left edge, small vertical uppercase English text: “THANK YOU FOR WAITING.” 4) In the top-right corner, small stacked uppercase English text: “THANK YOU / FOR YOUR / PATIENCE.” 5) In the lower-right area, small uppercase English text: “I’LL BE BACK / STRONGER.”

Decorative elements: Include thin rectangular outline framing the left headline, a narrow burgundy vertical bar at the far left, tiny dotted square patterns near the top-left and lower-left, thin horizontal divider lines across the top and lower middle, a small burgundy square near the lower-right caption, a partial thin circle and dot motif on the right edge, and a burgundy diagonal hatch block in the bottom-right corner. Keep all decorations sparse and precise.

Visual style: Polished Japanese anime illustration mixed with modern editorial typography; muted palette of off-white, black, charcoal, camel brown, and dusty burgundy. Soft lighting, clean linework, gentle cel-shading, no photorealism.

Constraints: Maintain the same wide banner composition, keep the character centered-right and pointing at the viewer, include exactly the 5 text groups listed, avoid extra characters, logos, watermarks, or additional readable text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的 16:9 动漫风格社交媒体横幅，主题为休息一天后回归发布。

画布：宽幅横向画布，浅暖灰白色背景，极简主义杂志排版，带有柔和的酒红色点缀、细灰色线条、小型点阵网格以及大量留白。

主体：半身动漫插画，人物为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着齐肩深棕色波浪卷发的年轻女性，身穿黑色罗纹高领毛衣，塞进高腰驼棕色长裤中，系着黑色腰带"}。将她放置在偏右中心的位置，面向观众。她的右臂向镜头方向伸出，食指直接指向前方，形成强烈的透视缩短效果。左手随意地插在裤兜里。在身后添加柔和的阴影，并在脸部周围添加细致的发丝。用一个位于中心的大型方形马赛克/模糊块遮盖上脸部区域，采用柔和的灰褐色，遮住面部，同时保留头发、耳朵、脖子和指向前方的手指。

排版与文字：使用 5 组主要文字。1) 左侧为大型竖排日语标题，采用毛笔书法风格，内容为 {argument name="left Japanese headline" default="1日投稿できませんでした、"}，其中数字“1”较大且为酒红色，其余日语字符主要为黑色。2) 右侧为大型酒红色手写体日语文字 {argument name="right Japanese phrase" default="でも…"}。3) 最左侧边缘为小型竖排大写英文字符：“THANK YOU FOR WAITING.” 4) 右上角为小型堆叠大写英文字符：“THANK YOU / FOR YOUR / PATIENCE.” 5) 右下区域为小型大写英文字符：“I’LL BE BACK / STRONGER.”

装饰元素：包含勾勒左侧标题的细矩形边框、最左侧的窄酒红色竖条、左上角和左下角的小型点状方形图案、顶部和中下部的细水平分割线、右下角说明文字附近的小型酒红色方块、右边缘的部分细圆环和圆点图案，以及右下角的酒红色斜线填充块。装饰需保持稀疏且精准。

视觉风格：精致的日本动漫插画与现代编辑排版相结合；采用灰白、黑、炭灰、驼棕和灰酒红的柔和色调。光线柔和，线条清晰，采用轻柔的赛璐珞阴影，非写实风格。

约束条件：保持相同的宽幅横幅构图，将角色保持在偏右中心并指向观众，包含列出的 5 组文字，避免出现额外字符、Logo、水印或其他可读文字。

templates.title: Luxury Telegram Cyber Hub Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华 Telegram 赛博风海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical futuristic luxury cyber-aesthetic poster inspired by Telegram, showing {argument name="character description" default="a confident young woman with long dark wavy hair"} standing inside a glowing holographic communication hub above a futuristic city.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 composition, cinematic high-resolution digital art, cool monochrome palette of electric blue, cyan, navy, chrome silver, and soft white cloud light. The camera is front-facing at waist-up to full-body crop, centered symmetry, dramatic sci-fi lighting, glossy reflections, volumetric glow, and a premium cyberpunk atmosphere.

Main subject: The woman stands confidently in the center with hands in her trouser pockets, wearing an oversized metallic silver blazer, matching tailored trousers, a pale blue top, layered silver necklaces, a glowing belt buckle, a chain accessory hanging from the waist, and subtle holographic UI patches on the jacket sleeve and lapel. Her face is intentionally hidden by a plain vertical matte gray rectangle covering the central facial area. Keep her hair visible around the rectangle. She should look like a luxury tech ambassador or digital nomad icon.

Environment: Place her in a transparent circular sky lounge or observatory with curved glass walls, glowing circular floor rings, polished reflective floor, and futuristic skyscrapers rising through bright clouds outside. Add a large overhead circular ceiling light and a luminous vertical beam descending from above.

Central hologram: Above the woman’s head, create one massive glowing paper-plane logo hologram inside a circular digital portal, made of translucent cyan light, particle sparks, HUD rings, and thin radial data lines. Make this the dominant icon in the image.

Floating interface panels: Include exactly 9 blue translucent holographic panels around the subject, each with rounded corners, cyan borders, faint glass blur, tiny icons, check marks, and encrypted-chat styling:
1. Top-left large Telegram channel panel with the visible title "Telegram", status words "Encrypted", "Secure", and "Cloud", a channel named "CyberWave Channel", "32.5K members", a pinned message reading "The future is encrypted.", and a chat preview from "Techno Empire" saying "The future is ours.".
2. Middle-left incoming message panel reading "INCOMING MESSAGE", "From: CyberWave", and the main message {argument name="main message text" default="The Future Is Ours."}, with a small decrypting progress bar.
3. Lower-left audio waveform panel showing a glowing cyan sound wave timeline.
4. Bottom-left security panel with a lock icon and text implying secure connection, end-to-end encryption, and protocol information.
5. Top-right chat card from "Digital Nomad" reading "Freedom is our protocol." with a timestamp and double-check marks.
6. Upper-right chat card from "Visionaries" reading "We build tomorrow." with a timestamp and double-check marks.
7. Mid-right chat card from "Blockchain" reading "Beyond limits." with a timestamp and double-check marks.
8. Lower-mid-right chat card from "AI Revolution" reading "Smart. Fast. Unstoppable." with a timestamp and double-check marks.
9. Bottom-right channel stats panel reading "CHANNEL STATS", "125.7K Subscribers", "2.4M Views", and a small rising line graph.

Style details: Use ultra-detailed sci-fi UI design, transparent glassmorphism, neon cyan outlines, tiny data glyphs, encrypted-message motifs, paper-plane icons, holographic particles, clean typography, atmospheric depth, reflective chrome fabric, rim lighting along the blazer, and soft cloud-filled daylight outside the tower. The mood should feel aspirational, futuristic, secure, and luxurious.

Text constraints: Keep all visible interface text in English. Use crisp readable text only for the main panel labels and key phrases; tiny secondary microtext may be decorative. Avoid extra logos, watermarks, brand clutter, or additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张垂直构图的未来主义奢华赛博风海报，灵感源自 Telegram，展示 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深色长波浪卷发的自信年轻女性"} 站在未来城市上空一个发光的全息通讯中心内。

画布：2:3 纵向构图，电影级高分辨率数字艺术，采用电光蓝、青色、海军蓝、铬银色和柔和白云光的冷色调单色调色板。相机采用腰部以上至全身的正面取景，居中对称，具有戏剧性的科幻灯光、光泽反射、体积光效果以及高级的赛博朋克氛围。

主体：女性自信地站在中心，双手插在裤兜里，身穿超大号金属银色西装外套，搭配同款定制长裤、浅蓝色上衣、叠戴银色项链、发光的皮带扣、腰间悬挂的链条配饰，外套袖口和翻领上有精致的全息 UI 贴片。她的面部被一个垂直的哑光灰色矩形刻意遮挡，仅露出矩形周围的头发。她看起来像是一位奢华科技大使或数字游民偶像。

环境：将她置于一个透明的圆形空中休息室或观景台内，配有弧形玻璃墙、发光的圆形地板环、抛光反射地面，窗外是穿过明亮云层的未来派摩天大楼。增加一个巨大的头顶圆形天花板灯，以及从上方投射下的发光垂直光束。

中央全息图：在女性头部上方，创建一个巨大的发光纸飞机 Logo 全息图，置于一个圆形数字传送门内，由半透明的青色光线、粒子火花、HUD 圆环和细密的径向数据线组成。使其成为画面中最醒目的图标。

悬浮界面面板：在主体周围包含 9 个蓝色的半透明全息面板，每个面板均带有圆角、青色边框、淡淡的玻璃模糊效果、微型图标、对勾标记和加密聊天样式：
1. 左上角大型 Telegram 频道面板，带有可见标题“Telegram”，状态词“Encrypted”、“Secure”和“Cloud”，频道名称为“CyberWave Channel”，“32.5K members”，置顶消息显示“The future is encrypted.”，以及来自“Techno Empire”的聊天预览，内容为“The future is ours.”。
2. 左中侧接收消息面板，显示“INCOMING MESSAGE”、“From: CyberWave”以及主消息 {argument name="main message text" default="The Future Is Ours."}，并配有一个小型解密进度条。
3. 左下侧音频波形面板，显示发光的青色声波时间轴。
4. 左下角安全面板，带有锁形图标和暗示安全连接、端到端加密及协议信息的文本。
5. 右上角来自“Digital Nomad”的聊天卡片，内容为“Freedom is our protocol.”，带有时间戳和双对勾标记。
6. 右上方来自“Visionaries”的聊天卡片，内容为“We build tomorrow.”，带有时间戳和双对勾标记。
7. 右中侧来自“Blockchain”的聊天卡片，内容为“Beyond limits.”，带有时间戳和双对勾标记。
8. 右下中侧来自“AI Revolution”的聊天卡片，内容为“Smart. Fast. Unstoppable.”，带有时间戳和双对勾标记。
9. 右下角频道统计面板，显示“CHANNEL STATS”、“125.7K Subscribers”、“2.4M Views”以及一个小型的上升折线图。

风格细节：使用超精细的科幻 UI 设计、透明玻璃拟态、霓虹青色轮廓、微型数据字形、加密消息图案、纸飞机图标、全息粒子、清晰的排版、大气深度、反光铬金属面料、西装外套边缘的轮廓光，以及塔楼外云雾缭绕的柔和日光。整体氛围应体现出进取、未来感、安全与奢华。

文本限制：所有可见的界面文本均保持为英文。仅在主面板标签和关键短语处使用清晰易读的文本；微小的次要微文本可作为装饰。避免添加额外的 Logo、水印、品牌杂乱信息或额外的人物。

templates.title: Moody Phone-Lit Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 手机光影下的忧郁肖像

templates.prompt: Create a moody, realistic vertical photograph of an adult woman in a dimly lit room, leaning forward on a sofa or bed while looking down at a glowing smartphone near the bottom right edge of the frame. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a messy bun, her head angled downward so most facial features are hidden, with one ear and the side of her neck visible. She wears a loose, semi-sheer {argument name="robe color" default="white"} robe or oversized shirt with a draped neckline and soft folds, giving a quiet late-night intimate atmosphere without nudity. Add a large opaque rectangular censor block over the face area, positioned from the right-center of the image across the head and upper face, colored {argument name="censor block color" default="dark muted brown"}. Use low-key naturalistic lighting, with the smartphone casting a small cool white-blue glow on her hand and sleeve, while the background remains dark, blurred, and brown-gray. Compose as a close vertical crop, subject filling most of the frame, shoulder and robe on the left, face area on the upper right, hand and phone at the bottom right. Photographic style: soft grain, shallow depth of field, muted colors, subdued contrast, candid cinematic realism, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张忧郁且写实的竖构图照片，展现一位身处昏暗房间的成年女性，她俯身在沙发或床上，低头注视着画面右下角发光的智能手机。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，扎成凌乱的发髻，头部向下倾斜，大部分面部特征被遮挡，仅露出耳朵和颈部侧面。她穿着一件宽松、半透明的 {argument name="robe color" default="白色"} 长袍或超大号衬衫，领口垂坠且带有柔和的褶皱，营造出深夜静谧的亲密氛围，且不含裸露内容。在面部区域添加一个大型不透明矩形遮挡块，位置从图像右侧中心横跨头部和上半部脸，颜色为 {argument name="censor block color" default="深哑光棕色"}。采用低调的自然光照明，智能手机在她的手部和袖子上投射出微弱的冷白蓝色光芒，背景保持黑暗、模糊且呈棕灰色。构图采用紧凑的竖向裁剪，主体占据大部分画面，左侧为肩膀和长袍，右上侧为面部区域，右下侧为手部和手机。摄影风格：柔和颗粒感、浅景深、柔和色彩、低对比度、坦率的电影级写实感，无文字，无水印。
