templates.title: Anime Dakimakura Preorder Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫抱枕预售海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished Japanese anime merchandise preorder announcement poster for an official dakimakura body pillow cover featuring {argument name="character name" default="のぞむ"}, styled like a real limited-time goods release visual.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 ratio, soft pastel spring palette with pink, sky blue, white, and cream. Use a dreamy glossy commercial anime look with bokeh, sunlight, window reflections, cherry blossoms, and floating petals.

Main layout: Split composition with the main character illustration occupying the entire left two-thirds, lying diagonally on a white body pillow. On the right third, place the product title, preorder ribbon, bonus items, a full-body pillow-cover mockup, and product specs. A wide hot-pink preorder banner spans the bottom.

Subject details: Draw one beautiful young anime girl with long fluffy wavy pastel pink hair, soft blue eyes, delicate features, and a gentle spring-like expression. She wears a loose white top, beige oversized coat slipping off the shoulders, teal-blue high-waisted skirt with belt, and white thigh-high socks. Her pose is relaxed and cute on the pillow, with one hand near her hair. Maintain an airy romantic atmosphere. Cover the center of her face with a plain opaque pale pink rectangle placeholder, as if a privacy/name-input mask has been placed over the generated face.

Visible text and typography: Use elegant Japanese promotional typography. Top right pink ribbon: 「公式グッズ化シリーズ 第1弾」. Large headline: 「{argument name="headline character text" default="のぞむ"} 抱き枕カバー」. Subtitle: 「ときめく春のひととき」. Pink ribbon below: 「期間限定受注」. Left vertical copy beside the pillow: 「春のときめき、ぎゅっと抱きしめて。」. Price area bottom left: 「価格 16,500円(税込)」. Bottom wide banner large text: 「予約受付中」. Bottom right date line: 「5/24(金)〜6/30(日)23:59まで」. Tiny disclaimer under the banner: 「※画像はイメージです。実際の商品とは異なる場合がございます。」.

Right-side product section: Include exactly 1 labeled back-side design card with the label 「裏面デザイン」 showing a smaller alternate pillow-cover illustration of the same girl. Include exactly 1 full-length dakimakura mockup in the center-right, showing the character standing on a long pillow cover. Include exactly 3 bonus items under the heading 「豪華特典3点セット」: 1 illustrated card labeled 「描き下ろしイラストカード」, 1 acrylic keychain labeled 「アクリルキーホルダー」, and 1 clear bookmark labeled 「クリアしおり」. Arrange these as small product thumbnails with soft shadows, pink swoosh accents, and blue label text.

Product specs box: Bottom right translucent white card titled 「製品仕様」 with exactly 6 lines: 「サイズ：160×50cm」, 「生地：2WAYトリコット」, 「印刷：フルカラー昇華転写」, 「仕様：両面印刷／ファスナー付き」, 「素材：ポリエステル85% ポリウレタン15%」, 「生産国：日本製」.

Visual style: High-end official anime goods advertisement, soft gradients, clean grid, delicate pink ribbons, white translucent panels, polished print design, realistic product mockups, no watermark, no extra characters, no additional bonus items, and keep all text legible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张精美的日系动漫周边预售公告海报，用于官方 {argument name="character name" default="のぞむ"} 等身抱枕套，呈现出真实限时商品发售的视觉效果。

画布：竖版海报，4:5 比例，采用粉色、天蓝色、白色和奶油色的柔和春日色调。使用梦幻般的亮面商业动漫风格，包含光斑、阳光、窗户倒影、樱花及飘落的花瓣。

主要布局：采用分割式构图，主体角色插画占据左侧三分之二，斜卧在白色抱枕上。右侧三分之一处放置产品标题、预售丝带、赠品、抱枕套全貌展示图及产品规格。底部横跨一条亮粉色的预售横幅。

角色细节：绘制一位美丽的年轻动漫少女，拥有长而蓬松的波浪状浅粉色头发、柔和的蓝色眼睛、精致的五官，表情如春日般温柔。身穿宽松的白色上衣、滑落肩头的米色大衣、青蓝色高腰裙配腰带，以及白色过膝袜。她在抱枕上的姿势放松可爱，一只手靠近头发。营造出轻盈浪漫的氛围。用一个纯色不透明的浅粉色矩形遮住她面部中心，如同在生成的脸部上添加了隐私/名称输入遮罩。

可见文字与排版：使用优雅的日式宣传字体。右上角粉色丝带：「公式グッズ化シリーズ 第1弾」。大标题：「{argument name="headline character text" default="のぞむ"} 抱き枕カバー」。副标题：「ときめく春のひととき」。下方粉色丝带：「期間限定受注」。抱枕左侧竖排文案：「春のときめき、ぎゅっと抱きしめて。」。左下角价格区域：「価格 16,500円(税込)」。底部宽横幅大字：「予約受付中」。右下角日期行：「5/24(金)〜6/30(日)23:59まで」。横幅下方的小字免责声明：「※画像はイメージです。実際の商品とは異なる場合がございます。」。

右侧产品区域：包含 1 张带有「裏面デザイン」标签的背面设计卡，展示该角色较小的备选抱枕套插画。在右侧中部包含 1 个完整的等身抱枕 mockup，展示角色站在长抱枕套上的样子。在「豪華特典3点セット」标题下包含 3 件赠品：1 张标有「描き下ろしイラストカード」的插画卡，1 个标有「アクリルキーホルダー」的亚克力钥匙扣，以及 1 个标有「クリアしおり」的透明书签。将这些作为带有柔和阴影、粉色弧线装饰和蓝色标签文字的小型产品缩略图进行排列。

产品规格框：右下角半透明白色卡片，标题为「製品仕様」，包含 6 行内容：「サイズ：160×50cm」、「生地：2WAYトリコット」、「印刷：フルカラー昇華転写」、「仕様：両面印刷／ファスナー付き」、「素材：ポリエステル85% ポリウレタン15%」、「生産国：日本製」。

视觉风格：高端动漫官方周边广告，柔和的渐变，整洁的网格，精致的粉色丝带，白色半透明面板，精美的印刷设计，写实的产品 mockup，无水印，无多余角色，无额外赠品，确保所有文字清晰易读。

templates.title: Sheep Good-Luck Charm Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 绵羊好运护身符海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a soft Japanese storybook-style good-luck charm poster themed around sheep magic and bedtime gratitude.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 illustration, warm ivory parchment background with subtle watercolor texture, faint circular astrological orbit lines, gold speckles, and dreamy celestial accents.

Layout: Place the character on the left third, facing forward and reaching one hand toward the viewer with an index finger pointing outward. Keep the right two-thirds mostly open for elegant Japanese typography. Center the title in the upper-right area, a thin gold divider line with a small star beneath it, then two centered message lines below. Add a tiny sheep icon near the lower center under the message.

Subject details: Illustrate exactly 1 young girl in a gentle watercolor anime picture-book style. She has wavy light brown shoulder-length hair, a fluffy white sheep hood with two floppy ears, and a pale sage-green long-sleeve dress with small white daisy prints and soft ruffles. Her face is intentionally hidden by a plain skin-toned square with no facial features. She carries exactly 1 woven wicker basket in her other hand, decorated with exactly 1 cute sheep face ornament and a bit of white wool trim. Behind her on the far left is exactly 1 large gold crescent moon.

Text content: Use Japanese calligraphy-inspired typography. Main title: {argument name="headline text" default="ひつじのおまじない"} followed by exactly 1 pink faceted heart emoji/gem on the right. Message line 1: {argument name="message line one" default="今日ラッキーだった事を"}. Message line 2: {argument name="message line two" default="ひとつ思い出してから寝よう"}. Highlight the word 「ラッキー」 in soft pink while the rest of the message is dark warm brown.

Decorative elements: Include exactly 1 main gold crescent moon, exactly 1 pink heart gem, exactly 1 small gold sheep icon under the text, exactly 1 thin horizontal divider line with a central star, and numerous tiny gold stars, dots, and constellation-like arcs distributed lightly across the background. Add soft white daisies and pale green foliage in the lower-left and lower-right corners without overpowering the text.

Visual style: Delicate watercolor, soft beige and gold palette, airy magical bedtime mood, Japanese kawaii fairy-tale atmosphere, gentle paper grain, low contrast, elegant and calming.

Constraints: Keep all typography crisp and readable, preserve the wide poster composition, avoid modern UI elements, avoid photorealism, no watermark, no extra characters, no extra main text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张柔和的日式绘本风格好运护身符海报，主题围绕绵羊魔法与睡前感恩。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向插画，温暖的象牙色羊皮纸背景，带有细腻的水彩纹理、淡淡的圆形星象轨道线、金色斑点以及梦幻般的天体装饰。

布局：将角色放置在左侧三分之一处，面向前方，一只手伸向观众，食指指向外侧。右侧三分之二区域保持大面积留白，用于展示优雅的日式排版。标题置于右上区域中心，下方设有一条细金线分割符及一颗小星，下方居中排列两行留言。在留言下方的底部中心处添加一个小巧的绵羊图标。

主体细节：绘制 1 位采用柔和水彩动漫绘本风格的年轻女孩。她留着波浪状浅棕色齐肩短发，戴着带有两只垂耳的毛茸茸白色绵羊头套，身穿浅鼠尾草绿色的长袖连衣裙，裙上有白色小雏菊印花和柔和的荷叶边。她的面部特意用一个纯肤色的正方形遮挡，没有任何五官。她另一只手提着 1 个编织柳条篮，篮子上装饰着 1 个可爱的绵羊脸挂件和少许白色羊毛饰边。在她左侧远方背景中，有 1 轮巨大的金色新月。

文字内容：使用受日式书法启发的字体。主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="ひつじのおまじない"}，右侧紧跟 1 个粉色多面心形表情/宝石。留言第一行：{argument name="message line one" default="今日ラッキーだった事を"}。留言第二行：{argument name="message line two" default="ひとつ思い出してから寝よう"}。将「ラッキー」一词高亮显示为柔粉色，其余文字为深暖棕色。

装饰元素：包含 1 轮主金色新月、1 颗粉色心形宝石、文字下方 1 个小型金色绵羊图标、1 条带有中心星形的细水平分割线，以及分布在背景中、如同星座弧线般的众多细小金星、圆点。在左下角和右下角添加柔和的白色雏菊和浅绿色叶片，且不遮挡文字。

视觉风格：精致水彩，柔和的米色与金色调，轻盈梦幻的睡前氛围，日式可爱童话气息，细腻的纸张纹理，低对比度，优雅且令人平静。

限制：保持所有排版清晰易读，保留宽幅海报构图，避免使用现代 UI 元素，避免照片写实，无水印，无额外角色，无额外主文字。

variables.defaultValue: 今日ラッキーだった事を

templates.title: Anime Dakimakura Preorder Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫抱枕预售海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished Japanese anime merchandise announcement poster for an official dakimakura body pillow cover featuring {argument name="character name" default="のぞむ"}, styled like a real preorder sales visual for a limited official goods release.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, soft ivory and pale powder-blue palette, elegant lace borders, faint floral patterns, sparkles, satin fabric texture, ornate gold trim, high-resolution commercial key visual.

Layout: Split composition with the character occupying the left half and product information on the right half. On the left, show a full-body anime girl reclining diagonally on a white dakimakura pillow, surrounded by pale blue flowers, ribbon bows, lace, petals, and soft bedding folds. Add a small ornate circular deadline badge at bottom left. On the right, place stacked promotional typography and boxed information panels: a ribbon banner at top, large product title, preorder banner, price line, specification box, sample product thumbnail, bonus section with three items, and a large blue call-to-action button at the bottom.

Main character: A beautiful delicate anime girl with long wavy light brown hair, fair skin, soft romantic expression, and an elegant white-and-sky-blue lolita dress. She wears a wide pale blue hat with lace, flowers, and ribbons, a white blouse with puff sleeves, blue bow accents, layered frilled skirt, lace trim, thigh ribbon detail, and bare feet. She reclines gracefully on the pillow with one hand lifted near her face holding a small ornate accessory or chain, legs extended naturally. Place a vertical soft beige rectangular privacy/name-input mask over the face area, obscuring the face while leaving hair, hat, pose, and outfit visible.

Text content: Use Japanese promotional copy in refined Mincho-style and handwritten-style fonts. Top ribbon: {argument name="series label" default="公式グッズ化シリーズ 第1弾"}. Large title: {argument name="product title" default="のぞむ 抱き枕カバー"}. Subtitle: 「— やさしい時間 —」. Main blue banner: {argument name="preorder headline" default="予約受付中"}. Smaller label beneath: 「期間限定受注」. Price line: {argument name="price" default="価格 16,500円(税込)"}. Bottom-left deadline badge: 「完全受注生産 2025年 6月30日(月)まで」. Product specification panel title: 「商品仕様」 with exactly 5 bullet points: 「サイズ：約160×50cm」, 「生地：2WAYトリコット」, 「両面フルカラー印刷」, 「ファスナー付き」, 「日本製」. Reservation bonus panel title: 「予約特典」 with exactly 3 numbered bonus items: ① 「描き下ろし A5イラストカード」, ② 「アクリルチャーム」, ③ 「クリアしおり」. Bottom button: 「ご予約はこちら」 with a white arrow icon. Add tiny legal footer text and copyright line at the bottom edge.

Bonus and product visuals: Include exactly 1 small product thumbnail near the specification box showing the same reclining character art. Include exactly 3 bonus preview images in the bonus panel: one A5 illustration card, one acrylic charm with a small chain, and one clear bookmark, all using miniature versions of the same character artwork; the acrylic charm preview also has a small beige face mask over the face.

Visual style: Premium shojo-anime illustration, airy watercolor shading, soft highlights, delicate linework, ornate feminine packaging design, blue-and-gold commercial banner elements, clean readable Japanese typography, realistic official preorder poster feel.

Constraints: Keep the poster information-dense but elegant, preserve the exact count of 5 product specification bullets and 3 preorder bonus items, do not add extra characters, avoid logos or watermarks beyond the small copyright/footer, and make the face-obscuring beige rectangle intentional and centered over the main face.

templates.title: Zheng He 3D Historical Archive Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 郑和 3D 历史档案海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical cinematic 3D historical figure archive poster about {argument name="historical figure" default="Zheng He"}, presenting him as a monumental explorer standing on the prow of a Ming dynasty treasure ship, with archival timeline panels floating around him.

Canvas: Tall 3:4 poster, epic historical documentary style, warm sepia and ocean-blue palette, high detail, dramatic perspective from slightly below, realistic 3D render mixed with aged parchment infographic design.

Main subject: A full-body Ming dynasty admiral in ornate embroidered robes, cloak, belt ornaments, and official headwear stands heroically on the carved wooden bow of a large sailing ship. His right arm thrusts a long rolled nautical map directly toward the viewer, creating strong foreshortening. His left hand rests near the ship rail. Keep the face softly obscured or indistinct, while the costume, posture, and props remain sharp. The figure should feel powerful, statuesque, and breaking out of the poster space.

Background: Massive canvas sails and rigging rise behind him, with faint large Chinese calligraphy on the sail. Sailors and officials occupy the deck to the right. The ship cuts through rough waves, sea spray, and mist. A distant harbor city and fleet silhouettes appear low on the left horizon, with a few birds in the cloudy sky.

Left title area: Large bold black ink-brush Chinese calligraphy reading {argument name="main calligraphy" default="郑和"}. Beside it, add slim vertical Chinese subtitle text: “航海家 · 远洋使节 · 七下西洋”. Add the date range “1371—1433” and a small red seal stamp. Include a narrow vertical note about the Ming dynasty navigator and diplomat opening the maritime Silk Road.

Infographic overlay: Use thin glowing gold lines, corner brackets, small nodes, and translucent parchment-glass rectangles. Include exactly 8 numbered archival cards with small monochrome historical scene images and Chinese captions:
1. “01 1371 出生云南” showing a mountain town or old city.
2. “02 1382 入宫服侍” showing palace or court imagery.
3. “03 1402 受命远航” showing an imperial command or ship deck ceremony.
4. “04 1405 首下西洋” showing a fleet departing on the ocean.
5. “05 1407–1433 七下西洋” showing ships and sea routes.
6. “06 访问诸国” showing diplomatic exchange with foreign envoys.
7. “07 和平友好” showing meetings, gifts, and mutual trade.
8. “08 1433之后 选择深远” showing ships fading into distance and legacy imagery.

Bottom timeline: Add a thin horizontal gold timeline with exactly 6 labeled milestones: “1371 出生云南”, “1382 入宫服侍”, “1402 受命远航”, “1405 首下西洋”, “1407–1433 七下西洋”, “1433之后 选择深远”. Use small dots and delicate vertical tick marks.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed cinematic 3D, historical realism, museum-exhibit infographic, parchment texture, gold technical-line overlays, atmospheric haze, dramatic lighting, carved ship ornamentation, fabric embroidery, weathered nautical map texture, dynamic waves, no modern objects.

Constraints: Maintain the exact count of 8 floating cards and 6 bottom timeline milestones. Keep all visible poster text in Chinese as specified. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra panels, or unrelated characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于 {argument name="historical figure" default="郑和"} 的竖版电影质感 3D 历史人物档案海报，将他呈现为站在明代宝船船头的伟大探险家，周围环绕着悬浮的档案时间线面板。

画布：高比例 3:4 海报，史诗级历史纪录片风格，暖棕褐色与海洋蓝配色，高细节，略微仰视的戏剧性视角，写实 3D 渲染与陈旧羊皮纸信息图设计相结合。

主体：一位身着华丽刺绣长袍、披风、腰饰及官帽的明代海军统帅，英勇地站在大型帆船的雕花木质船头上。他的右臂将一卷长长的航海图直接指向观众，形成强烈的透视感。他的左手放在船舷附近。保持面部柔和模糊或不清晰，同时服装、姿态和道具保持清晰锐利。人物应给人以强大、雕塑般的感觉，仿佛要冲出海报空间。

背景：巨大的帆布和索具在他身后升起，帆上有隐约可见的大型中文书法。水手和官员在右侧甲板上。船只破开汹涌的波浪、海浪飞沫和薄雾。远处的港口城市和船队剪影出现在左侧低地平线上，多云的天空中飞着几只鸟。

左侧标题区：大型粗体水墨书法，书写 {argument name="main calligraphy" default="郑和"}。旁边添加纤细的竖排中文副标题：“航海家 · 远洋使节 · 七下西洋”。添加日期范围“1371—1433”和一个红色小印章。包含一段关于明代航海家和外交官开启海上丝绸之路的窄竖排注释。

信息图叠加：使用纤细的金色发光线条、边角括号、小节点和半透明的羊皮纸质感矩形。包含 8 张带编号的档案卡片，每张卡片配有小型单色历史场景图像和中文说明：
1. “01 1371 出生云南”，展示山城或古城。
2. “02 1382 入宫服侍”，展示宫廷或朝廷意象。
3. “03 1402 受命远航”，展示圣旨或船上仪式。
4. “04 1405 首下西洋”，展示船队出海。
5. “05 1407–1433 七下西洋”，展示船只和航线。
6. “06 访问诸国”，展示与外国使节的外交交流。
7. “07 和平友好”，展示会晤、礼品和贸易往来。
8. “08 1433之后 选择深远”，展示远去的船只和历史遗产意象。

底部时间线：添加一条纤细的水平金色时间线，包含 6 个标注的里程碑：“1371 出生云南”、“1382 入宫服侍”、“1402 受命远航”、“1405 首下西洋”、“1407–1433 七下西洋”、“1433之后 选择深远”。使用小圆点和精致的竖向刻度线。

视觉风格：超精细电影级 3D，历史写实主义，博物馆展览信息图，羊皮纸纹理，金色技术线条叠加，大气朦胧感，戏剧性光影，雕刻船饰，织物刺绣，风化的航海图纹理，动态海浪，无现代物品。

约束：保持 8 张悬浮卡片和 6 个底部时间线里程碑的精确数量。海报上所有可见文字均按指定使用中文。不要添加任何标志、水印、额外面板或无关字符。

templates.title: Zhang Qian 3D Historical Archive Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 张骞 3D 历史档案海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical cinematic 3D historical figure archive poster about {argument name="character name" default="张骞"}, showing an ancient Chinese explorer breaking out of a documentary-style timeline layout with strong depth and motion.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, sepia desert palette, high-detail realistic 3D render mixed with aged parchment infographic design. Use dramatic backlight, dusty atmosphere, wind-blown fabric, shallow depth of field, and a grand Silk Road expedition mood.

Main subject: A full-body ancient Han dynasty envoy stands in the center foreground on a rocky desert road. His face is intentionally covered by a soft square pixelated blur. He wears layered worn robes, leather belts, travel wraps, boots, and a red-brown scarf blowing in the wind. His left arm stretches forward holding a large unrolled parchment map that projects toward the viewer in forced perspective; the map is labeled in Chinese as {argument name="map title" default="西域线路图"} and contains route lines and place names. His right hand holds a tall ceremonial staff with an ornate metal finial and a hanging vertical red banner reading {argument name="banner text" default="汉节"}. Behind him, show a caravan of camels, riders, soldiers, flags, and a distant western-region city gate under a hazy sky with birds.

Left title column: Place huge black ink-brush Chinese calligraphy vertically reading {argument name="main title" default="张骞"}. Add smaller vertical Chinese descriptors beside it describing him as an opener of the Western Regions and Silk Road pioneer, plus dates “前164—前114” and a small red seal stamp. Keep the typography elegant, historical, and museum-like.

Floating archive panels: Use exactly 6 translucent glass-and-gold-line information cards around the figure, each with thin borders, small glowing corner nodes, miniature monochrome historical scene illustrations, and Chinese headings. Count and place them as follows: 1) upper left card, “01 前138 奉汉出使”, with a small envoy departure scene; 2) upper right card, “02 前129 被匈奴扣留”, with a captivity or horsemen scene; 3) lower left-middle card, “03 前119 再通西域”, with a caravan scene; 4) right-middle card, “04 前115 联络诸国”, with diplomats and allies; 5) lower right card, “05 前114 回到长安”, with return-to-capital imagery; 6) bottom-left large card, “06 丝路初开”, showing a route map and camel caravan.

Bottom timeline: Add one thin horizontal timeline across the bottom with exactly 6 labeled milestones, evenly spaced: “前164 出生 汉中郡城固”, “前138 奉汉出使 出使大月氏”, “前129 被匈奴扣留 持节不屈”, “前119 再通西域 抵达大月氏”, “前115 联络诸国 建立友好”, “前114 回到长安 报告见闻”. Use small serif-like Chinese type, warm off-white ink, and subtle gold tick marks.

Visual style: Epic historical realism, photorealistic cloth and leather textures, parchment infographic overlay, museum exhibition poster, ancient Chinese frontier expedition, desert dust, wind, warm bronze and beige tones, sharp foreground map, cinematic perspective, volumetric light, ultra-detailed 3D立像档案 aesthetic.

Constraints: Preserve exactly one central figure, one large parchment map, one ceremonial staff with one hanging banner, six floating archive cards, and six bottom timeline milestones. Avoid modern objects, avoid extra panels, avoid neon colors, and do not add a watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张垂直构图的电影质感 3D 历史人物档案海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="张骞"}，展现这位中国古代探险家冲破纪录片式时间轴布局的画面，具有强烈的深度感与动态感。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，采用深褐色沙漠色调，高细节写实 3D 渲染与陈旧羊皮纸信息图设计相结合。运用戏剧性的背光、尘土飞扬的氛围、随风飘动的织物、浅景深以及宏大的丝绸之路探险意境。

主体：一位汉代使节全身像，站在前景中央的岩石沙漠道路上。他的面部刻意被柔和的方形像素模糊遮盖。他身着层叠的旧长袍、皮带、绑腿、靴子，一条红棕色围巾在风中飘扬。他的左臂向前伸展，握着一张巨大的展开羊皮纸地图，以强迫透视法向观众投射；地图上用中文标注为 {argument name="map title" default="西域线路图"}，并绘有路线和地名。他的右手握着一根高大的仪仗节杖，顶端有精致的金属装饰，挂着一条垂直的红色旗帜，上书 {argument name="banner text" default="汉节"}。在他身后，展现一支骆驼商队、骑兵、士兵、旗帜，以及朦胧天空下远处的西域城门，天空中飞鸟掠过。

左侧标题栏：放置巨大的黑色毛笔书法，垂直书写 {argument name="main title" default="张骞"}。旁边添加较小的垂直中文描述，将其称为西域开拓者和丝绸之路先驱，并标注日期“前 164—前 114”以及一枚红色小印章。排版需保持优雅、历史感和博物馆风格。

悬浮档案面板：在人物周围放置 6 张半透明玻璃与金色线条构成的资料卡，每张卡片带有细边框、微小的发光角节点、微型单色历史场景插图和中文标题。布局如下：1) 左上角卡片，“01 前 138 奉汉出使”，配以使节出发场景；2) 右上角卡片，“02 前 129 被匈奴扣留”，配以被俘或骑兵场景；3) 左中下卡片，“03 前 119 再通西域”，配以商队场景；4) 右中卡片，“04 前 115 联络诸国”，配以外交官与盟友场景；5) 右下卡片，“05 前 114 回到长安”，配以回京场景；6) 左下大卡片，“06 丝路初开”，展示路线图与骆驼商队。

底部时间轴：在底部添加一条细长的水平时间轴，包含 6 个均匀分布的里程碑节点：“前 164 出生 汉中郡城固”、“前 138 奉汉出使 出使大月氏”、“前 129 被匈奴扣留 持节不屈”、“前 119 再通西域 抵达大月氏”、“前 115 联络诸国 建立友好”、“前 114 回到长安 报告见闻”。使用衬线风格的中文小字体、暖米白色墨迹以及精致的金色刻度。

视觉风格：史诗级历史写实主义，照片级的布料与皮革纹理，羊皮纸信息图叠加，博物馆展览海报，中国古代边疆探险，沙漠尘埃，风感，暖青铜与米色调，清晰的前景地图，电影级透视，体积光，超精细 3D 立像档案美学。

约束：严格保留一个中心人物、一张大羊皮纸地图、一根带有挂旗的仪仗节杖、六张悬浮档案卡和六个底部时间轴里程碑。避免出现现代物品，避免多余面板，避免霓虹色，且不得添加水印。

templates.title: 3D Xuanzang Historical Archive Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 玄奘历史档案海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical 3D historical figure archive poster about {argument name="character name" default="Xuanzang"}, showing a Tang dynasty monk as a monumental full-body statue-like traveler walking toward the viewer through a desert Silk Road landscape. Use an epic museum-exhibition style with realistic 3D rendering, documentary historical atmosphere, and floating translucent data panels.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, warm sepia and dusty gold color palette, high detail, dramatic backlight, hazy sky, windblown sand, ancient city silhouettes and pagodas in the distance. The central figure occupies most of the height, slightly right of center, walking forward with strong depth and scale.

Main subject: A bald Tang dynasty Buddhist monk in layered weathered gray-brown robes, wrapped sashes, prayer beads around the neck, worn cloth textures, dust and wind movement. He holds a tall ornate monk staff in his right hand and extends an ancient rolled scripture tube or sutra scroll case toward the viewer in his left hand, creating a strong foreground perspective. The face area should be softly obscured or neutral rather than a recognizable modern face. The pose should feel determined, solemn, and pioneering.

Left title column: Large expressive black ink-brush Chinese calligraphy reading {argument name="main calligraphy title" default="玄奘"} at the upper left. Beside it, add thin vertical Chinese-style biographical text indicating Tang dynasty monk, westward scripture journey, Buddhist transmission, and lifespan 602—664. Add a small red seal stamp under the biographical text. Add an additional slim vertical annotation line near the lower left like an archival quote or route note.

Floating archive panels: Include exactly 6 semi-transparent glass panels with thin gold outlines, small node connectors, white/gold text, faint historical illustration backgrounds, and a numbered sequence. The six panels are: 01, year 629, departure from Chang'an; 02, year 630, crossing Gaochang; 03, year 635, reaching Tianzhu/India; 04, year 645, studying Buddhism and returning east; 05, year 653, collecting and bringing back scriptures; 06, years 645—664, translating classics and transmitting them to later generations. Place panels around the figure: 01 upper left, 02 mid-left, 03 upper right, 04 right middle, 05 lower right, 06 lower left. Keep the panels legible but ethereal, as if holographic museum labels.

Bottom timeline: Add one thin horizontal timeline across the bottom with exactly 6 marked dots labeled 629, 630, 635, 645, 653, and 664. Under the dots, add short Chinese-style event captions matching the six archive panels. Use small refined serif or Song-style typography in off-white/gold.

Background details: A vast desert road with caravan silhouettes, camels, monks, travelers, dust clouds, distant mountains, and ancient frontier architecture. Include faint ruined city walls and pagoda-like structures to support the historical westward journey atmosphere. Make the scroll case and monk staff break the flat poster plane visually, as if protruding from the archival layout.

Visual style: {argument name="visual style" default="ultra-realistic 3D historical poster, cinematic lighting, museum archive infographic, sepia desert palette, volumetric dust, high-detail cloth and metal textures"}. Elegant, solemn, heroic, not cartoonish. Combine realistic historical portraiture with infographic overlays and Chinese ink-calligraphy aesthetics.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 central character, exactly 6 floating archive panels, and exactly 6 bottom timeline markers. No modern objects, no English text on the poster unless requested, no watermark, no logo, no extra characters in the foreground.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张电影质感的 3D 历史人物档案竖版海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="玄奘"}，展现一位唐代僧人如纪念碑般全身雕像般的行者形象，正走在丝绸之路的沙漠景观中，向观众迎面而来。采用史诗般的博物馆展览风格，结合写实的 3D 渲染、纪录片式的历史氛围以及悬浮的半透明数据面板。

画布：3:4 竖版海报，温暖的深褐色与尘金色调，高细节，戏剧性的背光，朦胧的天空，风沙，远处的古城轮廓和佛塔。中心人物占据大部分高度，位于中心偏右，向前行走，具有强烈的深度感和比例感。

主体：一位唐代秃头佛教僧人，身着层叠的陈旧灰褐色僧袍，缠绕着腰带，颈挂念珠，布料质感磨损，带有风沙拂动的效果。他右手持一根华丽的高僧杖，左手向观众伸出一个古老的卷轴经筒，营造出强烈的近景透视感。面部区域应柔和遮蔽或保持中性，而非可辨认的现代面孔。姿态应显得坚定、庄重且具有开拓精神。

左侧标题栏：左上方书写醒目的黑色水墨书法大字 {argument name="main calligraphy title" default="玄奘"}。旁边添加纤细的竖排中式传记文字，注明唐代僧人、西行取经、佛教传播以及生卒年 602—664。在传记文字下方添加一枚小型红色印章。在左下角附近添加一条额外的纤细竖排注释线，如档案引文或路线备注。

悬浮档案面板：包含 6 个半透明玻璃面板，带有纤细的金色轮廓、小型节点连接器、白/金色文字、淡淡的历史插画背景以及编号序列。这 6 个面板分别为：01，629 年，从长安出发；02，630 年，穿越高昌；03，635 年，抵达天竺/印度；04，645 年，研习佛法并东归；05，653 年，收集并带回经书；06，645—664 年，翻译经典并传之后世。面板环绕人物放置：01 在左上，02 在左中，03 在右上，04 在右中，05 在右下，06 在左下。保持面板清晰但空灵，如同全息博物馆标签。

底部时间轴：在底部添加一条纤细的水平时间轴，上面有 6 个标记点，分别标注为 629、630、635、645、653 和 664。在点下方，添加与 6 个档案面板相对应的简短中式事件说明。使用精致的衬线体或宋体，颜色为米白色/金色。

背景细节：广阔的沙漠道路，有商队剪影、骆驼、僧侣、行者、尘云、远山和古代边疆建筑。包含隐约的废弃城墙和佛塔状结构，以烘托历史西行之旅的氛围。让经筒和僧杖在视觉上打破海报的平面感，仿佛从档案布局中凸显出来。

视觉风格：{argument name="visual style" default="超写实 3D 历史海报，电影级灯光，博物馆档案信息图，深褐色沙漠色调，体积感尘埃，高细节布料与金属质感"}。优雅、庄重、英勇，非卡通风格。将写实的历史肖像与信息图叠加层及中国水墨书法美学相结合。

约束：仅限 1 个中心人物，正好 6 个悬浮档案面板，正好 6 个底部时间轴标记。无现代物品，海报上无英文文本（除非另有要求），无水印，无 Logo，前景中无额外人物。

templates.title: China Divorce Data 3D Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 中国离婚数据 3D 信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an elegant editorial-style 3D infographic about {argument name="headline topic" default="2020–2026 China divorce population"}, using Chinese typography and a minimalist museum-display aesthetic.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 composition on warm off-white textured paper, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, muted cream background.

Layout: Place a large black Chinese headline on the upper left reading “2020–2026\n中国离婚人数”. Beneath it, add a smaller subtitle “全国依法办理离婚手续” with a thin horizontal line ending in a small orange dot. The main visual is a dark charcoal oval/cylindrical podium spanning the lower middle, with a recessed oval opening at the top like a stage. Along the podium front, label the years from left to right: 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026.

Chart elements: Use exactly 7 vertical year positions. Show 5 solid rectangular 3D bars and 2 dashed-outline placeholder bars. The 5 solid bars are: 2020 tall ochre-gold bar labeled “433.9”; 2021 shorter dusty coral bar labeled “283.9” with a small callout tag “2021 低点”; 2022 muted sage-green bar labeled “287.9”; 2023 taller salmon-pink bar labeled “360.53” with a small callout tag “2023 回升”; 2024 beige stone bar labeled “351.3”. The 2 future placeholders are dashed transparent bars for 2025 and 2026, each with a hanging tag below reading “待更新”. Put small black dots and leader lines above each numeric value.

Decorative details: Add two tiny human figures for scale: one standing on the left edge of the podium near a simple railing and sparse delicate branch/tree, another standing on the right side near the future bars. Add a large flat golden sun circle in the upper right. Add a tall cream rectangular slab on the far right behind the podium with a thin black vertical line in front. At the lower left, place a wooden semicircle, a leaning paper sheet with a small orange circle, a small pale green cube, and a miniature beige line-chart card attached to the podium front.

Text and legend: In the bottom-left corner add an orange dot followed by “单位：万对”. Keep all visible text in Chinese as specified, with crisp black type and no extra labels.

Visual style: Refined data-visualization poster, tactile paper texture, 3D clay/paper-cut look, muted ochre coral sage beige palette, high-end magazine infographic, clean negative space, realistic soft shadows, precise alignment.

Constraints: Use exactly the 7 year positions and exactly the 5 solid bars plus 2 dashed future bars described above. Do not add watermarks, logos, extra charts, or additional people.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一份优雅的编辑风格 3D 信息图，主题为 {argument name="headline topic" default="2020–2026 年中国离婚人口"}，采用中文字体设计和极简主义博物馆陈列美学。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向构图，背景为暖色调米白色纹理纸张，采用柔和的摄影棚灯光、细腻的阴影以及柔和的奶油色背景。

布局：在左上方放置醒目的黑色中文标题“2020–2026\n中国离婚人数”。下方添加较小的副标题“全国依法办理离婚手续”，并配有一条以橙色小圆点结尾的细横线。主体视觉为一个深炭灰色椭圆/圆柱形展台，横跨中下部，顶部设有如舞台般的凹陷椭圆开口。在展台正面，从左至右标注年份：2020、2021、2022、2023、2024、2025、2026。

图表元素：使用 7 个垂直年份位置。展示 5 个实心 3D 长方体柱状图和 2 个虚线轮廓占位柱。5 个实心柱分别为：2020 年高大的赭金色柱，标注“433.9”；2021 年较短的灰珊瑚色柱，标注“283.9”并附带“2021 低点”的小标签；2022 年柔和的鼠尾草绿柱，标注“287.9”；2023 年较高的鲑鱼粉色柱，标注“360.53”并附带“2023 回升”的小标签；2024 年米色石纹柱，标注“351.3”。2 个未来占位符为 2025 年和 2026 年的虚线透明柱，下方均悬挂“待更新”标签。在每个数值上方添加黑色小圆点和引导线。

装饰细节：添加两个微型人物以体现比例：一个站在展台左侧边缘，靠近简单的栏杆和稀疏精致的枝条/树木；另一个站在右侧，靠近未来数据柱。在右上角添加一个巨大的扁平金色太阳圆环。在展台后方右侧放置一块高大的奶油色长方形板，前方有一条细长的黑色垂直线。在左下角放置一个木制半圆、一张带有橙色小圆点的倾斜纸张、一个淡绿色小立方体，以及一张贴在展台正面的微型米色折线图卡片。

文字与图例：在左下角添加一个橙色圆点，后接“单位：万对”。所有可见文字均按指定使用中文，采用清晰的黑色字体，不添加额外标签。

视觉风格：精致的数据可视化海报，触感纸张纹理，3D 粘土/剪纸风格，赭色、珊瑚色、鼠尾草绿、米色调色板，高端杂志信息图，留白充裕，逼真的柔和阴影，精准对齐。

约束条件：严格使用上述 7 个年份位置，以及 5 个实心柱和 2 个虚线未来柱。请勿添加水印、Logo、额外图表或多余人物。

templates.title: 3D Chinese Historical Figure Archive Poster

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical historical figure archive poster about {argument name="character name" default="班超"}, showing a heroic ancient Chinese frontier general breaking out of a documentary-style infographic layout.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, 768 x 1024 feel, sepia-gold and smoky gray historical palette, dramatic backlight, dust, battlefield haze, high-detail 3D realism mixed with museum exhibition graphics.

Main subject: One full-body ancient Chinese armored commander stands in the center foreground, low-angle heroic composition. He wears layered dark lamellar armor, engraved belt plates, leather boots, red-brown cloak blowing leftward, and a stern dignified expression. His left arm thrusts forward toward the viewer holding a tall wooden command tablet engraved with Chinese calligraphy; his right hand holds a vertical staff or ceremonial standard with a tassel and Chinese characters. Make the figure feel three-dimensional, as if stepping out of the flat poster frame.

Background: Ancient Western Regions frontier setting with rocky desert ground, mountains in the distance, mounted soldiers and caravan silhouettes on the left, and a large fortified city gate on the right with banners, scaffolding, guards, and the gate plaque reading in Chinese. Add a large weathered war banner in the upper right. The atmosphere should suggest expedition, diplomacy, military command, and westward expansion.

Left typography block: Place very large black brush-calligraphy title text {argument name="main title text" default="班超"} vertically on the upper left. Beneath it, add smaller vertical Chinese biographical text describing birthplace, role, and lifespan, including the years 32—102. Add a small red seal stamp below the biographical block.

Floating archive cards: Add exactly 8 translucent glass-like historical event cards around the character, each with thin gold borders, tiny corner rivets, Chinese text, and monochrome documentary mini-illustrations. Count and place them as follows: 1) top center card, labeled 01 and 73, about joining the army after abandoning the brush; 2) left-middle card, labeled 02 and 73, about mission to the Western Regions; 3) top right card, labeled 03 and 91, about pacifying the northern Xiongnu; 4) right-middle card, labeled 04 and 95, about suppressing rebellion; 5) lower-left-middle card, labeled 05 and 96, about establishing the Protectorate of the Western Regions; 6) bottom-left card, labeled 06, about governing for forty years and uniting many states; 7) lower-right-middle card, labeled 07, about opening the Silk Road; 8) bottom-right card, labeled 08 and 102, about returning to Luoyang in old age. Each card should include a small faded illustration of cavalry, officials, soldiers, maps, or caravans.

Bottom timeline: Add exactly 6 timeline milestones along the bottom edge with a thin gold horizontal line, small dots, and Chinese labels: 32 birth, 73 joining army and mission west, 91 northern Xiongnu, 95 suppressing rebellion, 96 setting up the Protectorate, 102 successful return to Luoyang. Keep the timeline legible but secondary.

Visual style: Epic Chinese historical 3D poster, ultra-detailed armor textures, cinematic volumetric lighting, dust particles, depth of field, parchment-like overlays, museum archive infographic design, gold linework, realistic fabric motion, dramatic perspective.

Constraints: Use exactly one central historical figure, exactly 8 floating event cards, and exactly 6 bottom timeline milestones. Keep all visible text in Chinese calligraphy or Chinese serif style, with no English labels in the poster. Avoid modern objects, neon colors, cartoons, watermarks, or extra characters dominating the central figure.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张电影质感的竖版历史人物档案海报，主题为 {argument name="character name" default="班超"}，展现一位英雄气概的中国古代边疆将军，并使其从纪录片风格的信息图布局中脱颖而出。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，768 x 1024 视觉比例，采用深褐色、金色与烟灰色调的历史配色，戏剧性的背光效果，尘埃、战场薄雾，高细节 3D 写实感与博物馆展览图形相结合。

主体：一位全身着甲的中国古代统帅站在前景中央，采用低角度英雄构图。他身穿层叠的深色札甲，佩戴雕花腰带，脚蹬皮靴，红棕色披风向左飘动，表情庄重威严。左臂向前伸向观众，手持刻有汉字书法的木质令箭；右手持一根带有流苏和汉字的竖立权杖或仪仗旗。让人物呈现出三维立体感，仿佛正从平面的海报边框中走出来。

背景：古代西域边疆场景，地面为岩石沙漠，远处有山脉，左侧有骑兵和商队剪影，右侧有一座带有旗帜、脚手架、守卫的大型坚固城门，城门匾额上写有汉字。右上角添加一面巨大的风化战旗。氛围应体现远征、外交、军事指挥和西域开拓。

左侧排版：在左上角垂直放置非常大的黑色毛笔书法标题 {argument name="main title text" default="班超"}。下方添加较小的竖排中文传记文字，描述出生地、职位和生平，包括 32—102 年。在传记块下方添加一枚红色小印章。

浮动档案卡片：在人物周围添加 8 张半透明玻璃质感的历史事件卡片，每张卡片带有细金边、微型边角铆钉、中文文字和单色纪录片风格的小插图。放置方式如下：1) 顶部中央卡片，标注 01 和 73，关于投笔从戎；2) 左中卡片，标注 02 和 73，关于出使西域；3) 右上卡片，标注 03 和 91，关于平定北匈奴；4) 右中卡片，标注 04 和 95，关于平定叛乱；5) 左下中卡片，标注 05 和 96，关于设立西域都护府；6) 左下卡片，标注 06，关于经营西域四十载，联合多国；7) 右下中卡片，标注 07，关于开辟丝绸之路；8) 右下卡片，标注 08 和 102，关于晚年归洛阳。每张卡片应包含骑兵、官员、士兵、地图或商队的小型褪色插图。

底部时间轴：沿底部边缘添加 6 个时间轴里程碑，配有一条细金色水平线、小圆点和中文标签：32 出生，73 投笔从戎与出使西域，91 平定北匈奴，95 平定叛乱，96 设立都护府，102 功成归洛阳。保持时间轴清晰但作为次要元素。

视觉风格：史诗级中国历史 3D 海报，超精细盔甲纹理，电影级体积光，尘埃粒子，景深效果，羊皮纸质感叠加，博物馆档案信息图设计，金色线条，逼真的织物动态，戏剧性的透视效果。

约束：仅使用一位中心历史人物，严格包含 8 张浮动事件卡片和 6 个底部时间轴里程碑。所有可见文字均使用中文书法或中文宋体风格，海报内不得出现任何英文标签。避免使用现代物品、霓虹色、卡通元素、水印或除中心人物以外的额外角色。

templates.title: Lin Daiyu Period Drama Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 林黛玉古装剧海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical cinematic Chinese period-drama character poster for {argument name="series title" default="林黛玉"}, blending photorealistic costume drama with antique ink-painting graphic design and a literary mystery/poetry interface aesthetic.

Canvas: Tall 2:3 poster, muted gray-green and sepia palette, aged rice-paper texture along the left edge, dark bamboo grove and rainy stone garden in the background, soft mist, drifting pink flower petals, delicate gold geometric constellation lines overlaying the whole composition.

Main subject: A full-body young noblewoman from a Qing/classical Chinese literary setting stands centered on a round carved stone platform. She wears a pale blue-green layered hanfu with translucent gauze sleeves, embroidered floral patterns, long flowing ribbons, and elegant blue shoes partly visible. Her hair is in an ornate updo with black hair ornaments, white blossoms, dangling silver tassels, and a refined scholarly-poetic look. Her face is intentionally softly blurred/obscured while the costume remains sharp. She extends one hand toward the viewer holding an open handwritten poetry manuscript on aged paper; the other hand gathers her sleeve and holds a long tassel ornament with a jade-like bead. Add a blossoming branch crossing the lower foreground and scattered petals around her feet.

Left title column: Large bold black Chinese calligraphy reads 「林黛玉」 vertically near the upper left. Beneath it, smaller vertical text reads 「红楼梦 · 潇湘妃子」. Add faint background manuscript writing and small red seal stamps.

Left-side small tags: Include exactly 3 small boxed tags stacked vertically under the subtitle, labeled 「清冷才情」, 「葬花诗魂」, and 「弱柳扶风」.

Story card layout: Surround the central figure with exactly 8 vintage episode cards connected by thin gold lines, pale borders, corner ornaments, and tiny node dots. Each card contains a circular number badge, a Chinese title, a small monochrome inset illustration like an old engraved scene, and two short lines of smaller Chinese text. Arrange 4 cards down the left side and 4 cards down the right side.

The 8 episode cards must be:
1. Top-left card number 01, title 「扬州旧梦 黛玉入府」, showing a riverboat/arrival scene.
2. Left card number 02, title 「潇湘馆中 竹影清寒」, showing a bamboo courtyard.
3. Lower-left card number 03, title 「木石前盟 情根初种」, showing two young figures seated together.
4. Bottom-left card number 04, title 「共读西厢 诗心相照」, showing two figures reading.
5. Top-right card number 05, title 「海棠诗社 才情惊座」, showing a poetry gathering at a table.
6. Mid-right card number 06, title 「葬花吟成 一抔净土」, showing a sorrowful garden burial scene.
7. Lower-right card number 07, title 「焚稿断痴 泪尽魂归」, showing a woman beside a writing desk or window.
8. Bottom-right card number 08, title 「冷月诗魂 千古含香」, showing a moonlit memorial-like scene.

Bottom navigation: Along the bottom edge, place a thin gold timeline with exactly 5 circular nodes and 5 labels: 「入府」, 「潇湘」, 「诗社」, 「葬花」, 「焚稿」. Above the timeline, centered on the stone platform base, add a carved gold plaque reading 「一卷诗稿，满庭落花」.

Visual style: High-detail photorealistic fantasy poster with Chinese ink-wash atmosphere, antique paper collage, subtle UI/infographic framing, fine gold linework, weathered textures, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, elegant melancholic mood, soft haze, balanced symmetry, no modern objects, no watermark, no English text in the image.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="series title" default="林黛玉"} 创作一张竖版电影感中国古装剧人物海报，融合写实古装剧风格与古风水墨平面设计，并呈现文学悬疑/诗词界面的美学。

画布：高比例 2:3 海报，采用灰绿色与深褐色调，左侧边缘带有陈旧宣纸纹理，背景为幽暗竹林与雨中石园，伴有柔和雾气与飘落的花瓣，整幅构图覆盖着精致的金色几何星图线条。

主体：一位来自清代/中国古典文学背景的年轻贵族女子全身像，居中站立在圆形雕花石台上。她身着淡青绿色层叠汉服，配有半透明纱袖、刺绣花纹、长飘带，隐约可见优雅的蓝色鞋履。发型为精致的发髻，装饰着黑色发饰、白色花朵与垂下的银色流苏，尽显文人诗意气质。面部刻意处理得柔和模糊，而服饰细节保持清晰。她向观众伸出一只手，手中拿着一张陈旧的纸质手写诗稿；另一只手拢着衣袖，握着一枚带有玉质珠子的长流苏挂饰。在前景下方添加一枝盛开的枝条，脚边散落着花瓣。

左侧标题栏：左上方垂直排列着醒目的黑色大号中文字体「林黛玉」。下方垂直排列较小的文字「红楼梦 · 潇湘妃子」。添加淡淡的背景手稿字迹与红色印章。

左侧小标签：在副标题下方垂直堆叠 3 个小型方框标签，分别标注为「清冷才情」、「葬花诗魂」和「弱柳扶风」。

剧集卡片布局：在中心人物周围环绕 8 张复古剧集卡片，通过细金线、淡色边框、边角装饰及微小节点连接。每张卡片包含一个圆形数字徽章、中文标题、一幅类似古版画的小型单色插图，以及两行较小的中文短句。左侧排列 4 张，右侧排列 4 张。

8 张剧集卡片内容如下：
1. 左上角卡片编号 01，标题「扬州旧梦 黛玉入府」，展示河船/抵达场景。
2. 左侧卡片编号 02，标题「潇湘馆中 竹影清寒」，展示竹林庭院。
3. 左下侧卡片编号 03，标题「木石前盟 情根初种」，展示两位少年并坐的场景。
4. 左下角卡片编号 04，标题「共读西厢 诗心相照」，展示两人共读的场景。
5. 右上角卡片编号 05，标题「海棠诗社 才情惊座」，展示桌前的诗会场景。
6. 右中侧卡片编号 06，标题「葬花吟成 一抔净土」，展示忧伤的葬花场景。
7. 右下侧卡片编号 07，标题「焚稿断痴 泪尽魂归」，展示书桌或窗边的女子。
8. 右下角卡片编号 08，标题「冷月诗魂 千古含香」，展示月光下的纪念性场景。

底部导航：在底边放置一条细金线时间轴，包含 5 个圆形节点与 5 个标签：「入府」、「潇湘」、「诗社」、「葬花」、「焚稿」。在时间轴上方、石台基座中心，添加一块雕刻的金色铭牌，刻有「一卷诗稿，满庭落花」。

视觉风格：高细节写实奇幻海报，具有中国水墨氛围、古纸拼贴感、精致的 UI/信息图表框架、细腻的金线勾勒、风化纹理、电影级光影、浅景深、优雅忧郁的基调、柔和雾气、对称平衡，无现代物品，无水印，图像中无任何英文字符。

templates.title: Antique Chinese Noblewoman Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 中国古代贵族女性海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Chinese historical romance character-poster infographic for a noblewoman in an ancient garden, centered on the theme {argument name="character name" default="薛宝钗"}, with ornate Qing/Hanfu-inspired elegance, scrapbook textures, and numbered story vignettes.

Canvas: Tall 2:3 poster, antique parchment background with torn-paper edges, sepia ink calligraphy, fine gold geometric lines, translucent cracked-glass polygon overlays, and a warm muted palette of beige, cream, dusty rose, sage green, dark ink, and aged gold.

Central subject: Full-body aristocratic young woman standing on a carved round stone pedestal in front of a blurred old library/garden pavilion filled with flowers. Her face is intentionally soft-blurred and featureless, as if anonymized, while the rest of the portrait is highly detailed. She wears an elaborate pale cream embroidered robe with layered wide sleeves, peach-pink translucent outer drapes, sage-green trim, floral peony embroidery down the front panel and hem, embroidered shoes, and a gold-and-pearl hair ornament crown with dangling beads. She holds a round silk fan in her extended left hand, decorated with painted peonies and vertical Chinese calligraphy, and holds a round gold pendant near her chest with the other hand; a tassel and bead chain hang from her wrist. Overall pose: graceful, formal, slightly forward-facing, like a luxury period-drama character reveal.

Main typography: On the far left, place very large vertical black brush-calligraphy reading {argument name="main title" default="薛宝钗"}. Beneath it, smaller vertical text reads {argument name="subtitle" default="红楼梦·蘅芜君"}. Add one small red seal stamp beside the title.

Left-side small labels: Include exactly 3 stacked beige stamp-like tags with dark borders and Chinese text: 1) “端庄温润”, 2) “金玉良缘”, 3) “藏愚守拙”.

Story cards: Arrange exactly 8 numbered vignette cards around the central figure, connected by thin gold lines and triangular geometry. Each card has a dark circular number badge, a Chinese title, a small sepia photo-like inset scene, and two short lines of Chinese explanatory text. The 8 cards are:
1) Top-left card, number 01, title “薛家入京 宝钗初至”, showing a young woman arriving among attendants.
2) Top-right card, number 02, title “蘅芜苑中 香草清芬”, showing a pavilion garden scene.
3) Upper-right card, number 03, title “金锁随身 金玉之说”, showing an indoor seated figure with a blurred face.
4) Mid-right card, number 04, title “冷香丸意 温厚藏心”, showing a young woman writing or studying at a desk.
5) Lower-right card, number 05, title “诗社唱和 才情自敛”, showing a small group gathered around a table with books.
6) Mid-left card, number 06, title “扑蝶花间 春影微动”, showing two young women in a garden.
7) Lower-left card, number 07, title “宝黛钗局 情礼相衡”, showing three people in conversation.
8) Bottom-left card, number 08, title “金玉成婚 梦醒红楼”, showing a wedding or formal gathering scene.

Bottom title plaque: On the pedestal base, add a long gold-edged plaque with the slogan {argument name="bottom quote" default="一柄团扇，半生金玉"} in black Chinese calligraphy.

Bottom timeline: Along the very bottom edge, add exactly 5 milestone labels connected by a thin gold line with small circular nodes: “入京”, “蘅芜”, “金锁”, “诗社”, “成婚”.

Visual style: Highly detailed cinematic period-drama poster, antique Chinese manuscript collage, refined feminine luxury, realistic fabric embroidery, botanical peonies, shallow depth of field, soft warm lighting, museum-quality texture, aged paper grain, ink wash details, gold filigree borders, elegant editorial layout.

Constraints: Use Chinese text exactly as specified for all visible titles and labels. Keep the central figure dominant and full-body. Include exactly 8 numbered vignette cards, exactly 3 left-side tags, and exactly 5 bottom timeline milestones. Do not add extra numbered sections, modern objects, logos, watermarks, or English text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版中国历史言情角色海报信息图，描绘一位身处古风园林的贵族女性，主题围绕 {argument name="character name" default="薛宝钗"}，融合精致的清代/汉服风格、剪贴簿纹理以及带编号的故事插图。

画布：2:3 竖版海报，采用仿古羊皮纸背景，边缘呈撕纸效果，配有棕褐色水墨书法、精致的金色几何线条、半透明裂纹玻璃多边形叠加，整体色调为柔和的米色、奶油色、灰粉色、鼠尾草绿、深墨色及陈旧的金色。

中心主体：一位全身贵族少女，站在雕花圆形石座上，背景为模糊的古风书斋/园林花丛。人物面部刻意模糊处理，不显五官，如同匿名化处理，而肖像其余部分则高度精细。她身着精致的奶油色刺绣长袍，配有层叠的宽袖、桃粉色半透明外罩、鼠尾草绿滚边，前襟和下摆饰有牡丹花刺绣，脚穿绣花鞋，头戴金珠发冠，垂下珠串。左手持一把圆团扇，扇面绘有牡丹及竖排中文书法，右手持一枚圆形金坠于胸前；手腕处垂有流苏和珠链。整体姿态：优雅、端庄、微侧身，呈现出奢华古装剧的角色定妆照效果。

主要排版：在最左侧，放置巨大的黑色竖排毛笔书法，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="薛宝钗"}。下方配有较小的竖排文字 {argument name="subtitle" default="红楼梦·蘅芜君"}。标题旁加盖一枚红色印章。

左侧小标签：包含 3 个堆叠的米色印章式标签，带有深色边框及中文文字：1) “端庄温润”，2) “金玉良缘”，3) “藏愚守拙”。

故事卡片：在中心人物周围排列 8 张带编号的插图卡片，通过细金线和三角形几何结构连接。每张卡片均配有深色圆形数字徽章、中文标题、一张棕褐色照片风格的插图，以及两行简短的中文说明文字。8 张卡片如下：
1) 左上卡片，编号 01，标题“薛家入京 宝钗初至”，展示少女在随从簇拥下抵达。
2) 右上卡片，编号 02，标题“蘅芜苑中 香草清芬”，展示园林亭台场景。
3) 右上偏下卡片，编号 03，标题“金锁随身 金玉之说”，展示室内坐姿人物，面部模糊。
4) 右中卡片，编号 04，标题“冷香丸意 温厚藏心”，展示少女在书桌前书写或研读。
5) 右下卡片，编号 05，标题“诗社唱和 才情自敛”，展示一群人围坐在书桌旁。
6) 左中卡片，编号 06，标题“扑蝶花间 春影微动”，展示园林中的两位少女。
7) 左下卡片，编号 07，标题“宝黛钗局 情礼相衡”，展示三人交谈场景。
8) 左下底部卡片，编号 08，标题“金玉成婚 梦醒红楼”，展示婚礼或正式聚会场景。

底部标题牌：在底座上，添加一块长条形金边铭牌，刻有口号 {argument name="bottom quote" default="一柄团扇，半生金玉"}，采用黑色中文书法。

底部时间轴：在最底边缘，添加 5 个里程碑标签，通过带有小圆点的细金线连接：“入京”、“蘅芜”、“金锁”、“诗社”、“成婚”。

视觉风格：高度精细的电影级古装剧海报，中国古籍拼贴画，精致的女性奢华感，写实的织物刺绣，植物牡丹，浅景深，柔和暖光，博物馆级纹理，陈旧纸张颗粒感，水墨细节，金丝边框，优雅的编辑排版。

限制：所有可见标题和标签必须严格使用指定的中文文字。保持中心人物为主体且为全身像。包含 8 张带编号的插图卡片、3 个左侧标签和 5 个底部时间轴里程碑。请勿添加额外的编号部分、现代物品、徽标、水印或任何英文字符。

templates.title: Misty Chinese Spring Riverscape

titleLocalized.zh: 烟雨中国春日江景

templates.prompt: Create a vertical classical Chinese landscape illustration in a delicate early-20th-century gouache-and-watercolor style, inspired by an idealized ancient spring riverscape. Show a wide river curving from the lower right into the misty middle distance, with a small wooden covered sampan boat in the lower right carrying exactly 1 standing boatman in pale robes holding an oar. On the left bank, depict exactly 9 small human figures in traditional Chinese clothing: 3 strolling together near the lower left path, 2 standing by a large blossoming tree, 1 bending or walking alone near the grassy bank, 1 child-sized figure near a small flowering shrub, and 2 distant figures near the willows. Surround them with lush spring vegetation: dark gnarled trees, pale green willow trees, pink flowering blossoms, reeds, grasses, blue-green rocks, and a calm reflective river. In the background, place towering rounded mountains in jade green, turquoise, teal, and blue, partially wrapped in soft white mist and low clouds, with smaller distant peaks receding into atmospheric haze. Set the scene at {argument name="time of day" default="sunset"}, with a warm peach and golden sky, a low sun near the horizon, and gentle yellow light reflecting on the water. Use {argument name="art style" default="soft Chinese watercolor and gouache on paper"}, refined brush texture, pastel colors, poetic composition, high detail but airy and dreamlike, no hard outlines, no modern objects, no text except a very faint unobtrusive watermark-like mark in the top-left if desired. The overall mood should be serene, nostalgic, and collectible, like an elegant hand-painted illustration of an ancient riverside spring outing in the mountains.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖构图的中国古典山水插画，采用 20 世纪初细腻的水粉与水彩风格，灵感源自理想化的古代春日江景。画面展示一条宽阔的河流从右下角蜿蜒流向烟雨朦胧的中景，右下角有一艘小型木制篷顶舢板船，船上站着 1 位身着浅色长袍、手持船桨的船夫。在左岸，描绘 9 位身着中国传统服饰的小人物：3 人在左下角的小径上结伴漫步，2 人站在一棵巨大的繁花树旁，1 人在草岸边弯腰或独行，1 位孩童模样的角色在小型花丛附近，另有 2 位远景人物在柳树旁。周围环绕着茂盛的春日植被：深色的虬枝古树、浅绿的垂柳、粉色的花朵、芦苇、青草、青绿色的岩石以及平静如镜的江面。背景中，矗立着翡翠绿、绿松石色、青色和蓝色的圆润高山，部分被柔和的白雾和低云笼罩，更远处的山峰隐没在空气感十足的薄雾中。场景设定为 {argument name="time of day" default="日落"}，天空呈现温暖的桃色与金色，低垂的太阳靠近地平线，柔和的黄光映照在水面上。使用 {argument name="art style" default="纸上柔和中国水彩与水粉"}，笔触细腻，色彩柔和，构图富有诗意，细节丰富但空灵梦幻，无硬轮廓线，无现代物品，除左上角可选择性添加极淡且不显眼的类似水印的标记外，画面中不包含任何文字。整体氛围应宁静、怀旧且具有收藏价值，宛如一幅优雅的手绘古代山间春游江畔图。

templates.title: Shi Xiangyun Hanfu Story Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史湘云汉服故事海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ornate vertical Chinese historical-romance poster / character infographic featuring {argument name="character name" default="Shi Xiangyun"} as a full-body young noblewoman in a spring garden, blending cinematic photorealism with delicate illustrated UI overlays.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, warm parchment-and-gold palette, soft morning sunlight, shallow depth of field, high detail. Background is a blooming classical Chinese courtyard garden with pavilions, stone path, flowering trees, peonies, drifting pink petals, and a dreamy misty atmosphere.

Main subject: Centered full-body Hanfu woman standing on a round carved stone platform. She wears a flowing pastel embroidered Hanfu in {argument name="dress colors" default="pale blue, blush pink, ivory, and soft teal"}, layered translucent sleeves and long ribbons moving in the breeze, floral embroidery, pink sash belt, tassel ornaments, embroidered shoes, and ornate traditional hair buns decorated with small flowers and hairpins. Her right arm reaches toward the viewer holding a small green floral porcelain wine cup; her left hand holds a bouquet of large pink peonies. Use a graceful, poised, friendly gesture, with the face softly obscured or left non-specific.

Left title column: Add a textured parchment vertical strip on the left. Large black brush-calligraphy title reads 「史湘云」. Smaller vertical subtitle reads 「红楼梦·枕霞旧友」. Add a small red seal stamp. Below are exactly 3 stacked rectangular navigation tabs labeled: 1) 「明朗豪爽」 2) 「醉卧芍药」 3) 「少年清气」.

Information cards: Surround the subject with exactly 8 vintage parchment story cards connected by thin gold geometric lines, small circular number badges, translucent crystal-like paper shards, and faint constellation nodes. Each card has a sepia miniature illustration and Chinese title/body text. Use these exact numbered titles:
01 「史府旧影 湘云初至」
02 「大观园中 掌声成趣」
03 「海棠诗社 才思明快」
04 「芦雪庵联 豪气纵笔」
05 「醉卧芍药 春梦花眠」
06 「金麒麟缘 命运微响」
07 「枕霞旧友 笑语如风」
08 「云散高唐 明朗余音」
Place cards 01, 02, 03, 04 down the left/left-lower side and cards 05, 06, 07, 08 down the right side. Keep the card text small, decorative, and secondary; prioritize the titles and the numbered badges.

Bottom elements: At the base of the platform, add a gold plaque with the quote {argument name="bottom quote" default="一盏春酒，满身花气"}. Along the very bottom edge, add a thin gold timeline with exactly 5 labeled nodes: 「初至」, 「诗社」, 「联句」, 「醉卧」, 「余音」.

Visual style: Elegant Chinese vintage editorial design, Red Chamber Dream aesthetic, parchment texture, gold filigree borders, ink brush typography, sepia story thumbnails, translucent collage fragments, romantic peony blossoms, soft bokeh, premium museum-poster composition, highly detailed fabric and embroidery, cinematic lighting.

Constraints: Keep all text in Chinese exactly where specified, use no English text inside the image, no watermark, no logo, no extra cards, no extra timeline nodes, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张华丽的竖版中国古风言情海报 / 角色信息图，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="史湘云"}，展现一位身处春日花园的年轻贵族少女全身像，融合电影级写实感与精致的插画 UI 叠层。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，采用暖色羊皮纸与金色调，柔和的晨光，浅景深，高细节。背景为盛开的中国古典庭院，包含亭台楼阁、石径、花树、牡丹、飘落的粉色花瓣以及梦幻般的薄雾氛围。

主体：居中的全身汉服女子，站在圆形的雕花石台上。她身着飘逸的淡色刺绣汉服，配色为 {argument name="dress colors" default="淡蓝、绯粉、象牙白与柔青色"}，层叠的半透明袖口与长丝带在微风中飘动，饰有花卉刺绣、粉色腰带、流苏挂饰、绣花鞋，发髻上装饰着小花与发簪。她的右手向观众伸出，持有一只绿色花卉瓷酒杯；左手持一束硕大的粉色牡丹。姿态优雅、从容、亲切，面部柔化处理或保持模糊。

左侧标题栏：在左侧添加一条纹理羊皮纸竖条。大型黑色毛笔书法标题写着「史湘云」。较小的竖排副标题写着「红楼梦·枕霞旧友」。添加一枚红色印章。下方设有 3 个堆叠的矩形导航标签，分别标注为：1) 「明朗豪爽」 2) 「醉卧芍药」 3) 「少年清气」。

信息卡片：在主体周围环绕 8 张复古羊皮纸故事卡片，通过细金几何线条、圆形数字徽章、半透明水晶状纸屑以及淡淡的星座节点连接。每张卡片包含一幅棕褐色微缩插图及中文标题/正文。请使用以下精确的编号标题：
01 「史府旧影 湘云初至」
02 「大观园中 掌声成趣」
03 「海棠诗社 才思明快」
04 「芦雪庵联 豪气纵笔」
05 「醉卧芍药 春梦花眠」
06 「金麒麟缘 命运微响」
07 「枕霞旧友 笑语如风」
08 「云散高唐 明朗余音」
将 01、02、03、04 号卡片沿左侧/左下方排列，将 05、06、07、08 号卡片沿右侧排列。卡片文字保持小巧、装饰性且作为次要元素；优先突出标题和数字徽章。

底部元素：在平台基座处，添加一块金色铭牌，刻有引言 {argument name="bottom quote" default="一盏春酒，满身花气"}。在最底边缘，添加一条细金时间轴，包含 5 个标注节点：「初至」、「诗社」、「联句」、「醉卧」、「余音」。

视觉风格：优雅的中国复古编辑设计，《红楼梦》美学，羊皮纸纹理，金丝边框，水墨书法字体，棕褐色故事缩略图，半透明拼贴碎片，浪漫牡丹花，柔和焦外成像，高级博物馆海报构图，极具细节的织物与刺绣，电影级布光。

约束：所有文字必须按指定要求使用中文，图像内不得出现任何英文，无水印，无 Logo，不得增加额外卡片或时间轴节点，不得出现任何现代物品。

templates.title: Horned Six-Tailed Mountain Beast

titleLocalized.zh: 六尾角山兽

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic collectible wildlife photograph inspired by ancient Chinese myth: a fierce horned leopard-lynx hybrid, the {argument name="mythic beast" default="Zheng, a leopard-like mountain beast"}, standing on a jagged alpine rock ledge and roaring directly toward the camera. The creature has tawny-orange fur covered in dark leopard spots, a compact muscular feline body, lynx-like facial ruff and ears, one straight dark horn rising from the center of its forehead, and exactly six long ringed tails fanned upward behind it like a dramatic plume. Set the scene in a harsh high-mountain mineral landscape with dark fractured slate-gray cliffs, cold mist, and scattered translucent blue-green crystal formations embedded in the rocks. Use a low telephoto wildlife-photography angle from slightly below the animal, placing the beast left of center on the ledge, with the rocky slope and crystals receding into a blurred mountainous background. Lighting should be cinematic natural dawn light from the upper left, cool blue-gray atmosphere with warm rim highlights on the fur, visible breath-like mist, sharp detail on the animal’s face, open mouth, teeth, whiskers, spots, paws, horn, and tails, with shallow depth of field and realistic texture. Style: top-tier National Geographic fantasy realism, physically plausible anatomy and fur, no illustration look, no painting, no text, no humans, no watermark. Use a {argument name="camera lens" default="85mm telephoto lens"}, {argument name="lighting mood" default="cold misty dawn with warm side light"}, and {argument name="image aspect ratio" default="4:3 landscape"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张受中国古代神话启发的超写实野生动物收藏级照片：一只凶猛的带角豹猫混种，即 {argument name="mythic beast" default="狰，一种类似豹的山中野兽"}，站在崎岖的高山岩架上，正对着镜头咆哮。该生物拥有黄橙色的皮毛，覆盖着深色的豹纹，有着紧凑且肌肉发达的猫科动物躯干、类似猞猁的面部褶皱和耳朵，额头中央长有一只笔直的深色角，身后扇形展开着六条长长的环纹尾巴，宛如戏剧性的羽饰。场景设定在严酷的高山矿物地貌中，背景是深色破碎的板岩悬崖、寒冷的雾气，以及散布在岩石中半透明的蓝绿色水晶结构。采用略低于动物视角的长焦野生动物摄影角度，将野兽置于岩架左侧，岩石坡面和水晶向模糊的山峦背景延伸。光线采用来自左上方的电影级自然晨光，营造出冷蓝灰色的氛围，并在皮毛上形成温暖的轮廓光，可见呼出的雾气，动物的面部、张开的嘴巴、牙齿、胡须、斑点、爪子、角和尾巴细节清晰，具有浅景深和逼真的质感。风格：顶级《国家地理》奇幻写实主义，符合生理结构的解剖与皮毛，无插画感，无绘画感，无文字，无人像，无水印。使用 {argument name="camera lens" default="85mm 长焦镜头"}，{argument name="lighting mood" default="寒冷多雾的黎明伴随温暖侧光"}，以及 {argument name="image aspect ratio" default="4:3 横向比例"}。

templates.title: Pastel Court Ladies on Horseback

titleLocalized.zh: 骑马的粉彩宫廷仕女

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist contemporary ink-and-watercolor illustration on an off-white vertical paper canvas. In the center, show exactly 3 small ancient Chinese court ladies riding exactly 3 white horses from left to right, rendered as tiny delicate black-ink line figures with soft pink and coral robes. The riders have black hair in high traditional buns and simplified facial details; the horses have black manes, black tails, thin legs, and lightly sketched bridles, with a graceful procession rhythm. Surround them with large translucent abstract watercolor washes: one broad pale pink cloud band across the lower middle, one smaller pink oval wash at lower left, one soft coral-pink wash sweeping across the upper left, one large misty green wash in the lower right, one pale sage-green wash across the upper right, one darker teal-green rounded wash in the top-right corner, and one light yellow-green circular glow near the top center. Add scattered dark green ink speckles near the top-left and upper center-right, a few tiny pink and green dots in the open white space, and a thin vertical reddish drip line descending near the lower-left edge. Keep the composition airy with abundant negative space, soft bleeding watercolor edges, subtle paper grain, no border, no text, no watermark. Style: refined East Asian-inspired modern watercolor, poetic, ethereal, collectible art print, delicate ink strokes, pastel palette of {argument name="main pink color" default="soft rose pink"}, {argument name="main green color" default="misty teal green"}, and cream paper, with the central procession small and crisp against large abstract washes.

promptLocalized.zh: 在一张米白色的竖向纸质画布上，创作一幅极简主义的现代水墨水彩插画。画面中心展示 3 位小巧的中国古代宫廷仕女，正骑着 3 匹白马从左向右行进，以细腻的黑色墨线勾勒，身着柔和的粉色和珊瑚色长袍。仕女梳着高高的传统发髻，面部细节简约；马匹有着黑色的鬃毛和尾巴、纤细的腿部以及轻描的缰绳，呈现出优雅的行进节奏。在她们周围环绕着大面积半透明的抽象水彩晕染：中下部有一道宽阔的淡粉色云带，左下方有一个较小的粉色椭圆形晕染，左上方扫过一道柔和的珊瑚粉色晕染，右下方有一大片朦胧的绿色晕染，右上角横跨一道淡鼠尾草绿晕染，右上角边缘有一处较深的青绿色圆形晕染，顶部中央附近有一抹浅黄绿色的圆形光晕。在左上角和中上方附近添加零星的深绿色墨点，在留白的区域点缀少量细小的粉色和绿色圆点，左下边缘附近有一条细长的垂直红褐色滴墨线。保持构图空灵，留出充足的负空间，呈现柔和的水彩晕染边缘和细腻的纸张纹理，无边框，无文字，无水印。风格：精致的东亚风格现代水彩，诗意、空灵、具有收藏价值的艺术印刷品，细腻的墨线，采用 {argument name="main pink color" default="柔和玫瑰粉"}、{argument name="main green color" default="朦胧青绿色"} 和奶油色纸张的粉彩调色板，中央的行进队伍在巨大的抽象晕染背景下显得小巧而清晰。

templates.title: Misty Chinese Mountain Village

titleLocalized.zh: 云雾缭绕的中国山村

templates.prompt: Create a collectible fine-art landscape photograph as if captured by a world-class National Geographic photographer: a high mountain overlook looking down into a secluded Chinese river valley at early morning in spring. The scene shows a misty village nestled among forested hills, with dark tiled-roof houses scattered through bright green fields and orchards full of pale pink and white blossoms. A narrow stream winds through the right side of the valley, while a broad river curves in the far left distance between layered blue mountains. Foreground includes rugged mossy limestone cliffs and dark pine branches framing the view from both sides, creating depth. Count the main visible landscape elements as 1 winding distant river, 1 narrow valley stream, 1 clustered village, many blossoming orchard trees, terraced green fields, layered mountain ridges, and low drifting fog banks. Use soft golden morning light breaking through cool blue haze, volumetric mist, realistic atmospheric perspective, crisp natural detail, deep greens, muted slate-blue mountains, no people, no animals, no modern roads, no power lines, no text. The mood should feel like an ancient Chinese poem discovered as a real place, serene, vast, humid, and sacred. Shot on a medium-format camera with a wide-angle lens, high dynamic range, natural color grading, ultra-realistic documentary photography. Optional source inspiration: {argument name="source material" default="an ancient Chinese description of a hidden peach-blossom valley in the mountains"}; season: {argument name="season" default="early spring"}; time of day: {argument name="time of day" default="misty sunrise"}; location style: {argument name="location style" default="remote Chinese mountain village"}; mood: {argument name="mood" default="serene and timeless"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有收藏价值的艺术风景摄影作品，如同由世界级《国家地理》摄影师拍摄：清晨时分，从高山俯瞰隐秘的中国河谷。画面展示了一个坐落在森林山丘间的云雾村落，深色瓦房散落在翠绿的田野和开满浅粉色与白色花朵的果园中。一条狭窄的溪流蜿蜒穿过山谷右侧，远处左侧一条宽阔的河流在层叠的蓝色山峦间转弯。前景包括崎岖且长满苔藓的石灰岩悬崖，以及从两侧框住视野的深色松枝，营造出空间深度。画面主要景观元素包括：1 条蜿蜒的远方河流、1 条狭窄的山谷溪流、1 个聚落村庄、成片的开花果树、梯田绿地、层叠的山脊以及低空漂浮的雾气。使用穿透清冷蓝色薄雾的柔和金色晨光，营造体积感雾气、写实的空气透视、清晰的自然细节，色调为深绿色和柔和的板岩蓝，画面中无人、无动物、无现代道路、无电线、无文字。意境应如同古诗中描绘的隐世桃源，宁静、广阔、湿润且神圣。使用中画幅相机搭配广角镜头拍摄，具备高动态范围、自然色彩分级，呈现超写实的纪实摄影效果。可选参考来源：{argument name="source material" default="古文中关于深山隐秘桃花源的描述"}；季节：{argument name="season" default="早春"}；时间：{argument name="time of day" default="雾气弥漫的日出"}；地点风格：{argument name="location style" default="偏远的中国山村"}；意境：{argument name="mood" default="宁静而永恒"}。

templates.title: Misty Cliff Plank Road Photograph

titleLocalized.zh: 迷雾悬崖栈道摄影

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic collectible fine-art landscape photograph inspired by ancient Chinese mountain travel writing: a perilous plank road carved into a vertical cliff in a remote misty mountain gorge. The scene shows exactly two living subjects on the narrow path: one lone traveler in simple dark traditional mountain clothing walking away from the camera, and one small pack donkey or mule loaded with bundled brown cargo. The path clings to the left side of the frame beneath a towering wet rock wall, made of uneven stone slabs and rough wooden support beams jutting out over a sheer drop. The right and center of the image open into a vast abyss filled with drifting white-gray clouds and fog, with multiple jagged forested peaks and dark limestone cliffs receding into the distance. Use a moody overcast sky, cold blue-gray color grading, damp rock textures, sparse green vegetation on ledges, and soft diffused natural light after rain. Compose as a professional documentary adventure photograph from a slightly elevated viewpoint looking along the cliff trail into the gorge, wide-angle but natural perspective, deep depth of field, cinematic realism, high detail, no fantasy architecture, no modern objects, no text, no watermark. The atmosphere should feel dangerous, ancient, quiet, and awe-inspiring, as if captured by a top National Geographic photographer in a real hidden mountain pass. Customize the source mood as {argument name="source mood" default="ancient Chinese mountain travel writing"}, the location as {argument name="mountain location" default="remote misty Chinese gorge"}, the main traveler as {argument name="main traveler" default="lone traveler in simple dark traditional mountain clothing"}, the pack animal as {argument name="pack animal" default="small pack donkey loaded with brown bundled cargo"}, and the weather as {argument name="weather" default="overcast after-rain fog"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张受中国古代山水游记启发的超写实收藏级艺术风景摄影作品：一条开凿在偏远多雾山谷垂直悬崖上的险峻栈道。画面中狭窄的路径上仅有两个活体主体：一名身着深色简约传统山地服饰的孤独行者正背对镜头行走，以及一头驮着棕色捆绑货物的驮驴或骡子。栈道紧贴画面左侧，位于高耸潮湿的岩壁之下，由不平整的石板和伸向深渊的粗糙木质支撑梁构成。画面右侧和中心展现出广阔的深渊，充斥着漂浮的灰白色云雾，远处可见多个参差不齐的森林山峰和深色石灰岩悬崖。采用阴郁的阴天、冷蓝灰色调、潮湿的岩石纹理、岩架上稀疏的绿色植被，以及雨后柔和的漫射自然光。构图采用专业纪录片探险摄影视角，从略高的位置沿悬崖小径望向峡谷，广角但视角自然，深景深，电影级写实感，高细节，无奇幻建筑，无现代物品，无文字，无水印。氛围应营造出危险、古老、宁静且令人敬畏的感觉，仿佛由顶级《国家地理》摄影师在真实的隐秘山道中拍摄。自定义源头意境为 {argument name="source mood" default="中国古代山水游记"}，地点为 {argument name="mountain location" default="偏远多雾的中国峡谷"}，主要行者为 {argument name="main traveler" default="身着深色简约传统山地服饰的孤独行者"}，驮畜为 {argument name="pack animal" default="驮着棕色捆绑货物的小型驮驴"}，天气为 {argument name="weather" default="雨后阴天雾气"}。

variables.name: main traveler
variables.defaultValue: lone traveler in simple dark traditional mountain clothing

variables.defaultValue: small pack donkey loaded with brown bundled cargo

templates.title: Hanfu Pipa Garden Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 汉服琵琶园林人像

templates.prompt: Create a collectible fine-art realistic photograph inspired by classical Chinese garden aesthetics: a young Hanfu musician seated in a quiet scholar garden, holding a pear-shaped pipa vertically in front of her body as if mid-performance. She wears layered traditional robes with a white inner garment, pale aqua translucent shawl sleeves, and a black embroidered skirt with small floral patterns; her hair is styled in an ornate classical updo with delicate pink-and-white flower hairpins. Her face is softly obscured with a natural beige blur, keeping the focus on posture, costume, and instrument. The setting is a minimalist white plaster garden wall with a flowering tree branch entering from the upper left, covered in tiny white blossoms and fresh green leaves, and a large grey Taihu scholar rock formation on the right and lower foreground with sparse ornamental grass at its base. Add vertical black Chinese brush calligraphy on the upper right wall, with two small red seal stamps beneath it, reading like an elegant inscription rather than a modern caption. Use soft diffused daylight, muted pastel tones, shallow depth of field, delicate shadows, and museum-quality editorial photography composition. The pipa should have visible frets, wooden tuning pegs, pale polished wood grain, and be centered over the figure’s torso. Overall mood: serene, poetic, refined, timeless, as if photographed by a top-tier art photographer in a real classical garden. Customize the subject as {argument name="character name" default="an anonymous Hanfu pipa musician"}, the costume palette as {argument name="costume palette" default="white, pale aqua, and black floral embroidery"}, the instrument as {argument name="instrument" default="Chinese pipa"}, the wall inscription as {argument name="calligraphy text" default="vertical classical Chinese brush calligraphy with red seals"}, and the setting as {argument name="garden setting" default="white wall, blossoming branch, and Taihu scholar rocks"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为素材，将水墨画重新诠释为由顶级摄影师拍摄的写实艺术摄影作品，而非插画。将画中的女子转化为真人模特，保持同样的坐姿演奏概念，怀抱一把真实的琵琶，身着质感细腻的汉服，保留参考图中浅白、半透明水蓝色以及深色绣花裙的印象。保持整体的竖构图和诗意的园林氛围，但场景要呈现物理真实感：背景为白色粉墙，右侧及左下方前景设有一块质感丰富的太湖石，石基处点缀稀疏的草丛，左上方延伸出一枝花枝。保留右上角墙面上的竖排中国书法和红色印章，使其如同墨迹般融入场景。采用柔和的自然光，呈现浅景深但清晰的摄影质感、淡雅的春日色调、博物馆级的造型设计、逼真的织物半透明度、考究的发饰以及宁静的中国古典美学。严格保留以下摄影元素：1 位坐姿真人模特、1 把琵琶、1 组大型太湖石、1 枝花枝、1 丛草以及 2 枚红色印章。避免呈现出绘画、CGI、奇幻概念艺术或直接的平面复制感；最终成品应呈现出受古画启发而创作的真实摄影作品质感。可选自定义项：设置场景氛围为 {argument name="source mood" default="古典中国春日园林雅韵"}，乐器为 {argument name="instrument" default="琵琶"}，服装配色为 {argument name="wardrobe palette" default="白色、半透明水蓝色及黑色绣花丝绸"}，背景设置为 {argument name="background setting" default="带有太湖石的白色粉墙"}。

templates.title: Fictional Band Group Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构乐队合影

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic full-body studio group photo of a fictional four-member alternative synth-rock band named {argument name="band name" default="Neon Nocturne"}. The lineup has exactly 4 people standing shoulder-to-shoulder in a moody industrial photo studio: 1) far left, a tall slim man with shoulder-length wavy dark hair, wearing a deep burgundy velvet blazer over a black button-up shirt, black skinny jeans, and black leather boots, hands in pockets; 2) front center, the lead singer, a tall confident woman with short platinum-silver hair, wearing a cropped black leather motorcycle jacket, dark burgundy tank top, high-waisted black tailored trousers, pointed black ankle boots, and silver rings, standing slightly forward with one hand near the jacket; 3) right-center, a petite woman with a sleek black bob haircut, wearing a shiny teal satin bomber jacket over a dark top, short black pleated skirt, sheer black tights, and chunky black platform combat boots, standing close behind the lead singer; 4) far right, a tall broad man with a shaved head, wearing a loose charcoal knit sweater, black cargo pants, chunky black boots, and a small hoop earring, hands in pockets. Use a dark concrete wall and glossy concrete floor, with visible colored stage lights on stands: magenta/pink light glowing from the left and cyan/blue light glowing from the right, plus small warm floor lights near the background. The lighting should create dramatic rim highlights, haze, soft smoke, reflections on the floor, and a high-end music promo photography look. Keep the wardrobe mostly black with burgundy and teal accents, edgy but polished. Vertical 2:3 composition, full bodies visible, realistic photography, sharp clothing detail, shallow atmospheric depth, no text, no logo, no album cover typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感的全身摄影棚合影，主角是一支名为 {argument name="band name" default="Neon Nocturne"} 的虚构四人另类合成器摇滚乐队。阵容为 4 人并肩站立于氛围感十足的工业风摄影棚中：1) 最左侧，一位高瘦男子，留着齐肩深色波浪卷发，身穿深酒红色天鹅绒西装外套，内搭黑色衬衫，配黑色紧身牛仔裤和黑色皮靴，双手插兜；2) 前方中央，主唱，一位高挑自信的女性，留着银白色短发，身穿黑色短款皮质机车夹克，内搭深酒红色背心，配黑色高腰西装裤、黑色尖头短靴和银色戒指，身体微微前倾，一只手靠近夹克；3) 右侧中央，一位娇小的女性，留着利落的黑色波波头，身穿亮面青色缎面飞行员夹克，内搭深色上衣，配黑色百褶短裙、黑色透肤连裤袜和厚底黑色马丁靴，站在主唱身后；4) 最右侧，一位身材魁梧的男子，剃着光头，身穿宽松的炭灰色针织毛衣，配黑色工装裤、厚底黑色靴子和一枚小圆环耳环，双手插兜。背景为深色混凝土墙面和光亮的混凝土底面，配有可见的落地式彩色舞台灯：左侧发出洋红色/粉色光，右侧发出青色/蓝色光，背景处还有小型暖色地灯。灯光需营造出戏剧性的轮廓高光、薄雾、柔和烟雾、地面反射以及高端音乐宣传照的质感。服装以黑色为主，点缀酒红色和青色，风格前卫且精致。2:3 竖构图，全身可见，写实摄影，服装细节清晰，浅景深氛围，无文字，无 Logo，无专辑封面排版。

templates.title: Anime Idol Ad Truck in Japan

titleLocalized.zh: 日本动漫偶像宣传卡车

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic 16:9 daytime street scene in a fictional but realistic Japanese entertainment district resembling Shibuya or Akihabara, with a large white advertising truck centered in the composition driving through a wide crosswalk-lined road. The truck should be the main subject, angled three-quarters toward the viewer so both the front cab and the long side billboard are visible. Cover the truck’s side and upper billboard panels with bright anime-style promotional artwork for {argument name="character name" default="Erika Mizushima"}, a blonde blue-eyed swimsuit idol character, advertising {argument name="product" default="her first photo book"}. Include Japanese ad copy on the truck such as {argument name="headline text" default="はじまりの夏。"} and a release line like {argument name="release date" default="7.18 ON SALE"}, set in elegant cyan and pink typography over a tropical blue-sky beach background. Surround the road with tall commercial buildings packed with colorful vertical Japanese signs, karaoke signs, game center billboards, book store and cafe signage, huge anime posters, LED screens, and dense urban advertising; make the city feel busy but not based on a real exact location. Show a lively crowd of pedestrians on both sidewalks and at the crossing, with exactly 4 clearly visible foreground pedestrians holding smartphones up to photograph or film the ad truck: two on the left sidewalk and two on the right sidewalk. Add additional background pedestrians as a dense crowd, but keep them less detailed. Use bright summer sunlight, deep blue sky with scattered white clouds, crisp shadows, saturated colors, realistic asphalt texture, road lane markings, and a polished commercial-photo look. Keep the truck centered, sharp, and dominant; make the anime artwork vivid and readable while the background billboards remain slightly less important. Avoid logos from real brands and avoid watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的日间街景照片，场景设定在类似涩谷或秋叶原的虚构但真实的日本娱乐区，画面中央是一辆大型白色宣传卡车，正行驶在宽阔的斑马线道路上。卡车应作为主体，以四分之三的角度面向观众，以便同时展示前车头和长侧面的广告牌。卡车侧面和顶部广告牌应覆盖 {argument name="character name" default="Erika Mizushima"} 的明亮动漫风格宣传图，这是一位金发蓝眼的泳装偶像角色，正在宣传 {argument name="product" default="她的第一本写真集"}。卡车上应包含日文广告文案，例如 {argument name="headline text" default="はじまりの夏。"} 以及发布信息如 {argument name="release date" default="7.18 ON SALE"}，采用优雅的青色和粉色字体，背景为热带蓝天沙滩。道路周围环绕着高大的商业建筑，挂满色彩鲜艳的日文竖排招牌、卡拉 OK 招牌、游戏中心广告牌、书店和咖啡馆标识、巨型动漫海报、LED 屏幕以及密集的城市广告；让城市呈现出繁忙感，但不要基于真实的特定地点。在两侧人行道和十字路口展示热闹的人群，其中前景中要有 4 位清晰可见的行人正举着智能手机拍摄或录制这辆宣传卡车：左侧人行道 2 位，右侧人行道 2 位。背景中添加更多行人作为密集人群，但细节处理相对模糊。使用明亮的夏日阳光、深蓝天空和零星白云，阴影清晰，色彩饱和，呈现真实的沥青纹理、道路标线以及精致的商业摄影质感。保持卡车居中、清晰且占据主导地位；使动漫艺术作品生动易读，同时背景广告牌的视觉权重略低。避免使用真实品牌标志，并避免出现水印。

templates.title: Iridescent Water Phone Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 虹彩水波纹手机壁纸

templates.prompt: Create an abstract vertical phone wallpaper showing a close-up surface of clear tropical water with shimmering caustic light patterns, soft ripples, and iridescent pastel color refractions. The image should fill a tall {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} canvas with no horizon, no objects, no people, and no text. Use a luminous aqua and cyan base with areas of {argument name="accent colors" default="lavender, violet, pale pink, and turquoise"}, like sunlight refracting through shallow pool water or holographic glass. Include exactly three noticeable circular ripple whirlpools: one near the upper-left edge, one larger spiral in the lower-left quadrant, and one small partial spiral near the bottom center edge. Add long diagonal wave streaks flowing from upper right to lower left, bright white highlights, pearly glow, subtle rainbow dispersion, and a dreamy high-key exposure. The overall style is photorealistic but ethereal, glossy, clean, and suitable as a calming smartphone wallpaper.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张抽象的竖版手机壁纸，展示清澈热带水面的特写，呈现闪烁的焦散光影、柔和的涟漪以及虹彩般的柔和色彩折射。图像应填满 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} 的高比例画布，画面中不包含地平线、物体、人物或文字。使用发光的浅水蓝和青色作为基底，局部点缀 {argument name="accent colors" default="薰衣草紫、紫罗兰色、淡粉色和绿松石色"}，如同阳光穿透浅水池或全息玻璃的效果。画面中需包含三个明显的圆形涟漪漩涡：一个位于左上边缘附近，一个较大的螺旋位于左下象限，还有一个小型局部螺旋位于底部中心边缘附近。添加从右上流向左下的长条对角波纹、明亮的白色高光、珍珠般的光泽、微妙的彩虹色散，以及梦幻般的高调曝光。整体风格写实而空灵，质感光洁，非常适合作为令人心旷神怡的智能手机壁纸。

templates.title: Fantasy RPG Ad Truck in Tokyo District

titleLocalized.zh: 东京街头的奇幻 RPG 宣传卡车

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic 16:9 daytime street scene in a fictional Japanese entertainment district inspired by Akihabara or Shinjuku, with a large advertising truck centered in the composition driving down a multi-lane road. The truck should be a glossy white modern box truck viewed from a front three-quarter angle, chrome grille and mirrors sparkling, realistic windshield reflections, visible headlights, license plate, tires, and road markings. The entire side and roof billboard of the truck advertise a newly released fantasy RPG called {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}, featuring {argument name="character description" default="an elegant blonde anime holy knight woman in white and gold armor with a radiant sun emblem"}. Include large Japanese ad copy on the truck side reading {argument name="main ad copy" default="光の意志が、世界を救う。"}, smaller launch text reading {argument name="launch text" default="新作RPG、開幕。"}, and the game title in refined serif lettering. Surround the road with tall commercial buildings packed with colorful vertical signs, anime billboards, game posters, storefront banners, glass façades, and LED screens; repeat the same fantasy character on several building ads in the background. Show a crowd of pedestrians on both sidewalks and in the foreground, with exactly 4 clearly visible people holding smartphones up to photograph or record the advertising truck: two blurred phones in the lower left foreground, one raised phone at lower center, and one raised phone at right foreground. Make the ad truck the sharp focal point while foreground spectators are slightly blurred for depth of field. Lighting is bright midday sun with blue sky, crisp shadows, vibrant but realistic colors, urban bustle, cinematic street photography, high detail, no real brands, no watermark, no extra vehicles blocking the truck.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 的写实日间街景，场景设定在受秋叶原或新宿启发的虚构日本娱乐区，一辆大型宣传卡车位于构图中心，行驶在多车道公路上。卡车应为一辆现代白色厢式货车，采用前侧 45 度视角，镀铬格栅和后视镜闪闪发光，挡风玻璃有逼真的反射，可见大灯、车牌、轮胎和道路标线。卡车的整个侧面和车顶广告牌正在宣传一款名为 {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"} 的新发布奇幻 RPG，画面展示了 {argument name="character description" default="一位优雅的金色长发动漫圣骑士女性，身穿白金相间的盔甲，带有耀眼的太阳徽章"}。卡车侧面印有醒目的日文广告文案 {argument name="main ad copy" default="光の意志が、世界を救う。"}，以及较小的发布文字 {argument name="launch text" default="新作RPG、開幕。"}，游戏标题采用精致的衬线字体。道路周围环绕着高大的商业建筑，上面挤满了色彩缤纷的竖排招牌、动漫广告牌、游戏海报、店面横幅、玻璃幕墙和 LED 屏幕；在背景的几处建筑广告上重复出现相同的奇幻角色。在两侧人行道和前景中展示一群行人，其中明确可见 4 人正举起智能手机拍摄或录制这辆宣传卡车：左下前景中有两部模糊的手机，下部中心有一部举起的手机，右侧前景也有一部举起的手机。使宣传卡车成为清晰的焦点，前景中的观众略微模糊以营造景深感。光线为明亮的午后阳光，天空湛蓝，阴影清晰，色彩鲜艳且真实，展现城市喧嚣，电影级街头摄影，高细节，无真实品牌，无水印，无其他车辆遮挡卡车。

templates.title: Anime Idol Ad Truck in Japan

titleLocalized.zh: 日本动漫偶像宣传车

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic 16:9 daytime street scene in a fictional but believable Japanese entertainment district resembling Shibuya or Shinjuku, with a large advertising truck as the central subject driving along a multi-lane road. The ad truck promotes a newly released anime idol product titled {argument name="product title" default="Starlight Melody"}. Cover the truck with glossy blue, lavender, and white starry graphics featuring one main anime-style blonde idol girl in a blue frilly stage dress, with sparkling magical effects and a polished commercial campaign look; keep her face softly obscured or blanked as if anonymized. Place the same campaign across surrounding building billboards, LED screens, banners, and street posters, including exactly 6 prominent visible advertisements: 1 large front truck billboard with Japanese release text, 1 large side truck wrap with the idol character, 1 smaller logo panel on the truck bumper, 1 huge pink billboard above the street, 1 curved building screen showing the idol, and 1 tall blue roadside banner. Use readable promotional text on the truck and signs such as "New Release!", {argument name="release date" default="2025.6.25"}, "ON SALE!", and the title "Starlight Melody", with a mix of English and Japanese-style typography. The truck should have a shiny chrome cab, realistic reflections, tires, mirrors, headlights, and road shadows. Show crowds of pedestrians on both sidewalks and in the foreground; include exactly 4 clearly visible people holding smartphones up to photograph or record the ad truck, two close foreground figures seen from behind and two smaller figures in the crowd. Add crosswalk markings, lane lines, street trees, glass building facades, many vertical shop signs, blue sky, bright sun, and crisp high-detail realism. Composition: low street-level perspective, ad truck centered and moving slightly toward the viewer from left to right, bustling urban depth, vibrant colors, no real brands, no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 的日间街道场景，要求照片级逼真。场景设定在虚构但可信的日本娱乐区，类似于涩谷或新宿，一辆大型宣传车作为中心主体行驶在多车道公路上。这辆宣传车正在推广一款新发布的动漫偶像产品，标题为 {argument name="product title" default="Starlight Melody"}。车身覆盖着亮面的蓝色、淡紫色和白色星空图案，印有一位身穿蓝色荷叶边舞台装的动漫风格金发偶像少女，带有闪烁的魔法效果，呈现出精致的商业广告感；保持她的面部模糊或空白，以示匿名。将相同的宣传内容布置在周围建筑的广告牌、LED 屏幕、横幅和街头海报上，包括 6 个清晰可见的广告：1 个带有日文发布文本的卡车前部大广告牌、1 个印有偶像角色的卡车侧面大车贴、1 个位于卡车保险杠上的小型标志板、1 个街道上方巨大的粉色广告牌、1 个显示偶像的弧形建筑屏幕以及 1 个高大的蓝色路边横幅。在卡车和标志上使用清晰易读的宣传文字，例如“New Release!”、{argument name="release date" default="2025.6.25"}、“ON SALE!”以及标题“Starlight Melody”，并结合英文和日式排版。卡车应具备闪亮的镀铬驾驶室、逼真的反射效果、轮胎、后视镜、前大灯和路面阴影。在两侧人行道和前景中展示熙熙攘攘的行人；包括 4 位清晰可见、正举起智能手机拍摄或录制宣传车的行人，其中两位是背对镜头的近景人物，另外两位是人群中较小的人物。添加人行横道线、车道线、行道树、玻璃建筑外墙、许多垂直的商店招牌、蓝天、明媚的阳光以及清晰的高细节真实感。构图：低角度街景视角，宣传车居中并从左向右缓慢驶向观众，呈现繁华的城市纵深感，色彩鲜艳，无真实品牌，无水印。

templates.title: Japanese Cosmetic Ad Truck

titleLocalized.zh: 日本美妆广告宣传车

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic 16:9 daytime street scene in a fictional Japanese downtown entertainment district resembling Shibuya or Shinjuku, filled with tall glass buildings, dense vertical billboards, pink beauty advertisements, and crowds on both sidewalks. Place a large white advertising truck in the exact center of the composition, driving along a multi-lane road from left to right, shown in side profile with the cab on the left and the rear on the right. The truck is wrapped with a soft pink cosmetic campaign for {argument name="product name" default="LUMIERE"} by {argument name="brand name" default="PURELIA"}, featuring a bright high-key beauty photo of {argument name="featured model" default="a smiling young Japanese woman with long brown hair, winking and touching her cheek"}, plus three visible pink cosmetic bottles and tubes. Include elegant Japanese ad copy on the truck, with the main slogan {argument name="slogan text" default="わたし史上、いちばん透明感。"} above the product name and smaller pink text near the bottom. The same model and product packaging should also appear on the rear side panel of the truck and on large building screens in the background. In the foreground, show a crowd of pedestrians from behind and at the sides, with exactly 8 visible people holding smartphones up to photograph or record the ad truck: four on the lower left foreground, three across the lower center, and one on the lower right edge. Add larger sidewalk crowds standing behind the road, watching the truck. Use realistic daylight, blue sky with scattered clouds, crisp reflections on building glass, natural shadows, street markings, and a high-detail commercial photography look. Keep the truck dominant, clean, and sharply focused; make the city signs feel Japanese with mostly pink and white signage, but avoid logos from real brands. No watermark, no extra vehicles blocking the truck.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 的写实风格日间街景，场景设定在类似于涩谷或新宿的虚构日本市中心娱乐区，背景包含高耸的玻璃建筑、密集的垂直广告牌、粉色美妆广告以及两侧人行道上的人群。在构图正中央放置一辆大型白色广告宣传车，车辆沿多车道公路从左向右行驶，展示侧面轮廓，车头在左，车尾在右。车身包裹着由 {argument name="brand name" default="PURELIA"} 推出的 {argument name="product name" default="LUMIERE"} 系列柔和粉色美妆广告，画面包含一张高调明亮的美妆照片，主角为 {argument name="featured model" default="一位留着棕色长发、正在眨眼并轻触脸颊的年轻日本女性微笑照"}，以及三个清晰可见的粉色化妆品瓶罐。宣传车上印有优雅的日文广告文案，主标语 {argument name="slogan text" default="わたし史上、いちばん透明感。"} 位于产品名称上方，底部配有较小的粉色文字。同一位模特和产品包装也应出现在宣传车的后侧面板以及背景的大型建筑屏幕上。前景中展示从背后和侧面拍摄的行人，其中正好有 8 个人举着智能手机拍摄或录制这辆宣传车：左下角前景 4 人，下部中心 3 人，右下边缘 1 人。在道路后方增加更多驻足观看宣传车的人群。采用写实日光、蓝天白云、建筑玻璃上的清晰倒影、自然阴影、道路标线，并呈现高细节的商业摄影质感。保持宣传车处于主体地位，画面清晰且对焦锐利；城市招牌需体现日本特色，以粉色和白色为主，避免使用真实品牌 Logo。无水印，无其他车辆遮挡宣传车。
