templates.prompt:
A medium-shot authentic daily life photograph, natural candid moment, of an {argument name="subject" default="East Asian young woman"} standing at the corner of a long interior corridor. 85mm lens, waist-up framing, shallow depth of field. The corridor behind her recedes into soft depth — wooden panelling on one side, white plaster on the other, afternoon light arriving distantly at the far end.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes, elongated outer corners, gaze directed slightly sideways down the corridor's length. Straight delicate nose bridge. Skin tone fair beige, calm in the quiet of the hallway. Skin subsurface scattering visible under directional light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge, fine foundation powder grain perceptible.
She wears a {argument name="attire" default="charcoal grey silk qipao with gold phoenix embroidery"} — the gold thread dulled and settled, more like old lacquer than new gilt. Mandarin collar, short sleeves, fitted silhouette. She stands still at the corner without purpose, one shoulder near the wall, gaze carrying down the corridor as if listening. The corridor holds nothing else — no art, no furniture, just the texture of the wall and the long pull of the floor. Two or three stray hairs displaced by faint air movement, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.
Diffuse natural light arrives from the corridor's distant end, catching the near side of her face and the left shoulder of the qipao, leaving the rest in soft shadow. The charcoal silk absorbs the dim light with quiet weight. Mood: a pause between one room and the next. Subtle {argument name="film style" default="ISO 400 film grain"} in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 9:16. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

东亚年轻女性，20 岁出头。杏仁眼，眼角细长，目光略微侧向走廊深处。鼻梁挺直秀气。肤色白皙偏米色，在走廊的静谧中显得沉稳。在定向光线下可见皮肤的次表面散射，颧骨和鼻梁上有细微的镜面高光，隐约可见细腻的粉底质感。
她身着一件 {argument name="attire" default="炭灰色丝绸旗袍，配有金色凤凰刺绣"} ——金线色泽沉稳内敛，更像陈年漆器而非崭新的镀金。立领，短袖，修身剪裁。她漫不经心地站在拐角处，一侧肩膀靠近墙壁，目光顺着走廊延伸，仿佛在倾听。走廊里空无一物——没有艺术品，没有家具，只有墙壁的纹理和长长的地板延伸感。两三缕发丝因微弱的气流而散落，呈现出自然的非刻意瑕疵，而非几何对称。

templates.title: Classical Study Room Portrait

templates.prompt:

The background: dark bookshelves receding into soft darkness, a single {argument name="prop" default="inkstone"} on the desk surface catching reflected window light.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with soft single eyelids, composed and slightly downcast. Delicate refined nose bridge. Skin fair to light beige, smooth in even diffused light. Skin subsurface scattering visible under directional light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge, fine foundation powder grain perceptible.
She wears a deep {argument name="clothing color" default="navy silk qipao"} with {argument name="embroidery" default="interlocking vine embroidery"} in faded slate-grey thread — historical pattern, slightly muted, the navy absorbed into aged silk like old ink. Mandarin collar, short sleeves, clean and fitted. One hand rests on the edge of the desk near the inkstone, fingers just touching the dark stone without purpose. The room exists at the edge of what natural light can reach. Two or three stray hairs displaced by faint air movement, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.
Overcast afternoon light filters through a small high window off-frame, arriving as a soft ambient wash with no strong directionality — cool and grey, making the deep navy appear almost black against pale walls. Silence of concentration without a task. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 9:16. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

templates.title: 3D CG Anime Girl Illustration

templates.prompt:
An adult 2D fantasy female character, 3D CG high-precision rendering style, 9:16 vertical composition, upper body close-up portrait, character located slightly to the left of the center, body slightly turned to the right, face in a soft three-quarter profile view, looking gently forward or slightly toward the camera, expression gentle, sweet, quiet, with a slight sense of shyness and soft approachability, overall temperament cute, exquisite, warm, and high-end.

She has fair and transparent skin, delicate and smooth texture, with a soft luster and slight blush. Exquisite small facial features, soft and rounded face shape, slender nose, soft natural lips, corners of the mouth slightly upturned. Eyes are large and clear, pupils in a blue-purple gradient, expression gentle and bright, with a sweet dreamy temperament, long eyelashes, delicate eye makeup, overall face combining cuteness, softness, and high-end quality. She wears a pair of thin-rimmed round glasses, enhancing the literary, intellectual, and cute vibe.

Body type emphasizes mature and soft feminine beauty, well-proportioned and plump figure, full and natural chest, rounded and soft shoulders, elegant clavicle, slender neck, soft and smooth upper body curves, overall presenting a healthy, soft, slightly fleshy but very well-proportioned sweet female physique. Natural transition from chest to waist, figure is plump but not exaggerated, highlighting gentle, cute, and feminine high-end beauty.

Hairstyle is {argument name="hair color" default="light silver blue"} medium-length hair, overall light and fluffy, rich in layers, with distinct electric blue gradients at the tips and inner layers. Hair curls slightly at the ears and ends with airy stray hairs. Hair strands are delicate and smooth, with a sense of transparency, lightness, and clear luster. Wearing a {argument name="hat" default="navy blue beret"}, the material is soft and delicate with silky highlights, decorated with small metal buttons on the brim, overall cute and exquisite.

Clothing is a {argument name="outfit" default="light gray-white off-shoulder knitted sweater"}, coarse knit texture clearly visible, loose neckline sliding down naturally, revealing soft shoulders, clavicle, and upper chest lines. The sweater material is soft and thick, with a slight lazy and home-sweet temperament, naturally fitting the plump and soft upper body curves. Inner thin-strap top, natural and soft chest structure, not exaggerated but reflecting full, soft, feminine body features. Overall clothing presents a gentle, sweet, slightly sexy but still restrained high-end atmosphere.

Accessories include a black satin choker with a blue gemstone pendant in the center; earrings are blue crystal dangles; an exquisite blue butterfly gemstone necklace on the chest. All accessories are unified in the blue system, exquisite and delicate, enhancing the dreamy sweet feeling.

Scene is a bright indoor window side, morning or afternoon sunlight shining from the side and back, forming soft natural light and partial highlights. Character's skin, shoulders, clavicle, chest contour, and hair edges have clear rim light, soft and warm light sense. Background is clean and simple, light curtains and indoor environment are blurred, creating a warm, quiet, comfortable, and healing atmosphere. A cup of coffee or latte is visible in the bottom right corner, with light latte art, enhancing the lifestyle, relaxed, and sweet daily atmosphere.

Camera language is a close-up portrait lens, with a slight selfie-style foreground perspective, one arm can naturally extend slightly from the bottom left foreground, but not as the focus, avoiding the hand becoming the visual center. Overall style is a fusion of 2D aesthetics and high-quality 3D CG character modeling, similar to high-precision game character promo images, PBR materials, delicate skin shading, soft subsurface scattering, high-precision hair rendering, realistic fabric textures, transparent jewelry materials, the frame is bright, fresh, soft, sweet, exquisite, cute, and high-end.

Keywords: 3D CG, anime style 3D girl, sweet curvy girl, soft feminine beauty, upper body portrait, full figure, soft bust line, silver blue hair, blue gradient hair tips, round glasses, navy beret, off shoulder knitted sweater, butterfly pendant, blue crystal earrings, black ribbon choker, soft sunlight, indoor window light, coffee cup, delicate skin, cinematic lighting, PBR materials, ultra detailed, cute, gentle, sweet, refined

她拥有白皙通透的皮肤，质感细腻且带有柔和的光泽。五官精致小巧，脸型圆润，鼻梁纤细，嘴唇自然柔和，带着浅浅的微笑。双眼明亮清澈，呈现蓝紫色渐变，眼神温柔明亮，透着甜美梦幻的气质。她佩戴着细框圆眼镜，增添了一份文艺可爱的魅力。

她的发型是 {argument name="hair color" default="浅银蓝色"} 的中长发，轻盈蓬松，富有层次感，发梢带有电光蓝渐变。她戴着一顶海军蓝贝雷帽。身穿一件浅色露肩针织衫，展现出柔和的肩部和锁骨线条。

场景设定在 {argument name="scene" default="明亮的室内窗边"}，清晨或午后的阳光营造出柔和的高光。背景干净且经过虚化处理。

templates.title: Character Search History UI

titleLocalized.zh: 角色搜索记录 UI

templates.prompt:
Analyze the character in the attached image and create an image of the moment someone accidentally peeks at their smartphone search history, which they absolutely didn't want anyone to see.
[Search History]
- {argument name="count" default="5 to 7 items"} in Japanese
- {argument name="theme" default="probing into romance"}
- Content that reveals their inner thoughts (vanity, jealousy, desire for approval, secret hobbies, etc.) despite their efforts to hide them
- Each item must have a different emotion or role
- Write using the character's specific tone and word choice
- No extreme content required.

[UI] Smartphone search history screen style (with search bar, time, and icons). Legible information density.

[Character Reaction]
Draw a reaction typical of that character the moment their history is seen (e.g., getting angry to cover it up if they are strong-willed, hiding agitation if they are cool, laughing it off if they are calculating).

[Composition]
- A sense of distance as if peeking
- Both the search history and the character's reaction are the main focus
- Aspect ratio {argument name="ratio" default="9:16"}

promptLocalized.zh:

[搜索记录]
- {argument name="count" default="5 到 7 条"} 日语内容
- {argument name="theme" default="探究浪漫关系"}
- 内容需揭示其内心想法（如虚荣心、嫉妒、渴望认可、秘密爱好等），即使他们极力掩饰
- 每条记录需体现不同的情绪或侧面
- 使用该角色特定的语气和用词习惯
- 无需包含极端内容。

[UI] 智能手机搜索记录界面风格（包含搜索栏、时间及图标）。信息密度需清晰易读。

[角色反应]
描绘该角色在搜索记录被看到的瞬间所表现出的典型反应（例如：性格刚毅者会愤怒掩饰，冷静者会掩盖慌乱，精明者会试图一笑置之）。

[构图]
- 营造一种窥视般的距离感
- 搜索记录与角色的反应均为画面焦点

templates.title: Illustration-to-Clock Transformation Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 插画转挂钟设计提示词

templates.prompt:
Create a realistic premium wall clock inspired entirely by the uploaded illustration. The clock must reinterpret the artwork’s atmosphere, character design, emotional tone, color palette, symbols, architecture, fashion, lighting, fantasy or sci-fi elements, and worldbuilding into a highly original cuckoo-clock-like hanging clock design. Do not create a generic antique clock. The entire silhouette, carvings, ornaments, moving parts, pendulum, decorative windows, roof structure, numerals, hands, textures, and materials must feel naturally born from the illustration’s universe.

Fantasy shrine maiden themes may inspire lacquered wood, spiritual crests, torii-inspired framing, glowing talismans, hanging bells, sakura carvings, layered shrine architecture, elegant red-and-black lacquer textures, and softly illuminated paper windows. Futuristic or android-inspired illustrations may create holographic clock faces, segmented mechanical armor panels, glowing circuitry, transparent crystal housings, floating rings, neon edge lighting, animated digital pendulums, and sleek asymmetrical structures. Cute pastel worlds may inspire rounded soft silhouettes, candy-like decorations, transparent ornaments, heart motifs, glossy enamel surfaces, plush textures, and dreamy fairytale styling.

The cuckoo-clock-style opening should contain a small animated figure, spirit, mechanical bird, tiny mascot, or symbolic object derived from the illustration itself. The pendulum and moving ornaments should visually match the worldbuilding and emotional tone of the artwork. Clock hands and numerals must be uniquely designed to fit the illustration instead of using standard designs.

If the uploaded illustration contains a character, place the same character naturally beneath or beside the wall clock, looking upward toward it with curiosity or admiration while preserving the original face, hairstyle, proportions, colors, clothing style, and personality. Bright cinematic lighting, ultra detailed craftsmanship, realistic materials, premium fantasy interior photography, elegant shadows, highly detailed reflections, masterpiece quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据上传的插画，创作一款极具质感的高端挂钟。该挂钟需将插画的艺术氛围、角色设计、情感基调、配色方案、符号元素、建筑风格、服饰、光影、奇幻或科幻元素以及世界观，重新诠释为极具原创性的布谷鸟钟式挂钟设计。请勿设计成普通的古董钟。整体轮廓、雕刻、装饰、活动部件、钟摆、装饰窗、屋顶结构、数字、指针、纹理和材质，都必须呈现出仿佛源自该插画世界的自然感。

奇幻巫女主题可融入漆木、灵力纹章、鸟居风格框架、发光符咒、悬挂铃铛、樱花雕刻、层叠的神社建筑、优雅的红黑漆器纹理以及柔和发光的纸窗。未来主义或仿生人主题可采用全息钟面、分段式机械装甲面板、发光电路、透明水晶外壳、悬浮环、霓虹边缘灯光、动态数字钟摆以及流畅的非对称结构。可爱的马卡龙色系世界则可启发圆润柔和的轮廓、糖果般的装饰、透明饰品、爱心元素、光泽感珐琅表面、毛绒质感以及梦幻的童话风格。

布谷鸟钟式的开窗处应包含一个源自插画本身的小型动态角色、灵体、机械鸟、微型吉祥物或象征性物体。钟摆和活动装饰应在视觉上与插画的世界观及情感基调相契合。钟表指针和数字必须进行独特设计以适配插画，而非使用标准样式。

如果上传的插画中包含角色，请将该角色自然地放置在挂钟下方或侧面，使其带着好奇或赞赏的神情仰望挂钟，同时保留角色原有的面部特征、发型、比例、配色、服装风格和个性。要求明亮的电影级光影、极致的细节工艺、逼真的材质、高端奇幻室内摄影质感、优雅的阴影、高精度的反射效果，呈现大师级作品水准。

Replace the face area with a smooth, featureless dark gray rectangular placeholder centered under the hat brim, as if reserved for {argument name="character face" default="a recognizable selfie face"}. Lighting should be dramatic: the streetlamp creates a glowing halo on the left while the detective remains mostly in shadow, with rim light catching raindrops on the coat and hat. The letters must be black, extremely tall, tightly spaced, distressed, and partially hidden behind the model. The face is intentionally obscured by a centered soft gray square blur/mask. Outfit has exactly 8 visible fashion elements: 1 oversized dark distressed graphic T-shirt, 2 layered necklaces with small pendants, 1 baggy dark cargo pant, 1 hanging chain on the right hip, 1 bracelet stack on the wrist, 1 pair of chunky black-and-white sneakers, and 1 small forearm tattoo. Clothing should look worn, rebellious, and urban.

Text content: Include exactly 10 small text blocks/icons around the poster: 1 top-left quote reading “RULES WERE MADE / TO BE BROKEN.”, 1 top-center small globe icon, 1 top-right quote reading “NOT EVERYONE / WAS MEANT TO FIT IN.”, 1 left vertical slogan reading “DISRUPT. DEFY. Add exactly 2 tiny globe icons total: one at the top center and one at the bottom left.

Visual style: Black, white, and gray only; gritty halftone texture; editorial streetwear look; distressed typography; sharp studio lighting with a soft floor shadow; high-fashion poster design; no color accents.

Constraints: Keep all text in English, preserve the huge word and script title as the visual focus, do not add extra people, do not add extra logos beyond the specified {argument name="brand name" default="RBLN"} branding, and keep the composition clean but intense.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="RBLN"} 创作一张单色叛逆时尚编辑风格海报，以站在巨大字体前的全身街头风模特为中心。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，768 x 1152 构图，黑白色调，浅灰色纸张背景，细微的复印颗粒感，磨损的墨迹纹理，高对比度，地下音乐杂志美学。

布局：将一名全身人物置于画面中心，双脚靠近底部边缘，头部与背景的巨大文字重叠。在人物身后，用一个巨大的压缩粗体大写单词填满几乎整个海报高度：{argument name="main background word" default="REBELLION"}。字母必须为黑色，极高，间距紧凑，呈现做旧效果，并部分被模特遮挡。在下半部分前景中，叠加一个巨大的白色手绘笔刷字体，内容为 {argument name="script title" default="Rebellion"}，从左下角斜向右上方延伸，覆盖模特的腿部和躯干。在边缘处添加小型编辑风格微型文字，如同杂志封面或街头风宣传海报。

主体细节：模特为中性化形象，姿态放松，双手插兜，略微含胸，面向前方。留着齐肩凌乱的波浪金发。面部被一个居中的柔和灰色方形模糊遮罩刻意遮挡。服装包含 8 个可见的时尚元素：1 件超大号深色做旧印花 T 恤，2 条带有小吊坠的叠戴项链，1 条宽松深色工装裤，右侧腰间挂有 1 条链条，手腕上有 1 叠手链，1 双厚底黑白运动鞋，以及 1 个小前臂纹身。服装应看起来陈旧、叛逆且具有都市感。

文字内容：在海报周围包含 10 个小型文本块/图标：左上角引用语“RULES WERE MADE / TO BE BROKEN.”，顶部中心一个小地球仪图标，右上角引用语“NOT EVERYONE / WAS MEANT TO FIT IN.”，左侧垂直标语“DISRUPT. DEFY. DEFINE.”，右侧垂直条形码及微小标签文字，右侧垂直标语“BREAK THE PATTERN”，左下角宣言块“THEY CALL IT CHAOS. / I CALL IT FREEDOM. / I DON’T FOLLOW PATHS. / I LEAVE TRACES. / THIS ISN’T A PHASE. / THIS IS WHO I AM.”，一个小黑色标签“RBLN / WORLDWIDE / 2024”，右下角手写签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Rbln"}，以及右下角引用语“LOUD MINDS. / RAW SOULS. / REAL ONES ONLY.”。添加 3 个小型星形/火花图标：一个在左侧，一个在右侧条形码区域附近，一个在底部中心附近。总共添加 2 个微型地球仪图标：一个在顶部中心，一个在左下角。

视觉风格：仅限黑、白、灰；粗砺的半色调纹理；编辑风格街头感；做旧字体；锐利的摄影棚灯光，带有柔和的地板阴影；高级时尚海报设计；无彩色点缀。

约束：所有文字保持英文，保留巨大单词和手写标题作为视觉焦点，不要添加额外人物，除指定的 {argument name="brand name" default="RBLN"} 品牌外不要添加额外 Logo，保持构图简洁但强烈。

templates.title: Sketch to Manga Comic Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 从草图到漫画的华丽蜕变

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic tabletop scene showing a manga/comic artwork in progress on a sheet of paper, viewed from a slightly overhead angle on a dark wooden desk. The page is split diagonally by a jagged glowing golden tear of sparks: the left half is a rough graphite pencil sketch, and the right half is the finished colored comic. On the left sketch side, draw an unfinished city skyline with tall skyscrapers and a lone caped hero seen from behind, all in loose construction lines, smudges, crosshatching, and eraser dust. On the right finished side, render a dramatic noir manga superhero scene in deep navy blues, black inks, halftone dots, warm yellow window lights, and crisp white panel borders: a silhouetted young male hero with spiky hair and a long flowing cape stands on a rooftop ledge facing a dense futuristic city under a large full moon and streaky clouds. The finished comic page contains exactly 4 visible panels: 1 large main panel with the hero overlooking the city, 2 narrow vertical panels stacked on the right showing dark city architecture and a rooftop water tower, and 1 wide bottom-right panel showing diagonal urban perspective lines and buildings. Add real art supplies around the page: exactly 1 sharpened pencil on the lower left, exactly 2 black drawing pens on the lower right, and 1 metal cup partially visible at the top right. Use dramatic warm desk lighting, realistic paper texture, ink grain, halftone print texture, glowing transition sparks, and high-detail comic linework. The scene should feel like a transformation from sketch to finished comic art. Customize the hero as {argument name="character type" default="spiky-haired caped young male vigilante"}, the setting as {argument name="city setting" default="noir futuristic rooftop city"}, the comic palette as {argument name="color palette" default="deep navy, black ink, warm yellow lights, and golden sparks"}, the moon detail as {argument name="sky feature" default="large full moon behind drifting clouds"}, and the desk style as {argument name="desk surface" default="dark wooden artist desk"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影质感的桌面场景，展示一张正在创作中的漫画/绘本作品，视角为深色木质书桌上的微俯视视角。页面被一道锯齿状的金色闪光裂痕对角分割：左半部分是粗糙的石墨铅笔草图，右半部分是完成后的彩色漫画。在左侧草图区域，绘制一个未完成的城市天际线，包含高耸的摩天大楼和一个背影示人的披风英雄，画面充满松散的构图线条、涂抹痕迹、交叉排线和橡皮屑。在右侧完成区域，渲染一个戏剧性的黑色电影风格漫画超级英雄场景，采用深海军蓝、黑色墨水、网点、温暖的黄色窗灯和清晰的白色分镜框：一个剪影化的年轻男性英雄，留着尖刺发型，披风飘逸，站在屋顶边缘，面对着满月和条纹云层下密集的未来派城市。完成后的漫画页面包含 4 个清晰可见的分镜：1 个英雄俯瞰城市的大型主分镜，2 个堆叠在右侧的狭窄垂直分镜，展示黑暗的城市建筑和屋顶水塔，以及 1 个右下角的宽幅分镜，展示对角线的城市透视线条和建筑。在页面周围添加真实的艺术用品：左下方放置 1 支削好的铅笔，右下方放置 2 支黑色绘图笔，右上角部分可见 1 个金属杯。使用戏剧性的暖色调桌面照明、逼真的纸张纹理、墨水颗粒、网点印刷质感、发光的过渡火花以及高细节的漫画线条。整个场景应呈现出从草图到成品漫画艺术的蜕变感。自定义英雄为 {argument name="character type" default="留着尖刺发型、披着斗篷的年轻男性义警"}，场景为 {argument name="city setting" default="黑色电影风格的未来派屋顶城市"}，漫画色调为 {argument name="color palette" default="深海军蓝、黑色墨水、暖黄色灯光和金色火花"}，月亮细节为 {argument name="sky feature" default="漂浮云层后的巨大满月"}，桌面风格为 {argument name="desk surface" default="深色木质艺术家书桌"}。

templates.title: Selfie to Comic Style Split Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 自拍转漫画风格分屏样机

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical promotional app-style mockup for a “selfie to comic” image transformation tool, showing one portrait converted into multiple comic styles while keeping the same face structure recognizable.

Canvas: Tall smartphone-like 4:5 composition, dark glossy interface frame with thin cyan glow lines along the left and right edges. Background outside the phone is softly blurred, like a desk or creative studio with papers and drawing materials.

Layout: The main preview fills most of the screen and is split into exactly 4 vertical style panels from left to right: 1) realistic selfie/photo style, 2) black-and-white manga ink drawing, 3) saturated retro comic book halftone style, 4) chunky pixel-art avatar style. A large centered square mask/placeholder covers the middle of the face and upper torso area, colored warm beige/gray, as if the central facial region is intentionally hidden. Below the main preview is a dark carousel strip with exactly 4 rounded thumbnail cards matching the same four styles: photo selfie, manga ink, retro comic, and pixel art.

Subject details: Use a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown/black"} messy hair tied in a high bun, visible eyebrow and eye on the left and right panels, medium warm skin tone, wearing a simple dark crew-neck shirt and a thin necklace. Keep the same head position across all four transformations.

Style panel details: The photo panel should look like a casual indoor selfie with shallow depth of field and natural texture. The manga panel should use dramatic black ink, white highlights, crosshatching, and clean linework. The retro comic panel should use bold outlines, red and yellow background bursts, blue-black hair highlights, orange skin tones, and halftone dots. The pixel-art panel should use large square pixels, simplified facial features, teal background, and a limited palette.

Visual style: High-contrast social media product preview, crisp vertical divisions, glossy black UI chrome, neon cyan accents, clean rounded thumbnail cards, polished GPT-image promotional aesthetic.

Constraints: Include exactly 4 main vertical panels and exactly 4 bottom thumbnails. Do not add readable text, logos, or watermarks. Keep the central beige square mask prominent and perfectly centered. Use {argument name="interface mood" default="dark futuristic mobile UI"}, {argument name="comic transformation theme" default="manga, retro comic, and pixel art selfie conversion"}, and {argument name="background setting" default="blurred creative studio desk"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款“自拍转漫画”图像转换工具创建一个垂直的 App 风格宣传样机，展示同一张人像在保持面部结构可辨识的前提下，转换为多种漫画风格。

画布：类似智能手机的 4:5 纵向构图，深色光泽感界面边框，左右边缘带有细长的青色发光线条。手机外部背景经过柔和模糊处理，呈现出类似书桌或带有纸张和绘画素材的创意工作室环境。

布局：主预览图占据屏幕大部分空间，从左到右精确划分为 4 个垂直风格面板：1) 写实自拍/照片风格，2) 黑白漫画墨水画风格，3) 高饱和度复古连环画半色调风格，4) 块状像素艺术头像风格。一个居中的大方形遮罩/占位符覆盖了面部中部和上半身区域，呈暖米灰色，仿佛面部中心区域被刻意隐藏。主预览图下方是一个深色轮播条，包含 4 个与上述四种风格对应的圆角缩略图卡片：照片自拍、漫画墨水、复古连环画和像素艺术。

主体细节：使用一位年轻女性，{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色/黑色"} 的凌乱头发扎成高丸子头，左右面板可见眉毛和眼睛，中等暖色调肤色，身穿简单的深色圆领衫并佩戴细项链。在所有四种转换中保持相同的头部位置。

风格面板细节：照片面板应看起来像一张带有浅景深和自然质感的休闲室内自拍。漫画面板应使用戏剧性的黑色墨水、白色高光、交叉排线和干净的线条。复古连环画面板应使用粗轮廓、红黄色背景爆发效果、蓝黑色头发高光、橙色肤色和半色调网点。像素艺术面板应使用大方块像素、简化的面部特征、青色背景和有限的调色板。

视觉风格：高对比度社交媒体产品预览，清晰的垂直分割，光泽感黑色 UI 外壳，霓虹青色点缀，简洁的圆角缩略图卡片，精致的 GPT 图像宣传美学。

约束条件：包含精确的 4 个主垂直面板和 4 个底部缩略图。不要添加可读文字、Logo 或水印。保持中央米色方形遮罩突出且完美居中。使用 {argument name="interface mood" default="深色未来感移动端 UI"}、{argument name="comic transformation theme" default="漫画、复古连环画和像素艺术自拍转换"} 以及 {argument name="background setting" default="模糊的创意工作室书桌"}。

templates.title: Messi Comic Portal Bedroom

titleLocalized.zh: 梅西漫画传送门卧室

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic fantasy scene inside a messy teenage football fan bedroom at night, filled with comic book posters, football scarves, trading-card displays, scattered clothes, gaming controllers, magazines, and warm LED strip lighting around the ceiling. The central subject is {argument name="football player" default="Lionel Messi"}, shown from behind in an Argentina-style white-and-sky-blue striped jersey with the name MESSI and number 10, black shorts, white socks, cleats, and a captain armband, stepping into a gigantic open illustrated comic book leaning upright against the wall. The comic cover should be titled in huge bold letters “{argument name="comic title" default="MESSI"}” with the subtitle “{argument name="subtitle" default="THE CELESTIAL JOURNEY"}”; add small faux comic issue details in the upper left. Inside the comic page, depict a cracked paper portal with a swirling electric-blue cosmic vortex, glowing stadium floodlights, torn panels, flying paper shards, blue sparks, and the golden World Cup trophy floating in the center. Make the player appear halfway between the real bedroom and the illustrated comic world, with dramatic rim light from the portal and warm room light from a desk lamp. Include exactly 6 major bedroom fan-detail groups: 1 football scarves across the top walls, 2 framed/poster football images, 3 a grid of collectible cards on the left wall, 4 a white desk with lamp and pencil cup, 5 a black gaming chair, and 6 floor clutter with two game controllers, loose comics/magazines, and piles of clothing. Use a vertical 9:16 composition, cinematic depth of field, hyperrealistic texture mixed with comic-book illustration, dynamic motion, glowing particles, detailed shadows, and a magical sports-adventure mood. Avoid logos that exactly copy real clubs except the player name and football-inspired colors; no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个超精细的电影级奇幻场景，背景是夜晚一间杂乱的青少年足球迷卧室，房间里贴满了漫画海报，挂着足球围巾，展示着球星卡，地上散落着衣服、游戏手柄和杂志，天花板周围环绕着温暖的 LED 灯带。中心主体是 {argument name="football player" default="Lionel Messi"}，背影展示，身穿阿根廷风格的白蓝条纹球衣，印有 MESSI 字样和 10 号，黑色短裤，白色球袜，球鞋，并佩戴队长袖标，正步入一本靠墙竖立的巨型打开的漫画书。漫画封面应以醒目的粗体大字写着“{argument name="comic title" default="MESSI"}”，副标题为“{argument name="subtitle" default="THE CELESTIAL JOURNEY"}”；左上角添加小型的仿漫画期号细节。在漫画页面内，描绘一个破碎的纸质传送门，伴有旋转的电蓝色宇宙漩涡、发光的球场泛光灯、撕裂的画格、飞舞的纸屑、蓝色火花，以及悬浮在中心的金色世界杯奖杯。让球员看起来处于现实卧室与漫画世界之间，传送门投射出戏剧性的轮廓光，桌灯提供温暖的室内光。包含 6 个主要的卧室粉丝细节组：1 墙壁顶部的足球围巾，2 装裱好的足球海报，3 左侧墙上的球星卡展示墙，4 带台灯和笔筒的白色书桌，5 一把黑色电竞椅，6 地面上的杂物，包括两个游戏手柄、散落的漫画/杂志和成堆的衣物。使用 9:16 竖构图，电影级景深，超写实纹理与漫画插画风格融合，动态感，发光粒子，精细阴影，营造出奇幻的体育冒险氛围。避免使用完全复制真实俱乐部的标志，仅保留球员姓名和足球主题配色；无水印。

templates.title: Mbappé Comic Book Bedroom Portal

titleLocalized.zh: 姆巴佩漫画书卧室传送门

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic fantasy scene inside a messy teenage bedroom with warm orange-blue ambient lighting. In the center, show {argument name="football player" default="Kylian Mbappé"} magically stepping out of a gigantic illustrated comic book leaning open against the back wall. The oversized comic book cover and pages should feature dynamic football comic art, speed lines, lightning streaks, torn-paper edges, and the large visible title text {argument name="comic title" default="MBAPPÉ: L'HISTOIRE"}. The player wears a {argument name="football kit" default="France national team navy blue kit with a vertical red-and-white center stripe, red socks, white wrist tape, and grey boots"}, posed mid-stride with a football near his feet, as if breaking through the page into the room. Surround him with flying torn paper strips and glowing blue-white motion trails for a dramatic superhero entrance. The bedroom should be cluttered and realistic: exactly 12 notable room elements are visible — 1 black-and-red gaming chair on the left, 1 bed edge on the right, 1 blue carpet, 1 warm LED rope light looping across the floor and up near the bed, 1 game controller on the floor, 1 cardboard box or device near the lower right, 1 pair of blue football boots at lower left, 1 scattered red garment, 1 pile of light-colored clothes in the foreground, 1 dark football shirt in the lower right foreground, 1 graffiti-covered left wall, and multiple football and comic posters on the walls including a small Mbappé poster on the right. Make the room feel lived-in, with scattered clothes, gaming accessories, posters, soft bed linens, and dramatic shadows. Use a vertical 9:16 composition, low-angle cinematic perspective, volumetric lighting, glossy comic-book textures, realistic fabric detail, crisp focus on the player, and high-energy motion blur in the effects. No watermarks, no UI, no extra readable branding beyond the comic title and poster-style text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个超精细的电影感奇幻场景，背景是一个凌乱的青少年卧室，采用温暖的橙蓝色环境光。在画面中心，展示 {argument name="football player" default="Kylian Mbappé"} 正神奇地从一本靠在后墙上打开的巨大插画漫画书中走出。超大的漫画封面和页面应呈现动态的足球漫画艺术、速度线、闪电条纹、撕裂的纸张边缘，以及清晰可见的大标题文字 {argument name="comic title" default="MBAPPÉ: L'HISTOIRE"}。球员身穿 {argument name="football kit" default="法国国家队深蓝色球衣，中间带有垂直红白条纹，红色球袜，白色护腕，灰色球鞋"}，以迈步姿态出现，脚边放着一个足球，仿佛正从书页中冲入房间。周围环绕着飞舞的纸条和发光的蓝白色运动轨迹，营造出戏剧性的超级英雄登场效果。卧室应显得凌乱且真实：画面中清晰可见 12 个显著的房间元素——左侧 1 把红黑配色电竞椅，右侧 1 个床沿，1 块蓝色地毯，1 条环绕地板并延伸至床边的暖色 LED 灯带，地板上 1 个游戏手柄，右下角 1 个纸箱或设备，左下角 1 双蓝色足球鞋，1 件散落的红色衣物，前景中 1 堆浅色衣物，右下角前景中 1 件深色足球衫，左侧涂鸦墙面，以及墙上多张足球和漫画海报，包括右侧一张小型的姆巴佩海报。让房间充满生活气息，散落的衣物、游戏配件、海报、柔软的床品和戏剧性的阴影。采用 9:16 竖构图，低角度电影视角，体积光照明，光泽感漫画书质感，逼真的织物细节，焦点清晰对准球员，并带有高能量的运动模糊效果。无水印，无 UI，除漫画标题和海报风格文字外，无其他可读品牌信息。

templates.title: Vintage China Great Wall Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古中国长城海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic travel poster for {argument name="country title" default="CHINA"}, evoking an ancient historical world. The composition shows the Great Wall of China winding dramatically from the lower foreground up toward a large stone watchtower on the left-middle, then continuing across misty mountain ridges into the far distance. Use layered watercolor-like mountains in purple, mauve, and dusty violet, with atmospheric fog filling the valleys and a soft parchment sky above. Add a small golden crescent moon in the upper-right sky. The top half should feel spacious and aged, with a warm beige antique paper texture, darkened weathered edges, subtle stains, and a vintage museum-poster finish. Typography: place one huge centered headline at the top reading {argument name="country title" default="CHINA"} in tall elegant high-contrast serif capitals, colored muted ochre gold. Directly below it, add a small italic subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"} in muted purple. In the bottom-right corner, include one small red Chinese-style seal stamp as a decorative mark, not a logo. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影感的竖屏街头摄影场景，地点位于 {argument name="city" default="北京"}，时间为雨后黄昏。画面展示了一名通勤者背对镜头，走在光亮的湿润人行道上，前方右侧是一个灯火通明的地铁入口。地铁入口设有现代化的灰色长方形顶棚、玻璃墙面、通往内部的楼梯和自动扶梯、冷色调的荧光室内照明、触觉黄色导盲砖，以及门上方圆形的蓝白相间地铁标志。左侧是一条拥堵的多车道马路，挤满了汽车和出租车，红色的刹车灯在水坑和黑色沥青路面上形成倒影。远处展示密集的城市天际线，包括标志性的央视总部大楼，背景是戏剧性的多云日落，呈现出桃红、紫色和蓝色的色调。在交通上方添加一个风格化的发光红色导航路线叠加层：一条由细红线、小型连接节点组成的连续螺旋路径，左上方天际线附近有一个巨大的红色地图标记，象征着路线的不确定性和交通延误。行人是一名年轻男性，背影视角，中等身材，身穿 {argument name="commuter outfit" default="浅米色夹克、深色长裤、白色运动鞋和黑色单肩包"}，步伐平静但略显疲惫。采用写实比例、忧郁的城市氛围、高细节、湿润的倒影、浅景深的电影对比度、柔和的雾气以及纪录片摄影风格。画面中无可见标题、无水印、无额外文字。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宁静的超现实数字绘画，描绘一个与广阔倒影湖面融为一体的创意工作空间，时间设定为 {argument name="time of day" default="日落"}。采用 16:9 宽屏电影构图，前景为深色桌面，与平静的水面和远方的地平线无缝衔接。在背景正中央，放置一轮低垂的暖阳，在水面上投射出一条明亮的金色 S 型光路，延伸至观者眼前。在右侧地平线上，添加连绵起伏的锯齿状雪山，其中一座主峰尖锐突出，轻裹在低云薄雾中。在左上方天空，精确包含 2 个天体细节：一弯新月和一颗微小的星星。在右上方天空，精确包含 6 个呈对角线向上排列的小鸟剪影。前景物体：左侧放置一叠由 5 块光滑黑色禅石组成的平衡石堆，旁边是一个带有 5 个可见颜料槽的艺术调色板，以及一支斜放的画笔；右侧放置一本打开的空白笔记本，上面横放着一支笔，以及一个带有把手的深色咖啡杯。氛围应平和、冥想且如梦似幻，地平线附近呈现温暖的橙金色光芒，并向上下方渐变为冷蓝灰色调。使用柔和的大气雾感、逼真的倒影、细腻的绘画质感，高细节，画面中无人，无可见文字，无水印。整体主题为 {argument name="theme" default="宁静的创意独处"}，主色调强调 {argument name="color palette" default="温暖的琥珀色日落与冷峻的炭蓝色"}。

templates.title: Doraemon-Style Newton’s Second Law Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 哆啦 A 梦风格牛顿第二定律漫画

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a colorful educational manga-style science comic page teaching Newton's second law through a Doraemon-inspired classroom experiment, with a cheerful Japanese children’s comic aesthetic and clear Chinese educational captions.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 page, thick black outer border, divided into exactly 5 horizontal sections: 1 header story panel, 2 experiment panels, 1 conclusion panel, and 1 bottom key-summary strip. Use bright primary colors, clean ink outlines, schoolyard background, blue sky, trees, fence, and school building.

Layout and text content: Top left has a yellow torn-paper label reading {argument name="page label" default="第4页"}. Across the top headline, large bold Chinese title reads {argument name="main headline" default="实验一：同一辆车，用力越大，加速度越大"}, with blue emphasis on “同一辆车” and red emphasis on “用力越大，加速度越大”.

Section 1, introduction panel: On the left, a blue robotic cat character resembling a classic round-headed cartoon cat smiles widely and raises one finger, wearing a red collar and bell. In the center/right stand exactly 4 children: a boy in a yellow shirt with his face intentionally blurred/blanked, a girl in a pink top and green skirt, a large boy in an orange sweater, and a spiky-haired boy in a purple hoodie. Speech bubbles: the cat says “我们用小车来做实验，看看力大小对加速度的影响！” and the spiky-haired boy says “好耶！我们开始吧！”.

Section 2, experiment panel labeled in a blue rounded rectangle “实验1：小力推”: A schoolyard scene with the girl pushing a small blue wagon from left to right using a rope/handle. The wagon contains exactly 2 visible objects: one teddy bear and one striped ball. Add small dust puffs behind the wheels. A red arrow points right with blue text “慢慢地向前运动”. Speech bubbles: the girl says “我轻轻推……” and the blurred-face boy on the right says “哇，小车走得很慢！”.

Section 3, experiment panel labeled in a blue rounded rectangle “实验2：大力推”: The large boy in the orange sweater pushes the same blue wagon hard from left to right, leaning forward with speed lines, sweat drops, and stronger motion. The wagon again contains exactly 2 visible objects: the teddy bear and striped ball. A larger red arrow points right with red text “快速地向前运动”. Speech bubbles: the large boy says “我使劲推！” and the blurred-face boy on the right says “哇哦！小车一下子跑得好快啊！”.

Section 4, conclusion panel: On the left, the blue robotic cat points with a teaching stick and says “从实验可以看出：同一辆车，力越大，小车的加速效果越明显！”. In the center is a green chalkboard on a wooden easel. The chalkboard title reads “实验结论：同一辆车（质量相同）”, and it shows exactly 2 miniature illustrated comparison rows: small-force push with text “小力→小加速度”, and large-force push with text “大力→大加速度”. On the right stand exactly 4 children again: blurred-face yellow-shirt boy, pink-and-green girl, orange-sweater large boy, and purple-hoodie spiky-haired boy. Speech bubbles read “原来力越大，加速度就越大！” and “这就是“力与加速度的关系”啊！”.

Section 5, bottom key-summary strip: Pale yellow rounded rectangle with blue dashed border. On the left, the blue robotic cat smiles and raises one finger next to a star icon. Large blue heading reads {argument name="summary heading" default="本页重点"}. Main red sentence reads {argument name="summary sentence" default="质量相同：力越大，加速度越大。"}. On the right, show a formula card with bold red and blue symbols “F↑ → a↑”, plus a simple orange traffic cone icon with curved motion marks.

Visual style: Emulate a polished Japanese educational comic magazine layout inspired by Ohmsha-style science explainers: thick black panel dividers, clean cel-shaded colors, expressive cartoon faces, readable bold Chinese typography, speech bubbles with black outlines, and a friendly elementary-school science tone.

Constraints: Keep exactly 5 horizontal sections, exactly 4 children in the group scenes, exactly 2 wagon contents in each experiment panel, and preserve the intentionally blurred/blank face of the yellow-shirt boy wherever he appears. Avoid photorealism, avoid extra panels, avoid watermarks, and keep all text legible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页色彩鲜艳的科普漫画，通过受哆啦 A 梦启发的课堂实验教授牛顿第二定律，采用欢快的日本儿童漫画美学，并配有清晰的中文科普说明文字。

画布：竖向 3:4 页面，带有粗黑色外边框，精确划分为 5 个横向区域：1 个页眉故事格、2 个实验格、1 个结论格和 1 个底部重点总结条。使用明亮的基色，干净的墨线勾勒，背景为校园操场，包含蓝天、树木、围栏和教学楼。

布局与文本内容：左上角有一个黄色撕纸标签，内容为 {argument name="page label" default="第 4 页"}。顶部大标题采用醒目的粗体中文，内容为 {argument name="main headline" default="实验一：同一辆车，用力越大，加速度越大"}，其中“同一辆车”用蓝色强调，“用力越大，加速度越大”用红色强调。

第 1 区域，引入格：左侧是一个蓝色的机器猫角色，外形类似经典的圆头卡通猫，它笑容灿烂并竖起一根手指，戴着红领圈和铃铛。中间/右侧站着 4 名儿童：一名穿黄色衬衫的男孩（脸部刻意模糊/空白处理）、一名穿粉色上衣配绿色短裙的女孩、一名穿橙色毛衣的壮硕男孩，以及一名穿紫色连帽衫的刺猬头男孩。对话气泡：机器猫说“我们用小车来做实验，看看力大小对加速度的影响！”，刺猬头男孩说“好耶！我们开始吧！”。

第 2 区域，实验格，标注在蓝色圆角矩形内“实验 1：小力推”：校园场景，女孩正用绳子/把手将一辆蓝色小推车从左向右拉动。小车内装有 2 个清晰可见的物品：一只泰迪熊和一个条纹球。车轮后方添加少量灰尘效果。一个红色箭头指向右侧，配有蓝色文字“慢慢地向前运动”。对话气泡：女孩说“我轻轻推……”，右侧脸部模糊的男孩说“哇，小车走得很慢！”。

第 3 区域，实验格，标注在蓝色圆角矩形内“实验 2：大力推”：穿橙色毛衣的壮硕男孩用力将同一辆蓝色小推车从左向右推，身体前倾，带有速度线、汗珠和更强烈的动作感。小车内同样装有 2 个清晰可见的物品：泰迪熊和条纹球。一个更大的红色箭头指向右侧，配有红色文字“快速地向前运动”。对话气泡：壮硕男孩说“我使劲推！”，右侧脸部模糊的男孩说“哇哦！小车一下子跑得好快啊！”。

第 4 区域，结论格：左侧，蓝色机器猫用教鞭指着并说道“从实验可以看出：同一辆车，力越大，小车的加速效果越明显！”。中间是一个木制画架上的绿色黑板。黑板标题为“实验结论：同一辆车（质量相同）”，并展示 2 组微型插图对照行：小力推配文字“小力→小加速度”，大力推配文字“大力→大加速度”。右侧再次站着 4 名儿童：脸部模糊的黄衫男孩、粉衣绿裙女孩、橙衣壮硕男孩和紫衣刺猬头男孩。对话气泡写着“原来力越大，加速度就越大！”和“这就是“力与加速度的关系”啊！”。

第 5 区域，底部重点总结条：淡黄色圆角矩形，带有蓝色虚线边框。左侧，蓝色机器猫微笑着，在星星图标旁竖起一根手指。蓝色大标题为 {argument name="summary heading" default="本页重点"}。红色主句为 {argument name="summary sentence" default="质量相同：力越大，加速度越大。"}。右侧展示一张公式卡片，带有粗体红蓝符号“F↑ → a↑”，外加一个带有弧形运动轨迹的橙色交通锥图标。

视觉风格：模仿 Ohmsha 风格科普读物的精致日本漫画布局：粗黑色分格线、干净的赛璐珞配色、表情丰富的卡通脸、易读的粗体中文排版、带黑色轮廓的对话气泡，以及友好的小学科学教学语调。

约束条件：保持精确的 5 个横向区域，群组场景中保持精确的 4 名儿童，每个实验格中保持精确的 2 个小车内物品，并确保黄衫男孩的脸部在任何出现的地方都保持刻意模糊/空白。避免照片写实感，避免额外分格，避免水印，并确保所有文字清晰可辨。

She has a short bob haircut with white-blonde hair fading into bright pink tips and wears pink over-ear headphones. The background is a minimal sunlit wall with strong diagonal shadows and a narrow vertical architectural edge on the left, giving a modern urban indoor/outdoor feel. Color palette: white, black, pink, peach skin tones, and muted gray shadows. Composition should be portrait 3:4, fashion-editorial anime aesthetic, high detail, clean background, no extra characters, no watermark, no additional text besides the hoodie lettering. Customize the character with {argument name="hair color" default="white-blonde with pink tips"}, {argument name="headphones color" default="pink"}, {argument name="skin tone" default="warm tan"}, and {argument name="background lighting" default="bright sunlight with sharp diagonal shadows"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格竖版插画，描绘一位坐在黑色圆凳上的年轻女性。采用极具张力的低角度视角，膝盖位于前景，上半身居中。她留着短波波头，发色由白金色渐变为亮粉色，佩戴粉色头戴式耳机。她的面部被一个居中的不透明方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，遮挡块呈现柔和的米色至玫瑰色渐变，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和大部分面部特征。她身穿一件超大码白色卫衣，配有黑色风衣式袖子和罗纹黑色袖口；卫衣正面有一个大口袋，胸前印有醒目的粉色字母 {argument name="hoodie text" default="DIMES"}。她的双手放在大腿之间，指甲修剪整齐，呈粉紫色。使用暖棕色皮肤，腿部和手部带有光泽感高光，线条清晰的动漫勾线，细腻的衣物褶皱，以及柔和的赛璐璐阴影照明。背景为简约的阳光照射墙面，带有强烈的对角线阴影，左侧有一条狭窄的垂直建筑边缘，营造出现代都市室内外氛围。配色方案：白色、黑色、粉色、桃色肤色以及柔和的灰色阴影。构图应为 3:4 竖版，具有时尚杂志动漫美学，高细节，背景干净，无额外角色，无水印，除卫衣文字外无其他文字。可通过以下参数自定义角色：{argument name="hair color" default="白金色渐变粉色发梢"}、{argument name="headphones color" default="粉色"}、{argument name="skin tone" default="暖棕色"} 以及 {argument name="background lighting" default="明亮的阳光及强烈的对角线阴影"}。

Layout: Center the scene around a large desktop monitor on a glossy glass desk. At the top, place a small brand row with a circular mint leaf-like logo, the word {argument name="product name" default="MINTPAGE"}, a thin divider line, and the subtitle {argument name="brand subtitle" default="AI LANDING PAGE STUDIO"}. Below it, use a very large elegant serif headline in dark blue: {argument name="headline text" default="WHY DO MOST AI PAGES LOOK GENERIC?"}. Under the headline, place exactly 4 small feature badges in one row with delicate mint icons and labels: 1) AI-Powered, 2) React + Tailwind, 3) Production Ready, 4) Built to Convert.

Instantly.” in mint italic styling, followed by form fields such as Business Name, Target Audience, and Core Mission. Constraints: Use exactly the counted elements listed above, keep the image uncluttered, make the headline the most prominent text, avoid extra logos, watermarks, or unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为宣传 {argument name="product name" default="MINTPAGE"}（一款 AI 着陆页工作室）的 SaaS 着陆页概念创建一个精致的方形首屏图像。

画布：1:1 方形构图，柔和的日光办公环境，淡薄荷色与浅蓝色调，简洁的高端科技美学，逼真的 3D 产品模型与精致的排版设计相结合。

布局：场景中心为一个放置在光面玻璃桌上的大型桌面显示器。顶部放置一排小型品牌信息，包括一个圆形的薄荷叶状 Logo、单词 {argument name="product name" default="MINTPAGE"}、一条细分割线以及副标题 {argument name="brand subtitle" default="AI LANDING PAGE STUDIO"}。下方使用深蓝色的大号优雅衬线字体作为标题：{argument name="headline text" default="WHY DO MOST AI PAGES LOOK GENERIC?"}。在标题下方，并排放置 4 个带有精致薄荷色图标和标签的小型功能徽章：1) AI 驱动，2) React + Tailwind，3) 生产就绪，4) 专为转化而生。

主体：显示器展示了一个简洁的 Web 应用构建器界面，用于创建着陆页。界面应包含顶部导航栏和分屏工作区。左侧显示一个垂直设置流程，包含 4 个编号步骤：1) Context — 定义你的想法，2) Style — 视觉方向，3) Design — AI 生成布局，4) Code — 导出生产就绪代码。在中间面板，显示标题“From Idea to Code. Instantly.”，其中“Code. Instantly.”采用薄荷色斜体样式，随后是“业务名称”、“目标受众”和“核心使命”等表单字段。在右侧面板，显示一个名为“Live Environment”的代码编辑器，其中包含可读性强但字号较小的 React/Tailwind 风格代码，以及一段简短的渲染文本片段，内容为“Landing pages that look iconic. Built to convert.”。

前景物体：在桌子左侧，放置一个半透明的亚克力桌面铭牌，上面印有圆形 Logo 以及文字“MINTPAGE”和“AI LANDING PAGE STUDIO”。在其下方或旁边，堆叠 3 本书脊标签清晰的薄书：1) BUILT FOR CONVERSION，2) REACT + TAILWIND + AI，3) DESIGN SYSTEMS THAT SCALE。在显示器前方，放置一个纤薄的白色键盘。在右侧，放置一张名为“PROJECT STATUS”的小型半透明悬浮状态卡片，列出 5 个已勾选的项目：1) Live Environment，2) Context Defined，3) Style Generated，4) Design Created，5) Code Exported。此外，放置一个淡蓝色罗纹笔筒，内含 4 支书写工具和一个白色鼠标。

环境：极简现代办公室，背景中有柔焦书架和植物，右侧有大窗户采光，玻璃桌面上有微妙的反射，柔和的景深，画面中无人。

视觉风格：高端初创公司发布图形，柔和的体积光，逼真的产品摄影，玻璃拟态叠加层，薄荷绿点缀，深蓝色衬线字体，清晰的 UI 细节，冷静的高端工作室氛围。

约束：使用上述列出的精确数量元素，保持图像整洁，使标题成为最突出的文字，避免额外的 Logo、水印或无关文字。

templates.title: Fantasy GPT Image 2 Skill Banner

titleLocalized.zh: Fantasy GPT Image 2 Skill 横幅

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a richly detailed fantasy workshop banner advertising {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 Skill"}, showing a magical image-generation toolkit as if presented by cartoon gourd-doll apprentices and a wise master.

Canvas: Ultra-wide horizontal banner, about 2.4:1 aspect ratio, cinematic composition, warm glowing fantasy lighting, dense but readable. The headline sits across the upper center on a black brushstroke paint swash in large hand-painted cream-gold lettering.

Main scene: A cozy enchanted studio packed with scrolls, framed images, glowing code panels, UI cards, potion bottles, drawing tools, and magical icons. In the far background, an arched opening reveals misty blue-purple mountains and a fantasy landscape. The foreground is cluttered with parchment sheets, paintbrushes, pens, rolled scrolls, small gourds, beads, and colored potion-like spheres.

Characters: Include exactly 8 visible cartoon characters in a Chinese animated-fantasy style: 6 small gourd-doll children with topknot gourds/leaves and expressive faces, 1 elderly white-bearded master seated near the center-left, and 1 tall elegant robed figure on the far right. Arrange them in a lively group around the headline and display boards. The characters should be cheerful, excited, and collaborative, with some holding image examples or interface panels. If using privacy-safe placeholders, cover exactly 4 faces with soft rectangular blur masks: the elderly master, one center-left child holding a workflow board, one center child holding a bottle image, and the tall robed figure on the right.

Counted display items: Show exactly 11 major visible boards/panels/images: 1 top-left dark code editor panel with colorful code and a cube icon, 1 upper-left Chinese-style document held by a child with botanical illustration details, 1 lower-left anime action image held by a purple-clad child, 1 center-left workflow diagram board held by a child, 1 center image board showing a perfume bottle, 1 tablet-like UI mockup held by a smiling child, 1 framed bird photography image held near the lower center-right, 1 dark analytics/dashboard UI panel held by the right child, 1 large vertical fantasy city/night illustration behind the right child, 1 parchment code scroll floating at the top-right, and 1 glowing parchment code sheet lying across the front-center foreground.

Icon details: Add exactly 5 glowing square tech badges around the scene: a puzzle-piece icon on the far left, a connected-nodes icon on the left, a small cube icon near the upper center-left, a purple abstract skill/tool icon near the title, and a neon puzzle badge on the upper-right labeled {argument name="plugin label" default="PLUGIN"}. Add one additional golden star badge on the right labeled {argument name="skill label" default="SKILL"}.

Style: Painterly high-detail digital illustration, whimsical Chinese fantasy animation, warm amber highlights with cool cyan-purple magical glow, ornate wooden workshop interior, soft depth, dramatic rim lighting, gold sparkles, crisp readable central title, lively crowded composition like a promotional GitHub repository banner.

Text constraints: The main headline must read exactly {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 Skill"}. Preserve the small badge words {argument name="plugin label" default="PLUGIN"} and {argument name="skill label" default="SKILL"}. Any tiny code or document text may be decorative and mostly unreadable, but should resemble colorful syntax highlighting and design notes. Do not add extra logos, watermarks, or unrelated brand names.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张细节丰富的奇幻工作室横幅，用于宣传 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 Skill"}，展示一套如同由卡通葫芦娃学徒和智慧大师呈现的魔法图像生成工具包。

画布：超宽横向横幅，长宽比约为 2.4:1，电影级构图，温暖的发光奇幻照明，内容丰富且易于阅读。标题位于上方中央，横跨在黑色笔触的墨迹上，采用大型手绘奶油金色字体。

主场景：一个舒适的魔法工作室，堆满了卷轴、带框图像、发光代码面板、UI 卡片、药水瓶、绘图工具和魔法图标。远景中，一个拱形开口处显露出朦胧的蓝紫色山脉和奇幻景观。前景散落着羊皮纸、画笔、钢笔、卷轴、小葫芦、珠子和彩色的药水状球体。

角色：包含 8 个清晰可见的中国动画奇幻风格卡通角色：6 个头顶葫芦/叶子、表情生动的葫芦娃小童，1 位坐在中左侧的白胡子老大师，以及 1 位站在最右侧的高挑优雅长袍人物。将他们生动地安排在标题和项目周围。角色应表现得欢快、兴奋且富有协作精神，其中一些人手持图像示例或界面面板。如果使用隐私保护占位符，请用柔和的矩形模糊遮罩遮盖 4 张脸：老大师、一名手持项目的中左侧儿童、一名手持瓶子图像的中央儿童，以及右侧的高挑长袍人物。

展示项目计数：展示 11 个主要的可见项目/面板/图像：1 个左上角带有彩色代码和立方体图标的深色代码编辑器面板，1 个由儿童手持的左上方中式文档（带有植物插图细节），1 个由紫衣儿童手持的左下方动漫动作图像，1 个由儿童手持的中左侧工作流项目，1 个展示香水瓶的中央图像项目，1 个由微笑儿童手持的平板电脑式 UI 模型，1 个在中右下方手持的带框鸟类摄影图像，1 个由右侧儿童手持的深色分析/仪表盘 UI 面板，1 个在右侧儿童身后的巨型垂直奇幻城市/夜景插图，1 个漂浮在右上角的羊皮纸代码卷轴，以及 1 个横跨在前侧中央前景的发光羊皮纸代码页。

图标细节：在场景周围添加 5 个发光的方形科技徽章：最左侧的拼图图标，左侧的连接节点图标，中左上方的立方体小图标，标题附近的紫色抽象技能图标，以及右上角标记为 {argument name="plugin label" default="PLUGIN"} 的霓虹拼图徽章。在右侧添加一个额外的金色星形徽章，标记为 {argument name="skill label" default="SKILL"}。

风格：绘画感高细节数字插画，奇思妙想的中国奇幻动画风格，温暖的琥珀色高光与冷青紫色魔法光芒，华丽的木质工作室内部，柔和的景深，戏剧性的轮廓光，金色闪光，清晰易读的中央标题，如同 GitHub 仓库宣传横幅般生动拥挤的构图。

文本约束：主标题必须准确显示为 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 Skill"}。保留小徽章文字 {argument name="plugin label" default="PLUGIN"} 和 {argument name="skill label" default="SKILL"}。任何微小的代码或文档文本可以是装饰性的且大部分不可读，但应类似于彩色的语法高亮和设计笔记。请勿添加额外的徽标、水印或无关的品牌名称。

templates.title: Champion Monster Adventure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: “天选少女”冠军海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical anime/fantasy collectible poster for {argument name="poster title" default="The Champion"}, styled like a nostalgic monster-partner adventure magazine cover, blending realistic lighting with high-detail creature design.

Canvas: Tall portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, warm beige and gold color grading, dusty sunlit atmosphere, dramatic backlight, floating digital pixel fragments, subtle paper-grain texture, premium key visual composition.

Main subject: A young woman hero stands in the center foreground, running forward and reaching one hand toward the viewer. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain medium-brown rectangular censor block. She has dark brown hair in a loose low bun, soft flyaway strands, a delicate necklace, a cream floral summer dress, and a loose white cardigan. In her outstretched hand she holds a glowing round digital device with a bright blue circular core and metallic gold casing.

Creature count: Include exactly 5 monster companions. 1) A huge crystalline white-and-gold dragon fills the upper background, arcing behind the hero, with jagged crystal armor, long golden horns, open roaring mouth, sharp teeth, and one glowing electric-blue eye. 2) A tiny orange winged mascot sits near the hero’s raised hand, cute face, blue eyes, small bat-like wings, and cheerful expression. 3) A blue-gray horned wolf/reptile creature crouches on the lower left behind the hero, spiky fur scales, one striped horn, open snarling mouth, collar, and gem pendant. 4) An orange dinosaur-like creature occupies the bottom left foreground, big green eye, open happy roaring mouth, rounded snout, collar, and blue gem pendant. 5) A white cat-rabbit creature on the lower right, blue eyes, purple-tipped ear tufts, fluffy body, collar, gem pendant, and alert pose.

Layout and typography: Place large bold black sans-serif title text in the upper left reading {argument name="poster title" default="The Champion"}. Above it, add small text reading “DIGIMON CHAMPION EDITION” with tiny circular icons. Under the title, add Japanese subtitle text: 「選ばれし絆、未来へ。」 and a smaller Japanese line beneath it. Add left-side editorial markings: “01”, “DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION”, a vertical barcode, and a small globe icon. Add right-side markings: a circular champion emblem, “DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION”, “No.2025”, vertical Japanese text, and thin measurement-line graphics. Add bottom-left collectible card panel with “LEGEND” and Japanese text 「伝説のチャンピオン」. Add bottom-right black label panel with “CHAMPION”, “The Chosen One”, a signature scribble, and barcode-like decoration.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed anime-realism, cinematic fantasy poster, high-end game promotional art, glossy creature eyes, crystalline scales, warm dust particles, volumetric sunlight, shallow depth of field, dynamic diagonal composition, heroic nostalgic adventure mood.

Constraints: Keep the composition crowded but readable, use exactly the 5 listed creatures, preserve the obscured face block, avoid extra characters, avoid logos or watermarks beyond the designed fictional poster text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高质感的电影级动漫奇幻冒险冠军海报，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="The Champion"}，主题围绕“天选少女与她的数码伙伴”。使用 2:3 竖版海报画布，采用暖米色、金色、奶油色和朦胧日光色调，营造戏剧性的背光效果，加入漂浮的数字方形粒子、岩石碎片，呈现英雄大片的构图。前景中心：一位年轻的东亚女性，勇敢而温柔，身穿修身的奶油色碎花迷你裙和柔软的米白色开衫，棕黑色头发梳成低乱发髻，边缘有光晕勾勒出的散落发丝。她的面部应模糊处理或留作可自定义的空白/柔和匿名区域，但姿态自信：向前迈步，一只手伸向观众，手中拿着一个圆形的金属数码暴龙机，散发着电光蓝色的光芒。在她身后和周围环绕着 5 只数码兽伙伴：1. 一条巨大的水晶龙占据背景上方，银白色多面鳞片，长角，张嘴咆哮，眼睛闪烁蓝光；2. 一只小巧的橙色带翼生物漂浮在她抬起的手旁，有着大大的青色眼睛、可爱的表情和蝙蝠般的翅膀；3. 一只蓝灰色的狼形爬行动物位于左下方，长角头部，张嘴咆哮，露出尖牙，戴着镶有蓝色宝石的项圈；4. 一只橙色恐龙伙伴位于左下角，大大的绿色眼睛，开心地咆哮，戴着镶有蓝色宝石的项圈；5. 一只白色猫/兔状生物位于右下角，蓝色眼睛，紫色耳尖，小爪子，戴着镶有蓝色宝石的项圈。添加密集的排版和 UI 印刷细节：左上角小标签“DIGIMON CHAMPION EDITION”及四个小圆形图标；左侧醒目的黑色无衬线大标题“The Champion”；下方配有日语副标题“選ばれし絆、未来へ。”以及较小的文字“心をつなげ、デジタルワールドを守れ。”；左侧徽章写有“01”和“DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION”，并配有垂直条形码和地球图标；右侧圆形纹章标有“DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION”、小字“No.2025”、垂直虚线刻度以及垂直日语文字“デジタルの絆が、奇跡をつくる”；左下角技术说明卡标有“LEGEND”和“伝説のチャンピオン”；右下角黑色签名卡标有“CHAMPION”和“The Chosen One”，并带有条形码条。风格应融合动漫角色设计、半写实奇幻渲染、高级收藏品海报布局，具备高细节、体积光、火花、尘埃、玻璃质感鳞片以及清晰的杂志封面排版。使用 {argument name="character outfit" default="cream floral mini dress and off-white cardigan"}、{argument name="glowing device color" default="electric blue"}、{argument name="main dragon style" default="silver-white crystalline horned dragon"} 以及 {argument name="poster palette" default="warm beige and gold sunlight"}。避免出现除上述 5 只以外的额外怪物，避免标题杂乱，无水印，无现代城市背景。

templates.title: Nostalgic Train-Side Hotel Room

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧列车旁酒店客房

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical wallpaper scene in a quiet vintage hotel room beside a railway station, warm golden-hour sunlight streaming through a huge window. A young East Asian man with tousled dark hair, wearing a loose white button-up shirt and dark trousers, sits on the floor leaning against the side of an unmade bed, legs stretched out, looking contemplatively toward the window; an open book lies near his hand on the patterned rug. Outside the window, show exactly one long silver passenger train passing left to right on multiple tracks, with utility poles, misty hills, and hazy morning light in the distance. Inside the room include exactly two main furniture pieces: an unmade bed on the left with beige wrinkled sheets and an old sofa on the right with pillows and a draped coat or bag; also include a low foreground table with a dark mug, a vintage suitcase on the floor at bottom right, a small bedside clock on the left cabinet, a framed picture on the wall, a tall narrow vase with dried branches on the windowsill, a small table lamp on the right side of the windowsill, a drinking glass, and a sheer cream curtain hanging over the left part of the window. Use muted sepia and olive-brown tones, dusty air, soft volumetric sunlight, realistic film photography, shallow shadows, nostalgic Wong Kar-wai inspired mood, highly detailed textures, 4:5 vertical composition, no visible text, no watermark. Key customizable details: {argument name="character age" default="young adult"}, {argument name="character outfit" default="loose white button-up shirt and dark trousers"}, {argument name="time of day" default="golden-hour morning"}, {argument name="outside vehicle" default="one long silver passenger train"}, {argument name="room mood" default="quiet nostalgic melancholy"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影感竖屏壁纸场景，画面位于火车站旁安静的复古酒店客房内，温暖的黄金时刻阳光透过巨大的窗户倾泻而入。一位留着凌乱黑发的东亚年轻男子，身穿宽松的白色衬衫和深色长裤，坐在地板上，背靠着凌乱的床边，双腿伸展，若有所思地望向窗外；一本打开的书放在他手边的花纹地毯上。窗外，展示一列长长的银色客运列车正从左向右驶过轨道，远处可见电线杆、雾气缭绕的山丘和朦胧的晨光。室内包含两件主要家具：左侧是一张铺着米色褶皱床单的凌乱床铺，右侧是一张放有枕头和披着外套或包袋的旧沙发；此外还包括前景的一张矮桌，上面放着一个深色马克杯，右下角地板上有一个复古手提箱，左侧柜子上有一个小床头钟，墙上挂着一幅画，窗台上有一个插着干枯树枝的高窄花瓶，窗台右侧有一盏小台灯，一个水杯，以及挂在窗户左侧的米色薄纱窗帘。使用柔和的棕褐色和橄榄棕色调，营造尘埃感、柔和的体积光、写实摄影风格、浅阴影，呈现王家卫风格的怀旧氛围，高细节纹理，4:5 竖屏构图，无可见文字，无水印。关键可自定义细节：{argument name="character age" default="年轻成年人"}, {argument name="character outfit" default="宽松白色衬衫和深色长裤"}, {argument name="time of day" default="黄金时刻的清晨"}, {argument name="outside vehicle" default="一列长长的银色客运列车"}, {argument name="room mood" default="安静的怀旧忧郁感"}。

templates.title: Moonlit Pixel Art Bath Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的像素风沐浴场景

templates.prompt: Create a high-quality pixel art anime illustration of a young adult woman relaxing in a bathtub at night. She has {argument name="hair color" default="deep navy blue"} shoulder-length messy bob hair with long strands and bangs, wet and slightly clinging to her face and neck. Her eyes are closed, expression calm and peaceful, head tilted slightly upward, with one hand raised behind her head as if combing through her wet hair. Show only her head, neck, bare shoulders, upper arms, and the top of her chest mostly hidden by opaque bathwater and foam; keep the scene tasteful and non-explicit. The setting is a cozy tiled bathroom with pale green-gray wall tiles, a large dark-framed window on the left showing a moonlit night sky and leafy trees outside, and soft reflections on the glass. On the right rear ledge, include exactly 2 bath bottles: one tall blue pump bottle and one shorter pink rectangular bottle. The bathtub water is muted turquoise with shimmering highlights, small ripples, and scattered white foam along the edges. Use a nostalgic 16-bit / 32-bit pixel art style with visible square pixels, soft dithering, limited color palette, gentle bloom lighting, and warm indoor bathroom illumination mixed with cool blue moonlight. Composition is a close-up bust view centered on the woman, 4:3 landscape canvas, intimate tranquil atmosphere, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高质量的像素风动漫插画，描绘一位年轻女性在夜晚的浴缸中放松。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深海军蓝"} 的齐肩凌乱波波头，长发丝和刘海被打湿，微微贴在脸颊和脖颈上。她双眼紧闭，表情平静安详，头部微微上扬，一只手抬起放在脑后，仿佛正在梳理湿发。仅展示她的头部、颈部、裸露的肩膀、上臂以及大部分被不透明浴水和泡沫遮住的上胸部；保持画面高雅，避免露骨内容。场景设定为一个舒适的瓷砖浴室，墙面贴着浅灰绿色的瓷砖，左侧有一扇深色边框的大窗户，可以看到月光下的夜空和窗外的绿叶树木，玻璃上有柔和的倒影。在右后方的台面上，放置 2 个洗浴瓶：一个高大的蓝色泵头瓶和一个较矮的粉色长方形瓶。浴缸里的水呈柔和的绿松石色，带有闪烁的高光、细小的涟漪以及边缘散落的白色泡沫。采用怀旧的 16-bit / 32-bit 像素艺术风格，具有明显的方形像素、柔和的抖动效果、有限的调色板、轻微的泛光照明，以及室内暖光与冷色调月光的交融。构图为以女性为中心的近景半身像，4:3 横向画布，营造出亲密宁静的氛围，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。

templates.title: Japanese AI Workflow Notebook Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 日系 AI 工作流笔记本信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a square, hand-drawn Japanese notebook-style infographic about turning AI from a chat partner into an operations/work assistant, with a cute anime mascot at the bottom.

Canvas: 1:1 square image, cream lined notebook paper background with rounded corners, blue border line, visible metal spiral binding along the left edge, soft grid-paper tape decoration near the top left, and blue/yellow pen-marker accents. Overall look should be clean, friendly, handwritten, and sketchnote-like.

Text content: Use Japanese handwritten lettering. Top left page marker: “4/4”. Main title inside a blue outlined banner: {argument name="main title" default="実務への接続"}. Subtitle beneath it: “Manus / Codex / Claude Code / Newsletter”. Mid-page label in a dotted rounded rectangle: “自分のワークフローへ”. Large main message on the lower left: “AIはチャット相手から” above very large bold navy text {argument name="main message" default="作業担当へ"}. Speech bubble on the right of the character: {argument name="speech bubble text" default="毎日の型にする"}.

Layout: Top third contains exactly 3 connected workflow cards in a horizontal row, each with a numbered blue circle and rounded blue outline. Card 1 is labeled “Manusで収集” and shows a magnifying glass, document, and cloud icon. Card 2 is labeled “Codex/Claude Codeで整理” and shows a clipboard checklist, arrow, folder, and small hierarchy diagram. Card 3 is labeled “ニュースレターで発信” and shows an envelope with a paper and small heart. Add thick blue downward arrows between the cards and another blue arrow down from the center card to the dotted workflow label.

Lower section: On the left, place exactly 3 action rows with circular blue icons and Japanese labels: 1) magnifying glass icon with “調べる”, 2) folder icon with “整える”, 3) envelope icon with “発信する”. Underline or highlight each label with pale yellow marker strokes and dotted guide lines.

Character details: Bottom center-right features a cute anime cat-eared girl mascot from about knees up, with long pastel pink hair, white cat ears, a pink cat tail curling to the right, and a small gold hair clip reading “ME”. She wears a loose blue hoodie and dark skirt, holding a clipboard checklist with exactly 3 checked boxes. Keep the face area intentionally covered by a plain beige rectangular mask, as if anonymized. Use {argument name="character hair color" default="pastel pink"} hair and {argument name="hoodie color" default="blue"} hoodie if customized.

Visual style: Blue ink line art with occasional navy bold lettering, pale yellow highlights, soft sky-blue scribble fills, small sparkles, hearts, and radiating accent lines. Use a cheerful educational newsletter aesthetic, like a hand-drawn planner page mixed with kawaii anime illustration. Maintain legible text, balanced spacing, and no photorealism.

Constraints: Include exactly 3 workflow cards and exactly 3 action rows. Do not add extra panels, extra numbered steps, watermarks, logos, or English translations on the image beyond the subtitle line.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张正方形、日系手绘笔记本风格的信息图，主题是将 AI 从聊天伙伴转变为运营/工作助手，底部配有一个可爱的动漫吉祥物。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，奶油色横线笔记本纸背景，圆角设计，蓝色边框线，左侧可见金属螺旋装订，左上角有柔和的方格纸胶带装饰，并带有蓝色/黄色笔触点缀。整体风格应简洁、亲切、手写且类似速记笔记。

文字内容：使用日文手写字体。左上角页码：“4/4”。蓝色边框横幅内的主标题：{argument name="main title" default="実務への接続"}。下方副标题：“Manus / Codex / Claude Code / Newsletter”。页面中部虚线圆角矩形内的标签：“自分のワークフローへ”。左下角的大型核心信息：“AIはチャット相手から”，上方是超大号加粗深蓝色文字 {argument name="main message" default="作業担当へ"}。角色右侧的对话气泡：{argument name="speech bubble text" default="毎日の型にする"}。

布局：顶部三分之一处包含 3 张横向排列的互连工作流卡片，每张卡片带有编号的蓝色圆圈和圆角蓝色轮廓。卡片 1 标注为“Manusで収集”，显示放大镜、文档和云图标。卡片 2 标注为“Codex/Claude Codeで整理”，显示剪贴板清单、箭头、文件夹和小型层级图。卡片 3 标注为“ニュースレターで発信”，显示带有纸张和小心形图案的信封。在卡片之间添加粗蓝色向下箭头，并从中间卡片向下添加另一个蓝色箭头指向虚线工作流标签。

下半部分：左侧放置 3 行动作栏，带有圆形蓝色图标和日文标签：1) 放大镜图标配“調べる”，2) 文件夹图标配“整える”，3) 信封图标配“発信する”。用淡黄色记号笔笔触和虚线引导线为每个标签添加下划线或高亮。

角色细节：右下角中心位置设有一位可爱的动漫猫耳娘吉祥物，膝盖以上构图，留着长长的淡粉色头发，戴着白色猫耳，粉色猫尾向右卷曲，金色发夹上写着“ME”。她穿着宽松的蓝色连帽衫和深色短裙，拿着一个带有 3 个已勾选复选框的剪贴板。面部区域特意用简单的米色矩形遮盖，以示匿名。如需自定义，请使用 {argument name="character hair color" default="pastel pink"} 发色和 {argument name="hoodie color" default="blue"} 连帽衫。

视觉风格：蓝色墨水线条画，辅以深蓝色加粗字体、淡黄色高亮、柔和的天蓝色涂鸦填充，以及小火花、爱心和放射状强调线。采用欢快的教育通讯美学，融合手绘计划本页面与可爱动漫插画风格。保持文字清晰易读，间距平衡，避免写实风格。

约束条件：包含 3 张工作流卡片和 3 行动作栏。除副标题行外，图像中不得添加额外的面板、额外的编号步骤、水印、Logo 或英文翻译。

templates.title: Anime Sky Battle Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格天空战斗插画

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anime-style fantasy sci-fi battle illustration in a wide 16:9 composition. Show exactly 2 characters facing each other across a sky full of floating landmasses: on the left foreground, {argument name="heroine" default="a silver-haired female knight"} lunges forward in profile with a determined expression, long high ponytail streaming behind her, wearing ornate white, blue, and gold plate armor with a flowing royal-blue cape, gripping a brilliant oversized energy sword that glows electric blue and leaves streaks of light and sparks across the lower half of the image. On the right upper foreground, {argument name="rival" default="a black-haired male antagonist"} stands confidently on top of a sleek black futuristic gunship, wearing a dark suit-like outfit, facing the heroine from a distance. Include exactly 1 black angular gunship with a pointed nose, mechanical panels, circular engine details, and a large forward cannon aimed toward the heroine. The environment is a dramatic high-altitude sky or shattered dimension with exactly 18 visible floating rocky islands and debris masses scattered in depth, from huge jagged slabs near the center to smaller fragments in the distance. The left side of the scene should glow with cold blue magical energy, while the right side should be corrupted by magenta-red lightning and dark nebula-like cracks, creating a strong blue-versus-red contrast. Use dynamic diagonal composition, extreme perspective, wind motion streaks, glowing particles, detailed clouds, painterly anime rendering, crisp linework, high saturation, dramatic lighting, and epic novel-cover energy. No text, no watermark, no frame border.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅 16:9 宽画幅的电影级动漫风格奇幻科幻战斗插画。画面中需精确展示 2 个角色，在充满浮空陆地的天空中对峙：左侧前景中，{argument name="heroine" default="一位银发女骑士"} 侧身向前突刺，表情坚定，长长的高马尾在身后飘动，身着华丽的白、蓝、金三色板甲，披着飘逸的宝蓝色斗篷，紧握一把闪烁着电光蓝色的巨大能量剑，在画面下半部分留下光影与火花轨迹。右侧上方前景中，{argument name="rival" default="一位黑发男性反派"} 自信地站在一架流线型黑色未来感武装直升机顶部，身着深色西装风格服装，从远处面对女英雄。包含 1 架黑色棱角分明的武装直升机，具有尖锐的机头、机械面板、圆形引擎细节以及指向女英雄的大型前置加农炮。环境为戏剧性的高空或破碎维度，深度空间中散布着 18 个可见的浮空岩石岛屿和碎片，从中心巨大的锯齿状石板到远处的细小碎片。场景左侧应散发冷色调的蓝色魔法能量，而右侧则被洋红色闪电和类似暗星云的裂纹所侵蚀，营造出强烈的红蓝对比。采用动态对角线构图、极端透视、风动轨迹、发光粒子、细腻云层、绘画感动漫渲染、清晰的线条、高饱和度、戏剧性光影，呈现史诗级小说封面的质感。无文字，无水印，无边框。

templates.title: Dense Anime AI Era Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高密度动漫 AI 时代海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an extremely dense Japanese anime-style promotional collage poster about {argument name="topic" default="the current AI era with GPT-image2 and 5.5 Thinking"}, showing AI tools transforming everyday life, work, research, creativity, social media, and learning.

Canvas: 4:3 horizontal poster, 1024×768 feel, packed edge-to-edge like a futuristic magazine spread. Use high-contrast manga advertising design with diagonal speed lines, glowing blue UI panels, white speech bubbles, thick black outlines, neon cyan highlights, red emphasis words, and dramatic perspective. No empty space.

Layout: Build one large central headline and surrounding mini-panels in a chaotic but readable collage. Include exactly 16 distinct content zones: 1 huge top-left welcome headline, 1 central main slogan, 1 central crowd/workspace scene, 1 coding support panel, 1 image-generation gallery panel, 1 video-generation panel, 1 tool-war vertical banner, 1 AI-agent automation checklist, 1 music-AI waveform panel, 1 debate/legal scales panel, 1 startup meeting panel, 1 researcher evolution panel, 1 social-media excitement strip, and 3 bottom everyday-life support cards.

Main text: The top-left headline should be {argument name="welcome headline" default="ようこそ! AI時代へ!!"}. The central slogan should be {argument name="central slogan" default="AIで、もっと創造的に、もっと自由に、もっと豊かに!!"}. Add a top-center burst reading {argument name="evolution headline" default="進化が、毎日起きている!!"}. Add a right vertical banner reading {argument name="tool banner" default="ツール戦国時代!! 進化のスピードがエグい!!"}. Add a bottom-right final proclamation reading {argument name="final slogan" default="競争も、協力も、学びも、遊びも──全部ひっくるめて、これがAIの今だ!!"}. Surround everything with many smaller Japanese-style captions, exclamation bubbles, tags, arrows, badges, and UI labels; they should look authentic but may be tiny and partially unreadable.

Subject details: Central scene shows a crowded modern co-working hall filled with excited young anime creators, office workers, students, researchers, and startup founders using laptops, tablets, holographic screens, phones, and AI dashboards. Many human faces should be intentionally anonymized with soft square blur masks, while hair, poses, clothing, and devices remain visible. Add multiple cute white-and-blue robot mascots with black oval faces and glowing cyan eyes; include exactly 4 robots: one large robot at top left, one small robot beside the automation checklist, one tiny robot in the social-media strip, and one small robot in the elderly-support card.

Panel details and exact counted elements: The image-generation panel contains exactly 1 large fantasy castle preview and 5 thumbnail variations below it. The video-generation panel contains exactly 1 large cyberpunk anime girl preview and 6 small thumbnails below it. The AI-agent panel contains exactly 5 checklist items with checkmarks, suggesting research, data analysis, document creation, email sending, and scheduling. The music-AI panel contains exactly 1 large music-note icon, 1 waveform display, and 4 playback controls. The debate/legal panel contains exactly 1 balance-scale icon and 2 debating figures. The social-media area contains exactly 3 metric badges with heart, repost, and comment icons, showing large numbers such as 12.8K, 5.6K, and 3.2K, plus floating hearts and stars. The bottom strip contains exactly 4 everyday-support cards: translation/travel chat, AI learning support, health management support, and elderly monitoring/consultation.

Visual style: Polished anime illustration mixed with UI mockup, infographic, and manga advertisement aesthetics. Use saturated electric blues, blacks, whites, red accents, yellow lightbulb highlights, and glossy screen reflections. Fonts should be bold Japanese display fonts with heavy outlines, drop shadows, and slanted dynamic emphasis. Add motion streaks, comic bursts, arrows, stickers, holographic overlays, browser windows, code snippets, waveform graphs, data charts, smartphone screens, notification icons, and social media UI.

Constraints: Keep the poster extremely information-dense and energetic. Use Japanese typography throughout the design, but prioritize the five specified headline texts. Make the human characters clearly anime-style and varied in age and occupation. Maintain a celebratory, optimistic tone about AI becoming part of everyday life. Do not include real company logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张极其高密度的日式动漫风格宣传拼贴海报，主题为 {argument name="topic" default="当前的 AI 时代，以 GPT-image2 和 5.5 Thinking 为核心"}，展示 AI 工具如何改变日常生活、工作、研究、创意、社交媒体和学习。

画布：4:3 横向海报，1024×768 质感，像未来主义杂志内页一样填满每一个角落。采用高对比度的漫画广告设计，包含对角线速度线、发光的蓝色 UI 面板、白色对话气泡、粗黑轮廓、霓虹青色高光、红色强调文字以及极具张力的透视效果。不留任何空白。

布局：构建一个巨大的中央标题，周围环绕着混乱但易读的拼贴式小面板。包含 16 个明确的内容区域：1 个左上角巨大的欢迎标题，1 个中央主标语，1 个中央人群/工作空间场景，1 个代码支持面板，1 个图像生成画廊面板，1 个视频生成面板，1 个工具战争垂直横幅，1 个 AI Agent 自动化清单，1 个音乐 AI 波形面板，1 个辩论/法律天平面板，1 个创业会议面板，1 个研究员进化面板，1 个社交媒体热点条，以及 3 张底部日常生活支持卡片。

主要文字：左上角标题应为 {argument name="welcome headline" default="ようこそ! AI時代へ!!"}。中央标语应为 {argument name="central slogan" default="AIで、もっと創造的に、もっと自由に、もっと豊かに!!"}。在顶部中央添加一个爆炸效果文字 {argument name="evolution headline" default="進化が、毎日起きている!!"}。在右侧添加一个垂直横幅，文字为 {argument name="tool banner" default="ツール戦国時代!! 進化のスピードがエグい!!"}。在右下角添加最终宣言 {argument name="final slogan" default="競争も、協力も、学びも、遊びも──全部ひっくるめて、これがAIの今だ!!"}。周围环绕大量日式小标题、感叹号气泡、标签、箭头、徽章和 UI 标签；它们应看起来真实，但可以非常微小且部分模糊。

主体细节：中央场景展示了一个拥挤的现代联合办公大厅，里面挤满了兴奋的年轻动漫创作者、上班族、学生、研究人员和创业者，他们正在使用笔记本电脑、平板电脑、全息屏幕、手机和 AI 仪表盘。许多人脸应刻意用柔和的方形模糊遮罩进行匿名化处理，但发型、姿势、服装和设备保持可见。添加多个可爱的白蓝色机器人吉祥物，它们拥有黑色椭圆形脸和发光的青色眼睛；共包含 4 个机器人：左上角一个大机器人，自动化清单旁一个小机器人，社交媒体条中一个微型机器人，以及老年人支持卡片中一个小机器人。

面板细节与精确计数元素：图像生成面板包含 1 个大型奇幻城堡预览和下方 5 个缩略图变体。视频生成面板包含 1 个大型赛博朋克动漫女孩预览和下方 6 个小缩略图。AI Agent 面板包含 5 个带有勾选标记的清单项，暗示研究、数据分析、文档创建、邮件发送和日程安排。音乐 AI 面板包含 1 个大型音符图标、1 个波形显示和 4 个播放控件。辩论/法律面板包含 1 个天平图标和 2 个辩论人物。社交媒体区域包含 3 个带有心形、转发和评论图标的指标徽章，显示 12.8K、5.6K 和 3.2K 等大数字，以及漂浮的心形和星星。底部条包含 4 张日常生活支持卡片：翻译/旅行聊天、AI 学习支持、健康管理支持和老年人监控/咨询。

视觉风格：精致的动漫插画与 UI 模型、信息图表和漫画广告美学的结合。使用饱和的电光蓝、黑、白，搭配红色点缀、黄色灯泡高光和光泽屏幕反射。字体应为带有粗轮廓、投影和倾斜动态强调的粗体日文展示字体。添加运动条纹、漫画爆炸效果、箭头、贴纸、全息叠加层、浏览器窗口、代码片段、波形图、数据图表、智能手机屏幕、通知图标和社交媒体 UI。

约束：保持海报信息极其密集且充满活力。在整个设计中使用日文排版，但优先考虑五个指定的标题文本。确保动漫角色风格清晰，年龄和职业各异。保持对 AI 融入日常生活这一主题的庆祝和乐观基调。不要包含真实的品牌 Logo 或水印。

templates.title: Toyohashi Tourism Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 丰桥市旅游动漫海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-resolution Japanese tourism PR poster for {argument name="city name" default="Toyohashi City"}, combining an emotional anime travel illustration with a dense collage of local attractions, foods, and landmarks.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, bright cinematic daylight, ultra-detailed 2K feel. Use a saturated blue sky with white clouds and warm golden sunset light. The composition should feel like an official municipal promotional poster, polished and information-rich.

Main visual: Center a beautiful anime-style young woman seen from behind and slightly in profile, standing in a scenic city overlook. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="deep blue"} hair blowing dramatically in the wind, delicate hair ornaments, a white short-sleeve blouse, and a light blue skirt. She carries a cream tote bag printed with “TOYOHASHI” and small blue city-line art. Her face area should be softly obscured or turned away so the poster focuses on place and atmosphere. Add a small schoolgirl-like figure in the midground looking over the city, reinforcing nostalgia and travel.

Top headline text: Large elegant white Japanese calligraphy-style title across the upper left: 「住みたくなるまち、豊橋市」. Add smaller handwritten-style subcopy nearby: 「今日も、明日も、このまちが好きになる」. Use strong drop shadows so the text remains legible against the sky.

Right sidebar: Create a cream rounded vertical panel titled 「豊橋市の魅力10選」. It must contain exactly 10 numbered attraction cards, each with a small photo-like thumbnail and Japanese label:
1. 「のんほいパーク」 with an elephant/giraffe zoo image
2. 「手筒花火」 with handheld fireworks sparks
3. 「路面電車」 with a streetcar image
4. 「豊橋カレーうどん」 with curry udon bowl
5. 「『負けヒロインが多すぎる！』聖地巡礼」 with a seaside or school-route scene
6. 「花のまち豊橋」 with colorful flowers
7. 「葦毛湿原」 with wetland greenery
8. 「ブラックサンダー」 with a chocolate bar close-up
9. 「ヤマサちくわ」 with chikuwa fish cakes
10. 「うずら卵」 with quail eggs

Collage elements: Include exactly 10 major attraction/food elements integrated around the poster: a zoo scene with giraffe and elephant on the left, a brick windmill and flower field in the upper right background, handheld fireworks in the lower left, a red-and-white streetcar labeled “3203,” a large bowl of Toyohashi curry udon, a Black Thunder chocolate bar package, Yamasa chikuwa fish cakes, a small bowl of quail eggs, a river/canal landscape with bridge and birds, and abundant foreground flowers. Add small vertical Japanese label tags near some collage items such as 「のんほいパーク」, 「手筒花火」, 「路面電車」, 「豊橋カレーうどん」, 「ヤマサちくわ」, and 「うずら卵」.

Mid and lower text: Add a small sign near the overlook reading 「豊橋へようこそ」. Add a vertical poetic phrase near the windmill/flowers: 「花も 空も 未来も ここにある。」. Near the bottom, place white and yellow promotional copy: 「豊かな自然、便利な暮らし、あなたらしい人。」 followed by a larger closing line 「それが、豊橋。」 with “豊橋” emphasized in yellow.

Footer: Bottom right should show a white rounded municipal logo block with a simple blue emblem and the text 「豊橋市」 plus small roman letters “TOYOHASHI CITY”.

Visual style: Premium anime illustration mixed with realistic travel-poster collage, soft depth of field, painterly detail, sparkling particles and flower petals in the air, glossy food illustration, crisp readable Japanese typography, warm inspirational atmosphere, no blank areas, no watermark, no extra people beyond the two described figures.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="city name" default="丰桥市"} 创作一张高分辨率的日本旅游宣传海报，将富有感染力的动漫旅行插画与当地景点、美食和地标的密集拼贴相结合。

画布：竖版海报，4:5 长宽比，明亮的电影感日光，超细腻的 2K 质感。使用饱和的蓝天白云和温暖的金色夕阳。构图应呈现出官方市政宣传海报的质感，精致且信息丰富。

主视觉：画面中心为一位美丽的动漫风格少女，背影及侧脸出镜，站在城市观景台上。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深蓝色"} 秀发，在风中飘逸，佩戴精致的发饰，身穿白色短袖衬衫和浅蓝色裙子。她背着一个奶油色的帆布袋，上面印有“TOYOHASHI”字样和蓝色的城市线条艺术。她的面部应柔和地遮挡或转向一侧，使海报重心聚焦于地点和氛围。在中景处增加一个类似女学生的背影，眺望着城市，增强怀旧感与旅行氛围。

顶部标题：左上方使用优雅的白色日式书法字体书写大标题：「住みたくなるまち、豊橋市」。旁边添加较小的手写体副标题：「今日も、明日も、このまちが好きになる」。使用强烈的投影效果，确保文字在天空背景下清晰可见。

右侧边栏：创建一个奶油色的圆角竖向面板，标题为「豊橋市の魅力10選」。面板内必须包含 10 个带编号的景点卡片，每项均配有类似照片的小缩略图和日语标签：
1. 「のんほいパーク」（非帆公园），配有大象/长颈鹿动物园图像
2. 「手筒花火」（手筒烟花），配有手持烟花火花图像
3. 「路面電車」（路面电车），配有电车图像
4. 「豊橋カレーうどん」（丰桥咖喱乌冬面），配有咖喱乌冬面碗图像
5. 「『負けヒロインが多すぎる！』聖地巡礼」（《败犬女主太多了！》圣地巡礼），配有海边或上学路场景
6. 「花のまち豊橋」（花之城丰桥），配有色彩缤纷的花卉
7. 「葦毛湿原」（苇毛湿原），配有湿地绿植
8. 「ブラックサンダー」（雷神巧克力），配有巧克力棒特写
9. 「ヤマサちくわ」（山佐竹轮），配有竹轮鱼糕
10. 「うずら卵」（鹌鹑蛋），配有鹌鹑蛋图像

拼贴元素：海报周围需整合 10 个主要的景点/美食元素：左侧为长颈鹿和大象的动物园场景，右上背景为砖砌风车和花田，左下为手持烟花，一辆标有“3203”的红白相间路面电车，一大碗丰桥咖喱乌冬面，一包雷神巧克力，山佐竹轮，一小碗鹌鹑蛋，带有桥梁和飞鸟的河流/运河景观，以及前景中繁茂的花朵。在部分拼贴元素附近添加小的竖向日语标签，如「のんほいパーク」、「手筒花火」、「路面電車」、「豊橋カレーうどん」、「ヤマサちくわ」和「うずら卵」。

中下部文字：在观景台附近添加一个小标牌，写着「豊橋へようこそ」。在风车/花丛附近添加竖向的诗意短句：「花も 空も 未来も ここにある。」。底部放置白色和黄色的宣传文案：「豊かな自然、便利な暮らし、あなたらしい人。」，随后是一行较大的结束语「それが、豊橋。」，其中“豊橋”以黄色强调。

页脚：右下角应展示一个白色的圆角市政标志块，包含简单的蓝色徽章和文字「豊橋市」以及小号罗马字母“TOYOHASHI CITY”。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画与写实旅游海报拼贴相结合，柔和的景深，绘画般的细节，空气中飘浮着闪烁的微粒和花瓣，光泽感的美食插画，清晰易读的日文字体，温暖且鼓舞人心的氛围，无空白区域，无水印，除描述的两人外无其他人物。

templates.title: Anime Hardware Store Worker

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格五金店员工

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed anime-style illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young working woman"} standing in the center aisle of a crowded Japanese hardware store, surrounded by tall shelves packed with packaged hand tools, pliers, wrenches, drill bits, power tools, price tags, and colorful Japanese product signs. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair tied into twin ponytails with 2 large lavender ribbon bows, and wears a frilly {argument name="dress color" default="lavender"} Victorian-lolita work dress with exactly 6 prominent outfit details: puff sleeves, lace-trimmed collar, large bow at the neck, vertical lace panel with buttons, fitted waist sash, and tiered ruffled skirt. Her face is fully covered by a plain centered square censor block in warm skin-tone beige, with no facial features visible. She holds exactly 2 cordless power drills: a teal-blue drill in her left hand angled slightly downward toward the viewer, and a red drill in her right hand angled outward to the side, both with black battery packs and metallic chucks. The background should show exactly 2 long tool aisles receding in perspective on the left and right, with dense blister packs and signage, including blue and red Japanese-style DIY/tool labels, creating a busy retail atmosphere. Use warm overhead fluorescent lighting, shallow depth of field, cinematic perspective, glossy reflections on plastic packaging, soft golden rim light on the hair, intricate linework, painterly shading, and a polished GPT-image-2 anime illustration look. Keep the composition square, waist-up to thigh-up framing, centered character, dynamic but cute and hardworking mood, no extra characters, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的动漫风格插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻的女员工"}，她站在日本五金店拥挤的中央过道中，周围是摆满包装好的手动工具、钳子、扳手、钻头、电动工具、价格标签和色彩鲜艳的日本商品标识的高大货架。她留着长长的波浪形 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 头发，扎成双马尾，并系着 2 个巨大的薰衣草色蝴蝶结。她穿着一件带有荷叶边的 {argument name="dress color" default="薰衣草色"} 维多利亚洛丽塔风格工作裙，裙装包含 6 个显著细节：泡泡袖、蕾丝饰边领口、颈部大蝴蝶结、带纽扣的垂直蕾丝镶板、收腰腰带以及多层荷叶边裙摆。她的脸部被一个暖肤色的纯色正方形遮挡块完全覆盖，没有任何面部特征可见。她手中拿着 2 把无绳电钻：左手拿着一把略微向下倾斜指向观众的青蓝色电钻，右手拿着一把向侧面倾斜的红色电钻，两把电钻均带有黑色电池组和金属钻夹头。背景应展示 2 条向左右两侧延伸的深邃工具过道，货架上挂满了密集的吸塑包装和标识，包括蓝色和红色的日式 DIY/工具标签，营造出繁忙的零售氛围。使用温暖的头顶荧光照明、浅景深、电影级视角、塑料包装上的光泽反射、头发上柔和的金色轮廓光、复杂的线条、绘画般的阴影，以及精致的 GPT-image-2 动漫插画质感。保持构图为正方形，采用半身至大腿的取景方式，角色居中，呈现出动感、可爱且勤劳的氛围，画面中不包含其他角色，且无水印。

templates.title: Luxury Pink Chocolatier Gift Box

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华粉色巧克力礼盒

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious pastel pink limited-edition chocolate gift box product photo for {argument name="character name" default="Hana na chan"}. The scene is a dreamy, romantic flat-lay/angled close-up on a lace-covered table with soft warm studio lighting, shallow depth of field, pearl and satin accents, and an elegant rose-gold and blush color palette. Show an open rectangular chocolatier box: the upper lid fills the top half and is printed like a premium keepsake package with ornate thin gold border lines, delicate cherry-blossom clusters in the corners, and a large portrait-style photo of a cute young girl with a short pale-blonde bob haircut, a pink flower hair clip, a white blouse with tiny pink floral embroidery and lace collar, black suspenders, and one arm raised making a peace sign; place a simple opaque square privacy mosaic over the face. On the lid, include refined gold typography reading "花奈ちゃん" with a small blossom mark, "HANA NA CHAN", "ÉDITION LIMITÉE", and "CHOCOLAT DE RÊVE". Add a large satin bow at the upper right of the lid with dangling gold charm beads and a small flower ornament. The lower half of the box contains exactly 10 chocolates arranged in a 2-by-5 grid in individual dark brown fluted cups inside glossy gold compartments: 1 pink flower-shaped chocolate with a gold center, 2 faceted ruby-pink heart gem chocolate, 3 cream round ridged chocolate topped with a small pink flower, 4 pink rose-swirl chocolate, 5 dark round chocolate dusted with fine gold sprinkles, 6 square milk chocolate engraved with floral line art, 7 round pink striped chocolate with white drizzle and tiny sprinkles, 8 faceted blush-pink dome chocolate, 9 square dark chocolate engraved with a gold bee or floral motif, 10 pale pink heart chocolate with pearly sheen. Around the box, include soft props: lace fabric, pale pink flower petals, a small cream gift card at lower left with cursive "Hana na chan" and Japanese-style decorative text, a vintage gold mirror edge, pearls, and pink ribbon. Style should look like a high-end Japanese kawaii chocolatier advertisement, photorealistic but slightly fantasy-polished, with crisp packaging details, embossed textures, metallic gold accents, delicate blossoms, and no extra chocolates or extra text beyond the specified lettering.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="character name" default="Hana na chan"} 创建一张奢华的淡粉色限量版巧克力礼盒产品照。场景设定为铺着蕾丝的桌面上，采用梦幻浪漫的平铺或倾斜特写视角，配以柔和温暖的摄影棚灯光、浅景深、珍珠和缎面装饰，以及优雅的玫瑰金与腮红粉色调。展示一个打开的长方形巧克力礼盒：上盖占据上半部分，印有高级纪念品包装风格，带有精致的金色细边框、角落处点缀着细腻的樱花簇，以及一张大尺寸的人像风格照片，照片中是一位可爱的年轻女孩，留着浅金色短波波头，戴着粉色花朵发夹，身穿带有细小粉色花卉刺绣和蕾丝领口的白色衬衫，搭配黑色背带，一只手举起比出剪刀手；在脸部位置覆盖一个简单的半透明方形马赛克。在盒盖上，加入精致的金色字体，写着“花奈ちゃん”、一个小花朵标记、“HANA NA CHAN”、“ÉDITION LIMITÉE”和“CHOCOLAT DE RÊVE”。在盒盖右上角添加一个巨大的缎面蝴蝶结，配有悬垂的金色珠饰和小花装饰。礼盒下半部分包含整整 10 颗巧克力，以 2x5 的网格排列在光亮的金色隔层内，每颗巧克力放置在深棕色的褶皱纸托中：1 号为带金色花心的粉色花朵形巧克力，2 号为切面红宝石粉色心形宝石巧克力，3 号为顶部点缀小粉花的奶油色圆形条纹巧克力，4 号为粉色玫瑰漩涡巧克力，5 号为撒有细金粉的深色圆形巧克力，6 号为刻有花卉线条艺术的方形牛奶巧克力，7 号为带有白色淋酱和细小糖珠的圆形粉色条纹巧克力，8 号为切面腮红粉色圆顶巧克力，9 号为刻有金色蜜蜂或花卉图案的方形黑巧克力，10 号为带有珍珠光泽的淡粉色心形巧克力。礼盒周围布置柔和的道具：蕾丝面料、淡粉色花瓣、左下角一张写有草书“Hana na chan”和日式装饰文字的奶油色礼品卡、复古金镜边缘、珍珠和粉色丝带。整体风格应呈现高端日式可爱风巧克力广告质感，照片级真实但略带梦幻滤镜，包装细节清晰，具有浮雕质感、金属金色点缀和细腻花卉，除指定的文字外，不包含额外的巧克力或多余文字。
