templates.title: Four Anime Figures in Glass Display

titleLocalized.zh: 玻璃展示柜中的四个动漫手办

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic product-display image of exactly 4 collectible anime idol figurines posed inside a dark glass display cabinet, arranged in a 2-by-2 grid with black metal dividers between the four compartments. Use a cinematic warm spotlight from above in each compartment, glossy reflections on the glass, shallow depth of field, and a premium museum-diorama look. Each figurine sits or kneels on a circular polished wooden pedestal, with a softly blurred doll-like face and highly detailed glossy resin skin, hair, clothing, ribbons, gloves, stockings, and metallic accessories. The overall theme is {argument name="display theme" default="luxury fantasy idol figures in antique glass cases"}. Include exactly 4 figurines: top left is a purple-haired twin-tail idol in a white, black, and lavender frilled stage outfit, seated sideways with one hand on the pedestal and the other arm extended outward, wearing thigh-high stockings and garter details; top right is a blue-haired curled-twin-tail idol in a dark navy plaid school-uniform-inspired outfit, kneeling on the pedestal with one arm raised in a peace-sign gesture, wearing gloves and layered ribbons; bottom left is a pink-haired pastel idol in a pale pink frilly dress, seated with one leg folded and one hand touching her head, with blue-and-pink stockings and delicate bows; bottom right is a short white-and-blue-haired idol in a white, silver, and cyan outfit with small wing-like shoulder details and a star hair ornament, seated cross-legged while pointing toward the viewer. Surround the figures with antique props inside the cases: framed art prints, small books, vintage cameras, glass bottles, dried flowers in vases, a brass armillary sphere, a lantern with a candle, and a large antique clock. Keep the environment dark brown and black with warm amber highlights, realistic glass reflections, subtle dust and scratches, and a high-end collectible photography style. Use {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:2 horizontal"}, {argument name="lighting mood" default="warm moody cabinet spotlighting"}, {argument name="color palette" default="dark walnut, black metal, amber light, lavender, navy, pink, cyan"}, and {argument name="image realism" default="ultra-realistic resin figure photography"}. No text, no watermark, no extra figurines, no human hands, no packaging boxes.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的产品展示图，展示 4 个收藏级动漫偶像手办，它们被放置在一个深色玻璃展示柜中，以 2x2 的网格排列，四个隔间之间有黑色金属隔板。每个隔间上方使用电影质感的暖色聚光灯，玻璃上有光泽反射，采用浅景深，呈现出高端博物馆立体模型的视觉效果。每个手办都坐着或跪在圆形的抛光木质底座上，拥有柔和模糊的玩偶面孔，以及高度精细的树脂皮肤、头发、服装、丝带、手套、长筒袜和金属配饰。整体主题为 {argument name="display theme" default="古董玻璃柜中的奢华幻想偶像手办"}。包含 4 个手办：左上角是一个紫色双马尾偶像，身穿白、黑、薰衣草色相间的荷叶边舞台装，侧身坐着，一只手放在底座上，另一只手臂向外伸展，穿着过膝袜和吊带细节；右上角是一个蓝色卷发双马尾偶像，身穿深海军蓝格子校服风格服装，跪在底座上，一只手举起比出剪刀手姿势，戴着手套并有层叠的丝带；左下角是一个粉色头发的柔和系偶像，身穿浅粉色荷叶边裙子，坐着，一条腿弯曲，一只手触碰头部，穿着蓝粉相间的长筒袜和精致的蝴蝶结；右下角是一个短白蓝发偶像，身穿白、银、青色相间的服装，带有小翅膀状的肩部细节和星星发饰，盘腿坐着并指向观众。在柜内用古董道具环绕手办：装裱的艺术画、小书、复古相机、玻璃瓶、花瓶里的干花、黄铜浑天仪、带蜡烛的灯笼和一个大型古董钟。环境保持深棕色和黑色，带有温暖的琥珀色高光，真实的玻璃反射，细微的灰尘和划痕，以及高端收藏品摄影风格。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:2 横向"}，{argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖且富有情绪的柜内聚光灯"}，{argument name="color palette" default="深胡桃木色、黑色金属、琥珀光、薰衣草色、海军蓝、粉色、青色"}，以及 {argument name="image realism" default="超写实树脂手办摄影"}。无文字，无水印，无额外手办，无人手，无包装盒。

variables.defaultValue: luxury fantasy idol figures in antique glass cases

templates.title: Monochrome Megacity Black Hole

titleLocalized.zh: 单色巨型都市黑洞

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic sci-fi cityscape viewed from a very high aerial angle at night, in monochrome black, charcoal, silver, and cold white. The scene shows an impossibly vast futuristic megacity packed with thousands of tall skyscrapers, sharp spires, dense glowing windows, and intricate illuminated street grids stretching to a hazy horizon. In the center-right foreground, place a colossal circular black void like a perfectly dark sinkhole or artificial black hole embedded in the city, surrounded by countless bright concentric rings of white light trails that swirl around it like long-exposure traffic or orbital data streams. The light trails should form a wide vortex disk, brightest on the left side and fading into a deep black center. Buildings continue around and partly into the vortex, with some towers silhouetted against the glowing rings. The atmosphere is misty, high-contrast, and apocalyptic, with volumetric haze, bloom, fine detail, subtle film grain, and a luminous horizontal fog band near the distant horizon. No people, no vehicles visible as objects, no text, no logos; emphasize overwhelming scale, cyberpunk architecture, and the surreal gravitational distortion of a city being swallowed by a black hole.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅从极高空俯瞰的垂直电影级科幻城市夜景，采用单色黑、炭灰、银色和冷白色调。画面展现了一座规模宏大得不可思议的未来主义巨型都市，密布着数以千计的高耸摩天大楼、尖锐塔楼、密集发光的窗户以及延伸至朦胧地平线的复杂照明街道网。在画面中右侧前景处，放置一个巨大的圆形黑色虚空，如同嵌入城市中的完美暗黑深坑或人造黑洞，周围环绕着无数明亮的同心圆光轨，如同长曝光下的车流或轨道数据流般盘旋。光轨形成一个宽阔的漩涡盘，左侧最亮，并向深黑色的中心逐渐淡出。建筑群环绕并部分延伸至漩涡之中，部分塔楼在发光环的映衬下呈现出剪影。氛围朦胧、高对比度且具有末日感，带有体积雾、光晕、精细细节、微妙的胶片颗粒感，以及远方地平线附近的一条发光水平雾带。画面中无人、无可见车辆、无文字、无标志；强调压倒性的规模感、赛博朋克建筑风格，以及城市被黑洞吞噬的超现实引力扭曲感。

templates.title: Monochrome Bridal Prayer Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 单色新娘祈祷肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic black-and-white fine-art bridal portrait in a square 1:1 frame. Show {argument name="subject" default="a bride"} from the chest up, turned slightly to the right, with long dark hair partially hidden under a sheer cathedral veil. She wears an ornate high-neck long-sleeve lace wedding gown covered in floral embroidery, beadwork, and subtle sparkle, plus small pearl earrings. Her hands are clasped together in front of her chin in a prayer-like pose, fingers interlaced, creating a quiet devotional mood. Add a large opaque dark gray square over the center of her face, fully obscuring facial features while leaving the hair, veil, ear, neck, shoulders, and hands visible. The veil should drape from a lace floral headpiece across the crown and fall diagonally down the right side of the image, with delicate embroidered edging visible. Use soft directional studio lighting from the upper left, deep shadows, high contrast, shallow depth of field, and a dark textured charcoal background. Render as an elegant monochrome wedding photograph with realistic fabric texture, luminous lace detail, subtle film grain, and a small white handwritten photographer signature mark in the lower right corner reading {argument name="signature text" default="C Hase"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 正方形画幅的戏剧性黑白艺术风格新娘肖像。展示 {argument name="subject" default="一位新娘"} 的胸部以上部位，身体略微向右转，长长的深色头发部分隐藏在透明的大教堂式头纱下。她身穿一件华丽的高领长袖蕾丝婚纱，上面布满了花卉刺绣、珠饰和细微的闪光，并佩戴着小珍珠耳环。她的双手在下巴前合十，呈祈祷姿势，手指交错，营造出一种宁静虔诚的氛围。在她的面部中心添加一个巨大的不透明深灰色正方形，完全遮挡面部特征，同时保留头发、头纱、耳朵、颈部、肩膀和双手可见。头纱应从头顶的蕾丝花卉头饰垂下，斜向覆盖图像右侧，并露出精致的刺绣边缘。使用来自左上方的柔和定向影棚灯光、深邃的阴影、高对比度、浅景深以及深色纹理的炭灰色背景。渲染为一张优雅的单色婚礼照片，呈现真实的织物纹理、明亮的蕾丝细节、细微的胶片颗粒感，并在右下角添加一个白色手写摄影师签名，内容为 {argument name="signature text" default="C Hase"}。

templates.title: Safari Portrait With Tiger Cub

titleLocalized.zh: 野生动物园与幼虎的肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical editorial photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a young woman"} reclining confidently in a vintage wooden cane lounge chair outdoors in a dry, sunlit woodland or safari-like setting. She has long dark wavy hair and her face is intentionally hidden by a centered opaque square blur/censor block. She wears a brown suede jacket over a muted gray cropped lace-trim camisole, fitted cream pants, and black knee-high boots. A single tiger cub rests calmly on her lap between her legs, facing the camera with its front paws extended forward. Count the visible main elements exactly: 1 seated woman, 1 tiger cub, 1 vintage cane chair, and 1 square face-obscuring block. Use warm golden-hour lighting, strong dappled tree shadows across her clothing and body, shallow depth of field, blurred earthy trees in the background, natural film grain, high-fashion safari editorial mood, realistic skin and fabric textures, 35mm photography look, vertical 2:3 composition. Add a small subtle white signature-style mark and Threads-style watermark in the bottom-right corner. No extra animals, no extra people, no text besides the small watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感的竖构图时尚摄影作品，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，她自信地斜倚在户外干燥、阳光充足的林地或类似野生动物园环境中的复古木制藤椅上。她留着深色长波浪卷发，面部被一个居中的不透明方形模糊/遮挡块刻意遮住。她身穿棕色麂皮夹克，内搭灰暗色调的蕾丝边短款吊带背心，下身穿着合身的奶油色长裤和黑色及膝长靴。一只幼虎安静地趴在她的双腿之间，正对着镜头，前爪向前伸展。请精确计算可见的主要元素：1 位坐着的女性、1 只幼虎、1 把复古藤椅以及 1 个遮挡面部的方形块。使用温暖的黄金时刻光线，树影斑驳地投射在她的衣物和身体上，采用浅景深效果，背景为模糊的泥土色树木，呈现自然的胶片颗粒感，营造出高级时尚的野生动物园编辑风格，展现真实的皮肤和织物纹理，具备 35mm 摄影质感，采用 2:3 竖构图。在右下角添加一个细微的白色签名式标记和 Threads 风格的水印。画面中不得出现额外的动物、额外的人物，除小水印外不得包含任何文字。

templates.title: Photorealistic Shenzhen Factory Entrance

titleLocalized.zh: 深圳工厂大门照片

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic documentary-style street photograph of the entrance to a Chinese electronics factory in Shenzhen on an overcast day. Show a wide horizontal 4:3 view from across a concrete driveway, with a slightly dated early-2000s digital camera look, natural muted colors, soft gray sky, realistic perspective, and no cinematic grading. The main subject is a white ceramic-tile industrial building complex with pale blue horizontal trim, three stories at the front and a long two-to-three-story wing receding diagonally into the background. Place a covered entrance canopy at the front-left center, glass doors beneath it, many rectangular windows with greenish glass, and a few external air-conditioning units on the side wall. On the upper facade, include red Chinese wall text reading {argument name="facade slogan" default="质量第一 客户至上"}. Stretch a red safety banner across the driveway in front of the building with yellow Chinese text reading {argument name="banner text" default="安全来自长期警惕 事故源于瞬间麻痹"}. On the right, place a tall dark red-brown vertical gate pillar topped with a white globe lamp, with gold vertical Chinese company lettering reading {argument name="company sign" default="深圳市富恒昌电子有限公司"}. In front of the pillar and along the entrance, include a closed silver accordion-style metal retractable gate. Add exactly 6 visible people: three adult male workers walking out from the entrance in the foreground, one in a light blue short-sleeve shirt, one in pale work clothes, one in a white shirt and jeans; plus three smaller figures standing farther back near the doorway. Add exactly 5 visible vehicles or bikes: one white van at far left, one dark sedan with a blue license plate parked in front-left, one dark vehicle partly hidden inside the gate, one black bicycle leaning near the gate, and one motorbike/scooter parked at the far right near blue planters. Include a wooden utility pole near the left foreground with overhead power lines crossing the upper-left corner and small posters pasted on the pole. Add low shrubs in blue-tiled planters on the right, gray concrete pavement with cracks and seams, and surrounding tiled factory walls. Make the image convincingly real, like an ordinary factory entrance snapshot, with slight lens softness and mundane environmental detail. Avoid modern luxury architecture, dramatic lighting, crowds, logos other than the described Chinese signage, and any surreal or illustrative style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的纪录片风格街头摄影作品，拍摄中国深圳一家小型电子工厂的入口。拍摄视角为阴天下的平视视角，位置在车道对面。场景展示了一栋白色瓷砖外墙、蓝色装饰线条的工业建筑，正面为三层，侧面延伸出长长的两层翼楼，配有许多长方形的绿色玻璃窗、壁挂式空调和带顶棚的入口。在前墙上，包含醒目的红色中文字样 {argument name="building slogan" default="质量第一 客户至上"}。大门上方悬挂一条红色长横幅，上面印有黄色中文字样 {argument name="safety banner text" default="安全来自长期警惕 事故源于瞬间麻痹"}。在右侧，放置一根高大的深红色光面垂直公司招牌柱，上面印有金色中文字样 {argument name="company name" default="深圳市富恒昌电子有限公司"}，顶部配有一个白色球形灯。入口前方是一个打开的伸缩式不锈钢推拉门。画面中包含 9 个可见人物：前景大门附近有 3 名正向外走的男子，门口有 1 名半身可见的男子，有顶通道后方站着 4 人，大门区域远处还有 1 个小身影。包含 4 辆机动车：左侧停放着 1 辆挂蓝色牌照的黑色轿车，最左侧边缘有 1 辆被裁切的白色面包车，大门内隐约可见 1 辆深色车辆，右侧停放着 1 辆红色电动踏板车。包含 4 辆自行车：中右侧前景大门旁靠着 1 辆蓝色自行车，旁边有 1 辆黑色自行车，最右侧踏板车附近聚集着 2 辆自行车。在左侧前景增加一根木制电线杆，多条架空电线横跨天空，电线杆上贴着纸质通知，地面为灰色混凝土车道，右侧蓝色瓷砖花坛里种着低矮灌木，背景为沉闷的工业区环境。采用 21 世纪初略显陈旧的数码相机质感：自然但平淡的光线、柔和的雾气、轻微的镜头畸变、柔和的色彩、写实的瑕疵、清晰可辨的中文标牌，无戏剧性构图，无水印。

templates.title: Uncanny Thanksgiving Family Dinner

titleLocalized.zh: 诡异的感恩节家庭晚餐

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic, slightly unsettling 1970s–1980s American Thanksgiving family dinner scene in a cozy but old-fashioned dining room. Use a 4:3 horizontal composition, warm dim indoor lighting, muted brown and cream tones, and a documentary snapshot aesthetic with realistic imperfections. Show exactly 9 people seated around a round table: 1 young adult man in a white shirt at far left, 1 woman beside him in brown, 1 middle-aged man in a white shirt and dark tie, 1 middle-aged woman in a pale floral blouse at the center, 1 young girl in a plaid dress and headband, 1 elderly man in a dark suit, 1 elderly woman in a dark patterned dress at far right, 1 boy seated with his back to the camera in the foreground, and 1 partially obscured person near the left side of the table. Make all human faces deliberately anonymized with soft rectangular blur blocks, increasing the uncanny realism. The table should be covered with a white lace tablecloth and crowded with exactly 8 visible food items: a large roasted turkey in the center, a bowl of green beans, a bowl of cranberry sauce, a bowl of mashed potatoes, a basket of dinner rolls, a rectangular baked casserole, a stuffing dish, and small plates of sliced food around the place settings. Include plates, forks, knives, spoons, drinking glasses, and napkins arranged realistically. Add exactly 3 pets: a gray tabby cat sitting on a small wooden stool at the lower left, a large German shepherd lying on the carpet in the foreground, and a brown hound dog standing in the kitchen doorway at the right rear. Background details: floral wallpaper, lace curtains glowing from a window on the left, a wooden china cabinet filled with plates and glassware centered on the back wall, autumn harvest decorations on top of the cabinet, small framed pictures, a black wall cross to the right, and a view into a wood-cabinet kitchen through the doorway. Add a faint blurred watermark-like block in the bottom-right corner. No readable text, no modern objects, no clean studio lighting; keep the image realistic, nostalgic, and subtly eerie.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个令人毛骨悚然且具有照片级真实感的 1970 年代美式感恩节家庭晚餐场景，背景设在温暖昏暗的餐厅中，采用类似纪实摄影的抓拍风格，呈现 4:3 的略微广角构图。画面中需有 9 人围坐在圆桌旁：最左侧是一位穿白衬衫的成年男子，旁边是一位成年女子，接着是一位穿白衬衫系领带的成年男子，中间是一位中年女性，右侧是两个穿着朴素连衣裙的小女孩，还有一位穿深色西装的老年男子、一位穿花纹连衣裙的老年女性，以及前景中一个背对镜头的年轻男孩。将所有可见的面部处理为诡异的平滑方形模糊或无特征的遮挡块，而非正常的五官，同时保持身体、衣物、发型和房间的高度真实感。桌上铺着白色蕾丝桌布，摆满了感恩节盛宴：中心摆放 1 只大烤火鸡，周围自然地摆放着土豆泥、青豆、蔓越莓酱、篮装餐包、填料或砂锅菜、肉汁、餐盘、玻璃杯、银餐具和小型上菜碗。画面中需包含 3 只动物：左下角小椅子上坐着一只虎斑猫，前景地板上躺着一只德国牧羊犬，右侧厨房门口站着一只猎犬。房间贴着米色花卉壁纸，左侧有带蕾丝窗帘的窗户，后方有一个木制瓷器柜，柜内摆满盘子和玻璃器皿，顶部装饰着秋季丰收饰品，墙上挂着相框，右侧墙上挂着一个黑色十字架，门口可以看到老式木制厨房。色调采用柔和的棕色、奶油色和琥珀色，带有真实的胶片颗粒感、柔和的室内白炽灯光、微妙的镜头柔焦效果，营造出令人不安的恐怖谷氛围。画面中无任何可读文字，无现代物品，除右下角一个模糊的像素化标记外，无任何水印。可选自定义项：设置节日餐点 {argument name="holiday meal" default="感恩节晚餐"}，设置时代 {argument name="era" default="1970 年代"}，更改房间风格 {argument name="room style" default="老式美式餐厅"}，调整面部处理方式 {argument name="face treatment" default="所有可见面部均覆盖平滑的方形模糊遮挡"}，以及设置氛围 {argument name="mood" default="照片级真实但极度诡异"}。

templates.title: Tiny 3D Avatar in Front of X Profile

titleLocalized.zh: X 个人主页前的微型 3D 虚拟形象

templates.prompt:
Create a vertical cinematic sci-fi 3D render of a giant transparent glass-like 𝕏/Twitter profile page standing upright on a futuristic circular display platform, with a tiny full-body 3D avatar of the profile owner standing in front of it at the lower right. The profile belongs to {argument name="character name" default="Alexandra Aisling"}, handle {argument name="profile handle" default="@AllaAisling"}. The avatar is a stylish female sci-fi explorer with warm brown skin, short curly hair, orange headphones/goggles, a red-orange utility jumpsuit, cropped cream tactical vest, gloves, and chunky white-orange boots, posed confidently with arms relaxed. The face should be intentionally soft/blurred and not photorealistic, like a personalized avatar placeholder. Behind the profile card is an atmospheric alien city at night with stars, glowing futuristic towers, moons/planets, warm rim lighting, and shallow depth of field.

The profile card should resemble a dark-mode 𝕏 profile interface, scaled like a monumental translucent tablet with rounded corners and glossy edges. At the top is a wide banner image showing a desert sci-fi ruin: a domed white stone building with arched openings, dusty mountains, clouds, and two visible celestial bodies. Add a circular avatar overlapping the banner on the left, matching the character’s orange headphone look with a blurred face. Include a small blue verified check beside the name and an “Edit profile” pill button on the right.

Visible profile text: name “Alexandra Aisling”, handle “@AllaAisling”, bio “AI Creator, redefining the boundaries of AI-generated art, exploring future worlds in writing and images. Adobe Firefly Ambassador.”, joined date “Joined April 2023”, stats “965 Following” and “52.2K Followers”. Include exactly one Communities card labeled “Art Odyssey” with the description “Connect and collaborate with like-minded AI creators, share knowledge and techniques, and inspire innovation in the AI art...” and “4.6K Members”. Include exactly seven navigation tabs: Posts, Replies, Subs, Highlights, Articles, Media, Likes, with Posts selected and underlined in blue. Include one pinned post by Alexandra Aisling with the opening text: “They called her Ghost Circuit. She is the last ronin who refused to surrender her mind to the city’s machine gods.” followed by “Three nights ago, she stole something buried beneath the megacity. Something powerful enough to wake systems that were meant to stay dead forever.” Show faint engagement icons and counts including 112, 243, 1.8K, and 53K.

On the platform, add exactly three foreground props: a small glass dome terrarium containing a miniature version of the same desert ruin on the left, a metallic potted plant on the right, and a glowing front nameplate reading {argument name="nameplate text" default="@AllaAisling"}. Use premium octane-render style, highly detailed materials, cinematic orange-blue lighting, realistic reflections, volumetric atmosphere, and sharp focus on the character and profile card. Keep the composition centered, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio, no extra people, no watermark, no unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张竖版电影级科幻 3D 渲染图，画面中心是一个巨大的透明玻璃质感 𝕏/Twitter 个人主页，垂直矗立在未来感十足的圆形展示平台上。在平台右下方，站着一个与该主页所有者对应的微型全身 3D 虚拟形象。该主页属于 {argument name="character name" default="Alexandra Aisling"}，账号为 {argument name="profile handle" default="@AllaAisling"}。虚拟形象是一位时尚的科幻探险家，拥有温暖的棕色皮肤、短卷发、橙色耳机/护目镜、红橙色工装连体裤、短款米色战术背心、手套以及厚底白橙色靴子，姿态自信，双臂自然下垂。面部应刻意处理得柔和/模糊，非写实风格，呈现出个性化虚拟形象占位符的效果。个人主页卡片后方是充满氛围感的夜间外星城市，背景中有星空、发光的未来感高塔、卫星/行星，配以温暖的轮廓光和浅景深效果。

个人主页卡片应呈现深色模式的 𝕏 界面，外观如同一个巨大的半透明平板，带有圆角和光泽边缘。顶部是宽幅横幅图片，展示沙漠科幻废墟：一座带有拱形开口的圆顶白色石建筑、尘土飞扬的山脉、云层以及两颗可见的天体。左侧横幅上方叠加一个圆形头像，头像中的角色佩戴与主体一致的橙色耳机，面部模糊。名字旁包含一个蓝色认证勾选图标，右侧设有一个“编辑个人资料”的胶囊按钮。

可见的个人主页文字：名称“Alexandra Aisling”，账号“@AllaAisling”，简介“AI 创作者，重新定义 AI 生成艺术的边界，通过文字和图像探索未来世界。Adobe Firefly 大使。”，加入时间“2023 年 4 月加入”，数据统计“965 个正在关注”和“5.22 万粉丝”。包含一个名为“Art Odyssey”的社区卡片，描述为“与志同道合的 AI 创作者建立联系并协作，分享知识与技巧，激发 AI 艺术创新……”，以及“4.6K 成员”。包含七个导航标签：帖子、回复、订阅、精选、文章、媒体、喜欢，其中“帖子”处于选中状态并带有蓝色下划线。包含一条由 Alexandra Aisling 置顶的帖子，开头文字为：“他们称她为‘幽灵回路’。她是最后一位拒绝将思想交给城市机械神的浪人。”，随后是“三天前，她偷走了一些埋藏在超级城市地下的东西。那东西强大到足以唤醒那些本应永远沉睡的系统。”显示模糊的互动图标及数据，包括 112、243、1.8K 和 53K。

在平台上添加三个前景道具：左侧是一个装有相同沙漠废墟微缩模型的玻璃圆顶生态瓶，右侧是一盆金属盆栽，以及一个发光的前置铭牌，上面写着 {argument name="nameplate text" default="@AllaAisling"}。采用高端 Octane 渲染风格，材质细节丰富，电影级橙蓝光影，逼真的反射效果，体积感氛围，并聚焦于角色和个人主页卡片。保持构图居中，竖版 2:3 比例，画面中无其他人物，无水印，无无关文字。

templates.title: Cinematic Olympus Myth Poster

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic mythological travel poster for {argument name="mythic landmark" default="Olympus"}, in a dark bronze and molten-gold color palette. The composition is symmetrical and epic: a small ancient Greek temple with columns sits at the exact lower center on a rocky mountaintop, backlit by an overwhelming radiant golden sun or divine portal. Long dramatic shadows stretch forward from the temple. Behind it, glowing concentric sacred-geometry circles, radial lines, and faint astrolabe-like rings expand across the sky, as if charting the heavens. Massive storm clouds frame both sides, lit from within by orange firelight, with distant dark mountain silhouettes on the horizon. The upper sky is a textured, smoky, scratched parchment-like darkness with faint circular celestial markings near the edges. Use high-contrast cinematic lighting, volumetric rays, mythic grandeur, antique poster texture, subtle grain, and a fantasy historical-world atmosphere. Include exactly 2 text elements: the large bottom title {argument name="main title" default="OLYMPUS"} in elegant wide-spaced Roman serif gold lettering with embossed metallic highlights, and a small centered italic tagline beneath it reading {argument name="tagline" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"}. Keep the typography crisp and centered, with no extra logos, no people, no modern objects, and no additional text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直的电影级神话旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="mythic landmark" default="奥林匹斯"}，采用深青铜色和熔金色的色调。构图对称且宏大：一座小型古希腊柱式神庙位于岩石山顶的正下方中心，被背后耀眼的金色太阳或神圣之门逆光照亮。长长的戏剧性阴影从神庙向前延伸。神庙后方，发光的同心神圣几何圆环、放射状线条和微弱的星盘状圆环在天空中扩散，仿佛在绘制天体图。巨大的风暴云团框住两侧，内部被橙色的火光照亮，地平线上隐约可见深色的山脉轮廓。天空上方呈现出带有纹理、烟熏且有划痕的羊皮纸般的暗色，边缘附近有微弱的圆形天体标记。运用高对比度的电影级灯光、体积光、神话般的宏伟感、复古海报纹理、细腻的颗粒感以及奇幻历史世界的氛围。包含 2 个文本元素：底部的大标题 {argument name="main title" default="OLYMPUS"}，采用优雅、宽间距的罗马衬线金色字体，并带有浮雕金属高光；下方居中放置一行小的斜体标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"}。保持排版清晰且居中，不要添加额外的徽标、人物、现代物品或其他文本。

templates.title: Night Beach Sparkler Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间海滩仙女棒快照

templates.prompt: Create a candid flash-photo style nighttime beach snapshot of an adult {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} crouching low on wet sand near the shoreline, barefoot, wearing a short white floral summer dress with pink flower pattern and thin straps. She is holding one lit handheld sparkler in her left hand close to the sand, producing a bright golden flare and star-shaped sparks that illuminate her hand and the lower-left foreground. Her right hand rests near her toes, knees bent, body angled three-quarters toward the camera. Her medium-length {argument name="hair color" default="brown"} hair is loose and slightly windblown. Cover the face completely with a centered solid beige rectangular blur/censor block, with no facial details visible. The background is a dark ocean at night with small waves rolling in, wet sand reflecting warm streetlights, and a long diagonal line of blurry yellow-white promenade lights receding into the distance along the shore. Use a grainy, imperfect disposable-camera aesthetic with direct flash on the subject, high ISO noise, slight motion blur, warm highlights, dark blue-black sky, and a vertical smartphone composition. No text, no watermark, no extra people, exactly one visible sparkler, exactly one crouching subject, exactly one beige face-obscuring rectangle.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张抓拍风格的夜间海滩闪光灯照片，画面主体为一名 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，她赤脚蹲在岸边湿润的沙滩上，身穿带有粉色花朵图案的白色细肩带短款夏季连衣裙。她的左手拿着一支点燃的仙女棒靠近沙滩，产生明亮的金色光晕和星形火花，照亮了她的手部和左下角前景。她的右手放在脚趾附近，双膝弯曲，身体呈四分之三侧面对着镜头。她中等长度的 {argument name="hair color" default="棕色"} 头发散乱，略带风吹感。用一个居中的纯米色矩形模糊/遮挡块完全遮住面部，不显示任何面部细节。背景是黑暗的夜间海洋，有小波浪涌入，湿润的沙滩反射着温暖的街灯，岸边有一条长长的、模糊的黄白色长廊灯光向远处延伸。采用颗粒感强、不完美的胶片相机美学，对主体使用直接闪光，高 ISO 噪点，轻微运动模糊，暖色高光，深蓝黑色天空，以及竖屏手机构图。无文字，无水印，无多余人物，仅可见一支仙女棒，仅一名蹲着的主体，仅一个遮挡面部的米色矩形。

templates.title: Cinematic Babylon Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感巴比伦海报

templates.prompt:
Create a vertical cinematic ancient-world poster for {argument name="city name" default="BABYLON"}. Use a dark emerald green and antique gold palette, with a mystical Mesopotamian atmosphere. The canvas is a tall 2:3 poster with a thin aged gold double-line border and subtle distressed parchment texture. At the top center, place a glowing golden crescent moon above the title. The background should contain faint circular astrological diagrams, barely visible cuneiform-like inscriptions, worn map markings, and grainy film texture.

Typography: Set the main title as huge uppercase serif letters reading {argument name="headline text" default="BABYLON"}, centered across the upper third, pale oxidized gold with weathered texture. The title has wide tracking, sharp classical letterforms, and a small star-like diamond detail inside the letter O. Under the title, add one centered subtitle line in small elegant serif type reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"}. Place a tiny decorative diamond ornament between the title and subtitle.

Main subject: In the lower half, depict a monumental ancient Babylonian ziggurat and palace complex rising from darkness, symmetrical and imposing, with stacked terraces, towers, arched gates, long staircases, crenellated walls, and small palm trees on the terraces. The city is lit from behind by a green-gold atmospheric glow, creating a dramatic silhouette and misty depth. In the foreground, show a dark river reflecting faint green light, with shadowy palm trees framing both sides.

Visible discrete elements to include: 1 crescent moon, 1 main title, 1 subtitle line, 1 small central diamond ornament, 1 enormous ziggurat-city complex, 2 prominent foreground palm silhouettes on the left and right, 1 reflective river foreground, and 1 small winged emblem centered at the bottom border.

Style: premium cinematic poster design, ancient history fantasy, lost empire aesthetic, occult astronomy, moody lighting, fine-grain texture, worn gold ink on dark green, high contrast, majestic scale, no modern objects except the subtitle text, no people, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张竖版电影感古文明海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="BABYLON"}。使用深祖母绿和古金色调，营造神秘的古代美索不达米亚氛围。画布为 2:3 的长海报比例，带有细长的仿古金双线边框和细腻的做旧羊皮纸纹理。在顶部中央，放置一个发光的金色新月，位于标题上方。背景应包含隐约可见的圆形占星图、模糊的楔形文字、磨损的地图标记以及颗粒感胶片质感。

排版：主标题设为巨大的大写衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="BABYLON"}，居中置于上三分之一处，采用氧化金配色并带有风化质感。标题字间距较宽，字形古典锐利，字母 O 内部带有一个微小的星形钻石细节。在标题下方，添加一行居中的小号优雅衬线字体副标题，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"}。在标题和副标题之间放置一个微小的装饰性钻石饰物。

主体：在下半部分，描绘一座宏伟的古巴比伦塔庙和宫殿建筑群，从黑暗中升起，对称且庄严，具有层叠的露台、塔楼、拱门、长阶梯、城垛以及露台上的小型棕榈树。城市被背后的绿金色大气光晕照亮，营造出戏剧性的剪影和朦胧的纵深感。前景展示一条暗河，反射着微弱的绿光，两侧由阴影中的棕榈树勾勒轮廓。

可见的独立元素包括：1 个新月，1 个主标题，1 行副标题，1 个小型中央钻石饰物，1 座巨大的塔庙城市建筑群，左右两侧各 1 棵醒目的前景棕榈树剪影，1 条前景反射河流，以及底部边框中央的 1 个小型带翼徽章。

风格：高级电影海报设计，古代历史奇幻，失落帝国美学，神秘天文学，情绪化灯光，精细颗粒质感，深绿色背景上的磨损金墨，高对比度，宏伟尺度，除副标题文字外无现代物体，无人像，无水印。

templates.title: 16-Bit RPG Battle Screen

titleLocalized.zh: 16 位元 RPG 战斗画面

templates.prompt:
Using the provided reference image as the character source, transform the character into a 16-bit command RPG battle screen in pixel-art style. Keep the original character’s outfit, long blond hair, general silhouette, and faceless/blurred face treatment, but redraw her as a playable battle sprite standing on the left side in a ready-to-fight pose.

Goal: Create a retro Japanese fantasy RPG combat scene, like a Super Famicom / 16-bit era command battle screen.

Scene additions: Add an ancient ruined stone arena background with broken arches, columns, moss, vines, scattered machinery, and atmospheric depth. Place exactly 2 enemy monsters on the right side: 1 tall plant/serpent-like mechanical monster with glowing blue orbs, and 1 smaller spider-like mechanical creature with cyan energy rings.

UI layout: Add exactly 3 dark navy RPG interface boxes with thin white borders: 1 command menu in the upper left, 1 character status box near the lower center-left, and 1 dialogue box across the bottom.

Text: The command menu must contain exactly 4 Japanese options in vertical order: 「たたかう」, 「まほう」, 「アイテム」, 「にげる」, with a triangular cursor pointing to the first option. The status box should show {argument name="character name" default="フミ姐ぇ"}, LV 35, HP 320/320, and MP 150/150. The bottom dialogue box should show {argument name="battle line" default="さっさと片付けるわよ"}.

Style constraints: Use crisp 16-bit pixel art, limited color palette, visible pixel edges, side-view RPG composition, no modern UI, no photorealism, no extra characters, no extra menu items, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图像作为角色来源，将其转换为 16 位元像素风格的指令式 RPG 战斗画面。保留原角色的服装、金色长发、整体轮廓以及无脸/模糊面部的处理方式，但将其重绘为站在左侧、处于战斗准备姿态的可操作战斗精灵。

目标：创作一个复古日式奇幻 RPG 战斗场景，类似于超级任天堂 (Super Famicom) / 16 位元时代的指令式战斗画面。

场景添加：添加一个古老的废墟石制竞技场背景，包含破损的拱门、柱子、苔藓、藤蔓、散落的机械装置以及大气深度感。在右侧放置 2 个怪物：1 个带有发光蓝色球体的高大植物/蛇形机械怪物，以及 1 个带有青色能量环的小型蜘蛛状机械生物。

UI 布局：添加 3 个带有细白边框的深蓝色 RPG 界面框：左上角 1 个指令菜单，左下方附近 1 个角色状态框，底部 1 个对话框。

文本：指令菜单必须包含 4 个垂直排列的日文选项：「たたかう」、「まほう」、「アイテム」、「にげる」，并带有一个指向第一个选项的三角形光标。状态框应显示 {argument name="character name" default="フミ姐ぇ"}、LV 35、HP 320/320 以及 MP 150/150。底部对话框应显示 {argument name="battle line" default="さっさと片付けるわよ"}。

风格限制：使用清晰的 16 位元像素艺术、有限的调色板、可见的像素边缘、侧视 RPG 构图，禁止使用现代 UI、禁止写实风格、禁止添加额外角色、禁止添加额外菜单项、禁止添加水印。

templates.title: Cute Shanghai Chibi Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的上海 Q 版旅行海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cute chibi travel-blogger poster themed around {argument name="city name" default="Shanghai"}, with adorable miniature travelers exploring a giant 3D Chinese-character city title as the visual centerpiece.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, bright dreamy sky-blue background with fluffy clouds, scrapbook travel-journal collage aesthetic, warm pastel lighting, highly detailed but soft and cute.

Main layout: Place enormous glossy 3D sculptural Chinese characters spelling {argument name="large city text" default="上海"} in the center, occupying most of the poster. The characters should be cream-colored with metallic beveled edges, rounded corners, and deep inset windows. Inside the strokes of the characters, show vivid miniature cityscape scenes: Shanghai skyline, the Oriental Pearl Tower, skyscrapers, waterfront night views, historic Bund architecture, Nanjing Road neon signs, boats on the river, and warm sunset-to-night lighting. The 3D text should feel like a walkable miniature city installation.

Characters: Include exactly 5 cute Japanese-style chibi travel bloggers, all with soft round faces, tiny bodies, beige travel outfits, bucket hats or caps, backpacks, and camera/travel accessories. Count and place them as follows: 1 small seated traveler with a camera on the upper-left ledge near the Oriental Pearl Tower; 1 walking traveler on the upper-right holding a folded map; 1 standing traveler in the center lower area on the 3D text, like a tiny explorer; 1 larger traveler at the bottom-left foreground holding a camera while walking; 1 traveler at the lower-right sitting or leaning with an orange suitcase. Their faces may be simplified or softly obscured, but the poses must remain expressive and travel-blogger-like.

Travel collage details: Add exactly 10 prominent paper and stamp elements around the central city text: 1 vintage postcard stamp in the top-left reading “SHANGHAI” with smaller Chinese/Shanghai travel markings; 1 circular airplane passport stamp overlapping it; 1 handwritten title at the top center with Chinese text “旅行日志” and English text “Travel Diary”; 1 taped note in the top-right with Chinese handwritten romantic travel text and a doodled heart; 1 black vintage camera sticker near the note; 1 circular Shanghai passport stamp at upper-right reading “SHANGHAI / 上海 / 20.24.05.20”; 1 “I ♥ SH” sticker on the right; 1 boarding-pass ticket at the bottom-left with PVG, gate, seat, and Shanghai details; 1 small red luggage-label sign at the bottom center reading “上海 / SHANGHAI”; 1 postcard at the bottom-right reading “SHANGHAI / The City / That Holds / All My Dreams” with a small skyline photo.

Left-side itinerary text: Add a handwritten checklist on the left with exactly 6 destination bullets: 东方明珠, 外滩, 南京路步行街, 田子坊, 武康大楼, 迪士尼乐园. Include dotted route arrows and a small phrase “Have a nice trip!” nearby.

Bottom caption: Handwrite a short Chinese travel note near the bottom center: “下一站，上海 遇见更好的自己”, with tiny smiley doodles and stamp marks.

Visual style: Japanese soft-cute Q-version illustration mixed with polished 3D typography and travel scrapbook collage; pastel colors, creamy highlights, sparkling city reflections, small petals/leaves, decorative tape, paper textures, soft shadows, cinematic fantasy realism, extremely charming and detailed.

Constraints: Keep the huge 3D city text readable as 上海, make the city landmarks recognizable, use exactly 5 chibi travelers, preserve the listed English and Chinese visible text, avoid logos or watermarks, no extra main characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张以 {argument name="city name" default="上海"} 为主题的可爱 Q 版旅行博主海报，以巨大的 3D 中文字体作为视觉中心，展示可爱的迷你旅行者在其中探索。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，明亮梦幻的天蓝色背景配以蓬松云朵，剪贴簿旅行日志拼贴美学，温暖的柔和光影，细节丰富且风格柔和可爱。

主体布局：在中心放置巨大的光泽感 3D 雕塑中文字符 {argument name="large city text" default="上海"}，占据海报大部分空间。字符应为奶油色，带有金属斜面边缘、圆角和深陷的窗户。在字符的笔画内部，展示生动的微缩城市景观：上海天际线、东方明珠塔、摩天大楼、滨江夜景、外滩历史建筑、南京路霓虹灯、江上船只，以及从日落到夜晚的温暖光影。3D 文字应呈现出一种可供行走的微缩城市装置感。

角色：包含 5 位可爱的日系 Q 版旅行博主，均拥有圆润的脸庞、娇小的身躯、米色旅行装束、渔夫帽或鸭舌帽、背包以及相机/旅行配件。请按以下方式布置：1 位坐在左上方东方明珠塔附近边缘的小型旅行者，手持相机；1 位在右上方行走，手持折叠地图；1 位站在中心下方 3D 文字上的旅行者，如同小小探险家；1 位在左下方前景处，边走边拿着相机；1 位在右下方，坐着或倚靠着一个橙色行李箱。他们的面部可以简化或柔化处理，但姿势必须保持生动且具有旅行博主的风格。

旅行拼贴细节：在中心城市文字周围添加 10 个醒目的纸张和邮戳元素：左上方 1 枚复古明信片邮戳，写有“SHANGHAI”及较小的中文/上海旅行标记；1 枚重叠的圆形飞机护照邮戳；顶部中心 1 个手写标题，包含中文“旅行日志”和英文“Travel Diary”；右上角 1 张贴着的便签，写有中文手写浪漫旅行文字及涂鸦爱心；便签附近 1 个黑色复古相机贴纸；右上角 1 枚圆形上海护照邮戳，写有“SHANGHAI / 上海 / 20.24.05.20”；右侧 1 个“I ♥ SH”贴纸；左下方 1 张登机牌，包含 PVG、登机口、座位及上海相关信息；底部中心 1 个红色小行李标签，写有“上海 / SHANGHAI”；右下方 1 张明信片，写有“SHANGHAI / The City / That Holds / All My Dreams”并配有一张小型天际线照片。

左侧行程文字：在左侧添加一个手写清单，包含 6 个目的地要点：东方明珠、外滩、南京路步行街、田子坊、武康大楼、迪士尼乐园。包含虚线路线箭头及附近的小短语“Have a nice trip!”。

底部说明：在底部中心附近手写一段简短的中文旅行笔记：“下一站，上海 遇见更好的自己”，并配有微小的笑脸涂鸦和邮戳痕迹。

视觉风格：日系软萌 Q 版插画与精致 3D 字体及旅行剪贴簿拼贴相结合；柔和的色彩、奶油色高光、闪烁的城市倒影、小花瓣/叶片、装饰胶带、纸张纹理、柔和阴影、电影感奇幻写实，极具魅力且细节丰富。

约束：保持巨大的 3D 城市文字“上海”清晰可辨，使城市地标易于识别，使用 5 位 Q 版旅行者，保留列出的可见英文和中文文本，避免出现 Logo 或水印，不要添加额外的主角。

templates.title: Cinematic Alexandria Lighthouse Poster

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic historical travel poster for {argument name="ancient city" default="Alexandria"}, showing the Lighthouse of Alexandria as a monumental ancient stone tower on a harbor at sunset. The composition is portrait 2:3, with the lighthouse placed slightly right of center, rising from a fortified waterfront base, topped by a domed lantern room and a small statue. A brilliant golden beam of light projects diagonally from the lantern toward the upper left sky, cutting through smoky clouds and atmospheric dust. The foreground shows calm harbor water reflecting orange sunlight, with a rocky shoreline and ancient docks. Include exactly 5 visible distant harbor elements: 1 sailboat on the left water, 2 tall classical columns near the horizon, 1 small low building near the lighthouse base, and 1 faint city skyline silhouette on the far right. Use a mythic ancient-world mood, warm copper, amber, rose, and deep violet tones, painterly realism, epic scale, soft haze, volumetric light, subtle film grain, and aged parchment texture. Add an elegant thin double-line ornamental border around all four edges, with tiny corner flourishes, plus exactly 1 small decorative emblem panel in the upper-right corner. Typography: place the large title {argument name="poster title" default="ALEXANDRIA"} across the bottom in widely spaced classical Roman serif capitals, cream-gold color, with a subtle shadow; beneath it add a thin horizontal divider with a small diamond ornament at the center; below that place the tagline {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORE WITH VISIONARIA — FIRST CINEMATIC IMAGINATION APP"} in small uppercase sans serif lettering. Make it look like a premium cinematic poster for a lost ancient metropolis, not a modern photograph. Avoid people in the foreground, avoid modern objects, avoid extra logos or watermarks, and keep all visible text limited to the title and tagline.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高端方形 3D 时尚产品展示，在简洁的悬浮奢华构图中呈现 9 件核心时尚单品：左侧 1 顶黑色棒球帽，2 双黑米色拼色厚底奢华运动鞋（置于错落的石质底座上），1 件带有金色饰边及数字 10 的黑色足球衣，1 件带有黑金饰边及数字 7 的白色足球衣，中心悬浮 1 只金属黑金腕表，1 副带有米色/金色镜框的黑色太阳镜（置于大理石圆柱上），左下方 1 只带有垂直米金色条纹的黑色皮革旅行袋，右侧 1 只黑米色结构感设计师双肩包，以及右下方 1 双置于黑色圆柱底座上的抛光黑色正装皮鞋。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="哑光黑、暖金、奶油米色、白色和炭灰色"}，并呈现逼真的皮革、织物、金属、橡胶和大理石纹理。将物品以不同高度排列在黑色大理石、白色大理石和深色石材圆柱底座上，部分物品呈现失重悬浮感。背景：深炭灰色摄影棚墙面，球衣后方带有柔和发光的金色半圆拱门，辅以暖色轮廓光、光泽反射、柔和阴影，以及包括 3 个金球和 3 个小型金多面体在内的悬浮装饰性几何元素。风格：高端产品广告渲染、照片级 3D、电影级布光、清晰对焦、奢华精品店陈列、对称且充满动感的构图。通过 {argument name="black jersey number" default="10"} 和 {argument name="white jersey number" default="7"} 自定义球衣文字细节；包含小型徽章状装饰和星形细节，但不要出现可辨认的品牌名称或 Logo。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="1:1 正方形"}。

templates.title: Bitter Melon Lemon Soda Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 苦瓜柠檬气泡水海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Chinese beverage launch poster for a restaurant drink, centered on a highly realistic glass of {argument name="drink name" default="苦瓜柠檬气泡水"} with fresh ingredients, sales points, price, and ordering call-to-action.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 food advertising poster, warm off-white/beige background, clean premium restaurant menu style, high-resolution commercial photography mixed with neat infographic labels. Use soft sunlight, dewy freshness, crisp bubbles, and appetizing realism.

Top brand area: At the very top center place a small cute green lion mascot logo, then the brand name “凉兽”, and the slogan “苦都苦得很快乐”. Add a thin decorative divider underneath.

Main headline: Large bold dark-brown Chinese title centered: “苦瓜柠檬气泡水”. Add small orange decorative burst marks near the title. Under it place the subtitle “手摇蔬果气泡饮” with small green leaf ornaments on both sides.

Central product hero: Place one tall transparent glass in the center, filled with sparkling pale yellow-green soda, many visible carbonation bubbles, large ice cubes, sliced bitter melon rounds, lemon slices, and a rosemary sprig sticking out of the top. The glass should look cold, wet, and refreshing with condensation and reflections. Add loose droplets on the tabletop.

Left ingredient section: Title “成分亮点”. Show exactly 4 ingredient items stacked vertically with small photoreal ingredient illustrations and dotted curved arrows pointing toward the glass: 1) bitter melon illustration labeled “新鲜苦瓜” with subtext “去白瓤，只取翠绿层”; 2) lemon illustration labeled “香水柠檬” with subtext “手压取皮油”; 3) bubble icon labeled “苏打气泡” with subtext “2.8倍含气量”; 4) rock sugar illustration labeled “原蔗冰糖” with subtext “不抢苦味”.

Right selling-points section: Title “产品卖点”. Show exactly 4 rounded white cards stacked vertically, each with a circular icon on the left and Chinese text on the right: 1) green heart icon, “先苦后爽” / “不涩不假甜”; 2) green lemon icon, “VC炸弹” / “一杯≈3颗柠檬”; 3) orange flame icon, “0脂解辣” / “火锅绝配”; 4) green snowflake icon, “冰爽质感” / “一秒降温”.

Bottom price and CTA: At bottom left, use a black brush-stroke price badge with small English “PRICE”, huge white “{argument name="price" default="19"}”, and “元 / 杯”. At bottom right, add a large rounded green button with dark text “自讨苦吃”. Separate price and button with a thin vertical line. Add a halved lemon and rosemary sprig near the bottom right foreground. Include subtle blurred green leaves at the bottom left foreground for depth.

Footer: Along the very bottom add small app/platform icons and text: “抖音 / 小红书 / 美团 / 大众点评  搜索：凉兽”.

Visual style: Fresh lemon-green and dark-brown palette, premium Chinese food poster layout, realistic food textures, sharp condensation, sparkling soda bubbles, clean typography, balanced negative space, no watermark, no extra products, no people.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为餐厅饮品制作一张竖版中式新品发布海报，以一杯高度逼真的 {argument name="drink name" default="苦瓜柠檬气泡水"} 为核心，搭配新鲜食材、卖点、价格及下单引导。

画布：3:4 竖版美食广告海报，暖米白色/米色背景，简洁的高端餐厅菜单风格，商业摄影级高分辨率图像与整洁的信息图表标签相结合。运用柔和的阳光、清新的露珠、清脆的气泡以及令人垂涎的真实感。

顶部品牌区：在顶部正中央放置一个可爱的小绿色狮子吉祥物 Logo，随后是品牌名“凉兽”及口号“苦都苦得很快乐”。下方添加一条细装饰分割线。

主标题：居中放置醒目的深棕色大号中文字体：“苦瓜柠檬气泡水”。标题旁添加橙色装饰性爆炸贴。下方放置副标题“手摇蔬果气泡饮”，两侧点缀小绿叶装饰。

核心产品展示：中央放置一个高透明玻璃杯，杯中盛满淡黄绿色苏打水，可见大量碳酸气泡、大块冰块、苦瓜圈、柠檬片，顶部插有一枝迷迭香。玻璃杯需呈现出冰凉、湿润、清爽的质感，带有冷凝水珠和倒影。桌面散落水滴。

左侧成分区：标题“成分亮点”。垂直排列 4 项成分，配以逼真的成分插图，并有虚线弧形箭头指向玻璃杯：1) 苦瓜插图，标注“新鲜苦瓜”，副标题“去白瓤，只取翠绿层”；2) 柠檬插图，标注“香水柠檬”，副标题“手压取皮油”；3) 气泡图标，标注“苏打气泡”，副标题“2.8倍含气量”；4) 冰糖插图，标注“原蔗冰糖”，副标题“不抢苦味”。

右侧卖点区：标题“产品卖点”。垂直堆叠 4 张圆角白色卡片，每张卡片左侧为圆形图标，右侧为中文文本：1) 绿色爱心图标，“先苦后爽” / “不涩不假甜”；2) 绿色柠檬图标，“VC炸弹” / “一杯≈3颗柠檬”；3) 橙色火焰图标，“0脂解辣” / “火锅绝配”；4) 绿色雪花图标，“冰爽质感” / “一秒降温”。

底部价格与 CTA：左下角使用黑色笔触风格的价格标签，包含小号英文“PRICE”、醒目的白色“{argument name="price" default="19"}”及“元 / 杯”。右下角添加一个大型圆角绿色按钮，内含深色文字“自讨苦吃”。价格与按钮之间用细竖线分隔。右下角前景放置半个柠檬和迷迭香枝。左下角前景添加模糊的绿叶以增加空间深度。

页脚：最底部添加小型 App/平台图标及文字：“抖音 / 小红书 / 美团 / 大众点评 搜索：凉兽”。

视觉风格：清新的柠檬绿与深棕色调，高端中式美食海报排版，逼真的食物质感，清晰的冷凝水珠，气泡感十足，排版整洁，留白平衡，无水印，无额外产品，无人物。

templates.title: Ronaldo Comic Poster Bedroom Scene

titleLocalized.zh: C 罗漫画海报卧室场景

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical bedroom scene, 9:16 aspect ratio, showing a life-size soccer superstar in Portugal’s red-and-green number 7 uniform bursting out of a giant comic-book poster in a teenager’s room. The poster is leaning against a graffiti-covered wall and reads “CRISTIANO RONALDO: Lenda Viva” in large retro comic lettering, with an old trading-card style strip on the left labeled “ABE” and “5022.” The player’s face should be intentionally obscured with a soft square blur, while his body is sharply rendered in dynamic mid-run pose, one hand raised, dramatic golden backlight exploding from the torn poster opening. The poster art contains exactly 6 visible comic panels: a Portugal flag panel, a stadium panel, a pitch panel, a crowd/stadium panel, a red-and-green abstract soccer panel, and a lower action/comic panel; add flying torn paper shards around the figure. The room should feel like a messy fan bedroom at dusk with warm string lights along the ceiling, moody blue-orange lighting, graffiti tags on the walls, and sports memorabilia everywhere. Include exactly 5 wall posters outside the giant comic poster: one soccer player poster on the left wall, one soccer player poster above the dresser, one black-and-white band poster reading “BAND BAN” on the right wall, one smaller soccer action poster, and one Portugal flag poster. Include exactly 3 game controllers on the floor, 1 smartphone showing a soccer-themed image, 1 gold trophy cup and 1 smaller gold trophy on the dresser, 1 desk lamp glowing on the left desk, 2 beds or low sleeping areas with rumpled blankets, 1 pair of red sneakers near the right bed, and scattered Portugal jerseys and clothing on the wooden floor. Style: highly detailed 3D digital illustration with photorealistic room lighting, comic-book poster graphics, saturated reds and greens, dramatic volumetric glow, cozy clutter, realistic fabric folds, sharp depth of field, no watermark, no extra readable text beyond the specified poster lettering. Use {argument name="footballer name" default="CRISTIANO RONALDO"}, {argument name="subtitle text" default="Lenda Viva"}, {argument name="team colors" default="Portugal red and green"}, {argument name="room theme" default="teenage soccer fan bedroom"}, and {argument name="poster genre" default="retro comic-book superhero sports poster"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影感十足的竖版卧室场景，比例为 9:16，展示一位真人大小的足球巨星身穿葡萄牙红绿色 7 号球衣，从青少年房间里的一张巨大漫画海报中破壁而出。海报靠在涂鸦墙上，上面用醒目的复古漫画字体写着“CRISTIANO RONALDO: Lenda Viva”，左侧带有旧式球星卡风格的条带，标注为“ABE”和“5022”。球员面部应刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理，而身体则以动态奔跑姿势呈现，细节清晰，一只手抬起，戏剧性的金色背光从撕裂的海报开口处喷薄而出。海报艺术包含 6 个清晰可见的漫画分镜：一个葡萄牙国旗分镜、一个体育场分镜、一个球场分镜、一个观众/体育场分镜、一个红绿色抽象足球分镜，以及一个下方的动作/漫画分镜；在人物周围添加飞舞的碎纸片。房间应营造出黄昏时分凌乱的粉丝卧室氛围，天花板上挂着温暖的串灯，光影呈现忧郁的蓝橙色调，墙上有涂鸦标签，到处都是体育纪念品。在巨大的漫画海报外，需包含 5 张墙面海报：左墙一张足球运动员海报，梳妆台上方一张足球运动员海报，右墙一张写有“BAND BAN”的黑白乐队海报，一张较小的足球动作海报，以及一张葡萄牙国旗海报。地板上放置 3 个游戏手柄，1 部显示足球主题图像的智能手机，梳妆台上放置 1 个金奖杯和 1 个较小的金奖杯，左侧书桌上有一盏发光的台灯，2 张床或低矮的睡眠区铺着褶皱的毯子，右侧床边有一双红色运动鞋，木地板上散落着葡萄牙球衣和衣物。风格：高度精细的 3D 数字插画，具有照片级的室内光影、漫画海报图形、饱和的红绿色调、戏剧性的体积光、温馨的杂乱感、逼真的织物褶皱、清晰的景深，无水印，除指定的漫画海报文字外无其他可读文字。使用 {argument name="footballer name" default="CRISTIANO RONALDO"}、{argument name="subtitle text" default="Lenda Viva"}、{argument name="team colors" default="葡萄牙红绿色"}、{argument name="room theme" default="青少年足球迷卧室"} 以及 {argument name="poster genre" default="复古漫画超级英雄体育海报"}。

templates.title: Chinese Sour Fish Restaurant Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 中式酸菜鱼餐厅海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Chinese restaurant new-product poster for {argument name="dish name" default="老坛酸菜鱼"}, emphasizing appetite appeal, real food texture, ingredients, selling points, and a clear price/order call-to-action.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, warm off-white rice-paper background with subtle fibers, faint ink-wash mountains along the bottom edge, premium Chinese dining advertisement style.

Top branding: Centered circular logo showing a simple fish over wave lines. Under it place the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="渔堂白"} and the tagline 「酸爽有骨气」. Add a huge black brush-calligraphy headline 「老坛酸菜鱼」 across the upper third, with small orange splash marks on both sides.

Main visual: In the center, show one large steaming ceramic bowl of golden sour pickled-cabbage fish soup. The bowl has blue-gray Chinese landscape patterning. The soup is glossy yellow-gold with visible chopped pickled greens, tender white fish slices, red dried chilies, green Sichuan peppercorns, yellow ginger strips, sesame-like spices, and rising steam. Keep the food photorealistic and highly appetizing while the poster graphics remain elegant and clean.

Central label: Above the bowl, place an ornate rounded rectangular label with gold text 「金汤酸菜鱼」 and a thin decorative border.

Left ingredient column: Title 「精选食材」. Show exactly 4 ingredient items stacked vertically, each with a small circular food photo and text: 1) 「鲜鱼片」 with subtext 「活鱼现切，嫩而不散」, 2) 「老坛酸菜」 with subtext 「发酵90天，酸脆回味」, 3) 「猪骨高汤」 with subtext 「8小时慢熬」, 4) 「红灯笼椒+青花椒」 with subtext 「一辣一麻」. Connect the 4 items with a thin dotted vertical orange line.

Right selling-point column: Title 「产品亮点」. Show exactly 4 rounded white cards stacked vertically, each with one simple orange/green icon and text: 1) fish icon, 「当鱼现杀」 and 「每片都带皮」, 2) droplet icon, 「减盐25%」 and 「喝汤不口干」, 3) jar icon, 「川式老坛」 and 「自然发酵无添加」, 4) rice bowl icon, 「下饭神器」 and 「一鱼三碗饭」.

Price and CTA: Below the bowl, paint a wide dark brown brush-stroke swash. Over it place a large white hand-painted price {argument name="price" default="49"}, followed by 「元 / 份」. Beneath, add a glossy orange rounded button with white text {argument name="call to action" default="酸爽下单"} and a small right-arrow circle.

Footer: Add small text 「更多优惠活动 | 搜索 渔堂白」. Under it, place exactly 4 small circular platform icons/labels: Douyin-style music note, 「小红书」, 「美团」, and a simple person/share icon.

Visual style: High-end Chinese food poster, realistic steaming dish photography blended with brush-calligraphy typography, warm cream/gold/orange/brown palette, clean symmetrical layout, strong depth and shine on the soup, no clutter, no extra dishes or extra text beyond the specified elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="dish name" default="老坛酸菜鱼"} 创建一张竖版中式餐厅新品海报，强调食欲感、真实的食物质感、食材、卖点以及清晰的价格与下单引导。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，采用带有细微纤维的暖米白色宣纸背景，底部边缘带有淡淡的水墨山水，呈现高端中式餐饮广告风格。

顶部品牌：居中放置圆形 Logo，图案为简单的鱼与波浪线。下方放置品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="渔堂白"} 及标语「酸爽有骨气」。在上部三分之一处横跨巨大的黑色书法标题「老坛酸菜鱼」，两侧带有橙色的小泼墨点缀。

主视觉：中心展示一碗冒着热气的金汤酸菜鱼，盛装在带有蓝灰色山水纹样的陶瓷碗中。汤底呈现光泽的亮黄色，可见切碎的酸菜、鲜嫩的白鱼片、红干辣椒、青花椒、黄姜丝、芝麻状香料以及升腾的热气。保持食物的写实感与高食欲感，同时海报图形保持优雅整洁。

中央标签：在碗上方放置一个华丽的圆角矩形标签，内含金色文字「金汤酸菜鱼」及细边装饰。

左侧食材栏：标题「精选食材」。垂直堆叠展示 4 种食材，每项配有小圆形食物照片及文字：1) 「鲜鱼片」配副标题「活鱼现切，嫩而不散」，2) 「老坛酸菜」配副标题「发酵 90 天，酸脆回味」，3) 「猪骨高汤」配副标题「8 小时慢熬」，4) 「红灯笼椒+青花椒」配副标题「一辣一麻」。用一条细橙色虚线将 4 项内容连接。

右侧卖点栏：标题「产品亮点」。垂直堆叠展示 4 张圆角白色卡片，每张配有一个简单的橙色/绿色图标及文字：1) 鱼图标，「当鱼现杀」及「每片都带皮」，2) 水滴图标，「减盐 25%」及「喝汤不口干」，3) 坛子图标，「川式老坛」及「自然发酵无添加」，4) 饭碗图标，「下饭神器」及「一鱼三碗饭」。

价格与 CTA：在碗下方绘制一道宽大的深棕色毛笔刷痕。上方放置手写风格的大号白色价格 {argument name="price" default="49"}，后接「元 / 份」。下方添加一个带有白色文字 {argument name="call to action" default="酸爽下单"} 的亮橙色圆角按钮，并配有一个带右箭头的圆形图标。

页脚：添加小字「更多优惠活动 | 搜索 渔堂白」。下方放置 4 个小型圆形平台图标/标签：抖音风格音符、「小红书」、「美团」以及一个简单的人像/分享图标。

视觉风格：高端中式美食海报，写实的冒热气菜品摄影与书法字体相结合，采用暖奶油色/金色/橙色/棕色调，布局对称整洁，汤底质感强且有光泽，画面无杂乱，除指定元素外不添加额外菜品或文字。

templates.title: Mango Coconut Dessert Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 芒果椰子甜品海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Chinese food-and-beverage launch poster for {argument name="product name" default="杨枝甘露厚椰乳碗"}, advertising a refreshing iced dessert bowl with realistic appetizing texture, ingredients, selling points, and price.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 poster, warm cream-beige background with soft tropical sunlight, faint palm-leaf shadows in the upper right, a blurred lemon drink on the upper left, scattered fruit props at the bottom corners, premium dessert-shop advertising style.

Layout: Centered composition. At the top place a coconut brand logo icon and the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="椰殿"}, with the small tagline “甜得有层次” beneath it and thin decorative divider lines. Below, use a large dark-brown Chinese headline “杨枝甘露厚椰乳碗”. Under the headline add a rounded golden pill label reading “冰镇甜品碗” with a small bowl icon and snowflake icon. The middle is dominated by a transparent glass bowl filled with mango-yellow puree, thick coconut milk, translucent pearls, pink grapefruit pulp, and glossy mango cubes. A gold spoon enters from the upper right, lifting mango cubes, pearls, grapefruit, and dripping coconut milk. Add mint leaves on top for freshness.

Main food details: Make the dessert hyper-realistic and glossy: exactly 5 visible ingredient types in the bowl — mango cubes, thick coconut milk, pink grapefruit pulp, translucent boba pearls, and mint leaves. Show chunky mango pieces piled high, creamy white coconut layer around the rim, orange mango puree at the base, and condensation/fresh chilled feeling.

Left sidebar: A rounded vertical cream card titled “成分亮点” with exactly 4 stacked ingredient highlights, each with a small realistic ingredient illustration and Chinese text: 1) mango illustration, “爱文芒果 / 不打泥，保留果肉”; 2) coconut illustration, “泰国椰乳 / 椰肉现榨”; 3) grapefruit illustration, “红西柚粒 / 爆汁微苦”; 4) pearl illustration, “脆波波 / 无香精”.

Right sidebar: A rounded vertical cream card titled “产品卖点” with exactly 4 stacked circular line icons and Chinese text: 1) mango icon, “半斤芒果 / 一碗顶一杯”; 2) coconut icon, “椰乳代替淡奶 / 更轻更滑”; 3) snowflake icon, “冰碗出品 / 从第一口冷到最后”; 4) droplet icon, “不加一滴水 / 纯果 + 椰乳”.

Price and call to action: Under the bowl place a brown brush-stroke price band with the small label “价格” above a huge white price {argument name="price" default="32元 / 碗"}. Below it place a rounded white-and-gold CTA button with a spoon icon and the text {argument name="call to action" default="挖一勺夏天"}.

Bottom area: Add a thin divider line and small Chinese copy “更多新品与门店动态，可在以下平台搜索”. Show exactly 4 platform icons in a row: Douyin/TikTok, Xiaohongshu, Meituan, and Dianping-style orange icon. At the very bottom add a rounded search bar reading “搜索：椰殿”.

Visual style: Premium Chinese dessert poster, bright mango-yellow and coconut-white palette, dark chocolate-brown typography, gold accents, clean commercial layout, realistic food photography blended with polished graphic design, high contrast, sharp details, mouthwatering wet highlights, soft shadows, no people.

Constraints: Keep all Chinese text legible and correctly placed. Use exactly 2 side information cards, exactly 8 total sidebar feature items, exactly 4 bottom platform icons, and one central dessert bowl. Do not add extra prices, extra products, watermarks, QR codes, or unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="product name" default="杨枝甘露厚椰乳碗"} 创建一张竖版中式餐饮推广海报，宣传一款口感清爽的冰镇甜品碗，要求展现逼真诱人的质感、配料、卖点及价格。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，暖奶油米色背景，带有柔和的热带阳光感，右上角有淡淡的棕榈叶阴影，左上角有一杯模糊的柠檬饮品，底部角落散落着水果道具，呈现高端甜品店的广告风格。

布局：居中构图。顶部放置椰子品牌 Logo 图标及品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="椰殿"}，下方配有小字标语“甜得有层次”及纤细的装饰分割线。下方使用深棕色大号中文字体标题“杨枝甘露厚椰乳碗”。标题下方添加一个圆角金色胶囊标签，内含“冰镇甜品碗”字样，并配有小碗图标和雪花图标。画面中心主体为一个透明玻璃碗，盛满芒果黄果泥、浓郁椰乳、晶莹剔透的波波、红西柚果粒及光泽诱人的芒果丁。一把金勺从右上角伸入，舀起芒果丁、波波、西柚及滴落的椰乳。顶部点缀薄荷叶以增加新鲜感。

食物细节：确保甜品超写实且富有光泽：碗中清晰可见 5 种配料——芒果丁、浓郁椰乳、红西柚果粒、晶莹波波及薄荷叶。展示堆叠的高耸芒果块、碗缘的奶油白椰乳层、底部的橙色芒果泥，以及冷凝水珠带来的清凉感。

左侧边栏：一个圆角竖向奶油色卡片，标题为“成分亮点”，包含 4 个垂直排列的配料亮点，每个配料配有写实插图及中文说明：1) 芒果插图，“爱文芒果 / 不打泥，保留果肉”；2) 椰子插图，“泰国椰乳 / 椰肉现榨”；3) 西柚插图，“红西柚粒 / 爆汁微苦”；4) 波波插图，“脆波波 / 无香精”。

右侧边栏：一个圆角竖向奶油色卡片，标题为“产品卖点”，包含 4 个垂直排列的圆形线框图标及中文说明：1) 芒果图标，“半斤芒果 / 一碗顶一杯”；2) 椰子图标，“椰乳代替淡奶 / 更轻更滑”；3) 雪花图标，“冰碗出品 / 从第一口冷到最后”；4) 水滴图标，“不加一滴水 / 纯果 + 椰乳”。

价格与行动号召：碗下方放置一个棕色笔触风格的价格条，上方标注小字“价格”，下方为醒目的白色大号价格 {argument name="price" default="32元 / 碗"}。下方放置一个圆角白金配色 CTA 按钮，带有勺子图标及文字 {argument name="call to action" default="挖一勺夏天"}。

底部区域：添加一条纤细的分割线及中文文案“更多新品与门店动态，可在以下平台搜索”。横向排列 4 个平台图标：抖音、小红书、美团及大众点评风格的橙色图标。最底部添加一个圆角搜索栏，文字为“搜索：椰殿”。

视觉风格：高端中式甜品海报，明亮的芒果黄与椰子白配色，深巧克力棕色字体，金色点缀，简洁的商业排版，写实食物摄影与精致平面设计结合，高对比度，细节锐利，诱人的湿润高光，柔和阴影，画面中无人。

约束：确保所有中文字符清晰可辨且位置准确。使用 2 个侧边信息卡片，侧边栏共计 8 个功能项，底部 4 个平台图标，以及一个中心甜品碗。禁止添加额外价格、额外产品、水印、二维码或无关文字。

templates.title: Luxury Truffle Wagyu Burger Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华黑松露和牛汉堡海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a premium vertical restaurant launch poster for a decadent gourmet burger, branded as {argument name="brand name" default="Burger N"}, with a beige luxury food-ad background and realistic appetizing photography.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 ratio, warm cream paper texture background, centered composition, high-end casual dining aesthetic, black, dark brown, caramel orange, and cream color palette.

Top branding: At the top center place a minimalist black “N” logo with a small orange dot, then the brand text “Burger N”, then the Chinese tagline “一口堕落” with thin orange divider strokes. Below it add a tiny crown icon above the main headline.

Main headline: Large bold distressed Chinese display type across the upper middle: {argument name="headline text" default="黑松露鹅肝和牛堡"}. Underline it with a curved orange brush stroke and add small orange decorative burst marks on both sides. Beneath the headline add the subheading “奢华堕落，一口上头” with two small orange stars.

Main food subject: Center a huge hyper-realistic black truffle foie gras wagyu burger. Use a matte charcoal-black bun with black sesame seeds, thick glossy seared foie gras slabs, chunky black truffle sauce dripping heavily, melted yellow cheese stretching downward, a juicy coarse-ground wagyu beef patty with pink-red texture, leafy greens, and a dark bottom bun. Put truffle crumbs, peppercorns, sauce splashes, and sliced black truffle pieces around the base. Lighting should be soft studio food photography, glossy highlights, shallow depth of field, very appetizing and premium.

Left ingredients column: Add exactly 4 ingredient callouts on the left under a dark rounded label that says “INGREDIENTS / 成分亮点”. Each callout has a small realistic ingredient image, a dotted curved pointer line toward the burger, and Chinese text. The 4 callouts are: 1) marbled raw wagyu steak labeled “澳洲和牛 / 粗绞肉饼”; 2) seared foie gras medallions labeled “法式鹅肝 / 双面焦脆”; 3) black truffle sauce bowl labeled “黑松露酱 / 块菌含量≥12%”; 4) glossy brioche-style bun labeled “布里欧修面包 / 黄油比例18%”.

Right benefits panel: Add a rounded vertical cream card on the right titled “PRODUCT BENEFITS / 产品卖点”. Include exactly 4 stacked benefit rows with circular dark icons and Chinese copy: 1) crown icon, “双奢食材 / 和牛 + 鹅肝”; 2) spatula or knife icon, “现点现煎 / 出汁不压扁”; 3) cheese icon, “三重芝士 / 车达+马苏+帕森”; 4) takeout box icon, “手提单盒 / 不塌不湿”.

Price and CTA: Near the lower center place a dark brown rough brush-stroke price banner. On it write small orange “PRICE” and a huge white price {argument name="price" default="89"}, followed by “元 / 套”. Below, add a rounded outlined call-to-action button with bold Chinese text {argument name="call to action" default="现在就堕落"} and a right arrow.

Footer: Add a thin horizontal line, then small Chinese footer text: “更多美味，打开常用平台搜索”. Add a dark search pill reading “Burger N” with a magnifying-glass icon, followed by exactly 5 platform badges/icons labeled: 抖音, 小红书, 美团, 大众点评, and one small orange dining-app style icon. Keep all footer elements small and aligned along the bottom.

Visual style: Premium Chinese food advertising poster, realistic product photography blended with clean graphic design, strong central hero food, crisp typography, subtle paper grain, tasteful shadows, no people, no extra objects beyond the listed ingredients, icons, and text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款奢华美食汉堡创作一张高端竖版餐厅推广海报，品牌名为 {argument name="brand name" default="Burger N"}，采用米色奢华美食广告背景及写实诱人的摄影风格。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 比例，暖色调奶油质感纸张背景，居中构图，高端休闲餐饮美学，配色方案为黑色、深棕色、焦糖橙色和奶油色。

顶部品牌标识：顶部中心放置一个极简黑色“N”标志及一个小橙点，下方为品牌文字“Burger N”，随后是中文标语“一口堕落”，两侧配有细橙色分割线。在其下方，主标题上方添加一个小皇冠图标。

主标题：中上部使用醒目、粗犷的做旧风格中文字体：{argument name="headline text" default="黑松露鹅肝和牛堡"}。下方用弯曲的橙色笔触线条衬托，两侧添加小型橙色装饰性星芒。标题下方添加副标题“奢华堕落，一口上头”，并配以两颗小橙星。

主食主体：中心放置一个巨大的超写实黑松露鹅肝和牛汉堡。使用哑光炭黑色面包胚，撒有黑芝麻，厚实油亮的香煎鹅肝片，浓郁的黑松露酱垂坠而下，融化的黄色芝士拉丝向下，多汁的粗绞和牛牛肉饼呈现粉红色纹理，搭配新鲜绿叶菜和深色底部面包。汉堡底部周围散落松露碎、胡椒粒、酱汁溅点及黑松露切片。灯光采用柔和的摄影棚美食光效，高光质感，浅景深，极具食欲感与高端感。

左侧成分栏：在左侧添加 4 个成分亮点标注，置于深色圆角标签“INGREDIENTS / 成分亮点”下方。每个标注包含一个小巧写实的成分图片、指向汉堡的虚线弧形引导线以及中文文字。4 个标注分别为：1) 大理石纹生和牛排，标注“澳洲和牛 / 粗绞肉饼”；2) 香煎鹅肝圆片，标注“法式鹅肝 / 双面焦脆”；3) 黑松露酱碗，标注“黑松露酱 / 块菌含量≥12%”；4) 油亮布里欧修面包，标注“布里欧修面包 / 黄油比例18%”。

右侧卖点面板：在右侧添加一张圆角竖式奶油色卡片，标题为“PRODUCT BENEFITS / 产品卖点”。包含 4 行堆叠的卖点，配有圆形深色图标及中文文案：1) 皇冠图标，“双奢食材 / 和牛 + 鹅肝”；2) 铲子或刀具图标，“现点现煎 / 出汁不压扁”；3) 芝士图标，“三重芝士 / 车达+马苏+帕森”；4) 外卖盒图标，“手提单盒 / 不塌不湿”。

价格与 CTA：在底部中心附近放置一个深棕色粗笔触价格横幅。横幅上写有小号橙色“PRICE”和巨大的白色价格 {argument name="price" default="89"}，后接“元 / 套”。下方添加一个圆角轮廓的行动号召按钮，内含粗体中文 {argument name="call to action" default="现在就堕落"} 及一个向右箭头。

页脚：添加一条细水平线，随后是小号中文页脚文字：“更多美味，打开常用平台搜索”。添加一个深色搜索胶囊，内含“Burger N”文字及放大镜图标，后接 5 个平台徽标/图标，分别标注：抖音、小红书、美团、大众点评，以及一个小型橙色餐饮应用风格图标。保持所有页脚元素精简并沿底部对齐。

视觉风格：高端中式美食广告海报，写实产品摄影与简洁平面设计相结合，强有力的中心主体食物，清晰的排版，细腻的纸张纹理，考究的阴影，画面中无人像，除所列成分、图标和文字外无额外杂物。

templates.title: Overhead Escalator Mall Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 商场自动扶梯俯视肖像

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic 35mm portrait photograph from an extreme overhead, drone-like viewpoint looking down the center of a wide moving escalator inside a futuristic luxury shopping mall. A single {argument name="subject" default="adult man"} stands completely still on the escalator, centered in the frame and facing upward toward the camera, with calm, motionless body language. He has short dark hair and wears a {argument name="coat color" default="dark brown"} wool overcoat over a beige sweater, dark trousers, and polished dark leather shoes. The escalator steps form strong symmetrical leading lines, with glass side rails and metallic grooves, descending into a bright open mall atrium. Around him, show hundreds of shoppers on adjacent escalators and the mall floor rendered with heavy motion blur, creating a dramatic contrast between the sharp still subject and the rushing crowd. The mall should feel upscale and futuristic, with pale stone floors, glass storefronts, warm wood balcony curves, glossy black shop entrances, soft retail lighting, and a spacious multi-level interior. Use shallow depth of field focused on the subject, cinematic color grading, realistic lens perspective, subtle wide-angle distortion from above, natural indoor lighting, high detail, documentary fashion editorial mood, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实电影级 35mm 肖像摄影作品，采用极高俯视视角（类似无人机视角），向下俯瞰未来感豪华购物中心内宽阔自动扶梯的中心。一位 {argument name="subject" default="成年男性"} 站在自动扶梯上完全静止，位于画面中心并抬头看向镜头，肢体语言平静且纹丝不动。他留着深色短发，身穿 {argument name="coat color" default="深棕色"} 羊毛大衣，内搭米色毛衣，下穿深色长裤，脚蹬擦得锃亮的深色皮鞋。自动扶梯的台阶形成了强烈的对称引导线，配有玻璃侧栏和金属凹槽，向下延伸至明亮开阔的商场中庭。在他周围，展示数百名在相邻扶梯和商场楼层走动的购物者，并进行强烈的动态模糊处理，使清晰静止的主体与匆忙的人群形成鲜明对比。商场应呈现高端且具有未来感的氛围，配有浅色石材地面、玻璃店面、温暖的木质弧形阳台、亮黑色店铺入口、柔和的零售照明以及宽敞的多层室内空间。使用聚焦于主体的浅景深，电影级调色，真实的镜头透视，从上方观察时带有微妙的广角畸变，自然室内光线，高细节，纪录片时尚编辑风格，无可见文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Türkiye Floating Island Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 土耳其浮岛旅行海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed hyper-realistic vertical 9:16 cinematic luxury travel poster showing {argument name="country name" default="TÜRKİYE"} as a massive handcrafted floating island civilization suspended in soft atmospheric clouds, like a premium miniature world map and tourism masterpiece.

Canvas: Tall poster composition, off-white cloud background, elegant editorial layout. Use a grand navy serif headline at the top reading “{argument name="headline text" default="TÜRKİYE"}”, with a refined subtitle beneath: “Where Continents, Civilizations & Nature Converge”. Add thin gold divider lines and a high-end museum-map aesthetic.

Top feature row: Under the subtitle, include exactly 4 small gold line icons with captions: 1) Rich Heritage — Thousands of years, 2) Breathtaking Nature — From seas to peaks, 3) Vibrant Culture — Timeless & welcoming, 4) Limitless Discovery — Every region, a new story.

Main subject: The entire country is visualized as one enormous floating island in the shape and spirit of Turkey, surrounded by turquoise seas, white clouds, waterfalls pouring off cliff edges, tiny boats, bridges, highways, rivers, forests, farmland, mosques, ruins, castles, mountain ranges, ancient cities, and modern urban districts. Make the island densely detailed and believable, with cinematic depth, warm sunlight, atmospheric haze, and miniature scale realism. Include airplanes flying above, seagulls, hot air balloons over Cappadocia, a Turkish flag near Ankara, another red flag near the southeast, and rich regional architectural variety.

Labeled landmarks and regions: Add exactly 18 cream-colored map labels with fine serif typography and subtle shadows, placed across the floating island: 1) ISTANBUL — Where Europe Meets Asia, 2) BURSA, 3) İZMİR — Pearl of the Aegean, 4) EPHESUS — Timeless Ancient City, 5) PAMUKKALE — Cotton Castle, 6) ANTALYA — Turquoise Coast’s Timeless Charm, 7) KONYA — Home of Mevlana, 8) ANKARA — The Capital, 9) SAMSUN, 10) CAPPADOCIA — Land of Fairy Chimneys, 11) TRABZON — Uzungöl, Sümela Monastery, 12) MOUNT ARARAT — 5,137 m, Türkiye’s Highest Peak, 13) ERZURUM, 14) VAN — Lake Van, 15) DIYARBAKIR — Ancient Walls, Timeless Stories, 16) GAZIANTEP — City of Gastronomy & Antep Baklava, 17) GÖBEKLİ TEPE — World’s First Temple, 12,000 Years Old, 18) MARDİN — Stone City of Mesopotamia.

Bottom information panel: Create a cream-and-gold bordered stats panel across the bottom with refined travel-brochure typography and exactly 8 information blocks: 1) Population: 85.7M with people icon, 2) Official Language: Turkish with speech icon, 3) Currency: Turkish lira ₺ / TRY with coin icon, 4) Visitors in 2024: 62.27M with suitcase icon, 5) Famous Exports: Automotive, Textiles, Machinery, Electronics, Hazelnuts with truck icon, 6) Cuisine: Kebab, Baklava, Meze, Tea, Turkish Coffee with serving-dome icon, 7) Transport: High-Speed Rail, Major Airports, Highways, Ferries, Bosphorus Bridges with train/plane icon, 8) Identity: CROSSROADS OF EUROPE AND ASIA — A bridge between worlds, a home beyond time, with globe icon.

Decorative foreground: At the lower right, place a realistic tulip-shaped glass of Turkish tea on a saucer beside a sesame simit bread ring; add delicate red tulips at both lower corners. Use gold accents, ivory margins, navy typography, and realistic shadows.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic miniature diorama, cinematic luxury tourism poster, ultra-detailed 3D cartographic illustration, premium travel magazine cover, crisp readable labels, natural atmospheric clouds, turquoise water, golden-hour highlights, extremely dense but organized details, no watermark, no extra text beyond the specified labels and captions.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张超精细、超写实的 9:16 竖版电影级奢华旅行海报，将 {argument name="country name" default="TÜRKİYE"} 展现为悬浮在柔和大气云层中的巨大手工浮岛文明，宛如高端微缩世界地图和旅游艺术杰作。

画布：高挑的海报构图，灰白色云层背景，优雅的编辑排版。顶部使用宏伟的深蓝色衬线字体标题“{argument name="headline text" default="TÜRKİYE"}”，下方配以精致副标题：“连接大陆、文明与自然之地”。添加细金线分割线，营造高端博物馆地图的审美感。

顶部特征栏：在副标题下方，包含 4 个精致的金色线条图标及说明：1) 丰富的遗产 — 数千年的历史，2) 壮丽的自然 — 从海洋到山峰，3) 充满活力的文化 — 永恒且热情，4) 无限的探索 — 每一片区域都有新故事。

主体：整个国家被构想为一个巨大的浮岛，呈现土耳其的形状与神韵，周围环绕着绿松石色的海洋、白云、从悬崖边缘倾泻而下的瀑布，以及微小的船只、桥梁、高速公路、河流、森林、农田、清真寺、遗迹、城堡、山脉、古城和现代城区。使岛屿细节极其丰富且真实，具有电影般的深度、温暖的阳光、大气雾气和微缩景观的真实感。包含飞越上空的飞机、海鸥、卡帕多奇亚的热气球、安卡拉附近的土耳其国旗、东南部附近的另一面红旗，以及丰富的区域建筑多样性。

标注的地标与区域：在浮岛上放置 18 个奶油色的地图标签，使用精细的衬线字体和微妙的阴影：1) 伊斯坦布尔 (ISTANBUL) — 欧亚交汇处，2) 布尔萨 (BURSA)，3) 伊兹密尔 (İZMİR) — 爱琴海明珠，4) 以弗所 (EPHESUS) — 永恒的古城，5) 棉花堡 (PAMUKKALE) — 棉花城堡，6) 安塔利亚 (ANTALYA) — 绿松石海岸的永恒魅力，7) 科尼亚 (KONYA) — 梅夫拉纳的故乡，8) 安卡拉 (ANKARA) — 首都，9) 萨姆松 (SAMSUN)，10) 卡帕多奇亚 (CAPPADOCIA) — 精灵烟囱之地，11) 特拉布宗 (TRABZON) — 乌宗湖、苏美拉修道院，12) 阿拉拉特山 (MOUNT ARARAT) — 5,137 米，土耳其最高峰，13) 埃尔祖鲁姆 (ERZURUM)，14) 凡城 (VAN) — 凡湖，15) 迪亚巴克尔 (DIYARBAKIR) — 古城墙，永恒的故事，16) 加济安泰普 (GAZIANTEP) — 美食之城与安泰普果仁蜜饼，17) 哥贝克力石阵 (GÖBEKLİ TEPE) — 世界第一座神庙，12,000 年历史，18) 马尔丁 (MARDİN) — 美索不达米亚的石城。

底部信息面板：在底部创建一个奶油色与金色边框的统计面板，采用精致的旅游手册排版，包含 8 个信息块：1) 人口：8570 万（配人物图标），2) 官方语言：土耳其语（配语音图标），3) 货币：土耳其里拉 ₺ / TRY（配硬币图标），4) 2024 年游客量：6227 万（配行李箱图标），5) 著名出口产品：汽车、纺织品、机械、电子产品、榛子（配卡车图标），6) 美食：烤肉、果仁蜜饼、开胃菜、茶、土耳其咖啡（配餐盘盖图标），7) 交通：高速铁路、主要机场、高速公路、渡轮、博斯普鲁斯海峡大桥（配火车/飞机图标），8) 身份：欧亚十字路口 — 连接世界的桥梁，超越时间的家园（配地球仪图标）。

装饰性前景：在右下角放置一杯逼真的郁金香形土耳其茶，旁边放着芝麻圈饼 (Simit)；在两个下角添加精致的红郁金香。使用金色点缀、象牙色页边距、深蓝色排版和逼真的阴影。

视觉风格：超写实微缩立体模型，电影级奢华旅游海报，超精细 3D 制图插画，高端旅行杂志封面，清晰易读的标签，自然大气云层，绿松石色水域，黄金时刻光影，细节极其丰富且井然有序，无水印，除指定的标签和说明外无额外文字。

templates.title: Overhead Spiral Staircase Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 俯瞰螺旋楼梯人像

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic cinematic 35mm photograph from an extreme overhead perspective, looking straight down into an enormous circular spiral staircase. A lone {argument name="subject" default="middle-aged man"} stands perfectly still at the exact center of the spiral, far below the camera, looking upward. He wears a {argument name="coat color" default="dark brown"} overcoat, beige sweater, dark trousers, and brown shoes, with one hand raised near his chest as if holding his glasses or collar. The staircase forms multiple concentric rings around him, with stone steps, cream concrete undersides, dark metal railings, and a polished wooden handrail; the repeating curves should create a hypnotic vortex descending into shadow. Use warm muted beige, brown, and gray tones, soft dusty light from above, subtle haze, deep shadows, realistic architectural texture, and dramatic film grain. Compose vertically in a 3:4 frame with the man centered, the circular stairwell filling the entire image, strong radial symmetry, and a tense surreal atmosphere of isolation and vertigo. No text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影感 35mm 摄影作品，采用极端的俯瞰视角，直视下方巨大的圆形螺旋楼梯。一名孤独的 {argument name="subject" default="中年男子"} 在远处的楼梯中心静止站立，抬头仰望。他身穿一件 {argument name="coat color" default="深棕色"} 大衣、米色毛衣、深色长裤和棕色皮鞋，一只手抬起靠近胸前，仿佛正拿着眼镜或整理衣领。楼梯在他周围形成多个同心圆，包含石阶、奶油色混凝土底面、深色金属栏杆和抛光的木质扶手；重复的曲线营造出一种通向阴影的催眠式漩涡感。使用温暖柔和的米色、棕色和灰色调，上方投射出柔和的尘埃光感，带有轻微的雾气、深邃的阴影、逼真的建筑纹理和戏剧性的胶片颗粒感。采用 3:4 竖构图，人物居中，圆形楼梯井填满整个画面，呈现强烈的径向对称感，营造出一种紧张、超现实的孤独与眩晕氛围。无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: Top-Down Selfie in Empty Indoor Pool

titleLocalized.zh: 空室内泳池中的俯视自拍

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic wide-angle selfie photograph from a dramatic high, top-down perspective at the edge of a completely drained indoor swimming pool. A single adult man, {argument name="subject description" default="South Asian man with short black hair"}, stands alone near the deep end threshold and looks upward toward the camera, holding it at arm’s length so his extended sleeve dominates the lower-left foreground. He wears a {argument name="shirt color" default="bright pale yellow-green"} long-sleeve button-up shirt, dark trousers, and brown shoes, and holds a smartphone in his other hand. His face is intentionally covered by a soft rectangular blur for anonymity. The empty pool is large and rectangular, lined with worn pale blue and white tiles, dark blue lane markings, depth signs reading 6 ft and 7 ft, metal ladders on the right side, rounded tiled steps in the far-left corner, drain grates around the rim, and visible scuffs, stains, and dirt on the dry pool floor. The indoor natatorium has high windows along the upper walls casting strong rectangular sunlight patches and long shadows across the tiles, with a quiet abandoned atmosphere. Use natural daylight, crisp architectural detail, realistic perspective distortion from a phone ultra-wide lens, high dynamic range, subtle filmic color grading, and documentary-style realism. No extra people, no water, no text overlays, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的广角自拍照片，采用从干涸的室内游泳池边缘向下俯视的戏剧性视角。一名成年男子，{argument name="subject description" default="留着黑色短发的南亚裔男子"}，独自站在深水区边缘，抬头看向镜头，手臂伸长持机，使他伸出的袖子占据了左下角的前景。他穿着一件 {argument name="shirt color" default="明亮的淡黄绿色"} 长袖衬衫、深色长裤和棕色鞋子，另一只手拿着智能手机。为了保持匿名，他的脸部被柔和的矩形模糊处理。空旷的泳池呈大型矩形，铺设着磨损的淡蓝色和白色瓷砖，带有深蓝色泳道线，标有 6 英尺和 7 英尺的深度标识，右侧有金属梯子，远左角有圆形的瓷砖台阶，边缘有排水格栅，干燥的池底可见磨损、污渍和灰尘。室内游泳馆的高墙上设有窗户，投射出强烈的矩形阳光，在瓷砖上留下长长的阴影，营造出一种安静、废弃的氛围。使用自然日光、清晰的建筑细节、手机超广角镜头带来的真实透视畸变、高动态范围、细腻的电影感调色以及纪录片风格的写实感。画面中无其他人物，无水，无文字叠加，无水印。

templates.title: Top-Down Desert Footprint Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 沙漠俯视足迹肖像

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic 35mm editorial portrait of {argument name="subject" default="an adult man with short black hair"} standing alone on a vast desert-like surface of smooth ash-gray sand, photographed from an extreme top-down angle as if the camera is high above him looking straight down. The subject is centered, looking up toward the camera, with natural skin and realistic facial features, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a dark short-sleeve open overshirt over a beige knit sweater, loose black trousers, and polished brown leather boots"}. The sand has fine wind-ripple texture across the whole frame and is surrounded by rugged tan rock formations, sparse desert shrubs, scattered pebbles, and harsh midday sunlight casting strong shadows. Place exactly seven large circular footprint-like craters in the sand around the subject: one large crater at lower left, one large crater at lower center, one large crater at lower right, one crater to the subject’s left, one crater to the subject’s right, and two fainter partial craters behind him near shoulder level; also include one winding trail of tiny footprints in the upper-left background. Use {argument name="sand color" default="pale ash-gray"} tones, crisp natural shadows, high dynamic range, documentary realism, vertical smartphone composition, no text, no watermark, no surreal creatures, no extra people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的 35mm 编辑风格肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一名留着黑色短发的成年男子"}，他独自站在一片广阔、如沙漠般平滑的灰烬色沙地上。拍摄视角为极端的俯视角度，仿佛相机悬于高空正向下俯拍。主角位于画面中心，抬头望向镜头，皮肤质感自然，面部特征真实，身着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件深色短袖开衫，内搭米色针织毛衣，下穿宽松黑色长裤，脚蹬擦得锃亮的棕色皮靴"}。沙地表面布满了细微的风蚀波纹，周围环绕着崎岖的棕褐色岩层、稀疏的沙漠灌木、散落的碎石，强烈的正午阳光投射出浓重的阴影。在主角周围的沙地上放置 7 个巨大的圆形足迹状陨石坑：左下方一个大坑，正下方一个大坑，右下方一个大坑，主角左侧一个，主角右侧一个，以及主角肩部后方两个较浅的半圆形坑；此外，在左上角背景处加入一条蜿蜒的小型足迹路径。使用 {argument name="sand color" default="浅灰烬色"} 色调，阴影清晰自然，高动态范围，纪录片式写实风格，竖屏构图，无文字，无水印，无超现实生物，无其他人物。

templates.title: Bored Club Chibi Kids Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Bored Club Chibi Kids 海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 cute 3D cartoon fashion poster featuring two bored kids standing side by side with crossed arms, in a soft Pixar-like and Korean kawaii aesthetic. The background is a muted sage-gray studio backdrop with gentle vignette lighting and a cream floor. Center the children full-body: on the left, a young boy with fluffy brown hair partly visible, oversized plush white winter earmuff headphones, an oversized pastel sage-green T-shirt printed with bold black text “BORED TODAY” and a tiny purple monster graphic, loose dark charcoal cargo jogger pants with side pockets, and chunky white sneakers. On the right, a young girl with long wavy brown hair, oversized plush white winter earmuff headphones, a cropped pastel sage-green T-shirt printed with bold black text “BORED TODAY,” a dark charcoal cargo mini skirt with drawstring and flap pockets, white socks, and chunky white sneakers. Both children should have bored, unimpressed posture with arms folded and feet planted confidently. Add a large hand-drawn sticker-style title at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="BORED CLUB"}, using chunky black bubble letters with thick white outline, slightly tilted. Surround the characters with exactly 9 doodle elements: 5 cream-white hand-sketched stars around the headline, 3 small pastel monster doodles floating around the kids, and 1 speech bubble near the lower left reading {argument name="speech bubble text" default="NOPE."}. Include additional tiny cute monster stickers near the legs and shoes for playful balance, but keep the main visible count of doodle elements clear and uncluttered. Use high-detail toy-like 3D rendering, soft rounded forms, smooth skin, plush fabric texture on the earmuffs, realistic cotton clothing folds, gentle shadows, pastel colors, and a clean magazine-cover composition. Leave the children’s faces intentionally blank or softly obscured as neutral placeholder face areas, while preserving hair, clothing, and body pose. No watermark, no extra logos, no extra readable text beyond the headline, shirt text, and speech bubble.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 竖版可爱的 3D 卡通时尚海报，主角是两个并排站立、双臂交叉的无聊小孩，呈现出柔和的皮克斯风格和韩式卡哇伊美学。背景为柔和的鼠尾草灰摄影棚背景，带有柔和的晕影灯光和奶油色地板。将儿童全身置于画面中央：左侧是一个年轻男孩，露出部分蓬松的棕色头发，戴着超大号毛绒白色冬季耳罩式耳机，穿着印有醒目黑色文字“BORED TODAY”和微小紫色怪兽图案的超大号淡鼠尾草绿 T 恤，搭配宽松的深炭灰色工装慢跑裤（带侧袋）和厚底白色运动鞋。右侧是一个年轻女孩，留着长波浪棕色头发，戴着超大号毛绒白色冬季耳罩式耳机，穿着印有醒目黑色文字“BORED TODAY”的短款淡鼠尾草绿 T 恤，搭配带抽绳和翻盖口袋的深炭灰色工装短裙、白色袜子和厚底白色运动鞋。两个孩子都应呈现出无聊、不感兴趣的姿态，双臂交叉，双脚自信地站立。在顶部添加一个巨大的手绘贴纸风格标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="BORED CLUB"}，使用带有粗白色轮廓的厚实黑色气泡字体，略微倾斜。在角色周围添加 9 个涂鸦元素：标题周围 5 个奶油白色手绘星星，孩子们周围漂浮着 3 个小型淡色怪兽涂鸦，左下角附近有一个对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="NOPE."}。在腿部和鞋子附近添加额外的微小可爱怪兽贴纸以保持视觉平衡，但要确保主要涂鸦元素清晰且不杂乱。采用高细节的玩具质感 3D 渲染，柔和的圆润形态、光滑的皮肤、耳罩上的毛绒织物纹理、逼真的棉质服装褶皱、柔和的阴影、柔和的色彩以及干净的杂志封面构图。故意将孩子们的脸部留白或柔和遮盖作为中性占位符，同时保留头发、服装和身体姿势。无水印，无额外标志，除标题、衬衫文字和对话气泡外，无其他可读文本。
