templates.title: Luxury Caramel Frappuccino Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华焦糖星冰乐海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a sleek luxury beverage campaign poster for {argument name="product name" default="Starbucks Caramel Frappuccino"}, designed for viral Instagram and Pinterest, with an urban coffeehouse atmosphere and contemporary premium branding.

Canvas: Vertical portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, high-resolution advertising layout. Use a dark espresso-brown and black background with warm amber bokeh lights, caramel glow, glossy reflections, floating coffee beans, ice cubes, and dynamic caramel splashes around the drink.

Main visual: Place a large Starbucks-style caramel frappuccino cup on the right side as the hero object. The clear plastic cup is filled with blended caramel coffee, condensation droplets, caramel streaks down the inside and outside, a domed transparent lid, a green straw angled upward, and a tall swirl of whipped cream covered in glossy caramel drizzle. Add a green circular siren-style logo on the cup. Make the drink look rich, creamy, chilled, luxurious, and irresistible.

Top typography: At the upper left, add small uppercase text “STARBUCKS” with a tiny star divider beneath it. Below, set the word “Caramel” very large in elegant golden serif lettering. Under it, set “Frappuccino” in oversized white handwritten script. Add the tagline exactly: “smooth • chilled • iconic”. Use refined gold and white typography with premium spacing.

Luxury badge: Add 1 circular seal near the upper right reading “MADE TO INDULGE” and “MADE FOR YOU” around a central gold star.

Premium ingredients panel: On the left-center, create a rounded rectangular dark glass panel titled “PREMIUM INGREDIENTS”. Inside it, show exactly 6 ingredient tiles in a 2-column by 3-row grid, each with a small realistic product image, a simple white icon, and label: 1) ESPRESSO, shown as a small glass cup of espresso; 2) CARAMEL SAUCE, shown as a bowl of caramel with caramel cubes; 3) MILK, shown as a glass bottle and small cup; 4) WHIPPED CREAM, shown as a white cream swirl in a bowl; 5) ICE, shown as clear ice cubes in a bowl; 6) COFFEE BEANS, shown as roasted beans in a bowl.

Crafting steps section: Across the lower middle, add a horizontal process strip titled “CRAFTED TO PERFECTION”. Include exactly 5 numbered step cards connected by small arrows and dotted guide lines. Each card has a photo-like miniature scene and a label: 1) “BREW RICH ESPRESSO SHOT” with espresso pouring into a glass; 2) “BLEND COFFEE WITH ICE & MILK” with ice and milk in a blender cup; 3) “ADD CARAMEL FOR SWEETNESS” with caramel pouring over ice; 4) “TOP WITH WHIPPED CREAM” with whipped cream being added; 5) “FINISH WITH CARAMEL DRIZZLE” with the completed frappuccino. Add small matching icons below the cards.

Bottom information boxes: Add exactly 2 rounded rectangular callout boxes. Bottom left box title: “BARISTA TIP”, with a whisk icon and text: “Blend with extra ice for a thicker café-style texture”. Bottom right box title: “MAKE IT YOURS”, with text: “Customize your sweetness” and the options “Light • Regular • Extra”, plus a divider line and text: “Add an extra shot for a bolder kick”. Between the boxes, place a smaller close-up image of the caramel whipped topping.

Footer: At the bottom center, add spaced uppercase text “CHILLED. CREAMY. ICONIC.” and a handwritten line: “Made for caramel lovers.” followed by a small heart.

Visual style: Premium cinematic beverage advertising, dark luxury coffee palette, caramel-gold highlights, creamy whites, realistic product photography mixed with clean infographic layout, crisp readable labels, glossy surfaces, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, high contrast, elegant editorial composition.

Constraints: Use exactly 6 ingredient tiles, exactly 5 process steps, exactly 2 bottom callout boxes, and exactly 1 circular luxury seal. Keep all visible text sharp and correctly spelled. Do not add extra logos, extra ingredient tiles, extra process cards, watermark, QR code, or unrelated products.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="product name" default="Starbucks Caramel Frappuccino"} 创建一张时尚奢华的饮品宣传海报，专为 Instagram 和 Pinterest 的病毒式传播而设计，营造都市咖啡馆氛围及当代高端品牌感。

画布：垂直肖像海报，2:3 纵横比，高分辨率广告排版。使用深浓缩咖啡棕色和黑色背景，搭配温暖的琥珀色焦外成像灯光、焦糖光泽、光亮反射、漂浮的咖啡豆、冰块以及饮料周围动态的焦糖溅射效果。

主视觉：将一杯大型 Starbucks 风格的焦糖星冰乐置于右侧作为主体。透明塑料杯中装满混合焦糖咖啡，杯壁带有冷凝水珠，内外侧有焦糖流挂，配有圆顶透明盖、向上倾斜的绿色吸管，以及顶部覆盖着光亮焦糖淋酱的高耸奶油漩涡。杯身上印有绿色圆形海妖标志。让这款饮品看起来浓郁、丝滑、冰爽、奢华且令人无法抗拒。

顶部排版：在左上方添加小号大写文本“STARBUCKS”，下方配有一个微型星形分隔符。下方将“Caramel”一词放大，采用优雅的金色衬线字体。在其下方，用超大号白色手写体书写“Frappuccino”。添加标语：“smooth • chilled • iconic”。使用精致的金色和白色排版，并保持高级的间距。

奢华印章：在右上角附近添加 1 个圆形印章，中央为金色星星，周围环绕文字“MADE TO INDULGE”和“MADE FOR YOU”。

高端配料面板：在左侧中心位置，创建一个圆角矩形深色玻璃面板，标题为“PREMIUM INGREDIENTS”。面板内以 2 列 3 行的网格形式展示 6 个配料块，每个配料块包含一张写实的小型产品图、一个简洁的白色图标及标签：1) ESPRESSO，展示为一小杯浓缩咖啡；2) CARAMEL SAUCE，展示为一碗焦糖及焦糖块；3) MILK，展示为玻璃瓶和小杯牛奶；4) WHIPPED CREAM，展示为碗中的白色奶油漩涡；5) ICE，展示为碗中的透明冰块；6) COFFEE BEANS，展示为碗中的烘焙咖啡豆。

制作步骤部分：在下方中部横向添加一个标题为“CRAFTED TO PERFECTION”的流程条。包含 5 张带编号的步骤卡片，由小箭头和虚线引导线连接。每张卡片包含一张照片级微缩场景及标签：1) “BREW RICH ESPRESSO SHOT”，展示浓缩咖啡倒入玻璃杯；2) “BLEND COFFEE WITH ICE & MILK”，展示搅拌杯中的冰块和牛奶；3) “ADD CARAMEL FOR SWEETNESS”，展示焦糖淋在冰上；4) “TOP WITH WHIPPED CREAM”，展示添加奶油漩涡；5) “FINISH WITH CARAMEL DRIZZLE”，展示成品星冰乐。在卡片下方添加配套的小图标。

底部信息框：添加 2 个圆角矩形标注框。左下角框标题：“BARISTA TIP”，配有打蛋器图标及文字：“Blend with extra ice for a thicker café-style texture”。右下角框标题：“MAKE IT YOURS”，配有文字：“Customize your sweetness”及选项“Light • Regular • Extra”，并附有一条分隔线和文字：“Add an extra shot for a bolder kick”。在两个框之间，放置一张焦糖奶油顶部的特写小图。

页脚：在底部中心，添加间距均匀的大写文本“CHILLED. CREAMY. ICONIC.”以及一行手写文字：“Made for caramel lovers.”，后跟一颗小爱心。

视觉风格：高端电影级饮品广告，深色奢华咖啡色调，焦糖金色高光，奶油白色，写实产品摄影与简洁信息图表排版相结合，清晰易读的标签，光亮表面，戏剧性灯光，浅景深，高对比度，优雅的编辑式构图。

限制：使用 6 个配料块，5 个制作步骤，2 个底部标注框，以及 1 个圆形奢华印章。保持所有可见文字清晰且拼写正确。不要添加额外的标志、配料块、流程卡、水印、二维码或不相关的产品。

templates.title: Photo to Pixel Avatar Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 照片转像素头像拼贴画

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant pixel-art promotional collage showing a real portrait being transformed into a gaming-style pixel avatar. Canvas: wide 16:9 landscape banner, approximately 1200×675. Visual style: crisp retro 16-bit pixel art mixed with one realistic photo panel, thick black outlines, white sticker borders, halftone comic dots, teal and coral radial burst background, playful creator-studio atmosphere. Main subject: a large central pixel-art bust of {argument name="character name" default="a young man"} with {argument name="hair color" default="messy black hair"}, wearing a dark navy hoodie under an olive green jacket, facing forward; keep the face area as a soft anonymous placeholder or simplified blurred facial block, not a detailed identity. Left side: one large rounded-corner computer/photo window with three small circular window buttons at the top left, containing a realistic portrait of the same person in the same hoodie and jacket, with a thick mint-green frame. Between the photo window and the central avatar, place one bold white arrow pointing right to show transformation. Count the visible generated avatar outputs exactly: 5 total — 1 large central pixel avatar, 1 yellow comic-style square portrait near the top center-left with sparkle icons, 1 green comic-style square portrait at the top right with a white thought bubble, 1 blue comic-style square portrait at the right middle with expressive motion marks, and 1 small portrait displayed on a drawing tablet at the bottom left. Desk and studio details: include exactly 10 notable props — 1 black desk lamp glowing warm yellow on the far left, 1 potted leafy plant on the desk, 1 drawing tablet with colored tool bars, 1 stylus lying in front of it, 1 red mug with a white heart and steam, 2 small pixel figurines at the bottom left, 1 tiny green pixel creature, 1 wall shelf with a small pixel character figure, and 1 framed pixel heart picture on the wall. Background: dark cozy room on the far left with shelves and brick wall, transitioning into bright comic halftone rays behind the central avatar. Palette: saturated teal, mint, coral, yellow, navy, olive green, and black. Composition: dynamic, busy but readable, with the central avatar dominating the right half and the source photo dominating the left. Constraints: no readable text or logos, no watermark, no extra panels beyond the five counted avatar outputs, maintain a cheerful before-and-after transformation theme suitable for a free photo-to-pixel-avatar generator ad.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的像素艺术宣传拼贴画，展示真实肖像转换为游戏风格像素头像的过程。画布：宽屏 16:9 横向横幅，尺寸约为 1200×675。视觉风格：清晰的复古 16-bit 像素艺术与一张写实照片面板相结合，粗黑色轮廓，白色贴纸边框，半色调漫画圆点，青色与珊瑚色放射状背景，营造出俏皮的创作者工作室氛围。主体：中心位置是一个巨大的像素艺术半身像，角色为 {argument name="character name" default="一名年轻男子"}，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的黑发"}，身穿橄榄绿夹克，内搭深海军蓝连帽衫，面向前方；面部区域保持为柔和的匿名占位符或简化的模糊色块，无需具体的身份细节。左侧：一个带有圆角的大型电脑/照片窗口，左上角有三个小圆形窗口按钮，其中包含同一人物穿着相同连帽衫和夹克的写实肖像，并配有粗厚的薄荷绿边框。在照片窗口和中心头像之间，放置一个指向右侧的粗体白色箭头，以展示转换过程。准确计算可见的生成头像输出数量：总共 5 个 — 1 个大型中心像素头像，1 个位于左上方附近的黄色漫画风格方形肖像（带闪光图标），1 个位于右上方的绿色漫画风格方形肖像（带白色气泡），1 个位于右侧中部的蓝色漫画风格方形肖像（带生动的动作标记），以及 1 个显示在左下方绘图板上的小型肖像。桌面和工作室细节：包含 10 个显著道具 — 最左侧一盏发出暖黄色光芒的黑色台灯，桌上一盆绿植，一个带有彩色工具栏的绘图板，一支放在绘图板前的触控笔，一个带有白色爱心和蒸汽的红色马克杯，左下方 2 个小型像素手办，1 个微型绿色像素生物，一个放有小型像素角色人偶的墙面搁板，以及墙上一个带框的像素爱心画。背景：最左侧是带有搁板和砖墙的温馨暗色房间，过渡到中心头像后方明亮的漫画半色调光束。调色板：饱和的青色、薄荷色、珊瑚色、黄色、海军蓝、橄榄绿和黑色。构图：动态、丰富但易于阅读，中心头像占据右半部分，源照片占据左半部分。限制：无易读文本或徽标，无水印，除 5 个头像输出外无额外面板，保持适合免费照片转像素头像生成器广告的欢快“前后对比”主题。

templates.title: Noir Detective Rainy Alley Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黑色电影侦探雨巷肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic black-and-white noir manga illustration of {argument name="character type" default="a mysterious detective"} standing close to the camera in a rain-soaked city alley at night. The figure occupies the right half of the wide horizontal frame, wearing a dark fedora, high-collared trench coat, shirt, and tie, with sharp inked highlights and heavy cross-hatching; leave a large plain dark gray rectangular placeholder over the face area for a future uploaded portrait, centered from the hat brim down to the upper chest. The left half shows a tall glowing Victorian streetlamp, wet reflective cobblestones, dense fog or steam drifting along the ground, distant skyscrapers and fire escapes, and vertical rain streaks. Use a gritty monochrome graphic-novel style with high contrast, scratchy pen-and-ink texture, dramatic rim lighting, deep shadows, detailed brick wall perspective behind the detective, raindrops on the coat, and a cinematic 16:9 composition. No readable text, no watermark, no color except grayscale.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的黑白黑色电影风格漫画插图，画面中 {argument name="character type" default="一位神秘侦探"} 站在雨夜的城市小巷中，靠近镜头。人物占据宽幅横向构图的右半部分，身穿深色软呢帽、高领风衣、衬衫和领带，带有锐利的墨水高光和厚重的交叉排线；在面部区域留出一个大的纯深灰色矩形占位符，以便未来上传肖像，位置从帽檐向下延伸至上胸部。左半部分展示了一盏高大的发光维多利亚式路灯、湿润反光的鹅卵石路面、地面上漂浮的浓雾或蒸汽、远处的摩天大楼和消防梯，以及垂直的雨丝。采用粗犷的单色绘本风格，具有高对比度、粗糙的钢笔墨水纹理、戏剧性的轮廓光、深邃的阴影、侦探身后详细的砖墙透视、外套上的雨滴，以及 16:9 的电影级构图。无可见文字，无水印，除灰度外无任何颜色。

templates.title: Comic Sketch to Finished Hero Page

titleLocalized.zh: 从漫画草图到成品英雄页面

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic tabletop scene showing a comic-book illustration in progress, photographed from a slightly overhead angle on a dark wooden desk. A large sheet of comic art paper fills most of the frame, split diagonally by a jagged glowing transition: the left half is rough graphite pencil sketching, and the right half is a fully inked and colored manga/comic page. On the left, show loose construction lines of a futuristic city skyline and the back view of a lone caped hero, all in gray pencil with smudges, eraser dust, and sketch marks. On the right, render the finished version in dramatic dark blue and golden tones: the same hero stands on a rooftop ledge, seen from behind, with spiky {argument name="hair style" default="black spiky hair"}, a long windblown {argument name="cape color" default="deep blue cape"}, dark clothing, boots, and clenched fists, looking over a dense futuristic metropolis at night. A large warm full moon glows in the sky behind scattered clouds, with countless skyscrapers and lit windows below. Include exactly 3 narrow vertical comic panels along the far right edge: top panel with dark high-rise buildings and glowing windows, middle panel with a silhouetted water tower on rooftops, bottom panel with a golden city perspective and utility lines. The diagonal boundary between sketch and finished art should sparkle like burning golden embers, as if the drawing is transforming from pencil draft into completed comic art. Surround the paper with real drawing tools: one wooden pencil on the lower left, two metallic pens or markers at the lower right, a metal cup partially visible at the upper right, and faint papers or drafting sheets in the upper left background. Use high-detail ink hatching, halftone comic texture, deep shadows, warm moonlight, cool blue night colors, and realistic desk lighting. No speech bubbles, no captions, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影质感的桌面场景，展示一幅正在创作中的漫画插画，拍摄角度为略微俯视的深色木质桌面。画面主体是一张巨大的漫画纸，被一道锯齿状的发光过渡线对角分割：左半部分是粗糙的石墨铅笔草图，右半部分是完全上墨并着色的漫画页面。左侧展示未来城市天际线和一名孤独披风英雄背影的松散构图线条，呈现灰色铅笔笔触、涂抹痕迹、橡皮屑和草图标记。右侧渲染成品版本，采用戏剧性的深蓝色和金色调：同一位英雄站在屋顶边缘，背对镜头，拥有 {argument name="hair style" default="黑色尖刺发型"}，长长的 {argument name="cape color" default="深蓝色披风"} 在风中飘动，身着深色服装，穿着靴子，紧握双拳，俯瞰着夜晚密集的未来大都市。一轮巨大的暖色满月在云层后发光，下方是无数摩天大楼和明亮的窗户。在最右侧边缘包含 3 个狭窄的垂直漫画分镜：顶部面板是黑暗的高层建筑和发光的窗户，中间面板是屋顶上的水塔剪影，底部面板是金色的城市透视和电线。草图与成品艺术之间的对角边界应像燃烧的金色余烬一样闪烁，仿佛画作正在从铅笔草稿转变为完整的漫画艺术。在纸张周围放置真实的绘图工具：左下角有一支木铅笔，右下角有两支金属笔或马克笔，右上角隐约可见一个金属杯，左上角背景中有模糊的纸张或绘图纸。使用高细节的墨水排线、半色调漫画纹理、深邃的阴影、温暖的月光、冷蓝色的夜色以及写实的桌面光影。不要包含对话气泡、标题、可读文字、标志或水印。

templates.title: Satoru Gojo Anime Propaganda Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 五条悟动漫宣传海报

templates.prompt:
Create a vertical Japanese anime propaganda poster for {argument name="character name" default="Satoru Gojo"} from Jujutsu Kaisen, with a consistent hierarchical main visual composition and dramatic ink-wash collage style. Canvas: portrait 3:4 poster on warm off-white aged paper with subtle grain, dust specks, faint scratches, and scattered ink splatters. Visual hierarchy: the top half is dominated by an enormous right-facing side profile of Gojo wearing a black blindfold, smiling slightly, with spiky white hair exploding upward into translucent feather-like shards and blue-purple energy strokes. In the center foreground place a full-body Gojo walking toward the viewer, tall and slim in a high-collar black uniform, blindfolded, one hand in his pocket and the other raised with two fingers extended; red cursed-energy lightning coils around his torso and legs. Use deep indigo, violet, blue, black, white, and crimson accents, with painterly splashes and sharp manga linework.

Composition details: include exactly 6 smaller character/story vignettes blended into the ink cloud around the main figure: 1) a blue-haired male silhouette near the upper left within the hair/energy mass, 2) a white-haired blindfolded smaller Gojo in profile at upper left, 3) a dark standing figure facing the central energy on the mid-right, 4) a small lone silhouette in the lower-left mist, 5) a group of three small figures walking in the lower middle background, and 6) a red-haired/pink-haired male with a black blindfold or markings in the lower-right brush splash. Add exactly 4 environmental motifs: 1) a traditional Japanese temple building on the mid-right, 2) a modern city skyline at bottom center, 3) a red torii gate at the lower foreground behind the central figure’s legs, and 4) tiny bird silhouettes in the white margins. Keep all secondary elements partially dissolved into blue and purple watercolor smoke.

Text layout: on the left side, large vertical Japanese brush-calligraphy reading {argument name="large Japanese title" default="五条悟"}, painted in dark navy ink. Beside it add small vertical roman text reading “SATORU GOJO” and a small red seal with Japanese characters. On the right side, add clean vertical Japanese text reading {argument name="right side slogan" default="最強の呪術師 — 五条悟"}, with a small circular emblem and the Japanese series title beneath it. On the lower left, add smaller vertical Japanese text reading {argument name="lower left quote" default="大丈夫 僕 最強だから"}, mixing black and muted red characters. Overall mood: heroic, mythic, national-poster-like propaganda energy without real-world politics, elegant manga poster design, high detail, strong central silhouette, layered ink splashes, luminous cursed energy, crisp face profile, no English headline except the small “SATORU GOJO,” no watermark, no extra characters beyond the listed vignettes.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张竖版日式动漫宣传海报，主角为《咒术回战》中的 {argument name="character name" default="五条悟"}，采用统一的层级化主视觉构图和戏剧性的水墨拼贴风格。画布：3:4 竖向海报，采用带有细微颗粒、灰尘斑点、轻微划痕和零星墨迹的暖色调米白色旧纸质感。视觉层级：上半部分由一个巨大的五条悟右侧面特写占据，他戴着黑色眼罩，嘴角微扬，刺猬般的白发向上炸开，化作半透明的羽毛状碎片和蓝紫色能量流。画面中央前景放置一个全身五条悟，正向观众走来，身形高挑纤细，穿着高领黑色制服，戴着眼罩，一只手插在口袋里，另一只手抬起并伸出两根手指；红色的咒力闪电缠绕在他的躯干和双腿周围。使用深靛蓝、紫罗兰、蓝、黑、白和深红作为点缀，结合写意的水墨飞溅和锐利的漫画线条。

构图细节：在主人物周围的墨云中融入 6 个较小的角色/故事小图：1) 左上方发丝/能量团中有一个蓝发男性剪影，2) 左上方有一个白发戴眼罩的小型五条悟侧影，3) 中右侧有一个面对中央能量的深色站立身影，4) 左下角迷雾中有一个孤独的小剪影，5) 下方背景中央有三个行走的小人，6) 右下角墨迹中有一个红发/粉发男性，戴着黑色眼罩或带有纹路。添加 4 个环境元素：1) 中右侧的一座传统日式寺庙建筑，2) 底部中央的现代城市天际线，3) 中央人物腿部后方前景处的一座红色鸟居，4) 白色留白处微小的鸟群剪影。保持所有次要元素部分溶解在蓝紫色的水彩烟雾中。

文字排版：左侧放置巨大的竖排日式毛笔书法，内容为 {argument name="large Japanese title" default="五条悟"}，用深海军蓝墨水书写。旁边添加小号竖排罗马字母“SATORU GOJO”以及一枚带有日文的小红印章。右侧添加整洁的竖排日文，内容为 {argument name="right side slogan" default="最強の呪術師 — 五条悟"}，下方配有一个小圆形徽章和日文系列标题。左下方添加较小的竖排日文，内容为 {argument name="lower left quote" default="大丈夫 僕 最強だから"}，混合黑色和暗红色文字。整体氛围：英雄主义、神话感、具有国家宣传海报般的张力（不涉及现实政治）、优雅的漫画海报设计、高细节、强有力的中心剪影、分层水墨飞溅、发光的咒力、清晰的面部轮廓，除小号“SATORU GOJO”外无其他英文标题，无水印，除列出的细节外无多余角色。

templates.title: Watercolor to Reality Beijing CBD Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩幻化现实：北京 CBD 海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical city poster showing {argument name="city district" default="Beijing Guomao CBD"} transforming from watercolor painting into photorealism. The canvas is portrait-oriented, about 4:5, with a seamless left-to-right transition: the left half is a loose watercolor illustration with visible paper texture, splattered pigment edges, soft pastel washes in blue, lavender, peach, yellow, and teal, while the right half gradually becomes a crisp realistic aerial city photograph under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. The skyline must feature the Beijing CBD landmarks: the tall China Zun tower dominating the right side, the CCTV Headquarters angular loop building near the center-right, and multiple glass skyscrapers on the left-center, with broad roads, traffic lanes, trees, low-rise blocks, and urban avenues visible below. Add elegant Chinese title typography in the upper-left reading {argument name="headline text" default="国贸CBD"}, with a thin horizontal divider line beneath it and smaller subtitle text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="从水彩到现实"}. Use warm late-afternoon sunlight, high detail on the realistic side, dreamy translucent watercolor blooms on the painted side, and make the boundary between painting and reality feel poetic and fluid, as if the city is waking from a scroll. No people, no watermark, no extra labels.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版城市海报，展示 {argument name="city district" default="北京国贸 CBD"} 从水彩画转变为写实摄影的过程。画布为竖构图，比例约为 4:5，呈现从左到右的无缝过渡：左半部分为写意水彩插画，保留明显的纸张纹理和颜料喷溅边缘，采用蓝色、淡紫色、桃色、黄色和青色的柔和色调；右半部分逐渐过渡为在明亮蓝天和稀疏云层下，清晰写实的城市航拍照片。天际线必须包含北京 CBD 的地标建筑：右侧高耸的中国尊大厦，中右侧 CCTV 总部大楼（大裤衩），以及左中部的多座玻璃摩天大楼，下方可见宽阔的道路、车道、树木、低层建筑和城市大道。在左上方添加优雅的中文字体标题 {argument name="headline text" default="国贸CBD"}，下方配有一条细横分割线，以及较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="从水彩到现实"}。采用温暖的午后阳光，写实侧细节丰富，绘画侧呈现梦幻般的半透明水彩晕染效果，使绘画与现实之间的界限充满诗意与流动感，仿佛城市正从画卷中苏醒。画面中不包含人物，无水印，无额外标签。

templates.title: Tilt-Shift Palace Corridor Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 移轴宫殿长廊对比

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark editorial benchmark comparison card for {argument name="headline text" default="Tilt-shift palace corridor — avant-garde"}, comparing two generated fashion images in a palace corridor.

Canvas: Square 1024×1024 social media graphic with a nearly black warm-brown background, thin divider lines, and a refined fashion/tech review aesthetic.

Layout: Use exactly 2 stacked image panels centered horizontally, each with a palace corridor fashion render. The top panel is larger and begins near the upper third; the bottom panel sits directly below with a thin horizontal separator between them. Add a small header at the very top left reading “FASHION EDITORIAL · TECHNICAL LIGHTING”. Add a bottom caption band with the headline, a score-delta pill, a short note, and subtle branding.

Panel 1: A high-quality fashion editorial render labeled near the top left “GPT IMAGE · HIGH” and marked with a coral rounded “WINNER” badge near the top right. Show a full-body avant-garde model standing centered in a grand arched palace corridor with perfect one-point perspective, tall columns, classical statues, bright window light, and strong tilt-shift depth blur toward the distance. The model wears a geometric black, cream, and gray structured dress with sharp diagonal stripes, symmetrical shoulder panels, a cinched waist, a wide skirt with black diamond shapes, and a small architectural circular handbag held at the right side. The face should be intentionally blurred/obscured. Add a large white score “{argument name="top score" default="3.7"}” at the lower right of the panel.

Panel 2: A lower-quality competing render labeled near the top left “NANO BANANA PRO”. Show the same concept but less accurate: a centered model in the same sunlit vaulted palace corridor, warmer golden lighting, strong blur, less perfect geometry, and a flatter/less faithful outfit. The model holds an architectural circular object across the chest, with the face also blurred/obscured. Add a large translucent gray score “{argument name="bottom score" default="2.8"}” at the lower right of this panel.

Bottom text content: In the lower band, display the headline “{argument name="headline text" default="Tilt-shift palace corridor — avant-garde"}” in bold white. Beneath it place one coral pill reading “{argument name="score delta" default="GPT +0.9"}”, followed by the note “Perfect one-point perspective, geometric outfit fidelity”. Put a small orange V-shaped logo and the word “vibedex” at bottom left, and a faint “@vibedex” at bottom right.

Visual style: Premium dark UI, muted cream and black palette, coral accents, clean sans-serif typography, crisp alignment, cinematic shadows, shallow depth of field, editorial fashion lighting, and subtle grain.

Constraints: Include exactly 2 image panels, exactly 2 score numbers, exactly 2 model figures, exactly 1 winner badge, exactly 1 headline, exactly 1 score-delta pill, and exactly 2 brand marks. Preserve the split-screen benchmark layout and avoid adding extra charts, buttons, or decorative icons.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个深色调的编辑基准对比卡片，用于 {argument name="headline text" default="移轴宫殿长廊 — 先锋风格"}，对比两张在宫殿长廊中生成的时尚图像。

画布：1024×1024 正方形社交媒体图形，采用近乎黑色的暖棕色背景、细分割线，以及精致的时尚/科技评论美学。

布局：使用 2 个垂直堆叠且水平居中的图像面板，每个面板展示一张宫殿长廊时尚渲染图。顶部面板较大，起始位置靠近上方三分之一处；底部面板紧随其后，中间由一条细水平分割线隔开。在左上角添加一个小标题，文字为“FASHION EDITORIAL · TECHNICAL LIGHTING”。在底部添加一个标题栏，包含标题、评分差值胶囊、简短注释以及微妙的品牌标识。

面板 1：一张高质量时尚编辑渲染图，左上角标注“GPT IMAGE · HIGH”，右上角标记一个珊瑚色圆角“WINNER”徽章。展示一位全身先锋模特站在宏伟的拱形宫殿长廊中央，具有完美的单点透视、高大的柱子、古典雕像、明亮的窗光，以及向远处延伸的强烈移轴景深模糊。模特身着几何形状的黑、米、灰结构化连衣裙，带有锐利的对角条纹、对称肩部设计、收腰剪裁、带有黑色菱形图案的宽裙摆，右侧手持一个小巧的建筑感圆形手袋。面部应刻意模糊/遮挡。在面板右下角添加一个白色大字评分“{argument name="top score" default="3.7"}”。

面板 2：一张质量较低的竞品渲染图，左上角标注“NANO BANANA PRO”。展示相同概念但准确度较低的画面：模特位于同样的阳光照射拱形宫殿长廊中央，光线更偏暖金，模糊效果强烈，几何结构不够完美，服装还原度较低且显得扁平。模特胸前抱着一个建筑感圆形物体，面部同样模糊/遮挡。在此面板右下角添加一个半透明灰色大字评分“{argument name="bottom score" default="2.8"}”。

底部文本内容：在底部栏中，以粗体白色显示标题“{argument name="headline text" default="移轴宫殿长廊 — 先锋风格"}”。下方放置一个珊瑚色胶囊，文字为“{argument name="score delta" default="GPT +0.9"}”，随后附注“完美的单点透视，几何服装还原度高”。左下角放置一个小型橙色 V 形标志和“vibedex”字样，右下角放置淡色的“@vibedex”。

视觉风格：高级深色 UI，柔和的米色与黑色调，珊瑚色点缀，简洁的无衬线字体，清晰的对齐，电影级阴影，浅景深，编辑级时尚灯光，以及微妙的颗粒感。

约束：包含 2 个图像面板，2 个评分数字，2 个模特形象，1 个获胜徽章，1 个标题，1 个评分差值胶囊，以及 2 个品牌标识。保持分屏基准布局，避免添加额外的图表、按钮或装饰性图标。

templates.title: Harajuku Kawaii Graffiti Mural

titleLocalized.zh: 原宿 Kawaii 涂鸦壁画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a photorealistic dusk street-scene image of a Harajuku Takeshita Street style POP graffiti mural featuring an original anime girl named {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"} painted directly on a long concrete alley wall.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, wide-angle street photography perspective, looking diagonally down a narrow urban alley. The mural covers the entire left wall and recedes into the distance. Wet dark asphalt pavement, curb at the base of the wall, dense power lines and building facades in the background, blue evening sky.

Main subject: A huge kawaii anime mural of one girl, centered slightly left. She has {argument name="hair color" default="silvery blonde"} long wavy twin-tail hair with soft bangs, large sparkling blue eyes, flushed cheeks, a tiny open mouth, and a shy cute expression. She wears a pale blue frilly Harajuku fashion outfit with lace, bows, heart accessories, butterfly-like decorations, and a headband with blue bows. Her pose is slightly leaning forward with hands near her skirt, rendered as a polished anime illustration but convincingly painted on rough wall texture.

Graffiti layout and text: Include exactly 5 prominent readable text areas: 1) a cloud bubble near the upper left reading "HARAJUKU DREAM", 2) huge bubble-letter Japanese-style name text reading "のぞむ", 3) large Roman letters below it reading "NOZOMU", 4) a small bubble reading "TAKESHITA POP", 5) lower-left bubble letters reading "KAWAII STREET". Make the lettering pink, lavender, cyan, and white with thick outlines, spray-paint texture, drips, and highlights.

Decorative mural elements: Include exactly 8 large kawaii motifs around the character: 1) a large blue heart balloon with a pink star on the left, 2) a large smiling blue heart balloon on the upper right, 3) a red-pink heart balloon on the mid-right, 4) a small fluffy white cloud mascot near the lower right, 5) a round pink seal-like mascot at the bottom right, 6) a teddy-bear doodle near the bottom center-left, 7) a cloud-shaped title bubble at top left, 8) a small cluster of pastel hearts and sparkle doodles around the name. Add smaller hearts, stars, bubbles, paint drips, and pop-graffiti outlines, but keep the 8 large motifs clearly distinguishable.

Lighting and environment: Warm rectangular wall lamps mounted above the mural create pools of golden light and glossy highlights on the painted wall, contrasting with cool twilight blue ambient light. Show the wall texture, seams between concrete blocks, spray paint grain, weathering, and a few spray paint cans placed on the curb in front of the mural.

Visual style: Blend realistic Japanese backstreet photography with ultra-cute pastel anime street art. Color palette: {argument name="color palette" default="cotton-candy pink, sky blue, lavender, cream, and neon cyan"}. High detail, vibrant saturation, cinematic dusk lighting, authentic Harajuku alley atmosphere, no people walking in front of the mural, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张照片级逼真的黄昏街景图像，展示原宿竹下通风格的波普涂鸦壁画，壁画直接绘制在狭长的混凝土巷道墙面上，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"} 的原创动漫少女。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，广角街拍视角，沿狭窄的城市巷道斜向延伸。壁画覆盖整个左侧墙面并向远处延伸。潮湿的深色沥青路面，墙基处有路缘石，背景为密集的电线和建筑立面，天空呈现深蓝色黄昏色调。

主体：一幅巨大的 Kawaii 动漫少女壁画，位置略微偏左。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银金色"} 的长波浪双马尾，配有柔软的刘海，大而闪烁的蓝色眼睛，红润的双颊，微张的小嘴，表情羞涩可爱。她身穿淡蓝色原宿风荷叶边服饰，点缀着蕾丝、蝴蝶结、心形配饰、蝴蝶状装饰以及带有蓝色蝴蝶结的发带。她的姿势略微前倾，双手靠近裙摆，呈现出精致的动漫插画质感，并真实地融入粗糙的墙面纹理中。

涂鸦布局与文字：包含 5 个清晰可读的文字区域：1) 左上方云朵气泡文字“HARAJUKU DREAM”，2) 下方巨大的日式气泡字体“のぞむ”，3) 其下方的大号罗马字母“NOZOMU”，4) 一个写着“TAKESHITA POP”的小气泡，5) 左下角写着“KAWAII STREET”的气泡字体。文字采用粉色、淡紫色、青色和白色，带有粗轮廓、喷漆质感、流漆效果和高光。

壁画装饰元素：在角色周围包含 8 个醒目的 Kawaii 主题图案：1) 左侧一个带有粉色星星的大号蓝色心形气球，2) 右上方一个微笑的蓝色心形气球，3) 右侧中部一个红粉色心形气球，4) 右下方一个小巧蓬松的白色云朵吉祥物，5) 右下角一个圆形的粉色海豹状吉祥物，6) 左下中心附近的一个泰迪熊涂鸦，7) 左上角的云朵标题气泡，8) 名字周围的一簇粉彩心形和闪光涂鸦。添加较小的心形、星星、气泡、油漆滴和波普涂鸦轮廓，确保 8 个大型图案清晰可辨。

光影与环境：壁画上方安装的矩形暖色壁灯在墙面上投射出金色的光斑和光泽，与清冷的黄昏蓝色环境光形成对比。展现墙面纹理、混凝土块之间的接缝、喷漆颗粒、风化痕迹，并在壁画前的路缘石上放置几个喷漆罐。

视觉风格：将写实的日本后巷摄影与超可爱的粉彩动漫街头艺术相结合。配色方案：{argument name="color palette" default="棉花糖粉、天蓝、淡紫、奶油色和霓虹青色"}。高细节、鲜艳饱和度、电影级黄昏光影、地道的原宿巷道氛围，壁画前无人走动，无水印。

templates.title: Solara Art Nouveau Sun Goddess Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Solara 新艺术运动风格太阳女神海报

templates.prompt: Create an elegant vertical Art Nouveau poster for {argument name="goddess name" default="SOLARA"}, a radiant sun goddess standing front-facing in a graceful symmetrical pose. She has long flowing auburn-brown hair streaming outward, crowned with a lavish floral wreath and golden ornaments, with a glowing circular sun halo behind her head and large stylized golden sun rays filling the upper background. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain vertical rectangle in warm brown, centered over the face area. She wears a deep crimson and burgundy Greco-Roman draped dress with gold floral patterning, thin straps, and ornate gold chains; a large sun medallion sits at her chest with delicate dangling chains. Add gold jewelry including bracelets, arm bands, a necklace, and small ornamental medallions. Her arms extend outward as she lightly holds the flowing fabric of her dress and scarf-like sleeves. The background is rich dark red and burnt orange with luxurious antique gold linework, swirling ornamental curves, vines, and floral motifs. Include exactly two large sunflower arrangements in the top left and top right corners, plus one sunflower motif near the lower right corner, with additional smaller leaves and vine details throughout. Frame the entire poster with a thin decorative gold border and rounded Art Nouveau corner ornaments. At the bottom, place a dark red framed title plaque with ornate gold trim. Text on the plaque: large serif title "{argument name="headline text" default="SOLARA"}"; below it smaller French subtitle "{argument name="subtitle text" default="DÉESSE DU SOLEIL"}"; below that two centered lines in small gold capitals: "SOURCE DE VIE • LUMIÈRE ÉTERNELLE" and "FLAMME DU JOUR • CHALEUR SACRÉE"; at the very bottom center write "PARIS" with a tiny gold floral divider. Use a refined European vintage poster style inspired by Alphonse Mucha, with flat decorative illustration, intricate gold detailing, aged paper grain, muted crimson, ochre, amber, and antique gold palette, slightly distressed print texture, and no modern elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张优雅的竖版新艺术运动风格海报，主角是 {argument name="goddess name" default="SOLARA"}，一位光芒四射的太阳女神，以优雅对称的姿态正面站立。她拥有一头向外飘逸的长红棕色秀发，头戴奢华的花环和金色饰品，脑后有一个发光的圆形太阳光环，巨大的程式化金色太阳光束填满了背景上方。她的面部被一个位于脸部区域中心的暖棕色纯色竖长方形刻意遮挡。她身穿深绯红色和酒红色的希腊罗马式垂褶长裙，饰有金色花卉图案、细肩带和华丽的金链；胸前佩戴一枚巨大的太阳奖章，并挂有精致的垂坠链条。添加金色首饰，包括手镯、臂环、项链和小型装饰奖章。她的双臂向外伸展，轻轻托起长裙和围巾般的袖子。背景为浓郁的深红色和焦橙色，配以奢华的古金色线条、旋转的装饰曲线、藤蔓和花卉图案。在左上角和右上角各放置一束大型向日葵，右下角附近放置一个向日葵图案，并在各处点缀较小的叶子和藤蔓细节。用细窄的装饰性金边和圆润的新艺术风格边角装饰整个海报。在底部放置一个带有华丽金边的深红色标题牌。标题牌上的文字：大号衬线标题 "{argument name="headline text" default="SOLARA"}"；下方是较小的法文副标题 "{argument name="subtitle text" default="DÉESSE DU SOLEIL"}"；再下方是两行居中的小号金色大写字母："SOURCE DE VIE • LUMIÈRE ÉTERNELLE" 和 "FLAMME DU JOUR • CHALEUR SACRÉE"；最底部中心写上 "PARIS"，并配有一个微小的金色花卉分隔符。采用受 Alphonse Mucha 启发的高雅欧洲复古海报风格，运用扁平装饰插画、复杂的金色细节、陈旧纸张纹理、柔和的绯红、赭石、琥珀和古金配色，呈现轻微磨损的印刷质感，且不包含任何现代元素。

templates.title: Futuristic City Singularity

titleLocalized.zh: 未来城市奇点

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic sci-fi cityscape showing a vast futuristic megacity at night in monochrome {argument name="color palette" default="black, white, and cold silver-gray"}. The viewpoint is a high aerial perspective looking down across an endless dense skyline of countless narrow skyscrapers, towers, and glowing city grids stretching to a hazy horizon. In the right-center foreground, place a colossal circular black void or artificial singularity embedded in the city, like a perfectly dark bottomless hole, surrounded by bright concentric rings of light trails that spiral around it like an accretion disk. The luminous rings should be made of many fine white and silver lines, suggesting extreme speed, orbital traffic, data streams, or gravitational distortion. Tall buildings cluster tightly around and beneath the vortex, with some needle-like spires rising above the light rings; emphasize intricate architectural detail, glowing windows, reflective metallic surfaces, and immense scale. The atmosphere should feel ominous, awe-inspiring, and futuristic, with mist, fog, bloom, and a soft bright horizon band under a dark sky. Use ultra-detailed photorealistic digital matte painting style, high contrast, deep blacks, volumetric haze, sharp skyscraper silhouettes, and cinematic lighting. No people, vehicles, signs, logos, or readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直构图的电影级科幻城市景观，展现夜晚一座广阔的未来大都市，采用单色调 {argument name="color palette" default="黑、白、冷银灰色"}。视角为高空俯瞰，俯视着无尽且密集的城市天际线，无数狭窄的摩天大楼、塔楼和发光的城市网格延伸至朦胧的地平线。在画面中右侧前景处，放置一个巨大的圆形黑色虚空或人工奇点，嵌入城市之中，如同一个完美黑暗的无底洞，周围环绕着明亮的同心光环，像吸积盘一样围绕其旋转。发光环应由许多细密的白色和银色线条组成，暗示极高的速度、轨道交通、数据流或引力畸变。高大的建筑在漩涡周围和下方紧密聚集，一些针状尖塔耸立在光环之上；强调复杂的建筑细节、发光的窗户、反光的金属表面以及宏大的规模。氛围应营造出不祥、令人敬畏且充满未来感的感觉，在黑暗的天空下伴有薄雾、雾气、光晕和柔和明亮的地平线带。采用超精细的写实数字绘景风格，高对比度，深黑色，体积雾，锐利的摩天大楼剪影和电影级布光。画面中不应出现人物、车辆、标志、Logo 或可读文字。

templates.title: Neon Kawaii Punk Graffiti Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹卡哇伊朋克涂鸦肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cyberpunk punk-girl portrait in a dark neon graffiti alley, photographed like a high-contrast fashion editorial with blacklight lighting. A young woman kneels low in the center foreground, her face deliberately obscured by a solid muted purple rectangular block, with long dark hair and vivid purple highlights in a high ponytail. She wears a black paint-splattered oversized jacket, black crop top with a glowing cat face graphic, dark denim shorts, layered chokers and necklaces, thigh straps, black platform combat boots, black nail polish, and splashes of hot pink, cyan, and violet paint across her clothes and legs. She holds exactly two spray paint cans: one in her left hand extended toward the viewer and one upright in her right hand. Beside her on the lower right sits exactly one black cat with green eyes, a collar charm, neon paint splatters on its fur, and a glowing pink crown graffiti mark above its head. The background is a dense black wall covered in dripping neon graffiti, arcade-game doodles, hearts, cats, and text in magenta, cyan, and violet. Include exactly 8 prominent readable graffiti text elements: “{argument name="large left graffiti" default="KAWAIIII"}” at upper left in hot pink dripping letters, “NO O” below it, “NEE-CHAN” large at left-center, “{argument name="upper right graffiti" default="DAIISUKKI"}” at upper right in hot pink, “{argument name="blue name graffiti" default="KAWASHO-CHAN"}” at right-center in cyan, “GAME OVER” on the left, “LEVEL UP!” on the lower right, and “LOVE UP!” in a small sign near the cat. Include exactly 6 main icon groups: a purple cat face doodle on the left wall, a neon cat head near the top center, a skull with heart eyes near the upper right, an HP bar with 7 heart icons, repeated xoxo marks in cyan, and several dripping heart outlines. Use wet paint drips, splatters, glow bloom, saturated magenta/cyan rim light, gritty texture, shallow depth of field, and an intense rebellious kawaii-goth mood. No extra people, no watermark, no additional readable text beyond the specified graffiti.

templates.title: Winter Anime Realism Sequence

titleLocalized.zh: 冬季动漫写实序列

templates.prompt:
Cinematic cozy winter anime realism sequence of a fluffy white ragdoll cat wandering through a snowy Japanese town at night, wearing a knitted scarf and warm winter coat. Snow gently falls under glowing red lanterns while icy streets reflect warm shop lights. The cat slowly walks past tiny ramen shops, steaming food stalls, and snow-covered bicycles parked beside wooden buildings. Soft ambient snowfall and cold winter wind create a peaceful emotional atmosphere.
The cat enters a cozy fish market tucked beneath glowing lanterns and snowy rooftops. Cinematic close-up shots of fresh salmon and tuna resting on crushed ice, warm steam rising from nearby soup stalls, snowflakes melting on wooden counters. Friendly seafood vendors wrap fresh fish while the cat carefully chooses dinner ingredients. Cozy winter ambience with soft chatter and distant train sounds.
Next, the cat stops at a small roadside sweet potato and roasted chestnut stand beside a snowy alley. Slow-motion shots of steam rising from hot roasted snacks, glowing charcoal fire, warm hands exchanging food. The cat places roasted chestnuts into a small canvas tote bag while snow continues falling softly around lantern-lit streets.
The cat walks home through quiet snow-covered Japanese backstreets at blue hour dusk. Cinematic wide shots of snowy rooftops, glowing vending machines, distant temple bells, and warm apartment windows. Footprints form behind the cat in fresh snow while soft wind carries snowflakes through narrow alleyways.
Inside a tiny wooden apartment, the cat relaxes beside a heater and takes a warm bubble bath with steam filling the room. Cozy close-ups of fluffy fur drying beside glowing lamps and knitted blankets. Snow continues falling outside the frosted window.
Final cooking sequence shows cinematic close-ups of fish frying in a pan with sizzling butter and steam, warm golden lighting filling the kitchen. The cat prepares hot soup and roasted chestnuts while snowfall glows softly outside the window. Final emotional scene of the cat sitting beside the snowy window eating dinner peacefully while warm lantern lights reflect across the icy night streets, ultra detailed winter atmosphere, Studio Ghibli inspired realism, cinematic camera movement, shallow depth of field, realistic snow and steam physics, emotional cozy storytelling, 4K animated film quality.”

promptLocalized.zh:
电影级舒适冬季动漫写实序列：一只毛茸茸的布偶猫在夜晚的雪中日本小镇漫步，戴着针织围巾，穿着温暖的冬装。在红灯笼的映照下，雪花轻轻飘落，冰冷的街道反射着温暖的店铺灯光。猫咪缓缓走过小巧的拉面店、冒着热气的食品摊位，以及停在木质建筑旁的积雪自行车。柔和的降雪环境和寒冷的冬风营造出宁静的情感氛围。
猫咪走进了一个隐藏在灯笼和雪顶下的舒适鱼市场。电影级特写镜头展示了放在碎冰上的新鲜三文鱼和金枪鱼，附近汤摊冒出的热气，以及在木质柜台上融化的雪花。友好的海鲜摊贩正在包装鲜鱼，而猫咪则在仔细挑选晚餐食材。舒适的冬季氛围中夹杂着轻柔的交谈声和远处的火车声。
接着，猫咪停在雪中巷子旁的一个小型烤红薯和糖炒栗子摊位前。慢动作镜头捕捉着热腾腾小吃冒出的蒸汽、发光的木炭火，以及温暖的手交换食物的瞬间。猫咪将烤栗子放入一个小帆布袋中，雪花继续在灯火通明的街道上轻轻飘落。

Each frame shows a different confident bike pose and attitude. Include these 12 pose concepts:

1. Engine Check – standing beside the bike while checking the engine
2. Helmet Hold – holding a helmet confidently
3. Ride Pause – casual standing pose near the bike
4. Street Rider – aggressive riding posture
5. Side Rev – leaning sideways on the bike
6. Midnight Roll – sporty nighttime riding vibe
7. Lean Ride – turning slightly while riding
8. Road Drift – dynamic drifting motion
9. Silent Speed – calm cinematic standing pose
10. Motion Blur – high-speed action effect
11. Neon Stop – neon cyberpunk lighting with glowing reflections

Art style: trendy Instagram illustration, soft shadows, polished anime rendering, aesthetic poster composition, clean typography labels under each frame, highly detailed black superbike, cinematic mood, smooth color palette, modern youth fashion, editorial illustration quality. White/beige minimal background with subtle road textures. High detail, ultra clean composition, vertical poster format.

包含以下 12 个姿势概念：

templates.title: Rainy Day Kitchen Life Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 雨天厨房生活肖像

templates.prompt: A medium-shot authentic daily life photograph, natural candid moment, of an {argument name="subject" default="East Asian young woman"} standing at a kitchen window on a rain-grey afternoon. 85mm lens, waist-up framing, shallow depth of field. Behind her: dark wooden kitchen surfaces, a single porcelain bowl upturned to dry, the window glass blurred with rain-diffused light outside. East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes looking toward the window, quiet and unfocused, the expression of someone watching rain without expectation. Delicate straight nose. Skin tone fair beige, the overcast light removing all shadow, flattening her complexion to something almost porcelain. Skin subsurface scattering visible under directional light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge, fine foundation powder grain perceptible. She wears a {argument name="clothing" default="moss green silk qipao"} with bamboo-stalk embroidery in tones of grey-green and dark earth — the pattern modest and close to the fabric's own color, the green carrying the weight of old growth. Mandarin collar, short sleeves. She stands at the window ledge with both hands resting on the sill, looking out at the grey. An overturned bowl, a folded cloth — nothing more. Two or three stray hairs displaced by faint air movement, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical. Rainy overcast light — flat, cool, shadowless — floods the kitchen without warmth. The moss green absorbs it like lichen absorbs shade. No contrast, no drama. Mood: the particular peace of rain as permission to do nothing. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 9:16 . No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张中景真实日常生活摄影，捕捉自然的抓拍瞬间，画面中是一位 {argument name="subject" default="东亚年轻女性"} 站在雨天午后的厨房窗前。85mm 镜头，腰部以上构图，浅景深。背景：深色木质厨房台面，一个倒扣晾干的瓷碗，窗玻璃上模糊着窗外雨水漫射的光线。东亚年轻女性，20 岁出头。杏仁眼望向窗外，安静且失焦，那是看着雨水时毫无期待的神情。鼻梁挺直秀气。肤色白皙偏米色，阴天光线消除了所有阴影，使她的肤色呈现出近乎瓷器的质感。在定向光线下可见皮肤的次表面散射，颧骨和鼻梁上有微弱的镜面高光，可以察觉到细腻的粉底颗粒。她身穿一件 {argument name="clothing" default="苔藓绿丝绸旗袍"}，上面绣有灰绿色和深土色的竹茎刺绣——图案素雅且与面料颜色相近，绿色带有古老植被的厚重感。立领，短袖。她站在窗台边，双手轻搭在窗台上，望着灰蒙蒙的窗外。一个倒扣的碗，一块折叠的布——仅此而已。两三缕发丝被微风吹乱，呈现出自然的、非刻意的瑕疵，而非几何对称。雨天阴沉的光线——平淡、冷色调、无阴影——毫无暖意地充盈着厨房。苔藓绿像地衣吸收阴影一样吸收了光线。没有对比，没有戏剧性。氛围：雨天带来的那种允许自己什么都不做的独特宁静。阴影区域有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，呈现摄影噪点纹理，而非 CG 渲染的平滑感。长宽比 9:16。无水印，无文字叠加，非卡通，非数字绘画，非插画，非动漫。

Lighting/mood: brilliant high-altitude midday sun, visible lens flare near the upper left, sparkling backlight, bright optimistic mood, high clarity, realistic shadows on grass. Negative Prompt：watermark, logo, text, caption, signature, AI label, brand mark, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, deformed hands, oversized malformed palm, asymmetrical eyes, crossed eyes, warped face, plastic skin, waxy skin, over-smoothed beauty filter, blurry face, low detail, low resolution, heavy compression artifacts, distorted anatomy, duplicate person, bad perspective, bent flag strings, warped flags, fake CGI look, overexposed face, muddy colors

templates.title: Korean Classroom Golden Hour Portrait

templates.prompt: Ultra-realistic portrait of a beautiful Korean woman seated confidently on top of a wooden classroom desk during late afternoon golden hour, captured in a cinematic film photography style. Camera positioned directly in front at a slight low angle. She sits poised on the desk facing the camera, feet resting on the desk's edge, knees together and angled slightly to one side. Both hands resting lightly on the desk surface beside her hips, torso upright with relaxed confidence. Expression direct and composed — eyes locked into the lens, jaw relaxed, lips softly closed with quiet self-assurance. Chin level, posture open and elegant. Wearing a delicate {argument name="outfit style" default="pink lace corset-style mini dress"} with thin spaghetti straps — the bodice featuring a sheer lace overlay with intricate floral embroidery, a crystal rhinestone brooch at the center chest, and a row of pearl embellishments lining the waistband. The skirt is layered pink {argument name="material" default="tulle and organza"}, pleated and adorned with small 3D white floral appliqués, falling softly mid-thigh, the tulle catching and diffusing golden classroom light beautifully. Delicate silver chain bracelet on one wrist, thin silver necklace at the collarbone. White low-top sneakers. Long dark brown hair loose and natural, falling over both shoulders. Dewy glass skin, flushed cheeks, barely-there tinted lip, soft eye makeup. Canvas tote bag dropped casually on the desk beside her. Warm amber golden light flooding through tall classroom windows at a low angle, casting long shadows across the floor and desk surface. Dust motes floating in light beams. The pink tulle skirt glowing warmly, the lace bodice catching delicate rim highlights. Authentic Korean classroom setting — wooden desks, chalk-dusted green board with Korean writing, South Korean flag on the wall, old wall clock, stacked textbooks, worn polished flooring. {argument name="film stock" default="35mm analog film grain, Kodak Portra 400"} — the pink of the dress harmonizing with warm honey tones of the Portra palette, muted greens, soft creams. templates.title: Yeezy Fashion Campaign Collage

titleLocalized.zh: Yeezy 时尚广告拼贴画

templates.prompt:
Create a dark ultra-premium Yeezy fashion campaign collage titled:

“{argument name="title" default="AFTER MIDNIGHT"}.”

The composition should feel like:
a forbidden luxury streetwear editorial discovered through ripped underground posters, backstage fashion archives and late-night city photography.

Avoid:
bright commercial sneaker ads,
sports-brand energy,
or polished influencer aesthetics.

Instead:
the campaign should feel sensual,
moody,
minimal,
expensive and emotionally distant.

The layout should resemble:
a layered editorial wall collage built from:

- oversized fashion posters,
- torn paper textures,
- analog flash photography,
- handwritten notes,
- stitched magazine fragments,
- blurred polaroids,
- distressed print marks,
- fabric textures,
- and fragmented typography systems.

The collage should contain multiple interconnected fashion shots of the same male and female models across one sleepless urban night.

WARDROBE:

{argument name="wardrobe style" default="Muted Yeezy-inspired luxury minimalism"}:

- oversized washed hoodies,
- distressed layered fabrics,
- monochrome silhouettes,
- heavy boots,
- soft oversized coats,
- minimal jewelry,
- textured knitwear,
- loose neutral tailoring.

The styling should feel:
sensual through atmosphere and body language rather than exposed skin.

The models should appear:
emotionally detached,
intimate without smiling,
physically close but psychologically distant.

Examples:

- sitting silently in the backseat of a luxury car,
- standing under fluorescent motel lighting,
- leaning against concrete walls after rain,
- lying across wrinkled hotel sheets in oversized clothing,
- walking through empty parking structures at 3 AM,
- elevator mirror reflections,
- hands brushing subtly,
- soft eye contact through cigarette smoke and shadows.

No explicit nudity.
No exaggerated sexuality.

The sensuality should come from:

- tension,
- lighting,
- proximity,
- silence,
- fashion styling and realism.

VISUAL STYLE:

Blend:

- luxury fashion editorials,
- analog nightlife photography,
- underground Berlin fashion magazines,
- Yeezy Season campaign energy,
- cinematic urban loneliness,
- and tactile print-design aesthetics.

Typography should feel fragmented and emotionally cold:

- oversized serif text,
- handwritten notes,
- barcode fragments,
- faded timestamps,
- disconnected phrases,
- fashion-production markings.

Examples:
“NO SIGNAL.”
“2:17 AM.”
“TOO LATE TO LEAVE.”
“STATIC.”
“AFTER HOURS.”

No motivational slogans.

LIGHTING:

Low-light cinematic realism only:

- sodium-vapor streetlights,
- fluorescent elevator lighting,
- parking-garage shadows,
- passing headlights,
- warm hotel lamps,
- rainy reflections,
- harsh analog flash.

Use:

- realistic film grain,
- slight blur,
- lens imperfections,
- texture-heavy shadows,
- imperfect framing,
- realistic skin texture,
- muted contrast,
- atmospheric darkness.

COLOR PALETTE:

{argument name="colors" default="washed black, charcoal gray, warm tobacco brown, faded cream, industrial silver, dim amber l"}

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张暗黑极致奢华的 Yeezy 时尚广告拼贴画，标题为：

“{argument name="title" default="午夜之后"}”。

构图应呈现出：
一种通过撕裂的地下海报、后台时尚档案和深夜城市摄影所展现的禁忌奢华街头时尚社论感。

避免：

运动品牌活力、
或精致的网红美学。

相反：
该广告应呈现出感性、
忧郁、
极简、
昂贵且情感疏离的氛围。

布局应类似于：
一面由以下元素构成的分层社论墙拼贴画：

- 超大时尚海报、
- 撕裂的纸张纹理、
- 模拟闪光摄影、
- 手写笔记、
- 拼接的杂志碎片、
- 模糊的宝丽来照片、
- 磨损的印刷痕迹、
- 布料纹理、
- 以及碎片化的排版系统。

拼贴画应包含多张相互关联的时尚摄影，展示同一对男女模特在同一个不眠都市之夜的场景。

服装：

{argument name="wardrobe style" default="柔和的 Yeezy 风格奢华极简主义"}：

- 超大水洗连帽衫、
- 磨损的叠穿面料、
- 单色剪影、
- 厚重靴子、
- 柔软的超大外套、
- 极简首饰、
- 纹理针织衫、
- 宽松的中性剪裁。

造型应呈现出：
通过氛围和肢体语言展现感性，而非裸露肌肤。

模特应表现出：
情感疏离、
亲密但不微笑、
身体靠近但心理距离遥远。

示例：

- 沉默地坐在豪华轿车后座、
- 站在荧光汽车旅馆灯光下、
- 雨后倚靠在混凝土墙边、
- 穿着超大号衣服躺在褶皱的酒店床单上、
- 凌晨 3 点走在空旷的停车场结构中、
- 电梯镜面反射、
- 手指微妙地触碰、
- 在烟雾和阴影中进行柔和的眼神交流。

无露骨裸露。
无夸张的性暗示。

感性应源于：

- 张力、
- 灯光、
- 亲密度、
- 沉默、
- 时尚造型与写实感。

视觉风格：

融合：

- 奢华时尚社论、
- 模拟夜生活摄影、
- 柏林地下时尚杂志、
- Yeezy Season 广告能量、
- 电影般的都市孤独感、
- 以及触感十足的印刷设计美学。

排版应感觉碎片化且情感冰冷：

- 超大衬线字体、
- 手写笔记、
- 条形码碎片、
- 褪色的时间戳、
- 断开的短语、
- 时尚制作标记。

示例：
“无信号。”
“凌晨 2:17。”
“离开已太迟。”
“静态。”
“下班后。”

无励志口号。

灯光：

仅限低光电影写实风格：

- 钠灯路灯、
- 荧光电梯灯光、
- 停车场阴影、
- 经过的车头灯、
- 温暖的酒店台灯、
- 雨中倒影、
- 强烈的模拟闪光灯。

使用：

- 真实的胶片颗粒感、
- 轻微模糊、
- 镜头瑕疵、
- 质感厚重的阴影、
- 不完美的构图、
- 真实的皮肤纹理、
- 柔和的对比度、
- 氛围感黑暗。

调色板：

{argument name="colors" default="水洗黑、炭灰、暖烟草棕、褪色奶油色、工业银、暗琥珀色"}

templates.title: Cinematic Exhibition Room Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感展览室肖像

templates.prompt:
Use my reference photo to preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, bangs, facial proportions, skin tone, body posture, and overall silhouette with high identity consistency.

Cinematic portrait of a woman standing alone inside a dark exhibition room. She wears a vintage white shirt layered with a {argument name="jacket color" default="soft pink"} outer jacket and a black vintage-textured skirt. Minimal makeup. Front-profile pose with her body facing the camera, relaxed posture, one shoulder slightly lowered, hands gently adjusting her hair. Calm, mysterious expression with an intellectual and elegant aura.

She is positioned in the lower center of the frame, surrounded by darkness. A single dramatic diagonal spotlight cuts across the scene from the upper right to the lower left, illuminating only half of her body while the rest fades into shadow. Behind her is a {argument name="mural style" default="colorful vintage Japanese mural wall"} filled with retro cartoon illustrations and traditional artistic details.

Foreground shadows naturally frame the composition like torn darkness, creating a moody museum atmosphere with lonely artistic energy and a contemplative cinematic mood. Realistic photography with subtle film grain, analog texture, muted blacks, and vibrant mural accents.

Camera angle: eye-level shot, medium-close portrait framing, subject captured at approximately a 70-degree side profile angle, slight distance from the subject for environmental storytelling, centered cinematic composition.

Camera settings: cinematic low-light photography, shallow depth of field, realistic shadow falloff, Kodak Portra film color grading.

Lighting: {argument name="lighting source" default="harsh focused spotlight from the upper right"} creating a strong diagonal beam and deep high-contrast shadows, minimal ambient light, rich blacks, soft warm highlights along the face and glasses edges.

Vibe: mysterious, artistic, museum-core aesthetic, intelligent quiet energy, melancholic cinematic atmosphere, indie film still, luxury editorial photography, solitary nighttime mood, understated elegance.

Style: ultra-realistic cinematic photography, analog grain, editorial fashion portrait, natural skin texture, subtle imperfections, realistic color science, masterpiece quality.

Negative prompt: anime, smiling, overexposed lighting, extra limbs, bad anatomy, overly colorful outfit, cyberpunk neon, blurry face, low quality, distorted hands, unrealistic skin, HDR overload, exaggerated makeup, busy composition, duplicate person.

promptLocalized.zh:
使用我的参考照片，以保持高度的身份一致性，包括精准的面部特征、发型、刘海、面部比例、肤色、身体姿态以及整体轮廓。

一位女性独自站在黑暗展览室内的电影感肖像。她身穿一件复古白衬衫，外搭一件 {argument name="jacket color" default="柔粉色"} 外套，下身穿着黑色复古质感半身裙。淡妆。正面姿态，身体朝向镜头，姿势放松，一侧肩膀微垂，双手轻轻整理头发。表情平静而神秘，散发着知性与优雅的气质。

她位于画面下方中央，被黑暗包围。一道戏剧性的斜向聚光灯从右上角投射至左下角，仅照亮她半边身体，其余部分隐入阴影中。她身后是一面 {argument name="mural style" default="色彩丰富的复古日式壁画墙"}，上面绘有复古卡通插画和传统艺术细节。

前景的阴影如撕裂的黑暗般自然地构成了画框，营造出一种孤独艺术气息与沉思电影氛围的博物馆氛围。写实摄影，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感、模拟质感、柔和的黑色调以及鲜艳的壁画点缀。

相机角度：平视拍摄，中景肖像构图，主体以约 70 度的侧面角度呈现，与主体保持一定距离以进行环境叙事，居中电影感构图。

相机设置：电影感弱光摄影，浅景深，逼真的阴影衰减，Kodak Portra 胶片调色。

光线：{argument name="lighting source" default="来自右上角的强烈聚光灯"}，营造出强烈的对角线光束和高对比度的深邃阴影，极少的环境光，浓郁的黑色调，脸部和眼镜边缘带有柔和的暖色高光。

氛围：神秘、艺术、博物馆美学、知性静谧、忧郁的电影感氛围、独立电影剧照、奢华时尚摄影、孤独的夜晚情绪、低调的优雅。

风格：超写实电影摄影、模拟颗粒感、时尚编辑肖像、自然的皮肤质感、细微的瑕疵、真实的色彩科学、大师级品质。

负面提示词：动漫、微笑、过度曝光、多余的肢体、解剖结构错误、服装色彩过于鲜艳、赛博朋克霓虹灯、脸部模糊、低质量、手部扭曲、不真实的皮肤、HDR 过度、妆容夸张、构图杂乱、人物重复。

templates.title: Urban Life Mixed-Media Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 都市生活混合媒介拼贴画

templates.prompt:
Create a cinematic mixed-media fashion editorial collage

The composition should feel like a fragmented visual diary of a {argument name="subject" default="young man"} slowly disappearing into the rhythm of modern urban life.

Instead of a clean magazine layout, build the image like a layered wall of memories, screenshots, late-night photographs and torn printed posters assembled by hand over time.

The collage should contain multiple interconnected scenes of the same male character across one long sleepless city night:

rooftop solitude,

elevator mirror selfies,

empty subway platforms,

neon-lit convenience stores,

cigarette smoke drifting through alleyways,

blurry taxi reflections,

apartment-window loneliness,

headphones on during midnight walks,

and quiet moments of emotional exhaustion.

The same person should appear consistently throughout the collage but in different emotional states rather than different poses.

ART DIRECTION:

Blend:

luxury streetwear editorial photography,

analog film texture,

layered paper collage aesthetics,

distressed print graphics,

underground fashion magazines,

and modern urban melancholy.

Avoid: generic “cool guy” influencer aesthetics, symmetrical layouts, or overly polished AI perfection.

The composition should feel: messy in an intentional way.

Integrate:

torn paper edges,

tape marks,

handwritten notes,

distorted timestamps,

subway tickets,

blurred chat notifications,

weather widgets,

music-player overlays,

barcode fragments,

scratched textures,

scanned notebook pages,

and partially ripped typography.

The typography should feel fragmented and emotionally detached rather than motivational.

Examples: “2:17 AM” “offline.” “seen recently.” “somewhere between leaving and staying.” “low battery.” “city noise.”

No inspirational quotes.

WARDROBE:

Dark layered streetwear with realistic styling:

oversized hoodies,

washed leather jackets,

silver chains,

cargo pants,

worn sneakers,

heavy headphones,

slightly messy hair,

realistic fabric folds and texture.

The clothing should feel: expensive but lived-in.

LIGHTING:

Every section of the collage should use realistic urban nighttime lighting:

sodium-vapor streetlights,

convenience-store fluorescents,

elevator LEDs,

rainy reflections,

warm apartment lamps,

passing headlights,

rooftop city glow.

Use realistic low-light behavior:

soft sensor grain,

slight blur,

chromatic aberration,

imperfect exposure,

flash reflections,

realistic digital-camera texture.

COLOR PALETTE:

charcoal black, washed amber, cold teal, silver reflections, muted cream paper tones, faded neon and dark urban browns.

The final image should feel like: a visual archive of someone trying to stay emotionally visible in a city designed to make everyone disappear.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一幅电影质感的混合媒介时尚编辑拼贴画

构图应呈现出一种碎片化的视觉日记感，记录下 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男子"} 逐渐消融在现代都市生活节奏中的过程。

不要采用整洁的杂志排版，而是将图像构建成一堵由记忆、截图、深夜摄影和撕裂的印刷海报层叠而成的墙，仿佛是经过长时间手工拼凑而成。

拼贴画应包含同一男性角色在漫长不眠之夜中多个相互关联的场景：

天台的孤独，

电梯里的镜面自拍，

空荡的地铁站台，

霓虹闪烁的便利店，

穿过小巷的烟雾，

模糊的出租车倒影，

公寓窗前的落寞，

深夜漫步时佩戴的耳机，

以及情绪疲惫的静谧时刻。

同一个人应在整幅拼贴画中保持一致，但要展现出不同的情绪状态，而非仅仅是姿势的变化。

艺术指导：

融合：

奢华街头服饰编辑摄影，

胶片质感，

层叠纸张拼贴美学，

做旧印刷图形，

地下时尚杂志风格，

以及现代都市的忧郁感。

避免：平庸的“酷男”网红审美、对称式布局或过度修饰的 AI 完美感。

构图应呈现：一种刻意为之的凌乱感。

整合：

撕裂的纸张边缘，

胶带痕迹，

手写笔记，

扭曲的时间戳，

地铁票，

模糊的聊天通知，

天气小组件，

音乐播放器叠加层，

条形码碎片，

划痕纹理，

扫描的笔记本页面，

以及部分撕裂的排版设计。

排版应显得碎片化且情感疏离，而非励志风格。

示例：“2:17 AM”、“离线”、“最近可见”、“徘徊在离开与留下之间”、“电量低”、“城市噪音”。

不要使用励志名言。

服装：

深色叠穿街头服饰，风格写实：

廓形连帽衫，

水洗皮夹克，

银色链条，

工装裤，

磨损的运动鞋，

厚重的耳机，

略显凌乱的头发，

写实的织物褶皱与纹理。

服装应呈现：昂贵但充满生活气息的质感。

光影：

拼贴画的每个部分都应使用写实的都市夜间光影：

钠灯路灯，

便利店荧光灯，

电梯 LED 灯，

雨夜倒影，

温暖的公寓台灯，

经过的车灯，

天台的城市余晖。

运用写实的弱光表现：

柔和的感光颗粒，

轻微的模糊，

色差，

不完美的曝光，

闪光灯反射，

写实的数码相机质感。

调色板：

炭黑、水洗琥珀色、冷青色、银色反光、柔和的奶油纸色、褪色的霓虹色和深沉的都市棕色。

最终图像应呈现：一个试图在旨在让人消失的城市中保持情感可见的视觉档案。

templates.prompt: Using this character, create a story-driven illustration themed around {argument name="event" default="participating in a self-publishing circle at a comic market"}. Use the reference image for character reference only; do not reuse the original's composition, background, pose, or framing. The character is working as a salesperson at their own circle space. On the table, arrange original doujinshi, posters, acrylic goods, badges, flyers, price tags, and a menu that suit the character. Let the AI naturally imagine the content and world-building of the distributed items based on the character's personality, focusing on the atmosphere of a real circle. The character is wearing {argument name="attire" default="an arranged costume styled after their new work"}, creating the vibe of 'cosplaying as a character from their own book while selling it.' Include everyday items like cardboard boxes, packing tape, half-drunk plastic bottles, luggage, chairs, and small props to evoke the lived-in feeling of an event venue. The situation and mood should have randomness: a huge success, slightly bored, just after opening, near closing, fatigue, a sense of accomplishment, emptiness, chaos, quiet moments, unexpected popularity, or a dead period. Add a speech bubble to the character with a short comment fitting the situation. The dialogue should prioritize a realistic otaku-like energy, a slightly surreal air, or the everyday vibe of an event participant. Keep lines short and naturally funny. Avoid excessive effects, gaudy lighting, or unnatural 'aesthetic' staging. Focus on a realistic atmosphere that feels like a 'circle that truly exists somewhere.'

templates.prompt: From the character, clothing, expression, props, light, location, and atmosphere in the reference image, interpret the {argument name="item" default="bicycle culture"} that this person would truly choose. The goal is to create the inevitability that "this person would definitely pick this." However, simple stereotypes are forbidden. Even with a similar vibe, compare similar brands, philosophies, rival manufacturers, or similar cultures from other countries to select the one machine that resonates most with that child. The bicycle is not just a prop, but an entity linked to their life, escape, pride, movement, solitude, friendships, rebellion, or journey. The layout is {argument name="media" default="a realistic one-page feature in a major magazine"}. Include the manufacturer, model name, price, specs, interview, reporter's review, detailed photos, and a catchphrase. The subject of the article is not the 'bicycle introduction' itself, but 'the relationship between that child and that machine.'

Clothing and Materials: Top is a white long-sleeved shirt with vertical ruffles and small buttons on the chest, smooth and slightly shiny fabric, slightly puffed sleeves; bottom is a gray-black checkered high-waisted short pleated skirt, with a black waistband, thin fabric, skirt naturally flares out and folds after sitting. Bare legs, no shoes/socks info. Action, Camera, Composition Template: Person sitting on gray tile floor, back and left shoulder near the corner, torso leaning forward slightly, right arm extended holding phone for a selfie, left hand naturally holding a doll by the side. Knees forward, legs extended toward the camera, forming a continuous downward-pressing perspective of chest-waist-skirt-thighs. Camera is located slightly higher in the upper right front, shooting downwards, cropping the top of the head and most of the face, making the chest, waistline, skirt, and thighs the main subjects; left white wall and mirror frame, right dark door panel provide a sense of enclosed space, blue doll in the bottom left corner as an auxiliary anchor. Style and Controls: Style: Realistic daily mobile phone selfie, indoor warm yellow ceiling light/side-top light, brighter on the left, darker on the right, overall low contrast, clean and pale skin tone, soft shadows. Key Anchors: Light blue long curly hair hanging in front of chest, white slightly shiny shirt, gray-black checkered short skirt, sitting on floor leaning forward for selfie, obvious chest-waist-leg perspective, left-bright-right-dark warm light. Negative Constraints: Do not show full face, no standing or kneeling posture, no cold white light, no hard flash, do not make legs too long, do not use wide-angle exaggerated distortion, no complex background, do not miss the left doll and the oppressive feeling of the corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 在宽幅横向画布上创建一个暗黑奇幻像素艺术角色对比图，背景为炭黑色，并带有微妙的深灰色边框。并排展示 2 个完整的死灵法师全身像：左侧为柔和的类像素/混合像素版本，右侧为轮廓更清晰、黑色边框更强、块状边缘更明显的像素化版本。两个角色均描绘同一位亡灵巫师：一位身穿层叠破烂长袍、戴着兜帽的骷髅死灵法师，手持一根顶端带有蓝色幽灵火焰的扭曲木杖。左侧角色的兜帽下是模糊阴暗的空白面部，右侧角色则露出带有空洞眼眶和裸露牙齿的骷髅脸。角色穿着深色 {argument name="robe color" default="午夜蓝和柔和紫"} 连帽长袍，配有破烂的下摆、层叠的袖子、撕裂的拖曳布条、骨质胸甲、绳索与皮革腰带、悬挂的金色饰品、中央椭圆形蓝色宝石、小袋子，以及裸露的骷髅手脚。每个角色左手各持 1 根扭曲的法杖；每根法杖顶端有 1 团被扭曲树枝环绕的蓝色火焰，并带有悬挂的小挂件和珠状装饰。每个角色的右手均抬起，呈施法姿势，手指张开。使用有限的像素艺术调色板、高对比度的边缘阴影、柔和的棕色木材、象牙白骨骼细节、深海军蓝褶皱以及发光的电蓝色火焰高光。保持 2 个角色的姿势几乎一致，垂直居中，左侧角色略显柔和且具有绘画感，右侧角色则更具锐利的像素感。无文字、无标签、无水印、无额外字符，除纯色深色背景外无任何背景景观。

templates.title: Rooftop Pool Night Swimsuit Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹屋顶泳池自拍

templates.prompt: Create a realistic nighttime lifestyle photo of an adult woman posing in a rooftop infinity pool with her arms stretched wide toward the camera, upper body centered in the foreground, wet skin and damp short bob hair. She wears a one-piece athletic swimsuit with a bright {argument name="swimsuit pattern" default="red watermelon slice print with green rind lines and black seeds"}, high-cut sides, shoulder straps, and a small white chest logo reading “MAD WAVE.” Her face is intentionally obscured by a centered square privacy blur in muted mauve-pink. The setting is a luxurious urban rooftop pool at night with clear blue water, shimmering ripples, underwater lighting, purple and magenta neon reflections, lounge chairs, palm trees, glass railings, and a dense skyline of illuminated high-rise office towers in the background. Use a close wide-angle selfie-like composition from slightly above chest height, with the subject filling most of the frame, arms extending out of frame at both sides, pool water surrounding her waist and hips, and the city lights softly blurred behind her. Photorealistic camera quality, vibrant neon color grading, crisp water reflections, realistic anatomy, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, no extra people in the foreground, no added text except the swimsuit logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张在现代城市豪华屋顶度假村拍摄的写实风格夜间手机泳池自拍。在前景中，展示 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"} 站在发光的泳池中，水深及腰，双臂向画面两侧伸展，仿佛正在拍摄一张充满活力的度假自拍。她的脸部被一个位于中心位置、呈柔和紫褐色的不透明方形隐私遮挡块遮住。她留着凌乱的深棕色短发，露出肩膀和锁骨，身穿一件鲜红色的连体泳衣，上面印有满版西瓜图案：红色果肉、绿色果皮曲线和黑色小籽形状，胸前有一个白色小标志，写着 {argument name="swimsuit logo" default="MAD WAVE"}。泳衣采用运动肩带、圆领设计和高开叉剪裁。泳池水呈明亮的绿松石色，带有清晰的涟漪和倒影，场景被洋红色、紫色和蓝色的霓虹灯照亮。在她身后，包含三个清晰可见的度假村元素：左侧甲板上的躺椅、带有暖色上照灯的棕榈树，以及右侧带有粉色霓虹灯条的现代长形凉亭或池畔建筑。在远景中，展示一片密集的夜间高层办公楼天际线，有许多明亮的窗户和屋顶上的红色航空障碍灯。使用带有轻微镜头畸变的广角自拍视角，主体居中且靠近相机，双臂被左右边缘部分裁切，背景细节清晰但景深较浅，水面光泽倒影，高度写实，色彩鲜艳的夜生活氛围，前景中没有其他人。将场景氛围设置为 {argument name="city resort mood" default="迷人的城市屋顶泳池派对"}。

templates.title: Golden Meadow Portrait with Pets

titleLocalized.zh: 金黄草地上的宠物肖像

templates.prompt: Create a warm, naturalistic vertical outdoor portrait in golden-hour sunlight: {argument name="subject" default="a young woman with long brown hair in two braids"} sits barefoot on the grass in a wildflower meadow under a leafy green tree canopy, wearing a light cream sleeveless summer dress. She is centered, knees up toward the camera, gently holding exactly 1 tabby cat in her lap; the cat faces forward with clear striped fur and alert eyes. Include exactly 2 large dogs sitting close beside her: 1 dark brown shaggy dog on the left and 1 golden retriever on the right with its tongue out. Add exactly 3 opaque square censor blocks in a warm brown color covering the faces of the woman and both dogs, while leaving the cat unobscured. Use soft backlighting from the upper left, sun flare, dappled leaves, shallow depth of field, blurred foreground daisies and grass, a dreamy candid film-photography look, realistic skin and fur texture, natural warm color grading, vertical 9:16 composition, low camera angle, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖、自然的户外竖构图肖像，背景为黄金时刻的阳光：{argument name="subject" default="一位留着两条棕色长辫的年轻女性"} 赤脚坐在野花丛生的草地上，头顶是茂密的绿叶树冠，身穿一件奶油色无袖夏装。她位于画面中心，双膝朝向镜头，怀里轻轻抱着 1 只虎斑猫；猫咪面朝前方，条纹毛发清晰，眼神机警。画面中需包含 2 只紧挨着她的大狗：左侧为 1 只深棕色长毛狗，右侧为 1 只吐着舌头的金毛寻回犬。在女性和两只狗的面部添加 3 个不透明的暖棕色方形遮挡块，猫咪面部保持清晰。使用来自左上方的柔和逆光、光晕、斑驳的树影、浅景深、模糊的前景雏菊和草地，呈现梦幻般的抓拍胶片摄影质感，具备逼真的皮肤和毛发纹理，自然的暖色调，9:16 竖构图，低机位拍摄，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Luxury Facial Harmony Report

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华面部和谐度分析报告

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a luxury editorial "Facial Beauty Analysis" face-symmetry report for {argument name="subject gender" default="female"}, styled like a premium beauty lab scan with gold measurement landmarks over a grayscale portrait.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 report layout, clean white background with subtle paper texture, thin gold divider lines, black-and-gold luxury branding. Add a tall black rounded-corner sidebar on the left, a large central portrait-analysis area, and a right results column.

Layout: Use exactly three main vertical zones. Left sidebar takes about 22% width, center portrait report takes about 48% width, right analytics column takes about 30% width. Add a thin black footer bar across the bottom with gold text.

Left sidebar content: Large stacked gold serif title "FACIAL BEAUTY ANALYSIS". Small subtitle "SCIENCE. SYMMETRY. HARMONY.". An "OVERVIEW" section with a short paragraph explaining that the report analyzes facial features based on symmetry, proportion, and harmony research. A "YOUR MODEL" section with exactly 5 rows: ID "FB-2024-05-18", GENDER "Female", AGE RANGE "20-30", FACE SHAPE "Oval", SKIN TONE "Light". At the bottom, place an elegant monogram logo "FB" and the label "FACIAL BEAUTY LAB".

Center content: Top heading "YOUR FACIAL HARMONY REPORT". Show a front-facing grayscale portrait of a woman with dark hair pulled back, neutral expression, soft studio lighting, and a high-fashion clinical look. Cover the central facial area with a plain medium-gray rectangular privacy mask while leaving the hair outline, ears, neck, and shoulders visible. Overlay fine gold facial-analysis guide lines around the visible head: a vertical centerline, horizontal thirds labeled exactly 3 times as "1/3", lower neck/shoulder proportion ticks labeled exactly 5 times as "1/5", small gold landmark dots, and delicate dotted measurement rules. Below the portrait, add a "FACIAL PROPORTIONS" section with exactly 5 compact metric cards: FACE LENGTH 1.00, FOREHEAD 1.03, MIDFACE 1.00, LOWER FACE 0.97, FACE WIDTH 1.01. Include the note "Ideal proportion value: 1.00".

Right column content: Top card titled "HARMONY SCORE" with a gold semicircle gauge from 0 to 100 and large score {argument name="harmony score" default="91.2"}; below it, show "OUTSTANDING" and a short sentence saying the facial features are highly harmonious and well-balanced. Middle card titled "KEY METRICS" with exactly 7 rows, each with a small gold line icon, label, and score: Facial Symmetry 94, Proportions 90, Eye Position 92, Nose Proportion 90, Lips Symmetry 88, Chin & Jawline 89, Overall Harmony 91. Bottom card titled "ANALYSIS INSIGHTS" with a concise paragraph about excellent balance and proportion, and exactly 3 small icon captions: Balanced Symmetry, Well-Proportioned Features, High Aesthetic Potential.

Footer: Full-width black strip with centered gold serif quote "BEAUTY IS MEASURED IN HARMONY, NOT PERFECTION." with small decorative star marks.

Visual style: Luxury beauty-tech report, refined serif typography, minimal sans-serif labels, monochrome portrait, metallic gold accents, thin rules, clean margins, editorial medical-aesthetic design. Use {argument name="accent color" default="metallic gold"} for lines, icons, gauge, and headings. Keep text crisp and readable, no extra sections, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="subject gender" default="女性"} 创建一份奢华的“面部美学分析”对称性报告，采用高端美容实验室扫描风格，在灰度肖像上叠加金色测量基准线。

画布：横向 4:3 报告布局，简洁的白色背景，带有细微的纸张纹理，细金色的分隔线，黑金配色的奢华品牌风格。左侧添加一个高大的黑色圆角侧边栏，中央为大型肖像分析区，右侧为结果列。

布局：使用三个主要的垂直区域。左侧边栏约占 22% 的宽度，中央肖像报告区约占 48% 的宽度，右侧分析列约占 30% 的宽度。底部添加一条横跨全屏的黑色页脚栏，配以金色文字。

左侧边栏内容：大型堆叠式金色衬线标题“FACIAL BEAUTY ANALYSIS”。小字副标题“SCIENCE. SYMMETRY. HARMONY.”。一个“OVERVIEW”部分，用简短的段落解释该报告基于对称性、比例和和谐度研究分析面部特征。一个“YOUR MODEL”部分，包含 5 行内容：ID “FB-2024-05-18”，GENDER “Female”，AGE RANGE “20-30”，FACE SHAPE “Oval”，SKIN TONE “Light”。底部放置一个优雅的“FB”字母组合标志和“FACIAL BEAUTY LAB”标签。

中央内容：顶部标题“YOUR FACIAL HARMONY REPORT”。展示一张正面灰度肖像，模特为深色头发后梳，表情中性，柔和的摄影棚灯光，呈现高级时尚临床感。用一个中灰色矩形遮罩覆盖面部中央区域，仅露出头发轮廓、耳朵、颈部和肩膀。在可见的头部周围叠加精细的金色面部分析引导线：一条垂直中心线，水平三等分线（精确标注 3 次“1/3”），下颈部/肩部比例刻度（精确标注 5 次“1/5”），微小的金色基准点，以及精致的虚线测量标尺。肖像下方添加“FACIAL PROPORTIONS”部分，包含 5 张紧凑的指标卡片：FACE LENGTH 1.00, FOREHEAD 1.03, MIDFACE 1.00, LOWER FACE 0.97, FACE WIDTH 1.01。包含注释“Ideal proportion value: 1.00”。

右侧列内容：顶部卡片标题为“HARMONY SCORE”，配有一个 0 到 100 的金色半圆仪表盘和 {argument name="harmony score" default="91.2"} 的大号分数；下方显示“OUTSTANDING”，并配有一句简短的句子，说明面部特征高度和谐且比例均衡。中间卡片标题为“KEY METRICS”，包含 7 行内容，每行配有一个小型金色线条图标、标签和分数：Facial Symmetry 94, Proportions 90, Eye Position 92, Nose Proportion 90, Lips Symmetry 88, Chin & Jawline 89, Overall Harmony 91。底部卡片标题为“ANALYSIS INSIGHTS”，包含一段关于卓越平衡与比例的简洁段落，以及 3 个小型图标说明：Balanced Symmetry, Well-Proportioned Features, High Aesthetic Potential。

页脚：全宽黑色条带，居中显示金色衬线引言“BEAUTY IS MEASURED IN HARMONY, NOT PERFECTION.”，并配有小型装饰性星号。

视觉风格：奢华美容科技报告，精致的衬线字体，极简的无衬线标签，单色肖像，金属金色点缀，细线条，简洁的页边距，编辑类医学美学设计。线条、图标、仪表盘和标题使用 {argument name="accent color" default="金属金色"}。保持文字清晰易读，无需额外部分，无水印。

templates.title: Pixel Risograph Noodle Diner

templates.prompt: Create a retro pixel-art risograph print illustration on aged cream paper, showing {argument name="main subject" default="a person with a pink bob haircut eating noodles with chopsticks"} seated at a small restaurant table. Use a square dark teal-green background panel centered on the page with a thick cream paper margin, heavy risograph grain, imperfect ink registration, halftone speckles, and chunky low-resolution pixel edges. The subject should occupy the right half of the panel, wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="yellow sweater with a dark green pinafore-style apron"}; their face is intentionally hidden by a flat rectangular {argument name="face cover color" default="soft pink-to-tan gradient block"}. Show the person holding exactly 2 chopsticks horizontally in the left hand and lifting exactly 1 strand cluster of noodles with the right hand. Include exactly 4 main table items: 1 dark green bottle with a red-and-blue label on the left, 1 small oval side plate with a red rectangular food item, 1 large oval plate of yellow-orange fried noodles with blue rim details and small green garnish, and 1 brown tabletop spanning the bottom. Include exactly 1 hanging orange paper lantern in the upper left, attached by 1 thin vertical cord, with yellow highlights and pixelated edges. Use a limited risograph palette of deep teal, mustard yellow, orange, coral pink, red, cobalt blue, dark green, and cream paper, with no photorealism, no smooth vector lines, no extra people, no readable text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅复古像素风孔版印刷插画，背景为陈旧的米色纸张，展示 {argument name="main subject" default="一个留着粉色波波头、正用筷子吃面的人"} 坐在小餐馆的桌旁。页面中央设有一个深青绿色的方形背景板，四周留有厚实的米色纸张边框，呈现出浓重的孔版印刷颗粒感、不完美的油墨套印效果、半色调斑点以及粗犷的低分辨率像素边缘。主体应占据画面的右半部分，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="黄色毛衣搭配深绿色围裙"}；其面部被一块扁平的矩形 {argument name="face cover color" default="柔和的粉色至棕褐色渐变色块"} 刻意遮挡。画面中人物左手水平拿着 2 根筷子，右手挑起 1 簇面条。桌上需包含 4 件主要物品：左侧 1 个带有红蓝标签的深绿色瓶子、1 个放有红色长方形食物的小椭圆形配菜盘、1 个装有黄橙色炒面且带有蓝色边缘细节和少量绿色装饰的大椭圆形盘子，以及底部横跨桌面的棕色桌面。左上方包含 1 个悬挂的橙色纸灯笼，由 1 根细垂直线连接，带有黄色高光和像素化边缘。使用深青色、芥末黄、橙色、珊瑚粉、红色、钴蓝色、深绿色和米色纸张的有限孔版印刷调色板，拒绝写实风格，不使用平滑的矢量线条，画面中不包含其他人，不出现可读文字，且无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic studio portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a bald adult man with a short dark beard"} facing straight toward the camera, framed from upper chest to just above the head against a nearly black background. The subject wears {argument name="shirt color" default="a dark navy blue"} polo shirt with a collar and two visible buttons, shoulders broad and centered, posture upright and still. Use cinematic low-key lighting with strong colored rim lights: cool cyan-blue light along the left side of the head, ear, neck, and shoulder, and warm orange light along the right side, ear, neck, and shoulder, creating a high-contrast moody look. Place one large opaque square censor block directly over the center of the face, covering the forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, and most facial features while leaving the top of the bald head, ears, beard edge, neck, shirt, and shoulders visible; the square should have a muted dark gray-to-warm brown gradient matching the surrounding lighting. Make the image vertical, photorealistic, sharp, with subtle skin texture and fabric detail, no text, no watermark, no additional objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的摄影棚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着短黑胡须的秃头成年男性"}，正对镜头，构图范围从胸部上方至头顶，背景近乎全黑。主体穿着 {argument name="shirt color" default="深海军蓝"} 色 Polo 衫，带有领子和两颗可见纽扣，双肩宽阔居中，姿态挺拔静止。采用电影级低调布光，并辅以强烈的彩色轮廓光：头部、耳朵、颈部和肩部左侧为冷青蓝色光，右侧为暖橙色光，营造出高对比度的情绪化氛围。在面部中心位置放置一个大型不透明方形遮挡块，覆盖前额、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴及大部分面部特征，同时保留秃头顶部、耳朵、胡须边缘、颈部、衬衫和肩膀可见；方形遮挡块应呈现与周围光线相呼应的柔和深灰至暖棕色渐变。图像需为竖构图，照片级真实感，清晰锐利，展现细腻的皮肤纹理和织物细节，无文字，无水印，无额外物体。

templates.title: Enchanted Anime Forest Nymph Portrait

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic anime-style close-up portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious forest nymph"} facing directly forward, filling the frame from forehead to chin with an intense calm expression. She has porcelain skin with subtle freckles, glossy rose lips, dark wet-looking tousled hair, and large luminous {argument name="eye color" default="turquoise green"} eyes with highly detailed lashes and reflective catchlights. Adorn her face with symmetrical sparkling crystal and gold leaf ornaments under both eyes and across the bridge of her nose, like delicate tears and fairy makeup. Add long dangling iridescent gemstone earrings on both sides. Frame her head with a crown of deep teal leaves and small pale blue flowers, with thin vines and loose strands of hair crossing the image. Surround her with an enchanted nighttime forest atmosphere in {argument name="color palette" default="deep teal, midnight blue, warm gold, and soft rose"}, including glowing fireflies, tiny butterflies, floating dust motes, bokeh orbs, and warm rim light from the right side. Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, shallow depth of field, painterly yet hyper-detailed anime illustration, intricate linework, luminous skin texture, ethereal fantasy mood, ultra-detailed eyes, cinematic widescreen composition, no text, no watermark.
