templates.title: FN SCAR-L Tactical Spec Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: FN SCAR-L 战术规格表

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark tactical firearm character-sheet style technical poster for the {argument name="rifle model" default="FN SCAR-L"}, presented as a clean military product infographic.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster on a matte charcoal-black textured background, with worn tan stencil typography and thin muted-gray grid lines. Use realistic studio-rendered firearm illustrations in flat side profile, colored coyote tan and black, with subtle scratches, edge wear, and soft shadows.

Header: At the top left, place a huge distressed stencil title reading “FN SCAR-L”. Beneath it, add three smaller lines: “[SPECIAL OPERATIONS FORCES COMBAT ASSAULT RIFLE – LIGHT]”, “{argument name="caliber line" default="5.56x45mm NATO / 7.62x51mm NATO"}”, and “{argument name="tagline" default="THE MODULAR BATTLE RIFLE FOR THE MODERN WARRIOR"}”. At the top right, include a circular FN monogram-style logo and the text “FN HERSTAL”.

Main visual layout: Show exactly 4 firearm views/assemblies. 1) A large full-length left-facing side profile rifle spanning the upper half, dominant and highly detailed. 2) A smaller full rifle side profile beneath it on the right, used for numbered feature callouts. 3) A partially disassembled upper receiver and barrel assembly in the lower middle, with barrel components separated horizontally. 4) A lower receiver/stock assembly below it, with magazine removed and a small loose pin or screw nearby. Add one cropped rifle detail close-up at the bottom right inside the caliber conversion box.

Feature callouts: Include exactly 6 numbered callouts with small square labels and fine leader lines pointing to rifle parts. The numbered list at left must read: 1 “MIL-STD-1913 TOP RAIL” with subtext “For optics and accessories”; 2 “SIDE FOLDING STOCK” with subtext “Adjustable length of pull”; 3 “AMBIDEXTROUS CONTROLS” with subtext “Selector, magazine release, and bolt catch”; 4 “FREE-FLOATING HANDGUARD” with subtext “With accessory rails at 3, 6, and 9 o’clock”; 5 “QUICK-CHANGE BARREL” with subtext “Caliber conversion in minutes”; 6 “SHORT-STROKE GAS PISTON” with subtext “Reliable in adverse conditions”.

Specification table: Place a boxed table in the lower left titled “SPECIFICATIONS [5.56x45mm]”. Include exactly 10 rows: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO; Operation: Gas-operated, short-stroke piston; Magazine capacity: 30 rounds (STANAG); Overall length: 35.25 in (895 mm); Barrel length: 16.25 in (413 mm); Weight (unloaded): 7.50 lb (3.40 kg); Rate of fire: 625–650 rounds/min; Muzzle velocity: ~2,750 ft/s (838 m/s); Effective range: 500 m; Sights: Iron sights, foldable (front & rear), optic ready (MIL-STD-1913 rail).

Bottom information panels: Add two boxed text panels along the bottom. Left panel: a short paragraph explaining that the FN SCAR-L is a modular assault rifle designed for U.S. Special Operations Command and chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO, emphasizing reliability, accuracy, adaptability, and lightweight battle-proven use. Right panel title: “CALIBER CONVERSION”, followed by text explaining quick conversion using FN’s quick-change barrel system and exactly 2 bullet calibers: “5.56x45mm NATO (SCAR-L)” and “7.62x51mm NATO (SCAR-H)”.

Visual constraints: Keep all text in English, crisp and legible; use a professional weapon manual / defense catalog aesthetic; avoid people, hands, firing effects, flags, or clutter; maintain precise orthographic side views and a subdued black, tan, and gray color palette.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="rifle model" default="FN SCAR-L"} 创建一张深色战术枪械角色表风格的技术海报，呈现为简洁的军事产品信息图。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，采用磨砂炭黑色纹理背景，搭配磨损的棕褐色模板字体和纤细的柔和灰色网格线。使用写实的摄影棚渲染枪械插图，采用平视侧面轮廓，颜色为郊狼棕色和黑色，带有细微划痕、边缘磨损和柔和阴影。

页眉：在左上角放置一个巨大的做旧模板标题，写着“FN SCAR-L”。在其下方，添加三行较小的文字：“[SPECIAL OPERATIONS FORCES COMBAT ASSAULT RIFLE – LIGHT]”、“{argument name="caliber line" default="5.56x45mm NATO / 7.62x51mm NATO"}”以及“{argument name="tagline" default="THE MODULAR BATTLE RIFLE FOR THE MODERN WARRIOR"}”。在右上角，包含一个圆形的 FN 字母组合风格标志和文字“FN HERSTAL”。

主要视觉布局：展示 4 个枪械视图/组件。1) 上半部分是一个大型的左侧全长步枪侧面轮廓，占据主导地位且细节丰富。2) 其右下方是一个较小的完整步枪侧面轮廓，用于编号特征标注。3) 中下部是一个部分拆解的上机匣和枪管组件，枪管部件水平分离。4) 其下方是一个下机匣/枪托组件，弹匣已移除，附近有一个松脱的小销钉或螺丝。在右下角的口径转换框内添加一个裁剪后的步枪细节特写。

特征标注：包含 6 个带小方块标签的编号标注，并用细引导线指向步枪部件。左侧的编号列表必须为：1 “MIL-STD-1913 TOP RAIL”，副标题“用于光学瞄具和配件”；2 “SIDE FOLDING STOCK”，副标题“可调节拉距”；3 “AMBIDEXTROUS CONTROLS”，副标题“快慢机、弹匣释放钮和空仓挂机”；4 “FREE-FLOATING HANDGUARD”，副标题“带有 3、6 和 9 点钟方向的配件导轨”；5 “QUICK-CHANGE BARREL”，副标题“可在几分钟内完成口径转换”；6 “SHORT-STROKE GAS PISTON”，副标题“在恶劣环境下可靠运行”。

规格表：在左下角放置一个带框表格，标题为“SPECIFICATIONS [5.56x45mm]”。包含 10 行：口径：5.56x45mm NATO；操作方式：导气式，短行程活塞；弹匣容量：30 发 (STANAG)；全长：35.25 英寸 (895 毫米)；枪管长度：16.25 英寸 (413 毫米)；重量 (空枪)：7.50 磅 (3.40 千克)；射速：625–650 发/分钟；枪口初速：~2,750 英尺/秒 (838 米/秒)；有效射程：500 米；瞄具：机械瞄具，可折叠 (前部和后部)，支持光学瞄具 (MIL-STD-1913 导轨)。

底部信息面板：在底部添加两个带框文本面板。左侧面板：一段简短的段落，解释 FN SCAR-L 是一款为美国特种作战司令部设计的模块化突击步枪，口径为 5.56x45mm NATO，强调其可靠性、精度、适应性和轻量化的实战表现。右侧面板标题：“CALIBER CONVERSION”，随后是解释使用 FN 快速更换枪管系统进行快速转换的文字，以及 2 种弹药口径：“5.56x45mm NATO (SCAR-L)”和“7.62x51mm NATO (SCAR-H)”。

视觉约束：保持所有文字为英文，清晰易读；采用专业的武器手册/国防目录美学；避免出现人物、手部、射击效果、旗帜或杂乱元素；保持精确的正投影侧视图以及柔和的黑色、棕褐色和灰色调。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic military technical character-sheet style infographic for the {argument name="rifle model" default="M2010 ESR"}, showing a tan enhanced sniper rifle with labeled components, specifications, measurement guides, and detail close-ups.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster on a dark charcoal textured background, high-resolution, realistic 3D product-render look, muted tactical colors, tan and black rifle parts, beige military stencil typography.

Layout: At the top left, place a large title reading “{argument name="headline text" default="M2010 ESR"}” with the subtitle “ENHANCED SNIPER RIFLE” underneath. Below it add a short description: “The M2010 Enhanced Sniper Rifle (ESR) is a 7.62×51mm NATO precision bolt-action rifle adopted by the U.S. Army in 2010 as the upgrade to the M24 Sniper Weapon System.” The upper half is dominated by a large three-quarter view of the rifle angled from lower left to upper right, with scope, bipod, long barrel, muzzle brake, adjustable stock, pistol grip, magazine, and free-float handguard visible.

Callouts and text: Include exactly 3 component callouts around the large rifle: “MIL-STD-1913 Accessory Rail,” “5 or 10 Round Detachable Magazine,” and “Adjustable Stock (Length of Pull & Cheek Weld).” Add a “FEATURES” block with exactly 6 bullet points: “Accuracy and effective range improved over M24,” “Modular design for easier maintenance and upgrades,” “Adjustable stock for length of pull and cheek weld,” “Match-grade barrel for enhanced precision,” “Free-float handguard with accessory rail,” and “Compatible with sound suppressors.”

Specifications panel: On the right side of the upper rifle, include a boxed table titled “SPECIFICATIONS” with exactly 9 rows: Caliber: 7.62×51mm NATO; Action: Bolt-action; Overall Length: 48.5 in (1,230 mm); Barrel Length: 24 in (610 mm); Weight: 14.8 lb (6.7 kg) w/ scope & bipod; Magazine Capacity: 5 or 10 rounds; Effective Range: 800–1,000 m; Maximum Range: 1,500 m+; Sights: Leupold Mark 4 6.5–20×50mm.

Middle diagram: Add a second full side-profile view of the same rifle across the center, perfectly horizontal, smaller than the top render. Add measurement lines showing “48.5 in (1,230 mm)” above the rifle and “8.6 in (218 mm)” vertically near the stock.

Detail section: At the bottom, create a grid titled “DETAIL VIEWS” with exactly 6 close-up panels in two rows of three. The panels are: 1) “Muzzle Brake” with subtext “Reduces recoil and muzzle rise”; 2) “Free-Float Handguard” with subtext “Improves accuracy by minimizing barrel contact”; 3) “Bolt Action” with subtext “Smooth, reliable, and proven design”; 4) “Adjustable Stock” with subtext “Customizable for shooter fit and comfort”; 5) “Detachable Magazine” with subtext “5 or 10 round options for operational flexibility”; 6) “Leupold Mark 4 Scope” with subtext “6.5–20× magnification for long-range precision.”

Visual style: Photorealistic tactical catalog rendering, subtle rim lighting, crisp labels and thin pointer lines, slight vignette, professional defense-industry spec sheet aesthetic. Keep all text legible, use only the listed text, and do not add people, logos, flags, watermarks, or extra weapons.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="rifle model" default="M2010 ESR"} 创建一张逼真的军事技术说明书风格信息图，展示一把棕褐色的增强型狙击步枪，并附带组件标注、规格参数、测量指南和细节特写。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，采用深炭灰色纹理背景，高分辨率，逼真的 3D 产品渲染效果，柔和的战术配色，棕褐色与黑色步枪部件，米色军事模板字体。

布局：左上角放置一个大标题“{argument name="headline text" default="M2010 ESR"}”，下方副标题为“ENHANCED SNIPER RIFLE”。在其下方添加简短描述：“M2010 增强型狙击步枪 (ESR) 是一款 7.62×51mm NATO 口径精密栓动步枪，于 2010 年被美国陆军采用，作为 M24 狙击武器系统的升级版。” 上半部分主体为步枪的三分之二侧视图，从左下角向右上角倾斜，清晰可见瞄准镜、两脚架、长枪管、枪口制退器、可调枪托、握把、弹匣和自由浮动护木。

标注与文字：在步枪周围包含 3 个组件标注：“MIL-STD-1913 附件导轨”、“5 发或 10 发可拆卸弹匣”以及“可调枪托（拉距与贴腮高度）”。添加一个包含 6 个要点的“FEATURES”板块：“精度和有效射程较 M24 有所提升”、“模块化设计便于维护和升级”、“可调节枪托以适应拉距和贴腮”、“竞赛级枪管以提高精度”、“带附件导轨的自由浮动护木”以及“兼容消音器”。

规格面板：在步枪右上侧，包含一个标题为“SPECIFICATIONS”的表格，共 9 行：口径：7.62×51mm NATO；枪机：栓动式；全长：48.5 英寸 (1,230 毫米)；枪管长度：24 英寸 (610 毫米)；重量：14.8 磅 (6.7 公斤，含瞄准镜及两脚架)；弹匣容量：5 发或 10 发；有效射程：800–1,000 米；最大射程：1,500 米以上；瞄准具：Leupold Mark 4 6.5–20×50mm。

中间图示：在中心位置添加该步枪的第二个完整侧视图，保持水平，尺寸小于顶部渲染图。添加测量线，在步枪上方标注“48.5 英寸 (1,230 毫米)”，在枪托附近垂直标注“8.6 英寸 (218 毫米)”。

细节部分：在底部创建一个标题为“DETAIL VIEWS”的网格，分为两行，每行三个，共 6 个特写面板。面板内容为：1) “枪口制退器”，副标题“减少后坐力和枪口上跳”；2) “自由浮动护木”，副标题“通过减少枪管接触提高精度”；3) “栓动枪机”，副标题“平滑、可靠且经过验证的设计”；4) “可调枪托”，副标题“可根据射手需求定制，提升贴合度与舒适度”；5) “可拆卸弹匣”，副标题“5 发或 10 发选项，提升作战灵活性”；6) “Leupold Mark 4 瞄准镜”，副标题“6.5–20 倍放大倍率，实现远程精准射击”。

视觉风格：照片级战术目录渲染，微妙的轮廓光，清晰的标签和细指示线，轻微暗角，专业的国防工业规格说明书美学。确保所有文字清晰可读，仅使用列出的文字，不要添加人物、标志、旗帜、水印或额外的武器。

templates.title: Melancholy AutoCAD Working Girl Polaroid

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁的 AutoCAD 职场少女拍立得

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a nostalgic instant-film / Cheki-style anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a working girl"} looking dejected at her desk after receiving criticism on her AutoCAD work, with the concept of a delicate outfit worn by someone sturdily living everyday working life.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, designed as an aged Polaroid print with a thick cream paper border, rounded corners, dust, scratches, stains, vignette darkening, and a sepia faded-photo treatment.

Main photo area: Show exactly 1 young anime-style woman in side profile, seated at a desk in a dim office or studio. Her face is mostly hidden by a plain square censor block in muted beige-brown, centered over her face. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair in a high ponytail with loose curls, braided details, small floral hair ornaments, dangling earrings, and a very large bow headband. Her outfit is a frilly lavender-blue and pink lace blouse or dress with ribbons, puffed sleeves, and ornate trim, intentionally cute and refined despite the work setting. Her posture should feel slumped, disappointed, and quietly hurt.

Work environment: Include exactly 1 computer monitor on the right, angled toward her, showing a pale CAD drafting interface with architectural line drawings, toolbars, and technical rectangles. Include exactly 1 warm desk lamp in the upper right casting a soft cone of light. Background should be softly blurred with window-like shapes and warm dusty atmosphere.

Border design: The Polaroid border is hand-decorated with exactly 24 doodles in colored pen: 8 hearts, 4 stars, 3 arrows, 3 dotted swirl trails, 3 sparkle clusters, and 3 small circles. Use pink, purple, blue, and mustard-yellow ink. Make the doodles casual, uneven, and handwritten, as if drawn on the photo after printing.

Text content: On the lower white border, add handwritten Japanese text in dark blue ink with a slightly messy personal diary style. Use exactly 3 text elements: a two-line main caption reading {argument name="main handwritten caption" default="AutoCAD が出来たら\n何でも出来る…そう思っていた"}, a smaller third line reading {argument name="sub caption" default="時期もありました"}, and a date at the bottom right reading {argument name="date" default="2026年5月19日"}. Keep the writing legible but natural, like marker or ballpoint pen on old paper.

Visual style: Highly detailed soft anime illustration, delicate linework, warm sepia lighting, muted pastel palette, grainy analog film texture, slight overexposure around the lamp, emotional slice-of-life mood, cute but melancholic.

Constraints: Do not add extra characters, extra monitors, logos, watermarks, or modern UI overlays. Keep the square censor block flat and opaque. Preserve the handmade instant-photo frame and aged paper texture.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张怀旧拍立得（Cheki）风格的动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位职场少女"} 在 AutoCAD 工作受到批评后，坐在桌前垂头丧气的样子。核心概念是展现一位在坚韧日常工作中，却穿着精致服饰的女性形象。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，设计为一张陈旧的拍立得照片，带有厚实的奶油色纸质边框、圆角、灰尘、划痕、污渍、暗角以及褪色的棕褐色照片处理效果。

主体照片区域：画面中仅包含 1 位动漫风格的年轻女性侧影，坐在昏暗办公室或工作室的桌前。她的面部大部分被一个位于脸部中央、呈柔和米棕色的方形遮挡块遮住。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 波浪卷发，扎成高马尾，带有编发细节、小型花朵发饰、垂坠耳环以及一个非常大的蝴蝶结发带。她的装束是一件淡紫色与粉色相间的荷叶边蕾丝衬衫或裙子，配有丝带、泡泡袖和华丽的饰边，在工作环境中显得刻意可爱且精致。她的姿态应表现出颓丧、失望和默默受伤的感觉。

工作环境：右侧放置 1 台显示器，朝向她，屏幕上显示着浅色的 CAD 制图界面，包含建筑线条图、工具栏和技术矩形。右上角放置 1 台暖色调台灯，投射出一束柔和的光锥。背景应进行柔焦处理，呈现出窗户般的形状和温暖的尘埃氛围。

边框设计：拍立得边框上用彩色笔手绘了 24 个涂鸦：8 个爱心、4 个星星、3 个箭头、3 个点状漩涡轨迹、3 组闪光点和 3 个小圆圈。使用粉色、紫色、蓝色和芥末黄色的墨水。涂鸦应显得随意、不均匀且具有手写感，就像照片打印后在上面绘制的一样。

文字内容：在下方的白色边框上，用深蓝色墨水添加手写风格的日语文字，呈现出略显凌乱的个人日记风格。包含 3 个文本元素：两行主标题 {argument name="main handwritten caption" default="AutoCAD が出来たら\n何でも出来る…そう思っていた"}，第三行较小的副标题 {argument name="sub caption" default="時期もありました"}，以及右下角的日期 {argument name="date" default="2026年5月19日"}。书写应清晰但自然，如同在旧纸张上使用记号笔或圆珠笔书写的效果。

视觉风格：高细节的柔和动漫插画，细腻的线条，温暖的棕褐色光影，柔和的粉彩色调，颗粒感的模拟胶片质感，台灯周围有轻微的过曝，充满情感的日常番氛围，可爱但忧郁。

约束条件：不要添加额外的人物、额外的显示器、标志、水印或现代 UI 覆盖层。保持方形遮挡块平整且不透明。保留手工制作的拍立得相框和陈旧的纸张质感。

templates.title: Anime Stained Glass Cathedral Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格彩色玻璃大教堂肖像

templates.prompt: Create a luminous stained-glass artwork inside a grand Gothic cathedral, vertical 4:5 composition. The main subject is an anime-style young woman shown from the back and slightly turned in profile, with {argument name="hair color" default="warm blonde"} shoulder-length wavy hair made from intricate leaded glass strands. Her face is deliberately covered by a centered opaque beige square privacy block. She wears an off-shoulder pale blue dress with faceted translucent glass panels, exposing her shoulders and upper back. Add a floral hair ornament on the left side of her head with exactly 3 visible flower clusters: pink blossoms, white blossoms, and a green hydrangea-like cluster. The stained-glass window behind her fills nearly the whole frame and is built from many small rectangular and irregular panes in pastel turquoise, aqua, cream, peach, pink, lavender, cobalt blue, and gold, with a decorative arched floral motif at the top. Include exactly 2 side floral elements: a small stained-glass vase with flowers in the lower left of the window, and a real white flower bouquet near the lower right edge. Surround the window with dark carved stone cathedral columns and ribbed arches, with exactly 2 lit candles visible on the left side. Strong sunlight passes through the glass, casting colorful reflections across the polished stone floor and side walls. Emphasize complex transparent glass textures, metallic lead outlines, cracked mosaic facets, glowing highlights, caustic light, ornate cathedral atmosphere, ultra-detailed craftsmanship, romantic fantasy mood, high resolution, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 在宏伟的哥特式大教堂内创作一幅发光的彩色玻璃艺术品，采用 4:5 竖构图。主体是一位动漫风格的年轻女性，背对镜头并略微侧身，拥有由复杂的铅条玻璃丝构成的 {argument name="hair color" default="暖金色"} 肩长波浪发。她的脸部被一个居中的不透明米色方形隐私块故意遮挡。她身穿露肩浅蓝色连衣裙，裙身由多面半透明玻璃板组成，露出双肩和上背部。在她的头部左侧添加一个花卉发饰，要求包含 3 簇清晰可见的花朵：粉色花朵、白色花朵以及一簇类似绣球花的绿色花团。身后的彩色玻璃窗几乎填满整个画面，由许多长方形和不规则的小玻璃片组成，颜色包括浅绿松石色、水绿色、奶油色、桃色、粉色、薰衣草色、钴蓝色和金色，顶部饰有装饰性的拱形花卉图案。在窗户两侧加入 2 个花卉元素：窗户左下角有一个小型彩色玻璃花瓶，右下边缘附近有一束真实的白色花束。窗户周围环绕着深色雕刻石柱和肋架拱顶，左侧可见 2 支点燃的蜡烛。强烈的阳光穿过玻璃，在抛光的石质地面和侧墙上投射出绚丽的色彩。强调复杂的透明玻璃质感、金属铅条轮廓、破碎的马赛克切面、发光高光、焦散光影、华丽的大教堂氛围、超精细的工艺、浪漫的奇幻意境，高分辨率，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Monochrome Woodblock Character Postcard

titleLocalized.zh: 单色木刻版画风格角色明信片

templates.prompt:
Using the provided reference image as the character base, transform it into a nostalgic monochrome Japanese woodblock-print illustration on textured cream paper. Change the composition from vertical portrait to a wide horizontal postcard layout, keeping the same cute sea-themed girl and outfit concept but redrawing her smaller in the center, facing forward, with one hand raised in a friendly wave. Convert the blue-and-cream print into black ink linework only, with rough carved edges, uneven stamped texture, visible paper grain, and hand-printed imperfections.

Layout: Add a thick hand-carved rectangular border around the entire image. Fill the surrounding space with playful decorative motifs while keeping the center character readable.

Added motifs: Include exactly 3 jellyfish around the character, 4 ribbon bows placed near the four corners, 5 musical notes, 2 hearts, multiple bubbles, wavy water lines near the bottom, and scattered stars/sparkles in a cute handmade style.

Style: Make it look like an old children’s picture-book woodcut or linocut print, simple black ink on off-white paper, charming, slightly rough, nostalgic, with no color fills other than black ink. Avoid realistic shading, gradients, or modern digital polish.

Optional customization: Use {argument name="ink color" default="black"} ink on {argument name="paper color" default="cream"} paper, with the character in a {argument name="pose" default="one-hand waving pose"} and a {argument name="print style" default="nostalgic Japanese woodblock print"} finish.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图像为角色基础，将其转换为质感米色纸张上的怀旧单色日本木刻版画插图。将构图从竖向肖像改为宽幅横向明信片布局，保留可爱的海洋主题女孩及其服装设计，但将其重绘得更小并置于中心，面向前方，单手举起友好挥手。将蓝米配色转换为纯黑墨线条，呈现粗糙的雕刻边缘、不均匀的印章质感、可见的纸张纹理以及手工印刷的瑕疵。

布局：在整个图像周围添加厚实的纯手工雕刻矩形边框。在保持中心角色清晰可见的同时，用俏皮的装饰元素填充周围空间。

添加元素：在角色周围精确添加 3 只水母、放置在四个角落附近的 4 个蝴蝶结、5 个音符、2 个爱心、多个气泡、底部的波浪水纹，以及以可爱手工风格散落的星星/闪光点。

风格：呈现出老式儿童绘本木刻或版画的效果，米白色纸张上的简约黑墨线条，充满魅力、略显粗糙、怀旧，除黑墨外无任何填色。避免使用写实阴影、渐变或现代数字润色。

可选自定义：使用 {argument name="ink color" default="黑色"} 墨水在 {argument name="paper color" default="米色"} 纸张上进行创作，角色采用 {argument name="pose" default="单手挥手姿势"}，并呈现 {argument name="print style" default="怀旧日本木刻版画"} 效果。

templates.title: Gothic Stained Glass Anime Maiden

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical fantasy illustration of a grand Gothic cathedral interior dominated by a towering arched stained-glass window. The stained glass depicts an elegant anime-style holy maiden or battle princess, {argument name="character role" default="a saintly axe-wielding maiden"}, standing full-body in the center and holding an ornate long poleaxe diagonally across her body. She wears a delicate white and pale blue dress with translucent layered sleeves, gold filigree trim, floral embroidery, a dark corset bodice, pearl-like accessories, and a halo-like wreath of pale flowers around her head. Her face is intentionally covered by a flat opaque beige square censor block centered over the facial area. The window is filled with intricate lead came patterns and luminous glass textures: exactly 5 large floral medallion motifs near the upper arch, many white and cream blossoms with teal leaves around the figure, gold ornamental borders, blue accents, cracked translucent glass, and bright sunlight glowing through. Surround the window with realistic dark stone cathedral architecture, ribbed arch molding, carved columns, and warm side shadows. Add exactly 2 symmetrical flower arrangements in gold vases on pedestals near the lower left and lower right edges. The polished stone floor reflects the stained-glass colors in shimmering patches of blue, gold, and white. Use {argument name="visual style" default="ultra-detailed anime stained glass mixed with realistic cathedral photography"}, dramatic backlighting, warm sacred atmosphere, sharp ornate linework, complex transparent glass texture, high contrast, no visible text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高度精细的竖构图奇幻插画，展现宏伟的哥特式教堂内部，画面主体为一座高耸的拱形彩色玻璃窗。彩色玻璃描绘了一位优雅的动漫风格圣女或战斗公主，{argument name="character role" default="一位手持战斧的圣洁少女"}，全身立于画面中央，斜持一把华丽的长柄战斧。她身着精致的白蓝相间长裙，配有半透明的层叠袖子、金色花丝饰边、花卉刺绣、深色紧身胸衣、珍珠般的配饰，头戴一圈淡色花环，宛如光环。她的面部被一个位于脸部中央的平坦不透明米色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。窗户充满了复杂的铅条图案和发光的玻璃纹理：上拱门附近有 5 个大型花卉奖章图案，人物周围环绕着许多白色和奶油色的花朵及青色叶片，配有金色装饰边框、蓝色点缀、裂纹半透明玻璃，以及透过玻璃的明亮阳光。窗户周围环绕着写实的深色石质教堂建筑、肋架拱顶线条、雕刻柱子和温暖的侧影。在左下角和右下角的底座上各添加 2 个对称的金色花瓶插花。抛光的石质地面反射出彩色玻璃的色彩，呈现出闪烁的蓝色、金色和白色斑块。使用 {argument name="visual style" default="超精细动漫彩色玻璃与写实教堂摄影的结合"}，戏剧性的背光，温暖的神圣氛围，锐利华丽的线条，复杂的透明玻璃纹理，高对比度，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a simple abstract full-frame gradient wallpaper in a 16:9 landscape canvas. Use a smooth, soft-focus blue color field with no text, no objects, no visible shapes, and no borders. The composition should transition from very dark navy and near-black in the upper-left corner into saturated cobalt and royal blue across the center, then into brighter azure and electric blue toward the right side, with a pale icy blue glow near the lower-right area. Keep the gradient organic and slightly uneven, like a blurred luminous surface, with subtle diagonal movement from dark upper left to bright lower right. Use high resolution, clean digital rendering, minimal noise, and a polished modern tech aesthetic. Main palette: {argument name="dark corner color" default="near-black navy"}, {argument name="central blue" default="deep cobalt blue"}, and {argument name="bright glow color" default="pale icy azure"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 横向画布的简约抽象全屏渐变壁纸。使用平滑、柔焦的蓝色色域，不包含任何文字、物体、可见形状或边框。构图应从左上角的深海军蓝和近黑色，过渡到中心区域的饱和钴蓝和宝蓝色，再向右侧过渡为更明亮的蔚蓝和电光蓝，并在右下角附近呈现淡淡的冰蓝色光晕。保持渐变的有机感和轻微的不均匀感，如同模糊的发光表面，并带有从左上角深色到右下角亮色的微妙对角线动感。使用高分辨率、干净的数字渲染，减少噪点，呈现精致的现代科技美学。主色调：{argument name="dark corner color" default="近黑色海军蓝"}, {argument name="central blue" default="深钴蓝色"}, 以及 {argument name="bright glow color" default="淡冰蔚蓝色"}。

templates.title: Blueberry Courseware Cover Slide

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝莓课件封面 Slides

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an elegant widescreen PPT courseware cover slide about {argument name="topic" default="the past and present of blueberries"}, blending Chinese editorial typography with soft watercolor botanical illustration.

Canvas: 16:9 landscape presentation slide, warm off-white handmade paper texture background with subtle fibers, faint stains, and minimal ink speckles.

Layout: Left third is dominated by a large Chinese title in dark blue-gray: {argument name="Chinese title" default="蓝莓的\n前世今生"}. Place the title in two stacked lines with generous spacing, using a refined Song/Ming-style serif font. Above it, small uppercase text reads “PPT COURSEWARE” preceded by a tiny gold circular icon. Under the title, add a short thin gold line and the English subtitle in small serif capitals: {argument name="English subtitle" default="THE PAST AND PRESENT OF BLUEBERRIES"}. Bottom left shows the year {argument name="year" default="2026"} in large serif numerals, with a thin horizontal line beneath, then five small Chinese category labels separated by vertical dividers: “起源 | 演化 | 传播 | 栽培 | 科学 | 生活”.

Main imagery: Use exactly 6 visible blueberry-related watercolor elements across the slide: 1 large soft blue blueberry bloom near the upper center with a dark star-shaped calyx, 1 translucent blue leaf angled diagonally below-left of it, 1 small blueberry bloom near lower left labeled “origin”, 1 clustered pair of blurry blueberries near lower middle-right with one visible calyx, 1 circular blueberry cross-section on the right labeled “cut” with pale pulp and small seed dots, and 1 small fuzzy blueberry wash near the lower right. Keep all fruit elements desaturated indigo, smoky blue, and gray-blue, with feathered watercolor edges.

Technical annotation details: Add fine gold and blue-gray diagram marks: tiny crosses, dotted guide lines, small circles, target rings, and thin leader lines. Include exactly 3 small numeric labels: “01” near the upper-center blueberry, “02” near the middle-right cluster, and “01” as a page number at the bottom right. Add the labels “origin” and “cut” in very small serif text.

Right margin: Add a narrow vertical text column on the far right with small Chinese copy: {argument name="vertical quote" default="一颗小小的蓝色果实，如何跨越时间与空间，与人类的文明相遇、相知、相伴。"}. Beside or below it, add very small vertical English text in uppercase, decorative and partially editorial, about blueberries traversing time and space.

Visual style: Minimal premium academic presentation design, Chinese new-literati aesthetic, botanical science notes, high negative space, soft ink-wash watercolor, muted navy-blue and gray palette with restrained antique-gold accents, crisp typography but organic painted fruit. No people, no photorealistic fruit, no bright colors, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张优雅的 16:9 宽屏 PPT 课件封面，主题为 {argument name="topic" default="蓝莓的前世今生"}，融合中国风编辑排版与柔和的水彩植物插画。

画布：16:9 横向演示文稿，温暖的米白色手工纸纹理背景，带有细微的纤维、淡淡的污渍和极少的墨点。

布局：左侧三分之一处以深蓝灰色的中文大标题为主：{argument name="Chinese title" default="蓝莓的\n前世今生"}。标题分两行堆叠，字间距宽裕，采用精致的宋体/明体衬线字体。标题上方是一行小型大写字母“PPT COURSEWARE”，前缀为一个微小的金色圆形图标。标题下方添加一条细长的金线，以及小型衬线大写字母的英文副标题：{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE PAST AND PRESENT OF BLUEBERRIES"}。左下角显示年份 {argument name="year" default="2026"}，使用大号衬线数字，下方有一条细横线，随后是五个由竖线分隔的中文分类标签：“起源 | 演化 | 传播 | 栽培 | 科学 | 生活”。

主要图像：在整个页面中使用 6 个可见的蓝莓相关水彩元素：上部中心附近 1 个带有深色星形花萼的柔和蓝色蓝莓花，左下方斜向放置 1 片半透明蓝色叶子，左下角附近 1 个标有“origin”的小型蓝莓花，中右下方附近 1 组模糊的蓝莓（其中一个可见花萼），右侧 1 个标有“cut”的蓝莓横截面（带有淡色果肉和细小的种子点），以及右下角附近 1 个模糊的蓝莓水彩晕染。所有水果元素均保持去饱和的靛蓝、烟蓝和灰蓝色，边缘呈现水彩晕染效果。

技术标注细节：添加精致的金色和蓝灰色图表标记：微小的十字、虚线引导线、小圆圈、目标环和细长的指引线。包含 3 个小型数字标签：“01”位于上部中心蓝莓附近，“02”位于中右侧蓝莓簇附近，“01”作为页码位于右下角。添加极小的衬线文字标签“origin”和“cut”。

右侧边距：在最右侧添加一列窄竖排中文文案：{argument name="vertical quote" default="一颗小小的蓝色果实，如何跨越时间与空间，与人类的文明相遇、相知、相伴。"}。在其旁边或下方，添加非常小的竖排英文大写字母，作为装饰性且具有编辑感的文字，内容关于蓝莓跨越时间和空间。

视觉风格：极简高端学术演示设计，中国新文人美学，植物科学笔记，留白充裕，柔和的水墨水彩，静谧的深蓝与灰色调，点缀克制的古金色。无人物，无照片级写实水果，无鲜艳色彩，无水印。

templates.title: Tang Lychee Courseware Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 唐风荔枝课件封面

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an elegant Tang-dynasty inspired courseware/PPT cover slide about {argument name="main title" default="杨贵妃 与 荔枝"}, with a poetic Chinese historical aesthetic centered on lychees and a veiled court beauty.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal presentation cover, warm ivory handmade-rice-paper background with subtle fibers, stains, faint scratches, and ink-wash aging. Overall palette is muted cream, dusty rose, pale peach, faded red, olive gray, and ink gray.

Layout: Place the main title large on the left-center in refined Chinese calligraphy-style serif lettering. Put the small subtitle directly underneath with a decorative gold flourish at the far left. Keep generous negative space on the left and lower middle. On the right half, show a soft translucent back-view silhouette of a Tang-dynasty noblewoman with bare shoulders, high rounded hair buns, ornate gold dangling hair jewelry, and large pink-red peony flowers in her hair; her face area is intentionally covered by a plain pale beige rectangular privacy block. Add floating lychees around her and foreground depth blur.

Text content: Include exactly these visible text areas: 1) top-left small cloud-shaped seal containing “盛唐 / 风物”; 2) main title “杨贵妃 与 荔枝”; 3) subtitle “一颗果子的盛唐记忆”; 4) lower-left English stack “Tang Dynasty / Cultural Story / Courseware”; 5) lower-left Chinese label “PPT · 课件”; 6) right-side vertical poem text “长安回望绣堆，山顶千门次第开。——杜牧《过华清宫》”; 7) small tag near the peeled lychee reading “贵妃鲜” with a red seal mark; 8) bottom-right page number “01” with a small gold ornamental underline.

Subject details: Include exactly 4 visible lychee elements: one small blurred whole lychee floating near the upper center, one sharp whole lychee on the right side, one large peeled lychee in the lower-right center with translucent white flesh exposed and red bumpy skin opened around it, and one large heavily blurred partial lychee in the lower foreground. Add a few pale green lychee leaves connected to the peeled fruit. Make the lychees painterly but realistic, with bumpy red shells and soft natural highlights.

Visual style: Minimal luxury Chinese editorial design, museum-courseware cover, soft ink wash, translucent layering, shallow depth of field, delicate gold accents, understated red stamp marks, balanced asymmetrical composition, no modern UI elements.

Constraints: Keep the page clean and airy, maintain the exact count of 4 lychee elements, keep all typography readable, use no extra text beyond the specified labels, no watermark, no photorealistic harsh lighting.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张优雅的唐风课件/PPT 封面，主题为 {argument name="main title" default="杨贵妃 与 荔枝"}，展现以荔枝和朦胧宫廷美人为核心的诗意中国历史美学。

画布：16:9 横向演示封面，采用带有细微纤维、污渍、浅划痕和水墨老化效果的暖象牙色手工宣纸背景。整体色调为柔和的奶油色、灰粉色、淡桃色、褪色红、橄榄灰和水墨灰。

布局：将主标题以精致的中文书法风格衬线字体置于左侧中央。副标题置于其正下方，最左侧配有装饰性金色花纹。左侧和中下部留出充足的负空间。右半部分展示一位唐代贵族女性的柔和半透明背影剪影，露出肩部，梳着高耸圆髻，佩戴华丽的金色垂坠发饰，发间点缀着硕大的粉红色牡丹花；其面部区域特意用一块素雅的淡米色矩形遮挡。周围点缀漂浮的荔枝，并增加前景深度模糊效果。

文本内容：包含以下明确的可见文本区域：1) 左上角云形印章，内含“盛唐 / 风物”；2) 主标题“杨贵妃 与 荔枝”；3) 副标题“一颗果子的盛唐记忆”；4) 左下角英文堆叠文字“Tang Dynasty / Cultural Story / Courseware”；5) 左下角中文标签“PPT · 课件”；6) 右侧竖排诗句“长安回望绣堆，山顶千门次第开。——杜牧《过华清宫》”；7) 剥皮荔枝旁的小标签，写有“贵妃鲜”并带有红色印章标记；8) 右下角页码“01”，下方配有小型金色装饰下划线。

主体细节：包含 4 个可见的荔枝元素：上方中央漂浮一颗模糊的小荔枝，右侧一颗清晰的完整荔枝，右下中央一颗剥皮的大荔枝（露出半透明白色果肉，红色凹凸果皮向外翻开），以及前景下方一颗高度模糊的荔枝局部。在剥皮荔枝旁添加几片淡绿色荔枝叶。荔枝呈现绘画感且真实，具有凹凸的红色外壳和柔和的自然高光。

视觉风格：极简奢华的中国编辑设计，博物馆课件封面，柔和水墨，半透明分层，浅景深，精致的金色点缀，低调的红色印章，平衡的非对称构图，无现代 UI 元素。

约束：保持页面整洁通透，严格控制 4 个荔枝元素的数量，确保所有排版清晰易读，除指定标签外不添加额外文本，无水印，避免写实风格的强光效果。

templates.title: Deep Sea Jellyfish Couture Board

titleLocalized.zh: 深海水母高级定制项目

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-fashion menswear concept board inspired by {argument name="inspiration source" default="deep sea jellyfish"}, combining a central couture runway look with fashion design research panels, technical tailoring sketches, material tests, color studies, and handwritten atelier annotations.

Canvas: Portrait-oriented editorial fashion board on warm off-white archival paper, approximately 4:5 ratio, with faint grid marks, thin drafting lines, crop marks, pin-registration marks, subtle paper grain, and a luxury atelier mood. Use black, deep navy, icy cyan, translucent blue, silver, and white.

Main subject: Place one full-body male model centered and slightly forward, wearing {argument name="collection look name" default="Look 07 - Abyssalis"}. The face should be softly blurred or obscured, while the outfit remains sharp. The garment is futuristic couture menswear: a glossy black structured long coat or suit base with a high stand collar, layered liquid-black tailoring, wide sculptural shoulders, transparent jellyfish-like cape panels, flowing organza veils, fine dangling filament strands, reflective wet-look surfaces, and scattered bioluminescent cyan-blue bead lights. The silhouette should feel like a deep-sea creature translated into formal tailoring, with long translucent tentacle ribbons trailing from shoulders, sleeves, and hem to the floor. Add black boots visible beneath the layered coat.

Left research column: Include exactly 8 stacked research sections with small labels and visual materials:
1. Header reading “INSPIRATION : DEEP SEA JELLYFISH” with subheading “BIOLUMINESCENT STRUCTURE.”
2. “ANATOMI STUDY” section with exactly 2 jellyfish anatomy sketches, one blue-toned and one monochrome line sketch, plus small handwritten notes about a transparent bell, gelatinous structure, and radial symmetry.
3. “TENTACLE DYNAMICS” section with exactly 1 side-view jellyfish drawing showing long streaming tentacles, annotated with fluid motion, graceful undulation, and movement.
4. “BIOLUMINESCENCE ANALYSIS” section with exactly 2 glowing jellyfish reference images and exactly 5 vertical color bars beside them, from black and deep navy through teal to pale icy blue.
5. “MATERIAL EXPERIMENTS” section with exactly 3 square translucent material samples, annotated as fine membrane, iridescent organza, sheer tulle, liquid satin, and fiber optic thread.
6. “COLOR PALETTE” section with exactly 7 rectangular swatches: black, midnight navy, dark blue, teal, cyan, pale blue, and nearly white translucent blue, annotated as deep sea, ice blue, bioluminescent, and pearl white.
7. “FABRIC SWATCHES & TESTS” section with exactly 5 overlapping physical swatches in black vinyl/satin and translucent blue organza, some with glowing blue thread or bead-like highlights.
8. “LIGHT REACTION TEST” section with exactly 1 small dark photo panel showing bright blue fiber-optic streaks, plus a note about reaction, bioluminescent thread, subtle glow, and in darkness. At the bottom include atelier notes reading “ATELIER NOTES,” “PROJECT : ABYSSALIS,” “LOOK : 07,” “SEASON : SS27,” and “DEVELOPMENT STAGE : 4,” followed by a designer signature line.

Right technical column: Include exactly 6 design-development sections:
1. Top heading “TECHNICAL TAILORING SKETCH” with subheading “LOOK 07 - ABYSSALIS,” showing exactly 2 tall technical fashion sketches, front and back views, of the same long translucent layered coat.
2. A bullet-note block with exactly 5 bullets: bioluminescent tailoring; transparent marine layering; liquid silhouette engineering; floating organza extension; deep-sea inspired main couture; fluid structural movement.
3. A construction-detail area with exactly 4 smaller line drawings: structured inner coat with enlarged organic hood; transparent layered cape with floating silhouette; tentacle extensions as sheer organza; flowing wide-leg pants with liquid cut lines.
4. “EMBELLISHMENT MAP” section with exactly 1 front torso sketch covered in blue dot placements and exactly 3 legend dots labeled high density, medium density, and low density; add a note for fiber optic embroidery placement.
5. “DETAIL & TEXTURE CLOSE-UP” section with exactly 3 rectangular close-up images showing black glossy fabric with blue glowing bead lines, transparent crinkled organza, and watery translucent blue membrane texture.
6. Sparse handwritten annotations around the sketches, using elegant thin cursive, while keeping the text secondary and not overcrowded.

Visual style: Photorealistic central model blended with delicate pencil fashion sketches, scientific specimen diagrams, luxury couture board presentation, translucent layering, iridescent highlights, cyan bioluminescent specks, black liquid satin, and fine technical drafting aesthetics. The board should feel like an elite fashion house concept sheet for futuristic couture menswear, directly inspired by deep-sea jellyfish anatomy.

Text constraints: Use the visible English headings and atelier labels as described. Keep typography small, refined, and editorial; mix uppercase serif labels with handwritten cursive notes. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra models, or unrelated sea creatures. The final image should read as one complete fashion concept board for {argument name="garment theme" default="bioluminescent jellyfish couture menswear"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个以 {argument name="inspiration source" default="深海水母"} 为灵感的高级男装概念项目，将核心的高级定制秀场造型与时尚设计研究面板、技术剪裁草图、材料测试、色彩研究以及手写工作室注释相结合。

画布：暖白色档案纸上的纵向编辑风格时尚项目，比例约为 4:5，带有淡淡的网格标记、细制图线、裁切标记、定位标记、细腻的纸张纹理以及奢华的工作室氛围。使用黑色、深海军蓝、冰青色、半透明蓝色、银色和白色。

主体：将一名全身男模特置于中心并略微靠前，身穿 {argument name="collection look name" default="Look 07 - Abyssalis"}。面部应柔化模糊或遮挡，而服装保持清晰。服装为未来主义高级定制男装：黑色光泽结构长外套或西装底座，配有高立领、层叠的液态黑色剪裁、宽大的雕塑感肩部、透明的水母状斗篷面板、飘逸的欧根纱面纱、细长的悬垂丝线、反光的湿感表面以及散落的生物发光青蓝色珠光灯。轮廓应如同转化为正式剪裁的深海生物，长长的半透明触须丝带从肩部、袖子和下摆拖曳至地面。在层叠外套下露出黑色靴子。

左侧研究栏：包含 8 个堆叠的研究部分，带有小标签和视觉材料：
1. 标题为“INSPIRATION : DEEP SEA JELLYFISH”，副标题为“BIOLUMINESCENT STRUCTURE”。
2. “ANATOMI STUDY”部分，包含 2 个水母解剖草图，一个为蓝色调，一个为单色线条草图，并附有关于透明钟状体、胶状结构和径向对称的小型手写注释。
3. “TENTACLE DYNAMICS”部分，包含 1 个侧视图水母绘图，展示长长的流动触须，并标注有流体运动、优雅起伏和动态感。
4. “BIOLUMINESCENCE ANALYSIS”部分，包含 2 个发光水母参考图像，旁边有 5 个垂直色条，从黑色和深海军蓝过渡到青色和浅冰蓝色。
5. “MATERIAL EXPERIMENTS”部分，包含 3 个方形半透明材料样本，标注为精细薄膜、虹彩欧根纱、透明薄纱、液态缎面和光纤线。
6. “COLOR PALETTE”部分，包含 7 个矩形色块：黑色、午夜海军蓝、深蓝色、青色、青色、浅蓝色和近乎白色的半透明蓝色，标注为深海、冰蓝、生物发光和珍珠白。
7. “FABRIC SWATCHES & TESTS”部分，包含 5 个重叠的实体色块，材质为黑色乙烯基/缎面和半透明蓝色欧根纱，部分带有发光的蓝色线或珠状高光。
8. “LIGHT REACTION TEST”部分，包含 1 个小型暗色照片面板，展示明亮的蓝色光纤条纹，并附有关于反应、生物发光线、微光和黑暗环境中的注释。底部包含工作室注释，写着“ATELIER NOTES”、“PROJECT : ABYSSALIS”、“LOOK : 07”、“SEASON : SS27”和“DEVELOPMENT STAGE : 4”，后跟设计师签名栏。

右侧技术栏：包含 6 个设计开发部分：
1. 顶部标题“TECHNICAL TAILORING SKETCH”，副标题为“LOOK 07 - ABYSSALIS”，展示 2 个高大的技术时尚草图，即同一件长款半透明层叠外套的正反面视图。
2. 一个包含 5 个要点的列表块：生物发光剪裁；透明海洋层叠；液态轮廓工程；漂浮欧根纱延伸；深海灵感主打高定；流体结构运动。
3. 一个包含 4 个较小线条图的结构细节区域：带有放大有机连帽的结构化内层外套；带有漂浮轮廓的透明层叠斗篷；作为透明欧根纱的触须延伸；带有液态剪裁线条的飘逸阔腿裤。
4. “EMBELLISHMENT MAP”部分，包含 1 个覆盖蓝色圆点位置的前躯干草图，以及 3 个标注为高密度、中密度和低密度的图例圆点；添加光纤刺绣位置的注释。
5. “DETAIL & TEXTURE CLOSE-UP”部分，包含 3 个矩形特写图像，展示带有蓝色发光珠线的黑色光泽面料、透明褶皱欧根纱和水感半透明蓝色薄膜纹理。
6. 草图周围稀疏的手写注释，使用优雅纤细的连体字，同时保持文字作为辅助，不显得拥挤。

视觉风格：照片级真实感中心模特与精致的铅笔时尚草图、科学标本图、奢华高定项目展示、半透明层叠、虹彩高光、青色生物发光斑点、黑色液态缎面和精细技术制图美学相结合。该项目应呈现出精英时装屋为未来主义高级定制男装设计的概念页，直接灵感来源于深海水母解剖结构。

文本约束：使用描述中可见的英文标题和工作室标签。保持字体小巧、精致且具有编辑感；混合大写衬线标签与手写连体注释。不要添加徽标、水印、额外的模特或不相关的海洋生物。最终图像应呈现为一个完整的时尚概念项目，主题为 {argument name="garment theme" default="生物发光水母高级定制男装"}。

templates.title: Statue of Liberty Technical Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 自由女神像技术信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed vertical museum-style infographic poster about {argument name="monument name" default="自由女神像"}, combining Chinese primary typography with small English subtitles, as if from an architectural history atlas.

Canvas: Tall portrait poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, warm ivory paper background with faint grid lines, thin technical drafting rules, subtle aging texture, and precise editorial margins. Use a refined beige, charcoal, muted bronze, oxidized copper green, and faded gray palette.

Main title area: At the top center place the large black Chinese headline “自由女神像”, with the English title “STATUE OF LIBERTY” beneath it in spaced serif capitals. Add a small bilingual motto line below: “自由照亮世界，人类追求自由与希望的永恒象征” and “FREEDOM ILLUMINATES THE WORLD, AN ETERNAL SYMBOL OF HUMAN PURSUIT OF LIBERTY AND HOPE.”

Central subject: Dominating the middle, show a full-height Statue of Liberty technical cutaway. The left half should be the exterior oxidized copper statue with flowing robes, raised torch, crown spikes, and tablet; the right half should be sliced open to reveal dark iron lattice scaffolding, internal stairs, cross-bracing, and pedestal structure. Render it as realistic engraved architectural illustration with soft shadows and precise linework.

Left information column: Add a narrow sidebar titled “基本信息 / BASIC INFORMATION” with exactly 8 icon-and-text entries: official name, location, dedication date, designer, sculptor, total height, weight, and symbolism. Below it add “材料与工艺 / MATERIALS & CRAFTSMANSHIP” with exactly 4 stacked material swatches: copper sheets, wrought iron frame, granite base, and concrete foundation. Add a small “关键数据 / KEY DATA” block with exactly 6 compact numeric rows.

Left of central statue: Add “结构解析 / STRUCTURAL ANALYSIS” with exactly 4 circular magnified callout diagrams connected to the statue: torch structure, head structure, internal skeleton, and copper fixing method. Each circle contains a cropped technical detail, short Chinese label, English subtitle, and two short annotation lines.

Right analytical panels: Add “尺寸图与比例 / DIMENSIONS & PROPORTIONS” with exactly 5 diagrams: full statue height comparison, statue-only height, pedestal height, top-view star-shaped base diagram, and base-width measurement. Add “结构系统分解 / STRUCTURAL SYSTEM BREAKDOWN” with exactly 5 stacked exploded mini illustrations: copper exterior, iron framework, internal spiral/stair system, granite pedestal, and concrete foundation.

Far-right sidebar: Add “环境与耐久性 / ENVIRONMENT & DURABILITY” with exactly 4 icon entries: wind resistance, structural design, temperature range, and lightning safety. Add “方向与视野 / ORIENTATION & VIEWSHED” with a compass rose and a pale New York Harbor map, including radial sight lines. Add “全球影响力 / GLOBAL IMPACT” with exactly 4 icon entries: symbol of immigration, annual visitors, global freedom icon, and cultural influence.

Bottom middle band: Add “历史时间线 / HISTORY TIMELINE” on the lower left with exactly 8 dated milestones from concept, design, construction, shipment, assembly, dedication, restoration, and modern preservation. Across the lower center add “建造过程与运输安装 / CONSTRUCTION & ASSEMBLY PROCESS” with exactly 7 numbered sepia photo cards labeled 01 to 07: selected fabrication, disassembly and crating, maritime transportation, pedestal construction, statue assembly, final completion, and public opening. Each card has a small archival image, number, Chinese label, and English subtitle.

Bottom scenic footer: The entire bottom quarter should be a cinematic panoramic scene of the Statue of Liberty on Liberty Island at golden-hour sunset, with New York City skyline in the background, calm harbor water, ferries, warm clouds, and atmospheric haze. Overlay white text on the left titled “自由的灯塔 / THE BEACON OF FREEDOM” followed by a short paragraph about welcoming people from across the world. On the right overlay “设计理念 / DESIGN PHILOSOPHY” with exactly 4 icon entries: Neoclassical style, Inspired by Roman Libertas, Symbol of Enlightenment, and A Gift Beyond Borders. Add a centered small bilingual dedication line near the bottom: “法国人民赠予美国人民 / A GIFT FROM THE PEOPLE OF FRANCE TO THE PEOPLE OF THE UNITED STATES.”

Visual style: Premium educational infographic, dense but orderly, realistic architectural engraving mixed with archival photography, thin serif typography, subtle Chinese editorial layout, crisp icons, accurate proportions, clean grid alignment, and no modern UI elements. Ensure all labels are legible and the poster feels like a professional historical architecture reference sheet.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张高度详细的垂直博物馆风格信息图海报，主题为 {argument name="monument name" default="自由女神像"}，结合中文主排版与小型英文副标题，呈现出建筑历史图集般的质感。

画布：高长比例海报，纵横比约为 2:3，采用暖象牙色纸张背景，带有淡淡的网格线、细致的工程制图线条、微妙的陈旧纹理以及精确的编辑页边距。使用精致的米色、炭灰色、柔和的青铜色、氧化铜绿色和褪色灰色调。

主标题区：在顶部居中位置放置醒目的黑色中文大标题“自由女神像”，下方辅以间距适中的衬线体英文标题“STATUE OF LIBERTY”。在下方添加一行简短的双语格言：“自由照亮世界，人类追求自由与希望的永恒象征”以及“FREEDOM ILLUMINATES THE WORLD, AN ETERNAL SYMBOL OF HUMAN PURSUIT OF LIBERTY AND HOPE.”

中心主体：在画面中部展示自由女神像的全高技术剖面图。左侧为外层氧化铜雕像，展现飘逸的长袍、高举的火炬、冠冕尖刺及铭板；右侧剖开以揭示内部深色的铁质格构脚手架、内部楼梯、交叉支撑及基座结构。以写实的雕版建筑插图风格呈现，配以柔和的阴影和精确的线条。

左侧信息栏：添加一个窄侧边栏，标题为“基本信息 / BASIC INFORMATION”，包含 8 个图标加文字条目：官方名称、地理位置、落成日期、设计师、雕塑家、总高度、重量及象征意义。下方添加“材料与工艺 / MATERIALS & CRAFTSMANSHIP”，包含 4 个堆叠的材料样本：铜板、锻铁框架、花岗岩基座及混凝土基础。添加一个“关键数据 / KEY DATA”区块，包含 6 行紧凑的数字信息。

中心雕像左侧：添加“结构解析 / STRUCTURAL ANALYSIS”，包含 4 个连接至雕像的圆形放大标注图：火炬结构、头部结构、内部骨架及铜板固定方式。每个圆圈内包含裁剪的技术细节、简短的中文标签、英文副标题及两行简短注释。

右侧分析面板：添加“尺寸图与比例 / DIMENSIONS & PROPORTIONS”，包含 5 个图表：雕像全高对比、雕像净高、基座高度、星形基座俯视图及基座宽度测量。添加“结构系统分解 / STRUCTURAL SYSTEM BREAKDOWN”，包含 5 个堆叠的爆炸式迷你插图：铜质外壳、铁质框架、内部螺旋/楼梯系统、花岗岩基座及混凝土基础。

最右侧侧边栏：添加“环境与耐久性 / ENVIRONMENT & DURABILITY”，包含 4 个图标条目：抗风性、结构设计、温度范围及防雷安全。添加“方向与视野 / ORIENTATION & VIEWSHED”，配以罗盘玫瑰和淡色的纽约港地图，包含放射状视线。添加“全球影响力 / GLOBAL IMPACT”，包含 4 个图标条目：移民象征、年度游客量、全球自由偶像及文化影响力。

底部中间带：左下方添加“历史时间线 / HISTORY TIMELINE”，包含 8 个带日期的里程碑，涵盖概念、设计、建造、运输、组装、落成、修复及现代保护。底部中心横向添加“建造过程与运输安装 / CONSTRUCTION & ASSEMBLY PROCESS”，包含 7 张编号为 01 至 07 的棕褐色照片卡片：选材制造、拆卸装箱、海上运输、基座建造、雕像组装、最终完工及公众开放。每张卡片配有小型档案图像、编号、中文标签及英文副标题。

底部风景页脚：底部四分之一区域应为黄金时段日落时分自由岛上自由女神像的电影级全景图，背景为纽约市天际线、平静的港口水域、渡轮、暖色云层及大气薄雾。左侧叠加白色文字标题“自由的灯塔 / THE BEACON OF FREEDOM”，后接一段关于欢迎世界各地人民的简短文字。右侧叠加“设计理念 / DESIGN PHILOSOPHY”，包含 4 个图标条目：新古典主义风格、灵感源自罗马自由女神、启蒙运动象征及跨越国界的礼物。底部附近添加一行居中的双语致辞：“法国人民赠予美国人民 / A GIFT FROM THE PEOPLE OF FRANCE TO THE PEOPLE OF THE UNITED STATES.”

视觉风格：高端教育类信息图，内容密集但井然有序，写实建筑雕版画与档案摄影相结合，细衬线字体，微妙的中文编辑排版，清晰的图标，准确的比例，整齐的网格对齐，且不含现代 UI 元素。确保所有标签清晰易读，海报呈现出专业历史建筑参考图纸的质感。

templates.title: Sun Wukong Epic Fantasy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级孙悟空奇幻海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical fantasy movie poster for {argument name="character name" default="Sun Wukong"}, inspired by Journey to the West, showing the Monkey King charging out of the frame with overwhelming heroic motion.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, ultra-detailed, high-contrast, epic Chinese mythological fantasy, warm golden storm light, dark mountain valley, volumetric clouds, dust, sparks, magical energy trails, dramatic depth of field.

Main subject: One central full-body 3D character, Sun Wukong, leaping toward the viewer from a rocky mountain path. He wears ornate red-and-gold battle armor with engraved shoulder plates, layered scale skirt armor, red cloth ribbons, tiger-fur waist accents, decorated bracers and boots. His golden-brown monkey hair rises upward like a flaming mane. His face is covered by a centered opaque brown square censor block. His right arm thrusts a huge golden staff directly toward the camera, making the staff extremely foreshortened and breaking the poster frame; the staff dominates the left foreground and is motion-blurred at the tip. His left arm extends backward for balance, with red scarf fabric whipping in the wind.

Environment: A vast mythic mountain landscape with jagged cliffs on both sides, a winding rocky path below, distant temples and pavilions built on peaks, storm clouds split by heavenly sunlight, flying debris, mist, and radiant golden spell lines connecting scenes across the poster.

Background story vignettes: Include exactly 4 small narrative scenes around the main figure: 1) upper left, a distant sacred mountain temple on a cliff; 2) upper right, a floating celestial palace scene with two flying immortal figures inside a glowing rectangular magical frame; 3) lower left, a monk-like Tang Sanzang figure standing on the path among mist and followers; 4) mid-to-lower right, a small warrior or pilgrim figure walking through the mountain trail near glowing spell lines.

Chinese poster text: Add exactly 6 vertical or calligraphic text groups in gold. Preserve these visible Chinese titles: 1) large bottom-left brush calligraphy title 「孙悟空」; 2) upper-left vertical label 「花果山」; 3) upper-right vertical label 「大闹天宫」; 4) mid-right vertical label 「五行山下」; 5) lower-right vertical label 「降妖除魔」; 6) lower-left vertical label 「西天取经」. Add tiny supporting Chinese subtext beside each label, but keep it decorative and secondary. Include a small red seal stamp near the large title and a small tagline at the bottom reading 「齐天大圣·斗战之心」.

Composition: The staff must protrude aggressively from the center-left foreground toward the viewer; the main body should fill the middle of the poster; the four background vignettes should remain smaller and atmospheric. Use golden linework and faint geometric frames to guide the eye around the poster.

Style: Hyper-realistic 3D render mixed with Chinese fantasy concept art, ornate armor detail, cinematic lighting, IMAX poster scale, dynamic action, dust clouds, glowing particles, dramatic clouds, sharp central character, soft atmospheric background.

Constraints: No modern objects, no English text on the poster, no extra main characters, no logos or watermarks. Keep the face-obscuring brown square visible exactly over the central character's face.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="孙悟空"} 创建一张电影级奇幻角色海报，风格设定为史诗级 3D《西游记》英雄档案封面。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，超高细节，戏剧性的广角透视，高奇幻写实风格，金色风暴光效，云雾、尘埃、飞溅的火花，山峦纵深感，无现代物体。

主体：一位核心猴王英雄在岩石山路上腾空而起，直接冲向观众。他手中的长金箍棒从左下角前景向观众方向伸出画面，具有强烈的透视缩短效果，近端带有动态模糊。他身着华丽的红金战甲，配有雕花肩甲、层叠鳞片裙甲、雕刻护腕、装饰性长靴、飘逸的红绸腰带和虎皮腰裙。他的毛发呈炽热的金色并向上飞扬。在他的面部中心放置一个平面的不透明方形遮挡块，以匹配可见的图像构图。

背景与世界：广阔的神话山峦景观，伴有云海、悬崖、古寺、发光的法术轨迹和暴风雨般的夕阳云层。在英雄周围包含四个叙事性次要小插图：1) 左上角，远处的悬崖寺庙和山峦，标注为花果山场景；2) 左下角，岩石小径上的一位僧人形象，代表取经之路；3) 右上角，漂浮的天宫战斗场景，有空中战士和魔法线条；4) 中右至右下角，悬崖与云雾中远处的除魔形象。添加纤细的发光金色几何线条和类似星座的框架来连接这些场景。

文字与排版：在左下角添加醒目的粗犷金色书法标题 {argument name="main title text" default="孙悟空"}，旁边附带一枚红色印章。下方添加一行小型金色副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="齐天大圣·斗战之心"}。添加五组纤细的竖排侧边标签，采用优雅的金色中式排版：左上、左下、右上、中右、右下各一组；保持装饰性和次要地位，配有微小的注释线条和圆点。

视觉风格：超写实 3D 奇幻概念艺术，电影海报质感，华丽的中国神话盔甲，体积云，大气透视，发光的轮廓光，脚下的尘埃漩涡，以暖金和深红为主色调，搭配冷蓝灰色的山峦，中心细节锐利，背景远景柔和。

约束条件：仅限一位主要英雄，一根突出的金箍棒，四个次要小插图，五组竖排侧边标签，一个大标题块，一枚红印章，以及一个副标题。确保金箍棒明显打破画面边界。避免出现 Logo、水印、前景中多余的人物，或简洁的现代平面设计风格。

His face is replaced by a smooth soft rectangular blurred placeholder with no facial features. He rides one white horse facing forward, with elaborate leather-and-gold tack, tassels, medallions, and raised front hoof. In his left hand he holds one tall golden monk staff with multiple circular rings and decorative filigree; the staff extends upward like a heroic weapon breaking out of the composition. Wind blows the red robe to the right.

Background and layout: Surround the central figure with exactly 6 glowing parchment-like memory vignettes, each separated by flowing golden light trails and translucent irregular frame edges. The 6 vignettes are: 1) upper left, a heavenly scene with a robed monk figure on a cloud platform and soldiers or spirits around him; 2) upper right, the pilgrimage group walking with horses through a rocky mountain pass; 3) middle left, a battle scene with monks or companions fighting demons in dusty terrain; 4) middle right, a chaotic monster battle on a dark hillside; 5) lower left, a temple or village courtyard with figures standing under warm light; 6) lower right, a sorrowful kneeling figure or companion in a desolate rocky landscape. Keep all six panels semi-transparent and integrated into the storm clouds, not as clean modern boxes.

Text content: Add large vertical brush-calligraphy title at the lower left using {argument name="main title text" default="唐三藏"}, in rough metallic gold ink. Add a small red square seal stamp below the title. Add smaller gold subtitle near the bottom using {argument name="subtitle text" default="金蝉子转世 立誓求取真经"}. Place vertical Chinese chapter labels around the six vignettes using {argument name="vignette label text" default="天蓬元帅 / 西天取经 / 因醉被贬 / 大战妖魔 / 高老庄 / 慈悲忠心"}; use elegant thin gold calligraphy with small secondary lines, arranged like an ancient manuscript. Do not add English text.

Visual style: Epic Chinese mythological dark fantasy, ultra-detailed 3D character statue archive, cinematic lighting, warm rim light, glowing gold dust, realistic horse anatomy, ornate costume embroidery, weathered rocks, ancient scroll texture, dramatic depth of field, high contrast, heroic sacred atmosphere.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 central rider, 1 white horse, 1 ornate ringed monk staff, and exactly 6 surrounding vignette panels. Maintain a symmetrical poster hierarchy with the central horse and rider dominating the image. No modern objects, no watermark, no extra characters in the foreground, no clean UI borders.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="唐三藏"} 创建一张电影级竖版奇幻角色海报，采用史诗级《西游记》档案资料风格，中心为 3D 英雄人物，周围环绕多个故事记忆面板。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，采用深色神话色调，包含烟熏炭色、青铜色、金色、暖阳色和朦胧的羊皮纸色。使用超精细电影级 3D 渲染、体积云、戏剧性背光、尘埃、发光的魔法线条和高奇幻写实风格。

中心主体：将唐三藏置于画面中心，骑着白马沿崎岖山路前行。他身着赭色、棕褐色和深红色的多层佛教僧袍，配有华丽的金边、念珠和高耸的红金相间礼冠。他的面部应被柔和的方形模糊/马赛克遮挡。左手持一根高大华丽的金色禅杖，杖上有许多圆环和金银丝细工，向上突出。白马面向观众，向前迈步，配有装饰性的皮革金饰马具、流苏和胸前奖章装饰。让角色和马匹略微突破海报深度，仿佛从档案中浮现出来。

背景布局：在中心骑行者周围环绕 6 个发光的半透明故事小插图，形状为不规则的羊皮纸窗口，每个窗口由细细的金白色魔法光迹勾勒。六个面板分别是：1) 左上角，云端和武士中站立着身着长袍的仙人，呈现神圣的天界场景；2) 右上角，取经团队带着驮兽穿过山口；3) 左中，混乱的岩石战斗场景，有猪形武士和同伴；4) 右中，在迷雾和尘埃中与妖魔战斗的场景；5) 左下，寺庙或村庄场景，人物站在古建筑旁；6) 右下，悲伤的忠诚场景，人物在崎岖的景观中坐着或跪着。所有面板应呈现出嵌入在风暴背景中的棕褐色历史记忆感。

文字内容：在左下角添加大型竖排金色中文字体「唐三藏」。在下方添加较小的说明文字「金蝉子转世 立誓求取真经」。在相应的故事面板附近添加六组竖排中文标签，采用优雅的金白色字体：左上方面板附近为「天蓬元帅」，右上方面板附近为「西天取经」，左中面板附近为「因醉被贬」，右中面板附近为「大战妖魔」，左下面板附近为「高老庄」，右下面板附近为「慈悲忠心」。在左下角标题附近包含一个小红印章。

视觉风格：史诗级中国神话海报，华丽的佛教细节，高对比度，电影级灯光，奇幻概念艺术，写实的织物褶皱，金属反射，风化的山地地形，漂浮的烟雾，发光的金色轮廓，分层深度，无现代物品。

约束条件：使用 1 个中心骑行角色，1 匹白马，1 根突出的禅杖，6 个环绕的故事面板，以及上述 8 个主要文字元素。在适当的地方保持所有文字竖排，准确保留原始中文字符，避免添加额外的可读文本。

Goal: Create a cinematic vertical character-profile poster for a dark fantasy Journey to the West returning-heroes series, focused on {argument name="character name" default="猪八戒"}. The image should feel like a high-end 3D/photoreal fantasy movie key art poster, with the character standing full body in the foreground and breaking the poster frame with his weapon.

Main subject: One full-body stocky monk-warrior figure, Zhu Bajie inspired, centered and walking toward the viewer. He has a large round belly exposed under loose layered dark travel robes, worn cloth pants, wrapped boots, a scarf at the neck, a bundled traveler backpack over one shoulder, and two round brown gourds tied at his right side. His face is deliberately covered by a plain soft-edged brown rectangular blur mask, while the rest of the body remains sharp and detailed. The weapon should look heavy, metallic, ancient, and battle-worn.

Use exactly 7 small story vignette areas with Chinese vertical calligraphy captions: 3 on the left side and 4 on the right side. The vignettes should depict tiny robed pilgrims, monks, soldiers, mountain paths, temple silhouettes, and journey scenes, all integrated into the environment rather than as modern boxes.

Visible text: Add a large brush-calligraphy gold title near the lower left reading {argument name="large title text" default="猪八戒"}. Add a small red seal stamp beside it. Add a small gold subtitle along the bottom left reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="西行取经｜信念之心"}. Add the 7 vertical side captions as decorative Chinese calligraphy: left side captions include {argument name="left side captions" default="一戒挑担；高老庄招亲；贪嗔痴处皆自在人"}; right side captions include {argument name="right side captions" default="天蓬下凡；流沙河收徒；同行取经；终成正果"}. Make the calligraphy legible but secondary, with thin explanatory microtext beside some captions.

Style: Ultra-detailed 3D character render blended with painterly cinematic concept art, warm golden rim light from the cloudy sky, volumetric dust, dramatic depth, intricate fabric texture, mud and wear on clothing, ornate historical Chinese fantasy design, epic mythological atmosphere. Use a muted brown, amber, charcoal, and gold palette. High contrast, sharp foreground, atmospheric background.

Constraints: Include exactly 1 central character, exactly 1 oversized nine-toothed rake, exactly 1 backpack bundle, exactly 2 hanging gourds, exactly 7 side-story vignette caption areas, and 1 large gold calligraphy title. Do not add modern UI elements, English text, watermarks, logos, or extra characters in the foreground.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="猪八戒"} 创作一张电影级竖版奇幻角色档案海报，灵感源自《西游记》，将角色呈现为超写实 3D 全身立像，周围环绕充满神话色彩的叙事小图。

主体：中央为一个全身立像，一位体型魁梧的僧侣战士正沿着岩石小路向观众走来。他身材敦实，露出肚皮，身穿层叠破旧的黑褐色长袍、围巾、布腰带、宽松长裤、裹腿靴，背着一个巨大的行囊。他的面部被一个平滑的矩形模糊/遮罩刻意遮挡，而身体其余部分保持清晰写实。他肩上斜扛着 {argument name="weapon" default="九齿钉耙"}；金属耙头向上延伸，突破主画框，营造出强烈的 3D 出框效果。腰间挂着两个棕色葫芦和一些小型旅行用品。

背景与叙事元素：在中央人物周围包含 6 个电影级叙事小图，融入朦胧的景观中，如同发光的记忆画框。左侧有 2 个标注小图：左上角为取经队伍场景，标注「戒挑担」，配有较小的装饰性竖排中文；中左侧为村庄或婚嫁相关场景，标注「高老庄招亲」，配有较小的装饰性竖排中文。右侧有 4 个标注小图：右上角为天庭降临场景，标注「天蓬下凡」；中右侧为河中相遇场景，标注「流沙河收徒」；中下右侧为取经团队场景，标注「同行取经」；右下角为成就/觉悟场景，标注「终成正果」，每个小图均配有小型竖排中文注释。所有小图应展示山路或梯田上微小的僧侣身影，并与整体的深褐色-金色电影光影保持一致。

文字内容：在左下方添加一个醒目的金色粗体毛笔书法标题，内容为 {argument name="large title text" default="猪八戒"}。在标题旁添加一枚红色小印章。在左下角沿底部添加一行金色小字副标题，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="西行取经/信念之心"}。保留上述列出的 6 个中文小图标签，按垂直排列，仅允许添加额外的较小中文填充文字作为海报装饰排版。

约束：仅使用一个中心角色，仅使用一件主武器，精确包含 6 个带标签的叙事小图，一个大书法标题，以及一枚红印章。不要添加现代物品、Logo 或前景中的额外角色。保持面部模糊/遮罩作为构图的一部分。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Sha Seng Character Poster

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical 3D character profile poster for {argument name="character name" default="沙僧"}, inspired by an epic dark-fantasy Journey to the West return theme.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, high-resolution, dramatic movie-poster composition with a thin antique gold rectangular border and worn parchment-metal texture around the edges.

Main subject: One imposing warrior-monk stands full body in the center, wading through a shallow stormy river. He is tall, broad, rugged, and dressed in layered tattered dark green and gray monk robes, wrapped belts, hanging pouches, rope ties, weathered boots, and a huge strand of black prayer beads around his neck. His face is intentionally covered by a plain centered brown square censor block, while a small ornate golden headpiece remains visible above it. His stance is powerful, one foot forward splashing water.

Weapon and props: The character thrusts one large crescent-bladed demon-subduing staff toward the viewer, breaking the frame with extreme foreshortening from the left foreground. The blade is ornate bronze-gold with engraved patterns and sharp curved hooks. In his other hand he carries one small dark wooden traveling chest. Count the main visible props exactly: 1 oversized crescent staff, 1 wooden chest, 1 large prayer-bead necklace, multiple belt pouches as costume detail.

Background: A vast mythic river landscape under storm clouds, mist, splashing water, rocks, and glowing golden energy currents. Add exactly 5 narrative vignette scenes embedded in swirling circular mist portals around the character: 1 upper-left river struggle scene with a monk-like figure in turbulent water, 1 upper-right escort scene with a master riding a white horse and attendants, 1 mid-right pilgrimage scene with two travelers walking across a barren riverbank, 1 lower-left demon-slaying battle scene in rocks and waves, and 1 far-right distant mountain-road scene suggesting the westward journey. Make the vignettes semi-transparent, painterly, and integrated into the smoky sky and water.

Text content and placement: Use vertical Chinese calligraphy and small annotation text as decorative poster typography. Include exactly 6 prominent text groups: 1 large gold brush-calligraphy title at lower left reading {argument name="main title text" default="沙僧"}; 1 small subtitle below it reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="流沙河护法 / 沉稳之心"}; 1 upper-left vertical heading reading {argument name="upper left label" default="流沙河"} with small supporting text; 1 upper-right vertical heading reading "保护师父" with small supporting text; 1 middle-right vertical heading reading "挑担牵行" with small supporting text; 1 lower-right vertical heading reading "西行之路" with small supporting text. Also include a lower-left vertical heading "降妖伏魔" near the battle vignette, styled as part of the poster annotations. Keep all Chinese text legible enough to read but aged and integrated into the design.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed 3D cinematic realism, dark fantasy Chinese mythological epic, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, smoky volumetric atmosphere, gold sparks, wet fabric, rippling water, highly detailed metal engravings, weathered cloth texture, shallow depth of field on the foreground weapon, moody gray-blue and antique gold palette.

Constraints: Do not add extra characters beyond the background vignette figures. Keep the central warrior dominant, weapon breaking out toward the viewer, face covered by the brown square, and maintain the exact poster-like layout with ornate border, gold calligraphy, and 5 mist-vignette scenes.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张电影级暗黑奇幻风格的 3D 角色档案海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="沙僧"}，灵感源自《西游记》，呈现强有力的英雄姿态及收藏级人物卡片构图。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 比例，超精细写实 3D 渲染，戏剧性的明暗对比照明，风暴般的神话氛围，烟雾缭绕，浅水溅起，边缘带有风化的金色边框，色调采用炭灰、青铜、柔和青色与金色的陈旧羊皮纸与金属质感。

主体：一位全身武僧形象居中站立在没过脚踝的水中，面向前方，占据海报主体。他身着深绿灰色与棕色的破旧层叠僧袍，缠绕腰带，挂着小袋，穿着磨损的靴子和绳结，佩戴一串深色佛珠。头发凌乱卷曲，戴着小型装饰性头饰。面部被居中的不透明方形遮挡块隐藏，但身体和服饰保持高度细节。他将一根巨大的华丽月牙铲式降妖宝杖推向观众，武器在极近的前景视角中冲破画框；杖刃呈青铜金色，刻有纹路，锋利且具有强烈的透视缩短效果。另一只手提着一个小巧的深色木制行囊。

背景与插图元素：在角色身后环绕 4 个发光的神话故事小插图，每个插图都被薄雾和金色能量轨迹包围：1) 左上角，一个身着长袍的人物在湍急的河流中渡河或挣扎；2) 右上角，一位僧人与同伴骑行或牵着白马；3) 右侧中部，小小的取经人在荒凉的土地上行走；4) 左下角，在岩石与波浪间与妖魔战斗的场景。插图保持半透明和绘画感，如同围绕主角的记忆片段。

文字与图形布局：在左下角附近添加醒目的金色中文书法标题，内容为 {argument name="main title text" default="沙僧"}。在底部添加较小的金色副标题，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="流沙河护法 / 沉稳之心"}。添加 5 组精细的金色竖排中文侧标：左上角为「流沙河」及较小的描述文字；左下角为「降妖伏魔」及较小的描述文字；右上角为「保护师父」及较小的描述文字；右侧中部为「挑担牵行」及较小的描述文字；右下角为「西行之路」及较小的描述文字。在左下角书法附近包含两枚红色印章。

风格：高端游戏角色主视觉图，电影海报，超写实 3D 雕塑质感，体积雾，轮廓光，湿润的织物，水花，金色魔法火花，精细的武器雕刻，史诗感，硬核写实，角色与武器焦点清晰，背景插图略微柔化。

约束：仅使用一个中心角色，仅使用一根前景法杖，仅使用一个行囊，仅使用一串大型佛珠，背景插图严格为 4 个，侧标组严格为 5 组，红色印章严格为 2 枚。海报中不得添加现代物品、Logo、水印、前景中的额外角色或任何英文字符。

templates.title: GPT Image 2 Kunoichi Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: GPT Image 2 与 Kunoichi 对比图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a side-by-side comparison graphic showing an anime kunoichi illustration improved with GPT Image 2, emphasizing increased detail and cinematic rendering.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 white background, clean comparison layout. Place two tall vertical anime illustration panels side by side: one on the left and one on the right, separated by a central white column.

Layout: Use exactly 5 main visible elements: 1 left illustration panel, 1 right illustration panel, 1 large gray right-pointing arrow in the center, 1 bold black text label above the arrow reading “GPT Image2”, and 1 bold black Japanese caption below the arrow reading “描き込み量を\n極限まで上げて”. The left panel occupies the left third of the canvas, the right panel occupies the right third, and the center column contains the text and arrow.

Subject details: In both panels, depict the same dynamic high-quality anime-style female ninja, {argument name="character name" default="Ai-chan"}, leaping through the air in a dramatic action pose. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair tied high, a face obscured by a square tan blur censor block, black fingerless gloves, and a purple floral kimono-style kunoichi outfit with pink cherry blossom patterns, short skirt, thigh straps, belt pouches, and soft ninja boots. She wields exactly 3 visible weapons: 2 short swords crossed above her head in both hands and 1 curved sword drawn diagonally across her body at waist level. Her pose has one knee raised high and the other leg bent back, with strong motion and wind-swept hair.

Left panel: A detailed but slightly softer anime illustration of the kunoichi in front of a Japanese temple complex at sunset. Include stone stairs, a red pagoda, curved temple roof eaves, stone guardian lion statues, distant misty mountains, pink sky, cherry blossom branches, falling petals, and a faint spiral of pink magical energy around the character.

Right panel: A more polished, sharper, higher-detail, more cinematic version of the same scene, with richer contrast, denser cherry blossoms, more ornate roof carvings, stronger lighting, more saturated sunset colors, more petals, clearer stone textures, brighter pink energy swirl, and extra environmental detail. Keep the same character pose and outfit but make the rendering noticeably more refined than the left panel.

Visual style: Ultra high-quality cinematic anime art, extremely fine linework, soft shading, high detail, dramatic rim lighting, glossy highlights on blades, sakura-pink atmosphere, fantasy action composition, intricate Japanese architecture, dynamic motion blur only on petals and hair, sharp character focus.

Text content: Center text must include exactly 2 text blocks: “GPT Image2” above the arrow, and the Japanese two-line caption “描き込み量を” on the first line and “極限まで上げて” on the second line below the arrow.

Constraints: Preserve the white center gap and white outer margins. Do not add logos, watermarks, social-media UI, extra captions, or additional panels. Keep the face intentionally obscured by the square blur in both panels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张并排对比图，展示经由 GPT Image 2 优化后的动漫女忍者插画，重点突出细节的提升与电影级的渲染效果。

画布：16:9 宽幅白色背景，简洁的对比布局。并排放置两个高大的垂直动漫插画面板：左侧一个，右侧一个，中间由白色列隔开。

布局：使用 5 个主要可见元素：1 个左侧插画面板，1 个右侧插画面板，1 个位于中心指向右侧的大型灰色箭头，1 个位于箭头上方、加粗黑色的“GPT Image2”文本标签，以及 1 个位于箭头下方、加粗黑色的日语标题“描き込み量を\n極限まで上げて”。左侧面板占据画布左侧三分之一，右侧面板占据右侧三分之一，中间列包含文本和箭头。

主体细节：在两个面板中，描绘同一位高质量动态动漫风格的女忍者，{argument name="character name" default="Ai-chan"}，以戏剧性的动作姿态在空中跳跃。她留着飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 高马尾，面部被方形棕色模糊遮挡，戴着黑色露指手套，身穿紫色花卉和服风格的女忍者装束，配有粉色樱花图案、短裙、大腿绑带、腰包和柔软的忍者靴。她手持 3 件清晰可见的武器：双手在头顶交叉握着 2 把短剑，腰间斜挎着 1 把弯刀。她的姿势是一条腿高高抬起，另一条腿向后弯曲，展现出强烈的动感和被风吹拂的头发。

左侧面板：一幅细节丰富但略显柔和的动漫插画，背景为日落时分的日本寺庙建筑群。包含石阶、红塔、弯曲的寺庙屋檐、石狮子雕像、远处的朦胧山脉、粉色天空、樱花树枝、飘落的花瓣，以及角色周围淡淡的粉色魔法能量螺旋。

右侧面板：同一场景更精致、更锐利、细节更高、更具电影感的版本，具有更丰富的对比度、更密集的樱花、更华丽的屋顶雕刻、更强烈的灯光、更饱和的日落色彩、更多的花瓣、更清晰的石材纹理、更明亮的粉色能量旋涡以及额外的环境细节。保持与左侧面板相同的角色姿势和服装，但渲染效果要明显更精致。

视觉风格：超高质量电影级动漫艺术，极细致的线条，柔和的阴影，高细节，戏剧性的边缘光，刀刃上的光泽高光，樱花粉色的氛围，奇幻动作构图，复杂的日本建筑，仅在花瓣和头发上有动态运动模糊，角色焦点清晰。

文本内容：中心文本必须包含 2 个文本块：箭头上方为“GPT Image2”，箭头下方为两行日语标题，第一行为“描き込み量を”，第二行为“極限まで上げて”。

约束：保留中间的白色空隙和外部白色边距。不要添加任何标志、水印、社交媒体 UI、额外的说明文字或额外的面板。两个面板中的面部均需保持被方形模糊遮挡的状态。

templates.title: Cherry Blossom School Gate Manga Page

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花校园校门漫画页面

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a black-and-white manga page about two schoolgirls arriving at a school gate under cherry blossoms, with one character partly highlighted in pale cyan and the other character’s face obscured by gray blur blocks.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, high-resolution monochrome screentone style with thick black panel borders, clean line art, speed lines, petals, and dramatic perspective. Use grayscale shading with only one accent color: faint cyan glow on the glasses-haired girl.

Layout: Use exactly 5 visible manga panels. Panel 1 is a large top-left scene showing a twin-tailed schoolgirl in a sailor uniform standing on a cherry blossom path with the school gate far behind her; her face is covered by a soft-edged gray rectangular blur. Panel 2 is a narrow inset at the top right showing a cropped long-haired girl in sailor uniform holding a school bag in front of her body. Panel 3 is another top-right inset beside it showing the same long-haired girl wearing a beret and glowing cyan glasses, touching the bridge of her glasses with a confident gesture. Panel 4 is a wide middle panel showing the twin-tailed girl close up, raising one hand in greeting; her face is again covered by a larger gray rectangular blur. Panel 5 is a large bottom panel showing a dramatic tilted view of an ornate school gate opening in bright light, with the long-haired girl running or turning toward the viewer and the cyan-glasses girl standing farther back on the right.

Characters: The twin-tailed girl has messy medium-length twin ponytails tied with ribbons, a sailor school uniform with bow, pleated skirt, and shy energetic body language. The long-haired girl has very long flowing hair, sailor uniform, pleated skirt, school bag in one inset, and a composed expression in the bottom panel. The second version of the long-haired girl wears a round beret, glasses glowing pale cyan, sailor uniform, dark skirt, knee socks, and has a mysterious tech-like aura.

Text content: Include exactly 3 Japanese speech/sound text elements: a speech bubble in panel 1 reading {argument name="first speech bubble" default="あ見えたー校門"}, a speech bubble in panel 4 reading {argument name="second speech bubble" default="沙羅さーん、葵ちゃん！"}, and large stylized gate-opening sound effects in panel 5 reading {argument name="sound effect text" default="ザァァァ"}. Add small handwritten manga sound effects near the girls if needed, but keep them minimal and visually secondary.

Setting and style: A spring school entrance lined with dense cherry blossom trees, falling petals, stone path, ornate iron gate, bright backlight from the gate, detailed manga hatching, screentones, speed lines, and cinematic perspective. The overall style should resemble a polished Japanese shoujo manga page, with expressive poses, delicate hair rendering, dramatic lighting, and clean page composition.

Constraints: Keep the page monochrome except for the cyan glow on the glasses character. Keep the blurred gray face blocks visible on the twin-tailed girl in panels 1 and 4. Do not add extra panels, extra main characters, watermarks, logos, or English text. Use {argument name="school uniform style" default="Japanese sailor uniforms with bow ties and pleated skirts"} and a {argument name="season" default="spring cherry blossom season"} atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页黑白漫画，讲述两名女学生在樱花树下到达校门的故事，其中一名角色部分呈现淡青色高光，另一名角色的面部被灰色模糊块遮挡。

画布：竖版漫画页面，比例约为 2:3，高分辨率黑白网点风格，带有粗黑边框、干净的线条、速度线、花瓣和戏剧性的透视效果。使用灰度阴影，仅保留一种强调色：戴眼镜女孩身上淡淡的青色光芒。

布局：使用精确的 5 个可见漫画分镜。分镜 1 是左上角的大场景，展示了一名扎着双马尾、身穿水手服的女学生站在樱花小径上，校门在远处；她的脸被一个边缘柔和的灰色矩形模糊块遮住。分镜 2 是右上角的一个狭窄插图，展示了一名留着长发、身穿水手服的女孩，怀里抱着书包。分镜 3 是旁边另一个右上角的插图，展示了同一名长发女孩戴着贝雷帽和发光的青色眼镜，自信地推了推眼镜。分镜 4 是中间的宽幅分镜，展示了双马尾女孩的特写，她举起一只手打招呼；她的脸再次被一个更大的灰色矩形模糊块遮住。分镜 5 是底部的大分镜，展示了华丽校门在强光下开启的戏剧性倾斜视角，长发女孩正跑向或转向观众，而戴青色眼镜的女孩站在右后方。

角色：双马尾女孩留着凌乱的中长双马尾，系着丝带，身穿带蝴蝶结的水手校服和百褶裙，肢体语言害羞而充满活力。长发女孩留着飘逸的长发，身穿水手服和百褶裙，在插图中抱着书包，在底部画面中表情沉稳。长发女孩的第二个版本戴着圆贝雷帽，眼镜发出淡青色光芒，身穿水手服、深色裙子和过膝袜，散发出神秘的科技感光环。

文字内容：包含 3 个日语对话/音效元素：分镜 1 中的对话气泡内容为 {argument name="first speech bubble" default="あ見えたー校門"}，分镜 4 中的对话气泡内容为 {argument name="second speech bubble" default="沙羅さーん、葵ちゃん！"}，分镜 5 中巨大的风格化开门音效为 {argument name="sound effect text" default="ザァァァ"}。如有需要，可在女孩周围添加少量手写漫画音效，但保持简洁，且在视觉上作为次要元素。

场景与风格：春季校园入口，两旁种满茂密的樱花树，花瓣飘落，石板路，华丽的铁艺大门，来自大门的明亮逆光，细致的漫画排线、网点、速度线和电影般的透视感。整体风格应类似于精致的日本少女漫画页面，具有富有表现力的姿势、细腻的头发渲染、戏剧性的光影和干净的页面构图。

约束条件：除眼镜角色的青色光芒外，页面保持黑白。在分镜 1 和分镜 4 中，双马尾女孩面部的灰色模糊块必须可见。不要添加额外的分镜、额外的主角、水印、Logo 或英文字符。使用 {argument name="school uniform style" default="Japanese sailor uniforms with bow ties and pleated skirts"} 和 {argument name="season" default="spring cherry blossom season"} 的氛围。

templates.title: Vintage Creepy Children's Book Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 复古诡异童书风格转换

templates.prompt:
Using the provided reference photo as the scene base, transform it into a strange vintage children's picture-book illustration on aged yellow paper. Keep the same overall composition, building, clock tower, tent, lawn, statue position, string lights, tree, and dramatic cloud placement, but redraw everything as delicate ink line art with muted watercolor washes, paper grain, stains, scratches, and a slightly creepy whimsical storybook mood.

Style: old absurdist children's book illustration, hand-drawn pen hatching, muted olive/sepia/gray palette, worn book-page texture, imperfect perspective, whimsical grotesque faces added to ordinary objects.

Additions and changes:
- Add a hand-lettered poem in the upper-left, exactly 8 lines in two 4-line stanzas:
  “The clock has one moustache,
  and wears a green boiled egg.
  It watches the clouds
  who forget their legs.

  The tent has no secrets
  but keeps them anyway.
  The statue lost his head
  and went to buy a tea.”
- Turn the clock face on the tower into a surprised character with eyes, mouth, and one moustache; make the dome look like a green boiled egg.
- Add exactly 5 anthropomorphic clouds with worried faces and tiny dangling legs, placed around the tower and sky.
- Turn exactly 3 hanging bulbs on the string light into little worried faces.
- Make the statue headless and give it a teacup and small kettle/lantern, with a small plaque reading “HE WENT FOR TEA.”
- Add exactly 2 vertical poster banners on the building facade with silly monster faces and short readable words, one saying “EAT ART” and one saying “WHY?”
- Add exactly 2 strange figures inside or behind the tent plastic, one tall person-like figure holding tea and one shaggy creature near the right side.
- Add exactly 1 bird-like creature on the grass in the foreground with a speech bubble saying “TEA!”, plus exactly 1 small worm nearby.
- Add exactly 2 rusty cylindrical bins in the lower-right foreground, each with a face.

Constraints: preserve the architecture and layout from the reference, but make it look fully illustrated rather than photographic. No modern photorealism, no clean digital vector look, no extra poem text beyond the specified lines.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考照片作为场景基础，将其转换为一张印在泛黄旧纸上的复古奇幻童书插画。保持原有的整体构图、建筑、钟楼、帐篷、草坪、雕像位置、串灯、树木以及戏剧性的云层布局，但将所有元素重绘为精致的墨水线条画，辅以柔和的水彩渲染、纸张纹理、污渍、划痕，营造出一种略带诡异的奇幻故事书氛围。

风格：复古荒诞童书插画、手绘钢笔排线、柔和的橄榄色/深褐色/灰色调、磨损的书页质感、不完美的透视，并在普通物体上添加奇幻的怪诞表情。

添加与修改内容：
- 在左上角添加一首手写诗，共 8 行，分为两个 4 行的诗节：
  “时钟长着一撇胡子，
  戴着一颗煮熟的绿蛋。
  它注视着云朵，
  云朵却忘了它们的腿。

  帐篷没有秘密，
  却依然守口如瓶。
  雕像丢了头颅，
  去买一杯茶。”
- 将钟楼上的钟面变成一个带有眼睛、嘴巴和一撇胡子的惊讶表情；将圆顶处理成一颗煮熟的绿蛋。
- 在钟楼和天空周围添加 5 朵带有忧虑表情且垂着小腿的拟人化云朵。
- 将串灯上的 3 个灯泡变成带有忧虑表情的小脸。
- 将雕像处理为无头状态，给它配上一个茶杯和一个小水壶/灯笼，并加上一块写着“HE WENT FOR TEA.”（他去喝茶了）的小牌子。
- 在建筑立面上添加 2 条垂直海报横幅，上面画着滑稽的怪物脸和简短易读的文字，一条写着“EAT ART”（吃掉艺术），另一条写着“WHY?”（为什么？）。
- 在帐篷塑料布内或后方添加 2 个奇怪的人影，一个是拿着茶的高个子人影，另一个是右侧附近的毛茸茸生物。
- 在前景的草地上添加 1 个鸟类生物，配上写着“TEA!”（茶！）的对话气泡，并在附近添加 1 条小虫子。
- 在右下角前景处添加 2 个生锈的圆柱形垃圾桶，每个桶上都有表情。

约束：保留参考图中的建筑和布局，但使其呈现出完全的插画感而非摄影感。禁止使用现代写实风格、禁止使用干净的数字矢量外观，除指定的诗歌外，不得添加任何额外的诗歌文本。

templates.title: Gundam Series Timeline Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 高达系列时间轴信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean Japanese infographic slide summarizing {argument name="headline text" default="ガンダム・シリーズ　作中の世界・時代の関係性"}, with the small subtitle 「―主要シリーズの時系列と世界のつながり―」, showing how Gundam series relate by fictional world and era.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal presentation slide, white background, navy blue title typography, thin gray borders, pale pastel category bands, compact Japanese sans-serif text. Use a crisp corporate PowerPoint-style layout with a large boxed timeline on top, two boxed rows beneath it, and notes/legend at the bottom.

Top title area: Large dark navy Japanese title at top left. At top right, include a rounded note box saying the series are broadly divided into 「宇宙世紀（UC）」 and other 「アナザー（AU）」 worlds.

Main section: A large bordered panel titled {argument name="main section title" default="宇宙世紀（Universal Century／UC）シリーズ"} with a note 「※地球を起源とする人類の歴史（1年＝宇宙世紀元年＝宇宙移民開始年）」. Inside, create a horizontal timeline with exactly 9 era columns, each with a colored header and vertical guide lines: 1) 「UC 0001 宇宙移民開始」, 2) 「UC 0079」, 3) 「UC 0087」, 4) 「UC 0093」, 5) 「UC 0123」, 6) 「UC 0153」, 7) 「UC 100」, 8) 「UC 110」, 9) 「（年代不詳）」. Add an era-label row with exactly 8 colored labels: 「黎明期」, 「一年戦争期」, 「グリプス戦役期」, 「第一次ネオ・ジオン抗争」, 「第二次ネオ・ジオン抗争」, 「ラプラスの箱の時代」, 「宇宙世紀のその後」, 「その他の時代・作品」.

Universal Century content cards: Place exactly 14 rounded rectangular series cards in the top timeline panel, using pale green, yellow, orange, purple, blue, and gray fills. Cards must read: 1) 「機動戦士ガンダム (1979) / UC 0079 / 地球連邦軍とジオン公国の戦争」, 2) 「THE ORIGIN (2015-18) / UC 0068-0079 / 一年戦争前夜の物語」, 3) 「機動戦士Zガンダム (1985) / UC 0087 / エゥーゴとティターンズの戦い（グリプス戦役）」, 4) 「機動戦士ガンダムZZ (1986-87) / UC 0088 / ZZの直後、ネオ・ジオンの台頭」, 5) 「機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア (1988) / UC 0093 / シャアの反乱とラプラスの箱」, 6) 「機動戦士ガンダムUC（ユニコーン） (2010-14) / UC 0096-0097 / ラプラスの箱の継承を巡る戦い」, 7) 「機動戦士ガンダムNT（ナラティブ） (2018) / UC 0097 / UCの後継へ」, 8) 「機動戦士ガンダムF91 (1991) / UC 0123 / 新時代の幕開け」, 9) 「機動戦士Vガンダム (1993) / UC 0153 / ザンスカール帝国との戦争」, 10) 「機動戦士ガンダム 閃光のハサウェイ (2021) / UC 0105 / 地球連邦の腐敗と新たな抗争の火種」, 11) 「機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島 (2022) / UC 0083 / 一年戦争中の一編」, 12) 「機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN（左記に記載）」, 13) 「機動戦士ガンダム サンダーボルト (2012-17) / UC 0079-0080 / 一年戦争中の並行世界」, 14) 「機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY (1991-92) / UC 0083 / デラーズ・フリートの襲撃」. Use solid black arrows for chronological flow and dashed arrows for parallel or related works, including arrows connecting THE ORIGIN, the original Gundam, Z, ZZ, Char's Counterattack, Unicorn, Narrative, F91, and V Gundam. Add a small arrow legend below the main panel showing solid arrow 「時系列の流れ」 and dashed arrow 「並行・関連作品」 plus a note that years are approximate.

Middle left section: A bordered panel titled {argument name="alternate universe section title" default="アナザー（AU：Alternate Universe）シリーズ"} with a note that these are histories/worlds different from UC. Include exactly 6 pastel cards in one row: 1) 「機動戦士ガンダムSEED (2002-03) / C.E.（コズミック・イラ）/ 遺伝子調整者を巡る人類の対立」, 2) 「機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY (2004-05) / C.E.71-73 / SEEDの続編」, 3) 「機動戦士ガンダム00（ダブルオー） (2007-09) / 西暦2307年 / 化石燃料枯渇後の人類の争い」, 4) 「機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ (2015-17) / 西暦（Post Disaster）/ 火星移民後の厳しい社会」, 5) 「機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女 (2022-23) / A.S.（アド・ステラ）122年 / 企業群による支配とモビルスーツ開発競争」, 6) 「新機動戦記ガンダムW (1995-96) / A.C.（アフター・コロニー）/ 宇宙コロニーの独立運動と戦争」. Add a note below that each work has an independent world and era and does not directly connect to UC.

Middle right section: A bordered panel titled 「その他の作品・世界観」 with exactly 2 cards: 1) 「Gのレコンギスタ (2014-15) / R.C.（リギルド・センチュリー）/ 複数の時代が交錯する多層的な世界」, 2) 「∀ガンダム（ターンエー） (1999-2000) / 西暦2345年 / すべてのガンダムの未来の物語」. Add a small note that these are independent from UC.

Bottom area: Include exactly 3 boxes. Left box titled 「まとめ」 with two bullet paragraphs explaining that UC depicts history after humanity expands into space and is the origin world of the series, while AU has different histories/settings and develops independent eras/stories. Center box titled 「凡例」 with exactly 5 color swatches labeled 「一年戦争期」, 「グリプス戦役期」, 「第一次ネオ・ジオン抗争」, 「第二次ネオ・ジオン抗争」, 「ラプラスの箱の時代」. Right box lists abbreviations exactly: 「UC：Universal Century（宇宙世紀）」「C.E.：Cosmic Era（コズミック・イラ）」「A.C.：After Colony（アフター・コロニー）」「A.S.：Ad Stella（アド・ステラ）」「R.C.：Regild Century（リギルド・センチュリー）」 and a small note that names and era notation may differ by work.

Style constraints: Keep all text legible but dense, like a Japanese educational slide; use thin borders, subtle pastel fills, straight connectors, and no character art, no mobile suits, no photos, no watermark. Maintain the exact section/card counts: 9 timeline era markers, 8 era labels, 14 UC cards, 6 AU cards, 2 other-world cards, 3 bottom boxes.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张简洁的日文信息图 Slides，总结 {argument name="headline text" default="高达系列 作中世界与时代的关系"}，并附带副标题「―主要系列的各种时间轴与世界观关联―」，展示高达系列在虚构世界和时代上的联系。

画布：16:9 横向演示 Slides，白色背景，海军蓝标题字体，细灰色边框，淡色系分类色带，紧凑的日文无衬线字体。采用清晰的商务 PowerPoint 风格布局，顶部设有大型框选时间轴，下方设有两个框选行，底部为注释/图例。

顶部标题区：左上角为大型深海军蓝日文标题。右上角包含一个圆角注释框，说明系列大致分为「宇宙世纪（UC）」和其他「异世界（AU）」世界。

主要部分：一个带边框的大型面板，标题为 {argument name="main section title" default="宇宙世纪（Universal Century／UC）系列"}，附注「※以地球为起源的人类历史（1 年＝宇宙世纪元年＝宇宙移民开始年）」。在内部，创建一个水平时间轴，包含 9 个精确的时代列，每一列都有彩色标题和垂直引导线：1) 「UC 0001 宇宙移民开始」，2) 「UC 0079」，3) 「UC 0087」，4) 「UC 0093」，5) 「UC 0123」，6) 「UC 0153」，7) 「UC 100」，8) 「UC 110」，9) 「（年代不详）」。添加一行时代标签，包含 8 个精确的彩色标签：「黎明期」、「一年战争期」、「格里普斯战役期」、「第一次新吉翁抗争」、「第二次新吉翁抗争」、「拉普拉斯之盒时代」、「宇宙世纪之后」、「其他时代与作品」。

宇宙世纪内容卡片：在顶部时间轴面板中放置 14 张圆角矩形系列卡片，使用淡绿色、黄色、橙色、紫色、蓝色和灰色填充。卡片内容必须为：1) 「机动战士高达 (1979) / UC 0079 / 地球联邦军与吉翁公国的战争」，2) 「THE ORIGIN (2015-18) / UC 0068-0079 / 一年战争前夜的故事」，3) 「机动战士 Z 高达 (1985) / UC 0087 / 奥古与提坦斯的战斗（格里普斯战役）」，4) 「机动战士高达 ZZ (1986-87) / UC 0088 / ZZ 之后，新吉翁的崛起」，5) 「机动战士高达 逆袭的夏亚 (1988) / UC 0093 / 夏亚的反乱与拉普拉斯之盒」，6) 「机动战士高达 UC（独角兽） (2010-14) / UC 0096-0097 / 围绕拉普拉斯之盒继承权的战斗」，7) 「机动战士高达 NT（叙事） (2018) / UC 0097 / 迈向 UC 的后续」，8) 「机动战士高达 F91 (1991) / UC 0123 / 新时代的开端」，9) 「机动战士 V 高达 (1993) / UC 0153 / 与赞斯卡尔帝国的战争」，10) 「机动战士高达 闪光的哈萨维 (2021) / UC 0105 / 地球联邦的腐败与新抗争的火种」，11) 「机动战士高达 库库鲁斯·多安的岛 (2022) / UC 0083 / 一年战争中的一段插曲」，12) 「机动战士高达 THE ORIGIN（见左侧记载）」，13) 「机动战士高达 雷霆宙域 (2012-17) / UC 0079-0080 / 一年战争中的平行世界」，14) 「机动战士高达 0083 STARDUST MEMORY (1991-92) / UC 0083 / 迪拉兹舰队的袭击」。使用实心黑色箭头表示时间顺序，虚线箭头表示平行或相关作品，包括连接 THE ORIGIN、初代高达、Z、ZZ、逆袭的夏亚、独角兽、NT、F91 和 V 高达的箭头。在主面板下方添加一个小箭头图例，显示实心箭头「时间轴流向」和虚线箭头「平行/相关作品」，并注明年份为近似值。

中左部分：一个带边框的面板，标题为 {argument name="alternate universe section title" default="异世界（AU：Alternate Universe）系列"}，并注明这些历史/世界与 UC 不同。在一行中包含 6 张淡色卡片：1) 「机动战士高达 SEED (2002-03) / C.E.（宇宙纪元）/ 围绕基因调整者的人类对立」，2) 「机动战士高达 SEED DESTINY (2004-05) / C.E.71-73 / SEED 的续作」，3) 「机动战士高达 00 (2007-09) / 西历 2307 年 / 化石燃料枯竭后的人类纷争」，4) 「机动战士高达 铁血的奥尔芬斯 (2015-17) / 西历（Post Disaster）/ 火星移民后的严酷社会」，5) 「机动战士高达 水星的魔女 (2022-23) / A.S.（阿斯提卡西亚）122 年 / 企业群统治与机动战士开发竞争」，6) 「新机动战记高达 W (1995-96) / A.C.（殖民后）/ 宇宙殖民地的独立运动与战争」。在下方添加注释，说明每部作品都有独立的世界和时代，不直接与 UC 连接。

中右部分：一个带边框的面板，标题为「其他作品/世界观」，包含 2 张卡片：1) 「G 之复国运动 (2014-15) / R.C.（复兴世纪）/ 多个时代交错的多层世界」，2) 「∀高达（倒 A）(1999-2000) / 西历 2345 年 / 所有高达未来的故事」。添加小注释说明这些作品独立于 UC。

底部区域：包含 3 个框。左侧框标题为「总结」，包含两个要点段落，解释 UC 描绘了人类向太空扩张后的历史，是该系列的起源世界，而 AU 拥有不同的历史/设定，发展出独立的时代/故事。中间框标题为「图例」，包含 5 个色块，分别标注「一年战争期」、「格里普斯战役期」、「第一次新吉翁抗争」、「第二次新吉翁抗争」、「拉普拉斯之盒时代」。右侧框列出缩写，必须完全一致： 「UC：Universal Century（宇宙世纪）」「C.E.：Cosmic Era（宇宙纪元）」「A.C.：After Colony（殖民后）」「A.S.：Ad Stella（阿斯提卡西亚）」「R.C.：Regild Century（复兴世纪）」，并附带小注释，说明名称和时代标注可能因作品而异。

样式约束：保持所有文字清晰但紧凑，如同日文教学 Slides；使用细边框、微妙的淡色填充、直线连接器，无角色插图、无机动战士、无照片、无水印。保持精确的章节/卡片数量：9 个时间轴时代标记，8 个时代标签，14 张 UC 卡片，6 张 AU 卡片，2 张其他世界卡片，3 个底部框。
