templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the scene into a {argument name="art style" default="minimalist stylized flat vector illustration"} while preserving the original river-cormorant-fishing composition, subject placement, bamboo rafts, mountain river setting, and overall atmosphere. Simplify the photo into bold geometric shapes, clean silhouettes, limited detail, and layered poster-like forms with no photorealistic texture. Use a muted teal, deep blue, olive green, and warm cream palette, with angular stylized clouds and mountains, calm reflective water, and simplified rocky foreground. Keep exactly 3 fishermen on 3 bamboo rafts, exactly 4 black cormorants, and exactly 2 lanterns. Maintain the fishermen’s conical hats and dark traditional clothing, but render all people as simplified graphic figures with obscured/featureless faces. Make the result vertical in a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} poster composition, crisp-edged, atmospheric, and suitable as a minimalist travel illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其场景转换为 {argument name="art style" default="极简风格扁平矢量插画"}，同时保留原始的鸬鹚捕鱼构图、主体位置、竹筏、山水背景以及整体氛围。将照片简化为大胆的几何形状、干净的轮廓、极少的细节以及层叠的海报式形态，且不含照片级真实纹理。使用柔和的青色、深蓝色、橄榄绿和暖奶油色调，搭配棱角分明的风格化云朵和山脉、平静的倒影水面以及简化的岩石前景。保持画面中正好有 3 名渔夫在 3 只竹筏上、正好 4 只黑鸬鹚以及正好 2 盏灯笼。保留渔夫的斗笠和深色传统服饰，但将所有人物渲染为简化的图形化形象，且面部模糊/无特征。将最终结果制作成 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} 的垂直海报构图，要求边缘清晰、富有氛围感，适合作为极简主义旅行插画。

templates.title: Pombero Folklore Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Pombero 民间传说角色设定集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark fantasy creature-design character sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Pombero"}, alias {argument name="alias" default="Shadow of the Monte"}, presented as a professional concept-art turnaround on a clean off-white background.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 presentation sheet, museum-white paper texture, realistic high-detail digital painting with muted earthy colors, fine ink-like labels, thin divider lines, and a polished production-design layout.

Main subject: A short, muscular nocturnal forest spirit inspired by Paraguayan rural folklore. He has rough scarred bark-like skin, dirty bare feet, long clawed fingers, a hunched primal posture, and a faceless or obscured shadowed head under a ragged straw hat. His outfit is made from layered dry leaves, bark strips, vines, feathers, shredded fabric, rope ties, a shoulder mantle, ragged skirt-like wrappings, ankle bindings, and a round tobacco pouch at the waist. The mood is silent, elusive, territorial, cunning, and feral rather than heroic.

Layout: Place one large full-body hero figure on the left, occupying about one third of the canvas, standing barefoot with one arm extended and the other hanging, covered in ragged leaf-and-bark camouflage. At the top left, add the large title “{argument name="title text" default="POMBERO"}” and beneath it the subtitle “Alias: Shadow of the Monte”. Across the upper middle show exactly 4 labeled turnaround poses: “NEUTRAL FRONT VIEW”, “BACK VIEW”, “SIDE PROFILE”, and “SECONDARY ATTITUDE”. The secondary attitude pose should show him kneeling with one knee raised, holding a smoking hand-rolled tobacco roll.

Facial / expression studies: Under the turnaround row, include exactly 6 square portrait-study panels labeled, left to right: “SLY MENACE”, “EERIE CALM”, “PREDATORY FOCUS”, “CUNNING AMUSEMENT”, “WATCHFUL SILENCE”, and “WRATH”. Each portrait is mostly hidden in shadow beneath the hat, emphasizing a silent gaze rather than readable human features.

Details row: Along the lower center, include exactly 6 close-up detail panels labeled, left to right: “HAND & TOBACCO ROLL”, “TOBACCO POUCH”, “SHOULDER WRAP DETAIL”, “WAIST DETAILS”, “FOOT & ANKLE”, and “SKIN & SCAR DETAIL”. Show gnarled fingers gripping tobacco, a round leather pouch, tangled leaf wrappings, rope knots, cracked dirty feet, and scarred bark-like skin texture.

Right-side notes and props: On the right, add an “IDENTITY NOTES” text block with the following readable content: Role: Nocturnal forest spirit. Traits: silent, cunning, territorial, primal, elusive, feared. Core theme: Paraguayan rural folklore, night, superstition, nature, fear, respect. Signature feature: silent feet and piercing gaze. Below the attitude pose, add exactly 1 key prop section titled “KEY PROP – RITUAL TOBACCO”, showing a large hand-rolled tobacco bundle tied with fiber beside dry leaves, with a caption explaining that hand-rolled tobacco is his offering, companion, and mark of his presence.

Bottom-right studies: Include exactly 4 black silhouette thumbnails titled “SILHOUETTE STUDY”, showing different readable poses of the same ragged, hat-wearing creature. Include exactly 7 vertical color swatches titled “COLOR PALETTE”, labeled left to right: “BARK GRAY”, “MONTE GREEN”, “TOBACCO BROWN”, “EARTH UMBER”, “DRY LEAF BEIGE”, “NIGHT CHARCOAL”, and “BLACK”.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed cinematic creature concept art, earthy brown-gray-green palette, photorealistic anatomy mixed with folklore monster design, weathered textures, subtle shadows under each figure, crisp labels, thin black rules, organized like a studio character design board. Avoid bright colors, cute proportions, modern clothing, weapons, logos, watermarks, or extra panels beyond the specified counts.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Pombero"}（别名：{argument name="alias" default="Shadow of the Monte"}）创作一张暗黑奇幻风格的生物设计角色设定集，以专业的概念设计三视图形式呈现，背景为干净的灰白色。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向展示页，博物馆级白色纸张纹理，写实的高细节数字绘画，采用柔和的大地色系，搭配精致的墨水风格标签、细分割线以及考究的制作设计排版。

主体：一个身材矮小、肌肉发达的夜行森林精灵，灵感源自巴拉圭乡村民间传说。他拥有粗糙如树皮般的伤痕皮肤、肮脏的赤脚、长而尖锐的手指、佝偻的原始姿态，以及隐藏在破旧草帽下模糊或被阴影遮蔽的头部。他的服装由层叠的枯叶、树皮条、藤蔓、羽毛、碎布、绳结、肩披、破烂的裙状裹布、脚踝绑带以及腰间的圆形烟草袋组成。氛围宁静、难以捉摸、具有领地意识、狡黠且野性，而非英雄主义。

排版：左侧放置一个大型全身英雄形象，占据约三分之一的画布，赤脚站立，一只手臂伸展，另一只手臂下垂，身上覆盖着破烂的叶片和树皮伪装。左上角添加大标题“{argument name="title text" default="POMBERO"}”，下方添加副标题“Alias: Shadow of the Monte”。上方中部展示 4 个带标签的三视图姿态：“NEUTRAL FRONT VIEW”（中性正面）、“BACK VIEW”（背面）、“SIDE PROFILE”（侧面轮廓）和“SECONDARY ATTITUDE”（次要姿态）。次要姿态应展示他单膝跪地，手持一支手卷烟草。

面部/表情研究：在三视图行下方，包含 6 个方形肖像研究面板，从左至右依次标注：“SLY MENACE”（狡黠威胁）、“EERIE CALM”（诡异平静）、“PREDATORY FOCUS”（捕食专注）、“CUNNING AMUSEMENT”（狡诈戏谑）、“WATCHFUL SILENCE”（警觉沉默）和“WRATH”（愤怒）。每张肖像大多隐藏在草帽的阴影中，强调沉默的凝视而非清晰的人类特征。

细节行：在下方中部，包含 6 个特写细节面板，从左至右依次标注：“HAND & TOBACCO ROLL”（手部与烟卷）、“TOBACCO POUCH”（烟草袋）、“SHOULDER WRAP DETAIL”（肩部裹布细节）、“WAIST DETAILS”（腰部细节）、“FOOT & ANKLE”（足部与脚踝）和“SKIN & SCAR DETAIL”（皮肤与伤痕细节）。展示抓握烟草的粗糙手指、圆形皮袋、缠绕的叶片裹布、绳结、开裂肮脏的双脚以及如树皮般伤痕累累的皮肤纹理。

右侧备注与道具：在右侧，添加一个“IDENTITY NOTES”（身份备注）文本块，包含以下可读内容：角色：夜行森林精灵。特征：沉默、狡黠、领地意识强、原始、难以捉摸、令人畏惧。核心主题：巴拉圭乡村民间传说、夜晚、迷信、自然、恐惧、敬畏。标志性特征：无声的脚步和刺穿灵魂的凝视。在次要姿态下方，添加 1 个名为“KEY PROP – RITUAL TOBACCO”（关键道具 – 仪式烟草）的部分，展示一捆用纤维捆绑的大型手卷烟草，旁边配有枯叶，并附有说明，解释手卷烟草是他的供品、伴侣以及他存在的标志。

右下角研究：包含 4 个黑色剪影缩略图，标题为“SILHOUETTE STUDY”（剪影研究），展示该破烂草帽生物的不同可读姿态。包含 7 个垂直色块，标题为“COLOR PALETTE”（调色板），从左至右标注：“BARK GRAY”（树皮灰）、“MONTE GREEN”（山林绿）、“TOBACCO BROWN”（烟草褐）、“EARTH UMBER”（大地赭）、“DRY LEAF BEIGE”（枯叶米）、“NIGHT CHARCOAL”（夜炭黑）和“BLACK”（纯黑）。

视觉风格：超高细节的电影级生物概念艺术，大地色系（棕、灰、绿），写实解剖结构与民间传说怪物设计相结合，风化纹理，每个图形下方有微妙的阴影，清晰的标签，细黑线，排版如同工作室的角色设计项目。

templates.title: Axiom Cat-Eye Fashion Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Axiom 猫眼时尚封面

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical avant-garde fashion magazine cover featuring {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious cat-themed intelligence heroine"} as the central subject, blending minimalist high-fashion editorial portraiture, retro Japanese anime poster energy, and independent art-project key visual design.

Canvas: Vertical magazine cover, 4:5 aspect ratio, full bleed. Deep teal-blue sky background with warm orange clouds at the lower left and lower right edges. Use a strong teal-and-orange color grade, dramatic rim lighting, hard graphic shadows, and a vintage print-poster feel.

Main subject: One anime-style female character, shown from an extreme low-angle perspective so she feels monumental and presses outward from the page. She stands in a tense, stylish JoJo-like fashion pose with one hand in her trouser pocket, torso leaning slightly back, shoulders angled, and head tilted downward toward the viewer. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur or shadow block, keeping her identity mysterious. She has short black bobbed hair with orange rim highlights, visible earrings, and a cool, intelligent, slightly dangerous aura.

Outfit and symbols: Include exactly 5 main outfit pieces: an oversized cream trench coat with dramatic lapels, a black fitted top, high-waisted cream trousers, a black belt with a rectangular buckle, and small dark earrings. Add exactly 1 signature accessory system: a cat-eye bracelet on her wrist, designed as the character’s identifying visual symbol rather than simple jewelry. The bracelet should have exactly 2 visible dangling charms: one orange cat-eye amulet charm and one small dark spherical charm, connected by a gold chain.

Cover layout: Place a huge elegant serif masthead across the top reading {argument name="magazine title" default="AXIOM"} in warm orange, partially behind the character’s head and hair. Keep the typography sparse, refined, and fashion-magazine-like, with plenty of negative space. The character should overlap the masthead, reinforcing cover logic.

Visible text content: Include exactly 8 text groups on the cover: 1) top-left tiny text: “美学・反逆・未来”; 2) top-right tiny text: “VOL.09 / AUTUMN 2025”; 3) giant masthead: “AXIOM”; 4) left mid large Japanese character: “猫”; 5) left mid small English/Japanese lines: “WIT. INSTINCT. REVOLUTION.” and “本能は、真実を見抜く。”; 6) right mid small English/Japanese lines: “INTELLIGENCE IS THE ULTIMATE WEAPON.” and “知性こそ、最強の武器。”; 7) bottom-left issue block: “THE CLEVER ISSUE” and “妙案は、静かに仕掛ける。”; 8) bottom-right large issue number and caption: {argument name="issue number" default="09"} with “SHADOW GAME” and “BRIGHT MIND”.

Visual style: Japanese old-anime-inspired character design, fashion editorial cover composition, cinematic low-angle lighting, sharp inked contours, painterly cel-shaded folds, warm orange highlights, deep teal shadows, elegant serif typography, clean luxury-magazine spacing, retro poster grain.

Constraints: Use exactly one central character, exactly one cat-eye bracelet, exactly two bracelet charms, and exactly eight visible text groups. Do not add extra cover lines, logos, barcodes, watermarks, or additional characters. Keep the image stylish and symbolic rather than overly detailed or realistic.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版先锋时尚杂志封面，以 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的猫主题智能女主角"} 为核心主体，融合极简主义高级时装编辑人像、复古日本动漫海报能量以及独立艺术项目主视觉设计。

画布：竖版杂志封面，4:5 比例，全出血设计。深青蓝色天空背景，左下角和右下角边缘带有温暖的橙色云彩。采用强烈的青橙色调、戏剧性的轮廓光、硬朗的图形阴影以及复古印刷海报质感。

主体：一位动漫风格女性角色，采用极端的低角度透视，使其显得宏大并仿佛要从页面中冲出。她摆出紧张、时髦的 JoJo 式时尚姿势，一只手插在裤兜里，躯干微微后倾，双肩倾斜，头部向下俯视观众。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊或阴影块刻意遮挡，保持身份的神秘感。她留着黑色短波波头，带有橙色轮廓高光，佩戴着耳环，散发出冷静、睿智且略带危险的气息。

服装与符号：包含 5 件核心服装单品：一件带有夸张翻领的米色超大款风衣、一件黑色修身上衣、高腰米色长裤、一条带有矩形扣的黑色腰带，以及一对小型深色耳环。添加 1 套标志性配饰系统：手腕上佩戴猫眼手链，将其设计为角色的识别视觉符号，而非简单的珠宝。手链应有 2 个清晰可见的垂坠挂件：一个橙色猫眼护身符挂件和一个小型深色球形挂件，由金链连接。

封面排版：在顶部横跨一行巨大的优雅衬线字体刊头，文字为 {argument name="magazine title" default="AXIOM"}，颜色为暖橙色，部分位于角色头部和头发后方。排版保持稀疏、精致且具有时尚杂志感，留出充足的负空间。角色应与刊头重叠，以强化封面逻辑。

可见文字内容：封面上包含 8 组文字：1) 左上角微型文字：“美学・反逆・未来”；2) 右上角微型文字：“VOL.09 / AUTUMN 2025”；3) 巨型刊头：“AXIOM”；4) 左侧中部大型日文：“猫”；5) 左侧中部小型英/日文行：“WIT. INSTINCT. REVOLUTION.” 和 “本能は、真実を見抜く。”；6) 右侧中部小型英/日文行：“INTELLIGENCE IS THE ULTIMATE WEAPON.” 和 “知性こそ、最強の武器。”；7) 左下角刊号块：“THE CLEVER ISSUE” 和 “妙案は、静かに仕掛ける。”；8) 右下角大型刊号及说明：{argument name="issue number" default="09"}，附带 “SHADOW GAME” 和 “BRIGHT MIND”。

视觉风格：日本老式动漫风格角色设计、时尚编辑封面构图、电影级低角度光效、锐利的墨线轮廓、绘画感赛璐珞褶皱、暖橙色高光、深青色阴影、优雅的衬线字体、简洁的奢侈杂志间距、复古海报颗粒感。

约束：仅使用一个中心角色，仅使用一条猫眼手链，仅使用两个手链挂件，且仅包含八组可见文字。不要添加额外的封面行、Logo、条形码、水印或其他角色。保持图像的时尚感和象征意义，避免过度细节化或写实。

templates.title: Horror Wraith Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 恐怖幽灵角色设定图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a horror character concept sheet for a ghostly female creature named {argument name="character name" default="unnamed wraith"}, designed for film or game production.

Canvas: Wide horizontal character turnaround sheet on an off-white studio background, realistic dark fantasy concept art, high-detail texture study, evenly lit with soft shadows and no environment.

Layout: Show exactly 4 labeled views arranged left to right: 1) FRONT full-body view, 2) SIDE full-body profile view, 3) BACK full-body view, 4) CLOSE-UP portrait view occupying the right third of the canvas. Place small uppercase serif labels above each view: “FRONT”, “SIDE”, “BACK”, and “CLOSE-UP”.

Subject details: The character is a tall, emaciated, corpse-like female apparition with very long tangled {argument name="hair color" default="wet black hair"} falling past the chest and down the back. Her skin is gray, deathly, and dirty, with thin blackened hands and bare feet. She wears a floor-length shredded {argument name="garment color" default="ash-gray"} burial gown made of rotting gauze, torn lace, and ragged strips, full of holes, frayed edges, dangling fibers, grime, stains, and smoky wisps. The silhouette should feel fragile, decayed, damp, and supernatural.

Face treatment: Obscure the face in every visible view with a plain dark rectangular censor block, creating an anonymous unsettling look. The close-up should show the head, hair, neck, and shoulders in extreme detail, with a large dark rectangle covering the face.

Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic creature-design sheet, monochrome gray-black palette, high-resolution fabric decay, wet hair strands, fine scratchy linework, subtle misty edges around the torn gown, eerie but clean production-art presentation.

Constraints: Include exactly 4 views and exactly 4 labels. Keep the background blank and neutral. Do not add extra props, weapons, scenery, logos, watermark, or additional text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="character name" default="unnamed wraith"} 的女性幽灵生物创建恐怖角色概念设定图，专为电影或游戏制作设计。

画布：宽幅横向角色三视图（含特写），采用灰白色摄影棚背景，写实黑暗奇幻概念艺术，高细节纹理研究，光照均匀，带有柔和阴影，无环境背景。

布局：从左至右展示 4 个带标签的视图：1) 正面全身视图，2) 侧面全身侧影视图，3) 背面全身视图，4) 占据画布右侧三分之一的特写肖像视图。在每个视图上方放置小型大写衬线字体标签：“FRONT”、“SIDE”、“BACK” 和 “CLOSE-UP”。

主体细节：该角色是一个高大、消瘦、如尸体般的女性幽灵，留着极长的凌乱 {argument name="hair color" default="wet black hair"}，头发垂过胸部并延伸至背部。她的皮肤呈灰色，死气沉沉且肮脏，有着纤细发黑的手和赤脚。她穿着一件及地的破烂 {argument name="garment color" default="ash-gray"} 寿衣，由腐烂的纱布、撕裂的蕾丝和褴褛的布条制成，布满孔洞、磨损的边缘、悬垂的纤维、污垢、污渍和烟雾状的丝缕。轮廓应呈现出脆弱、腐朽、潮湿和超自然的质感。

面部处理：在每个可见视图中，用一个纯色深色矩形遮挡块遮住面部，营造出一种匿名且令人不安的视觉效果。特写视图应以极高的细节展示头部、头发、颈部和肩部，并用一个大的深色矩形覆盖面部。

视觉风格：照片级写实电影生物设计图，单色灰黑调色板，高分辨率织物腐朽感，湿润的发丝，细腻的划痕线条，破烂长袍边缘带有微妙的雾气，呈现出诡异但整洁的制作艺术风格。

约束条件：必须包含 4 个视图和 4 个标签。保持背景空白且中性。不要添加额外的道具、武器、场景、标志、水印或任何其他文字。

templates.title: Mythic Yerba Mate Product Shot

titleLocalized.zh: Mythic Yerba Mate 产品拍摄

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic premium product advertising image for {argument name="brand name" default="MyThos"}, a luxury yerba mate package design inspired by Paraguayan forest legends. Scene: a dark rustic wooden tabletop against a smoky warm brown studio backdrop, dramatic low-key lighting, soft shadows, amber highlights, hyper-realistic commercial photography. Arrange exactly 7 visible product objects from left to right: 1 large front-facing black matte yerba mate bag, 1 narrow side-facing black bag showing side branding, 1 rear-facing black bag showing nutrition facts and barcode, 1 three-quarter angled black bag showing the front and right side, 1 tall green Stanley-style thermos with stainless steel cap on the far right, 1 dark worn mate gourd in front of the thermos filled with loose yerba, and 1 curved metal bombilla straw emerging from the gourd. Packaging details: all bags are glossy crinkled black kraft pouches with gold foil typography, ornate botanical borders, small tree emblem at the top, subtle forest leaves near the bottom, and mythical guardian character art. The main front bag should prominently read "{argument name="product name" default="MyThos"}" in large elegant serif gold lettering, with Spanish text "YERBA MATE", "ELABORADA CON PALO", and the slogan "{argument name="slogan" default="LEYENDAS QUE VIVEN"}". The front artwork shows exactly 2 legendary forest guardian figures, one straw-covered Pombero-like figure and one long-haired pale Pora-like figure, standing in a dark jungle scene; include a round gold seal near the bottom and the label "POMBERO & PÓRA" plus "GUARDIANES DEL MONTE". The back-facing bag includes a centered nutrition information panel, exactly 3 small circular claim icons above it, paragraph text, a barcode at the bottom, and gold ornamental trim. The side-facing bag includes vertical layout branding, a small tree icon, short descriptive Spanish copy, and "POMBERO & PÓRA" near the bottom. Color palette: black, deep forest green, aged bronze, antique gold, warm brown wood, subtle cream text. Style: ultra-detailed, photorealistic, premium beverage packaging mockup, sharp focus on products, shallow depth of field, no people, no hands, no extra props, no watermark. Use {argument name="package weight" default="1kg"} on the front lower corner and make the thermos label read {argument name="thermos label" default="STANLEY SINCE 1913"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="MyThos"} 创建一张电影级高端产品广告图，这是一款受巴拉圭森林传说启发的奢华马黛茶包装设计。场景：深色质朴木质桌面，背景为烟雾缭绕的暖棕色摄影棚背景，戏剧性的低调照明，柔和阴影，琥珀色高光，超写实商业摄影。从左到右精确排列 7 个可见产品对象：1 个正面朝向的黑色哑光马黛茶包装袋，1 个侧面朝向的黑色包装袋（展示侧面品牌信息），1 个背面朝向的黑色包装袋（展示营养成分表和条形码），1 个四分之三角度的黑色包装袋（展示正面和右侧），最右侧放置 1 个带不锈钢盖的绿色 Stanley 风格高保温杯，保温杯前方放置 1 个装满散装马黛茶的深色磨损马黛茶葫芦，以及 1 根从葫芦中伸出的弯曲金属吸管（bombilla）。包装细节：所有包装袋均为带有烫金字体、华丽植物边框、顶部小树徽标、底部细微森林叶片图案以及神话守护者角色艺术的亮面褶皱黑色牛皮纸袋。主包装袋正面应以醒目的大号优雅衬线金字突出显示 "{argument name="product name" default="MyThos"}"，并配有西班牙语文字 "YERBA MATE"、"ELABORADA CON PALO" 以及标语 "{argument name="slogan" default="LEYENDAS QUE VIVEN"}"。正面艺术图展示了 2 位传奇森林守护者形象，一位是覆盖着稻草的 Pombero 类角色，另一位是长发苍白的 Pora 类角色，背景为黑暗丛林场景；底部附近包含一个圆形金印，以及标签 "POMBERO & PÓRA" 和 "GUARDIANES DEL MONTE"。背面包装袋包含一个居中的营养信息面板、上方 3 个圆形声明图标、段落文字、底部的条形码以及金色装饰边框。侧面包装袋包含垂直布局的品牌信息、一个小树图标、简短的西班牙语描述文案以及底部的 "POMBERO & PÓRA"。调色板：黑色、深森林绿、陈年青铜色、古金色、暖棕色木材、柔和的奶油色文字。风格：超细节、照片级真实感、高端饮料包装样机、产品焦点清晰、浅景深、无人像、无手部、无额外道具、无水印。在正面左下角使用 {argument name="package weight" default="1kg"}，并将保温杯标签设置为 {argument name="thermos label" default="STANLEY SINCE 1913"}。

templates.title: Whimsical Folk Art Window Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 充满奇趣的民间艺术窗景

templates.prompt: Create a whimsical hand-drawn folk-art illustration with a textured crayon, marker, and gouache look. Show an indoor wall scene filled with decorative floral doodles and bright handmade charm. In the foreground, place an adult woman presenter with {argument name="face style" default="a plain featureless tan square covering the face"}, dark center-parted hair, a black jacket, and a vivid red dress with a rounded red collar, black buttons, and drawstring details; she stands on the right half of the canvas and extends her left arm open toward a large window display. On the left, draw one large cream-colored double window with two tall panels and black hinges, decorated with tiny hearts, dots, and blue leafy borders. Behind the left window, show exactly one seated trumpet player: blue pants, dark jacket, curly gray hair, red cheek, holding a yellow trumpet, with black musical notes floating around; the pink background behind him contains leafy sprigs, white dots, yellow starbursts, and a handwritten vertical date-like note reading {argument name="window note" default="Feb / 13"}. On the far right, draw a second window with a golden yellow frame, teal curtains, pale lace trim, and a green garden-like view filled with flowers and vines. Between the woman and the left window, include a small wall poster reading {argument name="poster text" default="ACQUA PER LA VITA – WATER FOR LIFE"} with blue wave lines. Count and include exactly two windows, one presenter, one trumpet player, one poster, and two visible black musical notes. Surround everything with playful decorative motifs: red hearts, blue leafy branches, pink and red flowers, yellow starbursts, green vines, multicolored dots, and small white speckled texture. Use an off-white background, naïve proportions, thick black sketchy outlines, visible paper grain, and a cheerful Italian folk-art mood. Avoid photorealism, shadows, or digital polish; make it look handmade and slightly imperfect.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅充满奇趣的手绘民间艺术插画，呈现蜡笔、马克笔和水粉画的质感。描绘一个室内墙面场景，充满装饰性的花卉涂鸦和明亮的手工魅力。在前景中，放置一位成年女性演讲者，其面部为 {argument name="face style" default="一个覆盖面部的简洁无特征棕色正方形"}，留着深色中分发型，身穿黑色外套和一件鲜红色的连衣裙，配有圆领、黑色纽扣和抽绳细节；她站在画布右侧，左臂向一扇大型窗户展示区伸展。在左侧，绘制一扇大型奶油色双开窗，带有两块高大的窗板和黑色铰链，装饰着微小的爱心、圆点和蓝色叶状边框。在左侧窗户后方，展示唯一一位坐着的小号手：穿着蓝色裤子、深色外套，留着灰色卷发，脸颊红润，手持黄色小号，周围漂浮着黑色音符；他身后的粉色背景中包含叶枝、白色圆点、黄色星芒，以及一张手写的垂直日期状便签，写着 {argument name="window note" default="Feb / 13"}。在最右侧，绘制第二扇窗户，带有金黄色边框、青色窗帘、浅色蕾丝饰边，以及充满花朵和藤蔓的绿色花园景观。在女性和左侧窗户之间，加入一张小型墙面海报，上面写着 {argument name="poster text" default="ACQUA PER LA VITA – WATER FOR LIFE"}，并配有蓝色波浪线。画面中必须包含且仅包含两扇窗户、一位演讲者、一位小号手、一张海报和两个可见的黑色音符。周围环绕着俏皮的装饰图案：红色爱心、蓝色叶枝、粉色和红色花朵、黄色星芒、绿色藤蔓、彩色圆点以及细小的白色斑点纹理。使用米白色背景、稚拙的比例、粗犷的黑色素描轮廓、可见的纸张纹理，营造出欢快的意大利民间艺术氛围。避免写实主义、阴影或数字化的精致感；使其看起来像是手工制作且略带瑕疵。

templates.title: Organic Modern Interior Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 有机现代室内设计拼贴图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a warm minimalist interior design collage celebrating clean design, smooth forms, natural textures, and functional elegance, with a calm organic luxury mood.

Canvas: A 4:3 horizontal image divided into exactly 4 equal rectangular panels in a 2x2 grid, separated by thin white gutters. Use soft natural daylight, beige plaster walls, warm wood, cream upholstery, woven rugs, olive greenery, and a serene editorial photography style.

Visual style: Photorealistic high-end interior photography, neutral earthy palette, Japandi and organic modern influence, rounded forms, tactile materials, matte finishes, subtle shadows, no people, no visible branding, no text.

Panel 1, top left living room: Show a cozy living room with exactly 1 curved cream bouclé sofa, 1 round low wooden coffee table, 1 large potted olive tree on the left, 1 framed abstract beige artwork centered above the sofa, 1 arched brass floor lamp with a woven shade on the right, 1 small ceramic vase with greenery on the coffee table, 1 shallow wooden bowl on stacked books, and 1 woven natural rug. Include an arched doorway in the back right with dim shelves beyond it.

Panel 2, top right kitchen: Show a refined kitchen with exactly 1 pale stone island with vertical fluted wood front, exactly 3 wooden bar stools, exactly 2 dome pendant lamps hanging above, 1 tall window or glass door on the left with leafy outdoor greenery, 1 white vase filled with branches on the island, 1 bowl of green fruit, 1 black faucet and cooktop, and a slim floating shelf on the back wall with minimal ceramics and a small framed landscape print.

Panel 3, bottom left bedroom: Show a tranquil bedroom with exactly 1 low wooden bed frame, cream bedding, exactly 4 visible pillows, 1 olive green throw blanket draped across the bed, 1 wooden nightstand on the left, 1 rounded beige table lamp, 1 framed delicate botanical artwork above the bed, 1 small vase with leafy stems near the window, 1 large floor-to-ceiling window on the right, and a woven rug under the bed.

Panel 4, bottom right bathroom: Show a spa-like bathroom with exactly 1 freestanding oval cream stone bathtub, 1 white towel draped over the tub rim, 1 recessed illuminated wall niche holding minimal bottles, bowl, and plant, 1 wall-mounted black faucet with two knobs, 1 small round wooden side table with ceramics, 1 large potted olive tree near the right window, and 1 round woven rug in the foreground.

Customizable direction: Maintain the overall aesthetic as {argument name="design style" default="warm organic modern Japandi minimalism"}, use {argument name="main color palette" default="cream, beige, warm oak, olive green, and soft taupe"}, set the lighting to {argument name="lighting mood" default="soft natural morning daylight"}, keep the material focus on {argument name="material focus" default="bouclé, plaster, oak wood, stone, linen, ceramic, and woven fiber"}, and make the space feel {argument name="emotional tone" default="calm, warm, elegant, and quietly luxurious"}.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 panels and the specified object counts, keep the composition clean and uncluttered, avoid saturated colors, avoid harsh contrast, avoid people, pets, logos, captions, and extra decorative clutter.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一组温暖的极简主义室内设计拼贴图，展现简洁的设计、流畅的线条、自然的纹理和功能性的优雅，营造宁静的有机奢华氛围。

画布：一张 4:3 的横向图像，被细白边框分割为 2x2 网格的 4 个等大矩形面板。采用柔和的自然日光，使用米色灰泥墙面、暖色木材、奶油色软装、编织地毯、橄榄绿植，并呈现宁静的杂志摄影风格。

视觉风格：写实的高端室内摄影，中性大地色调，受 Japandi 和有机现代风格影响，圆润的造型、富有质感的材料、哑光饰面、微妙的阴影，画面中无人，无可见品牌标识，无文字。

面板 1（左上，客厅）：展示一个舒适的客厅，包含 1 张弧形奶油色羊羔绒沙发、1 张圆形低矮木质咖啡桌、左侧 1 棵大型盆栽橄榄树、沙发上方居中挂有 1 幅米色抽象艺术画、右侧 1 盏带编织灯罩的拱形黄铜落地灯、咖啡桌上 1 个插有绿植的小陶瓷花瓶、一叠书上放着 1 个浅木碗，以及 1 张天然编织地毯。右后方设有一个拱形门洞，门后可见模糊的搁架。

面板 2（右上，厨房）：展示一个精致的厨房，包含 1 个带有垂直长笛纹木饰面的浅色石材岛台、3 张木质吧台椅、上方悬挂 2 盏圆顶吊灯、左侧 1 扇高大的窗户或玻璃门，可见窗外绿植、岛台上 1 个插有树枝的白色花瓶、1 碗绿色水果、1 个黑色水龙头和灶台，后墙设有一块纤薄的悬浮搁板，摆放着极简陶瓷和 1 幅小型风景画框。

面板 3（左下，卧室）：展示一个宁静的卧室，包含 1 张低矮木质床架、奶油色寝具、4 个可见的枕头、床尾搭着 1 条橄榄绿毯子、左侧 1 个木质床头柜、1 盏圆润的米色台灯、床上方 1 幅精致的植物艺术画、窗边 1 个插有绿叶茎的小花瓶、右侧 1 扇落地大窗，以及床下 1 张编织地毯。

面板 4（右下，浴室）：展示一个水疗风格的浴室，包含 1 个独立式椭圆形奶油色石材浴缸、浴缸边缘搭着 1 条白毛巾、墙面嵌入式照明壁龛内摆放着极简瓶罐、碗和植物、1 个带两个旋钮的壁挂式黑色水龙头、1 张放有陶瓷的小圆木桌、右侧窗边 1 棵大型盆栽橄榄树，以及前景 1 张圆形编织地毯。

自定义方向：保持整体美学为 {argument name="design style" default="温暖的有机现代 Japandi 极简主义"}，使用 {argument name="main color palette" default="奶油色、米色、暖橡木色、橄榄绿和柔和的灰褐色"}，将光照设置为 {argument name="lighting mood" default="柔和的自然晨光"}，材料重点保持为 {argument name="material focus" default="羊羔绒、灰泥、橡木、石材、亚麻、陶瓷和编织纤维"}，并使空间氛围呈现 {argument name="emotional tone" default="宁静、温暖、优雅且低调奢华"}。

约束条件：严格使用 4 个面板并遵循指定的物体数量，保持构图简洁整洁，避免使用饱和色，避免强烈的对比，画面中不得出现人物、宠物、Logo、标题及多余的装饰杂物。

templates.title: Rainy Night Event Street Fashion

The background shows a nighttime urban street with large trees, scattered yellow fallen leaves on the pavement, warm streetlights, blurred car headlights, and distant city lights with shallow depth of field. Use realistic phone-camera flash lighting, natural shadows, detailed brick texture, candid street-fashion mood, vertical 2:3 composition, no text, no watermark. Customize the outfit color as {argument name="top color" default="dark charcoal"}, the hairstyle as {argument name="hair style" default="long wavy black hair"}, the setting as {argument name="street setting" default="autumn nighttime city sidewalk"}, and the privacy block color as {argument name="face block color" default="dark brown skin-tone"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的夜间手机自拍照片，画面中一位成年女性靠在城市人行道的红砖墙上，正值秋季。她留着黑色长波浪卷发，肤色中等偏白，身材苗条，面部被一个位于正中央的深棕色不透明方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身穿深炭灰色罗纹无袖短款背心，搭配黑色高腰牛仔短裤，单肩背着一个亮面黑色单肩包。让她以略微倾斜的角度站立，一只手臂伸向镜头，仿佛正在自拍，另一只手放在短裤口袋附近，画面截取范围从头部上方到大腿中部。背景展现了夜间的城市街道，有高大的树木、人行道上散落的黄色落叶、温暖的路灯、模糊的车前灯以及远处景深较浅的城市灯光。使用逼真的手机闪光灯照明、自然的阴影、细腻的砖块纹理，营造出抓拍的街头时尚氛围，采用 2:3 竖版构图，无文字，无水印。可自定义上衣颜色为 {argument name="top color" default="dark charcoal"}，发型为 {argument name="hair style" default="long wavy black hair"}，场景为 {argument name="street setting" default="autumn nighttime city sidewalk"}，以及隐私遮挡块颜色为 {argument name="face block color" default="dark brown skin-tone"}。

templates.title: Cybernetic Woman in Cryo Tank

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级的竖屏科幻场景，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="LATVIA-01"}，一位女性人形生物合成仿生人，悬浮在装满发光水蓝色液体的透明圆柱形冷冻舱中。她以类似胎儿的姿势蜷缩漂浮，双腿弯曲，一只手贴在玻璃上，另一只手臂交叉在胸前，苍白的长金发在液体中无重力飘动。她的身体大部分是人类形态，但部分呈现生物机械特征：可见的合成肌肉、裸露的赛博肩关节、金属胸部结构、线缆以及半透明的皮肤细节，解剖结构优雅，无任何露骨内容。舱体覆盖着冷凝水、气泡、划痕和折射光，顶部和底部由厚重的黑色金属环密封，并连接着软管和接头。明亮的青色能量带在舱内围绕她的身体盘旋上升，投射出蓝绿色的高光。将舱体置于黑暗的未来主义实验室中：两侧配有机械臂、悬挂的线缆、控制台、发光的显示器，左侧设有一个全息状态屏幕，显示“{argument name="status label" default="LATVIA-01 // BIO SYNTHESIS // STATUS: ACTIVE"}”。采用黑色、钢灰色、绿松石色和青色的高对比度赛博朋克色调；超精细的写实数字艺术，戏剧性的轮廓光，体积光，水体焦散，电影级景深，焦点清晰地聚焦在玻璃舱上，采用 9:16 竖屏构图。主体的面部应被隐藏或由中性的矩形遮挡模糊处理，同时保持图像其余部分的高细节度。避免血腥内容，避免出现额外角色，避免出现标志或水印。

templates.title: Ink River Fairy Tale Diorama

The river snakes from the pen nib through the center and foreground, sparkling with tiny star-like flecks, bordered by raised pebbles, moss, tiny flowers, and miniature rocky banks as if the drawing has become a 3D diorama. Include exactly 6 main story elements: 1 antique fountain pen held by fingers, 1 winding ink river, 1 small boy in dark clothes walking beside the river, 1 small light-colored dog walking with him, 1 twisted old tree with sparse blue-black foliage on the left, 1 glass bell jar containing a single red rose on the right. Add exactly 1 small wooden toy airplane near the lower right bank. At the upper left of the parchment, write exactly 2 lines of elegant cursive ink text: line 1, “{argument name="first handwritten line" default="draw me a dream..."}”; line 2, “{argument name="second handwritten line" default="It is only with the heart..."}”. The scene should feel like a miniature world from an old storybook, inspired by poetic childhood adventure, pen-and-ink illustration, and magical realism. Use a shallow depth of field, warm amber lighting, dark vignetted background, highly detailed paper fibers, wet ink reflections, realistic macro photography texture, and painterly handcrafted details. Keep the composition vertical, with the parchment filling most of the frame, the pen entering from the top right, the handwritten text at upper left, and the boy and dog placed in the lower-left-middle area beside the river. Do not add extra characters, extra animals, modern objects, logos, or additional readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖的电影感微距静物照，展现一幅古老的童话插画在深色木桌上一张粗糙的手工羊皮纸上活灵活现的场景。一只人手在右上角握着一支古董钢笔，笔尖触碰纸面，流淌出光亮的深蓝色墨水，化作一条蜿蜒的微型河流横跨纸面。河流从笔尖蜿蜒穿过中心和前景，闪烁着细小的星光，边缘环绕着凸起的鹅卵石、苔藓、微型花朵和岩石河岸，仿佛画作变成了一个 3D 立体模型。包含 6 个核心故事元素：1 支被手指握住的古董钢笔，1 条蜿蜒的墨水河，1 个身穿深色衣服的小男孩走在河边，1 只浅色小狗与他同行，左侧 1 棵长着稀疏蓝黑色叶片的扭曲古树，右侧 1 个装有一朵红玫瑰的玻璃钟罩。在右下河岸附近添加 1 架小型木制玩具飞机。在羊皮纸左上角，书写 2 行优雅的草书墨迹文字：第 1 行，“{argument name="first handwritten line" default="draw me a dream..."}”；第 2 行，“{argument name="second handwritten line" default="It is only with the heart..."}”。场景应呈现出古老故事书中的微型世界感，灵感源自诗意的童年冒险、钢笔画插图和魔幻现实主义。使用浅景深、温暖的琥珀色灯光、深色暗角背景，展现高细节的纸张纤维、湿润的墨水反光、逼真的微距摄影质感以及如画般的手工细节。保持竖构图，羊皮纸填满大部分画面，钢笔从右上角切入，手写文字位于左上角，男孩和狗位于左下至中部的河边。请勿添加额外角色、额外动物、现代物品、徽标或其他可读文本。

The mural features one central original anime girl named {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"}: a pastel Harajuku-style girl with {argument name="hair color" default="silvery blonde"} long wavy twin-tail hair, big sparkling blue eyes, flushed cheeks, a surprised tiny open mouth, a blue bow headband, small heart hair clips, and a frilly pale blue-and-white dress with ribbon details. templates.title: Anime Boy at Night Window

templates.title: East Asian Woman in Silk Qipao Corridor Portrait

The garden beyond the open frame: grey stone, a single bare-branched tree, soft ambient outdoor light. She stands inside the corridor, the garden behind her out of focus.
{argument name="subject" default="East Asian young woman"} in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes open toward the garden, the gaze released — not focused, carried outward by the space. Straight refined nose. Skin tone fair beige, lit from the diffuse outdoor light entering through the open side of the corridor. Skin subsurface scattering visible under directional light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge, fine foundation powder grain perceptible.
She wears a {argument name="outfit" default="moonwhite silk qipao with plum blossom embroidery in pale silver-grey thread"} — the white carrying a faint blue-cold undertone, the plum blossoms sparse and scattered across the fabric like actual fallen petals. Mandarin collar, short sleeves, the silk catching the outdoor diffuse light with a muted sheen. She stands with one shoulder toward the open garden side, arms loose. The corridor has no furnishings. Two or three stray hairs displaced by faint air movement, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.
Cool diffuse outdoor light entering through the open corridor side — overcast northern daylight, even and without shadow. The moonwhite qipao reflects it with the particular quality of aged silk: not glossy, not matte, something between. The garden beyond: grey softness. Mood: the inside world looking into the outside world without crossing over. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 9:16. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张中景真实日常生活摄影，捕捉自然的抓拍瞬间，画面中是一位 {argument name="subject" default="东亚年轻女性"} 站在通往小型庭院花园的室内长廊内。85mm 镜头，腰部以上构图，浅景深。开放式框架外的花园：灰色岩石、一棵光秃秃的树，柔和的户外环境光。她站在走廊内，身后的花园处于虚化状态。
{argument name="subject" default="东亚年轻女性"}，20 岁出头。杏仁眼望向花园，眼神放松——没有聚焦，被空间带向远方。鼻梁挺拔精致。肤色为白皙的米色，被从走廊开放侧射入的漫射户外光照亮。在定向光线下可见皮肤的次表面散射，颧骨和鼻梁上有细微的镜面高光，可见细腻的粉底质感。
她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="月白色丝绸旗袍，饰有淡银灰色丝线绣制的梅花"} ——白色带有淡淡的冷蓝色调，梅花稀疏地散落在面料上，如同真实的落花。立领，短袖，丝绸在户外漫射光下呈现出柔和的光泽。她侧身对着开放的花园一侧站立，双臂自然下垂。走廊内没有陈设。两三根碎发被微风吹乱，呈现出自然的非预期不完美感，而非几何对称。
凉爽的漫射户外光从走廊开放侧射入——阴天的北方日光，均匀且无阴影。月白色旗袍反射出陈年丝绸特有的质感：非高光，非哑光，介于两者之间。远处的花园：灰色的柔和感。氛围：内心世界向外窥探，却未曾跨越。阴影区域有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，具有摄影噪点质感，而非 CG 渲染的平滑感。纵横比 9:16。无水印，无文字覆盖，非卡通，非数字绘画，非插画，非动漫。

templates.prompt: (researched {argument name="dataset type" default="geopolitical or global dataset"} × {argument name="map style" default="elegant folded-paper cartography"}) + (origami sculpture ^ editorial information design ^ soft tactile shading) - (flat boring map + fake country data + corporate dashboard aesthetic) = viral folded-world infographic  INPUT: {argument name="topic" default="Countries with the fastest internet speeds"}   SYSTEM: Research the input topic and create a premium infographic built around a stylized world or regional map made from layered origami paper forms.  RESEARCH REQUIREMENTS: - Research the correct ranking or comparison data for the topic. - Verify country names, numerical values, and year/date. - Use authoritative international or official sources where possible. - Do not invent values, ranks, or map classifications. - Keep metric definitions consistent across all countries.  VISUAL CONCEPT: Turn the data into an elegant folded-paper map or collection of origami country tiles. Use folds, shadows, tabs, and layered paper shapes to encode hierarchy, rank, or magnitude.  STYLE: origami editorial infographic, layered paper map, tactile folds, premium magazine design, quiet luxury information art  COMPOSITION: - strong title at top - world map or region map as the main visual - top countries highlighted with larger folded structures - small callout cards with:   country name   value   rank   year - subtle legend if needed - use visual hierarchy through size, folds, and elevation - minimal but readable labels  MATERIALS: matte paper, embossed card, soft deckled edges, cream and muted color palette, subtle drop shadows  OUTPUT: Research the topic, verify the dataset, then generate a polished origami-style global infographic that feels tactile, elegant, and highly shareable.

promptLocalized.zh: (研究 {argument name="dataset type" default="地缘政治或全球数据集"} × {argument name="map style" default="优雅的折纸地图制图"}) + (折纸雕塑 ^ 编辑信息设计 ^ 柔和的触感阴影) - (平面枯燥的地图 + 虚假国家数据 + 企业仪表盘美学) = 病毒式传播的折纸世界信息图  输入：{argument name="topic" default="网速最快的国家"}   系统：研究输入的主题，并围绕由层叠折纸形式构成的风格化世界地图或区域地图，创作一张高级信息图。  研究要求： - 研究该主题准确的排名或对比数据。 - 核实国家名称、数值以及年份/日期。 - 尽可能使用权威的国际或官方来源。 - 请勿虚构数值、排名或地图分类。 - 确保各国的指标定义保持一致。  视觉概念：将数据转化为优雅的折纸地图或折纸国家板块集合。利用折痕、阴影、标签和层叠的纸张形状来编码层级、排名或量级。  风格：折纸编辑信息图、层叠纸质地图、触感折痕、高级杂志设计、静奢风信息艺术  构图： - 顶部设有醒目的标题 - 以世界地图或区域地图作为主要视觉元素 - 突出显示排名靠前的国家，并使用更大的折叠结构 - 带有以下内容的小型标注卡片：   国家名称   数值   排名   年份 - 必要时添加简洁的图例 - 通过尺寸、折痕和高度差体现视觉层级 - 标签简洁且易读  材质：哑光纸、压纹卡纸、柔和的毛边、奶油色与柔和的色调、细腻的投影  输出：研究主题，核实数据集，然后生成一张精致的折纸风格全球信息图，使其具有触感、优雅且极具传播价值。

templates.title: Professional Character Sheet Template

titleLocalized.zh: 专业角色设定表模板

templates.prompt:
[Layout]
Configure as a single, organized character sheet. White or very light gray background. Clean layout with easy-to-read margins. Each panel should have a dark blue or calm blue heading label. Minimal decoration, prioritizing clarity of information.

[Required Panel Configuration]
1. Full Body (Front)
2. Full Body (Side)
3. Full Body (Back)
4. Face Close-up (Front)
5. Face Close-up (45-degree angle)
6. Face Close-up (Profile)
7. Upper Body Close-up (Front)

[Content for Each Panel]
- Full Body (Front): A natural standing pose. Make face, hair, entire suit, skirt length, black high socks, and shoes visible.
- Full Body (Side): Profile standing pose. Make the side profile of the face, chest, waist, hips, leg lines, hair fall, and twintail position visible.
- Full Body (Back): Rear view. Show the parting, how the twintails look from the back, jacket back, skirt back, and leg lines.
- Face Close-up (Front): Reference shot of the face. Clearly show eyes, nose, mouth, contour, bangs, and ribbon position.
- Face Close-up (45-degree angle): Show the three-dimensionality of the face from an angle, appearance of cheeks, fall of bangs, and one twintail.
- Face Close-up (Profile): Clearly show the forehead, bridge of the nose, mouth, chin, ear position, neck connection, and side profile silhouette.
- Upper Body Close-up (Front): In addition to the face, show the jacket collar, blouse collar, shoulder shape, and silhouette from the chest to the upper waist.

[Style/Texture]
High-quality portrait expression leaning towards photorealism. Avoid excessive AI-style skin processing; keep a natural skin feel for a {argument name="subject" default="young person"}. Skin should be clean and smooth but not wax-like. {argument name="hair" default="Black hair"} should have a natural shine. The {argument name="outfit" default="suit"} should have a clean, high-quality fabric feel. Overall bright, clear, and highly informative finish.

[Excluded Items]
No tiny costume detail windows. No color palette column. No long profile section. No excessive explanatory text. No scene, background, or prop staging.

[Prohibitions]
Changing the person, making them look younger, mass-produced anime face, oversized eyes, unstable nose or chin shape, broken side profiles, changing twintail positions, changing ribbon shapes, altered hairstyles, suit color changes, unnecessary accessories, excessive skin beautification, excessive shadows, or cluttered layouts.

promptLocalized.zh:
[布局]
配置为单一、有组织的设定表。白色或极浅灰色的背景。布局整洁，留白易读。每个面板应带有深蓝色或冷静蓝色的标题标签。装饰极简，优先考虑信息清晰度。

[必需的面板配置]
1. 全身（正面）
2. 全身（侧面）
3. 全身（背面）
4. 面部特写（正面）
5. 面部特写（45 度角）
6. 面部特写（侧脸）
7. 上半身特写（正面）

[各面板内容]
- 全身（正面）：自然的站立姿势。确保面部、头发、整套服装、裙长、黑色长筒袜和鞋子清晰可见。
- 全身（侧面）：侧身站立姿势。确保面部侧影、胸部、腰部、臀部、腿部线条、头发垂落感及双马尾位置清晰可见。
- 全身（背面）：背面视图。展示发缝、双马尾的背面效果、夹克背面、裙子背面及腿部线条。
- 面部特写（正面）：面部参考图。清晰展示眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、轮廓、刘海及丝带位置。
- 面部特写（45 度角）：展示从侧角观察的面部立体感、脸颊外观、刘海垂落感及一侧双马尾。
- 面部特写（侧脸）：清晰展示额头、鼻梁、嘴巴、下巴、耳朵位置、颈部连接处及侧面轮廓。
- 上半身特写（正面）：除面部外，展示夹克领口、衬衫领口、肩部形状以及从胸部到上腰部的轮廓。

[风格/质感]
偏向写实的高质量肖像表现。避免过度 AI 风格的皮肤处理；保持 {argument name="subject" default="年轻人"} 自然的皮肤质感。皮肤应干净光滑，但不能像蜡像。{argument name="hair" default="黑发"} 应具有自然光泽。{argument name="outfit" default="西装"} 应具有干净、高质量的织物感。整体呈现明亮、清晰且信息量丰富的效果。

[排除项]
无微小的服装细节窗口。无色板栏。无长篇个人资料部分。无过多的说明性文字。无场景、背景或道具布置。

[禁止事项]
更换人物、使其看起来更年轻、量产型动漫脸、大眼睛、不稳定的鼻子或下巴形状、破碎的侧脸轮廓、改变双马尾位置、改变丝带形状、更改发型、改变西装颜色、不必要的配饰、过度美颜、过度阴影或杂乱的布局。

templates.prompt: [Style] High-quality realistic photography. Theme: "Traditional Costume Fashion Collage of Ten Countries". Magazine/social media-grade visuals for people/characters. Natural textures, cinematic tones, modern and elegant commercial photography. Avoid AI synthetic feel. [Composition] 16:9 wide aspect ratio. Fashion collage configuration of 2 rows x 5 columns. Arrangement where all ten figures look like the same person in different outfits. Do not cut off important parts of the face, hands, hairstyle, headpiece, or costume. Background is clean with negative space, slightly emphasizing the central figure. [Subject] A fictional Japanese woman around 20 years old. Maintain the same facial features, eyes, nose, lips, contour, skin tone, and body type. Change only the costume, hairstyle, hair accessories, makeup, and pose for each country. Expressed not as ten different people, but as ten transformations of one woman. [Costumes/Hairstyles/Makeup/Actions/Labels] Japan: Kimono, low bun, kanzashi, transparent white skin makeup, red lips. Lightly holding the sleeve, looking back slightly. Label "日本". China: Hanfu or Qipao style, elegant bun, hair accessories, thin eyeliner, soft rouge. Holding a round fan or adjusting the collar. Label "中国". Korea: Hanbok, low bun with center part, natural glass skin, pale pink lips. Standing with hands lightly overlapping. Label "韓国". India: Sari, side part or low bun, bindi, earrings, warm eye makeup and gold highlights. Lightly holding the edge of the sari. Label "インド". Vietnam: Ao Dai, long straight hair or half-up, natural and clean makeup. Holding a non la or looking slightly to the side. Label "ベトナム". Thailand: Traditional Thai ceremonial dress, high bun, gold hair ornaments, elegant gold-brown makeup. Gracefully pressing palms together (wai). Label "タイ". Mongolia: Deel, long braids or twin braids, traditional hat or forehead ornaments, healthy natural makeup. Lightly holding the sash or shawl. Label "モンゴル". Morocco: Kaftan, wavy long hair or low bun, metal decorations, subtle smoky eyes. Lightly touching the embroidery on the sleeve. Label "モロッコ". Mexico: Traditional embroidered dress, braided hair or low bun, floral hair ornaments, vivid but elegant lips. Lightly holding the skirt to show the embroidery. Label "メキシコ". Scotland: Tartan traditional costume or shawl, natural wavy hair or half-up, soft natural makeup. Lightly holding the tartan cloth. Label "スコットランド". [Scene] High-end photo studio based on light gray and cream white. Create depth with translucent glass, acrylic layers, low display stands, and soft shadows. Place small, readable Japanese labels near each person. No English, logos, watermarks, or meaningless symbols. [Lighting] Soft natural light from the front left. Weak rim light on the right side. Cinematic ambient light. Avoid blown-out highlights and preserve shadow detail. Unified color temperature and color grading. [Details] High-definition representation of fabric weave, embroidery, silk luster, cotton and linen texture, metal accessories, hair, skin texture, makeup, and clothing wrinkles. Label text is clear and readable. [Quality Keywords] High definition, realistic texture, clear subject, stable composition, unified colors, professional post-processing, clean outlines, natural body proportions, magazine cover level. [Avoid] Faces that look like different people, age changes, cultural confusion, excessive makeup, low resolution, distorted hands, too many limbs, facial collapse, incorrect perspective, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, garbled characters, English characters, long text, watermarks, logos, brand displays, meaningless symbols, incorrect national flags, rough synthesis, crowded composition.

promptLocalized.zh: [风格] 高质量写实摄影。主题：“十国传统服饰时尚拼贴画”。适用于人物/角色的杂志/社交媒体级视觉效果。自然的纹理，电影般的色调，现代且优雅的商业摄影。避免 AI 合成感。[构图] 16:9 宽屏比例。2 行 x 5 列的时尚拼贴布局。排列方式使所有十个人物看起来像是穿着不同服装的同一个人。不要裁剪掉面部、手部、发型、头饰或服装的重要部分。背景干净并留有负空间，略微突出中心人物。[主体] 一位 20 岁左右的虚构日本女性。保持相同的面部特征、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、轮廓、肤色和体型。仅改变每个国家的服装、发型、发饰、妆容和姿势。表现为同一个女性的十种变体，而非十个不同的人。[服装/发型/妆容/动作/标签] 日本：和服，低发髻，簪子，透明白皙底妆，红唇。轻提袖口，微微回眸。标签“日本”。中国：汉服或旗袍风格，优雅发髻，发饰，细眼线，柔和胭脂。手持团扇或整理领口。标签“中国”。韩国：韩服，中分低发髻，自然水光肌，淡粉色嘴唇。双手轻叠站立。标签“韩国”。印度：纱丽，侧分或低发髻，额饰 (bindi)，耳环，暖色眼影和金色高光。轻捏纱丽边缘。标签“印度”。越南：奥黛，长直发或半扎发，自然清透妆容。手持斗笠或微微侧头。标签“越南”。泰国：传统泰式礼服，高发髻，金色发饰，优雅金棕色妆容。优雅地双手合十 (wai)。标签“泰国”。蒙古：德勒 (Deel)，长辫或双辫，传统帽子或额饰，健康自然的妆容。轻扶腰带或披肩。标签“蒙古”。摩洛哥：卡夫坦长袍，波浪长发或低发髻，金属装饰，精致烟熏妆。轻触袖口刺绣。标签“摩洛哥”。墨西哥：传统刺绣连衣裙，编发或低发髻，花朵发饰，鲜艳而优雅的唇色。轻提裙摆以展示刺绣。标签“墨西哥”。苏格兰：格子呢传统服饰或披肩，自然波浪发或半扎发，柔和自然妆容。轻握格子呢布料。标签“苏格兰”。[场景] 以浅灰色和奶油白为主的高端摄影棚。通过半透明玻璃、亚克力层、低展示台和柔和阴影营造深度。在每个人物附近放置清晰可辨的日语标签。无英文、标志、水印或无意义符号。[光影] 左前方柔和自然光。右侧微弱轮廓光。电影级环境光。避免高光过曝，保留阴影细节。统一色温和调色。[细节] 高清呈现织物纹理、刺绣、丝绸光泽、棉麻质感、金属配饰、发丝、皮肤纹理、妆容和衣物褶皱。标签文字清晰易读。[质量关键词] 高清，写实纹理，主体清晰，构图稳定，色彩统一，专业后期处理，轮廓清晰，自然身体比例，杂志封面级。[避免] 看起来像不同人的脸、年龄变化、文化混淆、妆容过度、低分辨率、手部畸形、肢体过多、面部崩坏、透视错误、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、乱码、英文字符、长文本、水印、标志、品牌展示、无意义符号、国旗错误、合成粗糙、构图拥挤。

Atmosphere: Urban, artistic, and melancholic, reminiscent of high-end graphic novel cover art or a modern street-art mural. Aspect ratio is 9:16

promptLocalized.zh: 主体与构图：一张风格化的低角度肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位抬头仰望的年轻人"}，表情宁静。他戴着一副大型头戴式耳机和一顶有质感的红色针织帽。构图为特写，聚焦于侧脸和颈部，采用电影级视角拍摄。艺术风格：一种 {argument name="artistic style" default="现代波普艺术与数字矢量插画的融合"}。图像运用了大胆的高对比度阴影和清晰的线条。阴影呈现为“赛璐璐”或海报化风格，使用明显的色块而非平滑的渐变。调色板：引人注目的有限配色方案，包含 {argument name="color palette" default="深黑色、柔和的灰色、鲜艳的红色以及特定的青色/薄荷绿点缀"}。背景为平坦的中性灰白色，带有细微的几何草图线条。细节与质感：夹克和针织帽呈现出富有表现力的红色和青色笔触。耳机具有光泽的金属质感，并带有逼真的反射效果。皮肤以灰色调和青色高光渲染，以强调来自上方的戏剧性光影。氛围：城市感、艺术感且略带忧郁，让人联想到高端图形小说封面或现代街头艺术壁画。纵横比为 9:16

templates.title: Anime Character Pharmacist Reimagining

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫角色药剂师重构

templates.prompt:
Use uploaded character as exact identity reference.

Reimagine them as a {argument name="profession" default="pharmacist"} in a {argument name="setting" default="modern Japanese dispensing pharmacy"}.

CORE:
Create a humorous but believable anime screencap where the medication counseling perfectly matches the character’s personality, archetype, genre, speech style, powers, worldbuilding, vibe, hidden quirks, emotional tone, and aesthetic identity.

The absurd medicine explanations must feel NATURAL for THIS character specifically.

First internally analyze:
personality, genre, role, energy, speech style, motifs, intelligence style, emotional tone, powers, hidden quirks, whether they are sleepy, smug, saintly, chaotic, elegant, mysterious, villainous, chuuni, shy, cool, etc.

Then generate the most character-accurate absurd medication explanation possible.

Examples:
cat → cat language medicine
chuuni → parallel world stabilizer
angel → divine resonance suppressants
vampire → sunlight tolerance tablets
magical girl → transformation stabilizers
office lady → anti-overtime hallucination pills
idol → crowd charm stabilizer
nun → miracle suppression medicine
yandere → emotional limiter
fox girl → illusion leakage suppressants
cyberpunk → firmware stabilizers
delinquent → battle aura suppressants
sleepy girl → anti-dream-overflow tablets
etc.

Include visible Japanese dialogue:
speech bubbles, medicine labels, prescription bag text, monitor text, sticky notes, subtitles.

NO:
Medication instruction memos,
One-point advice,
large info sheets,
posters,
counter documents.

Dialogue MUST match the character’s speaking style.

Examples:
「副作用は軽微。……たまに時間感覚が崩れるだけ」
「夢のラスボス戦が少し弱くなります〜」
「裏世界側と接続される可能性がある……気をつけろ」
「奇跡酔いを抑えるお薬です」

Environment:
realistic Japanese pharmacy,
medicine shelves,
dosage packaging machine,
medicine boxes,
fluorescent lighting,
pharmacy counter,
waiting chairs,
medicine bags,
monitor display,
natural clutter,
believable depth.

Character actions:
holding medicine,
pointing at pills,
explaining bizarre side effects,
handing over medicine bags,
serious professional attitude despite nonsense explanations.

Patient visible from behind or side.

Speech bubbles:
rounded manga style,
large readable Japanese text,
few lines,
not overcrowded.

Style:
{argument name="visual style" default="hand-drawn anime illustration"},
soft sketch lines,
watercolor paper texture,
visible linework,
warm handmade feeling,
anime screencap energy,
slice-of-life comedy atmosphere,
cinematic composition,
soft indoor lighting

promptLocalized.zh:
将上传的角色作为精确的身份参考。

将他们重构为 {argument name="profession" default="药剂师"}，场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="现代日本调剂药房"} 中。

核心：
创作一张既幽默又真实的动漫截图，使药物咨询内容与角色的性格、原型、类型、说话风格、能力、世界观、氛围、隐藏怪癖、情感基调及审美特征完美契合。

这些荒诞的药物解释必须让该角色说出来显得“自然”。

首先进行内部分析：
性格、类型、角色定位、能量、说话风格、主题、智力类型、情感基调、能力、隐藏怪癖，以及他们是慵懒、自负、圣洁、混乱、优雅、神秘、邪恶、中二、害羞还是高冷等。

然后生成最符合该角色特征的荒诞药物解释。

示例：
猫 → 猫语药
中二病 → 平行世界稳定剂
天使 → 神圣共鸣抑制剂
吸血鬼 → 日光耐受片
魔法少女 → 变身稳定剂
职场女性 → 抗加班幻觉药
偶像 → 人气魅力稳定剂
修女 → 奇迹抑制药
病娇 → 情感限制器
狐娘 → 幻术泄露抑制剂
赛博朋克 → 固件稳定剂
不良少年 → 战斗气场抑制剂
嗜睡少女 → 抗梦境溢出片
等等。

包含可见的日语对话：
对话气泡、药瓶标签、处方袋文字、显示器文字、便利贴、字幕。

禁止：
用药说明备忘录、
一点建议、
大型信息表、
海报、
柜台文件。

对话必须符合角色的说话风格。

示例：
「副作用は軽微。……たまに時間感覚が崩れるだけ」（副作用很轻微……只是偶尔时间感会崩坏而已）
「夢のラスボス戦が少し弱くなります〜」（梦里的最终 Boss 战会变弱一点哦～）
「裏世界側と接続される可能性がある……気をつけろ」（可能会连接到里世界侧……小心点）
「奇跡酔いを抑えるお薬です」（这是抑制奇迹晕眩的药）

环境：
写实的日本药房、
药架、
分包机、
药盒、
荧光照明、
药房柜台、
候诊椅、
药袋、
显示器画面、
自然的杂乱感、
真实的景深。

角色动作：
拿着药、
指着药片、
解释离奇的副作用、
递出药袋、
尽管解释内容荒诞，但态度要严肃专业。

患者从背后或侧面可见。

对话气泡：
圆润的漫画风格、
清晰易读的日语大字、
行数少、
不拥挤。

风格：
{argument name="visual style" default="手绘动漫插画"}、
柔和的草图线条、
水彩纸质感、
可见的线条、
温暖的手工感、
动漫截图的氛围、
日常喜剧氛围、
电影级构图、
柔和的室内光

templates.prompt: Ultra-realistic portrait of the {argument name="subject" default="beautiful Korean girl"} from the previous images, maintaining identical facial appearance, silky long black hair, glossy eyes, soft blush makeup, youthful Korean beauty aesthetic, and realistic skin texture consistency. Bright natural sunlight streaming through the floor-to-ceiling office windows creates soft cinematic highlights and realistic shadows across the office interior. Luxury Korean drama atmosphere, sophisticated corporate aesthetic, candid office lifestyle vibe, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition, highly detailed, photorealistic office environment, realistic DSLR photography, soft warm glow, editorial fashion photography style, calm productive mood.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于前述图像中 {argument name="subject" default="美丽的韩国女孩"} 的超写实肖像，保持面部特征、丝滑长黑发、明亮双眸、柔和腮红妆容、年轻韩系美学及写实皮肤质感的一致性。她正站在 {argument name="setting" default="现代豪华企业办公室"} 内的大落地窗旁，姿态自然，一手拿着黑色咖啡杯，目光柔和地望向窗外的城市天际线。姿态优雅从容，一只手轻搭在窗台上，神情自信平静，展现现代韩式职场时尚美学。身着 {argument name="outfit" default="米色修身西装外套，内搭白色正式衬衫，下配黑色简约包臀短裙"}，尽显时尚专业的韩式职场穿搭。长长的丝滑黑发自然垂落，富有蓬松感，妆容精致自然，风格干练优雅。明亮的自然光透过落地窗洒入室内，在办公室中营造出柔和的电影级高光与写实阴影。现代办公环境，配有简约办公桌、笔记本电脑、文件、书架、办公椅及极简装饰，窗外可见写实的城市建筑。韩剧般的奢华氛围，精致的企业美学，职场生活抓拍感，浅景深，电影级构图，高度细节化，照片级写实办公环境，写实 DSLR 摄影，柔和暖光，编辑类时尚摄影风格，平静且高效的氛围。

templates.title: Cinematic Atlas Miniature World Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级微缩地图可视化

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
An ultra-premium cinematic atlas visualization of {argument name="country" default="COUNTRY"} designed as a luxurious collectible miniature world built directly into an aged textured world map. Instead of a simple diorama, the scene features an elevated hyper-detailed micro-city of {argument name="city" default="CITY"} emerging organically from the terrain like a living architectural island. The environment contains iconic monuments, historic buildings, rivers, bridges, tiny streets filled with realistic urban depth, glowing windows, vegetation, atmospheric details, and elegant cultural symbolism crafted with museum-level precision.
The camera angle feels like a high-end macro documentary photograph captured with a professional tilt-shift lens, creating an immersive miniature illusion with cinematic depth separation. Surrounding map typography, borders, coordinates, and neighboring regions remain subtly visible beneath the structure, blending cartography with luxury worldbuilding.
Add dramatic golden-hour sunlight mixed with soft volumetric atmospheric haze, realistic ambient occlusion, global illumination, rich shadows, ultra-detailed textures, reflective water canals, tiny moving boats, miniature street lamps, cinematic fog layering, and refined environmental storytelling. Include subtle weathered paper textures, embossed map details, and elegant depth transitions for a premium handcrafted aesthetic.
The color grading should feel inspired by luxury travel documentaries and next-generation editorial campaigns — warm golden highlights, rich earthy greens, elegant ivory paper tones, deep architectural contrast, and subtle teal shadows. The composition must feel grand, immersive, artistic, and visually unforgettable.
Ultra-photorealistic, insanely detailed, masterpiece-quality, hyper-realistic materials, advanced global illumination, macro realism, depth-rich cinematic atmosphere, luxury travel aesthetic, collectible miniature world design, editorial-quality rendering, 8K ultra detail.

promptLocalized.zh:
这是一幅超高端电影级 {argument name="country" default="[国家]"} 地图可视化作品，设计为嵌入古旧质感世界地图中的奢华收藏级微缩世界。场景并非简单的立体模型，而是将 {argument name="city" default="[城市]"} 的超精细微缩城市如同一座鲜活的建筑岛屿般从地形中自然浮现。环境包含标志性纪念碑、历史建筑、河流、桥梁、充满真实城市深度的微小街道、发光的窗户、植被、大气细节以及以博物馆级精度打造的优雅文化符号。

摄像机角度如同使用专业移轴镜头拍摄的高端微距纪录片，营造出具有电影级景深分离感的沉浸式微缩幻象。周围的地图排版、边界、坐标和邻近区域在结构下方隐约可见，将地图学与奢华世界观构建完美融合。

加入戏剧性的黄金时刻阳光，混合柔和的体积大气雾气、逼真的环境光遮蔽、全局光照、丰富的阴影、超精细纹理、反光水渠、微型移动船只、微型路灯、电影级雾气分层以及精致的环境叙事。包含微妙的风化纸张纹理、浮雕地图细节和优雅的景深过渡，呈现高级的手工质感。

色彩分级灵感源自奢华旅游纪录片和次世代编辑广告大片——温暖的金色高光、浓郁的大地绿、优雅的象牙纸色调、深邃的建筑对比度以及微妙的青色阴影。构图必须宏大、沉浸、艺术且令人过目难忘。

超写实主义、极致细节、大师级品质、超逼真材质、先进全局光照、微距真实感、深度丰富的电影级氛围、奢华旅游美学、收藏级微缩世界设计、编辑级渲染、8K 超高清细节。

templates.title: Crimson Volcanic Heart Tree

titleLocalized.zh: 绯红火山心树

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic dark fantasy landscape in a wide 16:9 aspect ratio. The scene shows a solitary ancient twisted tree on the right foreground, its gnarled black trunk spiraling upward into a dramatic loop like a heart or ring, with sparse thorny branches silhouetted against a blood-red sky. Place the tree on a jagged volcanic ridge of black rock with glowing red lava cracks. In the midground and background, show a vast hostile wasteland with exactly 7 visible mountain peaks or peak clusters: one dominant sharp black mountain mass on the left, one narrow glowing spire just right of it, three smaller triangular peaks near the center horizon, and two faint distant peaks on the far right. Add low red fog and smoke drifting through the valleys, with glowing lava rivers snaking across the lower left and center ground. The sky should be intense crimson and black, filled with layered storm clouds, faint stars, and a blazing red-orange horizon glow. Use a limited palette of {argument name="main color palette" default="deep red, black, crimson, and ember orange"}, high contrast, dramatic rim lighting, ultra-detailed textures, epic scale, realistic fantasy concept art, no characters, no buildings, no text, no watermark. Emphasize the mood as {argument name="mood" default="ominous, apocalyptic, and romantic"} and make the focal subject a {argument name="foreground tree shape" default="twisted heart-shaped dead tree"} in a {argument name="environment" default="volcanic wasteland at red dusk"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅 16:9 宽画幅的电影质感黑暗奇幻风景画。画面右侧前景展示一棵孤独的古老扭曲树木，其粗糙的黑色树干向上盘旋，形成类似心脏或圆环的戏剧性闭环，稀疏的荆棘枝条在血红色的天空中投下剪影。将树木置于布满发光红色熔岩裂缝的黑色岩石火山脊上。在中景和背景中，展现一片广阔而荒凉的废土，且必须清晰可见 7 座山峰或山峰群：左侧一座主导的尖锐黑色山体，其右侧一座狭窄的发光尖塔，地平线中心附近三座较小的三角形山峰，以及最右侧两座隐约可见的远山。添加在山谷间漂浮的低空红色雾气和烟雾，左下方和中心地面有蜿蜒的炽热熔岩河。天空应呈现强烈的深红与黑色，布满层叠的暴风云、微弱的星光以及地平线上炽热的红橙色光芒。使用有限的调色板 {argument name="main color palette" default="深红、黑色、绯红和余烬橙"}，高对比度，戏剧性的轮廓光，超精细纹理，史诗般的尺度，写实的奇幻概念艺术，无人物，无建筑，无文字，无水印。强调氛围为 {argument name="mood" default="阴森、末世且浪漫"}，并将焦点主体设定为 {argument name="foreground tree shape" default="扭曲的心形枯树"}，背景为 {argument name="environment" default="红色黄昏下的火山荒原"}。

templates.title: Living Dragon Mural in Sunset Alley

titleLocalized.zh: 日落巷弄中的活体巨龙壁画

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic urban fantasy scene in a gritty alley at sunset, showing one enormous {argument name="dragon color" default="black charcoal and ember-orange"} dragon as a massive wall mural that appears to be coming alive from the side of an old brick building. The dragon has a long serpentine neck, horned head, glowing amber eyes, sharp teeth, many jagged spines, layered armor-like scales, and two vast bat-like wings spread across the wall; its body and wings blend into the brick texture like street art but with 3D realism and fiery orange light glowing through the wing membranes and scale gaps. The setting is a narrow abandoned {argument name="city setting" default="New York-style industrial alley"} with tall brick buildings, metal fire escapes on the left, dark windows, graffiti along the lower wall, weeds and debris near the base of the building, and wet cracked pavement full of puddles reflecting the dragon and sunset. Place the low sun near the far end of the alley, casting strong golden backlight, long shadows, orange highlights, and dramatic contrast against the dark brick. Use a wide-angle perspective from ground level, vertical walls towering upward, the dragon dominating the right two-thirds of the composition and the alley receding into the glowing horizon on the left. Style should be ultra-detailed, realistic, high dynamic range, cinematic fantasy concept art, moody urban decay, sharp scale texture, damp reflective ground, warm orange and black color palette, no people, no readable text, no logos, no watermark. Optional greeting mood: {argument name="holiday mood" default="Happy Dragon Day, wonderful and awe-inspiring"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级、写实风格的都市奇幻场景，背景为日落时分的粗犷巷弄，展示一条巨大的 {argument name="dragon color" default="炭黑与余烬橙色"} 巨龙，它仿佛是从一栋古老砖墙上活过来的巨幅壁画。巨龙拥有细长的蛇颈、带角的头部、闪烁的琥珀色眼睛、锋利的牙齿、许多参差不齐的脊刺、层叠如盔甲般的鳞片，以及横跨墙面的两扇巨大蝙蝠状翅膀；它的身体和翅膀与砖墙纹理融为一体，如同街头艺术，但具备 3D 真实感，橙色的火光透过翼膜和鳞片缝隙透射出来。场景设定在一个狭窄废弃的 {argument name="city setting" default="纽约风格工业巷弄"}，两侧是高耸的砖墙，左侧有金属防火梯、深色的窗户，墙根处有涂鸦、杂草和碎屑，湿润开裂的地面上布满水洼，倒映着巨龙和日落。将低垂的太阳置于巷弄远端，投射出强烈的金色背光、长长的阴影和橙色高光，与深色砖墙形成戏剧性的对比。使用地面视角的广角镜头，高耸的墙壁向上延伸，巨龙占据构图右侧的三分之二，巷弄向左侧发光的地平线延伸。风格应为超细节、写实、高动态范围、电影级奇幻概念艺术、忧郁的城市衰败感、清晰的鳞片纹理、潮湿的反光地面、温暖的橙黑配色，画面中无人、无易读文字、无标志、无水印。可选问候语：{argument name="holiday mood" default="龙年快乐，精彩而令人敬畏"}。

templates.title: Vintage Indonesia Travel Collage Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古印度尼西亚旅行拼贴海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vintage travel-poster collage advertising {argument name="destination country" default="Indonesia"}, with a scrapbook postcard aesthetic and adventurous tourism mood.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, aged cream paper background with torn edges, distressed ink, speckles, layered paper scraps, postal markings, tape, and weathered print texture. Use warm earthy colors: red, teal, ochre, tan, brown, faded black, and sun-bleached cream.

Main subject: Center foreground shows a young female traveler from the waist up, holding a DSLR camera in one hand and an unfolded paper map in the other. She wears a loose white open shirt over a white crop top, patterned batik-style skirt, backpack straps, small jewelry, and messy tied-up hair. Her face is intentionally covered by a soft rectangular blur, while the rest of her body remains sharp and photo-realistic.

Text content: At the top, use a huge distressed red headline reading “{argument name="headline text" default="INDONESIA"}”. Beneath it, add a blue uppercase tagline: “{argument name="tagline" default="THOUSANDS OF ISLANDS, ENDLESS ADVENTURES"}”. Under that, add a red handwritten script line: “{argument name="script quote" default="Where culture, nature and smiles come together"}”. At the bottom, place a dark teal strip with white uppercase text: “NOT JUST A DESTINATION, IT’S AN EXPERIENCE”.

Layout and collage elements: Include exactly 12 major visible travel elements around the traveler: 1) a Balinese multi-tier temple pagoda on the left, 2) Borobudur-style stone stupas on the right, 3) a misty volcano and clouds in the upper middle background, 4) a busy Indonesian city street with scooters and traffic in the lower middle, 5) a turquoise public bus on the lower right, 6) a palm tree frond in the upper right, 7) a plate of Indonesian satay or grilled food with rice in the lower left, 8) a white frangipani flower near the food, 9) a yellow “WELCOME TO INDONESIA” tag in the upper left, 10) an Indonesian postage stamp in the upper right reading “REPUBLIK INDONESIA” with a volcano illustration, 11) a round Bali postal cancellation stamp near the upper right, and 12) passport-ticket ephemera in the lower left reading Jakarta, CGK, Indonesia, with a Garuda emblem.

Destination signpost: On the right side, add exactly 5 wooden arrow signs stacked vertically, each pointing right, labeled: “BALI”, “YOGYAKARTA”, “LABUAN BAJO”, “RAJA AMPAT”, and “LOMBOK”.

Brand mark: Bottom right contains a round sticker logo reading “wonderful indonesia” with a colorful flowing bird-like emblem.

Style constraints: Combine photorealistic travel photography with illustrated paper collage, vintage tourism poster typography, torn-paper layering, halftone grain, scratches, stamps, and muted cinematic contrast. Keep all text legible, avoid extra destination names beyond the listed ones, and do not add watermarks or modern UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张复古旅行海报拼贴画，用于宣传 {argument name="destination country" default="印度尼西亚"}，营造剪贴簿明信片的美感和充满冒险气息的旅游氛围。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，采用做旧的米色纸张背景，带有撕裂边缘、磨损的墨迹、斑点、分层纸屑、邮戳、胶带和风化印刷纹理。使用温暖的土色调：红色、青色、赭色、棕褐色、棕色、褪色的黑色和阳光暴晒后的奶油色。

主体：前景中心展示一位年轻女性旅行者，半身像，一只手拿着单反相机，另一只手拿着一张展开的纸质地图。她穿着一件宽松的白色开衫，内搭白色短款上衣，下身穿着印花蜡染风格裙子，背着背包带，佩戴小巧首饰，头发随意扎起。她的脸部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，而身体其余部分保持清晰且具有照片级的真实感。

文字内容：顶部使用巨大的做旧红色标题，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="INDONESIA"}”。在其下方，添加一行蓝色大写标语：“{argument name="tagline" default="THOUSANDS OF ISLANDS, ENDLESS ADVENTURES"}”。再下方，添加一行红色手写体引语：“{argument name="script quote" default="Where culture, nature and smiles come together"}”。底部放置一条深青色长条，上面印有白色大写文字：“NOT JUST A DESTINATION, IT’S AN EXPERIENCE”。

布局与拼贴元素：在旅行者周围包含 12 个清晰可见的旅行元素：1) 左侧的巴厘岛多层宝塔，2) 右侧的婆罗浮屠风格石塔，3) 上中背景中云雾缭绕的火山，4) 下中繁忙的印度尼西亚城市街道，有摩托车和交通流，5) 右下角的一辆绿松石色公共汽车，6) 右上角的棕榈叶，7) 左下角的一盘印尼沙爹或烤肉配米饭，8) 食物附近的一朵白色鸡蛋花，9) 左上角一个黄色的“WELCOME TO INDONESIA”标签，10) 右上角一张印有火山插图的“REPUBLIK INDONESIA”印尼邮票，11) 右上角附近的圆形巴厘岛邮戳，以及 12) 左下角印有雅加达、CGK、印度尼西亚字样及 Garuda 标志的护照机票票据。

目的地路标：在右侧，垂直堆叠 5 个木制箭头路标，均指向右侧，分别标注：“BALI”、“YOGYAKARTA”、“LABUAN BAJO”、“RAJA AMPAT”和“LOMBOK”。

品牌标识：右下角包含一个圆形贴纸标志，写着“wonderful indonesia”，并配有色彩鲜艳的流线型鸟类徽章。

风格限制：将照片级真实感的旅行摄影与插画纸质拼贴、复古旅游海报排版、撕纸分层、半色调颗粒、划痕、邮戳和柔和的电影感对比度相结合。保持所有文字清晰易读，除列出的名称外，避免添加额外的目的地名称，且不要添加水印或现代 UI 元素。

templates.title: Watercolor Cyberpunk Rooftop Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩赛博朋克屋顶少女

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cyberpunk watercolor illustration of one young woman seen from behind on a high rooftop balcony, overlooking a vast rainy futuristic city at night. The mood is soft and welcoming despite the dystopian setting, with luminous neon magenta, cyan, violet, and deep indigo washes, visible watercolor paper texture, ink-like edges, rain streaks, splatters, and glowing reflections. The woman has extremely long windblown {argument name="hair color" default="hot pink hair with cyan-blue underside streaks"}, a bare shoulder, dangling earrings, and a glossy black off-shoulder tech jacket covered in neon circuitry; her transparent iridescent skirt and straps glow with blue-pink light. Add exactly one visible flying drone or hovercraft in the sky. The skyline is dense with countless skyscrapers, holographic screens, vertical neon signs, and wet rooftops; include exactly three prominent readable Japanese text elements: 「未来都市」 on the largest magenta tower billboard, 「ホテル」 on a smaller right-side sign, and 「未来」 on the woman’s sleeve. Include exactly two opaque privacy/censor blocks as part of the composition: one dark plum square covering the woman’s face area, and one pink vertical rectangle covering the center of the giant billboard on the right. Use {argument name="art style" default="delicate watercolor cyberpunk anime concept art"}, dramatic back lighting, high detail, romantic rain, no photorealism, no clean vector look, no extra characters, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖构图的赛博朋克水彩插画，画面中一位年轻女性背对着观众站在高处屋顶阳台上，俯瞰着夜晚广阔且阴雨连绵的未来城市。尽管背景设定为反乌托邦，但整体氛围柔和且充满吸引力，运用了明亮的霓虹洋红色、青色、紫色和深靛蓝色的水彩渲染，呈现出可见的水彩纸纹理、墨迹边缘、雨痕、喷溅效果以及发光的倒影。这位女性拥有极长的随风飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色头发，内层带有青蓝色挑染"}，露出单侧肩膀，佩戴着垂坠耳环，身穿一件覆盖着霓虹电路图案的亮面黑色露肩科技夹克；她透明的虹彩裙摆和肩带散发着蓝粉色的光芒。在天空中添加正好一个可见的飞行无人机或气垫船。天际线极其密集，布满了无数摩天大楼、全息屏幕、垂直霓虹灯牌和湿漉漉的屋顶；画面中需包含正好三个清晰可见的日文元素：最大的洋红色塔楼广告牌上写着「未来都市」，右侧较小的招牌上写着「ホテル」，女性袖子上写着「未来」。构图中需包含正好两个不透明的隐私/遮挡块：一个深李子色的正方形遮住女性面部区域，以及一个粉色垂直长方形遮住右侧巨型广告牌的中心。使用 {argument name="art style" default="精致的水彩赛博朋克动漫概念艺术"}，戏剧性的背光，高细节，浪漫的雨景，非写实风格，非干净的矢量外观，无额外角色，且无水印。

templates.title: Pi Presentation Template Collage

titleLocalized.zh: Pi 演示文稿模板拼贴画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished promotional collage for {argument name="product name" default="Pi"}, showing that presentation visuals can be beautiful and varied by default.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, about 768×768 px, with a white background and a tight mosaic of rounded-rectangle presentation-slide thumbnails separated by thin white gutters. Use soft shadows, subtle bevels, and modern SaaS launch-ad aesthetics.

Layout: Arrange exactly 17 visible slide tiles in an irregular grid around one dominant central banner. The central banner spans most of the width and contains a dark rounded-square app icon on the left with a large light-blue “Pi” mark and a small diamond accent, plus the bold black slogan {argument name="main slogan" default="Beautiful by default. Limitless by design."} on the right. Surround it with varied presentation templates, mixing editorial, historical, abstract, photo, and product-design styles.

Visible tile count and contents: Include exactly 17 discrete tiles: 1) top-left painterly fantasy landscape with a glowing circular ring over water and mountains; 2) top-center dark “Standards” slide with a leather strap photo on the left, mustard title text, and small icon rows; 3) top-right wide purple-and-white “Design” slide with a seated laptop illustration and geometric UI decorations; 4) far top-right pastel gradient “Design” title slide; 5) left-middle black-and-white “Legacy” slide with the word partly cropped and a grayscale portrait holding an object, face obscured by a gray blur; 6) center-middle “Suzhou” slide with serif title, pale mountains, and a black-and-white classical Chinese garden photo; 7) right-middle vintage storybook “Prince:” slide with a small prince figure sitting on a planet under a starry sky; 8) far-left middle partially cropped antique mural/fresco slide with only the ending of a word visible; 9) central dominant {argument name="product name" default="Pi"} logo-and-slogan banner; 10) far-right dark lecture slide titled “3. Masterworks: Iconic Re…” with dense bullet text and small icons; 11) lower-left “Solstice” slide with soft watercolor greenery, a sun, lake, and sunflowers; 12) lower-center “Craftsmanship” slide with serif title, small circular icons, folded fabric photos, and a signature label; 13) lower-right map slide with a stylized terrain map and orange route line; 14) far-right small “Route” card with four colored square legend markers; 15) bottom-left misty karst mountain river photo tile; 16) bottom-center “3. User Experience Design” slide with paragraphs, bullet cards, and a smartphone mockup on a pale iridescent background; 17) bottom-right beige “Morandi Color System: Definition, History, and Professional Applications” slide with muted vases and botanical decor, plus a partially visible blue-purple technology slide titled “Apple Liquid G… Next-Generation Interface Design.”

Visual style: The collage should feel like a premium product-launch hero image for AI presentation generation: crisp typography, high visual diversity, rounded 12–18 px corners, clean white separators, subtle depth, and a balanced mix of neutral tones, pastel purple, sage green, muted blue, charcoal, cream, and watercolor textures.

Text constraints: Keep the central slogan large and fully legible. Other slide titles may be smaller but should resemble realistic presentation text. Use English text only. Do not add people outside the described slide thumbnails, do not add browser chrome, and do not include watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="product name" default="Pi"} 创建一张精致的宣传拼贴画，展示演示文稿的视觉效果在默认情况下也能既美观又多样。

画布：方形 1:1 图像，约 768×768 像素，白色背景，由圆角矩形演示文稿 Slides 缩略图组成的紧凑马赛克，中间由细白线隔开。采用柔和阴影、微妙的斜面效果以及现代 SaaS 发布广告的美学风格。

布局：在中心主横幅周围的不规则网格中精确排列 17 个可见的幻灯片磁贴。中心横幅占据大部分宽度，左侧包含一个深色圆角方形应用图标，带有醒目的浅蓝色“Pi”标志和一个小钻石装饰，右侧为加粗的黑色标语 {argument name="main slogan" default="Beautiful by default. Limitless by design."}。周围环绕着各种演示文稿模板，融合了编辑、历史、抽象、摄影和产品设计风格。

可见磁贴数量及内容：包含 17 个独立的磁贴：1) 左上角绘画风格的奇幻景观，水面和山脉上方有一个发光的圆环；2) 上方中央深色“Standards”幻灯片，左侧有皮带照片，芥末色标题文本，以及小图标行；3) 右上角宽幅紫色和白色“Design”幻灯片，带有坐着的笔记本电脑插图和几何 UI 装饰；4) 最右上角柔和渐变色的“Design”标题幻灯片；5) 左侧中间黑白“Legacy”幻灯片，单词部分被裁剪，灰度肖像中人物手持物体，面部被灰色模糊遮挡；6) 中央中间“Suzhou”幻灯片，带有衬线标题、浅色山脉以及黑白古典中国园林照片；7) 右侧中间复古故事书风格“Prince:”幻灯片，一个小王子形象坐在星空下的星球上；8) 最左侧中间部分被裁剪的古董壁画/湿壁画幻灯片，仅可见单词的结尾；9) 中央主导的 {argument name="product name" default="Pi"} 标志和标语横幅；10) 最右侧深色讲座幻灯片，标题为“3. Masterworks: Iconic Re…”，带有密集的项目符号文本和小图标；11) 左下角“Solstice”幻灯片，带有柔和的水彩绿植、太阳、湖泊和向日葵；12) 下方中央“Craftsmanship”幻灯片，带有衬线标题、小圆形图标、折叠织物照片和签名标签；13) 右下角地图幻灯片，带有风格化的地形图和橙色路线线；14) 最右侧小型“Route”卡片，带有四个彩色方形图例标记；15) 左下角朦胧的喀斯特山河照片磁贴；16) 下方中央“3. User Experience Design”幻灯片，在浅色虹彩背景上包含段落、项目符号卡片和智能手机模型；17) 右下角米色“Morandi Color System: Definition, History, and Professional Applications”幻灯片，带有柔和的花瓶和植物装饰，以及一张部分可见的蓝紫色科技幻灯片，标题为“Apple Liquid G… Next-Generation Interface Design”。

视觉风格：拼贴画应呈现出 AI 演示文稿生成产品发布的高级主图质感：清晰的排版、高度的视觉多样性、12–18 像素的圆角、干净的白色分隔线、微妙的深度感，以及中性色调、柔和紫、鼠尾草绿、柔和蓝、炭灰、奶油色和水彩纹理的平衡组合。

文本限制：保持中心标语醒目且完全清晰可辨。其他幻灯片标题可以较小，但应看起来像真实的演示文稿文本。仅使用英文文本。不要在描述的幻灯片缩略图之外添加人物，不要添加浏览器边框，也不要包含任何水印。

templates.title: Censored Realistic Spa Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 带遮挡的写实水疗肖像

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic vertical portrait photo of {argument name="subject" default="an elegant adult woman"} in a softly lit luxury bathroom or spa interior. The subject is framed from the upper chest to just above the head, facing slightly to the viewer's right, with long dark brown wavy hair pulled back loosely behind one ear and falling over the left shoulder. She wears a cream satin robe or blouse with a deep V neckline, showing natural collarbones, neck texture, subtle freckles and moles, warm tan skin, realistic pores, fine body hair, and natural highlights from sunlight. Place a large opaque square censor block over the entire face, centered from the forehead to below the mouth, filled with a smooth brown skin-tone gradient, hiding all facial features while leaving the hair, ears, neck, shoulders, and clothing visible. Use {argument name="lighting" default="warm late-afternoon natural sunlight"} with soft shadows and glossy skin highlights. Background: shallow-depth-of-field marble wall panels, muted beige-gray stone, a vertical brass or gold trim line on the right, faint blurred white flowers on the left, and an upscale calm interior mood. Photographic style: realistic editorial beauty portrait, 4:5 vertical crop, 768x1024 composition, natural imperfections, no text, no watermark, no jewelry, no extra people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的竖版肖像照片，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位优雅的成年女性"}，场景设定在光线柔和的奢华浴室或水疗中心内。主体取景范围从胸部以上至头顶，身体略微朝向观众右侧，留着深棕色长波浪卷发，头发松散地别在耳后并垂落在左肩。她身穿奶油色缎面长袍或衬衫，深 V 领口展现出自然的锁骨、颈部纹理、细微的雀斑和痣、温暖的棕褐色皮肤、真实的毛孔、细小的体毛以及阳光带来的自然高光。在整个面部覆盖一个巨大的不透明方形遮挡块，中心位置从额头延伸至嘴部下方，填充平滑的棕色肤色渐变，遮住所有面部特征，同时保留头发、耳朵、颈部、肩膀和衣物可见。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="温暖的午后自然阳光"}，营造柔和的阴影和亮泽的皮肤高光。背景：浅景深大理石墙板、柔和的米灰色石材、右侧有一条垂直的黄铜或金色装饰线条、左侧有模糊的白色花朵，整体呈现高端宁静的室内氛围。摄影风格：写实编辑类美妆肖像，4:5 竖版裁剪，768x1024 构图，保留自然瑕疵，无文字，无水印，无首饰，无其他人物。

templates.title: Rusted Decadent Clockwork Ruin

titleLocalized.zh: 锈迹斑驳的颓废发条遗迹

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic ultra-detailed wide-angle scene of {argument name="setting" default="an abandoned Victorian industrial greenhouse power station"} reclaimed by nature, with rusted iron beams, broken glass walls, a high arched glass-and-steel ceiling, hanging ivy, moss, puddles, corroded pipes, turbine-like machinery, and a long dark stone walkway leading toward a bright circular window at the far end. In the left foreground, place a decaying metal control console covered in rust and moss, topped by one ornate antique mantel clock with a yellowed Roman-numeral face and elaborate gold-brown filigree. Show exactly 7 visible analog time-and-pressure instruments in the foreground: 1 ornate mantel clock on top, 5 small round gauges embedded across the sloped console face, and 1 lower round gauge hanging near the central lever mechanism. Add old brass levers, valves, empty circular ports, cracked glass, verdigris, and heavy patina. The mood is {argument name="mood" default="rusted decadence, melancholy beauty, time reclaiming industry"}. Use warm golden-hour sunlight streaming through the broken roof and tall windows, with dramatic volumetric rays, floating dust, deep green shadows, amber highlights, wet reflective floor stones, and high contrast. Make the composition highly immersive and photorealistic, like a dystopian steampunk ruin after decades of abandonment, with no people, no modern objects, no readable text, no watermark. Use a 16:9 landscape aspect ratio, sharp foreground detail, rich texture, cinematic color grading, and atmospheric depth.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级、超精细的广角场景，展现一个被自然侵蚀的 {argument name="setting" default="废弃的维多利亚时代工业温室发电站"}，画面中包含锈迹斑斑的铁梁、破碎的玻璃墙、高耸的拱形玻璃钢结构天花板、悬垂的常春藤、苔藓、积水、腐蚀的管道、涡轮状机械，以及一条通向远端明亮圆形窗户的深色长石走廊。在左侧前景处，放置一个覆盖着铁锈和苔藓的腐朽金属控制台，上方摆放着一个华丽的古董壁炉钟，钟面为泛黄的罗马数字，并带有精致的金棕色花丝装饰。在前景中精确展示 7 个可见的模拟时间和压力仪表：顶部 1 个华丽的壁炉钟，控制台斜面上嵌入 5 个小型圆形仪表，中央杠杆机构附近悬挂 1 个下方的圆形仪表。添加旧黄铜杠杆、阀门、空的圆形端口、裂纹玻璃、铜绿和厚重的包浆。氛围为 {argument name="mood" default="锈迹颓废、忧郁之美、时间重塑工业"}。利用透过破碎屋顶和高窗射入的温暖黄金时刻阳光，营造出戏剧性的体积光、漂浮的尘埃、深绿色的阴影、琥珀色的高光、湿润反光的地面石块以及高对比度。构图需极具沉浸感且呈现照片级真实感，展现出废弃数十年后的反乌托邦蒸汽朋克遗迹，画面中无人、无现代物品、无清晰文字、无水印。使用 16:9 横向比例，前景细节锐利，纹理丰富，采用电影级调色，并具备深邃的氛围感。

templates.prompt: Create a high-fashion editorial studio portrait of {argument name="model description" default="a pale-skinned blonde woman with slicked-back hair"} standing in a three-quarter pose against a dramatic abstract impasto-painted backdrop. The model is shown from upper thighs to head, slightly left of center, shoulders bare, arms relaxed downward with one hand visible along the front of the dress. Cover the face with a smooth vertical rectangular blur in muted beige-gray so the portrait feels anonymous and conceptual. Dress her in {argument name="outfit" default="a sculptural strapless metallic silver satin gown"} with exaggerated folded origami-like panels, sharp architectural ruffles at the bodice and hip, and a cool reflective sheen. The background should be a dense expressive oil-paint wall with large sweeping palette-knife strokes and thick textures; use exactly 5 dominant palette colors: deep navy, cobalt blue, teal, charcoal black, and metallic silver-white. Lighting is moody and directional from the upper left, emphasizing glossy skin, satin highlights, and raised paint texture, with deep shadows on the right. Style: luxury fashion magazine cover aesthetic, avant-garde couture, painterly abstract expressionism, cinematic contrast, realistic photography blended with fine-art backdrop, vertical 4:5 composition, no text, no logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高级时装杂志风格的摄影棚肖像，主角为 {argument name="model description" default="一位皮肤白皙、梳着背头的金发女性"}，以四分之三侧身姿态站立在极具戏剧性的抽象厚涂画背景前。模特取景范围从大腿上部至头部，略微偏向画面左侧，双肩裸露，双臂自然下垂，其中一只手显露在裙子前方。用柔和的米灰色垂直矩形模糊效果遮盖面部，使肖像呈现出匿名感与概念感。为她穿上 {argument name="outfit" default="一件具有雕塑感的抹胸金属银色缎面礼服"}，礼服带有夸张的折纸式褶皱，胸部和臀部有锐利的建筑感荷叶边，并散发着冷冽的反射光泽。背景应为厚重的表现主义油画墙面，带有大面积的调色刀笔触和浓郁的纹理；使用 5 种主导色调：深海军蓝、钴蓝、青色、炭黑以及金属银白色。灯光采用情绪化且具有方向性的左上方侧光，强调光泽感皮肤、缎面高光以及凸起的颜料纹理，右侧留有深邃阴影。风格：奢华时尚杂志封面美学、先锋高定、绘画式抽象表现主义、电影级对比度、写实摄影与艺术背景的融合，垂直 4:5 构图，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。
