templates.title: Vintage North America Stamp Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 复古北美邮票网格

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean gallery sheet of vintage illustrated postage-stamp designs for an atlas-style North American city collection, presented as collectible UI/export assets.

Canvas: Landscape canvas, about 870×653 px, off-white background with generous margins and even spacing. Arrange the stamps in a precise 3-row by 6-column grid, for exactly 18 stamps total. Each city appears as a pair: first a sepia monochrome stamp, then a muted full-color version.

Layout: Use three horizontal rows with six stamps per row. Leave wide white space between stamp pairs and rows. Add faint small gray export filename captions under the paired groups, aligned near the lower left of each pair, such as “stamp-export-atlas-north-america-46”, “stamp-export-atlas-north-america-47”, “stamp-export-atlas-north-america-48”, continuing through the visible groups.

Stamp design: Every stamp is vertical with cream perforated edges, aged paper texture, thin ornate border, and an oval or arched central illustration window. Put “SOL” in the top-left corner and “100” in the top-right corner of every stamp. At the bottom of each stamp, include a ribbon banner with the city or neighborhood name, then stacked location text below it. Use engraved linework, antique travel-poster composition, soft shadows, and slightly worn ink.

Exact stamp count and labels: Include exactly 18 individual stamps in this order, left to right, top to bottom: 1 sepia Boston, Massachusetts, United States with a narrow historic street scene; 2 color Boston, Massachusetts, United States with red-brick buildings and a streetlamp; 3 sepia Charlotte, North Carolina, United States with a cozy storefront street and a “Noda” sign; 4 color Charlotte, North Carolina, United States with colorful buildings, plants, and blue sky; 5 sepia Chicago, Illinois, United States with a vertical “Chicago” theater sign and urban architecture; 6 color Chicago, Illinois, United States with the same theater sign in warm gold and teal tones; 7 sepia Wicker Park, Chicago, Illinois, USA with a storefront facade; 8 color Wicker Park, Chicago, Illinois, USA with an orange-brick storefront and teal sign; 9 sepia Cincinnati, Ohio, United States with a historic market building; 10 color Cincinnati, Ohio, United States with the same market in brick orange, green trim, and sky-blue background; 11 sepia Cleveland, Ohio, United States showing a grand arched arcade interior; 12 color Cleveland, Ohio, United States with teal glass ceiling and warm interior perspective; 13 sepia Dallas, Texas, United States with skyline and a “Deep Ellum” sign; 14 color Dallas, Texas, United States with lively street colors, teal sky, and Deep Ellum sign; 15 sepia Denver, Colorado, United States with a blue bear statue form against a glass building; 16 color Denver, Colorado, United States with a bright blue bear and green glass facade; 17 sepia Des Moines, Iowa, United States with a Tudor-style house; 18 color Des Moines, Iowa, United States with red roof, cream walls, green lawn, and blue sky.

Text content: Keep the stamp typography uppercase and vintage serif. Use the customizable collection mark {argument name="stamp currency text" default="SOL"}, denomination {argument name="stamp value" default="100"}, and export caption prefix {argument name="export filename prefix" default="stamp-export-atlas-north-america"}. Preserve the city labels as readable English, but allow the overall series theme to be {argument name="atlas region" default="North America"} and the visual finish to be {argument name="stamp finish" default="alternating sepia engraving and muted full color"}.

Visual style: Antique engraved postal ephemera, travel stamp sheet, cream paper, scalloped perforations, subtle drop shadows, fine hatch shading, warm browns, faded inks, muted teal, rust, ochre, brick red, and sky blue. Make the colored stamps look hand-tinted rather than modern digital. Keep all stamps consistent in size and framing.

Constraints: Do not add people, logos, watermarks, or extra stamps. The key requirement is exactly 18 stamps in a 3×6 grid, with paired sepia/color variants for the 9 listed places, readable city/state/country labels, “SOL” and “100” on every stamp, and faint gray export filenames beneath the groups.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张整洁的复古插画风格邮票画廊，用于北美城市地图系列，作为可收藏的 UI 或导出素材呈现。

画布：横向画布，尺寸约为 870×653 像素，米白色背景，留有宽裕的边距和均匀的间距。将邮票精确排列为 3 行 6 列的网格，总计 18 枚邮票。每个城市以一对形式出现：第一枚为棕褐色单色邮票，第二枚为柔和的全彩版本。

布局：使用三行横向排列，每行六枚邮票。在邮票对和行之间留出宽阔的留白。在每对邮票组的左下方添加淡淡的灰色导出文件名标注，例如“stamp-export-atlas-north-america-46”、“stamp-export-atlas-north-america-47”、“stamp-export-atlas-north-america-48”，并以此类推至所有可见组。

邮票设计：每枚邮票均为竖向，带有奶油色齿孔边缘、陈旧纸张纹理、精致的装饰边框以及椭圆形或拱形的中央插画窗口。每枚邮票的左上角标注“SOL”，右上角标注“100”。在每枚邮票底部，包含一个丝带横幅，标注城市或街区名称，下方堆叠位置文本。使用雕刻线条、复古旅行海报构图、柔和阴影和略显磨损的墨迹。

精确的邮票数量与标签：按从左到右、从上到下的顺序包含 18 枚独立邮票：1 棕褐色波士顿，马萨诸塞州，美国（狭窄的历史街道场景）；2 彩色波士顿，马萨诸塞州，美国（红砖建筑和路灯）；3 棕褐色夏洛特，北卡罗来纳州，美国（舒适的店面街道和“Noda”标志）；4 彩色夏洛特，北卡罗来纳州，美国（色彩丰富的建筑、植物和蓝天）；5 棕褐色芝加哥，伊利诺伊州，美国（垂直的“Chicago”剧院标志和城市建筑）；6 彩色芝加哥，伊利诺伊州，美国（带有暖金色和青色调的相同剧院标志）；7 棕褐色威克公园，芝加哥，伊利诺伊州，美国（店面外观）；8 彩色威克公园，芝加哥，伊利诺伊州，美国（橙砖店面和青色标志）；9 棕褐色辛辛那提，俄亥俄州，美国（历史悠久的市场建筑）；10 彩色辛辛那提，俄亥俄州，美国（砖橙色、绿色装饰和天蓝色背景的相同市场）；11 棕褐色克利夫兰，俄亥俄州，美国（宏伟的拱形拱廊内部）；12 彩色克利夫兰，俄亥俄州，美国（青色玻璃天花板和温暖的室内透视）；13 棕褐色达拉斯，得克萨斯州，美国（天际线和“Deep Ellum”标志）；14 彩色达拉斯，得克萨斯州，美国（生动的街道色彩、青色天空和 Deep Ellum 标志）；15 棕褐色丹佛，科罗拉多州，美国（玻璃建筑前的蓝色熊雕像）；16 彩色丹佛，科罗拉多州，美国（明亮的蓝色熊和绿色玻璃幕墙）；17 棕褐色得梅因，艾奥瓦州，美国（都铎风格房屋）；18 彩色得梅因，艾奥瓦州，美国（红屋顶、奶油色墙壁、绿色草坪和蓝天）。

文本内容：邮票排版保持大写和复古衬线字体。使用可自定义的集合标记 {argument name="stamp currency text" default="SOL"}、面值 {argument name="stamp value" default="100"} 以及导出文件名后缀 {argument name="export filename prefix" default="stamp-export-atlas-north-america"}。城市标签保留为可读的英文，但允许整体系列主题为 {argument name="atlas region" default="North America"}，视觉效果为 {argument name="stamp finish" default="alternating sepia engraving and muted full color"}。

视觉风格：古董雕刻邮政印刷品、旅行邮票单、奶油色纸张、扇形齿孔、细微的投影、精细的阴影排线、暖棕色、褪色的墨水、柔和的青色、铁锈色、赭石色、砖红色和天蓝色。让彩色邮票看起来像是手工上色，而非现代数字印刷。保持所有邮票的尺寸和框架一致。

约束：不要添加人物、徽标、水印或额外的邮票。核心要求是 3×6 网格中正好 18 枚邮票，9 个列出地点均有棕褐色/彩色配对变体，清晰的城市/州/国家标签，每枚邮票上均有“SOL”和“100”，且组下方有淡淡的灰色导出文件名。

templates.title: Emerald Couture Seasonal Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: Emerald Couture 季节性肖像

templates.prompt: Create a painterly high-fashion portrait of a single elegant woman representing the {argument name="season vibe" default="winter emerald mood"} palette. Vertical 3:4 canvas, waist-to-knee crop, dramatic studio lighting. The woman stands in a graceful contrapposto pose with one hand resting on her waist, wearing a flowing deep {argument name="dress color" default="emerald green"} couture gown with a plunging V neckline, wrapped bodice, layered drapery, long translucent chiffon sleeves, and subtle gold highlights in the folds. Her {argument name="hair color" default="dark teal-black"} hair is shoulder length, glossy, and wind-swept to one side. Place her in front of an abstract impasto oil-paint background made of broad palette-knife strokes in teal, forest green, dark blue, olive, charcoal, and small ochre accents. The overall mood should be moody, luxurious, artistic, and editorial, blending photorealistic fashion photography with visible painterly texture. Keep exactly one human figure, no text, no logos, no jewelry emphasis, no extra props, and leave the face softly obscured or featureless so the focus is on silhouette, garment, color palette, and brushwork.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有油画质感的高级时装肖像，描绘一位优雅的女性，展现 {argument name="season vibe" default="冬季祖母绿氛围"} 的色调。采用 3:4 竖构图，腰部至膝盖的剪裁，戏剧性的影棚灯光。女性以优雅的重心偏移姿势站立，一只手放在腰间，身着飘逸的深 {argument name="dress color" default="祖母绿"} 高定礼服，礼服采用深 V 领口、包裹式上衣、多层褶皱设计、长款半透明雪纺袖，褶皱处带有微妙的金色高光。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深青黑色"} 头发齐肩，富有光泽，并向一侧微风拂动。背景为抽象的厚涂油画风格，由青色、森林绿、深蓝、橄榄绿、炭灰色和少量赭石色调的宽大调色刀笔触组成。整体氛围应充满情绪感、奢华、艺术且具有编辑感，将照片级真实的时尚摄影与可见的油画质感融为一体。画面中仅保留一个人像，无文字，无标志，不强调珠宝，无额外道具，面部保持柔和模糊或无特征，以确保视觉焦点集中在轮廓、服装、色调和笔触上。

templates.title: Glamorous Backless Gown Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 迷人露背礼服肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical high-fashion editorial portrait of a glamorous woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long auburn hair"} standing in a three-quarter back pose, looking over her shoulder, with her face intentionally covered by a flat opaque square censor block in a warm brown skin-tone color. She wears a dramatic {argument name="dress color" default="black"} evening gown with an open back, halter-style neckline, gathered draping at the waist and hip, and metallic {argument name="metallic accent color" default="gold"} fabric accents wrapping across the bodice and waist. Her hair flows to the left as if moved by a light breeze, and she has elegant jewelry including one dangling earring and one ring. Place her in front of a large abstract textured painting background with thick impasto brush strokes, palette-knife relief, and warm autumnal colors: ochre, bronze, gold, rust red, burnt orange, cream, taupe, and smoky brown. Use warm directional studio lighting from the upper left, soft shadows, realistic skin texture, glossy fabric highlights, and a luxurious gallery atmosphere. Frame from mid-thigh upward, centered slightly right, with the open back and silhouette emphasized. Photorealistic fashion photography, 4:5 vertical aspect ratio, rich contrast, painterly background, no visible text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直构图的高级时尚编辑肖像，主角是一位迷人的女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的红棕色长发"}，以四分之三背影姿态站立，回眸凝视，脸部被一个与肤色相近的暖棕色不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身着一件极具戏剧性的 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"} 露背晚礼服，采用挂脖式领口，腰部和臀部有褶皱垂坠设计，金属质感的 {argument name="metallic accent color" default="金色"} 面料装饰环绕胸前与腰间。她的秀发向左飘动，仿佛被微风拂过，佩戴着优雅的珠宝，包括一只垂坠耳环和一枚戒指。将她置于一幅巨大的抽象纹理画背景前，画作呈现厚重的厚涂笔触、调色刀浮雕效果，以及温暖的秋季色调：赭石色、青铜色、金色、铁锈红、焦橙色、奶油色、灰褐色和烟棕色。使用来自左上方的温暖定向影棚灯光，营造柔和阴影、逼真的皮肤质感、光泽面料高光以及奢华的画廊氛围。取景范围从大腿中部向上，构图略微偏右，强调露背设计与轮廓。照片级逼真的时尚摄影，4:5 垂直比例，丰富的对比度，绘画感背景，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anonymous Red Couture Portrait

templates.prompt: Create a vertical high-fashion editorial portrait of {argument name="subject" default="an elegant androgynous model"} posed from the waist up against a richly textured abstract impasto oil-painting backdrop. The color story is dominated by {argument name="main color palette" default="deep crimson, burgundy, black, muted brown, and touches of antique gold"}. The model has short glossy {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair, bare shoulders, and wears a dramatic sculptural {argument name="garment" default="voluminous off-shoulder red satin gown"} with oversized folded sleeves, heavy draped fabric, deep shadows, and a glossy couture sheen. The pose is three-quarter turned, one shoulder exposed, one arm gathered near the chest as if holding the fabric closed, with the gown sweeping diagonally across the frame. The face is intentionally anonymized by a large centered square blur/solid gradient mask covering the facial features, blending from dark near the hairline to warm skin tone below, while ears and hair remain partially visible. Background: thick palette-knife strokes and layered paint ridges in red, wine, umber, black, and metallic gold, expressive and tactile like an abstract expressionist canvas. Lighting is dramatic studio lighting from the upper left, emphasizing satin highlights, skin glow, and deep fabric folds. Composition is tight, luxurious, and painterly, with no text, no watermark, no jewelry, and no extra people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版的高级时装编辑风格肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位优雅的中性风模特"}，半身姿态，背景为质感丰富的抽象厚涂油画。色调以 {argument name="main color palette" default="深绯红、酒红、黑色、柔和棕色以及点缀的古董金"} 为主。模特留着短而有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，露出双肩，身着一件极具雕塑感的 {argument name="garment" default="蓬松的露肩红色缎面礼服"}，配有超大折叠袖口、厚重的垂坠面料，呈现出深邃的阴影和高级定制的光泽感。姿态为四分之三侧身，露出一侧肩膀，一只手臂收拢在胸前，仿佛在抓紧布料，礼服斜向横跨画面。面部通过一个位于中央的大型方形模糊/纯色渐变遮罩进行刻意匿名处理，遮盖了五官，从发际线附近的深色过渡到下方的暖肤色，同时保留部分耳朵和头发可见。背景：厚重的调色刀笔触和层叠的颜料纹理，包含红色、酒红色、赭石色、黑色和金属金色，具有抽象表现主义画布般的表现力和触感。灯光采用左上方的戏剧性影棚光，强调缎面的高光、皮肤的质感以及深邃的布料褶皱。构图紧凑、奢华且具有绘画感，画面中无文字、无水印、无首饰，且无其他人物。

templates.title: Cloudflare Catch-All Email Routing Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: Cloudflare Catch-All 邮件路由信息图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a landscape hand-drawn notebook-style Chinese infographic explaining how to register multiple ChatGPT accounts by using Cloudflare Email Routing to create catch-all mailbox aliases.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 whiteboard page, clean off-white background, surrounded by a thick black dashed rounded border. Use a casual marker-and-pen sketch style with slightly imperfect lines, doodle arrows, stars, question marks, pins, and small expressive icons.

Title and intro: At the top center, write the bold headline {argument name="headline text" default="注册 ChatGPT 第 N 个账号：用 Cloudflare 造邮箱（手绘笔记）"}. Underline “Cloudflare” in blue. Beneath it on the left, write the pain point line: “痛点：同个邮箱只能注册一个账号，换邮箱麻烦。” Add a small curved arrow doodle and star near the title.

Main layout: Use exactly 7 main content boxes/cards plus decorative doodles. Arrange them left-to-right as a process with bold black arrows connecting sections. The 7 cards are: 1 pain card, 1 solution card, 1 core-principle card, and 4 numbered step cards.

Card 1, pain card: A red outlined sticky-note box on the upper left with a sad red face icon. Text: “想注册新号？没新邮箱！” Make it look like a folded-corner note.

Card 2, solution card: A blue rounded rectangle in the upper middle with a blue cloud icon. Text: “解决方案：Cloudflare Email Routing（邮箱路由）”. Put a blue arrow pointing toward the core principle box.

Card 3, core principle card: A large black-outlined rounded rectangle in the upper right. Header text: “核心原理：Catch-all（通配符 / 捕获所有）”. Include a funnel icon. Show exactly 4 example incoming aliases on the left: “chatgpt@”, “netflix@”, “test1@”, and “任意前缀@”. Draw arrows from all four into a large “@” symbol and “@你的域名.com”, then a thick black arrow to a mailbox icon labeled “真实邮箱（如 Gmail）”. Bottom line with green check icon: “全部自动转发，统一汇总！无需提前创建。”

Step cards along the bottom: Use exactly 4 numbered boxes.

Step 1 card, bottom left: Title “第一步：准备工作”. Include exactly 3 numbered requirements: “1. Cloudflare 账号（免费注册）”, “2. 你的域名（DNS 托管在 CF）”, “3. 真实邮箱（接收转发）”. Add a globe icon, a green check mark, and a yellow key icon. Below it add small text: “域名推荐：性价比高（如 top域名）”.

Step 2 card, bottom center-left: Title “第二步：启用并验证目标邮箱”. Include a small computer icon labeled “CF 控制台”. Text flow: “添加域名 → 解析 → 激活”. Draw an arrow down to a mini DNS nameserver panel with two columns: left “阿里云（修改 NS）”, right “Cloudflare（等待生效，状态：活动）”. Beneath the card, draw a red circled nameserver list with exactly 2 entries: “gene.ns.cloudflare.com” and “peyton.ns.cloudflare.com”. Add a small clock icon and text “约30分钟”.

Step 3 card, bottom center-right: Title “第三步：设置邮件路由”. Show a mini Cloudflare UI mockup with exactly 2 top tabs/boxes: “Email（电子邮件）” and “Email Routing（路由）”. Include a small “Get Started” button pointing to “绑定目标地址（Destination address）”. At the bottom add an envelope icon and text: “验证邮件 → 点击确认”. Under this card place a small blue status note titled “测试转发成功” with two arrow lines showing an alias forwarding to a Gmail address.

Step 4 card, bottom right: Title “第四步：设置路由规则（核心步骤）”. Show a UI panel titled “Catch-all 规则设置”. Include a blue toggle switch labeled “Active（启用）”. Include a two-row table with headers and values: row 1 “Action（操作）” to “Send to（发送至）”; row 2 “Destination（目标）” to “你的真实邮箱”. Add a red star near the corner.

Final result box: At the bottom right below Step 4, add a green rounded rectangle with a smiling face icon. Text: “效果：注册时随意编造前缀（例如 chatgpt@yourdomain.com）邮件全部统一汇总到真实邮箱，实现「邮箱自由」！全程免费！”

Visual style: Handwritten Chinese typography, thick black marker outlines, simple vector doodles, blue/red/green/yellow accent colors, informal classroom note-taking feel. Keep all arrows bold and directional, with minor sketchy imperfections.

Constraints: Keep the entire infographic in Chinese as specified, use no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no watermark, no extra sections beyond the 7 cards and final result box, and make the text legible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张横版手绘笔记本风格的中文信息图，解释如何通过使用 Cloudflare Email Routing 创建 Catch-all 邮箱别名来注册多个 ChatGPT 账号。

画布：宽屏 16:9 白板页面，干净的米白色背景，周围环绕着粗黑色的虚线圆角边框。使用随意的马克笔手绘风格，线条略显不完美，配有涂鸦箭头、星星、问号、图钉和小型表情图标。

标题与简介：在顶部居中位置，书写加粗标题 {argument name="headline text" default="注册 ChatGPT 第 N 个账号：用 Cloudflare 造邮箱（手绘笔记）"}。用蓝色下划线标注“Cloudflare”。在其下方左侧，书写痛点文案：“痛点：同个邮箱只能注册一个账号，换邮箱麻烦。”在标题附近添加一个小巧的弯曲箭头涂鸦和星星。

整体布局：使用 7 个主要内容框/卡片，并辅以装饰性涂鸦。按从左到右的流程排列，并用粗黑色箭头连接各部分。这 7 个卡片分别是：1 个痛点卡片、1 个解决方案卡片、1 个核心原理卡片以及 4 个带编号的步骤卡片。

卡片 1（痛点卡片）：左上角一个红色轮廓的便利贴框，配有一个悲伤的红色表情图标。文字：“想注册新号？没新邮箱！”使其看起来像一张折角的便签。

卡片 2（解决方案卡片）：中上方一个蓝色圆角矩形，配有一个蓝色云朵图标。文字：“解决方案：Cloudflare Email Routing（邮箱路由）”。画一个蓝色箭头指向核心原理框。

卡片 3（核心原理卡片）：右上角一个黑色轮廓的大型圆角矩形。标题文字：“核心原理：Catch-all（通配符 / 捕获所有）”。包含一个漏斗图标。左侧展示 4 个示例传入别名：“chatgpt@”、“netflix@”、“test1@”以及“任意前缀@”。画出箭头从这四个别名指向一个巨大的“@”符号和“@你的域名.com”，然后画一条粗黑色箭头指向一个标注为“真实邮箱（如 Gmail）”的邮箱图标。底部配有绿色对勾图标的文案：“全部自动转发，统一汇总！无需提前创建。”

底部步骤卡片：使用 4 个带编号的方框。

步骤 1 卡片（左下）：标题“第一步：准备工作”。包含 3 个带编号的要求：“1. Cloudflare 账号（免费注册）”、“2. 你的域名（DNS 托管在 CF）”、“3. 真实邮箱（接收转发）”。添加一个地球图标、一个绿色对勾和一个黄色钥匙图标。下方添加小字：“域名推荐：性价比高（如 top 域名）”。

步骤 2 卡片（中左下）：标题“第二步：启用并验证目标邮箱”。包含一个标注为“CF 控制台”的小型电脑图标。流程文字：“添加域名 → 解析 → 激活”。画一个箭头指向下方的一个小型 DNS 名称服务器面板，分为两列：左侧“阿里云（修改 NS）”，右侧“Cloudflare（等待生效，状态：活动）”。在卡片下方，画一个红色圈出的名称服务器列表，包含 2 个条目：“gene.ns.cloudflare.com”和“peyton.ns.cloudflare.com”。添加一个小闹钟图标和文字“约 30 分钟”。

步骤 3 卡片（中右下）：标题“第三步：设置邮件路由”。展示一个小型 Cloudflare UI 模拟图，包含 2 个顶部标签/方框：“Email（电子邮件）”和“Email Routing（路由）”。包含一个指向“绑定目标地址（Destination address）”的小型“Get Started”按钮。底部添加一个信封图标和文字：“验证邮件 → 点击确认”。在此卡片下方放置一个蓝色状态备注，标题为“测试转发成功”，并用两条箭头线展示别名转发到 Gmail 地址的过程。

步骤 4 卡片（右下）：标题“第四步：设置路由规则（核心步骤）”。展示一个标题为“Catch-all 规则设置”的 UI 面板。包含一个标注为“Active（启用）”的蓝色开关。包含一个两行表格，带有表头和值：第一行“Action（操作）”对应“Send to（发送至）”；第二行“Destination（目标）”对应“你的真实邮箱”。在角落处添加一颗红星。

最终结果框：在右下角步骤 4 的下方，添加一个带有笑脸图标的绿色圆角矩形。文字：“效果：注册时随意编造前缀（例如 chatgpt@yourdomain.com）邮件全部统一汇总到真实邮箱，实现「邮箱自由」！全程免费！”

视觉风格：手写中文排版，粗黑色马克笔轮廓，简单的矢量涂鸦，蓝/红/绿/黄强调色，非正式的课堂笔记感。保持所有箭头加粗且具有指向性，带有轻微的手绘不完美感。

约束：整张信息图必须按要求使用中文，不使用照片级真实感，不使用 3D 渲染，不添加水印，不超出 7 个卡片和最终结果框的范畴，并确保文字清晰易读。

templates.title: Luxury Skincare Campaign Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华护肤品广告宣传

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a luxurious vertical beauty campaign advertisement for {argument name="brand name" default="popcraft.ai"}, styled like a high-end skincare editorial.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, warm cream and blush palette, soft diffused daylight, glossy reflective tabletop, elegant fashion-magazine lighting.

Layout: Place a glamorous young woman on the left half, seated at a vanity in front of sheer cream curtains. Her face is covered by a centered opaque soft-brown square censor block, while her long wavy brunette hair, bare shoulder, pearl-and-gold necklaces, dangling floral earrings, and champagne-pink satin robe remain visible. Place the product lineup across the lower center and right foreground on clear acrylic risers. Put the main headline and brand mark in the upper right.

Text content: Top right small orange icon plus brand text: {argument name="brand name" default="popcraft.ai"}. Large elegant serif headline in dusty rose: {argument name="headline text" default="RADIANCE REFINED. BEAUTY DEFINED."}. Below it, a small floral divider icon. Subheadline in spaced serif caps: {argument name="subheadline text" default="LUXURY SKINCARE, CRAFTED FOR YOU."}. Tiny supporting copy beneath: {argument name="supporting copy" default="Advanced Care. Timeless Glow. Unveil Your Most Radiant Skin."}.

Product details: Show exactly 6 visible skincare products, each with minimalist popcraft.ai branding and small orange logo: 1 low round gold cream jar at front left labeled “LA CRÈME”; 2 tall white squeeze tube with gold cap near center labeled “LA MOUSSE DOUCE NETTOYANTE”; 3 tall frosted ivory lotion bottle with rounded reflective gold cap labeled “LA LOTION”; 4 small low round gold jar at front center labeled “LE BAUME”; 5 tall reflective metallic gold serum bottle at right-center labeled “SÉRUM”; 6 oval clear-and-gold bottle at far right labeled “L’ESSENCE DE BEAUTÉ”. Add one small gold-and-white cosmetic spatula or applicator lying near the front.

Set dressing: Include blush-pink roses and cream flowers in the lower left and soft floral blur in the background right, strands of white pearls draped across the tabletop, a faceted crystal glass at lower left, transparent acrylic display blocks, and warm gold reflections.

Visual style: Ultra-polished photorealistic luxury skincare ad, shallow depth of field, creamy highlights, soft bokeh, rose-gold accents, refined feminine atmosphere, premium editorial beauty campaign aesthetic.

Constraints: Keep the composition clean and upscale, maintain exactly 6 main products, preserve readable headline hierarchy, avoid extra products or extra text, no harsh shadows, no clutter.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="popcraft.ai"} 创建一则奢华的竖版美妆广告，风格对标高端护肤品杂志大片。

画布：3:4 竖构图，暖奶油色与腮红粉色调，柔和的漫射日光，光泽感反射桌面，优雅的时尚杂志布光。

布局：将一位迷人的年轻女性置于左侧，坐在奶油色薄纱窗帘前的梳妆台旁。她的面部被居中的不透明柔棕色方块遮挡，但她长长的棕色波浪卷发、裸露的肩部、珍珠金饰项链、垂坠花朵耳环以及香槟粉色缎面长袍清晰可见。将产品系列陈列在右侧及下方的透明亚克力展示台上。主标题和品牌标识置于右上角。

文本内容：右上角为小型橙色图标及品牌文字：{argument name="brand name" default="popcraft.ai"}。右上角使用优雅的烟粉色大号衬线字体作为主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="RADIANCE REFINED. BEAUTY DEFINED."}。下方配有一个小型花卉分割图标。副标题采用字间距拉开的衬线大写字母：{argument name="subheadline text" default="LUXURY SKINCARE, CRAFTED FOR YOU."}。下方配有极小的辅助文案：{argument name="supporting copy" default="Advanced Care. Timeless Glow. Unveil Your Most Radiant Skin."}。

产品细节：展示 6 款清晰可见的护肤品，每款均带有极简的 popcraft.ai 品牌标识及小型橙色 Logo：1. 左前方一个矮圆金盖面霜罐，标签为“LA CRÈME”；2. 中心附近一支高挑白色挤压管，配金色瓶盖，标签为“LA MOUSSE DOUCE NETTOYANTE”；3. 一支高挑磨砂象牙白乳液瓶，配圆润反光金盖，标签为“LA LOTION”；4. 前方中心一个矮圆金盖小罐，标签为“LE BAUME”；5. 中右侧一支高挑反光金属金精华液瓶，标签为“SÉRUM”；6. 最右侧一个椭圆形透明金盖瓶，标签为“L’ESSENCE DE BEAUTÉ”。在前方放置一个小型金白相间的化妆抹刀或涂抹棒。

场景布置：左下方点缀腮红粉色玫瑰与奶油色花卉，右侧背景呈现柔和的花卉虚化效果，桌面上散落着一串珍珠，左下方放置一个多面切割水晶杯，使用透明亚克力展示块，并呈现温暖的金色反射光。

视觉风格：极致精美的写实风奢华护肤品广告，浅景深，奶油色高光，柔和的焦外成像，玫瑰金点缀，精致的女性化氛围，高端杂志美妆宣传美学。

约束条件：保持构图简洁高端，严格保留 6 款主要产品，维持清晰的标题层级，避免添加额外产品或多余文字，无生硬阴影，画面整洁。

templates.title: AI Cosplay Expo Logo Guide Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: AI Cosplay Expo 标志设计指南

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean black-and-white logo guide and usage sheet for {argument name="event name" default="AI COSPLAY EXPO 2026"}, presented as a professional brand identity document.

Canvas: Portrait A4-style page, white background, thin light-gray divider lines, generous margins, crisp monochrome vector look. Use bold futuristic techno sans-serif typography, all caps, high contrast black ink.

Header: Top-left title reads “AI COSPLAY EXPO 2026” with small subtitle “INTERNATIONAL EVENT” underneath. Top-right small label reads “LOGO GUIDE & USAGE SHEET”. A thin horizontal rule separates the header from the main content.

Core logo design: The symbol is a black silhouette of a cute anime-style twin-tail cosplay girl standing inside four broken corner brackets, with a small diamond sparkle below. Combine it with bold text “AI COSPLAY EXPO” and large stacked numerals “2026”, plus the small tagline “- INTERNATIONAL EVENT -” and credit line “produced by {argument name="producer name" default="AI lady collection"}”.

Layout: Divide the page into exactly 7 numbered brand-guide sections using small black square number badges and thin gray rules.

Sections:
1. “PRIMARY LOGO – HORIZONTAL”: large horizontal lockup. Symbol on the left, text on the right: “AI COSPLAY EXPO” above huge “2026”, tagline “- INTERNATIONAL EVENT -”, and credit “produced by AI lady collection”.
2. “STACKED LOGO”: vertical centered lockup. Symbol on top, “AI COSPLAY EXPO” stacked in three lines, large “2026”, tagline, and producer credit below.
3. “SYMBOL MARK”: standalone large silhouette symbol only.
4. “MONOCHROME VARIATIONS”: show exactly 4 logo variations: black horizontal logo, gray/outline horizontal logo, black stacked logo, gray/outline stacked logo.
5. “INVERTED (WHITE ON BLACK)”: black rectangle containing exactly 2 white reversed logos: one horizontal logo at top and one stacked logo below.
6. “CLEAR SPACE / MINIMUM SIZE”: left side shows the horizontal logo inside a dotted clear-space box with “A” spacing markers on the top, left, right, and bottom; right side shows exactly 2 minimum-size examples: “MINIMUM SIZE (PRINT)” with width label “25mm / 0.98 in”, and “MINIMUM SIZE (DIGITAL)” with width label “32px”.
7. “USAGE EXAMPLES”: show exactly 4 simple outline icons with labels: globe icon labeled “INTERNATIONAL APPAREL”, ticket icon labeled “EVENTS & TICKETING”, open book icon labeled “MAGAZINE & EDITORIAL”, and medal badge icon labeled “STAFF & EXHIBITOR”.

Footer: Bottom strip divided into three columns. Left column title “ORGANIZER TEXT EXAMPLES” with two Japanese-style text lines: “主催: AI lady collection” and “公式 SNS: AI lady collection”. Center column contains a small stacked version of the logo. Right column title “CREDIT LINE” with the line “produced by AI lady collection”.

Visual style: Minimal Swiss grid meets Japanese event-brand manual, precise alignment, thin gray separators, no color except black, white, and light gray. Make all text legible, sharp, and print-ready. Avoid extra sections, extra icons, watermarks, gradients, shadows, or decorative backgrounds.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="event name" default="AI COSPLAY EXPO 2026"} 创建一份简洁的黑白标志指南及使用手册，并以专业的品牌识别文档形式呈现。

画布：纵向 A4 页面，白色背景，细浅灰色分隔线，宽裕的页边距，呈现清晰的单色矢量风格。使用粗体未来感科技无衬线字体，全大写，高对比度黑色油墨。

页眉：左上角标题为“AI COSPLAY EXPO 2026”，下方附带小字副标题“INTERNATIONAL EVENT”。右上角小标签为“LOGO GUIDE & USAGE SHEET”。一条细水平线将页眉与主要内容分隔开。

核心标志设计：标志主体为一个可爱的动漫风格双马尾 Cosplay 女孩黑色剪影，置于四个断开的直角括号内，下方有一个小菱形闪光点。将其与粗体文字“AI COSPLAY EXPO”及巨大的堆叠数字“2026”组合，并加上小标语“- INTERNATIONAL EVENT -”和制作署名“produced by {argument name="producer name" default="AI lady collection"}”。

布局：使用黑色小方块数字标号和细灰色线条，将页面划分为 7 个编号的品牌指南板块。

板块：
1. “PRIMARY LOGO – HORIZONTAL”：大型水平组合。符号在左，文字在右：“AI COSPLAY EXPO”位于巨大的“2026”上方，标语“- INTERNATIONAL EVENT -”，以及制作署名“produced by AI lady collection”。

4. “MONOCHROME VARIATIONS”：展示 4 种标志变体：黑色水平标志、灰色/轮廓水平标志、黑色堆叠标志、灰色/轮廓堆叠标志。

templates.title: Blurred Esports Audience Crowd Shot

templates.prompt: Create a realistic candid event-photography image shot from within the seated audience at a dark indoor {argument name="event type" default="esports gaming tournament"}. Use a wide 16:9 landscape frame, cool blue and purple stage lighting, shallow depth of field, high ISO concert-photo atmosphere, and a large blurred LED screen glowing in the background. In the foreground are three main seated spectators: on the left, a young man in a plain white long-sleeve shirt with a black lanyard, relaxed posture, hands low in frame; in the center, a young woman with long dark wavy hair wearing a pale pink ribbed wrap-style knit top, seated with hands folded in her lap; on the right, a young man in a light gray sweatshirt turned slightly toward the stage and holding a smartphone or small camera. Behind them is a dense crowd of spectators, some standing, some cheering. Include exactly 3 visible inflatable cheering sticks: two long white sticks with red tips held upright near the center-left background, and one blue-and-white stick partly visible behind the right spectator. Add privacy anonymization: place exactly 8 soft-edged rectangular purple blur blocks over visible faces, varying in size and opacity, covering the left foreground man, the top-left background person, a small center-left background face, the center-back person in red plaid, the central woman, a small mid-right background face, a bald mid-right background face, and the right foreground man. Make the image feel like an accidental TV broadcast crowd shot at a lively tournament, with natural poses, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, and photorealistic lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的活动抓拍照片，拍摄视角位于黑暗室内 {argument name="event type" default="电竞游戏锦标赛"} 的观众席中。采用 16:9 宽屏构图，运用冷蓝色和紫色的舞台灯光，营造浅景深和高 ISO 的演唱会摄影氛围，背景中有一个发光的巨大模糊 LED 屏幕。前景中有三位主要观众：左侧是一位身穿纯白色长袖衬衫、佩戴黑色挂绳的年轻男子，姿态放松，双手位于画面下方；中间是一位留着深色长波浪卷发的年轻女子，身穿淡粉色罗纹裹身针织衫，双手交叠放在膝盖上；右侧是一位身穿浅灰色卫衣的年轻男子，身体微微转向舞台，手持智能手机或小型相机。他们身后是密集的观众群，有的站立，有的在欢呼。画面中需包含 3 根清晰可见的充气应援棒：左后方竖直拿着两根顶端为红色的白色长棒，右侧观众身后部分可见一根蓝白相间的应援棒。添加隐私匿名处理：在可见的面部上放置 8 个边缘柔和的紫色矩形模糊块，大小和不透明度各异，分别覆盖左前景男子、左后方上方人物、左后方中心的一张小脸、后方中心穿红格子衫的人、中间的女子、右后方中心的一张小脸、右后方中心的一位秃头人物，以及右前景男子。使图像呈现出电视转播中锦标赛现场抓拍的质感，动作自然，无可见文字、无 Logo、无水印，光影效果真实。

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an anime fantasy character design sheet for a young male “novice veteran” adventurer, combining modern streetwear with magical blue flame effects.

Main title and text: Top-left title reads “✦ Novice Veteran ✦” with the subtitle “新手老兵” underneath. Include a short Chinese flavor paragraph on the left about an adventurer from another world who can control ice fire and becomes a trusted companion. Add the Chinese section labels “正面”, “側面”, and “背面” above the three full-body views. Use small Chinese labels for detail callouts.

Character: Show {argument name="character name" default="Novice Veteran"}, a young adult male fantasy swordsman with {argument name="hair color" default="short spiky white hair with pale blue highlights"}, athletic slim build, pale skin, confident relaxed posture, and a deliberately blurred or obscured face. Outfit is {argument name="jacket color" default="bright cobalt-blue bomber jacket"} with subtle floral patterning, high collar, ribbed cuffs and hem, black shirt, black belt, fitted black trousers, and glossy black combat boots. Surround the character with {argument name="flame effect color" default="icy blue magical flames"} rising behind him.

Layout: Use exactly 3 full-body character views: 1 front view on the left-center holding a blue crystal sword downward in one hand with the other hand in his pocket, 1 side view in the center-right with one hand in his pocket, and 1 back view on the far right showing the jacket pattern and flame aura. Add 1 standalone sword illustration on the far left, vertical, labeled “騎士劍”. Add 5 circular color swatches under the color scheme label: white, pale sky blue, vivid blue, dark navy, and charcoal black.

Detail callouts: Place exactly 6 circular detail insets in the middle column: 1 hair detail from the back labeled “髮型細節”, 1 head/back collar detail labeled “頭部細節”, 1 collar detail labeled “領口細節”, 1 jacket floral texture close-up labeled “夾克紋理細節”, and 2 boot/leg design circles at the bottom labeled left foot and right foot with the heading “褲子設計（左右相同）”.

Weapon: The sword should be a long knightly crystal blade with silver guard, blue gemstone accents, and glowing translucent blue edges; show it once as a separate weapon and once held by the front-view character.

Visual style: High-quality anime concept art, crisp linework, polished cel shading, luminous blue gradients, refined fantasy game character sheet aesthetic, elegant but readable typography, no extra characters, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一份动漫奇幻角色设计设定集，主角为一位年轻的“新手老兵”冒险者，将现代街头服饰与魔法蓝焰效果相结合。

Keep the composition cropped horizontally like a social media comparison image, with the subject centered across both panels and the edit looking subtle and trustworthy for a profile photo. Use {argument name="image ratio" default="16:9 landscape"}, {argument name="setting" default="sunny beach boardwalk"}, and {argument name="edit goal" default="remove eyeglasses glare without changing the face"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的左右对比图，展示同一张户外人像，通过细白线分隔为两个垂直面板。主体为 {argument name="subject description" default="一位留着深色长卷发、身穿宽松白色亚麻沙滩衬衫、佩戴小金圈耳环和浅框眼镜的女性"}，在阳光明媚的沙滩木栈道上拍摄，取景范围为肩部以上，呈四分之三侧面。背景左侧可见海浪、淡蓝色天空、木质栏杆以及柔和模糊的棕榈树，具有浅景深和自然的暖色调日光。使用 2 个面板：左侧面板为原始人像，眼镜上有明显的反光/倒影遮挡眼睛；右侧面板为编辑后的版本，去除了反光，眼睛看起来自然，同时脸型、姿势、发型、服装、光影和背景保持不变。不要添加任何标签或说明文字。保留卷发、半透明白色织物、肤色和沙滩环境的照片级逼真质感。构图采用类似社交媒体对比图的横向裁剪，主体居中横跨两个面板，编辑效果应微妙且真实，适合作为头像。使用 {argument name="image ratio" default="16:9 横屏"}、{argument name="setting" default="阳光明媚的沙滩木栈道"} 以及 {argument name="edit goal" default="在不改变面部特征的前提下去除眼镜反光"}。

templates.title: Cafe Portrait Glare Removal Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆肖像反光去除对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt: Create a realistic side-by-side comparison image showing the same cafe portrait duplicated in two equal vertical panels, like a before-and-after social media demonstration for removing glasses glare while preserving identity. Canvas is a wide 16:9 image, approximately 1200×675, split exactly down the center by a thin vertical white divider. Both panels show one adult man seated at a cafe table by large windows, wearing a dark navy blazer over a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, arms resting forward, with short neatly styled black hair and warm medium skin tone. In both panels, place a large opaque tan square censorship block over the center of the face, covering the eyes, nose, and mouth while leaving hair, ears, jawline, neck, and clothing visible; use {argument name="face block color" default="muted tan brown"}. The left panel should subtly imply the original portrait with eyeglass frames and glare partly visible at the edges of the face block, while the right panel should show the cleaned version with no visible glasses glare and the same face shape, pose, hair, outfit, lighting, and background. Include exactly 2 portrait panels: left original and right edited. Include exactly 2 identical coffee cups, one near the bottom center of each panel, cream-colored ceramic with coffee inside. Include exactly 2 small green potted plants, one at the lower left of each panel. Background: bright cafe interior with black window frames, sunlit glass, soft green foliage outside, blurred street and building shapes, shallow depth of field, natural daylight, realistic photography. Style should be high-quality candid profile-photo realism, crisp subject details, soft bokeh background, no text labels, no watermark, no extra people, and no changes between the two panels except the suggested glasses-glare removal on the right. Use {argument name="subject outfit" default="dark navy blazer over a white T-shirt"}, {argument name="setting" default="sunlit cafe by large windows"}, and {argument name="comparison theme" default="glasses glare removal before and after"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的并排对比图，将同一张咖啡馆肖像复制在两个等大的垂直面板中，类似于社交媒体上展示去除眼镜反光同时保留个人特征的“前后对比”效果。画布为 16:9 的宽幅图像（约 1200×675），中间由一条细长的白色垂直分隔线精准平分。两个面板均展示一名坐在咖啡馆桌旁的成年男子，他身穿深蓝色西装外套，内搭纯白色圆领 T 恤，双臂前伸，留着整齐的黑色短发，肤色为暖色调中等肤色。在两个面板中，在面部中心放置一个巨大的不透明棕褐色遮挡块，遮住眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，同时露出头发、耳朵、下颌线、颈部和衣物；使用 {argument name="face block color" default="muted tan brown"}。左侧面板应隐约暗示原始肖像，在遮挡块边缘部分可见眼镜框和反光；右侧面板应显示处理后的版本，即无可见眼镜反光，且保持相同的脸型、姿势、发型、服装、光照和背景。包含 2 个肖像面板：左侧为原始图，右侧为编辑图。包含 2 个完全相同的咖啡杯，分别位于每个面板的底部中心，为奶油色陶瓷杯，内盛咖啡。包含 2 盆相同的小型绿色盆栽，分别位于每个面板的左下角。背景：明亮的咖啡馆内部，配有黑色窗框、阳光照射的玻璃、窗外柔和的绿色植物、模糊的街道和建筑轮廓，浅景深，自然日光，写实摄影风格。风格应为高质量的抓拍肖像写实感，主体细节清晰，背景虚化柔和，无文字标签，无水印，无多余人物，除右侧建议的眼镜反光去除外，两个面板之间无其他变化。使用 {argument name="subject outfit" default="dark navy blazer over a white T-shirt"}、{argument name="setting" default="sunlit cafe by large windows"} 以及 {argument name="comparison theme" default="glasses glare removal before and after"}。

templates.title: Glasses Glare Removal Portrait Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 眼镜反光去除人像拼图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean comparison collage showing four portrait-photo examples for eyeglasses glare removal, with each example displayed as a side-by-side before-and-after pair while preserving the same person, pose, clothing, lighting, and background.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 image, approximately 1200×675 px, white background, thin white gutters between panels, rounded photo corners, realistic profile-photo photography.

Layout: Arrange exactly 4 comparison groups in a 2×2 grid. Each group contains exactly 2 near-identical portrait photos placed left and right, for a total of exactly 8 portrait panels. The pairs are: 1) top-left pair: an East Asian woman in a gray blazer in an office setting with shelves and a monitor behind her; 2) top-right pair: a young Black man outdoors in a green park, wearing an olive overshirt over a white T-shirt; 3) bottom-left pair: an older white man with gray hair wearing a pale blue sweater in a warm home-library setting with bookshelves and a glowing lamp; 4) bottom-right pair: a woman with dark curly hair tied up, wearing a navy blouse with white dots, seated indoors near a window and a green plant, resting her hand near her chin.

Subject details: In the left image of each pair, show subtle eyeglasses glare or reflection over the eye area; in the right image of each pair, remove the glare so the eyes look natural and clear, without changing facial identity, expression, head position, skin tone, hairstyle, clothing, camera angle, or background. Use realistic shallow depth of field, natural color grading, soft professional portrait lighting, and profile-photo framing from chest or shoulders upward.

Privacy treatment: Cover the central face area of every portrait with a solid opaque rectangular censor block, matching the skin tone of that subject, so facial features are hidden. Use exactly 8 censor rectangles, one per portrait panel, centered over the face and extending from forehead to lower face. The blocks should be plain, without blur texture or text.

Constraints: No captions, no arrows, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements, no extra people, no decorative graphics. Keep the comparison pairs aligned and visually consistent, like a social-media demonstration image for {argument name="editing task" default="remove glasses glare"}. Use {argument name="image style" default="realistic professional portrait photography"}, {argument name="collage layout" default="four side-by-side before-and-after portrait pairs"}, {argument name="background color" default="white"}, and {argument name="privacy treatment" default="solid skin-tone face censor blocks"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个清晰的对比拼图，展示 4 个眼镜反光去除的人像照片示例。每个示例均以左右对比的形式呈现，并保持人物、姿势、服装、光照和背景的一致性。

画布：宽屏 16:9 图像，尺寸约为 1200×675 像素，白色背景，面板间设有细白色间隙，照片圆角，呈现逼真的头像摄影效果。

布局：将 4 组对比图排列成 2×2 的网格。每组包含 2 张近乎相同的人像照片（左侧和右侧），总计 8 个头像面板。这 4 组分别为：1) 左上：一位身穿灰色西装外套的东亚女性，背景为带有书架和显示器的办公环境；2) 右上：一位在绿色公园户外的年轻黑人男性，身穿橄榄色外套内搭白色 T 恤；3) 左下：一位留着灰发、身穿浅蓝色毛衣的年长白人男性，背景为带有书架和暖色台灯的温馨家庭图书馆；4) 右下：一位扎着深色卷发的女性，身穿海军蓝圆点衬衫，坐在窗边和绿植旁，手托下巴。

主体细节：每组的左侧图像需显示眼部区域轻微的眼镜反光或眩光；右侧图像需去除反光，使眼睛看起来自然清晰，且不得改变面部特征、表情、头部位置、肤色、发型、服装、拍摄角度或背景。使用逼真的浅景深、自然的色彩分级、柔和的专业人像光效，以及胸部或肩部以上的头像构图。

隐私处理：用与主体肤色一致的纯色不透明矩形遮挡块覆盖每张人像的中央面部区域，以隐藏面部特征。共使用 8 个遮挡矩形，每个头像面板一个，居中覆盖从额头到下颌的面部区域。遮挡块应为纯色，不带模糊纹理或文字。

约束条件：无说明文字、无箭头、无 Logo、无水印、无 UI 元素、无额外人物、无装饰性图形。保持对比组对齐且视觉统一，如同用于 {argument name="editing task" default="remove glasses glare"} 的社交媒体演示图。使用 {argument name="image style" default="realistic professional portrait photography"}、{argument name="collage layout" default="four side-by-side before-and-after portrait pairs"}、{argument name="background color" default="white"} 以及 {argument name="privacy treatment" default="solid skin-tone face censor blocks"}。

templates.title: Office Signage Dimension Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 办公室标识尺寸效果图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic interior wall signage mockup with measurement annotations for a reception/office entrance, showing recommended dimensions and spacing for a company sign.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, photorealistic architectural visualization, front-facing view with slight natural perspective. Use a warm modern palette: light beige wall panels, pale wood cabinet, black signage, black metal door grille, and wood slat ceiling.

Scene layout: Center the composition on a beige feature wall with a mounted sign. On the right, include a tall black vertical-slat door or gate occupying about one quarter of the image width. At the top right of the wall, add one small white CCTV security camera angled downward. At the top center, add one rectangular wall-mounted light fixture with a single warm downlight. At the bottom center, place one light-wood cabinet with two doors and exactly two round black knobs. Across the lower wall behind the sign, include a horizontal band of narrow vertical rectangular tiles. The ceiling at the very top should show warm brown wooden slats running diagonally.

Main sign content: Use raised matte-black 3D letters on the wall. The largest line reads {argument name="company logo text" default="Ryplix"}. Directly underneath, centered smaller text reads {argument name="company legal text" default="Infotech Pvt. Ltd."}. Below that, centered, display a large number {argument name="unit number" default="1210"}, with one thin horizontal line above it and one thin horizontal line below it. Keep all sign elements black with soft realistic shadows.

Measurement annotations: Add fine black dimension arrows, dashed guide lines, and small technical labels around the sign. Include exactly 10 visible measurement labels in the main wall area: “3.5 - 4 in” from the bottom of the light to the logo, “7 - 7.5 in” beside the logo height, “1.5 in” between the logo and legal text, “2.5 - 3 in” between legal text and the number, “4 - 4.5 in” beside the number height, “4 - 5 in” from the number to the cabinet-top tile area, “34 in” as a long horizontal width guide above the cabinet, plus two side gap labels “5 - 6 in” on the left and “5 - 6 in” on the right.

Left information panels: Add exactly three rounded white cards stacked vertically along the left side of the image. Card 1 title: “SIGNAGE SIZE (RECOMMENDED)”. It contains exactly three item groups separated by thin horizontal rules: “Ryplix” with “Width: 19-20 in” and “Height: 7-7.5 in”; “Infotech Pvt. Ltd.” with “Width: 14 in” and “Height: 1.75 in”; “1210” with “Width: 8.5-9 in” and “Height: 4-4.5 in”; then “Lines (Both)” with “Width: 10-11 in” and “Thickness: 6 mm”. Card 2 title: “SPACING (RECOMMENDED)”. It contains exactly four item groups separated by thin rules: “Light bottom to logo top” with “3.5 - 4 in”; “Logo to Infotech text” with “1.5 in”; “Infotech text to 1210” with “2.5 - 3 in”; “1210 to bottom (cabinet top)” with “4 - 5 in”. Card 3 is a small note card reading: “Note: All dimensions are approximate. Visual spacing may vary slightly on site.”

Visual style: Clean modern office design, natural lighting, realistic materials, subtle shadows, crisp legible typography, professional signage installation guide aesthetic. Use black sans-serif text for all labels and cards. The measurement lines should look like a design-spec overlay, not handwritten.

Constraints: Keep the image free of people and clutter. Do not add extra logos, extra cards, extra measurement labels, or additional decorative objects. Maintain accurate alignment: logo, legal text, unit number, light, and cabinet should all be centered on the same vertical axis.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个逼真的室内墙面标识效果图，为接待处/办公室入口提供测量标注，展示公司标识的推荐尺寸和间距。

画布：方形 1:1 图像，照片级建筑可视化，正面视角，带有轻微的自然透视感。采用温暖的现代色调：浅米色墙板、浅色木柜、黑色标识、黑色金属门格栅以及木条吊顶。

场景布局：构图中心为一面带有安装标识的米色背景墙。右侧包含一扇占据图像宽度约四分之一的黑色高竖条门或栅栏。在墙面右上角，添加一个向下倾斜的小型白色闭路电视监控摄像头。在顶部中央，添加一个矩形壁挂式灯具，带有一个温暖的向下射灯。在底部中央，放置一个浅色木柜，带有两扇门和两个圆形的黑色旋钮。在标识后方的墙面下部，包含一条横向的窄竖矩形瓷砖带。最顶部的天花板应显示呈对角线排列的暖棕色木条。

主要标识内容：墙面使用凸起的哑光黑色 3D 字母。最大的一行文字为 {argument name="company logo text" default="Ryplix"}。正下方居中显示较小的文字 {argument name="company legal text" default="Infotech Pvt. Ltd."}。在其下方居中显示大号数字 {argument name="unit number" default="1210"}，数字上下方各有一条细横线。保持所有标识元素为黑色，并带有柔和逼真的阴影。

测量标注：在标识周围添加精细的黑色尺寸箭头、虚线引导线和小型技术标签。在主墙面区域包含正好 10 个可见的测量标签：“3.5 - 4 in”为灯具底部到 Logo 的距离，“7 - 7.5 in”为 Logo 高度，“1.5 in”为 Logo 与法律文本之间的间距，“2.5 - 3 in”为法律文本与数字之间的间距，“4 - 4.5 in”为数字高度，“4 - 5 in”为数字到柜顶瓷砖区域的距离，“34 in”为柜子上方长横向宽度指南，外加两个侧边间距标签，左侧“5 - 6 in”和右侧“5 - 6 in”。

左侧信息面板：在图像左侧垂直堆叠三个圆角白色卡片。卡片 1 标题：“SIGNAGE SIZE (RECOMMENDED)”。包含三个由细横线分隔的项目组：“Ryplix”对应“Width: 19-20 in”和“Height: 7-7.5 in”；“Infotech Pvt. Ltd.”对应“Width: 14 in”和“Height: 1.75 in”；“1210”对应“Width: 8.5-9 in”和“Height: 4-4.5 in”；以及“Lines (Both)”对应“Width: 10-11 in”和“Thickness: 6 mm”。卡片 2 标题：“SPACING (RECOMMENDED)”。包含四个由细线分隔的项目组：“Light bottom to logo top”对应“3.5 - 4 in”；“Logo to Infotech text”对应“1.5 in”；“Infotech text to 1210”对应“2.5 - 3 in”；“1210 to bottom (cabinet top)”对应“4 - 5 in”。卡片 3 为一张小注释卡，内容为：“Note: All dimensions are approximate. Visual spacing may vary slightly on site.”

视觉风格：简洁的现代办公室设计，自然采光，逼真的材质，微妙的阴影，清晰易读的排版，专业的标识安装指南美学。所有标签和卡片均使用黑色无衬线字体。测量线应呈现为设计规格叠加层，而非手写风格。

约束条件：保持图像中没有人像和杂物。不要添加额外的 Logo、额外的卡片、额外的测量标签或额外的装饰性物体。保持精确对齐：Logo、法律文本、单元号、灯具和柜子都应在同一垂直轴线上居中。

templates.title: AI Model Architecture Comparison Poster

titleLocalized.zh: AI 模型架构对比海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical side-by-side comparison poster showing the same photorealistic architectural scene generated by two AI image models.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, approximately 768×1024 px, split horizontally into exactly 2 equal stacked panels with no visible border between them.

Layout: The top panel is labeled {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} in the upper-left corner. The bottom panel is labeled {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"} in the upper-left corner. Use very large white blocky stencil-style display lettering with a thin dark outline and subtle vertical stripe/engraved texture inside the letters. Text should sit over the sky and tree area, aligned left, with generous spacing.

Scene in both panels: A serene photorealistic modern luxury house in a forest clearing beside a calm pond. The house is a low, minimalist rectilinear villa with white and light concrete volumes, flat roofs, broad glass windows, and warm wood-toned interior accents. It has a one-story left wing with a covered terrace and slim posts, a central solid rectangular tower-like volume, and a two-story right wing with large windows. The building sits across the water in the midground, centered horizontally, surrounded by green grass, reeds, and dense woodland.

Top panel details: The house appears smaller and farther away, with more open pale blue sky visible above it. The pond fills the lower third with a clear reflection of the house and trees. Forest trees frame the left and right edges, including leafy branches hanging from the top corners. Lighting is soft daylight, calm and slightly airy.

Bottom panel details: The same house and pond are shown closer and larger, with stronger contrast and richer greenery. Tall tree trunks frame both sides, dense forest spans the background, and the water occupies the lower portion with ripples and reflections. The lighting is bright but natural, with a more polished architectural visualization look.

Visual style: High-end photorealistic architectural rendering, realistic reflections, natural daylight, crisp modern design, lush summer forest, calm water, no people, no vehicles, no extra logos or UI elements.

Constraints: Include exactly 2 stacked panels and exactly 2 visible text labels. Keep the text readable and spelled exactly as provided. Preserve the comparison-poster look while making both panels depict the same {argument name="architecture subject" default="modern white concrete villa by a forest pond"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张垂直并排对比海报，展示由两个 AI 图像模型生成的相同照片级真实感建筑场景。

画布：3:4 纵向构图，尺寸约为 768×1024 像素，水平分割为 2 个完全相等的堆叠面板，面板间无可见边框。

布局：顶部面板左上角标注 {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"}。底部面板左上角标注 {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}。使用非常大的白色块状模板风格显示字体，带有细深色轮廓，字母内部有微妙的垂直条纹/雕刻纹理。文字应位于天空和树木区域上方，左对齐，并留有充足的间距。

两个面板中的场景：宁静、照片级真实感的现代豪华住宅，位于平静池塘旁的森林空地上。住宅为低矮、极简的直线型别墅，采用白色和浅色混凝土体块、平屋顶、宽大的玻璃窗以及温暖的木质调室内装饰。左侧为单层侧翼，带有带顶棚的露台和细柱，中间为坚固的矩形塔状体块，右侧为带大窗户的双层侧翼。建筑位于中景的水面对面，水平居中，周围环绕着绿草、芦苇和茂密的林地。

顶部面板细节：住宅看起来更小、更远，上方可见更多开阔的淡蓝色天空。池塘占据下三分之一，清晰地倒映着住宅和树木。森林树木框住左右边缘，包括从顶部角落垂下的叶片枝条。光线为柔和的日光，平静且略显通透。

底部面板细节：展示了更近、更大的相同住宅和池塘，对比度更强，绿色植被更丰富。高大的树干框住两侧，茂密的森林覆盖背景，水面占据下部，带有涟漪和倒影。光线明亮但自然，呈现出更精致的建筑可视化效果。

视觉风格：高端照片级真实感建筑渲染，真实的倒影，自然日光，简洁的现代设计，郁郁葱葱的夏季森林，平静的水面，无人物，无车辆，无额外的 Logo 或 UI 元素。

约束：包含 2 个堆叠面板和 2 个可见文字标签。保持文字可读且拼写与提供的内容完全一致。在保持对比海报外观的同时，确保两个面板都描绘相同的 {argument name="architecture subject" default="modern white concrete villa by a forest pond"}。

templates.title: Two-Panel Snow Cabin Model Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 双面板雪景木屋模型对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical side-by-side model comparison poster showing the same snowy modern mountain cabin scene rendered in two stacked panels, with bold labels identifying each model.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 image, approximately 768×1024 px. Split the canvas horizontally into exactly 2 equal photographic panels with no thick border between them.

Layout:
- Panel 1, top half: snowy alpine landscape with a modern dark wooden A-frame cabin on a hill, evergreen trees, pastel winter sky, and one small hiker walking toward the cabin along a trail of footprints. Add a large label in the upper-left reading {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"}.
- Panel 2, bottom half: a very similar snowy alpine cabin scene from a slightly lower and closer perspective, with warmer sunset colors, denser foreground trees, one small hiker on a snowy path, and a large label in the upper-left reading {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}.

Counted visible elements:
- Exactly 2 stacked comparison panels.
- Exactly 2 large text labels: “Banana pro” on the top panel and “GPT image 2” on the bottom panel.
- Exactly 2 modern cabins, one per panel.
- Exactly 2 human figures, one per panel, both small and walking away from the viewer.
- Each panel should include many snow-covered evergreen trees, but keep the composition focused on the cabin and path.

Scene details: Both panels depict a winter evening in a snowy conifer forest. The cabin is contemporary, tall, angular, and steep-roofed, with dark vertical wood siding, warm glowing rectangular windows, a concrete or stone lower level, and a roof with dark solar-panel-like sections or skylights. The snow should show soft wind-shaped drifts and a clear trail of footprints leading from the foreground toward the hiker and cabin. The sky should be soft lavender, pink, and pale blue, suggesting dusk.

Typography: Use a large decorative blocky condensed serif or western-style display font, white fill with dark outline and subtle internal striping. Place the text flush near the top-left of each panel, large enough to dominate the corner without covering the cabin.

Visual style: Photorealistic architectural visualization, crisp winter detail, high dynamic range, warm window light contrasting with cold snow, cinematic dusk lighting. The top panel should feel slightly cleaner and more minimal with a pale lavender sky; the bottom panel should feel more dramatic and polished with stronger pink sunset clouds and richer contrast.

Constraints: Do not add logos, watermarks, extra captions, UI frames, or additional people. Keep the two-panel comparison structure obvious and preserve the exact label wording unless customized.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个垂直排列的对比海报，展示在两个堆叠面板中呈现的相同现代雪景山间木屋场景，并使用醒目的标签标注每个模型。

画布：3:4 纵向图像，约 768×1024 像素。将画布水平分割为 2 个完全相等的摄影面板，中间无粗边框。

布局：
- 面板 1（上半部分）：雪山景观，山坡上有一座现代深色木质 A 型木屋，周围有常青树，背景为柔和的冬日天空，一名徒步者沿着脚印小径走向木屋。在左上角添加一个大标签，内容为 {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"}。
- 面板 2（下半部分）：视角略低且更近的类似雪山木屋场景，色调为更温暖的日落色，前景树木更密集，有一名徒步者在雪路上，左上角添加一个大标签，内容为 {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}。

可见元素统计：
- 恰好 2 个堆叠的对比面板。
- 恰好 2 个大文本标签：顶部面板为“Banana pro”，底部面板为“GPT image 2”。
- 恰好 2 座现代木屋，每个面板一座。
- 恰好 2 个人物，每个面板一个，均为背对观察者的小型徒步者。
- 每个面板应包含许多积雪的常青树，但构图需聚焦于木屋和小径。

场景细节：两个面板均描绘了雪地针叶林中的冬日傍晚。木屋为现代风格，高大、棱角分明且屋顶陡峭，采用深色垂直木质外墙，带有温暖发光的长方形窗户、混凝土或石材底层，以及带有深色太阳能板状部分或天窗的屋顶。积雪应呈现出柔和的风蚀纹理，并有一条清晰的脚印小径从前景延伸至徒步者和木屋。天空应呈现柔和的淡紫色、粉色和浅蓝色，暗示黄昏时刻。

排版：使用大型装饰性块状压缩衬线字体或西式展示字体，白色填充，带有深色轮廓和微妙的内部条纹。将文本放置在每个面板左上角附近，大小需足以占据角落，且不遮挡木屋。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的建筑可视化，清晰的冬季细节，高动态范围，温暖的窗光与寒冷的积雪形成对比，电影般的黄昏光影。顶部面板应感觉更简洁、更极简，天空呈淡紫色；底部面板应感觉更具戏剧性和精致感，带有更强烈的粉色日落云彩和更丰富的对比度。

约束：不要添加徽标、水印、额外说明文字、UI 框架或额外人物。保持双面板对比结构清晰，并保留确切的标签措辞（除非已自定义）。

templates.title: Night Skyscraper AI Model Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: Night Skyscraper AI 模型对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a two-panel vertical comparison image showing the same futuristic skyscraper concept rendered by two different image models at night.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 aspect ratio, 768×1024 feel, split horizontally into exactly 2 equal stacked panels with no visible border line. Both panels show a dark blue nighttime cityscape with a starry sky and glowing urban lights.

Panel 1: Top half labeled {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} in large white blocky stencil/gothic display lettering at the upper left. Show a futuristic illuminated skyscraper centered in a dense city district, surrounded by mid-rise apartment towers, roads, trees, and a plaza. The tower has a tall twin-volume form with vertical ribbed glass, bright white outline lighting, warm lit windows, angular cutouts, and a glowing geometric base/plaza. Camera angle is elevated aerial view, looking slightly downward, crisp cinematic night lighting.

Panel 2: Bottom half labeled {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"} in the same large white blocky display lettering at the upper left. Show a similar but more refined futuristic skyscraper centered in a nighttime urban landscape, taller and sleeker, with stacked faceted glass sections, luminous vertical lines, bright white edge lighting, warm interior floors, and a glowing multi-level podium. Surround it with high-rise residential towers, tree-lined roads, intersections, and distant city lights. Camera angle is elevated aerial view, cinematic and realistic.

Visual style: Photorealistic architectural visualization, dramatic blue-black night palette, crisp high contrast, cool white neon accents, realistic city depth, subtle stars, polished glass reflections, high detail, no people visible.

Text content: Use exactly 2 visible text labels: {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} and {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}. Keep the typography large, white, angular, and slightly retro-futuristic.

Constraints: Include exactly 2 comparison panels, exactly 2 central skyscraper subjects, and exactly 2 large labels. Do not add logos, watermarks, captions, UI elements, arrows, or extra explanatory text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个垂直的双面板对比图，展示两个不同的图像模型在夜间渲染出的相同未来感摩天大楼概念。

画布：纵向 3:4 比例，768×1024 视觉感，水平平分为两个完全相等的堆叠面板，无可见边框线。两个面板均展示深蓝色的夜间城市景观，配有星空和闪烁的城市灯光。

面板 1：上半部分在左上角标注 {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"}，采用大型白色块状模板/哥特式展示字体。展示一座位于密集城市区域中心的未来感发光摩天大楼，周围环绕着中层公寓楼、道路、树木和广场。大楼呈高耸的双体结构，带有垂直肋状玻璃、明亮的白色轮廓灯、温暖的窗户灯光、棱角分明的切口以及发光的几何底座/广场。摄像机角度为高空俯视，略微向下，呈现清晰的电影级夜间照明。

面板 2：下半部分在左上角标注 {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}，采用同样的大型白色块状展示字体。展示一座相似但更精致的未来感摩天大楼，位于夜间城市景观中心，更高、更流畅，具有堆叠的切面玻璃部分、发光的垂直线条、明亮的白色边缘灯光、温暖的室内楼层以及发光的多层裙楼。周围环绕着高层住宅楼、林荫大道、交叉路口和远处的城市灯光。摄像机角度为高空俯视，具有电影感和真实感。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的建筑可视化，戏剧性的蓝黑色夜间色调，清晰的高对比度，冷白色霓虹灯点缀，真实的城市深度，微妙的星光，抛光玻璃反射，高细节，画面中无人。

文本内容：使用 2 个可见的文本标签：{argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} 和 {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}。字体保持大型、白色、棱角分明且略带复古未来感。

约束：包含 2 个对比面板，2 个中心摩天大楼主体，以及 2 个大标签。不要添加任何徽标、水印、标题、UI 元素、箭头或其他解释性文字。

templates.title: AI City Rendering Comparison Poster

titleLocalized.zh: AI 城市渲染对比海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical side-by-side comparison poster showing two AI-generated aerial city renderings, one above the other, for a visual model comparison between {argument name="top model label" default="Banana pro"} and {argument name="bottom model label" default="GPT image 2"}.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 image, approximately 768×1024 px. Split the canvas into exactly 2 equal horizontal panels with no border or margin between them.

Layout: The top panel fills the upper half and the bottom panel fills the lower half. Each panel shows a similar futuristic waterfront business district at blue-hour dusk from a high oblique aerial view. Place exactly 2 large text labels: the top label in the upper-left corner reading “Banana pro”, and the bottom label in the upper-left area of the lower panel reading “GPT image 2”. Use a tall, blocky, condensed white display font with a dark shadow or outline, similar to retro stencil/gaming typography.

Top panel scene: A polished architectural visualization of a modern urban development beside a river or bay. Include approximately 12 prominent glass office towers and mid-rise blocks arranged on a gridded campus, with glowing rooftop edges, landscaped green roofs, tree-lined roads, and warm street lighting. Show water along the top edge and lower-right edge, with distant city buildings beyond the water. Roads have orange and white light trails, creating a lively night-city effect.

Bottom panel scene: A second version of the same waterfront district, slightly darker and more dramatic, with approximately 14 prominent glass towers and mid-rise buildings. Use cooler blue glass reflections, brighter illuminated windows, stronger road-light trails, green rooftop gardens, and a river or bay curving along the top and lower-right edges. Make the composition visibly similar to the top panel but not identical, so it feels like two different AI model outputs from the same prompt.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed aerial architectural rendering, realistic but slightly idealized, cinematic dusk lighting, blue and teal shadows, warm golden streetlights, crisp glass facades, dense urban planning, marina/waterfront atmosphere, high contrast, sharp perspective, no people visible.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 stacked comparison panels and exactly 2 visible text labels. Keep the labels large, readable, and white with dark outline/shadow. Do not add logos, UI elements, watermarks, captions, or extra text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张垂直并排对比海报，展示两张 AI 生成的空中城市渲染图，上下排列，用于 {argument name="top model label" default="Banana pro"} 和 {argument name="bottom model label" default="GPT image 2"} 之间的视觉模型对比。

画布：3:4 纵向图像，约 768×1024 像素。将画布精确分割为 2 个相等的水平面板，面板之间无边框或间距。

布局：顶部面板填充上半部分，底部面板填充下半部分。每个面板均从高处斜向俯视视角，展示相似的未来派水岸商业区，时间设定为蓝调黄昏。放置 2 个醒目的大型文本标签：顶部标签位于左上角，内容为“Banana pro”；底部标签位于下方面板的左上区域，内容为“GPT image 2”。使用高大、方正、紧凑的白色显示字体，并带有深色阴影或描边，类似于复古模板或游戏排版。

顶部面板场景：河流或海湾旁现代城市开发的精致建筑可视化效果。包含约 12 座显眼的玻璃办公塔楼和中层建筑，排列在网格化园区内，具有发光的屋顶边缘、景观绿化屋顶、林荫道路和温暖的街灯。顶部边缘和右下边缘展示水域，水域外可见远处的城市建筑。道路上有橙色和白色的光轨，营造出活跃的夜城效果。

底部面板场景：同一水岸区域的第二个版本，色调稍暗且更具戏剧性，包含约 14 座显眼的玻璃塔楼和中层建筑。使用更冷冽的蓝色玻璃反射、更明亮的窗户照明、更强烈的道路光轨、绿色屋顶花园，以及沿顶部和右下边缘弯曲的河流或海湾。构图需与顶部面板明显相似但不完全相同，以体现来自同一提示词的两个不同 AI 模型输出。

视觉风格：超精细空中建筑渲染，写实但略带理想化，电影级黄昏光影，蓝色和青色阴影，温暖的金色街灯，清晰的玻璃幕墙，密集的城市规划，码头/水岸氛围，高对比度，锐利的透视，画面中无人。

约束：使用精确的 2 个堆叠对比面板和 2 个可见文本标签。标签需保持大而清晰，白色字体并带有深色描边/阴影。请勿添加任何徽标、UI 元素、水印、标题或额外文本。

templates.title: Imperial Marshal Anime Commander

titleLocalized.zh: 帝国元帅动漫指挥官

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime fantasy-military illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Marshal Berg"}, an imposing adult male commander standing in a low-angle hero shot. He has {argument name="hair color" default="long tousled blond hair"} blown by the wind, a stern aristocratic presence, and a face visible without obstruction. Dress him in a black imperial marshal uniform with a high structured collar, fitted black jacket, gold piping, ornate epaulettes with heavy fringe, medals, jeweled brooches, layered gold chains, tassels, leather gloves, a wide black belt with a decorative gold buckle, and a deep crimson cape lined in shadow. His right hand holds an ornate black pistol angled downward in the foreground; his other hand rests near his side with confident posture. The setting is a grand dark steampunk-fantasy empire at dusk, with stormy glowing clouds, ember sparks, gothic towers, iron railings, red banners, and a huge military flag bearing a gold winged crest and crown on the left. In the sky show exactly 5 visible flying war machines: 2 large zeppelin airships and 3 smaller aircraft silhouettes. Use cinematic backlighting from the cloudy sunset, strong rim light on the hair and shoulders, high contrast shadows, intricate gold details, dynamic wind, epic scale, ultra-detailed anime painting style, sharp composition, no text, no watermark, no facial censor block, no blur.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有戏剧张力的竖版动漫奇幻军事插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="伯格元帅 (Marshal Berg)"}，一位气势磅礴的成年男性指挥官，采用低角度英雄视角。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的长金发"}，随风飘动，神情严峻且具有贵族气质，面部清晰可见，无任何遮挡。为他穿上黑色帝国元帅制服，配有高立领、修身黑色夹克、金色滚边、带有厚重流苏的华丽肩章、勋章、宝石胸针、层叠的金链、流苏、皮手套、带有装饰性金扣的宽大黑色腰带，以及内衬阴影的深红色披风。他的右手在前景中持有一把向下倾斜的华丽黑色手枪；另一只手以自信的姿态垂在身侧。背景设定在黄昏时分宏伟的暗黑蒸汽朋克奇幻帝国，伴有风暴般的发光云层、余烬火花、哥特式塔楼、铁栏杆、红色旗帜，左侧悬挂着一面印有金色带翼徽章和皇冠的巨型军旗。天空中清晰可见 5 架飞行战争机器：2 艘大型齐柏林飞艇和 3 架小型飞行器剪影。运用多云日落的电影级逆光效果，头发和肩部有强烈的轮廓光，高对比度阴影，精致的金色细节，动态风感，史诗级比例，超精细动漫绘画风格，构图锐利，无文字，无水印，无面部遮挡，无模糊。

templates.title: Japanese Train Schoolgirl Phone Recording

titleLocalized.zh: 日本电车女学生手机录像画面

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical smartphone candid photo inside a busy Japanese commuter train, shot from standing passenger height with a wide-angle phone lens. The main subject is {argument name="character description" default="a Japanese high school girl with long straight black hair"} standing in the aisle, wearing a classic navy-and-white sailor school uniform: short-sleeve white cropped sailor blouse with navy collar and double white stripes, navy neckerchief, navy pleated skirt, white crew socks, and brown loafers. Her face is intentionally hidden by a centered soft-edged square pixel blur/mosaic censor block. She raises her left arm to hold one gray triangular overhead train strap and looks downward while holding a dark smartphone in her right hand. On her shoulder is {argument name="bag description" default="a navy rectangular school shoulder bag"} decorated with exactly 5 visible dangling character charms: a pink bunny plush, a small red mushroom-like mascot, a blonde anime girl doll, a black-haired anime boy doll, and a pink-and-blue pastel plush on the far right. Surround her with other commuters in white shirts and school uniforms, some standing and some seated, with their faces blurred; include train windows showing an urban city view outside, metal poles, fluorescent ceiling lights, Japanese ad posters above the windows, and many gray triangular hanging straps receding into the background. Add a realistic phone video recording overlay: white corner frame brackets, a red dot and “REC” at the top center, timer text {argument name="recording time" default="03:12"}, small phone status icons at the top corners, and a small sparkle icon near the bottom right. Lighting should be natural daylight mixed with train interior fluorescent light, highly realistic, slightly compressed social-media photo quality, candid documentary mood, no glamour posing, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的竖屏手机抓拍照片，场景位于繁忙的日本通勤电车内，以站立乘客的高度使用手机广角镜头拍摄。主体是 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着黑色长直发的日本女高中生"}，她站在过道中，身穿经典的蓝白水手校服：短袖白色短款水手衫，配有海军蓝领子和双白条纹、海军蓝领巾、海军蓝百褶裙、白色中筒袜以及棕色乐福鞋。她的脸部被一个居中的柔边方形像素马赛克遮挡。她抬起左手抓着一个灰色的三角形电车吊环，低头看着右手拿着的深色智能手机。她的肩上背着 {argument name="bag description" default="一个海军蓝长方形学生单肩包"}，包上挂着 5 个清晰可见的挂件：一个粉色兔子毛绒玩具、一个小红蘑菇吉祥物、一个金发动漫女孩玩偶、一个黑发动漫男孩玩偶，以及最右侧的一个粉蓝配色柔和色调毛绒挂件。周围环绕着其他身穿白衬衫和校服的通勤者，部分站立，部分就座，他们的脸部均已模糊处理；画面包含显示城市景观的电车窗户、金属立柱、天花板荧光灯、窗上方的日本广告海报，以及向背景延伸的许多灰色三角形吊环。添加逼真的手机视频录制叠加层：白色边角框、顶部中央的红点和“REC”字样、计时器文本 {argument name="recording time" default="03:12"}、顶部角落的小型手机状态图标，以及右下角的一个小闪光图标。光线应为自然日光与电车内部荧光灯的混合，高度逼真，呈现轻微压缩的社交媒体照片质感，具有纪实抓拍氛围，无摆拍感，无水印。

templates.title: Moonlit Palace Dancer Duel

titleLocalized.zh: 月宫舞者对决

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical anime fantasy action illustration of exactly two masked female dancers/martial artists performing a dramatic synchronized pose in a moonlit palace courtyard. The first character, {argument name="upper dancer hair color" default="long flowing pastel pink hair"}, is elevated diagonally across the upper half of the image with one leg extended high toward the top-left corner, wearing a translucent white harem-dancer outfit with gauzy veils, gold chains, jeweled anklets, bare feet, pale fabric layers, and a delicate face veil; her expression is calm and confident with bright green eyes. The second character, {argument name="lower dancer hair color" default="black-and-white hair with red streaks in twin buns"}, crouches low in the foreground in a dynamic hand-to-ground fighting stance, wearing a dark red and black translucent harem outfit with gold jewelry, arm bands, ankle ornaments, bare feet, and a matching face veil; she has sharp green eyes and an intense gaze. Set them in an ornate domed palace at night under a bright full moon in the upper-right sky, with warm glowing windows, arched architecture, and a glossy reflective wet stone floor. Surround the characters with swirling ribbons of light, transparent silk trails, sparkling particles, rose-petal fragments, and a circular magical calligraphy spell effect on the right side containing black brush-like glyphs. Use a cinematic low-angle composition with strong diagonal motion, flowing hair and fabric, high-detail jewelry, dramatic rim lighting, soft moonlight, warm palace highlights, reflections on the ground, shallow depth of field, and an ultra-polished Japanese anime illustration style. The image should feel elegant, sensual, magical, and action-packed, with no modern objects, no watermark, and no readable English text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅细节极其丰富的竖版动漫奇幻动作插画，画面中正好有两位戴着面具的女性舞者/武术家，在月光下的宫殿庭院中进行充满戏剧性的同步动作。第一位角色，{argument name="upper dancer hair color" default="长发飘飘的淡粉色头发"}，位于画面上半部分，呈对角线姿态，一条腿向左上角高高伸展，身穿半透明的白色后宫舞者服装，配有薄纱面纱、金链、珠宝脚链、赤足、浅色布料层叠以及精致的面纱；她表情冷静自信，拥有一双明亮的绿色眼睛。第二位角色，{argument name="lower dancer hair color" default="黑白双色头发，带有红色挑染的双丸子头"}，在前景中以动态的手撑地战斗姿态低蹲，身穿深红色和黑色的半透明后宫服装，配有金饰、臂环、脚踝装饰、赤足以及配套的面纱；她有着锐利的绿色眼睛和强烈的凝视感。背景设定在夜晚一座华丽的圆顶宫殿中，右上方的天空中挂着一轮明亮的满月，窗户透出温暖的光芒，配有拱形建筑和光泽感十足的湿润石质地面。在角色周围环绕着旋转的光带、透明的丝绸拖尾、闪烁的微粒、玫瑰花瓣碎片，以及右侧一个包含黑色毛笔字迹的圆形魔法书法咒语效果。采用电影感的低角度构图，强调强烈的对角线运动感、飘逸的头发和布料、高细节的珠宝、戏剧性的轮廓光、柔和的月光、温暖的宫殿高光、地面的倒影、浅景深，以及极其精致的日式动漫插画风格。画面应呈现出优雅、感性、充满魔法和动作张力的氛围，禁止出现任何现代物品、水印或可辨认的英文字符。

templates.title: Abstract Aqua Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 抽象水色动漫海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 abstract anime illustration on an almost white background with lots of negative space. Show a dynamic, partially cropped futuristic anime girl or character fragment in translucent aqua and teal linework, tilted diagonally from upper left to lower right, with flowing cyan hair-like strands on the left, a glossy triangular turquoise glass-like form extending to the right, and a small white angular collar or garment shape near the lower center. Add bright yellow paint splashes and loose calligraphic strokes bursting from the upper-left side of the head, with thin cyan swoosh lines arcing around the top and left edges. Place one large centered square overlay in front of the character, covering the face and torso; the square should have a soft pastel gradient from pale yellow-green at the upper left to mint and light cyan at the lower right, with clean sharp edges and no text. Use an airy high-key color palette of {argument name="main color" default="aqua teal"}, {argument name="accent color" default="bright yellow"}, white, and pale mint, with glossy highlights, sketchy anime line art, watercolor-like transparency, and energetic modern composition. Keep the image text-free, borderless, and poster-like.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 的竖版抽象动漫插画，背景接近纯白，留有大量负空间。画面展示一个动态的、局部裁剪的未来感动漫少女或角色碎片，采用半透明的水绿色和青色线条勾勒，从左上角向右下角倾斜。左侧带有流动的青色发丝状线条，右侧延伸出一个光泽感十足的三角形绿松石色玻璃状形态，下方中央有一个白色的小型棱角领口或服饰形状。在头部左上方添加亮黄色泼墨和随性的书法笔触，顶部和左侧边缘环绕着细长的青色弧线。在角色前方放置一个居中的大方形叠加层，遮盖面部和躯干；该方形应呈现从左上角的淡黄绿色到右下角的薄荷色及浅青色的柔和渐变，边缘清晰锐利，且不含任何文字。采用轻盈的高调配色方案，包含 {argument name="main color" default="aqua teal"}、{argument name="accent color" default="bright yellow"}、白色和淡薄荷色，并结合光泽高光、素描感动漫线条、水彩般的透明感以及充满活力的现代构图。保持图像无文字、无边框，呈现海报质感。

templates.title: Voxel Goblin Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 体素哥布林战士

templates.prompt: Create a high-quality voxel art 3D render of a single fantasy goblin warrior character, centered on a clean off-white studio background. The character is built entirely from visible cube blocks in a Minecraft-like voxel style, with crisp grid-aligned geometry, soft ambient occlusion, and subtle studio shadows under the feet. Show the goblin in a three-quarter front view, standing upright with a slightly hunched, mischievous posture. The goblin has {argument name="skin color" default="olive green"} skin, a large square head, long pointed ears extending horizontally, dark heavy brow ridges, narrow yellow eyes, a protruding tan blocky nose, two small lower tusks, and a stern grumpy expression. Outfit details: a dark brown sleeveless vest, a brown ragged loincloth skirt, a simple belt with tan hanging strips, wrist wraps, ankle wraps, and a small bone or tooth pendant necklace. The left hand grips one large crude wooden club made of stacked brown voxel blocks, held upright beside the body; the right hand hangs open in a curled blocky claw shape. Use earthy colors, realistic voxel lighting, bevel-free cubic forms, detailed layered block construction, and a polished game-character collectible render look. No text, no watermark, no extra characters, no environment props beyond the ground shadow.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高质量的体素艺术 3D 渲染图，展示一个奇幻哥布林战士角色，主体置于干净的灰白色摄影棚背景中心。角色完全由可见的立方体块构成，呈现类似 Minecraft 的体素风格，具有清晰的网格对齐几何结构、柔和的环境光遮蔽，以及脚下微妙的摄影棚阴影。以四分之三正面视角展示哥布林，保持直立姿态，略微驼背，神情顽皮。哥布林拥有 {argument name="skin color" default="橄榄绿"} 的皮肤、巨大的方形头部、水平伸出的长尖耳、浓重的深色眉骨、狭长的黄色眼睛、突出的棕褐色块状鼻子、两颗下獠牙，以及严肃而暴躁的表情。服装细节：深棕色无袖背心、棕色破旧缠腰裙、带有棕褐色垂挂带的简单腰带、腕带、踝带，以及一条带有小骨头或牙齿吊坠的项链。左手握着一根由堆叠的棕色体素块制成的粗糙木棒，竖直握在身体一侧；右手自然下垂，呈蜷曲的块状爪形。使用大地色系、逼真的体素光影、无倒角的立方体形态、精细的层叠块状结构，呈现出精致的游戏角色收藏品渲染效果。无文字，无水印，无额外字符，除地面阴影外不包含任何环境道具。

templates.title: Manga Male Hairstyle Reference Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 漫画男性发型参考图

templates.prompt: Create a black-and-white anime hairstyle reference sheet for a male character, drawn as clean simple manga line art on a plain white background. Arrange exactly 6 bust-view head drawings in a 3-column by 2-row grid, evenly spaced, all wearing the same high-collar jacket. The character has {argument name="hair style" default="short messy layered hair with a center-split fringe and soft outward spikes"}; keep the face area intentionally hidden by a flat light-gray rectangular censor block in the first 5 views, while the 6th view shows the back of the head with no face visible. Include these 6 discrete views: 1) front view with symmetrical bangs and both ears partly visible, 2) three-quarter front view facing left with one ear visible and layered side hair, 3) right side profile with long sweeping bangs covering the forehead and an ear visible, 4) slightly lower front view with collar opened and hair framing both sides, 5) three-quarter front view facing right with messy fringe and one ear visible, 6) rear view showing the back silhouette, nape layers, and crown hair flow. Use thin expressive black sketch lines, minimal shading, no color, no labels, no text, no decorative background, no facial features visible, and keep the sheet useful as a simple drawing-practice reference.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑白动漫发型参考图，用于男性角色，采用简洁明快的漫画线条风格，背景为纯白色。将 6 个半身头部绘图排列成 3 列 2 行的网格，间距均匀，所有角色均穿着相同的高领夹克。角色发型为 {argument name="hair style" default="短款凌乱层次感发型，中分刘海，带有柔和的外翘发束"}；前 5 个视图中，脸部区域需用浅灰色矩形遮挡块刻意隐藏，第 6 个视图展示后脑勺，不显示脸部。包含以下 6 个独立视图：1) 正面视图，刘海对称，双耳部分可见；2) 左侧 45 度正面视图，可见一只耳朵及侧面层次感发丝；3) 右侧侧面视图，长刘海遮住额头，可见一只耳朵；4) 略微俯视的正面视图，衣领敞开，头发修饰两侧；5) 右侧 45 度正面视图，凌乱刘海，可见一只耳朵；6) 背面视图，展示后脑轮廓、颈部层次及头顶发流。使用纤细且富有表现力的黑色草图线条，极简阴影，无颜色，无标签，无文字，无装饰性背景，不显示面部特征，确保该图表作为简单的绘画练习参考非常实用。

templates.title: Japanese Kids Sports Class Flyer

titleLocalized.zh: 日本小学生体育课程宣传单

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bright, professional Japanese promotional flyer for a sponsor-supported elementary school sports class, using a cheerful children’s sports-clinic theme.

Canvas: Vertical A4 flyer, 3:4 aspect ratio, white background with rounded colorful corner swooshes in blue, orange, and green. Add playful confetti, stars, dots, circles, motion lines, and small sports icons throughout. Keep the design clean, print-ready, and family friendly.

Main branding: At the top center, place a circular sports-class logo with running and jumping child silhouettes, soccer ball and basketball icons, and the Japanese logo text {argument name="event logo text" default="小学生のスポーツ教室"}. Under it, add small text “supported by” and the Lovart logo in blue and green. Use the Lovart logo again near the bottom right with “supported by” above it.

Headline area: Large bold Japanese headline across the upper middle: {argument name="main headline text" default="小学生のスポーツ教室"}. Use thick rounded lettering with white outline and soft shadow; color the words blue, orange, and green. Beneath it, add the subheadline {argument name="subheadline text" default="理学療法士がチェック！"} in blue with small green accent lines.

Main layout: Divide the central area into a 2-by-2 dotted grid containing exactly 4 illustrated child activity check sections:
1. Posture check, upper left: a boy in blue sportswear standing in side profile, with a green label {argument name="posture label" default="姿勢チェック"} and text “まっすぐ立てているかな?” Add a vertical green dotted measuring line beside him.
2. Strength check, upper right: a smiling boy in orange shirt and shorts doing a squat or reaching pose, orange label “筋力チェック,” and text “力強く動けるかな?”
3. Flexibility check, lower left: a smiling girl in green shirt stretching forward while seated, green label “柔軟性チェック,” and text “体はやわらかいかな?”
4. Balance check, lower right: a smiling boy in blue shirt balancing on one leg with arms out, blue label “バランスチェック,” and text “バランスはしっかりとれているかな?”
Use soft pastel oval background shapes behind each child and a colorful flat vector illustration style.

Bottom information cards: Below the activity grid, place exactly 4 rounded rectangular summary cards in a row, each with a colored checkmark icon and bold Japanese title:
1. Green card: “姿勢,” smaller text “正しい姿勢をチェック.”
2. Orange card: “筋力,” smaller text “体の筋力をチェック.”
3. Green card: “柔軟性,” smaller text “体の柔らかさをチェック.”
4. Blue card: “バランス,” smaller text “バランス感覚をチェック.”

Event info row: Add exactly 3 rounded information boxes beneath the summary cards:
1. Blue people icon, label “対象,” value “小学生低学年〜高学年.”
2. Orange calendar icon, label “日時,” followed by four empty circle placeholders.
3. Green map-pin icon, label “場所,” followed by four empty circle placeholders.

Bottom CTA: Add a wide blue ribbon banner with a yellow star on the left and the Japanese slogan {argument name="bottom slogan text" default="運動パフォーマンスを向上させよう！"}; emphasize “向上” in yellow. At the very bottom left, add a blue rounded contact button with a white phone icon and “お問い合わせ,” followed by four empty circle placeholders.

Visual style: Modern Japanese children’s event flyer, high-quality vector graphics, vibrant blue/orange/green palette, rounded typography, crisp spacing, light shadows, playful but organized. Avoid photorealism, avoid clutter, no extra people beyond the 4 children in the activity grid, no extra cards beyond the specified counts.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张明亮、专业的日本宣传单，用于赞助商支持的小学体育课程，采用活泼的儿童体育训练营主题。

画布：竖版 A4 宣传单，3:4 宽高比，白色背景，配有蓝色、橙色和绿色的圆角彩色装饰条。在画面中添加俏皮的五彩纸屑、星星、圆点、圆圈、运动线条和小型运动图标。保持设计简洁、适合打印且适合家庭阅读。

主要品牌标识：在顶部中心放置一个圆形体育课程 Logo，包含奔跑和跳跃的儿童剪影、足球和篮球图标，以及日语 Logo 文字 {argument name="event logo text" default="小学生のスポーツ教室"}。在其下方添加小字“supported by”以及蓝绿色的 Lovart Logo。在右下角附近再次使用 Lovart Logo，上方标注“supported by”。

标题区域：中部上方放置醒目的大号日语标题：{argument name="main headline text" default="小学生のスポーツ教室"}。使用带有白色描边和柔和阴影的粗体圆角字体；文字颜色采用蓝色、橙色和绿色。下方添加副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="理学療法士がチェック！"}，颜色为蓝色，并配有绿色小装饰线。

主要布局：将中心区域划分为 2x2 的虚线网格，包含 4 个儿童活动检查板块：
1. 姿势检查（左上）：一名身穿蓝色运动服的男孩侧身站立，配有绿色标签 {argument name="posture label" default="姿勢チェック"} 和文字“まっすぐ立てているかな?”。旁边添加一条垂直的绿色虚线测量线。
2. 力量检查（右上）：一名身穿橙色上衣和短裤的微笑男孩在做深蹲或伸展动作，配有橙色标签“筋力チェック”和文字“力強く動けるかな?”。
3. 柔韧性检查（左下）：一名身穿绿色上衣的微笑女孩坐着向前伸展，配有绿色标签“柔軟性チェック”和文字“体はやわらかいかな?”。
4. 平衡检查（右下）：一名身穿蓝色上衣的微笑男孩单脚站立并张开双臂，配有蓝色标签“バランスチェック”和文字“バランスはしっかりとれているかな?”。
在每个儿童形象后使用柔和的淡色椭圆形背景，采用色彩鲜艳的扁平矢量插画风格。

底部信息卡片：在活动网格下方，横向排列 4 张圆角矩形摘要卡片，每张卡片配有一个彩色对勾图标和粗体日语标题：
1. 绿色卡片：“姿勢”，小字“正しい姿勢をチェック”。
2. 橙色卡片：“筋力”，小字“体の筋力をチェック”。
3. 绿色卡片：“柔軟性”，小字“体の柔らかさをチェック”。
4. 蓝色卡片：“バランス”，小字“バランス感覚をチェック”。

活动信息行：在摘要卡片下方添加 3 个圆角信息框：
1. 蓝色人物图标，标签“対象”，内容“小学生低学年〜高学年”。
2. 橙色日历图标，标签“日時”，后跟 4 个空心圆占位符。
3. 绿色地图定位图标，标签“場所”，后跟 4 个空心圆占位符。

底部行动号召（CTA）：添加一条宽大的蓝色丝带横幅，左侧带有一颗黄色星星，并写有日语口号 {argument name="bottom slogan text" default="運動パフォーマンスを向上させよう！"}；将“向上”二字用黄色强调。在最左下角添加一个蓝色圆角联系按钮，配有白色电话图标和“お問い合わせ”，后跟 4 个空心圆占位符。

视觉风格：现代日本儿童活动宣传单，高质量矢量图形，充满活力的蓝/橙/绿配色，圆角字体，间距清晰，轻微阴影，活泼且井然有序。避免照片级写实，避免杂乱，除活动网格中的 4 名儿童外不添加额外人物，不添加超出指定数量的卡片。

templates.title: Japanese Sports School Flyer Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 日本体育学校宣传单照片

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 3:4 photorealistic Japanese promotional flyer image with a clean editorial fashion-ad feel. Show a young Japanese woman, about 20s, wearing a plain white short-sleeve T-shirt tucked into high-waisted off-white linen pants with a tied waist belt, standing against a warm pale cream wall in soft direct sunlight. She is framed from upper thighs to head, positioned slightly right of center, looking calmly and confidently down toward the camera with a relaxed expression, natural glossy skin, subtle makeup, loose dark hair tied back with wispy strands around her face. She holds a white booklet vertically against her chest with both hands; include one thin ring on a finger. On the left side of the image, place the headline text 「理学療法士がサポート」 in an elegant Japanese Mincho-style serif font, with 「理学療法士」 in blue, 「が」 in green, and 「サポート」 in orange. The booklet cover should have a cheerful sports-school logo design with the main Japanese text 「高校生のスポーツ教室」 in playful rounded lettering, blue/orange/green colors, plus the Lovart logo text near the bottom. Count exactly 5 prominent sports-themed graphic elements on the booklet: 1 blue running silhouette on the left, 1 orange running silhouette on the right, 1 blue-and-white soccer ball near the lower left, 1 orange basketball near the lower right, and 1 circular swoosh arc wrapping around the title. Add small decorative stars and dots around the logo, but keep them secondary. Use a bright airy color palette, realistic shadows on the wall, shallow depth of field, premium commercial photography, crisp booklet print, no watermark, no extra text beyond the specified Japanese copy and Lovart branding. Customize the visible sponsor brand as {argument name="sponsor brand" default="Lovart"}, the booklet title as {argument name="booklet title" default="高校生のスポーツ教室"}, the left headline as {argument name="headline text" default="理学療法士がサポート"}, the target audience as {argument name="target audience" default="high school students"}, and the model outfit color as {argument name="model outfit color" default="white and off-white"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 3:4 竖版、照片级真实感的日本宣传单图像，呈现干净的编辑时尚广告质感。画面中是一位 20 岁左右的年轻日本女性，身穿纯白色短袖 T 恤，下摆束进高腰米白色亚麻长裤中，腰间系有腰带，站在温暖的淡奶油色墙面前，沐浴在柔和的直射阳光下。构图从大腿上部到头部，她位于画面中心偏右，神情从容自信地向下看向镜头，表情放松，皮肤自然有光泽，妆容清淡，深色长发扎起，脸颊两侧留有几缕碎发。她双手将一本白色手册垂直抱在胸前；手指上戴着一枚细戒指。在图像左侧，放置标题文字「理学療法士がサポート」，使用优雅的日本明朝体衬线字体，其中「理学療法士」为蓝色，「が」为绿色，「サポート」为橙色。手册封面应包含一个活泼的体育学校标志设计，主标题文字「高校生のスポーツ教室」采用俏皮的圆体字，配色为蓝、橙、绿色，底部印有 Lovart 品牌文字。手册上需包含 5 个醒目的体育主题图形元素：左侧 1 个蓝色跑步剪影，右侧 1 个橙色跑步剪影，左下方 1 个蓝白相间的足球，右下方 1 个橙色篮球，以及环绕标题的 1 个圆形弧线。在标志周围添加少量装饰性星星和圆点，但保持其次要地位。使用明亮通透的色调，墙面投射出真实的阴影，浅景深效果，高端商业摄影质感，手册印刷清晰，无水印，除指定的日文文案和 Lovart 品牌外，不包含任何额外文字。自定义可见赞助商品牌为 {argument name="sponsor brand" default="Lovart"}，手册标题为 {argument name="booklet title" default="高校生のスポーツ教室"}，左侧标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="理学療法士がサポート"}，目标受众为 {argument name="target audience" default="high school students"}，模特服装颜色为 {argument name="model outfit color" default="white and off-white"}。
