templates.title: Museum Papercraft Anime Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 博物馆纸艺动漫肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical museum-gallery scene showing {argument name="character name" default="an original anime-style girl"} as an ultra-detailed three-dimensional paper craft artwork bursting out from a large white shadow-box frame mounted on a wall. The artwork is a single oversized framed portrait: 1 young girl figure, 1 deep rectangular white frame, 1 small museum visitor standing at the lower right for scale, and 1 plain square privacy-like block covering the center of the girl’s face. The girl has {argument name="hair color" default="soft ash-brown"} long wavy hair made from layered cut paper strips, delicate anime proportions, a sleeveless cream dress with many folded paper ruffles, a pale blue ribbon tie, and a small bracelet. Surround her with intricate paper flowers, translucent petals, pale blue leaves, curling ribbon strips, and layered floral cutouts that extend beyond the frame, creating the feeling that the paper artwork is coming alive and spilling into the room. Use {argument name="accent color" default="pale sky blue"} accents among mostly ivory, beige, cream, and light blush tones. The setting is a quiet contemporary art museum with a high wall, wooden floor, soft natural sunlight from an upper-right skylight, long shadows, and a lone visitor in a black coat looking up at the piece. Visual style: photorealistic museum installation mixed with refined anime illustration, extremely precise paper-cut texture, visible folded edges, layered cardstock depth, delicate shadows, translucent vellum-like pieces, elegant pastel color grading, cinematic lighting, high detail, whimsical yet realistic. Composition: centered giant paper portrait occupying most of the image, visitor small in the bottom-right corner, frame slightly protruding from the wall, flowers and ribbons extending outward in shallow relief. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no extra people, keep the square face block plain and centered, maintain a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个垂直的博物馆画廊场景，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位原创动漫风格女孩"} 作为超精细的三维纸艺作品，从墙上悬挂的大型白色阴影画框中破框而出。该艺术品是一幅超大尺寸的肖像画：包含 1 个年轻女孩形象、1 个深邃的矩形白色画框、1 位站在右下角用于对比比例的小型博物馆参观者，以及 1 个遮挡女孩面部中心区域的纯色正方形隐私遮挡块。女孩拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和灰棕色"} 的长波浪卷发，由层叠的剪纸条构成，具有精致的动漫比例，身穿无袖奶油色连衣裙，带有许多折叠纸质褶边、淡蓝色丝带领结和一个小手镯。周围环绕着复杂的纸花、半透明花瓣、淡蓝色叶片、卷曲的丝带条以及延伸出画框的层叠花卉剪纸，营造出纸艺作品仿佛活过来并溢出到房间里的感觉。在以象牙白、米色、奶油色和淡腮红为主的色调中，使用 {argument name="accent color" default="淡天蓝色"} 作为点缀。场景设定在一个安静的当代艺术博物馆内，拥有高墙、木地板、来自右上角天窗的柔和自然光、长长的阴影，以及一位身穿黑色外套、抬头仰望作品的孤独参观者。视觉风格：写实的博物馆装置与精致动漫插画的结合，极度精准的剪纸纹理，可见的折叠边缘，层叠卡纸的深度感，细腻的阴影，半透明的羊皮纸质感，优雅的柔和色调，电影级布光，高细节，既奇幻又写实。构图：居中的巨型纸艺肖像占据画面大部分空间，参观者位于右下角，画框略微凸出墙面，花朵和丝带以浅浮雕形式向外延伸。约束条件：无文字，无水印，无额外人物，保持面部遮挡块为纯色且居中，保持 4:5 的垂直纵横比。

templates.title: Textile Collage Elf Maiden

titleLocalized.zh: 纺织拼贴精灵少女

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical mixed-media textile collage portrait of {argument name="character type" default="a delicate elf maiden"} made from real-looking lace, dried flowers, leaves, ribbons, and layered fabric scraps. The composition has exactly 1 central elf figure shown full body in a soft side-facing pose, with 2 long pointed ears, very long wavy ash-blonde hair, and a simple matte beige rectangular mask covering the face as an intentional blank placeholder. Dress the figure in exactly 5 visible costume components: a tattered off-white lace gown, a layered lace shawl, a large lace-and-flower headpiece, trailing gauze ribbons, and a small wildflower bouquet held at the chest. Surround the figure with a dense cream-and-sage botanical frame containing exactly 4 prominent anchor decorations: 1 large olive satin bow in the upper left, 1 diagonal white lace ribbon sweeping across the upper right, 1 large cream rose in the lower right, and 1 vertical cluster of dried beige grasses along the left side. Use {argument name="color palette" default="ivory, antique cream, beige, sage green, muted olive, pale gold"} with no bright colors. Emphasize tactile material realism: crocheted lace holes, frayed fabric edges, translucent gauze, pressed leaves, tiny white blossoms, dried stems, embroidered mesh, paper-like petals, and subtle shadows between layers. The background is an ornate handmade wall of overlapping lace scraps, botanical cuttings, and vintage fabric, filling the entire frame with no empty space. Lighting is soft diffuse natural light, warm vintage tone, shallow dimensional relief, romantic fairycore aesthetic, extremely intricate texture, high resolution, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高度精细的竖构图混合媒介纺织拼贴肖像，主体为 {argument name="character type" default="一位精致的精灵少女"}，由逼真的蕾丝、干花、叶片、丝带和分层布料碎片构成。构图包含 1 个位于中央的全身精灵形象，呈柔和的侧身姿态，拥有 2 只长尖耳、极长的波浪状灰金色长发，面部覆盖着一个简约的哑光米色长方形面具，作为刻意留白的占位符。为该形象设计 5 个可见的服饰组件：一件破旧的灰白色蕾丝长裙、一条分层蕾丝披肩、一个大型蕾丝花朵头饰、拖曳的纱质丝带，以及胸前捧着的一束小野花。在人物周围环绕着茂密的奶油色与鼠尾草绿植物边框，包含 4 个醒目的锚点装饰：左上方 1 个大型橄榄色缎带蝴蝶结，右上角 1 条斜向的白色蕾丝丝带，右下方 1 朵大型奶油色玫瑰，以及左侧 1 簇垂直的米色干草。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="象牙白、古董奶油色、米色、鼠尾草绿、柔和橄榄色、浅金色"}，不含鲜艳色彩。强调触感材质的真实性：钩针蕾丝孔洞、磨损的布料边缘、半透明薄纱、压花叶片、细小的白色花朵、干枯的茎秆、刺绣网眼、纸质花瓣，以及层叠间的微妙阴影。背景是一面由重叠的蕾丝碎片、植物剪枝和复古布料手工拼贴而成的华丽墙面，填满整个画面，不留空白。光线为柔和的漫射自然光，呈现温暖的复古色调，具有浅浮雕般的立体感，浪漫的精灵风美学，极其复杂的纹理，高分辨率，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Girl at Chuo Station

titleLocalized.zh: 中央车站的动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime-style street scene at a Japanese train station entrance, featuring one teenage girl standing in side profile in the foreground under a dark station canopy. The character has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied in a high ponytail with a red ribbon, straight bangs framing her face, pale skin, and striking {argument name="eye color" default="red"} eyes; she wears a crisp white short-sleeve school blouse with a small dark bow at the collar and a high-waisted dark pleated skirt. Her pose is calm and slightly wistful, arms relaxed at her sides, looking toward the bright city street to the right. The setting is {argument name="station name" default="Chuo Station"}, with visible bilingual station signage including “Chuo Sta”, “East Exit”, “Bus Terminal”, “Taxi Stand”, and “Coin Lockers”, plus a hanging directional sign and an analog clock on the right. The background shows a sunlit urban crosswalk, pedestrians, cars, mid-rise commercial buildings, storefront signs, tiled pavement, glass doors, pillars, and strong perspective lines leading out from the shadowed station interior. Use dramatic high-contrast lighting: deep black shadows inside the station, bright white daylight outside, long geometric shadows across the floor, and a limited monochrome palette with selective red accents in the eyes and hair ribbon. Style should blend detailed manga line art with cinematic noir photography, subtle film grain, slight chromatic aberration, sharp ink outlines, realistic architectural detail, and a moody urban atmosphere. No extra characters in the foreground, no smiling pose, no fantasy elements, no oversized accessories, and keep the composition centered on exactly one girl.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的动漫风格日本火车站入口街景，前景中一位少女侧身站在阴暗的车站顶棚下。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的高马尾发型，系着红色丝带，直刘海修饰脸庞，皮肤白皙，有着引人注目的 {argument name="eye color" default="红色"} 双眼；她身穿挺括的白色短袖校服衬衫，领口系着深色小蝴蝶结，下身穿着高腰深色百褶裙。她的姿态平静而略带忧郁，双臂自然垂在身侧，望向右侧明亮的城市街道。场景设定为 {argument name="station name" default="中央车站"}，可见双语车站标识，包括“Chuo Sta”、“东出口”、“巴士总站”、“出租车候车点”和“投币储物柜”，右侧还有悬挂的指示牌和模拟时钟。背景展示了阳光明媚的城市人行横道、行人、汽车、中层商业建筑、店面招牌、瓷砖路面、玻璃门、立柱，以及从阴暗车站内部延伸出的强烈透视线条。使用戏剧性的高对比度光影：车站内部深邃的黑色阴影，外部明亮的白色日光，地面上长长的几何阴影，以及仅在眼睛和发带处保留红色点缀的有限单色调。风格应融合细腻的漫画线条与电影感黑色摄影，带有细微的胶片颗粒感、轻微的色差、锐利的墨线、写实的建筑细节以及忧郁的城市氛围。前景中不要出现额外角色，不要有微笑姿态，不要有奇幻元素，不要有夸张的配饰，构图需聚焦于且仅包含这一位少女。

templates.title: Three-Panel Shoujo Rooftop Manga

titleLocalized.zh: 三格少女漫风格天台漫画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished black-and-white manga two-page-spread style comic page based on a simple one-page scene, drawn as a clean shoujo manga manuscript with delicate pen hatching, screentone-free ink linework, warm off-white paper texture, and thin black panel borders.

Canvas: Vertical page, about 3:4 aspect ratio, with three wide horizontal panels stacked from top to bottom. Use a hand-drawn manga border around each panel and slight paper grain. Overall mood is romantic, emotional, and gently dramatic.

Character: A cute teenage schoolgirl, {argument name="character name" default="unnamed schoolgirl"}, with light-colored hair in twin braids, straight bangs, a thick headband, small ribbon bows tied into the braids, large sparkling shoujo eyes, soft blush, and a sailor-style school uniform. She wears small cross-shaped earrings and carries a rectangular school bag with a cross charm. Her expression changes from worried hesitation to determined resolve to a confident, tender smile.

Layout and panel count: Use exactly 3 panels.
1. Top panel: A rooftop or elevated school terrace at sunset, city buildings in the distance, metal railings, drifting flower petals, soft clouds, and a calm wind. The girl leans on the railing in three-quarter view, resting one hand near her mouth in hesitation. Add an oval vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right containing exactly: 「…さっき、言いすぎたかな…」. Place a soft gray rectangular blur censor over the center of her face, obscuring facial features in this panel.
2. Middle panel: The same girl suddenly stands and moves forward with determination, holding or pulling up her school bag at her side. Use strong manga speed lines radiating from the background to show a decision moment. Add an oval vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right containing exactly: 「大丈夫。明日ちゃんと伝えよう。」. Place a soft gray rectangular blur censor over the center of her face, obscuring facial features in this panel.
3. Bottom panel: Close-up of the girl’s face, now uncensored and clearly visible, with sparkling eyes, blush marks, tiny heart highlights around her cheeks and hair, and a small confident smile while she lightly touches or holds her cross earring. Add an oval vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right containing exactly: 「私のやり方で、もう一度。」.

Visual style: Fine monochrome manga ink, expressive shoujo eyes, delicate crosshatching, clean contour lines, natural hand-drawn imperfections, subtle sunset atmosphere rendered only through linework, no color except the off-white paper background and gray face-censor blocks in the first two panels.

Constraints: Keep exactly 3 panels, exactly 3 speech bubbles, and exactly 2 gray face-obscuring rectangles. Do not add extra characters, extra captions, logos, watermarks, or modern UI elements. Preserve the Japanese text exactly as written.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：基于简单的单页场景，创作一页精致的黑白漫画双页跨页风格漫画，绘制成干净的少女漫画原稿，采用细腻的排线、无网点纸的墨水线条、温暖的米白色纸张纹理以及细黑色的分镜框。

画布：竖版页面，比例约为 3:4，从上到下堆叠三个宽横向分镜。每个分镜周围使用手绘漫画边框，并带有轻微的纸张颗粒感。整体氛围浪漫、感性且带有柔和的戏剧性。

角色：一位可爱的少女高中生，{argument name="character name" default="未命名女学生"}，浅色头发扎成双麻花辫，留着齐刘海，戴着宽发带，辫子上系着小蝴蝶结，拥有少女漫标志性的大眼睛，脸颊微红，身穿水手服风格校服。她戴着小十字架耳环，背着一个带有十字架挂饰的长方形书包。她的表情从担忧犹豫转变为坚定决心，最后露出自信而温柔的微笑。

布局与分镜数量：使用 3 个分镜。
1. 顶部：日落时的学校天台或高处露台，远处是城市建筑，有金属栏杆、飘落的花瓣、柔和的云朵和微风。女孩以四分之三侧面倚靠在栏杆上，一只手放在嘴边，神情犹豫。在右侧添加一个竖向椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为： 「…さっき、言いすぎたかな…」。在她的面部中心放置一个柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮罩，遮住此分镜中的面部特征。
2. 中间：同一个女孩突然站起身，神情坚定地向前迈进，手持或拉起侧面的书包。使用从背景放射出的强烈漫画速度线来表现决定的瞬间。在右侧添加一个竖向椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为： 「大丈夫。明日ちゃんと伝えよう。」。在她的面部中心放置一个柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮罩，遮住此分镜中的面部特征。
3. 底部：女孩面部的特写，此时不再有遮罩，面容清晰可见，眼睛闪闪发光，脸颊带有红晕，头发和脸颊周围有微小的爱心高光，她轻触或握住十字架耳环，露出自信的微笑。在右侧添加一个竖向椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为： 「私のやり方で、もう一度。」。

视觉风格：精细的黑白漫画墨水线条，富有表现力的少女漫大眼睛，细腻的排线，干净的轮廓线，自然的手绘瑕疵，仅通过线条呈现微妙的日落氛围，除了米白色纸张背景和前两个分镜中的灰色面部遮罩外，不使用任何颜色。

约束条件：保持 3 个分镜，3 个对话气泡，以及 2 个灰色面部遮罩矩形。不要添加额外角色、额外标题、标志、水印或现代 UI 元素。请务必保留所写的日文文本。

templates.title: GPT Image 2 Kawaii Sticker Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: GPT Image 2 可爱贴纸合集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cute sticker-sheet collage for a social media model comparison, featuring exactly 12 variations of the same faceless character and a bold top title reading {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2"}.

Canvas: Vertical 9:16 mobile format, white background with a thin dark border, arranged like a printable sticker sheet. Keep generous white space between stickers and use a playful kawaii scrapbook aesthetic.

Main character: A young person with {argument name="hair color" default="bright golden-orange"} messy chin-length bob hair, soft and fluffy strands, wearing an oversized white shirt or hoodie. The face area should be intentionally blurred or left featureless with a smooth beige oval, as if anonymized. Use soft semi-realistic anime illustration with glossy highlights and clean sticker-like cutout edges.

Layout: Place the large title at the very top in chunky rounded bubble letters, white fill with thick sky-blue outline and subtle drop shadow. Below it, arrange exactly 12 character stickers in a loose 3-column by 4-row grid:
1. Top-left: head tilted slightly, messy hair swept outward, small pink hearts nearby.
2. Top-center: front-facing bust, speech bubble with a pink heart above.
3. Top-right: playful pose with both hands near the head, small yellow crown doodle above.
4. Second-row-left: sleeping pose lying sideways with eyes hidden by the blur, surrounded by tiny Z marks and the phrase “Too Cute”.
5. Second-row-center: front-facing bust with the text “Good Vibes” and a small star.
6. Second-row-right: bust angled slightly, surrounded by sparkles and a black heart.
7. Third-row-left: front-facing bust with the phrase “You Got This” near the lower-left.
8. Third-row-center: bust holding or wearing a small black label that says “COFFEE FIRST”.
9. Third-row-right: smiling implied pose with hands near cheeks, text “Be You” and a small speech bubble heart.
10. Bottom-left: playful salute or hand-at-head pose, messy hair sweeping left.
11. Bottom-center: simple centered bust with small pink love marks around the head.
12. Bottom-right: cheerful bust with one hand near the hair, small heart speech bubble nearby.

Doodles and text: Add exactly 24 small decorative stickers scattered around the sheet: 6 pink hearts, 4 black hearts, 4 yellow stars, 3 pink flowers, 2 tiny crowns, 2 smiley faces, 1 “LOL” speech bubble, 1 “XOXO” text doodle, and 1 “Too Cute” text doodle. Include the phrases “Good Vibes”, “You Got This”, “COFFEE FIRST”, and “Be You” in casual handwritten lettering. Use {argument name="accent color" default="pink"} and yellow as the main accent colors.

Visual style: Bright, cute, high-key lighting, soft watercolor-marker texture mixed with polished digital illustration, rounded sticker outlines, hand-drawn doodles, playful Gen Z journal aesthetic. Keep the image clean, cheerful, and dense but readable.

Constraints: No realistic facial features; keep all 12 faces anonymized or softly blurred. Do not add extra character variations beyond 12. Do not add watermark, app UI, or model comparison panels beyond the single top title.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为社交媒体模型对比制作一张可爱的贴纸合集，包含 12 个相同的无脸角色变体，并在顶部放置醒目的标题 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2"}。

画布：垂直 9:16 移动端格式，白色背景，带有细深色边框，布局如同可打印的贴纸页。贴纸之间保持充足的留白，采用俏皮的可爱剪贴簿美学。

主角：一个留着 {argument name="hair color" default="明亮金橙色"} 凌乱下巴长度波波头的年轻人，发丝柔软蓬松，身穿超大号白色衬衫或连帽衫。脸部区域应刻意模糊或留白，呈现为平滑的米色椭圆形，以示匿名。采用柔和的半写实动漫插画风格，带有光泽高光和清晰的贴纸式剪裁边缘。

布局：将大标题置于最上方，使用圆润的粗体气泡字，白色填充，配以厚实的浅蓝色轮廓和微妙的投影。下方排列 12 个角色贴纸，采用 3 列 4 行的松散网格布局：
1. 左上：头部微倾，凌乱的头发向外扫，旁边有粉色小爱心。
2. 中上：正面半身像，上方有带粉色爱心的对话气泡。
3. 右上：双手靠近头部的俏皮姿势，上方有黄色小皇冠涂鸦。
4. 第二行左：侧卧睡姿，眼睛被模糊处理，周围有微小的 Z 字符和“Too Cute”字样。
5. 第二行中：正面半身像，带有“Good Vibes”文字和一颗小星星。
6. 第二行右：半身像略微倾斜，周围环绕着闪光和一颗黑色爱心。
7. 第三行左：正面半身像，左下方有“You Got This”字样。
8. 第三行中：半身像手持或佩戴写有“COFFEE FIRST”的黑色小标签。
9. 第三行右：暗示微笑的姿势，双手靠近脸颊，带有“Be You”文字和心形对话气泡。
10. 左下：俏皮的敬礼或手扶头部姿势，凌乱的头发向左扫。
11. 右下：简单的居中半身像，头部周围有粉色爱心标记。
12. 右下：欢快的半身像，一只手靠近头发，旁边有心形对话气泡。

涂鸦与文字：在页面周围散布 24 个装饰性小贴纸：6 个粉色爱心、4 个黑色爱心、4 个黄色星星、3 朵粉色花朵、2 个小皇冠、2 个笑脸、1 个“LOL”对话气泡、1 个“XOXO”文字涂鸦和 1 个“Too Cute”文字涂鸦。包含“Good Vibes”、“You Got This”、“COFFEE FIRST”和“Be You”等休闲手写字体。使用 {argument name="accent color" default="粉色"} 和黄色作为主要强调色。

视觉风格：明亮、可爱、高调照明，柔和的水彩马克笔质感与精致的数字插画相结合，圆润的贴纸轮廓，手绘涂鸦，俏皮的 Z 世代日记美学。保持画面整洁、欢快，内容丰富且易于阅读。

约束：禁止出现写实的五官；保持所有 12 个面部匿名或柔和模糊。不要添加超过 12 个的角色变体。不要添加水印、应用 UI 或除顶部标题以外的模型对比面板。

templates.title: Neon Anime DJ Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹动漫 DJ 女孩

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 anime-style music illustration of a young woman in a neon cyberpunk night scene. The subject is a stylish anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="long dark purple-black hair with pink and blue rim highlights"}, shown from the waist up in a dynamic three-quarter pose, her hair blown dramatically across the frame. She wears large glossy over-ear DJ headphones with glowing cyan and magenta rings, a black choker, a delicate necklace, a loose white camisole, and an oversized dark jacket slipping off one shoulder. Her right hand lightly touches the headphones near her ear. Place a perfectly centered opaque square censor block over the face, covering the eyes, nose, and mouth, colored muted mauve-purple. Surround her with an energetic audio-visual swirl: exactly 8 prominent glowing musical notes, including 3 hot-pink notes near the upper left and upper right, 2 cyan notes on the left side, 1 cyan-and-pink note on the right edge, and 2 pink notes near the lower foreground. Add luminous curved light trails wrapping around her body, sparkling particles, star-like bokeh, and digital equalizer bars along the lower edge. Use {argument name="color palette" default="electric blue, violet, magenta, hot pink, and deep black"}, high-contrast glossy lighting, detailed anime rendering, dramatic rim light, vibrant concert atmosphere, sharp hair strands, reflective headphone surfaces, and a dense magical music aura. No readable text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖屏动漫风格的音乐插画，呈现一位身处霓虹赛博朋克夜景中的年轻女性。主体是一位时尚的动漫女孩，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有粉色和蓝色边缘高光的长款深紫黑色头发"}，以动态的三分之四侧身姿势展示腰部以上画面，头发在画面中随风飘动。她戴着大型光泽感头戴式 DJ 耳机，耳机上有发光的青色和洋红色光环，佩戴黑色颈圈、精致项链，身穿宽松的白色吊带背心，以及一件从一侧肩膀滑落的超大款深色夹克。她的右手轻轻触碰耳边的耳机。在面部正中央放置一个不透明的方形遮挡块，覆盖眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，颜色为柔和的紫红色。在她的周围环绕充满活力的视听漩涡：精确布置 8 个醒目的发光音符，包括左上角和右上角附近的 3 个亮粉色音符、左侧的 2 个青色音符、右边缘的 1 个青粉双色音符，以及前景下方附近的 2 个粉色音符。添加环绕她身体的发光曲线光轨、闪烁的微粒、星状光斑，以及底部的数字均衡器条。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="电光蓝、紫罗兰色、洋红色、亮粉色和深黑色"}，高对比度光泽照明，细腻的动漫渲染，戏剧性的轮廓光，充满活力的音乐会氛围，清晰的发丝，反光的耳机表面，以及浓郁的魔法音乐光环。无可见文字，无水印，无多余字符。

templates.title: Sunset Maids by a Campfire

titleLocalized.zh: 篝火旁的黄昏女仆

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic anime-style illustration of exactly two young women dressed as ornate gothic-lolita maids sitting close together beside a bright campfire at dusk in a ruined post-apocalyptic city street. The left maid has {argument name="left maid hair color" default="short orange bob hair"}, a frilly white lace maid headband with a pink bow, a pink satin maid dress with puff sleeves, layered white ruffles, bows, lace trim, fingerless white gloves, a heart choker, and thigh-high stockings; she is holding one black metal mug with a white crest emblem. The right maid has {argument name="right maid hair color" default="long pink hair"}, a white lace maid headband with black lace and black ribbon bows, a black glossy gothic maid dress with white ruffled trim, a low neckline, black gloves and wrist cuffs, black stockings, and delicate earrings; she rests one hand against her cheek while sitting with her knees up. Their faces are intentionally obscured by two plain solid brown square blocks, one over each face, matching the original censored look. In the foreground include exactly one large orange campfire with glowing embers, exactly one metal teapot near the bottom center, exactly one small metal cup near the fire, and the black mug held by the left maid. The background should show ruined high-rise buildings, broken balconies, dark rubble, smoke, and a narrow street fading into depth under a soft pink-purple sunset sky. Use dramatic warm firelight from below and soft sunset rim light from behind, high-detail fabric textures, lace, ribbons, shiny satin, realistic anime rendering, shallow depth of field, atmospheric sparks floating through the air, moody cozy contrast between cute maid fashion and devastated urban scenery. No readable text except the small emblem on the mug, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的电影感动漫风格插画，画面中恰好有两名身着华丽哥特萝莉装的女仆，在黄昏时分废墟般的末日城市街道上，紧挨着明亮的篝火休息。左侧女仆拥有 {argument name="left maid hair color" default="短款橙色波波头"}，佩戴带有粉色蝴蝶结的蕾丝花边女仆头饰，身穿粉色缎面泡泡袖女仆裙，配有层叠的白色荷叶边、蝴蝶结、蕾丝饰边、白色露指手套、心形项圈和过膝袜；她手中拿着一个带有白色纹章的黑色金属马克杯。右侧女仆拥有 {argument name="right maid hair color" default="长款粉色头发"}，佩戴带有黑色蕾丝和黑色丝带蝴蝶结的白色蕾丝女仆头饰，身穿带有白色荷叶边饰的黑色亮面哥特女仆裙，低领设计，佩戴黑色手套和腕带、黑色长筒袜以及精致的耳环；她单手托腮，屈膝而坐。她们的面部特意用两个纯棕色实心正方形遮挡，每个面部各一个，以还原原始的遮挡效果。前景包含恰好一个大型橙色篝火及发光的余烬、底部中心附近恰好一个金属茶壶、火堆旁恰好一个小金属杯，以及左侧女仆手中持有的黑色马克杯。背景应展现废墟高楼、破碎的阳台、深色瓦砾、烟雾，以及在柔和的粉紫色夕阳下向深处延伸的狭窄街道。运用来自下方的戏剧性暖色火光和来自后方的柔和夕阳轮廓光，展现高细节的布料纹理、蕾丝、丝带、光泽缎面、写实动漫渲染、浅景深效果，以及空气中漂浮的氛围感火星，营造出可爱的女仆时尚与荒凉城市景观之间忧郁而温馨的对比。除马克杯上的小纹章外，画面中不应出现任何可读文字，无水印，无额外角色。

templates.title: Seaside Pocari Sweat Schoolgirl Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 海边宝矿力水特女高中生广告

templates.prompt: Create a bright Japanese summer beverage advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="POCARI SWEAT"}, in the style of a 2009 seaside TV commercial key visual. Full vertical poster composition, photorealistic, high-key daylight, vivid blue sky, white clouds, ocean and distant mountains in the background, a sunlit waterfront promenade with railings, and the side of a white building on the right. A teenage Japanese schoolgirl stands full body slightly right of center, viewed from a low angle, wearing a white sailor-style school uniform blouse with navy collar and blue necktie, a navy pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and black loafers. Her face is deliberately anonymized with a smooth rectangular blur, while her long dark hair and natural pose remain visible. She holds a small blue-and-white drink bottle near her mouth as if drinking, looking fresh and hydrated. Add exactly 3 visible branded text areas: top left small Otsuka logo with Japanese company name, large left-center Japanese copy reading 「あついカラダに、おいしい水分。」 above huge bold white stacked text "POCARI SWEAT" with a white wave mark, and bottom right small blue Japanese copy reading 「汗のあとに、ポカリスエット。」 plus tiny legal/footer text and website. Add exactly 2 product-bottle elements: one small bottle in the girl's hand and one large tilted condensation-covered plastic bottle cropped in the bottom-left foreground with the blue {argument name="bottle label" default="POCARI SWEAT"} label facing the viewer. Add a thin blue circular badge near the foreground bottle reading "ION SUPPLY DRINK". Place the year {argument name="year" default="2009"} in small white type at the top right. Use clean commercial typography, strong blue-and-white brand palette, glossy condensation, summer freshness, realistic shadows, slight wide-angle lens perspective, and poster-ready sharp detail. Avoid extra people, extra bottles, messy text, or any watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张明亮的日本夏季饮料广告海报，品牌为 {argument name="brand name" default="POCARI SWEAT"}，风格参考 2009 年海边电视广告的主视觉图。采用完整的竖版海报构图，照片级写实，高调日光，湛蓝天空，白云，背景为海洋和远山，阳光明媚的海滨长廊配有栏杆，右侧为白色建筑侧面。一位日本女高中生全身像位于画面中心偏右，低角度拍摄，身穿白色水手服风格校服上衣，配有海军蓝领子和蓝色领带，海军蓝百褶裙，白色及膝袜和黑色乐福鞋。她的面部经过平滑的矩形模糊处理以隐去身份，但保留了长长的黑发和自然的姿态。她手持一瓶蓝白相间的饮料靠近嘴边，仿佛正在饮用，显得清爽且补水。添加 3 处清晰的品牌文字区域：左上角为带有日本公司名称的小型 Otsuka 标志，左侧中央为醒目的日语文案「あついカラダに、おいしい水分。」，上方为巨大的粗体白色堆叠文字 "POCARI SWEAT" 及白色波浪标记，右下角为蓝色小字日语文案「汗のあとに、ポカリスエット。」，并附带微小的法律声明/页脚文字及网址。添加 2 个产品瓶身元素：女孩手中握着一瓶，左下角前景处有一瓶带有冷凝水的倾斜大瓶身，蓝色的 {argument name="bottle label" default="POCARI SWEAT"} 标签面向观众。在前景瓶身旁添加一个蓝色的圆形小徽章，上面写着 "ION SUPPLY DRINK"。在右上角以白色小字标注年份 {argument name="year" default="2009"}。使用简洁的商业排版，强烈的蓝白品牌色调，光泽感的冷凝水效果，夏日清新感，真实的阴影，轻微的广角镜头透视，以及海报级的清晰细节。避免出现多余的人物、多余的瓶子、杂乱的文字或任何水印。

templates.title: Blonde Woman in Pink Satin Pajamas

titleLocalized.zh: 身穿粉色缎面睡衣的金发女性

templates.prompt: Create a vertical realistic fashion-photo style image of an adult woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long messy blonde hair"} standing in a modern marble bathroom beside a white sink and vanity. She wears exactly 2 satin pajama pieces: a pale {argument name="pajama color" default="blush pink"} short-sleeve button-up shirt with piping, chest pocket, shiny fabric wrinkles, and matching drawstring short shorts. Her face is intentionally hidden by a centered solid opaque square censor block in warm tan-brown, covering the entire facial area while leaving hair visible. She holds exactly 1 novelty toothbrush near her mouth, a small {argument name="toothbrush style" default="pink flamingo-shaped toothbrush"}. On the sink counter at the left, include exactly 4 toiletry bottles: a white pump bottle, a small pale pink bottle, a tall pink-and-black bottle, and a second white pump bottle. The setting has gray-veined marble walls, a bright vertical mirror light on the far left, chrome faucet, soft warm bathroom lighting, shallow depth of field, and a darker doorway or bedroom area in the background on the right. Pose her leaning casually against the vanity with one hip tilted, natural relaxed hand placement, glossy pajama highlights, cinematic realism, high-detail skin and fabric texture, 2:3 portrait composition. Use {argument name="lighting mood" default="soft warm morning bathroom light"}; no text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的写实时尚摄影风格图像，画面中是一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱长金发"} 的成年女性，站在现代大理石浴室的白色洗手台旁。她穿着两件套缎面睡衣：一件浅 {argument name="pajama color" default="淡粉色"} 短袖纽扣衬衫，带有滚边、胸袋、光泽面料褶皱，以及配套的抽绳短裤。她的面部被一个位于正中央的实心不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住，遮挡块呈暖棕褐色，覆盖了整个面部区域，但露出了头发。她手持 1 把创意牙刷靠近嘴边，牙刷款式为 {argument name="toothbrush style" default="粉色火烈鸟造型牙刷"}。在左侧洗手台面上，放置 4 个洗漱用品瓶：一个白色按压瓶、一个小号淡粉色瓶、一个高大的粉黑配色瓶，以及第二个白色按压瓶。场景背景为带有灰色纹理的大理石墙面，最左侧有一盏明亮的竖条镜前灯，配有镀铬水龙头，光线为柔和的暖色调浴室光，具有浅景深效果，右侧背景为较暗的门口或卧室区域。让她以一侧髋部倾斜的姿势随意倚靠在洗手台上，手部姿势自然放松，展现缎面睡衣的光泽感，具有电影级写实感，皮肤和织物纹理细节丰富，采用 2:3 人像构图。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="柔和的暖色调清晨浴室光"}；画面中无文字、无水印、无额外人物。

templates.title: Female Android vs Robotic Scorpion

titleLocalized.zh: 女性仿生人对战机械蝎

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical sci-fi action illustration of {argument name="character concept" default="a female android warrior aboard a spaceship"} in a devastated spacecraft corridor during a hull breach. The central subject is a sleek feminine android in glossy white segmented biomechanical armor, athletic build, kneeling and twisting in a dynamic combat pose, with very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair streaming wildly in zero gravity; her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur or visor-like neutral mask so no facial features are visible. She holds a glowing {argument name="weapon color" default="blue-white"} energy blade or plasma sword diagonally across the foreground, striking a massive black mechanical scorpion enemy. The enemy is one giant robotic scorpion with two large claw arms, a heavy armored body, multiple articulated legs, and one arched segmented tail ending in a sharp stinger with a red glowing tip; include red sensor lights in its head and tail. Show bright sparks exploding where the blade hits the scorpion claw, with flying shrapnel, metallic debris, shattered glass, electrical arcs, and star-like particles filling the scene. The setting is the dark interior of a futuristic spaceship with exposed panels, cables, grated metal floor, warning screens, and a huge torn opening to outer space behind them; through the breach, show Earth’s blue curve and a starfield. Include exactly two visible warning displays on the left wall, with readable red text such as {argument name="warning text" default="HULL BREACH / SECTOR 7-A / WARNING"}. Use dramatic wide-angle perspective, intense motion, high contrast, cold blue rim light from space, red emergency highlights, volumetric particles, hyper-detailed hard-surface mecha design, photorealistic anime-real sci-fi concept art, ultra-detailed metal scratches and reflections, cinematic depth of field, no extra characters, no watermark, no captions beyond the warning displays.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级的竖版科幻动作插画，描绘 {argument name="character concept" default="一位身处宇宙飞船的女性仿生人战士"} 在飞船船体破损后的废墟走廊中战斗的场景。主体是一位身着光泽感白色分段式生物机械装甲的女性仿生人，体态矫健，正以动态战斗姿势跪地扭转，其极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 秀发在零重力下狂野飘散；她的面部被柔和的方形模糊效果或类似面罩的中性遮挡物刻意遮盖，无法看清五官。她手持一把发光的 {argument name="weapon color" default="蓝白色"} 能量刃或等离子剑，斜置于前景，正猛烈撞击一只巨大的黑色机械蝎敌人。敌人是一只巨大的机械蝎，拥有两只巨大的钳臂、厚重的装甲躯体、多条关节腿，以及一条末端带有红色发光尖刺的拱形分段尾巴；其头部和尾部带有红色传感器灯光。展示刀刃击中蝎钳时迸发的明亮火花，画面中充斥着飞溅的弹片、金属碎片、破碎的玻璃、电弧以及星光般的粒子。背景是充满未来感的宇宙飞船内部，可见裸露的面板、电缆、金属格栅地板、警示屏幕，以及身后通往外太空的巨大撕裂缺口；透过缺口，可以看到地球的蓝色弧线和星空。左侧墙壁上需包含两个清晰可见的警示显示屏，显示可读的红色文字，例如 {argument name="warning text" default="HULL BREACH / SECTOR 7-A / WARNING"}。采用戏剧性的广角透视，强调强烈的动感、高对比度、来自太空的冷蓝色轮廓光、红色紧急警示高光、体积粒子效果，以及超精细的硬表面机甲设计。风格为写实动漫风科幻概念艺术，具有极高细节的金属划痕与反射效果，以及电影级的景深，画面中不包含其他角色，无水印，除警示显示屏外无任何文字说明。

templates.title: Japanese Mecha Fast Food Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 日式机甲快餐分镜脚本

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a colorful Japanese 15-second TV commercial storyboard for a fictional McDonald's-style superhero robot campaign, titled {argument name="headline text" default="15秒CM ストーリーボード"} with the red subheadline {argument name="subheadline text" default="マックロボ、出動！"}.

Canvas: Landscape 16:9 presentation board on a white background, divided into exactly 8 bordered storyboard panels arranged in a 4-column by 2-row grid. Each panel has a red square number badge in the top-left corner, a vivid illustration area, and a white caption area underneath with red timecode text and black Japanese description text. Add a tiny black disclaimer line along the bottom edge.

Visual style: High-energy Japanese anime commercial storyboard, toy-ad dynamism, saturated reds/yellows/blues, dramatic speed lines, sparks, explosions, city action, glossy mecha rendering, McDonald's-like golden arches branding, thick comic outlines, cinematic lighting. Use a polished generated-image look, not flat vector art.

Main characters and motifs: A family of four eating fast food; their faces should appear intentionally blurred or masked for privacy. A team of exactly 4 transforming meal-themed robots: 1 red burger hero robot with wings, 1 blue dinosaur/T-rex robot, 1 golden lion robot, and 1 golden phoenix/eagle robot. Also show burgers, fries, nuggets, soft drinks, and a giant spaghetti/noodle monster made of curly noodles.

Panel count and contents: Use exactly 8 panels.
1. Panel 1, timecode "0-2秒": The family of four sits at a McDonald's-like restaurant table full of burgers, fries, nuggets, drinks, and small toy robots. Caption: "家族みんなでマクドナルド！ おいしい！たのしい！"
2. Panel 2, timecode "2-4秒": Fast food items burst into transformation energy and become the 4 robots: red burger robot, blue dinosaur robot, golden lion robot, golden phoenix robot. Caption: "食べものが光って…ロボに変形！ マックロボ、誕生！"
3. Panel 3, timecode "4-6秒": A character introduction grid inside the panel, split into exactly 4 smaller portrait boxes labeled: "パパ：バーガーロボ", "ママ：フェニックスロボ", "お兄ちゃん：ティーレックスロボ", "妹：ライオンロボ". Caption: "それぞれのロボットへ！ いくよ、出動！"
4. Panel 4, timecode "6-8秒": The robot team launches into a city street under a blue sky with a McDonald's sign in the background; red winged robot flies forward, other 3 robots run below. Caption: "街をかけぬけ、 マックロボ、出動！"
5. Panel 5, timecode "8-10秒": A huge angry spaghetti/noodle monster towers over city traffic, with forks and flying noodle strands around it. Caption: "街が危ないぞ！"
6. Panel 6, timecode "10-12秒": The 4 robots fight the noodle monster together in the city, with explosions, energy blasts, and dramatic motion. Caption: "チームで力をあわせて、 えいっ！ とかーん！"
7. Panel 7, timecode "12-14秒": Victory pose of the 4 robots in the city, red robot centered with wings spread, celebratory red-and-white Japanese impact text across the image: {argument name="impact slogan" default="今日もマックで元気100倍"}. Caption: "今日もマックで元気100倍！ マックロボの勝利だ！"
8. Panel 8, timecode "14-15秒": Final brand end card: bright red background with a large yellow McDonald's-style golden arch logo, the family of four and the 4 robots posing together, plus white/yellow slogan text {argument name="end card slogan" default="ワクワクを、いっしょに。 I'm lovin' it"}. Caption: "ワクワクを、いっしょに。 マクドナルド"

Text and layout constraints: Keep all visible title, timecodes, panel numbers, and captions in Japanese exactly as specified. Use bold red timecodes centered under each image. Ensure the 8 panels are clearly separated by thin black borders. Do not add extra panels, extra robots, QR codes, watermarks, or unrelated logos beyond the McDonald's-inspired golden arches visual language.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为虚构的麦当劳风格超级英雄机器人宣传活动创建一个色彩鲜艳的 15 秒日本电视广告分镜脚本，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="15秒CM ストーリーボード"}，并配有红色副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="マックロボ、出動！"}。

画布：白色背景上的 16:9 横向 Slides 项目，划分为 8 个带边框的分镜格，排列为 4 列 2 行。每个分镜格左上角有一个红色方形数字标签，中间是生动的插图区域，下方是白色说明文字区域，包含红色时间码和黑色日文描述文字。底部边缘添加一行极小的黑色免责声明。

视觉风格：高能量的日本动漫广告分镜，玩具广告的动态感，饱和的红/黄/蓝色调，戏剧性的速度线、火花、爆炸、城市动作场面、光泽感机甲渲染、类似麦当劳的金色拱门品牌元素、粗线条漫画轮廓、电影级光影。使用精致的生成图像外观，而非扁平的矢量艺术。

主要角色与主题：一家四口正在吃快餐；为了隐私，他们的脸应刻意模糊或遮挡。一支由 4 个以餐点为主题的变形机器人组成的团队：1 个带翅膀的红色汉堡英雄机器人，1 个蓝色恐龙/霸王龙机器人，1 个金色狮子机器人，以及 1 个金色凤凰/老鹰机器人。同时展示汉堡、薯条、鸡块、软饮以及一个由卷曲面条组成的巨大意大利面/面条怪兽。

分镜格数量与内容：使用 8 个分镜格。
1. 分镜 1，时间码 "0-2秒"：一家四口坐在类似麦当劳的餐厅桌前，桌上摆满了汉堡、薯条、鸡块、饮料和小型玩具机器人。说明文字："家族みんなでマクドナルド！ おいしい！たのしい！"
2. 分镜 2，时间码 "2-4秒"：快餐食品迸发出变形能量，变成了 4 个机器人：红色汉堡机器人、蓝色恐龙机器人、金色狮子机器人、金色凤凰机器人。说明文字："食べものが光って…ロボに変形！ マックロボ、誕生！"
3. 分镜 3，时间码 "4-6秒"：分镜格内包含一个角色介绍网格，分为 4 个较小的肖像框，标注为："パパ：バーガーロボ"、"ママ：フェニックスロボ"、"お兄ちゃん：ティーレックスロボ"、"妹：ライオンロボ"。说明文字："それぞれのロボットへ！ いくよ、出動！"
4. 分镜 4，时间码 "6-8秒"：机器人团队在蓝天下的城市街道上出动，背景有麦当劳标志；红色带翅膀机器人向前飞行，其他 3 个机器人在下方奔跑。说明文字："街をかけぬけ、 マックロボ、出動！"
5. 分镜 5，时间码 "8-10秒"：一个巨大的愤怒意大利面/面条怪兽耸立在城市交通之上，周围环绕着叉子和飞舞的面条。说明文字："街が危ないぞ！"
6. 分镜 6，时间码 "10-12秒"：4 个机器人在城市中共同对抗面条怪兽，伴随着爆炸、能量冲击和戏剧性的动作。说明文字："チームで力をあわせて、 えいっ！ とかーん！"
7. 分镜 7，时间码 "12-14秒"：4 个机器人在城市中的胜利姿势，红色机器人居中且张开翅膀，图像上覆盖着庆祝性的红白相间日文冲击文字：{argument name="impact slogan" default="今日もマックで元気100倍"}。说明文字："今日もマックで元気100倍！ マックロボの勝利だ！"
8. 分镜 8，时间码 "14-15秒"：最终品牌片尾：亮红色背景，带有巨大的黄色麦当劳风格金色拱门标志，一家四口和 4 个机器人共同摆出姿势，加上白色/黄色标语文字 {argument name="end card slogan" default="ワクワクを、いっしょに。 I'm lovin' it"}。说明文字："ワクワクを、いっしょに。 マクドナルド"

文本与布局限制：保持所有可见标题、时间码、分镜编号和说明文字为指定的日文。在每张图片下方居中放置加粗的红色时间码。确保 8 个分镜格由细黑边框清晰分隔。除麦当劳风格的金色拱门视觉语言外，请勿添加额外的分镜格、额外的机器人、二维码、水印或不相关的标志。

variables.defaultValue: 今日もマックで元気100倍

templates.title: Seal Adventure Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 海豹冒险电影海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a whimsical hand-drawn anime movie poster for a cozy maritime adventure starring three mischievous spotted baby seals sailing toward a legendary island.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, soft watercolor-and-ink illustration with warm cream highlights, teal ocean tones, misty blue sky, and gentle storybook shading.

Layout: Large Japanese movie title at the top center, sailboat filling the right and lower half, ocean and island background on the left, tagline text across the bottom. The composition should feel like a family adventure film poster.

Text content: At the very top, small text reads {argument name="small top label" default="映画"}. The main title, in large rounded cream letters with a dark brown outline, reads {argument name="main title" default="やわらかさんと幻の島"}. On the front of the wooden boat, painted text reads {argument name="boat name" default="やわらか丸"}. Bottom caption in bold white Japanese text with dark outline reads {argument name="bottom tagline" default="いたずらアザラシが、船乗りに語り継がれる伝説の島「ハイブラジル」へ向かって出航！"}. Tiny credit beneath reads {argument name="director credit" default="総監督：ペコちゃん"}.

Subject details: Show exactly three white spotted baby seals on the boat: 1) a small seal at the left bow holding a brass telescope to its eye and smiling, 2) a larger central seal at the wooden ship wheel, laughing happily with flippers on the wheel, 3) a small seal on the right side waving one flipper cheerfully. All three seals have soft rounded bodies, gray spots, tiny whiskers, black eyes, and cute open-mouth smiles.

Boat and props: A rustic wooden sailing boat with visible plank texture, curved bow, mast, ropes, rigging, tan sails, barrels, coiled rope, a small lantern, a compass on a box, pulleys, railings, and a bowsprit extending toward the viewer. Count the main visible deck props as exactly six: brass telescope, wooden barrel, compass, lantern, coiled rope, and rope pulley rigging.

Background: On the left horizon, show a misty legendary island with cliffs, a tall lighthouse, a small coastal town, green hills, and distant mountains partly hidden in fog. The boat sails through lively blue-green waves with white foam, with a dreamy cloudy sky above.

Visual style: Japanese illustrated children’s adventure film poster, watercolor wash, fine brown ink outlines, soft gradients, nostalgic Studio Ghibli-like warmth without copying any specific film, charming expressions, cinematic framing, high detail but gentle and cozy.

Constraints: Keep the title readable and dominant, use only the specified visible text, keep exactly three seals, no humans, no modern technology, no logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张充满奇趣的手绘动画电影海报，讲述三只调皮的斑点小海豹航向传说之岛的温馨航海冒险故事。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 比例，柔和的水彩与墨水插画风格，带有温暖的奶油色高光、青色海洋色调、雾蓝色天空以及柔和的绘本式阴影。

布局：顶部中央为醒目的日文电影标题，帆船占据右侧及下半部分，左侧为海洋与岛屿背景，底部为标语文字。整体构图应呈现出家庭冒险电影海报的质感。

文字内容：最顶部的小字为 {argument name="small top label" default="映画"}。主标题采用大号圆润奶油色字体，配有深棕色描边，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="やわらかさんと幻の島"}。木船船头绘有文字 {argument name="boat name" default="やわらか丸"}。底部标题采用加粗白色日文字体，配有深色描边，内容为 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="いたずらアザラシが、船乗りに語り継がれる伝説の島「ハイブラジル」へ向かって出航！"}。下方微小的制作人员名单为 {argument name="director credit" default="総監督：ペコちゃん"}。

主体细节：船上需准确展示三只白色斑点小海豹：1) 左侧船头的一只小海豹，正拿着黄铜望远镜眯眼微笑；2) 位于木制舵轮中央的一只较大海豹，正开心地大笑，鳍状肢扶着舵轮；3) 右侧的一只小海豹，正欢快地挥动一只鳍状肢。三只海豹均拥有圆润的身体、灰色斑点、细小的胡须、黑色的眼睛以及可爱的张嘴微笑表情。

船只与道具：一艘质朴的木制帆船，具有清晰的木板纹理、弯曲的船头、桅杆、绳索、索具、棕褐色船帆、木桶、盘绕的绳索、小灯笼、盒子上的指南针、滑轮、栏杆以及向观众延伸的船首斜桅。甲板上可见的道具需精确统计为六件：黄铜望远镜、木桶、指南针、灯笼、盘绕的绳索以及绳索滑轮索具。

背景：左侧地平线上展示一座雾气缭绕的传说之岛，岛上有悬崖、高耸的灯塔、小型沿海城镇、绿色山丘以及部分隐没在雾中的远山。船只航行在生动的蓝绿色波浪与白色浪花之间，上方是梦幻般的云层天空。

视觉风格：日式儿童冒险电影插画海报，水彩渲染，精细的棕色墨水勾线，柔和的渐变，具有类似 Studio Ghibli 的怀旧温暖感（非直接模仿特定电影），表情生动，电影级构图，细节丰富且温馨舒适。

约束条件：保持标题清晰且占据主导地位，仅使用指定的可见文字，保持三只海豹的数量，不出现人类，不出现现代科技，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: AI-Generated Board Report Slide

titleLocalized.zh: AI 生成的项目报告 Slides

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean Japanese corporate presentation slide for {argument name="company name" default="GROWTH DRIVER"}, showing that an AI tool can convert analysis into board/executive PowerPoint materials in one conversation.

Canvas: 16:9 widescreen slide, white background, polished consulting-deck style with navy and bright blue accents, subtle shadows, precise grid alignment, crisp vector charts, realistic miniature slide thumbnails.

Header: Top left contains a simple angular red-and-blue logo mark, the brand text “GROWTH DRIVER” and small Japanese subtitle “グロースドライバー”. Top right shows page number “11 / 21”. Large bold navy Japanese headline: {argument name="headline text" default="分析だけで終わらない：プレゼン資料も同じ会話で出る"}. Under it, smaller gray subheading: {argument name="subheading text" default="「これを役員説明用の PowerPoint にして」と頼んだ結果（架空サンプル12枚）"}.

Layout: Left side has a vertical blue annotation reading “Claude が生成した 役員報告資料”. The main area contains exactly 12 small white slide cards arranged in a 4-column by 3-row grid, each with a small navy numbered square in the top-left corner, a Japanese title, chart content, and light gray drop shadow. Use consistent blue chart styling and dense but readable board-report visuals.

The 12 slide cards, counted and labeled exactly:
1. “エグゼクティブサマリー” — checklist-style executive summary with four checkmarks and a tiny bar chart showing FY2021–FY2024 values 120, 147, 176, 209.
2. “業績ハイライト” — four KPI tiles: 売上高 209億円 +18.7%, 営業利益 26.3億円 +28.1%, 粗利率 31.5% +2.3pt, EBITDA 33.8億円 +24.6%.
3. “売上高の推移” — blue vertical bar chart FY2021 120, FY2022 147, FY2023 176, FY2024 209, with a callout “CAGR +20.3%”.
4. “売上の構成（FY2024）” — donut chart with center “209 億円” and legend: 製品販売 45%, サブスクリプション 30%, サービス 20%, その他 5%.
5. “顧客セグメント別売上（FY2024）” — horizontal bar chart: エンタープライズ 98 (47%), 中堅企業 63 (30%), SMB 31 (15%), その他 17 (8%).
6. “成長ドライバーの分解” — waterfall chart from FY2023売上 176 through increments +14, +12, +5, +2 to FY2024売上 209.
7. “粗利率の推移” — line chart from FY2021 25.4%, FY2022 27.8%, FY2023 29.2%, FY2024 31.5%.
8. “費用構造の変化（売上比）” — stacked column chart for FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 with legend: その他費用, 販管費, 研究開発費, 売上原価.
9. “地域別売上（FY2024）” — donut chart with center “209 億円” and legend: 日本 60%, 北米 25%, 欧州 10%, アジア 5%.
10. “パイプライン状況” — funnel chart plus text: 受注パイプライン（今後12カ月）312億円（前年比 +22%）, stages リード 1,120億円, 商談 512億円, 提案 312億円, 受注確度高 184億円.
11. “今後の注力領域” — three blue circular icons with short Japanese strategy notes: プロダクト強化, 市場拡大, 収益性向上.
12. “まとめ” — checklist with five blue check icons summarizing growth, new customers, margin improvement, strong pipeline, and strategic investment.

Bottom callout: A wide rounded pale-blue banner spans the lower slide. On the left of the banner is a small circular blue icon resembling an AI assistant/robot face. Large bold blue Japanese text reads: {argument name="bottom message" default="分析 → 資料化 までを 1 つの会話で完結。手戻りなし"}.

Visual style: Executive SaaS/consulting presentation aesthetic, minimal, high information density, strong hierarchy, navy typography, white cards, blue charts, subtle gray borders and shadows. Keep all 12 cards visible and evenly spaced. No people, no photos, no decorative clutter, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="company name" default="GROWTH DRIVER"} 创建一张简洁的日式企业演示 Slides，展示 AI 工具如何通过一次对话将分析结果转化为项目/执行层 PowerPoint 材料。

画布：16:9 宽屏 Slides，白色背景，精致的咨询风格，配有海军蓝和亮蓝色点缀，带有柔和阴影、精确的网格对齐、清晰的矢量图表以及逼真的微缩 Slides 缩略图。

页眉：左上角包含一个简单的红蓝角标 Logo，品牌文字“GROWTH DRIVER”及小型日文副标题“グロースドライバー”。右上角显示页码“11 / 21”。左侧为醒目的海军蓝日文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="分析だけで終わらない：プレゼン資料も同じ会話で出る"}。下方为较小的灰色副标题：{argument name="subheading text" default="「これを役員説明用の PowerPoint にして」と頼んだ結果（架空サンプル12枚）"}。

布局：左侧有一条蓝色竖向标注，写着“Claude が生成した 役員報告資料”。主要区域包含 12 张排列整齐的白色 Slides 卡片（4 列 3 行），每张卡片的左上角都有一个海军蓝色的数字方块、日文标题、图表内容及浅灰色投影。使用统一的蓝色图表样式，呈现密集但易读的项目报告视觉效果。

12 张 Slides 卡片，精确计数并标注如下：
1. “エグゼクティブサマリー” — 清单式执行摘要，包含四个勾选标记，以及一个显示 FY2021–FY2024 数值（120, 147, 176, 209）的小型柱状图。
2. “業績ハイライト” — 四个 KPI 磁贴：売上高 209 億円 +18.7%, 営業利益 26.3 億円 +28.1%, 粗利率 31.5% +2.3pt, EBITDA 33.8 億円 +24.6%。
3. “売上高の推移” — 蓝色垂直柱状图，FY2021 120, FY2022 147, FY2023 176, FY2024 209，并附有标注“CAGR +20.3%”。
4. “売上の構成（FY2024）” — 环形图，中心显示“209 億円”，图例：製品販売 45%, サブスクリプション 30%, サービス 20%, その他 5%。
5. “顧客セグメント別売上（FY2024）” — 水平柱状图：エンタープライズ 98 (47%), 中堅企業 63 (30%), SMB 31 (15%), その他 17 (8%)。
6. “成長ドライバーの分解” — 瀑布图，从 FY2023 売上 176 经过 +14, +12, +5, +2 的增量，达到 FY2024 売上 209。
7. “粗利率の推移” — 折线图，从 FY2021 25.4%, FY2022 27.8%, FY2023 29.2%, FY2024 31.5%。
8. “費用構造の変化（売上比）” — FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 的堆叠柱状图，图例：その他費用, 販管費, 研究開発費, 売上原価。
9. “地域別売上（FY2024）” — 环形图，中心显示“209 億円”，图例：日本 60%, 北米 25%, 欧州 10%, アジア 5%。
10. “パイプライン状況” — 漏斗图及文字：受注パイプライン（今後12カ月）312 億円（前年比 +22%），阶段包括：リード 1,120 億円, 商談 512 億円, 提案 312 億円, 受注確度高 184 億円。
11. “今後の注力領域” — 三个蓝色圆形图标，配有简短的日文战略说明：プロダクト強化, 市場拡大, 収益性向上。
12. “まとめ” — 带有五个蓝色勾选图标的清单，总结了增长、新客户、利润率提升、强劲的管道及战略投资。

底部标注：一个宽大的圆角浅蓝色横幅横跨 Slides 底部。横幅左侧是一个类似 AI Agent/机器人脸部的小型圆形蓝色图标。醒目的蓝色日文大字写着：{argument name="bottom message" default="分析 → 資料化 までを 1 つの会話で完結。手戻りなし"}。

视觉风格：执行级 SaaS/咨询演示美学，极简，高信息密度，强层级感，海军蓝排版，白色卡片，蓝色图表，细微的灰色边框和阴影。保持所有 12 张卡片可见且间距均匀。无人物，无照片，无装饰性杂乱元素，无水印。

templates.title: Rainy Cyberpunk Alley Sword Duel

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中赛博朋克巷战剑斗

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic dark anime battle scene in a rain-soaked cyberpunk alley at night, wide horizontal 16:9 composition, low camera angle near the wet pavement with dramatic perspective. On the left foreground, show {argument name="male fighter" default="a rugged dark-haired swordsman in torn black tactical clothing and a long ragged coat"} lunging forward in a wide aggressive stance, body mostly in shadow, holding a katana with both hands and thrusting the blade horizontally toward his opponent. On the right midground, show {argument name="female fighter" default="a petite pale-blue-haired elf girl with pointed ears"} in an ornate layered white frilly combat dress with armor-like details, thigh straps, white boots, and a small fantasy spear or halberd held defensively; she faces the swordsman with a tense ready posture. The two visible weapons should form a strong diagonal crossing line through the center of the frame, emphasizing imminent impact without showing contact. The setting is a narrow dystopian city alley with tall dark buildings, metal shutters, pipes, cables, fire escapes, vents, scattered crates, distant windows, mist, smoke, and glowing streetlamps; the ground is covered in puddles reflecting orange and blue lights. Use moody cinematic lighting, heavy shadows, rim light on both fighters, rain haze, water splashes, subtle sparks or glowing particles, detailed anime illustration style, high contrast, gritty texture, dynamic action composition, no text, no watermark, avoid extra limbs or malformed hands, keep exactly two fighters and exactly two primary weapons.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级的暗黑动漫战斗场景，背景为雨夜中潮湿的赛博朋克巷道，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，低角度镜头贴近湿润的地面，呈现出极具张力的透视感。左侧前景展示 {argument name="male fighter" default="一名留着深色短发、身穿破损黑色战术服和长款褴褛风衣的硬汉剑客"}，身体大部处于阴影中，正以宽大的进攻姿态向前冲刺，双手持武士刀向对手水平刺出。右侧中景展示 {argument name="female fighter" default="一名留着淡蓝色长发、尖耳朵的娇小精灵少女"}，身穿华丽的层叠白色荷叶边战斗服，带有盔甲细节和腿带，脚蹬白色长靴，防御性地持有一柄小型奇幻长矛或戟；她正以紧张的准备姿态面对剑客。两件武器应在画面中心形成一条强有力的对角交叉线，在不接触的情况下强调即将到来的碰撞。场景设定为狭窄的反乌托邦城市巷道，背景包括高耸的深色建筑、金属百叶窗、管道、电缆、消防梯、通风口、散落的板条箱、远处的窗户、薄雾、烟雾和发光的路灯；地面布满水坑，反射着橙色和蓝色的光芒。运用情绪化的电影级布光、浓重的阴影、两名战士身上的轮廓光、雨雾、水花、细微的火花或发光粒子，采用精细的动漫插画风格，高对比度，粗粝的质感，动态的动作构图，无文字，无水印，避免多余的肢体或畸形的手部，严格保持两名战士和两件主要武器。

templates.title: Anime Fairy Demon Office Pin-Up

templates.prompt: Create a polished anime-style full-body character illustration on a clean white background: a glamorous adult fairy-demon woman named {argument name="character name" default="Patarin"} floating in a playful pin-up pose with one leg bent behind the other, one hand lifted near her head and the other extended outward. Add swirling luminous ribbon trails around her body and legs, tiny blue-white sparkles, and exactly 4 small glowing butterfly silhouettes scattered near the wings. Include pink handwritten Japanese text near the lower right reading {argument name="signature text" default="ぱたりん♡"}. Use glossy highlights, soft bloom, crisp cel-shaded anime rendering with painterly gradients, delicate magical particles, luminous pastel fantasy effects, and a vertical composition centered on the character. Avoid extra characters, avoid a detailed background, and keep the overall mood cute, stylish, and magical.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精美的动漫风格全身角色插画，背景为纯净的白色：一位迷人的成年妖精恶魔女性，名为 {argument name="character name" default="Patarin"}，以俏皮的海报姿势悬浮，一条腿向后弯曲，一只手抬至头部附近，另一只手向外伸展。她留着短波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="薄荷绿"}，带有柔和的刘海，长着尖尖的精灵耳、两只光泽弯曲的黑色恶魔角、一个蓝色小蝴蝶发饰，以及一条末端呈黑桃形的细长黑色恶魔尾巴。她的面部应被柔和地遮盖或保持无五官状态，在面部中心区域覆盖一个半透明的方形模糊效果。让她身穿修身海军蓝商务西装外套，内搭白色衬衫，领口系着蓝色蝴蝶结，下穿紧身黑色包臀迷你裙，搭配深棕色透明连裤袜和黑色亮面高跟鞋。赋予她成熟的曲线身材和自信的魔法少女气质，同时保持渲染的优雅与高细节度。在她身后，绘制 2 只巨大的半透明蝴蝶翅膀，左右各一，散发着青色、淡紫色、粉色和电光蓝色的光芒，翅膀由多个花瓣状部分组成，填充着淡淡的魔法符文和闪亮的线条。在她的身体和腿部周围添加旋转的发光丝带轨迹、细小的蓝白色火花，并在翅膀附近散布 4 只发光的小蝴蝶剪影。在右下角附近加入粉色的日文手写文字 {argument name="signature text" default="ぱたりん♡"}。采用亮面高光、柔和的泛光效果、清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染与绘画感渐变，结合精致的魔法粒子和发光的柔和奇幻效果，采用以角色为中心的垂直构图。避免出现额外角色，避免复杂的背景，整体氛围保持可爱、时尚且充满魔法感。

She holds a transparent umbrella covered in raindrops above her head, her face intentionally covered by a plain brown rectangular privacy block. One boot is planted on the reflective sidewalk while the other is lifted forward toward the camera, splashing water dramatically from the sole in a clear arc of droplets. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的竖版时尚街拍，画面中一位魅力十足的辣妹风格年轻女性正走在豪华酒店门外的深夜大雨中，采用靠近湿润路面的电影级低角度广角镜头。她头顶撑着一把布满雨滴的透明雨伞，面部被一个纯棕色矩形隐私遮挡块刻意遮住。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长波浪金发"} 垂在肩头，身穿 {argument name="outfit color" default="白色短款无袖上衣和米色百褶迷你裙"}，搭配细金链腰带，以及亮面的 {argument name="boot color" default="亮红色"} 膝下老花图案厚底雨靴。一只雨靴踩在反光的人行道上，另一只向前抬起朝向镜头，靴底溅起的水花形成一道清晰的弧线。她的左肩背着 1 个黑色设计师风格链条单肩包，包上装饰着 2 个豹纹泰迪熊毛绒挂件。增加珠宝细节：手镯、戒指、精致美甲，以及自信的时尚模特姿态。场景设定为 {argument name="location sign" default="THE PENINSULA"} 酒店门面，配有温暖的金色入口灯光、石材建筑、玻璃雨棚、灯笼、盆栽绿植，背景是雨水浸润的城市街道，延伸出汽车前灯、霓虹灯倒影和高楼大厦。强调湿润的皮肤质感、光亮的雨靴、透明雨伞骨架、闪烁的雨滴、水坑倒影、城市灯光虚化以及高端杂志的写实感。运用戏剧性的透视畸变、清晰的前景水花、丰富的对比度，以温暖的酒店灯光映衬冷色调的雨夜蓝黑色，画面中无其他人物，无水印。

templates.title: Businesswoman at Shibuya Station

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic street snapshot of {argument name="character description" default="a young blonde businesswoman"} standing in front of Shibuya Station in Tokyo on a busy weekday morning before work. She wears a navy business suit with a fitted blazer and trousers over a crisp white button-up shirt, a small necklace, and carries a black leather handbag on one arm. She holds a takeaway coffee cup in one hand and a silver smartphone in the other, as if checking messages during her commute. Her face is deliberately anonymized by a flat solid tan square censor block covering the entire facial area, while her shoulder-length blonde hair remains visible around it. The background shows the JR Shibuya Station entrance with readable signage including “JR”, “Shibuya Station”, and Japanese station text, plus urban buildings, signboards, railings, pavement, and many commuting pedestrians slightly out of focus. Use natural morning sunlight, realistic shadows, shallow depth of field, documentary photography style, 16:9 horizontal composition, eye-level perspective, crisp detail on the woman and softer busy city background. Keep the scene realistic and candid, with no illustration style, no extra text overlays, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的街头快照，画面主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位年轻的金发商务女性"}，时间设定在东京涩谷车站前繁忙的工作日早晨。她身穿海军蓝商务套装，内搭干练的白色衬衫，佩戴一条小巧的项链，手臂上挎着一个黑色皮质手提包。她一手拿着外带咖啡杯，另一手拿着银色智能手机，仿佛正在通勤途中查看信息。她的面部被一个平坦的纯棕色方块遮挡，使其匿名化，但肩部长度的金发依然清晰可见。背景展示了 JR 涩谷车站的入口，包含可辨认的“JR”、“Shibuya Station”及日文车站标识，以及城市建筑、项目、栏杆、人行道和许多略微失焦的通勤行人。采用自然的晨光、真实的阴影、浅景深、纪实摄影风格、16:9 横向构图、平视视角，人物细节清晰，城市背景忙碌而柔和。保持场景的真实感和抓拍感，无需插画风格，不要添加额外的文字叠加或水印。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格竖构图插画，描绘一位成年职场女性自信地站在明亮的现代办公室中。角色留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮黑色"} 的头发，扎成高高的凌乱丸子头，几缕发丝垂在脸颊旁，面部被一个平滑的方形马赛克遮挡，没有任何可见的五官。她身穿一件修身的黑色短款西装外套，袖子卷至七分长，内搭白色衬衫，系着窄版黑色领带，下身穿着黑色低腰修身西裤；服装细节刻画精细，包括光泽感的面料高光、清晰的纽扣、翻领、口袋盖、腰带环和利落的接缝。构图采用从大腿中部向上的低角度四分之三侧视图，躯干微微拱起向后倾斜，一只手勾在腰带附近，另一只手放在口袋处，突显出自信的时尚杂志拍摄姿态以及露出的腰部。场景设定在一个整洁的企业办公室，身后是巨大的落地窗、白色窗框，远处是拥有蓝色摩天大楼的明亮城市天际线，墙壁为米色，天花板为带有荧光灯的方块吊顶，地面为光泽感的浅色地板，配有深色踢脚线，左侧边缘隐约可见一把黑蓝色办公椅。运用来自窗户的戏剧性日光逆光效果、强烈的轮廓高光、柔和的阴影，采用高细节的赛璐珞动漫渲染风格、流畅的数字绘画手法、写实的办公室透视、锐利的线条，营造出专业的时尚插画质感。保持 3:4 的竖构图，以女性为中心，画面中不含任何文字、水印或额外角色。

templates.title: Annotated ChatGPT Multiple Image Outputs

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 多图输出标注示例

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot-style image of a ChatGPT image generation interface demonstrating multiple image outputs from one request.

Canvas: Landscape 16:9 screenshot crop, white background, resembling a mobile or narrow desktop chat interface. Keep the composition slightly zoomed in so the right edge of the image carousel is visible.

Layout: At the top right, place one rounded light-gray user message bubble containing Japanese text. Beneath it on the left, show the status line “Thought for 2m 7s ›” in light gray. Below that, show one large generated image preview with rounded corners, and a narrow strip of additional generated thumbnails on the right side.

Text content: The user bubble should read: “絵コンテを参考に今回のベた塗アニメMVで使用する背景イラストを被写体なしで10個作成してください。\nテイスト強めで汚らしっぷつぷ感はなくしてください。プロアニメーターとして画質はよくしてほしいです。\n16:9　n=10”. Highlight the “n=10” part as the key detail.

Generated image preview: The main preview is a pastel anime background illustration of an empty stylized street with no characters, inspired by a colorful East Asian shopping district. Use soft cel-shaded anime line art, bright pastel blue, pink, yellow, and mint tones, lanterns hanging from buildings, decorative circular signs, shopfronts on both sides, a centered vanishing point, and a decorative archway in the distance. The image should look like a professional anime MV background, 16:9, clean and polished.

Discrete visible elements to include: exactly 1 user message bubble; exactly 1 status line; exactly 1 large main generated image; exactly 3 narrow vertical thumbnails partially visible on the right, each showing a different pastel anime background; exactly 2 circular overlay buttons on the main preview, one dark “編集” edit button at bottom left and one white downward arrow download button near bottom right; exactly 1 small dark share/upload icon button at the lower-right corner of the main preview.

Annotation: Add thick hand-drawn yellow marker annotations over the screenshot: exactly 1 yellow circle around “n=10”, exactly 1 thick yellow arrow pointing from the circled “n=10” down toward the right-side thumbnail strip, and exactly 1 tall yellow bracket-like outline encircling the vertical thumbnail strip. The yellow marker should look casual and drawn by hand.

Style: Clean UI screenshot aesthetic with subtle antialiasing, light gray interface elements, Japanese text rendered legibly, and bright yellow annotation marks. Use {argument name="main annotation text" default="n=10"} as the highlighted parameter in the chat message. Keep the screenshot realistic, not a poster or infographic.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张逼真的 ChatGPT 图像生成界面截图，演示单次请求生成多张图像的效果。

画布：16:9 横向截图裁剪，白色背景，类似移动端或窄版桌面聊天界面。构图需稍微放大，以便露出图像轮廓的右边缘。

布局：右上角放置一个圆角浅灰色用户消息气泡，内含日语文本。其下方左侧显示浅灰色状态行“Thought for 2m 7s ›”。再下方显示一张带有圆角的大型生成图像预览，右侧显示一排窄条状的额外生成缩略图。

文本内容：用户气泡应显示：“絵コンテを参考に今回のベた塗アニメMVで使用する背景イラストを被写体なしで10個作成してください。
テイスト強めで汚らしっぷつぷ感はなくしてください。プロアニメーターとして画質はよくしてほしいです。
16:9　n=10”。将“n=10”部分作为关键细节进行高亮显示。

生成图像预览：主预览图为一张柔和的动漫风格背景插画，描绘了一条空旷且风格化的街道，无人物，灵感来自色彩丰富的东亚商业街。使用柔和的赛璐珞动漫线条，采用明亮的淡蓝色、粉色、黄色和薄荷色调，建筑物上悬挂着灯笼，装饰有圆形招牌，两侧为店面，中心为消失点，远处有一个装饰性拱门。图像应呈现出专业动漫 MV 背景的质感，16:9 比例，干净且精致。

需包含的独立可见元素：1 个用户消息气泡；1 行状态栏；1 张大型主生成图像；右侧部分可见 3 个窄垂直缩略图，每个缩略图展示不同的淡彩动漫背景；主预览图上有 2 个圆形叠加按钮，左下角为深色“编辑”按钮，右下角附近为白色向下箭头下载按钮；主预览图右下角有 1 个小型深色分享/上传图标按钮。

标注：在截图上添加粗体手绘黄色标记：在“n=10”周围画 1 个黄色圆圈，从圈出的“n=10”指向右侧缩略图条画 1 个粗黄色箭头，并在垂直缩略图条周围画 1 个高大的黄色括号状轮廓。黄色标记应看起来随意且为手绘风格。

风格：简洁的 UI 截图美学，带有细微的抗锯齿效果，浅灰色界面元素，日语文本清晰易读，并带有明亮的黄色标注。使用 {argument name="main annotation text" default="n=10"} 作为聊天消息中的高亮参数。保持截图的真实感，而非海报或信息图表。

templates.title: ChatGPT Apple Generation Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT Apple 生成截图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic vertical smartphone screenshot of the ChatGPT mobile app in dark mode, showing an image-generation conversation about an apple.

Canvas: Tall phone screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, black background, iPhone-style status bar at the top. The time reads 19:44, with cellular bars, 4G, and battery at 67%.

Layout: At the top are exactly 4 interface elements: a circular hamburger menu button on the left, a rounded pill labeled “Thinking” in blue text, a rounded button with an edit-pencil icon on the right, and a three-dot menu icon. Below, place one right-aligned user message bubble in dark reddish-brown with rounded corners containing exactly 3 lines of text: “PROMPT: {argument name="prompt text" default="机上のリンゴ"}”, “size={argument name="image size" default="1024×1024"}”, and “seed={argument name="seed value" default="1234"}”. Under it, show the gray status text “Thought for {argument name="thinking time" default="33s"}”.

Generated image card: Below the status text, show one large rounded-square image card with a photorealistic red apple centered on a wooden tabletop. The apple is glossy with red skin, yellow-green highlights near the top indentation, subtle vertical streaks, a small brown stem, and soft studio lighting. The background inside the photo is a plain pale gray wall above the wooden desk, slightly blurred. The card has large rounded corners and fills most of the screen width.

Overlays and bottom UI: Inside the lower-left of the image card, add one brown rounded button labeled “編集する”. Inside the lower-right, add one circular brown share button with a white upload/share arrow icon. Below the image card, add exactly one standalone ellipsis line: “…”. At the bottom, show a ChatGPT input bar with exactly 5 visible elements: a plus icon button, placeholder text “ChatGPT に質問する”, a small microphone icon, an orange circular voice-wave button, and the rounded dark text-field container.

Visual style: Authentic iOS ChatGPT app screenshot, dark theme, crisp UI, realistic spacing, clean sans-serif typography, no extra messages, no watermark, no browser chrome.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个逼真的 ChatGPT 移动端 App 竖屏截图（深色模式），展示关于苹果的图像生成对话。

画布：高长宽比手机截图，9:16 比例，黑色背景，顶部带有 iPhone 风格的状态栏。时间显示为 19:44，包含信号格、4G 图标以及 67% 的电量。

布局：顶部包含 4 个界面元素：左侧的圆形汉堡菜单按钮、蓝色文字的“Thinking”圆角胶囊按钮、右侧带有编辑铅笔图标的圆角按钮，以及一个三点菜单图标。下方放置一个右对齐的深红褐色圆角用户消息气泡，包含 3 行文字：“PROMPT: {argument name="prompt text" default="机上のリンゴ"}”、“size={argument name="image size" default="1024×1024"}”以及“seed={argument name="seed value" default="1234"}”。在其下方，显示灰色状态文本“Thought for {argument name="thinking time" default="33s"}”。

生成的图像卡片：在状态文本下方，展示一张大型圆角方形图像卡片，中心为木质桌面上的逼真红苹果。苹果表皮光亮，顶部凹陷处带有黄绿色高光，有细微的垂直纹理，带有一个小棕色果梗，并采用柔和的摄影棚灯光。照片背景为木桌上方平淡的浅灰色墙壁，略微模糊。卡片具有大圆角，占据屏幕大部分宽度。

叠加层与底部 UI：在图像卡片左下角，添加一个标注为“編集する”的棕色圆角按钮。在右下角，添加一个带有白色上传/分享箭头图标的圆形棕色分享按钮。在图像卡片下方，添加一个独立的省略号行：“…”。底部显示一个 ChatGPT 输入栏，包含 5 个可见元素：加号图标按钮、占位符文字“ChatGPT に質問する”、一个小麦克风图标、一个橙色圆形语音波形按钮，以及圆角深色文本框容器。

视觉风格：真实的 iOS ChatGPT App 截图，深色主题，界面清晰，间距真实，简洁的无衬线字体，无额外消息，无水印，无浏览器边框。

templates.title: Vintage Temperance Tarot Card Pair

titleLocalized.zh: 复古“节制”塔罗牌组合

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vintage tarot card design sheet showing exactly 2 cards side by side: the front of a tarot card on the left and the matching card back on the right.

Canvas: Landscape composition on a transparent-background checkerboard preview, with both cards vertically oriented, evenly spaced, and centered. Use aged cream paper, muted ink, weathered edges, and a hand-illustrated antique tarot aesthetic.

Left card, front design: A classic tarot card titled {argument name="card title" default="TEMPERANCE"} with the Roman numeral {argument name="roman numeral" default="XIV"} in a small top plaque. The card has an ornate botanical border with vines, small flowers, stars, and corner linework. In the center stands a serene feminine figure in a flowing {argument name="dress color" default="pale teal"} Greco-Roman style dress with a thigh slit, barefoot in shallow water, pouring liquid from one golden cup into another. The face is softly indistinct and painterly rather than detailed. Behind her are a radiant halo, scattered stars, a crescent moon, distant mountains, a river, flowers, grasses, and a small cute stone-cat statue on a pedestal at the right side. The lower title band contains large serif text reading TEMPERANCE.

Right card, back design: A matching ornate tarot card back with no title text. Use the same aged parchment tone and thin dark green-gold border. The center contains one large circular compass-star emblem: an 8-point star inside concentric circles, with a dark teal ring decorated with small gold dots. Around it, add a symmetrical sunburst of many fine rays extending outward. Include small vertical ornamental dots and diamond marks above and below the circle, plus geometric corner brackets and small square corner ornaments.

Visual style: Antique occult illustration, Art Nouveau-inspired tarot engraving, muted teal, sage green, ochre gold, cream parchment, fine ink hatching, slightly faded print texture, subtle stains, realistic paper grain, handmade line art.

Constraints: Show exactly 2 cards: 1 front card and 1 back card. Keep both cards the same size and orientation. Preserve the readable text {argument name="bottom title text" default="TEMPERANCE"} and XIV. Do not add extra cards, hands, mockup shadows, modern UI, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张复古塔罗牌设计图，精确展示并排的 2 张牌：左侧为塔罗牌正面，右侧为配套的牌背。

画布：横向构图，背景为透明棋盘格预览，两张牌均为垂直方向，间距均匀且居中。采用陈旧的米色纸张、柔和的墨色、风化的边缘以及手绘风格的古董塔罗牌美学。

左侧牌，正面设计：一张经典的塔罗牌，顶部小牌匾上标有 {argument name="card title" default="TEMPERANCE"} 和罗马数字 {argument name="roman numeral" default="XIV"}。牌面带有华丽的植物边框，装饰有藤蔓、小花、星星和角落线条。中心站立着一位宁静的女性形象，身穿飘逸的 {argument name="dress color" default="淡青色"} 希腊罗马风格长裙，裙摆开叉，赤脚站在浅水中，正将液体从一个金杯倒入另一个金杯。面部呈现柔和模糊的油画质感，而非细节刻画。她身后有放射状光环、散落的星星、新月、远山、河流、花草，右侧基座上有一尊可爱的小石猫雕像。底部的标题栏包含大号衬线字体，书写着 TEMPERANCE。

右侧牌，背面设计：一张配套的华丽塔罗牌背面，无标题文字。使用相同的陈旧羊皮纸色调和深绿金色细边框。中心包含一个巨大的圆形罗盘星徽章：同心圆内有一个 8 角星，深青色圆环上装饰着金色小点。周围添加对称的太阳光芒，由许多向外延伸的细射线组成。在圆圈上下方加入垂直装饰点和菱形标记，以及几何角落支架和方形角落装饰。

视觉风格：古董神秘学插画、受新艺术运动启发的塔罗牌雕刻、柔和青色、鼠尾草绿、赭石金、奶油色羊皮纸、精细墨水排线、略微褪色的印刷质感、细微污渍、逼真的纸张纹理、手工线条艺术。

限制：仅展示 2 张牌：1 张正面和 1 张背面。保持两张牌的大小和方向一致。保留可读文字 {argument name="bottom title text" default="TEMPERANCE"} 和 XIV。不要添加额外的牌、手部、样机阴影、现代 UI 或水印。

templates.title: Rose Garden Travel Postcard Flat Lay

templates.prompt: Create a nostalgic travel postcard-style flat lay on a soft beige linen cloth, warm morning sunlight with gentle shadows, romantic rose-garden theme. The main object is a large square instant-photo print with a thick white border, placed slightly tilted on the left; inside the photo is an outdoor breakfast table in a lush rose garden with pink rose bushes, distant green hills, and a softly blurred dreamy background. The breakfast scene contains exactly 7 visible food/table elements: a red patterned teacup filled with black coffee on a matching saucer, a white plate, two slices of toast, one peeled banana half, one round bread roll or macaron-like bun, a small pile of nuts or cereal grains, and a glass bowl with pale fruit topped with dark jam and a small green herb sprig. Around the main photo are travel keepsakes: at upper right, a wicker basket partially visible holding large pink roses and dark green leaves, tied with a dusty pink satin ribbon; at right center, a smaller vintage postcard angled under the main photo showing a European hill village and the title {argument name="postcard title" default="Jardin de la Rose"}, with printed location text “SAINT-CIRQ-LAPOPIE” and “FRANCE” plus a circular postal stamp; at lower left, a torn handmade note card with pink handwritten Japanese text {argument name="note text" default="まだ見ぬ景色と、心ときめく瞬間を探しにいこう。♡"}; at bottom, a translucent rose-pink gel pen lies diagonally; near the bottom center is a small gold keychain charm shaped like a pink rose with green leaves; at lower right, a partially cropped pink ticket reading “ROSERAIE DE L'HAY” and “ENTREE”. Add exactly 3 loose pale rose petals on the linen. Use soft pastel colors, realistic paper textures, slight film grain, shallow depth of field, delicate highlights, and a cozy handwritten postcard mood. No people, no modern electronics, no watermark. promptLocalized.zh: 在柔软的米色亚麻布上创作一张怀旧旅行明信片风格的平铺图，画面呈现温暖的晨光与柔和的阴影，主题为浪漫的玫瑰花园。主体是一张带有厚白边的方形拍立得照片，略微倾斜地放置在左侧；照片内容为郁郁葱葱的玫瑰花园中的户外早餐桌，背景有粉色玫瑰丛、远处的青山以及柔焦梦幻的虚化效果。早餐场景包含 7 个清晰可见的食物/餐桌元素：一个盛有黑咖啡的红色花纹茶杯及配套茶托、一个白盘子、两片吐司、半根剥皮香蕉、一个圆形面包或马卡龙状小圆面包、一小堆坚果或谷物，以及一个装有浅色水果、顶部点缀深色果酱和一小枝绿色香草的玻璃碗。主照片周围散落着旅行纪念品：右上角是一个部分可见的柳条篮，里面装着大朵粉色玫瑰和深绿色叶子，并系着一条灰粉色缎带；右侧中心是一张压在主照片下方的复古明信片，展示了一个欧洲山村，标题为 {argument name="postcard title" default="Jardin de la Rose"}，印有“SAINT-CIRQ-LAPOPIE”和“FRANCE”字样以及一个圆形邮戳；左下角是一张撕下的手工笔记卡片，上面有粉色的日文手写文字 {argument name="note text" default="まだ見ぬ景色と、心ときめく瞬間を探しにいこう。♡"}；底部斜放着一支半透明的玫瑰粉色中性笔；底部中心附近有一个粉色玫瑰造型的金色小钥匙扣，带有绿叶装饰；右下角是一张被部分裁剪的粉色门票，上面写着“ROSERAIE DE L'HAY”和“ENTREE”。在亚麻布上添加 3 片散落的浅色玫瑰花瓣。使用柔和的粉彩色调，呈现真实的纸张纹理、轻微的胶片颗粒感、浅景深、细腻的高光，营造出温馨的手写明信片氛围。画面中无人，无现代电子产品，无水印。整体构图应呈现出一段来自 {argument name="travel destination" default="法国"} 的玫瑰花园旅行回忆。

In the foreground center, a rugged swordsman with {argument name="hero hair" default="long dark curly hair"} wears an off-white loose linen shirt, dark trousers, a leather belt, a side dagger, and tall worn brown boots; he crouches forward with both hands gripping a sword, blocking an attack. On the right foreground, an opponent in dark blue-black plate armor with ornate gold trim, a closed helmet, layered leather straps, and tall boots lunges in with crossed blades, partially back-facing the viewer. On the left midground, a regal knight commander with {argument name="commander armor" default="polished silver plate armor and a white cape"} stands calmly with arms crossed, watching the duel. Behind them, place 5 armored guards standing in a loose line with spears and dark armor, slightly out of focus. The background is an old gray stone fortress wall with an arched gate, narrow windows, wooden palisade details, and a large dark blue hanging banner bearing a gold heraldic lion-like crest. Faces should be anonymized with simple flat brown rectangular face coverings on all clearly visible people, matching the image’s censored look. Emphasize gritty medieval realism, textured armor, scratches, dust, leather, cobblestone ground, dramatic action, shallow depth of field, no modern objects, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级中世纪奇幻模拟决斗场景，地点位于石砌城堡庭院中，根据氛围命名为 {argument name="scene theme" default="模拟战斗"}。使用 4:5 竖构图，采用写实的高细节摄影风格，表现正午强烈的阳光、尘土飞扬的空气，以及武器碰撞时飞溅的沙砾和细小火花。画面中需清晰可见 8 个人物：2 名前景决斗者、1 名高贵的装甲观察者，以及 5 名背景守卫。前景中央，一名粗犷的剑客留着 {argument name="hero hair" default="深色长卷发"}，身穿米白色宽松亚麻衬衫、深色长裤、皮带，腰间佩戴匕首，脚蹬高筒磨损的棕色靴子；他向前俯身，双手紧握长剑，正在格挡攻击。右侧前景中，一名身穿深蓝黑色板甲的对手，盔甲带有华丽的金色饰边，佩戴封闭式头盔，配有分层皮带和高筒靴，正交叉双刃发起猛攻，背部部分朝向观众。左侧中景处，一名威严的骑士指挥官身穿 {argument name="commander armor" default="抛光银色板甲和白色披风"}，双臂交叉冷静地注视着决斗。在他们身后，放置 5 名身穿深色盔甲的守卫，手持长矛站成松散的一排，处于轻微失焦状态。背景是一座古老的灰色石砌堡垒墙，带有拱形大门、狭窄的窗户、木制栅栏细节，以及一面悬挂的深蓝色大旗，旗帜上绘有金色的狮形纹章。所有清晰可见人物的面部均需进行匿名化处理，使用简单的平整棕色矩形遮挡，以符合图像的审查风格。强调粗犷的中世纪写实感，突出盔甲质感、划痕、灰尘、皮革、鹅卵石地面、戏剧性的动作感以及浅景深效果，画面中不得出现任何现代物品、文字或水印。

templates.title: Bold Gold Fashion Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Bold Gold 时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bold fashion magazine cover featuring {argument name="model description" default="a young woman with long light-brown hair wearing a white baseball cap and a black ribbed halter top"}, posed from the chest up against a glossy golden satin fabric background. The model is centered, cropped close, with a large opaque square censor block covering the entire face area from forehead to chin; the square should be a warm beige-brown tone matching the cover palette.

Canvas: Vertical portrait magazine cover, 3:4 aspect ratio, high-resolution editorial print design. Use a saturated golden-yellow background with dark chocolate-brown typography. The overall look should be luxurious, sporty, feminine, and unapologetically graphic.

Layout: Oversized condensed serif masthead text fills the top and continues behind the model, reading {argument name="masthead text" default="HER19845"}. The letters are extremely tall, tightly spaced, and partially obscured by the cap and hair. Place additional huge cropped numeral-like typography behind the model on the left-center. Keep the model in the center foreground, with the cap brim extending left. Use strong magazine-cover layering: background fabric, huge masthead, model, censor square, then smaller cover lines.

Visible text elements: Include exactly 8 distinct text/graphic label groups: 1) giant top masthead “HER19845”; 2) small left label “SPRING / SUMMER 2024”; 3) large stacked left cover line {argument name="left cover line" default="OWN EVERY FRAME"}; 4) small right tagline “BOLD FEMININE UNAPOLOGETIC”; 5) right-side label “EST. 19845” with a horizontal rule below it; 6) large lower-right title {argument name="main cover word" default="HER"}; 7) small lower-right caption “POWER IN FOCUS. STYLE IN MOTION.”; 8) tiny footer copyright “© HER19845 ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.” plus a small globe icon nearby.

Subject details: The white baseball cap should look softly wrinkled with dark navy cursive embroidery on the front. Hair falls around both sides of the censor square. The black halter top has visible ribbed texture and a deep neckline. Skin is warmly lit with editorial studio lighting.

Visual style: High-fashion magazine cover, sharp commercial photography mixed with bold graphic design, heavy contrast, warm gold palette, glossy satin folds, dramatic typography, clean print finish, no border.

Constraints: Keep all text in dark brown or near-black. Do not add extra headlines beyond the 8 listed groups. Keep the censor square perfectly rectangular, centered over the face, and opaque. Make the composition look like a finished luxury sports-fashion magazine cover, not a poster mockup.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张大胆的时尚杂志封面，主体为 {argument name="model description" default="一位留着浅棕色长发、戴着白色棒球帽并身穿黑色罗纹挂脖上衣的年轻女性"}，采用胸部以上构图，背景为光泽感金色缎面织物。模特居中，近景裁剪，面部区域（从额头到下巴）覆盖有一个大型不透明方形遮挡块；该方形应为与封面色调相符的暖米棕色。

画布：竖版肖像杂志封面，3:4 纵横比，高分辨率编辑类印刷设计。使用饱和的金色背景搭配深巧克力棕色字体。整体风格应兼具奢华、运动、女性化与鲜明的图形感。

布局：超大紧凑型衬线刊头文字填满顶部并延伸至模特身后，内容为 {argument name="masthead text" default="HER19845"}。字母极高，间距紧凑，部分被帽子和头发遮挡。在模特左侧中心放置额外的巨大裁剪数字类字体。保持模特位于前景中心，帽檐向左延伸。运用强烈的杂志封面分层效果：背景织物、巨大刊头、模特、遮挡方块，以及较小的封面文案。

可见文本元素：包含 8 组独特的文本/图形标签：1) 顶部巨大刊头“HER19845”；2) 左侧小标签“SPRING / SUMMER 2024”；3) 左侧大型堆叠封面文案 {argument name="left cover line" default="OWN EVERY FRAME"}；4) 右侧小标语“BOLD FEMININE UNAPOLOGETIC”；5) 右侧标签“EST. 19845”及其下方的水平线；6) 右下角大标题 {argument name="main cover word" default="HER"}；7) 右下角小说明文字“POWER IN FOCUS. STYLE IN MOTION.”；8) 底部微型版权声明“© HER19845 ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.”及旁边的一个小地球图标。

主体细节：白色棒球帽应呈现出轻微的褶皱感，正面带有深海军蓝色的草书刺绣。头发垂落在遮挡方块的两侧。黑色挂脖上衣具有明显的罗纹质感和深领口。皮肤在编辑类摄影棚灯光下呈现出温暖的光泽。

视觉风格：高级时尚杂志封面，锐利的商业摄影与大胆的平面设计相结合，高对比度，暖金色调，光泽缎面褶皱，戏剧性字体，干净的印刷质感，无边框。

约束条件：所有文字保持深棕色或接近黑色。除上述 8 组外，请勿添加额外的标题。遮挡方块必须保持完美的矩形，居中覆盖面部，且不透明。构图应呈现为成品奢华运动时尚杂志封面，而非海报样机。

templates.title: Censored Fantasy Cosplayer at Expo

titleLocalized.zh: 漫展上被遮挡面部的奇幻角色扮演者

templates.prompt: Create a realistic candid convention photo of an adult woman cosplayer posing close to the camera in a crowded indoor anime/game expo. She wears an ornate white-and-gold fantasy goddess costume with translucent off-shoulder draped sleeves, gold filigree trim, a jeweled necklace with a glowing opal-like pendant, dangling earrings, and an elaborate gold crown hairpiece with pearls and crystal ornaments. Her long dark brown hair is styled half-up with glossy waves. The composition is a vertical smartphone shot from slightly below chest height, tightly cropped from upper torso to head, with her arms extended outward as if posing; place a solid rectangular censor block over the face in a muted brown skin-tone color. Emphasize glossy fabric, metallic gold details, realistic skin lighting, and shallow depth of field. Background: busy exhibition hall with overhead black ceiling trusses, bright booth lights, blurred attendees, a large fantasy character poster on the left with Chinese calligraphy, and a glowing booth sign on the right. Use photorealistic detail, natural convention lighting, wide-angle phone perspective, and no watermark. Customize the setting as {argument name="event setting" default="crowded indoor anime/game expo"}, the costume theme as {argument name="costume theme" default="white-and-gold fantasy goddess"}, the jewelry centerpiece as {argument name="jewelry centerpiece" default="opal-like pendant"}, the censor block color as {argument name="censor block color" default="muted brown skin-tone"}, and the background poster text style as {argument name="background poster text style" default="Chinese calligraphy"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的漫展抓拍照片，拍摄一位成年女性角色扮演者在拥挤的室内动漫/游戏展会上近距离摆拍的画面。她身着华丽的白金配色奇幻女神服装，带有半透明的露肩垂坠袖、金色花丝饰边、镶嵌着发光蛋白石吊坠的珠宝项链、垂坠耳环，以及饰有珍珠和水晶的精致金色皇冠发饰。她留着深棕色长发，做成了光泽感的半扎波浪卷发型。构图为从胸部高度略下方拍摄的竖版手机照片，从上半身到头部进行紧凑裁剪，双臂向外伸展，仿佛在摆姿势；在面部位置放置一个哑光棕色肤色的实心矩形遮挡块。强调光泽面料、金属金色细节、写实的皮肤光影以及浅景深效果。背景：繁忙的展厅，上方有黑色天花板桁架、明亮的展位灯光、模糊的参会者，左侧有一张带有中文书法的大型奇幻角色海报，右侧有一个发光的展位招牌。使用写实细节、自然的漫展光影、广角手机视角，且无水印。自定义设置 {argument name="event setting" default="拥挤的室内动漫/游戏展会"}，服装主题 {argument name="costume theme" default="白金配色奇幻女神"}，珠宝核心饰品 {argument name="jewelry centerpiece" default="蛋白石吊坠"}，遮挡块颜色 {argument name="censor block color" default="哑光棕色肤色"}，以及背景海报文字风格 {argument name="background poster text style" default="中文书法"}。

templates.title: Anonymized Fantasy Cosplay Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 匿名化奇幻 Cosplay 自拍

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic vertical 3:4 smartphone selfie photo of an adult female cosplayer at a crowded game/anime convention booth, shot from slightly above chest height with both arms extended toward the camera. She wears an ornate ethereal fantasy costume in {argument name="costume colors" default="pale icy blue, white, silver, and gold"}: a low-cut sculptural bodice with metallic gold trim, translucent flowing gauze sleeves, layered sheer fabric, and a central blue flower ornament. Include exactly 6 prominent costume/accessory elements: 1 floral-and-gold hairpiece with pale blue ribbons on the left side of her dark hair, 1 pair of dangling pearl-like earrings, 1 delicate necklace with a long crystal pendant, 1 ornate structured bodice, 2 translucent sleeve drapes, and 1 central flower-and-gold chest ornament. Her face is deliberately anonymized by a large opaque square censor block in {argument name="censor block color" default="warm gray-brown"}, covering the entire face from forehead to chin while leaving the hair and accessories visible. The background is a busy indoor expo hall with harsh overhead lighting, ceiling trusses, many attendees in casual clothing, and exactly 3 visible large fantasy character displays/posters behind her: one tall illustrated banner on the upper left, one bright central fantasy banner, and one smaller dark blue screen/poster on the upper right. Use natural smartphone flash/ambient lighting, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, candid convention atmosphere, no text overlay, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度写实的 3:4 竖版智能手机自拍照片，场景设定在拥挤的游戏/动漫展位，由胸部略上方视角拍摄，双臂向镜头方向伸展。她穿着一套华丽空灵的奇幻服装，颜色为 {argument name="costume colors" default="淡冰蓝色、白色、银色和金色"}：低胸雕塑感紧身胸衣，配有金属金边、半透明飘逸纱袖、层叠的薄纱面料以及中央的蓝色花朵装饰。包含 6 个显眼的服装/配饰元素：左侧深色头发上装饰有 1 个带有淡蓝色丝带的花朵金饰发饰，1 对垂坠珍珠感耳环，1 条带有长水晶吊坠的精致项链，1 件华丽的结构化紧身胸衣，2 个半透明袖帘，以及 1 个中央花朵金饰胸针。她的面部被 {argument name="censor block color" default="暖灰褐色"} 的大型不透明方形遮挡块刻意匿名化，遮盖了从额头到下巴的整个面部，同时保留了头发和配饰可见。背景是繁忙的室内博览大厅，带有强烈的顶光、天花板桁架、许多穿着休闲装的参会者，以及她身后 3 个清晰可见的大型奇幻角色展示/海报：左上方一个高大的插画横幅，中间一个明亮的奇幻横幅，以及右上角一个较小的深蓝色屏幕/海报。使用自然的智能手机闪光灯/环境光，真实的皮肤纹理，浅景深，自然的漫展氛围，无文字叠加，无水印。

templates.title: Whimsical Pirate Girl on Ship Deck

titleLocalized.zh: 船甲板上的异想天开海盗女孩

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant vertical 2:3 cinematic fantasy adventure illustration in a polished 3D animated feature style. Show {argument name="character name" default="a young pirate girl"} standing full-body on the sunlit wooden deck of a pirate ship, confident pose with one hand on her hip and the other arm extended outward. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered solid medium-brown square mask with no facial features. She has abundant dark brown curly hair blowing in the sea breeze, tied with a bright pink bandana bow, and wears a cream lace-up pirate blouse with puffy sleeves, a short purple vest with gold trim, loose high-waisted purple trousers decorated with small gold stars, a wide brown belt with a large brass buckle and dangling chain, a pink patterned sash at one hip, brown cuffed pirate boots with gold star accents, and small gold jewelry. Perched on her shoulder is {argument name="companion creature" default="a cute tiny blue fantasy monkey-mouse mascot"} with huge round ears, big expressive eyes, a cheerful smile, colorful pink and blue feathers on its head, a curled tail, and a small gold star charm wand. The setting is a richly detailed pirate ship deck with ropes, barrels, chests, brass fittings, mast, rigging, and glowing golden sparkles around the character’s feet; behind her are striped cream-and-red sails and exactly 1 black pirate flag with a yellow skull-and-crossbones style emblem. In the background, show a turquoise ocean with foamy waves, a tropical island with cliffs and palm trees, fluffy white clouds, and exactly 4 white seagulls flying in the bright blue sky. Use warm golden-hour sunlight, saturated colors, rim lighting, shallow depth of field, dynamic composition, ultra-detailed textures, whimsical magical atmosphere, and high-end family adventure movie concept art quality. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的 2:3 纵向电影级奇幻冒险插图，采用精致的 3D 动画长片风格。展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻海盗女孩"} 全身站在阳光明媚的海盗船木质甲板上，姿态自信，一手叉腰，另一只手臂向外伸展。她的脸被一个居中的纯中棕色方形面具遮住，没有任何面部特征。她拥有浓密的深棕色卷发，在海风中飘动，系着粉色的头巾蝴蝶结；身穿奶油色系带海盗衬衫，配有泡泡袖、带金色饰边的短款紫色马甲、装饰着小金星的宽松高腰紫色长裤、带有大黄铜扣和悬挂链条的宽棕色腰带、一侧系着粉色图案腰带、带有金星装饰的棕色翻边海盗靴，以及小巧的金饰。她的肩膀上栖息着 {argument name="companion creature" default="一只可爱的蓝色奇幻猴鼠吉祥物"}，有着巨大的圆耳朵、大而生动的眼睛、开心的笑容、头上长着五彩的粉色和蓝色羽毛、卷曲的尾巴，以及一根带有小金星吊坠的魔杖。场景是细节丰富的海盗船甲板，配有绳索、木桶、宝箱、黄铜配件、桅杆、索具，角色脚下环绕着闪烁的金色光芒；她身后是奶油色和红色相间的条纹帆，以及 1 面带有黄色骷髅交叉骨标志的黑色海盗旗。背景展示了带有泡沫波浪的绿松石色海洋、带有悬崖和棕榈树的热带岛屿、蓬松的白云，以及 4 只在明亮蓝天中飞翔的白色海鸥。使用温暖的黄金时刻阳光、饱和的色彩、轮廓光、浅景深、动态构图、超精细纹理、异想天开的魔法氛围，以及高端家庭冒险电影概念艺术品质。无文字，无水印，无额外角色。
