templates.title: Rebellious Streetwear Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 叛逆街头风海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical fashion-editorial magazine poster for a rebellious streetwear brand identity centered on {argument name="character name" default="HER19845"}.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, clean off-white studio background with subtle paper grain and tiny registration-cross marks in all four corners.

Layout: Place one full-body female model in the center foreground, standing confidently with legs apart and hands in pockets. Behind her, fill almost the entire background with enormous condensed block typography reading {argument name="headline text" default="HER19845"}, cropped at the edges, using a gritty orange-to-pink-to-purple gradient with distressed texture. Add an energetic orange handwritten signature/scribble overlay across the right-middle area, partially crossing the model and the large number forms.

Subject details: The model has long highlighted brown-blonde hair and a deliberately anonymized blurred face. She wears a white cropped ribbed tank top, layered necklaces, an oversized black zip hoodie with white lining and colorful paint-splatter graphics, very loose black drawstring streetwear pants with orange, pink, and purple graffiti marks, and chunky black-white-orange sneakers. Pose is relaxed, confident, rebellious, fashion campaign style.

Visible text content: Include exactly 9 distinct text elements: 1) giant background headline: “HER19845”; 2) left bold tagline: “REBEL. UNFILTERED. ICON IN PROGRESS.”; 3) left paragraph: “Built on raw energy and real ambition. This is not for everyone. This is for HER.”; 4) lower-left issue line: “VOL. 08 / MMXXV”; 5) lower-left pink slogan stacked in three lines: “THE CULTURE / THE VISION / THE FUTURE”; 6) right bracketed label: “[HER19845]”; 7) small pink right slogan: “NOT YOURS. NEVER WAS.”; 8) bottom-left black-and-white label: “PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT”; 9) orange handwritten mark reading {argument name="signature text" default="After19845"}. Also include two tiny graphic icons under the right slogan: a simple globe icon and a small barcode.

Visual style: High-contrast studio fashion photography blended with bold graphic poster design, sharp full-body lighting, slight floor shadow, grunge print texture, contemporary youth-culture zine aesthetic, neon gradient typography, orange marker strokes, black/pink accent typography.

Constraints: Keep the model centered over the huge background word, maintain legible poster text, use no extra words beyond the 9 listed text elements, preserve the blurred/anonymized face, and make the final result look like a premium rebellious streetwear magazine cover.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为以 {argument name="character name" default="HER19845"} 为核心的叛逆街头品牌打造一张垂直时尚编辑杂志海报。

画布：肖像海报，2:3 纵横比，干净的灰白色摄影棚背景，带有细微的纸张纹理，四个角有微小的套准十字标记。

布局：将一名全身女性模特置于中心前景，自信站立，双腿分开，双手插兜。在她身后，用巨大的压缩块状字体填满几乎整个背景，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="HER19845"}，边缘进行裁剪，采用带有磨损质感的橙色到粉色再到紫色的渐变效果。在右中区域添加一个充满活力的橙色手写签名/涂鸦覆盖层，部分穿过模特和巨大的数字形状。

主体细节：模特留着挑染的棕金色长发，面部经过刻意模糊处理以保持匿名。她身穿白色短款罗纹背心、叠戴项链、带有白色内衬和彩色油漆喷溅图案的超大号黑色拉链连帽衫、带有橙色、粉色和紫色涂鸦标记的宽松黑色抽绳街头长裤，以及厚底黑白橙色运动鞋。姿势放松、自信、叛逆，呈现时尚广告大片风格。

可见文本内容：包含 9 个明确的文本元素：1) 巨大的背景标题：“HER19845”；2) 左侧粗体标语：“REBEL. UNFILTERED. ICON IN PROGRESS.”；3) 左侧段落：“Built on raw energy and real ambition. This is not for everyone. This is for HER.”；4) 左下角期号：“VOL. 08 / MMXXV”；5) 左下角分三行排列的粉色口号：“THE CULTURE / THE VISION / THE FUTURE”；6) 右侧括号标签：“[HER19845]”；7) 右侧小号粉色口号：“NOT YOURS. NEVER WAS.”；8) 左下角黑白标签：“PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT”；9) 橙色手写标记，内容为 {argument name="signature text" default="After19845"}。此外，在右侧口号下方包含两个微小的图形图标：一个简单的地球仪图标和一个小条形码。

视觉风格：高对比度摄影棚时尚摄影与大胆图形海报设计相结合，锐利的全身光影，轻微的地板阴影，垃圾印刷纹理，当代青年文化杂志美学，霓虹渐变排版，橙色记号笔笔触，黑色/粉色强调排版。

约束条件：保持模特位于巨大背景文字的中心，确保海报文字清晰易读，除上述 9 个文本元素外不要添加额外文字，保留模糊/匿名的面部效果，并使最终结果看起来像是一张高级叛逆街头服饰杂志封面。

templates.title: Streetwear Magazine Cover Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 街头潮流杂志封面海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bold vertical streetwear magazine-cover poster featuring a full-body urban fashion model standing in front of enormous distressed typography.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, off-white paper background with subtle grain, scuffs, and vintage print texture. Use bright daylight shadows on the floor, slightly low-angle fashion photography mixed with graphic-design magazine layout.

Main subject: A young woman streetwear model, centered and overlapping the typography, standing with legs apart and hands in pockets, confident relaxed pose. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She has long blonde hair and wears a dark baseball cap, a black oversized bomber jacket, a cropped white graphic T-shirt with a teddy bear print and the word “Rebel,” a chunky gold chain necklace, oversized dark gray cargo sweatpants with large side pockets and worn paint marks, and black-white-blue high-top sneakers. Make the clothing realistic, baggy, textured, and slightly worn.

Background typography: Place one huge word/number composition spanning almost the full height behind the subject: “HER19845”. Use extremely tall condensed block letters with distressed ink texture. Color count: 3 large color regions — hot pink for “HER,” orange-red for “19,” and deep blue for “845.” The subject should cover the center of the letters, but the text remains readable.

Visible text blocks: Include exactly 9 smaller graphic text elements around the poster: 1) top-left small blue text: “ISSUE No.19845 / CONFIDENCE IS SILENT / INSECURITIES ARE LOUD”; 2) top-center small blue text: “WORLDWIDE EDITION / MUSIC. FASHION. CULTURE.”; 3) top-right small blue text: “COPYRIGHT © 2024 / ALL RIGHTS RESERVED / THIS IS AN ORIGINAL ARTWORK” plus a small globe icon; 4) left-middle blue slogan: “NOT FOR EVERYONE / MADE FOR ME.” with a small globe/eye icon beneath; 5) large lower-left hot pink handwritten signature: “Rebel” with a simple crown doodle above it; 6) right-middle blue handwritten phrase: “Since / Day One” with a hot pink underline and paint drips; 7) bottom-left small blue text: “LOUD HEART. / CLEAR VISION.”; 8) bottom-left barcode with the number “19845”; 9) bottom-right blue parental advisory label reading “PARENTAL / ADVISORY / EXPLICIT CONTENT.”

Visual style: High-impact editorial streetwear poster, Y2K hip-hop magazine cover energy, screen-printed ink, distressed halftone texture, rough paper grain, bold pink/orange/blue palette, realistic subject cutout layered over flat graphic type, sharp sneaker details, soft cast shadow.

Customizable parameters: Use the huge background title {argument name="background title" default="HER19845"}, the handwritten signature {argument name="signature text" default="Rebel"}, the handwritten slogan {argument name="slogan text" default="Since Day One"}, the model outfit theme {argument name="outfit theme" default="oversized black bomber, cropped white graphic tee, dark gray cargo sweatpants, black-white-blue high-top sneakers"}, and the issue number {argument name="issue number" default="19845"}.

Constraints: Keep the composition poster-like and vertically centered, do not add extra people, keep exactly one full-body model, preserve the nine small text elements, keep the face obscured, and avoid any watermark or realistic brand logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张大胆的竖版街头潮流杂志封面海报，展示一位全身都市时尚模特站在巨大的做旧字体前。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，米白色纸张背景，带有细微的颗粒感、磨损痕迹和复古印刷质感。使用明亮的日光投影在地面上，结合低角度时尚摄影与平面设计杂志排版。

主体：一位年轻的女性街头潮流模特，居中且与字体部分重叠，双腿分开，双手插兜，姿态自信放松。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理。她留着金色长发，戴着深色棒球帽，身穿黑色超大款飞行员夹克、带有泰迪熊印花和“Rebel”字样的白色短款图形 T 恤、粗金链项链、带有大侧袋和磨损油漆痕迹的深灰色超大款工装运动裤，以及黑白蓝配色高帮运动鞋。服装需呈现出写实、宽松、有质感且略带磨损的效果。

背景排版：在主体后方放置一个跨越几乎整个高度的巨大单词/数字组合：“HER19845”。使用极高的压缩块状字体，并带有做旧墨迹质感。颜色方案：3 个大色块区域 —— “HER”为亮粉色，“19”为橙红色，“845”为深蓝色。主体应覆盖字母中心，但文字仍需保持可读性。

可见文本块：海报周围需包含 9 个精确的图形化文本元素：1) 左上角蓝色小字：“ISSUE No.19845 / CONFIDENCE IS SILENT / INSECURITIES ARE LOUD”；2) 顶部中心蓝色小字：“WORLDWIDE EDITION / MUSIC. FASHION. CULTURE.”；3) 右上角蓝色小字：“COPYRIGHT © 2024 / ALL RIGHTS RESERVED / THIS IS AN ORIGINAL ARTWORK”及一个小地球图标；4) 左侧中部蓝色标语：“NOT FOR EVERYONE / MADE FOR ME.”，下方带有一个小地球/眼睛图标；5) 左下角巨大的亮粉色手写签名：“Rebel”，上方有一个简单的皇冠涂鸦；6) 右侧中部蓝色手写短语：“Since / Day One”，带有亮粉色下划线和油漆滴落效果；7) 左下角蓝色小字：“LOUD HEART. / CLEAR VISION.”；8) 左下角条形码，数字为“19845”；9) 右下角蓝色家长指引标签，内容为“PARENTAL / ADVISORY / EXPLICIT CONTENT.”。

视觉风格：高冲击力的编辑风格街头潮流海报，Y2K 嘻哈杂志封面质感，丝网印刷墨迹，做旧半色调纹理，粗糙纸张颗粒，大胆的粉/橙/蓝配色，写实主体剪影叠加在平面图形字体之上，运动鞋细节清晰，带有柔和的投影。

可自定义参数：使用巨大的背景标题 {argument name="background title" default="HER19845"}、手写签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Rebel"}、手写标语 {argument name="slogan text" default="Since Day One"}、模特服装主题 {argument name="outfit theme" default="oversized black bomber, cropped white graphic tee, dark gray cargo sweatpants, black-white-blue high-top sneakers"} 以及期号 {argument name="issue number" default="19845"}。

约束条件：保持海报构图并垂直居中，不要添加额外人物，保持仅有一位全身模特，保留 9 个小文本元素，保持面部模糊，避免任何水印或现实中的品牌 Logo。

templates.title: Golden Hour Privacy Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻隐私肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical golden-hour portrait photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a young woman"} outdoors in a lush green forest or garden, shown from the shoulders up in left-facing side profile with her face deliberately covered by a large opaque square privacy block in warm medium brown. She has {argument name="hair color" default="light brown"} hair gathered into a loose messy bun at the back of her head, with many fine flyaway strands glowing in strong backlight. She wears a simple {argument name="top color" default="white"} spaghetti-strap tank top, exposing her shoulder and upper back. The scene is lit by low sun behind her head, creating bright rim light, warm amber highlights, lens flare, and circular bokeh throughout a softly blurred green background. Use a realistic DSLR look with shallow depth of field, natural skin texture on the visible neck and shoulder, warm cinematic color grading, and a candid intimate mood. Composition: portrait orientation, subject centered slightly right, head near the top third, shoulder and torso filling the lower half. Add a small subtle signature-like watermark near the bottom right and a small circular social-media-style icon beneath it. Avoid extra people, text, or props.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的黄金时刻肖像摄影作品，拍摄对象为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，背景位于郁郁葱葱的森林或花园中。画面展示其肩部以上、向左侧的侧面轮廓，面部被一个不透明的深棕色方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色"} 头发，在脑后盘成一个松散凌乱的发髻，许多细碎的发丝在强烈的背光下闪闪发光。她穿着一件简单的 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 细肩带背心，露出肩膀和上背部。场景由她脑后的低角度阳光照亮，营造出明亮的轮廓光、温暖的琥珀色高光、镜头光晕，以及在柔和模糊的绿色背景中呈现的圆形光斑。采用写实的单反相机视觉效果，具有浅景深、可见颈部和肩部的自然皮肤纹理、温暖的电影级调色以及真实亲密的氛围。构图：竖向构图，主体略微偏右，头部位于上方三分之一处，肩部和躯干填充下半部分。在右下角附近添加一个细微的签名式水印，并在其下方添加一个小的圆形社交媒体风格图标。避免出现额外的人员、文字或道具。

templates.title: Japanese Sunscreen Beauty Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 日系防晒霜美妆广告横幅

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bright Japanese skincare advertising banner for a daily-use sunscreen, with an airy luxury cosmetic feel and soft morning sunlight.

Canvas: Wide horizontal web banner, 1200×675 px, 16:9 aspect ratio. Use a very pale blue-white color palette, high-key lighting, soft shadows, and a clean minimalist Japanese beauty-ad aesthetic.

Layout: Split the composition into three main zones: left product hero, center typography and feature icons, right lifestyle model. On the left, place one tall transparent cylindrical pump bottle standing on a glossy reflective surface, occupying about 25% of the width. In the center, place large handwritten Japanese headline text in soft blue. On the right, show a young woman in a white camisole near a bright window, cropped from chest upward, turned slightly toward the camera; her face is covered by a large opaque beige square privacy block, while hair, ear, neck, shoulders, and upper chest remain visible. Background should be a sunlit white room with blurred window frames and a hint of green plant on the far right.

Product details: The bottle is clear glass/plastic with a frosted white sunscreen liquid inside, a shiny silver cylindrical cap, and delicate blue label typography. The bottle label should include: “SPF 50+”, “PA++++”, “UV PROTECTION SUNSCREEN”, “Daily Use UV Protector”, and “50mL / 1.69 FL.OZ.” Add a tiny sun icon above the SPF text.

Text content: At the top left, add small Japanese copy “紫外線から、肌をもっと美しく。” with a small English subtitle “Daily use sunscreen” beneath it. Center headline: {argument name="headline text" default="やさしく、つよく。"}. Bottom-center SPF claim: “SPF 50+ PA++++” in large blue text, plus a thin outlined rectangular label reading “国内最高基準値*”. Add a very small footnote below in pale blue, visually present but not overly legible.

Feature icons: Include exactly 3 small line icons beneath the headline, evenly spaced with thin vertical dividers: 1) sun icon with “UV” and Japanese label “強力UVカット”, 2) water droplet icon with label “うるおい 保湿ケア”, 3) sparkle icon with label “透明感 トーンアップ”. Use simple blue line art.

Model details: The model has {argument name="hair color" default="soft brown"} hair tied loosely up with wispy strands near the ear and neck, fair luminous skin, delicate shoulder line, and a white camisole strap. Her face must be obscured by a perfectly rectangular solid beige overlay, roughly from forehead to chin and spanning most of the face area, color close to warm gray-beige.

Visual style: Photorealistic product-ad composite, soft bloom, gentle lens flare, cool blue shadows, natural daylight, glossy reflection under bottle, lots of negative space, refined Japanese cosmetics branding. Keep all typography light blue, thin, elegant, and clean. Avoid clutter, extra products, additional people, logos, watermarks, or harsh contrast.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款日常防晒霜制作明亮的日系护肤广告横幅，营造轻盈奢华的化妆品氛围和柔和的晨光感。

画布：宽幅横向网页横幅，1200×675 像素，16:9 纵横比。使用极淡的蓝白色调、高调照明、柔和阴影，以及简洁的日系极简美妆广告美学。

布局：将构图分为三个主要区域：左侧产品主体、中央排版与功能图标、右侧生活方式模特。左侧放置一个高大的透明圆柱形按压瓶，立于光亮的反射面上，占据约 25% 的宽度。中央放置柔和蓝色的手写体日文大标题。右侧展示一名身穿白色吊带背心的年轻女性，靠近明亮的窗户，胸部以上构图，身体略微转向镜头；她的面部被一个巨大的不透明米色方形遮挡块覆盖，但头发、耳朵、颈部、肩膀和上胸部保持可见。背景应为阳光明媚的白色房间，带有模糊的窗框，最右侧隐约可见一株绿植。

产品细节：瓶身为透明玻璃/塑料材质，内部装有磨砂白色防晒乳液，配有闪亮的银色圆柱形瓶盖，瓶身标签采用精致的蓝色字体。瓶身标签应包含：“SPF 50+”、“PA++++”、“UV PROTECTION SUNSCREEN”、“Daily Use UV Protector”以及“50mL / 1.69 FL.OZ.”。在 SPF 文字上方添加一个小太阳图标。

文字内容：左上角添加简短日文文案“紫外線から、肌をもっと美しく。”，下方配有英文副标题“Daily use sunscreen”。中央标题：{argument name="headline text" default="やさしく、つよく。"}。底部中央 SPF 说明：“SPF 50+ PA++++”采用蓝色大字，外加一个细边框矩形标签，写着“国内最高基準値*”。在下方添加一行极小的淡蓝色脚注，视觉上可见但不过分清晰。

功能图标：在标题下方包含 3 个等间距排列的小型线条图标，中间用细垂直线分隔：1) 带有“UV”字样和日文标签“強力UVカット”的太阳图标，2) 带有标签“うるおい 保湿ケア”的水滴图标，3) 带有标签“透明感 トーンアップ”的闪光图标。使用简洁的蓝色线条艺术。

模特细节：模特拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和棕色"} 的头发，松散地盘起，耳边和颈部有几缕碎发，皮肤白皙透亮，肩部线条精致，穿着白色吊带背心。她的面部必须被一个完美的矩形实心米色遮罩覆盖，大致从额头到下巴，覆盖大部分面部区域，颜色接近暖灰米色。

视觉风格：照片级真实感产品广告合成，柔光效果，轻微的镜头光晕，冷蓝色阴影，自然日光，瓶底有光泽反射，留有大量负空间，精致的日系化妆品品牌感。所有字体保持浅蓝色、纤细、优雅且简洁。避免杂乱、多余产品、额外人物、标志、水印或强烈的对比。

templates.title: Pastel Pop Star Bus Wrap Ad

titleLocalized.zh: Pastel Pop Star 风格巴士车身广告

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic wide-angle street photo of a modern coach bus driving through a bright downtown business district, shown in full side profile from the left with slight motion blur on the road and background. The bus has a glossy full-body wrap advertisement in a pastel pop-star fan campaign style: a pink rear half blending into a turquoise front half, black tinted windows, turquoise front mirrors, and a pink roofline. The wrap contains exactly 1 large female celebrity portrait centered on the side of the bus, with long dark hair, a white sleeveless top, and the face intentionally covered by a soft rectangular blur for privacy. Add exactly 2 large hand-painted white script text phrases on the bus: “{argument name="left slogan" default="Welcome Back"}” on the rear pink section and “{argument name="right name" default="CHAse"}” on the turquoise front section. Add exactly 2 small heart graphics: one small pink heart above the left slogan and one small outlined pink heart next to the right name. The bus should be traveling on a multi-lane city road with white lane markings, glass office towers, trees, pedestrians, and urban signage in the background, all slightly blurred from speed. Use realistic daylight, crisp reflections, natural shadows, and the look of a real Korean-style bus wrapping advertisement photo posted on social media. Avoid extra text, logos, watermarks, or additional vehicles blocking the bus.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级真实的广角街拍，展示一辆现代长途巴士行驶在明亮的市中心商业区，从左侧全侧面视角拍摄，路面和背景带有轻微的动态模糊。巴士车身采用光面全包裹广告，呈现 Pastel Pop Star 粉丝应援风格：后半部分为粉色，过渡到前半部分为绿松石色；配备黑色车窗、绿松石色前视镜和粉色车顶线。车身侧面中心位置印有 1 张大型女性明星肖像，留着长黑发，身穿白色无袖上衣，面部为保护隐私特意添加了柔和的矩形模糊处理。在巴士上添加 2 处大型手写风格白色文字：后部粉色区域为“{argument name="left slogan" default="Welcome Back"}”，前部绿松石色区域为“{argument name="right name" default="CHAse"}”。添加 2 个小型心形图案：左侧标语上方有一个粉色小爱心，右侧名字旁边有一个粉色轮廓小爱心。巴士应行驶在多车道的城市道路上，背景包含白色车道线、玻璃办公大楼、树木、行人和城市标识，均因速度而略显模糊。采用真实的日光效果、清晰的反射、自然的阴影，呈现出社交媒体上常见的韩式巴士车身广告照片质感。避免出现多余的文字、Logo、水印或遮挡巴士的其他车辆。

templates.title: Photorealistic 8K Photo Restoration

titleLocalized.zh: 照片级真实感 8K 图像修复

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, restore and upscale it into an ultra-premium photorealistic 8K image. Keep 100% of the original identity, pose, framing, perspective, and composition unchanged: the dog remains centered close to the camera, holding the same flowers in its mouth, with the same yard and house setting behind it. Remove the heavy blur and pixelation, recover natural microdetails such as crisp eyes, realistic nose texture, individual whiskers, soft fur strands, flower petals, grass, house edges, and tree detail. Make the result look like a high-quality cinematic studio-grade photo with natural daylight, high contrast, rich but realistic colors, clean focus, and no artificial-looking reconstruction. Do not change the subject, do not add new objects, do not alter the expression, and do not stylize it as illustration or CGI. Enhancement strength: {argument name="enhancement strength" default="ultra-premium 8K cinematic restoration"}. Detail priority: {argument name="detail priority" default="sharp eyes, realistic pores, whiskers, fur, and flower texture"}. Color grade: {argument name="color grade" default="natural sunny high-contrast photorealism"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影质感的全身奇幻时尚肖像，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的女刺客"} 走在暗黑东方赛博朋克奇幻城市的雨夜街道上，正向观看者走来。她身穿精致的非对称黑色与深紫色层叠和服风格战斗服，配有透明袖子、皮革绑带、露出单腿的高开叉设计、修身腰封、悬挂的紫色水晶饰品、黑色露指手套以及亮面过膝露趾靴。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有紫色挑染的黑发"} 梳成凌乱的半丸子头，长发丝微微飘动。她的面部应被柔和的方形模糊效果刻意遮挡，而身体其余部分保持清晰。她左手拿着一把装饰着紫色水晶碎片的折叠黑扇。环境是一条带有强烈反射、雨雾和向背景延伸的紫光灯笼的湿润石板巷；一侧是高耸、苍白且布满裂纹的混凝土墙，另一侧通向阴影重重、垂直密集的城市，那里有宝塔般的阳台、悬挂结构、灯笼塔和远处的紫光。添加 2 个清晰可见的水晶簇：左下角地面长出一簇巨大的锯齿状紫色水晶，脚边有一块小的散落水晶碎片。采用戏剧性的低调照明，紫色与琥珀色高光，亮面雨湿路面，浅景深，逼真的织物纹理，华丽的暗黑奇幻风格，以及 2:3 的竖构图。无可见文字，无水印，无多余字符。

templates.title: Lian Zhi Dark Fantasy Character Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Lian Zhi 暗黑奇幻角色设计图

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished cinematic character design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="LIAN ZHI"}, an elegant dark-fantasy East Asian female vanguard strategist and signal commander with the alias {argument name="alias" default="The Silent Bloom"}.

Canvas: Wide horizontal concept-art board on an off-white paper background, clean museum-catalog spacing, premium game character art presentation. Use refined serif typography, tiny red seal marks, sparse annotation text, and a muted ink-wash aesthetic.

Main subject: Full-body central hero pose of a tall poised woman wearing ornate black lacquered armor over layered robes. Outfit colors are black silk, deep oxblood red, bronze gold, lotus gray, and pearl white. She has a high intricate updo with hairpins, dangling ornaments, red ribbons, and loose wisps. Her face should be softly blurred or anonymized. She holds an open folding war fan in one hand and a slim sword angled downward in the other. The costume includes armored shoulders, fitted bodice, layered belts and tassels, asymmetrical skirt panels, floral ink-wash fabric, black heeled boots, and subtle battle-worn metallic detailing.

Left information column: Large title text “{argument name="character name" default="LIAN ZHI"}” at top left with a small red stamp. Below it include readable character-sheet copy: “Alias: {argument name="alias" default="The Silent Bloom"}”, “Role: Vanguard • Strategist • Signal Commander”, “Core Theme”, “Grace in command. Precision without noise. She fights like a poem—measured, lethal, and unforgettable.” Then a “Personality” list with exactly 4 bullets: calm and observant; speaks little, sees everything; fiercely loyal, slow to trust; believes in control through clarity not force. Then a “Signature” section describing the war fan as a collapsible fan carrying coded signals, hidden blades, and her mother’s final message. Add vertical Chinese calligraphy near the lower left with an ink lotus illustration.

Layout and count requirements: Include exactly 1 large full-body hero illustration. Include exactly 3 smaller full-body turnaround views across the upper middle labeled “+ FRONT”, “BACK”, and “PROFILE”. Include exactly 6 head-and-shoulder expression portraits at upper right under “+ EXPRESSIONS”, arranged in two rows of three, each with the same blurred/anonymized face and different head angles or moods. Include exactly 4 rectangular detail close-ups along the lower middle labeled “+ DETAILS”: chest armor and collar, waist belt with charms and red cords, floral robe fabric panel, and armored heeled boot. Include exactly 1 signature prop display at lower right labeled “+ SIGNATURE PROP”: the open black-and-gold folding war fan with a red tassel and concealed blade. Include exactly 5 black silhouette thumbnails at the bottom left labeled “+ SILHOUETTE STUDY”, showing varied readable cloak-and-fan poses. Include exactly 6 color palette swatches labeled “COLOR PALETTE”: ink black, bloom red, bronze gold, lotus gray, pearl white, and warm off-white.

Visual style: Highly detailed AAA game concept art, fashion-costume design sheet, realistic painterly rendering, delicate ink floral motifs, antique bronze ornaments, red cords, subtle fabric translucency, precise linework, soft studio lighting, neutral shadows, balanced white space, elegant editorial layout.

Constraints: Keep the whole image as one cohesive character sheet, not separate posters. No modern UI elements, no watermark, no photorealistic face identity, no extra characters, no extra panels beyond the specified counts. Preserve the typography hierarchy and labels clearly while keeping the small descriptive text tasteful and secondary.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="LIAN ZHI"} 创建一张精致的电影级角色设计图，她是一位优雅的东亚暗黑奇幻风格女性先锋战略家兼信号指挥官，代号为 {argument name="alias" default="The Silent Bloom"}。

画布：宽幅横向概念艺术项目，米白色纸张背景，整洁的博物馆目录式排版，呈现高端游戏角色艺术效果。使用精致的衬线字体、微小的红色印章、稀疏的注释文字以及淡雅的水墨美学。

主体：画面中央为全身英雄姿态，一位高挑从容的女性，身着华丽的黑色漆面盔甲，内搭多层长袍。服装配色为黑丝绸、深牛血红、青铜金、莲藕灰和珍珠白。她梳着高耸精致的发髻，配有发簪、垂饰、红丝带和散落的发丝。面部应略微模糊或去个性化。她一手持展开的折叠战扇，另一手斜持一把纤细的长剑。服装包括肩甲、修身胸衣、多层腰带与流苏、不对称裙摆、花卉水墨面料、黑色高跟靴以及细微的战损金属细节。

左侧信息栏：左上角为大号标题文字“{argument name="character name" default="LIAN ZHI"}”及一枚红色小印章。下方包含清晰的角色说明文字：“Alias: {argument name="alias" default="The Silent Bloom"}”、“Role: 先锋 • 战略家 • 信号指挥官”、“Core Theme”、“优雅指挥。精准无声。她的战斗如诗一般——从容、致命且令人难忘。”随后是一个“Personality”列表，包含 4 个要点：冷静且善于观察；言语极少，洞察一切；极其忠诚，难以建立信任；坚信通过清晰而非武力来掌控局势。接着是“Signature”部分，描述那把战扇，它既是可折叠的信号扇，也藏有暗刃和她母亲留下的最后讯息。左下角添加竖排中文书法，并配以水墨莲花插图。

布局与数量要求：包含 1 张大型全身英雄插图。在上方中部包含 3 张较小的全身多角度视图，分别标注“+ FRONT”、“BACK”和“PROFILE”。在右上角“+ EXPRESSIONS”下方包含 6 张头部及肩部表情肖像，排列为两行三列，每张肖像面部均保持模糊/去个性化，且角度或情绪各异。在下方中部包含 4 张矩形细节特写，标注“+ DETAILS”：胸甲与领口、带有饰品和红绳的腰带、花卉长袍面料、以及带盔甲的高跟靴。在右下角包含 1 个标志性道具展示，标注“+ SIGNATURE PROP”：带有红流苏和隐藏刀刃的黑金折叠战扇。在左下角包含 5 个黑色剪影缩略图，标注“+ SILHOUETTE STUDY”，展示不同的斗篷与折扇姿态。在底部包含 6 个色块，标注“COLOR PALETTE”：水墨黑、花卉红、青铜金、莲藕灰、珍珠白和暖米白。

视觉风格：高细节 AAA 游戏概念艺术，时尚服装设计图，写实绘画渲染，精致的水墨花卉图案，古青铜饰品，红绳，细腻的织物半透明感，精准的线条，柔和的摄影棚灯光，中性阴影，平衡的留白，优雅的编辑排版。

约束：将整张图保持为一个连贯的角色设计图，而非独立的海报。无现代 UI 元素，无水印，无写实面部特征，无额外角色，除指定数量外不添加额外面板。清晰保留字体层级和标签，同时确保小字描述文字雅致且作为次要内容。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感超写实全身肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位女性海盗船长"}，她自信地站在海上 17 世纪帆船湿漉漉的木质甲板上，画面居中并面向观众，其面部为了保持匿名而被柔和的矩形模糊处理。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的深紫黑色头发"}，扎成凌乱的高发髻并垂下几缕发丝，身着华丽的叠层海盗装束：黑色刺绣长外套配金色镶边、合身深色束腰、奶油色荷叶边衬衫袖口、不对称破旧蕾丝裙、酒红色布料镶片、多条腰带、小袋、带扣、悬挂的饰品、一块小怀表、开叉至大腿露出一条腿，以及棕色高筒角斗士风格皮靴。她右手持一把长柄燧发枪，枪口向下。场景设定在明亮日光下的戏剧性海盗船甲板：蓝色海平线、白云、索具、船帆、桅杆五金件、木质栏杆、盘绕的绳索、木桶、板条箱以及反射着阳光的雨后湿滑木板。画面中必须包含 4 名背景船员：左侧一名蹲着或倚靠着正在点燃冒烟大炮的水手，船长身后索具附近一名远处的站立水手，右侧木桶旁一名正在操作绳索的水手，以及最右侧一名半身可见且面部模糊的无袖船员。画面中必须包含左侧 1 门正在喷出浓厚白烟的大炮、右侧 2 处显眼的盘绕绳索，以及右中背景处 2 个木桶。使用 {argument name="visual style" default="超细节电影感超写实风格"}，左上方自然日光，高对比度，浅景深，逼真的布料质感，风化的木材，黄铜与皮革细节，海雾，以及充满冒险色彩的剑客氛围。1:1 正方形构图，全身主体，低平视视角，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Extract First Storyboard Row

titleLocalized.zh: 提取首行项目

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source storyboard, extract only the first row of the storyboard and regenerate it as a standalone horizontal storyboard strip. Keep exactly 4 panels, preserving their original artwork, panel borders, numbering, shot labels, and action/dialogue text as closely as possible: 1) “EXT. SPACE – ESTABLISHING SHOT” with “A fleet approaches a hostile sector.” 2) “INT. COCKPIT – PROFILE SHOT” with “PILOT: This is our home. We protect it.” 3) “EXT. SPACE – ENEMY APPROACHES” with “Enemy fighters warp into view.” 4) “INT. COCKPIT – MEDIUM SHOT” with “PILOT: For honor. For tomorrow.” Remove the overall storyboard header, project/director/date information, and all panels after number 4. Place the four extracted panels in one clean row across the lower-middle of a wide white canvas, with generous blank white space above and around the strip. Do not add new imagery, new titles, watermarks, or extra panels. Optional customization: extract panels {argument name="panel range" default="1–4"} from the storyboard for a {argument name="scene duration" default="15-second scene"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为源项目，仅提取项目的第一行，并将其重新生成为独立的横向项目条。保留 4 个分镜，尽可能忠实地保留其原始艺术图、分镜边框、编号、镜头标签以及动作/对话文本：1) “EXT. SPACE – ESTABLISHING SHOT”，配文“A fleet approaches a hostile sector.”；2) “INT. COCKPIT – PROFILE SHOT”，配文“PILOT: This is our home. We protect it.”；3) “EXT. SPACE – ENEMY APPROACHES”，配文“Enemy fighters warp into view.”；4) “INT. COCKPIT – MEDIUM SHOT”，配文“PILOT: For honor. For tomorrow.”。移除整体项目页眉、项目/导演/日期信息以及第 4 个分镜之后的所有内容。将提取出的 4 个分镜放置在宽幅白色画布的中下部，形成整洁的一行，并在条带上方及周围留出充足的空白区域。请勿添加新的图像、标题、水印或额外的分镜。可选自定义：从项目中提取 {argument name="panel range" default="1–4"} 分镜，用于 {argument name="scene duration" default="15-second scene"}。

templates.title: Anime Street Fashion Woman

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫街头时尚女性

templates.prompt: Create a vertical full-body anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young stylish woman"} standing casually on a sunlit city sidewalk in front of a modern glass-and-metal building entrance, with a shallow depth-of-field urban background. She has short wavy {argument name="hair color" default="pale aqua-blue"} bob-length hair and wears large retro over-ear headphones in pink, tan, and gold; her face is intentionally covered by a plain soft beige rectangular censor block. Add a small white wispy line near her head suggesting smoke, steam, or breath. Outfit: oversized loose pink haori-style cardigan with wide sleeves, faded blue graphic T-shirt reading “Visit Palm Spring” with a retro motel, road, palm tree, and sunset illustration, high-waisted tan pleated trousers rolled at the cuffs, a brown woven belt, off-white socks, and burgundy leather tassel loafers. She holds one cream canvas tote bag in her left hand, printed with a red circular logo reading “STRAND” and small website text near the bottom. Pose is relaxed and front-facing, one arm down holding the tote, the other mostly hidden by the cardigan, with natural clothing folds and soft shadows. Use cinematic anime rendering with clean line art, muted pastel colors, realistic proportions, subtle film-like lighting, and a contemporary street-fashion editorial feel. Vertical composition, full body centered, no extra people, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版全身动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位时尚年轻女性"} 随意地站在阳光明媚的城市人行道上，背景是现代玻璃金属建筑入口，并带有浅景深的城市背景。她留着波浪状的 {argument name="hair color" default="淡水蓝色"} 波波头，戴着粉色、棕褐色和金色相间的大型复古头戴式耳机；她的脸部被一个朴素的米色矩形遮挡块刻意遮住。在她的头部附近添加一缕细小的白色线条，暗示烟雾、蒸汽或呼吸。服装：超大宽松的粉色羽织风格开衫，袖口宽大；褪色的蓝色印花 T 恤，上面写着“Visit Palm Spring”，并配有复古汽车旅馆、道路、棕榈树和日落插图；高腰棕褐色褶皱长裤，裤脚卷起；棕色编织腰带；米白色袜子；以及酒红色皮革流苏乐福鞋。她左手拿着一个奶油色帆布托特包，上面印有红色的圆形标志“STRAND”，底部附近有小的网站文字。姿势放松且面向前方，一只手臂下垂拿着托特包，另一只手臂大部分被开衫遮住，衣物褶皱自然，阴影柔和。采用电影级动漫渲染，线条清晰，柔和的粉彩色调，比例写实，具有微妙的胶片感光影和现代街头时尚杂志的质感。竖构图，全身居中，无额外人物，无水印。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Energy Awakening

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫能量觉醒

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime key visual of {argument name="character name" default="a faceless cyberpunk heroine"} standing full-body from a low-angle perspective in the center of a dark futuristic city canyon. The character has wild, voluminous {argument name="hair color" default="silver-gray"} hair blown upward by energy, a deliberately obscured smooth blurred square over the face, and large metallic gold headphones over one ear. Outfit: exactly 6 visible clothing/accessory pieces — a loose translucent lavender-pink open coat whipping outward, a blue retro tourist T-shirt reading “Visit Palm Spring” with a small sunset motel graphic, high-waisted brown pleated trousers with rolled cuffs, a dark braided belt with gold buckle, white socks, and burgundy leather lace-up shoes. Pose: powerful upright stance with one hand in the trouser pocket, coat and hair floating as if gravity is distorted. Surround the character with an explosive vertical aura of cyan, turquoise, electric blue, and magenta plasma, with lightning filaments, glowing particle sparks, crystalline shards, floating rocks, and circular shockwave rings erupting from cracked ground at the feet. Background: deep black-blue neon alley or sci-fi city corridor with faint holographic panels and exactly 2 large glowing vertical kanji-like text elements, one on the left and one on the right, styled as cyan neon signs. Lighting is extreme backlight and rim light, with bloom, lens streaks, prismatic fragments, high contrast, and luminous energy reflections on clothing. Style: highly detailed modern anime illustration, cinematic composition, dynamic perspective, painterly rendering mixed with crisp linework, ultra vibrant cyberpunk fantasy energy, no frame, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有戏剧张力的竖屏动漫关键视觉图，画面中心为 {argument name="character name" default="一位无面赛博朋克女英雄"}，采用低角度仰拍视角，全身立于黑暗的未来城市峡谷中。角色拥有一头蓬松狂野的 {argument name="hair color" default="银灰色"} 长发，被能量向上吹起；面部覆盖着一个刻意模糊的平滑方形遮挡，单耳佩戴着大型金属金色耳机。服装：共 6 件可见的衣物/配饰——一件向外飘舞的宽松半透明淡紫色开衫外套、一件印有“Visit Palm Spring”字样及小型日落汽车旅馆图案的蓝色复古旅游 T 恤、高腰棕色百褶长裤（卷边）、带有金色扣环的深色编织腰带、白色短袜以及酒红色皮革系带鞋。姿势：强有力的直立站姿，一只手插在裤兜里，外套和头发仿佛在重力扭曲下漂浮。角色周围环绕着青色、绿松石色、电光蓝和洋红色的爆炸性垂直等离子光环，伴有闪电丝、发光的粒子火花、晶体碎片、漂浮岩石以及从脚下开裂地面喷涌而出的圆形冲击波环。背景：深蓝黑色的霓虹小巷或科幻城市走廊，带有微弱的全息面板，左右两侧各有一个巨大的发光垂直汉字风格文字元素，设计为青色霓虹灯牌。光效为极致的背光和轮廓光，带有光晕、镜头光斑、棱镜碎片、高对比度以及衣物上的发光能量反射。风格：高度精细的现代动漫插画，电影级构图，动态视角，绘画感渲染与清晰线条相结合，超鲜艳的赛博朋克奇幻能量，无边框，无水印，无额外角色。

templates.title: Pastel Peach Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和桃色时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic low-angle 35mm studio fashion portrait of a stylish {argument name="model gender" default="male"} model standing confidently in a monochromatic pastel peach cube room. The camera looks upward from waist level, vertical 9:16 composition, with the model centered and cropped around the upper thighs to head area. The room has sharp geometric architecture: peach walls, ceiling, and floor forming a cube-like corner, with large triangular sliced-panel facets across the walls and ceiling. Add exactly three visible glowing soft-white linear light strips: one diagonal strip along the ceiling from upper left toward center, one diagonal strip on the left wall rising from mid-left to the center, and one diagonal strip on the right wall rising from mid-right to the center, creating a luminous X-like background. The model wears a crisp open-collar {argument name="shirt color" default="ivory"} dress shirt tucked into high-waisted wide-leg {argument name="trouser color" default="cream"} trousers, plus a tailored blazer with a bold abstract camouflage-style pattern in {argument name="blazer colors" default="teal blue, burnt orange, ivory, and beige"}. Pose him with relaxed shoulders, one hand in a trouser pocket and the other arm hanging naturally, projecting high-fashion editorial confidence. Use glossy polished studio lighting, soft reflections, clean shadows, realistic fabric texture, accurate tailoring details, and warm peach color grading. The model’s face is covered by a centered soft-edged rectangular blur in a warm brown skin-tone color, while dark styled hair remains visible above it. Include a small four-point sparkle/star mark in the lower-right corner. No text, no logos, no extra people, no props.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的低角度 35mm 影棚时尚肖像，展示一位时尚的 {argument name="model gender" default="男性"} 模特自信地站在单色柔和桃色立方体房间内。相机从腰部高度向上仰拍，采用 9:16 竖构图，模特居中，画面从大腿上部裁剪至头部。房间具有鲜明的几何建筑感：桃色的墙壁、天花板和地板构成一个立方体角落，墙壁和天花板上布满了巨大的三角形切片面板。添加三条清晰可见的发光柔白线性灯带：一条沿天花板从左上角向中心延伸，一条在左墙上从左中向中心上升，一条在右墙上从右中向中心上升，从而营造出明亮的 X 型背景。模特身穿一件干练的开领 {argument name="shirt color" default="象牙白"} 衬衫，塞进高腰阔腿 {argument name="trouser color" default="奶油色"} 长裤中，外搭一件剪裁考究的西装外套，外套带有 {argument name="blazer colors" default="青蓝色、焦橙色、象牙白和米色"} 的大胆抽象迷彩风格图案。让他保持肩膀放松的姿势，一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手臂自然下垂，展现出高端时尚杂志的自信感。使用光泽感十足的影棚灯光、柔和的反射、干净的阴影、逼真的面料质感、精准的剪裁细节以及温暖的桃色调色。模特的脸部被一个居中的柔边矩形模糊效果遮盖，颜色为温暖的棕色肤色，但深色造型发型在模糊区域上方依然可见。在右下角添加一个小型的四角星光标记。画面中无文字、无标志、无额外人物、无道具。

templates.title: Fisheye Staircase Fashion Editorial

titleLocalized.zh: 鱼眼镜头楼梯时尚大片

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-cinematic fisheye low-angle fashion photograph inside a surreal futuristic all-white architectural interior. A {argument name="model gender" default="male"} fashion model leans directly over the camera from the edge of a giant floating spiral staircase, gripping the transparent glass railings with both hands, his face intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular mask. He has {argument name="hair color" default="deep blue-black"} swept-back hair and wears an ornate luxury brocade suit jacket in {argument name="jacket colors" default="burgundy and olive green"} with dense gold floral embroidery, a deep black shirt underneath, slim trousers, and dark polished shoes. The camera is positioned below and slightly in front of him, creating an extreme vertical fisheye perspective: his upper body dominates the top center while the spiral staircase plunges downward into an infinite repeating tunnel of white arches and glass balustrades. The environment is minimal, glossy, and futuristic, with massive smooth curved white walls, rounded cutouts, soft blue-gray shadows, and continuous glowing white LED strips tracing the stair edges, ceiling curves, and circular architectural lines. Use dramatic wide-angle distortion, high contrast between the ornate clothing and pristine white space, cool cinematic lighting, crisp architectural detail, realistic fashion editorial photography, symmetrical composition, deep depth, and a vertigo-inducing sense of height. No text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超电影质感的鱼眼低角度时尚摄影作品，场景位于超现实的未来主义全白建筑室内。一位 {argument name="model gender" default="男性"} 时尚模特从巨大的悬浮旋转楼梯边缘直接向镜头俯身，双手紧握透明玻璃栏杆，面部被一个简约的长方形面具刻意遮挡。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深蓝黑色"} 的后梳发型，身穿一件华丽的奢侈锦缎西装外套，颜色为 {argument name="jacket colors" default="酒红色和橄榄绿色"}，饰有密集的金色花卉刺绣，内搭深黑色衬衫，下身穿着修身长裤和深色抛光皮鞋。相机位于他下方略靠前的位置，营造出极端的垂直鱼眼透视效果：他的上半身占据顶部中心，而旋转楼梯向下延伸，形成一个由白色拱门和玻璃栏杆组成的无限重复隧道。环境极简、光洁且充满未来感，拥有巨大的光滑弧形白墙、圆形切口、柔和的蓝灰色阴影，以及沿着楼梯边缘、天花板曲线和圆形建筑线条延伸的连续发光白色 LED 灯带。运用戏剧性的广角畸变、华丽服装与纯净白色空间之间的高对比度、冷色调电影光效、清晰的建筑细节、写实的时尚摄影风格、对称构图、深邃的景深以及令人眩晕的高度感。无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: Low-Angle Fashion Portrait with Light Rings

titleLocalized.zh: 低角度光环时尚人像

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed 35mm low-angle studio fashion portrait of a stylish male model, {argument name="character description" default="a well-groomed adult man with dark slicked-back hair"}, standing centered on a giant curved white platform suspended just above a glossy reflective lavender floor. Shoot from a dramatic low angle with a slightly wide lens so the model appears tall and the shoes and floor reflection are visible at the bottom. He wears a bold tailored blazer with oversized tropical floral print in teal, burgundy, cream, and dark green, over a beige button-up shirt, slim tan trousers, and polished dark brown dress shoes. Above and behind his head are exactly 2 massive suspended circular light rings: one upper ring glowing soft lavender-white and one lower ring glowing pastel peach-warm white, both hanging from thin vertical cables. The background is a seamless curved studio wall in muted rose, salmon, and dusty pink tones with soft gradients. Use cinematic fashion editorial lighting, crisp fabric detail, glossy reflections on the floor, realistic skin and hair texture, shallow depth of field, symmetrical centered composition, luxurious futuristic set design, no text, no logos, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度细节化的 35mm 低角度摄影棚时尚人像，主角为一位时尚男模，{argument name="character description" default="一位发型整洁、梳着背头的成年男性"}，他站在一个巨大的弧形白色平台上，平台悬浮在光亮且具有反射感的淡紫色地板上方。采用极具戏剧性的低角度拍摄，配合略微广角镜头，使模特显得身材高挑，底部可见鞋子及地板倒影。他身穿一件大胆的定制西装外套，印有青色、酒红色、奶油色和深绿色的大型热带花卉图案，内搭米色衬衫，下穿修身棕褐色长裤，脚蹬锃亮的深棕色皮鞋。在他头部上方及后方悬挂着 2 个巨大的圆形光环：上方的光环发出柔和的淡紫白色光，下方的光环发出柔和的桃暖白色光，两者均由细垂直线缆悬挂。背景为无缝弧形摄影棚墙面，呈现出柔和的玫瑰色、鲑鱼粉和灰粉色调，带有细腻的渐变效果。采用电影级时尚杂志布光，呈现清晰的织物细节、地板上的光亮反射、逼真的皮肤与头发质感、浅景深、对称的中心构图、奢华的未来感布景设计，无文字、无 Logo、无水印。

templates.title: Anime Fashion Magazine Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫时尚杂志海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-fashion overseas magazine poster featuring an anime-style original character, using restrained typography, negative space, and an editorial mood rather than adding extra cuteness.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, off-white paper background with subtle concrete texture, faint stains, scratches, ink smudges, thin layout lines, and layered black rectangular graphic blocks.

Main subject: A delicate anime girl named {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"} posed from upper thighs to head, slightly angled, occupying the center and right side of the poster. She has very long pale blonde hair with soft highlights, flowing strands, and a large black bow hair accessory on the left side. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered muted beige square block, like a privacy mask or editorial placeholder. She wears a white frilled off-shoulder crop blouse with ruffles, puff sleeves, black straps, black bow accents, lace trim, and small jewelry details. Her lower outfit is a black plaid layered mini skirt with white frill underskirt, a wide black belt with silver buckle, hanging chains, and gothic street-fashion details. Her pose is refined and slightly mature: one hand near the ear, body relaxed, soft light on skin, elegant but youthful fashion-magazine atmosphere.

Layout and typography: Use large serif editorial typography in black and dark gray, mixed with small sans-serif captions. Put oversized stacked letters behind and beside the character reading “NO / ZO / MU” on the left half, partially hidden by the subject. Add fine rectangular frames and alignment guides around the typography.

Visible text content: Include exactly 8 distinct text areas: 1) top left title “NOZOMU” with small Japanese hiragana “のぞむ” beneath it; 2) small left headline “MODERN DREAMER.”; 3) small paragraph under it reading “SHE WALKS LIKE A THOUGHT THAT CHOSE TO SHINE.”; 4) large background typography “NO ZO MU”; 5) black strip near lower left reading “QUIET IMPACT.”; 6) tiny lower-left copy reading “NOT LOUD. NOT PERFECT. JUST UNFORGETTABLE.” plus small archive marks “///”, “N. 07”, and barcode lines; 7) top right label “ARCHIVE” with large number “07” and three small square dots; 8) right-side vertical text “OWN THE LIGHT.” beside a dark textured rectangular panel, plus a lower-right card reading “VISIBLE GRACE.” with small text “SOFT HEART. CLEAR VISION. STRONG PRESENCE.”

Visual style: Japanese anime illustration blended with Western fashion magazine poster design, monochrome editorial palette with warm cream, blush skin tones, pale blonde hair, black accents, and soft gray shadows. Use high detail in clothing, hair, chains, ruffles, and texture, while keeping the overall composition airy, elegant, and poster-like.

Constraints: Keep the square face-covering block visible and centered over the face; do not add extra characters; do not add more than the listed 8 text areas; avoid neon colors, clutter, logos, watermarks, or photorealistic rendering.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张以动漫风格原创角色为主角的高级感海外时尚杂志海报，运用克制的排版、留白艺术以及编辑风格的氛围，而非增加额外的可爱元素。

画布：1:1 正方形海报，米白色纸张背景，带有细微的混凝土质感、淡淡的污渍、划痕、墨迹、细线条排版以及分层的黑色矩形图形块。

主体：一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"} 的精致动漫少女，从大腿到头部出镜，身体略微倾斜，占据海报的中心和右侧。她拥有非常长的浅金色头发，带有柔和的高光和飘逸的发丝，左侧佩戴着一个巨大的黑色蝴蝶结发饰。她的面部被一个居中的柔和米色方块刻意遮挡，如同隐私遮罩或编辑占位符。她身穿白色荷叶边露肩短款上衣，配有褶皱、泡泡袖、黑色肩带、黑色蝴蝶结装饰、蕾丝花边和小型珠宝细节。下装为黑色格纹叠层迷你裙，内衬白色荷叶边，配有宽大的黑色银扣腰带、垂坠链条以及哥特街头时尚细节。姿势优雅且略显成熟：一只手靠近耳边，身体放松，皮肤上带有柔和的光影，营造出优雅而年轻的时尚杂志氛围。

布局与排版：使用黑色和深灰色的超大衬线体编辑排版，并混合小型无衬线体标题。在左半部分放置超大的堆叠字母“NO / ZO / MU”，部分被主体遮挡。在排版周围添加精细的矩形边框和对齐引导线。

可见文本内容：包含 8 个明确的文本区域：1) 左上角标题“NOZOMU”，下方附带小型日文平假名“のぞむ”；2) 左侧小型标题“MODERN DREAMER.”；3) 其下方的小段落“SHE WALKS LIKE A THOUGHT THAT CHOSE TO SHINE.”；4) 背景超大排版“NO ZO MU”；5) 左下角附近的黑色条带，写有“QUIET IMPACT.”；6) 左下角极小的文案“NOT LOUD. NOT PERFECT. JUST UNFORGETTABLE.”，外加小型存档标记“///”、“N. 07”和条形码线条；7) 右上角标签“ARCHIVE”，配有大号数字“07”和三个小方点；8) 右侧垂直文本“OWN THE LIGHT.”，旁边是一个深色纹理矩形面板，以及右下角的卡片，写有“VISIBLE GRACE.”，并附带小字“SOFT HEART. CLEAR VISION. STRONG PRESENCE.”

视觉风格：日本动漫插画与西方时尚杂志海报设计的融合，单色编辑调色板，搭配暖奶油色、腮红肤色、浅金色头发、黑色点缀和柔和的灰色阴影。在服装、头发、链条、褶皱和纹理上保持高细节，同时保持整体构图的通透感、优雅感和海报质感。

约束条件：保持遮挡面部的正方形色块可见并居中于面部；不要添加额外角色；不要添加超过上述 8 个文本区域的内容；避免使用霓虹色、杂乱元素、Logo、水印或写实渲染。

Add {argument name="chibi count" default="6–8"} miniature chibi clones of the same person around the main subject. Each chibi should closely resemble the real person with the same hairstyle, glasses, outfit colors, and overall appearance.

Design all chibi clones in a polished kawaii sticker style:

expressive eyes and soft facial expressions
smooth digital shading
clean white sticker outlines
soft drop shadows
slightly floating sticker placement

Give each chibi a unique pose and emotion inspired by everyday lifestyle moments:

peace sign pose
holding coffee
casual walking
shy smile
sitting relaxed
cheerful greeting
thoughtful/calm mood

Arrange the stickers around the edges of the composition without blocking the main subject’s face or body. Maintain balanced spacing and a clean {argument name="background" default="vertical layout similar to a social media diary collage"}.

Add soft hand-drawn doodles and scrapbook elements throughout the image:

arrows

stars
speech bubbles

Shot on a DSLR with a prime lens around 50mm or 85mm at f/1.4, shallow depth of field producing creamy bokeh, sharp focus on the subject in every frame, ultra-high resolution photorealistic textures, editorial lifestyle aesthetic. Lighting is soft, diffused, warm natural daylight coming from large windows. Overall mood is calm, serene, balanced, sophisticated, peaceful, rejuvenating. Style is minimalist, high-end, contemporary, clean and aspirational.

Color palette: dominant {argument name="color scheme" default="warm beige, cream, white, marble grey"}. Accents: green plants, gold fixtures and details, natural wood tones, and a soft purple smoothie. Materials throughout: white marble, light wood, stone, ceramic, glass, linen.

Panel 1, Modern Luxury Kitchen: white marble island and countertops, white shaker cabinets, gold hardware, integrated wine fridge, large window. She stands at the island with her body angled slightly, looking down while whisking a hot beverage in a small ceramic bowl with a wooden whisk, gentle steam rising. A mug marked with the letter "H" sits beside her.

Panel 2, High-End Bathroom: large backlit mirror, white marble vanity, white walls, an orchid plant on the counter. She stands facing the mirror, one hand applying a skincare product to her face with a cotton pad. Around her: a skincare bottle, a lit Diptyque candle, a whole coconut, and glass jars.

Panel 4, Bright Cafe Corner: round white marble table with a cane chair, large window overlooking a quiet street. She sits at the table, smiling softly while eating avocado toast and holding a fork. On the table: a purple smoothie in a glass, an Assouline book, small notebooks, and a few small flowers.

Final composition: a clean four-panel grid collage, sharp focus on the subject in each panel, editorial lifestyle photography, minimalist high-end contemporary feel, aspirational wellness vibe.

第一格，现代奢华厨房：白色大理石岛台和台面，白色摇臂柜，金色五金件，嵌入式酒柜，大窗户。她站在岛台旁，身体微微倾斜，低头用木制搅拌器在小陶瓷碗中搅拌热饮，热气袅袅升起。旁边放着一个印有字母“H”的马克杯。

第二格，高端浴室：大型背光镜，白色大理石洗漱台，白墙，台面上摆放着一盆兰花。她面对镜子站立，一只手正用化妆棉将护肤品涂抹在脸上。周围摆放着：护肤品瓶、点燃的 Diptyque 香氛蜡烛、一个完整的椰子和玻璃罐。

第三格，极简健康空间：带有弧形拱门的米色纹理墙面，石制喷泉，花瓶中插着尤加利叶。她正在进行全身拉伸，双臂向上伸展，头部后仰，闭着双眼。场景中可见一瓶大型香水。

第四格，明亮的咖啡馆角落：圆形的白色大理石桌子配藤编椅，大窗户俯瞰着安静的街道。她坐在桌边，一边吃着牛油果吐司，一边拿着叉子，温柔地微笑着。桌上摆放着：一杯紫色奶昔、一本 Assouline 书籍、几本小笔记本和几朵小花。

最终构图：干净的四宫格拼图，每一格中人物主体清晰对焦，编辑级生活方式摄影，简约高端的现代感，令人向往的健康生活氛围。

The overall style should feel expressive, raw, organic, and artistic while still maintaining strong visual appeal and realism on the subject’s facial structure. Use {argument name="color scheme" default="bright, vibrant, and eye-catching"} color combinations with rich tonal variation so the artwork feels alive, energetic, and visually dynamic, avoiding flat, dull, or monochromatic coloring. Skin textures, facial details, hair, outfit fabric, and all visible elements must fully follow the Dry Brush texture style with layered paint streaks and artistic imperfections. The subject’s pose and facial expression must look natural, relaxed, confident, and emotionally alive, avoiding stiff, awkward, gloomy, or expressionless appearances. The outfit must be stylish, modern, trendy, and casual with strong fashion aesthetics, avoiding basic, generic, or monotonous clothing designs. Ensure the outfit fully blends with the Dry Brush painting style, including textured fabric details, expressive brush patterns, and artistic color treatment. The final artwork should feel like a premium contemporary handmade portrait painting with expressive imperfections, dynamic brushwork, fashionable styling, and visually striking colors while still preserving the identity of the original subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用传统的 {argument name="technique" default="干笔"} 绘画技法，为主题创作一幅细节丰富的艺术肖像画。画面应呈现出明显的粗糙笔触、不完美的纹理、不均匀的颜料分布以及略显凌乱的手工细节，使作品看起来像是出自人类艺术家之手，而非数字生成的完美图像。整体风格应具有表现力、原始感、有机感和艺术感，同时在主题的面部结构上保持强烈的视觉吸引力和真实感。使用 {argument name="color scheme" default="明亮、鲜艳且引人注目"} 的配色方案，并结合丰富的色调变化，使作品充满活力、生动且具有视觉动态感，避免平淡、暗沉或单色调的配色。皮肤纹理、面部细节、头发、服装面料以及所有可见元素都必须完全遵循干笔纹理风格，展现出层叠的笔触和艺术性的瑕疵。主题的姿势和面部表情必须看起来自然、放松、自信且富有情感，避免僵硬、尴尬、阴郁或面无表情。服装必须时尚、现代、潮流且休闲，具有强烈的时尚美感，避免基础、普通或单调的服装设计。确保服装与干笔绘画风格完美融合，包括纹理化的面料细节、富有表现力的笔触图案以及艺术化的色彩处理。最终的作品应呈现为一幅优质的当代手工肖像画，具备富有表现力的瑕疵、动态的笔触、时尚的造型以及视觉冲击力强的色彩，同时保留原始主题的特征。

The atmosphere should feel dreamy, clean, ethereal, and fairy-like, but still realistic, like an outdoor editorial photoshoot rather than a 2D illustration. The subject wears a light, dreamy, pale-colored gauze dress with soft lavender, silver-white, and pale blue gradient tones. The overall styling should resemble a garden fairy or flower spirit. The dress can be naturally adjusted according to the temperament of my uploaded portrait, but it must keep a clean, beautiful, ethereal garden-fairy aesthetic. Use my uploaded portrait as the reference for the hairstyle and real hair volume. Based on that, create a natural loose braid or soft half-up hairstyle. Add small loose hair strands around the edges to make the hair feel realistic and natural. Decorate the hair with light purple flowers, forming a soft floral crown effect. The subject should be surrounded by soft backlight. The lighting must be realistic and unified across the person, flowers, butterflies, and background. Nothing should look pasted or composited. High-quality realistic portrait photography, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, soft natural backlight, cinematic garden atmosphere, realistic skin texture, delicate bokeh, high detail, elegant fantasy editorial portrait, dreamy but photorealistic. templates.title: Minimalist Children's Illustration Style

templates.title: Teenage Sketchbook Caricature Effect

templates.prompt: Keep the exact same pose of the reference image, composition, and people the same. templates.title: Anime Visual Novel Classroom Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫视觉小说风格教室横幅

templates.prompt: A wide anime banner illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Sayori"} in a bright dreamy classroom, rendered in a polished, high-end visual novel style with soft painterly lighting, warm pastel colors, and sparkling atmosphere. Show a cheerful teenage schoolgirl with short fluffy coral-pink hair, messy bob layers, and a large red bow on the right side of her head, wearing a Japanese school uniform with a light brown blazer, white shirt, red ribbon tie, brown sweater vest, and pleated navy skirt. She stands slightly left of center with arms open wide in an inviting, joyful pose, as if welcoming the viewer, with dynamic perspective and gentle motion in her hair and clothes. Her face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular skin-tone censor block. Behind her, tall classroom windows reveal a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds and warm sunlight streaming in. The right half of the image features a large decorative handwritten script reading {argument name="headline text" default="Sayori"}, cream-white lettering with a soft orange-gold outline and glow, integrated into a scrapbook-like wall background. Surround the scene with hanging photo prints clipped to string, including sky photos and a sunflower photo, plus hand-drawn doodles of clouds, stars, hearts, and a sun. Add blue and yellow paper stars, ribbons, floating confetti, a blue paper airplane, notebook pages, a spiral sketchbook, and scattered stationery elements. Place sunflowers prominently in the foreground and edges, with warm golden bokeh and soft depth of field. templates.title: Urban Street Market Caricature Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 城市街头市集漫画肖像

templates.prompt:
Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference for the subject’s face, hairstyle, facial structure, and overall impression.

Create a high-quality lifestyle editorial portrait of the same person sitting outdoors beside a wooden easel displaying a colorful street-style caricature portrait of them.

The real person and the caricature must clearly resemble the same individual.

Scene:
- the person is seated on a simple wooden folding chair
- beside them is a wooden easel holding a large caricature drawing
- the setting is a sentimental urban art market
- include illustration booths, handmade craft stalls, sketch displays, posters, cozy creative shopfronts, and a few softly blurred pedestrians
- lively but not crowded
- bright soft daylight, warm natural tones, shallow depth of field
- realistic photography for the person and environment
- vertical composition showing both the person and the caricature clearly

Subject:
- preserve the uploaded person’s recognizable identity
- natural pose
- calm, relaxed, slightly amused expression
- stylish casual outfit that suits the subject
- clean editorial lifestyle photography
- do not force the same pose or expression for every subject

Caricature direction:
- the drawing on the easel must be a true observational street caricature, not a generic cute cartoon
- the caricature artist should exaggerate the subject’s actual most recognizable facial traits

- analyze the uploaded face and exaggerate only 2–4 distinctive features, such as eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, cheeks, jawline, chin, ears, hairstyle, or facial proportions
- each caricature should feel custom-made for that specific person
- avoid using the same default cute face for every person
- avoid generic big eyes plus tongue-out expression
- the caricature should be funny because it captures the person’s unique features, not because it uses a random silly pose

Caricature style:
- oversized head with smaller simplified body
- playful but recognizable facial proportions
- bold hand-drawn marker lines
- quick sketchy pen strokes
- colored pencil texture
- lively street-artist energy
- humorous but flattering
- witty, expressive, and personality-driven
- charming handmade imperfections
- colorful accent doodles may be added, but keep the focus on the face

Expression in the caricature:
- choose a natural funny expression that fits the person’s facial character
- possible expressions: raised eyebrow, shy smile, surprised eyes, confident smirk, awkward polite smile, exaggerated calm face, pouty lips, confused cute face, or gentle blank stare
- the expression should vary depending on the subject
- do not always use a tongue-out face
- do not always use the same wide-eyed cute expression

Caricature canvas:
- large vertical drawing board or canvas on a wooden easel
- the caricature should be clearly visible and occupy a major part of the image
- it should immediately read as a funny street caricature

promptLocalized.zh:
使用上传的肖像作为主体面部、发型、面部结构和整体印象的身份参考。

创作一张高质量的生活方式编辑肖像，描绘同一个人坐在户外，旁边是一个木制画架，上面展示着一张色彩鲜艳的街头风格漫画肖像。

真人与漫画必须清晰地呈现为同一个人。

场景：
- 人物坐在简单的木制折叠椅上
- 旁边是一个放置着大幅漫画画作的木制画架
- 背景是充满情调的城市艺术市集
- 包含插画摊位、手工工艺品摊位、素描展示、海报、温馨的创意店面以及少量模糊的行人
- 氛围活跃但不拥挤
- 明亮柔和的日光，温暖的自然色调，浅景深
- 人物与环境采用写实摄影风格
- 垂直构图，清晰展示人物与漫画

主体：
- 保留上传人物的可辨识特征
- 自然的姿态
- 平静、放松、略带笑意的表情
- 适合主体的时尚休闲装扮
- 干净的编辑生活方式摄影风格
- 不要强求每个主体都使用相同的姿势或表情

漫画创作方向：
- 画架上的画作必须是真实的观察式街头漫画，而非通用的可爱卡通
- 漫画家应夸大主体最显著的面部特征

- 分析上传的面部照片，仅夸大 2–4 个显著特征，例如眼睛形状、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、脸颊、下颌线、下巴、耳朵、发型或面部比例
- 每幅漫画都应感觉是为该特定人物量身定制的
- 避免对每个人都使用相同的默认可爱脸型
- 避免通用的“大眼睛加吐舌头”表情
- 漫画的趣味性应源于捕捉人物的独特特征，而非使用随机的滑稽姿势

漫画风格：
- 大头小身的比例
- 有趣但可辨识的面部比例
- 大胆的手绘马克笔线条
- 快速的速写笔触
- 彩色铅笔质感
- 活跃的街头艺术家气息
- 幽默且讨喜
- 机智、富有表现力且充满个性
- 迷人的手工不完美感
- 可以添加色彩鲜艳的涂鸦点缀，但重点应保持在面部

漫画中的表情：
- 选择符合人物面部特征的自然幽默表情
- 可选表情：挑眉、羞涩微笑、惊讶眼神、自信坏笑、尴尬礼貌微笑、夸张的平静脸、嘟嘴、困惑可爱的表情或温柔的呆滞凝视
- 表情应根据主体而变化
- 不要总是使用吐舌头的表情
- 不要总是使用相同的瞪大眼睛的可爱表情

漫画画布：
- 木制画架上的大型垂直画板或画布
- 漫画应清晰可见，并占据画面的主要部分
- 应能让人一眼看出这是一幅有趣的街头漫画

templates.title: Double Exposure Sunset Beach Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日落海滩双重曝光人像

templates.prompt:
Use the {argument name="reference photo" default="uploaded portrait"} only as the identity and hairstyle reference. Accurately preserve the person’s real facial identity, face shape, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, hair volume, and natural real-life appearance. Do not copy the original clothes, background, lighting, pose, or image quality from the uploaded portrait.

Create a highly realistic cinematic double-exposure portrait in a vertical 9:16 composition. The scene is set at a {argument name="location" default="golden sunset beach"} with a calm ocean horizon, glowing orange sunlight, soft waves, and a dreamy purple-pink sky.

The final image should have two layers of the same person. The main layer is a large transparent side-profile portrait occupying the upper and middle part of the image, facing slightly upward with a soft natural smile, elegant facial expression, realistic skin texture, and long flowing hair. The face should blend naturally into the sunset sky and ocean light, creating a poetic cinematic double-exposure effect.

The second layer shows the same person as a smaller realistic half-body portrait near the lower center of the frame, standing or sitting in front of the ocean sunset. She wears an {argument name="outfit" default="elegant dark gray off-shoulder / strapless top"} with simple jewelry, natural makeup, soft glossy lips, and a calm romantic expression. The clothing should be tasteful, refined, and cinematic.

Add glowing golden particles and sparkling light dust flowing through the hair area of the large portrait, like tiny fireflies or stardust, blending into the warm sunset glow. The particles should look magical but still realistic, not cartoonish. Use soft cinematic lighting, warm golden rim light, gentle shadows, natural skin texture, high dynamic range, realistic ocean reflections, subtle film grain, premium editorial photography style.

Make the image dreamy, romantic, cinematic, elegant, and high-end. No text, no logo, no watermark, no Chinese characters, no random letters.

Negative Prompt：

watermark, logo, text, Chinese characters, random letters, low quality, blurry face, distorted face, fake skin, plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, anime, cartoon, illustration, AI-looking face, bad anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, duplicate face, messy composition, harsh outline, overexposure, oversaturated colors, unnatural smile, broken double exposure, bad hair detail, noisy artifacts, pixelated image.

最终图像应包含同一人物的两个图层。主图层是一个占据图像上方和中间部分的半透明侧面肖像，微微仰头，面带柔和自然的微笑，表情优雅，皮肤纹理真实，长发飘逸。面部应自然地融入日落天空和海洋光影中，营造出诗意的电影感双重曝光效果。

使图像呈现出梦幻、浪漫、电影感、优雅且高端的质感。无文字、无 Logo、无水印、无中文字符、无随机字母。

Several hanging straps and tags visibly read words like “WITCH 404,” “404,” and glitch-themed markings. Beneath and beside her, a {argument name="magic circle" default="large glowing violet magic circle mixed with hacker interface aesthetics"} is projected on the rooftop floor, filled with occult rings, sigils, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text such as error-code fragments, creating a fusion of sorcery and digital corruption. Emerging from the circle is 1 large armored summoned figure: a black futuristic demon-knight or robotic familiar with jagged reflective armor, a narrow purple-lit visor, and a heavy weapon held in one hand, partially dissolving into purple energy shards and smoke. The background shows a sprawling rainy megacity of apartment towers and industrial rooftops, packed with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and haze. On a nearby building wall is a giant vertical graffiti-style sign with 3 readable elements: “404”, “Witch”, and “ERROR NOT FOUND”, plus a smaller “E404”. Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across rooftops and in the air. Use a dark palette of black, indigo, and deep violet with sharp magenta-purple highlights, cinematic contrast, reflective wet surfaces, dense detail, and a high-end polished illustration style. The mood is occult, edgy, stylish, and dangerous, combining urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning.

templates.title: Vinyl Record Store Illusion Portrait

templates.prompt:
Subject: {argument name="theme" default="A May Day for Records"}

Person/Expression: Japanese woman in her early 20s, dark brown medium hair, thin bangs, translucent skin, natural Japanese-style makeup, gentle and calm atmosphere. The face is almost completely hidden by {argument name="prop" default="a 12-inch record jacket"}, so that the female portrait on the jacket cover appears naturally as the person's own face.

Clothing/Pose: Warm-toned Japanese style coordinate suitable for May, light peach-beige sheer cardigan, soft ivory blouse or dress, spring-like thin material. The woman holds the record jacket in front of her face with both hands, so the positions of the hands and the angles of the arms naturally connect with the shoulders, arms, and posture of the person on the jacket cover. The color, texture, and silhouette of the clothes should also have a high sense of unity with the person on the jacket.

Background/Light: Inside a record shop with the warmth of wood, an aisle with record shelves on both sides, a space with depth. Soft warm-toned indoor lighting and natural ambient light, gentle shadows, and a slightly nostalgic atmosphere.

Composition/Camera: Vertical composition, centered on the upper body, with the record jacket placed large in the center of the frame. A composition where the person from the completed album cover appears to emerge into real space. Not cutting and connecting only half the face, but naturally merging the completed figure on the jacket cover with real hands, body, and clothes. 50mm to 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, realistic snapshot style with appropriately blurred background.

Texture/Style: High-definition, photorealistic, 8K quality, natural skin texture, realistic hand texture, paper quality of the record jacket and fine reflections from shrink wrap, soft film feel. The album jacket is a vintage design based on pale pink-beige, with elegant English titles and a fictional artist name, with Japanese elements included as needed. A sophisticated record shop snap where the person, clothes, posture, hands, and jacket harmonize without any sense of incongruity.

Negative: Low quality, unnatural face disconnection, half-faces, unnatural connections, clothing mismatch, posture mismatch, double faces, compositions that look like two heads, extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed hands, extra arms, black vinyl records, real artist names, reproduction of real albums, logos, watermarks, nonsensical characters, hard-to-read text, cheap synthetic feel.

质感/风格：高清，照片级真实感，8K 画质，自然的皮肤纹理，写实的手部质感，唱片封套的纸张质感及收缩膜带来的细微反光，柔和的胶片质感。唱片封套采用以浅粉米色为基调的复古设计，配有优雅的英文标题和虚构的艺人名称，并根据需要融入日系元素。一张人物、服装、姿势、手部与封套和谐统一、毫无违和感的精致唱片店快照。

Naturally frame in live-action level human hands and arms in the foreground of the screen. The human side should show movements like trying to touch the girl, pointing, measuring distance, reacting in surprise, offering food or drink, or accidentally interfering during the stream.

The foreground hand should be slightly blurred with a shallow depth of field. Emphasize reality like "footage someone accidentally captured during a live stream."

Do not make it like a movie poster. No excessive cinematic production. No overly beautiful compositions. No excessive glowing effects. Avoid AI-specific glossy rendering. Do not overload with information.

The live streaming UI should include comment sections, concurrent viewer counts, LIVE display, likes, gift notifications, etc. The comment section should have realistic reactions buzzing with skepticism.

Unify lighting naturally. Match ambient light of the background and character, such as natural light, street lights, convenience store lighting, monitor light, etc.

Add smartphone photography-like texture. Light HDR processing, fine sensor noise, slight JPEG compression feel, natural exposure, weak chromatic aberration, light lens bloom, autofocus-like atmosphere, slight camera shake, and instability typical of handheld shooting. Emphasize a sense of coincidence like a "mysterious witness stream screenshot posted on SNS" rather than a perfect work.

promptLocalized.zh:
使用参考图像作为角色设计的基础，描绘“一个 {argument name="character" default="动漫角色"} 出现在现实世界 {argument name="scene" default="直播"} 中的瞬间”。

准确保持角色作为动漫插画的氛围。

绝不能破坏角色的身份特征。不要将其变成真人。角色部分需保持动漫插画的表现形式。

垂直智能手机直播屏幕。TikTok LIVE、YouTube Live、Instagram Live，常见的垂直直播 UI。

背景不固定。随机生成真实的城市空间或具有生活气息的真实空间。示例：{argument name="background example" default="建筑物屋顶"}、便利店前、游戏厅、车站前、住宅区、多租户大楼楼梯、深夜小巷、河床、卡拉 OK 前、深夜自动贩卖机旁、直播间、御宅族房间、地方城市车站前、雨中人行道、商业街等。

背景不要过于整洁。强调生活感、杂乱感和真实的噪点。

在屏幕前景自然地加入真人水平的手臂和手部。人类一侧应表现出试图触碰女孩、指点、测量距离、惊讶反应、递送食物或饮料，或在直播中意外干扰等动作。

前景的手部应略微模糊，具有浅景深效果。强调“某人在直播中意外捕捉到的画面”般的真实感。

不要做成电影海报风格。无需过度的电影化制作。不要过于完美的构图。不要有夸张的发光效果。避免 AI 特有的光泽渲染。不要堆砌过多信息。

直播 UI 应包含评论区、同时在线人数、LIVE 显示、点赞、礼物通知等。评论区应有充满怀疑的真实反应。

自然地统一光影。匹配背景和角色的环境光，如自然光、路灯、便利店灯光、显示器光等。

添加类似智能手机拍摄的质感。轻微的 HDR 处理、细微的传感器噪点、轻微的 JPEG 压缩感、自然的曝光、弱色差、轻微的镜头光晕、类似自动对焦的氛围、轻微的相机抖动以及手持拍摄特有的不稳定性。强调“SNS 上发布的神秘目击直播截图”那种偶然感，而非完美的作品。

templates.title: Summoning Jutsu i2i Manga Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 通灵之术 i2i 漫画提示词

templates.prompt: Using the character from the reference image, depict the moment the 'Summoning Jutsu' is activated. Accurately maintain the character's face, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, ears, costume, silhouette, body proportions, and atmosphere. Do not break the character's identity. Do not use the reference image as-is; redraw it naturally according to the situation and composition. The character is performing actions recognizable as activating the Summoning Jutsu, such as slamming a hand onto the ground, unfurling a scroll, or forming hand signs. Vary the pose and action for each image. Simultaneously, a massive ritual circle is spreading across the ground with black curse patterns, a circular array, and ink-like effects. A large amount of white smoke is explosively appearing. From the smoke, a giant entity contracted with the character fully emerges. The summoned being should be depicted as strongly linked to the character's worldview, personality, and design. It should not be a mere animal but possess a mythical, monstrous, mechanical, or fantastical presence. It is overwhelmingly larger than the character. Place the character in the foreground and the summoned being gigantically in the background. Use a low camera angle. Create impact like a Shonen manga spread. Add focus lines, ground destruction, flying debris, and smoke flows. Add manga-style onomatopoeia like 'Doron!!', 'Summoning Jutsu!!', or 'Gogogogo'. Add an old scroll-style information frame at the edge of the screen containing the summoned being's name, alias, and a short description. Keep the text brief. The presentation should feel like a sudden dangerous entity introduction in a manga spread, not a technical reference sheet. Use high-energy direction like 90s-2000s Jump manga. Maintain anime illustration style. High density, high contrast, dramatic lighting, and strong silhouettes. A composition that instantly catches the eye on social media.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用参考图像中的角色，描绘“通灵之术”启动的瞬间。准确保持角色的面部、发型、发色、眼睛、耳朵、服装、轮廓、身体比例和氛围。不要破坏角色的特征。不要直接使用参考图像，而是根据情境和构图自然地重新绘制。角色正在执行可识别为启动通灵之术的动作，例如手掌拍击地面、展开卷轴或结印。每张图像的姿势和动作都要有所不同。同时，一个巨大的仪式圆阵正在地面上蔓延，带有黑色咒文、圆形阵列和墨迹效果。大量白烟爆炸般涌现。从烟雾中，与角色缔结契约的巨大实体完全显现。被召唤的生物应被描绘为与角色的世界观、个性和设计紧密相连。它不应仅仅是一只动物，而应具有神话、怪兽、机械或奇幻的存在感。它的体型要远大于角色。将角色置于前景，被召唤的生物以巨大的姿态置于背景。使用低机位拍摄。营造出少年漫画跨页般的冲击力。添加集中线、地面破坏、飞溅的碎片和烟雾流。添加“砰！！”、“通灵之术！！”或“轰隆隆……”等漫画风格的拟声词。在屏幕边缘添加一个古卷轴风格的信息框，包含被召唤生物的名字、别名和简短描述。文字保持简洁。呈现效果应像漫画跨页中突然出现的危险实体，而不是技术参考表。使用 90 年代至 2000 年代《Jump》漫画般的高能量导向。保持动画插画风格。高密度、高对比度、戏剧性的光影和强烈的轮廓。构图需在社交媒体上瞬间抓住眼球。

templates.title: Dewy Skin Beauty Portrait with Chamomile

titleLocalized.zh: 洋甘菊水光感美妆人像

templates.prompt:
[Core Requirements] A close-up portrait of a face with a {argument name="hair style" default="short bob"}, holding a small {argument name="flower type" default="chamomile"} flower between the lips, featuring extremely glowing, dewy skin and intense {argument name="blush color" default="pink"} blush.

[Pose and Expression] A 3/4 pose facing the camera, with the lips slightly parted and a chamomile stem held lightly between them. The expression is neutral yet dreamy, with a direct gaze.

[Hair and Makeup Details] Natural layered dark brown bob hair with bangs styled to look wet, lightly covering the forehead. Makeup is based on extreme dewy skin expression, with broad and intense pink blush across the cheekbones and bridge of the nose, accentuated by freckles. Eyes are decorated with sharply curled lashes and highlights in the inner corners. Lips are moist and natural pink. A single chamomile flower is held in the mouth.

[Lighting] Uniform, soft, cool studio lighting from the front, maximizing the dewy skin texture and revealing all facial details clearly.

[Texture and Color Mood] Vivid contrast between extremely smooth, wet skin texture and the rough chamomile flower. Primary colors are pink, white, and brown, creating a dreamy, pure, yet sophisticated beauty editorial atmosphere.

[Lens and Depth] Tight close-up angle focused on the face using a high-resolution precision lens. Extremely shallow depth of field with the background perfectly blurred.

[Background] Simple, clean achromatic white background to focus all attention on the face. The upper part of a white lace top she is wearing is slightly visible.

promptLocalized.zh:
[核心要求] 一张面部特写人像，发型为 {argument name="hair style" default="短波波头"}，唇间衔着一朵小巧的 {argument name="flower type" default="洋甘菊"}，呈现出极具光泽的水光感皮肤和浓郁的 {argument name="blush color" default="粉色"} 腮红。

[姿势与表情] 3/4 侧脸面对镜头，双唇微张，轻衔洋甘菊茎部。表情中性而梦幻，直视镜头。

[发型与妆容细节] 自然层次感的深棕色波波头，刘海呈现湿发感，轻遮额头。妆容以极致水光肌为基底，颧骨和鼻梁处涂抹大面积且浓郁的粉色腮红，并点缀雀斑。眼妆搭配卷翘的睫毛和眼头高光。双唇水润自然，呈粉色。口中衔着一朵洋甘菊。

[光影] 正面均匀、柔和的冷色调摄影棚光线，最大程度展现水光感皮肤质地，清晰呈现所有面部细节。

[质感与色彩氛围] 极致平滑、湿润的皮肤质感与粗糙的洋甘菊形成鲜明对比。主色调为粉色、白色和棕色，营造出梦幻、纯净且高级的时尚杂志氛围。

[镜头与景深] 使用高分辨率精密镜头进行紧凑的面部特写。极浅的景深，背景完美虚化。

[背景] 简洁、干净的无彩色白色背景，将所有注意力集中在面部。隐约可见其穿着的白色蕾丝上衣领口。

templates.title: Hyper-Realistic Subject with Mini Chibi Clones

titleLocalized.zh: 超写实主体与迷你 Q 版分身

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic photo of the {argument name="subject" default="uploaded person"} in their exact current pose, outfit, and environment from the uploaded photo. Keep the {argument name="subject" default="uploaded person"}'s exact face, hair, skin tone, outfit, body proportions and all physical features fully preserved and unchanged — replicate everything exactly as seen in the uploaded image. Around the full-size realistic subject, place 5 tiny mini chibi cartoon versions of the same person — each mini chibi must share the same face, hairstyle, outfit, and overall look as the {argument name="subject" default="uploaded person"} but rendered in a {argument name="chibi style" default="cute 3D mini chibi doll style"} with big expressive eyes and small body. All 5 chibi versions must be exactly the same small size. One chibi is sitting on top of the subject's head, calm and unbothered. The remaining 4 chibi versions are placed naturally around the scene, each doing a different playful action that fits organically with the environment and objects visible in the uploaded photo — they interact with whatever is around them in a fun, spontaneous way. The full-size subject is photorealistic and the chibi versions are stylized 3D cartoon, creating a fun contrast. Match the exact lighting, background, and atmosphere of the uploaded photo. Ultra-detailed, {argument name="aesthetic" default="cinematic"}, 8K resolution. Every chibi version wears the same outfit and shoes as the {argument name="subject" default="uploaded person"}. ABSOLUTE RULE: every single chibi must have exactly 2 legs, exactly 2 arms, exactly 2 hands — count every limb before finalizing. Any chibi with 3 or more legs is incorrect.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实照片，展示 {argument name="subject" default="上传的人物"}，并完全复刻其在上传照片中的姿势、服装和环境。请确保 {argument name="subject" default="上传的人物"} 的面部、发型、肤色、服装、身体比例及所有身体特征得到完整保留且不发生任何改变——精准复刻上传图像中所见的一切。在全尺寸写实主体周围，放置 5 个微型 Q 版卡通分身——每个 Q 版分身必须与 {argument name="subject" default="上传的人物"} 拥有相同的面部、发型、服装和整体外观，但以 {argument name="chibi style" default="可爱的 3D 迷你 Q 版玩偶风格"} 呈现，拥有大而生动的眼睛和小巧的身体。所有 5 个 Q 版分身必须保持完全一致的小巧尺寸。其中一个 Q 版分身坐在主体头顶，神态冷静从容。其余 4 个 Q 版分身自然地分布在场景周围，每个分身都在进行不同的趣味动作，这些动作需与上传照片中的环境和物体有机融合——它们以有趣且自发的方式与周围的一切互动。全尺寸主体呈现照片级真实感，而 Q 版分身则为风格化的 3D 卡通，形成有趣的对比。匹配上传照片中精准的灯光、背景和氛围。超精细，{argument name="aesthetic" default="电影感"}，8K 分辨率。每个 Q 版分身都穿着与 {argument name="subject" default="上传的人物"} 相同的服装和鞋子。绝对规则：每一个 Q 版分身必须拥有且仅拥有 2 条腿、2 条手臂和 2 只手——在最终生成前请核对肢体数量。任何拥有 3 条或更多腿的 Q 版分身均为错误。

templates.title: Authentic Qipao Interior Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 中式旗袍室内人像摄影

templates.prompt:
A medium-shot authentic daily life photograph, natural candid moment, of an East Asian young woman standing beside a floor-to-ceiling dark wooden bookshelf in a dim interior room. 85mm lens, waist-up framing, shallow depth of field. The shelf behind her: old volumes in muted covers, a small dark ceramic piece on one shelf, no titles visible. Light enters from a narrow window off to the right.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes, soft single eyelids, a gaze that falls somewhere between the books and the middle distance without settling. Straight refined nose, the near-side profile catching the window's narrow edge of light. Skin tone fair beige, deep in shadow with one lateral stripe of natural light. Skin subsurface scattering visible under directional light, specular micro-highlights on cheekbones and nose ridge, fine foundation powder grain perceptible.
She wears a deep indigo silk qipao with water-ripple embroidery in tones of midnight teal and near-black thread — the pattern resembling old stone-rubbing ink, dense and layered. Mandarin collar, short sleeves. She stands beside the shelf with her fingertips just touching the spine of a book, without pulling it. The shelf holds its silence. Two or three stray hairs displaced by faint air movement, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.
A narrow strip of natural cool window light from the right — angular, specific, a line drawn across the room. It catches the left side of her face, the near shoulder of the qipao's indigo silk, and nothing else. Everything else falls into book-shelf dimness. Deep, quiet, interior. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 9:16. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张中景真实生活摄影作品，捕捉自然抓拍瞬间。一位东亚年轻女性站在室内昏暗房间的落地深色木质书架旁。85mm 镜头，腰部以上构图，浅景深。她身后的书架：摆放着封面色调柔和的旧书，架子上有一个小型深色陶瓷摆件，书名不可见。光线从右侧一扇窄窗射入。
东亚年轻女性，20 岁出头。杏仁眼，柔和的单眼皮，目光落在书本与中距离之间，并未聚焦。鼻梁挺拔精致，侧脸轮廓捕捉到了窗边窄窄的一束光。肤色呈浅米色，大部分处于阴影中，仅有一道侧向自然光。在定向光线下可见皮肤的次表面散射，颧骨和鼻梁上有微弱的镜面高光，可见细腻的粉底颗粒感。
她身着深靛蓝色丝绸旗袍，饰有午夜青色与近黑色丝线绣成的水波纹刺绣——图案如同古老的石碑拓印，浓郁且富有层次。立领，短袖。她站在书架旁，指尖轻轻触碰书脊，并未将其抽出。书架保持着静谧。两三根发丝因微弱的气流而散落，呈现出自然的非刻意瑕疵，而非几何对称。
来自右侧的一束窄窄的自然冷色窗光——角度明确，线条感强，如同在房间里画出的一道光线。光线仅照亮了她脸部的左侧和旗袍靛蓝色丝绸的近侧肩膀，其余部分均隐入书架的昏暗中。深邃、静谧、室内感。阴影区域带有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，呈现出摄影噪点质感，而非 CG 渲染的平滑感。长宽比 9:16。无水印，无文字覆盖，非卡通，非数字绘画，非插画，非动漫。

templates.title: Vintage Alexandria Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古亚历山大旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a richly layered vintage travel poster collage for {argument name="city name" default="Alexandria"}, Egypt, on an aged parchment paper background with subtle stains, fold marks, map grid lines, postal marks, handwritten annotations, and sepia texture. Use a vertical poster composition with a grand 1930s expedition-poster feel, combining photorealistic collage, engraved illustration, and retro print design. At the very top place small coordinate text “31°12’N 29°54’E” on the left, “ALEXANDRIA, EGYPT” centered, and “EST. 331 BC” on the right. The main title should dominate the upper third: huge dark navy slab-serif text “ALEXANDRIA” with large red Arabic text “الإسكندرية” beside it. Under the title add the tagline “WHERE THE MEDITERRANEAN TELLS ITS TIMELESS STORY.” Build the central scene as a dense historical city montage: the Lighthouse of Alexandria/Pharos tower rising at left near the sea, Qaitbay Citadel in warm stone at center, the modern Bibliotheca Alexandrina’s tilted disc roof hovering behind it, an Egyptian flag on a pole, a large muted golden sun circle, the Mediterranean coastline and harbor water, and a faint antique map labeled “MEDITERRANEAN SEA” with “ALEXANDRIA” marked. Add exactly 2 flying birds near the title area. Include exactly 3 circular stamp or seal elements: one upper-left Alexandria Egypt lighthouse stamp, one bottom-center Alexandria postal stamp with waves, and one small decorative seal near the café storefront. Add exactly 2 quote/annotation boxes on the left: a boxed Napoleon Bonaparte quote reading “I have not seen any place that can compare with it.” and handwritten notes reading “Qaitbay Citadel” and “Lighthouse of Alexandria.” The lower half should show a bustling old Alexandria street: a green vintage tram numbered 215 on tracks in the center foreground, a black-and-yellow classic taxi on the right, a cream-and-red bus behind it, palm trees, pedestrians, old European façades and balconies, and signage for Rue Fouad and Café Farouk on the left plus Florence signage on the right. In the foreground include a market and food spread with exactly 6 prominent food/display groups: a large platter of grilled fish and shrimp with lemon, a bowl of bread rolls, a basket of tomatoes and vegetables, a woven crate of oranges, a burlap sack with Arabic writing, and a patterned wooden produce crate with Arabic writing. Add a small bottom-left “MUST SEE” list with exactly 5 items: Qaitbay Citadel, Bibliotheca Alexandrina, Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, Montazah Palace & Gardens, The Corniche. Along the bottom center write “A CITY OF MANY LAYERS, A STORY THAT NEVER ENDS.” and beneath it “DISCOVER HER PAST. LIVE HER PRESENT. LOVE HER FOREVER.” Finish with coordinates repeated at bottom right. Color palette: faded cream parchment, navy ink, rusty red Arabic lettering, warm sandstone, teal sea, muted greens, taxi yellow, sun ochre. Keep typography sharp and legible, make the collage extremely detailed but coherent, no modern watermarks, no extra logos, no unrelated text.

promptLocalized.zh: 为埃及 {argument name="city name" default="亚历山大"} 创作一张层次丰富的复古旅行拼贴海报，背景采用带有细微污渍、折痕、地图网格线、邮戳、手写注释和深褐色纹理的陈旧羊皮纸。采用竖版海报构图，营造出 20 世纪 30 年代宏大的探险海报感，结合照片级拼贴、雕版插画和复古印刷设计。在最顶部左侧放置小号坐标文本“31°12’N 29°54’E”，居中放置“ALEXANDRIA, EGYPT”，右侧放置“EST. 331 BC”。主标题应占据上三分之一区域：巨大的深海军蓝粗衬线字体“ALEXANDRIA”，旁边配有醒目的红色阿拉伯语文本“الإسكندرية”。在标题下方添加标语“WHERE THE MEDITERRANEAN TELLS ITS TIMELESS STORY.”。将中心场景构建为密集的历史城市蒙太奇：左侧海边矗立着亚历山大灯塔（法罗斯灯塔），中央是暖色调石材的盖特贝城堡，其后方隐约可见现代化的亚历山大图书馆倾斜的圆盘屋顶，一根旗杆上挂着埃及国旗，一个巨大的柔和金色太阳圆环，地中海海岸线和港口水域，以及一张标有“MEDITERRANEAN SEA”和“ALEXANDRIA”的淡色古地图。在标题区域附近添加 2 只飞鸟。包含 3 个圆形邮戳或印章元素：左上方一个亚历山大灯塔邮戳，底部中央一个带有波浪图案的亚历山大邮戳，以及咖啡馆店面附近的一个小型装饰性印章。在左侧添加 2 个引用/注释框：一个框内的拿破仑·波拿巴名言“I have not seen any place that can compare with it.”，以及手写笔记“Qaitbay Citadel”和“Lighthouse of Alexandria”。下半部分展示繁华的亚历山大老街：中心前景是轨道上一辆编号为 215 的绿色复古电车，右侧是一辆黑黄相间的经典出租车，后方是一辆奶油红相间的巴士，还有棕榈树、行人、古老的欧洲建筑立面和阳台，左侧有 Rue Fouad 和 Café Farouk 的招牌，右侧有 Florence 的招牌。在前景中包含一个市场和食物展示，共有 6 组突出的食物/陈列：一大盘配有柠檬的烤鱼和虾、一碗面包卷、一篮番茄和蔬菜、一筐橙子、一个写有阿拉伯文的粗麻袋，以及一个写有阿拉伯文的图案木制农产品箱。在左下角添加一个包含 5 个项目的“必看清单”：Qaitbay Citadel, Bibliotheca Alexandrina, Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, Montazah Palace & Gardens, The Corniche。在底部中央书写“A CITY OF MANY LAYERS, A STORY THAT NEVER ENDS.”，下方书写“DISCOVER HER PAST. LIVE HER PRESENT. LOVE HER FOREVER.”。最后在右下角重复坐标。配色方案：褪色的奶油色羊皮纸、海军蓝墨水、铁锈红阿拉伯字母、暖砂岩色、青色海面、柔和的绿色、出租车黄、太阳赭石色。保持排版清晰易读，使拼贴画极其精细且连贯，无现代水印，无额外 Logo，无无关文本。

Layout: The app has 4 main regions: 1 left sidebar, 1 top toolbar spanning the editor area, 3 vertical code editor panes. The first editor pane is selected and outlined with a bright blue focus glow. The middle pane shows colored inline diff highlights. The rightmost pane is narrow and partially visible, like an additional file tab or third comparison column.

Left sidebar: Show macOS traffic-light buttons at top left: 3 circles, red, yellow, green. Under the app name, include 1 search field with placeholder text “Search diffs…” and a keyboard hint. Below it show exactly 8 saved diff list items with small document icons and timestamps: 1) “API Response — Checkout v2” with “Today, 10:24 AM”, highlighted in blue as the selected item; 2) “User Profile — Public API” with “Yesterday, 4:18 PM”; 3) “Orders Endpoint — v1 vs v2” with “May 20, 2025, 9:14 AM”; 4) “Product Catalog — EU Region” with “May 19, 2025, 2:47 PM”; 5) “Auth Response — SSO” with “May 18, 2025, 11:03 AM”; 6) “Billing Summary — Q2” with “May 17, 2025, 3:22 PM”; 7) “Webhook Payload — Stripe” with “May 16, 2025, 10:11 AM”; 8) “Search Results — Relevance” with “May 15, 2025, 5:35 PM”. At the bottom include exactly 1 prominent blue “+ New Diff” button and 1 small gear icon.

On the right include exactly 4 compact shortcut controls labeled “⌘T add column”, “⌘D toggle diff”, “⌘← / ⌘→ move focus” and one small spacing gap between groups.

Editor panes: Use a monospaced code font, line numbers, JSON syntax highlighting, dark navy panels, and thin rounded borders. The left pane header is “source.json” with a document icon and a three-dot menu. The middle pane header is “target.json” with a document icon and a three-dot menu. The narrow right pane header is “more.json” and should show only the left portion of code, implying overflow.
