templates.title: Steampunk Trio Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克三人肖像

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical anime-inspired steampunk group portrait of exactly 3 seated characters on a worn wooden bench in a dense retro-futuristic city alley. The trio consists of 1 left male figure, 1 center female figure, and 1 right male figure, all facing forward with intentionally featureless softly blurred faces. The left character is a slim young man wearing a black wide-brim hat, dark pinstripe three-piece suit, white shirt, narrow black tie, small lapel pins and medals, visible tattooed hands, cropped socks, and brown lace-up boots. The center character is a petite young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="short platinum-blonde bob hair"}, wearing a dark ornate double-breasted school-uniform-inspired jacket, white shirt, red patterned bow tie, decorative pins and brass buttons, a small red mechanical bird or toy perched near her hair, a short skirt, cream knee-high socks with intricate mechanical illustrations, red ankle straps, and glossy black platform Mary Jane shoes; her hands rest neatly on her knees. The right character is a slim young man in a navy tailored suit jacket, cream waistcoat, white shirt, patterned tie, many pins and medals, cropped trousers, cream socks, and dark brown leather shoes, sitting with hands clasped. The background should be packed wall-to-wall with countless vintage mechanical details: large clocks, turbine-like circular vents, gauges, pipes, gears, metal boxes, signs, wires, dials, old advertisements, and layered industrial panels, creating a cluttered whimsical steampunk marketplace facade. Use a muted cinematic palette of oxidized teal, rust red, brass, charcoal, cream, and weathered brown. Lighting is soft overcast daylight, sharp illustration detail, intricate linework, realistic fabric textures, antique metal patina, symmetrical centered composition, full-body view from head to shoes, cobblestone ground, no modern objects, no readable real-world branding, no extra characters. Overall mood: eccentric, fashionable, mysterious, and nostalgic, like {argument name="style influence" default="a richly detailed Japanese AI illustration blended with Victorian steampunk and retro street fashion"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节高度丰富的竖版动漫风格蒸汽朋克群像，描绘 3 位坐在密集复古未来主义城市小巷中破旧木长椅上的角色。这三人组包括左侧 1 位男性、中间 1 位女性和右侧 1 位男性，他们都面向前方，面部刻意处理为模糊且无五官。左侧角色是一位身材苗条的年轻人，戴着黑色宽檐帽，身穿深色细条纹三件套西装、白衬衫、窄版黑领带，佩戴小型翻领别针和勋章，露出有纹身的手部，穿着九分袜和棕色系带靴。中间角色是一位娇小的年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="短款铂金色波波头"}，身穿深色华丽的双排扣校服风格外套、白衬衫、红色花纹领结，装饰有别针和黄铜纽扣，发间栖息着一只红色小机械鸟或玩具，穿着短裙、带有复杂机械图案的奶油色过膝袜、红色脚踝绑带以及亮面黑色厚底玛丽珍鞋；双手整齐地放在膝盖上。右侧角色是一位身材苗条的年轻人，身穿海军蓝定制西装外套、奶油色马甲、白衬衫、花纹领带，佩戴许多别针和勋章，穿着九分裤、奶油色袜子和深棕色皮鞋，双手交叠而坐。背景应塞满无数复古机械细节：大型时钟、涡轮状圆形通风口、仪表、管道、齿轮、金属盒、标志、电线、刻度盘、旧广告和层叠的工业面板，营造出杂乱而奇幻的蒸汽朋克市场外墙。使用氧化青色、铁锈红、黄铜色、炭灰色、奶油色和风化棕色的柔和电影色调。光线为柔和的阴天日光，具备锐利的插画细节、复杂的线条、逼真的织物纹理、古董金属光泽、对称的中心构图、从头到鞋的全身视图、鹅卵石地面，无现代物品，无可见的现实品牌，无额外角色。整体氛围：古怪、时尚、神秘且怀旧，如同 {argument name="style influence" default="融合了维多利亚蒸汽朋克与复古街头时尚的精致日本 AI 插画"}。

templates.title: Nordic Skincare Campaign Board

titleLocalized.zh: 北欧护肤品牌营销项目

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a wide brand identity and advertising creative overview for a minimalist Nordic skincare brand named {argument name="brand name" default="FJÄLL"}, showing a complete campaign system on a clean white studio background.

Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 presentation board with a lot of negative space, soft warm off-white background, centered composition. Use muted Scandinavian colors: stone gray, cream, beige, sage green, charcoal blue-gray, and natural skin tones. Lighting is soft, diffused, premium, and editorial.

Layout: Arrange exactly 11 discrete tiles in a refined grid. Top row contains 3 larger brand assets: 1) a minimal circular mountain-line logo with the word FJÄLL and small subtext, 2) an alternate logo with a small abstract mountain/stone icon above the word FJÄLL and the tagline “NORDIC SKINCARE”, 3) a square product still-life photo of one dark gray skincare tube standing upright on a pale stone surface with a rock prop. Bottom row contains exactly 8 campaign mockups, evenly spaced and aligned: 1) square lifestyle product photo with hands holding the tube beside a cream product information card, 2) square close-up of a gray clay/mineral cream smear on stone with tiny text “MINERAL TEXTURE”, 3) vertical application tutorial tile showing cream being applied to fingers with a simple header, 4) vertical dew/balm hand-care tile showing cream rubbed onto the back of a hand, 5) square hero ingredient tile with the tube standing among stones, leaves, and three circular ingredient callouts, 6) vertical social media video interface mockup with a hand holding the product, visible play/engagement UI icons along the side and bottom, 7) vertical ad poster with the product tube, botanical sprigs, rock props, and headline text near the bottom, 8) tall mobile website or landing-page mockup with a clean navigation bar, product detail blocks, and an application photo.

Subject details: The product is a single squeeze tube labeled {argument name="product label" default="FJÄLL"}, matte dark blue-gray packaging, white minimalist typography, small circular emblem, premium cosmetic proportions. The skincare texture is thick, mineral, clay-like, pale gray-beige. Hands should look natural, softly lit, and elegant. Props include smooth stones, mineral rocks, small green leaves, neutral linen or plaster surfaces, and shallow shadows.

Text content: Include readable brand text “FJÄLL” on logos and packaging, “NORDIC SKINCARE” as a tagline, and campaign/product text suggesting {argument name="product name" default="Midnight Solstice"}, {argument name="benefit phrase" default="Performance in every touch."}, mineral texture, application, dew-bomb, and ingredient callouts. Keep small body copy mostly decorative but plausible, clean, and aligned.

Visual style: Luxury skincare art direction, minimal Swiss editorial layout, soft product photography, airy whitespace, muted natural palette, understated typography, commercial creative portfolio look. Make the entire board appear like a polished generated ad-material batch preview rather than a single ad.

Constraints: Use exactly 11 visible tiles total, exactly 3 on the top row and exactly 8 on the bottom row. Do not add extra products beyond the one tube design. Avoid bright colors, clutter, heavy shadows, glossy plastic, cartoon style, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一个名为 {argument name="brand name" default="FJÄLL"} 的极简主义北欧护肤品牌创建全面的品牌标识和广告创意概览，在干净的白色摄影棚背景下展示完整的营销系统。

画布：横向 16:9 的展示项目，留有大量负空间，采用柔和的暖米白色背景，构图居中。使用柔和的斯堪的纳维亚色调：石灰色、奶油色、米色、鼠尾草绿、炭蓝灰色以及自然的肤色。光线柔和、漫射，呈现出高端的编辑风格。

布局：在精致的网格中精确排列 11 个独立的板块。顶行包含 3 个较大的品牌资产：1) 一个极简的圆形山脉线条 Logo，带有“FJÄLL”字样及小型副标题；2) 一个备选 Logo，在“FJÄLL”字样上方有一个抽象的山脉/石头图标，并配有“NORDIC SKINCARE”标语；3) 一张方形产品静物照，展示一支深灰色护肤软管直立在浅色石材表面上，配有岩石道具。底行包含 8 个精确排列且间距均匀的营销样机：1) 方形生活方式产品照，展示双手持软管，旁边放置一张奶油色产品信息卡；2) 方形特写，展示石材上的灰色泥浆/矿物霜，并带有微小的“MINERAL TEXTURE”文字；3) 垂直应用教程板块，展示手指涂抹面霜的过程，配有简单的标题；4) 垂直露珠/润肤手部护理板块，展示面霜涂抹在手背上的效果；5) 方形核心成分板块，展示软管矗立在石头、叶片和三个圆形成分标注之间；6) 垂直社交媒体视频界面样机，展示手持产品，侧面和底部带有可见的播放/互动 UI 图标；7) 垂直广告海报，展示产品软管、植物嫩枝、岩石道具，底部附近配有标题文字；8) 纵向移动端网站或落地页样机，带有简洁的导航栏、产品详情区块以及应用展示照片。

主体细节：产品为一支标签为 {argument name="product label" default="FJÄLL"} 的挤压式软管，采用哑光深蓝灰色包装，白色极简排版，带有小型圆形徽标，符合高端化妆品比例。护肤质地浓稠、矿物感强，呈浅灰米色。手部应看起来自然、光线柔和且优雅。道具包括光滑的石头、矿物岩石、小绿叶、中性亚麻或石膏表面，以及浅淡的阴影。

文字内容：在 Logo 和包装上包含可读的品牌文字“FJÄLL”，标语使用“NORDIC SKINCARE”，营销/产品文字建议使用 {argument name="product name" default="Midnight Solstice"}、{argument name="benefit phrase" default="Performance in every touch."}、矿物质地、应用说明、露珠润肤及成分标注。保持小字正文主要为装饰性但需合理、整洁且对齐。

视觉风格：奢华护肤艺术指导，极简瑞士编辑布局，柔和的产品摄影，通透的留白，柔和的自然色调，低调的排版，商业创意作品集风格。使整个项目看起来像是一组精美的生成式广告素材预览，而非单一广告。

约束条件：总共使用 11 个可见板块，顶行 3 个，底行 8 个。除该软管设计外，请勿添加额外产品。避免使用鲜艳色彩、杂乱元素、浓重阴影、光面塑料、卡通风格或水印。

templates.title: Two-Panel AI Portrait Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 双面板 AI 人像对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a side-by-side comparison image showing two AI-generated close-up portraits of the same young East Asian woman, emphasizing subtle facial differences between two generations.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 2-panel layout, approximately 1200×525 px, with a thin vertical divider exactly in the center. No outer border, no title, no watermark.

Layout: Use exactly 2 equal panels. Left panel: first portrait, labeled {argument name="left label" default="1回目"} in small white text near the lower-right corner. Right panel: second portrait, labeled {argument name="right label" default="2回目"} in small white text near the lower-right corner. The labels should be clean sans-serif, white with a subtle dark shadow for legibility.

Subject details: Each panel shows a tightly cropped frontal head-and-face portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young East Asian woman"}. She has long, loose {argument name="hair color" default="black hair"} framing her face, a smooth forehead, natural dark eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes looking directly into the camera, a small straight nose, softly closed lips, and a calm neutral expression. The face fills most of each panel, cropped near the top of the forehead and around the chin, with hair extending to both sides. The two portraits should look very similar but not identical: slightly different eye shape, cheek fullness, nose bridge, mouth shape, and face proportions.

Visual style: Realistic AI portrait photography with soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth skin texture, muted warm skin tones, dark blurred background, and slightly soft focus. The overall mood is quiet and serious. Keep the left portrait a little softer and flatter, and the right portrait slightly more polished, warmer, and more symmetrical.

Constraints: Include exactly 2 portraits and exactly 2 text labels. Do not add extra captions, UI elements, logos, or decorative graphics. Maintain a direct face comparison composition with both faces centered and similarly scaled.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张并排对比图，展示同一位年轻东亚女性的两张 AI 生成近景人像，强调两代版本之间细微的面部差异。

画布：宽幅水平 2 面板布局，尺寸约为 1200×525 像素，中心处有一条细垂直分割线。无外边框，无标题，无水印。

布局：使用 2 个完全相等的面板。左侧面板：第一张人像，在右下角附近用小号白色文字标注 {argument name="left label" default="1回目"}。右侧面板：第二张人像，在右下角附近用小号白色文字标注 {argument name="right label" default="2回目"}。标签应使用简洁的无衬线字体，白色文字并带有淡淡的深色阴影以确保可读性。

主体细节：每个面板展示一张紧凑裁剪的正面头部和面部肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻东亚女性"}。她留着长而蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色头发"} 衬托脸型，额头光滑，眉毛自然呈深色，杏仁状的深色眼睛直视镜头，鼻梁小巧笔直，双唇柔和闭合，表情平静自然。面部占据每个面板的大部分空间，裁剪位置靠近额头顶部和下巴周围，头发延伸至两侧。两张人像应看起来非常相似但不完全相同：眼形、脸颊丰满度、鼻梁、嘴型和面部比例应略有不同。

视觉风格：写实 AI 人像摄影，采用柔和的电影级布光、浅景深、光滑的皮肤质感、柔和的暖色调肤色、深色模糊背景以及略带柔焦的效果。整体氛围安静且严肃。左侧人像保持稍显柔和和平淡，右侧人像则稍微更精致、更温暖且更对称。

约束条件：包含 2 张人像和 2 个文本标签。不要添加额外的说明文字、UI 元素、徽标或装饰性图形。保持直接的面部对比构图，两张脸均居中且比例相似。

templates.title: Anime Cafe Two-Panel Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫咖啡馆双图对比

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical comparison image showing an anime cafe illustration process, with two wide panels stacked on a dark charcoal background. The upper panel is a before/partial generation view: the left half remains a rough block-in sketch while the right half is a polished anime-style cafe scene. The lower panel is the completed polished illustration.

Canvas: Portrait 4:5 image with a thick dark charcoal margin around the artwork. Inside, place exactly 2 horizontal rectangular panels, one above the other, aligned vertically with a thin gap between them.

Layout: Upper panel: split visually down the middle. The left side should look unfinished, like a rough paint-over or masked area: dark black cafe wall, loose brown sketch lines for wall frames, two rough brown chair/table shapes, flat gray floor, and a broad pale sunlight patch. The right side should be fully rendered: a blonde anime girl leaning toward a tall strawberry parfait at a round cafe table. Lower panel: the same cafe setting fully rendered, now including exactly 2 anime girls seated across the table with the dessert centered between them.

Subject details: Main character is {argument name="main character" default="a cheerful blonde anime schoolgirl"}, shown on the right side in both panels. She has long flowing blonde hair, one messy side bun, loose curled strands, a light blue oversized button-up shirt, a yellow cardigan tied around her waist, and a dark plaid skirt. Her hands are clenched excitedly near her chest as she leans toward the dessert. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain beige square censor block in both panels; do not draw facial features inside the square. Secondary character appears only in the lower panel: {argument name="second character" default="a pink-haired anime schoolgirl with green eyes"}, seated on the left, wearing a navy school blazer with white trim, a white shirt, and a large red bow. She has twin braids, soft pink hair, a small crescent moon hair clip, and a calm shy expression.

Counted visible elements: exactly 2 stacked panels; exactly 2 finished anime girls in the lower panel; exactly 1 finished anime girl in the upper panel; exactly 2 beige square face blocks, one per panel on the blonde girl; exactly 2 tall strawberry parfait glasses, one in each panel; exactly 4 small white plates total, with 1 in the upper panel and 3 in the lower panel; exactly 3 visible pieces of cutlery total, one near the upper plate and two on lower plates; exactly 3 black menu boards on the lower panel wall labeled Coffee, Dessert, and Drink; exactly 1 round chalkboard sign reading “Cafe Coffee” behind the blonde girl.

Cafe environment: Warm sunlit cafe interior with dark charcoal walls, wooden chairs, small round wooden tables, large window light entering from the right, soft diagonal sunbeams across the floor and tabletop, and chalkboard menu boards in the background. The dessert is {argument name="dessert" default="a tall strawberry parfait with whipped cream, strawberries, wafers, kiwi slices, red syrup layers, and vanilla cream"}, placed in a clear glass in the center foreground.

Visual style: Polished modern Japanese anime illustration, clean linework, glossy eyes for the pink-haired girl, soft painterly shading, warm daylight, high detail on hair and dessert, cozy cafe atmosphere. The top-left rough area should deliberately contrast with the finished art: blurry, flat, sketchy, dark, and incomplete.

Text content: Use small readable English chalkboard text where visible: “Coffee”, “Dessert”, “Drink”, and “Cafe Coffee”. Other menu items may be tiny decorative scribbles.

Constraints: Keep the two-panel comparison composition. Do not add extra characters, extra desserts, captions, logos, watermarks, or comic speech bubbles. Preserve the beige facial censor blocks on the blonde character.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张垂直对比图，展示动漫咖啡馆插画的制作过程，在深炭灰色背景上堆叠两个宽幅面板。上方面板为生成前/部分生成视图：左半部分保留为粗略的草图，右半部分为精致的动漫风格咖啡馆场景。下方面板为完整的精修插画。

画布：4:5 比例的竖向图像，艺术作品周围有厚实的深炭灰色边框。在内部放置 2 个水平矩形面板，上下排列，垂直对齐，中间留有细小间隙。

布局：上方面板：视觉上从中间分割。左侧应看起来未完成，类似于粗略的涂抹或遮罩区域：深黑色咖啡馆墙壁、墙上画框的松散棕色草图线条、两个粗略的棕色椅子/桌子形状、平坦的灰色地板以及大片苍白的阳光。右侧应完全渲染：一位金发动漫少女正倾身靠近圆桌上的一杯高耸草莓圣代。下方面板：相同的咖啡馆环境完全渲染，现在包括 2 位动漫少女坐在桌子对面，甜点位于她们中间。

主体细节：主角为 {argument name="main character" default="一位开朗的金发动漫女学生"}，在两个面板的右侧均有展示。她留着飘逸的长金发，一侧扎着凌乱的发髻，有松散的卷发丝，穿着浅蓝色超大号衬衫，腰间系着黄色开衫，穿着深色格子裙。她双手兴奋地紧握在胸前，身体倾向甜点。在两个面板中，她的脸部都被一个简单的米色方形遮挡块刻意遮住；请勿在方块内绘制面部特征。次要角色仅出现在下方面板：{argument name="second character" default="一位有着绿色眼睛的粉发动漫女学生"}，坐在左侧，穿着带有白色饰边的海军蓝校服西装、白衬衫，系着大红蝴蝶结。她留着双麻花辫，有着柔和的粉色头发、一个小月牙发夹，表情平静而害羞。

可见元素计数：总共 2 个堆叠面板；下方面板中总共 2 位完成的动漫少女；上方面板中总共 1 位完成的动漫少女；总共 2 个米色方形面部遮挡块，金发少女每个面板各一个；总共 2 杯高耸草莓圣代，每个面板各一个；总共 4 个小白色盘子，上方面板 1 个，下方面板 3 个；总共 3 件可见餐具，上方盘子附近 1 件，下方盘子上 2 件；下方面板墙上有 3 个黑色菜单项目，分别标注为 Coffee、Dessert 和 Drink；金发少女身后有 1 个写着“Cafe Coffee”的圆形黑板标志。

咖啡馆环境：温暖的阳光咖啡馆室内，深炭灰色墙壁、木制椅子、小型圆形木桌，大型窗户光线从右侧射入，柔和的对角线阳光洒在地板和桌面上，背景中有黑板菜单。甜点为 {argument name="dessert" default="一杯高耸的草莓圣代，配有鲜奶油、草莓、威化饼、猕猴桃片、红糖浆层和香草奶油"}，放置在前景中央的透明玻璃杯中。

视觉风格：精致的现代日本动漫插画，干净的线条，粉发少女拥有明亮的眼睛，柔和的绘画式阴影，温暖的日光，头发和甜点细节丰富，温馨的咖啡馆氛围。左上角的粗略区域应与完成后的艺术作品形成鲜明对比：模糊、平坦、草图感、暗淡且不完整。

文本内容：在可见处使用清晰易读的英文黑板字体：“Coffee”、“Dessert”、“Drink”和“Cafe Coffee”。其他菜单项可以是微小的装饰性涂鸦。

约束：保持双面板对比构图。不要添加额外角色、额外甜点、标题、Logo、水印或漫画对话气泡。保留金发角色脸上的米色遮挡块。

templates.title: Rainy Day Anime Vocabulary Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 雨天动漫词汇表

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a detailed Japanese-style illustrated reference sheet infographic titled {argument name="headline text" default="雨の日シチュの用語表"}, explaining useful rainy-day scene vocabulary for AI illustration prompts.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, aged cream watercolor paper with ink stains, tape, paperclips, torn memo scraps, tiny stars, raindrop doodles, umbrella doodles, and purple hydrangea decorations in the corners. Use a handmade scrapbook notebook aesthetic with thin navy divider lines and slightly worn edges.

Overall visual style: Soft anime watercolor and ink wash, melancholic rainy atmosphere, muted navy, gray, lavender, and beige palette. The recurring subject is {argument name="main character" default="a black-haired anime girl in a dark raincoat"}, usually wet from rain, carrying or standing under {argument name="umbrella color" default="a transparent or black umbrella"}. Add reflective wet streets, mist, puddles, raindrops on glass, and blurred city lights. Keep the text dense but neatly organized like a prompt-writing cheat sheet.

Header: Large centered brush-calligraphy Japanese headline using the headline text. Under it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle line explaining that the sheet organizes rain, rainy season, puddles, and road-reflection words for AI illustration prompt support. Place a large decorative character portrait at the upper left with hydrangeas; the face area is covered by a soft square blur, matching the generated look. At the upper right, add small taped memo papers and a decorative umbrella sketch.

Main layout: A grid of exactly 24 numbered vocabulary cards, arranged 4 columns by 6 rows. Each card has a dark blue circular number badge, a bold Japanese term title, two or three short Japanese explanatory text lines, and a small anime rainy-scene thumbnail. Use thin navy borders and off-white card backgrounds. Count and label the 24 cards as follows, with these visible concepts: 1 umbrella, 2 shared umbrella, 3 transparent umbrella, 4 wet hair, 5 wet school uniform, 6 rain lodging or taking shelter from rain, 7 under the eaves, 8 bus stop, 9 rain in front of the station, 10 sudden shower, 11 rain inside a train car, 12 window glass, 13 puddle, 14 road surface reflection, 15 raindrops, 16 misty rain, 17 muddy ground, 18 cloudy sky, 19 gray sky, 20 after the rain, 21 night rain, 22 neon reflections, 23 rainy-season humidity, 24 rainy-day aftermath.

Thumbnail details: Vary every card image while keeping the same rainy anime mood. Include close-up portraits, walking scenes, umbrellas, wet clothes, bus stop, station crowd, train window, puddle reflection, neon city street, hydrangea after rain, and rainy room or alley aftermath. Cards 10 and 11 should include soft gray square blurs over part of the character face area, echoing the original censored-looking artifacts.

Bottom section: Add a wide bordered note panel titled in Japanese as a usage guide, with exactly 5 bullet points in small Japanese text explaining how to use the vocabulary list for AI illustration prompts. Decorate the bottom with washi tape, a fountain pen ink bottle, scattered clips, handwritten memo scraps, small flowers, and tiny rain icons.

Constraints: The final image must feel like an information-dense printable reference sheet, not a single illustration. Use exactly 24 numbered cards and exactly 5 bottom bullet points. Keep the Japanese calligraphy headline prominent, maintain legible grid structure, and avoid adding logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一份详细的日式插画参考表信息图，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="雨の日シチュの用語表"}，解释用于 AI 插画提示词的实用雨天场景词汇。

画布：竖向 3:4 海报，带有墨迹的陈旧奶油色水彩纸，配有胶带、回形针、撕下的备忘录碎片、小星星、雨滴涂鸦、雨伞涂鸦以及角落里的紫色绣球花装饰。采用手工剪贴簿笔记本美学，配有细深蓝色分隔线和略显磨损的边缘。

整体视觉风格：柔和的动漫水彩和水墨画，忧郁的雨天氛围，采用柔和的深蓝色、灰色、薰衣草色和米色调。反复出现的主题是 {argument name="main character" default="一个穿着深色雨衣的黑发动漫女孩"}，通常被雨淋湿，拿着或站在 {argument name="umbrella color" default="透明或黑色雨伞"} 下。添加反光的湿润街道、薄雾、水坑、玻璃上的雨滴以及模糊的城市灯光。保持文字密集但排列整齐，如同提示词编写速查表。

页眉：居中的大型日式毛笔书法标题，使用标题文本。下方添加一行较小的日语副标题，说明该表格整理了雨、雨季、水坑和道路反射等词汇，以支持 AI 插画提示词。在左上角放置一个带有绣球花的大型装饰性角色肖像；面部区域被柔和的方形模糊遮盖，与生成的视觉效果相匹配。在右上角添加贴好的小备忘录纸和装饰性雨伞草图。

主要布局：一个由 24 张编号词汇卡组成的网格，排列为 4 列 6 行。每张卡片都有一个深蓝色圆形数字徽章、一个粗体日语术语标题、两到三行简短的日语说明文字，以及一张小型动漫雨景缩略图。使用细深蓝色边框和米白色卡片背景。对 24 张卡片进行编号和标注，包含以下概念：1 雨伞，2 共用雨伞，3 透明雨伞，4 湿发，5 湿透的校服，6 雨中留宿或避雨，7 屋檐下，8 公交车站，9 车站前的雨，10 阵雨，11 火车车厢内的雨，12 窗户玻璃，13 水坑，14 路面反射，15 雨滴，16 细雨，17 泥泞的地面，18 多云的天空，19 灰色的天空，20 雨后，21 夜雨，22 霓虹灯反射，23 雨季的潮湿，24 雨后余韵。

缩略图细节：在保持相同雨天动漫氛围的同时，使每张卡片的图像各不相同。包括特写肖像、行走场景、雨伞、湿衣服、公交车站、车站人群、火车窗户、水坑反射、霓虹城市街道、雨后绣球花以及雨后的房间或小巷。第 10 张和第 11 张卡片应在角色面部区域的部分位置包含柔和的灰色方形模糊，呼应原始的遮盖效果。

底部区域：添加一个带有宽边框的注释面板，标题为日语的使用指南，包含 5 个简短的日语项目符号，解释如何将该词汇表用于 AI 插画提示词。底部装饰有和纸胶带、钢笔墨水瓶、散落的回形针、手写备忘录碎片、小花和微小的雨滴图标。

约束条件：最终图像必须呈现出信息密集的可打印参考表的感觉，而不是单幅插画。使用 24 张编号卡片和 5 个底部项目符号。保持日式书法标题突出，维持清晰的网格结构，并避免添加任何徽标或水印。

templates.title: Blue Hydrangea Kimono Fantasy

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色绣球花和服幻想

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 anime-style fantasy illustration of a young Japanese woman named {argument name="character name" default="Aoi"} standing full-body on a steep stone stairway lined with blooming blue hydrangeas. She wears an ornate dark navy and black short kimono-inspired outfit with wide flowing sleeves, gold embroidery, blue floral appliqués, layered lace trim, a red-and-gold obi belt with dangling tassels, blue ribbons, black thigh-high stockings with gold patterns, and decorative geta sandals. Her dark hair is styled with large black-and-blue bow ornaments and blue flower hair accessories; keep her face softly beautiful and unobscured. She poses gracefully with one hand slightly raised, looking toward the viewer. The scene is a sparkling coastal hillside town at golden-blue twilight, overlooking a bright bay, distant mountains, rooftops, utility poles, and shimmering water. Surround her with luminous blue petals, tiny glowing orbs, drifting white feathers, sun rays from the upper left, and magical bokeh highlights. On the right side, include a small dark sign beside a metal railing with the Japanese text {argument name="sign text" default="小筑紫"}. Use a highly detailed polished anime illustration style, photorealistic lighting adapted into painterly fantasy art, rich sapphire and indigo color palette, intricate fabric detail, cinematic depth, radiant rim light, and dreamy romantic atmosphere. No watermark, no blurred face, no extra characters, no modern UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 纵向的动漫风格幻想插画，画面中一位名叫 {argument name="character name" default="Aoi"} 的日本年轻女性全身站立在一条陡峭的石阶上，石阶两旁开满了蓝色的绣球花。她身穿一套华丽的深海军蓝与黑色短款和服风格服装，配有宽大的飘逸袖子、金色刺绣、蓝色花朵贴花、层叠蕾丝边、带有垂坠流苏的红金配色腰带、蓝色丝带、带有金色图案的黑色过膝袜以及装饰性木屐。她留着深色长发，发间装饰着巨大的黑蓝色蝴蝶结和蓝色花朵发饰；保持面部柔美且无遮挡。她姿态优雅，一只手微微抬起，看向观众。场景设定在金蓝色黄昏下的闪耀海滨山城，俯瞰着明亮的海湾、远处的山脉、屋顶、电线杆和波光粼粼的水面。周围环绕着发光的蓝色花瓣、微小的光球、飘落的白色羽毛、从左上方射入的阳光以及梦幻般的虚化光斑。在右侧，金属栏杆旁设置一块深色小招牌，上面写有日文 {argument name="sign text" default="小筑紫"}。采用高度精细的精致动漫插画风格，将写实光影融入绘画感幻想艺术中，运用深蓝与靛青色调，展现细腻的布料质感、电影级的景深、璀璨的轮廓光以及梦幻浪漫的氛围。无水印，无模糊面部，无多余角色，无现代 UI 元素。

templates.title: Chibi Cat Girl Sticker Pack Preview

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版猫娘贴纸包预览

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cute preview screenshot of a 3x3 set of exactly 9 Japanese LINE-style chibi stickers on a large white rounded-rectangle canvas, with a small app-like vertical thumbnail strip on the right and translucent circular edit/share buttons at the bottom corners.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, clean white background, large rounded white sticker-sheet panel occupying most of the frame. Add a subtle light-gray shadow and rounded corners. On the far right, show 4 tiny stacked thumbnail previews of the same sticker sheet, with the lowest thumbnail outlined in black like it is selected. Bottom left has a semi-transparent gray circular button labeled in Japanese for edit, and bottom right has a semi-transparent gray circular share/upload icon.

Main subjects: A pastel anime chibi cat-girl and a small penguin mascot. The cat-girl has {argument name="hair color" default="very pale pink-white long hair with soft pink tips"}, fluffy cat ears, blue eyes when open, a blue oversized hoodie, short skirt or shorts, yellow leg warmers, white sneakers, and a small yellow hair clip. The penguin is round, navy blue and white, wearing a matching blue hoodie with a small front label. Use soft watercolor shading, thick clean sticker outlines, rounded cute proportions, expressive faces, and no harsh realism.

Sticker layout: Arrange exactly 9 discrete sticker illustrations in a 3 columns by 3 rows grid, each with large colorful handwritten Japanese caption text above or near it. Use the complete caption set {argument name="sticker captions" default="はらぺこ..., もぐもぐ, 休憩中〜, チラッ, 逃げろー!, 準備中..., 到着っ!, ぐったり, ぺこり"}. The 9 stickers are: 1) top-left, hungry: cat-girl sitting with eyes closed, hand on stomach, penguin beside her holding an empty plate and spoon, caption in brown; 2) top-center, eating: cat-girl happily eating a burger while penguin eats popcorn, small pink hearts around them, caption in orange; 3) top-right, break time: cat-girl sitting relaxed with a cup, penguin also drinking, musical note and puff cloud, caption in green; 4) middle-left, peeking: cat-girl peeks from the left edge behind a vertical wall or sign, penguin peeks from below, caption in gray; 5) middle-center, running away: cat-girl dashes away with motion blur and dust clouds while penguin runs after her holding popcorn, caption in bright blue; 6) middle-right, getting ready: cat-girl stands by a full-length mirror brushing her hair while penguin holds a hairbrush, yellow sparkles, caption in yellow-orange; 7) bottom-left, arrived: cat-girl points upward cheerfully while sitting on a suitcase, penguin holds a travel map, small mountain scenery behind them and sparkles, caption in red; 8) bottom-center, exhausted: cat-girl sits slumped with tired face, penguin lies face-down wearing an ice pack, wavy blue fatigue lines above them, caption in blue; 9) bottom-right, bowing: cat-girl bows politely with eyes hidden and penguin bows/raises flipper beside her, caption in dark gray.

Style constraints: Make it look like a finished sticker pack preview from a mobile app, with crisp transparent-sticker-like artwork on white, soft shadows, pastel colors, handwritten playful lettering, and consistent character design across all 9 stickers. Avoid adding extra stickers, extra characters, watermarks, or unrelated UI text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：在大型白色圆角矩形画布上，创建一个包含 9 个日式 LINE 风格 Q 版贴纸的 3x3 预览截图，右侧带有类似 App 的垂直缩略图条，底部角落设有半透明的圆形编辑/分享按钮。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，干净的白色背景，大型圆角白色贴纸面板占据大部分画面。添加微妙的浅灰色阴影和圆角。最右侧显示 4 个相同的贴纸页微型堆叠缩略图，最下方的缩略图有黑色边框，表示已被选中。左下角有一个带有日文标签的半透明灰色圆形编辑按钮，右下角有一个半透明的灰色圆形分享/上传图标。

主要角色：一个淡彩动漫 Q 版猫娘和一个小企鹅吉祥物。猫娘拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极浅粉白色长发，发梢呈柔和的粉色"}、毛茸茸的猫耳、睁开时为蓝色的眼睛、蓝色大号连帽衫、短裙或短裤、黄色腿套、白色运动鞋和一个黄色小发夹。企鹅圆滚滚的，呈深蓝色和白色，穿着配套的蓝色连帽衫，前面有一个小标签。使用柔和的水彩阴影、厚实清晰的贴纸轮廓、圆润可爱的比例、生动的表情，避免生硬的写实感。

贴纸布局：将 9 个独立的贴纸插图排列成 3 列 3 行的网格，每个贴纸上方或附近都有醒目的彩色手写日文字幕。使用完整的字幕集 {argument name="sticker captions" default="はらぺこ..., もぐもぐ, 休憩中〜, チラッ, 逃げろー!, 準備中..., 到着っ!, ぐったり, ぺこり"}。9 个贴纸分别是：1) 左上，饥饿：猫娘闭眼坐着，手放在肚子上，企鹅在旁边拿着空盘子和勺子，棕色字幕；2) 上中，进食：猫娘开心地吃汉堡，企鹅吃爆米花，周围有粉色小爱心，橙色字幕；3) 右上，休息：猫娘放松地坐着喝杯子里的饮料，企鹅也在喝，有音符和气泡，绿色字幕；4) 中左，偷看：猫娘从左侧边缘的墙或标志后探出头，企鹅从下方探出头，灰色字幕；5) 中中，逃跑：猫娘带着动态模糊和灰尘云冲走，企鹅拿着爆米花在后面追，亮蓝色字幕；6) 中右，准备中：猫娘站在全身镜旁梳头，企鹅拿着梳子，有黄色闪光，黄橙色字幕；7) 左下，到达：猫娘坐在行李箱上开心地指着上方，企鹅拿着旅行地图，背后有小山风景和闪光，红色字幕；8) 下中，疲惫：猫娘垂头丧气地坐着，表情疲惫，企鹅趴着并戴着冰袋，上方有波浪状的蓝色疲劳线，蓝色字幕；9) 右下，鞠躬：猫娘礼貌地鞠躬，眼睛被遮住，企鹅在旁边鞠躬/举起鳍，深灰色字幕。

风格限制：使其看起来像移动 App 中完成的贴纸包预览，在白色背景上呈现清晰的透明贴纸式艺术效果，带有柔和的阴影、淡彩配色、俏皮的手写字体，并确保所有 9 个贴纸的角色设计保持一致。避免添加额外的贴纸、角色、水印或不相关的 UI 文字。

templates.title: Rainy Sports Day Chibi Manga

titleLocalized.zh: 雨天的运动会 Q 版漫画

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese 4-panel manga comic about a cute chibi girl becoming even more excited when a rainy sports day is postponed.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page in full color, approximately 9:16, with a white outer margin and thick black panel borders. Use exactly 4 stacked horizontal panels of equal width, manga-style composition, energetic expressions, glossy digital coloring, bold outlines, dramatic speed lines, sparkles, and sound effects.

Main character: A single chibi elementary-school girl named {argument name="character name" default="purple-haired girl"}. She has long wavy lavender-purple hair, pale skin, round gray eyes that turn into sparkling star eyes when excited, rosy cheeks, and a small open mouth. She wears a pale pink short-sleeve blouse with buttons, a light beige skirt, white socks, and simple shoes. Her pose is usually fists clenched near her chest in excitement or surprise.

Panel 1: School sports day setup under stormy clouds. Show the girl standing large in the center of a school athletic field, smiling with clenched fists and sparkles around her. Background includes a school building, Japanese flag, strings of international flags, a clock, a flower-decorated sports day arch labeled 「運動会」, tents, cones, bags, and lunch boxes. Add a large vertical speech bubble on the right with 「今日は運動会！」. At the very top outside or above the first panel, add the headline: {argument name="headline text" default="雨が空ごとプールに変わっても、楽しみは10倍に跳ね上がる！"}.

Panel 2: Indoor announcement scene. Show a wall-mounted gray loudspeaker on the left, a taped white notice below it reading 「雨で延期」, and the girl on the right in close-up looking shocked with a sweat drop, clenched fist, and wide open mouth. Add a speech bubble on the right reading 「延期!?」. Use beige indoor wall tones and manga burst lines radiating from her face.

Panel 3: Torrential rain on the sports field. Show the athletic field transformed into a shallow flooded pool under heavy rain, lightning, dark storm clouds, and dramatic water splashes. The girl stands in the foreground with star-shaped eyes and an amazed open mouth, holding a spiral-bound calendar that reads 「運動会（新しい日）」 with a large red circled 「7」 and 「日後！」 underneath. Add two sound effects: blue 「ザーッ」 for heavy rain on the left and orange 「ゴロゴロ」 for thunder on the upper right. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right reading 「あと7日!?」.

Panel 4: Extreme close-up celebration. Fill the panel with the girl's happy face, sparkling star eyes, open smiling mouth, and clenched fists. Use a hot pink and red radial burst background filled with yellow sparkles. Add one jagged speech bubble on the left containing 「100倍!!」 in red and 「楽しみ」 in black, meaning the excitement is multiplied.

Text count and placement: Include exactly 1 headline, exactly 4 comic panels, exactly 4 speech bubbles, exactly 1 taped notice, exactly 1 calendar page, exactly 2 manga sound effects, and exactly 1 sports day arch label. Preserve all Japanese text exactly as written. Avoid adding extra dialogue, captions, logos, watermarks, or additional characters.

Visual style: Cute Japanese chibi manga, bright saturated colors, clean black line art, expressive faces, playful dramatic exaggeration, polished webcomic look, high readability of all Japanese text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一幅竖版日本四格漫画，讲述一位可爱的 Q 版女孩在雨天运动会延期后变得更加兴奋的故事。

画布：全彩竖版长条漫画页面，比例约为 9:16，带有白色外边距和粗黑色的分镜边框。使用 4 个等宽的堆叠横向分镜，采用漫画风格构图，表现充满活力的表情、光泽感的数字上色、粗轮廓线、戏剧性的速度线、闪光效果和拟声词。

主角：一位名叫 {argument name="character name" default="紫发女孩"} 的 Q 版小学生。她留着长长的波浪状薰衣草紫发，皮肤白皙，圆圆的灰色眼睛在兴奋时会变成闪烁的星星眼，脸颊红润，小嘴微张。她穿着一件浅粉色的短袖衬衫，带有纽扣，搭配浅米色裙子、白袜子和简单的鞋子。她的姿势通常是双手握拳放在胸前，表现出兴奋或惊讶。

分镜 1：乌云笼罩下的学校运动会场景。展示女孩站在学校操场中央，握紧拳头微笑，周围环绕着闪光。背景包括教学楼、日本国旗、万国旗、时钟、装饰着花朵并标有「運動会」字样的运动会拱门、帐篷、锥形路标、包和午餐盒。在右侧添加一个大的竖向对话气泡，写着「今日は運動会！」。在第一个分镜的顶部外侧或上方，添加标题：{argument name="headline text" default="雨が空ごとプールに変わっても、楽しみは10倍に跳ね上がる！"}。

分镜 2：室内广播场景。左侧展示一个挂在墙上的灰色扬声器，下方贴着一张写有「雨で延期」的白色通知，右侧是女孩的特写，她看起来很震惊，带着汗滴，握紧拳头，嘴巴大张。在右侧添加一个对话气泡，写着「延期!?」。使用米色的室内墙壁色调，并从她的脸部向外辐射出漫画爆发线。

分镜 3：运动场上的倾盆大雨。展示操场在暴雨、闪电、乌云和戏剧性的水花中变成了一个浅浅的积水池。女孩站在前景中，眼睛变成星星状，嘴巴惊讶地张开，手里拿着一本螺旋装订的日历，上面写着「運動会（新しい日）」，下方有一个用红色大圆圈圈出的「7」和「日後！」。添加两个拟声词：左侧蓝色的「ザーッ」表示大雨，右上角橙色的「ゴロゴロ」表示雷声。在右侧添加一个竖向对话气泡，写着「あと7日!?」。

分镜 4：极度特写的庆祝画面。用女孩开心的脸部表情填满整个分镜，包括闪烁的星星眼、张开的笑嘴和紧握的拳头。使用亮粉色和红色的放射状爆发背景，并填满黄色闪光。在左侧添加一个锯齿状对话气泡，里面用红色写着「100倍!!」，黑色写着「楽しみ」，意为兴奋感倍增。

文字数量与位置：包含 1 个标题、4 个漫画分镜、4 个对话气泡、1 张贴纸通知、1 页日历、2 个漫画拟声词和 1 个运动会拱门标签。请完全保留所有日语文本。避免添加额外的对话、说明文字、Logo、水印或其他角色。

视觉风格：可爱的日本 Q 版漫画，明亮饱和的色彩，干净的黑色线条，生动的表情，俏皮的戏剧性夸张，精致的网络漫画质感，所有日语文本均需具备高可读性。

templates.title: Trading Card Battle Anime Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 集换式卡牌对战动画分镜

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished anime storyboard sheet for a fictional 10-second trading card battle anime sequence, designed like a cinematic ad storyboard made from five horizontal panels.

Canvas: Landscape 16:10 white storyboard page with thin gray table borders, a centered Japanese headline at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="10秒トレーディングカードバトルアニメ 絵コンテ"}, a thin red line accent near the top left, and a small angular red logo-like mark in the top right.

Layout: Use a three-column storyboard grid. The left column is narrow and contains red cut labels plus timing. The center column is wide and contains cinematic anime stills. The right column is a white notes column with camera direction and action notes. There are exactly 5 horizontal rows, separated by light gray lines.

Visible cut list: 1) Cut 1, 0.0s-2.0s: wide establishing arena shot. 2) Cut 2, 2.0s-4.0s: medium-close shot of the protagonist activating a card device. 3) Cut 3, 4.0s-6.2s: extreme close-up of a card thrust toward the viewer. 4) Cut 4, 6.2s-8.5s: whip-pan summoning scene with a dragon hologram appearing. 5) Cut 5, 8.5s-10.0s: final low-angle hero-and-dragon shot.

Subject details: The protagonist is {argument name="protagonist description" default="a fiery red-haired teenage anime boy wearing a red-and-black battle jacket, fingerless gloves, and a glowing mechanical card duel device on one arm"}. The summoned monster is {argument name="dragon description" default="a crimson armored dragon with huge wings, jagged horns, glowing red crystal chest core, and ember-like highlights"}. The arena is {argument name="arena description" default="a futuristic packed stadium at night with blue neon spotlights, a glowing duel field, massive audience stands, and a giant VS screen"}. The main card art shows a red demonic dragon emblem and fiery energy.

Center-panel imagery: Cut 1 shows the full stadium duel field with the red-haired protagonist on the left, an opponent in white far away on the right, giant red and blue card banners, and a large glowing “VS” display in the background. Cut 2 shows the protagonist grinning confidently, holding up a red dragon card while red energy coils around the wrist-mounted duel device; intentionally obscure or soften the exact face area as if motion-blurred/censored. Cut 3 shows a sharp close-up of one intense red eye and the raised dragon card, with rack-focus depth of field and explosive red particle streaks behind it. Cut 4 shows a red magic circle covering the arena floor as the dragon materializes in holographic flame beside the protagonist. Cut 5 shows the protagonist standing heroically beside the fully formed dragon, both lit from below by red embers and dramatic battle light.

Right-column text notes: For Cut 1 write “wide shot / dolly in / audience cheers, introduce protagonist”. For Cut 2 include the red Japanese quote {argument name="summon quote" default="「来い、紅蓮王ドラグレイザー！」"} followed by “medium-close-up / fearless smile / device activation”. For Cut 3 write “extreme close-up / rack focus / thrust card toward camera”. For Cut 4 write “whip pan / hologram summon / dragon appears”. For Cut 5 write “low angle / orbit shot / decisive cut”.

Visual style: High-energy modern shonen anime, glossy digital painting, cinematic lighting, red and blue color contrast, intense lens flares, speed lines, sparks, holographic particles, dramatic perspective, crisp storyboard presentation, professional production-board clarity.

Constraints: Keep exactly 5 storyboard rows, exactly 3 columns, and preserve the timing labels. Do not add extra cuts, extra characters, watermarks, or unrelated UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一段 10 秒的虚构集换式卡牌对战动画序列创建一个精致的动画分镜页，设计风格参考由五个横向画格组成的电影广告分镜。

画布：16:10 横向白色分镜页面，带有细灰色表格边框，顶部居中显示日语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="10秒トレーディングカードバトルアニメ 絵コンテ"}，左上角附近有一条细红线装饰，右上角有一个小的棱角分明的红色标志状标记。

布局：使用三列分镜网格。左列较窄，包含红色镜头标签和时间；中列较宽，包含电影感动画剧照；右列为白色备注栏，用于记录摄像机方向和动作说明。共有 5 个横向行，由浅灰色线条分隔。

可见镜头列表：1) Cut 1, 0.0s-2.0s：竞技场全景建立镜头。 2) Cut 2, 2.0s-4.0s：主角激活卡牌装置的中近景。 3) Cut 3, 4.0s-6.2s：卡牌向观众推近的特写镜头。 4) Cut 4, 6.2s-8.5s：龙形全息图出现的快速平移召唤场景。 5) Cut 5, 8.5s-10.0s：最终英雄与龙的低角度镜头。

主体细节：主角为 {argument name="protagonist description" default="一位留着火红色头发的少年，身穿红黑相间的战斗夹克，戴着露指手套，手臂上佩戴着发光的机械卡牌决斗装置"}。被召唤的怪兽为 {argument name="dragon description" default="一只深红色装甲龙，拥有巨大的翅膀、锯齿状的角、发光的红色水晶胸核以及余烬般的亮光"}。竞技场为 {argument name="arena description" default="一个夜晚充满未来感的拥挤体育场，配有蓝色霓虹聚光灯、发光的决斗场、巨大的观众席和巨大的 VS 屏幕"}。主卡牌图案展示了红色恶魔龙徽章和火焰能量。

中心画格图像：Cut 1 展示了完整的体育场决斗场，左侧是红发主角，右侧远处是身穿白衣的对手，背景中有巨大的红蓝卡牌横幅和巨大的发光“VS”显示屏。Cut 2 展示了主角自信地咧嘴一笑，举起一张红龙卡牌，红色能量环绕在腕式决斗装置周围；刻意模糊或柔化面部区域，营造出动态模糊/遮挡感。Cut 3 展示了一只锐利的红色眼睛和举起的龙卡牌的特写，具有焦点平移景深效果，身后有爆炸性的红色粒子条纹。Cut 4 展示了红色魔法阵覆盖竞技场地面，龙以全息火焰的形式在主角身边显现。Cut 5 展示了主角英勇地站在完全成形的龙身边，两者都被来自下方的红色余烬和戏剧性的战斗光线照亮。

右列文字备注：Cut 1 填写“全景 / 推镜头 / 观众欢呼，介绍主角”。Cut 2 包含红色日语引语 {argument name="summon quote" default="「来い、紅蓮王ドラグレイザー！」"}，后接“中近景 / 无畏微笑 / 装置激活”。Cut 3 填写“特写 / 焦点平移 / 卡牌向镜头推近”。Cut 4 填写“快速平移 / 全息召唤 / 龙出现”。Cut 5 填写“低角度 / 环绕镜头 / 决定性镜头”。

视觉风格：高能量现代少年动画，光泽感数字绘画，电影级灯光，红蓝色彩对比，强烈的镜头光晕，速度线，火花，全息粒子，戏剧性透视，清晰的分镜呈现，专业的制作板清晰度。

约束：保持正好 5 行分镜，正好 3 列，并保留时间标签。不要添加额外的镜头、额外角色、水印或不相关的 UI 元素。

templates.title: Anime Girl in Emergency Stairwell

titleLocalized.zh: 紧急楼梯间的动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 anime-style illustration set inside a dim industrial emergency stairwell at night. The camera is a high-angle first-person point of view looking down at a teenage girl standing on a metal diamond-plate stair landing, reaching toward the viewer and holding the viewer's hand in the foreground. She wears a short-sleeved white button-up school blouse with a collar, a dark olive-black layered ruffle skirt, and a loose blue-gray ribbon tied at the waist. Her {argument name="hair color" default="olive brown with blonde highlights and green-purple dyed streaks"} hair is shoulder length with bangs and side locks, slightly messy, catching cool overhead light. Add a large opaque square censor block over the center of her face, filled with a soft muted brown-to-pink gradient, hiding all facial features. The setting includes exactly 4 major stairwell elements: gray concrete walls, silver metal safety railings, textured steel floor panels, and one glowing emergency wall lamp near the lower left casting warm yellow light. Use dramatic cinematic anime lighting with cool blue-gray shadows, warm lamp glow, detailed line art, subtle film-grain texture, and a slightly intimate emotional mood as if she is guiding the viewer up or down the emergency stairs. Keep the composition tight, with her torso and skirt dominant in frame, one of her hands extended toward the viewer, the viewer's hand visible at bottom center, and no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖构图的动漫风格插画，场景设定在夜晚昏暗的工业风紧急楼梯间。镜头采用高角度第一人称视角，俯瞰站在金属花纹钢板楼梯平台上的少女，她正向观众伸出手，并在前景中牵着观众的手。她身穿短袖白色衬衫校服，搭配深橄榄黑色层叠荷叶边短裙，腰间系着一条宽松的蓝灰色丝带。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="橄榄棕色，带有金色挑染以及绿色和紫色染发条纹"} 头发为齐肩长度，留有刘海和侧发，略显凌乱，映衬着上方冷色调的光线。在她的脸部中心添加一个大型不透明方形马赛克遮挡块，填充柔和的棕色至粉色渐变，遮住所有面部特征。场景包含 4 个主要的楼梯间元素：灰色混凝土墙壁、银色金属安全护栏、纹理钢地板，以及左下方一盏散发着温暖黄光的紧急壁灯。采用富有戏剧性的电影感动漫光影，呈现冷蓝灰色的阴影与温暖的灯光，具备细腻的线条艺术、微妙的胶片颗粒质感，营造出一种仿佛她正引导观众上下紧急楼梯的亲密情绪氛围。构图紧凑，画面主体为她的上半身和裙子，她的一只手伸向观众，观众的手出现在底部中心，画面中不包含任何文字或水印。

templates.title: Fictional Anime Movie Review Page

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构动画电影评论页面

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a fictional Japanese movie information page and poster for an anime sci-fi mystery film titled {argument name="movie title" default="ノヴァ・リフレイン"}, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle" default="終わらない記憶"}. The design should look like a polished streaming/movie review website screenshot paired with theatrical key art.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, dark navy interface, approximately 768×1024. Use a two-column top layout and a full-width review feed below. Overall mood is futuristic, rainy, emotional, and cinematic.

Top-left poster: A tall theatrical anime poster with rounded corners and a thin blue border. Show a rainy cyberpunk city at night under a starry purple-blue galaxy sky. In the foreground is a teenage anime girl wearing a black hooded jacket, glowing cyan cat-ear headphones, dark twin-tail hair, and a small sleeve patch reading “S-07”. Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft square gray blur censor block. A small distant figure stands in the wet street behind her. Add Japanese tagline text at upper left: “記憶は、消えても、想いは、残る。” At the bottom of the poster, display the large title “ノヴァ・リフレイン”, beneath it “— NOVA: REFRAIN —”, then “— 終わらない記憶 —”, and at the very bottom “2025.07.18 (FRI) ROADSHOW” in purple-blue lettering.

Top-right movie details panel: Use a dark card with subtle borders and clean Japanese UI typography. Include exactly 4 genre tags at the top: “SF”, “ヒューマンドラマ”, “青春”, “ミステリー”. Below them show the title “ノヴァ・リフレイン” and subtitle “— 終わらない記憶 —”. Add the release line “2025年7月18日公開 / 上映時間 126分”. Show overall rating with exactly 5 gold star icons, the last star half-filled, and numeric rating “4.4”. Include exactly 3 action buttons: a purple play button labeled “予告編を見る”, an outlined bookmark button labeled “あとで観る”, and an outlined share button labeled “シェア”.

Synopsis section: Add heading “あらすじ” and a short Japanese synopsis about a near-future world where memory data has become normal, a high school girl named レティシア tries to restore the lost memories of a friend after an accident, and discovers a hidden “truth” that could alter the fate of the world.

Staff and cast section: Use two columns. Staff column title “スタッフ” with exactly 8 fictional staff lines: “監督：ソフト・レイン”, “脚本：ミサセ・ユウリ”, “音楽：ハルカ・ミサキ”, “撮影：フジサキ・レン”, “美術：カガリ・トウマ”, “編集：ナギサ・コトネ”, “VFX：アイオ・シュウ”, “制作：エクリプス・ピクチャーズ”. Cast column title “キャスト” with exactly 6 fictional cast lines: “レティシア：ユイナ・カナメ”, “アイオ：カガミ・リク”, “カイト：ハヤセ・ソウタ”, “博士：レイジ・クロサワ”, “ナビAI「ノヴァ」：ミユ・シラカワ”, plus one additional short fictional name if needed to fill spacing. Do not use real celebrity names.

Review feed: Below the top panels, create a section titled “みんなのレビュー” with a small button on the right reading “すべてのレビューを見る”. Include exactly 5 review cards stacked vertically, each with a circular avatar, reviewer display name, handle, gold star rating, bold Japanese review title/body, timestamp, and purple thumbs-up count. Reviews are:
1. Avatar: anime girl portrait. Name “星乃そら”, handle “@sora_hoshino_23”, rating “5.0” with 5 gold stars, title “今年一番の没入感。ラスト10分、涙が止まらなかった。” timestamp “2025/7/18 23:41”, likes “324”.
2. Avatar: dark-haired anime boy side profile. Name “霧島レン”, handle “@lenscape_07”, rating “4.5”, title “SF好きなら絶対ハマる。設定も演出も一級品。” timestamp “2025/7/19 10:12”, likes “198”.
3. Avatar: cute cat photo. Name “もちまる”, handle “@mochimaru_33”, rating “3.5”, title “泣けるけど、ちょっと難しかったかも？” timestamp “2025/7/19 14:56”, likes “87”.
4. Avatar: blue sky and clouds photo. Name “蒼井ナツメ”, handle “@natsume_aoi”, rating “4.0”, title “音楽がとにかく良い。サントラ絶対買う。” timestamp “2025/7/19 18:30”, likes “142”.
5. Avatar: anime portrait with face softly blurred. Name “タカト・ユウキ”, handle “@yuki_t_movie”, rating “2.5”, title “設定は面白いけど、後半の展開が駆け足すぎたかな。” timestamp “2025/7/20 00:05”, likes “51”.

Visual style: High-quality anime key visual combined with a modern dark-mode Japanese cinema database UI. Use neon cyan and purple accents, soft glow, rainy reflections, thin dividers, rounded cards, crisp legible Japanese text, gold stars, and a premium sci-fi drama atmosphere. Keep all names fictional and avoid real staff or cast.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部名为 {argument name="movie title" default="ノヴァ・リフレイン"}、副标题为 {argument name="subtitle" default="終わらない記憶"} 的动画科幻悬疑电影，创建一个虚构的日本电影信息页面和海报。设计应呈现为精致的流媒体/电影评论网站截图，并配以剧场版主视觉图。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，深蓝色界面，尺寸约为 768×1024。采用顶部双栏布局，下方为全宽评论流。整体氛围充满未来感、雨景、情感色彩和电影质感。

左上角海报：一张带有圆角和细蓝色边框的竖版剧场动画海报。展示一个雨夜的赛博朋克城市，背景是星光璀璨的紫蓝色银河。前景是一位少女，身穿黑色连帽夹克，戴着发光的青色猫耳耳机，留着深色双马尾，袖口有一个写着“S-07”的小补丁。她的面部被一个柔和的方形灰色模糊遮挡块刻意遮盖。在雨中的街道后方站着一个模糊的远景人物。左上角添加日文标语：“記憶は、消えても、想いは、残る。” 海报底部显示大标题“ノヴァ・リフレイン”，下方为“— NOVA: REFRAIN —”，接着是“— 終わらない記憶 —”，最底部以紫蓝色字体显示“2025.07.18 (FRI) ROADSHOW”。

右上角电影详情面板：使用带有细微边框和简洁日文 UI 排版的深色卡片。顶部包含 4 个类型标签：“SF”、“ヒューマンドラマ”、“青春”、“ミステリー”。下方显示标题“ノヴァ・リフレイン”和副标题“— 終わらない記憶 —”。添加上映信息行“2025年7月18日公開 / 上映時間 126分”。显示综合评分，包含 5 个金星图标（最后一颗星半满），以及数字评分“4.4”。包含 3 个操作按钮：紫色播放按钮标注“予告編を見る”，带边框的书签按钮标注“あとで観る”，以及带边框的分享按钮标注“シェア”。

剧情简介部分：添加标题“あらすじ”，并附上一段简短的日文剧情简介，讲述在一个记忆数据已成为常态的近未来世界中，一名叫作レティシア的高中女生在事故后试图恢复朋友丢失的记忆，并发现了可能改变世界命运的隐藏“真相”。

演职员部分：使用两栏布局。演职员栏标题“スタッフ”，包含 8 行虚构职员信息：“監督：ソフト・レイン”、“脚本：ミサセ・ユウリ”、“音楽：ハルカ・ミサキ”、“撮影：フジサキ・レン”、“美術：カガリ・トウマ”、“編集：ナギサ・コトネ”、“VFX：アイオ・シュウ”、“制作：エクリプス・ピクチャーズ”。演员栏标题“キャスト”，包含 6 行虚构演员信息：“レティシア：ユイナ・カナメ”、“アイオ：カガミ・リク”、“カイト：ハヤセ・ソウタ”、“博士：レイジ・クロサワ”、“ナビAI「ノヴァ」：ミユ・シラカワ”，如有需要可增加一个简短的虚构名字以填补间距。请勿使用真实名人姓名。

评论流：在顶部面板下方，创建一个标题为“みんなのレビュー”的部分，右侧设有一个小按钮，文字为“すべてのレビューを見る”。垂直堆叠 5 张评论卡片，每张卡片包含圆形头像、评论者显示名、账号 ID、金星评分、加粗的日文评论标题/正文、时间戳以及紫色的点赞数。评论内容如下：
1. 头像：动画少女肖像。名称“星乃そら”，账号“@sora_hoshino_23”，评分“5.0”（5 颗金星），标题“今年一番の没入感。ラスト10分、涙が止まらなかった。”，时间戳“2025/7/18 23:41”，点赞“324”。
2. 头像：深色头发动画少年侧脸。名称“霧島レン”，账号“@lenscape_07”，评分“4.5”，标题“SF好きなら絶対ハマる。設定も演出も一級品。”，时间戳“2025/7/19 10:12”，点赞“198”。
3. 头像：可爱的猫咪照片。名称“もちまる”，账号“@mochimaru_33”，评分“3.5”，标题“泣けるけど、ちょっと難しかったかも？”，时间戳“2025/7/19 14:56”，点赞“87”。
4. 头像：蓝天白云照片。名称“蒼井ナツメ”，账号“@natsume_aoi”，评分“4.0”，标题“音楽がとにかく良い。サントラ絶対買う。”，时间戳“2025/7/19 18:30”，点赞“142”。
5. 头像：面部被柔和模糊处理的动画肖像。名称“タカト・ユウキ”，账号“@yuki_t_movie”，评分“2.5”，标题“設定は面白いけど、後半の展開が駆け足すぎたかな。”，时间戳“2025/7/20 00:05”，点赞“51”。

视觉风格：高质量动画主视觉图结合现代深色模式日本电影数据库 UI。使用霓虹青色和紫色点缀，柔和的光晕，雨景反射，细分割线，圆角卡片，清晰易读的日文文本，金星图标，以及高级科幻剧情片的氛围。所有姓名均保持虚构，避免使用真实的演职员。

templates.title: Anime-Inspired Met Gala Trio

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格 Met Gala 三人组

templates.prompt: Create a glamorous vertical high-fashion red-carpet photograph at the Met Gala, featuring exactly three elegant anime-inspired female celebrities posing on wide midnight-blue stairs in front of a crowded paparazzi background. The scene is cinematic, ultra-detailed, realistic, and editorial, with bright camera flashes, soft bokeh lights, white floral hedges, a dark starry night sky, and dramatic luxury-event lighting. The three subjects should have smooth anonymized/blurred faces with no visible facial features, but highly detailed hair, jewelry, bodies, and gowns. Left subject: petite figure leaning slightly left, dark black hair in a polished low bun, wearing a strapless silver crystal corset bodice with a deep navy satin mermaid skirt, ornate gold-and-silver embroidery down the side, draped navy fabric at the hip, dangling tassel ornament, choker necklace, bracelets, and a small train. Center subject: tallest figure standing confidently with one hand on her hip, lavender-purple hair styled in a large sculptural braided updo, wearing a strapless silver beaded corset gown with a deep navy velvet diagonal sash over one shoulder, silver satin draped skirt, high thigh slit, dark navy embroidered side panel, long flowing silver train, sparkling brooch at the shoulder, layered necklace, rings, and strappy high heels. Right subject: poised figure with very long straight rose-pink hair in a high ponytail flowing to the right, wearing a black velvet strapless couture gown with dense silver pearl-and-crystal chains, black opera gloves, ornate choker, fitted bodice, large dark navy rose-shaped fabric sculpture at the hip, long black and navy velvet train, and one hand on her hip. Use a rich palette of {argument name="main dress colors" default="midnight navy, silver, black velvet, and rose pink"}, elaborate couture beadwork, pearl draping, embroidered floral appliqués, glossy satin, velvet textures, and dramatic Met Gala styling. Composition should be full-body, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio, three figures centered and filling the frame, photographed from a slightly low angle to emphasize grandeur. Make the image look like a real luxury fashion photo rather than a cartoon, while keeping subtle anime-character-inspired silhouettes and hair colors. Avoid logos, readable text, watermarks, extra people in the foreground, distorted hands, or additional main subjects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张迷人的竖版高级时尚红毯照片，背景设在 Met Gala，画面中恰好有三位优雅的动漫风格女性名人，在拥挤的狗仔队背景前，站在宽阔的午夜蓝台阶上摆姿势。场景具有电影感、超细节、写实且具编辑风格，伴有明亮的相机闪光灯、柔和的焦外成像光斑、白色花篱、深邃的星空以及戏剧性的奢华活动灯光。三位主体应拥有平滑且经过匿名/模糊处理的面部，无可见五官，但头发、珠宝、身体和礼服需高度精细。左侧主体：娇小身材，身体微向左倾，深黑色头发梳成精致的低发髻，身穿无肩带银色水晶束身胸衣，搭配深海军蓝缎面鱼尾裙，侧面饰有华丽的金银刺绣，臀部有海军蓝褶皱面料，配有垂坠流苏装饰、颈圈项链、手镯和小型裙摆。中间主体：最高挑的身材，自信站立，单手叉腰，薰衣草紫发型梳成大型雕塑感编织盘发，身穿无肩带银色珠饰束身礼服，肩部斜跨深海军蓝丝绒饰带，银色缎面褶皱裙，高开叉，深海军蓝刺绣侧板，长款飘逸银色裙摆，肩部饰有闪亮胸针，叠戴项链，戒指和系带高跟鞋。右侧主体：姿态优雅，留着极长的直发玫瑰粉色高马尾，向右飘逸，身穿黑色丝绒无肩带高级定制礼服，饰有密集的银色珍珠和水晶链，佩戴黑色歌剧手套、华丽颈圈，修身胸衣，臀部饰有大型深海军蓝玫瑰状面料雕塑，长款黑蓝丝绒裙摆，单手叉腰。使用丰富的色调 {argument name="main dress colors" default="午夜海军蓝、银色、黑色丝绒和玫瑰粉色"}，精美的高定串珠工艺、珍珠垂坠、刺绣花卉贴花、光泽缎面、丝绒质感以及戏剧性的 Met Gala 造型。构图应为全身照，2:3 竖向比例，三个人物居中并填满画面，从略微仰视的角度拍摄以强调宏伟感。使图像看起来像真实的奢华时尚照片而非卡通，同时保留微妙的动漫角色风格轮廓和发色。避免出现标志、可读文字、水印、前景中多余的人、扭曲的手部或额外的主体。

templates.prompt: Create a full-body vertical editorial fashion photograph of {argument name="character name" default="a glamorous anime-inspired woman"} posing on the Met Gala staircase, centered and slightly turned with one hand gathering the skirt. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全身垂直的时尚编辑风格摄影作品，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位迷人的动漫风格女性"}，她正摆姿势站在 Met Gala 的楼梯上，居中且身体微侧，一只手提起裙摆。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳的紫色"} 头发，梳成高耸的编织皇冠发髻，佩戴优雅的耳环，展现出自信的红毯姿态；保持面部柔和虚化，呈现平滑的肤色，不显示具体的五官特征。背景是拥挤的奢华晚宴入口，背景中有身着深色西装的摄影师、明亮的相机闪光灯、带有小星星图案的奶油色与蓝色地毯楼梯，以及楼梯旁茂密的奶油色花丛。服装包含 6 个主要可见部分：1) 雕塑感象牙白紧身胸衣，配心形领口；2) 垂坠感象牙白缎面裙，带有长长的褶皱裙摆；3) 深午夜蓝丝绒外裙片；4) 长款午夜蓝丝绒开襟外套/斗篷，带有扫地裙摆；5) 华丽的银色水晶花卉刺绣和珠饰贴花，点缀在胸衣、臀部、袖子和下摆上；6) 一条带有小吊坠的黑色颈圈。使用 {argument name="gown color palette" default="象牙白缎面、午夜蓝丝绒、银色水晶装饰"}，展现极致奢华的高定细节、逼真的面料质感、电影级闪光灯摄影效果、浅景深、高对比度、光面杂志质感，采用 3:4 垂直构图，无 Logo，无文字，无水印。

Use a realistic celebrity paparazzi photo style, shallow depth of field, cinematic flash lighting, natural skin tones, crisp fabric detail, luxurious contrast, vertical 2:3 composition, and the atmosphere of a glamorous fashion gala. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2026 年 Met Gala 红毯高级时装大片，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻女性"}，她正站在宏伟的蓝色地毯楼梯上摆姿势。画面采用背影视角，她优雅地转过四分之三身位，一只手轻放在腰间，头部微微回眸。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的发色，梳着精致浪漫的盘发，身形纤细白皙，露出双肩，面部轮廓刻意处理得柔和模糊，以确保视觉焦点集中在高级定制礼服上。礼服需包含 4 个核心部件：抹胸银色水晶刺绣紧身胸衣、背部垂下的长款象牙白缎面中片、深邃午夜蓝天鹅绒外裙（带有蓬松的褶皱臀部设计），以及拖地的超长裙摆，裙摆上覆盖着华丽的银色花卉刺绣和珠饰。礼服应呈现出奢华、雕塑感且具有博物馆收藏级别的质感，融合闪亮的蕾丝贴花、植物图案以及厚重的缎面与天鹅绒纹理。场景设定在 {argument name="event setting" default="Met Gala 楼梯"}，深青蓝色的楼梯上装饰着小雏菊图案，两侧是茂密的奶油色与绿色花墙，背景中是一群身着黑色礼服的摄影师，他们手持相机，闪光灯明亮。采用写实的明星街拍风格，浅景深，电影级闪光灯照明，自然的肤色，清晰的织物细节，奢华的对比度，2:3 竖构图，营造出迷人的时尚盛典氛围。避免出现文字、Logo、水印、前景中多余的人物、扭曲的解剖结构以及卡通风格。

templates.title: Twin Soap Bubble Birds at Tomamu

titleLocalized.zh: Tomamu 的双生泡泡鸟

templates.prompt: Create a bright, highly detailed anime illustration of {argument name="character description" default="twin young girls with pale silver-white bobbed hair"} walking side by side on a sunny resort pathway in Tomamu, Hokkaido. Both characters have their faces intentionally covered by smooth pale gray square blocks with no facial features. They wear matching airy white layered dresses with pale blue-gray ribbons, oversized light cardigans, delicate bead chains, pom-pom charms, small crossbody bags, white socks, and chunky white sneakers. Count exactly two girls: the left twin points outward with her left hand and has a feathery bird-like wing accessory and fluffy pom-pom bag at her side; the right twin holds one hand near her collar and carries a small iridescent transparent shoulder bag. Add exactly two fluffy white long-tailed-tit bird hair ornaments, one perched beside each twin’s head, with tiny black eyes and soft black-and-white feather markings. Surround them with exactly nine visible translucent soap bubbles with rainbow iridescence, distributed across foreground, midground, and sky. The background is a realistic anime resort landscape: a paved garden walkway, vivid green lawns, shrubs, white-barked trees, mountain slopes, blue sky with soft clouds, a chalet-style building and patio umbrellas on the right, exactly two tall greenish condominium towers in the left background, and one dark rectangular high-rise tower in the right background. On the left foreground place a black resort sign reading {argument name="sign text" default="TOMAMU HOKKAIDO 星野リゾート"}. Use soft summer daylight, sparkling highlights, pastel blue-white color grading, delicate linework, dreamy iridescent effects, shallow depth of field, and a polished Japanese AI-art aesthetic. Overall mood: {argument name="mood" default="whimsical, fresh, luxurious resort fantasy"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅明亮且高度精细的动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character description" default="留着淡银白色波波头的双胞胎少女"} 在北海道 Tomamu 阳光明媚的度假村小径上并肩行走。两个角色的脸部均被平滑的浅灰色方块遮挡，没有任何五官。她们穿着相配的轻盈白色叠层连衣裙，配有淡蓝灰色丝带、超大号浅色开衫、精致的珠链、毛球挂饰、小型斜挎包、白色短袜和厚底小白鞋。画面中必须正好有两名女孩：左侧的双胞胎左手向外指，身侧带有羽毛状的鸟翼配饰和毛茸茸的毛球包；右侧的双胞胎一只手靠近衣领，背着一个小巧的虹彩透明单肩包。在每位双胞胎的头部旁各添加一只毛茸茸的白色长尾山雀发饰，拥有细小的黑眼睛和柔软的黑白羽毛纹理。在前景、中景和天空中分布正好九个可见的半透明肥皂泡，呈现出彩虹般的虹彩。背景为写实的动漫度假村景观：铺设好的花园小径、翠绿的草坪、灌木丛、白桦树、山坡、带有柔和云朵的蓝天，右侧有一座小木屋风格的建筑和遮阳伞，左侧背景有两座高大的青绿色公寓塔楼，右侧背景有一座深色长方形高层塔楼。在左侧前景放置一个黑色的度假村指示牌，上面写着 {argument name="sign text" default="TOMAMU HOKKAIDO 星野リゾート"}。使用柔和的夏季日光、闪烁的高光、淡蓝白色的色调分级、细腻的线条、梦幻般的虹彩效果、浅景深以及精致的日本 AI 艺术美学。整体氛围：{argument name="mood" default="异想天开、清新、奢华的度假村幻想"}。

The scene shows one young female angel with {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing golden-blonde hair"}, soft amber eyes, delicate pale skin, and a calm melancholic expression, wearing a translucent layered {argument name="dress style" default="white lace dress with ruffled organza and floral details"}. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细、质感出众的动漫奇幻插画，描绘一位宁静的水下天使少女倚靠在古老弯曲石结构上的场景。画面中有一位年轻女性天使，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长金发"}、柔和的琥珀色双眸、细腻白皙的皮肤，神情平静而忧郁，身着半透明的层叠式 {argument name="dress style" default="带有荷叶边欧根纱和花卉细节的白色蕾丝裙"}。她背后展开着两只巨大的白色羽翼，被来自上方水面的阳光照亮。她的身体从左下向右上斜向漂浮，双腿伸展，一只手臂轻轻环抱着长满苔藓的石拱。背景是明亮的深蓝色水下废墟，水质清澈，伴有气泡、焦散光束、漂浮的织物和小规模海洋生物。画面中包含一个巨大的弯曲古石拱或船形废墟，上面覆盖着深青色苔藓、珊瑚、小白花和华丽的螺旋雕刻。在她周围添加许多大小不一的漂浮白色羽毛，右下角和右边缘附近有三根明显的模糊前景羽毛，翅膀附近则有较小的清晰羽毛。构图应为竖构图，具有电影感和沉浸感，明亮的太阳光束位于顶部中心，上方有波光粼粼的水面，背景为浓郁的绿松石色至钴蓝色，并带有柔和的体积光。采用精细的羽毛渲染、逼真的水下光影、闪烁的高光，细节清晰，无噪点，无墨迹，无文字，无水印，无边框。风格：高级日本动漫主视觉图，空灵奇幻，具有绘画感但线条清晰，面部特征精致，织物透明度高度精炼，充满浪漫与梦幻氛围。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4 竖构图"}。

templates.title: Blue Mary Fighting Game Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Blue Mary 格斗游戏海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic cinematic fighting-game character poster for {argument name="character name" default="Blue Mary"}, inspired by a dark cyberpunk arcade character-select splash screen.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal banner, high-detail semi-realistic anime/game key art, dark navy and black palette with electric blue highlights, gritty particles, glass shards, rain-like specks, and strong rim lighting.

Layout: Split the composition into 3 major visual zones: left seated character pose, center title typography, and right action character pose. Add thin futuristic HUD interface graphics around the edges.

Subject details: Show exactly 2 full/partial depictions of the same athletic blonde female fighter. Depiction 1 on the left: she lounges on a rough wooden bench in a shadowy industrial room beside tall window panes, leaning back casually with one knee raised, wearing a red halter crop top, loose blue pants with a white star-in-circle emblem on the thigh, brown belt, black fingerless gloves, brown boots, and an olive-green jacket slipping off her shoulders. Depiction 2 on the right: she stands in a dynamic forward-punch fighting pose, torso angled toward camera, one gloved fist thrust toward the viewer, wearing the same red halter crop top, loose blue pants, brown belt, and black fingerless gloves, with short blonde bob hair lit by blue rim light. Faces may be covered by soft rectangular blur blocks if a censored/anonymous look is desired.

Central typography: Place a huge distressed title reading {argument name="main title text" default="BLUE MARY"} in the middle, with “BLUE” in bright electric blue above “MARY” in weathered white. Under it, add the quote {argument name="subtitle quote" default="フッ…… Let's fight!"} in white italic serif/script styling with a thin blue underline.

HUD and text elements: Include exactly 6 visible interface text clusters: 1) top-left cluster with “BLUE MARY”, small bars, “CODE: BM-01”, “TARGET: YOU”, “STATUS: LOCKED ON”, “SYSTEM: OVERWRITE”, and “> READY TO FIGHT”; 2) mid-left ID block with boxed “BM” and “BLUE MARY”; 3) bottom-left small “EST. 1994” plus barcode; 4) top-right cluster with “BLUE MARY”, a globe icon, “I WON'T LOSE.” and “NOT TO ANYONE.”; 5) right-edge vertical label “BM-01”; 6) bottom-right cluster with “TARGET: YOU”, “STATUS: LOCKED ON”, plus minimal crosshair/slider marks.

Visual style: High-contrast glossy digital painting, realistic fabric and skin shading, sharp muscular anatomy, dramatic blue explosion and shattered-glass burst behind the right figure, moody warehouse lighting on the left, polished fighting game promotional art, intense cinematic depth and motion.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 character depictions, exactly 6 HUD text clusters, no extra characters, no watermark, keep all typography legible, preserve the dark blue combat-interface atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Blue Mary"} 创建一张极具戏剧性的电影感格斗游戏角色海报，灵感来源于黑暗赛博朋克风格的街机角色选择界面。

画布：16:9 宽屏横幅，高细节半写实动漫/游戏主视觉图，深海军蓝与黑色调，点缀电光蓝高光，带有颗粒感、玻璃碎片、雨滴状斑点以及强烈的轮廓光。

布局：将构图分为 3 个主要视觉区域：左侧坐姿角色、中央标题排版、右侧动作角色。在边缘添加纤细的未来感 HUD 界面图形。

主体细节：准确展示 2 个相同金发女性格斗家的全身/半身形象。左侧形象 1：她慵懒地靠在阴暗工业风房间里的粗糙木凳上，身旁是高大的窗格，单膝抬起，身穿红色挂脖露脐上衣，宽松的蓝色长裤（大腿处有白色圆圈星形徽章），棕色腰带，黑色露指手套，棕色靴子，橄榄绿夹克从肩头滑落。右侧形象 2：她处于动态的前冲格斗姿势，躯干朝向镜头，一只戴手套的拳头向观众挥出，身穿同样的红色挂脖露脐上衣、宽松蓝色长裤、棕色腰带和黑色露指手套，短金发被蓝色轮廓光照亮。若需要模糊/匿名效果，脸部可用柔和的矩形模糊块遮盖。

中央排版：在中间放置一个巨大的做旧标题 {argument name="main title text" default="BLUE MARY"}，“BLUE”为明亮的电光蓝色，位于风化的白色“MARY”上方。在标题下方，添加引语 {argument name="subtitle quote" default="フッ…… Let's fight!"}，采用白色斜体衬线/手写风格，并带有纤细的蓝色下划线。

HUD 与文本元素：包含 6 个可见的界面文本组：1) 左上角组，包含“BLUE MARY”、小条形图、“CODE: BM-01”、“TARGET: YOU”、“STATUS: LOCKED ON”、“SYSTEM: OVERWRITE”以及“> READY TO FIGHT”；2) 左中 ID 块，带有方框“BM”和“BLUE MARY”；3) 左下角小字“EST. 1994”及条形码；4) 右上角组，包含“BLUE MARY”、地球图标、“I WON'T LOSE.”和“NOT TO ANYONE.”；5) 右侧垂直标签“BM-01”；6) 右下角组，包含“TARGET: YOU”、“STATUS: LOCKED ON”以及极简十字准星/滑块标记。

视觉风格：高对比度光泽数字绘画，写实的布料与皮肤阴影，清晰的肌肉解剖结构，右侧人物身后有戏剧性的蓝色爆炸与破碎玻璃效果，左侧为忧郁的仓库灯光，精致的格斗游戏宣传艺术，强烈的电影感深度与动态效果。

约束：使用 2 个角色形象，6 个 HUD 文本组，不添加额外角色，无水印，保持所有排版清晰易读，保留深蓝色战斗界面的氛围。

templates.title: Super Kawaii Three Kittens Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 超可爱三只小猫海报

templates.prompt: Create a square 1:1 high-energy kawaii superhero comic poster with a glittery rose-gold sequin background and a thin pale pink rectangular border. In the center, place a chibi superhero child/mascot body in a shiny blue armored suit with red gloves, one fist raised in a punch pose, dark brown hair in a big swept-up bun, and a plain centered square face placeholder covering the face in medium brown. Surround the hero with exactly three cute fluffy kittens in dynamic flying poses: one large white-and-brown kitten on the lower left with big sparkling eyes and open smiling mouth, one cream ragdoll-style kitten on the upper right leaping forward with fluffy tail, and one small brown tabby-and-white kitten on the lower right smiling near yellow comic exclamation marks. Add comic-book action graphics: a yellow burst on the upper left with the word “KAPOW” in bold pink letters, multiple yellow stars, black speed lines, colorful confetti rectangles, sparkles, and pop-art outlines. At the bottom, add huge bubbly title text reading {argument name="title text" default="Super Kawaii Three Kittens"}, using hot pink fill, dark navy shadow, white outline, and a cyan outer glow, stacked across two lines. Overall style should be glossy Japanese kawaii, chibi superhero, sticker-like thick black outlines, vibrant saturated colors, cute expressive animal faces, celebratory sparkle effects, and crisp digital illustration suitable for a social media announcement graphic. Keep the count to exactly three kittens, exactly one central superhero figure, and one visible “KAPOW” burst; do not add extra characters or text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 方形的高能可爱超级英雄漫画海报，背景为闪亮的玫瑰金亮片，并带有细淡粉色矩形边框。在中心位置，放置一个 Q 版超级英雄儿童/吉祥物形象，身穿闪亮的蓝色盔甲，戴着红色手套，一只拳头举起呈出拳姿势，深棕色头发梳成高耸的大发髻，面部覆盖着一个中等棕色的纯色方形占位符。在英雄周围环绕整整三只毛茸茸的可爱小猫，呈现动态飞翔姿势：左下方是一只大大的白棕色小猫，有着闪闪发光的大眼睛和张开的笑脸；右上方是一只奶油色布偶猫风格的小猫，正向前跃起，尾巴毛茸茸的；右下方是一只棕色虎斑白猫，在黄色漫画感感叹号旁微笑。添加漫画动作图形：左上方有一个黄色爆炸效果，内有粗体粉色字母“KAPOW”，以及多个黄色星星、黑色速度线、彩色矩形纸屑、闪光和波普艺术轮廓。在底部添加巨大的气泡标题文字，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="Super Kawaii Three Kittens"}，使用亮粉色填充、深海军蓝阴影、白色描边和青色外发光，分两行排列。整体风格应为光泽感日系可爱风、Q 版超级英雄、贴纸般的粗黑轮廓、鲜艳饱和的色彩、可爱生动的动物表情、庆祝般的闪光效果，以及适合社交媒体公告图的清晰数字插画。请确保小猫数量正好为三只，中心超级英雄形象为一个，且仅有一个可见的“KAPOW”爆炸效果；请勿添加额外的角色或文字。

templates.title: Kawaii Wolf Donut Diagnosis Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱风狼系甜甜圈性格诊断海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cute Japanese “animal character donut diagnosis” infographic poster for {argument name="diagnosis animal" default="wolf"}, in a pastel kawaii dessert style, as if generated from text only.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, soft pink bakery/café background with pearls, lace, sparkles, tiny hearts, stars, flowers, ribbons, and glossy confectionery decorations. Use a warm cream-and-pink palette with lavender, sky blue, mint, and gold accents. Everything should feel magical, sweet, and highly decorative.

Main headline area: At the top, large rounded bubble-letter Japanese title text reading 「どうぶつキャラドーナツ診断」 in pink with white outline and drop shadow. Under it, smaller text 「あなたには」, then very large golden-orange outlined text 「オオカミ」, followed by 「の気配が漂っています」. Add tiny paw prints, stars, flower stickers, and pastel ribbon ornaments around the title.

Right-side main visual: Place a circular ornate gold-framed portrait on the upper right, decorated with small cream flowers and pink ribbons. Inside the frame is a stylish handsome anime man, shown from chest up, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and tie, with dramatic wavy black hair illuminated by neon magenta and electric blue highlights against a dark starry background. Cover the center of his face with a vertical soft-edged rectangular blur block in muted mauve, as if anonymized.

Bottom-right dessert subject: In front of the portrait, place one large realistic-cute animal donut on a decorative plate. The donut is shaped like a gray wolf/cat face: round purple-gray icing, two pointed ears, glossy black eyes, small pink cheeks, white muzzle, tiny black nose and smiling mouth, white icing whisker lines, and a fluffy tail-like crescent piece on the lower right. Decorate the donut with exactly 3 clusters of blueberry-like dark blue berries and tiny purple sugar flowers, plus pearl sprinkles and white icing drizzles. Add a small round cookie tag on the plate reading “You are Special.”

Left column: Create exactly 5 stacked rounded information cards, each with a translucent glossy border, pastel gradient fill, small icon, and Japanese text. The five cards are:
1. Pink card with donut icon, heading 「理由は」, body text 「鋭さとやさしさが同居する雰囲気、静かだけど芯が強くて少し近寄りがたい存在感が強いからです(｡•ᴗ•｡)」.
2. Purple card with crescent moon icon, heading 「オオカミの特徴」, exactly 4 bullet points: 「判断が早い」, 「仲間思い」, 「ミステリアス」, 「一度決めたらぶれにくい」.
3. Light blue card with sun icon, heading 「相性が良い動物」, exactly 2 illustrated animal icons and 2 bullet items: fox icon with 「キツネ：機転がきいて会話のテンポが合う」, cat icon with 「ネコ：距離感が心地よく、自然体でいられる」.
4. Mint green card with clover icon, heading 「運勢」, body text 「今は魅力が静かに伝わる好調期。信頼が積み上がり、じわじわ注目が集まります(≧▽≦)」.
5. Pink card with donut icon and blueberry icon, heading 「オオカミドーナツについて」, body text 「ビターなコーティングにホワイトチョコのライン、ブルーベリーのきらめきで凛とした甘さを表現。香ばしい生地と上品な仕上げで食べやすく、特別感のある一品です(๑•᎑•๑)」.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed kawaii Japanese social-media diagnostic card, glossy stickers, soft glow, pastel gradients, rounded typography, edible 3D donut realism mixed with anime illustration. Keep the composition dense but readable, with the left cards aligned neatly and the portrait/donut dominating the right side.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 information cards, exactly 4 bullets in the traits card, exactly 2 animals in the compatibility card, and one main animal donut. Preserve the Japanese text exactly as written. No extra logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张可爱的日系“动物角色甜甜圈诊断”信息图海报，主题为 {argument name="diagnosis animal" default="狼"}，采用柔和的可爱甜点风格，呈现出如同纯文本生成的效果。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，背景为柔粉色烘焙店/咖啡馆，点缀珍珠、蕾丝、闪光、爱心、星星、花朵、丝带及光泽感糖果装饰。使用暖奶油色与粉色调，辅以薰衣草紫、天蓝、薄荷绿和金色点缀。整体氛围应充满魔法感、甜美且极具装饰性。

主标题区域：顶部使用大型圆润气泡字体，书写日文标题「どうぶつキャラドーナツ診断」，粉色填充，白色描边并带有投影。下方为较小的文字「あなたには」，接着是极大的金橙色描边文字「オオカミ」，随后是「の気配が漂っています」。在标题周围添加微小的爪印、星星、花朵贴纸和柔和的丝带装饰。

右侧主视觉：右上角放置一个圆形华丽金框肖像，装饰有奶油小花和粉色丝带。框内是一位帅气的动漫男性，半身像，身穿深色西装、白衬衫并系领带，深色波浪卷发在暗色星空背景下被霓虹洋红色和电蓝色高光照亮。用一个柔和边缘的淡紫色长方形模糊块遮住他脸部中心，营造匿名感。

右下角甜点主体：在肖像前方，放置一个装饰盘，上面有一个写实且可爱的动物甜甜圈。甜甜圈造型为灰狼/猫脸：圆形的紫灰色糖霜，两只尖耳朵，亮黑色眼睛，粉色小脸颊，白色口鼻部，黑色小鼻子和微笑嘴，白色糖霜胡须线条，右下角有一个蓬松的尾巴状月牙块。用 3 簇蓝莓般的深蓝色浆果和紫色小糖花装饰甜甜圈，并撒上珍珠糖粒和白色糖霜淋酱。盘子上放一个小圆饼干标签，写着“You are Special.”。

左侧栏：创建 5 张堆叠的圆角信息卡片，每张卡片带有半透明光泽边框、柔和渐变填充、小图标和日文文本。五张卡片内容如下：
1. 粉色卡片，配甜甜圈图标，标题「理由は」，正文「鋭さとやさしさが同居する雰囲気、静かだけど芯が強くて少し近寄りがたい存在感が強いからです(｡•ᴗ•｡)」。
2. 紫色卡片，配新月图标，标题「オオカミの特徴」，包含 4 个要点：「判断が早い」、「仲間思い」、「ミステリアス」、「一度決めたらぶれにくい」。
3. 浅蓝色卡片，配太阳图标，标题「相性が良い動物」，包含 2 个动物图标和 2 个要点：狐狸图标配「キツネ：機転がきいて会話のテンポが合う」，猫图标配「ネコ：距離感が心地よく、自然体でいられる」。
4. 薄荷绿卡片，配三叶草图标，标题「運勢」，正文「今は魅力が静かに伝わる好調期。信頼が積み上がり、じわじわ注目が集まります(≧▽≦)」。
5. 粉色卡片，配甜甜圈和蓝莓图标，标题「オオカミドーナツについて」，正文「ビターなコーティングにホワイトチョコのライン、ブルーベリーのきらめきで凛とした甘さを表現。香ばしい生地と上品な仕上げで食べやすく、特別感のある一品です(๑•᎑•๑)」。

视觉风格：超精细的日系可爱社交媒体诊断卡，光泽贴纸，柔光效果，柔和渐变，圆润字体，逼真的 3D 甜甜圈质感与动漫插画结合。构图保持紧凑但易读，左侧卡片整齐排列，右侧以肖像和甜甜圈为视觉中心。

约束条件：必须使用 5 张信息卡片，特征卡片必须包含 4 个要点，相性卡片必须包含 2 种动物，且仅限一个主动物甜甜圈。请完整保留日文文本。不得添加额外的标志或水印。

templates.title: Seamless Watercolor Stone Path Tile

titleLocalized.zh: 无缝水彩石径瓷砖纹理

templates.prompt: Create a seamless repeating tile pattern of an old stone garden path seen from directly above. The composition is filled edge to edge with irregular polygonal paving stones separated by dark soil-filled cracks, designed so all edges match perfectly for tiling. Use a delicate watercolor and ink illustration style on warm off-white paper: soft translucent washes, hand-drawn graphite/sepia outlines, subtle granulation, uneven pigment blooms, and natural texture. The stones are pale cream, light gray, beige, and muted blush with mossy green stains and lichen patches; the cracks contain rich brown earth with tiny tufts of grass, small weeds, and miniature leafy sprouts. Keep the pattern moderately dense with varied stone sizes and orientations, organic randomness, no obvious central focal point, no shadows from objects, no text, no border, no watermark. Color palette: sage green moss, olive lichen, warm ivory stone, dusty beige, muted gray, earthy brown.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个从正上方俯视的古老花园石径无缝重复平铺图案。构图边缘到边缘均填满不规则的多边形铺路石，石块间由充满泥土的深色裂缝隔开，设计确保所有边缘完美衔接以实现平铺。采用温暖的米白色纸张上的精致水彩和墨水插画风格：柔和的半透明渲染、手绘石墨/棕褐色轮廓、细腻的颗粒感、不均匀的颜料晕染以及自然纹理。石块呈浅奶油色、浅灰色、米色和柔和的淡粉色，带有苔藓绿色的污渍和地衣斑块；裂缝中包含深棕色的泥土，点缀着细小的草丛、杂草和微小的叶芽。保持图案密度适中，石块大小和方向各异，呈现有机随机感，没有明显的中心焦点，无物体阴影，无文字，无边框，无水印。配色方案：鼠尾草绿苔藓、橄榄色地衣、暖象牙色石块、灰米色、柔和灰、大地棕。

templates.title: Fisheye Anime Schoolgirl Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 鱼眼镜头动漫女学生自拍

templates.prompt: Create a fisheye-lens close-up selfie of a cute anime schoolgirl sitting at a classroom desk, reaching one arm toward the camera as if taking the photo herself. The character has an oversized 3D anime doll-like head with glossy skin, a tiny open mouth, one eye winking and the other eye wide open with a vivid purple-blue starry iris and bright catchlights. She has {argument name="hair color" default="bubblegum pink hair with thin pastel blue streaks"}, styled as a short wavy bob with long bangs covering part of one eye, a small side braid across the top, and shiny black star-shaped hair clips. Add black star earrings on the visible ear. She wears {argument name="school uniform" default="a white short-sleeve shirt, beige-and-black plaid vest, and dark red ribbon tie"}. Her left hand writes with a black pen in an open lined notebook on the desk, while a black textbook labeled {argument name="textbook title" default="BIOCHEMISTRY"} with a colorful periodic-table graphic sits beside it. The background is a realistic Japanese classroom with desks, papers, window blinds, fluorescent ceiling lights, warm indoor lighting, and a few blurred students in the distance; one background face is intentionally obscured. Use extreme wide-angle fisheye distortion with a dark circular vignette at the edges, strong foreground arm foreshortening, shallow depth of field, glossy high-detail anime rendering blended with realistic classroom photography, vibrant colors, soft blush, and cinematic highlights. Keep the composition vertical, intimate, playful, and slightly surreal; no extra text except the textbook cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张鱼眼镜头特写自拍，画面中一位可爱的动漫女学生坐在教室课桌前，一只手臂伸向镜头，仿佛正在自拍。角色拥有超大的 3D 动漫玩偶式头部，皮肤具有光泽感，小嘴微张，一只眼睛眨眼，另一只眼睛睁大，呈现出鲜艳的紫蓝色星空虹膜和明亮的眼神光。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="泡泡糖粉色头发，带有细微的浅蓝色挑染"}，发型为短波浪波波头，长刘海遮住部分眼睛，头顶有一条小侧辫，并佩戴闪亮的黑色星形发夹。在可见的耳朵上添加黑色星形耳环。她穿着 {argument name="school uniform" default="白色短袖衬衫、米色与黑色格纹背心，以及深红色丝带领结"}。她的左手正拿着一支黑色钢笔在桌上打开的横线笔记本上书写，旁边放着一本标有 {argument name="textbook title" default="BIOCHEMISTRY"} 的黑色教科书，封面上印有色彩鲜艳的元素周期表图形。背景是逼真的日本教室，有课桌、纸张、百叶窗、天花板荧光灯、温暖的室内光线，远处有几个模糊的学生；其中一个背景人物面部被刻意遮挡。使用极端的广角鱼眼畸变效果，边缘带有深色圆形暗角，强调前景手臂的透视缩短效果，采用浅景深，将光泽感高细节动漫渲染与逼真的教室摄影相结合，色彩鲜艳，带有柔和的腮红和电影级高光。保持构图为竖屏，亲密、俏皮且略带超现实感；除教科书封面外，画面中不包含任何额外文字。

templates.title: HER19845 Streetwear Drop Poster

titleLocalized.zh: HER19845 街头服饰系列发布海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-fashion streetwear campaign poster for a limited-edition drop, centered on a full-body model wearing an oversized black graphic hoodie and black sweatpants with hot-pink graffiti branding.

Canvas: Vertical portrait poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, off-white studio background with subtle paper grain, slight shadows on the floor and wall, editorial fashion lighting.

Layout: Huge condensed hot-pink headline text fills the entire top background, reading {argument name="main headline" default="HER19845"}. Place the model in the center foreground, overlapping the headline so the letters appear behind the head and torso. Keep the composition bold, poster-like, and slightly grungy.

Subject details: A young adult streetwear model stands relaxed with legs apart and hands in pockets, long brown hair falling over the shoulders, face softly obscured or blurred, wearing layered silver necklaces, a white graphic T-shirt, an oversized black zip hoodie with white and hot-pink punk graphics, loose black sweatpants with large pink and white graffiti text, and pink-and-white sneakers. The visible outfit has exactly 6 major pieces: black hoodie, white graphic T-shirt, black sweatpants, pink-and-white sneakers, silver necklace stack, and long loose hair.

Text and graphics: Include exactly 7 secondary text/graphic clusters around the model: 1) left mid block reading “LIMITED EDITION / WORLDWIDE DROP” with three small stars and the slogan “SHE’S NOT HERE / TO FIT IN / SHE’S HERE / TO TAKE OVER.” in pink; 2) left vertical icon stack with a globe icon, circled H icon, outlined star icon, tiny abstract symbols, barcode, and small text “HER19845™”; 3) lower-left circular hot-pink globe stamp with surrounding microtext about global drop and rebel/hacker energy; 4) large black handwritten signature across the right side reading {argument name="signature text" default="Her 19845"}, underlined with expressive marker strokes; 5) right mid small outlined pink label box containing a globe icon and “19845”; 6) right lower manifesto block reading “BUILT DIFFERENT. / BREAKS RULES. / MAKES HISTORY.” with three stars, then “REBEL. RARE. REAL.” in pink and “THIS ISN’T FASHION. / THIS IS FREEDOM.” beneath it plus a small signature line; 7) bottom-right row of four small symbols: black sparkle star, black globe, black vertical bars, and a pink star inside a black square.

Visual style: Magazine cover meets underground streetwear lookbook, clean studio photography mixed with distressed punk typography, hot pink and black on off-white, sharp high-resolution product detail, slightly worn ink texture on the giant headline, graffiti marks on clothing, premium editorial realism.

Constraints: Use exactly the text clusters and symbols listed, avoid adding extra logos or watermarks, keep the face intentionally non-identifiable, make the poster feel like a collectible fashion drop announcement for {argument name="brand name" default="HER19845"}.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为限量版发售创作一张高级街头服饰宣传海报，以一名身穿超大号黑色印花连帽衫和黑色运动裤、带有亮粉色涂鸦品牌标识的全身模特为核心。

画布：竖向肖像海报，比例约为 2:3，米白色摄影棚背景，带有细微的纸张纹理，地面和墙面有轻微阴影，呈现编辑级时尚灯光效果。

布局：巨大的压缩感亮粉色标题文字填满整个顶部背景，内容为 {argument name="main headline" default="HER19845"}。将模特置于前景中心，与标题重叠，使文字出现在头部和躯干后方。保持构图大胆、具有海报感，并带有轻微的颓废风格。

主体细节：一位年轻的街头服饰模特双腿分开、双手插兜，姿态放松，棕色长发垂在肩上，面部被柔和地遮挡或模糊处理，佩戴叠戴银色项链，身穿白色印花 T 恤、超大号黑色拉链连帽衫（带有白色和亮粉色朋克图案）、宽松黑色运动裤（带有大型粉白色涂鸦文字）以及粉白色运动鞋。可见的服装共有 6 个主要部分：黑色连帽衫、白色印花 T 恤、黑色运动裤、粉白色运动鞋、银色项链叠戴以及长发。

文字与图形：在模特周围包含 7 组辅助文字/图形：1) 左侧中部区域，文字为“LIMITED EDITION / WORLDWIDE DROP”，配有三颗小星星和标语“SHE’S NOT HERE / TO FIT IN / SHE’S HERE / TO TAKE OVER.”（粉色）；2) 左侧垂直图标堆叠，包含地球图标、带圆圈的 H 图标、轮廓星形图标、微小抽象符号、条形码以及小字“HER19845™”；3) 左下角圆形亮粉色地球印章，周围环绕关于全球发售和叛逆/黑客能量的微型文字；4) 右侧横跨的大号黑色手写签名，内容为 {argument name="signature text" default="Her 19845"}，下方有表现力十足的记号笔划线；5) 右侧中部小型粉色轮廓标签框，包含地球图标和“19845”；6) 右下角宣言块，内容为“BUILT DIFFERENT. / BREAKS RULES. / MAKES HISTORY.”，配有三颗星星，下方为粉色的“REBEL. RARE. REAL.”以及“THIS ISN’T FASHION. / THIS IS FREEDOM.”，并附带一条小签名线；7) 右下角一行四个小符号：黑色闪烁星星、黑色地球、黑色垂直条纹以及黑色方块内的粉色星星。

约束条件：使用列出的 7 组文字和符号，避免添加额外的标志或水印，刻意保持面部不可辨认，使海报呈现出 {argument name="brand name" default="HER19845"} 收藏级时尚发布公告的质感。

templates.title: Urban Viking Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Urban Viking 杂志封面

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a gritty editorial magazine-cover collage titled {argument name="magazine title" default="URBAN VIKING"}, mixing Scandinavian runic heritage, street culture, and winter travel photography.

Canvas: Vertical poster cover, 2:3 aspect ratio, aged sepia and black palette, distressed paper texture, scratched ink, worn edges, vintage zine layout. Use a dark brown/black grunge background with warm tan typography and torn-paper photo borders.

Main image: A full-body street-fashion portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a blonde woman in a black knit beanie, black ribbed turtleneck sweater, and light beige high-waisted jeans"} standing slightly right of center on an old European cobblestone street beside tall Gothic stone buildings. Her pose is relaxed, one arm across the body, long blonde hair visible under the beanie, urban winter mood. Background pedestrians are small and slightly blurred. Keep the face intentionally obscured by a simple square censor block, matching the generated editorial anonymized look.

Layout: Place the huge vertical title “URBAN VIKING” along the entire left edge in distressed Gothic/blackletter capitals, cream ink on dark background. Add small technical annotation graphics, thin lines, crosshair marks, and archival print artifacts around the portrait.

Visible text blocks and labels: At upper left, include a compact data block reading: “NORDIC: 55.6761° N, 12.5683° E / FOUNDATION: STRENGTH / ELEMENT: EARTH / SYMBOL: ᚷ (ALGIZ) / MEANING: PROTECTION, CONNECTION, INSTINCT”. At upper right, add a barcode labeled “URBAN VIKING MAGAZINE” with numbers “5 012345 678900 07”. At lower left, add a small globe icon above text reading “STREET CULTURE / NORDIC SOUL / VIKING SPIRIT / ISSUE NO. 07 / WINTER SEASON”, plus a small boxed label “N°07” and vertical date text “MMXXV / 2025”. At bottom center, add typewriter-style text: “MADE BY THE STREETS / WORN BY THE FEW” and “BUILT ON INSTINCT / DRIVEN BY PURPOSE”. At bottom right, add handwritten text on torn brown paper: “keep your roots strong and your spirit wild x”.

Counted graphic elements: Include exactly 2 torn-edge inset photographs overlapping the lower third. Inset photo 1 is near the bottom center-left, tilted slightly counterclockwise, showing the same subject walking on a cobblestone street with colorful shopfronts behind her, wearing the same black top and beige pants plus a tan scarf; obscure the face with a small square censor block. Inset photo 2 is near the bottom right, tilted slightly clockwise, showing the same subject near a river or canal with old stone buildings and grass, wearing the black beanie and black top; obscure the face with a small square censor block. Include exactly 2 circular Nordic rune seal graphics: one mid-right beside the main subject and one lower-left/bottom-center labeled “VIKING HERITAGE / SCANDINAVIAN ROOTS”. Include exactly 1 barcode, exactly 1 globe icon, exactly 1 boxed issue number, and exactly 1 small triangular rune-like emblem near the bottom center.

Visual style: High-contrast urban documentary photography blended with printed magazine ephemera, muted amber highlights, deep blacks, beige paper whites, rough halftone grain, dust, scratches, torn tape edges, medieval typography, rune symbols, and a moody Scandinavian streetwear aesthetic.

Constraints: Preserve the exact count of 1 main portrait, 2 inset photos, 2 circular rune seals, 1 barcode, 1 globe icon, 1 boxed issue number, and 1 triangular emblem. Avoid clean modern minimalism; make it look weathered, layered, tactile, and collectible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张粗犷的编辑风格杂志封面拼贴画，标题为 {argument name="magazine title" default="URBAN VIKING"}，融合斯堪的纳维亚符文传承、街头文化和冬季旅行摄影。

画布：竖版海报封面，2:3 长宽比，做旧棕褐色与黑色调，陈旧纸张纹理，划痕墨迹，磨损边缘，复古杂志排版。使用深棕色/黑色颓废风背景，搭配暖棕褐色字体和撕纸效果的照片边框。

主体图像：一张全身街头时尚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位戴着黑色针织冷帽、身穿黑色罗纹高领毛衣和浅米色高腰牛仔裤的金发女性"}，站在欧洲古老鹅卵石街道上，位置略偏右，背景是高大的哥特式石建筑。她的姿势放松，一只手臂横在身前，冷帽下露出长长的金发，呈现出都市冬季氛围。背景中的行人较小且略显模糊。面部刻意用简单的方形马赛克遮挡，以符合生成的编辑匿名化外观。

排版：将巨大的竖排标题“URBAN VIKING”沿整个左边缘放置，采用做旧的哥特式/黑体大写字母，深色背景上的奶油色墨迹。在肖像周围添加小型技术注释图形、细线、十字准星标记和档案印刷痕迹。

可见文本块和标签：在左上角，包含一个紧凑的数据块，内容为：“NORDIC: 55.6761° N, 12.5683° E / FOUNDATION: STRENGTH / ELEMENT: EARTH / SYMBOL: ᚷ (ALGIZ) / MEANING: PROTECTION, CONNECTION, INSTINCT”。在右上角，添加一个标注为“URBAN VIKING MAGAZINE”的条形码，数字为“5 012345 678900 07”。在左下角，添加一个小地球仪图标，上方文字为“STREET CULTURE / NORDIC SOUL / VIKING SPIRIT / ISSUE NO. 07 / WINTER SEASON”，外加一个小的盒装标签“N°07”和竖排日期文字“MMXXV / 2025”。在底部中心，添加打字机风格文字：“MADE BY THE STREETS / WORN BY THE FEW”以及“BUILT ON INSTINCT / DRIVEN BY PURPOSE”。在右下角，添加写在撕裂棕色纸张上的手写文字：“keep your roots strong and your spirit wild x”。

图形元素计数：包含正好 2 张重叠在下三分之一处的撕边插图照片。插图照片 1 位于底部中左侧附近，略微逆时针倾斜，显示同一主体走在鹅卵石街道上，身后是色彩鲜艳的店面，穿着同样的黑色上衣和米色裤子，外加一条棕褐色围巾；用小方形马赛克遮住面部。插图照片 2 位于底部右侧附近，略微顺时针倾斜，显示同一主体在河流或运河边，背景是古老的石建筑和草地，戴着黑色冷帽，穿着黑色上衣；用小方形马赛克遮住面部。包含正好 2 个圆形北欧符文印章图形：一个在主体右侧中部，另一个在左下/底部中心，标注为“VIKING HERITAGE / SCANDINAVIAN ROOTS”。包含正好 1 个条形码、1 个地球仪图标、1 个盒装期号和 1 个位于底部中心附近的小型三角形符文徽章。

视觉风格：高对比度都市纪实摄影与印刷杂志纸媒的融合，柔和的琥珀色高光、深黑色、米色纸张白、粗糙的半色调颗粒、灰尘、划痕、撕裂的胶带边缘、中世纪排版、符文符号以及忧郁的斯堪的纳维亚街头服饰美学。

限制：保留 1 张主体肖像、2 张插图照片、2 个圆形符文印章、1 个条形码、1 个地球仪图标、1 个盒装期号和 1 个三角形徽章的精确数量。避免简洁的现代极简主义；使其看起来饱经风霜、层次丰富、具有质感且值得收藏。
