templates.title: Vintage Goa Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古果阿旅行海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vintage travel poster for {argument name="destination" default="GOA"}, {argument name="country" default="INDIA"}, with a warm colonial coastal atmosphere and dramatic typography.

Canvas: Vertical poster format, roughly 2:3 aspect ratio, aged tan parchment background with subtle paper grain, sepia-gold sunset color grading, and a thin double-line dark brown border inset from the edge.

Layout: The top half is dominated by huge serif headline text reading “GOA” in dark teal, spanning nearly the full width. Directly beneath it on the left is spaced uppercase text reading “INDIA” in muted brick red. Below that, place a small illustrated palm frond, then an italic script tagline reading “{argument name="tagline" default="Sun, Sand & Susegad."}”, a small ornamental divider made of a short line, dot, and short line, and a coordinate line reading “{argument name="coordinates" default="15.2993° N, 74.1240° E"}”.

Main scene: On the right side and lower half, show a highly detailed baroque Portuguese-style Goan church facade, golden-brown stone, ornate columns, arched doorway, circular windows, statues, finials, and a small cross at the top. The church occupies the right two-thirds of the poster and rises into the middle, partly under the headline. A partial adjacent old building appears along the far right edge.

Foreground and background: In the lower left foreground, place exactly 1 classic motorcycle, {argument name="vehicle" default="a vintage Royal Enfield-style motorcycle"}, parked on a cobblestone plaza, angled slightly to the right, with chrome details, black tires, brown leather seat, and warm reflections. Behind it, show a tropical coastline at sunset with the sun low near the horizon, ocean waves, rocks, and exactly 5 visible palm trees: 2 tall prominent palms on the left, 1 medium palm behind them, and 2 smaller palms farther back near the shoreline.

Visual style: Retro lithographic travel advertising, painterly realism mixed with engraved detail, warm amber and burnt orange lighting, deep shadows, nostalgic Indian coastal tourism aesthetic, crisp readable typography, slightly weathered ink texture, no modern logos, no people, no extra text beyond the specified poster lettering.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="destination" default="GOA"}，{argument name="country" default="INDIA"} 创作一张复古旅行海报，营造温暖的殖民地沿海氛围和极具张力的排版。

画布：竖版海报格式，比例约为 2:3，背景为带有细腻纸张纹理的陈旧棕褐色羊皮纸，采用深褐色与金色的日落色调，边缘内侧配有细双线深棕色边框。

布局：上半部分由巨大的深青色衬线标题文字“GOA”占据，几乎横跨整个宽度。其正下方左侧是间距适中的大写文字“INDIA”，颜色为柔和的砖红色。下方放置一片小型棕榈叶插画，接着是一行斜体脚本标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Sun, Sand & Susegad."}”，以及一个由短线、圆点和短线组成的装饰性分隔符，最后是一行坐标文字“{argument name="coordinates" default="15.2993° N, 74.1240° E"}”。

主体场景：在右侧和下半部分，展示一座细节丰富的巴洛克式葡萄牙风格果阿教堂立面，采用金棕色石材，配有华丽的圆柱、拱形门廊、圆形窗户、雕像、尖顶饰以及顶部的十字架。教堂占据海报右侧三分之二的区域，向上延伸至中部，部分位于标题下方。远右侧边缘可见部分相邻的古老建筑。

前景与背景：在左下角前景处，放置 1 辆经典摩托车，即 {argument name="vehicle" default="一辆复古皇家恩菲尔德风格摩托车"}，停在鹅卵石广场上，略微向右倾斜，带有镀铬细节、黑色轮胎、棕色皮革座椅和温暖的反光。其后方展示热带海岸的日落景象，太阳低垂在地平线附近，伴有海浪、岩石和 5 棵清晰可见的棕榈树：左侧有 2 棵高大显眼的棕榈树，后方有 1 棵中等高度的棕榈树，更远处的海岸线附近还有 2 棵较小的棕榈树。

视觉风格：复古石版画旅行广告风格，绘画写实主义与雕刻细节相结合，温暖的琥珀色和焦橙色光影，深邃的阴影，怀旧的印度沿海旅游美学，清晰易读的排版，略带风化的油墨质感，无现代标志，无人物，除指定的文字外无额外文字。

templates.title: Rebellious Streetwear Magazine Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 叛逆街头风尚杂志海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a bold vertical streetwear magazine-cover poster for {argument name="character name" default="HER19845"}, with a rebellious 1980s/1990s hip-hop fashion attitude.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, off-white paper background with subtle grain, scratches, dust speckles, worn print texture, and slight vintage magazine distressing.

Main subject: One full-body young woman centered in front of oversized typography, standing confidently with legs apart and both hands in her pants pockets. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain square blur/censor block. She has long wavy blonde-brown hair visible around the blur. Outfit count: 5 visible main clothing pieces/accessories — 1 oversized white graphic T-shirt with pink graffiti-style artwork and “19845” on the chest, 1 loose purple windbreaker jacket with teal and hot-pink accents, 1 pair of baggy black cargo/parachute pants, 1 pair of chunky white sneakers with pink and teal details, and 1 black heart pendant necklace. The pose should feel casual, defiant, and fashion-editorial.

Layout: Place giant condensed uppercase background text reading {argument name="large background text" default="HER19845"} across almost the full height of the poster, behind the model. The letters should be extremely tall, bold, and partially hidden by the figure. Use a left-to-right hot-pink to purple gradient, with distressed scuffs and print wear inside the letters. Keep the subject layered in front of the typography.

Visible text elements: Include exactly 9 separate text elements on the poster: 1) top-left small bracket label “[HER19845]”; 2) top-center tiny uppercase slogan “BUILT DIFFERENT. MADE TO BREAK RULES.”; 3) giant background word “HER19845”; 4) left handwritten black phrase “Not your average.” with a pink underline stroke; 5) lower-left stacked uppercase text “CONFIDENCE IS MY FAVORITE OUTFIT.”; 6) lower-left purple bracketed stacked text “[REBELLION LOOKS GOOD ON ME]”; 7) lower-left stacked uppercase text “NO APOLOGIES. JUST ENERGY. ALL DAY.”; 8) right-side red-orange handwritten signature text {argument name="signature text" default="Her 19845"} with an underline flourish; 9) bottom-center hot-pink bracket label “[HER19845]”. Also add two decorative print marks: a small barcode at bottom left and a black-and-white “PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT” label at bottom right.

Typography and style: Combine massive condensed sans-serif type, small utilitarian editorial captions, handwritten brush-script annotations, and punk zine details. Color palette: off-white paper, hot pink, violet purple, teal accents, black ink, and red-orange marker. Use high contrast, fashion poster lighting, crisp cutout subject, subtle floor shadow, and gritty editorial print texture.

Constraints: No extra characters, no extra text beyond the specified 9 text elements and the two decorative labels, keep the model full-body and centered, maintain the square face-obscuring blur, and make the final image look like a polished rebellious streetwear cover.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="HER19845"} 创建一张大胆的竖版街头风尚杂志封面海报，展现 20 世纪 80 年代/90 年代嘻哈时尚的叛逆态度。

画布：人像海报，2:3 比例，米白色纸张背景，带有细微的颗粒感、划痕、灰尘斑点、磨损的印刷纹理以及轻微的复古杂志做旧效果。

主体：一位全身年轻女性居中站立在超大字体前，姿态自信，双腿分开，双手插在裤兜里。她的脸部被一个简单的方形模糊/遮挡块刻意遮盖。模糊区域周围可见她长长的波浪形棕金色头发。服装清单：5 件可见的主要服饰/配饰 — 1 件胸前印有粉色涂鸦风格艺术图案及“19845”字样的超大白色印花 T 恤，1 件带有青色和亮粉色装饰的宽松紫色防风外套，1 条宽松的黑色工装/降落伞裤，1 双带有粉色和青色细节的厚底白色运动鞋，以及 1 条黑色心形吊坠项链。姿势应显得随意、挑衅且具有时尚编辑感。

布局：在模特身后放置巨大的压缩大写背景文字 {argument name="large background text" default="HER19845"}，几乎覆盖海报的整个高度。字母应极其高大、醒目，并被人物部分遮挡。使用从左到右的亮粉色到紫色的渐变，字母内部带有磨损的擦痕和印刷损耗。保持主体位于排版的前层。

可见文字元素：海报上需包含 9 个独立的文字元素：1) 左上角的小括号标签“[HER19845]”；2) 顶部中央极小的全大写标语“BUILT DIFFERENT. MADE TO BREAK RULES.”；3) 巨大的背景单词“HER19845”；4) 左侧手写黑色短语“Not your average.”并带有粉色下划线；5) 左下角堆叠的全大写文字“CONFIDENCE IS MY FAVORITE OUTFIT.”；6) 左下角紫色括号堆叠文字“[REBELLION LOOKS GOOD ON ME]”；7) 左下角堆叠的全大写文字“NO APOLOGIES. JUST ENERGY. ALL DAY.”；8) 右侧红橙色手写签名文字 {argument name="signature text" default="Her 19845"} 并带有下划线装饰；9) 底部中央的亮粉色括号标签“[HER19845]”。此外，添加两个装饰性印刷标记：左下角的一个小条形码和右下角的一个黑白“PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT”标签。

排版与风格：结合巨大的压缩无衬线字体、小型实用编辑说明文字、手写笔刷体注释以及朋克杂志细节。配色方案：米白色纸张、亮粉色、紫罗兰色、青色点缀、黑色墨水和红橙色记号笔。使用高对比度、时尚海报灯光、清晰的抠图主体、细微的地面阴影以及粗糙的编辑印刷纹理。

约束：除指定的 9 个文字元素和两个装饰标签外，不得添加额外字符或文字；保持模特全身且居中；保留方形遮脸模糊效果；确保最终图像呈现出精致的叛逆街头风尚封面效果。

templates.title: Vintage Delhi Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古德里旅游海报

templates.prompt: Create a vintage Art Deco travel poster for {argument name="destination" default="Delhi"}, India, in a vertical 2:3 format. Use a warm aged-paper palette of saffron, ochre, sepia, burnt orange, and deep teal, with subtle film grain, distressed print texture, and a thin double-line border around the edges. The composition should have a huge bold serif headline at the top reading “{argument name="headline text" default="DELHI"}” in dark teal, with widely spaced red-orange text beneath reading “INDIA”. Below the title on the left, place a simple lotus icon inside an arched outline, then the italic tagline “{argument name="tagline" default="Where Empires Meet."}”, a small decorative divider with a centered dot, and the coordinates “{argument name="coordinates" default="28.6139° N, 77.2090° E"}”. The right half and lower center should feature a monumental, photorealistic but posterized India Gate at golden hour, towering in perspective with detailed stone blocks, arch shadows, and an “INDIA” inscription near the top. In the hazy left background, show Humayun’s Tomb or a Mughal-style domed monument among trees, softened by sunset atmosphere. In the foreground, include exactly one cycle rickshaw with exactly two visible people: one cyclist pedaling and one seated passenger, rendered as dark silhouettes on a glowing road. Add small birds in the sky, long warm shadows, and sunlit haze behind the arch. Keep the design elegant, nostalgic, and tourism-focused, with no modern cars, no extra landmarks, and no additional text beyond the specified poster lettering.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 {argument name="destination" default="德里"}（印度）的复古装饰艺术风格旅游海报，采用 2:3 竖版比例。使用藏红花色、赭石色、深褐色、焦橙色和深青色的温暖旧纸色调，并添加细微的胶片颗粒感、做旧印刷纹理以及边缘的双细线边框。构图顶部需有一行巨大的粗体衬线标题，文字为“{argument name="headline text" default="DELHI"}”（深青色），下方是间距宽阔的红橙色文字“INDIA”。在标题左下方，放置一个拱形轮廓内的简单莲花图标，随后是斜体标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Where Empires Meet."}”、一个带有中心点的装饰性分隔符，以及坐标“{argument name="coordinates" default="28.6139° N, 77.2090° E"}”。右半部分及下方中心应展示黄金时刻的印度门（India Gate），采用写实但海报化的处理方式，以透视感呈现其宏伟气势，包含细致的石块纹理、拱门阴影，并在顶部附近刻有“INDIA”字样。在朦胧的左侧背景中，展示胡马雍陵或树丛中莫卧儿风格的圆顶纪念碑，并由日落氛围进行柔化处理。前景中需包含一辆人力三轮车，车上正好有两人：一名骑行者和一名乘客，以发光道路上的深色剪影呈现。天空中加入几只小鸟，并表现出长长的暖色阴影以及拱门后方的阳光薄雾。保持设计优雅、怀旧且聚焦于旅游主题，画面中不得出现现代汽车、额外的地标建筑，也不得包含除指定海报文字之外的任何其他文字。

templates.title: Vintage Mumbai Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 孟买复古旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a vintage Art Deco travel poster for {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"}, {argument name="country name" default="India"}. Use a vertical 2:3 poster canvas with a thin double-line border and aged paper texture in warm ochre, sepia, and sunset gold. At the very top, place huge bold condensed serif lettering reading “MUMBAI” in dark teal, spanning almost the full width. Directly below it on the left, add widely spaced uppercase red letters reading “INDIA”. Beneath that, include a simple line-art rising sun icon, then an italic tagline reading “The City That Never Sleeps.” and a small decorative divider with one centered dot. Under the divider, add coordinates text reading {argument name="coordinates" default="19.0760° N, 72.8777° E"}. The lower two-thirds should show a cinematic sunset view of the Gateway of India on the waterfront, rendered in realistic vintage-poster style: the monument is large on the right-center with its arches and turrets visible, glowing orange sky and clouds behind it, sun low near the horizon, shimmering water with small boats, and a curving seaside road along Marine Drive in the foreground. Include exactly one black-and-yellow vintage taxi on the road in the lower foreground, small city skyline buildings on the left background, palm trees, street lamps, a stone seawall, and scattered tiny pedestrians near the monument. Keep the typography clean and legible, with nostalgic grain, slightly faded ink, subtle halftone texture, and no modern objects, logos, or extra text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古装饰艺术风格的旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="孟买"}，{argument name="country name" default="印度"}。使用 2:3 的竖向海报画布，带有细双线边框，并呈现出暖赭色、深褐色和日落金色的旧纸质感。在最上方，放置巨大的粗体压缩衬线字体，写着“MUMBAI”，颜色为深青色，几乎横跨整个宽度。在其正下方左侧，添加间距宽阔的大写红色字母，写着“INDIA”。下方加入一个简单的线稿日出图标，接着是一行斜体标语“The City That Never Sleeps.”，以及一个带有居中圆点的小型装饰分隔符。在分隔符下方，添加坐标文本 {argument name="coordinates" default="19.0760° N, 72.8777° E"}。下三分之二处应展示海滨印度门的电影感日落景观，以写实的复古海报风格呈现：纪念碑位于中右侧，体量宏大，拱门和塔楼清晰可见；背景是橙色发光的天空和云朵，太阳低悬于地平线附近，波光粼粼的水面上有几艘小船，前景是沿海滨大道（Marine Drive）蜿蜒的滨海公路。在前景下方的道路上包含一辆黑黄相间的复古出租车，左侧背景有小型城市天际线建筑、棕榈树、路灯、石质海堤，以及纪念碑附近零星的微小行人。保持排版清晰易读，带有怀旧颗粒感、轻微褪色的墨迹和细腻的半色调纹理，不要包含任何现代物体、Logo 或多余的文字。

templates.title: Vintage Chennai Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古钦奈旅行海报

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a vintage travel poster for {argument name="city name" default="CHENNAI"}, {argument name="country label" default="INDIA"}, evoking an early 20th-century railway tourism advertisement.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, warm aged paper background in ochre, sepia, and sunset orange. Add a thin double-line rectangular border close to the edge, printed in muted reddish brown.

Layout: Huge uppercase title across the top reading {argument name="city name" default="CHENNAI"} in a tall condensed slab-serif style, dark teal ink, occupying about the top quarter of the poster. Beneath it on the left, place the smaller wide-spaced uppercase country label {argument name="country label" default="INDIA"} in burnt red. Below that, include a small line-art temple gopuram icon centered over the tagline {argument name="tagline" default="Gateway to the South."} in italic serif script. Under the tagline add a tiny decorative divider with two short horizontal lines and a centered dot, then the coordinates {argument name="coordinates" default="13.0827° N, 80.2707° E"} in small monospaced lettering.

Main scene: The lower two-thirds show a golden sunset beach in Chennai with the sea on the left, glowing sun low near the horizon, gentle waves, wet reflective sand, and a monumental South Indian temple gopuram dominating the right side. Render the temple as an extremely detailed carved Dravidian tower in dark amber and bronze shadows, rising from the shoreline wall; include two additional smaller temple towers receding into the distance near the center-left background. Add palm silhouettes and a low coastal promenade wall.

Foreground details: Include exactly 3 prominent fishing boats: one large wooden boat stretching across the bottom foreground, one narrow boat pulled onto the beach near the center-right, and one more boat farther right near the waterline. Include exactly 6 visible human figures: two silhouetted fishermen in the left and center foreground beside the large boat, one standing fisherman on the right foreground, and three smaller figures near the boats in the midground. Add exactly 5 small birds in the sky over the sea.

Visual style: Lithographic vintage travel-poster illustration, soft grain, subtle paper texture, limited ink palette of teal, burnt sienna, ochre, and deep brown. Strong atmospheric perspective, dramatic warm sunset lighting, crisp poster typography, no modern objects, no photorealistic camera look, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张 {argument name="city name" default="CHENNAI"}（钦奈），{argument name="country label" default="INDIA"}（印度）的复古旅行海报，营造出 20 世纪初铁路旅游广告的氛围。

画布：竖版海报，2:3 纵横比，温暖的陈旧纸张背景，色调为赭石色、深褐色和日落橙。在边缘附近添加一个细的双线矩形边框，以柔和的红褐色印刷。

布局：顶部横跨巨大的大写标题 {argument name="city name" default="CHENNAI"}，采用高挑的压缩板衬线字体，深青色油墨，占据海报顶部约四分之一的位置。在其下方左侧，放置较小的宽间距大写国家标签 {argument name="country label" default="INDIA"}，颜色为焦红色。下方居中放置一个小型的线稿寺庙塔门图标，图标下方是斜体衬线字体的标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Gateway to the South."}。在标语下方添加一个微小的装饰性分隔符，包含两条短横线和一个居中的圆点，随后是小号等宽字体的坐标 {argument name="coordinates" default="13.0827° N, 80.2707° E"}。

主体场景：下三分之二展示了钦奈金色日落海滩，左侧为大海，低垂的太阳靠近地平线，波浪轻柔，湿润的沙滩呈现倒影，右侧是一座宏伟的南印度寺庙塔门。将寺庙渲染为极其精细的达罗毗荼风格雕刻塔楼，呈现深琥珀色和青铜色阴影，从海岸线墙上升起；在左中背景处增加两座较小的远景寺庙塔楼。添加棕榈树剪影和低矮的海岸长廊墙。

前景细节：包含确切 3 艘显眼的渔船：一艘横跨底部前景的大型木船，一艘停靠在中右侧沙滩上的窄船，以及另一艘位于右侧水线附近的船。包含确切 6 个可见的人物：左侧和中心前景大船旁有两个渔民剪影，右侧前景站立着一名渔民，中景处船只旁有三个较小的人物。在海上方的天空中添加确切 5 只小鸟。

视觉风格：石版画风格的复古旅行海报插画，柔和的颗粒感，微妙的纸张纹理，青色、焦赭色、赭石色和深褐色的有限油墨调色板。强烈的空气透视感，戏剧性的温暖日落光影，清晰的海报排版，无现代物体，无照片级写实感，无水印。

templates.title: Pistachio Rose Latte Scrapbook Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 开心果玫瑰拿铁剪贴簿海报

zh.title: 信息图 / 教育视觉图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a dreamy vintage scrapbook poster for a Korean cafe drink, centered on a layered iced {argument name="drink name" default="Pistachio Rose Latte"} with a romantic pink-and-pistachio color palette, Pinterest-style cafe diary aesthetic, and handwritten annotations.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, warm window-side natural light, cozy wooden cafe table background, soft bokeh, cream paper textures, torn edges, washi tape, paper clips, pinned instant-photo frames, doodles, stickers, rose petals, pistachio crumbs, and delicate gold sparkle marks.

Main subject: Place one tall clear glass latte in the center on a beige ceramic saucer. The drink has exactly 4 visible layers from bottom to top: pale rose pink rose syrup, white fresh milk, muted pistachio-green sauce with ice cubes and condensation droplets on the glass, and fluffy pale pink rose cream foam. Top the foam with exactly 5 garnish types: a dried rosebud, crushed pistachios, dried rose petals, tiny pink crumbs, and scattered green nut dust. Add white hand-drawn arrows labeling exactly 4 drink layers: “Rose Cream (so fluffy!)”, “Pistachio Sauce”, “Fresh Milk”, and “Rose Syrup”. Add tiny handwritten text near the bottom of the glass: “stir & enjoy!♡”.

Top title collage: At upper left, make a large torn cream paper title card taped with pink patterned washi and green tape. Text on the card: “Creamy & Dreamy♡” above a large hand-lettered title “Pistachio Rose Latte”, with “Pistachio” in olive green and “Rose Latte” in dusty rose red. Beneath it, add a green brush-stroke label containing Korean text “피스타치오 로즈 라떼”. Decorate with a pink bow sticker, a small rose doodle, hearts, and sparkles. Attach a narrow pink note on the right edge with exactly 5 lines: “soft”, “sweet”, “nutty”, “floral”, “♡”, plus a round stamp reading “CAFE DIARY” and handwritten “love this!”.

Left ingredient card: Add one torn notebook-paper card on the left labeled “Ingredients”. It must list exactly 6 ingredients with tiny icons: “Pistachio Sauce”, “Rose Cream”, “Fresh Milk”, “Rose Syrup”, “Ice”, and “Dried Rose & Pistachio”.

Right recipe card: Add one small taped beige paper card on the right labeled “How to make ♡”. It must show exactly 7 numbered steps: “Add ice to the glass”, “Pour rose syrup”, “Add fresh milk”, “Add pistachio sauce”, “Top with rose cream”, “Sprinkle pistachio & dried rose”, and “Stir and enjoy”. Add a tiny pink bow doodle at the bottom.

Photo and memo elements: Include exactly 2 Polaroid-style photos: one at the upper right showing a window, pink roses in a glass vase, and a pink cup of coffee, captioned “Sunday mood ♡”; one at the lower left showing baby’s breath flowers, pink roses, and pistachios, captioned “little things make big days ♡”. Include exactly 3 small sticky-note style pieces: a pink heart tag at mid-right reading “Treat yourself Today! ☺”; a small note near lower-left center reading “it’s giving...” followed by exactly 3 bullet lines “soft girl”, “cafe vibes”, “happy” with a bear face; and a bottom-center illustrated cafe diary card with Korean text, a cute bear, a drawing of the latte, labels “my favorite color combo!”, “Pistachio”, “Rose”, and hashtags “#cafevibes  #pistachiolover  #roselatte”. Include one bottom-right “DAILY MEMO” checklist clipped with a gold binder clip, containing exactly 5 checked items: “good coffee”, “pretty flowers”, “favorite song”, “sweet treat”, “me time”, ending with “= perfect day ♡”.

Surrounding props: Add cookies on a plate at the bottom left, a gold spoon with a pink gem-like handle near the bottom center, scattered dried rose petals and pistachios, a lace doily texture under the glass, and a small bowl or cup of pistachios at the bottom right. Use soft blush, sage green, cream, warm brown, and muted gold throughout.

Visual style: Photorealistic central drink blended with hand-drawn scrapbook graphics, Korean cafe mood board, analog paper collage, watercolor doodles, textured stationery, soft film grain, warm highlights, shallow depth of field, cozy and healing atmosphere.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and hand-lettered, preserve the exact counted cards, lists, labels, Polaroids, and sticky notes, avoid modern UI elements, avoid extra drink glasses, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款韩式咖啡馆饮品创作一张梦幻复古的剪贴簿海报，以分层冰 {argument name="drink name" default="开心果玫瑰拿铁"} 为中心，采用浪漫的粉色与开心果绿配色，呈现 Pinterest 风格的咖啡馆日记美学及手写注释。

画布：2:3 竖版海报，温暖的窗边自然光，温馨的木质咖啡桌背景，柔和的焦外成像，奶油色纸张纹理，撕边效果，纸胶带，回形针，拍立得相框，涂鸦，贴纸，玫瑰花瓣，开心果碎，以及精致的金色闪光点缀。

主体：在米色陶瓷杯垫中央放置一杯高大的透明拿铁玻璃杯。饮品从下到上清晰可见 4 层：淡玫瑰粉色玫瑰糖浆、白色鲜奶、带有冰块和杯壁凝珠的哑光开心果绿酱，以及蓬松的淡粉色玫瑰奶油泡沫。在泡沫顶部装饰 5 种配料：干玫瑰花蕾、开心果碎、干玫瑰花瓣、细小粉色碎屑和零星的绿色坚果粉。添加白色手绘箭头标注 4 层饮品：“Rose Cream (so fluffy!)”、“Pistachio Sauce”、“Fresh Milk” 和 “Rose Syrup”。在杯底附近添加细小的手写文字：“stir & enjoy!♡”。

顶部标题拼贴：左上方制作一张大型撕边奶油色标题卡，用粉色花纹纸胶带和绿色胶带固定。卡片文字：“Creamy & Dreamy♡”，上方是手写体大标题“Pistachio Rose Latte”，其中“Pistachio”为橄榄绿色，“Rose Latte”为灰玫瑰红色。下方添加一个绿色笔触标签，包含韩文“피스타치오 로즈 라떼”。用粉色蝴蝶结贴纸、小玫瑰涂鸦、爱心和闪光点缀。在右侧边缘附上一张窄粉色便签，包含 5 行文字：“soft”、“sweet”、“nutty”、“floral”、“♡”，并盖有一个写着“CAFE DIARY”的圆形印章及手写体“love this!”。

左侧配料卡：在左侧添加一张撕边笔记本纸卡，标注为“Ingredients”。必须列出 6 种配料并配有微型图标：“Pistachio Sauce”、“Rose Cream”、“Fresh Milk”、“Rose Syrup”、“Ice” 和 “Dried Rose & Pistachio”。

右侧食谱卡：在右侧添加一张用胶带固定的米色小纸卡，标注为“How to make ♡”。必须显示 7 个编号步骤：“Add ice to the glass”、“Pour rose syrup”、“Add fresh milk”、“Add pistachio sauce”、“Top with rose cream”、“Sprinkle pistachio & dried rose” 和 “Stir and enjoy”。底部添加一个粉色蝴蝶结小涂鸦。

照片与备忘录元素：包含 2 张拍立得风格照片：右上角一张展示窗户、玻璃瓶中的粉色玫瑰和一杯粉色咖啡，配文“Sunday mood ♡”；左下角一张展示满天星、粉色玫瑰和开心果，配文“little things make big days ♡”。包含 3 张小型便利贴风格纸片：中右侧一张粉色爱心标签，写着“Treat yourself Today! ☺”；左下中心附近一张小纸条，写着“it’s giving...”后跟 3 行项目符号“soft girl”、“cafe vibes”、“happy”并配有一个小熊脸；底部中心一张插画风格咖啡馆日记卡，带有韩文、可爱小熊、拿铁绘图、标签“my favorite color combo!”、“Pistachio”、“Rose” 以及标签“#cafevibes #pistachiolover #roselatte”。包含一张右下角用金色长尾夹固定的“DAILY MEMO”清单，包含 5 个已勾选项目：“good coffee”、“pretty flowers”、“favorite song”、“sweet treat”、“me time”，结尾为“= perfect day ♡”。

周边道具：左下方盘子里放着饼干，底部中心附近有一把带有粉色宝石手柄的金色勺子，散落的干玫瑰花瓣和开心果，玻璃杯下有蕾丝垫片纹理，右下方有一个装开心果的小碗或小杯子。整体使用柔和的腮红粉、鼠尾草绿、奶油色、暖棕色和哑光金色。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的主体饮品与手绘剪贴簿图形融合，韩式咖啡馆 mood board，模拟纸张拼贴，水彩涂鸦，纹理文具，柔和胶片颗粒，暖色高光，浅景深，温馨治愈的氛围。

约束：保持所有文字清晰且为手写体，保留精确计数的卡片、列表、标签、拍立得和便利贴，避免现代 UI 元素，避免出现多余的饮用杯，无水印。

templates.title: Elf Idol Subway Poster Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 精灵偶像地铁海报场景

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic anime-realism scene inside a modern Korean subway station, showing a life-size fantasy elf idol character standing beside a giant illuminated character-design advertisement poster for {argument name="character name" default="SERIO"}.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, eye-level camera, realistic station perspective, warm fluorescent indoor lighting, glossy floor reflections, shallow depth of field on background commuters.

Main subject: One tall elegant female elf with very long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="orange"} hair, bright blue eyes, long pointed ears, delicate anime face, and a calm slightly serious expression. She stands on the left side of the image, facing forward with one hand gently touching or gesturing toward the poster. She wears a luxurious ivory-white fantasy concert gown: draped satin fabric, high thigh slit, translucent shawl sleeves, orange ribbon accents, gold jewelry details, thin waist ornaments, anklets, and white strappy high-heel sandals. Her design should feel like a high-end virtual idol brought into the real world, blending anime styling with photorealistic lighting and fabric texture.

Environment: Korean subway platform corridor with tiled walls, dark ceiling panels, metal columns, and blurred pedestrians in the background. Include exactly 2 overhead wayfinding signs: one large yellow sign with a left arrow, the number “3”, and Korean text meaning “exit / way out”; one smaller dark sign below it with Korean transfer text. The background should feel candid and urban, like a phone photo or street-fashion photo taken in a busy station.

Poster layout: On the right wall, create one huge backlit white poster framed in black. It is a detailed anime character sheet and concert advertisement. At the upper left of the poster, large serif orange title text reads “{argument name="headline text" default="SERIO CONCERT"}”, with smaller date text “2026.5.21” and short Korean concert/event notes beneath it. The poster should contain exactly 9 main visual sections: 1 large bust portrait of the elf, 1 full-body character render, 1 profile text block in Korean, 1 design-point area with ear and costume sketches, 1 color palette/expression area, 1 fabric-flow sketch area, 1 dynamic-pose area, 1 key-scale weapon/accessory area, and 1 makeup-detail/notes area.

Counted poster details: The color palette/expression area must show exactly 8 small head portraits of the same elf, arranged as 4 across the top row and 4 across the bottom row, each with slightly different expressions or angles. The dynamic-pose area must show exactly 2 small action poses of the elf. The makeup-detail/notes area must show exactly 2 close-up blue eye drawings. The key-scale area must show exactly 2 crystal-like accessory or weapon drawings. The design-point area must include exactly 3 sketch callouts: pointed ear jewelry, upper torso/costume detail, and leg or shoe detail.

Visual style: Premium anime illustration mixed with photorealistic subway photography, soft orange-white color palette, luminous poster glow, clean fine-line concept art on the poster, elegant serif typography, tiny Korean annotation text, subtle sparkle icons around the character-sheet elements, ultra-detailed hair strands and silk folds.

Constraints: Keep the image as a single scene, not a collage. Do not add extra main characters. Avoid logos, watermarks, or readable brand names. Make the Korean microtext look like authentic design notes while keeping the main readable text limited to the title, date, station signage, and short section labels such as PROFILE, DESIGN POINT, DYNAMIC POSE, KEY SCALE, MAKEUP DETAIL, and NOTES.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个位于现代韩国地铁站内的电影级动漫写实场景，展示一位真人大小的奇幻精灵偶像角色，站在一张巨大的背光角色设计广告海报旁，海报主角为 {argument name="character name" default="SERIO"}。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，平视视角，写实的车站透视，温暖的室内荧光灯照明，光洁的地板反射，背景通勤者采用浅景深效果。

主体：一位高挑优雅的女性精灵，拥有非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="orange"} 长发、明亮的蓝色眼睛、长尖耳、精致的动漫面孔，表情冷静且略显严肃。她站在画面左侧，面向前方，一只手轻轻触碰或指向海报。她身穿奢华的象牙白奇幻演唱会礼服：垂坠感缎面布料、高开叉设计、半透明披肩袖、橙色丝带装饰、金色珠宝细节、细腰饰、脚链以及白色绑带高跟凉鞋。她的设计应呈现出一种将高端虚拟偶像带入现实世界的感觉，融合动漫风格与照片级的灯光和布料质感。

环境：韩国地铁站台走廊，带有瓷砖墙壁、深色天花板面板、金属立柱，背景中有模糊的行人。包含 2 个头顶导向标志：一个大型黄色标志，带有左箭头、数字“3”以及韩文“出口”字样；下方是一个较小的深色标志，带有韩文换乘信息。背景应呈现出一种抓拍的城市感，如同在繁忙车站拍摄的手机照片或街拍时尚照。

海报布局：在右侧墙壁上，创建一张巨大的黑色边框背光白色海报。这是一张详细的动漫角色设定表和演唱会广告。海报左上方有醒目的橙色衬线标题文字“{argument name="headline text" default="SERIO CONCERT"}”，下方配有较小的日期文字“2026.5.21”以及简短的韩文演唱会/活动说明。海报应包含 9 个主要视觉区域：1 个精灵的大型半身肖像、1 个全身角色渲染图、1 个韩文个人资料文本块、1 个包含耳朵和服装草图的设计要点区、1 个调色板/表情区、1 个布料流动草图区、1 个动态姿势区、1 个关键比例武器/配饰区以及 1 个妆容细节/备注区。

海报细节计数：调色板/表情区必须展示 8 个相同精灵的小头像，排列为上下两行，每行 4 个，每个表情或角度略有不同。动态姿势区必须展示 2 个精灵的小型动作姿势。妆容细节/备注区必须展示 2 个蓝眼睛的特写绘图。关键比例区必须展示 2 个水晶般的配饰或武器绘图。设计要点区必须包含 3 个草图标注：尖耳珠宝、上半身/服装细节以及腿部或鞋子细节。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画与写实地铁摄影相结合，柔和的橙白色调，发光的海报效果，海报上清晰的细线条概念艺术，优雅的衬线字体，微小的韩文注释，角色设定元素周围有细微的闪光图标，超精细的发丝和丝绸褶皱。

约束：保持图像为单一场景，而非拼贴画。不要添加额外的主角。避免使用徽标、水印或可识别的品牌名称。使韩文微型文字看起来像真实的各种设计备注，同时将主要可读文本限制在标题、日期、车站标志以及简短的章节标签，如 PROFILE（个人资料）、DESIGN POINT（设计要点）、DYNAMIC POSE（动态姿势）、KEY SCALE（关键比例）、MAKEUP DETAIL（妆容细节）和 NOTES（备注）。

templates.title: Sunset Promise Anime Storyboard Card

titleLocalized.zh: “日落之约” 动画分镜卡

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic anime storyboard image card for an animation prompt, designed as a comic-strip scene plan with voice lines and timing.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 landscape canvas, approximately 1152×768, with a black script header occupying the top third and a 10-panel storyboard grid occupying the bottom two thirds. Use thin white dividers between panels and a clean production-board layout.

Header: Black background with crisp white sans-serif text. Top line reads: SCENE TITLE: {argument name="scene title" default="Sunset Promise"}  |  DURATION: {argument name="duration" default="~10 SECONDS"}  |  GENRE / MOOD: {argument name="genre and mood" default="Emotional, Bittersweet"}. Below it, include exactly 10 numbered shot instructions with yellow timecodes and white descriptions:
1. 0:00 - 0:01 WIDE SHOT. Rooftop at sunset. Boy and girl stand apart, facing each other. Wind blows.
2. 0:01 - 0:02 MEDIUM CLOSE UP on boy. He takes a breath, hesitant. BOY: “There’s something I need to say...”
3. 0:02 - 0:03 MEDIUM CLOSE UP on girl. She turns to him, curious.
4. 0:03 - 0:04 CLOSE UP on boy. He speaks with feeling. BOY: “Thank you... for everything.”
5. 0:04 - 0:05 CLOSE UP on girl. She’s taken aback, eyes glisten.
6. 0:05 - 0:06 CLOSE UP on boy. He shows a small, warm smile. BOY: {argument name="farewell line" default="I won’t forget you."}
7. 0:06 - 0:07 CLOSE UP on girl. Tears form, she fights to hold them back.
8. 0:07 - 0:08 WIDE SHOT. A beat of silence between them. Wind and sunset fill the moment.
9. 0:08 - 0:09 BOY turns and walks away slowly. Girl watches, unable to call out.
10. 0:09 - 0:10 CLOSE UP on girl reaching out. Tears fall. Fade out. (NO DIALOGUE)

Storyboard grid: Exactly 10 panels arranged in two rows of five. Each panel has a small white square number label in the top-left corner and a small white timecode in the top-right corner. Panel labels are: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 on the top row; 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 on the bottom row. Timecodes are: 0:00 - 0:01, 0:01 - 0:02, 0:02 - 0:03, 0:03 - 0:04, 0:04 - 0:05, 0:05 - 0:06, 0:06 - 0:07, 0:07 - 0:08, 0:08 - 0:09, 0:09 - 0:10.

Panel visuals: Use a dramatic Japanese anime film style with warm orange-pink sunset lighting, a rooftop railing, wet reflective rooftop floor, distant city skyline, glowing sun near the horizon, and wind-blown hair. The characters are a teenage boy in a dark Japanese school uniform and a teenage girl in a sailor-style school uniform with long brown hair. Add opaque brown rectangular censor blocks over the characters’ faces in close-up panels, matching the generated look.

Panel-by-panel imagery: 1) Wide rooftop shot with boy and girl standing apart facing each other, sunset centered between them. 2) Medium close-up of the boy from chest up, dark uniform, sunset skyline behind him, face covered by a brown rectangle. 3) Medium close-up of the girl turning toward him, long hair blowing, sailor uniform, face covered by a brown rectangle. 4) Extreme side close-up of the boy speaking, sunset behind, face mostly covered by a brown rectangle. 5) Close-up of the girl reacting, hair across frame, face covered by a brown rectangle. 6) Close-up of the boy with a subtle warm smile, face covered by a brown rectangle. 7) Close-up of the girl holding back tears, wind-blown hair, face covered by a brown rectangle. 8) Wide rooftop silence shot with both characters separated against the sunset. 9) Rear view of the boy walking away while the girl remains near the railing, orange sky behind them. 10) Close-up of the girl reaching one hand toward the camera, tears implied, face covered by a brown rectangle.

Visual style: High-detail anime key art, cinematic lighting, emotional bittersweet mood, soft film grain, saturated sunset clouds, reflective puddles, clean white storyboard borders, legible typography, no logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为动画提示词创建一个电影感的动画分镜图像卡，设计为包含台词和时间轴的漫画式场景规划。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向画布，尺寸约为 1152×768，顶部三分之一为黑色脚本标题栏，底部三分之二为 10 宫格分镜网格。面板之间使用细白线分隔，布局简洁，呈现专业项目风格。

标题栏：黑色背景，配以清晰的白色无衬线字体。顶行文字：场景标题：{argument name="scene title" default="日落之约"} | 时长：{argument name="duration" default="~10 秒"} | 类型 / 氛围：{argument name="genre and mood" default="感人，苦涩"}。下方包含 10 个带编号的镜头说明，配有黄色时间码和白色描述：
1. 0:00 - 0:01 远景。日落时的天台。男孩和女孩分开站立，面对面。风在吹。
2. 0:01 - 0:02 男孩中近景。他深吸一口气，有些犹豫。男孩：“我有话要对你说……”
3. 0:02 - 0:03 女孩中近景。她转向他，充满好奇。
4. 0:03 - 0:04 男孩特写。他深情地说道。男孩：“谢谢你……为我做的一切。”
5. 0:04 - 0:05 女孩特写。她感到惊讶，眼眶湿润。
6. 0:05 - 0:06 男孩特写。他露出一抹温暖的微笑。男孩：{argument name="farewell line" default="我不会忘记你的。"}
7. 0:06 - 0:07 女孩特写。泪水涌出，她努力忍住不让泪水落下。
8. 0:07 - 0:08 远景。两人之间沉默片刻。风和日落填满了这一瞬间。
9. 0:08 - 0:09 男孩转身缓慢走开。女孩注视着，却无法呼喊出声。
10. 0:09 - 0:10 女孩特写，伸手挽留。泪水滑落。淡出。（无对白）

分镜网格：共 10 个画面，排列为两行五列。每个画面左上角有一个白色小方块编号标签，右上角有一个白色小时间码。画面标签为：顶行 1、2、3、4、5；底行 6、7、8、9、10。时间码分别为：0:00 - 0:01, 0:01 - 0:02, 0:02 - 0:03, 0:03 - 0:04, 0:04 - 0:05, 0:05 - 0:06, 0:06 - 0:07, 0:07 - 0:08, 0:08 - 0:09, 0:09 - 0:10。

The subject is one young urban woman standing very close to the camera on the Bund waterfront at night, framed from mid-thigh to above the head in a slightly awkward handheld vertical composition. She has {argument name="hair color" default="messy pastel pink hair"}, wind-tossed and partially covering her head, with both arms raised over her head in a spontaneous pose; her face is intentionally obscured by a plain square censor block in muted skin-pink color. She wears one oversized black T-shirt with a large distressed horror-style graphic print on the front, one thin necklace, and exactly two visible wrist accessories on her raised right wrist: a colorful beaded bracelet and a dangling silver charm bracelet. The background shows illuminated historic Shanghai architecture and clock-tower buildings on the left, dark modern skyline lights on the right, wet-looking pavement, railings, and a dark riverfront promenade. Use harsh flash highlights on skin and shirt, low-contrast deep shadows, visible film grain, subtle motion blur in the hair and hands, imperfect handheld tilt, candid diary-like city-girl atmosphere, random beautiful flaws, realistic skin texture, warm building lights against a black night sky, and no polished studio look.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张深夜上海街头的写实抓拍，呈现日本负片美学，采用 Ricoh GR III 或一次性胶片相机的直闪摄影风格。主体是一位年轻的都市女性，她站在外滩江边，距离镜头非常近，构图采用略显随意的手持竖构图，取景范围从大腿中部到头部上方。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的淡粉色头发"}，发丝被风吹乱并遮住部分头部，双手高举过头顶，姿态自然随性；她的面部被一个柔和肤粉色的正方形遮挡块刻意遮住。她身穿一件超大号黑色 T 恤，正面印有大型做旧恐怖风格图案，佩戴一条细项链，高举的右腕上清晰可见两件配饰：一条彩色串珠手链和一条垂坠的银色吊坠手链。背景左侧是灯火通明的上海历史建筑和钟楼，右侧是深邃的现代天际线灯光，地面湿润，配有栏杆和昏暗的江滨步道。画面需体现皮肤和衬衫上的强闪光高光、低对比度的深邃阴影、可见的胶片颗粒、头发和手部的轻微动态模糊、不完美的手持倾斜感、随性的日记风都市女孩氛围、随机的自然瑕疵、真实的皮肤质感，以及黑色夜空下温暖的建筑灯光，避免任何精致的影棚感。

templates.title: Luxury Purple Anime Acrylic Block

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华紫色动漫亚克力砖

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-premium product photograph of a thick, transparent multilayer acrylic block containing a richly detailed 2D anime collage, as if a luxury acrylic collectible has been manufactured from an illustration.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 portrait product photo, close-up three-quarter view from slightly above, the acrylic block standing upright on a lace-covered tabletop. Use shallow depth of field with a dark violet studio background, purple bokeh lights, crystal beads, pearls, faceted gems, and soft glowing candles in the distance.

Main object: A large rectangular clear acrylic block, about 5–7 cm thick, with polished beveled edges, visible stacked transparent layers, refractive side walls, internal reflections, caustics, and glossy highlights. The front face is covered with delicate gold and white foil-like printed decorations, while the anime artwork appears suspended across many internal acrylic layers for a deep 3D collage effect.

Central artwork: Inside the block, show {argument name="character name" default="an elegant faceless anime heroine"} wearing a dark purple and black fantasy kimono-style gown with flowing translucent sleeves, ribbon-like fabric, lavender floral ornaments, and long black-purple hair spreading through the composition. Her face is intentionally obscured by a small soft-edged purple square censor block centered over the head. She holds or is surrounded by glowing paper lanterns. Behind her, include a radiant violet moon or circular magical halo, starry night textures, sparkling mist, and an umbrella-like fan silhouette. Overall mood: mysterious, romantic, luxurious, nocturnal.

Color and lighting: Dominant palette of deep violet, amethyst, indigo, black, lavender, transparent crystal, and metallic gold. Strong internal purple glow from behind the character, rim lighting through the acrylic edges, glitter particles, prismatic refractions, and highly realistic product-photography reflections.

Decorative printed elements: Use exactly 7 prominent decorative motif groups on the acrylic surface: 1) gold and white butterflies scattered near the top and lower front, 2) floral garlands and blossoms along the left and bottom edges, 3) ornate filigree frames and corner borders, 4) tiny stars and sparkles throughout, 5) hanging lantern illustrations integrated with the character, 6) a pink heart gem sticker on the right side, 7) crescent moon and chain ornaments near the bottom left.

Floating creatures: Include exactly 3 red goldfish inside the acrylic scene: one on the left side near the character’s sleeve, one mid-right near the character’s hand, and one larger goldfish in the lower-right foreground. Make them appear suspended in different acrylic layers with different depths and refractions.

Visible text printed on the object: Add ornate gold script and small serif typography as part of the premium packaging design. Include {argument name="main title text" default="Eternal Night"} at the top left, Chinese vertical text {argument name="vertical label text" default="永恒的夜"} on the left side, the word {argument name="decorative script text" default="Beautiful"} in large cursive gold at lower left, a small serial label "No. 5201314" at upper right, and a small quote plaque at lower right reading {argument name="quote text" default="You are The one Makes me Smile"}. Additional tiny decorative microtext may be present but should be secondary and not dominate.

Surface setting: Place the acrylic block on ornate white lace fabric with scattered purple crystals, pink rhinestones, pearl strands, and glossy beads in the foreground. The surroundings should feel like a luxury collectible product shoot, not a flat illustration.

Style and quality: Hyper-realistic macro product photography combined with anime illustration trapped inside acrylic; extremely sharp front details, realistic transparent material, layered parallax, high contrast purple lighting, premium handmade merchandise aesthetic, no watermark, no extra characters, no packaging box, no hands.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张超高端产品摄影照片，展示一块厚实的透明多层亚克力砖，内部包含细节丰富的 2D 动漫拼贴画，仿佛一件由插画制作而成的奢华亚克力收藏品。

画面：垂直 2:3 比例的产品摄影，从上方略微俯视的三分之四侧面特写，亚克力砖直立在铺有蕾丝的桌面上。使用浅景深效果，背景为深紫色的摄影棚，带有紫色光斑、水晶珠、珍珠、切面宝石和远处柔和发光的蜡烛。

主体：一块大型长方形透明亚克力砖，厚度约 5–7 厘米，边缘经过抛光倒角处理，可见堆叠的透明层、折射侧壁、内部反射、焦散效果和光泽高光。正面覆盖着精致的金白色箔片状印刷装饰，动漫艺术作品仿佛悬浮在多个亚克力层中，呈现出深邃的 3D 拼贴效果。

核心艺术：在砖块内部，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的无脸动漫女主角"}，身穿深紫色和黑色奇幻和服风格长裙，带有飘逸的半透明袖子、丝带状织物、薰衣草花卉装饰，以及在画面中散开的长长的黑紫色头发。她的脸部被一个位于头顶中心、边缘柔和的小紫色方块遮挡。她手持或被发光的纸灯笼环绕。在她身后，加入放射状的紫罗兰色月亮或圆形魔法光环、星夜纹理、闪烁的雾气以及伞状扇子剪影。整体氛围：神秘、浪漫、奢华、夜色。

色彩与灯光：主色调为深紫、紫水晶、靛蓝、黑、薰衣草紫、透明水晶和金属金。角色后方有强烈的内部紫色光芒，亚克力边缘有轮廓光，带有闪光颗粒、棱镜折射以及高度逼真的产品摄影反射效果。

印刷装饰元素：在亚克力表面使用 7 组醒目的装饰图案：1) 散布在顶部和左下方的金白色蝴蝶，2) 沿左侧和底部的花环与花朵，3) 华丽的镂空花纹边框和角落装饰，4) 遍布各处的微小星星和闪光，5) 与角色融为一体的悬挂灯笼插画，6) 右侧的一个粉色心形宝石贴纸，7) 左下角的月牙和链条装饰。

悬浮生物：在亚克力场景内加入 3 条红色金鱼：一条在左侧角色袖子附近，一条在右侧角色手部附近，一条较大的金鱼在右下角前景。让它们看起来悬浮在不同深度的亚克力层中，并呈现出不同的折射效果。

印刷在物体上的文字：作为高端包装设计的一部分，添加华丽的金色手写体和小型衬线字体。在左上角包含 {argument name="main title text" default="Eternal Night"}，左侧包含中文竖排文字 {argument name="vertical label text" default="永恒的夜"}，左下角用大型金色草书书写单词 {argument name="decorative script text" default="Beautiful"}，右上角有一个小型序列号标签“No. 5201314”，右下角有一个小型引用铭牌，内容为 {argument name="quote text" default="You are The one Makes me Smile"}。可以存在额外的微小装饰性文字，但应作为次要元素，不应喧宾夺主。

表面设置：将亚克力砖放置在华丽的白色蕾丝织物上，前景散布着紫色水晶、粉色水钻、珍珠串和光泽珠子。环境应营造出奢华收藏品拍摄的质感，而非平面插画。

风格与质量：超写实微距产品摄影与封存在亚克力中的动漫插画相结合；正面细节极其锐利，真实的透明材质，分层视差，高对比度紫色灯光，高端手工周边美学，无水印，无额外角色，无包装盒，无手部。

templates.title: Bioluminescent Plush Creature Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 生物发光毛绒生物设计图

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic 3D character reference sheet for a cute plush-like creature named {argument name="character name" default="bioluminescent cream forest cub"}, designed for consistent video generation.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 character sheet on a matte medium-gray studio background, soft diffused lighting, subtle floor shadows, high-resolution photorealistic fur rendering.

Subject details: The character is a small chubby teddy-bear/cat hybrid with a round oversized head, short rounded body, tiny arms, stubby legs, cream-colored dense fuzzy fur, glossy dark olive-brown eyes with bright catchlights, a tiny dark brown nose and mouth, faint pink cheeks, one thin curled hair sprout on top of the head, small rounded ears that glow bioluminescent green inside, and a short tail with a glowing green tip. The overall mood is adorable, soft, and toy-like, with realistic fiber texture and gentle translucency in the glowing green areas. Use {argument name="fur color" default="warm cream"}, {argument name="glow color" default="bioluminescent green"}, and {argument name="cheek color" default="soft pink blush"}.

Layout: Arrange the sheet in two main rows. Top row contains exactly 3 full-body turnaround views, evenly spaced and labeled in small white uppercase text: 1) “01 FRONT” showing the creature facing forward, 2) “02 3/4 LEFT” showing a three-quarter left view with the tail visible behind, 3) “03 BACK” showing the back view with rounded head, back fur, small arms, legs, and glowing tail tip. Bottom left contains an expression sheet with exactly 3 vertical framed panels labeled “EXPRESSION SHEET” above and captions below: 1) “01 NEUTRAL” with calm forward-facing eyes and closed small mouth, 2) “02 BATTLE FURY” with the face area covered by a centered opaque beige square block, 3) “03 SHOCK” with raised ears, wide eyes, and open surprised mouth. Bottom right contains a color palette column labeled “COLOR PALETTE” with exactly 5 rectangular swatches and labels: 1) “CREAM FUR” beige fur texture, 2) “BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN” glowing green gradient, 3) “PINK CHEEK” rosy pink texture, 4) “DARK BROWN OUTLINE / NOSE” dark brown swatch, 5) “WHITE HIGHLIGHT” white swatch.

Text style: Small clean sans-serif uppercase white labels, minimal technical character-sheet typography, aligned precisely and unobtrusively.

Constraints: Keep exactly 3 turnaround views, exactly 3 expression panels, and exactly 5 color swatches. Do not add extra characters, props, logos, watermarks, or decorative background elements. Maintain consistent proportions, fur texture, glowing ears and tail, and facial design across all views.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="character name" default="生物发光奶油森林幼崽"} 的可爱毛绒生物创建逼真的 3D 角色参考图，旨在实现一致的视频生成效果。

画布：垂直 4:5 角色设计图，采用哑光中灰色摄影棚背景，柔和的漫射光，细微的地面阴影，高分辨率照片级毛发渲染。

主体细节：该角色是一个圆滚滚的小型泰迪熊与猫的混合体，拥有圆圆的大脑袋、短圆的身体、细小的手臂、粗短的腿、奶油色浓密的毛绒皮毛、深橄榄棕色的光泽眼睛并带有明亮的高光、小巧的深棕色鼻子和嘴巴、淡淡的粉色脸颊、头顶有一根细细卷曲的毛发、小巧圆润的耳朵内部发出生物发光绿光，以及带有发光绿尖的短尾巴。整体氛围可爱、柔软且具有玩具感，具有逼真的纤维质感和发光绿色区域的柔和半透明感。使用 {argument name="fur color" default="暖奶油色"}、{argument name="glow color" default="生物发光绿色"} 和 {argument name="cheek color" default="柔和粉色腮红"}。

布局：将设计图分为两行。顶行包含 3 个全身三视图，均匀分布并带有小型白色大写字母标签：1) “01 FRONT”展示角色正面，2) “02 3/4 LEFT”展示左侧 3/4 视角，可见背后的尾巴，3) “03 BACK”展示背面视角，包括圆头、背部毛发、小手臂、腿部和发光的尾尖。左下角包含一个表情图，带有 3 个垂直排列的边框面板，上方标注“EXPRESSION SHEET”，下方带有说明文字：1) “01 NEUTRAL”表现平静的正面注视和微闭的小嘴，2) “02 BATTLE FURY”表现面部被居中的不透明米色方块遮挡，3) “03 SHOCK”表现耳朵竖起、瞪大眼睛、嘴巴张开的惊讶表情。右下角包含一个名为“COLOR PALETTE”的调色板列，带有 5 个矩形色块及标签：1) “CREAM FUR”米色毛发质感，2) “BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN”发光绿色渐变，3) “PINK CHEEK”玫瑰粉色质感，4) “DARK BROWN OUTLINE / NOSE”深棕色色块，5) “WHITE HIGHLIGHT”白色色块。

文字风格：小型、简洁的无衬线大写白色标签，采用极简的角色设计图排版，对齐精准且不显突兀。

约束：保持 3 个三视图、3 个表情面板和 5 个色块。不要添加额外的角色、道具、标志、水印或装饰性背景元素。在所有视图中保持一致的比例、毛发质感、发光的耳朵和尾巴以及面部设计。

titleLocalized.zh: 竞技场零食快照

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical smartphone photo taken inside a modern sports arena concourse at night, with glossy polished gray floors reflecting blue and purple lights, queue stanchions, concession signage, and distant entrance signs in the background, including a large red “STAPLES” wall graphic on the left and a blue “crypto.com” sign on the right. In the foreground, show {argument name="subject" default="a young woman"} standing close to the camera, framed from upper thighs to head, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a black satin slip dress with thin straps"}, with shoulder-length wavy dark hair and a black shoulder bag strap. Her face is fully obscured by a centered solid brown square privacy block. She holds exactly two food-and-drink items: in her left hand, one large clear plastic cup of dark red frozen drink with a domed lid and one black straw; in her right arm, one white cardboard tray containing exactly four visible snack components: a huge white bucket overflowing with yellow-and-white buttered popcorn, a pile of nacho chips covered in bright orange cheese sauce, one small clear cup of sliced jalapeños, and one small clear cup of red salsa. Use candid wide-angle perspective, slightly overhead camera angle, sharp foreground detail, natural indoor arena lighting, realistic colors, casual social-media snapshot aesthetic, no extra people in the foreground, no readable added text beyond the venue signs.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖屏手机摄影作品，场景设定在夜晚现代体育竞技场的大厅内。地面为光亮的灰色抛光材质，反射着蓝色和紫色的灯光；背景中可见排队护栏、餐饮指示牌以及远处的入口标志，左侧墙面有巨大的红色 “STAPLES” 图形，右侧有蓝色的 “crypto.com” 标志。在前景中，展示 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，镜头从大腿上部到头部进行构图，她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件黑色缎面吊带裙"}，留着齐肩波浪卷深色头发，背着黑色单肩包。她的脸部被一个居中的纯棕色方块完全遮挡以保护隐私。她手中拿着两样食品和饮料：左手拿着一个透明大塑料杯，装有深红色冰饮，配有圆顶盖和一根黑色吸管；右臂抱着一个白色纸板托盘，托盘内清晰可见四种零食：一个装满黄白相间奶油爆米花的大白桶、一堆淋有亮橙色芝士酱的玉米片、一个小透明杯装的墨西哥辣椒片，以及一个小透明杯装的红色莎莎酱。采用抓拍广角视角，略微俯拍，前景细节锐利，呈现自然的室内竞技场光影，色彩真实，具有休闲社交媒体快照的审美风格，前景中无其他人物，除场地标识外无任何额外添加的文字。

templates.title: Crochet Doll Movie Snacks

titleLocalized.zh: 钩针玩偶电影零食

templates.prompt: Create a realistic close-up photo of a handmade crochet amigurumi doll posed in a modern movie theater lobby, shot from slightly above with shallow depth of field. The doll is {argument name="character name" default="a young woman cinema-goer"} with medium-brown yarn skin, long dark brown micro-braid/twist crochet hair parted down the center, and a plain opaque square covering the face in a matching dark brown tone. She wears exactly 2 visible outfit pieces: a mustard-yellow ribbed crochet long-sleeve top and a black crochet pinafore-style dress with thin black straps. She holds exactly 5 cinema snack items: 1 clear-lidded red iced drink with a black straw in her left hand, 1 cream crochet tray in her right arm, 1 large cream crochet popcorn bucket piled high with yellow-and-white popcorn on the tray, 1 pile of orange crochet nachos in the tray, 1 small clear cup of green jalapeño slices, and 1 small clear cup of red salsa. The background is an indoor multiplex concourse with glossy polished stone floors reflecting blue and purple lights, blurred people, queue stanchions, a red storefront/sign on the left reading “STAPLES,” and a blue illuminated storefront/sign on the right reading “crypto.com.” Use warm indoor lighting, detailed yarn texture, realistic scale, documentary smartphone-photo look, bokeh background, no extra characters in the foreground, no watermark, and keep all objects made of crochet except the clear plastic-looking cup lids and sauce cups. Customize the doll’s hair as {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"}, the top as {argument name="top color" default="mustard yellow"}, the dress as {argument name="dress color" default="black"}, and the lobby setting as {argument name="location" default="a modern movie theater lobby"}.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的特写照片，展示一个手工钩针编织的阿米古鲁米玩偶，置身于现代电影院大厅中，采用略微俯视的视角，并带有浅景深效果。玩偶是 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻的女性电影观众"}，拥有中棕色毛线皮肤，长长的深棕色微型编织/扭转钩针发型，中分，脸部覆盖着一块匹配的深棕色纯色方形遮挡物。她穿着两件明显的服饰：一件芥末黄罗纹钩针长袖上衣和一件黑色钩针背带裙，带有细黑色肩带。她手里拿着 5 种电影零食：左手拿着一杯带黑色吸管的透明盖红色冰饮，右臂抱着一个奶油色钩针托盘，托盘上有一个堆满黄白色爆米花的奶油色钩针爆米花桶、一堆橙色钩针玉米片、一小杯绿色墨西哥辣椒切片以及一小杯红色莎莎酱。背景是室内多厅影院大厅，地面是反射着蓝紫色灯光的光滑抛光石材，背景中有模糊的人群、排队护栏，左侧有一个写着“STAPLES”的红色店面招牌，右侧有一个写着“crypto.com”的蓝色发光店面招牌。使用温暖的室内灯光，展现细腻的毛线质感，比例真实，呈现纪录片式的手机摄影风格，背景虚化，前景中没有多余的人物，无水印，除透明塑料质感的杯盖和酱料杯外，所有物体均由钩针编织而成。可自定义玩偶的头发颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，上衣颜色为 {argument name="top color" default="芥末黄"}，裙子颜色为 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"}，以及大厅场景为 {argument name="location" default="现代电影院大厅"}。

templates.title: Pink Floral Vacation Café Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色花卉度假咖啡馆人像

templates.prompt: Create a sun-drenched editorial lifestyle photograph in a Mediterranean café setting, vertical 4:5 composition. A stylish young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="sun-kissed blonde hair"} sits relaxed in a wicker chair against a cream stucco wall with pale blue decorative trim, wearing a romantic {argument name="dress description" default="strapless pink floral ruffled summer dress with a jeweled brooch at the bust"} and a matching {argument name="headscarf description" default="pink floral silk headscarf tied under the chin with long loose tails"}. Her face is intentionally covered by a centered rectangular privacy block in a warm tan skin-tone color. She holds a large stemmed glass of cloudy pale yellow drink in her left hand near her mouth and an open travel guidebook in her right hand on her lap; visible accessories include neatly manicured pale nails and several rings. Show warm golden-hour sunlight, glossy tanned skin highlights, soft shadows, a partial white café table at the lower left, a glass door edge on the left, and a white handbag partly visible at the lower right. The mood is elegant vacation glamour, candid but polished, shot like a high-end fashion Instagram photo on film with natural grain, realistic textures, pastel pink palette, bright summer light, shallow depth of field, and no extra text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满阳光的地中海咖啡馆生活方式时尚大片，采用 4:5 竖构图。一位时尚的年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="阳光亲吻般的金色长发"}，坐在藤椅上，背景是带有淡蓝色装饰边框的奶油色灰泥墙。她身穿浪漫的 {argument name="dress description" default="粉色花卉荷叶边抹胸夏装，胸前饰有珠宝胸针"}，并搭配同款 {argument name="headscarf description" default="粉色花卉丝绸头巾，在下巴处系结，长长的丝带自然垂落"}。她的面部被一个居中的暖棕色肤色矩形隐私遮挡块遮住。她左手拿着一杯大口径杯装的浑浊淡黄色饮品靠近嘴边，右手在膝盖上拿着一本打开的旅行指南；可见的配饰包括修剪整齐的浅色指甲和几枚戒指。画面呈现温暖的黄金时刻阳光、光泽感的古铜色肌肤高光、柔和的阴影，左下角可见部分白色咖啡桌，左侧有玻璃门边缘，右下角隐约可见一个白色手提包。整体氛围优雅、充满度假魅力，既随性又精致，如同高端时尚 Instagram 胶片摄影风格，带有自然颗粒感、逼真的质感、柔和的粉色调、明亮的夏日光线、浅景深，且无任何额外文字或水印。

templates.title: Neon City Superbike Stunt

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹都市超级摩托车特技

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 ultra-realistic 35mm cinematic action photograph at night: a powerful male biker with {argument name="facial reference" default="a blurred square face placeholder matching an uploaded exact face reference"} stands balanced on top of a moving {argument name="motorcycle color and type" default="black-and-red superbike"} while performing a dangerous rolling stunt through the center of a futuristic city intersection. He is full body, centered, legs spread on the motorcycle, fists tense, leaning forward with intense confidence, wearing a black leather biker jacket, white tank top, ripped black skinny jeans with a silver chain, black boots, and a necklace. The superbike is angled toward the viewer with bright headlights, glossy red fairings, black trim, and sparks spraying from the lower right side as metal scrapes the wet asphalt. Surround the main rider with exactly 3 other motorcycles in motion: one blurred dark motorcycle passing on the left foreground, one rider with headlights behind the main bike near the center-right, and one red motorcycle farther right. Set the scene in a neon futuristic Times Square-style downtown canyon with tall skyscrapers, glowing cyan and magenta billboards, vertical digital ads, traffic lights, road lane markings, and reflections on rain-soaked pavement. Use dramatic teal-and-pink lighting, high contrast, shallow depth of field, motion blur on background riders, crisp focus on the main stunt rider and bike, low-angle perspective, intense speed, realistic lens flares, wet street reflections, and flying orange sparks. Keep the face area as the intended reference face/placeholder, no extra people in the foreground, no readable brand logos, no watermark, no text overlay except indistinct billboard graphics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 垂直超写实 35mm 电影感动作照片，场景设于夜间：一位强壮的男性骑手，面部为 {argument name="facial reference" default="与上传的精确面部参考相匹配的模糊方形占位符"}，正平衡站在一辆行驶中的 {argument name="motorcycle color and type" default="黑红配色超级摩托车"} 上，在未来派城市十字路口中心表演危险的滚动特技。全身镜头，居中构图，双腿跨在摩托车上，双拳紧握，身体前倾，神情充满自信，身穿黑色皮质机车夹克、白色背心、破洞黑色紧身牛仔裤配银色链条、黑色靴子及项链。超级摩托车车头朝向观众，配有明亮的前灯、光泽的红色整流罩、黑色饰件，金属刮擦湿润的沥青路面，右下角火花四溅。主骑手周围环绕着 3 辆处于运动状态的摩托车：左侧前景有一辆模糊的深色摩托车经过，主车右后方有一位带前灯的骑手，更右侧还有一辆红色摩托车。场景设定在霓虹闪烁的未来派时代广场风格市中心峡谷，背景是高耸的摩天大楼、发光的青色和洋红色广告牌、垂直数字广告、交通信号灯、道路标线以及雨后路面的倒影。采用戏剧性的青粉色调灯光，高对比度，浅景深，背景骑手带有动态模糊，主特技骑手和摩托车焦点清晰，低角度透视，强烈的速度感，逼真的镜头光晕，湿润街道的倒影，以及飞溅的橙色火花。保持面部区域为预期的参考面部或占位符，前景中无额外人物，无清晰可见的品牌标志，无水印，除模糊的广告牌图形外无任何文字覆盖。

templates.title: Sport Motorcycle Wheelie Street Photo

titleLocalized.zh: 运动摩托车翘头街拍照片

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical 35mm street photography image of {argument name="rider description" default="a young man"} performing a dramatic wheelie on a red and black sport motorcycle in the middle of a busy urban street. The motorcycle is the main focus, shot from a low front angle with the front wheel lifted high toward the camera and the rear wheel still on the asphalt. The rider wears {argument name="outfit" default="a black leather jacket over a white t-shirt, a gold chain necklace, ripped black jeans, and black boots"}, gripping the handlebars with a confident posture. The sport bike has an aggressive red fairing with black accents, bright headlights, a tinted windscreen, angular mirrors, thick front tire, exposed brake disc, and glossy bodywork. Add small bright sparks spraying from the lower right side near the rear wheel or footpeg as it scrapes the road. Set the scene on a city street lined with mid-rise buildings, storefronts, pedestrians gathered along the sidewalk, and cars in the background, all softly blurred with shallow depth of field. Use warm late-afternoon natural light, teal-and-orange cinematic color grading, realistic motion energy, detailed asphalt texture, subtle film grain, and a professional 35mm lens look. Composition should be portrait orientation, centered on the motorcycle and rider, with no readable text, no logos, and no extra vehicles blocking the subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感竖版 35mm 街拍图像，画面中 {argument name="rider description" default="一名年轻男子"} 正在繁忙的城市街道中央，驾驶一辆红黑相间的运动摩托车进行极具张力的翘头表演。摩托车是画面的核心，采用低角度正面拍摄，前轮高高抬起朝向镜头，后轮仍着地于沥青路面。骑手身着 {argument name="outfit" default="黑色皮夹克内搭白色 T 恤，佩戴金项链，穿着破洞黑色牛仔裤和黑色靴子"}，姿态自信地握住车把。这辆运动摩托车拥有激进的红色整流罩及黑色点缀、明亮的前大灯、深色挡风玻璃、棱角分明的后视镜、粗壮的前轮胎、外露的刹车盘以及光泽感十足的车身。在右下方靠近后轮或脚踏板处添加因摩擦路面而溅出的细小火花。场景设定在街道两旁林立着中层建筑和店面的城市街道，人行道上聚集着行人，背景中的车辆呈现出柔和的浅景深模糊效果。使用温暖的午后自然光，采用青橙色调的电影级色彩分级，展现真实的动态能量，呈现细腻的沥青纹理、微妙的胶片颗粒感以及专业的 35mm 镜头质感。构图采用竖屏方向，以摩托车和骑手为中心，画面中不应包含可辨认的文字、标志，也不应有其他车辆遮挡主体。

templates.title: Tokyo Neon Motorcycle Drift

titleLocalized.zh: 东京霓虹摩托车漂移

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 hyper-realistic 35mm street-photography action shot in a crowded Tokyo-inspired neon alley at night. A stylish male rider with {argument name="rider face" default="a naturally integrated but anonymized face"} is on a matte black sport motorcycle, captured low and close from the front-left as he performs a sideways drift on wet asphalt. He wears {argument name="rider outfit" default="a black leather sleeveless biker vest over a white T-shirt, gray cargo pants, black boots, bracelets, and rings"}; one boot scrapes the road and throws a bright shower of orange sparks while the bike leans aggressively. The motorcycle has a black fairing, tinted windscreen, twin headlights, gold front forks, exposed disc brakes, and glossy wet reflections. Surround the rider with smoke, mist, motion streaks, and a dramatic cinematic atmosphere. The alley is narrow, dark, and packed with blurred onlookers on both sides; include exactly 10 visible bystanders, all secondary and softly out of focus. Add exactly 8 prominent vertical neon signs in the background with Japanese-style characters: 4 on the left side, 3 on the right side, and 1 small distant sign in the center, using red, cyan, white, and pink glow. The wet road should show painted lane lines, puddles, and colorful neon reflections stretching toward the camera. Use {argument name="lighting style" default="moody cyberpunk neon with cool blue smoke and warm orange sparks"}, shallow depth of field, high contrast, realistic skin and fabric texture, crisp motorcycle detail, rain-slick pavement, dynamic motion blur, no cartoon styling, no extra text overlays, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖屏超写实 35mm 街头摄影动作照，场景设定在夜晚东京风格的拥挤霓虹小巷中。一位时尚的男性骑手，面部为 {argument name="rider face" default="自然融合但经过匿名化处理的面孔"}，正驾驶着一辆哑光黑运动摩托车，从左前方低角度近距离捕捉他正在湿沥青路面上进行侧向漂移的瞬间。他身着 {argument name="rider outfit" default="白色 T 恤外搭黑色无袖皮质机车马甲，配灰色工装裤、黑色靴子、手链和戒指"}；一只靴子擦过路面，溅起一串明亮的橙色火花，摩托车车身剧烈倾斜。摩托车配有黑色整流罩、深色挡风玻璃、双前大灯、金色前叉、外露盘式制动器，并带有光亮的湿润反射。周围环绕着烟雾、薄雾、动态拖影和极具电影感的氛围。小巷狭窄昏暗，两侧挤满了模糊的围观人群；画面中需包含恰好 10 位可见的旁观者，所有人物均为次要角色且虚化处理。背景中需包含恰好 8 个醒目的垂直霓虹灯牌，带有日式风格字符：左侧 4 个，右侧 3 个，中心远处 1 个，使用红色、青色、白色和粉色光效。湿润的路面应呈现出车道线、水洼以及向镜头延伸的绚丽霓虹倒影。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="忧郁的赛博朋克霓虹风格，伴有冷蓝色烟雾和暖橙色火花"}，浅景深，高对比度，真实的皮肤和织物纹理，清晰的摩托车细节，雨后湿滑的路面，动态运动模糊，拒绝卡通风格，无额外文字叠加，无水印。

templates.title: Cinematic Biker Powder Explosion

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感机车彩粉爆炸

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 cinematic 35mm action portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a powerful male biker"} riding a modern black street motorcycle directly toward the camera inside a dark industrial tunnel. The rider is centered and symmetrical, leaning forward aggressively with intense posture, both gloved hands gripping the handlebars, wearing a fitted black racing jacket with small motorsport patches, black pants, protective gloves, and two gold chain necklaces. His hair is short, dark, and slicked back; place a smooth rectangular blurred face area over the face as if anonymized. The motorcycle has a large glowing round headlight, amber side indicators, thick front tire, visible front forks, glossy black fender, and sharp realistic mechanical detail. Behind him, create one enormous explosion of colored powder made of exactly four dominant color clouds: bright cyan-blue on the left, vivid red across the center-left and right, hot yellow on the right, and small pink/magenta accents mixed near the top center. # Hepburn Style Heiress Birthday Portrait | 8 Individually Retouched Photos | Enhanced Birthday Elements Version | Open Source Stable Prompt

Please generate **8 different individually retouched photoshoot photos** at once based on 1-3 clear uploaded photos of the user, all in a **3:4 vertical composition**.

**"Hepburn Style Heiress Birthday Portrait"**

In addition to the Hepburn style, socialite feel, and retro elegance, the following must be enhanced:

- Birthday cake
- Lit candles
- Gift boxes
- Flower bouquets
- Champagne glasses
- Birthday dinner table
- Candlelight and golden light spots
- A sense of birthday ritual being celebrated and meticulously recorded

Overall temperament: 

**Hepburn style + Old Money Heiress + Retro Dinner + Elegant Birthday Commemorative Photo.**

---

## I. Person Consistency

Please strictly preserve the user's real identity characteristics, including but not limited to:

- Face shape
- Facial feature proportions
- Eye shape
- Nose shape
- Lip shape
- Skin tone
- Age appearance
- Hairline
- Facial bone structure
- Body foundation
- Personal temperament

The same real woman must be clearly recognizable in all 8 photos. 
Do not turn her into a stranger, do not westernize, do not follow influencer trends, do not over-smooth skin, and do not use AI 'fake' faces. 
High-end commercial retouching is allowed, but real identification and high-end retro portrait texture must be maintained.

---

## II. Core Temperament and Narrative

This set is not an ordinary "Princess Birthday Photo" or a cheap party photo. It should look like: 

**A noble retro commemorative portrait taken on the night of her birthday dinner by a high-born heiress who is seriously pampered and meticulously celebrated.**

Personality Keywords:

- Elegant
- Quiet
- Composed
- Noble
- Retro
- Bright but not gaudy
- Slight aloofness
- Female lead vibe
- The celebrated birthday protagonist

---

## III. Clothing and Styling

Uniform clothing: 

**Hepburn-style black off-the-shoulder evening gown / Black retro strapless dress / Black dinner-style puff-skirt dress**

Requirements:

- Classic black dress
- Highlighting the neck, collarbone, and elegant upper body lines
- Retro dinner vibe
- Skirt can have slight volume
- No exaggerated exposure
- No nightclub dress vibe
- No cheap studio gauze skirt feel

Matching:

## IV. Accessories, Hair, and Makeup

### Accessories
- Pearl choker

- No exaggerated modern trendy accessories

### Hair
- Hepburn-style high bun

- High chignon

- Reveal neck and collarbones

### Makeup
- Exquisite retro makeup
- Clear soft-mist base
- Clean eye makeup with a slight upward tilt at the outer corners
- Lip colors in dusty rose, soft reddish-brown, or classic nude red
- No heavy influencer makeup
- Overall look like an exquisite female lead in a classic movie

---

## V. Birthday Scene Design (Key Point)

The scene must clearly be:

**A retro dinner-style birthday studio scene**

Must include multiple of the following birthday elements, appearing alternately in different photos:

### Birthday Core Props
1. **Retro Birthday Cake**
   - 1 or 2-layer small birthday cake
   - Cream white / black gold / champagne white color scheme
   - Exquisite frosting
   - With slender lit candles
   - Can have a very small "Happy Birthday" cake topper, but no large-scale exaggerated text

2. **European Silver Candelabra**
   - Silver candelabra
   - White long candles
   - Provides dinner-style birthday atmosphere

3. **Gift Boxes**
   - Black, white, cream gold, champagne-colored gift boxes
   - Ribbon packaging
   - Few but exquisite
   - Reflects the feeling of an heiress receiving gifts for her birthday

4. **Flowers**
   - White roses / champagne roses / cream-white bouquets
   - Can be placed on the table or held

5. **Champagne Glass**
   - Retro coupe glass champagne glass
   - Used to enhance the birthday dinner atmosphere

6. **Birthday Confetti / Golden Shards**
   - Small amount falling
   - Only as atmosphere embellishment
   - Not too much, no nightclub vibe

### Scene Furniture and Layout
- Deep black background
- A small banquet table / dessert table
- A French chair / light-colored retro chair
- Tabletop can hold cake, candelabra, gift boxes, flowers, and champagne glasses
- Maintain high-end feel and white space, do not clutter

---

## VI. Lighting Requirements

Uniform lighting: 

**Warm golden candlelight dinner vibe + Soft main light + Filmic rim light + Foreground soft-focus bokeh**

Requirements:

- Overall warm golden atmosphere
- Clear face with glowing skin
- Soft candlelight
- Possible golden blurred bokeh in the foreground
- Slight lens flare
- Dreamy and expensive feeling of a birthday dinner

Avoid:

- Cold white studio light
- Cheap strong flash
- Nightclub colorful lights
- Too dark to see the face
- Heavy vintage "dirty" filters

---

## VII. 8 Shot Requirements (Birthday Element Explicit Version)

Please generate 8 different photos, each clearly containing a birthday narrative rather than just a simple pose.

### Shot 1: Birthday Main Visual Portrait
Person standing by the birthday table, side view or slight side view. Table has a retro birthday cake, lit candles, and silver candelabra. Like a main poster for the shoot. Highlights high bun, pearls, black dress, and candlelight.

### Shot 2: Cake Close-up
Person near the birthday cake, looking gently at the cake or down at the candles. Camera focuses on the face, cake, candlelight, and shoulder lines. Makes it instantly recognizable as a birthday.

### Shot 3: Ritual Before Blowing Candles
Person sitting by the table or chair, facing the cake with lit candles. Gloved hand touching the table or dress, leaning slightly towards the cake. Atmosphere is quiet, precious, and blessed.

### Shot 4: Holding Gift Box
Person holding an exquisite gift box, or box on lap. Candelabra and flowers nearby. Captures the heiress feeling of receiving birthday gifts.

### Shot 5: Flowers and Champagne Shot
Person sitting by a French chair, one hand on a champagne glass, the other touching flowers or chin. Table has cake and gifts. Like an elegant moment in a birthday dinner.

### Shot 6: Looking Back Over Shoulder
Person turns slightly, showing back/shoulder lines, looking back. Background has candles and falling gold confetti. Combines birthday vibe with Hepburn filmic style.

### Shot 7: Full Body Sitting Pose
Person sitting on a light-colored French chair, black dress spread out naturally. Birthday table visible with cake, gifts, and candelabra. Slightly wider composition to show the full scene.

### Shot 8: Final Commemorative Photo
Person looks down at a gift, cake, or small card. Warm golden bokeh in foreground, soft candlelight in background. Like a quiet commemorative photo taken before the birthday night ends.

---

## VIII. Photography Style

Overall reference styles:

- Audrey-inspired birthday portrait
- Old money birthday photoshoot
- Elegant heiress celebration portrait
- Black dress and pearl editorial
- Candlelight birthday photography
- Luxurious vintage birthday setup
- Cinematic birthday portrait

---

## IX. Negative Requirements

Please avoid the following:
- No cheap balloon clusters
- No cartoon birthday backdrops
- No colorful children's party vibe
- No nightclub style
- No influencer livestream vibe
- No plastic-looking cakes
- No cluttered props
- No mangled fingers
- No weird body proportions or limbs
- No over-smoothing of skin
- No vulgar sexiness
- No cheap wedding studio feel
- No Hepburn style without explicit birthday elements

## X. Final Summary

The final visuals should make people feel:

This is a Hepburn-style heiress portrait with a true "birthday commemorative feel." Not just black dresses, pearls, and high buns, but also explicit birthday cakes, candlelight, gifts, flowers, and dinner settings. templates.title: 12-Panel Spear Sakuga Storyboard
templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a monochrome anime action storyboard sheet for an animation fight sequence, full of rough sakuga energy: gestural, dynamic, and readable, like a choreography bible for animators. The subject is {argument name="character name" default="a long-haired robed spear warrior"} performing a spear-and-water combat ritual across exactly 12 panels.

Canvas: Wide horizontal storyboard board, 16:9 ratio, divided into an exact 3x4 grid with thick black panel borders. Each panel has a black number badge in the upper-left corner, numbered 01 through 12, with hand-lettered uppercase titles and small color-coded annotation notes.

Visual style: Grayscale ink-and-pencil concept art with loose sketch lines, dramatic motion blur, wind-torn cloth, flying hair, splashing water, ruined coastal towers, hanging lanterns, birds in the sky, and cinematic camera angles. Keep the art mostly black, white, and gray, but overlay clear colored animator annotations: red for camera movement, blue for body mechanics, green for weapon arc, orange for impact or lantern reaction, and purple for timing or hold beats. Annotation arrows should be hand-drawn, bright, and readable.

Layout and panel content: Include exactly 12 storyboard panels:

01 — SPEAR PLANT REVEAL: The warrior stands upright on flooded stone, spear planted vertically into the water. Distant towers and seabirds behind. Red arrows show a low front wide camera move, blue notes show still stance, green arrow shows spear vertical, purple rings at the feet show stillness.

02 — TIDE BREATH: Medium side shot. The warrior extends the spear horizontally while cloth and hair flow in the wind. Red note: medium side. Blue arrows: arms rise, inhale. Green arrow: spear lifts parallel. Purple timing mark: breath hold.

03 — FIRST SWEEP CUT: Dynamic tracking-wide shot of the warrior lunging into a wide sweeping spear cut, water exploding at the feet. Red annotation: tracking wide. Blue arrows: hip rotation, low sweep. Green arc sweeps left to right across the panel. Purple note: release.

04 — SPIRAL ENTRY: Overhead or high-angle spin view. The warrior rotates in a 360-degree spiral, robes forming circular motion. Red note: orbit follow. Blue: spin 360. Green: spear orbital loop. Purple: snap at top.

05 — SALTWATER STEP: Ground-tracking shot. The warrior steps forward through shallow seawater, spear trailing outward, ripples spreading. Red: ground tracking. Blue: cross step forward. Green: water ripples outward. Purple: weight shift.

06 — PILLAR VAULT: High-angle follow shot as the warrior vaults or leaps near a tall broken pillar. Red: high angle follow. Blue: upward vault, body extend. Green: spear trails below. Purple: airborne beat.

07 — DOWNWARD PLUNGE: Front low push-in. The warrior drives the spear downward into the ground or water, creating a violent burst. Red: front low push-in. Blue: two-hand strike descend. Green: spear vertical down. Orange: impact burst. Purple: hit snap.

08 — BLADE SPIN RECOVER: Wide side view recovery stance. The warrior pivots low while the spear loops tightly around the body. Red: wide side view. Blue: behind-back loop, recover stance. Green: tight spear loop. Purple: reset breath.

09 — LANTERN PASS: Rear three-quarter composition with the warrior passing under hanging lanterns, spear extended across the frame. Red: rear 3/4. Blue: tip graze precise line. Green: spear tip path. Orange: lanterns sway, chain reaction. Purple: soft snap.

10 — TIDE SILHOUETTE: Extreme low wide shot. The warrior poses dramatically on a broken stone platform against a towering wave. Red: extreme low wide. Blue: full body pose. Green: spear overhead arc. Purple: hero pause.

11 — ROBES-TO-WATER CUT: Tracking front shot. The warrior slashes downward through water, robes whipping into the motion. Red: tracking front. Blue: slide descend steps. Green: robes trail through water. Purple: controlled flow decay.

12 — RITE UNFINISHED: Wide hero shot at sunset or pale dawn. The warrior stands facing the horizon, spear leveled forward, ocean ruins and a glowing sun in the distance. Red: wide hero shot. Blue: stand and level forward. Green: spear leveled at horizon. Purple: forward intent.

Text content: Use hand-lettered English titles exactly as listed for all 12 panels. Add small colored notes inside each panel, matching the listed red, blue, green, orange, and purple annotations. Optional main design emphasis: {argument name="motion emphasis" default="water-spear choreography with readable animation planning arrows"}.

Constraints: Exactly 12 panels in a 3x4 grid, no extra panels. Preserve the locked annotation color key: red camera, blue body, green weapon arc, orange impact, purple timing. Keep the image mostly monochrome with only the annotation colors vivid. Avoid polished clean lineart; keep it rough, energetic, cinematic, and storyboard-like.
